review: A very welcoming community, convenient location, overall some pretty good living
Union 505 is in a great location for Albuquerque. The amenities offered are pretty nice so you can enjoy yourself here with a positive attitude.

My Experience here at union505 is good only thing I would like to see is more adults instead of young kids taking the pets out due to pulling or barking dogs but ya ?? union505 apartment's I'm Settling in an I feel good Thank You!!!!!!
I love the apartment. Its very cozy and straightforward. I just wish the hot water was hotter. But I would definitely recommend this place to others.
The apartments are very spacious. The leasing office is really awesome. And if you have any maintenance request they will get it done for you.
Apartment wasn’t in good shape when I moved in also people haven’t been picking up after their dogs go out along with not being tied up on a leash and there’s a lot of roaches

Hot tub has been broken for almost a year. Management is unprofessional and rude. Office loses packages, got one 3 months after it was delivered. management sends emails not to let dogs on property without a leash, to park in one space, and not to smoke in common areas, however management does these things all the time.

My husband and I moved to Diamond Elite Luxury homes while our home is being built. We love that it’s a gated community with security present to keep us safe and secure. The staff are friendly and always willing to help. They that manages all of our mail and packages. We enjoy and take advantage of the free amenities on-site which include a well equipped gym, sauna, pool and jacuzzi. We recommend these homes to friends and family.

This is absolute worst place to live there is roaches all over the place the management is poor they will do anything to get extra money out of you. They do roommate matching but it is pointless because you get people who are total opposites and make the living horrible. The water is cold and when you call they do nothing. this is the most unsafe place to live there is shootings and stabbings there is also bad parties with fights. They also have people living there that have house with extra people. There are some houses with pets that are not allowed like rats, snakes, guinea pigs. THIS PLACE IS THE ABSOLUTE WORST AND UNSAFE DO NOT LIVE HERE.
this is the worst place to live. it is cheap but it has rude staff and horrible communication

I have been at The View for about two years now so I feel that I can leave a very honest review. Although maintenance and student staff (NOT management) are very nice and professional, there are many things to look out for before you sign a lease. Over the years that I have been here, my rent has gone up by $100-120, they started charging for utilities on top of the rent increase, and there have been many poor management changes. They will try to squeeze any last penny out of you, and I realize that many apartment complexes run in a similar way but it seems ludicrous when they ask you to do things like share 1 tiny fridge for 5 people. Towards the end of last year and this year, there have been HUGE security and safety issues. Residents and visitors have been shot, stabbed, and even murdered. The front gate is always broken and although there is some effort to have security at the front of the property at times, after a while it seems like they just give up and the problems start happening again. Someone was killed just three houses down from me, my valuables and friends' valuables have been taken, and our apartment has been broken into multiple times. Any attempt to get help and answers regarding these issues are disregarded. The huge security issues, fees, and lack of professionalism make this a difficult place to live. If management were more responsive and helpful, security precautions were taken more seriously, and rent/ fees didn't unexpectedly  increase, I would've loved living here and never wanted leave.

I stayed in the 5 Bedroom town home for a year. I requested an upstairs room but got assigned a downstairs room instead. Everything seemed fine at first but after a while my room mates would come back at 2 in the morning with non resident friends drunk screaming and having the tv volume maxed out late at night while i tried to sleep for work. Everyone drives around like its a road course. security lets everyone in no matter if they are a resident or not. parking lots get full due o non residents. This Property is a hit or miss.

They are super unhelpful.
Overpriced.
Really bad security. 
Thefts from porch and mail room broken into.
Insane cancellation fees.
Quiet place with lovely views. Located near lots of shopping.
Copper Hills Apartments is a very nice Community,  I AM happy to be here.
Excellent administrative staff and maintenance crew. Great location.
The Maintenance team was very professional, and I have always been happy with the work that they do in any Maintenance task
Great location, one of the better apartment residences in Albuquerque, definitely.
They have always been there for the tenants, and my mother who lived here with me for her last days loved it too
RUDE management, never answers the call. Stood outside the office & called them, and watched them ignore my call. AC hasn’t worked in months.  No maintenance. This place is absolute trash

Have mold growing thru the paint on the walls wont do anything about it. The walls at the base are cracking wont do anything about it. My kitchen light is humming loudly they wont do anything!!!! THEY DONT DO ANYTHING TO FIX WHATS WRONG!!

They will take you money and not do any repairs! They won't answer your calls and won't do anything to make your experience pleasant. The units look very poorly remodeled. And they paint over the black mold instead of getting rid of it. Serious health hazard.

I didn’t have a good experience while living at Dorado Heights. 

The manger would be standing in my living room after I finished showering. This happened twice. I finished showering and opened the bathroom door and the male manger was standing in my living room just staring at me. 
I became upset and threatened to call 911 but the manger said he could walk in my apartment whenever he wanted and then walked out of my apartment.

I moved my brother in and the manger never bothered me again. I would have broke my lease but I was living paycheck to paycheck. 

I would advise renting elsewhere, especially if you’re a women.

My apartment isn't just a place to live. Its my home. The staff and maintenance crew are phenomenal. I've been to many a place and have recognized that there is a trend of maintenance taking an overly extended period of time before they fix any issues. Here at my home they easily say with confidence that whatever the issue they will get to and fix it within just a few days. Thus far they have not let me or any other tenants down with their word. The location is beyond exquisite. With it being located at the base of The Sandia's it an amazing view of the City. Just a very short commute to almost anywhere in the city anyone would want to visit. Oh! And not to mention the specials they have going for their vacancies are beyond words to explain how close cut they are to the best deal in town! I love this place, and with the 24 hour gym, seasonal outdoor patio grills and pool, and laundry facility just makes it even more worth the time and money spent to Hang your Hat here.

Dorado Heights has been a fair place to live, but unfortunately has gone slightly down hill as far as future renters are concerned. I have lived at this complex for well over 12 years and have wached more and more long term residents leave because of new resident problems. It is very sad to see so few people who have little or no pride for where they live and little respect for neighbors as well as their property. The current owners of the property don't seem to care how down hill the complex is looking lately. Energy efficiant apliances as well as ciling fans would be a BIG improvment as well as a great rental point.
Maintenance work is handled well, in a timely and professional manner, increased our feeling of security here in Uptown Squares.
The location is great and the views are beautiful.
Very nice staff here at Uptown Square. We are very happy with our new home here. Love our new apt.
This truly feels like home.  Great Community.  Thank you!

Overall Uptown Square is a safe conveniently located place to live. It also seems to be a reasonably priced rental. Management is very responsive, and the apartments are refurbished nicely when you move in.

One of the nicer neighborhoods in Albuquerque and very conveniently located. The security is good and, although old, the complex is well maintained. The apartments seem to be well built and have been nicely updated.
A beautiful place to live.  Nice amenities.  Very professional, yet with a feeling of community.
A great place to live.  Our neighbors feel like family.  We also appreciate the gated community feel.  Thank you
Very convenient location for access to shopping, restaurants, public transportation, and bike paths.

I lived there for 18 months, two years ago.  Staff was very nice.  Repairs were always done promptly.  However:  (1)  The apartment complex went HUD, during the time I lived there, and current residents were not informed.  It took all of us a while to figure out what was going on.  (2) The pool was always dirty -- always.  (3) There is a cell phone tower on top of one of the two buildings, which was put up while I was there, and residents weren't informed of that either; (4) The 'state of the art' workout room consists of two treadmills and a TV.  Last but not least, I have no idea how they measure utility bills but my monthly bills -- and a lot of others' bills -- were extremely high every month, and there was no way to check to make sure that we were being billed properly.  I don't think I was ever intentionally cheated, but I do think that the staff -- the one(s) who figured out these bills -- didn't always know what they were doing when it came to correctly figuring out these bills.

As I said, the staff was very nice, repairs are done quickly, and the views, for most of the apartments, are gorgeous.  But the monthly rents and utility bills were (and still are) outrageous for those of us who were not HUD.  And unless there has been a real makeover in the past two years, the whole place is a little shabby, simply from wear and tear over the years.

Located in Albuquerque's Uptown area, Uptown Square has so much to offer.  The Apartments are solidly built, concrete construction.  The units have high ceilings, and spacious rooms.  There are also large balconies or porches for every unit.  There is a large community room, a media center & library, a combination indoor-outdoor pool, jacuzzi, dry heat saunas, and fitness center.  There is a controlled access parking lot with carports and garages.  Access to each of the two buildings is controlled by key or a keypad system if you have company.  We feel very safe and protected here.  There is a huge sense of community, and it feels like having an extended family.  There are a number of residents who have lived here for more than 30 years.  My husband and I have just signed our 14th lease.  We know most of our neighbors and we love living in a high-rise building.  Our neighbors and the staff are wonderful.  We are also close to three shopping malls, a Trader Joe's, good schools, and a number of restaurants, cafes, and local businesses.  I often tell new tenants that they are not just getting an apartment - they are getting a family along with a beautiful place to live.  My husband and I are so happy here that we wouldn't think of living anywhere else.

I lived in this complex for 2 years and loved it. I lived on the 7th floor and had the best view in Albuquerque. My place was quiet, which is my number one thing when choosing a place to live. Staff was courteous and maintenance was prompt.

I hope to return to this place someday.
After a month this place is all you could want - location, quiet, cheap and clean. What more could you want?

While searching for an apartment, the lady I spoke to was very nice and informative. She took the time and gave me all the information I needed. She was knowledgeable and responded to my questions in a timely manner. I was referred to the location by friends who know the area.

only lived here for 6 months and I cannot stress enough how poor these apartments are kept clean. they've marked my pest control requests as completed without spraying, which is shady at best. water turn offs without notification, and the washers and dryers are always broken. would not recommend this complex to ANYONE. unless you like roaches crawling everywhere and your vehicles getting booted for no reason.

The pool was closed until Sept and then closed again weeks later, on-site laundry has 1 or 2 working machines but the water's constantly off, out bldg has been without water 10 times in the last 6 months (for days at a time). You can find better for the same price if you just look around.

For one, this place doesn’t care about the requests you put in to fix things. I’ve input several requests and no one has showed up, for almost a year. I follow up but just get told to put in another request (???????) Also, the management is so unprofessional, my roommate signed his name off the lease but their name still appears on the lease agreement and they told me he has to to come in to sign his name off even though WE BOTH went to the office to sign his name off. This said friend now lives half way across the country and is extremely disappointed by this as well as he has to make a trip back to sign his name off AGAIN. Oh! They told me to remove my vehicle off the property or else it will get towed since it stays parked in one spot; I’ve informed them that I work from home and stay home most the time  and don’t go out because it was still a pandemic and I feared for my health but they didn’t care and told me to remove my car from their property or else the tow will come and get it. My vehicle is working and nothing is wrong with it. Tags are up to date, insurance is paid, but I just don’t go anywhere. They lock the laundry room even though your still doing your laundry and when you’re not doing laundry, the doors are wide open all night and washers/dryers are broken. They started locking the doors before they put up the sign for the laundry hours! IVE WASTED MONEY ON THIS AND HAD WET CLOTHES SIT IN THE WASHER ALL NIGHT for days until they finally put a sign up! Bugs everywhere, no matter how much I clean and clean and clean, bugs are just everywhere and they won’t do anything about it! I’m moving out, if you can put up with unprofessionalism and filth, then this place is the perfect spot for you!

So happy to see all the wonderful improvements here, especially now to have all gates.  Ignore the prior reviews, this has changed for the best!!! Team is very attentive and kind, so happy I live here.

Management does not deal with issues on a timely manner. It has occurred multiple times where we have to call a number of times to get issues resolved. Usually have to wait at least a month to get it fixed.

Sunset point used to be great but has become terrible over the past year and a half. First the elevators were constantly out of service which was very difficult when you live on the 4th floor, next the plumbing, they have turned off the water at least once a week due to emergencys for the last 8 months. Then they changed to having an outside service process the electric bills, which then doubled since they started charging us for water trash sewer etc. To top all that they have decided to rent out the office and pool for a movie, which is taking at least half of the residents parking including the covered parking which is paid for by renters without offering any compensation to it's resident s for the inconvenience, yet they are getting paid to do it. Save your money go elsewhere. I know I sure am.
This place is beautiful very well maintained very well priced I've never had any issues 10/10 would recommend

For the first couple months it was awesome, but then it was bad. Our car was stolen things got taken off the door, management won’t do anything to help you find anything that’s stolen. I’ve talked to neighbors and people have all said the same thing it is horrible living here. The cameras said are no where to be found. Security doesn’t help with anything. The only good thing is the maintenance men who are angels and always helpful. Management is the worst by far here. Your bills and cars WILL be stolen and no one will do anything to help you

I love living here. The building is very solid that has great sound insulation. I am never bothered by noises from neighbors next doors or upstairs. The courtyard is beautiful and has a couple of grills. I enjoy having barbecue, sitting under the tree shade in the courtyard in summer time. I will definitely recommend here.

Been here 5 years. Love the courtyard. The roses and stream are so beautiful. It is very beautiful during a rainy day. The staff are awesome and during the pandemic still can smile and wave hi through closed doors.

I’ve been here for a year and plan to renew my lease for many years. A well maintained courtyard, nice pool, great gym and recreation room. Excellent office and maintenance staff. They probably should hire a new elevator repair company because at times it stops working in the winter and the company isn’t reliable. Other than that, I love it here!
Beautiful central courtyard with a stream and a pool. The staff is wonderful and I never heard my neighbors because of the cement slab construction. I loved living here!

This place doesn’t deserve one star. 
 Don’t rent here. The office staff are rude and unprofessional. Jennifer and Jaime don’t know what customer service means. The property is not safe, my car was broken into multiple times and the office didn’t do anything or care.  In the leasing office there are cameras showing areas around the property but it doesn’t matter because when there is a break in the staff won’t be bothered to review them.  The windows don’t lock, and when I tried to secure my window with a stick, A note was placed on my door saying it needed to be removed or I would be fined. 
There are signs all around the property from the Albuquerque police warning residents to lock their cars. The only reason there are any good reviews is because Sunset point pays residents to write good reviews for them. The apartment complex is four stories high and even though there are two elevators, they are broken more often than not.
The apartments are old and bugs are everywhere.  If you’re looking for a new home, look elsewhere. The only positive are the maintenance staff. They are very nice.

I have lived in this apartment for 2 and a half years and it has only gotten worse since I moved in. Our bathroom shower has a leaky ceiling that drains into the tub whenever it rains. This has been reported 5 times over the course of my stay here and never once has it been looked at. In late 2017, the water was shut off almost every other day with little warning or explanation as to why; at one point one of the notices claimed "too many people were using their water" for them to fix whatever they needed to be fixed so they had to do it again, which sounds made up and puts blame on the tenants for no reason. The elevator constantly breaks down and is fixed only to sound as if it will fall apart on the same day. My pregnant wife was once stuck between floors on the elevator and had to pry the door open to crawl out. Add this to some problems in the office, in which my wife's application to be added to the lease was unwittingly shredded and their lack of lenience over being late for the first time in over two years on rent by only hours, it is apparent they do not care and only see their tenants as dollar signs. Can't wait until this lease ends in 2018!

I wrote a review a while back I believe I gave it three stars but I'm changing it to four stars because I've noticed big attitude change with one of the staff members. They deserve five stars because of how tidy they keep this  complex. The gym is always clean, and the pool has NEVER been dirty. Other than one girl, the staff has always been more than welcoming. But her attitude has changed so my rating has changed. But I am giving it a four-star review because when I moved in we were told to not turn off the air conditioner I usually have all the lights off and don't use the gas a lot but my utility bill is around $200 a month because of the fact that we have five fans in the house and are constantly running air conditioner. And it's STILL HOT. I have a buddy that lives here as well and he has the same problem. Other then that I am happy and satisfied with this apartment.

Very friendly staff at first, but don't really feel very welcome after you move in. Any little thing comes up and you get a 7 day notice, before even a phone call. My friend got one for leaving his flip flops outside his door, and I got one for my service dog pooping in the courtyards. I love my apartment besides the fact it almost caught fire while I was asleep due to my faulty air conditioner. Speaking of my air conditioner, my apartment reaches 100 degrees while the air conditioner is on HIGH, there's really nothing they can do about it I guess. Also, If my service dog even pees on their holy grass my home will be lost, I already have been verbally warned. Other then all that, the laundry facilities are up to par, the pool is always clean, the scenery is beautiful, the area is ok. I say the area is just ok because of the Montgomery drag racing in the middle of the night. Any apartment in Albuquerque isn't very "homie" I have lived in about 10 different complexes and they're all the same. Just look forward to the day of home owning.

I've always lived in a house and this was my first appartment living in. From the outside you wouldn't think there as nice as they are. I was skeptical at first but I'm so glad I got a tour. I fell in love instantly! So much more sq feet than what you would pay for in other places for less Sq footage. It's peaceful and quiet here and I never have problems with my neighbors. Management always fixes your issues right away if there's any concerns. It's pet friendly which is a plus since I have a Chihuahua attached to my hip. And it's conveniently located near everything. I've lived here for almost 6 months and plan to renew my lease. For my first appartment I'm very impressed!

I have been living here for 2 years and enjoy everything it has it to offer very quiet and Neighbor's are polite maintenance and office are always on top of everything that needs to be done in the apartment I highly recommend this apartment

I have lived at Sunset Pointe Apts. for several years. 
There are several people who have been here longer than me. The staff put on community events like pot lucks and catered get-togethers for the residents. If I have a problem they usually address it immediately. They fix anything that is wrong usually within a day. Inspection and replacement of fire alarm batteries, heating and air conditioner filters are done bi-yearly. The grounds and public areas are well maintained by regular staff and professional landscapers.
It is near by and assessable to everything. Good restaurants, grocery stores, parks and so much more.
And most importantly the apartments are filled with wonderful light! My orchids and other plants love it!

We've been here at Sunset Pointe for about a year now and we absolutely love it! All staff are very helpful and all neighbors are kind! The scenery is beautiful and peaceful. Here at sunset pointe its a very quiet and safe place to live. I highly recommend Sunset Pointe if you are looking for a beautiful, safe place to live!

We love this place! It does't look look like anything special from the outside, but the inside is beautiful. We love the "babbling brook" outside our our unit and we can't wait for our little ones (1st one on the way!) to enjoy the playground.  The apartments don't have the more luxurious features (gas stoves, laundry in unit, fireplaces etc) of some of the other places we've looked at, but then again they are over $100/month cheaper.  The staff has been nothing but friendly and the office hours are the best we have seen anywhere. We plan to stay here until we can afford to buy a home of our own.

Worst experience ever!!! We'll never try this place for living and call it our next home at any price and would continue to communicate our first experience with the property senior management:  On Saturday 10/22 2016, I and my spouse with our two kids (one three months old) went to see the complex at 4:10pm local time. We called the leasing office in advance. Unfortunately, my spouse did forget to bring her State ID while she had her CNM (Photo ID) and original SOCIAL SECURITY card -- which wasn't accepted by this unprofessional and with less customer service experience lady (Jennifer) at the property's leasing office. She demanded for her State ID, so I decided to drive back home and grab her State ID. The lady told us if we could make it back by 430pm, we will be able to see the property. So, we did return with the requested ID at 429pm according to leasing office "WALL CLOCK" and didn't know that this unprofessional lady will make another stupid excuse; she told us that her computer clock is 431pm now, so she cannot proceed with the request. We were totally shocked and tried showing her the leasing office WALL CLOCK which was 429pm but she ignored and kept telling us that her computer clock shows 431pm and she does not go by WALL CLOCK. She turned her face and didn't talk further, she never apologized for the inconvenience.   Her reaction was so rude that we can't explain in writing.

Nothing about these apartments is worth renting from here. Overpriced, better off paying a mortgage than the rent. Terribly put together and renovated, nothing is fixed appropriately. Maintenance doesn’t fix anything, ignores requests and enters apartments completely unannounced and with no notice. Squatters using vacant apartments, they now have electronic locks with passcodes, so someone within the company must be giving out codes for others to access and use. Random people always walking through the complex, feels very unsafe. No pest control, bugs all over the place so use your own bug spray to keep them out or dead. Vinyl floor splits and comes up as the floor is uneven, gaps between the floorboards and ground. Emergency water shut offs every other week, apartments smell of septic and backed up water often. The office does not care about your needs or issues and just pushes them off with nothing done to fix the issue. I could go on and on about how awful this place is, but this is the basis of most of it.

Do not expect to be able to use amenities listed such as the Swimming pool, Fitness center, Clubhouse, Business center, or Controlled access gates. The photos provided are also not an accurate representation of what your apartment may look like. Please take the time to tour the apartments before moving in. And if you can, speak to a resident or two about their experience living here.

This complex is in a convenient location, fairly priced for the area, and the grounds are very large and perfect for walking. My only real complaint is about the transparency, and the amenities. We were told the fitness center and rec building would be open early May, both verbally and in email, and those are still yet to available for use. There are also two pools on sight, both full of water, with umbrellas put out and lights on, that are also not open. This is a bit more frustrating since we do pay a monthly amenities fee. The apartment themselves are also nice, with upgraded amenities if you pay extra, but this place would really be worth it with better communication, and the opening of these facilities.

The staff is awful they don't offer half of the things they up charge you for.If you need to talk to office staff plan on calling 5 times before you get a answer if you are lucky and the office people like to argue with you and escalate situations they do work on your apartment without the 24 hour notice and act like it's no big deal the gates have been broken for 2 years already the lighting is awful it's pitch black all around the complex at night so crime happens alot stolen cars all the time car alarms going off in the middle of the night. Children unable to play in the grassy area due to there being needles left out by people who come on the property at night. Washers and dryers in the laundry areas are always broken so you just waste money they don't reimburse you cause they didn't work.The paint jobs are awful the guy is painting with black paint in a water bottle with the lid cut off not very professional job being done on the windows or paint.just save your self the trouble and move somewhere better

We moved out 2 months ago and have been waiting for our deposit refund and a refund for being charged double for our utilities the last month of our lease ever since. I have spoken at length about this issue with Ben, the Assistant Property Manager, and Bobbie, the Property Manager, with no success. Calling to speak with someone warrants no response, going in to speak with either one warrants no response. Bobbie telling me that she would contact me by email or phone call by a specific date warranted no response.

We received our move-out statement within 2 weeks of the end of our lease, but since have had to follow-up on multiple occasions with no resolve. Their excuse is that they changed systems and that their accounts payable department is behind. Our previous apartment was occupied within a few weeks of our departure, and yet they cannot refund us our hundreds of dollars that we are owed. I am tired of having to use my days off to go into the office to be given the same run-around every time. Last time I spoke with Bobbie, she gave me a check number that had supposedly been cut for one of our refunds, which meant essentially nothing to me as I had no way of verifying this with anyone. A check number does no good to me if I have no check. I have been more than patient with this process and just want it resolved.

The new owners are great at projects to upgrade the community, however fail completely to give residents even a courtesy notice of work to be done on their building. Just this morning, for example, an email blast was sent out about a project at the dog park. However absolutely no notice has been given to residents when their roof, or windows, or sidewalk outside, will be replaced. Apparently seeing work done around the complex is expected to serve as a notification that someone will be dropping a pallet of supplies on your roof, jack-hammering up the sidewalk outside your bedroom window, or entering your home sometime soon to do some work.

I do not recommend this complex to anyone! The maintenance is horrible and they charge you for things that should be handled by property maintenance. The complex constantly shuts off water to different buildings. The dog poop is never cleaned, and is everywhere on the property. Crime runs rampant in this complex and has no signs of slowing down. Management is only concerned with signing new tenants. Once your lease is signed they do not care about you! Don’t be fooled by the brand new paint on buildings, or the newly outfitted appliances. This complex is run down, and the management fails you at every step of the way.

The first half of the time I lived here there were ants constantly and occasionally roaches in the apartment.  Maybe we have a new exterminator because that issue has been resolved.  There are still issues with vents not blowing hot or cool air effectively (in the bedrooms or to the dryer).  And I have had numerous issues with faulty appliances and leaks in the kitchen.  The maintenance team is personable and responsive.  I get the feeling their hands may be tied by management as to what they can replace in the apartments?  Though I don't know that we needed it, the paint job is beautiful. Numerous things are being upgraded.  I look forward to seeing and experiencing it once all is said and done. Lastly, this neighborhood and being backed up to two trailheads is great!

Both my husband and I have lived here for 18 years. We've seen the property go through many changes. Our concerns were laid to rest when the Greystar Management team took over. We want to express our thanks and gratitude to the Maintenance Supervisor Jeremy and his crew, who handled our emergency air condition issue and stove replacement  with care, courtesy and professionalism.  Also, a shout out to two wonderful leasing agents Sindy and Sarah, whom you can easily reach out to in addressing and solving any issues that may arise.

At first I loved living here but after a year, it’s over priced, maintenance doesn’t come to fix anything. I’ve been trying to have maintenance come check my washer machine due to some leaking and not draining water and it’s been over 3 weeks. I’ve been having to clean up water from the leak every few days. My apartment has a den and above us is a patio and every time it rains water leaks from the ceiling and it’s starting to have a smell. I’ve told maintenance and they told me to leave a towel or bucket out for the leaks and that they were going to repair all the balcony’s so it would prevent leaks but I was told that in March and it is now December. I’ve tried to get rid of the smell and when someone finally came to check the washer machine he said it was fine but all he did was start the washer and left which left it leaking the next day. I brought up the smell and he told me it was mildew and said “it would go away when the washer machine started working” so far it has not gone away. I keep my apartment very clean and I cannot get rid of the smell. Also neighbors steal packages and leave dog poop bags outside their doors or at others. Then the doggy bags are never refilled so everyone doesn’t pickup after their pets. Also leasing office never picks up phone.

New staff is rude. Paperwork wasn't handled correctly and to hear back I had to reach out multiple times. Long wait time for maintenance. Just didn't enjoy my experience there, I've had much nicer and more capable interactions with other apartment complexes.

First let me say the girls in the office are amazing. Sweet and helpful all the time. However, maintenance is a joke. We would have important things happen like toilets not working, dishwasher not working, AC making a mess leaking water and it would take at least 2 weeks for them to come out to look at it. They would then have to order a part which would take another week or two. It shouldn’t take a month to get basic repairs done.

Rent is too high for what you get. The pools are freezing cold all year round.
Hard to believe I’ve been here that long. 6  years. Great community atmosphere. Natural landscaping. Comfortable apartment. Close to stores.

I would like to express my appreciation for Vanessa from the management team, who was incredibly helpful and made the entire process seamless. While I have only been a resident of Sun Plaza Apartments for a month I can say that my neighbors have been great, with the exception of one. I have also submitted a few service requests through the portal and hope they will be addressed soon. I would like to request the implementation of security services at night, as my car was previously targeted for a break-in. Aside from this concern, I have nothing else to report. My experience with Sun Plaza so far has been great, the atmosphere is nice, neighbors are ok. Love that there is a laundry mat and small gym in the community, It’s quiet and calm at nights. Vanessa in the front office is amazing she is friendly, attentive and caring she has been so amazing helped us throughout the whole process she communicated well via phone and email. For the most part it is better here than some of the other places in area that aren't gated. Management has changed a couple of times since I been here; however, they all were to me pleasant and helpful.

Overall The apartments are an old community, the main problem I have had is with roaches and plumbing. I’ve been here for 5  years. 
Very comfortable the whole time.
Maintenance sucks put a band aid on it it will be fine
Sun Plaza is a very comfortable place to live. It is a fairly large community (several buildings) and is very well managed. Surroundings and landscaping is pleasant also.
Some of the worst apartments on Montgomery. Overpriced decaying buildings, new management every year.
This is year 5 for me here. Been very comfortable and glad to be here.
Overall, it is okay here. However, they call the stairway a balcony and it really is not.

I've been here for 5 years. been very comfortable from the start and continuing.

Nice community and great service from the office staff.
Its such a scary place to live in, theres always roaches in patios and roaming around the house, spiders everywhere also.

HUSTLERS. They tow your car with no warning OR boot it without communicating with you first. It's ok but no pool no washer dryer in the apartment

Thank you all for making our our home a better,cleaner and safer place to live,I have lived here 3 years and just signed another lease,we have had a lot of different management throughout my 3 years here and because of last management,I planned on moving do to broken promises,however seeing the positive changes Melanie and her staff has made,and the hard work they have put forward to better our community has made me want to continue my home here,and I'd recommend Copper Ridge as your home to,come in and meet the staff you'll feel right at home before you and your family even see what our community and staff has to Offer???????Thank you to all the staff for your hard work and commitment ??

We have new management in less than 3 months this place has gone down hill. I've lived here for ten years. I will be moving as soon as my lease is up. There are fights and cops here often I have seen them. There is a bed bug and roach issue. When I reported it I was told it was my fault. Ten years never a bug. The management here isn't as sweet as they seem. I have personally been yelled at snapped at and hung up on. Most of the facilities here are down or do not work. Also they say there is security there is none.

This was never the perfect place to live. It was good enough.  Now we have a new management company and I want to give them the benefit of the doubt but after unfulfilled promises and waiting over a  for my air conditioner fixed, I'm done.  If you're looking for a cheap place to live then copper ridge is fine just don't expect too much. Yes there's a fitness room but the only machine that is plugged in is the treadmill. There are two laundry facilities that run on a card system. You have to buy a card and put money on the card in order to use them. You can't just add time to your dryer, you have to pay for another cycle.  The business center is a room with two computers.   All of our mailboxes have been broken into and they've installed new ones but I know those can be broken into as well.  There's also a church nearby that solicited everyone and actually walk through the property to talk about their church.  The only good thing is the utilities really are a flat rate (although they have been known to raise the price even if you're not renewing the lease).

I really do enjoy this apartment. Great for the price of a three bedroom, all utilities are included in the rent. Great neighborhood, kinda secluded in the foothills area which is great for those that like their privacy.  Nice, clean, and roomy apartments. Staff here are really nice and helpful. The only downside is all the paperwork required. This is the first apartment I lived in that requires renters insurance. Along with the paperwork for pets (registration, current vaccination). But other that, 3.5 stars out of 5.

I barely moved at the location and I have to the Landlords and the neighbors are very nice and friendly also looking out for each other. I am very thankful for a best community and invite of anyone for a picnic on a special occasion. Great for kids and all pet lovers.
Old run down apartment interiors, water is always being shut off for repairs, rude staff, ridiculous fines — not worth the price.

Lived in 909 for 10 months 2019 and 2020. The apartment had been “upgrade,” which seems to mean dark, faux-wood vinyl flooring was added. Maintenance was adequate, but long term damage like water damage in the bathroom to cabinet exteriors was not addressed. Lighting in the bathrooms and the medicine cabinet were circa 1970. The kitchen stove was also 20the century electric coil. No microwave.

When I left management hit me for their costs to clean carpets and paint — the usual maintenance that properties need to do without my money. They then claimed I didn’t pay the last water bill — cuz they took that money for their use — and then reported me to collections.

Also while there. My bicycle was stolen and an attempt to steal my motorcycle failed. Cost $900 to repair that botched hot wiring attempt. Management was not able to assist with any sort of reasonable standards security measures, like cameras in the parking lot. 

I see the price for my apartment has gone up by $700.

DO NOT MOVE IN HERE! I was renting a unit at Alvarado when the previous property management group was running the building and things were alright, until the new management company took over. I was renting a W/D from an appliance rental company (at the suggestion of the previous management group) and after I moved out, but before a new tenant moved in, somebody working for the building lost or discarded a perfectly good washer/dryer that did not belong to them, or to me, and now I have to pay for the lost equipment. Granted, I should've had the equipment picked up before I left, but Alvarado also should not have thrown out or lost heavy equipment that didn't belong to them, and they were at all confused about it, they should've just contacted me to ask about it. I've called many times to try to get to the bottom of this and they refuse to call me back. If I could afford a lawyer, I would get one, but of course I can't, and they know that, so they continue to ignore me. They've also refused to fix the hot tub, never clean the pool (which is often locked in the middle of the day for no reason at all), and raised rent throughout the entire pandemic. When they first took over managing the building they didn't have their online rent portal working yet and forced everybody to pay rent in physical checks. I told them that my bank doesn't issue checks (as is true with many banks these days) they told me that I had to pay via money order from Smiths. I asked when the online portal would be up and they said they didn't know. I asked, if it was only going to be a week or two, I could wait to pay until they got their act together and fixed their website and I was then threatened with eviction with all the cavalier attitude as somebody commenting on the weather. Oh, I almost forgot to mention that they turn off the water for maintenance at least once a week for an entire day at a time, with absolutely no warning at all. These people do not care about you as a human being, they only want your money and if something goes wrong they take no personal responsibility. RUN AWAY AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

This place is not a good place. For one year, I had the worse experience here, it is better to live somewhere else. 
The building I lived in was so old that maintenance tries to "update" it to this year style, that's not true, you can tell where the building is cracking.  That was just the outside of the apartment complex. The apartment interior was horrible. The paint peels off quickly that you cannot hang anything, the floors  are uneven, a huge bump in the carpet, the kitchen cabinets are peeled and slated, and the water in shut off once a week with a fifteen minute notice. And the ants that come out of the cracks that management hasn't fixed between residents. If you don't clean frequently, you will get mold on the window sills, so no ventilation in the apartment. You have to keep an eye on the AC filter inside cause that turns black really fast, so maintenance had to come into you apartment to change it. 
Use caution when using the laundry area, you would have to watch your clothes very carefully.  The machines break down easily and other residents will take out your clothes during the cycles to use the machines OR put their clothes with yours and take them out before you can check on your clothes. I don't know how many times I found different items of clothing that are not mine. It's better to invest in your own washer and dryer.
Don't get me started on the parking lots. You are lucky to find a parking spot that is close to your apartment. The spots are so small, that my car has scratches and bumps from other residents. 

There is so many problems with this place that I can go on and on. 
I wouldn't recommend this apartment complex to anyone

Lived here 10 months. Hardwood floors are vinyl. Cabinets are pressboard with cheap veneer. Had a bike stolen from this gated community. Attempted theft on my motorcycle. Single fluorescent light in the bathroom over the sink. Old, stained tub. Vent fan rattled, rusted. Dog urine on the sidewalks every day. Lovely smell. Mold and mildew around the windows and in between the panes. AC didn’t reach the bedrooms. Front door had air gaps on three sides. Electric stove that was made in the 1990s. Not sure they make those any more. No microwave. Management grabbed my $199 damage deposit when I moved out and now want to take me to collections for another $150.  Electric gate often stuck in open position, except for the time it closed on my car and put a hole through the steel door. Fence blew down in a spring 2020 storm. Took more than a week to replace it. I don’t recommend the place.

Nice cheap apartments near downtown.  Apartments are old and a bit run down. Biggest flaw? My upstairs neighbors don't stomp - just walk normally...and I can hear literally every footstep. Loud enough to wake me up pretty much every night since they go to bed after me. The apartments are being renovated to be more modern ...but with wood floors?! Looks nice, but it just makes the problem worse. I'd rather have a run down apartment I can sleep in vs a remodeled one that makes quality of life horribke. Lots of 
new buildings popping up downtown with propper construction - look into those.

This place is in a good location, unfortunately management is slow and for what you pay a month, everything is old and worn down. “Upgraded” apartments just have the black appliances and the cabinets are still old and gross. 
Maintenance is amazing and they get to apartments as quick as they can, but when they do, they get everything done correctly.
FEES!! Every month, our bills were $200+. Electricity and water were cheap, always around 50-80 combined, but all the other fees add up. If your electric is low in your apartment, the community electric goes up.
Apartments share vents so if your neighbor smokes cigarettes, guess what! Your apartment will smell. Management was informed many times and neighbors were only given warnings. Couldn’t use heat during winter because it would smell horrible. 
Prices have gone up an insane amount, and for the prices these apartments are going, you could rent somewhere else thats way nicer. Not all the apartments have a washer and dryer, and washing is expense at complex. 
LIVE SOMEWHERE ELSE

Dog poo everywhere, trash always overfilling, management difficult to get ahold of, extremely loud families with thin walls, neighbors breaking into neighbors vehicles. Extremely poor management, only cares/revolves around money. I was extremely lucky I took pics of my aparment, they tried charginging me for renovations/carpet they did to another apartment and told me I had to prove that wasn't the aparment I rented (I was denied a final walk through, they said they dont do that). Good luck if you decide to live here, and keep record of everything.

Been living here for 4 years because this 1-bedroom is the best layout I have seen & has an extra, huge closet for storage of things like Christmas deco & hobby supplies. Large MB! Has DR   sm eat-in kitchen. Now the bad news: appliances must date back to the early 80’s, lots of rust in refrigerator. Stove barely functional. Biggest issue: NO HOT WATER. Warm water to 110 degrees, able to hold my hand in it all day long. Management gives all kinds of excuses. I gave my notice to move, but found out that I had to stay for another year & suffer thru no hot water nor a washer & dryer. Laundry facilities are barely ok- lots of machines don’t work, yet take your money so have to go elsewhere & that is $$$$. So, because of the above, only rating 2 stars.

The first year and a half I lived here, I didn't have so many issues with the apartment itself, because I don't complain about a lot. The staff on the other hand has always been horrible. They were constantly changing, or getting fired. No one ever seemed to know what was going on. They were extremely unprofessional, and when I moved into a two bedroom apartment, I dealt with mold -shortly after I moved in. They also mishandled our billing, and maintenance issues were a mess. I had to wash my cloths multiple times, throw away expensive items (because it came back after they treated it), and the whole process for fixing the mold cost us a lot of time and money. They basically said we had to move to another apartment (even though we had just moved in), or we had to schedule times for them to come in and do everything from spray it, to cut holes in the wall, until it was all resolved. We finally decided to break our lease because of how much trouble we were having, and they basically said all they would do was cut our fee in half (a full month's rent), in addition we still had to pay two  months worth of rent (you have to give a 60 day notice), including utilities (which are high because they are community utilities), including time we weren't actually living in the apartment. I am still dealing with the billing situation because they take forever to get things to you, and then don't respond when you reply to their emails.

Went to go look at this apartment  complex and there were spider webs on all the bushes and gates. Residents i saw don't look happy living here. Overheard a resident saying the mailboxes are broken into all the time. The apartments  i thought were very expensive for the lack of security. Pool was small same with the workout room.

My husband just moved in a newly renovated unit but as soon as he enters it was so unclean, dust on floor, in kitchen and bedroom. Very dissatisfied with the way things are handled.
The list is too long! I’m writing this review because I paid my rent, I’m ahead by about a month and I got a Non-payment of rent and threat of court! This place is a living nightmare.
Never get answers from the office or corp AMC LLC. The pool looks like a swamp and it 100 right now. Wish l could put pictures on here. Looks nothing like that video.

The new UPDATE is that they are trying to charge us 900$ that we already payed, on top of this months rent. The money was paid by cashiers check, as requested. This place used to be nice when it was Broadstone a couple years ago, it has changed management several times w/the most recent in 12/2021. The rent they charge for the size of the units is a JOKE! You get small square footage for top dollar. What you are really paying for is the location since it's close to dining/shopping areas.  Don't be fooled it looks nice from the outside but look closer & you can tell it definitely needs a lot of work inside & out!  The place is overall gross!  It has more animals that residents living here as well as no credit/background check even though they charge an admin fee of $199 + $300 deposit!  The grounds are ALWAYS littered w/trash/dog poop all over the place even though maintenance does pick it up most of the time there are so many dogs here they can't keep up w/the dog poop & no one ever gets violations for it.  The place even has dog poop bags for owners to pick up the poop but they don't use them!  We stayed for 6 months in a 12 month lease & paid the buy-out fee of 1-months rent because our neighbors were so loud & up 24/7 that we couldn't take it anymore!  The upstairs neighbors were always STOMPING around the SMALL apartment & they were up 24/7 stomping around and/or letting very heavy things hit the floor at ALL times of the day/night.  We contacted the front office 12-18x with NO RESOLUTION. The trash containers are ALWAYS full & get dumped once they are overflowing with trash.  They have a "valet trash" company that comes & provides a trash can that you can set your trash outside in the can and the company will come by nightly & take your trash out, well MANY residents do not use the can they just sit there leaky, smelly, disgusting trash out in the breezeway with no container & expect the company to pick it up. Bottom line if you don't care about NOISY animals & neighbors then this is the place for you!  I would give this property 0 stars if I could.  Its overrun w/animals & rude neighbors that are not considerate of their neighbors below them.  Whoever gives this property 5 stars its either a fake review or a very old review when it was a nice property and they took care of it as well as having good tenants.  Don't be fooled by the model apartment as your unit will look NOTHING like that...that is why most of the time you can't even see your unit until AFTER you e-sign your lease.  We were in building 1 on the bottom floor and it was NOISY 24/7!

If you want accurate reviews, look up Broadstone Solaire, same address.

Moved in a month ago, the office staff was very helpful and polite, they were quick to respond to our questions about online setup and payments.

The day we move in, I notice a few things: 1. The Gold Package upgrade is not worth the price. 2. The carpet is older than my son. 3. The bedroom smells like pet urine. 4. The dryer lint trap is full of animal hair. 5. Our patio with storage is non-existent (catwalk instead).

Shortly after move in, office staff arranged to shampoo bedroom, tells me there was no pet in unit before me and they’re not sure what I found in the dryer. (I know what ammonia in an old carpet smells like and I know animal hair when I see it.) I’m told to wait a while and they’ll send someone to evaluate the carpet and we can take steps from there.

Three weeks later, it still smells like pee in the bedroom. The Maintenance Supervisor comes by, spends five seconds in the room and says there’s nothing. This is where my review lost stars. Basically, this guy is very condescending and rude. I’m told they won’t replace the carpet.

...until I ask if I can test the room for ammonia. Seeing that I have a toddler and both of us have allergies. Something we told the office staff prior to signing the lease.

A couple days later the General Manager comes with that same Maintenance Supervisor. They tell me there’s no smell, so they can’t do anything. Unless I pay to test the carpet for pet urine, without damaging the carpet, and then they might move me to another unit, but also at my expense.

When I ask if my rent will stay the same, the GM says if the next unit is bigger or upgraded, I will pay more. And that’s all they can do for me, unless I leave, but I’d be breaking the lease and won’t get refunded for time spent in a smelly apartment.

Long story short - they eventually offer me another unit, exactly like mine, same rent, but available in late October. I have to fight to get them to waive all fees and honor my initial lease terms. Then in less than 24 hours after I sign the transfer paperwork to move in said unit, the office staff calls to say they can replace my carpet. I am livid. They better replace this fake wood in the kitchen and bathroom, because that is starting to peel up. (The previous faux wood is underneath!)

Despite being expensive relative to other apartment complexes, management of common facilities is poor. The key fob and gate was out for several months as other reviewers mentioned. As a result, the pool/gym/bbq area could not be used in the evenings for several months and the car gate was left open at night. As of this writing, the left gate is functioning but the right gate remains open at night. I chose this apartment in part because it was gated at night. I will not be renewing my lease. Security is lax. As a result there have been several car break-in/break-in attempts in recent months.
Staff here is amazing from day one!  Any maintenance issues get done right away and office is nice and helpful!

Hm, where to start. I’m writing this anonymously because this place takes zero accountability and will argue it and I don’t want my name associated. Just want to warn others.  I will say the office has amazing communication when they want you to be a resident. They respond really quickly. After you sign, that’s where all communication stops. It’s my fault for not seeing that I signed an 8 month lease when I asked for a 6 month. I take full responsibility of that. However, seemed awfully convenient that they just tack on 2 extra months. All these great reviews? It’s because they email you every few weeks encouraging you to write a positive one. They haven’t moved out yet and had to deal with that BS.

The apartment itself. Older. We could hear the guy snoring below us. We considered leaving him a number for an ENT consult. The bath faucets didn’t really turn. Wasn’t too bad but nothing to write home about.

They tack on random charges on your rent. What’s a cam charge? Definitely wasn’t discussed initially. Email them? They don’t respond. Call them? Don’t answer. Email again? Don’t respond. They do bi-annual inspection, email a question? They don’t respond. They add huge move out fees. Bring keys when it’s time for the move out date? No confirmation that they received them or anything to sign. How do I know they are going to come after you saying you didn’t return them? Overall, not a great experience once your a resident. Communication is a big part of business and this place lacks it. It did the job for the time being and glad I don’t have to listen to someone snore underneath us and deal with this management company any further.

Our 1.5 year stay at La Ventana and we went through 3 management crews, 6 apartment inspections and our dog was attacked twice by off leash dogs. That's nothing though. We just received our deposit disposition and they are keeping our entire deposit and trying to charge us $1,870 to replace vinyl floors in the kitchen. Probably 100 sqft and the original product was old and the cheapest product I've ever seen. Replacement would be around $500 for an equivalent... including labor. It gets better though...the previous maintenance crew damaged the floor when pulling out the drier to replace it. The rest was normal wear on an aging and very cheap product. Unbelievable!!!

This property was nice when I was living there, however I have been gone for over 5 weeks and I am still missing my 1000$ deposit. I am getting nowhere with the office staff, I left a message for corporate. I'm not sure if I will have to take legal action to get my deposit. I did leave the apartment in great shape and they stated I should receive my 1000$ back. They also have been notified that I am receiving messages with codes to get packages that aren't mine. The woman in the office was told this, but didn't think to write the information down. This has been a struggle, I recommend you steer clear of this property.

Enjoy the neighborhood as you never know what nightmares await you in your La Ventana apartment.

Management does not respond to maintenance emergencies.

My apartment lost hot water.   No response from management.

My apartment flooded out due to fouled drainage.  No response from management.

The water removal team asked to use my towels when their vacuum pump broke.

It is understood that in a decrepit project such as La Ventana these things will happen; however management should at least respond and let tenants know that they are aware.

This apartment is in a nice location and it’s gated. But parking is the worst with random cars every day parking inside the gates no parking structure at all. Sometimes you have to work across the whole complex. We got this apartment for the pool but it was down all summer and now it’s never clean and hot tub has only been working one month out of the whole year. We had no ice machine the whole time even though we made a work order and we had a leak under our dish washer that went under our carpet that took them awhile to fix and took them forever ever to come fix the leak under our sink which ended up sinking through
I've been here 4 months complaining about my noisy neighbor and now my cars been stolen from behind the "security gates"

This apartment complex used to be so much better. The previous manager really did a good job managing. Things were fixed on time and the grounds were perfect. Over the last year it has gone done big time. The grounds have not been kept as well. The pool area is probably one of the worst. When you sign your lease it is you and maybe one guest. Now there are car loads of people filing in for the free pool. If they can't get in they force their way through the gate behind you or just break it. 
The quality of tenants used to be good. They did a background check and credit check. Now the place has I presume drug deals with shady people constantly coming and going. Also police doing searches for people on the premise, which almost lead to me being shot while walking my dog in the small grass area by my apartment. 
The management needs to seriously step up on security and screening of people. 
As well as service 4 times I have asked they fix my leaky faucet which has now warped the wood under the sink or have a professional spray for bugs now there is cockroaches inside the apartments and black widows. Luxury high end apartment is a joke now.

Living in Las Mananitas has been a wonderful experience seeing that is was my first out of state move. The staff has been very helpful, they went out of their way to ensure that I was familiarized with the area and the locals. Definitely I would recommend the complex to any new resident.

These apartments are great for anyone besides those who love to party. It is a quiet living environment, family friendly, and pet friendly. The apartments are also very roomy and very nice with updated appliances. The pool and workout area are also very nice. I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone.

Las Mananitas is located in the heart of the NW side of Albuquerque. Locals know, "getting across the river" can be a hassle, but with Las mananitas being lcoated between 2 major roads Montano Rd & Paseo Del Norte, as well as being just a couple miles from I-40, navigating from home could not be more convienent. To top off the location for travel, the amenities here at Las Mananitas are second to none. The resort style pool, really is a resort style pool. It's like walking into a California or Arizona resort. Also, unlike other apartments in the nice parts of Albuquerque "NW area" Las Mananitas actually has balconys and patio spaces. Cherry on top, Las Mananitas is eco-friendly, and you will definitely see this reflect on your energy bills. The staff has been more welcoming than any other customer service I've received in Albuquerque. Las Mananitas has truly been a home away from home for me, I will always recommend, and definitely come back if I ever return to Albuquerque when I leave.

The issues are more than I can count but the main ones include cheap builder grade interior to include cheap appliances, single pane glass, no insulation, and inefficient have that runs my electric bill through the roof. Mold constantly collects in the en-suite bathroom, the gate hasn’t worked for most of the 3 years we’ve stayed, pool is usually unavailable, forced cheap services like trash valet, and just poor management overall. The only redeeming factors are. the maintenance staff are killer and very kind, and it’s cheaper than other apartments in the area, but you get what you pay for… figuratively speaking of course, this place is not close to worth the cost

I move into the Resort at Sandia Village om October 24th so you may think I'm not equip to write a review just yet but I completely disagree! This will be my first apartment that I'm going to share with my boyfriend. Seeing as this is our first apartment you can assume we've been pretty nervous about it. Resort at Sandia has kept our nerves at ease in a way I couldn't even begin to thank! I have called them almost everyday with a new question for at least a month and they have eagerly and kindly helped me each time! They have shown us countless apartments until we finally approved of one that matched our very high expectations. As we are so young we are on a pretty tight budget and they have been very helpful in working with our price range. The community is small, clean and quiet. All in all I couldn't be more happy with this place and I know I will live here for years to come!

Pros: Well maintained, security gated  property with great amenities. Great location, near shopping and public transportation. Staff is very friendly and responsive. Spacious bathrooms and in-unit washer/dryer included.

I've been living in my apt for 2 1/2 years now and I'm happy here.

The only cons I have is that there are no in unit washer and dryers, no real drawer space in the kitchen and you have a swamp cooler

The drawers are very thin but I can see why and wouldn't sacrifice my dishwasher for anything so its not a big deal. I just have a silverware drawer that isnt very neat. 

 Also, the swamp cooler is well maintained and works but after you have had refrigerated air, nothing compares.

The first few weeks that the pool is open, they heat it. After a few weeks you dont need it heated.  The pool is very well maintained also and never too crowded or dirty. The staff throws parties every now and then to bring residents together and they do show their appreciation for us. The gym is nice and I never have a problem getting a machine. 

All in all, it's one of the best apartments in nw abq that's non tax credit and still affordable.

Worst place you can live. Sewer line are inside where water heat located. Sewer always backing up. Always getting flooded for 4 yrs we live over there. Recently came in to tour the eagle ranch apartment and they are by far the best apartments in Abq. I recently moved her from California, things have been a little stressful but Hannah in the office made things easy. She welcomed me with a smile and was happy to take time out of her day to help me. I’ve toured so many properties this past week and Hannah was by far the nicest leasing agent.

My wife and I are currently living on the other side of town and are exploring the option of moving to the west side of town to be closer to the rest of our family. While driving around one day we stumbled across the Eagle ranch Apartments and figured we should take a look. We stopped in, it was pretty busy in the office however, Hannah stopped what she was doing to greet us and invited us to have a seat while she finished with the phone call she was on. Hannah made everything very easy for us and it has been such a smooth process. We can not wait to move in, in September.

Over price apartments that appliances are made year 1994. Walls are so thin that you can hear other people using the bathroom. Poor maintenance outside area, dog poop all over the place. Sometimes their garbage are over full. So call refrigerated coolers are so old it make a lot of noise and it cost a lot to leave it on. Found out, they got F rating on Better Business Bureau. Save some heartache don't move to these apartments.

Honestly, this is the best living experience. No complaints about my apartment. It's in a good area close to shopping, next to a school. The girls in the leasing office are amazing. *Chef's kiss.* They literally go out of their way to help. The Maintenance team responds quickly, the same day. I'm glad my friend referred me here, it's a hidden gem. :)

I have lived here for about 9 months and I can't wait to renew when my lease is up this year. The grounds are so beautiful and well maintained. Everyone here is welcoming and I have the nicest neighbors! The office and maintenance staff are very responsive and I feel secure and comfortable living at these apartments. I highly recommend living at The Lakes!
The ladies who work in the office are the rudest in the area. If you walk into that office, expect to be talked down to.
Bad area of town and you can hear almost everything through the walls.

These apartments are very dated. Cabinets, appliances, outlets were in poor condition. Cockroaches were a problem. Management will try to bully you so if you feel you are right on an issue stand your ground. Utilities paid with rent are high (averaging $120 or more per month excluding electric) and there is no detail of what they are for.  Don't expect any of your deposit back on move out and they will charge you a huge amount on your final bill to replace the carpet, $750 in our case.

The apartment was actually very spacious and affordable.  The neighborhood left something to be desired.  If you live here, get ready to have your car broken into or stolen, ticketed or towed for no good reason, and vandalized.  You also will find random homeless and drunk people laying outside the fence or on the sidewalk at all hours and possibly using the area as their personal toilet.  As for the complex itself, the roof leaks if you're on the 3rd floor, which meant I lived without a smoke detector for about a year and a half.  When you move out, make sure you take pictures of everything or else they will charge you a cleaning fee for things that are already clean.  Take the actual apartment and move it to a better area with less shady company and you'd have the perfect place.
I have lived here since 2019. New management staff have enhanced security, beautified property. Any maintenance problems are resolved quickly.

I lived here many years ago and landed up back here in 2022. New management really has done a lot to help the apartments. The gate surrounding the apartments is really nice, especially when I walk my dogs in the late evening and early mornings. I can walk them without having to worry. The pools are nice and having access to the indoor pool all year is a plus for my son and I.  Its quick to get on either freeway and the management keeps the grounds pretty clean. Occasionally there is trash around but it is usually picked up quickly. I also really enjoy the grass and trees everywhere. It makes walking my dogs easy. Lastly, they have been on top of issues such as heat and cooling which is nice!! The price and size of the apartments is also worth it.  Compared to other apartments for same number of rooms/bath, the square footage is better for the price. I enjoy it here.

I have lots of experience with this property as I lived here from 2010-2014, then again in 2017-2018. My father has lived here since 2019. From 2010-2014, this place was amazing. I loved living here, always felt safe, and developed real friendships with all the staff. The manager had a relationship with most tenants and never let anything fall to the wayside. The staff regularly hosted Holiday parties and other events for residents without large families. The place was clean and everything was always in working order. I left with a heavy heart and the manager at the time was a big support of my coming of age process. Fast forward to 2017, life does not go the way I planned and I move back in. The manager I loved is still there and welcomes me home. A few months later, she leaves suddenly. Not a month goes by and the place is dirty. It stinks, nothing feels the same. It's May, hot as hell, and no air conditioner. The new manager seems nice enough but does not have anything to do with any tenant unless they are late on rent. I left in 2018, but still regularly come to see my dad. It stinks, its dirty. Nothing works. The heat/ cooling is turned off for days for no reason. It looks like another crappy apartment in the international district. It has the potential to be much more than that, so it was hard to see. It is hard to see. My advice is that you look elsewhere if you're looking...but know that this was once an Oasis in the international district that I still miss very much.

You might think this was a luxury apartment in the poshest neighborhood out there with their application process. Don't waste your time. I applied here and was denied, applied in a better part of town, with a better apartment, and was immediately approved. Still unsure what they did or didn't do right, but wow! Don't waste your time.

I'd give 3.7 stars, if there was that possibility.
Rents are going up, but when I 1st arrived (Sept 2021) they were very reasonable for the size and amenities, mainly compared to others in the same price/offer range. Price have since gone up 25%!!! I'm happy I entered a 1 year lease.
There are 2 pools, but unfortunately it is too cold in the inside pool area to adventure getting in the water in the Winter. Didn't use the outside pool yet, but the space and pool seem pretty thigh.
Gym is very small with very basic machines, not all working 100%.
Gardens are kinda well taken care of, with a team of landscapers coming by every Wednesday, but be careful walking on the grass: plenty of hidden holes and poops. Yes, dog waste abound, not only in the nicely sized dog area, as well as in the front garden area, which I agree are neighbors fault as well. There are signs everywhere for picking after the dog, but people seem to have trouble assuming that responsibility. Anyways, management could clean better, mainly the dog area, which some times stinks.
The garbage disposal is very handy and there is laundromat available.
Overall, I'm happy, mainly with the fast response of maintenance when needed... Some times tho, there's no response at all, as I am waiting for 2 months now to have the bathtub faucet replaced due to hot and cold water  flashes.
Rent payment is done thru a website where you have to pay an extra $1.95 fee every month, something unexpected, but they do facilitate payment installments, what it's very nice.
When I first visited here I liked the door system, which seemed to prevent from non tenants to enter. Unfortunately, some tenants and some doors won't close shut, and since a truck knocked down one of the canopies 2 months ago, the buzz system is unavailable and we've been encountering some people sheltering from the cold during the night and mornings in the lobbies, mainly on the weekend when management is not here. So, I wonder where and what the security guard is doing... and why isn't the canopy fixed yet?
Altho the airport is close by and there's a school across the street, the walls of these buildings are thick and insulate very well outside noises, perfect for working from home.
Parking is plenty, but don't leave your car in the streets around the building, as I have seem broken windows.

Apartments have second hand smoke drift coming through vents, walls, fixtures, sliding glass bedroom doors are loose and leak air like a wind tunnel, and let in black widows and other spiders. Roaches, office girls are rude, useless and trying too hard to be Kardashians, maintenance closes work orders without doing anything. Waiting to move - this was a mistake and nightmare.

We lived at Villa for about 9 months, and it was one of our best leasing experiences in Albuquerque. The staffs are professional and friendly, and always timely in response to maintenance calls. The apartments have great floor-plans, with a huge balcony. The common area is well-kept and clean, and having the indoor and outdoor pools is a plus. 
The gated parking and the security guard definitely helped feel safe there. I totally recommend this complex.
