I have been a resident of the Villa Apartments for many years and consider this complex my home. The staff are very supportive and attentive. There is a standing guard at night and the cameras work. I would not live somewhere if I did not think it safe and have never had or heard of an issue with property damage or theft. I really like how there is a community feel to this complex and that everyone watches out for each other. The events hosted throughout the year are always fun and the puppy park is a welcome retreat for my dogs.  I always recommend these apartments to my friends, colleagues, and family members and they always have positive feedback. Stop by and you will not be disappointed!

The ladies that work in front office are extremely rude to tenants and unprofessional. There are no cameras in or outside the building that work. My car was vandalized in a gated parking lot and my apartment of was robbed and they refuse to help.

755 square ft of awesome space. That's a 1 bedroom & 1 bath. There's up to a 2 bedroom & 2 bath. Great views & close to shopping. Sauna with 2 pools & gym. Billard room with twin tables, we have a library and the best karma anywhere. Its spacious, large balconies with 2 separate entrances. Elevators, inside mail room. Dog park on site. Great lawn maintenance every week. 2 buildings 4 floors. 200 units total. I've called it home for nearly 13yrs. There's covered parking or not & personal entrance gated parking. Best prices & amenities in town.

Placed right in front of a middle high school, this apartment, for its very reasonable pricing is a very comfortable, quiet and spacious place to have your family settle into. Pet friendly, family oriented the tenants are very welcoming and nice. If you like quiet , the apartment has a 0 tolernce policy, hence making the place a respectable environment for families. Landlords hosts events to get to know tenants both in indoor and outdoor pool areas on a regular. I've been here for over a couple of year's and my wife and I love it here. Come check out the Villa Apartments ! :)

I enjoy living here. The neighborhood is surrounded with apartments that are not as nice as the Villas. I have a dog that loves the dog park (which is enclosed) and he loves walking around the apartment complex. It's a nice apartment for the price you will pay. I do not like that it is across from a bar (Antonio's Restaurant), because drunk people are annoying. But that is my only complaint. Otherwise, it is great living here! :)

The pros, it’s next to a Trader Joe’s and uptown mall. Central ABQ location in general. So you could literally walk to any nearby store and live a “city” lifestyle. The gated parking lot and community add a level of safety and security for your car and self.
Maintenance staff is pretty good and quick to address issues. Usually pretty quiet. I only hear my newest of the upstairs neighbors. Trash going out MWF. And occasionally some activity outside during the day. Pretty typical of apartment life.

The cons, bugs. For paying the prices around here, this is the most bugs I’ve had in an apartment. My “energy efficient” window lets in rain. The shower has consistently been difficult to keep the water in the tub. It seems like it runs down the wall, hits the lip then spills out to the floor in my unit.

I lived here for 1.5 years, and about 10 years of apartment lifestyle to compare to. This one is in the better half, but not a great value at the current rates.

Absolutely horrible staff working at this complex. They will never respond to work order calls and everything in the apartment breaks. I had an inch of water flowing from the washer and they still didn’t come by to check on it. I feel absolutely ripped off by these people in the worst way. DO NOT sign a lease with Arterra Apartments in Albuquerque if you value your money and/or living quality. Absolutely vulgar negligence.
Maintenance has been great emergency maintenance requests always handled promptly

We still have no solution to all of this and do not even know a definite time that a plumber will get here. We’ve been told we are unable to break our lease and move to a new community.

They also handle renewal process poorly. They gave me my renewal notice a week before I had to give my moving notice. Which provided me very little time to actually make decision based on finances. 

Do not recommend. Only positive is location.
This property is so beautiful and in a great part of town. Everyone is so kind in the office!

Be prepared to be nickled and dimed. Make the complex review every word of the contract with you and ensure they are transparent with everything they're going to charge you with. I found over $450 EXTRA charges on my monthly bill beyond what i was expecting. I also found numerous black widow spiders in my garage and around the complex. Amazing location. Wonderful people. I absolutely love it here
Great place to live. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. Great neighborhood in a great location. Apartments are nice and decently sized.

This business is the same as it was when it was broad stone estates. The apartments appear luxury at a glance but they are old, decrepit and the staff is unhelpful. The apartments are great and spacious. The grounds are clean and the amenities are amazing, plus it's in a great neighborhood.

In my mid twenties, I'd make statements, "love the city night lights. Today much older and enjoying city lights! Have magnify views, etc. She's cozy with high ceilings, a lovely accent wall. A third floor queen, not much could be better than my apartment, a love!

After a recent change in family structure, my apartment at Broadstone Estates has made the transition a positive one.  The community is friendly, supportive, and such a pleasant place to live.  My apartment is beautiful and my neighbors are absolutely the best.

They tried to accuse us of taking the blinds and not cleaning the apartment and keep the deposit plus charge $200. If I didn’t have photos taken and pay attention to the dates they would’ve scammed us.

This was the first apartment i have ever lived in and the entire process for getting the apartment was super easy and convenient. I have lived here for a year and about 3 months. The office people have always been super friendly and never given me a hard time when i need to know something or report an issue. My personal experience i’ve never seen anything too crazy here and i can say it’s pretty quiet and i have respectful neighbors.

Office crew seemed to be nice. Very wonderful neighbors very friendly. Mantience was very attentive. Parking good. On occasion a few loud kids running around but nights are very quite. Lights all over premise at night . Over all very pleased with living here ...and most of it has that welcoming feeling like its home.

Not safe. I’ve lived here for half a year now and my truck has been broken into because parking policy sucks. These photos are false advertising. Appliances are not updated. For the 3 years the dishwasher never ran properly and it has been "fixed" several times. Also our sink broke while not having a running dishwasher and I haven't been able to wash dishes for 4 days because maintenance hasn't shown up. This is a joke.

The new management and staff are excellent and amazing. They really make you feel at home and make sure to take care of any issues or concerns with quick response time. I have seen several renovations that are in the works and can tell that the management takes pride in this property.

Worst apartment I ever lived. I really don't recommend anyone to move to this apartments. The standard that this complex keeps for itself is downright insulting. The apartment that I walked into was filthy. On moving day, I didn't get a walkthrough of the place that I am going to be living in for the next 12 months. What I got was pressured by Joanna into giving her both my money and my renter's insurance information before I got a set of keys. Walking into the apartment, I was appalled. There was dust everywhere, including dust bunnies clinging to life from the ceiling in the kitchen, rust covering a 1/3 of my porch and rust on my mirror in my bathroom, warped and missing screens, A HAIR from somebody else on the toilet, and a filthy laundry room. On top of all this, there is definitely more. I got a total of 108 photos and a video of the filth that is that apartment. The icing on the cake was the fire extinguisher that had been expired for 2 years. When I asked them why the apartment was this dirty, all I got were apologies that they didn't do a walk-through in between tenants because they didn't have time. That's no excuse, make time in between tenants to do the stuff that you need to do to make sure that the place is clean that you're going to be renting. And even though the fire extinguisher was clearly a breach of the safety portion of the renters agreement, they wouldn't let me out and now I'm forced to stay here.

1.) The inside of the apartment is decent. Older model, non-updated appliances, but decent. 3/5 stars here. Here's a huge issue: When we moved in, the apartment placed incompatible light bulbs into our hallway fixtures. All went fine for a few months, and about a week ago, we smelled fire. I look at the fixture and it's smoking. We take out the bulb, see that it's actually burning, and the fixture is slightly melted as well. Please check all apartments for incompatible bulbs. Had we not have been home, THIS WOULD HAVE TURNED TO A FIRE. 

2.) This is a terrible place for people who are responsible dog owners. 0/5 stars. More specifically, for people who keep their dogs on leashes because they don't want their dogs to get in any altercations with other dogs. There is no weight limit here, and although they claim there is a breed restriction, I don't believe it's implemented. There are many irresponsible owners that do not put their dogs on leashes, let them run loose to use the bathroom. We have two 15 lb dogs that are always on a leash. One night, an unleashed dog comes bounding up to ours and attacks one of my dogs. I wish that management would make this a safer place for dogs and owners by fully implementing  their leashed dog responsible owner rules. 

3.) Utilities. 0/5 stars. This is the third apartment complex I've been in, and I have NEVER seen such absurd utility charges. They charge community utilities. They send you a lovely little bill in the mail each month that you are expected to include in your rent. Ours is approximately $115 each month. PLEASE factor this into your budget when considering this apartment. The office staff will certainly not tell you this, so I am. For example, here's a breakdown of our current utilities bill that goes directly to the office: water $32.93, sewer $19.94, trash $19.66, gas $17.54, "C.A.M. FEE (this is the community maintenance fee... lol!!!!) $20.57, service fee $3.50. Grand total: $114.14. This is EXTREMELY HIGH. 

4.) Maintenance: 2/5 stars. Every maintenance personnel I've encountered has been super nice.  This isn't about that. Hopefully they'll help you out if you have an issue. The issue to me is the CONSTANT remodeling. If constant construction noise bothers you, think twice about moving here. 

5.) Office Staff: 2/5 stars. Although not particularly attentive, interested, or engaged, friendly enough. 

6.) Safety: 2/5. Since Oct I've personally seen 3 smashed windows in the parking lot.

I moved out in August 2017 and I would have moved sooner if I could. This complex is terrible. The staff is lazy and generally unconcerned about the state of the complex.  The first night I moved in my toilet backed up. This happened weekly during the colder months. I informed the office of this problem several times. They would do quick fixes such as snaking the toilet but it would back up again. They suggested I use less toilet paper. My apartment had one bathroom and it took on average 5 days to get fixed .  My AC worked marginally during the summer. When I notified the office they blamed me for opening my windows to try to cool the apartment. It would get to over 90 degrees inside while the school was broken. The final straw was the mice. I understand that mice can get into buildings but the offices response to the problem was subpar. I was given traps to set up. They told me they would remove mice if they were caught but sometimes they sat in the trap for a day or two. To the person now living in 88:  you have mice.  They enter behind the stove. The majority of the mice I caught were inside the top of my stove!!  

Do not live here!!

I have been a resident at Academy Terrace for over four years. This is a convenient location for me, but it's a mediocre facility for the rent that is charged. The buildings are very old (1970's) and very poorly insulated. Expect to pay a lot for your electricity in extreme hot or cold weather. The windows are single pane and very drafty as are the doors.  There are laundry facilities on site, but they are dirty & often the equipment does not work.  Insects are occasionally an issue, but they offer spraying every Friday.  Watch out for automobile property crime!  I have been a victim of gasoline theft & vandalism twice.  The first time thieves drilled a hole underneath in the gas tank in my SUV overnight which cost $800 in repairs. The same thing happened again overnight on Good Friday to my pick up truck. They drilled under the tank costing over $400 this time, and I have great difficulty filling the tank now very slowly.  The landscaping is nice and well kept, although the grass is over-watered in the summer leading to higher community water bills which is not fair. There is a pool in the center of the complex, but don't expect to ever swim in it because it is always closed. During Albuquerque's long hot summers, you would be lucky to have two weeks that the pool has been open. As far as residents, most people are not very friendly or talkative. The facility is pet friendly, but not everyone cleans up after their pets. The worst resident complaint I have is smokers of all shapes and sizes. I live on the second floor, and every time I get new downstairs neighbors, they smoke.  Cigarettes, e-cigs, and weed are always present unwelcome odors. The office staff used to be helpful, but since the management & staff has changed in 2017, the customer service has declined rapidly.  Academy Terrace definitely has potential to be a nice place with some simple upgrades, security, and better management, but at this time, they are missing the mark.

Website for online payment has been replaced with one that doesn't work. It's been this way for two months. There wasn't even a notice that you should use a different method of payment since the previous one was broken.

Pool is under construction/closed most of the summer.

Water get off as an 'emergency' once a month on average. You'll luck out one month, then get hit twice in another.

The staff is friendly and apologetic, at least.

The apartment managers have been extremely nice and very helpful. They are always there when me and my husband need them. There quick to answer and very polite and the facility is very clean. I recommend anyone who is looking for an apartment to come check out the place.

Academy terrace is nothing short of amazing , my girlfriend and I have lived here only a month and a half but we love everything about it, it's quiet it's affordable , the management are superstars about tending to the tenants needs and questions . We would highly reccomend it to anyone in he Albuquerque area looking for a good apartment to call home. The grounds are beautiful and the units are cozy but not cramped we may very we'll be calling this place home for many years to come .

Glows:  walking distance to grocery and other retail stores, to several restaurants, to two city parks, and to several neighborhood bars for happy hour;  an outdoor swimming pool; well-kept lawns and trees; good parking; helpful staff
Problems:  noisy street and scary traffic near Academy Rd; no area for picnic or barbecue; outdoor pool and basketball court need updates and cameras

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: If you’re looking for a quiet place to live then this ain’t it. There’s excessive noises you’ll hear, the staff don’t do anything about it

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: The management is awful liars. They will find anyway to over charge you. they do not prorate the month like they say they do. They will tell you one thing to appease you in person then call you the next day and tell you something different. IF you do not pay rent with a cashier check they will charge you an extra fee. Very unprofessional I have never lived at such a deceitful place. If you rent here record everything they tell you, or they will say they never said anything like that.

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: I absolutely love living at Riverwalk. My boyfriend and I had lived here for a year and when we went to move we viewed several different properties (even a sister property) and were SHOCKED at how awful the staff was to us so we came back to Riverwalk where the staff immediately know our names and take great care of us! Anytime we have had a concern the staff has openly communicated the issue, the solution, and how long the solution should take to be resolved. The community at Riverwalk is very friendly, it’s always clean (I even see staff members who are giving tours picking up trash on the tour). The amenities are great, and they even do “community gatherings” where food trucks come or they have treats to celebrate random holidays at the office. My boyfriend and I are so glad to cal Riverwalk our home.

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: I have been living here for almost 5 years!  The office staff changes so frequently called you are constantly harassed about what you have on your patio!  I recently bought an actual balcony privacy screen and within 3 weeks of attaching it to my railing.. I have gotten 3 “house mouse” notes on my door.  I have taken photos of numerous patios and balconies that have everything from chicken wire to a huge metal frame that has chain link fence attached to it.  But, mine is not acceptable because the office staff can’t see through the material.  Our lease specifically states you cannot drape or hand carpet, clothes, rugs or towels over the railing.  It makes no mention of screens f any kind.  Yet, some people can have chicken wire while others cannot have privacy screens. Some people can attach a mesh material with HUGE METAL CLIPS and others cannot have privacy screens.  Riverwalks own house mouse report specifically states “ONLY LIVE” plants are allowed, even though their own model apartment has a plastic plant.  I guarantee once you have signed your lease... and you thought how “nice” the staff was... you will never experience “nice” again.  They will look down their noses at you and treat you as if you are a nuisance or criminal.  I have heard this comment from every single person that has moved in!  Most, promptly move out.  If you get an apartment with the old yellow appliances... expect that they will never be replaced. I can’t count the number of times my neighbor has had her stove fixed and they refuse to replace it. Every couple of months there is new staff in the office. They arbitrarily apply rules in a discriminatory fashion and give excuses as to why for you the rule is different. I have witnessed a bike being stolen in broad daylight... just know if you move here,  the only thing the office will be concerned about is what you have on your patio or balcony. As far as your safety, having functional appliances etc.... that is not a priority at Riverwalk.

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: I thought living here was great until Management and maintenance left the rented unit unlocked via front door, patio screen door, patio sliding door, and water heater storage door on patio. After playing phone/email tag with maintenance and regional manager, the situation was not resolved but I was left with an empty meaningless apology and a shampooing for the carpets at the expense of NALs Management. I would have renewed my lease until both upper management personnel and corporate office brushed this "human error" under the rug. I never so violated, unsafe, or seriously disappointed until this happened to me. Management is horrible and their error should have never happened to begin with. Since my experience, I've never felt so unsafe, extremely violated since my home no longer felt like home.  There are so many vacancies....now I know why. On the plus, the location was great.

apartmentName: River Walk at Puerta de Corrales
review: I lived in River Walk for one year, until I bought a house and moved out. My experience with living here was very peaceful & pleasant. The apartments were well kept, and the amenities was great. The staff was very attentive and very professional. When ever I needed something fixed in the apartment, I'll submit a work order and the on-site maintenance responded & addressed all issues either the same day or the next, never ever having to follow-up. I have no negatives about living here and would recommend this place for anyone looking to rent. If it wasn't for affordable home buying in ABQ, I would defiantly renew my lease in a heart belt. Thank you River Walk for a great experience. It is very rare that I right a review, but you guys earned it!
I wish I can give 0 star. They charge you more than what is stated on the lease. The manager does not help at all. Worst experience I have ever had. Do not live there!

I have found Three Fountains Apartments to be well kept, with friendly people, and convenient to everything. I decided on this place, sight unseen, and I do not regret my decision. See for yourself. It’s beautiful and quiet!

I moved here almost two years ago from a colder climate and have been extremely happy to have made this my home. The maintenance here is quick and top notch, the grounds are lovely, the apartments are quiet with minimal sound traveling between apartments and the office staff is friendly. And my knees love that it is an elevator building!

I have been here for two years.  The office staff are all helpful, kind and efficient.  

The maintenance staff keep the buildings clean and repairs are made quickly.  The property, lawns, pools, etc. are clean and neat.   The prices for rent are unbelievable compared to other apartments I looked at and lived in prior to learning about Three Fountains.  Parking and storage are big assets.  The halls are quiet, the laundry rooms have new washers and dryers and as soon as the Pandemic is gone, the activities will be available again.  You don't have to go outside for mail, emptying trash or to recycle.   I highly recommend it.

MANY thanks to all the staff at 3 Fountains for all you have done to assist "Willow" and I into our new home.  We are loving it here!  
The heated pool goes hand in hand with my physical therapy and is helping me make this the most healthy year to come.
I have met several of my neighbors and pool buddies and everyone has been so positive and upbeat...such a great environment!
I feel safer here than I have ever felt anywhere in Albuquerque, in the 40 plus years I have lived in NM...
Many thanks for the very positive welcome!  Jo-Anne and Willow

Bed bug infested!!
And snooty office management!! 
They get their daily thrill out of towing cars!!! Poor senior tenants can not even run upstairs to take their groceries  in, with out comming down to a missing car or a big fat orange "not easily removed" sticker on their window.... I'm moving my parents!
For the price I pay to live here I would love to have someone answer the phone during normal business hours or at least return voicemails I CAN’T WAIT to move out

This complex advertises themselves as a safe, gated community however it is the exact opposite. The front gate has been broken for over a month (left open) and during this time I have known two people whose cars have been stolen from inside the complex. In response to complaints as to why the gate has not been fixed, the management just says that it's been expensive to fix the gate. These are not cheap apartments and we are paying for a gated community. They have not made any attempts to provide security during this time or even put up cameras. In summary, it's unsafe and the management has no regard for making it safe. Regrettably, I'll be leaving as soon as my lease is up and I'd highly recommend taking your business elsewhere.

Being a college student is extremely difficult dealing with financial costs. There aren't very nice apartments around the university area, but Broadstone Towne Center is extremely nice and safe. I chose to live here because it is convenient and really close to campus. However, living in a one bedroom it is extremely expensive.

Overall, the Broadstone Town Center apartment complex is good. The positive aspects are close proximity to the interstate, respectably large apartments, good room layouts, and overall nice facilities. The negative aspects are parking availability, occasional crime, Comcast, getting into the apartment difficulty, and minor "damage" to the kitchen floor. 

The apartment is located close to the interstate which means that most places in town are within 15 minutes away. Also close to Central Ave, Downtown, the University, and the Air Force Base. So in that respect it is a good location.

The apartments themselves are nice. Decently large square footage and a variety of layouts that fit a variety of tenant needs are the obvious reasons the apartments are nice.

The complex is nice with a long grass area in the middle, two pools, multiple grills, a nice outdoor patio area, and an indoor/outdoor workout area. There is also a Theater room but it has limited hours when you can use it and it has never been convenient for me personally.

The biggest problem with the Broadstone Town Center is the parking lot. There is not enough parking. There are garages, carports, and general parking. Garages cost $50/month and Carports are $25/month which would be totally fine if it weren't for the fact that there is no where near enough general parking. There are more carport spots than general parking so incidentally all the general parking spots get full and you don't have a spot but more than half of the carports are not being used. If you park somewhere you aren't supposed to park, you will be towed. The apartment has a partnership with a tow truck company and they patrol every night. So the apartment's policy is that you can park outside the gate in the Buffalo Wild Wings parking lot if there are no open spots. I pay to live in a gated apartment complex, so I should be able to park inside the gate where my car should be safe. 

Your car isn't necessarily safe inside the gate though. I mentioned that the location is good in the sense that it is centrally located and close to a variety of activities, but the location is also bad because it is not the most crime-free area of Albuquerque. My car and at least 8 others parked inside the gate were broken into on the same night. 

So while it may be too easy for criminals to enter the gate, getting to the gate from the street is a bit of a hassle involving U-turns or driving through parking lots. 

I still give it 4/5.

The sales associates are very nice and approachable.  However, no one accompanied me to inspect the apartment upon move-in.   And multitasking was not their strong suit.  The property is neat and safe.  My apartment model is very modern and spacious for a decent price.

Broadstone Towne Center is a wonderful apartment complex. It provides residents with a number of amenities including two lavish pools, a hot tub, a gym and theater space. The floor plans are well organized a perfect for everything I need. The complex is safe and well located near the university as well great restaurants. I have lived here for about a year and look forward to living here for the rest of my time in New Mexico while I earn my degree.

Have lived here for over 9 years.
If you enjoy hot showers, clean dishes or anything that involves Hot Water...this is NOT the apartment complex for you.  I have had issues with my hot water going out just about every other month and it usually lasts for several days.  Right now I have just completed 3 WEEKS with no hot water.
New owners bought complex about three years ago and have raised the rent $100-$300 every month.  Local Manager is nice, but she has no backup from the owners....in some other state.

Do you want to pay a premium price for a slum apartment and do nothing, know nothing management? This is it! Put some new paint on and cover up the water problems, air conditioner from the 1960s, cheap stick-on vinyl flooring, and pay for the owners' utilities with shady "shared" utility and CAM charges. Want to pay $200-250 in utilities every month on top of the outrageous rent? Move right in! There is no gate, no security, and no maintenance. Everything is OLD with a thin layer of paint. The worst place to call home in Albuquerque.

I lived at Ambassador East for five years. The rent was cheap and the neighborhood seemed quiet. The office staff were nice but inefficient. Things always took forever to resolve. The buildings are very old and have not been taken care of. We were always fighting bugs. Maintenance was the worst I’ve ever experienced. It caused me many tears. And, as time went on, crime became worse and worse in the neighborhood! My kids and I moved somewhere safer. When I moved, they hit me with a bunch of undisclosed fees that were NOT part of my lease and blamed it on the new company that bought the property. Ridiculous. We have a really nice place now and I’m happy to have moved on. I cannot recommend this place unless you’re desperate for something totally cheap.

I loved these apartments. If I ever move back into an apartment this would be where I'd go. The management was friendly and helpful; the maintenance was prompt. I loved my 2 bedroom 2 bath, it was very spacious with two walk in closets giving me more than enough space. Would definitely recommend!

I love my apartment here. I am in a one bdrm but am looking to moving up to a two bedroom. The courtyard is beautiful! On the ground floor you have the 18 inches in front of your patio to do with whatever you want. I planted a small garden and I got wonderful tomatoes. Am planning on broadening my horizons and planting more this year. For the most part, it is usually a nice, quiet and peaceful place to live. I started with the 6 month lease and extended to a one year lease after my 6 months ended. The property manager is always available for discussions or complaints. My apartment didn't have a ceiling fan, but all I had to do was ask and one is being installed. I plan on staying for a long time, just as several other tenants have also done.

The apartments are nice, however there are no ceiling fans as stated, only walk in closets in one room of  the 2br units, there is no clubhouse or business center, and the walls and floors are like paper. no dogs allowed on site yet residents have dogs, and guests must park on the street. Pool is freezing because they are too cheap to buy a heater, and they enter your apartment without consent or warning. If you complain about something they laugh about it and never do anything to fix it. also the manager chooses her favorite residents and gives them special treatment while the rest get treated like scum. The stairs are dangerous and the fountains have been "being repaired" for 3 years. Sure the utilities are paid, but its so not worth it to live in this dump.

I lived here for 2+ years from 2017 to 2020 and moved out mainly due to the crime and loud tenants screaming, fighting, etc. at all hours of day and night. The police are constantly called to these apartments and there were cops at the apartments responding to domestic violence/disturbances about 1 - 2 times a week. A neighbor told me another tenant had put a gun in his face. Cars get vandalized and broken into regularly. Apart from the regular crime and disturbances there were also very major ones - multiple times there were teams of cops looking for tenants or were there with warrants, my neighbor who seemed to keep up on what all went on there said there were some tenants that had been selling guns on the black market and drugs there. There were many other serious problems too but there's too many to list.

Upon giving my written notice to vacate they told me that cleaning the apartment would be charged or taken out of my deposit automatically, even if the apartment was spotless upon moving out, carpet cleaning would be taken out of the deposit as well, and so would painting the apartment, even if it needed 1 coat. I ignored it because I didn't think they would charge much for it, but now they are trying to retain 100% of my deposit and charge me an additional $200+ for painting the unit even though it was just 1 coat (I didn't paint or damage any walls and I patched any holes I made).

This is probably the worst apartment I've ever lived in. Save yourself all the headaches and live somewhere else.

Pros
Good location, close to old town and some museums
Apartment is nice
Nearby brewery and little shops
Close to biking trails

Cons
They changed the lease end date multiple times, initially it was a 6 month lease, then they had changed it to a 18 month lease without my approval or any sort of initials. You see this scribbling over the prior date and now it is a 12 month lease. And how I found out it was a 12 month lease was a notice on Friday March 29th. I didn't want to stay so I scrambled to find a new place. I found out they have a rule where if you do not let them know before the 1st of the month you have to pay an additional month. They let me know March 29th that my lease is now up and April 1st would have been the next Monday. That is very short notice. Because I did not let them know until now April 4th, I have to pay May’s entire rent.

Took 2 months from when we moved in for them to get us our washer/dryer unit with me reminding them multiple times.

Their office team changes every month, almost each time I go in to pay rent it’s someone completely different.

Noise level is high sometimes - car alarms, trucks backing up, this one scooter alarm that goes off whenever it rains


I was not able to get my problem resolved. If you still decide to move here keep paper copies of everything and have any sort of agreement in writing. I would avoid all properties managed by PMI.

This place is very nice and affordable, close to downtown & old town a lot to do in a very short amount of distance. Management is good, any issues are fixed timely.  my only complaint is that crime is starting to find its way into this neighborhood, cars are stolen and broken into often.
Rude staff, rude tenants, broken appliances, paper thin walls, unkempt facilities, ROACHES, NO parking!

This has been the worst experience! I was told that I qualified for the housing assistance program. I was all packed and ready to go. I even paid the deposit fee! On the move in day I was told that I did not qualify for the program anymore. I have not received my deposit back!
The Ladies were really nice an very helpful especially with my daughter. The area Manager was so helpful. Thank you an cant wait for the next step to move in

I’ve been living at Pinewood Estates for a year, and my experience has been wonderful overall. The property is beautiful, and the ongoing renovations are making it even more stunning. While the construction can sometimes make things a bit inconvenient, it’s exciting to see the improvements happening and knowing they’re investing in the community.

The management team here is fantastic:

Layla, the Assistant Manager, is always professional and quick to address any concerns.

Bernice, the Senior Leasing Agent, is warm, friendly, and incredibly helpful.

Erick, the Leasing Agent, made the leasing process easy and continues to provide great support whenever needed.


The community itself is amazing. All of my neighbors are friendly and even willing to help if you need something. It’s a great atmosphere to live in, and I feel lucky to be part of such a kind and welcoming environment.

If you’re looking for a place to call home, I highly recommend Pinewood Estates. The staff and community truly make it special!

On the day my wife and I moved in, the A/C was broken, the dishwasher leaked, the smoke alarm didn't work, and most electrical outlets didn't work properly. 

We were promised a working A/C by the time we moved in (May 7th), however we didn't get one until June. It was consistently 85+ degrees in our unit,  often reaching 90 or over for over a month. It was absolutely miserable, and some of our food went bad faster than expected because it was so hot. We received a small discount on rent for this.

After reporting it on the unit condition report, I had to talk to the front desk multiple times and put in a service request for them to finally fix the smoke alarm, and it started chirping again the next day. 

I  had to talk to the front desk multiple times before they finally sent someone to fix the dishwasher, and the maintenance guy spend 10 mins poking around, said it was fixed, but it STILL leaks.

After putting it on the unit condition report, I put in a service request to have them fix the electrical outlets, it was marked as resolved, however they STILL don't work properly. 

I am sick of constantly having to go report things that are broken and follow up about it, only for nothing to get done. Terrible experience.

Water gets shut off multiple times a month, they don’t notify you until the day of!! You will wake up to no running water to shower, brush teeth, wash hands etc. Management is awful even the new management that took over a month ago. The buildings are old and not kept up. There is mold in the apartments and roaches. Do not live here!! You’ll regret it!!

First, I agree with all other reviews, management is SO rude. I dread having to call the office because they always have an attitude. But when my husband goes in, they’re nice to him. 

Second, they are ALWAYS shutting the water off! Completely beyond ridiculous. It’s at least 2 times a month! 

Third, they do zero pest control outside. Walking from my car to the door there’s easily 15-20 big roaches, and if you don’t keep your place immaculately clean at all times you can expect them in your house to.

Fourth, there’s homeless people camping out at the side of the complex.

There are pros though. The apartments are decently priced for what you pay. The residents are MOSTLY quiet and respectful. Within walking distance of 2 parks and all of uptown.

We’ll see what the new ownership does. Thankfully I hear that old staff are leaving with old management. Hopefully we’ll see good change.

Office staff is very rude any time you have to come into contact with them . 

Roaches all over property no matter how clean you are . Water is always shut off and no hot water for weeks at a time .

Management is incredibly rude and dismissive. Amenities are never open to the public. Management refuses to fix the broken laundry machines. No complaint will come of anything, management just says everything is your fault and there is nothing they can possibly do.

The first lady I spoke with was very helpful, but when me and my Fiance went back there was a different lady and she was extremely rude; she kept rudely interrupting my fiance when he kept trying to ask questions about the applications and apartments, and then we came back again and the 3rd lady was a little better she did answer all his questions. Just heads up if you are couples or roommates you have to individually fill out an application one application per person it's turns out to be $80 altogether. Makes no sense, but whatever.

We have lived here two years and it’s gotten much worse from the time we moved in. Management is incredibly rude, inconsiderate, and unprofessional. They will just walk into your apartment whether you are there or not and not let you know that they are doing so. (We had work orders and we made it very clear we were not comfortable with them entering the apartment when we weren’t home. The manager was extremely rude about it and they entered anyway without permission as well as without even notifying us that they were going to, they just did.) The amount of roaches I have seen here is disturbing and they are always turning off the water for repairs. Laundry facilities are also poorly cared for and while these apartments supposedly don’t allow dogs, quite a few people have them and they don’t do anything when the outside of the apartment building smells like dog crap because the owners don’t clean it. I know multiple people who have had their cars broken into multiple times here and there has been an increase of homelessness and drug activity in the area recently. There are times where people are camping right next to the property and times where we have also seen them wandering around at night on the property. The one and only good thing I can say about this place is the security guards are great and ready to help out when needed. If you want super cheap, this is the place for you. But if you want comfortable with somewhat decent management, I would go elsewhere.

This place is infested with both roaches, not just german. I scrub my walls and hand scrub my floors but there is no controlling them. I went to the office for help but they told me to buy my own equipment. Tried their pest guy and he literally comes in for 5 minutes, sprays the floor and done. The ladies in the office are terrible, the laundry rooms are always broken and filthy. My clothes come out the washer with STAINS! like weird grease stains.

The only good thing about these apartments was Jerry, the security guy. Maintenance issues go without being fixed in a timely manner, the office staff is extremely rude, the office manager never addresses issues after staff says she’ll call. The laundry room just eats your money and your clothes always come out smelling worse than when they were put in. The pool hours posted are a lie. They close the pool two hours before it says. The water shut off is insane. The trash is everywhere except the dumpsters. They do not do anything about the dogs on property even though it is clearly stated cats only. The noise is ridiculous. You can hear conversations from other apartments. 
I would not wish my worse enemy to live here. I don’t know how this place is even operating still. 

I almost forgot to mention the black mold and roaches. Talk about insanitary conditions.

Great location,very nice apartments . I do recommend to friends . Management is very caring and helpful any small issues is always fixed within that day or the next . I have been living here for a couple of years and have not had no issues . Quiet neighbors,  security constantly walking around checking in things feel very safe .
These 2 bedrooms are great size.   The office staff are very helpful!

Since the day we moved in we’ve been nothing but happy. The staff is helpful and accommodating. Anytime we had an issue they came and fixed it in a timely fashion. Noise levels are usually low and neighbors are never a bother. Security is always on duty and patrolling at night. Definitely would recommend.

Very dishonest "legal" rent contracts affecting tenants ONLY. The administration/staff has a great experience violating basic standards of honesty in dealing with tenants. In other words, be aware of the bunch of rats there. Also, the administration might be protecting people vandalizing cars in the parking lot. DISGRACEFUL
Great location, regular apt stuff, caring staff, feels like home.

Worst place I have ever lived! The water is shut off for hours at a time every other week. The women who work in the office are the rudest bunch of hateful women I have ever met in my life! With the exception of one sweet older lady:). The management live here and one of the ladies husbands sits in his car and smokes his marijuana. If you make a valid complaint on a resident they just happen to be friends with you can expect either nothing to be done or retaliation. The pool sign says 10 pm but the ladies and I use that term very loosely in the office will tell you its 8 pm, so if you get off at say 7 you basically can't enjoy the ammeneties this place has to offer and its one of the few. The laundry room smells so bad thanks to stagnant water due to broken washers that never get fixed. If you call with a question to said ladies innocent or a complaint you will be greeted with a sarcastic tone, and an unwillingness to be of assistance . the maintenance is great and those guys are friendly. I would not recommend this place other than the fact its cheap this place sucks! Your asked to rate this place and the lowest you can give is one star, pshh I honestly am pained to even call it poor , its worse than that!!!!!

I wouldn't rent here.It is cheap,but you get what you pay for.Roaches,roaches and more roaches!Most washers are always broken and office doesn't seem to care or think they should have to do anything about it.Not much noise from neighbors,but at the same time person above me hardly home.Location is the most positive(I mean only)

My time living here was from Aug 2020 to 2024. The rent went up SO much every year I could not afford to save up to move out until now. If you want to pay rent online it's an extra 18% "convenience fee." These are just awful apartments; please do not live here. I can not get the office to reply to my emails or maintenance requests. In fact I submitted two just recently, they canceled one and marked the other as complete even though no one had stopped by. I pay a LOT per month to live here and I end up doing my own maintenance and spending my own money to fix appliance issues. Upon moving out I was tempted to take my light bulbs and fixtures I've put into the apartment. Every time I email the  office a question it goes unanswered. I feel completely ignored by this place. The water is shut off CONSTANTLY, and at random times for "work repairs." I get about 3-4 emails a month about water shut-offs. The AC/Hot air is controlled by the apartments and they have the AC off from mid October to mid May. Yes, May as it's 80 degrees outside and it's even hotter inside. I had to get a fan so I wouldn't be sleeping in my own sweat. The apt I had had not overhead fan, no light in the bedroom, no washer/dryer. I paid too much for the apartment and did my own maintenance and had to pay for laundry. I had a BAD roach infestation in the kitchen and the office did nothing; I put down my own roach killer that worked. There was black mold in the bathroom. I'm in the process of moving out and I'm concerned about the hefty extra fees they may send my way. PLEASE DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE

Thankfully they allowed me to still move out in January when my lease was up, but not with out trying to be sneaky with a 60 day notice that they sent only after 60 days was up. Lastly, when I moved out, no one conducted an inspection of my apartment, and they just took the keys and are now attempting to charge me for the bathtub being resurfaced. No damage was done to the unit, but you won't be getting your deposit back, keep that in mind. Also, good luck trying to get anyone from Living Well Homes to get in contact with you! 

You can find great places to live in ABQ, this just isn't one of them.

I've lived here for about a year and a half and this is the first apartment I've rented. 
I first moved in at a really good price and maintenance was very helpful and fast. A couple months into it my bathtub got a crack in it (twice on different occasions) and both times I had to submit a 7-day notice of rent abatement because they took so long just to respond.
That was the previous management. New management came in around the end of Dec. 2020. Everything was going great until I got a notice telling me I owed them $200. There was no reason on the notice, just that I owed them, which made no sense because I've been on time with all of my payments and have never been informed of a late-fee. Plus they were giving me three days to pay it or else they'd charge me more. Some investigation (of my own volition by the way, management didn't even bother to look into it and just told me "well that's what we have on the records") showed that the charge came from the previous management messing up their numbers and taking the $200 from my security deposit (for reference, my security deposit was an entire months worth of rent because I didn't have credit, which was $200 more than the normal deposit). So after many stressful days and phone calls and whatnot they finally dropped the nonexistent charge.
I wish that was all I had to say but recently I got a notice saying my lease was going to expire two months before it was actually going to expire. I don't even know how they managed to get the date wrong, but I was able to pull up the lease I signed and confirm that once again they had the wrong information. 
The water turns off a lot. It also fluctuates in temperature. Sometimes the cold knob will actually have hot water and the hot knob will give you cold water. And the shower is honestly a pain to deal with, the dial is incredibly  sensitive and sometimes it'll just give you cold water 2 minutes into your shower.
Not to mention the incident that made the news where most residents didn't have any hot water for nine days. And before Christmas! I was lucky to not have been one of those residents.
All in all, without the issues, it's a decent place to live. Nice area and close to shopping centers. Neighbors are quiet. It's certainly nice enough for my first time renting. However that doesn't mean I'm a bit eager to move out. My advice is to save everything you get from this property; the lease, notices, rent payments, everything. It helped me out so much in the long run.
Water never works, apartments flood often, smell like mildew and are loaded with cockroaches. A/C never works; I spent all summer in an apartment that was 85 degrees.

I lived at this apartment complex for two years. My truck got stolen from the apartments parking lot and the staff was very unhelpful with this. They refused to look at the parking lot video cameras for me. I decided to move out in August. I was tired of feeling like my stuff wasn't safe and my apartment did not feel like home anymore due to a roach invasion from my neighbor and constantly seeing homeless people rummaging through the trash. As if the experence wasn't worse enough upon move out the staff insisted that I didn't pay a security deposit and charged me about 200$ for "repairs." Staff is very unfriendly and unprofessional as soon as you don't benefit them anymore. When I first walked into the leasing office a very upset man told me not to move in as he had also had stuff stolen from him. I did not listen to him as I thought he was potentially being irrational but I should have listened. I hope if you are planning on moving in to these apartments that you will listen to me and not make the same mistake. Don't move in.

I have been a resident at Mesa Verde for about a year now, and I am very happy.  I live in a renovated apartment, and I love the updates including stainless steel appliances, glass back splash and wood plank flooring.   The location is excellent and the grounds are well maintained with tons of trees.  I have a view of the Sandia's from my balcony and there is also a nice park nearby to walk my dog.  The staff is very friendly and they are quick to respond to any questions or concerns.  I just renewed for another year, and I am looking forward to the new dog park that is supposed to open in a few months.

Decent employees 

The apartments are very dated and old 

Cheap rent 

Never had any maintenance issues or experienced violent crime

Where to begin.

Second, when the seasons change, it will take the management some time to get to turn on or off the air conditioning. Central cooling is really great but most likely you’ll be having to live with 90 degree days with no A/C before they turn it on. Keep in mind that this area is extremely close to central and crazy people come out of the woodwork at night. The windows that lead outside don’t have any bars to prevent break-ins and there have been several occasions where someone was screaming in the parking lot.

Living here has been a learning experience. Look elsewhere.
I really like the convenience of living here, as a student at UNM.  You really can't get much closer, and it's right next to the Frontier!

This apartment complex has a great location for University students and is reasonably priced.  However, the management is  bad.  They are known to require extra payment for repairs (e.g., windows) where the renter was not notified beforehand and it was unclear if any work was actually done or even needed to be done!  Faced with this, most poor and naive college students just bite the bullet and pay.  There have also been problems with registered renters' vehicles being towed from the parking area and the management not accepting responsibility for the error.
It's an awful place. Run fast run far there are better places then here and don't be fooled like the rest of us.
I have only been here for a couple of weeks but everyone I have encountered has been very helpful and friendly.
Terrible management, dangerous tenants, sub-standard apartments.
Do not move here. Terrible quality and service. Takes a week to get basic things fixed properly. Office staff is rude.

The location and outward appearance of the apartment complex is good.
However, the buildings are old and need to be rennovated on the outside and within.
Overall, for the price and location, it’s great here.

I believe Comanche Wells is an overall decent, Nice place to live. It is very convenient to shopping and downtown area. I would recommend Comanche Wells to anyone that asked me about these apartments.
Over all the front office are professional, about what they do. Need more people like them in the workforce.
Maintenance team is really great. Friendly and always makes sure issue is resolved to my satisfaction before they leave. Property is really nice and overall pretty quiet.
Good apartment community, friendly staff and maintenance crew, and quiet at night.

Very poor to little communication prior to moving in, never saw my unit prior to moving in, couldn't do a proper walk through inventory because once I received my keys I had to move in immediately since I was renting a UHaul so had to by default claim unit is fine but it isn't (non-working outlets, big holes in walls, carpet was poorly stapled down), received a non-working mailbox key post office kept returningmy mail/packages believing unit is still vacant, incorrect charges posted to my account, countless of roaches outside then entering my home and I live on the 3rd floor.
Comanche Wells is a quite clean community, great for all ages.

No laundry, gate security, or pool access. But they wont tell you that when you sign your lease! In fact, the fact that there wasnt an operational laundry facility was never mentioned and I was actually encouraged to place money into my laundry account that I cant use or access. You can hear every little noise outside from inside your unit. In the summer, the cockroach and fruit fly infestation is unacceptable. They do spray every 6 weeks or so, but it needs to be done more often. Find somewhere else, this place is not worth the money!

I have lived here for 3 years. I agree that the place has gone down terribly since MEB MANAGEMENT SERVICES took over; however, those are too small to talk about at
the moment. Right now, I have a leak from the upstairs bathtub and it is collecting into the drywall of my ceiling in my shower, my ceiling about to burst and cave
in. I notified the office at 2:00 PM Friday, Sept. 14, 2018 and the maintenance looked at it. I didn't hear from them so I went to the office at closing (6:00 PM) 
and the manage stated that they checked the apartment above me and didn't find a leak. Ayana stated that they will fix it on Tuesday, Sept. 18th. Right now, I am
unable to sleep because I spoke to the upstairs neighbor earlier and he stated that no one came to check the plumbing and he was home all day. It is 3:00 AM and 
I have called Emergency Maintenance 4 times as well as calling MEB Mgmt Services and no Maintenance man has called me back. The collection of water is larger and
I am to afraid of going to sleep.
