Comanche Wells is a great community!  The office staff is nice and maintenance guys are very responsive with requests.  The staff does care about residents and greets me by name.  They even know my pets name.  Love having a fitness room I can use when it fits my schedule.  I've never had to wait to use the laundry rooms either.  Very conveniently located.  They are pet friendly, you can find pet treats in the office!!!

Comanche Wells is a great place to live and the staff is exceptional. The rent is reasonable and they offer a student discount. The complex is kept clean and neat. There's a park, volleyball court, and pool to hang out with family and friend. The noise is minimal. The parking lot is huge. I like that it's a gated community. I love it here at Comanche Wells.

So far the community is nice. The managers in the office are great with follow up calls. The rent is low. The community is clean and well maintained. The pool and jacuzzi or kept clean. The laundry mats are nice. There's even a small park and volleyball court. Overall very safe and convenient for freeway, multi-use trails and grocery within distance.
Very nice, quiet. Nobody bothers you. Beautiful area. Small environment.

I moved into Sedona ridge in September of this year. It has been an amazing experience. Audrey in the office helped me from start to finish. She made the application and move in process effortless. I got an apartment on the third floor, it is spacious and beautiful. The property is secured well. My kids and I are loving the indoor pool. The park is great. The trees and grass make my view out the window GORGEOUS. You will not find such great apartments at such an affordable price. Would recommend to all.

Despite the gated community, the service is bad. I’m not sure the workers work to keep the place clean. I’m paying to hear neighbors having arguments and just about everything under the sun. In the process of leaving the year lease 6 months into the lease.

I lived here for 1.5 years and the themes were insanely unresponsive maintenance and management. Terrible neighbors. My car got at least 20 scratches and dents parking in terrible parking lot where chaos reigns. Move here only if you despise peace and quiet and love to know exactly what your neighbors are doing in the apartment next door. (Spoiler alert: They are fighting like cats and dogs from the stress of living here)

Also, try calling the office and see if they answer. It's about 50% of the time that they bother to answer at all. The apathy of the staff here is the stuff of legends.

The worst part about this place is the office I have never met such rude people. When you walk in the women in the office ask you what do you want with a dirty look and if you actually did need anything you're not going to get it. If you have any maintenance request they wont come until you ask them at least three time because they're to lazy to submit the work order. It's been in the high 90s here and our air conditioner has not worked we've called at least twice a week this month so far. Our dishwasher has been broken since we've moved in but we gave up on that after months of trying to get them to at least come look at it. Cars get stolen, theres dumpster divers that leave trash everywhere, and if you have a package going to the front office they will refuse it and have it sent back. Not worth the time, money, and patience.

I have lived here almost 2 years and seen several management teams come and go. This one is the worst. The laundry works on cards only. The card machine has been broken for 4 months. If you want to use the laundry you have to buy a card from them in $20 increments which means that you will have money that can’t be spent left on the card every time. They issue a new card every time and won’t refund or transfer credits. Plus when a package is delivered to the office they don’t notify you. That is fine if you know something is coming but any surprise packages sit in their store room. If you complain about anything they just say that is their policy. The apartments are getting old and the floors are uneven and noisy. The pools were closed most of the last summer due to bacterial problems. If you can, pay the extra money and go someplace else.

I moved into the Sedona Ridge Apartment complex on a six month lease to see how things were. At first glance the apartments seemed nice and the grounds clean and well taken care of, but after that new apartment glow faded came the problems.

I discovered there were roaches coming into the building that didn't originate from my apartment. I called the staff and they said they'd send an exterminator out, but that he was only available on a set schedule so I had to wait over a week for him to come down. This worked for maybe a month, then the roaches returned. After multiple visits I ended up buying my own poison to kill them and after that I didn't see anymore.

The management staff was friendly and helpful, but the maintenance staff (except for the emergency guy) was terrible. When I first moved in I noted problems I saw in the unit and submitted it to the front office and figured the issues would be fixed,but trying to get them fixed was like pulling teeth. The maintenance staff never came to fix issues I filed requests for multiple times (even with management writing direct notes for me) and when they did come they never finished the job, leaving things half-finished and broken.

Worst of all was a set of neighbors that constantly fought, choking and hitting each other out in the common areas and in the hallway. One even broke the others' cell phone on my door and when I reported it to the staff I was told to call the police. Apparently someone else did since one day coming home from work the cops were in their apartment and then they vanished for awhile. I'd hoped they'd been evicted, but no luck there as they were back and must have thought I'd reported them since from that point on my car was attacked with eggs and smeared with dog crap constantly. It got so bad and the staff didn't do a thing, so that I had to park across the complex at the actual staff building to get the attacks to stop and these lasted up until I left.

Never have I seen jerks like that given free reign to drive out decent paying residents while they seemingly got off with at most a slap on the wrist. Because of this and the aforementioned reasons I could not recommend this complex to any potential renter unless they seriously clean up their act and deal with these jerks, get their pest control problem under control, and actually make their maintenance staff work for their money.

I have lived at the Mesa Ridge Apartments for a total of 3 years. I lived here from September 2019 - September 2020 and the previous management was horrible at that time. I considered not to move back, but decided to give it a 2nd chance. I moved back in November 2021 and I MADE THE RIGHT CHOICE. The new manager, Nicole, and her AMAZING team members have done a great job turning this place around. The staff are very helpful, friendly, prompt, and are always willing to work with you. The staff are always reachable and willing to go above and beyond to ensure you have a safe, clean, comfortable place to live. Maintenance staff are always doing a great job keeping the complex grounds clean and completing maintenance requests in a timely matter. The apartment are spacious, and the patio is great! The other reason why I love this place is that ITS GATED! I am very glad I chose the Mesa Ridge Apartments as my home! I highly recommend it to be your home too!

This is the absolute worst place to live. Yes they make the outside look nice, but inside the apartments what a nightmare. Large burner on the stove takes 45 minutes to boil water & if I wanted dinner I would have had to start the night before & if I was lucky it would be ready by 6pm. The so called grounds people would use their blowers & blow all the leaves & dirt into the patio of the first floor tenants & management would send you a threatening letter to clean it up or get evicted. They offer nothing to tenants that have lived there for several years. IMO if some one has lived there for 10+ years offer them some type of discount.

Mesa ridge is great from the grounds to the office and maintenance team! The grounds are always so clean and the laundry rooms are always clean. Office staff is very helpful from Nicole to Randy and ash too! Never have i had such a great experience at an apartment complex before. 1000% recommended!

I have lived here for over 15-years and although the complex is well established and has seen it's share of problems it is a very quiet place to live. Most importantly the newest management team is doing a great job trying to make Mesa Ridge as comfortable  and peaceful as possible. Anywhere you live there are bound to be undesireable people but the new management is doing their best at weeding these people out. There will always be very nice tenants living here.

this is amazing location. near lots of useful things, 2 major bus stops, and not noisy despite being off a major street and near I-40. lovely simple apartment complex. perfect for the "dont wanna pay for stuff I dont use" type. great staff and management  that are always ready to help. they do excellent job with grounds keeping and keeping it clean.

best advice: be smart about what you own. they're good sized for 1 bedroom apartments  but it doesn't take much to lose that comfortable feeling. 

also and especially if you cook, pay the $70 rent increase for your appliance upgrade. my refrigerator spent 3 months with  irregular temperatures.  I would wake up and everything would be frozen or luke warm from the fridge shutting off in the night.

I've been here for 3 years, I've seen ups & downs with residents but at the end of day this place is really where I want to live. Miss Susan is very helpful, she has truly put the effort in to make sure this location as safe & secure as possible. I'm from the south and I think that southern hospitality goes a long way. I can say with absolute honesty that as long as your willing to help to make Mesa Ridge YOUR HOME you will enjoy your time here at MESA RIDGE APARTMENTS ??

Run, run far away from this place. They will make your life a living hell here. Lived a whole summer no ac, can't get the office to respond, when they do they are rude and make you feel like your putting them out to do their job. When you try to move out they completely ignore you. All 6 people that lived there with me have moved out and had the same experience. Then there are random people staying in empty units and partying. That's not safe for the kids living there. No one should ever be treated like they treat people. It's absolutely disgusting the stories from everyone that lived there.

Pictures on website are very deceiving. Management is terrible they never respond. Probably the worst place to live in this area way overpriced!! Not renovated even tho is says remodeled. More like a quick flip some paint and sticker floor from Walmart.

I went to go look and it smelled like dead bugs. There was dead roaches everywhere the floors were disconnected from the wall there was termite damage to the cabinets. The outside part was falling apart the floor was caving in felt like I was going to fall through. The “newly renovated” was a joke the place was disgusting. From bugs to caving in floors,dirty carpet, and walls disconnected from each other. Not to mention management is so hard to get ahold of.

Save yourself a headache, this place is run down with very little maintenance done. If you have anything broken, better just get use to the idea of fixing it yourself. I have called the leasing office and reported issues as well as gone onto their online report system, and still nothing. You are on your own here! My place is infested with centipedes, I am having to pay for pest control to come out and spray my place out of my own pocket. The absolute worst is having to deal with the people at the leasing office, do not trust them they will rip you off on your billing if you don't check your account, and the will want you pay via E-Check online in their portal. There is a huge issue that they want your long in credentials to your personal bank account. If you opt out of that you can pay with Credit card with fifty dollars in fees. Over all the management is the modern day slumlord. There are better places to stay for the money.

Apartments are run down, noisy and drafty. Mice, bugs and ants always around, can’t get rid of them. Management is a joke, never around unless they want more money. Do not consider coming here, way overpriced!

If you want to live in an over priced hazardous drafty apartment definitely rent here. Management is terrible, maintenance is rude, and you’ll have many roommates such a spiders, roaches, ants, and mice. Disgusting place to live.
Excellent place and very professional employees answered all my questions.

I remember I was so nervous to find a good place to live in Albuquerque and I stumbled upon mission Hills. From the start, the staff was so helpful and attentive to my needs and made me feel really welcome on my move in day. The entire move-in process was extremely stress-free, and I cannot thank the staff enough. Apartment exceeds my expectations, and I think the pictures did not do it justice. If you're looking for an affordable and safe place to live in ABQ, give this place a chance!

They say that these apartments are wheelchair friendly don’t boot don’t believe it. The only way you can get inside a bedroom with a wheelchair is if you take the doors off. Even then some of the rooms you can’t get in depending on the angle of the room. They say they have a food pantry in the rooms. Only if it’s a two bedroom apartment. A single room apartments do not have food pantries. They also say that there are ceiling fans in the apartments there is only one ceiling fan and that’s in the dining room. Before you move in here talk to some of the tenants away from management, living here can be a nightmare.

I lived here for 3 years. In that time my car had been stolen, windows broke out of it and tires stolen. My downstairs neighbor was shot, my neighbor across from me was the victim of a home invasion, drug deals are common and the FBI was always raiding someone's apartment. This place is not safe. The management doesn't care to fix any problems. If something breaks in your apartment, good luck getting it fixed in less than 6 months. The "gym" is a broken treadmill and a  half working bike. The laundry rooms are never clean or open most of the time. Homeless people live near the dumpsters and even walking around the complex for a little excercise is risky. Avoid.
They repair all necessaries things and the property is well maintained. Nice pools and Laundry. I have been living here for 5 years.
I like it here, I been live here for 14 or 15 years!

Forced to go on a month to month lease with no option to renew or possibly move into one of their "remodeled units". Now they are evicting those tenants on a month to month with no explanation. "Remodeled" units look nice from afar but after inspection, some still have roof leakage, clogged drains, water damage, and cracked windows. Twice my AC broke down during the months of July and August and it took maintenance 2 wks to respond to my request and my many calls into the office. Water heater leaked back in Oct and came to realize water heater had not been replaced since 1980. I do not recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a "luxury" apartment.

This property management is incompetent and they “remodeled on evictions purposely to raise rent in an unsecured complex. I’m sure the ongoing upgrades will fade from lack of ability and care so save your hard earned income for something not pretending to be luxury.

They are forcing folks on month to month leases and then kicking a bunch of them out and have intentionally neglected the property for insurance payouts while advertising it as "luxury." false. Horrible management who has been gone for 3 years. Constant water leaks, and harassment, intimidation, and property damage by owners, management, and staff. Complete neglect and no way to contact for maintenance requests, they don't care about you and they don't care about us current residents. Scum.

over all my stay has been great. i started in a 1 bedroom, now im in a 2 bd, 2 bathroom. thanks to the manager and worker for maintaining the property, from the pool, trees, grass and flowers. im glad to call this place my home.

At Cloverleaf, we experienced outstanding service from a committed staff. The spacious floor plans offer plenty of space for both living and entertaining, along with ample storage options. Plus, the location is unbeatable, just seconds from I-25, yet surprisingly peaceful without the hustle and noise.
Location it’s great, freeways nearby, gas stations, fast food  restaurants, groceries stores, management are pretty cool.. better than other places! For sure.. A home away from Home.

I have lived in many apartments though out Albuquerque, NYC and Portland and this is the only one that felt like a true home. It is the only one I lived the longest in. I lived there for 5 years and the only reason I left is I had to take care of a sick parent.

The grounds are beautiful with so many trees, green grass and beautiful flowers! Don't forget the amazing pool! Several apartments even have their own backyard. No apartment is alike and I had one of the largest apartments! They all have their own unique attributes which make you feel like you live in a house vs an apartment. I had huge walk in closets, fire place, jet tub as well as my own washer/dryer laundry room. The size of the apartment was larger than my first house I bought! The staff was always helpful and available when needed no matter the day or time, including holidays. So when something broke and as you know things never like to break when it was convenient the owners were there to address and fix it immediately! I have owned several homes and I still miss this apartment and all it has to offer!!!

Where do I begin…
If you want a honest review then it won’t get more honest than this. I have been waiting to post this review since the time I moved in and out of my apartment and I have officially moved out so it’s not a paid post or for any type of “reward” that some apt complexes give to write a review. It’s just a honest review from a young, first apartment, grad student that just needed to tell you folks the real deal about this place. When I first was looking for my new home to live in for the next four years I literally stumbled upon this place around midnight one night and on an outrageous page number on apartments.com because I couldn’t find the right apartment after searching for months. But when I say I thank God everyday that I found this place I MEAN IT. This was my very FIRST apartment and I stayed in it for FOUR YEARS! This is the best apartment complex in Albuquerque.

My husband and I are current residents at Cloverleaf. We have been living on the property for about 4 years now. I highly recommend looking into this apartment complex. The manager, Tonya, is very understanding to the needs of the residents. The front office manager, Veronica, is extremely helpful and caring. They make us feel so welcomed. There has been more lights and cameras installed on the property. I feel very safe in my home. I have not had any noise problem with any neighbors. We have never experienced any bug problems. The pool is cleaned daily.  Maintenance in our apartment, when it is needed, is done in a timely manner. Overall i would recommend Cloverleaf Apartments to anyone.

These apartments are decent but they do have a bug issue but I was able to get rid of all the ones in my apartment on my own. Every weekend there are police and since iv moved there 2 people have been killed.
This apartment complex is terrible. I've been without air conditioning for over a month now and I have 2 kids and a small dog.. They don't care and won't fix the problem.

My girlfriend and I lived at Taylor Ranch “Luxury” Apartments for a year. When we first moved in, it was already quite rocky. We were missing parts of our apartment and it was impossible to get work orders done in a timely manner. To their credit, once they switched property managers, the work orders got fixed faster. However, issues kept arising while we lived at Taylor Ranch and as a result, we did not renew our lease. Some of the major issues we encountered are as follows:

Had work orders open for months when we first moved in.

Our apartment was dirty when we first moved in, laundry closet doors were missing, our garbage disposal did not work, the screen from one of the windows was missing, and several outlets didn’t work, as well.

We had to call them to fix our garbage disposal and the guy who fixed it forgot a step resulting in our garbage disposal not working again.

AC was about 20 years old. Not efficient at all, we even had them look at it and that resulted in “That’s just how they are”. In summer, our electric bill was about $250 for a one bed, one bath because of the AC. Due to the AC being horrible, we ended up having to buy 4 fans in addition to the AC constantly being on. 

Parking was constantly a nightmare. We ended up using the street parking on Montano Plaza until my car got broken into and robbed. 

There was a constant ant infestation and massive anthills in front of our apartment that we called them to help us out with. We ended up dealing with it ourselves because they put out traps once and never checked on them again.

During our lease, the pool was only open 2 weeks out of the year.

My car got booted and then towed because the covered parking permit was not “correctly displayed” despite me having a permit and the apartment complex having my make, model, and license plate. 

To top all of this off, the property manager, Valerie, accused of us of having a pitbull that attacked someone and was insistent that they “identified” us in the video. The property manager told us that she was going to file a police report against us and call animal control to take our dogs away. After coming to our apartment, they finally admitted they made a mistake and saw that we did NOT have a pitbull. I kept asking how they “identified” us and they would dodge the question. 

Finally, our security deposit was returned July 1st even though we vacated the apartment and returned the keys May 28th, 34 days after. 

So glad I’m done with this place.

I have lived at Taylor Ranch Luxury Apartments since September, 2019.  I would like to take this opportunity to commend the personnel and Management.  Any interactions that I have had with them has always been positive.  The maintenance employees display professionalism, they are knowledgeable about the task at hand and in assuring it’s completion. The office personnel are very pleasant and very helpful whenever I’ve reached out to them.

I had lived here a year. All year round there were ants EVERYWHERE In every room. No matter how much I cleaned or had them spray. The parking lot has VERY limited. There is side street parking but my car was stolen and the staff didn’t care. There are not any cameras and there is not any security. They have fruit trees ALL over the property. Beautiful but they leave the sidewalks slippery. The staff doesn’t care about its residents at all. If you’re looking for an apartment complex where you don’t care about any of these then welcome.

When we first moved in, everything seemed perfect. Two months in and we found mice in our bathroom cabinets. Maintenance has come by, but this is our second run in with them. I have lived in ABQ my whole life and have never had an issue with mice anywhere else that I have lived. Not fun and very upsetting. The property is nice and we have loved our apartment up until this point. If you don't mind little friends around, then this place is perfect.

Where do I begin? Should I begin with the ant infestation? Or should I start with how I absolutely "loved" living with roaches? This is by far the worst place I have ever lived at and I am looking forward to the day I leave this hot mess. Carpets are disgusting and the parking lots are horrible. Wiser Now.

review: Central ave is incredibly dangerous. homeless everywhere. people on drugs. they knock on doors at night at this place and have shattered windows. When I first moved here the building had some serious problems with bad tenants, ranging from ongoing behavior nuisances to alleged criminal activity.  That activity spanned from low level property crimes to prostitution and drug dealing.   This has been cleared up in the first six months by Capstone to about 90% reduction.  So now a quick breakdown.  

Pros:  
1.  Location: you can't ask for a better location than this place if you are seeking the urban living atmosphere.  Within five to ten minute walking distance to several coffee shops, eateries, bars and breweries.  It is within a block of a 14 screen movie theater.  
2.  Parking:  It has adequate parking in a psuedo-secure underground garage.  I say pseudo-secure as there are vulnerabilities.  All things being equal its on par or better than other surrounding properties.  
3.  Rooftop Deck:  This is a nice addition to a modern urban experience.  It comes complete with a grill and is partitioned with a community rooftop garden.
4.  Grocery Store and Pharmacy on the first floor as well as sushi restaurant.  The grocery store is nice if you don't need to pack a fridge.  Its prices vary, some stuff is real good deal, their might be few things that will cost more, but for the convenience its worth it.  
5. Interior:  The interior is decent.  It has faux-wood floors, new fridge, electric stove and dishwasher.  It has washer and dryer hookups for a stackable, or you can use one of the washrooms on the 2nd or 4th floor.  
Cons:  
Security of the common areas:  The garage as I mentioned is psuedo-secure.  It can be breached by people waiting for a resident entering or exiting.  This facilitates access to the rest of the building through the elevators.  All someone has to do is wait for the elevator to be commanded to the desired floor. 

Single Elevator:  This is an issue for a couple reasons.  First is moving in.  Access to the stairwells may not be a convenient option depending on where your unit is situated.  

That is it in a nutshell.  There are a few minor annoyances.  Living below the rooftop deck can get noisy.  Not an issue at night as they shut the access off at 9pm, but if you are shift worker you may want to avoid a unit directly below the deck.  All in all, I would say the property is okay.  Its a good short term market rate to transition to somewhere else.  I would rate it lower for long term living.

Plus, it's very peaceful, no issues with my neighbors, a police officer on sight 24/7, and a secure garbage bin for residents only.  If there were anything I would say that would really make our living conditions better would be adding ceiling lights/fans to the bedrooms and a building playground on the property for the kids to play at. In my opinion though, for the price I am paying, I should not have as many problems as I do (poor wiring makes my circuit breakers trip frequently, water hookups are backwards, my dishwasher was literally not attached when I moved in, etc.). I will definitely not renew a contract here. They smile at you while pocketing your money.
I seems to be a very nice area, it seems to have what is needed and it's very spacious place.   If something broken the repair guy comes right away to check on things.
The apartments are poorly built and can hear eery noise from the apartment above me.

This apartment asked me to pay more than $1600 for the move out charge. They changed whole stove and told me the stove is totally damaged but I am pretty sure it is still working. Also They replaced the carpet for some stains that can be cleaned out!!!!Not just me, they changed my friend’s stove after she left. Don’t live there if you don’t want to lose your money!!!!!!

Vehicle break ins happen weekly here. Please, please do not move here unless you want to have your glass repaired every couple of months. I’ve had my cars broken into 3 times. My friend visiting had hers broken into. One of my neighbors has had theirs broken into 3 times. A different neighbors was broken into last Sunday. You frequently see vehicles driving through the complex with tape and plastic on their windows. There was a mass break in of 10 vehicles in July. When I contacted the complex, they told me I was lying and they lied and said that this is not a recurring problem. So I have continually documented the vehicle break ins. Please, if you value your safety and property, do not move in here. When asked what the complex is going to do to provide better security, they will not put in a fence, gate, or security cameras. Just had the same vehicle broken into again today. It’s ridiculous. This place is NOT safe.

Since this is a new property I’m the first person to live in my apartment and I love it! The staff is great and always helpful. The amenities are amazing and the property itself gives classy/elegant vibes. I love living here
Beautiful property & AMAZING staff which is almost impossible to find!
Beautiful property with awesome amenities.  The floor plans and finishes are high quality.  The decor in the common areas is quite luxurious and the customer service is impeccable.

The Roseberry is a wonderful property with modern amenities in a easily accessible location. Perks include a well thought out rose garden, urban art, a large-scale lounge pool, and more. 

Additionally, the community’s staff is unmatched. Their professional, knowledgeable, friendly, authentic, invested, and responsive. 

Regardless of your life stage, let me assure you that choosing The Roseberry is the right decision.
This place is near empty lived here for a year and have seen the same 10 faces, unfulfilled promises and no internet

The location and that the units are aesthetically pleasing are the only positives to this building. The community WiFi is horrible, rarely works, and you can’t install your own.  The common spaces are still not complete, a year after they were said to be open.  There’s still a piece of tape with a hand written number to mark my apartment door after 16 months. The staff are slow to respond, if they respond at all, and it’s always “I’ll speak with the owners”, followed by a “no”.  However, my biggest complaint is the dual washer and dryer that is your only option in the units. It takes more than 6 hours to wash and dry a very small load of laundry.

Unfinished amenities 
Bad wifi 
Expensive parking 
Washer/Dryer (dryer doesn’t dry properly) 
Exposed framework is inviting to critters 
Problems with drainage 
To name a few problems, definitely not worth the luxury price tag.

Tons of issues with the apartments. Flooding of units, plumbing issues, things breaking, and maintenance taking a crazy amount of time to fix things. Plus the first floor smells like sewage 80% of the time.

I like the apartment, and I like the area. That being said, they will tell you it’s very quiet and insulated, that’s not true. I can hear your conversation from down the hall. Either an elephant lives upstairs or it’s not well insulated. The door fobs don’t work half the time, truly sometimes I can’t get into the apartment with my keys, so people will just prop the doors open. Also, there’s been an alarm for the elevator going off every thirty seconds for the last 2 weeks and no one will fix it. Also, no one picks up their dog poop (they say they’re going to fix it, but it’s been that way since I’ve been here for a few months), and there’s limited parking. I would say the location is great and the apartment is nice, but for the money I would strongly consider all your options.

Not a bad place to live. The only complaints I have are the loud crosswalk bell, the A/C being inop during the summer, and packages not being able to be delivered because all doors are locked throughout the day.
This has been the best community living experience. I moved in last month and I am very pleased with the professional staff and the gorgeous building.
Most luxurious modern apartment complex in Columbia. Staff, amenities, and location are amazing!

As a college student renting for the first time you want an apartment that feels safe, friendly, and clean. Bennet at Bullstreet is all of those things and more with its wonderful staff and fabulous amenities.
Bennet @ Bullstreet is top tier for Columbia, SC downtown living! Second to none with amenities.

I am so impressed with everything about this community, mostly importantly the management team.  Amanda, Norman, and Gabby are incredible!  They are kind, responsive, knowledgeable, helpful, hardworking, and committed to the highest quality standards.  The interior of the buildings are impeccably maintained and well constructed.  The location is close to shopping and transportation.  Give Bennet at Bullstreet a look, you will love what you see in luxury apartment living!
The best living - from the people to the amenities!

I applied for a unit here. I called before I applied because of abnormal circumstances I’m currently dealing with. This lady told me everything is fine so I applied. I was denied with no reason why. They were prompt to return texts and calls as well as professionally courteous but kinda shady with the application

I worked at this place a few times and even walked all the units with a prospective corporate buyer last year. I could not believe the amount of black mold in these units. Honestly I'm not sure how these units have not been condemned. Behind the many coats of paint, under the many layers of vinyl floors, interior heater closets and inside the walls lies a horrid wealth of microbial growth. The lower to lower middle class residents with compromised immune systems or infant children could be awarded a pretty penny here with the right council. Surprisingly during our IAQ check we found traces of asbestos. (Which was a deal breaker for the corporation I was employed by). There are remaining asbestos materials in some buildings and others have trace amounts. So..... Me personally, I would pass! I hope this helps at least infants from being subjected to these living conditions.

I was on the fence on renewing, but after I saw how this new team was getting stuff done, and seeing the direction this community is going, I did not want to leave. Maintenance issues are getting better and they have a full team and completing them in a timely manner. The office staff is pretty cool too. Clark and Jazz I know the best. They are awesome and the two new girls Jamie and Jennifer are really sweet. Everyone in the office really cares about the residents out here and it shows every time I walk in the office. They know my name, they ask about personal things I've been going through, and offer guidance if they aren't super busy. Would defiantly recommend Gleneagle to anyone looking for a place to home. These people make it feel like home. Wish I could give it 10 stars!
Great maintenance team, gets work orders done in a timely manner, staff in the office is firm, but fair. I am seeing good things to come.
Jasmine and Leah are awesome ladies to work with!!! They go beyond and above their duties! Always willing to help in anyway they can! Keep it the good work!!

Been living here with my young family. The 3 bdrm apartments are spacious with large closets, pantries, and lots of kitchen storage. There's also outdoor storage, private patio/balconies to enjoy as well. The staff is friendly, and works well with residents to help them get adequate solutions to their maintenance and living conditions. There are several nice amenities (pool+ gym+ grilling spaces to name a few) to utilize and the property has undergone several renovations & upgrades to keep the complex environment beautiful and safer for residents. The location is almost in the back door to shopping, dining, & recreational experiences of Harbison Blvd/Columbiana & Seven Oaks/Saluda Schoals Parks!  It is also located within the highly desired Lexington-Richland 5 school district, of which my children have been excelling. Come check it out!

I have never in my life felt so mistreated and disrespected! I came in the office to get a air filter that was taken out of my townhouse this morning along with being told that the 2 air conditioner units will finally be returned to the upstairs bedroom windows because my air isn’t working properly again this summer. Hours later I came back to my home and felt the humidity and the air quality was at its very lowest. The maintenance guy told me he had to remove the window units from another apartment, I understood that but more then 5 hours later with no air filter with a unit barley working made matters worse. I came to the office asking about my new filter it’s was around 3:45pm. Denise the new manger wanted me to come in her office. I felt more  comfortable standing by the door of her office. At  that point she asked what was going on with my air  unit. I explained the REAL ISSUE and that per a very  qualified person “whoever bought that unit brand  new didn’t buy the right size for the square footage.”  Until that was resolved it will never work correctly. She threatened to call the police because I asked for a filter. She tried to play the “scared” role.. BEFORE YOU MOVE HERE PLEASE ASK A RESIDENT IN PASSING!!! The truth is in the people that live here!!

The administration is not if it is worse now than before, the manager extremely rude, my last months here have been a ruin, since 2017 I live here and I can assure you that if you move here you will regret for the rest of your life, not worth It's worth paying so much money in an income, the water is very high, you pay monthly for an animal control and never fumigate.

The water bill is now more expensive than my SCEG bill. Since the new management took over I went from $40 a month to $81.99 a month. I’m also being double billed for pest control and trash monthly. Residents are busting leases near me to move and vacant apartments everywhere. Management blames water company. Water company after multiple escalations states the double charges are sent from the complex as they only handle combined billing. I suspect I’m paying water for the vacant units.

I recently moved to St.Andrews Apartments and it has been nothing but amazing! The staff is very welcoming and caring, and the place is beautiful and very affordable.
I can say that I am enjoying my stay here.

I was glad to get the townhouse at first, but when I went to sit on the patio, I was ran inside from the putrid odor of pet poop and urine. I wrote to corporate and someone called and said that it would be cleaned......never happened! Before the letter, I complained to office management and was basically told that I was less than a dog! That stinch now comes through AC! Mold in unit.  Trash thrown around the complex and is ignored!  If you have a hardship, forget about Monument having compassion!

When I first moved here 2 years ago, the neighborhood was good and the office staff was even better.  They was timely and prompt with all of my questions and concerns and they appreciated the residents.   They changed the office staff about 3 months ago and I dread when the first of the month comes now.  The new staff is very unprofessional and they do not care about the residents.  They have bad attitudes and they care about taking breaks and eating more than helping the residents out.  The neighborhood is still good but every time I turn around, I see more and more people moving out than moving in.  I cannot WAIT til my lease is up so I can get out of this place! If you are on the search for a new apartment/town-home, please save yourself the trouble of having to deal with attitudes when your rent is due!
Great friendly employers.... Maintenance isn't the best.
My experience with apartments.com was great and I love my new apartment.

I have lived in St Andrews apartments since November of 2013. The apartment complex does a great deal to build relationships between members. Several times a year, the management hosts events for the entire community where they offer entertainment to bring people together. The management is awesome, and maintenance request are always responded to quickly. Also, the apartment has a quiet policy from 10 pm to 6 am, so that everyone is afforded the opportunity to receive a good sleep. They also provide pest control. The only downsides are the minimal space provided for parking, and the fact that loud noise is allowed until 10 pm. The community events always involve a DJ who plays music very loud until 10 pm, which may not be good for others who have younger children like I do.

So let me start by saying that I have rented apartments basically all my life and I would have to say this is the worst by far. So first they rented me an apartment with a broken AC unit and since day one I have asked the management to fix my broken AC unit. It is now SEVEN months later and they have yet to even come to my door. Now I have taken legal action against them in order to just get my unit fixed. PLEASE save yourself the hassle and DO NOT RENT HERE!

The neighborhood is quiet for the most part but this apartment gets ! star due to the poor professionalism of the management and office staff. If I could rate it a zero I would. Maintenance is lazy and they're an image of the office staff. Just save yourself the headache and go find another place to live that will appreciate you and your business. I've never seen such ignorance and lack of willingness to help from management, They charge to much per month to be so slack, Run away. I moved and will never refer or return

I live in the Barringer building. It is a historic building which means it can have problems from time to time, but the maintenance staff is always on it! I put in a work order for my sink and Eddie came and fixed it right away. Fast and friendly service is always a plus. 

The leasing office staff is also very helpful. They are sometimes short staffed, but they try their best and it shows! Every concern I have brought up they have been sure to follow up on and help to the best of their ability.

I used to live in the Barringer building. It got laundry machines on the even floors. Unfortunately, quite a fraction of them did not function. That means people in the entire building only had 2 or 3 sets of working machines. What's worse, the staff barely cleaned these machines on a regular basis. That was awfully gross. My underwears were attached with dog hair every time I used these machines for watching.

I love the  building, and decor, very trendy and modern. Central location on Main street provides endless entertainment and exquisite dining experiences. Amazingly friendly staff! Best place to live in downtown Columbia!

So far I'm liking it! Everything has been fast and acceptable. Leasing/management staff do stress the 60 and 30 day move out notices during signing of lease so they are working on past problems stated in other reviews. I'm sure I'll change this review if I feel otherwise in the future! The location is prime for anyone looking for events and things to do.

Great choice to experience downtown Columbia daily(they have multiple buildings around the area, all within a few blocks of each other). While I can only speak of my experience living in Barringer, the staff overall have always been helpful and prompt in responding to any requests. Waking up on Saturday mornings with the Farmer's Market just outside the door is a treat - not to mention easy access to the many festivals Columbia likes to host downtown. 

I do wish there was a change machine in the building for the community laundry machines, or that I could open up the windows(Barringer specific I believe due to the age of the building), however this is a very small price to pay for a price/location combo that can't be beat(and free gym!).

In my experience, Capitol Places is one of my favorite places I have ever lived. Maintenance is quick to respond if I ever have an issue and they are very friendly. The location of all apartments is ideal--right on Main Street. It is nice to be able to walk just around the corner to the leasing office to drop off rent, etc. Management does a really good job of scheduling resident outings, which creates a nice sense of community. As for the apartment itself, it is really cool living in a historic building and a space that is as spacious as it is beautiful. I would definitely recommend living here!

The location is awesome! Right outside my door is the local weekend market, great restaurants downtown, and only 15 minute walk to USC campus. I feel very secure in my apartment building and the amenities are pretty good (free gym pass to a small local gym, washer/dryer are rarely busy). Compared to other apartments in the downtown area, the rent is fairly priced. The staff is generally helpful and responsive; however, I have had some challenges, including slow or nonexistent responses to carpet cleaning requests when I first moved in, having to ask for a copy of my lease agreement without being given one upon signing, etc. They do promote some community building activities (i.e. free taco lunch, march madness bracket challenge, etc.); however a lot of the events they hold are during the day when I can't participate because I work a 8-5 job.

I have lived here for almost two years My apartment is comfortable, great view. The building is beautiful and secure. Its right downtown and so close to everything, It's near restaurants, the Columbia Museum of Art, a movie theatre, many venues. and also the University of South Carolina, one of the best libraries in the country and all those wonderful art galleries I'm a USC student and the walk to Class is about 15 minutes. The maintenance staff has been great and friendly. I love to live in Capitol Places building.

Capitol Places is a great place to live. It's right on Main St., close to all sorts of restaurants and entertainment, and walking distance to USC. I highly recommend it for anyone who is looking for a downtown living experience.

I live in the Barringer Building right on Main Street. Everything is great except on the street parking because it is always crowded on Main Street. The apartment offers option to park in the garage but it is not the best option because of its location and safety. Other than that, the apartment is great. Staffs and maintenance are always helpful and friendly. The farmer market right outside is also a plus.

I have lived here for about a year and I absolutely love it. It’s a quick walk to the vista, up and down Main Street, and soda city is basically my front door. I have nothing bad to say, excellent management!

I love the downtown area and Soda City Market every weekend right out side the building. Parking is one downside as the garage is three blocks away. The apartment is comfortable and mostly quiet but as with all apartment buildings you have some noises from other apartments. There is a party venue next door and they seem to have an event every weekend but generally the loud music wraps up by 11 PM. There are nearby restaurants and bars some as close as next door and many just a few blocks away. The management has handled all my concerns in a polite and timely manner. Now if there was a full service grocery within about three blocks that would be outstanding.

As students, we need a place that's close to USC, this one is on main Street, within walking distance to USC. It's perfect, the staff are friendly and were very understanding of my service animal.  Maintenance is quick and efficient and rooms are spacious with great views of the city!

this is the worst experience i have ever lived at….if it wasn’t in the location i need i would’ve moved. gats do not work and never work. remote useless, fob key useless, even the gate code doesn’t work…and when you ask questions you’re being difficult no i’m upset i’m not getting what i pay for.

This apartment is very unorganized and awful to live in. The leasing office gives you answers just to get you out of the office, and they only tend to favor the remodeled apartments. The West Shore organization is difficult to contact to discuss concerns. 

While living here, my refrigerator broke for two weeks with no accommodations. Our air conditioning was broken for two months with no accommodations made until we constantly went to the office. Additionally, we had a leak in our kitchen. We attempted to email and contact the regional property manager, but she has not responded to our last five emails. The leasing staff does not know how to handle situations and fails to provide updates.

Went without AC for 6 weeks and counting. Had to go to the office 20 times to remind them that my AC is out despite having multiple maintenance request active.
Would not recommend anyone that values quality of life.

Where to start...

We have appliances not working and other issues in the apartment since moving in that haven't even been looked at since the day we moved in, regardless of all the work orders, office visits and emails sent.

Gates have been broken and wide open for in/out traffic as long as we have been here...so much for the gated community.

There is always trash everywhere in the outdoor common area by the children playground and the grill, of course, does not work.

The online "residents section" brings you to a portal where you actually cannot put a work orders in nor pay. You have to go in-person everytime or call and nothing gets done anyway.

As other reviewers mentioned, they seem to take advantage of people moving in from out of town, securing an apartment without visiting first.

I highly DO NOT recommend this place. There are better apartment complexes in the area and even better houses for rent which would cost the same or less.

The apartment itself is okay.  The bedrooms are good size and have nice walk-in closets.  Decent for one person or couple.  Satisfactory parking.  Unfortunately, things are not taken care of in a timely or sufficient manner around the complex. 
 The gate system only worked for a couple weeks in the past year.  The gym has 2 (broken) treadmills.  Some neighbors leave gross trash out for weeks without it being picked up (whether that is the fault of the resident or the valet trash service is unclear, but still gross and invites bugs).  Maintenance requests take months to fulfill, if ever.  The apartment paint job upon moving it was very poor (used rollers on baseboards and trim work was sloppy).  If you are satisfied on move-in and never need anything done and have conscientious neighbors, then you might be okay.

This property used to be a great place to live. However, the last year has brought about some changes. It is currently owned/managed by West Shore, they did not introduce themselves or make their presence known until after they took over. Since then the staff they've brought in has been abysmal  to say the least. The Property Manager is awful, she's dismissive and offers minimal assistance/and/or follow up. 
Maintenance takes forever to fix your work orders and when they do come prepare for them not finish the requested service and mark your work order as "complete". The place is filthy, trash is everywhere, dog waste areas often overflow, the gate does not work. I've got a little more time on my lease and I'll be done with this place.
Between the maintenance and the management plus all the shooting/robberies every other week do not move here don’t waste your time or money??

The example pictures are misleading. They did a poor job get my apartments ready, the area stinks, and I had to kill roaches and files the very first minute I walked into my apartment. I wouldn't recommend anyone move here.

I lived here for 2 years while attending graduate school and enjoyed it. There was the occasional bug... but whenever I saw one I immediately called for pest control and they took care of it. It wasn't the fanciest, but it was clean, safe, and it did the job. I would live here again.

Absolute the worst apartment ever! Had 4 leaks that resulted in the master bedroom being flooded, lost of a cabinet, broken door because of the flood, damaged wall and mold. I asked dozens of times to have my carpet cleaned and Denise kept delaying it until new management took over. Once that happened I had to get it done by myself. The carpet needs to be replaced after 3+ years and they refuse to do it. Because of the new management the way to pay rent changed.  Between Denise and Cindy they would not processed the money orders in time and added on $100 for multiple months without notice. I currently have $400 in late fees that I just found out about and my rent was paid on time every month.

The Management never informs residents about any work on the property. They have changed my mailbox key, moved things on my porch and done construction outside my apartment all without calling or sending an email. If they do give notice it is always by attaching a piece of paper to the apartment door. They once changed how they accepted payment and didn't inform anyone. So, I was almost evicted (with no notice) because my autopay didn't go through. In the end, we were charged a hundred dollar late fee because they changed the system. Maintenance work is terrible. Our fridge broke, they got us a new one that is too big and blocks our laundry room door. Their solution was to remove the cabinet above the fridge. When we said "no, we use that cabinet" their solution became to cut off some of the cabinet above the fridge. Then, the fridge was still too deep but they just left it like that. Now, I have to the violently pull laundry room door open to get it past the giant fridge. Also, our front door doesn't latch right, they replaced the door instead of fixing the framing, so it still doesn't latch right. Overall, unsafe, mismanaged and all held together by duct tape. If you can afford to live somewhere else, you should.

This apartments are infested with roaches and the apartment manager refused to do anything about it. This problem has been express the management numerous of times. Pest control will have to come out of your pocket. The floors are uneven and you can clearly feel it when you walk especially in the downstairs apartments. The only reason I will give them a 2 star rating is because the maintenance crew is hard working and try to fix what is within their scope. The property manager and others in the front office are rude and quick to close front office before posted office hours. I don't recommend this property to anyone.
I highly recommend Ovation@3500 to anyone looking for a great place to live. Maintenance also a huge plus as they have been here for 20+ years!

Just moved in a couple of months ago and overall I'm enjoying living at this community. The property is maintained nicely by the maintenance staff and management has been helpful whenever I had questions. Appreciate having a place I can call home.
Toured the community today and viewed a renovated townhome. It was beautiful and management was aso knowledgeable and helpful. I can't wait to move in.

Move here at your own risk. This place is infested with bats and they are aware. They are not doing anything to fix the issue. I had to message them & call them for maintenance to even step foot in my apartment to see the living environment I’m living in with freaking bats.

Scheduled an appointment over the phone to tour an apartment the next day. The woman on the phone was very sweet and was able to answer any questions I had.  The next day, I drove over 40 minutes and the person looking with me drove 2 hours so we could tour this apartment.  We got there five minutes early.  We had to knock on the door and wait a few minutes for someone in the office to answer.  She had no clue who we were and had to ask what apartment we were there to look at.  We informed her who we were and what we were there to see.  She then went back into the building, closing the door and leaving us outside for a few more minutes.  She comes back and tells us that someone applied last night and we were not going to be getting a tour.  I understand someone applying for it first so they get it, not a big deal. But it was very frustrating that we drove a good distance when all we needed was a call or email that morning, saying the apartment was no longer available.  We expressed our frustrations to the woman and she did nothing to try to fix the situation, no apology for our wasted time and gas, did not try to ask if we wanted to tour a different apartment, and did not care that we were walking away with a bad taste in our mouths.  Seemed like she wanted us out of her hair so she could go back to watching Netflix.

No one answers the phones, returns calls, or responds to emails. Maybe management is a figment of my imagination. Tried to apply and application was canceled for a reason outside of my power, essentially it was on the property to contact me back after multiple attempts to get assistance after application was submitted. Was finally contacted and demanded to contact them before the end of the day and every call to the office was disconnected and emails went unanswered. Save your time and look elsewhere at a property that takes their applicants seriously

We enjoy living at The Grandview at Lake Murray. The apartments are comfortable, and we always feel safe walking our dog around the community. The proximity to the lake is a wonderful bonus that adds to the overall charm of the location.
Thank you for providing such a welcoming and enjoyable place to call home.
The apartments are very quiet and safe. Over all it’s a not a bad experience but I do believe there is a mold problem that needs to be addressed.
If anyone feels that they miss a previous home, this home will bring joy, care, and security to their heart.  It is a home, not just an apartment, away from any home.

Grandview is the best apartment community that I have ever chosen.  The community is so sweet and kind.  The staff is the same, very kind and friendly.  This is a beautiful place to live.  I feel extremely safe even when it is dark outside.  I have gone out to my car a few times in the parkinglot at night and felt really safe.

Honestly let’s wait for a few months for me to get everything fixed and by then, I should have a very positive outlook and response, it’s has only been two weeks and I would like to give very one the opportunity to fix the issue.
I really enjoy living here. Neighbors are friendly and employees are great.
Toilet leaks and doesn’t flush properly. Dirty water comes up the tub drain and maintenance is a joke. Don’t ever move there!!

Maintenance is a joke! Any eta given is a joke and if they say they’re gonna be back the next day it’s a lie. The AC has not worked since we moved in which was about a month ago and we’ve gotten no communication on what’s being done to fix it. The entire apartment feels un-level like you’re constantly walking up & down hills and the floor boards creak so bad and are so loud, I hate it for the person below us who has to hear it too. There’s been roaches in the apartment and we even found a dead rat, upon moving in like the apartment wasn’t cleaned at all. I’ll be working to buy out of my lease ASAP. This is ridiculous!!!

Don’t get sucked into what they sell you on. Professional 24 hr maintenance is a lie. Maintenance doesn’t respond in 24hours (AT ALL), they don’t  wear mask in your apartment. They enter when nobody is home even after you specified in your maintenance request not to allow. Apartments are not that well maintained. Floorboards are creaky all over the apartment. Balcony sliding door comes of track and gets stuck(has happened more than twice) ,bedroom windows stuck or won’t stay up once pushed up, AC in units don’t get cold(really ridiculous I had to get a super speed fan, no ceiling lights in the bed rooms, countertop designs are peeling off, bathroom tubs are rusted, and my current problem is dealing with a fridge that hasn’t been freezing for 2 months now(I have made 4 maintenance request about it and nothing gets fixed. I start off rating this with 3 stars but now after writing I have realized it’s worse than that. They don’t update you or email you when new charges arrive . Only lived here for 3 months coming up on 4 months. Water & sewer were never billed to us the first two months now out of nowhere it’s billed . Leasing office very very unprofessional . Highly disappointed in my move to peach tree. They have falsely advertised it

Regarding the water leak from upstairs.  The guys were awesome.  The carpet cleaning guy is the best and a true asset.  He was very thorough, professional, considerate, and took extra time to not only do the job correctly but meticulously.  The whole service was outstanding and I just thought you should know.  The maintenance guys kept me informed and were exceptional and efficient at troubleshooting and quickly resolving the issue.  Great job.

I would highly recommend Peachtree Place Apartments!!!! I have resided here for almost two years and it is an extraordinary place to stay!! Jose', Robin, and Alex are an amazing staff that will go out of their way to make sure their residents are taken care of, has assisted me with issues and challenges I have dealt with, and given me a chance to have the ability to provide my son with a place to call home. I am truly grateful to be a part of the Peachtree place apartments community, and truly feel they deserve 10 stars. Thank you for everything!

Not worth the price. Maintenance crew is trash. I have been dealing with a leak from upstairs for months, now we have mold, and their solution is to KILZ it, and it keeps coming back. Living room leaked for 2 months before they fixed it. Witnessed 2 drive by shooting attempts since June 2016. No pool, clubhouse, laundry room. With having to move unexpectantly ive reached out to multiple apartment complexes, most have not be very helpful or very knowledgeable...it has not been a great experience to say the least. I called Abberly Village and spoke with Alexis. She very polite, very knowledgeable, and very helpful. We set up a tour the very next day. I got there a little early but she was ready. As we toured the different areas I was impressed. Very nice and clean complex, nice amenities. The apartment itself was really nice and spotless, looked like no one had lived there. From start to finish that experience really made me want to live there, I may have to rework the budget. You get what you pay for and I think it may be worth it. Great Experience!

Pricing is well above market average for the area and amenities provided and this price will increase about 6% every year for no reason. Amenities are never working properly, gate is consistently broken and left open 24/7, pool constantly is closed for maintenance, and most of the workout machines are damaged. The management office does not communicate effectively at all, we had an apparent leak in our building which lasted an entire weekend and we only got two email telling us there were repairs happening and that they were unable to repair it so they will be back Monday (which left us with horrible water pressure all weekend). There's a weird mix of families, young professionals, college students, weed smokers, and middle aged divorced men living in this complex. I've just noticed a huge down tick in quality since 2016.

The maintenance people are super lazy and management is lackluster. The apartments are okay but you can tell they cheaped out wherever they could get away with it. The gate and pool are ALWAYS broken. Someone ran their car into the front gate on Halloween and we did not see a functioning gate until well after the new year (and certainly no rent discount for the time period where they were not providing the amenities stated in the lease contract). They want to price themselves like they are high quality but they are simply mediocre. The mailboxes are confusing as the numbers do not correspond to the apartment numbers so mail is misplaced ALL the time, the front office opened a large package we had delivered and didn't let us know we had a package for pickup, management does not communicate with residence efficiently so they never give a full 24 hour notice before coming into your apartment (they put letters in your door the afternoon before even though they have the capability to email residents), our sink was full of dishes as we were out the night before and didn't have time to clear it before leaving for work the next morning so the maintenance worker didn't change the air filter and just left the new one leaning in the wall in our apartment with no note indicating why it was left this way, management sent us an email reprimanding our living standards and that maintenance couldn't preform their job because of it (we called management that day and they said there were no specifics only that there was an obstruction which we made sure the door to the filter closet was completely clear). We are happily leaving this spring.

We Lived at Abberly Village from August 2017 to March 2018 while looking for our new home.  The front office staff was excellent and always helpful in addressing any concerns.  The grounds were always kept very clean.  I was particularly impressed with the maintenance staff.  They do preventative maintenance here.  They replace furnace filters and check smoke detectors, etc on a schedule.  Most apartments just react to problems.. At Abberly Village they work to prevent problems. We did have a problem with our A/C which was fixed the same day as reported.  I think one reason they do so well is that their maintenance staff is full time at the site as opposed to the apartment complex my Mother-in-law lives at, where they do no preventative maintenance and have to have hired contractors come out to fix each problem, which takes days.  We would definitely recommend Abberly Village as a place to live.

From the moment I stepped into the office doors i have felt right at home! The staff was very warm and welcoming from day one! I moved here from out of town not really knowing the area but the wonderful location of this place being right in the middle of Columbia allowed me to easily become familiar with the roads and all shopping attractions here. Any questions I have had the staff was happy to help. I went to resident event and met a lot of nice people. The price is reasonable considering the washer/dryer included with the convenient Valet trash. The gated community makes me feels very safe being a lone in a new city. You cannot put a price on safety so i don't mind the price of my beautiful apartment. I am still current at Abberly Village and I will definitely be referring this place to new people and friends i meet!

I've only lived in Abberly for 2 years and I've had some really frustrating experiences. My rent has increased EVERY year. Let me repeat- Management was completely unapologetic and stated that it is their POLICY to give a MASTER KEY to contractors (such as pest control, carpet cleaners, etc) and let them roam around Abberly without supervision. This makes me wonder how many master keys of Abberly Village are roaming around, and how unsafe that policy is.
The location is as good as it gets in the midlands of South Carolina. We call it “Central Park of Cayce on the Congaree  River”

Property is not maintained. No landscaping is done around property at all, only front entrance.  Renovation are a joke.  The apartments were giving a face-lift and nothing more. Same old 50yr old apartments with drafty windows. Poor management on the property as well.  Shop around.

We have been living here for almost 2 years this coming Augiust. We absolutely love  Granby Oaks. All of the staff have been wonderful. It is refreshing to live in a place that is well maintained and the rent is reasonable.

B. Goode

The staff was always responsive and friendly. The gym and the pool area was always clean and not as packed as you would think considering how good of a condition they are in. We had minimal bug issues, amazon was able to deliver to the door, and the location is close to stores, I26 and I77. The dog park is also an excellent feature of this complex. I would recommend to anyone looking for an affordable place to live.

I lived in this property with my wife. I  had a hardship situation I delayed paying the rent. Was excited to move in, unfortunately need to move up north because of family. We were halfway through the moving in process. I was excited at being in walking distance of CVS, bi-lo. Absolutely worth your time checking these out.
Just moved in two months ago. The staff has been very helpful. They respond quickly to your questions and needs. Nice place to live.
NICE QUIET NEIGHBORHOOD, EASY ACCESS TO GROCERY STORES AND INTERSTATE. OFFICE STAFF VERY FRIENDLY AND POLITE

I think the Nexus Apartments are in a nice location.  Wow ! Right  behind the movie theater!  You can literally walk any where.  When our granddaughter did talk to a policeman he said " you seem like a nice kid, get out of this place, its bad news". If I could give less stars I would.

I have lived here before  in 2013 ans hsd rhe same issues rhen that im hsving now. i moved back because  rhe management promise rhats rhinfs were better ans clewned up. I refuse to continue to pay them any money for problems that won't get fixed until they get ready to fix it. which could be anytime. I have been inconvenienced by staying here and regret my move. this apartment just need to renovate and do major upgrades.

I actually found these apartments using apartments.com and I have been living here since March 2015 and it's a pretty decent place. It's usually quiet, there's a pool here, and a nice park right across the street. The property manager is very nice and I haven't had any trouble out of anyone.

Huntington Place is a true gem in Columbia, SC. I have lived here for over a year and a half, and could not be more pleased with my experience. 

- The leasing staff is WONDERFUL! They are so nice, helpful, and quick to respond. I've had packages delivered to my doorstep while I was out of town, and the leasing team brought it inside after I gave them a quick call. It's the little things that go a long way! 

- The maintenance crew is GREAT! They have a quick turnaround time, even for small requests like unclogging a drain, paint touchups, and light bulb replacements. I have never had any major maintenance issues (broken AC, leaks, bugs, etc). 

- The storage space is unbeatable. Each bedroom has a big walk-in closet with plenty of hanging space to fit an entire wardrobe. The pantry/laundry room is also huge with six 5ft shelves. Most other apartments don't even have a pantry. The storage closet on the balcony has ample space for Christmas trees, extra chairs, or whatever your heart desires. 
Each bathroom has a small linen closet with 5 shelves that's perfect for towels, toilet paper, and cleaning supplies. There's also a coat closet by the front door that can fit a ton of coats, a vacuum, & much more.

- The bedrooms are large enough to fit a queen or king bed with nightstands on both sides along with a desk, dresser, and large mirror. You won't be tight on space in the bedrooms.

- LOCATION! Extremely close to I-77, Target, Marshalls, Walmart, Whole Foods, Food Lion, Aldi, Chick-Fil-A, Ulta, Goodwill...the list goes on. You can get to Devine St, Downtown Columbia, William's Brice Stadium, and the heart of Forest Acres in 15 minutes or less. 

- Huge pool! Columbia is HOT, so having a big pool was a must for me. There's plenty of chairs and it's never fully packed. 

- Ample parking space! I've always been able to park right in front of my building. No specified guest parking or guest tags, like many other apartments.

I could go on and on about all of the reasons why I love living here. If you are moving to Columbia or relocating apartments, Huntington Place is where you want to be!

We have been living here for a few months now and couldn't be happier. The staff is amazing, maintenance is quick and friendly, and our neighbors are awesome. They maintain the property and pool beyond my expectations. Love it here!
This is a nice place to live but the appliances are little old and the bathrooms are little small. The staff is great and super helpful.

Very well maintained! The pool is always clean and usually not crowded. Neighbors are mostly military or college students, but respectful college students. It's very peaceful here. The ladies in the office and maintenance are wonderful! I'm sad to be moving so soon! Well worth what we pay!!

Jason has been the most professional landlord I’ve ever encountered. He is extremely diligent, fast, and accommodating, always ensuring everything is handled promptly and efficiently. The experience has been beyond my expectations, and I couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend!

Jason and his staff have really worked hard. This is what I expect to be more expensive than the majority of apartments around SC, but it is reasonably priced, and you get more than what you paid for in terms of quality and professionalism.  Jason is like a genius because he designed it himself and he put his whole heart into this.

I asked about the availability because I know these are going to fill up fast.  I love how the developer is selective on not letting everyone rent that does not provide the needed the information (lots of scammers these days) this is the safest I have felt in over 2 years.  It’s like living in a place that has all of the models out at Lowes Hardware available for use in your home! Everything is high-class and it works! No fake bells or whistles.

Coming from a really expensive apartment community, this place makes the previous place on Two-Notch road feel like a half-way house in a ghetto area.  I love the oversized island, the brand new appliances and the sound construction.  Even the paint is silk-like on the walls.  The maintenance staff is the most respectful and professional.  Jason is the best!

When I was searching for an apartment that was practical and eye- catching, along with convenient access to the highway- this was the place! This is the best apartment that I have lived in for 100’s of dollars less! The developer is amazing and always on-site for questions and answers.  I have told all of my friends to rent here! This is one of a kind for Columbia; the best of the best.
Keystone apartments are very accommodating and tenant friendly. Very respectful and help too. Highly recommend.

Don’t move here. The apartments aren’t spacious. Thin walls and neighbors are loud and staff won’t do anything about it. The staff communication is horrible. They came to fix a leak in the p-trap under the sink and while they were there, they also fixed one of the electrical outlets that stopped working. I will say that turning left out of the complex is difficult at certain times (7am and 5pm) due to a school being just up the road and the two stop lights are just far away enough so that cars never align, or its just bad luck on my part. Any other time of day it's not bad at all. Sometimes parking can get annoying if a lot of people live in one apartment but for the most part parking isn't too big of a problem. I wouldn't have minded having assigned parking if each apartment always had the two closest to its door. But overall, I would stay here again if I wasn't moving out of state!
This review will remain here until you get assigned parking spots. I'm tired of having to park on the other side of the apartment complex at night.

The apartments are in good condition, management is reasonable, and overall there is a lot of good going for this place. This is especially true given the good location if you work in Columbia. The staff will hear your concerns and are willing to address them. We have lived here for almost two years and have only had a couple of issues, which in my experience, you can’t beat.
I love my apartment.  I think the carpets in the hallways need updating outside of that I have no complaints.

The property is very much designed to look much nicer than it actually is. My boyfriend and I moved in to Creekside around 2 weeks ago, and so far it’s been really wonderful. I appreciated the opportunity to discuss the presiding blame game tactics my self included and work towards a common bond. is there work to be done yes...does this company take their job and responsibility to the residents seriously yes...so all in all we are working to resolve some issues and it has given me a better outlook of this property.

I moved to Carriage Place about 3 months ago and I love it so far. I even got a completely remodeled condo with brand new stainless steal appliances and tile back splash which looks like the show I watch HGTV remodels. I told my friend about Carriage Place and she is moving out here next month when her lease is up. Its nice and quiet back here, my neighbors are very friendly.

The apartment has great features! Looking forward to making it my new home.
