I moved from out of state to 700 Woodrow in September 2013 and I love it here! I especially love sitting on the balcony on warm evenings watching the sunset over downtown Columbia. The fixtures are modern and the two bedroom floor plan is perfect for my needs. Other huge pluses and reasons that make 700 Woodrow an excellent choice: the building is clean and safe. The neighborhood is located next to unique boutiques and an array of popular restaurants within walking distance. There is a free Starbucks coffee machine in the lounge that is available 24/7. And finally, importantly, the staff and Ms. Meredith, the property manager are very helpful and readily available. When needed my maintenance requests have been addressed promptly with quality customer service.
I love living at 700 Woodrow! Staff is wonderful, close to everything, and free starbucks coffee! Can't find a better place in Columbia

Meredith and Mike run 700 Woodrow with such good care and efficiency! They are always so friendly and helpful. 700 Woodrow has such a variety of leasing options and can handle whatever you need - long or short term - with ease. It is truly a lovely environment and many fun activities have been planned during my Mom's time here - a great little community!

700 Woodrow provides convenient and easy living in Shandon. The biggest assets are the wonderful staff members. The concierge, Meredith, and head of maintenance, Mike, go above and beyond the call of duty to help all of us who reside here.  The grounds and common areas are kept in pristine condition. Often there are socials for the residents and their friends, and the coffee machine works 24/7. It is wonderful to be able to walk to the library, post office, restaurants and shops instead of searching for a parking space, especially at lunch time in Five Points.
I highly recommend 700 Woodrow for people who are downsizing, or just want to simplify their lives.

We love living at 700 Woodrow! We have spent two different time periods here, which goes to show how much we enjoy it. The staff is so friendly and helpful and truly go above and beyond to address any concerns and provide recommendations. We feel very safe here as a young family and love being able to walk to many restaurants, shops and parks. The apartments are beautiful with new finishes!

Can't beat the location! Great staff (especially the Property Manager, Meredith) the building is well maintained, any maintenance issues are addressed immediately and the units are updated and clean. The grounds are kept up and planting pots changed out seasonally.  We have lived here for 2 years and plan to stay until we are living full time in Charleston.

My car was vandalized due to the broken security gate.  Over $2000 in damage.  This damage is a direct result of the security gate being left open.  In the short time he's been there, the gate has never worked. This is not a 'gated' community.  I do not recommend living here.  Please fix the gate!!!!

Just moved in here sight unseen hoping the photos and reviews would be an accurate representation of what to expect. 
They are not. Our apartment is so small and dingy and all the appliances and cabinets haven’t been updated in YEARS.

Moving to Columbia for work was stressful.  The office staff was great in assisting me.  They're always friendly when I call or stop by to pick up a package.  Recently maintenance stopped by to replace my smoke detector battery.  They offered to take my trash on their way out.  I have made some new friendships with my neighbors.  So far this has been a great experience!  I highly recommend Hampton Greene for anyone looking to live in the Columbia area.

This is the worst run apartment complex I’ve ever seen. I’m so glad I no longer live here, best decision I’ve ever made.

Management only cares about money and doesn’t care about insuring that the apartments are safe for you to live in. This complex is a complete violation of habitable tenant rights.

If you decide to live here, don’t let them put you on the first floor. They use cheap vinyl flooring and any movement in the apartment above you can be heard. 

Ventilation is terrible and the air condition/heat system is old. Hope you like a dusty apartment because you’re apartment will never be clean.

I lived here for about a year, and would highly recommend.
My only complaints were minor:
-The gates leading into the driveway/parking lot took a little time to get used to
-The driveway didn't have sidewalks throughout the entire lot, at times making it awkward
-Not all packages were delivered to the door, which when I had bigger stuff delivered (and that was just me), it was tough moving it from their office. That most were brought to the door was really nice.

Highlights:
-Super close to retail (including a good liquor/beer store and Publix, and the first time I could say a Target was in walking distance to my apartment) and highways
-Parking lot was open, making it easy if someone visited
-Not 20 minutes to drive downtown, and while not "the big city," Rosewood has some fun bars
-I had an in-unit washer and dryer, which for the cost was a major value. Plenty of washer/dryers otherwise.
-The road it's on is off a major state/road or highway, tucked back a little into the woods, so it was generally quiet
-Office and maintenance staff were prompt, respectful, and courteous

Paces Run has been a great place to reset and prepare for your next move. I’ll list some of the pros and cons of living here as a new resident. Firstly, the staff have been friendly for the most part. I was worried about seeing roaches based on the reviews and I’ve been blessed to avoid that. It’s very quiet and the neighbors are friendly. It’s also less than 15 minutes away from the base which is a plus. Now for the cons.. The electric bill is outrageous. I travel a lot with my job and am rarely home. For maybe being home for 2 weeks out of the month my electric bill was 150.00, which is a lot for one person in a one bedroom. Next, the trash area is always overflowing and very unattractive. It is also extremely hard to get in contact with the office on the phone. There are days that I’m out of town and will call 10-15 times throughout the day, sometimes still not reaching anyone. Another issue for me has been my alarm system. I was told it would take 2 weeks to be up and running, and it’s been three months. After calling multiple times, and speaking with someone that told me that they would call me back, and never did, I still do not have a functioning alarm system. (It’s important to me because I do travel so often.) Overall rent is reasonable and the location, over the bridge, is pretty good. If you’re looking for a great place to reset, or just a temporary situation this is a great place. Aside from the minor things in regards to customer service, I enjoy it here.

They are charging way too much money for the quality and are very outdated. You have to pay for water separately and it charges based on what the complex uses not what YOU use. There are roaches  everywhere.

The maintenance young man Fred is an exceptional employee.  He is very knowledgeable about his job and he always does it with a SMILE! I have seen them pick trash that has fallen off of the back of cars and residents just continue to drive.  You don't find individuals that are humble enough to do "dirty" work.  The office staff more specifically Constance is always helpful, knowlegeable and most of all in a service industry it's nice when they remember your name that goes along way.  Since her much well deserved she's even more we do ated to serving Paces Run and its mission/vision and the tenants of this community.  We are lucky to have such a dedicated and knowlegeable individual.  To all of the staff here at Paces Run on Parklane.  Keep up the Great work!!!

The complex was recently sold to some investors from New York and is being managed by a local real estate management company so I'm still waiting to see what the new office staff is like.

The apartments are out dated and way over priced, they're trying to be an 'upscale' complex and failing. Some apartments were upgraded, others weren't. The upgrades that were made were cosmetic - like new cabinet doors and drawer fronts. The counter tops in the kitchen and bath are hideous. It's some sort of paper-like overlay that never looks clean.  The linoleum floor in the kitchen, dining room and bath rooms need to be replaced along with the appliances in the kitchen. The cabinets were repainted when the replaced the drawer fronts and doors but the crew made a mess, they did not ask to have things moved and as a result my things have paint spattered on them.

Do yourself a favor; spend another 100 on rent somewhere else instead and enjoy life. I promise it will be worth it somewhere else.

I have lived here at Cornell Arms since December of 2012. I’ll start with the good. I’m disabled & this location is bar none THE BEST. Very walkable everywhere. I left the country in upstate SC so I could live more independently & Cornell Arms is in a perfect spot. Utilities included. Good. New elevators! Excellent. Staff is much improved since CMM Realty acquired the property. Charles in maintenance is CA’s MOST VALUABLE EMPLOYEE!! Seriously. He’s educated, knows what he’s doing, & is prompt with responses. Somebody give him a huge raise please, he’s got to be tired of saving the day. Which brings me to the not so good. Ok. I get that the building is old & very hard to maintain for sure. However, we have had constant issues since 2021. The bug issue has been resolved finally. The other issues are, elevators have been constantly breaking down every few days for the past 2wks. & for the life of them, since fall of ‘21 they CANNOT keep their hot water & heat running consistently. The manager has been good in the past about sending emails to residents keeping us in the loop about what’s going on & status of repairs & such. Now, yesterday I came back from my parents to find no hot water. I called the emergency number that is on the teleprompter in the dwnst lobby. It WAS OUT OF SERVICE! Bad enough that there was no hot water. Downright unacceptable that the emergency maintenance number was disconnected! It was back up & running today & of course Charles came to the rescue & we have hot water at the moment but as soon as that was fixed, the elevator went out! But my biggest peeve with all this is… NO BULK EMAIL sent out to residents alerting & acknowledging the issue & apologies for the inconvenience. If the manager cannot send out an email then someone at CMM Realty needs to. So. To sum up, great place, great location, some better than average improvements, good neighbors, an EXCELLENT head of maintenance (Charles), but inconsistent maintenance issues & poor communication from the manager keep this a 3 star rating. I will update my rating and review when some of these issues are resolved.

Being a veteran of the building for the last decade, I can say that I've seen A LOT of positive changes over the last few months with new management at the helm.  The cosmetic brick work has gone according to plan on the east side of the building and is now complete with the focus on the west side for the next few months.  Improvements to the common areas and general upkeep are certainly a positive once again.  I've noticed a few new courtesy officers who make me feel even safer than before as well.  The location, essentially being on campus across from the new USC Law Center, makes it easy for me to get where I need to go, oftentimes without needing a car.

To address concerns some reviewers have noted about climate control:  My apartment has three climate control units, one in the large living room and one in each of the two bedrooms.  I have never had an issue with any of them or their thermostats.  They are independently controlled (each room can be set at a different temperature), which is actually really convenient.  I haven't seen this feature in other apartments around campus.  As for the twice a year switch over from heat-to-AC and vice versa, my unit has three-speed ceiling fans and the new commercial style windows as most other units do.  I've never had a problem remaining comfortable nor have any of my roommates in the past.  I use the ceiling fans as needed or slightly crack one of the energy efficient windows, and within minutes I'm comfortable.

Overall, for the location, amenities, and size of the units I'm really happy with Senate Plaza and can't imagine where I could get the same value elsewhere on campus!

Unbelievably old and poorly maintained building. Construction noise 24-7 shakes the building all day. AC is controlled by the building, the water pressure is so irregular you are either pinned up against your shower wall and clinging to your shower curtain and rod so you aren't knocked over, or it literally trickles out like a garden hose. It is unbelievable how much the residents of this place have to put up with, and I cannot wait for my lease to be up.

The most recent review posted here was very clearly written by the property manager, not a resident, of this building. This old building is not well-maintained and it is not worth your money. First, this building is NOT a non-smoking building--the hallways, stairwells, and common areas reek of smoke, and it often infiltrates neighboring units. Repulsive. As the employee below mentioned (yet curiously failed to account for when awarding 5-stars to this place), the AC and heat are entirely controlled by the building--like a dorm room or public school classroom. This year, the AC was off from the first week of November until April 19th. This is South Carolina, where we had probably 60 days of 75-85  degree weather during that time. My apartment was uninhabitable, yet my rent the exact same price. In February, there was no hot water in the entire building for 3 days. If it's not one thing, it's another with this place, and the management office couldn't be less bothered by any of it. The current property manager is "retiring" and is being replaced by her daughter, so I imagine it will be more of the same. The proximity of this building to the new law school, the rest of USC's campus, and the state house is not worth the amount of money you will spend, the amount of second-hand smoke you will inhale, and the amount of perspiration you will excrete on hot days and nights without AC and while at the mercy of the building.

Senate Plaza is an older apartment building, but is very well-maintained. I have always found the apartment building to be very quiet being halfway up the building away from traffic noise. The main negative is that the heat and air is centrally controlled so that individual units cannot control their own temperature. I would say that the positives far outweigh this negative, especially the location and the excellent security of the building. One has walking access to so much of interest and convenience in the city. I have never felt insecure in or around the building any time, day or night, and find the staff to be far above average and graciously willing to go the extra mile. One very important aspect for us especially is the close proximity to the State House and the fact that the beautiful, new USC School of Law is literally right across the street. Overall, our experience with Senate Plaza for the last five years has been very positive!

Unfortunately I had a new awful experience while living at Senate. As an international student I did not felt respected by management. It was also a lot more expensive than most places. I knew it was expensive, but I expected to have a service accordingly.

What attracted me to the community was the front office personnel, that person is long gone now, and the fact that Harbison is a townhome community which is indeed unique in the Columbia market. Also, the three bedroom apartments have ample square footage and is configured in a way that maximizes that square footage. It also comes with a washer and dryer combo which is included in your base rent. Oh and it is satellite tv ready. The downsides- the apartment complex is old and has electrical problems. All of the apartments are facing AC issues and the apartments have change out all the units for entire rows of apartments at the same time. But you get access to the Harbison Recreational Center that's right across the way without an extra fee and it also has a pool. But as other reviews have said that's not much. If you are a family with children, the center and its staff are not very friendly to your children. All in all I've been here 4 years because I'm too lazy to move and they still jack up rent every year.  Hope they're using it towards a pool but won't get my hopes up.

- Amenities and fixtures: You absolutely are paying for the location here. The apartments are not very nice, and the gym and pool are tiny--you'll wait to get in the water or on a treadmill.

If you've got the patience and the pocketbook to lose both by moving here, sell your car, send your mail elsewhere, and make sure to take pictures of every angle in every room before signing that inventory form.

This complex appears to be (and charges rent) like luxury apartment homes. However, once you move in everything changes. Construction is shoddy and cheaply done. You won't see this in the apartments they show, but there are all kinds of little issues with mis-aligned mirrors and paint chipping. Although the the show apartment there is a beautiful new washer/dryer, once you lease you'll be rented units from the 1970's that barely run. And to top it all off, they charge you for getting packages ($20 sign up fee   $3/month   $3 each day you don't pick up). 

All of this would be acceptable if the apartments were a steal. But these are luxury rents for low-end apartments.

Nice when you first move in because they paint over everything to make it look clean. Like the soap dish in the bathtub-they painted that.  They also painted the sprinklers.   Think about that. The new management is better than the old, but still not good.  They also will keep your whole deposit for things you did not do to the apartment-like the window’s cracking because of a foundation issue you can see from the outside.  The stairs are held together by a metal bar but the two sections of stairs don’t match up, there’s a big drop.   Seems not very safe. There have been shootings here, they tow if you don’t report a car that stays “too long”. They did not even have smoke detectors in my apartment, but then kept the deposit. Glad that we never had a fire because lots of people would be dead due to the managements negligence. Makes total sense that they don’t keep up their half of the rental agreement but they make sure you pay  them extra.  Do NOT rent here

The apartment seemed OK at first... until summer came around. The AC is running 24/7 and my apartment is 82 degrees while its 95 outside. In the morning with the AC running all night I wake up to a 75 degree apartment. I've put in several service requests and maintenance is clueless and just say it's working as it should, to deal with it, and buy a fan. 

There's also trash everywhere, they only have one trash dumpster and it's on the complete other side of the complex in the corner. However they have recycle dumps everywhere, so guess where people throw their trash? In the recycle dumps... then the recycle trucks refuse to take them because there is obviously trash in them. So what does management do? They put a second recycle bin next to it and that fills up with trash too, it's been sitting there piling up for months.

Can't wait to move out.

Stay the hell away from this place, it has become an absolute nightmare to live here. It used to be a nice peaceful community until RPM management came in and ruined the place. Say goodbye to ever getting any sleep since the neighbors want to play their music on full blast for hours on into the night. The bass from the music literally shakes the building, and no amount of earplugs or white noise cancels it out. Even after multiple complaints and calling the police, nothing ever gets done about the noise. I can never get a hold of the property manager. Trying to email the property manager is a pain as well since the manager is always changing and we never know who to contact anymore. Plus we keep getting double charged on rent and we keep having to pay an extra $200 over what was agreed on the lease. Has this issue been resolved? Not at all, since no one ever wants to respond to us. The hot water in our apartment runs this awful disgusting murky water. The maintenance guy came in, took a look, left, and never returned to fix the issue. Also, surprise, your water will randomly get turned off for days at a time with no notice, and if you want to try to call the emergency maintenance number you’ll get nothing. I’ve never had a worse living experience in any apartment complex I’ve been in. I wouldn’t touch this place with a 10 foot pole.

Repairs are not a priority here. And the more severe the problem, the less likely they are to handle it. My unit has suffered MULTIPLE instances of water damage caused by poor maintenance and they basically will not repair anything until I move out.  There are junk cars sitting in the lot.  Trash everywhere, people with no regard for their neighbors.  Don't get fooled when apartment searching. They only care when you sign your first lease.

We seem to have a new management team here who are incredibly responsive, attentive and simply, compassionate. #HappyResident

A nice upgraded apartment is all aesthetically pleasing, but not everything.

They took over in March 2018 and I've had nothing but problems dealing with these people.  I wish corporate would staff the office with people who know what they're doing.

I have been a residence at these apartments for a while now. The staff is very friendly and is always adequate to responding to maintenance. Very peaceful apartments to live at and a wonderful community.

Lovely, quiet, and visually alluring hidden gem. Far enough from Downtown Dallas to avoid busy traffic and noisy streets, but close enough to enjoy the urban lifestyle. Newly renovated apartments with a beautiful creek that’s adjacent to the complex and also runs right through it. Walking distance from the golf course and a huge park.

Every time you put a work order it takes them month to do them. Vanessa and Brenda don’t do nothing good for their residents. I was told i was going to get new cabinets covers, and i didn’t. Amenities are excellent and area is nice and quiet. We feel so comfortable here.

I’ve never had maintenance issues here which is nice, but the maintenance supervisor is awesome if you ever need him!
The floor plans are nice and have higher than average ceilings. 
Some units have the washer/dryer hookups in the garage, I don’t love that but it’s ok.
It’s also quiet and well maintained.
Very cute furniture in the clubhouse.
Mold problems and fbi raid! Management unwilling to let me break my lease.

This complex has nice amenities to go with their very nice apartments. The pool area is a common meeting place for the adults who live here. The management puts on some type of social event monthly with provided food and drink. Maintenance is very responsive and on-premise for any quick response needs. I recommend this complex without hesitation. Location, near hospitals, so we did not lose power and a great variety of major stores and restaurants within a mile or two.

We were on a 3 month lease why we were waiting for a job situation to clear up.  During the lease signing it was not pointed out that we would require 60 days advance move out notice for a 90 day lease.  We received no reminder during the time frame nearing that mark, so it passed by.  The fee is basically the rent until it would have been 60 days, so be careful and make sure you're on the ball, because they won't be.  

Outside of that grievance, which I will admit is why I'm posting today, the insulation in the apartment is poor.  So in the hot Texas summers, prepare to sweat a lot.  We have our A/C set to 72 and my back is covered in sweat in the morning.  The toilets don't work very well.  Be careful because the handle will get stuck and if you don't jiggle it, water will keep running without end.  I have submitted maintenance requests to fix it, and it didn't last a week. The apartment is older and between little things like that and the insulation, it can really rack up your water and energy bill.

Finally, their pest control is very unresponsive.  We have two wasp nests in a patio at two different times.  Sent in two separate tickets.  One sprayed the nest and left it up, so I always get nervous around it.  The second I put the ticket in well over a month ago and still have yet to have them come out to handle it, rendering the patio unusable.

If you decide on living here, remember, the amenities are older, so the building's efficiency is not up to par.  The fridge is small, with very little freezer room.  The toilet's are small, so it can be awkward to sit on.  As for location, unless you are looking to eat out at a lot of expensive restaurants near by, be prepared to drive a ways to get to something affordable.
Price is the only reason I would hesitate at all to recommend this property.  Most of my peers are also on a fixed income and would like to find a place to live for many years.

My experience has been pretty good here. I feel that the staff are trying their best with working through the problems of the building and fixing things will take some time. They have been communicating on the status of things around the building. I do wish the elevators would be back up and running.  But overall it’s quiet and convenient.

There have been improvements. I still find the property not well kept. There are numerous doors that do not work, and never lock. The elevators are all currently not operating. Homeless individuals sleep in the stairwells or, do drugs in the stairwells. There are constant break-ins in the parking garage because the gate that separates the residential part to the main area never closes. And my unit my bathroom sink faucet is no longer has any cold water than my Sink disposal is completely rusted and smells horrible. There’s a leak under my kitchen sink. My windows and sliding glass door leak cold or hot air all year round. The gym facility has a lot of room for improvement because they’re missing all kinds of weights, specifically 20 pound Dumbbells and 50 pound dumbbells. The amount of mold that is in the gym, you can see it everywhere. The televisions don’t work in the gym you can’t control them. Some of the ceiling fans are on super high fast speed, and can’t go low.
Best location on the street and the staff is very nice. Well maintained parking garage, will always tow. Very easy to pay rent on the app and payments go thru instantly
This will be my 4th lease renewal this time around and so far things have gone pretty well. Management is doing their best to fix and repair the mess created by the previous owner.
I love my unit and the staff. I just wish the building could be more secure and there were more strict rules for pet owners who don't pick up behind their pets

The place is still poorly maintained and secured. The guest entrance no longer locks itself because the magnet to keep it closed has been torn from its original location. One pedestrian gate doesn't have a latch so there might as well not be a fence around the back. The door handle of the door by the package locker has been rickity for ages. Location is great but there are other cheaper places nearby that are nicer and newer construction.
Water issues all winter.    Not hot water or kitchen sink just drizzles. Management does not care!!

I’ve been here for 4 months and I’ve had my car clipped in the garage, neighbors party until all hours on the night with loud music and homeless people ride the elevator or stay in the stay stairway when it’s cold. Management does not seem to care. I am scared to leave apartment at night.

Moving to Dallas from SC, the leasing staff made sure I had an easy transition. Kudos to Stephanie, Evelyn and Garret. So far everything has been handled beautifully by the leasing/maintenance staff and management at Southside flats. I love my apartment and the view. Not to mention, the amazing move in deal. The building staffs has been so patient, friendly, attentive, and accommodating to anything I may need to help with my move in. The building and apartment units are gorgeous, the amenities are great.

Been here for a cew months now. It was ok but the gates are open on the weekend so snybody can parl. When there's an event ppl parks in the visitor parking. The tow company sucks. They NEVER do their job. Non residents parks in the garage. Ppl stomp that lives above you. Loud music from neighbors and ppl having a party on the rooftop. Office NEVER answer the phone. The access door has been pry open. For the money im paying, i dont think i will renew. And i was really liking the rooftop view.....

I never review properties, however the way I have been treated by management has left me with no choice.  I moved here two years ago, at first it was ok management would take care of issues promptly, NOT the case now.  I recently moved into the largest one bedroom on property I was promised updated stainless steel appliances, new granite counter tops,  new cabinets, new floors.  Well I received the cabinets and counter tops however the the cabinet doors don't shut all the way and most of them are crooked, management literally brought in old appliances that where literally full of roaches (I will address the ongoing pest problem later), they didn't clean my unit before I moved in even though I pushed back my move in date twice.  I know the old manager is no longer there but I have even called and emailed the new manager the regional manager and I have tried to go above them as well and nothing has changed but they expect me to pay a premium for things I was promised and never received.  I will likely be breaking my lease as for what I am paying here I can get a much better value across the street and actually have amenities and at bare minimum basic respect and decency from a management company that will at least respond.  Did I mention this issue has been ongoing for over four months and to this day after 10+ emails and numerous I have YET to hear one word from Allied Property Management.  In closing DO NOT MOVE HERE I promise you will regret it, oh and the pictures with the unit with stainless steel appliances is the unit I moved out of how disrespectful is it that they give my old unit the very upgrades I was promised in my new unit please save yourself a huge headache and don't even consider living at Maverick Oaklawn.

Thank you

Latest management company is terrible! Rules only apply to certain tenants. Property has been damaged or stolen in what should be a secure area, but management does NOTHING to help or remedy the situation. TRUST ME when I say you don’t want the headache of living here. I can’t wait until my lease is up so I can get out! So sad, because this should be a great place to live….the reality is it just isn’t.

One of the two elevators has been broken and out of service for more than 4 months - always the same excuse… waiting for parts to repair. With over 150 units and five floors, only two
Elevators was insufficient in the first place. Can you imagine trying to move in or out, while all these residents and all the dogs share just one elevator?? Better plan on overtime hours from your moving company if you plan to move in here!

Rent at your own risk. Read the contract very carefully. These folks are sharks. Low grade build out, cut some corners, but charge a premium based upon location. Common areas are very poorly maintained. I found dog excrement in the stairwell and it sat for weeks. Carpeting in the hallways was always dirty and walls show significant wear from previous moves. My apartment smelled bad from the start and although they did attempt to deodorize, the smell never went away. Security gates were often broken and left open for days at a time. Just an overall very poor property and a staff that although is responsive, looks for every way possible to keep as much of your security deposit as possible. Do not rent here.

Preston Hollow is such a charming, vibrant community with old nostalgia. Not only is it great having the convenience of shopping and restaurants just seconds away, my dog is happy to be back near parks and big ol' wide streets with plenty of grass. My unit is very spacious with lots of natural light and I am also enjoying not to pay for a gym membership anymore. I also like my wall to wall wood floors and the fact that I am the first to have ever lived in my brand new apartment.

WOW....Is all i can say!!! Me and my husband came to visit this BEAUTIFUL property a few days ago and this was the BEST tour I've ever had looking for a high rise apartment home. Ron the resident liaison toured us and treated us like gold. His outgoing and warm personality really impressed us.....The Statler has best views in Dallas. Melanie the Property Manager was amazing, along with the leasing professional Alyssa and Concierge Tru' they all had a great caring vibe. My lease is up in "Up Town" in Oct, and i cant wait. The Statler Residences will be my new home. The units are sooooo beautiful. If your looking for a place that is warm, classy and welcoming. The Statler Residences is your best option.

The Statler staff, Ron & Alyssa were very easy going. The apartment and people here at the residency we’re almost like NYC style. 
Love the bar and restaurants downstairs! Will continue to come when I’m in town. 
Highly recommend this beautiful place in the heart of gorgeous city lights, Big D. 
Talk to Ron, he will get you in and out! You won’t be disappointed!

The Statler Residences are located in a stunning historic building and the apartments themselves are fine. Unfortunately, my review does take a negative turn.

If you are planning on renting a unit on one of the top floors, beware of insanely loud music coming from Waterproof, The Statler Hotel’s rooftop bar, on Thursday through Sunday nights. The lounge is in such close proximity that it feels like the DJ is inside your apartment. Absolutely unbearable.

There are also MAJOR leak and flooding issues happening on the top floor—both in apartments and common areas. Multiple neighbors of mine have had their belongings destroyed in huge floods. This has been happening for years now. All in all, the maintenance that is required to keep up with the building and units is not worth the current rental price points. I am honestly bewildered as to how The Statler Residences continue to advertise as a luxury apartment building.

The building management is also extremely unpleasant and unprofessional—picking and choosing to address certain situations and not others.

I literally called and left emails to speak with someone for 4 days to no avail.  Finally I reached someone and the person I spoke with was very rude and unprofessional.  I even told him I could pay 3 months in advance and he laughed.  All he told me was the unit I was interested in was for housing vouchers.  Ok... I have cash and he did not make any effort to look or make a recommendation for me. Rude! Rude! Rude! How much business have y’all lost behind your poor customer service?

Under no circumstances would I advise moving into this apartment. Communication is null between leasing office and residents, ongoing maintenance issues go unresolved and problems with property management and building ownership go unanswered.

I think that the residence side is obviously new so there are lots of issues arrising. The windows are old and let cold and hot air into the apartment which caused us to have to buy a space heater which isn’t cool with how much we pay for rent. We also have water all over the windows and window seals. So the windows are a big issue that if it doesn’t get resolved soon could result in mold or bigger issues. And I also feel that the parking garage isn’t good. There are no mirrors so you can’t see when going up or down the ramp.. which leads me to believe it’s only a matter of time before people start hitting each other as the complex fills up.
Cannot even go into enough detail it would take me hours to write. Worst place, worst management, worst neighbors. Absolutely disgusting place.

Toured this property last week. 
The office team was very inviting , warm , and helpful.
I'm looking forward to moving into this property. 
If I could give more than five stars. I would!

Jewel on Landmark (JOL) has certainly changed for the better since I originally moved in back in 2019 (and it was named Jefferson Landmark). The leasing agents have been very positive to work with and the maintenance team has been incredibly responsive to every request I’ve submitted; in fact, I’ve never lived somewhere with such attentive and respectful maintenance! There are the occasional smells and noises that you’ll see and hear at every apartment complex, but nothing permanent that creates a security risk that can be avoidable.

I'm thankful they’ve added a dog park and reinforced healthy living habits in the community (i.e. charging residents who put their trash in the hallway without a bin, which can cause the smell to seep into the carpet). The gym is convenient and large enough that plenty of people can workout at the same time. It’s also helpful to know that they’ve taken resident feedback into consideration - i.e. they now will text residents if there’s an emergency of any kind (which I recommended to JOL after our previous management neglected to keep us informed)

Overall, it’s been an easy community to call home and I’d highly recommend living here!

Stay away this is a horrible community to live in. We got out of our lease early due to theft and vandalism of our property. After moving out we went back into the office to pay what utilities we had left and were told that was our final bill and owed nothing more! I get a notification today saying I have a new collections account for Landmark for $196 which I do not owe and if we did for any reason you would think we would’ve received some sort of communication via email or in the mail to our new address but we got neither. I will definitely be reporting this on several other sites. This is a high theft and drug using community. Stay away!!!!!

If you're thinking about moving here, please save yourself the headache and avoid doing so.

Upon move-in, the apartment was not clean and they refused to clean the apartment due to "COVID concerns". I had to clean dirty drawers from the previous resident MYSELF. Do not be fooled by the nice amenities, it simply is not worth it. I am currently in the midst of filing a lawsuit against this awful management company. They will tow your car for no reason even though it is registered under your name. They'll then shift the blame over to the towing truck company (that they hired) and you'll consistently be getting the run-around. They've done this twice now and I've had to pay out over $600 thus far. I've had enough and will be taking them to court, I wouldn't wish this kind of treatment on my worst enemy. The amount of disorganization and dishonesty from the management group is appalling and I highly suggest you look elsewhere for a place to call home.

I wish I could leave less than 1 star. Since this new management company, South Oxford took over the property has declined considerably. I loved the property when we moved in and ZRS was the management company but now the new management does not maintain the property at all. Moving in to a hotel style apartment I thought that the halls would be climate controlled but that is not the case at all. The ac is rarely turned on and there is always trash in the hallways. However if you go towards the leasing office you will find that the AC is turned on and it smells good. I guess this is so that when they tour you get the better experience. We pay for valet garbage collection and they are suppose to pick up trash everyday except for holidays, but we are finding that trash is not consistently picked up especially on the weekends causing the hallways to smell. My car was broken into and was told that there are cameras in the garage. This is not true except for the camera at the entrance. We were told that they purchased cameras but have yet to see any cameras in the garage although there are a few cameras in the hallways. Renewing our lease was a complete ordeal. It took 2-3 weeks for anyone to respond and send us our lease. The front office is unresponsive and when they do respond they are not helpful at all. You can tell that they don't care at all. Work orders are not handle in a timely manner at all as well. The security guard came to our door the other night saying that someone put a noise complaint even though it was just me and my roommate that was home. We had on our television and it was 11:30pm at night on a Saturday. He threatened saying that if it was a second noise complaint the police would be called. I am not sure if this is the proper protocol but his presence definitely does not make me feel safe at all. Not sure who exactly this man could protect. They have the fire alarms under control as they don't go off as much as they did but the whole community has declined as a whole. People don't even take the fire alarms seriously because they use to go off all the time for no reason. Last week the alarm went off and we have yet to hear why it went off but this is just par for the course as they do not communicate at all. I would not suggest moving here at all. I hate moving but I can not wait to move away from this property. I will definitely not be renewing my lease and hate that I renewed this last time but will stick it out.

Do not live here. I have been living here since they opened and nothing has functioned properly from the very beginning. The garage gate breaks constantly. Pipes bursting. Random fire alarms. The outdoor grills have now been broken longer than they were operational. There's been a burglary. Amazon locker parcels are still not functioning. Do not be fooled by the new building façade. Live elsewhere.

Beautiful property! Had an amazing experience with the office team. Jordan was especially helpful during the lease signing process. Any questions I had, Jordan answered with a smile. Jordan was so kind and welcoming. I highly recommend this property. Amazing property and great prices.

I moved in at the beginning of January and it has been nothing but great since I moved in. I haven’t lived in an apartment in over 20 years so the new processes are very different. Katie, Shae and Kate have been extremely helpful in this whole situation getting everything sorted, settled and set up for my daughter’s and my new place. Amenities have been great and I look forward to spending time at the pool this summer cooking out. The maintenance staff have been on top of the small issues that we noticed on move in and got them taken care of same day. Close to i30 and right along 199 makes it easy to enjoy the local eateries or take care of shopping.

I've had a fantastic experience living at One90 Main. The leasing agent, Shay, has been incredible – always friendly, professional, and extremely helpful. She made the leasing process smooth and has been attentive to any questions or concerns I've had. The complex itself is well-maintained with great amenities. I highly recommend One90 Main to anyone looking for a wonderful place to live with outstanding staff support!

I was able to tour with Katie and she was the kindest and most professional leasing agent. She listened to all my needs and found me the perfect apartment based on what I wanted. I love living here and every time I go to the office Katie always has a beautiful smile on her face. Thank you Katie for all your kindness

Unprofessional and not a fun environment to live in. First of all I’ve lived here for 6 months and NEVER received a USPS mailbox. Min you when I signed my lease, I was told it would take 3weeks to get my mailbox by Kate…6 months in still never heard anything about my mailbox and never got a key. They send maintaintence to apartments to do “occupant checks” instead of sending office staff. The parking lot was becoming rather full and now everyone has broken their lease and moved out! I’ve had nothing but issues since I moved it. I’ve had several issues from the kitchen sink, to the bathroom. My shower is growing BLACK mold, and they keep doing is putting some product on it for it go away temporarily. They haggle you for every dime that they can get. They offered a discounted rate on reserved parking and then they told residents that you HAVE to keep the parking space on your lease once you purchase it. I wish I would have known before moving here.

The community is covered in dog poop. There aren't any surveillance in place to protect the residents or their belongings. I had a package stolen and was told "it's your duty to have a ring camera for your packages" the call box wasn't working for months any one could just walk into the building. The parking is designed that you'll have to pay. They have 10 slots for free in the front and the others in the back are all reserved costing 40-200 dollars depending on if you want a garage of covered parking. One good thing I can say is they give free pizza every once in a while :)

Ive lived here 5 years and don't plan on moving anytime soon.great location,they always have something going on in the club house for residents. Nick, Claudia and the rest of the office staff are wonderful. Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because I think my upstairs neighbor is a river dancer. Other than that I would recommend this property 100 times

I would strongly suggest looking for living elsewhere. This was my fifth apartment to live in and by far the worst experience I have had, and that includes my college apartments. If you accidentally back your chair into the wall, massive hole. My wife and I have had BOTH of our cars broken into in the parking garage. The staff is uncooperative and unhelpful. You couldn’t pay me a million dollars to live here again. Anything that could go wrong did go wrong. The location is the only thing this place has going for it, and there’s 10 better options to choose from with the same location. Counting the days until I am out of here right down the street.

This place is quiet, beautifully maintained, and worth every penny. As a single female living alone I feel safe with the covered parking and regularly rotating security guards. The pools are beautiful. Sometimes they get too crowded over the summer, but oh well. Everyone who lives near me is quiet and respectful.

I am so happy to finally get around to writing a review.  My husband and I will be entering into our 2nd year.  The Staff (Katrina, Meia, Nick, Brittney, Claudia and Marisol) are ATTENTIVE, FRIENDLY and HAVE MADE US FELL WELCOMED, SAFE and have accommodated any needs we have encountered.  Spacious Floor Plans and Quiet Living on the Lake!   Many other perks we have taken part in which have made this AMLI feel like a home and not just an apartment, is the time and effort, the OFFICE staff takes to have events in the common areas(Free Coffee, Free Plants and Chocolate Covered Strawberries).  Thanks you guys! We are so thankful for you!!!!!!!!! And OH YEAH WE LOVE THE MOVIE THEATER and the many GRILLING STATIONS.
So many issues with this apartment complex. Do not move here if you value working elevators, quiet neighbors, apartment walls/ceilings that aren't made out of paper.

This property is dirty. There is dog poop for days in the hallways and stairwells. Possibly along with urine or maybe a leaking roof? The elevator is usually broken so we leap over it hoping for a safe landing. I do not stay here ever by myself as I do not feel safe as s single female.
Rude staff, bug problem, maintenance that doesn't actually do the work, broken amenities, and high rent.

Been here for a few months, elevators do not work like at all. How can you call yourself a wheelchair friendly place but the elevators don’t work nor get fixed? Staff is completely inattentive and ignores inquiries/emails or calls on issues that need to be dealt with such as roach issues from past residents. Disruptive neighbors that have random yelling sessions at 3 AM. MAA Addison is a nice area in general but I would not recommend living here.

1) Elevators rarely work
2) Staff is inattentive, unresponsive, not approachable
3) Common areas are dirty and when complaints are made they go unanswered
4) Service requests are cancelled and might or might not be completed
5) Parking is nearly impossible and management doesn’t address it.

Management at this apartment complex only does the bare minimum. Even so, they think they can hike the lease price a malicious amount after only a year. 

This place has SO MUCH potential, but upper management squanders it in the pursuit of maximum profit.

The location is great.  Close to so much but still has a peaceful, quiet feel.   
Unfortunately, my experience with the property management leaves a lot to be desired.  I get the feeling they don’t particularly care if I’m happy or not.  There has been one staff member that is the exception.

I moved here almost two years ago because I like the Addison area and the price was right but MAA Addison Circle has went downhill since then. My rent increased more than 15% when I renewed my lease after the first year and I’m sure there would be another dramatic increase if I decided to renew again when my lease expires later this year. Common areas such as garages, pools, stairwells seem like they get cleaned maybe once a year. I notified the office of a dead bird in the garage right under the call box for all visitors to see almost two months ago and was promised that it would be taken care of. The bird remained there and after notifying the office two more times without any resolution I finally submitted a work order to have maintenance pick it up. Maintenance marked the work order complete without actually removing the dead bird and since then two more dead birds have dropped dead in the garage which is a lovely sight and smell for you and your guests to walk through as you make your way from the garage. The excessive cobwebs and stains on the walls in the stairwells and hallways are disgusting. It looks like something out of a haunted house.

I’ve been requesting a new ventilation hood since I moved in. The light on my hood powers on but the fan does absolutely nothing. Maintenance has told me that since it turns on as evident by the light, that it’s Ok if the ventilation hood doesn’t actually serve it’s intended purpose of ventilation, which is the dumbest thing I’ve heard in my life (and I’ve heard some dumb s*** in my day). To top it all off the office refuses to accept packages on behalf of the residents and won’t at least get a package locker. This has resulted in delivery drivers not being able to find or access our apartments in our heavily gated buildings with confusing layouts. Therefore they leave our packages in unsecured areas which has cost me more money in stolen packages then I care to think about at the moment. All in all there are much better places to stay in the area for comparable prices. Avoid this place.

- They never show up to fix things.
- Hidden fees
- rude management
- not safe to live here
Poor amenities and they don't even care to fix any issues

Initially we loved this place, the management was good - however for past 6 months or so, since the new management has taken over (and they changed the name from Santa Fe Ranch to Tides o Ranchview), the condition has deteriorated. They have added un-necessary amount to monthly bills, zero service, don't respond to calls from current renters, rude, change rules on their whims and fancy. Just waiting for my lease to be over. Avoid renting here if you can.

Moved out almost 5 months ago. They do not pay back security deposits. We passed all the inspections. Left apartment immaculate. After 15 phone calls and 12 emails, they admitted we were owed the security deposit however they will not send it.  These people are extremely dishonest and take advantage or renters. Stay away.

Worst in following the rules they put in place. No one follows the rules about trash or noise issues and even reported with evidence nothing is done here. Not sure why you give lease agreement for with so many rules ?

Water shutdown every month without notice using emergency as an excuse. Emergency means once or twice and not every month. The meaning of emergency lost its value in this complex.

If you never tried here, never even come here. Look some where else.

I’ve been living here for almost 2 years now and every month i find roaches. I live in a 3rd floor apt and am rarely home so not here enough to make mess. Management sprays with a non invasive spray inside the home upon request. Still have this problem.

Absolute worst place to live. No respect for their residents or their guests when it comes to parking. The very few guest parking they have is ridiculous. Towing happens all the time even if you have a “parking pass”. They obviously have some deal made with the shady towing company. 

I’d avoid at all costs and find a better complex in the area to live at. There are plenty others that give you way more for your money and you don’t have to deal with the rude staff and their miserable parking life.

My family and I called Santa Fe Ranch home from 2014-2015 and were sad to leave. We absolutely LOVED our apartment home- any issues, noise or maintenance related were handled in a timely matter and we had zero issues so it was a no brainer when we were looking for a new place in the fall of 2016 that we would be moving back to SFR. Since being here we’ve had no complaints- during the summer our AC went out and it was close to 11pm, I called the after hours line and 10 minutes later the on call service tech was knocking at our door letting us know he was handling the issue! To all the staff- thank you for making this experience such an enjoyable one, you will all be missed!

Nice place and i have been living for 3 years  .
the Maintenance staff and the leasing agents are very friendly.
I would recommend any one to stay in this apartments :)

I have been living at Santa Fe Ranch apartments for almost 5 years now, and it is still the best apartment I have lived in. The staff is great, maintenance requests are taken care of in a very timely manner, it is quiet (I have lived next to some very noisy neighbors), and the location can't be beat.

I would definitely recommend stopping by and checking it out.

The staff is wonderful. They are kind and responsive and maintenance is always quick to take care of tickets also. The complex is quiet and very well taken care of. It is in a great location. A quick drive to many restaurants and shopping. I have truly enjoyed calling this place home.
Absolutely love this residence. Extremely affordable. Staff is awesome. Apartments are nice. Maintenance is always sharp. Must rent from!!

I love it here! It is nice and well taken care of, and I say this after living here for almost four plus years. The staff in the management office is always pleasant and helpful. Perhaps the most important feature, most of the times maintenance staff is on the ball.

This manager was making up charges left and right after I left the property (after almost 3 years of living there).

The place is falling apart with garage doors constantly broken and/or manually left open by residents. In the last 2 weeks I’ve toured several high end, luxury apartments searching for my next home. Without comparison, St. James has won my heart and I will be moving there in the Spring.

The personal connection and genuinity found at St. James is far from common and something to really consider when choosing where you’re going to live next.

p.s. If you’re touring soon, ask about their phenomenal “Apartment Life” program — you won’t regret it!

I found the Kirby through a locator and based on the pictures, I was excited! When calling to setup an appointment, it was difficult to get someone to answer the phone. I called multiple times and at different times, left messages, but struggled to ever get a response. Finally I was able to make an appointment for the first possible day to show the apartment, as it was not yet ready for showings.
I called the night before to confirm my appointment and make sure the apartment was still available, before I drove three hours in from out of town to view it and the leasing agent confirmed that it was still available. I asked if there were any pending applications on the unit and he stated “no that it was still completely available”. Fast forward to the next morning, I call when I’m about 20 min out to inquire about parking and a different agent tells me “oh I’m sorry, it appears that unit has been leased over the weekend, but I have other units you may be interested in”. The agent half heartedly apologized for the misunderstanding, but it was nonetheless frustrating that I called 12 hours ago to confirm and they still led me on knowing there was an application pending! I went ahead with the appointment to at-least checkout the historic building, but was fairly disappointed. The bottom lobby floor is nicely updated and clean, but the actual residence floors had several potent odors throughout them. Most smelling like weed. When I asked about it, the agent stated that they were a smoking tolerant property and that they were not able to “legally stop somebody from smoking in their unit”.
The building came across as old. They advertise as being “historic”, however there is a difference between “historic” and just being old. Several windows throughout the building had years of caked on dirt, making it near impossible to enjoy the views you're paying for. They stated that it was too costly to have windows cleaned on a regular basis, so they “opt to complete it once every 7 years.”
I attempted to share feedback with my agent on several items however both agents seemed unreceptive and disinterested to the honest feedback being offered. A lot of excuses were given for things, but not a lot of solutions. They were unreceptive to feedback and failed to provide an open line of communication and transparency.
Their pricing is somewhat competitive, but you get what you pay for in downtown it seems.
The building has so much potential. I was disappointed and underwhelmed.

I don’t recommend this place at all. They charge tenants a monthly fee to park here when at times you’re not even able to park in your own spot you pay for!! There’s nothing worse than getting off a long shift only to be inconvenienced and unable to park in your own place THAT YOU PAY A MONTHLY FEE FOR A RESERVED SPOT. I am writing to express my growing concern regarding the security situation at Building B. Despite being told that patrol officers are monitoring the property, I have experienced a lack of response when reaching out to them for assistance. I’ve attempted to contact the patrol officer multiple times this week, specifically about the issue of homeless individuals residing within the building, but my calls have gone unanswered.

Additionally, I’ve witnessed homeless individuals coming out of the dog wash station and sleeping in the hallways. I’ve also encountered a homeless person when I was coming home at around 5 AM inside building B, where he jokingly told me he was “looking for an empty apartment to crash in.” Of course I don’t know if he was joking or not nor did I acknowledged him as I was trying to rush into my apartment. The gates are often broken, which I suspect may be facilitating unauthorized access to the building. It is particularly disheartening to pay a premium for what is advertised as a "luxury" apartment, only to encounter homeless individuals regularly at various hours of the day.

What’s even more frustrating is when I was asked if I had taken pictures of these individuals, as though that would be my first thought in such a situation. My primary concern in these moments is ensuring my safety and getting to my apartment without incident.

I would like to ask you to consider this situation from our perspective. If you were living here, would you want yourself or your guests to encounter individuals who are homeless and residing within the building? I believe the answer is no. While I understand that the leasing office or patrol officers cannot be in every area at all times, the fact that this issue seems to be occurring almost daily suggests the need for further attention. I recommend an investigation into the matter or an increase in overnight walk-throughs to identify and address the individuals involved. This proactive approach would help ensure the safety and comfort of all residents.

For everyone's safety, please be mindful and cautious when returning home late at night. The homeless I have encountered is a tall black male with a beard and curly, voluminous hair, wearing a green jacket. He has been seen with a shorter white woman. Please remain vigilant and take precautions when coming home. He has been seen sleeping next to the hallway that leads to the courtyard by apartment 2182.

I’ve called the leasing office for questions during business hours and I’ve yet to get through to anyone on the phone. Maintenance team comes out quickly to solve issues.  Quiet so far, close to work. Giving a 3 due to the gates being broken (& frequently according to residents).

Move in and lease process was very easy despite moving from out of state. Kat gave a great tour and explained all the amenities. My service dog  and I have had a great first week. Love the location.  So accessible to Downtown Dallas and the Medical District.

Moving in to West Love has been a generally easy process. The office staff was very responsive leading up to the move and very helpful. Maintenance has done a wonderful job in resolving any issues in a timely manner. We cannot wait to get settled in!

They cancelled our 'non-cancellable' booking less than a week before our trip citing 'new management'. It was for an event and so impossible for us to find equivalent accommodation at the same cost.  Don't trust that your booking will be honoured.

I read a lot of reviews before moving into the building. I was very skeptical due to some of the bad reviews I read but when I took my tour of the facility I absolutely fell in love with the building. The units are huge and you get your bang for your buck here. The location is fantastic you are minutes from some of the best restaurants, bars and attractions downtown Dallas has to offer. The staff so far has been amazing Mrs. Carla is absolutely the best.  She has gone out of her way multiple times to help me out whether I locked myself out of my unit to answering any and every question I have about my bill or just simply taking 5 minutes to see how you are doing if she sees you walking by. All of the staff is pretty awesome here you will never be disappointed. The only thing I have to complain about is the parking situation it's all Valet and its expensive and no quest parking. I moved into the Butler Brothers Building a few weeks ago and have had a great experience so far! The building is rich in history and every apartment that I have been in here has so much character. I travel to Highland Park every day and the location is great — I am able to hop on 75 and be in HP in about 10 minutes. The Farmers Market is right up the street and Main St is a few blocks up with restaurants, grocery and convenience stores, bars and clubs, etc. I felt that BBB offered well built, beautiful units for a very reasonable rate. 

As for my leasing experience, when I walked into the leasing office and met Miss Carla I knew that I wanted to be a part of this community. She greeted me with remarkable energy and truly listened to what I was looking for in an apartment and found me the perfect space. I grew up with family in the multifamily industry and am well versed in property management. I can honestly say that Miss Carla could be used as a case study when training leasing staff. She knew every detail about the history of this building (which is almost 110 years old!) and was extremely honest about life at BBB. I had toured the property a couple of times, and she was extremely patient with me while I was figuring out my housing arrangements. When I told her I was ready to move in and was hoping I could move in the next day, she made sure that the unit I wanted would be turned and everything was ready to go within 24 hours. I have toured dozens of beautiful apartment buildings and have yet to meet leasing personnel who are so passionate about their tenants and their job. 

While I am still a newer resident and have not enjoyed all of the amenities, there are so many! I was at Royal Blue up the street buying groceries last week and one of the employees told me that he used to be an apartment locater and was always impressed with how many amenities my building had. One of the unique amenities here are a bunch of glass cubicles to work in. I enjoy having a small confined work to focus and have found these to be useful. There is a conference room and another large meeting room, of course, if you are meeting with a group. Other than that, I have only used the fitness center, but it has enough equipment to get a good workout in. UNCONCERNED STAFF 
APATHY FROM STAFF

This is by far the worst place I have ever lived.  It’s not a residential building, it’s an Airbnb frat house where large and loud parties are thrown and residents are flung in the middle to deal with it.  I have lost countless hours of sleep as people yell and scream obnoxiously down the hallways, blast loud music, and 20 or 30 people will be in an apartment next to you screaming and yelling all night long. This is the trashiest group of people I have ever seen in one building.  It will take four hours to dry your clothes with these bizarre appliances, and the whole building smells like gasoline. Your clothes will smell like gasoline.  Where I live on the eighth floor, there is an Airbnb apartment on both sides of me and across from me and down the hall. Sometimes people will rent multiple apartments and walk back-and-forth between them partying and screaming loudly down the hallways as they go back and forth. It’s an utter nightmare living here.

My actual unit was great. It is an old cool looking building with a warehouse feel. That is why it is disappointing that this place is run so poorly. The place smells horrible, the doors to get into the building break,  there are problems getting packages. The biggest issue is that half of the apartments are being leased to a company that runs a Air BNB business. There are constant parties with nonexistent security. I used the elevator one morning and found a trash can full of vomit. There are a thousand options for apts downtown, and I would advise picking another one.

2 Management companies,  3 leasing staffs, 2 valet companies, 2 cocierge/security changes in less than a year...Maintenance requests as simple as a light bulb change stay open over a month. The building is FULL of more Airbnb than residents. The members at the Evolve Gym (located in the building) crowd up the Valet during rush hours and park for FREE while residents pay $125 per car to have to wait 20 mins for their cars. The building is not secured, doors stay broken and leave easy access for ANYONE to come in. The amenities super cool but are  definitely oversold or nonexistent. Apartments are nice and spacious but the disorganization of Management,Valet, Concierge is VERY frustrating and disconjointed. I've been here about 9 months and absolutely love my actual apartment space. However, I have to be honest to say that I am a LOT less excited about the building and my overall experience since moving in. My apartment was not ready at move-in.  They switched Mgt a week after I moved in. Things started out rocky but seemed to start getting better (for a moment). Then it seems they became relaxed, comfortable and more and more less concerned.  The amenities advertised are super cool but underutilized and incomplete or nonexistent in most cases. The new valet has been a horrible experience. No automated sms system so as you can imagine pure chaos.  Lost cars, 20 min waits. The new concierge/security are rude and unprofessional.  Every maintenance request I have submitted I have had to go to the office to inquire when it would be done. The promised outside grills we got emails about 2 months ago are still nonexistent.  The Airbnb guests trash the place and the cleaning crew is very inconsistent. I've seen the same muck in the elevator for days and it typically smells. The office staff are nice but seem to do little and care little about the building and residents overall wellbeing and experience living here.  There's only ONE Maintenance man trying to manage this whole building alone.  The BEST part of this building in my opinion is the Butler Brothers Bar that just opened about a month ago. Great people, good food, and convenient!

At this point, although I love my space, I'm feeling like I probably won't be renewing.

The maintenance staff is undermanned, overworked, and under appreciated.
The apartments are over priced with promises of amenities that never manifested in 13 months.
The leasing office is poorly managed and inexperienced.
The concierge and parking staff have been replaced 3x in 13 months.
It is poorly managed, unresponsive, and somewhere I was encourage no one to spend their earned dollars.

I moved in to the BBB in December, right when the new management team took over. It was a bit of a rocky transition at first, but I can say with confidence that I love living here! The location is wonderful! Right in the middle of downtown and within walking distance to the Farmer's Market and Deep Ellum. I have a fantastic view of downtown right outside my window too! The amenities are unbeatable- valet parking, an awesome gym with a separate yoga room and cycling room, an art studio, a "jam room" with all instruments and sound proof walls, office space to work from home, and a club house decked out with tons of things to do (pool, shuffle board, karaoke, ski ball, etc.) and a full kitchen, TV and seating area! I have 2 dogs that live with me and they love it too. I can walk them around City Hall and there's plenty of areas for them to use the restroom. Everyone at BBB has a dog it seems like. There's also a brand new restaurant and bar downstairs which is convenient and they deliver to the resident's doors for free like room service. This place truly has it all. 11/10 would definitely recommend.

I can honestly say that this is the best place I’ve ever seen. It had me at valet lol. The tour was amazing. Great amenities. I’m in love with the music and art room. As we went up the elevator I smelled something weird but then I realized it smells like the sealant they use for wood. The apartment was stunning. Exactly what I needed! WiFi...what?? Woo hoo. Thank you Veronica and Joe. You two truly went above and beyond. This is definitely my next home. The only thing I didn’t like was the large picture windows but I can live with that. Customer service was on point!!!

Excellent community with great events monthly. Joe and Veronica are super helpful and the valet parking is awesome. The apartments are spacious and updated with new appliances and are located within a short walk of great restaurants. The maintenance staff responds quickly and Veronica will help with anything you need.

I'm very impressed with this place, I've lived in a lot of nice communities around Downtown Dallas over the years and when it comes to location, price, and product, they have a great balance. Great neighbors, just a great quality of life living here. The staff was very helpful with the entire leasing and move in process.

Every week is a new disturbance.
Storage break-ins, car break-ins, stolen vehicles, flooded apartments, broken elevators for months, false alarms, construction at the worst times, waking up naked with maintenance people in my house…. the list continues. Horrible time to move for the year 2023/2024 as there are apartment renovations and they are loud and don’t come with warning! The management blames the corporate guys for not letting her go on vacation and the team has very little regard for making things right only just making sure you get rent in. It used to be a premier property but it really has gone downhill drastically..

Leasing agents of AMLI Design District knowing allowed me to be the sole occupant of an apartment leased by a now 'ex-boyfriend'. The leasing agents story turned to 'not knowing I lived there'.  He did.

It appears AMLI leasing agents can choose which company policies they choose to adhere to. I reported the occurrence.  AMLI corporate is there to back up their employees.  II would not recommend AMLI Design DIstrict or AMLI properties.

This used to be a quality building, but no more. I lived in the building since it was built and finally moved out last month. The only bright spot are the team concierges, who legitimately care about the residents. Unfortunately, the building itself has become dangerous. It's one thing to have the elevators always out of service, the common areas filled with trash and the "secure" access door propped open. It's another thing to be afraid to walk in the parking garage at late hours or witness criminal activity in the building. I used to love living here. It's very sad.

Large fitness facility, amazing pool with downtown Dallas view, grills and contemporary seating that surround common area, pet friendly, great concierge service.

Located in the Design District of Dallas, it's perfectly place for the creative and relaxed. 

Very close to Katy Trail makes getting out and getting fit a breeze.

Not happy at all with how my move in was handled. Was told I would receive $150 off 1st month if I look and lease. Was told that the apartment would be ready on 1st or 2nd. I called several times no answer. I receive an email with a new move date of July 4th on the 2nd. I sent an email advising they need to move the date to Friday as the 4th is mid week, a holiday and I took off Monday and Tuesday to move. Today 7/20 I entered 15 separate tickets for each repair. I was told previously the move in inspection sheet would be used to enter tickets. That was never done.
