I have shown office pictures, videos, filing a lawsuit against him now call me having this problem for a couple of months try six I can’t even walk in my house but I’ll be in scared because they be out in daylight also.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: So far, I have been treated right and I enjoy living in the community. The Amenities are A1 and everything is accessible. Thanks to management for all their efforts to make it a home for my family. Three years here and many more years to come.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
Love this place!  Friendly staff who went out if the way to help me. 
I felt welcome. 
Looking forward to living here for many years!

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: (1) My apartment was NOT ready when I moved in. They had to change my carpet because it smelled like a dog. I had severe allergies to the point where I had to sleep on the couch for weeks & buy a $600 air filter to breathe until they replaced the carpet. (2) -—The shower was not clean. It had hair. I hope you like hair.] -— (3) [The walls were damaged & needed to be painted. I believe the people who moved out before me kept scraping the walls with their furniture, etc.] —- (4) [8-12 fire alarms in like a 3-5 month period once I moved in. You practically live with people who don’t know how to prevent a fire.] —- (5) [Hope you like the smell of weed in the morning because my neighbors smoke more than snoop dog.] —-- (6) [The maintenance team had ME paint my own wall. They gave me a bucket of paint & asked me to buy my own brush. It gets worse trust me. The paint was the wrong color. They come back & ask me questions like “Did you take pictures of the wall before you painted it” and “Why didn’t you stop painting after you noticed it was the wrong color”. They are trying to pin this on me after the maintenance guy tried to take a shortcut by having me do the labor. If they try & charge me a dime for this, I will take this to a small claims court. It will be an easy win, but that’s beside the point. I shouldn’t have to go through this nonsense.] —-- (7) [The cover for the air vents was in my dishwasher when I moved in. That's right. I had holes in my ceiling when I moved in.] —-- (8) [The kitchen sink was clogged on move-in day.] —-- (9) [The kitchen faucet was also clogged on move-in day.] —- (10) [Dirt particles in my water from the refrigerator.] —- (11) [The garbage disposal air switch was not working on move-in day.] —- (12) [The maintenance team will try & take shortcuts whenever possible.] —- (13) [You can call the leasing office over 10 times a day. They will NOT answer the phone.] —- (14) [My car has been jacked into over 5 times in a 3-5 month period since I moved in.] —-- (15) [Don’t bother having any food delivered to you because you will have to go downstairs to get it because it's almost impossible for the driver to get up.] —- (16) [The people from “Amazon” leave my packages in an unprotected room where anybody can steal them because the leasing office doesn’t make it obvious where to leave the packages.]

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: DO NOT LIVE HERE. I cannot stress this enough. Ignore the signs saying "luxury". Ignore the community amenities. I am not someone who normally writes reviews but I have to for this place to hopefully save someone else from what I am dealing with. If you are a working professional adult you DO NOT want to live here. It has changed and it is UNSAFE. This used to be a community of working professionals and some older couples. I now currently live under drug dealers and I have DAILY problems. EVERY SINGLE DAY. I am often woken up by loud music, banging, pounding, basketball bouncing, and yelling at all hours of the night - 1am, 2am, 3am, 4am. I am forced to confront this group of boys on my own. As a single woman, it is scary every time - multiple times a week I am forced to choose between getting sleep or feeling safe. As I write this it is 2:54am and I have already been up there twice to ask them to turn music down and it's still going. I am very fearful of them retaliating on my vehicle or my boyfriend's vehicle. This is a decision we discuss at 2am on almost a weekly basis when he is here: do we go up there and risk them retaliating on our vehicles or do we just sit here and endure it and get no sleep? There are nights I have been in tears at 4am because I am so exhausted dealing with this apartment and have gotten ZERO sleep. When I first moved in there used to be a nighttime security officer you could call for noise/security issues and you would see walking around, but now you are completely on your own. The management does nothing. On several occasions I've debated calling the maintenance emergency line in the middle of the night and lying and saying I have water leaking everywhere, just to get a guy from maintenance to come and help me deal with this other apartment. The other day my boyfriend caught them trying to flood the 10th floor bathroom by plugging all the sinks and turning the water on full blast. This is the maturity level of some of the rentership here. The 10th floor reeks like marijuana all the time. It's embarrassing - it feels like you're a freshman in college living in the dorms. It's gotten so bad I've considered hiring an attorney to help get me out of my lease. If you like the location, I would strongly encourage checking out the Village or the other apartments in the Shops that are owned by a different company.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: I absolutely love the property and staff. Cody was nothing short of amazing. I relocated out of state and he made the process seamless and nice. Upon arrival,  Stephen helped me with picking up my keys. He went above and beyond to help me as it was pretty stressful relocating. Top of the line service and I love our unit.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
I moved in over three weeks ago and within hours of moving, there was such a disturbance it was greatly concerning. This disturbance has been an ongoing issue, and the entire leasing office staff knew about this prior to me moving in. This area of the Galleries has been plagued by this disturbance for quite some time. True professionals block or prevent future residents from these occurrences. The Galleries knowing full well of this issue allowed me to move in blindly without any forewarning when other units were available.
My first week in my apartment I stayed in the guest suite for a week due to the disturbance. This has impacted my sleep and work performance because this is an ongoing issue. In addition, now I am receiving intimidating and harassing symbols outside my unit. The leasing office has downplayed my concerns with nothing but excesses and no concern for my safety. I have stressed no one can tell what is in another person’s mind, and the unpredictability of this issue escalating into bodily or deadly harm is real.
My option was to move to another unit and absorb the cost of moving. This is so unfair and unprofessional. I bared the cost to move in 3 weeks ago and the Galleries have failed to create a safe and conducive living environment and now they want me to pay out of pocket again. Shame on you. You all are failing to keep your residents safe and free from harassment and disturbances.
The Galleries are a beautiful and up to date complex. However, I warn everyone of the character and lack of judgement within this property.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
It's been a very long time since I have lived in an apartment and I have been pleasantly surprised by the wonderful staff at the Galleries at Park Place. They really do go above and beyond to make you feel welcomed and comfortable at your new home. They answer every question quickly and in a friendly manner. Service requests are always handled very promptly. I love how the staff calls me by my name and I've only been here for 5 months. 
There are so many social activities each month. There is really something for everyone. Even, if you're not a social butterfly, you can just stop by when they have their 'breakfast on the go" mornings, scavenger hunts, and holiday door decorating contests. When people visit me and see the calendar of events in the elevator, they are always jealous. 
While the apartment has socials, the apartments are very quiet! Very quiet! I rarely hear my neighbors with their TV or Music. We are next to the Park Lane DART station... I can see it from my north facing balcony. However, I barely hear the train when inside my apartment. I definitely hear it when sitting on the balcony, but for a brief moment. This is as expected with living closer to a busy area.
As far as my apartment itself... I love the floor to ceiling windows. The location and the floor to ceiling windows drew me to this location. I really like the open floor plan providing a view out those windows. There's plenty of space in the large fridge and freezer. A washer/dryer provided was a must for me. The walk-in closet is nice and spacious. The bedroom is on the small side, but that is minor compared to the huge list of pros about this apartment.
It's great being able to receive package deliveries in the package locker system. Using the dry cleaner lockers has been super convenient for me. I have been able to take advantage of walking to my dentist. Dental Loft is an excellent dentist office located on the street level.  
I love to run and cycle. From our apartment, I can run east on Park Lane for about a mile and hit the SoPac trail which takes you to White Rock Lake. Run another half mile on Park Lane and you can hit the White Rock Creek Trail which will definitely take you to White Rock Lake. BONUS: You can get to White Rock Lake from here in 3 miles cycling or running.
I have been here for 5 months and I have had no regrets of choosing my home at Galleries at Park Lane. I really do enjoy living here. I highly recommend that you make Galleries at Park Lane your new home!

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: This place is so amazing and pristine the staff is so wonderful especially Hope she was so resourceful and so nice usually when I talk to apartment staff in general they usually have such a monotone attitude and not here and that's another reason i love it they were quick and helpful to answer any inquiries that i had and were so awesome at showcasing me around I am seriously recommending all my friends and family of this place!

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: I was really excited to move to Galleries at Park Lane from Uptown but soon realized I was in for a “treat”. I lived here for almost 8 months but moved for a new job to another state. First of all, I really appreciate Danny for being such a great leasing agent and helping me through the move in/move out process. The maintenance people are great as well and also very attentive. My biggest gripe with this place is the noise you get from the upstairs and next door neighbors. The walls must have been made of paper mache because I could hear every step my neighbors took. This was so annoying seeing as though I was on the 2nd floor. I really didn’t have any other complaints, while living there, aside from the ridiculous amount of money I had to pay to break my lease due to me taking another job out of state. I paid nearly $5,000 and my apartment was already re-leased before I moved. Such a racket seeing as though they never lost a month of rent even after I moved out. After moving out, I informed the front office that I would like for them to clean the apartment and take the costs out of the deposit. I was told that this was fine and that it is something that they normally do. Fast forward one month and I receive a threatening email from Hope saying that I owe a balance and if it’s not paid by the 1st of August, my account would go into collections. The email gave no detail as to what the charges were for so I emailed Hope back asking for more clarity. I also gave the office a phone call but didn’t get anyone. I  get an email reply from Hope saying that I owe $35 but still no clarity as to what the $35 was for. So I called the office again. This time Hope answers, with a less than professional attitude, and I proceed to ask her for more detail around what the charges were for. She gives me the charges that the apartment accessed me for different services/repairs then tells me that she was in the process of sending me an email. I’m perfectly fine with the charges but when I asked her how I could pay the difference, she tells me and then hangs up in my face. Totally disrespectful and that’s no way to do business. This property has gotten a new management team that just got there before I left. If this is the way they treat residents, I’m SO glad I left this place. Although this property is located in a great area, I don’t think it’s worth the price and headache of dealing with the issues I encountered. Rent at your own risk!

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: I have dealt with enough from this property and am still dealing with it after move out. I had to call several noise complaints on neighbors because they would blast music early in the morning and extremely late at night (I work from home). Street facing unit was riddled with road noise from cars and sirens and DART station. Area didn't feel safe at night. Hot tub was always broken. Animal excrements were found often in elevators and halls. Pool was supposed to be heated but they never followed through on that. Now I'm being charged $292 for carpet replacement 40 months premature due to damage" Please read other reviews as this seems to be happening to everyone who leaves.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
I didn’t know much about Dallas before moving and picked the Galleries on a recommendation from my husband’s coworker. It’s in a great area in the shops at Park Lane, near Whole Foods and other shops. The apartments have washer/dryers, they have a nice gym and pool.

The hot tub is often not working and we didn’t have much luck negotiating renewal of our lease (ironically, we know one of my husband’s other coworkers is moving in as we move out, and paying less than we pay now, and they wanted to increase our rent quite a bit to stay. We would have even paid more if they gave us a deal on one of the bigger apartments but that also didn’t pan out). If we could have negotiated the rent, I would have loved to stay. It’s a nice place in a cool area.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
Every neighbors I talk to can’t wait to move out once their lease is done. For past few months you see nothing but people moving out. 
Their elevators never work always broken. They have fire drill alarm going off at 4am in the morning. 
You can save the trouble and move somewhere that has the same amenities or more and pay less amount on rent. 
Gym equipments need updates on 10th floor. Treadmill is always out of service. 
Walls are so thin you can hear all the neighbors what they’re doing. I complained about upstairs noises and they told me I have to report it to Dallas police. I did and still nothing being done. I can still hear them
Running around all day and night. We can never get good night sleep cause of all the noises. 

Save all the troubles and move somewhere else.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: I’ve lived here for a couple months now and no complaints! Common areas stay super clean, and maintence orders are taken care of within 24 hours. There is also areas where you have to scan in at all major entry’s. Super secure and safe!

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
Management at Galleries has been an absolute nightmare. We dealt with several issues during our term and we are STILL dealing with them after moving out. We have just received our move-out balance and we are being charged $352.00 for “carpet replacement 44 months premature due to damage”. WHAT DAMAGE?! We had the manager do a preliminary tour to point out of there were any areas of the apartment that needed attention and she mentioned that we needed to do a more thorough clean on the appliances (which we did) and vacuum the carpet (which we already had, BUT did a more thorough job the second time). 

MOVE - IN: when we chose our apartment, we noticed that there was a significant area that had been affected by mold since there was a leak behind the fridge. This affected the baseboard and two of the cabinets as well as part of the flooring by the stove. This was mentioned to management within 2 days of moving in and they brought a humidifier and “cleaned” the cabinets. It took them 2-3 weeks to send someone to fix the area behind the fridge and LITERALLY 10 months to fix the cabinets. We had black mold for about 2-3 months before that was taken out, no matter how many times we mentioned it to management.  I had to reach out to the owners to make them do that, mind you they never actually fixed the cabinets fully (they were swollen and the floor started to come apart). 

There were SEVERAL noisy neighbors who would play music until late hours, sometimes 2-3 in the morning and several times up until 5 am. The answer from the office: “call our courtesy officer and they’ll make a report” which was a JOKE. I actually had to contact the city to report this because management did not want to deal with it at all. 

Other major issues were the continuous stench of weed throughout the apartment complex and hallways. I don’t care what people do behind their door but man, when the whole hall stinks of it and it blows into your apartment...
- Trash was continuously left by the door leading into the apartment from the garage. 
- They were numerous break-ins to vehicles on the property (again, security was a joke) and “secure” parking was super limited and you had to walk very far. 
- Paper thin walls. We could literally hear our neighbors conversations, music, movies. You name it. 
- the hot tub was ALWAYS broken. 
- they never paid attention to the machines in the work out area, and even after this was brought up, they never fixed it.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review:
This is the WORST apartment complex I have ever lived in.  DO NOT live here or you will regret it like everyone else who lives here.

DO NOT be fooled by the new amenities, this place looks good on paper but please ask residents who live here how their living experience has been. (*Coming soon photos and an email so anyone thinking about living here can ask me questions) 

 Everything was broken when I moved in.  (Washer not hooked up to dryer, hot water not turned on,  water leaking from my roof, then they never even fixed the hole in my ceiling, my closet needed to be fixed on day one) Since then my closet has collapsed twice from just hanging a normal amount of clothes the last time it collapsed the unfinished metal (yes they left uncovered cut wire exposed in my closet it ripped my tuxedo beyond repair and has yet to offer any concessions.

apartmentName: Galleries at Park Lane Apartment Homes
review: I was looking for an apartment with several "must-haves."  This complex had it all.  Walk-in shower (this beat my expectations)  You have to see the shower to believe how nice it is.  Washer/dryer in the apartment.   Pets allowed. Easy mobility and great management staff.  I highly recommend living here.

Amazing Location, Amenities and Serice! 
Yes, it's a little pricey but I am worth it!
You have to check it out!
I rarely leave reviews, but I had an incredible experience visiting The 23. Madison in the leasing office was incredibly helpful and went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. Highly recommend!

The 23 is an Amazing place to live in Victory Park! The amenities are Fabulous (you’ll want to use them), Nina, the manager along with her staff are great and will take care of you! I’ve been here since pre-Covid and I’m still enjoying The 23 Apartment life!

I visited the 23 and the team that met me was so hospitable and knowledgeable!  Beautiful property and great floorplans, as well.  I will be moving here because I know I will have a great team with me on board!
I've lived at The 23 for a couple years now and I have to give a special shout out to the maintenance team. They are very friendly and so quick to respond.

Bert did a great job of signing me up about a year ago! Also, Nina did an awesome job of helping me renew my lease earlier today. Greatly appreciate the excellent service and positive vibes! I love all of the amenities especially the gym/pool! Keep up the excellent work!
Great place to leave,  wonderful for kids and pets close to everything's,  shopping, grocery,  freeway, fast food and hospital
The property Manager Rochelle  and assistant manager meesh are amazing and caring young ladies they have been patient and have worked with me since relocating to dallas and I am forever grateful
I’ve been here for 2 years and can say my experience has been great. I’ve not had any issues since I moved in.
I enjoy living at Domain at Midtown Park. The new management seem to be doing a great job overall.

I would never recommend anyone to live here. It’s dirty, most things are broken and take months to fix, maintenance is quick to come look at an issue but not fix it, and you can never get in touch with someone via phone or email. You can go wait in the office for over an hour, in line with the other residents who have the same issues.
I’ve been here for 2 years and I have not had any major issues or problems. It’s been a great experience so far.

I have been a tenant at Larq Henderson formally alexan Henderson going on 3 years. My experience since the company transitioned to larq Henderson has been horrible. The area has become unsafe including the safety of the apt buildings doors and gates are always broken and cars are always being broken into. The upkeep of the building is not up to par, hallways and areas surrounding buildings are always dirty with trash and people leaving their doggie bags filled with poop. Maintance request are ignored constantly and sometimes takes weeks for them to respond. There has been several incidents in the building where my neighbors have had parties and their guest have run ramped through the building banging on people’s doors and trying to force their way in  putting everyone in the building safety at risk, till this day management has never addressed the issue. Most   Recent incident police had a shoot out with a suspect and one of the bullets entered my neighbors window a few doors down from me. Some neighbors are inconsiderate you can hear literally everything and sometimes they party until 4/5 in the mornings the time I’m getting up for work. I have made several noise complaints through email and verbally/ face to face and nothing has been done!  I would not recommend larq Henderson due to the lack of concern from management on addressing cleanliness, safety and the overall satisfaction for their tenants I will not be renewing my lease here. Do Not Recommend!
No security or cameras in the parking garage. My car has been broken into twice. Need more cameras

Dog park smells like poop all the time. The gym needs to be cleaned professionally. Gym wipes are always out. The pool in the summer is absolutely crazy. Music is too loud and makes it possible to be in your apartment on Saturdays.
The location and building are good, but the rent in this area is sky rocketing

I truly love this complex, and I have enjoyed the location and attention for my needs I have received so far. The one thing I keep warning people about and have even told them to reconsider even signing a lease here for - is Fetch. Before moving here, I had no idea what Fetch was, and I did not think to look it up. It doesn't take much to look at their terrible reviews and look at the type of service you will receive. In this age, getting packages is extremely important as it's how people mainly shop and get whatever they need - they are extremely unreliable and since it's part of living here, it is the only reason I tell my friends to look elsewhere. PLease please please reconsider your partnership with Fetch, as it is the ONLY yet BIGGEST reason we have had issues living here. We love this complex, but I NEED to receive my packages.
The staff are very responsive and it is a great location.

I moved in here a little over three years ago. Joey, Who is an amazing leasing agent, worked hand and hand with me, and I was able to lease a perfect unit… I absolutely love being a part of this community… Security is great, and I have never felt safer… The staff is so friendly and helpful and the maintenance crew is absolutely the best. I am so grateful that I had Joey as my leasing agent and I have never been happier??

Please tour the entire grounds before moving here!  This place is absolutely disgusting. The cleaning crew on keeps the 1st floor clean which is where the tours are, the rest of the floors are trash filled and the carpet is always dirty. There is dog poop everywhere and the on the weekends, the entire place is a dump. I gave it a two star because I actually like the inside my apartment and it is a garage but beware because your car will get broken into if you’re not careful. The garage doors only work sometimes. There has been construction outside the entire time I’ve been here and now I’m seeing mice!

I truly regret signing a 2 year lease here and I’m only 8 months into my lease. I dread walking outside of my apartment, there is no telling what I will see. I regret moving here!

I have lived in IMT Prestonwood for about a little over a year and it has been great. It is a beautiful property and there are so many amenities I haven't been able to enjoy all of them. The gym is nice, the pool area and conference/ meeting spaces are beautiful.All of the residents that I have meet have been kind. It is a diverse community. Eventhough the property is not as handicap friendly,(how the parking is setup and my personal preference) the management and leasing agents have be extremely accommodating to make my stay here as comfortable as possible. Therr were a few changes I requested  and they sent someone right over to make sure I was comfortable. I put in a maintanace request, the turn around is that day or within 24hours, that is what I am used to from the previous apartments I lived in.  I am glad this is truely an upgrade!  Also it is a new complex so that makes me feel good that not that many folks lived in my apartment. I really appreciate the staff because in the year that I have been here I have had the chance to work with Joey as my leasing agent, Justice and Robert were always willing to help and last but not least Misty the property manager is amazing and I enjoy my new home in a new city. I absolutely adore the fact that they do special things for the residents from the time you move in and throughout the year. This year has been tough with COVID, by IMT has been really good about keeping the residents safe and informed. I have a neighbor that makes noise a couple times a month but, in 11 yrs I haven't been able to escape that. But if you're looking for an apartment that feels like home, gorgeous, safe, kind staff and in a perfect location,you should choose IMT Prestonwood! Every thing you need is literally 1-2 blocks away! I hope this helps!

Lets lay it all out CWS...

SAFETY: It's non existent. Been here for a year +. 5+ car break ins. Multiple Squatters. They didn't hire a security service until one of the squatters literally started a trash fire IN THE APPARTMENT AND HE STILL CAME BACK AND DID IT AGAIN.

RENEWAL: Must provide a 60 days or more notice before leaving. I received pricing for a renewal at 57 days. Math is not adding up surprise surprise. 

DOGS: My dog has been scratched, bitten, growled at by multiple other dogs. It came to the point of me having to bring him to the vet to fix his eye. Never reported it since reporting issues and incidences never go anywhere here.

MAINTANCE: Super nice guys however very slow response time

Please. If you are looking for safety in any form do not move here.

Moved here in June/July and there has been multiple break-in’s; one event had 30+ cars hit. 

Management is non-responsive to the concern from many tenants. They will also promise you things but nothing gets done. 

Many are already looking at breaking their lease because we have 2 entrances where people can enter, one doesn’t even have a fence at all! 

Avoid at all cost; much better options out there.

We have lived here for just over two months. Over 100 car break ins just in that time period.
Both of our cars have been broken into and my truck has been stolen straight out of the parking garage

There have been repeated issues with car breakins and the fence around the new building has not been completed despite months of mass breakins. My car along with 30+ others had shattered windows on September 6. This has been happening since at least July 4 and there is still no fence.
I love my yard and the community is great.
I love living at the Nash.  The apartment and community are nice and the location is great and convenient!

Do not stay here, definitely not worth it. This is an immoral property that will add hidden charges just to take more of your money. My move out day was September 1st, one day into September and they decided to charge me an entire month of community charges. They also have a major trash issue that is disgusting. I wish they had a place to attached a picture or video. I do not recommend at all!

They have 7 giant metal trash containers in front of the apartment that get picked up several times a week, most of the time around 6-something AM, but they also have occasionally shown up at 1:30AM and 4:30AM. The empty containers are literally dropped onto the street by the trucks, with an unbelievable level of noise  ... making you stand in your bed upright. The worst experience!

I think in the past, there were previous managers who were poor at communication, did not take care of facilities, or even care to help residents... I can firmly say that each of the office staff team care so much to help everyone. They respond to requests and concerns quickly. There are several ongoing projects that they have been working for to improve our community. I love our neighbors and I love being in such a sweet spot in the neighborhood. It has been such a great experience here! It's the best place my husband and I have ever lived.

There is little sound barrier between the unit above you and your unit. So all day (and for lucky old me, all night), there is constant booming/stomping/dropping/flushing/furniture moving/HIIT workouts/dancing/singing...I have no idea. It can make a person insane.  I'm not sure how I can stay here.

My Apt/Home is comfortable for me. 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms attached garage. I do not bother and so far I am getting the same return. Put trash & recycle outside the door, I guess it can’t get no better than that right now for me.
I’ve live here for a little over a year and just renewed my lease because I couldn’t be happier with my unit and the leasing team as a whole.

Outstanding and Professional Management makes Axis Kessler Park THE premiere location to live, work and play! Located in the booming and elegant Kessler Park sector of North Oak Cliff in Dallas, Texas, Axis Kessler Park is a superior living experience!
The staff here are incredible. I understand not everything will go smooth, and they are on top of their game to make sure you get taken care of.
Management Urgently addressed the issues with the apartment with GREAT respect & professionalism
Overall I enjoyed my home at Lincoln Kessler. Great community and awesome front office staff.

We signed a 15 month lease and after living here for 6 months we moved out in the past 7 months there have been 10 vehicle break ins with multiple different vehicles each time. The amenities hardly ever work. The trash at the complex is always over flowing and the hallways and mail rooms reek of the smell of trash. There are homeless people always getting into the building I have caught multiple sleeping in the building. Security is basically non existent they have Security but they don't do anything.

I have lived at Inwood Station Apts for almost 3-years now. Here is my experience
POSITIVE:
1) good location, close to all that Dallas has to offer and especially the medical district (Parkland Hospital, etc)
2) The interiors of the apartments are very nice, quality materials, on-trend finish out & some of the floorplans offer a really nice big, bathroom
3) The staff is friendly

NEGATIVE:
1) Location - be sure 'not' to take an apartment close to the dumpsters or Dart Rail. The Garbage pickup is usually on Tuesday morning at 3-4 am...yes no lie. Horrific noise of the dumpsters being empties and slammed on the concrete. I have complained for 3 years and management is yet to offer a solution
2) Management is at best "slow" ...they will reply to your request via email fairly quickly, but will say things like we are getting the hallway carpet cleaned this coming week. Then weeks pass and nothing happens. Follow up with them again and then it finally happens
3) I have lived in many apartments, but never lived in a complex where so many people come and go. The apt across from me, people move in, stay a month or 2 and move out. It is a constant revolving door. How this is permitted or allowed here don't ask me

Over the course of my year at The Avery at Southwestern, I have experienced both positives and significant negatives that any potential resident should carefully consider.  

**Pros:**  
The only notable advantage of living at this complex is the professionalism and efficiency of the office staff and maintenance team. They are responsive and helpful when issues arise, which is appreciated.  

**Cons:**  
Unfortunately, the cons far outweigh this single positive aspect, and the complex has gone downhill over the past year. The most concerning issue is **safety**. Towards the end of 2024, there were multiple break-ins into apartment homes, and throughout my residency, car break-ins were also alarmingly frequent. While the complex does employ a third-party security company, their presence is sporadic at best—often only appearing **after** an incident has already taken place. Given the price point of this complex, the lack of security and peace of mind is completely unacceptable.  

Additionally, **the value for the cost of living here is poor**. The apartments themselves are nothing special and do not justify the high rent, especially considering the ongoing safety concerns. To make matters worse, the complex was recently taken over by **Greystar**, a management company notorious for excessive fees and unfair charges. Upon my lease ending, I was overcharged for multiple items and am still in dispute with Greystar over these unjustified charges. For anyone moving out, I strongly advise reviewing your **move-out statement carefully** and cross-checking it with your **prior monthly statements**, as I have been incorrectly billed for recurring fees multiple times at the end of my lease. Also note that if you do have to communicate with Greystar for fees, etc. to expect to work with someone with zero competence and you’ll be waiting weeks for generic email responses. Phone calls are useless as no one will answer nor get back with you.

**Final Recommendation:**  
If you are considering The Avery at Southwestern, I strongly urge you to **explore other nearby complexes** that offer better safety, security, and overall value for your money. Given the safety issues, lack of consistent security presence, and questionable management practices, this complex is not worth the cost or the potential risks involved.
