Also, on one occasion I received an eviction notice on my door saying I had failed to pay my rent. I had not. Luckily I had a receipt. Apparently my rent payment had been applied to the wrong apartment unit. Instead of an apology I received a "well, sometimes these things happen". 

The apartment itself is nice. But with the poor management, terrible parking, and thirst for more money, it for sure is not worth it.

If you are looking for a roach infested apartment with no parking this is the place for you!! I’ve been here 2 months still haven’t guests over cause I’m embarrassed of al these roach traps and roaches still popping out! If you don’t get home before dark you will have to walk all the way across the apartment complex in the dark. Just don’t move here I know I regret it daily

This has been the worst apartment I have ever lived in. The turnover rate of the office crew is through the roof and noone ever smiles. This must be a terrible place to work, just as it is a terrible place to live. Its over price and small. Ill be glad when this is over. The Asst Manager is terrible. No manager on site.

The apartments and the staff are FAR below average. There are many options in the area with a more polite staff as well as better amenities for less cost. Advenir turns over their office staff as frequent as the tenants. Nobody resigns here for a reason - do yourself a favor; drive around the complex and ask the people how they enjoy living at Advenir. Each person will explain with frustration that they cannot wait till their lease is up.

I just want to say we have lived here for almost a year.  I didn't want to move to an apartment but we downsized to a 3 bedroom that is beautiful. It's very spactious and I love the layout.  On day of move in our A/C didn't fix but by the time we got back with the next load it was fixed.  Any repair we have needed (which have been minor) have been fixed immediately.  The office staff/management has changed since we moved in but everyone is still nice and helpful.  I never feel unsafe here.  Everyone that lives here is friendly.  The gate is broke and left open at times.  I have looked at a lot of apartments and have seen that you can easily get into a gated community so it is what it is.  Also, the trash dumpster has always been bad but that's because the people that live here can't put their trash in the dumpster.  Instead they leave it on the ground, at the door, making it hard for others to even walk in.  New management is trying to fix this problem.  Oter than that (and that again is the tenants) I love it here.

I was approved for an apartment, I've been told that I have to sign my lease before move in. They (Grace) has yet to send me my lease. When I call and try to ask her to send it she either doesn't answer or when she does she says she's going to send it in 10 mins. I've emailed . I think that she's trying to keep
Our money and is very unprofessional . Worst experience of my life. Pleaseeeeeee stay away!!!! Please. Yes the place is BEAUTIFUL BUT IT IS NOT WORTH IT !!! Worst management ever . I am writing a review on every site that I see!

They take months to fix anything in the apartment, no decent parking for residents, awful parking for guests on the opposite side of the complex.  Garage is 6 buildings away from apartment.  Claim all covered parking is assigned, been on waiting list for 2 years and loads of spots never parked in.

Now for the neighbors.... Security is a joke!  The onsite security takes hours to respond.  They offer no assistance for any issues concerning harassing people at the complex. Increasing number of residents who harass our friends when they come to visit, make so much noise at 3 am in the pool area.  I no longer feel safe here at night!

Cannot wait to move!!

I currently live here and I will talk to the things I like before I talk about the things I don't.

The layout of the apartment is great. I live in a 3 bedroom and it is 1600 sq feet! Huge balcony and great floor plan with space for everything I need. This is how I got sucked in...

The things I hate are as follows:
- Neighbors hear everything you do if you walk around or even sneeze (was harassed by neighbors for walking around)
- the ants in my apartment are INSANE! We have had ants in our kitchen for about 3 months.
- water pressure is not good and is very very low
- stuff breaks CONSTANTLY. Fridge handle fell off, dish washer broke... I've been living here for four months
- when stuff breaks, they are constantly "short staffed" and takes forever to fix.
- curtesy officer can be non responsive 
- they don't recycle, this is important to me but may not be important to some
- Parking is a DISASTER

Again I have only been here for 4 months so I am sure more will happen. Please, whatever you do, don't move here!

From day one, issues began. They had us pay for a remote that is supposed to allow us access to all the features we pay for, such as the fitness center (that is very lacking and limited in terms of equipment), the laundry room (that we can't use, so we have to drive elsewhere), and other such things. The remote? It doesn't work and they have done nothing to fix it. So there's that cash down the drain.

The gate to enter the complex. It doesn't work properly. Anyone can enter, so not safe. When you pull up to the gate, it doesn't open. But, if you pull up to the gate on the right, it opens the one on the left, so you better rush around real quick to make it through that left one.

Parking is terrible. The spots fill up to the point where there is literally no available parking in the complex, so you better pay for the reserved parking (that every other apartment complex I have ever heard of includes(if they haven't ran out of that by now)) because they will tow you. So if you can't get the reserved parking, just go park at a gas station and walk back (it's not like the quarter mile walk to your apartment from the complex parking is that much better).

The place seems nice in pictures, but that's the small community center that is almost always flooded with people who do not live there. The rooms themselves are very outdated and poorly maintained. A/C wasn't working, the apartments maintenance guy just said he could fix it. So bummer, Texas summer heat. Just deal with it I guess. The guy also came to "fix" the sliding door for the balcony. Didn't do anything. I also noticed some black mold (potentially the bad black mold) on the A/C vents.

All in all, a very crummy place to call home. Look elsewhere.

I recently moved into The Brix Apartments, and my transition was incredibly smooth. Supriya was there every step of the way—on the day I dropped off my deposit, the keys were in my hand, and my apartment was all set and ready for move-in.

I moved into a studio apartment, and I’m amazed at how spacious it is. I have all my furniture set up exactly how I wanted, and there’s still plenty of room for friends and family to move around comfortably.

I've now been living here for three weeks, and I felt it was time to write this review. I have rented various properties for over 15 years, and I can confidently say that this property deserves 5 stars. It is affordable, clean, and consistently well-maintained.

The management team is exceptional, and they meet all my needs through clear and prompt communication. Overall, The Brix Apartments has been perfect for me, and I highly recommend it!

I recently moved into the Brix apartment and have had a great experience so far! The responses are quick and kind, the move-in process was smooth, and the room is clean and comfortable (seems to be fully renovated recently). What is the greatest for me is that they kindly helped me a lot who came from a foreign country recently and are not accustomed to life in the US. I will be able to start my life in the US comfortably. Thank you so much.

The rent here is a great price for Dallas but it comes at a cost. The biggest problem for me is not having AC from November to April. In Texas. The apartment itself is what it looks like in the pictures minus the roaches. It took a couple of weeks of pouring boric acid everywhere to get rid of most of them. The laundry machines are decent but they're detached from the apartments and coin operated so mildly inconvenient. All in all you get what you pay for, but if I could afford to move out, I would like to.
Move in was simple and no complaints almost two months in

I just recently moved in to the Brix apartments from out of state and I don’t think this process could have been any smoother. Emma was monumental and making me feel comfortable and at home. I haven’t felt this comfortable this fast in a living environment before so mad props to the staff here!
I feelmso blessed with the service and the warming welcome this place everyone is very polite and clear, it defenetly is the best option.

These apartments are horrible. They want their rent money on time. Could care less if things are fix. They have people from corporate calling you for feedback back NOTHING still gets taken care of in a timely manner. Went like 2 weeks with no hot water. Do you think they took anything off our rent or anything no. I would recommend you take to some residents before putting in a application

Pest control would come and put a few clicks of a gel in the cabinets and move on. The roaches kept getting worse. My neighbor upstairs had the same issue. After months of constant complaining they finally had them come spray and we had to remove everything from cabinets in kitchen and closets and bathrooms. We stayed away for 4 hours per recommendation. Less than a week later, the roaches were back. Instead of them treating the whole building, they did the minimum. I complained again. Alex told me they would call pest control to have them bombed the apartment. We left the apartment and came back. Less than a week later, more roaches. We complained again. We went thru the whole apartment with tape sealing off all holes thinking that would help. We even taped around the sink and under the microwave because they would appear anytime I cooked. Alex said when the pest control came this last time, he would be with him to see what I was seeing. Did he come with the guy? Of course he didn’t. I explained everything to the guy what we had going on, what had been done, and how long we had been dealing with it. I had requested out of my lease several times due to this but that fell on deaf ears. While standing there talking to the pest control guy, here comes a roach crawling out of my cabinet. He killed it and said these were German cockroaches and the whole apartment must be vacated in order to properly treat it. He also informed me that they did not come to bomb my apartment due to the canisters that were used. The office had maintenance do it in order to avoid paying for it to be properly done. He said they were going to be fined for it. He said the level of infestation I had, I should just get rid of everything. He went to the office to report his findings and then I was told that I could end my lease. HOWEVER, they refused to let me out immediately of my lease and instead required me to stay 60 days AND charged a reletting fee. Are you people insane??? Well, needless to say, I am in the process of going to small claims court over all of this. I have the report from pest control (he was gracious enough to provide me with a copy) all my pest control requests, pictures, and email correspondence with management.
To be treated as though my complaints were not valid and then to penalize me for it is absolutely unacceptable. When I refused to pay anymore rent let alone a referring fee, they had the nerve to present me with a Notice to Vacate.

The tour apartments look great however if you walk the property you will find otherwise. You pay for pest and bug monthly yet they never treat your apartment. AC leaks leaving area soaked with water. Ventilation smells from other apartments. Several units have animals but do not have registration. Sever cockroach problems in several units. Avoid for price they are asking.

Long time resident here, this is by far the worst management ever here.  Constant year-long broken promises about fixing basic amenities 'next week'.  It took 9 months to final fix the laundry rooms,  where almost all machines were broken, only for half to be out of commission AGAIN within only 2-3 months. And the pools.... they were closed abruptly on Labor Day 2022 with promises all 3 would be renovated "soon"(one was closed already for 2-3 years). But instead of work over the winter,, it did not begin until early August 2023, right in the middle of a scorching 105+ degree hot summer... They are extremely insensitive to providing basic needs expected. They pour money into remodeling empty apartments, but can't even fix a cordoned-off gazebo with a grill. ... Previous management kept things fixed, held regular social gatherings. The absolute minimum is all you see here.

I moved in during June.  The AC was not working.  I would put in maintenance request after maintenance request about it as I couldn't sleep there due to it being so hot.  They would come quickly, but it wouldn't get fixed.  They would come and put this temp gauge laser thing to the vent to see what the temp was and then add Freon.  The head maintenance man said that he was sorry that so many in the complex are experiencing the same thing.  He said we add freon and most of the time it causes more issues but that is all he can do.  He said they buy cheap units and he could add a ceiling fan to my dining room.  That was put up there 3 months later.  They weren't going to fix it and wouldn't hire true professionals to do the repairs so I had to go buy a window unit.  I drove around the complex and saw that many people had to do the same.  Fast forward to the winter months... my Heater doesn't work.  I don't even bother to put in a request because not one item I have sent a maintenance request for besides the garbage disposal has been fixed so why waste my time.  Ive only had 1 functioning bathroom since I have lived there.  They have huge plumbing issues here and they don't know how to fix it. The stove top doesn't get hot enough to boil water on.  There are baseball size holes in the ceiling for 3 months and they still haven't fixed that.  The whole complex smells like weed and dog poop. Do you know how disappointing it was to move into a new apartment and from day 1 to have issue after issue with no resolution?  Needless to say I am breaking my lease and moving.  I feel like the next person moving into this same unit should know about the toilet, AC, and Stove before choosing it because you will never be able to live comfortably due to those things.  They shouldn't be able to get away with this. I can't even imagine how many requests went in for the unit I am at.  Nothing works properly.  There is no excuse for it.  It has made a difficult time in my life become worse.  There has been not one night I was at peace living here.  It has been very draining.  I can't wait to move and be at a place that is comfortable and actually feels like a home.  Its been 6 months of hell here.

I have been complaining about the Lexington apartments since your company took over all I get is excuses and work order request on my apartment that are half done or take 2weeks for someone to get to. In my years of renting on any property or property group never took longer than 3 days. I have a light outside of my apartment that has been out for months and I have 2 use my phone to get in my apartment when it gets dark. It has become a trashy environment and glass in parking areas I pay for trash service for it to always look like a junkyard. I think this company is ok with the bare minimum and the only reason I stay at this property is because of my child school. I know they try to cover up and put message after you write about them instead of excepting responsibility for their property.

Here's the facts, these buildings are run down. No and I mean NO insulation, water leaks and routine shut-offs, heavily plastered cracks in the walls, layers of paint over uncleaned walls and windows that leak air. It doesn't really matter what management team is running the show, the infrastructure and cosmetics are sad. At one time those qualities could be overlooked for relative affordability, but not anymore. Also beware of "extra" charges, your rent will likely be an additional $200 dollars for water, trash fee, valet trash fee, mandatory cable buy in and parking spot fee should you want to actually park in the lot. 

Expect band aid solutions. Actually just do yourself a favor and rent elsewhere.

The new company City Group that just took over the rental property is much much more fast and efficient in getting things done then the previous owners were. Within a week my leak was repaired and looks like nothing was ever wrong.
And they seem to take much more pride in how the outside of the complex is keep clean with the parking lot and grounds kept clean.
The staff is always friendly and try to call you by name whenever possible.

Mr.Huey

I like the Brighton apartment homes actually. Although, my move-in date was pushed back a day, every thing else has been pretty smooth. Now, I will say the things I don't like are that a $5 fee is charged when you pay rent because it's all online. They charge another dumpster fee on top of charging for curbside trash which I still am annoyed about. Also when I moved in, I was told I didn't have a car port & I did & had paid for it for two months... I filed one work order since moving in & I specifically said make an appointment with me before you go into my apartment & they completely ignored that. They just went in & did it. That was annoying too. The place is also packed with wasps & summer cicada bugs (look it up... the most annoying noise from a bug you'll ever hear). They have 3 pools but I was only told of one by management. Other than that, My actual apartment it self is great.

At first glance the apartments look awesome and well kept, the pool and office are well decorated and look modern, and the buildings were recently painted on the outside. However once you move into the actual apartment you can see just how decrepit the buildings have become. Inside the apartment you can tell everything has been painted over dozens of time. There is a very thick layer of dark paint on everything, and most of the wood in the cabinets is heavily warped. When I first moved in the lady that was creating and having us sign the documents misspelled one of our names on the contract so she said she was just going to change that one thing really quick and have us sign the new one. It would not have been a problem if she had not changed the move in date also to six months later so that she could get more comision. She also allowed my roommate to not have a co-signer if we added an extra 400$ onto the deposit. Once we left the apartment we were billed 600$ for carpet replacement and "Clean-Up" despite leaving the apartment spotless, our deposit should have covered the expenses to replace said carpet but they insisted that we did not place a deposit on the apartment at all. Upon leaving the apartment we had several months in which we did not live in the apartment. Once we got the bill for those months we realized our water and electric bills had not changed despite not using any electricity and not turning on the water faucet at all. My advice? avoid this apartment at all costs, they will jew you out of every dollar you have and spit in your face as you do it.

Unfortunately I recently had to break my lease due to health reasons because of my apt! There was a white substance blowing from the vent in my bedroom. It left a thick layer on my tv, armoire, and the wall. I also ended up having to change my cpap filter weekly. I even ended up buying air purifiers and it still didn't help. I put in maintenance request after maintenance request and the issue was NEVER resolved even though the tickef would be marked as resolved as if it was. After suffering through scalding hot water(when the water was not shut off), rent climbing over $200 because of all the extras, paying extra for so-called valet trash pickup,a trashbag covered hole in my shower for months, my heat going out, my a/c going out, my door lock breaking, 2 bouts with bronchitis, several upper respiratory and sinus infections, I'm done. Lord bless the next person that rents that particular apartment. I hope it doesn't make you sick.

This place sucks... the management is rude Nd unresponsive. The office is not open on the weekends which makes it difficult to collect packages if they are even delivered in the 1st place and the hot water has gone out 8x in the 9 months that I’ve lived here even though gas and water are included in the price of rent. I haven’t had hot water in a full weekend and the emergency line actually states that lack of hot water isn’t an emergency don’t leave a message they are working on it. The complex knows this is an issue and hasn’t sent any corespondents to tenants and because no one works in the office on the weekends there is no way to get any answers as to when this issue will be fixed.

I thought our apartments were going to be horrible but it was a huge surprise!!

We are in love with these,  not gated but they just hired security and they are doing a great job. Almost everything is papeles which is a huge plus for me, I keep copies of everything. 

You get what you pay,  we are lucky to have nice and quiet neighbors. No one messes with each other and everyone minds their own business. 

We are planning on staying a few more years than expected  ??

Work orders are never filled in a timely manner and not completed correctly.  The manager uses security for her own personal reasons and the office hours and online only payments are a hassle for people with real jobs.  The complex fines you for having the slightest trash on your balcony yet the manager can have a rotted boat and garbage on hers without complaint.  You would be better off homeless than living here.  And no, corporate will not hear out your complaints as they only care to collect rent, oh and yea the actual apartments aren't worth the recently raised rent either.  We'll be moving out at lease end.  8years here.
good place to live not to loud and the apartment feels roomy and cozy seems updated and great management.

Well the Brighton Apartments in Dallas, Texas on Meadowcreek Drive was great in the beginning.  Neighbors were nice, people picked up after their dogs, and the office staff was great!  They used to have this wonderful lady named Simone.   6 Months after moving in they got bought by a different company and it was a turn for the worse.  The office is only open Mon-Fri. which means you cannot pick up your packages on the weekend (they step out and close the office for lunch too). Our a/c has gone out DOZENS of times - good luck having your a/c fixed on the weekend in this Texas heat.  Another big issue is the kids out of school running around, screaming, riding bikes, and making loud noise by the pool.   Parking at this complex has been a lot better since everyone is moving out!   The biggest issues is the drug users and safety.  I took my dog for a walk at night and he sniffed out used needles in the bushes.  The cops came and confirmed that it was heroin.  Thank god they were capped!   I am moving out in September and wont look back.  With the termites and pests we have had rats on our patio, cockroaches in every room, and despite treating for it and having a cat they are still coming.   Take my advice and run!

Howdy y'all, looking for a great space to rest, and dig in some roots, well The Brightons are not for you. I have been living at the Brightons for 3 years now and have not enjoyed myself.  In the 3 years I have been here there has been 3 separate owners. So as you can imagine it hasn't been easy. Plus this is my first apartment, I have been lucky enough to have been in wonderful homes that I rented. I needed to down size so I found, The Brightons,  formally the celery stock. Then the Trinity properties bought them and made a good name change. (The Brightons) That's about all that was for the better. Next up the bus broom properties.  Let's just say I am moving in August. Between the leaky pipes that took them 6 month to fix, to the constant pests out of control I can't take any more.  I was going to give the new owners a chance but when I went in to ask about switching apartments in the same Brightons apartments they didn't give me the time of day. Of course until I found a new place then they tried to talk me into staying. Day late and a dollar short.

I've been dealing with constant noise disturbances from my neighbors, despite contacting the leasing office multiple times. After each complaint, I’m assured that the issue will be addressed, but it’s only getting worse. The noise starts around 1 a.m. and steadily increases, culminating at 6 a.m. when they decide it’s time to rearrange their entire apartment—stomping around and hitting the floor relentlessly.

I’ve had enough, and honestly, I’ll keep calling the patrol every time this happens until they get tired of it or until something is actually done. I understand that living in an apartment means some noise is inevitable, but these people act like they’re the only ones in the building. They should be more mindful of their neighbors.

At this point, I’m just counting down the days until I can move out. It wouldn’t surprise me if they end up causing damage to my apartment just from their constant stomping. It’s incredibly frustrating.

Do Not Rent Apartment 1001. My front door wasn’t properly sealed so dirt was constantly blown in. My living room flooded from the rain. My closet flooded so bad it cause mold. The closet was not usable for 5 months because it kept flooding. Their idea of fixing it was to dry it out with a fan which basically did nothing. The flooding caused a lot of my belongings to be ruined. Then there was the ant problem, which I even had some fire ants bite me at times. I would definitely not recommend living here.

I will start positively by saying when I toured and the entire time I lived here, Andi was a great person to talk with. She was always helpful, responsive and understanding. I do like the general look of the apartments and I appreciate having underground parking available for us. 

However, I would not recommend living here. The insulation between apartments is non-existent. I can hear the neighbors next to me fighting and screaming daily. I can also hear the people above me every time they walk, move furniture, shut a door, take a shower and so on. It's frustrating to say the least, especially when working from home and having to explain loud noises to clients. 

On top of the constant noise, there is always trash everywhere. People really don't care to clean up after themselves here. They even leave their trash right outside of the trash chute instead of actually putting it in. Lots of inconsiderate and lazy neighbors here. 

Next are the appliances. My dryer takes 3-4 times being run to dry one set of clothes. My washer has broken 3 times and is from the 70s by the looks of it. My fridge completely broke a few months into living here and was replaced and now the freezer is so cold it has ice stacking up everywhere and the fridge is so cold it freezes anything on the top shelf (even when we manually change the temp). 

Lastly, the constant building maintenance issues. The water is off, or there is no hot water at least once a week in the buildings. There is always something going wrong here. Definitely do not recommend.

I moved into a first floor unit at the Courts At Preston Oaks in July 2020.  I like the location and amenities like the pool and hot tub.  The roaches are intolerable though. They are everywhere.  The pest control company has been in many times to treat but without success.  I am also not allowed to transfer to a unit on a higher floor due to company policy.  I will be leaving as soon as I can.

RUN AWAY AS FAST AS YOU CAN. If I could give this place 0 stars I would. It has been a nightmare since the day before I moved in. The day before I moved in, they changed my apartment because someone in the front office messed up. That should have been a red flag to start. I moved in in the middle of August and my AC was not working properly for 3 weeks, my laundry machine was not working properly for 3 weeks and there was a leak in my refrigerator for 3 weeks. Finally, when I complained enough, someone seemed to figure it out. I have been here for 5 months and it has been an absolute nightmare. Recently, there has been water pouring out from my ceiling for two weeks. I work from home and I have had maintenance in and out of my apartment for weeks leaving my place personally unlivable. I paid $800 out of pocket for a Health Inspector to come to prove that this mold is toxic. Finally, it has been "fixed" and now the apartment below me is having a leak which is leaving maintenance to basically live in my apartment for who knows how long. They will not let you get out of your lease for mold or unlivable situations. They will NOT reduce rent for major inconveniences. This place is soo bad that I am going to pay over $3,000 just to terminate my lease early. This place is disgusting. Run away ASAP.

I get home from a late night of work and somebody is parked in my  assigned parking spot .. I call security and was told they called the office manager and she said that she didn’t want to tow the car because they would be upset .. excuse me I was upset because I have no place to park so remember fairness is not an option at the Courts. Now on to the weed problem it’s all over the courts  property being used  bought and sold here with  gang graffiti on elevator doors weekly  they paint over it but it doesn’t take long for it to reappear .. as soon as my lease is up I am out ..  neither one of these issues were a problem when I started  leasing   here 4 years ago   Things have taken a turn for the worse ..  The office staff not wanting to upset people  well other than myself because I follow all the rules..  .. has really hurt the  property and loyal residents are moving ..  I am the last hold out of all the people who have lived near me ..one lady was here  8 years she told me to go I am now listening..

The Courts are under constant repairs. Just in 2018, they have shut off the water 8 times. The elevators seem to break down a lot as well. The maintenance team and the office do not communicate well and it takes several tries to get simple repairs done. When it rains, the garage floods. The management seems very overwhelmed and at times hostile. The door to our mail box has been broken for weeks and has yet to be fixed. There are plenty of apartments in the same area with the same price range to consider before The Courts.

*Military Veteran Recommended
*Outstanding & friendly customer service
*Well maintained and up-to-date apartment complex

I've been here for almost 2 years now and I've seen some serious changes for the betterment of the community here at The Courts from the management and staff. It's truly refreshing to see if and when an issue arises, the management and staff expedite on getting it taken care of.

Yes, at the beginning my experience wasn't the greatest and I gave a review that wasn't the best during my first 6 months here at The Courts. That's now in the past and the credit for the changes that have taken place here at the complex is well deserved. So to The Courts at Preston Oaks management and staff... Thank you for all that you have done here!

Our lease is up in January 2018 and we are highly considering on extending our stay here at The Courts for another year if we are not into a home by then. Thanks again!

I don't understand how an apartment complex can be up and running for so long without having a shred of professionalism among the senior staff. They will welcome you with open arms and promise you a great experience but, as soon as you sign the lease, they will not even acknowledge you. The staff at the leasing reception is quite friendly and they try to be helpful. But, if you really want to move into this place, you should walk into the Asst Manager's office and talk to her as a resident. I have never met a person as rude as her in my entire life. Not only does she talk down to everyone, she is more egoistic than an accomplished nobel laureate should be. NALS really messed up when they put her in a public facing job. And the worst part is, she is the one with the final say about any issues you might have (which you will). If you want to live in a community with some peace of mind and an ounce of respect, walk right past this complex.

The apartments will seem perfect on your tour, however they will not tell you about the constant maintenance issues you will have to deal with.  The complex is on a shared plumbing system.  That means that anytime there is a plumbing issue with one of the units the entire buildings water is turned off for the day.  This has happened 19 times and still counting in just a matter of months.  No solution to this issue until they decide to invest some money in a system overhaul, which is never going to happen here.

The apartment itself if nice, the staff is very friendly, and location is convenient. However, the place is under constant maintenance. Since I moved in 2 years ago, emails have been regularly sent a couple times a month about another elevator being down or water being shut off again for repairs.

I really enjoyed the tour of The Courts at Preston Oaks. Me and my wife was very satisfied with the property and the professionalism that the staff showed. We definitely will move forward. Eddie Eskridge (972)754-9603 thank you

The Courts at Preston Oaks is a jewel is an otherwise bland landscape. Even the fact that it is built in the mid '80s, it goes toe to toe with more current complexes and surpasses them. Instead of rows and rows of cars baking in the Dallas summer heat, vehicles are tucked under the complex, just a few steps from your new home,  protecting them and keeping them cooler while letting large breezeway, garden paths, and community pools with BBQ grills grace the grounds. It's so inviting to stand on your terrace and see green grounds and clear waters. Open floor plans allow for sunlight (or fire light from the fireplace) to light your common rooms. And keeping the common rooms between the bed rooms allows for privacy at night from roommates or family. It's how I would build my home. I'm glad someone else did it first.

I have to say..........I REALLY LOVE MY APARTMENT!!!!!
Even though it is 1 bedroom, it is spacious with central air and a wood burning
fireplace.
Of course, there is a beautiful pool with occasional gatherings for the residents.
Maintaince is incredible!!  Most times, they come to fix things that day.
In the past, I have had one of the maintenance guys even hang some of my wall hangings!!!
Oh, by the way, I have been here almost 6 years!!

I moved in about three weeks ago and love it. Upon move in the apartment looked essentially brand new. Location is wonderful, it is about three minuets from all the restaurants and bars on montford and beltline. They are redoing one of the pools right now but the noise isn't bad. Work out room is kind of small but I never have a problem getting on machines I want to use. It is nice that parking is underground but kind of a hassle going in and out through all the security. There are two remote control gates and then I have to use access card to get in elevator room. Office staff is alright, I had some communication issues with one of the leasing consultants before move in, he would never return my calls. Lastly, I am lucky to not have my balcony face in towards the apartment hall ways. It is a very strange architectural choice and I feel bad for the people whose balconies/windows open up to concrete hallway. It would be unpleasant to open windows for everyone to easily look into your apartment and the noise of people walking and talking would bother me.

I lived here for the past 3 years overall I enjoyed it. they had a lot resident events and catered food a lot which I liked. Great sense of community. I have had a few service issues over the years but they were taken care of right away.

After living 2 years I ended up moving and am reporting their issues to the TAA.

I initially didn't want to move due to the convenience the underground parking and newly renovated gym. It was their staff that fell short in every aspect. The maintenance staff will need multiple notifications before they fix an issue. The management is overwhelmed with running the property. A maintenance issue that could have been fixed when it was first brought to the office was put off resulting in greater repairs.

This is a great place to live if your apartment does not have any issues or if you never see the staff. I would use caution when leasing here.

I don’t typically leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience to save others time and money. I would not recommend moving into East Quarter Residences. Despite being marketed as a luxury property, my experience has been far from it.

While I do appreciate some positive aspects, such as the excellent concierge team and the well-equipped gym, the negatives outweigh these by far.

I’ve submitted multiple requests for essential maintenance, including a malfunctioning touchpad lock and a dangerously tilted glass panel on my balcony. Both issues, which are serious safety and security concerns, remain unresolved.

On top of this, I’m unable to use the heat in my apartment, even as temperatures drop to 32°F. Every time I turn on the heat, all the fire alarms in the unit go off. Maintenance advised me to open all the doors, turn on fans, and wait 15 minutes—this solution has done nothing to resolve the issue.

The elevators are also frequently out of service, leaving me to climb multiple flights of stairs, and the cleanliness of common areas has deteriorated. It’s not uncommon to encounter dog waste in shared spaces, which is both unpleasant and unsanitary.

This property does not live up to its promises, and I cannot recommend it to anyone seeking a comfortable and well-maintained home.

I have lived here for 8 months.  I was beyond excited when I leased b/c I thought living in such a "luxury" building would be a dream come true.  I was so mistaken and so quickly disappointed in East Quarter.  Although the outside of the building is beautiful and the inside of the apartments are lovely - it stops there!
Where do I begin:  The elevators are constantly broken for weeks on end.  The communication in regards to the broken elevators is extremely rare as if we aren't supposed to notice we have ONE WORKING ELEVATOR.   There has been over 20 times I have waited 15 minutes for an elevator to then have it come and barely fit on it b/c there are so many other people waiting on the SAME elevator. 
The windows look great until you realize they are single pane, poor quality, and let every bit of noise possible in at night. There’s a constant drone of the highway at night, and you can hear every big truck that rolls down the highway - not sure how I missed this during my tour but it is absolutely awful/unbearable.

The parking garage gate has been broken several times for days on end.  The parking garage is filthy and is never cleaned or cleared of debris or spills.  It is so embarrassing when I have guests and they get out of their car to see a huge spill that is sticky and old.  I do not believe the garage has a porter as it is so filthy that half the time the mirrors are so dirty you cannot see traffic coming the opposite way.  It is so dangerous!

The hallways smell of weed 24/7.  The carpet in the hallways are stained and dirty almost daily. The trash rooms smell so bad and are rarely mopped with any bleach or anything to kill germs or keep the floor cleaned.  The floors in the trash rooms are so sticky and disgusting it is so hard to go in there.  At my previous property the porter mopped the trash rooms daily!  Once again,  a filthy poor maintained "luxury" building.

Now to the selling point...."24 hour Concierge"  - I leased this unit with the SOLE purpose of a 24 hour Concierge.  They took away our concierge from 11 PM to 7 AM about two months ago.  This is NOT what I was promised and not what I agreed to when I leased this unit/property.  They did not offer a concession off of the rent or anything to offset this for the residents.  They simply sent out an email "effective immediately".  So unprofessional and honestly criminal to do this when this was part of the selling point of this building.

The building is beautiful.  The onsite bar is charming.  Location is amazing.  The customer service and management are AWFUL.  Cars are constantly being towed.  Packages are stolen or just "disappear" while in the care of the leasing office.  If you request a call back from management, do not hold your breath.  The leasing agents and management cannot be bothered by your concerns.  They are often rude and apathetic to your issues.

I have been living here for quite some time now and honestly things have never been better since new management came in. Alexander, Jazmine, Amber and the rest of the team are beyond amazing in ensuring our stay here at VV&M is almost near perfect. I cannot thank them enough for bringing this property back to its former glory.

DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!! Live anywhere else. I have lived in several different apartments and this was by far the worst experience I’ve ever had. When we first moved in, our unit was filthy. We spent two days cleaning before we could even start unpacking. The complex is disgusting. There is trash and/or dog poop everywhere. Doors, gates and lights are always broken around the facility. While we were living here a sewer line burst and other residents let us know that some apartments flooded. I thought we were finally done with this apartment on move out day, but was shocked when I received a move out ledger for $830!!!! Even though I thoroughly cleaned my entire apartment…. Management attached pictures of my CLEAN apartment demanding payment. Additionally, they are demanding that we pay for paint even though spackled nail holes are considered normal wear and tear according to Texas state law. Lastly, we vacuumed our carpets (leaving them in much better condition than they were when we moved in) and they looked great! Management literally ripped up our carpets, took pictures of the undersides of the carpet and said we stained the carpets!!!! Are you kidding me?!?! We were so good to that apartment!!!! So beware!!! Even good tenants will get punished here. DO NOT LIVE HERE

I moved in on January 30th 2024, having booked my move-in date two months prior. Upon arrival, I discovered that my unit was not ready. I filed six work orders on the first day for issues including cigarette butts on the balcony, a clogged bathtub, missing blinds, broken light bulbs, among others. The most severe problem is the lingering odor from the carpet, which management admitted was due to the previous residents' pets urinating on it. They promised to replace the carpet last week, but they never showed up, nor did they send an email to update me on when they will address this issue.

I am paying rent for a one-bedroom apartment but have been living in the living room on an air mattress due to the smell of cat urine, without any proper furniture, for over 10 days. It's ironic that IRT, a publicly traded REIT company, has a property and asset management team that is so unprofessional and negligent.

If any staff member reads this review, could you please provide me with an exact date for the carpet replacement and any compensation for IRT's breach of the lease terms?

To any prospective resident looking for an apartment, I recommend looking elsewhere and trying to avoid IRT properties.

VV&M has been truly incredible.  From the day we first inquired on an apartment, to our smooth move in process, and even after being settled in - the whole staff has been so helpful throughout the entire process.  Jasmine and Ray in the front office are always so kind and understanding.  It's so reassuring knowing that if we need anything they are one call away.  We really have appreciated working with both of them because of their knowledge and expertise. I have lived in over 8 different apartment complexes in DFW and VV&M has been the best one yet.  We really enjoy our neighbors and the awesome pool!
It is a nice complex, in a nice location, with very nice amenities.

I loved the apartment but the staff seemed very rushed when giving me the tour and she did not show me any of the amenities that this complex has. She also did not email me back when I asked a question about a few more apartments.

I lived in the apartment for almost five years. I had a good living experience but also the most horrible experience working with the apartment manager and associates. The manager is rude, and not fit for the customer facing role. I had good experience with only one of the associates who was empathetic, thus giving 2 stars.

Andalusian Gate is a very good apartment complex.  If you put in a work order, they fix the problem right away.  The walls are solid, and you don't hear much noise.  They keep the complex clean.  The staff are nice and friendly. It is one of the best apartments I have stayed in.
Parking is horrendous. Third floor a/c is nonexistent

Everyone is so nice here.  When I submit a request its usually done the same day or the next day.  Depending the time I e-mail them.   Nice pool, and great place.  Been here a few years.  Everyone seems nice around here too.  Everyone says hello.    
The staff is great too.   Talk to them when I go in the office.  They do have great cookies in there too.  ;)
Amanda is bad to work with.  I would not recommend working with her.
Aparments are really nice,as nice as  it looks in the outside its the same in the inside. Always quite never had to complain  about any noice. Very well kept,always happy to come home

I’ve been at the Henderson for about a month now. I honestly love my apartment, haven’t run into any major issues, maintenance is fast and sweet, the pool has been available when I wanted it (although only 1 grill at the pool is kind of a crime), and overall I haven’t had any issues other than being originally mislead/ manipulated into signing our lease (the office manager Adam told us different rate than what was actually going to be on the lease and we didn’t find out until after we had signed). I would say this is great place to live if you want to be in the best part of Dallas city life!

The Henderson has been a nice place to live. The office staff is super friendly and maintenance staff is always saying hello. It's nice that the community is small. I have noticed that there are often beer cans/bottles around the perimeter of the apartment, though I know that is partly just the neighborhood. I also wish the gym was maintained a little more often. They are often out of wipes to clean equipment.

The amenities have been great and well kept. The leasing office communicates thoroughly regarding any updates needed. The space is more than I could ask for and recently updated. There were some creative choices that needed to be made to increase kitchen storage, but this was a small downside. The area is quiet yet still has a lot to walk to in terms of restaurants/outdoor spaces, and feels safe to walk at night if you have a dog.

Great community. They do strive to make things better. Since we have lived here they have improved the community. They improved the weight room, pool, general look of the complex, and the units themselves. Staff is very nice and take action of your concerns.

I have lived here for 7 years (with a 2 year gap). The best part of living here is by far the staff. It is a little noisy with dogs and cars on the street, but that’s normal city life. I live on the top floor and rarely hear my neighbors to the sides of me, nice and quiet.

I know rates are set by the market, but I do feel the rent is inflated, especially for the size of the units and the small amenities. I’m being asked to move units so they can renovate my apartment, and they should have worked with me to set a better rate and provide moving credits. As it is, they are only waiving my admin fee, which I wouldn’t need to pay if they didn’t make me reapply in the first place. So, I will leave The Henderson altogether for a close-by complex with a larger apt at the same price, more amenities, since I have to pay for everything else anyway. 

I do think it is unfortunate that the Management company will not work with long term residents. But the leasing & maintenance staff are great!
I love the Henderson! Maintenance staff and leasing agents are so friendly and helpful. I feel very safe in the building and love the area as well. I would recommend anyone to live here!

This is such an easy complex to live in. The parking garage, valet trash, autopay billing, plenty of reminders from mgmt about maintenancy things that go on, and Kristy and Adam in the office are super responsive, along with the maintenance team. It's walkable to so many places that I can spend a whole weekend without driving when I want. Love it.
I moved to the Henderson a few weeks ago and can honestly say I have no complaints. The staff has been so helpful and quick when answering questions as well as throughout the application process.
Dog park, great gym and awesome pool. Amazing area and neighbors. I always feel safe walking my dog at anytime. Plus great food all around and in walking distance!

Everything here for my first five months has been wonderful.  The few times I've needed maintenance, they are prompt and extremely friendly and helpful (very knowledgeable).  The neighbors are all sweet and tons of fun fur babies around (with responsible owners....yay!).  The front office has always been very helpful and nice - I mean zero complaints!  One of the best apartment experiences I've ever had!
We Love it here at the Henderson! The staff and amenities are great. Location is perfect, close to fun restaurants and shops. We have resigned for two years and are still happy
I love how responsive the management team is. Lots of care taken by maintenance, quick work orders, beautiful community. I appreciate the events as well.

We leave both our cars inside the property and both were broken into. The main door breaks almost every month and it remains wide open for a couple of days until they fix it. Also my wife got his bicycle wheels stolen from inside the property (it was chained to the stairs immediately under our apartment). We are not the only ones and this its been going on for at least 3 years. A couple of cameras would help and also just change that front door for once.

I've had my truck broken into 3 times this year and it's only June. Every time it's been in the parking garage with the gates that are supposed to keep people out which don't even work half the time. The first break in they stole my laptop. So I blame myself for that. Since then, they have been breaking in just to see what they can get. Never getting more than 5 or 10 dollars cash. I am not the only one either. Another resident just had 3K worth of equipment stolen from his car. I have asked several times to get cameras and the office just says they will fill something with corporate. They care nothing about the safety of their residents or the fact that thieves are just having their way in our parking garage. Do not live here if you have a choice! I'm moving out in 2 months!

I moved in 3 years ago when this apartment was a Lincoln property. A year later the leasing company was switched over to Greystar and it was downhill from there. They decided to redo the patios, which meant that a man with a sledgehammer showed up at 7am every morning to break concrete. Awesome. The man with the sledgehammer broke a hole all of the way through the floor in the unit above mine and through my ceiling which showered my living room furniture with bits of broken wood, ceiling and paint chips. Multiple emails and calls were sent and after those were all ignored I finally ended up cleaning up the mess left from this myself. They finally showed up a month later and repaired the hole which ended up leaking a few weeks later. After several weeks of catching water with a bucket in my living room, they came and knocked a giant(12in x 6in) hole in my ceiling to get at the leak. Shortly after that, wasps started coming through the open hole somehow (I sent pictures of dead wasps to the office). They came by and taped a trash bag over the hole to stop the wasps. A few weeks later they finally came out again and patched it, but did a horrible job, it looked like someone glued a maxipad to my ceiling. After more complaints they finally sent out another crew to fix that. It has started leaking again and there is huge water stain on my ceiling but I'm not dumb enough to call and have it fixed for fear of more wasps.

Summary: Its definitely a stretch to use the term "luxury". It is however, close to all of the places in Dallas you want to be near without paying a small fortune.

If you rent there, they automatically sign you up for a credit reporting service that costs an extra $10 a month. This is buried in lease addenda (about the seventh of those), and that fee is in small print in a bullet point in the middle of a page of text. What it also says in small print is that it is UP TO YOU TO OPT OUT IF YOU DON'T WANT TO PAY THIS.

How about letting people opt IN if they want to pay this garbage fee and otherwise keeping junk charges off tenants' rent bills???

Unsavory business practice!!

I did opt out, but of course only after having found the junk charge on a rent bill. The opt out process took me more than 15 minutes, because I had to first create an account with that service and give them a ton of my personal information.

Too bad they decided to do this, because otherwise this is a great community and the management is very dedicated towards tenants.

This complex will charge you $75 to apply and then tell you that your documents of payment stubs, bank statements are unverifiable and then not tell you why. They claim they use a third party vendor for the application and cannot provide answers. I am a home owner with a perfect payment  history turning home into rental and downsize.

This townhome complex will try to squeeze every penny out of you when you move put. They will charge you to paint the entire residence even if it was painted 1 year ago. They will send you to collections for charges that are not accurate and then fail to provide any proof they are accurate.

Lived there 1.5 years. Guests cars were robbed and staff did not care. Onsight "courtesy officer" is a joke. 
No guest parking anywhere but by the pool. Dog poop everywhere--no one picks up after their pets. The office staff has no idea what they are doing. When we moved in they forgot to charge us nearly $250 and didn't tell us until after we had lived there over a month. They water heater broke, and flooded our walls leaving mold. After replacing our walls (poorly) we continued to have mold. 
After cleaning the place to nearly spotless at moveout, they claimed we did not and charged $200. But their system is "down" so they cannot provide proof that cleaning was needed. Neighborhood is only going down. During our last month there, a lady was MURDERED 20 ft from our window in the walmart parking lot. We heard everything.

I would not recommend this property at all - the office staff is a complete mess and are untrustworthy.  They are more of a headache to deal with than what it is worth.  You can find better value elsewhere and avoid their crazy staff.

I went for a tour last week and the first thing I noticed was the great and friendly management. The apartments looked very clean. All the appliances are very nice and it looks like a very good place to live

I have loved living at Carrara! The facilities are so nice and the staff is very friendly and helpful. We have had very few issues and the minor ones are always attended to very promptly. I feel very safe living here also! It’s a great place to live!

Carrara is a great place to live. It is less than a 5 min walk to tons of restaurants, shops, Katy Trail and so much more. The staff is very nice and the place is kept very clean. The maintenance staff is also wonderful! 10/10 recommend.

Carrara is so great! The staff is amazing, always working with us for quick solutions to maintenance issues or other questions we have. The units are great, the updates are fresh, and there is plenty of storage. The parking is great (no creepy parking garage) and I am always able to find a spot. The location is unbeatable with so many walking-distance options for restaurants, coffee, shopping, and groceries! And I love how close is it to the Katy trail. Even being so close to all the activities, the apartments are quiet and feel like we're in our own little neighborhood! Would highly recommend!!
The price for this location is amazing. Steps from coffee shops, Trader Joe’s, and awesome restaurants. Right by Katy trail. Great size apartments with nice updates too!

We have lived at Carrara now on 3 separate occasions due to frequent moving. Every time we come back to Dallas we don’t even look anywhere else because the location of Carrara is just unbeatable. Living right on the Katy is awesome. The staff here is so nice and helpful. The landscaping is one area for improvement that we have noticed with the grassy areas being mostly just dirt at this point, but there are other areas nearby that have grass we will walk our dog over too. Overall would recommend living here!
HVAC units are really old and are inefficient. The pools turn into clubs during the summers. Guests limits are not enforced by staff.

I’ve lived here for almost 2 years and am still impressed by how attentive and responsive the maintenance team is. The complex is very clean and dog friendly, and Stephanie at the leasing office always goes above and beyond whenever you have a question or concern. Highly recommend.

I just want to point out in the amenities listed above that there are no w/d in each apt. There is a laundromat on each floor but every single one of the machines never work. So you have to revert to taking your clothes to a laundromat place if you don't have your own machines. Highly inconvenient and a real drag. The property has gone through some major renovations and I suggest they get new machines if they're going to keep breaking down. 

Overall the new renovations looks great. Its a quiet place, nice property, neighbors are nice and have very minimal maintenance requests. I give it a 4.

This complex is very well-maintained, and in a great location.  Although a bit pricey for the space, still very well-priced for the area, which is fantastic.  Walking distance to retail, bars, and restaurants from super high-end to Chipotle and Jersey Mike's.  Easy access to a gorgeous urban walking/biking trail.  Did I mention well-maintained?  When you put in a maintenance request it is nearly always handled that very day, by a friendly and professional staff.  Finally, a ten-minute drive or twenty-minute bus ride from downtown, even in the heart of Dallas rush hour, make this complex very hard to beat.

I called 6 times they never answer!!! I left multiple voicemails and nobody returned my calls!!! When they did answer I requested a virtual tour, the lady told me that she'll call me back but she never did, I called back after two hours and she said I have to wait for the manager to come back and to call after an hour, I called back multiple times they did not answer!!!!
9670 is an awesome property to call home.Marco and office staff are great they go above and beyond to make you feel right at home??

My AC has been out simce sunday. They have no emergency. I called I paid them a visit to find that I am not the only one without AC. I was lied to yesterday. By Alice that she would call tge "on call" staff to come look at the AC I told tge manager tuesday to put a window unit in she tell we have a lot of work orders and we are working on it. I am packing in this heat which makes me feel bad. They don't care right off from the start I really suggest that no matter how cute it look on the outside don't move here. At least you have to show some compassion just bc they are new here I am sure they should have experience. But this manager a d Alice the staff have no emtions shown or compassion about the fact my birds and daughter and me are in heat everyday.

My experience with Deerfield apartments so far has been an okay one. When I first did a tour, I was shown a model that would be similar to mine, but I didn't feel they were similar. I also have had a pest problem with roaches that is driving me up the wall. They have an exterminator come once a week, and now I see why. The roaches are everywhere! I haven't even unpacked because I'm afraid they will get in my things. The workers who finalized the apartment did a sloppy job. There are water stains on the sink cabinets and major noticeable flaws in the paint. I haven't really enjoyed moving in just because there are so many problems with the apartment, but I will say the staff is very fast and friendly. I put in a work order, and they were on it. They really just need better maintenance and remodel people and to get rid of these roaches once and for all! There are also no lights in the unit expect for a bathroom and kitchen light which bothers me, but not too much. If you are considering renting here, I wouldn't advise it, but I wouldn't tell you not to as well. Just know what you're getting yourself into - good and bad.

The best apartments I've lived In in a long time, especially for the location. Very peaceful environment..I loved the fact that you can have visitors without them worrying about getting towed. Vivian is Awesome Sauce and highly appreciated.Maintenance on time. Only issue was living room space.

This is the first time I leased an apartment, and wasn't sure of what to know when searching for one. Just searched for places near to my work place and with a reasonable price.

I'm so glad that I chose Deerfield. Been here for more than 10 months and hardly anything to complain about. When ever I had a problem, the work was finished the same day I send a maintenance request.
Amazing community! Staff is very responsive and reply very quickly. Thank you for the virtual tour!!

Even though all we did was tour this apartment, we got a good sense of what it would feel like to love there. Emma was extremely courteous and patient with us during our search.

If only the apartments you had available came with balconies :(
They’re so kind, attentive and make the move in process so easy!  The amenities are beautiful and the apartment complex itself is gorgeous.
I just signed my lease and I couldn’t be more excited. A wonderful community, clean apartments, amazing staff, and a great value for luxury living.

The staff is rude and talked to us like we were idiots, they charge you for absolutely every thing. We got basically none of our deposit back because of small things that should not be charged for. THERES ALSO ROACHES. We lived here for 1 year and saw roaches every single day in our kitchen. We had pest control come multiple times and it did not help. You could not pay me to renew here. Absolutely ridiculous.
Super amazing place, leasing consultant is super sweet and super helpful, and the manager was incredibly helpful. I have not seen such a clean and beautiful apartments before like here.

The people here are so friendly and always answer the phone. They work around your schedule and are very personable. They also work very well as a team together and it’s evident that they offer strong support for the tenants. Their apartments are very crisp and clean and modern. I highly recommend! Give Emma a call, she’s great!

I lived here for a little over a year and I loved it. Really quiet, safe area. Close to downtown. Inside is spacious and great hardwood floors and new appliances. The pool is really nice too. The staff is amazing!!

We just moved to the Dallas area this week and was in need of a quick move in. BellaVeux staff was so accommodating and friendly and got us moved in within 2 days. Staff is wonderful and truly cares about their residents. So glad that we stumbled upon them while driving around.

Very nice, great value apartments. The building layout is convenient with easy access to food and a nearby park which tends to be lively. The best part of this place is the staff. They are highly attentive caring people who make you feel home. So happy I landed here.
This is a fantastic place to live. I am so blessed to call this place home. I love the area, the staff and the quiet. Five well deserved stars from this resident!

I toured a 2bd/2ba and was very impressed. I love the fact that it is a boutique apartment community and that it’s so close to shopping and dining. The best part of this apartment complex is the staff. Both Emma and the manager worked quickly and diligently to ensure I was able to get into my apartment within the lease special expiration time (that was ending the day after I applied). They are great and will help you with anything you need!
Staff is great and helpful. Would definitely recommend living here.

BellaVeux apartments were nice and clean. Management was friendly, helpful and very communicative if there was any news that would affect the community. I only had one work order, and it was performed in a timely fashion. I thought it was also pretty affordable with the signup offer I used.

I love the property, and it is on the very top of our list, despite it being at the top of our budget! 

Me and me partner met up with Emma, who was an awesome tour guide, very friendly, and knowledgeable. I also met Gary(I hope I remembered his name correctly) the maintenance man! I love that it’s a small complex and everyone knows everyone! We haven’t finalized our decision yet, but this complex seems like a great place to call home.

I toured a one bed one bath at BellaVeux 7/2019 and loved this little home! It is a unique find in its attention to detail and welcoming/family atmosphere from the staff! I had to go another direction with my housing but would truly recommend considering this complex if you are planning a move in Dallas!

Country Greens is a great property and is located in a great neighborhood. A couple of minutes of Bishop Arts District and nearby great schools. The property is always cared for and the office manager always communicates quickly. I have lived here for years and have never had a problem.
Time of my life!  Best apartment I've ever lived in since moving to Dallas!  Lovely staff!  Amazing corporate office staff as well!

Love living here! Amenities and community areas are clean. Office and maintenance personnel are friendly and helpful. We have lived here for the last 2 years and has been the best apartment we’ve lived in.
Poor living conditions and even worse property management. Bad mix! Lived here for 4 years and ever since Broadstone left so did a certain standard of living and customer service.

So far so good ??. I hope the parking garage doors fence gets fixed. Vehicle traffic coming and going must share half of an entrance.

Staff is always pleasant and civil.
Everyone that works here is amazing! I love my apartment and being able to park my car in the parking garage with no worries!

DO NOT MOVE HERE. Your car will be broken into, if not stolen. Since we've been here this happened TWICE. This is sooo common in these apartments regardless if the gates are working or not. I'm beginning to think it's an inside job.

Security is nonexistent. Police cars are parked at the front of the building as decoration, not necessarily for security.

The apartments are nice in the inside but terribly made if you actually look at the construction. The building is not well kept. The garage is full of trash. "Secured" doors are not secure. The dog park is a joke. It's a huge field full of poop and prayers. Be ready for the fire alarms to go off at random times in the middle of the night.. With no fire and no explanation from management.

I requested a copy of my lease via email Aug. 15th. It's Nov. 19th and Mariela still hasn't responded.

I really tried to give this building some grace despite prior issues, but I'm so tired and ready to move. Thankfully, our lease is ending and we're not renewing. I do not recommend anyone to move here that values their property. I have never contacted my insurance so much since being here smh.

I will say Stacy has been kind but that does not outweigh the many cons that comes with living here. We pay our rent on time, everytime and would like to feel safe and not worry about it our vehicle will be damaged or even outside when we wake up. Invest into some real security.

And please do not contact me to discuss my review without resolution/compensation for having to file ANOTHER insurance claim. Living here has become a huge inconvenience.

Please consider this review and every other stating the same prior to signing a lease here. I wish I would've instead of overlooking them.

It’s comfortable and quiet.  Staff is pleasant and maintenance takes every request seriously.  The gate has been working more so I am very pleased about that.  Hopefully, I’ll have time to use the pool this year.
It’s noisy, drama, bugs, poor management, poor maintenance. I wouldn’t recommend nobody to stay here.

Management is not responsive, plumbing in the building is poor, packages consistently get stolen, and maintenance staff does the bare minimum. I'm surprised this place is still in business. I have requested a phone call with Reg. Manager Dan on several occasions to discuss the matter of your company falsely advertising that you have an on-site fitness center.  Dan replied to my 1st email with a dismissive non-answer, had property rep Jimmy call me, and has since refused any further contact. 
This is unacceptable for a corporation that presents itself as providing "better living" for tenants. I'm well aware that you are a for profit trust whose sole purpose is to make money for its investors. I am also aware of the investments that Cottonwood Res. has made in streamlining its cost and profit structure in order to maximize said profit and lower operation costs. This service to your investors does not absolve your corporation from its responsibility to provide the amenities and services available as advertised and as provided in your initial contract. 
To summarize my issue, I moved to the property in early March with the belief that your advertised fitness center would be open in early May. I was assured when I signed the contract that the facility was complete, and once security tech was in place, it would be open. It is now August and there is no fitness center. The onsite team has continued to tell me the same "waiting for security system" line as justification, but its clear that they just don't know.  The bottom line remains, your company promised something, I made a decision to rent here based on that promise, and you have failed to meet the promise. 
I understand that in the grand scheme of things having a fitness center is not a life or death matter, however, it was and is important to tenants like myself who have demanding schedules to have a place to get healthy.  I have a family and must be a frugal as possible when budgeting such expenses, so, I decided to live somewhere where the cost of working out was included in the rent. 
Ultimately, I find it disturbing that this contractual relationship is so unbalanced. If I fail to comply with a term of my contract, you can, and do, charge fees.  If you don't comply, I have no remedy aside from incurring the cost of moving somewhere else, but I cant do that without being charged an early term fee. I feel that its only fair that you, as the party that has wronged me (and all of your other residents) respond in kind with some sort of remedy and stop advertising a non-existent fitness center.

The countertops in the kitchen and bathroom are spray painted with a speckle paint and there is overspray on the windows and walls. I have quite a bit of hood damage on my car from acorns, but my neighbors have never dinged my car and I can comfortably enjoy time on my patio without being disturbed. I do have issues with packages from time to time.

If you can avoid having packages delivered to the office, having a car to park in the lot, or any questions that require you to contact office, then this place is great.

I have been at the District for nearly 3x years and have interacted with with several changes in management and staff. I have to say that the current staff at the district is definitely the highest quality I have seen in my past 3x years. They are very courteous and caring. For any reviews beyond the past year, especially those focused on the staff, it is my opinion that they are not as relevant as recent reviews. Believe me, I had bad experiences with prior staff but there's no reason to rant about it now when currently, they are great.

However, I cannot in good faith recommend this complex based on management staffing alone. Overall there is a nice lobby (recently renovated), nice pool, nice apartments, but simply the neighborhood is not good and can be unsafe.

A couple years ago, a colleague of mine who also lived at the District was beat up at night for simply being Indian - he was an international employee on visit and was very passive, could not speak English very well.

In my own experiences, I have had several packages over the years stolen from my doorstep. Just yesterday, a thief left a package at my door step, torn apart through each layer of packaging, and just stole the bare item inside, leaving some of the worthless accessories behind.

Additionally, it seems like a few times a year, the District sends out a mass email of a report of a car being broken into. People smash the windows and steal items inside.

Every year around the holidays you hear about reports of apartments being broken into or items being stolen.

The District's entry gate is constantly being broken - usually about 1x every month or two. During this time, the gate is simply open all day long, which defeats the entire purpose of a secure gate entry.

I can't blame the District's staffing, but I have to say that this is not an area I would recommend to live in. Find a more secure apartment complex nearby or be willing to commute a bit longer to where you need to go.

Unless extra measures are taken for a new and secure gate, or unless cameras are installed in several locations as a deterrent, then this is simply not an area worth going to.

I am happy I was able to save up and purchase a house. I can't wait to move and install a security system, so I can (hopefully) be less worried about all of these kinds of issues.

-Alex

I've lived in 4 apartments in the DFW area in the last 5 years and this one has to be the worst. Don't be fooled with the "luxurious" living standards they advertise on their homepage. The bedrooms don't come with lights or ceiling fans (management says: "Buy a lamp"), the thermostat should be electrical as stated online instead of mechanical (management says "you're apartment doesn't have gas, it's electric"), we had a pipe burst behind the wall behind our washing machine only visible when it had finally reached and flooded the floor below, when I received my bill of $190 I was given a credit of $100 when I've never paid more than $60 (management says "They should have been notified sooner").

Let's get real as long as nothing wrong happens more than likely you're going to love your apartment/house you're living in, that's why you choose to live there in the first place. The biggest fear you have is that when things do go wrong you can at least feel somewhat satisfied that there's someone there to help. Communication and common sense is no where to be found here within management, you have to physically go in and speak to a manager (they don't work weekends) and more times than not there's no one even in the front office (if they are always out showing prospective renters the grounds take that as a rent no one is renting (I sure should have)).

Eventhough I did see a lot of complaints (which I still don't understand why), I belive this apartment is worth of a lot of praises. I have my apartment facing the main road and by the exit gate. I love city life and this definitely gives me that feel. I was thinking I might have to move out when the time comes to renew my lease. However, the day I began living in it, I found myself admitting that I won't be able to find another better place than this! And a few days back, I ended up renewing my lease! Everything is reasonable- rent, utilities (by use), swimming pool is great but all I want to brag about is my apartment alone because of its location!

Ever since the last property manager left in February, things went from bad to worse.  The former property manager lived onsite which was a huge advantage.  The spa has been out of order since last winter, with no repair in sight.  The community garden is being promoted by office staff as a "free garden" for ANY resident to take what they want instead of the assigned plots that we have to sign up for and plant at our own expense.  They close now on Sundays and if there is a vehicle in your parking spot, the only one that can have it removed by towing is the property manager.  They constantly badger you about paying online and have removed the rent box in the office.  The new manager is very unfriendly and has fired all the employees that were there when she started.  She has cancelled all events and does not plan on having any in the future.  We are moving at the end of our lease.  It's too bad, it started out as a nice place to live back in March 2013, but now it is horrible.  The main grounds are dirty and maintenance requests are ignored on a continual basis.  Everything is online, why have a leasing staff at all if they won't help you in person?

I moved in The District at Greenville Oct. 2013. The stay started off very good. Hardly any complaints. As time passed I witnessed the inconsistency in the office staff. It became very difficult to speak to someone about any concerns. I was told I had to make an appointment to speak with the office staff. One thing in particular that I didn't understand is how they except rent. There was a email that went out that stated it was almost mandatory to pay rent online. If you brought a money order it would have to be the exact amount of your rent. Not a cent more or less. These things came to be very frustrating. On another note, my apartment was fine. I do think the walls are waaaaaay too thin. You can hear any little thing from the neighbors. But, the space is very spacious. The finishes in the apartment are decent. My apartment also came with a washer n dryer which was a plus. They are price well for the location and easy access to the freeway. The propert grounds could be kept a little better.
