The price on this particular floor plan is between $1100 to $1200, which isn't bad at all. Before moving here I looked at one bedroom (sq ft around 600) apartments and were about the same or more than this one.

Pros: price, washer/dryer included, location, beautiful kitchen, and spacious bedrooms

Cons: soundproof (can hear neighbors walking & talking), people not picking up after their pets, fitness center and Leasing Agents don't respond back in a timely manner.

If I could leave 0 stars, I would! This apartment has the WORST MANAGEMENT TEAM, they’re complete FRAUDSTERS! They sell you an idea of a luxury living with their amenities and aesthetics but the management is HORRIBLE and they also make you pay to use these amenities. I feel absolutely violated!

Don’t believe the 5-star reviews on here because they actually tell their employees to rate them 5-star and leave a nice comment. I would advise you save your money and go live somewhere else. The package system is atrocious! Packages have been stolen since they choose NOT to install package lockers and leave packages lying around in a chaotic mailroom. The hallways frequently reek of weed and aren’t cleaned often. Apartment walls are VERY thin. There’s no system to automatically allow delivery drivers to deliver directly to your front door. The front desk staff can be loud, unfriendly, and unprofessional at times. The gym and the aesthetic of the apartments are great though.

I’ve lived at Hazel for almost a year now and it’s been fantastic! The location on the tollway also means that I can get to my office in Uptown in 10 minutes. Couldn’t be happier with our decision to lease at Hazel!

Use to be a good place to live it has had 3 different owners in 8 years the last two have been horrible without a clue of how to run a complex process keep going up with nothing to offer no clubhouse no covered parking and the area is drug infested along with prostitutes truly over priced for what you get for your hard earned money

The property is so clean!  The office manager is as polite as they come and always smiles when you walk into her office! She's very transparent and knows her stuff!  The property is well lit at night so we can feel safe and the recent updates in each home makes it feel like luxury living without the luxury price tag. These apartments are so cute! The leasing agent (Sylvia) was so kind and communicated so well. She showed us around the actual apartment we would be renting! Conveniently located near major freeways and just a few blocks from downtown. Maintenance responds in a timely manner. Pricing: I’m paying a good $100 more than what I think I should for a non-renovated unit but it’s an APARTMENT — can’t win em all.

I moved in a year ago, to 4804 Haverwood Apartments. Was an incredibly kind, thoughtful and professional Manager. She had one assist when I moved in , but Umarris has been the awesome assistant. After asking for evidence, they provided a blurry photo of some minorly damaged carpet, and a section of carper that was brighter than the rest of the carper where the plastic carpet protector for my desk chair went. I personally am happy with apartment and really appreciate how helpful Maria has been with any questions I have!
Very friendly staff and nice homes in a great location. Would highly recommend.

Living here is such a cool experience. The management has always taken care of business, and been very polite. The lobby is beautiful and always wonderfully decorated.  Suwarni, Kaba, Joel are  very helpful and insightful. The maintenance (Dragan - best manager) is doing an amazing job keeping the community outstanding. The employees here are the best and it makes community much more of a home for us.

Last but not least, I'd like to thank Brandon  - property manager is  very professional and caring. Leasing tour, appointments, agreements and paper work etc.  are super fast & easy under Brandon's guidance.

If you never have to work with the office staff, you may be ok staying here as the apartments themselves are just fine. However if you do need the office staff for anything, I must apologize in advance. First, I don't have a local phone number, so they cant sync my phone number to their gate dial pad. Well when family, guests, friends come over, the answer the staff gave me for them was "we cant provide a gate code for you, its for vendors. They must walk to the back to get to your apt" Considering I live 500 yards in the back of the complex, better hope its not cold and raining or your family will be walking in the rain because tenants aren't allowed to know the code to their own apartments. Secondly, they provided a "friendly" notice to provide 60 days notice to terminate at the end of lease. They provided the notice less than 24 hours before we had to advise of decision to terminate. Then when it was turned in w/58 days notice, not 60, they said they would charge us for 2 days of rent. What company receives a notice 58 days in advance, after providing less than 24 hours notice AND STILL wants to charge you a fee. Good riddance, thanks for reassuring our decision NOT to renew with this complex

If you're looking to pay rock bottom rent in North Dallas, then look no further. Summit has great rates and even worked out a short term lease for me without increasing the monthly charges. Don't expect to have 1500 a month fixtures and amenities though. The cabinets tend to be a bit rickety and the appliances are a little banged up. The pool is dated, but is sufficient for laying out in the sun, etc. The fitness center is nice, but is small and under equipped. You must use the on site laundry facility, rather than an in-house hookups (costs me about $35 a month doing around two loads a week). I can't speak much on the management as I have not needed to deal with them very regularly, but they have been courteous and genuinely helpful when I have visited the office. I had a bit of a creepy bug issue when I first moved in, but it was resolved after a few weeks of pest control treatments. The tenants here are largely diverse with a good mix of families and singles. Some can be a bit discourteous (especially in their cars in the parking lot), but I have largely felt safe living here. All and all, I enjoy living here because I love bargains, and this complex is one. If you're willing to put up with a few minor conveniences, then you can save a good amount of money living here. If little things have a tendency bug you (pun intended), then you might end up being one of those ranting one star reviewers on the internet, so I'd advise spending a little more and looking elsewhere. Even if you aren't, I recommend checking out the other properties adjacent to this one. They seem similar in rate and might offer something different. I simply went with The Summit at Midtown because of the aforementioned short term lease arrangement. Happy apartment hunting!

This complex has been nothing but amazing. Close enough to get the big city feel, but far enough to get a suburban feel. With a fully suited fitness center and a nearby walking path, getting a good exercise in couldn't be easier. The buildings and landscaping are well taken care of, leaving an atmosphere of home and comfort.

The best part of this complex is the proximity to things in Dallas. The actual complex itself looks updated on the outside but the units and appliances are very outdated. Sometimes there is no hot water/ there are leaks in random places(put in maintenance requests, they are supposedly fixed but next storm your get puddles again). Also, if your neighbors cook something, your apartment might smell like whatever they cooked. If you really just care about proximity to downtown, major highways then this is a good fit. Mix of people at complex from families to professionals.
This property is really good and service is also very fast.

Just moved in this place. I love this place!
Very comfortable living here. Love the environment 
The manager and the staff are really kind and friendly 
Quick response! Been helping me with what I needed
Nice and clean
I just moved in here, the assistance here is top notch. The manager is very friendly and good maintenance culture. I love to live in  this apartment.

When I sign my lease. They promised me a remode apartment apartment ( stainless steel appliances and microwave included)rent was a little more but I okay. Now that I report the the microwave not working they just took that away. I called for explanation and manager said it's been removed so I will not complain about it again. Followed by "well i work here now".What a quick solution and explanation. I report the dishwasher she said " well it's fix" this thing is leaking water everywhere and it sticks. At this point I can't make any reports I not sure if they would really fix anything anymore. I can't ask any questions because both office staff hang up , and will not let me speak to anyone else.

I just renewed my lease, I absolutely love living here! What makes it great is the safety, calm community, the quick maintenance service provided, and the best management I have met, always greeting you with a smile, very friendly and they make me feel like part of the family, they always provide great solutions for any questions or concerns. Also I love the easy access to the freeway and several stores are nearby. I absolutely recommend living here if you have children, the school bus picks up at the apartment complex.
The place is clean and bright, friendly neighbor. The asian manager she is nice and answer all of my questions. I wish I known this place sooner, so I don't have to run around looking.

I moved in to this complex in 2022 and it was great. However, since the beginning of 2024, the quality of management for this properly has decreased dramatically. Amenities are almost always nonfunctional. The security gate has been broken on and off for months. The front office is unable to keep the pool open or properly maintained. Management is so bad at dealing with pool noise complaints, they are threatening to shut the pool entirely rather than deal with specific residents who are noisy after hours. Communication about issues and closures is minimal at best. I had to constantly hound the front office for my renewal at the end of my previous term, and I wish I had just moved somewhere else instead. Do not move here, you can do better for your money. Two stars because maintenance is exceptional, otherwise I’d leave one star.

The apartments are huge and well maintained by their dedicated maintenance stuff Milton,Victor ,Sergio . Our stayed in Wimberly apartments was peaceful and Comfortable. This property is close to many stores, outlets and mall. The property Manager Jaycie and her team is very attentive to address all the concerns of the residents.

Lived here for 3 years and there was already mold in my apartment from day one. I now have developed health and respiratory issues that have made me go to the ER twice. I nicely notified them about the mold before moving out and didn't get any response at all. Then I asked if I could take a swab of the mold for a lab test just so I could have better luck of treating my medical issues by knowing specifically what kind of mold it was. They wouldn't allow me in the apartment even with a manager accompanying me. Very bad business practice, they do not care about the health of their tenants. They will probably fail to do mold remediation once again and rent the apartment out to another tenant to get sick. Tried to work with them nicely, but I am now considering a lawsuit at this point.

This is the most accommodating complex I have lived at, the manager Jaycie has been super helpful due to a power outage issue caused by outside sources. She has gone above and beyond to help us during this stressful situation and made us feel more comfortable during the uncertainty. Highly recommend for the amazing customer service !!!
I recommend asking for Latonya she was great and very accommodating. I love my apartment, very spacious.

So to preface, I don't usually write reviews, let alone for the places I live. But I've recently had an experience that I just knew I needed to write a review for. Due to an issue with our power meter, we lost power for nearly 5 days. Throughout that time, the apartment manager Jaycie was SO helpful to us. She went out of her way to make sure we were okay and that things were moving along smoothly until our power was back on. Jaycie, thank you so much.

Now, outside of that situation, Wimberly has honestly just been pretty great compared to anywhere I've lived. It really feels like the staff care about the residents. Maintenance comes swiftly, never had any issues with packages, the property is about as clean as you can keep an apartment complex. I think my only issue I have is that parking options can be pretty slim if you're coming home late at night.

This review was written 3/20/2023, so please keep that in mind.

Thanks for the great 9 months so far Wimberly, looking forward to more :)
I lived here for a few years and recently moved out.  Great place to live.  Good amenities, safe, nice neighbors and management team is top notch.

Really good apartment location distance wise to many places around dfw. I feel like we're close to the middle. Anyway the bad... The first I should point out is the noise. Close to Lovefield, Dart rail,another train rail w/ some random train that passes by around 2a.m. (train horn and all) and all kinds of emergency vehicle sirens. I can live with it, its just whenever I visit someones house I always realize how quiet the neighborhood is in comparison. Patio fencing is made of metal bars w/ no privacy at all. So nobody hangs outside their apartment except for smokers. It'll be a year before you see your neighbors. Parking is wrapped around the edge of the property so you have to go around the entire place just to get out (god forbid you forget anything lol) We've been having security for awhile and even though I leave for work every weekday at 230 am he still mugging like if I stole the car. Hmmm..... The good thing is very responsive matinence. Fix that problem in a couple of hours or less! I pointed out mostly bad things because these apartments are way better than the neighbouring ones. Very safe knowing what goes on around here...

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review:
Do not apply here. Waste of time and money.
My experience with this apartment complex has been nothing short of a nightmare.

Red Flags from the Start: I initially overlooked the warning signs due to my urgent need to find a new place as my lease was ending. Despite being assured by my locator that no appointment was necessary for a tour, I was abruptly told upon arrival that an appointment was required. Never have I been denied an apartment tour. This inconsistency was a glaring indication of the disorganization and lack of communication within the management team.

Inept and Unresponsive: The application process was a disaster. The website failed multiple times, and despite leaving several voicemails, I received no response. It took several attempts to get someone on the phone, and when I finally did, I was promised a call back that never came. Miraculously, my application finally went through the following day, but the frustration didn’t end there.

Ridiculous Verification Requirements: After submitting my documents, I was initially told that only my tax forms were needed. Given that I earn mostly in cash, my tax returns don’t fully reflect my income, but I was assured this wouldn't be an issue. However, when we followed up regarding my partner’s information, we were given the green light, only to be told later that his employment verification was unacceptable because it was sent from a Yahoo email account. The demand for an HR email from a small business that doesn’t even have an HR department was beyond absurd. I have never had this much trouble with income verification. Bottom line if you and/or your partner make cash do not apply here.

Uninformed and Unhelpful Staff: Dealing with this management team has been the worst experience I've ever had with an apartment complex. The application process dragged on for more than week without any clear communication or resolution. When seeking assistance, I was met with a barrage of “I need to check with my manager” responses, revealing a complete lack of competence and autonomy among the staff. It's clear they are neither trained nor equipped to handle basic inquiries.

Bottom Line: Save yourself the time, money, and headache. This management team is unprofessional, unresponsive, and incompetent. The numerous negative reviews are spot on, and the positive ones seem suspiciously fabricated.

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review: Applied weeks ago, called with no answer. Management repeatedly tried cancelling my application without reason. During the process, they requested my SSN in person and made a copy, which felt unnecessary and left me uncomfortable. Look elsewhere for a more transparent and professional apartment experience.

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review:
It looks nice but it isn't! Over Priced places and hazards. 

They care more about remodeling their office than taking care of other important things. I have lived here for almost a year, and when I went to move in, my supposedly remodeled apartment  was repaired due to the entire unit being flooded!

 Not only that, on the move-in day, they had cleaning crews trying to clean out black mold from the refrigerator, the door knob fell off the next day when I was trying to move stuff into the apartment; and the washer they provided filled all the way up and wouldn't drain! The whole apartment needed to be cleaned from top to bottom when I moved in. 

They have admitted to having no maintenance at all! They don't pay people enough to stay around. Almost all my windows have 2 to 3 inch gaps in them where heat gets out and bugs get in. Old maintenance people who left said multiple buildings have that issue and that the owners will not pay to install new windows! 

The dishwasher has never worked; it had old, moldy food in it and filled up with water the first time it was turned on, and it took them almost two months to come look at it! They replaced it with the equivalent of a Wish.com one, and the water also doesn't drain.

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review:
This property will not allow you to sleep at night without thinking your car will be broken into eventually.
Doors and gates around the complex don't even work, please do not live here if you want to feel safe when you sleep.
Apartment break ins have happened as well.

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review: Management is awful!! No one ever answers the phone  at the leasing office and it requires multiple emails/messages to get in touch with anyone. AC went out and nobody would answer for DAYS to give an update about progress. We went without for a week, but there are units at the complex that haven't had AC for months. Gates for building 24 were stuck open for over a year and were still not working at move out 9/14/23. Building 24 & 25 haven't had mailboxes since November 2022. The complex is aging and not being maintained. There are better complexes for the price.

apartmentName: Gateway East at the Arts District
review:
I have had the absolute worst experience with management at this complex. I have not had A/C in my apartment for nearly a month now. It's been 107 outside and 95 degrees in my apartment. I work from home and this place has basically been unliveable. I've put in maintenance request after maintenance request and they will say they're complete when they aren't or they will "fix" the A/C, it'll get down to 76 for a day and then go out again. I've sent probably a dozen emails to management - not a single one was replied to. I've gone into the office to speak to them and they say please send an email to us. Are you kidding me??? This is all on top of my fridge not having been working for 4 months and was never replaced, ruining all my food. My car being broken into, and management not doing anything about it even though it was on camera. Toilet leaking for weeks and not being fixed, causing permanent damage to the flooring and wall. The building is so old that the air leaks and my energy bill is through the roof trying to heat or cool, if it does. The amenities being out of service the entire time I've lived here. And yet, I'm still paying an absolutely absurd amount of money for rent.

I can go on and on with problems I've had in the months I've lived here but that won't matter because not a single issue will be addressed anyway. All I can do is warn anyone else looking to move here of my experience

Over flow of trash. Maintenance need to be micro-manage to ensure requistions are completed in a timely manner for the tenants by keeping two books (Work requistions, completed) so he won't forget to come back. Everyone in the office do not communicate on the same level when tenants give a certain person information effectively to others in the office to help the tentant. I found this out two days before I left from other tenants that it was a common thing that occurred often.   Beside that, the complex is a good community to live and the office staff is a good fit for the complex, very supportive. I thank Kim and Kareen for their help.
the location is central to the freeways,the property is maintained and the community is basically quiet.
I recommend this property for affordable single senior living that's quiet and comfortable
I would recommend this property because it is well maintained and maintenance is prompt,courteous,and knowledgeable
The community is quiet, peaceful, attractive, and affordable compared to other apartment communities.
Everything about this apartment complex is great. Keep up the great work.

Security gates didn't work for the 2 years I lived there and strangers roamed the hallways and parking lot at all hours. If you move in there you'd better make sure to keep your door locked at all times or someone will try to open it and come in to rob you. It has happened many times. Doors are also kicked in and bullets come through glass doors and windows. If you like loud neighbors and loud parking lots with loud cars and stereo systems this is the place for you.

I've been here 7 months and I have been disappointed in my experience. They tout themselves as a luxury building, but there is nothing luxurious about it. All of the amenities are broken or in a dilapidated condition. Currently the phone number to the office is disconnected. That was not great when all of the elevators in the building went out of service two nights ago. This was not deemed an emergency by the overnight maintenance call center. When taking the stairs 8 flights down, I found where a homeless person has been sleeping in the stairway, along with puddles of dried vomit and urine. We have received no communication about the phone number being disconnected or who to call if there is an emergency maintenance issue. When I asked for contact information for someone who does not work in the local office I was told they couldn't give it to me and I just got a random generic email address and phone number. The gate in the parking garage has been broken for months. We received one email on that about a month ago saying it would be fixed soon, but it's still broken. The callbox/key fob reader at the front door goes out constantly. They constantly bombard my email with the same 4 generic messages, but seldom communicate relevant information. They will tell you that big changes are coming, but they won't tell you what they are, or when they'll be here. Oh, and forget about getting packages delivered here. You have to use the service Fetch Packages for deliveries. Just check out all of Fetch's 1-star reviews to see how well it works.

The staff in the office was pretty good at first, but once the two leasing agents I used to deal with left, it's gone down hill. I'll give the staff the benefit of the doubt and assume that Sentinel does not provide them with the tools, budget, and training they need to provide the advertised service and amenities.

The actual unit is fine, a little dated, but I enjoy the space and views. Most of the residents I've met are friendly. The location is good. Humberto on the maintenance staff is great and hard working. I really appreciate him and his work.

I love the location of the building and my unit, but the Sentinel management team onsite is utterly terrible. Consistently- they have been rude, condescending, and irrational. In the instances in which I have had to interact with the Team- it's clear that their negative attitudes starts from the top down; they witness how awful the manager speaks to residents and follow her lead accordingly. As a paying resident/ their customer- it's unacceptable, and I have had to get Corporate involved on more than one occasion. Additionally- the team members that live onsite do not follow the community rules- specifically with regard to their own pets. If you are looking for a welcoming environment with kind staff- keep searching, this place is not it!

I currently live here and regret signing my lease. Management has change since. I would give this place a no star if I can. Cars are getting broken into and stolen on the 7th and 8th floor. The stairways are occupied by the homeless. Front door is not secured. We are supposed to have security but nowhere insight. Mailbox are always broken into. Marijuana smells through out the building and seeping into my unit have to cover all vents. Parking gate always broken. Management doesn’t give out memo on situations of what’s going on the property. At this point they just want to collect money. Do your own research and talk to the tenants. Worst place I ever lived.

I won't say this property is the worst.. but it is VERY dirty and outdated. When I first toured, i was promised lots of cleaning and upgrades. Not much has really happened and everything is pretty dirty. 

Worst Parts:

Dog pad upstairs is very dirty/stinky, doors are broken, hallways don't get the best cleaning, parking garage is very dirty (especially the hallway and stairwell between the two)


Check out the drake stone next door, very clean and great specials.

Dirty. Dirty. Dirty. The floors hardly ever get mopped, the walls are nasty, doors have grime on them from years of build up. Some door handles are missing and some are broken. Lights out everywhere through garage and buildings.

STAY AWAY. Things have been really bad at these "luxury" lofts for quite a few months now, but a new management company, ZRS, took over about 2 months ago, promising to make improvements. Long story short, they have NOT. In fact, things have gotten WORSE. I'm sure they will reply to this review with their typical "we are so sorry you are having a bad experience, please come talk to us in the office or call us so we can address your concerns." Here's the thing though, almost everyone I know that lives here has been down to the office multiple times since ZRS took over and brought up the many issues, and all they do is make excuses or say they are working on it. 

The biggest concern with Third Rail is safety, something that was brought up to ZRS the moment they took over. Homeless people often find their way into the building and sleep in the stairwells. Building "security" sits and texts during a night shift, instead of patrolling the building and keeping out trespassers, as they are supposed to do. Both of these things have happened within the last couple of weeks, well after ZRS took over and had a chance to address safety concerns. (I have pictures but it won't allow me to post them.) 

On to the "amenities." Nothing works. The gym is extremely outdated and honestly pretty disgusting. The internet cafe that is supposed to have free coffee never has cups. The cable in the internet cafe does not work. The theatre room's projector is broken and does not have cable like it used to have, only a blu ray player. And get this, after coming in and promising to make things better, ZRS has decided to start charging by the hour to use the theatre room and the "wine" room which is essentially a big room with tables in the basement of one of the buildings. A group of us residents were trying to rent out the wine room to have a Friendsgiving and the office then informed us we would be charged to use it, despite never having been charged in the past. After some push back they agreed to waive the charge, but told us moving forward there would be a charge. I want to reiterate here that this room they are charging residents $50/hr for, to hangout with other residents, is a large, outdated room with tables. No TV's, no couches, no windows. Just a room in the basement. Also, they gutted the bowling alley and pool room upon taking over.

Don't do it.
Gross, dirty, and loud. Should be called “ROACH Trails Apartments”. YUCK!

I live in RedBird Trails in Dallas Texas. I've been here for two years and I work from home so I see and hear everything. They are quiet and most of the time there is no drama or anything like that. Tina is the property manager and even though she comes off a little hard she always gets the job done. The apartments are reasonable on pricing and maintenance is PERFECT! You can call about a problem on Monday morning and they will be there professional and efficient. Molly and Yolanda also work in the office. They are always pleasant and professional. The apartments are big and spacious. Come see us! They are some of the best for their area.

I have been here only a few months and its beautiful. My neighbors speak and we watch out for each other. The staff is friendly and heplful. Our maintenance workers do what needs to be done in a timely manner. I like the fact that its close to my children school, they can use the computer room after school to help them out with their homework. Red Bird Trails Apartments are in a nice location, close to resturants and shopping malls.

I’ve been here for 7/8 years and it’s been a rocky road but new management and new building improvements are up to date now and Yolanda at the front office is very understanding and will work with you. The new front desk employees have great attitudes. They’re very nice! The tenants and neighbors are friendly & neighborly.

Apartment was filthy upon move-in and live and dead roaches throughout the apartment. Visitors must pay $4/day for parking. Gate is only app controlled; there is no gate code access. Office staff and maintenance seem nice, but the apartment unit is NOT renovated as shown in the model unit. Floors are uneven in my “renovated” apartment. Walls are thin. Blinds were broken in my “renovated” apartment. Maintenance simply put new blinds over old ones. I continue to see roaches in the apartment even after pest control came. My dishwasher doesn’t fully open in my “renovated” apartment and has a horrible smell. Paint splatter throughout apartment. Apartment was formerly named “Plum Meadow”. Please review those reviews. They appear to be more accurate. I regret moving here.

Update: Still have roaches. There hasn’t been a week that’s gone by that I haven’t seen a bug. They replaced my dishwasher with an older dishwasher that has a horrible smell. I’m afraid to use it. Every week I have to submit a service request for something in this “renovated” apartment. This week it was a leaky faucet, balcony falling apart, and pests. Maintenance is nice, but just paints over cracks and holes and there are countless problems.

Management and CEO don’t care and put residents in uninhabitable units.

I scheduled a tour in December and was shown a nice 1 bedroom. I thought this would be an okay place to live. The paperwork provided had typos all throughout it. My room given was horribly painted and the flooring was uneven. The balcony felt wobbly and had major cracks in the cement. 

I feel like I have been lied to, so I do NOT recommend living here. The apartments are supposed to be renovated, but it looks like they are covering all the major problems instead of fixing them and making those apartments look more livable.

I would highly recommend this community  to anyone looking for a very nice and quiet place to live. Ms. Natasha and Ms. Maria are always very helpful willing to  go that extra mile to make sure things are in order. The other ladies in the office are just as wonderful.  They are professional caring and down to earth.  They are renovating and everything is so nice. When ever I 
needed Maintenance  there was no hesitation they came right on. With all that said, my husband and I are very happy here. Thank you to The Paxton's Staff.

first i never got to do a walk through in the apartment that management was leasing to me.  I got my apt keys on Oct 8th, which they stated i would be moving in on Oct 7th.  Anyway, when i went into the apartment it was disturbing.   I feel like management does not walk through the apartment with the staff to ensure the apartment is clean and ready to be leased.  the living conditions are unacceptable and management , maintenance and the people that do the make ready should all be replaced.
The place is horrible and the staff doesn’t care about its tenants . All they do is lie and don’t fix anything . They have the worst attitudes which is weird since they don’t do anything .

Do not rent here. I have lived here for many years and the management rotates all the time. The area manager is not a nice person. She is actually the one who makes all the decisions on everything. They overcharge on late fees. They are eviction happy people. The property is always full of dog poop and trash. Loud music all hours of the night and day. The pool is only open when they say it is open. The laundry rooms are nasty and 90% of the machines do not work. Many apartments are full of roaches. They don’t even treat mold issues. They have hidden mold behind cabinets, etc. I do not recommend anyone suggesting living here.  I give 0 stars to this place.

Good location,  property not well maintained.  Very hard to get maintenance out to fix problems.  But, maintenance is good when they come.  Laundry facility has no working washers.  Completely outdated appliances

I recently moved to the Doral Apartments in July 2022 and do not have any complaints. The office staff was nice and assisted with all of my questions during the application process. They also assisted with any issues I had immediately after moving in
Not recommend at all! Its bad all the way around. Maintenance is horrible! Office workers don’t help with any problems that occur in, out, or, around the premises!

I would only advise renting if it is your last resort. I had to move to Dallas because of a natural disaster and needed something fast. I will be moving soon and would not recommend. The staff is extremely unprofessional. It is hard to get someone that understands mid to complex issues that arise. I’ve been hung up on several times when calling about maintenance updates. I haven’t had my apartment numbers on my door since I moved in and get a different story every time I call. Oh and the roaches, my God! I’ve NEVER in my life had roaches but here I am, spraying literally everyday. I’ve tried everything and they eventually come back.  You will also have to pay $5 for every guest you have or their car will be towed. Needless to say, let this be your last resort.

When we moved in they were very strict about having every single thing ready and in order (understandable) including the fees and information of our 2 dogs. Now all of a sudden we get letter at our door saying we have 2 unauthorized dogs and are wanting to charge more fees. This was left on a Sat leaving us only 24 hours to discuss this when they are closed on Sunday! .. Very upsetting . Definitely thinking of leaving when our lease is up. Let alone the customer service in the office has always been very unprofessional, no clear communication between workers, and bad attitude towards Tenants.

The apartments have rats and they never fix anything the blinds are dirty and the windows are not secured.. the rent office is terrible and the maintenance me. Don’t fix anything and they be shooting at night time.. they don’t keep up the grounds and they hire people in the apartments to do security… trash all over the property they need to really close these apartments down honestly nobody has made a difference yet at the property they switch management like it’s nothing

I’ve been living here for a year and it’s been nothing but trouble.. Two people nearly died infront of my apartment, my apartment was robbed twice management communication is poor all they care about is money.. not a safe place for kids to be shootouts almost every night and there’s a rat infestation at the back of the apartments and roach infestation in all buildings DO NOT MOVE HERE!!

The people were kind and nice to speak with, but the property itself was terrible. There are hornet and wasps nests all over the property, and cracks under the doors. We had cockroaches crawling underneath into our apartment. There was evidence of water damage in the "newly renovated" apartment which left us wondering about the health and safety. Drawers were missing tracks and we found hair and rice stuck in the cabinets from being painted over. I left something by my car for 2 minutes and when I came back it was gone. I didn't feel safe there. There were also numerous issues with our lease with us eventually just leaving.

From out of town looking to move in the area & I Called an scheduled a tour and was told to come in to see the apartment but once I got there I was told that there was nothing to tour and to check online. I don’t know about the inside of the apartments because I didn’t get to view one but the neighborhood was nothing I was interested in once I got to the property.

I called to schedule an appointment to view an apartment and was told to hang up and schedule the appoinment online (very annoying since the lady should have been able to see what was available while I was on the phone).
I went to the Mountain Creek Apartments website and there is no place to schedule an appointment. 
If setting an appointment to view the apartments is a hassle I can only imagine what it would be like living there. 
NO THANK YOU!

First of all the units are offered with a garage because the parking is so bad that if you do not have a garage you may not have a space to park.  Every month the property is trying to offer a new service that is extra money for us if you choose.  The leasing team is wonderful but the management is not so much. The property does not stack up to the wonderful pictures on the website mainly due to lack of cleanliness and insect control issues.

0/5 stars apt. management is absolutely incompetent. Maintenance is just the same. Pests are everywhere. AC units are broken in almost all the units. My partner and I just moved from Austin and are so lucky to call this place home!! We were looking for a great deal and our expectations were surpassed here!!
Darian, who works in the front office is one of the nicest, most supportive, and professional leasing agent we have ever worked with. He made the process comfortable and smooth! He definitely needs a raise!!
This property is clean and very well maintained. They have a strong maintenance team. We also have an app forum where the community can communicate and keep each other updated. The community is very friendly and respectful.

Not only did our ceiling collapse from water damage, the foundation of the building was shifting during our lease which lead to cracks in the floor. To top it all off, they took our security deposit and added an absurd number of fees and repairs, none of which were necessary and all of which were exorbitantly priced ($100 to resurface a bathtub that is in the same condition as when we moved in?). The residents are great and the maintenance workers are top notch but the management team is zero stars.
They don't even care about your problems at all. They even blame it on you and you have to move out or pay for the violation.

Management does not seem to care at all. Forced several people to move out due to foundation repairs leaving them homeless. After move out, several charges for damages were given for things that were not damaged such as carpet replacement and tile resurfacing.

The only people who should even be considering living here are students, and if you are, I highly suggest you look elsewhere. The management is constantly making billing "mistakes," and they do not communicate in any way that could be recorded. If you can even manage to find their email addresses, they do not respond. They do not have a website. They do not give receipts for payments or move-out notices, and they use that against you. Be prepared to get eviction notices for not paying a bill you've already paid. First of all, the management. I feel like you should have the mental capacity greater than that of a 6 year old to manage an apartment complex. They've given many people eviction notices for being 2 days late on a trash fee. They lost our rent payment, twice. They are completely incompetent and when you need information or clarification from them, they are not only useless but RUDE. The new management is horrendous and needs to be fixed. The one manager literally wears slippers to work and knows nothing. I've never been treated well by them and they KNOW they can take advantage of us because we're college students
The maintenance situation is a joke too. We've had multiple urgent issues that took weeks to fix and still have others yet to be addressed. 
Oh and they hire fake police officers to shut down our parties.

The management is a hodgepodge of people who have no business being in the business of hospitality.  They talk to you like you are a third grader, and have no consideration for their residents.  They will do the best the can to sell you on all the "new" updates, but the apartments are still a sinkhole with a poor foundation.  Our stove was broken since we moved in.  We filed work orders for months until we went into the office and demanded that it was fixed.  Instead of fixing the stove, the sent a notice that they had fixed the stove on a day that I had been in the apartment all day.  That is to say, the stove is still broken as we move out.  The only reason they can get away with being this inadequate at their jobs is because Tower Village is the only affordable apartments around the University of Dallas.  If you can afford to live somewhere else, do it.  I would rather sign my soul to the devil then sign a contract with Tower Village Apartments.

The staff is so rude and they will ignore your calls and emails until you show up at the office. If you work 8-5 you're screwed! the roof leaks the plumbing is trash . and you have to pay rent via an APP, yes you read that right, and once you pay your first months rent they will smack monthly facility fees and other previously unknown fees and tell you you're late on rent because of them. I DO NOT RECOMMEND MOVING HERE!!!

The apartments don't even have light fixtures in the rooms; you have to buy your own lamps to brighten up the rooms. The gate is always broken, no use of a gated community. We used to have Irving PD patrol the facility,  but now that the apartments are under new management,  we have no security. The water bill is always high, and the rent jumped 20-30%. New Management doesn't work with you, and basically wants you out! I have been living here for the past 3-4yrs, and worked well with the old management company, but now things are changing and getting expensive. For them to bump up rent, you would think the apartment would have W/D connection or at least light fixtures in the rooms,  but nothing! I ignored all the poor reviews and moved in here. My roof (in half bathroom) leaks and has mold. I've called in several times and it has not been fixed. On a good day it will not leak but it's such a mess. Our heater does not kick in and out by itself. It has to be on the whole time for us to get warm. There are holes under our windows and light bills are always over $100. What's the point moving in here to pay for high bills and no proper maintenance.

If you do not mind all the amenities that come with your apartment breaking or how you will be sleeping with cockroaches this might be the place for you. The staff is awful , and the gate always breaks more than half the time its just open so what is the point saying its a gated community. It is not a safe place to live and there is trash everywhere in the street. I will never suggest anyone to ever live here!

The staff is always so friendly. Love how everything is close by. I like that it's an isolated residential community with no unwanted guests or extra traffic in the area. Tower Village is the most affordable for the amenities provided, along with a sense of security. We are satisfied with our move in process and are enjoying our new place!

These apartments are great if you like flies in your ceiling lights, cockroaches under your bed, hornets at your door, and an apartment that cannot retain the A/C. I must not neglect the incredible staff that absolutely hate their job and only offer assistance if you walk into the office and say you've called 15 times. Or the diligent police officers that seem to be making an appearance to your neighbors every other weekend.  If your style of living sounds anything like this, then you've picked a real winner. Best of luck, it's best to sleep here with one eye open.

I’ve been living at Bent Tree Park for a while now, and I’m honestly really happy with how things are going. The office team, Seth and Art, are super friendly and always make sure everything’s running smoothly. They’re really responsive and always willing to help when I need something.

The maintenance team is on top of things too – they always take care of requests quickly, and it’s clear they are constantly improving and keeping the place looking great. The entire property has definitely been looking better lately, with improvements everywhere!

The dog park and pools are always nice and clean, and the fitness center is a bonus, especially the membership to the Addison Athletic Club. It’s just a great place to live, close to everything in Addison but still feels peaceful. Definitely happy I chose to call Bent Tree Park home!
You deserve better. Do not move here. Every company they contract with are scammers.

Pros: The square footage to price ratio. Close proximity to restaurants and shopping.

Cons: The lack of professional management regarding many issues with units containing roaches, water leaks, damaged foundations, inefficient electrical components (ex: stoves, fridges and outdated air conditioning systems). Not to mention the dusty air ducts that provide little to no cool air. I recognize the absence of maintenance staff but the property itself is poorly maintained.

These apartments are horrible in every sense of the word. The apartment management is terrible, they never communicate properly, are frequently out of the office, and never offer solutions to the issues you are facing. I experienced chronic bug issues from the very first day I moved in - ants, roaches, millipedes, pill bugs, etc. I contacted the apartment management multiple times and they never provided adequate solutions to solve the issue.  The apartments themselves are in terrible shape. There are cracks and gaps around every corner and seam inside. The buildings are so poorly constructed that many patios and staircases are sagging and appear unsafe. The apartment building next to mine caught fire and almost burned down completely. The walls are so thin that you can hear absolutely everything your neighbors are doing. The community is not great either, many people don't pick up after their dogs or themselves. There is dog poop and trash littered throughout the entire complex. Once again the apartment staff seems to not care or put any effort into maintaining the grounds. 
Unless this is your absolute only option, please never move here.

I think Bent Tree is a very nice looking apartment complex. I applied here, but unfortunately, the application process is pretty broken. The main gripe I have is that my leasing agent has still, even after a week and a half, never actually responded to a single email I've sent.

I admit I perhaps called a few too many times checking in on things, but I would not have called in every day if I could just get a response and an update on where things were.

I did not actually get all of the documents required to apply on the first email I was sent. I also wasn't given full instructions on how to make the app fee payment.

I sent in my documents, and I called to see if I was missing anything. I was told they didn't receive the email (though later it turns out they did, but they never responded back and said so).

I called in again later to get information on how to make the app payment. I made the payment and sent them an email with the payment confirmation as directed.

I still did not get an email letting me know the information was received, so again, I had to call them. I was told that they would work on my application.

I then called back the next day to see what the next steps were, and they told me they had earlier moveins and would process it later. I could not get a firm time on when I could expect my application to be processed.

I later called and asked for a manager and was told that they would work on getting me a response so I would feel more at ease. I still did not receive an email.

This process has been broken and I'm out $350 for the application because it went into a black hole. I understand that they have other applicants that they have to work with, but I have to get movers ready, get packed, etc, so I have to know if I'm approved or not. If they had just emailed me once or twice to let me know where we stood I certainly would not have called as much, which would have ultimately saved time for both them as well as me.

I would not recommend this place unless you are desperate or you have a very long time for your application to be processed.

I’ve lived here for two years the first year was okay. Once we signed the second year everything went down hill. We had roaches coming from the baseboards, fire place etc. They “called” people to come spray the apartment but they didn’t help anything so we had to buy things to help ourselves. We were calling maintenance so they can come out and fix issues but they never came so we had to fix things ourselves. Office people just lie and make up things as they go. They always have a new person that works there. The gym is complete trash, they don’t fix equipment. Just don’t move here!!

I have lived here for less than a year and am counting down the days until I can leave. The property is old and falling apart. The AC units cannot keep up so be prepared to purchase your own additional AC unit just to survive the summer, and I mean barely survive, it took both the in unit AC and the additional new on to keep our apartment under 80 degrees. The ant problem is relentless and unstoppable so keep your apartment stocked with pest killers. The parking is minimal and guests will have to fight for a spot after registering their vehicle or they WILL be towed. Oh and the covered parking structures for paying residents... they routinely collapse during storms, atleast three have fallen onto parked cars since I've lived here including my own. The property managers don't really care and it's on you to fix any damage and then hope and pray it doesn't fall down again after the guy they hired comes with his 2 sons(?) and uses old bricks and 2x4s to jack up the structure, then proceeds to spray paint over all the rust damage on the metal poles...really reassuring... The amenities are minimal and also don't work half the time. Currently there is one working laundry room for the entire complex and there is no time frame for the other one to be fixed so you can take all your laundry on a nice walk across the complex and hope there is something available to use. The "dog park" is unkempt and filthy, the gates don't even close anymore so if you have a small dog they will escape, and while the property claims to have dog breed restrictions, they are not enforced like most of the other rules. Residents are allowed to smoke on their balconies or patios which is essentially just as bad as smoking inside, which I know happens because othe residents make complaints constantly and the response is an email that kindly reminds us all of the rules.... super helpful. And currently I still have no hot water after 2 days of it being off and on, they said it's on but I beg to differ. Save yourself the stress and problems.. go literally anywhere else.

Man this is as E A S Y as it gets ! I called and Trisha answered the phone right away. She asked a few detailed questions about my needs and then invited me into her office. I really like this apartment tucked away from all the hussle of the city but yet everything you need within a 5 mile radius.  The staff is so friendly and helpful, Trish the manager helped me and was so sweet!
Prices are good, staff is pleasant and work orders don't take forever to be addressed. Resident events have been enjoyable.

The Best Maintenance Team Ever. They Do An AMAZING Work. I might also Appreciate  the Magnificent Management Team. Nothing Like It. Love All. Great Place To Live.

When my wife and I moved into Pebblebrook it was nice enough, the area is nice here in Rockwall and the neighbors are courteous and quite. These points remain true till this day, but there are some drawbacks here. 

First of all there are foundation shifts that lead to new cracks in the walls every so often and cause certain doors to no longer close, which the front office assures me is not dangerous and has just patched over them. This strikes me as a temporary solution that does not address the underlying problem. A brick fell from our building and smashed into the walkway for goodness sake.

Secondly, the rent no longer has the water bill included so the rent has effectively increased. Also, the covered parking is very narrow, larger vehicles will have trouble fitting.

When my wife and I moved in the basic floor plan was $750 a month including water. I can not recommend paying more than this considering this floor plan has no washer/dryer hook ups and foundational issues. At least the neighborhood and people are generally a plus.

Been living at Pebblebrook for over 2 years now. The neighborhood is nice and quiet. The apartment buildings themselves are outdated and showing their age. Inside is okay. In my opinion, the rent is a little high for the quality of the apartment - but I like the location. Appliances are outdated and only one floorplan offers washer/dryer hookups. 

The office staff is nice. Maintenance is okay. Most of the time, if you have a work order, they don't notify you if they're coming to your apartment - they just kind of show up whenever. Doesn't bother me THAT much but it would be nice if I got notice ahead of time - since I would like to know when people are gonna be entering my home. 

Overall, this place is nice if you're just moving out/having a first apartment. Like I said, the neighborhood is nice. It's close to the shopping centers and the high school.

General review:
The apartments are a little older and slightly rundown, but it's still a great place to live. I rarely have problems with neighbors and they look nice for an aging apartment complex. The girls in the office have been there for a while and are extremely helpful. 

My only true complaint about the place is the traffic in the area, but it's not a huge deal. It's a "little" pricey for what it is, but Rockwall is an amazing place to live. You pay for location. I would recommend this place for people who are just starting out together

Side note:

There is a Braums that's within walking distance which has a small grocery (It's ridiculously convenient, plus the ice cream is nice).

If your two 13 gallon bags are not balanced perfectly on top of the bin that fits one, if you don't have it out or in by the times that keeps changing, if you can't make it home from work in time to make one of the new times (one of which is currently a 1 hour window from 5 to 6pm), be prepared for a $50 fine each and every time. These are the two current issues, although there have been others, which is sad, because the area is nice, the apartments are well priced, and the apartments are comfortable. We're sad to not be renewing our lease.
