Many desirable weekends, large groups would bring their own large speakers/DJ and blast explicit music to where no one else could enjoy the pool. Again, thank goodness we didn’t have a pool-facing room. 

We had several maintenance issues throughout our stay, including the above neighbor’s washing machine flood their apartment into ours, damaging our rugs and laundry supplies — so much so that we weren’t home when it happened that the residents BELOW us reported it because theirs flooded as well. We also had all of the outlets in the living room area malfunction and stop working (including the only spot available for the wifi to be plugged in, and I worked from home at the time), and it took a few days for them to repair whatever damage occurred and finally leaving a mess of dust and drywall under all of the outlets. 

All that to be said, we thought we escaped this place when we moved out, only to be hit with a massive bill afterwards. The fees we were hit with are outrageous. Not only did they take away our entire security deposit and pet deposit ($150 + $250), but we still apparently owed $128 on top of that for 'blind replacement and damage', which of course they had no proof of.

This property has a serious problem with the fire alarms going off. Literally at least once a month at 3am. I’ve lived here for a year and there’s been no solution. 

Also - the garage is very narrow and cars speed through it regularly. There are no cameras, so if your car gets hit the leasing office will tell you to call the police and figure it out on your own. (I know this by experience)

If you want little to no sleep and to consistently worry about your car - you should totally live here.

Honestly it took a month to be approved that was the longest part and only issue I had no they don’t like to answer the phone all day so you would have to apply in person there is a long wait list and it be best to check in after a month of being on the lift to make sure u don’t get skipped but the property itself is new modern and luxury style like apartments and stainless steel appliances a nice play ground and pool and dog park  I would only recommend it to people who aren’t in a rush to move because again there’s a wait and they only have a limited amount of space as well as workers ..

Came here today and they said they was closed but online says otherwise , so I decided in and there was 3 workers who still didn’t acknowledge my walk in and still said they was close ! Bad first impression!!!

Having come from the property management world, I would like to say that my experience here has been outstanding thus far - Lincoln has a superior team here at Courts from office management to all the maintenance folks (Caeser, Juan, Memo). I couldn't be happier and thank you!
You really need to update the windows. They are not energy efficient at all.    Other than that, so far, this is a very nice place.
We did not want to move but was forced to move because management wanted to remodel our apartment.
I have told all my friends what a great place it is to live.
Always professional, courteous and knowledgeable in getting things fixed and resolved.

So take my review with a grain of salt, could be diff management, but it was still hands down the best property I lived on. Quiet. Well built. Beautiful walkable property. My only complaint was the A.C. Our unit was a 3 bedroom, and our ac kept going out, that’s the only reason we moved, but it’s still my fav place in dallas. Just unproblematic.

I've lived here for 14 years, the management used to be very friendly and helpful. Now they cycle through staff at record speed and don't expect them to lift a finger. They are lazy, unskilled, unhelpful, and won't get anything you need done. It's a complete joke. Other things to note, the property is unkempt, trash literally blowing down the breezeways. Pool furnishings haven't seen an update in 10+ years, the chairs are falling apart. Front gate is broken about 50% of the time. The units themselves have a nice layout, and the rent is reasonable which is why I'm still here. But every time I have to deal with the staff I am more determined to leave this place forever lol.

apartmentName: Village Oaks: A Dallas Living Experience
review: Very quiet, low key apt complex. Maintence is always on top of there job. Owners are very helpful along with leasing agent. Great spacious condo..

Thank you to the new staff that is very attentive to the property and residents. The new manager and maintenance have made such a big improvement in little time. Connie and JJ are great and take care of our needs and request.
Poor communication, pot smoking neighbors, loud at night, different property managers, bad smells in apartments. Cheap rent but you get what you pay for.

This property advertises as renovations throughout. The unit I was given was not renovated, smells terribly, is not well insulated or sealed. Allows for insects and noise pollution. Has expectation that if something needs repair you will pay cost IE air conditioning and a high electric bill, water leaks and higher water bill and has no regard for the excessive fees. Prior management gave ill informed costs and can no longer be held accountable to them. Any issue raised defaults as it being “an old property” Do not move here. All rennovations are purely cosmetic.

Pros: 
1) Rent is super reasonable for the area. 
2) If you call, they usually pick up. 
3) The maintenance guys are really nice. 

Cons: 
1) Lots of turnover. During the 2 years I lived here, there were four apartment managers: Hagit, Alma, Dominque, and Christie. During each transition, maintenance tickets got lost. My downstairs heater died in December, and it took over a month to fix. The downstairs toilet broke and it took over two months to fix. I moved out in May, and didn’t get my deposit check until August. If you want something done, don’t submit online and don’t leave a message. Just keep calling and emailing the office until it gets done. 
2) The units within each building share air ducts, so if your next door neighbor smokes pot or cooks lasagna, you’ll smell it. And if the next unit over gets painted, you’ll smell paint fumes in your place for days.

Hector the new manger is absolutely amazing! He took my friend and I on a tour of the 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom apartments and I just have to say he was such a wonderful person. You can tell he truly cares about this community and is passionate about what he does. The apartments are absolutely stunning with their old charm and historic vibe. 

Thank you Hector!

Do not move in

They advertise a gated community but leave it open all the time. My vehicle has been stolen and after it was recovered it was broken into. They do not care to work with residence feeling unsafe and targeted.

Son la mejor opción, y la Atencion es la mejor.

El lugar vale la pena

I went through a hard time recently.  Lost my job and everything.  Was falling behind on everything and the office staff went above and beyond to help me out with whatever they could. For that I am so very thankful. Great community to live in everyone is very friendly and get get that hello neighbor vibe. Maintenance is always quick to respond.

I've lived in two units. The first unit was infested with roaches and they moved me to another unit (with a higher rent). I was told by a neighbor that I was probably the 3rd or 4th tenant in that unit within the past year. Did they know about the roach infestation? Probably. 

The apartment complex will come back and say that they did everything they could to resolve the issue, which is asking pest control (which I already pay for) to come by and spritz and leave. They fumigated the unit, but when you're dealing with a building infestation, that does nothing. A proactive step would have been moving me free of charge and paying for movers. Instead, I had to resort to asking friends and shelling out my own money for THEIR mistake. I also had to pay another deposit that was eventually credited back to me, but ... another stressful step in a move that could have been prevented with better customer service. 

After moving to the 2nd unit, the heat/power for the entire building went out on Wednesday, 2/10. WE ARE STILL WITHOUT POWER. I've called and left emails, and all of them have gone without a response except for the one phone call where I was told they're "working on it" and another where I was told the "poor electrician was there for over ten hours the other day"!  They should have been updating us every single day. Instead, my neighbors and I have resorted to driving and checking on our units ourselves, just to make sure it's not submerged in water. Yes, we are all dealing with the effects of this winter storm, but it's your JOB to support your residents. YOU signed up for this job. Your residents should NEVER have to hunt you down about answers and timelines for THEIR HOMES. When I had come into the office to ask if I could work from their office, I was met with hesitance and then was told to "wait a bit" and then see if the power was restored. He said they would "call me back in a half hour" to tell me if they had an empty unit with power for me to use. They never even called. 45 minutes later, I walked over there and basically forced them to give me an empty unit just so I could get some work done. Unbelievable — I shouldn't even have to ASK to be accommodated. They should have been OFFERING ME some kind of relief. Their customer service is truly some of their worst I've seen. "Well, we've just never had to deal with this before" is NOT an excuse — you adapt and you rise to the occasion and you DO YOUR JOB.

These places are not only roach infested but the staff is lazy and only the minimum is done. Their “extreme make over” is just throwing another coat of paint on everything and buying some cheap new appliances. All of the windows and door and cabinet hinges are covered in paint. The floors are so bad. Huge scrapes and major discoloration. Complaints about violations go without action. As soon as my lease is up I’m out. Maybe before if I can.
I was so pleased on how well the staff was with me and my husband. They answered all of my questions and made us feel at ease. We can't wait to move in!

Worst rental experience i've ever had in my life. I would only recommend this place to my worst enemy. I was not able to view the unit I was renting until the day I moved in although it was vacant, which should've been my red flag. The unit was infested. I had to delay moving in due to the issue, in which management attempted to place the pest blame on me. Mind you, I'd only had the keys for less than an hour. I had to contact the management company several times in order to have issues resolved. I've had at least 20 maintenance requests to date and have not yet reached the end of my lease yet. These issues ranged from the pests, to a leak in the roof/mold, the AC units, and a electrical issues with the breaker. Whenever the issues are brought up, maintenance MAY show up and actually resolve. In most cases, you'd have to contact corporate in order to have it escalated. I've never seen the pool clean or be cleaned. The exit gate near my building is always broken. The previous reviews are correct, they will attempt to charge you additional fees for anything possible and will also harass/threaten you. I was charged a fee AFTER paying the total amount due online and also given an early notice for termination of my lease due to fee. Very horrible management. Not worth the bargain price. This is truly the worst customer service and rental experience in all of my years of renting.

We've lived here nearly two years. We are currently house shopping and can not wait to leave. We have been great tenants, made every payment and are quiet.

First year was fine, no issues. We enjoyed it here. But these last 8 months has been just awful. The front office has messed up our (auto drafted) payment TWICE! The second time an employee somehow "accidentally" miss-charged our rent price with another tenants' check somehow (even though we have auto pay) which messed up our balance. With us unaware of the balance, they put an EVICTION notice on our door ......on a Friday....at 5pm. They said they "couldn't get a hold of me".....they had the wrong number and i have never changed my number nor did they call my wife whose number they had. They made no other attempt at getting in contact with us before putting an eviction notice on our door with no time to plead our case! When we finally got a hold of them, the front office manager yelled at my wife claiming it was our fault for their mistake before knowing the whole story. 

Also, not only my car but multiple others have been broken into and one even stolen out of the complex (which caused me to write this review after speaking to the person who's car was stolen while they were on vacation). They have refused to put up cameras anywhere except for directly on the front office. They also told the person whose car was stolen that there is no crime issue in this complex which is a lie.

They have a gated community but the gates are open almost all the time. 
Also, on multiple occasions, the the property manager has been very rude and not at all understanding, interrupting and very lacking in customer service and care. We've made attempts to call and discuss our lease or other issues about our unit with them and we never get a call back.

But hey, it's a great location and quiet....so there's that.

One of the staff didn't review the application documents carefully, asked us for the house insurance and electricity account. Then right before the move in day, they told us they can't approve it. It's so rediculous and inefficient.

Preston Green Apt:

Safe and quite with no troubles at all. The people's mind their business. Stores all around you. rating 8. Nothing Perfect!!!
Right in the middle of living Good.

Came here last year looking for a decent place to stay. The rooms are spacious with plenty of space to put things (furniture, desks, TV etc.). I live in the first floor so its very cool in the summer times. However, during the winter time, its really cold. My electric bill went through the roof. I think they need to update their walls with better insulation against the cold. 

The management is fairly responsive to requests for maintenance. Most jobs are completed the next day (two days at the most on average). The crew is courteous with good knowledge of what they do. 

The parking is wide and really accommodating with a gated community environment.  Crime rates are fairly low with only a few incidents in the area. Neighbors are very friendly with no loud folks disturbing the peace. 

The only down side that I see with this place is the rates. I started around $800 for a 13 month lease. After renewal, now I'm at 940. It's quite unfortunate that the rates have been constantly adjusted for "market rates". I've seen better rates elsewhere. Hope this helps your apartment search.

Living here has been absolutely horrible. My storage unit was broken into and the office has done nothing besides ignore my emails, dismiss my concerns, and make themselves unavailable. 
Dozens of residents had storage units broken into and had several thousand dollars worth of belongings stolen. The leasing office didn't inform anyone in the building of these issues and I found out my unit was broken into from my neighbor. The leasing office was barely apologetic and they said they would ensure all doors are locked at all times. Yet, one day after they said that, every single door on the second-floor was unlocked. 
The office is also refusing to file any sort of police report and claiming it's not their responsibility. Several residents have urged them to contact the police, yet the office continues to turn their shoulder on the issue. They say it's not their responsibility, though they have been pestering me and my neighbors for our Case ID # through Dallas PD for the offices incident report. If there is a spot on the incident report for a case number, then the office needs to file their own report and stop relying on residents for help. 
In addition, packages are stolen out of the mail room, several cars have been broken into, and they found a man living in a vacant unit a few weeks back. 

In addition to being unsafe, the common areas of the complex are dirty and not maintained. Trash valet is never on schedule, so trash is left out in hallways for long periods, causing the hallways to constantly have a bad smell. The garage always has dog poop in it, elevators often have dog pee in them, and carpets in hallways are often stained. The trash rooms on each floor are horribly maintained. The rooms are always filled with trash bags, floors are sticky, and door handles are broken. We pay $145 as a 'Resident Service Fee', but it seems that this money is going to waste, because nothing is maintained to a $145 standard.

This apartment complex is incredibly unsafe and you should avoid it at all costs! You'll be doing yourself a favor

I’ve been having bed bugs probably since i moved in a year ago but they got really bad in September but i still didn’t think it could be bed bugs until i saw them for the 1st time 2 months later informed the office nd they said i had to wait a week their exterminators came 2 times! And they are still here, i hired my own exterminator he came twice theyre still here i will probably end up breaking my lease i refuse to live like this anymore. Plus it smells terrible when walking around the apartments like foul odors

The front office staff was good and the maintenance took care of any requests in a timely manner but that's about the only good things about this place.

ROACHES... There is a roach and bug infestation there. They will spray for roaches but it only kills the few on the surface and doesn't get rid of them. They are everywhere in the apartment and they're not going anywhere regardless of how much they spray. 

DIRTY...The apartment was dirty and not cleaned at all prior to me moving in. There were wood chunks and splinters all over the carpet. There was writing all over the place.

THE SMELL... There is a horrible smell that doesn't go away. It has to be mold and it will stink up all of your clothes and belongings.

HIGH CRIME AREA... Avenida Crossing is located in a very high crime area, not safe at all. The neighbors on the other side of my building had their car broken into and property stolen. Robbery and theft is high at these apartments. Look at the crime map I've provided and it clearly shows the danger of living in these apartments. 

DON'T LIVE HERE
Needed something quick and it was ready by when we needed it. Got accepted even if we didnt have credit. Everyone in the office was very helpful.

Spectacular. My second year here with my boyfriend. They are always working with me, and they know I never fail them when it comes down to fulfilling their payment arrangement needs. I have had a few occasions that I had to fall a little short on my rent due to my car wreck, and ms.tania laid down the arrangement process to avoid losing my apt and was a very good listener. I see some new faces in the front office but they are always so helpful.
they helped us move in when we needed something quick and ready to go and I couldn't be happier.  high five to everyone in the office thanks!
My safe Haven of Rest from the turmoil in the streets

Connor Group was not great management before. Now Lincoln has managed to do an even worse job. 
Elevators are constantly broken.
It took months for them to figure out how to order coffee cups.
Crackheads break in on occasion
Staff does the bare minimum if anything to help with issues
The apartments are nice, just not maintained well and if you have leaks etc. nothing happens

They stay in the trash chutes. Sleep in the gym bathroom. Better not forget to lock your doors and cars if you move here.

The elevators are horrible. Be ready to budget extra time to get in and out of the place.

Management turns over often. The current management has come in and poured money into giving the place an aesthetic uplift while ignoring the functional issues and security issues that matter to the residents.

3 years of L2 and I was glad to leave. The new management team, The Connor Group, has made this building go from a great place to slightly better than a Motel 6. Slightly.

Here's what you can expect:

1) The building is filthy. Trash barely gets picked up. The carpet is never cleaned. There are pee and poop stains all over the place, and it hasn't been steam cleaned in months. (Prior to the Connor Group taking over in May, the carpet was vacuumed weekly and steam cleaned monthly.) It is just gross. There are roaches now, bugs, and it's just a mess. 

2) It's loud - due to "building improvements." Expect at least another 1-2 years of daily construction on the building. They are repainting, tearing up balconies, and making lots of noise. You can expect to have workers at 8am on a Saturday morning hammering outside your window. 

3) A kindergartner picked out the paint. Seriously, just look at the building. I know 5-year olds with better understanding of color.

4) Maintenance is SLOW. It can take several days to a week to get simple requests completed. 

5) It's Overpriced. Seriously, there are other newer, nicer buildings in the same neighborhood for less money. 

6) I am surprised some of the staff has a job.

Ultimately, I to contact State Attorney General's Office and an attorney to get some issues resolved. Yes, it's that bad.  Don't live here. Don't live here. Don't live here. 

You've been warned.

STEER CLEAR OF L2! I loved living here before the Connor Group took over management. It was overnight the drastic changes. It went from being a clean, calm, quiet but with the right amount of fun mixed in, upscale, classy place to live and overnight they turned L2 into a dump. Trash everywhere, no communication or notification of changes, or construction taking place by management. Dirty hallways, trash, and dog waste all over the grounds and property INSIDE AND OUTSIDE of the building. The fire alarms are going off non stop in individual units without being handled, one is going off in the apartment next to me as we speak and preventing me from sleeping it’s almost midnight on a work night. Constant construction and “renovation of the building” creating a loud environment. It’s been impossible to work from home with all of the noise. They turned a tasteful building into a carnival. The new paint scheme and wall decals they have selected resemble a tacky elementary school. Do not live here if I could break my lease now I would. Unfortunately I’m stuck here until April of 2021 so if I can help anyone from being stuck in the same unfortunate situation I will. STAY AWAY!

New owners took over 5/19/2020 and it has been horrible. The most unhappy living experience I have ever had. Trash, cleanliness, maintenance issues, even bigger overall building failures. Elevators keep failing with people in them, A/C doesn’t work , water and electricity have gone out and fire alarms are chirping day and night. The new owner seems to prioritize painting over repairs.

Do not move here while this building is under ownership and management of the Connor Group. I used to love living here but ever since they took over on May 19th 2020, the quality of living has dropped dramatically. The trash is not maintained and piles up within the trash chute rooms to the point that it almost reaches the door frame. The smell is unbearable and is starting to attract pests. There have been several sightings of roaches and rats since the Connor Group moved in because of the absolute neglect for cleaning and sanitizing. The entire leasing office is filled with inexperienced and unprofessional individuals who don't know the first thing about managing a property. Their only goal is selling and getting new residents in here ASAP. Stay away!

We signed our lease here in November, after touring in July. We were coming from out of state, and the manager Sylvia made the process so easy and stress-free. She’s a very professional and sweet woman. She treats the units as if she’d be living in them herself. Our unit is a upgraded one, and it really makes such a difference. The upgrades have really made the unit feel more luxurious. While living here the manager has been making upgrades throughout the entire property. We’ve had no issues at all! If we ever needed anything it was handled in a timely manner! Maintenance is very sweet as well. The reviews seem to be outdated and towards a different owner.. they do not fit the experience living here at all! Overall such a warm welcome to Texas, and such a great place to live.
Filthy property, high crime area, very very very rude management.

Manager Victoria is the rudest and most unprofessional individual.  Roaches and rats run around the property.
Trash and glass are usually on the parking lot most of the time.

Rats, roaches, gunshots! Nastiest apartments ever and I live here now. I asked for a 2 bed 2 bath, they gave me a 2 bed 1 bath w/o any notice. Had to replace my stove because the first one was overcome with rat poop. Balcony ceiling fell thru. They shampooed my carpet the day I was suppose to move in so the carpet was soaked. Rat poop all throughout my kitchen. Shower hot water doesn’t last long. Nasty neighbors. They towed my car on the 3rd day of permit expiration without any notice. Please do not consider these apartments if u are looking for somewhere even halfway decent to live. I’m far Nebraska, this was my first experience in Dallas. Never late on rent. Never had such a poor experience before with any apartment!

I do not recommend this otherwise beautiful and delightful place due to the despicable behaviour of the apartment manager. She was nothing but rude and insolent toward me, a 58 year old disabled woman. She cheated me and left me homeless! Her sadistic unprofessional reeks of hypocrisy. I wouldn't want her karma. Her name is Iliana. ?????

Great Location, very quiet neighborhood if you like tranquility this is it!!
Well maintained gardens, they don't have the latest appliances but you get what you pay for it, some units have been updated recently.

Very friendly staff, manager is very people oriented, they will go above and beyond for their residents.

Overall Great Community..!!
Nice garden apts, just be aware that units are on a Chiller system. Which means its up to the manager when the heat or a/c is turned on.

There are leaks constantly happening, packages being stolen, elevator and hallways reeks of weed and sometimes I can even smell it through my vents. They don’t give you a fob and only have an app so I have been locked out at dangerous hours due to my phone being dead. I found out after that they charge $50 for a fob which I find weird since I’m going to be returning it to them when I leave anyways. I also didn’t realize that there are airbnb units in the building and I feel unsafe knowing there are random people staying on my floor. I signed up while they were offering a discount but I won’t be renewing my lease at the normal rent of the unit.
The new Magnolia community is stunning! Beautiful finishes, amazing amenities and perfectly laid out floor plans. Definitely the perfect place to call home!

This property has drastically declined since moving here two years ago. Most recent event, somewhere between 8PM July 26 and 8AM July 27, 30+ vehicles were broken into in the gated “secure” parking garage, some directly in front of the cameras.

The elevators are consistently being serviced and can be non-functional for months at a time. The leasing office could not be more unprofessional when handling escalated situations.

They also flag and remove negative reviews to create a false image of reality living here. Lease at your own risk.

Elevators are constantly down and cars get broken into every week. Management could care less. 

There are many other apartments to choose from in the area that prioritize tenant safety and are nicer.

Crime, poor maintenance and underinvestment

The ugly : lots of crime here including a break in an apartment broken into and an assault, car break ins , stolen packages , vandalism. Masked intruders seen roaming the garage at night. Broken and unsecured security doors , poor security. The bad : elevators always broken , ugly new floors, roaches and ants, management doesn’t respond to complaints and requests or sent to care . Parking difficult sometimes . The good: responsive maintenance , friendly maintenance staff , good location

If I could give this place 0 stars, or negative stars, I absolutely would. This complex is terrible and management does not care about their residents AT ALL. There are 3 elevators for the complex (2 side by sides and 1 standalone), and both of the side by side elevators were broken at least 75% of my lease term (~14 months). The remaining elevator also was broken most of the time I lived here, which left everyone without a working elevator. If I had lived on a lower floor then it might’ve been more manageable, but living on just the 5th floor made it a huge inconvenience. Management always had the same cut and paste response of “we’re trying, so sorry” and that was it. Even when supposedly it led back to one singular guy kicking in the elevator panels (which was one way that they would break), it took management 6 months to finally look at installing cameras to deter him. The aesthetics are ok at best, it’s an older building and it’s starting to show. Parking is a nightmare anytime there’s an event at the AAC, which is pretty often, because management lets everyone bring in their friends to park for the events. To top off my truly wonderful living experience, we consistently had cockroaches. Sometimes even falling from the CEILING FAN into the apartment. Pest control came out at least 20 times due to the 20+ instances we had in the apartment. They taped extra around pipes, sprayed, and put out traps, but aside from that their “hands were tied”. We also brought the issue to the attention of management and they tried to tell us that we were incorrect, belittled us for the issue, and said that it was “rainy season” so we basically needed to just suck it up. Last time we checked, “rainy season” isn’t year round. It was just a “coincidence” that this only has ever happened to us at Moda, even though we lived in 4 other apartment complexes previously (varying between Uptown and Victory Park/ Harwood), and had NEVER had an issue with pests. Thankfully we got out of here and are fully moved out, although management decided to try and charge us for the entirety of the last month instead of prorate it as they’re supposed to. Anyways, if you’re interested in living at Moda, don’t do it. The prices are cheap for a reason. It seems like a dream come true, but to quote taylor swift, it’s a nightmare dressed like a daydream.
The elevators never work and it's hard to get deliveries.

I?ve been living here for 3 weeks, and love living in Moda. The Leasing office are amazing. Very helpful and move very fast with my service orders. My only issue is the elevators doesn?t work but that?s normal for apartments complex. Lol. I need the exercise

I wish I listened to the other reviews before living here. DO NOT LIVE AT THE BRIXTON! We’ve had multiple issues with our apartment with our calls going unanswered and the issues not being resolved. There’s been black debris blowing from our AC vents for over 6 months, it’s been attempted to be fixed 6 times with it continuing to get worse. The management is absolutely incompetent and lies to you (if they even answer the phone or messages). The gates are always broken and left open. We’ve had packages stolen from the mailroom since anyone can access it and they refuse to install cameras. This apartment is old with a fresh coat of paint on top, don’t be fooled by initial impressions. Since leaving, the apartment has already been listed again as available so we know that no fixes have been completed and the next renter will have the same debris. Stay away, or you’ll regret signing the lease.

I've lived here for over 7 years. It's always been fairly hit or miss, in just about every area. The grounds are not well kept. A tree fell down on some cars a few years back, and after waiting for over a year, they finally got rid of the stump and decided a 10 foot by 10 foot mud hole was a good way to leave things. Customer service was always spotty, but now, with the new owners and (I use this word lightly) office staff, it's become almost unliveable. For months, there was no way to make maintenance requests, or contact the office, or even find out what our monthly rent was. That's right, for months, they couldn't tell anyone how much to make their check (since there was no online service) out for. THEN, they misplaced a bunch of people's checks and instead of reaching out to correct THEIR mistake, they just threatened to evict everyone. They just put a note on everyone's door one night. WHAT?! Crime is rampant here, as well.  The lockers and mail boxes have been broken into multiple times. Someone tried to break into our apartment from our patio and proceeded to break our deadbolt. We reached out to request it be changed or fixed....nothing....not a word....Just don't move here. Seriously. I've been renting for over 20 years, and never have I ever experienced such ineptitude and a complete and utter lack of willingness to do one's job.

I've lived here for over 10 years.  This used to be a great community.  Now the management only cares about increasing rent and making a profit!  Manager won't even call you back. Landscaping, or should I say lack of landscaping, is now mud and rocks.  The handful of us long term residents are moving or planning to move.  You can get so much more for the rents they are charging here! Don't lease at The Brixton.

I had to move to Dallas on very short notice to take a new job. The staff was very through and walked me through the leasing process remotely. I was very pleased with the apartment and continued support from the staff.

What turned out to be my new apartment home by default turned out to be a blessing in disguise. Perfect location. Right off the Dallas tollway. Great neighbors. They been living here for years which to me says a lot about the complex. My apartment is much more spacious than I thought. Maintenance stays on top of repairs. Rent is average for this area. The apartment office staff is great. They're always having something for The Brixton tenants such as Saturday morning breakfast, tea and cookie social, a fitness event and I've only been here about a month and half. I love it here.
Nice floors, whatever lighting, good neighbors, quiet. Overall great, but not when it's not where you're supposed to be.

It really sucks to say bad things about this place because overall it's been an enjoyable experience. For context, I've been here for over a year. Yes my car has been broken into but I attribute that less to the complex and more to living adjacent to Downtown. The location is great and maintenance has been very quick and attentive.

HOWEVER, safety is an absolute no here. The back
gate in building one has been broken since before I moved in and it hasn't been fixed yet. The  call box  in Building 1 has been broken since before I moved in and it has not been fixed. Everyone for every building has the same gate entry code including delivery drivers. My Ring has caught several of the transit population trying to and sometimes successfully breaking into storage units. The latest incident prompted me to stay else where until the broken lock was fixed.

Also, for those reading reviews for context after a tour, the back of Building One shows the height of gentrification in Old East Dallas. I'm not saying that's a bad thing, but I am saying they take great care of not showing that on the tour.

The new management stopped accepting packages when the package lockers were full and now packages are left on the ground outside. That decision has lead to an increase in package theft.

All of the cons combined is enough to not consider renewing my lease because it's simply not worth the peace of mind. I'm sure they'll find an unsuspecting soul to take the unit and they'll soon be presented with the same issues. Hoping that management would actual take some initiative to make the place better given the property value is raising in the area and new truly luxury apartments are being built within a few blocks.

I would highly recommend NOT living here. They’ve spent money on renovating the units and common areas but security is basically nonexistent. The pedestrian gates don’t lock, half of the time the garage doors are broken and left wide open, and we’ve consistently had break ins for the past 6 weeks. Our storage unit was broken into 5 days ago and now our car was stripped of parts when we parked it in the garage, and management claims they’re doing the best they can...

I am so excited to be a new resident at Fitzhugh Urban Flats! Ryan was extremely helpful during the entire leasing process. She got back to me so quickly and answered all of my questions.  She even let me tour the apartment a second time to compare different floor plans. She went above and beyond to make sure my move went smoothly! The property just got new owners so there’s a lot of renovations happening but I’m excited to be able to use the new two story gym! They have a lot of other awesome amenities as well like 3 pools, two new dog parks and you can park on the exact floor you live on.  I am glad to make Fitzhugh Urban Flats my new home!

I wouldn't recommend this place unless you live on the top floor and even then God help you if your next door neighbors are noisy. I can hear every footstep the upstairs person takes and can hear next door neighbors have "relations" (the good and the bad). If I'd known this, I wouldn't have moved here. Even if u complain, they just send a courtesy officer by. You really have to throw a fit to get management to contact the resident.

Very Bad alarm system in set up in this apartment complex. If you want to be a fireman and get up in the middle of the night because of loud fire alarms that happens a several times in one year, this is the right apartment for you.

I feel safe here and it is close to every thing, esp my job. Office staff are nice to your face and do nothing to resolve issues,ie noise upstairs after 10 pm like weight dropping,  hallways dirty and valet trash will not even take smallboxes. I am paying for upgrades I donot have ! Apt is large and mostly quiet except when pool open
It isn’t safe at all. My vehicle has been broken into and vandalized twice. They are only about making money and don’t care anything about the tenants. Save yourself the headache and money.

I've lived at Mariposa Villas for about 6 months now.  I love it here.  It's quiet, clean, management is friendly and attentive.  Maintenance takes care of issues quickly.  The only negative thing I have to mention is noisy 2nd floor neighbors.  I'm def ready for them to move out.

I have been dealing with extremely noisy neighbors upstairs with no help from the office . Their only suggestion was to call the police well I have done that a half dozen times and nothing is working. I can't wait until my lease is up.  The quality if residents has truly gone down.  Loud music in the parking lot and frequent gunshots from neighboring houses.

I was a little apprehensive about being on the first floor. But the breezeway are well lit, and it's really quiet around here. I'm so glad about the decision to move here. Great job to Hector , Alex, & Tanya.

Since moving to Mariposavillas Dallas location, the management Robert, Alex, and Hector, have treated me and my family very well. Despite the reviews I have read, my experience has been great!The maintenance guy even came to fix some small issues and educate me on the importance of always reporting maintenance issues early to avoid large problems later. Maintenance was very prompt. Those guys are gentleman, professional and knowledgeable. I feel happy about choosing Mariposavillas (Dallas, TX)for me and my family. The young lady who was temporarily there, Catara???? She was sweet in helping us with paperwork and she works fast and she was efficient!

I recently moved it, staff is amazing, big thanks to CJ in the front desk for all her help and finding me the perfect apartment and getting me settled in. I love it. It is quiet, no drama, and no bugs what more can I ask for. Neighbors are friendly and polite. No complaints. :)
The maintenance guy did a great job fixing the problem.

I had some electric outlet issues and fridge went out. Robert came out next day after reporting issue. He fixed all outlets very quickly and order new fridge. He both kind and courteous and let me know exactly when to expect new fridge.

Tiburon apartments are nice and clean apartments. They are very old with some foundation issues, but the size of the unit is huge for the price. Parking is very good. It’s very quiet at night and during the day in some areas of the neighborhood. The trash dumpster areas are kept clean. The trees have acorns falling everywhere, but they are swept up each week. You can’t beat the price for the area.
I've been here for almost a month now, and "I'm loving it!"
Maintenance is quick, courteous and efficient. Thank you for keeping the property pleasant!
Very professional management and online system, made signing the lease very easy and headache free. Great location and scenery and very nice floorplan layouts

So far I am loving it here. The staff is really nice and they are always willing to help. I like how close am I to downtown where I work and I can still go to uptown for a nice evening with my wife. Safety and limited access is a big plus. The apartment looks really nice inside, brand new appliances, no carpet and granite counters. My wife loves the lighted mirror in the bathroom. I give five stars for the excellent communication.

I was first drawn by the price and location. Once I got there the two girls in the front are very friendly and helpful.  The studio was cute and quaint. Applied today with the look and lease special.  Loved to see the community actually participating in the clubhouse billiards room.

Noisy and run down

My new wife and I were very excited to make a move from Washington down to Texas in 2021. We painstakingly reviewed several apartment complexes before making a MASSIVE mistake in choosing Tides as our home.

I highly recommend that if you cannot see this complex in-person, do NOT apply (we used a free apartment locator service for our next apartment).

The new management staff who started in Feb. 2022 (Mya and Juan) show decent professionalism. And the new maintenance staff are great!

However there are two aspects to the apartment complex that management seem unable to address. (1) The other residents and (2) the quality of the complex

Every single day and night we lived there we were woken up and disturbed by car alarms.
every….single…day!

On top of this, idiots were constantly honking their horns whenever someone is parked in their reserved car spot. Our sleep suffered severely due to these inconsiderate idiots. (In our new complex we have heard no car alarms or honking at all.)
These same residents are also incapable of putting trash in the dumpster (alot of photos support this).

In terms of the complex itself. It is very cheaply built with awful thin windows, and terrible (no) insulation. This causes the place to turn into a greenhouse in the summer months. The cooling costs made our seemingly cheap home, very expensive.
The maintenance of this complex has been neglected for a very long time.


Also note that this street used to be called Maham St. It was Renamed due to high crime levels in this area.

Please don’t make the same mistake as we did. Don’t apply without an in-person tour.

Dont move here. It is super cheap. I moved here in April they have permanently closed the pool (no pool all summer) the wash house is outed and the machines are always broke. The pictures they show are only of the done up places the reat of the place is completely trashed. People are always working in their cars. There is no where to park. Rodents because the trash is pilled high. Just drive through ine time and you’ll see what I mean
Renewing for another year!! Excellent property!!!!
Workers are horrible. There’s not even visitors passes.

DO NOT LIVE HERE. 1. This place is in the hood so you're not safe. 2. YOU WILL NEVER FIND PARKING AFTER 7PM. 3. Neighbors are always up at 3 am. 4. If you're a girl, get used to old men staring/stalking you. Oh and cherry on top, pool is ALWAYS closed.

worst place in Dallas, trash sits by our place for days before they decide to pick it up.

horrible experience

-1000 star!

They boot residents cars for parking in visitor’s spots, they don’t even have enough parking spots for their residents.

The apartment is owned by the towing company, they have no say so whatsoever. This apartment complex changed more regulations in a year span than the White House in the whole of American history lifetime.

We called a bajillion, and one time about mold in the apartment but no maintenance showed up until we fixed it ourselves.

Good luck getting your deposit back after moving out.

I've been living here since January 2022 and would not recommend this complex. I was welcomed on move in day with roaches crawling up the walls. The apartments are old and falling apart. I've had several instances where the doorknobs fell off the door and I have to screw them back in myself. I was promised a renovated apartment but the renovations were done very cheaply and do not look like the images online. For example, the baseboards in the kitchen and bathroom have chipped and peeling paint which I requested to be re-painted prior to move in but was never done. It takes on average 1-2 months for maintenance requests to be acknowledged and that is with constantly emailing the property staff to remind them of my requests. My washing machine is old and not draining properly and I have requested this be fixed or replaced but my maintenance work orders are closed without the washing machine being fixed. The top floor of the parking garage is dark and not safe at night. Many of the lights there have stopped working and were never replaced. Believe the majority negative reviews and live elsewhere. I wish I did. There are plenty of other nicer and better complexes in the area.

we moved in 8/2020 during covid, so we couldn't get a tour, I love the property that we basically walked ourselves. So we moved in, when we did they had JUST resurface the counter tops & the whole apartment smelled horrible. It wasn't cleaned properly so TWO WEEKS after we moved in they came again to clean. No one picks up after their dogs, this no smoking property has cigarette butts everywhere, & you can get a great 2nd hand contact of weed. I am not going in to the ordeal from the winter storm but let's say they weren't in a rush to help anyone.Now they just got bought out by a new management company & instead of explaining we had a final untilies bill with the old company, they just said the city of Dallas charged you 2-3 mths past due & if you don't pay you will incur late charges. We are due to renew in August & I was just going to stay but the are not only increasing out rent by 109.00 they are now charging 10 for packages (1/2 the time the packages are all over the floor) 10 for thier own rental insurance (we do not get an option) going up on the trash pick up, up on the pest fee (put in a work order because with all the renovations we have seen ROACHES) & they still haven't come, in total its about 50.00 in new fees. So needless to say WE ARE MOVING!! DO NOT LIVE HERE!! Hopefully this amazing property gets the management & love it needs. I really do love the property.

I have lived here since August of last year. The ownership changed in April 2021 to S2 Residential. New ownership is very unorganized. My apartment was completely damaged during the winter storms in mid February. Pipes froze and burst and completely damaged my entire apartment because I live on the ground floor. It is now May 5 and my apartment is still damaged. New ownership had the business phone lines and email accounts shut off for the first couple of weeks. It is extremely difficult to reach anyone in the office. I have called and emailed everyday for the past 2 weeks requesting to speak with the property manager but she is always busy and unable to speak with me. I was finally able to speak with an assistant manager today who basically politely told me this is why you have renters insurance and that I still owe them money. They rarely reply to emails and when they do they do not sign their names at the end so you don't know who you are speaking with. I can't get detailed updates on when my apartment will be finished and ready for me to move back into. It has been almost 3 months and they are still requesting full months rent for an apartment that I can't even live in. I would not recommend any complex under S2 residential management to anyone.

I’ve lived in many apartments, and I’ve never had a worse experience than this.

My water has been off for 6 days. Three units in my building have flooded. There is mildew smell coming from my vents. My apartment is completely unsafe and unsanitary.

So, I went to the leasing office today to try to come to an agreement to move out. They informed me I would have to pay a penalty if I moved out of my uninhabitable apartment. They gave me no assurance that my water would be fixed within an reasonable time. Even if the water is fixed I will be forced to live in a building covered in mold and mildew, unless I fork over extra money to them for the privilege of living someplace with running water.

These people are utterly immoral and have no concern whatsoever for the health and welfare of their residents.

For your own sake, I’m begging you to move somewhere else. Anywhere else.

Called them prior to driving out to look at a floor plan. The woman on the phone says as long as I’m able to make before 430 she would be able to show me. I drop what I’m doing and rush there to make it a few minutes before 430. I walk in with the woman very rudely acting like I just ruined her day even though she told me to come. I tell her the two floors plans I’m interested in looking at as I did on the phone. She says she won’t have time to show the amenities but will show the apartments. Then we go my 2nd choice apartment first and as were walking out she says she won’t have time to show the other one???! Mind you I’ve been here for maybe 4 minutes at this point. It’s 432 and they close at 5. I cannot believe this woman told me to drive all the way out here to tell me to come back another day to view the rest. Are you kidding me?!! The assistant manager had nothing else to input. Just that they could schedule me another day. Absolutely not. If this is how your office is run, how the hell would you expect anyone to want to live here?! I was already less than impressed with the quick 2 minute showing of one of the apartments. Looks very dated and not kept up with- shower looked gross. But the two women in the office just sealed the deal and I will never be back. Good riddance and good luck to anyone looking to live here!

Before even thinking about this apartment, please go through all the NEGATIVE reviews, ALL ARE TRUE. I wish I would have trusted those reviews before moving in.

THESE PEOPLE ARE MONEY MAKER and A BIG TIME LIER

1. If you are visiting this apartment, record all the information which is provided as a proof, because they will lure you will all the sweet talks and once you will sign on the lease they will deny everything and will for the proof. we have fallen for this trap.

2. Me and my husband recently moved in to this apartment, We were informed that I could be added as occupant at any time with normal application fees of $25. So, once we moved in and when we went to the leasing office to add me as an occupant they asked for $225 ($200(admin)+ $25(application fees)).
When I confronted to the property manager that this was not the information conveyed to us, She imply denied and started asking DO YOU HAVE THIS IN WRITTEN?

Question 1. Who will choose to pay $225 over $25?
Question 2. Who will have email conversation while visiting the property?

GARBAGE will never get collected even if you pay for valet trash.

I am current resident of almost 2 years waiting for my lease to end so that I can leave. My issues since living here:

#1: Within the first few months, cockroaches randomly pop up near my front entrance/ laundry door or in my bathroom. "pest control" did not work. I stopped requesting them, which I like every other tenant to pay for, and bought HomeDefense, which worked for almost a year (cockroaches reappeared) and then I had to reapply it throughout the entire perimeter of my apartment. 

#2: When I renewed my lease, the manager gave me a hard time for an issue that was not my fault and I went above her to the management company, who refunded my money swiftly, apologized and gave me a $100 gift card for the inconvenience. 

#3: When I first moved here, there was a security guy who patrolled the complex at night. I would see him coming home from work late at night or going to the gym in the early morning, which was great. He had been really helpful on more to me as well as other tenants (e.g., let a tenant know that her car door was left wide open). Since he left, my car among many has been broken into within less than a year (check sites that show history of criminal reports related to this location to verify what I am saying). Thankfully, it was not stolen but just ran-shacked inside (still horrible but I don't have to buy another car). The gate gives a false sense of security since cars can just come in right behind you or block you from entering until someone opens it. There is also limited parking space. Although visitors are suppose to park on the top floor, they do not and this is not enforced at all.

Issue #4: Most recent issue, which prompted me to write this, is the outcome of a maintenance request. I submitted a request to check a leak coming from my ceiling which I mentioned that I thought was related to constant use of my AC (the heating/cooling system is in the ceiling in the bathroom) but I came home to the unexpected --water in my bathroom drawer, water on the base of the cabinets under the sink and, as a result, several of my belongings damaged in these areas. I had to throw things out, let other things that could be salvaged air dry, get a fan and run it constantly to prevent mold to the cabinet as well as my things. Things were mishandled and gunk from the pipes were splattered on my stuff. I checked my email to see that they completed a request to unclog my bathroom sink. I don't know if they even looked at the AC unit!

I will agree these apartments are decent, but they are managed  horribly and they over charge for everything!!!! I wish i would have done more research when moving to dallas. There are way better apartments for cheaper! They charged for trash pickup from your front door, but I always had to go dump it myself because it was never picked up. The second month of living here my car got towed out of the parking garage because the girl at the front desk forgot to give us parking stickers. Yes, they paid for my car to get out but wouldn’t take me to go get it or pay for a uber. I had to wait til 9pm for my boyfriend to get off work to take me to go get my car. It was super frustrating that I had to miss a day of work.

First off the parking garages are constantly having cars robbed and vandalized. They have switched management from mediocre to terrible. Service requests are hardly ever addressed. The maintenence crew has no experience and shouldn't be allowed near a toolbox. The front office only wants to speak with potential new lease signers. They could not care less about current residents. Time Warner has a monopoly at this complex and is far from reliable for cable as well as wi-fi. No one answers the phone half the time. They will sign for your packages without consent, neglect to inform you, and then lose said package. If your rent or utilities go up without any reasonable explaination they will use their favorite phrase, "I don't have acess to that. There's nothing I can do" The rent is entirely too high to deal with such poor service and management.

Location is very awesome, minutes from635/75/and the Dallas North Tollway. Great landscaping, spacious rooms, open kitchen. Minutes away from the bustling night life of Addison minus the loud atmosphere. Been here three years, would stay, but needing to get into a home.

I love these apartments, I truly do. I'd hate to leave but my job transferred me out of state. These apartments are a 10-15 minute drive from Downtown Dallas and around the corner from a booming upscale shopping district with a movie theater and a sushi restaurant that has happy hour. The Galleria Mall is one of the largest in the country and it is within walking distance. Also within walking distance is the Blue Mesa Cafe that has a fantastic brunch and awesome happy hour deals ($4 margaritas, anyone?) and all you can eat quesadillas. There is a Whole Foods, Barnes & Noble, and an elementary school also within walking distance. What more can you ask for? There are bus stops close by (the 183 will take you to Downtown) and don't forget the 4th of July celebration where Addison (the town the apartments are located in) has its annual fireworks extravaganza "Boom Town"!

I like that the apartments are nice and quiet and that management has cut down on  partying after 10 pm. My friends look at my apartment and agree that I truly found a gem in the city. Close enough to the action but far enough away to have a view and enjoy some of that quiet TX country time. 

The only reason that these apartments get 4 stars and not 5 is because of management. They seem very aloof when it comes to your questions after you move in. They are under new management now so I hope that will improve but the on-sight maintenance is FANTASTIC! I called them at 12 midnight when I came home and found that my power wasn't on, they were there within 3 minutes. I had a water heater that started leaking (Boom!) They gave me a brand new one the next day. They are even so kind as to accept some packages while I'm out.

The apartment allows pets yet I've never had a problem with dogs howling through the night nor pooping everywhere as they have a designated dog area for that by the parking lot. Owners are encouraged to clean up after their animals.

The apartment complex is extremely clean and don't forget to use the clubhouse amenities? WiFi, a weight room, bathrooms, conference room and a cardio room (the bikes that are hooked up to the internet are my favorite). I was sold when they told me that washers and dryers are standard in every apartment.

If I could, I would pick up this apartment complex and take it with me to my new location. These apartments are a fantastic place and as soon as you see them, you will know you are home.
No hot water for two weeks and counting. Avoid this place.

GOOD MORNING THROUGH THIS COMMUNICATION, I WANT TO GIVE THANKS FOR ALL THE ATTENTIONS RECEIVED, AS WELL AS THE EXCELLENT AND FLUID INFORMATION PROVIDED, ESPECIALLY FROM THE LADIES JACQUELINE AND VANNESA, AND HIS UNCONDITIONAL SUPPORT, LIKE THAT OF HIS MANAGER, MRS. ALLYSON, BEYOND THEIR JOB DUTIES. ALSO I WANT TO GIVE THANKS TO MR. RODOLFO ROSALES, WHO WE ALREADY RECOMMEND THIS BEAUTIFUL CONDOMINIUM AND ITS STAFF. JOSE GILBERTO RAMIREZ V. TELEPHONE 305 9225721

My husband and I have been living here for 1.5 years now. The maintenance staff has recently changed and now I can't say a bad thing about the place. I love my town home, the area and the office/maintenance staff. The noise level is ok. I live right on a corner on the drive through the apartments, so I can hear car stereos, but that is to be expected. I will live here for a long time to come. :)

The apartment complex has bugs, all of my neighbors have spoken about it. I’ve witnessed it. Many times the water has been turned off for an extensive amount of time. Management will will rarely contact you back. Packages go missing. Vehicles get broken in to. A neighbor of mine had her door busted in by a crackhead. The gates rarely work. I 12/10 don’t recommend especially since rent is only increasing and there’s no reason it should be with the amount of issues.

Also, while away for business for many weeks, somehow my electricity bill (that Management bills you for) was $100 more than normal.

Just recently moved into a studio and fell in love as soon as the door was opened had a couple of minor problems but the problems were fixed in a very timely manner! Best apartments i’ve seen while apartment hunting so I just had to! And LaShaye was very professional, helpful and explained everything to me. It’s a Quiet place but people are pretty friendly if you see them outside of their apartment. Looking forward to the next 11 months in the Halston!

Management (which is always changing) is slow to respond to issues, the apartments themselves are not built well (many structural issues), parking is terrible, and there is a lot of crime in the community. The rent is low, but so is the quality of living at Halston.

I don't do reviews to often I am compelled to do one, really excited in the direction of Halston Apartments Dallas. I just completed my renewal and it was easy breezy thanks to the staff in the office staying after business hours to get me taken care of so I wouldn't have to pay late fees. Cassie and team I'm here for the long haul and thank you again!!

Broken appliances, bugs everywhere, wet garages, low security. File w/o’s With little to very slow response. Stink and dirt in most public spaces.
We don’t necessarily blame NightVest, but the property owners are out of touch or don’t care.

I can't agree at all with any of the negative posts here. I've been at Halston Apst (formerly The Vineyards) for right at 9yrs. For one thing, the new mgmt just totally remodeled every bldg on the property and redid the landscaping. Everything is upgraded, modern and nice. I'm very proud and happy to live here. The staff are experienced and efficient. I agree with another poster that Cassie is excellent to work with. She's been here long term and knows everything. She could run the property by herself and practically has at times in the past. I have no bug infestation but any place can because some residents aren't as clean as others in keeping their kitchen clean and trash removed. Is that the mgmt's fault? Hardly. It's also a very quiet, large property. I have nothing to complain about and there are lots of nice people here, some who are return residents and some longer term than I am. I've been very happy here, and have no reason to move.

These apartments have a roach problem. They say they’re completely clean but as soon as we moved in there were dead roaches in the fridge. The walls are thin and it’s noisy in every part of the apartments. Parking is a headache.
The new staff is very kind and help with any Maintenance    request I submit.
Roaches, no hot water for weeks, cars that are updated will be towed. Shootings every weekend, rent raises, rats, trash everywhere

Only live here if you enjoy not having hot water for an entire week without any communication from the owners/operators. After emails and maintenance requests, nothing has been done to remedy the problem or address concerns.

I hope to be living here soon, these apt look amaizing, just waiting to get approved now. Called the staff like 5 times with a different question and they were very patient to answer each one accordingly. Thank you!

We're so happy to be living at Hidden Oaks. After a long and difficult apartment search, Ashley helped us find our perfect place to call home. Not only was she so friendly and awesome, she's an animal lover as well. We have a sweet fur baby that we were not willing to part ways with, and after talking to her we didn't have to! Hidden Oaks is quiet, quaint, yet still so close to everything. Thank you!!!

I am thankful to have this apt I will call home!! I am single parent full time student and it was a rough ride before I came to Hidden Oaks!  They have a great staff and definetely made me feel welcome!  Its only 4 min from my sons high school!!  And 10 mins from my school!  Great neighborhood, few miles from a fitness center and shopping areas!  Great Place!!!  Thank You!
German roach infestation within 2 weeks of moving in. It is a building wide issue likely. Recommend staying away.

The one star was for the apartment layout and appliances.  Other than that, this was an abject failure.  Thin walls, noisy neighbors, shotty maintenance, gates frequently inoperable, and amenities inaccessible.  

Paid last month's rent in full because the website would not allow partial payments.  Moved out November 20th but was billed utilities through December 1st.  Due to this fact, did not receive full deposit.  Additionally, brought it to the attention of management that I had overpaid for November and was told I'd be reimbursed.  After almost 6 months, I still have not received the funds or an update.  Have decided not to pursue any further and instead take this as a learning experience to do my due diligence better in the future, I suggest you do the same before leasing here.

Do NOT move here , they are not sufficient with charges . You have a set rent amount but they have the ability to overcharge you for water 3 times the normal amount to where your paying almost an extra 300.00 on your rent without notice. They wont fix anything and do not take responsible for any charges that are invalid. PLEASE do not move here , i will not be renewing this lease ever again . Save your self the stress of being overcharged , thin walls and neighbors leaving poop on your patio . Im very dissapointed in this new management as they are definitely not helpful at ALL. THINK TWICE

So far I like living in this apartment. For the price it's fair because of amenities that's comes with it. The area is a hidden gem. I have no noise complaints because I sleep daytime on my work days and night time when I'm off. My neighbors are cool and respectful. Also the staff is very helpful when I booked a tour, when I applied to get a place and when I moved in.

Walls must be made of papier-mâché as you can hear every single creek and thump and thud and drop from the tenant(s) above.

Second consistent problem, tenants or visitors who just sit inside their car and blast their music ........... Did I mention that the walls are papier-mâché???  

If you work from home, don't here here! If you work overnight, don't rent here! Your time hear will NOT be peaceful!!! Expected better for fairly new yet overpriced apartments.

My overall recommendation, don't rent here. If you have (no other choice),  you better make sure you get a third floor unit. Now, I see why they always have on the roof "Now Leasing"

I've been living here for years, gate never worked, management changes every months, there's someone new in the leasing office, and you can't get maintenance to fix anything. I'm still waiting on maintenance, from work orders, I put in, years ago, and they all day the same thing "We're new, we'll definitely handle it" and never do!! They change up porters and maintenance so often, I wouldn't even trust them coming in my place! Painted the speed bumps and went up on rent, ridiculous

I've lived here 6 or 7 yrs now and things have changed. The gate hasn't worked in yrs. People are in and out all times of night with loud music. I still think the manager is very nice but, if an appliance breaks down and u have to throw food away, they will NOT REPLACE any of it. THEY DON'T OFFER EITHER. It has happened to me twice now. I once LOVED living here. Now, i'm leaving when my lease is up. I feel they have no respect. U are just a tenant and only a tenant

It's a nice complex but there are a few negatives as far as the cheap flooring and outdated appliances are concerned. The area isn't the best but if you're on a budget and want a townhouse its one to consider renting.

apartmentName: Tuscany at Goldmark Senior Living - 62+ Only
review:
This is a independent living senior citizen facility. 
They have several free options here, but they also have activities that you have to pay for. The rent goes up every year, yet our income stays the same. They had verbally agreed to allow a 30 day notice so that I could jump on any home purchase opportunities.  I had trouble getting into a home during pandemic until finding one in 2022. When the time came to give notice, the office sent out a lease renewal and I called and informed them that I was putting a bid on a house that weekend and would be giving official notice hopefully in about a week’s time assuming I won the bid.  Suddenly I was told they weren’t going to honor that agreement anymore and they not only switched from a 30 day notice back to the original 60 day notice but they raised my rent during the notice period which I did in fact give the following week when I won the bid on the house.  I was paying month to month premium for  a year but they stuck the $2200 despite our verbal.    They also charged for a broken light fixture but at $200 instead of even the $100 that I found it on eBay AND they refused to replace it until I moved out.  Also when I was packing up to move, I asked the for move out items.  One thing not mentioned was “pool bands”.  They slapped me with a $150 lost item fee upon moveout and smugly attached the lease addendum that we signed a couple years ago regarding pool bands, which of course I never remembered which is why I stopped by the office to ask them specifically what I needed to present upon moveout.  So after paying approximately $6,300 in extra month to month rent already, they decided not to honor our verbal agreement and force me to adhere to the 60 day terms for an additional $2,200 plus utilities AND charged me with the $200 pendant light and the $150 pool bands to boot.   I hate that I had such a good relationship with the old management team that had to turn so negative at the end.  In all my years of leasing, I have never been so fee gouged or misled by an apartment community.  I almost filed a BBB claim but honestly I just want to be past all this mess. I have been a resident at Sage Pointe apartments for 2 years. At first the cost of the apartment was affordable but came with a high price. The roach infestation was horrible!!! Roaches everywhere!!! I bombed and sprayed the heck out of my apartment but nothing worked for over a year until I discovered the power of roach gel. I bought over $100 worth of roach gel and covered the perimeter and every nook and cranny with this stuff and now I only see the occasional roach. Now management of the complex has changed and a number of new parking rules have been put into place. There is not enough parking for residents around the complex and they have tow trucks swarming the complex every night. I have had my car towed twice in the past three months, the first and only two times in my life I have ever been towed and I am 29. It really sucks to think that you are following all of the parking rules and then wake up the next morning to find that your own apartment complex has towed your car. For this reason alone, the apartment complex has become out of my price range and I have put in my 60 day notice. This complex works with Dallas County VSF towing company. I know that legally apartment complexes are not allowed to make a profit from tows but there are a number of perks that an apartment complex can get when choosing to use a tow company. There are great articles out there on this. I am willing to bet Sage Pointe Apartments has some type of arrangement set up to help Dallas County VSF make a profit. Anyway, lesson learned. As I proceed forward in apartment shopping I now know to ask apartment complexes what their parking policies are, what their protocol is for parking violations, to know the name of the towing company with which they work, and to find out the ratio between the number of apartment complexes they have to the number of parking spaces. All that to say, I don’t recommend Sage Pointe apartments. The rent is cheap but living here comes with a very high price. The website rates this complex 4 stars but I have no idea how. Honest Review from a 6 month resident and a few things you should know before moving:

Can't argue about the location, about the best you can find in uptown Dallas being next to at least 10 restaurants/bars within a 5 minute walk. Unfortunately I do not think that makes up for some of the issues I've encountered during my time here and wish I had been informed about a few things before I actually moved it:

1. The floors must be insanely thin because you can hear every single footstep of the person above you (and know that the people below you can hear your footsteps as well).

2. On multiple occasions have walked into the lobby, an elevator, or common areas to see someone let their dog defecate or urinate and leave it there. Pretty disgusting but I guess that's more on the residents than the actually property. 

3. Had my AC go out in the middle of the summer and took the maintenance team a week to do a simple fix that probably took 10 minutes.

4. Christmas night lost all water, leading to a monstrous noise from the HVAC that forced me to leave my apartment and sleep somewhere else. 

5. Horrible internet connection for any provider throughout the building, and seemly no interest in installing any kind of wifi throughout the property which seems like a standard in this day and age. 

6. Had the garage gate broken down, preventing anyone from parking their car

7. Latches on their entrance doors to the building that don't actually latch properly, giving a false sense of security.

8. Elevator doors that open half way.

And I really don't mind that a lot of these issues have happened, you have to know that it is an old building. I am more upset by the MAA management's lack of communication to their residents. Even just sending out emails notifying people about issues that they are working on would be nice, but I guess that is not in their interest.

I love the location of this building and the paperwork to apply/move-in was very seamless and easy. After move-in, I've been quite frustrated with the way my apartment came. My dishwasher doesn't operate, dryer and shower don't heat, mailbox key wasn't working and my blinds don't go down. All these should have been inspected prior to move-in by the team. It's been half a month that I've gone without these things, which are basic appliances I'm paying for and cannot use in my own place. I've called the front office several times and they just say I'm in their "queue" along with the others. I think those who just moved in should be prioritized so we can at least use our appliances upon move in.

These other reviews are from several years ago. In 2019, I suggest looking at the other options around uptown. I have lived here for nearly a year. Over that time, the plumbing has been frequently shut off to the entire building (maintenance informs us the pipes are bad and there is no way to disconnect just one floor or apartment), my circuit breakers have gone bad and needed replacing, there are units being rented out on airbnb (contacted leasing office, they acknowledged one had been taken down while 6 remain), discovered vents were full of mold and mildew, and recently cars have been stolen from the parking garage. The elevators are old and creaky, and also super slow. Take your money elsewhere.

The staff has absolutely no customer service skills. I hardly ever have to interact with them but anytime I have they have been extremely short and unhelpful. They may think they interact with a lot of people but in reality they are not making the interactions count. It's really turning me off about the place. Just be nice to your residents!!

I've been here a year and I'll start with the issues first:

Theft is HIGH -My partner and I literally saw a catalytic converter get stolen AND a bike got stolen too. Neighbors have mentioned other incidents. Be REALLY vigilant of yourself and your belongings, security measures here are practically a joke.

If you want to use the gym facilities, be on the lookout as it's on the outside of the property above the leasing office. The small staircase leading up to it there's sometimes guys on the staircase or around the entrance of the staircase taking phone calls and it's very odd. 

Parking is usually a nightmare but often it's a coin flip. Management has recently started cracking down on multiple cars per lease but the most apparent issue is that residents are allowing their guests park inside of the property instead of designated visitor parking outside. The gates are also constantly breaking down and allowing non-residents to just come and park inside the property.
Late during weekends non-residents park inside the property next to buildings even blocking other vehicles and I mean parking - not having hazard lights on or someone in the car waiting. It's also rare that there is any type of parking enforcement, in my whole time here I've only seen the tow truck come in once. 

People usually don't respect the flow of traffic and will enter through the exit/exit through the entrance. It's mostly annoying if there are giant box trucks while someone is moving and the street that runs along the property is small so that just causes a small traffic jam but just annoying. 

Some tenants suck at cleaning up after their dogs and the areas are usually covered in poop because of them. They also tend to place trash next to the large property bins once they are full causing the sanitation workers to make a mess at pick up and have the parking area littered with garbage. They just don't like to keep that shared area clean and like it filthy. 

Ending on a positive note:

People here tend to be calm and mind their business. The apartments themselves are quite nice, at least our remodeled unit is. The pools for the most part have been well kept during my lease. I haven't had any major issues with the unit itself aside from annoying cooking smells that come from other units but that's to be expected.
