When we first moved in we discovered the apartment we got was not the same floor plan advertised to us, and even after accepting this as an honest mistake we soon found out the unit was riddled with bugs and wasps as well as broken infrastructure. We requested to be moved to a new unit which they were kind enough to do (at a higher price of course) only to find out that the A/C unit in the new unit was not powerful enough to keep the entire apartment conditioned. Took them about 3 visits to finally accept that the A/C might not be functioning properly and then a 4th visit to decide to finally replace the A/C unit. After about 13 days of living in an 80 degree apartment in the middle of Texas summer they finally replaced the A/C and everything seemed to be good finally. That is until we received our electric bill and saw that we had consumed 1700kwh in a 3 week billing period, and owed over $250. We of course checked the daily consumption and sure enough the broken unit ran 24/7 for 2 weeks and doubled our bill, as we had halfed the consumption rate once the A/C was fixed. We attempted to get the office to assist us in paying part of the bill as it is common sense that they should compensate for an issue out of our control, but after repeated trips to the office we still have yet to speak to the manager who always seems to be on the phone, out of office or just too busy to talk. Instead the management proceeded to gaslight us about it and try to convince us "that's just how it goes sometimes" and offered to only give a $40 rent credit for the 8 days it took for them to fix it and blamed us for moving to a new unit that wasn't ready for move in. So I guess they consider a bug infested apartment "ready for move in" but regardless they repeatedly have beat around the bush and avoided any responsibility and we cannot recommend anyone move here if they value being respected by their apartment management.

Maintenance staff is more on point with repairs in a timely manner. Recent staffing for trash valet has become more punctual and taking what has been put out rather than leaving anything behind. 

There are still issues with the complex gates remaining open all the time, as a result there are issues with vehicle vandalism/theft. My own vehicle had a tire stolen and left on the ground. While the rent is super doable; if you want to move in, make sure to also take steps for your own protection.

Maintenance never comes, the front office staff doesn’t even acknowledge when you need a request. They’re unprofessional and rude! I’ve been here 6 years and it’s getting worst everyday. I’ve been waiting almost 3 month for them to fix my oven but they have no problem charging late fees to late rent. Do not move here!

For one someone was just MURDERED over here last week so it's NOT a safe place at all. I also hear people cars get broken into a lot!! They NEVER answer the phones. The assistant manager is extremely RUDE he has very poor customer service, he went off on a tenant because they were mad about a payment mistake THEY made. Or maybe 4.  Depends on when they feel like coming back .  But the most frustrating... we pay the rent through the paylease app. Well, if you're late on you're rent and you make the total payment which includes the late fees, their system doesn't count the extra money as the late fee.. so it still looks like you owe a late fee.. obviously their book keeper doesn't know how to book keep and manually disperse this money into the correct allocated portion so they're just going with what their computer says and will put a lockout sign on your door until you pay the EXTRA late fees on top of what you've already paid!! DO NOT MOVE HERE IF YOU VALUE YOUR MONEY AND SANITY!
they don't do their job on time and trying to charge on tenants, it is very hard to reach office staff  they do not answer phone calls.

My family have been residents at Ridge Parc for over 10 years. The location is perfect in regards to the major highways, 408 and I20. The staff are very friendly and helpful, always there to serve you. However I do feel they take 2 hour lunch breaks so getting in touch with them in the afternoon is difficult. The apartments have a full size basketball court, a small workout center and a nice size pool. The room sizes are bigger than your average room and the included appliances are high tech. What I really love about these apartments is the atmosphere. The people are friendly and management keeps the area very clean.

My wife and I were having some issues at first and they gave us a second chance. These people are God’s gift to Earth. I love them all Miss Tammy, Miss Edenina, Miss Letty and ESPECIALLY Miss Jackie. I hope to move into a bigger apartment here soon. Keep up the good work ladies.

Absolutely love this place moved in 6 months ago. Office staff is  very nice, very professional and helpful. The maintenance crew is amazing. I would definitely recommend this place, location is great rent is very affordable and the apartments are very, very spacious.

I couldn't be happier and was so glad I found this apartment. My friend told me about Sun Colony. She's been here over ten years and her apartment looks great also. I moved in a year ago and just signed my third lease and haven't had any major issues.

My family and I lived here close to 3 years. During our stay, the manager, Ms Jackie is the most courteous, the most tenant oriented manager we've ever came across. She really works with your situation. No matter what issue we bring to her attentiom she always finds a way to fix it and even follows up to make sure if it's resolved. She really is the best. The apartment it self is not bad at all. We lived in a 2 bed 2 bath and it is very specious for an apartment, specially the closets are the best. We also like the lay out. I gave it a 4 star only because no apartment is perfect and we lived right by the main road (Royal ln) and the noise level was a bit annoying during traffic hours. But even that you get used to. If we didn't buy a house we wouldn't move out any time soon because the price is still fare comparing to near by apartments. Oh and it's very close to major highway (635). Over all we really liked it here.

Lived here nine years. It's not for everyone. Been beoken into once. Seen 4 fires here. Only a few maintenance crew who actually know how to fix things. Most of the office staff are pleasant to deal with. Summer's and summer nights are louder with music, outside loud phone conversations, some arguments but mostly music. Most drivers speed through the parking lot and swerve to avoid the speed bumps so make sure your kids are well supervised. Gated entrance only works 3-4 days of the month so it's usually open.
These are some pretty good apartments. They treat us fair and make the changes you need.

First off, the price for this area is magnificent...This an area called  CityPlace/ Uptown.A person can't  get it like this unless you step up & come join us.I have a car & don't drive it due to being so close to the train station.I have  DART buses on my street running all over the place as well.Who needs a car? I am truly getting my life!

I’m disgusted by the management team. Save your hard earned $$. I recently applied & they took my $$. Property manager is never on sight poorly manage by other parent mgrs they do not care for applicants & making poor decisions and running the business to the ground. I will be at peace when I get my refund back in my accounts until then I strongly suggest u find other properties to live. Again bad management. Don’t do it. thank me later!

I am an older, single, woman and have lived here for 4 months. The manager and staff here are kind and professional. So far I have felt safe here, and am proud to call this complex my home. I plan on staying here quiet a while.

I lived in this apartment complex for a little over a year and that was about all the time I could tolerate living there. From the day I moved in I had problems with the apartment. I had water leaking from my ceiling in the bathroom which caused about an inch of standing water in my bathroom when I came home one day. I reported this at least 3 times and a year later, nothing was ever done about it. It stopped for a long time, then started up again when I was leaving. In addition to this I had issues with my hot water for about 2 months. Again I reported this multiple times. I got responses saying it was fixed, yet I would wake up the next morning with no hot water to shower with. Again I reported it. Justin (the property manager at the time) assured me it was fixed. Again I took a shower and had hot water for all of 2 minutes. I reported it again and was basically told I was making this up and my hot water was working fine. He came over to test it and SURPRISE no hot water, I was not making something up! This issue was finally resolved 2 months and many cold showers later. Another huge issue, I had mice/one very large rat for the duration of my time living there. It chewed through hundreds of dollars worth of food during my lease, and also chewed through some plastic storage containers I had. Again this was reported multiple times and still the rat lives on. The management of this property is awful. They take weeks to get anything done, if it does ever get done, and are no help whatsoever with questions about the lease and fees and such. It is a good location close to White Rock Lake, but other than that I have nothing good to say about this property or its management. The apartments are cheaply built and not well kept. Highly recommend finding somewhere else to live.

Its sad to say. I paid the application fee, Admin fee, and deposit and still backed out of moving in right before signing the lease. The apartment wasnt ready but I was able to do a walk thru. It was a nice looking place besides the ROACHES. There were dead roaches all over the kitchen. I was terrified, I was told it was because they had pest control come out just recently. Well I waited to walk thru again once the cleaned the apartment.... There were more Roaches alive coming out the baseboards and in the shower. I feel so bad for whoever got APARTMENT #630. I lost all that money because I refuse to live with ROACHES. It was a beautiful nightmare!!!!

The management staff is extremely nice and work hard to take care of me and my needs. I like that it's a small complex but horrible parking if you have a two car household or invite guest over. The maintenance is prompt but the quality of work is not good. The apartments were renovated through fresh paint, new floors, new appliances and fixtures but it complex should have been stripped down to the studs. Been here a year and the paint was chipping and laminate floors were bubbling up  after 4 months. Not to mention bees, wasp, roaches and ants. Not worth the money in the long run but nice for a short stay.

I lived at Rock Creek Apartments for 3 ½ years and it was an overall good experience.  The location is fantastic.  The apartments are within walking distance of the grocery store, White Rock Creek and a park in Addison, and numerous restaurants.  

I did have some reservations, reasons this review is not 5 stars.  Those include, the age of the building, which is old, and there is only so much that can be done to compensate.  New paint only does so much.  As well, there were always pests, which is unsurprising.  Finally, there were some security concerns and incidents on the apartment property during our time which did not leave a sense of safety.

On the other hand, when something did break, the complex has a very good maintenance team who fixed things quickly.  They are effective and timely, and the complex got specialists in when they needed.

All in all, I would recommend this complex as a home if you know what you are getting for the price.  It is a great place with some significant drawbacks, but the staff really do care and want to serve you.

Well, this historical moment found us at Rock Creek Apts. without power for several days.  The apartment complex shut the water off somewhere in all that mess to prevent further bursting of pipes.  We're back in the apts. now with electricity but still no water.  However, this isn't a review to complain.  This is a review to to let you all know the apartment complex staff really care about their residents.  They have been dealing with rude residents and people who apparently are not living in reality.  We appreciate the staff so much.  They had cases of water shipped in and were handing those out to residents.  They set up port a potties all around the property so people could use the restroom.  They suggested we get water from the pool to use for flushing toilets.  They have been working night and day to get us all back up and running.  I'm appalled at the people who complain.  It's all of us going through this.  I've got nothing but GREAT things to say about this staff and I have personally thanked them as best as I can.  Stay humble people.  Stay kind.  Thank you again Rock Creek Staff for EVERYTHING you are doing!  Great job!

I’ve been a resident since September 2017 and I love it here. The office staff is VERY professional and always nice. The parking lot is always clean and well lit and the complex is generally quiet and peaceful.  Hands down my BEST apartment living experience!!!

If you are looking for a responsive apartment complex, with decent upkeep, and amenities that work. This is not the one. The new company that took it over has very outdated paperwork and payment processing with a lot of bugs that haven't been fixed. I lived here for a year and honestly it wasn’t that bad till the new company took it over. The gate is broken most of the time and myself and neighbors have experienced and witnessed crimes taking place in the complex. You will simply get reminded that the account will be sent to collections. Womp womp. (Evidence of the clean apartment was provided.)

I have had a busted water line for a week and no one has come to even look at it. Talked to the office three times about it and was told "Old buildings tend to leak." communication is very poor and the parking lot is more potholes than street.

We love living here it is very pet friendly and we love the dog park! It is the best looking and best maintained property on the block.. Imelda and the rest of the team are the best and will always help you fix any problems you have big or small!

I have lived in many different places and this has been one of the best for me. Management has always been responsive and helpful if something arises based on my experience. I like the cozy and safe atmosphere and I would recommend this place.

You get out what you put in.
 
Pros: I've been a resident here since September 2014 and I like that it's quiet, cozy and relaxing here. I haven't had any major issues, the staff are attentive, and maintenance responds to my requests in a reasonable time frame.

Cons: My kitchen appliances are out of date, the laundry facilities washer and dryers are also out of date and visitors access is very minimal with strict towing regulations.

The closets are big and they have a play ground for kids.
I have been living in this apartment for 6 years. I don't intend moving out. Great environment and management team.
Emily answered all my questions and went above and beyond and I’m one happy resident!
I fell in love with this wonderful property. I appreciate the help I received from Jasmine. Everything was wonderful!

I moved into Vail Quarters in 2009 and was the first person to live in my unit.  During my 10 year stay I have seen many changes on management and a change in ownership.  Throughout that time there were no issues.  Maintenance request were always completed in a timely fashion and the office was always friendly and respectful.

Unfortunately due to work I had to move this past March at the end of my lease.  Maribel (Community Assistand Manager) and Erick (Community Manager) are super awesome people.  Inspite of living in the apartment for 10 years the move out process was seemless and I was given my deposit back.
This place is great ! Excellent management wonderful pool great maintaince ! No bugs consider this place

Anytime someone walks up and down the stairs it sounds like they are stomping. the parking is very limited and it has gotten worse and worse during the last year. If you don’t mind living with roaches and rodents, then this is the place to be for real.  Pest control only takes place on the 1st of every month and maintenance take forever as well. If you have DIY skills in both maintenance and pest control, then this is the ideal place for you to live. This complex is well over 30yrs old. Again only after threatening to sue did they fix it. They will lie to you. They will upcharge. Take this place with a mountain of salt.
I had no ac for almost 3 months, my carpet was wet for almost 2 weeks, would not had water on my showers every other day !

What can I say. PLEASE DO NOT MOVE HERE. We have been here for almost 3 months and we have had about every pest infestation that there can be; rats, mouses, cockroaches, fleas, ants. Maintenance fails to repair anything!!! we have been without a working A/C for over two weeks and it’s been 100 degrees almost every day. Just please do not move here

Do you like having roaches crawl all over your apartment? Then this is the place for you!!!! This place is an absolute joke. I was showed two decent looking units on my tour. Save your time, spend more money, and get a nicer place. Trust me.

They do not help because the maintenance workers say that the owner does not buy the parts from them, it is very sad to see that they cannot help as they should, I hope the owners have more so that those who are there can continue here

Great place to stay. The location is so convenient. It is to a Whole Foods, Northpark Mall, The Shops, Timber Creek Crossings, Target AND Costco! They also have a great after school program for kids and it’s free. Apart from that, the office staff is always so nice.

I’ve lived here for more than 10 years and this place has gone downhill over the last two. Security is non-existent as of the last year, trash sits in the parking lot for weeks, the maintenance guys are kind and helpful but major repairs will never happen, the front office has one or two great people but the manager will avoid you at all cost so they can’t ever get an answer to actually help you, and the pool has black mold all over the bottom with half the pool chairs ripped up.

All in all, for a similar price you can find a better property that is much safer. It’s heartbreaking because this place uses to be so beautiful until the manager cut so many costs that it’s just not worth it.

Dont stay here! I've been at this apartment 4 months and I still have renovation tape on my kitchen light, no door handles on my bathroom cabinets. We have to pay for valet trash, and they don't even pick up at the times they are suppose to. Whenever I call the front desk, I am ran in circles about any issue that I need fixed. They always say tomorrow something will be taken care of or I'll receive a call back shortly, and it never happens. I tried to give them months to solve these issues, and still NOTHING. Dont even waste your time. Communication was amazing until after I signed my lease. Very disappointed.

The staff here are very unprofessional and do not follow up with a potential renter.  Their lack of decent grammar only adds to this problem.  I could afford the apt they were offering and gave them all the information and fees which were about $400.  I was the one that had to keep following up and could not get any information or answer.  They allegedly contacted my employer but when I followed up the HR people had not gotten a voice mail or anything.  So in the end they sent back the $200 deposit but kept all the rest.  I could understand if I just didn't fit their qualification standards and didn't approve me.  But it didn't seem like that was the issue at all.  Poor service and unethical practices.

I would avoid this complex at all cost. The new management is trying to third party everything so they don't hold any responsibility. Honestly, I don't even know why those office workers are there, they don't do anything but make false agreements then deny it later.

1. The unit I rented had a flea issue and they "tested" it saying it came up negative. This is all despite me catching them in my vacuum and bring it to them to show in the canister (and being bitten everywhere in my own home). I ended up having to treat the apartment myself since they refused to do anything.

2. If you see Regina working at the office just turn around. You will not be getting anything resolved or help. She just deflects all issues and nothing ever gets resolved. She is also veeeery rude. I'm not happy all the time either but there is no professionalism.

3. When I moved out, they stated in their e-mail that I would have 1 month to drop off the final check. They sent the debt collectors to me a week after sending me the final bill. Despite all this, I still had their check to them in less than a month. But now the debt collectors are harassing me since Churchill does not communicate with them.

4. I would rank them lower but you have to give at least one star to leave a review. We live in the apartment right above where the poor girl was stabbed to death last month and had a package stolen from our door step by the same guy that might. 
I understand that when you live in a city, things like this happen but this apartment had a chance to make improvements to fix their security and waited until someone died to do any of it. Our friends who also live in the apartment complex had their door kicked in and their apartment torn apart a couple months before this and nothing was done to fix the security. At first it seemed like the apartment was finally going to step up after the murder, but now I think that all we got was a few new lights. 
Please stay safe and find anywhere else to live.

This is a great community. We love it here and our fur babies love it here too. Very pet friendly.
What a great community. The manager is delightful and easy to work with. My apartment is cute and a perfect size for me and my pup.
Great place to hang your hat up... that is for sure. Location is key!

AVOID THIS APARTMENT COMPLEX!

Apartment life is crappy. If you've lived in an apartment complex you know that.. but this management company here is downright awful!

Apartment breezeways and staircases are constantly filthy and riddled with trash, cigarette butts, empty alcohol bottles and cans, you name it!

The people here just let their pets crap all over the place and they dont pick it up. I had a guy look me dead in the eye while his dog crapped on the grass and then he just walked away.

People are loud, blasting music all hours of the night unchecked.

Lastly the PARKING. OMG...

First off their spaces are so tight that there is literally no margin for error when parking.. and you know how people park.

We pay money to live here and our cars are getting towed... even with the expired parking pass on the car! Such bad business! Does management care? Not at all. That's fine. Ill be breaking my lease and moving elsewhere.
Prose at New Hope is a quiet community, with high-quality common spaces. The apartments are beautiful, with excellent distribution. It's an excellent place to live!
I really like living here because management is efficient, professional. Thank you!
It has been so nice coming here and feeling like home when I walk in. The apartments are bright and spacious. It makes it so easy to feel like I can live here a long, long time.
Great and helpful staff, great location and wonderful amenities.

From the first day I stepped onto the property until move-in day and now a month into my lease, the whole process with the Alta Vale staff has been seamless. Brand new apartments on a property that is well upkept was exactly what I was looking for. When I moved in I had no issues getting my key and no issues with anything in my apartment. The complex is quiet outside of some construction going on for townhomes, but you know that moving in. Hannah in leasing was amazing from start to finish, and everyone is professional and nice. My building is secure which I like, and they host packages through butterfly which keeps your packages secure as well. I would highly recommend this apartment complex to anyone looking for an apartment.
Wish the noise barrier between floor levels and apartment units was better..
Great rooms, neighbors, prices, dog park, near the greenway and so much more! What else could you ask for?! Very pleased with my stay. :)
There are amenities here that no other properties in the area have! The apartments and halls are as incredible as the local staff! Can’t recommend enough!

I appreciate that Alta Vale feels like home.  After being a homeowner for two plus decades, I didn't  know what to expect, but the experience here has been altogether pleasant.  Albeit limited, I have enjoyed my exchanges with the staff. They have been helpful and very cordial. The apartment itself is nice. Interior space is allocated with applied sense to daily life. The daily tokens, such as trash collection, have been a treat I didn't expect to have. All around, I am thankful for this community.

Moved into this apartment complex towards its opening and all the things you look for (location, property, amenities, etc.), Alta Vale does really well, and I have enjoyed.

The part that has become very aggravating is the noise.  Upon moving in, it was communicated that the construction to the building would be done in Dec. of '23.  The noise in the intermediary was louder than I had anticipated when signing lease and unfortunately, it was failed in sharing that dozens of townhomes will be put up surrounding the property.  

With that being said, the early morning alarm of steel cutting and heavy machinery, etc. does not seem to go away for at least another year.  The noise, along with the occupancy of the parking lot by construction equipment/remanence of an active job site, can certainly be aggravating should you work remote or not leave by 6am.

Hope the experience improves sooner rather than later!

Very lengthy but everyone must read this. My boyfriend has been living here since 2023. When he moved in, in NOVEMBER, He did not have heat for the 1st 3 months, but they still illegally charged him rent. Then, there was a leak in his closet which ruined all his clothes, and the management did nothing , did not even help clean it up. Then, come to find out, after a weird smell in the water system of his apartment , that the water was contaminated and undrinkable or healthy to use. It would leave stains on the dish wear and smelled of mold. When complaining to the management, they said they couldn’t do anything and moved him to a new apartment, TO WHICH THEY IMMEDIATELY PUT UP THE DIRTY WATER APARTMENT FOR RENT AGAIN WITHOUT FIXING THE ISSUE.
As for the fire alarm issue, i’m currently writing this while the fire alarm is going off ONCE AGAIN for the 5th time in a month. The fire department gets called and they can’t do anything about it. When the fire alarm went off at 11 pm until 2 am multiple times in a week, no one from the leasing office would answer and they claimed they didn’t even know what was going on . It was freezing weather outside and a leak happened in the garage to which keeps setting off the alarm and they can’t even be bothered to fix the issue and would let the water freeze on the floor. Everyone would wait in their cars because it was freezing outside. I literally do not know how this place passed the Department of housing inspection. Everyone should report them that lives here because this is absolutely ridiculous especially for the amount of rent you pay!
Also, they illegally towed his car FROM THE GARAGE even though he had a resident sticker and made him pay 250$ to get it back.
This is by far the worst apartment I have had to experience . Do yourself a favor and save your money and headache and don’t live here.

Fire alarm goes off multiple times in the middle of the night. Fire department has left while alarm is still going at 3am after looking at it for over 1 hour, since it seems the issue can't be solved on the firefighters end.

These random fire alarms also happen in the middle of the day, and personally has been an issue with my pet.
Took a look at the apartments. Way bigger than anticipated and the ladies in the office were very helpful. Looking forward to living here soon!

What can I say about this place? Amazing!!! We have waited for the District at 54 to start touring so we could check it out. We were pleasantly surprised to find that the quality of this community far exceeded all our expectations. Although I have slowed down in life, the home-work-shop-dine-play possibilities are endless here. The location is one of the best locations in the triangle offering easy access to almost any location in Raleigh. Within 1 mile of I-40, easy access to 440, 540, and 5-10 miles to Cary, Morrisville and Crabtree. Midtown and North Hills are 10-13 miles. The apartment we toured was the smallest two bedroom but the layout was very practical with focus on larger bathrooms, closets and the kitchen. The quality is mostly what you would see in a custom single family home. No need to pay for a gym as they have state of the art equipment, several well appointed lounges to relax or watch your favorite games in. They have work from home pods that can be reserved. They offer so much more than I have listed. Go check it out. And, the staff is absolutely wonderful!!

The Keaton is an amazing, beautiful, upscale complex for a very reasonable price. It seems no attention to detail has gone unnoticed throughout the common areas and it feels like I’m walking down the hallway of a luxury hotel when going to my apartment. I love it here!
The maintenance team is awesome, they provided excellent customer service and got the job done the same day.
I am so ecstatic that I chose to live at The Keaton at Brier Creek. I absolutely love my apartment, the location, the amenities, and the staff is also amazing.

This community is clean quiet and very friendly.  Centrally located to everything  with close and easy highway access. Living at the Keaton is like Living in a private world.  I love and I  know any new tenants will love it too.
Beautiful, clean environment with amazing leasing staff. Very welcoming!

Keaton is awesome! We fell in love with it at first sight, and the moment we stepped through the door, we knew we wanted to live here. A month has passed, and our feelings haven’t changed. We’re so happy to be part of such a wonderful community.

The Keaton is a beautiful place. I love living here.The entire staff is really nice and they always have time for the residents and strive to make sure everyone is happy. They always have great events going on, which gives you a chance to meet your neighbors.
Derek is the best EVER! Sososo nice, helpful and welcoming always.

The Keaton is simply amazing! I really lucked out finding this stunning property. All of the staff at The Keaton are just so wonderful. Miyeah made it so easy for me to choose this place as my new home. From the apartments, to the on site amenities, to the proximity to all the stores and restaurants, this place is by far the best place to live. I knew immediately that this was the place for me. I highly recommend The Keaton to everyone.

I am so impressed with everything about this community, most importantly the management and staff. They are kind, responsive, knowlegeable, helpful, hardworking, and committed to highest quality standards. The grounds are impeccably maintained and the buildings are well constructed and maintained. The location is close to shopping and restaurants. I highly recommend The Keaton at Brier Creek for your next apartment home.
I have been at the Keaton at Brier Creek for 2 months now and love the community.
The Keaton is a beautiful property and you have a great staff. Everyone is very friendly and I think they’re doing a great job.

I am very pleased with my decision to move in The Keaton of Brier Creek. I love everything about my apartment, from the high ceilings open floor plan and modern appliances. The staff is amazingly friendly and efficient . I love being able to walk to the shopping center.
My overall experience with The Keaton is absolutely fantastic! I am so impressed with the staff and the beauty of the property.
Management & Leasing nice, fees as suspect, maintenance is nice, area is nice.
very nice office staff and maintenance team! tries to resolve any issues quickly!

I seriously love living here. The staff really took the time and listened to my needs and helped me find the perfect apartment. My move in was extremely smooth, my only work order was addressed same-day, and I have truly felt like I have a community here instead of just an apartment. The location, amenities, and apartments are second to none in my opinion. Seriously, the gym here is AMAZING!
The internet package seems steep but for what you’re getting, it is WELL WORTH IT. 
Everything has been seamless so far!! Highly recommend!!

Madison Wakefield is in a great location. It’s super close to restaurants and shops, and there is a Harris Teeter right across the street too. Maintenance is always fast, and the office staff is always friendly and helpful too!

Here are your perks: new apartment, nice design, good location.  When you sign lease things can  and do change. There have been 3 staffing changes since I've moved here and 1 maintenance staff change as well. If I'm honest the people that should stay there  the longest don't. That's one red flag. I had an experience where the electrical meters numbers were mixed up and had my powered shut off randomly. Luckily I was able to take to the contractor who turned it off and he stated the numbers listed on the electrical meters were mixed. That translates into you not knowing if you are paying for someone else's energy bill. That's another red flag. The bug situation has been trauma for me. Let me say this I don't believe most people have the same big problem has me but just be aware that there could be depending on the apartment you choose. Especially the ground level. Speaking on ground level. This noise level when living in apartment can be intense depending on neighbors. This apartment build was thrown together and probably cheap materials used so you can hear everything. The landscaper and his blower, the neighbors, the Mexican restaurants that have live music on weekends and one plays tuba, you'll hear car slams, people talking loudly walking by. Walls are thin you should understand that.

Monica and Michelle were very professional and great to work with.
I could not be happier with the apartments they are beautiful, not to mention the entire complex surrounded by nature and woods.
The neighborhood is nice and quiet a friendly place to live, is close to everything!
The team was really helpful and the location is on point. Win win!
I love it here its so peaceful and beautiful. Its literally in the middle of everything couldn't ask for a perfect spot.

I moved here with my wife and 1 month old baby from another state on Friday, Oct 18. Application process was smooth, and it was all great until I landed at this place. I reached here 12 days after my lease start date and followed up at least 10 times before coming here to ensure that apartment is move-in ready and all the issues were taken care, so they had enough time for all this.. It was anything but move-in ready when we opened the door, Bedroom carpet had stains, blind was broken, closet was all dirty and stained, door lock had no batteries, patio was all dirty with spider webs all around, few things were broken in bathrooms, fan lamp was not working, air filter was not replaced and there was bad smell all around and list goes on,  forget about cleaning, it wasn’t even vacuumed properly. Seems like no inspections was done basically. John from the maintenance team( giving 1 star because of him, otherwise this place is a negative) is the only good thing about this place, he was very polite and listened to all our concerns and scheduled a carpet replacement for Monday (still waiting for this to get done as I post this and it was scheduled for Monday AM) and handled few minor issues on the same day. I also got a storage outside as specials which had no light and filled with dead bugs, don’t think will be ever able to use that as it is more like a garbage bin than storage. So, I am in a situation where I feel I have to spend a lot of time in cleaning a newly leased apartment and will be busy killing the roaches (they are huge here) until I get out of here. Don’t expect any privacy, one of the carpet guys just walked into locked apartment without knocking when we were in there, not sure how he got access to the apartment, concerning! Walls are thin here so you can hear people walking upstairs. Don’t fall for the trap because of apartment size and pictures on the website, it is not a good place to live specially with family.
PS: I have mostly written positive feedback in my life, just could not hold this one.

Apartments great. Staff communication could be better. Rates are high for the area. Maintenance is terrible. I tell people it?s great if nothing goes wrong in your apartment and maintenance is never needed.

The apartment layouts are nice and up to date. Amenities are nice and improving as much as possible. The complex has begun to be more noisy than in the past. Aside from people outside and bass from music playing all night, if you have anyone living above you, you’ll be able to hear their footsteps throughout. I can hear my neighbors have conversations in the bathroom, hear their footsteps and even when they use the microwave. For the money, it isn’t worth it.

Aventura Crossroads is perfectly located for anything you could want in the Triangle. We love our apartment, and we appreciate the diverse community. Despite what some have said, I only occasionally hear doors closing, especially on windy days. The leasing staff are extremely helpful, and the maintenance team is always quick to respond to requests for service. We are very happy with our choice!
Top notch customer service, professional and friendly community staff that are quick to respond to an issue
Despite its faults on maintenance and staff turnover; It is a good location, well built apartment homes and beautiful property.

Very nice property.  No issues, I see some have said the walls were thin. But I rarely here anything from my neighbors.  Beautiful trail for runners or walkers.  A nice playground and dog park.  Plenty of parking. I have never had an issue with repair requests, maintenance is friendly and efficient.

I have been living here for almost a year  now, enjoyed it until some inconsiderate neighbors moved over top of me. Walking extremely loud and making a lot of noise over my head everyday.  Waking me up coming home late at night keeping a lot of noise. Tried to reason with them and got nowhere. When l complained  to the office about them and was resured  they would talked to them which they did. My neighbors got worst because l complained about them. I went back to the office and so did my neighbors telling lies on me. I came home one day and found a letter on my door stating l would be evicted along with my inconsiderate neighbors. I have  been a good tenant pay my rent on time, quite and mind my own business. I was very disappointed with the way things was handle. I will not be renewing my lease when it ends. If you move over here make  sure you get an apartment on the third floor because you could end up with inconsiderate neighbors and end up evicted at no fault of your own.

Do not expect privacy from management. We have lived in this community for 7 1/2 months and maintenance has keyed into the apartment three times with no notice for routine (non-emergency) maintenance. My wife is home with our kids during the day while I am at work and does not open the door to strangers (for obvious reasons). On three separate occasions, property management provided no notice for routine maintenance...things like changing the air filter, reading the water meter, etc...all things that we did not know would be occurring. Since we were not aware these maintenance visits would be taking place, my wife did not answer the door bell as she was not expecting anyone. Needless to say, she was quite startled to hear the door unlock and a man come stepping in. She was not dressed appropriately on one of the incidents. I communicated to the property manager each time that we would appreciate it if we could be given at least a 24 hour notice for routine (non-emergency) maintenance. The property manager apologized each time and assured me it would not happen again but it continues to happen. On two of the incidents, management gave the master key to a 3rd party contractor that is not even an employee of the community! Imagine as a woman, stepping out of the shower and looking up the hallway to see a man walking in that you have no idea who he is. Although we understand that the lease states they can enter with or without notice and NC law does not require maintenance notice, a little common courtesy (and common sense) would be greatly appreciated. There is term called right to "quiet enjoyment". We have zero confidence at this point that they will ever provide any notice. How much effort does it take to leave a note on the door or send an email saying maintenance needs to visit on MM/DD? Instead they just give the key to the technician and tells him to enter if no one answers. So beware, they can and will enter at any time with no notice. I have rented several dwellings for over seven years and never once had maintenance enter without notice until we moved to Palisades at Legacy Oaks. We certainly will not be renewing our lease and I do not recommend this community for anyone that seeks privacy.

Apartments are beautiful but walls are paper thin! If you so happen to get rude inconsiderate neighbors like I have who need to realize their floor is my ceiling you will definitely regret living here, parking is a mess, & people do not pick up their dog waste....I HATE IT HERE, once my lease expires there's no chance of me renewing, don't be fooled by the "new community" do yourself a favor and choose another place

This place seems nice and quiet but there is still not a lot of people living here yet. I see this place going downhill quick when more people move in. First off there are ALWAYS people at the pool after hours who are REALLY loud especially late at night. This is rather annoying because I work 40 hours plus a week and like my sleep. Also every time I walk my dog at night I always get a VERY strong smell of marijuana which is very displeasing. I would love to see rules being more in forced. I feel like this community is just trying to get people moved in by bending some rules which is unfair to people like me who does everything right I.e pay my pet deposit, pick up after my dog, and don't go to the pool after hours, don't use illegal substances, and stay quiet. I would also like a higher police presence if possible. We will see if things improve. I have seen some trash building up as well such as empty alcohol bottles. Please keep this community clean and quiet!!!!

I have been living at LC Brier Creek for 2 years and I just renewed my lease! I toured this property when it was first being built in 2020 and I moved in a year later in 2021. I was surprised to see the other reviews mentioning hidden fees. Management has always been clear and upfront with all monthly costs (rent, amenities, utilities, etc). I have lived at a few other communities in North Carolina and this is by far the best maintained property. Maintenance and work orders are  always done in a timely and professional manner. A lot of other properties usually have high turnover with staff and residents. The friendly staff has stayed the same over the years and only a few of my neighbors have moved out of the community. I can see myself staying here until I buy my first house.

This place is horrible. Loud construction all day, dirty roads with reckless drivers, extra fees all the time that you won’t see coming, thin and cheap walls, and shady business practices. They made me pay $1200 to replace an already new carpet for the entire upstairs because of a few stains that were underneath the carpet (not visible from the outside). While a professional cleaning service company could have eliminated these stains because they were so small and new, LC ripped up the carpet and charged me before I even knew there were any stains. They blindly rip up carpets in hopes for a stain so they can charge you at their leisure. They even charge $25 if you don’t bring your little trash can back in your place by 9am. I promise you that you will HATE living here.

After 20 years of renting, this is hands down the worst property mgmt company I have ever rented from. You can pay your rent on time, take great care of the apartment, and be a good, quiet tenant and the staff will still find something to be rude and antagonistic about. The leasing agents act very petty and are in need of some serious coaching about professional behavior. This company will also try and sneak in extra fees each month on your account without telling you and you have to jump through hoops to get them removed. Pro Tip: threaten to use a lawyer and that will expedite getting erroneous fees removed quicker.

This pricing isn’t great, but overall seems to have more sq ft than compared to other options for pricing. However, you can easily tell that they don’t take care of stuff. They don’t fix normal wear and tear from precious renters. The gates are never even closed, so I don’t feel like we even need them or the key card. I have no idea how to let anyone in with my “code” can’t get it to work and the office was not help in figuring it out. The dog waste bins are always overflowing. There’s still dog waste all over the place. Theres often no where to park near your own apartment. If they fix anything it’s half way and the cheapest option. And that’s just the start.
the corridor is so dirty and the management dont realy care that much ,uninhabitable period

My roommate and I have been here for about 6 months. Very quiet community, parking is alright. Emergency maintenance can be a pain as it is a call center not affiliated with MAA, but during office hours John is amazing and efficient when fixing any and all problems! Yale locks are easy to use, wish there was a key slot on doors for the dead lock as you can only get in from the pinpad. No complaints though we love living here!
We have been living at MAA Crabtree for three months now and plan to be here a long time! The staff goes out of their way to make sure our needs are met and are always enthusiastic and friendly!

I’ve been here for only 7 months and I’m counting down the days until my lease is up. From pest/ mice issue, poor maintenance workers, who leave the apartment filthy when they actually do show up it takes months for them to show up, you have to stress it several times and the staff STILL DO NOT CARE. Ever since we had new management things have really went down hill. My rent with up, cable doesn’t even work and it’s a hassle to get somebody to fix it. mold in showers, leaks in bathroom sinks, toilet issues, shower drain clogged. Broken AC unit, they came to fix it and gave me a portable AC unit that causes water damage in my living room leaking into the neighbors that live below me. You turn the heat on and the fire alarm goes off. When I moved in, the unit barley looked like they vacuumed or cleaned in there or did little to no work.  This place is HORRIBLE and they are MONEY HUNGRY  , I moved in as a first time renter in a rush trying to move out. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE TO ANYBODY KEEP LOOKING. only pro is they don’t have breed restrictions.

The whole process was unprofessional. There was a lack of communication & some false advertising. I wanted to see the apartment before I moved in and they stated I could only see it on move in day. I paid hundreds to move in only for the office staff to move me into an apartment that was not all the way ready. I haven’t been here a full month and my stay hasn’t been so pleasant. From having a broken tub, to maintenance walking in and out of my apartment is just too much. When I approached the office staff they didn’t seem to care. As a new resident I didn’t think I would be treated this way.

Maybe it's due to the pandemic but I could not download a copy (for printing) of the lease agreement before signing it. I had to resort to reading the contract on my phone, not recommended. I had a bad experience with the leasing office about the terms of renting an apartment at their complex. Honestly, I probably would have still rented there however that interaction does not sit well with me. To put icing on the cake my car was stolen in broad daylight after the second night of staying in the apartment. They could have at least pretended like they cared that would have gone a long way with me as a tenant. 

The apartment is ok. Its poorly laid out, some spaces are too large and others too small in the apartment. The design just doesn't make sense at times but it's not horrible. No linen closet in the master bedroom area. Kitchen too large and laundry room too small. No pantry!!!!!!!!! Bedrooms are small. Packages are misdelivered constantly. 

Last but not least, I work from home. I had submitted a request for Maintenace to complete. some tasks in the apartment. I noted that they did not have permission to enter the apartment. I heard a knock, and I responded just one second and before I know it, I heard the door opening. I quickly yelled "Hold on I am coming; I have to put some clothes on." Should probably let renters know how they will be contacted if no permissions are given. The leasing agent certainly did not have an issue getting in touch with me when I had not signed that contract!

I read several negative reviews. All were months before I moved in (9/23/2022). I could not relate. Office team was great, and apartment is spaciuos. Price quite competitive. Had 3 service calls and all were addressed very timely. Location is close to a LOT of stores, restaurants, and services, yet quiet at night. A great find.

I get that certain things come with any place lived in by another person, but when you raise the price of rent by $200 + and hardly anything has been added to make the apartment better, you constantly see bugs and roaches even after the exterminator sprays, the windows "sweat" year round causing some kind of mildew on all the window seals it makes the living experience terrible. The are better apartments in the surrounding area if you're able to afford it. The only reason my girlfriend and I renewed the lease is because despite the increase it's still cheaper than everywhere else. Moral of the story is only move here if you have no other options and don't mind bugs, roaches, and heavy-footed neighbors. Great area, below average place to stay.

*WARNING* We had a TERRIBLE and LOUSY experience with the leasing team, where they do not care about prospective customers. We got a price and could not fill out an application because of website issues--Site manager DANIEL did not send us an application as promised within 24 hours and said he would honor that first price. We email and call them the same day, and NO ANSWER or NO FOLLOW UP. The next day we have to fill out another form, then do not hear back for four days. We show up, and THEY BLAME US for having technical issues and DISHONOR the original price, wanting to charge about $300 MORE PER MONTH on the price. They have a BAD REPUTATION for treating people this way. We are HAPPY TO LOOK ELSEWHERE.

Went two separate weeks without hot water and management did not see this as a big deal or as an issue that needed immediate attention.  Having lived here for years this struck me as something that would require immediate attention, but Daniel, the property manager didn't seem to care and refused to call me back after hours to discuss why this has taken so long when the hot water heater was to be delivered and installed today.  This property has steadily gone down hill since i moved in here three years ago.  If I had known these issues would have arisen I NEVER would have renewed for another year.  I cannot wait to get out of my lease and away from this complex!!!!

This community and property is the first I have ever wanted to renew a lease with and continue my residency with. I would like to give them a perfect rating but little things here and there are inconvenient and the fault of these items aren't with the property or its staff, which are phenomenal. 

Their resident website though usable, is not the best and could use an overhaul. Maintenance request through the leasing office can be hit or miss; apparently only the property manager can submit them to the system and if you give that request to a leasing agent, it might never get recorded. 

From there everything else about the property is great. the staff is friendly and knows my name. They have many activities for their residence and little activities that make living there an experience.

Forced cable package that costs more than my preferred package from the same provider, no less.  Trash all over the parking lots, dog poo in the grass, apathetic office staff.  They keep jacking up the rent but make no improvements.  Maintenance is inept, incapable of simple repairs.

The things  I liked most about my year long stay at Autumn Ridge was the quietness of the neighborhood and real wood fireplaces, which are almost impossible to find. Management and maintenance were always exceptionally responsive in the few times I needed them. Had a brand new refurbished apartment too! Give them a strong look. You will be glad you did!

On the surface it looks like a great place - beautiful grounds, good location. But in the past eight or nine months it has gone downhill. There's trash littering the property around the buildings and in the parking lot, more nighttime appearances by police due to disturbances, and the pool and surrounding area have been shut down the entire summer. The pool was completely unusable beginning in the spring of 2018 and never opened at all. There have also been issues with their online payment system. I've spoken with several of my neighbors and they're all concerned about the same issues. Don't even bother with Autumn Ridge.

I visited in February and loved what I saw. Then I moved here in June and for the first month it was a pretty good experience. I was excited to be close to fun spots in the area.

The day I moved in, my neighbor said “This is a place you move OUT of, not into.” Yikes. Now that I’ve been here for a few months, I understand why. 
1. The pool was supposed to open in May, but it didn’t open at all this summer. I never saw people working on it, and we didn't get any discount for it on rent.
2. The office will mark online that they have completed our maintenance requests without ever walking into the apartment. How can you fix a broken toilet or spray for roaches if you don’t enter the room? 
3. I didn’t want to pay extra for washing machines, so I was happy to hear they have laundry rooms across the property. The problem? They don’t have air conditioning, and the machines are filled with dead, and sometimes alive bugs as well. 
4. The stairs are always disgusting, with bugs and cobwebs. I have never seen them power washed. 

Basically, don’t live here. I moved here for the price and the location, but it's just not worth it. I'm paying too much money for such a disappointing experience.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. The customer service from the manager has been non-existent over the past month and now I am being charged an additional $800 of which I do not owe. Customer Service for Autumn RIdge has become horrific since new management took over.

My fiancé and I have lived at Autumn Ridge for almost 4 years now. We have had a pretty good experience here until this past year. We have seen the high turnover rate from the staff at the office over the last 2 years. The team here now has been the worst bunch so far. 

1. When I called to verify when our lease ended, I was sent to a call center. The people working at the call center no nothing about your lease or anything. So it is beyond unhelpful. My fiancee called multiple times and finally got someone that could help with our lease. We were simply told we could not renew our lease because they were going to renovate our apartment at the end of the lease. The only option we were given was to move to a newly renovated apartment in a different building. So essentially we have 4 months to figure out where we would like to live. The apartment complex gave us NO indication that we would have to be moving when we renewed our lease or anything. Modern apartments bustling with renovations and a lively community. The staff will win you over. As I mentioned before this complex looks to you to pay for things that are their responsibility. Overall, in a majority of my commutations with the staff at the leasing office I found that most of them had no idea what they were talking about- information was always conflicting and the office manager was always extremely rude (which I’m sure is due to some underlying racism because I never witnessed her speak to other residents the way she spoke to me ) . I just re-newed my lease. I like living here. The location is great. I moved from Cary. I love North Hills and spend a lot of time there and Glenwood South. I work inside the beltline on Glenwood Avenue, so I am only one exit away, and I dont have to even get on the beltline to come to and from work.  The gym that I am a member of has three locations in VERY close proximity to the Crossroads at North Hills. But the apt complex also has a facilty with gym equipment. I'm constantly discovering shops and restaurants in very close proximity to the apartments. My most recent find is a beautiful greenway within walking distance of the apartments. I have been getting same day answers to my questions.  I also like the mail delivery service. I also like that people don't congregate in the parking lot with loud music blaring.  These are things as a single female that I pick up on. Safetly has not been an issue here for me. I noticed the laundry facility has a website access so you can go back to your apartment and log in any time and see your laundry/the laundry room.  Enjoy!
