I have had some maintenance problems from time to time, but the maintenance staff are cool, personable, and can resolve your issue in a day or two.  Honestly, for Raleigh, the price is great. If I don't go overseas for work, I'll definitely stay here another year.

I'm not sure where these bad reviews are coming from? I have been here for about 6 months and have no complaints. Management is organized and professional, maintenance gets to things quickly, and this location is convinient to everything. Love it!

I have lived here for about a year and a half and I have to say that since this new management group took over about a month ago, things have really improved. They are professional and it actually seems like they care abut their residents. Rent is reasonable too. I definitely recommend it!

I recently relocated to Raleigh, NC and the staff at Crossroads at North Hills were great! They helped every step of the way. I love the space that I have in my one bedroom apartment and the floor plan. I would highly recommend this complex to my family and friends!

I live here currently and everything is great except for 2 things, No valet trash and no lateral transfers. I was trying to transfer from the 3rd-floor apartment in the back to a first or second-floor in the front due to me not having a car and them not having valet trash and they refused. Also, the garbage is always piled up at the dumpster. And I tend to have a lot of problems with the electronic system.

Toured this complex today and sadly, the amenities are very outdated. Stuffy model apartment was shown, outdated appliances, only carpet options, and no detached garage, so the highest floor can’t even get a garage. Great location and all other amenities are there, just wish they updated the kitchen and had a few detached garages. We would seriously consider if so!

Scheduled a tour and canceled due to bad reviews. Leasing agent called me 10 times in 2 hours, left four voicemails, and only stopped calling once I answered and told him to leave me alone or I’d report him for harassment. He proceeded to email me three more times. It really makes you wonder how desperate they are to rent apartments if they feel the need to be this aggressive in this kind of housing market.

I was recently visiting with my sister and within an hour we killed almost 15 worms (centipedes)which she's experienced since June.  She has experienced mold in her bedroom on the window and she has been sick for almost a month due to it. I was watching the manager on security camera and she talked to my sister as if she was if ignorant and just allowed mold  to grow on her window. I spoke to neighbors who are experiencing the same things

I’ll start by saying, we’ve only been living here 4 months and it’s been a nightmare since day one. We did a walkthrough the day we moved in and it looked like they did absolutely nothing to prepare the unit for a new tenant. The second bedroom had a huge red stain in the middle of the carpet, the drain was missing from the kitchen sink, the shelf in the front closet was hanging by one screw, the fire alarms were dangling from the wires, and only one button on the microwave panel worked. They did fix all these issues...it just took them weeks to do so.

Another issue is the bugs. Yes, believe every review about bug issues that you read about this place. Thankfully, we have not had any mice in our apartment, but I wouldn’t be surprised if they were somewhere in this complex. So glad we pay for pest control..

And although the bugs are bad, I’m capable of killing them or bringing them outside myself. The real problem is the zoo that lives above me. These apartments are VERY cheaply made. The walls/ceilings are paper thin, and I’m unlucky enough to have gotten stuck beneath a family with useless parents who allow their children to scream at the top of their lungs and run/stomp through the apartment like wild animals at all hours of the day. But the office REFUSES to help. “They have determined” that these noises are par for the course in apartment living. (Although in the walkthrough, the apartment manager heard the noise from upstairs and said for us to let them know if it continues because it’s excessive). I’ve lived in numerous apartments and have NEVER been woken up at 6:30am EVERY weekend due to inconsiderate neighbors. The only solution the office has given is to move us to the fourth floor, which doesn’t work for me. All I want is to be let out of our lease, because if I need to be inconvenienced to move again, it would be far away from this sorry excuse of a living environment. 

DO NOT LIVE HERE. No one should ever have to pay this much money to absolutely hate being home. So unless you want to live in an absolute dump with awful neighbors,save yourself a lease-long headache.
Staff is awful and inconsiderate of your time and money. Place is not good.

I have lived here for almost five years,for the most part without complaint. But the dumpster issues here are horrendous. The manager is rude and there is always a problem with the staff sticking around. Never know who you will get. Finally seems that they are trying to rectify the maintenance turnover. We finally seem to have part of the maintenance staff,doing their job and then some.....hats off to Joe.......A    .

Long story short, we have moved into two different apartments within the complex. The first one was infested with German roaches after a fire from another resident. Pest control came every single week and nothing worked. Then after dealing with it for two months and having a newborn, we moved into another building just to find out that this building was ALREADY infested with German roaches. Talked to other residents within the building. The office manager then got an attorney involved because we did not want our 4 month old daughter around these chemicals anymore and asked if she would do something different. She didn’t agree and made it seem like it was our fault that we were dealing with this issue, after she already told us it wasn’t our fault. The office staff sucks, buildings are infested with German roaches, and both buildings that we lived in have horrible black mold. Yes, we did tell them number of times and they told us that it was our responsibility to clean it. According to the health department it’s thier responsibility to fix the issue seeing that it is very dangerous for Residents. Just stay away from this area, especially building 5 and 6. It’s not worth your time or enjoy. Let alone you’ll get very frustrated with the property manager because she constantly lies, she constantly makes it seem like it’s the residents fault, and she does NOTHING to fix the problems. You’ll see plenty of reviews about her, she is absolutely horrible.                                  .

Stay Away from this place! ! !  Each year they will randomly increase your rent with no justification whatsoever.  My rent has been increased by over $100! I went to their website and found my identical apartment listed for $100 cheaper!  Don't bother talking to management, they are worthless, unprofessional, and rude. They didn't comprehend that my identical apartment is being sold for over $100 cheaper on their website.  They intentionally raise your rent because they think you are too lazy to move out.  Good luck with that tactic, and they can enjoy the empty apartment on their property because of their greed.  I guarantee my current apartment will not sell for the amount they are trying to get me to release it for.  It will be listed on their website for much cheaper.  

Also, the maintenance crew will enter your apartment without giving any prior notice.  If you are in the shower, they will knock and come right in.  Stay away from MAA properties! There are newer, better managed, and nicer apartments in the area that are much cheaper.

Oh boy. where to start.

It isn't uncommon for me to receive three emails from three different people within the office in a given day, they are so disorganized. The office manager misspelled the words 'writing' and 'moving' in a most recent email to me. Why you would hire someone into an office position that can't master 3rd grade era spelling is beyond me. It doesn't seem like too much to ask for for the staff communicating with me to be literate in their communications.

Enclosing some pictures of the trash situation. Terrible. I've also been charged for a year for standard upgrades I was promised in writing before I moved in, but never received. I've showed this correspondence to the incompetent manager to demonstrate I've been over paying for a year essentially, and like everything else you try to deal with through management it was a total debacle. 

Broken glass everywhere. Extremely poor maintenance. Pot smokers have grown in numbers so if you aren't a fan of the smell, go elsewhere.

This apartment is in a block of three, and out of curiosity I've toured the other two. Please, anyone in your right mind choose any of the adjacent options. They are far nicer.

Terrible place to live.

Mice and cockroaches are a huge issue. Maintenance is out of touch, and the trash situation is obviously what causes the bugs.

In 2016, management obviously aggressively sold without planning to support those living here. Dog waste is left everywhere. I'm from Charlotte, and I have lived in a few apartments around there. I've never seen such a poor community.

Please, take it from someone that lived here. I'm soon relocating to a friends where - for less money - they have none of these issues! I have been dumfounded at how this company functions. 

Manager, Nicole, is useless. 5/10 times I've politely emailed her about maintenance issues, she is on extended PTO. Staff circulates so quickly the new people, while obviously trying their hardest, don't know enough to be helpful.

Steer clear. Ultimate irony? I used to run an apartment community early in my career! I would never imagine a place like this could exist providing such poor service.

There is a huge trash problem here. It doesn't get collected enough, so every week from Tuesday-Saturday you can't put anything in the compactor. You have to be on 24/7 alert to get trash in before the compactor is blocked. The leasing people are super aggressive but obviously didn't plan on this many people, which it seems like is something they should plan for. 

I thought it was just me at first, but I have a friend two building over, and am also friends with a family in the building directly adjacent to mine. Here is what i've heard, after asking around about whether it was just my apartment that had issues.

-Maintenance usually has to get called 3 times (I've literally tracked it) to fix anything correctly
-The manager, I think the name is Nicky or something, is really rude. I thought people got into leasing because they like being around people? 
-Because the trash is so bad, cockroaches are everywhere. My one friends says they have mice also, although to be fair I don't have this issue. But yeah, other bugs are everywhere

Recycling is also a problem. It isn't done properly so like the trash it spills out into the street for 5/7 days of the week.

I moved here from Tennessee, and I wish there had been more reviews when I signed my lease. The stuff I hear from my neighbors and experience personally most days is just nuts. The second my lease is up I am getting out of dodge. This place is really, really unprofessional. I manage a chain of retail stores, and I honestly don't understand how this business has any remaining customers.

I have been living in this apartment for the last 2 years and can't say anything bad about it.I love this apartment complex. It is located in a beautiful surrounding. It is close to lots of shopping and restaurants (Brier Creek and Brierdale Shopping Centers). The common areas are well maintained. It is safe and and very convenient to do walks and runs.

Lived here for 15 months. Friendly staff and maintenance who always responded very quickly. Very quiet except when people are in the courtyard, but never heard people out there past 10:30 pm (quiet hours start at 10). 

Great location being close to campus and I-40. Decent sized bathroom for a studio. Water is noticeably hard so I got a softener shower head. 

The main entrance from Main Campus Dr is very narrow though, and almost every day there was one huge pickup truck that parked at the bottom of that curve and created a huge blind spot. I wish they would turn those spaces by the pool into compact only. Never had a problem with the side entrance off Initiative Way though.

Occasionally people would speed within the property, but management was always receptive to complaints and prompt with emailing warnings about community policy in response to complaints. Several parking spaces also pretty narrow, except for the angled ones down the center of the property. 

Cell reception in building 521 was poor but the Wi-Fi worked well enough that it was rarely an issue. Submitting maintenance requests and other parts of the tenant portal was very easy. Community message board was very active & helpful in selling/acquiring stuff for free/low price. 

Rent for the next lease was only going to increase by $35, and would've taken it if I didn't need to move closer to work. Would definitely live here again!

We called this apartment home for 5 years, and we absolutely loved it. The leasing agents are really nice and always helpful. The location is perfect, especially if you have pets, as it’s very dog-friendly with trails nearby. As dog owners with two pups, this was a huge plus for us. The proximity to campus is incredibly convenient, and despite being so close, the area is remarkably quiet. The apartments themselves are well-maintained, making it a comfortable and pleasant place to live. Highly recommend!

Great place to live in every way. Serene environment, and close to lots of green spaces, lakes, a park, and stores/farmers market either moderate walking distance away or a very short drive away. Spacious apartments and lots of amenities.

I really wanted to like this place. I toured the apartments twice and applied to lease a unit. I was accepted, and the leasing agent communicated that the unit was mine. Unfortunately, after sending my deposits and reading through the leasing agreement, I got a call from the leasing agent that the unit was no longer available - the current resident decided they wanted to stay, after providing a notice to vacate, and The Greens choose to keep the unit for the current resident. They showed no empathy throughout this unfortunate situation and refused to offer a similar unit at the rate that I supposedly "locked in" when I applied. In addition to showing no empathy, the leasing agent was incredibly pushy and tried to get me to make a decision to lease a more expensive unit by the end of the day that they delivered the news.

I absolutely loved my time living at The Greens. I moved in right when the complex opened in March 2014 and moved out in March 2019. During my five years there, I never had any problems with any of the staff or any major problems with my apartment/the facilities. The apartments are impeccably kept. When you have a maintenance issue, you submit an online request through the resident portal and someone quickly repairs it. I never had any issue in my apartment last more than one day. Sometimes things can be a little loud in the apartment, but no more than any other complex I have lived in. I heard my neighbors above me, and my neighbor below me came up to let me know he heard me, too. Most residents are courteous about noise. I loved every person in the office. From signing my lease, to picking up too many Amazon packages, and to saying goodbye after five years, I always had pleasant visits with everyone in the office. Further, everyone was always helpful and had answers to all my many questions. There are fun resident events throughout the year, sometimes breakfast on the go or a Christmas present wrapping event. As for the common areas, the "caves" in each building are nice places with a lot of fun games and pleasant of cooking spaces. There are reasonable quiet hours for the areas, so there isn't usually a noise problem. However, and this is my only con about the common area, is that my apartment balcony opened to the "cave" and sometimes the noise would echo up and I could hear it loudly in my apartment. About five times, residents would use these later than the set hours. However, The Greens was great about enforcing the rules in these areas & keeping things quiet and clean. When moving out, I thought The Greens was fair about any repair costs. They were very considerate of what was just normal wear & tear after 5 years and what I should have to pay for, and I did not feel overcharged. The location is great. I went to school and worked downtown and had an easy commute. It is close to 40, downtown, and Western Boulevard (which you can take to 440). While being close to everything, there is still little traffic and tons of green space. It is a quick walk to the Farmers Market, Lake Raleigh, & Hunt Library. I cannot recommend this complex emphatically enough. It is my favorite place I've ever lived and a great place to call home while in Raleigh.

We love The Greens! Despite its close proximity to NCSU, you won't find a lot of rowdy college kids here. The apartments are so so so nice - granite countertops, hardwood laminate, wood cabinets - that it really feels like a home. The staff is so friendly and helpful! By far the nicest apartment I have ever lived in.

Just moved in to my newly renovated apt. and it is VERY nicely done. All of my initial concerns were handling promptly and with a positive attitude. Very professional staff and beautiful grounds. Compared to other properties in the area, I am impressed! ML

I will preface this review by saying that Shante rocks. Every interaction with her was pleasant & enjoyable. D was a very dedicated maintenance man when I needed him. I lived here for years before the management changed. Before this, it was a bustling community with a mixture of tenants. It was difficult to find a parking spot because of how full the building was. Now, the parking lot seems like a barren wasteland. I never had difficulty getting a good parking spot the last year I lived there. There have been a few safety concerns that arose over time. It's not uncommon for the police, CCBI, or both to arrive multiple times a week. I work early in the morning, & thrice there were HOMELESS PEOPLE SLEEPING IN THE LOBBY. One morning I had a gentleman wandering the halls approach me asking for a ride. There was a tenant who terrorized the building, screaming at people in the hallway, as well as trying to fight her neighbors. Another tenant would openly talk about his court dates, his weapons, drugs, etc. Every month there is a pest fee added to your rent, but nary an exterminator appeared in about a year. I was starting to get roaches when I left, so I guess that's what the pest fee was. The laundry rooms straight-up suck, between the dryers not drying after multiple loads to the washers not reading the laundry cards. Maintenance walks around a lot talking on their phones & talking to their friends. As stated above, D did a great job once. However, I once put in a ticket & it was not fixed for 4 days because they...didn't have a key to my apartment. And they...just...didn't tell me? They ended up taking my key to make a copy. My last gripe was that when I was moving out, we were told we couldn't park the U-Haul in front of the building or use the elevators in the lobby, despite this not being a rule for the entire 4.5 years I lived there. At the end of my tenure, there would be multiple U-Hauls at once with people moving out. I'm not sure if the change was to hide that so many people were moving or if there were other, more...sensitive & charged reasons. In conclusion, tenants are moving out at an alarming rate. The weekend I left, there were 3 other units being vacated. Since then, I have heard that there were upwards of 5 additional tenants leaving over the next few weeks. I hope management can get it together to save what was once a great building.

These pics are so old! (Except the one renovated unit.) They're from before the current company took over and the entire staff quit. Now the common areas stay dirty or out of use, the pool area especially - its bathrooms are disgusting and never stocked. The coffee bar is no longer stocked and the "clubhouse" is full of stained furniture that never gets cleaned. The staff is unresponsive when you have an issue or concern, and law enforcement is called on residents at least twice a month. Great location but it's not worth it! (Oh and there's no central a/c)

I'm a current resident and the property have went downhill since the new management. They are extremely rude the roaches are outrageous you honestly see at least 10 in your bathroom, kitchen and living room everyday the pest control does not work at all so you are basically wasting your money on it that they add on to rent and Do not get me started on maintenance they do not do their jobs and whatever they fix well most definitely be broken within a week.... If they even come to your apartment at all... Please save your money and move into another apartment in the area

Sincerely: a resident that cannot wait until the lease is up

Came here and I fell in love it’s so much to do here I love it I recommend this complex to all who needs a place to call home 



Latashia

I have loved living here for the past almost 2 years! I have always had the absolute best experience with their kind and extremely helpful management team which just made my first apartment post-grad such a smooth transition. The rooms are absolutely adorable with the cute colored porcelain tub that matches the floor and toilet (I got pink and felt like I was a Pink Lady)! You get a beautiful contrast from the old touches like that that they kept as well as from the new renovations such as a garbage disposal, light fixtures, kitchen floor, dishwasher, stove and countertops! Oh did I mention they have Google Fiber as well!?!? Everything about the unit is fabulous and the lobby looks like the entrance to a fancy hotel with a side room you can rent out for parties or to just hang out with other neighbors. The gym equipment is crazy nice and has saved me from myself more times than I can count from the constant and delicious food trucks they have come once or twice a week! If you have any trouble with anything in your apartment the awesome maintenance staff was extremely nice and would be there like lightning! Also the location is literally bonkers you get Crabtree Valley Mall LITERALLY a hop across the highway and you're already on Glenwood Avenue so it takes 7 minutes to get downtown, to Cameron Village and to Five Points. I have never been in a place that was more connected! I never worried about anything there and the team at Sterling Glenwood is one that should get awards for all that they do! I highly recommend this place and thank you all for being so wonderful to me these past couple years!

I recently moved to Sterling Glenwood Apartments, and I have never been so happy! Every morning I wake up with a smile on my face! Living here is a dream come true. It truly is a gorgeous, one-of-a-kind building, and I honestly feel like I'm living at a resort hotel! Everything is so modern and trendy, with a retro twist. There really is nothing else like it on the market. High-rise living that I can actually afford. I LOVE having a lobby where I can socialize with my neighbors. I also LOVE the view from my apartment, as well as the luxury swimming pool! I am minutes from downtown, and practically next door to Crabtree Mall. Everyone who comes to visit me is shocked and astounded by this place! So, aside from all of the awesomeness that I've just described, the best part of all is the Management team....namely, Julie, the Property Manager!!! I am not new to renting, and I am telling you, Julie is BY FAR the BEST PM I've ever had the pleasure of knowing. She is professional, caring, expeditious, kind, considerate, and an excellent customer service provider!!!! She truly goes miles above and beyond the call of duty, and she treats her residents like royalty! I just could not be happier about where I live, and I couldn't have chosen a better place to call home. If you're lucky enough to get an apartment here, you won't be sorry!!!

I first lived here in 1991, loved it then and now I've lived here for two years after the remodel.  The remodel is well done with amazing outdoor space.  I take my barbecue to the pool area enjoy a swim and watch one of the two outdoor TV 's in front of the fireplaces while cooking hamburgers to enjoy with my friends and neighbors.  I enjoy Highrise living with secure entry and the great neighbors that I call friends!  I live in a building with over hundred neighbors and the safety I feel is important to me .  If your looking for boutique courtyard living this may not be for you.  If your looking for a big city feel inside the belt line with an affordable price then you found your home.

i came to visit a friend for a week and  when i was doing laundry i noticed the hallways and floors where clean and the laundry rooms where very clean everything was who ever is the cleaning person he or she does a really good job
apartment is very nice. great location.quite, nice swimmimg pool.

I live in a one bedroom apartment at Sterling Glenwood Apartments in Raleigh, NC.  I moved in Feb. 1, 2015 and have had an excellent experience there.  When I moved in, there were a few things that caught my eye right away.  First, the living room and bedroom were huge. I have a king sized bed and there is tons of room left for my other bedroom furniture.  Second, the appliances were all new and up to date and the apartment was freshly painted.  There were a few things that needed fixing, like a loose cabinet door and the staff jumped on the problems that same day and fixed everything.  The whole apartment complex has been renovated with a new entry way and meeting place, a new state of the art gym, a new and beautiful swimming pool, and currently, new carpet is being laid in all the hallways.  If you want to live in a newly renovated, well managed Apartment complex, that is 2 minutes from Crabtree Valley Mall and 5 minutes from downtown, then Sterling Glenwood Apartments are for you.  My rent is a little over $800 and is very reasonable for the excellent location.  Oh, and yes, they do allow pets!!
The apartments are very nice just wish they had a washer and dryer inside the apartments rather than in the hall
Julie is very friendly and top notch to work with. Apartment building is being upgraded. Looks nice.

I first lived in Beckanna in 1990 it was my first apartment away from parents. I have returned and been here for six months. I disagree with the reviews I read on other sites. There were mostly regarding the previous management staff. I am pleased with the whole staff , professional , responsive and organized and that's all I can ask for. The building is currently under renovations and remodel and the new gym is going to be spectacular. New pool is under construction. I find the residents are friendly a nice mix and I have a number of new friends made here and we get together on spontaneous occasions and have a good time. Is the building perfect no, Is it brand new, no, Is it safe. Is it loud, on occasion I hear some through the front door but never bothered me. There are over two hundred apartments here under one roof , that's what I was looking for and the ITB was where I wanted to be so as far as the value, cant beat it. I have referred two friends that are looking and may be neighbors soon.
If you are looking for a quiet , quaint, garden style apartment then this building is not for you. If you are looking for a open minded , all welcome, reasonable apartment inside the beltline and you like living in a highrise then I think you should look.
We’ve lived here 1.5 years and plan to stay as long as possible. The community is quiet, well maintained, and the management & maintenance teams are very responsive and friendly.
Have lived here almost two years and very happy with my time here. Units are renovated and updated. Great and quiet location. Friendly staff and excellent maintenance team!

The cortland community is great. l love being a tenant there because the rooms are large and remodeled and the community is friendly 
.

The staff working on site are kind and helpful. The third party leasing office was a nightmare. I missed my move in date because it was impossible for me to get ahold of the staff after agreeing to sign the lease. They were attentive to getting me set up for a tour, but beyond that it was very frustrating to have to continue moving things around due to no communication from their end and not sending proper documents.
The office management exhibits poor performance, although the maintenance team excels in their duties. The community members are kind and the environment as a whole is great.

We love living at Cortland Olde Raleigh! The staff is very responsive to enforce adherence to community policies and the service team is stellar often responding to work orders in 2-hours. The exterior and interior of the apts were newly renovated and there are many windows bringing lots of cheery sunlight into our home. Don’t hesitate to over here!

apartmentName: Brook Hill Townhouse - Students Save Up to...
review: we experienced a flood 34 days ago and we are still waiting on repairs to be completed. we have been in constant communication with the management team and some how have "slipped through the cracks". this is literally what the management team said to us.

apartmentName: Brook Hill Townhouse - Students Save Up to...
review: If you're looking for a reasonable apartment complex, keep on looking. Rates keep going up, the parking lots flood, and if you're not careful, they'll have your car towed. I'm stuck here until my lease runs out, my roommate has needed to get his car repaired twice due to flooding, and the leasing office gave me the wrong parking sticker, then had my car towed for having the wrong sticker. Cost me $175 just to get my car back from the twits who towed it, and the office refuses to reimburse me for their error.

apartmentName: Brook Hill Townhouse - Students Save Up to...
review: As the title states, TERRIBLE OFFICE STAFF! They aren’t helpful and they don’t know what they are talking about. No visitor parking without prior office approval and constant flooding. Will definitely not be renewing after this

I really love my apartment, especially the wood floors.  The dog park is great, it is very convenient so I don't have to throw my dog in the car to let him get exercise.  He really enjoys it and has fun.  Overall I really like living here!

The bad reviews you may read are ridiculous and i honestly cant believe it.  I have lived in several apartments and this one by far has the nicest people and apartment.  They ALWAYS work with me.  They go above and beyond any other apartment people I have EVER dealt with.   These bad review people should try out some of the other apartments around here, and then see if theyre complaining about here!  TRUST ME, this place is 100% better.  Sometimes it can take a little while to get work orders done, but its really not a big deal or even THAT long.  Stuff happens.  They work with me, I work with them, and everything works out perfectly.  *thumbs up*

I just moved in to this complex and my move in experience was great!  I moved from out of state and the staff made the process such an easy transition for me.  I was way behind on the road on move in day (Friday traffic), and management stayed late to ensure that I would be able to get moved in as planned.  I could tell that they were behind on getting my apartment ready because maintenance was still working in there, I told the man he could come back next week since it was nothing major but he stayed to finish to make sure everything was finished up.  This whole staff seems so friendly and happy, and I was very impressed with how great the property looked when I pulled up!  They are not brand new apartments, but they are updated and the price is good too.  I am still learning the area, but it seems to be convenient to just about everything.  So far, I am very happy here and would definitely recommend the community!
My move-in was so easy and fast!  I love my apartment and the staff!

I recently transferred to a one bedroom, so I would not have to have a roommate. The people in the office made it really easy on me. My new apartment is wonderful. The closet is massive!! I have been here for a year, and going on 2 years now. I am happy here, and do not plan to move for awhile. Maintenance men are some really great guys also. 

I have recommend many friends and family to live here. Overall, I'm satisfied!

When it comes to location, this apartment complex is a great choice! 6 mins from Triangle Town Center, close to shopping, dining, attractions, and 15mins from downtown. Even though the location is prime and the neighborhood is quiet and laidback, there are some minor details about the apartment itself that might be HELPFUL. We have a 2br2ba and is about 1000sqft. The apt is nice in itself (good sized closets, bathrooms, open-floor plan, and faux hardwood floors), having been upgraded however the apt wasn’t finished when we were given our keys, The heat was also not working and some of the appliances were broken, we had 4 maintence calls in our first week here. We are now halfway through our lease and things have been going alright, however the office has put a new system in place that charges 25$ to pay your rent and this is the only form of accepting payment for them (online) which is extremely inconvenient, The past 6 mths we have been here the gym has been closed (advertises 24/7gym) and is not open 24/7. Last but not least upon signing our lease, the office manager was extremely adamant about reporting bugs and pests, now that were in the summer months my neighbors and I find ourselves infested with insects constantly. Also please note that the office has a 24/7 emergency line for repairs and they are pretty good at coming 3 out of 5 times. Even though it might sound negative, its BEARABLE and they do a pretty good job at addressing your issues. I would recommend this complex to anyone just starting out or looking for a quiet, relaxed atmosphere.

I will start with the good, the leasing ladies & maintenance staff are fantastic and very kind. That’s all that is good. Anyways, I promise, you will move in, think everything is great & you will start seeing german roaches - every single unit here has this problem and don’t let them tell you otherwise (I heard that from the pest control man’s mouth). I have had to clear my apartment for what they call a “roach out” twice, and have had MULTIPLE sprays from pest control, it does not work - especially because they don’t do all units so we are essentially just passing the roaches back and forth. Besides that, the grounds are gross, stairwells are gross, trash bags build up outside (I guarantee mice are next on their pest list). Parking stinks, if you come any time after 5pm you will not get a spot close to your unit; no fun when you have groceries and/or children. You can hear every single time your neighbors door slams, anytime they take a step in their unit - horrible. Appliances are outdated, paint is outdated. You can find SO MUCH better for the price.

I am absolutely happy with my new home. Mrs. Brenda, Mrs. Lee, & Ms. Ava were all wonderful. They were very assertive to my needs and what I wanted in my home. They are so nice! I really enjoyed my one bedroom apartments it overlooked the pool and was very spacious with in unit laundry. I also love the private patio.

As a new tenant at LYV Six Forks Apartments, my experience has been positive. The leasing process was smooth, and the staff was welcoming and helpful. My unit was clean upon move-in. The community is quiet, and the location is convenient for shopping and dining.

the staff is amazing. They are very responsive and helpful. Anytime there is an issue of any kind they take care of it immediately. The amenities are wonderful! The pool area is so nice! It is always clean and maintained.
New management is much better than last people who are in. I really enjoy how fast people respond to maintenance requests and how our garbage is actually taken out.

Magnolia house apartments has exceeded my expectations! The staff is super friendly and helpful!! The whole process has been so seamless and easy. If you’re looking for a good place to live this is it!

We have been tenants here for 7 years and this community has improved so much since Hawthorne took over management. Brandon and all the staff are very courteous and responsive to our needs. They do a lot for the tenants such as invite local food trucks to the property on a regular basis. The property itself is much cleaner than in the past as well. We love it here!

My husband, son, and I moved to Magnolia House in April of 2017, and we love the amount of space we have in our apartment. The location is very convenient. I am very pleased with our new management company, Hawthorne Residential. They are very professional, and they do nice things for residents like a cookout at the pool, birthday treats at the clubhouse, and inviting amazing food trucks to our community to save us a night from cooking.  We love living at Magnolia House Apartments and highly recommend it.

Location is amazing, community is beautiful. The dog park is a great size. The 2 bed 2.5 bath layout is absolutely beautiful. The neighborhood is quiet and the management office attends to resident's needs quickly. The maintenance man is so polite and attentive. I highly recommend Magnolia House Apartments.

I had a rough start moving from out of state, but with the new landlord, I felt heard. Any problems I did have, was resolved rather quickly. Wonderful people to work with while living in this complex.

I am Sorry to say but I live here for 3 years, I always paid my rent way early and never receive a late notice.  I always paid all my bills water, trash and other. The location cannot be beat. Grocery across the street, beautiful neighborhood adjacent, close to downtown. Where we were in the development was very quiet to be so convenient to everything. Always felt safe there. Apartment had a built in security system, but we never felt the need to use it.

The daily trash pickup was a handy feature. So was the office delivery of packages with a text and email notification. 

Our property representative (Patricia) was helpful and kind. Always very responsive anytime we had questions.

As a disclaimer I have not lived at this property and cannot speak to the renter's experience. I have been residing at The Vert at Six Forks for the past several months, and my experience has been nothing short of outstanding. From the moment I first stepped into this community, I knew I had found a special place to call home.

The amenities provided are great, ensuring a lifestyle of comfort and convenience. The fitness center, although undergoing renovations, is well-equipped, making it easy to maintain an active and healthy lifestyle. The pool area is not only a refreshing escape during the warmer months but also beautifully designed, creating a serene atmosphere for relaxation.

The apartments themselves are a testament to modern living. Spacious layouts, contemporary finishes, and attention to detail create an inviting and stylish living space. The well-designed kitchens and bathrooms add a touch of modesty to everyday life. The in-unit amenities, including a washer and dryer, appliances, and decent storage space, contribute to the overall convenience and comfort of living here.

One of the standout features of The Vert at Six Forks is the dedicated manager, Alex! She is responsive, attentive, and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure resident satisfaction. Maintenance requests are handled promptly. I've had two maintenance issues, and they were addressed within 24-48 hours.

The location is another aspect that adds to the appeal of this community. Conveniently situated with easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment options right off of Six Forks Road. The Vert at Six Forks strikes the perfect balance between a tranquil residential setting and proximity to urban conveniences.

In summary, my time at The Vert at Six Forks has been exceptional. The combination of amenities, well-maintained living spaces, and a welcoming community atmosphere make it a five-star residence. I highly recommend The Vert at Six Forks to anyone seeking a comfortable and affordable living experience in the Raleigh area.

Do not move here y'all. There was an enormous wasp infestation in the apartments when I moved in. I personally killed 27 wasps INSIDE my 1 bedroom apartment. 
More than that though, no one is ever available in the office once you move-in, maintenance never shows up, etc. It was infuriating trying to move-out. No one would reply to my calls or emails. Do not move here unless you want to spend an astronomical amount of money on heating and cooling each month. I am talking about 200.00 electric bills and still have 2 very different climates upstairs and downstairs.

Upstairs remains hot, and downstairs remains chilly. I lived alone and kept the heat and AC on conservative levels (heat 65, AC 78!) still ended up with big bills because there are a LOT of drafty windows and doors. Many nights I had the heat on 60...no difference.

Heating unit often blew cold air, nothing was done. I mentioned severe drafts, nothing was done. 

the upstairs has 2 *tiny* floor vents, that's it! and one vent is COVERED BY THE BATHROOM DOOR! The door sits on top of the vent when open!

Maintenance also left a bent screen door that was not the right size. A huge gap (1+) inch was left along the top, and it didnt close properly because the frame was bent. they installed 1 tiny magnet set towards the top to close the gap, but it never worked. 

They are too cheap to install a properly fitted door.

Valet trash charge now, so you have to keep disgusting garbage inside, they dont want the pails left out.

The place looks decent from the outside but inside is utterly terrible. 

Choose anywhere else.

Pros? Place was quiet with maintained grounds...except

the dog park. It is nasty and full of spiky seeds that stick in dog's feet...they never cleared the ground. We had to constantly complain to get them to fill the poop bag stations even though they collect pet rent.

The bathroom is so tiny if you're on the toilet and try to close the door, you have to move your legs out of the way! It is laughable they charge so much for rent for such a poor design with drafts everywhere.

This isn't everything, I've held back In comparison where I've moved now has zero drafts and day 2 maintenance added extra weather stripping to my front door when I mentioned I could feel some cold air. Day 2!

I've had an okay-ish time while living here for almost a year.

The first part of living here was good because of the constant communication from the office management and everything they had to offer. But this year has gone down hill ever since the new management took over...
I don't have any communication with the office anymore - they must've taken my email off the list because I don't hear from them anymore.
About a few weeks ago they were fixing the middle of the complex, the roads were blocked off, I didn't receive a single email telling me of this. Nor were there roads signs or warnings or anything. I was very disappointed by the lack of communication about this. (However, my husband received an email about this a WEEK after they started.)
Another recent issue, I had 2 leaks in the matter of 4 days. Yes, I had a dehumidifier given to me, yes they stopped the leak - but it was too late. 
I could splash a puddle in my carpet, so who knows how long the leak was going on for. 
I've had to throw away a few of my items including a MOLDY wicker basket. I am currently pregnant, and living in this environment isn't good for me and my health. I contacted management and they basically said "It happens. There's nothing we can do." 

I honestly would NOT suggest living here - if you do, you'll regret it. 
You'll have to deal with loud cars, barking dogs, no communication with the office staff, no respect, etc.
I would the maintenance man was very nice hardworking too he?s always on the job and get things done in a timely matter

**Review: Extremely Disappointing Management Experience**

I am compelled to share my profound dissatisfaction with the management at this property. Their handling of my grievances has been nothing short of appalling, marked by significant delays and woefully inadequate responses.

To begin with, repairs that were finally completed yesterday came after over a month of inconvenience, forcing the affected resident to find alternative accommodations. This delay was frustrating enough, but the persistent black mold on the windowsill, despite their claims of remediation, only adds to the disappointment.

The issue of compensation remains unresolved. While a credit of $1019.00 was offered, it falls far short of addressing the considerable upheaval we endured. Additionally, the theft of over $500 worth of mail and inadequate security measures have yet to be properly investigated or addressed. The suggestion that resolving these issues now only benefits future tenants, rather than addressing the immediate impact on us, is both disheartening and dismissive.

Communication from the management has been slow and ineffective. Although they acknowledged their responsibility for the repair delays and agreed to waive late fees, the overall handling of the situation reflects poorly on their management practices. Their recent decision to stop discussing the matter altogether is unprofessional and unacceptable.

In summary, this management team has demonstrated delays, inadequate responses, and a lack of genuine concern for tenant satisfaction. The minimal compensation offered and refusal to engage further on unresolved issues reveal a troubling disregard for tenant well-being. I strongly urge a reconsideration of their approach to tenant concerns and a more serious effort to address these ongoing problems.
All of the management and maintenance staff are helpful and kind. The community is well kept and overall a good place to live.
The Greens at Tryon are Awesome. I have lived here a total of 12 yrs.
The staff is so friendly, and I love that they make a point to remember the community. The process of living here was smooth and easy. I'm extremely grateful!

the apartment, grounds, and area looks very nice. I'm enjoying the location more than anything else. we gave been living here for about a week and have had more issues everyday. nothing to do with that staff just the apartment itself. the internet/cable package should be completely changed. the internet has been by far the biggest issue. there are smaller things but I just fix them myself or keep moving along.
Ill recommend The Greens at Tryon to anyone looking for a place to stay. The floor plan in the 3 bedrooms are amazing, the staff is AMAZING, everything is kid friendly, the scenery beautiful.
nice area however floors to thin keep hearing kids above us running and dropping stuff everyday as if they at a playground. also mail box aways open even when it's lock

There are good and bad things about this apartment complex as there are with every complex. The maintenance and office staff are shaky at best. I  have been living here for 4 years.  The community is nice. I live in the back and it is quiet. Neighbors are friendly. The maintenance team does an awesome job when there are concerns.

I have lived @ The Marq for over a year and couldn’t be happier. The staff is so friendly and kind. There have been so many resident appreciation days with food and other events. The apartments are Uber modern and very spacious! I’m so glad I chose The Marq @ Crabtree!
Really enjoy the apartment I live in. The kitchen is a great space where I can spread out and enjoy cooking. Living in the main building is a plus with having the gym and common area located there.

I took a self-guided tour due to the disaster and I have to say the apartment property is very well kept, beautiful all around. Apartments look just like the pictures. I love it. Would definitely recommend.

This community is truly beautiful. The location is close to so many perfect needs (Target, Starbucks, great food, and more).
We are not planning to relocate from Orlando for a few months. However, I wanted to compliment Lauren the leasing specialist on a terrific tour.
She covered all the important points, and was super friendly and professional.  We are a family of five and she was wonderful and accommodating.
We had the full community tour, and she made sure to give us all the info we requested to take with us.  I look forward to coming back!

Marq at Crabtree is the best apartment complex I have EVER lived in. The neighbors are friendly, the apartment layouts are fantastic (floor to ceiling windows with laminate throughout) and the location is perfect. Your close enough to everything but your far enough way to not feel like your in everything! I can't speak highly enough about the office team and maintenance crew, everyone is always helpful and nice and every maintenance request is completed within 24 hours. Nothing but good things to say about this place! You should rent here.
This is by far the best apartments I've ever lived in. Outstanding employees, and a great young community. -Nathan

Location is great. Price is average for what you get.

Park & Market is a great friendly community walking distance from everything in the best location in North Hills. If you have any issues with your apartment, the staff is responding fast and they will fix the issues and follow-up with you. As we are in the Covid period of time, there is restrictions, but they still make sure we are having some social distancing social events! The pool is big and pretty! The apartments are comfortable and includes  granite countertops and stainless steels appliances.

Living in this apartment has made my life miserable. I would rather share this so someone else does not get trapped here as I did.

I've seen the available apartments they're offering to new applicants and they genuinely look like trash. The office staff aren't welcoming, appear inexperienced, and don't do any activities on the property for tenants. I'd stay clear unless you had to live hear.

My time at Midtown was great and I would highly recommend living here if you're looking for a place in North Raleigh that is convenient to everything.
Everyone in the office was always very kind and helpful, willing to answer any questions I had. The apartments, and even the area around the apartment is well taken care of. You can tell they care about the quality of your stay.
Whenever I contacted maintenance to fix things (it wasn't often) they were prompt and took care of the problem quickly.
 
The best thing was the building I stayed in was very quiet.    
I would definitely recommend living here if you're looking for a nice, affordable place in North Raleigh.

Josh and Tori in the leasing office were so nice and helpful from day 1. When I moved in, the apartment was so clean and well taken care of. There were no bugs!!! (I’ve had a lot of issues with bugs in previous apartments complexes) All of the neighbors were so nice and helpful! Overall I was pleased with my experience living here. I will definitely recommend Midtown Crossing to friends looking for a new apartment.

The management and maintenance of Midtown Crossing are incredible. They genuinely care about the residents and they make that clear. Every time I've walked into the front office, I sense that they desire to serve me and my roommates in whatever way they can. They put on community events to thank us for living there. Also every time I've put in a maintenance request, they've responded promptly and addressed all of our needs. 

The apartments are clean, well designed, and they are in the process of renovating of most of the units. The cost is extremely affordable and the location is great in Raleigh. I can't imagine a better apartment living choice in the Raleigh area!

I love living here! The apartments are beautiful and the closet space is amazing!!! I love the staff. They are super friendly and helpful. Maintenance staff is professional and efficient. The amenities are beautiful. I love the sense of community. Going on my third year here! Started in a one bedroom and now living in a two bedroom. They made the transition super easy. Midtown Crossings is home at last.
if you love hidden fees, bugs & mold, outdated appliances in an outdated apartment along with an unprofessional, rude property manager come live here.

If I could give them zero stars I would... 
management and maintenance sucks which causes way more issues than needed. When my lease is up I’m out this dump!!

The staff at both of these locations is a joke as well. The worker Aaron came by and serviced everything quick and efficiently. Easy explanations. Feels hard to come by. Great workers thank you!

This community leaves a lot to be desired.  The management team is adversarial and too busy to be bothered with residents.  However, 75% of notices to enter your home are late. On top of these regular occurrences, they towed the new car that I owed for less than 12 because it didn't have a sticker that they could not provide. I felt like this was a scene from Facebook or YouTube.  I pay an exorbitant amount of rent, nonetheless, the complex tows my new car without the proper signs and the staff threatens me with police intervention but still refused to contact the manager.  I feel emotionally violated.  You home should be sanctuary not a place of victimization.

In the year I’ve lived here I’ve had the most unpleasant experiences. Mail and packages stolen or misdelivered TWELVE times. Still another two weeks of corporate office calls, and back and forth with the assistant manager before the matter was resolved. Rude and extremely unfriendly current management staff only one employee there is friendly and literally the sweetest woman in the world. You literally feel like you have to beg them to take any concerns seriously. Neighbors steal, go out of their way to use anything outside of your apartment that doesn’t belong to them and even though staff requests you come to them first before confronting any neighbors with issues they don’t do anything when you do.

Where do I start? Rude management team. They have way better things to do than help,with any maintenance request. Don't bother inviting friends over because they are all over towing someone's car whose been parked there for 10-15 mins.over priced for the age of the apartments. Have a friend who lives here who feels uncomfortable by the management that's a big problem. So instead I moved to the next apartment complex down and They are so much nicer and cheaper. Maintence men and man in office need a reality check on how to treat your people in your community.

I have lived here for two years. Lots of college students and recent grads seem to rent here since Carter Finley Stadium, PNC Arena, and the NC State Fairgrounds are within walking distance. College students equal noise and trash. The apartment complex's proximity to the aforementioned event venues is a great selling point but also makes traffic frustrating at times. The location is also within a short drive from downtown Raleigh, Chapel Hill, Durham, Cary, and RDU which is very convenient. The management team does not communicate well. I have walked to the pool or gym, on more than one occasion, only to find out that the pool or gym were closed or the grill was out of order. A simple email from management to the entire community would have saved me (and others) the trouble. During recent parking lot repaving, they sent out a nice, detailed repaving schedule. However, when weather caused delays, there was no follow up email. Parking lot sections were closed days after the schedule said they would be and that should have been communicated. The staff is very friendly and nice and they do address problems promptly but that is basic customer service that I would expect from a fry cook. If I am paying almost $950 per month for an old, worn out, dark, one bedroom apartment 15 minutes from downtown, management should proactively communicate to the community any changes to normal services. They raised rent by 10% after the first year. They charge a $50 Time Warner Cable (TWC) cable bill on top of rent that you cannot opt out of. Since moving here, TWC has changed the services that they offer twice. Now I must rent a digital cable box from TWC in order to access the cable that I am required to purchase. Mid Atlantic Apartments (MAA) is the parent company and, from talking to other people who have rented with them, this is par for the course. To me, they seem primarily concerned with squeezing every last penny from their properties. Rent is overpriced even for the area. The apartments are old but priced like the luxury apartments around the corner. I should have moved out last year. I will not be making the same mistake when my lease is up this year.

I have been living here for over a year and absolutely LOVE it! This is a quiet neighborhood and everyone I've encountered here from staff to residents has been pleasant. Also, no breed restrictions. Only complaint is that it's pricey but well worth it!
The apartment is very nice, and the prices are decent. The complex is fairly quiet, safe, and extremely dog friendly. It's a great place for college students and recent grads.

I've lived at this complex for about a month and it has been one of the best apartments I've lived in. The neighborhood is fairly quiet, there are pools and a pretty nice workout room on the property. Everyone is very nice, it's not far from NC State's campus, and it is a pet-friendly community with decent rent prices.

Main Pros: 
Location. Close to downtown Raleigh, but also near Cary. Very near to several large employers such as Wells Fargo. Good for young professionals. 
Community. Two pools, two clubhouses, social events, great area with tons of trees for shade.

Main Cons:
Confusing bill. Took awhile to get a straight answer on how much the full monthly bill would be, since they tack on a lot of extra charges. Ultimately worth it, but you won't be paying the sticker price.

The community at Colonial Grand at Trinity Commons is a wonderful place to live.  It is in a perfect location, on the board of Cary and minutes for downtown Raleigh. You will hear the term "Water bugs" all the time for roaches. During the summer they are out in full force and can get quite annoying and disgusting. The management will lead you on when you are first signing but do not believe them. Everything in your apartment will be constantly breaking down and it will take months to get it fixed. DO NOT LIVE HERE. The office and management company have no consideration or care for their residents. Dog urine and poop cover the inside hallways regularly. I unfortunately do not recommend living at 927 at all. There are plenty of places within the same price range that would be a much better experience. Please do not live in these apartments under any circumstances. The buildings are full of black mold that grows out of the vents and management will not fix the problems. Many serious maintenance issues that are fixed at extremely slow rate with poor communication from staff across the board.

steer clear of this complex. Lived here for 7 months, could not move out fast enough. There is a cockroach problem management is aware of but cannot control. the community is very sketchy. This place is very nice and clean. Affordable apartments with a new modern feel. Micah made the whole process super smooth and was very helpful throughout the whole process. 10/10. I would definitely recommend moving into these apartments.

I've lived here for over 7 years and rarely visit the rental office. We decided to transfer to the upgraded apartments and Alphonso was awesome. We clicked the first day we met. He was upbeat and most of all followed up to ensure the process was seamless. Thankfully it was!

I love my apartment, all of my neighbors are kind, and I rarely hear noises from the above or adjacent apartments. Ample parking, my kids feel safe and comfortable here.

I’m very pleased with the staff at the Park At North Ridge.

Excellent apartments. Very clean & spacious for our needs. Reasonable prices with pets. Excellent service in the leasing office as well. The entire staff is very professional & responds quickly to all requests.

I have had a great experience here for going on one year. Quiet and friendly atmosphere and very affordable pricing in North Raleigh. This place was wonderful up until 3 years ago.  I would stay far away from this company who manages this property and do your research and you will see every property managed by them here in the carolinas is a aweful experience.

I will gladly change my reviews once management handles the issues consistently.
The management team and the maintaince staff is always pleasent and helpful. This is a great environment to live in!

Love Love Love my apartment! Great location, with great conveniences to restaurants, shops, wine store and so much more. Blessed to have nice neighbors. Very very nice management team and super responsive maintenance team.
This apartment’s location is one of the best, it is easy access to many restaurants, Research triangle Park, RDU airport and many places.

Between the a/c that they didn't fix for over a month, freezer that took more than three months to fix, and having my wife's car towed at 5am because the decal fell off the rearview mirror, it's hard to believe these people care about their residents in the least. Cannot recommend less.

Was also sent a floorplan for a unit with a loft but the lease they had me sign was for a unit that did not have a loft. Unfortunately didn't find out until move-in. Be wary of these people.

Staff is so amazing, every time I need help with something it get completed. I would highly recommend living here. They also just got all new maintenance staff and they are very nice and knowledgeable. love it here

Too many issues,

I wish I could move but I cannot. I am stuck in a lease for year. My advice read all the reviews. that is something I did not do and I paying for it right now.

One of the worst apartment experiences ever.  We put in maintenance work-orders and they never get done.  You have to hound the front office if there's anything that needs to be fixed in your apartment.  Visitor's parking is extremely limited. Management is rude and unprofessional; they didn't even offer an apology for their absurd parking policy and have no plans to fix it. Cannot WAIT until this lease is up so I can get out!!!!

I toured along with Damelia a 2nd story apt as I wanted an idea what they looked like...  I need a 1st story apt as I am crippled and cannot take steps. Right now I am awaiting a call to see what I need to do next as I have applied.  I still need to inform the property mgmt of the apt # that will be available in March, and the price I was given yesterday.  I'm excited!!!
Horrible and old. Mice infested and they tow your car if the tags are not up to date.

This place is by far one of the WORST apartment complexes I've lived in. I've put in NUMEROUS requests to fix the peeling paint in the tub, which clogs up the drain. The photos are not an accurate to how the apartments currently look. I moved in November 2021 and as of August 2022, nothing that was suppose to be fixed in 2022 was fixed (balcony door, stove, electric/ lights, missing bathroom tiles).

There are huge bugs. You pay for extermination but they never come. Not once has an exterminator visited my own.
The lighting is horrible.
The boiler is located in the bedroom closet therefore, there’s not much in there.
Aria North Hills has not disappointed me. Renovated apartment, nice amenities. The first impression is the best impression and that is Linda, she truly represent Aria North Hills!

I did not get anyone to visit my apartment until I had to submit 2 work order requests and all that was done for my unit was an industrial fan. Finally, I have yet to receive any of these “Dasmen Points” they keep advertising. I always pay my full amount online and still nothing. I emailed them today but we will see if I get a response. I was excited about this property moving in but the cons out way the pros.

just moved in a week ago. The Leasing Consultant Bryan has been nothing short of AMAZING. He is very knowledgeable, caring and friendly.  He made the move in process  smooth and easy.

I also had the pleasure of meeting Charity the Property Manager. She is an absolute sweetheart, she is kind and customer focused. I love my apartment and the prices are by far the best value for what you are  getting compared to other communities. So if you happen to be reading this
