No condensation bucket was set up either, all the water was left to run all over the floor.  The regional manager told me at the end that "I should be grateful, since it is the only portable unit they have, they did not need to offer it to me ".  Hope no one else’s AC goes out because this is the only one they keep on hand.

I wish I could give this place a good review. Great location, horrible management. If any of these apply to you, I would avoid this place:

1) You look forward to enjoying the amenities.

-This year, everyone's rent hiked a month or so before we were told that the main office would be remodeled and nearly every amenity would be closed. The grill area was moved, but the best they offered for the pool or gym were temporary passes (15 days) to local spots that we had to front the cost of before they 'reimbursed' us. Inequitable offerings as not every tenant has the same availability to travel or front costs.  They are making us pay MORE for LESS.

2) You enjoy being engaged in your community whether for fun or activism.

-A group of tenants formed a Council to address inconsistencies with communication between Management and Tenants. We asked management to be a part of the council as we actively wanted their input. We were told "It's nice y'all found some comradery but we will only talk to you individually". The tenants have only tried to work with them, the office has actively tried to squash any and all efforts to organize as a community.

3) You're a responsible pet owner who prefers walking safely on a sidewalk over muddy and dark trails. 

-We have *literally* received a note saying that anyone who allows their pet to walk in the grass next to the sidewalks will "have their pet removed". This is verbatim, I still have the letter. 

4) You like sleep and/or you work from home.

-There will be a minimum of three people with leafblowers and/or lawn mowers out at 9AM *sharp* every. single. day. This is not an exaggeration. It is a waste of money, incredibly harmful to the environment, and regularly exceeds city noise ordinance levels. 

5) You prefer that the people in charge of the place you live to have the barest level of human decency and empathy. 

-The office will not work with you. Period. It does not matter the circumstances you find yourself in, it does not matter how/when/what you ask them. If they've decided on something, they will refuse to hear you out. They have told us they would call us back on issues and then instead snuck to our front door and posted a letter response. 

6) You value security/safety in your community.

-The community has asked for more street lighting and cameras in the parking lot for 2+ years. We've had at least FIVE catalytic converters stolen from cars in our lot. Crickets. 

As a resident, I urge you to look elsewhere.

WWofLJ was my home from 2002-2017.  I would not live anywhere else but here as far as apt. living is concerned.  Great location, beautiful grounds, access to Lake Johnson and its trails, well-kept interiors with lovely upgrades, large apts., walk-in closets (in some floorplans), large screened porches, and privately owned!  You get a comparable bang for your buck! Office staff is knowledgeable, courteous, responsible, and on top of any issues.  If I ever went back to apt. living again, I'd move back here in a minute!

This is truly the hidden gem of Raleigh. We feel so close to everything here (downtown, NCSU, Crossroads for shopping, main highways) yet we live in what is truly a little oasis of nature. The lake and trails are what intrigued us, but the management team, the beautifully updated apartments, the awesome pool setup, the fantastic screened porch and the price are what will keep us. Not to mention every resident here that we’ve met has been so kind and neighborly. You tend to forget you even live in an apartment here. You don’t find apartment communities like this anymore so we are truly grateful that we landed here!

We toured the apartment and in honesty, feel like we wasted our time because the complex was not like the pictures. The paint on the siding was splotchy and chipping everywhere. Even the model we were shown was very run down and smoky/musty smelling. I just think it’s fair to have some idea of that beforehand.

When I first moved to the complex I had a horrible experience with the property manager...she was extremely rude and unprofessional. When I found that the management team had been replaced I was less than surprised. Chris and Luke are the new property management and I know they are working extremely hard to "right" the bad vibes from the previous property management. Chris and Luke are always extremely helpful, greet you with a smile and by name, and make every effort to show you that they care about your needs. Maintenance is great too! These are older buildings so there are going to be times that something needs to be fixed, and they get the job done quickly and efficiently.
It could be better. Apartment does not look like the pictures that are posted.
I lived here here at oak city apartments for several months on a sublease. The neighbors were friendly. The pool was a little small. They did a lot of community activities. Maintenance was prompt.

What a refreshing change from my past place. This place has Washer and Dryer in the apartment. The living room and bedroom have so much natural light, nothing like the dungeon apartment i just came from. They have food trucks come out monthly, and keep the pool open longer than most. The staff is pleasant to deal with and the maintenance team looks professional, not like a bunch of bums. The area is close the restaurants and major highways. Hard not to like! Def recommend to friends and FAMILY.

I moved into my apartment at the beginning of September, and can not be more happy with how everything has been going. The apartment is close to all major stores. There are 2 malls closely situated around the apartment. My employer is located on NC State campus, which is a 15-20min drive from my apartment. Downtown Raleigh is 10 mins from where I am. The staff is very helpful. My refrigerator and dishwasher were not working right, I called the office and they sent maintenance right out. After the work was completed, the staff called me to check on the issue.

I'm leaving Shellbrook sadly disappointed. In the seven years I lived there, I referred three new residents, always kept the apartment clean, paid my rent early each month, and was a good tenant. Shellbrook was good to me, too. Maintenance requests were responded to quickly, and I've been pleased with the community over the years. I've given the property two 5 star reviews in the past. 

It's unfortunate that I have to give a 2 star review upon moving out.

The issue: I left the apartment in great condition when I moved, and expected to receive my $100 security deposit minus my final water bill. Instead, I was charged $40 for a yellow carpet stain and $85 for a pet "pee stain" cleaning fee. From the photos they sent, the "yellow stain" isn't visible and the "pee stain" on the bottom of the carpet is so small that it couldn't have been caused by my 15 lb. cat, who has always, without fail, used the litter box. These stains could have easily been removed by a general carpet cleaning and are signs of regular wear and tear from having lived there for seven years. *Also, the carpet at 7 years old will be replaced anyway. 

It baffles me that I should be charged this amount. It disappoints me that after having been such a good tenant that I would be treated so callously upon moving out. I cannot in good conscience recommend Shellbrook or any Drucker and Falk properties. It hurts to get burned. A 2-star review is appropriate.

Great property, Nice area and great for pet owners. North Hills is a 5 min drive away and its a 15 min drive to NCSU/Meredith College. Affordable rent with a good amount of space and parking is open. While there are a few issues with tile-work in the bathroom, a few phone lines hanging with their cases and having the cable line pulled from a closet a room over. Maintenance is great, they usually come within 2-3 days if its a non-emergency and they are very polite. If you enjoy a quiet, peaceful area with a huge lake equipped with turtles, fish and geese to keep you company, nice private balconies, large spacious rooms and great flooring, this is it.
It's alright not to bad very little but not for a family kids can't have bikes or have fun pretty much

When I moved to Raleigh I was a little overwhelmed by the amount of apartments in the area. I spent a week trying to find an affordable and nice one bedroom apartment. Being right out of college I needed the pricing to be reasonable and the environment to be safe. After my searching it was quite clear Shellbrook Apartments were superior. The employees are all incredibly kind and helpful. They are the only complex in the area that does not have breed restrictions on dogs which to me speaks highly of them already. What really shocked me was when my cat got fleas and the complex THE SAME DAY I reported it called me back and had an exterminator come in, at no cost to me. Also the few times I've had problems maintenance always comes the SAME DAY to fix the issue. Along with just a pleasant environment- a community where one can feel safe- Shellbrook has frequent mixer events and tries to get its tenants acquainted. They are constantly improving and having a stocked lake in my backyard is pretty fantastic. Shellbrook exceeded my expectations and everyone I've met who lives there says the exact same thing. We love it here!

Shellbrook Apartments is a great place to live. The staff is professional and nice. Maintenance issues are handled in a timely manner. They offer a number of amenities such as a pool, basic work out room, and laundry facility. They offer a number of apartment styles. Some are renovated and some are not. Shellbrook is located in north hills which is really close to lots of stores and restaurants. The place be a bit buggy, but they make an effort to exterminate the apartments every few months.

The apartment was good but not worth the price. You have all the nice appliances with the granite counter tops and the walk in shower and huge clostets, but I felt it was missing some important things that would help justify the price. There is LIMITED hot water. If you shower at 5pm, you will likely have luke warm water for about 5 minutes. On top of limited hot water, you have ZERO water pressure.  Visitor parking is a JOKE, your guests are required to park in a separate parking garage, in a different building. I will say the maintenance team is great and responds to requests quickly. The leasing team doesn’t seen 100% on top of their game. When I first moved in i wasn’t signed up for the apartment emails. Overall good, not spectacular.

They look nice on the outside, but are made of poor quality material. You can hear your neighbors walking, running, talking, singing, and watching tv, music and have sex. They have a marijuana problem as well. I wouldn’t recommend living here. If you like your sleep disturbed then move hear. If you want peace and quiet, look elsewhere. Don’t let the luxury feel fool you.

I cannot say enough amazing things about the staff and the apartment complex. During our tour the staff was incredibly sweet and answered whatever questions we had and more. The location of the complex is perfect as well, close to the mall and not far from downtown. what I loved most about this complex was the state of the art Gym. Incredibly amazing. I cannot wait to move in within a couple of months!

This is the worst complex I have ever stayed at. I requested to end my lease within 2 months due to work orders not being completed, bug infestation, and trash being left all over the ground. Management does not respond to emails or calls and they are extremely rude

Management is rude and inconsiderate. Trash is left on ground and the entire place is unsafe. I had multiple work orders that were closed without my issues being fixed. I had bug termination services come 3 times and that never worked. This place is infested with bugs. Management never answers calls or emails, only after I filled a complaint with the NC consumer justice department did I receive any help from management. This place is a disgrace. Please do not sign a lease unless you want more stress in your life

Take your money and go elsewhere. I moved in Feb 2021 and have move 3 times within the community and it is now April. Each time I moved the problem became worse. The apartments are old with all the original plumbing and electrical wiring. They have a terrible pest problem that includes drain flies, roaches, and rats (not mice). Management continues to use the excuse of being new and not fixing the problem. When tenants move out they don’t clean them, they don’t replace old things and replace with new things ex:toilet sets, and they don’t paint. Make this place your last stop on the way to hell.

Changed management during my stay and made it very hard to pay rent with the change of hand my work request where will no being meet. I went during winter with out heat after 3 request for months and I meant after 8 request and talking to managements as well with a whole in my celling had feel in and water leaked into my apartments for 3 months before being fixed. dirty laundry room. dose not spray for pest. My lock on my door was broken and still has not been fixed for about 7 months. I had my apartment looked at by management and told them everything that was wrong in did not have any one fix my fridge has been messed up apon moving in. Door handle has falling off in apon telling them they stated that I should jump over my back balcony with my 2 year old son to get in and out of the apartment in did not come to fix for over 24 hours.
The service to the public is very good !! Cleanliness always comes first and the apartments are spacious and clean as well as having a good location.

We have been residents for a long time and love our apartment. Maintenance is great. The office has went through changes but I really like the new employees as they have been pleasant and helpful each time I’ve come in the office with my dog.

This is a 1 star rating only because I can't give 0 and we also really appreciated the maintenance crew over the years, even though they had absolutely nothing to work with in terms of budget. They should all get a raise weekly for what the management puts them through.

Here are a few of our experiences that hope to sway you to look in another direction and you never rent here.
This place has the worst front office I have ever seen, especially with new management. They never call you back, nor do they take ownership for anything that goes wrong. This place should be condemned or turned into 1 star motel, because Luxury left when got near the complex.
We once read that it's a place if you don't mind the constant visitors, meaning the bugs. Ants, cockroaches, gnats, and others are everywhere and you get charged a monthly basis, whether they spray or not.
The screens, windows, closets, bathrooms, kitchen, lights, rugs, and everything is just nasty. They spray paint the cabinets so your dish-ware gets stuck to them, you can't open your windows because of the constant smoke (not just cigarettes). Oh yeah, mold is everywhere too.

Do not rent here, do not visit, and also, don't SWIM in the pool (Nasty as well).

Luxury Apartments is the funniest thing I ever heard. LMAO...

Girlfriend and I have lived here for about 9 months and are overall very pleased with the property. Very responsive maintenance (Carlos!) and friendly office staff (Mary and Stacy!). They also have cleaning staff (Rosa!) who regularly cleans the elevators and common areas. The office also hosts a community event at least once a month and do a great job engaging with the community. 
The facility amenities are good, the pool is not huge but it is large enough to swim laps if you want and is not very crowded even during peak summer hours and holidays. The fitness center is open 24/7 and has the basics for a workout. There are parcel lockers for secured for deliveries like Amazon or larger USPS packages. Centralized mail boxes. The elevators are a nice amenity, we’re on the 4th floor and moving in was a breeze as well as normal coming and going through the day.  We have not had any bugs what-so-ever in our apartment and if need be there is an exterminator that comes once a week. Parking spaces are not assigned, but are plentiful around my building. We also have a garage (optional $) for extra storage and parking. 
The apartment itself has been updated with granite counter tops in kitchen/bathroom and we had new carpet in our apartment (super nice) and updated appliances. Full sized washer and dryer also included. The closets are a little small, nor is there separate lighting inside the closets but manageable.
For the most part, we have wonderful neighbors and made several new friends. Some are inconsiderate, but that’s just people being people. Welcome to community living. The walls are thick, don’t hear the neighbors too much but every now and then someone wants to test out a surround sound. 
Across the street is a nice village of shops that has pretty much everything you could want (Food Lion, ACE Hardware, salon, a few pubs/restaurants/ice cream) that is easy walking distance. And of course, the greenway system (Abbots' Creek to Neuse River) is accessible, a huge plus. 
Only real downside I have is that this apartment complex is not a smoke free environment. We live on the 4th floor and unfortunately our downstairs neighbors (3rd and 2nd floors) take alternating shifts on balcony cigarette smoking which prohibits us from enjoying the balcony (or opening windows). In my opinion I think smoking should not be allowed on balconies as I consider it a common area since the balcony decking has gaps and not fully “enclosed”). Other than that, really like it here.

Over a year later, still a five star place to live. The staff is wonderful, they have been attentive to the few issues and maintenance needs that have come up and they worked with me during the renewal process to help manage expenses. The location is wonderful, I am close to everything I need and want. The entrance to the greenway is around the corner and there are shops less than a block away. I was concerned about thin walls when I moved in, but I honestly hear very little. I also enjoy a bit of white noise so if you are like me, a little background noise feels normal. The unit is beautiful, I love the updates the company has done and one of the nicest parts of the unit is having a fireplace, it warms the place up faster than the heater on winter days. Only con I have is that the company likes to do community events, but schedules them during the week prior to 6. Anyone who has a 9-5 is hard pressed to attend and I’d prefer they did them on the weekends. The siding on some of buildings also looks a bit weathered and could use a good power wash or repaint, but that’s minor. There is a dog park, if you’re a dog parent, but it’s more like a 5x12 cage. Again though, the greenway is next door for your 4 legged friend. Oh and before you look at reviews mentioning bugs, know that if you live in NC, bugs come with the territory. I’ve had to kill no more bugs than I would if I lived in a house. The value for money is great and I plan on staying here a very long time. Check this place out before going to other apartments!
My time here at Summermill at Falls River has been excellent.
Office staff are fast to answer all inquires, repairs request are answered and repaired quickly. Apartment complex is conveniently located to nearby shopping and restaurants. Quiet neighborhood.

I have lived here for over a year now. My particular unit had some maintenance issues In the beginning but the office fixed it quickly. Parking can be minimal near my building. Overall I love my unit, the design and location is great. Good stores nearby.

My story of living here is a horror story. Upon attempting to move in my girlfriend and I learned that it is common practice at this complex to not run the AC systems in unoccupied apartments to cut costs. As soon as we walked in the stench of mold was unbearable. The HVAC system itself was almost totally fouled with mold. We complained to management who did some things to mitigate the problem, but it was nowhere near what was actually needed. We have tried to live here and put up with it, however, recently our hot water heater sprung a leak thanks to management not actually maintaining them. By not maintaining them, I mean this fossil was 15 years old when a water heater of its type has a max lifetime of 12 years. Finally after this happened management started taking the proper steps to remediate our apartment to eliminate the mold. This process included putting up plastic sheeting to contain areas deemed hazardous by a mold/air quality testing company, ripping out multiple walls, and ripping out a floor. I would say we appreciate these efforts, however, since our apartment has been torn apart for a month, we haven't been given alternative housing, and we have been informed that even more needs to be done we consider it more like a nightmare. The sad thing is that all of this could have been avoided if management had just given this place reasonable maintenance over the years. To compound things, management switched over recently and the new team has been rude, unhelpful, and at times downright shady. If you are looking for a place to live in the Raleigh area I strongly recommend steering clear of this place.

After scheduling an appointment and confirming the date and time, I came from out of state to tour the property and get more information. When I got to the leasing office there was a piece of paper taped to the door stating the office was closed. I never received a phone call or email informing me. I'm very disappointed with this property, especially after they stressed how necessary it was for me to schedule an appointment. I really would hate to know how actual tenants are treated here...

I have lived at Summermill for over 3 years,  it is a great apartment with nice facilities.  The office has some room for improvement when the new management company took over they let go of the best employee there which was very sad.  The pool is nice and well kept and the grounds are maintained very nicely.  I live in a one bedroom which has plenty of space and the high ceilings make it seems very spacious.

My apartment is the best place to leave,  It have the best employees and much beautiful and peaceful naborhood,  and also professional in there jobs, they respond to work order as fast as possible,  the apartment is well taken care of,  i will recommend anyone looking for an apartment and a safe environment

Great Location! Near local supermarkets and great eating places. 2 Bedroom 2 Bath that has a very open floor plan. Elevators in each building which helps for the apartments upstairs. Gym, Pool, and a Movie Theatre! Cozy living area and a warm neighborly feel. Feels right at home!

Great location..lots of unique shops nearby.  Good restaurants!  Convenient to everything!  I have lived here for over 11 years and the new management has finally priced me out!  I'm very sad to have to be moving but that's big business for you.  The girls in the office have become friends over the years so I will not only miss the wonderful home I have made here, but also the great people that live and work here!!

Stop settling for low-hanging fruit when there's SummerMill Apartments at Falls River. Let our elevators rest those tired puppies as you transcend to your spacious un, deux, or trois bedroom home. Maybe bask in sun in our private oasis after visiting the 24/7 health refinement center. Paradis is a click away!

When my lady and I moved here, we were looking for a quite place to call home and got just that. Not only is it spacious and clean, the people around us are so friendly. We are so pleased to be here and love the managing team of Dallas, Izzy & Destiny. They make us feel so heard and always welcome us with a smile. There team is extremely responsive and the amenities are great. They also have fun events every month that keep the community engaged. We are so happy to call this our home.

My boyfriend and I moved to Maystone at Wakefield 9 months ago. We moved from NYC and this was our first apartment together, so we were pretty excited. On our move in day we decided to do a full walk through of the apartment and we noticed that it was very clean. Living here has been amazing, the community is quiet and clean, everyone in the leasing office is extremely welcoming, friendly, and genuinely helpful, there's monthly community events, the pool, gym and one of the dog parks (there are two) are super close to my apartment, and the community is very dog friendly. I've met a bunch of my neighbors that have dogs, which is great because I also have a dog. I sometimes bring my dog to the leasing office, and everyone in the leasing office gives are so much attention, and she loves it.

Peaceful and clean community.
Never had a maintenance issue in a year. Apartment was handed to me in an excellent condition. Leasing office staff super friendly and helpful.

I have been a resident through the last 4.5 yrs.  It is an incredibly well-kept, quiet property that any person will be proud/happy to come home to. You cannot beat the size and quality for the price in this area. :)

I just moved in recently and so far I am loving it! Izzy helped me through the application process and made everything so easy for me. My apartment looked great when I moved in and I am so excited I found such a great place in this area for such a great price. Thank you to the staff at Maystone for making my move such a smooth experience!!!

I highly recommend moving to Maystone at Wakefield! Their prices are fair and definitely worth all of the amenities you receive. I have loved my experience. The office staff was very personable and made my move stress free.

I’ve never been a resident here but looking at the floor plan i’m genuinely curious as to why you would put a laundry room in the master bedroom? Let alone any person’s bedroom? And looking at these reviews? Yikes.
Apartments are small, dark and loud and the office staff are unwilling or incapable of doing anything about excessive noise and surround sound shaking the walls.

I have noticed a ton of improvement in the last year. There was a time when I had my mind made up that I was going to move when my lease was up but I am definitely staying now. Thank you to the staff for turning this place around.

I initially loved this place when I moved in, inside the apartments are nice, however, 4 months in and it’s a nightmare. All deposits were made prior to moving in $0 balance you would think, but no.  Reviewing my account and I saw that I’m owing $300 for dog deposit. I called the office to have it removed and it didn’t, I have to be kept calling calling calling for it to be removed, then I stopped by to report that my oven bulb never worked that didn’t change until 2 weeks after me calling back to ask what happen to the bulb for the oven - 2 weeks. Trash on the steps sometimes for days, the dog park is covered in poo and dog poop sometimes at the walkway, GATES doesn’t work 90% of the time( Gated Community) it’s either left open or your gate fob not working so you’re stuck at the gate late at nights trying to get in. The other gate is totally broken off so it’s left wide open, Sanitising wipes in the gym dried out hence it cannot be used. Here goes my rent, which is paid in advance every month only to get an email stating I’m in arrears and what actions will be taken ( I asked myself is this really happening?) Then there is the unprofessionalism of staff who discusses other residents that they are complainers, or what type of furniture inside of their apartment etc. I had initially recommended friends and colleagues to Maystone but I’ll be forwarding this review to them. 
My mental health and security is of utmost importance to me and this is not it. This place was advertised as Luxury Apartment but I guess that’s subjective.

Don’t rent here they tell you all kinds of things to get you into the apartment and then when you get there they do nothing but lie and charge you for things that they said would be free I’ve been living here over six months and the gate that we have has been broken for three Never received my free month rent debit card they have been giving me the runaround every since very on organized

I have lived here for a little over a year and will be moving out this month.  I want to start by saying that Shaunte, Kiera and the rest of the (new) management staf are wonderful and will do whatever they can to get things done, when they can.  Unfortunately, the issue(s) I have had here are still unresolved.

My issues are as follows, the worst being number 1:

1.  A couple of weeks ago a family with 5 very young children moved in above me.  Apparently, these apartments were built very cheaply and I hear everything!  Most of the day, until around 10:00 p.m. it feels as though I have a stampede above me and it has gotten so bad that I cannot work from home anymore and have had to work at Starbucks during the day.  I have called security 2 times and they have gone to the apartment, however, no one will answer the door.  The management has told me that they have called the tenant, however, the  loud noise continues.  I  have been told that there is nothing more they can do and that that they get these complaints on a constant basis from other tenants

2.  I had knee surgery a couple of months after I moved in and needed to park in the handicap parking spot.  This was last June and there are, or should be, 2 handicap signs outside of each building.  Someone ripped off one of them (it still hasn't been replaced almost a year later) and people w/o handicap plackets or handicapped license plates parked in the one spot.  When the old management didn't do anything, I called the police.  The 1 sign is still missing.

3.  This is a gated community, however, the gates are open all day and when they are closed, we use a card--when the gate opens at least 4 cars can go through. So much for being "gated".

If you are planning to move here, my only suggestion is get an apartment on the 3rd floor!

You don't get your packages, you get charged for things you were told were free the 1st year.  You get everyone's mail but your own in the mailbox.  They tell you just put in the return mail. well 2 days later you get it back.  Instead of looking up the tenants name and asking them to put the correct address on it.
Every time you go up to the clubhouse to ask a question, they all too busy having coffee, or hanging out. 3 times in one day, I asked about a package
that was delivered for me. twice they told me it was not there.  The third time when I showed them the deliver receipt, from the post office
they finally took me into the storage room  and looked,  They said there were 3 packages there and none were mine.  I finally had them read the names and they did and one was mine. I said that's me, she said, oh it must have just come in. Wrong.....  it came in the da before and no one checked it in.  It states, no aggressive dogs, there a pits, Sheppard's and very large dogs in this community
NOISY NEIGHBORS, BIG SPIDERS IN THE SPRING, I MEAN BIG.
I'M LOOKING ELSEWHERE AS I TYPE, EVEN IF I HAVE TO BREAK THE LEASE, I'M LEAVING!

I have lived at Hunting Ridge for 4 years and would highly recommend it. It is an older property, but is well maintainted. I like my neighbors and being close to my work. I wish some people were more considerate with guests on the property, but I think that's a problem everywhere. I plan on staying here until I'm ready to buy a house.

Hunting Ridge is awesome, we love it and everyone we have met here says the same. The apartments are large and laid out nicely. Clean and renovated units. The bedrooms have massive closets! The kitchen is our favorite part--modern look with great new appliances. Nothing ever breaks or stops working. We have never had a problem with anything here. 

Neighbors are friendly, parking is abundant, amenities are killer. The pool area is super clean and it's always a nice place to chill. No one is obnoxious and it's never crowded. Gym has everything you need for a workout. Gas grill area is our favorite, we use them all the time. Staff is super nice and helpful. 

Location is awesome. Supremely safe, exactly what you expect of North Raleigh. Across the street is a Chick-fil-a!! Groceries, restaurants, shopping are less than 2 mins away. You would never have to leave the 5 mile area if you didn't want to. The complex is across the street from a golf course on one side, and the streets behind the complex are quiet and perfect for walks/runs. 

Overall this is exactly where you would want to be if you're renting in North Raleigh, especially for this price range--super affordable, safe, and clean!

My apartment complex has newly renovated apartments, saltwater pool, fitness center,and a dog park as well. Its in the heart of Raleigh near to many nice restaurants and shopping centers. The staff here is amazing, they try to solve any problem you may have.

I have lived here for almost a year and a half with no complaints.  Whenever there is an issue, maintenance comes in a timely manner and does their best to fix the issue.  My husband and I moved here from WV, and the main office helped make a smooth transition for us.  The only reason we are moving is so my husband can be closer to work.  Otherwise, we would live here until we bought a house.

My husband and I lived here for a little over a year.  It's a typical set up for college students and it was difficult (for us impossible) to see an actual manager when we were moving.  They only have students working in the office to talk to and they could not answer our moving questions.  Also, the lease was vague as what to do when you are moving for a job opportunity and when that was pointed out I was not treated as a friendly renter.  I asked for copied of documents that I signed, yet I was not allowed to and was given no explanation.  Save you time and money and rent somewhere else.

I really like living here. Great location. Everyone that I have interacted with are very nice. The staff in the main office seem to know all tenants by name. I find that quite impressive since there are a lot of people that live here. The buildings are pretty old, but they are very well maintained. If something messes up, the maintenance people are here in no time. Apartments are surrounded by tress, making it feel like you are away from the city. 8 ft. deep salt water pool is awesome!

I moved to The Residences from another community in Wake Forest about a month ago. I love it here.  The apartments are large and bright and mine has a wrap around verandah. The unit includes a garage at no additional cost.  The new management team is doing a great job.  They are friendly and responsive.  Hoping to call The Residences home for a long while to come.

The parking issue is absolutely ridiculous. They painted NO PARKING yellow lines all over the apartment complex for absolutely no reason, and will tow your car for no reason. There is virtually no guest parking and they just tell you to park on the street outside the complex, and if you live in the back of the complex it’s about a 10 - 15 minute walk.
I understand protecting driveways and reserved spaces, but there is absolutely no reason for the yellow lines EVERYWHERE.

Gym has been “under construction” for months now and the tennis court is non functioning. Not sure why we are still paying for “luxury amenities” when they aren’t available.

This is a great place to live. The grounds are kept very nice and the apartment is very nice.  The staff, especially Meredith, have been wonderful and very helpful. I know they I have any questions or concerns, I can talk to them and know that and it will be take fill be fixed. Good place to live

Avoid this place at all costs!! After 2.5 months of living here, we are finally able to break our lease and leave after countless issues… let’s start with a messy disgusting unit when arriving, we were assured it was cleaned moving in, it was extremely far from it. We had broken appliances moving in that took maintenance 3 weeks and some over a month to fix. We had our kitchen flood only 3 days into living here due to horrible plumbing. Weve had cockroach’s with pest control not doing a thing about it. The “Great” amenities this place offers… well not a single one is open or functioning. They “luxury” renovations look like a 5 year old did them with 0 experience, not kidding, someone with no experience could have made these units look better. The icing on the cake was when we had our upstairs neighbor overflow the toilet, not clean it up, causing our bathroom to have raw sewage leak from the ceiling and ruin our personal property… then management doesn’t want to help us in the slightest. Our apartment smelled of raw sewage and the management team wasn’t even willing to work with us on finding a comfortable place to sleep for our family and ignored our emails and phone calls for help. There is more and more to our story that a review can’t even contain…. But DO NOT live here!!!!!

My apartment is lovely. The ladies in management, Jessica and Amber, have been so helpful in my settling into a new city as well as a new apartment.  Chuck and his crew are professional and courteous which makes a huge difference when things need service in a rental community. So pleased to have found Residences at Wakefield.

I've been living here for just over 6 months, relocated from MI and I can't speak highly enough about the girls up front.  From day one they've been there to answer every question or concern I've ever had.  Very personable and easy to speak with, it makes it much easier to reach out for literally anything.  Lack of parking isn't great, so either get a garage or make sure you have a reserved parking spot.  I've had not so great experiences with office staff in the past, the quality of work they do here trumps any of the downsides to living here by far.  As long as I plan to keep renting, I won't have any plans to leave here.
Honestly for an apartment at this price I had worries. But i got a newly renovated unit for a great price. Easy access in and out. Management actually nice and helpful

The maintenance team here could be better. I have been a resident here for a long time. I have seen 3 different managements companies come in and out. The current maintenance team could use more training or a whole different crew.

The pipes freeze when running the ac and it leaks water into the filter compartment. Maintenance comes over with tape and blows water from inside the ac compartment all over the floor. No regard for cleanliness. Someone's dog took a s*** on the walk way coming out the door of the apartment spoke with maintenance about it.

They stated they would take care of it. Next day comes, it's still sitting there. Neighbors are smoking stank weed and you can smell the smoke leaking in your own apartment almost as if you were smoking it.

Must have thin insulation. Irresponsible tenants and maintenance crew. The valet will not pick up the trash or recycling and you are charged monthly. These one star reviews are telling the whole story about the complex.
Sattima was amazing! She made me feel extremely comfortable and was very reassuring and accurate with any and all questions that I had! Great customer service!

Sattima was very helpful & very knowledgeable of the properties. They were nice & spacious & the amenities are great as well!!! Me & my boyfriend are apartment hunting & are definitely considering Andover at Crabtree!!

Sattima was super attentive and took me on a full tour as well as answered all of my questions to provide me with the best insight to make my decision. I really liked this place and can see myself living here.

Sattima was knowledgeable about the property and helpful with details concerning the apartment of interest. The main con for me were the low ceilings. However, the updated finishes looked great in the renovated unit. Will be heavily considering this place as an option.

I was supposed to move in but had a issue, and I just needed a little bit more time to come up with first month rent but I was told it was nothing they could do AND I lost my deposit. It was misleading and what one of the manger told me, did not add to what the lease told me!
I love my new apartment. It's spacious and near a lot of city attractions! The neighborhood is awesome!

A cozy laid back relaxing studio with excellent view of swimming pool off patio area.A hide away low underground ride bye going to miss it.A just enough space not to chillax private entrance no neighbor on the sides of you. A very personal welcome kinda spot too.

I love all the trees and small pond surrounding the apartment and it's very pet friendly. I have a 1 bedroom apartment and it comes with a very large balcony. The staff are very friendly and helpful here.

I lived here for a year and it was an awful experience. For starters when I moved in, they didn't have my postal keys. It took a month of me calling in the office asking where they were before I finally got them. The pest control they had was useless as far as I could tell. I ended up doing a better job of killing pest myself. At one point it took a whole month for my AC to be fixed and didn't even get a temporary unit until two days before it was fixed. The online portal was also useless, I had switched banks and filled out my new info long before the end of the month, but they still charged my closed bank account and then charged me a late fee, even though I was doing everything to prevent that from happening. Neighbors would park illegal on the street and in handicap spots, but I never saw a tow truck enter the neighborhood. The price looks tempting considering the market, but spending an extra $100 a month somewhere else is a much better investment. The move in process was also painful as no one in the office knew what they were doing when I moved in and sent direct deposits. Don't move here.

I’ve been living here for less than 6 months and I can say that that every single month, there has been some kind of issue. Ive had a mouse in my apartment 2nd month in and was simply told that they would put me on the pest control list (it’s already suppose to be pest control - we pay a fee for it every month). Management staff isn’t helpful and always has to get back with you, if they ever do!! They have high fees just to pay your rent with a debit card (extra $52 on top of already expensive rent). God forbid you have nfs and they will charge you ridiculous fees just to be able to try the payment again (rent + nfs fee -$35 + late fee - $81 + debit card -$52)! Now I’m told I can only pay rent using check cashing locations or with a debit card including extra fee, very inconvenient! This will be my first and last lease at this apartment complex.

I can't believe I never gave my review when I moved in 2019. I signed a lease on a 2BR 2018 & we were one of the first tenants in some of the back buildings that had just finished being built. When we signed our lease it was a little expensive than what I liked but because I was commuting so far for my job at my previous residence I needed to be closer & thus justified my living expense increase. Paid all the necessary fees/move in rent costs, their outrageous pet fees & moved in. Didn't have too much of an issue. I go online to the portal to set up auto-drafts for rent & manually pay the November rent (moved in ~October 20th) & was surprised to see no rent is due. Knowing there is never anything as free rent, I emailed the property about it. They said there was a move-in special that no one told us about where we got our first full month rent free. Interesting to NOT mention that as that seems like a pretty good selling point to rent a unit but OK. The next couple days I spoke to probably 2 other people in that office INCLUDING the bookkeeper to confirm this infor & was told that it was in fact true. To be on the safe side, I never set up the auto-draft. B/c as soon as December 1 came around, BAM! I got a bill for almost $5k in rent charges & ever since then it was a constant fight with the office. No one told me that this was a free month, they have no record of it, the bookkeeper was always unavailable but would call me back (sure Jan), etc. I got the run around. The icing on the cake was that my job transferred me to Louisiana causing me to have to break my lease. Unfortunately for me, I wasn't high enough on the food chain to get all of my moving expenses paid for so I was forced to pay $3,870 to break the lease. I would have hoped that considering all the nonsense about this rent issue being a problem that some sort of concession could have been made for coming down on the price but Bacarra? Of course not! I ended up paying it because I honestly didn't have a choice; I had to be 1000 miles away in under 2 weeks for work. I had to deal with their leasing "staff", property "manager", and their bookkeeper/finance person who was NEVER in the office (how magical) over the issue of these back rent charges. I got to the point where I had to call a law firm and involve an attorney. RIDICULOUS!

BEWARE - IT IS NOT WORTH THE MONEY OR THE HASSLE. It's like the girl at the bar who is really pretty; the next morning she's not as pretty as you remember her.

I am currently living here. My air conditioner was not working for more than a month now and I am living in temperatures greater than 80F. They setup a small window unit which is limited to a piece of area. It’s really frustrating. No efficient service men. Management really doesn’t care even after 1 month without ac. Don’t recommend

Recently, the apartment above me had a horrible flood which flooded my bedroom.  I called, and called, and called their emergency number and NO ONE ever called back.  The fire department cut the water and electricity off (thank God) . 
 It was over two hours before anyone showed up.  Then, when I requested for them to research why my water bill was so high, they discovered a clear white tube (maintenance) was broken in my toilet bowl.  They denied my concern and told me I had to pay for the extremely high (triple than the normal) water bill because I didn't put in a work request.  Now, how am I suppose to know a tube disconnected in my toilet bowl?  I requested a copy of my past water bill which I am still waiting for, got a shock from the light socket when I attempted to turn the light switch on, and had to go to the office because they NEVER return phone calls.  I've lived in apartment managed by Carroll Management in SC and now NC.  Time to find a place that appreciated its tenants.  Shame on Bacarra Apartments and Carroll Management.

These apartments are pretty nice (except for as the other reviewers have mentioned no natural light, and very few lights in the apartment itself) until you have to communicate with the unorganized office staff. They are very slow to get back with you, if they get back to you at all.  Good luck getting answers when you need them.  Maintenance is also slow with a chance of not showing up at all.

I lived in this apartment complex for year and it was the WORST. The management is totally rude, unresponsive and doesn't give a darn about the residents. They will charge you for damages even if you have proof that you didn't cause them. I was charged for new blinds even though I had replaced the damaged ones myself. I showed them the pictures of the new blinds, but they still refused to refund me. The carpet was also damaged when I moved in, but the management refused to do anything about it. I told them about the damage when I moved in, but they said it wasn't their problem. The maintenance crew have this habit of wandering into our apartments when we weren't around. This is totally messed up and makes me feel unsafe in my own home. One time, I was chillin' at home when a maintenance worker just strolled in without a care in the world and stayed all day. I had to tell him to leave after 6 pm. So, if you're thinking about living in this apartment complex, I'd give it a hard pass. The management is MIA when you need 'em, they'll charge you for stuff you didn't do, and the maintenance crew can be pretty unsettling.

I lived at Woodlake Downs for a year, and it was the worst experience of my life. The low rent is not worth it. You'll be spending more money on repairs, maintenance, and other unexpected costs. The buildings are old and falling apart. There are leaking pipes, broken appliances, and other safety hazards. The management is rude and unresponsive. They won't fix anything, and they'll make you pay for repairs even if they're caused by their neglect. They even try to bribe tenants for positive reviews. They prioritize money over tenant safety and health. The pool was opened with unsafe water, and they refused to help with pest control. When you move out, they'll hit you with hefty damages charges, even if the damages are not your fault. There are better options available in the area. Don't waste your time and money at Woodlake Downs. The management is only concerned with lining their pockets, not with the well-being of their tenants.

Steer clear of this place! Yeah, at first glance, the price might look tempting, but trust me, they'll sneak in all these crazy charges while you're there and then stick you with unnecessary fees when you try to move out. I've been around the block, rented four different spots in the last seven years, and never once had to pay for any damages. But guess what? Woodlake Downs hit me with a massive bill. And let me tell you, the buildings there are straight-up ancient and falling apart. They don't lift a finger to fix anything, but you can bet your bottom dollar they'll make you foot the repair costs. And don't even get me started on the management—rude, unresponsive, and their sole focus is squeezing every cent they can out of you. No joke, this place takes the cake for being the absolute worst I've ever called home. Oh, and get this: they try to bribe tenants with gift vouchers and all sorts of goodies just to get positive reviews. Makes you wonder if any of those rave reviews are even legit, right? Seriously, do yourself a favor and run the other way!
Old buildings, pest problems & poor management. They will treat you well to lure you in the beginning and start treating you badly afterwards. Only good thing is the location.

They were by far the worst management I have ever encountered, showing little concern for anything other than making money. Their behavior drastically changed after I signed the lease.

I submitted a request to fix a clogged toilet. To my astonishment, upon returning home, I discovered that they had placed the toilet directly on top of the bathroom tub. This was a clear violation of basic hygiene protocols, and it only takes them a mere five minutes to properly fit the toilet without resorting to such an unnecessary measure. What's worse is that they failed to inform me about this unconventional placement. I promptly reached out to them through phone and email, but received no response. As a result, I was left without functioning bathroom facilities for approximately 24 hours. To make matters even more unsatisfactory, they left my bathroom filled with dirt after completing the repair.

Adding insult to injury, the management falsely charged me for damages I did not cause. Despite repeatedly voicing my concerns to them, they continued to overcharge me. When I expressed my desire to break the lease during the first week of the month, they charged me a lease break fee for the following three months, instead of the standard two months. They did not return my security deposit.

Living in that apartment was an absolute nightmare, and I cannot express how relieved I am to have finally escaped their clutches.

Be cautious about this apartment as it can be a financial drain. The management is highly incompetent and expressing any concerns to them often leads to their anger. When leaving the apartment, they will impose unreasonable charges for issues that are their responsibility, and demand the apartment be returned to its original, pristine condition. I highly recommend exercising caution if you are thinking about relocating to this apartment.

I’ve been living here for over a year and my experience has honestly been great. Always good customer service when speaking with office staff, maintenance team is very respectful and bring great energy into your home when making repairs (I hate bad energy entering my home), the complex is always very clean and well kept, the location is great! You’re near glenwood, brier creek, north hills, & can easily take 540 to get to durham. The staff is very good with updating you on the status of the pool, fitness center, etc. Overall, I’m pretty satisfied and don’t have anything negative to say about my experience living here. Move on in!!

They will charge you for normal wear and tear. The facility is ill maintained with duck poop all over the walkways and near the pool area. Not very sanitary and there is water leakage in the wall pipes that I believe caused mold in my unit.

There is better apartments in the area that will not increase your rent by 45% twice in the same year.

This place is an old structure with pipes that leak into the walls. A couple of times I had to call because water was flowing under the sink both kitchen and bathroom. In the bathroom there appears to be a leakage behind the toilet that they couldn't fix. The water caused mold and blackening of the wall which they went ahead to bill me for even though I called it in. This place cares more about money than the safety and health of their tenants opening the pool even when the water was not safe to swim in.

In my opinion nothing is as advertised; shoddy all the way.

Please rent somewhere else if you value your health and peace of mind. Wendy will drive you crazy at the bare minimum you will leave the place with grey hair.

I was a resident of 3.5 years. From my time at the complex I had multiple bug issues where 100's of flying bugs were coming out of cracks in the apartment. The office refused to take the matter seriously. I had to come out of pocket for many supplies to treat the pest. On top of that cost, after moving out of the apartment we were charged $1,051 in damages. Between my roommate and I we have rented from 7 apartment complexes and we have never been charged damages. Needless to say we are still disputing these charges from when me moved out in April. From the reviews it seems this is a very common occurrence. The office sends out multiple communications offering gift cards if you leave reviews, which leads me to believe this is the only reason they have any positive feedback. Recently the cops have been called to the apartment quite often so that was another thing I did not like towards the end. Your money will go much further at any other apartment in the area. Don't waste your time on this one!

Be very careful with this property I am still battling them about my security deposit. When I stated the NC statue that they had 30 days to send me an itemized bill or they forfeit the rights to my deposit I never heard back. Since I moved across the streets I walked back over back in June 2018. Below is one of my pictures I have where they have claimed to have repainted the door. I have lived here for 9 1/2 years. There have been a few negative incidents but nothing that would have caused me to move. Most of the staff is great, it's the people who move here from other states and don't want to follow the rules that I have the most problem with but whenever I have an issue, they do their best to address it. It's a beautiful area and mostly quiet. Close to everything.

This is a nice community. The grounds are well maintained and the staff is pleasant and professional. There are two pools, a playground, gym, and  the office area provides computers, lounge with tv, and you can borrow books and movies. The complex abuts Lake Lynn which offers great walking trails, fishing, and other outdoor activities. Woodlake is located close schools, hospitals, and shopping. There are a few problems though. Some buildings have problems with the walkways flooding, the washer dryer hook ups are on the patio, and some apartment's feature old appliances. Choose your apartment carefully, and you've got a nice place to live.
The employees at Walnut Ridge has been nothing but kind and helpful to me. It was a smooth move in. My emails always been answered in a timely manner.

Walnut Ridge have great amenities the team that they have on site from the office to the maintenance workers are awesome! I love that they have a hub where your package can be delivered safe. I love how they have a portal where you can check for updates your account and more, Walnut ridge has offered a great app called next door to keep up what goes around in the community  you can meet other residence and more .Great app!

Over the years it has been a great place to live. There have been a few changes down through the years but it will get better. The staff do their best sometimes you just gotta be patient and positive. the maintenance team works good but the job gets done and they’re courteous over all i love it here.
Walnut Ridge is a nice and peaceful place to live. Office staff and maintenance  make you feel very welcome and take care of any issues promptly.
It's a nice quiet management always answer any questions I have and maintenance comes in a very reasonable time I love it here.
Walnut Ridge was fine when I first moved here in 2020, but now it's just very unpleasant to be here.

Pros: 
1. Staff is friendly and helpful
2. Good location for me

Cons:
1. The other reviews are correct - there are a lot of roaches here. The exterminator gets around to the apartment about 3 times a year. If you continue to see roaches you can ask the main office to have them come again. The exterminator usually just walks in, does 2 quick sprays/squirts on the floor in front of the sink and leaves. It's good for about 3 weeks. Then you start seeing roaches again(usually baby ones in my apt). I am constantly having to buy Raid and use it every weekend. That usually keeps the roaches away, but I shouldn't have to spend money, and breath in Raid fumes all the time.

2. The elevators are constantly breaking down. There are 11 floors here and people either have to stay in their apartments until the elevators get fixed or walk up and down the stairs (carrying groceries, work laptops, brief cases, etc. at times)

3. As another reviewer wrote there is a smell in the hallways, and usually some light trash/paper on the floors where people drop stuff and don't pick it up. The strong, spicy smell, I think, comes from all the cooking some people do inside their apartments seeping out onto the hallways. The carpet has been here a long, long time. And yes, you do smell marijuana at times.

4. People don't seem to care about cars here. I have more dents in my car since moving here a few months ago then I've ever had. Also, some people like to always take up two parking spaces and the office says there's nothing they can do about that. So, you end up having to park in the very back of a large parking area because others want to take up two spaces in front of the building. I've never lived anywhere else where the office wouldn't take care of this issue.

5. There has been a smell coming from the refrigerator area in my studio apt. It almost smells like escaping Freon. Visitors have noticed it, and so did one of the office staff. However, Maintenance apparently can't smell anything. I'm breathing in whatever this is, yet nothing is being done.
I love living here! The office staff is friendly and helpful. Yes, the building is an older building but I have honestly not had any problems that weren't corrected immediately.

DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!!!! There are roaches everywhere and they’ve been here for years terminex comes and goes and nothing changes! People are so nice here and don’t get me wrong it’s a cute cheap place. But when people don’t care about you living with a disgusting insect. Then there’s a problem

Place is completely infested with bugs. They claim to spray each floor once every other month but it doesn’t do anything to help.
