The apartment needs to replace hallway carpet as there is a constant odor. This likely stems from the many residents who smoke indoors with little regard to property or neighbors.
Good pricing. Great service ??  great interior and exterior.

The office team has great customer service, The Manager Glenda is very proffessional understaing,When Covid hit she was very understanding residents not working, the cleanining and maintence very good.  You place an order and the men are there to fix the problem right away

If you’re truly desperate for a place that has a reasonable price within this area of Raleigh try your hardest not to move here. The reviews on this place are outdated. If you check Google almost everyone gives it a 1 star wishing they could give less. The community only cares about your money. If you call almost never answer. The are tons and tons of roaches. I have to get the pest control twice a month and buy bills of my own pest control traps and the fill up like crazy! Maintenance here is a joke! A literal joke. I have to have my AC fixed on almost all warm months. It took them two months after what should have been my 60 day notice to get all my paperwork set. I’ve been lied to about community policies and no one seems to know exactly what the policy is for anything from noise, to parking to repairs or anything in the office. The community is not peaceful or quiet. People are loud, robberies happen often. And my mother and I were basically robbed at gun point by a man who would not move his vehicle from in front of ours and had a gun on his waist until we gave him some change and acted like we didn’t speak English. And even with all that the maintenance team has ignored request to fix all of the lights onto the front entrance of the apartment after two request have been submitted. Don’t waste your time or money move somewhere else!!

I was pleasantly surprised with how nice my apartment was. I like all of the grassy walking area and the pretty pool. The ladies in the office are nice and helpful. Just not enough open parking spaces and would have liked a digital thermostat not the old kind. Overall good place to live.
Love the changes happening, new look love the color change, pool furniture, maintenance of the gym and laundry room and the breezeways being pressure washed. A good start to Improvement!

The past year has been a wonderful experience! This is my first apartment and the staff helped make it an easy transiton for me. They actually listen to you and assist you to the best of their ability. If i had any problem with my apartment the responce was pretty fast. I had the same maintenance man(James) work on my apartment since day one; he always went above and beyond the call of duty! All the amenities listed an the website was available at all times and when broken was fixed within a reasonable amount of time. Parking wasnt too bad and it was pretty quite. I never had any issues with neighbors. The rent was extemely reasonable for the location and for what was offered. You were literally minutes away from everything walking or driving. I will definately consider renewing my lease!!! :)

I've lived in my apartment for over 10 years and I love it!! It is so convenient to grocery stores, restaurants, and the mall! You name it, it's nearby; my teenage daughter found a job that she could walk to!! We have a pool, tennis court, sand volleyball court, and a 1/3 mile walking trail.The grounds are well maintained and the maintenance staff fixes repairs within two days of my request.We've even got security patrolling the parking lots at night.  I've got everything I need right here. You'd love it too!!

I’m a current tenant and this 55+ apartment building community is safe , beautiful and affordable. All the units and grounds are all brand new spacious and modern. The maintenance staff makes sure everything is meticulously kept clean inside and out and working properly. I haven’t had any major issues and when there was a minor repair needed for my apartment it was taken care of the same day. The entire building is accessible from the main entrance where there is an elevator and throughout every space inside. The extra amenities are very nice. The building is very secure and I feel completely safe here. The entire leasing office staff are all very friendly and helpful. Monica who is the leasing office manager is wonderful. I would recommend Milner Commons. I give it 1000 stars!!!!
Left email and messages seven times with no response

The price is overpriced for the unmaintained amenities and the inept front office. Took over a month for the front office to complete my lease renewal. The front office is also hyper focused on ‘updating’ amenities instead of fixing current broken ones.

The location of Lofts is convenient for me to get to work and the grocery store.  I like that it is not on a busy street and has access to Lake Crabtree so I can bike to the trails and run around the lake on my free time.  I am an avid cyclist so it was important to me to be near Umstead Park and within biking distance of shops.  All of my neighbors are friendly and I have made some great friends while living here.  The ladies in the office always say hello and remember my name when I stop by.  Overall I would recommend this place as it has been perfect for my needs and I am absolutely in love with the location and the lake.

Our ceiling in the unit has leaked 5 times during our stay and all the The Arboretum does is "paint over" the damage. No one has opened the ceiling to see where the leaks are coming from! Please don't give me that generic reply as to "we'll love to speak with you regarding the issue". We are concerned about mold from sitting water in our ceiling and also electrical issues since our fan is located right next to the main leak.  They only want to allow our unit to be switched and have us pay the new market value for the unit which is unfair since the structural issues are not tenants responsibilities.

GOOD: The people that work here in the building are kind and helpful. Lynne and Gabby in particular. My apt was flooded 2 times for separate issues and (after some fighting with sr. Management) they moved me to another unit at the same rate. It was an upgrade and I truly believe that Lynne and Gabby had to fought on my behalf. 

BAD: I. Have. Never. Gotten. A. Package. I have to use an Amazon locker, I have to send things to friends houses. Almost everything that that was sent here was lost and you can’t order food.

This community is amazing!!! The staff is extremely attentive, they are very quick with responses and making sure my questions do not go unanswered. Maintenance is phenomenal as well, as willing to help.
My apartment is great amenities are great location near shopping malls and attractions.
Wonderful location near transportation shopping malls and attractions.
Good , clean, and quiet.  It’s is older but lots of space. I like it just renewed.

Moved in a few weeks ago and seems like Sandhurst doesn’t have enough staff to run the place properly. Simple maintenance requests take forever to be fixed and small cosmetic issues throughout the entire place. Other simple requests often have to be sent reminders and the maintenance staff will leave the place dirty after they leave your unit.

Susan, the on-site manager, seems to be the only one working and the maintenance is not on site everyday.

On the website it states amenities such as a microwave for all units, as it doesn’t have an asterisk for select units, but after talking with Susan apparently that is for only select units.

Dumpsters located far away from certain units and does not come with any trash cans. Renters beware!

My husband and I recently moved to Williamsburg Manor, the location being its main attraction. What we found, however, was a beautifully diverse and well managed neighborhood with kind neighbors, amazing office staff and great maintenance.  While the townhomes are older, the staff have done well to keep everything up to date. We love our home at Williamsburg Manor and would recommend it to anyone looking for their next home.

Just moved into my apartment yesterday. While the apartment is nice the appliance are old and worn down even in a renovated unit . Was told that they would not be replaced and we could use our own washer and dryer since we had one. Disappointed

Went 2 weeks without AC and have water damage to my belongings. Lack of professionalism and accountability regarding both issues. Property manager and regional manager useless as they do not have any regard for the tenants.

I wish that I could give this apartment complex a 0-star review. This is one of the worst property management groups I have had the misfortune of doing business with. When I first moved into my apartment, many fixtures were broken and the dryer and garbage disposal did not work. I lived here for two years, and the garbage disposal was still not working by the time I moved out! During my time as a resident, there were several occasions where my A/C unit went out in the summer, and my heat was not working in the winter. On one such occasion, I had to go 5 days without heat in the winter. The apartments and appliances are very dated, and not worth the money you pay in the area. Please save yourself some grief and do business with one of the other apartment complexes in the area for a comparable rate and a much nicer apartment, with better staff running the place. When I notified them that I would not be renewing my lease, they decided to charge me a premium in addition to my regular rate that forced me to pay a whole month’s rent for a total of 3 days my final month. They tried to justify this premium by informing me that I did not give them a 60-day notice; however, they gave me lease renewal options less than a week prior to when the 60-day notice would have been due, and I gave them my notice prior to the expiration of the lease renewal options. In other words, this apartment complex will give you less than a week to review lease renewal options, attempt to negotiate those options, and decide if you want to accept those options. And if you decide that you don’t want to renew with them, they will charge you a premium even if you notify them that you will not be renewing your lease with them prior to the renewal options expire. I cannot stress this enough, please do not do business with this apartment complex and go to one of the other ones in the area. You will be glad you did!

URGENT WARNING - NEW RESIDENTS BEWARE: This company charges you a $75 application fee PER PERSON. Background checks cost less than $25 per person so they are basically getting FREE money from you. Also, they charge you a $175 Administration Fee BEFORE your application is even accepted so be prepared to spend at least $325 after filling out application. If it gets denied, you will NOT get your $150 back for the applications if two people are on the application/lease.  I will keep you posted if they refund my Administration Fee since my application was denied. As of 5/25/23, no refund to my Admin Fee yet. Will update this post daily until I am refunded

Since this property was acquired by Avenue 5 there has been nothing but trouble. The company is greedy and money hungry and could not care less about the happiness of the tenants. In the past year they have forced residents to pay for Spectrum (many of us were with Google Fiber for much cheaper), they are forcing us to send all our packages through Fetch which causes delivery delays, confusion, and makes amazon prime delivery obsolete, they raised the rent at least 200 dollars, and the list goes on. You are completely unable to contact your property manager if you have any questions or issues. The office never answers the phone when you call and it takes days for anyone to respond to an e-mail. They will likely be very kind in getting you to move in but there is absolutely NO support or good will after that. Stay far away.

Like other residents have indicated, the change in Management has been disappointing.

Negatives:
Communication: It is almost impossible to get any issue (e.g. lease renewals, billing errors, problems with the mail lockers, etc.) resolved over email or phone call in one try. You have to make numerous attempts to get anything resolved and usually can only get resolution if you physically go into the office and remind them multiple times about your problem. Never seen such unprofessional customer service/communication from a management company. This is even more frustrating when your job is during office hours and its hard for you to physically go into the office to beg management to get basic things done.

Amenities/Pool: Last summer, the pool was closed and did not open until some point in July. Also, it would be nice if you guys fixed all of the BBQs and made them operational.

Pet Waste: You cant go on a walk around the facilities without seeing giant turds all over. On a weekly basis, there will be pet waste on the cement sidewalks on the way to the mail box areas. Its disgusting that you have to use a flash light at night so you wont step in pet waste.

Unlimited Recovery Towing: Another resident mentioned his guest’s vehicle was towed for some non-compliance with the parking rules. Quite common to see the tow truck drive around and tow people’s cars. You guys raised rent hundreds of dollars last year… do you guys really need to tow residents/guests cars for minor parking infractions?! Towing should be a last resort - inflation is already hurting peoples pockets.

Cable/Internet: once again, you guys raised rent by hundreds of dollars. I know you want to find any opportunity to stick residents with more fees. Is it really necessary to force residents into purchasing internet from your exclusive provider, spectrum?!

Positives:
Take a walk around in the afternoon and you will not be able to miss the smell of marijuana in the air. Premises are 420 friendly.

Great location. Super market is nearby.

I recently had the pleasure of exploring Aston Apartments and I can’t recommend it enough! The combination of a great location, beautiful apartments, and the top-notch amenities, along with the exceptional service from Nadeen, makes it a standout choice. If you’re in the market for a new place, definitely consider giving Aston Apartments a visit!

After a fresh start and a new chapter in my life, I made an excellent decision moving to Aston. The amenities are top quality and my apartment truly feels like home. I look forward to coming home every night just by the coziness of my living space. I had an excellent experience with Nadeen, whose kindness, customer service, and commitment to helping me find exactly what I wanted left an unforgettable impression on me. 10/10 would recommend living here.
Working with Cayla was absolutely amazing. She was very professional answered all my questions and returned my correspondence in a timely fashion. I look forward to working for Cayla in the future
I am a vendor and every time i go to the  office for assistance, Nadeen was always friendly and polite
Great customer service from Nadeem!  I leased here because of how she made Mel feel!  I am excited to move in soon!
I love living here, the staff are amazing and definitely recommend! Thank you Nadeen!
We thinking of relocating and must say Nadeen was awesome. She gave us a tour of the property and she awesome. Very professional, knowledgeable, kind and patient.  Thank you Nadeen!!
I had a great experience with Cayla, she was thoughful and thorough throughout the process; answering all questions I had.
I love this place. It’s very peaceful and convenient. I’ve been here for 2 years and Cayla has always been helpful and friendly!
I’m a vendor working across the street who has dropped off marketing flyers, the entire staff is always nice and friendly to work with, especially Nadeen!
Friendly staff Ashelyn, Cayla, Nadeen and property is well kept up.  Great location! Would recommend to anyone.

Kayla did my onboarding process and apartment tour, she was very professional and friendly throughout the process. Nadine and Ashley at the leasing office are also very kind and welcoming. Maintenance is always prompt and helpful. The community itself is always clean and feels safe. The units are also very affordable, considering all the amenities available to use. Highly recommend!
I have been living at Aston Apartments for over two years and the customer service from staff Nadeen, Cayla is outstanding.  Love the community and amenities!

I came in for a tour with my wife. Loved the whole customer experience which was lead by Nadeen Richard. My wife and I loved it so we moved in.  I must admit I love it here. Definitely renewing my rent when it’s due.

I just recently moved the beginning of February. My leasing agent Cayla Williams was above and beyond helpful. She carries a grace for what she does that allowed her to elaborately perform her duties to ensure that my transition was a success. Her thorough knowledge and skills was superb! I am loving my new place. Full of space and the neighborhood is nice.

I have lived here for 1 year with my husband and we just renewed for another year. These apartments are beautiful with large open kitchens with lots of storage which is really important to us. This is the first apartment I have lived in where I finally have a closet or shelf for everything I own. The layout and design of these units is perfect!
I have not had need to meet with apartment staff on a regular basis (which in my opinion means that everything is run very well),and the complex makes sure to regularly schedule treatments for insects and cleaning of air vents. This is a wonderful peaceful place to live. This is the 4th complex I have lived in within 2.5 years and it is by far the best.

I’ve been living at Townes at Bishops Park for the past 2+ years, and I couldn’t be happier with my decision! The location is unbeatable—nestled in a peaceful neighborhood yet close to all the best spots in Raleigh. Glenwood South, Five Points and Village District are just a short walk away, so I’m never far from great dining, shopping, and entertainment.

The townhome itself is spacious and well-maintained, with modern finishes and plenty of natural light. The community amenities are top-notch, especially the saltwater pool and the gas grill area with fire pits, which are perfect for relaxing or hosting friends.

As someone who enjoys outdoor activities, I also appreciate how close we are to Fred Fletcher Park and the bike trails nearby. It’s ideal for a quick walk or bike ride. The management team is always responsive and friendly, which makes a big difference when you’re living in a community.

All in all, Townes at Bishops Park has been an amazing place to call home, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a mix of convenience, comfort, and community.

I'm sorry to say that my experience at this apartment complex has been incredibly disappointing. Despite the management's best efforts to put down traps for the mouse infestation, it seems that the real issue is not being properly addressed. While the traps may work, the stench of dead mice in my kitchen is absolutely unbearable.

To make matters worse, the mouse infestation is rampant inside and outside the complex. We found seven mice just a few weeks ago, and today we found two more in our kitchen. We take cleanliness very seriously, especially since we have two dogs. We make sure not to leave any food out, and we prioritize vacuuming and mopping twice a day to keep our living space tidy. This is not only a major health hazard, but it's also completely unacceptable in a living space.

I cannot in good conscience recommend this apartment complex to anyone who values their health and well-being. The mouse infestation is not being handled properly, and it's only a matter of time before it worsens. Save yourself the headache and look for a safer and more hygienic living environment elsewhere.
Currently live here now, rats inhabit our back patio rendering it useless to us. Community has placed traps but we have seen no change.

They never answer calls or return emails.  I've even gone in and they are always closed early for no reason. Be warned if you have an issue or even just need to contact then for anything you will be ignored!

This is definitely my favorite apartment I've ever lived in! My apartment is giant and has two master suites, a sunroom, a covered porch, a fireplace, and four closets. The community and apartments are quiet and peaceful. The office staff is amazing and they go above and beyond. The maintenance guys are always on top of things and take care of any issues quickly. The location right next to Tryon Road, the highway, and Lake Johnson can't be beat. I can get to NC State in less than 10 minutes, I can get to downtown Raleigh in 10 minutes, I'm within 20 minutes of the airport, I'm close to the mall, multiple movie theaters, grocery stores, and one of the biggest shopping centers in the area. My only complaint would be that my apartment is not renovated, but I know that it would cost more if it was. I would definitely recommend this community!

I don’t know if the management office was bad or the people in the office were.
I reported leaks, bugs, rats and thieves. They didn’t replied to me for 1.5 months, then they let me wait for another month. When I asked the maintenance guys when they were chatting and laughing at the lawns, they said they were never assigned to fix my apartment. Some of my electric device broke because of bugs and rats. The office never toke responsibility and they changed the management (2023-2024). They forced us to move out then charge you extra money! So cruel.

An absolute horror show. Do not even give this place a chance. Since moving in it has been nothing but terrible. To start the floors are all warped and coming up, constantly dealing with cockroachs and other bugs crawling up through the floor boards, the bathroom sink is falling off the wall and so much more. The worst part is noone will answer my calls or emails. And when you try to call, it hangs up on you. Oh and my ac is not working but there is no where to put in for a work order and its 95! I wish I could post all my photos and videos of how disgusting and terrible this place truly is. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME!

When they say renovated apartments, they simply mean painted apartments. The management is very unprofessional and rude to the point they treat you like you not paying your rent. You better look somewhere else and yourself a lot of headaches.

- Ask the office to do a tour of the exact place before you pay the NON refundable application and deposit. 
- Maintenance is non existent. I replace my own filters and I pay for my own pest control services because I'm stuck on a year lease. 
- Lastly, realize that those are the pre 1970 homes with a touch up renovation. The $250 electrical is usual and hearing your neighbors shewing sound is casual. Yes the walls are that thin.

I applied and paid app fee and admin fee. Never heard a word back other then the company who ran the credit check. 
This property management never answered my 3 emails asking if the status of my application. 

They took my money and ran.

Been living here for two years and they’re terminating our lease with no reason given. We’re good tenants; rent is always on time. They’re doing this to many units so they can renovate them and have them ready to drastically up charge, my guess for college students in the fall.

Moved out a few months ago. This place went through 3 different management companies in 6 months. These apartments are completely falling apart. In the time I lived there I dealt with leaks, bugs, rats, and poor heating in the winter months. I felt like I was constantly waiting for the next thing to break down. Please be cautious and don’t be fooled by the pretty pictures you see - and don’t move in unless you’ve actually walked through the unit that you’ll be living in.

Beware of this company!  I have had the worst experience with them.  Maintenance would show up at the apartment without notice and refuse to fix appliances, ignoring my requests for up to weeks.  There was also an instance where their maintainance employee entered my apartment without knocking or saying a word.  I was terrified as I had no idea they were coming and no verbal warning was given (they hadn’t contacted me back in days).   When they realized I was in the home (which they could have already realized just looking by the packing spaces), they left and entered again a few minutes later.  I never received an apology or recognition of the incident, though it was communicated to them.  When I moved out, I was promised my deposit back/told it would be mailed.  When I contacted them about it, they refused to honor it.  This company is disrespectful, dishonest,  and will not handle anything in a timely manner.

I just moved to the area and wanted to be close to NC State. I love the location its close to walking trails also. The price point for the 2 bedroom was perfect and its just so quiet all my neighbors are friendly. The staff in the office were very friendly and such a huge help as i was looking for an apartment in Raleigh. 

I highly recommend Walnut Creek to anyone looking to live in South Raleigh.

Nice area dispite being near a busy road 
   Best biking trails downtown and it's woodsy enough so you don't feel like your in a sufficating city.

Don’t even think about moving here!!! it’s an old building with unprofessional management team, every time you call they told that they have to much work even in case of emergency. You gonna have problems with water leaking, heater, they replaced my refrigerator 3 time and still bring old one with maintenance problem. It was a snow weekend everybody waiting for a very cold weather, my heater was down I call the office they come check it and they can’t fix it until Monday because he don’t want to work overtime and he will take him 4 hours to fix it!! I spoke to the manager she said that somebody will Saturday morning to fix it, next day somebody show up check it for 10 min and he said it fix, as soon as he leave I lost the power at home I call the office nobody answer my call until evening time they told me nobody want to come to fix it because it snow even it’s an emergency and I don’t have power at home I try to call the manager nobody answer my call for 2 days of snow I don’t have heater or power!!!! Monday they said nobody told him I have an emergency and that was just mass communication between technicians!!!!!!

When I left they tricked me to rob my money. They told me they can waive the 60 days notice just give us a 31 days notice. I did that and at the end, they charged me for the 60 days. When I talked to the manager, she was cold and not friendly at all.
good location ,closed to my son s school and NCSU its the most features that it owns an optimum location
I love the peace and quiet of the community and where it’s located to stores and the mall as well as the diversity. I like the staff they are very friendly

Poor communication with staff. This place went from luxury apartments to ghetto projects. From break ins to your cars, to strangers with guns knocking on your door, to unkept pool, to broken computers and printers. Don’t even get me started on the filthy walkways and constant smell of weed. Such a shame because the apartments are beautiful but the property itself is unsafe and unkept.
My experience overall is goood. I hope that there is more maintenance around the property and the upkeep of amenities. The maintenance team is fast and reliable
Great place to reside. Quiet, great atmosphere, great amenities. However, I have noticed throughout my daily walk around the complex it’s a lot of dog poop on the property.
Tremayne was very helpful and informative. The entire staff came together to make sure my move in went well. The apartment is beautiful and I’m looking forward to decorating
Love everything about apartment specifically the kitchen which has double door freezer and a big bathroom. Also, Jamie , leasing consultant, she is really helpful.

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review: This apartment is great if you like living in the deep dark wilderness. The musty smell, the cave like sunlight, and bug sanctuary really give the apartment its charm! Not to mention you make tons of friends including strange men who look into windows at the wee hours of the morning. I certainly loved every single cabinet door falling off in our kitchen, it really opened up the space. I think the only down side of the apartment was the mountainous speed bumps and pot holes leading up to your oasis.

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review:
Apartments are run of the mill. But the management is bottom of the barrel. It'd be easier to fake my own death than to quickly and efficiently sign the roommate release form. Took 2 months thanks to these guys having some sort of "unresolved IT issue" and them taking their sweet time to fix it. Because of that, I lost several, SEVERAL, better apartment opportunities.

During that whole debacle, I'd email again and AGAIN and nothing would come of it until 3-4 days later, by which time the apartment I had in mind elsewhere had been sold. 

Also a bad idea to go to the office, because two people will come in at the same time and tell you different things right in front of you.

Only rent here if you want an extremely frustrating experience with your leasing office!

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review:
If you never need a work order completed, never have a question regarding your lease, never want your apartment sprayed for bugs, maybe it's not bad, but the moment you need something, management is absent. 

I have sent in work orders about mold, water damage, wildlife breaking into my outdoor storage, pest control, etc. and most of the time they get closed without being addressed at all, and I'm automatically emailed a survey to rate my lack of experience. If a work order is addressed, it's because I followed it up with a call or email. Even discussing the lease renewal (we're unfortunately not in a position where we can easily leave yet) it was so difficult to get my questions answered, and it seemed like the individual at the desk didn't understand their own lease and what it meant.

I also got a terrible rash from the pool the day before it was mysteriously closed due to "vandalism" and they had to "balance the chemicals". I was on antibiotics for 10 days.

Location is nice. Walking trail out back, lake is very close by. You're a short drive to campus and right off i40 but it feels secluded. Is it worth dealing with an ineffective, disinterested management? No.

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review:
I have been here for 2 months now and I thoroughly enjoy it! The office and maintenance staff are kind, and aim to be efficient!  

The property itself is an established community, so not Class A luxury, but I am 100% ok with that. It has its quirks as any older property does, but these things were not deal breakers for me (i.e- no overhead lights - ok buy more lamps, kinda thing!) What I think I loved the most is the bedrooms are on opposite ends of the apartment (mom here who sometimes just needs a moment to herself)

The management company is still fairly new so I understand there are growing pains, however I personally feel the staff certainly aims to please residents, not just prospects alone.

I highly recommend this place. Based on price point and location, you wont find anything better! 40 is directly on the front of the property, and if you come out the backside of the property, Crossroads is quite literally 7 mins away!

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review: I have lived here for 1.5 years now and it's great spot, nice and secluded but just minutes to anywhere you need to be. Like another review said, since changing Management it's been one small inconvenience after another. Which sucks because I really love my apartment. They are a little older but have been mostly updated so it's not really a huge issue. But my biggest problem is the staff, they are not friendly, they don't help you out. I haven't decided if I'll renew but it's definitely in the air because of that. And don't ever expect to get an email back about issues you've had once moved in. They had to do some construction in my unit when they changed Management and the crew that they hired left my place a mess, got paint or something like it all over my floors and other things. I messaged 2 different people, called, and went into the office and I never heard anything back. Also, the crew wasn't accompanied by a member of staff even though they said that the crew would be escorted with a staff member.

apartmentName: The Retreat at Lake Johnson Apartments
review: DO NOT SIGN LEASE! Mold in our apartment around the showerhead, its pretty obvious there's a leak since it it only around there and the drywall was falling off. We asked them to come fix it in December. They came and replaced the wall and said the mold is from steam and to keep the door open when showering... Obviously the mold returned. I went in on Sunday to place a work order. Waited 48 hours with no response. Called them today and they said there's no work order, you should do it online so there is no human error. They said sometimes the office workers forget to hit send. They also claim free rent credit for every day after 48 hours that there is no response. But they said it doesn't apply to us because there is no work order. This is ridiculous. Do not move here!

I helped my girlfriend move into a new apartment at L&C in July and she and I have both had the most unpleasant experience. The day of moving in, we noticed a large amount of broken or dirty places in the apartment. The door going to the deck had a broken doorknob that fell off when my girlfriend attempted to open it, there is a spray paint stain on one of the cabinets, handprints on the ceiling and scuffs all over the bedroom walls. The kitchen cabinetry was practically falling apart with pieces of cheaply and haphazardly applied wood hanging off and the inside of the cabinets were quite filthy. The washing machine reeks of mildew and has mold growing inside the liner. However, I would say the most disgusting experience overall was the hundreds of roaches my girlfriend and I discovered each night in the cracks of the cabinets and floors, which had large cracks between them. The bugs were crawling over the counters and even inside the dishwasher. My girlfriend wrote complaints repeatedly about bugs as well as about a crack in the door going out to the deck, which was so large that you could feel the air conditioning rush out of the room. Management took weeks, if not an entire month to properly address the bug and door situation, while my girlfriend had to endure unsanitary conditions. My girlfriend also informed management that the roaches seemed to be coming from behind the dishwasher and fridge, but this issue took an unreasonably long time to be addressed. After management finally sprayed, my girlfriend continued to complain about roaches, which were finally unveiled in nests when maintenance was sent up to remove the dishwasher and fridge. This revealed hundreds of bug droppings and roaches (dead and alive) behind the appliances. Maintenance did not even send a cleaner up, my girlfriend’s roommate used her own personal vacuum to clean. I am not sure what reputable place does not notice a massive roach infestation or care to properly clean before new tenants enter into a new unit, nor can I seem to grasp how nothing was done for so long about this absolute filth. All my girlfriend was offered was a measly discount and reimbursement once or twice and was allowed to exit her lease, which is pretty pointless because all other apartments in this area fill up very quickly and she was unable to find another apartment to live in.

This property and its management has been horrendous since day one. We picked a unit to move into 2 weeks before moving in they tell us that that one is not available and gave us another option which we had to take we had no choice at 2 weeks to move in. The front door looks like it's been shot up, the HVAC system is so loud you can't hear the TV. The building had a squirrel infestation it took them 9 months to fix. There are 2 pools neither of which ever open or don't open for long. Bugs are horrible, and we've had maintenance issues that never get corrected. Pay a bit more money and go somewhere decent.

The grounds are nice with a dog park and playground plus tennis court and 2 pools. The walking trail is great. I enjoy the screened in porch and wood burning fireplace. The property is older and established. Maintenance issues are quickly completed. We moved in at the beginning of the COVID19 Pandemic and were so happy with the way the move-in was handled and condition of the apartment.

This property is poorly managed and needs an entirely new staff.  The duration of our lease here (14 Months) has been nothing short of toxic hazards since our move-in last March. We have had issues with excessive trash, clogged sinks, non-working dishwasher, rodents, snakes, ceiling leaks, range fires, car break-ends, pothole tire damage, no amenities usage.
Upon our move-in, all the sinks were clogged, toilets are overfilled with water, and the dishwasher not working. Maintenance was not allowed to enter due to COVID, so we were stuck with these issues for months because we had more than one bathroom. We also noticed an abundance of wasps and checked the backside of our patio.  We then notice the rundown condition of the back of the building with exposed wiring, large wasp hives, and no upkeep of the backside of the building.  Due to the lack of maintenance, a variety of insects were able to access the property very easily.
The direction came from the governor that pools could start opening with restrictions in the latter part of the summer. After weeks of promises no amenities, we paid forever opened.
Please be aware of frivolous charges as well.  My debit card number on my account portal changed.  The system would not allow me to put in another debit card number, so I put it under credit.  I was charged well over $90.00 in fees, due to the system error. When I contacted the office, they were rude and showed no empathy.   I was also charged $14.50 a month after submitting proof of insurance twice.  I feel it was in retaliation for giving a 1-star rating earlier and submitting my letter to vacate.  The office will not send reminders about vacating.  Please do not fall into the trap of paying astronomical fees for submitting a letter to vacate in time.
I have paid my rent on time every month during a pandemic!  This complex did not hold up their end of the bargain even though I did everything in my power to ensure my part was taken care of.  Management is rude, unempathetic, and lacks management skills.

All our neighbor has been super nice and quiet.  The only issues are all management-related.  Also, your apartment will not be professionally cleaned and sanitized.  They leave it up to the tenants before to have the apartment "move-in ready". Even with COVID.  This accounts for 70% of our problem.  If the apartment would have been properly clean by professionals, then a lot of the hazards could have been solved.

I have moved into the apartment for two months, the area is good, the neighborhood is good, but the maintenance and the staff (especially the lady whose office is located the innermost room) is terrible.  If you want to experience 1.5-2.5 weeks waiting for every maintenance (Ex: food disposal, outlets, metal come from the carpet, damaged cabinet, a hole in the restroom which cause lots of spiders, etc) and some of them are still not get repaired, please come to  ARIUM Trailwood. I tried to explain this to the emergency service line, but all she could do was repeat the weather report and talk over me. I gave up and hung up. BE AWARE!!! Do not move to this place! Moved out June 25th was told had to kept the apartment to July 24th. Paid the pro rate of $1500 in July and turned in the key before the 24th. Just got a bill from them for $1000 for August. Definitely would not recommend moving here.

Nearly two years ago, my wife and I retired while living in New England and decided to relocate to Raleigh, NC, for the warmer climate and to be closer to family.  We decided to live in an apartment while we took our time searching for a house.  After looking at at least a dozen complexes and becoming frustrated and unimpressed, we stumbled upon Bexley at Brier Creek.  We were sold!  We have lived here for nearly two years and love it!  The buildings and grounds are maintained meticulously, the neighbors are friendly, the amenities are perfect and it truly feels like a community.  We’re on our second lease and will renew again for a third.  We put the house on hold because the rates here are reasonable and there are none of the expenses and bother that come along with home ownership.  Most importantly, the management and staff are wonderful and sincerely care about your living experience.  Jennifer, the community manager and Anthony, the Maintenance manager are wonderful people.  They are friendly and approachable and extremely responsive to any issues you may have.  The office staff and maintenance teams are great.  All of the common areas are maintained really well and the pool is especially cared for.  The property is well lite at night and the sidewalks make it perfect for an evening stroll through the neighborhood.  Bexley is also close to shopping with the Brier Creek Complex in walking distance.  It all makes for a great living experience.  If you are looking for an apartment, be sure to add Bexley at Brier Creek to your list.  Once you explore other communities and options, we believe you will be very happy here.

I'll start with the positives. The floor plans in Bexley are thoughtful and the best I found in the area. I  especially love our fenced in backyard. They are the only property I found with that option. The employees that work at the office and on the maintenance team are friendly and professional. The location is excellent.

However, I wouldn't choose to live here again.

The windows are not insulated at all. In the winter the windowsills collect significant puddles of water and mildew grows daily. You are expected to be ok with this and you are responsible for cleaning the water and mold from the windows daily. Maintenance will come to your apartment and paint over the mold. This appears to be the practice for many years as the windows look terrible. The mold comes back about 2 weeks after they paint over it. Any room with a window will be exceptionally cold in the winter and heat up quickly in the summer. The apartments are not energy efficient and you will have to pay for it in your electric bill.

Some apartment noise is expected but the walls here are so thin I can hear my neighbor snoring through the walls at night, the other neighbors kids crying during the day and my upstairs neighbors when they do laundry, take a shower, walk, etc.

When we moved in, there was a huge roach problem. I found one in my bed. Every morning I would wake up and kill 3-4 roaches. There was a waitlist to get our unit sprayed. I put out my own traps. When I removed the traps, roaches came back. There is a lot of rotting wood outside the windows which I suspect is an entry point.

Parking is not assigned. Nor are there designated resident and visitor spaces. I often have to park on the next street over. 

There are several other details that have been overlooked for a "luxury" property. In the guest bathroom, the toilet tank lid was the wrong size and it shifted every time my kids used it. 
The closet door falls of the track every other time we open it. It almost fell on my son once. The door to the laundry room has a warped rail. It sticks and has to be forced closed. It too falls off. The stove had a burner that was sparking. Turns out the burner had been replaced with one from a totally different brand stove. The counters in the kitchen are made of particle board with a plastic coating. The underside overhang isn't finished and the particle board flakes and splinters. 

Maintenance is responsive but I wouldn't pay  to live here again.

PROS:
I lived here for just over a year to transition from PA to NC and I must say it was an awesome experience, everyone is super friendly (and Dog Friendly), some of the long-term renters are very genuine and I was quite impressed with how flexible they've been with moving out, they even let me move out a week early and pro-rated my rent.  Maintenance is super respectful, prompt and they do a good job, interiors are dated but everything functions. I had their best unit, 3BR+Garage and It's a fantastic layout, huge closets, lots of storage in the garage and everything you'd ever need is across the street.

CONS:
Utilities are not very efficient, my electric bill was much higher than I had anticipated ($120-180) likely due to poor insulation and low SEER appliances.

Other than this, the community is really good, been living here for over 2.5 years now, a beautiful place to live in with young children and dogs(except some irresponsible dog owners who don't pick up after their dogs). And the after hours property attendant and a fellow dog parent, Ms. Stacey attended to us promptly assuring us we don't have to feel left alone dealing with the nuisance.

I complained several weeks ago about wasps and bee nests outside the exterior. Nothing has been done at all. And I had to speak with maintenance personally to remove a nest outside by balcony.

Nice community and staff. Rates are a little high but everything is included. And the wifi is fast.

I cannot speak for others but I am glad she chose to live there for her under grad.

DO NOT LIVE HERE!!! If i could give zero stars I would. I can not stress the amount of anxiety, stress, and frustration living at the community has brought me. The apartment was dirty when I moved in, I spent hours cleaning the tub. I lived on the third floor and my roommates and I are very neat, they still have roaches and other bugs. Pool is never cleaned. The staff, specifically Shelby is inconsiderate and rude. Also, they will not let you out of your lease even in extreme circumstances. I graduated from NC State in December 2023, and intended to stay my entire lease term which was until may 2024. My only sibling passed away just weeks after me graduating. Not only that, but she had given birth to my niece two months prior, who spent a month in the NICU due to health complications. When my sister passed, my niece was on oxygen and required 24/7 in home care. This situation called for me to move back home immediately to help my parents through this loss and help care for my sick niece. Additionally, I had to help pay for funeral and medical cost for my niece, which left me with no extra funds to pay for rent at a place I was no longer going to be residing in. I explained this entire situation to the staff and was willing to provide all documentation to the assistant manger Shelby. I even stated that I was ok with paying a fee for breaking the lease! They stated that the only way I could be let out of the lease is by subleasing. Not only that, but once I asked if they could help with the subleasing process by putting the room back on the market or any other way they said no. I would be fully responsible for finding someone and pointing them in their direction. I had to post ads on Facebook, but still had no luck finding anyone who was serious about renting the apartment. I was so stressed and desperate to find someone to take over my lease all while trying to grieve, take care of my nice, and manage my finances. It took a SERIOUS toll on me mentally. They said they would send my account to collections and let me know when they did as they had to find a new collections agency to work with. They never reached out to let me know when they sent it. A year later, and I just now have a collections reported from them that destroyed my credit all for a situation that was unimaginable and out of my control. I even called corporate office to express my concerns and was rerouted back to the home management office. SAVE YOURSELF THE TROUBLE.

Reasons I'd recommend:
- easily one of the most affordable places to live in Raleigh

-convenient access to interstate, highway, and downtown areas

-I was able to avoid major move in fees, making it more affordable to actually move in

-roommate matching- you can lease an individual room and they will match you to others within the complex

-pretty quiet for a college aged complex

Reasons I wouldn't recommend:
-the parking spaces are barely wide enough to fit your actual car.  Your car WILL get hit/scratched. We've had reports of break ins as well, but I haven't experienced that personally. 

-The apartment management is a joke. Our downstairs neighbors caught our apartment on fire two months ago and they haven't even began repairs, or told us when we can expect them to begin. If you are on your own, looking for your student, or you are from out of state, I really would look elsewhere. 

-the amenities are sporadically available and not well maintained


Just depends on your needs- if you're a young adult needing an affordable place to stay with walkable groceries/but routes, then this would be fine for you. If you are a parent looking for your student- especially if you're out of state- i would not recommend this complex.

Honestly have mixed feelings about this place. There are many pros and cons. I've lived in other apartments in other towns and this was by far the worst.  If you don't mind living away from campus and downtown, this place would be good. It is very basic so if you have high expectations, this is not your place. I suggest paying more and finding something better, but if this is in your range its not terrible, its just okay. 

Pros:

Maintenance is always pretty good at fixing things and really nice. The gym and club house are nice as well with a great study room. Its not really close to campus or downtown but is on Tryon near some things. Also has a shuttle to campus. 

Cons:

However, My roommate was told that we could move in early because my classes started earlier than NC States. However, once we signed the lease, we were not allowed to move in early until NC State moved the date of its classes up because covid. Even then I had to stay in a hotel because the move in date was not early enough like they had said.  Probably our fault for not getting names.

Next, the condition of the apartment was not great. We did not get an updated unit but still. Our cabinet was broken when we moved in and the bottom of the other cabinet was rotting. More annoying than anything but I'm noting it for people who would be bothered by it. Very cheap paint job as well as appliances.  
 
The biggest thing that made me mad was Campus Crossing cutting cable. The lease I signed specifically said they would provide cable. The cable was cut off in March without notice to me. When I went to the office and asked they said they sent out a survey and only 5% of ppl used it. The survey numbers were so low because no one was sent the survey (including me). Paying for cable would make this place just as expensive as a nicer place fwiw.  

WiFi was not great. They said they were upgrading but my connection was not good at all. Pool took forever to open

Don't live here.

Not only would they not let me view my apartment i was supposed to be renting their tour was all different than the actual rental. Plus BUGS BUGS BUGS there is a bug INFESTATION here they are EVREYWHERE and they refuse to do anything about it don't move here

Maybe if the rent was about 100 dollars less I wouldn’t be as angry. Bottom line is don’t move here.

Seriously.  Don't make the mistake we did. Well, "renovated" means painted with some new light fixtures put in.  It apparently didn't mean testing the electrical wiring or any of the appliances to ensure there were no issues there.
