They promise someone will fix your issue tomorrow and then no one shows up.  They say they are discussing a rent concession to compensate for the issues and then never speak of it again.  They are full of sympathy and concern when you are sitting in front of them but there is literally zero follow-up.  We HATE this place.  Take your money elsewhere.

Me and a couple of other residents have experienced some random person in the area breaking into cars luckily for me I had my wallet and my car alarm was on to wake me up the But who ever the person was broke my window Motor and adding on to more expensive for a place that supposedly has security patrol in the area

They say I have 5 days to put the energy under my name and just was 2 day , they laying about that I don’t know why. 
Never going to refer someone to live in this place,  ??
And now we had to stay without lights .

The neighborhood has started going downhill. I’ve been here over two years. It was once very quiet and felt safe. Now you hear gunshots all the time and someone was actually shot down the street (which was roped off blocking the entrance to my apartment.) The apartment are a nice size, maintenance is quick to come out, but if you have asked for more than one thing to be fixed..... only one thing on the list is usually done. There was also a time where maintenance key were left in my door all day. I never told the management, because I didn’t want someone to lose their job. The fixtures over the outlets break very easily, and have fallen off around my apartment. I asked for them to be replaced, but when they weren’t I just let it go and didn’t ask again. Bugs aren’t usually too big of a problem, unless it’s close to the time for pest control to come back out. Walls are very thin... my current neighbors I can hear at all hours of the night and they smoke in the house. That smell gets into my apartment and guest often mention that my house smells like smoke. Joseph and Griselda have been amazing the whole time I’ve lived here and they have always helped me when problems have arise. (Management for the apartments).  From time to time there are nice community events and prizes to be won, but overall I’m happy to be leaving.
Very friendly and peace  place to live great management an staff glad I found this amazing community.

I've lived here for 2 years and I like the location. My apartment has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and a laundry room. I'm retiring in February 2016 and the rent is probably going to be my biggest bill. I haven't had any problems with the apartment. Hope I win.

This neighborhood is great, they community center has events throughout the year for the residents in the community and locals and the area. I thinks that it's a great place to live. But they are bad when it comes to maintenance. If they free like your issue isn't important, you get pushed to the waiting list. I've been waiting about 4-5 months just to get my bathroom and bedroom checked out for rodents.

If you live at College Inn, I would encourage you to review your monthly bill carefully.  My daughter's bill was incorrect more than once during the two years she lived at College Inn and I am not sure if it was due to pure incompetency or just outright slyness.  

In order to get an invoice corrected, you have to deal with rude staff members.  

Most recently, my daughter subleased her apartment.  She was charged several hundred dollars to transfer the lease, in addition to the new leasee paying over $350 in fees as well - including an "application fee."  In addition, my daughter paid the May rent, but her subleaser was invoiced for May's rent as well.  Actually, the subleaser's invoice included incorrect charges totally $1500!  

Although my daughter's parking pass is paid thru the month of May, she was assessed a charge for not turning it in at move out.  The staff told me the parking pass charge would be dropped when she turned in the pass - shouldn't a charge not be assessed until her paid time is up?

The apartments are smelly.

Extremely dirty grounds. There are stains and grime and dirt in every part of the buildings outside of the apartment, the stairways are especially filthy. There are only two maintenance workers who try their best to fulfill dozens of work orders. My apartment has been falling apart since I moved in and I have had to submit over 7 work orders. The carpets and couches provided are extremely dirty and unkempt. Constant noise and construction at every hour of the day. Wifi often cuts off for hours a day, amenities are falling apart and aren't even worth the price, and the pool is often dirty. DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!

DO NOT LIVE HERE. The office is run by college students who have no authority to do anything. If you do happen to catch the manager in the office, she will tell you what you want to hear and promise to get back to you...she won’t. There is a reason that they do not list a name or contact info on their website. The place is an unorganized mess with no one in charge. The apartments and the grounds are filthy. Do not be fooled by the pleasant tour of the model apartment. The place is an overpriced joke.

The apartments even smell old.. air vents are NEVER cleaned, light shining through exit doors(lots of bugs in the summer), gutters NEVER cleaned, holes under sinks and filled with foam/duct tape, filth behind appliances, outdated finishings, poor lighting, creeky floors, rude office staff, poor maintenance, filthy laundry rooms, and the list goes on.

The apartments are well managed and have excellent facilities. 3 pools, 3 laundry mats, and 1 small gym. Only 2 complaints: 1) I wish the laundry rooms had more washers and dryers. 4 washers and 4 dryers aren't enough for entire section of apartments. 2) the exterior of some buildings have unsightly pipes going up the building. Overall great apartments. No deal breakers.

So many people get fooled by the prettiness of a new apartment. If you are only going to stay a year, that might be okay. If you really want a place to live, find an older property like Montecito that makes investments. The new properties tend to spend as little as possible on good quality appliances and you have nothing but problems. Montecito wants things to last and is always quick to repair and replace items as needed. They have made major renovations in the apartments both inside and outside. I have been here a long time and get more for my money than any other property in the area. There are many different floor plans. I have a big dining room and living room but smaller bathrooms and kitchen. There are options to suit everyone. It is very close to lots of shopping and Downtown as well as right next to North Hills so there is plenty to do in the area.
We went for rental in this particular place because they post it on a rental app. The girl in the office was very mean to us. I guess she was having a bad day, but ??

Roaches and Water/Palmetto bugs. I’ve been living here for FIVE MONTHS. Not worth the cheaper rent when you’re constantly looking over your shoulder.

Maintenance even warned me after signing the lease to expect leaks and small clogs due to the plumbing system being old and outdated. That’s exactly what has happened.

Management communication is poor.

The steps outside are supposed to have “diamond grip,” but are extremely slippery and dangerous when it rains. Both me and my two year old toddlers have slipped and we live on the second floor.

Management has a serious issue with taking accountability and always has an excuse for why something is the way it is but rarely any solutions.

Just find somewhere else to live.
Great customer service, The lady's in the office are so helpful and wonderful. Its a great place to live. everything is close by the school for my kids and the area is very quite. I love it.

The apartments are dated(built in the 60s), office staff is rude, they never really fix things just do "patchwork" jobs. I had an issue with my floor the entire year I lived there, each time I went to the office to pay my rent I would bring it to their attention... they NEVER fixed it!! The staircase leading to the second floor is rusty & rotting, they have yet to fix it! These are the worst apartments I've ever lived in!!!

The place is rotting and falling apart. It also has a lot of problems with cockroaches and other insects. The business also messes with your credit without warning. Avoid these guys and rent somewhere else.
Office is not open as posted, unlicensed vehicles all around amenities always broken or closed smells like pot

Been living here for four years and it’s been pretty solid. Recently new management has come in and they have been utterly incompetent in regards to repairs. They decided to do pool maintenance two weeks before memorial day. Poole didn’t open until well into the season. 

Recently, they had the bright idea to close the gym right before new years. Initially they planned to open before February 1st. They were very uncommunicative during this time. Consistently they send out email saying it would be open on X day, the gym would still be closed on that day without any follow-up.

I emailed management multiple times, called them several times as well, requesting for some form of compensation. Management never responded to any of my emails, nor return any of my left voicemails.

If amenities or something you care about do not choose this as a place to stay. I’m sure management will be communicative when you start looking at signing a lease, however, once you sign the leave you in the dark.

Please do not live here. I moved in for grad school in 2018 because the rent was affordable but ever year since not only have they increased our rent substantially, but the new management is flat out terrible. They will not take care of emergency maintenance requests in a timely manner and will blow off residents who bring up concerns. Our upstairs neighbors water heater burst and it has been three weeks since that and the only action that has been taken by them was to repaint one of the three ceilings had significant damage. Even to get them to do that required DAILY phone calls, emails, and follow ups. They will tell you a date when someone is supposed to come but then no one will show up. They seem irritated to have to be dealing with residents, but they’ll pay us to try and lure other chumps into living here. They double charge for trash and pest control above what is mentioned in the legal agreement (lease) that we sign and cannot give an explanation as to why beyond it is a  required fee. I have more reasons to not live here but at the risk of turning into a manifesto I will digress. 0/10 recommend.
Don't rent here!! There is not customer service or maintenance worth anything.
Great location and close by to everything, quiet community as well.

This was the worst experience of our lives. We moved within a month of being there. Disgusting mold. Ceiling and walls so thin you can hear ever step, work, tv, literally anything and everything. I had a full conversation with my upstairs neighbor at a normal volume. The management was horrendous.

Made an appointment and she didn’t even show up, leasing office was unlock with nobody in there. How you trying to rent units out and you not answering the phone or showing up to appointments that were made. We just wanted to tour the place and see if we could get in. They playing around

Let me start by saying I did everything virtually due to covid, so i had never seen my apartment in person. But, in September, they sent me a video walkthrough of “my unit” and sold me on a different one. Apartment catfishing is REAL!! When I first moved in, I had thousands of bugs. Roaches, recluses, centipedes, daddy long legs and more. It took forever to get someone to come spray so i did it myself but it still didn’t do much. Mold is a big problem. The residents here are so extremely disrespectful. Blaring music at ALL hours of the day and night, leaving broken alcohol bottles and trash everywhere. The parking lot is the worst. The walls are so thin you can literally hear everyone’s conversations. Take it from me who didn’t listen to the bad reviews, pay the extra $100 to move in somewhere nicer!!!! If you absolutely have to, you can learn to live here but i’m only doing that until my lease is over. The new management, i will say, is better. There just isn’t much they can do about this property and it’s horrible residents.

With the new management, I feel that the community is improving. She's (I think her name is India) very nice, friendly, accommodating, and cares about my well-being living out here. 

I like my apartment, it's very comfy and feels like home. I look forward to the new renovations and floor plans they will be offering soon.

The management of this property is terrible. They give you wrong information or tell you something one day then change it the next day. The communication is horrible.  They are currently renovating so be prepared to deal with the workers all in the parking lot and blocking the entrance/exit. They work on weekends, so all you hear is them yelling and using tools and banging on the walls. The apartments that have not been renovated are infested with roaches, which travel into the other apartments.  The air/heat  units do not help keep you warm or cool, so you will probably have to buy fans or heaters to put around. This is one of the worst places I have lived with the worst management!

apartmentName: Loch Raven Pointe Apartments and Townhomes
review: I love this place!!! I’ve been living here going on 4 years. No complaints at all! The amenities are a bonus, everything is always clean. My family & friends are always impressed by the size & layout of my apartment &  how well maintained the outside grounds are kept. The property managers Alexis and Heather are amazing!! They go above and beyond with everything they do, which makes it so wonderful. The maintenance crew are friendly and professional! I recommend Loch Raven Townhomes & Apartments to everyone!

apartmentName: Loch Raven Pointe Apartments and Townhomes
review: I can't say enough good things about this place! The property manager Heather really knows what she's doing, and does everything she can to make your living experience good. I've lived here for a few months now and absolutely love it. The residents are really nice, it's a quiet community and I feel safe walking my dog at night. All of the amenities are always clean too, which is a huge plus!

apartmentName: Loch Raven Pointe Apartments and Townhomes
review: The unit I stayed in was nice; it was a new unit.  There were some sloppiness in paint on the floors and wooden edges, but nothing terrible.  My water drain blocked up twice during and soaked my carpet.  HVAC unit stopped working for a few days at one point.  Maintenance is very friendly, and arrived to help almost immediately.  My unit was broken into while I was on vacation.  More than one occurrence of vehicle break-ins or attempted vehicle break-ins.  Recommend keeping your unit and vehicle doors locked at all times.  Pool and gym are nicely maintained; great access to Greenway trail along Neuse River.  Generally a quiet community, and you can get to know your neighbors since it is also a small community.  Trash pick-up service is a nice plus.
I called several times to give them my email address. they said that they would send me an email to apply but they never did... too bad

"Our friendly, award-winning staff is here to help you. We offer 24 hour emergency maintenance. Your stay is worry free. Stop in any time to say hi!" , that is what they have said on their website!!
HA!! What award did their staff get? Award for "the MOST careless  persons in the world"???? The office staff are the worst people I've ever  seen, they do not care about people's time and life!!! It was a horrible experience!
The location is excellent! Easy access to downtown, Hillsborough st, and NC State.

I lived in the oaks apartments for over three years. I had some serious maintenance issues, that were never fixed. I had a hole in the wall, that the maintenance man did while he was in the crawl space. I had a hole in the floor where you walk into the closet, that was never fixed properly. And a toilet that would run over everytime you flushed it.None of these.work orders were done while I lived there.They asked me to leave.

Please be aware of what you are moving into.  Elevators break constantly as well as the garage doors.  They have recently put in new systems at the door and that has been broken for weeks.  My mother is a resident there and is moving out because of a roach issue.  After knowing about the issues for 2 months they have had a professional come in only once.  Multiple treatments are needed but they are not doing that.  Their solution is placing sticky traps around the apartment.  We have had to purchase our own spray and have sprayed for weeks with nothing.  There are a few thousand dollars of belongings that we can't take to a new apartment because of the lack of response.
My car has been broken into three times while in the parking garage.  Packages have been stolen.  Bonadventure is the worst management company.
Do not move here, car has been broken into 3 times this month and i pay for 2 cars to be in that awful garage for nothing. management does nothing about any issue you have.

As someone who has lived here for almost 2, and have seen the change of hands in management I would highly recommend looking elsewhere. I am speaking as a concerned resident who wants change.

Since 2023 multiple cars have been literally broken into while parked in the parking garage we pay for monthly. Personal property stolen. People running down the halls and kicking/banging on doors. Elevator broken for over 6 months. 2am fire alarm going off with no explanation the following days/weeks to come. Overall, no relevant/consistent communication on these serious, relevant, safety issues from our property managers. No actions have been taken to stop/prevent these incidents.

We call the nonemergency number for the police (per the advice of management) and unsurprisingly they’re very familiar with Vida East.

Please consider/prioritize your own personal safety before committing to a place like this.

Everything seems nice at first, but if you have a problem with your unit, maintenance will gaslight you and try to make you believe there is no problem. Managers on site are nice, but corporate will not answer your calls or call you back if you leave messages. It cost $100 extra a month for garage parking, yet the garage door has been broken for months. The garage door remains open, unable to shut, allowing anyone to walk in and have access to your car. It even got stuck with the garage door down once preventing tenants from being able to leave. They took away the cable that was included in the rent but did not decrease the rent. Seems like they like to take tenants' money and do the absolute bare minimum for the tenants.

This is a brand new apartment complex in a great location - walking distance to Shockoe Bottom and there are still apartments that have yet to be lived in! As people who have looked at dozens of apartment complexes in the past 2 years (military moves, am I right?), let me just say that our experience at Vida East was beyond our wildest expectations from start to finish. After a frankly disappointing apartment hunt up until that point, we walked into the lobby of Vida East after seeing their leasing sign on the building. We didn't have extremely high hopes after our earlier experiences around Richmond, but as soon as we walked in it was like a weight off of our shoulders. 

Magda really sold the place for us! She immediately greeted us with kindness and enthusiasm. She told us all about the area and the property amenities and gave us a ton of info about the available apartments. We walked them, toured the rest of the complex, and decided right then that this would be our new home. When we sat down to fill out our applications, Magda could tell we were deliberating over the apartment we wanted, and she went above and beyond - she offered to take us to see each apartment a second time, even showing us the exact unit we would be renting (which was an awesome surprise), AND when we mentioned we would be downsizing from a house to an apartment she let us see her own apartment so we could get some ideas of what to do with the space!! By far, Magda stole the show and we are so looking forward to working with her. 

After some technical difficulties filling out the online application, we got to meet Laura, who did such a great job at putting our minds at ease and welcoming us to the  community. All of her communications were prompt and delivered as promised, which was super helpful since we were on a time crunch! We also got to speak with Anna several times with questions about the lease or apartment in general. In fact, we forgot to get a floorplan of our apartment, but we reached out to Anna who offered to send us a video of the unit! She had that emailed to us later that afternoon. 

We genuinely cannot wait to be a part of this residential community. They also offer flexible lease terms! Most utilities are included or payable with your rent, so you don't have to worry about a ton of different bills, and they do offer the option of paid, private parking in a gated underground garage (pay for a space in a shared but secure underground garage).

Those ladies in that office will lie & give misinformation that you’ll have to pay for later. Will tell you one thing in person one day but another thing the next. GET EVERYTHING FROM THEM IN WRITING OR THEY WILL MAKE YOU PAY, literally.

Literally everything from the time I moved in has been awful. So glad to have gotten out!
Promised hardwood floors because we have a dog and didnt want to pay for carpet damage, well we moved in and had carpet everywhere. When we asked if we could get a different house they told us to deal with it. A few maintenance issues still havent been addressed since I placed the issue months ago. The people in the office are rude and blame everything on eachother and never take responsibility for their actions. 100% dont waste your time

Moved in Jan. 2017 into a one bedroom on the first floor. Rent was around $750 and seemed fair how small and dated the apartment was. Had many problems with the central air unit during both winter and summer months and the turn around time to fix the problems took around a couple days. The apartment above us leaked water multiple times onto our ceiling in the bathroom, kitchen, hallway, and dining area. The floor above us was horrible! The floor creeked so loudly and we heard every step the people above us made. What made it worst was they had big pets on top of being up all times of the night. The walls were thin and could hear people conversation on both sides of us. The parking lot was a joke. Lines were faded so residents parked inconsiderate to one another. Visitors never used the visitors parking space across the street which made the people who lived there park on a different street all together. The lack of residential awareness was sad. Saw at less 2 different families living in a one bedroom apartment (know the rental office didn't allow that) for about 2 months. Since it was pet friendly, it was dog poop everywhere. We never had a pet but somehow, we got fleas in our apartment and had to get them to call someone the treat our apartment. The cost of living goes up every year but towards the end, what they was asking for in rent wasnt reasonable with the quality of life we was having. The office staff were all awesome and the maintenance crew too, however, paying so much in rent to still have to deal with the dated essentials of living wasn't cutting it.

I moved here because of the awesome rent specials they had - $300 off second month and first month free of charge, who could beat that price?! The apartments are extremely old so every step you take makes a heck of a lot of noise, so if you live on the first floor then you have to deal with hearing constant walking in the apartment upstairs, it creaks badly! The front door was crooked to the point that I had to slam my door to be able to close it correctly so that I could lock it, if not then it would stay open. There were roaches in my kitchen when I moved in and even though I told the office staff to please send pest control, they sent someone who "checked" my apartment (for about only 5 minutes) and they decided that my apartment didn't need to be fumigated because they didn't see any roaches in those 5 minutes they were there. I had to take care of the pest problem myself. When I first moved in, the area seemed nice and quiet. However, after a few months I was receiving letters from the office (3 in total) about cars being broken into. I thought that it wasn't going to happen to me since I never leave anything in my car, well I was wrong! My car was vandalized with a BB Gun!! I had to replace my windshield and the passenger side window because it was completely shattered. They also shot at my tires and dented my car a few times. They chose my car even though it was parked between other cars and parked right in front of my apartment. I am a female leaving alone and I did not feel safe being zeroed in like that. I didn't even last 8 full months there. I had to pay (a lot of money!) to terminate my lease and leave. Just save yourself the trouble and look somewhere else.

For the location the price can't be beat. The apartments are old and creaky but it's nothing you can't get used to and certainly doesn't reflect on the management. I have only had positive interactions with management. Efficient and usually pretty quick to get back to me. Maintenance has not been an issue either. There have been a couple of times where they have had to come back a couple of times to fix an issue but really not a big deal. The only complaint I have is that some of the community members are not courteous when it comes to picking up their dog's poop and some of the members will throw eaten chicken wing bones on the ground (which is a danger to my dog), but again that is not a reflection on the property itself or the management. Overall I would recommend moving here if you work out in the west end and are looking for an affordable and decent complex. It is also very safe! In my particular area all of my neighbors are very nice and we all kind of look out for each other and make sure there's nothing going on (which in the 4 months I've been living there there hasn't been anything "going on"). There are some mild lighting issues with some of the security lights meant to light up behind and beside the buildings, but the street lights are almost always in working order. In my particular area there aren't a whole lot of kids but there are kids in surrounding areas. It's a pretty family friendly and diverse population.

When I first moved in they failed to tell me that the key wouldn’t be available at a particular time so I had ppl and moving trucks waiting until the key was ready. Then I found out the stove wasn’t plugged into the outlet and it took about a week for maintenance to come plug it in (the stove had to be moved otherwise I would’ve done it myself). My lease was coming to an end and they called me a few times about renewal. I spoken with a girl and told her I wasn’t interested in renewing she told me ok and that was that. Months later I get a renewal letter with rent that increased over $200 than the previous lease and I can’t get out of it bc the staff failed to let me know a written statement was required. And don’t bother confronting anyone about their mistakes they’ll put the blame on any and everything else. The word “they” shouldn’t be used in customer service. When you’re hired to work for a company it becomes “we”. They have no accountability. Also walls are thin af. I hear my neighbor snoring every single night. Maintence takes forever and a day and they will lose your key so you inconveniently have to be home if they are “fixing” something. They fix things with paint btw. The bathroom tiles are horrid but nothing a fresh coat of paint can’t fix. (Sarcasm). I can say the deposit is low!

I fist moved into this community about 6 years ago, I was in the hunters ridge apartments and then moved to a townhouse in foxchase. Whenever I have a maintenance issue it is promptly resolved and the grounds are kept very well. The pool is pristine and well maintained. Dzenita one of the staff members is always polite and often asks about my daughter. Kudos to G.S.C for maintaining such a fine community and proffesional staff.

After reading through some of the comments, I chuckled to myself. Yes, you can hear the neighbor on occasions, but its not a constant as one reader stated. Yes, the kids do run around the property but they're kids and truly veryone encroach on everyone's backyard area. However, people forget that this isn't abnormal...we live in a apartment complex. I too had to find an apartment quickly as I took a job in the Richmond area. This was again a new experience as I haven't lived in an apartment for over 24yrs. Sold my house and lived here for almost 2yrs. The location is fantastic and Foxchase is a great place. 

However, whatever needs or concerns I addressed to the staff, they were prompt to react and find resolution. Whether it be a severe issue such as replacing my HVAC in my apartment or simple courtesy of assigning parking passes. Jennifer and Dzenita have never waivered in thier professional demeanor. I applaud their Phenomenal customer service as I know daily interactions with different personalities can be stressful. To the new staff member Lesley, you have the best mentors and I know you'll be just as good.

Rude office staff and horrible maintenance. Apartments need a total remodel and bug infestation is a huge problem. Don't fall for their sales pitch because it is  great location. They have no idea of customer service and only want full occupancy. They suck you in with low low price and after one year they raise your rent. Horrible complex
Great place to stay. Great management and staff. The location is near to Short pump and Interstate.
Its a cool and friendly place.Quiet and serene. Great Staff and maintantence.

Don't live here. Period. I live in a one bedroom townhouse. There is someone above me and one person on each side of me. I can hear the people perfectly up and diagonal from me. I thought I wouldn't have to deal with kids since I am living in a row of units that are one bedroom... NOPE. Screaming toddlers! They also do not plow the parking lots nor the sidewalks. When I moved in, the were two giant rips in the carpet, no hot water, the dryer didn't work, & the dishwasher didn't work. The fitness center is a joke. Four machines and one of them is broke. And good luck getting a key for the fitness center. Took me three weeks and two different keys!! My apartment is newly renovated...ish. The water has two settings freezing cold or surface of the sun hot. The HVAC is the same way. Oh, and good luck cooking in the kitchen with your gas range and HVAC unit on the same time; It is insanely hot. Well, I have to go put in a ticket for the toilet that stopped working at 1AM and for the front door where you can see daylight coming through the top!

Nestled in an amazing spot that is close to the mall as well as sheltered enough to offer a little privacy, Foxchase is a nice blend. With apartments dating back to the 70s that are renovated and new appliances to go in each I'm satisfied so far with where I'm living. The community is nice and friendly, and on a whole welcoming. The few qualms I have are more aesthetic than anything. The floors aren't exactly spotless due to paint stains and wear and tear, and the buildings themselves are a bit drafty due to their age. Also, the walls are pretty thin so keeping noise down later at night is an absolute must.  I've been here for about four months now and I enjoy it a lot, and so does my dog!

My family and I moved here ONLY because we needed to find some where to live quickly. I was disappointed upon entering the apartment before we moved in: old, outdated kitchen and bathrooms, SQUEAKY floors, paper thin walls, dirty tiles and old, drafty windows! Before bringing our furniture in we fogged and sprayed for bugs and returned to find LOTS of bugs including roaches and spiders scattered across the apartment. Our neighbors are disgusting and noisy along with all of the children in this neighborhood who obviously have not been taught to have respect for other peoples' property! My only advice is to consider your options, these apartments/townhomes are not worth $880+/month, you could find way better in this area!

Cheap construction, paper thin walls, rude office staff leaky windows and doors, and careless maintenance people is all I can say about Fox Chase. The only good thing about this complex is its location. If you want to be able to hear your neighbors going to the bathroom, this is the place for you. Save yourself a lot of agony-do NOT rent one of these apartments.
I have been living in this community for last 3 years. Very nice neighborhood. Maintenance is very good, especially the guy Syed, he is awesome in taking care of the maintenance requests.

My light went out in my kitchen & I have called for 3 days. No one has come out to fix the light still. The girl answering the phone has been very rude each time. I've even told her I have a visual disability and even then rude & not sending someone immediately. We've had to eat out for 2 days and I'm assuming today will be the third. It would take no more than 5 minutes to get it changed. I moved in mid-year 2020 and my rent has gone up almost $400. They're totally willing to stick it to you rather than other places that are only raisi g the rent by 5%. I love the lake & location but anytime there is a maintenance issue it's like pulling teeth trying to get it fixed timely. Every time there's an issue it's a fight to get it fixed. This time I even called only once a day & was kind & still nada. The person answering the phone was very clear with me how much of a priority it is NOT to change it. She was rude the first day I called & rude now. If you don't like your job, or that people complain when their maintenance has not been done when you've said you'd have them do it for 3 days then maybe you are in the wrong job. It's ridiculous. Again, great location. Great lake & friendly neighbors. You just have to think about how bad you want issues resolved when there are ones.

Property and location is good but service is very poor. I had very hard time getting response from management team. End up paying more for ending lease. Did not receive proper communication. Make sure you clear terms before signing lease.

Terrible rude management. They do not care about tenants. They will not return your deposit, and they will try to make you pay for extra things and threaten to take you to collections if you do not pay.

If you're thinking about moving here DONT do it. For the money my husband and I are paying, all the issues we've had are not worth it.
Problem 1:
There is NO hot water on the regular bases. I was one of the first residents moving into this building, while it was still under construction, in June of 2020. I love my apartment and was very pleased for a time. When I was researching complexes in the Scott's Addition area The Scout was a big winner for me because it was listed to have free parking that was "plentiful" with some optional pay to park spaces and beautiful amenities all in walking distance to lots of great places that I enjoy in Richmond. 

I chose not to pay to park when I moved in because I was ok not having a promised parking space. However, as the building got closer to full occupancy, I have been more or less forced into paying for parking due to my unusual work schedule in order to protect my safety.

When the amenities finally opened in Mid July 2020 they were wonderfully maintained and always available for use. Since the pool has reopened this summer it is constantly dirty. The rooftop deck and pool deck have already warped and become unsafe, even after replacing several areas. 

I still love my unit, but I am overall disappointed in the facilities available to me and how management has chosen to handle them.

There is no nearby street parking and the Scout's parking lot has way WAY too few spots for tenants (when we moved in we were told all residents had parking, but they may be advertising differently now that the building is more full). Every night you have to park far away and uber home, park at the bar next door and risk getting towed, or park on boulevard (my car has been hit and run twice parking overnight) and walk home to the Scout. There are plenty of apartments in the area at a similar price point as the Scout that have access to either a parking lot or safe, nearby street parking. I would recommend avoiding this complex until they are able to get a handle on the parking situation.

You get the richmond experience without having to settle for a 100+ year old apt. w/o amenities. It feels like I am living in the Hilton, but BETTER.

However, it is now January 2022 and the construction is nowhere near done. I was told that the restaurants and shops on the first level would be complete by September 2021 and their completion is nowhere in sight.

Also, The Ella has an extreme problem with impromptu fire alarms at awful times of the day. If you work from home, I strongly discourage you from living here.

As for other broken promises, I was told parking would be free with my lease. However, once they filled all the apartments, they rescinded their promise and began to charge for parking.

Other than that, the quality of the appliances within the units are not up to par. I treat my unit extremely well and submit service requests frequently in order to maintain everything. Within 6 months, my blinds broke (which required two service requests to fix - the first one being ignored altogether), my dishwasher failed to close causing fluids to leak every time I was my dishes.

Also, the first two weeks I lived here, I was without wifi even though I was once again promised wifi would be available when I moved in.

I have never complained or left a public review like this but the behavior displayed by the building and its management is unacceptable. I am currently writing this review while a fire alarm is going off at 10:40am on a Sunday and it's been going on for over10 minutes now.

They reserved like half of the parking and are trying to charge $75/month for it but no one wants to pay that so the spots just sit empty.

The package room is a chaotic mess. It seems impossible to find anything and neighbors are consistently reporting things getting stolen or going missing. There's no organization and packages are just thrown anywhere and everywhere. I’ve had several packages go missing or get stolen.

One of the elevator breaks at least once a week and it is the ONLY elevator that goes to our floor, which makes us take 5 flights of stairs.

Would not recommend living here. Had high expectations and have been consistently let down.

Definitely not worth the price.

Do. Not. Live. Here. The leasing office continually has excuses for every complaint the residents have instead of having empathy and admitting this has not been an enjoyable place to live. When I originally signed my leased, I was told construction was ahead of schedule and should be completed by the end of July or early August at the latest. It’s now the end of October and I’m currently listening to a jackhammer right outside my window while the construction workers drill up a brand new sidewalk for reasons that haven’t been communicated. I would have never ever signed my lease if I had known this is what it would be like to live here. I work from home and my work is constantly interrupted by construction or maintenance or various other things which is how I pay my rent to live here. They rushed to get apartments completed first so they could begin collecting rent and there is plaint spatters everywhere and my bathroom is covered in random globs of plaster. Amenities still aren’t completed. Parking is a complete mess. I’ve continually taken my concerns to the leasing office for a rent discount until construction is completed which has been ignored, although I’ve been told numberous times that “we’re willing to do anything to make our residents happy”. I moved here because the Ella is owned by steelhead and I have many friends that live at other steelhead properties that are happy where they live so I didn’t think I would have such a negative experience. If it wasn’t such an inconvenience to me to pay to break my lease and move again then I 100% would.
We enjoyed living here. Happy the pool was built and the location is great! The apartments are nice and the all utilities included is a deal!

Apartment is OK. Fun location in Scotts Addition but management was very behind on construction schedule. Pool and courtyard area were completed months after we were told it would be ready. Maintenance issues with our apartment that have yet to be fixed.

Overall I really like living here! It was frustrating to not have the pool that was part of the amenities I paid for the first summer, but it was opened early this year and is very nice. Krista is a great prop manager and I really appreciate her.

Wish they wouldn’t increase rent by 2% every year for no reason. Also because construction was rushed, even though it’s new construction, there are several issues with the paint job, dirt on windows, and knicks on cabinets that are visible. There is absurdly little closet space if you want you live with two people. Like the neighborhood and having utilities included though.

good: 
location, in unit W/D, large closets, package room, wifi connection

bad: kitchen storage (not enough), natural light (I’m on parking garage side), dirty dog park (it is hosed but needs to be professionally cleaning frequently), construction, loud neighbors, shower doesn’t always get hot enough 

ugly: pricing (increase is my reason for moving), fire alarms go off just by opening the oven (even with all fans on and window open), windows won’t open more than a couple inches and don’t have screens so bugs come in if open, i had a very uncomfortable interaction one night in the dog park and never received any follow up from management.

the building is always super clean, noise levels are normal, having a parking garage makes life so much easier and safer! The pool area is beautiful but would love a couch on the side with the grills for a places to relax with the pool is closed. Best place to live in Scott’s

Moving in to Sphere was made super easy and quick with Jo in the leasing office. She answered all my questions quickly prior to signing the lease and was beyond helpful throughout the process. The apartments are new and very modern, clean, and comfortable. Management keeps the property impeccably clean and the whole building smells great! They have some kind of scent machine pumping through the vents. As soon as you walk in, you won't want to leave. The buildings are quiet with pretty good soundproofing, I never hear my neighbors through the wall unless they're in the hallway. I've only lived here about two weeks but I plan to stay for a while!
Very nice apartment with new and quality appliances. But people smoke weed in hallways and elevators. Non-residents also come in to use amenities like swimming pool and gym.

At other apartment complexes you have to hunt down the office and/or maintenance staff.  Not at the Sphere Apartments.Their staff is always professional, courteous and on top of their job.  Keep up the excellent work.
Sphere has been a great place to live so far, we really enjoy the amenities and the leasing staff is very responsive and helpful.
informative and friendly staff, great floor plans, nice amenities, pet friendly

I toured with Jo and she provided tons of information during the tour. She was thorough and she was very personable, you can tell she loves her job. I decided to apply for a two bedroom since the move in special was great! It was in my desired budget and not to mention, the community is brand new. Beautiful stainless steel appliances and open concept layout.

Rachel is absolutely amazing. I was in need of finding a great apartment in a short amount of time to start a new job. I was moving from a little over an hour away and she helped with every step, down to the last detail. I was probably one of her more difficult applicants with a new job and a quick relocation timeline. She worked with my budget, my needs, and went out of her way to keep me comfortable through the entire (very stressful for me) process. Even after my initial move in, she continued to help navigate this new chapter with me. I could not be happier with her efficient, conscientious, and extremely caring approach. I am so grateful for her and for this home in this beautiful neighborhood and city. Thank you, thank you!
Love the different activities each month. Great community. Great apartment overall

Rachel from the leasing & management team has been truly exceptional to work with. She’s been great since I first made the call to the leasing office, since then expertly finding out my apartment needs and providing me with in-depth tours of the apartments and amenities of this brand new, very well-situated luxury apartment complex. Her professional yet personal nature and depth of knowledge have made the tours, apartment selection, paperwork, and move-in a breeze and a truly pleasant experience.

The apartment complex comes with:
* comfortable floor plans
* a close proximity to restaurants, parks, & the city (right across the river)
* luxury finishings both in the apartments, as well as throughout the amenities & other common areas
* a lively community and plenty of regular community events organized by the management team

I’m enjoying my experience here so far and I’m looking forward to continuing to call The Commodore my home!
The team here have been amazing! Extremely accommodating and helpful. Super easy move! Rachel, Cam and Matt go the extra mile!
Staff has been so nice and helpful with helping us find the right place! You can tell they really care about their residents. Great location and great view of Richmond! Would recommend!

We just moved in and can say we are absolutely thrilled with our decision to move here! Matthew was extremely helpful on our tour. He took the time to go over our needs and showed us several units that fit our criteria and also engaged in conversations with us to make the experience more memorable. Application process was very easy and smooth and we were approved in a timely manner. Rachel has also been helpful updating us throughout the process as well. We are so happy to be here!

Instantly fell in love with the property as soon as I stepped into the lobby! Everything is beautiful - from common areas to apartments to amenities. The staff is professional and attentive; they’ve been so helpful and accommodating! I’m so excited to move in!

The Commodore combines contemporary urban living with chic-timeless style. Its proximity to downtown and the business district make it an ideal home for young professionals. The property management staff is second to none. Rachel and Matt possess a welcoming blend of professionalism, expertise, and infectious enthusiasm that make the facility a true community.

Decided on The Commodore when moving back to Richmond and couldn’t be happier with that decision. The staff is incredibly helpful and prompt and the property itself is not only appealing aesthetically but has great amenities and is in a fantastic and convenient location.
Excited to move in, staff was super helpful with the tour process and answering all questions! Property is so pretty!
The staff is so amazing. They helped me decide on which apartment was best based on my needs and budget. Great amenities and even better apartments!
The Commodore is one of the best places to live overall in Richmond. Leasing office staff are very helpful as well! 10/10 recommend!

I relocated two weeks ago from another state, and it was my first time in Richmond, VA. Rachel assisted me during my move since I was new to Virginia, promptly addressing all my concerns and making the transition smooth. Additionally, Mathews has been responsive to any issues I've encountered!

Beyond the helpful staff, the apartment itself is stunning, and the neighbors are friendly too. I haven't experienced a better combination than this!
Great location; the best property in the area. Amenities are top notch, and the staff is really responsive.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: This place is amazing! And all the staff are so friendly! Excited to be in this beautiful apartment! All of the amenities are state of the art, great dog park, pool area and corn hole make this like a resort.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Novel is hands down one of, if not the nicest apartment in the area. The amenities are like no other locations. It is in a fantastic location. Great food and shopping options are very close by. They are located right by the highway. The staff is phenomenal and helpful. They made the entire process from touring to moving in easy and accommodating.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Beautiful property with perfect amenities. Courtnii made our move in experience amazing! She was patient, friendly, and efficient. We are very happy with our decision to move to Novel.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: My experience so far has been beyond my expectations. It’s so peaceful but yet so much to explore indoors and outdoors . I would like to give a huge shout out to the management team at THE NOVEL .

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: The staff was very nice and responsive from start to finish with my move in. I had a very seamless move in process. The building is extremely clean and the amenities are amazing as well. If you're looking to move to the Scotts Addition Area, I definitely recommend Novels.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Clean and safe apartment, needing keys to access elevators and to apartment. Great for pets, with large spaces and great construction work. Looking forward to trying the pool once it’s warmer.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Everyone has been so lovely and helpful! The amenities are stunning, and the apartment is everything I have dreamed of. So happy to call The Novel home!

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: I absolutely love it here, It is everything I wanted in an Apartment! The appliances are very nice, the views from the apartment are spectacular (especially at sunset), and the design/materials are top-notch. I also love the amenities! The gym is great and has everything I need and the skylounge has a breathtaking view of The Diamond and Downtown RVA. I love it here and couldn't imagine being anywhere else!

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Cayce and Courtnii have been extremely helpful leading up to, during, and after my move-in. They are always available to answer questions. The maintenance man is extremely nice and resolves my requests very quickly. I love the building and my apartment so much. When the city of RVA was instructed to boil water during to a snowstorm, he hand delivered waters to our apartment!! They know me by name here and I love it. Great community, I’m glad that I chose to live here :)

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Living at Novel has been a wonderful experience. The staff and events make this feel like a true luxury community - my only complaint would be I wish the food and drink were stocked more regularly.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review:
Novel is amazing! They really do a great job at getting to know their residents and for the residents to know each other. They are constantly hosting get together throughout the week and there is never any pressure to join. 

While there are areas of improvement (none staff related), I promise you they work tirelessly to address all of them, while still maintaining wonderful their wonderful customer service and community feel they are cultivating.

I have never experienced a community like this and I am happy to be a part of it as it continues  to grow!

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Im still in process of moving in but know I will thoroughly enjoy making Novel my home.  It is a beautiful facility, supported by a caring and conscientious property management team.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Best place to live in Scott's Addition !!  The staff is top notch and they all aim to make their residents feel happy and provide the best customer service in the Richmond area.  The little things they do every week makes living there a dream  .

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Beautiful building! The appliances are top notch and the building itself is very clean. The parking garage is very spacious as well, with plenty of parking.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: What a fun environment! The staff and other residents are fantastic! They are friendly and the staff are always ready to help with anything.

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Nothing short of amazing!!! Top notch customer service from the greatest staff ever! I am amazed at how beautiful and inviting this community is. The staff treats you like real family!

apartmentName: NOVEL Scott's Addition by Crescent Communi...
review: Very friendly community and it has been a true joy living here. If you are looking for somewhere to call home in this area, look no further!

Stay away from this apartment. The management here sucks! They made me pay a Utility bill that was their responsibility. I called the utility company & they confirmed that the apartment people made me pay for their bill. This apartment complex not only made me pay for their bill, they charged me $50 fee for the bill that was their responsibility. So they gave me partial credit back. Then next month they removed the credit & charged my account again. I had to pay the charge or else they threaten to charge late fee! I paid then I contacted them about the credit reversed. The management team played dumb & said they waived me $25 fee for my bill. I had them look into my payments history & I paid extra always. I was never waived any $25 that they made up. I was actually charged extra $50 fee + bill that they used( that was weeks prior to my move in). I confronted them with proof & they ignored me after they found out I was right & that they made up about the part of waiving $25 fee when they actually charged me $50 + a bill they used before my move in! Unprofessional team & lack of honesty. Do not move here!

I moved in 5/2020 and within three weeks the hot water heater went out. I stayed without hot water for almost a week. On top of all the issues I have had here (see other reviews)… guess what?! 5/2021 the hot water heater is out again! I am without hot water for a week. Credit: they have been lighting the pilot each day for a week instead of getting a new hot water heater BUT today the pilot went out. Smh..

This place is horrible. There is trash everywhere and I sincerely mean everywhere! Before you rent take a drive through the neighborhood especially on the weekend and look at the trash collection. It’s horrible. Do not move here if you want sanity.

This place is not even worth 1 star. It’s awful!! Now on top of all the other issues in the community, they remove ALL dumpsters and expect residents to use one centralized compactor. The community is filled with trash. It looks disgusting and is causing health hazards. We also are attracting strange animals nightly. 
There are elderly people who live here and this joke of a complex expects them to transport their trash blocks down the road. Disgusting. Shameful!! 
This is just one of the numerous issues with this property. Do your research!! Also check out the Henrico county crime stats on the community before you relocate here. Suspicious activity, drug activity, gun shots... it’s not worth the money or your safety!

Trash is everywhere. They removed dumpsters and replaced it with 1 trash compactor that is never attended. Our sidewalks flood with the slightest rain. 

They're saving tons on trash pickup fees but rent keeps increasing. Don't give this place your money.

If I could give it no stars, I definitely would. We moved in 03/15/2019 and immediately had issues. The day we moved in and paid our move in fees, we had a sign on our door stating we needed to pay them money. When we confronted them about it, they just acted like it was no big deal. Already a red flag on day 1 isn’t a good sign. The first week of July our AC went out. I called them as this was a maintenance emergency, and they did not come fix it promptly. It wasn’t until after I called corporate that they gave us a portable unit. The guy set it up in the living room and left without another word. The AC problem continued for almost an entire week before it was “Frankensteined” fixed. We continued to have AC problems for the duration of our tenancy. Last winter, I received a call from the maintenance department saying they were coming to fix our furnace. When I questioned them about why they were coming to fix it, they stated during the inspection, they noticed if we turned our heat on “flames will shoot into the living room” (that’s an exact quote). I was out of town and no one was home, so I asked if they could come back to fix it. I still had no working heat until yesterday when my lease was up. We complained of an overwhelming smell of marijuana to the assistant property manager, who proceeded to tell us the office was closing in 10 minutes, and it wasn’t his problem. Our neighbors upstairs had a leak in their toilet which caused our bathroom ceiling to sag. When I called maintenance, the guy came and cut a huge hole in my ceiling and wanted to leave it open. After I asked to cover the hole, he shoved trash bags up there and said they would be back the next day. I again had to call corporate to get them to come fix it. I had water damage to my dining room which they refused to take care of. For the last 2 months of our stay, I did not have a working washing machine after repeatedly calling to get it fixed. This place is absolutely horrible and I would not even recommend my worst enemy live there. If you wanna live in an area with gun violence and drugs then by all means, but if you’re looking for a quality place to live, run far away from GSC properties.
Very bad app.  Bad management and the water is back following from the kitchen sink to the floor the maintenance didn’t show up.

The all inclusive rent is a plus but you have to deal with the following: stolen packages, auto theft, safety issues, slow maintenance requests, and terrible communication from management. You also won’t get your full deposit back and they won’t tell you why.

I’ve lived here for 2 years.  During that time I haven’t had too many issues with my apartment.  When I’ve inputted a ticket to have something fixed they have been responsive.  I will say there were a couple of time where it took awhile to respond to the maintenance ticket.  I’ve had good interactions with the people in the leasing office.  They put together social activities for the community.  They send out emails if anything needs to be communicated to residents.  I hear my neighbors sometimes but not that often.  My biggest gripe has nothing to do with Cold Storage and everything to do with some issues in the neighborhood.  More so the trash.  It’s gross.  Otherwise this is a good place to live for what pay and what’s included with rent.

every time there is an issue the management will pretend to be busy, lie about responding, ignore your calls, etc

don't bother

Noise is a huge issue here. First, there is zero insulation and the windows are thin so you hear everything, especially the obnoxious folks blasting music from their cars virtually every single day. Second, the fire alarms used to go off every week (sometimes multiple times in a week), forcing people to leave their homes for a false alarm that is entirely too loud (imagine if you had kids or pets). Lastly, if you are on a bottom level, again you will hear everything from your neighbors because there is no barrier between apartments. The lease consultants are pretty good. They seem to try their best to accommodate and resolve issues in a respectful way. However, they don't seem to have much power and often have to take up issues with their management. And let me tell you, management here does not care one bit. Have a complaint? They will interrupt you as you are explaining the issue. Have a disputed charge? Doesn't matter, pay them first and MAYBE they will do something about it (hint: they won't). Some amenities are pretty good such as the pool. However, if you have been paying attention to this review, you'll probably guess that even that has its issues. The pool wasn't even open for weeks after the intended opening date. This was probably because management is incompetent and unsympathetic to any issues or complaints. For how much you have to pay to stay here, you would think standard maintenance is part of your rent (hint: it's not and they will nickle and dime you). Find another place to stay because chief, this ain't it.

I lived here for 3 years and loved the apartment. The all inclusivity and the location are great. The management is decently responsive, as far as leasing offices go. Having a restaurant in the building was terrible; they have loud events during week nights that kept me up late (and I was on the 4th floor). I complained multiple times, and after the first few complaints the office started ignoring me. I cleaned my side of the apartment and the main area (I don’t think my roommate cleaned anything) and they made sure to charge the amount of our deposit almost exactly despite areas that were obviously cleaned to the best of my ability, so unless you can clean like a professional, do not expect your deposit back.

My apartment was lovely & affordable. I also never had an issue with parking. However, my apartment was infested with centipedes and spiders. The spiders were living inside of the brick walls and were nesting in the cracks. The centipedes would crawl out from the cracks in the roof and also from the drain. The unit was exterminated several times, but the issue still pursued.

Pests. Mold. Pathetic “gym”. 10+ maintenance requests & I went without a working washer and dryer for half of my lease (they do use a 3rd party company to lease them from, but there was a lack of coordination & advocacy from the leasing office). Corporate says one thing, the leasing office says another. Not guaranteed close parking. The biggest pro is tray the area is generally quiet at night.

They don’t call back, maintenance doesn’t fix your problem. We have mold in our apartment, from a water leak. It’s been a month, they refuse to treat it properly. My kids have had perpetual sinus infections for two months, causing us to miss work and events.

I wish I could give a lesser review for this place. My family and I have been living on the property for 5 years. Recently, we were notified by our upstairs neighbors that their apartment had been condemned and deemed unlivable due to a black mold infestation. He proceeded to show my photos of the interior of his apartment where there was black mold growing up the walls in multiple closets and in the hallway. Having a child with severe allergies and asthma who needs breathing treatments seasonally, I was very concerned. Upon calling the office and speaking with the property manager, Katie, about my concerns for my family's safety, she informs me that there is nothing she can do and could not approve allowing us to break our lease without penalty due to the fact that the resident (me) hadn't seen any signs of mold. It was only after expressing my concerns did she offer for maintenance to come inspect my apartment for mold. When maintenance arrived the following day, I had a few areas that I suspected mold may be and had them check there first. They proceeded to cut a whole in my ceiling revealing water damage from the apartment above, then cut a whole behind my washing machine where mold was then found. Still, GSC apartments refused to allow us to break our lease in order to find more viable housing for our family. The lack of communication, empathy and concern for their residents health and safety is baffling. Please do not rent from GSC properties.

I’ve lived here over six years and built a relationship with the rental staff. There are some hiccups but the staff is only human. They try their best to build community and give the best service possible. And the maintenance staff is polite and courteous as long as you show them respect.

I contacted property manger Jan to discuss why I had to pay full price of rent when my upgrade has not  been done  and I was told by her that I had to  come in sign a order form to upgrade. Which the form was a resident form. I am considering taking this to the news station. Jan told me that I had to come in to sign an order form to do the upgrade which was supposed to have been done before my renewal in July as of today it is still not done but they want me to still pay upgrade rental price

I've lived in the horrific complex for almost two years and can't wait to leave. Staff has changed numerous times and maintenance is horrendous. I've spent days with no water and almost a week with no a.c and they could care less. Two apartments in my building had serious water leaks that effected me and guess what? No one cared. Rent has gone up every year and quality has kept on going down. No one cares. The parking sticker deal is a total nightmare so having guests is risky. I can go on and on but I'll stop at the serious roach problem. Don't move here
Walked in for a tour and the front desk worker was very rude and not accommodating. Was not eager to help and was upset that we did not schedule a tour online.

I lived here for 3 months. I was getting bit up in my apartment, and the exterminator couldn't even figure out what was biting me. I was told I would have to pay 4 months rent to break my lease. I would have paid 5 months just to get out of that apartment.

I still live there for now but they are very slow on repairs, if they even repair anything. Trash everywhere because they took out all the trash bins for a centralized compactor that hasn’t worked yet. The front office is trifling, won’t answer the phone and want to argue over the simplest of things. I tried to get a 2 day guest pass for parking and they won’t even do that. I strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

When ever I call them they say they have apartments available for lease, they tell we can come and look at the apartment . Once we reach there they say there are no apartments available . This is the third time we were experience this!!! 

Not sure how would it be after signing the lease thanks we got experienced before!!

This is the worst apartment complex we have ever lived in. We've only been here for a year and 10 months and we've have more problems than anywhere else we've ever lived. Our gas water heater broke twice, causing us to have to vacate our apartment both times. The toilet in our master bedroom hasn't worked since we moved in, despite numerous calls to maintenance. More recently, the ceiling in our bedroom collapsed while we were sleeping in bed because of a crack we told them about 4 months ago that they never fixed. I wouldn't suggest anyone move her until the do some serious work to their units and not the patch job they seem to think is okay.

I live in the Cardinals and the apartment Has leaks everywhere.  The sink is always broken.they come fix it and two or three days later is broken again. The bathtub also leaks...tha AIR CONDITIONING IS ALWAYS having trouble. I am not the only one all of my neighbors. Has the same complains. Dont move to the Cardinals!!!!!!! Oh and i live alone so there is no kids at home.

The apartments are in okay condition. They are always doing roadwork which makes coming in and out of the apartment a hassle in the morning. My problem is that they will threaten eviction, if you are just a day late with your rent, even with perfect payment history. After five days, they add a late fee. After eight days, they add court costs. They will do this each month. God forbid if you fall on hard times, because they will make it even harder for you. Not worth it in the end. Only consider this complex as a last option.
It’s not worth it honestly don’t it it’s hella roaches in those apartments

Bottom of the barrel. The nastiest slum. Roaches the size of playing cards. Rats the size of cats. Trash everywhere. My apartment has been flooded by my upstairs neighbors 4 times in less than 6 months and they never do anything to fix it. My upstairs neighbor throws his trash off the top balcony and leaves it in the yard. People leave entire furniture sets by the dumpster bay. No one picks up after or leashes their dogs. It’s basically anarchy. If you want an unsafe neighborhood with no rules that you can’t walk around at night and slum apartments that are dangerous and pest infested then this is the place for you. Management is nonexistent. Maintenance is a joke. Don’t give these horrible people your money

Do not live here. I have been here since last fall and I will be leaving as soon as possible. The maintenance staff never responds and if they do they will enter your apartment without notice and without knocking. The roaches are HUGE and abundant. The windows and doors are unsealed and break/won’t open. Water damage is rampant and unaddressed. The other residents regularly leave large amounts of trash in the parking lot. Several residents walk their aggressive dogs without a leash and don’t pick up the poop. The people in the office are rude and unhelpful. The entire staff gives you attitude if you ask them to do their job. The cops are here several times a week. There is absolutely no sense of community and even as a grown man I don’t walk around at night because it is not safe. This is a dirty and horrible place to live that is run by people who refuse to give even the bare minimum.

The worst apartment complex. My air was not working for summer 2020 a month after I moved in. I requested a new apartment and was denied. Maintenance came to my apartment several times and could not fix the issue. They had to use a generator which tripled my electricity bill. Corporate never reach back to me and I was working from home in 100 degree weather. They hired an outside contractor during the fall and the issue was still it fixed as of summer 2021. The apartment never owned up to this situation, but processed to raise my rent if I decided to continue living there. Terrible service in my opinion. No one wanted to hear my situation or help the issue.

If I could give zero stars I would. Please at all cost DO NOT MOVE HERE! They are absolutely awful. From the living conditions to the general incompetence these people are slum lords. I lived there for two years (only due to the pandemic) and hated every minute of it. We lived in one of their townhomes and our living room and downstairs half bath were infested with mold due to a leak coming from the upstairs bathroom. I placed several maintenance request to have this looked at but it was until our ceiling in the living room began to fall apart did someone come to look at it. When they did all they did was patch up the wall and paint it without addressing the leak or the mold. It got so bad there was mold growing under the carpet and spread to anything left in that corner over night. We had several issues with our heating and cooling system and had to plead for a new unit after spending a weeks with no ac as the attempted to find the problem. I would like to note the maintenance employees themselves were always kind, courteous, and attempted to help despite the system they worked for. With the maintenance issues aside, the leasing office attendants are grossly incompetent. Due to the global pandemic, we entered into a payment agreement for one month’s rent that was to be evenly distributed among the remaining months. When we attempted to pay out of the payment arrangement we were told that everything was overpaid and we were given a $300 credit to the next month. The following month we were billed with late fees for a balance we were told we over paid. When we attempted to address this, no one wanted to take responsibility or reimbursed the late fee charges placed on the account due to the the staffs mistakes. I attempted multiple times to meet with the the location Manager Shannon; who avoided meeting. In short do yourself a favor and find ANYWHERE ELSE to live.

They denied me, and I never got an email saying this, after j paid my 150 for app fee and hold fee. They never got back to me at all after calling for about two weeks. Horrible customer service!!!! I will take action though!

This property did it's job, once we were able to contact them and sign the lease. My roommate and I needed a place to stay, which this place provided, nothing more. 

We started the process at the start of the month, however one week before the expected move in date, and when my other lease ended, they told us there was no available space and the apartment we wanted was not ready. They gave us an apartment with many issues, however once we reported it, they did fix it. We asked for all the documents, however we never received during our time here. the place does have a lot of cockroaches and bugs, even though they do maintenance pretty often. They were ok at being responsive, but they never went above and beyond like other places I stayed at. I would honestly recommend another place.

This place is “fine” overall. But management and upkeep of the property is horrible.
