This place is undue charges galore!!! The only things that you do not need to pay for is to keep your kidney and your liver.
great place to live nice and clean but good luck getting home past 6 0 parking spots.

I loved my apartment at the preserve but just couldn't justify staying there after the rents went up. I lived in a 1 bed 1 bath on the factory side which I loved. I never had any major maintenance problems, and when i did it was always quickly tended to. the amenities were okay (small pool with no security on the gate, small gym, limited parking, cool rooftop, awesome community room). management was great as well. always quick to respond and very involved in the community (monthly gatherings/parties). would definitely recommend living there if you can afford it

The Preserve…Great location!!!
I have lived at The Preserve for 3 years and regrettably I must say that the quality of life at The Preserve has declined over the past 6 to 9 months. Inconsistent operation of the elevators, dogs running the halls off their leash, trash shoot is regularly clogged and trash rooms are regularly filled with trash. Dog waste is another issue (lazy dog owners). Management continuously makes empty threats of fining violators and to start taking dog DNA samples to catch violators… to my knowledge, neither has happened. Not sure if the decline is due to management, leasing office staff no longer living onsite or due to some of the new residents…or all the above.
The staff at the leasing office are very personable and can be helpful. They will bend over backwards for you if you are looking to sign a new lease or renew a lease, otherwise you are dirt.
The maintenance staff is responsive and pretty good. Just if they don’t have to repair walls & paint, otherwise they leave a mess and may damage furniture (I speak from experience). 
Some of the fees should be negotiable, such as the valet trash fee.
The rents are market value, but does not include plowing or salting of the parking lot when it snows…so pack your ice skates.

I've lived in this area (and the DC area) for 20 years. I've lived in various communities in that time, some of them apartment complexes. I've lived through several blizzards worse than Jonas in 2016. NEVER have I encountered worse management of snow conditions than over the last few days at The Preserve. First- it's 9:30am on a Monday, snow has stopped for a day already, and the sidewalks are not clear, AT ALL. They haven't even been salted and are pure ice. That includes the sidewalks in front of the leasing office, which I would expect them to at the very least do. Forget if you're someone who needs a power chair or really any assistance with walking- you wouldn't be able to travel during the winter at The Preserve it seems. On top of that, they refused to plow the parking lots, because they don't want to inconvenience people by piling snow behind their cars. Except- the real reason is that they probably don't want to spend the money for the plow, because people are still inconvenienced by getting stuck and having to shovel themselves out anyway. It makes absolutely zero sense- every apartment complex or community I've lived has plowed the parking lots. It's UNDERSTOOD by residents that we'll have to dig ourselves out, but at the very least, we should be able to pull out onto a clear road. If you somehow get a 6 month lease during warmer climates, I may recommend staying here, but don't expect to be safe or get anywhere during the winter.

The Preserve is a middling apartment complex. The idea and layout of the building is actually pretty cool. With the industrial feel, exposed brick, natural sunlight, and high ceilings, it has a nice ambiance to it. The pool is small, but still fun. The amenities inside the apartment are also very nice with your own washer/dryer, trash service, and new appliances.

Parking is miserable however. As if the apartments aren't expensive enough (>$1,000/mo without utilities), they ask for an additional $50/mo for a "reserved parking space". If you choose not to pay the extra money, you may or may not get to park in the actual lot that day. Your alternative is parking on the street where your car is less safe and having to hike a pretty significant way to make it back to your unit. The property management is also sub-par. It might be because they are understaffed, but normally they are not as responsive and helpful as you would like them to be for the cost of living there. All in all, I would probably recommend to look at other options first before choosing the Preserve.

The apartments at The Preserve at Scott's Addition are beautifully laid out. My apartment has ample living space and an incredible kitchen.  Lots of storage in the "Icon" floor plan and a really nice, spacious balcony. The units are designed in a way that makes total sense for decor, and I appreciate that. There are more than enough outlets in the apartment, the flooring is great, and the bedroom sizes are spacious. The amenities are wonderful - gym, pool, clubroom. The historic location is nice. 

That being said, parking is really difficult. There are only FIVE guest spaces. Five. For an apartment complex of over 200 units. Parking for residents is only guaranteed if you pay $50 per month. The rest is first come, first serve and there are not enough spots.

PLEASE: IF YOU CAN STAY SOMEWHERE ELSE, PLEASE DO!!

The turnover rate for maintenance is unbelievable. It may take months for something to be addressed, and even then, it won’t be done correctly. It’ll be done quickly and sloppy. The electoral wiring is horrible meaning you may not be able to have several things on and plugged up at one time. They will mark your maintenance request as “resolved” without resolving I’m guessing in hopes that you’ll forget about it. There was a gaping hole in our ceiling for 2 months. When I threatened to call
Pegasus residential, someone came and fixed it immediately. We have a centipede, spider, and slug problem. We have contacted maintenance several times to send out pest control and the “pest control” is someone from maintenance bringing bug spray bought from a regular store and spraying it in the corners. We have seen maintenance on our ring camera doing this, there is no actual pest control. There is a request sitting in our account right now for pest control that has not been addressed.

Depending on where the apartment is, parking is horrid. A family can have 5 cars that take up 5 spaces when there is limited space in front of certain apartments and the only thing the front office will tell you is call the towing company to come get the cars with expired tags.

You WILL NOT have peace if you live near the shared spaces (pool, fire pit, etc). The quiet hours are NOT enforced by the complex and people will be outside screaming, playing music, and being loud 1, 2, 3 am. They do not do anything about noise complaints. I have complained via email and in person several times about the apartment above me constantly making noise and they have not done anything about it. They can send emails about picking up after your pets but not about disruptions.

The front office does not hear concerns and does nothing about them. They are categorized as “luxury” but it’s nothing of the sort. It costs way too much to have so many issues. In addition to the horrible living conditions and the prices they also tack on hidden “community fees” to your rent. If you were thinking of staying here, please look elsewhere.

Do not live here!!! You will be welcomed to rats everywhere. Nothing in the apartments work. From the sinks, to the toilets, to the outlets, to the refrigerator. Maintenance never comes either. I had 6 maintenance requests sitting for 2 months.. I’ve only been here 3. The people at the front desk could care less about you. I’ve wrecked my car here because of the crazy pothole they have leaving out of the entrance and they did absolutely nothing about it. If you care about your mental and want somewhere to live, where you can actually live, DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!! huge mistake.

Evee since the new company took over, work orders don't get done. They don't respond and IF they do, they promise things and never get to it. Work orders half complete. They replaced my faucet after 3 months only for it to just literally be sitting on my sink. I had to call my friend to come and put it together properly and tighten it. Still waiting on another work order placed 3 months ago that the door had been snagging my carpet. Don't rent here.
I am loving living at Hickory Creek! Georgiana made the process so easy and the whole staff has been so great to work with.

As a resident for nearly 3 years, I have experienced rent and fee increases, while customer service regarding maintenance requests has diminished since October, 2022.  Property Management contends, staff-shortage as the reason for maintenance delays. However, this was not the case prior to new management in October and the issue continues as of late December.  Unless deemed an emergency, maintenance requests are not considered important or a priority.

Pegasus Residential, new management company, is just as worse as the past one. Voiced my concerns to Thomas at the office. Nothing has changed for the better.

Walls are very thin, I can hear everything with my upstairs neighbor (ALL activity, walking around, their cats/dog jumping). Makes it very hard working from home. Also, this complex does not pay attention to the balconies and pets. Lease states NOT to leave certain items out on the balcony, but people do whatever they want. Lease also states certain breeds are restricted to live here. For example, my neighbor throws trash over their balcony which gets into my living space. They also leave their restricted dog out on the balcony who makes noise which echoes into my living space. Unfortunately, I can’t consider this place home if I can’t be comfortable here. Still looking for a resolution.

Living at The Masonry has been an incredibly frustrating experience due to ongoing mismanagement, poor communication, and unresolved maintenance issues. Despite multiple attempts to contact management, emails go unanswered, and work orders are frequently left incomplete with no updates. When responses do come, they often feel dismissive or passive-aggressive rather than helpful.

One of the biggest concerns is the significant rent discrepancies for identical apartments. I am paying considerably more than other tenants for the same unit, with no explanation or justification. This lack of transparency, combined with the maintenance issues, makes me question the fairness of their pricing.

Maintenance is severely mismanaged. When the apartment above me flooded—twice—management failed to take meaningful action, leaving me to run an industrial moisture removal machine for months. As a 988 crisis worker who works remotely, this was a major disruption to my job, sleep, and mental health. Despite requesting a better solution, I was told to run the machine only at night, which was completely unrealistic.

The pest control situation is just as bad. Despite paying a monthly pest control fee, I had to deal with a severe cockroach infestation for months. The initial “solution” was glue traps, which did nothing. Only after months of complaints was I told I needed to pay over $100 for specialized treatment—an expense that should not have fallen on me.

Additionally, my apartment has structural issues like visible gaps in the molding and walls, leading to persistent leaks and pest problems. These should have been addressed through routine inspections but remain unresolved.

I understand that managing a complex of this size is challenging, but the lack of communication, delayed maintenance, and overall mismanagement have made this the worst living experience I have ever had. Many tenants, including myself, are actively looking for alternative housing. If The Masonry wants to improve tenant satisfaction, they need to focus on better communication, prompt maintenance responses, and addressing ongoing concerns in a fair and transparent manner.

Would not recommend living here unless major changes are made.

Management is the worst. Our entire building has low water pressure since I moved in August 2024 and we lost hot water since the middle of February 2025 to this day. They don’t answer calls or emails and the office is by appointment only, they are only available to get new tenants but once you signed they do not exist. This is not worth living in, stay away.

Please DO NOT RENT HERE!!!, Broken appliances, roaches and bugs everywhere! Property management does nothing.If you live here every tenant will tell you it’s a nightmare! Common utilities sharing. Fees for everything.Nice properties elsewhere.

The whole building has eerie vibes and is poorly lit. The only natural light is in the bedrooms and if you have a 1 bedroom, you might not even get a window. The parking garage is usually left open because the doors are broken. Maintenance is responsive, however. The price is also way too much for what you get, the laundry is very expensive and half the machines are broken.

I've lived here for half a year and since there are very few positives I'm going to start there: The maintenance staff are extremely kind and really do try to help, the cleaning lady is sweet, and the soundproofing between apartments is actually pretty good.
The negatives: Laundry is expensive and the system is stupid, you have to buy a $5 laundry card which you can then fill with cash (ONLY cash) to put into laundry machines. There are plenty of machines so the fact one or two are always out of order isn't a big deal, but it costs 1.73 to wash and about the same to dry. $4 for a single load of laundry adds up. Also, as you can see in the pictures on here, there's white mold in the rafters- that's because the roof leaks. It has since the day I moved in and probably will until the day I move out. We keep different cups and buckets around so that we don't have to come home to another disaster. We haven't had too many pests, just a couple baby roaches here or there. The water pressure sucks and the vending machines are always out of drinks. There's not always somebody on call in the office and because of that, your best shot is hitting up Dodson property management after hours. There was a peeping tom on the roof looking in skylights at one point and the cops ended up having to be called because we'd have to wait all weekend for somebody from coliseum lofts to actually be there. When the power went out (happened only a couple times) some guy got stuck in the elevator which doesn’t actually have a call button if you get stuck, he just had to yell and push the little bell until somebody found him. The people in the leasing office are, in my opinion, rude and parking is $75 per month, much more expensive than a VCU parking pass so I recommend doing that if you can. If you bike, don't trust putting it in the garage because your tires might get stolen. Overall, it's not worth the price and I would say keep looking.

Writing a second review because there's a whole family of MICE and ROACHES living in my unit!! I live on the third floor, and keep my apartment absolutely spotless, and I am being forced to live with pests due to the unsanitary qualities of this property. ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING-DO NOT LIVE HERE, unless you like to sleep with rodents. Also saw a homeless man camped out in the stairwell last week. TAKE YOUR MONEY ELSEWHERE

So thankful to the entire team for making the move in process easy! 
The convenience to 288 is a huge selling point for me .  The pool and resident  events keep me busy.

I moved in this month and found a rodent running around, neighbors complaining about mold all over their apartment and my dog who i have had for 7 years developed high grade infections in his feet. The staff are very nice until you sign then they don't care about you. The dog park is unsanitary and the apartments are very poorly maintained. My shower drips when the people above me use theirs and the pipes have issues in most apartments. Its sad such a new community has so many issues. Don't move in I am ready to move out today!

I lived here for 3 years, after not living in an apartment for over 30 years. I had a great experience living here, especially enjoyed the “Salt” swimming pool and the fact the pool is open all year! Yes, not heated but there are many days in March/April & October that you can enjoy the pool area. Th grilles are a nice touch and a great “outdoor “ kitchen feel!
 The office staff are wonderful, the maintenance folks very responsive.
 My only issue is the noise from the apartment above , as you can hear every footstep and if there are children it can become very loud.

 Overall, a great experience, wonderful facility and very close to great shopping and bars and restaurants!

I do enjoy my living experience here. The gals in the office are great and the maintenance crew is the best! The grounds are pretty well maintained, especially around the pool area. Although (the inside) building maintenance has improved (as far as cleanliness is concerned) - the area in the elevator needs special attention. It never seems clean; the same debris remains week after week even though the center has obviously been touched with water. The stairwell often needs special attention. I think that this is important those of us who live here, but especially to visitors and their first impressions. Would I choose to live here again? I would say yes. I would like to add that the floors are not very well insulated. The noise from above is sometimes dreadful!!! furniture being moved, heavy-handed vacuuming, chairs, etc. being slid across the floor, drawers being opened and closed in the bathroom ~ would be nice if corrections could be made there and certainly in future apartments.

I truly enjoy living at the retreat, being right off I-64 makes it SO convenient to be close to Short Pump but not have to get stuck in the traffic to get to my destination. In addition, the facilities are wonderful & the property managers are also a joy to work with. Would recommend this apartment complex to anyone!

It's a very beautiful and quiet place to live. It is well maintained and the staff is very efficient and pleasant. When you need something it is taken care of either that day or the next. I absolutely love living here. When I moved here I intended it to be my forever home however, with the significant rent increases I don't know but that will be possible and that makes me very sad.

I recently moved out of here and I am so glad that I am gone.  This place overall I think is very trash and no where near worth the money you would spend if you were to stay here.  I had multiple occasions where an overflowed toiled or bath seeped through the floor and into my space and ruin plenty of my nice furniture.  The maintenance staff is extremely slow to respond and not very nice to talk to.  The walls are extremely then so be prepared to hear literally all of your neighbors.  The ones above me through parties a lot and you could hear conversations as if you were standing right in the room with them.  They charge you for all these insane fees that done make much sense.  Overall was not a great experience for my first time living in the Richmond area.  I was really looking forward to living here because of the loft style and the beauty in it but within just two months I regretted my decisions entirely.  Never had this many problems renting before until I got here.

This place is absolutely atrocious. I live on the 4th floor and there are leaks everywhere in my ceiling that I request to be fixed but no one does anything. The leaks are in the hall as well as the staircase which is so ridiculously unsafe and they aren’t little leaks at all. Whenever it rains pretty hard it looks like someone took buckets of water and dumped them down the stairs. The gym is “new” but half the stuff is broken and if you have a package delivered it’s thrown on the floor of the mail area for anyone to take. The doors into the building that are supposed to be locked are broken and anyone can get in and they don’t even close so half the time the doors are wide open. I feel awful for anyone who lives near doors to stairwells or anything because every door slams shut. There’s also hard drug paraphernalia in the stairwells so dogs or kids could easily get a hold of something. They claim they clean but the elevators and the stairs I swear have never been cleaned they are covered in a layer of grime and stickiness. Every single person I’ve run into here talks about how much they hate it so I can’t wait to move out of this dump and into a place I’m not getting side effects from living in mold and dust. Seriously don’t move here.

This is one of the worst places I have lived in. The building advertises that it is secure it is not. Some of the people who live there throw their trash anywhere they feel like it. The walls are so thin you can hear your neighbors conversations. If you live on anywhere but the top floor the noise from above is excessive.

So far so good. I moved in September. I like the amenities included in my rent, however someone child friendly would be great! My puppy baby loves the dog park..wish there was a playground? Now sure if thats possible with all the covid..but just an idea
You get a great value for your money at the Hudson. Great city views and any maintenance issues are dealt with quickly.

This apt complex let's thier private trash company, Republic, come and empty trash dumpsters outside my bedroom window in the middle of the night. This is not within city ordinances. Please call Republic to set pickup after noise ordinance times... aka after 7am, not 4am.
I have had nothing but a great experience here at Shockoe. Staff is friendly and ready to assist with any issues. They’re a great team & I’d recommend to anyone getting started.

Our experience with Shockoe Valley View has been extremely disappointing and frustrating. We have been dealing with the leasing process since March, and it has been nothing short of chaotic and disorganized.

Initially, we provided our income information, which was verified by their team as sufficient. However, despite this verification, the screening process was mishandled from the start. There was a significant lack of communication; I was not informed directly about any issues with our application. Instead, my roommate was notified that our income was insufficient, contradicting the earlier verification.

The entire process dragged on for months, only to end in rejection. This not only wasted our time but also left us feeling blindsided and misled. The inconsistencies and poor communication throughout the process were unacceptable.

We have decided to pay the fees to conclude our dealings with Shockoe Valley View. However, based on our experience, we will not be applying here again nor recommending it to others. This ordeal has left us with a negative impression, and we will remember this when writing further reviews and recommendations.

When I first got here management was great and then management changed and it has just been a terrible experience. First there’s “no parking” when it’s clear there is parking and the people that park in the parking lot don’t pay and management is aware of that but doesn’t take any action towards the issue. Now I have mice problems and I am getting little to no help on the situation. I would say spend your money where it is worth it and where the people actually care for you.

I was very happy when I first moved in and with the management. The only complaint I had was that the walls were too thin so you can hear everything that happens outside of your walls. After some time, management changed many times and everything just went from bad to worse. If you want peace of mind when living in Richmond and can spend an extra couple of bucks I would consider somewhere else. Don't come here to get packages stolen and tampered with, you'll lose your mind here.

I agree with every negative review. My car has been broken into despite their "patrolling", I am kept up until 3am every Thursday-Sunday due to people screaming and singing having parties in their apartments and in the streets, I had major leakage from sliding doors and was only fixed 8 months later, the rain keeps me up every night because it wasnt built right and there for loud drips echo the apartment, my apartment smells like cigarette smoke always because the people below me smoke and it rises through my air vents and laundry room - making my clothes smell, the printers are NEVER working, loud neighbors, aggressive dogs, awful sewage smell often coming from the pipes that the have to "fix" every once in a while and so much more to be added if there wasnt a limit on how long I could post here. I have only lived here almost a year because my contract binds me here until May. I am getting out ASAP and never looking back. Don't buy for the price, so much better out there worth it to pay a hundred more.

The location is pretty much as one would expect for an urban setting.  My apartment has a balcony that affords probably one of the better city views around.  Although it is not far from I-95 it is fairly quiet except for that tractors trailers ‘jake breaking’ and occasionally the VCU helicopter idling for extended periods. Reeks of stank stale pit smoke in the stairwells. Some trashy residents that seem to lack the energy to place trash in the dumpster but instead seem to fling their trash in the general direction of the dumpster.   Agree with previous post about turnover of managers.  The folks in the office are nice enough but not very responsive. Machines in gym frequently broken and covered in sweat stains. The place seems to be pretty poorly constructed and they are in the prossess of trying to remedy some of the problems that have existed since the original construction.  Finally, the first 2 reviews here are so glowing and general that I’m a bit skeptical about their authorship.

Katy and Sarah are the best! The apartments are spacious and beautifully designed. The complex itself is located in a perfect location, along with a very secure entry and exit system. The penthouse and gym are TO DIE FOR!

My daughter currently lives here for college. Sarah & Katie are very friendly and helpful. Things that need attention are quickly handled. And their communication with tenants is very good. The building is clean and cared for by Kevin & Vickie. We moved her there from Cedar Broad and the difference is night and day. There is always a long waitlist. But if you can wait, it's very worth it.

I just graduated but lived at the square for 3 years. I truly miss the exceptional service now that I’ve graduated. The office staff, especially Sarah and Katie, are always responsive and friendly, making it easy to feel at home. The amenities are consistently clean and well-maintained, and the secure access system gives me peace of mind.
The maintenance team—Kevin and Vickie—are fast, reliable, and always handle requests with a positive attitude. After three years of excellent service, The Square has truly felt like a community. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a well-run, safe, and clean place to live!

I’ve had the pleasure of living at the Square for 5 years and I can't say enough about how exceptional the apartment complex staff is. Sarah, Katie, Kevin, and Vickie gave me the feeling from moment I toured that they are committed to providing a comfortable and well-maintained environment for all residents. They are always friendly, approachable, and responsive—whether it's handling maintenance requests or answering questions, they are on top of everything with a positive attitude.
The property itself is always impeccably cared for. The property is consistently neat and well-kept, with attention to detail in both common areas and the grounds. The team also ensures that any maintenance issues are addressed quickly and efficiently, often going above and beyond to make sure everything is functioning smoothly.
It’s rare to see a staff that takes such pride in the upkeep of a community. Whether it’s through seasonal decorations, regular cleanings, or prompt repairs, it's clear they genuinely care about the living experience here. The sense of community given by this attentive staff makes it a pleasure to call this apartment complex home.
Everything is clean and smells good, the staff are very friendly, and the amenities are extremely convenient.
This is our third year at The Square and we continue to rave about the excellent service and support from the management and maintenance teams. They are the best, genuinely helpful and professional!
Great place to live… this is our second time around to live at the square. Our son stayed at the square the whole time he was in college and graduated and now our daughter…

The staff is fantastic! I cannot say enough about the professionalism and excellent customer service for this management team and support staff!  Absolutely the best!  Great communication and fantastic resident surprises!  We love it here!

The Square is by far the nicest place I've ever lived since moving out of my parents' house. The staff is incredibly nice and welcoming. Everyone has a positive attitude and says Hello. I'm living in a single apartment with a balcony looking down on W Grace St. I love sitting outside and drinking coffee in the morning.

I've lived here for two years and am very happy here.  As all the other reviews mention, the staff in the leasing office and maintenance are super sweet! The prices are pretty high but I would say worth it due to the really convenient location as a VCU student and all the amenities, especially the gym.  I would say parking is really expensive, it's cheaper to get a spot close by elsewhere.  The apartment itself is gorgeous, great views especially if you get one with a balcony!
The Square has everything you need and want (gym, clubhouse, laundry in unit, allows pets, ect). Along with that, the staff is SUPERB and always available to help.

I have lived at The Square for almost 4 years now. The only reason why I didn’t renew my lease for next year is because I’m moving out of state. The staff at The Square go above and beyond to make sure everything is perfect for you. Maintenance gets completed promptly. The views from the higher up apartments are fantastic (Full view of the sunrise if you face Shafer St!!!) and you can see an unreal view of the sunset from the roof. Everyone who works there truly is fantastic! Extra shoutout to Miss Vickie and Kevin- they always say hi to me when they see me and even ask how my cat is doing. 10/10, would recommend living here.
The staff is amazing! Mini gym and rooftop is what I love the most at The Square. Location is convenient - 2 min walk to the GRTC bus stop. Highly recommend!

The Square is much more like a home than I had expected out of an apartment complex. The office and maintenance staff are what really make The Square go above and beyond compared to other living options.

You will be hard pressed to fine staff that genuinely cares about their residents more than those at The Square.  By far the friendliest, most accommodating group of professionals I have ever had the pleasure of leasing from.
Treats their tenants with a lot of respect! Very caring and comfortable place to live!
Love living at the square. All the staff is amazing

This is the worst complex I’ve ever lived in. -Constant HVAC issues - My HVAC unit has consistently been broken for almost two years. Every few months it gets too unbearably hot or cold that I request maintenance look at it, but there is clearly a more centralized HVAC issue that’s never been properly dealt with. You don’t have control over your own apartment’s heat/ac setting, which is insane to me. 
-Bad plumbing - I’ve had numerous other plumbing and filter issues that are shoddily repaired or left worse off. Recently a plumbing issue was dealt with using a faulty shop vac that leaked all over my apartment. The smell is still there months later. My water pressure inexplicably went down months ago and no answer or solution was given. 
-Be careful which unit you choose too - I had no idea how noisy the nearby restaurants are in the early morning hours. Routinely woken up by delivery and/or garbage trucks between 2-4 AM. 
-They hire pest control, but I watch them spray one corner of my apartment and think that’s sufficient. I’ve had multiple ant and/or fly issues that I had to solve with my own money. 
-Parking is not secure. There are “badged” parking areas, but anyone could walk in and break into your car. My car was broken into in April 2024 with multiple stolen belongings. 
The mostly-public garage is filled with loiterers - mainly teenagers smoking and drinking. 
-Moving is incredibly inconvenient. You can’t fit a small moving van or truck under the garage’s short clearance. You’re left on your own to illegally stop on the road outside or try to move in/out from a parallel parking street spot with steady traffic & no loading zone. 
-Management sends awfully rude emails that are threatening & snarky in tone about pets, people who misuse the trash rooms or smoke in their apartments. I hate those violations too, but surely they have more professional methods to manage a community than send emails with caps and exclamation points telling people to simply follow the rules. 
-The gym seems nice and is usually empty or quiet. 
-I haven’t had many issues with packages. They have a package room with a “secure entrance” system, but it’s not actually secure so it’s more just luck that I haven’t had an issue.

I sound like a Karen but have never left a bad review online before. This community and its poor management deserve it & I’m looking forward to leaving when my lease is up. Don’t waste your money on high rent for such problematic apartments.

Ever since this property was sold (2022) nearly everything has changed for the worse, most notably the skyrocketing rent (because they can, with no percentage cap, btw no negotiating allowed, "it's our policy - we don't have a licensed broker on staff, that's why.")  What makes it worse is the  lack of organization by office staff in implementing lease renewals/changes, the ridiculous nightly evening noise level from motorcycles and muscle cars blaring window-shaking music while cruising the neighborhood, loud drunken patrons screaming at all hours, lack of cleanliness in common areas, police presence parked at the entrance to the neighborhood because things often get too rowdy between Dave & Busters and Mona Lounge, resulting in vandalism. The elevators are always in need of repair, there is a lack of ease and security of package pick up (system always broken, staff always blaming FEDEX, UPS and everyone else), and lastly, there is an unacceptable lack of friendliness, flexibility, honesty, responsiveness and competence of office staff, etc. 

If nighttime noise doesn't bother you, it is quite nice to be able to say, "Hey, I can walk to Whole Foods and Trader Joe's." Just beware, the cost is high. If you don't believe me, I suggest you ask any Henrico police officer. If you DO believe me, don't make my mistake. Always a good idea to do some due diligence and ask the local police for information on safety, noise and resident complaints before moving into any neighborhood. After having a conversation with one officer about the crazy amount of DUIs handed out here, I'm quite certain none of them would suggest The Flats as a quiet, charming place to live.

The leasing office was very attentive and responsive to any issues I had. Katya, in particular, was fantastic.  She does everything she can to help residents. I was very impressed with her. It’s a nice property that is in a great location. I had a very good experience overall.

I've never lived anywhere so convenient!  Modern, stylish apartments where i can walk to grocery stores, restaurants, barber shop, my favorite shops, gym and more!  It's also an easy 15 minute commute to downtown Richmond, and the staff is wonderfully helpful and attentive.

We downsized a few years ago, and only planned to stay at The Flats for a short while. We knew immediately we didn't want to leave! Beautiful, updated apartments, great amenities and perfect location. The leasing staff is amazing, always eager to help. The maintenance staff is professional, prompt and knowledgeable. Lots of activities, lovely neighbors!

Fantastic place to live! We were new to the area having relocated from another state.  Very diverse and friendly neighborhood. The staff is awesome, super friendly and host fabulous events for the residents!  We love living here because we can walk to the pool, gym, restaurants, plenty of shopping and retail all around.  The maintenance staff completes service orders quickly and they do it right.  Apartments have nice features, clean upon move in and they even have a service that cleans the lobby areas and hallways.  We plan to stay for awhile.  Don't waste your time leasing at another community, visit the office and take a tour.  You will be glad you did.  Truly the best in the area.

Short pump has the BEST schools and is the safest place to live in Richmond. This urban style community being shared with so much commercial space means you can just come home, park your car in the parking garage, and walk just a few blocks to anything you need. I highly recommend The Flats!

Management is absent most of the time and don’t really care about the people that live there as much as how much work they need to do.  There have been large dogs running loose in the halls so we asked them to post a leash policy on the door.  They didn’t, however, when somebody’s dog peed on the floor they immediately put a nasty gram up telling people not to let their dogs pee in the halls (because THEY have to clean that.)

They’ve also been sending people into our apartment fairly regularly.  Two this week, termite inspector Wednesday and fire department on Friday.  They tell you what time they are coming and there is no flexibility in if/when they come into your apartment, just hope you didn’t have plans that day because you don’t anymore...

Overall a pretty bad experience.  If the above wasn’t enough, the floor in our apartment has a huge lump in it, there is only one non-fire exit in our building and it’s a 10 minute walk when we take our dogs out but there is a fire door with a nasty gram directly next to us which is annoying.

I do NOT suggest this complex. They were so sweet and professional to get me hooked. And once I signed my lease that was it.  
I have sent countless emails with no responses. 
Called and called again just to be told to email.  Email again with no response. Go into the office- send us an email. I’m sure you see the trend. I’ve had to call more than 10 times (yes- during business hours) to have anyone answer. 
I asked for my packages not to be held (on at least 4 occasions) as my work hours don’t allow me to retrieve them. The response? “I’m pregnant- don’t think I’m about to walk it to your building!”
They’re not always open during posted hours. They have no issue leaving the office with no warning after you have made clear arrangements to drop things off to them. 
Office staff have no issue throwing each other under the bus to avoid them personally looking unreliable or bad in any way.

The property management team struggles to follow through, the property was poorly built with wall peeling and leaking windows.  My neighbors weren't noisy, but their pets seemed to have special privilege.  Privileges like using the restroom in the elevator and it not getting cleaned up until the next mid-morning. It use to be noisy, when Halligans Bar was in the area, even then the noise didn't bother me because that was expected and at time I participated. The convenience is perfect, which is the only reason for the price of rent. I move to a more expensive apartment, just because I didn't care for the property management team.

I would like to say thank you to Courtney for assisting me through my transition as I was preparing to move back to Georgia. She considered all of the plans and options that were available in case I would need to extend my lease. She was always friendly and maintained professionalism in everything she did. 

I enjoyed staying at the Flats and would come back if I ever returned to Richmond. The apartment was perfect for me with shopping and restaurant options at my doorsteps.

Very upset with your customer service and package delivery notifications and availability for package pick ups for your residents.  I live here in the flats. I called the office Tuesday night, 12/26 and left a voicemail asking for a call as well as an email for a package I was paying express and needed for the holiday weekend, being delivered Thursday. I had people on standby to pick it up as soon as I knew it had come in... as I work nights and cannot get there my self before 6. The package arrived Thursday before 6... and was delivered to the office as is procedure ,... NO ONE calledl, NO EMAIL with delivery notification either.  I retrieved the package from the office on Tuesday, way past the time I had needed them,  ...still no email....or call... or verbal acknowledgment of receiving my voicemail or my email .... I sent an email to their management, letting them know how upset I am about no one letting me know I had a package on Thursday. I needed those items for New Years Eve. I understand closing on Sunday and Monday for the New Years holiday, but think closing 4 days on a holiday weekend with lots of package deliveries and no way for their residents to get their packages for those 4 days...excessive! They should have at least had one person there on Friday for package pickups/deliveries since its the holidays and a busy time with package deliveries.   I have asked for the $25 back I paid for express delivery at least...No RESPONSE to this request yet..... This is an ongoing problem with package deliveries at this complex as the office has limited hours(nothing for later evenings and only a few hours on weekend. They also lock the office if they are out showing apartments during office hours... I have in the past also had a problem with no response from emails or voicemails...simply saying they never received them.... I am receiving their emails no problem and have had a response about 10% of the time, so we have the correct contact info on both ends...? Hoping they will do the right thing here to take care of their residents.
 Based on this experience and the lack of response and good management on the office side, I would recommend renting from the private townhouses in West Broad Village instead. (The community itself is very nice). They appear to have no authority or willingness to help you within the office. There appears to be no higher authority to appeal to either when there is an issue.

I'm in my 9th month and counting down till I can move. The noise below from the bar will keep you awake every weekend till 2:00am, the windows leak when a heavy rain comes through and the howling wind is so loud. The walls must be constructed well, but the floors are very thin as it sounds like the person above is going to come thru the ceiling. The only thing good about this place is the maintenance crew, they are top notch and come at a moments notice. It's convenient to a lot of places, but definitely not worth losing sleep from all the noise. Check where your unit will be before you sign anything.

The Flats at West Broad Village is a perfect living space for the individual or family that's looking for a vivacious place to live in the comfort and accessibility of Short Pump: a safe and commercial area within minutes of downtown Richmond. With a large shopping center and both Whole Foods and Trader Joe's nearby, this is an ideally convenient place to reside. Also, there are multiple restaurants and bars within walking distance; not to mention a gorgeous fitness center and pool for residents! There is noise at night, but it's to be expected if proximity to entertainment and nightlife is a priority. All of the benefits of the location and beauty of The Flats is what makes this place so above average, compared to other communities in the area.

live here Or nowhere else in all of the capital city! It takes your breath away for those who miss the shopping to the gourmet dining sound s you  all paneled doors , hugh  closet space a spectacular view and distinctively chicks an understatement. Please take the tour... The family will live the great food choices in walking distance! ACAC IS  a great  GYM, or listen to jazz at the Wine Loft ( great foot) this is living! 9' ceilings & the most modern appliance. Even on site storage space for residents.???????????? I luv it!  You will too. Oh there is gated parking for residents

I moved here and I don't know anyone, so this was a great community to meet people. It can get a little noisy since I live next to a bar but it's not that bad. The staff is friendly and the apartments are gorgeous though a little pricey.

as if everything was'nt already perfect, I just learned Duck Donuts will  be at my ground level!!! Also resident appreciation week  annually is wonderful.. Thanks to the staff. Also, I would like to thank  Mia & Chrissy for offering their assistance after my surgery.  Upscale, Chic, spectacular  are adjectives that come to mind. Not for everyone, only those who yearn for the Best! The attention to detail surpasses anything I've seen elsewhere. I hope they do a senior building I can afford when I retire in  5 years! This apt. Makes me feel like I'm living in a million dollar listing! Security. & gated parking are also comforting ammenities

4 years of the best! Office staff, maintenance , the community, the view, the amenities , the apt. size, security, & most of all the WOW look on my  guest faces?? I feel like I am in a NYC penthouse! I 'm  61 & this home is another world from the 3.3 miles I formerly resided in for 10 years!!! I have pics proving my delight!
So far I have absolutely loved living here! The leasing office has always been on top of any needs and maintenance is awesome! My cat loves the huge windows.
Kind team. Lacks in urgency for urgent maintenance requests. Many issues with maintenance. Cleanliness of complex and community safety are questionable.
Just moved in not even a week ago but i’m loving it so far. So far the staff is pretty nice, free parking hasn’t been too bad to get, and overall just a major upgrade from my last apartment!

This place is in a central location and within walking distance from VCU Medical Center. The gym is quiet and has free Wi-Fi. The preinstalled internet is definitely a convenience. However, all these advantages cannot make up for the poor construction quality and the least responsive management I have ever experienced thus far. 
Even before I moved in, management sent me the wrong floor plans. Moreover, the models are not exactly representative of the actual space as I painfully realized when I compared my planned furniture geography to the actuality of the floor plan. Loud music is the norm and none of the management seems willing to apply the community rules. Moreover, they are not responsive to any emails. I have personally sent them 5 emails over a period for one month without receiving a single response or any attempt to address my concerns. The quality of construction is questionable at best. Insulation is suboptimal despite being a relatively new construction and the a/c units are rather loud. The idea of placing the a/c and the boiler by the "living room" (in a real world probably the bedroom) is weird to say the least. Moreover, in my floorplan the person who designed the place made sure the a/c vent blows air right over my gas stove, making cooking and having the a/c on an adventure +/- fire hazard. The parking lot seems to hold a lot of water after every rain, being dangerously slippery and probably an injury lawyer's dream. 
In conclusion, I would recommend against this property, especially if you are a young professional who wants to relax at his or her apartment. I am personally seriously considering to move out of her as soon as possible. One can find many properties nearby where at least he or she will feel respected.

Honestly I wish I could put 0 stars. I’ve lived here for over 2 years and quickly realized how overpriced symbol is for what you receive. Living here you get everything from your car broken into (security cameras that “don’t work”), elevators that don’t work, stolen packages, leaking windows, and mold. The management has absolutely no clue what goes on because they don’t communicate with their maintenance staff. There are plenty newer nicer apartments in Scott’s, save your money and live elsewhere.

There were broken promises/agreements from the leasing office and management. It feels a little like working with a used car dealership when trying to agree on a lease.

Holes in apartment walls remain after three months of more broken promises from the maintenance side. They were never fixed when the unit was flipped.

Constant turnover in both leasing and maintenance is creating a lot of confusion and frustration among residents.

I’ve lived in the Current for the past 2 years, it’s a great location (right near the river & downtown Richmond) and a nice building. It’s very convenient, plus the facilities are new. The maintenance is fine, I personally haven’t had any problems. The few things I didn’t like so much was the parking is hard to find around the building (if your not paying for parking in the garage) and the Fire Alarms go off fairly often. It’s gone off at 2am three times in the past couple weeks, which is pretty annoying. Not sure why, idk if it’s a maintenance issue or what. But 6 times in the past 6 weeks is absurd. But other than that it’s a great place to live. I’ve enjoyed my stay here, but am ready to move.

Nice, new building that gives you the modern feel but with great prices! This was my first apartment by myself and the staff, especially Caitlin, made the process so easy and manageable for me. The affordability is surprising with the quality you get from the units.

I love living here. My apartment is nice. It gets a little loud at times, but honestly doesn’t bother me too much unless it’s super late at night. The management is great, especially Grace and Ethan. They are super friendly and know what they are doing.
Wow, was my first impression when I walked through the doors. The build is amazing and everyone was super helpful. There's a brewery and food hall just down stairs.

I am extremely disappointed by management. The day after I moved in my apartment it flooded from a 20 min  rain storm. damaged a tv, my clothes and important papers were damaged. Management was unwilling to move me while servpro fans were in my apartment for 5 days. They have not done anything to correct the problem which they were aware of before I moved in. I would not recommend this property to anyone due to management inability to properly resolve issues that they are aware of. I have Richmond Code Enforcement coming to inspect because I have no faith that management is going to correct the problem. This is by far the worst move in experience I have had in my entire life. I expressed my concern for mold and the flooding happening again and was not given any assurances that the issue would be fixed. Do not move here if peace of mind is what you are looking for. They will not correct any issues with the apartments.

Could not more strongly recommend AVOIDING the Summit. While the building is fine, and the people on site are nice enough, the parent company Gates Hudson is terrible. I lived at the summit from 5/2022-8/2023 and over the course was repeatedly overcharged. The accounting team was unresponsive and inattentive, and repeatedly butchered my financial ledger. Aside from the stress and frustration of attempting to contact the offices of gates Hudson (often to be ignored or told emptily “it’s being worked on”), this has caused me real life issues outside of my tenancy. I am now unable to get approved for future living situations because of gates Hudson’s financial negligence. Save yourself the legal fees, and live elsewhere.
Property is poorly maintained, high turnover for leasing staff, cheaply made apartment, bad smell and smears all over walls

The turnover in the leasing office is terrible. Within the 2 leases I have signed here, there have been 4 property managers. Most of the amenities are kept up and clean, but the dog run is awful. It is not maintained and the mulch is never replaced. Owners also do not pick up their dogs’ poop and trash is everywhere. During summer months at the pool, you have to race to the pool deck to get a lounge chair before they are all taken by noon. Others are left to use the other furniture or place their towels on the concrete. Lately, the halls have been smelling like old, rundown hotels because of how much smoke is in them. My guests used to comment on how nice the building smelled and now they always comment on the smoke. Overall, I think this property can improve a lot if management was consistent. The noise, cost of rent, and parking will likely deter me from renewing my lease. I think there are better living options with more community within Scott’s Addition.
No one here knows how to communicate in a timely manner. Up charged my rent by over $1000 with less than 30 days notice.

There is nothing luxury about living at the Summit in Scott’s Addition. If you rent a unit above the 3rd floor, the floors are paper thin (basically a sheet of plywood). You will hear your neighbors every step, music, and conversations. The summit management will not do anything to remedy this by requiring those individuals to put down rugs to absorb the sounds from the extremely cheap construction. Beware that end units with floor to ceiling windows have no insulation and will heat up to above 80 degrees on a sunny day even with the AC at 66 degrees and shades down. Dogs are a huge issue with this complex. Due to the extremely thin walls a dog barking will echo several floors up or down through your unit. The management of the summit will not do anything to remedy excessive dog barking; it’s apparently “hard to prove” even with recordings. Fixtures at the summit are extremely cheap (I had my bedroom roller shade fall from the ceiling on my head). If you are unfortunate to live above the 3rd floor, the tenants above you will cause your ceiling fan and light fixtures to shake just by walking; if they have a large dog that runs and plays this will be significantly worse. The building is extremely cheap - I would warn anyone who is looking to rent at the summit to look at other places. The $$$ rent is not worth the issues you will encounter by living here. If you value neighborly respect, quality and sleep do not live here!!

I love living here. The location makes it easy to access grocery stores, restaurants and my office in downtown. The amenities are better than other properties I toured in the area and kept very clean.

Smoking cigarettes is allowed in the units themselves, just not in the common areas. My neighbor smokes cigs in their apartment, it leaks into my apartment. The smell of cigarettes is overpowering and gets on my clothes. My whole apartment smells like an ash tray. The most management will do is ask the neighbors to smoke out their window then ignore your emails. The building inside and out smells like dog urine, especially around the elevators. Management let's it reek for weeks before trying to clean it up. There are so so many stains on the hallway carpet. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place

This apartment is okay but depends on who lives next to you.  My both neighbors were really loud and didn't have a small basic attitude. They played basketball in the house at 2 am and one couple kept fighting until early morning almost every day. The wall is very thin so you can hear everything even the phone ringing. One of the biggest reasons that I didn't renew this apartment was not soundproof. I usually can hear moaning in my bedroom 3-4 am. I couldn't hold out anymore.
Quiet and clean.  Maintenance is on their game. Nice place to live.

Honestly living here I regret completely 
The staff is terrible 
No one seems to really care about getting issues resolved that Tenants have 
Communication is horrible Among the Tenants concerning the Staff also in general the staff doesn’t not seem to Communicate well with each other
New management would make the world of a difference for Main2525
DO NOT WASTE YOU’RE TIME OR MONEY WITH THESE APARTMENTS!!
People are nice. Maintenance is fast! Building is very secure. Lived here for almost a year! No problem with anything at all.

I give this place a 5 star review, but not having Jenny in the front office made you guys lose one. She made Main 2525 very warm and full of positive energy. Even when I walked the stairs I see her working. It took me a few weeks to see people on my floor but I see her all over. You can tell things aren't as it used to be. A lot of things here and there is making me turn my head, BUT hopefully that energy if restored. Maybe putting some Christmas lights and etc would bring some good vibes to main2525.

My husband and I love it here! The maintenance crew, leasing ladies, and everyone is so friendly. The events they have monthly are something we both look forward too every month.
Love my unit! I love any community that offers a sense of security and The Jamestown does just that! Really a nice place to call your next home.
Great living space, the apartment itself is very nice and the amenities that come along with living here are also extremely nice especially compared to other apartments in Richmond.
The community and staff are nice. Great amenities and activities for the residents. The grounds are kept clean and the halls inside the building.

I have lived here for over 2 years and have thoroughly enjoyed my time. If I didn’t have to move for work, I would keep renewing. The apartments are nice and typically well kept. The staff is very kind and helpful. The best part is the community events that they offer that have free food and drinks and bring everyone together. It’s an awesome way for you to meet new people in your community as well as unwind a bit!

First a lot of the 5/5 star reviews you see here are because they ask residents to do it for a raffle to give out a gift card. This happens every year.
Pros: Next the Front Staff and Maintenance staff are 5/5 amazing. It is a bit of a shame that the person who sits are the front desk is leaving today but I feel strong that they will hire another solid person. The management do seem to take complaints seriously when it comes to noise issues, neighbor issues, etc. Work orders are usually completed in 24-48 hours unless entered on the weekend.
Cons: The building was built very cheaply and short cuts were taken. They do have a few residents who smoke weed and the smell over powers all the cleaning and spray machines they use to combat it. Some residents thought it would be a good idea to set up a bass system in an apartment building. Walls are a little thin. People will leave their trash out around noon so it sits there for 10 hours smelling up the hall ways. Other people will put it out on Friday and it stays there for 48 hours. This is one of the biggest issues. The shower will get moldy in your time here. They have a very big bathroom but a very small and weak vent as far away from the shower as possible, at least with my floor plan. They will let anyone park in handicap spaces so if you are handicap or have friends that are you will never get a spot. Overall the value of your money is a little hard to justify the place as they seem to put a 10-20% premium on the place.
The Average: Parking is never a problem but you might end up on the top floor parking. People will smoke weed in the parking garage a lot. The office workers will hit your car when leaving the parking building so tread very carefully. They have great security cameras on the outside of the building but none in the halls ways. So people can run up and down the halls ways, yell in the hall ways at all hours of the night and it is impossible to do anything about it but that doesn't happen to often and when it does it is usually on Friday/Saturday night. The amenities are very person specific and it would almost be impossible to be the type of person to use all of them, unless you need a study with, that has a dog, loves to work out and meditate, also are an activate swimmer, that is a coffee drinker that plays pool. Also, when we first moved in the pool table was really nice, however people have destroyed it and the sticks. Only about 1-2 sticks work now.
Tapestry West is a great place to reside. I moved in not too long and as yet have no regrets. I would recommend this facility to anyone looking for a place within the area.

We are not enjoying living at Tapestry at all. Honestly, we cannot wait until our lease is over and we just moved in. It is not worth the money. We had family over one day with children on a Sunday at 1pm in the afternoon and the neighbor below us started banging on their ceiling. It was quite interrogating and so inappropriate given we are very quiet people. A lady came up about 20 minutes AFTER they banged on their ceiling to ask us to be quiet. We had kids over for a couple of hours so it was a very rare occasion. It was ONE TIME, not like we were noisy every day. The whole situation was extremely uncalled for. The ceiling walls are very thin, we hear our upstairs neighbors walk around their house and it sounds like they walk with cement shoes but we would never bang on our ceiling to affect their peace of living. Hallways sometimes smell like marijuana and the day we moved in, the leasing consultant also smelled like marijuana. It has been a completely different experience from the day we toured, unfortunately we couldn’t go back as we already signed the lease. The pool hasn’t been open since we moved in, the coffee machine barely works and the shared parking lot with the building across the street is inconvenient M-F. Choosing to live at Tapestry is a decision we are regretting. I would never recommend it. I am not one to write reviews but I think it’s important to note when an experience is poor.
Great team here at Tapestry West. Understood that some issues arise beyond their control i.e. crack in the pool and pests. Keep up the good work!

Amenities are nice and the community is friendly. However the apartment I moved into is infested with fruit flies. The flies were here before I moved any of my belongings in but now that I have moved my belongings and food in, I am constantly swatting flies.

Moved here only because Belmont didn't have any openings. Not really as luxury as it claims to be. The hallways are depressing and the front desk staff are very condescending and snarky. Frequent elevator break downs too

This is net NOT gross, as I assumed. Mostly, all properties have this stipulation, but income is based on gross income NOT net income. I had multiple email  conversations with my licensing agent, and met her in person. Income was NEVER mentioned. I basically paid them $100 view my 3 pay stubs. They refused to refund my money. The $100 is for a credit and background check, neither one was done, again I paid a $100 for them to view my paystubs. However, it all worked out, found a larger apartment, 2 bedroom for the same price. I met their income requirements, as it was based on GROSS NOT NET, and I was told upfront as everyone should be as a curtesy.

She gave me a dirty apartment with problems. The experience of living in Miller and Rhoads has turned to be a nightmare . Dust and hair are everywhere .  Valerie did not care and said “ it is not a big deal you can live in” 
The question is can she live in a dirty apartment !? 
They changed the old carpet and fixed the AC and heat after I moved in. I had to change my movers until the carpet was changed  to bring my furniture . 
Also, most reviews in their website are 5 stars and praising the leasing office by names. They do not post any reviews under 5 stars. What a shame ! Unprofessional team. 
People ! Be carful before signing the lease with one of the ladies in the leasing office. You will waste your first week fixing and calling. They do not respect people time

It's been two months and we love living here !  It's actuall quiet at night, thick walls and the location can't be beat.  Close to theatres,restaurants and convention center.  Connected to the downtown Hilton but separate entrance gives you all the conveniences of the hotel with discounts included. Apt is very light with tall Windows and luxury appliances !  Onsite managers are very responsive too. Oh, love that the parking is underground with direct access to apartments with controlled access.

I wished somebody warned me what a disgusting, filthy place this was so I could run away. The management is full of lazy liars who are never in the office during hours. The leasing office is totally unresponsive to issues. They all act like the don’t even want to be there. Lots of times they aren’t. Maintience is too slow. Don’t even bother. This is a projects style apartment complex. They charge an absurd amount for what you get. The complex is trash. I haven’t had electricity in half my apartment for two years. I moved here back in April of this year. I thought I had me a nice remodeled apartment in a decent neighborhood. Although my apartment was remodeled it still had roaches. Mold in apartments, water leaks, bugs in units no help from maintenance. Can't wait till end of my lease best thing u can do is avoid this place don't make my mistake

Worst place I’ve ever lived at. Been here for a year and 2 months. To break the lease is outrageous! Rent goes up every month. WITH NO NOTICE!! The gym and pool are never open. If It is open, everything closes at 5. Normal people work til 5. Roach infested. Slow maintenance. Never fix anything.

Front desk will ignore your calls unless you call multiple times in row, car almost towed,  maintenance requests get ignored, front office will lie about specific dates and times that something will be repaired, have been shady with letting me see my past billing statements, cannot explain certain charges or their increases (on lease, not from utilities). This place has a serious rat/mice problem. Management is fairly new as well as the maintenance team. Poor customer service. Had a tour booked for this morning at 10 and nobody was even at the leasing office or had the decency to say no one would be there. Called multiple times with no answer & wasted gas coming all this way. Will NOT be returning.

They have been working on the “clubhouse” the last 5 months. The pool is gone and by looks of things it won’t be opened for Memorial Day. The workers only work the weekends and it’s loud! If you work Monday through Friday you won’t get any rest on the weekends.

I really enjoy the staff here. They are quick to respond to Maintenance calls and often are checking in around the complex and are super friendly.

The dryers do not dry in one cycle, sometimes takes 3 or 4 cycles to dry.  The air conditioning does not cool the upstairs due to sub standard duct work. The apartment building has major pest issues with both mice and roaches, and the temperature control is frustrating as it's managed by the building, making it uncomfortable during seasonal changes. 2000 Riverside has always presented first class service in the way they manage the building and answer promptly to any service request for maintenance.
Aside from the paper thin walls, I‘be enjoyed living here. The front desk has always been helpful and having everything you need in your building is amazing and so convenient.

Terrible place to live, management is not cooperative or helpful. I immediately started seeing roaches as soon as I moved in. You will regret moving here in 2024!!!!! Management is very unreliable. Unless you never have a reason to contact their management or rental office you may have a decent stay but if you need them for anything even to come change your filter haha good luck! Roaches and mice are starting to make their rounds in my neighbors units. All this has started when levco management took over. What a disastrous company to ruin an entire complex of decades. Shame

People will break into your car, your house etc. we had someone try to break in one night when I was alone with my toddler. My car has been broken into a few times since we’ve moved there. They will enter your apartment without notice, despite having a note on your account that they need to call first due to an alarm system and dog.  You can smell activities going on in other apartments.  There has been an increased in crime in the area.

"Noise complaint Issue" had someone complain about my kids. So I heard banging and filed a noise complaint of my own. They want to put me out next time lol what a joke. Been living here over 3 years. The lady who called knows someone personally in the office smh...she told me

My fiancé and I moved here in Jan. of 17.  Our first year was wonderful.  We decided to move into a bigger apartment with a roommate and that's when all the issues started. I visited this property on my quest for a move to be closer to family. The property was very nice and clean and the staff were all very kind and helpful with my questions and concerns.  Unfortunately, I was not able to make the move into the area, but I would have chosen this property had the move not fallen through.

Absolutely do not move here unless you want to gamble with black mold. When I first got here I thought it was wonderful and even referred a friend to move into the complex. After this I've found black mold in my bedroom and every time it rains there is a spot on our ceiling (in that same room) that must have a leak above it because there is always water damage. What an amazing community! The office staff and maintenance staff is top notch! I had the privilege of performing a secret shop on what seemed to be an extremely busy day. Laura was simply amazing and caring to my needs and took the time to introduce me to each member of the staff we came in contact with along our tour. The grounds were absolutely beautiful and well maintained. The model of their Dogwood was absolutely beautiful and well  decorated! Along our tour we came in contact with Eugene and Pierre, who Laura introduced as "members of our amazing maintenance team". In addition to the model, I was given a virtual tour of the Willowbrook and Lynhaven, the fitness center, the 24 hr business center and their beautiful resort style pool! The feeling I received warmed my heart - I witnessed two teenage boys ride their bikes up to us and thanked Laura for the fun night and asked when there would be another event. Laura told me about their National Night Out event earlier this week - the feeling I got from her was warm and I could tell she cares about her community and it's residents. If I truly needed a new home, I would not only choose Belmont Hills for its beautiful community but it's caring staff. When Laura spoke of the community it was "our community" - she wasn't treating me like just another tour or trying to sell me - she made me feel like I was already a part of this amazing community. It's hard to ignore the negative  reviews you see here but I will say this - Laura and the staff care about this community and it's residents...keep it up Belmont Hills - YOU ROCK and I will be sharing my thoughts with anyone I come across looking for a caring community to call home!
Serious safety concerns in the pool. Main office staff has no concern about the safety of their residence. Despite 2 letters and 2 face to face meetings problems are not resolved.

I love Belmont Hills! The staff members are extremely helpful and nice. I live in a two bedroom townhouse and love it! It is more spacious than our previous apartment and way more affordable! I also love all the great amenities and dog parks.

I have lived in my one bedroom apartment for almost a year and a half and it's been one of the worst experiences in my life.  The apartment itself is nice and rather cute, but the leasing staff and management is terrible. They seldom do anything to help me with my maintenance issues, stating that Maintenance won't come by at that certain time etc. etc.,  I had my car broken into and the leasing staff would do nothing about it, and I'm constantly being harassed by them for issues that are untrue. For instance, they left a note on my door saying I need to remove the grill from my balcony… I don't even own a grill.  Anytime I contact thenwith an issue that I need taken care of it they won't respond  but are quick to harass you if they think you were doing something wrong, which I never was.  Do  yourself a favor and don't live here.

On the first review, I was in the process of moving out of Belmont Hills and had submitted two check to cover my last month's rent. I log onto my account weeks later to find that only one check had been credited to our account. I knew we had turned in two checks so I call Belmont to figure out what happened to our other check. It took days for them to get back to us after leaving multiple messages with the leasing office and it wasn't until I wrote my first review that they had realized where the mistake occurred. They had credited our second check to the tenants moving into the apartment after us. Once they realized their mistake, they begged and pleaded that I take my original review down as it would impact their overall rating. I agreed to take it down seeing as mistakes happen and hoped this would be the last issue. The first instance happened about two to three weeks ago. Fast forward to today and we receive our final bill from Belmont that covers any damage fees upon having moved out. I notice on our statement that we had been charged for a carpet replacement fee of $586.00. We knew we had dropped things on the carpet and were fully aware of the charges. The problem with this however is not the charge itself but with the payment. We transferred to another Weinstein Property in order to be closer to my job and as a condition of the property transfer, we paid the carpet replacement fee in March before the transfer could be finalized. It is now June and this statement reflects that we have never paid that fee when in fact we did before the transfer could even be finalized. This is now the second time Belmont Hills has misplaced a check and I am fed up! I will not be taking down this review as people who are considering moving into this complex need to know that Belmont Hills will lose your money every chance they get! I understand mistakes happen but this is the second time in a span of a month our money has been lost by the leasing office. Do yourself a favor and steer clear of these apartments. If you want to live somewhere that will keep track of your money, then Belmont Hills is the last place you would want to reside.

I live on first floor of a garden apt. in Richmond Va the complex apt is Belmont Hills. in North Chesterfield Va. Very quiet , well kept lawns and very helpful office asst. Not far

Nice Community. Clean area, Easy access to downtown. Great Office & Maintenance Personnel. The unit is a bit small for the price but the new appliance upgrades makes up for it. Great Common Areas, well kept. Lot's of fun community activities and also a pet friendly community.

One bedroom apt remodeled about 2 years ago. Great location, very peaceful. You would really enjoy living here. I've lived here six years but this year I plan to move due to the high increase in rent each year. Your water bill is divided into # of units & trash is a set fee which non renters uses the bin and complex doesn't do anything to stop the usage from outsiders. Nice exercise room, club house, pool & grounds. Chesterfield Police is visible for safety. Nice paved parking spaces close to your home. Due to the rent increase, there is a high turnover of new neighbors. Just see the vacancy list.

The amenities and neighborhood are modern.  The neighborhood is quiet for the most part.  We have a garden apartment and so far, we have found many large spiders, several slugs, 4 bees (I have been stung once so far )and a handful of cockroaches in the apartment.  All of these insects except for the cockroaches were found  in the master bedroom.  The apartment itself is also very small.  The eating area has carpet in it, which is not ideal because we have small children who drop things, and it take a lot of work to clean these messes out of the carpet.  We pay close to $1100 a month for this apartment, which is a lot in this area and this part of town.  I really don't feel like we are getting our money's worth.

After six years in this community, I cannot in good conscience recommend it to anyone. Senior management changed last year (or sometime thereabouts) and severely compromised the professionalism and integrity of the local office. I became little more than a rent payment. I watched as tenancy changed and the Richmond Police became more present. I witnessed noise violations and policy breaches become unnoticed by the team there while petty grievances in fee collecting elevated to primary focus. Vehicle break-ins became the norm. Students throwing parties—during COVID 19—is actually a concern today. Every year rent escalations occur and have to be negotiated. After six years and living in two buildings, very little consideration was offered and the apartment I inhabited became priced well above the declining market. Luckily, I found other housing after losing some part-time work during the pandemic, but not without a pained exit with the staff. A lease at Creek’s Edge is just a lease for an apartment. It is certainly not a home. As a business owner myself, I’ve never left a negative review for public consumption. This place warrants exception. I must, however, give highest praise to Pernell and the maintenance team. Always efficient, always delivering exceptional response time, and ALWAYS going the extra mile, I am so grateful for his daily presence on the property. I was greeted every single day in those years with a cheerful disposition from him. I wish he & his facilities team the very best, and wish the general management shared his common sense and integrity.

A good property is all about a great location, superior management and excellent amenities. Creeks Edge has it all.  Two nearby parkways enable us to reach all points in Richmond easily.  We can't say enough about the office and maintenance staff.  They are eager to please and ready to help with any needs we may have.  The grounds are well kept and pleasing to the eye.  The owners keep on top of improvements and right now are adding a fire pit area for us to enjoy.
When we moved in we were pleasantly surprised to find the apartment was immaculate and looked brand new.  
We proudly tell everyone we meet how much we love living at 
Creek's Edge! It truly is our home!
