There's ample parking, great amenities and apartment features, and the price is great for what you're getting.
I moved here from across the country a year ago and have never found such a welcoming and friendly community. South Falls is an amazing way to live upscale and connect with good people!
The building is clean, the management is pretty organized, really good amenities, covered parking lot and awesome residents. I've been living here for a year with no complaints.
We moved to the US and this is our first place living here, we couldn’t have chosen one better.

Choosing to live at South Falls Tower has turned out to be an awesome decision. The amenities and overall aesthetics are one of a kind. Most importantly, it is safe, quiet, and perfectly suited for young professionals. Its convenient access to downtown and nearby outdoor activities for cycling, running, and more makes it a perfect gem. The views are spectacular, and the staff is one in a million, particularly Savannah. It has been a pleasure living here, to say the least.

South Falls Tower has been very welcoming, since the day I toured the apartment complex. They have a great management team. Emmett, specifically, has been really great with helping me during my move in process. Also, the neighbors are very friendly. So far, I am so happy I decided to move here.

As a Richmond native, seeing the changes that the city has gone through in the past decade, SFT is THE place to make home.
First, it’s quite literally ON the James River with a view from the pool deck that shows you the heart of the city that no other apartment or brewery can match. City life with the sounds of nature, chilling under the night sky by our fire pits. Short walk to Downtown RVA; short drive to Downtown Expressway, I-95/64. The Summer is best lived in SFT if not for the pool but for the nice walk along the Flood Wall that leads right to Brown’s Island/Belle Isle. For parking, there’s three floors including a basement for gate-access garage for residents and guests only. The garage is monitored and the spots are not reserved; EV charging available. Manchester is the happening spot now, but SFT is the home that offers a community through both its staff and residents.
I have made some of the best friendships of my neighbors that I’d be happy to have at my wedding one day. The kindness and generosity of meeting our neighbors has been nothing but positive. I have a lot of respect and trust in my community that I share my home with.
It is difficult to call my leasing agents, my leasing agents, as they have been as helpful as family. Moving in was a breeze from Jamie and her team that I don’t think I have ever had moving into an apartment go so smoothly. Any questions, concerns, comments, they are always there and willing to listen and take action. Savannah down in the office has worked miracles for me that brought me to tears at their resolutions. The maintenance gentlemen work diligently and will process your request within a day if not THE day. No task too small that they haven’t been able to tackle for me and my patrons.
I lived in a one bedroom apartment here for two years before moving into a two bedroom with my significant other. It’s bigger than most one bedrooms that I have stayed in and the layout makes a good amount of sense. Appliances are mostly energy efficient but work great (electric oven, microwave, fridge, dishwasher, in-unit washer and vent-less dryer). Color scheme for the walls are not offensive and ready for some of your character. Shower/tub combo offers great water pressure. 
Overall, I could not be happier with calling South Falls Tower my home. Like I said, the SFT team are amazing at what they do and I could not recommend them enough to help you make South Falls your home.

My boyfriend and I planned to move here while I was still pregnant with our son, and we only lasted ONE day. We toured an entirely different apartment, which was considered the “model.” In one day, we saw too many roaches to count and they were all through our boxes. When leaving out, we had to throw away most of our things and shake out all of our clothes. All management was worried about was getting the $ for rent, and said that if we didn’t pay they would change the locks and we wouldn’t be able to get our things from inside. When we left (a day later), we received no refund, even though we were told otherwise. All the apartment complex did was move the next family in. We demanded to see an exterminator whether we decided to move in or not because the conditions were literally inhabitable & saw no one. Please do not move into these apartments, I would give them zero stars if I could.

I would absolutely not live here anytime soon. There are these kids that blast their music throughout the entire complex from the parking lot for HOURS. We ask them to stop and they turn it up louder. The police have been called on them multiple times from all different residents, but because the noise ordinance policy doesn't start until 10pm, they do what they want. We've called Aston Ridge and they say they'll work on it, but they haven't done anything for months.

If you enjoy your time when you're at home, don't move here.


We have lived here for 3 years and it was fine the first year, but has gotten considerably worse.  This summer our AC was out for a whole month.  We were calling every few days and they gave us a different story each time.  I finally had to contact lawyers and together we called the property owners and they put me in a hotel and had it fixed that day. 

It's honestly a great location here. It's close to the mall and Richmond, but I promise you it's not worth the living in misery while you're here.

This could be a great place to live - off the main road but close to everything, spacious apartments, somewhat renovated (though the quick paint jobs were rather lousy jobs), but only if you consider yourself lucky.

- The walls are paper thin, so if you're unlucky, you'll end up with the noisy neighbors and forget any peace and quiet, because the office doesn't even bother enforcing their quiet hours (and even if they did, if your neighbor snores, you'll hear it as well as if they were sleeping in your room - and I'm half-deaf - imagine what happens when they scream at each other.).

- As mentioned above, the office doesn't enforce their own rules. They don't bother with the night hours, and pay the same attention to "no loitering": so if you're unlucky, your packages will be stolen from the doorstep. No soliciting? They don't care either, so you get to "enjoy" annoying ice cream trucks melodies all day long.

- Communication with the management office is poor. Their best method is leaving a piece of paper on your door handle and sneaking away... good luck reading it if it gets wet. If you call them, they will sound nice and promise to call you back... Well, don't hold your breath. You might as well call them again the next day. And again. And again. But maybe you'll be lucky and you won't have to call them for a week.

- Their portal has issues. Seemingly, a lot of them, because sending multiple statements, sending the water bill out on paper and only weeks later adding it to the portal is a common occurrence. And, by the way, the device you "activate" your account will likely be the only one you can access it from. Very 21st century indeed.

- Community events? "Come have some free food at the office" text an hour before the event starts, and it is just it: free food.

- There are some issues with USPS delivering mail as well - it's not on the office, but it'll affect your standard of living when you have to chase your mail down.

- Oh, and manage your expectations when it comes to the "upgraded fitness center" which is several machines in a closet-sized space, and the "modern clubhouse" is just a backroom of the office.

What's good? The maintenance team. Great communication, responsiveness, and I truly feel sorry for them to suffer the same lack of communication from the office. Space is nice too, and the apartment is bright, and if you complain of any bugs, you'll be put on pest control - so at least they'll taking care of something.

Quiet area, back off major road. Nice location to major shopping areas. Maintenance is great and friendly when they finally respond to request. When I moved in I was told there were events every week. When we have them they are few and in between and when we do have one we don’t get notified till the moment it’s happening, very last minute. If they’d happen more, think it would bring the community together. The pool and outdoor area is great except for the young kids and no residents that show up to swim, which makes it very unpleasant for the paying residents. There’s no one there to follow up on the rules posted. But for the most part good community, friendly people.

Quite area back off major road. Maintenance is great and always friendly when they finally respond to request. When I signed my lease they talked about events every week but they are few and in between and when they do happen we get a text at the time it’s happening. Very short notice! Think by doing more events and things in the community it could bring the area together more. The pool gets a lot of nonresidents and young people and makes it less enjoyable as a paying resident. No one cares about the rules posted. But for the most part, happy w the area and apartment.

Have had so many issues since living here before and after change in management.  There have been so many different people working in the office , maintenance and management since change in ownership.  Also have dealt with the police concerning neighbors more here than ever have in my whole life.  Lack of communication with tenants and maintenance.  The nice amenities they have are not very family friendly and overrun by teenagers and unsupervised children.  Thanks Choose living here wisely.

I saw all the bad reviews and thought “how bad can it be”. The answer is BAD! I had a place on the top floor of the building. The AC units are so loud that it would often keep me from sleeping. Sometimes the noises would be so ear splitting I would have to leave. On two occasions the AC units were shaking so badly we had cups fall and break. The maintenance team couldn’t do anything about it. They only suggested I pay to have the ceiling insulated. That brings me to my next point. No real ceiling, so lots of roof noise and LEAKS! The entire time we were there we had different roof leaks, on my couch, carpet, bed, and kitchen. It just kept happening, and it took them almost three months to actually deal with any of them. It got to the point where I had actually slipped when there was a 3 by 4 puddle going across my hallway. It also caused our floor boards and baseboards to rot. The air handle wasn’t installed properly, so every once in a while our apartment would have a back up of sewer gas. So imagine that smell. I originally thought it was a gas line backup and when I voiced that concern I was very rudely told there was no gas to our building. My toilet leaked for two weeks and when I asked if I could be compensated for my extra water (mind you the bill was almost 20 dollars more - it was a LARGE leak) they refused. Also they showed up at my door at 7:30 am and just came into my bedroom WHILE I WAS SLEEPING. Pool was nasty, gym was almost totally broken, and legit blood, poop, and pee constantly found in elevators. Internet wouldn’t reach bedrooms bc it was so weak. Hated every second of it. Both my roommate and I left almost two month early because of how terrible this place was. Water pressure was also terrible and the water tasted terrible. Please do not live here!

Southern Stove Lofts advertises "free" wifi, but requires you to buy a router for around $100 to access it, and then when you do, the connection is so slow you are basically forced to pay more and upgrade.

The building is cold and filthy, I already had maintenance issues upon moving in. The fan makes LOUD creaking noises when you turn it on (it also takes over 60 seconds to start) and I was told they couldn't fix this, so I essentially cannot use it.

Additionally, the noise pollution in this entire place is terrible. You can vividly hear the trains, neighbors, dogs, people talking, water going thru pipes, et cetera. It is virtually impossible to get a moment's peace here.

Southern Stove Lofts are convenient to yummy places to eat, WholeFoods, Starbucks  and Lee’s Fried Chicken and public transportation! I moved here about three months ago from out of state and the staff including maintenance ( very responsive to maintenance requests) are friendly and professional. Florence, Rebekah and Noah are amazing! Thanks for the warm welcome to Richmond!
I have only just moved in but every step in the process but poorly managed and communicated.  The people who work here might as well be 3rd graders with the amount of assistance they can give you.

Do NOT move into this building if you use the internet. Southern Stove Lofts does not deserve a single tenant while AmTech is the ISP in the building. I read the reviews and said it can't be that bad, but I implore you to trust that it is indeed that bad. Bottom line: AmTech is the ISP in this building, they aren't a real ISP, they're a shell that contracts out everything to the lowest bidder. Look them up before you sign anything and read the reviews.  You will not have reliable internet while you live here. Don't let them tell you it's a router issue, it's not a you issue, Amtech provides horrible service with zero accountability from the apartment complex. These are two separate issues, AmTech provides horrible service and no support while Southern Stove Lofts will not hold them accountable for that horrible service. Working from home during the pandemic has been a nightmare with weekly outages. If your internet goes down, you can only call support between 8AM-5PM, and when they say it will be 24 hours before you hear back, they mean it. Our internet went hard down and we were told someone couldn't look at it for SIX days.

Southern Stove Lofts will say it is out of their hands, that is just because AmTech is the cheap option they can advertise included internet with while maintaining profit, all without holding themselves or AmTech accountable in any way for any of the infinite issues you will have.

tldr: Southern Stove Lofts doesn't deserve you as long as they disrespect their tenants with this internet provider.

I can't rate them zero stars, so I have to put one star but that's giving them too much credit.

Since day one of subleasing from this company I had a terrible vibe from them. I ended up signing a year lease once my sublease contract was ending and I had just moved in the month before. I never received a new written copy of the lease which I found very odd. A month or so later, after asking twice via phone and email and being told "we'll have it right to you", I went in person and wouldn't you know it, they didn't even have an updated lease for me on file and I had already been there for 2 months on my own lease.  Very odd and off-putting since i'm giving these people a lot of money each month.

Next, since I was subleasing for a month I ended up just venmoing the previous tenant money until I went on my own lease the following month. Wellllll even up to 4 months after I was for my own lease, they STILL had the previous tenant on the water bill. You got that right, I had been on my own lease for 4 months and they STILL never changed it until I refused to leave their office until I had proof it had been changed. Don't worry, I had went in every month before that to let them know to change the bill to my name and they clearly could never get it correct. Again, very disheartening.

Oh did I mention we didn't have water in the building on multiple occasions for days at a time. Don't worry, they gave us all 3 gallons of water just in case we needed to use the bathroom and drink anything.

Oh yeah, don't you dare ask them about fixing the call boxes! How dare anyone ask them to fix something that is broken on their property which they offer as an amenity. And don't let them fool you, the screens light up but they don't work.

Don't even get me started on the elevators. The buttons on the second floor (which is to the back of the building and has the largest parking area) stopped working at the end of February and they weren't fixed until I moved out at the end of May. Poor guy that lives in the building who has to walk with crutches always struggled. Makes me sick to think about still.

From one decent person to another, I do not recommend renting from this company at Southern Stove Lofts or any of their other properties.

Some of the issues my roommate and I had during our 1 year lease at Southern Stove...
- we were without RUNNING WATER for at least 2 days straight, twice!!!
- if you have any issues besides an HVAC issue, it takes forever to get resolved. For example, my bathroom light burned out and there was no way to get the cover off (keep in mind there are no windows or natural light in the bathroom) and it took almost 3 weeks for them to fix
 - the walls are paper thin, you can literally hear everything everyone above, below and beside you are saying
- the lights in the apartment provide as much light as a child's bedside night-light

Now, upon move-out, we were charged $900 worth of move-out charges; mainly due to "door damage," which led them to need to refinish 4 or 5 doors. TAKE DETAILED PICTURES OF EVERY DAMAGED INCH OF APARTMENT UPON MOVE-IN. After asking about the charges multiple times, I received pictures of the damages a month after moving out and all of the damages were there when we moved in. 

Bottom line, you can find a much nicer apartment for the same price elsewhere. Please don't give this place your money.

Overpriced, Horrible Management.

So many problems where do I start? There is a literal motorcycle parked in the hallway across from my door. Was told I could make copies of my keys when I moved in, tried four different places and none worked. When I finally confronted management, they told me that we are not able to copy keys. A lot of classic bait and switch, when I  moved in they told me one thing, come to find out that reality is the exact opposite. They do not maintain the property well. Hot tub has never worked, the gym is full of broken-down equipment, etc. They have been saying they are under renovation for two years now. Smells like weed all of the time. Can hear each neighbor... LOUDLY. ZERO water pressure. No sense of community. My girlfriend has an old, non-violent felony on her record and after taking her money when she applied as a tenant -- NOT LEASEHOLDER -- on MY lease, was rejected which is INTERESTING since we personally know at least 8 leaseholders in the building who have multiple felonies.

The physical apartments themselves are really nice, in great shape and are a decent price, but you have to be willing to put up with management that has no idea what they are doing and are completely unorganized and maintenance that take forever and doesn't do a great job. I have lived in this complex for three years, and have seen about 20 new employees come through. The team changes so quickly once you find someone who actually is decent at the job and listens to your requests they are gone the next week. They are constantly "losing" information, and if you call into the office with a simple question, EVERY TIME they never have the answer and have to "call back" to let you know. I say this with quotations because they NEVER call back. On top of this, we have had maintenance steal from our apartment but had no proof so the office did nothing. We had them come in to fix our bath and they ended up flooding the whole apartment and doing damage to our carpet because they didn't fix something the right way. They have no idea what they are doing, are likely paid extremely poorly as well so they don't even care about doing a good job or working quickly. Basically anything but an AC issue takes about a month to get resolved, and they refuse to give you a discount on it because it isn't that important. They have no concern about keeping their good residents around, and let serious dirtbags move into the building. 

You end up feeling like a jerk after how often you complain, but you are complaining about such basic things you should be getting for what you are paying that it all just ends up being extremely ridiculous. 

Overall I WOULD NOT MOVE HERE if I were you. Until this apartment can even hold a consistent management staff for longer than a month, I wouldn't waste your time and money. If you do decide that you want to give it a shot, you better hope there isn't anything that you need fixed, otherwise you'll be waiting around for maintenance who will probably never show up....

Giving this community 1 star is being generous. The staff puts on a smile when you walk in, but behind those smiles is nothing. The apartments look nice but were so cheaply made its laughable. 0 insulation in the apartments so expect very high electric bills. They advertise high speed Internet and cable included, well its a higher speed than when dial up first came out, but dont expect much more. And the cable, well if you want more than 3 channels that you can sometimes see clearly, budget to upgrade to satellite tv (your only option). The hallways always smell like pot, and when I complained about this to the office their response was always "well theres not much we can do." Like other reviews said, the noise is absurd between apartments. I lived here for two years and was woken up to late night activities of my neighbors more than I care to (good for them for getting some?). Our upstairs neighbors were rude and loud and the final straw for us. Loud at all hours of the night and the office couldnt care less, they were getting their rent!. When we first moved in the grounds were always well kept and clean, that ended about a year ago. The "secured" parking, was a gate that broke so often they just gave up on. Several cars were broken into in the parking lot, which of course no resident would know about since management was not helpful (noticing a trend?) and the only reason I knew about it was from seeing the police outside when I left to go to work. While on the topic of the parking lot, hope you are ready for dings and scratches! The spots are so small, you cant park in most of them and expect to be able to open your doors without hitting another car. Bottom line, get away. Don't be fooled by the nice pictures (that are years old). Don't let the fake reviews on here and other sites trick you. They no longer have a spot to share reviews on facebook (wonder why?). There are far better places to spend your money in the neighborhood. Once Whole Foods is in and other apartments come to the area, Southern Stove will need to make some big changes, but my guess is the management couldnt care less about that, since they will all be long gone by then! The ONLY positive thing I can say about this community is that they didnt raise our rent after year one (only reason we stayed) and after our 2nd year we could have stayed for $25 more a month. Not worth it.

SS has a unique urban style with brick walls and high ceilings. Every apartment layout is different so it's hard to get an idea of what you are getting unless you are able to see your actual apartment. The appliances work well, maintenance is nice and respond pretty quickly depending on the time of day, and leasing staff are nice. The walls are EXTREMELY thin - I could hear full conversations and even phones vibrating.  Nice location close to VCU, The Diamond, Hardywood and others places. Great for students and first apartments but not so much for long term, hearing the lives of others and smelling marijuana every night gets old. It's been a great experience living here, but its time to move on!

The building itself is nice, and the apartments are decent to look at (less so to live in). Here are some key points:
1. Washer and dryer are good enough. Nothing fancy, but not awful.
2. Most floorplans are decent, although some are very oddly laid out.
3. Appliances work alright most of the time but are slowly getting worse. When (not if) one or more appliances stop working, maintenance will bandaid them, and the problem will come back. They are not willing to replace anything, even if it means they are here every week fixing the same problem. 
4. One of my two bathrooms has a trickle of water pressure and both are poorly lit and have tiny sinks.
5. The lighting in every area except the kitchen is awful (one bedroom has a tiny sconce, the other bedroom and the living have no installed fixtures at all.
6. "High speed internet" and "cable" are a sham. 
7. Some units have great windows, and just as many have poor windows and little to no natural light.
8. The building was renovated in 2007-08, and the age is starting to show. Unless some major changes are made in the next year or so, these apartments shouldn't be sold as "luxury."
9. There are much better choices in the area, in the same price range, and I should've not picked a place so quickly. Lesson learned. 

And for some in-depth details:
The included "internet and cable" is a joke, and you are lucky to load a webpage on a Friday night when everyone is trying to stream Netflix. This is when using my own, brand new router plugged into a cat 5 jack in my unit. The "community wifi" is completely nonfunctional, regardless of time of day. If you rely on the internet for work at all, stay away. If you hope to stream full HD (or 4K), stay away. 2-3mbps down may have been alright when the building first opened, but in 2016 it's horrendous. Note: That speed is during down-times; during peak hours you can expect less than 1mbps. I've spoken with the management about this, and there are no plans to change or upgrade the internet any time soon. There is no alternative for the internet because the building management won't work with Comcast to provide services, despite being told before signing my lease that I was able to get Comcast. 

As far as the cable, when I plugged my tv into the coax (as directed), I got 2 channels; both were fuzzy and inaudible. You can "upgrade" your Directv package, but you pay full price - the tier included in your rent cannot be applied to your own Directv package.
the apartments are spacious , but they have no actual windows. Only airflow is through the air conditioning and heating vents . More of a natural feel to them .

I love loft style apartments so I have been searching for awhile, and I must say that I absolutely love this apartment complex. The layout is beautiful, and the exposed brick and beams are stunning. I would love to live in an apartment like this. The pool caught my eye too! Everything looks historic, unique, and homey all in one. Great pictures!

Half the building is infested with roaches. If you manage to avoid that, you're still likely to deal with unreliable facilities (it took them three weeks to repair my neighbor's HVAC when it broke in the middle of the summer).

Every year, the entire building is subjected to a week or so of the fire alarm going off at random, all times of day and night. This happens EVERY year. Clearly there is a fault in the system - but like everything else here, they either can't be bothered to fix it or are too inept.

Packages are often stolen and management has done nothing to fix it. They purchased package lockers 18 months ago and STILL have not set them up. They refuse to review surveillance footage to find the culprits. 

At least one elevator is usually out of service. The "secure" parking garage gate stood open for two months earlier this year.

I have discovered multiple doors around the building this summer that do not have functioning FOB locks. They simply swing open to let anyone walk into the building. It is a severe safety concern.

And someone (or their dog) throws up in the elevator at least once a month.

Yes the floor plans are unique, the views/location are good. But you're literally in an 800 sq ft hellscape in the midst of that.
Management has basically stopped answering phone calls, emails go unanswered, disgusting roach problem, rampant package theft, I could go on

Maintenance refuses to do anything, including emergency off-hours. Currently I have been waiting for over 3 hours locked out due to their key fob system without any call. The answering service is not able to contact anyone.

This is by far and away the WORST place I have ever lived. Management is not only inept, but they simply don't care about their residents. If something breaks, you have about a 50% chance that maintenance will even show up after you put in a request. When they do show up, they charge you for fixing everything. The building is rarely cleaned, the elevator doesn't go up to the gym anymore (so it's not handicap accessible), there is broken glass surrounding all the trash dumpsters, the dog waste disposal can outside is rarely changed and always overflowing. To make matters worse, multiple apartments have rodents, there is a cockroach infestation of the first floor during warmer months, and there is mold in the storage units in the garage/basement level. This winter the electricity bills have gone up 2-4x normal for a FEW DOZEN RESIDENTS. Dominion energy says the increases are too great to be accounted for by slightly colder temperatures this year, and said the HVAC units are the culprit. Is management willing to get to the bottom of the issue and help their residents? Of course not. They don't care. PLEASE LISTEN TO ME WHEN I SAY DO NOT MOVE TO THIS BUILDING. I CANNOT WAIT TO LEAVE.

How is this place rated 5 stars on here when the majority of reviews are two stars and below? 

First the positive..... the building. That’s it. 
Now onto the negatives..... Management. Either they don’t care or are ham-stringed by a building owner doesn’t care and it shows by 30+ apartment vacancies at the time of this review.    The parking spaces are narrow and there aren’t enough of them. The internet is 5MBps which means you can’t stream. Sure you can upgrade for $60/month but Amtech can’t guarantee speed. The hallways and stairways are never cleaned. The lobby area is the only part of the building that  is cleaned....once a week. There is trash everywhere. I think they stopped landscaping other than  cutting the grass. Light bulbs in the hallways aren’t replaced for weeks on end. Don’t even bother calling maintenance. It’s cheaper and less expensive to fix it yourself.  Don’t rent an apartment that faces River City Roll. You won’t be able to sleep until 1am when the music stops.  

I’ve lived in numerous apartment buildings within  Richmond and this building has the worst management company out of all of them

My wife and I lived in the Cookie Factory Lofts for 2 and half years. I strongly warn against living here. The building and apartments physically have problems, and the management team is as bad as it gets. 
Physical Problems: 
1. Parking: The parking lot is cramped. 
2. Package Delivery:  if you work a typical 9-5, you only have a potential 4 hour window per week when you can retrieve a package.
3. Multiple leaks reported. Faulty intercom at the front door. Disgusting pool. Machines in the fitness center break down and are never fixed. Pieces of the floor (old original floor) constantly break off and old nails stick up through it. Almost impossible to heat your apartment during the winter (at least on the top floor). 
4. Internet/Cable. The internet averages a 4.8MB/S Download speed and a 1.6 MB/S Upload speed. (This is about 10% of the speed of Verizon Fios or At&T Uverse). 
Management: 
In general, I have to say my interactions with the management team at CFL were the worst customer service experiences of my life. They will continually make excuses for their own errors and show absolutely no concern for residents.
They will knowingly  inconvenience you when an obvious simply solution is staring them in the face. 
Finally, after more than 45 days after my lease ending, I have yet to have my security deposit returned. (They have 45 days to return it). After just recently calling them, I can't say I was shocked when they rattled off more excuses for their own incompetence. Nothing close to an apology. 
I wouldn't move here unless you're desperate.

While the building and "ammenities" are enticing to an outsider, it is all smoke and mirrors. Below is a list of problems I have encounter during my time at CFL:

- Leaks! Leaks in the apartment, the hallways, and the stair wells
- tiny parking spaces (if you can find a spot)
- management who play the innocent or dumbfounded card whenever a problem is reported and goes unfixed 
- their pool continuously has all sorts of mold growing on the walls, floor and steps of the pool. They claim that it is cleaned regularly but this clearly couldn't be possible. Last summer I spoke with one of the pool maintain even personally, who told me that he had detected 5, FIVE!!!, different types of mold in the pool.
- don't be shocked to see homeless people in and around the cars, pool, common areas, not to mention 2am gun fire that rings out on the occasional Saturday night 
- the fire alarms go off at all hours of the day
- several first floor break ins through the window were reported in the past 2 years that I have lived there  
- the walls are thick (which is great for sound proofing your neighbors), however you better be ready to pay at least $80 in electricity in a single bedroom unit of you want your apartment warm in the winter, and mildly comfortable (not cool...) in the summer. The insulation is laughable 


In all - yes it's nice they have a pool, but so do a ton of other apartments in the area. Save your money and sanity and look somewhere else! You'll take me later!

I would caution anyone considering moving to the Cookie Factory Lofts to reconsider or at least speak to a current resident. I lived there for 2 years and can honestly say it was the worst apartment complex I have ever dealt with in 8 years of renting.

During the first year, I lived in a 1 BR on the 1st floor. There were numerous red flags that I should have taken note of, but sadly did not. Early on, they were multiple times when I found homeless people sleeping/living in common areas of the building. I reported it to management, but they said there wasn't much they could do but they would look into it. This is a pretty big safety issue in my mind, but they didn't seem to care. The cable and internet are included in the rent, but the internet was so slow you couldn't even stream videos and the cable went out constantly. My apartment was often filled with a foul odor that maintenance claimed was caused by something in the ventilation system. It happened multiple times even though each time they said it was fixed. The pool was always filled with algae and mold. 

In the 2nd year, when I went to get my keys they had no record of me moving in that day.  I had to wait another week before I could move into the new apartment. On the day I moved, there was a large puddle in the middle of the main bedroom floor. I knew the previous residents of the apartment and they said that they had dealt with leaks, so this was a known issue for CFL. The management team lied to me and claimed they had no knowledge of leaks in the apartment even though I had proof. Over the year I lived in that unit, there were 10 substantial leaks from that exact same spot. Cookie Factory did absolutely nothing to help me or compensate me for these leaks. Each time it leaked, I would complain and they would state that they fixed it, but the next time it rained it would leak again. I found out that Cookie Factory was in a dispute with the roofing contractor, so residents suffered while they dealt with the contractor and refused to actually fix the roof. Maintenance actually put tarps on the roof to try to stop the leaks. After a year of dealing with the constant leaks, I was able to finally get 4 days’ worth of rent refunded. In their minds, they did nothing wrong and didn’t owe me anything. 

I cannot stress enough how much I would caution anyone from renting from the Cookie Factory Lofts. They are deceitful and they truly do not care about their residents at all.

After living here for two years, management seems to be getting worse and worse. The apartments themselves are beautiful, along with the building and the pool. But the management, maintenance department, package system and parking leave a lot to be desired. Management seems to help with as little as possible and is very hands off. Leasing office hours are 9-5 so if you work a standard job it is hard to pick up packages and they offer no kind of assistance depending on your schedule. They don't even email if your receive a package so good luck with those surprise ones! Also, we have had packages just walk off with other tenants (leasing office employees never check to see if the package you walk out with is actually yours so anyone could walk in and take it). When packages went missing the leasing office took zero responsibility for the issue. The appliances in the apartments are cheap and often have issues, there is no online maintenance request portal so your only option is to email someone in the leasing office and hope they respond. Parking is alright, but the spaces are tiny so you will inevitably end up with scratches all over the side of your car. If you get home late the lot is sometimes full, parking on the street will result in a ticket or being towed. They rely heavily on the physical appearance of the place but do not put adequate effort into the small things that really make an apartment complex livable.

The apartments are beautiful if not expensive for the area. We have lived here for two years. The only reason we haven't moved is because we are lazy.

Parking is atrocious. There aren't enough surface spots and the spaces are too narrow. Your vehicle will get dinged and scratched. There's an empty underground parking lot that management demands $75 monthly for.

Things break too often and don't get fixed. These units are less than 3 years old but ovens, microwaves , and dishwashers are already breaking. Trying to get anything fixed takes and act of Congress. There is no automated work order system and no one ever answers the phone. 

The fire alarms malfunction constantly. Expect to be woken up in the middle of the night.

The walls are actually fairly soundproof. No complaints about noise.

You have to be a psychic to determine if you have a package delivered. Was it dropped at the front desk? Did they leave It at your door? Did someone steal it? Who knows, the policy isn't consistent and the front office refuses to send you a courtesy note. Just don't ever order anything perishable or time sensitive.

The pool will be closed at various points through the summer because they refuse to spend money on actually maintaining the one nice thing we have.

The gym could be nice. If they fixed the treadmill that has been broken for 1.5 years. Or if they soundproofed the floor so you could actually do physical activities.

There is no sense of community. Other apartment complexes have community events, happy hours, bar crawls, etc. Not here. The only time you'll meet your neighbors is when the fire alarms malfunction in the middle of the night.

Go look at other apartments in the area.
A high quality restoration of a beautiful historic property.  Close to Carytown.  Secured building and parking!

Pros:
Building is very clean and modern. Very well decorated general interior areas. 
Cons: 
-Parking is world war 3. You will have to pay extra for below deck parking.
-Cable and Internet is useless. My cable never worked. And download and upload speeds under 5mps. Yes 5!!!
-No option to get your own cable and internet. 
-Price is somewhat on the high end.

This apartment is a great place to live. It has a nice pool and a great community room. The building is well maintained and they frequently drop cookies off at my door. They also schedule parties from time to time. I love this place.

apartmentName: The Corner Lofts - 1321 E. Main St.
review:
While the units are decent, management is impossible to get a hold of. The only time you'll hear from them is if you owe them money or they want to come in your unit. Otherwise the office assistant will just keep transferring you to the manager (who at this point I'm convinced is not a person, just an outgoing voicemail box).  In my first 2 weeks living here, I had 2 packages stolen from the "mailroom" and have since not had anything delivered to me here. 
No one cleans up after their animals, and the cleaning crew comes MAYBE once a month, so the entryway constantly smells of different animal accidents and the parking lot is littered with trash and waste. If this is what utilities included looks like I'd happily pay them for some actual management. Do yourself a favor and save a year of your life.

I lived in Georgetown apartments for 6 years, and it was a wonderful experience. The leasing office folks, Leslie and Kristie, are two of the best people I’ve ever had the pleasure of living under. Always quick to help with any issues! For example, the tree on my patio had died, and they promptly had someone come remove it. 

Maintenance is always trustworthy and quick, usually responding the next business day. The off-street parking is a plus, and the renovated apartments are ??

The only down side I found is there’s no in unit washer dryer, though you can rent some from the office. Unfortunately they have to hook up in the kitchen, to access the sink. There are on site facilities, and they’re okay, but the prices were  slowly rising to the point where it was 10$ for me to do two loads of laundry. 

Otherwise the community is safe and quiet, and close to everything. The patio is a wonderful privilege that you won’t find anywhere else in the fan. Truly I think this place is one of the hidden gems of Richmond rentals. Overall an A+ experience, highly recommend.

I love Georgetown Apartments. They are reasonably priced, close enough to everywhere I want to drive/walk while still being quiet, and well-kept. The office is very nice, and all my maintenance needs were taken care of within 24 hours. Very dog friendly - they just added a dog park this past year next to the Kent Road apartments. Never had a problem with noisy or unfriendly neighbors. Ample parking.

Townhome like setting with a patio that has a privacy fence and lots of space for plants, grill, and whatever else you need to relax. Central air, 24 hr maintenance, reserved parking for you and the grounds are well kept and beautiful...the office is great and always ready to help with whatever you may need. Safe area that is close to interstate no matter the direction you have to go...very close to VCU and downtown Richmond.

I strongly urge anyone considering moving to this place to think twice. My experience has been nothing short of a nightmare. The living conditions are extremely unsafe, and the place is infested with bed bugs. Despite numerous complaints, management has been utterly unresponsive and negligent in addressing these serious issues.

The bed bug infestation is rampant and makes living here unbearable. I've had sleepless nights and itchy, painful bites that have left me feeling constantly uncomfortable and anxious. The management's lack of promptness and concern for residents' safety is appalling. They have shown no urgency in handling the situation, leaving us to suffer without any support or effective solutions.

This place has left me feeling heartbroken and powerless. I deeply regret my decision to move here and wouldn't wish this experience on anyone. If you value your health and peace of mind, please do not move here. It's not worth the risk. I'm desperately seeking help and hoping for a resolution, but in the meantime, consider this a warning to stay away from this horrendous place!!!!!
The apartments have bugs that they cannot get rid off. Ive ask for a 6 months lease so I can move haven't heard a world. I moved here from Indianapolis and not to come to this
Leasing Manager is very friendly and willing to work with you. Very quiet neighborhood, secluded. Features quiet time from 7am-7pm. I will be renewing my lease.
Worst place to live I would not recommend my worst enemy to live here.

This this apartment complex actively avoids handling issues. They neglected to provide internet for 5 weeks with little to no communication and no compensation for the outage. During the course of my lease (1.5 years) I had over eight unannounced entries into my apartment that went unexplained and unacknowledged. There is still not active ADT monitoring no matter how often I contacted the office or the ADT contact point they provided me. Likely because they do not pay for it despite the alarm infrastructure being there. When challenged on the lease violations, they basically told me to just move and offered $25. Talk about a multi-million dollar company not caring at all for its low income tenants. Break lease as soon as you can! Even better, don't sign to begin with.

Maintenance isn't bad, they respond pretty quickly. However, their solution to mold in the bathroom was to just paint over it. And don't even get me started on management. Vanessa or Veronica, whatever her name is, gives you a hard time every call and she's not good at her job. They almost never reply to emails/calls. I have been trying to add my cat to my lease since September, it is now April. They did an audit a couple of months ago and had the audacity to say they were going to back-charge me for all the months she was living there. I had to threaten to get legal with them because I am not responsible for their negligence. I have now paid the fee and signed the paperwork and she's still not on the lease. I have contacted them multiple times since then. Make sure you keep copies of any email you send/get regarding an issue. They will most definitely try to pull a fast one on you. 

Ever since I moved here there have been 2 times that the city has blocked 2-3 main parking streets because of construction for at least 2 months at a time. You will constantly be fighting to find a parking spot even without construction. The roaches weren't horrible for us, but that's because we had a corner unit with nobody below us or beside us on one side. I had a friend that lived there as well and the roaches were atrocious (she was a clean person too). And if for whatever reason you decide to live there, be careful with the washer/dryer. It will tear your clothes to shreds. I would also anticipate buying gnat traps.

I’m living here currently, and I’ve lived through a tough bout of roaches. However, not all of my neighbors have had this problem, and they fired the old useless pest control guy that was using highly inappropriate methods. 

Levco management has redeemed themselves and has actual pest control now. My loft is pretty cool to be honest. The color scheme is nice, the kitchen is small and dated, but it is budget downtown Richmond living at its finest. 

Now that changes have been made, I would consider renewing my lease if I didn’t have different plans.

Roaches  everywhere  there is no way this apartment  will be able to control the infestation. this building  needs to be condemned. The building  is also infested  with Very scummy people  who steal your mail, numerous times i have had packages stolen almost immediately upon arrival. my advice is to save yourself  from this headache  and save your money because  this place is too expensive for what you get.

Wish I could post some photos on here because all of there apartments are infested with roaches! Our fridge, stove, oven, microwave, ice  machine/bucket, bathroom.... Everything where!  The apartment complex pest control will blame it on you, but this is a building issue. All or most units in the building have this issue.

I recently relocated to Richmond from South Carolina and came across these apartments. The young ladies that I spoke with did a virtual tour with me on a townhouse and told me it would be ready upon my arrival. After traveling over 400 miles, I was shown a completely different apartment. I was livid!!! I immediately went back to the office and said this is not what I agreed to. The heat didn't work, the premises has loads of trash overflowing the trash cans, the apartment was not cleaned properly, bugs were on the wall, some were dead in the corners of the apartment, and most importantly there was no washer and dryer connection that I had requested. I was given a phone number to reach out to corporate on 2/12/2024 and as of today 2/16/2024 I had not received a phone call yet. Do yourself a favor and run like hell away from this apartment complex.

Scheduled an apt viewing, got a confirmation text,  drove all the way to the apts, just to be told they don't have any apts to view.  A complete waste of time.  I'm so glad I didn't put my app in. The staff seemed to not care at all about the inconvenience.

The management doesn’t answer the phone when you call. They are quick to try to put you off if you only a couple days late on the rent but if you have an issue they don’t try to solve it in a timely manner. They are all about money and they promise the gate would be fixed and it’s been a year. They need better security also I hear guns shots on occasion. I will be glad when my lease up.

The staff is a mess here. There's a million reasons you always need to go into the office to sort things out, and so does everyone else. They never answer their phones, or their emails, and often do shady things to wrest more money from you whenever they can. It's a shame because things could be good here if management didn't actively try to make life worse for the residents.

Our community has had many changes in the last year as well as staffing and we can honestly tell how the new staff members are involved with the tenants. They have shown to care of our well bieng and also make sure we are well taken care of.

I have many compliments on this community. This has been a really good year for brookside because they have made so many changes in such little time. we have gates at both entrances now and have survellience 24/7 and maintenace is on board and up to day fixing what we need fixed.

The unit had wear and tear, rodents (snakes and mice) surrounded the townhomes side. Outside siding not update on the far end. Air filter always nasty, ceiling leaks and major water damage that patched up. However as a tenant for three years maintain by sweeping the unit every day outside, clean the gutters after complaining several times to property manager.

I was so excited to move in to Cross Creek after I graduated college and officially starting teaching in the Chesterfield area. For the most part my experience there was good. The maintenance staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. I always felt comfortable welcoming them into my home, and they are quite frankly the only reason I would give this complex a 2 out of 5 stars.

At the beginning of May we notified the apartment complex of our plan to move out at the end of August, due to a desire for more space and a change of location. I turned in a letter to the front office right around the same time the normal office manager was out of office due to knee surgery. However, the assistant manager was there to take her place in the meantime. 

After dropping off the letter, I notified the new apartment complex I was applying for. They requested that Cross Creek fill out a renters history verification and the assistant manager promptly filled out the form and faxed it back to my new complex. (The date on the fax time stamp matches that of my 60 day notice letter by the way.) On this renters verification it even states the exact date of our move out and that proper notice WAS given to Cross Creek. 

However, now Cross Creek is claiming that we never gave them a 60 day notice and their manager even stated that they never filled out any renters history verification. After I sent them the copy I had of my renters verification, the manager denied any responsibility and they are still trying to charge me for an additional 2 months rent. Not to mention... they are also trying to charge me for a “bed bug infestation” and cleaning treatment. There was absolutely no evidence of bed bugs when we moved out or in our new apartment (which has the same furniture). My husband and I called up to the front office to check on the status of our move-out after dropping off the letter, and were assured by the assistant manager we would be out by the end of our lease. It is not my responsibility to file the paperwork correctly in their front office. It is also not my fault that the assistant manager dropped the ball and forgot to file the final move out paper work. However, the manager at Cross Creek is claiming that it is somehow my responsibility to keep up to date with this paperwork. 

This has put a huge burden on me and my family. As an elementary school teacher, I cannot afford to pay these outlandish additional fees for something I was not responsible for.

This complex is a gorgeous community within minutes from metro Richmond, VA. The grounds are filled with trees and manicured lawns. I don't believe I've lived in a community where it's clean, quiet and the staff is  really nice. Plenty of ample parking and school bus stop within walking distance for my two children. They also have two parks, bark park, pool and gym as well. My only concern would be for the gym to have updated equipment and updated restrooms to match the updated kitchens. Besides that, it's great!

Cross Creek is an up to date, friendly, family oriented, and safe community.  The office and maintainence staff are always willing to do whatever is necessary to make sure the tenants are well taken care of.  I highly recommend Cross Creek to anyone looking for apartment living at it's best.

This is a nice community with a very friendly office and maintenance staff. They know your name and provide help in anyway they can regarding various issues should you come across one. The area is very convenient and close to parks, gyms, restaurants, and grocery stores.

I am a Resident at Townsend Square Townhomes and I can tell you from living there since March 2018 you do not want to live there every bug from outside is in my apartment and today I found mice in my house. I have sent in lots of complaints and they are not doing anything,today once I called Mantance about the mice he informed me he was going to bring me some stickie pads, as if I did not already have them that’s what the mice ran out of. I am so mad because I pay my rent on time and I am a wonderful Lease holder.

I have not lived here for a full year yet and it has been a terrible experience. The apartments are infested with roaches and there are mice. They tell you that pest control will come every Monday but in reality pest control comes to your apartment once a month. My package has been stolen from the mail room twice and they do nothing about, and maintenance takes forever to fix anything.

A little over a month after I moved in, I did have pest control issues however management was quick to take care of it. I haven't had any problems since. Lowest prices in rent in the area which include all utilities, although the amenities could use improvement. The location of the place is great and within walking distance to my classes.

As a student attending VCU, the prices here are affordable. The apartments themselves are a little dated however management has done a lot of renovations this past year and they do a great job at keeping the place clean. I am walking distance to my classes and work, the location is very convenient.

To start, theres a definite roach problem. It's the whole building too, I know of people who live on different floors and also experience a roach problem. I have done as much as I can do and the management won't respond to my or anyone elses complaints about the roaches. Some neighbors I talked to even told me there are mice (which, knock on wood, I haven't experienced). I can tolerate all the other issues of this place, but the roaches is what brought this place down from 3 or even 4 stars to just 1 star. 
The kitchen needs A LOT of work. The cabinets are so old and grimey that the only thing you can really do for them is either sand them down and repaint them or just replace them all together. Again, I've seen the cabinets in other units and honestly mine look the best out of all of them. I'd ask to do it myself, but that is 100% not my job. Why should I waste anymore money on fixing this place up? The $100+ on roach spray/bait is already too much. 
There is no hood over my stove and no windows in the kitchen so cooking is a challenge. The vent in my kitchen is so clogged I doubt it's even doing anything (I tried cleaning it, but I think only a professional with serious PPE can actually tackle that job). 
In addition, my stove wont ignite without a match. One of the burners used to ignite with no match, but not anymore. My neighbors have a pilot light so their stove is hot to the touch all the time (in case that's something you're concerned about).
Half my outlets don't work and the bathroom has no outlet whatsoever. 
Another potential concern is the "How to protect your family from lead" pamphlet they gave me when I first moved in. I understand it's an old building and I'm fine with that, but I thought it's worth a mention.
Lastly, the sundeck being  closed. That was a big thing they advertised, but it's impossible to get up there. You have to ask someone in management to unlock it for you, if you can even track down anyone from management. That means the deck is only open during office hours so you can forget about going up there early in the morning, in the evening, or on Sundays. 
The only plus to this place is that the maintenance workers came very quickly to fix my issues (though they did enter my apartment while I wasn't there despite me specifying to not enter my apartment while I was there because I wanted to explain the issues in person). Plus the view is very pretty, especially at night if you're facing East.

Parts of my ceiling collapsed multiple times due to leaking from rain. They took money out of my security deposit to “fix” it. I had to go out of my way to argue with them and they finally claimed to give me back my security deposit but it’s been well over 3 months since I moved out and I still have not received back my $200.

They love stealing money from students, and the apartment itself is awful. Old, moldy, mice and cockroach infested. Please save yourself the trouble and do not live here.

I currently live in a 1br on a middle floor in the West side of the building. The East side might be better since more families live there.

You'll hear every single footstep from the people upstairs; every conversation in the apartments next door; even the constant elevator arrival "dings" wake me up, and I'm a fairly deep sleeper. I'm not exaggerating. It's rough. If I could do it over again I would go to a newer building (with proper sound insulation)and pay the same rate for a smaller unit. I was lured into Berkshire by the big rooms and low rent but of course there was a catch: quiet doesn't exist here.

Also the beaming 5-star reviews on here are fake.

Though the lobby and aisle looks attractive, rooms are filthy. No maintenance. I have been living here with several problems such as roaches, malfunctioned AC and air exhaust, dirty, worn out floor tiles. I am tired of telling them. No option left except moving out.

DO NOT MOVE HERE! 

I literally cannot stress this enough. This building should be knocked over and rebuilt honestly. Get new people and just do away with the hot mess that is this building. I get these apartment towers downtown are old and stuff but really!?! Bugs everywhere, I feel like my apartment is falling apart around me. I cannot wait to get out of here. I am way sorry I chose this place. Get in somewhere better and do not waste time looking for an apartment if you know you are going to be moving in this city.

there are rats and roaches in the building. unfriendly staff. they never gets things done. they lie to you in your faces and act like they didn't do anything wrong. the office is never opened. Somebody pooped in the hallways and nobody cleaned for a week. Few weeks after I moved in the ceiling fell off and nobody came to fix it for more than 2 weeks. Dont live here

Hi, My name is Mike L., I am impressed by the nice attitude of Birkshire Apartments staff. The nice personalities are  worthy of a award. Their honesty presents for a quintessential integrity award. I think The Birkshire will be an most excellent place to reside and put my head on my pillow!

Giving the berkshire one star is being gracious. They have the worst customer service and management that I have ever dealt with. Beyond the terrible service, the Berkshire is also an old and poorly maintained building. The appliances have not been changed in several decades. The floors are falling apart. The hallways also have a pungent, disgusting stench. Avoid at all costs.

Giving the berkshire one star is being gracious. They have the worst customer service and management that I have ever dealt with. Beyond the terrible service, the Berkshire is also an old and poorly maintained building. The appliances have not been changed in several decades. The floors are falling apart. The hallways also have a pungent, disgusting stench. Avoid at all costs.

Apartment officer always pass the buck. Also, their attitude toward resident is like the attitude of warden toward prisoners. Very bad customer service, definitely move out when lease is end. Quality of Amenities is old, the floor are not easy to clean. The design of air condition is weird, it is vertical, not very effective in summer and winter compared to the horizantal way. The most important thing is that, in the winter, sometimes the A/C can broken occasionally.(I mean the whole building's A/C system is broken) I remember that night, I can't fall sleep due to the low temputure. And this apartment officers did not response to this situation quickly, it last 2 nights.

Every reply is the same. They don’t answer the phone in the office nor do they return calls. The seemingly promise to address the concerns are a joke. In the previous reviews from years ago they reply the same. The owners are well aware of the many issues. Reaching out to them is a joke. Nothing changes if nothing changes

The appliances are not stainless steel Very small counter space. Broken appliances in the breezeway. No pool. Not kid friendly. No maintenance men. Gun fire. Thin walls Office does answer the phone. Not open on Saturday.
Maintenance needs severe help. Management has Poor communication.
Very poor staff, apartment was in poor condition. Still have not gotten any of my complaints resolved. Would not recommend.

My first three weeks here was a disaster and placed me under a ton of stress. There's a really big roach issue in my apartment. I have had to throw my furniture away due to infestation over the last three weeks. Management should really compensate me for my pain and suffering. I did not get to choose my apartment and this is what was given to me. I'm so disappointed in the roach and spider situation. And maintenance takes too long to come in and address issues for new move in priority.
Unprofessional, poor communication. Would not recommend.

Absolutely one of the worst experiences I’ve dealt with in terms of living conditions, we have a 2 bedroom apartment and a family of two, but aren’t allowed another space to park our car and it gets towed FROM WHERE I PAY TO LIVE. This place is a joke. And the Manager told me “not my problem” as if it’s only mine. I will not renew this lease. And I Recommend the Apartment Complex just across on Janke road there are two other complexes with plenty of space.
Good Luck with having company, all the visitors spots will be taken. Since it’s only 12 visitor spots most of them are taken by people that have commercial vehicles…..

Management is rude especially over the phone. The place is over crowded and parking is horrible. The electric wiring is absolutely horrible. Fuses blow all the time. You literally can not microwave and toast bread at the same time. Bugs galore throughout the community. It's just a nasty place to be. Don't waste your money or time even looking into it.

I went into the leasing office today curious about what options they had for me as a potential resident. They were so rude and stared at me blankly. I told them why I was there and there was a long awkward pause before she finally asked me to fill out an information card. I asked a few questions about the apartment complex based on notes in my phone and one lady questioned my motives for asking questions pointing out the fact that I kept looking at my phone. They accused me of lying about why I was there. They were so rude. I asked about how they felt about safety in the area and one lady said she had no opinion; the other lady referred me to the police to ask them about crime in the area. I have never felt so offended in my life.

Landmark property allowed me and my family to move in back on 2007 when I lost my daughter no question ask they took the time to support me and my family and we still are tents to this day. So I want to thank them for their support over the 8 years of me living out here in Old Bridge Apartment

This is a terrible place to live. They will tow your vehicle without notice if it is missing the decal EVEN if someone has very obviously busted your window and clearly taken the sticker. Very predatory tow truck company is able to terrorize the community and tow residents cars without any problem due to the management just not caring. Stay away! Community has become extremely run down.
nice but too small.,i like the town home but no bath down stares,

The building was built in 1914. Honestly the worst issues are the roof at the moment. There are house centipedes and spiders that come in during the warmer months because the windows are original but I do really love the location, the price is decent, and I was able to bring my cat without having to pay fees because he is an ESA. The apartment Im in is honestly beautiful and once the windows are replaced it’s really just learning to clean the years of build up from previous tenants and move on from it (this apartment wasn’t exactly 100% clean like a new place when I moved in but you pick and choose your battles I guess). I’m just more upset there will be an automatic % increase to my rent and I will have to probably pay fees to leave.

This is the worst apartment I've ever stayed in. It's infested with insects like cockroaches, tics, silverfish, and centipedes. Almost all of the windows are broken and don't have a screen so you can't open them. The building is very old. The heating and air conditioning broke all the time. It's in a really sketchy area. The water had very low pressure. There were small nails sticking out of the floor all over the apartment. I should have realized how terrible it was by how excited the staff was that someone was finally renting it, but I didn't listen to my initial instinct. Speaking of the staff, there were a few times where additional charges would be added to the rent for no reason, and when my roommate and I were waiting for them to fix the error, we got charged a late fee for the rent. Avoid this place at all costs.

I lived here for a long time but the rent increases were way too much. I am talking increases of almost $100 in one year upon renewal.  The apartments are very modern and upscale with a townhome design.  I liked having more privacy and not having anyone above or beneath me. The community was centrally located as well as relatively quite with nice and responsive staff. However, they are overpriced especially for an one bedroom. They are also now 13 to 14 years old. Overall I enjoyed living there but the high rent increases pushed me out.

Worst apartments ever new managers are in office and every week something is getting messed up my car got broken into kids be smoking weed outside fees are always being added to our rent. If you thinking about moving here don't you will be moving out in less than a  month

Whenever we have anyone over, they always comment on how gorgeous the whole facility is! 

Safety - I feel super safe living here. The apartments are not accessible from the outside. You have to use your key fob to enter the building, the hallway, and then your apartment.

Pool - Gorgeous! They have several cabanas with coolers, which is really great.

Front Office - They are the absolute best and always have a little bowl of chocolate for residents. 

Main Area - All furniture and decor is from West Elm. Beautiful fireplace that can seem from both inside and outside.

Maintenance - They are also so great! Friendly, respectful. Whenever I have had an issue, they resolved it same day. 

Trash Fairies - Garbage removal service 5 days a week. No walking your trash to a dumpster! They also take recycling!

Courtyard - Beautiful! Pool table, ping pong table, several different sitting areas, gated, beautiful landscaping. 

Library / Lake / Events - Across the street is the Henrico library, several swinging bench seats, bistro table/chairs, overlooking a lake with a fountain. Weekly food trucks, monthly family-friendly live music, Spring and Winter festivals, etc. 

Quiet / Peaceful - Other reviews say the walls are paper thin. That’s not been my experience.  

The Apartment - Nicely laid out. Marble countertops, white tile backsplash, new appliances. Tall windows provide great sunlight! Neighbors are all friendly. 

I have a one bedroom, with a gigantic bonus room / office (that is actually used as a bedroom because its size is approx. same as the master). I have a patio unit facing the courtyard, which imo is the best view to have!

I’m convinced that anyone who has left a bad review about this place, are people who leave bad reviews everywhere they go. I love Wellsmith and feel proud to live here!

Lowest end appliances available. Peel and stick flooring. Insufficient water pressure (at least on the 5th floor). Surly maintenance supervisor. Very noisy (outdoor noise - trash trucks, delivery trucks, motorcycles, buses, air conditioner on roof of adjacent building, etc.). 

They do have a nice pool and the sales staff is nice and seems to care, but seems to have little to no say in management of the building.

This place is atrocious. You will love it if you don’t mind living with no breed restrictions which includes aggressive dog, smoking of weed and cigarettes within the building and the property manager sponsoring companies who’s employees are not screened and live among you. The corporate housing tenants breaks every rule and create fire hazards with no repercussions because their company pays the insane rent prices. There are mature working professionals here and retired people who are great residents but they subject you to a fraternity lifestyle. The once accommodating and friendly staff are dismissive and combative. None of them appear to care about the property they manage anymore. There are screens from windows that have fallen and lay in the bushes for over a year, it takes 4 days for them to clean dog vomit in stairwells. This entire place is a joke. I have a laundry list of dangerous hazards that the county inspector needs to address. Don’t waste your money here

I can hear every single step my neighbor above me takes. I think they work through the night because it goes on from 12 to 6 am nearly every night. The apartment also has glue left behind from construction everywhere and the stove was not level when I first moved in which I had to do myself. The trash room is constantly clogged so it smells terrible. The doors used are hollow and crooked. The bedrooms have no lights in them!!! and the switches on the wall don't connect to any outlets so you cannot use them to connect to a lamp.

Currently live here and waiting on lease to end. They sell you on this being a new property but I have never had more issues with an apartment before. Our air conditioning broke within the first few weeks of being here and it took all day to get someone to bother to come by to fix it. We now can’t use our master bath because there is a short in the fuse for the lighting and maintenance can’t fix it without waiting on the warranty company to send someone out. This is now day 3 of waiting and all the front office can say is we will get back to you when we here from someone. The trash room is always overfilled with garbage. The side walks always have dog poop all over them because there are only 2 stations to drop off dog poop bags on the entire property and 0 green space for your dogs. Packages are constantly lost or stolen and the front desk staff just say take it up with Amazon and give not assistance addressing these problems. Also there is now constant construction noise making it impossible to sleep after 7a any day of the week. Totally overpriced and wouldn’t recommend this place for anyone to live!

I loved living at Penstock! It's a convenient, walkable, and clean area. The apartments are very nice. I never had any issues with noise or odors from neighbors. The walls seemed adequately soundproofed. The amenities are great- there's a nice gym, a beautiful pool, and a massive courtyard with tables and grills. The apartment is in a very convenient location. The exit to 64 is right there. there's plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, and retail shops in the area. The leasing and maintenance staff are responsive and friendly. Highly recommend!!

The bad
1.	There is street cleaning from 6 to 9 AM
2.	Street drift gangs around 9 to 12:30 PM
3.	Constant loud exhaust noise
4.	Nasty neighbor dragging trash bags across the hallway living sticky residue
5.	Fruit fly problem
6.	Poor sound proofing materials are used all around the building. Meaning there will be constant noise in your unit (conversations/Laundry machines at night/toilet flushing/door/drawers/footsteps)
7.	Trash pickup service  (high service fee)
8.	Managers in the office are rude/uneducated.
9.     Dog pee in random places
10.    Cars are getting broken into by thieves (CCTV in garage is probably useless)

The good
1.	Maintenance personnel are friendly and quick to resolve problems
2.	Location/parking garage.

There are so many wonderful things about living here. I understand it's a new building, but there are definitely some adjustments that need to be made.

Pros:
- The staff is so wonderful. They provide us with free meals just about every month - whether its a food truck or restaurant here in Libbie Mill. They're also readily available and consistent. This includes the maintenance workers and "trash fairies" as well. Again, I am so grateful for their kindness and dedication to their residents.
- This place is beautiful and has a ton of thoughtful features (dog washing station, fire pits, grilling stations, a Peloton, etc.)
- GREAT location. We're 10-15 minutes (or less) from just about anywhere we need to be. 
- We live in a one-bedroom and there's actually a decent amount of storage, which we're thankful for.
- No power outages or water shortages/temperature issues.
- We always feel pretty safe going on walks or runs, even when it's dark out.
- Nice granite countertops and appliances. Haven't had any trouble with them.

Cons:
- Many people here DO NOT RESPECT THE PROPERTY and it's infuriating. Some residents bring way too many people to the pool/courtyard and get very drunk, leaving their beer cans, food, and trash behind. I've also found beer cans around the building and find myself picking up trash on a weekly basis. I've called the front office about these things and have not seen an improvement. But I guess they can't make people care. It's just when you're paying for a nice apartment, you expect the people living here to be respectful. That's not always the case.
- We recently had someone move in above us and you can hear every footstep, toilet flush, or movement they make.
- Last night the fire alarm went off at 2:30am... and then again at 6am...because there was water pressure build up in the sprinkler system.
- They need to clean the pool more. I've found random items like Q-tips at the bottom on multiple occasions and it gets SO greasy from the sunscreen build-up.
- There's rarely wipes to clean the equipment at the gym.
- There are very few cameras in the parking garage, stairwells, or hallways. Just in the halls leading into the parking garage, next to the elevator doors leading out to the garage, and the elevators. There are blue safety lights around, but as a woman and car owner, I would appreciate seeing more cameras. 
- There's something funky with the pipes. We smell sulfur in our bathroom a few weeks out of the month.

I lived in a 2br for a year from when it was brand new. We had numerous appliance issues, but overall it was nice. I downsized to a 1br after my lease ended and now I have to smell a very strong odor of marijuana every single day. All of my clothes and belongings now smell like it. I have received little to no help from the leasing office. The small dumpsters on site are usually overflowing. They rarely cut what grass is left. There's a dead tree that will soon fall on someone's car.  Very poorly managed apartment considering the cost.

Damp units, pest, toxic chemicals such as lead, doors easily breached, chipping paint, & outdated utilities.

Save yourself the headache
