I'm a huge fan of this property. I lived here for just under 2 years, and my situation changed and necessitated a move--otherwise, I would have stayed longer. I've lived in a LOT of apartments both Museum District and West End, and the value of these cozy townhouses was on point. You get the easy access to The Village/LibbieGrove/Willow Lawn/Reynolds Crossing, you're still close to the city, etc... but paying a lot less than you would closer into the city while still getting all the amenities (in-unit laundry, dishwasher, pool, easy parking). The units are cozy (625 sq ft) but well laid out, and while older, mine at least had been updated in recent years with newer kitchen cabinets and laminate (this varies by unit, I believe). They also replaced the bathroom vanity as a lease renewal gift. The storage is great--decent closets in both bedrooms, hall linen closet, and closet under the stairs (could fit my bike!). Regarding neighbor noise, while I've heard noise is an issue for some, I honestly had minimal sound from either side... and both my neighbors were apparently active musicians. In my location, street parking was plentiful and I lived across from the park which was pleasant. Beyond the actual unit, I'm a raving fan of the property management. The 3 ladies in the leasing office are fantastic--unlike most properties, their friendliness and helpfulness doesn't end when you sign a lease! I always found them to be extremely nice and courteous. On-site maintenance is also efficient--any issue I had was dealt with day-of. At least for me, everything about this rental experience was great. The location, unit, staff, and price was a fantastic package.

I am a business student at VCU, and I couldn't stand the high volume of noise living across the street from the campus.
My parents found this great website (apartments.com), and we were able to find the perfect place for me! Im in a beautiful apartment with an upstairs!! The living area, kitchen, and half bath are downstairs, while the bedroom, washer and dryer,full bathroom, and 2 walk in closets!! are upstairs.
It is only 15 minutes to campus, close to stores, and shops, and the best part is that its quiet with a park around the corner. It has terrific amenities, and beautiful , safe walking areas. Because my parents are helping me out with rent, I am so fortunate to live in a quiet, safe, people friendly complex thanks to Apartments.com for having an amazing site thats fun and easy to navigate.

My Town home is too small for my personal taste, but the neighborhood and neighbors are quite, friendly, but keep or themselves. Whatever maintenance issues I had was addressed in a reasonable time period.
I would recommend this complex. I saw no bugs or roaches at all, but I always put down boric acid before I move anything in. My neighbors has dogs.

Worst experience ever. When we moved in, the apartment was roach infested. You will not be able to get them to fix anything. It says they're central air and heating, but its hot in the summer and freezing in the winter. Don't believe me, roll by and see all of the window units in the windows. A neighbor had her upstairs bathroom literally fall through the floor, and they did not fix it. The inside looks like its stuck in the 70's. Run do not walk, if you're thinking of moving here, the projects are a better option.

These apartments are rip offs!!! They don't complete any maintenance orders. They never answer the phones. Your concerns are never addressed !!! Your ceiling could b laying in the floor and they still wouldn't come fix it! Oh but they are quick to put a notice on your door . Worse move ever!!!

overall it's a great apartment a living room a dinning room fenced in back yard 3 bedroom town home. Maintenance is a bit slow they fix the problem but normally takes them a week to fix it not to shabby. However my air stop working and one time took them 3 weeks to fix it. It was the  beg. Of summer (yeah tell me about it). But back to the rooms there pretty spacious and lots of closet space my kitchens also a good size. Everything's overall good we do have a lot of kids in our complex very noisy and they throw the ball at my door every 4 mins, tried talking to them but that didn't help much. Lastly parking is great always have a spot however late a night they tow and the company they hired to tow, DONT get out to check for the apartment stickers so you might wake up and your cars not outside , then you have to pay $160 to get it out. Not perfected but overall a Good Apartment.

These apartments are in a nice part of town that is quiet, safe and very convenient to shopping.  The complex is well kept but very plain.  There is no pool or gym or playground.  They do have a laundry facility in addition to the hookups in the apartments.  I have found the people in the complex to be friendly and easy to live around.  I haven't had any issues.  The people in the rental office and maintenance are both ok.  The few problems I've had were fixed promptly the first time.  The apartments themselves are very old, even the remodeled ones are not what you would call nice.  In my opinion they are overpriced because of their age but that's just my opinion.

The community is very quiet and the people are quite friendly. The management is very personable and polite. They are professional and handle maintenance, accounts, and public relations extremely well. I've lived in dumps where management did not care about anything but the rent. That is not the case at Amber Ridge. 
The location is very good with shopping and restaurants within a short walk or drive, depending upon what you want/need. They may not have all of the so-called amenities that some may want, but if you want a quiet place to live, Amber Ridge is where it's at.
I can heartily recommend this community without reservation.

Hello, 
Please do not move here. The pictures do NOT match the actual unit, and they are infested with roaches. This is a very old apartment, and while it may not entirely be their fault, just don't do it. Please look elsewhere. I have been here a month and I regret it. I notified the office and all they do is come and spray but we all know how much that will do, probably keep roaches at bay but not eliminate the issue.
Roaches, ceiling leaks, cheap appliances, quick-fix methods instead of trying to actually fix the work orders, it has potential but the owners have to care.

Went to schedule a tour accepted an available time. When I arrived they told me that they had nothing to show me. And that there was nothing available bc someone put in an application before me. I drove 45 min. Nothing was communicated and wasted my time. They knew my need to move ASAP and didn’t bother to notify or update me until I arrived. No apology no nothing. Very unprofessional. 6/2/22

Lived here 3 years. Captured 6 rats. Brought 2 of them to the Property Manager, Eric - no resolution. Neighbors also complained numerous times to no avail. Complained about high water bill (supposedly I used 200 gallons a day) only to be told "that's what the meter says". Was told by other tenants they were experiencing the same problems. Extensive mold issue that kept coming back 2 of the 3 years. Was told be maintenence that it was "surface mold" and they wiped it down and painted over it.

I was told this used to be one of the premier properties in the West End. Unfortunately times have changed and management doesn't seem to care.

I've got plenty of pictures but no way of posting them with this review.
I love my apartment and Charaje was very helpful and nice. I rate kings crossing 5 stars!

We signed up to have hardwood floor and when we got the keys the place had wall to wall carpet. Also on the website it shows that water is to be included, it’s actually added to your monthly rent. We have been complaining about infestation of ants inside and out and nothing is being done about it. Also our appliances barely work. The dishwasher doesn’t clean the dishes and the dryer is broken. I have only been here a couple of weeks but have over 5 work orders that haven’t been completed. I’m trying to be understanding and patient but I’m paying for amenities that I can’t use and they won’t compensate me for it.

I love the community so much, it’s so peaceful and modernized. The customer service is so excellent  from the leasing office!, there are also great amenities and I can say that I would definitely recommend and encourage  anyone looking for an apartment in the West end

My girlfriend and I lived here for 1 year and it is a decision we still regret. While living here, we experienced lack of care and attention by the leasing office and maintenance. When something happened that required maintenance's attention often it was put off or only temporarily fixed (two weeks or less). One of the biggest concerns we had was the amount of cockroaches that the leasing office failed to care or act on. After days of waiting for the Terminix people to arrive, they advised that there were multiple holes that were accessible to the barn roaches that were coming in and that despite there spraying it the roaches would still come in due to these holes. For the remaining 5 months, constant emails and calls the leasing office never sent maintenance to address this. Another major concern is the loud and inconsiderate neighbors throughout the neighborhood. Obviously having people on both sides of town home, there is going to be a general noise from people. But loud bass music playing throughout all hours of the night with no response from the nightly community attendant is ridiculous. Add on the constant smell of smoke coming in from neighbors smoking in there homes and it leaking into your apartment got old fast. And lastly, parking is absolute hell here. YOU WILL FIGHT TOOTH AND NAIL FOR PARKING.

DO NOT LIVE HERE. If you enjoy roaches, spiders, and ants, this may be the place for you. This place does not care that bugs are everywhere in your home. I had never seen a roach before I moved here and found them many times in my kitchen. HUGE roaches. Pest control did nothing. I cleaned daily and had to get rid of the problem myself. Until the bugs started coming back. Also, every appliance breaks. They are absolutely horrible and management will not replace outdated equipment.

We feel very disappointed with how the leasing agent dealt with us. We explained our situation before we sent the application to them and they said that we would qualify they just needed the official application online which cost us $100. Then after, they rejected our application and told us there is nothing they can do as they are only following what the system is showing them. And the $100 is nonredundable. We feel like we are being robbed with the application fee when they knew in the first place we would get rejected. We were heartbroken.

Stressed and disappointed. Our excitement to live here was completely ruined within a few days of putting down the reservation fee. Feeling very much scammed into it at this point. We were pushed to put down the non-refundable reservation for a townhouse after being given lots of inaccurate information (move-in date, appearance of townhome) - all of which would've prevented us from choosing this townhouse/complex in the first place. Even still, these may not have been dealbreaking issues if not for the inconsistency of management and lack of drive to find solutions for us as future tenants. It truly comes off like the staff has very little care or respect for tenants once they have roped them into a reservation. I have received the same canned responses from multiple employees with odd explanations, zero resolutions, and always ending with "is there anything else I can assist you with today?". Clearly not - if they are not assisting me with my concerns in the first place. When I did the research, came up with and asked about with a potential solution, my email was ignored. Even after being forwarded twice. I also received a call from my current complex WARNING me to be cautious with Kings Crossing as they had contacted my current residence for information about me without consent from me. Overall, I am now feeling extremely nervous about residing here as I can tell any issues we have in the future will likely be addressed in the same manner. After going through this process, I definitely do not recommend this complex.

Many pros, but the con outweighs them all.  Examples:
- Fumes came through our air system from renovations 2 units away. We were told to keep our windows open and fans blowing at night (not safe AND causes heating/cooling system to constantly run)  
- Loud, after hours noise from a neighbor allowed to persist for months
- >2 weeks to remove broken, rusty bedframe from common area
- Assigned wrong unit at move in, terrible customer service

I've lived here almost a year and absolutely love it here.  Theresa in the office has been so helpful with any questions I have. Apartments are more like townhouse living, quiet neighborhoods. Maintenance is quick in responding and fixing any issues.  The gym is amazing, and has a security entrance. Pools are well maintained and life guard on duty at all times. Totally recommend!!!

I have really enjoyed my stay at Kings Crossing thus far. The staff has been amazing, with this being a big and sudden move for me and my children. The town home is fabulous with a winding staircase, sunken living room, and three bedrooms. The only thing is I wish I had the wood floors and den, but other than that, it is very homey.
They are always quick to send maintenance out to fix any problems. It is a well manicured and secure apartment complex. I have lived here for 12 years so I should know!!

We have lived here for just over 2 years in a 2 bedroom 1 1/2 bath townhouse. When we first moved in the apartment was not cleaned very well, the office stay has a cleaning service come through but they didn't do a very good job. We have never had problems with noisy neighbors. They are pretty pet friendly, they have a pet fee and pet rent but most places in the area do so that's to be expected. We have a patio and direct access to a grassy area out our back door which makes taking care of our dog very easy. Most people are not very good about picking up after their dogs even though there are pet stations around the property with bags and waste cans, so be careful where you step. Our townhouse is very poorly insulated, the carpet has thin,cheap padding, and the top panel of our windows sometimes slide down, opening to the outside with now screen and if we don't check behind the shades then we don't notice the window is open. Maintenance can tighten the windows to prevent this but it makes it very difficult to open the bottom of the window when you want to. The maintenance staff is very quick to respond after we put in a work request, which can be done on the apartment website. You can also pay rent on the website rather than writing checks each month. We got a good deal on rent when we first moved in but it has gone up each year since, and each year we look around at other places before we resign. Though I feel our rent is high, it seems to be fairly competitive with other places of the same size with the same amenities. I like the area it offers easy access to many grocery stores (kroger, martins, whole foods) as well as multiple malls and shopping areas without feeling like I'm  living in an industrial area. We are in the area across the street from a cemetery but we can't see it from any of our windows and I don't feel like I live near a cemetery so it doesn't bother me. They are in the process of updating the townhouses, but we live in one that has not had this done yet. I have seen the updates and they seem nice but I don't feel like we are missing out on anything with our place the way it is now. I think my favorite thing about this place is the storage! We have 1 usable closet downstairs (the other has our water heater, washer, and dryer in it) and 4 closets upstairs, 1 of which is a double closet in our master bedroom. We have 2 cars and can normally find parking within a block of our place. The office staff is extremely helpful and courteous!

The size of the rooms are nice & gas/heat is included… that makes the rent price even cheaper. No water bill either! 
Maintenance is nice & the office team always tries to help!
just move in the apartment Oct.1,2015 so far we like it here planning on staying a year here.
we move in morningside Oct.1,2015 so far we like it.

It's known that the staff purposely don't answer residents' calls whose issues they don't want to deal with. Barely responded to my constant emails and calls on the situation. Reported me to the credit agency even after I payed for everything. Run by students and a manager who have never had a job before.

I moved in when these apartments were first built last year and it turned into a nightmare quickly! The management doesn’t care to fix your issues unless they like you. We had some of the amenities taken away from us because that residents are nasty and let their pets pee in the hallway and not clean it up. People get washed and throw up all over the place and the staff have no urgency to clean it up. When I took hot steamy showers, I would sneeze a lot, nasal drip, watery eyes so I think my bathroom had mold but they covered it up. The office staff were not inviting at all and acted like they had an attitude because you were bothering them even though it’s their job! I left because I was starting to see roaches in my unit and our unit was clean, we were starting to get gnats, and there was talk about rats because people aren’t clean and don’t put their trash down the trash chute! Look at the low star reviews because those are true! The high star reviews are from people who have gotten a tour or from parents who doesn’t even stay there!

FIRST we have never, not once see any security guard at the entry desk or on premises. 
The swimming pool is always covered in green algae. There’s supposed to be an armed security person is the main reason we chose to live here- NOPE!
Have complained many times about this as well.

Joelle Reed and the staff scams students and are very unprofessional!! During the tour (11/22), was told wouldn’t have to pay reassignment fee. We couldn’t move in and let them know in April 6 2023, called the next day and Shay Miller told us verbally we would not have to pay the reassignment fee because they had a long waitlist of people looking for her floor plan. We were charged a reassignment fee in August. Reached out via phone call on 8/10 and spoke to Joelle Reed. She said she would look into it and get back to me. No call back. I called again on 8/16 and asked for an update and said I had an email with it in writing and I would send along. No response to email or phone call back. Sent another email 8/30. No response. Called again 8/31, I spoke to Sianna today, she said now they don’t waive any reassignment fees and Joelle would not take my call. I’ve asked to speak to the property manager twice on 8/16 and 8/31 and no one will pass along my message. Three different staff including the assistant property manager have said they will waive the reassignment fee. They tell you one thing and then that is not the case! Do not trust anything they say because they are scamming these students any chance they get! Unprofessional because the staff will not return phone calls or emails!
Newest building with fresh amenities and spacious units!! Right next to Kroger and so close to VCU's campus--best spot in town!

After moving from somewhere who did not care about my needs and wellbeing, Ascend makes sure to go above and beyond to make sure I am safe and easily accommodated! I love it here and I will definitely be renewing my lease! Glad to call Ascend home(:

Hello I have been in this apartment complex for almost 10 years it used to be friendly People good people Decent community to raise your kids Unfortunately not any more 2 week Ago my son bike were missing and last night my wife’s car got stolen and six other vehicle were brake in I don’t feel safe anymore here my kids are scared I am scared to walk outside and leave my door open just for a second you never know what’s gonna happen next we are moving out soon this place has no camera no security gate absolutely you’re on you’re on if anything happens it’s all you

The community at these apartments is great.The people are nice and friendly. The rent rate is fair and there is enough storage in the two bedroom, 1 and a half bath. There is a nice pool and playground for kids. They keep the property looking nice and the maintenance is fast and efficient.  The downside is there is no washer and dryer hookups, so you have to use a laundry room with a card that you load cash onto.  There is also no gym on site. Also water and gas are included on rent every month with a $50 cap on gas. Stove and heat are gas powered and only reach the cap in winter when it is colder. Overall a nice, quiet place to live.

apartmentName: Kensington, Patterson Place and Grove Ave
review:
I figured I would leave a review since the most recent review is 4+ years old. I'm going on my third year at Kensington Place. All of my immediate neighbors have lived here for 7+ years, which is a good sign. The complex was apparently built in 1947, so the units are older, but they are renovated as folks move out. This complex is in a GREAT location for a fair price, especially considering you get off-street parking and in-unit laundry. Maintenance is always responsive, usually within a day. Same with the leasing office. I love that I have real wood floors and cute retro tile in the bathroom.

Cons: I see roaches and crickets unless I have pest control out frequently. Very close to the fire station, so you hear all the sirens. No fancy clubhouse/gym/pool, if you care (I don't). My apartment is a bit worse for wear in terms of the walls, paint, baseboards, and tile floors in the bathroom. 

Overall, I recommend this place and I'll continue to renew.

apartmentName: Kensington, Patterson Place and Grove Ave
review: For the price you get Free parking and a large space for what you pay and have access to a 24/7 emergency maintenance team

apartmentName: Kensington, Patterson Place and Grove Ave
review: Do not rent from this complex! Huge issue with the billing practices for this apartment complex. Upon moving in we provided our rental insurance coverage and the property manager said everything was good to go. About 2 months in we received a charge for renters insurance. I called Kim the property manager and she said that my husband was listed on the insurance and I wasn’t. We called and confirmed with our insurance company that both my husband and I were covered and provided Kim with the information. She reversed the charges. About 2 months later we get another charge for insurance! This time Kim told us that our insurance had expired. We called our insurance company again and they confirmed that the policy was updated and sent over to Kim the property manager. We then had the insurance company call Kim (which the did) and inform her that we were covered and sent the policy for the second time. This month I received a third charge for insurance even though Kim was aware that we are covered!! Also, there is apparently a new policy that they can no longer reverse incorrect charges so my husband and I are liable for them. On top of this the apartment complex is very loud. You can hear everything your neighbors are doing. The apartment also smells like smoke due to the lady living down stairs smoking in her apartment. Needless to say we are moving out ASAP.

apartmentName: Kensington, Patterson Place and Grove Ave
review: If you like to sleep through the night ever, don't move here. If you want to listen to your neighbors stomping and screaming, this is the place for you.

apartmentName: Kensington, Patterson Place and Grove Ave
review: When I checked online they listed the July 1st as when an apartment would be available, however when I went to look at it they said that the date listed online was when the former tenants would be moving out and that they take a few days to clean the place so I decided not to apply since that was unprofessional in my opinion. Upper units do not have elevators. It looked nice and had there not been calendar issues I would have considered moving there.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review:
Even though I asked to be placed on the parking pass list I've never been given one. Not that I could afford $150 a month anyways... ridiculously high price... The parking situation is trash and the people paying $150 for spot are parking in the free spots instead meaning I have to park far away. Our elevator has been broken for over a month and a half. It breaks often but is normally fixed after a week. The stairs smell like pee a majority of the time. The all in one washer/dryer combo sucks and I usually have to take my laundry elsewhere to do it. Packages aren't even delivered to my building, instead I have to go to the building next door to get them. It's been an okay time up until recently.

Best thing I ever did was move out!

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: Lack of communication is my biggest complaint. My lease renewal was stalled because I didn’t submit proof of renters insurance but I HAD submitted it months earlier. I told them and was told the problem was solved. It’s been about a month and someone knocked on my door this morning to tour my apartment.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: Overall, pretty good. I lived here for 2 years, and if I wasn't moving out of town, I'd live here longer. Neighbors are considerate, lots of dogs to brighten up my day. Amenities are top notch - indoor courtyard, gym, free laundry machines (on top of the in-unit ones). Maintenance is quick to respond for issues inside your apartment, and they're always right on time with those filter changes. Sometimes random things malfunction for a while, like elevators or parking garage doors, but those things have not directly impacted me.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: love how clean and up to date the hallways are. the staff are great in the main office, maintenance, cleaning crew, and trash service. great place

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: The location is great and the character of the apartment is great. Everything else is less than. I had to wait 7 months to get a parking spot, in the meantime my car was hit several times on the street while parked. I can hear every conversation my neighbor has despite him talking in a normal voice. My entire apartment shakes when I use my laundry machine and the drying cycle takes longer than air drying the clothes. I dust weekly and you couldn't tell, my rag comes up black every time (despite not having any pets or windows open) - so I can't imagine the last time they actually cleaned the duct work or had the windows properly sealed.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: The Upper Lofts at Canal walk are the best lofts in Richmond! Tall ceilings, modern amenities, gym, pool and a great management team. Steps away from a brewery convenient stores great restaurants grocery stores and pharmacies. it is dog friendly with a cute dog park. It’s a secure area so you feel safe walking around the complex. Some of the best restaurants are in Shockoe bottom or Shockoe slip. It’s a great area to live in and very close to the interstate.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: Love the trash pick-up. It’s convenient that the electric and water are included so I have less bills to worry about. I wish parking was included with rent.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: I think a lot of the reviews on here were left prior to new management taking over, or at the least, new staff. I had a great experience with maintenance requests and office staff. They were friendly and even worked with me on a move out mix up where we were both at fault. Being in the industry- I know most places could have legally held their ground and taken me for thousands- but they did the right thing when they didn’t have to. Never had qc issues (I believe the system was replaced building wide in the last few years), buildings are cleanish especially when you consider how many residents these buildings house. Elevators sucked and were broken a lot. But overall- my apartment was beautiful and I would rent here again for sure if I was to move back to the city.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: I love my apartment, but I am leaving this place as soon as I can.  I have lived here for over a year and a half, and since then I have experienced numerous issues.  My washer/dryer breaks down frequently.  Even flooded my apartment after the maintenance crew said that it was fixed.  There is a leak within the bathroom wall that the office will not fix, causing water damage that compounds on itself.  The management office is absolutely incompetent, minus one or two.  Additionally, there aren't enough parking spaces for the amount of tenants here, so you have to try and find spot on the street or you end up with a 5-6 block walk back. Please, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review:
I have lived here a little over 6 months and I would tell anyone and everyone not to live here. a few of my complaints: 1.The whole outside of the building smells like dog urine and the dog owners NEVER clean up after their pets. I have a dog here and I always clean up after them because...that's my job as a dog owner. They have a "dog run" which is literally a long narrow area that's fenced in where dogs do their business and owners never clean up after them and neither do maintenance. Maybe if they provided a better and bigger area for the dogs the smell around the building wouldn't be so strong. 2. PARKING IS TERRIBLE. One of the "perks" when signing our lease was 2 "free" parking passes. What that means is they give you two passes that are good for the free lot down on dock st (which is always full after about 3 PM), or street parking. They have closed down about 2-3 lots since I have been here which has resulted in zero open parking spots. It's ridiculous and they seem to be not worried about it at all. I've been towed and ticketed because of this. I would pay an extra $50 a month for one parking spot but I don't want to give them anymore of my money. 3. NOISE LEVEL IN THE SUMMER. The pool area is the worst in the summer. Our bedroom window is right next to the pool area, which I thought would be a nice view. I wish I would have realized this was a bad thing when I signed my lease. The staff do NOTHING to enforce their "pool area is closed after 10 PM" rule. They have put up stupid little notes around the building once, which of course did nothing. I have had to call the onsite deputy about 3-4 times due to people being loud, drunk, and inconsiderate till about 4 AM. They blast music, grill, swim, scream, etc till late into the night. I have reported it to the front office too, but nothing happened. 4. The staff do absolutely nothing when you write in complaints.As you can tell. 5. My AC unit broke over the summer and it took about 2 months for them to fix it. I have talked to other residents and it seems everyones unit has broken. 6. They take better care of their other buildings more than the lofts at canal. They always seem more clean. 7. People are always smoking int the stairwells. 8. They have been doing construction for over a year. 8 AM wake up call monday-friday. 
I never planned to complain, but, I wish I would have seen a review like this before I signed a year of my life away here.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: I am having a horrible time with this location. I attempted to get an apartment with the Lofts. I was unfortunately declined in which I was advised I would get the holding fee back to my card. (Not to mention the experience and length of time in the office and computer issues encountered during applying.) The deposit was mailed to an address that I no longer live and the company is trying to charge me either 35.00 to have MY money sent to an address or I have to wait until 12.15.2017 to have MY money resent. IN addition , the Rep Keonia or KeeKee has hung up on me twice. I asked for a management, she states they are busy. After indicating I'd wait, I was placed on hold for about 5 minutes and hung up again. NEVER do business with this place!

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: The grounds are dirty, leasing staff is unprofessional and rude and doesn't value your time (despite thier voicemail message ). The whole utilities included thing actually kind of sucks from a maintenance standpoint- for example our AC went out for the whole month of July - it was 82 degrees in the apartment at one point- we called and emailed and they claimed they "fixed it" 4 times (it would work for a half day and then temp would creep back up- ya ok). We ended up deciding to move- for this and other reasons--big one is felt we were over-paying for what we were getting- and it wasn't until we said something in front of a prospective resident touring our apt that they actually fixed the AC for good. When it's cooler in the un- air conditioned stairways than it is it your apartment and no one from the front office seems to really care yet you are technically still paying for essentially broken AC- ya kinda turns you off from a place. Also included internet is a joke--its so slow! Anyways- this was one of several incidents in which the leasing office displayed their utter lack of care and total disregard for the residents. Seems like they wasted a lot of money on a fancy new office rather than fix their obvious staffing issues

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review:
My husband and I lived there for a year and would not recommend it. We had mold growing in our unit, and we they attempted to clean it, they ruined 2 of my husband's blazers. And the mold came back. And ruined some of my aloe plants. But don't fret, they can fix somethings... when they get to them... like our A/C we lost for a few days, our dishwasher that quit working, our bathroom light that wouldn't turn on (multiple times. and it wasn't the bulb.)....

Parking is included with rent, but good luck finding a spot if you don't get home in the evenings before 7 pm. 

The package room is a mess, and no notifications come when you do get a delivery. So check often and search hard when you do.

Everything is out of order.... the vending machines, over half of the cardio equipment, and often the fob system to get in. I have circled the building knocking on doors before to get in my own building.

And Shockoe Bottom itself isn't worth the rent. It is dirty. It doesn't attract the classiest weekend crowd. The only nearby grocery store is a small, Farm Fresh.. where nothing is fresh.....

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review:
Pros: Location and the one check a month policy. 

Cons: Oh boy where do I begin? First, the free internet is an absolute scam. The free internet is limited to 10 mbps, which for those unfamiliar is barely enough to stream Netflix let alone do any major web browsing. They have a deal with a local ISP to where you can only use their services and must pay more for the "premium" internet which is 20 mbps which, again, is WAY below acceptable standards. A decent internet speed comes in around 50 mbps. 

Next, the office staff is absolutely TERRIBLE. They are unresponsive, never follow through on promises, and either intentionally or unintentionally spread misinformation about policies constantly. 

If you need maintenance in your apartment done, forget about it. Average wait time is over a month and a half, even when an issue is deemed an "emergency" by the property. Our apartment had black mold and it was never addressed in three months. Beyond that, a nearby neighbor had black soot coming out of their ventilation that was never addressed. 

The "free" parking does not really exist as the parking lot is very typically full by later in the day. 

The building is currently under construction and cleaning which has no estimated end date (so assume years as it has already been a few, or the entirety of your lease). Every day at 8 AM they begin working on the building which reverberates through the entire apartment complex and forbids you from sleeping beyond that time. 

Now, I get that every apartment complex in Richmond has negative reviews online and I encourage everyone to take all online reviews with a grain of salt. HOWEVER, this property truly is the exception. Living here is absolutely terrible. It is common knowledge around the building that the front office staff is poorly managed, the maintenance team is unreliable at best, and that the tenants are not highly prioritized due to high leasing numbers. If you can, avoid living at property at all costs...There are plenty of great apartments on this same street for similar prices. Do not live here.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review: When I moved into this apartment things were clean. When I moved out, I cleaned everything very thoroughly, however, they found one spec of dirt inside a cabinet and they charged me $35, claiming that I didn't clean it. They charged me $25 because they said I hadn't wiped off the countertops because they could see the water droplets that had dried there.

apartmentName: Lofts and Upper Lofts at Canal Walk III
review:
When I was given a parking pass, the office staff who filled it out made a typo. She corrected it. However, my car got towed because she corrected it instead of giving me a new one, so the towing company thought my parking pass was a fake. Then the office staff refused to pay the cost of towing! Even though it was their fault that my car got towed!
Do not live here, the staff is incredibly stupid.

LP is a garbage dump. It has 2 small dumpsters for all the apts. The dumpster areas are always overflowing and trash blows all over the property. This attracts the bugs and rats that infest the property. I took out my trash once and a squirrel jumped out and hit me.
LP also has constant plumbing issues, the plumbers are out here every day. Then they just put a piece of wood over the hole the cut to cover the mess. There is mold everywhere.

Me and my boyfriend did a application for this place and they would never get back to us on the status of the application we always had to call them and when calling it took 30 calls in one day before someone would answer the phone but when i went into the office the lady was talking on her cell phone. It has been 3 weeks since we’ve done the application and payed them our money and we haven’t had any update on the status update of our application.

Laurel Pines is a cute friendly community across the street from the Shops at White Oaks. Many of the residents who call Laurel Pines home have been here for up to 20 years. The new owners and management have made many repairs in the last 9 months and the staff works hard to keep everything looking and feeling good. Apartments are spacious and the location is wonderful. There are many great restaurants and shopping just across the street. We are only minutes from the Richmond Airport or downtown but yet nestled in a quiet community.

These apartments are calm for the few months I have been here already I could tell that I can just go on my balcony and just take everything in. From the landlord to our neighbors they have been nothing but nice

I love my apartment, besides some minor issues that I believe can be resolved. The apartments have many different floorplans; that are very spacious. The maintenance team has been very helpful & they make sure they get issues resolved before close(office). 
Now for why my rate is average. Guest have to park by rental office. I pay my rent & still have not been able to utilize the pool(has not been opened since summer of 2014), fitness center has not been opened, there's really nowhere for kids to play(playground area is awful), new management not too friendly(only to some).

There were roaches in the apartment when we moved in as well as rats everywhere outside! We dealt with a huge mold issue and they never gave us the results due to the ongoing issue of untreated mold my husband suffered a really bad asthma attack beware!!

Beware of RATS not mice inside and outside these units. Property management is very unbothered by this public health issue and instead of fixing the issue they pacify you by sending maintenance instead of a true pest control company. Been dealing with rats for almost 2 months and they are still getting in. Some neighbors don’t help by keeping trash outside on their porches which is a feast for this pestilence. Think twice about moving here unless you want Ben and friends shacking up with you rent free. No one should have to live in fear and filth from rats no matter how cheap it is.

A new management company (Gate Hudson) has taken over the past few months and has done an amazing job. They have replaced the roofing and continue to keep the grounds clean. The maintenance staff comes fairly quick when request are entered or if there is an emergency. Riley in the office has also been great help. I was a little skeptical when they initially took over because the property managment company doesn’t have the best reviews. However, they have made it a better place. * Great location, good schools, and decent pricing for the area and spacious units!!

Canterbury Square Townhomes are great.The staff is friendly the units are beautiful maintenance is punctual. The neighborhood is very quiet close to a lot of stores. Dunkin Donuts ,7-Eleven ,and the post office in walking distance .Short Pump shopping district is 5 minutes away in a car.When I first came to Canterbury Square. I didn't think I would be approved my credit is not the greatest so I was very nervous. That's when I met Gina the property manager she was great. She made me feel so comfortable in the process of applying she was very caring and helpful.She did all she could for me to be approved.She treated me as if she knew me and was just helping a friend. Then I  ended up meeting her boss Miss Cindy who also was very caring and helpful long story short I was approved .They were so friendly they gave me hugs when I got approved. I met some of the other staff after I moved in and they were just as professional and attentive to my needs. I love my townhome I wanted to live in a house. So l thought that if I wasn't in a house I wouldn't be completely satisfied . Little to my surprise I would be. My town home was fully renovated ,stainless steel appliances,dishwasher ,microwave ,beautiful gray wood floors, in the kitchen and dining room .Laundry room, and a bath and a half. Nice little back porch with room for chairs and umbrella table .Very nice size bedrooms nice size closets . Beautiful wood grain in the bathroom cabinets as well as the kitchen cabinets. A pool for the residence along with a play house that's being built. If you are looking for a beautiful place to live, a quiet neighborhood, great staff ,and close to lots of stores. Canterbury Square is the perfect place for you to call home. I love it and the staff is great thank you Miss Gina and Miss Cindy and staff for making my process stress free you guys are awesome. Keesha!!!!

Since Greenbrier Management took over and hired a new property manager and leasing professional, the property is really turning around. They are passionate about what they do and you can tell they are here to help their residents. Maintenance is prompt and courteous.

New Management (Greenbrier Management) is really excellent. I know they just started, but they have been extremely accommodating thus far. Their friendly staff are very welcoming, and on top of everything. From quick turnaround on maintenance calls, to a very responsive office staff. 5 stars to them!!

I lived there for four years. And while it was dated, the property manager and company at least were consistent and made sense. About a year ago a company called UPA bought the complex. The threatening letters of fines and rules came immediately. They disabled the online payment site and then drastically changed the hours to M-F until 4pm. Who doesn’t have Saturday hours? Most apartment offices have Saturday hours! Their staff was a revolving door, you talk to someone about an issue one day, they’d no longer be with the company the next. When I moved I left my apartment spotless after paying professional cleaners. I have video. I had some holes in the wall from pictures that I plugged. I even wrote an email to the property manager about damage they were responsible for fixing that they didn’t. I took a video and pictures of my move because they refused to do a walk thru on my move out date and wanted me to come on a Tuesday at 11 am like I don’t have a job.  They refused to give my deposit back and I am looking to sue due to the physical evidence I have and email correspondence with JR, who of course...no longer works there. Their upgrades are simply slapping paint over moldy cabinets and shiny knobs so you can see the BLACK MOLD I had coming out of my vents or the water coming through my walls from upstairs. Air does not filter upstairs so prepare to be hot up there. They don’t give you adequate notice before they come in a force service and fees on your home for upgrades you are supposed to have. Maintenance is a joke. The walls are thin and twice a neighbor has hit my vehicle and the property manager does nothing. DO NOT MOVE HERE.

Used to be ran great until new management bought it in October 2018, since then they have been saying multiple times they will have an online way to pay rent in 1-2 months, that was being said in October 2018 it is now August 2019. Still no way to pay rent online like we used to have. On top of that no one is in the office friday through sunday, so if you work like most people good look paying rent, they also say now any payment after the 1st is late when it was fine before between the 1st and 5th. Now if you pay rent after the 1st you are charged a late fee.So good luck paying rent if the 1st falls on a weekend when people actually have time off work. On top of that they mailed me a notice saying if any mini blind is slightly damaged we are charged a ridiculous fee. My mini blinds looked almost brand new. As if mini blinds are expensive to begin with.There are plenty of other options around the same price in the west end, so if you want good management and being able to pay your rent in the modern usual way I would suggest renting somewhere else.

This place has gone to crap! Last year a new company bought out the apartments and it's gone to hell living here I feel like I'm not welcome in my own home!! They send out letters saying they are checking to see if we replaced our broken blinds if not by certain date maintenance will be replacing for 10 dollars per blind and an 89 dollar labor fee! On top of that they sent out a letter yesterday saying now they want us to give them money to do background checks on the people that already live here????!!! I CANNOT WAIT TO MOVE FROM THIS PLACE STAY FAR AWAY UNLESS YOU LIKE FEELING UNWELCOME IN YOUR HOME!!!!!!!!!!!

Wanted to give ZERO stars. They never pick up the calls, never return calls, they do not respond to mails back even if you travelled 300 miles to look at the apartment and would like to reserve one. I am glad I don’t live here.

,we talk to them 5 times about it they never fix it , there excuse was there is allot of apartments have this problem , we waiting to do all of them one time , i am ready to move out of here ,too many problem in this apartment.

I lived in one of the 1bdrm apts for about a year and a half while I was working in downtown Richmond and I loved it!  The office staff was always very friendly and helpful, especially Logan who walked me through the application process and then helped me again when I was moving out to make sure that everything was taken care of.  The location/commute is outside the city but absolutely worth the price and the peace and quiet that comes with living outside the city rather than downtown. The neighborhood is nice and very kid-friendly, mostly families I think, even though I was a young adult living by myself. The apartment itself was the perfect size for me and everything worked fine. Maintenance was courteous and quick to fix the one issue I had with a leaky sink. I would absolutely live here again if I ever move back to Richmond!

I lived at Canterbury Square Apartments from July 2013-June 2015. Out of all the places I have lived over the years, I absolutely loved living here and only left because I got a new job in another state.  Logan was my leasing agent and Wendy was the manager in my second year there. From beginning to end, the customer was excellent and they have a very fair lease where you can break it for any reason with 60 days notice...with no penalty. They only want people in the community that want to live there and trust me you will!  Canterbury Square, thanks for being so wonderful!  Even in 2017, I still miss you guys!

Sue M

This is a great neighborhood for both individuals and families. The neighbors appear to be friendly and social. The maintenance staff responds within reasonable time after a request, and the management staff have been attentive and friendly thus far. The property is well maintained. The location is close to malls, multicultural restaurants, highways, the post office, hospitals and local convenience stores. There's a large swimming pool with lounge chairs and tables and spacious grounds for children to play outside. Unlike other apartments/townhouses, the rooms are very spacious.
The office staff were well-informed and very helpful. I did not walk through a model, but I drove through the complex, which seemed clean and quiet.

Has to be the easiest move ever. The office staff  is great and available. The Apt was clean no evidence of any creatures building seems guiet. No complaints I even got it at a cheaper rate than quoted.
Longtime resident. Great community! Well kept grounds and the staff are courteous and professional. Excellent maintenance service. And neighbors look out for each other.

I have been trying to move in for a while now, But no one EVER answers the phone. I have had them call me back but my phone only rings once and they hang up. I called back within the same minute and still received no answer. I had to go to the leasing office and practically bang on the door just to get someone to answer a couple of my questions. At this point, I’m not sure how I would move in and how to speak with someone. They have left no voicemails, or emails so I have very limited knowledge on how much the move in fees are. I filled out 2 applications and still have yet to receive a call back or an email or SOMETHING!! This may be a good place to live, but their communication is HORRIBLE!!
Maintenance really good work orders are done plenty fast

The apartment complex itself is nice and comfortable. However, every since the Pandemic has started the office staff has been very distant with communicating with the residents. I understand whole heartedly the importance of practicing social distancing and keeping the residents and staff safe. But the staff here at Reserve South has taking this opportunity a bit far. I watch from my apartment window new and old residents having to wait outside the renters office as if they are not a valued renter to sign papers or just ask general questions. The staff acts as if everyone who steps at the door is some sort of contagious resident. I have toured other properties recently and they too are practicing social distancing like self guided tours etc. but all guest and residents are still welcome inside the office and greeted with respect. Recently I came into the office to inquire about an upgrade, the door was open so I proceeded to come in. The property manager looked shocked and informed me that no one is still allowed into the office. Prior to coming into the office I called multiple times and left a voicemail and no one had reached out to me. So I thought coming into the office as a valued resident who has always paid my rent on time was not a problem. Instead I was talked to as though I was some sort of contagious resident. Everyone is out here risking their lives at work to keep the country going so why do they feel as though they can sit in the office and not greet or welcome residents by keeping the office door locked. As I mentioned before I called multiple times prior to coming in. I just feel as though if it is so unsafe to work, work from home. It’s rude and it’s not inviting at all. I don’t feel appreciated or respected as a resident. During this whole pandemic the staff has become difficult to communicate with. I see so many future residents signing their leases outside in the rain/cold as the office staff stands in front of them inside the building while they sign papers. It is very disturbing, if we are so contagious why still take out money.

Moving here was the best decision I made. Its definitely worth the money. I love seeing that the property is maintained frequently, trash is picked up from the property, dumpster are conveniently placed and is emptied regularly, there is a trash valet service, maintenance request are responded to within 24 hours, the maintenance staff is amazing, alarm systems were added, and there are plenty amenities.

Bright! Yes, I was.....for moving here a few years back. 
Take a Right or left from the parking lot and your needs are met. A major supermarket, an aquatic center or a major highway, one or two exits on which leads to banks, restaurants, a major hospital and fun!
Ok....enough about outside what about the apartment complex itself?
Tight! Beautifully maintained grounds under the oversight of one who knows everyone's name and they his.
Night! Well lit patios with outdoor lighting galore.  Yes, the rooms are 
comfortable even for my large pieces of furniture.
Conveniently located electrical outlets on all walls. 
Cabinets are ample in the kitchen and bathroom. 
My bath has four double doored cabinets with a brightly and stylishly lit basin area.
The bedrooms....eye appeal abounds as each wide bedroom closet has French doors (on hinges) and is enhanced by the brightly lit double wide windows. 

ACCESSIBILITY, BEAUTY and CONVENIENCE in and out! A, B, C.
So, if you are looking for the  ABC's of apartment living in a senior development? Look nor farther! Be concerned no further!

cons: the roof leaks every time it rains. ventilation is poor as most units have no openable windows, so dust and mold are big issues. youll have to replace your units air filter at least once a month, so i recommend getting an air purifier. we tested the water after developing sores/rashes only to find out its hard water.

when we first moved in, they gave us a different unit than the one we toured. this unit had a light fixture missing, a broken garbage disposal, a broken dishwasher that had to be replaced, a dented dryer with a clogged vent (once it was fixed the dust just exploded over the top bedroom, due to horrible ventilation), and we found pre-rolled joints in both closets, indicating no cleaning had been done prior to us moving in.

the wifi here is horrible. outages are a regular occurrence. the walls are paper thin, so you will hear everything that happens both in and outside the building, from neighbors being intimate to dogs barking at all hours of the night. its not uncommon for the ceiling to leak, as there are many cracks in the ceiling of the unit. and of course no openable windows. not only does it make the dust and mold issues worse, its a huge fire risk. apparently code violations do not apply to the building thanks to the grandfather clause, so nothing can be done about it.

bugs are also an issue. spiders, centipedes, and a few gnats. there are some small holes in the bricks, so dont be surprised to find a new buddy or two when you first move in. pest control comes once every month or so to spray a few entryways and nothing else. sometimes theyll forget to treat your apartment and youll have to request they come outside the batch appointment, and even then they barely do anything.

lastly there are issues with break ins in the area. not to mention people speed a lot in the area, and accidents are not uncommon. our car had its bumper ripped off from street parking recently in a hit and run and there was nothing we could do about it. make sure you have full coverage car insurance. lot parking is paid and towing is enforced, its not cheap. theres also sewage leaks outside. you may hear construction outside throughout the day, and road closures for construction are common.

management and maintenance is difficult to get a hold of unless you follow up multiple times. be aware theres a lot of personal responsibility placed on the tenants to care for the apartment. read your lease carefully.

pros: located by some lovely parks.
Apartments is trash management is even worse and it is infested with mice.
The management is terrible, walls are paper thin, and parking is terrible. Be aware!

The staff they have here will always make you feel welcomed! They always make residents the number one priority! I will definitely recommend them to any of my friends and family looking for a good place to live!

Management is not helpful. Emergency maintenance does not respond in acceptable amount of time. After a small flood happen in my apartment, repairs were not done properly. After being told I can move out due to evidence of standing water, I was not returned my rent nor deposit. The management team has been a avoiding all calls and emails. 

Look at other complaints, similar stories.
Trash is all over the place for days. Not a clean place. People breaking into your cars. People selling drugs .  No place you would want to have your child.

If you're looking for something clean and with newer appliances but with an affordable rent for two then I would recommend this property. However just keep in mind they do lawn work early mornings Monday through Friday so if you work the night shift you'll be woken up every Tuesday at least at 9am as they mow the grass. Maintenance is unavailable on weekends and really unavailable period. Since living here for the past two years the dishwasher has not worked and I have written letters and called and left messages but after 2 years so I'm still sitting here with the same broken dishwasher. We had mold in our bedroom ceilings both years we lived here and had to get that repaired and cleansed twice. The bathroom sink upstairs has been leaking since I moved in I have called and I have written letters and it has not been fixed the kitchen sink has broken twice the second time in January and I have called and written letters and have yet to have a working kitchen sink so I have to boil water to clean my home. Slowly but surely this place hard to fall apart after I moved in and the office and maintenance only care about if your rent is on time they don't care about anything else.
They have rats, German roaches, and palmetto bugs. Residences treat this place like the projects so nothing ever changes.

Besides there being literally no amenities, everything leaks the ceiling, the furnace, the sinks. You will battle rats, roaches, children screaming underneath your windows, trash everywhere. The parking is horrible. There is literally NOTHING good about these apartments. Words can’t describe how horrendous my experience has been here…and they have the audacity to raise the rent with no changes. Artcraft Management is the absolute worst.
the maintence staff is wonderful jerry head of the department he tries to get your issues fixed as promptly as possible just a great staff at mallard greens wonderful place to live
The staff has been wonderful. The leasing person kept my application and was helpful. Maintenance was helpful to show me how to use my thermostat and other little things

My ceiling leaks every other week. Instead of fixing it maintenance just patches it up. Only for it to leak again. Work orders for maintenance just sits there for months with no fix. Everything is falling apart inside my apartment due to poor foundation. Cracks form in the ceilings, the doors never stay on track, people have Pitt bulls here and management does nothing about it. After living in a single family home for decades, I wasn't sure how I would like an apartment. After a year and a half at Lava Lofts, I can say that I am 100% sure I made the right decision!  This is a wonderful place to live, with residents ranging from college students to retirees. There is a sense of camaraderie and community thanks, in large part, to the wonderful staff. Concerns, comments, and requests are all handled efficiently and cheerfully by the wonderful team of Kim, Lindsey, and Mark. They also host seasonal events throughout the year which add to the lovely atmosphere.
 
All apartments are a beautiful blend of historic and modern features. I originally moved into a ground floor apartment which was comfy and cozy!  I then decided that I needed an extra bedroom for guests and moved to a second floor unit which is sunny, spacious, and just perfect for me.

This is a pet friendly building and my dog loves his new friends and the park just across the street. Not sure he feels the same about the dog wash, but I love it :-)

One of my main considerations while looking for a new home, was the walkability of the environs. Within just a few blocks, there are at least 10 restaurants, coffee shops, and bakeries. Expand that radius to just less than a mile and that number jumps to at least 25. Two small groceries, a pharmacy, and a full-service grocery store are also found within walking distance. Chimborazo and Libby Hill Parks, a dog park, and the James are in your backyard and festivals and other community activities abound. 
 
With so much activity, you may think that parking would be difficult but that is far from the case. Street parking is plentiful and there is also a lot for Lava Lofts residents just steps from the building. 

All in all, this is the 'best of the best' if you are seeking a vibrant community, a chill city location with green spaces, a walkable neighborhood, a great building and staff, and neighbors that can't be beat!  Come join us at Lava Lofts!

My wife and I searched the whole of Richmond looking for the right place to live. We chose Lava Lofts for 100 different reasons and we have never looked back! Not having a backyard has never bothered us because we are literally next door to the giant Chimborazo park, where we take our dog every day. The staff go above and beyond for all the residents living here. Work orders are completed that day by the maintenance team. Kim and Lindsey downstairs are problem fixers and truly wonderful people!

We've been in the Lava Lofts for nearly 2 years now and have already signed our third year lease. I truly cannot imagine living anywhere else in Richmond. From the absolutely incredible and kind staff who make you feel at home from your first tour, to the amazing location in the heart of Church Hill, our favorite Richmond neighborhood, Lava Lofts has it all. Any maintenance is handled immediately–Kim, Lindsey, Mark and Aaron really do take pride in making the living experience the best it can be. The facilities are great and include an epic rooftop where you can see the RVA skyline, a gym, free Starbucks coffee machine, free parking, complimentary cable and internet in all apartments and common spaces and even a dog wash room. It's extremely pet friendly, and they even bring in Santa at Christmas to take pictures with your pets for free. The location is in a family-friendly area of Church hill right across from a massive park and within walking distance of 10  restaurants. Overall, we truly believe this is the best apartment complex to live in Richmond and recommend it to anyone looking for affordable and pet friendly accommodation in the area.

I have been a resident at lava lofts for year now and I love it. Having lived in several buildings/ dealing with different leasing offices in Richmond for the past ten years, I can absolutely say this is the best it gets. The building is well maintained and offers many amenities. They recently replaced all of the carpet in the hallways, and have someone constantly cleaning the halls/ outside grounds. There is a dog washing room, free coffee, roof access, gym, and a club room. The building is completely pet friendly. This year they decorated the downstairs lobby with a Christmas tree with pet ornaments and offered pet pictures with Santa for the residents. They also had a Halloween and Christmas door decorating competition. Kim and Lindsey manage and lease the building and are always easy to get in touch with. This summer when my air conditioning went out in 100 degree weather, they had someone in my apartment within the hour to fix it, and even checked in with me to make sure everything was working. When my dog was sick and I was worried about him being home alone, I called leasing and Lindsey checked on my dog for me and sent me updates to let me know he was okay while I was at work. They are also great about notifying you ahead of time if someone has to enter your apartment. This is above and beyond what is required of them. The building is full of young professionals and there has never been a noise issue while I have been here.

I had never lived in Churchill before, but I could not have chosen a better location.

The actual unit was quaint, but more than enough space to live. My unit had a better kitchen than most houses I have been in, plenty of storage space, washer & dryer, and I never had an issue with any aspect of the unit.

The building is in a safe part of Churchill, hardly a block from the park.
Other tenants are a mix of yuppies and stoic forty-somethings. I never had an issue with any of my neighbors, and
no one was ever loud past a respectable hour. 

There is a coffee/hot chocolate machine in the lobby, a dog wash(lots of dogs!), conference room(great for events, watching
sports or your favorite TV show, or getting away to relax), and my favorite, the rooftop observatory with the best view of Richmond I have seen in my 27 years.

Shockoe Bottom(entertainment hub of Richmond) is only a fifteen minute walk away.
There is a corner store only a few blocks away, and several low-key, delicious places to eat.

The building itself is modern, secure(key fob) entrances, very dog friendly, and there is always something fun going on( Halloween door contest, Christmas toy drives) and the gym while compact, has everything even the hardcore gym rat would need. 

Kim & Lindsey are typically in the front of the building M-F during traditional business hours.
It was clutch to be able to walk into their office if I ever needed anything.
Both women are exceptional at what they do, they were always helpful and swift to address a concern, and they were more
than accommodating during my tenancy.

As long as you take care of your unit and clean it thoroughly, you can expect a full deposit return and none of the games many
rental companies(Metro Properties) like to play. 

I moved out only because I am moving out of state, I have zero trepidation suggesting Lava Lofts to anyone, and will likely
be moving back myself once I return.

Yes, I did look at the apartment I was moving into and knew the appliances were a little old, which was fine. However, upon using these appliances I realized that maybe having older appliances wasn't such a good idea. My dishwasher is starting to dry rot at the bottom and I refuse to use it. The microwave takes forever to heat up my food and when it is heated there's still some cooler parts of my food due to the fact the microwave does not contain a spinning plate. One day when I was cleaning out the microwave I took a glance at the manufacturing information and realized this appliance was made back in 1988.... 3 years before I was born. Another issue I have with this apartment is that the water stinks. I know that's a strange thing to say, but on multiple occasions I have used the water to wash my clothes or simply wash my hands and it has a putrid rotten egg smell. I will say maintenance is great here and have been kind enough the flush the water pipes in my apartment to try in aid in the issue. I share this review with a sense of delicacy, one striving to be honest and provide some social good to others seeking a review while recognizing that higher demand of what is good makes my life in retirement somewhat more difficult, as higher demand tends to drive up costs.  That said, I have lived in a third floor studio at The Edgar at Linden Row for approximately eleven months, and I hope my successor shares my adoration of it.  

Charm. On many occasions, I have approached my home at The Edgar on Linden Row with a sense that I was living in a beautiful movie.  The white of snow against the red bricks, black fence, and green Ivy and Magnolia leaves; the majestic Magnolia tree unique to our courtyard on the row, a tree that blooms firm, white flowers in Spring; the two red chairs in the courtyard that remind me that home is a place of rest and peace; and more recently, the courtyard, which had been destroyed by tenants who allowed their dogs to convert a beautiful courtyard into a dusty dog park with holes and daily urine on the fence and sidewalk, was recaptured (the destructive dogs are gone), revived, and adorned with plants and stones.  For most of my time here, it has been relaxing to come home, and perhaps I will most miss the charm of this place and the smile that often spread lightly across my face as I approached it most days.

Energy efficiency.  I had never previously lived in a home with an energy efficient stovetop and heater, and I experienced a mild adjustment period with that.  After a few days or weeks, I not only adjusted to lower-heat cooking temperatures, but I intend to use lower heat temperatures to cook going forward, even with a conventional stovetop.  I also discovered that I sleep better in cooler temperatures, so I rarely used my heater.

Staff: Management's customer service, together with the charm of this place, are enough to make me consider life-long tenancy here.

Neighbors:  Currently, my neighbors are pleasant and respectful of the shared house-like environment. If you decide to make this place your new home, I hope you continue to respect the timeless delicacy of peace.  Some of us need it.  I am relocating to another state, but should I return to Richmond, Virginia some day, I hope to find that you have respected this place I presently call home.
