Management is okay, but they don't care if you were a victim of credit card fraud, and about 60% of your money was taking out of your account, and you were never late on rent but just this time(which was my case), you will still have to pay their 10% late fee.

Other than that, the Morton building is a great place to stay if you're going to pay your rent on time every month don't matter what.

While they are reasonably priced, you get what you pay for. 

The office staff and maintenance are very slow to take action. You will have to keep calling over and over to get a service performed. There is limited parking, so if you have guests, they will likely have to walk far if they don't catch a visitor spot early. It gets really dark at night and there are not enough lights on the property to keep the community well lit. There's a roach infestation. Several tenants have complained. The floors squeak when you walk around upstairs and so do the stairs. The appliances are outdated.

Reasonable priced 2 bedroom town homes in a small community. Units REALLY need to be renovated at the very least with new appliances. Visitor parking is limited in the summer time due to the residents having to use the visitor spaces because of the tree sap falling on our cars when parked in our assigned spaces. Try cleaning sap off a car .. no fun!

My father, now 84, has been living in a single room Brookdale efficiency apartment for well over 15 years now. He has watched his rent steadily increase every year from $550 to $750 without any change to the amenities he's received. My dad is on a fixed income from social security, which helps pay for his prescription meds and frequent doctor visits related to his COPD, severe anxiety, balance issues, and neuropathy.

Brookdale Apartments has repeatedly told him the rent increase pays for renovations and improvements to the units in his neighborhood. But, unless something was broken, his tiny studio has not been updated once since he moved in over a decade ago. However, most of the apartments around him have been fixed up with new interiors, appliances, roofs, etc... So, my dad must simply be helping to pay for other tenant's renovations?

Brookdale has stated they will not update my dad's apartment until he moves out. They also will not decrease his rent, despite the fact that his living space is so much less adequate compared to those around him. This is no way to treat anyone, let alone a senior citizen and a veteran with serious health issues on a fixed income.

My apartment community is clean and the maintenance does a good job of addressing issues. The manager of the complex is also a very sweet laid back, but attentive person. She responds to emails and phone calls very quickly.  The location is great for a person with a vehicle or without. We are on the border of Henrico,VA and Richmond, VA. Plenty of interstate access within 5 minutes. One grocery store right next door, another across the street and another one less than a mile down the road. Plenty of shopping and anything you need. It's really a perfect location.

I only have two issues.  One I've had is some of the most resistant ants I have ever encountered.  I noticed them the day I moved in and they have done everything to rid me of the problem, but nothing is working.  The second is the a/c.  It is the kind you find in hotels. Part of it sits outside and the other inside. I think it's called ductless.  It's loud and has my electric bill for a 250sq ft unit upwards of $50/month.  As soon as I turn it off, it's warm almost immediately which may have something to do with insulation or lack thereof. So, those are the issues.  

My apartment is a studio and it is furnished.

I lived in Deering manor for little under a year and I absolutely hate it. The hallway always smells like pee due to whatever my neighbors have going on. The walls are extremely thin, there is absolutely no privacy. The building is run down, the maintenance of the complex as a whole is horrible.  Its a terrible area with loud and rude people. To top it all off I can never find a decent parking space in front of my home. It is the most ridiculous thing ever. For me to have to park down the street from my house is completely unacceptable. Everyone should have at least one assigned parking spot in front of or at least close to their building but they don't. Visitors crowd the parking lot and it's just overall terrible. I wouldn't recommend anyone live here unless you are single and desperate.

My apartment is nice n cozy spacious kitchen and living room. It is located near downtown Richmond n various other stores and schools. It has  pool area for the residents. Has a very understanding staff that works in the rental office and a maintenance crew that be on call when ever there is a problem.

I have lived here at Deering Manor for quite a while and find it to be a wonderful place to live. The community is a quiet one and I haven't seen any drama going on. No guys hanging on the outside except for children who play and ride their bikes in the evening but during the day when kids are out to school you can almost hear a pin drop except for the trains that go by in the distance now and then.

There are several buildings in the community and most buildings has two apartments downstairs and two upstairs. The amenities are basic yet modest. Alot of units were just renovated so they are pretty decent with the newer ones having granite counter tops. Some apartments has dishwashers, others don't. You can rent a stacked washer/dryer from the office or you can have your own. Office staff is friendly especially Ms. Lawrence(manager) and maintenance comes in a timely manner.

Utilities are gas and electric but water is included and you will need renter's insurance which is less than $15 monthly. We have the option to pay our rent online. The units are a little on the smaller side but comfortable. You may have carpet or wooden floors and there are screen and blinds at every window. All in all it's a nice place, very tranquil surrounding and we the residents have access to on property laundry all year round and a big pool in the summer months. I am glad that I made the decision to be here. Nobody bother me and I don't bother them.
Building 3901 Resident

Moved in April 2023 with my toddler and pup. The neighbors have been super friendly.  Maintenace is quick to get items taken care off. The office team is very responsive. My toddler and I had so much fun at the saltwater pool this summer.  We just enjoy strolling through the community. I truly enjoy my coming home to this place, very calming.

Upcharge for 1st floor
A lot of foot traffic between properties.
Appliances don't match.
Units needed upgrading  SERIOUSLY
Cleanliness lacking at move-in
Property required a lot of repairs in 2018- sidewalks , wires showing, fences down, wood decayed
Marijuana issues -call the police not the property
Car vandalism
Front door allowed mouse and bugs into the apartment and property could not fix problem.
Unauthorized visits by vendor and maintenance
Pool wide open for anybody to access-pool was trashed
No  ceiling light in living room
Dog park -sure its a dog park in my sarcastic voice
Perk-location /ample parking
Suggestion-see your apartment BEFORE signing the lease

I wish that I had read more reviews on this place before we'd moved in. The list of unacceptable behavior and lack of cleanliness goes on for miles. The comments about a bug problem are understatements. We have had a cockroach problem since we moved in. They have started biting my boyfriend's left eye in his sleep, causing it to swell. They also bite him when he tries to pick them up with tissue to flush them down the toilet. This is an issue that has never been resolved despite multiple emails and conversations. On top of this, I am 98% sure that the building we live in is not up to code. The walls are literally sagging in, there are giant cracks in every wall, and the bedroom floor is sinking. Their response to this has been less than adequate. Their response to the cracks was to paint over them. Their response to the sinking floor was to spray foam insulation in the crack, which is no help at all. We have had to fix all but one maintenance issue because their is no response or the maintenance team will straight up tell you 'no'. Do not rent here. Run the other way.

My wife & I love it here! Since we’ve been here we’ve had no issues with any pests, the only thing is the appliances were a bit old, but maintenance came quickly to fix the issues. Our neighbors are very friendly & considerate, the environment is clean. The property is not on the newer side, but in our experience the renovation team was very professional & tidy. I recommend Sundance to anyone looking for a good apartment, with a nice neighborhood, in a nice area for a reasonable price.

Cheaply renovated. I’m positive you can get better quality for your money in surrounding complexes in the area. Management is nice but that’s about all they have going for them. They avoid handling any complaints at all costs. We’ve been told on several occasions to utilize the non emergency police line for excessive noise and smoke smells. If you’re moving in to 3516 F enjoy your neighbor that chain smokes inside which comes through the ventilation everyday to make your apartment smell like cigarette smoke. Management did the bare minimum and could’ve cared less to try and fix this ventilation problem. Like previous people have stated when renovations are done they contract out companies who could care less about the residents living inside dealing with noise and the mess they leave behind.

When they were replacing the roof, roofing tiles were thrown on our balcony and no one came to fix it. Roofing nails were everywhere and all we got was an apology. We had to clean it up ourselves.
Parking is terrible especially late at night on the weekends. 
They left us with 2 space heaters that did nothing for 3 days when our heat went out when the temps at night were below zero. 
They ripped apart the balcony above us with a birds nest in it and left 3 dead baby birds on our balcony along with the nest and wood with nails everywhere.
Children play in the streets with no care for cars trying to park.
The outside of the apartments has paint peeling off the wood.
Our mailbox key stopped working and it took a month to get a new key.

I BEG you, do not move here! The building is not kept up at all. Very bad smells, people always soliciting in and around the building, homeless people sleeping in the hallways, the roof leaks when it rains and the management does not fix anything unless you constantly ask them to. As a woman, I do not feel safe here and I am ready to move as soon as my lease it up. I was persuaded to move here by the rent cost and accessibility to downtown BUT I truly regret this decision.

Please save your time, money and heartache. Do NOT move here!

Eagle Mill's location is great, in heart of VCU.  We had no problems at all with management. They responded to service requests and fixed whatever we needed  fixed. We did have to wait a couple of days for a part to come in, but that's not management's fault.  If the location works for you, I would recommend living here.  Price was reasonable, too, for our apartment.

This place just finds any way possible to take your money. We waited two weeks after move in to finally get our apartment cleaned (it was filthy at move in with bathroom stains, cob webs, dust, etc). At move out date we made sure to leave it in a clean condition so that the next tenants would not have the problem we did. However because we forgot to clean the inside of the oven they deducted $50 from our security deposit. Not the first time something like this occurred over the two years we lived here. Highly do not recommend living here
-FB.

I have never been more disgusted with an apartment property or with the people that manage it. Besides the fact that the staff is completely incompetent and negligent, I found mold in my apartment and after they ignored the issue, I sued and WON. What does that tell you?

Run! The staff of the Pondok Management is the horrible. They are lazy, disrespectful and don’t know how to run a realty office. They make up new rules that didn’t exist in the contract before and then reverse it if it serves their purpose. They don’t answer phone calls or emails or if they do it is always late. Be careful to read the contract word by word. The contract gets renewed automatically unless you give them plenty of notice time.   Basically, the management is made up of crooks and the staff are incompetent idiots. The apartment hallway floors and elevator are stained, dirty and smell bad. The front door security system is usually broken. They don’t take care of maintaining the building right. I will not recommend them and their apartments.

Let me start by saying the maintenance team is a one man band and he does the best he can and i appreciate that. He's the best part of TOC. Within an hour of me signing my lease i started to see roaches while i was cleaning and unpacking. I went back to the main office to let them know of the issue and that if they could not get rid of them , i needed my deposit back. The work orders get marked as completed when they've never been attempted to be resolved. They never answer the phone and never return voicemails but expect to get paid on time. There are like 6 visitor parking spaces throughout the whole complex. There is ALWAYS busted glass in the parking lot. I HATE living here. The space is tremendous and the complex has so much potential, but right now.......throw the whole complex away. I cannot wait to move!

She has a nasty attitude she never goes by the law she makes her rules as she goes and the maintenance guy keeps so much confusion going on with tenants I would not recommend these apartments to anyone. The grounds look awful

I just moved in and is already having problems with my apartment. I bring the issues to the manager and she gets an attitude. She has also gotten smart with me over the phone about such a small issue and charged me $500 because of the claim that my house "smelled" like dog (whatever that means). I would never direct someone to these apartments. I hate a bad attitude!

I am a tenant at Dutch Village have been for almost 4 years . I love the spaciousness of the apartment.The atmosphere is peaceful and the neighbors are friendly. The property manager and maintenance are superb! If you are looking for a suburb like environment than Dutch Village is the place to live.
I can't wait to move out. The people that owns this property doesn't care how their buildings look like. Just want your rent...

I have been living in Dutch Village who is owned by KRS Holding I really enjoy living there. They are great apartments.  They keep the grounds  looking awesome. I feel safe when I am at home . I would recommend these apartments to everyone.

Couldn’t believe i was able to find such a historic, unique, and luxury level apartment like this. The units are amazing and the rent is more than reasonable. The amenities are great and useful. Best deal in downtown cleveland for sure!

Yesterday me and my partner toured the apartment and absolutely fell in love. Our tour guide/ the leasing manager Deborah Elsamny was absolutely incredible really friendly and was ready to answer any questions we had. We will definitely be applying!
It is a really quiet apartment building which is rare in downtown area. The apartment itself is nice as well. The managers Deborah and Diana are very professional and friendly.

Expensive, and extremely UNSAFE! So small and not worth it given the location. Cars are broken into all of the time and the “Landlord” says he’s looking into it - why are there cameras if you cant pull up the footage? The rent RAISES every lease renewal and no option to go 6 month or month to month unless you want to tack on another 250$. Save your time, peace of mind, and especially money

Highly recommend! The large windows allow natural light to flood the rooms, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The kitchen is a dream—modern appliances and plenty of counter space. 

One of the standout features of Driftwood is its location -  walkable to plenty of restaurants and shops nearby, but it still feels quiet and serene inside. 

Overall, I’m thoroughly impressed with Driftwood and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a stylish, comfortable, and well-located home. It’s a true gem!

I've only been here for 3 days and I can already say that it is unlike anywhere I have ever lived. Not only is the staff friendly, but the residents are also shockingly considerate and friendly. I am obsessed with the way that our apartment came together, but also the entire building.

Our move in experience at Driftwood could not have been more amazing. Jessicas help and communication was a 10/10 which helped us navigate the whole process. The building is absolutely beautiful and our apartment is as well. We are so grateful to call this place home and can’t wait to enjoy all of the amenities it has to offer.
Moving in was so easy and everyone has been helpful and responsive. It is a beautiful building and apartment and I am looking forward to seeing the additional spaces that are in the works.

I love living at the Driftwood. I've never experienced this level of luxury in an apartment but it still feels low key and welcoming. My dog is also a happy camper and the washing station is a lifesaver.

I was super excited for this building to open when it was first announced, and it did not disappoint! The location is perfect and the building has a peaceful/earthy vibe. The property manager is very communicative and responsive. Great experience so far!
Love the design and finishes of this modern building. The units are so unique and spacious you feel like you’re in California or New York with how modern everything feels. Couldn’t recommend enough!
Still some ongoing construction but the property manager and maintenance have been so great
Love the neighborhood and the units are beautiful! And management is so nice.

You can't beat this location!!! Amenities are unbelievable, the units are extremely spacious with the highest ceilings in Tremont, and you truly can't beat the location! To top it all off, the management company is local and cares a ton about its residents. They are always onsite, extremely communicative and very responsive.
So far management has been great and communicative regarding property updates. Love the location and amenities (:
Moved in about a month ago and the building is beautiful and in a great location. Only 4 stars bc it’s not quite done yet but think it’ll be 5 starts once construction is over!

Such a unique space, you really won't find anything else like this. Great location in the heart of Tremont, attentive and helpful management, and the apartments feel very high-end. Really excited to be living here!

ZERO STARS I cannot put into words how horrible this place is and the management is even worse. Building is NOT secure, squatters living in empty units because the doors are broke. There was a fire in March and the hallways were flooded. They haven’t even bothered to clean up the mold, trash and nails after they took the carpet out of the halls. Didn’t have heat for over a month, AC doesnt work, maintenance closes requests without even checking, HOWEVER, the other day they came in without knocking, I was home and he just walked in. I didn’t have a maintenance request in and it also said not to enter if I wasn’t home, zero 24 hour notice. Management is horrible, they don’t respond. RUN RUN RUN the City of Cleveland needs to step in.

Very poor communication from management!They do not care about their tenants and they are so nonchalant about everything. I could go on and on. DO NOT MOVE HERE! By far the worst apartment building I ever lived in.
Worst organization in Cleveland! Unprofessional and rude! Stay clear of this location!!

I’ve lived here for about 8 months. I was looking forward to the pool and management said it would be open by Memorial Day. It is now the end of June and it is still closed. My apartment has a had a giant plastic cover on the far corner. This has been there for 2 months now. The wall is ripped out due to them fixing the A/C which has been down for 2 months as well. It has been scorching hot and the management team can’t give me a straight answer. Only one elevator has worked since I moved in.

I love everything about my new unit! The renovations are very well done, well thought out, and upscale looking. The staff is super friendly and helpful. The move-in special was the icing on the cake! :)

I was a bit skeptical as I had heard nothing good about the prior company running this place but things have changed with the new people who bought it.  My apartment looks brand new and they are continually adding new stuff and making it look really nice.  I can't wait for the new gym which they said would be ready very soon.
I can walk to school from here and not worry about need to drive!

This newly remodeled apartment is super nice. It looks like brand new! I like the new kitchen very much. It is very spacious and bright! All appliances are brand new and works well. In addition, I love the new wood floor. It looks clean and tidy! I really enjoy the newly renovated apartment!

Beautiful building in a great location! The luxury amenities  shows they really care for their tenants. The management team here were friendly and welcoming. Their move-in special made it easy and seamless for me!! Would definitely recommend this place!

Overall, everyone on the staff is great, the building is very nice, maintenance is available immediately and they are great! Only cons for me was no natural air/windows/balcony (which of course is just due to the building itself), and I received 2 noise complaints on the NFL Draft weekend at 9 PM because people were talking in the hall way. Great place overall but if you are young and like to have company, or be able to talk over a whisper, I would recommend somewhere in the warehouse district. In my opinion if you cant handle people talking in a hallway you should move to the suburbs instead of a apartment that is a hotel and has 3 bars.

This is a great place to live! The staff is very friendly and will go above and beyond to assist with any issues that come up. The leasing team are very transparent and friendly so felt like I could make a good decision to move here. There is so much to do both inside and nearby the apartment. It is perfect for me and my doggo who has adjusted well as it is peaceful and comfortable here.

I have absolutely loved my time and experience here. The building is clean and beautiful, staff is attentive, and maintenance usually comes same day. The amenities are a huge perk as well. I would HIGHLY recommend living here.

My husband and I spent 3 years living at The 9 and it was one of the best apartment experiences that we have had.  The appliances and construction of the apartments are top notch.  The 9 has great security (which was my main priority) and the staff is very personable.  Other residents are very nice and courteous.  We had a great living experience and I highly recommend!

Everything here is perfect from the amenities to the staff. We have lived in other mixed use/hotel apartments and this is the only one where the hotel staff provides equal attention to hotel and apartment guests. The maintenance staff is also fantastic here. Extremely responsive with any requests you have!
Love living here at the 9! It's extremely convenient and the people here are great! Highly recommend!

I have lived in the Boutique Suites at The 9 since February and love it. You can't have a more central, convenient apartment in downtown Cleveland. I can go grocery shopping at Heinen's, go to the gym, and enjoy 4 different bar/restaurant/lounges, all without stepping outside. 
The option to have room service right to your door is amazing on lazy days, and I often take advantage of the same-day dry cleaning service. I have only had 2 minor maintenance requests and they were both taken care of same day. 
Location-wise, I love the fact that I can walk to Browns, Indians, and Cavs games all within minutes, and my bank, office and pharmacy are all very close too. I plan to stay here for a long time!

I live here and couldn't recommend the facilities, amenities or, most importantly, people highly enough. I was really impressed upon move-in at the condition of my apartment: it's clear management have taken particular care of the space over the years. When I've had to submit for minor repairs, I've been blown away by how quickly and effectively building maintenance responds. Common areas are always pristine. The lobby and management staff are all soo nice, and take care to not only be helpful but also to curate community. My experience has been a 10/10 so far - complete satisfaction and absolute confidence I am getting my money's worth.

I’m about to enter my fifth year as a resident here, and at this point I can’t imagine living anywhere else in Downtown Cleveland. The units are great (I will never tire of the views), and the location right at the nexus of downtown’s two main thoroughfares (E. 9th and Euclid Ave.) is second-to-none. Shows in Playhouse Square and hundreds of food and retail options are all within a few minutes’ walk, and being able to pop down to the grocery without even leaving the building is the height of convenience. 

Even better, four bars and restaurants are all located WITHIN the building, so sometimes I don’t even have to venture outside. Adega is perhaps my fav restaurant, Vault is definitely one of the most impressive bars downtown, and the rooftop bar Azure offers some of the best views of the city (and serves as a great daytime escape for residents). And since it’s connected to a hotel, residents get access to all the same amenities: the gym, coffee bar, valet, and even room service + housekeeping if you want it. 

The staff here is top-notch and another big reason I’ve stayed for so long. Everyone is kind, attentive, and  just generally great. There’s a reason The 9 has won so many “best of” awards since it opened: it is!

The 1010 Building is truly located in the center of it all (between Playhouse Square & Public Square). It’s terrific to be in an apartment complex with concierge services, restaurants, rooftop bar, exercise facilities, massage spa, in-house theatre and a grocery store. Our front desk, leasing, security & engineering staff are among the very best!

Lived here for 2 years. Definitely the best downtown apartment complex. I believe Cleveland Scene has rated them #1 for 3 out of the last 4 years. Management puts on nice events every month. The indoor dog park is great for the cold weather. Can’t beat the location.

Cleveland is experiencing a boom. The 9 downtown was one of the first buildings to take advantage and provide higher end apartments in the area. However, as nice as the apartments are, management can be difficult to work with and the price is higher than market value.

I had an amazing stay at The 9, and an experience that I would recommend for any savvy professional busineman or woman. The realestate here is beyond my expectations. It's super clean, well appointed, and very modern in appearance. The entire facility inside and out looked fabulous and is well maintained. The staff are very professional, and they seem to take great care to ensure your time spent here short or long term is an unforgettable experience and that your evenings are quiet so all residents can have a good night's sleep. As everyone's knows the demand and expectations increase for high-speed internet, hotels occasionally fall behind in offering adequate bandwidth but not this property they keep up with consumer demand for faster "business-class" internet speeds. The pricing was very reasonable for the luxury to what you'd expect from a residence of this kind. If you purchase realestate at this property I guarantee the staff will do their best to ensure you feel like you got your money's worth.

- John Hughes Cleveland, Ohio Sept 12, 2015

I have lived at this property my entire time at grad school and it is the absolute best place for students to live. Also, the staff is extremely caring and helpful. Very pet friendly, clean, pretty, and perfectly located next to a delicious bakery, multiple nice restaurants, and small shops!

I have legit questions regarding the recent and terrible changes. The new people in the office are just bodies holding down chairs. The lobby stinks, elevators are dirty, we have no resident app, and the building has a depressing vibe. ???? My dog has gotten sick twice now from the large amount of dog poo all around the building. Communication doesn’t exist. I’m paying for Gucci and getting Walmart. 

You can “restore my satisfaction” by bringing back the other managers. The new ones are never in the office and all around selfish and unhelpful. My friend has been on the parking waitlist since August yet the new manager helped herself to open parking spots first. No interest in the residents and we’re treated as an inconvenience.

Bottled water, chocolates and small gift on move-in day. Flat carts to help with our move. Moving company was shocked! Basket carts offered to help us with our groceries. Packages delivered to our door. Free shuttle to and from airport. I travel often! Enjoy the staff/tenant parties every few months so that we can meet our neighbors. On-site management and a maintenance man who is fast and efficient.  Housekeeper does a great job keeping common areas spotless. They take pride in the building. It's the little things that matter and have made my stay here the last two years a pleasure.

If you are interning at NASA, this is your best bet. The GRC is walkable from here. This is a nice, modern building with amenities, a gym, and a community room. Additionally, the staff consists of some of the most pleasant and welcoming people I have ever seen. This is a great place to stay long-term.

I lived here for two years and loved it. Nice updated appliances and beautiful large windows. I especially appreciated the free airport shuttle service amenity. The building manager and maintenance team is awesome and quick to help. Definitely recommend!

Moved here from Downtown almost 10 months ago.  Very happy with my decision and peaceful in comparison.  My apartment was super clean, perfect and can't beat the price-point.  Put this place anywhere Downtown and monthly rent would jump a few hundred dollars.  My two maintenance requests were minor and handled quickly.  Super-friendly and attentive staff, even deliver packages right to your door.  Plan on staying put for a few years.
Loved my unit and living there! Really enjoyed all of the updated chic finishes. The building manager is the best!!

Great place to live, Dawn takes care of everything which is awesome. Very quiet throughout the whole building which is something we loved. When they get the pool built, I’m sure it’ll be even better. Gym is also good and empty most of the time. Recommend living here!

I recently had the pleasure of living in this exceptional apartment, and my experience was nothing short of fantastic. From the moment I stepped through the door, I was impressed by the modern, stylish decor and the flood of natural light that filled the space. The living area is perfectly designed for both relaxation and entertainment, blending comfort and elegance seamlessly.

What truly sets this apartment apart, however, is the staff. Every interaction I had with them was positive. They are incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional, always going above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay. Whether it was providing local recommendations, quickly addressing any minor issues, or simply greeting me with a smile, their dedication to excellent service was evident.

This apartment complex is amazing! The apartments are beautiful and spacious. The staff is awesome, and is extremely friendly and responsive to all needs. Great location, lots of things close by. Have loved living here!

This is an excellent place everything is new but the most important part is that management really care about the people and the comunicación is awesome. Sad to leave but work move me to another state.

I was one of the first tenants to move in & just renewed my lease. I absolutely love my apartment!  All the amenities advertised are not ready yet, however, it's been exciting to watch the progress over the year I've been here and can see the management team really works hard to make things happen & keep everyone happy.  A bonus to have a quiet building in a great location with plenty of green space for my fur baby.

If you have ever rented you know that finding good management is rare. However, the Centaur has knocked it out of the park with Dawn, Dave, and Danielle! Dawn is always easy to get a hold of and talk to. She is fantastic at making sure the tenants are informed and taken care of. When it comes to maintenance, things are taken care of quickly. If it’s not something Dave is able to fix on his own, they communicate quickly with outside companies and keep you in the loop on how things are progressing. Danielle had the apartment cleaned to the point I didn’t need to do a thing before moving in. It was spotless. She keeps the hallways and common places in excellent, clean condition. All three of them are genuinely kind and caring humans who just want to make the Centaur a wonderful place to live. The Centaur is a legitimate dog friendly community. Plenty of space to walk outside and soon there will be an indoor space for the same. Huge perk, in my opinion, there’s no fee for parking. The tenant has an assigned space and ample parking for guest. I’m hopeful for all of the additional amenities to come! If you are looking for a wonderful management team, a location you feel safe in, and a dog friendly community - the Centaur is it!

Nice to finally have un-lived in, brand new apartments on this part of the West Side. Nice, new everything! However, this place does gives me “haunted elementary school” type vibes. To my knowledge, construction on the units is complete, but the rest of the renovations for the complex is still under construction, which sort of gives it this cold feeling all throughout the hallways. The windows in the actual apartment homes do not open, but that’s because this is essentially a historic office building located across the street from the airport that’s been repurposed - a secluded area that’s sort of out the way, which may be a pro or con for different people. The windows were designed to help dampen any ambient noise that may come from the outside, and are the original windows that have been apart of the building for years. But overall, if you want a modern apartment home in the Brookpark area, that’s  minutes away from Rocky River reservation, the highway, etc…I’d go for it!
Could have been a great building but the windows do not open! I have asthma and need fresh air when cooking or just to breathe.

I moved into this building in June 2024, renting a 1-bedroom flat, and I couldn’t be happier with my decision. While the building is still undergoing construction, which has resulted in some delays and unfinished features, the staff has been incredibly patient and considerate. One of the highlights of living here has been the Wine Down Wednesdays — a fantastic opportunity to unwind and relax after a busy workday. The sense of community here is really strong, and the staff truly makes you feel like you’re part of something special.

A standout experience for me has been the exceptional service provided by the concierge team. I recently relocated from Massachusetts to Ohio and had to navigate some local processes like changing my car registration and license. Charles, the concierge, went out of his way to guide me through the process. Despite having a fractured foot, he even drove his scooter to help me swap my car plates. It’s little acts like this that really make you feel valued. Charles, along with Angel — the morning concierge — and the rest of the team, are always there to lend a hand. One memorable moment was when my wife’s parcel was mistakenly delivered to another building. Angel went out in the cold winter and personally tracked it down, getting it to us with a smile.

Additionally, I’ve had excellent experiences with Bob, the maintenance manager, who not only resolves issues quickly but is also a great resource for tips on navigating Ohio. Sheree, the cleaning lady, is always thoughtful and accommodating, and Sonia, the building manager, is approachable and genuinely cares about the residents' well-being. Despite the ongoing construction, it’s clear that the potential for this building is enormous, and I feel safe and comfortable here with my family. The staff’s dedication to making our experience positive, even during a transition period, makes this building feel like home.

Our experience has been extremely disappointing and if I could rate them zero stars I would. We came to the see the apartments in April while they were still under construction, signed a lease and we were led to believe that everything would be completed by July of this year (pool, rooftop, dog park, club house on the rooftop, balconies, etc.) we moved in mid June and of course non of the above has been finalized and it's not set to be completed until summer 2025!!! Now I can understand that the delays happen but a whole year? You provide false expectations with unrealistic dates to entice people to sign a lease only to have them wondering when theses amenities that you're paying for will be completed. We can't even access the balcony due to the fact that there is no handle to the door, which I believe is a fire hazard since there are no windows in the unit that can be opened, this is the very least you should be able to speed up. Management does not respond to emails or service requests just blatantly ignore everything.
This is a great place with great staff. If you want high quality and professional, this is the place for you. You can’t go wrong with either Ryan or Laurie in regards to your leasing needs.
Rita and Mykala were amazing! The whole renting process was so easy and my unit is beautiful!

My husband and I were initially thrilled about moving into this apartment complex. However, our enthusiasm quickly diminished after just three weeks of residency due to persistent maintenance issues. In the past two days, we have been grappling with a partial power outage, affecting the elevators, security gates, security doors, and hallways. The electric water heater failure has left us without hot water for two consecutive days, necessitating the use of literal ice baths for hygiene.

Despite receiving two misleading emails from management assuring a resolution by the end of the day, our apartment still experiences a partial power outage, with no hot water in sight as I write this at 9 pm. Attempts to reach out via email and phone calls to the provided numbers have been met with ignorance, including being hung up on or directed to voicemail, leaving us without any answers.

While the apartment space is appealing and conveniently located near downtown restaurants, the ongoing issues have become increasingly frustrating. This situation has reached a point where legal action may be necessary, reflecting our deep disappointment with the current state of affairs.

Hard to find any faults with this place- Have lived here for a few months and the staff is super helpful, with any issues been addressed within a couple days- Very quiet with well-insulated walls so I don't hear the neighbors- Great location and literally a 1-2 minute walk to a grocery store and multiple restaurants/bars- Exposed pillars add character and pay homage to the original structure- My guests are always impressed-
 Highly recommended

I walked in The Archer on a Tuesday afternoon looking for a place to rent ASAP.  I had an appointment the next day in which Amanda showed me several places.  After having invested so much money in renovations, the building looked incredible.  The "Welcome Home" sign in the leasing office was spot on- I knew this was my next home.  Amanda worked with the property manager, Amber, to get me moved in by Saturday- yes 3 days later.  The application process was smooth and easy too.  I can't say enough good things about the staff, the building, or the location.  I never thought I would live downtown, but I could not be happier.  If you're looking for the excitement of downtown living, white glove service, and a spot that is convenient to get to (even on days where there are multiple events going on) make sure to visit The Archer- you'll be impressed from the moment you walk in the door.

Love the unit. Love the location, but the place is infested with roaches. I moved in an found a roach my first week. I been here for 7 months and have had pest control come a total of 6 times and I STILL have the problem. Parking is expensive, and since it’s public, the resident assigned floors are always full. Almost impossible to find a spot most days. Besides these things, the apartment is nice

I’ve been living here for 2 years now and the staff has been very helpful. Whenever I have a concern there is always someone available to assist me in a timely manner. 

Maintenance services are great, Cinesta and the maintenance group do a great job of addressing issues usually within 24-48 hours.

I recently transferred into a different unit and the transition was very smooth thanks to Laura and Joe. They worked together to discover my needs and helped me find the perfect apartment. 

If you’re interested in moving to reserve square you should ask for Joe. He is very professional, responds quickly and courteously to any of my concerns, and even recommended a few restaurants in the area for my wife and I to try. 

Overall the new staff at reserve square is great!

I have been a resident here going on two years. 
I have recently upgraded to a three bedroom in the East tower. 
I had a few complaints in the West tower but they were taken care of ASAP. 
This moving transition went smooth thanks to Lacey and Laura. 
To all or whom may be looking: 
NO WHERE IS PERFECT!
You will find something wrong anywhere you move, look for what’s important to your lifestyle and go from there. 
I am happy here! 
The amenities kept me here another term. 
K &D take care of all there properties!

I recently moved to Reserve Square in August of 2015. Having previously lived in Chicago, IL for the past 8 years my expectations of high rise living was pretty set. The initial move in was a little shaky due to us having to move in a day earlier. The apartment wasn't initially ready for move in but...... they were so helpful and accommodating with meeting our requests in a timely manner and getting things fixed and up to my liking. The building itself is in an amazing location and has a lot of amenities at no additional cost. I also received a discount for being a Principal which I truly appreciate. This discount each month covers my utility bill which is a very nice added bonus. If you want the feel of downtown living at a reasonable price, I would definitely recommend Reserve Square.

First things first: you really can't beat Reserve Square's location. You're right around the corner from Play House Square (theaters and restaurants galore), a 5 minute walk from Heinen's Grocery Store, a 10 minute walk from the public library, and a 15 minute walk from Tower City Center. Pharmacies, banks, and other necessities are all within walking distance, as are fun things like bars and stadiums.

Reserve Square itself also has some pretty nice amenities: the convenience store on the first floor is surprisingly well stocked, having laundry in the building saves tons of time and effort, and the gym has plenty of weight and cardio machines.

The apartments are pretty standard: beige carpet and walls, vertical blinds. Appliances (microwave, fridge, dishwasher, garbage disposal, stove and oven) come included, and I haven't had a single problem with any part of my apartment since I've moved in. Maintenance usually responds pretty quickly if something does go wrong.

Now for the not so great stuff: the building is seriously understaffed. The staff is generally pretty friendly, though often frazzled because they're overwhelmed with work. The package room is ridiculously slow to process mail, the elevators are pretty much constantly in need of maintenance, moving in is hellish (there's no real freight elevator), and the in-building laundry is ridiculously expensive. 

In general: Reserve Square is not perfect and suffers from some organizational problems, but the apartments are pretty nice, the amenities convenient, and the location amazing.

The best part about this apartment is that the gym is actually pretty nice for an apartment downtown. And its included which is great, because I would need to find another gym for probably 40 bucks a month if this one sucked. Indoor pool is nice, but I never use it. Sometimes I feel like I'm the only one in the building that doesn't speak a foreign language just to mention in case that bothers you. Staff is nice but not a very nice apartment. I've seen cock roaches many times, even in the first floor lobby before you get on the elevators.

If zero stars were possible, I’d rate these apartments zero. The good reviews are totally fake, or they bribe residents for good reviews. Heat and A/C constantly went out and would take months to get fixed. Maintenance & management would go into apartments while residents were gone for “repairs” that would leave the apartments dirty & would eat food out of the fridge, on top of that they wouldn’t lock the door when they left! Multiple instances of package theft & apartments being robbed here. When moving in, the apartments were dirty. The parking garage door wouldn’t work half the time. It was almost impossible to get anyone on the management team to respond to emails or phone calls, they were hardly ever in the office on site too. All in all, just a terrible experience that I wouldn’t wish on anyone. Save your time and sanity, avoid this place or any complex under this management company.

I’ve lived in Cleveland for five years and this by far has been the best experience thus far! From working with the leasing company to find the perfect apartment, to the move in experience and to now living here they do a wonderful job. I’m really happy here- thank you MPG!!

The reviews are all true, avoid renting here if you can. Over the course of living here for 15 months we have had working AC and heating for less than half. Ohio Tenant Law states that heating must be provided, and yet, during the winter months we were without heating and into the spring without AC. To their very minor credit they did offer us $200 off on account of "disruption of the AC installation", even though we had requested $500/month for 3-months that the AC and Heat were not working.

After countless discussions with management, when they can be reached, they did not offer us any rent concessions for advertising an apartment that did not have working AC or heat. The management company finally decided to install units, but this is after over a year (and more if you read others experiences) of people complaining. Furthermore, management is hardly around and extremely difficult to reach making resolutions drag out and forcing tenants in a position where they risk hurting their credit if they don't pay rent for apartments that aren't as described. To add to this, none of our maintenance requests showing the numerous requests made are in the resident portal so you cannot review the previous requests made.

I don't write a lot of reviews because in general, I find things can usually be worked out. This is not the case here, and I would strongly caution anyone considering living here to find somewhere else. Given the cost and general condition of these apartments, you can do better for the same or less.

Let's start with the positives which doesn't change my 1 star rating. Underground parking is nice if you want to pay the $150 / month (spaces are very close together and close to pillars. Skyroom is cool but you will rarely ever go in it. Gym is better than nothing. It's small. Now the negatives. First off when I moved in back in October of 2021 I recall the building soliciting gift cards for anyone will to leave a positive review. That's unethical in my opinion but I get it. The correspondence between tenant and management is terrible. No record of my messages once sent and no one ever follows up. Literally never. I leave for out of town and usually my lights are on multiple times??? Turn my heat off, I come back and it's 85 degrees heat blaring. The heat wasn't working for a total of half a month in the cold of winter, I heard of a reimbursement from staff and nothing ever came. I've heard the air conditioning doesn't work either (hvac) but have not tested it yet. Same system so i'm sure it will be a hot mess (pun) intended. The hvac system is trash it never works but I still get charged and this month I got charged more than double for something that never works and randomly gets set to 85 degrees and no one responds to any messages about any of this. It's like they don't care and will just take your money. For what you pay you can do better basically anywhere else. DO NOT waste your money here. They do not care about their tenants from what I can tell. for me it's the massive lack of communication and doing what's right ahead of time. Not me having to complain and complain. It gets old.
Terrible what else can I say roaches and mice and they do nothing about it

Please beware! These apartments are roach and mice infested. My building was moreso roach infested which is why I decided to move out. They blame tenants instead of making sure they keep up with routine extermination. Tenants have to pay for their own extermination. I've complained several times to management with no resolve. The regional manager is a joke and has a very bad disposition. I was standing outside of the office one day and heard her telling the property managers to write good reviews online as if they are tenants. The property management is very unprofessional and you literally have to beg them to do what they are supposed to do. Maintenance request take months for a response (if they ever even respond). I paid for garage parking and my car has been broken into, which was a surprise bc this neighborhood is very peaceful. There are no cameras. 
The buildings are no longer under Brick and Mortar, they are under Athene Property management but they still have the same poor staff.
 The rent is too high for the dated ,poorly maintained, infested apartments. The units could be so much better with updates as simple as fixing holes, cracks, and paint. The floors are loud,it sounds like someone is walking your apartment but it was just the neighbors above me- no good foundation. 
Bottom line,don't move here. Since moving out my life has been so much better. The roaches were driving me crazy and I've spent hundreds on trying to o solve the problem that should have been solved by management.

Staff is impossible to get a hold of, even if you go into their office they have no answers and are unprofessional. Heat is not included, gas and electric is in your name and they charge $90 for water every month. Roach/mice problem, and all the windows are rotting/falling apart. Also recently added a $65 monthly internet charge even if you do not use the internet they provide you still get charged due to a clause in the lease saying they can do so. AVOID THIS COMPANY

The management is impossible to get a hold of, and when you finally do, they are rude and unhelpful. It often takes a month or longer to get simple repairs done. The building itself is infested with roaches and mice.

Building is infested with cockroaches and has mice that live in the walls and raid your pantry. Management is rude, unresponsive, and they raise the rent 10% every year despite not having upgraded my apartment at all.

The apartment is mice infested and the management won’t take care of it even after multiple complaints. They are driving out old tenant and slapping in vinyl laminates and renting at rents 50% higher calling it as upgrades when they are simply ignoring the mice living inside the walls of the building.

This apartment is an awsome place to live. It host a pleathra of immenities such as fitness center game room, conference area front door trash collection services, security area,  security doors and a secure gated parkin lot, and every thing is wheel-chair assessable.
The great part about living here other than all utilities including cable and unlimited internet being offered is the amazing staff.  The apartment manager  Miss Mcghee actively engage with tenants continuously seeking feedback.  This apartment is cozy and the people here are friendly and familiar.

I've lived here for almost 4 years now with my child. Management has been great. Both management and maintenance has promptly replied to any issues I've had. Crystol and Francesca are in charge of Management. Management has been extremely empathetic towards my struggles in raising a special needs child.  I have had no issues in recieving any accomdations I've requested.

Been living here since August and my girlfriend and I completely love it here. Healthline bus stop right out front of the building which I took downtown to and from work. This building is clean, security guards are nice and very alert, and property manager Katie is AWESOME! Everything downtown is anywhere from a 15 min walk to a 5 minute bus ride. We have went to many sporting events Cavaliers and browns games which we walked to and from the stadiums. The area is very safe I have never felt threatened at all walking around.

I lived in Innova for 3.5 years, and the quality of the apartment complex significantly decreased since management changed last year. I terminated my lease halfway through and moved to a different place. The elevators are constantly broken, the A/C is shut off during the winter and the apartments are extremely hot. The security is poor, as the parking garage is open for anyone to walk into, and there is a public parking lot behind the building that frequently attracts young people that shout and play loud music at night. While the maintenance and concierge staff were always cordial, the new leasing managers are unprofessional and disrespectful. 10/10 do not recommend.

Lived here for 2 years- management never followed up on any issues I had. When some of my belongings were stolen by their furniture rental partners (CORT Furniture) under their watch (they signed off on paperwork without making sure my personal things were not taken from my apartment), their response was “I don’t know what to tell you, sorry”. They promised they’d follow up, and I never heard anything from them. Additionally, notice that they respond to every poor review on here with some sort of passive aggressive comment - pretty telling. Everyone at Concierge (with the exception of Jeriah) was annoyed whenever asking to pick up a package or get an overnight parking pass. I truly felt like I was bothering them any time I needed something. Daytime parking for guests cost a lot of money especially over time. If you miss parking payment by minutes, you’ll receive a sticker on your window that’s very difficult to remove and leaves a bad residue. The only reason I stayed for so long was because of school. As soon as I graduated, I was out. I have never written a poor review for anything before, but living here has compelled me to warn others because I wish someone had said something before I decided to live here. Move out to the west suburbs, you’ll get a lot more for your money, it’s much safer, there’s a lot more to do, and you’ll receive better management.

I've lived at Innova for 2.5 years now. With any apartment complex, there are pros and cons, but at Innova, the pros far outweigh the cons. The building is a perfect location for Cleveland Clinic, the VA, University Hospitals, and Case Western. Even Metro Health is a short drive (10-15 minutes tops). It’s always clean and never noisy (being on call overnight means sometimes I have to sleep during the day and it’s incredibly quiet). My next door neighbor had a piano in her apartment for a year and I had no idea until she moved out. The staff are friendly and they’ve responded to all my maintenance requests very quickly (most in the same day). After internet, parking, and rent, yes, Innova is expensive…but if you shop around the area you will find that most, if not all apartments that are similar in style, amenities, and modernity, will be similarly priced. 

A majority of the tenants are young professionals who are here for residency/fellowship/other graduate programs. Everyone I’ve run into is respectful and friendly. The Innova sky deck with fire pits and TV’s is very relaxing on a nice evening. The gym is clean and very modern. I have a small dog and the concierge service is extremely helpful in walking him if I’m stuck at work late one night. Location wise, you are a 12 minute walk to UH Hospital, CCF is across the street (can’t beat that), and the Art Museum, Uptown area, and Little Italy are all within walking distance (less than 25 minute walk to little Italy). An Uber from the apartment to the airport is on average $20-25 and from the apartment to downtown is around $7-8. 

They are completing construction on additions to Innova, Cleveland Clinic’s Medical school building, and the Case Western Dental School, so the only con I can think of is construction. But if you’re gone for work most of the day then it won’t matter to you. You can still get in and out easily and I’m rarely inconvenienced by it.

I’ve never had a bad experience here. I’ve walked my dog at all hours of the night and I feel safe. Like any city, there are good and bad areas. Just be smart about what you’re doing. I’ve looked at A LOT of apartments around Cleveland and Innova, while pricey, is worth it at the end of the day. I’ve chosen to renew my lease here twice now and I don’t regret it. They even had a promotional code for hospital residents when applying to Innova to save money! Use it!... "UH2018SS"
Avoid at all costs. Read the reviews all over the internet about how this place really us and be weary of reviews that sound too good to be true. They are.

I have been fortunate to call Innova home since August 2015.  The beautiful building, incredible amenities and superb concierge staff makes this not only a great place to live, but one that makes you feel special and spoiled!  Pet friendly, immaculate and safe/secure, this building is located near world-class educational and health care institutions with local shopping and arts/entertainment venues easily accessible.  Friendly, attentive and responsive management is also a great asset.  Do yourself a favor and put Innova at the top of your list, you will look long and hard to find a place that has more to offer.

I LOVE living at Innova, concierge are so helpful. They have walked my 8 year old rat terrier, cleaned snow off my car, and have answered any questions I may have regarding property and neighborhood with no hesitation. I work at Cleveland Clinic and can’t beat my 6min “walking” morning commute! 

I really enjoy the activities they have available for the residents. We had a Christmas Ugly Sweater Party including alcoholic beverages and had so much fun! We also have an upcoming Wine and Canvas party in Feb. In addition, we have a very trendy rec room and rooftop lounge to invite friends/family.

My husband and I relocated from Atlanta for the role at the Clinic and researched so many apartments in the University Circle area. We are so glad we chose Innova Living!! They stand by their model: Work Hard. Live Easy.

Really wanted to love the Bingham because of the location but unfortunately after a year, we're looking to move. 

Beyond horrible move in experience and no one from the leasing office ever checked in with us after. 

Dog park is under constructions for over 3 months, meanwhile everyone is leaving poop all around the outside of the building. They also let their dogs pee on the concrete near the entrance so it constantly smells like urine. To my knowledge, no one is actually fined. 

Parking is expensive and people will park in you garage spot. No tow truck can get in. 

Cheap carpet with nails that stick out. Always dirty in the common spaces.

Lived here for 2 years, great location, apartment itself was nice and spacious, staff very friendly as well and never had any issues. I've lived at the 9 and Flats East Bank post the bingham and neither came close to the Bingham. Would be my recommendation for downtown living.

My Wife and I spent 3 Years living at The Bingham recently relocating back to the west coast. If you are going to live downtown Cleveland, which has so much to offer, this is the place for you. Our tenure there was characterized by very professional, down to earth, accessible and effective leadership. Randa is a terrific manager that always took the time to address any issues we had either by herself or quickly routing to an appropriate team member. She always had a smile and was perpetually inquisitive about how things were going. The maintenance staff led by Steve were terrific, prompt and kept our apartment in to shape. The amenities are great with great community rooms both upstairs and downstairs that we have used to celebrate major events. There are also two wonderfully appointed guest rooms  right in the building that our families have stayed at while visiting as opposed to hotels, allowing them privacy, however, very convenient proximity. There is a Constantinos market grocery just downstairs which we are already missing. It is awesome to be able to run to the grocery store 2 mins away to grab the ingredient you missed while cooking  or top up for drinks or ice when entertaining. There are two large parking lots adjacent to the building meaning that when hosting large events, your guests can park and walk right up - no worries. Finally I'd like to commend the concierges, Robert, Travis, Kelley and the team who have been a constant helping with every little thing - and doing so cheerfully. Having stayed at many apartment complexes, I have to finish by saying that the tone of leadership from Randa clearly permeates the culture and has created an environment that we loved staying at. We will be staying at The Bingham again if Cleveland is in the future again.

Thank You Again!

Update: Someone reached out from Morgan Properties to "rectify" the situation. Initially the lady had apologized. But rather than follow through with humility, attempted to gas light me for their own wrong doing. You really can't make this up. The Bingham may be nice apartments, I'm sure the staff is lovely, but WOW..... the property managers are down right despicable.

Had reached out in May 8th when a listing for a 1 bedroom with a balcony was first listed to inquire on applying. Laura took 2 days to respond (understandable) but proceeded to attempt to sell me on 2 bedroom apartments. So I restated I wanted what I originally inquired about. She then ignored me for 4 days and it wasn't until I sent a question mark that she finally responded. She said that apartment was still available and sent me a link to apply for it to have already been taken. 6 days it took when the original information clearly stated I wanted "that" apartment. So then she goes back to attempt to sell me once again on what I don't want. Talk about unprofessional. Laura, you are terrible.

I was a former tenant of the Bingham. I was in a penthouse unit so the layout was a little different than the lofts. All I can say is positive things. My roommate was a bust but that is my fault. We looked everywhere including the Bingham at first until I learned about the penthouses and I was lucky to call when one had just opened but was being renovated. We signed the very next day. Move in was flawless and we had to wait on parking but it was no problem with the lot being available next door for renters monthly. The room had a jacuzzi, a real full size jacuzzi tub that was what won me over immediately, this was the real deal and it is by far the best tub I have ever experienced. Many books and articles were read in that tub. Giant balcony that was the envy of everyone I knew. A killer view of Lake Erie. Stunning kitchen, amply storage place, giant gym, huge parking garage once I got my space and the best staff you can ask for. They did not seem to be corporate minded but for the residents. I met a ton of people but the penthouse people all knew each other and it was like a family. I made many friends which I did not expect as I am somewhat private but still a talker. All in all, you really cannot go wrong here, do it!

Eric D

Incredibly spacious apartments. The floor plans are very open with high ceilings (mine is about 15-18ft). Short walk to all downtown sport stadiums and nightlife areas. Has a large gym for an apartment complex consisting of several machines and dumbbells 5-110lbs. Price is reasonable for the amount of space and location. Connected to the complex is an fresh foods market that has all the essentials at reasonable prices.

I loved my time at the Garfield, the location, amenities, and the staff were outstanding. I have lived in 3 different complex's downtown and this was by far the best.

The building is brand new, the room was a perfect size, and the 2nd floor community room is an awesome place to have a social gathering or study. 

Lastly, the management team was top notch. Lea and Kiki do a fantastic job. They put on fun and unique events for the residents all year round, which I will surely miss.

After living in The Garfield over 6 months, I figured I have a good outlook on the place now. And it's great.

The best place I toured in Cleveland. In my opinion, it has the upper hand on any other location.

So here's a review of my 3 favorite things I love about The Garf (in no order):

1. The building is great - clean, new and quiet. (I fall asleep like a baby. Everyone's super respectable noise-wise)

2. The staff are ALL friendly - from the managers to the maintenance people - everyone's super down-to-earth and personable.

3. The monthly residence events*

*I moved here from "out of town" and didn't know anyone...

So I was a bit nervous because I imagined it'd take awhile to make new friends.

...however, the first resident event I went to I met a great group of people I clicked with. And made a ton of new friends.

Not sure I could ask for anything else at this place (although, a rooftop pool would be nice... haha)

Seriously though, couldn't ask for a better place to live.

I just moved in a few weeks ago and I want to highlight how great the management has been. Lea and Kiki always get back to me right away whenever I have needed their assistance. There is also an on-site maintenance man who will help you hang anything up in your room. In addition, the building is right you where you want to be downtown. I am a short walk away from some of the best bars, restaurants, and entertainment in town. If you are looking to move downtown, come check out the Garfield.

I toured this past week and I was overall very impressed with the property. It is charming but modern which is hard to pull off but they did. I hate the giant windows in the one bedroom but it is a different take and lets in a lot of light (why I dislike it). The prices are right on though which makes this noteworthy and having a huge garage across the street with high clearance is a winner right off of Euclid by east fourth and by all the major buildings. This place should be a hit. Also beer bar and amazing coffee, four elevators, and a great staff. A home run I think 


Eric

I have been living here for two years and have seen this newly renovated building rapidly fall into disrepair. The parking garage is being held up by scaffolding due to the severe rust on many of the supporting beams. Management has also failed to remove graffiti on the property. There's also only one elevator in the entire property, and it is constantly out of service due to maintenance.

From the moment I toured the building, I knew that Euclid Grand was something else. Ever since then, living here has been nothing short of amazing. The friendly staff, the sense of security and the community feel are simply unmatched.
Best place to stay in downtown, the rooftop has a view of the fireworks whenever there is a game in the stadium, the game room is fun and has a big TV where we enjoy our weekends watching movies.

We love our apartment and the sense of security provided by Euclid Grand. The secure parking and building access along with the beautiful PH apartment and amenities were the top selling points for us.
The maintenance so far has not been good but the apartments are nice and spacious and the prices are reasonable.
I loved it since the tour and almost a year later I still love it. Great communication all around. The energy is great!

We moved in two weeks ago and love it! The leasing and concierge staff of very pleasant to work with and have been very accommodating to our needs. The units are beautiful and quiet. We have had no noise issues at all. We love the downtown location and vibe! We could not be happier with our choice on Euclid Grand.
Beautiful, clean, modern apartments. Love the high ceilings and rooftop. Very walkable in the Tremont neighborhood.

I have been living here since June and I love it. The location is perfect as well as the amenities. Bars and resturant and walkable and building is always doing fun events for residents. As a female I feel safe living here and I couldn't imagine living at any other building in the area. Dog friendly as well and my dog loves the green space!
I am on my third year at Electric Gardens. Nobody bothers me, very little noise, other tenants are friendly. Maintenance is very quick to fix anything. Overall great experience

I've lived here for about 3 years now and have loved my experience! Located right in Tremont, it's in walking distance to many coffee shops, bars, and restaurants. Electric Gardens is also right on the towpath, which is perfect for long walks with scenic views of downtown. I also enjoy the amenities of Electric Gardens: a beautiful rooftop overlooking downtown, a modern gym right downstairs, and a coffeeshop/bar in the lobby. I also love the modern, luxurious look of my apartment unit! You can't beat the new appliances and ample closet space.
Beautiful property with amazing amenities from the gym to the rooftop- it’s well appointed and maintained.
The best apartment I have lived at so far!! :) Rushil is great and very communicative! We have great amenities, including my favorite our cafe and the trail!! :) high recommend!

I can't say enough good things about this apartment complex! From the moment I moved to Cleveland, I’ve felt completely at home. The amenities are top-notch – the fitness center is great, and the rooftop is amazing to enjoy the beautiful view of the Cleveland skyline. 
The best part? The staff. They are so friendly and always go above and beyond to make sure residents feel welcome and taken care of. One of the most unexpected but wonderful surprises was the sense of community. I’ve met so many amazing people here and have made some great friends. Not to mention the layout of my apartment is spacious, modern, and just perfect for my needs

've been living here for a while now, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. The apartment offers an amazing view of the city, which is definitely one of the highlights. Every morning, I wake up to a breathtaking panorama that never gets old.

The building itself is always well-maintained. The cleanliness is top-notch, and I really appreciate how the common areas are kept spotless. It's clear that the management takes pride in the property.

Another standout feature is the customer service. The staff is incredibly friendly and responsive. Whether I have a maintenance request or just need help with something, they’re always quick to assist. It's refreshing to live somewhere where the management truly cares about their residents.

Additionally, the community here is great. There are frequent social events that make it easy to meet neighbors and stay connected. It creates a real sense of community, which I love.

Overall, I’m extremely satisfied with my experience and am planning to stay for another two years, God willing. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, well-managed apartment with great amenities and an unbeatable view.

Really loving my experience at Electric Gardens! I just moved in recently and everything was seamless. I especially loved how the property manager was here to help me get set up, (delivered my packages to me even), and gave me free goodies. The best parts are: the access to the Tow Path, the dog friendly complex, and the quiet atmosphere. And it’s got THE best city skyline views! Really looking forward to staying here long term :)

I love living at Electric Gardens! My partner moved in this past summer & from our tour to move in everything was handled with fantastic communication and professionalism. Rushil the property manager has really put an innovative in promoting resident events which has been amazing!

From the amenities, to the apartments, to the management— Electric Gardens is a place to be!

I've lived at Electric Gardens since the building opened and I absolutely love it. The location and views are unbeatable, and I love having a coffee shop and wine bar in the lobby for those work from home days when I need to get out of my apartment. Rushil, the property manager is AMAZING and so attentive to resident's needs. If you are looking for a new place to live, I would definitely recommend EG.

By far the best apartment that has a great location. You are minutes away from restaurants, grocery stores, highways, and right in the center of Cleveland! You are close (even walking distance) - I love living here!!

This place is so amazing. The views are fantastic, but the care put into design are what really sold me. Truly the best place to rent right now in Cleveland! Can’t wait for the summer time here with the rooftop views!!!

Amazing property nestled in the center of Tremont with direct access to the Metroparks Tow Path and all the local restaurants. The design of the building feels more like a boutique hotel with 5 star amenities (fitness center, co working space, AND AIRBNB!). The building manager, Hannah, has been great to work with and answers questions quickly. We got postponed for our move-in but the developers (Jroc) have been transparent and uber-accommodating!  Can’t wait to be apart of this project.
This is a special property right on the towpath.  Very unique.  Like a boutique hotel with sweeping panoramic views and lots of deck space.

Electric Gardens is in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Cleveland - Tremont.  Both of the roof decks have panoramic views of downtown which are incredible.  The coworking space (Limelight) on the first floor is a huge value add, especially with working from home becoming more of the norm.  The units are decked out with everything you would want and expect + more.  Customer service from Hannah, the property manager, is first-class.

I had a terrible experience as a tenant at My Place Group’s 41 West property. During a 4-day power outage, they offered no alternative housing, and the emergency lights in the building stopped working, creating unsafe conditions. All my food went bad, and my renter’s insurance didn’t cover the loss.

After moving out in November, it took over six weeks to hear about my security deposit. They deducted charges for a stove I never used, cleaning cabinets I had already cleaned, and repainting small spots on the walls where I had hung items. The charges were excessive, and communication was poor throughout my tenancy.

I do not recommend renting from My Place Group.

The location is perfect and I don’t want to move any time soon.

Any time there are problems with the building, management has been quick to address them. It is clear they care about the common areas but the roof deck needs more attention. Maintanence is fairly quick for in-unit requests.

I have been calling the office and property managers for weeks now and have not heard back. They are charging my resident portal hundreds of dollars AFTER I MOVED OUT almost a month ago and will not tell me what the charges are for.
The place got sold multiple times no one there bed bugs crazy people washers overflow and don't work bad parking lot bad records

Upgrades to the building was continuous during my stay here, management transitions had some hiccups, but those are expected and they worked out any problems. I think it’s a quiet building, and I never had any trouble during my stay
The apartments smell like drugs. I had to call police several times.management could care less as long as there apartments are rented .

It was a great property until AIY Properties took over! Not kept clean, section 8, renters that play loud music at different hours, halls can smell of weed, stomping. AIY Properties will do nothing to control issues you will have to call the police time and time again. All AIY Properties cares about money and they will harass you even if it's $10 that you owe.
Go elsewhere!
Poor management. Outdated appliances & old carpet. Bedbug infestation.

Bed bugs and management doesn’t care. They said it could have came from the Uhaul. But other tenements in same floor state bed bug infested prior. Management does not do enough to eradicate. They spray twice and doesn’t do monthly exterminating maintenance. Do not recommend this place.

I went and looked at these apartments.  Residents told me not to rent.  Drug activity’s rampant, and bedbugs are a hug problem. I wanted to live close to my friends and public transit.  The rent was well within my budget. I’m so disappointed. It was perfect for me.

Call to place work orders and either they don't answer or you never receive a confirmation call back. Called about air conditioner/fan unit not working since 12/19/18. Told on 2/8/19, after complaining about not having heat that the 12/19/18 work order was cancelled and they would get back to it in the spring (I was never contacted). 2/13/19, I had told go to the Main Office because no one had shown up or called about fixing my heat, someone showed later that afternoon. Placed another work order for A/C on 4/8/19, have heard nothing. Made 3 calls to Maintenance on 4/22/19, phone rings and goes to voice mail. its 5/4/19, I guess they will be seeing me in the office again!!!

I've lived at the Shoreham for 2 years now with few to no complaints.  Having access to the pool in the summer is a huge perk of living here, as well as the proximity to downtown CLE, Lakewood, and the Metroparks.  I was lucky to have a downtown and lake view, although not everyone renter will.     A few minor drawbacks are the lack of street parking and somewhat outdated appliances/furnishings, also I didn't have a dishwasher. Overall, a nice place to live in a mostly safe area.
