I love having access to a beautiful clean indoor pool, party room, game room, gym, laundry room, grills and a spacious relaxing back deck. Overall I’m so HAPPY to be a tenant here! Rent here you won’t be disappointed!
Amazing place to live, love the love the location and staff!!

DO NOT MOVE HERE

They do not abide to their lease, and force you to stick out your lease despite them breaking the agreement on their end. This is not a trustworthy management team.

We had a water leak in April which resulted in mold growing throughout our laundry room which I personally am allergic too. My fiancee and I then had to pay for a mold inspector out of pocket which was confirmed as mold and that is growing within the walls. The maintenance team simply came and sprayed bleach on the surface of the wall. Less than a week later, the water broke again and the mold immediately returned to the surface, further showing their is more mold that they had yet to remove. We were then told that even though I am allergic and have been feeling symptoms for months, that they are not concerned about it.

Apart from the water leak, the flooring is extremely penetrable with sound. We are kept up until midnight every night from the upstairs neighbor sounding as if he is pounding on the floor unless we turn a sound machine on to max volume. The same neighbor wakes up everyday at 640am making the same sounds. This includes weekends. The lease states there are quiet hours and you must respect your neighbors, yet they refuse to abide to their own lease when we shared this with them to allow us to move out.

The wood flooring of the kitchen also was not fixated to the floor. As you walk it would stick to your feet. At one point causing  my fiancee to fall into the laundry room door. The door has yet to be fixed when we notified the office.

Look elsewhere if you wish to live comfortably with a respectable landlord/management team.

Found black mold in my unit, they did not care, this will make you very sick. All they care about is their money. Can hear every footstop above you and toilets flushing, do not rent here! Contacting health department and better business bureau. Awful awful experience.

My wife and I are seniors who sold our home and downsized.  We have found Brighton Chase to be well-built and quiet, with friendly and responsive office staff personnel and prompt maintenance service when needed.  We hear the occasional barking dog and upstairs neighbor's vacuuming, but never "what the neighbors are talking about" as one reviewer said.  Lower floor residents do hear water running in the walls when upstairs bathrooms are used, but it's not a bother.  It's convenient to rent 9x7 storage rooms (with lights and a power outlet) on the same floor, so we can quickly access infrequently-used items. My wife uses one storage room to keep her art supplies organized, and has a work table there.  I keep my bicycles in another room (and the Metropark all-purpose trail is a few minutes away)   Before the pandemic, we enjoyed using the community room for family or church-group gatherings, and we would invite friends to join us in the the  theater room for DVD viewing or to watch sports.  The fitness center is well-equipped, and the business center has two computers and a free copier.  Summer pool crowding has been eliminated by having a pool attendant to enforce the "two guests per unit" rule.  Finally, while paying rent automatically from one's checking account is encouraged, we write a personal check every month with no problem (permitted so long as no bounced checks).  The only drawback for some might be it's hard to meet people, but these are apartments not condos so maybe that's to be expected.

These apartments look really nice but are poorly built.  Expect to hear everything your neighbors are talking about. If you have someone who lives above you, expect to hear their alarm going off in the morning, talking/yelling, and even going to the bathroom.

The pool area is nice but gets crowded on the weekends.  People invite excess amount of guests to he pool which makes it overcrowded, non-availability of chairs for residence. 

Management and maintenance are great but due to the poor construction of these apartments, I would not recommend living here.

great amenities but absolutely horrible staff. Constant issues with their corporate office and using checks. I feel like they try to get you to pay online and the $25 fee on top of that. Very rude office staff and not very helpful with package deliveries and maintenance issues. The pool area sounds like its a Vegas pool party so in the summer it is extremely loud and uncontrolled partying. Also, there has been more cops showing up to the building lately because of unknown issues with residences. Meaning numerous cars at once. The staff doesn't let the residences know what is going on so we feel more safe. To me it makes me uneasy not knowing who is living in the building and what is going on. Yes the rooms are nice but its brand new but after being here for over 2 years i would never recommend this strictly because of the lack of safety and the lack of professionalism with the staff.

Brighton Chase is the newest complex on the west side of Cleveland and they have really raised the bar on what  renter wants and needs. All the apartments have high end finishes, a spacious gourmet kitchen, in suite washer and dryer, a beautiful pool, and state of the art fitness center. There is also a beautifully landscaped courtyard with BBQ grills available, and a business center with wifi and printers available for resident use. There are garages around the property as well as platform parking under the building (a must for our Cleveland winters). Every floor also has a lounge area. Rocky River is a suburb of Cleveland with many locally owned restaurants and businesses.It has that small town feel close to a big city. It is close to shopping and there is a bus stop right in front of the building that will get you to downtown Cleveland's theaters, restaurants, and professional sports venues in 20 minutes. Brighton Chase is also 5 minutes from the metro park system, 10 minutes from marinas and beaches, 10 minutes from highways and 15 minutes from the airport. The management and on site maintenance staff is very courteous and very quick to respond to any concern. I have lived in other apartments and this one far exceeded  my expectations.
Wonderful community. A very quiet building. Good maintenance staff. Would recommend highly.

I went there on Sunday at 11 am (their web page said they opened at 10 am). They have a security door and a call in box at the entrance. The glass security door was locked and I could see people sitting inside "chatting" and laughing. I knocked on the door. No Response. I called using the wall phone and the woman who answered said "You must wait. I can take a message".
The message was "I am here to view the one bedroom apartment advertised as vacant". She didn't say anything and just put the phone down (the line went dead).
So that was my experience with Linden House. Move in there at your own peril.

Love Oxford Club Apartments, Marizela and Mitzi have made the application process so easy! I love how close it is to everything in Rocky River too! I would recommend Oxford Court to anyone looking for a nicer, quiet, complex with good location to stores and restaurants.
I moved in during Covid and am now in a bigger apartment here everything has been smooth sailing.
I put application in about a month ago (9/2023), no approval or denial. Where is $299 “hold fee”?

During the time I was here I didn't have any issues. The people were nice, maintenance was always on time, they made it real easy to pay rent and the office staff was professional. I don't know how it is with the new company Millennial but I think I might return good or bad.

Basic apartments. Dated dirty hallway carpeting. Elevators, washers, dryers and doorbells consistently break down with lengthy repair times. No apartment updates but the price for rent shoots up at least 30 bucks every lease renewal. Back hallways are filthy 5 of the 7 days of the week. Good luck with the leasing office picking up the phone. The corporate office is terrible on so many levels. My building was quiet. That’s the best compliment I have for this place.

It’s a good apartment if your looking for something quick to move into. Elevator is always broke and water gets shut off at least once a month . There’s minor details they don’t tell you when signing your lease that eventually turn into big problems. Highly don’t recommend
Beautiful, spacious apartment. Comfy and makes for a great home. Maintenance and leasing office workers are top tier. No complaints, We love it here!

This location is a great place due to the diversity, nine minutes from work if you work at one of the two leading premier hospitals in Cleveland, Ohio.  Also very close to going out to the night hot spots and restaurants on Shaker Square and University Circle.

View is awesome. Management and maintenance are readily available and experienced.  Hearing noise from your floor is rare- you can hear people in the hall, but someone can be blasting music and you won't hear it. Occasionally you'll get noise above or below.  Parking garage needs repair. You're on your own if your vehicle is hit.  No guest parking.  People around the nearby bars are VERY loud outside every Friday and Saturday; police and EMS are over there almost every weekend. You pay electric, laundry, optional garage parking. They could be better about giving notice ahead of time for showings once you give notice that you're leaving. Pretty solid overall- as of writing nothing competes at their price ranges imo.

This building is perfectly located, right on the river, with easy walking to a lot of the local hot spots. The units are well-maintained, and the closet space is amazing (which is hard to come by in Lakewood)! The kitchen offers great storage space along with major appliances. The leasing office manager is extremely friendly, and knows all her tenants by name.

Bonus: there's a beautiful metro park across the street that provides running, biking, and access to the river. I love it here!
The units vary. Check the actual website for pictures of the unit. Only select units look that renovated.
I am in Brunswick ohio living at a beautiful apartment in the usa.
have heard it's a great place to live. it's a well kept apartment and they are always there to work with you. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who is looking for a place to call home!

The process of renting was straightforward. Everything was handled online. Very professional in tours and exploration of spaces. Rent and other things handled online, so its convenient. The apartment is clean, painted, well-maintained. Solid hardware on radiators to control heat, excellent tankless toilets so no problems there. Parking is solid.

If you are interested in leasing an apartment ask for Madeline!!! Her personality was top tier. She is involved with her community. She gave us a detailed tour, walked us around the entire complex. Her attitude is the right attitude to have when you are in an industry like hers. She completely won me and my husband over!
EXCELLENT!!!! customer service! i felt right at home
Customer service was great. Enjoyed the tour and hospitality! Good community.
Leasing office holds information isn’t helpful or direct no help at all. Lies about what apartments are available

i have live here going on five years, two bedroom with a cat and sister , living here is almost like living in the country , i live right next to the creek , when you walk a long the sidewalk next to the creek sometimes a deer or racoon will come out and take a look at you as you pass by . my apartment is downstairs , so i have a patio to sit out and crochet at times , cute little kitchen , little dining area, that is really all i need at my age 57 now. bedrooms are very large and living room too,i love it here free heat and hot water makes its with in budget .

Went in to the leasing office after the holiday. Saw 2 nicely available units. Noisy and bustling area. Person showing me the Apartments just gave me an application. I didn't turn it in. The real manager wouldn't return for a few days. I called and sent requests but nothing happened. Transit is right there.

I lived here for a few years and didn't have a problem until the new management stepped in. The water is turned off once a week and the elevators are always broken. The "updates" on the first floor are awful. The new manager is such a jerk. He makes you feel uncomfortable and is incredibly rude. Many residents were leaving as soon as the management changed because he is terrible to deal with. Don't bother to try to contact the owner about him because he is her grandson  The rent goes up $30 every year. I left my apartment cleaner than when I moved in and never got my security deposit back. I never ever received a letter in the mail stating why I wasn't getting it back (which is illegal in the state of Ohio from what I've read)

Every since management changed last Summer this place has gone down the tubes. No renovations are being down to hallways except the first floor. Management is slimy and customer service is lacking. It takes months for anything to get fixed. Elevator is constantly broken. Many people living there for many years are moving out and say this is the worst managemt they have ever seen. Prices going up as well! Please do yourself a favor and stay away!! My move out date cannot come soon enough! There are several fake reviews as well on other websites! Be aware!

I moved in 2 weeks ago, and after a difficult search, I know I've made the right choice. Moving is the worst, but I got a renovated apartment at a great price. Comfort with the management all the way to the great location made it easy. Management and maintenance staff truly care about the people who live here, as they are available and accessible whenever needed. It feels good knowing I have a safe, comfortable and classy place to live. Thank you to Brook, Ron, Richie!
Our floor manfisted with bed bugs , close to bars , not enough parking. Can’t wait to get out.

This is a great apartment to live. It is situated in a fun area of town with bars and restaurants close by which caters to a younger clientele like myself. Also, the apartment has renovated kitchens which are very nice. The bedroom is a perfect size for a queen size bed. The maintenance team is on call 24/7 which is great if there are any issues with electric or etc. There is swimming pool that is awesome and open from Memorial Day to Labor Day. The laundry room has an adequate amount of washers and dryers and is only $2.50 for washes and $2.50 for drying. There is an apartment manager who is on the facility for about 50 hours a week and is available for any questions. The elevators are a tad outdated tho and make a weird sound when on them. Parking is only $10.00 and than it is free for the entirety of your lease which is nice. Other apartments in Lakewood either have limited parking or a much higher fee. Lastly, the apartments are at an affordable rate for the location and the quality of the rooms and complex. I highly recommend it to anyone considering moving to Lakewood, Ohio.

yeah like the title says, the heater and ac constantly break down and when it does it almost always takes at least 3 or 4 days for them to finally fix it. even when the hvac is working the temperature varies wildly in your apartment and the thermostat is seemingly for decoration only. in the summer my apartment gets up to like 76 during the day then dips down to 64 overnight. in the winter it stays around 65. overall the apartments and the building itself is nice but the hvac issues get real old real quick.

Air conditioning is useless. Its 82 degrees and humid enough to make my chairs and tables sticky as I write this. The thermostat is for show. Its central air so you have no real control.

Management does not care, nor will they abide by typical and ethical business processes. A friend moved out after hating it here, never got their deposit back. Was told it was lost in the mail, they'd have to pay a fee to have it resent, and they should ask the post office to find it.

Fire department has to enforce the regular maintenance if their elevators. They're out of service regularly and for long periods. They were all out of service at the same time  a period over a month. There are 15 floors in this building.

Appliances are ineffective. Dryer takes at least 3 hours worth of cycles to dry clothes. Dishwasher leaves things dirty. Shower water runs cold quickly (even with a whole heater in the unit).

Walls are thin. You'll hear everything and have no privacy. 

And they raised rent.

I’m not seeing luxury value after two years. The construction is cheap, expect to hear your neighbors loud and clear. You can’t control the temp in your unit- don’t be fooled by the digital thermostats. All you can do it open and close hot/cold vents (if you have a ladder). Can’t open windows. The dryer is ventless, meaning it doesn’t work. Unimpressed by building security for residents. There are better options in Lakewood. It’s a shame, because the location is good.

nope. Terrible management company and if you like getting ZERO sleep from construction starting between 6am-9am lasting HOURS every day then this may be your spot. I've even tried turning my tv up but its just so loud. Lobby smells like dog poop and trash. The never clean the dog park. its sick. elevators have a mind of their own, dropping you off wherever. management NEVER tells you important things like alarms, elevators down, water shut offs, construction hours. which is nuts considering they use AppFolio and they can send mass texts and emails for things like that. You'll wait forever on an elevator that's never going to come. I was actually told almost 2 years ago that construction would last 2 months HAAAAAAAHHAAAAA yea, no, still happening and its BAD. I'm home more now so I'm starting to understand everyone else's complaints. for the price its not worth it. they really have no "luxury" amenities. take your money elsewhere. Do not live here.

I lived at center north for two years and had an awesome experience! Rachel is amazing & took her time to make sure that I had the apartment I wanted as well as needed. I never had any issues with my apartment. Close to everything & such a convenient location. Loved the layouts of the apartments and the amenities were great! The view is even more amazing - and the gym downstairs was a huge plus for me.  Wouldn't have wanted to live anywhere else in Lakewood other than Center North.

I recently moved out and am really going to miss my apartment. All the units are modern with updated appliances and fixtures, I love the granite countertops and the dark brown wooden cabinets!! I’m a big shopper and the huge walk in closet supported my addiction. My unit was also very quiet, I never heard my neighbors besides an occasional dog bark. The building is very pet friendly and the indoor dog park is so convenient! The staff was also very helpful and friendly, especially Rachel and Chuck! Amazing location close to so many great restaurants, coffee shops, and Lakewood Park.

Do NOT rent from Westview North!
In my two years of living in these apartments, I was held up at gunpoint walking into my building only 2 months in, there was a 24 hour police stake out of one of the buildings adjacent to mine where they put off tear gas to try to get the gunman out of the building around 4 am, a neighbor moved in next door who was clearly doing illegal things because the police woke me up at 1 am banging on my door asking about him. As I was moving, the glass door to my apartment building had a bullet hole in it and shattered glass that was held together with duct tape. This is not a safe place to live and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

They have ants really bad , I’ve been here a year and they haven’t took care of it I’ve called them about it they send someone out but ants get worst . People next door and above your head u can hear like they in your home . They will tow your car if it’s infront of your apartment if your tags are expired of tires flat . Do not move here .
This is my first one-bedroom apartment on my own, and it's been lovely so far. The staff is helpful and it's great having a park right across the street.

the manager was bad at communicating with me after I have applied for a studio at lawn village. I have been calling and leaving emails looking for updates on my application and it took them 2 weeks to reach back just tell me I was not approved for the apartment.

I have lived in Lawn Village for around 4 years.  The manager and crew does over and above what a leasing office has to do.  For instance they allowed me to move to a first floor apartment because of the arthritis.  When you call to have something done, they are there that day or the next.  Except for the heater or. Ac.  They come just about right away..  the complex if quiet.  Not many kids making noise.

Since I am going to be moving to Columbus I want to say thank you Brandon you’re doing a great job here!!

I came to the apartments because my boyfriend and I were looking to move in together. We already live in the city. I know the area and know that this is the city we want to live. I did a walk through the one apartment and was pretty pleased. The bedrooms were nice size (wanted a spare), bathroom was great size, closet space was ok. The doorway was a bit small it seemed. Was told that there was going to be a rec room put in. A few days later I went for my nightly walk with my mother and we decided to stroll through the complex. Garbage cans on the property were emptied, but the full ones were sitting next to the can with holes ripped in them from animals and garbage all over the place. Went through the parking lots, which we were told were monitored. Tenants are having to make their own parking spots it looks like, so obviously there isn't enough parking. We ran into an old friend of mine from school. She lives here with her two kids. She's looking to move. She said nothing gets fixed like it should. She said her rent is expensive and could live in another city and get better management and a bigger apartment. She has issues with neighbors playing music all hours of the night and management does nothing about it. I asked about the rec room, she told me she was told that when she moved in, over 5 years ago. I felt so bad for her. My mom and I continued our walk and saw the maintenance lady letting out her two dogs. When I came for the walk through I was told cats only. So employees must get special treatment. It seems really the only good thing about this place is the location and the apartment itself. Kind of disappointed in the lack of respect the management has for their tenants. Reflects them in the end as to how much they care about this place. But hey, as long as it pays the bills.

I've called Lawn Village Apartments my home now for nearly 10 years. It has always had a very warm, family oriented atmosphere, with apartments of all sizes...surrounded by trees and a park just a hop, skip and a jump up the road. The staff has become more like family through out the years and it's been a wonderful place to live and grow.

Negatives:
The climate control breaks frequently. Heating in our apartment was broken (off) the entire winter. We were given a plug in heating unit for the main area. The air conditioning has broken several times, often on very hot days and for many days in a row. Climate control is shared across apartments, so in order to change the temperature when it is working you have to change it to the lowest (or highest) setting and hope that will turn on the heating/cooling. Dishwasher, washing machine and water dispenser have broken once each, but maintenance was very responsive. Also, the fire alarm in the kitchen is too close to the stove/oven, so we can't use the oven or else we risk setting off the fire alarm. 

Positive aspects include large bedrooms, large windows, nice views (depending on unit), plenty of closet space, lots of common area space and a balcony (depending on unit). Bathrooms are nice. Really nice internal soundproofing between rooms. The staff is very friendly. It is located in an excellent location, right in the middle of little Italy, and there are a ton of different shops on the same block. There is an option for one paid parking spot per unit(for like 170 a month) but you can generally find free parking on the side streets (with permit from city around 10 dollars per half year). 

Overall for the price I would expect functioning climate control and to be able to use the oven, but it is in a very nice area and the management is nice. I would however recommend a cheaper place with working climate control.

Entered work orders for missing lights and a broken front door knob, neither of which was ever actually fixed. Then, maintenance broke the plumbing in the apartment above ours which caused water to break open our bathroom ceiling and flood. Maintenance came to our apartment, looked at it, said they'd come back and left the water flowing into our apartment for 18 hours before coming back. This then resulted in over a week of construction in our apartment, all done on the property manager's schedule and not ours. Reached out to the property manager about getting a rent credit as our apartment was unlivable for a week and it was 100% the fault of property maintenance staff. Of course, this was also ignored.

The apartments appear to be beautiful, but the overall conditions are so poor. I lived here for two years and the second year it was unfortunately bought out by new management. They have no idea what they are doing. It would take them weeks to get back to my emails and calls and even when they did they were no help. I put in a service request and maintenance entered my unit with no notice and caused a mess. I see that they have since upped the rent, totally not worth it.

I lived at said property for two years. The first year it was owned by a great company, sadly that's no longer true. The new owners jacked up the price, with little to no true improvements, only cosmetics to hide the place isn't worth the price. Maintenence took MONTHS to solve major issues, including shower temperature and a functional kitchen sink. Things only improved once I put rent in escrow, but not by much. Plus your property manager will change monthly, if not more. Good luck with contact. You're worth more time and effort.
The whole building is infested with cockroaches, building manager gaslight me thinking I was the problem.

I loved living at Elbur Ave Apartments! The area is safe and super walkable: Giant Eagle is .3 mi away, downtown Lakewood is less than a mile, Lakewood Park is 1.3 mi. Couple of great bars nearby and Toni's Pizza is to die for!
 
The building itself is brick with beautiful landscaping. There are kind landscapers there daily and maintenance requests are filled quickly. The resident portal was easy to use and I always had positive interactions with the staff. I could usually hear my neighbors when I was in the hallway but not in my apartment.

The unit was the perfect size for me! I was lucky to have a corner unit so I had lots of windows. They are newer windows so they seal well and keep out the noise from Detroit Ave. Ceilings are tall, good amount of storage space, big bedroom. Utilities (except electric) were included in the rent, which was helpful.

Neighbors were friendly and never sketchy. I will definitely miss it!

Only downside was A/C and heat were too weak for me. But I had a space heater that worked great in the winter and used 2 window A/C units during the summer. So even that worked out!
I live here and this property is amazing. Great amenities, parking available and great nearby places to eat. Also maintenance is very quick and management is professional and respectful.

The washing machines and dryers were always down, the front door would be broken at times where people could just enter the building, and dead cockroaches would be occasionally found in the stairwell. I would highly recommend avoiding the lakewood cliffs. I have called multiple times about the return of our security deposit and was told to speak to the Director of Operations. I called and left 3 messages, none of which he returned, until I finally called when he was in the office. He then was supposed to provide me information, in which he never did, until I followed up more than a week and a half later.

I have lived at Lakewood Cliffs for almost three years. Moving from out of town, I was surprised by the quality of the location. The lot is well maintained, as are common areas. The building is right off the Rocky River Metropark, two bus lines, and less than a mile from multiple grocery stores. Management is very accessible and responsive. They are quick to resolve any issues that arise. Lakewood has been an amazing place to live!

This happened to me last year. The manager promised me with one bedroom but when I arrived at the property, it was a studio with the same rate. The manager said I could choose either from moving to one bedroom but with a much higher rate or stay where I was - disappointment, frustration, and such unprofessionalism. Also during the process of finding a solution, the manager’s attitude was unbelievable. She behaved in a way that it was my mistake and she was just trying to help me figure things out. I can’t believe such a nice property like this place hired such ignorant and unprofessional employees. People at OUC, please don’t deny what happened to me and how you treated me during 14 days of my stay. I am willing to share my email communications with them if anyone wants for validity

PROS: 
Walking distance to both Cleveland Clinic and CWRU
Well-furnished lounges on both 5th and 20th floor lounges (great view), great for hosting large groups 
Great pool, grills, and gym
Hardwood floors and good kitchen appliances 
Friendly and competent maintenance staff  
Heated garage
dog-friendly

CONS: 
Fan is loud: turn it on during your tour to hear for yourself
OUC raised my rent 7% in one year 
Utilities bill is ~$200/month for 2bed not including internet
Mice were found in multiple units on the 3rd floor, mouse traps were permanently present in my unit for the remainder of my stay
high staff turnover: at least 3 property managers in 2 years 
In Summer 2018, garage door didn’t close overnight, unlocked cars were broken into, and locked cars had doors jiggled. After reporting the incident to management, they did not notify the apartment community. The lack of transparency is astonishing. 
My visitor’s car was totaled due to flooding in the side visitor lot. Multiple cars were waterlogged and severely damaged and totaled. The management did not notify residents of the flash flood warning beforehand despite flooding in the University Circle area in the past. Management also did not notify residents that their visitors’ cars may be flooded. There is a large visitor lot on the East side that would not flood, but is always empty because OUC charges $25/day to park there.
My visitor tried to open the balcony door on the 20th floor lounge, the handle snapped, and we left the handle on the lounge table. The management later charged me $500 for a total replacement of the door. The accusation was “excessive force”, which I tried to dispute because we were obviously not maliciously vandalizing, but rather the handle was assembled poorly. I had to pay for their faulty construction when OUC should have. Faulty construction in units too: when I moved in my window screen fell off when I tried to open the window. Thank goodness they didn’t charge me $500 for that one too. 
Walls not sound-proof, can hear conversations from adjacent unit

Me and my boyfriend had just relocated to Cleveland for work and moving is stressful.  But the staff at One University Circle has made our move seamless.  We didn't have a chance to tour the property before we got into town so I honestly didn't expect it to be as beautiful as the photos that I was sent.  But we were wrong, it is hands down the most beautiful building we have ever seen.  Not only are you in WOW when you walk in with the building but the staff is right there waiting for you with a huge smile.  They made everything so easy for us, from helping with our late night move in to making us coffee (the lounge has a coffee bar!! Who needs Starbucks when I can get coffee without stepping foot outside)  We are most excited about using the rooftop pool and community garden this spring /summer.  We have lived in many states and this is probably our 5th apartment in the last few years (due to work opportunities) but when we walked into our apartment we finally knew we were home.  Thank You so much to the staff and if you haven't checked out One University Circle yet I would call them today before it is to late!

Not worth the rent at all. Awful living experiences. The management team likes to argue with tenants instead of solving problem. They might have some misunderstandings of good customer service and luxury apartment. At least my satisfaction is not a thing to them.

Living experience was not as we expected. We’ve been living here for three months, yet there have been many problems. Two of the drawers weren’t installed properly; microwave’s light went out already, which according to the manager that it’s been a year and half since it was installed. For real? We lived in another apartment for three years and the microwave had no problem at all. Not to mention that the trash chute. We’ve never seen the trash chute been filled up to the third floor. And the manager here thought it’s normal since no one works over the weekend. What a luxury place. And just like the other reviewers mentioned, there’s no securities out side of the building. Innova has securities outside the building patrolling all the night. We want to transfer to a higher unit, so that we won’t see a clogged trash chute. Other residents have successfully transferred within two weeks, but according to a policy just came up, we can’t transfer until we have lived 6 months. It’s like a policy specially made for us. How flattered. The thing is that the management team really treated people so differently that make us feel so uncomfortable. 
One more thing to mention. Maintenance guys are really good themselves. However it seems like they didn’t get the order in a timely manner? There was no hot water at all on the first night we moved in. I went to the concierge, and I was told to wait for about 45 minutes. It was around 2:00 in the morning, and we waited until 3:30 am but no one showed up. We were too tired to wait, after the whole day of moving stuff. YET the maintenance guy came to knock on our door at 6:00 am. We were exhausted, but we have to get up. What about EMERGENCY SERVICE you guys promised? I could wait until the next day for the hot water to be fixed, just don't tell me it could be fixed within 45 minutes. Everything that’s not as promised is not a big deal to the management team. They think as long as the problem was fixed(no matter how it was fixed and how long it took), there won’t be any problem and therefore we won’t be and shouldn’t be bothered at all. 
Just don’t pay such money to get an apartment that you have to keep requesting maintenance.

I moved in a month ago and I currently live here and while there are many pros to living here, there are also some significant cons. The building is absolutely beautiful and the location is excellent. However, my main issues are with the security and the property management. 

At first, I was really impressed by the security, but after a few weeks of living here, I am a little more concerned. The concierge or security guard is supposed to be at the desk 24/7 but most of the time, I find that is not the case. Plus, they only answer the phone half of the time and when they don't, the voicemail box is full and you can't leave a message. My bike seat was stolen last week because my bike was parked in the racks located in back of the building. I kept my cool about my bike seat being stolen as it was an easy fix, but one of the concierges made a snide remark about how another girl got her bike stolen from the front of the building and how *she* didn't make a big deal out of it. The reason I parked my bike outside was that the bike room lights aren't working. Plus, all of the wheelchair access buttons that are supposed to automatically open the doors are out of order. I've brought up these concerns to the staff a few times and every time I get a vague response about how it will take a few weeks. So now I'm hesitant to park my bike outside because of my theft experience, but I also have a hard time parking my bike in the bike room. 

The maintenance employees themselves are very nice, but my luck with getting repairs done is iffy. When I first moved in, we didn't have hot water, a part of the sink was missing, the shower door didn't close, the shower lights turn off while you're showing, and the air filter was very dirty. They fixed the hot water issue the night I moved in but the sink and the shower door took almost two weeks. The air filter was fixed a few hours after I reported it. The shower light still doesn't work and turns off sporadically.

I have mixed feelings about the office staff. I have had multiple experiences where I have received attitude from the office staff.  Often times, instead of offering to help, they seem to be more interested in arguing with you. I'm still willing to give the place a chance because I really do like the building and my apartment. For the price I am paying, the building lives up to my expectations, but the management and the security definitely do not.

We viewed the building a few weeks ago and absolutely loved the apartment; we planned to move in later in the spring. With the current health situation; we were forced to make our move from NY on an emergency timeline. After a quick call with the management team on a Monday afternoon; they had our apartment move-in ready by the Friday--two months early--and stayed late to make sure we got the keys and were able to move in when we arrived Friday evening. Cannot recommend the building and management team enough!
I have been working with Rita on pre-leasing a unit and she has been terrific! I can’t wait to call this place home! Ideal location and the renderings look stunning!
Great location (walking distance to Playhouse Square, East 4th, etc.), private garages for each unit, and they're brand new and beautiful!

I am close to I-71, I-480, and, I-90. Cleveland Hopkins Airport is close by as is Great Northern Shopping Center, and Cleveland Metro Park with three golf courses is just a long iron shot away.
The in suite washer and dryer along with central heat and air conditioning will keep your apartment just the way you like it.
We have a great pool and picnic area with gas grills.
If any problems should arise, Rachelle in the onsite office will make sure it will get immediate attention.
I think Parkridge is a great place to live, and think you will also.
Ted Strezoff

I’ve been living with K&D for two years now. The apartment is fine, the amenities are subpar at best, location is fine (Lakewood/Tremont are more lively areas in Cleveland), and the maintenance staff are timely with responses. Currently applying to grad school so my life is up in the air - I cannot commit to another year-long lease. The property manager, Jerome, told me I would be able to negotiate month-to-month lease prices, with K&D charging up to an extra $100/month for leases less than a year. When I in fact tried to negotiate, they stonewalled me and did not negotiate. This was disappointing considering I was initially fine with paying the extra rate, until their own property manager told me that I could get the extra fees for month-to-month waived. I expressed that I would like to stay with K&D for three more years if I stay in the area, so I would value some collaboration when it came to the arbitrary month-to-month rates, especially since I’ve been paying them for the last two years. Again, no. Without any options, I of course had to resign. Later, they delivered a paper that addressed a new pet policy. Now, I have to pay an extra monthly fee for my pet, even though I haven’t paid this for the last two years. Additionally, the past two years I’ve been receiving a preferred employer discount since I work with a hospital. I asked for my new 3-month lease to reflect the discount. To my surprise, they told me after I signed my lease that I’m no longer eligible to receive the discount, even though I’m still with the same employer I’ve been with for the last two years. Additionally, K&D security guards essentially threw my groceries away when I had them delivered through Instacart, and even though the property manager expressed that the security guard should have put them in the fridge, they never followed up or reimbursed me for my lost groceries. Overall, K&D is becoming increasingly greedy, valuing lining their own pockets over the relationships with their tenants. I’m extremely displeased and I cannot wait to end my lease with them as soon as possible, even if I stay in Cleveland. Would highly recommend living somewhere else if you have the option. I never write reviews, and I consider myself to be a very reasonable person, but I can’t help but feel like K&D has become money hungry and is taking advantage of my current instability during my school application process.

I have lived in 5 different major cities on the East Coast and this is by far, one of the best properties and staff I have come across.  Mark and Lindsey are very professional and responsive, and that really sets them apart from the rest.  Maintenance is on top of things and keeping the building clean and safe is an obvious priority.  The only downfall is that parking is not attached to the building or available onsite at all.  However - I have found that so much is within walkable distance that it hasn't been as much of an issue as I thought it would.

I moved  to Cleveland this spring and I am delighted that I found The Residences at Leader! The building itself is beautiful and very solidly built so there’s no noise from neighbors at all. The hallways are very well lit and are made of beautiful white marble!  The ceilings are so high that 96 inch curtains come just to my window sills, not the floor.  I love the character of the building! The temperature in the gym is a wonderful 68 degrees, which I find perfect for working out, and the equipment is new. The security staff is friendly and helpful, and heavy packages are actually delivered right to your door! I’ve put in a couple of maintenance requests at 9 am and they were completed by noon that same day! There is a trash shoot on each floor which is a huge convenience.  It’s an easy 5 min walk to the downtown Heinen’s grocery, and 10 mins to Indian’s and Cav’s games.  I thought I would miss gardening but there are so many lovely flower beds and planters to enjoy downtown, and someone else is maintaining them!  I wasn’t sure urban living would work for me but it turns out it’s great!  I feel very lucky to be here!

My wife and I have been living here since 2017.  We love it!  The Leader Building is in the best section of downtown.  Close to everything--from the Cleveland Public Library to the Lakefront, to Browns Stadium, to the Warehouse District, to Playhouse Square, to the baseball bark, to Cleveland State University.  Everything is walkable from Superior and East 6th.  Great staff in the building.  Kept very clean!  And very responsive to maintenance requests.  The building itself is extremely solid, and noise-proof.  We have never heard anyone in the suites on either side of us.  And there is an infant in one, and a dog in the other.  Theb asement has a wonderful gym, as well as secure storage for your bikes.  And did I mention the history of the building itself.  Built in 1912 by the scion of one of Cleveland's wealthy 19th century families.  The lobby is richly ornate and the elevators are gorgeous; they are said to have been designed by Tiffany.  Rent is reasonable for what you get.  Check it out!
I love my apartment and the building is so classy! So happy to call Leader my home!

There's no fenced in parking.
The parking lot has potholes 
Huge RATS running 
Every rodent,flying and crawling   live here!
The lights blink off and on.
There are holes in the foundation, and soo much more
I wouldn't recommend this place to a FLEA

It has great views of downtown, and also within walking distance to pretty much anything! The units are updated and a big selling point for me was having laundry in my unit! It’s a great place to live if you want to have the “downtown experience.” I would recommend living here to anyone!

After moving into the top floor with a central view of public square....

...I can't believe I even considered moving anywhere else!!!

I moved into The Terminal Tower Residences after dealing with some sub-par leasing offices in the area. The experience working with Rita and the front office of K&D was very easy, accommodating, and personal.

During my stay, I enjoyed:

1. Making friends in the morning while doing workouts
2. Starbucks from the location in the building while starting my workday
3. Sharing skyline sunset views with friends and family from the rooftop patio
4. Friday evening dinners in the Flats
5. Easy access to Edgewater beach for outdoor exercise and sunshine
6. The best front-yard in all of North East Ohio with Cleveland's public square, the lawn - garden - and fountain outside of the Marriott overlooking Cleveland Browns Stadium - The Science Center - and The Rock N Roll Hall Of Fame

AND MORE!!!!

I made friends with the security guards who were always kind, helpful, and respectful.

If you're considering moving downtown anywhere other than The Terminal Tower ...

...I would ask that you schedule a visit before making your final decision. 

You will be happy you did!

Former Resident,
Michael

I moved to cleveland for a job in COVID times and moved into Terminal Tower without actually seeing the place in person. Honestly, the apartment was very better than I had expected. Very spacious apartment, brand new stainless steal appliances, energy efficient. Rock top deck was a great surprise. Terminal Tower is located right in the heart of Cleveland, great restaurants right around the corner; walking distance to sporting venues. Finally, the apartment manager (Rita) made the process of moving seamless. She was available practically any day of the week. Maintenance requests completed in timely manner. Overall, very satisfied living at the terminal tower

My wife and I moved into the terminal tower residences in September of 2020 and we've loved every minute of it. The building is full of rich history and there are big plans for downtown Cleveland coming to life all around. 

Our apartment unit itself is amazing. Compared to anything we've ever had... I mean it comes with a wine fridge and stainless appliances, what else could I ask for. 

Residents get access to a full gym and the lounge is equipped with a bar, a rooftop deck, a pool table, and shuffleboard. I can walk to work, we're surrounded by Cleveland's best bars and restaurants, and if we ever need to leave we park underneath the building... life is good. 

Finally, K&D, and specifically the apartment manager Rita, worked with my wife and I every step of the way to make sure we were happy, to complete maintenance requests on time, and help us move in on a tight schedule. 

No, I didn't get paid to write this review-- I'm just pleasantly surprised at how much we like it here and I don't have anything bad to say. Dealing with landlords is usually a nightmare, but I feel like K&D deserved some praise, and there aren't enough positive vibes going around. So if you want some positivity in your life, maybe try moving in to Tower City.

The apartments here are visually appealing. The finishes are reasonably polished (though appliances really should be nicer, given the monthly rent.) Maintenance is responsive. Dogs are allowed and welcome. The neighborhood is pleasant and quiet.

Unfortunately, there is a major problem: the floors are so thin that you can hear EVERYTHING going on in the apartment above you. I mean every step. When my upstairs neighbor pulls out a chair, it sounds like loud feedback from a speaker. I regularly wake up at 2am when the person living above me walks from their bedroom to the bathroom.

It's unfathomable to me why a company would invest so much on an apartment building and then skimp on basics like insulation between the floors (and elevators -- there's only one for four floors of many apartments, making for some very long waits.) It's a shame, really: it could be a nice place to live. But the noise is simply intolerable. Obviously, I won't be renewing my lease.
Walk at Edgewater Park; easy access to east, west or south burbs; dog friendly neighborhood; well maintained building!  Cleveland at its best!

I moved into the BPL shortly after they were built and have lived in two different style units since that time. The apartments are elegant, and the location is great for people of all ages. The current management is also very helpful. Very happy that I get to call BPL home.

Love living in Battery Park Lofts!  If you are looking for quiet lovely apartment living in Cleveland that is accessible to everything-this is it.The building is well maintained and excellently managed.  The units are very nicely appointed.  Lake views are amazing!! You can take your daily run or walk at beautiful Edgewater Park.  Get downtown in minutes.  Great coffee shops, bars and restaurants very close at hand. Excellent place to settle in Cleveland.

I moved into Battery Park Lofts a little over a month ago. I love it here! Melissa, the property manager, is super friendly and goes above and beyond for her residents. There are many great attractions, including Edgewater Beach which is just 15min walking distance. From the brewery across the street to the Gordon square arts district just a few blocks away there’s something to love for everyone. The high ceiling, breakfast bar and picturesque windows leave little to be desired. Battery Park is more than an apartment complex, its a luxury lifestyle!

I moved into BPL after a horrible experience at a nearby apartment and it was the best decision I could have made. 

The team at BPL is extremely attentive - there is always open and constant communication about what is going on in and around the property. First and foremost, as a young woman, I feel extremely safe here. On top of that, the apartment complex is clean, the common areas are amazing and the staff & residents are extremely friendly. Any small issue I've ever had has been dealt with and resolved in timely manner. It's one of the best priced apartments in the area, especially when you factor in the proximity to Edgewater and so many great local bars and restaurants. 

Overall, I genuinely can't say enough great things about Battery Park Lofts and I recommend it to everyone I know moving to the city. I have already renewed my lease twice and will be renewing a third time this year...I love it here!

This apartment is the perfect place to live if you want to escape the noise of downtown but don't want to commit to a house in Lakewood. It's a little outside of downtown but right on the shoreway, so getting to both Lakewood and Ohio City/Tremont is very convenient. It's a great community with many, many dogs and a lot of fun things to do, eat, and drink. It's also very convenient to east cleveland and the heights, so if you work in the hospitals or in the studios of asiatown, you'll have an easy commute. 
The apartment is pretty spacious depending on which unit you opt for, and switching units is fairly easy if you outgrow your living situation! The walls are thick enough that the noise from dogs/weekend music/the train isn't bad, but if you want complete silence, this probably isn't for you (not sure which apartment would be). 
The residents are generally respectful, and those who aren't tend to leave quickly. 
The building is safe and the management takes care of any kind of issue that arises. You are at the mercy of Spectrum community wifi and cleveland public power, which can't be changed, but you'll likely experience that anywhere in cleveland. From my experience, this building is built better than most in Cleveland and has one of the best management teams as well. It isn't the fanciest, but it is very nice and much more affordable than all of the newest buildings. The package system is about the same as any apartment building, and the neighborhood is safe enough that theft isn't a huge concern. 
I love living here. It reminds me of my college dorms because of how friendly everyone is - many residents can be found at Terrestrial on the weekends with their dogs. Of course- way nicer than a college dorm, especially the two-beds! 
And the beach views / city views can't be beat for this price point!

Absolutely love living here!! The building is always clean, secure and both management and tenants are so kind. You can’t beat the location with walkable access to Edgewater park and lots of restaurants/bars/breweries. Highly recommend!

The building is kept clean, management is responsive, and the apartments are very nice. I have a great view of the lake and of downtown and it’s within walking distance to Edgewater Park. I highly recommend BPL if you want a quiet, conveniently located, and modern building.

We have lived at Battery Park Lofts since the summer of ‘22. The location is great, close to food & drinks, and a short walk to the beach.

Management were easy to communicate with as we were coordinating from out of state and the apartment was clean when we arrived.

We’ve rented a 1 bedroom apartment with Battery Park for a little over 6 months now. The apartment itself is nice and relatively updated. We have a view of the Lake/Edgewater beach which is awesome! I would recommend to friends who are looking for a place a few minutes from downtown. If we were planning on staying in Cleveland, we would definitely renew our lease! 

Pros: updated living space, excellent view, shared spaces are nice (grill, large patio w/ seating, community room), friendly neighbors, FREE PARKING, building feels secure and safe, have never had an issue where maintenance was needed but I’m sure they are great, good price for the area, resultants and brewery within walking distance, 5 minute walk to the beach. (The list goes on) 

Cons: I wish the workout room was a little bigger/ had more weights but it gets the job done.

Could really benefit with a structured package system. They stack up quickly and it is inconvenient to go through them all.

I love living in this building! I have lived here for about a year and a half, and management has always handled any situation (not really any issues for me living here- but any electrical outings, etc.) very promptly! It's in a great area thats a walk to the beach, and great food places. Definitely recommend this apt complex!

I've really enjoyed my time in the Battery Park Lofts. Big walk in closet, private balcony with wonderful views, in unit washer and dryer, new appliances while in walking distance from Edgewater and Gordon Square. Easy access to downtown. Friendly and responsive management with well maintained common areas.
Great place to live!! Comfortable and everything is new and modern

I’ve lived here for the last 6 months and it’s been nothing but a wonderful experience. Everything from the tour to signing the lease was a very easy process. It’s clean, it’s safe, and it’s quiet. Residential staff are all very friendly and extremely responsive (for a maintenance request for example, it’ll get fixed that same day or the next). There’s also great food and drinks spot in the neighborhood and it sits right over Edgewater Beach & Park. BPL is an amazing place to live. I highly recommend!

Lived here for over two years. Horrendous, unresponsive management that changes every few months. Multiple cars have been broken into and even stolen from the indoor parking garage, yet management have done nothing to make it more secure. I would look elsewhere
I really liked how the finishes in the building didn't look like a lot of other buildings I have seen. The finishes have a nice warm feeling to them. The staff was also very friendly and welcoming .

At first I had trouble trying to get ahold of the leasing office.  They didn't show up to my appointment.  However I tried to reach them again to tell them the situation and they were very apologetic. I did not get to tour the property but from the pictures and looking around outside, it looked very nice.

I’ve lived at Stonebridge for four years - this place is a true gem. Location is great - it’s a quick walk to both the West Bank of the flats and Ohio City, right next to a great bike path over to Whiskey Island and only a quick ride to the Towpath. It’s got great views of the river and downtown, and parking is the cheapest of anywhere in the city. Also, the access the viaduct means you can catch nautica concerts for free, and easily eat at the best Italian restaurant downtown. 
The property manager Ashley and the maintenance staff are what truly makes this place special. Ashley is incredibly organized, responsive, and kind. She cares about the residents, and it really shows. Maintenance staff are quick, efficient, and knowledgeable. We absolutely love living here.

Been living here for a year and a half and love the spot, you get a great view of the river and downtown and I work from home and watch the boats go by all day. 

Property managers are excellent, Ashley is on top of things and is very good at her job. 

Maintenance always comes quickly and does a good job. 

Access to the Superior Viaduct is a major plus and one of the main reasons I picked this place. I ride my bike everywhere and being able to take the elevator to the top saves my legs. 

The location is very good if you get around on a bike, it's right on the towpath trail which you can take to the lake, Ohio city, Tremont, and the steelyards shopping area. If you have an Ebike you can make it to the steelyards easily. If you don't have an Ebike, the stores in Ohio city make more sense. 

Very easy to bike to downtown and Ohio city on the city roads however there isn't a lot of consideration for bike safety in Ohio city. Only issue is the Detroit and West 25th intersection which is very dangerous and has to be crossed to get basically anywhere since the center street bridge is out for the rest of the year. 

Some of the apartments are very long and have lightshaft windows for the interior rooms. I like having a pitch black bedroom so this is nice but it isn't nice for anything besides a bedroom.

We've been at Stonebridge for almost two years and picked this place over the 7+ other apartments we toured downtown.  The office staff is AMAZING - the manager knows everyone by name and is a joy to chat with. The maintenance guys are top notch, too! Our water heater broke a while back (just typical wear-and-tear) and they had a team over to replace it within 24 hours. 

There is a great view of the Cuyahoga River so you can watch boats go by all summer from your living room window, or pop up on the Viaduct to get views of the city and river. There's a rapid station within a 5 minute walk, and it only takes 10 minutes to walk downtown or to the West Side Market. 

OH, the apartments are great, too. The granite countertops and stainless steel everything has me spoiled. I don't know if I'll ever be able to live without heat lamps in my bathroom again!

We have just moved in, but what I can tell you is that the leasing experience was very easy, and the staff is friendly and responsive!  They have an open office and welcome you to come in and talk, very accessible.

Our full height windows in the living room are awesome and we are fully enjoying our views!

So far so good!  A really great value and size of apartments.

This property is great!! Friendly staff, very attentive, very knowledgeable about the area and the property itself. Jay and John are great at what they do and create a space that you  want to be apart of. Move in was simple and stress free thanks to the staff.

Pros:
- Size:  large living room, pretty view, decent sized bedroom with study, large kitchen with space to put a table for maybe 5 people, sufficient closet/storage space, power outlets
-  location: within walking distance of Case Western/ UH and Cleveland Clinic. Close to University Circle, plenty to do within walking distance or a short drive: cultural attractions (art museums, Cleveland Orchestra, Botanical Garden, etc.), places to eat (I recommend Mitchell's Ice Cream), UPS store (which has a public notary), gym, etc.  The building is called Parkside Dwellings, and the "park" is a long stretch of trees across the street with some art pieces (nice for jogging); there's another stretch of trees with a stone pathway between the building and the Children's Museum. It's very pretty, especially in the fall. Bonus: seeing rabbits and fireflies!
- neighborhood: it's quiet, and most of the building residents in the building are professionals or students at Cleveland Clinic or UH. 
- bus station a block away (Healthline)
- brick building and steam heat, warm when it's snowing outside 
- laundry: 2 washing machines and 2 dryers, which is okay for building; you pay $1 in quarters for each m/c
- maintenance comes quickly enough for emergencies; they also installed my ACs
- gated parking

 Cons:
- only Time Warner available for internet
- toilet got clogged several times this year (I don't throw anything in it); I recommend to use plunger immediately when it doesn't flush properly or slows down (I was busy, didn't do this for a day or 2 and had to call maintenance emergently as a result...they did do a good job cleaning up for me)
- you have no control over the heat, and as the weather transitions from hot to cold, it gets cold indoors before they turn on the heat for the building
- 1 small window AC (good for bedroom, but you need another for living room); most units don't have AC
- they don't cover electric - use Apples to Apples program or you'll pay too much
-  small bathroom, mirror to side of sink
-  no elevator
-  trash disposal outside building
-  no front desk, no one to sign for packages
- fridge and stove a bit small, and had to cover gaping vent above stove because flies were coming in
- I still get flies, even after taping the windows and covering the vent!
- No dishwasher or microwave
- laundry:  inefficient dryer (they finally fixed it)
- parking is uncovered
- park is dark if you walk home at night

No more space.

I've been staying in this community for quite some time and i can honestly say that since the new Management and office staff things are improving. Progression take time but within the little time the staff took over i can see the changes. The office answers the phone every time i reach out in regards to concerns. Maintenance responses are quicker. They have updated lighting in parking lots and even got security.

Stay away from this place! The contract you sign with them might as well be a piece of trash. Their management is unprofessional and irresponsible. Throughout the lease, there were no prior notifications, and they arbitrarily raised the rent without adhering to the contractually agreed prices. Whenever you question this, their only response is impatiently telling you to either move out or accept the exorbitant rate.

We asked for a virtual tour and the new manger-Madeline- offered the best experience we could ever have. She showed us all the spots while driving her car, and made sure we could get a gist of the neighborhood. She was very kind, helpful, and considerate. She answered all our questions, showed us the apartment from different angels so that we knew where we are going to reside. She also showed the office, the pool, the gym and other surroundings. It was an impeccable tour we had with Madeline.

The property manager that we toured with was very friendly. She gave and kept offering us hot chocolate and water. She gave us any information we asked for and more. 

I really hope we get a unit there. We filled out the application information and hope to turn it in this weekend when we pass through or on Monday sometime when they're open. 

Great people and the apartments and townhomes looked great.

Miss. Madeline was wonderful and gave an honest/cheerful/lovely tour. She was so accommodating and flexible. It’s worth coming just to take a tour and meet Miss. Madeline! :) It was truly a pleasure to come to the Lexington Village Apartments.

The Lexington Village property manager(Madeline)and her team worked in a quick and efficient way to resolve the problem in my unit, and she called me on Saturday to make sure I was satisfied. Best customer satisfaction ever!

The absolute worst place to live EVER. Moved in and The showers had hair all over them, the bathroom floors had black footprints and smears, and the floors were sticky and caused our shoes and feet to turn black. One of our girls walked barefoot in the apartment and actually had black feet after... that’s how nasty it was.
The bottom floor bathroom was disgusting... i had to scrub and bleach the floor for it to appear partially clean. One swiffer wipe was completely black after using it on the smallest bathroom. 
Also, the manager sheila is absolutely terrible and only contacts you back if she needs money from you. She gave us no information on moving in... We got stuck in the garage without a way out, and stuck outside for no way to get in until another person drove in.

Management company is aweful - they'll hit you with extra fees any way they can, maintenance is poor, elevator is down several times a year, packages get stolen, uninvited guests are let into the building all the time, loud tenants are not dealt with timely if at all, smell of drugs is not unusual, cars parked in driveway blocking garage access, etc, etc, etc

The building is physically nice to look at and some units are good size.  Location is great if you work downtown.  But due to the terrible management, I would not recommend this place to anyone.  There are plenty of better options in this area or downtown.  Do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

Dirty common areas in my bldg; no attention to cleaning much. I think AZ makes the same person who has to prep and clean the un-rented apts also clean the common areas and with constant apt turnover, there apparently never seems to be time to do much cleaning in common areas. It seems to me that onsite mgmt is pushed into only being concerned with keeping apts rented, not condition of the bldg. The onsite maintenance guys do their best, but it seems like they aren't given much to work with...Shame, it's a neat vintage bldg but not in good shape.

Warning: Not worth the aggravation of putting up with the way management is forced by the owners to do all they can to screw tenants out of security deposits. I heard this directly from past 3 managers.

I live here currently. The apartments are nice with beautiful wood floors in a great location. However, the owner does not allow management to have any security cameras anywhere. I've had multiple packages stolen from the mailbox as well as strange experiences with rude people living in the building. I would feel much safer with cameras in the building. The elevator is old and dangerous. I got trapped recently in the elevator and had to call the fire department to come get me out. I will be moving out soon as soon as my lease is up! I would not recommend this place to anyone!
Great Location right next to Edgewater Park, high ceilings and ceiling fans.  Great Management, not a lot of noise.  I've never had any problems

Awesome property with a great management company! 
Highly recommended!!!

Owner & Manager is very unprofessional. Maintenance staff is not what it use to be. It's been snowing and the walkways no longer get cleared on weekends and plowing is terrible. Rent at your own risk.

Brookline Apartments are located in the back of an dead end street directly on Mayfield Road which allows residents to have peace and quiet without unnecessary traffic coming down the street.  There are   around 8 buildings in total with only 8 apartments in each individual complex,4 apartments on the second floor and 4 on the ground floor allowing for lots of living space and the chance to actually know who lives in your building. This apartment is up the street from Walmart, Whole Foods Cedar Market, 10 minutes from Coventry, close to Beachwood Mall and Legacy Village whether driving or using public transportation. The neighborhood is very safe plus the Cleveland Heights police station is one street over. Brookline Apartments are located on the same street as KFC, next door to Wendy's, and across the street from Ralleys whenever you have a taste for fast-food.  This apartment complex has residents who are working college students, families, retirees, couples, and people from all backgrounds. Pets are not allowed. Each building has its own laundry room located downstairs. The one bedroom apartments are located on the 1st floor and the 2 bedrooms are on the 2nd floor with a glass window in the hallway to easily see your car parked outside.Parking is located right in front of your building and each apartment is also offered an garage which comes in handy during Winter, not to mention ****maintenance workers live on-site which is convenient. The buildings are mopped and vacuumed  at least 2 times a week per building and the property is constantly being updated for the best, allowing you to see where your money is going. This apartment is everything you could want and more plus minutes from Downtown Cleveland.

My fiancee and I have lived at 2320 Lofts for the past 3 years. The apartments are beautiful with high ceilings, historic charm, large windows, modern finishings. It has been so convenient to have secure garage parking under the building as well as a gym in the building. Not to mention that it is within walking distance to downtown! Dave and Karen have been the greatest landlords imaginable. My fiancee and I were in the process of buying a house which unfortunately fell through the night before closing, and after explaining the situation to Dave and Karen, they were kind enough to allow us to move into another unit in the building the same week because our previous lease was ending. They are always a text or call away and go above and beyond for their tenants. This has been an amazing place to live and I highly recommend 2320 Lofts.

I have nothing to complain about at 2320. Units are large, they have garage parking (not inexpensive), great location. Neighbors are nice. I chose this location due to the freeway access and I liked the building layout.

PROS: High-rise ceilings & large windows. Decent room sizes & living space. It is within walking distance to AsiaTown & CSU. Gated parking lot & garage parking is a MUST when living in Cleveland. An in-unit washer/dryer. Onsite resident manager; new RM from the prior in 2021. Maintenance is decent. I had a washer stop working & was able to get a new washer/dryer replaced within a few days as well as other maintenance requests were met in a timely manner. 

CONS: You will be paying more than your rent as utilities aren't included. Insulation in the units isn't too good during the winter, so you'll best believe you will turn the heat up or bundle up. THE WALLS ARE THIN! You'll be hearing noises & sounds from your unit neighbors. The "young professionals" that the landlord says live here are people who are either a few years out of college or actual college students. The latter contributes to the loud noises and behaviours in the hallways. For some reason, there were a few pest control situations in the building even though my unit was not greatly affected.

The only good reviews must be written by the management.

Parking- Unless you can afford the garage fee, you must leave your car in the lot or street parking. Assume your car will get broken into 2-3x a year.

Location- Close to downtown but far from the closest safe grocery store.  Homeless shelters and lots of homeless walking around, you will get harassed. Not safe at night.

Space - Lots of open space, but little to no closet/storage space. Small bedroom closets that are not completely enclosed so dust gets over everything. No jacket closet or shoe closet. Little kitchen counter space and storage

Noise/Neighbors - The biggest problem. No insulation between units including between floors.  I can hear everything going on in the neighboring units and upstairs. Most of the apartment is too loud to sleep or study in because of the neighbors or people yelling in the halls. The building is filled immature college students. Loud music and screaming all day. Asking the management to deal with it is useless. You will find trash, beer can/bottles everywhere. The hallways and elevators smell like a mixture of vomit, stale beer and cigarettes.  The carpets are old and stained.  Managements tries to cover them with a lot of mats.

Overpriced- It is nearly the same price as renting an entire house 10 minutes away in Cleveland heights or Ohio city.

Building Quality – Developers did a cheap job of converting this place. Cheap counters, flooring, lack of insulation, fixtures, no firewalls between units & overall very poor quality. There are holes in the windows.  When it rains, water comes in the windows. Heating/cooling cost are crazy. The holes are so big that nearly twice a week, I find huge wasps and hornets that have sneak into the apartment through these cracks (I don’t open the windows because of the horrible garbage smell outside and the abandoned building next door that has several hives). It shouldn’t surprise you that the building is filled with spiders and bugs.

Mail – I have had multiple amazon packages stolen. I have to have my packages dropped of at the Cleveland amazon store where I have to go to pick them up, defeating the whole point of amazon.

Management – They lied to me when I visited here.  They said the units were sound proof (huge lie).  They said the building was mostly young working professionals (lie – mostly a dorm).  The will say anything to fill the units and get you to sign the contract.

Summary: go elsewhere…I can't wait to leave.

This place is a chic loft style apartment, that looks cool. However, the renovators did a clearly budget oriented job. Shelves do not have proper support, no molding leads to exposed under-flooring, and poor paint job. Worst part of this place is the insane amount of noise. There must be nothing between the walls. I can hear people pouring cereal in other apartments and crumpling paper. No conversation is private in this place. If one person is watching TV, everyone is at least listening to TV. They do nothing about people blasting music all day.  Also, the common spaces smell horrible...like vomit and cigarette smoke.  They don't care about maintenance issues.  At best, they seldom respond to issues. The management does not give a crap about you once you sign a lease. You are just rent to them.   There are much more affordable and better places to live.  The only good reviews must be written by them.  I was so happy to leave.

I have lived at 2320 for almost a year, and it's fair at best. The price you pay with enough roommates can make it affordable and there is plenty of space for everyone, however utilities can get costly. Heating and cooling a large space is expensive, but I figured this going in. My apartment is on the first floor so the windows don't open which is a main problem I have. I could have easily cut my A/C use in half if the windows could have been cracked. The apartment offers no amenities or community spaces. The location is not horrible but it is filled with homeless people. My car has been broken into twice parked right outside of the building. They have a free lot a few blocks away so that does solve the issue of break-ins but if you have guests they are supposed to park out front (where the break-ins happen. There is no package drop off so your mail could be sitting anywhere in the building which gets frustrating. The rooms are nice, and they are decently sound proof. Maintenance is also slow, but I have yet to find an apartment where they aren't slow. 

Overall the property is slightly overpriced (utilities included on top of rent) for what you get unless you have roommates. Try to avoid the first floor on the 24th side. Park in the lot or splurge for the garage. Management is iffy so hopefully you can avoid needing them. I personally will not be living here again but if you plan to, heed my advice. 

I will say it is one of the better options for students.

Stairs always dirty. Pool never open. Maintenance half fix things. They lie about renovating the hallways but I’ve been here for 2 years and they never renovated anything. If u plan on moving here, DONT.

The elevators work 2x a week!The heat only work in the summer and the air only works in the winter!The property management has straight A’s in non communication, rudeness, dismissing and collecting rent and handing out eviction notices after taking CHN payments!

My girlfriend and I had an appointment at 3:45 to tour an apartment. We showed up early and walked into the lobby. We waited there for a little while and no one ever came to see us. We called every number they had available, and no one would answer the calls, besides a lady who said “I’m really sorry but unfortunately there’s nothing I can do”.
Keep in mind, the entire time we’re in the lobby, we hear LOUD yelling and laughing from down the hallway. 
Finally around 4, we walk back into the lobby and there was a group standing there talking, who happened to be the people making all the noise, who ALSO happened to be all of the employees. While nice, they had no idea who we were or why we were there. Not sure why were even supposed to set an appointment? And then, they informed us that all of the apartments we had inquired about were all filled. 
All I’ve seen is water damage and complaints about how the building is not well kept. They seemed very proud of their new pool though.
The main building might look nice but if you in 1929 I feel bad for you the stairways barely get clean elevator stay broke the hallway floor carpet is molded
Sooo nice to see new staff Paul and santasia are doing great !

The staff is horrible especially the older lady that works in the office. She treats us as if she is beyond and better then us all especially her assistant. Even when she smiles I can tell it’s fake .  She always has smart remarks to say and then acts as if she did nothing or said nothing. She also lies on you once you go to corporate about the problems she did nothing about. She will act as if you were this crazy person that came at her. Elevators are dirty and they’re always broken. If you have a problem with loud music in your apartment from neighbors , don’t even bother telling them. They will make up an Excuse on why they came do anything.
