I've been here for a few years now and it has worked out very well. These apartments are one of the best values you'll find downtown. With that said, don't expect a luxury loft. Most of the units aren't extremely updated, and the ones that are don't use premium finishes. For the price you pay, everything is adequate. My unit is spacious with a great layout. The floors are concrete (under the carpet), so you don't hear the neighbors above or below. Unfortunately, the thick plaster walls absorb a disappointing amount of sound from the apartments next to you, so hopefully you're neighbors aren't too loud. I can hear every word of conversations at normal volume. My description of the units carries over to the building itself, meaning you get what you pay for. It is well kept with nice historic details, but it is nothing fancy. The fitness room is a nice touch, but you'll want an external gym membership if you're into serious workouts. It has the basic cardio equipment and a multi-station machine. There are mats, benches, and free weights, but the dumbbells only go up to 25 lbs. The laundry room is conveniently located in the basement and has plenty of machines available when you avoid peak hours (Sundays). Unfortunately, there is no dedicated outdoor space for grilling or relaxing, but the grassy park area across the street is good for pets. The parking lot is attended throughout the day and gated with electronic access at night. The lot is managed by a different company, so you have to pay the monthly fee separate from your rent. A big downside is that the parking spaces are not assigned, so it can be difficult to find parking at times and there are frequently cars that block you in. Luckily, there are plenty of things nearby when you don't want to use a car. Bars, restaurants, Greektown, the ballparks, Campus Martius, you name it. Many places within quick walking distance. Overall, I would recommend this place to anyone who asks because the location cannot be beat and many of the units have awesome views.

We've lived here for 3 years now, and will be moving soon due to job changes. The apartments are modest (some appliances are older, some sloppy baseboard and tile work in the kitchen and bathrooms) but are well maintained, and while we've lived here the windows and refrigerators have been updated throughout the entire complex. Maintenance has been excellent in their response times and considerate when entering our apartment. We had no issues with water leakage or insects. The grounds are well maintained as well.

The apartment design overall is a little awkward to fully utilize. The cubby in the living room has the cable jack, but won't fit modern entertainment centers. There are few to no lighting fixtures in the common areas. The One Bedroom model has an irregularly shaped bedroom. However, these are minor concerns.

The location is excellent. There's a corner grocery store and a gas station within walking distance (that's it), and downtown Dearborn and the Fairlane shopping mall are both a very short drive away. The complex sits on Ford Road, which is basically always noisy, so be aware if your living room or bedroom windows directly face the street. Also be aware that the police often idle in the complex's parking lots to set up speed traps.

Our only major complaint was laundry. Each building has hookups for private machines, which we did not have, and the "laundry facilities" are 3 washers and 3 dryers attached to the lease office, which was a long walk away from us. Those machines service the entire complex, so they are very worn and are usually taken. There are a number of coin laundry places on Warren and Ford road, and we ended up utilizing them heavily.

Overall, I would highly recommend this complex to students or families. It is not top of the line, but it is great for the price point!

This place is incredible. I cannot speak highly enough of the building, management, and community at The Ashley. The team at The Ashley is kind, attentive, and friendly, and they truly go out of their way to make the building feel like home from the second you walk in the door to check it out for the first time. I knew pretty much immediately after my tour that I wanted to live here and the team made my transition into the building seamless and every moment living there an absolute joy.  10/10 - LIVE HERE!!!

This is the first apartment I moved into out of college. Over the span of my lease I had several service requests that were performed quickly by one of the staff named Jason, very professional and friendly. Apartment was great quality, rent was unbeatable, and the security of the building helped me ease into the transition of living in a big city. The wine bar downstairs is a huge perk if you enjoy the events etc that they have or just want to stop and grab a quick glass of wine or cocktail. Great property!

The Ashley completed a full renovation in February of 2015, and the flatiron-style building is in the heart of downtown Detroit. 

The common facilities are clean, appliances are state of the art and there is plenty of natural night throughout the building. There is also a wine bar opening soon in the basement, retail next door and a number of concerts in Harmonie park. It's the ideal location for someone interested in soaking up all that the city has to offer. 

Rent is extremely reasonable for this location, and on the whole management is attentive. Building security is a bit confusing to me and I still question whether it's effective; there is a code to get in the door of the building and a unique keystroke to get onto each floor using the elevator. Since it's a ten-story building with no security to get into the stairwell, it seems as though an elevator code would not be a deterrent to even the most lazy of intruders. I moved from an apartment from across town with a doorman, and i think that was a more effective security management option. 

The building was once a historic hotel and the redo keeps the integrity of the original architecture. This gives the building a lot of character but also means the rooms can be a bit cramped and storage is lacking. For example, my closet is large but almost half  of it is taken up by a hot water heater. In the bathroom, the sink did not include anywhere to put towels, medicine, etc. we are also unable to hang things on the walls without command hooks, which is limiting and kind of expensive but not a deal breaker. 

Overall, this apartment comes recommended. I look forward to a number of years in this unit.

A couple of the negatives that I have for Lafayette Towers is that my AC unit is hilariously outdated and loud and that after 3 years there they are still increasing my rent when I renew my lease. I’ve only lived at Philip Houze for 7 months, but I’ve lived in Downtown Detroit for 15 years.

The staff here are extremely friendly and very easy to get a hold of. All questions are answered very promptly (and to my satisfaction), usually in person, since the staff is always available, one way or the other. Communication is handled so well, that my questions are answered before I even ask.

Maintenance issues are resolved in a timely (and friendly) manner. I never feel like I’m “putting anyone out”. The maintenance team goes above and beyond to ensure our safety by making sure everything is running properly.

Our cleaning guy is amazing! He begins early each morning to keep the building sparkling clean! Even my hallway is vacuumed regularly, and the stairwells are maintained. The building is very old, but it always smells and looks clean. This is a big plus in my book! 

Management plans lovely, regularly scheduled events that accommodate all different types of residents (including the dogs!). Nicely printed flyers are posted in advance so that we know what’s going on and can plan to attend. It’s such a nice way to meet my neighbors!

We have a secure, organized room where we can pick up our packages at our own convenience. If we know we have a delivery and would like it placed in our apartment, we just email management and they take care of it!

I love the fact that we have a secure bike room conveniently located in the basement. They’ve even installed a “bike station” with every tool necessary to do simple bike repairs. A heavy-duty tire pump has also been installed. It is securely bolted to the concrete floor, so you don’t have to hold it down with your foot. This may not seem important but, if you have a bike, it really means a lot to have these items available.

All in all, as you can tell, I think that Philip Houze is a great place to call home and I highly recommend it!

The views are unmatched!

The apartments are situated close enough to the city center  (walking distance) but removed far enough to have a peaceful space to yourself or your family. I loved walking into the city for work and dinner and having the Dequindre cut as a path way to the Eastern Market or the Riverfront. The complexes are in an excellent area for students, professionals and families alike since all the city's must see places are just right out the door.

As a young professional, the apartments has all the amenities that I could have asked for and more! All the appliances (stainless) were shiny new when I moved in, the bathroom was just redone in a crisp modern style and the rest of the apartment retained its mid century modern aesthetic which was a dream. The complex boats a mini gym, ample laundry machines that were load card operated (which was such a convenience), a pool, in-complex letter boxes and a new parcel system that was so convenient and secure. If you needed further motivation to move in, your neighbours are some of the best that you will have! I will miss my two neighbours because we truly were a little Central Park family: getting together for holidays, exchanging holiday gifts and just enjoying the park from our balcony on a summer evening with a laugh and a drink or two.
The maintenance team is the absolute best! They respond quickly to any work requests and make sure that  you are satisfied and comfortable.

I can go on and on singing the praises of Central Park apartments but this review will be chapters long. You will not regret living at this place. Please schedule a visit and I assure you that you will feel at home once you enter the gate and are welcomed by the Central Park Family.

I moved to Central Park Apts a couple months ago and there were some unforeseen circumstances that delayed our move-in. The staff were very kind and accommodating during this time. They did everything in their power to help us move in at the time we needed. The apartment is beautiful and VERY spacious. It is the best you can get in Detroit for the given price. The surrounding areas are safe and there is a parking lot with affordable parking fees. They newly renovated the apartments and are continuing to make changes, and giving it a modern touch. The maintenance team works really hard to make sure all requests are completed at a reasonable time. I just love these apartments, the staff, and the area. I plan to live here as long as I can!

I've lived at Kirby Manor for a few years now and my experience has been exceptional! The building is located in a nice part of Midtown Detroit that has more of a residential type feel to it. But it is still within walking distance of the DIA, the Q-Line, and Wayne State University. I used to love my morning walk to class when I attended Wayne State. I would recommend living at Kirby Manor to anyone!

I lived here for a little bit, it got progressively worse. Elevator is always broken, packages are lost, laundry is always broken, and they will raise your rent $200 every year. It’s also totally impossible to contact management, even though they live in the building.

Total upgrade from my last place. No leaks, heat works, hardwood floors were redone and I have a beautiful kitchen. The halls get dirty from the workers sometimes but its usually cleaned up by the next day.

Been living in the “Midtown” area for several years. This is by far my favorite building. (A lot of slum lords own apartment buildings in the cass corridor, if you find a really cheap apartment theres probably like a thousand things wrong with it). Dont have to worry about anything here, and everyone in the building hangs on the porch on the weekends, which is nice.  Huge lot next door for my dogs. Rent is reasonable, and theres no crazy fees for parking. I pay $40 a month. Not sure what “property manager is not license” means? Ali is seriously the best!

If you value you're time and money don't move in here. If you want to be respected by management look elsewhere. 

I put down a security deposit on a unit and told it would be ready in mid July. The move in date continued to be pushed back. Once mid September rolled around and the unit was still not ready for move in I demanded to have my security deposit refunded. I was given a hard time about and again was told the unit would be ready in 2 weeks.

After waiting 3 months and the unit was still not completed, I again asked for my deposit back and was told it would be 3 weeks to get it. I had to call and attorney and threaten the management with legal action. 

The place is run by 21 year old kid who doesn't know what he is doing. They do not respect your time.

Move on, there are better spaces for a much better price.

This apartment complex is definitely not ready to rent any apartments. I don't believe they understand what all goes into  leasing real estate. There are to many issues that need to be resolved. First, there are a lot of safety issues, secondly they have a big plumbing issue, and the apartments are extremely small. There are some small showers stalls in some apartments and bathtubs in others.  I do not believe they realized when they bought this property what they where inheriting. They have fixed up a few apartments to go up on the rent, but there are no amenities included except for a laundry room. The building is old and really should have been torn down and rebuilt from the ground up. What I have experience is that they continue to patch things up and ignore the real issues that they are having in this building. I like to see anyone succeed in any endeavors of their choosing, but be cognitive of your actions and be fair and honest with people.  Had I known or read the reviews before moving in here I would not have considered moving in at all.

I have been living here for four years. The owners live on site and they were having trouble keeping everything together. 

A few months ago, they hired a new property manager named Ali. His presence has had a huge impact for us here. He is kind, answers his phone immediately and I haven't had to wait more than a day or two for any maintenance issues since he started working here.  Unlike before, where it would take several days to even get someone to return our call.

Quiet neighborhood, people in the building are chill and street parking is free.

Terrible managent and owner. Cutting corners will only leave you with a full circle of endless problems. Might as well knock the entire building and start from scratch. DONT MOVE IN to this property. You can't keep putting a bandage on things that need more serious attention.
DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE! the management is terrible, apartment is overpriced and half of your stuff will end up missing

This apartment building has all the makings of a top notch rehabbed industrial building, and the price tag to come with it.

However, we were not made aware of the long construction project currently happening in front of the building that will last a long while to complete.  Additionally, parking is managed by a third party, to which they charge a whopping $250/month.  You'll want the parking though, as there is a rehabilitation center across the street that puts you near some interesting characters when on the street.  This area and location will probably be nice in 5 years or so, but as of 2019 I would NOT rent here. Additionally, the heating/HVAC system is not set up for residential units correctly, you're either freezing because it's out, or getting directly blasted with heat to the point that it's tough to be in the room. Whoever put up the walls made them paper thin and not-flush with the ground, noise/light from the neighboring unit frequently comes in.  Water and heat have been consistent issues. Again, I highly recommend you do not live in this building at this price point. It's just not worth the price point for the issues you deal with.

Has really bad roaches and water leaks. Terrible place to live. The only good thing about this place is the location. It is over priced for what it is. Has a lot of potential but has roaches the size of 50 cent pieces in the basement. Then the heat is constantly going out.

Was fine for the first half, but had lots of leaks that got worse as it was left unaddressed by maintenance despite multiple calls from me and my roommate. Roach issue just got worse over time and was also unaddressed save for leaving a few sticky roach traps.

I moved into a studio in July 2020 and had so many issues my entire time there. The building was infested with mice, I caught 15 mice in my apartment and had to move out & stay somewhere else and the building did nothing to  help or compensate. All my neighbors also had issues with mice and or roaches. I broke my lease in  after threatening legal action for the disgusting living conditions and I had to wait 5 months to get my security deposit back. Terrible management please stay away from essential management company and any of their buildings in midtown.

Maintenance here is a big problem, but management above maintenance is not doing their job either.
The apartment manager is unreliable and unresponsive.
No one here cares about living conditions. 
The tenants above me had pooling water on their floor in their bathroom because they were doing laundry in their bathtub. It was leaking through my bathroom ceiling, RAINING all over my bathroom. Their toilet was also leaking above my toilet, so going to the bathroom throughout this process was unpleasant. My problems were not addressed for a month or so. 
Then, I had a perfectly working kitchen. Management offered a kitchen upgrade. Four months later and it is still not done. It is a little kitchen, it should not take this long. They took apart my kitchen, then for a month, it was not even touched. They don’t clean up after themselves. 
Rooms are overcharged for what they are. 
Personally, I am a good tenant and would like more than anything to not deal with maintenance. But the problems occuring here, are beyond my reach. 
If you don’t like headaches, don’t rent here.

Rooms are live-able. Some bedrooms might not have a heater in them. Noise from people are quite loud but I personally think it is ok. Do not surprise if washing machines sometimes do not work and are not fixed for a month. The biggest problem experienced living here was the maintenance. On the third month of living, some part of the bathroom ceiling fell down. I asked for maintenance twice and did not even get anything fixed. Two months later, there were people coming in and  COMPLETELY TEARING DOWN the bathroom and kitchen for renovation. The apartment was completely ruined by dust... I was not even informed that there would be a maintenance. Even though I email to the manager, I did not receive any reaponse until I called via phone. Apart from its location near to WSU and safe neighborhood, there is nothing left.

I've been living here almost 5 years. I never had any problems what so ever. I leave and go to work come back home and it's the same as I left it. My neighbors are awesome, we all mind our own business but look out for one another. Management could be a little more to up keeping the apartments, I put in an work order almost a month ago and still no one has come to fix the things that needs to be fixed here, that's my only complaint about this place.

Pros: The price, location and people in the building. Everything else sucks. Our windows are chalked shut due to lead. The front lobby if you can call it that floods every year and smells of mold. We have gone weeks with out air... every single year and always on the hottest days of the year. We also have gone days with out hot water. But the worst part of living here is the club Anxex next door. If you are looking at a 01 or 02 on floors 2-6  you will be able to feel the club in your apartment. It gets so bad my hanging glasses clink together. This isnt just the weekend but also random week days. The best part is stepping over the club goers vomit in the morning to get out of building.

The number isn't even connected. Don't even bother calling because no one will talk to you. For people who are trying to make money off of apartments; they really have zero interest in talking to anyone.

I have called everyday at different times, left voicemails several time leaving my contact information, and sent multiple emails. None of them were answered or returned. I stopped at the apartment several times to speak with someone and nobody is there. It looks closed every time i stop by. Very unprofessional.

Set up an appointment for a tour. Arrived at building, waited 20 minutes and no one showed up. Communication was through email. Never answered their phone. Called and emailed again before we left. It has been 2 weeks and neither was returned. Cannot comment on apartment itself because we never were able to see it. 
Based on the comment below mine and my experience, even if the apartment is nice, not worth it if you can never get in touch with management.

I promise if I did not work near this building I would think it was closed you can call any week day at any time and near get there or a call back. I have even tried with multiple number not once have I spoken to anyone.

Management is the worst thing about this place I understand things happen but when they do management doesn’t care. If you have a maintenance requests look forward to not getting any updates or hearing from them until you personally go into the office.

Roaches, Nets, Flies, Mice. Only cosmetic work completed LITERALLY! All reviews are and will be true. I truly believe everyone here regrets moving here. They only take care of things that are literally important. Management appears to be so reassuring but they aren’t. I moved here for a temporary reason  and this is the worst decision of my life. Ceilings falling in, washers and dryers  stolen, management doesn’t communicate with tenants at all. They own other places in royal oak and Dearborn as well. There’s other reviews out there as well regarding their other properties. The reviews on the companies website are FAKE. Notice they’re all 4 stars. There’s also rusty water here. I could go on and on. Stay away!

When i moved in everything seemed perfect. They raise rent without notice. No utilities are included with rent wifi doesn’t work well in all units. All units have problems with water pipes my unit; personally my son room leaks during rain and my bathroom leaks from the unit above me. I don’t recommend anyone moved it any of the location

My costumer service experience was super fast!! The leasing agents were so quick even with COVID19 going on :) ive called the office over 20 times since applying and tori made sure she returned every call with every question answered! Im so happy with the team you guys have! Kyle is amazing at doing his job as well!! Stay blessed

This is an older building but you can tell the management is really trying their best to make updates. Renovations to units, a new elevator, updates to electric/water all within the last year.

Building common areas are clean and the neighbors and friendly/quiet. Staff is responsive too if you have questions. 

I've loved staying in this building, it's a great distance between midtown and downtown. I'm glad the prices are somewhat affordable for the city. Parking is a bit of a struggle but otherwise no complaints. Laundry is located in the basement.  I'd recommend checking this building out.
I lived here for about 2 years and loved it! Great location, friendly neighbors, and management was always very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

Extremely friendly neighbors and staff. Convenient location in terms of the arenas and downtown area. Kitchen area had brand new fridge and convention microwave.  Was only able to stay here a few months due to work/covid situation but would highly recommend!!

I just moved into one of the recently renovated apartments.  The kitchen is brand new, beautiful hardwood floors, and they are adding a bike room in the basement.  Everyone has been very accommodating.  It was one of the most reasonably priced places in the area.  I  am looking forward to exploring Detroit and my new neighborhood.

Bad (REALLY bad) communication from management, bed bug outbreaks were a serious concern, and the elevator was constantly broken (my friend even got stuck on it once and had to be rescued by myself and another tenant). Also, I have found the apartment management and the corporate management to lie - often, especially around complaints lodged against them. No private parking, so your car is at the mercy of street parking (mine got sideswiped and broken into more than once). Its an okay place and has some really nice historical attributes, but the parking and terrible management make it not worth even the reasonable price of renting close to downtown. I would not recommend anyone stay here unless your other option was pretty dire (i.e. homelessness, etc.).

To start off the building and the landscape is very well kept. The maintenance man(Alan) is great and is Johnny on the spot! My one bedroom apartment is very spacious and still has the original hardwood floors and they are gorgeous! The location is the best part though. One block down the road is the river walk which offer so much to do. You are within a half mile of the rennisance center and within walking distance to downtown and pretty much anything you need. There is a laundry room in the basement which is convenient. Your heat is included, unfortunately no AC. But a window air conditioner cools down the place fast! Overall I am happy with my selection!
Elevator shut down every other day.  Laundry didn’t work. Halls smelled like crack. Mold issues and bed bugs. It was awful!

Worst place I have ever lived! It is very dirty. The elevator is like  a big trash bin. Most of  washing machine and dryers are not working. When something need to be fixed they are carless and reluctant to come and fix it. And If they do they do a real lousy job.

We moved in January and since it’s been bad, it’s always so dirty and smells like pee. Since i moved in the elevator is constantly down and they also stay turning off the water, super unprofessional. Save your money and keep looking it’s definitely not worth it especially when they want you to pay for your own ac

One of the worst places I have ever lived. the management is incompetent and care less. washing machine and driers are not working %90 of the time. the elevators look like a big trashcan. And if something is broken it takes forever for them to come and fix it!

Lived here for two years, and it got worse every day. Initially, it was fine. Management was alright, but it quickly devolved. Our apartment still has problems from the day we moved in they were “going to” fix. Management has changed probably two or three times since then and about 6 different random maintenance people have come into my apartment and they all said “okay I can’t fix this today but I’ll be back later this week.” Never heard from them again. Ever. Gated parking is a joke, it’s broken every other day. Water hardly works. Usually only one elevator is working and it’s sketchy as can be and probably littered with trash (like half eaten food or cigarettes). They just took away the trash removal service, so we have to take our trash to the dumpster now (instead of the 2 bins in the laundry rooms). Which is probably a good thing because this place is infested with roaches. I really mean infested. My apartments pretty clean most of the time and I still have them. I probably won’t even bother telling management because they won’t do anything. I could really go on about the maintenance stuff but they’re landlords, I’m sure you get it. I am so sick of living here. It feels so hopeless. It’s disgusting and sad, and no one except some of the tenants seem to care. This really could be a gem but they run it so poorly. There’s well over 100 units so I’m sure it’s not easy, but it’s pretty clear whatever corporation owns it doesn’t care at all. There was one manager who was really nice and genuine, and they fired her pretty quick because she was actually trying to help people. I’ve seen the new guy maybe once in 6 months. Don’t live here. It ain’t worth the utilities.

Been here since August and it’s awful. We just got new management but nothing has really changed. The only good thing is the price for the space you get and utilities being included but even then, we have cockroaches here and the office just blamed the people next to us. The ‘gated’ parking lot isn’t gated, lights outside don’t turn on until like 10pm so it’s super dark out front for the longest time. Not a single floor has a working washer AND dryer. I do laundry on 10 and dry on 2, and each load is $1.75 for the nastiest machines, plus the elevators feel like they’re gonna drop any second, it’s horrifying.
We pay for a newly renovated apartment and our apartment was not done on move-in day and still isn’t done to this day. We have reminded the office multiple times and they never try to plan ahead. They call day or or see us in the hallway and ask if they can come and when we cancel our plans to wait for them, they don’t show up. Prior management gave us a credit so we weren’t paying the full rent and we’re paying the un-renovated apartment price and when bringing it up to the new management they told us since we have the new appliances we have to pay.
I don’t remember agreeing to pay full price for an unfinished apartment. . If people still have to come in to fix it then it’s not finished. Like I have a hole in my kitchen with a superb  old rusty fan from where the oven used to be.
Place is pretty dirty too.

This place is horrible so today I tried washing my clothes and one of the washers was broke so I went to floor five to wash and I leave. I come back and the whole washroom is flooded and hallway so nobody left a note stating it was broke also THEY HAVR ROACHES  I literally bombed my apartment over 5 times and they come back still. the elevator is always broke or it’s always trash on it like rotting fruit or fast food trash THIS PLACE IS HORRIBLE don’t waste your money

If I could give the 0 stars I would.  Don’t move here you will regret it. Management is rude and disrespectful ! They take forever to complete any work orders, in order for them to even think about coming to fix something in your apartment Lawyers may have to get involved. Management is constantly lying about small things. They need new management period.  Ive had so many issues in my apartment that my rent should have been free , from the moment I moved in there were issues.  Save yourself the hassle MOVE SOME PLACE ELSE

I’ve lived here for multiple years and one thing keeps me: relatively affordable rent. I try to keep an open mind and recognize that this is a large apartment complex. That being said, there are many things I wish I could change  Cigarette smoke is SO heavy in this building that I’ve considered getting an air purifier. My hair and clothes still smell like smoke when I leave town. Marijuana smell is almost always present as well which I wouldn’t have an issue with except for the fact that it’s nearly constant. The elevators are only both in operation 50% of the time, and they are filled with trash and unknown sticky substances frequently. The building is “secure” but there are ways to get in without a key. Parking is included which is a plus, however, the parking gate also only functions 50% of the time so anybody has access. Residents (or non residents, who knows) park in non parking spots which ends up blocking cars in when there are plenty of spaces to go around they are just further away from the building entrance. There are frequently issues with the hot water which I want to have sympathy about, but also I shouldn’t be without hot water for 5 days multiple times in a year. Unlike others, I don’t have complaints about the office staff. They want to work a 9-5 just like anyone else and the office has been better about being staffed during posted hours in the recent months. They have responded promptly to my requests, there are just many things I understand as a resident probably can’t be changed.

It has been hell Living at Pallister since the new landlord. At least with the last one I could call her to get things done. Not with this one though. She is Never available and when there is a fire, smoke concern, gas issue or any issues with the water, which happens a lot...the voicemail is full on the emergency line. I was told it is the building owners aunt who is now the landlord, so I guess that is why she is not doing anything for the tenants.

The building is quite and the location is close to everything however there are two trash cans in each laundry room for people to dispose of their trash which is convenient but the residents will put trash bags on the floor, pizza boxes on the floor etc... when the trash can Is full people also put loose food in the can and the trash doesn’t always get emptied on the weekend I would appreciate it if management started making people take their trash to the outside dumpster. Since new management has been in charge for a little over  year now the up keep of the building has declined

Living here in this building has been a wonderful, smooth ride. For starters it is in a wonderful area, only 2 minutes away from the Fisher Theatre as well as the New Center Building in addition to many other attractions such as restuarants and parks. This building is kept in great conditions and everyone that I have come into contact with is very friendly. This apartment is the perfect choice if you are looking for a nice apartment building with everything included, a nice area, and things to do that's fun as well as close to your home.

Apartments and building are very clean. Maintenance and office staff are always friendly and on top of things. The building has had a problem with bed bugs, so take precautions before moving in! The guest lot is super small and always full. There have been several cars in the guest lot broken into, I haven't seen any broken into in the resident lot. Despite car break-ins, I've never felt unsafe there. Overall it's a pretty nice place for the price.

Pro: This is a great place to stay for a very cheap price. It is very safe. The parking lot is safe. The maintenance is super quick and the maintenance staff is very friendly.

Con: It would be great if they keep the hallway clean and do something about visitor parking lot as it is always full.

I've been here for just over a year and have really enjoyed the spot.  At first the units were not ready for internet but the building provided free wifi until everything was up and running.  I am writing this review because the building management just installed new windows and screens on all of the units to improve airflow.  I thought that was great so I asked them what I could do and they said spread the word.  There are a few dog owners on the first floor that let their dogs roam the courtyard but they are all very friendly.  Just know, if you are afraid of dogs, this is a pet friendly place.

I’ve been here just over a month now and I’m extremely impressed with the new management team. They’ve gone out of their way to accommodate me and make sure my needs are met. I love my apartment and I’m looking forward to living here for a while!

The place is cute the neighborhood is great. Management is unresponsive and doesn’t seem to care about any issues. Trash is left all over and nothing is done about it. Doors slam all hours of the night and management has done nothing to help the situation. The first review was left 1.5 years before the project was complete. I’m not sure how they would know anything about the pace. And how is a 410 sq Ft apartment be any place for twins to grow up?

I had a set of twins 16 years ago & Parker House was our first home.  Now I would like my twin sons to start their new beginning where it all started for them at ......666 Parker St.  The listed prices are extremely high for what I paid for a studio apartment in 1999.  But I guess it is worth it for only 410 sqft.

At face value, this property is extremely appealing: the location, the ease of facility access and student lifestyle. However, the pretty marketing is just a mask for the truly subpar quality that the Union is. Basic amenities such as a printer, and secondary security door lock, remained broken the entirety of my stay. Moreover, these two aspects, just to name two example among many, were broadcasted on the Union's website to entice potential renters. That being said, the maintenance and property behaved abhorrently in rectifying these issue. Not only did they take months to fix a simple issue, they acted as though we were the issue for raising a maintenance issue for an important part of our apartment. For example, we spent three consecutive months without a functioning washer and dryer. While I cannot speak highly enough of Bethany, I would not recommend this place to rent. The cost of monthly rent is not proportional to what is provided.

I just applied for a one bed apt and after two days I cancelled it. They told me at the time of applying that the application fee is non-refundable but the security deposit of $200 is. However, I never got my money back. The people at the front desk were super rude, unwilling to help and also lied about sending my money to my address, when infact I  never received any.

Lived here during the 2016-2017 academic year. Pros- was very close to my classes, all costs included in rent, master bathroom, fully furnished. Cons- no overnight parking associated with the building, the building had some heating/cooling problems on the floor I lived on and the only compensation was to give myself and my roommate a small heating fan in winter since our unit dipped to 60 degrees, no prorating on rent you will be expected to pay the full month regardless of when you move in/out. Biggest issue I had was communication between office staff and the manager. I was verbally told I could move into my apartment a week early from the original date (So I signed a rental contract based on this) and three weeks before the early move in I was emailed and told it wasn't possible. Which was an issue since my work contract started three days earlier than the contract move in date. Had a similar problem with subletting for the end of my contract with communication and they didn't have the room turned over in time for my subletter (Biggest issue is they wanted to "work it out" and not change contract language and I decided to trust them verbally- which meant when things fell through management was indifferent since the contract writing had not been changed and I lost out.) Had to contact twice about my deposit, the second time was after 50 days of my move out date.

The stairwell smells of urine.  The staff members are polite and prompt until you sign your lease but then are apathetic and inattentive.

The maintenance men are lazy and incompetent.  You will wait at least a week for repairs.  My washer is done for.

Do yourself a favor and move elsewhere.

Jess

I am in my second year here and I love it! It's great that all of the utilities are included and that the apartment is fully furnished. The appliances and furniture are nice and modern and good quality. One added bonus about living here is that you have your very own washer and dryer, which for me is a make or break! The office staff is very friendly and are always willing to go above and beyond to help. It's a convenient location for any Wayne State student like myself. Also it is found in the heart of Midtown surrounded by great places to eat! The only down side is that they do not have parking, of course not very many places in Detroit do offer parking. For the price and all that you get there is nothing better around! I would suggests this place to everyone!

This apartment complex was just ok. I was a student that attended Wayne State and that is the only thing that I can say was good about it, the convenience. It was right in the middle of campus and it made getting to class easy. 
.
Let me start off by saying that I should have known better from the start. They only have one model available to view and it’s a one bed room. They would not let me walk through and see a two bed room without signing the lease. The room was an ok size but very small for what the rent was. My roommate and I paid $779 a piece ($1558 total) for a box. It was a nice box, new w/utilities and furnished but WAY too expensive. This has taught me NEVER to sign a lease without seeing the apartment first.

The parking was HORRIBLE. Not only did I pay a crazy amount for rent to live in this box, I had to come out of pocket another $250  for a parking pass (per semester) in the parking structure (which is a block and a half away from the apartment). I felt very unsafe walking from my car to my apartment at night. They do have minimal parking under the structure but it is only 20 min parking and parking for the surrounding businesses. They will tow your car at your own expense if you park there for longer. 

The office staff for the most part was ok. But if you challenge what they are saying it is a different story. . I found out months later after moving out, when I checked my credit score they put a payment in collections. I received no letter, no nothing about rent not being paid. I paid my rent EVERY MONTH and for some reason they claimed that one of the payments "did not go though" and we were not notified by them or the bank. You would think that if a payment declined that it would show up on the bank statement as well.  Initially, they said that I did not pay my rent and later on after getting my lawyer involved they said they found the payment but it did not go through. They also claimed that I left my room a mess and took my security deposit, which was a lie. I should have taken pictures of everything before I left AND did a walk through with the staff! When I called to ask about it, the woman I spoke to was very short and rude to me. The only office member I remember who was very kind was Katie. She was awesome!

Overall, I would not recommend anyone to move here, especially if rent increased. My overall experience was poor and it definitely was not worth it.

The refrigerator is so small it will make your food go bad it will leak water the hot water goes out sometimes and your car will get broken into windows busted packages stolen elevator will break down. We absolutely enjoyed our time here. Knowing what we know now, we would absolutely sign on again with them if we were staying in the Dearborn area. 

1.) They are highly proactive with pre-winter maintenance. Prior to last winter, they inspected every single apartment. For our apartment, they replaced our furnace and repaired the downstairs heater. I’m glad they found it when they did, because winter would have been quite cold without their proactive approach. 

2.) They are very responsive with maintenance needs. We asked for someone twice for non-emergency, basic issues. Within 24 hours the problems were resolved. 

3.) One of the reasons we chose here was because of the subdivision’s beauty. We love to run, and it’s been incredibly nice to run on quiet streets without having to drive to a park. Plus, the ponds have ducks and geese pretty much year round. In the early spring, you get to see the year’s new babies. They’ve done an incredible job at keeping the natural beauty of this area.

4.) The staff inside the office are always nice and very attentive. Even more, I will say that, due to my interactions especially with two people in the office, that they are also just good people, not just helpful landlords.

5.) The pool is wonderful, as is the club house and gym. The gym provides excellent variety in work outs, from yoga to cycling, weights to treadmills, etc…

6.) They foster a wonderful environment for anyone, regardless of family type. Our building has elderly (including a handicapped individual), college students, and families with young children. We have never had a problem, nor have I heard of anyone else having an issue. It’s quite remarkable, especially since we’re right next door to a college and have college student neighbors.

If we were staying in Dearborn, we would stay here until we purchased a home. Unfortunately, life’s taking us elsewhere. This is the first time where I’ll actually be sad to part ways with my landlord and management. This was truly a wonderful experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone considering moving to the Dearborn area.

After being a Detroit resident for 27yrs, I found a gem right outside the city in Warren Michigan. The first step into this new scenery made me feel as if I were finally at home. With 24 hour on call maintenance and prompt action from both management and facility employees all issues are taken care of effectively and in a timely manner. The property itself is beautifully landscaped, with a large courtyard, and a welcoming atmosphere. The courtyard is equipped with benches and public barbecue pits. The neighbors are quiet, friendly, and some have even started personal gardens outside the building that add a nice touch. It is conviently located next to Shoppers Market which makes grocery shopping a walk in the "park"ing lot. I truly feel like residing here has been a breath of fresh air, and I would highly recommend this apartment if you are looking in the area.
My apartment is great. Beautiful facility. All utilities included with one set cost per month! Great people to work with!

Been here few months and I love it. Staff are very professional. Move in process went very smoothly. The 1 bedroom tower apartment is very spacious and plenty of storage space. Very nice size kitchen. I also love that you can go on the balcony from your bedroom as well as your living room. The apartment complex is kept very clean. Maintenance responds very quickly. Most the residents are older so it is very quiet and everyone is friendly. Nice amenities such as indoor pool, fitness room, community room that you can rent for events, and play area for children. Also there is a trash chute on each floor in the towers, storage space for every apartment and laundry room.  I definitely would recommend if you are looking for a nice, safe, and affordable place to live.

I did like this apartment. The swimming pool was warm. The layout of the apartment is very spacious. I live in the loft. It's cool to have my own 2 story unit. I've lived here for 11 years and it is now time for me to move. There is new management here and maintenance does not come on time anymore.  They fired the good employees. There was black mode in my neighbor's apartment and they ignored the issue for 3 weeks until the neighbor said she would call MSHDA. Black mode is deadly. Now, the new secretary over here is losing people's rent money. The new building cleaner barely cleans. I love these apartments, it's been my home for 11 years, but the new management is the problem.
I Love the view when I look out onto the patio. I see a city of lights and I don't have to leave my apartment to watch the Fireworks. Wahoo!!!
I Love being able to look out pass my patio onto the City of Lights. A Great Plus I don't have to leave the comforts of my home to watch the Fireworks. Wahoo!!!!

Couldn’t believe i was able to find such a historic, unique, and luxury level apartment like this. The units are amazing and the rent is more than reasonable. The amenities are great and useful. Best deal in downtown cleveland for sure!

Yesterday me and my partner toured the apartment and absolutely fell in love. Our tour guide/ the leasing manager Deborah Elsamny was absolutely incredible really friendly and was ready to answer any questions we had. We will definitely be applying!
It is a really quiet apartment building which is rare in downtown area. The apartment itself is nice as well. The managers Deborah and Diana are very professional and friendly.

Expensive, and extremely UNSAFE! So small and not worth it given the location. The rent RAISES every lease renewal and no option to go 6 month or month to month unless you want to tack on another 250$. Save your time, peace of mind, and especially money

Highly recommend! The large windows allow natural light to flood the rooms, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The kitchen is a dream—modern appliances and plenty of counter space. 

One of the standout features of Driftwood is its location -  walkable to plenty of restaurants and shops nearby, but it still feels quiet and serene inside. 

Overall, I’m thoroughly impressed with Driftwood and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a stylish, comfortable, and well-located home. It’s a true gem!

I've only been here for 3 days and I can already say that it is unlike anywhere I have ever lived. Not only is the staff friendly, but the residents are also shockingly considerate and friendly. I am obsessed with the way that our apartment came together, but also the entire building.

Our move in experience at Driftwood could not have been more amazing. Jessicas help and communication was a 10/10 which helped us navigate the whole process. The building is absolutely beautiful and our apartment is as well. We are so grateful to call this place home and can’t wait to enjoy all of the amenities it has to offer.
Moving in was so easy and everyone has been helpful and responsive. It is a beautiful building and apartment and I am looking forward to seeing the additional spaces that are in the works.

I love living at the Driftwood. I've never experienced this level of luxury in an apartment but it still feels low key and welcoming. My dog is also a happy camper and the washing station is a lifesaver.

I was super excited for this building to open when it was first announced, and it did not disappoint! The location is perfect and the building has a peaceful/earthy vibe. The property manager is very communicative and responsive. Great experience so far!
Love the design and finishes of this modern building. The units are so unique and spacious you feel like you’re in California or New York with how modern everything feels. Couldn’t recommend enough!
Still some ongoing construction but the property manager and maintenance have been so great
Love the neighborhood and the units are beautiful! And management is so nice.

You can't beat this location!!! Amenities are unbelievable, the units are extremely spacious with the highest ceilings in Tremont, and you truly can't beat the location! To top it all off, the management company is local and cares a ton about its residents. They are always onsite, extremely communicative and very responsive.
So far management has been great and communicative regarding property updates. Love the location and amenities (:
Moved in about a month ago and the building is beautiful and in a great location. Only 4 stars bc it’s not quite done yet but think it’ll be 5 starts once construction is over!

Such a unique space, you really won't find anything else like this. Great location in the heart of Tremont, attentive and helpful management, and the apartments feel very high-end. Really excited to be living here!

ZERO STARS I cannot put into words how horrible this place is and the management is even worse. Building is NOT secure, squatters living in empty units because the doors are broke. Didn’t have heat for over a month, AC doesnt work, maintenance closes requests without even checking, HOWEVER, the other day they came in without knocking, I was home and he just walked in. I didn’t have a maintenance request in and it also said not to enter if I wasn’t home, zero 24 hour notice. Management is horrible, they don’t respond. RUN RUN RUN the City of Cleveland needs to step in.

Very poor communication from management!They do not care about their tenants and they are so nonchalant about everything. I could go on and on. DO NOT MOVE HERE! By far the worst apartment building I ever lived in.
Worst organization in Cleveland! Unprofessional and rude! Stay clear of this location!!

I’ve lived here for about 8 months. I was looking forward to the pool and management said it would be open by Memorial Day. It is now the end of June and it is still closed. My apartment has a had a giant plastic cover on the far corner. This has been there for 2 months now. The wall is ripped out due to them fixing the A/C which has been down for 2 months as well. It has been scorching hot and the management team can’t give me a straight answer. Only one elevator has worked since I moved in.

I love everything about my new unit! The renovations are very well done, well thought out, and upscale looking. The staff is super friendly and helpful. The move-in special was the icing on the cake! :)

I was a bit skeptical as I had heard nothing good about the prior company running this place but things have changed with the new people who bought it.  My apartment looks brand new and they are continually adding new stuff and making it look really nice.  I can't wait for the new gym which they said would be ready very soon.
I can walk to school from here and not worry about need to drive!

This newly remodeled apartment is super nice. It looks like brand new! I like the new kitchen very much. It is very spacious and bright! All appliances are brand new and works well. In addition, I love the new wood floor. It looks clean and tidy! I really enjoy the newly renovated apartment!

Beautiful building in a great location! The luxury amenities  shows they really care for their tenants. The management team here were friendly and welcoming. Their move-in special made it easy and seamless for me!! Would definitely recommend this place!

Overall, everyone on the staff is great, the building is very nice, maintenance is available immediately and they are great! Only cons for me was no natural air/windows/balcony (which of course is just due to the building itself), and I received 2 noise complaints on the NFL Draft weekend at 9 PM because people were talking in the hall way. Great place overall but if you are young and like to have company, or be able to talk over a whisper, I would recommend somewhere in the warehouse district. In my opinion if you cant handle people talking in a hallway you should move to the suburbs instead of a apartment that is a hotel and has 3 bars.

This is a great place to live! The staff is very friendly and will go above and beyond to assist with any issues that come up. The leasing team are very transparent and friendly so felt like I could make a good decision to move here. There is so much to do both inside and nearby the apartment. It is perfect for me and my doggo who has adjusted well as it is peaceful and comfortable here.

I have absolutely loved my time and experience here. The building is clean and beautiful, staff is attentive, and maintenance usually comes same day. The amenities are a huge perk as well. I would HIGHLY recommend living here.

My husband and I spent 3 years living at The 9 and it was one of the best apartment experiences that we have had.  The appliances and construction of the apartments are top notch.  The 9 has great security (which was my main priority) and the staff is very personable.  Other residents are very nice and courteous.  We had a great living experience and I highly recommend!

Everything here is perfect from the amenities to the staff. We have lived in other mixed use/hotel apartments and this is the only one where the hotel staff provides equal attention to hotel and apartment guests. The maintenance staff is also fantastic here. Extremely responsive with any requests you have!
Love living here at the 9! It's extremely convenient and the people here are great! Highly recommend!

I have lived in the Boutique Suites at The 9 since February and love it. You can't have a more central, convenient apartment in downtown Cleveland. I can go grocery shopping at Heinen's, go to the gym, and enjoy 4 different bar/restaurant/lounges, all without stepping outside. 
The option to have room service right to your door is amazing on lazy days, and I often take advantage of the same-day dry cleaning service. I have only had 2 minor maintenance requests and they were both taken care of same day. 
Location-wise, I love the fact that I can walk to Browns, Indians, and Cavs games all within minutes, and my bank, office and pharmacy are all very close too. I plan to stay here for a long time!

I live here and couldn't recommend the facilities, amenities or, most importantly, people highly enough. I was really impressed upon move-in at the condition of my apartment: it's clear management have taken particular care of the space over the years. When I've had to submit for minor repairs, I've been blown away by how quickly and effectively building maintenance responds. Common areas are always pristine. The lobby and management staff are all soo nice, and take care to not only be helpful but also to curate community. My experience has been a 10/10 so far - complete satisfaction and absolute confidence I am getting my money's worth.

I’m about to enter my fifth year as a resident here, and at this point I can’t imagine living anywhere else in Downtown Cleveland. The units are great (I will never tire of the views), and the location right at the nexus of downtown’s two main thoroughfares (E. 9th and Euclid Ave.) is second-to-none. Shows in Playhouse Square and hundreds of food and retail options are all within a few minutes’ walk, and being able to pop down to the grocery without even leaving the building is the height of convenience. 

Even better, four bars and restaurants are all located WITHIN the building, so sometimes I don’t even have to venture outside. Adega is perhaps my fav restaurant, Vault is definitely one of the most impressive bars downtown, and the rooftop bar Azure offers some of the best views of the city (and serves as a great daytime escape for residents). And since it’s connected to a hotel, residents get access to all the same amenities: the gym, coffee bar, valet, and even room service + housekeeping if you want it. 

The staff here is top-notch and another big reason I’ve stayed for so long. Everyone is kind, attentive, and  just generally great. There’s a reason The 9 has won so many “best of” awards since it opened: it is!

The 1010 Building is truly located in the center of it all (between Playhouse Square & Public Square). It’s terrific to be in an apartment complex with concierge services, restaurants, rooftop bar, exercise facilities, massage spa, in-house theatre and a grocery store. Our front desk, leasing, security & engineering staff are among the very best!

Lived here for 2 years. Definitely the best downtown apartment complex. I believe Cleveland Scene has rated them #1 for 3 out of the last 4 years. Management puts on nice events every month. The indoor dog park is great for the cold weather. Can’t beat the location.

Cleveland is experiencing a boom. The 9 downtown was one of the first buildings to take advantage and provide higher end apartments in the area. However, as nice as the apartments are, management can be difficult to work with and the price is higher than market value.

I had an amazing stay at The 9, and an experience that I would recommend for any savvy professional busineman or woman. The realestate here is beyond my expectations. It's super clean, well appointed, and very modern in appearance. The entire facility inside and out looked fabulous and is well maintained. The staff are very professional, and they seem to take great care to ensure your time spent here short or long term is an unforgettable experience and that your evenings are quiet so all residents can have a good night's sleep. As everyone's knows the demand and expectations increase for high-speed internet, hotels occasionally fall behind in offering adequate bandwidth but not this property they keep up with consumer demand for faster "business-class" internet speeds. The pricing was very reasonable for the luxury to what you'd expect from a residence of this kind. If you purchase realestate at this property I guarantee the staff will do their best to ensure you feel like you got your money's worth.

- John Hughes Cleveland, Ohio Sept 12, 2015

I have lived at this property my entire time at grad school and it is the absolute best place for students to live. Also, the staff is extremely caring and helpful. Very pet friendly, clean, pretty, and perfectly located next to a delicious bakery, multiple nice restaurants, and small shops!

I have legit questions regarding the recent and terrible changes. The new people in the office are just bodies holding down chairs. The lobby stinks, elevators are dirty, we have no resident app, and the building has a depressing vibe. ???? My dog has gotten sick twice now from the large amount of dog poo all around the building. Communication doesn’t exist. I’m paying for Gucci and getting Walmart. 

You can “restore my satisfaction” by bringing back the other managers. The new ones are never in the office and all around selfish and unhelpful. My friend has been on the parking waitlist since August yet the new manager helped herself to open parking spots first. No interest in the residents and we’re treated as an inconvenience.

Bottled water, chocolates and small gift on move-in day. Flat carts to help with our move. Moving company was shocked! Basket carts offered to help us with our groceries. Packages delivered to our door. Free shuttle to and from airport. I travel often! Enjoy the staff/tenant parties every few months so that we can meet our neighbors. On-site management and a maintenance man who is fast and efficient.  Housekeeper does a great job keeping common areas spotless. They take pride in the building. It's the little things that matter and have made my stay here the last two years a pleasure.

If you are interning at NASA, this is your best bet. The GRC is walkable from here. This is a nice, modern building with amenities, a gym, and a community room. Additionally, the staff consists of some of the most pleasant and welcoming people I have ever seen. This is a great place to stay long-term.

I lived here for two years and loved it. Nice updated appliances and beautiful large windows. I especially appreciated the free airport shuttle service amenity. The building manager and maintenance team is awesome and quick to help. Definitely recommend!

Moved here from Downtown almost 10 months ago.  Very happy with my decision and peaceful in comparison.  My apartment was super clean, perfect and can't beat the price-point.  Put this place anywhere Downtown and monthly rent would jump a few hundred dollars.  My two maintenance requests were minor and handled quickly.  Super-friendly and attentive staff, even deliver packages right to your door.  Plan on staying put for a few years.
Loved my unit and living there! Really enjoyed all of the updated chic finishes. The building manager is the best!!

Great place to live, Dawn takes care of everything which is awesome. Very quiet throughout the whole building which is something we loved. When they get the pool built, I’m sure it’ll be even better. Gym is also good and empty most of the time. Recommend living here!

I recently had the pleasure of living in this exceptional apartment, and my experience was nothing short of fantastic. From the moment I stepped through the door, I was impressed by the modern, stylish decor and the flood of natural light that filled the space. The living area is perfectly designed for both relaxation and entertainment, blending comfort and elegance seamlessly.

What truly sets this apartment apart, however, is the staff. Every interaction I had with them was positive. They are incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional, always going above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay. Whether it was providing local recommendations, quickly addressing any minor issues, or simply greeting me with a smile, their dedication to excellent service was evident.

This apartment complex is amazing! The apartments are beautiful and spacious. The staff is awesome, and is extremely friendly and responsive to all needs. Great location, lots of things close by. Have loved living here!

This is an excellent place everything is new but the most important part is that management really care about the people and the comunicación is awesome. Sad to leave but work move me to another state.

I was one of the first tenants to move in & just renewed my lease. I absolutely love my apartment!  All the amenities advertised are not ready yet, however, it's been exciting to watch the progress over the year I've been here and can see the management team really works hard to make things happen & keep everyone happy.  A bonus to have a quiet building in a great location with plenty of green space for my fur baby.

If you have ever rented you know that finding good management is rare. However, the Centaur has knocked it out of the park with Dawn, Dave, and Danielle! Dawn is always easy to get a hold of and talk to. She is fantastic at making sure the tenants are informed and taken care of. When it comes to maintenance, things are taken care of quickly. If it’s not something Dave is able to fix on his own, they communicate quickly with outside companies and keep you in the loop on how things are progressing. Danielle had the apartment cleaned to the point I didn’t need to do a thing before moving in. It was spotless. She keeps the hallways and common places in excellent, clean condition. All three of them are genuinely kind and caring humans who just want to make the Centaur a wonderful place to live. The Centaur is a legitimate dog friendly community. Plenty of space to walk outside and soon there will be an indoor space for the same. Huge perk, in my opinion, there’s no fee for parking. The tenant has an assigned space and ample parking for guest. I’m hopeful for all of the additional amenities to come! If you are looking for a wonderful management team, a location you feel safe in, and a dog friendly community - the Centaur is it!

The windows in the actual apartment homes do not open, but that’s because this is essentially a historic office building located across the street from the airport that’s been repurposed - a secluded area that’s sort of out the way, which may be a pro or con for different people. The windows were designed to help dampen any ambient noise that may come from the outside, and are the original windows that have been apart of the building for years. But overall, if you want a modern apartment home in the Brookpark area, that’s  minutes away from Rocky River reservation, the highway, etc…I’d go for it!
Could have been a great building but the windows do not open! I have asthma and need fresh air when cooking or just to breathe.

I moved into this building in June 2024, renting a 1-bedroom flat, and I couldn’t be happier with my decision. While the building is still undergoing construction, which has resulted in some delays and unfinished features, the staff has been incredibly patient and considerate. One of the highlights of living here has been the Wine Down Wednesdays — a fantastic opportunity to unwind and relax after a busy workday. The sense of community here is really strong, and the staff truly makes you feel like you’re part of something special.

A standout experience for me has been the exceptional service provided by the concierge team. I recently relocated from Massachusetts to Ohio and had to navigate some local processes like changing my car registration and license. Charles, the concierge, went out of his way to guide me through the process. Despite having a fractured foot, he even drove his scooter to help me swap my car plates. It’s little acts like this that really make you feel valued. Charles, along with Angel — the morning concierge — and the rest of the team, are always there to lend a hand. One memorable moment was when my wife’s parcel was mistakenly delivered to another building. Angel went out in the cold winter and personally tracked it down, getting it to us with a smile.

Additionally, I’ve had excellent experiences with Bob, the maintenance manager, who not only resolves issues quickly but is also a great resource for tips on navigating Ohio. Sheree, the cleaning lady, is always thoughtful and accommodating, and Sonia, the building manager, is approachable and genuinely cares about the residents' well-being. Despite the ongoing construction, it’s clear that the potential for this building is enormous, and I feel safe and comfortable here with my family. The staff’s dedication to making our experience positive, even during a transition period, makes this building feel like home.

Our experience has been extremely disappointing and if I could rate them zero stars I would. Management does not respond to emails or service requests just blatantly ignore everything.
This is a great place with great staff. If you want high quality and professional, this is the place for you. You can’t go wrong with either Ryan or Laurie in regards to your leasing needs.
Rita and Mykala were amazing! The whole renting process was so easy and my unit is beautiful!

My husband and I were initially thrilled about moving into this apartment complex. However, our enthusiasm quickly diminished after just three weeks of residency due to persistent maintenance issues. In the past two days, we have been grappling with a partial power outage, affecting the elevators, security gates, security doors, and hallways. The electric water heater failure has left us without hot water for two consecutive days, necessitating the use of literal ice baths for hygiene.

Despite receiving two misleading emails from management assuring a resolution by the end of the day, our apartment still experiences a partial power outage, with no hot water in sight as I write this at 9 pm. Attempts to reach out via email and phone calls to the provided numbers have been met with ignorance, including being hung up on or directed to voicemail, leaving us without any answers.

While the apartment space is appealing and conveniently located near downtown restaurants, the ongoing issues have become increasingly frustrating. This situation has reached a point where legal action may be necessary, reflecting our deep disappointment with the current state of affairs.

Hard to find any faults with this place- Have lived here for a few months and the staff is super helpful, with any issues been addressed within a couple days- Very quiet with well-insulated walls so I don't hear the neighbors- Great location and literally a 1-2 minute walk to a grocery store and multiple restaurants/bars- Exposed pillars add character and pay homage to the original structure- My guests are always impressed-
 Highly recommended

I walked in The Archer on a Tuesday afternoon looking for a place to rent ASAP.  I had an appointment the next day in which Amanda showed me several places.  After having invested so much money in renovations, the building looked incredible.  The "Welcome Home" sign in the leasing office was spot on- I knew this was my next home.  Amanda worked with the property manager, Amber, to get me moved in by Saturday- yes 3 days later.  The application process was smooth and easy too.  I can't say enough good things about the staff, the building, or the location.  I never thought I would live downtown, but I could not be happier.  If you're looking for the excitement of downtown living, white glove service, and a spot that is convenient to get to (even on days where there are multiple events going on) make sure to visit The Archer- you'll be impressed from the moment you walk in the door.

Love the unit. Love the location, but the place is infested with roaches. I moved in an found a roach my first week. I been here for 7 months and have had pest control come a total of 6 times and I STILL have the problem. Parking is expensive, and since it’s public, the resident assigned floors are always full. Almost impossible to find a spot most days. Besides these things, the apartment is nice

I’ve been living here for 2 years now and the staff has been very helpful. Whenever I have a concern there is always someone available to assist me in a timely manner. 

Maintenance services are great, Cinesta and the maintenance group do a great job of addressing issues usually within 24-48 hours.

I recently transferred into a different unit and the transition was very smooth thanks to Laura and Joe. They worked together to discover my needs and helped me find the perfect apartment. 

If you’re interested in moving to reserve square you should ask for Joe. He is very professional, responds quickly and courteously to any of my concerns, and even recommended a few restaurants in the area for my wife and I to try. 

Overall the new staff at reserve square is great!

I have been a resident here going on two years. 
I have recently upgraded to a three bedroom in the East tower. 
I had a few complaints in the West tower but they were taken care of ASAP. 
This moving transition went smooth thanks to Lacey and Laura. 
To all or whom may be looking: 
NO WHERE IS PERFECT!
You will find something wrong anywhere you move, look for what’s important to your lifestyle and go from there. 
I am happy here! 
The amenities kept me here another term. 
K &D take care of all there properties!

I recently moved to Reserve Square in August of 2015. Having previously lived in Chicago, IL for the past 8 years my expectations of high rise living was pretty set. The initial move in was a little shaky due to us having to move in a day earlier. The apartment wasn't initially ready for move in but...... they were so helpful and accommodating with meeting our requests in a timely manner and getting things fixed and up to my liking. The building itself is in an amazing location and has a lot of amenities at no additional cost. I also received a discount for being a Principal which I truly appreciate. This discount each month covers my utility bill which is a very nice added bonus. If you want the feel of downtown living at a reasonable price, I would definitely recommend Reserve Square.

First things first: you really can't beat Reserve Square's location. You're right around the corner from Play House Square (theaters and restaurants galore), a 5 minute walk from Heinen's Grocery Store, a 10 minute walk from the public library, and a 15 minute walk from Tower City Center. Pharmacies, banks, and other necessities are all within walking distance, as are fun things like bars and stadiums.

Reserve Square itself also has some pretty nice amenities: the convenience store on the first floor is surprisingly well stocked, having laundry in the building saves tons of time and effort, and the gym has plenty of weight and cardio machines.

The apartments are pretty standard: beige carpet and walls, vertical blinds. Appliances (microwave, fridge, dishwasher, garbage disposal, stove and oven) come included, and I haven't had a single problem with any part of my apartment since I've moved in. Maintenance usually responds pretty quickly if something does go wrong.

Now for the not so great stuff: the building is seriously understaffed. The staff is generally pretty friendly, though often frazzled because they're overwhelmed with work. The package room is ridiculously slow to process mail, the elevators are pretty much constantly in need of maintenance, moving in is hellish (there's no real freight elevator), and the in-building laundry is ridiculously expensive. 

In general: Reserve Square is not perfect and suffers from some organizational problems, but the apartments are pretty nice, the amenities convenient, and the location amazing.

The best part about this apartment is that the gym is actually pretty nice for an apartment downtown. And its included which is great, because I would need to find another gym for probably 40 bucks a month if this one sucked. Indoor pool is nice, but I never use it. Sometimes I feel like I'm the only one in the building that doesn't speak a foreign language just to mention in case that bothers you. Staff is nice but not a very nice apartment. I've seen cock roaches many times, even in the first floor lobby before you get on the elevators.

If zero stars were possible, I’d rate these apartments zero. The good reviews are totally fake, or they bribe residents for good reviews. Heat and A/C constantly went out and would take months to get fixed. Maintenance & management would go into apartments while residents were gone for “repairs” that would leave the apartments dirty & would eat food out of the fridge, on top of that they wouldn’t lock the door when they left! Multiple instances of package theft & apartments being robbed here. When moving in, the apartments were dirty. The parking garage door wouldn’t work half the time. It was almost impossible to get anyone on the management team to respond to emails or phone calls, they were hardly ever in the office on site too. All in all, just a terrible experience that I wouldn’t wish on anyone. Save your time and sanity, avoid this place or any complex under this management company.

I’ve lived in Cleveland for five years and this by far has been the best experience thus far! From working with the leasing company to find the perfect apartment, to the move in experience and to now living here they do a wonderful job. I’m really happy here- thank you MPG!!

The reviews are all true, avoid renting here if you can. Over the course of living here for 15 months we have had working AC and heating for less than half. Ohio Tenant Law states that heating must be provided, and yet, during the winter months we were without heating and into the spring without AC. To their very minor credit they did offer us $200 off on account of "disruption of the AC installation", even though we had requested $500/month for 3-months that the AC and Heat were not working.

After countless discussions with management, when they can be reached, they did not offer us any rent concessions for advertising an apartment that did not have working AC or heat. The management company finally decided to install units, but this is after over a year (and more if you read others experiences) of people complaining. Furthermore, management is hardly around and extremely difficult to reach making resolutions drag out and forcing tenants in a position where they risk hurting their credit if they don't pay rent for apartments that aren't as described. To add to this, none of our maintenance requests showing the numerous requests made are in the resident portal so you cannot review the previous requests made.

I don't write a lot of reviews because in general, I find things can usually be worked out.
