This is not the case here, and I would strongly caution anyone considering living here to find somewhere else. Given the cost and general condition of these apartments, you can do better for the same or less.

Let's start with the positives which doesn't change my 1 star rating. Underground parking is nice if you want to pay the $150 / month (spaces are very close together and close to pillars. Skyroom is cool but you will rarely ever go in it. Gym is better than nothing. It's small. Now the negatives. First off when I moved in back in October of 2021 I recall the building soliciting gift cards for anyone will to leave a positive review. That's unethical in my opinion but I get it. The correspondence between tenant and management is terrible. No record of my messages once sent and no one ever follows up. Literally never. I leave for out of town and usually my lights are on multiple times??? Turn my heat off, I come back and it's 85 degrees heat blaring. The heat wasn't working for a total of half a month in the cold of winter, I heard of a reimbursement from staff and nothing ever came. I've heard the air conditioning doesn't work either (hvac) but have not tested it yet. Same system so i'm sure it will be a hot mess (pun) intended. The hvac system is trash it never works but I still get charged and this month I got charged more than double for something that never works and randomly gets set to 85 degrees and no one responds to any messages about any of this. It's like they don't care and will just take your money. For what you pay you can do better basically anywhere else. DO NOT waste your money here. They do not care about their tenants from what I can tell. for me it's the massive lack of communication and doing what's right ahead of time. Not me having to complain and complain. It gets old.
Terrible what else can I say roaches and mice and they do nothing about it

Please beware! These apartments are roach and mice infested. My building was moreso roach infested which is why I decided to move out. They blame tenants instead of making sure they keep up with routine extermination. Tenants have to pay for their own extermination. I've complained several times to management with no resolve. The regional manager is a joke and has a very bad disposition. I was standing outside of the office one day and heard her telling the property managers to write good reviews online as if they are tenants. The property management is very unprofessional and you literally have to beg them to do what they are supposed to do. Maintenance request take months for a response (if they ever even respond). I paid for garage parking and my car has been broken into, which was a surprise bc this neighborhood is very peaceful. There are no cameras. 
The buildings are no longer under Brick and Mortar, they are under Athene Property management but they still have the same poor staff.
 The rent is too high for the dated ,poorly maintained, infested apartments. The units could be so much better with updates as simple as fixing holes, cracks, and paint. The floors are loud,it sounds like someone is walking your apartment but it was just the neighbors above me- no good foundation. 
Bottom line,don't move here. Since moving out my life has been so much better. The roaches were driving me crazy and I've spent hundreds on trying to o solve the problem that should have been solved by management.

Staff is impossible to get a hold of, even if you go into their office they have no answers and are unprofessional. Heat is not included, gas and electric is in your name and they charge $90 for water every month. Roach/mice problem, and all the windows are rotting/falling apart. Also recently added a $65 monthly internet charge even if you do not use the internet they provide you still get charged due to a clause in the lease saying they can do so. AVOID THIS COMPANY

The management is impossible to get a hold of, and when you finally do, they are rude and unhelpful. It often takes a month or longer to get simple repairs done. The building itself is infested with roaches and mice.

Building is infested with cockroaches and has mice that live in the walls and raid your pantry. Management is rude, unresponsive, and they raise the rent 10% every year despite not having upgraded my apartment at all.

The apartment is mice infested and the management won’t take care of it even after multiple complaints. They are driving out old tenant and slapping in vinyl laminates and renting at rents 50% higher calling it as upgrades when they are simply ignoring the mice living inside the walls of the building.

This apartment is an awsome place to live. It host a pleathra of immenities such as fitness center game room, conference area front door trash collection services, security area,  security doors and a secure gated parkin lot, and every thing is wheel-chair assessable.
The great part about living here other than all utilities including cable and unlimited internet being offered is the amazing staff.  The apartment manager  Miss Mcghee actively engage with tenants continuously seeking feedback.  This apartment is cozy and the people here are friendly and familiar.

I've lived here for almost 4 years now with my child. Management has been great. Both management and maintenance has promptly replied to any issues I've had. Crystol and Francesca are in charge of Management. Management has been extremely empathetic towards my struggles in raising a special needs child.  I have had no issues in recieving any accomdations I've requested.

Been living here since August and my girlfriend and I completely love it here. Healthline bus stop right out front of the building which I took downtown to and from work. This building is clean, security guards are nice and very alert, and property manager Katie is AWESOME! Everything downtown is anywhere from a 15 min walk to a 5 minute bus ride. We have went to many sporting events Cavaliers and browns games which we walked to and from the stadiums. The area is very safe I have never felt threatened at all walking around.

I lived in Innova for 3.5 years, and the quality of the apartment complex significantly decreased since management changed last year. I terminated my lease halfway through and moved to a different place. The elevators are constantly broken, the A/C is shut off during the winter and the apartments are extremely hot. The security is poor, as the parking garage is open for anyone to walk into, and there is a public parking lot behind the building that frequently attracts young people that shout and play loud music at night. While the maintenance and concierge staff were always cordial, the new leasing managers are unprofessional and disrespectful. 10/10 do not recommend.

Lived here for 2 years- management never followed up on any issues I had. When some of my belongings were stolen by their furniture rental partners (CORT Furniture) under their watch (they signed off on paperwork without making sure my personal things were not taken from my apartment), their response was “I don’t know what to tell you, sorry”. They promised they’d follow up, and I never heard anything from them. Additionally, notice that they respond to every poor review on here with some sort of passive aggressive comment - pretty telling. Everyone at Concierge (with the exception of Jeriah) was annoyed whenever asking to pick up a package or get an overnight parking pass. I truly felt like I was bothering them any time I needed something. Daytime parking for guests cost a lot of money especially over time. If you miss parking payment by minutes, you’ll receive a sticker on your window that’s very difficult to remove and leaves a bad residue. The only reason I stayed for so long was because of school. As soon as I graduated, I was out. I have never written a poor review for anything before, but living here has compelled me to warn others because I wish someone had said something before I decided to live here. Move out to the west suburbs, you’ll get a lot more for your money, it’s much safer, there’s a lot more to do, and you’ll receive better management.

I've lived at Innova for 2.5 years now. With any apartment complex, there are pros and cons, but at Innova, the pros far outweigh the cons. The building is a perfect location for Cleveland Clinic, the VA, University Hospitals, and Case Western. Even Metro Health is a short drive (10-15 minutes tops). It’s always clean and never noisy (being on call overnight means sometimes I have to sleep during the day and it’s incredibly quiet). My next door neighbor had a piano in her apartment for a year and I had no idea until she moved out. The staff are friendly and they’ve responded to all my maintenance requests very quickly (most in the same day). After internet, parking, and rent, yes, Innova is expensive…but if you shop around the area you will find that most, if not all apartments that are similar in style, amenities, and modernity, will be similarly priced. 

A majority of the tenants are young professionals who are here for residency/fellowship/other graduate programs. Everyone I’ve run into is respectful and friendly. The Innova sky deck with fire pits and TV’s is very relaxing on a nice evening. The gym is clean and very modern. I have a small dog and the concierge service is extremely helpful in walking him if I’m stuck at work late one night. Location wise, you are a 12 minute walk to UH Hospital, CCF is across the street (can’t beat that), and the Art Museum, Uptown area, and Little Italy are all within walking distance (less than 25 minute walk to little Italy). An Uber from the apartment to the airport is on average $20-25 and from the apartment to downtown is around $7-8. 

They are completing construction on additions to Innova, Cleveland Clinic’s Medical school building, and the Case Western Dental School, so the only con I can think of is construction. But if you’re gone for work most of the day then it won’t matter to you. You can still get in and out easily and I’m rarely inconvenienced by it.

I’ve never had a bad experience here. I’ve walked my dog at all hours of the night and I feel safe. Like any city, there are good and bad areas. Just be smart about what you’re doing. I’ve looked at A LOT of apartments around Cleveland and Innova, while pricey, is worth it at the end of the day. I’ve chosen to renew my lease here twice now and I don’t regret it. They even had a promotional code for hospital residents when applying to Innova to save money! Use it!... "UH2018SS"
Avoid at all costs. Read the reviews all over the internet about how this place really us and be weary of reviews that sound too good to be true. They are.

I have been fortunate to call Innova home since August 2015.  The beautiful building, incredible amenities and superb concierge staff makes this not only a great place to live, but one that makes you feel special and spoiled!  Pet friendly, immaculate and safe/secure, this building is located near world-class educational and health care institutions with local shopping and arts/entertainment venues easily accessible.  Friendly, attentive and responsive management is also a great asset.  Do yourself a favor and put Innova at the top of your list, you will look long and hard to find a place that has more to offer.

I LOVE living at Innova, concierge are so helpful. They have walked my 8 year old rat terrier, cleaned snow off my car, and have answered any questions I may have regarding property and neighborhood with no hesitation. I work at Cleveland Clinic and can’t beat my 6min “walking” morning commute! 

I really enjoy the activities they have available for the residents. We had a Christmas Ugly Sweater Party including alcoholic beverages and had so much fun! We also have an upcoming Wine and Canvas party in Feb. In addition, we have a very trendy rec room and rooftop lounge to invite friends/family.

My husband and I relocated from Atlanta for the role at the Clinic and researched so many apartments in the University Circle area. We are so glad we chose Innova Living!! They stand by their model: Work Hard. Live Easy.

Really wanted to love the Bingham because of the location but unfortunately after a year, we're looking to move. 

Beyond horrible move in experience and no one from the leasing office ever checked in with us after. 

Dog park is under constructions for over 3 months, meanwhile everyone is leaving poop all around the outside of the building. They also let their dogs pee on the concrete near the entrance so it constantly smells like urine. To my knowledge, no one is actually fined. 

Parking is expensive and people will park in you garage spot. No tow truck can get in. 

Cheap carpet with nails that stick out. Always dirty in the common spaces.

Lived here for 2 years, great location, apartment itself was nice and spacious, staff very friendly as well and never had any issues. I've lived at the 9 and Flats East Bank post the bingham and neither came close to the Bingham. Would be my recommendation for downtown living.

My Wife and I spent 3 Years living at The Bingham recently relocating back to the west coast. If you are going to live downtown Cleveland, which has so much to offer, this is the place for you. Our tenure there was characterized by very professional, down to earth, accessible and effective leadership. Randa is a terrific manager that always took the time to address any issues we had either by herself or quickly routing to an appropriate team member. She always had a smile and was perpetually inquisitive about how things were going. The maintenance staff led by Steve were terrific, prompt and kept our apartment in to shape. The amenities are great with great community rooms both upstairs and downstairs that we have used to celebrate major events. There are also two wonderfully appointed guest rooms  right in the building that our families have stayed at while visiting as opposed to hotels, allowing them privacy, however, very convenient proximity. There is a Constantinos market grocery just downstairs which we are already missing. It is awesome to be able to run to the grocery store 2 mins away to grab the ingredient you missed while cooking  or top up for drinks or ice when entertaining. There are two large parking lots adjacent to the building meaning that when hosting large events, your guests can park and walk right up - no worries. Finally I'd like to commend the concierges, Robert, Travis, Kelley and the team who have been a constant helping with every little thing - and doing so cheerfully. Having stayed at many apartment complexes, I have to finish by saying that the tone of leadership from Randa clearly permeates the culture and has created an environment that we loved staying at. We will be staying at The Bingham again if Cleveland is in the future again.

Thank You Again!

Update: Someone reached out from Morgan Properties to "rectify" the situation. Initially the lady had apologized. But rather than follow through with humility, attempted to gas light me for their own wrong doing. You really can't make this up. The Bingham may be nice apartments, I'm sure the staff is lovely, but WOW..... the property managers are down right despicable.

Had reached out in May 8th when a listing for a 1 bedroom with a balcony was first listed to inquire on applying. Laura took 2 days to respond (understandable) but proceeded to attempt to sell me on 2 bedroom apartments. So I restated I wanted what I originally inquired about. She then ignored me for 4 days and it wasn't until I sent a question mark that she finally responded. She said that apartment was still available and sent me a link to apply for it to have already been taken. 6 days it took when the original information clearly stated I wanted "that" apartment. So then she goes back to attempt to sell me once again on what I don't want. Talk about unprofessional. Laura, you are terrible.

I was a former tenant of the Bingham. I was in a penthouse unit so the layout was a little different than the lofts. All I can say is positive things. My roommate was a bust but that is my fault. We looked everywhere including the Bingham at first until I learned about the penthouses and I was lucky to call when one had just opened but was being renovated. We signed the very next day. Move in was flawless and we had to wait on parking but it was no problem with the lot being available next door for renters monthly. The room had a jacuzzi, a real full size jacuzzi tub that was what won me over immediately, this was the real deal and it is by far the best tub I have ever experienced. Many books and articles were read in that tub. Giant balcony that was the envy of everyone I knew. A killer view of Lake Erie. Stunning kitchen, amply storage place, giant gym, huge parking garage once I got my space and the best staff you can ask for. They did not seem to be corporate minded but for the residents. I met a ton of people but the penthouse people all knew each other and it was like a family. I made many friends which I did not expect as I am somewhat private but still a talker. All in all, you really cannot go wrong here, do it!

Eric D

Incredibly spacious apartments. The floor plans are very open with high ceilings (mine is about 15-18ft). Short walk to all downtown sport stadiums and nightlife areas. Has a large gym for an apartment complex consisting of several machines and dumbbells 5-110lbs. Price is reasonable for the amount of space and location. Connected to the complex is an fresh foods market that has all the essentials at reasonable prices.

I loved my time at the Garfield, the location, amenities, and the staff were outstanding. I have lived in 3 different complex's downtown and this was by far the best.

The building is brand new, the room was a perfect size, and the 2nd floor community room is an awesome place to have a social gathering or study. 

Lastly, the management team was top notch. Lea and Kiki do a fantastic job. They put on fun and unique events for the residents all year round, which I will surely miss.

After living in The Garfield over 6 months, I figured I have a good outlook on the place now. And it's great.

The best place I toured in Cleveland. In my opinion, it has the upper hand on any other location.

So here's a review of my 3 favorite things I love about The Garf (in no order):

1. The building is great - clean, new and quiet. (I fall asleep like a baby. Everyone's super respectable noise-wise)

2. The staff are ALL friendly - from the managers to the maintenance people - everyone's super down-to-earth and personable.

3. The monthly residence events*

*I moved here from "out of town" and didn't know anyone...

So I was a bit nervous because I imagined it'd take awhile to make new friends.

...however, the first resident event I went to I met a great group of people I clicked with. And made a ton of new friends.

Not sure I could ask for anything else at this place (although, a rooftop pool would be nice... haha)

Seriously though, couldn't ask for a better place to live.

I just moved in a few weeks ago and I want to highlight how great the management has been. Lea and Kiki always get back to me right away whenever I have needed their assistance. There is also an on-site maintenance man who will help you hang anything up in your room. In addition, the building is right you where you want to be downtown. I am a short walk away from some of the best bars, restaurants, and entertainment in town. If you are looking to move downtown, come check out the Garfield.

I toured this past week and I was overall very impressed with the property. It is charming but modern which is hard to pull off but they did. I hate the giant windows in the one bedroom but it is a different take and lets in a lot of light (why I dislike it). The prices are right on though which makes this noteworthy and having a huge garage across the street with high clearance is a winner right off of Euclid by east fourth and by all the major buildings. This place should be a hit. Also beer bar and amazing coffee, four elevators, and a great staff. A home run I think 


Eric

I have been living here for two years and have seen this newly renovated building rapidly fall into disrepair. The parking garage is being held up by scaffolding due to the severe rust on many of the supporting beams. Management has also failed to remove graffiti on the property. There's also only one elevator in the entire property, and it is constantly out of service due to maintenance.

From the moment I toured the building, I knew that Euclid Grand was something else. Ever since then, living here has been nothing short of amazing. The friendly staff, the sense of security and the community feel are simply unmatched.
Best place to stay in downtown, the rooftop has a view of the fireworks whenever there is a game in the stadium, the game room is fun and has a big TV where we enjoy our weekends watching movies.

We love our apartment and the sense of security provided by Euclid Grand. The secure parking and building access along with the beautiful PH apartment and amenities were the top selling points for us.
The maintenance so far has not been good but the apartments are nice and spacious and the prices are reasonable.
I loved it since the tour and almost a year later I still love it. Great communication all around. The energy is great!

We moved in two weeks ago and love it! The leasing and concierge staff of very pleasant to work with and have been very accommodating to our needs. The units are beautiful and quiet. We have had no noise issues at all. We love the downtown location and vibe! We could not be happier with our choice on Euclid Grand.
Beautiful, clean, modern apartments. Love the high ceilings and rooftop. Very walkable in the Tremont neighborhood.

I have been living here since June and I love it. The location is perfect as well as the amenities. Bars and resturant and walkable and building is always doing fun events for residents. As a female I feel safe living here and I couldn't imagine living at any other building in the area. Dog friendly as well and my dog loves the green space!
I am on my third year at Electric Gardens. Nobody bothers me, very little noise, other tenants are friendly. Maintenance is very quick to fix anything. Overall great experience

I've lived here for about 3 years now and have loved my experience! Located right in Tremont, it's in walking distance to many coffee shops, bars, and restaurants. Electric Gardens is also right on the towpath, which is perfect for long walks with scenic views of downtown. I also enjoy the amenities of Electric Gardens: a beautiful rooftop overlooking downtown, a modern gym right downstairs, and a coffeeshop/bar in the lobby. I also love the modern, luxurious look of my apartment unit! You can't beat the new appliances and ample closet space.
Beautiful property with amazing amenities from the gym to the rooftop- it’s well appointed and maintained.
The best apartment I have lived at so far!! :) Rushil is great and very communicative! We have great amenities, including my favorite our cafe and the trail!! :) high recommend!

I can't say enough good things about this apartment complex! From the moment I moved to Cleveland, I’ve felt completely at home. The amenities are top-notch – the fitness center is great, and the rooftop is amazing to enjoy the beautiful view of the Cleveland skyline. 
The best part? The staff. They are so friendly and always go above and beyond to make sure residents feel welcome and taken care of. One of the most unexpected but wonderful surprises was the sense of community. I’ve met so many amazing people here and have made some great friends. Not to mention the layout of my apartment is spacious, modern, and just perfect for my needs

've been living here for a while now, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. The apartment offers an amazing view of the city, which is definitely one of the highlights. Every morning, I wake up to a breathtaking panorama that never gets old.

The building itself is always well-maintained. The cleanliness is top-notch, and I really appreciate how the common areas are kept spotless. It's clear that the management takes pride in the property.

Another standout feature is the customer service. The staff is incredibly friendly and responsive. Whether I have a maintenance request or just need help with something, they’re always quick to assist. It's refreshing to live somewhere where the management truly cares about their residents.

Additionally, the community here is great. There are frequent social events that make it easy to meet neighbors and stay connected. It creates a real sense of community, which I love.

Overall, I’m extremely satisfied with my experience and am planning to stay for another two years, God willing. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, well-managed apartment with great amenities and an unbeatable view.

Really loving my experience at Electric Gardens! I just moved in recently and everything was seamless. I especially loved how the property manager was here to help me get set up, (delivered my packages to me even), and gave me free goodies. The best parts are: the access to the Tow Path, the dog friendly complex, and the quiet atmosphere. And it’s got THE best city skyline views! Really looking forward to staying here long term :)

I love living at Electric Gardens! My partner moved in this past summer & from our tour to move in everything was handled with fantastic communication and professionalism. Rushil the property manager has really put an innovative in promoting resident events which has been amazing!

From the amenities, to the apartments, to the management— Electric Gardens is a place to be!

I've lived at Electric Gardens since the building opened and I absolutely love it. The location and views are unbeatable, and I love having a coffee shop and wine bar in the lobby for those work from home days when I need to get out of my apartment. Rushil, the property manager is AMAZING and so attentive to resident's needs. If you are looking for a new place to live, I would definitely recommend EG.

By far the best apartment that has a great location. You are minutes away from restaurants, grocery stores, highways, and right in the center of Cleveland! You are close (even walking distance) - I love living here!!

This place is so amazing. The views are fantastic, but the care put into design are what really sold me. Truly the best place to rent right now in Cleveland! Can’t wait for the summer time here with the rooftop views!!!

Amazing property nestled in the center of Tremont with direct access to the Metroparks Tow Path and all the local restaurants. The design of the building feels more like a boutique hotel with 5 star amenities (fitness center, co working space, AND AIRBNB!). The building manager, Hannah, has been great to work with and answers questions quickly. We got postponed for our move-in but the developers (Jroc) have been transparent and uber-accommodating!  Can’t wait to be apart of this project.
This is a special property right on the towpath.  Very unique.  Like a boutique hotel with sweeping panoramic views and lots of deck space.

Electric Gardens is in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Cleveland - Tremont.  Both of the roof decks have panoramic views of downtown which are incredible.  The coworking space (Limelight) on the first floor is a huge value add, especially with working from home becoming more of the norm.  The units are decked out with everything you would want and expect + more.  Customer service from Hannah, the property manager, is first-class.

I had a terrible experience as a tenant at My Place Group’s 41 West property. During a 4-day power outage, they offered no alternative housing, and the emergency lights in the building stopped working, creating unsafe conditions. All my food went bad, and my renter’s insurance didn’t cover the loss.

After moving out in November, it took over six weeks to hear about my security deposit. They deducted charges for a stove I never used, cleaning cabinets I had already cleaned, and repainting small spots on the walls where I had hung items. The charges were excessive, and communication was poor throughout my tenancy.

I do not recommend renting from My Place Group.

The location is perfect and I don’t want to move any time soon.

Any time there are problems with the building, management has been quick to address them. It is clear they care about the common areas but the roof deck needs more attention. Maintanence is fairly quick for in-unit requests.

I have been calling the office and property managers for weeks now and have not heard back. They are charging my resident portal hundreds of dollars AFTER I MOVED OUT almost a month ago and will not tell me what the charges are for.
The place got sold multiple times no one there bed bugs crazy people washers overflow and don't work bad parking lot bad records

Upgrades to the building was continuous during my stay here, management transitions had some hiccups, but those are expected and they worked out any problems. I think it’s a quiet building, and I never had any trouble during my stay
The apartments smell like drugs. I had to call police several times.management could care less as long as there apartments are rented .

It was a great property until AIY Properties took over! Not kept clean, section 8, renters that play loud music at different hours, halls can smell of weed, stomping. AIY Properties will do nothing to control issues you will have to call the police time and time again. All AIY Properties cares about money and they will harass you even if it's $10 that you owe.
Go elsewhere!
Poor management. Outdated appliances & old carpet. Bedbug infestation.

Bed bugs and management doesn’t care. They said it could have came from the Uhaul. But other tenements in same floor state bed bug infested prior. Management does not do enough to eradicate. They spray twice and doesn’t do monthly exterminating maintenance. Do not recommend this place.

I went and looked at these apartments.  Residents told me not to rent.  Drug activity’s rampant, and bedbugs are a hug problem. I wanted to live close to my friends and public transit.  The rent was well within my budget. I’m so disappointed. It was perfect for me.

Call to place work orders and either they don't answer or you never receive a confirmation call back. Called about air conditioner/fan unit not working since 12/19/18. Told on 2/8/19, after complaining about not having heat that the 12/19/18 work order was cancelled and they would get back to it in the spring (I was never contacted). 2/13/19, I had told go to the Main Office because no one had shown up or called about fixing my heat, someone showed later that afternoon. Placed another work order for A/C on 4/8/19, have heard nothing. Made 3 calls to Maintenance on 4/22/19, phone rings and goes to voice mail. its 5/4/19, I guess they will be seeing me in the office again!!!

I've lived at the Shoreham for 2 years now with few to no complaints.  Having access to the pool in the summer is a huge perk of living here, as well as the proximity to downtown CLE, Lakewood, and the Metroparks.  I was lucky to have a downtown and lake view, although not everyone renter will.     A few minor drawbacks are the lack of street parking and somewhat outdated appliances/furnishings, also I didn't have a dishwasher. Overall, a nice place to live in a mostly safe area.

It is a cool building and it definitely has a great location but well below average customer service experience I had here. The property manager was not helpful when I asked simple questions and generally had a bad attitude a number of times throughout my year stay. There were a couple other things that I disliked about the place. The gym is pretty outdated for one and they don't keep up with, as in, there aren't towels or water stocked. Also, my neighbor had a bad experience in their unit (there was a unfixed hole in the ceiling for over a month). 

My major concern about this place is how I was treated. Sure, there were some times that I was treated with respect and as a preferred customer, which I appreciated. However, I received some miscommunication from the property manager and this experience overshadowed everything else. After attempting to reach out to the office a few times to attempt to discuss the confusion/miscommunication, my calls were not returned. I felt unheard as they responded with comments that did not address my concern(s) and were inconsistent/unreasonable with what the property manager has previously said. This situation left me feeling ripped off. I'm writing this this review as objectively as I can - the rating it is not a reflection of the result of the disagreement but more-so how the situation was handled (unprofessionally). Honestly, it is a nice building but poor ethics displayed by the property group.
i moved here 3 months ago. really like it. very nice and clean. staff in the office is super friendly and nice. great lake and downtown view.

I am a recently new renter not only at Marine Towers West, but also in the Cleveland area. I moved to Cleveland right after college graduation to start over with a new nursing job downtown. The staff at Marine Towers West has been nothing short of a helping hand in my relocation. Not only was the staff timely and professional with my move, they have also helped me get acclimated and comfortable in this new city. Claire and Char in the leasing office hold every answer you will ever need to know about the building as well as the local area. The maintenance crew, Terry and James, have been extremely timely on my needs and very efficient with their work. 

Although this move was a bit overwhelming for a young professional, Marine Towers West made every effort they could to make it easier on me. Coming home from work where no one knows you yet, to a friendly smile and someone who remembers your name, goes a lot farther than one could imagine. I look forward to the growing relationships I am developing within the building as well as my future time in these apartments.

Midtown Towers has recently gone under a change of management; so it is now owned by a new company called Oakmark Management and I have been blown away by the service provided. For over the year I have lived here, I faced numerous issues with the other management. It got so bad to the point where I was starting to think it was time for a move, but this new management has gone above and beyond to work with me and finally address the issues and concerns I have had. Cheers to Oakmark Management!

Worst management ever! So bad management changes every couple of months. The residents are dirty with bad roach infestations that cause them to come into your apartment. Pest control only puts down bait they dont spray to kill them so they ultimately dont help at all! Hallways always are smelly. Maintenance will knock once and will enter your home weather you allow them in or not even if you are sleep they will come in without you knowing and starting working. Dont move here worst apartment I have ever lived in.
Roaches. Rude management. Trash overflow. Dirty/smelly hallways. Over priced. Get out before 30 days. ROACHES!

The hallway has had a dry egg in it for weeks, someone peed in the hallway once, they charged new utilities with only a month notice ($40 a month for water, which I do NOT use that much water), there are bugs!! So many ants. There's water damage in my closet and maintenance just spray painted over it. You can hear everything your neighbors are doing. The pool smells bad and has short hours. The weight room doesn't have anything to clean the equipment. There's only one trash compacter (sucks to be in building 3) and it's almost always overflowing with trash. 
Cherry on top is They lost my notice to terminate! I have no idea how long I'm going to be paying for this hell hole that I'm definitely not going to be living in any longer than I have to.

Only move here if it's your last option. Other then that keep looking. The office staff is rude and absolutely NO help whatsoever. You'll wait MONTHS to get something done by maintenance. The elevators will break on you (While your in it). Garbage is left in the stair well, hallways, and outside areas. People will steal your packages. Also the security doors are not so secure as they are ALWAYS propped open so anyone/anything can get in.
Not a bad living experience, but they need better communication and response time from the maintenance department and management.

Was a good place to live overall for 4 years. They charged $378 from my deposit to replace the carpet that was there after 4 years of normal wear and tear. The carpet was outdated compared to some of the other units in the complex and this appears to be a way of then having  the tenants pay for updates that should be their responsibility.

These apartments are TERRIBLE! This place has gone downhill big time! From mold, poor ventilation, very loud and weak AC units to neighbors smoking and having no consideration for others. If you care about your health, DO NOT MOVE HERE!
I lived here 4 years before going to the military and miss everything about it so much

I have lived at the Terraces at Northridge for 5 years and plan to renew my lease for another 2 years.  This is one of the only communities that offers everything I desire in an apartment complex.  I have a beautiful 2 bedroom/2 bathroom apartment with central air, washer & dryer in my unit, dishwasher, extremely responsive maintenance staff, swimming pool, community gym, pets allowed, right off I-480, close to all shopping, safe quiet neighborhood within close proximity to Cleveland downtown and also the airport, and a quick 10-15 minute commute to downtown.  The grounds are kept very well, and the crowd that lives here is a good mix between young families and more seasoned adults.  Overall everyone is very respectful of their neighbors.  For all of these features, this complex is reasonably priced and I would recommend it.  Comparatively, I have lived downtown Cleveland and in West Park.  I have chosen to maintain my residence here the longest for good reason.

I've lived at The Terraces at Northridge the past 8 years. Very lovely and quiet community, close to everything (stores, highways, school), 24 hour maintenance service and always very prompt on work orders, love having an in suite washer and dryer and out of all the apartments I've lived at, this is the only one that has felt like home. They also have holiday parties and fun summer events (when the pool opens) which are very fun and a great way to meet fellow neighbors.

Our apartment is very nice, and the location is great. Everything from shopping, to a movie theater, to grocery shopping is a walk away. The community is very quite.

Improvements:  It would be nice to have a lower fixed amount for water, and either having a fix rate for heat, or lowering the cost.

Within my first month here a man got shot right outside my window. The management and staff is horrible to work with. The lady's in the office are rude! The only nice people are the maintenance workers. They over charged my for things that was damaged prior to me moving in. They're in it for the money.  People always leave their clothes in the shared washer and drying for the apartment. It's 8 units per building with shared washer and dryer. THEY DONT SHOVEL WHEN IT SNOWS. I had to purchase a shovel and I had to shovel the entrance/exit to the apartment because it was a safety hazard. The apartments have a no smoking policy yet the hall's reeked of cigarettes and weed.

I’ve been here for about 4 months now. The ladies in the leasing office have been great. They are pleasant and sweet every time I see them. 
As for the apartment itself, it is super small. I live here alone with a bunny and it’s been great. The living room is pretty spacious. The bedroom is quite spacious for the size but the kitchen is literally as big as my armspan on a single wall. If you like to cook, maybe not for you. I’m actually super impressed with how much storage space this place has. The linen closet is preshelved and quite large. Big windows. The AC is a unit mounted to the wall in the living room which means if you like to sleep hot, you’re golden. It’s great for what I pay and it’s definitely a good size for what I was looking for. All in all I wish the shower was a little bigger but other than that it’s a great single person apartment.
I have only been at Westview Acres since April and I haven't had any problems, they keep the area clean and great security. I highly recommend Westview Acres to anyone that is looking to move.

Maintenance was always very prompt and you rarely heard neighbors. Hot water never ran out and central AC was awesome. New windows, plenty of outlets, heat works great. Very rare wifi issues. The garage is a pretty tight, it was quite dirty on move-in and packages are often stolen, but otherwise I enjoyed living here!

I have lived here for 2 years, and I do not foresee myself leaving anytime soon. The atmosphere of the building and location is amazing. I get to live right in the hustle and bustle of downtown, but this all is blocked out while I’m in my apartment. The apartment is quiet and provides me privacy while allowing me to walk outside into one of the foremost urban centers in the country. The apartment is luxurious and the management is customer-service oriented. I would plain and simply recommend these apartments to anybody seeking to augment their life. The few who did not like it here probably have issues with themselves, their dealers, their families, spouses, and employers too. Nevertheless, the establishment is great.

The apartment I lived in was clean, updated, and quiet. The management worked tirelessly to address all of my concerns. Though security may seem like a concern, the management provides several layers of protections, making these apartments feel very very safe. Everything about the building and my apartment were splendid, even the temperature. At my old apartment I’d always wake up sweating, but Schofield features some of the best climate units on the market. Needless to say, I was more than satisfied with my time here.

These apartments were horrible, AC units that never worked, smoke (both types) circulating throughout both apartments, and worst of all poor security. 

The management is well aware of the AC issues but they refuse to address it. After multiple attempts they finally stopped trying to assist. The units stop operating in the middle of the night and you wake up hot. If you decide to sign here be sure to have a clause added to your contract allowing you to get out of the contract if it’s not working.

Security is probably the worst part of the this place. A homeless man broke into the apartments and exposed himself. It took over 2 months for management to update security at all. Additionally, management had a photo of the person but did not share it with the residents because they “didn’t want to alarm anyone.” The homeless man was known to hang around the apartment per local police.

The management does not provide a private security guard circulating the building while many other buildings do provide this. If you decide to lease here make sure that they add private security first.

We sold our large Shaker home and decided to try something different...downtown living.  The Schofield fits our desire for compact, efficient living without sacrificing comfort, beauty or safety.  Management made it easy, allowing multiple moves in and out, while deciding the furnishings necessary for our new life style.  The desk staff and valets are excellent, responding to all requests with prompt, courteous service.  With Parker's in the building and Heinen's across the street, we are never without delicious choices for dining.  Thank goodness for the walkability of the city streets!  The nearly floor to ceiling windows are the art that create an exciting vibe when entering our apartment. We love our new home and the convenience of downtown living.

My husband and I have lived at The Schofield for almost two years now. We’ve really enjoyed our time here, from the welcome basket we got on move in day, to the ease of moving out. It’s downtown living without all the hassle you get at other big apartment complexes. We loved the safety and security and also the wine hour :). We’re going to miss it!!!
Things are so bad a petition was made by residents with over 100 signatures

I've been living here a few years and I don't plan on moving any time soon. This community has experienced growing pains that many couldn't recover from and I'm actually proud to see all of the improvements and upgrades that have occurred. It's a great place to live, great neighbors in a great location.
They made the move in process super easy and loved the new apartment. Everything was clean and everyone on staff is friendly

The property is okay. The windows do not open so you are limited on fresh air. The main issue they force you to get their wifi which is more than if i were to get it myself and parking is an additional $200 a month on top of paying for your own utilities. The rent is a good price to live downtown in the flats. But having to pay for parking when the garage is attached to the property is not fair. Having to pay 75 a month for wifi that doesn’t work well is not fair.

Great apartment, maintanance, and neighbors. 

Bad management and office staff.
Great option if you want downtown living but don't want to go out ALL the time.

Just leaving an honest review to keep things real - I’ve lived here for just about a year and while there have been some isolated incidents involving car window breakings (hello you live in the city???), management was responsive in getting security instated, and are receptive to feedback from residents that report such things. I have friends that live in other neighborhoods and it’s way worse in Ohio city or downtown. I have a dog and feel very comfortable walking around any time of day, it’s one of the reasons I chose this area to live. All of the amenities are top tier and are well kept, and the apartments themselves are lovely, spacious, and reasonably priced for the quality. 

Entitlement leads people to embark on cancel culture tantrum tirades - form your own opinions on this awesome spot in Cleveland :)

My car has been broken into multiple times.  This week alone, 6+ cars have been vandalized multiple nights in a row. Meaning, the people committing these crimes are not afraid to come back.  We are paying for a "Security" guard but he does absolutely nothing.  Last night the people smashing in car windows parked 20 ft away from the Security car and managed to vandalize 6 cars before the police came. The security guard did nothing.  
A woman was robbed at gun point. 
Someone broke into the building and vandalized an apartment inside on the first floor of building A. 
Multiple cars have been stolen. 
Cars are not safe inside the garage as well, multiple cars are broken into and stolen with garage parking. 
Maintenance requests are just closed out without actually resolving the issue. 
They use Nationwide Energy which is known for being over priced, so plan to pay over $200 a month for your Electric bill and sometimes near $300 in the winter.

so much crime on this property and nothing is done.  The property itself is nice but your car will be broken into if not stolen, happens at least twice a week here with smashed windows at minimum. This occurs even inside the parking garage, also no cameras inside parking garage.  Safe lite van is always here fixing  windows.  Cleveland crime scene van has even been here.

Local criminals will sit in this parking inside stolen vehicles waiting to pray on you day or night.  Management does nothing to prevent this.  Management keeps residents in the dark about the crime and potential safety concerns on the property.  Cleveland Police take 5 hours to respond if you call 911 and are a victim of theft and or vandalism.  My roommate and I are two grown men and we don't feel safe at night.

There is no security here, do not be mislead. 

Do your research contact public records search at Cleveland police 2nd district for the property if you need anymore factual information on what really goes on and make your decision from there.

Stay safe, be smart.

S73 Management if you choose to respond to this, I will begin to post pictures off everything I've witness since I have been here.  Just keeping you honest :)
Great place to stay. The staff is extremely friendly & the apartment community is beautiful.

Although the Artisan is a nice place to live. I wish the corporate/management gave preferred employee discounts besides a $25 discount on parking which is still yet to be confirmed. I been to many other locations they offered so many promotional offers which were also upscale apartment living. My current place of residence the management is outstanding they go above and beyond to find solutions and accommodate the residents no matter what situation. I felt this was lacking at Artisan which is my honest and transparent thought; it’s not just about getting the apartments filled and making quota. Like I said the apartment itself is nice and located in a safe place but hopefully certain things change to be more accommodating for the future residents this will truly make Artisan outshine other places.
Just recently started a lease at this complex. I have had a great experience thus far. Notably, LaTosha was an excellent resource for me and was very responsive.

Application was denied with no email regarding why. Location is right on water and on a steep hill so beware of bugs. Not much regarding the apartments online. Number does not work on website. Only communication is through email.

This is one of the last truly affordable places in Downtown Cleveland. I have lived here for 2 years and have enjoyed the convenient location and availability for parking. The prices at Crittenden Court are very affordable, however you will not get any major amenities. The building is overall decently maintained. The gym and the common room are very nice to have but are not remarkable. I feel safe in the neighborhood and there is security at the building at night. During the summer months depending on where your apartment is located, you may hear the concerts from the Nautica. However it is well worth being within walking distance to the Brown's, Cavilers', and Indian's Stadium. It is a great place to live in the growing city center in Downtown Cleveland.

We have lived here for 11 years. The neighborhood is wonderful. I would never want to live anywhere else. And the Van Aken district is a five minute walk and filled with restaurants and stores. I love to walk and this is the perfect location to do that. Our apartments faces the golf course and we love the view. 

The management really cares about the tenants and their needs. They respond quickly to resolve problems and work to fix the problems as quickly as they can.  

If you are looking for a unique neighborhood and a great place to live then check out Essex House and Blair House.

Impossible to communicate with anyone in the leasing office at all. The entire system is run by poor automation that does not answer questions that you ask it. I have left messages for a week with no response from a person. The only communication that I have received from this building came after I put in an application, which requires you to link a bank account for rent verification (no one else has asked for this anywhere I applied). The communication I received after the application was only to tell me they could not find my pet application which I was forced to complete using a secondary system which is an additional fee as well.

We lived on the 12th floor end unit facing downtown.  Best view in town from private balcony(s) overlooking Lake Erie.  The staff on-site very helpful and take time to celebrate events throughout the year.  It’s with mixed emotions we are relocating to anther community with a change in employer.

We love living here.  We've been here for 4years.  The staff is AMAZING.  The management company fixes or replaces just about everything (from the pool to the elevators).  NO BUGS- THANK GOODNESS! Killer views, huge balconies and a carwash! Also, you never hear your neighbors which is a huge plus.

The management at the complex could be a lot better, but the apartment itself is amazing. Absolutely huge for the cost (around $1650). Utilities aren't too bad (around $250), and parking is relatively cheap at $50 a space. The utilities are a little odd though because a lot of them are "communal utilities", where they average out the water and heat for the whole complex and that's your bill. If you get a unit that doesn't face the water, you are wasting your money. We had a corner view, 5th floor. It overlooked the lake and has a beautiful view of the skyline. This view is great for the Cleveland Air Show, Fireworks for the 4th of July and Sporting Events, and generally just watching sailboats all day.

This place is awful! I had to live with cockroaches for 2 months because my neighbors are nasty. That was followed by massive water damage that ruined most of the clothes in my closet. All i was given was a weak "we're sorry" after ruining about 2500$ worth of clothes. Also my friend who also live here had his car stolen out of the parking lot. Do yourself a favor dont live here!

Don’t live here. I have been here 5 years 3 were ok. in the last 2 I have had a insane cockroach infestation from my dirty neighbors and now a leak from upstairs ruined my whole closet of clothes and all I got was a sorry. not to mention my friend who also lives here had his car stolen. they don’t care about their tenants don’t live here.

Elevators are always broken down, water leaks in the stairwell leading to fall risk, ALWAYS construction going on with no notification of such. The construction is often extremely loud and starts extremely early in the day. There are no efforts to push starting time later even for residents who work nights and sleep during the day. You are basically told to deal with it.

I just moved into this apartment on May 1st and it is the worst apartment I have ever rented. They stated we can check out videos of the apartments on youtube. They purposefully did not have pictures of the kitchen snd the bathroom in the video. The kitchen is very dated and they did the bathroom was not cleaned before the move in.

First I’d like to say I’ve leased here once before back in 2009-2010 I believe. Although I had a pleasant experience, I was told that all apartments were being updated then and that has clearly not happened. I am currently leasing a 2 bedroom apartment with approximately 1000sq ft of Living space. The entire apartment has the  feel of an old 1970’s show. Kitchen cabinets are dull and are on their last leg.  The vanity in the main bath is swollen and musty smelling from the years of water issues. Appliances are not energy efficient and outdated and continue to pop breakers for some reason.  Also, to quote the maintenance manager the plumbing lines, “burp” back into your bathtub. Leaving what appeared to be raw sewage  and maggots ( one to be exact). Said it happens especially on the first floor. Moving on,  apartments are supposed to be freshly painted and their not, they touched up with the same color paint throughout my apartment and there was visible discoloration on the ceiling /walls when I moved in.. Speaking of painting don’t be surprised if two unattended 15 year old kids show up to your door to paint because that who they sent after my apartment was flooded from an upstairs tenant. They proceeded to splatter paint on my dinette set, curtains, curtain rod, television, carpet. Even after I provided and laid down plastic in areas I believed they’d be working. Rather then move the plastic, they just painted away because again their 15-16 year old kids. All these things are well documented both by myself and Zaremba management. I have pics and video and even a thank you letter from the 15 year old for allowing him the use of my plastic.. Recently after the second flooding and botched work I was told the painters would be out to resolve painting issue in master bed/hallway and bath once things have,”dried out”........ That was almost a month ago. Finally after a drippy faucet, a $300 light bill ( from commercials dryers and humidifier) I had enough. So I sent in a review and low and behold I get offered a whopping “$75 one time credit.” It’s almost laughable.  There are of number of other things I could mention but I’m sure you get the point. I’m totally dissatisfied and disappointed in the staff and management here. By the way I’ve only been here 3 months, Yayyyy!! 9/20

I just renewed my lease.  After living 40  years in a single family home, this was my first experience with apartment living.  Yes, it may be a little dated but  it is kept up. Any problem I have had, maintenance has promptly (within days for non-sensitive issues)fixed to my satisfaction..  The new upgraded apartments are absolutely beautiful.  They have complimentary  transportation to grocery, Walmart and Great Northern mall.  The bus driver is great.  The office staff knows all the residents and are very helpful.  They also have planned social activities--movies, game nights, midweek bingo, ice cream social, resident appreciation dinner and BBQ's.  The pool area is fantastic.  Lots of lounge chairs and umbrellas for those who aren't swimmers. It is like a resort.  My building is extremely quiet.  I have never heard a sound  from the neighboring apartments or those above me.  I love the balconies. The large sliders make the apartment  bright and appear more spacious.  I have found the other tenants to be friendly and helpful.It is located on two RTA bus lines that make it super convenient if you don't drive or don't want to drive.  They provide service  20 hrs a day 7 days a week.  The location bein across the street from the MetroParks is another plus.  I hope they keep up the good work.
Clean great very nice staff members its the Best thank you.

This is a very nice place. My wife and I are in our early 60's and have downsized from a home with a large yard. We have a lovely 5th floor balcony overlooking a nice courtyard, the grounds are kept up and improved constantly, and the maintenance and office people are very nice. The pool area is very nice; with new lounge chairs and tables, almost like a resort, and has a tennis court and a gas grilling setup nearby. The work out room has just been upgraded and the staff hold free parties for the residents. There is a large party room available and a smaller one in each of the four buildings. Altogether I love it here. The Metropark system is right across the street and is a real treat. Everything is nearby and convenient. Very nice living here.

I wouldn't be in this place if it wasn't for Apartments.com. It was the very first place that showed up upon my search and ended up being the best one for me after other potential places. It's nice and quiet, but you feel like a part of a small village on the grounds. I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.

I am a mature but young at heart person starting over in life (okay 3rd time starting over) and needed to find a place that felt welcome and safe but not staid. Upon meeting with a Zaremba Management leasing consultant, and touring the Fairview Village apartment complex, I felt that I had found that zen space. The grounds are lovely with unexpected but delightful visits from deer wandering up from the Metro Parks System down the hill, and the pool is heavenly. Looking forward to using the newly renovated work-out room when summer is over. Big bonus is that Fairview Village is so close to Hopkins Airport!
I have enjoyed living here. Maintenance responds quickly, the community is quiet, and the office staff know you by name.

I lived here 6 years and have seen the place go down hill over 6 years. For the price you pay, everything is outdated. The wiring is old so That I'd you get ATT for internet, DSL (it very very slow) the att guy told the wires are very old in this building that was why could not get u verse. My appliances and ac are from early 80's. The only thing new is the dishwasher. That's because mine broke. I waited 8 months to get a new one installed. The only reason I got it was because after 8 months and constantly going to the office to complain about the stale stagnate water that was in it. I threatened to call the health department and show the moldy water that was in this. I finally got the new dishwasher.

About 2 years ago they got a new manager who decided to start taking on fees. That was when everything started going downhill. She turned it into section 8. However they do not take section 8 but everyone swears the residents are on section 8. That the appearance anymore.

Fairview Village used to be a really amazing place to live. I lived here 5 years ago and I never had a problem. I think I had to call the maintenance staff just once for a minor issue. Sadly, 5 years later the quality of so many things have went down considerably.
First, back in winter time I had a water pipe leak.so they had to create a hole to fix it. Which they didn't quite even fix. (That hole was never fixed either..and will play a role in future issues). Fast forward a few months. I now have Carpenter Ants, yes Carpenter Ants. (These ants are attracted to moisture for those of you who might not know.) I live on the 6th floor..I shouldn't be having any at all, especially being on the sixth floor. I have called for them to take care of it. They have been here 4 times without the problem being taken care of. I still have ants..and now they are in my kitchen!! You know that hole that I mentioned earlier? Well, that is where the ants are coming from and the maintenance refuses to fix it saying "The whole should be there." Well, if I have to duct type my wall shut...well maybe the hole is a little to big, you think?? And some of the people who live are questionable in my opinion. Leaving their trash out in the hallway, yelling at each other and then the police are called...*sigh* Honestly, I wouldn't waste your time here. I haven't even been here for a year and I can't wait to move out in September. I hate it here. And plus this place isn't really that cheap..you can find much better apartments elsewhere.
Very nice place to live. Location is great. Nice, clean and well maintained living.

put down a deposit on this for my son, to be in my name, was told there would be a senior discount, upper management then said no, as my son would be the occupant. No overnight guests, whereas most apts allow guests for 14 consecutive days. They make you take out insurance, privately, or through a company they deal with.They also charge a maintenance fee monthly to cover water and trash. Add these fees to your rent, your better off getting a nicer place elsewhere. with all this , I cancelled out!

Lived here for a year after college in a 1br. apartment on the ground level in building 1 (no patio). This really is a decent place to live, having reasonable prices, a fantastic location, and sizable rooms, most with nice carpeting. Downsides are creepy elevators, small kitchen with outdated stove, and I wasn't a fan of the laundry accommodations.

Elevators are clean, just a little run down/old. Never broke that I know of, just stuff like the doors jiggling and awkward lurches when it stopped. The laundry rooms weren't the roomiest, and I disliked paying per load (and only using a pre-paid card) after having in-apt hookups at my last place, but having laundry rooms less than a few floors away is convenient. Maintenance always responded in a timely manner to my minor requests. Small/outdated wooden cabinets, old stove, poor stovetop ventilation when cooking, and very limited counter space depending on your appliances. Plus it was just small, width-wise. Everything worked, I just had very little patience because my last apartment had an exemplary kitchen. :)

This was a good apartment at a great location, only thing I disliked was the outdated/undersized kitchen.
Friendly and Helpful staff. Quiet building with friendly neighbors. Nice view of Cleveland and surrounding suburbs as far as the eye can see from the gym or party room.
I visit lake park quite frequently for family and I love it. The view is awesome/amazing/beautiful, the staff is very nice and helpful, and it's a very clean property !

This building is a perfect view from Downtown Cleveland and if you look far enough you can see Lake Erie and the boats sailing across. During Labor Day weekend you can see the airshow going on from your window and watch the jets practice before the show begins. If you are looking for some peace and quiet after a hard day's work or coming from school, open your shades sit back and relax, because at times you have an almost unreal view of the sun setting. If you are more of an outdoor person this apartment building is minutes away from a place called Coventry Village that gives diversity to the neighborhood and the strip of shops cater to people of all ages and makes you feel like you belong, from artwork, concerts, and great food to a little vegan ice cream shop, and market to do your grocery shopping at, this little place gives everyone something to appreciate. The apartment itself does have an outdoor pool and a fitness room filled with new equipment. This is an ideal building for a person who wants to be in between the suburbs and minutes away from the great city of Cleveland!

The location of the building is very convenient. My job is two miles down the road, and there are lots of places in the area to shop at. I can be essentially anywhere I want to go within 20 minutes. Grocery store, cinema, electronics store, clothing store, and anything else.

The apartment prices are very reasonable. It is located near Superior train and bus station. The apartment is within walking distance of the circle (about 2 miles). The staff is friendly and quickly responds to any repair request. There is a pool but I have never visited. There is also indoor parking, for a fee, which is very convenient during the winter. Some of the issues are that one of the three elevators seem to be broken quite often. Some of the halls are in bad shape with some of them having open leaks. There is also the smell of weed emanating from other rooms (though the staff does warn that anyone caught will be evicted and reported to the police).

I moved into Lakepark Tower after seeing the gorgeous view of the city of Cleveland from my now home for the first time. It was terrifying finding a place to move into after I graduated college, but Lakepark offered me totally reasonable rent, incredible amenities including a pool, fitness room, free water, air-conditioning and heat (which is a godsend in the ever-changing Cleveland weather). I am within a five minute ride to Little Italy, the RTA stop, Coventry (for your inner hipster), Uptown Cleveland with University Circle and all of the cool restaurants and bars any recent grad could want. Additionally, there is totally easy access to all the major freeways and 15 minutes from the city. What more could you ask for?
Lived here for 4 years! Yes they updated the units and the grounds but nothing has changed. Management is non existent and the police are there everyday! It’s really a joke

I visited this property as a potential resident late last year and everything had been updated. The parking lots were redone, the playground area was well kept. All the commons had been repainted. The units had been updated with granite countertops. It was lovely. I ended up buying a home instead but always mention Forest Ridge to anyone I know who is looking for a new apartment.

I’ve lived here for one year, in feb midst of that a new company named REM commercial bought the apartments. So we got new management about halfway into my lease, the old company always accepted cash so sometimes I paid cash or other times I paid on the app. The new company changed the rules to no cash… ok cool but never made me aware of that. So anyways I put cash in for October and basically a week later they’re trying to kick me out for non payment and I’m like I miss definitely payed if you have cameras you can look on them. Moral of the story they lost my rent money, no cameras whatsoever around the drop box, and they told me to make a police report on it. I Did that and they somehow made a whole different story than what I put on my police report and basically told me I’m responsible and I have to pay again. I would never live there again. And then told my new apartment they wouldn’t rent to me again as if I’m the unprofessional ones who lost the money.
Great updates units. New owners are great and the new office staff is great to work with. I have seen so many improvements.

I had the pleasure of meeting Shannon, the Propery Manager at Forest Ridge. She is very understanding and personable! Although I have not moved in yet she has been in constant communication with me regarding the renovation of my unit. I will give an update after the move in!

This place declined drastically . The carpet in the lobby is beyond filthy .. each floor could use a good cleaning.  The elevator has been broken for months now. The wash room floods.  And this to me is just basic up keep. So much more unkept maintainence.  Don’t move here!
The property management has gone downhill in the last few months. It was better when Mike managed the buildings. The new person is cold and not friendly. Maintenance is slow to respond, if at all.

Maintenance never actually finishes jobs or doesn’t respond at all, place is rarely properly cleaned, one small elevator and a back staircase for moving and their was vomit on the floor for over 3 months from another tenant before someone came to clean it up.

Mike and his team have been so kind and timely with their replies with me since day one. Mike is often around the property, there to help at any time. I am so pleased with how spacious my apartment unit is, its location, and how I know I can count on Mike and his team if I need anything. Would recommend to anyone!
They never clean, the buzzer is always broken, rats in the walls, and they ignore any complaints. Look elsewhere, this place is a slum.

I’ve lived at Fry Overlook for almost two years  and have really enjoyed my time here. Not only is my apartment beautiful (I love white kitchens) but the leasing staff/maintenance are so helpful and efficient anytime I am in need. If I wasn’t looking to buy a home I would definitely be renewing my lease!

I have lived here for 6 months and cannot say enough about how incredible my experience has been. My suite is beautiful with large windows in the living room overlooking the city and Lake Erie allowing for breathtaking sunrise and sunset views. My bedroom fits a king bed and my walk in closet is large enough for a dresser and a desk. The in unit washer & dryer is extremely convenient. I have had one minor maintenance issue (Lightbulb burned out in living room) that was taken care of within 1 hour of notifying the leasing office. The gym is clean and is never overcrowded. Location wise, could not be more ideal. I can make it to work in under 10 minutes (at Key Tower) and there are multiple options for entertainment and dining within walking distance.

I have lived here for 9 months ad have had a very positive experience overall. I have my disagreements with management every now and again, but overall they are as accommodating as they are empowered to be by the corporate office. Security is friendly and helpful in managing packages, dry-cleaning, and general inquiries as they can. The garage is one of the cheapest in town, and even though they tried raising the rates twice in one year it STILL would have been the cheapest. However, after feedback from residents the price raise was delayed indefinitely. Maintenance is prompt and as helpful as they are empowered to be. I have had no problems with their fixes whether I am in the apartment or not. Emergency maintenance is also very responsive.

The unit is as well constructed as any new, residential convert is anymore. Appliances are modern and functional. Cabinet storage is adequate for a one-bedroom unit. Closet is spacious and fits my large wardrobe with room left over for auxiliary storage. Bathroom is large and functional with adequate storage and a linen closet. The living room / kitchen area has a wall of windows with gorgeous views (depending on which side of the building you are on). The only down side to these is the heat loss in the winter (there is roughly a 10 degree difference between the thermostat in the hallway and the window area). The bedroom, however, is interior and therefore unaffected by this. 

I live on the second floor near the weight room, and occasionally notice some noise form this, but overall the noise level is much quieter than expected.If I am near the door i can sometimes hear some shuffle in the hallway or the bump of someone upstairs or to the side, but never obscene noise. 

Speaking of this, the weight room is more than adequate for the routine workout. The party room on the 4th floor is spacious and nice for the occasional community event as well. 

Overall, if you are looking for a professional, welcoming apartment for a fair price in the downtown area, look no further. I have friend that live in apartments all over the city and still plan to stay here for the duration of my stay in the Downtown area.

Overall, living at 1717 is a positive experience.  The views are amazing with huge windows in the living room, the design is modern, and you are downtown near countless things to do and places to go.  There is even a deli in the lobby, and parking is attached to the building.  The use of space is interesting as you have a unnecessarily huge bathroom space and massive walk in closet at the cost of living room space.  Also, you can tell that they finished a new floor every two weeks.  Walls are quite thin, many sockets aren't aligned right so often you have to force plugs in or sometimes won't even go, paint missing in a few areas and small things like that.  Nothing that really ruin the space, but small nuisances that keep it from being great.  

Support is pretty poor, as if you submit a ticket or ask a question, expect to ask a few more times and try to find the answer yourself  if possible, as the usual return on a question to the leasing office is over a week, and a ticket to support is 2 weeks to a month.  

Overall the place is good, and surprisingly one of the cheaper options downtown.

Residences at 1717 is a haven of peace and quiet in the busy downtown area. With a fully equipped gym, this building provides all the luxuries for downtown upscale living. Jessica and Rita, the building managers, are such sweethearts and really take the time to listen to their residents. Resident activities are frequently organized and provide an excellent way to meet your neighbors. All in all, a fabulous way to live!!

I have been living in the Residences at 1717 by K&D for almost 8 months now and it has exceeded my expectations. I was looking for something that was newly constructed for my wife and I. We came across the 1717 building and we knew it was it. It is not directly in the middle of downtown which is great for traffic reasons but you are still able to walk to any place you would want to. The staff is great and the amenities are second to no other apartments downtown.

My unit is nice but management is horrible. When I 1st booked an appointment to visit, they were 30+ mins late. I loved the unit I saw so I applied anyway, but they took over a month to process my aplication. When it finally came through, they were very unhelpful providing move-in info. the two buildings have different street numbers and none are on Google maps, which has created numerous issues. Delivery people can NEVER find you. 

About a year ago, things really went downhill. The trash rooms would be overflowing. They refused to recycle at some point, even though they're LEED certified. There is supposed to be a package delivery service for large packages but that's never been implemented. The package room is often a disaster zone, making it hard to find stuff. And they threaten to return stuff if you don't pick it up right away. Our call box is broken, so no one can be buzzed in.

As residents we can reserve the roof for private events twice a year, so I've been trying to do this for weeks now and have had no response from management despite numerous calls, texts and emails. If you don't walk into their office to talk to them, they ignore you. And even if you go into their office, they often tell you they're busy and ask you to text or email....which obviously doesn't work.

Numerous residents have complained about dubious utilities charges considering we can't access meters for our units and are charged directly by management. I've been away for an entire month before, yet my utility bill went up.

Safety in the neighborhood is an issue. I've filmed one car robbery and witnessed people checking cars very suspiciously. The garage was broken into once and multiple cars were smashed and robbed. Parking in the garage is insanely packed. I have a Subaru Crosstrek and the lines are barely a few inches wider on each side of my car. Plus there's a pillar on one side, which I have to get within a couple inches of in order for my neighbor to be able to open their car door to get out. Get ready for dents. 

The management also rents the Lantern Room and rooftop. Whenever it's rented, residents are not allowed up there to use the amenities we all pay for. This means many weekends and nights during the best weather. As someone who lives in the building where there's only one elevator up to all the floors, including the rooftop venue, we constantly have to deal with drunken guests. That and the courtyard can be really noisy.

I was deciding between the quarter, the dexter and church + state. After touring all three, it was clear church and state is the best option by a MILE.  I would also like to point out that Victoria gave me the best tour, and was so knowledgable. I probably would’ve decided to stay in my rented house in Lakewood if it weren’t for the people at C+S. As soon as I walked in the door Laurel greeted me and I felt at home. Jared, Eric and Riko do an incredible job keeping the building sparkling, and all work orders I ever had have been taken care of same day. Also got to customize my apartment with them for free. My girlfriend is WFH and uses the rooftop hot tub as her undeclared home office. I saw a previous comment that we don't have a peloton, rooftop grill, or pet spa, but we do have one ?  You can also clearly see these amenities if you've ever been around the building so I would beware of fake reviews from rando's to try to deter you from living here.  I would recommend this place to anyone looking to have a luxurious apartment, an easy move, and a staff that goes above and beyond to make you feel like more than just a renter.
