No, I didn't get paid to write this review-- I'm just pleasantly surprised at how much we like it here and I don't have anything bad to say. Dealing with landlords is usually a nightmare, but I feel like K&D deserved some praise, and there aren't enough positive vibes going around. So if you want some positivity in your life, maybe try moving in to Tower City.

The apartments here are visually appealing. The finishes are reasonably polished (though appliances really should be nicer, given the monthly rent.) Maintenance is responsive. Dogs are allowed and welcome. The neighborhood is pleasant and quiet.

Unfortunately, there is a major problem: the floors are so thin that you can hear EVERYTHING going on in the apartment above you. I mean every step. When my upstairs neighbor pulls out a chair, it sounds like loud feedback from a speaker. I regularly wake up at 2am when the person living above me walks from their bedroom to the bathroom.

It's unfathomable to me why a company would invest so much on an apartment building and then skimp on basics like insulation between the floors (and elevators -- there's only one for four floors of many apartments, making for some very long waits.) It's a shame, really: it could be a nice place to live. But the noise is simply intolerable. Obviously, I won't be renewing my lease.
Walk at Edgewater Park; easy access to east, west or south burbs; dog friendly neighborhood; well maintained building!  Cleveland at its best!

I moved into the BPL shortly after they were built and have lived in two different style units since that time. The apartments are elegant, and the location is great for people of all ages. The current management is also very helpful. Very happy that I get to call BPL home.

Love living in Battery Park Lofts!  If you are looking for quiet lovely apartment living in Cleveland that is accessible to everything-this is it.The building is well maintained and excellently managed.  The units are very nicely appointed.  Lake views are amazing!! You can take your daily run or walk at beautiful Edgewater Park.  Get downtown in minutes.  Great coffee shops, bars and restaurants very close at hand. Excellent place to settle in Cleveland.

I moved into Battery Park Lofts a little over a month ago. I love it here! Melissa, the property manager, is super friendly and goes above and beyond for her residents. There are many great attractions, including Edgewater Beach which is just 15min walking distance. From the brewery across the street to the Gordon square arts district just a few blocks away there’s something to love for everyone. The high ceiling, breakfast bar and picturesque windows leave little to be desired. Battery Park is more than an apartment complex, its a luxury lifestyle!

I moved into BPL after a horrible experience at a nearby apartment and it was the best decision I could have made. 

The team at BPL is extremely attentive - there is always open and constant communication about what is going on in and around the property. First and foremost, as a young woman, I feel extremely safe here. On top of that, the apartment complex is clean, the common areas are amazing and the staff & residents are extremely friendly. Any small issue I've ever had has been dealt with and resolved in timely manner. It's one of the best priced apartments in the area, especially when you factor in the proximity to Edgewater and so many great local bars and restaurants. 

Overall, I genuinely can't say enough great things about Battery Park Lofts and I recommend it to everyone I know moving to the city. I have already renewed my lease twice and will be renewing a third time this year...I love it here!

This apartment is the perfect place to live if you want to escape the noise of downtown but don't want to commit to a house in Lakewood. It's a little outside of downtown but right on the shoreway, so getting to both Lakewood and Ohio City/Tremont is very convenient. It's a great community with many, many dogs and a lot of fun things to do, eat, and drink. It's also very convenient to east cleveland and the heights, so if you work in the hospitals or in the studios of asiatown, you'll have an easy commute. 
The apartment is pretty spacious depending on which unit you opt for, and switching units is fairly easy if you outgrow your living situation! The walls are thick enough that the noise from dogs/weekend music/the train isn't bad, but if you want complete silence, this probably isn't for you (not sure which apartment would be). 
The residents are generally respectful, and those who aren't tend to leave quickly. 
The building is safe and the management takes care of any kind of issue that arises. You are at the mercy of Spectrum community wifi and cleveland public power, which can't be changed, but you'll likely experience that anywhere in cleveland. From my experience, this building is built better than most in Cleveland and has one of the best management teams as well. It isn't the fanciest, but it is very nice and much more affordable than all of the newest buildings. The package system is about the same as any apartment building, and the neighborhood is safe enough that theft isn't a huge concern. 
I love living here. It reminds me of my college dorms because of how friendly everyone is - many residents can be found at Terrestrial on the weekends with their dogs. Of course- way nicer than a college dorm, especially the two-beds! 
And the beach views / city views can't be beat for this price point!

Absolutely love living here!! The building is always clean, secure and both management and tenants are so kind. You can’t beat the location with walkable access to Edgewater park and lots of restaurants/bars/breweries. Highly recommend!

The building is kept clean, management is responsive, and the apartments are very nice. I have a great view of the lake and of downtown and it’s within walking distance to Edgewater Park. I highly recommend BPL if you want a quiet, conveniently located, and modern building.

We have lived at Battery Park Lofts since the summer of ‘22. The location is great, close to food & drinks, and a short walk to the beach.

Management were easy to communicate with as we were coordinating from out of state and the apartment was clean when we arrived.

We’ve rented a 1 bedroom apartment with Battery Park for a little over 6 months now. The apartment itself is nice and relatively updated. We have a view of the Lake/Edgewater beach which is awesome! I would recommend to friends who are looking for a place a few minutes from downtown. If we were planning on staying in Cleveland, we would definitely renew our lease! 

Pros: updated living space, excellent view, shared spaces are nice (grill, large patio w/ seating, community room), friendly neighbors, FREE PARKING, building feels secure and safe, have never had an issue where maintenance was needed but I’m sure they are great, good price for the area, resultants and brewery within walking distance, 5 minute walk to the beach. (The list goes on) 

Cons: I wish the workout room was a little bigger/ had more weights but it gets the job done.

Could really benefit with a structured package system. They stack up quickly and it is inconvenient to go through them all.

I love living in this building! I have lived here for about a year and a half, and management has always handled any situation (not really any issues for me living here- but any electrical outings, etc.) very promptly! It's in a great area thats a walk to the beach, and great food places. Definitely recommend this apt complex!

I've really enjoyed my time in the Battery Park Lofts. Big walk in closet, private balcony with wonderful views, in unit washer and dryer, new appliances while in walking distance from Edgewater and Gordon Square. Easy access to downtown. Friendly and responsive management with well maintained common areas.
Great place to live!! Comfortable and everything is new and modern

I’ve lived here for the last 6 months and it’s been nothing but a wonderful experience. Everything from the tour to signing the lease was a very easy process. It’s clean, it’s safe, and it’s quiet. Residential staff are all very friendly and extremely responsive (for a maintenance request for example, it’ll get fixed that same day or the next). There’s also great food and drinks spot in the neighborhood and it sits right over Edgewater Beach & Park. BPL is an amazing place to live. I highly recommend!

Lived here for over two years. Horrendous, unresponsive management that changes every few months. Multiple cars have been broken into and even stolen from the indoor parking garage, yet management have done nothing to make it more secure. I would look elsewhere
I really liked how the finishes in the building didn't look like a lot of other buildings I have seen. The finishes have a nice warm feeling to them. The staff was also very friendly and welcoming .

At first I had trouble trying to get ahold of the leasing office.  They didn't show up to my appointment.  However I tried to reach them again to tell them the situation and they were very apologetic. I did not get to tour the property but from the pictures and looking around outside, it looked very nice.

I’ve lived at Stonebridge for four years - this place is a true gem. Location is great - it’s a quick walk to both the West Bank of the flats and Ohio City, right next to a great bike path over to Whiskey Island and only a quick ride to the Towpath. It’s got great views of the river and downtown, and parking is the cheapest of anywhere in the city. Also, the access the viaduct means you can catch nautica concerts for free, and easily eat at the best Italian restaurant downtown. 
The property manager Ashley and the maintenance staff are what truly makes this place special. Ashley is incredibly organized, responsive, and kind. She cares about the residents, and it really shows. Maintenance staff are quick, efficient, and knowledgeable. We absolutely love living here.

Been living here for a year and a half and love the spot, you get a great view of the river and downtown and I work from home and watch the boats go by all day. 

Property managers are excellent, Ashley is on top of things and is very good at her job. 

Maintenance always comes quickly and does a good job. 

Access to the Superior Viaduct is a major plus and one of the main reasons I picked this place. I ride my bike everywhere and being able to take the elevator to the top saves my legs. 

The location is very good if you get around on a bike, it's right on the towpath trail which you can take to the lake, Ohio city, Tremont, and the steelyards shopping area. If you have an Ebike you can make it to the steelyards easily. If you don't have an Ebike, the stores in Ohio city make more sense. 

Very easy to bike to downtown and Ohio city on the city roads however there isn't a lot of consideration for bike safety in Ohio city. Only issue is the Detroit and West 25th intersection which is very dangerous and has to be crossed to get basically anywhere since the center street bridge is out for the rest of the year. 

Some of the apartments are very long and have lightshaft windows for the interior rooms. I like having a pitch black bedroom so this is nice but it isn't nice for anything besides a bedroom.

We've been at Stonebridge for almost two years and picked this place over the 7+ other apartments we toured downtown.  The office staff is AMAZING - the manager knows everyone by name and is a joy to chat with. The maintenance guys are top notch, too! Our water heater broke a while back (just typical wear-and-tear) and they had a team over to replace it within 24 hours. 

There is a great view of the Cuyahoga River so you can watch boats go by all summer from your living room window, or pop up on the Viaduct to get views of the city and river. There's a rapid station within a 5 minute walk, and it only takes 10 minutes to walk downtown or to the West Side Market. 

OH, the apartments are great, too. The granite countertops and stainless steel everything has me spoiled. I don't know if I'll ever be able to live without heat lamps in my bathroom again!

We have just moved in, but what I can tell you is that the leasing experience was very easy, and the staff is friendly and responsive!  They have an open office and welcome you to come in and talk, very accessible.

Our full height windows in the living room are awesome and we are fully enjoying our views!

So far so good!  A really great value and size of apartments.

This property is great!! Friendly staff, very attentive, very knowledgeable about the area and the property itself. Jay and John are great at what they do and create a space that you  want to be apart of. Move in was simple and stress free thanks to the staff.

Pros:
- Size:  large living room, pretty view, decent sized bedroom with study, large kitchen with space to put a table for maybe 5 people, sufficient closet/storage space, power outlets
-  location: within walking distance of Case Western/ UH and Cleveland Clinic. Close to University Circle, plenty to do within walking distance or a short drive: cultural attractions (art museums, Cleveland Orchestra, Botanical Garden, etc.), places to eat (I recommend Mitchell's Ice Cream), UPS store (which has a public notary), gym, etc.  The building is called Parkside Dwellings, and the "park" is a long stretch of trees across the street with some art pieces (nice for jogging); there's another stretch of trees with a stone pathway between the building and the Children's Museum. It's very pretty, especially in the fall. Bonus: seeing rabbits and fireflies!
- neighborhood: it's quiet, and most of the building residents in the building are professionals or students at Cleveland Clinic or UH. 
- bus station a block away (Healthline)
- brick building and steam heat, warm when it's snowing outside 
- laundry: 2 washing machines and 2 dryers, which is okay for building; you pay $1 in quarters for each m/c
- maintenance comes quickly enough for emergencies; they also installed my ACs
- gated parking

 Cons:
- only Time Warner available for internet
- toilet got clogged several times this year (I don't throw anything in it); I recommend to use plunger immediately when it doesn't flush properly or slows down (I was busy, didn't do this for a day or 2 and had to call maintenance emergently as a result...they did do a good job cleaning up for me)
- you have no control over the heat, and as the weather transitions from hot to cold, it gets cold indoors before they turn on the heat for the building
- 1 small window AC (good for bedroom, but you need another for living room); most units don't have AC
- they don't cover electric - use Apples to Apples program or you'll pay too much
-  small bathroom, mirror to side of sink
-  no elevator
-  trash disposal outside building
-  no front desk, no one to sign for packages
- fridge and stove a bit small, and had to cover gaping vent above stove because flies were coming in
- I still get flies, even after taping the windows and covering the vent!
- No dishwasher or microwave
- laundry:  inefficient dryer (they finally fixed it)
- parking is uncovered
- park is dark if you walk home at night

No more space.

I've been staying in this community for quite some time and i can honestly say that since the new Management and office staff things are improving. My fiancee and I have lived at 2320 Lofts for the past 3 years. The apartments are beautiful with high ceilings, historic charm, large windows, modern finishings. Dave and Karen have been the greatest landlords imaginable. My fiancee and I were in the process of buying a house which unfortunately fell through the night before closing, and after explaining the situation to Dave and Karen, they were kind enough to allow us to move into another unit in the building the same week because our previous lease was ending. They are always a text or call away and go above and beyond for their tenants. This has been an amazing place to live and I highly recommend 2320 Lofts.

I have nothing to complain about at 2320. Units are large, they have garage parking (not inexpensive), great location. Neighbors are nice. I chose this location due to the freeway access and I liked the building layout.

PROS: High-rise ceilings & large windows. Decent room sizes & living space. It is within walking distance to AsiaTown & CSU. Gated parking lot & garage parking is a MUST when living in Cleveland. An in-unit washer/dryer. Onsite resident manager; new RM from the prior in 2021. Maintenance is decent. I had a washer stop working & was able to get a new washer/dryer replaced within a few days as well as other maintenance requests were met in a timely manner. 

CONS: You will be paying more than your rent as utilities aren't included. Insulation in the units isn't too good during the winter, so you'll best believe you will turn the heat up or bundle up. THE WALLS ARE THIN! You'll be hearing noises & sounds from your unit neighbors. The "young professionals" that the landlord says live here are people who are either a few years out of college or actual college students. The latter contributes to the loud noises and behaviours in the hallways. For some reason, there were a few pest control situations in the building even though my unit was not greatly affected.

The only good reviews must be written by the management.

Parking- Unless you can afford the garage fee, you must leave your car in the lot or street parking. Assume your car will get broken into 2-3x a year.

Location- Close to downtown but far from the closest safe grocery store.  Homeless shelters and lots of homeless walking around, you will get harassed. Not safe at night.

Space - Lots of open space, but little to no closet/storage space. Small bedroom closets that are not completely enclosed so dust gets over everything. No jacket closet or shoe closet. Little kitchen counter space and storage

Noise/Neighbors - The biggest problem. No insulation between units including between floors.  I can hear everything going on in the neighboring units and upstairs. Most of the apartment is too loud to sleep or study in because of the neighbors or people yelling in the halls. The building is filled immature college students. Loud music and screaming all day. Asking the management to deal with it is useless. You will find trash, beer can/bottles everywhere. The hallways and elevators smell like a mixture of vomit, stale beer and cigarettes.  The carpets are old and stained.  Managements tries to cover them with a lot of mats.

Overpriced- It is nearly the same price as renting an entire house 10 minutes away in Cleveland heights or Ohio city.

Building Quality – Developers did a cheap job of converting this place. Cheap counters, flooring, lack of insulation, fixtures, no firewalls between units & overall very poor quality. There are holes in the windows.  When it rains, water comes in the windows. Heating/cooling cost are crazy. The holes are so big that nearly twice a week, I find huge wasps and hornets that have sneak into the apartment through these cracks (I don’t open the windows because of the horrible garbage smell outside and the abandoned building next door that has several hives). It shouldn’t surprise you that the building is filled with spiders and bugs.

Mail – I have had multiple amazon packages stolen. I have to have my packages dropped of at the Cleveland amazon store where I have to go to pick them up, defeating the whole point of amazon.

Management – They lied to me when I visited here.  They said the units were sound proof (huge lie).  They said the building was mostly young working professionals (lie – mostly a dorm).  The will say anything to fill the units and get you to sign the contract.

Summary: go elsewhere…I can't wait to leave.

Probably the worse company and apartments in Cleveland, The apartment was flooded all the time, forget about maintenance and they only care about your rent. It was a nightmare for me deal with this scams.

Management is awful. They entered my unit on more than one occasion with absolutely no notice. Denied that they entered despite leaving equipment in the unit and being caught on my security camera. They charged me late rent every month on their resident portal despite rent being paid on time they are scammers. Blamed hot showers on a leak in the ceiling then never answered calls when the leaks got worse.

I have looked at many apartments and buildings and by far this is the cleanliest and friendliest building. I was welcomed in with a great lobby with current tenants that were very friendly and helpful. The property manager is great and very helpful and knowledgeable. Units are well taken care of.

Do not recommend. The price may be alluring for the area but do not be fooled. Maintenance does the best they can but are understaffed and have to pay for all materials out-of-pocket. The apartments are just beautiful and spacious and the area is perfect! Very conveniently located near a lot of restaurants, supermarkets and walkable areas which are a must for me. Would definitely love to live again there without hesitation.

My time at Clifton Lake Apartments has been nothing short of disappointing. From the incessant noise of the radiators to the paper-thin walls and crumbling ceilings, it's been a continuous saga of discomfort.

Let's start with the radiators—they seem to have a mind of their own, emitting a cacophony of clanks and hisses that echo throughout the apartment. It's impossible to find peace or rest with such a disruptive soundtrack constantly playing in the background.

Speaking of disruption, the walls might as well be made of tissue paper. Conversations from neighboring units are as clear as if they were happening right in my living room, leaving no semblance of privacy or tranquility.

As if the structural integrity weren't already in question, the ceiling has decided to join the fray, with cracks and leaks appearing as if on cue. Waking up to find bits of plaster on the floor has become an unwelcome routine.

And then there are the bugs. They seem to have taken up permanent residence, infiltrating every corner of the apartment despite all efforts to keep them at bay.

Adding insult to injury, the lack of air conditioning during the sweltering summer months is nothing short of unbearable. Residents are left to swelter in the heat, with no relief in sight.

To top it all off, the pervasive smell of smoke lingers in the air, making it impossible to escape the acrid odor of burnt offerings.

In short, Clifton Lake Apartments is a far cry from the peaceful sanctuary one expects from a place called home. Between the noisy radiators, thin walls, crumbling ceilings, unwelcome guests, lack of air conditioning, and the smell of smoke, it's safe to say that this is one living situation best avoided.

review: The location is great! You’re near major highways, Ohio City, Downtown, Lakewood and major store plazas. Units are roomy and they have free parking lot.

review: This is the worst place to live. review: It is a great place to stay. I can only speak bad about the neighborhood, but everyone that works in the leasing office tries.

review: Apartment is relatively updated, very spacious apartments. Large hallways, easy move in. Industrial style on the inside , not what you would expect when you consider it used to be a school. Pet friendly , nice washer /dryer units on site. Surrounding neighborhood not great but areas directly outside the apartment are nice. apartmentName: The Brick Lofts at Historic West Tech
review: Love the unique character of the apartments. Apartments have exposed brick and oversized windows which I love. Also nice to find a place that is clean and pet friendly. However, gym is a joke. Has a couple machines and is so hot that I can't even work out there. Neighborhood and parking could be better but overall not a bad place.

apartmentName: The Brick Lofts at Historic West Tech
review: I currently live in a three bedroom three bathroom. While the structure is nice ( 1 bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, and 1 bedroom on the first floor; 1 bedroom living room bathroom on 2nd floor; master bedroom master bath on 3rd) the utilities plays a big role in one of the many cons of this building. The building is brick, making it hard too keep the apartment heated. As a tenant you are only required to pay electric, however everything is ran off of you lights. Heat, cooking is electricalmaking an average light bill of 350/month. They offer the option of renting a washing machine for 60/month on top of paying a 75/month for underground parking. While underground parking doesn't seem like a necessity, parking is very limited. If you get off after 4, you can forget about it. All of this glory for 1285/month. The walls are so thin that I can hear my neighbors alarm clock. Need I go on?

apartmentName: The Brick Lofts at Historic West Tech
review:
I've lived at West Tech for almost two years, and I can't say I'm happy with my choice. I chose West Tech for the reasonable prices and large space. But unfortunately that's all they have to offer. The pet friendly apartment has a yard that is constantly littered with dog feces and trash. The halls are regularly littered with trash after hours and on weekends when the cleaning lady isn't working. The fire alarms go off at least once a month without notice, and that doesn't include the regular fire alarm testing that they do. The hallways regularly smell of pot. Our neighbors smoke both pot and cigarettes causing our upstairs bedroom to smell of them as all. The maintenance requests can take weeks to be completed as long as you keep on them about it. Otherwise it may not get done at all. Lastly before i move onto the apartment itself, is the parking lot and security. The parking lot is consistently littered with vehicles in disrepair, despite the warnings displayed that threatening towing. Several vehicles stolen out of the parking lot and parking garage due to lack of security and the constant foot traffic by non residents on the property. 
     The apartment itself is spaceous. The walk in closet and huge master bath with his and her sinks is awesome. However apon moving in, I was very disappointed what I saw. The carpet was stained, the cupboards needed a significant amount of touch up painting done. 2 of the light globs were broken, walls still needed painted and the some of the appliances were usable but in disrepair. 
      In summary, I would not recommend this place. There are better units around Cleveland for around the same price.

The new resident has a young child that runs, stomps, bounces balls and rides a big wheel all hours of the day and night. He has spoken with the tenant personally 4 or 5 times. Called security and contacted the leasing office more than twenty different times.He has even called the police several times when the noise continued after midnite. Management has failed to take any steps to resolve the problem. My boyfriend has coranary heart disease and severe migraines. He has been back and forth to the hospital several times and is unable to get any rest or sleep because of the constant noise. The management has made little if any effort to resolve this issue. He has asked to be moved into another apartment within the complex or to be let out of his lease, both request were denied. Right now he is simply stuck with no way out and no help from management.

The leasing office specifically Tamika is unprofessional, dishonest and incompetent. I would never recommend anyone trust anything she says.  She should not be allowed to help anyone obtain housing.  Zero stars for her.  Apartments are very nice but who wants to be mistreated and put their trust into a person in charge who cannot be trusted.

Fulton Flats West was just upgraded and modernized. The interior units have new flooring, cabinets, appliances and bathrooms. New LVP flooring is great. New carpets, paint and LED lights in the commons. There's a huge parking lot and 1 car garages for rent for a small fee. Lots of lighting at night! Safe! Clean! Storage units available. Laundry on site. Way nicer than most complexes nearby. Manager is so nice!

This apartment complex is very nasty also they love to towe people's car ?? at night. There is no proper parking lot for tenants to park. Whenever you moving out they will lies on you and says you for stuff that don't make no sense. Please don't rent from here, if you rent from them you will regret it. Find a better place to rent before it's too late for yoh

This management company only takes money orders for rent which is a huge hassle. Most places that only take money orders do so because they take for ever to cash your check. Normally it's because they would rather wait until they have all the rent checks to make a run to the bank versus going regularly for the people that do pay rent on time. 

As far as crime. Drive by at night. You will see people hanging out in the front smoking weed and drinking while listening to music.
I love to brouze these apartments online. They are so nice and located in a area where violence is not present. The neighborhood is bea utiful and there is a variety of places to shop and eat.

The most incompetent management team I have ever seen! Once you sign that lease, they do not care about you in the slightest. They do not return phone calls or emails. The apartments are degrading to the point where they are unlivable. Water leaks, bugs, rats outside your door. Homeless people going through the trash bins outside your place. 

Parking is miserable. You pay to have other people take your spot while management does 0 to help. 

They overcharge you for rent and insist it’s not their fault. 

I’d recommend living anywhere else than here.

Quite honestly the worst rental experience I have ever had. Icy parking lots, unlocked entrances, rickety stairs, stolen packages, and untimely maintenance coupled with the unprofessional behavior of the property management team leaves much to be desired from Integrity Gold Coast.

One of the 1st places I've lived where the management team doesn't seem to be actively working against the residents at all times. Rent is very reasonable, shared spaces are clean, & they're quick to respond to questions or maintenance requests.
The cons are extremely average for an apartment- neighbors can be obnoxious, trash day can be very noisy, & if you don't have an assigned spot you have to park on the street. To me, parking is the only aspect that makes living here 4/5 but at least I've never felt unsafe walking home.
Terrible living conditions. Too many problems to name including bugs, water damage, trash, management problems, noisy neighbors.

I recently moved into these apartments (9/1/2023) and on 9/4/2023 left a detailed message with the leasing agent concerning seeing roaches, verbally (over the phone) he was apologetic and understood my desire to break my lease and move, the same day he text me and said there had been no prior complaints, they wouldn't break the lease. That same evening as I was entering the apartment a long time tenant told me she also has roaches and always has and even went as far as to pull out roach spray from the grocery bags she was carrying in. Whenever I complain I am always told, "pest control will be there Friday OR pest control was just there" no hard working person should have to pay rent to live with bugs. I am prohibited from moving anyone in, or adding another pet to my lease without their knowing but they want to force tenants to live in roach motels and still collect rent. The property manager and leasing agent are OF NO HELP! REM Commercial is TERRIBLE. Save yourself some trouble, find somewhere decent and bug free to live!
They will take your money and not help do a thing to your unit. Cars are not safe in back. & the doors to the building are open for intruders.
Crackheads galore, management doesn't fix anything, I had a roof caving in for the better part of a year, and they had the audacity to act surprise when I moved out when my lease was up.

I lived there for 7 months and never had a problem, the person working there named Kaylyn was very helpful with all. I never had and issue and I extended my stay there and they were able to acommodate me on the same day. Everything was smooth on business and service. The studio did not had any problem and had everything I need.

My fiance and I lived here 2018-2019. Everything was pretty good when we moved in and the maintenance man Ramon is awesome! We moved in during the summer and that winter there were problems with the heat (sometimes the radiators wouldn't turn off and the apartment was boiling hot, and sometimes the heat didn't work and we had a space heater going). Also, after the big snowstorm that came the ceiling in one room started leaking and the ceiling started falling down. Management was supposed to fix it, but we spent over a month with a quarter of our living space taken up by a garbage can and an industrial tarp taped to the walls and ceiling to keep the water and falling plaster off of our stuff. We also had a HUGE ant infestation on the Friday before labor day and the emergency maintenance wouldn't come, so we had to bug bomb our apartment at our own expense and stay with a friend for the weekend. Management told us afterwards that we technically weren't allowed to do that, even though they wouldn't do anything for us since it was a holiday weekend and they didn't wanna pay holiday pay to an exterminator. We ended up packing our stuff and leaving early. Definitely not worth the headaches and management is impossible to get ahold of most of the time, and doesn't like to work with you.

If I were moving into the stockbridge now these are the things I would want someone to tell me:
-Take pictures of everything on move in day.  A week after I moved out of my apartment I received an email saying that I had damaged the floor and bathroom door.  Both were in the same condition they were when i moved in.  Thank god I take an obnoxious amount of photos of my cat because I only had evidence of the existing damage in the background of cat pics.
-The neighborhood is no good.  Carry mace and don't wear headphones ever.  Trust me.
-Put your mattress in a bedbug proof cover.  The only time I've come across bedbugs was in this building.  
-The police will probably bang on the front door to arrest one of your neighbors at some point.  Let them in and take the elevator, they'll use the stairs. 
-Get acquainted with your local tenants rights group and know what you need to do to put your rent into escrow if repairs go unaddressed.  
This is hands down the worst building I've ever lived in.  Competent and helpful building management does exist-just not here.

Stockbridge is very affordable with rent that includes utilities and a close location to the highway. There are some grocery stores near by, but the 15 minute walk to Heinen's is worth it. You will have to pay monthly for parking. There are the garage spots which are  in the building's basement, or the back lot with a gate. The back lot has issues with cars being damaged or broken into, and has happened multiple times in the time I have lived here. The gate also occasionally breaks. The building is very sound proof, and I have had no issues with my neighbors. Most of them are very nice or keep to themselves. Either way I was happy with the people I lived around. The heating can be a bit much at times and it is not controlled in unit, so you will have to email them about the settings. The kitchen feels like it was just placed into the apartment. It is very small and fits one person, and the lack of ventilation above the stove is somewhat bothersome to me. I haven't had a maintenance issue so I am unsure as to how responsive they are in that regard. I will say that I wish that they had a better way of communicating with tenants. There was maintenance on piping so they shut the water off without any notification. I emailed and they were responsive to letting me know what was going on, but I feel that prior communication would have been better. Overall it has been an average experience with some experiences being better than others.

I scheduled an appointment to tour this property today, and no one showed up to give the tour. I waited 15 minutes, called the individual I made arrangements with and also the main leasing office, left voicemails, and emailed twice without a response. This occurred during business hours, too; I’m not sure why I was unable to reach anyone despite my various attempts.
It has all the amenities you could ask for. Monica the manager, Dan the maintenance man, the friendliness of all the residents are just a few things that make Sheldon  a very pleasant place to live.

Can I give 6 stars?? These apartments are just amazing. Crown moulding everywhere, solid wood doors, REAL fireplaces, and the apartments are huge! The owner lives in one of the units upstairs. So anytime we have an issue we just give him a call and he's always on top of it. This is a really great place to live
Beautiful apartments with an owner who truly cares about his building and tenants. Highly recommend

apartmentName: Shaker Lake Apartments & North Moreland Co...
review: This place has mice and roaches. The rent is extremely high and I can't find one security camera. The lobby door is left open all night, I don't feel safe here.

apartmentName: Shaker Lake Apartments & North Moreland Co...
review: I love the area, but my maintenance issues have not been addressed

apartmentName: Shaker Lake Apartments & North Moreland Co...
review: I have been here for a year and 4 months. The management has changed 3 times. My original Lease was lost and they never contacted me to correct this. I had to find out on my own. This new company has been doing emergency water shut offs for a consistent 5 months! Going on 6 months. Every week the water is turned off and we are forced to find a water source. They never say why this is only that the water will be shut off. They have only recently started telling us before hand instead of the day of. There have been times the furnace was broken in the winter with no accommodations. There are no security cameras in the garage and cars have been broken into. The apartment is in a nice neighborhood but that's about it.

Clean and reasonable apartments. no bugs… Apartments and grounds are maintained on a regular basis. parking is available, and garage space is also if you want it. There are clean, laundry, rooms and washing machines are maintained by the company that has placed them in the building… both Cash and cards are used for payment. Wi-Fi is available to make your car transactions. Management and maintenance are very cordial and friendly. also management and Maintenance are very serious about Maintenance and keeping apartments in good working condition and clean that is one of the things that impressed me about Princeton Park Apts. repairs are readily addressed, And your wishes are taken seriously and addressed as well! this is a safe area in South Euclid. Stores are conveniently located and safe and commuting to them. Would like to express how happy I am to have found a clean reasonable and safe complex to live in! have experienced no break-ins. And I am very happy to be living at Princeton Park Apts.
Property Manager cuts corners and delays important maintenance requests to avoid spending money. Some requests have never be completed despite being told that they would be.

once you have moved in , your stuffs will never get replaced if they get damaged. instead of correcting these bad experiences the management will rather come here to wage war against speaking the truth. its left for the new tenants to experience it themselves . fortunately for the management most of them move out without actually narrating their problems on places like this. beauty on the outside is not always what it seems inside.

Horrible horrible customer service! Refuses to give receipts for deposit and application fees. No structure or organization within  the family owned property. I was in contact with three different people whom neither were of any help. Could not answer basic questions like weather they exterminate before move in? Common areas as well as apartments were nasty!

I went from 3 bedroom house to 2 bedroom apartment. Not working all the time sometimes makes it hard but, with Gods grace and mercy we will make it. So far things are going good at our new home. It's clean and  quiet and that's a blessing.

Please do not live here. The management is super sketchy.
They say they have "laundry" and there is only one washer and dryer for the entire building, leaving tenants who have to wash their laundry many failed attempts and waiting around for other tenants to take their clothes out of the washer/dryer. There is another one, but it is broken and they won't fix it. 
There is only street parking and it is an absolute nightmare.
If you accidentally lock yourself out do not bother trying to get someone to come. They will tell you to hire a locksmith and you will be out around $300. This place is a nightmare and a serious joke. Not worth the money at all and has zero amenities.

Worst apartment complex I’ve ever lived in. Put in a request for the hvac system. Goes straight to voicemail when you call maintenance or the leasing office. Packages were stolen twice. Camera systems don’t work they will just say oh well. Security, maintenance, and management don’t care at all. I wish I could give it 0 stars. Also dishwasher is portable and is on the opposite side of the kitchen which makes it impossible!
Good location, decent building but DEFINITELY needs some work done throughout. Prices are somewhat reasonable, hopefully they'll have a loyalty program to keep current tenants.
There are mice throughout the building. Maintenance responds quickly and  adds traps to apartments. I wish I knew before I signed my lease.
New owners and property management since 2024 have made huge improvements with renovating dozens of units, improving grounds and new technology for the resident experience!
Loved living here. Place is older, but well maintained. If I ever had a problem, it was taken care of by the maintenance guy. I only moved, because I bought a home.

I lived here for 1 year and there is nothing good to say. Bathrooms look like they're from the 70s, kitchens are SMALL, and there is a huge spider problem!! The "Manager" Kevin has NO SENSE OF PRIVACY OR RESPECT!! He fought with tenants causing a scene in the courtyard weekly! HE WILL WALK KNTO YOUR APARTMENT WHENEVER HE WANTS! I worked 3rd and was sleeping in my room and woke up to Kevin in my apartment!! Do not rent here!!! I promise you will regret it!! The list of problems goes on!

I'm not sure who wrote the other reviews, but I was shown the manager's apartment and it is very nice.  There was nothing there that I didn't like.  It was very clean, well kept and had nothing in disrepair that I could see.  The property outside has a well kept lawn and the bushes trimmed nicely.  I am on the list for a 2 bedroom when one becomes available and I can't wait.

I believe a landlord will let you take an apartment the way they let you see it. I went to look at a space with an appointment. I was greeted as if I was unexpected. The manager's apartment was shown as an example. No thank you. It was in disrepair to say the least. I'm sure this complex was very nice at one time, maybe in the last century.

The Apartments for building 5890, has had no hot water for seven days so far.  That is SEVEN FULL DAY!  And its 10 pm at night so I believe there will be no hot water on day 8.  06/28/16.  So my suggestion to future renters be very careful about your choice of this place!

I have been here for about a year and I love this place anything that needs to be done they take care of. Maintenance is wonderful, Front desk is very pleasant to be around.  Very quiet just a beautiful place all around.

I've lived at Parma East for a long time. we got a new manager three years ago, and things are so nicer and more organized than before. we have a community room for us to enjoy crafts, puzzles etc.. the manager host bingo every month. there a lot more activities. it a real joy to be living here now.

The office staff at Westbrook Village is fantastic. They've been here for years and are very helpful with everything I've ever needed from service requests or just a nice hello to brighten my day. The property is quiet and the amenities are very nice! I would recommend this property to anyone looking for an apartment in the area!
Landscaping always looks nice, the upgrades they have done throughout the year. Last but not lease the staff is wonderful!!
I lived there prior to 2016. I like the area. Eating a Boston Market  and Cicis Pizza. We got the furniture at Value Furniture. The carpet was nice.
Had to call for emergency service and the response was quick and polite.

I come into town every few months to visit family an this place is amazing.  The staff is very friendly and welcoming with arms wide open.  The buildings are very clean and the maintenance guys are awesome when you call they are there to help right away.  They have a great pool area with a really nice pool to enjoy when it's hot.  The fitness room is really nice equipment that is up to date.  An they have a great area to grill out with  Picnic tables. Not to mention but they have on site security witch is a major bonus to me. When I move to Ohio this is where I will call home.

Okay so I don't know where to begin but wow I love this place. The staff is amazing. The apartments are kept up and clean. Maintenance has never been an issue, if you have a problem give them a call an they will fix it asap.  If I had to recommend any apartment living in the Cleveland area it would be Westbrook village apartments.  They also offer security throughout the property witch is a big bonus.  An don't get me started about the amazing pool they have on the hot summer days you can take a dip and refresh or just hang out on the comfortable chairs and get some sun. I highly recommend these apartments to anyone and best of all they are affordable.

They don't fix anything heat is controlled by the owner. I haven't had any heat all winter.  I been here for years. My light bill is very high but I got a percentage off the rent for one month. I'm planning on moving rent goes up every year. No help with maintenance if anything goes wrong apartment outdated. I think it needs to be updated in these apartments. Rent shouldn't go up every year and your apartments outdated. I like the property manager just not satisfied with the treatment of living here paying my rent and something goes wrong I can't get help. If something goes wrong you might as well forget about it getting  fix . All they want is your money every month.  And yes they will tow your car fast if you park in a tenant parking area. You better have some money to get it out it's expensive. I see people post mice I haven't seen it don't want to see it or roaches or my lease will be broken the same day.

I had a chance to speak with the property manager there. A nice young lady who seemed to really love her job and care for the tenants. I just really wish the property wasn’t at full occupancy at the time.

When I moved out these people charged me $100 for a smallest crack in the freezer. I spoke to someone by the name of Ned Wasserstein which told me via email “ I did zoom in as close as I could and really it was not damaged.“ but still charged me which is INSANE!! First i'll start with when we first moved in the carpet was disgusting, tub wasn't clean, and they had paint all over everything. I was in the apartment closest to the woods, BAD IDEA! We got ants terribly and then after we got the ants to go here come the MICE. Come to find out this is a normal thing you could literally hear them in the walls or see them dart across the floor in the evening. Last thing  is the parking they were having an issue with visitors parking in resident parking so they started going crazy with the tow truck. You would go to bed just to wake up to your car gone. I knew several residents including myself that got wrongfully towed and they could have cared less about reimbursing. Just save yourself the trouble you could find a better apartment for the price they're asking for this dump. WORST YEAR EVER!

First..They have mice annually as the weather starts to get nice. It doesn’t matter if you’re clean or not because they will come into your apartment and make themselves at home. 
Second...they said there were no dogs allowed but I’ve seen residents sneaking dogs on the property. Third...we’ve called the landlord several times about our garbage disposal because it was broken and nobody came to fix it.
Lastly...they didn’t clean the apartment before we moved in. The tub was dirty and there was dust and dirt everywhere.

The layout on the inside of the Townhouses are nicely spacious for a couple or small family! We did get very dirty carpet and mold within the bathroom when we first moved in.... Although the noise barrier and parking situation is a little irritating...youre only given 2 spots to park and it is VERY tight parking so be prepared to get bumps and scrapes. The walls are thin and you can hear neighbors doing unspeakable things. The neighbors on our side love to argue and scream and on top of that you are next to train tracks that can be loud sometimes unless you are used to that. If you have your windows open you can hear everything going on outside even if there are people hanging outside talking. Goodluck if you decide to move in!
The office staff was very helpful when I moved in. They are very responsive to any matters that you would have.  Would recommend them to friends.

If you want to live the maintenance free life of apartment living, Tabor Ridge Apartments IS NOT FOR YOU! This is the second Christmas in a row where Management (property manager and maintenance manager)  left for the holidays only to leave us residents with no snow removal, no driveway plowing or even throwing down some salt so stoops, sidewalks and the parking lot were safe for our guests arriving on Christmas day.  After a heavy snowfall,  tenants have to perform their own snow removal if they want to leave the apartments or wait days until Management finds the time or hires personnel to clear the snow. The individual unit maintenance performed here is a joke. Repairs are done by using rubber bands, glue and duct tape only when they (Management) deem it absolutely necessary.   The Management team at Tabor Ridge is rude, condescending and downright nasty to the tenants.   Tenant turnover is high, hmm…. I wonder why?
I toured with Gina! She was awesome and the unit she showed me was darling! Just right for me and my kitty.

Poorly managed. The property manager  doesn't seem to care that most of the outdoor lights are non working. Makes it real inviting that the whole complex is completely dark, including the lights that light up the sign and the flag.

I've lived here several years and this place is getting worse by the year.

Pros: Large sized bedrooms, lots of storage, washer/dryer hook ups, quiet neighbors
Cons: Takes a month to get repairs, serious ant problem, dead trees leaning over parking lot, pot holes, disorganized and unfriendly manager, constant rent/water bill increase (4 times in 2 years)

I would not rent here if you have children, but for a single person who doesn't care much about how things look, it's suitable for a temporary place.
Appearance not as presented, tiny space, management takes every opportunity to squeeze out addl.fees whenever possible

apartmentName: 202 E. Green St by Bankier Apartments
review: 202 E Green has been my home for the last year and we've just renewed our lease. Initially we shopped around for a better deal, but its hard to beat the location and quality of service that Bankier provides. Their maintenance team has been very responsive to all of our requests and I highly recommend signing with them!

I've been with Town and Country for a while now and very much enjoy my unit! The staff here is friendly, maintenance is timely and efficient, the overall atmosphere of my complex building is quiet, which I share with equally cordial neighbors!
The apartment I had when I lived there had everything I needed for a great price. Leasing office staff and maintenance was always attentive and helpful. 5/5
Good place to live staff is friendly and willing to help

Clean area 
Very nice and respectful property management 
Maintenance get on things right away 
Highly recommend

I went in to tour this property today and was honestly impressed. The staff was knowledgeable and kind, and you could tell they took pride in the community.

The apartment building looked and smelled clean and the show rooms were beautiful and inviting.
Since I moved here it has been amazing they have been very understanding when I go to them with questions never had any issues.i love it here and the staff are wonderful.
Looking for a place to live is not easy, and finding a place you enjoy to live at is harder yet. I moved in Aug of 2018 and have not looked back.
Loved working with management and excited to move in! The apartments are great and a deal at the price.

Parkland Point is a one of a kind of place live that centrally located and affordable within the Champaign-Urbana area. Staff is very helpful, caring and level of care is provided to each resident on a personal basis.
Pretty good for it's price. The apartment has all utilities included, and it's very convenient to pay rent and bills.
Very helpful and friendly staff, with a great environment. The apartments are nice with plenty of room.

Parkland Point is a safe, fun, and clean place to live. Its’s super close to Parkland College which makes it so easy to get to class. The property is well maintained and maintenance is always willing to help. Friendly staff and great people!
The apartments are quality for the price you pay and the closeness to Parkland College is a godsend. The pros are only compounded by a kind and efficient staff, which makes living here easier.
Beautiful place, always kind and hospitable and available for any problem. I am a student at Parkland College, and my college is 2 minutes from the apartment, this is perfect for me.
Very clean and safe. I love living here. Walls are really thin and neighbors are loud but if you don’t mind that then it’s a great place to live!

Parkland Point does a great job of making residents feel safe! The friendly staff make it easy to put in maintenance requests, get new parking stickers, etc. Being right next to Parkland College is also a plus!
A great place to live, very spacious, and very modern apartments!
Great location, lot of space, great maintenance! Love how the area is gated, perfect walking space in park next to apartment, and no problem for parking!
Parkland Point is super well maintained on the inside and outside. If you have any questions the office is super quick to respond and do everything they can to maintain a safe and clean environment.
Parkland Point provides a safe place to love. The clubhouse always has fun things going on and are very helpful!!

BEDBUG RIDDEN. My roommates and I suffered numerous bites, blood spotting and stains from having to live with bedbugs while treatment was being conducted after we found them during move in. Very dirty. Poor spotty internet. Extremely high utility overages due to horrible apartment insulation. Management will withhold security deposit. Friends apartment in other building was much nicer than mine even though we paid the same rent.
I paid rent on time each and every month and had to fight management constantly for a clean apartment with all utilities/amenities promised upon lease signing. 
Stay at your own risk…

The apartment itself is fine except that it is kinda pricy for its location (really far from campus). However, the management office can basically do nothing for you but charging you fees. I live on the first floor and mold came out of nowhere in a bathroom that I had never used. (I live in a 2b2b and use the other one because that's where all the shampoos and stuffs are). It was  so obvious because there  was not a single towel/bottle/whatever in the bathroom. The manager insisted it was my fault due to my misuse of the bathroom(srsly?)and took away the showerhead, which I don't really care because I don't use it anyway. But I still have to pay for the ridiculous "mold damage".

Would give zero stars if I could. The apartment itself is not terrible. The location is good. The amenities are kind of nice sometimes. But management is terrible. I was forced to move apartments because they were renovating the unit I was originally leasing. No big deal. That's in the terms of the lease. But then they charged my rent to the wrong unit. So I got a notice of unpaid rent and threat of eviction because they messed something up. I went to the office and got it all taken care of. Didn't get evicted. After my lease was up, not only did I not get my security deposit back, but they charged me $400 for cleaning fees. Turns out, they didn't switch my security deposit over when they forced me to move apartments. Then, after multiple phone calls and multiple emails, none of which received any reply, they sent my bill to a collection agency. If you move here, you will have to keep management accountable with your money.
Management is terrible. So many issues with requesting for maintenance, Miscommunication, and Mischarging. I highly recommend to not live here.
If I could give this place a zero I would. Too many hidden fees and they have terrible management. They don’t communicate at all.

Anyone looking to rent here should carefully consider 2 things. Condition of units vary greatly because units are not inspected or cleaned before tenants move in. Do not rely on your stated roommate preferences. You are better off finding your own. Maintenance crew is great. Units are pet friendly and completely furnished.

My apartment was very clean and organized when I moved in, and this is a big thing for me. I really liked the staff and complex overall. I definitely recommend living here if you are looking for a quiet place to live.

I loved my apartment at The Place, as well as the staff. The apartment was clean and organized when I first moved in, which is a big deal for me. I definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a quiet area to live.

DO NOT LIVE HERE

If I could rate this place one stars I would. First the management is HORRIBLE! They will lie to you every chance you get and try to extract any type of money from you. Second the units are not up kept. You will have to clean it yourself. My unit was dirty upon arrival, it had mold, broken and dirty toilet seats, pee stains on the mattress, chipped paint, dirty everywhere… and a host of other problems. I would recommend no one stay here, it is uncleanly. Not to mention the place stinks of the farm next to it. I’d recommend finding somewhere closer on campus and save yourself the hassle of dealing with a horrible unit and horrible management who doesn’t look to resolve anything. This place should be shut down
