The public areas of the buildings like hallways and stairwells are never cleaned or maintained by anyone so the walls and floor are dirty, dusty, and have little bits of trash, spiderwebs, and dead insects. The front gate is almost always partially broken and instead of punching in a code, your guest has to find your name and it's supposed to call your cell phone but it has never worked for us.

The management will increase your rent every year by the absolute maximum amount allowed under rent control laws. There's moving trucks every other weekend and turnover seems high.

Do not move to this prison. Worst decision I ever made. I think they paid that person to write a 5 star review due to all the bad reviews. This place is made like card board you hear your neighbors doing everything! Even bathroom business. The noise level is through the roof. Dryer vents next to bedroom windows. Dogs barking for long periods of time and management does nothing. Dog feces everywhere. Vandalism, car ports have collapsed on cars, half the gym equipment doesn't work, pool area is full of screaming roudy children and police have come due to a man threatening tenants at the pool. Floors bleed on your feet, units are dark like a cave, washers ruin your clothes, unsafe traffic.  Rent increases are huge after a year.

If I can live here forever I will.  I have lived in different apartment complexes in the area and Carmel Creek has all the pluses and is second to none.  The service and professionalism of the management and maintenance staff is consistent. The two dog parks have added a social life for our four legged love as well as for us.   I would not spread the word so that demand would not soar and rents would not raise, but I find it unfair for Carmel Creek staff as well as for potential renters.  Best place to rent!

The property tricks you with friendly staff who support you through the leasing process - answering your calls and treating you friendly. The facility looks nice enough and the rental price is almost too good to be true. And so you sign your lease and happily move in to your new apartment with high ceilings, ample closet spaces, and large windows that let in lovely light. And you are happy with your decision.

AND THEN...

They no longer take your phone call because they are too busy. Everything, you find, is a facade...the bathtub isn't fresh white and clean - but rather painted white. There is sewage smell emitting from every pipe. You enter maintenance requests and it takes days - if not weeks before someone shows up and some maintenance staff talk to you with disrepsectful, scolding tones, and put bainaides on things that truly need serious attetion and repairs.

AND THEN...

Your water is shut of regularly because there is ALWAYS something wrong with the plumbing. And then your mail boxes are closed down for several months because they were broken in to and now you have to go to the psot office to get your mail. And your car is broken in to and the deadbolt to your storage locker is cut and creepy men are prowling around your property at night looking for something to steal.

STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS! This is a low income project, masquerading as a suburban "retreat". (that is their word choice - just check out their website - what a joke!)

We have lived at Deerwood Apartments in San DIego for the past three years.  During that time, our sinks, tubs and toilets have been regularly clogged.  Sewage has been in our home - covering floors, filling tubs and sinks, even blocking our front door - many times.  We have regular visits from emergency plumbing companies at all hours of the night.  Countless times our water has been shut off - for hours and hours at a time.  

You call the front office - and no one answers.  In fact its their policy to not answer their phones.  The office is only open on Tuesday through Saturdays, 10 am to 6 pm, and even on those days and times, you will often find the office doors locked.  You will send emails to the office, and the often go completely unanswered - or perhaps answered - but in a dismissive way.

You try contacting a "headquarters" office - and the dismiss you as well. You reach out to the "corporate" office in New York - and no one replies.

If you are good with lack of water, and sewage in your home - if you are good with no customer service - then this place is for you.

My experience with this place wasn't all together bad, but my biggest gripe is with Deerwood's  unethical business practices, and disrespectful treatment towards a disabled veteran. My advice would be to find another place to live, especially if you are looking for something long term. 

I can't fit everything I'd like to say about Deerwood in this limited review space, but I will highlight the key points. Deerwood's staff is very intrusive, they frequently (every month or 2) would notify us that they would be entering our apartment for random reasons, unprompted.  

They wait as long as possible before issuing a renewal offer, and regardless of how good you were as a tenant (paying rent on time, never having issues with neighbors or staff) they will increase rent to the max allowable by law. For me it was more than a $300 increase.

They will take advantage of their position by charging for any perceived discrepancies post move out, no matter how immaculate you make the unit look after vacating it (nearly invisible scuffs on ceilings).

After moving out I find out I will not be getting any deposit back, and they are actually looking to collect $180.  After many months of disputes, and thinking they realized their mistake, I find that they turned me over to collections. Definition of "Taking Advantage"

It is almost always very quiet, the pool is very clean and there is an air conditioned gym room, and all cardio machines have TV attached to them. Overall I love this apartment complex and the main property manager always is reachable by email and replies quickly.

When we had to relocate from Las Vegas to San Diego, we searched for apartments to rent for a year before we buy a home. We needed a pet friendly place, and Deerwood is it. We see many breeds of dogs ranging from very small to quite large. There is a fee per pet (ups to 3 pets). I went online and found Deerwood Apartments in the Rancho Bernardo area of San Diego. We thought by the pictures that the kitchen was tiny, but it's much larger than the photos indicated. The buildings are nice, grounds are well maintained. The staff has been exceptional, everyone in the office and the maintenance staff has gone out of their way to make us feel welcome. The complex is located very near a lot of shopping as well as a large number of high-tech companies doing business in the area. The pool area is really nice, with a large jacuzzi and two newly installed gas grills. There is a nice gym with enough equipment to satisfy needs of residents. The only drawback is it's a touch pricey, but given the area, that is to be expected. All in all, a very nice place, I recommend it.

I could not be more happy with where I live! It's more of a small community then an apartment building. For what I can afford to pay I hit the jackpot with finding my place! The appliances are new, I have hardwood/carpet flooring. Lots of natural light and even a washer/dryer in my unit! Not to mention the great amenities, pool and fitness center that are always kept nice and clean. The management and staff are all nice and helpful. If you have a maintenance request it's simple and easy to request online and they come in about 24 hours. Simple fast and easy to pay rent online. I can't say enough good things about this place! Definitely happy to call this place home!

It's a quiet quaint community. The fact that there's so many store and highway access right here is great. It's also in a safe clean area. No homeless, sketchy people, trash, graffiti, broken down cars, or anything signifying a rough area.
The move in process at Navajo Bluffs was easy and fast. Property is well maintained and so far my experience has been great
Beautiful grounds and quiet, very helpful management
Navajo Bluffs is at a great location with easy access to the freeway with plenty of nearby stores to meet all of your needs and within a short distance to other areas within the San Diego County.
The only thing I can say is it is next to stores within walking distance-grocery, gas, restaurants, etc..
Well maintained apartment complex and a comfortable place to live.  Management always responds to maintenance issues.

The fire alarm is constantly going off. It has gone off 5 times in the middle of the night for the past year I’ve lived here and it is ear damaging loud. My AC has broke 4 times while being here. It is the worst place I’ve ever lived and I can’t wait til my lease is over in 2 months. DO NOT LIVE HERE

Don’t waste your time even touring. It’s horrible. The office staff is completely inept and lazy. The bldg is not kept well and there are major security and safety breaches that mgmt ignores. The lack of sound insulation in the “upgraded flooring” makes life miserable for residents living on lower floors. It’s as if there’s a herd of elephants running above us at all hours of the day and night.

Don't rent here. Yeah, the location is great as far as access to highways, downtown, beaches, shopping etc. go but management is the worst. As others have mentioned the building is in terrible shape, trash littered throughout the property, pet waste, elevators that are either broken down or reserved and incredibly slow. Loud, noisy neighbors in the common areas after quiet time, poor maintenance response time and lack of appreciation for current residents. 

They are painting the building right now which means that contractors are putting up scaffolding. But since no schedule was given to residents as to when and what extent that was happening I had men looking at me through my open blinds while I was getting out of the shower to get ready for work. Nice! You know, the blinds were open to get some sunlight and the windows were open for some fresh air all the while painters were staring at me, my room and what ever else. Management has no respect or care for their current residents.

And the fire alarms. They go off all the time. The alarm went off yesterday while the scaffolding was going up. It's no joke. You could survey every resident that has ever lived there and they will tell you that the alarms go off ALL the time. It's to the point that nobody bothers to exit the building when they go off because it happens so frequently and it's always a false alarm. But it takes the fire department 20 or so minutes to get there and clear the building before the alarms go off. It is absolutely ridiculous. 

This is NOT a luxury apartment community. It's a living nightmare. And not a single person in management on-site or at RW Selby cares. There is a mass exodus.
The pool are is awful. Sandwiched between two buildings and no deeper than 4 feet it's hardly a place to relax, get some sun and cool off. And the hot tub? Yeah, almost always "out of order" and never "hot" more like slightly less than luke warm.

One would think that such a nice, luxurious building would have full occupancy and be difficult to get into........Not here. A whopping 76% occupancy rate and a desperate promotion of one free month if you sign up now to try and lure new tenants. DON'T BE FOOLED. Is there any other "luxury" building in San Diego offering such a promotion? Nope.
I could go on and on but do your own research. Check Yelp. Virtually every single review since RW Selby took over is a 1 star. It would be negative if possible.

Your money would be better spent elsewhere.

APEX Fashion Valley is an amazing place to live in. The staff is awesome, the amenities are great and the Apartments are well laid out and very reasonably priced and I'm across the street from a beautiful Mall. I expect APEX to be my long term home in San Diego!....Joseph Vilella

This place is trash. 

The reviews from several years ago are for when this property was owned and managed by Avalon. Despite the new property management company not removing Avalon signage that still appears all over the property for months, RW Selby has proven to be a colossal failure in providing a comfortable or safe living experience. 

It's dirty, loud, mismanaged, and unsafe. The elevators are constantly broken. Amenities are routinely out of service for long periods but you still pay for them. Maybe 5% of pet owners clean up after their animals, so the hallways and area around the building constantly smell like urine and has pet waste accumulated. The quality of the building's repairs is absurd. Basic service requests are routinely mismanaged.  

Most recently 2 security doors were accessible without a fob from Friars Rd. and the emergency exit was locked, locking residents in. Management knew about it, was negligent, and did nothing to notify the community. In the event of an emergency, RW Selby demonstrated it cares nothing of its residents' safety. 

There are a million other places to live in Mission Valley and the San Diego area - look elsewhere.

Avalon at Fashion Valley is a great place to live.  The location is terrific - 15 minutes to the beach, 10 minutes to downtown, and easy access to places like La Jolla and Coronado.  Everything you need - groceries, shopping, etc. - is 5 minutes away, and you can catch the trolley across the street at Fashion Valley Mall.

The only real drawbacks are the traffic noise on Friars and the lack of light in the rear apartments.

The staff at Fashion Valley are REALLY terrific - always friendly and helpful.  The neighbors are also very friendly.  It's a great place to be.

I moved in the Rey at the end of May. Since I was relocating in San Diego in a very short time, L. Celiene from the leasing office was absolutely amazing, so professional, and friendly at the same time, answered all of my questions. She certainly made my move-in experience smooth and pleasant. Any issues, every little thing are addressed immediately, and she is always attentive- BEST! The building is very modern, elegant, clean, safe and has wonderful  amenities. The entire staff - office, maintenance- is great , very professional team.

I've really enjoyed living here so far. The views are spectacular. The place is in excellent shape. And Norelle in the leasing office was so helpful with facilitating the application process and move-in. Highly recommended.

I've been here a year now. It's pretty decent to live here they keep the grounds maintained grass cut trees trimmed always clean I will say that the trash sometimes gets out of hand. But other than that it's pretty cool the neighbors are decent they don't bother you you don't bother them. Well at least on my side anyway. But if you thinking about moving here I would suggest it. The only thing I found out was a surprise is that you have to pay for water trash and pesticides and that bill is about 60dollars a month.. and they make you get renters insurance that's about $136 a year. But other than that it's pretty cool. The people in the leasing office are nice and respectful and all of the maintenance people are nice and respectful there's never any situations haven't really seen too many. Oh yeah the area is pretty cool also and the stores are pretty close there's a 7-Eleven and gas station down the street you can walk too.

The apartments are decent. Despite being older, the grounds are well kept and maintained. Office staff is usually helpful and maintenance staff responds quickly. The age and lower price for the area do attract some riffraff but overall not too bad.

I have been living here for a few years now and have had a good experience so far. Staff here is very friendly and maintenance if quick to help with any problem. Its pretty peaceful and lots of nice trees around. I took a star off because i'd really love air conditioning and laundry inside apartment! The laundry center is OK but can be a hassel especially if one of the machines isnt working properly and it takes your money :(  overall though i feel content living here.

Place is in a great location. Close to State if you're a student. Neighbors keep to themselves and friendly. Staff is very helpful. Wish there was a weight room, but I enjoyed the 3 years I resided there.

The apartment is in a good location, my neighbor are great, but it's a little to small for 3 people, i been here since my kids were in the 6 grade. It time for something biger. Where we all  can live together and help each other. Thanks

Parkview Terrace is a nice residence to live,  but the apartments need upgrades, from the appliances to the fixtures in the bathrooms. Due to the foliage the apt is constantly having some type of insect crawling on the walls, and the noise pollution can disrupt your sleep, but for the monthly price it's nice.
Its spaches but its on the 3rd floor amd its a hasel when we buy grocery.

I've been living here for 14 years, or rather since I was 13 years of age. Having switched houses within the complex 3 times since I've been here,  I have seen slight upgrades and improvements to the interiors and outdoor aesthetics over the years. Safety and security has improved drastically, with close to 24hr security. And the location is central to many shopping centers, malls are close, as well as multiple freeways for getting around the city. The only downside, happens to be that this location has a lot of children unmonitored by their parents who tend to deface areas, and create garbage. As well as, loud noises which can be heard through paper thin walls. Luckily, the maintenance workers get to it early, while most people are quiet during the evening.

I lived here for 5 years and I love it .it doesn't feel like an apartment it feels like a home , the maintenance department is the best , when something brakes the fix it almost right away the rest of the staff incredibly helpful .. I'm very happy here. I have shopping centers and restaurants just across the street , I'm surrounded by the best schools and university in San Diego.I just Love it here.                                                      Elizabeth F. San Diego CA

This apartment has a great maintenance crew, but this is where the good stops and the bad begins.  The crew is needed because there is constantly something that is disfunctional.  The washing machine/dryer is terrible and takes 4-6 hours to wash and dry one load. Also the Tandem parking drives you crazy. Cant wait to move out of here.....

Found it by accident, but glad we did.  My husband and I were looking to find our first home. Being married for only 2 weeks we stumbled across Eaves while trying to find a different address.  We stopped because the entrance looked inviting.  The amenities are great,  and the staff is always so helpful.  The apartments are spacious,  and the internet cafe was very convenient when waiting for our cable and internet to be installed, and the convenience of a gym right by the pool is great. The community is friendly and quiet and the location is 15 minutes from everywhere that you want to go.

Since Eaves Rancho Penasquitos is a small complex, one could feel its warmth, belongingness and comfortability. It is nestled in a quiet, clean and safe surroundings.  It is near a freeway but you do not feel the freeway. It is convenience at its best. Maintenance is great too.

The complex it nice looking, typical SOCal look(Spanish style)
The management staff is very easy to deal with and pleasant. Pet friendly! Onsite parking, units have washer and dryers, optional units with garages available. Each unit also has porch or balcony. The common area has gym and pool.
clean and safe location. Nice and accommodating staff
Hector is awesome, he will make the leasing process awesome. The office manager is not pleasant and very condescending... Otherwise, the actual community is great

We had high hopes for Montanosa. The management, aside from the maintenance team, doesn't deliver on their promises and has no interest in being honest or courteous with the residents. They will nickel and dime you and charge you extra fees when you try to move out. They are out to get as much money from you as they can while you are there. They have no interest in respecting their current tenants because they have military families moving in and out all the time so that is their bread and butter. 

The units are older, with a couple new coats of paint to cover up the mold in the bathrooms that have little to zero exhaust fans sucking out the air. The appliances are a bit older, unless you pay extra for updated ones, and the exhaust fan in the kitchen is non existent. 

Montanosa's management team doesn't deliver once you sign the lease. Be careful.

Retention is not their goal. Draining you of money on hidden fees is. DO NOT GET INTO A LEASE HERE. Not a rant from an angry tenant since I loved my time living there...

At one point in time I gave this business four stars. Then I saw the Essex businesses model in its true colors. Despite amazing staff navigating the property, the company itself is diabolical.

Hidden charges and extra fees galore!! Dealt with mold issues, rats, and roaches. Poor quality units. Everything is falling apart with just a coat of paint covering it. They charge everyone who moves out for new carpeting. Regardless if it's needed or not. This is their standard practice. I also saw them charge tenants for broken a/c units that went out because they were from the 1980's.

I couldn't be happier to be out from their umbrella and would WARN ANYONE TO RETHINK SIGNING PAPERWORK WITH THEM!!

During the COVID-19 pandemic they used the moratorium as a gentle way to kick tenants out. Charging astronomical amounts to these individuals behind the scenes. Instead of working with tenants they used the moratorium to save themselves legal fees and move everyone out. Their fees came after "settling" deals with Essex's collection team.

Some tenants had to pay their lease break fees while some were allowed to waive it. Others had rental increases. There was no consistency, or formula to how they treated people. Only trying to figure out how they could get as much money as possible while vacating units then highly increase their price.

The staff was helpful and kind. The company is terrible, and will strong arm you into so many things you won't get the pleasure of discovering until you move out. Good luck.

Only good thing about this place is the maintenance crew. Management is horrible and you would think for the amount that you pay for rent, that they would respond to issues you have with your apartment right away. Also they have a huge rodent problem. After coming home from vacation, a giant rat had made its way into our fireplace from a hole in the roof and died. You would think they would do something as soon as possible to take care of this issue but they didn’t. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS OVERATED PROPERTY!!!

We work in the early AM and the pool and hot tub closes at 10 pm but often doesn't get locked so there are many LATE night hot tub parties on work nights. We call the security as we've been told to and it takes 45-60 minutes for them to show up to get the people out. So our warning is to not live anywhere near the pool when you are looking to move here if you want a restful sleep. And the security is a joke, don't bother calling them. Otherwise it's a cool place to live.
It's small for the price in the rent. Does have a garage which is nice.

What is written in the description is not correct, there are no tennis courts, I don't believe that this particular website is honest with any of these listings but Mariners Cove is a nice complex that is being destroyed, we had hundreds of beautiful trees on the complex but now they are all being torn out... The carports need to be reinforced.

If you are looking for housing where you can have up to 3 pets, Mariners Cove is great. We have a large dog and we are all very happy to have found someplace nice to live. The grounds are lovely , so it’s easy to take him out for his quick potty breaks , with abundant grassy areas. Walks are fun too. I wish more people took care of their doggy poos, but that is not management’s fault. 
We have had just a couple of issues since moving in, and everything is resolved quickly. Management responds quickly. Trash and furniture piled up a few weeks ago( people seem to use the trash areas as a dumping ground) but a message to the office and someone was out the next day to clear it. A homeless person with a full grocery cart of stuff was seen gently escorted towards the front gate a week weeks ago. It’s a loosely gated community. I feel pretty safe here. 
The location is ideal, we moved from out of state and enjoy being close to the beach with the cooler temps and proximity to the freeways . Mariners Cove is not quite luxury living , but the amenities are pretty great and when the gym reopens we will be glad. People decorate their patios and seem happily settled in.  I would sign the lease all over again and we hope to be here with our furry friend for quite awhile.

I went to talk to Paige on behalf of a resident that was having trouble paying the rent for that month. She was not pleasant to interact with and was not helpful until she was forced to provide the information I needed to help the resident. I don't know if she has a problem with the resident and so by default, she had an issue with me. I felt disrespected and as if she tried extremely hard to belittle me and the person I tried to help but I would not live on this property.
No comments provided.
No comments provided.
No comments provided.

We've lived here for a little over a year now and I must say how expensive it is becoming without the proper security! The maintenance team is the best no doubt. But why pay basically a mortgage when packages are being stolen, garages being broken into, cars being broken into, cars being STOLEN, catalytic converters being stolen, including mine. The worst part is it's a gated community and THE GATES AREN'T CLOSED AT NIGHT! Theft is skyrocketing in this little community and yet they're more focused on redoing the parking structure rather than investing in cameras or a security team. SMH! But sure, considering the location, the property is "ok".

My wife and I have been living here for 8 months and there have been alot of problems with the dishwasher, pipes in the walls, loud neighbors and you can hear every car that drives by. No designated parking spots. Too expensive and we are looking to move once our 12 month lease expires. If you have a family I would not move here.

I'll summarize it fairly. 
Cons: 
Complex is overall quiet and clean, and I've met some nice residents! 
People pick up their dog waste. 
Great location near freeway, shopping, walking, etc.
Cons:
Parking is tight.
Gym equipment is old and most machines needs to be replaced or thrown away. The area appeared dirty. 

The worst part was the move-out process; they nickel and dime you. I am a travel nurse and lived there for 3.5 out of the 6 month lease and had to pay for CARPET REPLACEMENT, PAINTING, AND OVERALL CLEANING. I was hardly home (you can ask my neighbors). The employee that came to do the move-out inspection barely took any photos (that was not the case in the final report). 
He also claimed that the section of missing paint on my patio was from dog urine. Ha!! Nice try, sir. Maybe it was the crappy paint job and weather that caused the paint to crack. I must add that my place smelled awful when I first moved in. It took 3 floor washings with my Shark mop. Additionally, the bathroom fan was full of dust and dirt and it didn't even work! I should have complained about it then; but I was too focused on starting my new job. 

I have been a renter for years and not once have I received LESS than my original security deposit. I am happy for the experience in San Diego, but disappointed in how it ended.
Equity will gouge your pockets. There are plenty of nicer and cheaper places to live.

If I could give zero stars I would. The office staff is highly unprofessional and adds on extra charges and late fees that are not documented anywhere. Parking here is a nightmare, no spots available after 6pm. No assigned spots so you are fighting to park. Apartments are mediocre at best.

My husband and I have been living here for almost 2.5 years. We originally moved into a 1 bedroom and we were there for about 2 months. I noticed that a 2 bedroom was the exact same price as the one bedroom. So we were able to transfer with ease. (We had to pay and extra $75 because the deposit is larger for a 2 bedroom). The 12 month lease started over when we moved into the 2 bedroom. When that lease ended, the renewal lease increased by $200 a month. We decided to stay as our lease ended 7 days before our wedding and we didn't want the hassle of moving before our wedding. Our lease is almost up and we will probably move to a one bedroom here to save as we don't need a second bedroom (although extra space is always nice).

Now for the apartment itself. The location is great. There a gate that requires a card to get in. Very quite! Although I have neighbor friends on the other side of the complex that say their side is crazy. So I do believe there are 2 sides to the complex. The north side seems to be quite and family oriented (which is where we are) the other side sound like a party. Loud neighbors etc. 

Gym: overall the gym is nice. It has almost everything for you to stay fit. However, it's not always clean (I.e. Other tenants don't clean up after themselves.) My husband stated that when the staff comes to clean he sees them clean just the mirror and vacuum. They do the minimum. 

The staff: overall very friendly. I haven't had any issue with them. When something was broken (washing machine for example) they show up in a timely matter. No issues with that. 

Appliances: washing machine has broken a handful of times on us but they always fix it quickly. (One of my neighbors washer broke once and they replaced the entire washing machine).

Overall a great place to live and the location is great. Love the storage that the patio has.

Pros: staff is friendly, location is great, multiple shops within walking distance.

Cons: NO FIBER OPTIC INTERNET (best you can get is 5g wireless internet)
often homeless people stealing from the grocery store on the first level or doing drugs.
Been times when fire alarms going off multiple times in one week, including once at 1am.
Old building so large maintenance back log and was told could take longer than a week to fix issues with my apartment.
Electric bill is Ridiculous, one time almost 400 dollars for a 1 bedroom off setting the savings you get from rent.

Overall experience here has been pretty meh. If you intend to move here, do your due diligence.

Roaches, urine in elevators, no maintenance team response (requested more than 3 weeks ago), no one in lobby, leaking appliances, no communication with residents for example when testing fire alarm "briefly" it went off 6 hours, then elevators went out for weeks. Used to be WONDERFUL before the change.
Crappy inefficient appliances. Poor A/C design causes overuse. Only hot water in summer, and mostly cold in winter. Only internet is VDSL. Priced way too high!

I'm new to San Diego and I signed a lease before arriving. I couldn't be happier! The leasing office is great as well as the maintenance staff. The price is also pretty good for the location and the square footage. It's close to work and still in downtown but not too close to where it's really noisy. I plan on living here for a couple of years!

Awesome place to live, Henry and Jerry have turned the whole place around, we no longer worry about stolen packages or homelessness. The complex has literally done a 180 since Henry has been here, Jerry has maintained the whole complex and kept it running. 5 stars

We have lived here awhile and have dealt with the problems in reviews but since Gerry became maintenance on site the property is so much nicer kept. He is very respectful of his job and is always there for any maintenance needs. Our new Manager Henry is also very helpful with anything.The best about living here is the neighbors. A lot of cool cool people live here and are animal lovers!!! Dana L

- unresponsive management
-terrible building with mold, uneven floors, nasty carpeting, broken light fixtures, and often unusable amenities.
-Unsecured mailboxes and building (packages are chronically stolen
-Had two homeless people living in a storage closet management failed to address
- They will nickel and dime you on move-out. 

Overall they promise improvement and "luxury living" and charge for it but offer nothing other than substandard living conditions. 

Avoid the move in deals, building, and management at all costs
The management is horrible and unresponsive. They do not inform you of damaged units and will try to rent them to you. They are non-responsive about returning deposit. Avoid renting from them!

First off, there is mold all over the building, which FPI Management (the owner/property manager) denies that there is mold. I had to stay in a hotel for months while my apartment was remediated of mold. Second, the property is very dirty with trash and dog poop. Also, racoons live under the building. Third, the homeless situation has gotten out of control. The homeless sleep in the elevator and stairwells, use the laundry, and steal packages. The management office is NEVER open and you can never get a call or email back. STAY AWAY FROM FPI MANAGEMENT.

Please save your health and don’t rent here. Major mold issues - not just the normal amount of mold you might see when living near the beach. Lost thousands of dollars of sentimental items. Management’s “solution” was to paint over all the mold. Needless to say, the mold came right back 3 weeks later. Property manager can be very petty, she has a hard job and does decent at it, but I was so nice to her and she just thru attitude at me left and right. Plus I was so proud of my Halloween door decorations for the contest and I worked really hard on making it look spooky and I got lots of compliments from the nice neighbors, but the property manager didn’t even make me an honorable mention :( First place went to someone who clearly spent a fraction of the time on their door. I got snubbed for sure, but I digress. Don’t rent here if you can find anywhere else. The mold is enough to make anyone sick.

Girlfriend and I were on the search for an apartment and on paper Gables seemed to check all the boxes. Close to stores, gyms, not too far from the beach, and appeared to be tucked away from the red light Midway area.

It's been 19 days since move-in at the time of this review and we have so far had over $1500 worth stolen from us, including several packages disappearing within minutes of delivery and one of our cars being broken into and ransacked. The complex offers secure lockers for packages but despite including it in delivery instructions we have only ever had one package actually go to the locker as most drivers don't know or care. The apartment itself is rather nice and cozy once we got it set up, but minor details were imperfect. One nuisance the person above us, whose footsteps are so loud it sounds like they are trying to stomp through the floor with each step. Laundry rooms smell like vomit and consistently have wastewater on the floors and it costs nearly $5 to run a single load through washer and dryer. Overall disappointed with the experience and will be considering cutting losses and terminating the lease early. We do not feel safe or secure enough with the events that have happened within just a few weeks of move-in

Rude, incompetent management
Dog poop and litter all over the place
you can hear your neighbors footsteps and anytime they use their plumbing
Laundry room is frequently flooded with sewage water
Constant construction from plumbing leaks
I moved in 3 months ago and it has gotten progressively more unpleasant

Maintenance is always friendly and quick with repairs though some need to be redone.
Jillian in Management is responsive, friendly and professional, and really seems to care about the residents. 
I see and appreciate upgrades and community maintenance (tree trimming, window washing); though the hot tub (all jets not working) and fire pit both need attending and it would be nice if we had access to the game room without having to request a key only during office hours. 
Love the hours for the gym and pool deck. Is very nice to have a late night relaxing jacuzzi soak. 
Bike storage is also a big plus!
Love the convenience of the trash chute, if people didn’t clog it and then leave their trash next to it.

overall i love Gables, i have lived  here for over three years now, noise level is always low and love my actual apartment, i love the open floor plan and my amenities. Whenever maintenance needs to be done they are pretty quick. the pool, jacuzzi, and gym are a plus. I think the only thing they can work on is cleaning the hallways and staircases more, however i feel like it is getting better.

So far so good! I love my apartment, the staff are always so friendly specially Decky. I haven’t had a single issue. I was worried about shared laundry but there hasn’t been a single problem there, I seem to be lucky and get free washes and dries almost every time I do laundry
It’s subpar. They can’t keep their staff for some reason to maintain the buildings, cleaning is a huge problem. Important daily needs are low priority.

I have been very pleased with Maritza and of all of her help. The repair people are also very quick to respond.
Thank you,
Heilda (New resident)
The images they have provided are photoshopped/ using filters. The units are not nearly as nice as they are presented.

The management team is great, especially Lamonda! She was so patient and kind when helping me get through the application process. Seems like they really care about there tenants and future tenants. Overall high quality service, lease here!!

I’m not one to write reviews good or bad but I don’t think Villa Del Sol gets enough recognition. Property was taken over by a new property management who are nothing but kind and helpful. I love my unit and quiet. Only downside is street parking but welcome to San Diego. Lease here!!
This is the worst experience you could ever imagine living anywhere can’t ever sleep the ceilings are so loud and cockroaches

This place is perfectly located right next to SDSU and is clean and well maintained. But Jacque, the property manager, is what really makes this please great! She is super nice and communicative and gets things done! She helped us through every step of our lease and seems to really care about the tenants! Highly recommend!!!

This apartment is amazing, and since I transitioned over to this one, it has almost immediately proven wonderful!

Rooms are large, even for single bedroom apartments. A pool, gym, sauna, and yoga room are all provided. It looks more like a resort than an apartment complex, and not to mention the swift actions by on site staff whenever there's something amiss, like circuits that may be shorted or if the water doesn't work. They're on the case within the hour to fix it. 

I'd recommend Villa Del Sol to anyone looking for quality and pleasant surroundings!

La Jolla Blue provides five-star service. The management team is very courteous and professional and helps you to make it your home.

Richard P
I moved in La Jolla Blue two weeks ago, I am very happy about the apartment, the community area and the service of the team.
The staff has and is always accommodating and friendly!!! And incredibly responsive to any needs or concerns.

I would reconsider renting from this property.

They don't know which units are 'renovated', with hodgepodge pricing.

Management is nice but incompetent.  Have taken WEEKS to fulfill simple work orders.

I've been gaslit about maintenance issues, and how their online payment/financial ledger is inaccurate.  Was told 'that's just how it is'.

They are undergoing major construction, so even when things reopen, they won't be done.

DO NOT rent a bottom/ground floor unit.  The upstairs will have hard vinyl flooring, and you will hear stomping from heal-strikers.  Pets running across the floor, etc.  If you work from home, this is a dealbreaker.

No air conditioning.  During warmer weather, you will have to have a de-humidifier from how swampy it gets.  About 4x months out of the year.

Again, reconsider renting from here.

After my experience you don't want me spreading the word... 
I have a physical email from a Greystar staff member that concludes my mold issue is "simply the direction that the apartment faces, making it darker and colder in the winter months which may help it to appear". Also that several other apartments were dealing with the same consistent issues. So no matter what I do the mold keeps winning which is detrimental to my health and my newly discovered mold allergy. For that reason I will not be renewing my lease.

The overall quality of the units is terrible.  The management does not tend to your issues in a timely manner.  Renovations are sloppy, and insulation is non-existent.  Prepare to buy cooling and heating accessories on your dime.  Inspect every inch of your unit before getting a lease.  Hardware and installation is usually wrong on everything.  Fiber runs are all chewed up by vermin and run through many adjacent apartments, so AT&T had to get approvals for access into many apartments to fix and setup my internet.  Have photos and lengthy email threads to prove everything.

It's Christmas Day. Approximately 10 minutes to MIDNIGHT, I see water on the Kitchen Floor. Believe it or not, I call Maintenance and they actually ANSWER THE PHONE!!!!! 
Better yet, in less than twenty minutes Jose is at my door.

Honestly, what more can you ask for? Hot Tub. Swimming Pool, Elevaltors, onsite management (open door),  5 major Freeways within walking distance, a Public library, and Post Office. Seriously what more is there? 
Easy on the wallet rent, Balcony, Gated Parking, Covered Parking, and Three malls within a mile. I just Love it here, six years and counting.
Water is always being shut off. Dirty tenants. Gates and doors are always broken.

Nice place to live at. I've been here since May of 2004. That was due to my military status. I am now retired from the Navy as of last year and I am still at the apartment complex. A lot of things close by for me to walk to as well.

A nice cozy apartment. The apartment is a bit small but its perfect for couples and small families. Also there is a nice big pool and jacuzzi. The attendants are nice and welcoming and the manager and her family are extremely welcoming. If you travel down the hill you will be introduced to the famous Fashion Valley Mall.

I have lived here for several years now. I have watched this place go from an amazing place to live to an absolute dump. This is NOT a safe environment to live in. There has been stabbings and shootings at the complex over the past year. Broken glass is frequently found by the pool area. Security gates are frequently broken so anyone can enter in/out as they please. To no surprise, the shooting occurred when all gates were broken. Motorcylces have been stolen and cars are always getting broken into. Some neighbors have even had their homes broken into. The "security" guards they have don't monitor anything for safety. All they care about is making sure everyone is out of the pool by 10 PM. Most of the time, no one is actually even on site.

This used to be a fun party place but now it is just out of control. I have seen groups of 15+ people hanging out by the pool and grills and not a single one of them will be a resident. There will be minors frequently out there way too intoxicated/high and get carried out by their friends. The hot tub has so much chlorine in it I know many who have developed skin rashes/fungal infections from it.

The laundry machines have not been consistently working for over a year. The complex will not take responsibility for this and blames a 3rd party vendor for this.

If you still decide to live here, expect your rent to increase at least $150 every time your lease expires. The office will promise a luxury lifestyle with high-end amenities and the quality has plummeted over the years. They no longer hold events, amenity hours are limited, gym equipment and basketball courts are frequently broken. There have been multiple rat infestations and the office does a poor job to address them. Honestly, I feel bad when I watch people moving in at this point because they'll soon be disappointed.
RAT infestation happening - no follow-up from management or Corporate / other residents found rat in hot tub. Next step Health Department?

Fees for everything, including cancellation of your APPLICATION. Also, if you are a sucker and do move in like me, don't forget to fill out the apartment condition paperwork or they will ding you for every little piece of damage that was there long before you.

First, the positive: The pool area is resort-like, and the staff is friendly and helpful. Any maintenance requests I placed were fixed within minutes. The location is perfect: just close enough to the bay/beach/bars to walk, and right next to a nice cluster of restaurants.
There was a handful of things which bugged me. The air conditioning barely worked (not that I needed it often). It is almost impossible to get cell service inside the apartments. The shower heads are really low (odd, but you notice it the first time you try to shower), and there are a bunch of doors that lead to nowhere (I had to open 3 pointless doors to get to/from the laundry room). Pretty much everyone owns a dog, so expect a lot of barking at night and dog hair everywhere. 
Overall, I enjoyed living here, but it was not quite worth the price.

Very shady business. Because they have so many units there are always appartments available so prices change daily and team in the lobby is very aggressive. Very sales oriented (you feel like you in a car dealership). The team definitely is getting commission out of each sale.

This was a bad experience and I did not even move in!! Careful, don't sign anything.
Avalon apartments are awesome! Just moved here from new york and couldnt be happier with the place I chose to live. The vibe is great and everything is within walking distance! :)

This has been the worst apartment living experience I have ever had- there are water/plumbing issues about once a month where we might be without water completely or without hot water.
My closet broke twice and the second time it took maintenance 3+ weeks to fix it- so I had nowhere to put my clothes for that period of time.
The elevator wait time can get veryyy long and there is always at least 3-4/8 of the total elevators that are not working at any period of time and it is seemingly like there are no goals to fix them.
Lastly, we had issues with the dryer and dishwasher and it took at least a month for anyone to come inspect it and another 2-3 weeks so any maintenance to be done.
Yes, it has nice amenities and gym and the apartment itself is more modern but the logistical issues listed above and the parking garage that is difficult to maneuver would make another building worth your while.
When myself and multiple tenants asked for a rent reduction because of all of the problems, the staff said "there was nothing they could do about it", and that its an issue for higher up in the company- aka- still haven't heard back and this was weeks ago.

The elevators are constantly down. You'll find yourself waiting 20-30 minutes at times just to catch an elevator. Management is incompetent, untruthful, lacks communication, and have even retaliated against tenants who speak up about the issues plaguing this terrible building.

In addition to the elevator problems, you will also experience frequent water shutoffs due to maintenance.

Do not let yourself be fooled, this place is miserable to live in and you'll instantly regret it.
Don't fall for it. This place has gone way down hill since the new owners took over. Evevators NEVER work and the staff doesn't care.
Do not rent from these people.  They will not return your deposit.
cleanliness was incredible, the staff was extremely helpful and seemed very caring and concerned with peoples needs and how to accommodate to all.
Only 1 out of the 4 elevators work, long lines waiting for the elevator, can take up to 20 min to get on the elevator… unacceptable..

If you want to walk half a mile each day to get to your car come live here! Parking is not organized at all! And people have cars parked for weeks in the street so you can never find a good parking spot...... if you have multiple cars go live somewhere else .

This place was a nightmare. Thankfully it’s a monthly lease so we were able to leave in less than 6 months. 
There was a HUGE roach infestation, ants, and a beehive right outside our window for over 2 months. The manager, Ana, is horrible at her job. She would tell us that she had called the exterminator and he never came. She was never in her office, some days the phone wouldn’t be answered until 12:00pm! 
They are also in the process of remodeling some units and the noise from the construction is loud and often starts early morning on weekends. Due to the construction they will shut off the water all day with no notice. 
My advice is to live somewhere else.

Management on site will never assist you with any needs. There is one parking spot assigned to each unit but every time someone parks in your spot they never call anyone to take care of it. Most pathetic management I’ve ever dealt with, Property manager needs to be replaced.

Many compalints was reported but not addressed properly. We’ve been licing in the place for over ten years but never replaced our carpeting. Cocroaches was inabiding us and we have to take care of that oursekves. Disable parking was always occupied by the old blue car and res SUV. It seems permanent. We could not even talk to the company owner and no information about them where to complain our converns.

Management is lazy hard to catch her in the office never check to see if work orders have been accomplished. Vents don't suck air adequately enough in the bathroom and above the stove. Lots of ants. BBQ grills been broken since the day we moved in over a year ago. If it wasn't for the rent being so cheep we would of moved out already.

There is no security in this place or security cameras.  People lose their Amazon packages or deliveries.  Cars get broken into almost every week, and the management can't do anything about it.  As much as I like the place, but often times there are some shady strangers in the apartment complex.  Strange people use the apartment complex as a shortcut from Honey Drive to Woodman, and I guess these same strange people are the ones stealing mail packages.  It would have been nice if they have security cameras to deter these criminals, but they don't have it.  Sometimes there are teenagers who are not a resident who smokes weed or probably do drugs beside the swimming pool, you can smell the weed from a distance.   If a lose another Amazon package, I'll be looking for a different apartment soon.

The supervisor (not the manager) who visits monthly is rude and does not care about the tenants' well being.  The supervisor does not want anything visible on the windows except the blinds, no signs, stickers, or any ornaments on the windows.  The supervisor also does not want any windows exhaust fan.  The apartments here are super hot during the summer because only one side has windows, but the supervisor does not allow any kind of windows fan which makes living here very uncomfortable during summer.

They don't really care about the tenants. Many times they have a "professional day" but tenants are not informed in advance when the office is closed. So if you need help specifically from the leasing office, too bad!

 I could write a book on the problems here.
A very poor hygiene of the building and the amenities.

I'm so happy to be living here at 900 F. The price is very affordable and you can't beat it for the location. Great amenities and very friendly neighbors. Apartments are very nice and cozy too, I like the hardwood floors. The management and maintenance team are amazing as well, very nice and supportive. They never fail to solve any problem I have.

Great management and beautiful location.
very organized and nice people run this place
Everything is outdated. If you don’t live on the 4th floor. You will never be able to get peace .. the floors/walls are super thin
The rent is high. Central Park is a nice facility, but it is not ?luxury?, and the rent is high!
We really love how well the grounds are maintained, we love the trees and greenery, but most of all the staff makes this a really nice place to live. Thank you!
I think the location and the green spaces and amenities are good.

Not only would I recommend this community to others but I have. My mom and dad are moving in in a month! Hopefully I can get my brothers and sisters to move in here as well! One big happy family all in one place, Central Park!
Overall we are so pleased to be here. The grounds are meticulously maintained and maintenance staff are friendly and responsive.
I would recommend to a friend but, I will warn them that rent will increase by a lot every renewal of lease.
The leasing office (I believe India) is Great! she is so helpful and kind.

The maintenance staff never came to repair the issue but simply closed the maintenance request. The community office staff helped schedule a new appointment for Thursday at 5 PM, but no one showed up on time. The next day, another staff member from the community office said that the technician wouldn’t be working on Thursday. TI have no idea when someone will come to fix it.

It’s a great starter apartment has everything one might need. Close to a lot of great things like gyms, stores, grocery stores, movie theaters. It’s also very close for college students to get to school. It might have flaws but it is still a great place to live.
Great team at the leasing office. Great location. Nice remodeled apartment (inside)
maintenance has always been very helpful along with current manager.

I have lived here 12 years and been completely satisfied.  And during that 12 years no significant issues that needed to be addressed, maintenance or otherwise.  India is always professional and friendly, and the staff as well.

HORRIBLE MANAGMENT! Management is very rude, doesn't get back to you. Talks down to you. I highly not recommend living here. Also wouldn't tel me if their was previous leaks, which means likely their was. Stay away! RUDE people!

The NEW management here is very rude and they take FOREVER to get anything done. You have to bug them for several days to weeks to accomplish anything. They also don’t take care of the property, and don’t care about the residents. Also, the cheap fixtures and carpet (ours tore up after only two months with NO DOGS)  and the poor installation of basic items make this complex a subpar place to live. I wish the Bridge (management company) would bring the old property manager back. Think twice before moving here.

First a man tried to break into my bedroom through the window in the middle of the night.  He was outside my apartment, beating on the window, which is single pane and flimsy.  I called Solazzo’s security line, but they had nobody nearby and the man got away.  Instead of putting bars over the window or replacing it with a stronger window, Solazzo management gave me a lock that you can buy on Amazon for two dollars.  It only keeps the window from being slid open sideways, and doesn’t make any difference if someone is trying to push the window in.
Then someone scraped my car in the garage and I asked management if they had security cameras in the garage that might have told me who did it.  Management told me they do not have any security cameras in the garage.  Lighting in the garage is also not good.
A few months later, someone ransacked my car, stealing items from it, when it was parked in the same garage.  You would have thought that management would have known it was a good idea to install security cameras, but they still had none.  So again, I can’t find out who the perpetrator is.
At the same time that management refuses to take security measures, they are squeezing current tenants with big rent increases.  We are paying more money despite the fact that management has closed many of the amenities.  I believe their rent increases illegally violate the limitations on price gouging that apply under the current state of emergency declared in California.
I can’t wait to get out of here in a few months.  Management is greedy and does not care about the safety of the tenants.

Lived here 13 months. Close to UCSD.Lots of shopping walking distance.Plenty of parking.Tenants friendly and respectful. Units spacious and plenty of closet space. Office staff available and helpful. PROBLEM-work crew. These guys loiter around all day and hide out in stairwells and cubby holes all day.They could easily cut the crew in half if they worked an honest 8 hour day. .Scarry to think they have pass keys to the units..They are the dominant atmosphere starting at 8am. No accountability or oversight

Had a horrible experince here from start to finish. I have never lived somewhere that I have dreaded coming home to until now. My husband and I moved in at the height of construction. We knew this and did not complain about the noise. But we did complain about the dirt, trash, and trip hazards left by construction workers. This place looked like a war zone on a daily basis. On top of that residents allow their dogs to pee on the walking paths so if you weren’t dodging construction hazards you were dodging pee puddles. The last straw was when a family of four moved in above us. These are one bedroom 600sqft apartments. There made constant noise and complaints to the leasing office yielded no results. Our sleep, jobs, and sanity were affected by these people. We tried to break our lease early given this problem but the leasing office would only let us out 20 days early. Stay away from this place. Horribly run.

This place is absolutely unjustifiably terrible.They breached their contract by lying about how long the construction would last. About the noise level. About everything. NEVER MOVE HERE. The corporate office is not helpful. I had to wait an entire month before I could move out because they took so long to get back to me. They  tried to charge me a two month penalty plus a 30 day notice to break my lease even though they were the ones that breached their contract. So I got a lawyer and had to deal with a lawyer contacting them and figuring out how I could break my lease without being penalized because they were the ones at fault. Absolutely ridiculous. I’ve never experienced such a disaster when living in an apartment complex. The construction went on the entire time I lived there  I moved out and then they are trying to charge me $400 for the carpet to be replaced. Claiming that there were cat pee stains underneath once they ripped up the carpet. Not sure what gave them the idea to rip up the carpet when there were no stains, it wasn’t damaged, there was nothing wrong with it, and yet my deposit return was $424 less than it should have been. I’m still dealing with this mess and I don’t even live there anymore. Never move into an Irvine company apartment. It will be the biggest mistake of your life.

The community is well kept overall, however there service can be improved. Also, there is huge remodeling happening, which may be good for future - but not for anyone looking to move there due to constant construction.

I selected to live at Solazzo apartment because I was in a time crunch to find an apartment moving to San diego from out of town. I did not have the luxury to look around apartments, so I decided to rent there due to reputation I've heard of Irving Company Apartments. 

I lived here for about a year and for how much you pay, I am quite confident people can find a lot better community. 

The unit itself is mostly nice, however, the community is not as nice. The walkways are always dirty, trash bins are overflowing. 

Leasing office staffs are all kinda rude except Anna who is always so professional and attentive. Everyone else does not seem to ever care about your life. 

Overall, not really recommend living here. There are better apartments.

Horrible management, this place is literally falling apart and so many empty apartments. Maintenance is very lazy with remodeling and upkeep and a majority of the washers and dryers are broken. This place is going downhill fast.

Zero stars because the manager didn’t do her job.
The washer and dryer machines are always broken but she increased the price????.
The pool is always dirty but she always increases the rent.
Not suitable for living????.

This place has cheap affordable rent but at price. Property management is very poor and really just does the bare minimum. I’ve been here for a while and noticed people moving out and empty apartments have stayed empty for a long time but not remodeled. Maintenance is bad. Just quick patch jobs. No communication between management and tenants even when water is being shut off. Super inconvenient and very inconsiderate of the manager.

This place has horrible management. It’s very hard to come in contact with the property manager and/or get maintenance to fix something. They give you a date, never show up and then don’t reach out to reschedule. Parking can be hard to find and the recent remodeling is very poorly done. Rent fluctuates and never stays the same. In the past year or so it has gone up and down twice. It a nice “in the meantime” place but a lot of people are moving out.

I had an appointment with Viviana to apply for an apartment that isn’t even listed yet. She called at the appointment time to inform me she leased it to someone else. 
we had been communicating for a couple weeks and had everything ready to put the deposit down months ahead of the available move in date. 
Extremely unsatisfied with the professionalism of the management. 
She claims she didn’t have my number but I had emailed her recently and had my number on there so she could have easily emailed me or found my number on there before I drove out. 
The complex looks nice and is in a convenient location, but beware of management.

Villa Morocco is located in an ideal part of La Mesa, close to shopping and restaurants. It is a multi dwelling complex composed of apartments, townhouses and duplexes. Check it out to see if it is a place you would want to live. It has worked out for me and my family for over ten years.
Management was very sweet and welcoming. Apartment had brand new appliances and nice hard wood flooring.
It’s been an overall better experience since the apartments were taken over by Greystar Company. The management team is much friendlier and approachable.

What can you ask for, this apartment is so convenient. It's right across the street from target, Michael, walmart, Costco and the freeway entrance is close by. I've lived in this apartment for 5 years now and have had no issues. When I needed something to get fix, the apartment manager and assistant mangers were always helpful. The apt is perfect for the price that we pay for and you won't find apt this cheap anywhere.

I would highly recommend this aparement complex. The property manager, Josie was a breath of fresh air and was so responsive to tenant needs/requests. The complex is kept up well and the neighbor's were friendly and quiet. If you are thinking of moving, this is a fantastic option!!

Lived here for 9 years. The sound proofing is great. Of all the neighbors we had over the years, we never had to complain about noisy neighbors. If you keep the windows closed, you can't hear the busy street and freeways nearby. 
We love the area and will miss living here. Lots of great local restaurants along with the usual chain stores right across the street. If you are a reliable renter and take care of your apartment, it is easy to live here comfortably for many years.

I lived there for 2 years. The community is safe and clean. Josie the manager goes far and beyond to help you and provides wonderful service. Maintenance team are very friendly people. They had a security team. Overall a very good experience.

This place was very conveniently located, very close to grocery stores (Albertsons, Trader Joe's, Target, Wal Mart), gas  stations, veterinarians, gyms, a park, the I-8 and highway 125, as well as Sharp Grossmont hospital. The complex is quiet, safe, and family friendly. Josie, the property manager was very nice and helpful, and was also lenient during one month of tough financial times for our family. She always answered our questions and was prompt whenever we had issues in the apartment (AC, clogged drain from hair, offered free light bulbs, and when the burners on our stove went out). She also was very knowledgeable of the area and offered advice when traveling throughout San Diego. The main complaint would be not enough parking! Often times if you're a resident, you may not get a spot as the visitors parking is not very clear/not enough. If there had been better parking, I would give a 5/5 rating. Otherwise, I would definitely live here again and recommend it to family and friends.

I've been living in this complex for 5 years with my family. The maintenance guy is professional and does everything on time. Josie, the office manager, is doing a fantastic job considering the fact that she is taking care of 170 apartments all by herself. Very professional, courteous and makes sure everything gets done. In all my years here I never had to wait for more than a day to get anything done. Very efficient operation. You can write an email with the request, it gets printed, solved and filed. 
 Landlord is great and paying for every service imaginable, from cleaning pools twice a week (whether people use it or not) to paying pest control people and having a full time gardener. In 5 years I haven't seen one rodent or cockroach in our apartment (I started thinking there are no cockroaches in San Diego, nice change from NYC apartments). Overall, nice, clean and quite place.

Have livefd here 2 years and apartments are very well kept. Prices are gd compared to other communitues.They have recently upgraded exterior look along with windows and pool area .Clubhouse is beautiful.Staff is friendly and prompt and always willing to assist your needs.Management is always willing to answer any questions and does her best in resolving issues I have addressed.In general: Great place,gd prices,friendly staff and best of all conveniently located .

Just moved out of the apartment after living there for a year and a half. Absolutely no complaints. Everything in the unit was brand new when I moved in, or seemed like it, down to stickers on the pantry shelves and plastic covering on the cupboard handles. The management team is friendly and professional, all notifications are posted on doors and emailed with at least 48 hours heads up. Can't attest to the maintenance team since I didn't have a single reason to call them... but in my mind that speaks for itself. Located between a fire station and a middle school, which, at least in my mind, serve as a deterrent for crime. Central location between San Diego proper and Kearny Mesa, traffic was a nonissue commuting into the city 5-6 days a week. The apartment common areas are being renovated, but very quietly, no disturbance noted at all. Just means you watch the complex get nicer and nicer with no disruptions.
Although this site says available soon, I was told nothing is coming available, and was then hung up on as I started to speak about what is being shown on the website!
I have been a resident for 10 years. The managers live on site. Not a lot of turnover.

Well maintained units with helpful staff.
Nice swimming pool and laundry

I have lived in this apartment for about 2 years now, it has been peaceful and quiet.  The only complaint I would have about this complex is that the walls are super thin, so your neighbors can hear basically anything what you are doing and vice versa.  Other than that, the laundry facility is good and the place is relatively close to the highway.

The moment I met the managers,Deena and Barbara, I knew that I would be well taken care of. I've lived at the Villa for a year and am well pleased with the complex. Neighbors are nice and respectful. I enjoy the residential area as opposed to where I originally lived for 18 years, North Park. But the deciding factor was definitely the on-site managers, Deena and Barbara. very dedicated and sweet. Thanks gals!??

I moved here about a year and half ago. As a work from home employee its important for me to live in a quite neighborhood. The property is by far the quietest complex I have ever lived in. At night the male assistant manager checks the parking lot, my assigned spot is never taken by someone else and I never have to worry about coming home with no where to park. This was a huge issue at my last complex and its nice to have the assigned and resident parking so well managed. I pay a fair price especially for San Diego. The recent upgrades were a little nuisance as far as noise goes but it has been worth now living in a nicer more updated place!

The manager is very rude and will tow your car even if you tell her you’ll be parked there for five minutes. She will harass you but when you ask for the actual company information to file a complaint she will ask why & refuse to give you any information. For all you looking to move into River Front, here are two things to keep in mind before inking your lease:

1. You are likely going to be on the hook for paying to repaint the entire apartment despite normal wear and tear. The language on the lease explicitly states that the tenants are not liable for being charged for “ordinary wear and tear”, yet we were still charged for painting charges.

When asked why we are receiving this charge, the manager simply stated “This work was necessary.” Furthermore he added, “Walls are not only painted for appearance. There are many types of substances and odors that permeate into your walls as you reside in the apartment. Particles from your cooking, skin oils from your hands, etc.” Do you expect your tenants to not cook or not touch the walls with their bare hands? 

Not sure about you but I would consider that regular wear and tear. 

Additionally, we were offered 2 accent walls at the time of move-in. It seems that River Front included the price of repainting these accent walls to our charge. On their contractor’s invoice it does not specifically leave out the 2 walls. All the invoice said was “2x2 bed, full paint.” I tried doing my due diligence by calling the painting contractor to verify River Front’s claim that they did not include the accent walls in the charge but their contractor's phone number on the invoice was disabled. 

River Front also provided an invoice for their last year’s paint job on my apartment with a different contractor so I called them as well. They mentioned that River Front simply orders to have their apartments repainted in full — not omitting any walls/accent walls from the paint job that is charged to the tenants. 

2. If you are moving in with a pet, and your pet has ONE (1) accident on the carpet in either bedroom, you will get charged for the replacement of carpets in BOTH bedrooms. River Front pulls back the carpet, checks the mat for any "accident" stains and will not hesitate to replace both carpets for consistency. I do not disagree with this charge, although this is a fair warning for all pet owners. 

TIP: Ensure that you ask for photos of the carpet under mat/padding condition from RIGHT BEFORE your move in to avoid any false charges.

It was unfortunate to leave River Front with a bad taste in my mouth. I’m sure that I’m not the only one to get wrongfully charged for ordinary wear and tear - which makes me wonder how many people they have nickle and dimed.

Their justification was that, after me living there for 8 months, they needed to replace the carpet in the entire apartment and repaint all the walls. In 20 years of renting, I've never not gotten my entire security deposit back, because I always leave my apartment in a good state. (Ex, I once lived in an apartment where part of the carpet had gotten quite dirty due to foot traffic, so I paid someone to shampoo it twice, and it came out perfectly clean.) This is the third point you should be aware of before making your decision to move in at this location.
