Our last place would have resolved these issues within the week. We will 100% not be renewing our lease.
Tows your car, even if your a resident and registered in their system.

We love living here at Avion! The leasing team is amazing! Anthony and Donovan are super sweet always asking if we need anything. We have lived here almost two years now and have enjoyed it! Super safe community where you can walk your dog at night and not worry. The Maintenance team is great they are so on top of it, the same day you have an issue they come in and fix it. We love all the Facility Amenities, you can tell that they take great pride in their community. Every single morning they are cleaning the property, landscaping, and always making improvements to make it a wonderful place to call home.

Overall disappointing. We moved here 5 months ago the apartment is actually nice even if the appliances are cheap and not new. However the apartment overall Is decent and nice. What is not working is the manager office. Recently they changed the ownership of the property and with that they also changed the manager. Let's not talk about the fact that I have a disability and I must have an emotional support dog, the manager she made it so hard that I almost felt discriminated. Let's not talk about the fact that she asked me papers and documents that are not required by the federal law for people with disabilities. The problem Is that when you walked in that office feels like they are doing a favor to make you stay here when the truth is, without us tenets, they won't have a job. The problem is that they need to change their attitude cause right across the street they just finished several new condos much nicer than this one all new, and happens that the people who works there they really make you feel welcomed. I guess they did understand how it works. Who wants to stay in a place as expensive as all the new other places when you feel like that you are not welcomed ? The new management needs to remember that we can choose among many places much better than this, and they should be grateful of our business. To end this review I'd like to remind to them and to all, the first rule of marketing : takes years to build up a good reputation but it's takes an hour to destroy it

I've never lived in such a beautiful apartment complex before. Not only are the newly renovated rooms breathtaking but so is the entire complex! it's great to be able to sit under the cabanas at the pool on a nice day and watch tv on one of the many flat screens provided! I never hear loud noises from neighbors, and the staff is always there to help when you need it! it's been almost a vacation living here!

Avion at Spectrum is clean and quiet.  The property is beautiful and the location is perfect for "seclusion" in the heart of San Diego even though shops, restaurants and other attractions are very close by-some even walking distance.

This is the best place that we've ever lived. The grounds are well kept, there are loads of amenities, and the office staff is mostly nice and friendly.
Everything is modern and upgraded and the room sizes are fairly large compared to comparable apartments.  The walls seem thicker than other areas in San Diego, it's rare to hear neighbors on either side.  If I had to be picky, the only downsides are no elevators which make moving in and out difficult and the trees in the parking lot tend to shed quite a bit on all the vehicles parked unless they're under cover.  These are very minor annoyances, we love the place.

We have been living in our apartment for almost 2 years now. I have to say that this has been my favorite complex in San Diego. The amenities are well maintained, staff is very friendly and accommodating. One complaint I do have would be a standard apartment problem which would be hearing your upstairs neighbors walking around. We can't hear neighbors conversations beside us though so that is great!. There is a very convenient park across the street. However, if you have small children it can be annoying that dogs are off leashes (its a city park, so there's not much Domain can do about that except maybe complain to the city?) Our unit is spacious, open and overall very pleasant to be in. Domain has really made this experience a great one! We really appreciate them being prompt with all service requests and communication with them is never a hassle. We have a young child so safety is definitely at the top of our list, this neighborhood is great, plenty of great places to eat, grocery stores, close freeway access, safe to walk around, underground parking. The price is a little bit higher than we would like, but coming from a couple places with pest problems, building issues and less than stellar staff to work with we will take Domain any day!

I love my apartment! It's in a great area and has easy access to freeways. There are a lot of great restaurants and shops within walking distance. I often walk my dogs to the nearby park where all my other neighbors and their dogs hang out as well. The amenities are amazing! The gym is nice and clean and I use it all the time. The pool area is absolutely beautiful and I'm down there all the time. The unit itself is really nice too. It's spacious and has lots of closets and storage space. I love having a washer and dryer in-unit because it makes things a lot easier. I hope to live here for as long as I possibly can!
This is a good apartment complex that has good grounds and is very centralized to everything without it being in a busy downtown area.
Gated community with lots of families, very quiet at night with nice walls so we don't hear the neighbors. Lot's of amenities, good gym, very nice with a great exterior and lots of green.

The apartments are spacious and the grounds are well maintained. Appliances are older in my unit but from what I understand they are trying to update those (washer, dryer, fridge, etc.) as apartments become available.

If you’re looking for a great place to walk or run in your neighborhood, I have the perfect place for you. Avion at Spectrum is just that place.  It is miles of paved sidewalks and two green lush parks. The area is all industrial and corporate offices.  Very safe to walk, run or even ride your bike.  You will also see lots of private security in the area for the corporate offices.  
If you have kids or pets, the area has two nice parks to play at. One park is across the street and has lots of tables and bbq grills.  In the evening, you will find lots of people out with their dogs and families socializing. It is a wonderful community. 
In addition to all the great walking area, you find easy access to all the major freeways.  The area is close to downtown San Diego and the airport.  When out of town guest arrive, the apartment has a couple of apartments you can rent for your guest or down the block is hotel, within walking distance from the apartment. 
Lastly, if you’re wondering where to eat or shop, don’t worry.  Everything is within walking distance or down the street; several steak and burger places and local bars around the corner.  
This location is really very idol. Hope you will find this area your next home, as I have for the past seven years.  I can’t imagine living anywhere else.   See you at the park!

The Avion at Spectrum apartments are awesome! The complex is tucked away in a business park in Kearny Mesa that is both quiet and peaceful. It's close to Convoy and the 163 North and South freeways. The apartments are newer and each have their own washer and dryer. All of the neighbors that I've bumped into are respectful and quiet. The pool, hot tub and gym facilities are well kept up. I would highly recommend this complex to anyone looking in the Kearny Mesa area.

I have lived here for almost 7 years.  I always say that I live close enough to downtown San Diego to have fun but far away from the noise and congestion of downtown.  The Golden Hill area is working hard to improve the neighborhood.  There are new restaurants and even a farmers market on weekends.

Quiet neighborhood, Friendly staff, Clean community, and access to all the shops you need. 
We've been moved recently and we have experienced other properties, This is something we can call home

The apartments and property are decent and fairly well maintained, but overpriced for basic apartment living. Good location near lots of stores.  Unfortunately, there is a lot of noise and there does not appear to an effort to do anything about reducing the amount of noise here.  Trash trucks, cars with modified exhaust systems to increase the noise of their cars, landscaping crews with leaf blowers and other gas powered equipment are a constant.  Unfortunately, there does not seem to be any effort to reduce the excessive noise so it's hard to give this place a higher rating.

Jefferson at Carmel Mountain sits in a prime location ! You can get to most areas of SD within 20mins. More importantly within 2 or 3 minutes is everything you could ever need as far as shopping or eating out! I looked at over 20 apartments when moving to this area and Jefferson was by far the best bang for my buck. The units are very nice, large and updated interiors. The grounds are very well kept, the pool is fantastic and the management is great and very accommodating. I have nothing but good things to say about this place.

Awful. If you wanna live somewhere where they just don’t care about communication, simple things like auto responders aren’t a thing, when you have an issue, there’s no communication on updates and they called themselves luxury. this is the place for you.
Top notch well designed apartments with great amenities but average maintenance responsiveness.

I love my unit and the area but I wish they would have inspected my apartment before moving in and did a better job with my move in experience. being advertised as a luxury apartment I should have had a better experience moving in.

Ariva is in a great location if one can afford the rent.  
Ariva imposes amenities that the residents generally don’t care about and charge for those services.  The free Kamucha is not free anymore except for one day in a week.  Parking used to be free, but not anymore.  They charge exorbitantly for trash and other services like water.

After my husband and I scheduled a tour and confirmed the time and date . We flew from Denver Colorado to go apartment hunting for one day in San Diego . We arrived to Ariva to our scheduled appointment, no one opened the door , we left multiple voicemails and called numerous of times and we never received a call back. We ending up just leaving after waiting outside for an entire hour . It has been a week and we have yet to receive a call back or at least an email . This place is unprofessional, unreliable. As a military family that is used to house hunt and move from state to state this has been by far the worst experience with an apartment complex. Do yourself a favor and stay away !!
Love this complex. Small and friendly. Definitely recommend it.

This building was built extremely poorly—you hear everything. Every cabinet slam, drawer slam, footsteps above you, tv’s vibrating through the walls at all hours, etc. It’s CONSTANT and there is no solution from management. For the price, you can easily find a quieter place in the area with better construction. I really wish I had seen a review like this before signing a lease.
Av8 made my move to San Diego so easy. Virtual tours, online application were so helpful. Leasing staff Dondi and manager Chase are very communicative and friendly which made the process smooth.

Lived here for almost 5 years. I do not recommend the building. It’s poorly built and the unit features are subpar. They might look nice when you tour but trust me go look someone else. There are newer buildings with better amenities in the area that cost around the same.
I had a great experience moving in.  AV8 is a comfortable place to live.  The management team is professional and very helpful, approachable and friendly.  I am so happy with my choice.

Great location and modern updated units. I especially love the in-unit W/D and central AC. The parking included is also a major plus. I have an EV and I was able to get a parking spot with an EV charging unit. Also a very dog friendly property, which is a big plus for me and my pup!
Great location, staff is very friendly and helpful. Beautiful apartments and a great rooftop and gym. Parking is included which is a great perk as well.
The family area is excellent, especially the office management

I love living in Rancho Villas Apt, Rancho Penasquitos.  This has been our home in almost a decade now, that's how much we love this place.  I truly believe that there are no other apartments can compare to what we've experienced so far at Rancho Villas.  Such a friendly and welcoming staff as well as their maintenance team, safe neighborhood with a clean surrounding property.  Office staff is always open to help and understanding and the ground keepers are quick to provide services within the property's needs.  The entire community acknowledge each other and associates to voice or collaborate on any current events happening in the neighborhood. The property is close by local markets and shopping centers, easy and accessible to freeways.  This place has been a great place to live, great location, welcoming staff and friendly tenants.  Thank you Rancho Villas Apts!

I have lived for almost 3 years and I loved it here. The manager team really care for you, they come right away the same day if you had any problems. They always keep the ground and surrounding areas clean. The swimming is a plus. They remodeled everything brand new from the vinyl floor, carpet floor to the fixtures in the bathrooms when I moved in. The manager is always nice, courtesy and professional. Mr.Ye the supervisor of the maintenance team is always there for any of your questions. It is also nice that they have an Appliance Tech lives onsite for any of your appliances needs. When I looked for the place to live and for my kids to go school I chose it here. You have Canyon View Elementary school, Mesa Verde Middle school  and then 10/10 West view High school, all those 3 schools have the scores of 9/10 and that is very important to me. I would recommend this place to any one I know.

We are living here more than 14 years.
It is really nice place. People, who works here so professional and very kind and friendly.
Our apartment was completely renovated last year and looks beautiful.
I totally recommend anyone this place.  
Yelena Lipkina & family.

I have lived here for two years, it is a great complex that has a family friendly community feel. The manager and maintenance staff all know everyone's names and everything is well maintained and clean. Any issues that arise they take care of immediately. The apartments are well cared for with some nice features like roomy balconies and nice kitchens. Apartments are safe and you can tell the staff and owners care about the property and tenants.

The Rancho Villas are a great apartment complex located in a great area. There is a lot to do in the surrounding area with many great places for food and shopping all around. The apartments themselves are so clean and visually appealing, with everything in them working great from the very start. The grounds and facilities are always so well kept and clean, the entire staff does a tremendous job daily. The manager is great! She is always so attentive and quick to respond to anything that may arise, definitely the best manager I have ever had. All in all I have enjoyed my time living at the Rancho Villas very much, they are a great complex in a great area with great a great manager and somewhere I would recommend to anyone in the market for a home.

Good location, in San Diego. Lots of restaurants, bars, stores less than two blocks away. Good transportation system.
Bad parking options. Management is not too responsive. It will take you more than two months to solve something with them.

Location, location, location! Wonderful family owned stores around and my neighbors have been some of the best people I've met. Maintenance  and staff are always helpful and very responsive. Pet friendly building was a huge plus for us.

Amazing location for everything and if you have pets. It was exciting to move into a new building and yes there was some hiccups but the team has been great to work with. The manager has gotten everything resolved and very quickly too.

Can't be this Hillcrest location however despite being brand new building, the quality of construction is terrible.  Floors 3 & above have wood framing in between floors and you here every step that your neighbors above take.  The front doors to each unit do not block hallway noise.  For instance, I can neighbor's dog who is 4 doors down from me.  Walking down the hall, you can hear not just neighbors conversations crystal clear, but also their bedroom activities.  The appliances are very cheap and inefficient.  Its nice having an in-unit W/D however is sounds like a train coming through your apartment.  I cannot run laundry while during the day while on Zoom calls. This leads to higher utility bills.

They are shady with how they operate and will try to con you out of as much money as possible. Good luck with parking and keeping your hard earned property, your car, safe from damage because the parking spots are impossible to get in and out of if you have someone next to you. Expect for your car to be hit and dinged up by the first month of being there. Neighbors are noisy and inconsiderate almost everywhere from what I’ve heard and experienced. People do not follow leash regulations and will glare at you if their dog acts up and tries to take off after your dog while it’s doing its business. They charged us a ridiculous price on move out and didn’t do a walkthrough with me as discussed so I couldn’t point out what their maintenance team messed up while working in the unit, so it got pinned on us. Didn’t even attempt to talk to me about anything before sending the bill. Just don’t do it. You can find a much better place with actual parking spots and a management team that cares elsewhere for waaaay cheaper and more room.

Office staff was pretty nice, no problem there.  They raised the rent $250/mo in 2 years.  They offer nice deals to potential tenants and make up for it at the expense existing ones, which is a bad look.  I had a 2br/2bath unit and ended up finding a 3br in the same area with a garage and storage.  Unit is 2x the size and rent is the same.  Office called to re-negotiate rent 5 days my lease ended, I'd already given my 30 days notice.  Perhaps it'd be better to try and retain people when they give their notice next time.      

The parking situation is a nightmare.  Enforcement was inconsistent and the policies made no sense.  A family member came from out of town and parked in a marked visitor space.  Apt requires a permit anyway and before I could walk to the office to print one their rental car was towed.  Completely unacceptable practice, you don't treat people that way.

Maintenance was inconsistent.  My unit had old worn out appliances (oven preheat indicator didn't work, fridge/freezer wouldn't seal correctly when closing the doors, washer would tear up clothes occasionally), fixtures that were sloppily attached to their surfaces(bathroom fan/vent covers came off, plug in sink was loose/broken, towel racks and tp racks loose), and other small issues (persistent smoke detector issues) that weren't properly fixed to the point where I just gave up.  Called maintenance multiple times without receiving service. 

The laissez-faire approach to major projects within the complex was problem.  We were given a couple days notice for a re-piping project that took weeks to complete.  Later the complex was upgrading a water line and told us the night before that the complex wouldn't for a day.  The rushed planning resulted in no water service for two straight days.  My family had to use the restrooms at Ralph's for a couple days and stayed in a hotel so my wife and kids could shower before work and school.  Office provided no help or accommodations for their mistake, it was really bad.

Looks nice, seems nice, but they’re not nice. Not worth the price, will charge you for everything when you move out. If you don’t have hardwood you WILL pay to replace the carpet regardless(the entire apartment, i might add. Even if the bedrooms are spotless, due to “color matching”). They don’t understand what wear and tear is, even when they repaved the parking lot two times during your lease. They expect you to pay to have it steam cleaned prior to move out. Truly was not worth the headache. Much better higher quality apartments nearby. Big companies like this one don’t care about you, just about how much money they willl make off of you, upgrade their apartment at your expense.

I had to relocate to San Diego for work and this seemed like the perfect place. It is in the perfect location and the apartment they showed me was cute, so I made the terrible mistake of signing a lease. It has been an awful experience. The neighbors are very loud late at night and no matter how many times I've spoken to the leasing office the noise continues. There is very little insulation and the windows are very cheap panes of glass, so there is constant traffic noise. The appliances are old and cheap. The oven barely works. The parking is a nightmare. I can't get in and out of my space if people park on both sides of my car. There is only one, maybe two people in the leasing office that are pleasant to deal with. The rest either don't care or are very rude. Avoid this place at all costs.

The apartments are of decent quality at a fair price for the Carmel Mountain area of San Diego. The neighbors are quit and the location of the apartments are in a family friendly location directly across the street from shops and restaurants. My unit's balcony faces the west with mountain views. Each evening, weather permitting, I am graced with a beautifully painted, sunset sky. Sometimes one can even see hot air balloons creeping over the top of the mountain :)

The downside, however, is the parking situation. Each unit is allotted on assigned carport space; if you own another vehicle you receive a parking permit to park in the open parking. These open spots are VERY small and leave little room between vehicles. Each time I park I have to squeeze myself out of the car. Not to mention, parking fills up fast and it is a race against time to get home and grab a spot :(
Very expensive area.  Lots of shops and restaurants nearby.  Public transportation nearby.  Typical amenities.  Pet friendly.  Dog park.

No notice on utilities charges increasing, $ 58/month for trash for 1 person, $20-30/ month for water and sewer, $ 3 for pest control, expect your electricity to run from $100-$200/month for one person with basic appliances and not working from home. If you used the website autopay, there is also convenience fee charges.

Rusty appliances, old/falling apart finishings, old rundown carpet in the hallways.

No Centralized AC or AC period

Elevator, Garage parking gate, Washer/Dryer takes turns in being broken and there is no urgency in repairs, sometimes takes a few days and sometimes a few weeks.

Only 3 washers and 3 dryers for the whole building

Never ending construction work in and around the building

Very noisy and dirty surrounding

Most tenants have experienced being stolen from parking in the car garage and storing stuff in the car garage due to unmaintained fence or the garage being broken and would not closed

no security camera, just gate code and garage code that never gets changed.

Onsite manager is only available in person on tuesdays/thursdays, maintenance is only during tuesdays and thursdays from 1pm to 5pm.

I've been a resident for about 5 months now. Management is cool, friendly and very helpful. I have no complaints about the place thus far. All of my needs have been met and I really enjoy the place, it's relaxing, peaceful, inviting and feels like home. 
The only improvement I would say the property could make is to be more vigilant/responsive to making any needed repairs etc. other than that, everything is great. Great location, great amenities, and overall great atmosphere. Thanks so far, I hope things continue to be this nice and they don't start doing what typical properties start doing, jacking up the rent (more than it already is), degrading service etc. We'll see. 

Thank you Olympus Corsair Office Management

Cars keep getting broken into and nothing has really been done to curb them. I had nothing in my car to steal, but my window was still busted in and I was out hundreds of dollars. Management just tells you that you sign away and acknowledge their lack of liability for your car when you sign your lease. The place looks nice but it does the minimum to ensure resident safety.

This place is like 5 stars Hotel except it is daily use and the style is off the chart amazing. The service is great, the level of care for costumers is beyond 5 starts. The best things in this place is the things you can use while staying here. The best gym, good quality, can find all the necessary equipment for full body workout and even better for fitness. The pool view is breath taking and stunning, the jakozi is perfect for after an intense gym. Massaging the body with clean and salted water which makes the muscles  relax and cleanse up. Besides the great service and the gym along with the pool, there is a club house that can be rented for family occasions, big, classy, clean and stylish room. Besides the excellent utilities then location is near everything you need from markets to restaurants to cosco groceries etc...
Lastly OLYMPUS creates fun events to socialize the people and make the environment more friendly for everyone.

I move into Broadstone Corsair Oct 20th and I couldn't be more excited. The application process has been great and the staff at the Broadstone Corsair have been beyond helpful. Everything from sending in the application to signing up for the utilities etc have been a breeze. I have received a couple emails from Broadstone with upcoming events that they are hosting and I cannot wait to participate. Thank You Broadstone for making my move across the country easy!
Still getting out the glitches of a new facility. Finding construction was not quality but it is nice being the first ever resident in my apartment.

I have rented quite a few apartments but this will be my 1st review. Broadstone Corsair has exceeded my expectations from the application process to the day of move-in.  Simon, the sales associate was knowledgeable and available for questions. I was able to view the exact apartment I selected prior to moving. Broadstone Corsair has all the amenities I look for in an apartment home; in-home washer/dryer unit, garage, private balcony, and fitness center. The management team also hosts events for residents. I hope to have many more pleasant experiences while residing at Broadstone Corsair.

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: Summer Brook was the absolute worse place we’ve lived.  I don’t even know where to start.  Laundry rooms are not well maintained or cleaned.  I’ve had many pieces of clothing due to left over bleach on machines.  The machines require a pay per use card.  The machines to purchase cards and add money never work or do not have cards to disburse for new users.  The laundry rooms are always full and people leave their clothes in the machine long after cycles have finished.  The worst part of this complex is the apartment has termites. We reported it and had multiple instances.  The unit wasn’t fumigate.  The pest control company came and sprayed the ceiling where the termites were falling from the ceiling onto sour bed.  This place is an absolute mess and cost too much for what you get.  Also this place has no air conditioning.  Find somewhere else to live.  You won’t be sorry.

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: If I could give it a zero I would. My clothes got stolen today while doing laundry; I tell the manager and all she does is give me a dumb found look basically saying there’s nothing she can do about it. Nobody is much help here other than the maintenance guy. These apartments are absolutely a waste of money. Don’t bother.

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: Too many tenants that do not clean up after their dogs. Tenants do not know how to properly dispose of their trash into the trash cans

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: Es un lugar muy comodo, se siente seguro a cualquier hora. y sus areas comunes siempre estan limpias.

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: Definitivamente lo recomendaria por que sus areas son limpias, el lugar es muy agradable y se ve que su mantenimiento es el adecuado. luce seguro y confiable.

apartmentName: Summer Brook Apartments: Your Oasis of Com...
review: Summer Brook is a relatively quiet and healthy place for families to live in. It is easily accessible from the I-5 and the I-905. There is a 7-11 Store that is a 5-minute walk away.

Cars get broken into ALL THE TIME. Nothing has been done. Elevators smell like dog pee. Rent keeps going up and now with the new management it has went up even higher! The appliances are old and the kitchen cabinets need to be remodeled their falling apart. Parking is tight and limited.

I've been a resident here since 8/8/20, and I've been killing ants on a daily basis ever since.  Sometimes I have to kill 5, sometimes I have to kill 50, but on nights like tonight, I have to kill 500. 

We are not slobs.  We are on the 4th floor.  These ants have a long ways to get to us, and if a bag of dog food somehow pops open, or if we prefer to rely on fresh air for the sake of a lower electric bill, then we have to stop whatever we're doing and treat the area.

The leasing office has offered to spray for us, but taking our pets out of the apartment for several hours is a nearly impossible task for us, and not for nothing, this place should have been properly treated before I acquired the keys.

I am miserable here.  I am paying the highest I've ever paid in rent, to live in a building with the worst infestation I've ever seen, and to make matters worse, I can't use hand-held shower heads in the bathrooms, because the building relies on dated pipes that easily cause leaks.  My girlfriend has special needs, and because of this issue, she struggles in the shower.

We are already looking at other apartments, and August of 2021 can't come fast enough.

I still live here and waiting to move out.

My car was broken into, I have the police report. 5 other cars were broken into the same day. The property manager said it was a resident, and they knew who it was, but they didn't do anything about it.

The elevators smell really bad. They fired the super and now it smells worst. The new replacement super/maintenance is not really attentive to the property. There was blood on the stairs and you can tell they just tried to bleach it out, so now there's bright spots on the stairs.

This place is not secure at all. They are unable to change the gate code because its broken, so whoever has ever had delivery, or lived here since ever can get in. Also the buzzer doesnt work, so they have names on the buzzer door from residents from 5 years ago. 

It's overpriced, carpets in the units are old, there's water damage everywhere. 

I wish I could post photos in here so you can see what the living condition looks like. Since I still live here, I'll even give you a property tour so you can see exactly what I'm looking at.

I would suggest not moving here. They hired a new property manager, but its a revolving door. The ones that work here don't care enough for you in the long run, they're just waiting for another job.

I have been a resident for nearly 4 years at Fashion Terrace Apts.  The location is exceptional in terms of freeways, malls, and hospitals.  A secured garage and building helps me to feel safe in my living space.

I just moved in 3 months ago and so far I am happy with my move.  The Manager is friendly and proactive.  Maintenance is always taken care of right away and the maintenance staff is always kind and courteous.  I haven't had any real maintenance issues.  Most places these days have a water and sewage fee.  Mine is only $26 a month and I have not seen anyone taking advantage of the water.  Maybe to rinse their feet after going to the beach but it does water the plants so its a win win situation. My neighbors are great and I have already made a few new friends.   Everything is in walking distance.  The beach, restaurant's and great music!   I would definitely refer Seacoast Apartments.

We just got a new apartment manager, after not having a manager for several months.  The old apartment manager was AWESOME - that's why it used to be better.  The new one is okay so far.  

Rent keeps going up, and they charge for water now.  Which is super annoying because people use the hoses to hose down themselves and their surfboards, wasting a ton of water, but then I get charged for that.  (They take the total cost of water for the entire building, then divide that by the number of tenants, and you pay the amount for however many tenants are in your apartment.)  I use very, very little water (even take showers at the gym), so it bothers me that I have to pay for all the water the people who live here waste.

It's generally quiet, but there are some loud tenants now (since the old apartment manager left).  

Repairs are always made right away, at least.

Friendly clean close to Ralph's grocery store 
Caring neighbors

Well we just moved into this apartment complex overall they're okay I would rated 7 out of 10. The best part of this apartment would be the balcony it's a very large the downside is this is a gated community apartment complex but they are a few apartments on the outside of the gate which I happen to get one so no security for me,also it is very noisy since it is on a busy main street.

I have lived here for about 2 1/2 years. I have had a wonderful experience staying here. Most of the time it's very quiet and the neighbors are very friendly.  The apartment is also located across the street from Ralph's store which is very convenient
I have enjoyed living here. For the most part very nice. The managers also are very nice.

Awesome apartment 2 bedrooms 2 bath with fireplace comes with a pool, spa and racquetball court . For $1378 can't beat that with a stick. The 2 ladies that runs the apartment complex awesome customer service.??????????????????????

North Bonita racquet club apartments overall there decent seven  and a half out of it and I give it out of ten, the only downfall is that it's on a very busy street,so if  you have and outside apartment, like me   ,plus no security as well for the outside guys even though it is a gated apartment complex

This place does not care about its tenants, just money! They have raised our rent and are renting apartments nearly double what the previous owner charged for a worse product.  We have constant leaks, cockroaches, and an overall lack of safety on this property.  Obviously, the word got out that this place is awful because half the complex is empty, and people always leave.  Really sad that this is how this beautiful, charming complex turned into completely overpriced garbage with awful management.    They are lucky that I am not going to go into detail about some of the awful things they have done to us residents since they took over.

I have lived here for a couple of months and this place is the worse place to live. There’s so many things wrong with it I don’t know where to start. First is that we don’t get mail. They closed it months so say goodbye to whatever mail your suppose to get. The gate doesn’t work so homeless people come in and out and its really making me feel unsafe. There are cockroaches everywhere. I talked to them about getting pest control but they did not show up twice. Finally they came once and I got one spray but they are still everywhere. They really only care about money and there’s women that works in the office that super rude. Do yourself a favor and run from this place!

Called and scheduled a tour, they then sent email to confirm my tour. Showed up and girl in the office said they have no idea what Im talking about when I just called them and hour before. Waste of my time.

ever since the new management started this place has gone downhill. they have been giving us new rules, new contracts, raising our rent, making utilites an additional cost since the second they took over. super upset about this place. it was such a hidden gem in san diego.

I recently toured and moved into an apartment here.  My apartment is completely upgraded with modern flooring and brand new appliances.  I was skeptical about visiting here after reading some of the reviews, but have had nothing but a wonderful experience here.  I had small maintenance issues with my shower and had them immediately taken care of after calling the office.  The manager was very nice and helpful when I was touring as well.  She addressed my concerned regarding other reviews and made me feel comfortable moving in here.  So far, I have not had any complaints and have had any issues addressed very quickly.   It’s been about a month and a half now and really have enjoyed my stay here.

My daughter and I moved to Mission Knolls 2 years ago from a recommendation by a close friend.  I previously lived in Carmel Valley relocated after getting a job in Downtown San Diego.  So far my experience here has been very peaceful.  I have had no problems in my apartment and we feel very safe living here.  Although I haven't spent much time here during the day the complex is very well maintained and is kept very clean.  I've reached out to management a few times regarding small things like getting a new mailbox key and the manager was very receptive to my request.  I am very pleased with living here, especially because I am getting married soon and we are trying to save up for a house.

I give this a second star for location only.  I've lived in this complex for almost three years.  We moved here because of location and proximity to our daughters' school at a time during covid when there we hardly no vacancies anywhere.  During our time here we've encountered the following:
-Unbelievable noise with garbage trucks at 7am multiple days per week (over 75db ive measured)
-Constant construction noise from endless remodellng  
-Construction workers roaming halls 
-No security cams at complex in garages, nor common areas yet they offer Airbnb of their units??
-One EV charger per building (it's 2025)
