The staff are not the most responsive or easiest to get ahold of which is disappointing. Parking can be a problem and your fellow tenants are not the most courteous with their trash or picking up after their pets. Lots of pet owners in this complex.  Decent place but you can do much better and get more bang for your buck.

As first time apartment renters .. I was not impressed. Management functions poorly (lack of communication causes inconveniences, etc.). I don't like how maintenance disregards your time request for service and they just walk in if you don't answer the door w.in a few knocks. Rent is expensive and there is not much to offer (wish there was a pool table or something in club house). There is a nice trail behind the apartments but the weight room, business office and pool are mediocre. They claim to have a dog park but its really just an open field.

Great apartment complex, living conditions, and staff. The only issue is I'd like to see more amenities for children in the complex e.g basketball area, swingsets. Also, a billiard area in the clubhouse would be nice! Overall, I'm excited about this new chapter of residing in these quarters!

I've always enjoyed living here and often find it's the best deal when it comes to price vs space in the area which is what's kept us here when it's time to renew. But things have changed. Our building is more rundown than ever and while I could make a list of things the main reason you won't want to live here is the elevators are constantly breaking down. They were 99% reliable up until the middle of last year when it broke down for the first time and was out about a month. Since then it's been non stop frustration. The elevator company will fix it on a Monday, it'll be down 3 days later. Over and over for about 9+ months now. If you plan to live on anything but the 1st floor, avoid this complex. I was told it was just our building and took a walk asking neighbors I ran into around the complex; it's every building. Move here to an upper floor and you'll be stuck carrying groceries up every time you buy them. Fedex will refuse to deliver packages up if they're too heavy or leave them on the 1st floor or in some cases you'll catch them slamming your packages at your door in frustration they had to carry them up. Moving in or out? Good luck, expect to have to move everything up or down without the elevator. I'm on this site because we're looking at moving out and while we were fortunate to have the elevators working when we moved in, I dread having to carry our heavy furniture down without them. You've been warned.

Tiffany, Patience, Crystal, Sam, Don and everyone else are very kind and professional, even under the scary stress related to the pandemic. The apartments are lovely, and so is the setting. Our homes have high ceilings, faux wood flooring, new fixtures, ample space, and there are also some lovely views of the big Texas sky, our green space, and the stylish homes and apartment complexes nestled in the hills. There is a gym (open now) a pool, gas grills, and a large dog park. There are two beautiful walking trails just down the road. Migrating songbirds, butterflies, occasional families of wild turkeys all visit us. Coyotes howl in the evenings and the cicadas sing us to sleep. The flocks of Turkey Vultures that roost on the electrical wires are fascinating to watch, as well, even though they are a little creepy. You will love it here! Marquis at Crown Ridge is a special community of people.

I recently moved in about a month ago.  The office staff is great!  The leasing girl Giselle was very professional she went above and beyond by helping us find movers.  I would recommend this place to all my friends.  Everyone seems to be very friendly.  My work order was done the same day I called it in.  Keep up the good work!

These apartments are perfect if you want a quiet place to live. They are tucked back into the beautiful San Antonio hill country. Just a 5 minute drive to i10 and 1604. The management is very kind and helpful when needed. The one thing I would recommend for these apartments is a valet trash service. The dumpsters are not the closest and are pretty full most of the time. I love living here and recommend it to others all of the time!

I love living here! The price is right especially where it's located. It's so close to the country but still close enough to the Rim. The people at the office are so helpful! Of course the construction is terrible but there's construction going on all over the city.
Quality has really gone down since the new manager took over

This is an awesome community.  I lived here twice in 5 years.  I signed my original lease in 2012 and moved out 2014 to live in another community.  I couldn't wait to move back to the Vintage in 2015.  The staff is courteous, responsive, and consistent.  They treat you like family.  They invest in their tenets and their property is well maintained.   Live here and you will feel at home, safe, and secure.

Wonderful! Been here two years. Good value for a Class A apartment. Beautiful surroundings and cheerful magament and maintainence guys (James and George). Parking garage is so convenient. Wouldn't want to live anywhere else.
I love this community!  From the friendly staff to the parking garage to the brand new fitness equipment they've installed in the gym.  The Vintage has been a great place to live.

Hallways are Dirty smell like urine , trash people half do their job , cars being broken into and stolen apartment property manager is unprofessional and shows no empathy to his tenants , AC doesn’t work during the summer and your bill will be outrageously high. Straight up 0!!!

I love living here! The property grounds are awesome. For the most part its quiet. Kids are outside playing alot but i dont think thats a bad thing. This is a great and peaceful apartment complex with a Walmart down the street and a gas station down the other. Amenities include three pools (two at the main center and one more into the complex, convenient for residents who live further into the complex and don't want to take a long trip to beat the heat!), a gym (with about 5 treadmills, 5 stationary bikes, 5 elliptical, and two weight equipment), a business center, play room, indoor basketball court, party center, small trail and dog park, playground, and tennis/volleyball courtyard. Apartments are located about 7 miles from convenient shopping center. Neighbors are friendly and not abrupt. Overall good place to reside, only reason it did not get that last star is because recent insect issues (outside, not inside the apartment!).

We absolutely love the location, comedies,and the neighbor's. We are so happy living here. Our children love the swimming pools, it's like if we were living in a vacation resort home. My daughter had open heart surgery this year at 4 months old and all the hospital is close by. We are so happy living here, it is our home.

I've lived at the Villas in Westover Hills since 2013 - I was one of the first to live here so I've seen the property from construction to completion and everything in between. The leasing staff is friendly and remember you by name when you stop by. The property has a lot going for it: 

*assigned covered parking for garden apartment residents and unassigned garage parking for mid-rise apartment residents
*better than average clubhouse including fully equipped gym, sauna, hot tub, racquetball court, and basketball court

The pool is great and available until 11 PM everyday. Valet trash is also included. The covered/garage parking and location are my favorite perks of this property. Also, the maintenance staff does a good job of responding to maintenance requests in a timely manner considering the size of this community. My only complaint here is that you sometimes have to make follow-up requests to ensure maintenance is properly completed, but this is a similar experience I've had at lots of rental properties. 

I would recommend the Villas to anyone that wants to live in Westover Hills. The rent is expensive but so are all apartments in northwest San Antonio. This is currently the fastest growing area of the city with the highest rent rates. Considering the perks, the Villas is worth the price tag.

I’ve lived at this place for about three months and have had a few issues, which I’ll address in turn.

Noise - you can hear footsteps from upstairs neighbors VERY clearly. It keeps my wife and me up at night. Made two noise complaints so far.

Apartment - the apartments look very nice, but they seemed to have been repainted by the lowest bidder, as there are drops of paint on the wood floors, on doorknobs, on the granite countertops, and around the trim at the base of the wall. There is also a small hole in the wall under our light fixture in the master bathroom. Moreover, the outlets are all crooked, and appear to be the result of some very sloppy, rushed rehab work.

Bathrooms - there seems to be a peculiar plumbing issue that causes a smell of sewage when flushing the toilet. However, we did notice that the smell was not as persistent after our noisy upstairs neighbors moved in. Go figure.

Bedrooms - my wife and I leased a two bedroom apartment. The master bedroom where my wife and I sleep is consistently the hottest room in the unit. 

Parking - guest parking is about 40 spaces total. For the entire apartment. If your guest parks elsewhere, they will have the car towed. There is a parking garage in which residents can park, but due to the poor structure, water still leaks through. The resulting spots on your car comprised of dirt/concrete take weeks to come off, making garage parking undesirable.

Gates - secondary gate is broken 90% of the time. 

Conclusion - if you can handle the noise from upstairs neighbors, then honestly this may be a decent place for you to live (disregarding the other annoyances). However, if peace and quiet are important to you, as well as a real luxury feel, I would advise against moving to Landmark Grandview.

this place is truly a dangerous place to live. Other than the things listed in the title, the maintainance is inadequate.  The cabinets throughout the apartment are falling apart. This is our first apartment and everything about this environment is welcoming. The scenery is just outstanding and prices are understandable thanks Cali for everything you've done for us to move in here. We wouldn't wanna be anywhere else.

Kudo to the property staff

Really loved living here  Had no major issues with maintenance and for the price I paid it was a great space to create my cozy plac . The only thing I wish was there was more of is greenery. Overall not to bad and location is great!

Beautiful apartment community nestled in the hills above San Antonio. Allie and her leasing team are incredibly kind and work hard to ensure a safe and welcoming property. Thomas and Eriq are the best technicians and the residents are very lucky to have such a diligent and timely crew. In the rare event of a maintenance request, the techs are out to the apartment in record time and get things back up and running! We're so happy we found Marquis Cross Mountain and it's an absolute pleasure to get to be a part of this community.

Yoli, the apartment manager, has failed to manage this property. There is LOTS of criminal activity as the gates are constantly broken so the criminals can come right in and out! Find a better place to live, as the "luxury" is 100% false advertising.

Terrible community to live in. A lot of loud noises, and the leasing agents are the least bit helpful. Multiple car break ins, and dog poop left throughout the community. Stay away from this complex! I do not recommended this place. It's dated and not being kept up. The A/C breaks down constantly (3 work orders so far this year, and it's not even summer yet), and the old carpet is just nasty. We lived here for 2 1/2 years and when our lease was up, we moved into a rental home. After living in the rental home for one year we moved back because we missed the amenities, the great management, and the location being off the beaten path and out of traffic but having access to I 10 and 1604.  The hiking trail, coffee house/ business center, grill and fireplace gazebo, clubhouse with kitchen, pool table and tv are all amazing. Management is quick to respond to help and kind and professional.  It is a small community feel. Feels like home.

As for the negative- hire more people in the office. There's always a line of customers waiting - especially on weekends- oh and more parking space.

Each time I drive home to The Retreat I am struck by how lucky I am to live in such a beautiful apartment complex. The drive up into Cross Mountain on Kyle Seale Parkway reminds me of California (but at a much lower price). The beautifully lighted and landscaped grounds with palm trees surrounding the pool elegantly welcome me home.  The interior of the apartments equal the rest with luxurious finishes. With free yoga and circuit training classes, car washes on premises, a fabulous walking trail, and a management team which can't seem to do enough to please its residents, it is a joy to live here. I also love being a few miles from our highways with their noise and pollution but only 5 minutes to them for convenience.

I used to drive by these apartments every single day in awe of how beautiful they were. I finally went inside and my love for these apartments, the staff, and amenities grew. This is the best place to live in San Antonio. It is peaceful, clean, aesthetically pleasing, and the amenities are amazing.

Retreat at Cross Mountain is an excellent place to live.  We moved here from Maine and have received excellent customer service from the staff since day 1.  The apartments are absolutely beautiful, well maintained, and have an amazing view.  It's a small community that makes it completely safe and family friendly.  By far, the best apartments we found in San Antonio!
OUR EXPERIENCE WAS AWESOME, KATHY WAS VERY HELPFUL!

I've lived all over, and this is actually the nicest place I've lived at.  I've toured about every apartment around San Antonio and I can't find anything better.  Absolutely love the hiking trail.  The pool was heated all winter.  Everyone else who lives here feels the same way from what I gather. Since I work from home, I feel like the staff are my coworkers, and there is plenty of room to spread out within wifi range. I don't give reviews lightly but I genuinely enjoy living here.
This is a wonderful place to live!! The staff is always friendly and professional. They are always on top of things. The grounds are well maintained and well managed. We LOVE living here!

Two city parks are just around the corner. This is a country-feel residence with quick access to IH10 and Loop 1604.  The management is awesome and quick to help if needed.  They also do free yoga, pool parties, free mobile car washes...omg... totally do not want to leave.  PS : top floor apartment homes have high ceilings which make for bigger feel and lots of natural light.

The location is amazing - out in the country overlooking hills, but only a five minute drive from La Cantera. Very quiet. Wonderful that garages are available with some of the apartments! Love the heated pool, although it is small. Very, very nice outside lounge with TV. Everything is clean even though there is some construction going on. Your rent money is going into the quality of the apartment, staff, and landscaping. And the staff? Warm, friendly, helpful. This was undoubtedly one of the best moves I've ever made.

Gorgeous floor plans! When you walk in, it feels more like a house or condo than an apartment. Granite countertops! Beautiful views! I originally wanted to get the A1 but I chose the A4 because of the hill country view.

5002 is a gem. Its located conveniently between 2 major highways and nestled quietly near to Sea World. The staff are great.
Great place to live, quiet neighborhood, attentive staff. Easy to drive in and out of during traffic hours. Definitely recommended.

Since my arrival to Estraya Westover Hills complex, I have been quite pleased with the speed and professionalism of the maintenance team. The maintenance team is a great credit and asset to the complex.
The staff always professional and keeps us informed about what is happening in the community and on the property.

I do recommend a garage,  my truck did have the catalytic converter stolen early on,  but I feel super safe with the garage,  not only from thieves,  but any weather that moves through,  my truck is protected! Office staff is great and attentive, maintenance is on the spot right away if you need them. Honestly it is just a great place to live!
Living at Palmetto Pointe has been wonderful.  The office staff is awesome, I always feel safe, and the neighbors are friendly.

-Kel

From the minute I stepped in the office, greeted by Michelle, I felt comfortable and not pressured. She was so informative and understanding. She viewed 3 different floor plans with me.  Was very patient and did not rush me at all. Recommend this property highly!
The staff is great and when I had a change in my move date they were so supportive and helpful! I love the community and I can’t wait to move in.
Living in vecina is very close to living in nature. With the songs of birds we definitely forgot our busy life struggles.

We have been living here for 8 months now and we love everything, the staff is polite and friendly and the layout of the apartments is perfect for us, we are glad we chose this residential complex.

Vecina Apartments provides excellent service. Whenever I place a work order, it is handled promptly and efficiently. The staff is professional and ensures that any issues are resolved in a timely manner. Highly recommend!

After being invited to several of Dolce Vita events  by friends living here, I can honestly say this location takes REALLY good care of their residents! My review is towards Jenny! She was so understanding and very helpful, she was kind and took the time to explain everything. any email or phone call was answered and she made sure I was settled in.
Definitely recommend the apartment complex, and if needed work with Jenny!

It was hard trying to find an apartment that checked all of our boxes, but then we found Caroline at Longhorn Quarry. We have loved living here! The apartments are nice and modern, and the people here are so nice. Lauren was amazing in helping us through the leasing process.

I've been living at Caroline at Longhorn Quarry for almost a year now, and I couldn't be happier with my experience. From the moment I inquired about leasing, the entire process has been smooth and hassle-free. A big shoutout to Lauren who has been an incredible help throughout my time here. She made the leasing process seamless and has always been available to address any questions or concerns I've had.

The apartment complex itself is fantastic. The grounds are well-maintained, and the amenities are top-notch. I feel safe and comfortable living here, and the community is friendly and welcoming. The management team is responsive and proactive, ensuring that any maintenance requests are handled promptly.

I'm so impressed with the overall experience that I'm looking forward to renewing my lease. If you're looking for a great place to live with excellent customer service, I highly recommend Caroline at Longhorn Quarry. It's truly a wonderful place to call home.
Overall we like our single family rental home and the amenities. Only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is the craftsmanship of the home isn’t the best.

Staff members in leasing office are quite unfriendly & unwelcoming / elevators need to be cleaned other than that everything is great. Gym equipment is new and very clean. Pool is lovely & the free coffee / tea / espresso is one of my favorite parts !

I have tried multiple times to reach out when I have a problem and get the same line “we will talk to management” then I never hear back and the problem really doesn’t get fixed or if it does it is not fixed in a timely manner. I have had so many issues since moving in here and it honestly is insane given the price we pay for these units.

Overall, my experience living here has been sub par. It’s gone in waves of being a likeable place to live to absolutely hating it. The quality of the buildings is poor and constantly things are failing that they are having to fix. Management tries there best at hosting events but that just started lately. If you want to live somewhere that is maintained just enough, this is for you but there is better out there

Upon calling first, I knew I was in good hands. Jana the assistant manager walked me through everything including the approval process. She is beyond great. Great experience so far. I know I made the right move
Great staff made the process to lease very easy! Carmen is awesome and great to work with. They have so many amenities that make living will be so great.

We have been Living at Alta rolling oaks for close to a year now, We love that is located in a very quiet and peaceful area. It always feels safe around here and we have a great team of office staff and maintanance crew. we are proud to say we look forward to many years to come in our cozy home.
Community is calm, quiet, and pretty. Floor plans are good and have great amenities!!

A must see NEW Apartment complex!! Ask for Michelle. She is the sweetest and will answer all of your questions. Best customer service I have received by far when looking for an apartment. We signed a 15 month lease and are so excited to become residents at Alta Rolling Oaks. The property is beautiful and the views are just gorgeous! Make sure you go check them out.

So far I am enjoying my stay at Alta Rolling Oaks. I love the layout and design of my apartment and I like that the property is kept clean. The gym is nice and the staff have been helpful and friendly.
The move in process was so easy. The whole staff is great. The apartments are a brand new build so everything is clean and brand new. One of the best apartment complexes I’ve ever lived in.
The apartments are beautiful. Tatiyanna is so friendly and helpful she made our move in process a 10/10!!! Thank you Tatiyanna!!

Tatiana was very professional and swift into getting us into our new apartment she made it easy and was able to communicate back and forth in a timely manner which is much appreciated, dog park is huge and the community is quite. Nothing to complain about.
I love the complex! The trail for my pups has to be favorite part, besides the wonderful management team. They made the moving process so easy. They were also extremely helpful.
I just moved in and it’s amazing great management beautiful property!
Alta Rolling Oaks is a great place to live. The experience so far has been wonderful!

Couldnt ask for a easier move in management was awesome and welcoming, and apartments were clean and ready for us on move in date. they have best communication i've had renting, the amenities are awesome!!
The apartments are beautiful. Everyone in the office has been so friendly and helpful.
Good community with nice and friendly environment. Feels like home

Applying to Landon Ridge has been a nightmare. I was initially promised a background check would be done within 3-5 days, but it’s been over two weeks with no updates or progress. Their constant assurances of daily updates were empty promises. This incompetence has cost me a small fortune—I've had to pay for hotels and make multiple trips from my current apartment in Dallas, all while waiting on them.

I eventually applied to another apartment next door, where my background check was completed and approved in just one day. Landon Ridge now has my payment for the admin fee, which is non-refundable and a complete waste for nothing. Their reliance on an inexperienced third party for basic tasks like background checks is a huge red flag. I'm glad I discovered their lack of professionalism early on before committing to more issues.

Also, the property is still under heavy construction. Spare yourself the frustration and choose a place that values your time.

Lived here almost 3 years. These apartments are actual trash. When we moved in we had a huge leak in our water heater that flooded our entire apartment. We called maintenance and were told to wait until morning. The leak got so bad that it was spewing into the apartment next to ours and when the neighbors called the office that’s when management felt it was appropriate to have the leak fixed. Next we had an issue with the apartment above our bathroom leaking water THRU OUR LIGHT FIXTURE every time the man got in the shower. I contacted management about the leak and was told they would come look at it. They came and basically told me I was tripping because they turned the water on upstairs and “they ddnt hear anything”. A couple more days went by and the water leaking from our light fixture got a little worse so I called the office and after a few attempts thru out the day I told them and they sent maintenance again and again I was told I’m tripping even tho I had video this time. The man upstairs was admitted to the hospital for a while so a few weeks went by and no water leaking. The man’s family came to clean his apartment and while they did that they ran the water in the shower off and on over 3 days leaking into our bathroom so I submitted a 3rd maintenance request and I guess that’s the straw that broke the camels back because our shower ceiling literally just caved in which is alarming but what really got me was the RAT that came from the ceiling which can be seen in one of the videos I uploaded. I then called maintenance to have the rat removed and they acted like they were afraid and basically told me to do it myself so I had to maneuver my whole apartment because the rat got out under the door and catch it myself. When the ceiling caved in I called and emailed the office several times over 2 days. My work hours and their open hours did not line up so I couldn’t just go in so in order to get this issue addressed it took me having to research who is a corporate level employee and then digging to figure out their email address and then emailing them with the main spice creek email along with the property manager ccd on the email to get a call back about this which really whipped the apartment manager into shape and got us taken care of. So they ended up offering us a “renovated unit” to move into for the remainder of our lease. When we moved in I couldn’t help but scoff at their attempt to call that unit renovated… it was the same as our other unit

I really enjoy living at Spice Creek.  It is very quiet.  I needed my disposal repaired and they showed up fixed it the same day I put in the maintenance request.  Amazing!!  It is clean and everyone in the office is professional and friendly.  I recommend these apartments to everyone.  The rent is reasonable too!!
This apartment complex is very well taken care of and the management is great and haven’t had problems is years

This is the worst living experience I have ever from here!!! First, please don't be fooled by the model. What they show you and what you end up leasing are nothing alike. When I first signed my lease and I asked to view my apartment prior to moving in I was shown an apartment which was not ready at all. The door had been busted off the hinges; there were huge holes in the walls; there were dead roaches everywhere; the floors were filthy and the apartment smelled awful!!! I later learned that an estranged lover had broken in on his ex-lover and her current boyfriend there. Obviously, I was extremely perturbed by the situation. The manager apologized for the sand offered me a different apartment. I really wanted to rescind my lease, but I was in a desperate situation as I was moving from another city and was scheduled for surgery the next week. So, I accepted. Little did I know this would be one of the worst decisions of my life. I did not have the opportunity to view the apartment until the day I received the keys. Once I expressed my displeasure the manager offered the option to change my lease terms to six months. Before I had the opportunity to do so she was fired and replaced with the current manager who advised me I was stuck with the lease. Every since I moved in it has been nothing but problems. 

I have had so many maintenance requests I stopped counting. First, it three weeks for the washer and dryer to be removed. Not to mention a mess was left behind. Secondly, it was the end of August when I moved in and the air conditioning was not working.  There was a HUGE hole beneath the bathroom sink with so much filth stuck in it it was ridiculous! Everything is just painted over. There are patched holes in the ceiling and the ceiling leaks in the second bathroom whenever it rains. Lastly, but DEFINITELY not least the noise is unbearable! I hear everything my neighbors upstairs do even when their noise is not excessive. I even hear their cell phone alarm vibrations every morning at 6:45. It sounds as if too many people living up there. Once the tramping noise was so bad I thought the ceiling fan was going to fall. I have filed so many noise complaints with the police department and management that I have given up. Not to mention the noise from the street. There is no peace here. I can never rest. This place is SO antiquated it should be torn down. You hear everything from toilets flushing; showers running; water running and traffic all day and night.

I moved in to the property in February. To begin with I was shown the model which is a 1 bedroom 1 bath and was told the 2 bedroom was exactly the same except for an extra bedroom and bathroom on the other side of the living room. My apartment is NOTHING like the model. I was also told my unit was on the first floor. Once I picked up my keys I realized that was also a lie. Immediately after moving in I noticed mouse droppings. I called the office and was told they had not been told by anyone else that there was mice. I have had problems with maintenance and have to continuously baby sit them and call several times before I ever get them to come to my unit. They do the worst job possible and most of the time say they’ll return to complete which they never do and ends up with me having to baby sit again. My a/c went out early summer and maintenance was impossible to reach after hours. All I got was an apology and having to find another place to stay until the a/c was fixed because toddlers should not be in 85+ degree weather. They refused to prorate rent for the days that I had to stay somewhere else even tho it was their staff that wasn’t responding to the emergency

Called the leasing office earlier today to discuss 2 bed 2 bath apartment. Was told that there would not be one available for the date I was looking to move in. Was told about a 2 bed 1 bath that would be available by the time I needed it. I didn't notice it the floor plan on here or their website but thought it was because it was due to an eviction. The whole conversation on the phone I kept mentioning the 2 bed 1 bath phrase. Never once did the leasing agent correct me. My roommate and I show up to tour the apartment only to find out that there is no 2/1. The leasing agent was referring to her 1/1 unit. Ummm...I mentioned repeatedly 2/1. Why the bait and switch tactic when I arrive? Come to find out it was the same complex that sites behind the one I am currently renting. Spice creek usually has broken cars and furniture in their parking lot. Totally not worth the price they expect tenants to pay.

What an amazing leasing experience! It was an absolute pleasure working with the staff at Oakhampton! My unit was ready earlier than expected and everything was absolutely perfect! The community is very quiet and welcoming. There were butterflies all throughout the pathway where the landscaping is beautifully kept! We are so happy to be home!

The staff is hard to get a hold of and takes days to respond to emails.  They can be rude and defensive when called out on issues.  Construction has been going on before and since I've moved in. Last minute water or electrical shut offs constantly.  They changed my window during construction and left it completely open while I was at work and my AC was just running all day and didn't even clean the mess they left. Over just a poorly ran complex. Would be a nice place if the office actually cared about the property or tenants.

I have rented many apartments over the years and I am a reasonable and fairly easy going person. My experience over the past year at Oak Hampton prompts me to write this review. Scrolling through some of the other reviews I am convinced management has written at least some of the good reviews.

Not suitable for dogs or those with children. Nowhere to walk dogs without them becoming caked in mud and requiring a bath after every walk when it rains. Dog park is a tiny area with no grass. Nowhere for kids to play that isnt muddy or in a construction zone. Construction crew leaves up many hazzards over every weekend. Mud runs into parking lot and over walkways due to lack of grass and stepping off curb into parking lot is really tricky during rainstorms - I've slipped TWICE pn the same day and twisted a different ankle each time. Other residents have told me they've fallen as well.

Standing water in giant potholes in parking lot and the constant wet mud (that takes days to dry its so deep) breeds mosquitos. I average 10 to 15 mosquito bites per walk with my dog. Pools are not properly maintained. Laundry rooms are always dirty.

Nails in tires, took receipt and nails to office; management won't reimburse despite saying they would in other reviews regarding same issue. Had 2 flats on SAME DAY. I pick up approximately 20 nails and screws (and razor blades) a week from the sidewalks and parking lot. Construction has been going on entire year I've been here and other residents tell me it has been going on for years. My windows were replaced about a month ago but giant cracks around sliding doors and windows have not been repaired. Makes apt very cold or very hot.

My AC and oven hasnt worked correctly since I moved in. I have had maintenance come out and check but each time was told they were working properly. I baked something for 45 minutes at 350 last week and it was still cold in the middle. Check the AC unit for your specific apt before signjng lease, they vary greatly in age with some units looking like they're 30+ years old! My electric bills in the summer months are ridiculous.

High crime. They chain maintenance golf cart to a column at night. Mailboxes were broken into (again) and residents had to pick up mail at post office. Outgoing mail couldnt be left at box for at least a month. I have seen people digging thru dumpsters at night.

I have lived here for going on six years. The staff is always helpful, and they respond quickly to any maintenance requests. The renovations to the buildings has been a little stressful, but it is coming along  quickly and the place has never looked better! If you are looking for a great place to live you just found it!

Water has been turned off to entire complex 5 times in the 6 weeks I have lived here. Today is the second time I've woke up to no water & needed to shower and can't. Always told after the fact that it's an emergency shut off due to water line leak, but after 6 weeks you'd think they would have taken care of it by now. Otherwise apartments are ok....but not being able to shower when you want/need to on a frequent basis is horribly inconvenient. Utility bills are high and parking is scarce.

Negative stars! Do Not rent at this complex! I have broken my lease due to many complications and the facility is completely unaccountable. They have been doing construction all over the complex throughout my stay which was less than a year but other occupants have been there for 5 years and they said the same.  There are nails and boards all over the floor, which has forced me to replace my tires TWICE! Which the complex will deny and not compensate for. When trying to address the problem the staff will only say that there have been no other complaints. Yet I have called numerous times about the issues of construction vehicles hitting and scratching my car, AC going out for days in the summer, management entering the apartment without notice or permission, AND debris being left all over which I have personally picked up to avoid another nail in my tire. Other minor issues are that there is no room for parking, the pool hours are very limited if ever open, massive potholes throughout complex street, and a school just opened next door which makes morning very loud and traffic horrible. 
Upsides to this location are rare and few.

This staff is GREAT!! I moved here from El Paso and was in a rush. The staff took the time to ensure I understood what my apartment would look like when I came in they delivered exactly what they promised. Even upon my arrival they saw that I was tired and made sure they got me in and out the door so that I could enjoy my new place. I must’ve called seven different times asking different questions and they were more than happy to assist. This place is huge for the price and very well kept on the inside!!! I definitely recommend this place to military as well!! Thank you Oakhampton Place Staff!!

This place used to be nice when I first moved in. Now, there is constant construction 6 days a week, nails in the parking lot, the concrete is pulled up due to the tractors which has now ruined a peice under my car and mamagemt will not fix it until construction is done but they have been working on the buildings since January. The construction workers stare at you all day and even threaten your guests. Maintence enters your home without your permission for NON EMERGENCY issues. They have tried to enter multiple times while I was taking a nap or watching tv just to replace a air filter when they can just leave it by your door. Luckily I've been home the times they "tried" to enter my unit. Who knows how many other times theyve been In here while I was at work. Maintence will also stare at you and your guests for absolutely no reason. They are very unprofessional. I feel extremely uncomfortable at theses apartments. I DO NOT recommend these apartments. If you value your privacy and the things youve worked hard for then do not rent here.

I've lived in four different apartments in the past four years, and Oakhampton Place was BY FAR the worst experience. I have never met such an unprofessional and ignorant management staff. Not only was the complex entirely unsafe, but the staff was not interested in hearing about various encounters I had with break-ins and uncomfortable encounters in general that I experienced there. There was only one nice maintenance man that helped me when I needed it, but other than him the place cared nothing about maintenance with rotting materials being covered by paint or ceiling leaks that were never taken care of. The place was cute, on the inside at least, but don't let that fool you. It's all a front for how cheaply put together the apartment is. None of my cabinet doors even closed because of how carelessly they were installed. Just do yourself a favor and do not live in such an awful place, because you are definitely not getting your moneys worth for pretty much anything. I'd be surprised if they have even finished repairing their hail damage...

This is an awful nice place to live!!!!! The only positive is its the most pet friendly place around. So with that you get barking dogs and feces galore. It is so loud here with the airport and construction going on all around. There's also a lot of petty crime. Someone had all 3 loads of his laundry taken this weekend. Also the mailboxes was broken into WEEKS ago and the front office has done NOTHING to fix it.  Packages also are getting taken from peoples porches. Do yourself a favor and try some place else.

Family/Military apartment. 3 Pools are nice and well maintained. You can either live in a new upgraded apartment (with granite/high end finishings) or the more economical version which I am in. The one bedroom with a den is basically like a two bedroom. Very spacious for the price. I recommend this apartment for military families and students.

Oakhampton is a really great place to live--it's quiet, shaded, and very well-kept.

Management has always been very responsive to requests and maintenance. They know you by name, and usually fixes are completed within 48 hours.

I have always felt very safe and taken care of here.

Pros - It's a nice complex. The landscaping is great, the pools are pristine, and they keep the apartments up to date with features like wood blinds and nice carpeting. The ladies in the on-site office are very nice and friendly. Also I just found out that the office is open on Saturdays most of the day, which is an added bonus for office workers. The apartments are super quiet, and very pet friendly.

Cons - Parking isn't great, especially after 6pm. I've had to park on the other side of the complex when coming home later in the evening. Also they canceled a reservation at the last minute on me for a weekend apartment rental. Thankfully my out of town guests were able to find a hotel about 20 minutes away. I also had a disagreement with them about the due date of rent when it fell due on a Sunday and was considered late if a check was dropped off at 8:01am on Monday morning (had to eat a $50 late fee for that). When I talked to the property management group based out of Kansas, their owner Bob Hanson was pretty rude on the phone and condescending - didn't treat it like the professional business discussion that it was. Given that experience, I wouldn't recommend it to others. You may never have to deal with him and have a great experience living here, but if something goes awry, be prepared for a nasty conversation or two.

Regular employees are nice... but.. Management...  Complete lack of integrity and honesty, it’s like it’s being run by a bunch of slimeball lawyers.  Here is a sampling of things that happened in the year  I was a resident:

-My washer and (their) microwave got fried in my apartment due to a surge in their building’s electrical system.  They replaced their microwave and would no nothing about my washer.

Maintenance left their keys in my door.  All day.

Overcharged me on a cleaning fee on move-out, did not own up to error, even when faced with the evidence!  (Bizarro world moment)

Left a threatening note on my door because I only paid $1495 of my $1505 bill.  They hadn’t updated the payment system by the first of the month to include all the nickel and dime fees yet, but still thought it was fine to leave me that note over $10 even though it was their fault (common theme is they NEVER accept responsibility).

I stopped having a pet, so asked to get my pet fee back.  Nope, should’ve told them earlier.

Gate is ALWAYS broken.  So much for security.  So weird that my car was broken into while parked there, huh?
 
Good luck parking close to your apartment if you come in late.  There won’t be a space for you.  There will be covered parking spaces open, but if you aren’t paying for it, expect a threatening call.

If you like ROACHES, appliances that don't fully function, old carpets, and an unappreciative and immature office staff, then this is the place for you.  This is NOT an upscale place.  Half the time the gates don't work and you have less than desirable neighbors.  You could rent a nice home for the money you spend here.  Go elsewhere.

I don't know from  where I have to start. It is undoubtedly great experience.
Front Office - 
Celeste and team you all are doing fantastic work. Seriously, I have been living in San Antonio almost 5 years and this is my third apartment community and I regret that I could not find you guys earlier. The true customer oriented, taking care, always customer first kind of service. Even though I am moving to CA, you all are helping me genuinely. Like I said, you definitely deserve this 5 star rating.
Floor Plan and Unit - 
I especially liked the 2B1B plan which I am currently in. It is awesome and perfectly planned floor plan. You will feel that there is not at all waste of area or interior. Kitchen, both bedrooms, living room etc are perfectly designed and architected.
Maintenance  -
I still remember the way Celeste took care of one of the work orders by arranging pest control prior to the schedule. Highly appreciate that. Also, all the work orders got done almost on the same day
Community -
Really great ppl community. Awesome pool and gym area. 
Overall -
You feel same response all the time what you had while moving to this community. Last but not the least, if I moved back to Texas, this will be my home for sure. Keep up the good work. :) :)

Our family has been living here for about a year and a half. The staff is great! The team always great my children and I with a genuine smile. The maitnence staff is amazing and so trust worthy. They even let my 2 yr old "help" do repairs with his toy drill. The 2 bed 1 bath is a perfect layout for us
The apartments them selves are nice, a tad over priced, and the extras we are charged but don't use bothers us some. The pool area is amazing!

1800 is advertised as "Luxury" living but it has been far from that for a while now. We have lived here for many years now and the gate never works leaving us vulnerable to theft and damage by people who do not live here. Many Pearl patrons will use our ungated garage as a parking lot so they don't have to pay. The gym has had equipment that has not been usable going on about a year now. For months the TVs have not been working and have the cords hanging down the wall, very tacky. Many places will have problems just like any family, business or relationship but what usually makes people work things out is mutual respect and caring for each other. The property management and front office does not see the residents that way. We sign a contract that says we have to obey all these rules to be a good resident yet they are not held accountable for keeping up the building and making this feel like a home for us. They blame the residents for many of the problems in the building like the front gate and plumbing problems. And if it's not the residents then it is the contractors they hired or the fact that they need more time to research and buy new equipment; there are not that many ellipticals out on the market that it should take over 6 months to get them replaced. As residents, this is where we have chosen to make our home and I will continue to do that for my family and neighbors despite the lace of respect and caring from the front office and Churchill Forge Properties management company.

Two months ago one of our vehicles was struck by the entrance gate. On the day of the incident the property manager, Destiny, was outside in the morning checking to see if the gate was working. In the afternoon, after the gate fell on our car, she was out there manually lifting it because it got stuck in a position too low for cars to enter. There is a record of the gate not operating correctly consistently and fob RF issues. The front office allowed landscapers to park in the driveway causing another safety issue that day. Even with Destiny knowing of the gate problems that day, the management company denied our claim to have our car fixed. They claim the gate was operating properly that day. They say they care about the residents but actions say otherwise.

Management is kind and helpful, the maintenance staff always goes above and beyond. I wish I could take them everywhere I live- it's made my standards pretty high and even though I'm not staying in the city for the long term, this complex makes me second guess leaving just because I feel comfortable.

Room to grow, if I have to- some of the gym equipment could use an update. I also wish there were a bit more security with construction workers around at all times. Even just cameras at gated entrances would make me feel more secure.

The location is great. The property is not well maintained. The maintenance crew is not allow to fix most problems. They blame the residents for 90% of the issues. The building had to be shut down for mold  a few years ago and the air circulation is still so poor that the units are humid and you can smell mildew. There is something wrong with the drains or water, black flakey stuff grows out of the drains and on the toilet tank lid. I clean religiously, I have a desk job, and I was told the black stuff was dirt that rinses off of my body. I guess this makes sense because I often bathe in my toilet tank? They treat the property like a hotel for temp guests so my unit often smells like smoke and there are always out of state vehicles in the parking garage and I am forced to park on several floors away. I am next to the pool and mosquitoes get inside my apartment. I only renewed my lease because I did not have time to move when the courts briefly reopened.

I have lived at 1800 Broadway for a little over one-year now and while I will give it 4-stars for the location, the overall construction of the physical plant is simply average. The walls between units are quite thin and you can definitely hear your neighbors personal arguments or amorous activities. You do need a key fob to get into everything which sounds like a good idea, but if you forget your key fob on a weekend or after hours you will have to wait in the garage or a stairwell for quite a bit of time for another resident to show-up to assist you in gaining entry. The COVID-19 Pandemic has unfortunately resulted in the closure of most of the common area amenities (pool, social gathering room, gym, etc.). Absent the recreational amenities you're paying about $1.90/SF/month for the interior of your apartment space. The management staff is friendly during business hours, however, once the management office closes, you are on your own. The after-hours answering service will only take a message and while there was an occasional garage security car after a rash of automobile break-ins, I haven't seen the security service in several months. My guess is the additional security proved to be too expensive.  The property is managed by Churchill Forge Properties and they manage 8-other properties in San Antonio. Most of their other properties in San Antonio are Class-B type properties and while 1800 Broadway has a nice façade on Broadway and a prime location, it fails to live-up to its' potential. The multifamily communities that are adjacent to The Pearl and/or the Riverwalk are more expensive, but in all things in life, you get what you pay for, though I question the overall value for the rent dollar at this community. One final comment, I travel a great deal and sometimes am unable to transfer funds into my rental account on a timely basis. I am currently "locked-out" of the communities' very archaic payment portal and it appears that I need to purchase a "MoneyGram" to pay my rent. Seriously, doesn't Craig's List publicly warn you about paying anyone with a MoneyGram. So, in summary, a great location with a Class-B building, hibernating recreational amenities, and competent local management. CFP, which was established in 1966, has earned a reputation as a tertiary property management company that has declined in service and efficiency over the last decade.

I just moved in a few weeks ago and so far, it's been all I had hoped it would be.  The leasing staff has been excellent and has gone above and beyond to make sure all my needs are being met. Extremely friendly and engaged. The maintenance staff has been awesome and friendly also.  I love my studio apartment; more room, storage and space than I expected plus the floor, fridge, appliances, lighting, countertops and cupboards are really nice. Bathroom looks great and the washer and dryer included is a nice touch. Pool and gym are great along with the clubhouse area.  Always enough room for resident parking and easy access to the major highways.  It's always fun to be able to walk to the bars, shops and restaurants.  If you are a fan of the Pearl, The Broadway 1800 is a must.

Ember Apartments are really nice. Vanessa, the Assistant Community Manager, was such a big help to my daughter and I when we were looking for an apartment. I look forward to doing lot of business with her for years to come.

I normally don’t give reviews but I felt like I needed to give this place some credit ! We just moved down here about 2 going on 3 months .  And so far we are so happy with these apartments. All the ladies in the office are nice and welcoming. We spoke directly with kristi , she made the process so easy considering we did everything via email since we were all the way in Chicago.  She was great and very helpful, would keep us updated with everything. She made everything go smooth sailing. .. another thing , we wrote on that checklist sheet they give you when you first move in about a bedroom door not closing properly and they sent maintenance out to come fix it without us even having to request it  which was awesome definitely a good first impression ! Ive noticed they  always have someone picking up trash outside in the mornings  and they had someone come power wash the halls..  they do a great job here maintaining the place clean. My wife and I rented here for a little over a year and loved a lot about this place.  Our thoughts are as follows:

- Quiet.  I worked nights for part of my time here and never had an issue sleeping.
- It is a couple hundred dollars a month cheaper than comparably nice complexes.
- The staff is amazing and maintenance are prompt and friendly.
- The trees and landscape are delightful.  You can walk through a bit of a forest and never leave the complex.
- The dog park is great.
- The valet trash service is nice.
- Parking is never an issue (for residents, see cons for more details)

Cons:
- We have had multiple packages stolen throughout our time here.  We put instructions on all packages that they be delivered to the front office but if they are not and you are not home somebody else will most likely take your merchandise.
- Having visitors is a massive pain.  They have a minuscule visitor's parking lot and and tow anybody who is parked within the gate after 7 pm.  The offer a guest pass now but that costs money ($5 per night I think, we've never bought one).  Our guests have had to park at Home Depot down the street and be shuttled to our place.
- The gate is a bit inconvenient.  We've never had it working quite properly since we've lived here.  The FOBs aren't a problem but the visitor's codes have not worked correctly.
- The sidewalks do not connect to anything so for now your only real option if you want to take a walk is to walk within the confines of the complex or to drive elsewhere.
- Storage is limited

So there it is.  I do not regret living here and have thoroughly enjoyed this place.  Due to parking I would give this place a 4/5 but the theft issue, which they admittedly cannot do much about, drops it to 3/5.  Due to the price and experience so far I would choose to continue to live here were I not moving.  The visitors issue may be a huge deal to some and the theft thing keep this from being my favorite apartment I have rented so far.

They have a sign out front advertising they did a MULTI-MILLION dollar renovation, and within those millions of dollars they couldn't find a budget for anything to prevent the constant theft of resident's mail, and vehicles from the property. 

Changes include makeovers on amenities like the pools, new railings on the balconies, and new shingles on the rooves. The leasing office was given a HUGE makeover, new carpets, computers, floors, paint job, and a kitchenette. 
Everything to give the APPEARANCE of a new fancy apartment complex, but that's as far as the updates go.

The gates have no cameras, so anyone can go in. The fence has holes in it, so anyone can sneak in if the gates are locked. They have cameras ALL AROUND the leasing office, but none at the gates to see who is coming or going.

Just last night I had to chase someone away who had broken into the residential mailboxes. Two days ago I saw two people standing in a parking spot that had a pile of broken glass next to it, looking for their car that was obviously stolen.

The leasing office states they have a patrol car for security. I have yet to see such a vehicle on the premises.

When I bring any of this up with the leasing office they tell ME to go report the broken mailboxes to the post office. They also gave me a number for the security to call......THEY installed the boxes, AND chose to secure them with as little money as they could muster, so why am I left with the responsibility to report, and follow up? I don't own the property, and I didn't spend MILLIONS of dollars to paint the roses red, while not actually fixing anything.

DO. NOT. MOVE. HERE.

Awesome community to live at! I love my apartment. Been a resident for 2 months and so far so good! The manager is great, always see him out  helping the maintenance and cleaning up the property. BEWARE OF UNRELIABLE STAFF! Always  get whatever staff tells you in writing!  Staff changes monthly. Very unprofessional! They never come through on what is promised to you. I love how secluded the property is in such a busy area of the city (tucked behind another property and surrounded by a country club).  Very Quiet.  My only other issue is my cell phone doesn't receive service while in my apartment, but this could be because I'm on the 2nd floor (of 3) and I'm in the back of the property, so my building is completely surrounded by trees.

This apartment is pretty clean.  This is an older property, but has been taken care of.  Maintenance requests take a minimum of 9 days before you hear anything. (And this included a large LEAK under the kitchen sink that required a bucket to deter any damage)

The property is full of oak trees which is beautiful but too many stray cats that continually reproduce. The property is very old, walls are thin and doors are squeaky, have never been able to get hot water in the laundry. No grass on the grounds, just dirt and rocks so it feels dirty. Pet friendly, but the residents don't pick up their pets' feces so it smells.

PROS
*Fast Maintenance: anything that breaks is usually fixed same or next day
*Price: great price for location and size
*Location: everything is around the corner
*Quiet: aside from a weekend every now and again it is quiet
*Safe: have not heard of a single robbery or violence of any kind. Also have 2 officers that live near that always drive around Fredericksburg
*Amenities: small workout room and pool available, laundry room available as well as laundry connections in apartment storage room
*Office: great and friendly office staff always willing to help out

CONS
*Building: the complex is outdated, was built in the 80s, old appliances
*Expensive Upgrades: in order to get stainless steel and wood floors you have to tack on 200  a month
*Fees: pet fees are a little steep with $100  per animal in addition to $15 a month
*Flood: recent flooding has shown bottom floors get quite wet due to the hill the complex was built on
*Cramped: the street going through the complex is small and is hard to navigate when there are others leaving/entering the complex

I lived at the Villas at Oakwell Farms for 16 months, and I would not live there again. Here are the positives and negatives:

Positives: 
-Great maintenance staff!
-Good location to Fort Sam Houston.
-Amenities are decent for the price point.
-The Salado Creek Greenway is close if you want to bike or run it.

Negatives:
-There were numerous car break-ins, mailboxes were broken into, and the gym door was left unlocked, and some guys stole all of the weights. The whole area felt a little sketchy to live in as a single female. 
-The gym and clubhouse were not cleaned very often (or at least it did not look like it). There was blood on the basketball court for a month before it was cleaned up. I would've sent an email, but I probably would not have gotten a reply....
-I was told by management that I would get reimbursed for my move-out clean, which I confirmed several times before leaving. When I sent my receipt in, no one replied to my email. I called a few weeks later and was told my reimbursement request was being sent to the headquarters, and it may take a while. I called a few weeks after that and was told that they don't reimburse for move-out cleans and that it becomes a credit toward your security deposit, which did not add up to what I was told from the manager.
That added to the other communication issues I had with the leasing office. Hopefully, they've gotten better, but I never received email replies to several of my messages to them.
-Don't expect the gates to work.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. If anyone is thinking about moving here, please reconsider because it's not worth the cost. Management is horrible and maintenance is okay. Apartments are of average to low quality, this place could use an upgrade. Unfortunately like most properties they hire young women without experience who are unable to advise accurately or take resident's issues seriously and effectively. The regional manager is only concerned with making a buck and has no concern for her residents. Customer service here and respect for residents is abysmal. The inmates are running this asylum, and single professionals and veterans should avoid this property. The Villas at Oakwell Farms markets themselves to servicemen and veterans, but it is only a marketing ploy to capture the SAMMC/Ft. Sam Houston commuters, as they have no real respect for us. If Apartments.com allowed me to provide no stars I would, and will be out of here as soon as my lease expires.

I lived at The Villas at Oakwell Farms April 2013 to March 2016.  I absolutely loved it.  The management was awesome.  The maintenance guys are amazing; if I had a problem, it was fixed promptly.  The staff really makes an effort to make you feel welcome and "at home." AND they really work around everyone.  I had a couple situations where the staff has really bent over backwards for me.  I am forever grateful.  I had no issues with neighbors; everyone was cool and courteous. I LOVED loved living there. THANKS FOR EVERYTHING!!!

In general, our experience at the Villas at Oakwell Farms has been a very positive one.  Here are some of my favorite things about it: 

-They have a recently renovated gym room with new equipment, flooring, and lighting.
- Great location is close to 410 and Austin Highway, but you would never think it, since the area is quiet.
- The area around the apartment is nice for walking and the Villas itself is close to an entrance for the Salado Creek trails. 
- The maintenance crew is very helpful and kind. I've never seen them take longer than 24 hours to address a work order. If you need assistance more immediately, you can always flag one of them down since they are always visibly around the complex.
- Very few maintenance issues. Problems are usually small, like a burnt lightbulb.
- 24 hour notices are given any time major work is done on the apartment, which is infrequent.
- There are a wide range of apartment options: some have vaulted ceilings, some come with laundry hookups, others have access to washer/dryers on site, etc.
- Dog friendly!
- Gated community with cameras at entrances and exits.

I only have a few dislikes. For example, the kitchen appliances are okay, but nothing special. They work, but are on the older side. This apartment complex is very nice, but nothing over the top or impressive. The location is generally good, but there are very few delivery options, so driving is a necessity.
