Be warned.

If you are planning to live here by yourself and not use the amenities, fantastic, perhaps youd have a few run ins with management but thats about it. They are pleasant to greet you and get your packages for you, however, anytime you have to deal with additional issues, hidden fees that you are unaware off until you have to pay 100s of dollars plus whatever fee you are being charged, good luck. 

Staff have in multiple occasions provided misleading information, you will sign paperwork and get random entries on your bills to end up paying late fees because you were unaware these were added, if you need to deal with paperwork you are in for a treat... Each staff member can give you different answers and request different paperwork and perform all tasks except what you need. 

Complain about late fees and post here what happens to you... I dare you.

Dirty apartments turned in at move in time, managnent extremely rude manager and assistant manager. That's the least of it. Apartments are "gated" but the gates are broken more often then not. Multiple break in each week, cars get broken into constantly even cases of people robbing residents at gun point. Courtesy officer never available and the worst part is office doesn't even inform residents of the situation. We talk among residents and find out what's going on in the complex. Amenity center is like a public recreation center always crowded with people who don't even live at the complex

I have lived in this apartment complex for almost two years now. In that time, I can't remember the gates ever working correctly. I've never experienced any break-ins but I have heard of quite a few and I'm sure it has to do with the gates being wide open all the time. I have experienced some pest problems and have had to prod maintenance several times to get things done. My requests were always completed eventually, just not necessarily in a timely manner. The neighbors in this complex tend to be younger and somewhat rowdy. The office staff always advises that you call the police rather than at least courtesy calling or something of the sort. The apartment itself is nice enough but I wouldn't call it "luxury". Again, I've lived in better apartments but I have also lived in worse. It's a good place when you are in a bind.
Pretty nice place to live. Friendly office people and maintenance crew. Apartments are nice.

I have been living at these apartment complexes for almost 2 years now. We have had a few problems with the apartments but nothing severe. With each problem, the apartments came within 24 hours to fix it. They also have pest control come every Tuesday so if you call the office, you can arrange them to come spray if you have any bug problems. The office is also open every day of the week and they accept packages on your behalf! No more boxes outside the door and no more "missed" package slips!! 
The apartments are also in a decent part of San Antonio as well. And for what the apartments give you (racquetball & basketball court, sauna, gym and such) on top of their service, the price is cheaper than the neighboring apartments. They also just renovated the recreation center so it's even better than it was before with more equipment as well! This complex is by 2 HEBs and a Wal-mart. It's also conveniently located by every highway in San Antonio. It literally takes no more than 7 minutes to 410, 1604, 281 and i-10.
They also have a beautiful pool area with a two-tiered pooling area. The bbq area is first come first serve, but as for the actual pool area, there usually always is space. Most people don't go to the pool until 11am so anytime before then, it's all yours!

These are a gated apartment complex that should be secure, but  it's been so far the worst. I have been here for  four months and so far there have been 6 vehicles broken into, mine included. The second month I was here, we received notice of 4 cars broken into and this last time it was a ladies' car and mine. We spoke with someone in the office but they never did anything. I was expecting another notice for my neighbors, but we got nothing. I personally would not recommend them and will definitely not be renewing.

I am currently staying in a 2 bed apartment paying over $1,200 a month. Although the view is nice (overlooking a lake) I am really paying for it. I had my car broken into one night and so have 7 other cars in the last month. If you are a late night worker or like to go out at night you can say goodbye to parking anywhere near your apartment when you get home. The leading agents are really nice and have helped me to the best of their ability when I needed them. There is a basketball court, but word that this apartment complex actually has one has reached to the local near by high school, so it is really a hot place to go if you are a local kid looking to sneak into a facility you don't pay for. Maintenance is one of the best I've seen they get to request relatively quick and actually know their stuff. The leasing agent talked up the local pond and how we would be able to fish there, but heads up its just a reservoir for the local golf course so no telling how long before they find out and with the number of homeless hipsters that like to stay down there it won't be very long before they do. Overall it is a very quiet community consisting of mostly military, their family, and med nurses and students. All in all I give this place a 4 star rating.

WORST OFFICE STAFF I've ever dealt with. If you are looking at renting an apartment in this property, I would highly recommend that you look elsewhere. I've had problems with dealing with the staff and the information they provide since we signed our lease. When you move out, they will charge you for painting your apartment and cleaning the carpet so you definitely will not get your deposit back. On top of that, they will pile on fees at their convenience. Even if the office staff makes a mistake, you will still have to pay for whatever charges are added on, even if they were added there to no fault of your own. In reading previous reviews, I see that complaints about staff are a common thread, so clearly this is not an issue the manager is concerned about enough to correct it.
As far as the property, it is very noisy since it is right on the flight path for most airplanes. The walkways and stairs are really dirty as the management does nothing to maintain the upkeep of the buildings.
There are other properties in the area that may cost a bit extra but it's probably so worth it in order to deal with professional and helpful staff.

Been here a little while now and these apartments are okay. I don't know as if I would qualify these apartments as "luxury". I mean, the "wood" floors are of a linoleum of some sort, not actual wood.

I like the view that we have an it is peaceful, except for the planes that are constantly flying over. They say you will eventually not hear them, but that has not been the case for me, yet.

The staff....they are okay, could be friendlier. The office manager is nice.

Maintenance is good. They come in a timely manner.

You are allowed to have pets which is awesome but it would be a lot better if the owners of the pets would not be lazy and pick up after them. Office staff is aware of the issue and has done nothing to resolve it. Very annoying.

The gates....well they work but not very often and you will usually always find people at the gym that do not belong to the complex or you will find people waiting outside the gates for them to open so they can sneak in.

For the price that I am paying everything should be top notch and they are not there, hopefully they will get there.

The nice thing is they are in a good area and centralized to most things.

Was great the past 3 years, but now after the new manager took over it's like you don't even exist as a resident. All messages go without a response, phone,  portal, and email. You have to go in to get any type of response and even then it's not helpful. They won't even address missing mail or let you post on the resident board anymore. The only one who seems to care is Keirra.
I?ve lived here for about 6 months now, and an overall great experience so far. Friendly staff and they are quick to resolve any problems that may arise.

I really enjoy living at Bulverde Oaks. The staff is always helpful and nice. The grounds are well-kept and I appreciate the new lighting on my building as the light across the from my building no longer works. I leave so early in the morning, but I've never run into any issue with safety. A great place to live.

Excellent leasing office manager, staff & maintenance crew! We enjoy our 2 bedroom, 2 bath apartment with attached garage. Our maintenance crew takes care of our service requests almost immediately or within 24 hours. Noise level is okay. Friendly, quiet environment. We have lived at Bulverde Oaks for almost 6 years & love it. Highly recommend the management company start Pet DNA system to identify violators of not picking up their pet poop. It's getting worse, especially with the owners of the very large pets.
It?s great. I rated four stars only due to horrendous parking. There is simply not enough free spaces. Which begs the question if it was done on purpose to sell covered parking and garages.
I?ve really enjoyed my experience at Bulverde Oaks. The amenities are great. The grounds are kept and clean. There aren?t any major safety concerns or unfriendly neighbors. It?s been really great.

The staff was hit or miss whether they were polite or difficult depending on what you were going to them for. If I had an issue, they were rude and not helpful. The couple times that I had to run in and turn in some lost and found or someone else’s mail, they were nice. 

The property could be nice if it weren’t for it being a dog poop mine field. Every section that is even slightly guarded by cars or garages means it was free rein to let your dog poop and not pick it up. The place is also lousy with roaches and crickets. I only ever saw one cricket into the apartment, but walking the dog at night was pretty gross because of the bugs. The location is nice with a couple restaurants a block away.

When we moved in, there was mold growing in the tank of our toilet, which caused mold to grow down in the bowl which required constant cleaning. Additionally, when we moved in, the dryer wasn’t hooked up, which I didn’t notice until the lint started growing up the wall. Getting behind the washer and dryer to clean lint was a pain and added insult to injury when they tried to tack on a cleaning fee for the dryer not having a lint trap that was immaculately clean. Don’t move into a unit near the pool if you need to get to sleep at a time before about 11 since they have people out there blaring music that you can understand the lyrics through the building/windows. 

I wouldn’t recommend getting a garage since my car was locked in 3 different mornings spread over the course of about 2 months, putting me on hard times at work. The specific garage that I had never had a light that worked, the door was missing a key, and had cob webs and a bunch of leaves when I got it. The cob webs and leaves weren’t an issue for me since it was a garage, but with all of the tacky cleaning fees at moveout, I would expect everything that I receive to be clean. Management said they were going to install a key into the door so they didn’t have such a difficult time getting into the garage when I was locked out, but that was never added. My wife asked if we could get a new garage after getting locked out the second time and was told “let’s just see if if happens again before moving garages” (see the staff being unhelpful when an actual issue is present). After the third time, I asked if there was going to be anything done to rectify the issues that I was having being late to work because of the garage and they said “nothing could be done since the problem was fixed.”

The apartment will charge you a lot of money, when you pay the first, the second will coming soon. If you insist on living this apartment, I suggest you request the officer to list the amount in advance

Do not trust any rating above a 3 star. They are written by employees and it's extremely obvious. IF YOURE LOOKING FOR A COOL HIP PLACE, THIS ISNT IT. THANK U, NEXT. The neighbors are old and crochet and extremely annoying.. There's no community. Management is lacking. Lack of parking spots is a huge issue. If you leave past 7 PM, you might as well say you don't live here because you'll have to park outside of your own apartment grounds. Who wants to do that? Anyway, I regret signing a lease here. DO NOT SIGN HERE if youre under the age of 33. This place is completely not a good vibe. If you're an old person above the age of 37 that loves to complain about your neighbors and are elderly then go for it. But if youre a young professional with an amazing job and make really good money, do not sign here. DO NOT.  DO NOT LIVE HERE. I regret signing my lease and am counting the days until im out of here. Peace. ON top of that, the gates are always broken. That and the workout room equipment is broken, children smoke in the break rooms, and the "towels" are filthy and are never washed. It takes management weeks to "wash" them if they ever do. I try and bring my own towel because of how disgusting they are. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

Active duty military,  travelled and moved a lot, the only place I felt I want to make it home forever is Siena on sonterra.  Lovely staff,  new buildings and appliances,  elevator,  washer and dryer in every apartment and affordable prices.  I feel blessed I live here ??????

Beware beware beware these people will steal your application fee of $400 if you aren't careful. We filed an application, paid the fee and then they told us at 5pm that they couldn't run our application or credit check until we providedmore info from our bank. So, as of 5pm July 31 no application had been run for us pending further info from my bank. On August 1st, 10:30am, I go to their office and say that I read their online reviews andneeded to withdraw the application because their apartments just have too low scores from their residents to be able to live there. The office manager said we applied they took the unit off the market so we gave up our $400 dollars. They didn't run our application. The "off the market" comment is a joke because we had no actual unit picked and we didn't have all our paperwork for them to even run the credit check.  Beware.

My sister moved out of her apartment the day her lease was up at this place. Renters  Beware!  
At the start she liked the idea that this was supposed to be a well managed complex , strict on policies and well kept.  She began to smell backed up sewage when she first moved in.  After repeated excuses from management and acting like they had no idea what we were talking about, the repairman admitted it was an issue of defective vents or drains from the construction and a recurring problem throughout the property.  When she confronted the manager, she was rude and saying they weren't required by law to do anything.  She was never able to get rid of the smell and in the summer it was awful.  Parking was a nightmare and often she had to park outside the gate if she came home late.  The last straw was a police raid with 6  cars that lasted a couple days.  Management stayed in their office and people were scared and just wanting to know what was going on.  Not the place she thought it was...

The buildings are old (built almost 30 years ago, in 1996), they have cracks so there are lots of cockroaches and other pests, company is not BBB accredited (I am not surprised), neighbors are rude and unhappy, most of them wont make eye contact, its very loud due to the front street and also, some neighbors even converted their garages into mechanical repair shops (building #12)-good luck taking a nap during the day or going to sleep early at night. Trash is always overflowing, the pool is always "under repairs", the gates never work and are always open, people do not clean after their pets and is smelly, neighbors are not good influence on your kids...the only luxury part of this apartment complex is the frontal office...also, the only positive is that the payment system works really well..and they will charge late fees and move out fees (carpet cleaning, carpet replacement..)

I lived here with my brother a couple years ago, SUPER nice apartments. REALLY friendly staff (I wish I remembered their names) we had an issue with our hot water tank and the maintenance fixed it so great and were so professional about everything. Just wish the 3 bedroom wasn't so expensive. Other than the rent costs, probably would go back..

I've lived here five years and it's the best apartment I've lived in. It's beautiful here, and the staff has always been on top of things. What impressed me the most recently was how the management handled the big freeze in February. They did a good job communicating with tenants through email, and the two times I called with concerns, after leaving a message, my calls were returned within an hour each time. I'm glad I live here, and I'll probably stay here a few more years at least.

I've lived here two years and overall I'm pretty happy with the complex.  The office staff are very nice and happy to help with anything you might need.  For the first two years the monthly rent stayed about the same but my lease is up in two month and the renewal has increased almost $90.  They are starting to renovate some of the apartments, which is much needed, but you have to transfer apartments to get one of the "new" ones.

The entire staff is nice and professional.
They make sure to take care of their residents, that work orders are always done.

I have lived here almost a year.  I enjoy the quiet community and the big trees around building 8. I love the Trash Pick Up and the Recycling programs.  I also enjoy the food trucks. The Bar-B-Que is my favorite. I wish you could bring some fruit and vegetable stands-Farmers Market.  Even a Fresh Peach stand would be great when they are in 
season. I look forward to having my father and brothers over some day. I like that I can walk in the complex. I have own 2 mile walk chartered out. I feel safe here and appreciate my neighbors.  The only thing I would suggeest is hiring happy employees in the office.  The old owners had very cherry and respectful help.  The ones that were hired for Seraphina are not very friendly and are not willing to help.  They need to go the extra mile with a smile on their face.  They don't seem to like their job very much. Maybe they need some incentives for creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. I would incorporate a way for them to make more money by handing out or emailing out surveys on how they helped each tenant and/or potential tenants. They need to see and hear how they make people feel.  If I were to come into Seraphina today, I would not rent here because of the way they have treated me. I want to conclude by complimenting your Resident App for work orders and other needs. It's convenient and easy to use.
Location is easy access to grocery stores hospitals pharmacies airport!

The complex is nice and quite, which is perfect after a long day. The neighbors are friendly. The pools are always clean, and the gym area is well-maintained. Plus added security of night-time surveillance gives me a peace of mind. Highly recommend!

I have lived at this complex for nearly 10 years and the complex recently transition to new ownership (Greystar), changing the name to Seraphina. Overall, I have enjoyed living here despite some problems with crime, gates that do not work reliably, and consistent water shut-offs; however, I am absolutely disappointed after I came home from work to a Notice to Vacate on my door, alleging that I did not pay rent (when I actually overpaid for the month because they could not give me the amount owed because they were switching to a new computer system). When I went to the office to resolve, they mentioned that it happened to some other residents and they were able to "find" their payments, telling me not to worry about it and to come back when the property manager is there. I traced the money order and it had indeed been cashed. You think that they would do their homework before sending out notices like that, especially around Holidays.

I cannot say enough good things about this apartment community.  Stephanie is my leasing agent, and is so efficient, professional, and friendly.  She understood the urgency of my daughter’s need for a quick move from her current apartment. She was encouraging, welcoming and willing to work with me, mom, to assist with the details. Not once was I told I could not be present and in the mix, because I was not going to be on the lease.  The deal was sealed in a week.  I believe Stephanie, literally jumped through fiery hoops to get my daughter the needed apartment in her budget, super-fast. I am truly grateful that this agent stayed in touch with me, updated me and when it was time to sign on the dotted line, explained everything, two and three times to make sure every step went smoothly.  Stephanie, loves her job, loves her clients and her co-workers and believes in her product. It shows in every breath she takes and the courtesy she lavishes on future tenants.
 The apartment grounds are massive, well-kept and updated.  Family and pet friendly, plenty of parking, a playground and gym and lots of area to walk and enjoy the mature oak trees.  The apartment itself is smaller than what my daughter had but we both laughed because the floor plan is so much better designed. It feels equal to or larger. All appliances are new, the carpet is new, there is a sliding door to a small balcony, which I never thought would come with this small space.  Thrilled, thrilled, thrilled. Honestly, while it has only been a week, this apartment community is starting off on a great foot.  If Stephanie is the indicator of the temperament of the office and maintenance staff, this is a 5 star facility in my eyes.

HORRIBLE PLACE TO LIVE IN! These apartments are so outdated that you will face maintenance issues way too often! And when I'm talking maintenance issues I mean poor plumbing (water literally leaks through the bathroom floor),and upstairs units will leak into yours and cause mold. Not to mention, mailboxes get broken into about once a month with nothing done about it. You can request maintenance but they will never show up.
I am happy to say I am glad to be here. The amenities are wonderful and management is awesome! The best part is washer and dryer is included. Convenient and I recommend this place to everyone??

They used to be on top of things. Giving noticed by both text and email but now they come into your apt without a notice or leaving any kind of note and then they decide they are cutting your water for "emergency" reasons that no one is aware of and the rude Goergie in the office says she will be checking on it and in less than 1 second gets back on the phone saying "I don't know" 
Thanks for the notice! 
We sure do get notice on giving away food but not on the important things. 
Thanks for nothing.

Do not live here. I have had 9 different times that my apartment has been flooded due to 3 different issues which to this day only one of them has actually been fixed so I will not be getting water damage from it but the other 2 are still ongoing. I have only lived here for 3 months. The management refuses to be inconvenienced to call me on a weekend even though having my apartment full of water is quite inconvenient. They have never fixed the damage caused by the water either. My apartment looks like a wreck. This most recent incident has my guest room full of my upstairs neighbors shower water and they do not even pay for a carpet cleaning company to come out and clean this filthy nastiness. I have had over $2500.00 of my own personal property damaged due to this and they still refuse to accept responsibility. This should not be my insurances responsibility to pay. It is their blatant negligence that has caused this damage so it should be their bill.

I am not at all happy with my complex. The apartments are very overpriced for what they are worth. The shower sprays all over the bathroom and other tenants I have spoken to throughout the complex have the same problem. There are a few very wonderful people in the office, but the few snotty people make it an unfortunate office to deal with. There is never parking available and I have to walk a very long distance. I am pregnant so that is very difficult, especially when carrying groceries or other heavy things. If you make a mistake or they think you do, they come down hard. However if they make a mistake, they will not try to correct it. Earlier in my year lease I had my fridge randomly stop working. I called the "24-hour" maintenance and they did not want to come help. I expressed my concern because I had no car for a week while my husband was out for work and limited food.  I ended up in tears on the phone and still received no sympathy. My food rotted and I had to go without food for a week. My complex never helped, apologized nor replaced what I had lost. On another occasion during my pregnancy, the A/C stopped working. It was terribly hot and it was making me sick. The maintenance said they could not fix it until the following day. The office did not offer to send us anywhere or to help in any way, leaving a pregnant woman with no cool air. Also, for most of our lease here, the complex has decided to change the paint on the building along with a few other things. While I understand the need for renovation at times, we were not notified before we signed our lease agreement. My husband works nights and sleeps days and the work they did was so loud, day in and day out. We paid to lose sleep, be treated with unkindness and not have parking. I would never recommend this apartment complex to anyone.
Staff did very friendly, apartments are very cozy. It's gated, I feel very safe living here AND they don't have pet restrictions! How cool is that?!

I have lived here for a year. It is very quiet. The staff is friendly. They are updating the development. Great, centralized location. Pet friendly. Fast response to repairs. Reasonable rents. Cons:The cabinets are horrible-- peeling particle board and I don't like walking through mud to get to my car after it rains. Many of the apartments have been updated and the items I am complaining about should be fixed over the next year.

Beautifully designed apartment with decorator touches. I have a washer & dryer in the unit, which I love!  and it saves my time and money. Office staff is professional and maintenance staff is excellent. They are constantly striving to improve. And best of all....pet friendly!!

The Place at Castle Hills is a great environment, staff was very friendly! The apartments are in good condition and have worked out great for me. I highly recommend this property for future apartment finders!
I live in a small one bedroom. It's perfect for one person, limited storage space but over all it's perfect for me.

I've only lived here for a month but I like it so far. I had a problem with a neighbor's dog barking at night and the management handled it the next day. No barking dogs anymore. Complex seems generally safe and well maintained. Not the absolute best in San Antonio but great for the price.

By far the worst apartment customer service I’ve ever had. People in the office never call you back when they say they will and corporate service isn’t any better. We were, literally, told that it didn’t matter what someone in the office told us because of the lease agreement. You would expect though that if you have a question and are given information from someone who works for the company that whatever they tell you is true. We also had a horrible time with roaches while there despite keeping our home clean. My suggestion is to pay more money to live in a community ran by a different management company and steer clear of any Management Support property.

The management is the WORST. The inside of the apartments are nice as long as the pest control is under control. I regret moving here. If you have time to be at the office making sure everyone is doing their jobs, then you'll be fine. I don't have time to submit the same maintenance request 5 times.

We moved in this place 4 years ago.  Was not a bad place maintenance was bad and when i moved in lots of things were wrong but it was temporary and i was willing to deal with it.  In the past I have had realtors try to dry me out and take all of my deposit so i took pictures at this place before moving.  Pointing out all that was wrong.  Then when moving out they charged me anything they can think of and to make matters worse they tried to charge me for what I reported when we first moved in.  I even had picture worked with the manager and then she stated that all was resolved and what was a 1500 bill went down to only charging me to shampoo my carpet.  WELL 4 years later I get a letter from the credit agency telling me that I have a balance that I owe them.  4 years later same house, same number, same email and not once did i hear from them. None of my contact info changed.  It is disappointing that these type of placed take advantage of taking all the money they can out of honest working individuals who truly tried their best to follow all their rules.

I'm an active duty service member and in town for a short period of time for training.  Since arriving i've had issues with the loud neighbors above me and have received no help from management.  Regardless of how many times i've expressed my concerns and the effect that the 24-hour noise has had on sleep and training, I continue to be ignored by front office personnel at management at all levels.  

Please do yourself a favor and find a different apartment complex to live.

I have lived here for 4 years and I love it. The apartments are beautiful and the staff is great. I have never had to wait long if something needed repair but I really haven't had many things go wrong. The area is ideal with so much to do.

The management is here rude and crude.  So is maintenance.  Accuses people of doing things that some other resident is doing.  They had a lot of drug problems when I lived there.   They do not care about there residents at all.

I had no hot water for almost my entire lease - at one point management literally told me to boil water on the stove… roaches everywhere, no matter what you do. Don’t bother putting in a maintenance request, they’ll never have the time to fix it, even if it’s your front door handle falling off.
Bad management, roach infestations and vastly overpriced. Take your pick of bad conditions, they have them all.

Put in applications mid November and was told we were accepted with conditions. No problem with that; I completely Understand that when that happens there’s an extra deposit needed. But when I never got an answer as to how much the extra deposit would be for almost 2 weeks I had to scramble and find a different apartment complex to move to since we had to be out of our other place at the end of the month. Been trying to get in contact with management ever since and they refuse to call me back. Don’t waste your money trying to apply for this place.

Management was super nice but please make sure to ask to see your unit you’re moving into. They showed me a nice unit in a decent spot but put me in the very back where it’s scary, random people walking around all hours of the day, gun shots probably once or twice a week from the apartments across the street. I saw roach reviews about it being infested but I’ve maybe seen 2 or 3 in the few months I’ve been here. Also there is no microwave, and no ice machine. And you practically live with your neighbors because of how thin these walls are.

We love our new place!  Super cute & cozy with wood floors throughout.  Ours is a 3 bdrm flat and feels very spacious!  Especially with the huge patio!  I'm impressed with office staff, Ashley & Paul especially, and maintenance is right on time!  The only downfall so far has been with the neighbors.  One lets the dog poo so when we walk by, we see it and sometimes smell it, gross!  The other seems to have some domestic issues going on and their music is always EXTREMELY loud.  Everyone else we've met seems super nice though.  I do wish there was better landscaping over here on this side of the complex, the non-pool side, but all in all, we LOVE it here.

3 weeks into renting. I have been having A/C trouble for over a week. It gets up to 86° F inside every day. There have been 5 different maintenance techs out, and each one found a huge problem that SHOULD have been checked and fixed before I even moved in. Do not rent here unless you can tolerate sweating through your clothing, bedsheets, couch, office chair.... Office outwardly sympathetic but ultimately useless. No fixes have been offered and several times they failed to send a maintenance tech out at all.

These people charge former residents for leaving the apartments dirty but this charge is just for them to enjoy, not to be paid for cleaning. They also have this unreasonably restricted policy of a 3-WEEK gap between move-in and move-out. They make you live outside of Maverick even if you are just switching apartments inside the complex. They SAY it’s because of the cleaning and repairing. But then you walk into a wreck. They won’t let you see the apartment until you pay the deposit and first rent so you are stuck with whatever they give you. I don’t like moving and I had plans to renew my contract as long as I am here but I can not stand being practically insulted anymore.
This is what I walked into as a new resident: the oven and fridge were left in the middle of kitchen. Their original spots were showing and infested. There was trash alllll over the other floors and even on the chairs.
Long story short, be prepared to move into a slum if you are renting an apt here.

I love the strategic location of this apartment complex. Easy access to stores, restaurants and highway loops and I feel safe living across a police dept, near hospital - the basic needs of life in general. My fave part is the customer service of Diana (leasing consultant) - lovely to talk to, very professional and diligent, which I believe plays a huge part of us staying for another year or more ??

I move in 12-01-2016 one bed room,what i like is assign parking space in carport,maintance personal usually fix things depending what time,sometimes next day and friendly staffs.the only problem had was some guy breaking into mail boxes,so call the police and what i was told they caught the guy.I am glad because this place is quite,nobody bothers you.

The office manager is incompetent, and does not understand rentals laws and regulations. Regardless of whether you've professionally cleaned your apartment at move-out, this place will deduct cleaning fees, and a carpet cleaning fee, regardless of any actual carpet damage. Be prepared to lose a part of your security deposit, even if you're an excellent tenant who returns the unit in better condition than it was rendered to you.

We found mold under the soap holders in the showers, a layer of dust, roaches, pet fur and debris under the washer and dryer, debris in the vanity drawers and a fridge that had been poorly wiped down on the interior.  We made sure to return it in better shape by having it professionally cleaned for over $120 - but were still charged a cleaning fee (despite only living here a few months).
The staff seem very nice and were helpful, but they have dishonest practices.  So, don't trust the friendly facade.  Get everything documented and in writing, because they will ultimately try and screw you.  Maintenance was quick - but required often - as the units are old and appliances are run-down.  Insulation is a joke (we found a window with a large hole drilled through the metal frame and they thought an appropriate fix was to stuff foam in it when I complained) and our utility bills were high for a place this size.  
The grassy areas are covered in dog-poop.  The pool never looked very clean.  Though I don't know if there were break-ins, I did hear car alarms go off at all hours of the morning, and saw signs of what I assumed were theft.  The gates are frequently broken, or left open, so don't assume that this is a secure complex: there's no patrolling of the lots at night, so actual tenants lose spots to visitors.  And, the walls are thin - so you'll hear your neighbors.
Overall, the location may be convenient for some, but the apartments are older.  The month-to-month leasing option isn't actually month-to-month...it's a 60 day notice regardless.  Staff may be helpful and maintenance quick when you live there, but be prepared for dishonest practices regarding your security deposit.

Four months ago, having decided to downsize and move to an apartment, we began looking at what was available near my wife's work. I'm a firm believer in researching online reviews, so when I saw what great ratings The Abbey at Grande Oaks was getting, I began the process of checking them out more thoroughly. I looked at both longterm and newer reviews on several social media websites, and the consensus confirmed my initial assessment. I called The Abbey and went through the application process. The application was quickly approved, and the few obstacles that arose were handled seamlessly by the office staff (Kody, the leasing agent, Marlene, the assistant manager, and Vanessa, the manager). We moved into our apartment in mid-June, and after two months I can say that this is the best apartment complex I've ever lived in. The staff truly cares about the comfort and safety of the residents, repairs are done promptly, and the grounds are clean and well-kept. (Our balcony overlooks the pool, and the landscaping looks like a resort.) Our apartment (a 2-bedroom/2 bath) is beautiful, with spacious rooms, high ceilings and lots of storage. The kitchen is large and well-appointed. (The only minor drawback is that there isn't a built-in microwave, so we had to buy our own.) We love the fact that there is a huge multi-level parking garage and two elevators--both of which make life so much easier. Considering everything it has to offer, The Abbey is surprisingly affordable, with move-in specials, basic cable, valet trash pick-up and lower rates for water. (The required monthly amenity fee of around $70 covers the extra perks--which we think are well worth the extra cost.) Another benefit to living here is the convenient location--we are within a 10 minute drive of most of the businesses we frequent, so we rarely have to get on the freeways anymore--what a relief. If you're looking for comfort, convenience and peaceful surroundings at an affordable price, this is the place!

Poor fixtures, massive roach infestation, apartment wasn’t ready for move instead they renovated the apartment for a month the first day I moved in.Had plumbing issues the entire time.No hot water for a bit over a month.DONT MOVE HERE unless last resort

Don’t move here! Leasing office doesn’t care. You’ll have no ac for a month during a heat advisory warning when legally they need to fix that within 3 days. They Won’t fix anything. Maintenance will enter your apartment for one minute and leave and then close your maintenance request after they haven’t fixed anything and will continue to this for months until you cause a scene. I put in work orders for all of these issues and they don’t fix anything! my tub is still leaking from months ago! neither of my doors close all the way and they just keep telling you to add another work order after work order after work order after work order! I leave in Nov I can’t wait! Don’t move here!

This place does not value their tenants. There is no one available after hours when they say to call if there is a problem. If you want anything that broken fixed don't expect it to be fixed or if it is it will be done very poorly. It takes them days upon days to fix the important stuff. Examples a refrigerator not cooling,  AC not working, water leak from an unknown source, unknown ant invasion in a closet.

The apartment complex office has A LOT of issues that just don't seem to make sense. I am in the process of leasing a 3 bd apt and it has been the most frustrating/confusing process Ive been through. I need 2 more documents approved (proof of hiring and rental verification) to sign the lease, and the emails that are sent from Hunters Glen to various places to be approved never seem to get through to where they are supposed to. Meanwhile Hunters Glen sits back and has does nothing about the situation. I keep having to call and re call these different places asking if they have received an email from Hunters Glen.(Its been 3 days of the same thing). Apparently Hunters Glen has a problem receiving emails too. My rental verification has been sent MULTIPLE times through fax AND email and Hunters Glen says they still have NOT received anything. It just doesn't make sense. If you decide to sign here, be prepared for a horrible leasing experience and lack of communication from the office staff. And I still don't even know what to expect of the actual apt complex.
Black mold and bugs are very bad. Office staff very rude. Service dogs not accepted with proof. Never been treated so poorly. Dont move here!!!

I would suggest don't stay in any apartment around the swimming pool or barbecue area. It's always so noisy sometime until 12 am, 2 am or even sometimes whole night. Forget about getting enough sleep even over the weekdays. Management helped by closing swimming pool at 10 pm, but people will still invite their friends and families from outside of apartment community and keep making noise around the barbecue area. It's affecting multiple apartment buildings around it and management can do very little about it. We regret staying here.

This community is becoming very unsafe day by day. Very dangerous people showed up around our apartment at late night, making loud noise. Forget about calling coursey officer, after so many calls (waking up late night), no one will show up at all.

Management is giving better rent to atract new residents but if you have been staying there for years they will keep increasing your rent. Basically it's a trap, once you sign the lease who you are to them. Plus be ready for mang sleepless nights feeling unsafe with paying more price.

We regret renewing our lease, but this is the last time.

STAY AWAY

I have been here since about the time it opened. I stay because although there are problems from time to time I have been able to work through them with management. Additionally, except for the previous maintenance supervisor who was always in a hurry, was argumentative, and sloppy, we are fortunate to have Javier. He listens, is competent, and friendly. A shout out to Javier and David for helping me today. I really appreciated your going the extra mile. Thank you.

I have lived at this property for 5 years due to the location and sense of safety. The buildings are spread out nicely, so there's always parking available for guests. The finishes are of quality and the convenience of direct access garages is awesome!

When we first moved in, everything was great. Rent was manageable, parking was somewhat easy to find, and neighbors were okay.

Now, our rent has gone up $100 more with the new management and when checking to see what we’re paying for, there’s so many fees lined up. The neighbors below us smoke weed (even though the property is a “clean air community” now) & I can smell it very strongly in my bathroom. There’s been a motorcycle parked in one spot for over a month now, never seen it moved before. Our dryer doesn’t work, even after putting multiple service requests. 

We’re considering breaking our lease early just so we can escape this place.

The staff is always friendly and helpful, but the apartments themselves are garbage. I did not receive a paper to fill out for any damages upon moving in, and stupidly did not ask for one, but the dishwasher has been broken since day one, the paneling of the cabinets is falling off, and the light fixture in the "office" space fell because it broke through the holdings, nothing was attached and I had never touched it. I have never in my 7 years on living in apartments had roaches, but I have found roach eggs and have killed a few so I know there is an infestation, and my water heater sprung a leak, leaking into the apartment below, the emergency maintenance came quickly and were very professional, but said they couldn't understand why such expensive apartments would use such cheap products, and the reason it sprung a leak was that it was faulty. I have only been here a few months, but I will not be renewing my lease.

Do not live here at all if you expect to have any peace and quiet. I have been filing noise complaints with this apartment complex for over 8 months and still nothing has been resolved with a barking dog above me. It will bark late into the night when the owner isn't home until 3 or 4am. The apartment complex says that they will do something about it, but 8 months later and nothing has come of it. Save your money and your sanity because the management team is horrible and doesn't follow through if you need help with something.
The office staff are all very friendly and accommodating and I am so far very pleased with my experience here.

This place is nightmare to move in, EXTREMELY disappointing customer services, they do not care about their customers and start to throw they’re face attitude. Im living in this complex 2 years and had been STOLEN in my apartment and they be like they didn’t care about the problem of their property and it happened many time in this property apartment complex, the front gate is usually open. Absolutely NO more renew contract with this Apartment Complex. Please stay away from it if you want to be safe, they look for your money not like your are the customer.

Firstly, parking is miserable. If you plan on getting home after 9:30 pm you'll have to park outside the leasing office. Once, my roommate had to park in front of a trash dumpster because there was not ONE open spot on the property.
Secondly, the management company is a mess. The management in the leasing office is great (only because they understand the people they work for are not so great). 
Example: I was told to take down my outdoor, white patio lights or I would get a fine. The on-site management said to take them down for a day while they inspect then put them back up. 
Overall, the unit is nice and there's a great dog park. If crowded parking and management instability is your thing, you'll love it here.

The unit they gave my wife and I looked pretty good. We had a plumbing issue occur and we called the emergency maintenance line after hours and spoke with Robert. He was great as he advised me what to do to stop things until he got there. Showed up 10 minutes later. Polite professional, fixed the issue and cleaned up everything and advised us he would follow up the next day to make sure there were no other issues.

First of all the fact that the main office keeps replying to these reviews with "please contact us directly" is laughable because there is zero way to contact the office - the phone is completely automated and they won't reply to emails or voicemail. I understand they had a recent changeover in management but I would have thought that would have been rectified by now. 

Most of the amenities they advertise have not been operational for some time: the work out room and pool have been closed since at least the pandemic began. The laundry room is hit or miss and is frequently flooded. 

The gate system is annoying- instead of a code, there is a buzzing in/phone system that is confusing for some people, and doesn't do much to keep out unwanted people, as we still get religious solicitors, and advertisements and flyers on our doors. The back gate by the park gets stuck frequently and they removed access to the pedestrian gate that faces Walmart: this causes those of us that need to get to the bus stop to have to walk through the unlit park in the dark. I'd understand the inconveniences if the gate system did add security, but considering solicitors are still able to get in, I'd say it doesn't. 

Yes, there are good things: I've never had a problem with my immediate neighbors and I've never personally dealt with theft or break ins, and I've been here six years. The times I've seen signs of danger appeared to be results of personal or domestic disputes. It can be hard to find a balance between safe and affordable and this location does fall in a good place between the two (particularly in a big city like San Antonio), which means a lot even when considering all of the above. I'm able to get to and from work and the store without a car, which is more than I can say for other complexes in this area of San Antonio. 

Take my negatives with a grain of salt: like I said there's been a recent change of management, and it appears they read these. Let's hope they take it to heart.

We’ve lived here for 1 year and a half and can’t wait to leave. The manager Sandra is the worst and most unprofessional apartment manager  I have ever met. While speaking with her about a complaint she interrupted me twice to take a personal phone call and motioned for me to step out of her office. I waited 10 minutes for her to discuss her home remodeling. Afterward she had an attitude like she didn’t want to be bothered. She has a bad reputation in this apartment complex and god forbid you ever have an issue to speak to her about. Before you can even speak to her the front office staff needs your name, apartment number and the reason for your visit before she will even see you. There have been a lot of car break ins but the front gate is always broken and left open for anyone to come and go as they please. The parking here is always full. If you leave after 8pm, expect to park far away. The compactor is always breaking and the trash piles up. During these times they tell the valet trash service not to pick up your trash but they do not credot you any of those days since it is a monthly fee included in your rent. There is also a weird pest control issue with silverfish. Since we moved in we have seen them around the air vents mostly which leads me to believe there is an issue with moisture somewhere. They say there is a courtesy officer here but I have never seen one. I once called the emergency courtesy officer and no one ever responded and the issue was never resolved. I know from other neighbors that have moved out that they will add bogus charges even if you clean your apartment and professionally clean your carpet  in amount less of $380.00 - $800.00 on average. For the price of these apartments in the Medical Center you can get better quality, security, and professional management else where.

The Villas at Medical Center appears very nice. The units are all nicely maintained, abundant parking spots are available, and the rent is a reasonable price. But their MANAGEMENT IS THE WORST and they are so DIFFICULT. We were charged a total of $800 upon moving out for absolutely ridiculous things. We had the unit professionally cleaned and returned the unit in the EXACT condition we received it in, if not better-- yet they still found random things to charge us on. We spent 2 months after moving out questioning why we were charged so much but management took over a month to get back to us and also failed to provide sufficient reasoning for why we were being charged. I would not recommend this apartment complex to ANYONE. Please do yourself a favor and live elsewhere.

Got same experience like some mentioned here. They sent me $400  after I moved out. Rediculas.. I cleaned apartment pretty well but they just said thr were some marks on wall, carpet ..bla bla bla... 
I will not recommend anyone here.

I got MILITARY ORDERS TO PCS and had to terminate my lease early. They kept losing my orders. The office staff are clueless! Even on the day of move out the office manager had no clue I was moving out and couldn't find it in my file. Every time I came in there to talk about my orders and early termination the staff could not answer any questions. They took my entire $300 deposit and claim I owe them an additional $44. I had a carpet fee which I expected because I didn't clean the carpet. The cost to have the carpet cleaned was the same charge as the complex so I had them take it out of my deposit. i had an expected exterminator fee of $50 which is written in the lease for dogs. They ripped me off of the rest of my deposit claiming they needed to clean my apartment for $100 and repaint the entire apartment for $65 due to "scuffs." They sent me pictures of 3 small scuff that cost $65. In my inventory I reported some black marks and scuffs already but they charged ME to repaint the walls. They also sent me a picture of my "filthy" apartment that they had to clean....the dirty edge of the washer and stain in the dishwasher which resulted in the $100 clean up fee. My apartment needed a spot cleaning AT MOST. THIS IS RIDICULOUS! Carpet; $90 Clean up fee: $100 Paint walls: $65 Exterminator fee: $50 Water bill for last 2 months: $43

Office team is good and helping. Apartments are fine not very good. 
Worst is maintenance. It sometime takes 4-5 days just for small things.

The area is very nice and so are the neighbors. Maintenance is very quick to respond, however every summer I had to submit multiple requests for my A/C unit. My number one complaint is the management of this complex, I was a tenant for 4 years and have had numerous problems with management including losing my package but more importantly I had the worst move out experience ever. If you do decide to move here make sure to turn on all of the lights and note every detail you see that will cause you to not get your deposit back, this complex is known for trying their hardest to keep your deposit and I didn't know that before moving out. In my opinion there are much nicer and newer apartments within a few blocks radius that you should consider. These apartments are old and haven't been renovated in many years, the most recent change was painting the exteriors.

I reside in one of their one bedroom apartments. I love the modern appliances, the high ceilings, the quietness of the neighborhood and the all around look of the property. It's a beautiful place to live. I don't believe you can find better for the price anywhere else.
Thank you Miranda for all your help in making this move so smooth! Enjoying this beautiful apartment that my husband and I now call home. We appreciate your help!
I viewed the website and was very impressed, I then contacted community and spoke with Nike, she was very informative.  My family and I will be visiting Lookout Hollow next week.
Amazingly professional, attentive, and knowledgeable staff. I could not be happier with my decision of moving here. LOVE the doggie parks, too!

after an awful experience at Cityside apartment complex in Alexandria va it was wonderful to move into Lookout Hollow. The neighbors are friendly the staff is great and on top of things and it's such a nice place to live. Both the community and the structure/build of the complex is just great!

Lived here two years now, I've enjoyed living here.  I feel safe living here, never heard of any break-ins/robberies on the property. Have accidentally left my apt & car doors unlocked over night and no issues. Did experience some issues with delays on maintenance calls last year but no problems this year. I would recommend this complex.

apartmentName: Los Cielos at Brooks Luxury Rentals
review: Karissa and Charles is very friendly and provided excellent service to us.No matter what help we need and what time they are always here for us.And Bobby the maintenance guy is a super hero.All 3 of them deserve a raise.Thanks to them for all the hard work they do for us

The worse part about the time living here was by far the speed bumps. Any dirrection i went, on the less than a quarter mile way to my apartment from the front entrance, there was a minimum of 6 speed bumps. and terrible made ones. not to mention the pot hole in adition another problem was the gate. the thing was constantly broken leading to repetative traffic jams.
 The staff is polite but hard to work with. We had to make an edit to the lease and it took them almost 6 months to make this change. They would constantly forget what they had been asked to do and tell us the task was waiting on us to do something, when it was in fact them. The move out was also a difficult process as when i had questions instead of reading and responding they sent me a chat GPT response and were too lazy to write a 3 sentence email themselves.

This place is a joke, from management to maintenance to living. Negligence is massive throughout and they make excuses for everything. They charge you for everything eventhough on walk through they tell you it's fine. The apartment wasnt clean on move in, wasnt even painted or holes filled in after they charged the previous resident 
carpets and floors where messed up then they charge me $500 when i move out.  I cut my lease short 6 months but if I didn't have to give notice I'd have been out months ago. The worst place I've lived. My Neighbour was a living hell and this place gave me so much anxiety.

My husband and I moved in two years ago as newlyweds. It was our first apartment together and we've loved our first experience. We had the Serafina unit. The complex is so close to the Forum (lots of restaurants & shopping) and great highway access to get anywhere in San Antonio. Definitely consider renting here! And talk to Amber in the front office!

My boyfriend and I live here and at first it was great but since the new management it has sucked. Our upstairs neighbors blast their music and are loud 24/7. We have tried asking her to turn her music down and discuss the loudness but every time she says “I don’t give a f***” we have called the courtesy officer and she has told them the same thing. We even have a police report stating so. We have emailed the front office and they never respond. When we go to the office to discuss it they always say the manager is too busy to talk about it and resolve the issue. Very inconsiderate for someone who works from home and has to deal with it on a daily basis. Our other neighbors dog is left outside and barks at anything and everything and their patio is covered with dog poop. This dog wakes us up every morning with his barking. We have also filed a complaint against this neighbor too and they have done NOTHING about it. There is always trash piled up next to the dumpster and it smells so bad. All of the trash cans on site are always filled, never taken out. There is dog poop all over the premises that is never picked up and it’s DISGUSTING. When we moved in most of our doors had holes in them and they just painted right over it. Our back gate is high and our dog can escape and it has not been looked into. The appliances are outdated and need to be replaced. The walls are so thin you can hear everything your neighbor is doing. I do not recommend moving here. The worst apartments I have ever lived in for sure.

Opposite of luxury living, neighbors are rude and loud and management will not do anything about it. They will not respond to your emails or phone calls you have to go see them in the office and they will lie straight to your face and do nothing. Garbage is piled up high by the dumpster every week like it’s a dump and it smells bad.  Gates are always broken and anybody can just walk in. There have been shootings here and is an unsafe uncomfortable place. Dogs will bark constantly everyday bc people just leave them out and management is incapable of handling their community. Would not recommend living here unless you are a loud Inconsider person who doesn’t care then it’s perfect. Would give zero stars if possible.

Overpriced for what it is. Just a budget apartment with makeup made out to be "luxury living.  Walls are so thin you can hear what your neighbor is watching on TV. There's years of grime just painted over.
People drive recklessly through the lot, once my car was hit while parked, yet there's no cameras to assist in any investigation. Mandatory garbage fee for a service that only shows up 75% of the time.  Their automated payment system failed to take money out of my account two months in a row, and they acknowledged the issue was on their end, yet there was still an eviction notice sitting on my door when I got home from work.
Oh and when its time to move out, they will charge you $50 to take 5-10 minutes out of their day to do a  rental verification for the place you're moving to. I've lived in nearly a dozen apartments in my lifetime, and never once have had to pay for rental verification.  
Way too many issues with this place to justify the rent prices, and then the nickel and diming on top of that adds up very quickly.  Look elsewhere.

We first really liked the location of this place but they were all over the place. Took weeks to finally see the unit we were gonna move into, they showed us demo units and other units but never ours. When they did we found 3 roaches all in different rooms, less then 5 minutes into a freshly renovated and “move-in” ready unit. Barbara assured me that the roaches are active because they’ve sprayed pesticides 3 times in the three weeks it took to get the apartment ready for my and my family. When I asked her how they were still getting in she let me know no apartment is 100% sealed. They kept trying to have us sign the lease before viewing the unit and we are so glad we didn’t. Would not recommend.
Mrs Argentina has always been so great helping me out with any questions I have. She is very nice and friendly.

Only good thing is location. Fleas, dog poop and trash is a big issue here. Its embarrassing when you drive in and see trash all around the one dumpster they have and junk cars in the same area for over a month. Staff does nothing about it .  No control over pets, poop, and fleas as you walk around.

New manager & office staff don't care about current residents! They just focus on renting all of the vacancies! Garbage everywhere! Sewage system has backed up at least 4 times this year! They eventually stop the flow but leave the human waste, toilet paper etc. all over the parking lots. People, kids & dogs drive, walk & bike through the disgusting biohazardous pools! Can't wait to get out of here!!

This place is trashy, there are water leaks, mold, crackheads, break ins... the new manager isn’t helpful at all, none of the staff know how to answer even the simplest questions and the police are on site every day for one reason or another! Do not rent here!

Horrible ! I moved in March of 2021, starting off all of March no hot water ! Took maintenance forever to fix the issue let alone the front office to notify maintenance, moving forward, the ac vent in the master bedroom barley blows any cold air, I have a newborn at home and I can’t have it uncomfortable! I’ve been waiting for a toilet seat since mine has been messed up, the Sheetrock is still not repaired and is now forming black mold in the inside !!! The washer was replaced and still has no cold water or hot water so that leaves me to find time with two kids at home to wash clothes ! So do yourself a favor and stay the hell away from here, front office does not care about your issues, and will just give you the run around.

Please read the reviews on Google and the Better Business Bureau before considering this property. A troubling pattern is evident: whenever there’s a negative review on Google, a positive review about the management team quickly follows, creating a misleading impression.

To briefly summarize my experience: I was late on rent, and the property manager, Jorge Juarez, refused to accept payment unless I paid the overdue rent plus 75% of January’s future rent—this happened while it was still December. I informed Mr. Juarez that this condition is not outlined anywhere in my lease agreement and that he cannot legally enforce it. My concerns were met with silence, and he stated that he was unwilling to resolve the issue. I escalated this matter to Quantum Leap Management and its leadership, Leslie and David Shippy, but have yet to receive any response.

Beyond the management issues, safety is a major concern at this property. The mailbox area is frequently broken into, an ongoing problem that has not been addressed with preventive measures. The complex is a hotspot for criminal activity, with no security cameras and a gate that breaks down every 2–3 months, leaving residents vulnerable.

As for maintenance, the reality is far from the glowing reviews. On average, it takes maintenance two weeks to close a ticket, but my most recent request took over two months to be addressed. This delay is unacceptable and reflects poorly on the management’s ability to support residents.

In short, Broadstone Colonnade fails to provide a safe, transparent, or responsive living environment. I cannot recommend this property to anyone.

Moving in: was scheduled to move in March 3rd of 2023. I called and let them know we would be delayed and the office said that was okay and that everything would be ready when we got there. Once my husband and I showed up after moving from Iowa they said the apartment wasn’t ready and that they would have to find us something different. After multiple hours we were moved to a new floor plan. Due to the delay we had to sit outside with a U-Haul holding all of our belongings and our cats had to continue to sit in the car for 3-4 hours. Very frustrating first interaction after they knew we weren’t even going to arrive until after our actual move in date. Then when we did finally move in and were doing an inspection and taking photos, we realized the apartment was very over priced, borders were missing, walls were chipped, the front lock wasn’t aligned, an outlet was removed from the kitchen wall, along with other issues. At this point we just didn’t want to be homeless and moved in taking photos of everything.

Amenities: we moved in in March and were informed we would receive a clicker for the gym and front gate in March, July, October, and December. Finally got one in December shortly before we ended up moving out and never was able to use the gym. Also mail was horrible, the mail room would often not be secured inside and you would be able to completely open a whole wall of mail and anyone who was in the mail room could access your mail. As well as for any large packages, you got to pay a nonrefundable fee to obtain a locker!

Employees: employees do not help with issues unless you call and email and text and follow up at least 2-3 times. They are almost never in the actual office and leave multiple times through to day for showings, staff seemed understaffed, unknowledgable, and just not helpful overall.

Moving out: apartment does not take normal wear and tear into consideration, should’ve taken more and more photos as soon as we moved in as we did not receive our deposit and was expected to pay close to $100 due to a stove and oven that had staining as well as the bathtub peeling (due to cheap materials and paint used) peeled within the first week of moving in. We left the apartment cleaner than when we arrived and still owed so much.

Management changed multiple times through our lease, the front gate was broken half the time, neighbors are loud and disrespectful during night hours.

These apartments on the first floor will flood with heavy rains. Creating water damage to the apartment complex. Renters insurance will also not cover damage caused by flooding. Outside of the apartment complex always smells like dog poop because none of the residents pick up after their animals. The gates are always broken. I’ve had my car license plate stolen. Management will give you a lame excuse for not giving you your security deposit back. The Maintenance does not know how to fix anything. They constantly need to call an expert in. If you don’t mind your apartment unit flooding every time it rains and never having anything properly fixed and not getting your security deposit back then this place is great for you.

The cleanliness and organization of the office and brilliant staff. The grounds are kept very neat, neighbors that I interacted with while on my tour, were friendly. The apartment was everything I dreamed of while on a budget. This property is Very peaceful
I've been here since 2008. I've gone through several management changes and this present group by far is the best.
It's nice for students but not for working professionals. Too noisy. Too many hooligans.

Cons: 
Gates are always broken (cars are broken into).
Dog park fits 3 dogs. 
Management never answers the phone.
The pool is always dirty and the deepest is 4 feet.
Cleanliness in the hallways is nonexistent.
Dog poop everywhere. 
Poor enforcement of consequences for broken rules. 
Parking layout and design is terrible. Good luck finding parking close to your apartment after a long day at work - especially if you live at the back of the property.
No cameras (terrible security)
There is a fee for EVERYTHING along with rent. 

Pros: 
Apartments have very nice with awesome layouts and the area is very convenient. (Many restaurants, stores, etc.)
Prices are excellent.

Inconvenient work orders are held off, vague answers are given from leasing staff, package room has a code, but not monitored, front gates are constantly broken, pool is not kept clean - in pool, bathroom, etc., communication from management is sparse, spell errors and unable to read announcements on certain devices, backside of property is not closed off, unable to keep track of which vehicles are residents vs. visitors, poop bags for dogs aren't always in-stock at stations, Security is only for outside observing and reporting, they go to their assigned stations throughout the property, then off to their next location.
Management, pool is filled with people who don’t live here until late hours, security NONE, gym is very dirty.

Excellent choice for the 151-side of town! My sister lives here and that's why I decided to move in. 

Units have granite counters, black appliances, and great layouts for every need. The gym has the latest equipment and the resort-style pool is fantastic for year-round use. She did have a noisy neighbor once but management intervened and hasn’t been a problem since! Management responds to maintenance requests promptly, keeps the grounds looking nice, and makes improvements wherever needed (i.e. speed bumps were added recently). All office staff were nice when I applied and answer all questions you may have.

This complex is one of the best places I have been. It is a friendly and quiet complex. Management gets back to you in a timely manner whenever I have questions. Maintenance is very well kept up with , and whenever work orders are placed it gets done almost instantly. The gym is 24hrs and has a kid area! That is my favorite part of this gym! My kids love all the breeds of dog we see as well as playing outside, we have not had any issues with any residents not picking up after their dogs.  We have been there going on a year and just renewed for another year!!

It simply baffles me when I read such negative reviews. I have lived here for almost a year and have never had any major issues. Of course there is little stuff from time to time like parking, dog poop, and neighbors but this is an apartment complex you can't expect perfection! And whenever I do notice these problems I call into the front office and they take care of it for me, as simple as that. A new company took over about a month ago and this place just keeps getting better and better. They are having more resident events, taking care of the community more etc. For the people who complain about prices, it's literally the same at almost every apartment complex in this area probably even less! I love this place and they have been so good to me since I've moved in, the front office staff are awesome makes it feel like home.

Terrible management! My balance is never updated on time, so I never know what my rent amount is till the 3rd. Cars and buildings are getting broken into. There are all these extra fees that have been added that are misleading, non negotiable, and not worth it. Looks nice at first, but lots of unspoken downfalls. I find myself warning people not to fall for the looks or rent with this place. Not worth paying for covered parking if the cars get broken into. Not worth the pool or gym, if it's always "closed for cleaning". Not worth washer and dryer in unit, if I have to pay extra and I can't even opt out. Not worth looking nice on the inside, if there's always cops and management doesn't even know why.

Bad place to move into lots of construction on roadways,behind and In front of apartments. The Apartments living room flooring are prone to gathering bugs and insects due to small openings and old wooden “tile” which I’ve dealt with spiders and ants biting my children. Some Other tenants claim to live here a couple years now and dealt with the construction the same. It does not look like it will be done with anytime soon.

On the website it clearly states that electricity is included in the rental amount, however upon calling they told me that no utilities are included, and that an additional $100 "Water Deposit" was required in addition to the Application Fee and Security Deposit.
Every time you actually get a hold of them they hang up or they just leave you on the line. Suppose they need the money.

BEWARE OF BUGS! I lived in building 3, 3rd floor for a year. 
 1. Building three needs so much cleaning. it constantly is dirty and smells whereas building one is so clean and smells great.

This is the second time living in these apartments. The property owners have been nothing but nice and respectful. And are always on top of things. The buildings may look old but it is nothing compare to the inside. They have done some good upgrades. The property is always clean. This is a very quiet and peaceful place to live.
Rude management, old draft apartments, and roaches. Don't rent here.

When my lease renewal came up, it was an easy decision to sign for another year. The entire complex, including the grounds, trees, pool, gym, and laundry room, is well-maintained. Added bonus— the laundry prices are cheaper than any of the laundromats in the area. The office and maintenance have always been very prompt and professional regarding any concerns. The apartments themselves are a bit older which means the insulation is better (I have never heard my neighbors), and the architectural design creates natural wind tunnels (as opposed to the giant block style of newer apartments where it gets stuffy). The unit upgrades are well done. The balconies are massive—certainly the largest I’ve had in any of the apartments I’ve previously rented. Surprising amount of storage as well. Large patio doors and windows allow for a lot of natural light. It’s a very quiet complex (in part due to the fact that there are no dogs allowed), which is a welcome change.

The area itself is very walkable. All necessary amenities (HEB, restaurants, department stores, mall) are located within minutes—either by walking or by car. There are also several schools in the area if you have kids. A big bonus is that Phil Hardberger Park is a five minute drive away.

All in all, it’s just a great place to be.
I love living here, the staff is nice management is excellent!!! The apartments are spacious and clean compare to another's I lived in. Overall this apartment complex deserves 10 stars.
I love living here! Lamaie and staff are amazing. Maintenance are always there when you need them .
Do not rent here. You will most definitely regret it!

Couldn't be more disgusted & disappointed. Trash! They wouldn't give me a mailbox key until I turned in their move-in checklist. Once I turned it in it took 2 weeks for them to 'create' a maintenance ticket to fix all the items. One of my main concerns is no weather stripping all the way around to the front door.
