Roaches everywhere! Hard to reach staff! Mailboxes were removed onsite for a while.  Pool is filthy.   Potholes all around parking areas.  Trash overflowing.  Water pipe breaks guaranteed every month so no hot water on many occasions.  No lights or ceiling fans in any room.  I moved our asap after lease I was tired of seeing roaches everywhere.

Lived at Avistar on the Blvd for 3 years, moved out October 2023. Contemplated leaving a review, would have left 3 stars. You get what you pay for, low price, low quality, but great location, staff is not rude or unhelpful, but lord can they not get maintenance requests done. Went without a flushing toilet for 5 months before moving out. Called and emailed about it to no avail. The three stars would've been lower were it not for the positive experience I had in the first year and a half living here. But management changed, and you know how the story goes. The straw that broke the camels back in leaving this review: Paid the amount owed after moving out, which was reasonable for cleaning charges, not overcharged. Paid before the given due date, have signed receipt. Yet they still sent that statement to their collections agency and now I get to spend my holiday season proving that I don't owe a debt dealing with debt collectors. Save yourself the headache, pay $50 or $100 more in rent to live somewhere nicer and don't get screwed over as you leave. 1 star for you Avistar.

We've been here two years now and have received little communication from the office regarding the availability of facilities. The winter storm and aftermath left many without access to water and laundry, and timelines were not clear as to when they would be fixed. The grounds are not kept well throughout the year. Twice, packages have been left at the office and no effort was made from the office to contact us and let us know before they were closed for the weekend. The hot water has been out more than a few times without notice and AC unit replaced or fixed at least twice in two years. We treat the unit frequently for small bugs. Cars have been left on blocks with no tires or wheels on occasion, which makes me wonder if we should worry for our vehicle. Upon renewal, two different prices were communicated by the office. The price and location are the only good things I can say about this place.

If I could do no stars, I would. There’s roaches all the time. The leasing office doesn’t listen(just a few of them, the rest are fine). The ice storm(Feb. 2021) knocked out plumbing to the washers and dryers. It’s still not fixed (April 2021). The owner sucks. They’re not offering any reimbursement or discounts for the inconvenience. It also just isn’t a safe complex. Don’t come unless desperate.

I was in search of an Awesome Property with a Fire Place in an Exclusive location in this Popular Tourist City Of San Antonio  3 years ago, I discovered ( via internet ) " Avistar On The Blvd. Apartment Homes " ...  I've lived here comfortably with courteous kind and friendly neighbors for three years... I rate Avistar On The Boulevard with 5-Stars ... Mr. Bryant - Suite   412 ...

I lived here for three years and loved it at first, then management changed and the quality of resident’s lives plummeted. I have voiced all the below complaints to staff and not a single one was addressed or fixed. The maintenance team is awesome, but their resources are limited by the office staff. I wouldn’t rent here if Francis Properties is still managing.

Pros:
• Location is awesome
• Cheap for where it is

Cons:

• Staff WILL nickel and dime you. The online payment portal was down when rent was due, I provided screenshots of their website not working to staff and they still charged me a late fee, claiming that I could have paid with a check, even though I was out of state at the time.
• You can hear the highway all day and night.
• The mail frequently gets stolen.
• Car break-ins are rare, but the complex doesn’t do much to prevent it
• The staff changes codes to gates and doesn’t notify residents

• Not nearly enough space for pets

I’ve only been here a couple months and had only a few requests. But when I have, they were answered within a day usually. Todays request was handled the same day! They are very helpful and courteous. The other staff are great as well and always willing to help.

Not safe at all. Someone stole our car this morning and thankfully our car has the tracking system and we were able to find the car! They didn't caught the person though but this place is not safe at all. Both gates in front were open early in the morning we waited for it to be closed and it didn't so anyone can just pop in! Mail center break ins like 3 to 4 times this year with "security cameras" and haven't resolved this??? so whats next? Entering inside our apartment??? This is negligence! Oh but they love to charge us extra fees right? So frustrating! We are waiting for the offices to open for the report.

I lived in a 1 bedroom and a 2 bedroom of the the course of 2 years here and I can honestly say you will not find a better apartment in San Antonio, or the state for that matter, for the price. I did have some very minor issues, but that happens when you're renting rather than owning and think things should be done a certain way.

Staff - 4.7/5- You probably couldn't find a more knowledgeable staff or friendly staff. That includes everyone from the property manager to the groundskeeper. The only reason I did not give a 5/5 was because I had issues with the move-out process, both times, that I didn't agree with. After sitting down and talking with the staff they saw my side and I saw theirs and we were able to come to a mutual understanding and agreement. As an additional note, I can be particularly difficult to deal with when I feel I'm being taken advantage of, but I commend the heck out of this staff for being able to handle it in the professional manner that they did.

Location/appearance - 5/5 Located right next to The Rim, La Cantera, 6 Flags, and Top Golf with 2 grocery stores right up the road, this location especially in this area is perfect. My wife and I had everything we needing within a short drive. The property is very well maintained. There are a few times when "Pet droppings" got a little out of hand, but the office sent out notices and the issues was usually resolved with in a week.

Parking - 4/5 I personally didn't have an issue with parking unless it was an over packed Saturday, but I did notice other parts of the property that were limited in available parking. Not a huge issue.

Maintenance - 5/5 This really gets a 10 out of 5 because that's how good this maintenance team is. Most of my work orders were fixed within hours, granted 99% of them were simple fixes, but even the big projects took less than a week. Apparently our tub was leaking on to the bathroom below and we didn't realize it. The maintenance team found the problem, resurfaced our tub/shower and patched the hole in the wall in less than 72 hours. I cannot say enough about these guys.

Conclusion- You WILL NOT find a better apartment in a better area for a better price than this place, and believe me, I tried. Everywhere else is over priced for the quality and size.

Vista Ridge is the best apartment complex I've lived in and there has been many. The staff is very friendly and are ready to answer any questions or concerns that you have. The complex is very clean and the apartment floor plans are very spacious and can accommodate anyone's needs. I would definitely recommend this complex to anyone who is in the market for a new place to call home.

On your drive home from work you end up getting cut of by at least three other drivers on I10...one of them almost took out the car next to you as well.  This is a typical drive, but work was long, and youre pretty tired.  You glance over at the traffic going on to 1604 and smile.  At least you dont have to sit in that for 30 mins!  You continue on I10, and take the exit past the Rim and La Cantera Pkwy.  Easy, no traffic, and no lights.  You ride on the access road for a couple minutes and notice they are putting in more high-end restaurants and yet another shopping center.  At least your little sister will have something to keep her busy when she visits this year.  You pull into the U-Turn lane, bypassing the lights, go under the highway and turn left into your apartments driveway.  You reach for your remote and drive slowly pass the gates as they close behind you.  Home.  You park the car and gather your computer bag and purse.  You turn off the car and walk towards your building... which only takes two seconds because there is always a couple parking spaces right in front of it.  Walking up to your second floor, two bedroom unit, you can hear voices coming from the pool area and smile.  Maybe I'll go for a swim today, you think.  You enter your little haven and the tension in your shoulders relax.  All the stress from the day is left outside.  You are greeted with loving meows from Felix and his brother Oscar as they rub against your legs, glad you are home.  You place your computer bag on the built in computer desk and decide to ignore it until tomorrow.  You walk into your vinyl floored kitchen and run your hands on the smooth, cold, granite counter tops.  Oscar jumps onto the counter and leans into your face while Felix meows at the balcony door.  You walk over to open the balcony door and see your neighbors car pulling up.  He waves as he exits his vehicle and you smile back.  You sit on your Adirondack chair and stretch your feet out infront of you, enjoying the view of the hill country and lack of a city presence.  You close your eyes and sigh.  Home at last.  What a day.

In one instance I said my food disposal wasn’t working I didn’t even have to fill a work order ,maintenance went right over and fixed it. Leon valley police always in the area also security at night .

Do not waste your time or money getting reeled into this place. I have spent an entire miserable year dealing with 88 instances of no water or no hot water for multiple days since the day I moved in a year ago. Apartment is roach infested. Water is constantly being turned off. Neighbors are loud, by loud I mean frequently having pool parties at 2am on a Wednesday! Maintenance rarely fix anything. Office management is rude. Please do not move here!!

DO NOT MOVE INTO THIS COMPLEX.  Sometimes you have water, sometimes you do not.  If your air conditioning unit breaks, you will sleep in 90°  heat until they feel like fixing it. Amazing staff , always willing to help with an issues you may have. The maintenance team works wonders and is in out in no time. The apartments are up to date very roomy and with wood floors, very spacious. I've lived here for 3 years and by far the best apartments I've ever lived in. The floorplans are spacious. And the neighborhood is safe. And prices are great!

Since I have been here things have gone smoothly. Great laundry facilities , pool, fitness and business center. Always quiet and whenever there is an issue in my apartment it is handled ASAP by our friendly mantainance.

I just love this place! It's the best place in the area. I have lived here for some time and moved into a upgrade apartment. It looks amazing, with the new black appliances and wood flooring & blinds. I can get over the face lift around here. The office looks great and you should see these new pools and gym. It's open 24 hrs.
If you are looking for free parking and quiet place that you can be proud to call home. Call my apartment home.

Hands down, the best place to live. Great management, amazing neighbors and top notch maintenance. Very communicative and responsive to any and all needs. There is a great sense of community. The residents are shown appreciation on a monthly basis.
These apartments are very high quality and comfortable. I’m enjoying this community a lot so far!

The park at Braun Station has just been a wonderful place to live.  Very quiet.  The grounds are well maintained.  Beautiful oaks throughout the property. The pool is always clean.
The staff are nice but the apartment structure is cheap. Just closing door shakes the whole structure. Gentle walking disturbs neighbor.

Great apartments i stayed here going on 3yrs, its a little expensive and small for the price. but overall its quite, comfortable the neighbors stay to themselves, and most of all it's close to major shopping areas.
Landera management and maintenance staff are very friendly and helpful. The community seems to be quiet and peaceful. The apartment is very cozy and spacious.

Lovely place to live. Staff is professional and friendly.
I have been here going on 8 yrs now and my loft has become my home. It is quiet, neighbors are friendly and the grass is green!!

I've lived on property for a while now and love it. Everything I need is close by, HEB, the airport, 281 and downtown. The staff is amazing and friendly, you will always see the manager always coming out to greet you no matter how busy she is. The maintenance guys are nice and come out quick when i have a work order. I have renewed my lease for another year and happy to stay. Overall, this place is great and thanks to Amy and her wonderful staff!
I love these apartments. The staff is amazing. It is very quite I would definitely refer these apartments

I agree, 100% with the review posted on June 12, 2023 with the title: AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE -HORRIBLE, and all the things stated. This has been my favorite complex to live at by far. The neighborhood is quiet, and the amenities are nice. Management has always been great, but they've recently stepped up their communications and events, which has been great.

I've never written a review of a property, but my experience has been so poor that now I feel compelled to. They constantly have issues with their payment portal. The second month I moved in their payment went down, and then they did not sufficiently notify residents that they would have to pay via money order or check. The day the rent was due I attempted to pay through their portal, and it was down. The following I went into their office and let them know that I couldn't pay via their portal. They said, "yes we know, that's we are giving residents until the end of today to pay via money order." I let them know that I could get a money order after I get off at 6 pm and slide it under the door. Their response was "no that won't work because we have to process it by 6 pm." So I ended up having to pay a late fee of nearly $200. I made a complaint to the property manager. The following month, when I went to pay my rent via the portal (which supposedly had been fixed by then) my account showed a credit of nearly $200. I assumed that they reversed the late fee (which was their fault, to begin with). That's not what they did but remember that part. I paid the amount due for October. November came around and I paid an extra amount that month so that I would have to pay less in December. Nope. I get my bill for December and it's nearly $200 more than what I owe. Remember that "credit" on my account? Apparently, that credit was from "utility charges". Somehow I got a credit from "utility charges?" It doesn't make a ton of sense. Also, they double-charged me on many of my amenity fees. A staffer went through and removed the double charges, and my rent was still higher than it normally should be. Their poor communication on the issues and their constant problems with their payment system make it extremely difficult to track your personal finances. It's all over the place. I highly recommend against moving here. This has been the poorest rental experience I've had. I've had discussions with my neighbors and they all agree. Trust me, It's not worth the headache.

Our experience with Hillstone at Prue was unfortunately a nightmare.  There were too many incidents to recount, but here are the worst ones.  There was the ongoing situation of only one dumpster for the entire complex, resulting in the nauseating stench of trash continually piled up outside the overflowing dumpster.  There was the pool that was left to grow nasty for a couple of months, despite many complaints from tenants.  The tiny, inadequate fitness room had dirty, dated machines that often didn't work.  There were unsavory tenants who partied, had visits from the police, and knocked on our door, apparently high, around 3 am.  The event that forced us to move was this: In Sept-Oct 2015, with temps in the 80s and 90s, our AC unit failed 13 times, switching off for periods of time ranging from hours to days.  Despite 3 written notices and many verbal notices to management, they took an interminably long time to respond to most of the AC outages, leaving us without AC for extended periods as long as 2 1/2 days.  When they finally responded, they failed to have the AC attended by a professional, instead, having their maintenance people make unsuccessful attempts at repairs. Management knew my husband was recovering from surgery and was extremely uncomfortable with the heat and humidity, yet ignored our requests to bring in an expert to properly repair the AC.  When they finally ascertained the problem was a failing compressor, they told us they would not replace it until it totally failed, despite the facts that we were suffering and that the failing unit was drawing a great deal more electricity than normal (tenant pays for utilities).  According to Texas law, their failure to respond enabled us to terminate our lease and move without the usual notice.  However, this was at great expense and inconvenience to us.  Management has failed to respond in any way to our requests for reimbursement of moving expenses.

I have never had another manager provide me with her personal number like Katherine has. Everyone is awesome. If anything breaks it gets taken care of immediately. Everyone is so nice and polite. I definitely love this place. I'm a complainer but I have no complaints here.
Very bad Manganement team,Unsafe community living experience and Theft of packages. I do not recommend anybody to move to this apartments.

The walls and floors are too thin and the neighbor’s are inconsiderate with their music and partying. I never slept well. They charge for trash valet service but it is anything but valet. They show up at 9:30PM and throw everyone’s trash cans around in the breezeways and leave them laying there. You are expected to put your can away by 9:00AM or they will actually FINE YOU $25. They for you to use their Spectrum package which was more than twice what I was paying on my own. They for e you to pay your rent via their resident portal and charge $35 service fee, or you can be highly inconvenienced and have to go pay at Walmart or HEB and the service fee is a bit lower. The hot water doesn’t ever truly get hot. I don’t recommend this place.

Great place to live. Here is just one of many reasons why. I'm very impressed with Eddie and Pedro, the powerhouse maintenance team! These guys are on top of it and were get to the core issue and fix anything that needs it. They get it right the first time around. They are very respectful and always smiling and waving at a member of the community. They call me by my first name, and that's impressive! 

All in all, I feel like I'm at home with at Firewheel

Christina was the best leasing agent i have dealt with ever! Very nice and Welcoming! She had a lot of information. She even called to thank me for going on a tour! Katherine the property manager was very nice too!
This place is beautiful and has amazing people running it!!!

Due to my work schedule, I was not able to be home to receive a heavy package. Management helped me by holding the heavy package for me and have the delivery completed. I have heard the apartments/ managements do not hold receive heavy packages like mine, thanks to them I could have my package in time.

I moved in about four months ago and so far my experience has been excellent. My apartment is beautiful, modern, and spacious. I fell in love with from the moment I saw it. The office staff are amazing. Katherine and Vanessa are the best and always happy to help with whatever the issue. The grounds are absolutely beautiful and well kept. Best of all, it’s pet friendly. My dogs have had a wonderful experience. My neighbors are friendly. What can I say, my experience has been amazing. Thank you Katherine and Vanessa for making first-time apartment experience so great.

I visited Firewheel last weekend to look for an apartment close to the medical center. I love that they're just minutes from where I work. I was really impressed with how the complex looked and was kept. Everything appears very clean, new and nice. The apartments I viewed were updated compared to a lot of other apartments in the medical center within a similar price range. The kitchen granite countertops and new appliances were a plus. I am really excited to apply here and hopefully call this place home!

Please note that most of the 5 star reviews on various sites are not by residents but by people who are touring the community and who are give an application fee waiver if the write a positive review.  The management has to do this so that they can counter the negative experiences of the people who live here.  You should definitely question any company that has most of their reviews from potential rather than real residents.

The grounds are not clean.  There are piles of trash near the stairwells and in the halls that will sit there for weeks at a time.  The dumpsters overflow and trash gets tracked all over the parking lot.  The shower water temperature fluctuates wildly over even a 15 minute shower.

The management is the worst part of the whole experience.  They are condescending and rude.  They don’t care about keeping people happy once they are here.  They only care about luring people in and then everything becomes about squeezing as much money from you as possible.  If you intend to live here, ask for a full explanation of all of the fees upfront.  The rent seems reasonable but by the time all the fees are added, you will be looking at several hundred extra dollars per month.  And they have clauses in their leases that say they can add technology packages in the future that are mandatory.

These apartments are in great proximity to the medical center and restaurants. The customer service is awesome, the homes are contemporary with newer appliances, and some of the apartments have small yards! The fitness center has a stair master and a squat machine. I totally recommend this apartment complex!

THE REVIEWS ARE NOT ACCURATE, you are given an application discount for each application if you write a review and show it to them.  You cannot accurately give them a good review if you have not lived at the apartment. I was asked to screen shot or email the review when it was completed. My review was based on what I saw, but then I experienced  different staff with different rates. STAY AWAY

My boyfriend spoke with Lacie and she was very helpful and informative. She showed us several rooms and we found the one that fit our needs, even offered us a good deal! Not to mention the complex is new and appealing.

My roommate and I were searching for a new apartment for a while. Luckily one of our friends had recommended Firewheel to us and we went there to see the apartment and checkout the prices. We met Leasing Agent Lacie. She was really helpful. She showed us 2 apartments and the amenities and gave us a good deal.  We are looking forward to live there.

This is not a nice place to live people!! 
We have new management and they are changing a lot of stuff around and not for the better.
First of all, it seems like everybody hates you, they give you a bad face and an attitude... they're just nice on tours, when you move here you'll see the difference.
They are closing the community bathrooms after business hours, so if you’re at the gym and need to use the bathroom, you gotta go back to your apartment, good luck if you live in the far building!
We used to be able to rent the club house, new management came and now we dont!
We used to have a lot of fun events, they fired the people in charge and we've had no events.
Yes they have very low rates, but have you stopped to think why? BECAUSE THIS PLACE IS SO BAD! 
There's dog poop everywhere and the common areas must of the times are dirty.  
Once you move here, they stop caring about you and raise your rate. 
There are a lot of better places to live around the same area that offer more for what you pay.
Right now management is just desperate to get new residents and are offering deals, but just for the new guys, the ones that have been living here get the overpriced deals, seriously, live elsewhere!

I signed 3 leases with Firewheel Apartments over the course of the past 2.5 years, and boy have things changed over that time.

Pros:
- Maintaince is fantastic. They are responsive and friendly
- Amenities are very nice and kept (reasonibly) clean
- Offer a choice of internet providers (Spectrum and Grande Communications)
- CARES team does a fantastic job of community events to bring neighbors together

Cons:
- DO NOT LIVE HERE IF YOU HAVE ANIMALS
	There is a $300 'fee' per pet for....nothing? On top of $15/month per pet for rent, that also covers...nothing? They take that money that  one would think cover any pet incidentals, nope. You'll still get charged on move out for that. Oh and you want to stay in complex and change units? Yeah, that fee will need to be paid again.

- They do not give you all addendum's when signing the lease
	I had to terminate my most recent lease early due to a job relocation. Read through the lease and thought it was pretty straight forward. Nope, there's a separate addendum for that. Would recommend anyone wanting to live here ask for all addendum's upfront (even if you don't think you'll have to use them) just so you're fully aware what kind of shady practices they do here.

- High turnover for front staff
	Over the course of the last 2.5 years, 0 people I moved in with are still working upfront

- Get everything in writing
	Lesson learned the hard way, some staff will say something just to get you to go away.

- Undersized AC unit in 2br/2bth (or really poor insulation)
	AC would constantly be running just to keep up with cooling the space

- Suspicious activity after hours
	A few cars on my side of the complex were keyed, packages were stolen from front doors

Firewheel apartments are not bad but overprice. The complex is brand new and the apartments are aesthetically appealing but there are some issues with the workmanship of the apartment, which I have been told is possible because the complex was built fast and that construction was probably rushed. A hallway light fixture that is located in my apartment's indoor stairwell fell over and broke while I was laying in bed not long after i first moved in. I also had a co-worker who lives in the same complex who showed me pictures and told me about the ceiling of his apt cracking down to the wall! he had to move his family out of the apt. 
The good is that they generally do provide a fast turn around to fix stuff when you put a work order in. Also, I have not had an issues with pests inside the apartment. The only pest issue  I had were  waterbugs in the attached garage and they all died after pest control treated the garage. 
The complex feels safe and it is a gated community, also each apartment has its own alarm system that you can set up if you wish to. 
A con is that maintanence  comes in fairly frequently to check apts. and they often come when residents aren't home. You also have to pay a monthly fee for the required valet trash service, valet trash is not optional. Which would be fine if I was home to use it, I work nights so I am often not home in the allotted hours that you are allowed to put your trash can out for the service .
 All in all, not the worse apt  complex but it is pricey for the size and quality of the apartments.

Great location, maintenance team is reliable. However, the interior & exterior smells like poop on a daily basis because tenants rarely ever clean up after their pets, also the amenities are modern and not so appealing. Overall, this property can use some minor upgrade.

I would not recommend others to move here based on my horrible experiences. I do not feel safe in this apartment due to less than a year after moving here my car as well as other peoples cars have been broken into while parked inside the parking garage. The parking garage gate has not been operating for months. This allows for criminal activity to take place inside the apartment garage. Secondly, my car got towed last night due to "double parking". The white lines on most of the parking spots are hardly white now, they are barely visible. It is hard for myself and others to be able to park properly due to these lines not being visible. I am a resident of this apartment and pay for a parking pass, I should never have to worry about my car getting towed.
I would recommend because the office staff has always been friendly and respectful.
Rent in comparison to other areas nearby is better
Besides a location and price range been great, the staff is welcoming
Area seems dangerous but the closeness to downtown makes it convenient.
Everyone at the office is nice, rent is a bit over board for an apartment, but I’m working hard to keep a roof over my children head as a single mother. Besides that, great area. Thanks
So far my stay here has been good. The only thing that would make it better is if the gym was remodeled with new equipment. There is only one treadmill that works and very few weights.

The unit is beautiful with the exception of various minor imperfections/damages. The many amenities and great location are a huge plus. We just moved in, but we can’t wait to see how resourceful, tactful, and helpful the employees are
I love living here. It's very quiet and luxurious. The pool is amazing. They gym is amazing. All the amenities are fantastic. I also love the valet trash service as well

:

"Beautiful and well-organized, with all services available. The management is professional, and maintenance is available at all times. The housing is also close to schools."

Great community the office personnel is great very attentive. Moving into echelon is the best choice I made. The beautiful amenities is just a cherry on top compared to the home and peacefulness that’s come from this great community I’m grateful to be apart of.

Once you sign that lease the only thing management is concerned about is collecting your rent and do not care about you as a resident. I have had so many issues with this property after only living here for 3 months. The rooms are so run down, many amenities are broken, the landscaping and grounds look horrible, the gates are constantly broken so we have had cars stolen, windows shattered, and things stolen from the yards and balconies. Maintenance is questionable. There is nothing luxurious about this apartment. All those good reviews you see on here from a few months ago were all posted on the same day, they are fake! This place is way overpriced for how run down it is. There is nothing luxurious about it, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere as you can get something so much nicer for the same price. They also screw up the rent amounts and fees each month which is super sketchy, I constantly have to bring it up to them because they try and overcharge. I so wish I could rewind time and never have moved to this place, it has been nothing but a headache. PLEASE do your research and stay away from Legacy Heights.

I would give this place zero stars, but obviously that isn't an option. Since the day I moved into this place, it has been nothing but an issue. If you have a maintenance issue, don't expect anything to happen anytime soon. You can submit your maintenance request on their portal, but it doesn't receive a response unless you physically walk into the leasing office and ask about it. And even at that point, you may still not get any action taken. All they tell you is that there has been a change in maintenance and they're having issues or the truth will come out and they will tell you that they currently don't have a maintenance supervisor. Which honestly shouldn't be the response any resident should receive. I've seen a total of about 2 maintenance workers zipping around in their golf cart, but nothing ever seems to get fixed. There are a multitude of lights out throughout the complex as well as issues with the gates in and out of the complex not working or not working properly, which to me is a definite safety concern. It's great that they allow pets, but there are no consequences for tenants who don't pick up after their pets. I've seen one tenant let their dog on their patio to do it's business, then sweep the poop out into the grass. In what world is this okay? And I'm not talking just a one time poop. Like a weeks worth. I have neighbors that have no respect for anyone else as they decide to slam doors and scream obscenities at each other late in the evening, but apparently this is acceptable as well. One of their main amenities is a BBQ lounge with grilling stations which haven't been operational in the time that I've lived here. And "newly renovated" means they spray painted your apartment and didn't tape anything off in the process. You will find paint overspray on everything, including appliances.

If you're looking for a place to live in San Antonio, keep looking. There is nothing LUXURY about this place.
Christie gave me a walk thru into my apartment and the process to move in was quick and easy as my family transitioned from another state

I have been living in this property for 4 yrs and moved around to diferente units. The roaches ?? are real and pest control has come by. I am a neat freak and have all my food in containers but the roaches just continue to come by. There has been a hole in the roof by my balcony for about 2-3 yrs I have sent pictures submitted work orders and nothing - still there 
My fridge makes rumbling noises at night - submitted a video/work order maintenance came by and said everything is fine. My dish washer doesn’t dry so I have not being using it for the past 2-4 yrs. have been hand washing my dishes as i clean them better that this old dishwasher. It took maintenance more than a month to even change my air filter. For all the fees this property has and rental  price it is definitely NOT WORTH IT - 
Also the gate breaks all the time so the property is left unsecured- oh and yeah my vehicle was stolen from the parking lot by the mail boxes - so yes whoever keeps writing that this place is secure - it’s a complete lie I constantly see homeless roaming around trash containers

With myself being in the military my whole life and my fiance being a clean freak,  a cockroach infestation was the last thing we expected moving into so called "luxury apartments." upon contacting the office who we pay for pest control they let us know the exterminator will be there in 3 days.  Not ideal, but i digress.  The Friday comes along and the exterminator doesnt show, i took leave for the day and i even contacted the office to see when he would show. got told in the morning, when noon hit got told by 4 p.m,  after that timeline,  the office girl stopped guessing and just said "thats weird." it's now Sunday, the office stopped returning my calls. i expect more for the price of a 1 bedroom apartment that they charge.  but the leasing office just got renovated, so that's cool for them.

Legacy Heights is an incredible, inclusive and secure place to live in! As a single woman, I feel safe in this community. The staff are welcoming and helpful and my neighbors are great. This is the perfect community for young professionals, families, military, and everyone in between. The location is great because you have easy access to most major highways, places to eat, and grocery stores. Maintenance requests are promptly and correctly taken care of. I've loved being a resident of this property!

Lived here close to a year and already thinking of renewing my lease. Owners are really making these apartments look a lot better and I really enjoy the upgrades done to the gym room. Very quiet and comforting apartment complex suitable for all. looking forward to another year.

Have been here for over a year and have to say I feel at home!  The office staff is nice and helpful at any time you go in.  Maintenance is always so quick to resolve any problems you have.  Have not had an issue with management nor maintenance since living here.  They make you feel at home with the events they occasionally have.  Property is well maintained along with gym and pool.

Apartments are nice and cozy.  You never have a parking issue!  The area is gated and very well lighted.  The location is convenient.  You have H-E-B, Walmart and Target right down the road.  Plenty of restaurants and places to go within a few minutes.  Not far from 410 and I35.  

Come check them out!

I really recommend living in theses apartments! The area is always kept so nice and clean, the office staff is very helpful and polite and the maintenance is always so quick with any problem. I have currently been living here for a year and would not want to live anywhere else. It has been amazing and I always recommend to everyone! The rent is not too bad and is quite affordable. The area is gated and very well lighted so it makes you feel safe. These apartments are also in a very convenient location in Alamo Hights with H-E-B and Walmart down the road. They have a lot of great amenities such as a pool and work out area and there are always a lot of fun activities to participate it!!

I started having problem with the internet since they did the community wifi service.  Every month there's an issue of 3-4days without internet and it sucks if you live here and you really need internet for school or job. I don't think they are making this a priority specially almost the whole community losing wifi service.

Even with military orders they made me pay through the end of the month and did not try to be amenable to my situation. As a good tenant I would've expected some understanding. The gym needs some more updated equipment (especially treadmills). Otherwise it was an ok place to live with maintenance responding to requests within 24 hours

For the last 3 months, this has been home. My apartment is well laid out, clean on move-in, and maintenance responded day of move-in to my only concern. The area has been quiet and apartment community is kept clean outside. I feel comfortable taking my dog out in the early hours and late at night. The complex has a refreshing pool, nice dog park, and impressive fitness facility for an apartment. If you are looking for an apartment in the area, I would definitely consider Legacy Heights.

Just moved in, so far so good. Very clean, quiet, nice area with lots of stores near by. It's gated, so that's good. The pool looks clean. The staff was very helpful and friendly throughout the entire move in process, very willing to work around our schedule. Looking forward to living here.

Wonderful staff. Resort style pool. Gym. Grills. Gated Community. Pet friendly. Kids play areas. Comfy low key community close to Ft. Sam Houston and many major hwy's and shopping areas. Perfect location. Loved it here!

This is the perfect apartment if you want to live near the Alamo Heights and Pearl area of San Antonio but don't want to pay a crazy high price.  My roommates and I have loved living in our current apartment for the past few years.  We have always felt both safe and near fun.  The apartment maintenance staff is extremely responsive and prompt (after submitting a maintenance request, I think they have always fixed the problem within 24 hours).  We have had a few problems with the online payment system, but other than that, we have had a blissful experience.

This place is really great. The pool is stylish, the community is active, the grounds are well-kept, there's a mini-dog park on site, gates at all entrances, there's a club house with an open kitchen, one gas and two charcoal grills by the pool- it really has it all. The staff is very friendly. And the apartments themselves have a cool, modern, yet unmistakable Texan feel.

Noisy

The floors are not insulated to block out upstairs noise. I moved in 3 weeks ago and I can hear every single step my upstairs neighbors make, which starts at 5am. I was told this wasn’t going to be an issue prior to moving in. I went to office on a Monday to inquire about switching units since I had just moved in, and it took until Friday (and me calling every day until) to get a response from the front office. They told me that I would have to wait 6 months to change units due to fairness, which makes it seem like this issue is a common one. They kept emphasizing “quiet hours,” but I’m not seeing the relevance of hearing footsteps all day all the time. Poor construction is the problem, not the tenants. Walls are also incredibly thin. I can hear my next door neighbors watching movies to the point where I know exactly what they’re watching. I live in one of the larger units so I pay a fair share for rent, and it’s a shame that I will not be renewing at this property after my lease ends, considering I had planned to stay here until I was finished with school in 3 more years.
Customer service is great and property amenities. Recommend. A bit pricey but nice area.
Excellent service.   The team is polite, professional, and competent.

I chose this place for the great location downtown and the nice amenities and continue to stay because it feels like home to me now. Modern appliances, study rooms downstairs, and quick maintenance service are my favorite parts of living here. 
Cleanliness of the common areas, limited parking spaces, and noise from upstairs neighbors are some challenges of living here. Overall, my experience here has been positive.

Honestly the best experience I've ever had with an apartment complex. the staff is attentive, thoughtful, and extremely helpful and upfront about everything. It was a breath of fresh air after our previous experiences.

The amenities are unbeatable, especially the fitness room, which has a lot more equipment than most apartments, and the individual offices/workspaces downstairs. Also, the: pizza ovens outside, the multiple grilling station, the large pool, outdoor terrace, the beer tap (although it’s often empty), the coffee station, the bike storage room, and the rec room which is open 24/7.

A few improvements that can be addressed: the hallways should be vacuumed and cleaned more frequently, the beer tap is almost always empty, and pet owners here sometimes don’t pick up after their pets, but that’s not management’s fault. 

I love loving here, the fact that I enjoy having friends and family over, and that I’m literally in walking distance to an HEB, the river walk and downtown. This is the best place I’ve lived in.

We needed to keep our kids in the same school until the school year was over. We decided to rent a one bedroom apartment at SYNC at Nobu for three months. We DID NOT live in the apartment. We just paid rent. I took pictures and did inventory and emailed to the main office. The apartment was dirty inside and the balcony had bird poop all over it.No big deal for us since we weren't living there. Fast forward- Time to turn the apartment back in. Well they did the walk through and we informed them we didn't live in it.
Everything seemed fine. Well they sent us a bill for $70.00 for  power wash for a carpet never used. Then we are given the whole thing (it is in writing). We didn't sign our inventory form that magically is not available to them bc you have to come in and have leasing office and you sign it TOGETHER.  Amazing how they follow protocol at the end but not at the beginning (where papers need to be signed)
So *****WARNING****
if you decide to rent here:
* You will get a dirty apartment
* The only clean and nice place is the leasing office
*You WILL get charge power wash for a carpet not used and a
service never done.( I did get a dirty apartment)
*The interior of the apartments are really worn down
*They are quick to send you to collections for the power wash scam. I am sure they have a few others up their sleeves.
*Make sure Leasing office and you sign the Inventory sheet at the beginning. (They will pretend they never got it)
***I hope my experience helps you ;)

Just moved out of our apartment. We didn’t have  issues while we lived there. Once we moved out, we were sent photos of items that were left in the closet. One of which was a file that had tax returns, photos, birth certificates, Etc. I immediately called them, and they said they threw them away. How can they just throw something like that away without contacting me to let me know it was left behind. I realize it is my responsibility to remove items but mistakes happen, and things are crazy when you’re moving. Now I have to worry about my personal items floating around. A little common courtesy, and a simple call could have resolved all of that. I have been in that same industry, and I would never throw something like that away without contacting the previous renter. When we called they simply said we forfeited our items. This is the worst customer service and just plain lack of human decency.

The area is ideal and cost per square feet is good for the area.My problem is the waiting for repairs that STILL need  to be done on my home due to the February winter storm. The damages not done by me just a casualty of the snow and freezing temperatures. The management on this process has been HORRIBLE. It feels like you are being penalized because you don’t want to  or need to transfer to another apartment. You want to rely on your apartment property management is being truthful when they give you a date of repairs to start and almost two weeks later NOTHING has been done, NOTHING, not one start of any repair. You email every day that no repairs have started just to be told it will the next day and still nothing. You email on April 14th and 15th just to no get an out of office reply that the property manager is out for a few days.Yet I should just transfer to another unit and be thankful for the 2 week credit as informed by the apartment property management and their executive management when the concern with them shares time and time again is I want to go back to my home, the one I have continued to pay for. And to be honest the two credit was not a two week credit since that credit had to be applied to the pro rated rent to a apartment I don’t really want to transfer to. This Apartment Company  set this advertisement that you should make their complex your home but have shown no desire, urgency or effort to get me back into mine.
Breath of fresh air dealing with office staff.  Beautiful apartment, just the right size for this bachelor.  Pool is an accent and gym is nice and adequate.  Overall great place to live... no bugs.

The breezeways arr filthy they NEVER clean them. Dog excrement frequently found on sidewalks. Little gym with equipment that is old and worn. Useless! Super thin walls can hear neighbors all around me. That includes everytime they flush their toilets, turn on a faucet, converse, or have sex. Yes I'm serious it's annoying. Office staff is not helpful when they decide to answer the phones and maintenance requests zzzz..... You've been warned!

Its very noise and smelly and not that clean based on the price you pay. Office staff is friendly but that;s it. Dog poops are all over the place lacks orninance and supervison. Not recommend it and the price point is not right

I had some move out charges that i agreed to pay to the previous owners but during transition to the new owners, nobody got back to me in MONTHS via email and they wont agree to take it off my credit report. VERY unprofessional of the management. I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT! I also always had a bug problem in my apt and the cheap laminate floors and countertops were already lifting up because it was bad quality! Save your money, move elsewhere!

I moved here when it was brand new. I was the first person to ever live in my apartment so I thought it would be great. It was expensive, but I was willing to pay a bit more for a really nice place.  Well, I lived here for two years and regretted extending for that second year almost immediately. The walls/ceilings are so thin you can hear everything, and I had very loud upstairs neighbors.  The other problem is bugs. I was in an apartment at the back by the greenbelt and during the hot summer months, mainly August & September, crickets would come into my apartment by the dozen. Bugs can get into the apartments through the A/C vents, don't ask me how but my next door neighbor and I both saw them dropping out of the vents. It got pretty gross. The breezeways in the buildings looked like a great cricket massacre had taken place - dead crickets by the hundreds, and they only rarely got cleaned.  I could have put up with the upstairs neighbor stomping around like an elephant, but having crickets and scorpions as roommates was a deal breaker for me. The apartment looked great, and it was nice to have a washer & dryer in the unit.  Most of the office staff were nice (except one who I believe is no longer there) and maintenance requests were handled timely.  I had my own parking space (paid extra for a car port) and never had any issues with parking.  Overall, it could have been great, but they really dropped the ball on the bug issue.  If you decide to move here - get an apartment on an upper floor away from the trees.

My boyfriend and I moved into here together. We moved in here in 2013 and have lived here going on 2 years. They're so beautiful inside and the neighbors there really are your neighbors. Everyone is so friendly. The staff up front are the sweetest girls I've ever met, they help you with everything you need. The 24 hour emergency maintaince is the best! They're pet friendly as well, they even have a small dog park for your dog to burn some energy! It's also great to go running/walking around. We've never had problems here because the staff is really the best.
The Staff is always very helpful and kind. Many times they have gone above and beyond for me.

Had high expectations for my new apartment. Constant issues needing maintenance to come in and out of my home for the first year. Management companies has changed three times, the last time without notification. The pool is beautiful but not family-friendly. On any day you will find a lot of nonresidents, alcohol, and smoking in the pool. This continues often until the late hours at night. Rent is insanely expensive for the community you're living in. I expected more. The worst part is the paperthin walls. Typical apartment living with one of the highest price tags in town.

Having lived here two years now, I would definitely recommend Nobu Station.  The place is quiet, well maintained and the staff is super friendly. I've only had a couple maintenance requests but they were done within 24hours! Overall the price is fair for the amenities and apartments.

Have stayed in this apartment for a year. Everytime I needed work to be done It gets seen on time. I recently had my AC literally frozen while I was out of state and when i arrived and saw the problem, they fixed it the same day. I have no problems with neighbors. There is ample parking right at my building. I also like that the complex is just across the street from the fire station. Right now there is construction in front of the apartment for Dunkin Donuts and Baskin but it looks like it will be finished soon. I will be renewing my lease soon.

NoBu Station—this is a great place to live. Here's why...the apartments are nicely designed, never hear my neighbors, the grounds for the most part are taken care of. Every time I go to the office the ladies that work here are so friendly and fun. 
One complaint—the outside—stairs have never been cleaned. I do wish that would be cleaner. But like I said, the apartment itself is wonderful.
The administration people are a little rude, there is very little security, the gate is always open, many cars have been stolen and no one gives a solution

Living at the apartment is okay, anything that malfunctions the workers will do their best to fix. 

However the administration does a substandard job
1. If you want your security deposit back, it took them 3 months after departing to tell me I owed them.

First of all, just a little bit about myself. I am a first time apartment owner, look at a lot of reviews, and try to give the most objective perspective as possible. My initial thoughts of the Montecristo apartments were that it was outstanding. I have been here for 6 months, and will be renewing my lease. The staff is responsive, the maintenance are friendly and competent, I feel safe here, and the price is great. The location is great, they have occasional events, like breakfast by the gate, food trucks, Italian ice, and coffee. It is a quiet complex as well. I cannot think of any legitimate negatives that were not addressed by the staff. Perhaps, it is a older complex, my dishwasher wasn’t working, but it was replaced within a week. I wish there was a formal walkway route within the complex. And I wish my apartment complex was handicap accessible. Overall, I love the culture at this complex and quality. I recommend this apartment for friendly individuals and families!

I’m about to move and I still highly recommend. The dollar-to-square foot cost is unmatched for Stone Oak. Immediate access to 1604, minutes from 281 is already worth it. Maintenance and landscape is on point and no issues with pests. Sound hasn’t been an issue except for my upstairs neighbor’s heavy footsteps. Mostly families live here, so it’s pretty quiet, and the school bus even stops at our complex. The pool is awesome. I want to note that car “break ins” were rumored to be at vehicles left unlocked. They have since set up security cameras and I live near the courtesy officer - yes, he exists and is SO aware of everything going on, it’s kind of intense. Residents (at least around me) are conscientious about noise levels, picking up after their dogs, and helping each other out. I got myself a carport, but scope out buildings with ample parking nearby.

Having lived at the Montecristo for 5 years, through a series of unfortunate events I renewed my lease for another 18 months, a decision I will regret.
A rash of weekend car burglaries-never addressed by management nor Francis Properties, a stolen mail box-never addressed by management nor Francis Properties.
Currently a management team full of smiles and empty promises.
As a retired educator, an active yet independent over 60 person- I have been treated horribly by management. While going through a difficult time no compassion nor empathy from management. 
So if you are looking for a complex that doesn’t take criticism well, stay clear of Montecristo. They are mean spirited and vindictive.

Hello, This is one of my first time ever writing a review. I moved out here a couple months ago from El Paso, and I have not regretted it at all. I am very picky when it comes to housing and I saw 25 different apartments in person and this was by far the best. I really didn't think customer service was a big thing, but anytime I have a problem or a question they are very friendly. As far as the people here living, its pretty chill. Good people. I feel at home, and the area is amazing, I love stone oak and this location skips a lot of traffic going to and from work which I love. All in all, great move. Thanks and hope this helps anyone who is looking to move. (I am 23 years old, just graduated college, good job out here in SA, just in case you were wondering my background).

Yes the apartments themselves are nice but the management is lacking. Since I've been her (1year) they have already gone through a property manager. This was my first apartment and a month into living here,we encountered bed bugs. Never had bed bugs in my LIFE. We are near the trash which brings rodents out at night. They tried to pin the bed bugs on us but were unsuccessful. The apartments are very crowded and parking is not enforced so everyone and their friends park where ever. Our AC went out and was putting out a burning smell after hours. We contacted the emergency line but we're told since its not 80 degrees outside, it's not an emergency. It seems they try to get people into the apartments but don't try to keep them to stay. These are the big problems we have had. It's been a terrible move out experience. The reviews are good but when you start talking to people that have loved here and other properties, you'll get an understanding of the many on going issues with the property management.
Very nice and beautiful!, first floor, light, big spaces, love the pool area.
Excellent  apartment, wonderful ubication,  a very nice place to live.

I moved here about 5 and a half years ago. I thought it would be a tough change, going from a house to an apartment, but I ended up loving it even more. Gorgeous pool, friendly staff, monthly community parties, beautiful amenities, 24/7. It is also in a great and convenient location right off 1604, less than a mile from Reagan High School, and next to a plaza with restaurants, a health care facility, and a delightful coffee place. If there is one complaint, it is that the gym machines are often out of order. Other than that, I am happy. I enjoy going to the pool the most, and so do my guests. They are always wanting to come over on hot, sunny days.
Apartments on the north side of San Antonio. Awesome Floorplan with the option of a garage. Gated community.

Apartments are very comfortable with the amenities,  makes it feel homey. Whenever you have a question or concern, staff is fast with answers or a remedy.  Very proactive too. Washer/dryer connection,  ceiling fans (of course ac/heat, dishwasher, etc.) Was the only apartment I felt at home in immediately when I was looking. Location is great too..close to major highways and attractions.
The most welcoming and accommodating staff I've ever come across. The location of these nice apartments can't be beat!

The location is good for a quick escape to the highway. However, this is a two-edged sword because the ambience reflects with the highway noise in the background, although not too bad. Having lived here a short time and not seen what happens here during the summer, I cannot describe this. I am leery about the potential noise from crumb crunchers and later in the evening, drinkers hanging out. I've noticed on a couple fair weather weekends that we had, the drinkers were out and as usual they get loud and do not realize it. And of course, the cigarettes come out.

The floor/ceilings allow sound to penetrate. If someone upstairs has heels and doesn't walk properly, she'll sound like a Clydesdale down below. Maintenance is good in the daytime.

Other problems occur, and supposedly they have a courtesy person on duty for important problems. I think this is a bunch of hot air. I've called for a couple of bad problems, one even involved calling the police, but I received no call back from the management office that night or the next day. They're alright with maintenance, but typical with any management company, when it comes to rule enforcement, they fold.

I spoke with Ashlynn originally and she is on her stuff! She gave me everything I was wanting in an apartment than less than 5 minutes. I have spoke to everyone in the office, they are so nice and very professional. If you are looking for an apartment in this area I would suggest going here! It is amazing! Thank you Park staff for everything you do!

Park at Briggs Ranch sponsored a community get together yesterday where residents could bring their pets and get treats and toys and such--all for free! It was so much fun meeting everyone, playing with their dogs, and generally having a good time. I even met a lady who offered to come to my apartment and clean for me anytime I called her. I recently lost my wife to cancer and I live alone, so this offer is very much appreciated. I am 67 years old and have never lived in such a loving, caring community.  The Garzas are also amazing people, and are well suited for this kind of work. But thanks to Berkshire for fostering this kind of community.

Park at Briggs Ranch is Simply The Best. I Appreciate and Love each one of the staff! They are wonderful & Amazing. Alexis ??who helped me with everything and she is beyond amazing, sweet & Kind. No complaints whatsoever towards the Apartment itself. I Highly Recommend it. No regrets :-)

We moved here in January and unfortunately it has been nothing but a bad experience. We have had problems after problems with this apartment and the community. This is my absolute favorite apartment complex ever, and I've lived in some nice places and some terrible ones.

Besides the quiet, quality living spaces I am ultra impressed with the office staff and maintenance crew.

I've NEVER had an apartment team care this much about our satisfaction!

Honestly, I don't ever want to move and I hope the team never changes!

Mundo and Edward are super responsive and kind when we have maintenance needs, too. They are awesome!

This apartment complex is hands down the worst apartment complex I ever had the displeasure of living at. The managers are extremely unhelpful and disrespectful. I do NOT recommend that anyone ever live in this apartment complex, seek any other place to live.
I love living in Saddle Ridge. Management is friendly and helpful. Maintenance is quick to fix service issues.
Living at Saddle Ridge has been a comfortable experience.
Great management and maintenance, but sorry the residents ruin the community.

Very satisfied with saddle ridge. Complex is appealing on the outside and inside as well. I had a beautiful view of the sunset everyday from my location. Property is always clean. Office always have fun resident activities. Office staff  is very friendly and professional. Thank you Ms Miranda , Ms PJ, and Mr Sergio for making my stay a pleasant one!

Saddle Ridge has spacious rooms, 9ft ceilings, spacious bathrooms, and some units even include washer and dryer hook-ups. Their amenities are great and their spaces kept clean and inviting. The management staff is easy to work worth and they are always ready to help. The complex is quiet and the people around polite and respectful. i feel safe and comfortable in my new home!

I would absolutely not recommend this place to ANYONE. It was a disaster since I moved in last year and I’m glad that im finally gone. When I moved in, the apartment was disgusting. Excellent customer service, office staff goes above and beyond to your needs and they care. The best maintenance staff, work orders are taken care of on a timely manner. The best apartment community with amazing views and beautiful scenery.
So happy living at wiregrass. The office people are beyond helpful and kind. Also, maintenance requests are taken care quickly!

Honestly they never return your calls or respond to email. They don’t do anything about rust growing in your apartment, it may look nice but give it a month and you will see rust growing in the sinks, toilet and everywhere around the apartment. They don’t give you an update on your deposit or email you an itemized list of deductions. They care about taking your money but never respond in a matter of time.
My experience at Wiregrass has been amazing. Any issues that arise are remedied immediately and with care.  I could not ask for a better complex and staff!  THANK YOU ALL for taking great care of me!
Amazing office and maintenance staff! Property is always well kept and has amazing views!

I don’t usually leave reviews. But this place needs one. My husband and I have now lived here for almost 2 years. When we first moved it it was great. But since then the complex has changed management and has gone WAY down hill. Lazy, careless, rude and WAY to expensive for the service you get. I absolutely do not recommend living here.

The only reason these apartments get one star is for the scenic views.  As another review stated "if management were to change (again) and get a more solid, skilled team together, then I would recommend these apartments." And that's to say the least of all the problems experienced with the manager. In addition, it took maintenance several attempts to fix a simple issue. I strongly suggest to save yourself the headache and do NOT move into these apartments.
You will love coming home to this beautiful community!  The office is so friendly and the views are stunning!  You want to lease here!

Management changes constantly. I have lived here for one year and seen 2 managers and 3 assistant managers come and go. Complaints are not handled properly. Noise is a HUGE issue. I like the apartment but the appliances (for me it has been AC heater and dryer) have issues which can only be handled by a "technician" not on staff maintenance. Friendly neighbors and good community events. If management were to change (again) and get a more solid, skilled team together I would recommend this apartment. But as of today, NO!

This complex is by far the most beautiful I have ever lived in. This is not an exaggeration. Sitting on a hill overlooking Stone Oak and miles and miles of San Antonio it's view is absolutely amazing. This property is brand new not even a year old. Inside I feel like a king with vaulted ceilings stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The pool is awesome, they have fireplaces and couches outside you can relax on. Feels more like a getaway then your home. But isn't that what we all want? To feel like we're not at home when we are. Its location is perfect .  There's a park conveniently located  right next door . Also for  families with children there are schools close by. They keep this area very nice  and well kept. Very clean . Which is what I noticed  first . The staff is courteous, polite and super helpful. Being a United States veteran they treated me with respect so they have earned mine. If you're looking for a beautiful place in a beautiful area come to Wiregrass. You won't be disappointed. I can guarantee that.
Great location and customer service. Doggie Park to accommodate pets and spacious family home apartments!

Great customer service and place the tenets need above their in a professional perspective manner.

As an interior designer, I found the office staff professional and focused.

Absolutely great place to live! Especially the staff Aidee is GREAT. Highly recommended.

If you’re used to having things fixed in a timely manner, then do not move here. Maintenance staff is always low, and they always have emergencies to work on, so they can never get to anyone else.

Great service! Always on time to help out if I run into any issues. Although there aren’t that many issues that I’ve experienced living at the falls. Great community, awesome staff and excellent environment.

I have bonuses where to start. There was so much about this place. Rude front office. Ignorant inconsiderate people! So glad I moved I don’t recommend this place to anyone. Pool is always dirty. Property poorly maintained and maintenance never comes to clean the steps, bird mess all over the place. Once you sign it, you are trapped until it ends. They charge luxury rates but this is definitely not a luxury property. 

Dog poo an bird poo everywhere. Dog owners do not carry bags and let pets mess all over the property. Management only cares about money. They start posting eviction notices the third day of the month, even if you already told them what's going on. Customer/Tenant care is horrible so don't fall for what
they tell you before you sign the lease. 

I've lived here almost a year and glad it's almost over. ******* DO NOT RENT HERE*******

I am so upset with the apartments. This morning they started replacing the floors in the unit above me. I work from home and I also own a dog. I could have been given a notice that they were going to be working on the apartment above me. I was never notified. I told her that I would be calling corporate and she thanked me and hung up on me. Real professional. I called the regional office in San Antonio and the person I spoke to didn't even take my name and number but said someone would call me back tomorrow. I called the corporate office in Austin and she was nice enough to take my name and number for someone to call me back. I have referred 2 people to these apartments but warn the rest to stay away! The management team is pretty good, but the residents that stay here are not so good. Ive seen drugs sold, fights, cars vandalized, packages stolen, you name it we got it. I recommend paying the extra cash to stay somewhere else. I wish I would have, my lease is up soon and im going to be running out of here like the 300 spartans.

Where to start, I haven't lived here long but felt the need to warn people that are looking to move here. The Parking is absolutely horrible,  every night the parking lot is full, you have to find parking further down the complex buildings away if you are lucky, so be aware when needing to park close when you have things to tote if you are trying to move things furniture, groceries, etc.. They do tow without notice if you park under the car ports and the place for pick up is quite a distance away with a hefty fine(known by a recent experience, while needing to go back and forth late at night with tons of groceries and no parking near the buildings around me, car was parked for less than an hour) I'm hoping that with all the terrible reviews something will eventually click; to where they find some sort of method to help this situation out, create parking permits or add a great discount to the carports. The apartments are filthy, with critters everywhere trash, spider webs, wasps nest, by your doors and on the stairs, we signed a form before move in that stated we were to get two gate remotes notified front office and they said they were out and we never received them, so we have to punch the code in every time we arrive home in what ever type weather, we also went in to pick up the pool passes, were again they stated and signed a paper that said there were one for each resident and two additional for guest and the lady told us very rudely it would only be the one for each resident and to come in the front office for additional when ever you have guests, which is not a big problem but what if my guest comes after front office closes?. The trash people are pretty lazy, when they cant take your trash bag out of the trash can, or if the bag is slightly ripped they won't take it. The garbage bins are repulsive and always full and over flowing, and the bins are only closed in by wooden gates that are always wide open, which makes it look gross, smells, and when the wind blows trash flows on to the complex grounds.  We've recently about a week or two in, have gone under new management, its still early to tell nothings changed yet, but hoping for a better experience in the upcoming weeks/months.

If no stars was an option I'm certain I wouldn't be the only one taking advantage. Look at all of the other review sites before going to this awful place. DO NOT MOVE HERE! GO ELSEWHERE YOU WILL THANK ME LATER! This complex puts a new meaning to scrapping the bottom of the barrel. Ok, where to start... The ladies up fromt are your best friends untill you sign the contract, from then on they couldn't care less. The amount you pay is way too much for what you actually get. Everything in the apartment is far outdated and falling apart. The complex is always filled with trash scattered here and there. I absolutely love this place. Everything is just amazing. Wonderful staff that is ready to help your need no matter what it is. Even the maintenance staff is great, get all your requests done in a timely manner. I am glad I have chosen this apartment to raise my children in.

These apartments are in an excellent location for military members working at the nearby military base. There is also a shopping center nearby, several restaurants, and a school. As far as the apartments themselves, they are quite nice, and spacious. The walls are slightly thin, but unless your neighbors are extremely noisy, you will not hear them. Overall, a nice apartment complex.

Somewhat over crowded area.  Over good quality apartments.
Close to work, close to stores and hospital.
Great apartments, friendly staff, awesome amenities.
These last 3 months have changed many things for bad increase everything and do not warn or know how to give explanations.

A lot of management changes over the last / years. Previous mgrs SUCKED.  The newest ones are absolutely FABULOUS. Kind, responsive, helpful; Tanya alone might be restoring my faith in humanity! Repairs/manintance on the property is resuming and the pool is actually being taken care of. Thank you Verandas staff, keep up the good work!!

I lived here and unfortunately had to terminate my lease due to personal reasons. during this time, management was so helpful and kind. The apartments and property are well kept...beautiful place
Office & management are Fabulous!!!!

I looked at an apartment here and the people were so nice and helpful.  The pool was so pretty and had large closets.  I didn't end up leasing here because of my job but I totally would have.  I highly recommend this place.

This complex has had people's tires for their cars stolen and the cars were sitting on rocks in the parking lot. Pool has been closed more than open, pet wash has never been open, gym in phase one and rec center have been closed for months with no communication on when things will open.

This property is ever unsafe! there is constantly cars getting broke into as well as apartments. There is not type of cameras or security either

This place is the absolute worst. The rating shows 4.5 stars and I am more than sure these high reviews are fake. To begin, the front office is HORRIBLE! BOTH CAR THEFT (was stolen) AND APARTMENT THEFT HAPPENED AT THE SAME TIME!
