Don't live here. And btw, the police said that this happened to MULTIPLE APARTMENTS WHILE THEY WERE OUT OF TOWN! BE AWARE!

The maintenance staff and the office staff in the front office steals tenants property and blames it on other tenants. The maintenance staff are local criminals. They go into ur apartment without any prior notice. And when complaints is made, they say one of the other neighbors stole it.

I imagine I would have a higher rating for Triomphe if I actually lived there - both the property and the units themselves seem rather nice.  So nice, actually, that I wanted to live there.  A suitable apartment was found, an application was filled out, and a deposit was left - but two days later I receive a call from the leasing agent informing me that the apartment I left a deposit for was apparently no longer available.

As it was explained to me by Amy, the current tenant had already provided his notice to move out and then after promising the apartment to someone else (me), Triomphe decided to allow the tenant to remain.  Their solution was to offer me a different apartment, in a worse location, on the first floor only (not an option for me) for the same price.  Worse yet, as someone who is trying to find a place in San Antonio for when they move there in 2 months, I am not in a position to go back out there to look at other units without hours of driving.  

My circumstances and rigidity certainly wouldn't apply to everyone.  And mistakes happen and I cannot personally fault any of the individuals involved here.  But at the same time I would strongly discourage anyone from leasing or looking into Triomphe as I feel they are untrustworthy - the intent to mislead is immaterial.  And while nothing is set in stone until a lease is signed, is that really the kind of attitude you want from the management of where you will be living?  The "if you didn't get it in writing it didn't happen" type of relationship?

Ironically, though, this was all in writing - but it doesn't matter.  To their credit, however, Amy told me that they would not be attempting to cash the application fees or deposit.  Although considering it was all for an apartment that was never available...it's not a lot of credit.

I used to live here with my boyfriend and they are amazing. Trash valet actually comes and picks up trash. The gate really works which made me feel a lot safer coming home late at night. They play it by the book here so just make sure your rent is paid on time and you follow the terms in your lease agreement and you won't be sorry!
Everything in this complex is great.  From the office staff to the new pool that is in the making.   Can't wait for it to be finished.   Floor plan is spacious.

Cars are regularly vandalized, the pool is always closed for “ maintenance”  been waiting three weeks for damage to the crappy laminate floor to be repaired. Staff non responsive or downright rude if you dare bring up an issue. Run, don’t walk away!!

This place doesn’t even deserve 1 star, but I had to do it to write this review. This is the most horrid apartment complex. Extremely dirty all the time. Management & staff don’t care about you at all. Once they have you in a lease customer service is our the window. They don’t return calls or emails so don’t bother. Maintenance manger is a waste of space and snoops through your apt mask-less during COVID (have video), but when you fill out a work order they ask you a health questionnaire because they are only concerned about themselves getting it and not you. Rent is WAY to high for what you’re getting. The neighbors smoke pot and it gets into your Apt and makes you sick and management doesn’t care at all. It’s like the slums on a good side of town. STAY AWAY!!!

Don’t you hate it when you move in and your treated like royalty and by the 3rd month they forgot your name. Well 4 years later I still feel like I matter and I love living here. Like all places there can be problems but usually it’s a problem renter not with the property or the management and fortunately they don’t last long and t move out. This is a place for mature professionals so if your looking for the wild pool side party place this is not your place. If you are kind and think about your neighbors as much as your self you will be happy here. It’s rare you hear blasting music and other such typical annoying apartment issues.  Mostly adults which helps in keeping it more quite or a lot of good parents keeping younger kids  under control as behaving well because they are not all over the place taking over if you have ever experienced that. You may find some negative reviews, but me and those around me, below me and I have met at the mail box are all happy campers here at the Abbey, the longer you live here the more it feels like a family even if it’s just a warm hello to a familiar face you see on the elevator. It’s nice. If your not that kind of person, please don’t move here. You could really tell the management here cares during the recent freeze and all the  problems that came with it was just another example of how they learned 5 stars in effort and action to get problems fixed as they arose daily. It was really nice to see how much extra effort was made to help us get through no water and electricity times and of course the days following fixing the damages some units experienced. By the way, I’m really picky and a bit of a snob about stuff. So if I’m happy here you could be too.

I moved into the Abbey a year and a half ago.. It was the best experience. The property is gorgeous and the staff truly cared about the residents. Recently I have had interaction with the staff as my lease was coming to an end and some minimal maintenance request. Selena the former Property Manager mirrored what a Luxury Property manager should be and made sure everything was always up to standard.. BUT she has left and the new Property Manager Amanda is quick to get defensive and be disrespectful.  She has no desire to keep residents happy.  I will be moving to another property in the Dominion soon.  I really hope the Abbey gets it together soon or they will need more then a cruise and free rent to get new residents.
We love living at the abbey at Dominion Crossing. The management staff are great and easy to work with. I always feel safe here at the Abbey! Kudos to Celina and Amanda!

Lived here 6 months. There has been at least 9 cars vandalized on 6 different occasions.  No real actions taken by management. I was told “not our responsibility”, which is understandable up to the extent of it being a repetitive issue. That is your responsibility. Gate is constantly broken for guests, however random people can come in, bash windows, and steal tires. Go figure. 

Would NOT recommend living here unless you want your vehicle vandalized.
I am so glad we moved here!!! It has been an amazing experience. We have so much more room to go on walks with our dogs. A lot of open area the pool is amazing. The workers are just as great.

My roommate and I were looking for an apartment that had immediate move in and Palomino provided that. I am so grateful for Jeanette B and Krystal W, they stayed after closing hours to help us finish our leasing application. They were patient and understanding, I have less than a week living here but so far it seems like a safe environment. The only thing is that there is mandatory valet trash pick up with other fees and it’s $42 extra to the monthly rent. This should honestly be an option for the residents but other than that the move in was as smooth as possible and the staff were amazing!

The apartment complex itself is beautiful- very few complaints except for the lack of parking and complete lack of privacy on balconies and patios.

Usually the latter wouldn't be an issue since there are many different options to create a private outdoor space, but the complex forbids any kind of privacy solution. If I wouldn't want strangers to watch me in my living room, why would I want them to see me in any other area that I pay to occupy?

Another issue is the access gate. If living in a gated community is something you desire, the security of one is void at Palomino. Almost everyday as I approach the gate, a car is waiting for someone to let them in. It's ideal if you have friends/family that need to follow you in, but the timing on the gate is horrible. I've seen 4-5 cars enter the complex at once. 

Palomino has a mandatory trash valet service that is an additional cost. Valet trash is great, and I wouldn't mind the additional cost if the company they contracted actually picked up my trash. At least once or twice a week, they fail to pick up my trash, leaving food and pet waste by my doorstep. 

But by far, the worst thing is the proximity to UTSA. The complex is overrun by college students, and it's a nightmare for working professionals. Although the lease states that residents are only allowed 2 guests at the pool, there are large groups of people at the pool every weekend and they are LOUD. If you live even remotely near the pool area, you will 100% hear them yelling, screaming, and blasting music from their apartment out to the pool area. If you share a wall with someone who does this, your cabinets and appliances will shake and vibrate.

For the price and appearance, it's a great value, however, the appearance doesn't properly reflect the quality of the apartment and office management.
When moving in, I agreed to get a smaller more affordable 2 bedroom, but after spending 60-90 minutes going through the application process they 'discovered' that apartment was no longer available and they only had a more expensive one.  As I had spent all day apartment hunting and was pressed for time, I accepted the more expensive option instead of going to other apartments for another few hours.
Since moving in, I have had the following issues...Dishwasher falling out of the island; Washer no properly hooked in resulting in water leaking all over my kitchen floor; bottom of the front door coming off amid move-in day; Ice machine broken; stovetop light broken; birds nest on the fire sprinkler right next to my door.
While maintenance was fairly quick in to respond and fix the items (within 24-48 hours), most of these were issues that should have been taken care of prior to move in day.
While not a terrible choice, I recommend seeking other options first and if choosing to live here be aware that living next to the pool will mean music all weekends until pool closing at 10 pm (sometimes for a bit longer afterwards)

By far the best apartments I have stayed at. I have not once had an issue with my apartment. Neighbors are very friendly and this is the first time I have not had a noise issue! The amenities are great, I love that there are washers and dryers included. Would definitely recommend staying!

Luxury living and affordable prices. Kitchen storage space is limited and water pressure is lacking but the room and the amenities make up for it! Love living here with the 2 pools and gas grills. Community puts on monthly tenant appreciation activities and weekly zumba class

If you are looking for downtown living, Inspire Downtown is the place! Great location for restaurants and entertainment. If you are a fan of the Majestic theater, it is within walking distance. 

The amenities are great. Fantastic views from the roof top pool and hot tub amenity deck. The deck offers plenty of seating for relaxing in the sun. Feeling the urge for a cookout or a workout? The bbq grills and Gym are perfect for both! 
I have loved every moment of living at The Inspire Downtown!

I really love living here! The leasing staff is fantastic and works hard every day to improve the community. I also want to give a special shoutout to the maintenance guy, he is here every day, ready to work, and always quick to fix anything that needs attention. He provides excellent service and is a great asset to the community!

The Inspire is a great community with many restaurants and bars and very close to the San Antonio River. Also, very close to venues that have concerts , comedy shows as well as performing arts. We have an amazing office staff as well as the maintained crew. I have enjoyed my tenure (8yrs)
Love living at Inspire! The units are unique and the community is awesome. They always put on great events, keep us informed, and are very kind.
Great location, despites being located downtown, you rarely heard loud noise from the city! The elevator has failed a couple times but they fixed it immediately!
Everything was great I love the service I love the experience everybody was very pleasant professionally and very helpful in making a process as quick as possible
Seems like new owner actually cares about resident experiences. They've been super responsive with any issues and its been great since thier takeover.

To begin with, this place is pretty pricey. Which could be understandable if all the amenities were top notch and maintenance was on point.  Neither is the case.  the units were updated, but only painted cabinets, cheap fixtures and a stainless steel sink and reftidgerator. the pool is closed more than it’s open, the ‘brand new’ fitness center is only accessible from 9a-2p…I guess it’s not made for people who actually work during the day. Maintenance is horrible.  It takes weeks to get things fixed, the gates are broken for weeks and months at a time.  They have even eliminated washers and dryers from the units.  good thing i got mine replaced
twice before the policy changed.  If moving wasn’t such a miserable experience i would have left after year one, but definitely doing it after year 2.  Find another place, unless your a group of college kids that doesn’t mind your neighbors up and partying at all times of the night.  oh ya….even semi-automatic gun fire at a party during my first year.

one more thing, we are charged a very premium price for our internet, which constantly goes down.  the last attempt at a fix i was told the original ground wiring was done incorrectly….that will NEVER get fixed.  so if you want internet, get a unit as close to the offices as you can, otherwise, good luck with your streaming or work for those of you who work from home.
NO water pressure. NO hot water. NO air condition. Shootings / robberies. THE ABSOLUTE WORST!
I’m excited about the renovated homes and private yards, the homes are so spacious and these renovations definitely make me feel like I’m moving into a brand new home.

The staff has not fixed any of our maintenance request for over two weeks. We do not have running water in two of the bathrooms and have been calling every day for no response. The front desk staff is nice but the management and maintenance is slow and inconsiderate.
Management is great very personable, great maintenance, great leasing agents always there when you need them
This roach infested, landlord special, everything in the gym, broken or stolen, unhelpful management riddled apartment is not worth your time.

Office management does not help with anything. They are rude and impose rules on residents, but not themselves. Amenities here are not up to par either. For the better part of the summer the pool was either green or closed. When they give you notice on needing to enter your apartment, they will not work with you if you have animals and will fine you for not being able to enter (even though you tried to work with them on it.) The "security officer" on site doesn't help with anything involving security. He only walks around the complex to fine people and tow cars. Nights are really dark in the parking lot (almost pitch black) be careful going out at night. Ive submitted multiple requests to get the leak in my a/c fixed, the office has cancelled all my requests and never came. Lastly, the office always closes before its supposed to and opens after its supposed to. Office personnel don't answer the phone either. Ive stood outside the office and called and watch them ignore it with no one in the office. Overall not a good place I highly regret moving here.

Living at the Villa Espada is great. The ladies in the office are amazing (Diamond, Janie & Stephanie). They are doing a lot of maintenance work on the exterior (landscaping and painting the building). My apartment is very spacious for the price. Work order are usually done in the same day.  maintenance is great never have issues ( Daniel & Jose)!  I just renewed for another year.

Firstly, the location is decent being next to a nice subdivision and a golf course as well as close to Brook City Base for shopping and downtown San Antonio isn't far at all; You do travel through a poorer neighborhood as well as passing a junkyard/auto shops.

Next, the apartment and complex were nice and the car gates always worked. The mail area is nicely done, the grounds are maintained, and covered parking is good to have available. The pool, by the time we left, was upgraded on the filter side to handle the pool of its size. Also the pool has problems with over crowding as many people bring in extra family and friends who don't live there. A few times people brought glass and broke it. Frequently throughout the summer, people would have loud parties at the pool, so be aware if your apartment is near the pool area. Not me but when I was there I saw someone who had a truck - evidently with some nice rims - on the ground because someone stole the tires in the night.

I liked the manager, Mohannad, who was always very professional and organized fun events; though from my understanding he's moved up/moved on. 

When we moved out, we left the apartment clean. Quite some time after we left, I get a notification that something happened to my credit. Well the apartment sent something to collections for $75. As far as I knew, I had everything paid up in full and we were in good standing. This is very frustrating since I have had the same phone number and email for 15  years now, always have my addresses forwarded, and pay all my bills. Furthermore, I used to receive emails and phone calls from the office whenever there was something I needed to do, ie pick up a package. To add further insult, my wife also was on file there and the office had her contact information.  I guess I should have been suspicious when some friends we made there called us and asked if we were being charged a cleaning fee - they too said they left the apartment clean.

I understand a company may clean an apartment regardless of its state, but Villa had my full contact info and I didn't receive any contacts from them - Villas phone contact was stored in my phone so I would have seen them calling. I guess it got more chaotic there - I know a few of the receptionist were/did leave so maybe the ball got dropped. Either way, I find it very poor that now I need to fight to get my credit fixed all for $75.

The apartment itself was ok, decent looking and away from the city if that’s what you are looking for. 

HOWEVER, the management changed a couple of months ago and now it’s POOR service. We received a hit in our credit for ONLY $55 that Villa sent to collections without contacting us first and after a year of us moving out of that place for supposedly “cleaning fees” ....

 I can’t believe that they sent this collections for $55 ... that’s NOTHING compared of much rent and fees are that WE ALWAYS paid on time, now my credit is suffering. It’s FRUSTRATING !!! It’s taking us time to dispute it and we are on hold to get better deals on housing because of this. 
Terrible place!!!

This place SUCKS!!!
Stay away
I hope they close this place down so that I can move without paying for fees.
1st off-Noise 
Sound proof walls do not exist here.
You can hear neighbors scream at each other, crying kids and worst of all if you live on the first floor like I do; you'll have to get used to noise till wee hours of the morning. And good luck filing a noise complaint... On top of being a tedious process, nothing ever gets taken care of. It literally sound like wwe upstairs. Also, since I'm talking about noise. It would be nice to receive warning that the fire alarms will be tested. My wife called me upset one day that they were testing fire alarms in our building and had to quickly and unexpectedly take our 3 month old outside without notice. She said the alarms were so blaring loud that it left ringing in her ears after they were done. That's annoying and upsetting that they gave zero notice of what they were planning to do.

2nd-The grounds. 
It's filthy everywhere. People constantly throw trash in the parking lot. Not to mention the valet trash frequently gets left behind cause they won't pick up unless everything is in a sealed bag. The problem is that people constantly throw loose trash outside. So it just stays there for days. I'm talking food, boxes, diapers, beer cans etc. 
Also, No matter how clean we try to be... Little German roaches everywhere. There is an infestation here in the buildings, I am sure of it. I have to be careful bringing in the trash can because of the possibility of roaches being in or around it. It's that bad. I think pest control sprays sugar water. 
Also it's very hard to see at night cause a lot of the building lights have been out for months now. 

3rd-Safety. 
My car was stolen from here. Right outside my window in the parking lot. Should I say more? Cops and ambulances at least 3 times a week. 

4th-Neighborhood
People like to take evening walks around here but there's nothing close or near by. If you want convenience, I recommend city base area. 

5th-Maintenance
What can I say, They'll show up eventually but perform mediocre work. 

6th-Staff
Lastly, All the staff including maintenance is kind. They are nice people but it just does not make up for how crappy this appartment complex is.

I've read plenty of reviews for other places and I think to myself can it really be that bad. Well, It is. It's bad here.

Please 
Take this warning seriously

STAY AWAY

Just moved in at the beginning of this month, and this has been by far one of the  best moving experiences of my 20 years of renting! Great customer service! Amy was very knowledgeable and professional, and she and her team worked around our situations (timing, schedule...) to help us with our moving... Added to this, this place is amazing! The lake and surrounding  trees make it a joy to relax and breath fresh air! (So glad that this is non-smoking community!)
Looking forward to a long and happy stay!!

I have written a review on Hidden Lake Apartments before. My wife and I just signed our 18th lease and are happy to call Hidden Lake Apartments our home. If you are looking for a well managed, clean, safe and attractive place to live Hidden Lake is all of that. Wonderful staff and great upkeep on the entire property. We enjoy a wonderful pool and GYM. The property has many trees and 2 small lakes "with fish". Hidden Lake is great for younger adults and we believe it is a wonderful place for older tenants also. So if you are looking for a place that you can call home come by and take a look at Hidden Lake Apartments. See you soon.
Ron
Stupendous and great a customer service! Great team overall

I moved in at the end of 2020 and am so glad that I did! Fantastic location, excellent staff, and great turn around times for maintenance issues. We just moved from our one br to our two, and couldn’t be more happy with the complex!
Everyone has been so prompt at handling any issues and concerns. I do appreciate it, especially after working long days, and enjoying coming home and relaxing!

i moved to Hidden Lake complex from NY in October 2020. i am very happy with the way management keeps the area clean and how they have handled any issues i have had.  Maintenance staff are friendly, courteous and professional.

This complex is falling apart! We had water leak through our bedroom ceiling and onto our bed. We requested repairs several times and they just kept telling us that "they'll send the contractors to look at it." The ceiling leaked anytime it rained and we tried to cover it up ourselves. The paint eventually peeled away from the leak and there was mold growing! This place had roaches, overflowing dumpsters with horrible smells, parking was assigned but rarely enforced so you wouldn't have anywhere to park your car, and homeless people broke into cars daily. 
When we finally moved out, they had the audacity to ask me for money to repair the apartment we were in. Even with the dozens of maintenance requests we had put in for all of these damages that were out of our control! 
Management is a joke. They're rude, accusatory, disorganized, the office was closed on random parts of the day when they were supposed to be open. Reception made you feel like an inconvenience for walking into the leasing office for anything.

We have been here for only 6 days, and it has been a complete nightmare. Please consider that we had to drive over 20 HOURS from Florida to get here. The first impression was ruined because even though we were told that moving in on a Sunday would not be problem, they were closed because they were “slow”, and the manager sent the one person in the office home. You would think they’d have a list of people that were moving in on that day so someone would be in the office. The assistant property manager Marisol came and opened the door. Starting at the door, it looked like it had been kicked in with multiple dirty footprints on the door and a broken lock and nearly broken doorknob, but we were told it was “secured”. There was a distinct smell as soon as we walked through the door that would later reveal a nasty roach infestation, and I’m talking HUNDREDS. They were coming out of every crack, crevice and drain. We had to spend money on a hotel for two nights waiting to be “approved” to be moved to a different unit. It just went from horrible to nightmare fuel. While in the new unit and cleaning the first night, we noticed banging coming from the wall and rightfully assumed it was just our next-door neighbor. We still saw a few roaches but not as bad as the first unit, the second night in the unit turned our stomach all the way over. As we’re relaxing, we hear more banging but this time it is coming directly from the kitchen. As I’m investigating, a rat runs through our kitchen and the soul left my body. RATS ARE IN THE WALL. Later the property manager also exposed that there could also be POSSUMS IN THE WALL. We have pictures and video evidence not only of the infestations, but also unprofessionalism like sending a “maintenance” man that does not work at the property to come into our apartment and “fix” things that are still not fully fixed, the assistant property manager stating VERBATIM that she only has urgency to fix our apartment because it is right next door to her daughters. So not caring about the other resident’s situation and safety, but also wanting to make us pay over $4000 to get out of a lease because our situation is unsafe and uninhabitable. This place is making me physically sick because the airways are disgusting and now, I have developed a very bad cough, and it could progress if I continue to stay here. This place has to be THE WORST PLACE in San Antonio, and they should not be receiving any more business or future residents.

No repairs are made, charging water bills that were before you moved in, maintenance never fixes anything, office staff say one thing and do the opposite or nothing at all. Apartment was not cleaned upon move and live roaches everywhere. I was shown several different apartments that were the same way. Showed me one apartment because we couldn't get the right one opened. Had me sign lease anyway, gave me the keys the next day, and I gave them right back and had the employee visibly come look at how it was. I asked for my money back and they showed me a few other empty apartments just to tell me a week later that I was stuck with the apartment I signed for. So I had to clean the whole place myself, even though they had a week to make it right. I moved in January19th and its May now no repairs have been made after several work orders have been put in. The new management company doesn't answer phone calls or emails. The pool is a swamp the laundry room is disgusting. You are safer wearing your dirty clothes. There are random homeless or drug addicts around at night and you have to park on the street nowhere near your apartment. They send nasty letters about clean your area but the trash dumpsters have all kinds of trash around them and common areas aren't clean or usable.

I have been here 3 years in those 3 years my AC unit broke twice for weeks in 103 degrees temperatures. I have been without hot water for seven days the first time and as of now it's been another 7 days. It's been twice. There's roaches they charge you every month for pest control and in three years that I have been here I have yet to see pest control come. Parking is horrible you can never find parking and if you park in the wrong place they're fast to tow your car. They have changed management in the three years I've been here 4 times and they have raised my rent every time without notice. That should tell you a lot. I'm getting ready to move out I have had a very very bad experience and I'm trying to be very careful where I go next.

we had concerns about the roof sagging in the living room because there was water in the ceiling and they promised it would not be an issue. Later on that same area in our roof started dripping in our living room, we had to call repeatedly for over a week before someone even came to look at it and all they did was take photos, leave and not come back for days. And when they did come back the cut a whole the size of a fist in our ceiling and left it open for days, looking at the sky through ceiling for days. They patched the whole but did nothing about the sagging, so it started dripping again and it took another week to get them out to the apartment, multiple people came in and took pictures sporadically. after two weeks they worked on the roof and told us it was fixed. not even a month later that spot started dripping AGAIN. so we called and called, they sent people to take pictures. One of the people they sent we asked if it was ever going to be fixed instead of people just taking photos he yelled at us and slammed our door walking out. And there is definitely a roach problem no matter how clean you keep your apartment, we had professionals come bomb our apartment through the managers but its useless because the people around us refuse to do anything about their roach problem because they are drug dealers and don't want people going into their apartment. and our air conditioner has went out 3 times now in only 6 months of living here and each time it takes maintenance a week to even come to the apartment let alone fix it. And the front office never answers their phone so they hired a phone service that gives out false information and doesn't help at all. And after you've called about an issue for a few days in a row that they haven't fixed they start denying your calls! The apartments look nothing like the photos, the people living here are noisy and rude and inconsiderate. Also come 9 o clock at night all the free parking spots are taken and the prices of the covered parking passes has gone from $20 when we moved in to $50 for ONE spot. so its pay $50 a month for a spot or drive in circles until someone leaves at night and take their parking spot. And the dumpsters in the center of the apartments are always overfilled to the point where there's just huge piles of trash around the dumpsters quite often. If you like roaches, leaking ceilings, terrible service and sitting in an 85 degree apartment then this place is perfect for you! :)

I have to admit I just moved in and the apartment wasn’t quiet what I expected from The model shown.  However the staff has been extremely professional and courteous. The first couple of days I moved in , I had major issues with my apartment. I was screaming internally but the maintenance crew was extremely helpful and was able to resolve all and any issues with my apartment. Trust me, I put about 5 work orders in and I had all hands on deck to help. It’s my understanding the previous staff didn’t keep up with the work load but the new staff is great! Martha, Felix and Gilbert definitely helped out with lots of issues.

I would give 0 stars if I could. We moved in in March, and by June our AC was not working fully. It was 90 degrees in the master room with the AC set to 72. This is while my partner and I worked full time outside in 100 degrees every day. Our shower also would not stay cold for more than 20 seconds at a time, and would shoot scalding water, so I could not even take a cold shower to cool down. 
We submitted a work order, and for the next three months I sent multiple emails and work orders saying the issue was not fixed, even though maintenance came to "fix" it every time I submitted a work order. At one point, after 3 or so times of maintenance coming to "fix" it, my partner and I cleaned the vents ourselves, which were DISGUSTING. It immediately made the AC air pressure slightly better, allowing our room to get down to 80. How did multiple maintenance checks come through and not think to clean the vents. 

However, this did not fully fix the problem, and the unit was still not cooling fully. I sent more emails, with more pictures of the thermostat with time stamps, and still got no response. At one point I was told my emails were being forwarded to management, but of course I heard nothing. 

Fast forward to now, we still have a month of our lease but we moved out early due to a job I could not pass up. I finally got a hold of management after being told they had not been told that we had been calling and didn't know about our emails. I was then told to just RESUBMIT THE WORK ORDER. At this point it has been 4 months without fully functioning AC, and it had also been leaking for a few weeks even AFTER maintenance came to "fix" the leak. 

All I was trying to ask was for some sort of rent reduction for the last month, which we fully plan to pay, but instead of even addressing this question, they just keep telling me to re submit a work order. It's like talking to a brick wall.

Additionally, I found out recently from a coworker who also lives there, that when their AC was out for two weeks they were given a window AC unit until maintenance could fix the issue. Of course this was never offered to us after MONTHS of overheating. We ended up spending 200$ to get our own. 

I ALSO found out about a unit that had mold which made the residents sick and they are pursuing legal action, but that is not my story to tell. 

DO NOT LIVE HERE.

Worse apartments I've ever lived in!! (And I came from a low income complex) The apartment we received was nothing like the one we were shown. (but that was the least of my complaints) We signed the lease. We we're set to move in Sept 1st. We get an email asking if it would be ok to push our move in date to the 7th because they needed time to clean the apartment and fix things before we moved in. We called said that would not work for us. Since I took vacation days and couldn't reschedule. Plus my roommate works 7 days on and 7 days off and the first was during her off week. But we were told we couldn't move in until the 1st. It was a total inconvenience but whatever. Got the keys on the 7th. Entered the apartment for the first time on the 10th and it was not cleaned! Supposedly we got new floors but they were scuffed , paint drippings all over. We're moped or wiped down. A small pile of trash on the floor. The stove has paint on the stove top and the burners. (CAN WE SAY FIRE HAZARD!!) The fridge needs to be replaced completely!! It wobbles. It's missing shelves inside. It doesn't get cold. The insulation is all torn up on the door!! •	They’ve already rotated through roughly three different apartment management companies and can’t seem to get their act together.
•	Management is invasive –  They’ll send a text message notice out at the end of the day that they’ll be coming into our apartments for full unit inspections of everyone’s units beginning the next day.  That does NOT count as 24 hours’ notice—at best, it’s maybe 14.  If you work from home or have a disability and can’t just make your space available, they will refuse to accommodate with an arranged time, or even narrow down a window of time that they will show up.  I tried to ask them repeatedly (and couldn’t get through until several tries), was placed on hold several times throughout the call, and was told they couldn't help.
• Twice within a few months they've done 'audits' of the parking spaces, garages, and storage units.  Why aren't records being kept straight?
• Giant hole in mail room ceiling from water damage left for months, which is still dripping water, “fixed” by stuffing plastic bags and paper towels in the hole.
•	Parking garage not consistently cleaned/monitored and frequently has a non-functioning gate. It’s dirty, dusty, trashcans are either completely full or completely missing. No cameras. Calthemite build up in several areas of parking garage ceiling, which indicates structural degradation. Once had a paid spot in the garage (for an exorbitant fee, mind you), and almost immediately had a break in and had a dash cam stolen out of it (which had been hidden in center console), along with a cell phone charger.
•	Non-paid parking availability is extremely limited.  Often feel as though I can’t leave my apartment after 5 pm because parking will be gone and the alternative is to park on a busy street, very far away, where break-ins and thefts are a regular thing.

Leaving sort of a long term review as I moved in September 2020 and I have to say the experience since has been very nice and extremely welcoming.

The front office was very accommodating during the sign up process and they were able to get me approved within the same day, much faster than other complexes who were sitting on my application for 3 days. There hasn’t been any hidden fees or unpleasant surprises ever since moving in, the valet trash is consistent and the trash compactor is easily accessible to throw away any extra trash away. There are also about a dozen recycling bins next to the compactor so there are spaces to recycle in addition to just trash.

The maintenance team is on point, I haven’t used them much but every time I put in a request they came the same day, and with the new online portal they make filling out a request really easy. 

The parking can get busy next to the buildings at night but they have a large lot near the entrance & the reserved car ports are only $35/mo, there is also a good amount of lights around the complex so it doesn’t look sketchy at night and easy to maneuver. 

The actual apartment is very nice, the carpet feels new and the kitchen looks amazing with the white cabinets! I have to say that the patio is also really nice, enough space to put a table and chair outside if you wanted to get some fresh air. Also there isn’t any noise issues, most of the time I don’t even hear my neighbors at all and the only time I do hear them is if I hear dogs barking which is not in their control and not that disturbing. Honestly there isn’t anything wrong with the apartment units, if I wanted to nitpick I would say that that the laundry room door and the pantry door get in the way with each other which is kinda annoying but you just have to close one and move the other. Also at night you can hear some loud cars trying to race or something, I’m fine with it since I used to live next to Lackland and those jets were much worse haha, normal traffic isn’t noticeable.

The location is also pretty good, there’s a H-E-B, Walmart, & Sams Club all down the road and a good amount of restaurants nearby for eating out. Traffic around the place also isn’t bad, getting on DeZavala from I-10 is gonna be busy as that intersection has a lot of cars during peak hours, but it clears up fairly quickly. 

Overall I would highly recommend this apartment complex if you’re looking for a place in the DeZavala area and near UTSA.

No parking, rude managers, old buildings, black mold in the air conditioning vents, the air conditioner broke in my apartment every summer for three years until they finally replaced the unit. Only good thing is the maintenance guys are nice and do what they can but management ties their hands

The inside of this apartment are old n run down. Also the  Community  Have dogs and let the use the bathroom any where.  Literally every day I walk out of my apartment there is a new pile of poop at and my door around my house. And no one cares

I only gave this place one star because I had too. If there was an option to give negative then I would. The ac never worked the whole time I was there. They kept sending people over and over but it never gets corrected. My son has health conditions that can cause over heating if the temp is too high which it stays at 85 degrees. They also found fiber glass in the unit which means we had been breathing in toxins the whole time. In the lease it says that I get off if the problem hasn't been fixed but for some reason they suck so much and lied to corporate saying we are the reason it hasn't been fixed. I asked for the number to corporate and they gave me a number that goes straight to voicemail and refuse to give me another form of contact for some reason that makes no sense. We are forced to come back to my parents house cause we can't live in that heat but yet still pay them the rent. DO NOT LIVE HERE unless you like a leasing office who doesn't care at all about you or your children OR YOUR SAFETY!  Also there is sooooooo many roaches at night crawling everywhere you literally can't even take a step without getting swormed with roaches. The staff will act like they care about you but nope. Alex is a horrible manager she's always "busy" and will never return your phone call. Kim is also super fake and rude. They both have no heart.

I've lived in one of the townhomes for over 9 years. Alex, the manager, and Johnny Garza, head of maintenance have treated me very well. I recently had a plumbing issue in my home and Johnny went above and beyond to make sure the issues were promptly handled. I'd like to thank them for always making me and my family feel welcomed and an important priority to them.

T Martinez

you get what you pay for, more square footage and upgraded appliances for a decent price, but the safety is what i was concerned about. Put down my deposit and was ready to move in the next month until a friend of mine told me a couple days later that she used to live there and it wasn't a safe complex. Drug Dealers, cops getting called out there multiple times, arrests, loud music,etc she also said the pools never cleaned and the walls are paper thin. Needless to say after hearing that and so much more I decided to go with another complex, lost out on my $140 deposit of course but ended up finding a way nicer apartment at a better complex down the road for an extra $30 a month. My advice if you don't have kids and your just a young couple or a single guy, go for it its cheap, but if you have kids or your a single woman living on your own, keep looking there's better complex's in the area.

This is my 2nd yr here.  Management is easy to work with.  There were problems with the central air but have since been resolved.  Mostly CPS issues.  Lots of shade -only complaint is finding parking near the building. Quiet and close to stores, restaurants and churches.

I  really love my apartment complex and my current apartment. The staff here is always very helpful. If you have a problem,they address it right away. I feel safe, very family oriented complex.  It is located near everything, stores, shops , movies , etc. That is important, where it is located. It is also very well maintained and attractive.
A good place to live. They have a responsive maintenance staff.  They just need garages on the premises.

Overall a pretty good complex. Nice pool, helpful staff, pet friendly. Maintenance guy is so sweet and great!  Workout room, sauna, and laundry facility. It's old, but not falling apart. No bugs in our apt so far!

I can back up the claim of rats. Their is a huge rat problem and although they have taken measures to control the issue, the office staff still claims there is not a problem. If there is not a rat problem why are there huge industrial sized poison rat traps outside all of the buildings now?

I lived here with my mom and sister at first they were perfect apartments. Awesome neighborhood very safe. Than we got rats. Maintenance put out rat traps but in the end my cat got rid of the pest. When our lease was up they tried blaiming my cat for the holes in the cabinet that the rats chewed. Also tried saying rat dropping were from her, and that they had no records of us having rats when my mom had picture proof! Don't let their politeness get you!

DON’T MOVE HERE. All those empty houses are empty for a reason besides the hefty price. The staff (not including maintence) is downright RUDE. They need better training or better yet they need to hire new staff.

Staff is very rude. No amenities. Pool is packed and you have to pay to use it. Parties at pool late at night. The one amenities is never clean and hazardous. lots of homes for sale throughout community. Street parking is laughable and homes are very small for expensive price. Not well maintained against pests
Property is very nice, but a specific staff member needs better training on how to conduct themselves professionally when it comes to business.
Thank You Natalie the manager shes been very helpful from the beginning. It was worth the wait and renewed my lease for another year.

Big fan of living here, great people, nice apartment, and they hold events with free food when we're not in a pandemic. I just wish they were more on the ball with the monthly newsletters. They are either early or late or sometimes there just isn't one.  But very worth it to live here. Ask for Ashley she knows her stuff
I mostly enjoy leaving here. I wish they had valet trash, but that's because I'm a diva. The complex is nice and well kept. Definitely the best complex in area

Love it - great neighbors, have a dog park, grounds kept in great shape.  
Everyone in the office and main. very friendly and helpful.  Moved in quickly as my old apartment at another complex had MOLD, yikes............
Found this apartment had my lease signed and moved in in 3 days - can't beat that!!!

I moved in these apartments in April and the move in was very quick an easy. In the time I have lived here I have loved it its a very clean  apartment complex an everyone around me has been very nice. The rent is very reasonable for the the size an I like the fact that they bring the rent down depending on your income. I also like that they have pest control an maintance open every week, and there staff in the office is always so helpful. They have nice aminities. Only thing I wish was different would be the. Price for a deposit on a pet.400$ for the first pet an 200$ for any additional plus 20$ added to rent per pet.It is a little pricy and makes me not won't a pet but if u have the money for it then its ok. Other than hat I love the white rock apartments an plan to stay for a while.

ROACHES everywhere the entire complex is infested it doesn't 
matter how clean you keep your apartment because your neighbor has them and your neighbors neighbor has them and they will just move back in unless you want to get used to roaches crawling on you at night and getting in your food stay far away not to mention I haven't had A/C the whole time

I've lived here for 5+ years and quality has severely gone down.

The front lady is very rude. Will give attitude for no go reason and she will make it very clear that she's annoyed with you and hates you!

Maintenance is very slow. Sometimes they'll straight up forget about you. You're lucky if they respond to your request at all.

Ac/Heat hasn’t been working since October. The neighbors flooded their apartment abd the only thing Timber Ridge fixed was the carpet. Soemone broke the door I’m assuming trying to fix the carpet. My water has been trickle to none since the storm and I’ve been living in 88 degree heat while it’s 90 degrees outside. I’ve reported it multiple times and nobody has gotten back to me unless I’ve stopped them outside or gone into office. They say they’ve fixed it but all I see different was a thermostat and then they tell me to place another order if it still doesn’t work which in turn drops me to the bottom of the work order list. Will not be renewing my lease.
Amazing and caring. The staff at Timber  Ridge were so wonderful, going above and beyond to help. Highly recommend!!

I've lived here for over 4 years and have no major complaints. There are a lot of stores close by within walking distance (Walgreens, Culebra Meat Market, Circle K). Its quiet and there are no ants, roaches, or rodents which is a huge plus for me.

I am going on almost two years of living here. I love the new management staff the apartment has. I definitely see all of the improvements being made. My lease renewal is coming up and I'm staying! It was a bit rocky at first but the girls in the front office are doing an excellent job! They are so involved and really try hard to make you feel like this is your home! Maintenance really works hard at getting work orders done in a timely manner. The property itself looks good and well taken care of. Overall very happy!

Living at The Exchange has been such a unique experience. I arrived just as the property changed ownership and it was really inspiring to see how Mitch and Sean worked to get things in order - from window washing, to a installing a security gate, to creating a gym and lounge, to restoring access to the community balcony overlooking the Riverwalk, to getting a pizza joint to lease a retail spot in the building (bummed I’m leaving before they open). They’re working hard to enhance and preserve this historic building, and it shows. 

The units themselves are truly unique for an area like San Antonio. Polished concrete floors, antique windows - industrial loft-style vibes at a bargain. Some dated finishes and appliances, but if that doesn’t bother you, you’ll be just fine. I believe there are upgrades being done to units slowly, but I can’t say with certainty what exactly is happening there. Be sure to ask/tour if possible.

Neighbors are very nice. Most keep to themselves, a few have been here for years and know everyone. A good mix of young and old folks. Socialize where you can, and you’ll have a good experience. I left for weeks at a time as my parents battled illness and my father passed away. I had packages sitting at my door for ages without being tampered with if that tells you anything about the integrity of the community.

Prepare for street noise if you’re on a lower floor, prepare for traffic during peak hours and events. There is a VIA bus stop right in front of the building and a Greyhound bus station across the street (Good for accessibility, iffy for noise and crowding at times). If you walk around the streets, chances are, you’ll be approached by folks struggling with housing insecurity asking for cash. None of this is fault of the building - it’s just the downtown lifestyle. If you’ve never lived downtown before, just be prepared for a change of pace and be able to adjust accordingly. 

All said and done, I have high hopes for the future of the building and community! It’s a great place to land if you’re looking for a budget-friendly, authentic, downtown living experience.

I lived at the Exchange Building for 3 years prior to the new owner.  I LOVE living & working downtown.  The year leading up to the building being sold, I had strong reservations about renewing my lease due to lack of service & quality of care towards tenants.  Due to lack of affordable & quality living spaces downtown, I considered looking outside the area.

New owner began making swift improvements, even small ones, like washing the windows, made a difference in the quality of living.  The addition of added security was also a HUGE plus. I happily renewed my lease, moving into a larger upgraded unit with sweeping views of downtown. Looking forward to many more great things coming at the Exchange!  I love living downtown again!

The building was sold a few months ago and the new owner has done more in two months than the old owner did in five years.  Just having upgraded software and residents portal has made a big difference.  Work orders are getting done almost immediately, The exterior windows were finally cleaned after five years.  All of our laundry equipment finally works and they are spending a lot of money on access control and security.  We used to have a problem with homeless people in the building but not anymore. I was not going to renew my lease but I just did the other day because of the progress being made.  .

Since we’ve moved here we’ve had nothing but problems they were supposed to remove the paint on our hard wood floor upon move in which was almost 6 months ago. We currently don’t have any running water in the kitchen haven’t had any for about 5 days we put in a maintenance request a couple time they never respond to those either. We have seen roaches quite frequently in the apartment and we are being charged extra for a company to come spray and I’ve only seen them once so we are paying for nothing basically. I went to the office to explain my concerns and then later my friend was going to work and heard the manager talking to a maintenance guy and making fun of the conversation that we had while I was in the office so management is very poor here they just changed to a “luxury”apartment but sweetie nothing is luxury about this terrible place.
New management.  The office staff doesn't respond to messages or requests.  The office seems to always be closed.  Many changes with zero notice.  Just miserable now.

Nice size apartments, condo type, equipped for handicap, fairly new. It has elevators. Includes water, pet friendly. Grounds are nice with walkways for walking pets and wheelchairs to move about. Has a nice size pool with BBQ grills. A community room with ongoing activities, transportation to grocery store weekly and staff that will assist seniors on benefits you may need.  I have been here almost 2 yrs. Maintenance is quick and very friendly.

apartmentName: Vintage at Oak Hill 1543 Babcock Rd San A...
review: I highly recommend these apartments! The community is great, the units are spacious and clean, and the location is super convenient. But what really made the experience amazing was the attention and service I received from Darli

apartmentName: Vintage at Oak Hill 1543 Babcock Rd San A...
review: I was so excited to move here but I’m two months in and I’m looking for another apartment. There was a shooting right outside my bedroom window within the first month of living here. They charge you for EVERYTHING! They violate you for the smallest things. I was told I couldn’t have my windows open. Windows are required to be closed and have a white backing (the blinds). Kids are not allowed to have pool toys at the pool. There is ZERO shade in the pool area but you’re not allowed to bring an umbrella. They have a “picnic” area but you’re not allowed to have gatherings?!?! No music either. You can only bring one guest into the pool area and if you like to get some laps in, well you can’t do it here! No solo swimming?? Why? 7 out 7 residents I spoke with are not renewing their leases. What does that tell you? They are friendly to get you in and sign all the paperwork. After that, it’s all down hill… they approach you with aggressiveness from the get go stating “per the lease, per the community rules”.. if I would have known it’s against the rules to have my windows open & blinds drawn, I would have rented elsewhere. Hot water is minimal, lots of drug deals going on on the far side of the property and my poor kids can’t have their pool toys in the pool. Save your money, find somewhere else

apartmentName: Vintage at Oak Hill 1543 Babcock Rd San A...
review: I am very happy at Vintage at Oak Hill. It is a small quaint community with lovely landscaping. Folks are warm and friendly. Laundry room, mail kiosk, pool and picnic area immaculate. Well maintained older community.
Boardwalk at Med Center is a dog-friendly, quiet community. I love socializing with my neighbors at the dog park! The Office Staff are responsive and care about tenants.

I enjoy the dog park at boardwalk, I couldn't have a dog in an apartment without it! I also enjoy that they have a dog washing station to clean up my dog after getting dirty at the dog park. I enjoy when the complex brings food trucks to the complex and gives us credits to use at the truck. I feel safe in my apartment and feel at home.
Boardwalk is a safe and beautiful community to live in. Maintenance requests are taken care of quickly and efficiently.

Besides the heck up…. This community is okay, now if they will just do simple stuff keep stuff up and going as promised… car wash, making people pick up after there dogs, and keeping Bbq pits clean, cars driving in slow as there suppose to. Or just keeping residents informed in our community… things would be great. That’s what you call home.
Beautiful property, pet friendly, quiet community
I love it here and the noise level here is splendid.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review:
I have just renewed my lease AGAIN! I love Brooks and so close to where I work and EVERYTHING you need is so conveniently close. Shop, groceries, restaurants, bars, gyms, Southtown /downtown. 
I do have to rave about the management group and maintenance. Best I’ve seen and so quick to respond to your needs.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review: The office and maintenance staff at The Kennedy Apartment property are incredible. The quick turn around and constant communication is extremely appreciated. The apartment location is perfect for dog owners with direct access to the Greenline park trails.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review: The staff is very friendly to talk with us. And we learned things from them that belong to this apartment.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review:
This place is way below average, in all aspects other than maintenance. Yet they continue to raise the rent each year. You drive 0.5 miles in any direction and you'll be in the ghetto. At night you'll here the drive by shootings in the distance. The area isn't nice so it's baffling why they push tenants out by raising rent. 

Package handling is abysmal. When the lockers are offline, just pray to the Gods the front office doesnt "lose" your package or return to sender. They will return to sender without a receipt, so you will have no idea where your packages are. 

Also, hallways and stairs are absolutely filthy. When valet trash comes to take your garbage, bags will drip and stain everywhere and the complex will never clean it. I watched valet trash literally gather all the bags for one building and set them on the sidewalk that leads to the building, which puddles all that lovely trash juice in one area. 

Your walls in your apartment are either thin or made of hardened construction paper, because you will hear every single thing your neighbors do. I mean EVERYTHING.The complex will also allow landscapers to start mowing the grass at like 5am-6am, which will wake you up instantly. 

Bugs are a real problem here. Had issues with spiders, roaches, crickets, and wasps throughout my time here. Doesn't matter what floor your on.

The only positive about this place, is their maintenance crew, which will fix anything you need asap, day of. Access to the Greenline park is another plus.

All in all, I would not recommend this place. The value isn't there, for what you are paying. Not by a long shot.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review:
The community is great and the units are amazing. However, the leasing office staff is horrible. They have horrible communication skills and as a result I have to constantly follow up to get basic issues resolved. 

I couldnt get into the complex because my clickers didnt work, nor did my gate code. Also, I cant even check my mail because my mail keys dont work either. I also cant get packages because they have yet to send info for their package concierge services either.

apartmentName: The Kennedy Apartments at Brooks City Base
review: The Kennedy Apartment are very nice luxury apartments with a great location

They let a towing company come in tow. Supposedly the rule is anyone who doesn't live there will be towed after 8pm. There is limited "visitor" spots and they expect visitors to park across the street at another property, from a busy street. And I'm sure they're not going to responsible for anything across the street.

My Wife and I just recently moved into theses apartment. Great step up, appliances up to date, but that's about it. Good luck talking to anyone from the front office. Everything about this place has been a headache. After signing our lease we never received our mail box key, gate code, front door code. Now its a gated community with cameras my car was stolen on 22 Dec at 0500. I reach out to the front office to see if they could look at the cameras and over a week haven't heard back from them. Please do your research prior to moving here.

We moved out recently due to job relocation but most likely would have moved out regardless at the end of our lease, as whatever is going on with neighboring tenants and management has just gotten increasingly worse over the past year. The staff and maintenance themselves are very nice, but otherwise the state of the complex itself is increasingly dirty and disorganized while the rent climbs higher, as compared to when we first moved in three years ago.

Valet trash is unreliable and will just drag trash bags through the halls and sometimes just not take them out and/or leave them on the outside curbs in the middle of summer, so the buildings stink and trash is littered all over the hallways. There's dog poop EVERYWHERE in grassy areas and on the sidewalks, it is unavoidable at this point. Both pools went uncleaned for so long during this summer that they were green and filled with leaves. The fitness center was half constantly closed and half "soon to be 24 hours," for the entire time we were there. One of our newer neighbors had audible domestic incidents happening practically every month.

When we moved out we were charged for anything possible and given vague reasons as to why; with the amount of other tenants we saw also moving out in the months before we did, management is losing money and doing whatever they can to make a cent back from any tenant that's getting out. Do yourself a favor and move in elsewhere.

Trash is everywhere, property management never responds in a timely manner, the pools are constantly out of service, roaches live rent free, poor ventilation, maintenance either does the job half way or just closes the request out. No pest control, trash valet drags the trash through the building so there is always cat litter, food, and garbage scattered through the apartment buildings. Worst experience ever.

Ive been living in Walker Ranch Apartment Homes for 3 years and really like them. I even recommended them to a friend and she & her husband moved here. The maintenance workers are knowledgeable and quick to respond to work orders.

Such a beautiful complex that I can call home. It really is more than just an apartment here. Its comfortable and cozy, the community is very active and polite. Its peaceful and quiet here. Just an overall great place to call home. Maintenance is very efficient. The office team is great. Definitely recommend!!!

I lived in my previous home for almost four years and would have stayed had I not needed another bedroom. Moving here was an excellent decision and I am very happy. Management is great, maintenance was on time and fixed the small issue I had and I am looking forward to this next year here.
Love living here. Great location s yet et off the main road. Grounds are maintained beautifully and staff is courteous. My place is quiet and calm.
This is a very quiet community all around! No crime or loud music.

I use to stay here for about a year. I never had a single problem living here! I’m trying as of right now 09/03/21019 trying to move back there but finding it hard to do so because of no vacancies.??Hopefully soon there will be one opening up so I could move on.??
The building is an old hotel from the 60's and has alot of personality. The staff is friendly and maintenance works really hard.

Overall this apartment shows a lot of promise but as it stands, it is not worth. With problem with roaches, black mold, and water damage, it’s considered a hazard to live here. This place needs to be gutted down and rebuilt as there are multiple things that need to be updated.  They are literally just profiting on the location more than anything else. The community used to be great but now it’s just a revolving door.

The Beverly is a great place to live. The staff is always so nice, they treat everyone like family. The residents are very friendly as well. I would recommend to anyone if they are looking to live kind of downtown and for a reasonable price.

I love living at Beverly. The manager is so sweet and helpful (although I wish your temps were more knowledgeable), maintenance is attentive, friendly, and professional. Every morning when I leave for work he is cleaning the lobby and wishes me a good day at work. I've seen him interact with other residents- the service is superb. The building is older, but the renovation is excellent. Residents are friendly as well; I have not ran into a sour-puss yet. Extremely happy to be living off Broadway (SUPER EXPENSIVE AREA, PEOPLE!) for such an affordable rate. No major complaints. You get what you pay for.

Poorly up kept, poorly managed; this property is absolutely glowing with potential.  Unfortunately, it would appear that Roscoe properties views it as an investment not worth maintaining.  I've lived here for over a year and the issues of repairs damaged walls and fixtures in public spaces, enforcing already weak policies, and providing services that are billed monthly to residents (especially pest control) are ongoing and unresolved.  In the past year I've dealt with:

Cockroaches
Assault from other residents
Dog attacks
Theft
Vehicle Vandalism
Constant tire damage from garbage in the Parking Lot
Missing/Mishandled mail and packages

and on and on and on.  Do not rent here, or even slow down in this part of the block.
They renovated the whole building recently and the upgrades are nice. The doors into the hallway are thin or don't fit properly, though: you can hear EVERYTHING.
Poor Management & Infestation Issues.  Roaches, theft from balconies and vehicles, homeless encampments within walking distance of the Avalon Apartments and crime.  Don’t move here

Avalon apartments are a bit dated but upgrades are continually being done. The maintenance and office personnel are very helpful and courteous. Before moving here I spent 2 months looking for the best value and Avalon takes the cake. Not only do you get covered parking but a washer and dryer in the unit. The complex is gated and very quiet and close enough to everything. It has been a wonderful three years the only reason I am leaving is due to relocation. Thanks for a great experience Avalon!!!

I've been staying here for a little over a year and I've never had any trouble. Maintenance is quick to help and is friendly. Managers speak every day with a smile. Nicely maintained and great neighbors. No loud music and pool is nice for an afternoon. Parking isn't bad unless you work real late hours. Rent isn't too bad and I haven't had a reason to want to leave yet!

I lived here for 1.5 years and have only positive remarks. The staff is so friendly. One of ghe managers, Melonye is so sweet, always making conversation when you come into the office. They are incredibly efficient at work requests. I submit a work request at 9 pm, and the problem is fixed by 12 the next day. The area is quiet and family friendly. You can periodically hear children playing outside, but it's never disruptive. The gate surrounding the apartment grounds only malfunctioned once and was fixed immediately. I've felt safe, welcomed, and at home here. I'm only moving for school and would stay longer if I could.

These apartments are awesome! They are older but well maintained by the maintenance crew and they're constantly upgrading apartments. I felt safe living there even though the surroundings off Austin hwy. are not the safest. Had problems with noise every now and then you would have a selfish neighbor making to much noise but it wasn't a huge issue. All in all its a great place and a awesomely amazing great location!

I visited Avalon with my son that is going to UTSA. I was very happy at the convenience of the facility which is close enough for my son to walk to the campus for his classes. The apartments are laid out very well. The manager and the leasing agents are extremely nice and professional. I also feel that my son will live somewhere I don't have to worry for his safety.

Samantha Coffman

The Enclave is a great looking property with many amenities. The location is safe and convenient to IH10 and 1604.  However, the management is difficult to work with. As long as you don't need assistance from the office, I'm sure you will enjoy living here.

The apartments and amenities itself are amazing. However, the parking situation is anything but acceptable and if you are looking for a place with convenient resident parking then look elsewhere. The complex has numbered, covered and some garage space available for an extra cost, but even with the numbered spots people still park in them and the patrol guard on call is difficult to get a hold of and seems to not care at all. All of this results in a very limited amount of un-numbered spots which are also used by residents leaving a very MINIMAL  available spots for guests. The rent here is 1k plus and residents aren't even provided an assigned spot.... a little substandard for a so called "luxury apartment complex. And to top it all off, the staff seems very uninterested in concerns and their kindness often times seems forced and extremely "fake"
Don’t move here. Bad management, bad tenets, dirty hallways, trash everywhere, no wifi ever. So many better options.

During my stay at Prado for a period of a year and a half, I had a lot of issues with management. 
First, their maintenance crew is a mess. They are completely careless and would go into my unit for routine inspections or work orders and leave absolutely everything on (lights, vents, ac, etc). They would also leave lights and vents on in empty unis which is a problem since I had no way of knowing that they were on and my electricity bills would go up by a lot because of them. I had to struggle with this multiple times and management would not recognize their fault until after weeks of arguing with them.

Second, their hallways are very dirty. You can see all kinds of things: open trash bags, dog’s poop, vomit, etc. They do not clean their hallways as often as they should and the smell is really bad at times.

Third, even if you ask for a certain roommate preference, they will assign you whoever they want. I literally got roommates who where complete opposites and who I had arguments with. I advise you to leave with a friend if you decide to leave in Prado.

Fourth, the move out charges are absolutely ridiculous. This is not only me who is complaining. As you could see from the reviews, pretty much every single resident complains about the move-out charges. I left my room in great conditions and they charge me for charges that were not even mine. I had to pay for almost $400. At the end of the day, it is their word against yours. 

I would honestly advise you to research all the student living complexes before you decide to move to Prado. I am sure there have to be better options.

If you enjoy a quiet night’s sleep, do not move in here. It’s right across the street from the Block which plays LOUD music until 1-2am with an annoying DJ 6 out of 7 days of the week (closed on Monday).

As for the apartment itself, it’s about average. The hallways are dirty and usually covered in animal waste and trash bags. 

There are so many other better options to live at near campus, keep looking elsewhere.

Absolutely terrible apartment complex. I was visiting from out of state to take a tour of this complex to rent as I am moving down later in the year. The staff was incredibly rude and acted like they didn't want me there. The hallways were incredibly dirty, filled with random debris and funky odors. On top of everything in my short visit to the complex, which lasted just over an hour, they towed my car. It cost me over 300$ to get my car out of impound from their extremely sketchy towing service, and then management wouldn't even return my calls after wrongfully towing my car. Place should be shut down for bad practice and health violations.
Close to UTSA campus and great restaurants and shopping

I've lived in this complex for a few years now and it is probably one of the best places I've ever lived in. Staff is amazing and very responsive. Also, if you're a foodie, you can't beat this location with the wide variety of eateries nearby and in the surrounding areas.
Great area with many good places to eat nearby, community is very calm and peaceful, always greeted when I see staff out and about the area. Spacious apartments

I really enjoyed the property. It was quiet and the neighbors seemed friendly. Deanna was beyond knowledgeable about the area and property. I honestly didn't want to go look anywhere else. The apartments are very nice inside. I like that they try to do things for the residents too.  I will call when I'm ready to apply.

While my apartment was nice in size 3bed 2bath I couldn't enjoy it because of the roach. Had to repeatedly call and ask for spray to get rid of the roaches but I didn't work. They want you to clean out the apartment (everything empty like when you first move in) in order for them to spray. Water is always being turned off for the whole day with no notice and there is no routine maintenance for air filters. The clubhouse has been in repair the whole time I lived there so we never even saw it and overall these apartments are old and run down.

Bugs, despite spraying and setting traps on my own, appliances in disrepair, A/C can't keep the place at 80 despite multiple maintenance requests, balcony was falling apart when we first moved in, water gets shut off routinely with no notice, and mandatory dna testing for your dog's poop. -Great location- This is an excellent area of San Antonio. There are tons of stores close by and there is easy access to the highways. The Stone Oak area is also really safe, has great schools, and there's a nice park close by. 
-Updated Apartments- They're not brand new, but the bathrooms and kitchens are really nice- those are the two rooms I always care about the most when looking for an apartment. -Pet friendly

-Parking- there is ample parking for you and your guests and each apartment has a garage which is great. 
-Patios- each apartment has some sort of patio or balcony
-fireplace- I'm not sure if every floor plan has one, but I'm a huge fan of them 
Cons:
Noise- not a noisy neighborhood, but if you live on the bottom floor you can hear EVERYTHING upstairs. Even if the people upstairs are doing very normal things, like simply walking you'll hear them. You can sometimes hear your next door neighbors too. 
Valet Trash- sounds convenient, but its not that great- no dumpster available and no large trash can to put your trash on days when they don't pick up.

About the apartments the building is well kept, staff is very very nice, beautiful pool with plants and flowers well kept. When you have a service request the respond is within 24hrs. I just love living here every thing is beautiful.

Very unprofessional staff, unorganized! No one in the office is ever on the same page! I put in request for maintenance and weeks later still nothing! This place has gone downhill fast. Lived here for 3 years. Avoid this place if you have the option. MC Companies does not have the best interest of their residents in mind, only their investors. Negatives:

- Mismanagement. I think they've been through 4 sets of management in 3 years.
- Long waits for even the most essential work orders, the management is incredibly cheap so the maintenance staff is always short and behind.

- Poor parking.

Everything's is close schools, bus, grocery store , gas station, post office, restaurants, hotels, highway, barbershop...its all close but doesn't bother a quiet lifestyle.  I'm satisfied living here.. I enjoy it and don't plan on leaving unless they raise the rent so high that I can no longer afford it..lol.
