We moved in about a month ago. I was pleased to see that the complex actually did look like the photos on the website. I had expected it to have been photoshopped and it was not. I was unhappy that we were unable to see our unit until after we signed the lease but now that our belongings are in, we are very comfortable in our new apartment. There were some small things not finished as we were told to expect, but, the office staff is working with us to resolve it. They have been polite and professional. The exterior of the buildings and the grounds are very nice. There are some areas where residents are not cleaning up after their animals. The complex does supply waste bags so there is no excuse for that. The noise level is very good in a community this size. We did have an issue with a neighbor and their loud music but after speaking with Jeannette, that has been resolved. As others have noted, we have seen some roaches. I'm still waiting for pest control after two requests. I understand to some degree it's a reality in apartment living. That said, we didn't have them before moving here and I don't plan on living with them now. So far, it's felt very safe and secure here. Most neighbors are very friendly and do a great job making their areas pretty to look at. I honestly can't say that I have seen much of what others have said in previous negative reviews. Our overall impression and experience so far has been very good. Parking is usually not too big an issue. I know decals are supposed to be in the works which should alleviate lack of parking if enforced. Parking areas are set up fairly well and the walk to apartments is well lit and pretty short, even if you cant park near your building. However, the gates are another matter. You will constantly fight cars trying to leave the complex from the entrance. Which often means being blinded by headlights as they try to squeeze past you instead of leaving through the exit gates. And the exit gates are often open due to large rocks being jammed around them by residents for people to come in without the gate code. My husband and I have removed them several times just to see them put right back. In the big picture, the pros outweigh the cons here. It's a nice community with good amenities and responsive office staff.

I finally managed to get an email address to send my complaint, after having to go in there again & complain. It's just exhausting. Stay away if you can.

Pros:
Vast quantities of parking
Improving conditions
Visual remodeling
Affordable 
Great Management staff (they are very kind and helpful)
Many deals available for new residents
Community events
Pet friendly 
3 swimming pools
Playground
Dog park

Cons:
Pest control is none existent
Maintenance is as needed, not preventative, and unresponsive to major issues with appliances
Lease promises use of certain amenities but not consistently available (ex. Washer and dryer in unit)
Not wheelchair accessible throughout complex
Obviously overwhelmed staff, very kind individuals and helpful, but are clearly taking on too much 


I gave 3 stars instead of 4 because of a problem specific to my unit that has gone unattended.
Reported furnace failure on Saturday- repair completed one hour later!

We loved these apartments. Maintenance is always on top of tickets, complex stays clean. Mailboxes do tend to get broken into but not apartments fault. Pool is never open due to ongoing maintenance always during the summer. Costs are extremely reasonable. But better pray you never get into a bind, have a string of bad luck or lose your job, because management/leasing office does not offer any payment plans or grace periods for rent. We have been residents here for over 2 years and that means nothing to this business. Have your rent in on the 3rd or 10% late fee, no ifs ands or buts. And if you need to contact the property manager for any reason, you have to show up. Trust me you will not get a call back, regardless of urgency or multiple attempts.

UPDATE: Do not waste your money and move here. Multiple residents, including us left due to poor new management. They have caused nothing but stress and anguish to my family. It's run like a business and not a home and they could care less about you. We use to love these apartments and would have stayed for as long as possible. The office staff to the property manager to corporate office are incompetent and blindly make mistakes that cost you money with no regard to your finances. Water consistently shutoff with no warning or explanation. Pools never open due to "maintenance". Mailboxes broken into weekly with no improvement or care from management. You put in a ticket from maintenance and you get a 50/50 chance it's done right. We had our ac leaking inside for months and they would come and say well we don't see it so it's okay. Khalid in the front office didn't give us one thread of accurate information. Yesenia straight up unprofessional and should have gotten fired for the mistake she did. You ask her anything and she just repeats the same information without even listening. Hanna, the property manager, is absentee and it's a headache to reach her let alone get her to do anything. Incompetent all around and not a place you want your money, home or family apart of.

We’ll let me start. They had me apply and pay 350$ for an apartment that wasn’t even on the market and their reasoning is that their computer didn’t work. So the downgrade my apartment and move it up a floor as a peace offering. I took the offer, come to find out they can’t do anything right. They kept changing my move in dates, made me and my co-applicant do everything two or three times. Lost our CPS confirmation number. And oh yeah, they CANCELLED MY LEASE LESS THAN 48 HOURS BEFORE MOVE IN. Don’t apply here, they want your fees. I saw them make two people apply for the same apartment in front of my own two eyes. Oh yeah and the pool was bad too.

I've been at Walnut Hills for almost 3 years now and plan to stay until the time comes to buy a house. The office staff are incredible and always have an answer. The maintenance staff always fix issues as fast as possible. Everyone has been more than happy to help when any problems have come up. I love it here.

Management does not talk to each other. You can call multiple times and nothing gets done. No notes made to your account. They are terrible with communication. Never call you back. I hate it here. Moving asap.

It looked clean from the inside, but after the first night,  German roaches came from everywhere. They are in the walls, cabinets, and come around all the time. I have had the pest control spray my house every 3 months but I still have to buy bug bombs to make sure they don't come back before then. I wouldn't ever come back to these apts, I'm literally just waiting for my lease to be up and I'll never be back. Oh and if you want to go swimming during the hot summer, just make sure they clean the pool and unlock it everyday like there suppose to be.

This place has a new property management company; it went from MEB to Bryten Properties . Let me tell you, the people they sent to work in the office with the original team are GREEDY. I not only called but also wanted to ensure that I ended my lease correctly. The only problem was that we did not know the closing date of our new place, and closing dates change all the time. It happens.

So, I called the office to ask the best way to give my 60 days’ notice. I told them I wasn’t sure of the closing date, that it could be late or early, and that I didn’t want to pay for two places at once. This is where they outright lied and conned me. I was told to NOT give notice until I was absolutely sure when I was going to leave because “If your closing falls through and you have already given notice, we have the right to rent your property out.” So, we didn’t give notice.

Once our closing date was locked in, I was told to email an inbox. I emailed the generic email and received a reply from the assistant manager advising me that I hadn’t given notice. I forwarded the notice I had sent (to the wrong email, which the office had given me) and was told that not only was I “in violation” of the lease, but now I was on the hook for rent for 10 days after my lease ended. Of course, the rent was $20 more, and they acted like they did me a “favor” by “pro-rating it” at $600 for 10 days of the month. I emailed back, calling them out on this.

I’m not even mad; it’s just truly pathetic. It shows they can’t even run a good business because they can’t keep tenants, so they resort to “gotcha” tactics. Thanks for doing this to a newlywed couple with a baby!

Your car will be broken into, I’ve spoke to 6 other residents who have said they have had theft of their car or their car broken into. Last night I saw a woman throwing bricks at a car. They will lie and say there is cameras. I knew they were lying so I got it recorded and will be following up for negligent security.

They changed major services we relied on 4 days after we renewed and wouldn’t let us cancel our renewal 3 months out. Their valet living services included pet care by people we know and regularly chat with and their replacement was rover.com.  Among other things. Carpets are always filthy. Dog poop everywhere in the bark parks even though we have to DNA test pets to live here.  Pretty on the surface but that’s it.

If you're looking for luxury apartments then maybe try somewhere else because this place is all but luxurious. Let me start off by saying this complex was opened in October 2018 and I moved in December 2018. Unfortunately, since living here (17 months) the mgmt has changed 4 times (usually without notice) and office staff has completely changed. Other than the Valet Living personel the office is all new staff, and most of which are not very friendly or helpful. There are numerous issues here. For starters the building was not built on leveled ground nor constructed properly and as a result there is a slope in my apartment and across the complex. Additionally, my breaker trips a number of time when using my washing machine. The water pressure varies, some days there’s good pressure but often it has low pressure. This might also contribute to the numerous toilet backups I have in my apartment, as well as have noticed in the common bathrooms (on the ground level by pool and level 1 outside the gym). During quarantine, nearly all amenities were closed to residents but you still had to pay for it while office staff uses it (I snapped a picture of one using the coffee machine in the lounge...closed to residents). I’ve asked management twice for the owners information to express my frustration but management denied my request. The office staff has definitely locked themselves up and their lack of hospitality can be felt across the complex. When I’ve reach out to management I typically get back excuses, ignorance, or rudeness. I’ve pretty much been called a liar by the current management. When I first moved in residents could openly post on our community wall, however within the last few months management has changed this to have manager approval. This apartment’s management is censoring what information the residence can post onto the community wall so wanted to post here for our neighbors to read....and potential residence (wish I could give more of a review but limited on characters, just DO NOT LIVE HERE!). I've tried contact corporate about my 50+ but just get a machine.
I had a really good tour. The property was nice and the office staff was amazing.

I have been living here for a little over a year now and while it’s not been perfect I am hopeful this new management team can make things better. I am already starting to see changes. The staff are friendly and happy to listen and help.

I spent about two years at this complex and the experience was the worst out of any places I have lived. When we first moved in the property management company was well organized. Within the first year the complex changed property management companies. this is where things stared to go down hill, we had many maintenance request that went unattended. Then the request would completely disappear from the resident portal. some of these maintenance request went unresolved until we moved out. They advertise as "luxury apartments" but the finishes used are subpar, the unit we moved into had broken light fixtures. In both restrooms the tile and shower surrounds had been refinished but the finish started peeling off the tiles and tub within the fist few months. The gate to the dog park are was broken. Most of our issues came from the inorganization when the current property management/ property manager took over. As we were charged for a garage that had continued to be charged for even though it had been removed from the lease months prior. Along with the previous issues we also felt a concern for our safety as there was at least two shootings that happened in the complex while we were there. The first happed around the entrance gate which is the only way in and out of the complex. This left the residents that knew about it uneasy as management swept it under the rug. The second happened around the dog park area. This indecent also created an uneasy atmosphere as damage affected more than one buildings. There are still areas that have bullet holes if you look around. I'm sure I've forgotten some of the other incidents that have happened during my time here. As decent as the place appears I would not ever recommend it to someone looking for a new apartment.
The staff is courteous and professional. The apartment community is close to shops, supermarkets and the airport.
We still have maintenance requests open from our move-in checklist performed by office staff, and then additional items submitted by us as we find them. Somewhat frustrating.
It' quiet. A good location to amenities within walking distance. A supportive, responsive management staff

The managers and assistant manager I have been in contact with have been really responsive and have been an important part of the process! They are very helpful and always willing to help and have answered every question! They are a big influence on why I would recommend these apartments also the apartments themselves and location

I would recommend because of location and amenities. I would recommend because everyone that goes into my apartment says how nice it smells and how clean it looks, but then glue starts coming out of the hardwood floors if we stand on them for a long time and the toilet doesn't flush correctly, and the guest faucet keeps leaking. These issues have been addressed before without success.
Each time I visited I had an excellent experience, first with Travis and then with Kristin. I feel very secure knowing that I'm going to me moving to a community who cared about its tenants.
I loved the location and the office staff was very helpful and kind with our move in and out!!
yes

1. The gates to the property are open 24/7 for weeks without repairs
2. Trash and recycling piles up because pick up is not often enough--leads to insects and animals attracted to the site
3. Management is never seen outside of locked offices--they fail to see and/or respond to problems; typical email response is 5-6 days

This place sucks really bad i lived there and the pool was always dirty and green, gym equipment never worked, maintance guys were slow and took forever to change a light blub let alone major issues, my apt had mold an they never fixed it. ALSO the complex only has one dumpster so the trash is always falling out and rodents galore, your paying for location and school district not worth the headache, better to live at newer apts around area.

Overall we have enjoyed our "almost" two years here. The staff is helpful and the maintenance staff is professional and courteous. The location is excellent. We walk to The Quarry to see a movie or share an ice cream cone.

Lived here for 3yrs during that time my truck was broken into 3times w items stolen from the inside. Security gates don’t work it’s a free for all. Water constantly shutdown at least once a week (have proof) for hours. Roach infestation is gross had to put medicine several times & had exterminator come out & nothing worked since there’s cracks & holes that the roaches were coming thru. Maintenance wouldn’t fix it. Don’t get an upstairs apartment during the summer it sucks the cold air goes to the downstairs unit first so you’re having to buy fans etc to keep the apartment cool/cold. Apparently the upstairs & downstairs share the vent for the cooling & the ac unit outside is old & again they won’t replace or fix. Would not recommend

This place is located conveniently off of I10 with easy access to Heb ( Groceries etc), La Cantera, Boerne and San Antonio. If you are considering a new place to live I would highly recommend this community!

Even with a scheduled and confirmed appointment for a tour at 1:00pm both office reps. walked out at 12:53, put an out to lunch sign for an hour and twenty minutes. As I watched them walk out together I thought there has to be someone else in the office … nope. This is the second time I’ve been here and no one has been in the office. I’ve called numerous times at all times of the day and no one ever answers the phone. I guess they are full and don’t need the business.

Do not rent here unless you want to pay exorbitant rent for the worst management and maintenance you can imagine.   It took 5 months and multiple lies from the front office blaming C19 in order for two towel bars to be installed.   I had to add a garage just to have a place to park.  Lastly I have not had air conditioning for over a week.   No response to follow ups and maintenance in the office says, "what ac"?  Oh yeah, well ill check today and if nothing then tomorrow we'll take the part off another AC.  Really? Couldnt do that right away and install the new part on the unused AC?  And half way through day 8 and I still have not heard a peep.   This place is a joke!!

Save yourself a lot of money, stress, and peace of mind and AVOID renting here at all costs. The woman in the office is beyond rude and unprofessional. They lure you with “valet trash” but you can only leave it out on certain days and god forbid you leave it out outside their designated hours, you’ll get charged. This service doesn’t work if you work certain schedules but you still have to pay for it. The pool looks nice but there is mildew in it. We all got sick and were throwing up. They nickel and dime you for everything! Steal your deposit and even charge you to pay your rent! It’s absolutely disgusting. They are a gated complex but it’s never working and they have no control over the residents. Kids having parties, dogs pooping everywhere, people doing burnouts in the parking lot at 2:30 am because the gate doesn’t work. Additionally, they entered my apartment without my consent on MULTIPLE occasions. They never answer the phone and if you want to extend your lease by a month you can’t because they require a 90 day move out alert. Everything is gross, not kept up, and dingy. Do not let the “floor models” they show fool you. We literally paid to get out because it was so bad. Worst management and complex I have ever lived in. Please read recent reviews. I don’t want any family making the same mistake we did.

people should check the parking spot before move in! this apartment does not have enough parking space and lots of nonresident cars parked inside during the night, which makes the parking situation worse.  The leasing office's solution is to tow your car.
I am a resident and I have a parking permit. I got towed twice.
it made me mad when I see nonresident cars park in the spot and I cannot find a place to park.
I said I will go to civil court to argue. The leasing office just told me to go ahead and do it.
The staff is amazing and the amenities make weekends easy!

The pictures of the apartments look great and your apartment will look like the pictures.  But the pet park is a giant bathroom. Most grass around the apartments is covered is dog poop because no one cleans it and its not enforced.  The walls are paper thin, we hear our neighbors 24/7 and managment doesn't care that people make noise past noise curfew. Our neighbors stop around from 10pm to midnight, made multiple complaints and nothing has been done. We constantly deal with roaches and ants no matter how clean we keep it.  Cars get towed all the times,no matter if they're parked correctly. Guest parking is always full of the same handful of cars so good luck having a guest.  the car gates are broken often and so are the pedestrian gates. And it's just very expensive for what you're getting. They have a fee for everything. Look elsewhere.

The office staff is great. Always super professional. Any maintenance issues addressed quickly, even with the Covid restrictions. Only downside, if you live on the first or second floor you can hear every step the people above you make. The sounds are intense. We were quarantined for three weeks in September and our upstairs neighbor walks like an elephant and does some kind of carpentry or drilling in their apartment. As a renter I always try to remember that people live very close around me and that we need to be respectful. Anyhow, we really like the area and the apartment but will be looking for another apartment that’s on the top floor.

Getting bad out here. Somebody broke in my car and some of these neighbors are super weird. Been putting in work orders for my AC. Which was suppose to be a brand new unit. Work order gets created then cancel. There no communication with the office at all. They'll tell you one thing. But will not stand on what they say... need new management.

When we moved in we had no hot water for about 2 weeks. Roaches everywhere, dog crap everywhere, been without properly working AC for 7 months now . Gate has been wide open since we moved in. Doors on the gates are welded shut to keep “ homeless people out” they just walk through the open gate. Work orders get completed without anybody doing anything. Maintenance just opens apartment doors unannounced when they do look into work orders.  .

I moved to The Boulevard at Sonterra in September 2023.  Apologies to them for not writing this review until now.  The Office Staff here are amazing and ready to help you as soon as you walk in.  The response time for a Maintenance Request is very good and the guys do a great job. I feel very safe, comfortable and am enjoying my apartment! If you're looking for an apartment, please stop by the office here and see what's available.

Dear The Boulevard at Sonterra Team,

I am writing to express my gratitude and appreciation for the exceptional service provided by both your office and maintenance teams. Special mention goes to Diana, who has made our stay here truly feel like home. My family and I enjoy the amenities, such as the billiards and theater, and appreciate how convenient the location is to my children's school.

Furthermore, I would like to extend my gratitude to the maintenance team for their quick and efficient handling of any issues that have arisen in my apartment. Despite the fact that I live in an older unit, I have never felt concerned about any problems that have arisen as the team has always been prompt in finding and resolving the issue at hand. I especially appreciate the approachable, friendly, and knowledgeable demeanor of the maintenance staff. They truly understand their job and go above and beyond to ensure that residents are satisfied with their service.

Once again, I would like to express my heartfelt thanks for all that you do. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.

Best regards,

Hatice Zeynep Inan

I’ve only been here about a week and if you’re interested in an apartment consider this one! The office team is so nice and are willing to help. Diana is a huge help, she puts herself in our shoes and understands what it feels like to be applying for an apartment. The manager is nice as well. 
It’s quiet at night, no loud music or people outside being loud. Maintenance works FAST. I had my garbage disposal not work and when I told the front office my issue, 30 mins later maintenance was knocking on my door! He was nice enough to ask if there is anything else he can do to help. There is a little parking issue but since I work from home I hardly have that problem. If you have pest problems the office will handle it ASAP. I feel safe here at night as well if you have anxiety with coming home late at night. I feel blessed to call this place home.

Finally, a wonderful team, a great apartment with beautiful amenities.  Great attention. Grounds are beautiful.  Prices are reasonable for today's economy. Your $ get much more bang here. 100% satisfied with wonderful team and great new home.! Thank you

The apartment is nice. Some cleaning of carpets and things, but not bad. 
We had a couple of non-emergency maintenance items, and the kind staff helped us within a couple of days. 
The front office staff has answered our questions quickly and nicely. 
The grounds are kept nice, so taking walks here is relaxing. 
There is enough parking.
I have to say the staff and maintenance here are doing a wonderful job!!! I am so proud to call this my home!!!  Bella thank you so much for everything you have done, great girl!
For those who enjoy the downtown lifestyle, this place is perfect. Maira, the manager, was wonderful, providing a friendly and informative experience.

i've been living here for almost 6 months and honestly it's nice, maintenance is attentive everyone kinda keeps to themselves, these apartments are affordable and in a convenient location. definitely will be renewing my lease!

The leasing office was not even open. Walking into the apartment was unsanitary.The stairs were narrow and hunched up against the side of the room, with a narrow elevator with broken buttons on the opposite side of it. Also, the walls were dirty. It is also a very unsafe location. It's right in the middle of downtown where there is unfortunately many homeless around the area. Overall I would not recommend anyone live here. It is unsafe and unsanitary.
When the new management came on the bed bugs came in. Office staff and maintenance Will do nothing for you. do not rent from Western Hills. You will regret it

I felt safe in this complex when there was a storm a tree fell and block the door I made one call help was in the way the tree was removed.If there was a problem inside the apartment Which wasn't often but It was taken care of quickly.Management is awesome I wouldn't have left if I didn't have to take care of business out of state I'll b done with my business soon and ready to move back.
Nice apartments. Property manager Kim is GREAT, she does a great job managing the property!!!!  - William

I just finished out my 1 year lease, and I enjoyed my time here. After the change in management the place was cleaned up, and maintenance responds in a timely and professional manner. Management is very well maintained, very understanding, and as long you work with them, they'll work with you to make your living experience affordable, simple, and enjoyable.
The location is ideal for students to SAC or UTSA downtown. It's close to the downtown scene without busting your budget. Plenty of restaurants, attractions, HEB is about a 7 minute drive. I can't say how lucky I was to find such a gem in a developing city like San Antonio.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: Nice place to live. Management and staff are helpful Julio the manager helped us with move in and made sure we got a good unit. We chose the partial renovated unit with new everything and washer dryer connections.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: These apartments are claiming to be luxury but everything has the “landlord special.” There’s water damage everywhere which makes a comfortable home for pests, all the cabinets and drawers are not latched properly and unable to completely close due to the amount of layers of paint, there were stains on the carpet before moving in, and the trash can is always overflowing. I have been living here close to a year and the pool has never been cleaned or opened. When I moved in, the floor plan guaranteed in-unit washer and dryer but did not come with it which meant I had to pay to use the community washer and dryers. This was a burden and got even worse after management removed half of the washer and dryers in the facility while raising cost to wash. They also implemented reserved parking without thinking over the logistics, they have more people residing in apartments than the amount of parking spots. I have placed unattended work orders that were marked as completed. Management is never at office even when stopping by several times a day. I have been able to contact them over phone once and they are incredibly rude and unprofessional. DO NOT RENT HERE, NOT WORTH SAVING A FEW BUCKS FOR THE CONSTANT HEADACHES. Plenty of nicer apartments down the street.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review:
Nice staff and loving the renovations.
Their specials that they are having is really what caught my eye.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: I’ve been living here for some time now and seen this place change dramatically. I have to say from my time being here it has really cleaned up and looking a lot nicer than ever before. I love living here it has been a great experience.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: They have nice make ready units and renovated units. I chose a renovated unit for the washer dryer and paid the premium. I have been very happy with the unit since moving in August. I recommend living here. The management  and staff has improved a lot since the previous owner bought the property.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: The pool is nice with lounge chairs, umbrellas and more. I recommend living here. I am in building 13. It is safe and quite. the units are nice and with the upgraded or make ready.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: I moved into and chose the renovated unit for the washer dryer. Good location to the medical district and safe for my kiddos. They have a new play-set that is going into the courtyard along with BBQ and sitting area. The pool is nice with lounge chairs, umbrellas and more. They have nice make-ready units that look like the renovated ones but don't have the washer dryer. I wanted a washer dryer. The laundry center is pretty nice too. I recommend living here. I am in building 9.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: Do not believe their website, there is nothing luxury about these apartments. I expected my apartment to be move in ready but was far from it. It smelled very old, they left so much trash and random things behind. Most of the doors don’t close properly, the fridge is missing multiple pieces, I can’t even put condiments on the door. Toilet seat was broken, missing shower rod. All the blinds are old and dirty, they did not replace them. Most of all the drawers in kitchen weren’t on properly and some broken. There is no light fixture in master bath, just two holes in closing. The stove and fridge were a little dirty. The floor plan is spacious but it’s very outdated and most outlets don’t work. If I knew how crappy they were gonna leave it, I never would’ve moved here. I informed the office of the issues I had when I first moved in and they said someone would be by but it’s about to be a week and no issues were rectified. I bought a new toilet seat, fixed some blinds and threw the trash myself. I’ve lived in “cheap” apartments before but they have never been this old and crappy. Do not recommend living here.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: Since new ownership took over Jan 2022, the property has changed a lot. All new paint, renovated amenities, remodeling units, adding washer dryers, new counters, flooring and more. The location is awesome, nice and quiet. They are adding a kids playground, courtyard amenities, games, and more.

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review:
I have lived here at Oak Hills Village since 2000 I have made this place my home for all these years. We have The Best office Manager, by the name of Anna. We also have the Best Maintenance Dept. both guys are wonderful and they take care of problems immediately. We also have a courtesy Parol who takes care of the grounds, which makes it safe. The complex is older, but they have huge floor plans which makes it nice when you have lots of furniture. Since I have been living here close to 20 years, I would never move anywhere else. 
I highly recommend Oak Hills Village -

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: They throw trash everywhere in the parking lot. My kids and i got stung by bees while trying to enjoy the day outside in our back patio. Called maintenance to inform them of the problem and they said just keep the door closed.  Pay to much to have them tell me there's nothing they can do. No stars for this complex!!!!

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review:
I love the location that the apartment is at everything has been great with the new management. Tanna is always on top of everything & she insures that everything is done and  in a timely manner! I had second thoughts about renewing my lease but after new
 management this  place is very more welcoming. Everything has changed to the remodeling to the loud music & being afraid to go outside at night lol. I highly recommend this place. Apt 1804

apartmentName: The Oaks Apartments At Medical Center
review: Used to live there.  Management and Maintenance were awesome.  Apartment had wooden floors and very beautiful.  Don't know about all the kids running around and guys outside drinking until 2 am every weekend.  Also had my vehicle broken into twice while living there.  Its not a gated community as advertised.  Courtesy Patrol on site.  Swimming pool was always dirty and just nasty.  I'm so glad I bought a home and moved out while I had the chance.  And there's only 2 entrances and exits.  very small space while exiting and entering property.  the second driveway entrance/exit, needs to be widen.  too many accidents I witnessed cause the space is just too narrow.

Management has changed and are not responsive.  You can call the office, no one ever answers.  When you leave a message, you never get a call back.  They do nothing about residents feeding stray cats or not picking up after their pets. The dumpsters are always full and people have left furniture there making look like a dump site.  I asked for pest control several times but no one ever came. The security gate never worked properly. The pool was always dirty and the hot tub never worked.  I was really hoping when the new management took over that things would get better.  Unfortunately, it seems like they don't want to hear about any old problems or try to help.
Landscape is very nice and up to date. Quite complex. Neighbors are good. Walls are a little thin. No issues with management. A tad expensive for size.

The location is great! 
-close to schools, food, work, shopping
-The price is good and I did tons of research! 
-Based on the area and safe feel the price is reasonable.  
-The landscaping is well taken care of and the lawns are done every Friday morning. The trees in the courtyard are very mature and shady.  
- I have not seen animal feces on the ground even though I know quite a few people have pets here. 
- love the paint , usually the walls are all white but here the walls are shades of gray that match the fans and carpet (which was new) 
- the pool is always clean 
-the area is quiet most of the time, there are some gatherings but most are done by ten pm and that's because it is summer.  I have seen all ages here from college to families to elderly.  
- the appliances are very basic. Nothing fancy. 
- the buildings were built in 1983 so the insulation is sub par which causes utilities to be higher than say a apartment built in 2010. 
-Also because the buildings were but in 1983, the balusters along the stairs and second floor breeze way are over 4" wide , they are 9" wide which can be a hazard for small children to fall thru. The patios are up to current building codes.  
- The staff have been helpful to fix issues, including ac.

I've been living here at Brookfield for 5years now and would like to say that management has been very helpful and would like to give a thumbs up to their communication response. Communication is key to getting things done. Thank you for getting things done in a timely manner.

Front office is slow and never answers the phone. Maintenance guys are sweet and try their best but can take a while to fix something. There are people breaking into cars and stealing cars at the apartment complex and management hasn’t done anything to stop it. The water is off at least 3/4 times a month for maintenance. The dog park is full of poop and there’s roaches. The exterminator just sprays whatever and leaves but doesn’t really do anything other than walk along the walls of the apartment. There’s never any visitors parking because residents park there. My neighbor has at least 12 people leaving in the apartment and are forever smoking outside my window. The apartment complex is cheap but I guess you get what you pay for. I wouldn’t recommend it.
Love the employees here everyone is very friendly and welcoming
Lauren & Charlie are always very courteous and professional. Im very satisfied with everything here at Brooksfield Apts. 2 thumbs up
This is a great area to live at. Great management and great maintenance services.. only problem is noise neighbors. And the smell of sewer by the entrance.

I have been at this complex for over 5 years now. I have enjoyed the location of the property for the convenience and access to surrounding restaurants, shopping, exercise options, easy parking, care and property maintenance. The rent seems fair according to surrounding market value. AND! During the recent unexpected freeze, my power or water never went out! THAT was amazing! Overall, I have had a very good living experience at Brooksfield!
I have lived here at Brookfield Apartments for some years now and I have never had any problems here. It is a very nice complex and very well maintained.
Complex well clean, maintenance responds accordingly,  and administration is professional.

Management: Very professional and kind ladies. Lauren and Yvette are awesome! 
Maintenance: Charlie and his staff took care of my bees nest right away...I am extremely happy to call Brooksfield home! 
5 Stars

My mom and I have been overwhelmed by how nice and welcoming everyone is here.  The maintenance man Rick is awesome and Yvette and Lauren from the office have been extremely helpful with the move in process.
Staff is very helpful, love the floor plan, amenities, overall experience is excellent!
Great friendly community and staff.
Great team
The application process and move in was smooth and easy.  Its been a pleasant place to live and the price is very reasonable. The office staff has been really friendly and Im glad I moved in.
Head and shoulders above any other apt complexes.

Brooksfield has been my home for the past 10 years. I love it here! No problems, staff is great and any maintenance problems have always been taken care of in a timely manner. I believe Charlie (maintenance) has been here the longest and he is always prompt and gets things fixed the first time. Thank you!

I have never experienced such ridiculous policies at an apartment complex. They tried to sneak in a $50 fee when we paid our first month's rent. They charged us a $580 re-letting fee when we gave our 45 day notice. They also charged us to professionally steam-clean our apartment, even though there were no stains and we cleaned it when we moved. The laundry facilities are terrible at best. My clothes were ruined on two occasions and often would come out of the washer smelling terrible.

My experience while looking to lease an apartment at The Flats was exceptional, largely thanks to the outstanding customer service provided by Andres Q.  From the moment I first inquired about the property, Andres was attentive, knowledgeable, and incredibly helpful.  He patiently answered all my questions, addressed my concerns, and guided me through the entire leasing process with ease

Our sink was broken about every month. We had a corner apartment with no lights. The office is hard to get ahold of. The gate for the garage was always broken. The location and price are great but the constant issues were hard to deal with.

My daughter and I toured this property a few days ago and she fell in love with the floor plans and great location! She is looking to relocate downtown and this property meets all of her desires for a luxury apartment. The Assistant Manager, Lauren, was very professional and made us feel right at home with her attentiveness to our needs and awesome customer service! I definitely recommend a visit to this property!

The Flats at River North is such a beautiful community. The apartments are gorgeous, as well as fantastic amenities! The assistant property manger, Lauren, is AMAZING! She was super friendly and very knowledgeable about the property. I will definitely be recommending this property to my friends and family!

This is absolutely the worst place to live. They conveniently left out the rental agreement that the entire basement and first floor of parking is not even owned by the apartment complex and you have to pay to park there. Also conveniently didn’t mention this detail in the walk-through I did. On the weekends, there is tons of trash everywhere specifically on the first level. On top of trash, there has been dead rats on the first level as well.  For a place that "cares" so much about security, one entrance has been completely closed for almost the entire year now and the only entrance and exit security gates are always broken to the point that they completely took them off. The touchscreen mailbox is broken almost on a weekly basis. The staff is somehow never there on the weekdays during business hours, so you can't complain to them, pretty convenient of them. They also allow a home cooking business to not only solicit us by passing out flyers but that specific resident opens there door while cooking all day and the entire first floor hallway smells absolutely putrid. When you walk through the first level hallway on the weekends, you have to cover your mouth because the smell is absolutely horrendous, every weekend that specific resident cracks there door open and we all have to suffer. This apartment complex does not care about its residents at all. If you want a safe, quiet, well managed place to call your home, BEWARE!!!

Staff complains about helping tenants in any way and is no help, elevator always broken, very unsafe, pee in the elevator, trash never picked up, every street surrounding the building is closed and the one that is open is a one way. Good luck trying to get to work in the morning without a Additional 10 minute detour. Surrounded by three loud bars making the already horrible traffic even worse on the weekends. Soooo many break ins. Garage arm is broken and they do not intend on fixing it. They offer public parking in the already crowded garage. Shootings and stabbings often occur in the area. There were times residents had nowhere to park. Very small pool. Moving in and out of the building is hard due to the shape of the apartments and the small doorways. Not to mention you have to rely on the nonexistent street parking for you moving vehicle as they don’t fit in the garage. The outside of the building smells horrible from the residents dogs because there is no grass. Etc etc...

I am from out of town. I came to see a vacant apartment and the lady was by herself. I take the bus around town since I am not from here and I don't have a rental car. The lady at the desk was rude and said that the lady in charge of tours was out to lunch. I waited and she finally came back. She asked me to postpone the tour and I politely refused. If they can't understand my transportation situation, then I have no reason to move here. You all lost a potential tenant. I don't recommend this place at all.

I do not know why someone would provide any negative feedback on this property management and office staff. I just received my approval and I must say that the attention and dedication I received from Joselyn and Gaby were second to none. Our family is going through some very tough times but Joselyn and Gaby did everything in their power to help us get our new home. I had read negative reviews about Joselyn, (which I only use as reference as I always make my own decision after my interaction with someone) and I must say that for someone to have written a negative review on her it untold for. Joselyn knew about our situation and made sure that or process and application was handled diligently and effectively. My family and I will forever be grateful for everything they have done for us.

In regards to the community, I always call the precinct closest to where we will be living to obtain information on how many reports have been filed for both that community as well as the surrounding communities and the amount was extremely low for the surrounding communities and none for Masters Ranch. That is the first good news if you consider safety. I also took the liberty of visiting the community at different hours and days to see how the environment and I must say it was always calm and quiet. So taking in consideration the price, security and staff I would definitely give them a 10 star rating although this system only allows 5.

Mrs. Tara is extremely nice. When having go into the office she is always willing to help and the visits are always pleasant. The current staff is friendly. Maintenance request are always completed in a timely manner, the maintenance team that I have worked w is Mr. Alberto, he’s also really nice and gets the job done. The staff is great!

Very peaceful complex. Maintenance requests are handled quickly. My a/c went out and it was replaced next day; they installed a window unit meanwhile which was nice. The sports track needs to be kept up. You can hardly pass through one side of it with all the leaved and roots and the gym has three machines, two of which don't work. The kitchen is too small but everything else is just the right size, the appliances are pretty basic, outdated even. I wanted a better refrigerator but had to be happy with what I got. I loved the high ceilings and huge windows. The pool stays open year round which is kinda cool. It's small but nice and clean. W/d connection.

The leasing agents helped me move in ASAP and were insanely helpful and educating in the process as this is one of the first places by myself. I look forward to living here and creating a home for my family, this place seems the place to do so :) Thanks Georgia, Yvette, and Michael for all your help!
Charlie

As a former property manager, I am compelled to share how truly impressed I am with the current staff. I was starting to think basic manners, empathy, courtesy were a thing of the past- until my first interaction with Miss Georgia, whose middle.name might be "go the extra mile" and while making it seem effortless. The property is clean and the location is so convenient. Whether it is your 1st apartment where you begin living your life or your 1st apartment in the next chapter of your life, either way I feel at ease with what Westland has going on at Altitude, simplicity and genuineness goes a long way. At Altitude, attitude is everything!

I came into Altitude apartments as part of my research until I found an apartment. Since I walked into the leasing office Georgia greeted me with a smile and although she was with another potential resident she ensured I felt welcomed. Units are in great shape and the location is perfect.

The owners and staff do not care what issues you have, and nothing will be taken care of. Out of date units, ACs, furnaces, appliances, lots of break ins or just neglectful technicians leaving doors open, plus MAJOR pest issues. Save your time and money, just go somewhere else…
Break ins are frequent, apartment complex is ill kept. Dealing with the office is a nightmare
Staff was very helpful and informing. Mrs.Mary helped out with great advice & information for myself, definitely going to refer friends about this property!

Do not even think about moving here.  Where do I even begin.  Roaches are everywhere, giant roaches, small roaches.  The apartments are infested with them no matter how much cleaning is done.  We had 4 leaks in the apartment, went to the front desk, closed on a normal business day.  They had a phone number on the door for maintenance, the number didn't work.  Through searching the internet, I found the maintenance number and called twice for someone to come out and fix the leaks.  Waited weeks and they never showed up each time I called.  One leak was so bad that it was flooding half the kitchen and living room.  Mold growing everywhere in the apartment, probably because of the leaking.  We ended up doing what we could with the leaks so it didn't leak on us while we were in bed since nobody came out.

We ended up moving a month early from the apartment because it was so bad, we requested a mutual early termination because of all the issues and it was denied by them.  Horrible company that doesn't care about their customers, just look at all their recent reviews.  Who wants to live with roaches, mold, and four leaks around the apartment.

Dog poop is everywhere, no one picks up after their dogs and management doesn't do anything about it.  After we requested early termination of the lease, they did come out to "fix" the leaks, where they just put up new drywall and didn't address the leaking, so I wish the next tenant luck in that apartment.

Crime is not the best out here too, people shooting guns in the back of the parking lot, drug addicts making the parking lot their home because the lot is not gated.  The road/parking lot they have is crumbling.

I highly suggest you do NOT move here.

I've been a resident at Amberhill for 3 and a half years. I currently moved from 1 bedroom to a 2 bedroom 2 bath. First I was notified I was responsible for rent for the apt I was moving out of as well as the rent for the new apt I was moving into. It cost me $1800 to move in when I could have moved in elsewhere for $500 or less. New management took over AGAIN.....and promised better service, nice staff, and a safer place. I moved into a 2 bed 2 bath to work from home and have more space. I pay for a 2 bedroom 2 bath, however since I moved in, I have had sporadic hot water, sand blasts out my shower and tub faucets. A showerhead exploded on me, shooting plastic and metal & I was cut on the hand. I've had a several plumbing companies come in last 3 months no one fixes it right. Maintenance gets sent to my apt, they make some excuse for not finishing the repair ...they say they need approval to continue or are missing tools that they will be back in 15 minutes and they never return. When I first reported my water issue, I was urged by leasing to just be released from my lease and go somewhere else. However cost for moving and time packing would be my problem NOT theirs. I've had to call code compliance before anyone lifted a finger to help with water issues. I had a leak and water just sat on my bathroom floor for 2 weeks saturating my floor getting mold. The floor was eventually repaired but the water leak was just capped off risking another possible leak. The sheetrock was eventually replaced after several of my requests. I've had to involve code compliance to help get things resolved. I don't suggest this complex!!! Repairs never get fixed and the office will just tell you whatever & ONLY WORK ON THINGS WHEN CODE COMPLIANCE IS INVOLVED. the property has Major water issues. I don't suggest.

Its great living at the Renata I was a tenant for 8 years and only bad thing I had ever experienced was no notice when pool was closed and some roaches. The manger was great Ashley and always helpful when I need assistance. Maintenace was always quick to fix a situation. To be honest I miss it there it was great price and convenient to all sides of town.
Every week our mail is stolen and nothing is done to protect our mail. The staff doesn't even act like it is a problem! Do not move here!

Attempted to charge me a bunch of extra fees after moveout. Additionally, they purposefully tried to obfuscate these fees by adding and then subtracting approximately a half a dozen different various fees on my account, which made it difficult to see what I was actually being charged for. I called and left a voice mail asking for a clear explanation of these fees. They never responded. Ended up having to pay over $100 that was never fully explained. I do not recommend living here.

***SAVE YOUR MONEY DON'T APPLY HERE*** They use an outsourced background check service that isn't accurate for credit and and other background material. I had a terrible experience with them and ultimately I was  given the run around and had to pay non refundable fees just to be embarrassed by false reports. Now I have another inquiry on my report and lost $250.00. I would recommend skipping this property and taking your chances elsewhere .

-unresponsive management 
-ROACHES 
-Flooding issues 
-loud neighbors 
-dog poop everywhere 
-pools are closed with no notice
I am being VERY HONEST, roaches, pool is never open, laundry machines charge me twice sometimes, dog crap everywhere

My wife an I have been living here for just over a year now, and so far I have been pulling teeth with management, and maintenance for basic amenities. The unit is constructed poorly with the floor separating from the walls just about in every room, with wall outlets working half of the time and a sagging foundation that locks doors shut. The maintenance people are constantly changing out and are therefore under trained.  
  An example of this is when just recently we requested for our hot water looked at (again for the 5th or more time) because it lasts for 10 mins or less and we have a baby on the way. When help arrived a few weeks later nothing happened except quick troubleshooting. The maintenance man concluded an electrical issue was causing the hot water heater to tripped and reset after some time, this is fine because it seemed like progress was on the way, but then he began to brag about how he just installed a water heater in a different unit and that he didn't understand the wiring having three wires vs two. I've been studying electrical engneering for a few years and kindly began to explain why some equipment uses three wires besides two, he quickly became offended/dejected and changed his story of the AC system having four wires now, I noticed he was trying to save face, so I told him, "in a nutshell its for safty" and quickly changed the subject to something he would likely know more about. Ultimately this ended up him lying to us about more help coming by, we still have the same problem to this day, the hot water issue began about three months ago. Before this unpleasant visit, we talked to the main office in person and over the phone multiple times, only to have them 'forget' us completly multiple times. Thanks, Kati. 
  Neglect seems to be the way things work here, air filter changing is ignored, work orders are marked as complete when they have not been, told to me from the main office themselves, and staff frequently saying no one was home when we are, often we try to coordinate our schedule with them but they ignore it and arrive just as were leaving when right when they are closing for the day, and this is all still the tip of the ice burg. We had an enormous mold problem near the front door that grew because no one would show up, and when it was 'fixed' the wood was replaced by a splintery plank that is risky to handle without injury.
  This isn't worth the price they charge for. All this happing with new management already taken over.

THIS IS THE ABSOLUTE WORST PLACE TO LIVE!!!! 
MAINTANANCE NEVER COMES TO YOUR PLACE NO MATTER HOW MANY TIMES YOU CALL AND REQUEST SERVICE ORDERS. 

THE TWO SWIMMING POOLS HAVE BEEN CLOSED ALLLLL SUMMER LONG WITH CHAINS AND LOCKS. THE OFFICE ALWAYS SAYS THEY'RE WORKING ON THEM YET YOU NEVER SEE ANYONE CARE. WE HAVE 100 DEGREE WEATHER AND ZERO ACCESS TO THE SWIMMING POOLS FOR NO REASON.

I don't know where they're coming from .. probably from the vents?

This is my second month, and every day I would see roaches .. all over   ... in the cabinets, plates, in the kitchen, bathroom even in the closet.. 

I bought a raid spray for bugs/roaches and its almost empty .. everyday I can spot one or two running and hiding from small cracks under the cabinets, sinks .. 

This is like the motherlode of all roaches ..yes they just like Renata for a reason.

RoachHunter@Renata

Place  is infested with roaches and management doesn't do anything to resolve that issue. Spray treatments that btw are additional fee on top of your rent simply DON'T work.
Gym has been under "construction" since I've moved in so for almost two months (that wasn't disclosed during the process)...so if you're looking for free of charge huge, creepy roommates who decide to show up when you're cooking or sleeping and be charge for services that are not provide that's the place to be.
 If you however looking for place that fix issue from the roots that's definitely not the right place.Property manager is a "problem solver" who who claimshe has "transformed the place". Funny he says that and then you speak to other tenants who have been brushed off by him and let without any solution to their problem... Do yourself a favor and look somewhere else, definitely not worth the hassle or the money...

The new management at Renata have really turned things around.  The exterior is so much nicer and the renovations they are making are exceptional.  I would definitely recommend you check these apartments out!

We recently moved into Renata Apartments.  The office staff, especially Clarissa, worked closely and patiently with us to find the perfect floor plan within our budget.  On move in, the apartment was clean and recently renovated with new appliances, fresh paint, and new carpet.  The maintenance crew has responded to our requests promptly.   The property management is making great strides at maintaining a safe and beautiful living environment for the tenants.  In spite of a few negative reviews, the attentiveness of the staff was the deciding factor in selecting this apartment complex.  After being here a bit, I can affirm we made the right decision.  Thumbs up Renata Apartments!!!

Terrible! Aside from the mailbox fence that was taken down, and immediately had our mail stolen, the apartments have yet to fix the swimming pools. We've been without a swimming pool for over 8 weeks. Yes, all summer and no pool. Everytime we've reached out to the office they state they're waiting on parts. Let's see how much longer the parts will take. For now, no security guarding our mail, no swimming pools, and no interest in getting either addressed.

The apts are now under new management. They took down the gate for the mailroom that park hill had installed because people were breaking in and guess what when it came down they broke in again! I went to talk to the person in charge, Ida Duranta,  and she said that there was nothing they could do. They took it down because it looked bad. I asked for a corporate number and she said she didn't have one. She so rude and impatient with me she didn't want anything to do with me or the other residents who were there to talk to her. Someone was trying to ask her something and all she kept saying over and over in the middle of the residents sentence was "there's nothing I can do. You're gonna have to fix it yourself." She was rude and completely incompetent. She couldn't give me any information and dismissed me before I was even done with what I had to say.

This is our first apartment and it's okay especially for people who are renting for the first time. I wouldn't say it's a great place for kids though there are families here with kids, there isn't a park for them to play at. Most parks that are nearby are super crowded and have limited parking. Parking is a little tight but it's okay. So I'll go over some of the good things. They have a great pool, it's not loud it's actually quite quiet during the day and nights, I haven't had any trouble with neighbors or anything. Maintenance guys are great they respond pretty quickly and are informative as to what's going on and what they're doing to fix it. Now the bad, there have been some days where I have found workers on my patio early in the morning fixing things that I was unaware of. I'd at least like a warning or so knowing that there's going to be people working on the patio just as a courtesy. Everything started to break. The blinds were already broken and the last people just taped them with scratch tape. The sinks leak pretty badly. The cabinet underneath the bathroom sink caved in. The ceiling started to leak from upstairs and then our neighbors ceiling downstairs also leaked within that same week. There's a huge crack on the ceiling in the bathroom. The floor bed and wall started to creep up or peel behind the fridge. The fridge started leaking as soon as we moved in. The disposable started smoking as soon as we moved in. There's a roach in the eye hole to look outside. Our light outside didn't work and took months for someone to notice but that was mainly our bad for never reporting it. Super small pantry. Toilet wobbles and basically needs to be replaced, it doesn't flush. Door handle started to come undone. It's like one thing after another with this apartment so I suggest that they do some major TLC, and redo some of the small things. Also for paying pest control it doesn't really work. But because there's these holes in the bathroom and kitchen it's pretty easy for them to just come and go. It's honestly not a bad apartment complex, it's quiet and decent and affordable. I recommend people who are in colleges or budgets to live here. I enjoyed living here but due to my little family I'll need a place that's more space and something for my kids to hang out at. It's not bad, it's not amazing, it's nice and quaint. I'd bump it up if it wasn't for everything feeling like they were falling apart.

Having spent months looking for apartments I am glad I picked Park Hill. 
The staff here is incredibly helpful & friendly.
The assistant manager, Erin, has been the most welcoming in helping me settle in. 
If you have ever lived on the first floor you'll be happy to know that the foundation doesn't cream when your upstairs neighbors move.
If you love swimming, they clean their pools daily. More fun in the sun!
The best part is they make you a great promise on their maintanence. No more than 48 hour wait.
The staff is friendly the neighbors are friendly. 

I spent months looking through the entirety of apartments in San Antonio. 
Park Hill is one of the best apartments you'll find.

This place is an all around drag and a poor excuse of an apartment complex. Management is a joke, they will never give you a straight answer and if you call to complain about anything or even just ask a question they will be rude and disrespectful. There always seems to be an issue with water and no exact reason as to why. The maintenance men can barley tie their own shoes much less fix anything wrong in your apartment, can't trust them to look at anything without myself or wife being there to watch them only make thing worse. If you value good communication and like feeling safe and proud to be a part of a community, then this is definitely not the place for you. If you are new to San Antonio steer clear of Hilltop Oaks.

Iam currently in the transition part of trying to move to these apts. I can say so far the staff has replied to me in a timely manner, everyone i spoke with was helpful and not rude, like the 3 apts i talked to before about leasing, Iam looking forward to this community. Thx Office staff of Hilltop oaks apts yall really made things alot easier for me at such a stressful time.      Mrs.R. Brown

Horrible communication,  their is a constant problem with the water it's always disconnected without notification, our hot water hasnt been working going to 6 days now and the office and maintenance dont know anything. And they send out papers saying they're gonna start charging everyone for things unnecessary, while they cant even supply us hot water.
Been living here for 2 years. I like the service and all bills paid except CPS

I move out since February 2018 they call me months later they are going to send my deposit back still waiting l stop by the Oficce 4 times they ask me for my new adress and apartment number l give it to them 2 more times via phone we are in the middle of October they call me and ask for my apartment number again THIS IS A PLACE YOU CAN'T TRUST. l always paid my rent on time and leave it nice and clean

I've lived at Hilltop Oaks Apts in San Antonio for almost a year and have never had any problems at all. If I put for a maintenance request they show up either the same day or the next and the job is done right the first time so I don't need to call them back. The entire office staff is so friendly. They really try to get to know their residents on a first name basis and vice versa.  Pest control is amazing to where I've never seen any types of bugs at all.

This past Saturday 5/25/19, I was visiting from out of town and decided to take a look at some apartments. Upon entering the leasing office I inquired about the availability of a 1 bedroom apartment which I was told was unavailable at this time. So I asked if any two bedrooms were available and and I was told yes. When I asked to see a model the woman in the leasing office was very rude and told me no she cannot leave the office to go show me the apartment. I was told since she was the only one there she couldn't leave. Her attitude and demeanor was very unpleasant throughout my whole visit. You certainly lost a prospective tenant. My advice would be to hire someone a bit more customer friendly. I was truly disappointed.

Update: I've been living at Costa Almadena for a month. I absolutely love it here! I love that they have  caring management. Everytime I go into office these ladies are busy trying to make the community better as well as our friendly maintenance guys. The apts are quiet at night and during the day the children are at play, I love sitting on balcony watching them. Everyone is friendly here. When I first moved in I had so many people offer to help me. Which was so unexpected! It is very beautiful here as well! I hope everyone does their part to keep our community clean. It is our duty as residents to keep our community looking beautiful as well. Again a big Thank you Costa Almendena!

I haven't had any problems so far just this one time they left a note on my door saying i had paid my rent late (which I didn't). I confronted them about it and the manager didn't even apologize she just told me to disregard the note, and when i went to the office to pay my utility bill, she still was trying to charge me the late fees for paying my rent late! I cleared that up with her and told her they need to stay on top of their payment posting because no one likes to get home to such a note after a long day at work. Other than than all is good, nice people, pretty calm.

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: This place has a very unprofessional staff that doesn't care about you or your families safety. Trash is everywhere. They don't take care of noise complaints. Good luck with them answering the phone if you need anything. Find a different place for you and your family to live. Don't waste your money here.

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: I am loving this apartment.  It is spacious and hard wood.  The apartment is very sound proof.  Both of my neighbors are dog owners and I don't ever hear anything from either side.  The electricity bill for the first 3 weeks has come in which is around 30 dollars with it blasting at 70 degrees so it has very good power utilization.  Maintenance is quick.  If you have an issue and you need it resolved quickly call it in.   Closets are walk in which is lovely.  I got the A1U apartment and so far I am loving it very much.  I also love the granite kitchen tops.  I highly recommend this place.

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: I was hesitant to move here because of all the mixed reviewers. You either get really good reviews or really terrible ones- no one between. I called the office to kind of get a first impression to determine whether or not this will be my future home. Keep in mind I’ve moved to enough apartments and suffered enough hell to deal with any more none sense. Immediately the staff who answered was rude. I told her I had a question about her available units. She said sure, give me one minute, and after putting me on hold for 5 minutes she hung up! I can’t imagine what actual residents will put up with in these apartments with these people when they’re already this dismissing with potential future residences.

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: I don't even know where to start, I have been living in this apartment complex for more than 6 years and going through all the different management companies but the one that is managing the apartment complex now is the worst. There are always excuses about not having a maintenance order fix within a reasonable time, we just got someone breaking into our car because the gate is not working for more than a year now. The property is full of dog's excrement, and the grass is all mud now. The staff is always new and never knows what is happening, the resident portal only works for you to pay rent but you will not work for emails or updates in your maintenance request. We are forced to pay pest control each month and I have been requested to come to my apartment three times already and never stopped by. The only convenience is the garage, which I am using as storage for all the furniture that I have. Thinking of moving if management company does not get better. It is sad because the prices keep getting higher and management is getting cheaper.

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: Do not move here! They are trying to charge me over 2 months worth of rent for vacating our apartment early in order for them to rent it out sooner! People have already moved into our old apartment and now they send us a bill for over 2000 dollars for lease termination! It’s also impossible to get ahold of anyone on the phone!  10 out of 10 do not recommend!!!

apartmentName: Overlook at Stone Oak Park Apartments
review: It’s been more than a few weeks since both the main and the pedestrian gate broke,  and no one has bothered to fix it. Apparently, the administration isn’t concerned over the security of the place. Two of of three runners in the gym have as well been broken for more than a few months. During most of May, the pool was out of service, and currently the car wash isn{t working either. During the sunny afternoon of June 11th, when the pool was full of people, the administration ordered to take all of the furniture that was on the pool area, leaving everyone sitting on the hot floor, while giving a vague explanation of why they had taken everything. Overall, a disaster.
Gates always broken, pool finally hot deep cleaned. Filthy and Noisy.

The pricing is way to high for the poor quality living, everything is outdated except for the new thermostats they’ve installed. They never answer the phones, then when you walk into the office they aren’t busy. Maintenance and employees don’t follow up with work orders, you have to constantly remind them of your problem. They’ve painted all of the buildings white, so they are false advertising online, and it’s been a hot summer but the pool hasn’t be available for use in weeks. Mind you, after the snowstorm they didn’t deep clean the pool, even though they said they did, they’re always lying, I would know, I have a pool view. It would get as green as a swamp, and they would just add chlorine. It’s not a gated community because the gate has been broken for years now. So anyone would come in and swim, There is also Trash everywhere. They don’t keep the pool restroom available like they should, the gym is dirty, and the employees in the office are unprofessional. It’s getting worse and worse with each new management team. Oh and the mail box door is broken too, like everything else.

The Republic Woodlake apartments are pretty spacious and functional.  I've currently lived here for 11 months and cannot complain much.  

Pros: 
the location- it is definitely the biggest plus about moving here.  There is a Target, Bank of America, Chic-Fil-A, Subway, Ross, and Sally's literally across the street.  HEB and Wal-Mart are directly down the street, and there are plenty of places to eat.  Although the complex has a small gym onsite, there is a Gold's Gym within minutes of driving.  The complex is located within Judson ISD, with Woodlake MS within walking distance. 

the cost- the rent is also a plus.  Republic Woodlake is reasonably priced, especially because of the location.  I live in the bigger one bedroom (around 750 sq ft) for under $800/month.  When I signed my lease, I received a discount for where I worked.  Make sure to asked about any specials!

the amenities-The apartment includes all black GE appliances, walk-in closets, spacious rooms, ceiling fans, a washer/dryer facility, washer/dryer connections.  Also included are valet trash pickup, utilities paid to the complex, Time Warner basic cable and your choice of carpet or hardwood floors.

the residents- in all the time of leasing here, I have never made a noise complaint.  It's pretty quiet here. 

Cons: the only downside is that, although gated, there are several times during my stay that the gate has been stuck open for several days at a time.  Unfortunately, during one of those times numerous cars were broken into, including my boyfriends'.  

Overall, I would recommend staying here.

When the issue was raised to management, we were told that pest control was scheduled to come in a few days. No more details were given. Infestations like this do not happen overnight. Reviews warning of this issue at Paragon Westover Hills are either hard to find or nonexistent, so the lack of transparency carries more weight. This place has all the bells and whistles of a luxury apartment (including rent prices), but that does not mean much when you can’t go to bed without worrying that cockroaches will be crawling all over you while you sleep. Moving here was expensive, and finding somewhere new on such short notice would not be a simple task. Not to mention the matter of the lease that was signed. I came from Cali and after a few months moved into a one bedroom here at Altamonte with my boyfriend. We have 1 bed, over 700 sq. ft. (3rd floor) and pay in the low $700's for it. You can even get like a $20 discount if you work at a favored place (like schools). Our price has never but one time increased and that was for an $8 trash fee. The people up front are always wonderful. We never had an apartment under our names before, but with a parent being our benefactor it was a no problem. 
Additionally this is part of one of the nicer areas in Texas, so be relieved. Stick with the Northern part of San Antonio.

There's a wash/dry hook up as well as a laundry building nearby (we go to a family's house and don't use these) The pools are popular with the kids and I see a lot if dog owners here. The trees here are nice to look at, compared to staring out my window to the next apartment across the way. It has a good smell all around, never a stinky place even with all the dogs. The parking can be a bit of an issue if you arrive later in the evenings, but of course it depends on how many people are actually living here at the time.

The apartment itself may be on the more out dated side, but it's a really good place overall, so I can overlook it. Some paint mess ups, a simple older window (we have one in the bedroom and a sliding glass door out to our balcony-that's all but it's not bad). We complained and they sent over a cleaning lady the next day! If course I felt if anyone is going to clean it to my standards it's going to have to be me. I have lived here over a year and still find one if those nasty white hairs from time to time...

Our AC, heat, and water all work really well! The AC has been our biggest issue, it's conked out on us now and then, but MAINTENANCE IS AMAZING and 95% of the time can come by that day to fix it, assuming you don't call after everything has closed. They make this a priority issue anyway. These guys work hard in this Texas heat.

We would highly recommend this place, we even waited a few months just to get an apartment-without even looking at it (only saw the small model show room)! We plan to live here until we move again, AKA out of state.

I've looked into MANY apartment complexes in San Antonio, and being my first time in a big city, my boyfriend & I had one priority: safety.

It even has signs all around the premises. For a boyfriend in law enforcement, this was very pleasing. Another key feature is the gates only being accessible with a card or remote.
Now, about the complex itself. There is always parking available, at any time of day. The price I pay for all available amenities and size of our apartment is very reasonable. It is a friendly community filled with families. There are two pools and fitness centers - a major plus if you're lucky enough to be close!

To be completely honest, if you want a great complex with a home feel to it, look no further. Everything you need at an affordable price is right in front of you.
