We've been there for two happy years, wonderful location and the building itself is great, both in looks and quality.

For the last 6 & 1/2 yrs I have enjoyed living here at Mallard Creek. The maintenance staff has been the same two people- Herman and Jay. They both seem knowledgeable and address issues promptly. The manager Deena is very professional and is a good listener, which I truly appreciate!! I love the pool and new grills for enjoying a cookout! Neighbors are friendly and also seem to like it here. New owners of property have been updating roofs, paint, and making big updates to many apartments. Love it!

I lived for 5 years in one apartment, and when it came time for more space I stayed at Mallard creek. They did everything to make the transition easy!! Thank you, staff!
The environment is quiet and peacetul. The maintenance service is great, Herman Acevedo is quick to respond to orders
Mallard creek has gone through some changes and has improved significantly. Maintenance staff is always on point and on time .

Dirty, unkept property, unsafe conditions, they let anyone move in tons of drug deals on site and fights outsides, drug dealing thugs stand at the corner of the buildings at night. Management company doesn't care

Horrible Place to live, apartments are outdated and need to be remodeled.  My apartment was broke into while staying there, and we had to keep reminding them to come fix the windows, and when we asked moved, they tried getting us to pay three more months of rent, and then sign a new 6 month lease.  The girls in the office never pick up the phone, and don't try to work with you at all.  After we moved out we got charged 35 dollars a stain on the carpet even though most of them were already there and the lady that moved us in said we did not need to document them.  No security, there is no gate or cameras, just a sketchy area overall.  Stay away!

We consider ourselves fortunate to have found these wonderful apartments within walking distance to UNC-Charlotte! We like our neighbors and the family atmosphere, and the fact that we're conveniently located near schools, restaurants, grocery stores and the cinema. It's a  quick 25 minute drive to the heart of Charlotte, or you you can take the Blue Line at the university.
Apartmant managers at Mallard Creek are helpful, knowledgeable, professional, welcoming, and enthusuastic. The landscaping is beautiful, the pool enjoyable, and maintenance requests are resolved in a timely manner. Mallard Creek is an awesome place to live!

We looked at a number of properties and settled on this one because of the beauty of the grounds, the amenities (beatiful clubouse, pool, workout room, indoor half count basket ball, tennis courts and car wash area), the apartment layouts (we are in a 3 bedroom), the proximity of the additional storage grages to the apartments, the spacious garages and the value.  We were treated well by the staff when viewing the property and were pleased to find the courtesy and responsiveness of the staff carried over to our time here.  Although we have experienced few issues requiring maintenance, on those occassions when we did need a hand the response was prompt and the service professional.  We have no regrets about moving in and look forward spending many more years here.

This is one of the worst place to live. Rents are very huge. The your rent for the lease renewal depends on the mood of leasing management. Completely uneven prices across the apartment homes. The apartments are not at all clean. There will be always lots of bugs in the edges of the carpet as they do not fix the carpet on to the wall properly. I also saw lot of break-ins in the apartments and cars. There is no assigned parking and no proper lighting on the street. They dont even care to look into complaints. The maintenance people are very harsh. They do not maintain proper cleaning standards and directly come into your apartment without removing shoes.

I was very excited to move here from out of state because of the location and floor plans but after only a few months started to become frustrated with the experience altogether because of the poor maintenance standards.
The layout is very nice, but the ventilation is very poor throughout the apartment, especially in the bedrooms. The poor ventilation promotes mold growth and accumulation around the vents and in the duct work. Appliances are base level, discount models that work ok, but are not very nice. The maintenance staff is mostly aware of the problems, but would rather fix an aging AC unit twice a year instead of actually replacing it.
There are some safety concerns around the community, no sidewalks and cars that speed through the neighborhood (in spite of some clunky and equally dangerous speed bumps). There have also been several instances of vandalism in the complex.
The amenities seem nice enough, until you find that the hot tub is under maintenance for the majority of the year, and the exercise equipment is poor and once it breaks is replaced with used equipment. The pool is a nice relaxing spot, except for the hot summer days when the community dumpster next to the clubhouse blows rancid air in that direction. There is a basketball court as well, but it is mostly unavailable because they keep a bike lock wrapped around the doors instead of fixing the electronic key pad.
The staff is generally polite (with the exception of a few individuals), but also not very helpful. There seems to be very little communication in the office, and even less follow through. There are reviews on other sites that more specifically address these issues.
While the living experience is less than ideal, I will say that the location is great. Concord Mills is only 5 minutes away and the close proximity to 85 and 485 make getting nearly any where in Charlotte very easy. The local schools aren't so great, but there are still a lot of children that live here.
To summarize, I think the most telling piece of information, would be the declining residency. There are several units that have remained empty for several months (high demand, 3 bedroom, end units). Now that we have been in the area for a while, we have actually met several other people who have at one time lived in this community and had similar experiences. I'm sure that once we leave, our unit will likely remain vacant as well.

The Tradition at Mallard Creek is a well-managed property. You will find friendly office staff. Cheryl, Pilar and Lyndsey are always ready and willing to help with any question you may have. The maintenance staff is also amazing... Tom, Marvin and others go above and beyond in their personal care for the property. In the rare event an appliance should no longer work, rest assured your call for assistance will be addressed quickly with a repaired or replacement product.  The grounds are also beautifully manicured.  You may find a newer property nearby, but my husband and I agree... Tradition is the place to be!  I give Tradition 5 stars!

Everyone here is so friendly and helpful. They handle everything so quickly. Not to mention, the apartments are so nice and open. After doing a lot of apartment shopping, I found you get the most for your money here in a family friendly environment. Once I can move to the area, this is where I will be.

I wish I could afford to live here forever.  I looked at others in the area but to me this is heaven and luxury.  I feel very safe here and taken care of.  I love the built in bookcase, tile shelf in the bathtub for my shower gels, fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and separate sink with mirror and lights (my own vanity in the bedroom), which has a large walk in closet.  The washer and dryer are included in a room off of the kitchen. The kitchen has many cabinets including 2 large ones over the breakfast bar.  I can sleep here, it is well insulated and very quiet.  Family oriented. Beautiful landscaping, swimming pool, hot tub, tennis court, indoor basketball, fitness room, play ground for the kids.  Great office staff and maintenance people.  I lived here 5 years but they raise the rent every year by $39.00 or $40.00 a month!  That is the only bad thing in an otherwise perfect apartment.  I would buy it; if I could.

We all really hate it here and be suffering but they slick cheap. I use to live in the hood on the south side and lived better but came her thinking I moved up. Its hella worse!! Management dont do nun and be lying thru they teeth. Cant trust these folks frfr but if you desperate just make sure you keep up with all your papers.

I have been here for a month (May 1st - Today)!!! I was assigned to an apartment with a dirty filter, foul smell like mold or something and I became extremely sick. When I contacted multiple higher ups (Property manager, Regional manager, director or tech services, HVAC) It took them 2-3 weeks to even believe me even with all my videos and pictures until I came home to my apartment bathroom flooded , wires sparking , a pungent smell and smoke throughout the whole apartment to actually take me serious & find me another unit to move to. After 2-3 weeks of trying to make me stay during my sickness and hell I finally was assigned to move to a new unit. Just when I thought things were getting better and was somewhat accommodated for my first month inconvenience, I moved in this new unit to a drain line pipe from the AC above my bathroom shower leaking dirty cold full buckets of water. The dirty water is even leaking on me while I’m taking a shower!! I spoke with other residents who stated their apartments were not doing the same thing and in my first apartment I was assigned to had no leak. When speaking again with the regional manager and property manager on site about the leak they stated that it is suppose to do that and that there is no fix to it. Why would y’all not tell tenants that before moving in?? Can you imagine taking a hot shower or washing your hair and a pool of cold water drops on you from the ceiling?? Can you imagine hearing water NOT DRIP BUT continuously POUR in your bathroom 24/7 while you get ready for work, use the restroom, or even hearing it leak at all. Does that sound habitable or even a comfortable place to live?? I even had an HVAC contractor that I know personally come take a look and he stated the problem and that it can actually be fixed, so what are we doing? HVAC came today and stated that only SOME apartments leak but I am not the only one. SOMEE!!?? So what is in the other apartments that aren’t leaking that is different from mine?? And why can’t it be fixed?? And who cares if I am not the only one when it’s dirty pipe line water dripping 24/7 and while I’m showering?? Because I am so clean it is a major problem for me to have to clean my shower before I step in because there is dirty ceiling water all in my tub. This is a horrible experience.

If you go on there actual apartment website they screen they reviews so that it’s only good ones but they or horrible! I’ve been here for a week and moving in i had roaches! They do not car about you! Can’t get in touch with anyone in the office! Call or email! Maintenance won’t even come for the simple things

Terrible experience!!!!!! DO NOT MOVE HERE! I have been staying here 2 months and have had issues since day 1. I was out of water for 2 days 2 weeks after moving in and the first night I couldn’t get in contact with anyone to let them know, not to mention I haven’t had AC since I moved in and it seems like they are not in any type of rush to get me any AC. I was also told they don’t give concessions so I couldn’t get any off my rent for any of my troubles.

Mailbox has been broken for almost the entire month and they refuse to give us a concrete answer as to when it will be fixed. Haven't received any mail since. Took them 3 months to fix maintenance issues from WHEN I MOVED in. Absolute joke of a complex

The Piedmonts management staff were very helpful with the apartment selection process as well as being attentive to any questions or needs I have. Management has been very friendly and a few of the maintenance staff have been as well. I feel comfortable and at home living here.
Office staff and maintenance are the best! Grounds are beautiful, and any request are handled quickly!
The girls in the office are wonderful! I recently had the pleasure of meeting the new manager, Brittany! It seems she is a good addition to the team here!
Beautiful Community! Office staff and maintenance are amazing! They are truly involved in the community, and truly care!

Dog poop in common areas, very common. The tenant pool patrol person was very discriminatory. I  complained several times and the staff did nothing. Everything else in terms of amenities was great. Rent hike over $100/mth caused me to leave like several other tenants. Lived there when the property shifted from one property management company to another.

a great place to call "home". The entire staff always greet you with a smile and are very helpful to our needs, and are quick to attend to any problems that arise . The grounds and facilities are kept clean every day by friendly courteous workers. The workout rooms are open 24//7 are rarely crowded and the pool area is lovely.  I live alone here and could not feel safer anywhere else....a beautiful neighborhood!

We've lived here for two years, and this is honestly the first apartment I've truly loved. The management team is incredible, and they seriously do make you feel welcomed by going out of their way to add special touches. From moving in, to our birthdays, to simply stopping by to get mail (which I did ALL the time, and they were so friendly and organized), it's personalized and you can tell that they do care about their tenants. I also really appreciated the planned maintenance we received for upkeep. Upon adopting a large dog that is insanely hyper, we've decided that a house would be a better option for him to run and play as much as he can, but that's the only reason we are leaving. It's been wonderful, and we will truly miss the staff. Thanks so much!

Well... I have officially been here for a full month (wanted to get a few weeks in before I confirmed my initial impressions and write a review) and I can't say enough great things about this place.  To start, my initial salesperson who gave me the tour and closed the deal was Shani.  What a delight.  Overall my whole experience from first walking in the office, to move in day, to day to day interactions with the office has been fantastic.  Shani, Cathy and Kim couldn't be more accommodating.  All of my basic 'new resident" requests and questions were handled timely and professionally.  As for as the actual place- it's great.  The atmosphere, the other residents, the location and the amenities are great for the value.  The South Park neighborhood has so much to offer, and this place is a very reasonable choice in a VERY nice neighborhood.  Keep up the good work ladies!!!!

We have lived here over two years and couldn’t be more pleased.  The building and grounds are well maintained and the staff is always friendly and responsive to all requests.  Monthly social gatherings are provided so you have an opportunity to get to know your neighbors.  The location couldn’t be better with numerous restaurants, shopping and business needs close by.  We strongly recommend anyone planning on moving to this part of Charlotte to check out Ashley Square.

Although I have a "non-smoking" unit,  all of the neighbor's smoke flows straight into my apartment.  The place reeks.  There are balconies and you would think the smokers would use them...  They don't.   The odor and residue is in my closet and pantry.   Ugh!  The staff smokes.   So,  don't expect much.   It is not the finest place to live.   There aren't any amenities.  If you smoke, however, this is paradise.

Ashley Square Apartments in South Park is a wonderful community.  They have really nice modern apartments with spacious floor plans and balconies.  There are several amenities, such as a 24 hour business center, fitness center and media room.  There is also a very nice pool and gas grills that residents may use all year round.  The leasing staff is also very helpful and friendly. They really want to make sure that all residents are happy.  There are also monthly community events for residents at the Rusty Bucket Restaurant across the street.  Residents get together, meet and enjoy a nice meal and a great atmosphere.  The maintenance staff at Ashley Square is great too.  The maintenance techs are friendly and knowledgeable and make repairs quickly and efficiently.   I would refer my family and friends to this property for an apartment.  The location is ideal too--right in the heart of South Park and just a short walk to shops and restaurants.

Moved in a little over a month ago. Fantastic building in even better location. 50 ft from Whole Foods and across the street from the South Park Mall. Service is exceptional. Apartments are specious. A lot more affordable than its neighbours. Best kept secret in South Park.

Terrible experiences as soon as I moved in.
I moved in just a day ago and they charged me for that. 
As I moved in late in the evening, was not able to put in the parking sticker on the car. Next day morning I went to get my car and I got to know it way towed, and the ruthless towing company charged 225 dollars to release the car.

Also, Apartment is full of spiders !!!!

Maintenance takes months to fix any issue, even if that issue is 2 out of 4 elevators are broken. Their package lockers broke, so now they just let people steal packages from the mail room instead of fixing them or coming up with a better solution. The hallways are always covered in trash and half the amenities don't even work.

Lived here since Dec 22, the elevator has been down over 25times for the longest stretch being 5 weeks. Water disaster recovery vendors are at the property more often than not. It’s common for homeless trespassers to be on property, I have seen used drug paraphernalia left over from them. AC in hallway does not work. Packages are often opened and or stolen. Property management is completely inept.

I lived here for about 2 and a half years (summer 2021 - fall 2023). I liked my experience for the most part. Thought it was one of the more affordable apartments close enough to everything in Uptown. You've got a solid 10-15min walk to the heart of uptown but there are a couple bars and the football stadium are even closer of a walk. If it's hot or cold enough outside you'll find yourself wondering if it's worth walking the 3/4 mile into uptown or ubering just to not be drenched in sweat/frozen solid. Not entirely sure when it happened, but there was a change in management about halfway through my time there and there was a noticeable change in the availability and helpfulness of office staff. There were a number of times I'd call the office multiple times and get no answer only to walk downstairs and see people working in the office which was weird. You used to be able to have a guest pass to have visitors park for free but they did away with those and started charging for guests and presented it as a favor that they were giving us 2 hours free for guest parking. Ended up being ~$20/day which is insane for a guest at the place you're living. There is street parking near the building but it's very inconvenient. This past summer the pool was closed the entire summer until a handful of weeks before fall because ??? There were a couple weeks (maybe 4-5) where there were repairs on the sides of the building and there was scaffolding right outside the windows and balconies and there were times I'd leave the blinds open and see the workers looking in. Never got any heads up or explanation about what was going on. I lived near the main elevator of the building and whenever that went down (which happens decently often), it'd be quite a walk from one of the other elevators. On a positive note, when I'm inside my apartment, I *never* hear what my neighbors are doing inside theirs. I've walked outside to the hallway and have heard them playing loud music but as soon as I got inside mine it's always been quiet. I lived on the top floor so can't speak about noises from above really.   You're near the city so you'll hear the noises of the city at night. Distinctly remember hearing some gunshots and seeing several police cars maybe a mile or so away one time. All in all, some good some bad, more than anything else charging for visitor parking would make me not stay here again but it's a solid monthly rent for the proximity to the city.

Other than the gym finally being finished and being in Uptown,  that’s the only thing good about this place. In my 1.5 years living here the pool has been unusable for a total of a year… Hallways always smells like Trash and Gnats constantly in elevators and hallways which lead to them getting into apartments. You would think making all this money from leases they would give back and improve features you were told were being upgraded when you toured or Atleast maintain other features they already had like the pool. Convenience is awesome but not at the price of being embarrassed anytime you invite friends over.. smh I now know the area a lot more and would work a few more hours a week at my job or doing Lyft to cover the difference in price if I more more towards Southend area. Don’t make the same decision I did
All I have to say is the pool has been closed all year and still no sense of urgency. Better look elsewhere for luxery!!!

I love living at Gateway West. I have everything I would hope for in Uptown living  - beautiful view, nice amenities, a spacious living space, and great natural light, as well as conveniently located to walk to stadiums and parks. The new management has been so respectful and considerate in hearing tenant concerns and making positive changes to the property. They are kind and welcoming and have made living here a more positive experience.
They charge hidden fees. Trash is everywhere. Staff is horrible. Cockroaches in the apartments.its not as “luxury” as they promote. You can get better

I had a HORRIBLE experience living here. They over charge for everything and market “luxury” bc they have granite countertops. The maintenance requests never get finished and then when you move out and they aren’t complete bc they never came back they’ll charge you for it. There is TRASH everywhere. The staff is RUDE. There smoke detectors go off randomly all the time even in the middle of the night and are LOUD. SAVE YOUR MONEY DONT LIVE HERE.

From a current tenant, do not live here.

The fire alarms in the building randomly go off at least once every few weeks due to false alarms. It's extremely loud and lasts between 15 to 30 min. In the past 20 days it's gone off 4 times, including once at 3AM. Last night it went off at 10:00 PM and again at 11:00 PM, and we had to leave our apartment and stay somewhere else so we could get some sleep. Interestingly, after the 3AM instance, we asked the office and they said it was a medical emergency, but I asked the fire dept last night and they said it's been constant false alarms. They're as fed up as we are, because the false alarms take up fire department resources.

The gates to the parking garage are always broken, and the exterior doors to the complex didn't lock for months when we first moved in. The office said it was due to lightning striking the building. I could maybe see that happening, and the people at the office seemed really apologetic about essentially an act of god causing the issue. But a few months later it happened again, and the garage gates and exterior doors stayed unlocked for another month. This suggests the lightning thing either wasn't true or happened twice, which seems unlikely.

I saw the bad reviews about garbage and security issues before we moved in, but when I mentioned the reviews to the people at the office, they were so nice and appeared to be so transparent with us that we decided to take a chance and believe them that the reviews were outdated or just disgruntled people trying to make the complex look bad. The issues persist. The people in the office truly are nice, but there are clearly have clearly underlying issues with the building fire alarms and security systems that they either haven't disclosed or don't know about.

Other issues with the building, the office can't do much about. The facilities, including common hallways, are a bit run down. Tenants allow their dogs to poop in the parking garage. People leave trash in common areas. We got an email recently that heavily implied people are having sex in the pool.

I'm not being dramatic and I don't have a vendetta. In fact, I feel bad posting this review - I feel like I'm betraying the nice people at the office. But I'm being honest when I say that until they've resolved the issues with the fire alarm, security systems, and trash services, it's not worth your sleep quality, peace of mind, and especially your money to live here.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. The management team is horrible . We moved into an apartment that had not been professionally cleaned before our move in. We moved in on a Saturday and when we told management, they told us there was nothing they could do for us until Monday. There was dried pee on the toilet seats and mold in the dishwasher. We have 50+ pictures of filth that we had no choice but to clean ourselves in order to move our things into our unit. Management did NOTHING for us and offered no solutions. It was our problem, not theirs. Since then, things have only gotten worse. Our washer, dryer, and dishwasher were broken upon move in. They lied to us about our charges in the "bundle." I've had an outstanding maintenance request for two weeks for an issue with the microwave. Corporate has done absolutely nothing. DO NOT LIVE HERE. 

UPDATE: (as of 5/17) My car has been broken into 3 times since living at Elizabeth Station, which has only been since August. Other cars too. The last time my window was completely shattered in what's supposed to be a secure parking garage. EVERYONE in the office was aware of my car break in. The last thing on my mind was checking to see if my parking pass was stolen, which it was. My car was towed and Elizabeth Station did NOTHING to help me in this already horrible situation. The guy in the front office said "It's black and white. You either have a parking pass or you don't" KNOWING that mine was stolen out of my vehicle days before. He showed zero empathy or willingness to help in any way. He was very condescending in the way he spoke to me. I never have pleasant experiences with management when issues arise at this complex. It's as if as soon as you become a resident they no longer care about you. All they care about is getting you to sign the initial lease. Additionally, my car was parked only two spaces away from resident apartments. Only separated by an UNLOCKED door that management is aware of. We've brought this security hazard to them multiple times. The door is broken and does not lock. Anyone can walk into resident halls. If someone's willing to violently break into vehicles that close to apartments, what's stopping them from breaking into apartments? Especially with the door to the hall being unlocked. Management comes up with excuses not to fix the door. This complex is not safe and I've other reviews say the same.
Nothing has improved since my 1st review. DO NOT LIVE HERE.

Do yourself a favor and stay away! Whoever wrote these wonderful reviews is lying! Trash everywhere, common areas never cleaned, security gates unlocked all the time, they got rid of the security officer that used to make sure they were locked, noisy, can hear neighbors through the walls, and they had the nerve to raise the hundreds of dollars plus they’re starting to charge for parking for nothing! Much better places to rent from at this price point. After a year of renting there I ran and even lived out before my lease was up.

The state of this place is horrible. No one cleans any common places like the garage or the mail rooms or the hallways. They’re disgusting. No one is dusting down cob webs, power washing or even aesthetically keeping the place. They raised my rent over $300 and the maintenance man asked me for masking tape to repair my refrigerator. My air conditioning unit has broken or stopped working 7 times in a little over a year. The ducts seem to be clogged because there is an annoying creaking noise coming from the vents. The staff is friendly but very matter of fact. The garage doors keep breaking and Instead of replacing or upgrading them they’re just patching things up like they do everything else here. They can’t manage the trash for some reason. Long story short, for the price we pay for rent here the grounds are mediocre despite “LUXURY APARTMENTS” being plastered all over the place. You can pay the same rent and pick one of the many many MANY true luxury apartment complexes in the city. The only reason I am still here is because I was “tricked into signing the base rent lease before the RBS fees were disclosed to me by the property manager. There was a $270 difference that he swore to me was only $50 because they were “replacing other expenses”

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review:
I lived in the Fairways for 7 months in 2024. I experienced exposure to super aggressive dogs, that the management would not do anything about, and had several maintenance requests that went unfulfilled. Because it is a nice area, I was hoping this would be a great experience, it was not.

If you have a chance to live elsewhere, do that.

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review: I moved in over a month ago. The apartments are absolutely spacious, clean dog friendly. The amenities are great. The staff here at the building complex are friendly. There is convenient shopping in walking distance. My neighbors are friendly and very outgoing. I am enjoying my stay here and can see myself here for more years to come. I highly recommend the complex.

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review:
Pool Availability: july 2st 2024 and the pool is still closed....The pool consistently opens late, then will closes in September, despite the warm weather continuing. During July and August, the pool is often closed for weeks because it is dirty.

Jacuzzi Problems: The jacuzzi is perpetually out of order and seems to never get fixed.

Garbage Management: The garbage area is always overflowing, creating an unpleasant and unsanitary environment.

Security Issues: Car theft is rampant, and there are frequent break-ins in the apartments. Residents are fed up with the lack of security, as highlighted in local news reports (check the article: "Residents at South Charlotte Apartment Complex Fed Up with Break-Ins").

Management Apathy: The management team is unresponsive and indifferent to these ongoing issues. They clearly do not care about the well-being and satisfaction of their residents.

I would not recommend this complex to anyone. Stay away if you value your peace of mind and safety.

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review:
There have been 3 management changes in the time I’ve been here (April 2020). Some of the issues I put on my move-in checklist have still not been fixed. My sink leaks frequently and should’ve been an easy fix; when my fiancé went to change the tap, he realized we would HAVE to call maintenance because of the way the sink is rigged up Macgyver-style.

There have been ongoing issues with the TRASH for several months now (I have photos going back to September 2021); it is disgusting and a health hazard, as well as being the first thing people see when driving into the complex. I personally had to lure a possum out of the mail room with dog food. 

My heat has been broken for 2 weeks and it is currently snowing. This is not the first time my HVAC unit has stopped functioning; it’s been ongoing since moving in. On the topic of snow, management nor maintenance bothered to salt the sidewalks or parking lots, leaving tenants in unsafe, icy conditions. 

There is a cockroach infestation in the complex. Myself and several neighbors have seen multiples of them and we are clean tenants. There are also house centipedes and wasps. When complaining to the office, they will not remove wasp or hornets nests and they leave you to your own devices. 

Since moving in (reminder: April 2020), I have used 0 amenities because they haven’t been open. The pool was open for the month of October 2021 and that was it. The gym just recently opened but is only accessible during business hours; I have a job during business hours (that’s why they’re called “business hours”).

For what they expect you to pay in rent, none of it seems to go towards maintaining an inhabitable, safe living environment.

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review: These apartments are definitely worth the price. Location is the best. you can walk to trader joes, starbucks, and the greenway!

apartmentName: The Fairways at Piper Glen Apartments
review:
We originally moved in 2 years ago because of the great location and rent was cheaper than some other places we were looking at. Since then, rent has unfortunately gone up each year. Parking is ridiculous, people park illegally on the curb and in handicapped spaces. Management sends out emails that they're going to do "daily parking checks" and start towing people. That literally never happens. There's plenty of parking, you just have to park a bit farther away and people are too lazy and entitled to do so because there are no consequences. People are constantly playing loud music, sometimes just sitting in their cars blasting the bass after quiet hours. I don't even know who the actual manager is because anytime I send an email to them I get a response from a different person and they only respond to my first email, never after I've sent a reply. Insulation sucks- our living room is hot in summer/cold in winter when the rest of the apt is comfortable. They powerwash the outside of the building but not our actual decks, we just get the overspray all over everything making the windows look gross. 

With all this negative, my favorite part about living here has been the maintenance guys. They are always so friendly and super quick to respond to a request.

I’ve been here two months so far and the only issue I’ve had is some barking dogs and the noise from the street-facing apartment (nothing they can control). It definitely smells like weed on the courtyard side halls but I haven’t had issues on my side. For south end location, I toured a lot of places and this one fit the bill for my needs. the balconies are super small, but you’re right on the rail trail line so it’s very walkable.  the maintenance is super nice and Matthew in the front office always gets me what I need. There are much worse places to live in the location with even higher prices.

I wish I was able to attach pictures in this review.  My roommate and I moved out after cleaning our apartment very well.  There is a change within the lease for cleaning the carpets which we were okay with paying although there is no damage.  MAA’s management decided to charge us to replace the carpet… over 500 dollars which is outrageous and no one at MAA will have an actually conversation about how they think it’s justifiable to replace this carpet.  This carpet is not debatably close to needing replacement to stains or tears at all.

DON'T MOVE HERE. I initially moved in to MAA Reserve because of it's great location in Southend and because it was more affordable then other apartments in the area. This ended up not being worth it for all of the reasons listed below and I will not be renewing my lease. It is worth noting that, no matter how many times you complain about something to management, they either do nothing or find a short term sloppy "fix" and then never follow up. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. Beyond that, below are all of the issues I've dealt with in the span of 9 months or less.

- Community cleanliness: there is constantly dog waste and trash both inside and outside the MAA property; additionally, the hallways smell badly 99% of the time and the floors are usually dirty.
- Broken community facilities: throughout my time here, a number of community appliances are consistently breaking; a few examples include hallway lights, exit doors either not locking or not opening, false repeated fire alarms (which is an extreme safety hazard as it lowers people's likeliness to go outside for real alarms), grills, the elevator, the parking garage door, the call box etc.
- Package delivery: beyond simply posting signs, I have not seen any serious progress in getting vendors to not leave packages on the floor or outside. There have been many times where my packages have been left outdoors in front of the leasing center which is very unsafe.
- Apartment appliances: recently after moving in, my dryer broke. I informed the maintenance man and after "fixing" it, he let me know I can only use one setting on the dryer for it to work and let me know that they would not be replacing it - that is not a fix. Furthermore, my AC/Heating system was broken and when I brought him in to repair it, he found a similar temporary "fix" and as a result I constantly hear fan noise in my apartment even when the unit is off and my energy bill has increased a crazy amount.
- Inconsiderate neighbors: In the hallway I live on, there have been repeated problems with noise complaints, trash left out at the wrong time, and people smoking weed and nicotine in their apartments causing not only the hallway to reek, but also my apartment as it leaks through my vents.

I have lived here for less than a year and experienced all of these problems repeatedly. I have held up my end of the lease but MAA has not held up their end of the contract and for the past year I have paid for services I have not received.

I have lived here for a few years and have had so many issues. The garage floods to where you can’t even get in every time it rains. There are few to nine community events and it is extremely expensive to live here with all the issues that come up. Convenient location and that is about it.

If you’re  moving to South End, don’t move here. This is the bottom of the barrel. The management here does not take care of the building nor care about tenant issues. My experience with other MAA properties has been great, but this place is by far the worst building I’ve ever lived in. 
You will pay a premium here for the location, and that’s about the only positive you’ll get.

The building was one of the first to be built in South End. It hasn’t aged well. The walls are paper thin and the building is always gross. The halls, elevators and stairs always smell like pet waste.

There has been an issue with break-ins. The same suspect just kept coming back and hitting apartment after apartment.

Your “included” utilities might get disconnected! It took me six months, $150 and my internet and cable being disconnected twice before everything was corrected. 
Other tenant are still paying out of pocket to AT&T even though it’s supposed to be included! They’ve also had issues with people losing power for a couple days at a time!

The parking garage floods badly when it rains. The building also aggressively tows. I’ve been towed 4x at $180 a tow.

My experience has been, management will offer you a quick apology but no concessions or solutions to any issue. 

Don’t move here.

Avoid Colonial Reserve. You’ll quickly find out that you can hear and feel every single footstep and movement from the person above you (I’m not kidding. Every. Single. Footstep). It’s one thing to simply hear noises from other apartments, it’s another for the entire apartment to shake like there’s a small earthquake anytime the person above you decides to walk around their apartment (and it’s made much worse if they also have a dog that barks or runs around). 

The building was poorly built and management doesn’t respond to residents when issues are raised. While there are some decent amenities, they aren’t anything special that you can’t already find at most other places in the area. But I cannot stress enough just how bad the paper thin ceilings are. 

You will regret signing a lease here.

I have lived here for a year and a half and while I have had some issues and concerns(as any place can), they have always been addressed in a timely fashion. Angel and Jerry are both assets to this company.
Location great apartments are nice amenities wonderful and the rent office workers are the absolute best. Best ive ever encountered thank you!
Very loud partying at the pool area on the weekends at night. Music can be heard the entire block. Also, floors/ceilings are so thin. I can hear every movement going on upstairs.

This location is in the middle of everything you would need, which is great! The apartment size is decent. Pets:
There is no where to scoop your pets poop, so always walk with your baggie and prepare to walk with it for the remainder. Office management: I usually get Kaia , who is so very sweet and patient, direct and gets my questions answered to the best of her knowledge, but the Office manager Angel is never available for those unanswered questions (that gets annoying). Maintenance: Jerry is the go to! Overall, I call this place home and besides lack of communication, playing hopscotch with poop on the property, I like it here!

I truthfully wish I had NEVER moved into this place. It is in no way worth what I paid. The bathrooms are not modern in any way and look patched together. The kitchen appliance are subpar. The amenities are useless to anyone with a job. Pool and gym are only open til 5/6. I had noise issues throughout the entire time. The office does not have it together. They’d call multiple times to verify something they had already called about. They never knew what was going on. My car was damaged. Parking is terrible with people who aren’t residents. The renewal went up by hundreds of dollars when the apartment complex already wasn’t worth what was being paid. Please just do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.

Overall I was not pleased with my experience at reserve at stone hollow. Ive had mold issues since I moved in and all they continue to do is clean the walls off which is like putting a band aid on a knife wound. The maintenance guy was ok with responding to maintenance requests but the issue never gets solved. Ive sent emails to the leasing office which Ive never received a reply to or a call back regarding any of my issues. For the amount of rent it costs to stay there I definitely wouldnt recommend living here.

It’s been almost a year now since I’ve been leaving in the complex with my family. We really appreciate the neighborhood as well as the management and maintenance team. Lizzy is awesome. She’s the one that helped us find a place in the complex. And since then, she’s always been very attentive every time we had a maintenance issue or any other need. Very nice and professional at a time. 
Good experience overall.

I’ve been here 4 months now and really enjoy it. Great location close to lots of food and stores. Staff is super nice and attentive. Apartment is nice and outside is very clean especially compared to other complexes in this area. I’ve seen previous negative reviews but it seems they’ve fixed all of those issues to me.

The apartments are aesthetically pleasing at first glance but don't be fooled.  Revolving office staff.  No one is around long enough to fix any of the problems with this complex.  Maintenance does the bare minimum.  We've fixed many issues ourself in order not to have to deal with them.  Roaches everywhere.  I try not to be outside at night - but that doesn't do any good when they get inside.  They aren't the small ones either.  I've found so many large roaches in my apartment I might as well be living outside.  I'm an extremely clean person and it doesn't matter.  The message boards are full of people requesting their stolen packages be returned.  I would NEVER get anything shipped to my apartment and the office won't take packages.  The stairwells are disgusting.  Full of food wrappers, dead bugs and dog hair.  We were told we were moving into a unit with new cabinets, yet they all had water damage.  The storage units are nice to have, the pool area is generally clean, but trash cans around the complex are always over-flowing.  Needless to say, we won't be staying.

Truth... So far move in has been a ball of confusion.
1. Tub was not usable, and this apartment had showings, how with a busted tub. Step it up you'll.
2. Then had to switch apartments, another thing to deal with. ??
3. Had to update the lights & then light company wanted a $240 extra fee (for the confusion I guess) now have to deal with that.
4. Now they can't get on the right page with what fee is due for moving in on the date (my son ) did.
5. I'm a need them to get on the right page with Everything. As so far it's Not good.
And hope no back lash for telling the truth. They need to give a months credit for all this trouble... Ijs ????
I'll add that staff were very personable. I liked them. But they must up the quality & training... ??????
Awful property management!! Roaches that travel inside, and not enough parking spaces for guest. Overall do not spend the money it’s not worth it.
We are form New York and moving down here was the best decision for my family .

No parking only about fifteen spots for four buildings to share then you have to park on the street and hope it’s around your building and you better be able to parallel park. 

Trash and cardboard dumpster overflowing. pet waste containers overflowing. Have a community fee that is a waste. 

Staff is terrible

Only three stars for the lack of communication and helpfulness of the office employees. Overall the place is great and looks nice and I do not have any other complaints. However, the people currently working in the office are absolutely worthless. Not only do they apply timed deadlines without any communication or notification until there were only six hours left. They also do not care to talk to you at all! It is very clear that everything needs to be done on their time and it is not important if it inconveniences the residents or applicants. I have never had such a terrible experience with office personnel and would not live here if the apartments themselves did not meet all my requirements. The office people do not answer the phone or respond to messages of emails. I’ve given over a week for both and they simply don’t care enough to respond in any way. Excuses are always that they are busy, but they cannot be busy for 9 days without any sort of reply. Honestly it’s a nice place to live, just brace yourself for the absolute imbeciles working in the office who do not communicate or explain anything and clearly do not care about those they are “helping.”

Huge roaches everywhere. They are in the garage, outside the perimeter, and now have traveled indoors. I have had my apt. exterminated 4x. I'm an extremely clean person. I've been here less than a year. Oh did I mention the marijuana smoke that seeps through the walls? Loud music. Awful parking.  Not worth the money! I selected 1 star because I had to select something. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!

Barbara Moss reviewed Colonial Grand At Ayrsley — 3 star
Just now · 
The pros: The apartments and grounds are well kept. Maintenance is very quick to respond to requests. The office staff is friendly. It is very centrally located to shops.
The cons: They aren't flexible or understanding at all. Parking is a nightmare. I worked two jobs and often had nowhere close to my building to park when I came home from my night job. I lived right off Sandy Porter but was walking from the office or the dumpster area at midnight or 1am because parking is so bad. Lots of people park illegally, sometimes even behind other cars. I had several days where I was late to work because someone was parked in the driving area close enough to my car that I couldn't get out. The one time I parked illegally because it was 2am and raining, my car got towed. Now, I know I was in the wrong technically, but I see cars all the time parked wrong and never towed. Going to talk to the folks in the office did no good. They are just policy enforcers and claim they have no solutions or leeway. In that one aspect, their customer service was terrible.
I also gave notice and moved out two weeks before my lease was up. I get my final bill, and I have rent, cable connection, and water charges all the way to the end date, despite my moving out. Most places will pro-rate for you, but when I called they simply said I was charged to the end of my lease date despite me moving out early. No offers to work with me, pro-rate, or make any concessions. So I paid an extra $113 for a place I wasn't even living or using utilities at.
The apartments are expensive for the size, even for the area. While clean and kept nice, they are really pricey for what you get. Also, if you have a situation that doesn't go by the letter of the law (most people's lives do) expect NO flexibility or understanding from the office.

I moved to Charlotte over a year.  I am still a current resident.  I love my apartment.  I have a one bedroom, with a great closet space. Beside the satisfaction of my apartment, the community is great.  The amenities, the staff.  The grounds are well manicured. The maintenance is excellent.  They are prompt to your request,and  courteous. The town has a bowling alley, hotels, movie theater, all in walking distance. There is so much to add.  We all dream of a stress free environment.  I wake up in the morning with gratitude in my heart.  I definitely will give this community a four star.  Well deserved.

Moving can be very stressful, but when you find the right apartment, it is all worth it! This apartment complex is new, clean, the staff is helpful, and in the most perfect location for all of your shopping needs (groceries, food, pharmacy, dry cleaning, nail salons, etc, etc, etc...) and the rent is more than reasonable (compared to many of the apartment complexes in Charlotte). This is definitely a place I will stay for a long time!

Great place to live. Free basic cable, security system, car wash, washer and dryer installed in every apartment. Consistant maintenance, fast and friendly. Nice floor plans and landscaping/pest control. Great gym and area sidewalks that are safe! Very convenient to other places like the movies, grocery stores, shopping and fast food chains/restaurants...woohoo!

ITS A MODERN CENTRALLY LOCATED OFF OF ROUTE 485  STREET IN CHARLOTTE. THE APARTMENT ARE SPACIOUS AND STAFF IS FRIENDLY AND CENTRALLY T  TO SUPERMARKETS AND HIGHWAYS AND MALLS AND A SHORT DRIVE TO UPTOWN CHARLOTTE AND  SPORT EVENTS AND THE THEATER. ITS  GOOD FAMILY AND SINGLES. ITS GREAT

The apartment complex is very clean, family oriented and quiet. The staff is very professional and efficient,maintenance gets done in a matter of 24 to 48 hours of a request and most importantly the staff make a very generous effort to get to know each and every resident. This is my first time living alone and it has been a more than pleasant experience thus far.
Aziza was great and so friendly really enjoyed our tour

In my personal opinion, the apartment fails to live up to the standards depicted in its advertisements. Despite initial appeal, the actual condition falls short, with outdated features and malfunctioning appliances. The discrepancy between expectation and reality is evident. I hope this feedback serves as a cautionary note for potential renters.

Anytime I have any questions or need help with anything Marcus and the team always come to my aid! They are super helpful with ensuring I am comfortable and happy in my space. The property is super safe, close to my work, and everything is modern and clean! My favorite place I’ve stayed in Charlotte yet!

I really like my unit so that is why my rating is not lower - though appliances are simple compared to other complexes I lived in… buuuut the valet trash drags bags down the corridors causing leakage that the complex has not bothered cleaning in the almost six months I’ve been here.  They don’t even seem to bother to blow the leafs and other debris that accumulates over time.

The dog park is also filthy and not worth the risk of stepping into.  I complained and they picked up the waste but they didn’t bother actually cleaning anything that is still set into the turf.

This is a beautiful complex. Although my husband & i choose elsewhere i can not go without saying how awesome the office property managers were (Taki). She was warm, friendly & had all the answers for our questions. Very professional yet comfortable with her expertise in her job.

Not going to say much because at this point really considering hiring a lawyer. Still haven’t received my refund that was stated, highlighted etc upon applying that would be refunded if denied. I have emailed, called multiple times and it’s been a month and no response. Beautiful property, poor management!

DO NOT LIVE HERE. My roommates car was stolen last week while parked right under our window in the parking lot. There is no security even though CityPark advertises 24 hour security. The “24 hour security” is a parked and empty cop car that sits in the same place for weeks and also there is no surveillance or cameras anywhere to be found. The leasing office still has not answered or returned our numerous phone calls and e-mails about the incident and have not notified the other residents even though 3 other residents had there windshields broken on the same night. This place is not safe.

City Park view has a great maintenance team. My roommate and I have had unexpected things that needed to be fixed within a certain amount of time and they came to fix it in a matter of a couple days, if that long, plus they came and fix our problems with ease. Both Marcus and Christopher did a great job !

Been here for a few years. The main office and maintenance team is always great. Shantel, & Semone* (may be spelled wrong)are always helpful. Recently, had an issue with my fridge and Christopher came but and took care of it.He was very pleasant, respectful and knowledgeable or what he needed to do.

2 years and BOTH pools are always closed during summer because "the levels" are off.. How about using chlorine like the rest of the apartments.
Also they NEVER answer their phones.

When we first moved here over a year ago, we absolutely loved our apartment. We still do. The management staff is friendly and maintenance generally responds in a day or less. The amenities are pretty great as well. But, the walls seem to be super thin. We had terrible neighbors that were up at all hours of the night... We would hear loud talking, their headboard banging up against our bedroom wall and who knows what else from 12-5 in the morning. We’ve had to call the office, courtesy officer, the police, and even go over there ourselves, but they continued to be disrespectful. They would always tell the leading office they were asleep. I’ll just say, hope for better neighbors than we had.

Did I just visit a doctor's office or an apartment leasing office? I've never been to a leasing office that only gives apartment tours by appointment. I've got news for you all, your apartment complex is not superior to the many others in the area so get off your high horse. You all aren't doctors so don't act like 30 minute appointments per prospective resident are necessary. Turning people away who are already there potentially ready to sign a lease upon touring aren't going to come back with an appointment. Instead, they will just use that time to tour other apartment complexes and sign a lease elsewhere. What a horrible way of doing business. You all are losing business! No wonder why you all have so much vacancy. Poor business practices, rude staff, and overpriced "luxury" apartments.

This was the worst experience that I've ever had at a leasing office. The staff member that I interacted with was so rude. Very apathetic, cold, and unwelcoming. Leasing office staff should be smiling and hospitable. Rude staff members who don't even bother getting up from their desk to greet you at the entrance gives potential residents a bad first impression since nobody wants to deal with unhelpful leasing office staff during their lease term. Please consider a first come, first served touring policy or at least accept walk-ins when the leasing office is empty, like how it was when your staff member refused to give me a tour. I was able to tour all six other apartments I visited that day simply by walking in, and I can tell you every single one of them are more likely to get my business than you.

This company has roped me into renting a brand new apartment with a one a half month free rent promise. Then after charging the highest non-refundable application fee I have seen at any of the places I visited told me I had to give them Two months Deposit(more than $2,400!!!)
My credit score is average, and I haven't had a late payment since the end of the recession 5 years ago... I also have been with my current company for over 5 years and make a fairly good amount of money. I really feel like they are taking advantage of me and pulled a total bait and switch because they are having a hard time filling the new apartments and need the money. I am very disappointed right now.

This Complex is great! The Manager is super sweet go to her she is awsome! the Community Rec room and pool area is great, w/ lots of great features.
The only complaint i have is the New Construction  thats going up in front of and behind the complex. There is a hotel going up and the construction crew starts there noise and yelling at 7am Mon-Sat, its annoying if u are trying to sleep in. 
But overall its a great open complex with lots of space and style, plus you are tight next to the huge Rennisance Park so at night its quiet and relaxing.

If you like receiving compliments on your apartment this is the place for you. Every new visitor tells me how attractive it is. And I love living here. High ceilings and thick column boarders makes furniture look even more filling. The fitness center is very nice, all glass, if you like to workout. It's not huge but still a good size for 4-6 people at a time. Most of the staff are extremely nice.

I have lived here for 7 months and think this is the best apartment I have lived in . The staff here are more than that they are more like family from leasing to maintance.my neighbors are friendly and quiet,the complex is very well kept as is my apartment when ever I had a maintenance issue they where here that day and it was fixed at the same time( great maintenance staff)the ladies in the front office are always friendly and helpful in all respects.In closing if you looking for an apartment in the charlotte aera I highly recommend this one      thank you

I love the Apartments they are new and very spacious! The staff and rec center are awsome and they occasionally have partys and pizza night, to help with getting to know your neighbors.Also the complex is right next to a huge park.
The only complaint I have is the sorrounding Construction. There is a hotel going up right in front of the complex, that start work as early as 5am with loud construction noises and now townhouses going up in the back.(But I know if your faceing construction they do discount the rent.) Other Than that its a great place to live.

This is a brand new apartment complex, by a park, a golf course and a farmer's market. It's however not in walking distance of anything else: shopping centers a few miles away, rail station about 3 miles away, a bus stop half mile away, and a few mile drive to some parkway or highways and the airport.

It's bit of noisy during the day or evening with the airport within a few miles range though. But if you like a plenty of open spaces, green surroundings and parking, or like doing some biking, walking or running everyday, this is just a perfect place. They also provide recycle bins, which may attract some environment conscious people like me to live here.

The rent is a little high, but I got a move-in discount and special, which made up my mind for moving in. So far, I am loving here.

The apartment was turned over in appalling condition. The carpet reeked of mold and an overpowering stench that made my entire family sick daily, and visitors refused to come over. After the property manager argued and dismissed my complaints, I had to threaten to involve the North Carolina Department of Health & Human Services before they finally replaced the carpet. They assumed I didn’t know my rights, but as a law student with close federal government connections, I was prepared to hold them accountable. Their attempt to use coercion and intimidation to avoid providing a clean, habitable unit was a huge red flag.

In less than a year, the apartment developed a roach infestation, and I accumulated about 20 pages of maintenance requests—everything from severe leaks flooding in from the ceiling to the AC failing in the height of summer. The unit was in terrible shape from start to finish and far from what they advertise.

When I finally had enough and canceled my lease *before* it started, they still tried to lock me into another term, attempting to charge me rent for an unlivable apartment they couldn’t otherwise rent. Once again, it seems I’ll need legal recourse, as I did when fighting to replace the filthy carpet, to make them back off.

This place is filthy and poorly maintained—move in at your own risk.

Beware. Units are turned over with mold, pet stains, broken appliances, broken and leaking HVAC units. Inspect HVAC, appliances, dishwasher during your tour.
1) I was charged first months rent and deposit in advance to find the unit in conditions attached.  No professional cleaning performed, and maintenance cleaned the unit leaking bleach on the carpet.
2) From move in in January 2022 to March 2022, dishwasher was broken with door not being able to close due to broken latch. This took 3 months to fix.
3) End of March 2022 to August 2022, HVAC was broken and leaking. Due to this AC did not go below 78 degrees and could not cool the apartment. Solution from management was a plastic bucket and window positioned AC unit (violating property’s own residents handbook). 
4) No maintenance of breezeways at any point, despite their valet trash service dragging tenants trash, leaving stains Sunday to Thursday. In addition, the valet personnel examines tenants postal packages. Leasing office is maintained daily and has a dedicated cleaning person, but no maintenance for tenants and their common areas. Due to raising these concerns, the property collets annually is allocated, the management told me via email they will not extend my lease, offering me to leave early, not saying penalties will not be charged.
5) Mold is present in all units. Read other user experiences. I conducted a mold inspection out of pocket due to my cat’s wheezing. The inspection confirmed high presence of clodosporium spores, and according to the inspector, is an EPA concern.   Report was sent to management on 12/23, after which they mailed a letter of non renewal, sent prior to my 60 day notice (1/19). No attempt at remediation from management made. Per the regional director of this multi-million dollar company “that type of mold is commonplace and harmless.” They do not mention this on their website as part of the luxury experience.
6) The community is not in a wooded area, and a new community is being built next door, with construction Monday-Saturday for the foreseeable future.
7) Coyotes abound around the property and the issue is not addressed.
8) Toxic emissions from local paper mill factory reach the area all the time, and management does not warn their tenants.
9)Rent prices do not reflect market conditions.

I regret renting. If I had prior knowledge, experience, and dealings with Bexley's corporate office and its people, I would have surely researched harder for a better landlord.

1. We were given an apartment with a crappy carpet.

2. It was to late as we moved in and noticed after closer observation. We informed a person at the local office.

3. Upon giving notice to leave and setting a move out date. We were informed that they would need an extra week to change out the carpet for the next tenant.

4. Regardless of indicating possible carpet change. Corporate office charged for replacing the carpet and used a small stain, not even a nickle in size and some cleanable areas for the reason.

5. Corporate office did not take into account for the previous tenant's contribution to the excessive wear on the carpet because they would not be able to squeeze the extra money out of us if they acknowledged the truth of the whole situation. I would not recommend to move in with a used carpet. 

I can not recommend Bexley to anyone nor do I trust this organization to do the right thing in certain situations.  
Zero trust,

Bexley crossing was great at first but when you as a paying tenant contact the emergency line to request assistance due to their door lock not turning and to be told that "You'll have to find a lock smith" is ridiculous.  Not only did I miss important work time I was stranded outside of my apartment for over 3.5 hours.  The process for a tenant to get assistance is so far from acceptable it deserves to be dismantled and shutdown.  3 days later finally able to enter my apartment without brute force entry.  So many other options out there please look elsewhere.  You've been warned.

Painted over the mold in our ceiling in the bathroom told me to just turn the fan on it’ll be fine. Roaches & centipedes. Gaps under patio and front door it gets flooded when they power wash. I could keep going.

Moving state to state can be difficult to find a new home to meet your needs. I was drawn to this community after reading how dog friendly it was and it being advertised as a luxury community. Do not let the name fool you. I have not even been here for a full two months and have sent over 5 maintenance orders for their cheap appliances to be fixed. The fridge/freezer has ruined over $200 worth of food and the problem is still not resolved. There are countless stray cats around the community lounging on the poolside lounge chairs for their residents. Being extremely allergic to cats I brought this to the attention of their staff. Curious about their response? “There are a few residents that put out food for these cats because they are attempting to gain the stray cat's trust so that they may "catch" it and bring it to a shelter to remove them from the property.” And “if you would like to have a chair disinfected before using it, we are happy to provide a disinfecting wipe.” The cat bowls are left out all hours of the day and night bringing more pests to the area and anyone with a brain knows this will only create an incentive for more cats to populate the area. Personally, the lack of care is embarrassing for a “luxury” community. Do not let the granite countertops and designer lighting fool you. Pick a different community.

Lived here for years great time. Had a new neighbor move in who would pound on her walls/floors at all hours of the night the pounding was so loud/violent made it impossible to sleep past 5 am. Our walls would shake. Contacted the front office they did NOTHING. They had no solution so we plan to move out. Multiple other people in our building have also moved out because of this neighbor. Hope the complex knows they are losing business and the word will travel fast.

The first reason the place is full of disgusting cockroaches.  The second reason is that I pay for the back balcony while it is unfit for use due to poor maintenance and the third reason is that they spoiled my outdoor furniture without offering an apology or compensation for the damaged furniture. Forth reason is the restrooms in the swimming area are very old and dirty. Also there is no coffee machine in the office area. The only thing is good is its location.

Amazing staff and service technicians. Very responsive and genuine in their responses and always greet you will a smiling face when you walk in the leasing office. Really recommend if you're looking for something that feels more like a home than just another apartment complex.

Yes this place is cheap...but there is a reason for the that. These apartments are disgusting and dark. They allow pets but don’t expect your deposit back bc the carpet is sooooo cheap and nasty they will claim any stain is animal and charge you to replace it. Like if I had money, I wouldn’t have lived in this terrible place, so I hope you do and don’t have to. Never so happy to leave somewhere and good luck to you.
Wonderful place to live, great maintenance staff, quiet, well kept, peaceful. Love having Fresh Market, Red Rocks and Rite Aide within walking distance

I lived at Strawberry Hills for 2 years in a 1 bedroom 1.5 bath unit.
The pros: There is no comparison in rent price for this large sized apartment in this location of town. Rent only goes up about $25 per lease, which is reasonable if compared to other management companies. Maintenance is very prompt – call office if urgent matter is not resolved in 24hrs and it will get fixed. They have monthly events for all the residents if that’s something you like. Walking distance to Fresh Market, Rite Aid and a number of restaurants. Staff is communicative and forthright about safety concerns that occur on the property.
The cons: OLD apartments even though they are moderately clean looking and functioning. That means all the doors and windows leak air (electric bill), there are sometimes mold issues on the ceiling in the living room (gets painted over by maintenance), there is that “old” smell to the kitchen cabinets and closets (easily covered up by products), poor insulation between upstairs/downstairs units (neighbors can smell what you are cooking despite using exhaust fan and can hear EVERYTHING you are doing above normal conversation level) and they have to work on the water pipes at least 3 times a year (your water gets shut off so they can perform temporary fixes; gets more annoying than you might think). If you have a crazy/disruptive neighbor there is nothing the office can do, you just have to constantly call the police until this causes the neighbor to be evicted – honestly it’s just easier to move at that point.
Warning: If you have health issues or have moderate to severe environmental allergies, do NOT move here. They will become exponentially worse.
If you can’t tell by the above, my primary reason for moving was my disruptive upstairs neighbor (if I told you all the things she did you wouldn’t believe me, but I could not live a normal life). My secondary motive for moving was my allergies, which became gradually so bad that my health started being affected.
 Since I have moved 5 months ago to a farther, but newer apartment complex, I have normal neighbors and my allergies have returned to mild (it is fully Spring right now) and all negative heath affects have disappeared. 
All things considered, I would recommend this complex if you do not have allergies and are not too concerned with up to date finishes.

The location and 2 bedroom layout is great.  It’s in uptown so it is easy to walk everywhere.  The Corner Pub, CVS, Dunkin, Harris Teeter, and 4th ward park are within 2 blocks.  The kitchen and living room are in the middle with a bedroom, a bathroom and spacious closet on each side.  The kitchen could use some more storage as there is no pantry and there is minimal space for any kind of 2 or 4 person dining room table.  The balcony is almost unusable, but it is there.

The not so good.  If the unit is off 7th street the train tracks are busy and the train horn will wake you up at night. The windows are older and build up condensation, that drips onto the carpet.  They replace the carpet anyway, but will charge you.  The doors also don’t seal tight. If you like to open your door on a nice day, think twice.  The building is constantly dirty.  A cracked sheet of drywall had been in the parking ramp for at least a month.  Carpet fuzz, used drinks, and other trash stays in the stairwells for weeks at a time.  The dumpsters are always in the entrance to the parking ramp so pulling in/out gets tight.  The worst though, is the constant fire alarms.  The fire department is there at least once a month.  We have had our in unit alarm go off a few times when opening the oven door.  (Nothing was burning/smoking)

Major word of warning, on move out, they will be creative with charges.  I have lived in 7 other apartment complexes, never been charged once.  Here, they go through everything and anything they don’t like, including nail (not anchor) holes, they charge you for.  Be prepared for that. 

Front office staff, Stephanie is nice and pleasant to deal with.  

Maintenance personnel were pleasant and seemed competent.  

There are better options at this price point.  I recommend looking around.

MANAGEMENT TAKING ADVANTAGE. HORRIBLE PLACE!!!
Right after moving out they sent a picture of the carpet and charged us 165 dollars to clean it, after 10 days, they came back charging us 965 dollars to replace the whole carpet, making us pay for the renovations that they were going
to do anyway. This management only wants to charge you for everything. On top of that, the elevators  never work, this place is not safe, my car got broken into, and the AC is always broken. The common places are always dirty and full of garbage. Please do not move into this apartment.

My partner and I recently moved to MAA Uptown from out of state. During the process the leasing office was very responsive and even helped us when our shipping container was dropped off while we were still on the road trip into Charlotte. 

Everyone is very friendly and welcoming in the building although most people just keep to themselves. We rarely have any issues with noise in the building. The train can be a bit annoying but you get used to it. 

The location is everything here. Living right in Uptown its pretty safe in the area this apt is located in. We are right next to a Dunkin Donuts, a CVS, and Harris Teeter grocery store. There is a cute pub on the corner of our building where we have noticed many of the residents like to go to. 

Maintenance support are very friendly and promptly when issues come up. Front desk is also great. Very happy and would recommend.

I absolutely love this apartment. The office and leasing ladies are wonderful and it's located just 5 blocks from Trade and Tryon. Maintence is timely and all the workers are incredibly friendly and helpful. Fourth Ward park is only a block away (great if you have a dog).  A delicious bakery, CVS, and a grocery store are all within a block away, which is super convenient. Great view of the skyline too!

I love the location of the apartments. I can walk to my job in  downtown Charlotte in under 15 minutes.  The rent is cheaper than most other places around here, but at the cost of some cheaper fixtures (cheap doors/windows/counter tops).  However, the appliances are still pretty nice.  The biggest draw back is just how young the community is here.  My wife and I are upper 20s, and we feel like the old people in the building.  We would not care, but it can seem like living in the college dorms again (loud/inebriated neighbors walking down the hall, general uncleanliness of public areas, loud music late at night).  The only other drawback is how close you are to the train tracks. This woke us up the first 2 or so weeks, but you do get used to it and learn to sleep through it.  All in all, if you are looking for an relatively affordable/decent place downtown, this is a great choice.

The reason I chose Post Uptown is for the fair pricing, flexible guest parking, and proximity to everything uptown - from the Panther's stadium to the historic 4th ward - plus it's easy to get on most of the highways while still avoiding the traffic bustle of Tryon / Epicentre. This is by no means a luxury apartment high-rise but it's cozy and convenient and still has all the amenities (including a pool and gym). The management is great and never had a problem with maintenance. Quick walk to Harris Teeter, Knights stadium, Panthers stadium, Epicentre, basically anything uptown is 15 mins or less. My apartment has 10ft ceilings, vintage wood floors and exposed duck work. I love it! Would definitely recommend it to anyone who's looking for a great location with young professionals and still stay on a reasonable budget.

Leasing office is very hard to reach through phone/email, you have to just show up to get help. My apartment was changed last minute so the one i viewed wasnt what i got. The apartment was filthy, several inches of dust in ac and painted over, trash in garbage disposal, holes in flooring, internet connections painted over and couldn't connect my wifi, parking lot was/still is filled with mud, there's a centipede/bug problem, bathroom handle wouldn't lock, the bathroom sink and ac was leaking, and so many more problems. I tried calling multiple times to the office and the emergency maintenance line and could get no one. Finally found how to put in requests online and all were marked completed yet either not done or were half way done. The bathroom door handle was replaced but fell off in my hand when I got home. Trash was left in the garbage disposal too and nothing else was done. I spoke to the manager and she got the flooring replaced and all of those issues fixed but maintenance shouldn't have lied about completing it. Later, I found out I didn't have the key for the storage room and was locked out, the light pull chain was also missing. Put both things in for maintenance and next day was marked done but was still locked and told they were waiting on parts. How would they even know what part for the light is needed since it was locked? Door remained locked for weeks and I kept being told someone would come out a certain day but that never happened. Finally they unlocked it but still haven't been given a key and light is still messed up. There is a trash problem with trash piled up high at the dumpster and large items like appliances all around. Some of this is from tenants but a large majority is maintenance. Tenants aren't pulling out dishwashers, stoves, etc and leaving them laying. Valet trash is required where you put your trash outside your door and someone picks it up so it's not the tenants leaving a mountain of trash laying in front of the compactor, that's maintenance. It's been a month now and the bins at the dog waste stations are overflowing, I know they aren't emptying them because the mail I threw away when I first moved in is still sitting on top. I only gave 2 stars because when my ac went out they did fix it the next day. It seems like management is trying but they're blaming tenants when maintenance is not doing their job and lying about completing things. The pool is nice but they show a gym on the site and it hasn't even been started.
