The roach infestation is really bad. No matter how clean of a person you are they will always appear. Pest control? There is no such thing. You’ll be paying for an imaginary service. Apartments are old and outdated. Very little natural lighting. Unattractive curb appeal and no security. Property management is basically on rotation. The “clubhouse/pool” haven’t been worked on in a year with no expected finish time. Mailboxes are completely run down and half are broken and cannot be used. DO NOT MOVE HERE! My biggest mistake was signing the lease.

Please do not be fooled by the description & the pictures. We do not have a clubhouse, a fitness center, or a pool. The current leasing office is in an apartment after the old one burned down. The on-site maintenance people are very lazy, they ride around all day on their golf carts instead of repairing things. A few months ago our AC went out in the dead heat of the summer & it took them 3 days to fix it!! I had a baby in the apartment & he could’ve had a HEAT STROKE! Did they care? No, it was over 100 degrees in the apartment. As of recently, our heat went out at the worse time possible when the temperatures dipped below freezing. No one answered the phone in the leasing office & I showed up & no one answered the door. It’s been two days now with no heat & I had to come out of pocket to buy a space heater that only heats one part of the apartment. Long story short, this apartment complex does not care about anybody but themselves so please don’t make the same mistake I did by signing the lease!
I went as a potential future resident to try and tour the place. Could not find the leasing office. The buildings have been neglected with grime on them, broken framework, and small narrow roads.

I’ve been living here for three years, the property has declined since it has had three different property management companies within a year. The people in the office have no idea how to run the place. My rent has been applied to different peoples accounts and now I’m being double charged. I pay for pest control but they won’t send anyone to spray my apartment there is an infestation of roaches. I have fogged bombed and sprayed myself and keep my apartment cleaned and I still can’t go a day without seeing a roach. I’m really trying to move as soon as possible
They are very poor in taking care of their property and it is very crime ridden. No maintenance ever!

Since moving in this community has been TERRIBLE!! When I moved in there has been many things wrong that I have requested to be fixed since August & it is now DECEMBER! It is extremely hard to get in contact with the leasing office by phone. The community is too expensive to live in for the conditions to be how they are! I am extremely dissatisfied & I WILL NOT be renewing my lease nor would I suggest ANYBODY to move into this horrid nightmare of a community! Upon moving in the floors were lifting, drawers broken in the bathroom & so much more. I am disappointed that I have to live here.

Filth all over the exterior , exterior needs power washed , interior looks like what it probably looked like when they built the property back in the day . Things are broken and neglected . Leasing office are indifferent. I’ve actually never seen anything like it . I am not sure what kind of maintenance people they have on the staff . My child can fix things better than this . It’s impossible that there’s an actual maintenance person performing these duties around the property .

These slums are raggedy, old & need to be torn down in rebuilt. The people they have running apartment are very unprofessional & couldn't care less about your issues. They have changed the name to The Kelston 3rd name change. Management changes every couple of months. Maintenance is the worst your better off hiring outsiders. I just a leak in my living room that eventually grew mold & had to withhold rent & call Code department to get it somewhat fixed. Tried to take me to court & never came to my apt to even see the damage so of course it was dismissed. My tub is cracked for the 4th time & still not fixed but somehow my request are closed. My toliet has not worked in months & my hot water is Luke warm on a good day & done after one shower. If you move here after doing your research you deserve the misery of living in the over priced slums.

ONE OF THE WORST PLACES I HAVE EVER STAYED IN MY LIFE! DO NOT I REPEAT DO NOT MOVE HERE!!!!!!THERE IS A REASON THEY HAVE SO MANY APARTMENTS AVB!!!! THE UP KEEPING OF THE OUTSIDE IS THE WORST SO OF COURSE YOUR APARTMENT WILL NEVER GET ANY WORK DONE! YOU CAN CALL THEM FOR A WEEK AND THEY WILL NEVER COME FIX ANY PROBLEMS YOU MAY HAVE REVIEW ON OTHER SITES FOR ALL DETAILS

Stanford Reserve is a quiet apartment complex, very low key and tucked away. I like living here because its very remote very close to all the things i need. As a parent it was very important to me that i live in a safe place and it isn't a lot of craziness going on. It's located near great schools and great people. The leasing office people are very nice and any time i have a maintenance issue they are always prompt and get the job done right no matter what time it is. I would highly recommend living here, it's been great for me and my family thus far.

I just moved here in July, I loved that it is a one level apt. After I got unpacked I love my new apt it's spacious which is what us ladies look for.The best thing about these apts the area is quiet, security is always out scanning the area. We have valet trash which is awesome. I don't have to smell stinky trash or  hear loud music. It's close to uptown and all the shopping area's it feels a lot like home should be.
Nice quality place love the atmosphere and the people are very friendly love it over here just looking for more space

Within the past year, I have seen a vast amount of different backgrounds of people moving into the complex and have not heard of any complaints. The children play together as though they already knew each other and sometimes I see parents outside playing with the kids as well. Everyone is respectful and there are less stereotypical instances occurring as there was before when the whole complex was a majority of one background.  Its so refreshing to witness harmony at the pool, in the workout room and just on the grounds of the property.

The apartment is fair but not good enough for what the rent is asked. The appliances are very old and the will not be replaced, the sockets in the walls are all loose, the water pressure is very low, there are no lights in the rooms, the A/C is low and the counters need to be replaced.

The unit and the complex is average and basically mirrors most of the apartment complexes within the city and area.  I just renewed my lease for another year as the location is ideal for my work and other activities, being somewhat centrally located in the area most frequently visited.

I’ve lived here since November 2018 and have had a number of issues with this complex. First, half of the building flooded. Then, there were a number of break ins into the parking garage, where my boyfriend’s car (along with other vehicles) was broken into and damaged. Within the last few months, there was also some sort of car bombing/arson on the top floor of the garage, which residents were never fully informed about (I had to find out through an affected resident). To top it off, this week my bike was stolen (along with many others) from Arlo’s “secure” bike cage, and it looks as though the only thing residents can do is file a police report and hope that their insurance reimburses them for the losses. Outside of those issues, there are other, less immediate problems. A lot of people with dogs who don’t like to pick up pet waste (inside or outside of the building) and numerous changes in management, although that may or may not be normal for the area. The one positive thing I will say is that the maintenance team is awesome and always very helpful. Other than that, I would sum this place up by saying what once was a great apartment in a convenient location is now a poorly managed building owned by a large national conglomerate. Take notice that the majority of the 5 star reviews are from those who have yet to move into the complex. I don’t know if this is something soon-to-be residents are encouraged to do by the leasing office, but the reviews from people who have already moved in are more consistent with my experience of living here.
Awful, floods, crimes, horrible management, dog poop everywhere, beer cans like a frat house.

The property seems great and new from the outside, but that is very deceiving. I lived there for two years and just moved out and so glad I did! The whole experience was one big headache. The good parts are the amenities are nice, location is good, and the maintenance staff is absolutely amazing. The rest, however, was not so good. There has been a lot of staff turnover in the office which has been a big headache with files being lost and being charged for things I shouldn't have. Multiple items in both of my units didn't work or broke soon after moving in such as fans, the stove, and the dishwasher. I was charged for damage done by previous tenants because of paperwork missing/not filed. There's no staff on premises after the office closes so when I asked who I needed to contact after hours in case there was an emergency I was told to call the police. There were multiple break ins at the pool area and rocks were being thrown at windows in the complex and multiple break ins in the parking garage where several cars were damaged on more than one occasion. Not to mention when the water main for the building broke and flooded two whole floors. I understand growing pains of a newer building, but it was all too much. I would save my money and looks elsewhere. There are plenty of better quality places to live in the same price point around the area.

Before leasing my apartment, staff was polite and sweet. but after lease they behaved very rudely.
Lied about first one half month free of rent. After complain they said you will get this offer after 2 months.
Never listen to complains, Keep charging you extra money in terms of garbage pick up, service charges, bug fee (which wasn't mentioned before).
Dog poo everywhere. Smell in corridors and elevators.

Moved into Arlo recently. About a week into living there my car got towed from the property. It was registered with the property. When I realized I had gotten towed I was then told by the leasing staff that I needed a parking decal. I was not informed of this upon move in. Once I got my car back, Arlo refused to reimburse me for the tow even though it was entirely on their end for never informing me about a decal. When I went to the office to discuss being reimbursed, the manager Darcie simply said “Im not going to back and forth with you we do not reimburse for towing” which is why Im writing this review. I'll continue to write reviews like this so potential tenants understand the kind of penny pinching, uncooperative establishment they are considering moving into
Super easy to get to work in Uptown.  The amenities are fantastic and they staff is super helpful!

I held a total of four leases for Weinstein Properties. 3 at their location closer to the Arboretum here in Charlotte and 1 at Steelecroft.
This apartment was awful through and through. Upon move in I was taken aback by how outdated the apartment was. Then came the toilet - mold in the tank and the toilet had a leak! This should tell you proper check out procedures or turn over check lists don't exist or are not enforced. 
Then came the noise. I had two different tenants above me during my lease. I have left videos on their Facebook if you would like to see a glimpse of what I had to endure. From being able to hear the neighbors drawer gliders, flicking light switches, sneezing, and EVERY SINGLE STEP, I was going insane. The creaking wood between the floors sounded similar to a door frame being busted open. As one can imagine living alone and hearing loud enough sounds that resemble break-ins I had trouble sleeping. The noise was so obvious that when the third party came out to fix my dryer switch. He even asked me what he was hearing. The leasing office suggestion: get a noise machine that's what everyone else does.
I lived on the second floor, never again will I willingly choose to have neighbor above me. 
I did not have a noise issue the entire 3 years at their sister property. At that property I lived on the ground floor.
Judging by the rental rates on this site, I cannot image paying that much for a unit as outdated as mine was. 
Now for the positives - 2 pools, so you don't have to necessarily squeeze in, although not maintained regularly while I was there. My unit had a linen closet in the bathroom and a coat closet which helps a ton with storage. Screened in porch was nice for bugs but was harder to keep clean.

While the apartment itself isn't bad. The service leaves a lot to be desired. Several unexpected fees were charged to my account upon returning my keys to the leasing office. The manager Beth refused to remove these charges despite one of the leasing associates saying they'd be removed. Very disappointed in their dishonesty regarding this. 

Not sure if I can recommend living here based on this experience alone despite the living environment itself.

Maybe a year or two ago this complex used to be good, not anymore. I do not know how to start, but two of their major issues are safety and cleaning. The grounds of this complex are estremely dirty, specially the hallways and the pool area. This issue is regularly reported to the office, but nothing is done. They just say it would be done, but nothing happens. Pressure wash was promised a year ago, still nothing. Several car break-ins had been reported. A package was stolen from my front door. People jumping the back fence and some crowd hanging late at night. Everything has been reported to management, but they denied it. Please do not move here, the prices are not worth it. Stop calling this luxury.

I paid my rent either early or on time every month.  When I chose to move from this apartment complex I submitted over a 60 day notice informing the leasing office of my departure.  The last two months of my lease were March and April of 2016.  Due to my hectic life and having some time off at Easter I moved my belongings out of the apartment at the end of March.  After moving out I called the leasing office to let them know I had moved my furniture out and that I no longer needed the washer and dryer in my apartment.  The leasing office stated they would take care of the situation.  I always paid my rent online at this complex.  A few days after moving out I went to pay my rent for my last month-April 2016-and the system said I owe $0.00 rent.  I then proceeded to call the leasing office to verify this information and was told my apartment had been rented, I needed to switch the utilities out of my name immediately, and that I did not owe anymore rent.  Due to being out of town for the next 10 days for work I was advised to mail my keys to the office and to include my apartment address and move out date with the keys.  I did this.  I also immediately called to switch my utilities out of my name, as advised by the complex, and this had already been done by the leasing office.  I did not have access to my apartment at anytime during April 2016.  Over 30 days later I receive a call from the corporate office stating I now owe my last month's rent.  The call came from the "collections" department.  I consider myself a professional and have always paid my bills on time.  To say the least this was both embarrassing and frustrating.  I then call the property manager at Bexley Steelecroft in Charlotte to discuss what is going on and she basically laughs off everything I am telling her.  She advises to me that she will call me back as soon as she looks into the situation.  After multiple phone calls and attempts to reach her she still has not called me back weeks later.  I even called the regional property manager and she too failed to return my telephone call.  I have however, received more phone calls from their collections department.  I went ahead and paid the last month's rent because I don't want this showing on my credit report.  I was treated highly unfairly in this situation.  I simply want to warn anyone in the future to look elsewhere when considering this complex.

I cannot begin to praise this property and its staff enough; especially the staff.  This morning my keys got entangled in the handle ties of my trashbag as I threw it into the trash compactor.  My car was locked, dog inside, and the keys to everything I owned were in the compactor.  Lesley and Brittany came from the office in their dress clothes to my rescue.  Lesley literally shimmied her way down into the shute while being held by her legs by Brittany and myself and was able to grab the keys.  People, you don't see this kind of "Good Samaritan" acts of kindness anywhere!!!!!!  They went BEYOND the call of duty to help someone in need.  I feel so blessed to be a part of such a great community with such caring people.  It doesn't seem enough, but thank you Lesley and Brittany from the bottom of my heart.

This complex building is right in the center of all your needs. It has great restaurants and other eateries, lots of retail grocery stores and plenty of other services. The staff is helpful and likeable. The grounds are maintained on a daily basis. It also has a large courtyard with pool and large TV screen right outside. The exercise room has plenty of equipment for a victorious workout.


Thank You!
Sharon Stepney

The apartment was not move-in ready, it was dirty and damaged. The appliances did not work and the bathroom fixtures were either broken or moldy, took multiple maintenance requests to be remedied. Our water has been shut off multiple times with less than 12 hours notice. The 24/7 gym and package room has been shut down multiple times, once for several weeks with the only time for access between 9a-6p M-Sat (office hours). The gym floods on the bottom floor when it rains. Mold growth on every window because the windows leak when it rains, we put in a maintenance request for that and all they did was re-caulk over the existing caulk and spray paint the mold and water stains. We live in an ADA-accessible apartment and every one of the strobe-light fire alarms in our apartment have been painted over who knows how many times. My mother, who is physically disabled due to a stroke, came to visit and had a hard time doing basic tasks in this apartment even though it is supposed to be handicap accessible. You can't even load the dishwasher, the door opens directly in front of the sink with only a few inches of room between the sink and the fully opened dishwasher. And most recently, the stairs leading up to floors 2 and 3 of our building were literally falling apart. Several residents had notified them, along with putting maintenance requests in starting in Aug 2023 that there was water and structural damage to the stairwell, management repeatedly marked the requests as completed and never actually did anything to fix the issues. Until recently when a piece of the stairwell actually broke off and fell on top of a resident's family member. Starting February 25, 2024, the second and third-floor residents were given 24 hours notice to vacate their apartments and move into a hotel for construction, however, the 4 families on the first floor were given zero notice of any of this and did not even know construction was even happening. First-floor residents were not given the option to move their families to a hotel even though the construction completely blocked all access to our front doors, and we were required to use back doors. Management has given multiple residents conflicting information regarding the construction. It appears that all they have done on the stairwell is a band-aid job and it doesn't appear that they actually did the work to properly address the safety issues because there are still parts of the ceiling that have significant water damage to them.

Have a six-month lease from July 2022 which ends January 2023 and I’m so thankful I only did a six month lease.  Writing this review today because of my horrible treatment in trying to get the dishwasher repaired.  This review is the overall experience, and we have pictures to back up the condition of the interior.  Doing the move in walk through, they had attempted kitchen and bath cabinet upgrades however, the cabinets were very poorly installed, are crooked and don't close properly.  Opening the oven, we found a bag of stove burners in there in addition to the ones placed on the stove. Any wall damage they attempted to repair looks like a small child did the repair.  Parts of the floor are mushy which you can feel when you walk on them which makes me wonder about the condition of the sub floor which is probably rotting.  The front door is so poorly installed I have to literally put my shoulder against the door and push hard to open it.  The living room ceiling fan light was removed at some point and not replaced so there is no light in the living area and the windows in that area are very small. The second bedroom ceiling had a fan installed at some point however, they must have taken it out and did not replace it.  The bedroom window has an unrepaired bullet hole in it.  The bedroom door is so poorly installed it won’t stay open.  There is paint on the towel racks and dripped on the floor.  Our unit has a garage and we requested a second garage door open which they had to order and took two months to arrive. The dishwasher stopped working and they had to order a pump, which is ridiculous they don't have them on hand, so I was told condescendingly by Mariam to use the sink and the pump might arrive next week which will be over 2 weeks without a dishwasher.  The package locker is inconveniently located, you must walk around the office building, go downstairs, walk to the back of the basement to pick up your packages.  The dumpster area is always a disaster with trash laying everywhere around the dumpster.  As mentioned in other reviews, cockroaches are a problem.  I would never recommend Citra to anyone.

My wife and I have lived here for 8 months, and our stove top has not worked properly the whole time.  Numerous work orders put in only to be closed out with nothing being fixed.  Multiple in person visits from me and my wife to the office. Last time I was was in the office the manager looked me in the eye and said she would personally go to our apartment with maintenance the next day.  Lie. That was a month ago. None of the burners work. Worst part is management doesn’t care.

I’ve been here since 12/2008 and have seen this complex go through ALL the works. I must say- my favorite- is Brooke becoming the property manager. She is young and enthusiastic. She’s getting food trucks and even a mobile nail salon in the community! I appreciate her for the efforts she’s putting forth improving this. 

Residents are rough- we are all different personalities but honestly I love living here and I’m probably the most difficult person to impress.

I have been complaining since day 1 that there is paint on my stove burners because they painted so sloppy.  The bottom of my pots and pans are ruined and one of the larger burners doesn't even work.  Five months later...here we go again.  He came in and out the door three times on 9/17. Left at 4:15 saying he needed to speak to his supervisor about replacing our stove burners and never returned.  It's now Tuesday.  So unhappy with this place!

I really wanted to make a statement about the horrible reviews that give this place a bad rep, I have not had a problem with any of the so called big issues such as roaches or any unprofessional manner with the property staff. I have lived here since 2010! I have seen this property go through DRASTIC changes from renovations and updates to new staff. Since I have been here I have seen the  property go through a really rough state from trash and other things mentioned in the previous reviews, BUT within the last 2 years the staff has really been turned around and the property/grounds look PHENOMENAL!!! Melanie and Brooke have really stepped up and made this place better to live all around; from getting the breezeways pressure washed, a better maintenance staff to take care of the grounds, even being very prompt in assisting me with any concerns. This place is great and the ladies in the office do the best they can and it really shows throughout!

I've lived in this apartment community for a couple weeks, and overall, it has been a pleasant experience. The location is ideal, with easy access to public transportation and shopping. The amenities, such as the fitness center and pool, are well-maintained and available year-round. The staff is friendly and responsive, especially when it comes to maintenance requests.The community is generally safe and quiet. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to live.
The experience has been great so far thank you to the staff for being so understanding when it comes to certain things . You guys are really appreciated

The community is beautiful, peaceful, the apartment is beautiful. Love the lake and fitness's center.
staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the overall experience was outstanding.
The leasing staff was very friendly professional and knowledgeable. All my questions were answered and the process went smoothly The property is very well kept and very clean.  This is a hidden gem

I’m new to the area and I am really enjoying it so far. I expected some noise being in an apartment but this community is so quiet. The buildings and grounds are clean and taken care of and the residents are all super nice.
From what I've observed, the residents are friendly and peaceful, always willing to assist one another and mindful of each other's privacy. This is a great community!

The best thing about this place is the area I initially had a lot of issues moving in. Bugs in my fridge they came to try to clean and fix it after I said it need to be replaced. Then it went out and all my food went bad after I noticed the stuff in my freezer wasn’t freezing. Then they gave me a new refrigerator. My blinds have been dirty and raggedy since I moved in this place was not thoroughly cleaned upon move in. The cabinet drawer is broken I noticed a shelf missing they brought me one. Every issue I had I have to say something when these are things that should’ve been inspected prior to me moving in. The best thing about this place is the price and location but I will not stay if I have to pay more.
Very convenient. I love the loading and unloading area which made my move in very easy. Also love the 24 hour concierge and the fact that they are so helpful.
Overall a fine place to live. Recent updates to amenities have been nice. Continue to need better support from management and leasing office.

I love it here 2nd time around but my maintenance issues are never resolved though but other than that this is my happy place!
I would definitely recommend if you can stomach a little dog smell and the less fortunate always sleeping by the door or on the garage

I am concerned about my packages.  I've had a few packages that were lost. The aparment kitchen and floors are dated.  I feel like painting the cabinets white or gray and getting new lighter floors in the apartments would make the apartments look so much better.

My roommate and I had an extremely difficult move in experience. Largely due to our leasing agent giving us ample amounts of misinformation, as well as neglecting to give or failing to know critical information. It’s impossible to get a timely response to emailed questions or requests, but the office staff is very helpful if you go in person. Everyone else in the community, besides our leasing agent, has been helpful and very kind, so thankfully that has helped save it! The facility itself is beautiful, safe, and well kept in my opinion.
Frequent car break ins and no effort to create a safer environment. Not a family friendly community
The apartments seem beautiful but are cheaply made. Also car break ins happen multiple times a week.

Don’t move here unless you want your vehicle broken into!!!! There has been non stop break ins since this community has opened and they do nothing to increase security or make this complex safe. People are getting their cars broken into every week! There are no cameras on the property or police or security. A complete waste of money and not LUXURY living

Amazing customer service and property! Deidre was spectacular! She was prompt responding and answering all emails and questions. So knowledgeable! She listened to all my needs and made sure to find the perfect unit for me. The property is well maintained inside and out! I was warmly welcome to the community when touring. The staff made sure I felt at home and made my move in process easy. Maintenance is quick to respond to any request. Deidre went above and beyond to find storage for all my extras. I was worried about noise but that has not been an issue it’s so quiet! You will not regret living at the Beverley! Great customers service and environment.
Loved living here. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to live in the south Charlotte/Ballantyne Area!

Now that I’ve unpacked the last box. Let me just say, this has been the absolute BEST moving experience I’ve ever had. Deidre was an Angel! She made the move in experience as seamless as possible. Answered all my questions and kept in contact with me throughout the entire process. The building itself is luxurious and beautifully designed. The community is walking distance to dozens of restaurants, boutiques, shopping, and spas. I am in love and certainly looking forward to living here for awhile.

Just moved in to a one BR with balcony. The staff and especially Curtis, the manager, were extremely helpful. The apartment is beautiful. The layout is great and everything is modern and clean.

The amenities and grounds are beautiful. The pool is large, clean and a lot of chairs. There are cabanas with fans and a nice grilling station. Very pet friendly too. It is also very quiet.

Everything is very secure. Also nice visitor parking. 

The location is excellent. Could not be happier so far.

Only recommendation would be some kind of screen for balcony door.

Everyone at 1010 Dilworth has been a pleasure to work with. Arayna in particular has been super helpful in answering all of my questions and resolving any problems. So far this is one of the best renting experiences I've had.
Great area for people who like to be close to things to do! Dog friendly building! Not to mention beautiful apartments. I really love it here!
Clean, quiet, great amenities, reasonable rental rates. Excellent location.

Great location but the building hallways and garage are rarely clean, issues arise often, and the fire alarm goes off all the time and will not be shut off for hours on occasion. Overall love the location but the building is subpar.
Great area to live in, residents and staff are extremely nice!

Very nice place to live before owning a home.
Staff is very professional.
Location is the best.
Living on the Green is beautiful
Very nice for the price, staff and most neighbors are super friendly!
This is a lovely community! Office staff know you by name, and everyone is friendly and helpful. Grounds and buildings are well maintained, and the location can't be beat!
It’s a quiet place and the management has excellent customer service.
The community is beautiful and the residents are a priority
The staff are great. Any maintenance request is taken care of almost immediately.

I would say if you are looking forward to have a pool during summer months stay away. 

Moved in without visiting the property, and was pleased with my choice. However, that opinion changed months later.
Pros: The location is great for our needs. Also enjoy that where our apartment is, it doesn’t feel like we are in the city. We have not taken the advantage of when food trucks arrive during the week, however like that idea. 

Cons: 
Pool: First year here, the pool was closed here and there. It was closed from end of April through June 6th once the pool opened due to repairs and inspection from the city.  Then right back on July 5th, the pool was closed again due to issue with a part. They reopened the pool at the end of July due to the part being replaced.  It was frustrated with the pool but understandable things out of their control. Now current summer of 2024. Pool was opened to enjoy however due to residents actions at the pool.  In May; was decided to close the pool on Sundays and closed at the end of the day when the leasing office closed. June 17th, the office to close the pool until further notice. No reason why.  Sure maybe due to actions of residents in the complex but it is punishment to everyone else. Same problems as last year with people but they never closed the pool for it. 
Sure, I don’t care for some actions at the pool (smoking, rude people (adults or kids), or parents not watching their kids but still look forward to relaxing at the pool.  There is always going to be rude inconsiderate people, people not respecting others or policies are going to be found everywhere we go… that’s life. 

Other downs falls, just normal apartment life, loud vehicles and residents. Thin walls or just neighbors that don’t care and turn their device up so everyone can hear or smell. Security drove around at night for awhile, no longer. Cars now have been broken into and even stolen. Broken down cars that sit for months unmoved. Feels like constantly changing portals on making rent.

Super amazing place to live. The vibe is good, people are chill, and the apartments are spectacular and at a decent price. Also, we love all the staff and our favorite is Ameko! She made us feel 100% confident about making this our home.

I've been living here for 5 years and though I Enjoyed the previous staff and Management team, there have been so many Improvements. They Enforced the Towing at night, because the complex isn't big and they're must have been allot of vehicles here that didn't belong, because now there's parking. They added improvements to the insides like a Living Room Ceiling Fan, USB Outlets, new toilets, shower heads, and a Key Fob for the front door, instead of a regular key. You can also use your cell phone to open up your door. They keep the grounds clean of debris, and they are Johnny on the spot with customer complaints, or Maintenance issues. There's a Complex Email where we all can chat, and They have Food Trucks now of different Vendors a Couple of times a week. Madison, and the Rest of the Staff Including the Maintenance Crew are one of The Best Staff of a Complex I ever lived in. Lastly I can't forget all the Improvements to the Clubhouse, gym, and pool area. The only Complaint I have is that we can no longer Rent out the Clubhouse for free or at all as Residents. That was a Very Nice Perk, and would be Even Nicer with all the New Ammenties added. Food for Thought. Smile and Blessings!! R.j.
Amazing property and great location! Love the upgrades that were done. Very luxurious and great staff.

When I set up my tours for apartment complexes in Charlotte, The District was first on my list.  Once I saw the apartment, I cancelled the rest of my tours.  This was it for me.  I loved it and frankly, I never expected it to be this amazing.  The leasing agent, Ms. Townsend, was the best.  She was as excited as I was.  I have a 1-bedroom and it's extremely spacious.  I just moved last week and hopefully, this amazing experience will last throughout my journey.

The apartments are super spacious and lux! The location is perfect, with the Northlake Mall and Target and several restaurants within walking distance! The District is a safe place to live and honestly the management team is incredible and thoughtful and genuinely seems to care about their residents! We enjoyed our time here and recommend it! It's super close to uptown Charlotte as well as the major highways so you can get to most popular Charlotte places in under 30 mins! The only thing that is irritating is the aerators that were placed on the kitchen faucet and the shower: they installed them to preserve water but it's honestly so irritating because it makes the water pressure soooo weak and cold. Be warned if you wash plenty of dishes or like to enjoy a long hot shower!!!
If you would like to live with mold, ceiling leaks, and trash this is the place for you. Management is incredibly rude and unhelpful. I would never recommend this complex to anyone.

Beware of new management. I had the unfortunate experience of moving out right when management companies were changing hands. I did my due diligence of confirming with the previous management just to do the basic cleaning. Now I am being charged for cleaning because the new management claims I did none. There are no pictures for their claims. Watch yourself! Also, their follow up is terrible

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: Awesome Place. So excited to call Elevate at Tryon my home! The staff is also very kind and cooperative.

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: Simple to dwell here with incredible staff and decent neighbors.

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: Living in  Elevate at Tryon is a terrific choice. I've been a resident for more than six years, and the staff is fantastic.

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: I always had hygiene issues but the way you guys maintained the property is really appreciated. I would recommend your property among my known friends.

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: Rents on this property are affordable. Highly recommended

apartmentName: Elevate at Tryon- Unique Uptown Living
review: Wonderful experience with the management of this property.
Terrible communication, small parking spaces, pool has been closed for a year, dingy apartment and lots of attitude from the girls that work the front desk. I don’t recommend.

I was scheduled for a virtual tour today at 11am, and about 45 mins before- I got an email asking for “recent pay stubs and my Drivers License” before the tour could commence. Now, the ID I could understand if I was in person, but not for a FaceTime tour on my iPhone.  I have toured 4 other properties this week virtually, and none of them have asked for anything beyond basic information. I do think this is a bit extreme considering I had not agreed on anything contractual beyond just looking at available units. I don’t know where my personal pay stub and identification would be stored or viewed by whom and it’s a bit intrusive to say the least, so I opted for another apartment, and decided to not do business with GCI.

This apartment complex was great when I moved in 3 years ago. Now, the gym is run down, one building has bed bugs, I’m constantly hearing about people’s apartments flooding (luckily on the 2nd floor I’ve escaped that) and the dog park has a broken gate, broken fence, and the waste container is always over flowing. From the overflowing trash containers to the fountain that’s been broken for 2 years and the snakes they do nothing about, don’t live here.

I've been at Legacy for about 6 months now, Connie has always been great and Melanie is amazingly helpful as well, very fast to respond to email requests for any issues and in the office, thanks!

Eric
A friend referred me to Legacy and now I know why! My neighbors are very friendly and I have a much larger place than before for a lot less money.
I moved to Charlotte a couple weeks ago and I stumbled across this place. They were running a great special and it helped with moving cost. So far so good I have no complaints!

I've lived at Eastover Ridge since the spring of 2021. Overall, it's a great place to live. My apartment is spacious and I have a beautiful view of the greenway. Trails are close by, office staff are friendly and do their best when there are any requests, maintenance is also friendly and does their best.

Maintenance crews have ruined personal property on my balcony. The noise from other tenets is absurd. I have sent 5 messages to the office over 3 months with no response. This is an attempt for the office to finally take my message's notice. Eastover ridge has thin walls and floors. You can hear the actions of neighbors, my upstairs neighbor loves Disney movies. Please looks elsewhere for a place to live.

I went to school in charlotte and wanted to stay in the city after I graduated. I moved into a 3 bedroom apartment with two other friends of mine, and we've really loved it. The pool parties in the summer are so fun and a great way to meet other residents since most everyone is either in college, or is a young professional. Don't live by the smaller pool if you ever want a quiet Saturday during the summer. The larger pool behind the main clubhouse is usually much much quieter during the hot months. 
The staff are also incredibly helpful and attentive. They know me by first name, and always make sure that any maintenance requests get fixed asap. The apartments themselves are a liiiiitle bit dated (carpet, vinyl flooring, older appliances), but they are working on renovating the apartments with new fixtures, flooring, and granite countertops. 
The complex has 2 pools that they regularly take care of, especially in the summer. It truly is a gated community, meaning that anytime the gate is broken, they fix it within a day or so. They also have a little dog park that seems to be very popular with all the dog owners. 
The neighborhood is great, being super close to popular restaurants like Chick-Fil-A, Starbucks, and Panera, as well as being close to Harris Teeter and now Publix! Uptown is literally 10 minutes straight down the street, and Southpark mall is about 10 minutes as well.
We haven't had a ton of pest problems besides the odd bug here or there, but that could be because we're very clean and on the second floor. My boyfriend also lives in this complex in a first floor unit and had more pest problems than I have had. However, the staff was very responsive and had people come out and spray. The complex also pays for water and valet trash, which is a dream. Valet trash is now a necessity for me, so I don't have to walk down to the dumpsters with all of my trash bags. 

All in all, we have loved living in Eastover and would most likely renew our lease in an updated unit if we were staying in Charlotte! If you're looking for a less expensive, practical place in a good neighborhood, Eastover is the place.
I've lived in the old phase for 3 years and the new phase for 1 and I absolutely love it here. Karen is the best Property Manager and the entire staff is wonderful and so helpful!

My family and I lived at Eastover Ridge for a year and we loved it. the Property Manager, Karen, is very capable and excellent at her job. The rest of the staff are amazing as well. The maintenance crew always had a 48 hour or less turn around on service requests. We only moved out due to my Husband taking a job out of Charlotte. We recommend Eastover Ridge to anyone looking for apartments in the Charlotte area.

Eastover is great if you are new in the city or a young adult. There are two phases to the complex, one built in 02 the other in 92. Each side has their own pool and the main leasing office has a decent gym with an indoor basketball court. Also both clubhouses have laundry in there, though there are hookups in each unit as well. During the summer there are great pool parties on the older side and you can meet lots of people. Don't get an apartment on the pool unless you don't want any quiet Saturdays during the summer. Can't speak to the newer side but the older is just fine for the location/price. Good sized bedrooms and balconies. Can't speak to the townhomes.. other than they seem a little over priced. Being only a 10 min max ride to the center of uptown and also close to neighborhoods like plaza midwood etc. its great.
This place has it all Great location Great Amenities and Great Staff, Manager is friendly and will go above and beyond to make it happen. Maintance is always same day IF needed. Clean place and cozy.

All I can say is this place is nothing like it was when I first moved in, but surely started going downhill very very quickly! 3 different property management staffs now since I I've been here, that should tell you something regardless of what they say for the reasons/excuses not being truthful. The only thing great about living here is the location. This is supposed to be more luxury living and please believe me it's NOT for the price you pay!! I'm even beginning to say it's not even healthy to live here. The carpets are unbelievably horrible in the hallways, never cleaned, and smell so bad when you are walking to your place/coming home. How would you like to have to hold your breath while coming home everyday or leaving going down your hallways? When I first came there was no valet trash required which was great, then they brought it in and made mandatory regardless of lots of voices against this!!! Hallways smell literally like trash and you feel like you are living in trash practically. I don't think valet waste is a good idea for places like these that are closed in and also if they are NOT going to be able to clean carpets more often. Trash guy comes at 8 pm rolling trash big bin through hallway. They try and cover smell up with bunch of chemical air fresheners plug ins. Only thing they try and keep looking nice is when you would first walk in, like a new customer to make it look good. I don't even think management even goes to the floors EVER! Also, there are barely any amenities, not that great for price you pay. Very think walls too,can hear and smell everything!!! Overall, this place was lthrown up quick like many others and poorly built overall. You will regret moving here if you do.

I've been living here for a little over a year, and I've noticed that the entire building has become beset by deferred maintenance in the last few months: water damage/wood rot left untouched for weeks on end; roaches in the common spaces that have begun to infiltrate individual units; stains on the carpeting; broken light fixtures left unrepaired; one of two elevators that routinely breaks down, leaving half the residents to trek to the other side of the building with their groceries/packages/whathaveyou; apologetic but largely powerless staff who responds to repeated complaints with a "bear with us a while longer" attitude as opposed to immediate measures being taken to address such unacceptable conditions.

The walls are also incredibly thin. It is literally possible to hear every step taken by my upstairs neighbor as he traipses across his floor.

This building looks great on the surface, and the location is excellent, but I would not recommend it to anyone. The cost is entirely too high to merit a host of issues I have not dealt with since living in a college dorm.

I fell in love with this place at first site. But after living here for 3 months I'm realizing this place is awful! There is no insulation between the walls floor and ceiling leaving you with no sound privacy. I can hear my upstairs neighbors walking around and I can hear people in the hallway. Not only that but the elevator never works so I have to walk up and down 5 flights of stairs to let my dog out. And to continue There is dog for dog poop dust cockroaches and other bugs littering the stairwell not to mention the carpet between the hallways is disgusting it's covered in trash and stains. Overall horrible place to live can't wait to move
A great apartment...great location (walk to everything). It's new, it's hip, and I feel totally safe. Management is fun and friendly....what else could you ask for?!!
May be perfect for you.... I like the fact that this location is brand new... however, they are quite small.

For tenants it is a wakeup call, be cautious with the MAA University Lake apartment community.
Writing my experience, continues weather condition issues, additional carpet replacement charges imposed on moveout and numerous issues we encountered at MAA University Lake. 

Firstly, upon entering the apartment we noticed several stains and excessive pet hair embedded in the carpet, it's nasty. Despite our best efforts to clean it, the stains remain, and the pet hair or human hair continues to resurface. The condition of the apartment did not match the expectations set during the leasing process. Specifically, the Staines are noticeable, and it includes pet hair, bugs and roaches. That was highly unsanitary and poses a health risk. We promptly informed the leasing office about these issues multiple times in person, through mail and service requests. Unfortunately, none got fixed, and not enough action was taken to rectify the carpet condition and uncomfortable indoor temperature issues. 
We consistently maintained the apartment in good condition(as it is) and followed all guidelines regarding maintenance. However, The move-out inspection is done without my presence and intimation, we shocked to find that in a statement received after few days of moveout, leasing team imposed charges for the replacement of the carpet. Charges imposed are unjust since the carpet was already in a substandard condition. Addition to that we experienced difficulties with maintaining a comfortable indoor temperature. the issues were not resolved after multiple maintenance requests, as per the team the issues are due to the age of the building and structural, can’t be fixed, leading to discomfort and during extreme heat and cold weather conditions with water leakage and air leakage from the windows and doors. The management is rude and by knowing the pre-existing issues (even after showing proofs) they just asked for additional payments. these are specific issues, there are multiple common issues.. Beware..

I live here for almost 5 years. The last 4 months has been a nightmare. They have rats and do nothing but the bare minimum to get rid of them. Pest control laid traps that didn’t catch them. Maintenance didn’t do a sweep for holes in the unit. Corporate didn’t offer to move me in a different unit, house me until it was caught or even reimbursed me for the food. I asked corporate to allow me to break my lease without penalty, they refused. I was sick not once but 3 times with respiratory issue due to these rodents in my place. I would not recommend staying here because if it happens to you, they will not do anything. This has been ongoing since 11/30/2022. They didn’t send pest control until 12/6/2022 and still been unable to catch them. I moved out and they had the nerve to send a bill for $4600 after having me live in a rat infested unit where I paid my rent even thought I didn’t not want to on time during the whole thing. I have many other complaints but this one was the one that took the cake!!

So I debated on posting this because I’m finally out of the apartment which is like a breath of fresh air but I’ll just give a summary of what I’ve been through. When I first moved in i was excited because this was my first apartment to myself... the first 6 months I stayed there was literally exhausting. I kept finding mice in my apartment which TERRIFIED ME. Everytime I saw one I would cry, I wanted to move so bad and the maintenance men could never find where they were coming from so I dealt with this for months until my sister finally called the health department and reported the situation to help me out. The guy came through for only ONE DAY and found the hole under my dish washer and patched it up. The only thing I got for this problem was 100 dollars off for ONE month of rent but I dealt with this problem for atleast 6 months. Next I had a heavy neighbor over my head (I know it’s an apartment what do I expect) well everyday, every single day this man would move and it sounded like my floor was collapsing, my pictures would move from the wall, it was terrible I complained multiple times, and that was not the only neighbor, I had a wall neighbor who I don’t know if he had some sort of medical condition but he would constantly yell through out the day and night just randomly screaming. I’ve complained about him multiple times too. I was a full time student and was working full time and barely could get any sleep in my apartment due to mice and both neighbors. Anyway there is better apartments, same price else where!

I have been a resident here for 13 months , I signed A 15 month lease when I first moved here from NY in March 2018. My time here has been mostly pleasant except for a few hiccups with the office, encountering an HOMELESS man sleeping on the yoga mat in the fitness center at 5:30 AM on March 6th and then to TOP it all off, Someone BROKE into my apartment and stole all of the things I worked hard for and cherished on March 20th! If you are considering moving here DO NOT move on the ground floor! other than the constant Debris from the landscapers you COULD ALSO BE TARGETED! I left my guest window cracked while I was away at work & someone took full ADVANTAGE by cutting a whole in the window screen & and climbing in. I’ve lived here for a YEAR with not ONE incident not even a package being STOLEN. The only invader I’ve ever experienced was a frog that got in after a rainy day by the lake! PRIOR to the breaking and entering I have had no issues with management! The morning after my home was violated I went in to the office and spoke with Patrice,I made her aware of what happened, Jessie called the following day and stated “I’m sorry to hear about the incident that happened in your home” I thanked her and replied yes , I’m distraught and it is more than an incident to me, my family feels violated. I inquired if there was anything or Any exceptions to be made since I no longer felt safe in my apartment and requested if my lease could be terminated early,her response was “I’m sorry, crime can happen anywhere ” she promised to reach out to her manager to get a final answer & get back to me with the final decision! As any one reading this could imagine , I was disappointed, yes crime can happen anywhere and it does, but it also happened here, on a weekday, before 6 pm while the office staff was available! The gate to this gated community had been broken for over a month prior to 4 days ago. It breaks every 8 weeks or so, the community has trespassers on property due to this ! No cameras on site, the incident with yet another trespasser in the fitness center could have went COMPLETELY LEFT ! He could have attacked me! I asked how did he get in there to begin with, its a badge entrance , Jessie response was yet again I’m not sure but thanks for making me aware! This complex charges a decent amount for rent ! Please do the right thing by your residents and have someone patrol the areas DAY & night!

My daughter moved in last June with two roommates. They signed a years lease, but my daughter only lived there three months. The place had rats and the carpet smelled musty and like cigarettes.  They got broke into three times, and the guy watched both roommates on two different occasions. The blind in my daughters room was broke and you could not even see outside because of a dirty film. She now has a $814.00 charge on her credit report for s long list of charges she did not do.

The perfect apartment complex for the UNC Charlotte Faculty/Staff/Student. Right in front of the University, walking distance to restaurants and grocery store. The apartments are well maintained. There is a tennis court, two pools, gym and business center. The staff is very friendly. I moved a couple times around this area, not planning on moving again. Oh, and I love the lake view from my apartment!
The new management never answers the phone and always trying to enter the unit the same day of placing out notices. Management is awful

Since moving in there’s been multiple managers and horrible maintenance. And apparently the last manager threw away all the work orders which hopefully doesn’t mean they threw away our original rental agreement paperwork because the apartment needed to be fixed before we moved in and never was. The buildings are old and were never maintained. They need to be torn down and replaced. Roaches and water bugs galore and Yes both!!! We weren’t allowed to use the fireplace we were told upon moving in the property lost insurance because a crackhead set their apartment on fire. This new Apartment manager is making improvements but the prices are honestly ridiculous at the moment based on space, area, and living conditions alone. I can’t wait until my lease is up.

I’m a current resident here and it’s been a decent place to live but maintenance people take so long to come fix things. I’ve had a clogged sink and garbage disposal for 3 months and I keep calling to get maintenance to come and they never show up and I’m fed up with it now...
Several serious issues over priced, falling apart. New employees every few months, mold,floods,electrical etc.

This place is terrible, its run and managed by a group of people that will take the cheapest routes every time. They don't complete work orders, the AC in all the apartments rarely works. The office staff are rude and act like you are incompetent, police are in the neighborhood very frequently due to the community this place attracts. They do not care about their tenets. Its honestly a joke. I could write a full ten page paper about the level of disgust I have for this place. The worst part, is if they actually cared and acted like a competent company this place could easily be a great place to live. But they don't care and on top of it all they painted all the building a used dirty diaper/toilet paper yellow, brown. So if you like investing in a place where you are concerned for your health, safety, and over all well being. There is a beautiful view of the lake that is close by and residents are more than welcome.

I am impressed, because I have a beautiful view of Gods' trees, also  it's relaxing to sit on the balcony in the morning, and wonderful to experience the cleanness of the view. Runaway bay is a beautiful property.The landscape is done weekly if not more beautiful flowers, and real yes real ducks that walk though out the property there is a beautiful lake with a fountain in the center at lakeside each building has a picnic area with grills for t h em nights you want to cookout and sit by the lake and watch the ducks swim. Beautiful places on a lake lots of beautiful landscape, pool, lots of ducks that walk the property all day can fish in the lake or swim at the pool sit out on the beautiful patio and take in the view or .sit at the beautiful lake side and cookout at the grills and picnic area provided by the property

Runaway Bay apartments are beautiful (with the trees and trails, lake and water fountain) and rent is affordable (ours is $650 for a one bedroom, then add electricity and wate), but there's a few things that I wish would change. I wish they had someone come spray the insect killer outside all the apartments every two months or something. We mentioned it before and someone came with a leaf blower ! Other than that, they're pretty helpful when I have a question. The pool is great and beautiful! The laundry area is much appreciated, but the gym could use a few more machines or maybe just some Dumbbells, please!

It's ok to live if you need a cheep starter apt. They have made some improvements ......to the outside. The model apt looks great compared to the actual apt. They seem to have a friendly staff that takes your concerns serious. I feel that eventually they will upgrade the actual apt, but no time soon.

The apartment was in excellent condition, the staff was great in telling us about the place and showing us around the complex. Everything is close by and in walking distant. I love this place, the lake the ducks and the people, amazing.

When I stayed there 2 years ago. the maintenance man and staff was always so nice and fixed anything I ever needed fixed before 2 days. The apartments were kinda old but were at a good price. Its a little pricey now but I would move back because it is a good area but bad traffic.

This place is beyond disgusting. Maintenance gets reported and never resolved, infestation is off the charts not only that wood in my apartment has been mildewing. This place is disappointing.The office peple are rude and when you need anything fixed they never go.They claim it is a friendly place to live but the dumpsters are full of trash that you can smell it in the air from far away.People could get sick and the just don’t care!

Our family has lived in this community 3 years.  We love the spacious apartment and modern amenities.  It is a lovely neighborhood and excellent location. The office staff, Ms. Cheryl the property manager as well as everyone in the office is very involved in making the community safe and welcoming.  The maintenance team are wonderful and always available.  Everyone is invested in making this a great community.  Also the local schools, elementary, middle and high school are the top in the region and some of the best in the state.  We also appreciate all the extra amenities Providence Park has. It is a very family friendly area and we feel safe and at home.

Nice Apartments, Rude office Staff.

I cannot stress enough how terrible my experience has been living at University Village at Charlotte. Avoid living here at all cost.

I strongly advise against choosing University Village at Charlotte as your place of residence. They didn't send any itemized deductions list, and seem to think that ignoring emails is a proper legal defense. Be very wary when moving out if you're unfortunate enough to live here.

Even in the days after my leaving a voice-mail, there was never a call to assess how the situation unfolded or if any further actions were needed. do not bother calling security, just call 911 because you'll wait for hours or days for help from security, if you receive any at all. My last issue with UVC would be the the fees that they tack on to rent. They have ways that they add fees to your rent via loopholes in the lease. They write that Electric is covered by them and you reimburse them for the usage, but in the lease it doesn't state how much the base reimbursement rate is, so they were in the clear when they increased my electric fee. Another fee they've added is for rental insurance. In the lease it states it is not REQUIRED to purchase rental insurance or liability insurance. However, on an addendum, it is stated that it is an added fee. Another lovely fee they have is one required to process any online payments via debit/credit cards. If you're thinking of living here, DONT.

From the break ins, to maintenance issues, to parking issues, to just not caring at all for the residents that live there. Beautiful place, absolutely the WORST management and “service” out of any apartment complexes in the area. Move farther or pay more for a place because this place ISNT worth it.

Just like my title says, I wouldn't recommend this place to my worst enemy. I had a friend ask me about this place and I told them to run as far as they could. If I could stand outside all day and tell visitors not to live here I would. Living with your parents or living on campus is better than living here.
Oh, and the gate is broken again for the 10th time since I moved here in August.
No no no no no and no. Thank me later. Not worth it and is not safe. Worth moving a bit further. Horrible people

This place is a joke and “security” is never around! Car break ins happen all the time and gun shots every night. Yes, this place is cheap and seems nice on the inside but its not worth it!!! Stay away!!!!!!

University Village is a great place for students and residents alike. The pool is always the right temperature during the summer months.  The staff is friendly and helpful, no problem is too big or too small.  Well furnished and well maintained it can be home away from home.

I've been a resident for two years now. Moved here from NYC by myself so I wanted a community that was safe and accessible to grocery stores, Starbucks, Trader Joe's, yummy dining options and still affordable. Minutes from the 4mile creek greenway trail! There's a French bakery Amelie, Colombian restaurants, an authentic Japanese hidden gem nearby, and lots of dining diversity. There's a new brewery nearby, too. I don't really have to drive uptown to hangout when I meet up with friends and can stay local.

My apt is huge for the price and with windows that look out to a beautiful canopy of trees. I'm on the 3rd floor with vaulted ceilings and a fireplace. When my family and friends visit, they love my apt and the peace of the community. I've looked at what current apt prices are because this has been my first and only apt since my move from NYC, so just to stay in-the-know, and my rent is still better than anything else I've seen for the sq footage I receive and the convenience of location and amenities. My neighbors are friendly and quiet. I'm by the dog park so I get to meet neighbors from other buildings, too. I work remote from home and go for midday walks around the community to get some sun. It's always quiet and peaceful. Have to say, I've never seen bugs in my apt. I am on the 3rd floor, so maybe that's a thing. I think I've asked for the exterminator to come like twice in the two years more for the balcony area because I'm right by all the trees and more as a preventative thing.

The management company changed before my 2nd year here and there have been really great changes! The buildings were redone and painted, including our balconies/porches.The leasing staff is kind and attentive. Angel remembers me by name when she sees me. Amazon misdelivered a package and Armetria helped me to locate it immediately. The leasing office also puts on some cute and fun events--where you get to meet your neighbors. Maintenance staff changed and the current maintenance team is amazing. The few times I've had to make a maintenance request, my issues are quickly resolved and appliances replaced immediately, if needed. The maintenance staff is kind, respectful and knowledgeable. Lester is great! 

The gym is amazing and when I was having issues with my wifi router, I was able to go work from the business center boardroom in the clubhouse very conveniently. I've enjoyed and currently enjoy living here and just renewed my lease for a third year.

My experience here at Canopy has been great so far. The location was very important to me when I was searching for a place to live. Canopy is close to a lot of stores and restaurants. I've also loved being so close to the greenway. The staff have been kind and helpful with any requests I've had.

Buildings exterior are neglected. Pine trees with dead branches, very messy and bugs were a problem especially outside. Leasing company doesn't seem to care about the look of the buildings. They need maintenance. Eaves are clogged and water runs over edge. Steps are dangerous

We love our apartment and the community is really friendly and pleasant. Despite this being apartments, the building is quiet and I rarely hear noise from the other apartments. Nice green spaces and plenty of parking.

As a first apartment the experience was amazing, we were able to get moved in and all paperwork complete pretty much on our own time. While living in the community we felt like the staff knew who we were and cared about our time spent there. Whenever we reached out we always got a response in a timely and professional manner.
I had a great experience and they were very transparent about any fees up front so no surprises! Jacob was very helpful throughout the process.

I have lived here for many years and have been here during several different management companies.  The management company now is fantastic.  The have a wonderful group of people  from upper management, to the property manager, assistant manager, and rental agents.  The people are very professional and also  very kind to the residents.  They seem to genuinely care about the people who live here. I have lived here, as I said, for a very long time.   This complex is very quiet, and that is due to the management.  If there are issues, they handle them in a timely manner.  Also, the maintenance is the best I have ever seen.  They take care of maintenance  issues   when they get them and they are also very personable.  They also complete the job correctly the first time.   I hopefully will be able to remain here for years to come.

Warning ahead. The property management company should focus some time and attention to their current residents reasonable requests and abide by the terms and conditions of their own contract. Let's start with the good, finish with the unfortunate:
Good: Gym is very sizable for an apartment complex (could use slight updating), pool is nice, parking is gated and never an issue, location is great if you want to be near bars/restaurants (although someone was shot and killed two weeks ago a block away at Summit & Tryon).
Bad: Noise within the building between units is bad. I hear every single footstep the person above me takes. This doesn't bother me in the daytime, but sadly I have an upstairs neighbor that some weeknights is up until midnight, and some weekdays wakes up at 4:30am. I don't consider myself a light sleeper and I sleep with a fan on, but I can't sleep through them walking around. I've also spoken to a half dozen tenants in the building, and ALL of them said they do hear steps above them or through the neighboring walls between units. I was waiting on an elevator the other day and right behind me I could hear the tenant chopping on a cutting board through the wall. Minor things- both elevator inspections haven't been done since 2017 (unless they haven't put the updated slips in the elevators), the electrical wiring work in the utility closest looks to be a bit of a nightmare. Random soft spots in the flooring (someone posted a review on another site with mold issues, maybe there is something moisture related going on).
Sadly, I very specifically asked when touring the unit how the noise was between units, and was told along the lines of 'no, not really an issue'. Perhaps the office doesn't get noise complaints often, but every tenant I spoke to saying you do hear your neighbors is pretty telling. Not worth it to hear people walk above you all day for the high rental rates. Less than a month after moving in, I'm submitting my 60-day notice and paying a hefty moveout fee because it's not worth it to struggle to get more than 5 hours of sleep many weeknights for me. 
Advice: If you don't like hearing your neighbors, proceed with caution. Holdout for a top floor end unit if you can.

I've lived here for a few months and think it's been a great experience so far. The amenities are awesome! There is always plenty of room at the pool, parking garage, gym etc. The gym is huge! 
Sounds like the negative reviewer is a real sour apple and has a problem with everything. It's an apartment building so it will have it's occasional kinks to work out. Living in an apartment building comes with living with 10s or 100s of other people who cause issues. Anyways, my experience has been great, you can't beat the location! With any apartment complex, you will always have a little bad that you have to take with the good. Over the last year that I've been here, the good is decreasing and the bad is increasing. The good - location is amazing! Close enough to uptown and in the heart of south end. Walking distance to all the breweries, panthers and knights games, and restaurants. The staff is usually pretty nice, although turnover has been fairly constant. The apartments look pretty, even though the longer you're there the more you notice that they were put together pretty sloppy. You're always going to have a couple bad eggs in the bunch but most of the people are good neighbors. 

The bad - if you live here, you might as well get used to things breaking down, malfunctioning, or being closed altogether. At least one of the elevators is breaking down every other week. One day, both weren't working at the same time, so I wouldn't recommend this place if you rely on elevators. One also malfunctioned when I and couple others were inside, fun! The pool was dug up for repairs in January, left alone for months, and then they finally decided to finish the work in April when the weather consistently reached the 80s. Our pool opened 3-4 weeks later than every other one in south end. Each week they'd tell us it's only going to one more week. The gym was also closed for 2 1/2 weeks for repairs that they originally said would only be a couple days, then a week, then another week.... So you better have a gym membership if you plan to work out. Or just go running in 95 degree weather, because no biggie, right? Now, it's Friday afternoon and the entrance gate to one of the parking garages is broken (because there's always something malfunctioning). So, if I want to leave the garage after 5:00 on a Friday or Saturday evening for dinner with friends or to run errands, I'll have to try to find street parking which is impossible on a weekend night in this area or circle the other garage waiting for someone to leave (which already has 10 spots blocked off for months). They boast their events, but realistically hardly anyone shows up to them. 

Is this the worst apartment complex in Charlotte? Absolutely not. But with so many option in south end, there are comparable places for the same price and less frustrations. Recommendation to the apartment - We understand you can't control things going wrong sometimes, but do something to make it up to us. It would go a long way.
