We moved here last summer after looking for awhile in the area - we needed a larger apartment and unfortunately this was the least expensive option available. We got what we paid for.

Management has changed multiple times in the last year with no notice (we don't even know who's in charge anymore), and they've added a fence and "security" gates that do nothing but frustrate everyone when they don't work half the time and people can no longer use the back gate to enter.

The renovations are purely cosmetic and low-quality - stick-on "backsplash" that isn't even trimmed properly, laminate "plank" flooring and even with brand new appliances I'm still having to wash most of my dishes after a run through the dishwasher.

All of that would be fine, however - but the drug problems here are rampant. On an almost daily basis I see people buying drugs, smoking pot in their cars at all hours of the day and night, and no one does anything about it. When I called to report something the other day I was told that they would "check to see if there's anything we can do" even though I could literally see them rolling a joint in their car. I never got a call back.

I know they're trying to improve the quality here, but until they address the drug issues, it's not going to get any better.

I recently  divorced and was put out of my house by my now husband.  I found  myself  with nowhere to go.  Not mention I had a 17 year old  son and a pet. I once lived in an Apartment  complex  named Davis Commons. I found myself  right back  there again. Shorty  after moving  back in the complex went bankrupt.  We had some new owners  come in and  buy the property.  We're  now called  the Hamptons. The transformations  they have made to these  apartments  are amazing.  They have tmade these  apartments  very elegant . Each apartment  has it's  own unique  renovation  features.  I don't  even miss being in my house because  my apartment  has just as much if not more than my house. I love the accent  wall, the nickel  plated  fixtures,  the black appliances,  the plank floors, new carpet., the blinds  and ceiling fans as well. But did  I mention that  I reside in a  3 bedroom  apartment  that is 1386  square feet.  I love the new amenities  they have to offer.  For safety reasons we are also in the process of  becoming a  gated community. We  now have a bark park also. I could not have  made a better  choice.  Living here takes me away from  all  the frustrations  of my old house . I love everything about the  HAMPTONS  APARTMENT  HOMES!

I called the property and I was greeted by Lorenzo. You can really tell that he takes pride in what he does. He was very friendly and professional. We visited the property and we were were shown the ADA unit as well as another unit. I was thoroughly impressed and I applied online  before I left. Within two days I had a response. I’ve been here for a month now and it is quiet. The neighbors are pretty cool and respectful.  The property is clean and well kept. I love the cabinet space and the fact that there is NO carpet. I only had one small issue with my bedroom door being a little off and not latching when closed and that was fixed immediately. Great staff…..nice location…. We’re happy.

Beautiful apartments, I will not lie. But the management is horrible.. DO NOT WALK AWAY, RUN! I would go into depth with the situation but I am still hoping to get my money back from them. They do not want to give me my deposit back even though I left EVERYTHING SPOTLESS.

I have been living here for a little over a year now, and I have to say I love my apartment. I felt inclined to write this review because I do see some bad ones posted, however I have never encountered any of these issues. I mean, there is some noise, but any apartment I have lived in has sounded the same. I relocated here, and the office staff has helped me navigate things to do around town, and offer events for me to come mingle. I have nothing but great things to say about them! On top of everything else, everyone who comes over always tells me how nice my place is! I love entertaining and showing it off! I am so obsessed with my apartment, and everyone wants to come cook at my place, which, I love food, so I'm all about it!

I honestly can't wait until my lease is up, I dread coming home every single day. Office staff is horrible and will not mend any issues. I've literally complained about my neighbors on top of me at least 15 times and nothing has been done. It literally sounds like an elephant is falling on the ceiling at all times of night. I've even asked to be moved or terminate my lease because it's gotten soooo bad. If you want peace and quiet when you come home, this is the wrong place for you. I'm counting down the days until the end of my lease and I will never recommend this apartment complex to anyone.

Crime is rampant. 

Parties happen almost every night with excessive noise. 

Landscapers damage vehicles parked in the lot. 

Management does nothing to fix issues. They're oblivious and incompetent.

I have lived here for about a year now and I moved from out of state. If my move wasn't so rushed for the new job I would have never stayed here.   First of all I believe someone who works for the property stole from my apartment. The appliances look nice however when it comes to quality they are cheap. About a month ago they switched management and started making changes. I have had two vehicles and when I signed my lease it was never stated I could not have more than one vehicle parked. They have issued parking passes and my car was towed because they refused to give me two decals for my vehicles. So I had to pay 180 to get my car back. There is more than enough parking without decals but they created visitor parking only 20 visitor spots. This is not enough considering the amount of residences. You will also be towed in places that do not indicate no parking. 

People do not pick up their dog droppings. Which is disgusting. 

Noise - Dogs are constantly barking. all my neighbors have dogs and the walls are EXTREMELY THIN. It almost sounds like the Dogs are in my own living room. You can hear your neighbors doing everything. talking on the phone. Watching TV . Everything. I have complained about this numerous times and I'm always told something will  be done. I'm still having these issues. People like to hang out at the pool area making noise. - They have a security guard however he does absolutely nothing but sit in his Car. -What a waste. 

The finishes in the apartment look to be rushed through. There was no thought when building. The placement of the cable jack is behind the bedroom door. Which is annoying because the doors open inwards.

I could go on and on but my lease is almost up Thank GOD! the only good thing about this place was the distance to my job and the rent isn't too bad. But this is a prime example of getting what you pay for. Next place is definitely an upgrade and it costs a lot more.

I got a horrible experience with cockroaches on the first day it self.
We went to shopping at 5 pm and came back at 8 pm on that day and we are all surprised with cockroaches on living room walls, kitchen, laundry and bathroom etc. We killed around 30 roaches on that day. We continuously killing the roaches for couple of days. I reported this incident to the management and management told me that pest control team will come on every other Tuesday. So, I need wait for 8 more days to resolve this issue. My kids were afraid of these roaches and they didn't sleep well in the nights.
Management should have done pest control before giving apartments to the new tenants. I noticed these roaches backside of freezer and stove.

I got one more incident on the rental insurance. I took rental insurance from progressive and not added additional interest in my policy. For not adding additional interest, they charged $35 from my account for that month rental insurance even though I have an insurance. Management should have told me that I need to add additional interest in the policy before giving home keys to me. But that not happen.

Kids park is too small and it not clean. Kids not showing any interest to play here.

We need to wait long time to get the lease agreement from the management.

Mailbox area is getting very bad smell and not able to stand for a minute.

I have not seen visitor parking signs here.
If you plan on having any visitors don’t move here! There’s barely any visitor parking spots and the spots they do have are compact parking spots (for smaller cars) which is dumb!
Legacy 521 is a great place to live.  The apartments are immaculate and the staff is exceptional!

Outstanding service by property management.We loved this beautiful apartment; new and fresh greatly looking apartment with proximate to freeway ,school and shopping.
My experience here quite excellent with topnotch staff; There are so many great experiences just to share here one of the great service when you have real challenging time.
I was lived only for 5 months, and I have to vacate apartment due to my personal reason. 
Wendy, property manager is very honest ; worked with management really taken serious about helping us finding new tenants. Starting leasing process until ending of lease , and in between, every step of the process, they maintain and provided highly professional service .
I would definitely recommend these beautiful new apartments.  We miss Legacy 521 and Team.
Thank you Chelsy, Melissa and Wendy !!!

Fantastic location and the property management staff (Wendy, Melissa and Chelsea - 5 Stars) have been nothing but very helpful. Any issue with apartment unit you put across to them they get it fixed in reasonable time frame. Maintenance (Lamont) keeps area up and running. The apartment units have fairly spacious floor plans. Very much looking forward for the club house with amazing gym, basketball court & outdoor swimming pool! 

- Sunny

I use to manage the Woodlands and the Devonwood Apartments when they were one whole community called The Woodlands.  That was well over 30 years ago, but I find it odd that the Devonwood calls a one bedroom one bath apartment with a den (The Barksdale) a "two" bedroom apartment.  Unless the building codes have changed, a bedroom must contain a closet.  I may be wrong, but we always listed the Barksdale as a one bedroom, one bath with a den just as neighboring The Woodlands does now – they currently called it “The Wren”.  It's the same floor plan.  It just seems one property is telling the truth and the other is being a bit misleading.   If the floor plan at either property suits you - fine, but I do find the description by one property somewhat misleading.  I've been in property management for over 40 years and believe what you sell should be the truth.

I Move In Today. The Apartment was beautiful as I walk in but once I looked inside the freezer and the refrigerator it had dead maggots inside & was dirty, the cabinets has spiders and webs & the bathroom sink was alil dirty. Wish they full cleaned the apartment before moving me in. But the staff was great. Cleanness should be their number one priority.

I was thinking of moving to Charlotte, North Carolina and Ms. Daisy was very very pleasant and a joy to talk to. She was very thorough with the apartment details and the apartments look great! I has a quiet/cozy feel!

A month ago I decided along with my fiance to make Devonwood into our home. October 18, 2017 was our move in date. As the day came we were told to bring our deposit and they would go on from there. Once the lease was signed off and were given the keys we were surprised by what we encountered inside the unit. The moment we stepped in we saw roaches everywhere. Not only that but the apartment was clearly not ready for our arrival. The main entrance wall had fresh wet paint, the wall in the master had what seems to be red crayon marks, a dirty ear swab, the cabinets were not fully closing, the fridge smelled like as if something was decomposing, and the shelves were on the verge of breaking into half. Also in our arrival we saw a lady cleaning the apartment but did not procede with her routine once she saw us. She left the toilet with urine and hairs in the tub. As soon as we saw the conditions of the apartment, we reported the roaches the same day of our move in. The next day they sent someone to exterminate and later that night more roaches were crawling out of the carpet and holes from the wall. At that point I was disappointed because they gave us a apartment that was not move in ready with a month of knowing in advance. I gave them the apartment keys and kindly asked to have the lease terminated with no consequence because I could not bring my new furniture into a place that was not ready. She suggested to moving us into a new unit but I refused because it would be fixing the problem that they should have resolved before it got to this point. She also suggested to exterminate everyday but I explained to her I have asthma and would basically have to live in a hotel because I can not be in that environment. Today, 10/23/2017 I called to let them know I want my deposit and prorated rent without being responsible of the rent since i'm not the one who is to be held accountable for their negligence

Hi my name is Dee Martinez 
I been living at the (Casabella) aka also know as the Devonwoods Apartments Homes now ..
I been here since the end of Oct 2012 to present I love it here the area has a bad reputation for high crimes ect...
But to be quite honest I feel very safe my neighbors are amazing and the office staff are too . I never had a problem here regardless of the area and reputation this apartment has ...I really feel at home here..
My first place here in Charlotte. .is sad that now I have too move out I'm so bummed out about it because they raised my rent too much and is over my budget at this present time in my life .
Ps. ..to anyone that is reading my review remember one thing home is where you make it ??
I've been trying to pay rent today and no one is at the office.  I've been to the office 3 times today and I've called 4 times.  Need people to do their job.

The physical location is great, apartments are nothing extraordinary, management is horrendous.

1. Don't pay attention to the promotions they run, it's very likely you'll never receive what ever the promotion promised.

2. Management is only responsive when there is money involved. Noise complaint? You're on your own. Issues with amenities? Just don't use them. It's not like you're paying for them or anything. 

3. Gym is not an actual gym, just some treadmills, machines and dumbbells, no actual barbells.

4. Gate fobs they give you don't actually work.

So all in all, property is bad because management is the definition of incompetence

Half of the gates are broken, cars constantly get broken into. Constantly. Trash around the property. Elevators are always dirty, half the time there’s urine....yes urine...no it will not get cleaned up by the management...yes, you will more than likely take the stairs. Constant odor of marijuana. Whatever price you set and agree on, it will change. Constantly charge you $25 fines, for example if you put lights on your balcony or a towel or anything nice, yes its a $25 fine. Management constantly changes, if that tells you anything. 
Don’t be shocked to live without AC or heat, just be prepared. 
Nice sink hole in the bag that gets your car muddy every time it rains. No its not getting fixed, its been going on for couple years. 
N

Lived here for almost 3 years. The apartment itself was great. Close to uptown, BOA stadium and many other things. Great size apartment and the pool in the complex is a lot of fun...BUT the new management is terrible. I had nothing but issues when I moved out. They said I didn’t notify them 30 days in advance but I had the email as proof. Then they didn’t show up for my “move-out walk through”. I gave them my new address but they never sent me a final bill and sent me right to collections for lack of payment. I’ve tried calling them and they won’t return my phone calls because it’s “not their problem anymore”. They added numerous fees to the final bill with no breakdown or explanation. Bottom line...be warned about the new management and keep your documentation!

I’ve lived here almost 5 months now and I signed my lease without even taking a tour of the place. I had to go by the pictures and the vibe I got from the girls over the phone. I moved here from Alabama and I didn’t have the time to come up just to apartment hunt. The girls in the office are SO sweet and helpful. They always have a big smile on their faces and are excited about all the events and things happening at Wesley. They just renovated the clubhouse and it’s beautiful. These apartments are so spacious and have all the nice finishing. Granite, stainless steel, dish washers, garbage disposals, back splashes, everything. I actually have the smallest 2BR 2BA apartment and it’s still so spacious. It’s a quiet apartment complex for the most part, plenty of parking, and gated. A few of the buildings have garages, elevators, lofts, and other special features. The pool is big and there’s nice chairs, grills, music, couches, cabanas, and restrooms. There’s only a few kids that live here and pretty much everyone here is like 20s/30s. The area is great, a few places you can walk to including the panthers stadium and restaurants. It’s a cheap uber/Lyft to anywhere uptown, plaza, or south end and less than 10 min. You really can’t beat what all Wesley Village has to offer for the price. It’s uptown living without the price and stress of horrible parking and noise honestly.

Where to start.. well I’ve lived here for about 2 months now and on my first night, I walked out to my car window completely shattered in our “gated community.” Mind you, the gates have been broken nearly the whole entire time that I’ve lived here, so... so much for being “safe”. With that being said, when you call the office explaining that your car got broken into and your concern for safety with the gates, their answer is, “well we have cameras, but they don’t work anyway.. so there’s nothing we can do.” As well as “we’re working on the gate.” Well, it’s been two months and the gate is off the hinges and still
broken. 
Also, they’re very big on their new “pool pass” idea.. literally all we hear about: not allowed to have more than one guest, not allowed to bring a personal speaker, this that and the third- but forget about the constant car break ins and the gate being broken. 
It’s a HUGE concern when you have to worry about parking inside the alleged “gated community” with a parking pass that we pay monthly for because cars are being damaged and your only answer is “did you file a police report” and “sorry, our cameras don’t work/are too blurry.” 

DONT live here, not worth the money or the effort because they don’t care about anything.

Wesley Village is located in a prime location right outside of Uptown. The commute to work takes me 5 mins, which is outstanding; not to mention the complementary Starbucks machine in the lobby. Being a young professional in the city makes this a huge benefit during the week. That said, even though the amenities are fairly nice they can found in just about any of the new apartment complexes recently opened nearby.

Unfortunately, there is a major drawback and flaw with this community in that the physical apartment buildings/framework and units themselves are of poor/cheap construction (the new paint job came out nice, but don't let it fool you). The units themselves are decent inside, with the exception of the amount of noise pollution from neighbors. You can hear your neighbors at all hours of the day (and night) through the walls and ceilings upstairs. This includes stomping footsteps, any form of yelling/shouting, washer/dryer machines, barking dogs, and plumbing, to name a few. It's hard to get a good night sleep, let alone just try to relax. This has been brought to the attention of management regularly, but they don't do anything about it or just tell you what you want to hear. I will not be renewing my lease due to this norm. The location is certainly the best part, but the noise factor really does impact the living experience here in a very negative way. Like my old boss used to say, "it's like putting lipstick on a pig around here".

The buildings and apartments are gorgeous - there really is no catch. There are four women who run the office and I love every single one of them! Maintenance requests completed next day, great location, very community feel despite close proximity to Uptown. Pictures online don't really do it justice, so go take a tour! Drawbacks: tricky gate access for guests, only part of the complex has ATT available.

I have been at Wesley for awhile now and really have loved the experience. I have seen a lot of improvements since it was bought out this year. The buildings are being freshly painted. I didn't even realize the old paint was as faded until I started seeing the new and it definitely makes a huge difference! The pool area was redone this year and new stuff added to it. 
I come into the office everyday with my dog and the staff knows his name and gives him a treat. He won't even let me walk by the door without stopping in for his cookie and his pets. I have read reviews about the staff being rude but this has never been my experience. 
My apartment is very spacious and for the price you can't beat it. The complex is in a really convenient location and has close highway access making it easy to get around.

I lived in Wesley Village for a year. I ultimately did not resign my lease for a number of reasons.

The gate- BROKEN. When it did work it was noisy and would wake me up at night. Not sure why I was paying to live in a gated community that didn't have a gate. 

The trash company- AWFUL. We got charged $25 for a trash fee because it wasn't in a trash bag. Too lazy to do their jobs!

The staff- UNHELPFUL. Nice but they don't care about the residents. They signed for a package of mine (valued at $750 dollars) and did not notify me. When I asked them to notify me for future packages, they said that it was not a policy, it was a favor to me. Why couldn't they just say yes and do their job? I know why, because they are lazy!!!!

I saved the worst for last..

I moved out June 30th. In August, I called to check on my security deposit refund. They said it takes 4-6 weeks after moving out to receive it so I should receive it soon. I waited, nothing. I called, they did not have any information on it. I called 12 times and kept getting the same run around. I would ask to speak to the property manager who was supposed know the status of it, and she avoided me! Told me she would call back later, she never did. When I called her, she once again avoided my call. Maybe they thought I was being annoying? But they had $500 of my money and they were doing nothing to help! Once again, lazy. 

The best part about this is that their excuse was: "our headquarters were in Miami and i don't know if you have heard or not, but it was affected by the hurricane." Who in America did not hear about hurricane Irma?? They used that excuse three times on me! The hurricane happened two months after I moved out, I should have received my money way before then! Finally, I just called their headquarters in Miami and they were open and they told me the status of my check. Guess they were open after all! It is so unprofessional to lie to try to cover your own tracks, but guess that is what I should expect!

It ended up taking me 4 months to get my check.. ridiculous. There are so many amazing complexes in Charlotte, don't waste your money living at Wesley Village. You will end up disappointed and frustrated!

The leasing office team is great, Kelly was very helpful and knowledgeable and got me just the apartment I was looking for. The community is awesome with all the renovations that they are doing, and I like the fact that Im very close to Uptown and South End!!

Gated community but the gates rarely work. 

Front office is very unprofessional, packages are always lost. Yes, this is consistent since new management has taken over the property. 

The only, and i mean only, good thing about this complex is simply, the location.
Great apartment complex. Has a dog park and wonderful staff. They are attentive and very helpful when needed.

Very nice kitchen with lots of storage and decent counter tops.  Walk in closet is a decent size.  There is no other storage in the 1 bedrooms other than that which is unfortunate.  Gym has a bike, a few treadmills and ellipticals, nothing too special.  Starbucks coffee in the clubhouse is awesome and convenient. Pool and grills on site are nice and well kept but often packed.  Neighbors are super friendly.  Plenty of parking and walking distance to Bank of America stadium and BB&T ballpark.  Plenty of bars and restaurants nearby.

Wesley Village, when compared to the inordinate amount of apartment Charlotte has to offer, is a decent decent apartment complex.  It's not bad on the eyes, and, at $1,036/month for a 1-bedroom, not too bad on the wallet either.  Combine that price with the location, which is about 5 minutes from Uptown, and this place would seem to be a winner.  However, like the Charlotte Hornets being a good NBA franchise, that's just not the case.  

I mean, its not all bad.  The apartment is well laid out with high end appliances.  The closet space is manageable, and the bedroom(s) are a good size.  Also, compared to some other kitchens at higher-end apartments, Wesley Village offers a high quality kitchen with plenty of cabinet space and good finishes.  Oh, one more thing, the pool is out of this world.  If you're young and want to get rowdy, it was literally made for you.  

But, the new management company that took over for the old one is absolutely deplorable at their job.  The property was formerly managed by Greystar, and they did an incredible job at management.  Professional, prompt, courteous, (insert adjective) . . . . However, the ownership at Wesley Village must have determined that Greystar wasn't worth the money, so they brought in their own crew to handle things.  And then the nightmare began.  Management now is unprofessional, slow, unorganized, and downright rude.  And all of these attributes were experienced by my fiance and I, which pay our rent early every month and, being true southerners, are impossible not to get along with (or so we think at least).  

Nevertheless, before the new management showed up, we were content in staying in this apartment for 3-4 years while we built up our savings for a downpayment.  But, alas, our hand has been forced and we will be leaving at the end of our lease to head for higher ground (like literally . . . we're moving into uptown).  

If you're looking for a decent apartment, close to uptown, with a nice kitchen and a great pool, Wesley Village could be your ticket.  However, you've been warned.  The new management is absolutely awful.

they are irresponsible, they require future tenants to meet all the requirements but they do not meet the delivery date of the apartment and offer you the available units with a higher price and if you do not accept said unit they will not return the money. administrative expenses.

They’ll have you schedule tours for floor plans that do not exist. The Devonshire isn’t even a real floor plan. Don’t bother your time the reviews of actual residents suck and then the website is false advertising. Better amenities for same prices somewhere else.
Un excelente servicio y muy lindas sus instalaciones, felicidades.
Great location. The staff has always been friendly and helpful.
convenient location, friendly staff and well maintained property

The apartments are reasonably priced and I love the location. It’s a quick drive to uptown, which makes it very convenient for me. I really like the interior renovations and I like the 24hr fitness center.

I’ve lived here since July, and since moving in, my smart home has never worked. I’ve submitted multiple work orders and emails but have received no response. There is mold and mildew in the hallway from the building flood, puke on the ground in the parking garage, and homeless individuals sleeping there. The lights on the parking garage roof are all burnt out, the roof is vandalized, and none of the doors lock or function properly.

We live on the top floor, and people frequently gather on the roof at night, making loud noises, smoking marijuana, and throwing things onto our balcony. We've tried calling the office when that happens, but no one responds. We complained about that and the office staff gave us a phone number, but at night nobody ever answered. This time my husband was standing outside and someone threw a very heavy block and it hit him on the back of the head/neck. The main door has been broken for months, the hallways are dirty and stained. The place always smells like garbage. It's definitely not a safe place. So far, we've had a very bad experience here.

Do NOT live here. We got charged over a thousand dollars after moving out on things that are considered normal wear and tear by every other apartment complex I've ever lived in. I've never experienced this level of disrespect and dismissal towards my roommate and myself. We'd been tenants for 3 years. The first 2 years were awesome, but this new management team has ruined everything great about this apartment complex. In addition to the blatant disrespect, the doors are always left unlocked, the garbage room is so dirty, and it's become a shell of what it used to be.

READ THE OTHER REVIEWS FROM TENANTS. DO NOT MOVE HERE IF YOU WANT TO HAVE A NORMAL APARTMENT LIVING EXPERIENCE. Look elsewhere.

Management is terrible. The building is disgusting. There is trash and dog poop constantly throughout the halls. Dont even bother making complaints. No one responds by email and even if you go to management in person, they claim to be fixing the issues and they never do. Been living here for two years and regret re signing my lease. I cannot wait to move out.

I moved into the Gibson in 2020 and loved it at first. However, once new management took over a couple years ago, things went downhill VERY quickly. It became extremely difficult to get office staff to respond to any phone calls or emails (they often claimed to "never have received" the messages), the hallways and common areas were no longer well-maintained, and safety took a big hit. For a while, almost every single exterior key fob around the whole building was broken. Doors were routinely propped open and there were frequently people lingering outside or wandering the halls. After I moved out, it took 4 months (and 10+ phone calls and emails) to receive my security deposit back. 

The location is excellent and the size/layout of some units is great, but ultimately I would not recommend living here.

I moved in under the old ownership/mgmt. and had a great living experience. New ownership has basically no idea what they are doing and run the place into the ground. Only thing going for it is location.
Not worth the rent.

The Gibson is a great place to live that makes me feel comfortable and safe on a daily basis. The staff is attentive and make residents feel at home. The location is perfect for being in plaza midwood, but separated from heavy traffic areas or other apartment complexes.

I love the Gibson! I was one of the first residents to move into this complex. I signed my lease while construction on the building was still being completed back in 2017. I have been here ever since. When I first moved I didn't know all that much about Charlotte even growing up in nearby Gastonia, NC but I now know that I chose the perfect location for my apartment. I think Plaza Midwood is the best neighborhood in Charlotte and the traffic still is not too crazy yet here. Everyone I have met here is so nice and the staff and management is extremely professional and accommodating. I have recommended the Gibson multiple times to friends. My sister just moved into the Gibson a week ago from NYC and I know she is going to love it. I have been very busy with work and have not had a lot of time to go to a lot of the community events but I just switched jobs and have some more free time so now my sister and I plan to try some of the community events.
The Gibson is amazing! Along with the history of the place it’s well maintained and quiet and the community itself is great.

Compared to the other apartment complexes in the area, The Gibson doesn't provide the same care and security for their residents or the building itself. Walls have black marks and other blemishes all over them, security pads for doors don't work so anyone who can get in the garage can enter the building. All food delivery persons who gain access codes from residents who refuse to meet them in the main lobby can freely roam the complex and potentially hurt or harm residents and property.
I would not recommend living here if someone likes interactions with the staff. I dont interact much, so its fine but the few interactions Ive had arent the best.

So far, living at Gibson has been great. I was a lit skeptical before I moved in but now I am convinced that I made the right choice picking Gibson. The staffs are very helpful and nice. The community is located in a good environment within nice restaurants within walking distance. Everyone I have met so far in the community has been great. The amenities are not bad either. Currently I am glad I signed with Gibson.
We really enjoy everything so far! We cant wait for warmer days so we can sit out on our patio. Any issues weve had have been solved quickly.

I've never lived in an apartment quite like the Gibson! My boyfriend and I moved here in May of 2020 (middle of the pandemic). We were moving from out of state and weren't able to come and see the apartment in person for a number of reasons. Jeffery was so helpful by giving us a virtual tour and answering a million of our questions to help put us at ease during a major move. The Gibson Is very community-oriented. They are always putting on fun events for the residents (including virtual and socially distant ones right now) and for the pets! All our friends back home are jealous when we tell them about the fun things our apartment does  I would 100% recommend The Gibson to anyone and we are so lucky to have found this apartment and to call it home here in Charlotte.

I have a beautiful 3rd floor one bedroom one bath apartment at the Gibson with large windows and a sliding door opening to clear evening views of the colorful city skyline.  The neighborhood is ideal for dog walking with many handsome old bungalows to admire.  You can leave the car at home and walk to consignment shops, restaurants, breweries, bakeries and salons. it is nice here, i wish the gate would be fixed so it can operate correctly. It is near alot of shops and stores and that is nice the location is good

Good quality apartments in the university area. Located conveniently near the light-rail, grocery stores, and general necessities. Friendly staff and an excellent garden / grounds crew. Great option for anyone working in the University area or near any lightrail stops.
This community is great, quiet area , convenient and the maintenance team and office staff actually manages the property to keep everything clean and nice

When I toured the complex it was amazing and spotless.  You find out quick that is not the norm. Trash not picked up all over the complex. Management is relatively responsive and helpful. Parking isn’t great, but there are always spots (sometimes a hike). Clubhouse facilities are nice. Interior of apartment is nice. 

The traffic pattern for entering and exiting the complex is terribly annoying. Trash is everywhere and piles up very high around the dumpster. The gate is broken as often as it is working. Police have been on site responding to calls multiple times in the six months I’ve lived there. 

Overall, I’d say it’s a decent place to live because of the proximity to Uptown. I will likely not renew. I think I can find a comparably better option for a better price.

Update
I only put two stars so you would know I'm a reasonable person and not someone who "wishes they could give negative stars" that a one star review may denote.

I been living here for almost a year and its great for living very quiet community and very clean. Profesional staff and the pool is always clean.
Great view from my living room window where I can enjoy watching the deer, rabbits, squirrels and many different kinds of birds.
I love the staff here and they always address any maintenance requests quickly.
Cedar flats has been one of the cleanest, well managed apartments in Uptown Clt! Super great location too!

It should not be my job to write on a paper that things need to be cleaned, that is your job for a paying customer.

Cleanliness - Take a look at the trash chute (photo) and the dirty grill. I made it a goal never to touch that nasty floor. 

Allergies/Air Quality - Third, I want to add on to the recent review I have read about allergies that was posted 3 weeks ago. I agree. Leasing staff is awesome. Called to inquiry about an apartment and leasing agent Elijah was very helpful and informative.

Spent 30 minutes trying to get in touch with someone at the office that I never got to talk to anyone. The apartment quality like the brass nickel finish is so cheap that the handles fall off at least once a month, the crown molding and floor molding is was down by novice, the fridge has a problem with leaks, the walls are paper thin so be ready to hear everything around when you sleep, the gated community is never gated they are always open, and my biggest complaint was the maintenance team came in our apartment without a notice or even a knock on the door while my wife was half-naked and left the apartment in a rush saying sorry. We tried to complain about it to the office but no further actions were taken. We still haven’t received our $150 deposit even though we left the apartment exactly the way we received it.

If you work from home or want a peaceful place to live, do not choose this apartment. They will walk you around and show you a unit, however not disclose the many events that happen on the greenway or the loud cars that drive up and down the streets. AND beware of renting an apartment by the trash compactor areas. How is it that a trash collector comes on a Sunday night at 1AM? Great location (walking to Harris Teeter, Whole Foods Market, many restaurants, and Life Time!), spacious units with true 10 ft. ceiling, friendly and helpful staff. I enjoyed my time here in the past year or so. Sadly had to move due to work relocation to out of state.
I've already recommended the complex to several friends. It is a wonderful and beautiful community.
It is a very family friendly and the neighborhood is fantastic.
Awesome maintenance team!! Always respond fast and get things fixed. No better community in the state!!
The Links are a great place to live from the staff to the apartments. Would totally recommend to anyone. WHit
A relatively new complex,With a few problems,as usual.I have seen improvement in areas,they stay on top of any issues
Great place to live...great management people.  Service people are top notch.  Resort living at Cortland-Whitehall.

I absolutely love living at Cortland Whitehall! Apartments are beautiful, office staff is friendly and handles issues quickly! Maintenance staff is there within 24 hours of entering a ticket, and will fix your issues immediately! I couldn't ask for a better home!
great apartment complex, worth the price if you ask me.

Great place to live...clean, quiet, beautiful, outstanding staff and maintenance. Honestly...when I moved to Charlotte 6 months ago,  I physically looked at and toured 15 different apartments.  I have to say "This IS the best!".  Super amenities and really good parking. No horror stories about cars being towed off for no reason like I've read about in so many other apartment reviews.  Lucky to live here.

Very professional staff with pristine customer service . I love the management and how they maintain the property. The amenities are spectacular. If you are you looking for outstanding service, location and quality, I recommend you select Cortland Whitehall as your next place to call home.
I really like the specious kitchen area with open floor to  the dinning area and living room . New buildings with well taking care Hallways .

I am in search of a place to live following a divorce and sell of our marital home. I went in to look at a 3 bedroom apartment since I’m moving out of a 2800 sqft house I need the space. I was informed by a rude lady with dark long hair that they wouldn’t be able to show me the 3 bedroom because of the “weather outside”. Keep in mind this was well before Florence reached Charlotte and it hadn’t began raining one drop. I said that would be ok and they offered to show me the 2 bedroom in connected building. I agreed and gave my ID to the gentlemen who would be showing me the apartment. I had my 7 year old daughter and my mother with me at the time. They then asked to see my mothers ID. Unfortunately she left her ID at home since I was driving. They informed me she would not be able to view the apartment without her ID. This is the most ridiculous thing I’ve ever herd of. If the purposes of the ID check is Safety they already had my ID. I believe the staff in the office were just to lazy to do their job. The attitude from the dark haired girl was offensive to me as if we were some kind of drifter. Well their lack of customer service cost them a lease because I had all but decided that was going to be the place I was going to rent. Viewing the apartment was a formality as I like the area because it’s where we have been living for the past 7 years. Guess I’ll be renting from Axis down the road.

This building is extremely well located in the heart of the Steele Creek. It is conveniently located near restaurants, bars, shopping and gyms. The staff is extremely nice and helpful. I would recommend this building to anyone looking to live in this area.

We have lived in this building for almost a year and really love it. The location is great, being just a block away from Harris Teeter and Walgreens. The apartments are very well appointed with wood floors, granite counters, and stainless steel appliances. The staff is extremely friendly and landscaping is top notch.

This has literally been the worst choice I’ve made in my life! From the outside this place is awesome and beautiful I was so excited to be moving in, that lasted all of a month! This place is noisey noisey noisey, from upstairs neighbors to dogs barking at all hours. They did a terrible job building this place you can hear conversations next door. When you tell the office its we’ve emailed them but you can always call the police. When it comes to rent they will tell you one thing and comeback and say they never said that and it’s never their fault for anything that happens and they will slap on fees like it’s nothing. They’re have been fire alarms going off in the middle of the night and they blame residents for it. They found glass bottle near the pool and shut that down. And let’s not talk about the breakins to cars! No security cameras around and say well maybe you should lock your car.... this place has been the worst experience I’ve ever had, these ratings are for a reason take them into consideration before you move in here.

The apt layout and convenience are wonderful; however, the experience living here and with management has been horrific!  And I don’t use that term lightly. 

Basically, they avoid handling anything and take no responsibility for your living experience.  In June, we experienced 6 fire alarms in 2 weeks between the hours of 1 and 5am. These last approx 30 minutes each. There was no recourse for those in the building but we were told there would be a “treat” which I expected would be a rent discount.  NEVER received anything. 

Some people were taking glass bottles to the pool, instead of monitoring and removing their privileges, the pool was closed to everyone for 3 days. 

We have significant noise issues from upstairs neighbors, the only reply is that “we sent an email to the resident asking them to be quiet” and that we can call 911 at night. Structurally, The walls are paper thin as far as sound is concerned. I lay in bed and literally hear my neighbor coughing. 

Although security is nice with the exterior doors, if my babysitter has both kids and needs to get in she can’t simply call the office to meet her at the door and let her in (although we were told that was the process). She has to take both kids to the leasing office and then wait until one of them will go and let her in.  

Per post office staff, the office staff refuse to accept packages since they put in the Luxor systemSo when I receive a package through USPS I have to go to the Post Office and pick it up. 

These issues can all be validated with emails I have retained. We are unfortunately trapped here until our home is ready for move in, but I would advise anyone else.... any other option in Charlotte is better.

Amazing property! Great location. Go see Cali at the leasing office. The property manager is awesome too. They’re friendly, professional, patient, and on top of the process!
Apartments are super cool, huge windows, upgraded appliances, and a variety of unique floor plans.

After moving in, I happily gave a 5 star review and I still love living here. However, there are some issues that need to be sorted out...


-----The Positives: 

The location is great - some others have left negative reviews regarding location and I disagree. I have walked home late at night many times and have felt safe. My commute to work uptown is very quick and easy in the morning as well!

The building is beautiful! I have gorgeous windows, exposed brick walls, original hardwoods and a shiplap ceiling!

The pool, gym and fire pits are great!

My neighbors have quickly become my friends!


-----The Negatives:

Lots of units leak.

Mushrooms grow out of the bricks inside some units.

The appliances (especially the washer/dryer and dishwasher) give frequent issues. It's my understanding that this is common with low-end Frigidaire appliances.

Kitchen cabinets - my cabinet above my fridge has fallen off the wall twice. Each time they responded to my complaints and repaired them. Clearly it was just a rush job installing them initially.

The staff has recently changed and not for the better.

Lots of spiders when I first moved in - and i still see them occasionally. The worst encounter was a 6" spider IN MY BED.

My neighbor recently sent me photos of a black snake she found in her unit. I now sleep with a shovel by my headboard just in case I have to fight them off in my unit!  

There aren't really events here every month like other places I've rented in Charlotte which is really a bummer. 

---- Summary:

For a long time, the architecture and location outweighed the bad - but they have since become insurmountable. Stay away!

Love love love the historic and restored building with great amenities in a wonderful location. Unfortunately, the property management is the worst I’ve experience in years and years of renting. They cannot keep a property manager and leasing agents for longer than a few month. I assume It’s because they treat their staff with the same intimidating and threatening behavior they use towards their residents. While most residents understand lease agreements and rules, management tends to disregard the same to benefit them (For example: entering apartments without prior notice or notice at all). They often treat residents as though we were doing them a favor by living here, lack apologies for their mistakes and accuse residents before properly investigating the issue at hand. In fact, I personally felt I had to leave this review after I moved out last month in fear of retaliation and mistreatment.

This building is an amazing example of how a restoration should be done. The history and architecture are blended in a manner that makes you feel like you own a little bit of the past. The amenities are top notch and an added bonus to an already great property. The windows let in tons of natural light for plant lovers. Last but not least the site staff are pleasant to work with, treat you like family, and get the job done!

THE WALLS ARE SUPER THIN,  ONLY LIVE ON THE 3RD FLOOR!!!

Do not, and I repeat,  DO NOT LIVE HERE because the walls are super thin. You can hear people walk upstairs all day, listen to their conversations,  and hear everytime they vacuum their floors or use their washing machine.  If you put your head to the wall, you can easily hear your next door neighbors full conversations.  I can  hear the person who lives above me use the bathroom ( flushing toilet) snoring at night and  walking around their apartment all day.

I knew a friend that lived in the building and they moved out, but when I went to vist their apartment in the same complex,  I was shocked that it's not just me experiencing this noise problem. I really thought I was the only one until my friend complained to me that their family has been living through the thin walls and poor installation conditions in the building for almost 12 months ( I wish they would of told me this before I signed my lease).

I can't believe that they built this building so cheap.  It looks beautiful from the outside,  but once you sign your lease and you spend a night,  you will be shocked at how thin the walls are. 

They have poor security service.  I talked to the one security guard that I randomly see and he told me that the apartment complex doesn't employ a full-time in house/ on property guard.  He told me that has 6 other building that he also patrols. If there was an emergency which there's always noise and vandalism,  it would take him 20min to get here.  I called the security company to verify  what the security guard told me and the manager said that it's true, the apartment complex chose not to have a full in house security guard on post all day, but rather chose the cheaper option of having one officer make a routine check every hour.

I'm now looking for another place to live... who wants to live in a building and hear your neighbors every footsteps and conversations.  Who wants to hear dogs barking 6 doors down from your unit because the walls are so thin.

IF YOU STILL DECIDE TO LIVE HERE AND AVOID MY MANY WARNING SIGNS,  PLEASE LIVE ON THR 3RD FLOOR !

The apartment itself is very nice and so are the people at the front desk. Unfortunately, the amenities never work - car wash (a hose with a kink and vacuum that never works), the pool is closed in the summer due to kids using the bathroom, the gym never gets cleaned always dirty with trash, no one cleans up after their dogs, trash up all the stairs to the apartments, trash valet is picky and does not take boxes - and they will report you. The apartment will fine you but then never tell you until it happens 3-4 times (by then over $150 in fines). They send out forms about how you will be fined but nothing gets done about the constant dog waste around the apartments or fixing amenities.
I have lived here for about 2 years. My husband is getting transferred to South Carolina in April or I would be signing another lease. Its a nice place and near by a lot. The staff is sweet too.

We have been living here for almost two years, and our experience living here has been horrific. The place was not bad under the previous management, but it has truly taken a. turn for the worst since being bought out by RK properties in 2021. We live in the most expensive floorpan here, and our unit is literally falling apart. The grounds are dirty because they do not enforce the policy requiring dog owners to pick up after their dogs. 

There is a lot of turnover in management and other staff because they are rude and incompetent. Also, residents' packages are frequently lost or stolen. 

Save yourself time, money, and a headache by renting something much nicer for the same price in this area.

We searched for over a month to find a place that felt like “home” they were all nice but just didn’t have that “extra” needed to make a year commitment until we met Angel. He made us feel like we could spend years to come here. It is by far the best choice we’ve made!
I love alta Prosperity village, I feel like I am living in a resort style hotel. The staff is A+ and I couldn't ask for a better view of this beautiful pool! I love where I live!

When we first moved to this property everything was great! Toward the end of our time there the management changes and every thing changed for the WORST! We would pay the full rent amount listed on the community portal, just to be told we were short money that wasn’t even listed on the portal. Upon moving out our security deposit was used for random miscellaneous fees that had nothing to do with any damages. Also, the new staff is HORRIBLE AND RUDE. I would not recommend moving to this community now.

I stay for the elevator and convenience to work location.  Otherwise, it's overpriced-average.  The shower is plastic, there is no ceiling fan/light in the living room, and you only get a CHANCE for a Nest thermostat if you refer someone.  The staff acts friendly but is unyielding.  For my 3rd year, at the height of the pandemic, rent was raised $70 monthly.
Nice community but unfortunately allow LARGE, Loud dogs to make a LOT of noise making neighbors below or beside miserable.  Beware.

Current resident at Sycamore - What i have to say about this place is that the environment is very peaceful. It is a beautiful place to live in.

The Staff Is ****** Star excellence. (I have worked with Rochelle and Amanda) they are great. I would recommend this to anyone in the area!
Great staff, beautiful apartment features and enjoyable amenities.. Its an excellent community all the way around.. No complaints

The price of the rent is reasonable, but you will have to consider things such as the apartment itself. I wouldn't personally consider it luxury, but if you are okay with a average apartment and a younger crowd and what that experience brings, then its okay.

I relocated to willows just one week back and I found this place very amazing. Community is very peaceful and the apartment staff is so good and kind. They responded quickly for any sought of queries or issues. Im enjoying my stay here so far

I couldnt be more pleased with the complex overall! I love the location, all the updates appliances and overall look of the complex and our new home! It appears everything is well maintained and that truly makes all the difference to me! The staff is so friendly and attentive! Jody has been the biggest help! I dont know what wed do without her! She made our overall experience at Willows such a joy! Im very pleased with our decision to stay here! I hope it remains this way!

Dale and the maintenance team is such a blessing to have on side they always go above and beyond to help around the willow community they are always so kind and they stay very busy. The community manager Alexandra is also so kind and always very helpful she is always willing to listen to any concerns and questions about the property overall the willow at university is a really place to reside

I am on the property 6 days a week as a mail carrier . I must say Angie and Alexandra are the best  !!! And now their new addition Jody as well ... they are a great team !!! They are so nice and helpful with anything I need in servicing their residents . The property is so clean and well maintained.  Maintenance crew is also great and super helpful with anything I’ve ever needed help with. They truly make my day easier . If your are looking for something in this area they are who to go with !!! For sure !!!

I have been living here for 1 month, I love the attention from the office, Lorri, Shay and Antoinette are the best  ever, they do whatever it takes to make you feel like family, I moved here because my whole family was already living here from 6 month before me, the community is really quiet, the neighbors are really kind, please if you are looking at this community, don't think anymore, it will be the best decision.

Cons: Management and staff are rude, condescending, and lack customer service. Crime scene onsite multiple times,loud parties, marijuana smoking, theft and break-ins. I could go on but I think you get it by now.

Please I beg you do not invest your time or money in renting from this company. There is very little done to maintain renters safety. In 6 months we have had an attempted break in, cars broken into, cars towed, things stolen off our front porch, and a full fledge break in involving theft of thousands of dollars where the robbers broke down the door, and we still are unable to break our lease. Management is very difficult to get a hold of in a crisis. 
If I could give 0 stars I would. Please for your own safety avoid at all costs.

Our cars get broken into at least once a month and we are moving out. We asked management to do something about it, but they don’t seem too worried about our safety. The cops are here every other week, because there is always an issue. Don’t waste your time!
They tow cars daily, unfriendly staff, hidden fees, unprofessional

So I write a work order to replace two bathroom lights that went out.  I was told to buy the bulbs and they would install them.  First I can't reach them, second if I could, I might as well change it myself.   Management was no help at all.

A year ago, Walker Steele Creek, which was formerly Steele Creek Rivergate, was a nice place to live. It was quiet, new, and inviting. The cost of rent has increased by a high percentage. The parking situation is very bad. The area is known for high crime. The smell of weed is always overwhelming. 

Rent increases are common, but it seems like the property management team increases rent with the goal of forcing existing residents out so they can make room for new, higher-paying tenants. 

Good luck finding a place to park. They planned poorly. Every space in the complex is full, even though there is a rule against more than two cars per unit. They tried a permit system but gave up after a few weeks of residents and visitors getting their cars booted. Now they want an extra $100 per car per month if you want to park in front of your building. 

I would recommend parking at Target and walking to your apartment if you move to Walker Steele Creek, but because of the high crime, it might be dangerous. Police activity is common at WSC and there have been cars stolen from the resident lot, drug deals, and other crimes committed at the complex according to CMPD. 

People are constantly smoking, skateboarding, and wandering the complex late at night. It isn't a safe place to be. It is cheaper than other complexes in Charlotte but not worth your time. You can't opt out of the trash fee. Comporium is the only internet provider offered. The office is closed on Sundays and not open to residents during non-business hours. The pool has been closed because of destructive parties.

There is a reason this property is still listing rental specials! No accountability from the property management. There are hidden fees once you move in that are not discussed. The parking is horrible! It is first come for anyone! Meaning, people that don't live here can park anywhere. Now they are taking away more parking by making them reserved for $100/month. No noise insulation. Drug deals going on in the parking lots at 8 am. They say there is security but I have never seen them, and they don't give out information to contact them. The water heaters are so small you get a 10 minute hot shower. So many other residents say they have complained multiple times for different reasons (noise, smoking, parking, etc) and nothing gets resolved.

Mixed community of  families, retirees, working professionals. Majority of residents are courteous and friendly. Opportunity to spend time with the community at resident events that happen 2/3 times a month.
Wow. What a wonderful experience settling into the Hazel. Cayden and the concierge team made everything easy. Sitting in the club area relaxing as I type this and feeling great.
My family and I have been living at the Hazel for almost 3 years. We love our neighbors and the community staff is great! The grounds are always clean and we always feel safe living here!
So far an amazing experience with super helpful staff on the concierge desk that are always ready to help provide guidance and show me the logistics of living in the building

Lovely property with great amenities including gym and saltwater swimming pool with a clubhouse you can hire for events. They have a great team including the property manager Kelli, estate manager Alex and concierge Nakia.

A great complex in a really good location. Restaurants, shops and a local community all thrive around Hazel Southpark.
Security and privacy are paramount but the work to connect neighbourhood community is excellent. We enjoy living here.

Love the community and the neighbors. The grounds are kept up well and the maintenance team is very prompt! We have lived at the Hazel for over 2 years and we feel safe and comfortable living at the property!

Moving into Hazel Southpark has been the most hassle-free move I have experienced yet. Staff, especially concierge, is so nice and super helpful. I feel safe living here which is really important to me as a woman, 10/10 recommend living here!

Beautiful apartments, clean, and friendly neighbors/staff. Community is active and staff is helpful. Living here is very nice and calming. Would definitely recommend this spot for anyone looking for a comfortable place to live in.

I recently moved into my new apartment here at hazel and the experience was incredibly smooth and easy. From the initial application process to the final walkthrough, everything was well-organized and efficient. 
Kelli and the team have been responsive and helpful, answering all my questions promptly. The apartment itself was clean and ready for move-in, with all necessary utilities already set up, which made the transition seamless. 

The building amenities are a great bonus. I appreciate the secure environment and the convenience of the location. Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better moving experience. Highly recommend Hazel!

Great staff. They are extremely helpful. The common areas are kept very clean. Very nice amenities. However, the garage area of the freight elevator needs to be cleaned as well as the freight elevator itself.

This is a lovely apartment complex in a good location with quite a good few restaurants / cafes and a small park in walking distance .
The majority of the community is very friendly and has some nice amenities including a communal club house and pool which make you feel like you’re in a resort. The leasing staff are exceptional as are the majority of the concierge staff.

I really like living here. Noise can be loud sometimes living near the mall nut the staff is absolutely amazing. So helpful and always there to answer questions or if I need help with something. I also want to give a shoutout to the Maintenace staff. I have never had an issue that is not resolved within the same day. I even had my fire detector need a battery change in the middle of the night and someone came and fixed it. That is the best of the best.
We have been living at the Hazel for over 2 years and we love the property. Kelli is wonderful and always so helpful. We are renewing for another year!
Quiet place to retreat for my family.  Very nice management and concierge staff.  We’re in the apartment 1-2 weeks every month and we’ve never run into any issues or noise

Hazel is in a really great location , the amenities are very good, I love the gym in particular. The team are very friendly and efficient. 

The only reason I am not giving it a full 5 stars is that the soundproofing is not that great from above and from the side. Nothing that can be done about that as it is structural.

Other than that I have really enjoyed my time here at Hazel!
I had a great experience the office staff are very welcoming and helpful made my move in day easy and seamless Tasha helped me with getting set up she is awesome

Great experience living here and I love that there are more resident events being put on. Great place to live and fairly quiet too - with the occasional train, but overall great place to live. Would renew if it wasn't so expensive unfortunately.

Overall satisfied. Maintenance and communication is solid. Would love to see more investment in the property itself. Lots of gates are damaged or broken. Dog area gates are in need of repair, gas in grills and fireplace maintained more often. Biggest suggestion is adding additional dog bins and trash cans throughout the property.  There should be dog bins near most major entry points. Currently only 3 for entire property and tend to overflow and be too far away from entrances making it more likely for people not to pick up behind their dogs.
The apartments are nice My first utility bill Make me smile The amenities will keep me Plenty of community engagement Three elevators Too Months free was the kicker
Great news place to live! Quiet and peaceful. I love how close it is to a lot of the place I like to travel to. The amenities of the buildings are great!
It’s a good experience so far I’ve only been here 2 days but the days the I have been here had been pretty pleasant I have a nice view of the pool
I love it here!! The assistant manager Ashley was very helpful with my tour and will be moving in shortly to the property.
The experience was quick and helpful! I love the new management.

There has been so much crime in this apartment complex. Last night cars were stolen and shot into. The apartment complex won’t install cameras anywhere on the property and take no responsibility for the resident’s safety. This is a transient area so there is crime almost daily. Find a better cheaper apartment. Management is by far the worst I’ve ever experienced. Very nasty people. Particularly Antonio, he lies to residents about everything and does NOT take any of our concerns or complaints with even the smallest amount of seriousness. Beware of him and this terrible apartment complex. It’s very dangerous to live here.

Many neighbors I’ve spoken to have previously (prior to last nights large scale criminal activity) had their cars stolen, broken into, or vandalized. Theres also been gunshots several times here. Like I said, they refuse to secure the place with cameras for our own safety. They seriously sweep everything under the rug.

They also delete reviews and it’s very obvious many of the reviews are fake. Just today I saw the amount of reviews drop from 67 to 64 and the rating went up from 4.2 to 4.3…. This place is such a creepy sketchy place… like other people have said.. Run, don’t walk

The apartments are nice but have gone downhill. Pet owners do not pick up after their pets, so there is a lot of animal waste on the property. No one uses the trashcans that are provided, so there's lots of trash bags just sitting outside of people's doors. No cameras in the mailroom, so your packages will/can be stolen. The staff changes here so often. Very thin walls and floors, so you hear your neighbors walking and talking. I've had to call the police because the office refused to deal with my neighbor who plays loud music and parties on weeknights. Overall, the apartments are overpriced and could use better management.

Best suggestion, Don't get a unit facing the main street, you will hear EVERYTHING!!! And I Mean It, Every car that drives by... Also probably best to just move in once the amenities (leasing office, pool,  gym) are done... Don't want to pay for amenities you can't use!
I like the community, everything is good inside ....

Broadstone Ayrsley has been a great place to live. The staff is helpful and responsive, and Madeline has been especially great to work with. The community itself is quiet but within walking distance to everything Ayrsley has to offer - I would highly recommend.
The apartment it's nice, maintenance responds quickly but we were never told about the heavy traffic and excessive noise of the trucks passing by 24/7. Can't sleep or rest well. Will not be renewing.

My husband and I absolutely love living here! Leasing office staff are professional and responsive and neighbors are polite and friendly. Maintenance team are excellent; they quickly respond to service requests, are respectful and pleasant, and do good work. The community is well kept by their hard work every day. We also enjoy the layout of the community for walks our dog. Lastly, we also appreciate the staff for regular social events for the residents. Great opportunity to meet neighbors and get out!
FInd somewhere else to live. There are plenty of new apartments in Charlotte

Broadstone Ayrsley has been a great experience from the very beginning. They have surpassed all expectations. I am thoroughly impressed with their professionalism and dedication to making this an easy transition for me. I will recommend them to everyone.

If you're considering living here, please reconsider. The prior negative comments are all true. In the last 7-8 years I've lived in 4 or 5 different apartments and this is by far the worst apartment I've lived in. Not because of the apartment itself, after all the maintenance team here is outstanding, it's everything else.
In the last year and a half, I've had at least 4 packages stolen from the mail room, not counting the several my roommate reported stolen as well. When I asked the employees in the front office how they're combating it, they responded with "We've talked to FedEx about it", which didn't answer anything. So, I pressed on and ask about the camera in the mail room, since I was going to file a report about my stolen package- again. I was then pleasantly informed that the camera in the mail room doesn't work but that the doors are locked. Unfortunately, for all of us living here, we know the mail room doors are never locked. And, her piece of helpful advice was this: "I'd consider buying a PO box somewhere else, that's what I do". And when I suggested getting cameras that worked, I received the same line about FedEx. Considering what we all pay to live here, I would think they could afford working cameras in the mail room.
The gun shots, car break ins, MURDER(s), lack of accountability or concern for the safety of their tenants, poor security, lack-luster outside maintenance (dog poop, everywhere), and Swat Team incidents are all true. The majority of those have happened during the last year that I've lived here. The employees in the front office simply care about collecting rent and hosting "community" events- despite not being able to protect their community or their community's mail. So little care for our safety, in fact, that after the last shooting they sent us a cheerful email listing "proper" ways for us to protect ourselves. Yet, we don't have cameras in our buildings or outside of them or anywhere on the property except the fake ones in the mail room.
And, mind you, I haven't even mentioned the lack of accountability that the employees in the front office take when it comes to handling issues between tenants. Specifically, in regards to, issues with quiet hours (Monday-Thursday) and allowing tenants to leave massive piles of trash in the hallways. if you report it to the office, they don't do anything for 2-3 days.

Roaches, elevator down for 4 days, packages stolen regularly, cars broken into, Security doors always broken, outside surrounding area not maintained. Carpet stained, Don't be fooled by the tour, you will break your lease. Do not move here.
clean and comfortable living spaces and amenities and GREAT HELPFUL STAFF

This apartment community is very new.  Only 2 years old the agent said who toured me around.
