They have not fixed my cousins heat for 6 months have a lot of proof as well incase any one wants to know cause I wouldn't let a worse enemy even live here !
This area is very clean And the office people are nice. The workers that work there leave the apartments looking good…

I have lived in the Ponderosa apartments for over two years. I like it because it is quiet, close to the highway and inexpensive. Whenever general maintenance needs to be done, Lori or Elizabeth get the right people out to fix it right away. They even have snacks in the front office for tenants. A weakness of mine. Ha, ha. I recommend this location especially if you are thinking about eventually owning your own home.

my only complaints are related to other residents not taking care of their pets, it's so sad that there is dog pee in the stairwells and people don't utilize the many bag stations and garbage containers all around. The staff is wonderful and I know this is not their fault.

We have had a wonderful experience living at The Silos! We appreciate the cleanliness of other residents when it comes to common areas, how clean the staff keeps the amenities, and the variety of amenities that are offered

In the past, and currently, I continue to recommend this apartment community to friends. I have had friends sign leases with Silos and others tour the facility. I believe Silos has a unique blend of community and location.
Every staff memeber has been fantastic. Everytime i go into the office for anything my expectations are exceeded. Everyone is soo helpful and nice.
The excellent responsiveness and quality of the maintenance staff here is one of the first things I mention to people when I talk about what I like about living here.
This apartment is great for everyday needs and a roof over your head. It is pretty outdated and things within the apartment should be updated.
I absolutely love it, most likely to renew my lease here
It is a pleasure living here. The apartments are gorgeous and spacious. The community is fine. I haven’t had no problems at all. ??

My experience was top-tier. I applied for Avana Avebury and was approved after being denied other places. I was homeless with my child and the office staff worked with me. My deposit was high, but I was giving time and resources to help make it happen. I haven't experienced any problems and am hopeful it stays as pleasant as the beginning.

This is my first apartment on my own, and it makes a pleasant first home! I love the layout of the apartments, and the amenities that are available. The community is overall friendly, quiet and clean!
The team at the leasing office at Avana Avebury is simply amazing!!

Not a safe community like was advertised. Needs to have gates locked. They need more maintenance crew members hired. Maintenance team seems clearly over worked and things don’t get done fast. This will also help with inspection of the units before move in. When moving into apartment all amenities such as; bathroom fans, dishwasher, washer and drier, ac, fridge, microwave and showers should be checked. There should also be a bug inspection or bug spray before moving in. First week we saw 3 cockroaches and had to put up cockroach traps. With not having the dishwasher fixed at all and not much of urgency along with multiple work orders and feeling uncomfortable walking in the community it has been hard to find this an enjoyable experience.

Been living here for more than a year. The apartment is nice and Plaza is an awesome location but there has been a lot of parking deck issues, false alarms, and there has been issues from the management side as well. Plus my rent has gone up 40 PERCENT over last year. There are a lot of options out there. I would look at others first.
You never get to sleep here because the fire alarms go off all the time. Within the last 2 months the entire building fire alarm has gone off at lease 4/5 times.

I love love my little unit. Cute place and the few months I’ve lived here I’ve loved it. Loved the staff. Maintenance all that but the cleanliness/halls need major work. I thought it was just my little area so I went to the top floor and the bottom and almost even worse. Broken glass, bags not in bins sitting on the floor from Friday to Sunday. The stench can be horrible. Extremely embarrassing when family came to visit awhile back and they commented how nice my place was but the stench was bad in the halls. Please enforce trash bags. If it’s Friday people just leave trash and food outside til Sunday.

Was looking for a place to live in with my partner in plaza midwood. Came across what I thought would be the perfect fit. Unfortunately my experience with the leasing consultant was horrible. No follow ups, poor communication, etc. Basically had to chase them down to get information out of them. Apparently their customer service is known to be bad from some tenants I know that already live there too.

I fell in love with this place as soon as I was greeted by the staff! They are extremely friendly and gracious hosts! I moved in about 3 months ago and enjoy all the area has to offer, 2 grocery stores, over 25 retailers, and several bars and restaurants! You will not be disappointed in this complex!! love it!

I am 100% in love with this place. First, I had an awesome tour and every time I chat with the staff they remember me (shoutout to Jaime in the office). Also they do a bunch of fun events for us, which is really fun. Everyone says they do that, but it doesn't always happen. I order online like constantly and all my stuff gets delivered to these lockers that I can reach all the time. My apartment has a view of the BEST pool you'll ever see at an apartment community -- there are colored lights in the pool its gorgeous - and there's a ton of seating around it. But I think my favorite is the gym, which is huge and open 24/7 and you can watch youtube on it or select spin classes. Lovelovelove!  

And literally the best neighborhood - way too many good restaurants within 1 block, if I didn't have the gym I'd die. I seriously think Plaza Midwood is a thousand times more walkable than the other places I've lived (fourth ward, south end etc). 

MOVE HERE

This is a really nice community that’s be pushed to the side over the years and just needed a little more love. -The Community manager Chris l believe, is super respectful and goes the extra mile for the residents here. It’s so good to see the changes that are happening and consistent faces in the office!!!
Horrible horrible horrible!!!! If you're looking for peaceful this is not the place for you!!!
terrible security has herion addicts living there, pay way too much for such crappy service

First off I’d like to say if you need somewhere and don’t have anywhere to sleep, sleep in your car. DO NOT come here, the longer I’ve been here the more problems there are. Rooms are cheap is THE ONLY benefit, MAINTENACE IS SLOW, OFFICE PEOPLE ARE SLOW, everything is slow. Always a new excuse as to why something doesn’t work or isn’t available. FYI POOL HAS BEEN OPENED FOR A TOTAL OR 1.5MONTHS IN THE 2 SUMMERS IVE BEEN HERE

The maintenance staff here is the slowest I’ve ever seen, and I’m not sure if it’s due to their own laziness or incompetence, or if the main office is horribly unorganized. My brother lives at these apartments and put on a request two weeks ago to fix some floorboards that are popping up (because the apartment is horribly made,) that are literally causing people to trip. No word from them. Then, he files a request to get his garbage disposal fixed because it’s SMOKING when you go to use it and now smells foul. Still no appearance from maintenance. The pool is not open, it’s the middle of July and the office won’t reimburse residents for paying for an amenity that right now doesn’t exist. They’ve told my brother multiple times that the pool would be ready in a week or so; it doesn’t even have a liner! This place is a scummy property, an absolute joke, and has the worst staff I’ve ever seen of any complex. If you’re looking for affordable rent, look elsewhere you will find it!!!!

They have cons and some pros. 
Their pool water is horrible. It looks as though it has never been cleaned. Its plain disgusting to even think about getting in. The scenic view of it is very nice. It looks newly renovated, however, the water is still very dirty. 
Do NOT accept an apartment near the pond where they have a picnic area. Everyone who visits the picnic, parks infront of that building, and you will end up parking up by the office or behind the building. Which is inconvenient, especially when you have bags to carry. 
Renovations are poorly done. The model they show you looks nothing like what they end up giving you.Their porches are practically falling apart. Instead of getting new grout in molded areas of the shower, they put caulk over the mold which will eventually come through the caulking. They dont repair water damages, they just paint over the water stains. When you put work orders in, even if you dont give authorization for them to come in your home without you present, they come in anyways. I got up one morning and ran into a pest control man in my bathroom. 
There is duck poop everywhere ! You cant sit or walk on a piece of grass or sidewalk without stepping on some. 
The community is very tranquil. All the neighbors are friendly and it is always very quiet. They have laundry rooms onsite, although its normally packed because of the high demand . One bedrooms dont have w/d connections. They have a nice new gym although its pretty small and around 4 people in there most of the time. There is pretty much everything close by, gas station, bank, pharmacy, etc. oh and maintaince is pretty prompt at coming to your home to fix things. Although like I said they come in when not authorized and I hope you dont get a water leak because you will probably have to live with it. Good place for single people . Wouldnt reccomend it for families seeing as though they dont have any kind of recreation for children or pets.

Do you ever sit, and ponder, what oh what could the people around you be doing? Well this is the perfect apartment for you, especially if you have the joy of moving into anything on the 4th floor or below. Why you ask? Well let me tell you... imagine everyday you get to sit and contemplate the actions of your upstairs neighbors for not moments, but hours on end. Dumping and sorting of nuts and bolts all afternoon? Check. Cosplay Spider-Man antics? Check.  At home version of whack-a-mole? Check.  Re-enactments of Jurassic Park. Oh boy CHECK! Don’t worry, they’re here to entertain… no tv, sound machine, ear plugs, headphones or music will allow you to escape. Around 10pm until about 2am is when these glorious specimens really amplify the volume as they develop their skills as backup dancers for Russian Hopak right above your bedroom to ensure your quiet time doesn’t grow too intrusive. The best part.. you can feel these activities like a Disney ride.. the pounding straight to your chest, the vibrations through your furniture, the shaking of your artwork and get ready to watch your water tremble. I can only imagine patrons of Action Park has this much fun.  I mean, sleep is for the weak after all.

What else does the Calvert offer? As you enter you’ll realize the official scent is ganja, handicap parking is meant for luxury vehicles owners who are now financially handicap not those with actual placards and handicaps, and if you have pets who have to relieve themselves outside, just let them poop on your balcony and then sweep it off onto the sidewalk and apartment below.  

What’s better is they’re aware, the neighbors, the building, the management. It has been 4 months and you have yet to lease our old apartment, thank you for validating our claims... though you diligently feigned ignorance at our 25+ noise complaints/videos/recordings/and physical proof (though you couldn't admit to that on paper, because how would you swindle another property management company into buying this atrocity in the future) So please if some hapless tenant decides to take on this ride of doom, please do disclose the lack of quiet enjoyment they will have so long as your value systems stands in its current order.

If you think you can master this living space like a glorious blue barracuda battling the final rounds in Legends Of The Hidden Temple, brava, step right up.
Me and my girl came to check this place out and I can’t get over this place. This apartment building really sets the standard on what an apartment should be.

This was the worst apartment I have ever lived in.  We broke our lease after 3 months of dealing with unresolved noise disturbances from our upstairs neighbors.  There are some structural issues with the building causing rooms and walls to shake from any impact to the floors above and below.

The Calvert has been the best apartment building I have lived in to date. My apartment is beautiful! The bathrooms are so uniquely designed, unlike any other apartment I’ve seen in the area. The staff really care about the well being of each resident. David, Brandon and Marcus work so hard to keep the property clean and new and Chandler and Samantha always keep the residents happy and the property running. I appreciate you all! Location can’t be beat- right next to the Greenway and minutes from South End/Uptown. The common areas are stunning, free coffee, quiet office spaces, great gym and fun events. Love my neighbors too! 10/10 recommend
Beautiful new property tucked away in its own little nook. I love the modern look they went with for this property, it fits my personal style so I was immediately drawn to this place.

I truly do enjoy living at the Calvert!! It is so new and bright! Going on my 5th month of living here and haven’t had any problems. Makes me happy to have a home to go back to that is safe and comfortable!! :)
Love how quiet and peaceful it is here! It’s an older complex and probably could use some updates, but the space in the apartments are great and you cannot beat the location.
Everything at uptown gardens is nice but the gym sucks and the machines are always out of order. It’s would be a 10/10 living experience if the gym actually worked
I like this place. It is very nice. I like the pool. It was very very nice. I left the office staff. They are very very very nice. I don't like the workout area. It is not that good.
The convience of living uptown has been a blessing in many ways. The community has been great through out the two years that we have lived here.
Everyone I’ve dealt with so far has been AMAZING! Great complex, great location! Very close to all the necessities, I could not be any happier

We have enjoyed everything so far! It’s a pretty quiet neighborhood and the neighbors are very friendly. The pool is a nice amenity , but wish the gym would be more functional (cardio equipment not working). Other than that, we’ve enjoyed everything!
The office staff is amazing and very friendly! As well as the neighborhood is good and always maintained. I would definitely recommend living here

This neighborhood is so conveniently located with so many entertainment options close by. Travel is easy with 77 so close by and you also have the light rail within 2 blocks. Finding great restaurants is never hard from this location either.

Looking to live here? Go ahead and save yourself the misery and sign elsewhere. My lease just ended and I can easily say this is the WORST place I have ever rented from.

They regularly do not answer the phone during business hours and take about a week to respond to any email, if they even respond at all. Submit a maintenance request? They’ll either leave it on hold for months or just go ahead and complete it without actually fixing it. When you ask why it hasn’t been completed, they will make up some excuse… that is if they even respond at all.

Don’t bother getting your hopes up about receiving your deposit back within a timely manner. I have emailed, left voicemails, and even Instagram DMed them and I still have yet to hear back from someone about my deposit. My friend finally got hers back after 5 MONTHS of consistently calling the office just for the check to BOUNCE. Absolutely unbelievable.

The parking is an absolute nightmare. The spots in the lot are so tiny that people regularly have to park in two spaces to make their car fit. This then causes for even less spaces to be available. The spots are so narrow that there have been a few occasions where I have had to get out of my car through my passenger seat. I used to park on the street until my car, along with multiple other residents’ cars, got broken into. Oh but you can get your own parking space?! It’s only an extra $600 a year to be 3 inches closer to the building and it’s still not gated. What a steal!

The trash area deserves its own paragraph as well. It is CONSTANTLY overflowing. One time it piled up to the tippy top for a month and when my roommate called the front desk and said it’s been out of control for a month now, all the girl in the office said was “well it’s actually just been 3 weeks”. Her mom ended up calling the city and they determined it unsafe and told the office they had 48 hours to clear it out or they would be fined. Of course the area was then cleared out immediately.

As for security, there is none. At the bare minimum, the building doors should be able to close all the way but that can’t even seem to happen. The complex consistently reeks of weed, your packages will go missing, and they rarely bother to clean the hallways. Toward the end of my lease, the quality of tenants also significantly went downhill as I started noticing drug deals happening left and right.

Positive- Location
Negative-Communication with Apartment Complex (Don't return phone calls, they will tell you one thing verbally and if you don't have it in writing they don't honor it) - Emergency Work Orders (had a work order that was on the list of emergencies - can't get into apt because of the deadbolt suddenly malfunctioned and was told it's not an emergency and to pay for it out of pocket and we will see about refunding you) - Parking (Super tight parking, good luck finding one after work hours, Unless you pay for covered parking or park in the handicap like others do for free because it's not enforced)  - Policies ( seems to be there to protect them not the tenet, No Smoking Building and complained that the neighbor is smoking weed and it smells like they are smoking it in my apartment and on entire floor hallway, and was told nothing we can do you have to call the Police) - Noise level (Thin walls and doors and some neighbors don't understand that they are thin) - Common area clean (They don't clean the common area frequently, had dirty diapers left in the hallway for over a week, dogs hair all over, leaked fluids from garbage bags all over)
The leasing staff is friendly and helpful and the property is clean and well maintained. Maintenance responds promptly. The technicians are knowledgeable and respects my property.
Great staff, great location, and great value. I wont live anywhere else until I buy a home.
About to move-in and the process has been so EASY so far. The office staff is so friendly and helpful!
Nice professional office staff, helped with all my questions. They are always occupied and have waiting list most of the time so that says a lot, people must like it there.
Very professional the staff is amazing manager amazing luv the place very clean
The place changes management like seasons the root issues never get fixed when you call the office they hardly ever pick up.
Management staff does an excellent job with staying updated on any issues as well as doing all they can to get future tenants in an apartment. Very professional and caring .

This place is the absolute worse. First of all, whoever did the plumbing and sealing did not know what they were doing and did a terrible job. Many of our pipes are sticking out of the wall. When we first got here, there were bugs everywhere and the outside of the buildings were filthy. No one answers the phone in leasing office so it’s hard to get in contact with them to discuss issues about our apartment. We live right near the dumpster and are having to pay a $20 monthly fee for valet trash even though we don’t use it. They recently disabled the e check option on our resident portal so we have to pay close to a $40 card fee just to get our rent paid. If you wash clothes, you have to pay $2 to wash and $2 to dry and some of the machines are out of order. So basically, we are paying more than what this trash dump is worth. DO NOT STAY HERE!

I called up to rent a one bedroom apartment. I was informed that the application and processing fee would be $50. However, I was charged $250 in the name of application and administrative fee. I never got my holding money of $200 back. 

Charging me $50 for application and processing was fine, but I wasn't expecting to lose $200. Especially, when I never even signed the lease. I'd have loved to be a part of this community, but unfortunately no one followed up with me - neither via phone calls nor emails and I was running out of time. So, I went on to rent with someone else.

I'd have to admit that there was a sheer lack of clear communication. What I was told over the phone didn't match with what ended up happening.

The lesson learned is, don't fall for their false promises over the phone. It's all white lies. I've lost money just once, but certainly trust is lost forever.

Avoid this building.  There are constant maintenance issues both  in unit and common areas (eg elevators constantly down).  I have not had proper heat all winter.  Mgmt tells me its because I have a big apartment and alot of windows -not sure what that has to do with the cold air coming out of my vents when the heat it on.  I was also told to turn my heat up to 78/80 and mgmt would cover my increased utility costs which turned out not to be true as they are only covering some of the cost increase despite following their guidance.  I was also told by the 2nd half of january I would have my heater replaced as it was not right for the size of my apt.  Now they have changed their story and have no timeline for this whatsover.  I also still dont have hot water in my master shower.  My balcony was damaged in the hurricane and since sept have been trying to get it fixed. I was told by mgmt it was ok that my apartment isnt comfortable since its big (what??).  I was told to close all the blinds (what??) - how does that make hot air come out of the vents?  Mgmt  has confrimed my bedrooms are freezing but are now making excuses and reneging on their promises.  I am aware of many other issues in the building as well.  All I want is heat and hot water and mgmt to cover what they said they would cover - is that too much to ask.  Apparently is is.  save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere

First, amenities.  The golf sim is a complete joke.  It seems to be original equiment and technology from when the building was opened in 2010.  Worst simulator in the city, no doubt.  Can barely see the screen due to crappy old projector.  And worse, the equipment gives very few readings/stats and fails to read 50% of your hits.  To call this an amenity (and advertise it as such) is a joke.  All simulators in Charlotte -- at big box stores, people's homes, businesses that do indoor golf sims, etc. are far superior to this crap.

Second, the elevators are constantly broken.  I shouldn't need to explain more for a 50-story building.  Big problem.

Third, every year we are guaranteed to have a water problem.  Hot water?  Sorry, you don't get any for a few days.  No reduction in your rent.  No alternative for you to take a shower.  Just too bad.  No hot water for all of you.

Fourth, on a frequent basis, like the elevator issues, the building (and your unit) will smell like a dumpster/trash.  It's awesome.

Fifth, the idiots built this thing in 2010, but didn't build vents for the dryer.  So it's a ventless dryer that takes 20 years to dry your small load of clothes.  Ventless dryers are for 100-year old buildings.  But we have them here!

Sixth, there are two many people smoking weed in this building.  It smells terrible on the elevators and certain floors.  Not so luxury.

Seventh, the pool is always dirty as hell.  Very infrequently cleaned.  If you have a balcony on the pool side, you'll see all the dirt and grime at the bottom of the pool.  If you get close to the pool, you will see a terrible layer of grime floating on top and not want to touch the water.  Too bad, b/c it's a big pool and it would be nice for it to look like a high-end luxury apartment pool instead of a dirty mess.

The good:  the concierge staff and the ability to have packages delivered and secured until you can retrieve them.

I have never given a one star rating before for anything.. i have visited my boyfriend kody christensen since he has lived here for about 7 months. Every week that i have visited, about 12 weekends in total, the heat and air conditioning has never been functioning properly. 

He has showed me all the interactions that he has had with the Vue and it seems they are negligent about properly fixing the issue. And yesterday we noticed the couch that he spent a large sum of money on was being stained by rust particles being discharged by the vents (he has even put in a maintenance request before about the vents discharging a large amount of dirty air). 

Please do not live here. The concierge’s are nice and all, but if you get unlucky and get a problematic apartment, you will have a very stressful life and sleepless nights of sleeping in a freezing cold or scorching hot apartment depending on the time of year.

Maybe it's nice to live here, but their leasing department is utterly incompetent, so I'll never really know. Don't waste your time with them. They're opportunists. Tried to upsell me on a pricier unit (EVEN THOUGH IT HAD A WORSE VIEW) after they yanked an apartment I'd already applied for and paid deposits for off the market over the people currently living there rescinding their notice to vacate. Every other complex I've ever dealt with won't allow that after someone's PAID MONEY to reserve a unit. It's a waste of time to engage with these people, so don't bother. Plenty of better, newer places uptown that WON'T waste your time.

I love the vue! Theres so many things to do. I swim all the time and hang out on the balcony which is nice because of the pandemic. Employees are great and I never have problems with them. When I had questions Mark answered them and helped me make my mind up.

We were concerned about the Covid fears this year, but The VUE and their management company (Northwood Ravin) really stepped up to make us feel resort-level comfortable. They literally CREATED two new gyms so that everyone could more easily and safely enter one-at-a-time under a reservation-only system (one of them is a "virtual" gym with Smart equipment machines). Resident events have not only been creative amidst the restrictions, but the VUE also has the most outdoor space of anywhere in Uptown, so our outdoor events (with plenty of masks present) have been very comfortable and fun! The leasing staff has kept professionally too: Gina, Lauren, Mark, Briana, they've helped us feel more at ease any time we have an issue. Thanks, VUE team!

So I will start with the positive.  I like diversity.  We have it here.  Kids, older folks, different ethnic backgrounds.  The people that live here are nice, very nice.  Love all the pets and love having kids running around.  Size of the apartments are very good.  Really good location.  Okay with the pricing but of course there is all the after add ons that nickel and dime you.  My apartment was pretty clean but I did rinse the floor before I moved in.  Cleaning staff never rinse floors enough of soap.  I have not noticed any bug issues but it’s only April.  So we shall see.  
Now, the negative, which is very easy to change.  Staff in office, hit or miss.  The one that checked me in was less than warm and acted like she hates her job.  When I toured I got the impression that here would be more community get togethers, there really isn't and no one checks the friggin app. I don't know how they get away with saying there are granite counters, many do not have that nor updated cabinets or bathrooms.  Now the kitchens and baths that are not updated aren’t horrible but they aren’t that great either.   Luckily most seem to have updated the flooring so there is only carpet in the bedrooms.  There seems to be no insulation in the roof/crawl space area because the second floor apartments get cold.  Yes they come with washers and dryers but they really are bottom of the barrel but better than going to a laundry matt.  I had to put in a repair request and they showed up promptly the next day but I asked for them to call me first and that did not happen.  I want to know when someone is coming that I need for repairs not just show up.  They even acknowledge that they had indeed read my request for a phone call to set up a good time.  The parking company they use is rude. RUDE.  RUDE.  RUDE and unhelpful.  Luckily when I had a problem with the parking company a helpful staff member for the office was working that day.  My wall neighbors I do not hear but the folks below me I hear. A lot but luckily they are quiet at night.  So sound proofing is medium I guess.  I would recommend this complex and I foresee myself staying a few years.

The absolute worst apartment complex I have stayed at in 10 years. They have placed yellow tow boots onto residents' cars weekly. During the time when you sign your lease it states for you to give your license plate and make/model of car. however, the front office noted "it states in your lease we can change policies at any time." So now even if your vehicle is listed on the lease, they can still boot your car. 
I have never in my life dealt with a more incompetent group of people. It's as if they act like protecting their own residents does not matter.

This is the worst apartment complex experience I’ve ever had. Avoid it.

I’ve placed numerous maintenance requests both through the app and via the voicemail line for the same issue beginning in January 2022. Just a simple set of blinds that need to be replaced. And they still haven’t been replaced as of November 2022. When it was time to renew my lease - it went up very significantly. The lease rate listed online is far less than what you’ll pay whenever you renew. They are doing anything they can to nickel and dime residents. The “renovations” they’re doing are cheaply done. There are much better places to stay for what they’re charging for rent here.

Such a great place to live, very clean the area is amazing for my kids. Everything is close to this apartment, shopping center is just across the street great restaurants so happy and blessed to live in this complex very friendly people the school is a #1 in the area of Charlotte just amazing love it here...
The Blakeney neighborhood is the best place to live in Charlotte NC with great schools and community events. The property is beautiful.

This apartment complex is wonderful. It's in a great location and the apartment staff does everything they can to keep you happy. If anything is broken it is fixed the day you report it or the next day. The grounds are beautiful and I couldn't ask for more. I love where I live.

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review: Roach infested, huge rent increases, moldy units!!!!!!!

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review:
Muy buena atención de parte de el personal 
Muy calificado

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review: Nice apartment homes for the price and Location!!!

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review: Good place to live and I feel comfortable Being here

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review: I moved in about 4 months ago and everything has been amazing so far. The apartment is so spacious. The area is very quiet & my neighbors are friendly. There is always parking. The neighborhood is a clean community. Don’t let looks deceive you, this complex is great. Staff and maintenance are super nice and want to help you in anyway they can!

apartmentName: The Edge at Noda Apartments and Townhomes
review: I honestly don’t know why people wouldn’t rate this community higher. I’ve lived here a year as a single female I’ve never felt uncomfortable or my safety was at risk ever. The apartment alone is huge! The office staff is amazing and the community is safe. Although the outside and location I’m sure would have anyone skeptical but believe me this place is awesome! I was super close to noda and uptown (I loved) the apaprtment itself is clean also, never had issues with bugs, or anything. I did tell them they should upgrade appliances and I was told after the feedback they have been receiving they are in the works of making those accommodations. Courtney is awesome I recommend this place to everyone.

I have recently renewed my lease and this apartment complex thinking the next year might be pretty good, but it’s starting out horrible. My first year of staying here I’ve rarely to never called Maintenance for any issue now that I have renewed my lease. I am running into major problems, such as my shower, not being correctly functional and also master bedroom blinds, not being correctly functional either. For the first two days, Maintenance tried to fix my shower after those two days he let me know he will not be able to fix it and he will have to get a plumber in here, three business days have passed, five days in all. I haven’t received any communication whatsoever from the leasing office or from the maintenance team even though before he left, he said he would keep in touch mind you there are plenty of same-day plumbers. So I personally went up to the office to see what was going on and let them know that I felt neglected because not even the easiest issue has been fixed yet. I am forced to continue paying full price for a bathroom. I cannot 100% use.
At the propping them because I know the team 100% forgot about me. I am told another member of the Maintenance team has to come look at it before they actually call the plumbers.

The points I do not like are:
-NonCommunication

I have been a current resident for 7 years 3 month, and the people that been living here can said that it’s a nice and quiet place.
