Worst apartments to live at ever. People in the office are extremely rude. Roaches everywhere and the maintenance takes forever to fix something. I've only lived here for a few months and I'm trying to get out of my lease now. DO NOT MOVE HERE. It's cheap for a reason and not worth the hassle.

Current resident here! We have loved living here, we just hit our 1 year mark and released! The area is nice and has many restaurants so we’re never really stuck with the whole “what’s for dinner” question. Things were nice and the staff was nice (Julie and Pablo) until we met a staff member by the name of Alex. Personally, we feel that he is not friendly towards us for whatever reason but everyone has different experiences. Recently, there has been nobody in the leasing office so we haven’t been able to reach anyone for any issues. If there has been someone, they haven’t been there during the posted hours. Nor have they notified us of closing early as they’re supposed to do. There is a roach infestation in the courtyard that we live right off of on the 2nd floor. We can’t open our back door without them trying to run in. It’s horrid. I’m a huge clean freak and we pay monthly for pest control so we never thought we would come across this issue but here we are. Hopefully someone can see this since we can never seem to reach anybody in office. Thanks!

The location of the Langston is great and my actual apartment is fine but they don't have the latest features like key fob entry and Nest thermostats, most places do in this price range. I have lived here for 6 months and my 2 biggest complaints are the maintenance of the building and the mail. The lobby and office area are gorgeous, but if you look at any other floor in the building the floors always look dirty and the areas around the elevators are most often dirty as well. No one ever wipes down walls near the elevators and light bulbs go months without being replaced. The common areas always look run down and dirty, this includes stairwells as well.
Mail is managed horribly. Mail room is too small and there is zero consistency on how UPS and FED EX are delivered, so you are constantly tracking down your packages.

Overall, the complex needs a more experienced management team or the current team needs to put more effort into maintaining all of the common areas. Honestly, with so many places available in this price range I wouldn't recommend this one.

I have lived here  pretty much since it opened and the management has switched more times than years it's been open.  The new management seems nice enough but some things just don't change. The hallways always have the faint smell of garbage because they make you use valet trash, so the hall is filled with trash overnight.  It's pretty hard to get rid of the smell even when the garbage is gone because there is no ventilation/circulation. The carpets are stained because of this and look raggedy.  The elevator lobbies on each of the floors are gross, the walls are stained terribly.  It needs cleaned and/or repainted terribly. You have nothing to do while waiting for the elevator then to look at the gross walls. I walked by vomit in the parking garage last night and it's still there today. And car break ins are super common as there isn't secure or gated parking.  The side door was broken into the building for weeks and management didn't seem to care. The area is great though with lots to talk to and the residents are nice.

I absolutely love the location! Situated in the heart of Elizabeth amid great restaurants, The Langston is ideal for professionals who enjoy dining out and relaxing with friends after a long day. Residents will soon be able to enjoy the convenience of having the trolley less than two blocks away when Phase 2 construction is complete. The staff here are friendly and always willing to go the extra mile to accommodate. I've only lived here for less than a month and they already know me by name. If you're considering moving to the area, I highly recommend scheduling a tour.

This place looks great and is a wonderful location so I got a lease and moved in at the beginning of this month. Literally every single interaction since paying my application fee is unprofessional and terrible.  First of all they changed managers before I moved in and the person that I signed the lease with left without giving me the appropriate paperwork to complete my move-in. The manager currently on property was completely unprofessional and rude to me because I did not have the correct information on move-in day. The first two weeks in the Apartment I discover that my fridge doesn’t work and after multiple maintenance requests that are close without being completed no one from the management here or the corporate managers a run this place will communicate with me about when this will be resolved. I dread anything else going wrong because I do not have faith that anyone here is competent enough to do anything right. Avoid this place at all cost.

Latreekia and Team are so people centered. I feel very welc Ned when I come to the office to pick up packages. I feel like they have this communities best interest and also the residents. I have lived in other properties and none as easy going and understanding as this one. Thank you guys for bringing back service into the property management industry.
Car was stolen from this property and had to be totalled. Not a safe complex at all. Find somewhere else.

Everything is already off to a not so great start. The office doesn’t do a great job of informing new tenants of their process. It seems like they’re just out to get your money. It would have been nice to know that there is a 3 day bank account verification process that needs to take place before you would be able to make a payment. Then they administer a late fee, although the verification process is something that’s on their end.

Do not move here. They are roach infested ! Their are coach roaches in my bedroom bathroom and small roaches in my kitchen. the tenant before me  was disgusting and they did not properly treat the apartment and now I am dealing with the after math.

There are an influx of bugs on the lower level in building especially the units close to the woods. There are jumping spiders, daddy long legs, earwigs, grasshoppers, and millipedes, all of these are IN the apartment. In addition, you can here every movement from the upstairs neighbors, so if they have children, it is truly a nightmare. "VALET" trash is not really valet. We take our own garbage to the dumpster that does not work the majority of the time so there is trash sitting on the side of it, not to mention the lack of spacing for visitors parking close to your complex. For the amount of rent that is being charged, it is not worth it.
Alexander village is a very clean and welcoming apartment complex havent had a bad experience at all while living here!

Alexander Village is not just an attractive community: once you move in, you feel at home. beautiful landscaping, excellent amenities, comfortable apartments, a safe community: these are all the best features of a highly recommendable place to call home.
Nice apartment complex. Pretty quiet area with great amenities.

Alexander Village is a wonderful place to stay. The location is very convenient, as I can quickly access I-85 within around 2 to 3  minutes. The community is absolutely beautiful and the maintenance team ensures the grounds are kept clean. This makes for a wonderful walk around the neighborhood. The leasing staff are always friendly and quickly respond to requests. The area I stay does not have too loud neighbors and overall I have enjoyed my stay here. It should be noted that there are a few noise issues if you are sensitive to sounds like I am. Sometimes neighbors do slam their doors due to the hinges on the doors. You also may be able to hear your neighbor walk under you if they are heavy footed, (as I stay on the 3rd floor but can hear my neighbor walk under me.) The pond area is beautiful but during spring, summer and fall their are frogs in the pond that are extremely loud. But again, no community is perfect, but I have truly enjoyed residing at Alexander Village and would recommend it to others. Inside the  apartment is also truly beautiful as well.
Alexander village staff and manager are really good and we are living here from past close to 3 years and we are happy here.
Great place to live, awesome location and clean. Friendly staff, attentive to calls and emails.

This complex seems to be in the middle of nowhere in relation to other complexes in the city but it is in fact perfectly situated. Close to a Walmart, multiple grocery stores, pharmacies, fast food options and within 10 minutes of I-77, I-85 and I-485, Alta Grove is a place to check out when looking for an apartment in the Mountain Island/Northwest Charlotte area. The office staff are attentive and the maintenance staff works quickly. I have had very few issues since moving in and all were resolved very quickly.

We have lived here for almost 3 years now. First 2 years we stayed in a 1 bedroom, then we added a new member to the family and needed a 2 bedroom. Brittany was amazing with switching us over without any hassle! She is always so amazing!! Chris is also the best with maintenance! He’s helped with jumping my car in the dead heat of summer. And even came out last night with an ac unit for the window since ours unfortunately went out! Chris and Brittany are the best! 10/10 would recommend to anyone!

10/10, highly recommend! Brittany and Chris have been such a pleasure since I moved in. I had my first maintenance request today. They worked with my schedule and Chris was in/out with all issues solved within 10 minutes. Thank you.

When I moved in had about 5 maintenance requests of things I wasn’t even sure if they’d address! Chris has gone above and beyond getting to all work orders in a timely manner, fixing something I hadn’t submitted a work order for yet because he noticed it was broken, and solved problems without a “band aid” fix. Very impressed and thankful

It is a place to live but don't expect much sleep as the is constant noise from bass music and construction workers 24/7. In the short time I have live in a freshly renovated apartment they have had to replace the dishwasher, the light fixture, the furnace didn't work for most of the summer, all the burners on the stove don't work. The "new" floor is cracking and has spilt in multiple spots. The pool is always closed as well.
I will be living at Summit on Central for a year now in just a few months and it's been great. They have been nothing but kind, helpful,. and prompt on maintenance requests as rare as they are. 5/5

The staff at Summit are extraordinary. They go above and beyond to make sure residents feel welcome and appreciated. Sarah has been in the office since I have moved in here, she has been super helpful and friendly since day one. Brandi is super helpful and always has a smile to greet you. Leo is always a pleasure to run into around the complex, he is so helpful and works very quickly if anything needs to be fixed. 

Great place to live!

The staff at Soho are wonderful; they know all of the residents by name, welcome visits, and handle complaints efficiently. This is one of the biggest assets because it makes it feel like a community! The apartments are spacious and renovated. The renovations make each apartment feel cozy and welcoming. 

The only reasons I gave the property a four is based on personal preference. None of the apartments have a private porch. Although this may seem like a minor thing, once I moved in, I realized how beneficial it would be to have this area. You are allowed to put chairs or rugs in the breezeway, but this doesn't feel as private. 
Additionally, the area around the complex isn't the most aesthetically pleasing. The property is conveniently located (only five minutes from Harris Teeter and Plaza Midwood) but the immediate area isn't the most well kept.

My girlfriend and I have lived here for almost a year now and it has really been wonderful. Whenever we have a problem the staff is very prompt to help. The ladies in the office always welcome you with a smile and some delicious Starbucks coffee.
Brandi at SoHo on Central is so friendly and personable!! The apartments are upgraded and affordable, even better... pet friendly!!! Also right down the street from Plaza Midwood!

The leasing staff went above and beyond to make my move in go as smoothly as possible, including holding on to multiple large packages that arrived before my lease even began.

They never grew impatient with me asking questions (and I asked ALOT) and were so warm and welcoming.

The location of the apartments is great. They are walking distance from some great restaurants and just a short drive to everything else. 

Over all I am very happy with my move!

My studio apartment is spacious, with pretty views of the community. I enjoy walking my dog around the community because the grounds are so well kept! SoHo is located in the perfect location, close to everything. The maintenance and leasing staff goes above and beyond to please myself and my neighbors/ other residents. I absolutely love living here at SoHo on Central!

Hi, we love our 2 bedroom apartment its very quite, very clean, great staff, is still under construction so we got a nice look around us. I like the environment here in our complex and the best of all is that is walking distance to everything.
We leased a 1 bedroom apartment and we got 1 month free, I love my apartment everything is new, pet friendly too.
I was scared to go to this apartments because of reviews, but was relieved to know that management had changed! Super friendly staff and theyre very helpful!

Where do I even begin with the problems I had to deal with...! We applied to live here July 1st. The leasing manager mentioned that they were doing new renovations on the interior/exterior of the apartments. Which at the time was very appealing, who wouldn't want to move into a brand new place! Well.... from the beginning I should have known that they had NO TIME LINE set for this. Which is ridiculous. We were told the end of July/ beginning of August. They mentioned they needed residents to be "flexible" (remember this key word they used, "flexible.") So my bf and I were on board with this. Come beginning of August we received NO call as to what the status was for moving in would be. But boy were they quick to want us to pay the application fees/admin fees. So we payed them and asked again what the status was, still nothing. We called every few days and kept getting the same answer "we aren't sure just yet..." "its going to be a few weeks longer, if you can just wait another few weeks.." "we will speak to the contractors and call you back with a new date." ..... we NEVER! EVER! got any calls back on this.. So that in itself really speaks on the staff of this complex. Lazy, and fully inconsiderate. I finally called back last week (mid August) in hopes of finally getting a date... we were told END of SEPTEMBER maybe first week of OCTOBER...excuse me? what?! That is CRAZY. --insert key work "flexible"-- I was informed that we were asked to be flexible.. Well where I come from flexible is not 3 months later. I don't appreciate a company taking advantage of me and my living situations so carelessly. It really shows a lot about what this company is about, and I am FULLY thankful that I am no longer looking to live here. If you can't even be honest and say "hey, we are unsure and the dates are being pushed out. I will speak with the contractors and try and get a date for you" I might have considered staying here. But they couldn't even call me back and let me know what was going on. Oh, they also would only give me back my admin fee of $150 and kept saying how the application fee was non refundable. Which I gave them $100 for... But they sure were quick to offer me off $300 on my first month rent..which the women did not even have a move in date for me. No, I don't really want $300 off, I would rather have all my money back. Had I known they were going to make me wait 3 months I wouldn't have even applied.

This apartment has the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I applied for an apartment in June and was told I could move in July 30th. Well come July 30th they delayed two weeks but still couldn't give us a move in date for sure. I call every week and they say they will contact me back but never do. They were wishy washy and kept saying "oh probably the end of august" "oh probably the end of august" I ended up talking to the renovation guy and he told me EXACTLY how long it was going to take. They ended up delaying us to September 20th but that still wasn't for sure. I was living on couches and homeless waiting. I couldnt do that and had to find something else. I bet they would have delayed us from July to October..... I applied in June. I got no apologies and no compensation offered for this either. They did not care about me as a customer. I cant imagine how they are with service if they LIE to their customers about what is really happening.
The kitchen looks terrific. Every area of the unit is great. My patio is perfect. Living in this unit is a delight.

I was impressed after my visit. The community is older however it is very well kept. 
The staff are all very kind and helpful. The ladies in the office are nice, Trinisha was helpful & knowledgeable during my visit. 
I am not looking to move until next year, but if this group of people are still here, I will for sure be back.

I have read many reviews on this property, Both good & bad. I was skeptical at 1st but I decieded to check them out for myself. I have lived her for a while now and I must say this most recent team of folks at The Harlowe are good people They are helpful, understanding and they know what they are doing. I think the new maintenance supervisor Starlin is maybe one of the best supervisors they have had here. And Trinisha has been a joy to work with as well. 
My advice, Check out this community for yourself. I am serious about where I lay my head and I feel this was a good move thus far. The improvements are definitley noticed. 

Thank you team Harlowe!

New manager is making a difference. Love the improvements to the exterior. Love that residents are being held accountable for following rules. Thank You to Ms. Mattison for caring. Harbor Group is making a difference here

I lived here for 1 year. The model unit is nothing like the actual units. We had 4 leaks, one of which caused us to leave the apartment for 5 days due to the mildew issues. The old manager worked to get issues resolved by prorating rent, but the new manager would not. The flooring laminate was terrible and they did not replace it until the last major flood. The only reason they repaired it was due to several apartments in my unit getting an issue. They have gone through several maintenance men all of which have not known how to fix issues. Do not move here.

This property is terrible. I lived there for 5 years and the complex had at lease 15 managers. We had regular water issues. I had 3 infants and my water was off for days at a time. Maintenance staff didn't know how to fix a toilet. Work orders were never completed. This place is a dump. I moved out and they left me with a $1,000 bill. Why? To fix that old 1970's apartment that had bad plumbing and dirty walls. Good luck if you move to this dump.

I am the newest resident here at Anker Haus and it has been nothing short of amazing for my first few days. As they prepare the property for the final look things are looking  great. 

Thank you to the management team for taking great care of me!!!! They are so nice and get things done very quickly. It’s beautiful here 

I would rate so far a 10!!!!!!!!!! 

Let’s be neighbors :))))))

I moved here back in February but since then they’ve gotten new management and they are very rude and not welcoming. They don’t take care of the property and our security gates have been broken for weeks now. They don’t answer their phone when you try to call the office and when you leave a message they never get back to you. If I would’ve known that this management company was taking over I never would’ve chose this place to call my home. Definitely not worth the money. Don’t bother moving here
Such a great location and looks like it is going to be a beautiful community! Can’t wait for them to open!

We have lived here for 3 years. We loved it at first- beautiful apartment and many amenities and community events. However, it seems like the staff focus more on events than maintaining the quality of living for residents. We have had problems with pests and mold that have not been addressed. Office staff is not responsive. The rent has increased $1000 in 3 years. It is not worth it.

Living at the Village at Commonwealth has been a disappointing and disgusting experience. 

1) Moved into a filthy unit. 
2) Had an extensive problem with cockroaches. 
3) Other physical issues with the unit were untreated or treated improperly, requiring that I initiate multiple follow-ups or implement DIY solutions. These included but were not limited to - multiple leaks and holes in cabinetry.
4) Was misled on lease conditions

The apartment complex decided to boot my car even though I live here and have a parking pass. I missed work because of this and had to pay $140 (no warning, just boot). The employee at the front desk, when I first moved in, lied to me and told me there's never issues with parking (there's always issues with parking fyi, look at the other reviews). The office manager hid behind her employee when I asked to schedule a meeting, and her employee told me I could not schedule one through her.

We had problems with roaches and gnats right when we moved in, it took six weeks of calling for the staff to follow up on our requests. There were big cracks in the walls and ceilings, they never followed up to confirm there weren't structural issues.  The NWR Cares number, they ask you to call for issues, is never answered, there’s no waiting on hold, you leave a message and they never got back to us. 

We needed to break our lease early, their "policy" is 3 month rent penalty and 60 days notice (5 month penalty).  If there's any chance you may need to terminate early, don't rent here.

This review is specifically for the wonderful Concierge Team! Aaron, Stanley, Anllelo and Evan are always so helpful! I’m probably the only resident they see just about every day when it comes to packages! Their service has made my life so much easier as I run an online side business that requires a lot of shipping and also personally prefer to order most necessities these days for myself. Every time I show up, I’m greeted with a smile! I feel spoiled to have this service and team available to me at the Village. ????

Living here last year with the previous management was a great experience. I loved this "luxury" complex at the time, despite the fact that when we moved in, it wasn't cleaned very well at all and there was a visible dip in the floor. There were some food stains on the kitchen cabinets, but it wasn't worth making a fuss about at the time. The place did have ROACHES, which I saw all over the building and inside the hallways. I called the office about it and they sent someone to spray the building but it had no effect. Because of this, I couldn't wait to move out. The dog park is awful for the price you pay here. Most apartment dog parks have turf for the dogs to run around, this one is straight up dirt. Only took my dog twice because I don't have time to bathe her everyday. Management changed somewhere along the way and they were awful to work with upon moving out. It baffles me why a place with a waitlist for their apartments would require a 60 day notification to move out, especially when the previous apartments that I have lived in in CLT only require a 30 day notice. Upon moving out, we weren't given our deposit back and were charged for things that did not apply to us, such as leaving things in the apartment. I know for a FACT I left nothing in the apartment because it was a very exhausting experience to make sure everything was out. We tried SEVERAL times to get in contact with a manager to dispute this and were told over and over again that the manager would call us back. That never happened. Ginette was utterly useless and I believe she intentionally ignored us. I ended up paying the fee just so I could be done with this trash apartment. All in all, the staff here lacks integrity and will take any dime they can from you. The place is dirty, unless you get a Phase II apartment, which is a recent build, but ridiculously expensive. I enjoyed walking to Plaza Midwood and all of the amenities that were offered, but it wasn't worth it. Until this place improves, there are better places to live in Charlotte.

I have lived at Doral apartments for almost two years and I will not be renewing my lease. Any maintenance request you have will not be addressed adequately. My dishwasher broke and was flooding my kitchen and I had to wait nearly two weeks until it was addressed. The price is not worth the hassle.

Doral is an incredible property. I’ve been living here 3 months now and absolutely love it. Every maitenance issue is fixed very quickly, the grounds are very clean, and there’s a beautiful park right behind the property. The rent is a great price compared to other places in the area. This is the place to be.

If you value location then move out here. But, the price isn’t worth it. These are not high end apartments/luxury apartments. There are waaaay better options around the area. Old pool. Apartments use to flood so water bugs are everywhere even in renovated apartments. The floors are uneven. Squeaky. The apartment is a nice size but once again the price isn’t worth it at all.

If possible I would rate this a 4.5, but if I had to choose it is a 5!

Doral Apartments may not have hardwood floors, stainless steel appliances, or a deluxe clubhouse, but you will not find a better apartment or community for such a great price! 

Doral has kept all the "must-haves" of an excellent apartment community:
- pet friendly living!
- great staff and maintenance crew
- roomy and well-kept cute apartments
- included dishwasher
- included individual apartment W/D
- on-site pool
- on-site enclosed area for dogs
- AFFORDABLE rent

Doral has cut the unnecessary fluff that other apartment complexes use to bump rent prices: exuberant kitchen appliances, high-end hardwood floors, flashy outdoor decorations, or a barely-used clubhouse.

While they have used their natural features and location to enhance the living experience at no cost to renters:
- located next to a huge field, great for running, biking, and playing
- through the field is a lovely neighborhood park, equipped with two playgrounds, a covered picnic area and grill, an outdoor ping-pong area, and a Frisbee golf set-up
- only a walk to the Elizabeth and Plaza Midwood neighborhoods and a short drive to Uptown.

The community at Doral is wonderful and we feel very lucky to have found this complex!

[Been living at Doral 7/2014 - Present]

Doral Apartments live up to their commitment.  Clean, well maintained apartments that comes with excellent services.  Not far from from Central Ave., and Uptown with great restaurants and taverns for all foodies.  Not far from a Park which is great for children and pets. Also close enough to enjoy the nightlife of the Uptown, but retains its family community atmosphere.They keep the pool area for family fun, and we even have a pavilion for private gatherings.  Doral Apartments also tries to keep the community active with events throughout the year. I love Doral Apartments because I am only four minutes from work.

I've lived here for years, left twice just to keep coming back because the Doral is so awesome. The neighbors, management, you can have large dogs, great staff, respond quickly to maintenance issues, great location & price.  It's not upscale or glamourous but it sure is a great place to live with nicely remodled apartments, well maintained grounds and each unit has a washer & dryer.

Doral Apartments is a great place to live. I've lived here for four years and feel safe day or night for someone my age. They have a great staff. And last but very important is the fact that Doral is very Dog Friendly. I love that about them.

Safe? Yes!
Affordable? I have 3 beds 2 baths all under 850
Location?  Look, uptown! 
Decor? Management really makes things look nice before you move in. No crud left from previous tenants. 
Management?  Great! They really care about you and take care of things fast

Overall? A great place!

Apartment searching is not exactly the most fun thing to do. I would know, my husband and I spent two full days, back in June 2013, all over the city of Charlotte trying to find an apartment. We searched and searched and just when we thought we were going to have to settle on a complex that we weren't too keen on, we found a listing for Doral Apartments. The funniest thing about Doral is that we had driven past it at least twice in our two day search, and didn't even notice it...hence "Hidden Gem." The complex is set back off the main road, which is lovely, it is a quite community with super friendly neighbors. The pool, pavilion and dog park are fabulous features. There is a sweet park behind the complex, great to take a walk to as well. Even though you're only a five minute drive to Uptown, it is quiet and has lots of greenery. What drew us to the complex: PET friendly! That's a big deal, because some places look at you like you have two heads if you have two pets! We are so happy to have such features as a gorgeous brick wall, a spacious balcony (or patio for downstairs apartments), washer, dryer and dishwasher are all included and without an extra fee! There are people of all age groups here, young couples, older folks, families with children. Often you'll see a group of kids, varying in age all playing together and riding their bikes, it reminds me of being in a neighborhood, and well, it is! I try to encourage all my friends who are looking for a new place to check out Doral, and some have already joined us in the complex! It is a very inviting and affordable place to live!

For the past two years, my wife and I have lived at Doral Apartments nearby the Chantilly and Elizabeth neighborhoods of Charlotte. When we saw that it was one of the highest rated apartments in Charlotte, it piqued our interest. The first thing that blew my mind was the price for the location. We currently pay $845 per month (utilities included) for a three bedroom apartment that is less than 5 minutes away from Uptown, with more than ample space in all three bedrooms (for instance, one of the rooms serves as both my office and my music studio). When you realize that most two bedroom apartments in Charlotte cost more than that, let alone are located in far off or unsafe areas, you realize how valuable this place is to a renting Charlottean. That's not all... the staff has some of the nicest and most down to earth individuals I've ever met. Claire and Danielle, the office managers, are very professional, have great attitudes, and they plan plenty of events and games for the community. Jason and Aristotle, the resident maintenance guys, are very friendly and give me household tips for fixing things almost every time they come over. And our neighbors are super awesome! One of my neighbors hooked me up with a great deal on a set of speakers and a receiver (actually, he tried to give them to me but I insisted on buying them). I often go biking with one of my other neighbors (he flips bikes as a hobby). While there are many great places to live in Charlotte, clearly THIS one tops the list and it is a reason why I have and will continue to recommend this place to friends.

Doral apartments are a great place for any first time renter or people focused on location. I moved there looking for both and have loved it. I am a teacher living on my own and the rent does not make me go broke. They renovated the apartments so they looked nice upon my arrival. I love the location near great bars and close to several grocery stores. There appear to be an equal amount of new renters as well as people who have families. I've lived here 2 years now and must say I've lived each moment.

I have lived in many places in the last, say 50 years.  Many apartments in the mix, but the Doral is the best.  Large apartments, with great floor plans.  A great mix of people, good service from the staff.  All in a great area of a growing city.  Very pedestrian friendly, great shopping close by, not to mention the restaurant and entertainment venues equally as close.  Whether you are a young person, newly weds, family or an empty nester the Doral Apartments are a great match.  Hope to meet you as a new neighbor soon !!
I have live in doral  apt. for about 11 years  My community is the best ever.

I live in the Doral Apartments in Charlotte, NC. They used to be notorious for being flooded after a heavy downpour. However, since the city of Charlotte purchased part of the Doral apartments as well as the Cavalier apartments things have changed. The city of Charlotte is planning to create a park and green way in that location which will enhance the area even more.
The staff at the Doral apartments is excellent - whenever I have an issue such as the washing machine being broken, Jason the maintenance manager will fix the problem asap. I also like the fact that we have very diverse residents from many different countries - I am from Germany myself!
I've been living here for more than a year and literally cannot find a better apartment for this price, even though I've changed jobs and now have a much longer commute. I've been spoiled!

We moved in 2021 and wish I would have never moved here. The carpet in the halls are never cleaned, they are filthy, the halls stink from all the dogs, and the tenants are extremely loud. No need to complain because they will not  do anything to help with any issues. If you go to them they look at you like your bothering them.The machines in the fitness center have been broken since I been here.The staff changes constantly and is uninterested in trying to solve any problems you may have.

This property gets 1 star for location but it’s down hill after that.
It’s filthy here. The stairwell always has trash, residents don’t clean up after pets and there is an abandoned car in the parking deck that is covered in dirt!
The loud music is insane. It literally sounds like thunder and absolutely nothing has been done about it.
I can’t wait until my lease is up.

Absolutely love the Lowrie! They are constantly adding new amenities that go above and beyond previously added perks. From Wine Wednesday to additional other holiday or resident focused get-togethers they are always going above and beyond as a staff. Incredibly friendly and helpful group that is dedicated to making the residents stay here as awesome as possible. I love everything about the Lowrie!

The Apts at Sage are very nice, all size units provide adequate closet space, large bathrooms and bedrooms..the Clubhouse is built within the complex and is a main attraction because one can easily leave the apt. and enjoy the beautifully furnished clubhouse and enjoy the view of the courtyard pool and deck area year round.The Sage complex is a part of the well kept Highland Creek neighborhood..Although I find the living here to be quite enjoyable, no place is perfect and some of the issues  of concern are trash removal , mail/ package delivery issues and sensitivity to resident concerns could be better.

This property is more then I expected. The staff is so accommodating and welcoming. The grounds are maintained and beautiful, it is a safe and quiet community with many activities and facilities available for use. They have done a wonderful and effective job maintaining safety during our current pandemic. I could not have made a better choice.

I toured the property and worked with Patrekia and she was so awesome!! From the moment I walked in everyone was welcoming and warm! You have to appreciate great service and attention to detail! Thank you Patrekia and I look forward to making The Preserve home!

Mi esposo y yo estamos muy pero muy contentos con nuestro primer hogar, cuando empezamos nuestra relación y decidimos mudarnos juntos, en muchos lugares no nos daban noticias prometedoras, hasta que llegamos a Preserve At Steele Creek, nos abrieron sus puertas permitiendonos disfrutar de cada una de sus instalaciones, con la mejor acogida y amabilidad, ha sido una experiencia maravillosa. Las personas de la oficina, las personas de mantenimiento  siempre dispuestos a poder ayudarnos con cualquier situación que se presente. Estamos agradecidos, ademas es una zona buena de muchos puntos referentes, farmacias, outlet, tiendas, escuelas, parada de bus, etc. El paisaje los árboles la conexión con la naturaleza son únicas, un buen lugar para vivir aquí en Charlotte. Alan y Nicolle

I Been at this Complex for 3 years and it’s been a great place that I can call home. It’s comfortable and the neighbors are nice. After a long Day at work it feels good to come home and be in my sanctuary. Management been awesome Kim and Amy when it’s been stressful times they been there for me and that means a lot. So if your looking for a Beautiful place to live Come to Preserve at Steele Creek. Asia :)

I moved in just a couple months ago and I can say I haven’t had any issues with this place. It’s so comfortable and friendly. Any concerns I have are resolved that same day . Definitely a place to call home!
The maintenance staff work very hard for us all. They are respectful and responsive.

This community was flexible with their criteria to allow my family and I to move in and was efficient and effective with getting our home ready for us! I will be forever grateful. Great location, staff and amenities!  AWESOME, AWESOME, AWESOME.

If I could leave 0 stars I would this place is horrible they tow ur car unlawfully. Vehicles get broken into. Management is disrespectful and rude. Nichole verbally told me they could “careless about me being a disabled veteran that anit got nun to do with her” after they unlawfully towed my vehicle, worst place to live go take your hard earned money somewhere else. Hate it here can’t wait to leave.

So I have been a resident for over a year now and this has by far been one of the best experiences I’ve had living within this community! The amenities are nice, valet trash is reliable and the office team is great! Thanks to Ms. Nichole for always insuring that my leasing office visits are welcoming and supportive! Would highly recommend.

Horrible complex! We just moved here in August 2024. In September 2024, my car was broken into. We contacted the leasing office and their response was "there is nothing we can do." We asked if they could get nighttime security or security cameras to prevent this in the future, but they refused. On today (November 2024), I get up to go to work and my car was gone. It had been towed because the tow company "couldn't see" my handicap sticker due to the tint in my window being too dark. I am now forced to pay $370 to get it out. I am so fed up with this complex. Trash is always overflown, the complex constantly reeks of dog poop, and the walls are so thin you can hear what your neighbor is watching on tv. If I could give 0 stars I would.
Like you, we were drawn in by the price and location, but you'll quickly learn that it's not at all what it seems to be.

From the application process to the move-in day was fast and super smooth.  Nicole the property manager was a absolute pleasure to work with. She answered all of our questions in a timely manner and got us move in very swiftly. Our apartment is spacious, closets are huge and the community is very clean.  Thank you Nicole for helping my family call Cyan our new home!!!

The apartment complex is poorly built. You will hear noise above you and beside you from neighbors word for word. Music is being played extremely after hours. People do not pick up when they walk there pets and also do not use dog leash. Weed is being smoke around the apartments and inside apartments. The weed scent travels into apartments. Valet trash pickup is not being picked up daily and it being charged to be pick up on the lease agreement. People are parking on grounds over 4 days without parking permits. No parking available hardly ever. Do not waste your time coming here seriously.

Cyan Mallard Creek is one of the worst places to live in the Mallard Creek Area. The residents constantly leave trash on the property in areas other than the designated compactors and trash receptacles. The leasing staff is unprofessional with communications and often confusing. The leasing staff provides very short notice in changes that affect residents in instrumental ways. Relocating to this complex from out of state has been one of the worst experiences.

WATERTON IS THE WORST MANAGEMENT COMPANY I HAVE EVER DEALT WITH AND DO NOT CARE ABOUT THEIR RESIDENTS AT ALL. DO NOT MOVE HERE if you plan on living here. I would rate this place a 0 if I could. You will be paying luxury apartment prices to live in apartments that are less kept up than the apartments that are in the ghetto. You are not protected and your word and experiences mean nothing to them!

Absolutely wonderful people that work at this particular complex! From maintenance to the office! Wondefully accommodating.  Pool area is stunning and comfortable; great location in NoDa.  Community units are a bit old and very much converted warehouse living.
Cool relaxing place to call home, and close to everything I need. I would buy my unit if they would let me.
This place is not only beautiful,  it's quiet, clean, and the staff is so nice and very quick to respond and handle any issues immediately.

Love these apartments! They have truly given me a great experience as I live in a gorgeous studio and it still feels homey. HML does feel like a standard apartment complex it feels like a community. Love it here!
Highland Mill Lofts gives you that industrial and stylish living space, and the staff is very accommodating. I love it here!
Ive been here for a very long time for a reason. Great place, perfect location!
The best company and value for price I’ve found in CLT.

Tricia, Al’Alai and Sheldon made moving in a breeze. The community is super friendly and the location is awesome with easy parking. We’re at the pool or grill almost daily and it never feels crowded. We plan on staying here for quite a while.

If I could give this complex a zero, I would. I was so excited about this apartment, I loved the industrial feel and how open it felt. But that ended up being the only positive of living there. On more than five occasions, I complained to management regarding issues with a neighbor and the dog they left alone in the apartment for hours, barking. The walls were paper thin and I could hear everything happening. Nothing was ever done and I finally contacted the regional rep to complain. After some discussion, it was determined I would be released from my lease and would only have to pay a prorated rate for the 6 days I was residing within the apartment. I was to be given a final statement and pay within the portal. This was never received, and I was told management had turned over in the time the lease had been canceled and instead of following up with me or sending me a bill, what I "owed" was sent to collections. I've called on over (9) occasions to rectify the situation, and I've never received ANY help or clear cut answers as to why my prorated bill was never sent to me directly or why I cannot pay the Mills directly. SEVEN MONTHS LATER and I've received a major derogatory mark on my credit score, with the amount owed being an entire months rent (which is incorrect) and still NO movement from management about how the situation can be rectified. Management here has never been receptive to complaints, nor can they be trusted with early lease terminations. Steer far clear of the Mills, there are far better communities in the area that have more receptive management and will make sure you feel safe in your home.

I wanted to give one star so badly. The only thing keeping me from that is that it delivers on the promise of an apartment with cool style in a trendy part of town. It's walkable to plenty of cool restaurants. Those are the only positive notes I can give. 

The layout of the unit makes no sense. Whoever designed it forgot added a bathroom as an afterthought. I am not a large person and I barely fit in the shower. The kitchen is a similar story... It's not actually an area, just the back wall of the front room. 

The build quality is hilariously bad - at least it would be if I were capable of laughing after being woken up in the middle of the night, after stubbing my toe on one of the giant cracks in the concrete floor, or fumbling through the dark to reset the breaker because the wiring in the closet shorts when you turn the light off, or when the wind blows the front door open because it actually does not latch. 

The apartment itself is dirty - none of the walls extend to the ceiling inside the apartment, so the bathroom is actually a little pod with a roof over it. You cant get up there to clean so it's filthy. The cracks in the floor are impossible to clean. There's a French fry jammed in one of ours that's been there since before we moved in. Disgusting. 

The neighborhood isn't great. You'll be catcalled by the construction crews that practically live there and I wouldn't recommend leaving your bike outside - mine was stolen from the bike rack just 10 meters from the leasing office. They had nothing to say besides "oh I'm so sorry that happened to you."

Don't even get me started on the leasing office. They only fix problems that don't exist like putting locks on communal areas that no one used except to take your trash to the dumpster or pick up (already locked up) packages. So now you have to try and type in a code while balancing your trash 

The final straw just happened today when they said they'd start enforcing parking. "Finally" I thought. But they only let us know when we walked into the leasing office to pick up our parking passes that it would be one car per bedroom. If we so desired we could purchase a second pass for only $50 a month! This is the last straw. If we could leave today we would - plenty of others have. We've had 3 neighbors in the 9 months we lived here.

If the only thing you want is an apartment in NoDa with a cool style in an renovated historic mill... Actually still don't choose this one, it's not even the only one here.
Great place to live! Staff and maintenance are very helpful and the resident events are always creative and fun.

This is a great apartment complex right in the heart of Historic North Davidson (NoDa). Having been an old mill converted to quant and personable apartments, it's more than a home, it is a community. Neighbors are all friendly and the management staff top notch. They treat all residents and guests with dignity and respect, remembering most everyone by their names. 

But things don't just stop there. The apartment complex is nestled just past the heart of Noda right next to Heist Brewery. Less than a mile walk down the street you are in the heart of NoDa, rife with nightlife, eateries, art galleries and the ever popular neighborhood theater. A short drive the other direction and you are at the 24 hour Amelie's Bakery and several other great shops. 

It's a heavenly place to live and one would be completely at want to find a boring night. There's simply no better place in the Charlotte area to live than Highland Mills.

Great staff and excellent location in NODA. Loft apartments in a historic building/ very satisfied. Maintenance is taken care of very quickly although I have not had that many problems. The community will be close to the light rail line which will be great and make getting uptown easy.

I have lived at Highland Mill for 3  years and I love it here. They cater to their residents as needed. They always fix or replace anything that needs maintenance. You also couldn't ask for a more unique apt. Awesome brick walls and concrete floors. There is a dog park located on site and pet stations everywhere around the complex. The staff is great. They welcome you with open arms every time you come into the office. I don't see myself leaving anytime soon!
Excellent place to live. Great vibe and the staff have been amazing.

I have only been here two months and so far it’s super noisy. There is No noise ordinance set in place so If you like peace and quiet for, the most part,  you won’t get that over here! The appliances The apartment is nice to look at but not for the Price! My cabinets and used appliances are so sloppily installed they are already coming off the hinges.DID I SAY NO W/D Hookup. The ancient Sliding patio doors are annoying because they are metal and make a loud sound when opening and closing them. Yes you can hear your neighbors door open too! Oh, and the “Laundry Unit” has washers and dryers with NO HEAT. I would highly not recommend

Property is crumbling. Constantly under new management. I've been in my apartment almost 4 years and the management people are super lazy. Nothing gets fixed even after numerous maintenance requests. Crime is up as well

I wou l d give it 0 stars if I could.
This is an older property that h at has not been maintained. 
I've lived in my apartment for 10 years and management has had 6 different management companies. 
Over the past 4 years my half bath has ceased to work has has yet to be fixed despite numerous requests. I've been told since I have one working toilet that they won't fix it.
One week ago the kitchen sinks and dishwasher back up with water o to my floor. They sent a plumber who said that he had to get permission to fix it. Someone from met came Thursday to tell us not to use our kitchen sinks or dishwasher.  That's the last time we saw or heard from them. 
After calling for emergency help 4 hours ago,  I've not heard from them since.

At first the complex was decent. After approximately 9 months of no issues - had a rat problem for the last 3 months of my lease. Then my apartment got broken into - which the complex did not and probably still has yet to notify its residents of. I’m not a dirty individual after speaking with the pest control found out what apartment they were actually coming from. However leasing office stated Bc I had only a month left on my lease they would not move me despite weekly seeing a rat in my apartment. I was a victim of someone stalking me and because of that had my apartment broken into. The only thing the apartment complex did was put a gold plate over the door and change the locks. Did not provide additional locks stated if I wanted them I would have to put them in myself. I felt completely unsafe living here and the apartment complex has a rat/pest issue. One star is appropriate.

They don’t follow the leasing contract, hangs lots of stupid stuff in the door.
I renewed my contract in March 18 for a year but at the middle of the year they send the letter of changes!

I applied at this complex and everything seemed fine.  I gave them the fees, two pay stubs and offer letter I was asked for.  They told me that everything was in order and I would hear back later that day or at the latest the next day.  Three days later I was called and told I needed to submit a third pay stub because I get paid bi-weekly, which I was not told about because my pay period was never discussed.  When I requested to get refunded my admin fee because of this mistake I was denied and the leasing staff refused to admit any mistakes or miscommunication on their end.

The apartments look nice, the neighborhood has certainly changed incredibly! Maria was incredible in answering all my questions that I had about the unit that was available. The only thing is that they did not have a unit to show for what I wanted to move in to. She did show pictures and tried to explain all the differences between the model that they have to show and the unit that I wanted. Certainly looking forward to my move !
Good Maintenance and quick response. Very friendly
Our living experience at this property was good.  We felt safe and the staff was very good at handling our needs.

I regret renting here. The apartment is okay but at move in floors were dirty, fridge didn’t work (I had to throw all my food away after 2 days to get it fixed), and I’m not sure the carpet was steam cleaned. If it was, there are stains that remain and carpet looks worn. You can definitely hear all the neighbors. The Olympics happen every night between 7pm-9pm at the apartment above me. Trash smell and spills outside the front door.

I am utterly dismayed by the complete lack of security in this community. My car was stolen right under the nose of supposed security measures, leaving me in absolute shock and frustration. Despite the promises of a safe environment, I found myself a victim of crime within these premises.

The incident has not only caused immense inconvenience but also shattered my trust in the security measures advertised here. The response from the community management has been slow and unhelpful, leaving me feeling completely unsupported during this difficult time.

I strongly advise anyone considering this community to think twice about their safety and the safety of their belongings. It's deeply disappointing that I have to experience such a violation of my personal property within a place that should provide a sense of security and peace.

I lived at Ascent at Mallard Creek for 16 months 9/2019 - 2/2021. Although the staff is mostly pleasant to work with and the ground are adequately maintained, be aware of the following:

1. Hard to get a staff member on the phone, if you have a need you’ll need to physically go to the office.
2. Some neighbors have dogs that bark literally all day, so if you work from home, have headphones.
3. If your are a late sleeper, good luck. Some neighbors (particularly one Mustang) have loud cars that they start up early and rev the engine continuously as to assure all are awake.
4. MOST IMPORTANT, makes sure to thoroughly clean your apartment before you move out, seriously DEEP CLEAN. I was charged several unjustified fees upon leaving, specifically a cleaning fee. Mind you nothing was out of the ordinary. Also don’t use the stove top, if you scratch it, they’ll charge you, so I hope you like microwaveable food.

I am a current resident at the Ascent Mallard Creek. In just two short weeks I am looking forward to moving out.  My issues with this complex over the last year haven’t been extreme, but there are definitely areas for improvement. The office staff is usually friendly, but they lack consistency and responsiveness when addressing tenant concerns. 
When there are issues that arise (ex. consistent leak in bathroom ceiling, broken garage door, answers to simple questions, etc) you often have to call several times, go by the leasing office and/or email to follow to get answers or additional information.  The apartments are new, and look good. However, you can hear your neighbors clearly and there is limited parking.  As I plan my move, I wish that I had a better experience living here and just wanted to share my experience as it may help someone else that is hoping to move into a place with responsive office staff and quality features.

If youre new to the area, dont do it!
If you want a timely response, dont expect to get it from the leasing office. Extremely high turnover of staff who are not responsive unless you stay on top of them. Need to go into the leasing office to drop off a cashier's check or get an update, dont expect anyone to be there to give you a response/proper notice. You will receive an email DAILY TO BE REMINDED that Tryon Farms is a smoke free policy and if policy is violated your lease could be terminated, with no further actions actually done!  If you want to experience the pool at the top of pool season, dont expect for it to be opened until June or later. What i actually loved about my unit is all of the natural light and my balcony. No consistent programming or reoccuring community events to create a good living environment. The best "event" that happened was  food truck- "drums vs flats" on a Friday night! That was the most active i saw the residents out and about. Nacho Business was the next food truck partnership, but never happened after it was supposed to be rescheduled. In short, DONT DO IT!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Being our first apartment in Charlotte, Tryon Farms is a very clean, affordable and nicely updated community. The pet amenities along with the numerous pet waste stations around the community and a dog park is a major plus for the fur babies. Lastly the valet trash service thats available is very convenient after a long day. We enjoy the quiet tranquility of the community!
This is a great community and a great place to live I like it so far.

Since Bell Partners management took over, crime has significantly reduced (car break-ins, gun/drug crimes) at Tryon Farms. Thank you x1000, it finally feels like a safe place to live. Management is responsive and helpful.
Lived here for about a month and my overall experience is great. The leasing office is great and are on top of the property.

The apartments are beautiful and in a desirable area, close to shops and highway accessible. It’s a shame that bad residents have ruined the community. Would honestly love to see Tryon Farms cleaned up.
Nice apartment and amenities. Nice and responsive staff.
Tryon Farms has been a very nice place to live over the past year. Location is great along with the management and the rates. Highly recommend this community!

Tryon Farms is a great community to live in. Great staff, the apartment homes are beautiful and modern, and the amenities are great. Tryon farms made my relocation here easy, stress free and for all that comes with it, you’ll probably won’t find at the same price as Tryon farms.

After 3 months of living here, I can say this is the best place I have ever lived. Staff is extremely friendly and responsive to any questions I have had. Grounds are clean, plentiful parking, excellent living space for the price. 10/10

This apartment was nice in the beginning but now people are having illegal parties in the clubhouse so now the clubhouse has dirt all over the floors and alcohol in the trash cans. The police is called here often now due to a lot of commotion. If management don’t crack down on getting rid of the trouble makers, this once beautiful place is going to go down hill tremendously.

I wouldn’t recommend tryon farms to anyone! Police are called here very often, drug dealing happening on premises. Cars getting broken into about a month ago 15 cars got broken into. The whole neighborhood smells like weed at night. Poor management they never answer the phones and when I clearly pass by they are in the office sitting down. Dog poop all over the grass people don’t seem to pick it up. Neighbors partying all night. I don’t want to say names but management is very poor. Also trash is always backed up no one seems to care about that. Also one of my neighbors moved out  and they let her out of her lease with no penalty but when I complained about the same issues because I have a 3 year old I was told I might as well suck it up and stay. My apartment at night when I walk in it smells like weed I can smell it thru the vents in my apartment and I don’t want my child smelling that he already has issues with his allergies. Just on a serious note I would not recommend this place to anyone!! It looks nice thru the outside because they are brand new but it’s not what it always seems this place is horrible!!!!!
I dont love it here. There is a lot of suspicious activity and not much help from the front office when concerns are expressed.

I moved into Tryon Farms in June. When I came to tour the NEW complex Carrin was AMAZING at giving me a tour and giving me very specific numbers and details before moving in. On my move in day the staff was very helpful with making this as seamless as possible and seamless it was. Very clean and quiet community, looks like the photos. Out of all the tours i had before moving to Charlotte Tryon was the most affordable for the amount of living space I received. I HIGHLY recommend touring and living here. It is 10 mins from Premium Outlets, 24 mins from Uptown Charlotte and about 4-6mins from tons of shops and eateries.

I have one star because the apartments themselves are beautiful. However as a current resident I must say the office staff is rude. There have been numerous times I have come into the leasing office without someone even greeting me.  Office staff personality is very dry. I also do not appreciate the all community emails they send out. They are very unprofessional and is like a mother speaking to a child with threats of “we will not hesitate to close the pool” and “do not be the one that makes the entire community suffer.” Yes, I agree in rules and regulations but whoever approves the emails that are sent to all residents needs a little more respect. We call this place home and would like to be treated as it is such not like we are children at a daycare waiting to be scalded for a couple bad residents. There are cameras by the pool area and gym area so if there is an issue speak directly with those residents rather than sending out an unprofessional email. For this to be a new complex as well none of the stairs have been stained and from the recent rain mildew has already started accumulating on the wood.

Horrible experience! Two appliances failed immediately after move in including fridge. Lost $200 in food and they won't reimburse us. Apathetic and unprofessional.  They couldn't care less. Dont rent here.
The people in the leasing office are GREAT they help me with everything I needed. They are very polite and you can see they care. I will update my review in 1 year. Thank-you Tryon Farms

I highly recommend anyone to come check this apartment complex out. They currently don’t have any pictures right now as it is still very brand new. But, LET ME TELL YOU, it is worth the drive to meet up with the leasing Manager, Carrin. She was so welcoming, so funny and so nice. She answered all of our questions and just made our tour so fun, easy and smooth. Their updated appliances and amenities are top notch! They will not disappoint! Their property manager, Alexandria is quick to respond to any questions/clarifications you may have - she is just as welcoming and so easy to talk to. Plus side to brand new apartments is HUGE SPECIALS!!! So I’d suggest you to come right now while it still last!!! You can’t beat their prices right now for the area that it’s at! It’s just down the street from Rivergate shopping centers! I’m so excited to move into my brand new apartment soon!
I lived at this facility for a year.   It's in a great location and the office staff were wonderful.    I had not issues and I would highly recommend.
Bad management.  Dirty.  Crime.   Overpriced.  Poor quality.  Weed and cigarette smoke all the time

The staff isn’t very helpful. They came to do a “customer service survey” which was really just a tactic to try to get us to sign a lease that was $300 a month more than our current price. We told them no thanks and listed a number of reasons we wouldn’t stay including a few maintenance issues we needed help with, they said they’d get maintenance out but maintenance never came. I submitted a ticket digitally and when maintenance got here he said he had no clue about all the other issues we told the lady from the front office about. The pool is also out of control. There are constantly people blasting music and there are children screaming all day long. There is also frequently people there blasting music past closing time as well, there was even an instance of someone hiring a DJ to play from the pool. If you want a quiet community I would definitely recommend not living here.

Greenway at Mallard Creek is a complete disgrace! I have emailed the manager, JP multiple times for various things and she never responds. I finally started going to the leasing office to ask my questions in person and the staff is rude and not helpful. JP even went as far as saying that she has not received my email, which in my opinion, is very unprofessional. Email’s don’t just go missing and if I had the wrong one it would bounce back to me and it never did. Even when bringing up concerns about my safety, the leasing office neglected to answer any of my emails and calls. Not only do they fail to respond to personal emails, but they do not send out community emails about current happenings or construction that is taking place. A few examples include, failure to communicate about pool closures, fire alarm tests, construction taking place outside of units, etc. You would think all of these things would be properly communicated but you don’t find out until it’s happening since the management team does not know how to communicate with its residents! The management team couldn’t even have the decency to inform me of my move out procedures. After ignoring my emails yet again, I went to ask them my questions in person and they refused to talk to me. It took me 5 trips to the office and by the 5th one, I sat and waited in the lobby for 30 minutes until someone would finally talk to me. My time living here under the Connor Group Management has truly been awful and I would never recommend this place to anyone! This place and the management team is a joke!

Before this new management took over, everything was great! Ever since they started here everything has gone down hill. It takes forever for any of our maintenance requests to come in. Our air conditioner broke right as summer started and they had to order a part for it and gave us a super old window unit that did not help one bit. We were stuck in 90 degree heat for over a month. They let us know the part came in, but never when they were going to fix the AC. We called over the span of another 3 weeks and were constantly told "Lindsey will call you today", which never happened. They lied and said only one person in Charlotte knows how to fix the AC and that's why it took so long to fix it. I'm pretty sure they just didn't want to hire anyone else. Now that the pool is open, the closing time for it is 9 pm. Yet, every single night that I have come home from work at 9:30 pm there are teenagers still in the pool talking and playing music as loud as they can till almost midnight. There also isn't any security anymore at night as far as I can tell, which explains why no one is getting kicked out of the pool past closing time and is honestly concerning to me. The place is nice other than the horrible management, but it's definitely not worth what we are paying for.

I am counting down the days til I can move out of this property! Ever since the new management took over, I have felt so disrespected due to their consistent negligence in communication. I have put in multiple requests for maintenance and they NEVER come. The few times I have gotten in contact with the management team, they have assured me that maintenance will come at the time of my request but that has never happened. When I reach out to follow up with the maintenance request, I get no response. Nobody responds to my emails or returns my calls. My apartment has a major bug issue due to poor structural foundation and they have neglected to fix any of the issues that I have stated. I do not recommend giving any of your money to this property group.

I came for my tour and I must say that Erika showed me a beautiful apartment but I was not sure it was going to be for me. Sandra came to let me know that are offering $800 off rent so I applied today! Another lady there even offered me something to drink and I think her name is Angela. They are super nice so I hope I get approved.

I haven’t even been here a year and its a nightmare.. I move in a apartment that wasn’t fully ready for move in.. they don’t answer the phone in the office and the maintenance team sucks… they take you as a joke cause they don’t have to live in these conditions… the trash in the hallways are terrible. They are easy to get in because all they care about is the money not the up kept of the property. I wish I could give 0 starts.. The conditions are sad

When I first moved here my experience was exceptional. Work orders were completed on time in a fast effective manner. The leasing office staff was easy to reach regarding tenant issues. The buildings were a lot cleaner in the breezeways. Now, since the transition it's so hard to get InTouch with the rental office staff. And even when you do, they are of no help to you and whatever problem you may have. They take forever to complete a simple work order/task. They never follow up with you or any issues with your unit. You literally have to just show up and even still they are no help. Don't Move here!!!!!

When I moved into this complex 5 years ago it was divine compared to where it is now. Although the complex, has always struggled with issues like power outages and bad cellphone service, there were many positives that made those issues seem less stressful at times. The maintenance team was quick, effective, and fun to be around. The front office staff was friendly too, very responsive, easily accessible, and flexible if need be. 5 years later, TRASH! The maintenance team is slow and barely know what they're doing. My dryer has been squeaking for months! I've put in at least 3 service tickets they came 2 of 3 times and said they'd need to replace the unit, after leaving they just closed the service ticket. I went to see an apartment and this place does not look anything like the pictures. It is completely run down.

constantly misspelling stuff so its natural that they "forget" a lot and dont actually fix anything they say they will fix. maintenance gets upset when u put in a maintenance request. not a dog friendly community (neighbors hate dogs, dog park constantly has poop everywhere and broken equipment, waste bags never refilled, etc). pest control never comes unless ur on a "schedule" which they take u off of anyway. u pay for it every month regardless. roaches everywhere. they dont care. also took forever to "find" the security deposit. i had recurring problems here bc they use the cheapest stuff to do "repairs". its not worth what u pay by far lol

Being new to the city and a woman living alone, I chose Tyvola Center Apartment Homes because they emphasized their security features. Unfortunately, that was not my experience. 

At least one of the security gates to access the property was almost always broken in the open position, which is probably a major reason why management was frequently sending out emails warning about car thefts, mailbox break-ins, and drug use on property. 

The stairwells and parking lots were always the darkest, scariest places for me, especially at night. The most chilling moment was the night I came down the stairs at 4 am with my dog for an emergency potty break and was startled by a man in a dark hoodie hiding under the stairs. My dog lunged at him and he took off, but I hate to think if my dog hadn’t been with me. (They do accept all shapes and sizes of dogs, which I appreciate.)

You would think that Management would put measures in place to protect their tenants, especially in light of so many security failures.  Instead, I received an email from management telling me, in effect, that if I’d like to park in a well-lit spot, close to my building, I would have to start paying rent on a safe parking space. I moved out.

If you are a woman living alone and concerned about your personal safety, Tyvola Center Apartment Homes is, in my opinion, absolutely the last place you will ever feel secure.

These are all the issues this apartment needs to address to be more competitive: 
Outdated fridge, outdated washer/dryer, very small kitchen sink, old/stained carpet in bedroom, cracks in window foundations (dirt and bugs get in all the time), small bathroom sink and counter, small/outdated toilet, poor shower water pressure, outdated shower head and drain (clogs a lot), and cockroaches get in frequently.

You can find better value elsewhere for the same or slightly higher rent.

The floor plan for the 1 bedroom is quite nice and open. I get lots of compliments when people come to visit. The grounds are well maintained (although too many residents leave dog waste around). Maintenance requests are handled promptly and well, and the staff does a great job of communicating with the community.

The garbage situation is inadequate. The compactor is regularly overflowing, and the cardboard recycling bin is routinely inaccessible due to an overflow of boxes. The smaller recycling bins are likewise almost always full and it's difficult to find one to deposit into.

The gate situation: I chose this community over some others because of the extra security that comes with a gated entrance. Unfortunately, the gates are wide open about 25 - 40% of the time. Even when they're operational, it is IMPOSSIBLE to prevent cars from piggy-backing through (I have tried), rendering the whole point of gates utterly useless.

I lived at this complex for 2.5 years, and have seen the good, the bad, and the ugly. While I adored my quaint apartment, the top-notch maintenance staff, and the friendships I built during my time there, the leasing staff became increasingly difficult to work with. Upon my move out, I had several questions to ensure I would not be charged additional fees. The staff did not seem to think my questions were important and delayed in answering me. It was upsetting that even though I had spent so much money and time in this complex they did not treat me as a valued resident.

The apartment unit itself I love. I love the floor plan, and the grounds are kept up very well. Full-size washer and dryer in unit is big plus. Management staff seems to care about the tenants. My friends and family are impressed with my apartment. 

But the HUGE negative of this place is the garbage situation. Tyvola Centre has 403 apartments spread out among 17 buildings. There is ONE dumpster for the entire complex! It is located in the middle, and personally I have to take my garbage in the car because it is too far to walk. The dumpster is almost always overflowing, and it is woefully inadequate for a complex of this size. I am truly amazed of this setup! There is also a recycling center which is equally inadequate for a complex this size. Sadly, I feel compelled to throw my recyclables out with the rest of my household trash. 

If it wasn't for the garbage situation, this property would be 5 stars.

This place is awesome. I have lived here for a few years, and the office and maintenance staff are stellar. The location is perfect for traveling out of town for work. The landscaping is stellar, and you can tell the staff takes a lot of pride in the place. I wouldn't want to live anywhere else!

The best apartment that I lived in Charlotte. Unbelievable service. Jamie & Ashley always help when asked.
I like this apartment , it is close to walmart, Costo and other shopping center. 1 min walkable to CATs bus stop.

I reached out to the office asking them to release us from our lease, or for more money off the rent as our unit now rents for even less than we currently pay.  No response.  After a month I reached out to Willow Bridge (the new owners) and they ignored most of my questions to say that they will not release us from our lease and will not give us more off our rent.

Nothing was received for losing all my windows and when I asked about a storage unit for my balcony furniture they offered a pathetic discount. My houseplants are all withering away from the windows being covered. My washing machine sucks and breaks if I try to wash a full-size comforter and I was told that it was "oversized" and that I need to take it to a laundry mat. Overall, if you're considering moving here, save yourself the trouble and just don't do it.

Very clean complex!

Most recent frustration: friend arrived late on Memorial Day night and parked in front of my building as there were no open guest spaces but plenty of regular spaces and he had a lot of luggage. When we went out in the morning, his car had been towed. It was towed at 5:26 am.
