Love the new look of the community and the responsiveness to all residents !!!

I moved to The Addison a week ago. Megan & Sabrina were both very responsive and eager to assist (especially via email). Megan is the amazing, as well as the gentleman that I believe is a manager. They are both very knowledgeable, helpful, and friendly. Megan gave me a breakdown of everything and ensured that she explained everything thoroughly. There weren't any available studios to view at the time, so she sent me a video and she committed to contacting me when one became available to show. On the video alone, I decided to apply on a Saturday and was informed that I was approved on Monday (talk about swift!). She stuck to her word though and showed me a unit, and I was very impressed!  We emailed a number of times on different occasions before I moved in (I committed to this property 2.5 months before moving in) and each time Megan and the rest of the staff were very humble, dedicated, and personable.  There were even renovations and a "facelift" done from when I first inquired lol. I would encourage prospective tenants to move here because the apartments are conveniently located, and thus far everything has been fun, safe, and rewarding. There are seasonal/holiday gatherings (I was invited to participate in the National Puppy Day event), snacks when you enter the office (even puppy treats), and a very clean facility! This is an amazing community for a young professional. Thank you, Addison Staff!

Moved in 3 months ago to Addison. Lauren was freaking amazing answer all my question was quick to respond to my emails before moving in. Which was super helpful as I travel a lot for work and was not always able to call. On the day of move in everything went quickly and smoothly no issues. They made sure everything was perfect on move in. It was great to do the move in walk thought for any issues with the head of maintenance.  As with all apartments have thin walls. For me being on the first floor I almost never hear my neighbors at all even the one above me. Typically, I only ever hear anything is when people let their doors slam shut.  So here for me its quiet I guess this all depends on your neighbors. Due to my job I am up different hours of the night and day and never really see anyone outside at night. You may not always park out-front of your building because parking is a bit of a premium which the have parking stickers but no reserved spots.  I did found out that the poor reviews were from when it was an old management company and staff was here.The new management and staff are differently working hard to make sure people know.  Defiantly love living here and all the amenities are just as nice if not nicer than in the photos. This place does not disappoint.

Mathan our leasing agent was amazing. Helped us find the apartment we needed in four days. Went above and beyond for us. Staff was very helpful with all the questions we've have. From Long Island New York. It was very important for me to get a clean and spacious place. This apartment has everything I needed the pool and cafe lounge are beautiful! 10 min from the city of Charlotte and the airport! Thank You again Mathan!

Have had nothing but a pleasant experience at The Addison so far. 

I've worked with Cabre, Matthan, and Lauren. All three of them are friendly, and very helpful. I was moving here from Seattle and driving cross country. On a Friday I gave them a call to see if there were available units. By the following Monday I was moved into new unit. This was very last minute for me and I was pretty stressed with the move, the staff took the moving stress away. Seriously grateful to them. Also shoutout to Roger who I believe is the property maintenance lead ... he is an extremely nice guy and is always successful at putting a smile on my face. 

As for the actual apartments ... the units are nice with large closets and bathrooms. The kitchens aren't anything fancy but everything works and is in good condition so I have nothing to complain about! The ceilings also seem very tall.

This place is worst place to live ever. I lived here for 2 years, and I am not going to recommend it to anyone. bad neighborhood very rude management and not very safe apartment no security camera. the townhouses have insects. they are mold and mildew.

Poor experience. Staff is disorganized at best, and downright disrespectful at worst. Would highly suggest looking elsewhere if you're considering Berkshire at Dilworth.

I don’t know where to begin. You pay premium prices for luxury quality apartments and everything is cheap and far from luxury on the inside. The staff are all very rude and fake-nice. The only positive thing I can say about this place are the maintenance crew are quick and nice. But if you value a strong and happy community along with quality of the apartment itself, live elsewhere. I would do anything to get out of my lease here.

Staff discourteous and non responsive. You will be treated as a nuisance if you have any concerns or questions. For example I needed to get Triple A into the gates and left a msg asking. I never received a call back. You will see call boxes in place but they aren’t operable so you can’t get anyone in the gates for emergency. There is rarely parking available. There is another apartment under construction down the street and they have the road blocked off during the week so you can’t park on the side streets. And they were only maybe 15 to 20 of visitor spaces  for the entire building at any given time. Staff is unorganized. For ex, Our package delivery system has been down for a month and they will not pay the $300 to get a technician to fix it.  Now packages are being delivered and the office is demanding that we pick them up or they will charge us a fee for storage at a rate of $50/mth even though we have not been notified we have a package. Another example, I rented the kitchen space for a Thanksgiving dinner. Upon arriving to the room to set up there was a party of about 30 there in full swing. This was 1 hr before my guests arrived. This party was a kids birthday party. When I went to the office to seek assistance the concierge took my info down. I waited 30 min went back to the office as no one called me back and now my own guests were arriving for dinner. When I went back down the concierge was of no assistance and even though it was a Saturday afternoon a leasing agent was nowhere to be found. I ended up having to go in and ask the guests to leave myself. The person who “rented” the space was the leasing agents brother who was borrowing the space for the day. I pd for over 4 hrs and pd full price even tho I didn’t get the space full time. Oh and I never even got a call back so much been as an apology, an offer for a credit NOTHING.On moving day the elevator was rented for the same time and I ended up having to pay my movers while they sat around waiting for the other tenants to finish moving in. In regards to safety we had break ins to apartments and bikes stolen as well furniture. This has happened to myself as well as other residents. Cleanliness has really gone down hill the last six months. There are pet urine spots on my hallway that have been there for months, the elevators and parking garage are filthy, etc.Things will happen and I get that but it’s the lack of concern, kindness, response and respect from the staff that frustrates me.

Lived here for a year and about to move into a larger unit. Cannot beat this location. The complex is beautiful and well maintained. All staff are friendly and helpful. Don't listen to the bad reviews, things mentioned happen everywhere. Also, being in the design field, the detail put into this complex is incomparable to others in the area.

Have been living here for about 6 months and things are ok. However, they are still doing considerable construction work and they do not provide appropriate notice about the dangers of the construction work. They redid the balcony and did not make us aware of the general scope of work and when stepping on my deck my feet adhered to the decking. None of the on site staff knew what the product was or how to treat it. Some of the leasing office staff saw it more appropriate to show new tenants than help me with a medical condition that was a result of their negligence. 

After about 18 hours they were able to determine what was actually applied and did send out a new notice warning residents. The property manger told me I would be allowed out of my lease with 30 day notice. I then received a phone call from corporate Berkshire stating that I would not be let out of my lease and that in fact they were considering coming after me for damages to their property that were the result of me walking on my own balcony. After the incident they came in and placed warnings all over the property saying not to walk on the balcony. 

The property manager agreed that this was incorrect and we got the regional manager involved. The regional manager withdrew the offer to terminate the lease with 30 day notice and said I had to get out now or fulfill my entire lease. When directly asked about the liability aspect they remain silent. So the written communication from the property manager is now being overruled by her higher ups and they make threats to their tenants and are in no way customer service friendly.

Moved out after a few months after constant issues with our apartment and the leasing team. AC unit was broken for weeks and people in leasing office avoided the issue at all costs. Lived on a ground floor unit on Morehead. The noise from the street was extremely loud and did not feel safe. When there are so many better options around Charlotte, don't choose this place.

My wife and I moved to BD in July.  Important factors were noise, security, promised flexibility of lease if we found a house, amenities and apt. quality.

Despite advanced notice of our move, BD informed us an hour before move-in that our unit's AC was broken and the two backup window units were currently being used by other tenants who's ACs were broken. There was no apology and no offer to put us up anywhere for a night. Our unit was 90 degrees and impossible to be in.

Noise: Our unit is across the street from a Hospital Heli-Pad. The Helicopter arrives and leaves 5-10 times a day and is deafening. At night, vehicles on the road might as well be in our bedroom. Music or TV from our neighbors is pervasive and disrupts our ability to sleep. We are on the top floor but have heard other tenants describe Fixtures shake and "it sounds like people are dropping bowling balls above us" as the worst feature of the Apt.

Security: There have been more than one instances where the security and safety of the residents has been threatened. Cars parked in the underground garage that are supposed to be behind gated and secure entrances were broken into. Vehicles had their windows broken in and robbed. Mgmt. waited days to inform the tenant community, took no responsibility in their part and basically blamed tenants. We were also told that Mgmt found a homeless person living in an abandoned unit which was not disclosed to the entire community. In addition, the building is across the street from a greenway, which is a great place to walk, run, or bike, but is constantly flooded with some in the homeless community. We have seen multiple instances across the street from the apartment where police were needed. 

Amenities: The pool failed inspections for the first couple months we were living there and were unable to take advantage. Management continually made excuses. 

Apartment Quality: In one word: Cheap. The appliances are awful, the floors are fake wood and wear easily. 

Lease Flexibility: We informed Mgmt. that we were moving out and were ready to pay the 1 month cancellation fee. Mgmt. then informed us we owed a second month's penalty as a "concession". The contract language was not clear, we were not told of any concessions and feel not only misled, but blatantly lied to. Instead of working with us, Mgmt told us to use it as a lesson be more careful of what we signed in the future. .

Ignore the bad reviews. There are always typical construction delays, especially when property is being bought and sold. My husband and I have been here since the beginning. The location is amazing, the amenities are amazing, and the staff is super friendly. Berkshire does a great job hosting events for residents, whether it's brunch or a workout class. Also, the pool is now officially open! Sometimes I feel like I am at a resort when I'm by the pool, in the club room, or on the rooftop. No other places in Charlotte compare!

I read the other reviews and I don't agree. Yes, the pool isn't open yet but I love the location and my apartment. We have a nice coffee bar and fitness room and the view from the rooftop is awesome! The pool is gorgeous and I can't wait to use it when it is ready. My dog loves the greenway and I love that I can walk or ride my bike to the farmer's market or trader joe's on the weekend!

I absolutely love living here. The location is amazing! It's so close to the Metropolotan where there is plenty of shopping, dining and bars. The staff is so friendly, helpful, and upbeat. It's dog friendly which I love and it's also right on the Greenway. It is brand new so it's finishing up the final touches but they are more than accommodating and helpful with anything you need. Love it! :)

Unfortunately this apartment complex is very pricey and does not live up to the hype. The pool was promised to be open on June 1, however it is August 15 and pool is still open. When staff is confronted about it they just give vague answers. I have been extremely disappointed in the management and availability of the amenities that were advertised.

Don't live here if you expect comfort and great amenities. This complex is the worst complex I've ever lived at in Charlotte. They make promises that remain unfulfilled and all of the previous reviews stand true.

Both of the previous reviews are absolutely accurate. Do not waste your money!! Everything about this place is awful, from the ownership to the structuring of the complex itself. Things might be done on time if they hired construction crews that actually worked while they were on the clock. Most of the time you see most of the crew standing around doing nothing. The pool isn't finished - that's the construction company's fault. The online portal isn't working - that's the technology company's fault. The property consistently lies to you about timing and when things will be completed. The best is when they blame crescent (the old property owner) and doesn't take any ownership for themselves. Don't bother spendig all that money on rent livin here. Find a place where the pool is actually open and doesn't take 4 months. I agree with the shoddy building of the apartment. The drawers are supposed to close automatically but have broken twice. This place is a perfect example of why you should judge a book by its cover

Do not be lured in by the promises made by management, the beautiful white, bright kitchen, or the location. This place is absolutely TERRIBLE! I, as well as several other tenants that have been living here for months now, have been extremely disappointed. 

The pool has been promised to be ready for months now, it still isn't. They haven't provided trash receptacles for the pet areas or general areas so people have literally left trash and dog feces laying around. Our kitchen cabinets were poorly installed and two of the drawers don't close. They made promises of a bike repair company, pool table and poker table in the club house, and a partnership with a deli and/or coffee shop for the retail area by the leasing office - absolutely none of these things have happened. While the deli/coffee shop may still come to fruition, the club house is already complete with nothing but couches, tables, and more couches. Also, I've spoken with the gentleman that was supposed to do the bike repair and said they canceled that. On top of all of this, we haven't been able to pay online for rent for several months now, so we all have to pay for money orders/cashiers checks which they refuse to reimburse us for.

I could continue, but I think you get the point. This place is not worth the money. I would recommend moving into basically any other complex in Charlotte.

They have new management every other week it seems like. Maintenance doesn’t fix anything. If you use the laundry facilities people will stop your clothes and you’ll have to pay to wash again. I live in the front of my complex. It has been an ok experience.

The apartment is small, but comfortable and cozy. The neighborhood is quiet except for the trains that pass on the other side of the highway.

Being able to come home to our own little comfortable place after a hard day at work makes everything better and relaxing. I'm really considering renewing my lease next year when the time comes. These are the best yet and I love my place.

My husband and I have been trying to sign a lease with them and trying to get information from them is terrible. I am a current resident and this complex is horrible! It is bug infested, maintenance doesn’t fix anything, poorly managed and just unorganized! I am so disappointed with living in this complex. I have had three ceiling leaks that attracted a bunch of bugs and I have complained several times to the property manager and even called the owners! Nothing gets done! This isn’t a safe environment to raise a child either with all the mold that keeps developing from the water damage.

Wife and I have lived here for 6 months and have been very satisfied...very quite here but the true asset of this complex is the resident manager (Geneva) who is always available and goes out of her way to rectify any issue...even the most simple maintenance problem or question...one of the few apartments I've seen where the maintenance man responds the same day and is on the grounds every day

I lived at Sharon ridge from Nov '14 to Nov '16.  First of all, i want to say that the people they hire are excellent.  It is beyond their control of the conditions of the apartments.  The apartments are simply poorly built and need structural renovations.
1)  Hot water.  If you take more than 10 minutes to bathe, this place isn't for you.  I literally had to decide if I was going to wash my hair or shave my legs during the shower.  There is no way to do both with only 10 minutes worth of hot water.  The maintenance man tried everything he could including changing out the water heater but it never rectified the problem.  

2)  Insulation.  I lived in a 2 BR unit that isn't even 1K sqft.  My utility bill was consistently almost $200.  I've lived in larger apartments and even lived in a 3BR 2 bath home and my bill was never consistently this high.  I even got Duke energy to come out and check the meter.  The ONLY time I've had a utility bill this high in my adult life was during a winter month of record level low temperatures.  When I moved in I could tell there was a SEVERE insulation issue.  The heat hardly Ever went off.  I brought it to the maintenance guy's attention only to be told that the buildings were poorly insulated and that it was reported to the owner.  The tracking on the sliding door was completely off which cause more gaps at the base and sides.  I also taped the windows on the interior, sealed the guest bedroom off from the rest of the apartment and lined the entrance doorway with insulating foam.

3)  The building maintenance – the stairwell and breezeway were not being maintained and haven’t been pressure washed in ages or at least not since I lived there which gave the outside of the apartment a very displeasing look and a bad stench. 

4)  Poor insulation between floors. The adults were CONSTANTLY pacing back and forth and there was a young child that lived above me and made it completely unbearable to live there.  The constant running all day everyday back and forth was enough to drive me near the brink of insanity.  This kid LITERALLY ran and jumped until 4am almost Every night as if he was going for Olympic gold.  I absolutely HATED coming home everyday due to all the noise that went into the wee hours of the morning.  No kids should be allowed to live in the upstairs units due to the poor insulation between floors.

I do not recommend living here. I have seen a lot of five start reviews but they are not accurate at all. First are the costs, which they don’t tell you when you move in. Under previous management my utilities were around $40, but they average $90 under new management. My last utility bill was over $190. Even if you have your own renters insurance they will charge you every month for it. Then there’s the issue of cleanliness. You are charged for trash pickup, but valet trash does not come every day and many residents do not follow the requirements to get their trash picked up. This results in loose garbage, not in bags, everywhere, and it sits there for weeks. Nobody picks up their pet waste. There are cockroaches, and when you tell maintenance the “pest control” tells you there aren’t any. The biggest problem I’ve had is safety. This is a gated community but the gate rarely works! Cars regularly get broken into, catalytic converters get stolen, and last week my car was stolen and then totaled. Either the security cameras are dummies or management does not care, because minimal actions have been taken to deal with this issue. The security company they have contracted only works 6pm-6am, but I’m not sure what they even do. If you try to contact management, they will never respond. This might be because the property gets a new manager every few months; it has changed management at least four times since I started living here. They also recently closed the pool due to non-residents using the pool. I’m not even sure how it makes sense to close the pool to residents because non residents are abusing our amenities.

If you are wanting to live in a student apartment, you need to look at all your options before deciding on this one.

My two times at Aspen have not been the best.
I hated my 2 random roommates the first year. 
My second year we lived in the two person and it's way too small for both of our things to fit.

The office never answers their phones and they are all too young and don't know how to respond to questions.

You will get charged for stupid fees that will bill your account. Not worth the hassle in my opinion or the money. Trust me there are safer, cheaper options.

Our daughter lived there 2 years, her roommate 4 years. If you are charged hundreds at move out... you are the problem. We were only charged $20 and also a $35 carpet cleaning charge which clearly states will be charged in the lease to all tenants.  We had photos of move in condition and the $20 charge was removed when we inquired about it.  Raven and Breonna were very helpful and professional regarding any issues or questions we had.  Any needed repairs in the apartment during the years were handled quickly. Very happy with our Aspen experience!  Move in, be responsible, respect the property, clean for inspections, follow the rules and instructions and you will be, too!

I really enjoyed living at Aspen. There we a couple hiccups along the way but my apartment was nice and the girls in the office were always really nice. I did receive a fine for leaving my trash out overnight, which I didn't do but they took care of the charge after I explained the situation with me and my roommates. I'm graduating but otherwise, I'd renew. Way better than other places in the area.

We were charged $200 to repaint a bedroom. No pictures were provided when we requested them. Do not rent from this complex!! They would not work with us either.

However, we will not be removing any charges from this account.  As we are assessing well over 300 bedrooms in a span of less than 24 hours on move-out day, it would be nearly impossible to photograph every single minute damage charge.  I have confirmed that we did in fact incur costs for our vendor to repaint both the common area and Madison's bedroom.  I am sorry that you feel that these charges are inflated, but I cannot edit these charges as they are uniform charges which were used to process all damages for each of our vacating residents.

I couldn’t be happier with the hospitality I received from Anthony and Sabrina! While looking for my next place to call home, it made a huge impact on how I was greeted and informed. Anthony made sure no question was left unanswered and Sabrina made it her duty to listen to the needs I was looking for within the community! Thank you again for your patience and great work ethics!

I only just moved out of Delta Crossing (job relocation) after five  years of living there, so I want to finally do these folks a solid and review after years of them being so good to me! For what you get, especially considering how expensive all options in Charlotte are getting (if you want anything decent), Delta Crossing is a gem in the rough.

I've lived all over Charlotte, and have friends/family around town, as well. DD is in a beautiful location, tons of trees, several outdoor areas to relax, all the essentials in the gym. And most importantly, the staff is great. Every community has over-worked people, but even if so here, it never seemed like it. And their company must be good, because whenever they have a floater helping out from a sister community, they are always so sweet and helpful.

The buildings: let me address another review I read: Unless you are in a BRAND NEW building in CLT, you will find imperfections. What matters is how your crew addresses them. Out maintenance concerns were always taken care of, and we were always kept in the loop. Besides, that said, the buildings are in much better shape then a LOT of places of comparable stature. This place is solid.

I could go on, but if you want an affordable place that has great finishes, good staff, and great location (so many great locally owned restaurants!), DELTA CROSSING is your place!

They likely have rats and roaches too, but not where residents can see them. It’s unclear now why someone would choose 415 over one of those buildings. I loved this apartment, though. The leasing staff is always busy with tours and leave actual residents waiting long periods of time without recourse for their concerns. They actually gave a package a friend sent me away to another resident, who of course opened it. I tried to find out how this happened and if they would implement guidelines so this wouldn't happen again and they looked at me like I was speaking a foreign language. The leasing staff doesn't seem to understand the Luxor package program they force residents to use, so I haven't gotten much help there. Again, I really enjoy the actual apartment, but the leasing staff really needs to get their acts together. This is really a beautiful luxury apartment but the unprofessionalism of the staff makes the luxury status very questionable. I recommend looking at other luxury apartments in the area due to the above concerns.

For new renters please note the inspire has new ownership since end of 2019. This is a great place to live but since the new ownership a lot of amenities have been heavily trimmed down. We had a barista providing free fresh coffee, we had a marketing team organizing two events a month which were top notch, we had weekly free after work drinks and snacks, ... The warm inspire experience turned into a profit optimizing experience. I have no problem with companies making profit but if you market yourself as an upscale experience (and charge accordingly) you should walk the talk. To give one example: all 400 apartments received an invite for pizza and wine. There were a total of 4(!) pizza's and 4(!) bottles of red wine. A pity it is going downhill this fast....

very friendly attentive and just easy to talk to
great 1st impression of customer servic
Quiet neighborhood. Great features in the unit and a nice place for families and pets.
The area is very nice, and the apartments are very clean. I've never had a problem with any noise.

I have lived here for three years and there’s always some type of problem. My packages have been stolen from my front door, my bike was stolen, my bathroom ceiling is falling apart, and amongst other things my dishwasher has been broken since I moved in. I have notified the rental office several times. 
The only reason I gave them two stars is because the staff is polite and the parks in the neighborhood. I wish I could post the pictures of how horrible this place is.
Emerald bay has a great surrounding school system and a lake area. Always great about fixing stuff promptly when having a problem. Staff is always nice

I have a loft apartments and it's the perfect size and layout for just me and my pets, rent is decent for being in Charlotte. The residents are nice, and it's surprisingly quiet here. Maintenance is a bit slow, but the people in the office are awesome!!

My family has been living in Emerald Bay Apartments for four years. When we first moved in, it was a quiet, affordable neighborhood. There is a park nearby for the kids, and the lake/waterfront is nice to walk around. The apartments are of decent size, mine had a new fridge and new(?) carpet. The dishwasher and other appliances were older. I have a nice view of the place since I sit on the second floor. The grounds are well kept.

Now it is quite expensive to live here (around $715-730 for a two bedroom, 1 1/2 bath) when I first started it was $625. There are many newer neighbors that don't control their kids so there are smelly, sticky messes outside (and some stay out past curfew and make a LOT of noise). The poor maitentence men have to clean up after everyone here since they love throwing trash everywhere. Fire trucks, and ambulances are common sights and sounds here (at least once a week). The office is helmed by three nice ladies but if you have an issue (short of a maitentence issues) they will tell you to call the police for noisy neighbors, neighbors parking behind your car, and sorts.

Bottom line, this area used to be nice to live in. Next year, I doubt my family will want to live here since rent will be shy of $750 and this place isn't worth it. The apartments are good, the staff is nice, but there can be better elsewhere.

I literally had a walk through at every single apartment complex in south Charlotte and Bexley at springs farm BY FAR is the best for price and value. Tenants, maintenance, and staff are all professional and courteous. Their events are top notch as well!

In 2017, I moved to Charlotte, NC.  After doing lots of online research and viewing multiple apartment complexes, I decided on Bexley at Springs Farm. From the beginning, the leasing staff was extremely helpful, answered all of my questions, and took me on a tour of the complex.  I have been extremely happy with the community. I'm a nurse that works night shift and sleeps during the day, so I was worried that it would be too loud during the day to sleep! But honestly, I haven't had any issues. All my neighbors are very nice, and for an apartment complex, it is very quiet. The apartments are updated, and you can't beat all the upgrades for the price. Just like any apartment complex, things sometimes break.  At the beginning of the summer, my AC wasn't working. I called maintenance on a Friday night...not expecting to get any repose until the next day at the earliest. To my surprise, someone called me within an hour to come out a fix it that night! The maintenance staff was always pleasant to deal with. They even provided flyers when they were renovating an apartment nearby to warn you of any excess noise that could be disruptive. Their pool area is fantastic! Always clean and quiet with plenty of space to hang with friends or alone. I have enjoyed to TV's outside and the firepit that you can use all year long!!  If you're looking for a peaceful community close to shopping and plenty to do, Bexley at Springs Farm is a perfect match.

In 2016 I relocated to Charlotte from Hickory, NC.  After doing lots of online research, I toured Bexley at Springs Farm.  It is a beautiful complex and was close to my work at the time.  The leasing staff was extremely helpful and sat with us while we looked over different floorplans, and took us on a tour of the community.  A week later we moved into a one bedroom apartment on the first floor.   Over the course of our lease we were very happy with the community.  The apartments are virtually soundproof, and upgraded to the max!  I utilized the gym almost every day, and rarely was it too packed to enjoy!  

Just like any apartment complex, things sometimes break and this unfortunately happened to us.  There was a weekend that the A/C went out during the summer, and after calling the emergency maintenance hotline, there was someone out almost immediately to repair it.  The maintenance staff was always pleasant to deal with and gave adequate notice before ever entering your home.  They even provided flyers when they were renovating an apartment nearby to warn you of any excess noise that could be disruptive.

Their pool area is fantastic!  Always clean and quiet with plenty of space to hang with friends or alone.  I moved away from this complex to enjoy the "Uptown Charlotte" experience.  If you're looking for a peaceful community close to shopping and plenty to do, Bexley at Springs Farm is a perfect match.

I needed a place short term (I'm a travel nurse who only stays in one place about 3 months) and was happy to find that Bexley not only did short term leases, but they didn't jack up the price of the apartment for them. I'm in their smallest one bedroom and it's plenty of room for me and would be enough space for 2 people also. The kitchen is newly renovated and beautiful, dark wood cabinets, granite counter tops, stainless steel appliances. While I haven't been here long, the front office staff has been very nice and helpful. I also had a minor maintenance issue that they came by to fix the same day. I think I will really enjoy my stay here. The complex is beautiful and close to a large shopping center in a nice area.

We moved to Bexley about a year ago in hope of finding a good community to make home for a while. When we first moved in the Management was GREAT! They were always on top of things and made sure that the community was well put together. A few months ago we got all new management and all new leasing agents in the office. It has been a horrible change. The new management doesn't seem to care about the community or the residents. I have spoken with several long time residents that are just awaiting the day their lease comes due to get out of the complex. The complex is has wonderful landscaping but most of the residents that have patios on the lower lever are trashed (toys all over, clothes hanging outside, trash, etc.) it is just a horrible thing to look at everyday. I know multiple people including myself that live on the 1st floor and have problems with people above making a lot of noise, and the office doesn't seem to care about that either. There is also a problem with children gathering and playing in the parking lots around cars... They won't move when you are trying to back up and leave their toys all over the road so you can't back up. They also throw their scooters down. Which has resulted in a nice dent in the side of my SUV.  I could go on and on about this community. If you are looking for a community to call home, please save yourself the trouble and find another community!
Broadstone Highland Creek is an excellent, welcoming living experience! Our community enjoys and shares many opportunities to meet and welcome new friends.

Broadstone Highland Creek is a wonderful community! I have been here for 20 days and have felt at home from day one. There are many opportunities to meet neighbors, participate in different events, enjoy many amenities, plus the surrounding areas are welcoming! And provides for daily walks.

Okay right off the bat, I want to give a huge shout-out to the leasing office and staff that works here. Brandon helped me out through this whole process and honestly it was smooth sailing. Also huge huge thanks to Jonamel, Karina, and Davon they bring a welcoming feeling every time you walk into the office. They are the most nice, professional, and the most up lifting people I have ever met. All the amenities are amazing and super clean. Gym is huge and has everything. Pool area is kept clean and the big plus is that the pool is salt water and not chlorinated water. I am really glad I chose to live here and I can not wait to attend the events.

I enjoy living here. My apartment is quite spacious. The amenities are amazing and kept clean. The staff is courteous and welcoming. The neighbors are quiet. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for an apartment close to shops, restaurants, a quick drive to the city center and airport as well as easy access to highways.
Broadstone has a great growing community close to many stores & shops which makes things very convenient
Ongoing construction is far more important than the residents. Communication is poor, accountability is poor.

This apartment complex is the absolute worst place I’ve ever lived. First off, the office staff is NEVER in the office. They come and leave when they wish. They’re rude as crap and they don’t care about anything other than money. Speaking of which, they claimed we owed them 500$ which was absolutely untrue and seeing as how much of a problem they have with giving you a receipt when you turn in rent, we believe one of the employees have been embezzling money. Just our theory on how we somehow got behind on our rent. We believe this because this happened to a couple of other tenants who live in this community. They left a lovely note on our door saying we had 2 weeks to pay up or they would start the eviction process. We are currently without hot water because our shower faucets won’t shut off all the way and “they had to order a part”. That was 3 weeks ago and it’s still not fixed. My husband and I barely cook, so we don’t really have groceries anywhere except in the fridge. I say this because there have been baby roaches popping up here and there. Again, we brought this to the attention of the staff and maintenance, all we got was “we don’t know when the pest control are coming to spray the apartments again.” Um, what? This experience has been the most frustrating and trying experiences of my life. So fair warning, you’ll regret signing a lease here shortly after the ink dries on the dotted line.

Pros: Cheap rent, convenient location, safe area, large apartments.
Cons:  Office staff is difficult to reach.  Maintenance doesn't make repairs in a timely manner.  

If you like being without AC in the summer for weeks at a time, this is the place for you.  I'm regretting that I renewed my lease for another year.  I can't wait to get out of here.    The rent may be cheap but it's not worth it.  Spend a little more and get someplace where they actually make repairs.

Living here currently in one of the one-bedroom units, for about a year and a half now. Very spacious, with a big kitchen and living room/den. It being a townhome is also nice, with the bedroom being upstairs. However, I do have some issues. I have to say that the maintenance team is pretty lacking. Ive had issues with the weather stripping on my doors since I moved in, and they've yet to finish fixing it. I shouldnt have to be vacuuming up pillbugs almost every day due to them having a nice gap under my doors to get through. On a related note, pest control is very inconsistent. Sometimes they show up monthly and do a thorough job, and sometimes they wont show up for months, and then swing by for a quick spray. I understand that the team is busy, but my rent was raised over 10% when I renewed my lease. The least I can get out of it is some issues being fixed. So, nice unit on its own, but I cant ignore these other issues. 3/5.
Great customer service. Great Management. The Maintenance team does an excellent job. Everyone is very friendly and polite.

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review: Management took care of my apartment and it was clean. Maintenance made tge repairs to the outlets. Plus, the bathroom was cleaned for the most part

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review: I like it so far since I’ve moved in. It’s quiet and not too far from downtown. It has its pros and cons but definitely not at bad place to live.

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review:
I love my apartment at The Lodge.  It’s spacious and has covered outdoor space.  I haven’t needed many repairs, but when I did they were efficient.  I don’t have pets, but it would be nice to have a dog park that has activities for the dogs to play.  Also, with so many cars in the car park a car cleaning center would be great.
Thank you.

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review: Friendly office staff, great location.Easy to get to 485 and 77. Near grocery stores and gas stations. Renovated and unrenovated apartments.

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review: An excellent community that I truly love. Calm community and courteous staff. I would love to live in this community for three years or more.

apartmentName: The Lodge at Mallard Creek Apartments
review: Nice place to live. Floors are a but thin & look cheap, so be careful when moving furniture. Try not to drag it or it will scape & tear up the floor very easily.
I have rented  an one bedroom and it is very spacious!!!
I lived  for one year at this property. I've enjoyed living at there, it was great for me. The management team with a beautiful apptitude, always there when you need service, thank you!
Nice apartments close to a lot of places, very friendly staff.
good apartments, very nice on the inside everything is new., for a good price.
I just moved here a couple of days ago to a one bedroom it has a specious walk in closet. There is also a shopping center within  walking distance and also public transportation.

This property has gotten better over time, the newly renovated apartments look very nice, they have new appliances, and the kitchen countertops are pretty. The bathrooms have tile, and the apartment I moved into has white vanity and white cabinets in my kitchen.

We recently moved here and the leasing process was convenient and easy thanks to Kelly and Alexandria . As for the home itself, the kitchen/ living room is large  , we love the layout and how bright the home is . We would highly recommend crossing at noda to anyone.

Good quiet apartment complex. Maintenance is quick and does a professional job. Front office people are friendly and even better, helpful! Between the apartment, the amenities and the location, it's a fair price. The surroundings are beautiful and the grounds of the complex are manicured and pretty. It's an all around good place to be. I recommend to my friends all the time to move here.

The absolute worst apartment I have ever lived in. During my year stay here I had fleas, mice (three times), and mold (twice), along with many other issues. There are children constantly running through the parking lots, the trash is always over flowing, and the office manager is beyond rude and unhelpful; she even hung up on me once. The only good thing I have to say about this property is the maintenance guys were always friendly and you can tell they actually care about their residents. Do yourself a huge favor and don't live here.

Good management n good maintenance. Lots of apartments in Charlotte but I really like it here. No complaints...............................................................................................

Long gone are the days when people went from place to place in search of the perfect apartment.  Thankfully.  Therefore, I felt it was my duty to leave a reveiw for those who count on them like I do.  Don't you thank the person who wrote, "don't rent here" and then spells out why you shouldn't.  Well, my review will say, "rent here".  I'm still a fairly new tenant. It will soon be 2 months that I've lived here.  I had a slow drain in my bathroom and my AC unit went out this past Sat.  It was 87 degrees in my  apt.  However, it didn't take lone for the maintenance to fix the issue with my drain, and someone came out the same day to fix the issue with my AC.  I've read horror stories on the front office staff.  They are nice when they are trying to get you to rent and then once you're in, they become rude and obnoxious.  Not Ivy Hollow's staff.  They remain pleasant and professional.  It doens't have a lot a amnenties if amnenties are what you are into, but overall it's a decent place to stay.  Hope my review has been helpful

A nice, quiet neighborhood, with great connection to the CATS busline (7N, 7S) and is within walking distance of grocery stores and fast food restaurants. With a pool, play park, outdoor grilling area, and an on site laundry facility for residents, Ivy Hollow shows great support for its community.
Close to the mall and 77, 485, and 85. Great prove for the location and size. Pool and playground are kid friendly.
This is a ridiculous society. With very very rude management.. Water problem, roach problem.. STAY AWAY FROM THIS SOCIETY....

I was able to get a renovated unit and it is gorgeous! All of my friends and coWorkers are interested in moving here bc they love my apartment. The ladies in the leasing office, Marilyn and Stephanie, go above and beyond with answering questions and assisting with anything I need. Maintenance (James) has responded to my requests quickly and efficiently. Moving here has been a wonderful experience and one of the best decisions I’ve made.
From a yr ago I see a difference in what’s going on an it’s getting better also due to different management and maintenance

Signed my lease last year and it was the worst year!!! The property is horribly messy trash is always everywhere. They tell you cable & wifi is included it isn’t! Water is included but it’s always off due to “maintenance” issues. Plus it’s no cold water only warm & scolding hot. Took 9 months for pest control to come! Work orders mean nothing! Dasmen is horrible! Mya is new & she’s awesome but the residential company is the worst! They don’t respond to calls or emails! I would not recommend this property

Grounds Keeping is horrible. 

Management allows tenants to leave trash outside their doors which leaks and causes rodents, bugs and stray animals.

Grounds are not kept clean . It is trash everywhere.

I would not recommend anyone to move here.
I am so EMBARRASSED To have company for they would have to walk over trash, bottles, food etc..in the stairways. I am so angry and upset.   Office staff should walk around and check the property.
Nysha is a great manager! Love the way she helps you when you have a problem.

I have lived in these apartments for 3 years. At first I must admit that everything was perfect. I was excited, cheap rent, nice place, very spacious, and a quiet neighborhood. What more could I ask for? Well the more was spiders, roaches, and giant water bugs. They have a very bad pest problem here. Every 3 months they make you take everything out of the cabinets for them to spray. Now they have a bed bug problem many of my neighbors have them so now we have to get our apartments treated. Also parking is another big problem. The lease states that each Apt has 2 designated parking spaces but I have trouble parking my one car. So beware.

Wish I could post the pictures of the issues I've had from day one. The person that wrote this is a modern day slum complex was not lying. On my move in day the apartment was not cleaned with it being apparent spider webs, dead roaches/waterbugs on the carpet in the bedroom. I actually asked the person doing the walk through with me if they had another unit I could get over this one because of how poor everything look. I vacuumed the carpet before I brought anything into the room and vacuumed 2 canisters of dirt up. I've lived out of my boxes because I haven't unpacked much of anything because the cabinetry in the bathroom and kitchen is terribly old, filthy, and looks like it has mold on it. Again wish I could post pictures here to prove what I'm saying is true.

We've had 2 severe rainstorms in early Jan 24 where the window has leaked into the apartment. When I say leaked I mean 2 towels were completely soaked and if they weren't there the water would have overflowed the bay window and unto the floor. There's obvious water damage and the entire window area needs to be replaced and to address that they sent maintenance to put more caulk on the outer window seal. Band aids. My cousin owns his own HVAC business so he looked at my unit one day and we discovered the unit is as old as the building it seems and has mold on the blower compartment which is what is being blown into my apartment and I'm breathing now. I know it's mold because we did 2 mold tests with a lab result for one of them to give to the apartments so they can replace the unit. That test returned Jan 9 and it's now March 2 with still no communication from them on how they will/or if they will fix anything. Again I have the picture evidence for these claims.

The final straw for me is the fact that I didn't move in here with roaches but seems I may move out of here with them. As I stated earlier I haven't unpacked much of anything because of how filthy everything was well the roaches have invaded my stuff as I'm seeing them in my boxes now and looks like I will be trashing a good bit of my stuff so I don't bring anything with me. The one bright spot about living here is that they were ok with me breaking my lease and us parting ways. I've only been here 5 months and have never broken any other lease for any other apartment complex.

For what they charge find anything else unless you are ok with living in substandard conditions.
This place is a modern day slum complex. Nasty, uncommunicative and outdated. Spend a little more time and research before committing to this HELL.

They will not fix my air conditioner! My work order was submitted on April 5 and it's still not repaired. They said it should be repaired within 48 hours but it is well past that. We have had 9 straight days over 80 degrees according to the news. The temperature in the apartment has reached 87 degrees as I live on the second floor.

No idea what it's like to live here, but if my experience just trying to visit is any indication, STAY AWAY. The prices here and on their website are not what they quote you in person, and they don't actually have availability for a few months. I scheduled a tour over the phone, only to get there and be told that they aren't doing in person tours. Not a good look.

I stay in copper creek now at first it was fine but due to lack of property management there is trash on ground everywhere near dumpster only one dumpster for whole neighborhood so it gets pretty full fast. Which have had rats take over the neighborhood. Come in the evening they are in the parking lot in the walls and sometimes in front on the door. You can ask anyone who lives here and they will tell you about the rats. The leasing office will say anything to get you to leave and never get to talk to manager but talk to assistant instead. They will also charge your account extra money and not be able to tell you why they did . They will tell you to email corporate but no one emails you back . This has been a terrible living experience
Rats and Trash overflow. Bad communication in leasing office. Lights out by door

I've been reaching out to these people for three months and the property manager Kelley and one of the assistance named Amaya have been ignoring me. Yes I was denied but things happen for a reason found a better community but anyways with that denial I've been nice about the situation and asking for my refund back no one is cooperating with me. They aren't returning my calls or anything they said once they find where my money went too and the check comes they'll call me back yeah right it's been 3 months now... Please don't let these people play you be very cautious.

The front office is beautiful but take a drive around the community and you’ll be quickly disenchanted. Trash is everywhere and the property is poorly maintained. Its impossible to get ahold of anyone in the office or in corporate. Don’t waste your time or money. Also they have a rat issue which they choose to ignore reports of.
The apartments  are great. The maintenance technician, Omar, is great and has helped fixed issues the apartment has had. He is very polite as well!

This apartment complex exceeds my expectations in many ways. Last month, I called maintenance regarding some  concerns with my pluming in my restroom. Within minutes, one of the maintenance workers, (Omar) was at my door with all of the right supplies! He properly fixed my pluming, and there has been no issues since. *Bonus* he even took my trash for me on his way out!! 

-Blessed in a great environment
This apartment complex is filled with roaches. They are everywhere and will not go away no matter the treatment plan. DO NOT MOVE HERE! Copper Creek has a serious bug problem.

Don't move into a place where people don't care about your health and safety, which is exactly the management at Copper Creek. Kelly and the whole team will literally lie to your face just to get our of a jam. DAMSEN!!! you really need to look into the type of people you have representing your company. This is atrocious living conditions, management, and a poor level of customer care, but I guess you already knew that. Moral of the story is - - find a different place to live in beautiful Charlotte east.

Copper Creek is poor because they would say they coming to fix something and don’t fix NOTHING! you have to keep going to the rent office just to keep telling them the same stuff over. My tub or my refrigerator is still not fix and my tub been like that since I first moved in. I been telling them about my refrigerator since 3 months ago and they always claim they coming to fix it or put a new one in there the same day but nobody EVER comes out to fix it. This is not a good place to move in and the pictures thru showing online is not what you paying for.

This is the worst experience I have ever had at an apartment complex. Since the moment I moved in there were issues and the ladies at the office are unprofessional. They don’t truly care about the tenants. My A/C has been broken for 37 days now and we’re going into July. I can’t sleep comfortably in my own home. I can’t have family or friends visit because it’s too hot. I’ve actually began working over time just so I can be in a space that’s cool rather than coming home. I’ve requested to have this repaired more than four times and it is still broken. I don’t understand how they could treat tenants like this and not even have the decency to respond or give updates. Please, save yourself grief and do not move here just because the advertised pictures look good or the price is reasonable. It’s worth paying a little extra if you can, to at least live in a habitable environment and be treated well by the property management. It’s unethical, truly. And previous times when I had placed a maintenance request they come into your home without notice even if you check the option that someone must be home and to be notified prior to entry. This makes me uncomfortable and not at ease, like anyone can enter without knowing who has been in my apartment. This place doesn’t feel like a home, do not move here unless you have no other option...

This is a great community. The new management is offering a bunch of interesting new programs and has really improved things with the new valet trash service. Great schools! And the upgrades are phenomenal!

Somerstone was my first apartment and don’t get me wrong as a first time renter it was a great experience but there’s better out there. There’s rats around the trash disposal that I’m assuming no one cares about. The office NEVER, and I mean NEVER answer the phone, you can go days calling them with no answer. They advertise a fitness facility but I’ve been here over a year and I can’t tell you where it is, I’ve never seen it. The roads are horrible, you’ll need an alignment immediately. The grass gets cut whenever they feel like it, so expect your grass to get high, I’ve seen a lady have to physically cut her own grass with a personal lawnmower? The neighbors blast music all times of night and throughout the day, very inconsiderate. Sometimes they don’t open the pool, my car was broken into, the list goes on. I don’t have complaints about the inside of my particular apartment (I can’t speak for others) but as far as the neighborhood and the facility, you could find better..

This has literally been the worse place of my life. From the lazy Maintenance men to the community internet going out daily. Be prepared to call multiple time before getting a response from the office. The afterhours Maintenance is a joke, it goes straight to Voicemail which is in Spanish, and doesn't allow you to leave a vm. Oh, I also forgot to mention, none of the maintenance men speak any other language outside of Spanish so good luck with your needs. They'll mark your request complete without actually coming to fix the issue. 

There is a huge Rat problem here, so much where tenants have called Charlotte code enforcement for them to actually do something about. There's also a Flea infestation that they are doing nothing about. They finally fixed the termite situation after multiple complaints from multiple tenants.

They literally just opened the gym and laundry area past 5 pm, and the valet trash ppl come when they want. We were informed that we would have to reach out to any vendor they bring on site as they will not do it. I mean I can keep on and on and on, but I did this review so that others do not make the same mistake That I did. I moved from a different state here and had I known what I was getting myself into, i wouldn't have signed a lease

Charge trash service and half the time they dont pick up. Charge for not putting my trash out when i didnt have trash to put out. Rat at trash compact when i have take my trash out.Neighbor music can be hear to bedroom wall. Parking space is bad to point . You have pay for spot to have space to park if work late at night. Email office but no response because they changed email without tell us. This some of the reason me left.

Horrible experience trying to rent here! I originally applied here in mid-April. I was encouraged to do so by Gaby, the main leasing agent, as this was the only way to be placed on the waitlist. I was told there weren't any availability for my time range just then but they would know more in May. Fast forward a few days, I was approved and told that there weren't any vacancies still and they'd refer me to one of the sister properties. No one from the other complexes ever reached out or responded to inquiries. About a month after applying and no other contact, I received several calls and emails from Gaby letting me that they had a 1 bedroom that had become available but it wasn't the exact floor plan I had applied but it still had all the amenities I required i.e. washer/dryer connection. So I agree to switch to this apartment. I asked several time to actually view the apartment since it was now vacant and was denied under the pretense that they had a policy of not seeing the apartment prior to maintenance and turnover. But she didn't hesitate to tell me that the only way to reserve the apartment was by paying my deposit. So on May 24th, I went to the complex to take care of the deposit and see apartment. Again I was denied seeing the apartment but promised the she'd check with maintenance to see when it was ready. I never got a call. The day before I was scheduled to move in, I get an urgent call and email from Gaby stating the apartment still wasn't ready because the floor vendor didn't show up. I tried to call back the following day, which was my move-in day, but Gaby was "sick" and hadn't come in. No one ever called to try to make things right and honor the move in date like switching to another apartment. I had to escalate the issue to their regional manager C.J. who offered empty apologies and no solutions. So decided to go to the complex and see the state of the apartment. It was disgusting! They had painted and that was it! The floor was littered with dead cockroaches, the kitchen and bathroom hadn't been cleaned. On top of all that, the apartment layout was completely different from what was shown and promised as it was an accessible/ wheelchair-friendly apartment.
