The staff does such an excellent job putting on events that are so fun and a great way to meet others in the community. The amenities are also so great and well maintained. Windsor Landing is the place to be!

I've lived at Windsor Landing a little over 2 years now. I cannot say enough about this property and the staff! The maintenance guys are quick to respond and keep me informed! The ladies in the office are fantastic! They have taken the time to get to know me since living here. Upon move in my apartment was clean and the move in process was quick and simple. One of my favorite parts about living here are the resident events each month. The events are a great way to get to know my new neighbors and hang out with the ones that I've grown close with over the years. The grounds are always kept clean and all of the staff are quick to help when I need them! I cannot recommend living here enough! I love my apartment and this community!
I have been living at Pineville Place for over 5 yrs!  It’s very quiet!  The staff is great!

The maintenance team is great here, when you submit a work order they are quick to respond and get the issue done in a timely.

Greatly appreciated.

Oh the horror of roaches running throughout the kitchen, dining, and the floor reaching upwards to the living room. The faculty has one member who sends scathing messages to the tenants. Don't be fooled run for the hills! We were desperate but please no one wants to live like this.
The mangement team here is amazing.Ms. Tabatha is truly always friendly and willing to help. She's personable and respectful at all times.
Staff is very nice and professional also the property is always clean and attentive. Friendly staff are always going above and beyond.

Angela the property manager is great at her job, very dedicated to maintaining property and tenants well being.
   Nate the onsite maintenance manager is efficient, prompt and knows every inch of this complex inside and out.
   I recommend Shorewood at Raintree to anyone,
These apartments are very spacious. Stayed in a 3 bed room townhome. Older buildings that can show some age, but overall good experience.
Close to everything. Walk to Arboretum Shopping Center. Bus Stops closeby. Quiet. Reasonably priced.

We have lived in our 3 bedroom townhouse for 3 years. If you're looking for comfort, space, a quiet place to come home to after a hard day, is your place. No it's not glitzy or sleek, but charming and quaint. The office manager is tops and the maintenance crew are always at the quick and ready. Shopping center on one side and the Golf Course is our backyard and my husbands dream come true!!!

I was very impressed with the price and square feet for a three bedroom, two bath. I got to tour a two bedroom since the three bedroom was not available. I was not impressed with the inside as much as I was the outside community. It is very old and outdated. The fireplace, light fixtures, the whole kitchen, cracks in the pavement and walls....just not what I thought it would be, to be located near the country club. No pool/playground or workout center unless you want to pay a $1000 deposit and monthly fees to the country club next door. I also think the qualification to even be approved is not sensible. Two months rent?? really?

The apartment community looked old but filled with character online. However, when I actually went and looked at one of them, I was extremely disappointed. The buildings are run down and need of cosmetic repair. The apartment that I was shown was in the process of being extensively remodeled on the inside but there was a smell in the apartment that no amount of paint or new carpeting was going to cover up. I was also disppointed in the fact that they do not allow even small animals in these apartments. In this day and age where everyone has a little four-legged member of the family, it is unheard of not to accept them. Most people that I know do not mind paying the extra deposit just so that they can have their little guy with them. It might be a great spot for some but not for me.

This building is located in a great neighborhood and is walking distance to plenty of bars, restaurants, and the Greenway. My unit is very spacious and has tons of storage space. However, it's on a very busy street and although it's technically pet-friendly, there's not much green space.

The trash compactor that used to break all the time finally permanently broke down, so they're getting a new one. Hopefully it will be more reliable. They did at least put bins on every other level that maintenance empties in the meantime. It should really have been every level.

Elevators are still a huge problem. They break down frequently. However management has gotten much better at communication around this, although they still really need to just stop being greedy and spend whatever it's gonna take to permanently resolve this.

The new concierges are absolutely world class. Awesome people, and professional to a tee while still getting to know the residents.

All in all, there is still a laundry list of problems here, but it's gotten marginally better in the past few months. Hopefully that trend continues.

EDIT:
They recently literally had to resort to bribing people with a raffle to leave good reviews here, as no reasonable person would otherwise. Tried to coin it as a community event. You should absolutely ignore any 5 star rating from the past 2-3 months. They were purchased by the leasing office, and aren't representative of the reality of this place in any way.

EDIT 2:
They have 2 elevators down again at current, after having one down for months. They are also throwing arbitrary rules on use of the club level that weren't in existence when everyone currently here signed our leases. Avoid this place at all costs. I'll be moving when my lease term is up. I've dropped my rating back to one star, which between the constant failures of maintenance and the literal raffle drive for fake 5 star reviews, is DEFINITELY what this place currently deserves.
Property manager is rude to residents. Too many issues. Concierge company is great though.

Lincoln Property company is awful. Maintenance doesn’t do their job. Property manager is rude. They don’t respond to phone calls or emails. Don’t enforce lease policies. Building smells like marijuana. Move in condition was a joke.
The building is noisy at late night which causes difficulties for sleeping.

I've done a long research for a place to live. Once I walked in to Museum Tower I was blown away the concierge leasing have met and exceeded my expectations. Whitney is the girl to go she showed me the apt.  She showed me that she was there to make sure my need and request were met.  She was quick to respond to my questions and made this a very easy transition. I am so happy I couldn't find anything to complaint about this place. Thank you Whitney you rock.

The Delivery process and scheduling of the loading the dock is difficult and inconvenient. I understand deliveries are not desired through the front door, but scheduling of loading dock is not easy with short notice of delivery. HVAC is extremely loud in unit, and deemed "normal". Not what I expected.Gym has minimal free weight selection. Should have heavier dumbells and kettle bells.

A truly wonderful place to live. Nice neighbors that have become more than family. The manager is great and takes all issues seriously. She takes good care of the property, and sometimes works outside the office cleaning around and creating a decent atmosphere for the tenants. The kids have a place to play and that makes me very happy. The neighborhood is safe and has been since I moved in now over 10 years. I truly have been blessed living here.

I am so happy with Brighton Place! I was afraid of the traffic of Charlotte when I moved, but Brighton Place is conveniently located close to work, and is tucked away in a nice neighborhood. I love the trees and beautiful flowers outside, and the apartments themselves are roomy. I had to get an apartment short notice, and they were able to turn around the apartment with new carpet and paint in 4 days after the previous tenant moved. Carol and the whole team here are so nice and helpful! Problems get fixed fast! 
 I am happy to call this place home, and will be renewing my lease after a year, for sure!

I have lived here for about 6 months. They worked with me when I moved in, are always very nice whenever I have anything to go to them about, and always prompt at fixing issues. I have lived in some pretty noisy apartments, and was happy to find Brighton Place to be quiet and nicely kept. I am so happy I signed a lease with Brighton Place, and plan to resign when my lease runs out.

Office staff and maintenance are great and pronto, to assist you, my work orders are done in time and office manager always friendly to you they keep the ground property  nice. I been here for a few years. And I recommed Brighton place!

Renting here was suppose to be temporary!  Fortunately for my family, we have enjoyed the small community setting and the neighborhood, we have stayed much longer.  I will recommend this community especially because of a wonderful staff Carol! She is a great example of what to expect from a manager courteous and friendly. I have witnessed her clean up snow and ice off the cars off elderly tenants. I also appreciate her timely maintenance resolution in my unit. she gained my trust when she determined a service request I had placed could be taken care of by doing it herself.  She inspired me that day to not panic "just yet" when my key does not turn.  Most importantly she gave us peace of mind because we did not have to wait until the next day for the maintenance person to get the work order. Thank you Carol for making us feel at home. 

Sincerely

Had employees steal items from my apartment. The trash piles up to 6ft tall in the trash chute area. Tenants dogs poop/pee in hallways and other areas and nobody picks it up. Maintenance shuts work completing them. I pay for parking but the complex lets anybody park there. Someone was shot in the apartment across from mine and management has hid the details. This place is a dump

I have been extremely disappointed in my experience at Latitude 49. Upon move in, it was clear my room and bathroom had not been cleaned thoroughly despite being informed they would be. Both rooms have had sloppy paint jobs and damage to the carpets. Water damage is visible on the ceiling, but has thankfully not gotten worse during recent storms. The prior tenant left command strips on the bathroom cabinets because they don't stay closed. The dryer for the apartment has had repeated issues that have not been addressed properly until the 10th work order request, which has resulted in increased electric bills. Outside of the apartment, the walkways smell like weed and trash as some neighbors don't adhere to the trash policy and the policy is not properly enforced. I have seen roaches around the buildings on multiple occasions. The complex has also falsely advertised 24-hour study rooms and gym, which are not open 24 hours. The study rooms are only accessible M-F 10-6. The mail room is also a mess, packages are tossed in with no proper organization. Speaking of mail, my assigned mailbox has been broken for sometime now and we've had issues with the office holding our mail until it's repaired. I also have concerns about security as there have been shootings nearby and the gates to the property do not close or lock properly.

Do not live here! Only 2 of the apartment buildings are “student living”, the dumpsters are always full trash is everywhere. Was a shooting outside my window last week! Room students with old people that aren’t students

I moved here a few months ago, shortly after new management started. I live in a top floor newly renovated unit and it has vaulted ceilings, new hardwood, appliances, and new furniture. The new community manager, Levi, is awesome and always very respectful to his tenants. I would highly recommend living at Latitude 49, especially if you are a college student on a budget!

Moved into an apartment that they didn’t even attempt to clean, trash everywhere because the two trash disposal areas aren’t emptied frequently enough, security will harass you and your guest, outdated kitchen, no lights in the room, outside of maintenance it’s hard to get in touch with the office. If I could give this place zeros stars I would undoubtedly the happiest day was the day I got to move out.
The Latitude apartments is good I been here for three years. The events that we have are fun. We have our ups and downs our staff an residents are nice. It's a good place to live. Marilyn D Williams

I signed my lease back in August and everyone said not to do it but I looked at some of the reviews and it seemed pretty run of the mill and took a chance but don’t make the same mistake I did!! This apartment has been the worst. It’s suppose to be a safe gated community but the gate has worked a total of two weeks in the almost year I’ve lived here, police are constantly here, security does nothing, there’s been multiple gun shots since I’ve moved in, my cars been broken into and the office does nothing to fix the issues (or the gate). The pet fee is actually $300 along with the $20 a month unlike the website says but the area isn’t safe to have your pets out, the dog park is just a fence,poop surrounding the entire complex because it doesn’t get picked up. Maintence is horrible, flooded my apartment twice, “fixed” our roof by spray painting over the water damage while getting paint all over my roommates clothes, overall just causes more problems than it’s worth to get fixed. Shuttle to school breaks down fairly often/ is late or leaves early. Property manager has never gotten back to us on any of our issues, only ever says she will email us like we have time to sit around and wait on important issues. Do yourself a favor and pay the few extra dollars in rent somewhere nicer because in the long run you’ll end up paying more here with all the fees they charge you and get way less!!
My apartment is very nice and my neighborhood is quite witch I love

Management team is so efficient and caring!

The property is so well maintained.  It is decorated very pretty.  The amenities are a blessing, especially the community and craft room.  There is an immediate and timely response to maintenance request. 

However, just as important are the residence. There are such kind and caring folks that live here.  It is also very diverse.
I have lived here since 2011; and don't plan on moving.
how could i ever become a resident ? they don’t answer the phone or respond to emails..

i called 8/11/21 Wednesday which is opened from 9 to 5. darn well there should be someone at the desk picking up calls. i left 2 voicemails and nothing. how the heck is this place supposed to fill apartments if they can't answer a freaking phone call. might as well take my services elsewhere.
I can never get in contact. Ive been requesting applications for a while and if I ever get to fill one out they never respond.

I've been trying to get into these apartments for over a year now. They do not answer their phone and the emails they have written in one of the comments below do not work. I've even gone up there but no one was in the office. I'm still trying to move into these apartments because it's the only apartment complex in Charlotte within my budget. I'd really appreciate a response of some sort back.

I put in my application 4 weeks ago, haven’t received a call yet. I’ve call up there multiple times, left multiple emails & went to there office multiple times. It’s bad enough there only i open 3 days a week and on the 3 days there open NO ONES THERE.

Today I called like 20 times. At first it ranged and kept raining and then all of a sudden it would only ring for 2 seconds and somebody would hang up. Not acceptable. I would not be wasting my time doing an application.

I am so glad that I took those old reviews w a grain of salt and called the pines at carolina place. the new staff is amazing! this group actually cares and it shows!! I’ve been a resident since March 2020 and hear horror story’s about what’s happened before w the only management company but also heard how much of an improvement it’s been this year. check it out yourself.

I moved to the property a few weeks ago and I have been pleased. Management has gone above and beyond to accommodate my family and I. The 2 bedroom apartment that we are renting is nice and spacious. The appliances are a little outdated but for the price it’s definitely reasonable. I would totally recommend this community!

I should’ve looked at the review before moving here. There’s roach infestation, nasty neighbors, the landscaping is neglected, dumpsters always overloaded, no bug control inside or outside, random employees constantly. The pool area doesn’t look appealing, the clubhouse is apart of their office now, the gym looks run down and outdated. The community is embarrassing. You can’t even invite guest over because it’s not inviting

Where do I start first been here for going on 3 years had 5 mangers 3 set of office employees. N 8 maintenance teams .... the pool hasn't been open for a whole year since I been here ... the lights on the building is out it's so dark u can't see u hands .. the law care is horrible it patches of grass the pictures they put the website are fake .. the workout room is a treadmill and yoga mats ... dont get cool moving here I WARN YOU

TERRIBLE place to live they change staff every month they put the wrong rental amounts in the Ledger they add rent to Residents accounts late so they can charge them a late fee even when the tenants have paid their rent on time these pictures that you see on this website or fake the pool has been shut down for years this is not the same workout gym in the pictures they don't have a computer for use for the residence anymore 95% of these pictures are fake run away from this property it's a terrible place to live

Ever since ownership changed the place is getting worse by the minute. Supposed maintenance crew and office personnel change constantly. Had multiple issues in my apartment that i put in work orders in so that maintenance would come to fix but after 6-7 months and multiple attempts to no avail. I eventually just fixed them myself to which i wasn't even reimbursed for the parts i had to buy. The pool was one of the things i was really looking forward to because my 2yr old daughter loves to swim. It was open a total of maybe ten days this past summer, and when it was you were bombarded by 20 or more teenagers (half of which didn't even live here) running and jumping all over the place. They raise the rent every year boasting these amenities that you barely get to use. Not to mention the first photo you see above is a pool that's not even ours

This is an excellent property that I feel privileged to live in!  The work the guys did to make it beautiful is fantastic!  I would highly recommend Chris and company over and over again for all home improvement or any
needs!

My husband and I love the Melrose. The building is beautiful. The staff is friendly. It is hands down the nicest community in Midtown / Central Gardens.  All of our neighbors are professionals like us.  It is gated and we feel very safe.

I moved into the Melrose just after the renovation. It is the nicest place I have ever lived. My apartment is huge. The prices are high, but given the size they are actually lower than any of the other nice and high-end buildings I looked at.  The pool is nice to have in the summer. Security is great, including a nighttime patrol most days.  I like the bike storage room, so I don't need to take my bike into the elevators.

•The construction and renovations seem to never end. 
• The inside of the apartments are very small and therefore overpriced.
• it’s on Lamar which is a very loud & busy street and it does not have the “Midtown Vibe”. 
• The amenities extremely extremely mediocre. 
• The apartment front doors extremely thin, it’s doesn’t feel secure & you can hear every thing your neighbors do. 
• Parking is the worst and they charge you for decent parking spot.
• If you ever have guest over, forget it.. the process is so inconvenient.

This is my second review. I'm not sure why my other one is not appearing. But I moved into the Melrose in March. It is the nicest place I've ever lived.  My apartment is beautiful. The building is great.  The staff is wonderful.  Most of my neighbors are pleasant and friendly, and I've made several friends. The building is mostly professionals.  Very quiet. I'm very pleased with my decision and recommend this building to anyone looking.

I am from out of town and I’ve been a resident of the Melrose Midtown for approximately 2 months now and I have to say I am absolutely pleased with everything. The apartments are tastefully remodeled and are very modern. All of the appliances are new, the flooring is modern and sleek and the bathrooms are updated. Even though the tubs are the originals from the existing building, they do add character to the bathrooms. I reside in a one bedroom and the closet space is ample for me, the bedroom is large and the bathroom has ample space. 

I was also pleasantly surprised that the building is a couple of minutes drive from a main strip that has pretty much anything you could need. Grocery (Kroger’s), retail, gas stations, gym, Home Depot, planet fitness, therapists, churches...anything you can think of...including several bargain shopping dollar stores. It’s also in close proximity to midtown and downtown for those that want to venture out and dabble in the local cuisine or the more refined restaurants. 

Even though the building is technically under construction, you couldn’t tell as there is absolutely no noise when I’m home (6p to about 7:30am every morning). The property management is extremely responsive and Janice is absolutely amazing!!! She is extremely personal and is willing to assist any way she can. I have no words about how helpful and kind she has been. 

 The grounds staff (Ricky) and maintenance crew are extremely helpful and responsive and obviously take pride in what they do. I literally texted the property manager with a question one night curious about a potential issue an about 5 minutes later I had a maintenance guy at my door ready to assist. 

I’m looking forward to the opening of the pool for the summer and being able to utilize the amenities on the grounds. Parking seems to be readily available, but I have a reserved space so I’m not sure if I’m a good judge. 

Overall this is an excellent and quiet  community and building. My only, only hang up (which I quickly got over) was my unit is on the busy side of town...Lamar Ave, but if you’re a deep sleeper like I am you get used to it. 

I would definitely recommend this building as it feels like home!

After five years of living in these apartments and being single, life happened. I had to move to a bigger place in an area that wasn't as loud and busy. I loved the fact that just about everything was in walking distance, the staff changed a few a times over the years but the place seemed to have kept a constant good vibe. Getting things fixed was normally easy and there a few issues that I felt took longer than needed but they always kept their word. One of my biggest issues before moving was that ALCO the property management company cut daytime security out and limited the night crew. When that happened you saw and heard a difference. If the sounds of downtown don't bother you then I would recommend this place.
Very cozy. Lived here for 2 years.  A bit older but staff is very attentive and helpful. Close to downtown.

The management, for one, is hands down the worst I've ever dealt with. From the beginning, the woman we spoke with was unprofessional, rude, and not at all transparent about what we were getting ourselves into when we decided to apply to  live here. I had been emailing her questions leading up to our moving out, and I came to find out she had been let go from the company. What a surprise.  Thanks for letting me know that I was emailing no one...?
Then the front door literally wouldn't shut without scraping the entire side of the wall because of how poorly it was fixed.
Next, we had no hot water in our kitchen sink for about two weeks when we moved in. It was nice of her to make sure that was working before she hurried out.
The security gate stopped working twice, so we had no way of getting in to where we lived. And this so -called "security" gate lets just about everyone and their mother into the facility, so there's no point in having it. The security guards don't do anything, even though we are in a dangerous part of the city with homelessness and crime literally lurking around the corner. It's next to the Shelby County jail, but they won't tell you that when you're looking at living here.
The walls are extremely thin so you can hear everything that your neighbors are saying and doing.
Did I mention the cockroaches? Oh yeah, and they let us sit on that for a few weeks too.
And then we had a mouse that we had to buy our own traps for in order to get rid of. You would think they would’ve checked for places where any bug or rodent could enter the townhouse when they came in to spray for cockroaches.
Don't let the whole "free" wifi nonsense persuade you. No wifi. It goes out about every two minutes and when I called the company they used to get help, they told me that Uptown Square provides a wifi not meant for use in homes, and therefore he suggested we buy our own router.

Did I mention the soaking wet carpets when we moved in? They knew what time we were coming, and they postponed cleaning the carpets until right before we arrived with our furniture.  We couldn’t even put our bags down on the floor, so we had to wait to move our stuff in. Were we compensated for that in any way? Of course not, it’s Uptown Square after all.
I could go on and on but let me tell you, the best day was the day I moved out of this place. Please do not give your business to these people.

Been here two years and Have to say the community is very quiet the rent is awesome bargain for the location and perks. Great staff that get thing done in a reasonable amount of time based on priority. If you can get a free unit get it fast !!!

This is a quiet, cozy gated apartment community. Nestled in the heart of downtown, it has a great location if you want to be in or near the city. The staff and security are always very helpful with any needs I have, whether it's helping me get back in my apartment if I locked myself out or putting my name on the list for the weekly pest control provided. In the five years I've been here, I do not know of any crimes or related problems. I actually left my door open by mistake twice. The first time I returned home three hours later; it was still open and no one had touched a thing. The second time the groundskeeper told me he closed it for me after waiting to see if I was home. The apartments are well kept inside and out. My loft style townhouse is great size for one person and my walk-in closet is huge. The gym and computer center leave something to be desired but overall, the apartments are great.
I've here for over 18 months and so far the it been a good place to live.  The large washer and dryer along with the other appliances make home life easy.

Moved to gather on august. It includes all the facilities in our budget. I am living here with my friends. We do have pool, gym, study rooms, parking space is more and that doesn’t cost more. I love stay in gather.

Moved in last September when I started my fall semester at UofM. All my roommates are students as well, and we get along great. Having an in-unit washer/dryer and dishwasher is great too. Way better than living in the dorms, and still close enough to walk.

This apartment complex is not only super affordable but very accommodating towards my dog and me. All the staff is very friendly and the apartments are extremely well designed. The location is awesome being so close to campus. 10/10 recommend this complex

The staff is very accommodating and helpful ALWAYS . But, the trash is always over flowing with huge rats. Most apartments have roaches. The inside is very outdated but they are working on renovations.

We first moved in and the apartment they put us in was covered in cockroachs, we got another apartment but it has not been updated since the building was built.  The office staff does not care about the tenants that they have, half of the complex is empty and vacant.  The water pipes busted over a month ago and they still have not fixed the walls or the carpet.  This place is a joke, you ask to speak with a manager when finally someone answers and you get put on hold until you hang up. Do not move here!! There was a violent crime with a fatality and the next day there was a note on the doors telling everyone to keep their binds closed and windows and doors locked. Like I said these people do not care about their responsibilities or residents.

Very poor communication, takes multiple calls to the office for someone to fix something. Everytime i would call the office i would hear “I’ll give you a call back” never heard anything back and i had to constantly call back. Took almost 3 months for them to replace a part in my refrigerator that was missing when i first moved in. I kept getting the run around saying someone would be heading over to my apartment no one ever came i had to keep calling back. Parking is terrible, and all appliances are outdated.

Please avoid if you want your peace. My car war broken into, my bike stolen and my catalytic convert stolen all within two months. They don’t take any precautions, no camera, nothing. People smoking weed all the time outside and we have children. Sorry, this is the worst on my list.

I was a resident for one year. I moved in late 2020. From Nov to February my hot water would not work. It took more than 5 tickets and multiple calls to the front desk to get help. They took $100 off for one month for the inhumane treatment I had. This was my first apartment. Then in the summer, my a/c didn't work for one month. I contemplated suing multiple times but I didn't have to money to do so. Don't live here.

I am looking to move to Memphis for grad school in May. I was in town for a couple of days this past week for an interview so i decided to kill 2 birds with one stone and find an apartment as well. I loved the Arbors, i was impressed with the units and the price was fair. I was stuck between the Arbors and one more apartment complex so i came to see them twice. On the first visit, Savannah was sweet, helping to answer any and all questions and provide as much insight as she could. The second visit, her entire mood had shifted. She was very rude, very irritable, and barely wanted to answer any questions. That kind of concerned me but i still liked the apartment so i was still interested. Right before i was going to hit the highway to head back home, i stopped by the office. This was it, i decided to put in my application. As i sat down and got my pen out, i asked Savannah about the process and how i was going to know i was approved, how should i pay the rest of my fees, etc. well i guess she had enough of my questions because her answers became sarcastic as well as disrespectful. It was distasteful to treat someone like that when they are there to apply for the apartment. I will never spend my hard earned money to be disrespected. If anybody is looking for an apartment, i would suggest anywhere besides The Arbors of Century Center.

Hello I I'm a current resident at the trails at  Mt Moriah and my leasing agent is Traneal Watkins her customer service is great I love her she so helpful anytime I have a problem in my apartment I call the office I always ask for her she so friendly helpful and sweet
This property is so nice. The staff is always helpful.  Chermika is great manager and helps a lot.

I love my apartment , very spacious . Ask for Ms.Vaughn . She’s the best. Every problem or question, she responds to them both at a timely manner and gets the task done. She’s professional and helpful. Ms. Vaughn helped me find an unit that was most convenient for me and my kids. My kids love their rooms and free space they have to play outside ! Very kid friendly apartment !
I'm having a wonderful experience, love everything about this apartment. It's clean and quiet.t

Love my new apartment here at the trails. Such a friendly staff and community, close to everything shopping wise which is very convenient. Glad I chose to move here after relocating to memphis from detroit.
I am so happy with my first apartment here at the trails. Miss Lily was such a big part of my decision on moving here and I really hope others get the opportunity of working with her!

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review: Love the ambiance! Great walkability in downtown Memphis. Highly recommend living here!

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review: We have really enjoyed living at Gayoso House, the office team is always so helpful

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review: I just signed my second lease. I love this place. The maintenance is quick and fast. I love that about them.

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review:
For quite some time I've wanted to live at these apartments, and oh had they find me at the right time!

The lovely ladies in the Front/Leasing Office are very courteous and were able to get me approved and moving into a place where I truly felt at home in record time.

The feeling I get when I walk through the lobby and double doors everyday is unmatched.

I'm not too found of most management companies in Memphis, but RAM and their employees are truly a cut above the rest. They've been able to do justice with the interior renovations to the historic Gayoso House all while maintaining a proper relationship with their tenants.

Speaking of tenants - throughout my time residing here not once have I had to file any type of complaint against a fellow tenant or guest. Everyone is respectful of each other and mindful of their business. Whether you do or don't enjoy small talking with your neighbors, there's enough space for everybody. Most people respect the arbitrary rules so a simple nod or "hello" will be enough.

Above all else : the Gayoso House is a great place to live for adults that expect a higher level of service and satisfaction from the place they inhabit. I hope to renew my lease here when the time comes. (Something I've never said before!)

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review: Very nice,safe and The best place to live in downtown Memphis!

apartmentName: Gayoso House at Peabody Place | Apartments
review:
I have enjoyed living in this building. There are some great perks as well as a few drawbacks. The management is thoughtful in the way it looks out for it's residents. 

Things I love: Courtyard view - My apartment is set back away from the street overlooking the courtyard. This gives me a nice buffer from downtown noise. I have lived in 4 buildings downtown and this one is by far the quietest.

Loading/unloading zone - The building has a convenient area to park your car with close access to the freight elevator. On most days this allows for quick and easy loading or unloading of your vehicle.

Patio - There is a nice patio on the second floor. I enjoy sitting out there in the evening and chatting with other residents.

CONS: --No washer and dryer in my unit. (no connections, w&d in hallway–very outdated machines and are pricey, no change machine.)
--Security parks in the loading zone for long periods. Completely negates the purpose of this area.
--Windows in apartments do not open.
--Rent is high - the sq. ft. is the same as others downtown that are much more updated. Fixtures/finishing are old.
--Patio is not covered. Useless if raining as well as on hot days. No outdoor grill for resident use.

They do not handle any requests for the maintenance.
All the staff are mean and raciest.
Please do not rent the apartment here.
You can go to check the Google reviews.

I am about to finish my one year lease and my move out could not come fast enough. There have been four different management companies in the nearly one year I have been a resident, and each one has been more negligent than the last. 

The current leasing office management is horrible. The women are extremely rude and they do not even pretend to care about their residents. Maintenance requests can take weeks at a time to be processed, even for things like broken washers or broken air conditioning. 

The gates for the parking garage have been broken since I moved in. Even still, they leave one gate open pretty much at all times, so anyone can enter at any time. 

The pool used to be the one redeeming quality of the property, but this management company never handed out any kind of wrist bands/security check for residents to use to ensure outside people don't use the pool, but of course they do. People have parties at the pool with tons of people, none of whom actually live in the building.

The package room is a NIGHTMARE. There is no organization and people leave their food packages and never pick them up. You can imagine the smell. 

The door handles on the dog park doors were broken for at least six months, so the door was just left propped open for bugs to come in day/night. Again, the leasing office did not care. 

Do not move into this building. For the price, it is absolutely not worth it. Save your money and go elsewhere.
Cars stolen and broken into with security run from these apartments not safe

Overall it’s a pretty nice place to live. 
Pros:
- the pool 
- upgraded security by the parking garage at night to make us feel more safe 
- coffee machine in the lobby when it’s actually working and is full 
- price isn’t terrible for Memphis apartments 

I only wish there were established quiet hours because some people like to play their electric guitar loudly at midnight when you are trying to sleep.
I absolutely love my apartment. The high ceilings open concept and beautiful pool. Everyone is so nice and it’s a great place to live. I would recommend highland row to anyone.

Since being an Highland Row Resident I can say it is truly an excellent experience. Meeting my neighbors has been an absolute joy! 
Management team is working hard on communicating information to the residents.

s another complex and that we would have to reapply in order to get another complex. As of rn we still aren’t living in the apartment due to black mold and water damage. Our experience with Greenbrook Apartments was horrendous. Despite clear communication and fulfilling all requirements, we were denied move-in upon arrival after a grueling 4-day drive from California to Memphis with two young children. The staff showed no compassion or flexibility, leaving us stranded in a new city without support. They need serious retraining in empathy and professionalism. I just moved in and Kelly did a great job making sure I’m aware and informed on everything about my apartment and made the transition incredibly easy.

I have lived in this complex since May. I liked it until my AC went out a week ago. I have submitted 3 requests for maintenance that get marked complete while my ac is still not working. I have tried emailing and calling and finally walked to the office. No one seems to care that my ac is out despite the temperatures reaching 97 degrees this past weekend. I’ve had to relocate my dog for her safety, and I’m going to have to be late to work to try to speak to someone to get this fixed tomorrow. I just got approved and sign lease with these apartments and I must tell you the staff went beyond helping to get into my apartment. Looking forward to being apart of the community
Love love this. Perfect place to live. Recommend anytime . Very affordable

The property is beautiful!  It's a hidden gem, with a great pool, and clubhouse. Ann was amazing and went the extra mile to help us.  

Thank you

Since the new management started, they have poor communication and have not followed up and done what they said they would do. At the renewal of my lease, I was suppose to receive complimentary carpet cleaning. The office staff has not returned my phone calls or emails. I've stopped by to address this in person with no success. Now I'm 4 months into my lease and my carpet still hasn't been cleaned. I do not recommend living here at all.

Living here was ok. The walls were extremely thin, maintenance constantly coming for mandatory check ins, and there's no side walks to take your pup for a walk. They have dog parks, but people do not pick up after their pet. I moved out a week ago and they still TEXT, not call, that they're going to fine me because I haven't turned in my keys. My call log says I've called them 12 times this past month to ask what I needed to do to move out and only have gotten 2 responses. I've gotten 3 confirmations from 3 different people that they'll let management know that I've turned in the apartment but I guess they don't know how to communicate. I've also emailed, texted, and showed up on person but no one seems to be able to help me. They treat you all nicely to get you to rent but once you're in, good luck getting anything done.

The property is stunning and the office staff is beyond amazing. Their bubbly personalities make me want to come in for my Starbucks coffee every morning. There is a Starbucks machine in the office and a gorgeous pool!! We love living here!!

I've been living here for almost a year and it has exceeded expectations! The office staff is so responsive, not just with the move-in process, but any questions I've had since moving in, also. My unit is brand new and I love being the first person to live in it. It's a beautiful space. I love how close I am to downtown without having to worry about downtown traffic. It really was a hidden gem!

Our lease officer gave us fresh unit and just what we asked for, first floor and a patio! Beverly has been so responsive and accommodating to us since Day 1! No complaints here! The unit is almost complete from stove, fridge, ceiling fan, dishwasher, microwave to washer and dryer! No hard time connecting to the pre-installed xfinity device, you just have to activate it and voila wifi is ready 24/7! I also got a free 1-month lease! What more can we ask for!

This place is infested with bugs, the staff is impossible to get a hold of, everything breaks, people are constantly doing drugs in the buildings, the staff comes into units without notice, and the worst part is you cannot cancel their overpriced lease at any point. Do not live in this place, by a nice cardboard box it’s a better alternative

I have been at this apartment since July, this has been one of the worst apartments that I have experienced. If you are thinking about staying here DONT! Here are just a couple of things that have made this the apartment from hell. when moving into the apartment the elevator broke down so everyone had to bring all their furniture and things through the nasty stinky stairwell. It is currently May, and the elevators are still broken, and they are never working so we are always forced to take the stairs. Another thing is the maintenance and trash team never come pick up the trash, so the trash constantly builds up which leads to you getting nats and flies and roaches in your apartment and the apartment hallway always stinks! ( if you tell the property manager they will just give you some raid and go about their day.). The Leasing office is never any help and does not take complaints seriously, all they care about is getting people to buy into these overpriced apartments. Also, the car gate is never working so it is always open 24/7. so your car is never safe since the gate does not lock. DO NOT MAKE THE MISTAKE I MADE AND MOVE HERE!

No matter what, if you want an apartment in the area around the University of Memphis area, it is not going to be a perfect experience. Lived here for 2 years and I can confidently say that from stories I hear from friends at other properties, I had a better experience than them. I had minimal issues while I was here, office staff was always responsive. No one really uses the amenities so they are all generally clean, and if they are not you can let the office know and it should be fixed by the next day.

Tons of undisclosed costs, filthy, alarms always going off, price is not worth the quality, parking garage is to short for any vehicles that are lifted at all. Had fleas in apartment when moving in. Manager never responds until days later.

Trash chute and room is usually always filled, urine in the elevators, poor maintenance, fire alarms periodically are pulled, smells like marijuana throughout the hallways, trash in the stairwell, elevators and hallways, power outages are common, always overages on utilities bill. Great location though.

I really love this place! the first time i had a tour with this wonderful place the people were so nice and fun to talk to and also they give very great information to the guest ,Therefore i will indeed tell my friends and family about this beautiful place. Thanks  you!

I moved in last year and I have maintenance requests still not resolved from several months ago. I don’t have a working A/C and there is a leak in my apartment. I’ve contacted staff many
times without a resolution.

Unfortunately I would not recommend the Roxbury Apartments. I was moved into a unit with an a/c not working properly. It reached up to 86 degrees and it took over a month before maintenance even came by. They've done a quick fix and when I cook the temperature still rises to 80. The women in the office are the most  nonchalant women I've ever dealt with. I absolutely would not recommend these apartments.

Unfortunately I can not recommend moving here under any circumstances.  While the property and location itself are nice, the maintenance and management is abysmal.  When we moved in they were not ready for us despite having 4 weeks notice of our move in date, still had the builder locks on the doors, and we did not have a refrigerator in the apartment at all.  While they did fix those in the first week it took another 4 weeks for them to fix our A/C issues, and we are now going on 50+ days and they still have not addressed our other move in complaints.  Despite this the property manager refuses to compromise on our lease, still charging us full price despite not being able to fulfill their requirements of adequate maintenance. 

It is unfortunate that these problems plague what would otherwise be a great apartment community, but as of speaking with management today I was told that over 30 other units don't have working A/C and they still have no reasonable timeline before they can address our original move in complaints.  They have no ability to maintain the property and will not carry out repairs unless absolutely necessary.  They will instead make promises they cannot keep and then blame everything on having abnormal circumstances at the moment, but at this point the abnormal circumstances have been ongoing for over 2 months...
Wanted to see a model home stated “they didn’t have a model home”. Lady at the front was rude and had a nasty attitude. Don’t make anyone feel unwelcome. You don’t get future residents like that!

water leak is terrible water has been leaking for a month still not fixed. Nats are everywhere due to the water leak, a nat was in my bread and cereal boxes ??. hidden fees are another issue it’s about a 50 extra fee added to the rent

The environment and the people within are great, the issue is the service after moving in. It’s obvious contractors were hired to do quick work because outlets in all rooms don’t function, the heat had to be fixed in the first month and there were even fuses missing from the fuse box. The maintenance team is run ragged because they have to pick up the mess from whoever did the work to begin with. Worst of all is that the air has gone out at the onset of this pandemic but the offices have been closed and the maintenance team sent home for the foreseeable duration. If you have the money to live here just buy a house, you will at least be in control over the time it takes for a problems to be fixed.

I would not recommend moving here. Maintenance is terrible, my ac went out and was not fixed for a month so I was not able to live in my apartment due to it being 100 degrees.  You would think that since there are so many reviews about AC being out for so long that management would do something about it but no. There are roaches. All of the renovations are done at the bare minimum and very poorly. I have multiple cracks and leaks in my ceilings and they have not been fixed properly.  The parking lots were recently redone and even that was done at the bare minimum! Just waiting for my lease to be up and I will not be living here again.

Love living here. Literally dead center of the city— a main reason why I chose Roxbury. Close to 4 major exits (Poplar, MT. Moriah, Ridgeway, Kirby Pkwy) Quiet neighborhood. Beautiful old/modern interior. However The Roxbury needs significant improvement with maintenance requests and fulfillments. Front office sometimes have not properly submitted maintenance requests. Or have not followed through with their promises. Would have to continue to follow up to see if any progress has been made. Maintenance team has changed at least 3 times in the year I’ve lived here. Air conditioner went out this summer and waited 2 months for it to be repaired. Also requested flooring to be fixed up 6 months ago and have followed up at least 5 times and it still has not been replaced/patched up. Also lost out on $500 off my rent for referring a friend several times due to the “fine print”. In order to receive it, the person must put your name as a reference on their initial Application. They will cheat you out of this promo!!! All in all the bad does not outweigh the good. Can not see myself living anywhere else for the amount of space you get for the price.

The staff 6 months ago was awful and incompetent. However, there is a whole new team of office staff, management, and maintenance. The renovations were originally done very shotty and the staff did not seem to care. The new staff however is doing their jobs and going above and beyond to make their tenants happy. My husband and I had tons of issues that are just now being taken care of by the new staff that the old staff failed to follow through on. The ladies in the office are much more professional and diligent in their work now.

This place is TERRIBLE. I’ve had nothing but issues with my apartment not being ready when I moved in and multiple roof leaks plus other damaged things that take 2 months to fix. Not to mention I was out of air conditioning for my first two months here. Don’t let them fool you, the office staff and just plain rude. They don’t care about helping as long as they’re getting paid. DO NOT MOVE HERE.

I am not sure where to start on this apartment complex.  So I will start from the beginning of the new ownership.  They are unprofessional, deceptive and liars.  No one accepts any responsibility for anything that happens on the property.  The new owners seemed to forget that there were tenants that actually lived on the property and your property is of no concern to them, that is what renters insurance is for.  Renovations would tell you it was a leasing problem and Leasing would tell you it was Renovations problem and don't even try to call corporate; they were just as tone deaf.  This may be a great place to live once they get done with the rushed renovations, before moving in make sure you a separate bank account for tire repairs.  This place has contractors that do not care about dropping nails on the ground or start banging at 6am renovating empty apartments.  The Leasing staff, well they are a breed of their own, once they get you onto the property you are no longer their concern.  Make sure that your renters insurance will cover everything; (a hint, renters insurance don't cover tires, a heater that no longer works or the air conditioning unit.  If your flooded because the water heater is in the attic your covered.  Auto insurance does not cover damaged tires either, its wear and tear to them.)  Maintenance is working with what they are provided.  They were great, actually better than the office staff was.  I would recommend that they have a Leasing person and then a person to handle residents, the manager was never there and would lie to keep an argument down.  It is almost like they are treating this place as a HOA, once your in your responsible for everything.  The gates are a joke, they claimed it was security, you are safer without them.  There were a couple of elderly tenants in the condos adjacent that felt safe in their homes until their homes were broken into and they were assaulted.  Once again, I think their is potential for this property, once they replace the office staff and finish their renovations.  Good Luck and patience, you are going to need both when your furnace is sitting on your patio in 32 degree weather, or no air conditioner on a hot 95 degree day.

Great area, and the new gate was a great addition, but as previous reviews have stated THEY SIMPLY DO NOT CARE ABOUT THE TENANTS! Maintenance is completely awful, it's actually worse now that management has changed, probably because there is only 1 maintenance guy for over 500 units now & clearly he is stretched thin, but with rent being so high you would think they would hire more people. All the new construction is causing more issues into other units, A/C unit keeps malfunctioning all of a sudden, flooding in my unit from water coming from upstairs renovation ruined my carpet,no one ever came to correct it, so I have to smell mildew every single day. A/C unit broken, resulting in more water damaging the carpet. They literally take 2-3 weeks to correct anything, and some issues you just have to ignore because they will never come. Completely inconsiderate but expect your money every month for the horrible living conditions.

I have lived here only 2 months and this place has been a sham since day 1 where my air unit went out. The management does not care about its tenants and forget about getting anything fixed in a timely manner. Oh did I mention they have RATS!! I've heard rodents in my walls for weeks and reported it to the office that doesn't seem to care  at all. Rodents in the walls turned into rodents in my kitchen eating bread in my pantry at night. The office refuses to let me out of my lease and not to mention they did not cover any holes in the apartment where the rodents may have entered, WE DID. I would really advise no one to move into this place. Upgrades are cheap and rushed, no quality. This place is old and falling apart. Please don't waste your money! One star is being generous. 1/2 star would be more than I would rate this place.

Having been a tenant for almost 3 years, I am more than frustrated with the new owners and management of The Roxbury. Initially the new management tried to make the current tenants feel at ease by jumping quickly onto taking care of maintenance orders, but as renovations began in 2017 and continue, work orders have gone to the wayside. Many people have air conditioners that aren't working, water leaks and other issues that aren't being addressed or taking care of. Their excuses for not taking care of the work orders are outnumbering the number of work orders. One excuse in particular is that there is only one repairman taking care of the issues. So, it could be a couple of weeks or more before my issues are taken care of! Unacceptable! At least hire a contractor to help out with the a/c issues for goodness sake! I never fail to pay my rent on time but this is the "thanks" I receive in return..."thank you for being a great tenant but your comfort really doesn't mean that much to us. We'll get to you when we feel like it". So, if keeping great tenants is so important to the Roxbury, their actions surely don't match the rhetoric. Moreover, after seeing much of the renovation work being done to some of the units, I am appalled at the poor workmanship so far. First of all, the new doors that have been installed have many gaps and aren't being sealed properly. You can see daylight around the edges. I had to seal up the doors myself. It doesn't matter to the Roxbury if our utility costs go through the roof because of this. They just want to slap on the "new" stuff and hope that it doesn't fall apart anytime soon. I can't believe they can actually get away with demanding $200 to $300 more a month in rent for putting lipstick on a pig. Sure, the face lift is long over due but it doesn't do any good when the quality of the workmanship is severely lacking. I could add much much more, but you get the picture. Having said all of this, I would caution anyone who is considering making a move to the Roxbury. If you intend to look at the property, ask to see a newly renovated unit instead of the demo. After all, more attention was made to the demo than any other unit. Currently I am looking for a house to rent or buy. At least I would feel justified in paying the higher rent or mortgage.

Worse place ever!!!!!!! I’ve been living here almost 3 years and have seen the drastic decline. Since changing ownership, maintenance doesn’t fix anything and management is not cooperative in correcting any concerns residents have. The rent has gone up $ 300. It’s not worth staying here. Can’t wait until my lease is up to leave!

The property is old and was recently bought out by a company from out of town. They jacked up the rent and are basically running all the current residents out. The new front office staff is horrible to deal with. They have no respect for the residents. And their idea of  maintenance or security is a joke. They are trying to slap a new coat of paint on the walls, replace carpet that should have been replaced long ago, and hiring new staff who address you as if you are poop on their shoe, and act like all this is an upgrade worth $200  more for rent. Stay away. You can rent a house for what they are trying to get in rent.

Do not rent here!  You can't get a simple repair done in less than two weeks of daily phone calls.  They are owned by some enormous, out-of-town company that does not care about ANYTHING other than their ledger.  My AC has been out for six days during 90-100 degree weather, and they still can't commit to when it will be fixed.  They refuse to offer me even a token consideration on my rent for six-days-and-counting of an unlivable apartment.  The apartments are shabby and broken down.  I have been miserable with them as my landlord!

From the outside looking in the apartments appear to be nice. Onthe inside they are old and outdated. When something breaks its months before its fixed. If you live in the front your mailbox is in the back so no quick trips to the mailbox

It was an overall decent stay until I moved into my 3 bedroom apartment. Yolanda moved me in knowing it was roach infested, when I asked to move she wouldn’t accommodate me. Pest control doesn’t come regularly and that’s a problem because I have children. A lot of holes in hard to reach areas so insects are getting into the home. Rent is far way to high for the quality of these apartments.

Riverdale School does not belong to Shlpy district where the apartments located, it belongs to Germantown district.
They add extra $90 dollars on the rent, they told me about it on the moving day.

The living space of these apartment homes are very generous. The space in each bedroom could easily be divided into another bedroom. Some negatives would be these units are old and the upkeep has not been the best and it really shows. I would hope that in the future they would find qualified contractors.
I enjoy being close to all of the stores and restaurants
Poplar place is simply NOT the place to stay if you’re looking for apartments with staff that care. I’d recommend looking elsewhere for housing.
Maintenance is a dream, responsive and professional. Management lacks.

I left the apartment in 02/2024 and it's now 06/2024 I have still not received my security deposit. Everytime I go to the office their managers keep telling me lies upon lies. Am definitely going to file a legal suit against them but I thought somebody should know. If you want to go through the stress I have been throught just to get my security deposit back from these people then you can go ahead and rent here. But if you really care about your time and your money, then please stay away from this apartment. Ofcos, they will make your move in easy but what about your move out?The incompetence of this management is beyond my understanding.  While I lived there almost every other month they tried to put extra charge on my account which I had to keep going to the office for correction. It's a terrible experience there!!! Stay away! Stay Away!! Stay away!!!

I would like to thank you all  for your kindness and professionalism.I forgot I was in Memphis Tn,These apartments look great.Yvonne and darius made the process very smooth.From the start to the end.I recommend these apartments to anyone looking for a nice place to live.

I’ve been here for going on a year and haven’t experienced any problems except for the smoke detector going off for no reason but they immediately came and fixed it they’ve done a lot of renovating including the parking lots and that was very much so needed but for the best part it’s nice here pretty quiet community and people here are friendly therefore I’d highly recommend considering Kensington Manor??

The neighbors are really loud and are always bumping. I had a problem with my A/C and I continuously put in Maintenace request to come fix it but they wouldn't come out it took them exactly 4 months before I had any A/C in my apartment. The outside is not well kept up or cleaned, The laundry is always dirty or something is out of order. Clothes are always left in the dryers and washers. There's always dog poop on the ground and in the grass so it lease the outside smelling horrible.

DO NOT MOVE HERE. Zero stars. Getting hold of anyone in the office is imposible when applying for the apartment and even more so once moved in. It is impossible to get anyone to come to your apartment to fix anything. I've emailed and called maitenence since i've moved in, 5 months, to fix an issue and am still waiting. They've only actually showed up once, didn't fix it, and continue to close the request without showing up. I've had noise issues as well the whole time, and management says they'll talk to people and get problems sorted but they do not. They also advertise a fitness center when there is none and no clear plans to create one. There is absolutely no insulation between my ceiling and the above people's floor and the windows are single panned and not sealed what so ever, so I get second hand weed in my apartment. It may looks nice but not worth the mental hassel of playing phone and email tag and having broken things in your apartment for months, if not longer.

Very nice apartments overall. Strict security. Pretty quiet for the most part. Down side: there’s always an outage in the area and the water gets turned off A LOT! I do mean A LOT as in often. They need lighting at the entrance it’s very dark and easy to miss. Finding a parking spot can sometimes be difficult
I have been a resident for 15yrs I really enjoy the staff and the community upkeep. They are friendly and supportive. Love living here

This was by far the worst apartment I have ever had. The staff is terrible. They never answer the phone or help with anything including maintenance issues. We had mold issues that we complained about several times that never got resolved. The air conditioner went out so many times that we had to purchase a portable one. Once we left, they did not give us our deposit back and charged us for the cleaning they finally decided to do for the mold. If you decide to stay here, good luck.

Tenemos una semana viviendo aquí y estamos felices, la etapa VI es muy bonita, limpia y callada además hay seguridad día y noche. En la oficina todos son muy amables y la verdad es bien fácil todo el proceso para mudarse. Lo único negativo es que no vimos el apartamento y el closet del cuarto secundario es muy pequeño para el tamaño del apartamento, tendremos que hacer un gasto extra comprado un mueble, el refrigerador es muy pequeño parece para un apt de una habitación. Les escribiré para que me ayuden a cambiarlo y así no tener que comprar un refrigerador adicional. Muchas cosas positivas el vivir aquí… Realmente es muy hermoso este complejo de apartamentos!
Lovely apartments , everything’s redone and amenities are up to date and our leasing agent TK was so excellent she was kind and quickly responsive great place to move

This place has me spoiled! The location, the amenities, the helpful staff (especially TK in the leasing office). And I so appreciate that the staff and the safety team are always attentive to the community making sure things are safe and peaceful. 
I’ve lived here before. Thought I’d try somewhere different….9 months later I’m right back and so glad to be here. Put this place at the top of your list to consider. Come be my neighbor!

I have lived at this community for a little over 14 years now.  There has never been a problem that the front office or maintenance could not fix.  Recently I decided to upgrade from Phase II to Phase VII with a garage.  The service given to me by the front office was beyond anything I could have imagined.  They guided me through every step of the process and most importantly worked with me on my busy schedule.  Such a wonderful and amazing staff.  I have lived at three different apartment complexes in my lifetime and this is the only one I truly have ever called home.
I lived at this apartment for almost 3 years. When leaving they refused to give my refundable security deposit back. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
It’s very Good neighborhood and locality’s but this year we faced so many maintenance issues. Some of them resolved quickly but few are still pending
I love the trees and the small lakes. Makes it feel like home. Some parts look a little neglected. Just getting use to the grounds and finding my way around
Love the resident the manager is nice and friendly I just love it here my kids love the pool and the playground it’s dog friendly I have no problems…
The staff was very friendly.  The apartment is nice but would like better lighting and nicer counter tops in the bathrooms. I enjoy the mature trees and landscaping.

Mr. Duffie, the manager in charge of new tenants is just outstanding. He makes you feel really at home. The property is beautiful and the apartment is spacious and elegant. 
I have been looking for a while and I made the best decision. This is the place to live in Germantown. I recommend this property.
I’ve lived here almost 2 years and I plan to renew another year. Friendly staff and beautiful apartments! Love the area too.

We live here since 5 th week and we have 5th weeks can’t taking a shower in our house. They know that my wife is pregnant and only put silicon or glue to fix this issue, it’s a really nightmare to my wife. It will be a very loooong year if this situation continues….
LOVED the 3 years I lived at Stonebridge! Staff is amazing, service requests were responded to in a timely fashion- just all around a great experience!

Do not move into this community! I ust recently moved here from out of town. They showed me the model and it looked great. I was excited to move to a unit near the main office and pool. Unfortunately just a few days after I moved into my apartment I started seeing roaches. I had my apartment treated the following Monday, which is their scheduled pest control day each week. They failed to have the other apartments treated on the same day. As a result, it is now week two and I still have roaches and other bugs appearing even after apartment was treated. I am now looking for another apartment because the property manager has failed to address the issue in a timely manner. Also the trash compactor is broke so there are piles of trash stackes on the ground each morning. Instead of fixing it, they have one of their maintenance guys manually loading trash into the compactor and using a pole to make everything fit. The only positive thing I can say is that the maintenance issues outside of getting rid od roaches was handled quickly.
