Even after they stopped the leaking I had a lovely large brown stain on my ceiling. =)

JUST DON'T DO IT...I lived there two years ...trust me
They cut your water off randomly....quite often actually

Neighbors are so LOUD, with walls so thin that Siri was able to tell me what song was playing upstairs. 

The new office staff is a joke..UNPROFESSIONAL 
EXPECT HIDDEN FEES
Even moving out gave me problems! 

There is no gate so random people from who knows where are always in the parking lot or the pool...whenever they please 

The apartments are extremely LOW QUALITY ...your paying for the location

This apartment really surprised me. I had an unrenovated unit and actually never saw it before I moved in, but it was one of the nicer unrenovated units! It was affordable on mud island, great amenities and very responsive and helpful office staff. The new property manager is AWESOME, and they're all very accommodating. I would recommend this complex to a friend. Oh and very nice and quick maintenance men! The dumpster is a hike unless you're right next to it, but no big deal. However, they could use a recycling bin. I think it's crazy they don't have one.

I've been a resident of Riverset for two months now and I love it. The location is perfect for when my dogs come visit and being so close to Harbor Town means there's always something to do. The office staff and maintenance always go above and beyond to help residents. If you're looking for an affordable, friendly place to live; look no further than Riverset Apartments!

I think this is a great place to live if you aren't too picky! 

First of all I love the area and, depending on where your actual apartment is located in the complex, there's great western views of the Mississippi River and super easy access to the park across the street. My sunset Instagram posts are ON POINT since moving in.

The tennis courts are GREAT.  I haven't really used the pools much but they look cool. My only real gripe is the GYM.  There's  a racquetball court and that's pretty darn cool. But as for the actual fitness center, half of the machines don't work and there are NEVER any sanitizing wipes available...I can't imagine how many peoples' sweat I bring home with me. But oh well, it's still possible to get a workout in.

As far as the apartment itself, fixtures/floors/cabinets are updated so that's a plus.  Maintenance requests seem to be handled fairly quickly.  The people in the office are nice. 

It's not perfect (hence 4 out of 5 stars) but I really like this place and would recommend it!
It has really nice pools and tennis courts but the apartment is nothing exciting. Let's just say I had to buy my own microwave and I was paying 1200

I've been at riverset apartments since March of this year.  My apartment was very clean when I moved in.  Electric is around 50 a month for my 2 bedroom, which I think is pretty good.  The pools are clean and they do a good job of making sure that it is for residences only.  Very per friendly.  My maintence request was completed in a timely manner.  Only complaint it that my water pressure when running the hot water is subpar.

Very convenient for UTHSC students. It's literally minutes from campus (I only drive 3 blocks to my parking lot for school) and even close to Beale St and all nightlife by the river or in Midtown and Overton Square. The office staff and maintenance guys are superb! If you are about walking to school, it's close enough to do that! I've never had any issues with anything.  They really do take care of you here! Very nice property! They offer a ton of floor plans so I'm sure you can find a floor plan that fits you!  There's a pool and gym onsite, gated property, dog run, dog wash, business center, covered parking and so much more!!! Come make the Bristol your new home! You won't regret it! If you are hesitant about moving to downtown Memphis because of the safety, I have never felt unsafe around the apartment.  I come back to the apt very late at night after studying and still feel safe. We've got a super security guard who walks around the complex making sure everything is ok all through the night. 

Make your move to the Bristol.  I dare you.  You will not regret it.

Looking for an apartment near UTHSC campus? Just 0.5 miles away. Nearly immediate response to maintenance issues. Covered parking, gated access, security guard patrol, recycling, a relaxing pool area, business center, gym, and the most phenomenal office staff you can imagine!! I love living at The Bristol on Union!!!
I have never had a more pleasant experience living anywhere. Great place to live. Leasing office is very responsive.

I've been in a 1 bedroom/1 bathroom at South Line for about two months now and I've been so impressed with my experience here. The units have an updated, modern design with high-end fixtures (love the REAL granite countertops!) and the quality is better than any apartment I've ever rented. They're also "green" units that are copiously insulated and even have light-filtering film on the windows, so utility bills for my unit have been under $60/month. Walls and floors are quite thick so ambient noise is very low. Lots of young professionals live here and everyone is so respectful and friendly. The property managers are fantastic; easily accessible and they routinely keep residents in the loop with goings-on within the apartment community or downtown, in general. 

South Line is close to everything you'd need - a four-minute drive from the core of downtown Memphis and unlike other properties in the area, they don't charge a parking fee. The community is gated and I feel safe taking my dog outside in the middle of the night, especially since a security patrol keeps watch over the area. You're situated in a lovely, upscale neighborhood that still retains the historic character of downtown Memphis.

Don't let the location right by the train tracks scare you - it's just the station and trains are quiet as they pull up. Sometimes they honk their horns during daylight hours but that's about it. I'm a light sleeper and I've never had an issue. If you want all the amenities of downtown Memphis with the streamlined beauty and peace-of-mind of new construction, you'll feel right at home here!

I love my new apartment. The location is perfect, your in walking distance to shops and restaurants. You are steps away from the farmers market, which I must add always have the best fresh produces. The community is full of young professional. Mgt and maintenance are the best. If your looking for a high end, safe environment then this is the community for you!!
The office ladies are rude and have no respect for you or your property.

Moved here to work at St Jude’s. Rented here after touring nice clean model.  The apartment is filthy and we seem to be the only ones that care. They took our money just fine though.  Offered to let us out of our lease but keep our $1805 deposit. They said our standards were too high and we should look for a new build. Can’t afford to go anywhere else because they have the money we spent in good faith when they said our apartment would be clean and we are living in a hotel. Now I’m afraid that because we can’t afford to go anywhere else without our money that we will be treated like crap the whole year we are obligated to.  Go somewhere else!
Timely and super understanding! Went about and beyond on a short notice…
It was a great experience with Great leasing team??
I moved in when the property first opened and just renewed my lease for the 2nd time. I love it here I hope to never leave!

My husband and I have been residents for almost two years and we love it. The units are upgraded, the community is safe and the neighbors/staff are friendly. Terrly and Carolyn are very friendly and go beyond to be helpful. I highly recommend this property.

as soon as i moved in the apartment the dishwasher didn’t work and a window was taped into place. 3 months later of asking to fix it, still no response. The restroom ceiling has begun to cave in due to a leak from upstairs and i fear it may collapse if not attended soon. Maintenance sucks here. “Renovations” are just the landlord special of painting over problematic areas. take this into consideration when considering this complex!

i love the look of the apartments but i will say that i’ve had some issues with trying to get any help and i’ve only been here a few weeks. when i moved in my window was busted and they have yet to fix it even with multiple notices. i also had a defective oven which leaked carbon monoxide and gas into my apartment. they sent someone to check it out but they just unplugged my oven and haven’t replaced it so i’ve been stuck without being able to cook anything for a week and no one has answered my calls or messages. it’s a shame because the place is so cute and put together i just don’t like how the issue isn’t more prioritized.

There are a few things that you have to deal with living in the complex currently.  First is the construction noise during the day, as not all the units are finished.  Secondly, I have come home to strong paint fumes when the units adjacent to mine were being repainted.  The landscaping is nice but there are some drainage issues and the leaves are not being kept up with.  Finally, with the location of the laundry room being a good distance away from most units; a folding table, hanging rack and change machine would be welcome additions.

First of all, it is not "gated" as advertised.  The metal gates are always open and anyone can just drive in at anytime.  Second, the wooden fence separating the property from the 
Greenline is in bad disrepair.   Third, a drive around the building shows broken windows, missing screens, and general neglect.   It doesn't matter how "renovated" the inside may be if the outside is this bad.

Love this location! So convenient to the Greenline trail and shopping (and restaurants). Quiet place to live and the new management is really making positive changes here! Happy to call this place Home.

The grounds stink, no windows are cleaned so they are very dirty outside and hard to look out of. Trash compactors stay broken. Mail packages are stolen. They don’t ensure apartments are clean and ready for move in prior to occupancy. Management doesn’t follow up on complaints

I had two cousins that recently stayed here! Nothing but bad things started happening as soon as they moved in! The apartments are not GATED and their cars were broken into multiple times. Poor management, they could care less and have no sympathy for what goes on their property. They do not answer when they know you have a problem they will ignore you for weeks! False advertising that their apartments are Gated, when they’re clearly not! Online they make it look so amazing and safe and that’s not the case. Months later my cousins are still waiting on their deposit that was promise to them after they moved out! All the apartments have mold!! Maintenance comes and fix things and leave your door unlocked. Coming from another state, I wouldn’t advise ANYONE to live here!!!
I love how close Tiger Estates is to campus, and the neighborhood has so many great locations close by to eat and gather with friends.
Very quiet area. Nice neighborhood. Definitely worth the investment would recommend to anyone 10 out of 10. I have yet to see anything wrong with this location a lot better than some places I've been
Tiger Estates provides easy living and convenience for a student getting to and from the University. I love the area and the privacy that the bedroom ensuites give

Just don’t do it, trust me mane. This place isn’t what it seems. My air conditioner has been leaking for 6 months, I called maintenance (no answer)  I’ve also reached out to management (no answer). The front gate is pointless because cars still get broke into, this place is a living hell hole.

This place is not what it seems AT ALL! Their money hungry..maintenance will never answer and if they do it’ll take half the lease to fix a issue like A/C when its 99 degrees outside..Oh then in the winter the heat doesn’t work also. Property Mangers are janky they won’t answer. It looks nice but once your a month in you’ll realize what you got yourself into. I stayed here for a year and half. They still don’t have decency to respect my request or EVEN ANSWER!!
Great maintenance. Goes above and beyond. Takes his time. And does the job well, and efficiently the first time.
Art Lofts at Overton is a beautiful community and location is perfect especially if you work at St. Jude or any where off poplar. The staff is always going above and beyond to meet my needs

My car along with 25+ others have been broken in to continuously over the course of a month. Management covers it up and just won’t show up for work. Tupi find out a car got ransacked by walking out to shattered glass that will never get cleaned up. Beautiful space but shady management. Go somewhere else
Amongst a frightening amount of vehicle break-ins and vehicle theft, the management neglected to address the lack of adequate security to prevent this from continuing.

Perfect Location! Art lofts is a beautiful, clean, and quiet environment. A few things I love is the washer/dryer in unit, the beautiful pool & patio area, and the private parking garage. Not to mention the property manager and staff are very friendly and helpful.

My boyfriend and I have been here for about two months now and it is a great place to live. The staff is very nice and helpful. We have a studio apartment and have had no problems that we weren’t able to get resolved quickly.
This is a great apartment community. The staff is extremely nice and helpful. The landscaping is also great. The pool areas are peaceful and nice. I love this property.

Miller Creek is on the pricier side for cost of living in Memphis; however, it is so worth it. You receive valet trash, an active alarm, full size working washer and dryer, and the community amenities are worth the investment. The apartment complex is like a small happy neighborhood where we have random community gatherings over wine, at the pool, or in the club house. If you're a gym rat like me, you'll love the 24 hour fitness center. I've lived in several apartment complexes and it is hard to find a community with an adequate fitness center with working equipment. I've never had a problem with a machine and the facility is always clean. I love the management team here. The only downfall is, I hear people come up and down the stairs, but you'll find that in most apartments if you're on an end unit. The location is perfect for food shopping, retail therapy, and super easy access to the highway. Love it. I highly recommend it to any family. It's a great, quiet, yet fun community.

New and beautiful apartment. Mostly a great neighborhood. Being right behind sketchy apartments and having our apartments be a part of section 8, it leaves room for people that live three families into one apartment. There is no security officer here to deal with noise complaints and tenants who violate rules.  The perimeter gates do not close all the way around, leaving room for people to slide through or climb over easily. I wish it was harder to apply to live here. It seemed to be a rigorous background check process, but apparently not. 
Also, the walls in the apt are paper thin! I can hear my neighbors talking at night. The managements way of dealing with a neighbors dog barking or a loud neighbor is to call the sheriff. I hate having to call the sheriff just for a dog barking.....

Never in my wildest dreams could I have imagined being so excited about moving into apartment homes.    MillerCreek Apartment Homes are not only beautiful on the outside; the interior is just as beautiful.  The large rooms and closets rivaled most homes that I have lived in. And...just when I thought that the apartment community could not get any better, I'm greeted with an excellent staff and fabulous amenities such as a valet garbage pick-up, a cyber cafe, media room, and a yoga room separate from the exercise room and the list goes on.  The location is only a few minutes away from the most popular shopping centers and situated in the heart of the two municipalities. I moved on the 3rd floor. The view overlooks part of the city and is especially beautiful when night falls and the lights shine across the horizon.  I have signed up for text and emails with the leasing office and look forward to what they post daily about happenings at our community and could not be more happy to call Miller Creek my home.

I recently moved into Miller Creek Apartments and the atmosphere here for young professionals is unlike any other apartment complex I have ever lived. There is a full gym, cyber café, and theater room accessible at any hour of the day, the pool always has a fun crowd during the weekends, and best of all, the Miller Creek front office hosts different events for their residents every week of the year. The majority of the residents who live here are responsible and I feel safe 100% of the time. I would recommend this apartment complex to anyone looking for a new place of residency.
This is a five star Apartment Community and the Office staff is awesome!! The best apartment complex in Memphis!!!

I have lived here for almost 3 years now and ever since Wogan group bought it last year it has gone downhill fast. The gates never work. They will raise rent yearly. They are asking way too much for the amount of crime in that area. Also a ridiculous amount of hidden fees that are useless like the "package concierge" fee. You have to pay it but still your packages end up on poplar ave waiting to be stolen or at someone else's front door. If the driver can even get in the place. Horrible response times from the property manager as well. I think im going on 1 month now from the last email I sent without a response. They also use some apartments as airbnbs (which of course they dont tell you that) so there are always strangers coming in and out trashing the place or being disrespectful. The only saving grace is the apartments themselves are quite nice inside.

I have lived here at the Midtown Apartment Complex for almost 4 years during that time I have had problems with rent payments but my issues were always addressed with kindness and an open minded opinion, and the option of when I would be able to pay my rent. I've never had any bad interactions with the staff, they are always polite and very genuine. A very good place to rent from!!!!!!!!!!

1 is too high of a score for this complex. I am currently dealing with a pest issue and it seems like management could care less about their tenant of 3 years. When the Leasing Manager first took over he was hands on but it seems like ever since he has more tenure he could care less about anyone. I will be calling BBB.

I have lived at LOG for the past two years, and I am completely done with the added fees of living here as well with the bugs. These apartments are infested and you have to remind the office staff for pest control to come MULTIPLE times for a slight chance that they will come and spray your apartment. 

I will be leaving based on the lackluster service in regards to the pest control, the fees that add roughly $80 to the rent for the place, and security does not do anything. People do whatever they want at the pools. People bring alcohol when there are children there and I have seen several people smoking cigarettes while in the pool with others in the vicinity, all while security sits on their phones and does nothing. 

I would not recommend living here at all.

This place is fantastic. The maintenance was on point and the staff is very nice. However, I had to give it four stars instead of five because they charge you for cable which is a part of the rent even though you don't really use cable at all.

If you move here be sure pest control spray the apartment. They charge you monthly for pest control fees but you are lucky if they come and spray. And you would think pest control will come monthly to all the apartments so nobody has unwanted roommates. But nope you will have to call(lots of time) to remind the staff and ask if pest control will be coming, and if they do not come you will still be charged. Nonsense

This is just an average apartment. rent seems below the market price, but there is a required $45 cable fee on top of the rent which I think it's not fair. interior does not look new. bugs are out of control during the summer. fortunately staff here are very helpful.

I have lived in LOG for almost a year now and I love it. It's very quiet and has a diverse culture of residents. The leasing office is really good at rectifying maintenance issues and fairly quickly including the after hours maintenance staff.

This place is repugnant. Filthy and dirty. Every floor stinks. Dogs are allowed to pee and poop everywhere but they only clean one floor. Several of my expensive shoes have been ruined due to the filthy, wet, peery, and doo doo carpet. This may as well be a pet and rodent motel. The worst place I have ever stayed. The elevators are no better. Often filled with pee, filth, and stink. If you have allergies and don’t like filth I advice you to stay away. The side doors glass hasn’t been wiped looks like all year

I moved in early August of this year.  The management team has been amazing since day 1.  I've lived all over the country for my work and I can't tell you how refreshing it is to have kind, helpful and responsive management.  The amenities are excellent.  The walls must be thick or I have very quiet neighbors.  Love the location just wish they would start playing baseball again!
This location cannot be beat.  Perfect spot.  I love it here!

I give our apartment a 4 star BC its nice and quiet the maintenance people are always so helpful. The leasing office people were nice and helpful until some of them started to make broken promises but in all its a cool place to live.

These are great apartments! The buildings are clean and well maintained, the staff is great, and most of the neighbors are grad students or young professionals. This is hands down the best place for Millennials to live in the downtown area. The only downside is that is takes about a week for maintenance to respond to non-emergency requests for repairs.
This has to be one of the best places that I have lived in Memphis, the staff and management are the best...

The other tenants who say this place needs Zero stars are absolutely right. AC is always out and never working. Nothing ever gets fixed. Plumbing issues, cars constantly get broken into. Leasing Office people are rude and will tell you anything including flat out lying, to get you off the phone or out the leasing office. Months go by with constant complaining over the same thing and nothing gets fixed. Even the Security gate is always broken. Do yourself a huge favor and save yourself a lot of misery, look elsewhere.

im a current resident here, I've been dealing with a leaking toilet , no air , animals. (raccoons ) in the attic of the apartment and faulty appliances that cause outrageous electrical bills!!! maintenance never shows up to fix anything and the staff including the property manager lie intentionally just so you won't stay on them about getting anything fixed. if you think you found a home here I urge you to continue your search ! I wouldn't recommend a crack head to live in these ran down apartments. lastly everyone working in that leasing office needs to be fired ASAP they have no type customer service and they're attitudes are horrible

The apartments are horrible they refuse to fix anything and when someone does come out to so called fix things it is never done correctly and the problem is never fixed . The rent is constantly increased yet we have been in this apartment for a year now have not been able to get in the pool one time whatever the reason maybe air has not worked properly for one full day they have sent out people multiple times yet still no air. 
We literally have to put air conditioners in our apartment just so that our children aren’t burning up in this Memphis heat . The office staff is horrible they put a sticker on my car because I have multiple cars sometimes this car sits I was told to drive it to the office or the vehicle will be towed and that the office hours are from 9 to 5 I was there exactly at nine and literally the office worker did not show up until 10:30. Four times since we’ve been here they randomly turn off your water with no heads up or warning. Not to mention there was some kind of animal I believe a raccoon in our roof and when I told a maintenance person seen around the apartments in their golf cart about it he literally told me “ they are friendly big bro just give him my name “ . Really not sure what kind of management this apartment is under but they need an entirely new staff and I would highly recommend you staying in the middle of any hood in Memphis before moving into these apartments literally the worst experience I’ve had with any residence. Ps there are so many stray cats and the garbage bins constantly overflow not to mention there’s only two for the entire apartment complex and the front gates with the security code literally have not worked longer than a week . So anyone literally anyone can come in and out of your apartment complex at any time the so-called security can be seen at the front kicked back in their car doing nothing. DO NOT I REPEAT DO NOT MOVE HERE . If this was a last resort for apartments I would move out of the city! Going to have to break the lease and find better worst experience of my life.

First, the management is RUDE and they don’t know how to talk to people. They’ll make up bs charges so that you don’t get your security deposit back. They handle ALL situations/problems very unprofessionally.
Second, The interior of the apartment is completely outdated, and not worth the rent. No matter how clean your apartment is you will see bugs. When I first moved in (just got the keys, checking it out) dead roaches in the refrigerator and the cabinet. I had to deep clean the apartment before I moved ANYTHING in???? Something is always breaking, or broken already. The refrigerator door handle, lights, doors, locks, windows,etc. They way they “fix” things is so disappointing and unreliable, you’ll be calling or putting in request for the same thing every time. 
Third, the secured gate, is ALWAYS broken (waste of time/money paying for a gate card) Cars get broken into. The parking lot is full of extremely deep potholes and they don’t fill them and won’t pay for damages done to the car because of them. 
Just look somewhere else because these apartments aren’t worth the money, headaches, problems you’ll encounter living here.

This apartment complex is one of the top 3 worst apartments to live in Memphis whether it’s your first time renting or looking for a new apartment. There are a series of daily gunfire within the complex and the surrounding area along with car crashes, police sirens, illegal night drag racing, and traffic jams. There is also, literally little to no security patrolling the property, and when they do patrol the property they’re only here for a couple hours out of the whole day. This area looks great in terms of location and conveniency for your daily wants and needs. But the majority of stores and restaurants have little to no staff service, there’s always a shortage of goods that last for at least a week, and it’s a constant bustling area with springing gas prices. So, I typed all this to genuinely say as a previous resident to save a potential apartment leaser to PLEASE save your time and money by NOT moving into this apartment complex or this area of Memphis in general.

I have been here for almost a year now. The apartment is good , The neighborhood is quiet, it depends on who you live beside basically .. the ONLY downfall I had was a  sink that was basically patched up and maintenance took about a month to fix & my dish washer doesn’t work. They have neighborhood watch, everything you need is literally 3-5 mins away.

WORST APARTMENTS IN MEMPHIS. DO NOT MOVE HERE. My neighbor and I had major plumbing issues for months, with SEWAGE, HUMAN WASTE, and USED CONDOMS overflowing into our bathtubs for WEEKS. Not to mention several FLOODS. Management failed to correct the problem for months until we got the health department involved. When they finally did correct the sewage issue, they left a PUDDLE OF SEWAGE AND POOP outside of my window for days. My neighbor and I requested to move units an uncountable number of times, to which they denied and wanted to charge nearly $1000 for the application to even be submitted. They gave some excuse about being too far along in our leases to transfer units.
Other major HEALTH RISKS and damages incurred included the HVAC systems being sealed shut and never being changed upon inspection, several property items lost during floods, and the obvious MOLD that must be festering in the floorboards of the unit after flooding so many times. In addition, there is always a layer of TRASH on the ground throughout the complex.
The management and office staff are the most INCOMPETENT, APATHETIC, and UNPROFESSIONAL people I have EVER had the displeasure of dealing with. They only care about getting your money.
It's remarkable these units haven't been condemned. Living here has been an ABSOLUTE NIGHTMARE.
DO NOT GIVE THESE PEOPLE YOUR MONEY.

If I have could give zero stars I would. I have been living here for a little over a year, and I hate it. I had heard good things before I moved here so I thought it would be good, especially for a single person on a budget. I have lived in apartments that cost less but were much better quality. The air in my apartment stops working frequently. I have put in several requests, some of which were never responded to. Maintenance keeps saying my air will never reach the temperature that the thermostat is set to and that the unit is not sufficient to cool a three-story apartment building. To me, that means there is a problem on the part of the property management. However, I was told that due to a leak in my a/c into the apartment below mine, that I would be charged if I put MY AIR below 70 degrees in an apartment that I pay rent for and utilities. I was outraged that they would suggest charging me after I have already told them that there is a problem with the unit, which they clearly already know.  It never gets below 75 degrees no matter what temperature I put my a/c on. When it's on 70, it works for a few days after maintenance comes in to patch it up and then it's right back up to 80+ degrees. They care more about the person below me having a leak than me burning up. I can't even sit in my living room comfortably most days because it's so hot. There is a horrible raccoon problem. They have previously damaged my ductwork according to maintenance. I'm sometimes scared to leave my house because of the raccoons. They run around in the attic all night, yet I'm told there's nothing that can be done other than setting traps (which clearly isn't helping). My freezer constantly freezes up and cause my refrigerator to stop running properly. The toilet in the bathroom runs constantly. I am so dissatisfied. I will say the people the leasing office are always nice to me. However, that has not made up for the multitude of problems that I have encountered. I have been tempted several times to just break the lease because it is that horrible. I am waiting on the day that my lease is up.

This place is Terrible. On the outside the place is decent up front but on the inside that's a totally different story! My fiancé and I have live in these apartments for only 3 months. Our dry has broke and it takes 2 hours to dry 1 load of clothes. Our water heater has leaked all on the floor. There are water stains on our bathroom ceiling and bedroom ceiling. Which we were told a month ago that it would be fixed. On top we have put in 20 request to have our toilet fixed and they come in plunge it and then let flush once and say the fixed it. The minute they leave I go to flush it again and it doesn't flush. We have brought it to the attention of one of the apartment managers and said that they had to get a contractor in and that was out of his hands. Also we have found roaches in out apartment and were paying for pest control so I brought to the apartment managers attention and he said oh those are water bugs. Water bugs or not they are still a pest and if Im paying for pest control I better not have any pest. There are tears in our floor as well and we have to slam our door shut because the hinge is to close to the second door. The bushes are have lots of trash in them as well and the second dumpster does not work half of the time. I would never recommend this place to anyone and it is very over priced!

I have lived here for a year and I have had nothing but issues. There are drugs deals always going on in the parking lot. The gates are never working so anyone can get in and out of the complex. The property manager Don doesn't care when something personally happens to you. He pretty much brushed it off. I have had raccoons in my attic since day 1 and they now are always running around the parking lot. I have had a person in my attic as well at 3 am. There has been several car break ins and when I called to ask when the gates would be fixed they said a few days it's still not fixed. My car has personally been broken into. People have come pounding on my door at 10 pm and would not say who they were. It's very unsafe and very unclean. I enjoyed living there until the complex got sold in the fall. Ever since the new management has taken over it's been awful. Any time I have called to address these issues no one calls  back and they do not get resolved.

***UNSAFE*** Do not move to these apartments!!! I have been a resident for 2 years, and there have been several armed robberies, dozens of vehicles burglarized, and gunshots fired on apartment grounds frequently. My vehicle has been broke into 3 times, lease is up next month, and will be moving out and warning others of this place. They spend money making the grounds look nice, but the apartments are full of criminals. The only security (besides the gate that is always broken, likely by the criminals who need access), is a rent a cop who makes a few rounds every night with a flashing light on his golf cart, alerting criminals of his presence.

I'm a new tenant and this is the first apartments that I've leased. I was really nervous about it being my first apartment. This community is quite and secured. I love and enjoy my new apartment and all of its amenities. I really feel secure with the gated entrance and the fact of knowing security is on the patrol. I wanted an apartment with washer & dryer in the apartment and I am very satisfied that they have this feature.I love that these apartments are in distance of my job. That is very important to me. If you love your phone calls and emails to be ignored this is the place for you. Work orders are completed at their leisure. Good luck with getting in touch with anyone to even submit it and when they finally do answer the phone, it’s the most rudest person ever. Contacted the regional and she seemed unbothered as well. This place does not care about their residents.

I have been a resident here at Appling Lakes for about 4 months. I have had to deal with mice, the maintenance staff not fixing things, rude office staff (management as well), and tons of other things. The first impression that they give you is a trap. I even went as far as contacting the company (Cottonwood) that owns this property about my issues and all they have done is take $100 off one months rent. I talked to the manager Keri and I get yelled at as if I am her child, when I addressed her about what the maintenance crew is doing that I see on a regular basis. When calling Cottonwood you never get to speak to no one but the front desk staff who I think in the whole matter cares but are limited to what they can do.

PLEASE AVOID THESE APARTMENTS!!!! We lived here for 11 months and it has been a horrible experience. First the management is horrible and will scam you out of money, we moved into the apartment it had so many problems and it was affected with ROACHES we complain about the issues to the manager nothing was done. Second this gate was down for 4 to 5 months but i was paying for a gated community. Third we had several leaks in our apartment and the stove barely works but maintenance still haven't fixed. I have pictures of the ROACHES and the LEAKS for proof

I'm surprised this apartment complex has not been run into the ground by the Manager Kathleen! She is not management material treats the tenants like dirt, well unless you are a Police officer, a fireman, a teacher, or other wise recognized individual in the community. 

DO NOT MOVE HERE ! 
 
The last straw for me was the neighbor upstairs had a water leak.  So rather than taking care of it correctly they left my apt. soaked. After about the fourth day of no one doing anything I went to the office and complained about the mold growth that was starting on my walls. Kathleen immediately got defensive and told me that it was not mold and that It will be taken care of. 

There remedy was to come over and wipe the walls off with a cloth. Which in turn spread more spores through out my house. 

I was paying almost 1,000 a month to live in a two bedroom apt. My lease just expired the same month so I let them know that I was moving. She stated that I cannot move out and must let me know by the 6th of the month other wise I will break my month to month lease and be penalized.  My rent has increased to 1,400 for my month to month lease.  

In order to get out of my month to month lease I had pay $400 to a Mold Inspector to come out and test.  Sure enough the Tests came back as Highly elevated mold (Aspergillum). 

So after moving out of Appling lake Apt. I had to dispose of 75% of the things I owned and start over. 

Just one of my experiences with them !

After writing the last review about a month ago pretty much nothing has changed. The light bulbs in our breezeway were finally replaced a week after the review,  And 3 months after we moved in and said something that very day. The trash in lake has not been picked up, it's actually accumulated more trash, and the fountain in the lake stopped working 2 weeks ago. The lake looks disgusting. 
They finally got a new trash compactor last week....after 2 months of not having one. 
The landscaping around the back of my building is still horrible. They haven't gotten the dead shrub out still or trimmed any others. We were informed that they only trim shrubs once a year.
The water bill here is so stupid. There is only 2 of us in the apartment and every month the bill goes up. Right now it's $60 just for water. That's insane!! Our electricity bill isn't any better. We hardly ever have lights on. The air conditioner is what is eating all the electricity. It's an old unit and an even older thermostat. We have said something to the office more than once and nothing has been done. 
The gates have been broken for at least 2 months. Peoples apartments have gotten broken into. Just don't move here!

Apartment has ample room and garage.
Large rooms
patio
Poorly insulated
Cold when it's cold outside
warm when it's hot outside.
Swimming pool.
gym has gone from 24 hours a day to only being open during office hours
Security gate uses codes which many people share with others

I have  been a resident at Appling Lakes since the beginning of the year and I have to say of all the apartments I've searched, this one gave the most bang for my buck. As a single parent, we are always searching for economical housing without sacrificing location and safety. Appling Lakes gives me all. My three bedroom apartment is spacious (at over 1500 sq ft). I enjoy  a double patio facing the woods, and my unit has a fire place and garden tub. For this area and space given,  you absolutely cannot beat the price. The staff is wonderful! I have never had any issues here. I feel safe and so do my children. No one is saying to expect perfection. But for the price, the neighborhood and all the luxuries that the apartment offers, this is a good deal. Did I mention the beautiful landscaping and pool? Definitely check it out. It's worth it.
Application process was smooth and easy , don’t understand need for admin fee!!!
Manangement is shady and dishonest. I could write for hours about how unhelpful and incompetent the staff is, but just head my warning and find somewhere else

The new apartment managers are nice but they seem to have way more work on their hands than they were prepared for. The apartments were renovated cheaply, leaving WAY too many issues to solve through maintenance requests. Feels like I am paying them to renovate their own apartment.

This is a little hidden gem however the jury is still out for the full review.  The complex is going through a remodeling phase with the roofs, pools, and other additions.  I’ll update once all those those things are completed.  Nice not having upstairs neighbors.  Quiet so far.

The ladies in the office are so pleasant and their mood is just a plus! Miss Joyce was so funny and the fact that she sings her words is a bonus! They made the move in process so easy and were very helpful!
The staff is wonderful and very communicative! I like my new home and I recommend people to come and live here! The leasing agents are very talkative and communicative.

If you enjoy sleeping and working in a room over 80F degrees or spending the nights on the sofa downstairs, the townhomes are your place to live! Look closely when you visit, most townhomes have either a portable air conditioner (yes, sounds like a jet engine taking off, like the other review below) in the master bedroom window or they only allow window units in the rooms in the back (so future residents don't notice it). We have our thermostat on 65 and the master bedroom is still marking 80F! We requested that it be fixed many times and their answer was "There is nothing else we can do". Well, there is: fix that issue in the townhomes or be honest before renting to the next resident.
No complaints. The office is helpful and responsive. Would recommend for other potential residents.

The location is probably one of the best I’ve seen in the Memphis area if you are wanting to be close to downtown.. yet still in a safe area. Moving in was a breeze and it was already spotless before move in. Great if you are looking for a safe, clean, pet friendly apartment.

Our move-in process was very easy. We knew exactly what we wanted and the staff helped us navigate available properties and were excellent communicators throughout the process. They showed us multiple floorplans and let us take the measurements we wanted prior to moving in. Since moving in we have loved the location and the amenities, especially the fire pit, outdoor lounge area, and the proximity to the Wolf River Greenway. The staff have been quick to address any issues we have had and we have been happy to be residents here!

I have been living at the Arbors at River Oaks for two years now. I have not had any complaints. The location is very safe, next door to a hospital district and located right near the main interstates in the city of Memphis. It is also located right in the center of everything. It takes me 15 minutes to get to any part of the city that I would like to go to. The residents are really friendly and are always looking out for their neighbors. This is really a great community!

The location is fantastic. Quiet, safe, green area. Close to everything. Management is about average. They are very kind and polite, but not the fastest in getting things done. Same goes for maintenance. Overall a good place to live.

I’ve lived at this property for 2 years now, with absolutely no problems the first year. In the second year, Stella Maris property management has taken over and there is an extreme roach problem that they refuse to resolve. PLEASE save your time & money and avoid these apartments. It’s absolutely disgusting!

First off, the leasing office is so helpful and personable. The security, housekeeping, and maintenance workers are so helpful and sweet. They make you feel at home. I was a single girl and always felt safe. It's very quiet and can't hear anyone. You feel like you live in a community with fun activities planned.

I have lived in three different apartments at Metro 67-- two with roommates and one alone-- and I am so thankful to have had the chance to live in such a great community. Management does a great job of hosting little community events to help you meet your neighbors, and the rooftop during the warm months is the absolute best. The other amenities are great as well. My top two favorite features are the secured doors and elevators as well as the quietness of the building. I have always had neighbors above me but rarely even know that other people exist in the building. It is by far the most quiet place I've ever lived. I really appreciate all that the staff does to keep Metro 67 clean and well maintained. If there is ever a cleaning or maintenance issue, they are super quick to respond. It's hard to expect perfection with apartment living, but Metro 67 does a great job at doing their best to make this the perfect place to live!

I LOVE living here! I was pretty nervous moving alone downtown in Memphis but I feel so secure now. Every floor requires a keycard and there’s a tunnel to connect to parking across the street. Love the communication from the office and maintenance team when theres an issue and even when I just want to say hi. Everyone is super friendly. They even have breakfast in the lobby sometimes. It’s been a great adjustment and I love talking to my neighbors while we drink a glass of wine at the end of the day watching the sunset from the rooftop. Sooo dreamy! Overall great experience so far. Happy to stay as long as it’s this good.

Best apartment building and staff we have ever lived in!  The entire staff goes above and beyond to help out their tenants, and treat everyone like family.  The apartments themselves are beautiful, with great finishings.  The floors look great, and the kitchen is spacious with a modern feel.  Any maintenance issue (which is rare) is resolved within 24 hours every time.  Special shout out to the the management staff: Morgan, Emily, and Cage; security team: Charles and Sam; cleaning crew: Tiesha; and maintenance staff: Sam.  Overall, an outstanding team and building, and would highly recommend to anyone looking to live in downtown Memphis!

At first glance Metro 67 is a great looking property. A very large and nice marble lobby greets you, the elevators are clean and bright, your apartment has wood floors and granite counter tops. The property does a good job with the big things people notice like the floors and counter tops. The dishwasher and 2-in-1 washer/dryer in the unit are 2 big pluses. Security if excellent, a security card is needed to get into the building and also you your floor. The underground tunnel to the parking garage is especially helpful when the weather is lousy. 

Try to look past the initial "shiny" items when considering this property. 

My biggest gripes:
Windows:
You cannot open your windows if they are facing the street, you can get an interior unit that faces a very small courtyard with nothing but rocks or you can go with the alley view. On a side note, the alley can become very loud around midnight when the neighboring hotel starts throwing out their restaurant and bar trash,(BTW, there are about 4 large dumpsters in that alley, things tend to spoil rather quickly in Memphis summers). You can experience the outside or view the outside, not both.

Water:
I find it a little too dirty. Once a month I need to clean the dirt and goup that forms on the head of each faucet. I am not from Memphis originally so that just may be how water here is but for me it's very off-putting when I see something black dangling from my faucet when I'm brushing my teeth. I filter any tap water I use.

Technology:
There is a $30/mo fee for SD cable TV, there is no way to opt out nor can you upgrade the service.  You can get a satellite package but you are still forced to pay that $30 fee.  The service is downright awful, channels are constantly disappearing and are formatted incorrectly so that the edges are cut off.
  
Internet:
DSL through AT&T is the only option.  The fastest available speed is 18Mbps at $45/mo before fees.  Consider that the cable ISP in the same area costs $30/mo for 25Mbps.  I don't know if Metro or the ISPs are to blame for this problem, but considering other buildings on the same block have access to cable internet I'm going look at the Metro first. Given that the majority of tenants are young professionals, I would think a good technology infrastructure would be a priority.

In a nutshell I would say the property uses a Versace box for Walmart item.

Pros:
Good "big" stuff
Attached parking garage
Security

Cons:
Water
Windows
Tech
Details
Stay away from free wifi

Madison 67 is touted as the swankiest address in downtown Memphis and that is totally accurate. It's also very safe, clean, spacious and fun to live in. The staff is very attentive and prompt with maintenance. The rooftop view is the best in the city. The party rooms in the converted basement are the perfect space for any event you can dream up. The building is a former bank. The walls are insulated so there's no stomping neighbors and worries of loud noise coming through. I love my apartment and am so glad that I live here. I'm steps away from the most sought after restaurants, bars and entertainment in downtown Memphis.

The property itself is ok. But, they don't tell you before you sign the lease that there is a loud night club next door. I didn't find out until I moved in and spent my first nights. The club really doesn't start getting louder until 9 p.m. It reaches a crescendo around midnight and doesn't stop until 1 or 2 depending on the night. Ear plugs don't help much because the main disturbance is the vibration and base. I discussed this with the apartment and they offered to move me to another unit on the other side of the complex, for more money. So, if sleeping is something that you enjoy at night, stay away from here. I will be leaving as soon as my lease is up.

I struggle to be positive about this apartment complex as they enable bad residents, fail to communicate well, and are slow to solve maintenance issues (if they do so at all). There is a lack of comfortable parking reasonably distanced to a residence. I was flat lied to that there were regular community events and that things would remain clean. It is not uncommon for their to be pet waste left out or the doors to fail to lock. The high staff turnover seems to be the reason for the steep decline in quality.

Probably the worst “luxury” apartment in Memphis. Leasing staff never communicates with their residents about anything because they are too busy trying to increase their commissions. Consistent car break-ins because leasing will not hire security. The main entrances to the buildings do not even lock which poses a huge safety issue. The hallways smell so bad from trash always being left out. Maintenance usually shows up unannounced or enters without permission. Residents are always breaking their lease soon after they move in because they realize how bad it is. I’m surprised they can charge as much as they do for rent because they have nothing to show for it.

Demarius Is the reason why it’s excellent. We are not from this area and were skeptical about being in a new area however Demarius went far and beyond the call of duty to make us feel welcome and that did not go unnoticed No matter what problems we were having he took care of it and did not make us feel bad about having to call on him so frequently the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming  the apartment was nice and clean I could go on and on about our experience but there isn’t enough time I would definitely recommend Midtown Madison Memphis Tn to anyone in need of a home away from home awesome job keep up the great work!!!

Taylor is so sweet in very helpful. She went out her way to help me in any way she can. The Waterford is very grateful to have her. I hope my next stop will be here. Thank you Taylor for the Great experience.

I had a great experience. I was greeted well and openly, also was explained everything very well. I really liked the self touring, which was something new for me. Most of all the receptionist were very helpful with great attitudes!
'Jasmine were phenomenal with her hospitality doing the tour site.. She can persuade anybody to move over there with her courtesy and gratitude.. well appreciated!!

the maintenance service is very bad, the management ignores you. They offer you one thing and then you find others. the apartments have many details and do not fix them. the pool in summer almost always dirty. If you have something to repair, it takes days to resolve. the main entrance is damaged. very little security.
My complex has gone through many changes however this time it seems to be getting better.  The apartments are getting updated and the staff seems to truly be concerned about making things better.

I moved to this apartment after living in a house for 10 years. The size, amenities,  and spaciousness of my apartment, along with a garage gives me the feel of still living in a house. I have lived here for five years and love it here. The leasing office and maintenance staff is wonderful and responsive to all requests. The complex is beautifully landscaped with a wonderful outside appearance. The location is perfect, with access to 385, good schools, shopping, dining, and entertainment. I plan to live here for years to come.

Trash has piled up all over the place (including a dead cat affixed to the dumpster that was left there for over a week). It feels like a dumpster fire. Prices are way too high and continually increasing all while the property is going downhill. As I went to go pay my rent today I noticed I was charged for something I opted out of - and even if I hadn't opted out I would have been overcharged. 
The new property manager refuses to come out of the office while residents, prospects, and vendors pile up in the office for the leasing agent alone to assist. It is unprofessional and is a shame to see all of the hard work Katie and Karlie put into this property go to waste. If I hadn’t just renewed my lease, I would not choose to live here for another year.

I lived in these apartments with a river view for 4 years. During the last year of my lease the management changed over to Main South Management. They came in deciding that apartments needed upgrades (new fridge, oven/stove, dishwasher, microwaves, garbage disposals, a tile backsplash added in kitchens, new hardware on cabinets, new counter tops, and deeper kitchen sinks…in all honesty none of this was necessary - what I wish they would have upgraded was the terrible washing machine they have in the units!). Most units are still relying on the original installed air condition units. My unit’s air condition died in the summer and took a full 2 weeks to completely fix (while COVID work from home was in place – apartment temperatures exceeded 90° at times). I got caught in the middle of Main South Management forcing residents out of their current units so they could remodel. They didn’t have the decency to attempt to keep current residents in a similar model. By the time I got the notification of my having to vacate and talked to the office about leasing options, there were no other similar units for me to choose from. I’d either need to upgrade to a larger unit with a 25% rent increase (this included the measly discount offered to current residents) or move elsewhere. I moved out. Before my lease ended I had an issue with dripping water from my garbage disposal. This repair took longer than a week to fixe, even though water damage should be seen as a serious maintenance concern and was resolved only after I made multiple appearances in the leasing office and e-mailed management staff regarding my issue. It appeared they were hoping they could just ‘wait out the repair’ until I moved out in 2 months. My advice to you is that if it is taking over 24 hours for a serious maintenance concern to e-mail or call upper management directly, NOT the leasing office. Also, it took me over 90 days (twice the amount of estimated time) to receive my deposit reimbursement after moving out. That also required chasing after management. From what I had witnessed with the newest management at this apartment complex, I would NOT recommend.  They jacked up rent prices to the point that this complex is now one of the most expensive on the Island, staff in the leasing office is useless, consider the state of the air condition unit you are receiving, and ask yourself if you are ok with having to nag upper management to get maintenance repairs done in a timely manner.

This apartment complex has the potential to be one of the best in Memphis if it weren't for unprofessional management changing aspects of lease agreements and the nightmare parking situation. For a complex of over 200 residents there are a total of 10 visitor parking spaces behind closed gates. 

While there is ample parking outside of the gates and on the street, Grand Island has contracted Superior Towing company (please see their reviews) to tow residents' visitors. A $30 extra day storage fee is added regardless of if your car has been there a day or less than 10 hours ($155 minimum), violating towing laws. When they tow during the weekends, they are only open from 9AM-11AM Sat/Sun and are located 25 minutes away in an unsafe part of town. 

Management has stated that visitors must park their car a quarter mile down the road at the dog park or at businesses a half mile down road to visit residents, while both places run the risk of getting towed there or having their cars broken into. There are also no sidewalk lights, so walking to Grand Island can be dangerous at night. 

There is no "No Parking" sign outside the gate along the wide driveway or painted fire lines that say "Do Not Park". There are 6 painted spots next to the leasing office (4 regular, 2 handicap) that management has stated they will not tow a vehicle in the handicap spot even if they do not have a handicap tag/sticker. 

No emails, texts, phone calls, or signs placed in common areas are used to notify residents about any issue. Residents are notified to changes in parking contradicting their lease or other areas by having a piece of paper folded in half and put in the crack of their door at night. These papers have blown away or people have been known to take them down. Most other apartment complexes in Memphis have electronic systems in place to properly notify residents of any changes of the building that do not violate their lease. 

Multiple times throughout the year, their garbage compacter is so full of trash that it overflows onto the sidewalk. There are 2 dog waste containers in the complex that are either overflowing or there are no bags for residents to pick up after their dog. 

I hate leaving a negative review because I’m sure there are some people here that do their best to make things work. I would love to leave this apartment a 5 star review because the amenities it offers; however, management has stated they are not changing their policy and have no desire to do so.
Worth every penny! I love my apartment and the staff here is phenomenal. They always have gone above and beyond for their tenants. Very pet friendly complex, perfect for young professionals

I was so excited when they built these Appartments in 2012. I was glad that they were finally bringing Back some beauty to our wonderful city. Speaking of adding beauty to the city, This beautiful appartment Complex is less than 10 minutes from the river and it is almost in walking distance to "The Bass Pro Shop". Grand Island Harbor has so many wonderful amenities to offer. They have Pets Allowed; they also have funished spaces available. Anyone in their right mind would love to live here!! It is absolutely stunning in everyway!!

I have lived here for the last 16 months and the experience has been sub par. Aside from a GREAT maintenance staff - I have not enjoyed my stay here. The property is poorly constructed. You can hear EVERYTHING happening outside in the parking lot and in your neighbors home. The floors are uneven when walking. There’s an odor that saturates your home randomly throughout the week. No amount of plugins or cleaning can rid your apartment of it. 

The property is not as secure as they would lead you to believe. Residents are not able to book the community room for private usage and management says that community areas are not apart of our rent payment. Although they say it’s an amenity to make use of. 

Management does not respect your privacy or confidential information. They post personal resident information on your door rather than in your mailbox or even giving you a call. I’ve come home many times to letterhead with my name and contact information sitting in the crack of my door.

Your packages are thrown in the mail area and you may or may not receive communication that the mail has arrived. 

Management never answers the phone when you have a need but implement “policy” when beneficial for them. I submitted about 10 noise complaints before I ever received a response. Management is extremely inconsiderate of the resident. They rarely know what’s going on around the property. There have been many nights police have answered calls to car break ins and we do not receive any correspondence from the complex notifying every one of what has occurred on the property.  

All in all, Madison at McLean is NOT a luxury apartment.

You are really paying for the area. You really can get better for what they are charging. They are nice looking apartments but it seems like they just threw them together structurally. This is my first apartment and I didn’t expect to hear the person that stay above me so much. You can literally hear them sit on their bed. The floors boards in the bedroom make these loud sounds, that literally wake me up out of my sleep. It just seem like the flooring between the floors is super thin.

The place is okay to live. However! When you move out they make up a bunch of fees such as damage or garbage removal which I did not have ! There was no damage and my c
Garbage was placed outside in garbage pick up area. The place was left clean and neat. They still also wanted to charge me carpet cleaning and so on. Is this not part of regular maintenance you face with a rental unit? 
I’ve never had anything like this! 
Be careful what you sign!
I got an apartment with a lake view and the office staff made the move in easy! I've liked the basketball court and the fitness center is pretty updated

I have lived in 4 different states, with countless property management and this has been the worst place yet. The gate has never worked. They send out emails saying that is going to be fixed but no action is ever taken. Within the first two months of me living here, there were at least 6 cars broken into and the gate remains broken months later. This has been the slowest maintenance team I’ve ever had. Minor maintenance issues take more than a month. The unit is nice but the property is not taken care of. There are HUGE pot holes all around the property. The trash over the weekend overflows from the compactor. All of the balconies need to be painted and pressure washed. It’s almost embarrassing to even bring guests over because of the lack of care. Over priced low grade apartments with poor management. They literally charge for services they dont provide example (pest control) . The gate is always broken and the trash service is garbage. I can’t wait until my lease is up. They send threatening emails about charging people for everything.

I stayed at the property for 4 years.  The apartment was nice.  Parking is horrible.  I just moved out because of a job transfer.  I was not expecting the aftermath of the move.  I had to pay two months of rent for the move which was $2500 on top of the monthly rent.  The Manager didn't want to give me back my security deposit and presented me a lease that I didn't sign trying to say that I didn't pay a deposit.  The cleaning fee was over $400 to spot clean an empty 1200 square foot apartment which equated to $51/hour if it took one person 8 hours to clean.

Poor management.  Kelly (The property manager) hung up the phone in my face the other day after telling me that "she isn't dealing with my problems today".  Neighbors have trash piled in front of their doors. The property is an eyesore. They charge you thousands in rent only to be rude as soon as you have a problem with something. BEWARE. DO NOT RENT HERE. I do not want anyone to make the same mistake I did. I moved into my apartment too swiftly. DO YOUR RESEARCH BEFORE CHOOSING A HOME

In an effort to keep this review concise, I will only detail what ultimately led to our move-out. 

- External water dripped into unit from the ceiling whenever it rained, even after it was apparently fixed. 
- Exterior walls were uninsulated. Without insulated walls, changes in weather caused severe problems with temp control. With colder weather, we noticed a marked increase in humidity in the unit. We brought in a humidity sensor which showed 89% humidity in the unit after just a couple weeks of having the heat on. As we dug deeper into the issue, we realized every exterior wall was wet with condensation and the closets and walls were all growing significant mold. The walls were *saturated*. Several pieces of art and clothing were ruined. We discovered this mold in November. The solution was to bring in dehumidifiers and put up new walls with insulation in both bedrooms and one closet. Everything began to spiral when:
        1. They refused to test the mold (I ended up testing it and there were 4 types of black mold growing). Amy told me “you breathe in more mold in the city of Memphis than what is in your unit. Plus, this is mildew, not mold.” It was in fact mold. 
        2. Apartment manager, in writing, said both bedrooms were uninhabitable during construction. However, she deflected all conversation around options for alternate living situations. She said “the contractor is confident you can live in the living space during this process.” We were expected to both work from home and combine 2 bedrooms to both live in the living space (the size of a studio apartment). 
        3. Apartment manager’s communication was exceptionally poor throughout this process. After documenting this issue in the portal on December 7th and continued follow up with no response with a plan for construction and relocation, we ultimately decided to terminate our lease. It took 7 weeks for construction to begin, and she gave us less than 24 hours notice to move out of the bedrooms. 
        4. The mold was never safely removed from the apartment. Someone came in with a washcloth and wiped it down, missing major spots and leaving the entire closet full of mold. 

Finally, 5 months after moving out, our full security deposit was not returned. Our email to response ratio was 10:1, with management ultimately ghosting us. We still have not gotten the money they owe us, and I do not expect to ever get it back.

This place is absolutely beautiful and charming! I love the small community feel of the building, and the style/design of the building is simply amazing! This was exactly the look and vibe I was looking for when I started searching for a place to live. To make it even more special, the owner is truly the BEST!!  She takes great pride in the building itself and strives for the residents to feel safe and at ease while living in a beautiful environment full of wonderful amenities.

I've lived here for almost a year and had 3 other places in Memphis. This one is by far, my favorite. I love the place. It's quiet, secure and beautiful. It's not a big building so there's not a lot of people. There's outdoor space, and some other nice perks and quiet in the evenings account it is on a dead-end St. 

The owner is super responsive and has taken great care to make this place amazing......5 Stars!!!!
National Rose Co. is a great location but off the beaten path. It’s a warehouse renovation, the lobby is beautiful, and the apartments are not cookie cutter like a lot of other places  in town.

Hands down the best niche apartment community I’ve ever lived in. Thoughtful finishes, layouts, & amenity spaces inside your home AND outside your home in the common areas. I’d truly live here forever if my job allows - love it!
This building is full of loud and obnoxious barking dogs . The barking is non stop ! All throughout the night .

My wife and I live here for 10 months before moving into our house and we loved it. The outdoor patio/grill area was awesome and neighbors were friendly. The apartment had been recently updated and was done well. We enjoyed our time there!

My family loved our time at the Galloway at Evergreen. It was the perfect location between crosstown concourse and the zoo. I loved walking around the historic district and enjoying the character filled homes around me. We also Loved how Overton Park is within walking distance. We were very sad to have to move away as our family grew, and will always think back fondly on our time there.

I've been here for 2 months and I cannot wait until my lease is up I honestly don't even think ima make it, my ac has been out I put out maintenance request multiple times they been in my house multiple times while I'm not there so called fixing the air everytime they leave it still be out, I'm hardly home because it's 87-100 degrees in my house I don't even feel comfortable there they bad with communication don't give me any updates nor communicate when they are coming and never the answer the phone.

The community is a distinctive community in that the people who live here are mostly professionals.  Therefore, not a lot of noise at night outside even if you live in the back of the community.  I live close to the back gate.  The people who live here are mostly families as well and are of diverse culture and races.  Nice folks combined with nice amenities and staff, makes this a great place to consider in apartment homes.  The apartments are spacious, lots of windows (natural lighting), include washers & dryers, and a staff eager to please the residents.

If I could give this apartment complex less than 1 star, I would. The staff was rude and the apartment was infested with mold, even after they fixed it the first time. Serious bug infestation... don’t let the grounds fool u. You don’t wanna stay here. They need to offer people incentives for staying here as opposed to referrals

Last year we needed to place an employee in Memphis for a term and located the Bridges.  All seemed fine when speaking to the sales people. This has turned out to be a management mask as our company manages over 1,000 units in the Western NY state area.  Our employee moved in under some cloudy circumstances relating to her dog but the conduct of the staff was incredibly unprofessional.  During her stay there was a strong mold odor coming from the living room floor which the management company did deal with eventually along with the flood caused in the bathroom originating from an upper unit.  There was further inconvenience with a broken down A/C unit which the repair people attempted to fix by replacing a filter!  really? 

Regretfully the assignment was cut short in Memphis and the lease had to be discontinued.  you would think it was the end of the world with charges being reversed and penalties levied.  A final bill was issued which could not be paid online because the "account was closed". This required a dog sled check by mail which to my surprise was never received. It was our inquiry as to why the check wasn't cashed before any follow up was received. At that point, we discovered that this company just tossed the whole matter to a collection agency. 

The staff are incredible unprofessional, rude and never accommodating. We have sent a check by FedEx to settle the matter directly with the bridges.  BE CAREFUL, this an outdated complex typical of the mismanaged facilities in the Memphis area that are suffering from poor management, absentee owners and poor maintenance to save costs. 

You were warned!!

I waited a week to see an apartment that they said will have available, after viewing it then agreeing to lease it. I was giving an application to fill by Melissa who said to bring it in by the end of day or early the next morning which I did just to be told the apartment was leased after driving all the way to their office and then she tried to push other apartments that I wasn't interested in. Also, because the garages are integrated into the dwellings you can hear everyone's garage door open and close no matter what time of day or night. I was in a unit that was directly over a neighboring garage and that tenant was in and out of the garage all night! There are other places nearby that offer better service, amenities, and price.

I just moved out of these apartments and I want to share what I found out about these apartments. First of all, they are overpriced. They look nice on the outside but they aren't anything special on the inside. No fireplaces, no sauna tubs,etc.  They aren't bad, but they aren't great either. The good is that the management is nice as long as you pay your rent and the area is safe. It is a gated community. Has a gym and pool and computer room and a movie theatre for residents and is pet friendly. The bad is that the maintainence guy is very slow to fix anything if it ever gets fixed at all! I had a faucet in bathroom that needed tightened up and was never done. The worst part in my experience was that the walls are paper thin!! I could hear my upstairs neighbors arguing, anytime they played music, , I could hear their television sometimes, and every day it sounded like they were " stomping on my ceiling " when they walked across their floors. The walls and ceiling not insulated from hearing your neighbors. If you want piece and quiet you may not get it here!!

This place is falling apart! The pictures on the website are misleading!
The kitchen cabinets are peeling, under the cabinets had mold growing, the sink is leaking, and the appliances are all old and cheap. Maintenance came to fix sink but was unable to.
The front door had spider webs (looked like it was never cleaned), the patio had black stains throughout (no one ever attempted to clean it before we moved in).
The guest bath was chipping and rust was getting built-up, Maintenance resurfaced and after 1 scrub it is exactly the same as before.
Dining room window has a huge crack.
The park is all dirt with tree roots growing in it. There are no wood chips as the advertising pictures show.
The windows were all so dirty you could not see through them. I asked for them to power spray...they did 3 of the 9 windows. We had to do the rest ourselves.
I tried to use the car wash and the hose did not work. I believe it has been replaced since.
The carpeting is old, there are paint stains all over the floor, and the blinds in all the windows were stained.
We are paying for a 3 bd/2ba but are only able to use 1 1/2 baths, my toddler can't play at the park, underneath my sink is unusable, and most of what they attempt to fix never actually gets fixed.
