Pros:
*They do provide you with a washer & dryer, although they don't maintain them to insure they work. So you may end up going to a laundromat any way.
*The apartments does provide alarm systems with each unit, however they're not guaranteed to work.
*They do provide smoke free & pet free apartments, however you neighbors will most likely smoke and/or have pets.
*They do provide FREE WI-FI in each unit, but it only works in one room; in our case it's the master bedroom closet (Don't step on my shoes, when you do your homework kids).
*They provide security guards to drive around the apartments, lounge around at the pool, and sometimes take a nap in their car.
*They provide you with FREE cookies in the offices ( 3 - 4 day old).
*They have a volleyball court, however the sand is used a litter box for all cats within a 5 miles radius.
*They provide you with a FREE carwash area, however the vacuum doesn't suck up anything and somebody took the attachment off the hose and the apartments haven't replaced it; that was 12/2016.
*They are always available to take your calls and maintenance requires. However, it takes 2 or more weeks for them to address your concerns, IF they address them at all.
*Cover parking is available as a added feature, however there is no effort made to keep other people from parking in your spot.
*You can smoke marijuana WHEREVER you want on the Registry @ Wolfchase property, without having to worry about penalties.  
*They keep the lawns maintained.
*They keep the pool clean.
*Aside from the trash compacter, the apartment complex appears very pleasant.

   In conclusion these apartments appear to look nicer then what they really are. The time has come for me to renew my lease, and I am shocked at all the issues I have encountered here they are going to increase my rent. They say the increase is to help maintain the apartments, I'm already not getting what I'm paying for.

*Upon moving in, I noticed that I didn't have a fireplace or a lining closet which was in the model apartment. I was told that because I'm in a smoke free building, that's why I didn't have one.
*The trash compacter is a problem over here in the apartments. It's only ONE and it's located outside of the apartments gate, which allows non-residents to come and dispose of their trash and throw it all over the place. However with it only being one trash compacter, people that stay a distances from the front have to put their trash on their cars. Which sometimes fall & bust in the streets and they keep driving like it's nothing. Some residents are to lazy to take their trash to the garbage and leaves trash bags in the walk way, which then brings odors, flies & rodents. The apartments act like they're going to penalties residents for it, they don't.
*After a year of dealing with heavy rains, leaking ceilings, leaking air conditioner units, none changing of air filters; I am now dealing with Mold & Mildew. The apartment's hasn't taking any corrective action to insure the safety of my family. As a last resort I have had to contact Code Enforcement to help resolve this pertain life-threating situation.

*Apparently, living in a pet free & smoke free building doesn't excluded marijuana. Which to live in a pet free & smoke free building it costs more money, but there is no penalty for people that smokes and have pets in these buildings. The office does nothing but call and let them know they got a complaint about the smell of smoke. So, why am I being forced to pay more for a building that I need to live in and the one's who smoke aren't penalties or evicted? Things that makes you go hmmmmm. Not to mention the added medical expenses you gain from having to deal with asthma and smoke or pets.  
*A malfunction alarm system that goes off at random when it storms really bad. Which is probably caused from all the rain that was coming into the apartment. The only thing the apartments did was cut the wires on the alarm systems, which means I don't have a function alarm system in my home. That could probably very well be leading to the increase crime rate in the apartments.
*The air conditioner unit leaks really bad and causes it to soil the carpet. I was told by maintenances & management that was normal for the unit to leak. (Uhhhhhhh) I have never in the history of living had to deal with a leak in the unit UNLESS it was a problem with the unit.
*There was a vent in one of the bedroom's (asthmatic child)  that had mold around the vent and water residue on wall. I was told that it was to cold in the home and that's what caused the problem. The only thing they did was scrape the mold off the wall and changed the air vent.
*The light fixture in the master bedroom has 3 bulbs, well one side has been changed 4 times and it keeps shorten out. The apartments doesn't replace it anymore nor will I spend my money to replace it again. I believe it's from the water that was coming into the apartment that causes it to shorten out.

* When I moved into the apartment it wasn't cleaned. The master bedroom toilet was nasty and have a permanent ring around the toilet that I have tried to get replaced (They refused). I still had cups in the back of my cabinet from the last tenant. There was a blue bullet (sex toy) found by my baby in her bedroom closet. The only thing the apartments could saw was they will talk with the cleaning crew. However, I thought they're suppose to do a walk-thru after the apartment is cleaned.
* Upon moving in the guest bathroom tub was painted, there was no lid on the back of the toilet, nor did my sprayer work on the kitchen sink.
*All the countertops (Both bathrooms & kitchen) are painted. Once water is on the countertops they start to bubble & peel. 
*The person that does the painting apparently doesn't use trimming tape and gets it all over the mirrors and faucets.
*Whenever it rained on the outside, it also rained on the inside. I would have to turn the breaker box off, because the water was coming thru the light fixtures. After filing numerous compliance with office (7 months), I was informed that my building wasn't the only one having that problem and that they are taking a BID on what building roof would get fixed. 
*I have been trying to get one of the bedroom's door fixed from the time I moved into the apartment which has been over a year now and it's still not fixed to this day. I keep all of my maintenances request slips, so when I move they won't try to charge me for something that I have been requesting from the time I moved in.
*I have went thru 1 washer machine & 3 dryers since I have been staying here. Maintenances takes about 7- 10 days to replace them and will sit the old one outside your door for 1 - 3 days.

I advised them that my children are having breathing problems and that I would like the air filter to be replaced with a better brand that I purchased. Well, low and behold the air filter they pulled out of the unit was dated to be changed 01/2016, I moved in 09/2016. For people that doesn't know with asthmatic people in the home air filters are suppose to be changed every month but no longer then every 3 months.
*There was no screens on bedroom windows, it took about 9 months to get them on the windows a couple of months ago.

There isn't 3 pools over here, you have one pool that goes from 3ft to 4ft and a baby pool that only has 1ft of water if that. If you are looking for somewhere to go on short notice, an emergency, just tired of looking for somewhere, or have a busy schedule where your not really home a lot but need a roof over your head and a place for your belongs Registry at Wolfchase is the place for you. 

   I'm not saying you will have a bad experience, but I'm not saying you will have a good experience either. Since I have been here there is only 3 loyal employees that work in the office, everybody else is comes and go. They have went thru 7 or 8 people within a year of me being here. They sometimes use temp service to fill office space, which I have a problem with because your dealing with peoples personal information. So I only deal with the loyal workers when it comes to my information only because I'm not sure how long the next person may be around. Some where along the last few months the crime rate has gone up, which has cause the apartments to gain security thru a security company not a police officer. These are "by far" the worst apartments I have ever stayed at. You would think that Cordova was a nice safe area, right?? I have been looking for a new apartment for almost a month. It seemed like all the nice ones were overpriced and the okay priced ones left much to be desired from both the models and staff. I brought my 13 month old daughter with most times and everyone was super sweet to her. As far as customer service goes the staff is excellent. The homes here are not super fancy but have everything you need. I love the space and that we did not have to choose between a sun-room or patio like with  most complexes, we have both! Joe, Kristen and everyone else here at the Registry is great. They deserve a gold star!

My apartment complex is wonderful the staff do friendly we have three pools and we have washer and dryer in every unit carpet and a big bedroom i love my apartment, i am a single parent and i will tell a friend to move here its so home.

These apartments aren’t the worst but they are certainly NOT FULLY renovated as advertised. It’s definitely overpriced for the quality. The building is 100 years old and it really shows when you start living in the apartment. The rooms are really spacious which is great, but not really functional because so may repairs are needed. And there are some things not disclosed on the listing that people should know before choosing to live here. These are the main issues with this apartment building: 

1. HVAC (heating/cooling)- is very outdated. It takes a lot of energy to heat and cool the entire apartment which results in higher utility bills.
2. Hot water- the building uses “community hot water” so the entire building shares two water tanks. So sometimes the water is hot, but more than likely it’s NOT. This is so inconvenient during winter! 
3. Structural issues- the building is very old so the floors and walls have a lot of cracks (this results in more creepy inspects getting into the building).
4. Windows- in the apartment weren’t installed properly so some leak when it rains, and alot of air comes in through the cracks in the window esp during the winter months, making it colder in the apartment, and means you have to turn up the heat. 
5. Lights- the bedrooms and the living room were not built with lights so you have to use lamps for lighting at night. 
6. Electrical outlets- there aren’t enough outlets in the house and the ones that are there most do not work properly or you can’t plug in certain devices. 
7. Doors- the doors in the apartment are old and have not been replaced so they do not close properly. So the apartment doesn’t have much privacy. 
8. Parking- there is gated parking but the parking lot is too small and narrow that larger vehicles can’t fit and there needs to be more parking spaces. 
9. Power outages- occur very frequently, not sure if it’s because of it being so close to the road, but whenever the weather is bad the power always goes out at this apartment building. 
10. Noisy neighbors- I was on the first floor and the upstairs neighbors are very LOUD and they have alot of children. And you hear EVERYTHING on those creaky old hardwood floors.

Me and my girlfriend moved in about 6 months ago and right off the bat issues occurred like our door knob being broke and the hallway light to the rooms dangling after being hit by a door. No one comes to fix these issues as stated in other reviews. We have filed work orders for these issues and have even been told they will be fixed. On top of things just being broke the management tends to change the rules of the property. For example, the indoor gate parking is reserved for residents only but when we originally chose this place we were both allowed to park inside the gate. I say this because even though I live here since my name wasn’t put on the co-sign they will not let me park inside the gate. I wouldn’t be so bothered by this if they worked with us but they didn’t and even went as far as towing my vehicle. Also note that if you have family or friends visiting guest parking is only available to them for 24-48 hours and after this alotted time your vehicle will be towed. For everyone reading this please save yourself the hassle of being tricked into moving into this place.

Overall my experience so far has been a positive one and I’m very happy with my apartment. The apartment has been updated nicely and I receive compliments from everyone who comes over. It’s a great suede for a small family or someone like me who has a pet but travels too much for work to maintain a house. The area is pretty nice and I really like having the golf course on two sides.
A few small issues, primarily with the quality of the renovations.
 Most of the work is good or decent, the main complaint is old window panes being left on the exterior so I’m unable to open the window for fresh air. Additionally the floors in the halls weren’t installed completely correct or the doors need some work because the front doors don’t close all the way but they are working on it. Other than those two relatively minor issues the apartment is fantastic and very spacious. 
Neighbors are quiet and most are respectful of the property. Definitely recommend!

Also Taylor in the leasing office is amazing!

I moved in Feb 2024. We’ve had 3 managers in 3 months. Yes, they have been renovated but they just slapped paint on very messily. Barely any outlets work. Only 1 for the kitchen works properly. Over the last 5 weeks, I’ve been trying to get my family member who lives with me access to the gate via an app.  Management can’t seem to get it right.  I have now lost my high paying job because I had to constantly stop working to let them in remotely. This has been a complete nightmare. A few weeks after moving in there was a leak in the kitchen ceiling. Now other parts of the ceiling in the kitchen have been falling apart. There have been so many trespassing kids using the pool that residents aren’t able to use it. – A REAL RESIDENT

What a joke! These people are awful and do NOT care about the people that live here nor do they care about our safety! Need something done? Good luck! No air? Haha! Mold? Hope you like it! Overpriced amenities you can't even use? No security? Bugs? Sure come live here! Oh, and Rachel is the rudest person here. This place is awful!!!!!

The apartment and location is nice.l, but if you have any issues nothing will be fixed. The pool is green, literally looks like a swamp. Our dishwasher has been broken for 6 months and never even been looked at.

1. I got this apartment sight unseen because of Covid. The apartment in the pictures was not the apartment I was given. I did ask and was assured it was the same one.
2. Pet policy is not followed. There are numerous pit-bulls, huskies, German Shepard’s and Great Danes. My dog was bit by a pit-bull and nothing was done after I filed a complaint. My carpet is stained from the blood as well. Also my dog has fallen sick often because they pet waste policy is not followed.

I do not see the point in paying when I could just park like many do and not get towed. Also I have almost been hit because somebody didn’t see me because a car was parked on the curb.

7. This apartment complex is mostly college students. Beer cans and trash are thrown across the property with no regard. They also have massive parties outside at the volleyball court, with loud music and many non caring guests.
8. There is a resident there now that has a manikin in his window and will sit outside on his porch and yell profanities at other residents. This was also filed as a complaint and nothing was done. 
The apartment and amenities are not worth the price. I can go somewhere else and get the same amenities for $400-$500 cheaper. If the policies were followed and updates were made I would stay and pay the price but they are not and that is why I will be taking my money elsewhere

Lot of potential, The staffs are some what friendly but the property isn’t maintained well. They don’t do a good job of cleaning the apartment grounds and parking can be difficult sometimes. The towing company doesn’t do a good job towing vehicles that are not parked in the visitors parking.

I can deal with rustic things, but an oven that burns everything to a crisp is irritating.

apartmentName: Tranquility at Hickory Hill Senior Apartments
review: Quiet community. Jackie and Catherine truly care about the seniors. Tony and Marquis are great maintenance men. They are fast and friendly. Beautiful lobby areas, newly remodeled fitness center with all new equipment, business center, media room, free groceries distributed to seniors monthly from Costco. Bingo and exercise classes. Ms. Bobbetta is the on site coordinator and plans events for us. She has lived on the property for 7 years. She is amazing. Never stops! The rent price is affordable. Gated community. Top notch living for 55+ all in all. New cameras and card reader system are being installed soon. Front area beside office is being converted into a seating area with grills and benches.

apartmentName: Tranquility at Hickory Hill Senior Apartments
review: This community is a disgrace for senior living. Start at the front desk with disrespectful and uncaring management. Their attitude is and I quote " they aren't going anywhere cause they have nowhere to go,." They are extremely slow and even most of the time never answer maintenance request. There is no form of much needed security and the staff could care less of security concerns. They act as if you are trouble for bringing things up.  Rats infest the trash rooms and have migrated into first floor apts. Trash rooms and shoots c are filthy and are sitting grounds for diseases such as TB and Hepatitis. This could be a great community with a full renovation from front to back and head to toe. Oh yes. I am living my last lease out and yes I have somewhere else to go . To God be the glory... I gave it a one because zero be was not a choice. It's a zero

apartmentName: Tranquility at Hickory Hill Senior Apartments
review: When entering the two floor, gated, non smoking Serenity Apartments, a feeling of elegance surrounds you with double doors, chandeliers and sophisticated décor. After being greeted by a warm, professional, you are shown the delights of the community. It includes the movie theater, cable in each apartment, library, game area with pool table etc., computer room, Bible study area, exercise room, inside trash area, two kitchen areas for gatherings; with a Grand piano in the middle. You are giving a choice of solitude or a choice of engaging in the many activities provided. There are meetings to allow the community to voice concerns, that are addressed. Serenity apartments are a Serene place to live.

These are literally LAST RESORT apartments. If you absolutely have NOWHERE ELSE TO GO these would be the apartments you choose. The staff is rude and the maintenance men are LAZY AND UNPROFESSIONAL. They randomly come in your apartment by just yelling instead of knocking and waiting for an answer.Don’t expect anything to get fixed on time and expect utilities to constantly go out during the year. The hot water goes out during the winter and the air goes out during the summer. And like I said they take FOREVER to fix anything. Save your money and a headache by NOT MOVING HERE!
They don’t respond to maintenance requests, the management is a joke. They don’t care about the people who live here and that’s why they’re losing residents hand over fist

My daughter's apartment is next to the garbage chute which regularly overflows with rotting garbage. The fruit flies and gnats have gotten so bad that her apartment is now infested with them. We have tried to let the management know about the problem,  but they haven't done anything yet.  She has to try to sleep with flies landing on her face all night.
This place is a mess!
We need help!

Between 4:00 and 4:30 we heard something like 13 to 15 gunshots coming from the building behind us.  Broad daylight, office still open, yet one hour later there was no response from the much-hyped new security guards and no arriving police cars.  If someone can unload a clip and a half and not get a response, what kind of operation are they running here?  And that's not even mentioning the many and varied unaddressed maintenance issues.  Just don't move here.  Period.
I need help because I live in a building that won't fix anything and I don't want to get sick and die!!!
Nice up-to-date apartments, quite area. World recommend
Ms. Shun was such a great help and was able to assist me with what  I needed for my family! I love the unit and will definitely refer the complex to others.
Shundra was very sweet and helpful. Speedy response in rental. I would suggest to my friends and family.
Shundra was very sweet and helpful.  Speedy response in rental.  I would suggest to my friends and family
I love the apartment manager she is so awesome and helpful and patient everything went smoothly I would highly recommend !

The rating for this apartment need to be a 0.6 instead of a 3.6. They send out reminders about rules regarding pets and trash however they didn't alert residents of a shooting that took place Monday night. There is consistent loud noise, weed smoking that you can smell in your apartment. There have been domestic violence incidents as well that the police were called. The gate is still broken and amenities continue to be added. This is not the same North Creek apartment from years ago. The actual company that owns the complex is in NJ. I hope no one makes the same mistake as us and moves here.

If you’re looking for a place to stay, I highly DO NOT recommend this place. Terrible. Management is very ridiculous! Apartments are not in good condition. Bad environment. Gate has not been fixed. They don’t plan on fixing it honestly. Cars get broken into and stolen. I advise people to look else where!

As the years passed, the management went from worse to ridiculous. Used to be a good place & family oriented. It’s turned into shootings, marijuana smoke, and poverty. Management is condescending & arrogant for no reason. Don’t stay here! Police had to be called weekly. RUN!

I’ve been waiting on my oven to be repaired for about 10  days since October 4 I don’t know if they keep on forgetting about it or what I had to leave my job To remind them about it 
They don’t answer the phone or  the voice mailbox is full

we lived at north creek for our 11 month lease and could not wait to get out of it. Our apartment reaked of marijuana most nights because of our neighbors. Complained multiple times to no avail. Our bill for our rent and pet deposit went up each month. There were always unexplained charges on each bill. When we asked about them, they always beat around the bush and gave a pitiful excuse to why we owed them more money. The MANAGER told us to leave a mattress and box springs in our apartment the day we were moving out. We did not want them, and she said she had someone in mind to give it to. After we moved out, we were charged $30 for leaving it in there after being told to. I do not recommend this complex to ANYONE. They are very unorganized and not reliable at all.

North Creek apartments a nice looking. From what I have seen they are clean. The former tenant took very good care of the apartment. The apartments have been renovated within the last few years, so they don't look brand new but they are up to date. I love that it has a washer and dryer within each apartment. The balcony is spacious. When I moved in there were a lot of dead bugs, but I haven't seen any live ones crawling around so I'm guessing an exterminator sprayed recently. I love that each room has an accent wall. My closet is huge and my bedroom is very spacious. Overall, I am pleased with the apartment.

Poorly managed and maintained. The majority of my neighbors were converted to Airbnb. Gate to access “patio” door to my unit was broken within the first month of Airbnbs taking over (around March/April 2023) and remain broken. Moved out after 2 years and have yet to receive my full security deposit (they were a month’s rent short on the security deposit and have not resolved the matter to date — it is May 31, 2024; I moved out February 29, 2024). Management companies changed 2 or 3 times in my two years as a resident, and have only gotten progressively worse. Poor communication and poor organization across the board. I would go as far as to recommend avoiding *any* property managed by RPM Living.

The location is excellent, and the units are a decent size, but noise is a constant issue… the walls seem to be made of tissue paper. That’s about as positive as I can be.

Avoid at all costs! There are plenty of options in the same price range that won’t leave you regretting your decision!

At first, I thought  I had one of the best spots downtown. The Air B & Bs are out of control. Very sad and scary. The gates are never all working at one time. It’s a challenge to get anything fixed. I hope it improves. I can’t wait to go.

I didn't love or hate living here. 
Pros: The apartments are nice, large bedroom and kitchen, had some issues with the vents being noisy and a few other repairs that I can't recall off the top of my head, but repairs were made quickly. Nice pool area most of the time (see below for the other times).

Cons: Office staff wasn't the easiest to get a hold of and their office was left unstaffed quite a bit (I'm fairly certain they got new management, so this might have changed, just my experience). Shower ran cold after 15 minutes. There were parties in the pool area often which made it uncomfortable to relax out there sometimes. The parties would go late into the night and was incredibly loud and the next morning there was trash left everywhere. Children roaming around the city would break into the pool area and cause a mess as well, but the office was swift in calling the police to get them to leave which was nice. The parking garage that the apartment is connected with is incredibly unsecured and my car was stolen once and vandalized twice. I know that's just a Memphis issue, but the apartment promised "secure" parking, which this is not. 

Glad I moved, but I also didn't HATE living here, it was just OK

I’ve been to this property on a few different occasions and the energy has been nothing but sincere and helpful I LOVEEEEE the staff at 266 lofts can’t wait to move in I recommend this place to anyone honestly. P.s Katie and Katilyn are amazing keep up the great work
The premises are not kept clean, maintenance slow to respond, paper thin walls and noise is out of control, safety an issue due to so many people who are not tenants in and out of the building

Based on the rent and how nice the finishings are, one would think they would have spent a little extra during construction to prevent noise between the floors. Living at 266 has been awful in terms of the noise.  The floors are paper thin so the noise is awful. There is absolutely no sound barrier between the floors. Sounds like whoever's above you is coming through the floor. Neighbors are so tired of complaining and management does nothing to remedy the situation. The air bnb situation is ok. Mostly people are nice.

I love living here at Monticello. The leasing team has gone out of their way to accommodate me to make sure I had a pleasant living experience. I’m not going to say that it hasn’t been challenging but it’s definitely nothing that the leasing team neglect purposely. This is as close to having a home as you can get. I’m writing this review because I’m thinking of how hard it will be to replace my cute apartment and the leasing team that really go out of their way to keep us tenants happy. I hope to get to stay here but if not I will definitely miss it. I bet you wondering if I love it so much then why am I considering moving and the answer is because I’m needing to move closer to downtown. It’s almost worth the drive so you may see me here. I would recommend Monticello being your next home. Mrs Ward

I must say this apartment complex are one of the best out there. At such an affordable price, this property has all the amenities any  tenant would want. I recently moved to another MRG property closer to my job and although this property is good as well I miss the amenities at The Monticello. The two entrances plus a patio, the car port, the personal mail box attached under the car port, the storage, the washer and dryer, black appliances, spacious bed room, and my great quiet neighbors. There were some issues that I had while there, but Brooke and Tony assured me those issues would be handled. I've referred several people to this community and I hope they enjoy it as much as I did :-)
I have not moved in yet but I am so excited the management are excellent the leasing consulting  (Toni) has been great

A well hidden secret, this apartment community is nestled in an well manicured property. Each apartment has very large. Each tenant has assigned covered parking. Personal mailboxes and  personal trash receptor. More than adequate closets and storage.  This is the perfect place to live. The office and ground staff are warm and very professional. Shopping and restaurants nearby.
A fantastic center kitchen that helps the place feel like home, despite the grand total of three pieces of furniture in the entire townhouse

I was wrongfully charged on my credit report by this company. I had 3 months left on my lease and I broke my lease June of 2017 and notified the apartments that I was moving due to being charged for extermination of bedbugs that came from the upstairs apartment. The maintenance guy at the time told me that the above apartment had a bedbug infestation and at the time I had a newborn baby and didn’t want him to be bitten by bedbugs. This company is trying to charge me more than $5K for this issue and has caused me a great deal of headaches with looking for someone else to stay.
The absolute worst apartments I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was super outdated and not worth what they’re trying to charge me!!! Avoid them at all cost, my cars were broken in twice, no lights ever worked outside. Just a disaster.

This apartment complex are pure trash. They dont even deserve half of an star.  The walls are filled with roaches and bed bugs, save your time and find a better place. Moving in will only hurt your credit because the roaches will be running you out and bed bugs will be eating you alive at night, roaches crawl all over you at night and moving your furniture in will only get ruined and infested with bed bugs. Maintenance Never gets anything done and they dont care about fixing anything. Just want you to pay rent. Its a shame that they haven't been sued YET for lack of respect for the families that pay the property owner rent.

There has been nothing but issues with Kismet property management. They take no accountability for ANYTHING that goes wrong at the complex. IT IS NOT SAFE HERE. There are no security gates so anyone can just break into your vehicle. Whis has happened twice since I've moved in and mind you, I've only been living here for a year. We are currently without heat due to radiator issues, and this has been going on for weeks. We were also locked out of our apartments a few days ago due to a malfunction with the key security system. All they could tell me at the leasing office was, "Well I don't know what to tell you. The technician is on the way." Please do yourself a favor and RUN away from these apartments.
I have been living at the Ellington @ Kirby around 12 years. I love it here. It is quiet and peaceful. The staff is wonderful and friendly, and  my Maintenace request are always done on time.

I can never get anyone on the phone! I have to stop by to talk to someone. And when I do talk to someone its always through the door. I know we're in a crisis with COVID and all but GEEZ!! Show some PROFESSIONAL!! I've been living in these apartments for 15 years and never been this BAD!! Its time to move!!! Out of the 15 years I can only use 2 eyes on my stove YES I have put in several & several of tickets for the same issue and still nothing been done. I had to fix my toilet myself (smh) and the leak in the master bathroom don't get me started on that........ I can go on on with a lot of issues..

I am giving this complex a 1 star. I am doing this because of they have ignored major issues within our unit. We have had electric bills of $350 and $406 the last two months. I called and called and called the first month to try and get ahold of them and no one ever answered the phone and I also sent an email the first month as well. So I went ahead and paid that bill in full. This month I called and they “took a message” and would “call me back” I haven’t heard a thing. I also sent them a detailed message of what MLGW stated the issue was and that the complex had a responsibility of getting that issue resolved. They haven’t responded to me. We are very close to taking LEGAL ACTIONS against this complex for not upholding the city requirements that are in place! I will be writing reviews on all the apartment listing websites as well as their own website. Now, with all that being said this complex is not horrible to live in. It’s quiet, the insides are ehh okay for the price and really spacious! We really have no other complaints other than this and the other maintenance requests we’ve had to put in, in less than a year. There definitely could be some improvements on the insides of these to make them a really really good complex. I hope they fix this issue or we will be taking legal actions and moving out

I can never get anyone on the phone! I have to always stop by for whatever I am needing. Leave a message and you still wont get a response. This is very inconvenient  for me since I am working 2 jobs. Maintenance orders takes sometimes up to 2 or 3 weeks depending on what the issue is. 

White paint does fall on your cars after it rains. Cabinets and appliances  need replaced-. look like they just varnished over the grease and crud from the past tenants. My fridge is so old it whistles when it kicks on or sounds like a hurt animal at times. 

Shower is old and the door barely stays on. People do hang out in the breezeways and are not supposed to. They park where they shouldn't on the sides and its crowded enough trying to get around them. 

They just seem to be going down more and more.

My family and I stayed here for 4 years.  The first few months were ok, then the gradual decline in care and service began!

1.  For three summers, our AC was garbage! Anytime the outside temperature rose above 80 degrees, our apartment turned into a sauna!  We CONSTANTLY had to call maintenance to see about the AC...all to no avail.  If you decide on staying in a 2-bed room layout, just know that your AC more than likely WON'T properly cool your apartment during the summer months.

2.  The white paint leakage from the covered parking got on my wife and I's last nerves!!!   They never proposed a solution to this issue.  The point of having covered parking is to PROTECT YOUR FREAKING CAR FROM THE RAIN!!!  But , every time it rained, WE COULDN'T PARK UNDER THE COVERED PARKING FOR FEAR OF HAVING WHITE PAINT DROPS ALL OVER OUR VEHICLE!!!  Be prepared for that if you decide to rent there.

3.  The layouts are severely in need of cosmetic upgrades!  The cabinets, closets, and trims look like something from the 70's...too old with no modern attraction whatsoever.

4.  The leasing office and management over my time there was ok.  Very nice people...until we put in our vacate notice in February 2017.  After move out, I asked them TWICE about my deposit and if I would get it back, with no legit answer.  All I got was, "we'll examine the apartment and give you a call about it."  STILL WAITING ON THAT PHONE CALL having moved out two months ago!  Screw it, you can keep the money!  I'm sure they have some new tenants in my old apartment by now.  Good luck trying to stay cooled in that HOT BOX!  I hope they have a white vehicle so that the PAINT DROPS from the covered parking don't show!

This is an honest review from someone who has lived here since it has been renovated. Cars are constantly broken into due to easy access from the Greenline. The gate was once ran through by car thieves. Roaches and ants are pretty bad, but it has gotten a little better with pest control but you will have to pay for pest fees monthly. The pool is tiny and has no covering. The renovations look nice but were not properly done. Doors are weak and can be easily broken into. Walls are paper-thin and can hear your neighbors. Only one dumpster for the entire apartment and is constantly overflowing. The owners of these apartments are pretty shady and greedy. Office constantly threatening fines and can be shady as well. Parking is terrible and you will get threatened with fines. Don't be fooled by how quick the response time is and how friendly the office can be in the beginning. Reviews on google are not accurate either. Most of those were posted after a party they held to be friendly with tenants. It's not worth the headache you get when living here

Nasty.. Bad Management... Never Fix things.  Bugs, Cars on Cinder Blocks.. Security is Nilch.... DONT STAY HERE.. Much better places nearby.. 
John....June 2021
DONT RENT HERE! Warning. Very ugly and trashy place to live.

I'm a long-term tenant (lived here for many years) and the last 2-3 has been terrible. In the past two years we've probably had around 20-25 property managers. No information is shared between any of them when a new one takes over. It is nearly impossible to get maintenance out to look at an issue, and when they do come out, they just look at the issue and do nothing for a month. The doors look like they were painted by a five-year-old. There are shutters missing on many of the buildings. The pool is disgusting and not maintained/cleaned. The roofs are consistently leaking. The gate is not secure and is propped open more than it is closed.

This has been a nightmare since the new owner took over, Grounds look terrible as they are unable to pay for lawn service, trash is all over the grounds, and management is a joke. There have been no less than 6 managers in the last 12 months. It doesn't help that the new owner is trying to falsely pump up his rent roll with month to month tenants without screening. My air conditioner has been out for a month with promises of " we will get someone down there in a few minutes" over and over again. Do yourself a favor unless you are one that could benefit from no screening and a month to month arrangement, go elsewhere. You can't say you weren't warned

We've been trying for 3 months to get our tub fixed, it suddenly started gushing hot water. We'd been emailing and calling, with the promise that work orders had been put in, but no one came. Our gas bill was sky-high because of the hot water. Finally my roommate went in and threw a fit and showed the property manager (who I'm positive I'd already had a conversation with) a video of the tub. She sent someone the same day to look at it. And he did come by and I truly believe he has an intention to fix it. The apartment's excuse is that they've had 3 property managers in 3 months. But what happened to those work orders!? The property manager doesn't personally carry them out, so?

Also they lost our rent checks and our renewed lease. We called them and told them the checks were never deposited and we never received a copy of the lease, but we never heard back until the property manger called and asked us why we had missed a month of rent... We told them we're not signing a new one until our tub is fixed. 

On top of that the place has roaches - however they are much better than the used to be.

Walls and floors are paper-thin. 

And we just got a notice that MLGW is turning off services because the apartments haven't paid them.

I have lived in these apartments for 3 years and I must say it's been quite the experience. First of all water is NOT free, trash removal isn't either it's more than likely included in the rent because the rent is extremely high for the quality of the apartment. Bad electrical problems, not enough electrical outlets (1 per room), cockroach problem, central air and heat are only in the apartments on the south side, management can be frustrating to deal with at times, parking is terrible because the other tenants don't understand why the lines weren't painted on the ground. The property's upkeep is all wrong. I advise to look elsewhere for the price. Not enough bang for the money.
So far so good. Just moved in this week staff seem very nice and helpful.  Apartments are clean and quite.

I cannot tell you how much I enjoyed my stay at Kirby Station. From the AMAZING office staff (?Beth, Shameka, Rashmi *sorry for spelling) to the peaceful grounds and neighbors. If I didn't have to relocate, Kirby Station would definitely still be home.

If you want your car to get broken into 5 times in a year, this is the place for you!! They have terrible security and while they will act like they are going to get tougher with security, they will not.  The most security I have ever seen is one person driving around in the lot two times in one night- and that was the day after an armed robbery on my street. It is not well lit at night and there are break-ins each week.  I would not recommend living here to anyone!!!!

The staff is super friendly since day 1 and we have been here for two years. They are always quick to respond to maintenance requests and even the smallest of issues you may experience. When it comes time to renew your lease, they are efficient and will strive to work with you if the rent increase isn't something you can feasibly handle. This last renewal the company that owns Kirby Station, MAA, wanted a $70  increase per month. Beth at Kirby Station worked with us to get only an $11 dollar increase and arranged to have some carpet damage caused by our puppy FOR FREE. Everyone in the Kirby Station office is amazing: David, Beth, Robert, Chelsey, and all the maintenance guys rock! They always remember our names and our somewhat "destructive" puppy's name. Will stay here for a while until we are ready to buy a house. Only cons: when it rains here the sidewalks flood and not every apartment has washer dryer hookups (like ours). But that by NO MEANS is a deal breaker for this place. LOVE KIRBY STATION!

I lived in a townhome here for around a year.  Staff is friendly and professional.  The buildings are old but they keep them in good condition.  I did have to spray like 10 wasp nests over the summer but other than that no big problems with bugs.  The neiborhood is located in a pretty safe area for Memphis and the whole place is really well lit at night.  Overall it was a positive experience.

I've lived at Kirby for over 3 yrs. now.  A couple of days ago I submitted 2 maintenance requests online 1) the exhaust fan in my downstairs BR had burned-out and 2) the gutter above my door was bent, causing water to pour down the awning over my front door like a waterfall.  Within 24-hrs. both issues were solved.  Not only did they fix the gutter while it was raining and repair the fan, but they also made some small improvements like replacing my door knob.  Above & beyond!

I love these apartments. I feel safe to walk my dog at 3 AM by myself. The staff is insanely friendly as are the residents. My only complaint is during the summer it seems bugs like to flock. Luckily, they'll spray. Also, they're apts from the 90's, so there are many maintenance issues, but after many times, it was finally fixed. They usually only take 1 day to come, though. So that's good. It was just a pain for them to keep coming back lol. Overall, my experience here has been great!
They don’t fix anything .. they have roaches and mice !

Management is horrible, they dont fix anything, trash is everywhere. They claim they about to be under new management but its still terrible! Worst place ever to live at. And the apartment manager HOPE has a bad attitude, rude, and doesnt care about the tenants.

This apartments are completely not ready for move in but they put you in it anyways. My bathrooms and one of my bedrooms didn’t have any doors when I moved in. The light fixtures over the stove, in the bathrooms are broken, the windows doesn’t have locks on them so I can feel breeze coming thru. The front door is very uneven, that’s visible and any living thing can crawl from under it, my front door is also hard to push and pull open because it is so uneven. My closet doors is uneven, won’t close all the way. My AC/Heater unit is not working. I’ve been here three months and I just got a new toilet seat because the one I had when moved in was broken. I just got my bathroom and room doors put in after 3 months of living here. Since I moved in I been requesting that my  heat and air be fixed and yet it hasn’t yet!!

My apartment got robbed in broad daylight. I left my house for a couple of hours, and found my apartment ransacked. No one saw anything. The apartments are also outdated. The gate is NEVER closed. Maintenance never notifies you if they are coming in. They just unlock your door and enter if they can. If I wasn’t stuck in a lease, I would’ve left.

Maintenance can use some help in certain areas but other than that these apartments are very descent for a single person or a family and also the office staff is great one in particular Ms. Ebony is a joy she's very helpful!!!

I've loved living here the past few years. The apartments are spacious and location is great! Maintenance is prompt and gets orders complete on time. You have to expect some noise since there are a lot of people around but overall its never out of control and people are respectful most of the time.

I have been living here for a year, it is affordable for its location in the city, spacious and near at my work. The management is better now, they will renovate the parking and other rooms, I can manage the noise from some neighbors and cars outside but what I cant deal with are cockroaches everywhere and bugs..that is why I am moving for 300 bucks more for an apartment that gives you peace of mind and cleanliness
Not safe constantly having cars broken in or vandalized
i feel safe. Staff is great. only thing its becoming un affordable for me. I wold and have recommended to a working person.

We currently have a new management company and new name, but so far the changes have been great. The team is super nice, I love the fitness room and computer lounge, it's a great place to chill or hang out when I don't want to lounge in my apartment. Close to work and all the great restaurants. Love it here so far!

We were impressed right away looking at the apartments that the Maynard had available for rent in comparison to the others in the area (midtown, downtown) as far as space and cost. The FREE parking, (yes, free, some of the places we looked at wanted anywhere from $30-70 per person per month, ouch!) pool, gym and laundry on site were just an added bonus that sealed the deal for us. Also the security guard at night helped with uneasiness we may have had about the neighborhood. We were moving from out of state and weren't sure how safe alot of the neighborhoods were in Memphis.

Upon moving in, there were a couple of maintenance issues in our apartment and not only did they get fixed right away, the guy working maintenance was polite and friendly. 

The neighborhood has almost everything we need right down on Union Ave, and we are finding our way around the city and realizing how close this building is to Beale Street, Cooper Young, Overton Park, ect. The leasing staff is friendly and is willing to answer any questions that we had about the apartment or the area.

The only downside to this building that I can see for other people is that they might have an issue with the hospital across the street because of the noise sometimes. We don't hear much, our balcony faces the back of the building, so it is quiet for us. 

Overall, we are really impressed with the Maynard and love living here.
The area I live is very quiet during the day and night friendly neighborhood great management that help their tenants as much as possible.

I had the best move in experience. Mrs. Lisa got me moved in in under 24 hours. with a smile and kind heart. She attended to every one of my needs and made me feel right at home. It is peaceful and quiet here. Also, the property is well kept and clean. I am very happy with my unit, it is very nicely renovated and I am now a very happy resident!
Alexius has been wonderful!  She has made the move in process easy and worry free.  Looking forward to moving in my new apartment.

Im going to make this as short as possible. Got approved for a 2bd 2 bth with a move in date of Nov 7th 2021. Was told I would have to pay an admin fee and deposit of 4 hundred and something. Cool, was willing to bring the money that day because I wanted to secure my place. Was told on the phone that before I bring that, they would need to do a walk through to check and see what they unit needed and that I would get a call whenever that's done to bring the money. Days, and then weeks passed without hearing anything back. I thought about calling serval times but wanted to be patient. That and the fact that I was receiving emails from the apartment about my  unit, setting up my renters insurance and an access code.  Paid for my renters insurance and held on to my deposit this entire time only to be told that the unit had been rented out to someone else because I didn't pay my deposit! The leasing agent sounded like she was over hearing what I had to say and quickly offered to give me my application fee back. Seriously????!!! I took off from work was having a couch delivered that week. This is truly heart breaking that The Nova would do this to a family. A single mother of Two!!! Now Im left with confusion , anxiety, and no where to move to. This is heartbreaking

Love love love my apartment. I had to wait a little while on a downstairs unit, but it was worth it! I got new carpet & some beautiful hard word floors. Special thanks to Ms. Bishop for all she has done & for finding me the perfect apartment at The Nova.

Waited 2 months to move over here but it was worth the wait. My apartment is exactly what I wanted clean, nice, & I got some cool neighbors! If you looking for a apartment go holler at Devette in the leasing office.
My name is Mr. Davis I just moved in the nova. I love my apartment its just what I wanted. Ms. Bishop was very helpful & help me get everything I needed. I'm glad I came to the nova.

Now onto the bad: It is nearly impossible to have packages shipped, as I don't feel comfortable having them leave it at the door, and the new management is not as assiduous at being in the office at all times. 
In the beginning, we were promised that the pool would be available in a few months (we got here in April of 2014). The pool was not open at all in 2014, and now that it has finally opened (in July 2015), it is not kept clean enough, giving the water the look and consistency of a pond.

We still have not had a new leasing agreement (which was supposed to be renewed in April, and it is now August). When asked, management said that they were "way behind on paperwork".

In conclusion, this is a great place if you need something cheap, but there are some problems that some may find unpleasant.

My roommates and I lived in the apartment for 16 months. Everything was fine until after we moved out. We moved out on 12/18/17. There is documentation of this. The following February 2018, I receive a letter from ARS Collection Agency, saying I owe The Edison $440.50 for not letting the apartment know when we were moving out. The “associate” at ARS told me not to talk to anyone or call the apartment complex to discuss the issue, and that if I did not pay the amount, I would be taken to court. The ARS collection “associate” also told me that ARS Collection and MRG Apartments ARE THE SAME COMPANY. So calling MRG corporate is the SAME as calling ARS Collection agency. I called The Edison apartment complex, anyway, and they told me that they did have confirmation and proof of us giving notice of moving out in December. Then they told me we were being charged because one of my roommates turned in her key on 1/17/18 – a whole month after we had officially moved out. They went as far as to describe what she was wearing in January, when she supposedly turned in her key. The Manager claimed to witness this event in January. The Edison told me they could not contact ARS Collection Agency or MRG corporate because they were “not allowed” to contact them after a resident has moved out. I contacted this roommate, who had proof from the Manager, confirming she did, in fact, turned in her key on 12/19/17. When this proof was sent to the Manager, she called ARS Collection Agency (which they apparently could not do a few days earlier), and our account was cleared. We did not receive our $100 deposit, which was supposed to be refunded to us. This was definitely a scam. 

If you decide to live here, consider these things:  
1.	The apartment community is quiet and the price is good. 
2.	We never had any issues while we lived there. 
3.	Maintenance is quick to fix issues. 
4.	Make sure all roommates physically sign the lease. 
5.	Make sure to have all copies of all documents from The Edison to keep as proof. 
6.	ARS Collection Agency and MRG Corporate are the same company.
7.	Be aware (and prepared) that they may try to scam more money out of you when you move out.

Hope this helps! Good luck!

It was the worst apartment I have ever lived in. They will respond and say to call or email, but no resolution will ever be found. The Quad on Delaware is extremely unhelpful and honestly does not care. Never live here

Mold, water damage, unexpected water shutoffs, wifi often goes out, elevators often broken, no security (bikes and catalytic converters stolen, doors don't lock), sidewalks and stairs left icy during the winter, garage full of trash and dead rats, units entered without proper notice (once at 1am), front desk employees can't answer questions, poor communication from management, garage leaking, entrance ceiling leaking, do I need to go on?

The fire alarms regularly go off in the middle of the night, and when we tried to evacuate the emergency exit was blocked (they have gotten cited twice by the fire department for not being up to code for missing exit signs/blocked exits). Twice in the past few weeks people have set off the fire extinguishers in the elevator/common areas and they didn't clean it up for a while. If something in your apartment breaks and you put in a maintenance request, they will take anywhere from weeks to months to fix it. Our garbage disposal broke in October and they wouldn't fix it until 4 months later, and when they did they failed to reconnect the pipes under the sink and flooded our kitchen (which we then had to clean up ourselves). Get ready to fall in the winter cuz don't clear the snow or ice off the sidewalks. They also don't clear the parking lot so if you have your car it will be stuck for a few months. The grounds outside are covered in dog poop and garbage and inside the common areas and elevators are also full of trash. The front desk take multiple days or weeks to log packages so account for that if you order something urgently. The amenities (gym, study room, computer lab) have all flooded and been closed at some point, and the printer has been broken for months so they don't actually have free 24/7 printing like they advertise. Finally, the windows don't open, so if you burn food or there are other bad smells in your apartment they'll stay there. I could go on and on, but don't be tempter by the lower price tag- spend a few extra dollars to rent somewhere livable.

The maintenance wasn't great and usually took forever.  It was the system for actually getting maintenance that was brutal. Also, there's a good chance most of the wifi ports won't work and right when you move in you will probably have to put in at least one maintenance request upon moving in for this or other things.  More importantly, the lack of transparency and the things they charge you for were really killer. For starters, the lease has a couple of ways to charge you more than you would expect unless you read it very closely and look for everything. For 1, it's slightly less than a year-long lease, 2nd, there's a (not cheap) fee if you want to transfer rooms because you add or subtract a roommate. Additionally, I lived there for 3 years in college and transferred every year, never once had a problem when I moved out. Then on my last move out, they racked up a bunch of charges that they suddenly needed to fix in the apartment I just moved out of now that I wasn't renewing. A lot of the charges didn't make sense and all seemed to be overpriced and like they were trying to make a little extra money off of it. For example, they were charging $40 per pinhole to paint/fill. They basically refused to have any kind of conversation with me about it when I requested a meeting about this. I tried multiple times to call, go into the office, and email to talk about these charges and they never got back to me with anything but an email reiterating what the charges were. Needless to say, I was very disappointed in how management handled the situation. If I can say anything positive about it, it was slightly cheaper than the neighboring apartments if you're looking for your own bed and bathroom. Other than that, you can definitely find better around campus, and it's worth a little extra money on your rent to not get screwed when you move out. The maintenance workers themselves were some of the friendliest and most helpful people I have ever met, I don't want them to take any of the blame for the issues at this place.

This place will try to screw you. Upon moving out we were hit with a variety of fees with no explanation and no evidence of any damage. They charged us $40 per nail hole even though they are explicitly allowed in the lease. They know that they can get away with it because their residents are students who likely don't have the money for a lawyer. They refused to meet with me or talk over the reason for the fees, and ended up threatening to send us to collections. The initial meeting to "sign us up" was so impressive. Then reality struck. Manager on duty? Occasionally. Activities to meet other students? Rarely. Safety and security details? A joke. There are so many wonderful apartments for Minnesota students. Stay away from here!

The units themselves are absolutely beautiful, modern and spacious and each unit has central air, stainless steel appliances and a full size washer and dryer.  There is also an option of secured underground parking or an outdoor lot.  They recently remodeled and added a trendy community room and gym with new equipment which has been an add on that I personally have loved.  Did I mention that because the property is not right in the city you get all of this for a good chunk less than you would get moving a couple miles closer towards Downtown or Uptown?? The apartments were updated a few years ago and look great, the pool was refinished and looks amazing, they added a sand volleyball court if that's something you like to do. They accept pets and are pretty reasonably priced. My main thing was the location. They are right off the bus line and near all the basic needs stores... I'm pleased I was approved and will be moving in soon.. Way to go to the new property owners for making this a nice place to live..

Great place to live - wonderful community and location! Had quite a bit of community management turnover when I first moved in (and I was less than impressed with the support they offered) but this has improved with the most recent managers who are much more responsive and open to feedback.

I have toured several times and currently waiting for my dream apartment to become available.  It's a bit s pendy but worth it when you realize what you get in return. The building is beautiful and the staff is wonderful.  Looking forward to being a resident.

I’m not a resident of Elan West End (yet!!) but I recently visited and had such a great experience. I thought I had made up my mind on another building in Downtown but on a whim I stopped by Elan West End. It was a totally difference experience there than I had at the other places I visited. I had no appointment but the leasing person Zoe was so nice and Brian, the manager, came out to say hello and welcomed me. As soon as my relocation package is finalized, I can officially commit and I hope I can make Elan West End my next home!

I originally lived here for a year and half in 2013 -2014. The location is amazing and the rent is really reasonable for what you get. The apartments are spacious and well designed, especially the kitchen. I moved back in 2018 and took a bigger unit. Everyone I have over to my place comments on how spacious my 2 bedroom 2 bath is. The neighbors are all really friendly and everyone is respectful of noise levels. I would recommend anyone looking in the Edina area to consider York Place!

Have been living here for approximately 4 months.

This is a great location for proximity to shopping outlets at Southdale. Walk-able to Walgreens/CVS and others. Close to France ave, Hwy 62, and I-494.

Apartment managers have been very courteous, helpful and respect their residents. 

Overall very quiet building, units have high ceilings and the fitness center is a nice amenity to have. Price is more affordable than comparable complexes in the vicinity. Would definitely recommend renting here.

The staff at  Excelsior and Grand are the best!
I cant stress how much I appreciate all they do for the residents. 
They are so hands on...
The activities are a great way to meet others in your community.
They continue to upgrade these apartment buildings which is appreciated.

Our family needed a place to stay here while we remodel our home. Marie and Meagan are nice women to work with, and receptive and accomodating. They helped us get furniture through Cort. Cort set up our place in l5 minutes! It was great! The area is quiet (we live on 4th floor) and the people around me couldn't be nicer! I love that we have a mix of little kids, older generation of people and middle age people living around us. It is nice. I also like living next to Kindercare. Hearing cute little voices throughout my day is nice and assuring. The fireplace is very nice and warms up our place fast. Management has come to fix things and has done a great job.

Marie and Meagan have helped our family to make a transition into a home and have been receptive, warm and just nice ladies. I appreciate that as moving is stressful.

Thank you!
The management team wants to take your money as soon as they can.  DO NOT BOTHER TOURING THE WILL GET YOU TO SIGN A LEASE BY DISGUISING IT AS A PRE-LEASE AGREEMENT
The management and maintenance is unreliable. I’ve had issues with my apartment that have not been fixed after multiple attempts. The apartments are incredibly overpriced for the quality.

We asked them to sub-lease an apartment months in advance. They said no one has tried to rent the apartment. When you call them on the phone, they said no apartments are available. Legally they are required to attempt to rent the apartment in “good faith”. Clearly they don’t have the ability to uphold their end of a contract. They want $18,000 US dollars to get out of a lease. So if you sign a lease here, don’t plan on getting a job out of state during that time. 

I would provide Excelsior and Grand as well as the ownership organization “The Connor Group” a star rating with a negative number if possible.
Management is terrible. They don’t tell you when they’re going to charge you more and they keep finding ways to charge you more money! Don’t move here!!!!

I have been living at Rex26 for 2 years.  We have a new management company take over the building.  They are amazing.  The community manager is prompt, professional and extremely nice.  The leasing and marketing manager is also super helpful and puts on great resident events for us.  i feel so appreciated and my friends and family love coming over to use the theater room and community areas.  The terrace is gorgeous!! 
LOVE IT HERE!!

I've lived in alot of apartment downtown; but I have to agree that this is the best apartment hands down. The property manager is extraordinary, and she goes above and beyond to ensure my needs are met. I am very happy.

UNSAFE!!! I have been living in The Vicinity (Sonder at Vicinity) for a year and I (as well as many other residents) have been victims of continuous robberies. On the weekends, individuals with weapons come into the apartment building garage and break into cars stealing anything they can find. It happened to me once again this past weekend 10/16/2021 and the weekend before 10/09/2021. This last time, the thieves even left/forgot a knife inside of my car!! There are cameras but the management company will not show you the footage. They are more worried about the reputation of the building than the safety of the people who live in it. I have tried posting this in the apartment building's community page but the manager will not allow those posts and will take them down (again, they are more worried about the reputation of the building). The managers will not inform other residents about these robberies and the only action they will take is send emails every once in a while about "not letting other people in the garage" as if all these was the residents fault and not a lack of a reliable security system- as the residents have NO way to control when the parking garage door closes. What will it take for the Sherman Associate Management company to do something about this? For someone to get stabbed or shot? I think it is also worth mentioning that the vicinity charges a monthly rate of $185 for a parking spot

These apartments are so gorgeous! I spent the longest time looking for an apartment and I couldn’t be happier, my appartment is so spacious and everything is brand new. There are a lot of great amenities in the building, and the neighborhood is very conveniently located with a lot of activities!

Constant shootings and large parties almost every weekend. Work orders are closed with no action. Increasing fees added to rent each year. Most amenities are never open or in a poor state of repair.

Avoid greystar they take your $$ and run!

Not generally a fan of getting shot at, for one. Add to that horrendous rent rates, utilities charged at 3x what the city is charging, requiring to use a commercial trash account, and we have told everyone we could to avoid Elan, and all Greystar properties, in the future.
Great amenities. As long as the pool’s not closed because of outside guest partying with glass ruining it for all residents.

I feel right at home at Elan Uptown. The management is excellent & always supportive when needed. The location is walking distance or a close drive to many great restaurants & hiking areas. Me & my pup love it here!
I enjoy living at Elon uptown. I have a great Floorplan in the west building with a good amount of space for just myself

Elan Uptown has been an amazing place to live  thus far. We love the townhouse style units and access to our own garage. The layout is perfect for what we need and location is great. Staff has seemed friendly, helpful and very communicative. We are eager to finish unpacking and settling in so that we can enjoy every bit of our new home.

Me and my girlfriend looked at 9-10 upper end apartments when we moved to Minneapolis and Daymark really stood out. 

What’s kept us here are the staff. Everything is so well run, clean, efficient, and fun! The staff make sure to get to know you so I always have someone to talk to if I need something. They even sent me a gift for when I got out of surgery!

The amenities are great, I love the apartment I have (The Grand), and they have fun events all throughout the month that help me save on my entertainment budget haha. As long as these people keep running this place I have no reason to leave.

Moving into this apartment was one of the best decisions I made when moving to Minnesota. The amenities are well kept and the location allows for many opportunities to get to know the neighborhood. 

The best part of living here is the staff! They are friendly, helpful, and have routinely gone above and beyond all expectations. In addition to being approachable and helpful for the individual residents they plan community events that fosters a strong sense of community and provides many opportunities to meet neighbors.

There are many reasons that Daymark has earned its spot as the best apartment complex I have ever lived in. First and foremost, the staff are amazing. The amenities are top-notch and very nice. The floor plan is incredible. I have an amazing view of the Lakes. The surrounding neighborhood is beautiful and vibrant.

The staff here are extraordinary. They are all so kind, helpful, and caring. They create an awesome community! I love my apartment, it's gorgeous and cozy. I have a fireplace, which I've always wanted! I haven't had any issues with my apartment either after six months living here and the entire property is well-maintained.

I am impressed with the Weidner management team they have done an outstanding job creating and maintaining this community. I will wholeheartedly recommend anyone to live here or one of the other properties under Weidner management.

I feel very much at home here. The staff are incredibly responsive and kind, and make sure I feel recognized and appreciated. The amenities and hosted events are top-notch, and I truly love seeing my neighbors enjoy their time here, as well. My apt is so lovely, and it feels like a place I will stay for a long time.

Thank you so much for all you do, Daymark staff!!!

There was a shooting with over 30 bullets and management only cared for profit. They treated affected residents with disrespect and offered nothing besides fake apologies as they try to hide everything under the rug. Do not live here and believe their lies of a 24/7 security. 

People in the area will try to break into the slow garage doors daily, follow you as you walk your dog, take photos of you, follow you into the building (as security plays on their phone and doesn’t do anything), and harass you.

I really wish the property managers would manage the property better. They throw more parties then actually working on the concerns of residents.
Management fails at basic communication skills. They never answer emails and are very curt sounding on the phone.
One manager has her whole family, cousins etc renting apartments here.
I was expecting so much more from this building but all i have received so far is bad attitude and dog urine smells in the common areas.
There are much better apartments to rent from,  this is not it.
There was another shooting last week.

This building is terrible. Management is unresponsive and do not care about the building or it’s residents. Building is weekly vandalized and broken into, robberies occur frequently on property. Bikes are stolen cars are stolen and management doesn’t let anyone know! I reported that six bike locks were lying cut in the garage clearly all stolen. They didn’t send a message out to residents about it at all. Shootings occur on a regular basis. I live where I have actually witnessed shooters flee into this building! When reported, management didn’t even respond. Parking garage is filled with cars who don’t pay to park there. Management lets friends park for free while everyone else pays hundred of dollars a month for spots. Which even then doesn’t really matter as I am double parked and blocked in on a regular basis. I had to miss 5 days of work because management didn't respond to my email about being blocked in for 10 days! There is a security guard on property but they literally do nothing. They sleep on the job and I have actually witnessed them allow homeless people to sleep in the lobby because they were too lazy to call police and deal with it. They don’t monitor common areas on the property and when I have reported unsafe situations they have actually told me “that’s not their job and nothing they can do about it, maybe I should call the police”. I asked management for their supervisors information and they did not give it to me. They denied it to me on 4 occasions that I asked and didn’t get ahold of a manger for months. After having to call multiple people at their corporate office I was about to get ahold of their supervisor, who is as incompetent and the management team. Didn’t respond to my messages for 6 days, doesn’t actually read the messages and replies to things I didn’t even ask. When I told them of my experiences he said that “Talesha the manager here says that didn’t happen so I believe her”. Maybe you should believe all the reviews and complaints from other people then. Maybe you should believe the photos and time stamps I have sent you. Do not live here!!!! It’s overpriced, unsafe, dirty, and not worth the stress!

Love it here! Units are sunny, new, and beautifully designed. Management and maintenance care and are super responsive. Amenities are perfect (work/lounge spaces, patio w/grill, printer, bike room, pet wash, fitness room). Building is a nice size (not too big not too small). Only downside is there isn’t enough garage parking for everyone. I’ve been able to find convenient street spots most of the time but am hoping to get off the parking waitlist soon.

Nox is an amazing place to live. It's recently built in 2021 with new stainless steel appliances, modern cabinetry with soft-close, and beautiful marble stone countertop. Light fixtures have a modern touch.  Floors are dark hardwood and windows are full-sized. I love the heated underground parking. It's apparent the builders put a lot of love into the design. The place is very well-kept with weekly cleaners and everywhere from the elevator to the hallways are always spotless. However, as a current resident, what I appreciate the most is the management team. The staff is the most professional rental team I've worked with since living on my own. Everyone from the front desk and maintenance to the VP of operations are super kind, courteous, and responsive. Once, a concerning event happened on the premise, the VP emailed all residents directly to keep everyone informed. He was kind and caring and opened up the opportunity to talk to residents individually if needed. Being in Uptown, crazy things are bound to happen. And it's so comforting to know that Nox is ran by a team of professionals who makes the quality, service, and safety of residents their main priority. I am glad that I chose Nox - Yellow Tree.

I’ve lived in Nox for the past 6 months with a roommate and we’ve had a very pleasant living experience. They have a friendly and responsive team who manages the building. If you ever need work done, they handle it in a timely fashion and always have someone on call for emergencies. I’ve never felt unsafe and everyone we’ve been around has been respectful of others and their space (I.e., clean community spaces, no disruptive noise). Free coffee, free printer (limited pages per month before you would have to pay), community grill and fire pit are all great features. The one tough part about Nox can be the street parking, but it’s not too bad, especially if you get a parking spot below the building. It is an extra cost per month for parking and it can be a little spendy. Overall though, worth checking out if you like being in the heart of Uptown and within a couple blocks of the lakes!

Overall I would say it has been a very positive experience in our first 6 months (may-nov) here at the Nox. We asked to move our move in date back a week and they were very flexible. Overall the place is in excellent condition with high end finishing touches. Although you can definitely tell it was somewhat rushed when you look closely. Every issue with appliances have been handled very quickly and the repair man is a very nice man. We were a little upset to not get parking spots, because we were under the impression there would be at least one for us and have been told there are some not in use due to leaks down there. 

To sum it up it has been a pleasant time living at the nox for half a year within walking distance to some great uptown spots as well as the lakes. Would recommend to friends and family.

Haven't gotten to see the place in person yet due to construction and COVID, but Anthony was so great to work with!! He made the application and leasing process so easy to understand and as stress free as possible, especially for those who are early on in the renting world. I got very quick responses to any questions I had, even outside of normal business hours, and he included extra information in his emails that I hadn't even asked for yet. Couldn't have asked for a better experience so far. Excited to see the place in person!

Stay FAR AWAY! You will regret moving here. Management here does not treat people with respect. Took 9 weeks for me to get my security deposit refunded, and it was in the wrong amount. I spent weeks trying to clear up confusion with the new property management that took over during my last month here.

I was overcharged for parking and was charged a day's worth of "month-to-month" fees - all because no one could get a hold of the manager so I could turn in my keys and complete the move-out inspection. I was already gone at my new place a few weeks before the lease was up. A month prior to move-out, I was emailing & calling to schedule the move-out inspection, and they would never follow up. When I was disputing the fees charged to me after moving out, I couldn't get a hold of the manager either. I'm sure they were purposely ignoring my calls. I had to contact the corporate office of TI Communities, but they still did not take action to rectify the mistakes.

Now, months after moving out, and after having settled the final move-out ledger, they've sent a debt collector after me for a supposed cleaning fee, when no issues were found with the unit and no cleaning fee was ever disclosed to me across weeks of emails and ledgers. B Side management STILL refuses to talk to me. It could be a mistake, it could be someone else's debt - but I would not be surprised if this is an act of retaliation after my complaints of the previous manager there.

DO NOT consider moving here! These shysters don't deserve to be in business. They are bullies & the building has become worse since TI Communities took over.

I just ended my year lease at this apartment. It was the longest year of my life. 
I didn't know much about the area at all but the apartment seemed really hip and cool. Chelsea talked up the place and showed all the "awesome" amenities. I signed my lease and my moving day arrived, I moved in and a week later I was awoken in the middle of the night to several gunshots.
