I jumped out of bed and looked out my window that faced the metro and I saw two groups of people running away from each other and gun shots flying. I then witnessed someone who was shot on the ground and dying from their wound. This became such a common occurrence that it didn't scare me any more. 

The shootouts happened at any time of day. It is not just in the late hours of the night. 

Fedex and Amazon will not put your package in the secure mail room. They will leave it outside the building or anywhere in the lobby where someone will steal it. I had several packages stolen during my year there. The first time it happened I talked to the apartment manager and she did not care at all, she said "oh yeah it happens". If the package does make it to the mail room you most likely wont get a code for the room and when you ask the leasing office to open the room for you they will be super rude about it. 

The fire alarm for the building went off a few times a month. 



The weekends are like the wild west. There is not maintenance and no one in the leasing office sunday. People go crazy. One morning I was in the elevator to go to work and there was vomit on the floor. 

My car got broken into while parked in the "secure" underground garage. Last october we will told very last minute (30 minutes before) that our cars had to be out of the garage because it was going to be under renovation and we had to park on the surface lot outside. I was not compensated the $150 a month that i still had to pay even though I was not parking in the underground garage. 

The staff is so rude and horrible at communicating. During my year there I would send emails and never hear back and when I would go in person to the office they were so unkind. 


The hallways alway smell like cigarettes and burned food.

Anyone who has written a good review for the apartment must have just moved in because everyone that I have met in the building hates this place. I was told by another resident that most people break their lease because they can't stand to live there anymore.

Last year I signed a lease with B-Side and I was new to the area. They did a great job with prices and trick you into all the amenities their apartment offers. They made it seem like they were a family, cared about their residents. Everything seemed new, up to date, safe, and one of their biggest sales point was that it was next to a light rail ( I should've known better). Please do your research on this area before you even consider moving into it and I recommend you visit this apartment at night if you're really contemplating. 
-	Fire alarms constantly went off throughout the apartment, forcing residents out of their apartment at odd hours of the night. The fire department would show up and everything would be cleared within an hour or two because of something little. My biggest problem was that there was no communication what caused it (ever). 
-	I paid $150 for parking and if the fire alarm went off, the underground gate would not open and you would be unable to get your car out of the underground garage. 
-	The parking is crazy, I paid $150 for underground parking and my car still got broken into. I had several friends who paid for the parking outside and their cars were broken into on several occasions and even had damages on their vehicle. IF something goes wrong with your underground parking access card, B-Side has no control over resetting it because they share this parking structure and it technically does not belong to them. 
-	There is almost never anyone there who wants to help you. They are quick to get you in and never want to talk to you ever again. Their turn over is extremely high.
-	I was so afraid to have my packages delivered here because packages would constantly be stolen or the door was broken, preventing anyone from accessing their packages.
-	There were always homeless people inside the apartment complex, roaming around and it was the most frightening thing because I lived on my own for a couple months. They always talked about improving the security and when I was there, nothing was done. I hope this has improved. 
-	Quality of the Apartment
The walls are very thin and you can hear the conversations and television from your neighbors. The apartment is updated but everything is done very cheaply and breaks down.

We searched long and hard for a wonderful property to rent. We stayed at the laurel building, and it was by far my favorite place I’ve rented. It was perfect size, had in unit laundry for an extremely fair price, and central AC/heating system. Not to mention- it had a gym we were able to access at any time. There were wonderful technology features- keyless front doorway entry we could just use a code to get in our unit; and an app to let people into the buildings needed. Brad and his team were super accommodating. Not only were they kind and caring, but Brad was extremely reasonable and helped accommodate to a special circumstance with our personal rent situation, which I’ve never had or expected anyone to be so gracious to do. I recommend anyone to rent from this property, it’s rare to find wonderful people like this to rent from with an actual great apartment!
These apartments are beyond beautiful and very well maintained.  The location is tough to beat, as is the price for the quality.  These are apartments for grown ups!
Great management, and wonderfully designed and brand new community in a nice location!

I've lived here for over a year and have had nothing but great experiences. I've never had property managers so responsive - any time an issue comes up (which is very rare), Brad is immediately on top of it. The apartment itself is fantastic, with high-quality appliances, custom closets, and my favorite part, large windows and abundant natural light. I would definitely recommend living here.

I've had an outstanding experience living at Caraway West End Apartments! From the moment I moved in, the staff has been incredibly welcoming and attentive. The apartments themselves are modern. The location is perfect – close to everything. I truly feel at home here and couldn’t ask for a better place to live. Highly recommend Caraway West End to anyone looking for a fantastic apartment community!

The units at Caraway are modern and well-maintained, and the amenities, like the fitness center, pool, and rooftop lounge, are great! The management is friendly and responsive, and the neighbors are welcoming. It’s also very dog friendly.
Great space, amenities and location. Expensive, restricting management, poor lease terms, little price transparency

We love living here! The staff is fantastic, always friendly and helpful, and their communication is top-notch. We're especially thrilled that the hot tub stays open during the winter—it's such a nice perk! Couldn't be happier with our experience here.
Shout out to Brooke and Robyn for always listening and taking resident's concerns seriously.  You are both appreciated.  We love living here and can't imagine anywhere better in the west end.

I moved into my apartment around August this year. Since my move, everything has been wonderful! I have been treated so kindly by all the office and maintenance staff. The building is always clean and upkept. The location is conveniently located by a Costco, a grocery store, and many local restaurants and bars. Needless to say, I love my home!

Amazing experience at Caraway! Great staff, spacious apartments and beautiful amenities. Overall, I highly recommend Caraway to anyone looking for a comfortable, modern, and well-managed place to live. It’s truly a five-star experience!

Absolutely loved my experience at Caraway West End! The management team was incredibly helpful and friendly throughout the entire leasing process. The apartment itself was spacious, modern, and well-maintained. The amenities were top-notch, especially the fitness center and pool area. The location is perfect, with easy access to shopping and dining options. Overall, I highly recommend Caraway West End for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to call home!
Great place to live with friendly and helpful staff that provide great communication.
Caraway is a vibrant and welcoming community in a convenient location with fantastic amenities.
I love living at Caraway West End because of the amenities and location. However, the rent is really expensive and the office staff isn’t great.

Securing a viewing at Caraway West End was an absolute breeze! What stood out to me was the convenience of the office being open on weekends—both Saturday and Sunday—which significantly simplified the process for me. Remarkably, I was able to tour my future apartment, submit my application, and sign the lease in under two days, a testament to Greystar's efficient and prompt communication. The office staff, especially Brooke and Robyn, have been phenomenal. Their professionalism, kindness, and dedication ensured my move was smooth, and they've remained readily available for any questions or concerns I've had.

The location of Caraway West End is unbeatable, offering an abundance of activities in the vicinity and easy access to downtown. From the moment you enter, the signature Greystar lobby scent is captivating—truly a sensory delight that complements the immaculate maintenance of the building by the housekeeping team. My apartment has been everything I hoped for and more, making my living experience here truly enjoyable.

I wholeheartedly recommend Caraway West End or any Greystar property to those considering a move. It's clear they have mastered the art of property management, prioritizing tenant satisfaction and operational excellence. If you're looking for a seamless move-in experience and exceptional living standards, look no further!
Great staff and location. No complaints here. Thank you
I absolutely love the finishes in my apartment! The amenities are top notch and it’s a very welcoming environment.

Great locations for students looking for so what cheap rent. It's couple blocks from downtown, at Anthony main bridge and the u of m. The building is kind of old. Some units have been remodeled but not all. The management is alright. As for the neighbors it's been quiet and peaceful thus far. The neighborhood is also nice with a couple fast food chops very close by. The bus station on 2min away!

Don’t live here. Its been a week and I cannot wait to get out and now I’m stuck. Yes the leasing staff is helpful and very nice and building is super cute. However, I am constantly woken up by drunk people both in and outside the building. I was told it was young professionals and that there were strict quiet hours etc and that all seems to not be the case. 
I feel like an idiot for believing it and really wish I never moved here. I’ve lived in the heart of NYC and Hollywood and have never experienced this. Do yourself a favor and don’t move here. As for the staff, they’ve all been so kind.  This is not a review for them. They are beyond excellent. But the building is essentially a frat house.

HORRIBLE Management. You are in for some complete BS when working with this team. The will lie worse than military recruiters promising you the world before you sign a lease including things like weekly breakfast, resident events, nice and amenities. The reality is they do not maintain their current amenities. The fire pits have be missing the remotes for a month making them not operational, the BBQ grills are disgusting without any cleaning in over a year, the fitness area workout on demand is for show only and not actually capable of streaming the TV. On top of all of that, you get to deal with them pulling stunts like waking you up for 6:30-7am construction on the exterior of the building without notice. Recommend staying far away.
Ruby did a great job!! Apartment looks great, can’t wait to see it built.

I had an excellent tour and info-session about Accolade earlier this month. I greatly appreciate the affordable unit option, and I think it's admirable that the units seem to be equal quality of regular units. I truly think that was a great first impression and I am happy to be signing my lease soon. I look forward to living here!
Came in for a tour of their 4x4 and was extremely impressed with the amenities! The staff was also very helpful with showing us their renderings!
This property is very affordable, safe, student friendly housing!  And not to mention, beautiful!  All the amenities are amazing!

I dunno what everyone on this site is talking about. I've  lived here for 3 weeks and they still haven't given me my parking spot. I paid for it and I'm expected to pay my rent for reserved parking but the actual parking spot has yet to be given to me. Basically I ask for updates on any progress regarding the issue and I get laughed at by management. I'm guess it's mostly about my money and not returning goods for services.  They tell me there working on it then I see them lounging in the pool area ...that's cool I guess but I think I know what steps to take next. This isn't pleasant in my opinion. 

The staff is friendly on the other hand not at all a reflection on them. They do a great job. The staff...that is.. not the management team.

P.s, please buy some light bulbs so the maintenance team can actually change them out.

I had lived in Marquette Place Apartments (MP) since June 2014 until November 2020 for a personal reason. I am getting ready to move back in on May 1, 2021 for not only all the nice things other folks shared about MP Apartments, I feel at home here at MP – the property management & staff are friendly, always ready to help. They make sure your needs are accommodated to your satisfaction and your stay will be comfortable. I am looking for a place for my retirement and I am quite convinced MP is the place.

I've lived in nearly 10 apartments in the last 3 years due to my travel. This is my favorite by a long way. There are a ton of amenities and the staff are fantastic, most maintenance requests get fixed the same day. They also provide free yoga, zumba, tennis lessons for all residents. Facility is clean and well maintained. Apartments are spacious. 
They also provide free breakfast and wine on weekdays. Rooftop club room, indoor heated pool and spa just makes this that much better.

Incredibly quiet for apartment living and we love having a washer/dryer in the apartment and a large balcony that accommodates a regular size gas grill!  Convenient to highway, bus, light rail, and great restaurants.  Very attentive management with quick response to requested maintenance.  Has great amenities including business center and shuttle driver.  Good mix of young and old in the building.  Be prepared for quite a culturally diverse tenant population.  The building is somewhat dated and shows it's 30-year-old-age, but is kept up well with some partial remodeling. I'll take the quiet construction over fancy aesthetics any day!

Marquette is the perfect distance from downtown and is connected to the sky-way! This apartment building has found a way to accommodate all of the residents needs and their staff is super friendly! There's free breakfast during the weekdays, an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and gym. Outside there's a tennis court and basketball court. They even provide the rackets if you want to play tennis! The staff also plans events for residents like tennis lessons, sake tastings and zumba classes. It's like living in a 5 star hotel.

Marquette place is in a beautiful location and has some nice amenities. The in unit features are pretty outdated so the price is a little steep considering how many new, updated, and cheaper complexes are up and coming BUT the place has great parking and the units are very spacious! Sometimes can be loud, but that's expected in most apartments.

I loved staying this apartment. I am 100% satisfied. Room is good enough and washer/Dryer are even in the room. Location is great. 3 minutes to Target, 5 minutes YMCA by walk.  
Even Management is Awesome. They are really kind and always do their best to take care of tenants. Maintenance is always on time and no hassle. 
I am sad that I am leaving this apartment and Minneapolis. But if you are looking for a place in downtown, Lasalle Apartment must be the 1st choice for sure.

The price, location, and management make La Salle awesome! Living in downtown is expensive, but this is one of the most reasonable. The management is also so nice and helpful. Jake, Michele, Tim, and Pete are all so kind and really care about us as residents and not just another apartment number. The location is also perfect! Right in the middle of things with skyway access and so close to target! Would recommend

The location of these apartments is incredible in downtown Minneapolis. The problem is that you will definitely pay for it. They do not have parking options for the apartment, so those have to be found on your own if you want a vehicle. Also, there are not really any amenities in the building. Everything else is separate including finding fitness, and paying all utilities.

Here is a non-exhaustive list of what’s happened in the 1.5 years I’ve been here.

1. My dishwasher has been broken for 3 months. I’ve been lied to on the progress of getting it fixed from them saying multiple times it would be handled by the end of the week and having no person come into my unit. Lying about saying new dishwashers have been ordered to then go back a week later and talk to someone else and find out they haven’t ordered any. The property manager himself has twice just made something up to appease me in the moment.

2. The package room was broken into and several resident packages were stolen. The building has done nothing to accept responsibility or compensate folks.

3. Related to#2, the building claims that they have a 24/7 concierge. I’m not sure there has been an entire week with someone on duty 24/7 since I moved in. Doesn’t seem like a big deal right? Unfortunately they control most things in the building. I’ve encountered people who do not live here in the lobby, elevators, and ramp asking for money or harassing residents.

3. The elevators consistently break down. I’ve waited upwards of 20 minutes just to get an elevator. I was stuck in an elevator for 1.5 hours and missed a work meeting because they didn’t close an elevator that was reported to be broken.

4. The garage door is consistently non-functional and was broken for weeks at a time allowing anyone into our garage. In general the property is not secure.

5. The parking lot consistently has outside cars in it. When my parents were here they were harassed several times in the lot and I’ve noticed suspicious activity but the building does nothing about it and never tows.
6. The pet wash, ice machine, and a majority of the washing/drying machines have been broken for weeks on end.
8. When facilities came to look at my dishwasher one of the men spent time in my bedroom. It’s really odd and uncomfortable to me that he was going into parts of my unit that are not at all necessary when it comes to fixing a washer.

In general the building is not secure, and the management does little to help residents. I moved in after visiting a friend who lived here for 5 years and it seemed great. But in the nearly two years I’ve been here I’ve seen the building fall into disrepair and the staff get more and more short and unhelpful. It’s sad because I want to feel safe and respected in my home and love where I live.

One Ten Grant would probably have to be the best all-around apartment complex in the Loring Park neighborhood. I lived here for a year and enjoyed the experience. The units are well taken care of and are also being remodeled. The views are fantastic, and the location can’t be beat right on The Greenway. The 24hr concierge, large guest parking lot and free cable are some other amenities I enjoyed. You won’t find a better value in the area. The people who work and live there are great, too. Make sure it’s on your list if you’re looking to live in the area.
Really cool spot. Close to everything on Nicolet Ave. Would be awesome if renovated a little bit but still an awesome spot.

This apartment is best for living if you love greenery nearby as the Loring park is next to it. Very well maintained and clean apartment. Amenities include decent swimming pool , small jacuzzi , gym , a good party room , theater room and a nice terrace space used by us for grilling. The only issue is number of elevators, when some one is moving in it becomes difficult to get an elevator. Other wise I would recommend One Ten Grant a nice to live aparment.
Super pet friendly, indoor dog park, on the Loring Greenway.  Amazing views of downtown Minneapolis

Great location on the Greenway with super easy access to the Skyway starting in the Hyatt next door. Perfect for anyone who works downtown and/or wants to be close to the nightlife. The interior is a bit dated but everything (appliances, A/C, water temp, etc) has worked perfectly for me. North side of the building has a great view of downtown. Staff is extremely friendly and helpful and they offer some really convenient services. Never have had trouble with the parking situation and there is a guest parking lot which is pretty unusual for downtown. If it were more up to date I would give it 5/5 stars.

This was my first apartment I stayed here 8 years over the years it got filthy they don't wanna fix anything here they have bugs roaches and mice like crazy the leasing office is so unprofessional with your file they don't care to help you or keep up with anything they filed about you to give you notice on anything trust me If your looking for a nice peaceful helpful environment this IS NOT THE PLACEEEE !!!

I lived here for 3 years. I literally had mice living in my unit due to the apartment complex not taking care of the maintenance. They will charge you high rent without fixing issues to end up leaving you owing them money once you decide to end your lease due to health issues. You can be the cleanest tenant and still deal with loads of mice in and out of your unit as well as roaches being EVERYWHERE!! This is no where you would want to rent at. They need to lower the rent and honestly refund everyone who lived here in the past 8 years. Its not fair and now im in dept due to me owing them knowing the unit was not properly cleaned or maintained. Im very upset...
My very first apartment and i had to get a cat to keep away the mice. The property management are not helpful at all and not a good enviorment for kids.
Only good if you like roaches and constant loud neighbors. If you are alright with that then this place is decent.

I would have given a zero, 1 is the lowest we can give. They don't care about their tenants at all. The light bill was to be paid by the apartment complex and they have now sent my daughter a bill for over $1000 saying that the light bill was not paid. They don't fix anything in the apartments. The have bugs and mice. Please don't move in this building if you can help it, because they will treat you like dirt.

If you live or lived on first floor I’m pretty sure your going to experience ants or roaches or mice and they won’t go away I’ve called maintenance a lot of times to get rid of it and when they came to “fix” the problem it became way worst they were crawling on our ceiling and I’m my bathrooms cabinets and my living room walls and on my bedroom walls I’m very happy I’ve never seen nothing on my bed I thank god for that.Otherwise please don’t consider this place it’s really bad.

Ive lived at Autumn ridge since October 2018 and I have to say my experience has been fairly well. Ive never had any mice, or any type of roaches or insects. My neighbors in my building, are pretty respectful and I've never had any problems with anyone. My 3 complaints however though are 1. The noise of outside neighbors from different buildings can be loud during late hours. 2. It is entirely too hard to get in touch with the leasing office by phone. If you need assistance Id suggest to walk into the office and speak with someone. 3. In order to do laundry you have to load a laundry card in the leasing office and if youre like any one else you probably dont leave work until about 4-5p but the leasing office closes at 4:30 M-Fr and they are not open on weekends so doing laundry here can be tough. Other than that I love my apartment, its plenty of storage space, the bedrooms are quite roomy and spacious and they try their best to keep the hallways clean. (People do intentionally try to destroy this building but maintenance usually fixes the repairs within the next day or two).

Where do I start???
From the work orders not being responded to for months to the rent raising $100!
How about I start on my first day moving in...
The first night moving in was a typical move on. My wife, 2kids and I were 1st best satisfied. It was many things wrong with the adjustment that needed to be fixed but the one thing that made us want to get out of our lease the very first night was 3 mice running around corner to corner. THE VERY FIRST NIGHT! 

The building is invested with mice! I have seen them literally everywhere to the point where they running around in the day time right in the middle of your living room. Management had the pest control people come to our apartment about every week for the first few months, noticing that they were useless I started asking for the sticky traps they provide...**BEST BET** I alone caught  10 mice in the open with these and another3-5 under my oven and fridge. ( NO EXAGGERATION) Management is horrible so don't expect any help from them. They also feel like enemies for some reason. They give off that vibe. And PARKING is absolutely horrible! 2 visitors parking spots to every building! If that! My company's cars Gabe been towed in the matter of seconds! My car... Was towed for being parked in visitors parking! My car! A paying tenant. They are money hungry. I give half a star to the apartment for the size of my apartment. Please save yourself the trouble.

Autumn Ridge Apartments are probably the worst apartment complex in Minnesota they treat their tenants very poorly they do not keep up with maintenance in the building they do not clean the building they do not repair anything you asked for and the office staff is rude and disgusting towards their tenants. They will up your rent without making any changes or upgrades to your apartment. Your guest have nowhere to park  and they don't even allow you to have a guest pass after hours because they decided that they want their office to run from 9 AM to 6 PM which any normal human works those hours. And then they refused open on weekends I don't recommend anyone moves here is the worst mistake I have ever made I'm building my credit so that I can move into a real apartment complex that treats people better! Don't do it! And I only put 1 star because negative isn't an option. They suck

The price is okay, I actually have one of the bigger two bedrooms (900  sq ft) which is the same price as all the others so that's good. This renovation they claimed they did was not done to all the apartments, things are outdated, old doors cabinets. Did I mention they have a huge pest and bug problem. It's ridiculous, can't wait for my lease to be up.

Living here at Autumn Ridge it was my very first apartment. I moved in November of 2014. At first I loved it from the outside looking in this place was perfect and affordable. But shortly after I moved in I started to notice things I didn't realize due to my excitement. The grounds weren't kept up garbage was all over the parking lot and grass even in the apartment hallways. The grounds keeper does a poor job. Dead bug left on the walks in hallways along with beer cans and cigar wrappers.  The carpet has stench from garabage being left sitting in the hallway too long. Marijuana wanna smoke constantly fills the hallways even after it was brought to management, and the police are constantly here. This apartment does have a roach and mice problem. Despite the fact of keeping my apartment squeaky clean you still see them. They are partnered with an exterminator called Bug Busters but they have been know to steal out of people's apartments when they are not present. I have experienced this first hand.  The upside of this location is that it is in a nice neighborhood and is fairly quiet, despite  your surrounding apartment tenants. It is Close to the main highways 169, I-94, and I-694. The office will work with you on rent if you may be short at times.  My lease is almost up here I do not plan on renewing it for this is not what I had planned for my first apartment. But you be the judge...

Autumn ridge apartments is a fairly old building with lots of updates needed. Lots of families with children of all ages. New Dog park for the pet owners and it's in a good location regarding shopping malls, schools and public transportation. There is  onsite laundry service but unfortunately it's not 24hours. The maintenance could be better and there could be more visitor parking available for tenants guest.
I REALLY WISH - THE RENT COULD BE LOWERED , GIVING THE MANY REPAIRS NEEDED. BUT ITS OKAY.

At first, when we found a 2 bedroom apartment for only 850/month we thought it was too good to be true. But after we looked at it, it seemed very real that we were going to get a decent apartment for an amazing price! We heard bad things about the management but we ignored it assuming we wouldn't need to interact with them too much since we were always good with paying our rent on time. The first couple months showed us why it was so cheap. There was no security, well there was supposed to be but the lock doors didn't work and they took months to even listen to our requests to fix it. Our neighbors everywhere were loud and rude. The place was always dirty from the hallways to parking lots. We didn't see any spiders for the first 2 months, most likely because we had to keep our windows closed all the time because the screens on every window was broken. But the first thing we did see were centipedes... Almost every day we would see at least one. About 6months into our lease our apartment got broken into, the door kicked in and everything stolen. We did not feel safe here anymore and they refused to let us out of our lease or even work with us to relocate or anything. The girls in the office are extremely busy and unless you make an appointment weeks ahead of time, it's unlikely that you will get to talk to the people you need to talk to.
All in all, I would not reccommend this appartment to anyone. It's cheap, but not worth it.

lived here for a few years and havent had any major problems. office staff is friendly and polite when you go to the office. a few maintenance issues every now and then but thats what you get when you live in an apartment for 3+ years. another plus is that its really close to 94/694 and also 169 so it makes my drive to work really fast.

I love having a balcony to sit on during the warm summer nights. I also have plenty of room for my family in my 2 bedroom apartment. The office staff is also friendly and helpful. I really appreciate the extra effort that has been put in to get the garbage cleaned up. Overall it has been a nice, inexpensive place for me and my family.

Tried to contact property manager to get more info about the apartments for rent(ie floor plans, pics, and things of this nature), and the woman who answered the number listed was nothing but rude. She just yelled at us. I don’t know if she was having a bad day or not, (not an excuse) but that’s not how I want a first experience with a new possible home to go.

I've lived in this location on Franklin Ave for 7 years. It was my very first apartment and it was a magnificent experience due to the building manager. If there were any issues she was always on top of it. She is very kind, funny, and proficient in her role.
The buildings are old but well maintained. I love the the arch windows, the high ceilings, the balcony facing the city, and the antique fireplace/mantel. It's not the most glamorous neighborhood especially when you get closer to Chicago Ave, but the park across the street is clean and their are three bus lines to take you where you need to go.

Alright, folks, let's talk about this apartment – it's like the cool kid in the neighborhood, but with a touch of fancy. Picture this: you walk into this one-bedroom wonderland, and it's like, "Hey, welcome home, buddy!"
First off, those original wood floors? Freshly redone, and they're like the Beyoncé of floors – flawless and full of character. And don't get me started on the woodwork – we're talking pocket doors and built-ins and fireplaces that are basically the Swiss Army knives of furniture. Need storage? Got it. Want to impress your friends? Done and done.Did I mention the balcony? Yup.
Now, let's talk security. Off-street parking? Check. So you can sleep at night knowing your wheels are safe and sound. Plus, there's secure front and back entrances – ain’t nobody getting in here without an invite.
And location? It's the golden ticket, my friends. Downtown's practically your backyard, Uptown's just around the corner, and the highway entrances are like your trusty sidekicks – always there when you need 'em. Oh, and did I mention the park? Yeah, forget looking into boring buildings – you've got yourself a view of sports courts & fields  & some trees right across the street.
But here's the kicker – the property management team? They're like the MVPs of apartment living. Been here seven years, switched units recently, and they made it feel like a walk in the park. Super communicative, super chill, super flexible, and always on the ball.Things get taken care of quickly & by a small team in-house.
So, in a nutshell, this place? It's got charm, it's got convenience, and it's got a whole lot of personality. Living here? It's like having your own little slice of awesome.

I recently moved into this amazing apartment and let me tell you, it's like a breath of fresh air compared to my previous luxury apartment. The difference is striking—it feels less like a sterile hotel and more like a cozy, inviting home.

First off, the move-in process was a breeze. The property manager is an absolute gem—friendly, responsive, and always ready to assist with any requests. It's reassuring to know that any issues or concerns will be addressed promptly.

Once I stepped inside the apartment, I was blown away by the beautiful woodwork around the doors and the stunning hardwood floors. It adds such warmth and character to the space, making it feel truly special.

Another highlight is the fantastic park conveniently located right across the road. It's perfect for leisurely strolls, picnics, or just soaking up some fresh air and sunshine.

What truly sets this place apart is the level of flexibility and attentiveness from the property manager. They took the time to understand our needs and preferences, showing us some fantastic options that ticked all the boxes.

As someone who works from home, having a bright room with interesting features like the fireplace is a game-changer. It creates a comfortable and inspiring environment where I can be productive and creative.

Overall, I couldn't be happier with my decision to move here. It's more than just an apartment—it's a place I'm proud to call home. If you're looking for a welcoming and charming living space with top-notch management, look no further!

This was my first time living alone and I ended up staying for two years! I loved this place so so much! The location is convenient, the apartments are beautiful, and the grounds crew is simply amazing. If you're looking for a luxury apartment this won't be for you. Its an old building that comes with quirks and less than ideals by nature. But if you're looking for a homie place to make your own, give it a try :)

I literally cannot say enough to dissuade anyone from renting these apartments. One star is too many. First off, these pictures are wildly inaccurate. The units are run down, poorly kept and dirty. The landlord is nearly impossible to contact and is unhelpful when he is reached.  The worst is the property manager though.  I've literally never encountered anyone so impatient and rude. From the first time I spoke with her,  when I called to inquire about any availabilities,  she cut me off, raised her voice and ended up hanging up on me.  Absolutely awful, constant miscommunications, very short temper,  all around unprofessional and terrible to interact with.

I have lived here about two and a half years now. What keeps me here? The location and the rent. The building is located near the Mississippi river (I can see it from my apartment!). The views are awesome. It is centrally located  right in downtown Minneapolis. The train is only three blocks away. There is a bus line right across the street and many others within no more than 2-3 blocks walking distance. Skyway access is right across the street (This is awesome in the winter time.). There are lots of shopping and dining options, within a 6 block radius. This area is very pedestrian friendly :). The building is very secure, clean and well maintained. The staff are wonderful and the office is open everyday until 10pm. Any maintenance requests are taken care of within 24 hours on business days and immediately in case of emergencies. 24 hour fitness room, beautiful community room and patio. The rent is extremely reasonable for the area and ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED!  You will not find a better deal. This apartment building is a rare gem in the downtown Minneapolis area. I have done extensive apartment searching and can honestly and happily say that Rivergate is probably going to continue to be my home for while longer.
Muy buena comodida  , vivi 2 añoa haí y todo muy bien

The owners are trying to upgrade quite a bit & my apt is newly renovated but very shoddy in part. The painted trim on the doors isn't even done all the way around. Things are often broke when I need them such as  the "new" elevator &  I've been without hot water. I was informed of a "bug inspection" yesterday and arrived home today to find my new bed completely ransacked, which I find beyond intrusive and was not explained. The rent is very overpriced for the area especially considering there is no central air conditioning & that the gym is poor quality & the quality of tenants. I was told this building was adult only & numerous people have children living with them. There are homeless people all over & I'm constantly hassled at the gas station across the street. I plan to move somewhere safer less questionable where I can more bang for my buck.

Lived at Cedars 94 for a little over a year. 
The property is dated and rundown. They renovated the front lobby in summer 2016 to appeal to new tenants, but neglected the rest of the property. Garage floods every time it rains. I leased a second floor unit and could smell marijuana every night coming into my unit from the apartment below. The ceilings are paper thin, you can hear every footstep from unit above. Staff is cold and uninviting. The location is convenient, but not safe. This property is not worth more than $800/mo. for one bedroom.

My Partner and me have lived here for three years, and we have been very happy with the amenities and management. Though the rent is going up a little higher, we plan to continue to make it our home for as long as we can. I recommend Cedars to anyone who qualifies.
Great apartment to live in with amenities and convenient location near eateries and shopping.
I see Marcus every morning on my way out. He always greets me with a smile, friendly conversation, and a welcoming attitude. Talking to him every day makes this place truly feel like home.
Bathroom Maintenance Oak Grove maintenance crew is the best!   They fix things so quickly and then leave a little card letting you know it's complete!

Refrigerator Not Running - At Risk of Losing Everything Inside  I wanted to commend 430 Oak Grove's Maintenance Crew on how they handled my minor crisis when I woke up and my refrigerator was not working.  With-in 15 minutes of leaving a voicemail message regarding my issue, I had a phone call and with-in a half hour Maintenance was knocking at my door to assess my problem and evaluate both ST and LT options to get my refrigerator back up and running. 
 With-in an hour, the refrigerator was back up and running.
Thanks for the prompt response and qualified maintenance crew to handle the problem.
Unit 406
Maintenance  Maintenance requests are handled seemlessly and timely! Excellent customer service!

A 1924 gem right in heart of the Loring Park neighborhood. Walk, bike, or bus to downtown. A short trek to the Walker Art Museum and Minneapolis Sculpture Garden. Pet friendly, washer/dryer in each unit, heated parking and storage for bikes/household items. Very private and plenty of common space including murals in the entry, rooftop deck, party room and workout facility. Awesome on-site management ensures this historic residence is and its tenants are well cared for.

I’ve lived here for multiple years and am very disappointed with my experience. Have only stayed because of the inconvenience of moving. Here are my issues: 

- If the hot tub has been functional 25% of the time I’ve lived here, I’d be shocked. It’s constantly under repair, and they often close the entire pool area for repairs. 

- The elevators are also frequently broken, and when they work they are painfully slow. They are also often dirty. 

- The gym is tiny and the equipment hasn’t been updated…ever? You’ve got two janky treadmills, two jankier stationary bikes, an elliptical and some free weights/cables. 

- They clean out the garage about twice a year, and it sets off the entire building’s fire alarm EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. Good luck if you have anxious pets. 

- The package room is only accessible during the office’s open hours from 10am-6pm. If you work during those hours and have an important package, you’re out of luck. 

- The building is impossible for Uber drivers to find. The entrance is basically hidden and the signage is terrible. 

- Most of the equipment in the common room is broken. Management is too lazy to replace the pool triangle or chalk. Only one TV works, and the building has had a robbery in the past where someone stole the one good TV. 

Positives: right on the greenway, near the lakes, front desk workers and custodial staff are friendly. But I highly recommend looking elsewhere.

I relocated from South Carolina to Minneapolis and had no clue about housing/ locations in the Twin Cities. Grace and Amy were so great about communicating with me and answering any and all questions I had about leasing from Lake Calhoun Flats. So sweet and responsive both via email and phone calls!
Management 5 stars. Maintenance 5 stars. Amenities spectacular. Apartments unique. Great price. Perfect location.

this place is pretty MEH.. I wish I was paying the 300 more a month to live at the building a block away. Lake Calhoun Flats is updated but cheaply updated. great location with the lakes, the greenway, uptown nearby but again wishing i knew better before signing and paying a little more to live at a much better place a block away. Lake Calhoun Flats has extremely thin walls. you can hear your neighbors and also the contruction outside. This week alone I have been woken up or not able to take work calls from home because our buildings construction work and the workers talking is loud right outside my door and windows starting around 7am. Not to mention the only driveway in is hidden and with massive potholes from the building torn down in front of our building that is building new apartments. there is minimal parking available and tons of cars illegally parked in front of the entrance and some blocking exits. In the winter - the snow is not always addressed immediately and having a lower car at times I was not able to get in or get out. Also- Uber and friends coming over will struggle to find Lake Calhoun Flats. can't see the apartment from street and poor signage. If you enjoy the smell of marijuana in the halls- you will like this place. i made the mistake of signing a 14 month lease so I am stuck here until 2020. miserable experience. i gave 2 stars instead of 1 because the building staff is pleasant.

The best advice I can give anyone looking for a place to live in this area is to avoid Lake Calhoun Flats! I have continually been disappointed with everything in this community. Some highlights would include: being towed numerous times (there is pretty much no parking availability - no matter what the management office tells you!!!), the contact high I get from my neighbors smoking weed, mold in my unit (and the issue not being addressed), lack of cleanliness (I don't appreciate the dog poop not being cleaned up inside the building in a reasonable amount of time), lack of notice when they come in to inspect the units, fire alarms going off at all hours and for long periods of time... you get the point. For your sanity, please live somewhere else!

I love living here! I've been here since November and it's the best place I've ever lived! The location is EXCELLENT. It's so close to the lakes, the bus stops, whole foods, yoga and 15 minutes walking to the heart of uptown. It's also a 8ish dollar ride to downtown which is an extra plus! The units are super nice and modern. I love the gym and party room too.

The people that work here are also so great. Shoutout to Bradley - he's such an amazing leasing manager and always there when we need something! Highly recommend living here :)

They unfortunately have scaled down on the security. Located within the skyways but lost of parties and multiple incidences where police have had to raid the rooftop. This area of town is unsafe for a building that does not have consistent security. If village green was no longer managing, and someone decided to take building security seriously then I would recommend living here! But at the current time the amenities aren't even safe or useable, especially the rooftop where kids threw rocks off and shut down the light rail.

After looking at over 20 different apartment properties near the U, we found SL to be the best and most ideal for our needs checking off all of our boxes.   Right next to the light rail, you can get to the U in 10 minutes.   It is conveniently located in downtown and very walk-able to many venues, restaurants and shops.   This area of downtown and the underground parking seems a lot safer than many others I have seen.   The SL management staff has been terrific to work with and very responsive to our needs in welcoming us to live here.   A special thanks to Amanda and Logan!  The apartment we are in is very nice and we look forward to using the nice amenities that SL has to offer specially the roof top pool and hot tub with the spectacular 360 view of the city.   I think it will be very comfortable and relaxing living here and look forward to meeting our new neighbors as well.

Generally, we had a great experience at the Soo Line. The apartments are in great condition, the location is outstanding, and the amenities are really well maintained.  And, contrary to some of the earlier reviews, the management has always been friendly and responsive. 

It's great to have a good restaurant downstairs, Peloton bikes in the workout room, a gorgeous 20th floor commons, and a year-round pool and hot tub arrangement!

The first issue, though, is noise. The floors and walls here are really thin which means that you are at the complete mercy of your neighbors. When we had good neighbors all was well, but when we had bad neighbors. . . 

If quiet is a value, and if you aren't up for the risk of hearing your neighbors parties or their music through the ceiling, then it's worth a second thought. 

The second issue is parking. Residents use the 517 Marquette lot next door. As downtown garages go it's poorly monitored and all manner of mischief goes down there. My car had the window broken out and was vandalized, and Nextdoor posts confirm that I'm not the only one.

These things happen, and I don't blame Soo Line. But, if you have a car, you need to know that it's going into a less than ideal garage.

Soo Line has been wonderful! I had a few hiccups during the move-in process but everyone did everything they could to help make it work. All the people in the office and at that concierge desk are very helpful. 
The app they have is pretty neat! You can make maintenance requests, get package notifications, and post on a virtual community board. 
I love that I can't hear my upstairs neighbors at all (I can hear my neighbors on either side of me but they are quiet most of the time). The connection to the skyway has been fantastic. 
I was very nervous to move downtown, but so far my experience at Soo Line has been better than expected.

The location of Soo Line is fantastic! Easy light rail and bus access, downtown restaurants, and indoor skyway access all in one community. I was able to take public transportation to work and walk to get groceries even during the winter. The amenities are great too...indoor pool and hot tub, rooftop patio outdoor area, and fitness center. I thought the management was friendly and maintenance was quick to respond to any needs. I did not notice any noise issues and neighbors were polite. I would highly recommended this place. The only downside I can think of is that the underground heated parking is expensive, although I did not use this amenity so I can't speak to the value of the parking situation.

While the apartments are lovely, newly renovated, and fantastically located, I cannot in good faith say my experience here has been good.

The management, specifically Troy, who heads it, is from a nightmare. You may get great service when visiting but as soon as you sign, game over. The staff are useless and can’t answer half the basic questions you may have because all they know how to do is sell you an apartment. Their office hours are at their discretion. As a resident, it is often near impossible to grab them as their hours are typical work hours. Try to catch them first thing in the morning? Oh they’re out somewhere... and you figure out it’s touring with a potential resident for an hour. Try to catch them in the last 20 mins before they close? Oh they’ve already locked the doors because they’re too busy talking to a prospective resident and despite your pleas for them to open the door, they casually dismiss you with a wave of the hand.
They will arbitrarily charge you exorbitant fees (over $100/month) for water/trash/gas fees, which is unheard of in all my experiences. And I say “arbitrary” because there is no visibility—even the actual company doesn’t know the breakdown of the costs when you call and instead they refer you to the apartment management, who actually puts through the charges. I’ve even been to the point of getting charged 2 times a month twice now and had to complain about it both times.
Oh and good luck getting any of your deposit back even if you tried to keep your apartment in pristine condition.
It’s right on the Greenway with a lot of restaurants and things to do. Our apartment is very spacious with lots of natural light.
The staff is super helpful and friendly! Great amenities and location.

The square footage of these apartments are huge compared to other apartments in Mpls. I live on first floor with loft style ceilings too.  So many great restaurants/activities to do in the area.  The management staff is awesome!  Shout out to Shannon & Hana!  Love living here!

I have lived several places in Uptown and the Murals is by far my favorite. The building and units are well made and functional. Even stylish!

The rare times I have needed maintenance, they were always quick and kind about all fixes.

The most impressive part is the constant upgrades. Many buildings in Uptown just stay as they are because they know people will pay for location. In my 3 years at Murals, there has been new flooring, the building has been painted, new furniture in the community room, new shared computers, new fancy coffee machine, and more. I always feel like I am getting the value for my rent here.
Love living here. Right next to tons of restaurants and bars. Easy access to downtown and the lakes. Perfect for biking around on the greenway and surrounding bike paths.

It's a great building! The unit is nice & has a lot of space for the price. I love the location, and there is always guest parking on the street behind the building. The amenities are nice, right on the greenway, and an all around good vibe and nice place to live :)

We love living here! It's a great price and great location within walking distance to food, shopping, and Aldi. Even though it's right on Lyndale, it's incredibly quiet and we hardly hear neighbors or the busy street noise. Our unit has all the appliances we want/need and we've barely had any maintenance issues in the two years we've lived here. The management is great and very on top of things too! I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone.

I would highly recommend living here. It is a more affordable apartment option in this area while still having a W/D in unit and decent sized square footage. I lived in an apartment overlooking the little courtyard and it was so pretty with the trees, and very quiet considering the location right on Lyndale. Also, noise from neighbors isn't too bad here. I have heard horror stories of super thin walls where you can hear everything through them but I didn't have that problem here at all. And the management here is very responsive to any concerns and are very easy to work with.

I moved into the Murals of Lynlake this past summer and I can’t imagine living anywhere else. The location is right next to the greenway and located within walking distance of many great restaurants and bars. The staff is friendly, helpful and attentive. The price is very reasonable, especially when compared to surrounding apartment complexes. We absolutely love our two bedroom apartment. It’s very open with a beautiful view. I can’t imagine living anywhere else.
- Jeff N

I’ve lived in the Murals for a little over 3 years now and couldn’t imagine being in a different apartment complex. The location is close to great restaurants and bars, pricing can’t be beat and the staff are friendly, helpful and attentive.

I've lived in The Murals for over a year now and absolutely love it! The building is super clean and kept in great shape thanks to Steve. The Community Manager Michaela and Leasing Agent Cindy are both super duper nice and make ever interaction positive. 

The amenities are also great, my personal favorite is the community room complete with a pool table, fireplace, speakers, and tvs. It's the perfect hangout spot in winter. During summer, nothing beats grilling up on the rooftop with a view of downtown Minneapolis.
Quiet, friendly, safe building with professional and helpful staff and efficient maintenance. This apartment community distinguishes itself nicely from the others in the neighborhood.

My husband and I moved in with our cat and dog in December 2019, and we've said multiple times how lucky we are that we did. It's been awesome having so many awesome restaurants nearby, super easy access to the Greenway and bike rentals, and enough space for us to both work from home. They treat residents like humans and the gardens are such a nice feature. The amount of space you get for the rent is far better than nearby competitors we toured.

I've lived at the Murals for about 2 years, and it's been great.  I would recommend it for anyone who wants to live in the LynLake Area.  The apartments are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff are great.  Everything is very convenient.  In my opinion, it's better than other modern apartment complexes in the area because it's more chill.  There isn't the obnoxious "Uptown Party Dude" environment here, just a diverse group of nice tenants.  You can socialize with people if you like, or just do your own thing. 

If you're sensitive to street noise, you'd probably prefer an apartment on the east side (facing away from Lyndale).  However, the apartments on the Lyndale side--especially on the higher floors--have great sunset views.  So it's a trade-off in that respect.  But wherever you are, the large windows let in plenty of natural light.  The windows are pretty well-insulated too, so even in the coldest months my heating bill has remained reasonable.  So, it's an artsy place, but also a very practical homebase if you want to live close to everything without all the hassles that commonly come from living uptown...

If you love poor customer service and being ignored look no further you found your new home. I have attempted to call and talk to someone about leasing a 1 bedroom apartment for the past week and have yet to receive a single phone call. I spoke with both Keith and Erin that work at the concierge desk who were both very pleasant to speak with but could not assist me with the leasing situation. They  referred me to speak with Kirby. I have attempted to reach Kirby multiple times but at this point I feel like my odds of hitting the lotto are better then receiving a call back from him. I was exhilarated when the assistant manager Kelly finally emailed me back but she was honestly very little help. She informed me that she attempted to call me three times but received a busy signal each time she called. I want to give Kelly the benefit of the doubt but it’s hard to believe anything this staff has to say at this point. I asked Kelly for a direct line to call her just minutes after she emailed me and she told me email works best and if I wanted to speak with someone call Keith (spoke with him three times this week).I feel like the staff at the nic on fifth would make great personal trainers with how much they have me running around. If management wanted to reach me my number is on multiple emails and at least 4 voicemails. Beautiful apartment horrible staff. I’m not one to leave reviews but I feel like people deserve to know the experience I went through.

I recently took a couple of tours at The Nic on 5th. My experience was so great! I worked with Mino and she was so professional and informative! After seeing the available units, her communication with me was perfect . So quick to respond to my emails, and took every call/appointment I needed to help familiarize me with the property. This place was elegant and high-end compared to many others that I've toured in mpls. Very nice decor. It didn't feel cheep the way so many mpls rental props do. The quality and finishings of each unit were by far the best I've seen in any rental property in the city! It really felt like a home, but inside of a lavish hotel with amenities that you would get in a grand hotel nationwide . Each person(residents) I saw during my tour seemed to be a very professional type and very together. So i'm thinking a pretty great group of neighbors to meet and socialize with. I am super excited to make a move to The Nic! I decided to wait until spring, and Mino was so accommodating. She understood that my timing was a bit off for my move this summer/fall, and made me feel okay about waiting until it was right for me. This was after she did a lot of work and almost putting a contract together. I got the impression she just wanted me to be happy in my decision and would be there for me at any time to make it work. Amazing service! It just left me with a great feeling that The Nic would be a great place to call home!!

It is very sad that such a nice building in a nice location with great tenants has such a terrible management team. They make so many mistakes and don't respond to emails. They make false accusations against people and never apologize for their mistakes. 

Save yourself the stress, this place is not worth it.

Negatives:
1.Only 3 elevators in the whole building. Two are standard and one is a freight elevator. The latter is used many times when people are moving in and out or order big items.
The building was down to one elevator for about 3 weeks. They would open and close them throughout the day and would try to keep two working during peak hours. We had about 20 people in the freight elevator stepping on each other's toes many nights. They did give us free cookies yay!
2. Very bad management. They do nothing but cause stress and problems. If you need something, they will exacerbate the problem. I am not sure how they still have jobs. They always act like they are doing you a favor. Horrible people. 
3. Lots of construction noise but it has come down over the last couple months.
4. Cheap interior finishes. Really really cheap
5. Mail has been lost numerous times
6. Don't properly clean your room when you  move in. When we moved in it was all dusty and dirty. It was as if the construction workers just left.
7. Very high energy costs for what you use. In the winter they charge you for what the community uses. Its not a very fair practice. Summer utilities are not too bad, but Winter utilities are extremely high. Beware

Positives
1. New building
2. Friendly tenants
3. Good location
4. Close to many workplaces

Bottom line, if you don't want to be stressed by poor management and waiting a very long time for an elevator and living in an overpriced building, stay away. 
If management were good, it would be a great place, but their mistakes and attitudes will be very frustrating and prevent you from being happy.

I lived at Laurel Village for two years. Just found out that Amazon delivered packages yesterday to that address rather than my new address. I called to see if they could check to see if my package might still be in the entryway as they always were when I lived there. Response: We are too busy to do that!

Good location, ok price (for the first year ONLY). That is where my list of good things ends. Read the bad reviews and believe them! Management is not helpful and rude. Guest parking sucks. The apartments literally fall apart more and more everyday to the point where you no longer want to call maintenance cause they will be in your home EVERY DAY. Plus the last time they were in my apartment they were supposed to fix something on the main floor yet EVERY SINGLE light was on I’m my apartment and that is the only utility they make me pay for. - Never called maintenance again, just living in a broken down apartment. Can’t wait to get out. Do waste your time out your money - it’s 100% not worth it!

I moved from out of state and when I was talking with the agent they never once mentioned that due to construction the amenities in my building would be closed for 6 months of my lease. That's crooked in my book. They have a beautiful sundeck, That you are not allowed out on if it lightly sprinkles rain and they close access to whenever there is a parade. They talk about the movie theater and movie night as well as game night. Game night is always Bingo so bring your grandma vibes and the movie picks are all done by one person with horrible movie taste. Priced high for all of the failures. The first week I lived here there were several thefts in the secure garage and when I have scheduled guest parking for visitors the unprofessional security staff has parked in the reserved spacing causing me to have to call in and get other parking arranged last minute. The Air Conditioning in the entire building has been out for days in the middle of summer and any communication on the community wall bulletin board they offer is heavily censored and any criticism of the operation of the property is redacted. Its a beautiful property with an excellent location but is poorly managed and maintained. The office staff is always friendly but I will definitely not be renewing my lease.

Property management communication is just not present. If you plan to apply and have any questions regarding the property, good luck. Their email responses are uninformative and robotic, despite taking about an entire work week to respond. The struggle to communicate with them will be something you have to live with if you consider this place your home.

The central has been broken since August 22nd . We are now in September !!! Do not waste  your time moving here . It has been in the 90s for the past few days and they can’t even get us bottled water but canceled the movie showing so they don’t have to be in the heat . Very slow to fix . They have not offered resident fans  or reimbursement for fans . A mouse has also been in the parking lot for weeks and no one has removed it .

My apartment was disgusting when I moved in. Dust was caked on the blinds and door hinges more than 2 inches thick. There was dog food and ants behind my stove even though management said an animal had never lived in the unit. Everything smelled like urine. Also, the hallway constantly smells like marijuana and the smell has started to fill my unit too. The price is nice for what you get and there are some nice amenities, but I wouldn’t recommend. Also, there aren’t any cameras in the hallways so even when a tenant was being anonymously harassed by another tenant management could not help with identification. 

That said, I’ve had mostly pleasant interactions with management and have had all work orders fixed in a timely manner.

Pros:
Management team generally responsive, good (not great) apartments, several options for paying rent, community events, responsive maintenance team, free guest garage parking (albeit, extremely limited).

Cons:
•swimming pool basically useless if you don't live in that building because it's too small to comfortably fit more than one person/couple, and you don't know if someone is already there before you get over there.
•Crappy gym.
•Security is only for looks (they don't do anything and basically say "idk what you want me to do about it" when you call them.)
•They messed up my key fob when I moved in on a Friday and I couldn't park my car in the the garage I paid for until Monday and just HOPE my car didn't get towed.
•It's supposed to be a smoke-free community, but it literally ALWAYS smells like cigarettes AND marijuana in the hallways.
•Walls are so thin that I can hear my neighbor talking on the phone...and also the person on the other line.
•Speaking of loud, if anyone else is running water, there is a high-pitched sound coming from the pipes in the walls the entire time.
•Barely any kitchen storage space.
•They have bike storage, but it's so crowded it's almost not even worth trying to get your bike locked up, because it's not happening.
•SUPER hard water that's hard on my hair and skin.
I looked up the model number for my dishwasher, and it was made in the year 2000.
•I have seven windows in my apartment, and six of them face my neighbor's widows.
•The lock for the dumpster is messed up, so it's extremely difficult to open, and other residents just leave their trash on the ground.
•It's near a busy road so you hear honking all day and night.
•It's also near the interstate, so you hear people revving their engines. I think I've made my point.

The maintenance and cleaning staff are wonderful but be sure to read your lease thoroughly. There is no way to break your lease or sublet in any way. This company is based on profits, not taking care of their tenants. 

My storage unit was also broken into, so the buildings are not secure.

Maintenance takes a long time to show up, and closes work orders when they don’t feel like completing them.  I had a wasp infestation that they ignored for a month - I ended up having to sleep with a towel covering the bottom gap on my bedroom door.

The property management is awful to work with. They do not care about their residents needs or concerns. They’re drones that stick to a script and are unacommodating in every situation. The security is also a joke. They’re rarely seen and when they are, are too busy stopping guests from coming upstairs after they’ve been buzzed in, to stop people from vandalizing cars in the parking lots. The location is NOT worth the hassle this comes with. The cleaning and maintenance staff however are very kind and good at their jobs.

The location was pretty great.  However Hennepin is starting to attract some shady characters so I didn't really feel safe walking to most things from that location.  There were recently some break ins to cars in the garage which wasn't great either.   Also, the management company the wasn't great.  Any time we had to work with them they were hard to deal with.  They mostly treat you like you're a dumb college kid in a dorm or something.   They lost some of my paperwork one time and tried to say it was my fault, luckily I'd kept my copy!   The maintenance workers and desk workers were all super nice though.

This place is shady and I should have trusted my gut.

Their apartments are dingy, dirty and under-maintained.  They engaged in bait-and-switch by showing an apartment supposedly identical to the available units (since available units are not available for viewing because it is occupied).  My units weren't properly cleaned, the carpet was atrocious and broken blinds were replaced.  I felt like I was moving into a slum building.  I literally broke out in hives during the short time of my move.  When I reached out to the property manager, their expectation is on the tenants to make all possible accommodations and concessions: Can I move all my stuff out so they can clean the carpet?  Can I take off work because "some conversations must be in person"?  There is not an ounce of human decency, understanding and remorse coming from the property management.

Long story short, I would have been better off camping in the woods and burned my money for warmth than choosing this dump.  This place is hazardous to your health.

Apartment is in a great location, easy access to a lot of great bars/restaurants and highway. Decently priced rent compared to downtown apartments. Covered, heated parking is a huge perk. Main downfall is that some apartments are outdated, my kitchen could use some updates.

I've been at Laurel Village for three years and have had a wonderful experience. The staff is helpful and friendly, the common areas are clean and well taken care of, and it is in the heart of downtown Minneapolis, walking distance from tons of restaurants, theaters, bars and even Loring Park.

My apartment is the perfect place to enjoy the many different attractions around me. It is not only conveniently located near trendy shops and thriving bars, its also located right near the lakes. My roommate and I love to walk/run the lake every night or sometimes take out the paddle board. The apartment itself is the perfect size and staff that rent from us are very friendly. Overall a great first place to take on the city!
Its rather old, but a nice little apartment in the heart of uptown. If you are looking to be close to the city and all the action, this is a great place to live.

The building management since Weidner has taken over has been absolutely appalling. Thefts in the garage and crime in the building has gone up. Getting an email response from the building director or assistant director has been impossible (it's been two weeks to a month to get a response). Facilities are constantly out of order. They prioritize community events versus fixing amenities that are "sold" as a part of the community. They will charge late fees on ZERO balances and not tell you.

This property management company does NOT care about residents in any capacity and will just ignore residents outright. I am not the only resident who cannot get an email reply for over weeks or MONTHS at a time.

Since moving in to the building in early summer the building sold to Weidner. The decline (as others have mentioned) has been stunningly bad. The lack of attention and upkeep to common areas is the tip of the iceberg. There still is no true concierge service as the current "placeholders" are not nearly as detailed as the previous management. Amenities continue to break on a weekly basis, the third elevator was out of order for almost 90 days which resulted in 5 minute wait times to access the elevators. Responses from management have not been timely and often go completely un-noticed. I've also noticed they've seemed to have raised rent along with the rapid decline, to which I do not see a correlation. Hoping things turn around but this is not the building I thought I was moving in to.

The building was recently sold….and holy crap I’ve never seen such a rapid decline. I believe it comes down to this…..pride. The previous owners were many things…and not always good. But they took ownership and pride in their responsibilities. Our concierge showed up early in the morning to check every nook and cranny in the common areas. She cleaned the coffee machines every morning. She checked the computers and the copy machine. She catalogued all the overnight deliveries and promptly got them to the Luxer room. She may not have been much for small talk….but I got to come home every day knowing that things were being taken care of.

Weidner staff seem annoyed to be here. They’re clearly frustrated with all the complaints we’ve been giving them….but rather than be our advocates, they treat us like another annoying crisis to deal with right along side a building experiencing the first signs of being over a decade old. Greystar made it clear that they’d take care of us…..Weidner makes it clear they are tired of dealing with everything…including the residents.
Love the layouts, residents keep to themselves, and we feel safe.
I have loved living at LPM Apartments! The location is great and the apartments are very spacious.
Amazing Amenities, Unique Layouts that feel big. So happy we moved here and will probably stay a second year!

Poor management.
Ridiculous fees.
Homeless & drug dealer problem outside.
Slow elevator & coin operated washer/dryer units that run poorly.
The list goes on.

As far as convenience goes, this place is walking distance of many places but living here will make you feel unsafe. Security measures are woefully lacking. Nonresidents get in all the time (it’s really easy to get into) and then they get in to the whole building. They will smoke, drink, pee, leave garbage everywhere and STEAL so many packages. The rent is high considering the only amenity is free Wi-Fi that they tell you isn’t even that great. Management is nice and tries to be helpful but they can only do some much about the non residents coming in. The owners need to add fobs to all entrances and doors. I carry mace and a knife with me just to check mail or do laundry. Laundry is coin operated and the machines aren’t that great. They also don’t have any drawers in bathroom or kitchen.

Stage is the perfect building for those wanting to live downtown without breaking the bank. Though one of the  most affordable (non-rent controlled) options in the downtown MPLS area, the units are well-maintained and relatively trendy, with NYC loft-style high ceilings and stainless steel appliances. and are also pet friendly (cats and dogs under 25 lbs). Vehicle owners may be inconvenienced by the lack of affordable parking options, but bike lanes and transit links abound nearby (only 3 blocks to the light rail!). Stage may lack "luxury apartment" amenities (pools, fitness rooms, communal areas, etc.), but does well at providing the basics, and speedy maintenance. The area immediately  surrounding the building can at times feel a bit sketchy, but never have I felt unsafe. Overall recommended.
I love the location, walkability & amenities. Britni was great and so knowledgeable, she answered all of my questions before I asked them!

I would not recommend this apartment specifically due to management. We moved out in November 2023. From the beginning, there were very high application fees — more than anyone else in the area was charging. This management does not do any referral deals or really any deals/specials like most other north loop apartments will do. Lots of hidden fees — had to pay for our key fobs (mine ended up not even working) which you have to return and this is not a deposit/refundable expense.

Other issues we would’ve looked past if we didn’t have a bad experience with management: dishwasher didn’t work when we moved in, dryer broke and took 2 maintenance requests and 2 emails before we ever heard from anyone — we were without a dryer for multiple weeks. Our names were never added to the call/ring-up system despite multiple requests throughout our time there. I WFH and there were multiple occasions where there was extremely loud construction without warning. Also many random fire alarms went on throughout the summer due to system issues. In the summer, running water wouldn’t get cold. During renovations, which were going on the majority of our time there, our parking spot was surrounded by boxes for months on end.

Despite all of this, we still considered resigning because of the great location and the actual building was great. However, 5 months before our lease was up, management had us schedule a “yearly walkthrough” where we were given an “early bird special” which increased our rent and told us we had to make a decision while they were in our apartment. We declined and got multiple texts and calls trying to convince us, telling us they’re saving us so much money with this special, etc. This ultimately turned us away from Dock Street Flats. I’ve never had to make a decision to resign/get a rent special more than a couple months away from the end of the lease. It felt super pushy and we had no idea that’s what the “walkthrough” was for. Once we moved out, they also asked us for our forwarding address 4 separate times which felt really unorganized. 

Overall, we really enjoyed the building and location, and day to day living there was fine. However, the insane hidden fees and constant feeling like they were always trying to get more money from us made it not worth it to live there anymore. Have had much better experiences elsewhere in the north loop.

Research the Connor Group before ever signing ANYTHING. They bought the building in Nov 22 and ever since then it has been a literal nightmare to live here. Read and believe the negative reviews. Do NOT disregard them

DO NOT MOVE HERE! This place is unsafe, I have come home many nights to strangers sleeping in the common areas and buildings front vestibule. Living at Dock Street Flats is an absolute nightmare, filled with broken promises, deceitful practices, and charges for amenities and services that were never delivered. I cannot stress enough how disappointing and frustrating my experience has been.

The management team made several promises during the initial leasing process that they failed to fulfill and questions regarding the updates are often ignored. They claimed they were going to update the community and make it an amazing place to live. They slapped a “Luxury Apartments” sign up and raised rent despite the community lacking a lot of features and amenities that most of the other apartments in the neighborhood have. They said that they are going to prioritize the current residents before discounting for new residents and then increased our monthly expenses over 20%!
