Please share this with all the friends whom you know and live at green briar.

This complex was built in the 70s and has never left.  The previous review (Cheap and Cheap) is spot on.  The staff are rude--they make promises and then when you confirm or follow up, they deny they ever said what they said.  They will brag that floors and walls are incredibly sound proof--LIE LIE LIE. I am pretty sure the people above me wear cinderblock sandals all day long and rehearse their STOMP performances nightly. Be prepared to wait several minutes for hot water from any tap unless you can time it with your upstairs neighbor flushing their toilet--then you will get a surge of hot water. I have had to make multiple repairs to things because maintenance is unreliable (thank gawd I married a general contractor). The garage flooded in August 2018 and the entry carpets and common areas got soaked with 1-2 inches of water and when it rescinded, it left a disgusting mess behind that took months to address--even though they say that cleaners come through weekly.  Its laughable that they think just laying down new laminate that looks like wood suddenly makes it all better!  Its dark and dank and they have raised the rent without raising amenities or the aesthetics of the place.  Their attention to detail (or lack there of) is clearly evident in their ad above--it is wrought with spelling and grammar errors--seriously--they couldn't take a few extra minutes to review it before hitting the send button?   That should be enough to tell you--keep looking.

This apartment is located on two bus stops, 15/56/57 routes which takes you to campus quickly and 2/10 which takes you there a bit longer. And the apartments are both big and cheap however, they is crappy from the inside. Everything is OLD. But I mean, you get used to it.

My big problem is with the landlord. Pam, at start, was very friendly and helpful, but ended up charging us 400$ for absolutely nothing. When I first signed the lease and saw the apartment, she pointed out that there were burn marks on kitchen tiles, and she said that she has acknowledged it and that it isn't even necessary to note it on the sheet she gives you. Anyways, after I left the apartment she charged us 200$ for the tiles, and although I have emailed her about it, she said that they were brand new! THE KITCHEN TILES WERE DISGUSTING, matter of fact, the countertops and the cabinets were all disgusting and smelled, but I really didn't feel like making a fuss and went on with life. The tiles were so bad that we never walked barefoot into the kitchen. And after suffering for a full year, Pam ended up charging us for the tiles. Anyways I asked her to show me documentation that proves when the tiles were last change and she stopped responding. She also made us pay for cleaning charges which was stupid because we returned the apartment in a better condition (after 4 days of cleaning). 
The other lady, however, is even worse. She is very rude. Cant really explain this one but trust me on this.

Overall, don't expect much. The prices are low but the quality is really bad and the office people are terrible. I would recommend one of the neighboring apartments.

I initially liked this place as soon as I toured it. However, after living here for a month, I realized it was a mistake to choose this house. We reside on the 2nd floor, and we constantly have to tolerate the noise from the apartment above us. The noise is persistent throughout the day, with frequent sounds of footsteps and movement.

Additionally, although it was mentioned that the upstairs neighbor had a cat as a pet, they also have a large dog that frequently runs around, further contributing to the noise and causing significant disturbance.
The location is really good, next to a park and tennis court, quiet at night. A bit far from campus but very convenient bus service.

It has been horrible under the new Katz Management. There is no communication between management and resident. Emergency exit lights do not work, multiple washing machines down for months, little to no snow removal, no turn around time given on ticket requests, the list goes on. Currently there was no hot water for a week and not a single email until the end of the week from Management. Ridiculous

This near-westside Madison is perfectly located on a busline close to the UW-Madison campus. We have a nice pool and well kept grounds and are next to a very large park. While rent is still relatively low compared to many of the new complexes around, there are also no new updates inside. Appliances are outdated, light fixtures may be original from the 1970s, and the walls are paper thin. Still, location and price make this a nice complex.
I cannot say enough good things about this place.  Love the apartment, the amenities, the response from staff.    A great place to live.

While still living here and after asking to re sign a lease, management showed our home and even had the new tenants sign a lease FOR OUR UNIT. Also, inflation is ridiculous here. Look elsewhere. Definitely not worth it
This is by far the best place I have ever lived!  The units are top of the line and beautiful.  Staff is great.

Pros: Maintenance is very timely when you have issues during the week.  Had the heating unit in our apartment go out twice during the winter where it was blasting cold air but they came first thing when they came in.  View of the river is nice.

Cons: Pricing is extremely high for the size of the apartments offered.  First floor business (B&H) is extremely loud for most of the warmer season (April/May through October) with their live music.  If you get home after work and are hoping for a relaxing evening, you won't get it until after 9 PM of course they won't show you the apartments during the live music so you won't appreciate how loud until you've signed the lease and moved in.  Also went to a new computing system that they don't seem to understand resulting in them forcing tenants to handle finding replacements for their apartment units if you need to leave your lease early (can't do 12 month commitments).  In the past 10 years, the places I've lived with let you terminate your lease if you get 60 day notice and pay 1 or 2 month fee but this one you'll be locked in for a full year and on the hook for all of it, no exceptions with the explanation, our software is too complicated to figure out.  Being on the river, the thought of having the patio was great to be able to enjoy the view but with being next to the water, you get an insane amount of river flies when it's warm which means lot of spiders as well.  You can clean off the patio so it looks great but by the next day the patio will be covered in cobwebs again.  Along with those issues, they have an electronic key system (fobs) that work 90% of the time but you will eventually have issues with because they don't keep their door software up-to-date.  Has been an issue for the onsite gym and parcel room.

This property is only 1 year old and has required numerous maintenance requests. When engaging with the on-site manager be prepared for passive aggressive emails. The only time they send property-wide emails they’re threats about lease violations. Beware: THEY WILL CHANGE THE RULES OF THE BUILDING/LEASE BECAUSE IT IS WRITTEN IN THE LEASE ALLOWING THEM TO DO SO(*at their discretion*), so basically whenever they want regardless of the contract you signed upon moving in. This is not a troll review, but man has this place a let down…

We lived in unit 274, I would not recommend this unit. It is located right above a very noisy dog park that is open 24/7. Expect dogs barking throughout the night(midnight-5am). Don’t expect to enjoy your balcony without your HVAC vent blasting and being loud. (It is located on the balcony). There is no windows in the living area besides the balcony door. When we moved in it was brand new, but you can already see things breaking down(shower heads from hard water, the sinks aren’t installed properly and randomly switch between hot and cold, etc). It is a shame because you can tell they invested a lot of money into the property for it to be poorly managed and poorly assembled(on-site manager isn’t very kind and contracted builders cut corners). We opted to not renew our lease for all the factors listed above. Keep these thoughts in mind when considering this property.

I love living at the West Edge! The beautiful, huge quality windows, along with the unique rolling shades are just perfect! The appliances here, along with the gorgeous common spaces, make this truly a place I'm so thankful to call home!
I love living here! Quiet neighborhood and neighbors. Amazing and stunning pool area. Couldn’t name a better location!
Couldn't be happier living here! The staff is fantastic, the community events are super fun and the overall living experience is just amazing. Thanks West Edge!
Our property manager is super responsive as well as the maintenance crew.  Great layout of townhome style apartment and love the many amenities.

The neighborhood is not only close to Madison but it also has character of its own with electric bikes you can rent, wooded walking paths, a restaurant, cafe and salon. The units at 4888 Brassica are new, very clean and cozy with activities for all ages and fire pits on the rooftop. Highly recommended!

We absolutely loved The Edge at Terravessa! It is the perfect spot for short or long term rentals. Everything you could need is SO close! The buildings are all clean and beautifully kept! We are so glad to have had this as a place to call home. From the management to the repair crew, everyone was top notch! Thanks so much for welcoming us! It was such amazing, friendly and peaceful community to live in.

Great staff. Everyone cares about what you have to say, or what you need. Maintenance gets done fast as well. The people in the office are very fast to get things done for you or the apartment in general. Great place to live !!

I’ve Been Living here for 2/3 and I can Say since I First  sign my Lease I knew this was Gonna Be Home for me . My very first apartment @ 21 years old . Wow they took a chance with me an I appreciate them for that I had some Rocky Boats Dealing with my own personal issues and the Management team , was able to understand and work with me , Literally that’s  what I like about living here they’re willing to work with you Give chances etc  just Don’t spoil it take advantage or even , Take the kindness for weakness otherwise if you’d love the fairway apartment of Fitchburg wi .

I have lived here for about 3 years. I love my view. I am facing the golf  course.  the office team is great. they are friendly and respond in a timely manner to any of my service request. I was concern with so many unit that it would be loud but that is never an issue. I plan to stay here until i purchase my first home. Shout out to Rhonda for being professional and caring. 

thank you fairways for all your support.

As a current resident for almost a year, I am completely happy with the staff and maintenance of The apartments They are very efficient and timely when addressing needs of residents. Property is very well maintained and a safe place to reside.
I love the view from my patio, even with the beautiful remodel.
Fairways is a very good complex to live, and the staff is excellent at there property. The property to me is well maintenance and safe to live.

For me the Fairways provides a really nice atmosphere along with plenty of attractions like swimming pools,tennis courts, weightlifting facilities.. etc. OH! And, you can use the community rooms for private parties and the room is next to the best leasing office I've ever encountered. I would strongly encourage you to apply.
They are doing a lot of upgrades and cleaning up the area. Very fun place to live
This place is nice because they are in a great location and the office staff is nice and friendly!
They are so friendly and the office is open to residents concerns. The maintenance is great and so is the pool during the summer.
They are very pet friendly and the apartments are affordable. Also the people in the office are wonderful. Maintenance is great and we love our new winfows.

This is hood. Apartments are run down. Constant traffic in and out all hours. People leaving locked doors open. Lots of issues in the apartment it self. Mostly cosmetic but verry noticable. If I had other choice I would of waited. But I had a time crunch and had to take what I could at the moment. Also the area around is trashed. Garbage everwhere. Kids seem to be unsupervised a lot. Be careful when driving. Almost hit a 2 year old wandering the street late at night. Basically is this the new allied drive?

For $840 per month I am paying for a place that is not worth the money. No dishwasher. Old cabinets and poor caulking around the tub that looks as brown as dirt. I am completely dissatisfied.  Not to mention my broken patio sliding screen and only two washers and dryers for more than a few apartments.  My issues and concerns with my apartment are mainly aesthetic, but who wouldn't want to come home to a place that LOOKS good!?

The building smells horrible ALL THE TIME. The leasing office staff are clueless airheads. It takes weeks for matience to fix anything. I still don't understand why there is only three washers and dryers for the ENTIRE building. Okay, it's a decent price for a first apartment with roommates and bad credit numbers/history other than that pass!!!!!

The apartment community was very good and it was very clean and kept up. The office staff were very friendly and knowledgeable. The apartments themselves when shown were very clean. I would recommend these apartments to anyone looking for a place to live.

Management claimed a range of different reasons to take our entire security deposit and charge us more. We cleaned for 3 days prior to moving out and paid a cleaning company. They still claimed it smelled like cat and was left in awful condition. They also charged us 100 for a key we know was turned in. Our word against their word though. 

Appliances are cheap, the pool is crowded, gym is crowded, and management does care about anything besides collecting your rent.

The amenities are nice with the pools and a nice gym (when the equipment is functioning as intended). I overall enjoyed my time while I lived there. However, I was shocked at the move out and handling of the security deposit. I am a very clean person and I spent 3 days cleaning the apartment for move out but management was extremely nitpicky on inspection. They would just write “dirty” and nothing else. They also held me responsible for a repair that was not my fault and was a result of the construction so I ended up losing my $300 security deposit AND owing $120 additionally. This, in combination with the outrageous rent increase from one year to the next, show that they are more concerned with making money than keeping residents around.
Poor management and they will keep a significant portion if not all of your security deposit for what should be considered normal wear and tear.
It has been quite here for the last year, very peaceful, front office is very responsive.

It has been one month applying for an apartment and couldn't reach to them easily and after I reached to them they kept saying it's under review and they said that my kids cannot enjoy the swimming pool, it's only for adult's which sounded odd to me, they are extremely disrespectful and unavailable, it's not a healthy friendly environment, I will never recommend them to any one and if I could give zero stars I would but sadly I had to choose one star, they never got back to me for approval or denial even though I was waiting for one month.

Loudest apartments I have ever lived in.  I hear EVERYTHING my neighbors do.  The amenities are amazing, but the noise is not worth it.  I'm unsure what "whisper technology" does, but it sure doesn't dampen the noise!

It’s good except the buildings are built very thin. Highly recommend living on the top floor, because every step can be heard from the lower levels. It can be a little anxiety inducing but everything else is fine.

Walked the property today with Rhiannon and met Apoo. Very nice ladies & BEAUTIFUL complex. Beautiful location and extremely quiet. Good price & amenities included. Temp controlled garage is everything.

We’ve been living here for several years and it’s been a great experience the whole way! Something that really stood out for us personally is that ten35/TRM has a realty team that will work with you to help you buy a house when you decide to transition out of renting! We just bought our first home with their expert help and we couldn’t be happier!

The cool thing too is that if you use their realtor team and close on a house, they’ll work with you to end your lease early with no fees! They even have suggestions on what banks and credit unions to contact for a reasonable house loan, they have a professional site to track houses that meet your needs/wants and they’ll help you craft a strong offer when you find a house you love!

The apartment complex itself is also super nice for the (affordable price), with a pool, exercise center and clubhouse you can book for private events like parties or meetings! Apoo is also the sweetest, most personable property manager I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting and is a real treasure to know!

At least come tour the available apartments, you won’t regret renting here!

I've been living here for a few months and I really just love it. The buildings are nice, kept well and I never hear my neighbors. The grounds keepers do a great job especially during the winter. I am excited for the pool to open up soon, I'll be there all summer!
Great amenities, great managers in charge, not crazy expensive either, very fair for what you pay for!

I have lived with TR McKenzie for 3 years and have loved it. the property managers are incredibly helpful and nice. The apartments themselves and the common areas are beautiful. For the few maintenance issues we've had, the maintenance staff is timely, communicative, and very productive.

I was worried about the train tracks more than anything as they are so close to our building but they really have not been much of an issue. The trains are super random and we can go for days without one and then have 4 in one day. They are also short and you get used to them quickly, so don't let the train tracks discourage you. 
Our apartment is nice and we love the layout. It's relatively quiet other than the noise from above us which is pretty unavoidable in an apartment, especially since there are children over our heads. Also our balcony has been a bit of an issue with a neighbor constantly smoking and the smoke pouring onto our space. Those are really the main negatives regarding the space. Management is not terribly responsive but I think a lot of that is due to short staffing and everything surrounding the pandemic. I'm hoping this gets better. The package room can be a bit of a mess and carriers drop packages in the lobby on weekends which sucks, but that is not the fault of the apartment complex but the package delivery services. 
The amenities are great. Storage area is huge for the price and climate controlled. It's one of the only places in the area where you get two, underground parking spots for no additional charge. Trash room could have been done better and often is overflowing when there are move ins. You also have to go outdoors to get to the trash room which will be a pain in the winter, but there are worse things I guess. It would have been nice if the buildings had trash chutes and their own trash rooms. 
Overall I'm really happy with our decision to live here, even with the downsides listed. We are close to so many things. Walking outdoors is nice and it's safe. The place seems well built and the rooms are a nice size. The finishes in the building we're in are nice and modern. Overall, other than the upstairs neighbors walking and dropping things, it's very quiet. 
This is the review I would have liked to have seen when making my decision to live here. I tried to address all of the questions I had an but could not get an answer for. I hope this review helps someone else who is considering living here.

Over the course of the 5 years I have lived here, this apartment has raised my rent by 200 dollars and there are numerous issues. Firstly, the apartment manager likes to raise your rent just to hire 4 DJs and a private sailboat while they have year-round construction projects that make living there essentially impossible. Not to mention the homeless that sleep in the basement and sleep on the  bench outside. Manager doesnt respond to emails on weekends too.

terrible terrible terrible. the management makes it outrageously difficult to do almost anything. signing the lease is a nightmare for no reason, as if everything else. the property itself is not very nice and ridiculously overpriced. upon move in there were issues with my sink, loose cabinets, and more. the temperature inside of the apartment was very uncomfortable and the bathrooms were one million degrees even during winter. and the air conditioner makes the entire room smell horrible. there where bugs everywhere. they shut the water off every other week. mail gets stolen and they do nothing about it. the furniture is old, ratty, and literally falling apart. also when it’s windy or rains the windows rattle extremely loud and make it impossible to sleep. the employees are slow to respond to emails and are so unorganized. and for the prices of this place?? it’s almost insulting. take your money somewhere else please.
insanely overpriced, really weird and poorly organized management, broken appliances and furniture, no natural light. worst mistake i’ve made in quite a while

Property manager is quite difficult to contact. Maintenance is basically non-existent. Lots of bugs. Water is often yellow, you will need a filter for everything. Another tenant can’t even get their air conditioning fixed. This property is super overpriced when considering how negative of an experience the new management this year is.
Management doesn't care about the tenants. Building needs lots of repairs to make it liveable in my opinion.

If I could give 0 I would!!!! If you’re considering signing a lease with this company RUN!!! Trust me it is not worth the headache they give you, especially when you’re trying to end your lease early (after being there over a year) and with plenty of notice! They make you jump through all these hoops and end up stiffing you for your deposit in the end. We spent 6 + hours cleaning everything that was on the check out list and they still charged a cleaning fee for something as petty as dust or cleaning streaks in the fridge! Please know that their appliances are NOT new nor are they in perfect conditions like they say. Although there is a laundry list of other things I could mention it’s simply not worth it and I am glad to FINALLY be done with this place. Best of luck!
Moving in here was easy and went smoothly. The office staff are responsive and very helpful. It is also clean and quiet which is the most important thing for me. I would recommend.

I have been living with TR Mackenzie for almost a year now. I have no complaints. Maintenance is amazing. The girls in the office are always helpful and I really enjoy living in this area. You never hear noise from the neighbors and I have always felt safe.
It’s a nice location on the west side and convenient. Maintenance is quick and gets the job done.

My time at shadow creek has been fantastic. I've been here for close to four years now. This is a great location close to bike trails, bus stops, and grocery shopping. Good neighborhood. Very friendly staff who take maintenance requests seriously and respond quickly to requests. Lovely apartments with great quality and amenities.
The apartments are modern and it has a good location close to supermarket, drugstore, school and park

I currently live in the apartment complex. These pictures are LIES!!! the rent amount is not correct. after move in be prepared for another $200-300 in bills that the complex with make you pay for complex bills such as (common area lights, sewer,2 trash fees, water, pest fee, water) on TOP of the rent. I have lived here for 5 months and every maintenance request goes unanswered or they just delete them. there is NOT a playground or a fitness center. Some of the buildings have been deem unlivable due to the roaches. They don't enter partial payments in the system. They only enter when you have all the rent if not, they start eviction process after 1 day late on rent. PLEASE DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND DO NOT MOVE HERE. I WISH I WASNT.
Amazing staff and a lovely location with awesome amenities.

I lived at 22 Slate for the last year, and wouldn't be moving if I hadn't upgraded to being a homeowner. The apartments and fixtures are nice and modern, and I love that the faux hardwood flooring and limited carpet in the apartment made it feel easier to clean. I love that for the most part, package carriers leave things in the key-entry mailroom for extra security. The community is quiet and really well situated close to shops/restaurants. Management has always been very communicative about things going on in the community or maintenance check-ins. Sometimes guests have to park a bit away from my building, but that's not the end of the world. My only complaints are some people driving well above the speed limit around the community, and that it can be annoying that some package carriers will leave things at your mailbox rather than the package room, so sometimes you have to go searching. Neither of these are management's fault, though. I would definitely recommend living here!

I moved into 22 Slate and absolutely love it here. The staff members are always helpful and courteous. My apartment is well appointed, rather large for a 1BR, and has all the features I need. The apartment building and community ground are well maintained, daily.  Having free garage parking is a real luxury. The brand-new pool, fitness and community center also recently opened.   I highly recommend you come and see this community yourself. Once you see it, you will not want to leave.

Best in Class building and management.
We rented at this location for two years.
Heated garage and very nice community room and outdoor spaces.
Its spotless clean- well maintained and quite considering all the dogs who also enjoy this property.
The on-site manager Katie was very helpful in our first day to our last.
Its one of the best values on the West of Madison.
Close to the VA- shopping and world class work out Gym.

Moved to Wisconsin for work from another state and the Marling was my first choice. It was mostly the staff that made me want to live here, they are friendly, kind and helpful. Plus the building is beautiful with all the needed amenities and then some. Great location close to walking trail, restaurants, and access to the interstate. Highly recommend!

Hi! I arrived from other country for just 3 months of short stay and I rent a full furniture apartment. For me they are big professionals who helped me in all I needed, also the building include all you need like gym, free coffee, social loungue with a beautiful fireplace, and so on. Overall it´s high recommend.

The Marling is a new and shiny apartment complex with some great looking features.  The staff there is friendly and easy to work with.  However, please be aware of the hidden charges and slick wording of contracts.  The Marling requires you to pay half of you security deposit prior to signing the lease to "hold" the apartment with no chance of getting it back, even if you cannot sign the lease within a short time period.  In addition, the $150 parking fee to park in their attached garage is hard to swallow, given that they are not in a prime downtown location and are actually closer to the near east side.  Make sure to do your research first.

Not much space for dogs to enjoy the area. Building quality is not that good. Doors don’t close or open properly. You can hear upstairs neighbors walking around all the time. Parking is starting to become limited as the complex is almost full now. Otherwise apartment is ok don’t think it’s worth the price they are charging

I lived at Cross Hill Heights for one full year, and if it weren't for moving into my boyfriends house that he owns, I wouldn't have ever left! The amenities are amazing, high-end quality materials in the apartments which are so beautifully designed! The fitness center is large and overlooks the courtyard area, the pool is tons of fun and I love that they provide grills to use and have a cute little firepit area to entertain at. My roommates and I used the community room to hose a fun get together with our friends and it was easy to book and we were able to use all of the appliances/pool table, etc for a whole night. Management is friendly and easy going and Joe always addressed our concerns promptly and professionally! If I ever needed to find an apartment in the future, I'd be back here for sure!

I have lived in my current unit for almost 2 years and love it. The location is extremely convenient, the build is new and has new modern appliances, the unit is spacious, and the management staff have been helpful and accommodating. They have been much better than some of the other management companies I have worked with in the Madison area. My only complaint (and a minor one at that) would be that the gym is too small for the number of residents that the property serves.

My dad lives in the stacked flats and I visit from time to time. The amenities are nice pool, outdoor grills, gym, etc. However, management does not care.
