Great location. Amazing Staff. Lots of different unit types to chose from. Apartments are new, clean, and modern. Very pleased with our move in experience
I have never felt so uncomfortable in an apartment as I do here. The team is incredibly rude, unprofessional, and deceptive, and I will not be resigning.

The location of this property is really convenient, located right off of Park Street near restaurants, the post office and not far from the UW Arboretum! I can't wait for the grocery store to be installed on the first floor and to relax on the outdoor terrace as soon as the weather warms up!

Office staff are tentative and friendly, and truly care about trying to maintain the safety and atmosphere of the property. I'm happy I was able to secure a 2-bedroom unit before they're filled!

Although I was a little skeptical of touring a building still under construction, Trey did an incredible job of painting a picture of what it will look like finished - highlighting all of the major amenities they'll have that other apartment buildings won't, such as the bar and pool! There is literally no need to leave the country to visit a resort - just live here instead and get the same experience everyday!

The proximity to restaurants, shopping, and fun spots like Spare Time and Dave & Busters is so convenient. Nearby traffic is inaudible inside the apartment. You really can't beat the amenities; you have everything you need in one place!

Lived here 2 years too many, windows don’t have any seal so we spent hundreds in the winter to barely stay warm and could feel a breeze often, windows and toilets also got moldy despite being cleaned regularly. One of our maintenance requests never got fulfilled, also discovered we definitely had mice at some point. The appliances are new but everything else is falling apart, especially in the bathrooms. But at least the leasing office got a beautiful renovation :). Rarely interacted with management but they handled a railing replacement incredibly poorly and had severe mail issues because of it. I don’t blame the post office for not wanting to use a crumbling bridge with no railing to get to our mail boxes but management didn’t even tell us for multiple weeks we had to go to the post office to get our mail. The railing kept getting pushed back for reinstallation due to weather but then they installed it in the snow anyways? Just don’t even bother, there are much nicer places. Property and management need a lot of love.

Do not live here. They never put a vapor lock barrier down in the foundation so with 2 dehumidifiers constantly running the humidity never drops below 65 percent and mold constantly needs to be bleach treated. Stay away. Over priced crap. Doors are jacked. The bathtub sounds like it’s going to fall through the floor when you’re in it. All in all worst place I’ve ever lived.
Management lady is really rude and will try to evict you for the most stupid thing. Just for being a normal human being you could be evicted. Be aware and be happy somewhere else.

My wife and I lived here for two years, and she had lived here two years prior to that in a different apartment. We both really enjoyed our time here and would have stayed longer if we had not bought a house. The location was great for us and convenient to all the westside shopping and restaurants. Maintenance staff was fast and helpful and the office staff was always friendly and professional. We also enjoyed the fitness center and pool, especially during Covid when the office was very observant of the CDC guidelines, it made us feel more comfortable using these amenities. Pretty much all you could expect from an apartment complex.

For the location and price, it does not get much better. The kitchen is amazing (which is fantastic because I cook a lot) and the light fixtures are gorgeous. 

The location cannot be beat - Aldi, Woodmans, the mall, multiple pharmacies / convenience stores, easy access to the Beltline, and one of the largest (and nicest) gyms in Madison is just up the road. Plus having a movie theatre within walking distance is a nice perk.

The pool is nice and the other residents are kind. It's a broad variety of newly weds, families with young children, students, adults looking for a quiet neighborhood... there's lots of variety, which I appreciate. 

The reviews saying the walls are thin and loud highway noise initially concerned me (I work from home) but it really isn't a big deal. The street traffic noise is the same as any apartment in Madison (you live in a largish city, there will be street noise) and while I occasionally hear my neighbors vacuuming, it's always between 8 am and 8 pm. The walls are plenty thick enough that I never hear my neighbors talking / their TV.

Maintenance is super fast and very professional. The leasing office can be hard to work with - getting my emotional support animal on the lease was not easy. They know the loopholes and will do what they can to keep an emotional support animal out without actually breaking any laws. In the end, I did get my animal on the lease, but be ready to jump through hoops.

All in all, I love living here. I toured 10+ apartments before signing here and I'm confident I made the right choice.

Overall OK but nothing special. Your typical suburban apartment complex. 

The biggest thing for me was the HIGHWAY NOISE. The property is wedged in between Watts , High Point and the Beltline so traffic noise is significant. I made the mistake of renting a unit directly backed up the Beltline. Other units are likely not as noisy but be aware. 
***Property is somewhat dated although my unit had some fairly-recent kitchen and floor upgrades. Cheap hollow interior doors. Not the greatest furnace during the long winters. The hallway in my building sometimes reeked and I don't know old the carpet in there was. My unit had some minor damages on move-in.   
***Moderate noise from the other units --walls not soundproof or anything but not paper thin either.
***Fitness room but had to make reservation (a legacy from COVID maybe?); the bigger problem is the fitness room is in a separate building across Watts Road from some of the units which is especially inconvenient in the winter
***Clubhouse room but you couldn't bring in outside guests like your friends or family (also maybe a COVID thing)
***Swimming pool was nice to have
***Management wasn't super-friendly but professional which is all you can really ask for. Maintenance response times were pretty good.

Awesome laundry facilities, maintenence crew, and Management. I love my studio! The location is perfect for bus travel, UW Facilities, and nature walks. Right across from Lake Mendota at the Memorial Union :)!

My experience in this apartment has been nothing short of a nightmare. I was pitted in a battle against a severe bug infestation every day and night, leaving my once peaceful abode akin to a warzone, leading to countless sleepless nights filled with distress.

The management, with their promised 24-hour emergency service, has proven nothing but empty words. It's been almost two weeks, and the infestation remains untouched - an alarming testament to their subpar service.

Their nonchalant responses to my pleas, their startling indifference, and the fact that they failed to even correctly identify me as a resident, have only served to magnify my frustration. I was left feeling unheard and ignored in a place I used to call home.

Their assurances of prompt action within 24 hours were just empty promises. Their response didn't come until several days after, despite claiming they could intervene the first time they were aware of it when I noticed them I wanted to move out just because they think of it was not urgent! Despite their continued assertions, the infestation still flourished, contradicting their claims of resolution.

I finally decided to move out after enduring nights plagued by insects, with bugs infesting every corner of my space. Please note, the window screens are entirely ineffective! If you open your window (not just screens, since screens can't be opened), a swarm of insects will invade your room in the spring and summer. When I informed the team, they did nothing but blame me, accusing me of deliberately inviting these pests in and rendering the room uninhabitable. Their condescending attitude, coupled with their unwillingness to timely address the issue, is utterly repugnant.

The entire ordeal has been nothing short of emotionally draining and infuriating. The lack of tenant care from management has been shockingly disappointing and a total letdown.

Also, it's worth mentioning that on March 21st, management sent an email encouraging residents to leave positive reviews in exchange for a chance to win an Amazon gift card. They announced the winner on April 28th, so be cautious when evaluating any positive reviews during this period.

For those considering this place as a future home, I implore you to think twice. Their lack of accountability, empathy, and responsiveness is alarming and wholly unsatisfactory.

I really like it here. The efficiency is a nice size with a kitchen almost the same size as the rest of the room. There's a full size oven, but a smaller refrigerator. The other part of the room is big enough to put a queen bed in. Old fashioned radiators really work well when it gets cold. However, if you're on the lower floors, sometimes the Kollege Klub below can be obnoxiously loud. 
The noise makes up for being so close to everything though. I love being one street off of State Street!

When I moved in, there were multiple things damaged in the unit, including ripped carpet, water damage, chipped paint, etc. The tile and carpets were dirty, and a weird yellow gunk was on the bathroom vanity. The unit had been recently renovated, but they clearly chose the cheapest contractor they could find, as there are parts of the tiling with gaps and you can see a few inches underneath the floor. Also, don't plan on having guests, management will have them towed unless you apply for a guest parking pass at their office, which closes at 5. They'll tow your car even if the lot is empty and there is no snow.

We've been here at Sauk Creek Apt for about a year. The first 10 months were great. Apartment was obviously well taken care of previously, but as with all good things they dont last forever. Over the span of a month we needed a new furnace, central air unit, garbage disposal, and dishwasher maintenance and they knocked it out of the park. Everything was taken care of within a couple short weeks with the exception of the dishwasher which was causing issues. Maintenance techs: Jon and Matt were particularly awesome in keeping us up-to-date with repairs and the leasing team were understanding of our issues. I'll be buying a home in the near future, but if I wasnt, I would definitely still be here. Thanks team! 
Great location right off of the beltline with none of the noise. 5 mins from the mall and all of the eateries and as an added bonus connected to a quiet city play area and field great to take the kiddo to as well.

Great location, private neighborhood, well maintained landscaping and sidewalks. Hallways and garage are well maintained, and the spacious apartment we have is an excellent value per square foot. Not many on-site amenities, but that probably keeps rent costs down. I have my own gym membership and I don't need a pool, so this is great, no need to pay for extras you won't use. Have been very happy here in our two years.  Haven't had too many maintenance requests, but they were all handled very quickly.  Grounds are maintained well, common areas are repainted and cleaned frequently, our neighbors are quiet.  One of the best value apartments I have ever lived in.

We absolutely love the Sauk Creek Apartments.  The layout and spacious rooms are what sold us on selecting these apartments, along with how well the grounds are maintained in both summer and winter.  We are extremely happy with the management.  Both the manager and maintenance staff go above and beyond all our expectations.  The get the job done very efficiently and effectively with their great knowledge of everything in the unit.  Everyone is professional and really caring for the well being of their tenants.  We could not ask for a better, more comfortable place to live.  Many thanks for all the time and efforts the staff put into making this an excellent place to call home.

If you are looking for a place to rent, you've found it. I've lived here for ten years, and I love it. I needed a safe place to raise my kids. This complex is quiet, neat, clean, well-maintained, and always staffed with friendly, helpful people. My neighbors have been consistently awesome. The maintenance is always prompt, and any time I have ever needed anything, the staff has been extremely helpful. They even offered to help me lug heavy things after my surgery when I had lifting restrictions. I love the location. It's near all of the schools I wanted my kids to attend. Both kids started at Muir Elementary and are now at Memorial (my son is a senior, and my youngest is a sophomore). It's close to the mall, the library, one of the best coffee shops in town (TNT), Metcalfe's grocery store, the book store, and Walgreens. There is storage, the windows are large so that the apartment interiors are sunny and bright, there are security doors, and I love the underground garage (it makes a great tornado shelter -- just sayin'). If you have cats, there is a very good vet right across the street next to the coffee shop. There are several bus stops close by. When my kids were little, the park right next door was really great. We don't use it as much now that they are in high school, but if you have little ones, there's a playground, a basketball court, a new covered pavilion, a baseball backstop, and a soccer field, so it's great. There are paths across the street that run through pretty neighborhoods and around nearby ponds with lots of birds and flowering trees. It's just a really nice place. It's been a good and safe place to raise my kids. I highly recommend it.

I am staying in Sauk Creek Apts for 3 years now. The Apts are well maintained, always clean and nice. The management attends to any service within 24 hours. The location of the apt is perfect for me since it is near shops, restaurants and schools. One thing is the apartment doesnt have fitness center and pool.

We moved into Yorktown Estate Apartments in April of 2017 and thoroughly enjoy all the amenities and overall quality of our unit. Here is our top 10 list of what we believe is the best of Yorktown Estate Apartments... 1) Very helpful and knowledgeable staff; 2) Our unit was spotless and freshly painted when we moved in; 3) The grounds are clean and well-maintained; 4) The stainless steel kitchen appliances are in excellent condition and work well; 5) The underground parking is convenient and also accommodates our bicycles well; 6) The salt water pool is awesome and the annual pool party/pig roast was fun; 7) The "free" morning weekday breakfast buffet is tasty and they make it easy to drop-in on the way to work; 8) The units are close to multiple city bus lines which makes access to public transportation convenient; 9) The central building has a full business center, an exercise facility, a hot tub, a community room and a billiards table; and 10) And perhaps the best part is that we no longer have to mow grass, shovel snow, and do all the maintenance that we previously did when we owned a home.

I lived at Yorktown Estates for a year while going through a divorce and found it a pleasant place to live with a park-like setting. My two teenagers were with me half the time and they enjoyed the pool, as I did, in the summer and the hot tub during the winter, as well as the workout facilities. My dog also liked the grounds, where we walked daily.  When there was a problem with my apartment, which was rare, the staff responded quickly.  I made friends at the apartment complex at the complimentary breakfasts and still return there every other week or so to have coffee with my acquaintances. I only moved because I missed having a yard and a garden and wanted to be closer to my kids’ high school in Middleton. No complaints at all.

I lived in Yorktown Estates for almost five years, moving apartments about halfway through to get more space. I was very impressed with the maintenance staff. They did seasonal routine maintenance, and were quick to respond when there were problems. The leasing staff was also great when I moved in, when I changed apartments, and when I moved out. Previously Yorktown Estates management was a bit stingy with upgrades like stainless steel appliances and ceramic top stoves, but now they seem to be trying to improve all apartments when they turn over.

I never thought I'd live in an apartment complex again however, this isn't just and apartment complex it is home. The apartments are gorgeous and extremely livable. I walk in the door and I am at home! The staff is incredibly helpful and considerate of all living here! Everything is beautifuly maintained and the pool is crystal clear. A treat one would never expect is breakfast Monday through Friday!  Fellow residents have become my friends, very warm and friendly. They even have parties: wine tasting, pool party, packer tailgating, St. Patties day, not to mention the soup cook-off. Everything is so professionally done I can't believe I live here! Whoever is reading this will know who I am when you live here! I hope to see you!!!!

Yorktown Estates is a very comfortable community to live in. They provide  great amenities including a salt water pool, hot tub, seating areas with gas fireplaces and breakfast weekday mornings. It's located in a quiet neighborhood close to shopping.

The homes here are comfortable, quiet and worth the rent.

These apartments come with a staff and community that is very supportive.  As an added bonus, the staff will respond to needs within the day if possible.

The apartments are updated and the walls are thick, allowing for practically no noise from neighbors.  The carpeting is something to be admired as well.  It is very plush and easy to clean.  All of the units that we have lived in have some amount of sun getting in throughout the day.

If you get central air, it works well and quick.  In terms of additions, all add ons make that unit feel more luxerious.   I especially like the jacuzzi tub.

Parking spots underground are wide and convenient.  However, sometimes, there is a shortage.  You will get a spot in your building within the term of your lease if you want.

Porches sometimes need updating and faulty fire alarms in the buildings are tormenting at times.  The doors in the hallways slam loud and the corner units suffer because of this.

All and all, a pleasant place to live, however, sometimes you must move to find the right unit for you.

I have enjoyed living here for the last year, but I am moving out due to a YEAR long construction project (new school being built) literally next door. A lot of the trees were already cut down. Staff is pretty neutral- they will not go out of their way to be flexible, but they are cordial. Maintenance requests get taken care of quickly, and we had mostly minor issues. The pool and clubhouse are super nice. My 2 bedroom is huge and definitely worth the price. If you do not have an anxious pet and do not mind construction all day (they start at 7 am) for the next year, it is a good place to live. Lots of small dogs and older people; very few people in their 20s/30s.

It is like living in the country. Everything is a 2-5 minute drive. 
Allie, Ruth, Kelly, and Casey are very helpful and the buildings and grounds are clean. I am never moving!

The apartments are set in the woods, you would never know that you are in the city.  The apartments themselves are very spacious some with fireplaces.  The office staff and the maintenance are WONDERFUL any problems they are right on top of it. Beautiful swimming pool, firepit,fireplace and a gourmet kitchen Feels like a resort.  The staff also throws several parties a year.  They are also very giving to the community, toys for tots and second harvest food bank.

This apartment has it all, every amenity and so close to everything on Madison's west side. The clubhouse, pool, and workout room are great. The staff is friendly and helpful and recently a beautiful firepit/social area was added!  This is truly a place to call  home !!!!

I currently live in a 2 bed with a loft. The complex as a whole is very clean and filled with nice people. The apartment I am in is both spacious and kept in a like-new state. I like the While the rent is higher than average for a 2 bedroom, I think it is worth the price. Additionally, there are many amenities in the club house, such as a pool, gym, billiards room, and party room, that is included in the price. Lastly, I feel that the complex is well located. While it is not directly around anything in particular, allowing for a peaceful immediate area, it is also within a short drive to commercial locations, such as restaurants and shopping locations!

This community is so wonderful, I don't even know where to begin. The apartments are beautiful: spacious with interesting floor plans, screened in porches, and beautiful views. The staff made my husband and I feel like we were family. Every maintenance issue was addressed without delay. The exercise facilities and the pool are awesome amenities that we used all the time. The clubhouse is beautiful, too; we had our wedding reception there as well as a baby shower. The neighbors are friendly and comprise a variety of age groups. We will miss Province Hill and the wonderful people there.
Thank you Jason E for doing a great job replacing our shower fan

Thank you to Brandon & T.J for their help with my first experience with mold on our window due to the weather change & it not being closed properly. I appreciate the quick assistance!! Thank you to Hanna as well for the timely response :)
Just had the annual dryer vent cleaning. The maintenance guys were polite, friendly, and did great work.

I have lived with HPC for almost one year and three months now and I love it here! Everyone at the leasing office are warm and friendly, and eager to help you! The maintenance staff also do a great job at taking care of your requests and addressing them promptly.

Cleaned the dryer vent & Helped with changing out light bulbs too! 
Super courteous. 

Name: Brandon L

I am looking to move to the area and the High Point Commons staff was very 
 helpful! Hanna answered all of my questions and was very friendly. Seems to be a large focus on community and lots of green space.

I have lived in Watermark for over two years in one of the lofts, I genuinely do like living here, but there are some things you should know. 

Pros:

The community here is absolutely great. You will easily make friends in the common spaces. 

There is a secret dog clique here. All the dog owners know each other and are good friends. 

The public spaces are kept incredibly clean. Huge plus during Covid. 

You are right next to the B Cycle station at the Sheraton, a bus station, and the beltline. 

If you have a lake view, then the views are absolutely incredible.

Plenty of community gardens to grow plants if you’re into that. 

Very responsive maintenance staff. 

My unit has quite possibly the largest utility closet I have ever seen in an apartment. This is incredible. 

You have access to fiber internet through AT&T. I generally get 200-400 both up and down over WiFi here with AT&T fiber. Spectrum 960 Mbps tier generally gave me 250 down and 15-30 up.

If you live in a loft, then every guest you have over is generally impressed by the place. It’s a cool living space! 

Cons: 

Moving in/out takes forever. 

There is only one extremely slow elevator. Expect to add 5-10 minutes to your commute time. The elevator broke three times since I’ve lived here.

Parking is expensive. Cheaper alternatives are inconvenient. 

If you live in a loft, then expect a $200+ electric bill in the summer. There are no blinds at all on the second floor, and the sun will cause your apartment temps to reach 78°F or higher. During the winter, the sun heats your apartment and the furnace almost never turns on. My lowest utility bill was in March of 2020 at $63. It’s important to note that sometimes you have to turn on the A/C in the winter because the sun can make your unit that hot. 

The proximity to the lake is misleading. There is no useable beach other than a small slope of rubble that you have to cross the train tracks to get to. There’s green algae there in the summer, and the scooper boats rarely clean the area. 

The train tracks are right next to the building. The trains are really annoying. They’re pretty infrequent, so this is not a huge issue. 

The proximity to the lake makes the roof a massive breeding ground for mosquitoes. You absolutely have to wear bug spray up there in the summer. 

The bathrooms are oversized and waste a lot of square footage that could be used for the bedroom, closet, etc.

The building has had consistent hot water issues.

I have lived in the Silverstone apartments for about nine years. When I moved here they were amazing about taking care of problems and maintenance issues promptly. The management was extremely friendly. That has completely changed. The last couple years everything has completely gone downhill. They are slow to take care of maintenance issues. The management is extremely rude and condescending. They treat us like garbage. I would have highly recommended it here several years ago, but I do not feel that is the case now.

Apartment building and garage are clean and well maintained. The environment is super chill. The walls are thick. Overall great apartment, but I've had frustrating experiences with maintenance. Had to go 2 weeks in the summer without A/C. Also, there were squirrels in the ceiling and walls that were annoying for several months.

I've lived at Silverstone for 9+ years. I love my apartment and the location! Close to all the things I need, still able to access downtown when I want. Quiet neighborhood. Any maintenance items I've had have been handled quickly and efficiently.
The Silverstone Apartments are very well maintained. The units look beautiful and so do the common areas and exteriors! Management is friendly and responsive. I am so happy we found this place!
Very quick to make repairs to any issues we have had. Landscaping is done in proper maintenance n upkeep. Very safe n comfortable community.

Silverstone is a great place to live, which is I have resided here over 15 years. These are somewhat expensive apartments, but you definitely get what you pay for. The buildings and grounds are well maintained, and most winters the snow plowing and sidewalk-clearing has been fast.  Some of the reasons I moved out west here from the east side, were the convenient location closer to my work,  because even the studios have in-unit laundry, the option of underground parking available for an extra charge, and free off-street parking. In my experience, the property manager and maintenance crew are helpful and pleasant to work with, and the neighborhood is safe.

Maintenance requests were always completed promptly, the interior hallways and parking lots/garage were well kept year-round (especially during winter), and the studio I had was spacious and quiet. Linda (front desk) was awesome and personally cared for each resident that came through to the resident's center.

If you don’t mind hearing your upstairs neighbor’s footsteps, this is the place for you. If you do mind, look elsewhere or make sure your on the 3rd floor. The floorboards are to a point that they creak with the lightest of footsteps, and without the fault of your neighbor, it’s just super annoying. It’s enough to wake you up so you feel bad for moving around at odd hours. I may be picky, but for the rent price, I expected it to be structurally more sound to keep noises under control. If I saw a review like this for this apartment, I for sure would have looked elsewhere.

I lived in Nantucket Apartments for 9 years, in all 4 buildings! Overall, a great living experience. Good quality, spacious, and quite apartments. In unit washer and dryer, lots of kitchen storage, delightful patio areas some facing the pretty green pond area, and some units with a warm and cozy fireplace that my cat loved. Underground parking, secure storage unit are huge advantages. Clean buildings and facilities. Fantastic amenities with fun clubhouse available for rental, delightful pool area and gym. Linda in the office was always very helpful and fast to respond when assistance was needed. Maintenance was quick to fix any issues. Noteworthy far westside location in a peaceful area with grassy pond area nearby. Close to Ice age trail for beautiful walking paths. I recommend Nantucket for the variety of floor plans, charming, safe atmosphere. Overall wonderful experience living here where it felt like home.

My sister and her husband lived here before I moved my wife and I in, so my family has years of experience living in Nantucket Apartments. I work in real estate and I have to say that this place is the most well-run property, in my experience. The maintenance team is responsive and considerate. The managers are kind, diligent, and fair. The amenities are on point.

Absolutely loved living at Nantucket. The front desk staff is fantastic (especially Linda) and the apartment floor plans are super functional. I also enjoyed the super clean grills, pool, and underground parking. I would highly recommend living here! We moved out because we bought a house, but would’ve loved to stay at Nantucket forever.

I lived here for 6 months after moving from Florida and it was honestly the best experience! From the beginning, Linda was very helpful and kind. She is truly one of the greatest assets to Nantucket. The process of securing the apartment was very easy and the actual apartment/amenities are incredible. The property is very well maintained and maintenance requests are handled in an efficient manner. I would recommend anyone to live here if they can!

Property manager Mellissa was great to work with, made things super convenient and as stress free as possible. Great communication. The property was always kept clean, apartment was in turn-key condition. No complaints at all.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Mellissa during my apartment leasing process, and I can't speak highly enough of the experience. She made everything incredibly smooth and efficient, allowing me to apply and move in within just a week. The apartment itself has brand new everything inside with top-notch appliances and finishes. The location is fantastic and truly add to the overall experience of living here. Mellissa's professionalism, attention to detail, and prompt communication made all the difference. I highly recommend working with her for anyone looking for a seamless leasing process.

I have lived at Royal Arms (previously Karen Arms) apartments for nearly 5 years now. The previous management was absolutely amazing and I loved living here! However, since Orosz Properties took over management of the apartment living here has been terrible! Nearly every week the water to our apartment is shut off without prior notice. Recently, they have been doing renovations to the common areas of the apartments and entered my apartment without any prior notice. I have called the front office multiple times and their answer is always the same: "I don't know how this could have happened." If you value your rights as a tenant in Wisconsin, look elsewhere for a place to live.

Truly enjoyed my time at Karen Arms apartments up until the new management took over. I lived there for 4 years and never had any issues, loved the apartment, location, and neighbors. Unfortunately when the new management took over and rebranded to Royal Arms, things took a turn for the worse. We started having issues with hot water and occasionally had water turned off without any notice. Previously when an emergency caused water to be shut off we'd get instant notice either in person or over the phone. Once the new management took over, I had to call the office about coming home to no water and the response I got was "oh yea it will be back on within the hour". It's unacceptable to not notify tenants that the water was to be shut off even in an emergency. This happened many times, and only one of those times was due to the road construction. Even though they did get slightly better at notifying us about water shut offs, there were still times when it was shut off without a word from management. We also started having trouble with water pressure and water temp, leading to our showers occasionally going super cold, super hot, or reducing water flow so much that it wasn't enough to even rinse off the soap we just lathered on. Not to mention the multiple times the hot water was just non-existent. With new management also came constant construction, often even on weekends early in the morning. The construction happening in apartments in our hall often meant the hall was filled with dust which is unsafe to breathe and often nails were left scattered on the floor in common hall space. The few times they would give warning about an upgrade that would be happening to or around our apartment, they didn't even show up when they said they would.  The new management was extremely flakey, and often hard to get ahold of.  Our deposit got lost in the mail and though we were told they'd follow up promptly via email after they spoke with accounting, we didn't get any response to follow up emails and had to go in person twice to finally get our deposit back. Be weary of the flakey management and greedy owner.

The remodelled unit in these pictures is not representative of most of the units, which don’t have dishwashers! The buildings needs maintenance on gutters, doors & frames, windows, electrical wiring, etc which IMO should take priority over the cosmetic improvements like new countertops.  Management seems understaffed for the number of residents & underequipped for even routine maintenance requests, and on top of all that my 2 bedroom unit had a 20% rent increase in this year (some of my neighbors saw a 40% increase), with additional fees added on for things like parking and heat that had previously been included. Not worth your money .

I've lived at Royal Arms (previously Karen Arms) for several years, and it's been downhill since Orosz Properties took over. These buildings were built in the 1960s and are not in great shape. Orosz is making a bunch of aesthetic changes to make it look nice on the outside, but they neglect serious maintenance concerns. Not only that, but the price of rent shot up so much it literally made the news (look up “West-side Madison tenants fight back” on Isthmus, for example).

The buildings are poorly insulated, have corroded pipes (leading to frequent clogging and occasional brown water), and have sunken sections of floor. Several balcony railings are rusted through. The heat in several buildings is malfunctioning so that it is either always weak or is completely on/off when people adjust the thermostat. The lights in several hallways have gone out, making it hard to see, especially for the older tenants, but Orosz hasn't cared to replace the bulbs even though it's been weeks or months.

The previous landlord had decent management and great maintenance. Nowadays, management and maintenance are extremely poor. The front office staff is not very responsive or helpful, and management has shown up to people's units without giving the legally required 12-hour notice. My maintenance requests take several weeks to complete, they are marked as complete on the online portal before they actually are (meaning I had to submit additional requests for the same things), and when maintenance finally comes they do a poor job and show up at their leisure with no notice. A few times, maintenance had to come and go several times to try and fix some issues, but even after they were "done" the issues weren't fixed. They even left my door open one time, which was a risk to my cats. They also shut the water off in my building with no notice to tenants.

In the new leases being offered by Orosz, they pass the costs of light bulbs, batteries, and laundry machine repairs off to tenants. Speaking of laundry, Orosz raised the price from $1.75 per load to $4 per load. To my knowledge, this is the most expensive laundry in Madison.

Orosz seems single-mindedly focused on making money and they do not care about the well-being of tenants. I would seriously NOT recommend moving here. You can find other places in the area and in Madison with similar amenities for cheaper, or places with much better amenities for a similar price.

Ovation 309 has been open for a few months now and I can't imagine a better place to live. Our apartment has floor-to-ceiling windows with high-end trimmings and appliances. It is incredibly quiet and we never hear our neighbors or noise from the street. The parking is private, heated, underground, and secured. All doors are secured by electronic keyfob as are the elevators, and there is a 24 hour doorman. The doorman will help us open doors if our hands are full, put our packages in our apartment for us during the day, and are just all around awesome. 

The building amenities are crazy, starting with the 13th floor terrace which must have the best views of the city and goes 270 degrees around the top of the building. It includes outdoor gas fireplaces and plenty of comfy furniture. The inside of the 13th floor is also community space, and has multiple gas fireplaces, flat screen TV, full bar with ice, refrigerators, a catering kitchen, tons of furniture, free WiFi, and a shuffleboard, along with wine lockers you can rent out. On the 7th floor is another veranda with outdoor fireplaces and gas grills. There is a club room on the 7th floor with free WiFi, flat screen, a full kitchen, and a coffee machine that makes free coffee, espresso, cappuccino, and more. Also on the 7th floor is an outdoor dog walking area when your pets can relieve themselves without you having the physically leave the building. On the second floor is a full gym with free weights, machines, stationary bikes, ellipticals, mats, and men's and women's locker rooms which each include a full pine wood lined sauna. The building will arrange for a fitness instructor or massage. Also on the second floor is a built-in yoga studio with daily yoga. On the ground floor the sidewalks outside are heated. There is the incredible Johnson Street lobby (there is also a back lobby on Dayton street). There is a Mr. Brew's taphouse built in to the first floor with a back door that leads into the building. A new high-end restaurant will open soon, also on the first floor and connected to the building. The doorman will also assist in making reservations at any restaurant or event in the city. Cap Foods is a 24 hour grocery store across the street.

I can't recommend this place enough.

Just moved in a week ago. So far I'm in love with the place! Beautiful, modern units, floor to ceiling windows, gym included and underground parking and great common spaces. The front desk is very helpful as well and worked hard to make sure everything in the apartment was working well. It is located in Downtown Madison so it is within easy walking distance of tons of great restaurants and bars.

The staff are great 
          Leasing agents 
          24 hour front desk 
          Service desk
          Yoga Studio
          Spa
          Personal Trainer

The amenities are great
          7th and 13 rooftop decks with grills, fireplaces and indoor
          Sauna in changing rooms - although no bench in changing room
          Gym has free weights, cardio and bench and squat racks
          Better than any other apartment gym I've seen in the area
          Underground parking is not cheap, but it's good
          
The location is great you can walk to everything downtown, there's a great bar with food at the foot of the building and a close walk to tons of other options.

Fiduciary Real Estate Development owns the Domain apartment building in Madison, WI. My experience living in their building since August ‘21 has been terrible. I would never recommend this apartment to anybody for housing. Property management is slow to act and un-eager to provide excellent service. It took 9 months to have kitchen cabinetry replaced that was water damaged before I moved in. It took 2 months for them to fix my HVAC in the middle of the summer. They kept trying to just replace the wall unit over and over which didn't work, and never sent out a professional HVAC technician. The garage door was broken and removed from the building making it completely insecure from unauthorized individuals gaining access to the inside of the apartment. This went unfixed for 4 months. Theft and vandalism to property inside the building occurred during this time. My girlfriend had her motor vehicle which was parked inside the parking garage vandalized. The building was graffitied and upon removing the paint the buildings windows were made extremely dirty, and the property management has said they will not clean the multiple story high windows, which residents are unable to clean themselves. They have an annual end of summer pool party that property management supplies alcohol to underage individuals at. No service by a liquor licensed business and no checking of ID's, nobody ensuring people are not over-served. I have witnessed this going on at the summer party, as a resident, two years in a row. The parking garage smells like a trash dump, it is covered in liquid streaming from the dumpsters all over the floor of the parking garage making it smell horrible. The building's management is a nightmare and I would never recommend it to anybody as a place to live. I can’t speak to the quality of other Fiduciary properties but Domain is poorly managed.

I would never recommend this apartment to anybody for housing. Property management is slow to act and un-eager to provide excellent service. It took 9 months to have kitchen cabinetry replaced that was water damaged before I moved in. It took 2 months for them to fix my HVAC in the middle of the summer. They kept trying to just replace the wall unit over and over which didn’t work, and never sent out a professional HVAC technician. The garage door was broken and removed from the building making it completely insecure from unauthorized individuals gaining access to the inside of the apartment. This problem persisted for 4 monthes. Theft and vandalism to property inside the building occurred during this time, including my girlfriends motor vehicle being vandalized while parked inside the parking garage. The building was graffitied and upon removing the paint the buildings windows were made extremely dirty, and the property management has not given a definitive answer as to whether they will clean the multiple story high windows, which residents are unable to clean themselves. They have an annual end of summer pool party that property management supplies alcohol to underage individuals at. No service by a liquor licensed business and no checking of ID’s, nobody ensuring people are not over-served. I have witnessed this going on at the summer party, as a resident, two years in a row. The parking garage smells like a trash dump, it is covered in liquid coming from the dumpsters making it smell horrible. This building’s management is a nightmare and I would never recommend it to anybody as a place to live.

At times it seems like if you want to live near State St. and the bus lines you're stuck living in a dorm, or if you want nicer amenities and other adults then you're in for a trudge. The Domain mostly manages to balance location and the quality of life. The prices are towards the higher end, but for that you're getting a short walk to everything important and aren't surrounded by drunken parties every gameday (at least not in the building). Solid gym, great clubhouse, no real issues with the neighbors - really the only complaint I've had is the mailboxes are in an inconvenient wing of the complex.

Domain's location is perfect if you want to be steps from State Street, but escape the noisy environment. A good mix of graduate students and young professionals provides a clean and quiet living situation. The amenities are brand new, with laundry in unit. The management is always available and willing to help with any questions. Domain makes my living situation so convenient. I never have to worry about having any problems. It's a quiet, clean, modern escape that is still seconds away from all of the fun that Madison has to offer.

Domain is an incredible place to live. The apartments themselves are huge, beautiful, and very reasonably priced. The amenities are phenomenal. It is so nice to have a gym right downstairs, and on Wednesday mornings, they offer yoga classes. Dogs are very welcome, and they even have a jar or dog treats outside the elevator! Beyond the building itself, the management is the absolute best I have ever dealt with (after 7 years and 7 different apartments in Madison). They go above and beyond to assist and accommodate. They even plan social events to meet and hang out with your neighbors--which is really unique to Domain. I will live here until I move out of Madison!

As a very busy grad student, I love coming home to the Domain.  The building is extremely clean, secure, and feels like home.  The staff were very helpful in setting up my dream apartment. I don't plan on leaving any time soon!  

My favorite features about the building are the fitness studio and the 11th floor lounge.  I enjoy working in the lounge during the day and having a glass of wine there by night.  I also love the bike garage, which has its own "bike garage door" that I can access with my clicker.  No need to jump off my bike to ride in and out of the garage.  I could go on about how great the building is, but you'll just have to come see for yourself!

If you’ve had or have to use funding for any type of financial hardship, they won’t renew your lease. Nothing is included as far as utilities. You’ll have a bill from Alliant, MG&E, trash, water, AND internet on top of the rent cost. 

If you need maintenance, they cake a bunch of caulk on it and call it a day.

I have been living at The Madison Apartments since 2015. 
The management is welcoming, friendly and they are very helpful. 
Maintenance staff communicates well and they accommodate my work orders in a timely manner. 
I love the location. We are up on a hill with only residential areas surrounding us.
It is a dog friendly neighborhood, lots of walking areas and they just built a new dog park!!
 I love living at The Madison Apartments and I plan to stay for long time coming.

I have now been living at the Madison for a little over 6 months and I have to say this is my favorite apartment I've ever lived in.  I live in a quad plex and it is absolutely wonderful walking into a foyer area and being able to enter my apartment without having to walk down long hallways like I'm in a hotel.  The office and maintenance staff are all wonderful and very helpful when anything has been needed and the pool and other amenities that are offered here are wonderful.  Would highly suggest turning in an application and joining us here at The Madison if you want to love where you live.

I wish I could give them a NEGATIVE rating. Initially, apartments started off under a different management who was very prompt in taking care of the tenants issues. One day, the Heater in my apartment was not working and I called the leasing office, I was told that I didn't know how to operate it and they refused to send any one to take care of the issue. They also switched off the lights in the corridor of our Apartment building and we had to call them multiple times to get them back on. The new staff is extremely shrewd and rude. Most of the people that I know of have already been vacating these apartments after the new management took over.  We do not have any short term leases and we are stuck for 12 months. So BEWARE before you sign the lease as they tell you that you can pay a lease breakage fee of $250 if you want to get out of the lease but you would still be held responsible for the rent till they find someone to lease it out. As they have many vacant units, they would not even care to show your unit to others as they are still making money on it from you and you would end up paying thousands of dollars in spite of paying the lease breakage fee. AVOID Madison Apartments at any cost!!!

I have lived in these apartments for 2 years only because I hate to move. Even so I regretted signing my lease for the second year almost immediately. The first two managers were wonderful, however there has been significant turn over in the time that I have lived here (6 managers in 22 months) and changes have been made that have cost me thousands. I am unsure what I did to upset the one office staff that has been consistent, but I have received letters that now border on harassment. The topics have varied, but for some reason I seem to carry the blame in her eyes for anything that is not as she likes in the entire complex. I cannot comprehend why things that take place in other buildings are attributed to me. When I have gone to the office to see what I could do differently I was told it was not just me. The letters stopped then, but then I started receiving phone calls. I prefer the direct method, however I can no longer be convinced the blame is not being placed on me. (I have been 5 days late on rent once in the years that I have lived here and that was related to the tacked on fees with change in management. All other payments have been early. I am still in contact with the staff in the last apartments I lived in, even after moving out of state because I developed strong friendships with several of the staff. I am adding this information to show that I am truly not a difficult tenant. ) 
I am from a large boisterous family and it is difficult to get me to a place where I am frustrated with noise levels. Either the sound proofing is truly terrible or I have the loudest neighbors of all time. 
Please keep looking- there are much better alternatives in this price range.

We moved here from a house in the Chicago area and were nervous about apartment living. Thanks to The Madison and their amazing staff, it was a wonderful transition. The apartments themselves are cheerful, sunny and have great storage space. The grounds are beautiful with plenty of green space and the pool is really great. The location is super close to Starbucks, Target, Costco...amazing. And the staff, especially the property manager, Christine, is the best. She has gone above and beyond to make us comfortable. The few minor issues that have come up she resolved quickly and made me feel like she actually cares! We are really happy here.

Apartment is ok, but somewhat dated. We have one of the upgraded ones, so it is better. However, we have not been able to use our balcony since we moved in. First, it was the wasps who have made a nest in the bottom of our air conditioner vent. Then, we were besieged by an infestation of boxelder bugs...thousands of them. When we consulted with the management, we were told there was nothing they could do about the wasps and that "everybody" had the boxelder bugs (not true...we asked some of our neighbors). In addition, our car has been broken into and the halls are rarely cleaned. Be aware that you will also be charged for water and sewer, as we discovered after not reading the "fine print" on our lease. They will not inform you of this and it will not be indicated on your list of monthly expenditures that you receive upon moving in. We have yet to hear of an apartment complex that charges for water and sewer. On the plus side, everyone is friendly and the location, next to the hiking trails, is great. The maintenance men are really nice, as well, and try to be helpful.

We moved here a year ago from a house (duplex) and this is our first apartment setting for a long time. We love the pet friendly atmosphere and meeting the friendly neighbors who walk their dogs (we have cats). The building is clean and well maintained. Maintenance staff is hard to reach in a timely manner, but they do respond. We have had a couple of minor problems in the apartment that remain unrepaired ( a light that wont work in the kitchen and a very noisy washing machine they said was 'fine') but the furnace/air filters are replaced regularly with ample warning. A nice place to live.

I lived at The Vue for 2 years and I saw a massive decline in quality during that time. They let go of most of the maintenance staff and traded out the office staff, so it has been getting worse. Two years ago, I would have recommended this place to everyone; now, I would recommend avoiding it. I have listed my pros and cons:
Pros:
- Parking garage is nice and felt safe..
- They only increased my rent by $100 after the first year which I felt wasn't bad given the prices in the area.
- They have been quick to respond to my maintenance requests.
- They have a low barrier to ending your lease early.
- There's a decent amount of storage in the apartment.
Cons:
- Cockroaches. I dealt with a significant cockroach infestation for months; I have been told the infestation was active as of August 2024.
- Very dirty communal spaces. Spoiled food waste and dirty diapers in entryways and stairwells. Most of the time you can't even enter the trash room because there is trash piled up and spilling everywhere. The hallway and entrance carpets are stained, smelly and disgusting.
- Snow removal and grass cutting is limited. The first year I lived in The Vue, the maintenance staff did an excellent job, but since they let go of staff the sidewalks are always icy in the winter and the grass is high and full of ticks in the spring.
- My A/C and heating broke twice a year at least. All they did was switch out blower motors repeatedly.
- Very heavy email communication. Sometimes multiple emails per day from management with all caps with bold, highlighting, and underlining. It's aggressive, they repeat the same rules by email over and over with no tangible changes, and they have obvious disdain for their tenants.
- Low professionalism. When I moved out, they wrote my forwarding address on a random piece of scrap paper and then never updated it in the system. 2 months after moving out, I still hadn't received my reimbursement check.
- Disrespectful entry into tenants' homes. In my final month living there, I woke up in my bed to see a male maintenance staff member standing in my kitchen saying he was "checking for a leak." No communication from management before or after this event to legitimize it. Another time, I made a confirmed appointment for regular maintenance and the staff disregarded my appointment and entered my apartment whenever they wanted while I wasn't there. Don't expect respect for your time or privacy.

Would not recommend!

I have been living at the Vue for a while now and I couldn’t ask for a better place to call home. 

The community is beautiful and the residents are amazing.  

The property management staff is super helpful.  One of the employees, Artan, made my move to the Madison that much easier and stress free with his services.  He was able to recommend places to eat, places to see, and things to do. 

I could not ask for a better place to call home.  

Thank you “Vue” for going above and beyond keeping your residents well taken care of and keeping the property beautiful.

I've lived here 2  years and it's gone from a great place to live to absolutely terrible. I'm not sure if management has changed but they have become so rude with their interactions - whether it be via email, phone or in person. They won't hold any packages at their office anymore (cant do hellofresh), they constantly have apartment inspections (difficult for pet owners who have to cage their pets then while at work) and they won't let you store anything more than a single bike in your garage space (what if a family has more than one bike??). There have been a string of break-ins, plus newer tenants are loud and disrespectful. The hallways are filthy and people trash the pool (at 1am might I add) and leave the workout facility dirty. Also, there is never enough parking. My suggestion is to look elsewhere! You can find something A LOT better for less.

Been here for 3 years in 2 different buildings. Staff turns over in the office incredibly fast leading to difficulties and pointing to poor management. Amenities are nice, but rarely all working or open (ex. grills all frequently broken and never fixed, clubroom always locked even when not reserved, treadmills broken contently...). Now when attempting to switch apartments we almost lost a lease because the office refused to send rental history despite us paying on time and in full every month for our whole time there! Lots of empty apartments and lots of bad dog owners, no one cleans up and no one holds the leash.

This probably won't make it on the site but it is an honest opinion from someone that lived there for 2 years.  The place is poorly managed and run the elevator breaks down alot and the door system too. There was 2 floods in 2971 in the first year I was there.  And when you move out they don't go thru the apt with you cause they want to make up stuff so you can't get your security deposit back or a minimal amount of it .  That is what exactly happened to mine.  The ammenities are nice except the clubhouse cause it is locked up I don't know why they put it in there if you can't use it all the time. IN the 2 years I was there  it was never open.  There are a lot of apts around town this is not one to rent . The rent is also outrageous is not worth it .
Everything is decent and new and efficient, but gas and electric rack up since it's central air during the summer and electric stove.

Wife and I had a wonderful time at Timber Valley!  Quiet area with great amenities.  High quality apartment for the price, and thick walls where we couldn’t hear others around us.  Management is great, and is really responsive.  Would recommend anyone to Timber Valley
Timber valley provides a great up north environment. The pool, fitness centers, movie theater, and sauna are great additions to an already impressive apartment complex!

This place seriously has everything!  We love the game room and work out rooms.  A brand new pool was put in this summer and a dog park is going in across the street this fall.  I can't say enough good things about this Apartment complex!

My husband and I love our 1 bedroom apartment at Timber Valley. The apartment has a great layout, with tons of kitchen space and storage (which was essential for me), large patio, central AC/heat, walk in bedroom closet, in-unit washer/dryer. Other perks of our apartment are a double bathroom vanity and pantry. 

We choose Timber Valley also because of the awesome amenities, including a really nice pool area, game room, theater, 2 work out rooms, sauna, main area you can hang out in and rent out as well, and it being pet-friendly. It's also really close to shops on the West side of Madison like Target, Pick & Save, and the mall, but far enough away that it's quiet. 

Highly recommend Timber Valley!!

We love our apartment. It’s super spacious, tons of sunlight, cabinet space, etc. High ceilings, too! The amenities is what makes this all totally worth it as well. Pool, two gyms, tanning bed, sauna, dog park, coffee bar, game room, community room, etc. The four grills in the pool area have been great for dinner as well :)

Awesome place to live. Dog-friendly, and very receptive of concerns and ideas that residents have. The staff is super friendly and helpful when asking questions. Our apartment is very spacious, loads of cabinet space, in-unit washer/dryer, and a large balcony.

Amenities:
- Pool
- Great Room
- Outdoor bar area, with grills
- Game Room 
- Huge Movie Theater (available to all residence)
- two work out areas, plenty of machines to go around

Location:
- 5-minute drive to Target, Old Navy, and other stores on Junction road. 
- 5-minute drive to the Beltline
- The neighborhood is very quiet, with friendly neighbors
- If you work at Epic - Very close with no traffic at all. If not, a great location for anyone working on the west side of Madison/Middleton

The amenities at One glenn are excellent! The office and maintenance team are responsive, kind, and so helpful. I love the neighborhood as well, so many great walking paths and intersecting bike routes.
This location is perfect. The apartment is great and has everything I was looking for. The management and maintenance team at one Glenn are amazing!!

For what you pay in rent they should have used concrete for their base instead they used wood so you can hear your neighbors above you. Also we’re just bought out by Banner property management no monthly my fees have changed even though I paid my year in advance. Ruins it for the next landlord because I will never pay ahead again
I experienced a lot of noise from dogs barking. Management won’t do anything about it. If “quiet enjoyment” isn’t a priority for you, this place is great!
They answered the phone and offered to have me join in their activities so I could see how nice it is. No one else was this nice. I would give more than 5 stars!

Laura answered the phone. Most places I called did not. She took the time and did not rush me. She answered all my questions, and offered me to come to the events to meet the people living there and staff. I was impressed and will attend. Thank you Laura!
Very nice staff, friendly on the phone. She answered all my questions.

I needed a safe place to live while pursuing two hip replacements. This is it: elevators, handrails, extra wide doors, spacious walk-in shower with grab bars, laundry in unit.
Modern with high quality appliances. But design details to please older folks: traditional windows that open and have screens, wide windowsills for houseplants.
They accept pets. I’m glad to have my cat. Cute dogs live here.
People are nice.

This is a beautiful place. I moved here in 2020, during the pandemic and it was the best decision I made.  The Management Team top notch. Affordable, good neighbors, and everything close by walk, bike, bus, or auto. Pet friendly.

Excellent location and service.  I brought my mom over to visit a friend and she felt so welcome and loved her whole experience visiting The Highline.  If she didn't live in Jefferson where she has been so many years, she said she would move here!

On October 22nd, RPM took over the property. They were around for about a week then I haven't seen them since. They've barely responded to emails. Something in the lease they don't like? It's not there, just like them! 

If management can't even pay someone to be around, why would you pay them to be here?

This place is gorgeous! From the beautiful views outside to the incredible amenities inside and out, along with interiors that feel like luxury living! I have no complaints about the maintenance staff and haven't heard any complaints from anyone! The saying  "wherever you go there you are" is true, you will get the experience of living at The Aviary at Middleton Market what you expect it will be.

Management here acts like they own you in they lock you up.  You become a captive of their ridiculous rants and rules.  The property way under delivers promises and staff is rude.  This was a big mistake.

They will tell you all sorts of things to get you to sign, but then they don't have any answers to why things are not being done or when we can use amenities etc.  Like the game room, which you cannot use in the evening because it is over another apartment and too loud.  Really?  The security is lacking to say the least, especially with the strangers constantly coming and going because they have hotel rooms on two floors, not permanent residents.   The police are here way too often too.  Coincidence?  There is no storage, but they will offer you space in an unfinished room, no cages or security and charge you extra.  The rent is too high for the cheap building materials such as windows, which leak and the plastic locks break.  Can't use your patio because the air conditioner sits right smack-dab on the deck.  If you do go outside don't go near any of the many stagnant water retention pods all over the property.  They have no water-movers so they have become mosquito infested.  I could go on, but honestly I just can't wait to get out.  With all the new places going up this place just doesn't measure up.

The apartments are beautiful and and new but they’re pretty small, barely any room for 2 people, never got notice of new management so we have no idea what their names are. The hotel part is a bit annoying, we had people smoking weed down the hall from us and people smoking cigarettes outside their door below us. Rent will be increasing significantly so we will not be renewing. We moved in right when the building opened and there was a lot of construction dust in one of the bed rooms, paint drips on the floors and bathroom drawers, just not what you would expect from this price point.

Poor staff, horrible construction. Susan the manager also runs the hotel, yes hotel, on the first two floors of the first building. She has no sense of how to run apartments, discusses residents with other residents, will enter you unit with no prior notice. You are paying market rate pricing for low income quality.

Lived here for a little over a year, rented here for 2 years. Built very poorly. In the year I was here my next door neighbor had a fruit fly infestation and they were coming in through our vents, hundreds of them in our unit for months. A few weeks after Christmas our top floor apartment ceiling vent started pouring water from the vent from a leak on the roof. In the winter the apartment was very cold and drafty, in the summer our AC went out and they didn’t have the supplies to fix it so we were without AC for days in August. The office isn’t there on weekends and people would take advantage of that and have extremely loud parties at the pool early in the morning. Due to changes in life we had to move shortly after renewing our lease, but TPC won’t let you break a lease, so we’ve been paying over 2k a month plus incredibly high utilities for an apartment we don’t live in, and upon reaching out to ask why our utilities for an empty apartment were so high, Magen- the current office girl was incredibly unprofessional,rude, and hard to work with, didn’t respond to my emails for months, and when she did gave us a snarky short reply that it was in the contract that we would have to pay utilities, but offering no reason for why they’re so high when no one is using them. Don’t let the “luxury apartment” front fool you, it’s anything but luxury.

The facilities themselves are very nice, but many tenants are not respectful of the amenities that are available here. There are frequently loud parties/music in the pool area on the weekends, dog waste on the grass/sidewalks, dirty socks/shoes in the hallways and stairwells, etc. so when you are in your own unit it’s fine, but difficult to enjoy the surrounding community. There is also a community room with a kitchen, big screen tv, pool table, etc. but it is almost never available for all tenants to use because it is always “reserved” by the same families- it is nice of management to offer this amenity but there should be some kind of restriction on the amount of time the room can be reserved for and the frequency  at which each tenant can reserve the facility

The consummately professional and CARING manner in which the property manager and her staff respect and take care of their tenants' needs/wishes.  Specifically, service is provided quickly and is 100% satisfactory.  Have lived here a little more than one year and EVERY promise made before signing our lease agreement has been delivered. Very importantly, the COMMUNICATION from the office of the property manager/staff is, in a word, excellent.  No surprises.  While emails during the last 30+ years spent in business were beyond onerous and frankly speaking, production inhibitors, here both the number and content of the emails sent by management are important and timely (i.e. they are sent ONLY when key information should be shared with we tenants). I do not often give 5-star ratings EXCEPT when they are deserved.  This place warrants a 5+ rating.

Without a doubt the best property I’ve lived at in my experience as a renter. The amenities are top notch. The units are spacious and have excellent appliances. The move-in process was very efficient. The location is perfect. So far it has been a very quiet and peaceful living situation. Everybody living here has been very pleasant. Also the office staff has been extremely accommodating, special shout out to Amy and Taylor. Very pleased to be living here.

Nice new building but if you want to be micromanaged you should live here. Management sends out Emails 5 times a week with more rules on what you can and can’t do. Its getting very old and I’ve heard many tenants talking about moving out due to management.

I moved in about a month ago and am really enjoying my apartment so far. The building is very clean and the amenities are great. Additionally the leasing office is super friendly and always willing to help out with anything. I highly recommend it here.

I’ve been a resident here for just over a year. I moved in just after completion of the building. The day I go to move in the elevators were not yet installed and being that I was not on the first floor that meant to use the stairs. Thankfully they agreed to hire movers for me. It was the least they could do. 
It’s been over a year of this place being built and its been one construction project after another. The only quiet time we get is in the winter. Otherwise, it’s been issues with water leaking in the garage. Digging up all around the building. For someone who works from home, and I know I’m not the only one who does, this has been hell. It’s crazy they raised rent after my first year when they still are doing construction on the place! Beware if you plan to move here. Its more than outside issues as they are still having to enter people’s units and fix things. 
I thought being in a new build and being the first tenant would be nice but no. No peace here!

Pros: OVERALL PLEASANT LIVING EXPERIENCE
-newer build, meaning new finishings
-very quiet neighborhood!
-the on-site property manager is friendly. she put on apartment-wide events

Cons: BUDGET AHEAD (whether you stay or move)
-they increased rent about 10% annually at lease signing. I ultimately decided to move and later saw they posted my unit at a lower price than what they asked me to resign--odd, because they even asked me to reconsider moving
-they charged exorbitant cleaning fees, even for what looked like new construction sawdust left behind the fridge and oven
They raised the rent over 10% on us, then after we left, lowered back to what is was for our last term. We tried to get them to to negotiate, but they refused

We love this community! So great to deal with management that truly cares about their residents more than just collecting the money. Jill the property manager is AWESOME!!! Very down to earth, not snobs. We recommend The Outlook to everyone
The property manager has been amazing at every turn! She has made moving cross-country as smooth as possible, and I highly recommend this property for other long-distance movers.

My family and I moved into The Meadows recently and so far it is a very nice place to live.  Any maintenance requests are answered quickly, and they follow up when needed.  All the staff is great to work with, I have never had a problem with anyone, they are always friendly and willing to help.  The building we are in has had a recent renovation to the outside and because of it we have not had to turn our heat on despite the days in the teens.  Overall a nice place to live!

I lived here two years ago and unfortunately my roommate situation didn't work out so I ended up moving. I moved in here again in August and once again I absolutely love it. They've made some redid one of the pools, and have redone the outside of some of the buildings. The new look is very appealing and I assume they intend to finish the rest in the warmer months. The office staff is very kind and accommodating; Lukas is my favorite! Maintenance is also great, very fast and efficient! Christian is the best maintenance man we've had, very friendly! I was very disappointed that since moving in we've had our water shut off for long periods of time five times. I do understand however, that there was a pipe issue in the ground of which was dug up and replaced. Haven't had an issue with water being shut off since. I love that this apartment is pet friendly and the neighbors are pretty decent. Also very affordable bills! I highly recommend these apartments!

Leased for 3yrs, maintenance was non-existent for our building, washer/dryer out of order frequently, minimal maintenance done to the apt lived in, even though called the office many times. Visitor parking=VERY small. Didn't have any cable outlets in the bedrooms. Interior not up to date, shabby looking cabnits and counter tops, the paint job done was poor and is spotty in the bathrooms, could see had painted over edging tape, there may be spliced outlets connecting rooms and can overload fuse box if to many watts used at once.They may update after moved. As for a 4 bdrm apt they count the den as a bedroom, we also had to move a family member out from the den due to the damp, and suspected mold, they are a severe asthmatic. The staff in the office are poor/average to work with, they seem to be courteous, but a relative heard one get short with someone, didn't know if was a tenant. Tenants keep to themselves, but can be noisy. The rent, in my opinion, is average. The Garbage removal services aren't frequent, and had spill over weekly. Can get a breeze with the smell of garbage in the house from outside. The heat is very poor, was freezing in the house during winter, even with the new windows and patio door are installed. The air conditioner they have isn't sized to the square footage of the apt. Outlets are loose, broken. One sparked and caused a small appliance's plug to melt.

We have lived at the Meadows for over a year. We first subleted a 2 bedroom, and then downgraded to a 1 bedroom. It's very quiet, neighbors pretty much keep to themselves, and trash is picked up almost every other day. Clean space, 2 outdoor pools, and an excericise room. The leasing staff is very helpful and courteous. The only issue I've ever had, was the stricked visitor parking rules. Small space or you're visitors are walking from the street...they do offer visitor stickers- but the local towing company will tow your vehilce without it. They did just upgarde windows and patio doors, giving it a more modern look. I'm happy with my experience at the Meadows.

The Meadows is a place you could call home.  No matter the size of the apartment you chose to live in, I’d consider it cozy and livable.  There’s plenty of parking as well.  My experience here, I’d like to share that it’s been peaceful at times and I’ve had all the privacy I need.  The team here is good with maintenance on a timely manner, plus they do get back to me on time.  The landlords are quick to react in situations involved in living here.  The downfall of living here is, the other tenants may not be as great as to help keep the building clean and not knowing how loud they can be, but it’s just like living anywhere else.   Other than that, it’s a great place to live and the location is awesome!

-Mai 2057t
Love the size of my apartment.  Quiet area.  My kids enjoy the pool every summer.  Front desk staff is always very polite and helpful.  Maintenance issues get fixed in a timely manner.

It's ok for a starter apartment or college apartment. It's not a chateau, poorly insulated, mixed resident base. People keep to themselves (great thing), not really a family complex. Front desk staff are wonderful. They need to upgrade windows and patio doors.

I have only lived here a month and I am quite pleased with it. It is extremely quiet inside the apartment. Office staff do the best they can to help whenever there's a problem that needs to be dealt with. There was absolutely no service in my apartment (T Mobile carrier), but I now use wifi calling, which works just as well as normal calls. The location is quite far from the center of Madison by bus (~30-45min), which is how I travel, bus that is mostly on me for picking it. Aside from the location, it really is a great place to live.

We sublet one of the meadows apt over 7 months ago. We had a couple of horrible experience with this apt that made us regret of renting this apt si kuch that we will never ever rent any apt from them. Once my husband and I traveled outside of the country and we didn't get the invoice before we left. We contacted the leasing office a week before the rent due date and arranged a check to be sent to them by our bank, due to the July 4th holiday, our check was 1 day late and they charged us $35 late fee. The leasing office manager told us "we are too big a company to make any exception for you". Another day my farther in law came to visit us for one night, and the next day his car got towed. We went to the leasing office again and they told us that they let a 3rd party towing company to come and tow cars which don't have a visiter stickers whenever they want. If you want to get your car back, you need to pay $320 per day. My farther in law came to visit us at 10pm that night and the office was closed. The next morning the car was already gone. We didn't even have time to get the visitor sticker! Overall, we are extremely angry with the meadows apt. We will strongly recommend everyone NOT to rent from them. They never want to help you and they cause a lot of inconvenience for the residents there.

The buildings were built in the early 70's... The Meadows idea of a upgrade is paint everything white... They will raise your rent 20.00 every year but you will not see any improvements. They have issues with rodents and bugs. There management staff changes monthly. There is always trouble at the pools and nothing is done to fix the issue. It is a nice location and easy to get to everywhere in Madison from here. If you don't mind overpriced rent and some riff raft, then it a good place to go.

When first moving in the office staff was amazing and helpful asking if there was anything they could fix right away or anything we needed help finding. The neighborhood is great and the people I have met so far are helpful and kind. I would recommend this apartment complex to anyone, whether you have kids, just a couple, or all by yourself this is a dream come true apartment!!!

There's a reason I lived here for 4 years! This was such a great place to live.
