Brenda is an amazing owner - she's great at quickly communicating with you about any issues, and we seriously never waited more than half a day to have our maintenance requests fulfilled. Although the building is on the older side, the apartments are nice, & Brenda works to update things often. Over the years we got a whole new bathroom as well as new appliances (fridge, dishwasher, stove). The rent is quite reasonable for the location, which is also great - right next to Sequoya Commons, a mile from Hilldale Mall, and just a couple miles from downtown. Westmorland Park is right down the road, and it's also not far from the bike path. I'd recommend this place to anyone. Thank you Brenda!!

Going on my 4th year at Midvale Heights.  We couldn't be happier with our experience moving here right after college.  The staff is friendly and helpful, the facilities are well kept and clean, and the location is great for those who want to get out of downtown and remain 10 minutes away.

Highly Recommended!

I rented a one room   den apartment at Midvale Heights, right from the beginning the property manager Brenda was very helpful. Approval of application was fast, service/repair in apartment was quick. Overall a great experience. Also, had to move out earlier then end date, Brend helped with the sublet as well.

The rent is low enough to make this a pretty good value.  The manager, Brenda, is hard to get a hold of in person, but when you contact her via email or phone she's usually pretty responsive.  The location is pretty nice.  It's centrally located to most of the stuff you would want on the west side and it's easy enough to get downtown.  The walls are really thin though, you'll hear your neighbors whether you want to or not.

Palisades is definitely an OK place to live but be wary of who lived in your unit before you. There were SO MANY BUGS (bed bugs, fruit flys, etc) and it was so dirty. We had to clean our entire unit before we put anything in and it was an extensive process. I understand that it’s a college apartment but we do pay quite a bit to live here so it should be somewhat up to par cleanliness wise. I think once we get everything in order it will be a great place to live, but initially it’s been a lot of work and I would prefer to avoid that. If you’re thinking of living here just keep that in mind but don’t let it stop you. It is a great place to live so far and the staff is very helpful with any issues we have.

Unhelpful management from all over the place. Disappointing new staff. Finally leaving after getting bed bugs for the 3rd time in my building. Being ignored by staff, and trying to get help is impossible. And then police have been constantly present. Someone is getting arrested every day! They knocked my neighbors door down with an entire squad to execute a warrant! Crazy! Not family friendly anymore.

I've been living here at Stonewood Village since 1990.  What I really like is the private entrance, it makes it feel more like a home instead of an apartment.  The amenities of having a dishwater and your own washer and dryer are a plus.  Since I've been here so long I have seen and worked with staff coming and going.  I have always found them to be courteous and helpful.  Repairs that need to be done are done in a timely manner.  The grounds are well maintained with lawn maintenance done regularly and snow removal done timely.
We've lived at Stonewood for a couple of years.  The grounds are well maintained and the staff is amazing.

My son and I have been living at Stonewood for about 4 and half years now. I’ve always been pleased with the location of the apartments, the quickness of the maintenance staff, the overall landscaping,  and feeling safe at this complex. One thing to note however, if you are a new resident and are just  moving in, double check and make sure all your appliances are working correctly. Some of mine were not but overall love these apartments!

This place is great, it has an inunit washer/dryer, is pet friendly, right next to a park, and gives the feel you aren't living directly in the city, although there are shops less than 10 mins away, bus roughts, and a pool on the grounds. The apartments are spacious and it stays pretty quiet. This is a nice neighborhood to live in.

Move here if you don't want your security deposit back - they find all kinds of ways NOT to return it. Means more bonuses for management. More mud than green grass - very little landscaping done. You need permission to plant flowers, you pay for their insurance on THEIR BUILDINGS - $25/month. Renters insurance - they want their names on your renters insurance. They do not de-ice or remove snow from sidewalks until 11:00 in the morning. You should not put anything on the walls as you will be assessed and charged when you move out for the nail holes. You should hire a cleaning agency to clean for the next renters. No upgrades done in years. Just BE AWARE. Take pictures and have walk throughs before handing over your keys.
Office staff are friendly and easy to communicate with. Maintenance is also respectful and oftentimes there the same day you submit a request!

Great location, private neighborhood, well maintained landscaping and sidewalks. There are two bus stops steps away from the property for the #15 city bus that will take you right to UW-Madison/downtown. Hallways and garage are well maintained, and the spacious apartment we have is an excellent value per square foot. Not many on-site amenities, but that probably keeps rent costs down. I have my own gym membership and I don't need a pool, so this is great, no need to pay for extras you won't use. Have been very happy here for two years. Haven't had too many maintenance requests, but they were all handled very quickly. Grounds are maintained well, common areas are repainted and cleaned frequently, our neighbors are quiet. One of the best value apartments I have ever lived in.

I've been living here for nearly 3 years. My apartment is nice and quiet. Occasionally I hear other residents but it's pretty minor. The complex is really well maintained. The common areas are very clean. If anything needs to be fixed management is quick to respond. 

The location is great... Easy to get most places the area quickly. UW campus is approximately 10 minutes... Central Madison is 10 to 15 minutes (all depending on traffic). Not far from recreational areas. Restaurants within walking distance. 

I would highly recommend living here to anyone.

The units are well maintained, in a very nice location (right on a bus route), management is very responsive to requests, and heat and internet costs are included in the rent price.

The only downside is the air conditioning doesn't always reach every room of the apartment on the hottest days of the summer (it is a single room wall mounted a/c unit).

All things considered, it is a great apartment complex though. Lived in my unit for 5 years and only left to buy a house.

It took awhile-but it seems you have finally found the top notch service team we all deserve, and need. Payton, the chief maintenance man in the white truck- Tim, and Desiree are approachable, focused, and timely. Working with the general public, in a challenged neighborhood, is far from easy. They seem to show up every day ready to make a difference, to help, to make things better. I can t say how much better I sleep knowing there is finally hope at Renew 78 West. Keep this team, they are winners!! Thank you Payton, Tim, Desiree-you are appreciated.

I strongly advise not renting from Trinity. I recently moved from Renew 78 West. I always paid rent in full and on time, and left the unit in excellent condition. They kept my deposit and sent me a bill for $1400. If I call the office, they say call corporate. Corporate says call the office. Point, they use unethical and dishonest practices to overcharge honest tenants. Terrible experience still haunting me.

I’ve lived at the Hub for the past year and it’s everything I hoped for! I think the location is the best at UW and the amenities are better than any other I’ve seen. The staff is always helpful, whether it’s in the middle of the day or calling the on-call phone at night. Morgan has especially been super helpful at the front desk!
The Hub has great amenities and the staff is very friendly and helpful. Morgan in particular at the front desk is wonderful!
The location downtown is perfect, and I love the view of Bascom, State Street, the Capital and the lake!! Staff is very helpful and always willing to answer my questions.
The location is great! Near many shops, restaurants, and UW. The staff is very helpful and the amenities are great.
Love the location of the building. The units and amenities are great! The office staff is very helpful.

My experience has been amazing at the hub since I’ve moved in. While there might be some clunks here and there with appliances, maintenance and the RAs have always been quick to help and solve my problems—it just takes communication. Mitch specifically had been such a sigh of relief, he is always ready to help residents even if he is on call late at night. He is extremely dependable and has helped me and many other friends find great units tailored to our taste, you’re lucky if he picks up the phone!

If you’re looking for a luxury building in Madison with amenities, DO NOT live here. The Hub advertises a rooftop pool, hot tubs, a spa, grills, etc.; however, none of these amenities are open (and when they are open, they’re completely run down). When I asked the staff if the pool was safe for swimming, they gave me the green light. Unfortunately, the only thing that was green is the swamp-like algae floating in the water. While they eventually cleaned the pool (after numerous complaints), as of June 28th, none of the hot tubs work.

The management is incredibly lazy, and they pin the blame on third parties (such as New Wave Pools), which supposedly maintains these amenities. I lived here when the building first opened, and it was easily the nicest apartment in Madison. It’s unfortunate to see such a prime spot go downhill, but until the building hires competent management, it will only get worse.

If you’re considering living at the Hub, live at the James or Lucky instead.

They lose your packages and don’t care and tel you to figure it out yourself, overpriced, closed down all the amenities due to Covid and didn’t reduce our rent, doesn’t answer your phone calls, made us bring our own carts for move in.

Please know this:  You are signing a lease for a bedroom with a bed and desk.  That's it.  You have no guarantees that the bedroom you want is in an apartment you want.  There is no guarantee that the bedroom will resemble anything like what they showed you.  There is no guarantee that the bedroom will have a window.  Yes - there ARE bedrooms in this building with NO WINDOWS.  There is no guarantee that you won't get put into a unit with someone who owns a pet, even though the building says "NO PETS ALLOWED".  There is no guarantee that your rent will be anything close to what you see on the website.  All floorplans are NOT represented.  All of the above things have happened to us.  And you will find that there is nobody to talk to about your concerns except the students working at the front desk.  STAY AWAY!  Don't believe the hype about living here - plenty of other places where your students will be much happier.

After being a student and living at the Hub, I've been very pleased with living here. From day one I was able to reach out to the support staff for any questions that I might've had with either my lease, maintenance request, etc. Everything is answered in a timely manner with great service. Additionally, it is in one of the best locations on campus centrally located meaning I am able to walk wherever I needed to go. The amenities are great, and rooftop views made for an enjoyable and relaxing experience.

BEWARE!  Rent somewhere else other than the HUB.  Read the other reviews and know that this is a rotten place to rent.  Management is run by a bunch of 21 year olds and they are terrible to deal with.  My daughter rents a parking space for $250/month.  Her car was in the shop so she used mine and parked in her own spot.  The HUB took the liberty of towing my vehicle in the parking spot we pay for and cost me $221 to get my vehicle back.  I asked management to reimburse me and they refused.  In addition, they bullied my daughter and her roommate accusing them of smoking.  They don't smoke and they don't have parties yet the HUB is harassing them about this.  Go walk the halls and you'll be sure to smell the marijuana smoke.  Go look at their "quiet rooms" and see the garbage and dirt all over the floor.  This place is disgusting and I can't wait to pull my daughter from this place.  Oh, and don't let them bully you into signing up early threatening they will "fill up."  They never do and scare you into thinking they are full.  Don't believe anything from management.  Absolutely the worst place to be.

There are much much better places to live with the same price you would pay to live here. The staff is rude, they lie about everything, they do not offer roommate matching they will place you anywhere they have an opening, the security in the building is awful, they are only here on friday and saturday so other days anyone can come in, the wifi cuts out at night, the rooms are EXTREMELY SMALL and overpriced, the sauna is broken in the spa room. On top of that if you do put a maintenance request in for them to come and fix something like my patio door and it is in the middle of winter and freezing will probably not do it even after 2 months, and your heating bill will be over $200. Honestly, it is not worth they hype or price. Live somewhere else with better staff and security.

Warning for all young adults , read the lease , then have your parents read the lease , then a lawyer. First line in dark print after you fill in all your personal info. No  Oral representations made by US or any other promises outside of this lease are binding upon US . Management just wants a body in a bedroom and can promise  anything because it is not binding . The required general liability insurance policy for damages by tenants [ page 8 ] seems appropriate with such a high potential for unhappy tenants.

To give an analogy on how I feel about the hub: It is like that beautiful girl that looks great from the outside, then when you get to know her, it turns out she has a terrible soul, and is terrible to be around.  That is the hub in a nutshell, the management and staff makes it miserable to live there.  Without a doubt the worst management I have ever seen, and everyone I talk to at the hub has similar opinions.  This is not a place where you want to live, especially at the price!! The rooms are also extremely small, and utilities are not included.  They do not make it a good experience to live here, even though it is loaded with amenities.  I do want to say I am not sure how much of the fault it is the actual employees at the hub itself (definitely some), but the "Hub Corporate" is something you should not want or have to deal with.  Glad I am moving out.

What a racket this place is. My daughter signed a lease after touring the different apartment configurations. Her and 3 other girls followed the procedures. They put down what type of apartment they wanted along with two other options they would settle for in the event their first choice was not available. They didn't get any of those 3 choices that they asked for AND the rent was higher! They were told they are paying for a 'window' which looks out into the construction going on! Their 2 double rooms are smaller, their living space is smaller, bathrooms are smaller and no walk in closets like they had requested that the other units have. The change this company made to the lease was never brought to the girls attention over the summer. We are very disappointed in this place. In the event of trying to deal with this situation the only people you can get ahold of are students working the desk. It is very difficult to get anyone in management. I would not recommend this place.
This place is shaping up as a disaster. No one knows what is going on.

My girlfriend and I have lived here for about a year now and fully intended on staying if a promotion did not require us to move out of town. The rent is extremely fair, especially compared to others that are even remotely similar. Attached garages, private entrances, and vaulted ceilings with a skylight (if you are on the top floor) were definitely some of our favorite features. The neighborhood is friendly, quiet, and well maintained through all seasons. Management was always responsive and very friendly. We’ve seriously had no complaints and are sad to go.

Tracy is AWESOME! Caring, kind and helpful....always. Maintenance is always on top of things and very nice and helpful as well. The community looks great and everything is taken care of so nicely around here. 

The apartments, buildings and grounds are neat and clean and taken care of .

Very nice and quiet place. Sandburg Woods is a plus, beautiful scenery and walking trails with awesome wildlife activity.
Nice large three bedrooms are clean and taken care of. Washer, dryer, dishwasher, etc. is everything you need. Nice private deck and 1
car garage is a great size, with plenty of storage. 2 full baths are great too. Also, nice walking community within a nice neighborhood.

I love living at Forest Run.  The apartments are spacious with a large master suite which includes generous closets and a full bath.  The apartment has two bathrooms which is not the norm for apartments.  The attached garage and pool are a big pulse.  Visitors are quite impressed when they see the apartment.  The apartment complex is surprisingly quiet for its size.  The buildings and grounds are well maintained and management is on site.  All maintenance requests are handled promptly.  I foresee living here for many years.  
 
Cheryl G

We have been residents of Forest Run Apartments going on nine years. Our residency has been truly enjoyable. Whenever we have a maintenance issue, it is taken care of immediately. We also have a dog, and appreciate the fact that pets are allowed. The grounds are perfect for walking our pet. Forest Run even provide waste bags and receptacles which is convenient. 

Forest Run treats their residents and apartments with respect, and for that reason, we intend to stay here for many years to come!

Have lived here for 1 year & renewed for a second go 'round.  Price per square foot makes these apartment homes the best for your buck.  Grounds are well maintained (year round) & the maintenance staff is prompt & efficient.
By far, the BEST Bang for your buck in the area!!!
I've loved living here for almost 2 years. Management is super helpful, friendly and are very quick to responding to maintenance requests. I highly recommend living here.

Honestly, I absolutely love our apartment as it is refreshing to be at a property that actually treats you like one of the family and like a human being! It is so easy to do business with this company and staff. I feel like I am getting quality style Chicago and New York style living with their stainless steel appliances, beautiful view, underground parking, outdoor pool, update fitness room, space to have parties and even a hot tub. Omg! The apartments are huge like a condo but with washer and dryer in unit! Our Masterbedroom have a walk closet that connects to the bedroom!

Our move in and renew process was very seamlessly and extremely fair! I can't imagine anyone having issues at all. The paperwork is so easy my sister's  unborn child could read, understand and follow through. You can beat that anywhere else. The Property Manager, Assistant Manager, Leasing Agent and Maintenance staff goes above and beyond.

I can't imagine anyone having issues with this property or staff. In my personal opinion, Maple Valley apartment staff always tries to help their residents with providing alternatives and solutions but you have to communicate. We are planning to stay at this property. I wish that I would've found this place earlier. I hope this helps!

I don't know where the positive reviews came from but my experience has been awful. Maybe they're old. just moved out (January 2017). Maintenance takes forever to respond and are always loosing requests. The office has lost paperwork before and one staff members seems as though they could not care less. The apartment walls are thin, window ac does nothing, rent is always going up, and complaints/concerns are met with a passive aggressive attitude. I will say the location was convenient for me but that's about the only positive.

This is a safe neighborhood, judging by the crime maps for Madison and this apartment complex is quite nice at about $200 a month less than comparable units in Madison. The two-bedroom, two bath I have is $1140 a month and doesn't have the jetted tub, fireplace, or skylights of some of the other units, but I do enjoy the vaulted ceilings, hardwood-look laminate floors in the open-concept living, dining and kitchen area, stainless appliances, and carpeted bedrooms. Great underground heated parking space! Balcony is big enough for a 2-seat wicker sofa and 2 folding chairs. This is a dog-friendly community, which we love! Nice pool, beautiful community room and good sized exercise room.

Maple Grove Apartments, spacious units, great management. They have units to fit every residents needs. They respond to residents concerns in a timely manner. They have a great pool and fitness center. I would recommend these apartments to anyone!

Ive been here for almost a year now and this is one of the better apartment complexes around Madison. Maintenance is very responsive and on top of things, neighbors are friendly, and it's a great price for the space. There is so much closet space and storage in general - I feel very safe here! Can't say enough good things.

The windows in the apartments are very poorly installed with mold on them. You can hear mice in the walls. Their are ants EVERYWHERE and pest control doesn’t help, they only come once a week and it does nothing. Their are at least 3 police their every single day. You have to have your heat on high 24/7 throughout the winter because of how much air comes through the windows. Just overall a terrible experience.  I will NEVER recommend these apartments to anyone. Save yourself the time & stress and LOOK SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!

We have been living here for nearly 5 years now. These apartment are the best. Great responsive management and maintenance are top notch. super friendly. Take serious action to any complaint. Never ever had any issue living here. One or two time all these years I had parking issue due to non resident parking but they took serious action to it. The community is nice. Majority of them are family based and educated. I highly recommend these apartments then any in Madison. I just wish they had lease terms for 6 months too otherwise we would have stayed here more. Due to nature of my husband job we can’t be bonded with 12 months lease.

Over all have lived here for about 2-3 years. It's a nice place to live I like that it has a washer and dryer in unit and it doesn't feel like an apartment because of the separate entrance. The vaulted ceilings on the second floor make the place seem larger and it's a great unit. Close to everything, MATC, the mall, American Parkway, and it's also on a bus route. Love going on the walking trail near by with the dogs, haven't had any issues with the neighbors. The apartment staff is pretty quick to address any issues that arise and are very flexible.

My boyfriend and I just moved in to our 1 bedroom apartment at Morningside on the Green and we love it! It's the perfect size for the two of us (and our kitty). We have a garage and storage off of our balcony, plus the ample closets and open concept gives it a very spacious feel. The location is great with a lot of shopping very close by and only a 15-ish minute drive downtown. I also really like the private entrance - it gives it a very homey feel.
The perfect building has a bay window to the see the rising sun, landscaping is tended to carefully.

apartmentName: River Bend Apartments at the Arboretum
review:
We have lived here almost two years and have enjoyed it very much. The only reason we are leaving is that we recently purchased a house.

Very dog friendly and we've met many wonderful people we now call friends by being outside with our dog. The pool is well-kept and has allowed us to  stay connected with people even during the pandemic. The pool capacity was limited during this time as management wanted to make sure everyone remained safe even while outdoors.

The maintenance team is wonderful and very prompt at responding to requests.

Beth is our apartment manager and does a superb job making sure residents are taken care of.

We would definitely recommend this complex to potential renters!

On site management is seriously lacking. I am a current resident & could not be more disappointed with the filthy common areas, broken WiFi, non-working fire pits, constantly malfunctioning garage door (only one was in & out), and the property managements inability or unwillingness to address these issues. There are numerous properties all around this one. Do yourself a favor and seek alternatives or be stuck paying for non-usable amenities like me.

We’ve had a great experience renting at Brownpoint Reserve for the last (almost) 2 years. The quality of the apartments is unmatched compared to everything else we’ve seen in the Madison area. Yes, we can sometimes hear footsteps from our upstairs neighbors, but it has never been problematic for us. Beautiful outdoor space and common area. We love having access to basic gym equipment and the yoga room right on site. Parking is the easiest I’ve ever experienced for an apartment (the garage is huge).

The staff has been wonderful during our time here. Most of the time, we forget they are even there (feels more like a private home in that way). But when you need them, they’re very helpful and responsive. All of our maintenance requests (nothing major) have been completed within a few days, most of the time the very next day. When we wanted to upgrade from a 1-bedroom to a 2-bedroom apartment within the building, Dylan was incredibly helpful in securing us the exact unit we were interested in and making sure the transfer went smoothly for everyone involved.

All in all, we’ve loved our time here. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone.

This is by far the most quiet and well kept apartment building we have ever lived in.   The location is amazing with the bike trail right outside our door and walking distance to groceries, brewery/wine bar, restaurants, book store etc..  Management has been very friendly and responsive.
I like the apartment so much and I feel the staffs are super friendly and nice! And the facilities are very new and shiny.
Beautiful setting with very sound proof apartments. Quick response on any issues that arise.

I have lived Lincoln Street a little over a year.  The staff are so friendly and tentative to any maintenance issues I have ran into. The  grounds are beautiful, clean and well maintained! I was worried when I first moved in about all the noise that I my hear from the fire station and EMS across the street but at night they do nit run sirens just lights!  So I get the safety and security of the police and fire department across the street without the noise!

Lincoln street has a lot to like. The location right near main street and the military ridge trail is great. The option for a private entrance on the first floor was a big plus. The overall fit and finish of the fixtures and appliances is high quality and modern and the building is new and clean.

Just moved in about 10 days ago and so far, I've had no issues. The location is great; there's a grocery store, fast food, and some other stuff within walking distance, and it's a 20 minute bike ride from Epic if you're looking for somewhere to move after being hired (that's why I'm here). I'm renting a studio apartment, and I've had no issues with it (decent amount of room, walk-in closet, kitchen is good), plus the internet here is really fast. The property manager has been quite friendly and helpful as well. You get a spot in an underground garage, so you don't need to worry about parking, and the fitness room is pretty nice. I'll update this review if anything comes up, but as of now, I'm liking this place.

Great Value and Location!  This is a spacious apartment with everything we need.  Lots of storage in the apartment and a downstairs storage unit for those seasonal items.  Friendly, responsive management team that take care of things in a timely manner.

Fantastic place to live! I have lived here for almost 2 years, and my experience has been a very positive one here. Tracy, the manager, does an outstanding job of keeping things running well, and addressing issues right away. Maintenance is also very quick to respond, and fixes things right away.  I would highly recommend living here if you prefer a quiet nice community with great management!

Great value in a quiet neighborhood. Management and maintenance are always responsive, attentive,and flexible. I have access to downtown and west Madison, while having a quiet home close to the Conservancy.

Really nice apartments in a great location! Only minutes away from the west side of Madison and is right up against the Pheasant Branch Nature Conservancy. It’s in a quiet neighborhood and you can enjoy a campfire on those cool summer nights. Also is affordable for the Madison area.

I love the location, I love the quiet, peaceful environment, and I love living next door to Pheasant Branch Conservancy. Management is receptive, flexible and helpful, and my apartment is beautiful. I've been here for 5 years, and I'm really happy.
Really nice apartment community for the price. Great value, spacious floor plan, new appliances, and is smoke free. The management team is really on top of their game. I love living here.

I have lived here two years. I chose Le Silve for the overall environment including the landscaping, management and staff. The maintenance requests are responded to very promptly and with a personal touch. The management really goes the extra mile to be helpful and make this a great place to live. I love the landscaping and natural setting as well. It is quiet and has many extra features. Great place to live!
LeSilve is a great place to live. Friendly and responsive management and maintenance. Excellent amenities! I have lived here for almost 2 years and it has been an outstanding experience.

LeSilve Apartments and management and maintenance staff have raised the bar for apartment life and customer service. LeSilve is the benchmark that other apartments need to reach. We never knew how wonderful apartment life could be until we found them. When we needed to move closer to family, it was hard to leave. The apartments we found were no LeSilve. Even though we were not renewing our lease, Mark, Andrea, and Lori worked hard to rent our apartment so that we would not need to pay rent for the last month of our lease. You are going to want to live here.

The staff at LeSilve was very helpful & accommodating when we were looking for a place to live. They are very responsive to requests & the apartments are beautiful. I love the breakfast every morning & the business center. Couldn't ask for a better place to live!

Be warned anyone who looks to lock themselves into a financial contract with the management of this property. After living in this complex as accomodating and model tenants for 11 months, come check out time, Gallina management slashed 15% of our security deposit on purely subjective circumstances, for things such as "warn carpet" and "spot in the tub". Hard water stains in the sink, a direct contribution to the poor water quality of the apartment, were also deemed the fault of our poor care. No pictures were provided to justify any of these claims, nor any detailed explanation, aside from a poorly legible pink sheet from a check out list that listed the complaints above, somehow equating to 15 percent of the deposit. The water quality is so outrageously corrosive that both toilets in the apartment had to be scrubbed diligently with a sponge every other week because of the sediment poring out after every single flush.

I've been renting apartments for 10 years. Not once have I seen money taken out of my security. This behavior at check out is representitive of the moral character of management you will be subjected to. Considering the already stiff costs of the rent compared to similar properties, and the inconvenience of them changing the terms of their lease lengths to end at more convenient rental periods for them, at your expense, I would advise against anyone making a financial commitment to this complex, especially considering the opening of brand new buildings under different management closer to Greenway staton.

If you want a quiet sanctuary that backs up to the woods in town this is it. Everyone in management is like family and they go out of there way to make it the best place for you to live. My place is not large but it's the little touches: pool parties, up grades, immediate maintenance, even warm chocolate chip cookies in the office everyday etc that make it special. I lived here about 10yrs ago then moved out of town and recently came back and after looking at a lot of apts. I knew I had come home again and that's exactly what it feels like. Home

Springtree apartments are great, affordable apartments! The staff is incredibly helpful, repairs are typically completed within 24 hours, and the maintenance team does a great job keeping everything in good shape. That said,  you are getting what you are paying for, so expect your apartment to have a few quirks due to age and use.

Springtree Apartments has excellent customer service and care a lot about their tenants. With every problem we had the staff was easy to work with and took care of it immediately! The apartment itself was okay, but for the price we are paying, and a little decorating, it’s a great place to stay.

Moved out of state and this is my first apartment in this area. It has been great living at springtree, the ladies in the office are great and very knowledgeable and are willing to help when needed. The community is very quiet. And whenever I put in a maintenance notice it gets taken care of that day!

I've been living here for almost three years now and I still totally love it.  My apartment is cozy and well taken care of, the maintenance team is fantastic!  They are always here right away to address my issues.  And the office staff is great!  Whitney is one of the best Property Managers I've ever had to deal with.  She's compassionate and fair and always has a smile on her face.  The location can't be beat, they just built a huge Goodwill right across the street, and there's plenty of food and entertainment options within walking distance. I would recommend Springtree to anyone and actually have, I have a good friend who moved in last year and I got a bonus just for having my friend move in!

I have lived in Middleton my whole life & wanted to move closer to my mom- worst experience I have ever had renting in Madison.

We all know what they say about first impressions, so I'll start with that: I moved in at the end of December with no heat. When I called the office, they laughed me off like I didn't understand how to operate a thermostat. Maintenance took me to the basement and showed me the valve off.  You think you would check that before someone moves in.....in December.

Units are “newly renovated” but buildings themselves just so old. You can see it was a cheap "cover up what’s falling apart" job.

In the summer, temperature in my unit was COMPLETELY out of control.  Entire upper level of my building was stifling hot. My unit was 86  degrees so I needed to run my HVAC on full blast all day and night. Ran my electric bill up $100  /month because HVAC was so inefficient. I bought 3 tower fans & used the ceiling fan to get air circulation. HVAC barely kept living room at a comfortable temp. Management acted like it was just me complaining….I was so disappointed.

The people who work in the office are condescending & incompetent.  Ask for Cameron or don't even bother.  He is very knowledgeable, honest and hardworking.

The manager, Whitney, is disrespectful and uses repetitive "customer service language" instead of talking to you like a real person.  I was a hotel manager for 3 years and I can tell you she is in the WRONG field or not happy with her job.  Probably both.  She does not listen, responds poorly to conflict, and lacks understanding of how to interact with residents.  She needs to be reminded that residents are customers and people with rights, not just checks to be cashed.

2 weeks ago my sub-lessee moved out. I called to ask about the status of my deposit return and an itemization of any damages. The manager, Whitney, said in a snarky and fake-nice tone, "All deposits are returned within 21 days of move-out."  I didn't ask for their policy, I asked about MY deposit.  I simply replied that I would wait the 21 days.  She repeated herself again, blah blah blah "All deposits are returned within 21 days.  You will receive it by then."  Clearly this woman is a total airhead with no business etiquette.

I would not recommend living here to anyone unless you are out of options.  I moved as soon as I could get someone to sublet.  I am so happy to have gotten away from this mess of a place.

I have been a resident of SpringTree for a number of years now, and I have not enjoyed a single year of it. Every year, kids run rampant across your yard, yelling at one another, littering your yard with snack wrappers and sticks, digging up your yard, and even sit on your stoop and yell at each other. It's not uncommon for the kids to even come screaming through the hallways and bang on your door because they think it's funny. And what does the management do about all of this? Nothing. They send ONE letter saying for parents to watch their kids while they play, and of course the parents are too lazy to watch their kids as they're told to. It's not even uncommon for the parents themselves to yell across the complex for their kids to come home. I tell you all - If you want a place to live in peace and quiet, this is NOT the place! The buildings are also VERY dated! One side of the complex is even sinking into the ground! The garages look like they were built in the 70's and never remodeled. Raccoons will LOVE to go from garage to garage and litter what ever they bring from the adjoining unit over to yours, and just dump it there. I've even found little paw prints on my car that I keep in the garage. Don't ask the management to do anything about it, because they won't. They care more about making the office look pretty and updating a few units to lure you in, then once they've got you, they release the complex on you. I will say that I am looking forward of moving out of this apartment complex and moving to somewhere where the people actually care about their neighbors, and about you. The only semi-redeeming quality this place has is it's close to just about anything you'd want. And even within walking distance. That is the ONLY part I like about this place. Future tenants beware!
Staff and maintenance are communicative and friendly. They are always willing to listen to your concerns. Property is very well loved with many long term tenants.

In addition to easy access to the conservancy, the 2 bedroom apartment we live in is spacious, bright and comfortably laid out. Neighbors are friendly and quiet. The pool and the grounds are really well maintained. The staff has been great: friendly and always quick to respond to any requests. 
Walking distance to grocery store, pharmacy, hardware store and several good eateries and an easy drive to downtown.
Fantastic place!

Middleton Shores is an great place to live! Whether you are single or have a family you will find the staff and tenants warm and inviting.  Middleton Shores is a well maintained property with plenty of green space, community garden, playground and pool.  In addition to all of these great amenities the staff at Middleton Shores are wonderful to work with. I have been very happy living in this charming, social and fun community.  Thank you Middleton Shores!

R+N

This apartment is in a good location for commuting to downtown Madison.  It gets you away from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area but is still close enough to make the bus ride or drive in not too much of a hastle.  The complex is very quiet and provides well maintained common areas.  It has a playground for children, a small workout room and computer lab, and outdoor pool.  The staff is very friendly and helpful. And the apartments are well maintained.  In typical apartment fashion there is only an air conditioning unit in the living room which can make summers a little warm, but this is not true for all of their buildings.

The apartment complex is quiet and well maintained.  The staff are helpful and friendly.  It is within walking distance of a CVS, gas station, and a couple of restaurants, with a grocery store only a couple of blocks away. It is far enough away from the craziness of downtown Madison but still close enough that the commute isn't too horrible.

Amazing office staff - always friendly. The maintenance crew are friendly and on top of things. In Winter before I go to work the sidewalks are salted and cleared every morning! The price is amazing for the location, which also includes free cable, internet, heat and laundry! We've call this place home for the last 5 years!

I provided my personal information to be considered as a potential resident and even completed a tour, although we had to reschedule due to the unit not being a good fit. We agreed on a specific date and time for a face-to-face meeting, setting it up two weeks in advance. I drove from the east side of Madison, only to arrive and find no one there. The lights were off, and despite another individual with an appointment being present, there was no sign of staff. I attempted to reach out multiple times through calls, leaving voicemails and sending emails, but I still have not received any response.

If this is how you operate, I have serious concerns about being a resident here. It reflects a complete lack of professionalism in handling potential residents.

I throughly enjoyed the Trotta Apartments. Their apartments are modern and nicely updated with multiple common spaces. The underground parking is clean and very convenient in winters! Maintenance was always very timely and helpful, as was the management office. The location is also great for restaurants and downtown Middleton!

I love my kitchen!  I always wanted a granite counter top and I finally could afford to live somewhere with one.  The other tenants I've met so far are nice and the manager has been good work with.  Huge gym room with lots of machines, not just a treadmill.

Let me list the reasons:
1) tenant has to print their own lease for signature.
2) the poor maintenance guy runs the place.
3) the wiring in this new apartment complex is messed up. 
4) the thermostat is located near the front door of apartment, thus poor circulation of air resulting in a/c running all the time. 
5) clothes washer machine will not fill with water b/c they refuse to replace the 6’ hot/cold water lines with 4’ water lines.

apartmentName: The Edge at Cottage Grove Commons
review: We love our 2 bedroom apartment. This property has great amenities and places to walk to close by. Since they switched management, they have been extremely quick on responding to maintenance issue and seem like they really care about their renters.

We had to move here on a whim from across the country and was the only thing in our budget. SUPER outdated, and kind of gross. Paint in the bathroom was cracked all over the place, i actually painted it myself cause i was so embarrassed to even have people over. The wood counter tops in the kitchen clash so hard with the cabinets. A simple updating of these could have a lot of potential. Good location, however the neighborhood is getting sketchier by the day. Access to the bike trails was a positive, plus the garage and storage unit down below.  Overall, we couldn’t wait to move out of these. There’s far nicer apartments out there for $100 more with nicer amenities.

Living at Pirate Island Apartments over the last two years has been an amazing experience! The location is unbeatable—being on a small island gives it a peaceful, vacation-like vibe, and the updated boardwalk is such a nice touch. I love that I can drop my paddleboard in and enjoy the water whenever I want.

The landscaping is always well-maintained, making the entire community look beautiful year-round. The wildlife with the water and the quiet neighborhood brings a crane every year, I call him Old Blue. 

Maintenance is top-notch; they’re prompt, professional, and always take care of any requests quickly. The staff is friendly and helpful, making sure residents feel at home.

If you’re looking for a unique, relaxing place to live with great amenities and a well-kept environment, Pirate Island Apartments is the perfect spot. Highly recommend!
Worst management staff EVER!! They fix nothing and NEVER respond to anything valid.

This place is tidy, well managed and couldn’t be in a better location. My unit was updated last year and it’s it’s amazing. It’s a gem in the middle of Madison, I feel lucky to have found it! Many long term residents and I always feel safe. I’ve never had more responsive maintenance. You can tell it’s family owned, they care about you and the property.

I checked this place out based on other reviews. I asked management about smoking. They said they havnt allowed smoking in three years but there were a few older residents grandfathered in. I ended up seeing two one bedrooms and a studio. All of them except one were updated with new flooring and fresh paint and remodeled bathrooms. I was extremely impressed by the leasing agents knowledge and kindness. I ended up signing a lease and moving in. I’ve been here four months and I just can’t say enough good things! I have never heard a single neighbor and every time I’ve called for maintenance, this older guy who lives on the island comes over and fixes whatever I need usually that day. Everyone is so nice, I just love it here. I almost don’t even want to write this review because I don’t want more people to find out about my secret spot!!

Can't really beat the location, on the water, dead-end island, Monona neighborhood, all really great. The price is excellent for the area as well, heat included in low rent price. Old fashioned management is OK, outdoor space is in general disrepair. The not so great things include: smoking is allowed indoors so the whole place kinda smells like cigarettes, the units haven't been updated in while (maybe never), fairly thin walls and ceilings (if you know what I mean). Great place to have your grill and kayak on your porch, even your boat tied to the boardwalk for extra. I can put up with the faint to medium scent of cigarette smoke for the low price and location.

Once your lease is up they tell you to not cancel your electric and that the new tenants will take over the electric. Unfortunately that is not the case. I was still charged from MGE even though the apartment manager stated that would not happen. Now they are unresponsive to emails and phone calls to get this issue resolved. Electric bill should be on the apartment complex for miscommunication. Shady business.

This is the first Madison apartment I have lived in that is both clean, affordable, and spacious. It's slightly set apart from campus which allows the residents some quiet away from the hustle and bustle, but it is also close enough to catch a bus into the heart of Madison in less than ten minutes. Located close to restaurants, it's a really happy medium at an affordable rate. I love having my own room, and I have had only positive interactions with management so far! A wonderful apartment for students and community members alike.

Les Chateaux has the perfect mix: a quiet neighborhood feel, but less than 10 mins drive or bus ride to campus and downtown. Nestled between 2 parks - Hoyt Park is a hidden gem. Lots of natural light, very large bedrooms, and responsive management. Perfect spot for young professionals and grad/professional students

Les Chateaux is a great option in almost every way. Location is fantastic with walkable (15 mins) or short-trip shopping (5 mins). Bus stop right there. In a very good school district and big outdoor space onsite for playing plus two really great wooded parks right next door -- recommended for people with kids. (When I was there with my elementary school kid there were other kids in the complex from the same school to play with which was really great.) Lots of grad students living there too which makes for a quiet, pleasant environment. Free parking in lot or pay a little extra for a garage. Pets allowed. Coin laundry on-site. Price very reasonable for the area. No, you won't get granite countertops or fancy cabinets, and the bathrooms are circa 1980s, but  management is very responsive to calls for repairs & the apartments are big with lots of storage. I have lived in many cities and in many apartments, and Les Chateux is possibly the best location for the money I have ever seen anywhere, especially if you want both nature across the street and the ability to walk to a movie or shopping!

I love Les Chateaux! It is a super affordable and great place to live in Madison. It's super close to the hospital area, grocery stores, target, and the bus line. Surrounded by trees and close to two parks, it's a great place for singles and families alike. Free street parking is pretty hard to come by, so it's a huge plus! Whenever anything goes wrong, maintenance always fixes it quickly. It's really nice to have central air, spacious living rooms, and a great deck. All the neighbors are friendly, and the area is incredibly safe. Overall great place to live!

The mailroom is accessible to the public since there is no door/key and people walk inside the building behind other tenants. The packages are opened and stolen from time to time. The elevator doesn't have a functional fob so you will find panhandlers and homeless people in the lobby or on your floor knocking on your doors. If your dog has an accident (#1) in the garage you will be charged $100 each time. You are required to give 4 months' notice before the end of your lease and they will start the showings right away with 18-24 hrs notice, four months before your last day and the management won't accommodate the minor requests (30 min later/sooner) even though they know you work from home and have a dog. Overall, a very unhappy place to live with poor management.

There are a lot of pluses: located in the heart of downtown, this project is walkable to many restaurants and the square, the finishes are nice, the views are great. Parking is relatively easy, though its a bit tight in the garage. The one big issue is the balconies facing the lake get overrun with spiders in the summer - yes the views are great, but its a shame I cant open the door without breaking multiple webs and multiple spiders getting inside the apartment. Management washes the windows once a year, but nothing is done for the balconies, and there is no hose attachment out there to take care of it yourself.

Mgmt is compassionate and attentive. Good sound quality. I rarely hear my neighbors. Grounds are well kept. Near a lot of shopping. Would’ve given 5 stars but maintenance is understaffed and slow. Apts are new so gratefully any maintenance needed is minor.

As someone who has been living here for about 3.5 months I would say the place is nothing special. The price of rent is a little high for what you get.

As you see other reviews, the walls are thin and you will be able to hear your neighbors at night. The parking situation is terrible. Basically get home late and there is no parking. Park out in the back if there is not a spot. I saw people checking cars multiple nights back there. Not to mention the Towing price is also threw the roof. Parked in the 30 minute parking overnight because I saw people checking car doors and boom $300 because I did not want my car getting broking into. Plus cars park in handicaps, on side of street, fire lane, and in the 30 minute parking all the time and do not get towed. $75 a month for under ground parking is a lot. They could reduce the cost of that to $40 to $50 and I bet a lot of people would pay that. They could also take to the business behind them and ask about parking in their lots because they are never full and are a waste of area. The outdoors area are a bonus.

Pool is great and the grill area is nice. Workout area is small but not to shabby.

Overall, not bad but not great. Staff is wonderful but parking is a big negative for me.

Everything day I come back from work I could not find parking, THERE IS NO PARKING, that’s my issue every single day with this apartments. People Parked outside in the streets and walk all the way to the building. However that all and the building still not full yet, we live outside of Madison and must of apartment give me free indoor parking with that high price of rent we pay for this apartment.  

*And if you have visitors or so, good luck, let the park In Costco and you bring them to the building because probably they will get towing, parking only for residents and event the residents could not have one, they force you to pay $75 for indoor parking since towing company will take your car if you park in street or somewhere, I just pay $370 for towing company to get my car back. 

From now I will write a comment every time I could not find a parking.

The building is nice and people who work in the office are wonderful and helpful.

I've lived here for about 2 months and I can tell you the walls are very thin. I hear the AC unit going of my neighbors and I've complained about it and they haven't done anything about it. Don't think you'll have less noise by paying the extra fee they charge to live on the top floor because I live on the top floor and the noise is just as bad. The location is good but this isn't a place I'd recommend if you're looking for a quiet place to live.

The apartment itself is nice and modern. The amenities are wonderful and kept clean. The complex is proactive in getting the kinks sorted out with being a new building. But the sound proof in the apartments is not the best, I can hear a lot of what my neighbors do when they do anything over a regular noise level. So loud talking, slamming of doors, heavy walking, you will hear it all. Especially when they have company over I can almost hear their conversations word for word. The trash situation is a whole other issue thats getting figured out slowly. Can't put large boxes or certain items down the trash chute and recyclable chute, but the extra dumpsters that they have to put them in are either full or not in the trash area at all.

Brand new modern apartments (no carpet!) w/ awesome amenities like the fitness center, love having a washer/dryer right in my unit and a pet spa to wash my dog. My neighbors are friendly when I see them and I always feel safe. Happy to call Elevate home! 

Office staff is top notch - always friendly & responsive.

Great location, right by the bike path, lake monona and its just a 10 minute walk to the square. 

Modern design, but very comfortable and functional layout. Appliances are top of the line. Very quiet, because the walls are insulated well. Heated floors and quality of windows/insulation lead to low winter heating costs, while AC is also efficient and can easily cool all rooms.

Sure this building is expensive, but what you pay for includes the exercise/weight room and access to use the lounge for parties. Overall, it's worth the price in my opinion.

Best place ever. Great location, amazing building, friendly neighbors, and minutes away from everything. Plus, you can't beat being surrounded by farmers markets during the Summer and the fantastic penthouse community room views!

It's a beautiful place to live! The rent is pretty high for a one bedroom. The benefits of a quiet area just outside the city are great. There are some awesome amenities as well. It's a lovely community!

Management decided it was appropriate to treat our unit for cockroaches just two weeks prior to our move out without any inspection/evidence of them there. (Neighbors had cockroaches). Our building here is only a year old. They also didn't inform any other residents.

You can tell this building’s construction was rushed. Poor quality and attention to detail overall. Chipped wood trimming throughout, drywall plastering already cracking,No pool until Summer 2023. Apparently they didn’t know they would need that area for access to finish construction when folks were signing during the Summer of 2021. The manager’s partner also has a habit of not wiping down gym equipment used, even after bringing this up. The property manager at the time also did not wear a mask to the gym AND did not wipe equipment. Rather than apologizing when this was brought up, I was thanked for the reminder and encouraged to talk to them next time. LOL you shouldn’t need a reminder as a management employee. Not to mention the signs posted on the door…

Mice/rats were a problem, we found poop behind furniture and in the closet, heard them in the walls and saw them twice on the floor. My dog caught and killed one and left it for me on my couch. Fridge stopped working at least two times a month and we lost food several times. Everything in the place is as cheap as it comes and I was harassed several times for rent that I had already paid and was harassed and pressured to resign the lease. Took my entire security deposit for "cleaning." Seemingly nice landlord but 100% would not recommend and would avoid.

We lived at Longfellow Lofts for almost 4 years. Property manager Tammy and maintenance master Ziggy, made sure we were always comfortable and they answered any requests or concerns quickly, professionally, and never made us feel like we were bothering them. They always had a cheery “good morning” and “hello, how are you?” whenever they’d see us. The apartments are comfortable, beautifully maintained and there’s a floor plan for everyone. The buildings are clean everywhere, including hallways, carpeting, floors, elevators, garage and courtyard. Convenient in-unit washer and dryers, too. No quarters here!
Options for garage or courtyard parking available, as well as street parking. We loved being able to park in the garage, unload our shopping into one of the carts provided, and take it to our apartment in the elevator. Great in rain and snow!
Pet friendly? Yes! Our dogs loved visiting with Tammy, Ziggy, and Emma who assists Tammy part-time. Lots of ear scratches, hugs and treats for all the dogs who reside there. The staff has gone over and above in times of need. In an emergency or if we were running late getting home, and our dogs needed attention or to be checked on, we were able to ask the office to do that for us. They happily obliged. Buildings do not smell of pets, ever. Very clean!
We enjoyed movie day on Tuesdays, when we could go to the historical building (once Longfellow School) auditorium, and enjoy a movie with complimentary fresh popcorn, chips, candy, and water or coffee. 
Christmas time is made less hectic for the residents, as the beautifully decorated auditorium is set-up with everything you need to wrap gifts with a vast array of wrap, bags, tissue paper, bows and tags, pens, tape, and scissors. Hot cocoa and Christmas music playing to give you the warm and fuzzies. All complimentary! 
If you are looking for a place to live, you can live anywhere. BUT, if you are looking for a place to call home, you’ll find it in Longfellow Lofts under the expect management of Tammy and Ziggy. 
Great community! Great people!

Tammy and Ziggy both went well out of their way to make anything they could better, including after hours cookouts, watch parties, gift wrapping stations, and even a pet-friendly holiday card photo op! They've also gone out of their way to help my new puppy when he was in distress (after getting my permission) when I wasn't home, rather than just saying "hey your dog's loud".

I really wish that more apartment staff were like what Longfellow has... It always felt like home instead of just a rental.

I transferred to Madison from a prior work with no time to do my research and picked Longfellow Lofts for convenience since it was close to work. It was a strike of luck because we loved it here and we ended up staying for the next 4 years. 
The area is beautiful and quiet, Meriter Hospital is across the street but FYI, ambulances enter the ER trough Park St and you rarely hear a noise. Once or twice a month you may hear the  air ambulance but the heliport is in the 8th floor, so also not a big deal. 
I lived in the Historic building, it used to be a primary school (I think). They have preserved the architecture and feeling, my unit had a wall of lockers which was great for storage and I hear some units even have glass cabinets from the old chemistry labs, wall to wall blackboards etc. No 2 units are the same, mine also had a basketball hoop  There is an auditorium which is free to use for tenants. This is no small perk, I hosted many parties and movie nights and even a couple of events from my work (sits over 200 ppl). There is a professional projector with a great sound system, microphones, blue ray player, apple TV, etc. there is also a full size popcorn machine and the corn/oil/salt packets and popcorn bags are included. The Longfellow has Movie night every Tuesday for any tenant to attend, there is usually snacks and drinks available. They also have events for important games or events and occasionally there is stand up comedy shows also free for tenants. Oh and they also have gift wrapping station during holiday season!.
The building is well kept and professionally cleaned often. 
There is reading nooks in the stair rest between floors, usually very quiet. Tenants are mostly professionals, very friendly and quiet. I never had any issue with noise or any other problem. 
The place is pet friendly and the is areas for pet relief, bags and trashcans with hand sanitizer dispenser to keep things nice and clean. 
The staff is super friendly and available via text or email, they will get back to you right away. I never had an issue that would take more than a day or 2 to resolve. 
I could keep going but as you can tell, we were very happy living here during our time in Madison and we will really miss our apartment, you should check the Longfellow's out.

We absolutely loved the two years we spent at the Longfellow Lofts. We lived in the historic building, which had such unique character! Beyond the incredible building, Tammy will go above and beyond to ensure you have a great experience. It truly feels like a community and the only reason we left was because we were relocating to a different city. I would 100% recommend this apartment for your next home!

Tammy and Ziggy are always so helpful and friendly.  
They are pet friendly, too!  Great community, location, and service.  Highly recommended. Loved living here for 3 years

Tammy and the staff are wonderful and extremely helpful - which is often a rarity while renting. The buildings are clean, spacious, stylish and well maintained. Great location and pet friendly! We miss it already!
We love the location.  Between the amenities and amazing staff we have had a great rental experience!
The staff here is friendly and always quick to respond to help you. all the apartments are pretty new, comfortable and not too pricy. Would recommend

I have lived here (Phase II) since summer of 2021 and have been pleased so far with Packtenn and Northshore Rentals. The new buildings are great quality with all the amenities you would expect from a modern apartment complex. Besides the proximity to the airport (particularly the rather loud fighter jets that fly overhead during training exercises every few days) the location is relatively quiet and the walls seem well insulated (no neighbor noise). Staff has also been very pleasant to work/communicate with and have been prompt to deal with any maintenance issues. For the price and the Madison rental market at large, I believe Packtenn is a great value. In fact, the location in particular piqued my interest due to its proximity to downtown, Sun Prairie, Middleton (quick drive up and around Lake Mendota), and easy access to/from I-94/90.

Been living at this property for a year and a half now and have nothing but good things to say! From the welcoming staff in the office to the helpful and efficient maintenance crew, living here has been a pleasant experience all around. Management, along with everyone in the office, are always more than happy to assist with any issue and provide adequate information/resources. Overall I have felt  valued and part of a welcoming community.

We have lived here for 3 years and find the apartment complex generally quiet with beautiful grounds. The maintenance team is quick to respond and repaired everything to our satisfaction. The management has also answered our questions in a timely way and is trying to help develop a sense of community with monthly prizes, a nice small dog park, and two well-maintained pools.

We got caught in a bait and switch. We went in for a showing and got shown a really good looking apartment and were told the one that was available is the exact same layout. We filled out the paperwork and suddenly, oh the apartment isn't available anymore, Ha Ha, you have to pick from these other 2 now. Because we needed to move quickly we just said whatever and moved into the other apartment that was available. Biggest mistake of my life. The first night i knew i messed up. None of the windows are well insulated so the apartment was ice cold. Turn up the thermostat you say? What thermostat, the apartment manager gets to decide when they get turned on, we dont even get a thermostat in our apartment. The longer we stayed the more we found wrong with the apartment. The shower water will go from warm to burning hot randomly, our front door knob likes to fall out from time to time, and our toilet needs to be "reset" 2-3 times a day. And maintenance? I don't know if its just the apartment's policy to be cheap so the maintenance people just follow but their motto is never replace anything. Our doorknob was falling out and all they did, was put it back in, and then a few days later it started falling back off. Key doesn't work? "Oh just jiggle it a few times" they say. 
Avoid this place. Its not worth the headache.
Love this place! Marissa is so helpful and helped me with everything I needed and made it very easy.

My husband and I have pretty high standards and were staying here for 6-8 months while we searched for a home to buy...we're excited to get out of here. 
Pros: Safe: it's definitely a low income area and some of our neighbors creeped me out but we generally felt safe. Great storage: the closets and pantry are pretty huge which was really nice for a two bedroom apartment. Nice staff: the staff are relatively helpful. We needed our tub unclogged the day we moved in, which they were fast to fix. Laundry downstairs: the machines were generally functional and no one stole my clothes. Pet friendly: we required a place that was cat friendly. Rental price point was appropriate considering the amount of space in the apartment but building being exceedingly dated. 

Cons: 
Generally grimy: Although I do consider this place 'clean' it just has a gross feeling. The cabinets in the kitchen have sticky areas where something was spilled sometime in the past and the wood just looks like...it's been through years of being coated with filth. The bathroom was pretty gross when we moved in..like the staff kind of spot-cleaned it. The indoor hallways have ancient carpet which is rarely vacuumed and the walls have similar layers of grime that occasionally get painted over. There were also frequent cockroaches in the kitchen despite us leaving no food out.
Heat: You can't turn it off - it automatically comes on if the sensor believes that the apartment is too cold.
The smell of pot all the time: Our downstairs neighbors and neighbors down the hall were terrible potheads. We live a clean and healthy life and are not fans. The smell is disgusting and comes up through the floors and under the door. The staff won't do anything about it despite clear rules in the rental contract about smoking anything indoors. If you're similarly a huge waste of space in this life and want to smoke pot all day, you'll get away with it here.  
Thin walls: You can hear your neighbors arguing, coughing, throwing open the metal closet doors, holding a party for 15 screaming children...anything really.
Tiny kitchen: The kitchen is truly a tiny little hallway with old cabinets, old counters, and almost no counter space. 
Carpet in the bathroom? Yep...the carpet extends into the bathroom which is just weird and disgusting. The small area of tile in the bathroom by the tub is uneven with grout across the surface in odd areas. Obviously done by someone without access to basic youtube videos on laying tile.

Place is awful.

Will not respond to maintenance requests - maintenance staff lies about problems, and even about what they do.  Office does nothing even when they discover it themselves.

Hallways are always dirty and often smell of urine.

Will not control unruly or criminal tenants - neighbors have accosted me in the hallway asking me if my husband is home and trying to force me into their apartment or come into mine.

Landlords lie about apartment availability to try and panic tenants into extending leases.

Recently came under new ownership by a big corporation called Bender Mangement LLC and this place has taken a sharp nosedive. Rent was increased, staff randomly enters apartments without prior notice and maintenance requests either take forever or are downright ignored. When they took over, a bunch of staff and residents including myself left because of how bad it got. Country Meadows used to be a great place to live but is now showing all the signs of yet another profits over residents enterprise.

I just moved in and I wanted something close to work and I got it it's a 1 BR nice size great neighborhood great ppl not far from the mall at all 2 minute drive. Great places to dine in and out and a Cheese Factory is about to open at the mall that's life love it.

My boyfriend and I have been living here for 2 years, out of all the apartments I have had in madison this one is my favorite. The staff is very helpful and friendly and I feel a very good sense of community within the complex. Super pet friendly! Highly recommend.

I'm really looking forward to an studio or an efficiency for rent. Trying to move on from having roommates! Need my own private Space to build more character for myself being! I really think I can do it here with Country Meadows! I like the atmosphere there!

I love my apartment beautiful landscape when you enter the parking lot. Quiet no hanging out in the parking lot or the hallways.the entry door is kept closed/locked.the hallways are kept clean.the apartment is very nice and everything is working inside.the office staff is very helpful and informative .neighbors in the building are polite and friendly and getting approved for the apartment was a smooth sailing and just love where im living.

Their apartments seem to go fast and they offer a pool, two tennis courts,  services such as watering your plants when you're on vacation, feeding a pet, coin exchange for the on site laundry machines, packages can be delivered to the on site offices.

However if you are planing on moving out, they become less willing to help you and their mood towards you changes noticeably. Even if you have fixed up the apartment to leave it looking better than when you moved in and payed your rent weeks to a month ahead of when it's due?
They also have a bad habit of calling and calling you to keep confirming your move out date even after you signed the release and texted them when you are moving out.
The  harassment on their part had had left a bitter taste in my mouth and has left two of my friends rethinking looking into the place.
With all the work I have done to fix the apartment up. I hope I would have any trouble getting every penny of my  security deposit back. Time will tell.

Good luck to you if you do decide to go with them.

This by far the worse place I have ever lived!!! You can Youtube "M Block" and see for yourself the violence and disruption that goes on in these buildings. 
The office staff don't care and the worse attitudes, especially the manager.

I wish I could give this place 0 stars. This complex has been declared a public nuisance. Tenants and neighbors have had it. There have been drugs, guns, fights and stolen cars. Management is non responsive. Children aren't allowed to play on the grass. A dog was found strangled and dead in an apartment. There is little security. Do your research and don't be deceived! Especially if you aren't from the area, stay away. You will be so mad if you relocate and end up here!

I have been a resident here since October and it has been GREAT! The amenities are very convenient for us residents. The office staff is ran by very nice people that makes sure our community  is comfortable and safe. From what I have seen the staff care and work collectively as a team to insure lovely housing.

Drugs. Violence. Cops. Need I say more. It's gotten so bad they now have to have security officers on duty. Steer clear. KCG company that owns this building is in Indiana and they dont care about your safety just cashing the checks they get. Please heed my warning.

apartmentName: The Foundry - Luxury Living Forged at Gree...
review: We are so glad we rented at the Foundry.  The apartment,  the staff,  and the location were great. We walked out the front door and had fantastic restaurants and shops within walking.

apartmentName: The Foundry - Luxury Living Forged at Gree...
review: This is my second year living at the Foundry, located in the heart of Greenway Station. Not only do I enjoy the convenience and accessibility to the shops at Greenway, the bikes trails that run parallel to this residency are lovely. You are able to take them all the way to Middleton's Pheasant Branch Conservancy. As a business professional, I am fond of the quietness and privacy that the Foundry presents. Everyone from the complex Manager, Nicki to the lead maintenance personnel, Chuck are nothing short of fabulous. If you are looking for a new home, this is such a nice place to get settled into.

Don't get me wrong, these apartments look cool and there is nothing inherently wrong with them. However, there are zero amenities and this area of Verona leaves a lot to be desired. You can find cheaper apartments with better facilities in more convenient locations.

I moved to Madison in February. The administration of Lafayette were AMAZING. I was so afraid that they will be nice only till I will sign the contract ( as it happened to me in LA).
But they are amazing.
I love the atmosphere they bring into the apartment complex.
The facility is clean, nice, well organized.
All maintenance requests are fulfilled in a day!
Amazing gym, yoga studio, library room.
Hot tub, pool, sauna.
They even have a billiards and some other games.
Coffee machine in a lobby - its such a nice bonus.

The location is great and that is what has kept us here! Aside from moving in with no handles on any of the kitchen cabinets the build quality has been fine. The amenities are great when they are open and working. Management has been OK, focused more on cute games rather than fixing real issues-i.e. repeated mold in shower, random fire alarms, cold hot tub and run around answers on guest policy. The neighbors have been great, though it is a VERY dog heavy property. I wish sub-leasing were allowed as rent increased after the first year of being open, during a pandemic with all amenities closed and no reduction in rent to account for that. Guest are allowed, just not to any of the amenities that you want to use with them. The location has kept us here, the staff and price has not. I wish residents were treated like the young professionals they are and not kids in grade school.

We have lived here for five months and truly, this has been the best experience. Every question or concern has been addressed with care and detail. The apartments themselves are stunning-amazing finishes and really livable layouts, and the amenities are top-notch. 

If you are considering the Lafayette Apartments for your next home, do it!! You will not be disappointed.

Since we began talking about where wanted to move, we decided to give the Lafayette a chance, and they’ve been amazing!  They’ve been easy to work with, responsive and prompt in their follow ups. 

The property & amenities are maintained very well, clean and safe.  Our apartment is basically brand new, everything works perfectly and haven’t had any issues with anything.  

They are even thoughtful enough to have events like “root beer float day,” “joke day” with little candies and a joke, etc.  A very good atmosphere of people, trails and puppy dogs! 

Would highly recommend this property, but more so, the team itself that makes all work!

This is an amazing property and has an amazing property manager/director! The staff really do care about the residents and enjoy chatting every chance they get...which I love. I love all the amenities, from the pool, sauna, hot tub and fireplace, to the community room, gym, yoga studio, lounge areas and the library. I love that this community is pet-friendly as well. I love the layout and design of the apartment units. My friends are all wowed everytime they see the complex and my apartment. I hope to stay here a very long time.

We couldn't ask to live in a better apartment. We moved from a place down the street, that at the time seemed like a good place to live, but we soon released that the Yahara Terrace was the place we needed to move to. The amenities here are outrageously nice, the gym is large, there are large common areas, they are extremely dog and pet friendly (they do a pet of the month and give great prizes), it's clean, the neighbors are nice and the management isn't even comparable to other apartments we have lived in. Frances is the property manager and she is AMAZING!

This building is incredible beautiful and the location is perfect! The community is incredibly kind and welcoming. The staff are amazing to work with, especially Alexis! Moving here was the best decision we have made.

I leased a single bed/bath apartment at Yahara and the management staff are incredibly nice and very helpful. My apartment is beautiful and the other tenants have all been incredibly welcoming, which is amazing when moving to a new place/town.
