I have a big dog that is rapidly making friends and the parks around the apartment building are great for exploring!

The attached restaurant is also very good and the apartment gym is really convenient. 

Overall, a really great apartment complex.

Been here less that 2 years and just moved out.  There have been 3 different managers, my rent has been raised yet have been unable to use the outdoor “amenities” (grills, fire pit and even my porch) all summer due to construction,  garage lights not working,  garbage shoot broken for months , intercom not working for months and now unable to store things in my garage space forcing most of us to pay for storage....of course more money for them.  Underground parking is $75 a month. They must think it’s downtown Madison or something. The new place across the street gives a free underground parking with rental. And to add insult to injury they offer $500 off rent for a referral but keep increasing rent for people who  live here and want to renew.  That alone is bad business!  SMH!!!

The ownership recently changed hands, so hopefully they make some changes. The intercom has work for less than half of the 11 months that I’ve lived here. If the restaurant is busy you will be spending a couple minutes driving around looking for a spot. Currently there are multiple lifts in the back of the building and they are taking up eight precious parking spots for the folks that weren’t lucky enough to get an underground spot for $75/month. My email for renewed informed me they are raising rent by $55 per month. They have made no improvements to deserve more money than they are already getting. The garbage chute has been broken for weeks now, but allegedly there’s a “spending freeze” due to the ownership transition and so maintenance requests are just sitting and not being handled.
I currently live here. Views=beautiful. Apartment= Wonderful. Management/Service/Friendliness= Atrocious. My advice= Look to live to somewhere else.

I have lived at Market West Apartments almost 3 years and have truly enjoyed it. Staff is awesome and buildings and amenities are kept very clean. Apartments are spacious and modern. No noise issues, nice and quiet with respectful residents. Great Middleton location minutes from Madison with lots of walkability and shopping. Many great walking, biking and hiking trails nearby. Super safe and f
The place was clean, modern, and accommodating! Everyone there was nice and welcoming. The amenities are wonderful. I would recommend the apartment and area to everyone!

We’re not ones to leave a review usually, but feel the need to protect a sweet family like ours from moving in here... Read this if you have a baby or you would like to live in a quiet home!

We relocated to Market West due to my husband’s job promotion.. and we’re moving out as soon as we can! Yikes!

The apartments are acceptable and the staff is polite and responsive, but it is loud! Like college dorm loud!

A lot of young single college grads with dogs live here, so if partying is your thing you’d love it here. Booming speakers and howling dogs. All day. And all night. 

The walls are paper thin. We can hear conversations and flushing toilets next door. Every cabinet slam and thump from neighbors shakes our shelves. Not exaggerating. (And we lived on the top floor... don’t even want to know how bad it is to be below people!)

Forget it if you want to push a stroller through the courtyard without someone with three unleashed dogs getting way too close for comfort. Forget it if you want to put your baby down for a nap in your own home... not gonna happen. The neighbors will not stop bumping music.

We had so many frustrating, sleepless nights here.. so let me save your family. PASS on touring Market West.
Overpriced, low-quality construction & low- value, this apartment complex and its management weren't ready for primetime.
It’s an okay place but make sure you read all the hidden fees they will tack in! They will add so many Monthly fees and no matter how clean  when you move out they will charge you up the wall!.

The apartments are okay at best. All furnishings and finishes (cabinets, appliances, floors, etc.) are the cheapest of the cheap and yet they still charge an arm and a leg for rent. The HVAC systems are the absolute worst, you can't hear yourself think with how loud they are...plus the windows leak like a sieve so it turns on all the time.

Additionally, they will raise your rent every year you live there plus charge a bunch of additional monthly fees on top of the advertised price.

There are many things I like about the Springs: Dog friendly, pool access, private entrance to your apartment, and friendly staff. 
The only things that I find lacking at the Springs is in the apartment itself. Both apartments I have lived in here have pretty poor insulation. Which is really unfortunate, because I like to be earth friendly but I end up having to put the heat on way more than I'd like to. 
Other than that one issue, my experience at the Springs has been very positive.

I loved living at the springs because of its location- close to shopping, restaurants, and easy access to 151.

However, the parking is atrocious. While this complex has garages, tons of residents use it for storage and park outside. In winter when street parking isn’t available, good luck finding a parking spot. Some buildings have only 6 spots in front but obviously far more residents. (No underground parking either). You either won’t get a spot or will be walking across the community. Also if you park on the curb to carry stuff in, they’ll have your vehicle towed :) 

Also, for a property of its caliber, it’s expensive. The apartments look nice because they’re newish, but the finishes are cheap. You also lay water, sewer and trash twice because to have to pay valet trash as well as pay trash to the city. So much more expensive than other new apartments that offer the same amenities.

For those of you with dogs- the dog park is nice. The dog wash however, is closed all winter (it’s not built inside a building or in underground parking like other complexes do, so it’s unusable for 1/2 the year. Same goes for the car wash. 

For this money, I’d look at other newer properties.

We chose this apartment since it had a pool, a garage and a convenient location.  It's a good place to live but the parking is lacking.  The garage is so narrow that you can't fit a pickup truck or large SUV in it.  Most use their garages for storage and park outside.  In the nonwinter months, it's OK since many park on the street.  Once winter hits, good luck finding parking.  Zach and Dave are great in there care in keeping the pool clean and enforcing apartment rules.  We are moving since there were big rent increases, we are moving to a less expensive, new apartment.

Springs at Sun Prairie has been a transitional move for us. We left a state we had lived in for nearly 
50 years along with a large home and equally large property. To say the least it was a trying time for us. The Springs, both the staff and our new apartment, have made this transition easier. Our apartment has provided us with the space we needed for our downsized life style. The location is conveniently located for shopping, entertainment, eating venues, medical etc. All the staff have been accommodating, courteous and responsive to our needs. We would especially like to thank Meghan who from our first meeting to our completion of our lease has gone above and beyond in making us feel at home in our new community.

Not only does management do a poor job of responding/messing up your ledger but the overall set up is poor. I lived in the first floor and couldn’t even open my window due to the strong stench of animal urine. In the lease it has a “do not allow pets to urine outside of windows/entry points” but they do not reinforce it and it seems none of the pet owners cared to walk their dogs not in front of windows/patios. I had neighbors who were loud at all hours of the day/night, including one family who used the hallway as a playground for their child. The kid would literally be crying so they’d bring it to the hallway to walk and cry down the hall so the whole wing got to enjoy that. Don’t even get me started on the trash situation either. Other large apartment complexes in the Middleton area clean out their trash bins to discourage smell and insect growth, brown ridge does not. Taking your trash out in the summer is like running in and out of a smelly, hot, fly trap. If your decide to live her good luck to you but i was extremely disappointed upon moving in and extremely excited to leave. (Sidenote for a horror story, I got approval from management to have a couch shipped to the property and placed in my unit about 4 days before I moved in. I confirmed by looking through the unit that the couch was delivered then when I moved in 4 days later it magically disappeared. IMO I think one of their maintenance people stole it as management said “only maintenance would have went in to ensure the unit was ready.” So my introduction to the property was having 400$ stolen from me essentially.) Good luck if you decide to live here but I suggest you keep looking!
I’ve tried multiple times to get a hold of this apartment complex to check availability and have yet to get a response. Very disappointing because these apartments look beautiful!

seems like Goldleaf would just like you to pay for their updates. Apartment was left in great condition(nothing broken, no stains, no holes in wall... everything looked great) and yet we were unable to get our deposit back. It's unfortunate they're so greedy. Glad to be out!
Whatever you do, you have to kiss your security deposit goodbye, don't think it will be returned.

Kiss that security deposit goodbye. The property managers cleaning, wear and tear, normal use expectations are out of wack. If for some reason you do decide to take the chance , be sure you take extensive photos at move in. open cabinets and take photos of hinges, inside drawers, ect. The prices for this place vs surrounding competition does not line up, so i would just avoid the hassle
Staff are helpful and responsive. No issues after several years. Wonderful location. Quiet area. Only complaint is that there really isn't air conditioning - it is one unit. Hot in summer.

My husband and I have lived in our Goldleaf Development apartment (Hickory Point) for 3 years and have truly loved it. The apartments are nice and we have loved the loft layout and 1400 square feet of space.  We love that we can barely ever hear our neighbors from inside our apartment and, we've asked, they can't really hear us either even when the TV seems loud to us or the washing machine, dryer, and dish washer are all running.  The underground parking is fabulous, as is the storage unit down there to keep all the Christmas decorations, etc. from filling up our closet space.  The staff here is wonderful - the maintenance guys are super helpful and very quick to help with anything you need. When my baby girl was born we wanted to add a smoke detector to her room for safety - there were ones in kitchen and one upstairs already. They came in the day after I requested and put it in. That's just one example, and we don't have to call them that often, but when we do, they are timely, efficient and very helpful.  The people in the office are great too and they throw little resident appreciation events pretty much every month. We won an iPad Mini at one. It's a safe apartment complex (front door locks with buzzed entranced) that is close to Walmart, Target, Costco, Copps, Woodman's, and Aldi. It's just off 151, so it is easy to head into Madison, East to Milwaukee, South toward Janesville, or North towards the Dells, but you can't hear the highway noise at all from the apartment. We have enjoyed living here for three years and highly recommend it.

This is the apartment for you if you want the best maintenance staff. Great landscaping, lots of trees and grass. Private patio for furniture and plants. They had a appreciation day in August with lunch & dessert and a chili & dessert lunch in Sept. with 2 gift baskets giveaway. A $100 price every month for a rental renewal.
Walking distance to a super Walmart and restaurants.

I just moved in to my apartment and so far so good. The ladies in the office have been really helpful. The neighborhood is quite and convenient to all many shops. Only time will tell, but so far I am having a pleasant experience. This location is a great location for work, as I only have a 10 minute drive.

We've heard there is a less-than-great neighborhood nearby, but that this immediate area is a nice place to live, and it seems that way in our visits. After getting a tour, we signed a lease but have not yet moved in.

Amazing property managers! They have consistently impressed me with their professionalism and responsiveness before and after moving in. One of the smoothest moving processes, even with moving across the country. Hard to beat this location in the Madison area too! Feels like home.

It's like living at a 5-star hotel!  This property has a great maintenance team that is knowledgeable and very prompt at responding to any and all of my requests.   They even have 24-hour emergency after hours service and everything is taken care of swiftly.  You can tell the management cares about the property.  The property is very well taken care and maintained.  Everyone here is above and beyond!  I love living here.

When I first moved to the Madison area, I was between this building and another. I choose the later and regretted it deeply and moved to Parmenter II the moment my lease was up! I have had a spectacular experience in this building! The staff is so welcoming and accommodating, the residents are respectful and friendly and location is wonderful!
The building is well maintained and very conveniently located within walking distance to downtown and many amenities.  The staff if wonderful and quite accommodating.  This is a great place to live.

Deer Creek is a quaint community on the edge of Middleton. It's older construction, which is preferable to all of these "luxury" apartments going up everywhere that are cheaply made and often look hideous. They do a good job keeping the grounds looking nice. The units themselves are also well maintained, though most are pretty dated. Perhaps the biggest highlight of Deer Creek is the excellent staff! Very helpful and friendly. Maintenance requests are also carried out quickly (usually the next business day, in our experience). 

My biggest complaint is that they just will not leave the rent prices alone. Our rend has gone up something like $400/month over four years. Going to be priced out of the complex soon enough.

For nearly two months I've had to deal with the property management team sending someone to my unit regularly to investigate neighbor's complaints. When they need to do so, they give broad hours like 8am - 5pm (worse than Spectrum Internet). It makes it difficult to schedule meetings around and is incredibly disruptive if you have a dog. If you work from home and have the option to rent somewhere else, I would certainly recommend staying away from this place. I definitely will not be renewing.

You could not go wrong choosing to live here at Deer Creek. The onsite management team (Susie, Nick and Laurie) are the best to work with and are always so hopeful. The maintenance team is also very responsive and kind whenever needed. Great location in Middleton too!!! I have just recently moved back here after being away from the complex for 2 years and it feels like I never left. I couldn't wait to get back. It still feels like home!!!

This is a great apartment complex!  They serve families and singles cats and dogs or no pets at all.   its great value for the cost spacious apartments on a bus line with underground parking and only a half hour bus ride to downtown Madison!  Fear you are too far from the night life?  Well fear not you are just 3 blocks from greenway station shopping and dining experiences, a mile or so from downtown Middleton and its boutique shops and just a 5 minute jaunt to University Ave.  This apartment is close enough to the action but far enough away to see the stars out at night! What a great combination!  The management team is wonderful and remembers each renter by name.  They are always thoughtful and have fun activities for the renters.  So keep your eye out for an open apartment at Deer Creek Apartments, you will be glad you did!

I have and will continually recommend this apartment complex for those living in the sun Prairie area. The company went above and beyond rental expectations. Management/Whitney were easy to work with and the maintenance department consistently remedied any request in a professional and timely manner same or next day service dependent on request. Check out was a seamless process. I was able to schedule my check out with the property manager a few days in advance before my keys were due. The pool, fitness center, and grilling patios were an added bonus and we’re always well-maintained and added a sense of community. This, as well as monthly events, added to the experience and gave the place a comfortable and cozy vibe. All tenants were pleasant, easy to get along with, and from what I gathered enjoyed staying at Irongate as much as I had. Again, would highly recommend and loved my time staying at iron gate.

Kiss your security deposit goodbye. The move-out experience was terrible and painful. They treat you well when you live there but when it comes to moving out, they treat you like dirt. I took good care of my unit and cleaned 99% of it and they still charged me for things that I cleaned 100% spotless. They decided to replace blinds on my dime even though they were in perfect condition. They also decided to charge me to replace the counter tops that were in great condition and in no need of replacing. These people will do anything to take your security deposit, even if it means fabricating "damage" from thin air. Lived there for a year and it was a really nice place. Everything is pretty new. While I was living there I experienced no problems and was treated well. HOWEVER, my move out experience has irreparably tarnished the name of Goldleaf Development and I will be avoiding renting from them in the future. Disappointing.

While living in this apartment complex, my concerns and complaints mirror those who have already written reviews. Noise level seems a bit excessive, especially for an almost brand-new building (I rented from the newest building of the three). My main issue to checking out. As quoted from another review: "Make sure your move in check in list is very complete as they are eager to charge for any flaw when you move out." I would highly recommend taking photos. When moving out, there was no notice that the office would be closed and no instructions on how to proceed with checking out. Afterwards, they claimed to have found damage but their only proof is photos taken days after the check-out sheet was completed. I was told they were "too busy" to contact me or respond to my emails.
Long story short: I would only recommend this renting here if you have absolutely no other options.
Great location in Sun Prairie and only a short drive to the east side of Madison. The gym and the pool are awesome perks.

Rented a 1 bedroom for 2  years. Onsite management is very responsive to any issues. Rate building manager a 5. The hallways are not air conditioned so they are hot in the summer and moving in the summer is steamy. The exercise area is also not air conditioned. Rate common areas a 2. This is a wood framed 4 story building so sound travels between apartments. Rate noise a 3. The builders did not seem to include any sound dampening between apartments. Underground parking is great. Rate parking a 5. Underground parking is not included with all apartments, so ask. Many families with children in the building. Some issues with noisey children. Quality of appliances, carpeting and fixtures is average. Rate appliances and fixtures a 3. The good news is if the appliances fail the management will respond quickly. Make sure your move in check in list is very complete as they are eager to charge for any flaw when you move out. The bathroom drains clog up easily. Overall better than most rentals in Madison area.

I have lived here since the summer and I really like it. I live in a studio and it has a really great layout (there are a few choices for layouts on studios and they are all really nice and spacious!). I have not had to call maintenance yet so I did not give them a rating, but I have heard from neighbors that they are always really great!

I have only communicated with Corey, who is always really helpful and friendly. I believe we have a new assistant property manager, but I have not communicated with her yet. I'm sure she will be just as helpful and friendly :D

So far, the apartments seem well insulated from the cold air this winter. It is in a great location, near shopping, auto shop, gas, food, bike paths, etc.

The only thing I can really complain about are my neighbors above who stomp around (sometimes it sounds like they are jumping around) and slam their cupboards and doors without regard to others. My neighbors on both sides of me are really nice and I never hear any loud noises so I don't think it's the building that isn't sound proof. I really think it's the neighbors who are overly loud (especially since I didn't hear anything above until the end of August after having been there for over a month).

I lived in a studio with my partner and loved the space (good finish and plenty of room for two people). Location and amenities are also a plus. The only problems I had came from trying to communicate with the property manager about various things. I'm not sure if it is because I am younger and newer to the renting/subleasing process, but many of my questions were not fully answered or just completely ignored. Additionally, my car was hit twice while parked in the surface lot. No notes were left (shows who your neighbors are) and, despite being parked in front of a camera, no help could be offered by the property manager.  Again, it's a good place overall there are just some small issues that have lead me to explore other apartments in the Middleton/Madison area.

This place is incredible. Curb appeal is exactly what I was looking for and in addition to that the interior of this building is well kept and just as beautiful on the inside. The best thing about this apartment complex is that it doesn’t feel like an apartment it feels like home!!!!! The staff especially Jessica and Connie are incredibly professional and meet all your needs. I highly recommend , Cheryl

We moved here from out of state in the hopes of finding a short-term lease while we shopped for a house. Now we are starting to wonder if we even want a house! We have a 2 BR  Den apartment and it is more than enough space for two empty nesters, a dog and occasional teenage college visits. The property is beautiful and maintenance is very attentive to any needs. Overall the building is very quiet and we have no complaints about noisy neighbors. It is a very pet-friendly building. Jessica and Connie have been very helpful with any issues and even let us move in a few days early to accommodate our schedule. Out of all the apartments we looked at when moving to Madison, this is the best one we found. Great location, great staff. You can't go wrong with renting from The Masters!

Haven't lived in an apartment for almost 20 years but found myself in need of a short-term lease with virtually no notice last June. I contacted the Masters and they immediately placed me in a beautiful brand-new apartment. I was able to move in just a few days later. Jessica and Connie went out of their way to make me feel comfortable as I got settled -- and they've been super accommodating as I've finalized my long-term living arrangements. The building is beautiful. It's a great place to call home no matter where you're at in life. The grounds are beautiful with many amenities, including an outdoor pool and a fully equipped workout facility. Very accommodating for people with pets and it's a great location, super close to downtown Middleton with easy access to both east side and west side of Madison. If I could give more than 5 stars I would. Although I've been on a break from renting for many years, I was a renter for almost 15 years before that. This is by far the nicest, most well-managed apartment I've ever lived in.

I am renting at the Masters while I am in transition between selling my home and building a new home.  The apartment is beautiful and feels like home during this season of transition.  The staff is so kind and responsive to questions.  This is a beautiful neighborhood that I believe will only get better with time.

This is more than an apartment complex to me, but more so a little "retreat" away from my days long work hours. Maintenance is super speedy at fixing any issues that arise in my unit, and the grounds are kept impeccable. There are a few issues, which the staff is trying to address (mainly, the lack of parking...which for me while it's a bit annoying I would gladly take parking issues over any other issue that could be at a complex!), so it makes my voice feel heads as well. Beautiful pool, gym, and clubhouse! Only downside, while I understand that a community pool isn't the place for you're own private pool party...living alone I sometimes have 3 visitors for an evening from time to time. It's unfortunate that the "2 guests per apartment" rule applies to me even though I live alone (which most units have 2 people, so 4 at the pool). Again, this little frustration is NOTHING compared to what I have dealt with at other units in Wisconsin. Overall, I am VERY comfortable and happy to call The Masters Residence my home! :)

I love this place i been here more than a year now and renewed for another. Maintenance team is very timely and they do very good work. Management is always available and helpful. I don't think i could have found a better 1st apartment.

I’ve been here at overlook apartment community for over 5 years.  This winter of 2019 has been snowy, icy, sub-zero. Walkways always promptly clean and safe. The contracted snow removal company is very good at snow removal as well.  Maybe my only issue is with parking lot entrances and parking lots themselves. They are rough, uneven without parking strips. Entrances are pot hole-y. Over-all living at overlook is issue free. It’s always clean, and management is kind professional and prompt with any issue that might arise.  Thanks for reading my review.

Long Story Short: I had a great time living here for 3 years. I love the staff and my neighbors. I love that almost all utilities are included in the rent. Maintenance was quick and painless. Neighborhood is peaceful and pretty. Parking is great. Location is removed from the hustle and bustle of Madison. The laundry service and card is very inconvenient.

I was a college grad in 2015 looking for a place to live. I procrastinated the search, obviously. By the time I started, Overlook Pointe was the only place left. I didn't want to be taken advantage of just because I was desperate. Since then, I have felt very lucky.

The Staff - Whenever I go to the office, the reception is warm. They made an effort to remember me, even after I signed the lease.

Maintenance - Never had an issue. When I first moved in, my fridge did not keep things cold enough. The work was done the next morning. Unfortunately, the fix didn't work - so they replaced the fridge the following day! The other time was a clogged shower drain. This was my fault, but I was young and didn't understand why it was flooding. They unclogged it for me - no questions asked. It's a little thing, but it made a big impression on me.

Neighborhood - Safe. Peaceful. Lots of families with kids. The nearby Conservancy is beautiful. I recommend you hike to the top of the biggest hill there. You get a great view of Madison and the capitol. Close to Groceries, Gas, Hardware, and Food. After 9 PM, the neighborhood goes to sleep. There are a few bars nearby. There's a huge lake between you and downtown.

Ameneties - My biggest gripe is laundry. You have to use a special card which you can only add money to by walking to the special machine outside the office. If you're not in the same building as the office, that's a rough hike on a winter's night. Only 3 washers/dryers in the basement. Laundromat was quicker and cheaper. Fitness Center is nice. Never crowded. Not 24 hour, but still good. No covered parking makes winter a pain, but parking lots were always plowed. 

Utilities - Having everything included with rent was awesome. A/C is not included, so summers can get hot. But I never had to worry about heat. I figured that was more important.

First of all the place is full of kids. Everywhere you go you will encounter, and of course hear children running around. Also, people living there are very noisy. I can hear them screaming from their parking lot cars and their apartment windows. Overall, I would not move here if I were you, save your money and get a better place.

My husband and I have lived here 1.5 years and have lived in apartments in several cities over the past decade.

Positives:
The office staff is EXCELLENT. They know our names when we come in, have handled any of our concerns, and generally keep an eye on the place (they know residents' vehicles) and genuinely want this to be a nice place to live. We also like that packages are kept safely in the office instead of at our doors and the office is open until 6pm (nice if you work til 5). We only had one maintenance concern and it was handled before noon the next day. It's true that last winter there were a number of snow plowing issues, however this winter was very good. Our building is on Century, but our unit is on the back side and we do not hear road noise except for an occasional siren. We feel safe here and have never had problems with our cars or walking to/from the parking lot or fitness center at night. There is a small but nice fitness center with a few machines. We have a nicely-sized balcony and the grounds themselves are pretty and neighborhood-like with lots of trees. Their pet policy is very reasonable and they allowed both of our cats. Better yet, having cats does not put you into the "dog" building, which would have stressed out my older felines very much. There are also shorter leases available, which is great if you need something flexible.

Negatives:
The buildings are old. That said, they have made many improvements even in the short time we've been here, including our unit before we moved in. Sometimes visitors take up tenant parking spots, but most of the time we are able to park in our usual lot. There is no buffer between the hallways and units. If there is a conversation in the hallway, it might as well be in your living room. It seems better between the units themselves, however, and we don't hear footsteps upstairs. Occasionally we do hear sounds, but nothing that we haven't heard in almost every apartment we've lived in so far. For the most part, our neighbors are working professionals and young families and it's not a party zone. I like that the storage units in the basement are locked in separate rooms, but there are so many spider webs!!

Overall:
It's not the worst place we've lived, and it's not the best place. But we're comfortable here and plan to stay until we buy a home. I would never give it only one star unless I'd never lived in an apartment before. I think the rent is extremely reasonable and if I wanted something nicer, it would cost more. And like I said, the office staff is wonderful and that makes a huge difference.

We lived here for two years. The office and maintenance staff are super friendly. The area behind Century Ave is beautiful. The price is reasonable for the location (if you have a pet). Most of the apartments are updated but they are still working on updating the entire community. There is a fitness center and a play area for the kiddies. Heat is included

There are many downfalls to the apartment community. There are only three washers and dryers per building and may not always be fully operational. Also, it is way too expensive and it isn't convenient to access the laundry room. The buildings are old and it is either too hot or too cold in the winter time. And this varies depending on which unit you live in. The walls are paper thin and you will hear many noises from neighbors all around. If you live on the Century Ave side you will have a lot of road noise but if you live on the back side it's a little haven. Not everyone is considerate of their dogs and don't pick up after them. This includes the basement.

The management does what they can with what they have. If you politely inform them of any issue and are specific they are always on top of it. I've never had any problems. There is only one full time and one part-time maintenance person on staff. They contract grounds maintenance and laundry so if there's a problem there it's not because management is not doing their part. Also, the local management works for a larger corporation that owns many developments in several different locations in the nation. They are the ones that make the decisions on what major projects are done and what 3rd party companies are contracted for maintaining the grounds, etc. The local management just implements.

Overall, it is what it is. If you're looking for something with a little more luxury or service in this area you're going to pay a lot more money.

We've lived here for a year and a half and loved it. The townhomes are very nice and I love the layouts. We've also loved living in Verona and the location is so close to downtown Verona in a great, beautiful neighborhood. We've really loved the staff here as well- Olivia and Roger. They're very responsive and helpful and have made living here so easy.

The townhomes are super nice with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The property manager Olivia is friendly and works with you. The maintenance person Roger is very involved, friendly and knowledgeable. Great location within walking distance to Badger Prairie Park and a couple restaurants. Excellent place to rent from. The residents are friendly and nice.

We have had a horrible experience at MurrayGlen Townhomes & would highly suggest not renting there.  Stacy Sumwalt, the Apartment Manager will do nothing for you once she signs you up for a lease.  Garry Bunz, the Managing Member of MurrayGlen will lie right to your face.  Starting February 22nd, 2019 we noticed mold damage in our apartment.  We had to live in a hotel for several months.  During a meeting with Garry Bunz we were told all added expenses would be paid.  On June 14th, 2019 we received a check for $181.09.  That was supposed to pay for damaged furniture that was moved during the construction by their employees, higher food costs due to no kitchen for 3 of us and higher utility costs due to construction.  3 of us lived in a 1 bedroom hotel and they wanted us to also pay rent for the apartment we couldn’t live in due to the mold and construction.  We were told there were 18 apartments with mold damage due to leaking roofs.  They will also try to charge you extra for parking stalls after you get signed up.  Dogs bark nonstop through the paper thin walls.  DO NOT RENT AT MURRAYGLEN!
Very much affordable and home feeling. Great service and communication with the management and the place is always clean and kept up with.

I'll start with the units/ building itself.. everything is so up to date and screams luxury, I'm in a one bedroom and it's so spacious compared to other apartments I've lived at. Stainless steel appliances, in unit washer and dryer, GORGEOUS bathroom, and storage galore! The kitchen has never ending cabinets from floor to ceiling and perfectly designed floor plan, and wonderfully constructed walk in closets with built-ins. The area is very nice, quiet and safe; lovely neighborhood and neighbors:) located by so many great bars, eateries,  and minutes from awesome shopping at Greenway Station. Kept extra tidy from lobby to garage to hallways, this truly is a great place to live I couldn't be happier! Application process went smoothly and Alex as well as Jen, were extremely easy to work with and are very easy going folks who helped answer all of my questions along the way. Can't wait to use the huge outdoor courtyard grill in the spring and looking forward to meeting more of my new neighbors.  Definitely a 10/10 for me
Great location off the Beltline. Alex did a great job getting me settled in my new place. EV chargers on site!!!

This complex is beautiful! Alex did an amazing job helping me and my family navigate the application process. Super kind, professional, and attentive.
Everything you could ask for and more!

My wife and I are moving out of this building after four years. We have loved our time at 640 West--the property managers are responsive, the maintenance crew is awesome, and the location can't be beat. It's close enough to be walkable to both campus and the capital but is still quiet. We highly, highly recommend living here.

Great location downtown, right next to the bike path and a mile away from the heart of the city. Storage included and indoor/underground secured parking. Large one bedrooms with great fixtures and cabinets.

I had the pleasure of living at Holy Name Heights for three years, and it was an exceptional experience. The property is unique, set on 70 acres right in Madison, offering a serene and spacious environment. The location is fantastic—close to shopping, restaurants, and the highway, yet away from the hustle and bustle of traffic.

The apartments are well-maintained and feature modern amenities like granite countertops, hardwood floors, and in-unit washers and dryers. The building is tranquil, which makes it easy to get restful sleep.

One of the most remarkable aspects of Holy Name Heights is its strong sense of community. The property manager, Jim, is exceptional and always responsive to any resident's needs. The maintenance team, Tony and Alan, are fantastic and ensure that any issues are promptly and efficiently resolved. The residents, a mix of retired adults, middle-aged families, and younger couples, contribute to the friendly atmosphere. With ample visitor parking and reliable security, it's a worry-free living experience.

The amenities are top-notch, including a nice walking trail, a ¼ mile track, a workout room, a basketball court, and heated parking. The community also offers a theater lounge, sunrise lounge, and two patios, which provide plenty of spaces to relax and enjoy the surroundings.

Overall, Holy Name Heights is a hidden gem in Madison. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, quiet, and friendly place to call home. Living here has felt like being part of a welcoming and caring family. I can't recommend Holy Name Heights enough!

The property manager, Jim, is the best property manager I have ever had. The pricing is fair and the building is super cool. It sits on 70 acres right in Madison. It's really unique, I very much enjoyed living here.

You don’t have to be catholic to live here! There is a great mix of some retired adults, middle age families and younger couples. There’s plenty of parking for visitors and most people who live here are very friendly. Never had to worry about things getting stolen. I worked night shift for awhile and never had an issue getting enough sleep. There’s a nice walking trail around the perimeter of the property, ¼ mile track, workout room, basketball court, and heated parking.

Can't beat the location.  Close to shopping, restaurants, and highway.  The complex is away from hustle and bustle of traffic.  There are so many extras for the rent you pay.  There is a Church on property, basketball court, and small workout center that residents have access to.  The apartment that I am in is very clean and has plenty of space for a 1 bedroom.  When something does need fixed the property manager has taken care of it right away.  Residents are very friendly.  I have never been in a complex that is so quiet.  Don't pass up living here you will not be disappointed.  I feel blessed to be a part of Holy Name Heights.
Peaceful and beautiful place to call home. Love balcony views, property upkeep, neighbors including their pets. Thanks for organizing community events too.

I've been here about two weeks.  So far, my experience has been positive and continues to be positive. 

The property management staff has been responsive answering my questions, sharing a utility cart to move my stuff in, and just being helpful.

I love the light in my apartment and how quiet it is here. I get cranky when there's lots of noise "pollution"  from streets and traffic. I don't find that here at all.  Yay!

People here are friendly and the atmosphere is relaxed. I've spent  time down by the pool and met a number of people there; long-time residents, as well as people who have been here less than a year, and again, I' m reassured that I made the right decision coming to Glacier Valley.
The team of Katrina, Nikole, and Manuel make Glacier Valley the best place to call home. On site management cares about their residents and it shows.
Staff has been very helpful and so nice! I love our new space, and the layout of the loft is amazing! Such a cute neighborhood and love having a pool!

I have lived at Glacier Valley since May 2024. Everything has gone smoothly since move in - management, maintenance, etc. I would definitely recommend Glacier Valley to anyone looking for their next home.
The area is super quiet and the building is well maintained! The communication is great and the move in process was very smooth. Would recommend.

The office people don't seem organized.   The neighbors there are rude and loud.  Kids run wild and have no respect.  Appliances were shoddy and no painting was done before move in.  Black mold everywhere.  Hallways stink pot smell and garbage smell nauseating.   Walls and ceilings paper thin so you can hear people beating their kids.  People drag their garbage across the hall floor so you can step in the leaked juice later.  Post office/UPS hardly ever deliver to your door, always have to pick up at office.  Which is just as well due to the package thefts.  Never enough parking spots for the whole complex with no hope of expansion.  Police cruisers seem to show up at least once a month as well as fire trucks.  Units are cooled with only one weak air conditioner unit in the living room so bedrooms are boiling in the summer.  The only response that seems concerned is maintenance.   Office people just shrug off all the problems or roll their eyes.  They hate writing security deposit checks and will cite made up reasons why you won't get your money back.
Very clean and quiet,  great staff. Home like feel and great place for a single mother to raise 2 children!
I have a very short drive to work from here, my apartment is big, I have a huge closet and it is a pretty reasonable price.
I really like it here.  I like how big my place is and the new style.  The staff is very friendly and I like the people in my building!

I've lived here for 3 years and love this place. The floor plan is great with lots of space for my kids to run around. My kids love the pool. My boyfriend loves that it has a fitness center so we don't have to spend money on a membership else where. We have lots of windows for natural sunlight. We feel safe since all buildings have entry locks. Easy access to beltline, as well as a Super Walmart close by. I would recommend these community to my friends and family.

We moved into the Blackhawk Trails Apartments after searching around the Madison/Middleton area for an appropriate rental after selling our country home. We were hoping to find something that reminded us of our place in rural Iowa County. Blackhawk Trails offered just the place we hoped to find. Our third story two bedroom apartment is perfect. We love it. We have  all the room we need. The kitchen has loads of countertops and cupboards. Both bedrooms have lovely large closets. It is close to services, grocery stores and more. We enjoy the excellent management of the property that is combined with friendly folks we meet as they go about their daily business. The neighborhood surrounding the complex is quiet and close to several excellent trails, including one that is part of the Ice Age Trail which meanders throughout some beautiful Wisconsin countryside. We intend to use the pool as summer approaches. The exercise room comes in handy for long winter days that tends to keep us inside.

I’ve been living here for a while, and I have to say—it’s a great place to call home. The school district is excellent, which is a huge plus. The pool is always clean, and maintenance is super quick whenever something needs fixing.

One of my favorite things is the park right across the street—it’s perfect for a walk or just getting some fresh air. It’s also a really pet-friendly community, with no size restrictions, and despite having plenty of dogs around, it’s surprisingly quiet. The neighbors are respectful, and the overall atmosphere is really nice.

Another big plus is the management. The manager is super responsive and always helpful, which makes a huge difference.

If you’re looking for a peaceful, well-kept place in a great location, I’d definitely recommend this apartment!

Giving a review from slightly older residents . Been here going on 7 months and couldn’t be happier. From  how nice the buildings are kept to having access to a pool, workout room and  able to go for walks in a beautiful area. The other residents are so nice and it’s quiet all the time. Jessica is great! Always available if you need her. So happy we moved here.

We just signed our 3rd year lease and I am sure we'll be signing more! The property manager and maintenance staff are very friendly and quickly respond to any need. The complex is beautifully maintained. It's also located close to many stores and restaurants yet its location is quite serene. Thank you Jessica and Ervin for all you do!

Lived here for about a year and had to move due to a job out of state. But during my time this has been the most excellent place to live at. The complex and units are very luxurious. Jessica really manages the place well from administration, events, and communication, and I think thats what sets this place apart from other apartments.

The maintenance staff are also very good. I had uneven stovetop prongs due to heat warping over the years. Put a request in. Next day the prongs were all replaced with brand new ones.

Very quite and clean apartments! Pet friendly (dog and cat) and close to highways and city, but still a feeling of being away. Jessica and staff are fantastic! Never had a problem with management and BY FAR the best property management experience I have EVER had. Would HIGHLY recommend!

Marissa is an all-star BEST at Heather Downs. They have indeed raised the bar when it comes to service, and I was blown away by how much they exceeded my expectations. Marissa is an absolute gem to work with - she's on top of everything and always has a smile on her face. And the maintenance team is just as fantastic, providing top-notch service every step of the way. I can't say enough good things about them - they're hands down the best team I've ever worked with! Their dedication and commitment to delivering exceptional service are genuinely remarkable.
Very convenient location. Close to parks and grocery stores. On the bus line. Maintenance is very efficient and the landlord is very helpful and kind.

I’ve been living in HD for over 8 years and love it! Close to everything, easy transits if you ever need to use public transportation, a friendly Kwik Trip right across the street (‘where everybody knows your name’ type of vibe, really cool), and Marissa and John working the main HD office have always been easy and supportive and helpful to work with! I really like it here and will probably be here for some time.
Lots of dangerous mold here. I got very sick and I'm still sick even after moving out.
Rent went up every year, multiple mold issues, and in one of the most dangerous parts of the city. Not bad if you are desperate for the price, but don’t stick around too long.

Diane is the best property manager out there. She made it quick and easy for us to move in to Heather Downs and was willing to work with my boyfriend and me. It's a great community to live in and is close to Elver Park and right across the road from a Kwik Trip (was PDQ). We lived in a dog friendly unit and my dog was welcomed. We didn't have any issues with the neighbors and parking was easy to find and no competition for the close spots. 

It was a tough decision to move after our lease ended, but Diane was helpful with everything. We got our entire security deposit back. They didn't try to nickel and dime us for anything.

Heather Downs is definitely one of the best places I've lived at while renting and I've lived at a number of other rentals. They have really timely communication and you don't have to worry about being just another rent payer. You are part of their community and will get treated as such.
Bug Infested, Poor Quilty Staff, Tv doesn’t work, Phone has no Dial tone, No screens in the Windows

Cheap appliances, mini fridge, gross ceramic stove.  Dirty buildings.  Barking dogs.  Not sound proof.  Terrible complex manager who is rude and unfriendly.  Will keep your security deposit for no reason.  Are not nice to tenants.
Love living here!  Beautiful apartments! Fast maintenance and very responsive in general.  Nice residents. Minimal noise.

Hands down the best apartment building that I have lived in. Not only because the apartment itself is beautiful, but also because the managers and maintenance staff have always been very responsive and accommodating. One example of this was when my kitchen faucet had a small leak, so I submitted a maintenance request and the faucet was fixed that day! Also, almost all of the residents I have met have been very friendly and welcoming. There have been many instances where it almost feels like a little community where you know everyone you see around the Deco grounds. Common examples of this include taking your dog to the dog park, hanging out by the pool, or grilling out. Highly recommend!

Deco is an awesome place to live! My fiancee, 2 dogs, and I have lived here for 3 years and just renewed our lease for a 4th year. The staff is friendly, professional, and responsive. Communication is excellent. Maintenance is the most prompt I've experienced in an apartment. We haven't had to wait more than a day for a request to be handled. Our neighbors are friendly and respectful. I couldn't recommend Deco more to anyone looking for a great living experience on Madison's west side.

Deco Apartments is the best apartment I have found in the Madison area! They are the epitome of luxury apartments. The community spaces are always clean. The pool, gym, and grills on site are great. It really is a community feel between us as tenants (and no - it is not all 18 to 25 year olds). Management always goes above and beyond when I have an issue whether it be a maintenance request or a disturbance. It's easy to write a bad review - but I have spent years renting and have always had all of my issues resolved in a matter of a day once it is brought to their attention... Deco Apartments is great.

First of all let me say that the managers are very nice as well as the maintenance guy. The units are also very nice.

However the residents are completely rude and inconsiderate.  They are primarily 18 to 25-year-olds living in this complex. They blast music, over run the pool, and let their large obnoxious dogs attack you. Several times I have been in the main areas of the building where these residents let their dogs off the leash and they come running towards you and attack you. I even stepped in pee in the lobby that one of these kids refused to clean up. They will invite their drug using friends over to use the pool so you won’t ever get a chance to actually use it and enjoy it.  Or they’ll invite all of their friends who have children and let them over run the pool.  The guy above me blasts his music almost all day long. When he’s walking, he cannot be walking like a normal person-literally sounds like there’s an elephant in my place. He also feels the need to make phone calls at five or six in the morning where he screaming on the phone and it sounds like he’s in my bedroom. They leave the common areas dirty and expect other people to pick up after them.  I went to use the community room one morning and somebody had literally trashed it and left all sorts of stuff all over that I had to clean up. If you go down to the trash room they apparently don’t understand that you need to recycle and they throw stuff and pile it up all over the place. They will even throw furniture in there because they’re too lazy to take it to Goodwill. If you are essentially looking to live in an overpriced dorm, where you can’t use the pool, around a bunch of spoiled millennial brats, then this place is for you.

Cons: Since management switched hands, everything but the rent has gone downhill. First, they raised our rent (and everybody else we talked to) around $75 in 2021. Now at the beginning of 2022, they want another $85 increase. Their reasons being how the property was worth so much more, and being under sold. All they've done so far is raise the rent, and paint the doors. A huge draw for this place is the pool and hot tub. Summer of 2021 the pool opened late, and kept having to close due to the water being cloudy and gross. Hot tub never opened, and looked like a literal toilet until they just covered it up. Parking lot is full of potholes, underground parking and the elevator area are filthy, and it doesn't look like the ritzy place they seem to think it is. Looking at their prices for new renters, let me tell you, this place isn't worth it.  

Pros: No pet fee, decent but outdated workout area, nice neighborhood, great walking path and parks within waking distance.

Having lived here several years, I was at first very impressed with both the staff and fellow residents. However, as a new property manager has taken over, the quality has started going downhill. Basic maintenance is overlooked, new residents are problematic, and overall staff has become rude and disheartening. There have been several reported thefts with no assistance in security upgrades. Several upper level balconies have started to fall. The new property manager mixes up maintenance requests, in turn resulting in two of our neighbors having their apartments entered without notice. The halls are becoming dirty. The pool had continuous issues both with guests and repair. It started off a nice place but like many of JSM’s locations, they just can’t keep good staff around to keep up.

We lived at Midtown Terrace for 3 years. We are a family of four with 2 cats, and there is plenty of room in the 2 bed 2 bath and loft. The management is very responsive to any maintenance requests . The buildings are quiet and secure. We enjoyed the pool and fitness center, and occasionally community gatherings. Underground parking is great in the winter, and they always have the walks and driveways cleaned off and salted. Free cat sitting when you are away, saves money on boarding costs. 10 out of 10 would recommend!

We came to Midtown Terrace after selling our home, so we were definitely worried about adjusting back to apartment living. As it turns out, there was nothing to worry about. We have really enjoyed living at Midtown Terrace. The office and maintenance staff are great and very responsive to anything you need.  The neighborhood is quiet and there is a beautiful park and pond adjacent to the complex. The pool and fitness room are nice and well taken care of as are all of the common areas. We also love that we can reserve the clubhouse (for free) and have a bunch of our friends over to watch a game without having to have everyone in our apartment. We have even taken advantage of the free cat sitting and have come home to happy and healthy cat, it's a valuable perk if you have a kitty. I'd definitely recommend living at Midtown Terrace!

The apartments are pretty modern with a fairly open floorplan. The appliances aren't brand new, but they aren't that old either. The staff is helpful and will work with you on issues. Maintenance requests are handled promptly. The location is great, close to a target and grocery store as well as the mall and several restaurants. Tons of options within a 5-10 minute drive is great. They will also allow dogs, which is kind of difficult to find in Madison. There is a big park with a trail behind the complex that people walk their dogs on all the time. It really is a nice place to live, especially if you have pets.

I have lived here close to 2 years and it is very nice. Its a great area to have a dog and management is great. Maintenance also is helpful and prompt. The pool is a wonderful perk and makes the summer months worth the rent!

I have been living here for a little over a year and it’s amazing. The staff is incredibly nice and patient. The apartments are really great and the apartments are pretty quite as whole. I have never had a negative experience with the leasing office.

Moved out to Madison for a job, and had to find an apartment quickly. John and Katie at Timberlake Village Apts. did a wonderful job helping my family and I get the lease signed in a matter of days. You can certainly find more space for the money, but this is a solid and safe choice.

I loved how conveniently located the Timberlake Village apartments were. Close to Walmart, several grocery stores, the West Towne Mall, and the beltline highway, it's very easy to get too and from anywhere in Madison within 10-25 minutes.
I lived in 2 different apartments here across 7 years.  The apartments are spacious and great quality. We purchased the upgrade in both apartments I lived in which included bedroom ceiling fans, new appliances, new countertops, cabinets, and other improvements. 
The staff are phenomenal and very helpful. They are very personable and will go great lengths to ensure we were satisfied.
The gym and clubhouse are 2 other conveniences at Timberlake offers. We rented the clubhouse several times for birthdays or other get togethers. The workout room had a decent variety of equipment as well.

I have lived at Timber Lake Village for around 2 years now. The apartments are clean and well equipped with newly renovated appliances. The complexes are quiet and neighbors are friendly. This is situated nicely on the west side of Madison and is close to any type of shopping you may need to do. My employment situation changed and I had to relocate, but my experience throughout my tenancy has been very positive. John and Kate in the office are great and promptly respond to any concerns or maintenance requests. Would highly recommend Timber Lake Village to anyone looking for a place on the west side.

Living at Timberlake Trl is pretty good. Well kept and very communicative management. They do work hard to kept the complex looking nice as well as having monrlt events for resisdents. However I have never been at a place that enters your apartment so often. I had to take numerous days off to be home or work from home when my apartment was being entered (I am not comfortable letting strangers into my home unsupervised, regardless of who it is). In the past few months its been like every other week and were not per my request. Seriously annoying so if you value privacy in your own home this place is not for you. 

On another note the prices are high for the area and you will pay a lot for electric with only a single wall unit to heat/ cool your apartment. Although they have a very nice pay online portal.

First! I love my apartment; I love the size all of the appliances it has. I have a family of five and my three-bedroom two bath is more than spacious for us all. 

All of my neighbors are very kind helpful. In the warmer months the kids are able to go out back and play with the rest of the kids at the playground. In December we have a holiday party hosted by the property manager LJ.  

The Maintenace guy (wish I knew his name) is amazing he has always been timely and efficient. 

 I have had the pleasure of renting from LJ before the ace years ago and I had nothing but pleasant interactions with him.

I’m here with a update things started out so bad for me here but with the help of the property manager LJ things started to look up all my maintenance repairs have been Completed i thank y’all as I am handicap and needed things done appreciate all the time and effort y’all put in for me I’m praying for even greater things for the property

The location is great and the property manager has been amazing, but the amount of short cuts they took while constructing this place is baffling. They chose an internet provider from Texas whose internet goes out at least once a month with out the option to be serviced. You are unable to get your own internet. The only way to keep your patio door closed is to lock it and my bedroom door doesn't latch shut. The first month was spent without a dryer and they promised to give a laundry stipend but didn't give one. The area is noisy and active, plus they're has been a lot of kids running around the halls without supervision.

My apartment is absolutely gorgeous-Not unlike all new buildings- there have been issues.The staff has worked hard to handle issues professionally and in a timely manner.I hope to sign on again next year as I am enjoying being a part of this new community.Thank you!

This place is beautiful I feel Rushed and tricked as my place was failing apart at 1st day of moving in no repairs have been made it’s going on two months I haven’t been able to wash since I moved in  now kids are all over the place all day and night with no supervision from parents management is terrible with being consistent and fixing problems I hate it here do not move here

I have not officially moved in yet..  however, Lynn and Wendy have been AMAZING!!  The kindness they have shown to me during my transition as been absolutely fantastic!  I would recommend Wisconsin Management/ The Ace to anyone and everyone who is looking for their next home.

wonderful apartment in verona, wi - close to epic where i am currently employed. i plan to stay here until i purchase my first home. manager Hayley is all around fantastic, maintenance Jose is prompt and knowledgeable, and i have nothing but great things to say about this place. it seems there are very few openings, even in summertime, so if you are able to grab a place, you will be happy living here!

I absolutely love living at Siena Ridge Apartments. The manager, Hayley, is professional and efficient and makes this property incredible. Maintenance guys, Jose and David, are prompt and wear booties and a mask when they enter - sometime I really appreciate. They always get the small work orders I request done in a timely and professional manner. I love to walk around the neighborhood, and am just so happy with my choice. If you can find a unit when they become available make sure to jump on it - I will be here for many years.

I have lived here 3 years and love it. I love the small town feel of Verona, the cozy neighbor, the fantastic management (Hayley is the best manager, and maintenance is taken care of promptly when needed), and my one bedroom apartment is perfect for my needs. I will be renewing another year. Thank you again Siena Ridge!

Stars: 5 I Love everything about living in Siena. It is not just an apt complex, but it is a community. Everyone is friendly, and we try to help each other as necessary. The building is very well maintained inside and out. Whenever a issue arises, I email Hayley, and the matter is taken care of promptly. Preventive maintenance is done: air filters, etc. I really like that the Apt. Manager is on site 8a to 5. Hayley's Office Door is always open and she always greets you with a smile and she knows our names., she welcomes positive feedback, and issues of concern. I have lived at Siena for 6yrs., and I have no plans to move., I am very happy living at Siena. Thank You for providing us with a great place to live.

My husband and I recently sold our home and moved into a townhome at Siena Ridge. The manager, Hayley, has been a gem to work with, is so kind, and very knowledgeable with any question we asked her. We love the spacious unit, gas fireplace, and our dogs love the surround park/trails. We plan to stay a while!

Siena Ridge is a truly amazing place to call home! The complex is full of friendly people, a well maintained property and large apartments. Our 2 bedroom - 2 bathroom was so spacious with a laundry room area, open concept living/kitchen/dining area and plenty of closet spaces. Quick drive to a grocery store in downtown Verona. As well as the businesses on Mckee. The property manager, Hayley, will make you feel welcome and is always quick to handle any maintenance request. Overall a great experience!

Located just east of Madison, this apartment offers peaceful quiet living within minutes of everything in the city and surrounding towns.  With immediate access to Hwy 151 and just around the corner from the exploding Reiner Road area, you have access to shopping, theaters, great restaurants and night life, as well as several parks and outdoor activities.  You definitely get more bang for your buck in these nice large apartments with superb management.

I lived at Middleton Ridge for 3.5 years starting in 2021, the complex was excellent. I never had any issues with rowdy neighbors or noises, the on site team were a pleasure to deal with and the property was very well maintained. The only slight negative in my view is that the kitchen/bathrooms could use an upgrade but other than that I’d recommend this apartment complex without hesitation.

Although I only lived here for a short while, I thoroughly enjoyed my time here. Emily, the project manager, is very on top of things, responds very quickly and overall great at her job. I don't think a maintenance request ever took over 24 hours to complete. The location is amazing as it is right on the outskirts of Middleton, but you are only a few minutes away from Downtown Middleton and all the restaurants. I have nothing but good things to say about Middleton Ridge and would definitely recommend living here.

I'm in my 2nd lease year and I have never been happier as an apartment renter. Emily, the apartment manager, is phenomenal. Super responsive and always on top of things. Logan, the maintenance guy, is super sweet and willing to show how the simple things like the dishwasher spinny thingy go back in so I can re-set it myself. I cannot recommend the property enough!
We have lived here for about 2 years now and have loved every second of it. A quiet area but only minutes away from downtown Middleton. I could not recommend this place enough!

I lived here for 3 years and only left because of relocating for work. One of the best renting experiences I have had, absolutely loved my studio - it was the most spacious studio unit I’ve come across and an incredible value for such affordable rent! Emily, the property manager, is so attentive and helpful and Greg, the head of maintenance, was always so accommodating and friendly to my cat. This is a very pet friendly building, kept extremely clean, and located in a great neighborhood that is typically very quiet with lots of great places to walk/bike/run. Highly recommend living here and will miss my apartment so much!

I've  lived here over 3 years and moved only to be closer to work.  My 2 BR, 2 Bath, 3rd floor was spacious, quiet, convenient and beautiful. The gas corner fireplace was loved on chilly evenings. Management is responsive and pleasant. All concerns are takrn seriously and handled without delay.  Manager Emily keeps residents informed of happenings and is filled with advice of all sorts as I moved in and out.  I'm  not a pool person, but she arranged an aqua zoomba class that was fun and entertaining.   She tries to provide occasional social events (crafts, etc) that brings people together in the community room if they choose to enjoy the fellowship.   Maintenance person Greg was helpful always. A buddy to my dog, friendly and responsive to all building and resident needs.
I highly recommend the total Middleton Ridge experience!

Crooked management, avoid this place. 
Terrible experience. Horrible. Zero stars

I lived here for 3+ years. Management switched the property manager at least 4 times during my stay. I was charged for items once I vacated that were already there and documented with the first property manager. Rent went up +$350 over my residency here. Stay away.

This complex is in a great area. However there were some major issues in the 2 years that I lived here. Maintenance was not timely and often had to come back due to errors on their own part. When I moved in it was dirty and there were things that were not supposed to be there. When moving out I was charged for things that were there prior to moving in even though it was mentioned/documented. 3+ property managers in 2 years.

Zero Management zero care from them never in office ,on property , never answer phone calls cash checks late and then hit you with late fees because they aren't around to pick up a check or cashier check from one or the drop box don't have any internet portal to pay , Amenities are fake partial gym , Ac wall units are not Energy efficient expect to pay over 100 on your  E bill, heater runs on heated water which is under the floors in the units , lack of Maint ,Emergency Maintance are the heroes of this building still standing

Let me first start by saying nobody is ever in the office. We have gone through at least four people in management keep in mind we’re just now coming up on a year of being open. Sad. I have had several packages stolen. There is a locked key room on the first floor for packages connected to the office. Had somebody actually been in the office doing their job the several times my packages were stolen they would’ve been secured and locked away in a room that they were so high and mighty proud of to show. The one day management was here a couple weeks ago they put the packages outside between the garbage from and key locked package room. It seems the only time management is ever here is to type up paragraphs and put them on everybody’s door and surrounding common areas in the building. Our heat and water didn’t work for almost 3 days which they didn’t seem to be too concerned about. They changed the dog policy in the middle of my lease. Nobody answers phone calls or voicemails and if it’s emails it’s at their convenience. The garbage rooms are constantly trash disgusting and backed up. Maintenance either doesn’t know what they’re doing or management doesn’t properly tell them what they are coming to the unit for to fix. The one time management actually sent Maintenance only one of the things were fixed out of the few I requested all being essential things. It’s just sad that such a nice place really is not good to live because management as well as other residents who have lack of respect for where they live. Sad.

It’s a decent place to live and when I say decent really whoever built it is all I could give credit for. Management sucks. They have listed it on the garbage door to contact them if garbage is full which intends to be because the people who live here have no respect for the place they reside or for others who reside here. I don’t know where they say to contact them because they’re never in the office nor do they answer their phones and they hardly ever get back to you an email. Expect AT LEAST a week or two to pass before getting contacted. Like the headline states, decent place but management SUCKS.

1 of the machines in fitness room has been broken since I moved in 8 months ago.  Landlady claimed that internet was included, but I’ve spent months calling her and TDS to get it installed in my unit (and I got charged for the “free service”). Community room is frequently locked, and main entrance door is frequently broken/unlocked. Looks nice otherwise, but be aware of the false advertising

I enjoyed calling my apartment home. It was spacious and had a wonderful view, the amount of wildlife was mind blowing. Our resident manager Paula was friendly and very attentive to any needs that arose. I would definitely recommend Ridge Creek Apartments!

I lived at Ridge Creek for four years. Paula, the property manager, was fantastic! She went above and beyond to help me with every need I had during my four year stay. The entire property including my apartment when I moved in, was super clean! When I was moving out she showed me what I needed to clean better and what products to buy so I wouldn't get deductions on my security deposit. I thought that was super honest and awesome of her! I did get all my security deposit back.

Stone Creek Gardens has been a great home away from home so far! I've had great experiences with the management staff here, and the apartment was spotless upon my arrival.  They have been incredibly fast with maintenance requests, very responsive to my needs, and are also warm and friendly when you have questions.  I don't think I'll be moving any time soon unless I buy a house!

Property is 20 years old but is beginning to show it's age (hallway & common area carpets).  Units are nice, great location (Schroeder Rd is a bit noisy).  Management is a struggle:
1) press you to sign (prorate rent), even if you don't need/want till 1st of month, then next year lease starts at beginning of month you signed (11 mon lease)
2) they try to be accommodating on parking, storage closet
3) they get very rigid on rules, even when no one else is affected (rules for rules sake)
4) Facility maintenance (not unit) is slow or unresponsive. 
5) Residents are scared they'll do something and get kicked out (most are elderly and can't move easily)
Generally decent but not quite the warm, inviting, new home portrayed.

I absolutely love living here at Prairie Park Senior! I moved in this past August and Marion was so very helpful in explaining all the paperwork involved. She and Glen are always very approachable and pleasant, any issues have been resolved quickly for me.
 The fact that it's so dog friendly is one of the things that definitely matters. I've met most of the people I've come to know while we're outside walking our dogs; a good ice-breaker!
Also, it's very clean here. .I'm always proud to show my friends where I'm now living.

Prairie Park Senior is just what I need.  I moved here from out-of-state and into a sight-unseen apartment. The apartment manager was wonderful in helping me select the right apartment for me.  The building is beautiful with touches of Frank Lloyd Wright architecture and the grounds are professionally pleasing.  The balconies are very large and they look like an additional room. Building security is professional so I feel very safe living here.  Staff is very friendly and courteous.  I have found my forever home and I love it.

I retired and relocated home to Madison, from Carmel Indiana in August 2020.  The Property Manager here at Prairie Park made the application and screening process seamless and stress free.  My apartment is beautiful, light and airy, with spacious rooms.  The location is close to anything one might need.  The security locked building, underground parking and elevators provide a sense of security and ease.  Compared to many other area Senior apartments, the rent is reasonable.

I have been living at Prairie Park for Seniors for 3 months. I moved here from New Jersey and worked with the office manager prior to moving here to get all paperwork completed prior to my move. 

I love my apartment. It has good size rooms, secure building, 












close to shopping, restaurants and public transportation. Very happy to be living here!

My husband and I moved here a year ago from Florida; we no longer wanted to own a home (too much work)and wanted to be close to family.  We enjoy living here because the apartments and building are kept in good condition, the management is easy to contact and work with.  The initial paperwork was easy to process and also the subsequent renewal process this year.
The location is great we are near shopping and medical facilities. If you are a veteran we are very close to the VA hospital and clinics.
Management WILL try to illegally take your security deposit for “painting” when you move out.

I have lived here for over four years and absolutely love it. Huge unit, beautiful building, awesome neighborhood, wonderful landlord. My quality of life has been significantly impacted for the better since I moved here. I have a peaceful retreat to recharge in and enough room to host Thanksgiving dinner. The best grocery store in Madison, Metro Market, is in walking distance, and I am able to get downtown very quickly. The property manager, Paula, is exceptional at her job. She has been so helpful the few times I have needed maintenance assistance, and she is honest, ethical, and caring. If you want to be treated like your happiness is important, Aurora Pointe is the place for you!

I have lived in Rosewood Villas for almost a year now and have felt so welcome! In all the facilities I toured in Madison, WI for independent living housing, I found Rosewood Villas to be the friendliest and most active community. Before I even made up my mind to live here, everyone I met was so very friendly and inviting me to participate in their activities (and there are many to choose from here!). I started to move in on April 1st, 2021 and before I had even been here a week I became the new Librarian, set up a painting class, enjoyed coffee hour in the Community Center and had made many new friends. 
There are so many activities here that one really needs to pick and choose which ones are right for you. I now play Scrabble, Canasta, just learned Eucker, Mexican Train, Quiddler, Phase 10, Bible Study and Bingo.
And in the summertime we enjoyed Happy Hour, coffee and musical entertainment in the interior courtyard! 
This is a very active independent living community and it was a perfect fit for me. I'm very happy I discovered Rosewood Villas!
Sincerely, Joanne Zintel
A very happy and active resident!!
Park House Apartments is a decent place. It's not perfect by any means, but what place is. I like the location here too.
The apartment is very well laid out and all the appliances are in good shape. The management is prompt in fixing minor issues. I recommend this place

Overall, my experience has been very positive. The assistant building managers have been friendly and responsive. I love that I can walk to a wide variety of grocery stores, restaurants, and other retail shops, plus libraries and post offices are within short walking or drivig distances.

It's a quiet place. Close to EVERYTHING - Park and Grocery shops are nearby.
