The complex is new, clean, and super pet friendly! All the residents we met were friendly and considerate. And best of all, the units are quiet!The only sounds we ever heard were when people talk loudly walking through the halls.

The Parkhouse Apartments in Madison, WI are infested with cockroaches, flies, and spiders no matter how clean you are they will be present in your living space and will crawl over you as you sleep. You walk in and immediately are hit with a rotting stench. The hallways and indoor common areas look (and smell) like they haven't been cleaned in years. At move-in there was a maintenance person in the apartment that said I could not move in for another hour so I had to wait in my car until he was finished. Carpet was filthy and covered in stains, had to get the carpet cleaned myself. The balcony is dangerous, has rotting wood and sinks down when you step on it. Management doesn't care about you or the property as long as you pay your rent. Definitely regretting renting here but thought I would at least warn others before you think about signing a lease!

My apartment is definitely not the usual apartment, the man who built them didn't tear down land he built it how the land laid which is amazing. The new landscape makes the apartment much brighter ! My apartment itself is very spacious, feels like my second home when I'm away from my parents.

UPDATE 8/1/2017: raised our rates and now the building is a giant construction zone (they are renovating at least 20 apartments slowly), halls are dirty, building isn't being clean once a week like it was, still no roof furniture on the patio. REALLY SORRY I RENEWED HERE. gorham properties raised the rent in 2016 and now they are raising the rent for 2017 from $122 and $142 on an efficiencies, many tenants are on fixed incomes. At least 20 apartments left. Their rates on efficiencies are now equal to The Constellation, high-end apartments, which these are not. They are older in need of many upgrades, like new carpet and appliances, to even be sub Constellation quality.

This building is unique and has a great location in walking distance to entertainment, restaurants, the Capital Square, etc.  For such a reasonable price you get a gym and roof top terrace with a capital view.  Staff is always ready to help you with anything you need and they make you feel like they care about you as an individual, not just a unit number.  A great place to live!

I loved living at Harbour Town. My unit was spacious, with plenty of storage via large closets and ample cabinets. The best part of living here was the location: you can walk to Pick N Save and Target! My third floor unit had a beautiful view of UW’s agricultural field. The only reason I left was so I could adopt a cat. I can’t recommend this place enough!

The location is perfect for walking to grocery stores and biking to West side business’s for work. Also loved the in unit washer/dryer and underground parking! Would have stayed if wasn’t moving to another town.

The location is very convenient, across the street from Pick n Save, Target, etc.  The property manager Bill is very helpful, he takes care of maintenance requests promptly. There is also covered parking for no extra charge!!

Lived here for two years and only have good things to say. The buildings are well-kept and cared for. The lobbies, common areas, and halls are always clean. The apartments themselves are very spacious on the inside. The high ceilings make the rooms feel big and open. The balcony is a good size, too, with plenty of space for patio furniture. The pool and surrounding area are beautiful, always clean, and never too busy. This was a huge bonus! The property managers and maintenance staff are super friendly and always helpful. We never had to wait more than 24 hours on a maintenance request. I also love that the apartments are conveniently right across the street from the Prairie Towne shopping center but still manage to feel secluded from the traffic and volume happening around the stores. My first year here, I was lucky enough to have an apartment facing the Agricultural Research fields owned by UW. The view from my balcony was open land and colorful sunsets year-round. My second year I lived in an apartment facing the street but the trees planted between the complex and the street do a great job of separating you from traffic and made me feel like I was living in a cozy tree house! Altogether a beautiful, safe, and friendly place to live. And all this comes at a very fair price for the West side of Madison.

Harbour Town is well kept and the landlord is awesome. Prices are comparable to other unite around the area. Great views and peacefulness due to the UW fields. Great location with quick acess to the beltline and the west side of madison. Felt safe the entire time I was here. Overall a great place to live.

Harbour Town Apartments has been a wonderful home for over 5 years. With beautiful views of the UW Research fields on the west side of the building, I have enjoyed many peaceful sunset dinners from my private balcony (feeling as though I’m miles away from a city). As someone who loves walking and bike riding, I have also enjoyed being just steps away from Target, a grocery store, restaurants and a lovely neighborhood with sidewalks, a bike lane and a park (or an easy 15 min commute to downtown Madison). Both quiet and conveniently located - truly the best of both worlds! The neighbors are friendly, the hallways are kept clean and I have always felt very safe around the property. The building is brick outside, which has kept my apartment cozy and warm during the winter. The few maintenance requests I have sent over the years were all taken care of within hours, even on weekends. Bill has been very accommodating and flexible, always easy to work with. I feel very lucky that I came across Harbour Town when I first moved to Madison. Having a nice, comfortable, stress-free place to call home made my transition to a new city easier than I ever imagined.

I have lived at the Lodge since August 2020. I moved for my job at UW-Hospital. I love how convenient it is for me to get to work. It takes me about 10 minutes from the heated garage to the hospital parking lot! This is much better than my commute when I lived on the east coast. The actual apartment is very spacious, clean, and has all the amenities you would want. The neighbors are friendly but the apartment is very quiet. I appreciate this for my sleep and study schedule. The staff is very easy to work with and maintenance is very responsive when I have had simple repairs. Can’t say enough about our experience at the Lodge!

No other living place compares to The Lodge.  Everything from top notch management to great fitness facilities to beautiful golf course to gorgeous apartment living.  I have looked at comparably priced apartments in the Madison area..and nothing even comes close  to living at the Lodge!

I've been living here for a couple years now with my giant fluffy dog, and I absolutely love it!  This building is pet friendly, has an amazing location, is clean and secure, has convenient underground parking, and the lease office is super friendly!  The rooms are modern and sharp looking.  The walls are thick and I rarely hear my neighbors.  I also like that I only pay for electricity and it's pretty cheap to keep this place heated/cooled.  I just signed the lease for another year!

This review is for one of Butler Plaza's locations - Washington Plaza:

I would say this building is good to live in if you’re a student, but if you’re out in the professional world, you might want to pick somewhere else to live.

It’s pretty noisy here. I can hear all of my neighbors’ conversations when they talk at a normal volume, I can hear them sneeze, I can hear their TV, and so on. I can also hear music playing even if it’s not from the unit next to me. So when someone has a party, I can hear everything which is disturbing because it’ll go all night. Also, I can hear every time someone drops weights in the gym which is 3 floors below. And the smells in the hallway are sometimes repulsive, they often smell like marijuana. 

I would give the quality of the apartment 3 stars. The cabinets and drawers are flimsy and loud. The closet doors are also flimsy, loud, and hard to open/close. I can hear my neighbors open/close their closet doors. 

There are good things about this apartment. There is plenty of natural light. The floors and the kitchen are a good color/style. There is plenty of cabinet space. The balcony is a nice addition. The building is in a great location. Also, management is very responsive and helpful. 

When I had a maintenance issue, I submitted a request, and maintenance showed up the next day unannounced. They didn’t call me to see when I’d be home, they just showed up. They fixed the issue, but showing up unannounced feels unsafe to me.
Butler Plaza is an excellent place to live! The apartments are  nice, clean, and in a great location! Also, management is a joy to work with. I could not recommend Butter Plaza more!

One of the best parts about this property is the location - love being a few blocks away from the capitol building, near many popular restaurants, bars, coffee shops and concert venues. Management is very responsive to maintenance requests, and I appreciate all the modern renovations they have done as of late - helps up-level the living experience. Having capital fitness next door is a plus, too!
The staff is so quick to respond and super helpful, the apartment (2 bed/1 bath) is comfortable, and the building is safe and well maintained.
Butler Plaza is located downtown, just three blocks away from the Capitol. The staff is friendly and accommodating to any needs you may have.

All appliances are old and useless.  Garbage disposal retains the stink of the previous owner.  Rooms smell of smoke or rotting food in garbage disposal.  There will be bugs in your apartment: from roller beetles to spiders.  Window screens have several holes in them.

We have lived at Barrington Place 1.5 years and have had no complaints. What sold us was the amount of square footage for the price. Checked several different places in town and Barrington always came out on top. It’s safe and quiet which is a huge plus too. We have enjoyed living here thus far.
Barrington place apartments is very good place to live and good environment

Terrible experience living at Barrington for a year. My car was burglarized in the apartment's underground parking and apartment management didn't even bother to follow up with the incident report that I provided. I also got overcharged for minor damages in the apartment and was warned after the pre-inspection notice that if a sticker won't be removed, the refrigerator door will have to be replaced.

Worst apartment I've lived in. When I moved in, the place was filthy. They cleaned the carpet and some main things, but all the doors and walls were gross. I'm paying for a renovated apartment, but all the flooring is very old. Sadly, I didnt get to see the place before I signed the lease. Some of the staff are nice. Barrington is definitely not worth the price, especially with much nicer places nearby for not much more money.
I live here and I have loved every minute of it! The new staff in the office has been so helpful with my questions. My apartment is beautiful!  I recommend living here!!

Where should we start. The more you pay for. The more they like you. Free parking is slowly being taken away for those paid garages. Disabled parking is right by the street instead of by the buildings. If you live in the back..get ready to not have the walkway or steps shoveled or salted (and they’ll be the first to lie and say they were out there doing it….) They will for sure talk down to you and so condescending. After complaining you then get targeted. Always take photos and videos if you do end up here.

Lived here for what will be 2 years and will not be renewing. 

When we moved in, our toilet wasnt working and we had to no be fully moved in for another week.

A year in we found that the vents have tons of mold in them and they spread to the bathroom ceiling. Maintenance took 3 months to fix that issue, and the vents still have mold in them. 

Neighbors moved in and were nice, except for they had to move out less than a month later due to a roach infestation that wasn't taken care of before they moved in.

If it weren't for these issues, this place would be nice, but it's gotten really bad this past year. Look somewhere else.

I've lived in this building for over a year and have never had a complaint. Perfect location with proximity to shops, downtown, and campus. My only frustration is that the laundry constantly has a machine or two out of order but management is nice and will do repairs. Plus there is usually enough available machines even with the out of order ones.

I lived at Capitol Centre for 3 years and was really happy there. Great location close to campus and the Capitol, State St., and grocery store. Management was really responsive and helpful. Maintenance was speedy if I needed anything.
Loved my time here and the management is very helpful!

Just moved out to buy a new home, and I can't say how awesome it was being here after 3 years. Maintenance came quick, they supplied us with water softener, and every time we called management she was quick and super nice handling everything. Super dog friendly, and she even brought us dog treats as a parting gift. Will miss our home! Thanks Brody!

Lived there for a year and have nothing but good things to say. Management company is easy to work with and responses quickly. Cost of living is very responsible with location and space. Newly renovated and good neighbors! Neighborhood is still growing but lots to do in the area.

I’ve lived here for 2 years and loved it. Our apartment was very spacious and had no issues with neighbors. Generally pretty quiet for an apartment complex. The pool was awesome to go to and very well kept. Maintenance does a good job keeping up with requests and with general building up keep. Currently they are in the process of redoing the carpets in the main hallways and stairwells. As for the location, could not be any better. It’s 15 mins from downtown, 5-10mins from 6 grocery stores and other shopping areas, and close to many schools. I’ve always felt super safe here and would highly recommend for young professionals, families, and pet owners.

Would recommend for young professionals or people with dogs. Lots of barking all the time at this property. Management staff is good and never had an issue with them or maintenance. Never had an issue with packages like ither reviewers. Great location near the interstate. Wonderful sunset view. Love using the pool but they let other buildings outside of 5020 use it which causes it to always be busy with children and families. Parking is terrible, never enough for residents, unassigned spots which leave residents having to park down the street while guests take spots. Hallways need to be redone and many apartments smell of weed, would not recommend for those who do not want to smell this on a daily basis

I really enjoy living here and so do my kids. I love our space and the peace and quite inside my apartment home. Neighbors are respectful and everyone I’ve met or passed by are friendly, including the pets. I’ve met many residents at community events and enjoying the fire pit at night. Great atmosphere here.

Everything inside is cheap and falling apart. Maintenance takes months if they don't just forget about you completely. Management lies when it comes to re signing leases. Hallways and stairwell never get cleaned. Packages go missing from the lobby.

Although this apartment is listed as "luxury", it could not be further from that. When we moved in, the carpets in our unit reeked of urine and there were multiple yellow and brown stains in our living room and bedroom. Melissa (property manager) advised it was "coffee" that they "didn't see" when they "inspected" the unit. We had to move out for a week while our carpets had to be replaced from the previous tenant's dirtiness and did not receive any pro-rated rent. 

Management is deceitful, disorganized, and has a complete disregard for tenant safety and comfort. Please don't make the same mistake I did and find somewhere else to live!

Here’s my experience at 50Twenty,,,, first day moving in clothing and furniture got soaked by the vendor who services their fire suppression system. No follow up from management.

Incredibly poor management.

I moved here to assist a family member move out....and two weeks ago that family member was TRAPPED in the ELEVATOR! The fire department was called and they had to rescue him. 

No response from management until I called them to find out what the heck was going on...

Issues with maintenance, billing on the apartment.... not sure what Level of service one expects from their apartment management...but the service is horrendous.

Run quickly.
This place has been a wonderful place to live. I travel for work and the office staff help me out  constantly with what ever I need. They even helped me pick my apartment from across the country.
An amazing place to live for my family and my pets. They have a friendly staff and modern apartments. We would not want to live anywhere else!!

My husband and I lived at the 50Twenty for a year. I would absolutely not recommend it to anyone. The apartment itself is gorgeous, very modern with nice appliances. The apartment amenities – pool, fitness center, grills, fire pit – are great, too. At first, we were elated to be moving into such a ‘fancy’ place. We quickly realized, however, that there was nothing but disorganization under the surface. There was theft among our neighbors, with packages disappearing if left unattended. Passive aggressive notes were left in the halls directed at other neighbors, which seemed childish and inappropriate. It seems to be a revolving door of office staff, and communication was an issue. Many times, things we communicated to management fell through the cracks, including our written notice to vacate. Somehow it was missed, and we received a slap-in-the-face of an eviction notice, despite several instances of communication with regard to our moving out.
 Parking is an abomination. While each unit does have one underground parking space, the outdoor parking capacity is insufficient. There are not enough parking spaces even for residents, let alone guests, so we often had to park down the street. The first snow fall was ridiculous. Maintenance was driving around with small plows, but instead of plowing parking spots as they were vacated in the morning, each building was given a ‘time slot’ that we were all supposed to move our vehicles so that they could remove the snow from one entire building at a time. Given the already outrageous parking situation, you can imagine this was a real treat, not to mention unrealistic for those of us at work during that time.
We felt that we were taken advantage of because we keep a clean living space. I have never lived in a place where management was so intrusive. Management was in our place upwards of 12 times in the one year we lived there for several maintenance inspections, bank investor showings, and walk throughs. It was a huge inconvenience to us, because we both work daytime hours and we have a dog that had to be removed from the apartment every time they came in. When we requested not to have management use our apartment anymore, they told us that we should consider this a ‘compliment’ because we have a nice place. So inconsiderate of our requests. This place has no regard for its residents. It is strictly a business. I was disgusted with the way this place is operated, and I would not recommend the 50Twenty to anyone.

The apartments have nice finishes but they don't last too long. The parking sucks. The new building hasn't even opened yet and people are already parking out front. You can't ever park out front of your building because other people from different buildings are parked in front of yours. The walls are very thin so you can hear your neighbors inside your unit. Over half of the people located in each building are not friendly or just look at you and stare. They say it's dog friendly and you are allowed to have dogs but over half of the people in each unit are deathly afraid of dogs and will scream and run away or tell you to get their dog away from them. So in the end it is not dog friendly.
Very functional, brand new, and cozy. They are pet friendly and enthusiastic about their residents have an active lifestyle.

If you are looking out for a royal lifestyle with all amenities, this is the perfect place to stay.

5020 has all the upgraded amenities which includes state of the art gym, swimming pool, grilling area, etc.  It is very near to the most frequented places like Costco, Cinema Palace, Woodmans, etc.

Not to mention, very near to the workplace who work for American Insurance Family. 

In a nutshell, best value for your bucks :-)

We love our newly constructed apartment.  If you choose the top floor (3rd floor) corner unit you will have cathedral ceilings in the Living Room/Kitchen and both Bedrooms.  Since we moved from a house into an apartment, it's helped us deal with the less square footage.  The bedrooms both have walk in closets that double for great storage.  The unit has two full bathrooms with lots of storage.  We use the linen closet as an extra pantry for items we don't use that much.  The view is incredible!  We are facing the court yard so we can see people coming and going or just lounging around the fire and grill area.  Also if you sit in the living room at dusk we can see the sun go down and the skyline in the distance.  The under ground parking will be a blessing this winter.  Currently we are enjoying the free access to the pool & fitness center that is located on the property.

Apartments are brand new and very comfortable. 
They allow up to 2 pets per apartment and that includes dogs.  There are dog cleaning stations in the underground parking garage, which is very thoughtful.  They also have dog waste stations out on the grounds w/bags and trash cans.  
The clubhouse/pool/fitness center are all top notch.  They are really trying to encourage a community feel.  There is a central grilling station with 3 gas grills, picnic table; 4 top table... and a huge firepit.  
Management is friendly and maintenance requests have been responded to very quickly. 
It is worth a trip to come check this place out!!!

I have just recently moved into my building. I feel so at home! Everyone is friendly and the entire community feels like a resort. Like I am on vacation everyday at home. I can't wait to see all the new additions they are adding over the next year:)

I lived here for about a year and couldn't wait to get out. The property markets itself as a luxury apartment complex and the rent reflects that but the reality is that is falls short of the marketing in many areas. Yes, they have granite countertops, but only on the island, the rest are Formica. The rest of the finishes are average at best and don't hold up to the traffic or use. 

A much larger concern is SECURITY, which is dismal. The complex has had recent issues with theft to the point that the County Sheriff was involved. Even with that happening he management doesn't step up the security, in fact they prop open the security doors to the building allowing anyone to come and go as they please. If you ask me having to call in the Sherriff for a firearms theft in the complex is reason enough to move out right away but there's more. 

The management staff onsite is a revolving door of people that talk the talk but don't follow through and definitely don't walk the walk. The common areas are filthy, the garages are disgusting, and the snow removal takes forever. Parking on the comlex is tough as the construction traffic takes a lot of spots during the day. Nighttime paring is even worse as the streets are very narrow and the overload of parked cars makes it possible to meet a car coming from the other area. Professional management that follows through, understands customer service, and cares about the residents is far overdue. 

Madison has so many great places to live, it's difficult to see how this location will hold up which is very disappointing.

I've been living here since October 2015. The size of the one bedroom apartment I have is very spacious. I like it here. There are washer and dryers on each floor which is very convenient. There hasn't been any incidents since I lived here. The hallways are neat and trash anywhere. And the community room is very nice. They have Wi-Fi in the lobby. And the neighbors are friendly. This is a great place to live.   Frederick Jones
Very nice staff that are super friendly. Maintenance is usually quick. Great location
Took a tour of this place, the staff was very nice and love the location right on state street!
The staff at the apartment are very friendly and can help you with any questions. There are also many free activities to participate in the apartment, which is a great living experience.

In love with towers on state! This place might have the BEST location in downtown Madison. Right in the middle of everything, the staff has been nothing but helpful! Thank you for having such a great community here!
I’m really liking how close I am to everything on campus. Not nearly as expensive as the other high rise apartments down here!

I lost my package in the mailroom before even getting a code. I talked to staff and they were not helping me. I lost my packages multiple times now. Not just once, not just twice, but uncountable many times. I want to write this review to warn people about coming here. Towers is one of the worst apartments. With my 4 years of living here, I would say nobody is really helpful. My dishwasher is still broken in these 4 years. My ceiling is still leaking water after multiple repairs. Please run away from towers if you can.
I like this place. Though there are some problems with utilities, but I like the staffs here.

The kitchen is small with no room to prepare a meal. The bathroom drawers get stuck on their sliders. The air conditioning doesn’t work in one of the rooms in a double that I live in. The place was in a good location and had a washer and dryer in the unit. The rent continues to get higher for a mediocre place. Not worth the money!
Locations nice but gets super load at night and the apartments are older but maintenance team is super fast!

Towers on State is placed in the center of campus. It is in walking distance to all my classes and only seconds away from every store on state street. The amenities in the buildings are great and everyone who works there is helpful and nice. Highly recommend!!

I really enjoy being right on State St and not having to walk far for anything at all, including class. The staff is super nice and it's really convenient to have the management and maintenance in-house!

Towers is the best location in the city and with a secure building what more can you ask for. The gym and studies room are super useful, and they even have a secure package room. The staff is always friendly and helpful and we have 24 hour emergency maintenance.

I have been living at Towers on State for two years now. I have had a few internet issues, but the front desk has been super helpful which I really appreciate. I love the new fitness center and game room. They just added a new pool table and dart board, which is super nice right now since we can't do much with COVID. All of the study rooms have been the biggest plus since I am not ready to go sit at a coffee shop with a bunch of people without masks on.

I absolutely love living at Towers. The front desk staff is so kind and helpful, and everyone is super nice. The walking distance to campus is perfect. I work at the Memorial Union, and it is literally 5 minutes away. It is also super cool that I can see Bascom Hill from my living room!!

This is by far the WORST apartment building I've ever lived in. I have lived in 2 different apartment buildings in the Down-Town Madison area before this one. And this is my worst experience so far. When we moved in our blinds were broken and walls were really damaged and they didn't do anything about either. Don't bother filling out a maintenance request because they don't get answered to. We filled out a maintenance request about our AC because it was 87 degrees in our apartment and they said they had shut off the AC for the rest of the year and didn't tell us. It was only an "emergency" if it got over 90 degrees. Here's a list of some of the many things that are horrible with this place.
-No parking or car space out front. so moving-in is a nightmare.
-Maintenance guys came into our apartment randomly as early as 8am. Only knocked once before entering (I was in bed during one of these times)
-Wifi constantly went out for hours on end sometimes into the next day. sucks if you have online work to do.
-Neighbors partying throughout the weekdays (til 3am most times)
-Hot water shut off for days throughout the year
-Fire alarms 24/7
-No oven. They list they have a "microwave oven" but it's literally a regular microwave cause it doesn't work as an oven.
-Dust accumulation everywhere. Air quality is literally horrible.
-AC and heat get shut off during certain points of the year
-No closet in the bedrooms
-The shower is literally the tiniest thing ever
-Gym was never cleaned
This place is just straight up grimy. It's so gross and smelly and the furnishings are hideous and damaged. Please, if you are looking at this place, keep in mind there is so much better you can get for your money. I know the location on State street is nice but it's not worth all the things that go wrong within the building. It is not worth the money.

I was told this was a pet-friendly apartment however upon reading my lease (and after paying $100 for the application) it appears they do not allow pets. This is frustrating however I have an ESA letter that will enable me to bring my pets wherever. Anyways, Dion, the manager was very inconsiderate, unhelpful, and overall rude. When on the phone he never once stated his name until I asked.I received an email today stating that if I didn't sign the lease today, they would put the apartment back on the market. How on earth can I sign this lease when management has not even received or accepted my ESA documentation? When I explained to this Dion he exclaimed that "That is the least of our worries". Folks, rent is cheap because management is poor. RUN
Perfect location, neighborhood, friendly staff. Very quiet, clean and conveniently accessible to all shopping stores on the west side of Madison. Highly recommended.

I am Totally in love with Oakbridge Ct apartment, The place is gorgeous and better than the pictures.  It’s extremely modern and clean 
Grocery stores and  restaurants are so near by from this place. 
I am here from  three years and this was one of the safer buildings which includes a code to gain access. 
 Property Manager exceeded our expectations and Maintenance Requests are responded very quickly. The two bedroom apartment is so spacious for two people and When  we were expecting our little one during peak covid-June 2020 last year having no place to walk outside we managed to walk within the spacious home.
Very nice apartment, Go for it,  Just renewed our fourth year lease ??
Love this place. Wonderful management, They respond really quick for any of the maintenance requests. Very secured place. Would highly recommend to others.

Oakbridge apartment complex is a great company to work with! They are very responsive to any and all questions and make the process of renting an apartment easy. I was very impressed with the quality of the apartment and property!

Oakbridge apartment complex was a great company to work with a made the process of signing a lease easy! I was impressed with the quick response time from the staff in answering my questions and the quality of the apartment and property. I would highly recommend!

Not a good place to live PERIOD ! Management does nothing about the smell of drugs and smoke coming from other apartments even though the buildings are supposed to be smoke free, animal waste left everywhere and they advertise a heated pool and it IS NOT HEATED and the liner of the pool has needed repair for over 2 years and you can see the mold in the pool..These buildings also have no sound proofing and is very stressful to live in.

I lived at Arbor hills for 14 years. My 2 bedroom 1 bath with laundry in unit was so reasonably priced I couldn’t justify living anywhere else until we decided to buy a home. Adam the property manager is great and has been with the company since before we lived there. That longevity makes all the difference. It has a pool and gym. Maintenance issues were dealt with in a timely manner. You can’t beat it for the price, that’s for sure!

I love these apartments we had to move last minute due to the covid and had a super hard time trying to find a place in such short notice. We went from a studio to an affordable 2 bedroom with a washer and dryer, dishwasher, and sink disposal. The parking is free. There is a pool and a work out room. They are both very nice in the office and I’m happy we found a place that is nice. The maintenance team came the next day to fix a couple minor repairs. Everyone was very professional . The neighborhood is nice and super close to the highway to leave for work in the morning. The apartment are very sound proof. You can have cats. This is a great place to call home.

I lived in a renovated 2 bdrm apartment for a year and could not have been happier with my experience.  The location is perfect and you're roughly 10 minutes away from most attractions in the area.  The property management team was always very responsive to any request or question that I had.  The property is well maintained and any neighbor that I interacted with was always very friendly.

The day to day isn't bad, if you ignore the occasional gunshot. What really gets you is the nickel and diming by the management. I wasn't bothered by the state of the apartment upon move-in, but mostly because I'm not that picky. Fortunately the other tenants warned me in time to protect myself. If you rent here be prepared to play lawyer, management is after every bit of money they can get from you, especially on move out. Renovation costs are frequently pushed onto former tenants. Know your rights and protect yourself with pictures.

This place has been the bane of my existence for the last nearly three years. I can't wait for this lease to be up so we can leave. I only stayed because the apartments are cheap but it's not worth the price anymore. It never was. We moved in and the bathroom wasn't finished- we had to request someone come caulk the bathtub but whoever did it did a horrible job and now we have issues with mold management. Nobody from management seems to care- we've made several requests to have the bathroom and broken counters fixed. We also had an ant problem because of a crack in the wall that they refused to fix- we ended up having to use duct tape to patch the hole. When they came to fix the problem, they gave us ant traps and shrugged their shoulders instead of fixing the wall that was broken when we moved in. 
My favorite story to tell people about is when the sewage leaked from the apartment above (I rent in the basement in the one bedrooms- they look NOTHING like the pictures listed here, by the way) and it took them nearly two weeks to fix the problem. 
Most recently, someone puked in the hallway and it took more than a month to get someone to clean it up. They cleaned the carpet but did nothing about the puke splatter on the wall.
The community laundry machines don't work- when they finally replaced one of the broken ones (there are two and they are both broken) they up-charged on the machine and it leaves clothes sopping wet because water doesn't drain. You can always go across the street to the laundromat- but make sure your car doors are locked because of a recent uptick in car thefts and shootings. 
The locks on the doors are frequently broken- I laughed out loud when I read "controlled access" on the listing. Air conditioning is a box in the window- if you rent one of the basement apartments, note you'll have only one window that opens because the box is not removable and causes significant drafts and heating issues during the winter. You won't want to open the windows anyways, people smoke next to the windows and people are constantly screaming during domestic disputes. 

Rent here because it's cheap but I promise you deserve better.
Nice apt elevator under ground parking very fancy. The staff is great. Awesome location

I have genuinely loved living here I have had very few problems and if I have, the office staff is always super responsive and attentive. Genuinely a great place to live and easy access to all parts of Madison.

Jan 15th, 2023 I called Maintenance and asked if they could go into my apartment to check if I had possibly left my curling iron on. I had $300 worth in cash sitting on my kitchen bar stool. I would be charged $55 for the inconvenience fee which I was aware of. I came back home to see that my $300 in cash was missing. I called maintenance and asked if he knew where the money had gone. He responded that I must’ve left my door unlocked before he came in and someone else took it and that he did not take it. I said I would check my cameras (at the time I did not have any cameras inside of my apartment though if he took it he’d return it to avoid any reports made against him), I informed them of the situation and they had let me know that someone had returned $245 in cash.As I mentioned earlier the fee to be charged to have maintenance is$55,which had seemed to be already taken out of my money. They then charged me two times($55)for the inconvenience fee on the online portal. I decided not to make any police reports since the money had been returned and believe there would no longer be any issues moving forward.I indeed decided to then get a camera put into my apartment.month later my heater stopped working, I let the office know and it took them 2 months to fix my heater. During the winter. I then proceeded to get noise complaints from my apartment saying that I had been making loud noising as if I was partying until 2am. I have two jobs, one is day shift and the other is 3rd shift. From my 3rd shift I do not get home until approx 4am. I do have footage of me coming home at this time. The only time I did make loud noises was in the beginning of my lease for my birthday in August of 2022. I take full responsibility for that, after that I made sure to be more mindful & to not let it happen again. 
I decided best thing I would do for both myself and the office was to end my lease early b/c I no longer felt welcomed. My lease ended in July. I decided to leave in April. I thought leaving my tenancy there would be the end of these issues though I have been proved wrong.  May 12, 2023 i applied for a new apartment, they had gave me the worst housing reference to the property manager and sabotaged my chances of getting approved.thankfully i had four other rental references that would vouch otherwise.Overall, the office seems to be extremely shady & mendacious.And has a lot of animosity towards me which is unprofessional & staggering.

Apartment Complex smells like marijuana everyday, especially on 4th floor. Neighbors are very disrespectful and play loud music throughout the night. Neighborhood has a lot of crime and barely any guest parking. For what you pay it is not worth it. Laundry is a joke 1.50 per wash/dry and the machines are always broke

I really enjoyed my time at Granite Ridge. It feels like luxury living but at an affordable price! The kitchen was my favorite part of my place, very generous countertops and cabinet space. The floors are beautiful and easy to clean. The bathroom also has a lot of space, is beautiful and easy to get ready in. I had an apartment on the top floor, and it had a really beautiful view. I enjoyed having breakfast out on my balcony many mornings. It was also a great place to have my friends over for a good time. The third floor community room was also a nice place to chill and chat with someone too. The courtyard in the Spring and Summer is really great, gorgeous scenery, nice grilling area, and a good place for outdoor fun. Maintenance does a great job fixing issues and is good about following up to make sure things are still going well. It's right next to the police station and securely locked, so I felt really safe living there too. It was so hard to move on to my next place, I really miss my time there.

Granite Ridge is a very nice apartment building. Management really takes care of the property; they respond very quickly to any questions or maintenance issues. It is a security locked building, it's right across the street from the police station. I feel very safe, haven't had any problems.  I’m really happy living here.

apartmentName: Allen House Apartments | MARCH MADNESS SPE...
review: The heating system was not working until November 30 (12 degrees outside, no central heating, very cold inside).  The Allen House “model” unit and website are not representative of my apartment, which is filthy and worn (manager agreed but didn’t remedy).  The toilet was dirty and had not even been flushed!  When flushed, it broke and spewed water, flooded the bathroom, and soaked the living room carpet.  Toilet water drained through a large gap in the dirty bathroom floor. The unit did not have a working toilet.  There are leaks in the bathroom and mold on the bathtub, floors, carpeting, and sinks.  Carpeting is worn and stained and so dirty I had it shampooed; the extracted residue was disgusting. Kitchen appliances were covered with a thick film of grease and dried food residue and the refrigerator and freezer were dirty.  Found drug paraphernalia, used personal hygiene items, and trash scattered around the unit.  Cabinets and walls have peeling paint, scuffs, and holes.   Discovered electrical issues when a portable heater wouldn’t operate in several outlets (landlord would not supply adequate heat) and another tripped a breaker.  Heating pipes leak onto the carpet resulting in more mold.  Access to a fire door was blocked by trash and stored furniture. Unhoused people sleep in the building foyer.  Apparently no “24/7 Maintenance” as claimed on the website as most requests are ignored.  Management refused to properly repair or terminate the lease, notwithstanding numerous requests.

I lived here for 3 years and I have had nothing but good experiences. The building is quiet and kept clean. The property management is friendly and answers your questions and concerns promptly and always say hello to you. Other tenants are friendly and considerate. There is lots of great restaurants down the street which is convenient. The units are a perfect size-kitchen has good cupboard space and the bedrooms are Big.

We spent a year at Bedford Crossing and the only thing I can say good about this place is that the apartment was a good deal for the price. However living there was more of a hassle than an enjoyment. 

The main thing was the noise of the apartments. This complex must have been the cheapest built construction I have ever seen. You could hear your next door neighbors sneeze and even their cell phone vibrating on their table. You could easily hear a full conversation your next door neighbor was having. If you consider this place you must get a place on the top floor, or you will be EXTREMELY irritated by the amount of noise you hear.

As far as the complex, there are absolutely no amenities except a picnic table in the back. It would have been nice to have a little gym or something.

Our other large main concern was the security of living there. There are no cameras anywhere in the building and absolutely no staff onsite. Here were the experiences which made the security of the building a huge issue for us.

About 2 weeks after moving into Bedford Crossing multiple cars were broken into in the “secured” garage in which they charge a hefty $145 per month/per spot to rent out. I believe at least 3-5 cars had their windows smashed out and items stolen from their vehicles. A mass email was sent out which told residents basically lock their doors, don’t keep valuables in the open, and that they were going to get security cameras installed. A year later and there are still no cameras on the building.

The next issue that seemed to be an ever growing issue and one that I was personally affected by was the large amount of packages being stolen from the locked lobby. They don’t have any area or room for packages and it’s basically a free for all in the lobby with dozens of packages scattered all around. There were 2 mass emails sent to tenants within about a month timeframe stating that packages were missing and they stated that this type of behavior was unacceptable. 

Finally, about a week before we were scheduled to move out, I of course had a package stolen and notified the management team, when all I got back was a very unprofessional rude email, blaming me and stating, “I should have gone to the store to buy my item and it wouldn’t have been stolen”. I didn't even receive a "Sorry" from the company.

I lived at this location for 2 years. It served its purpose.

Pros: 
- At the time, it was cheap. Main reason I stayed 2 years. Sounds like rent has hiked significantly, though. 
- Management was very responsive and easy to work with.
- Surprisingly quiet. Neighbors were respectful, rarely heard people above me/to the sides.
- Great location

Cons: 
- This place was not cleaned prior to my moving in, which was incredibly inconvenient. 
- This place is actively falling apart. On moving in, I had to fix the kitchen drawer and the garbage disposal myself. Toilet requires several flushes (even just for TP). Drywall on the ceiling was constantly falling down, leaving lots of "sand" like material all over the place. Paired with the gross carpeting, the vacuum cleaner got a major workout. 
- Our heat did not work. At all. Maintenance was aware of the issue but it wasn't fixed. That was not a huge issue being on an upper floor, but still got chilly in the winter! Ice actually built up on the windowsills a bit.
- A/C worked, but was incredibly noisy, so be warned there. 
- We had no hot water about 50% of the time during the winter. I assume the boiler system couldn't handle both hot water and heat?
- Garage is difficult to navigate and park in. Additionally, the grade of the driveway makes it difficult to exit the garage in the winter when there is ice.
- Elevator feels like a horror movie. Tiny and very slow, also a million degrees in the summer. Door somewhat frequently gets stuck, which is spooky.
- Hallways have no emergency lights. Power went out and without any windows the hallways were pitch black. Not super safe.
- Not sure how often they clean hallways and things? Garbage scattered about, watched one receipt lay on the floor in a common space for months. Also, so many spiders/bugs in the hallways and stairwells
- Apartment is not level so none of the cupboards would stay shut? Had to add velcro.
- Paint peeling off bathroom walls made it difficult to clean. Had to sweep up paint flakes frequently.

Starting with some of the red flags I wish I would've seen when touring. 
 - Extremely poor external sound proofing. Located by a very busy street, if you get a road-facing window, you will hear every car, passing pedestrian, and utility vehicle at all hours of the day. 
 - No direct sunlight after 9AM
 - AC unit is very noisy when on. Fan by itself isn't too bad, but AC will be loud.
 - When the heater is turned on (out of your control, mind you) it will keep the room at a boiling temp. Seriously, upwards of 90F during the fall. Only way I lowered it was to stuff blankets underneath the radiator to stop air re-uptake.
 - Also when the heat is turned on, I subsequently lost hot water anywhere from 1-3 days a week. Called for maintenance, didn't do anything. Emailed the management company in October 2021 (as of writing December 2021) about it, no response since then. 
 - Oven is tilted, one heating element is broken. Refrigerator squeaks but WD-40 seems to fix it.
 - Outlets were loose, opted to just replace them myself. 
 
I will mention some of the decent aspects. 
 - Furniture and bathroom are in good condition. Decent enough storage space.
 - Parking is good price for underground.
 - The sound proofing between apartments is at least good. Rarely, if ever, hear neighbors. 
 - Your checks will certainly be cashed on time.
 
Suffice it to say, it has been a terrible living here. I really wouldn't be writing this review if I could at least have consistent hot water. If you're looking at this apartment, please consider elsewhere. The price is not worth it.
The title says it all. Whether it’s problems with ownership/management, or the old building itself.
The title says it all. Whether it’s management/ownership, or the old building itself.
The title says it all. Problems of all kinds. Whether it’s the ownership, or the old building itself.
Moved in during the summer. A lot has been updated around the complex as a whole and the studios are totally remodeled and look amazing. Happy to call this place my home.

I’ve been here for over a year and they’ve shut the water off on us 4 times already with little to no communication. The management doesn’t care about the residents here as I’ve specifically brought issues to the property manager and have been ignored. You will be constantly awoken by power tools and hammering while you live here and your rent will increase every year despite having no repairs or updates done to your apartment. Don’t live here.

The manager assured me the check out process is an honorable one. Not the case. These apartments are 65 years old yet they hold your security as if thought they are brand new. New manager here, and he definitely didn't hold up the old Manager's promise. Place is a dump. Smells and looks like an old hospital. A guy died there last year, and you can still smell it when it gets hot.

I've been here 7 years. Would be staying longer if not for a job opportunity in another state. Very affordable by Madison standards, with internet included in rent, a large storage space, and laundry room in the basement. Off street parking is nice, and is within walking distance to Willy St. Coop, Northside Farmers Market, and Warner park. If you travel a lot, it's also nice to be just a $6 cab ride to the airport and to not have to pay for parking.

This is my first year here and the staff is quite helpful! If you have any questions, they promptly respond. As well, the studios are spacious and the complex is peaceful. I would recommend to check out Londonderry Lofts that are about a 15 minutes drive from downtown Madison!
-Alea E.

I am very grateful to have found such a nice place to call home at Londonderry!  I am going on my THIRD year here and I have never been happier.  The office and maintenance staff are wonderful and always respond very quickly.  They have gone over and beyond many times and no past rentals compare to the royal treatment I receive from Northshore Rentals.  I love my studio layout and spend a lot of time in the beautiful backyard.  I feel very safe here and the free internet is an added bonus.    Thank you Londonderry for everything! Sarah Ann

LR refused to remove prior tenants items from storage for weeks. Bay windows leak cold air so bad they may as well be open in winter. Summer hot air isnt any better. Black mold was behind both toilets, including the bathroom where we never turned the shower on. It took multiple asks for them to clean it. AC drain pipe flooded and we got told to wait til after the holiday to submit a request. maintenance can be rude. They charge you to pay rent online. "Ground floor" units might require you to walk down a flight of stairs.

This apartment is just eh, the in-unit washer and dryer is a plus, but the air/ heat struggles to keep up which left the bedroom freezing in the winter time (along with extremely drafty windows). Guest parking fills up quickly and most times had to pick my guests up then bring them to the apartment. Hot water runs out quickly in the morning, so we often have to take cold showers. Positives are that it has a large balcony and there are always parking spots available, maintenance is pretty quick- the longest we waited was about 5 days once.

Black mold in the vents when I moved in. They tow guests' cars and don't have a good setup for guest parking. Appliances in unit are terrible. This place would not be worth it even it was half the(outrageously priced) rent

I haven't lived here long but I enjoy it so far.  Maintenance is difficult to get ahold of after hours (even through the after hours phone number).  Little bit smaller than I pictured (as I could not tour in person) but it ended up being the perfect size.  Community forum is a fantastic idea. Guest parking being so far away is very inconvenient. Interested to see how it is during the winter months.

I am new resident at Lincoln Ridge, and  so far my experience has been great.  The staff is so nice and caring, and went above and beyond to help me with my move!  Both Alicia and Diane have been so helpful to my needs, professional, always available when needed, and providing excellent customer service!!

Originally, we had maintenance issues that took forever to get fixed. The response rate has improved since they added new team members, but the quality of work isn't always the best.

Currently, our issue is the thin walls and drafty windows. During the winter, the second room (large bay windows) would stay considerably cooler than the rest of the apartment despite plastic wrappings. The heat would also do a poor job of heating the room.

The walls are so thin that our walls (2nd floor) shake when the upstairs neighbors walk around, although it sounds like stomping. When they play music, TV, or even talk, we can almost make out the exact words that are being said. Despite multiple complaints, the noise level has not improved. Clearly, emails from management do not hold any weight.
DO NOT RENT FROM HERE. The people that own this place will not help with anything. It’s everyone for themselves.

We have been with this landlord for going on 12 years. We have lived at these apartments for going on 6 years. Dave has been an excellent landlord to us and the property managers both past and present have been wonderful as well. It's nice to have affordable place to live as well as a great management team with it. Highly recommend!

My family has lived at Prentice Park for 6 years and we have nothing but good things to say about it. The staff is super helpful, kind, and care about their tenants - so much so that they know each of our family members by name, including the dogs! They've been quick to fix the few appliance issues we've had. The staff answers questions quickly and efficiently. We love it here!

We had a great experience at Prentice Park. We felt safe, never had any issues with neighbors, Jenni in the office is very kind and helpful. Wonderful common area amenities. The only down fall is not being able to view your apartment until after you sign your lease. But had a great year living at Prentice Park  being it was our last apartment experience before moving into our first home.

The only reason I am moving is to be closer to work. I really love this apartment. It is quiet, I almost never hear my neighbors on either side. We live downstairs and we sometimes hear our upstairs neighbors come home but that is it. When ever we have had a maintenance request our stuff gets fixed quickly, sometimes even in the same day. Jenni is a great landlord, very kind and personable. She was very accommodating when we deiced to get cats in the middle of our lease. Great location on the east side.  I've really enjoyed living here and will miss it.

Prentice park is like a home for us for last 4 years.  One of the reason for us to stay here, it is conveniently located on a Madison bus route yet quite peaceful.  The apartments are spacious, well maintained. One advantage of Prentice park is they have  private entrance which gives you your privacy as well ensure a fresh air when you open your door. I am kind of not comfortable with common apartment where there is a common lobby.  The Maintenance team is quick and get issues addressed quickly. The staff is very co-operative and provides all information and help required.  Thank you.

Although I’ve only been at Prentice Park for 6 months, i have been beyond impressed with the maintenance woman (Kat) and her ability to get things done and be easy to communicate with. I have had many discussions with the property manager (Jenni) and although there have been minor hickups here and there at my apartment, those two have been great and responsive to the needs i have. A  for sure in terms of personability for Kat, she has been amazing and willing to go above and beyond to get my girlfriends and my needs met. A specific example involved Kat going through different light bulb options with me and was even able to install a small dimmer for my kitchen light...now that is good service!

Horrible place to live! Office manager is nice but upper management is awful and doesn't care about anything. You don't get anything along with the over priced apartment either, no workout facility, no pool, no garage or underground parking (you have to pay extra).  Our electric bill is over $200 a month in the winter with hardly using the heat because the heater is a hotel style and is not energy efficient at all. And all the doors and windows leak air. You can feel a breeze by the balcony door. There are always couples screaming and fighting, drugs and needles found in the laundry room on multiple occasions, dirty panties in the stairs and vomit left in the hallway for 3 days. Yes this place seems like a good deal but don't waste your time moving here!

I've been living at Ridgewood Trails for the past 6 months. And so far it's been beyond terrible. The property management considers themselves "being helpful" by entering your locked apartment with no notice to deliver your mail. You'll almost never get your guaranteed surface parking lots, because the parking is completely unregulated and people do what they want. Plan on having your car vandalized in the parking lot as well. You can hear every single move your upstairs neighbors make, so make sure you get an apartment on the top floor. And the beer can and beer bottle lawn decorations are superb. Have fun picking those up. Oh! And don't get me started on the black mold. I love a dark, dramatic, decor, but the black mold really puts the final touch on things. And if you bring any concerns to management expect them to find a way to pass the blame back onto you. They're superb at doing so.

If you're considering renting here, don't. You'll regret it almost immediately.

Ridgewood Trails is tucked behind a beautiful scenery of trees right here in the city of Madison. Right as you leave you have businesses galore and the mall is located right behind us. The place is pet friendly with a dog park just down the road. If you're looking for a quiet, peaceful setting yet looking to be around the city Ridgewood Trails is the place to be!

Glendale has been our home for two years now. They have always been prompt with any maintenance issues. Having three levels of living space is really nice and having access to front and back is great too! We love the court yard for playing games in the summer. The neighbors are really nice and I am impressed with how quiet the townhouse is. We don't not hear any noise coming from the next door. Heating and cooling costs are well within normal too. I think they did really well with the snow removal this year. Parking can be an issue at times as it is first come first serve, but that's okay. Street parking works too! I would recommend living there to anyone.

I lived here for a bit w my family and honestly I have to say I have never had a more incompetent landlord/management service. The receptionists are nice, and the one maintenance guy was great- but it’s not enough for the property, and these people are cheap!! 
The bricks were redone when I was living there because some fell and hit a lady on the head. They took our fences down and never replaced them, tore holes in our screens, & pitches the gutters completely wrong so everything is a sheet of ice at night in the winter. The best part is I don’t even know what they fixed because a lot of the bricks still looked messed up. 
Garbage piles up in the nasty dumpsters in the parking lots- and the dumpsters take up parking spaces in the already over-crowded and dangerously damaged lots. You can easily bottom your vehicle out coming or going at first- it takes some getting used to- and don’t plan on going anywhere’s after 5pm if you want to park in the lot when you come back!!
Good luck, stay away from Glendale

My two-bedroom townhouse was the first placed I lived when I moved to Madison with my 2 cats. I really enjoyed the privacy and two entrances, and I never experienced any noise problems. The manager was very friendly and accommodating. Things that needed fixing generally got fixed, although my leaky basement window never did. I loved the central air and big living room window. I ended up moving because of the rent increase but also so I could be closer to work. I enjoyed my time here.

We recently moved from Glendale Townhomes after living there for four years to buy our first home.  We rented at Glendale even after our jobs took us to the westside of Madison because we knew we would not be able to find a better rental home anywhere else!

The management and staff at Glendale were always very responsive to our maintenance needs and requests and everything in our townhouse was always in neat and working order.  Outside maintenance was also promptly attended to and we never had the experience of being stuck in the driveway like so many other Madison residents when there was a big snow.

If we needed to rent again in Madison, we would not rent anywhere else.  We recommend Glendale Townhomes to anyone, but particularly to families and renters who would like to have a sense of community in their rental home.  Unlike other rental properties in Madison, Glendale Townhomes strives to foster a community environment!

Despite significant rent increases each year, and demands to commit to the lease coming sooner each year (is that even legal?), upkeep in Glendale is a joke. Landlord does his own maintenance with *one* assistant (who really does all of the work but it is not a one man job...not even a three man job) and it puts residents in danger. Sidewalks are badly pitched, chipped and cracked, children are constantly scraping their knees playing, and I nearly broke my ankle taking out the trash. He does his own snow removal (awful) and hardly salts (it sits in clumps). There are not enough parking spaces for residents, and it seems that the single bedroom apartments get an angry meth addict discount? The noise off of stoughton road is pretty impressive too. Don't waste your time here. Those photos are highly deceiving.

My boyfriend and our 2 fur-kids lived at Glendale for about 5 years. We enjoyed the comforts of the property and care of the staff. The grounds provided a great walking space for our dog and great views for the dog and cat with the large windows and low to the ground (2nd floor). We really liked the privacy factor that the two personal entrances and townhome feel the complex provided. We never heard our neighbors and event felt like we had a little 'front lawn' of our own! The price for the space is great too - you can't beat it on the east side of Madison! Plus right next to all major highways and intersections, and just a few miles from the East Town Mall area/restaurants. I also loved the feel of being next to Monona, which is a great, safe place to live and be social. We made some lasting friendships from our time there with one of our neighbors and even recommended another close friend to the place after we moved out! Thanks for your lovely community as a great step before we could buy our first house!

The elevator in this building was recently broken for about six months. At one point, both elevators were broken. All we heard from management was smarmy non-apologies for this massive inconvenience. The apartments are decent, although very overpriced. You'd be much better off getting a good value and a friendly manager somewhere other than here.

My wife, daughter and I have been at Arbor Crossing for 8 months and think Arbor Crossing is a great place.

Here's the details:

Location- It's central to everything, but not buried in the downtown. It's a nice walk/bike to campus, the capitol square (a.k.a. farmer's market), and State Street. The other direction... Whole foods, Target and Hilldale Shops.

Amenities- Gym... it's nice, but small. I see people in there often and it has 2 TV's to follow news or a show while you workout. Patio... is great! 2 grills and plenty of room to relax. Community room... great! It's comfortable, roomy, and has a TV to watch sports, local programming, and host events.

Underground parking- It's nice to have parking and storage underground. We really appreciated it during the winter and for the security.

Staff- Tiffany is great! She was responsive while we were looking, helpful for any concerns or repair requests and manages the many tenants very well. Jason, Stone house's trusty maintenance man, is great too. He has always been friendly, timely and considerate during repairs.

Construction. While I appreciate that Arbor Crossing is a "Green" property, I feel they skimped on building materials to save costs. The baseboards are office style vinyl which is easy to clean, but not attractive. The door frames are also very office like in appearance.

Overall, I'd recommend Arbor Crossing to anyone looking to live in a great location, with a warm vibe.

I've never had the struggles I have with Colonial Property Management/Skyview Apartments. Generally when I need to contact them with an issue they're response is "I'm not sure what else we can do," leaving me to suggest several reasonable ways they could address my issues. The first several months were much better service but lately there have been many issues.  When I first moved in, my apartment had been vacant for a month so they could make repairs and replace flooring but somehow I inherited a nasty fruit fly issue. Eventually I figured out it was due to unmaintained drains and plumbing, they cleaned and unclogged each and the fruit flies ceased. When I requested a second key to my apartment so I could leave with my petsitter, it took 3 tries to get it right. When I had a loaner car, even though I contacted them, it was towed in the middle of the night so I woke up to no car, and a $200 bill to pick up my dealerships loaner in Sun Prairie. They weren't receptive or helpful but instead blamed the tow company and accused them of lying to me about their policies. Things are often broken, repairs are always done with cheaper replacement materials and often sloppily. They've dripped paint on my furniture and belongings during maintenance several times. Pet policies are inconsistent. I have several packages stolen from the apartment building (as have neighbors) to the point that most carriers wont leave packages here anymore. They won't do anything about the issue like offering later office hours, a package delivery locker, or security camera on site. It's 2019 and you must pay a fee each month to pay your rent online. Laundry machines operate on cards that must be loaded with cash at another site but the limit is too low so it is quite inconvenient. There is little care for the property yet many rules not written in your lease and very little human-based service. The office hours are terrible and often noone is there to answer your calls or drop in questions even during those hours. Wish I could say better but as much as I've tried to work with them, they don't seem to be interested in making renting from Colonial a pleasant experience.

apartmentName: Oak Ridge at University Park Senior Apartm...
review: Such a lovely building with some incredible amenities, I really enjoy the fireplace with a lounge area to read the paper and get a cup of coffee.  The apartment is full of light and particularly like the granite countertops and the laminate wood flooring, so beautiful!

Since I had know choice but to give them some kind of stars, I gave them 1. If it was up to me I wouldn’t give them any. From the mold growing in my home, from snakes and mice getting in. Management has know sense in urgency. They take forever to fix stuff. Just horrible horrible , did I say mice and snakes getting in already ?

Parking is ridiculous,then they offer garages for 55 dollars a month and if your car gets towed be ready to drive all the way to Sun Prairie and pay $221. Tittle has to be in your name in order to get a parking sticker doesn't matter if your parents gave you a car.  
Only allowed one key per adult. They charge 50 dollars per extra key. Too much crime going on here, kids&adults fighting, gang rape back in January, drug raids, management in your apartment without proper notices, putting work orders in under your children name. Don't let this place fool you with the small business center and bingo once every month. The hallways smell awful, instead of them cleaning the carpet they put air freshners up.

This was very 1st time and it was a horrible.experience the staff who was there when I left.in 2015 is rude , the landlord is never at work , they don't care about their residents they never fix anything in the apartment , the apartments have a chance to be good but due to the management its a horrible place to live I tried to leave a.month before.my lease end and they refuse to let me.leave on good terms instead they took me to court even after.I told her I need to leave because of.my health issues I could no longer work . Horrible.place Dont rent to them go to Pheasant Ridge/Sycamore woods

The Seven Oaks Apartments could be a great place to live if the owners would take better care of the place and have actual security guards, more then one please. Only reason I moved here was because it was the only place I could afford after my father was diagnosed with cancer. When I first moved in I noticed a bunch of things, like a bullet hole on my window. Lot of things they told me was going to fixed never where fixed. They even changed management and now it even got worse, they have no care for the place and the lady in charge of the front desk is totally rude and is never on time at work and leaves 30 minutes before the closing time. This is sad because the apartment has plenty of potential. It has two pools, three laundry mats, and a playground. If I had the money to be owner I would make some changes and it is in a great location for those who work in the medical field.

newly remodeled, yes, only to cover up leaking pipes leading to the water baseboard heaters. report that you smell mildew, they respond if you can not see it (leaking), they will do nothing about it. as they are newly remodeled to cover. If you have allergies, tough luck. free internet, but not on the week ends, no internet til Monday. only been here a few months and can not wait one year to move.

My experience is this is a Bad place to live. Allow smoking, so the place is toxic 24hrs. Rude neighbors with a small dogs that bark every time you enter the building its name is Benny. The dog also bark loud at night randomly. Sign of intruders broken to my room

I have enjoyed my stay Sun Valley. The place is clean and very cozy, with plenty of parking available. The location is great: next to a Pick N' Save plaza and walking distance to restaurants, parks, Walgreens, UPS etc. Very close to the beltline and downtown. The office staff is very friendly and very prompt with service requests.

I live here for 3 years without any issues. My apartment was huge, new appliances and maintenance was reliable. During winter months walkways and driveway was cleared quickly. Would recommend living here.
Sun Valley is a great place to live. The maintenance is excellent. The location is really convenient, near by restaurants, supermarkets, banks, pharmacy and others. I highly recommend it!!!

I originally was looking to move in february 1st and now it has moved to April15th or for sure may 1st. so I am hopeful that I could call Sun Valley my new home. I work at the Great Dane so I couldnt ask for a better location and the amount of money for the rent is right in my guidelines for what I can afford. Alot of other places are so expensive and it would make it more difficult to make it paying so much for rent.
Quiet, Clean & Convenient I enjoy living at this apartment complex which is quiet, clean and convenient to Madison where I work.  There are many trails nearby and a beautiful park.

Not clean as it used to be Hi… the hallways are not vacuumed for weeks. I can see the same dirt siting on the carpet. At least in building 5216. Anyways, the same seems to be true with the entrances. Other than that it remains a nice spot to live in.

Home :) We have been living here for 9 years and it's been great! The building and common areas are well kept and clean. Jenifer, the property manager is always kind and helpful. Every possible effort is made to make life pleasant!
Maintenance  Kyle is doing a great job.  When something breaks down he is fast and efficient.
Great place to live I thoroughly enjoy my apartment home at Paragon Place.

It is a place that you can call home! It is cozy, spacious, clean, friendly... all you can ask for a luxury home. The management is outstanding and after 3 years of living here I can assure you that this place will make you happy.

I've been living in Madison for 8 years now and for the last 3 years I have been living at Scenic Ridge and it was the most pleasant experience I've ever had. Throughout my time here I have been only treated with kindness and respect. For instance, my dishwasher broke down and I contacted maintenance and they responded the same the same day. They told me that they will try their best to get me a new washer as quick as they could, yet I asked if there is anyway that they can get it to me quicker. Maintenance said they will do what they can and what do you know, 2 days later a brand new dishwasher was installed at my apartment with no charge! Another time I was contacted by management that my rent wasn't paid and I saw that I had a late fee. I realized that when I switched banks I forgot to change my autopay information for my rent payment. I contacted management and told them the story and they fully understood and waived the fee. The very next month the autopay feature didn't work and again they waived the fee. All of my fellow tenants in this apartment complex have been wonderful and we all have had a great time here. Additionally, when compared to apartments in the area you get the most out of your money as management, apartment quality, amenities, and location are all high quality, well maintained, and spectacular. Whenever my co-workers at work are looking for a place to stay I immediately mention Scenic Ridge and I will continue to do so. If you are looking for a wonderful place where you will be respected and heard this is the place for you!

I have lived at Scenic Ridge for over 5 years and I've had nothing but a great experience. The front office has treated me with nothing but respect and has been very understanding with any situations that I had during my time there. The maintenance team is quick and responsive and truly care about fixing the problem. The property is located in a very nice location as it is near a lot of shops and restaurants nearby! The amenities are good and well maintained and I especially enjoy the pool during the hot summer days! Overall,  if you are looking for a place where the apartments are high quality, spacious, and well maintained then this is the place for you!!!

I had a horrendous experience as a potential tenant just this morning. I am from out of state and wanted to look at apartments, as I will be working in the Verona area starting this summer. Three days ago, I emailed the leasing office to request for more information and I had a pretty nice exchange. I was told by email "You are more than welcome to come for a visit when you are in the area" and that their office "is open daily from 10 am – 1 pm". Again, I am not even close to the Wisconsin area, so I have a very limited time to check out apartments before having to fly back. I had mentioned in the email exchange that I will be in the area on the 11th and the 13th (today) and I thought that the email was a good sign.

Fast forward to today, I went to the address to view the apartment. When I arrived, no one was at the leasing office, so I decided to give the office a call. As soon as the phone was picked up, the person on the other side of the phone sounded agitated. I was told that I needed a 24 hour notice before a showing. I mentioned the email exchange and I was then asked how many bedroom(s) I wanted. I said that I wanted a studio or a one room apartment. She then told me snarkily that she just "got rid of" a one room apartment. What a way to phrase it. Shen then hastily said "sorry" and hung up, as if she couldn't wait to "get rid of" me. I guess she also "got rid of" a possible customer.

While I admit fault and that it made sense to schedule for a showing before the actual showing, when the email said  "You are more than welcome to come for a visit when you are in the area" and "Our office is open daily from 10 am – 1 pm", it was clearly an honest mistake. I was not even asked if I wanted to be added on a waitlist of some kind. Nothing. I intentionally planned  for this and it was for naught. Not to mention having to wait in the Wisconsin cold for nearly half an hour.

If this is how potential tenants are treated, I can't imagine how I will be treated after I sign a lease and handed over my money. Judging from this experience, the reviews of management's greed and doing anything to keep security deposits seems much closer to truth than fiction...
This place is very unprofessional. I need to have a lawyer get my security deposit back. Stay away.

I have stayed with Scenic Ridge since last spring, and have only positive things to say. The apartments are well-appointed and well-constructed, while at the same time offered at very reasonable rates for what they are. I work in Madison proper and was hesitant at first about the commute, but have grown to appreciate the fact that I have easy access to Madison without living in a loud, bustling area. Maintenance requests are handled in a timely manner, and the premises both inside and out are well-kempt. The entire staff is exceptionally pleasant and responsive. Residents are mostly young professionals, and living here is quiet but not desolate.
