We have lived at Scenic Ridge Apartments for almost 1 year. We moved in when the building was brand new, so everything is in great shape. The apartment is also very quiet. Maintenance is quick to respond if something comes up. Management is on site, so they are readily accessible. The location is great, bicycle trail is very close, we love the small town, yet close to Madison, access to highway 151 is very quick. Plus if your apartment faces the west as ours does the sunsets are great!

Garage door is broken all the time, exposing your vehicle to theft. Management does not communicate with tenants and is negligent to tenant requests for repairs. Thin walls and doors make for loud environment, even living at the end of the hallway. Wonderful location, it's a shame it isn't managed.

I've lived at Middleton Station for about a year and a half. Several great restaurants and shops in downtown Middleton are within walking distance. My apartment is comfortable, the appliances are nice, and I almost never hear neighbors. Underground parking is a plus. The staff is professional, too.

Justin and the workers/maintenance workers are extremely helpful. Covid times didn’t slow down their attentiveness or helpfulness when needed for a few things. As to the property, it’s in a fantastic area being right next to Capitol Brewery and the Middleton downtown area.

I love living at Middleton Station. It's close to historic downtown Middleton, to Greenway Station, and to the Beltline entrance, but it's also quiet and feels out of the way. The apartments are spacious and sunny, and the building is clean and well maintained. The style and details here are stylish and upscale. We have an indoor parking space, and outdoor street parking is never a problem. The building feels safe and secure, and I like that it's pet-friendly for my small dog. I  highly recommend Middleton Station apartments!
The apartment is great, all new appliances, and love the space.   In a great location, walking paths all around, and close to some great restaurants and take outs.  Really like living here!

I love this apartment! Any requests we’ve had for maintenance have been completed either same day or the following day. The places are clean, well-kept, and comfortable. We were originally worried about the train tracks, but actually we can’t hear it when windows are closed! There’s an exercise room, a conference room, a parking garage, and a wonderful rooftop with a grill and plenty of seating. We also appreciate during this time that they’ve respected mask-wearing and keep safety at the top of their priorities list.

Last October they gave out free stuff to anyone who left a 5 star review which is why Oct 2021 has so many fake 5 stars You can spend 30 hours cleaning and make everything spotless and they will still take all your money. It's a great apartment to live in as long as you are willing to pay a $600 deposit you will never see again. They will make up stains that are not there or charge you for stains the previous renters made and ignore your move in report you fill out.

I applied to live here and was told there were no other applications for the apartment so mine would have first choice. I was told I’d hear back in three days. After a week I was told I’d hear back in a few more days. This went on a few more times, each time I contacted them. Finally after 3 weeks I was told the apartment was rented. When I mentioned that I was told no one has applied, they let me know there was a “mix-up”. I can’t speak to how living here is, but my experience seemed dodgy at best.

We have lived at Prairie Crest for a couple of weeks now. We moved in with only a brief virtual walkthrough but we have been happy with our choice! Ian, the property manager, has been a delight to work with and has been ready to help us with anything! The room, and the whole complex, seem to be kept up really well.  The carpets are probably the nicest carpets we have seen in an apartment and we love the massive closets. We do live right above the garage (I’m sure most other people don’t) and sometimes that wakes us up early in the morning and the walls are easy to mark up but not easy to clean. We had a suitcase scuff up a wall and as we were trying to wipe it off, the paint came along with it. Besides that, we would recommend this complex to anyone and we look forward to our time here!
Love it here. Nice apt with plenty of storage and very quiet. The pool is awesome. Staff is very nice. I have been here, soon 7 years

My roommate and I love living here. The apartment is spacious and gets lots of light! Maintenance is super quick to fix things if there are ever any problems. It’s a great location too! Ver close to the grocery store, gas station, coffee shops and parks. Overall, we have loved our experience here!

We recently leased a one bedroom one bathroom apartment an my husband and I couldn't be happier. The apartment is just the right size for the two of us, it's comfortable and big enough to entertain two couples at the same time without hovering over each other. We are truly happy we rented at Prairie Crest.

Please live anywhere else. The alarm system issue is still happening. The fire alarm system will  go off at random times ( usually in the middle of the night) You’ll find this in other reviews here. They haven’t fixed it. After more than 5 YEARS THEY HAVE NOT FIXED IT.  I was woken up in the middle of the night again just yesterday to the shrieking fire alarm system. It’s in every bedroom and all throughout the building. The kids get sick of it pretty quick. This has happened multiple times in the past 3 years I’ve been here ( I will not be staying another year) and they just don’t care about you. Why is the alarm going off so much? Because they haven’t fixed their crumbling infrastructure since they built this place. The building has a plumbing issue which causes your water to turn poop brown. Yes DARK BROWN COLORED WATER FROM YOUR FAUCET.   This happens every time the fire alarm goes off ( and sometimes randomly ). Maintenance and the company know about it. They don’t care about you. Us residents suspect the pipes aren’t meeting spec and it triggers the alarms. Don’t even think about calling maintenance or the after hours number. Absolutely useless. Apart from this, the beautiful windows they are so proud of don’t open well anymore if at all and the outside facade is literally crumbling. I moved in here because I was in graduate school and needed a relatively cheap place to live. Wish I had read more reviews. You get what you pay for. I would scope out other places first. Save yourself some trouble . 10/18/2020

We have lived here for a few years now, and absolutely love it. Beautiful apartments and a wonderful staff. One particular experience regarding a maintenance request prompted this review. Bob, one of the maintenance technicians, stopped by to help with our maintenance request regarding our microwave, as it stopped working suddenly. After troubleshooting the issue, Bob let us know that he would have to order a new microwave (if we wanted a new one vs replace that same day with one from a vacant unit in our building), and we were completely okay with waiting for the window of time he mentioned. Before leaving, he told us to call if we happened upon any other things we may need help with.

Cut to the NEXT day, and Bob knocks on our door holding the brand new microwave box. He mentioned that he was going on vacation soon and wanted to make sure we got a new microwave before he left - so he drove to the ordering center to go pick up a new model for us at the end of his work day. Cue our jaws hitting the floor - we were blown away to say the least! He installed everything, showed us how to program the new functions (and how it was different from the old microwave), and asked if we had any more questions.

On top of that, Bob volunteered to help with any other issues we may have going on in the apartment while he was there. We didn't have any in mind immediately, but after thinking for a bit we came up with a few we'd put on the back burner. He fixed a wobbly foot on the back of our oven, placed a shim under our refrigerator to help the door stay closed, and gave us some really great ideas for other questions we had about our apartment. He was really great, and you could just tell he truly cared about helping us out with anything and everything.

We have cats, and they had knocked a few small toys (and money) under the oven drawer - one of us was home and Bob let us know as soon as he opened the oven drawer; he easily could have pocketed the money and we never would have known, but his choice to be honest was so truly appreciated. On top of that, he was really great with our cats (who can be a little too friendly / curious) and very respectful of our living space. To say we were impressed with Bob's attention to detail and exceptional service is an understatement of colossal proportions. Bob was a total total rockstar. Just one more reason we love living at Steve Brown Apartments!

Rented one of the studios on ground floor. Loved the large kitchen and laminate flooring, because carpet in apartments can be gross. The two way fireplace was a nice bonus and a unique way to split living from bedroom area. Plus the in unit laundry, door side garbage collection, and free coffee were all great perks.  The only downside was the noise from the garage could be heard sometimes and I had a neighbor who liked music with to much bass. Otherwise,  if you can handle only having a patio door to let outside light in,  this was a great unit with lots of storage space that didn't feel like a studio.

Great studio apartment that is more spacious and feels larger than the floor plan displays. Friendly neighbors and work out facility with sauna to relax in. Love the club house to host gatherings. Convenient location for all needs and to Madison.

I have lived at Van Buren Place for a little over 3 months and have some of the best customer service I’ve ever experienced in apartment living. Friendly “hellos” each time you see a staff member and you can tell they genuinely care when they ask how you’re doing. They recently had a hot chocolate bar and gift wrapping station set up for the holiday, super cute! Looking forward to the rest of my lease here and hopefully more!

If you are looking for a home with a dedicated and caring staff; this is it.   A phone call, email, or text to them, never goes unanswered.  Stop into the office; and, they great you with a smile.   My few concerns have been handled professionally and resolved quickly.  They offer detailed communication for the move in process.   The homes are high quality and clean.  I recommend touring here.

If you are looking for a home with a dedicated and caring staff; this is it.   A phone call, email, or text to them, never goes unanswered.  Stop into the office; and, they great you with a smile.   My few concerns have been handled professionally and resolved quickly.  They offer detailed communication for the move in process.   The homes are high quality and clean.  I recommend touring here.

I had a wonderful time at Van Buren Place during my 2 years there. The apartment was very spacious and the kitchen appliances were great! Jen and Jodi, the property managers, are very kind people and very knowledgeable and helpful for any questions I had throughout my time. They were very friendly and were always ready to wave hello from their offices as I passed by to go to the fitness center. The fitness center is fantastic in this community, tons of weight machines for all sorts of workouts. Thanks for an unforgettable 2 years!

Apartment managers Jenn and Jodi do an excellent job. Fast maintenance response (within 24hrs), beautiful apartments, hallways cleaned and sanitized often. Location couldn't be better - close to everything you need, but quiet, secluded and away from heavy traffic.

Overall, this apartment is fine and will work for some people but I did not think it was worth the price that it's at. There's way too many things I did not like to list here but I'll keep it brief, I am currently writing this review with an internet speed of 0.68 mbps (yes you read that right). The internet is via landline, faucet is broken, plumbing is very loud at random times, walls are thin, there is constant noise coming from the hallway or the weight room that's right next to my bed, microwave is extremely loud, half the outlets don't work, there's about 6 switches that don't do anything, I spent the first week or so without hot water, and I think the shag carpetting has trapped the odors from the previous owners dog. That's a sample from a much longer list of grievances but the point is that there's nothing huge that's wrong with this place, just a lot of little things that are subpar compared to others. It's a fine place to live but the rent should reflect the quality that you're paying for which it does not.

We are just across the street from The Great Dane and Pick and Save. I love that I can just walk across the street and pick up my food. The reason I rented here is because underground parking, washer and dryer in the apartment and elevators! I never hear my neighbors but do see them when I walk my dog. Everyone is super friendly and everything is clean!
Landmark was very easy to work with. The complex and apartments are well organized and clean.
Very nice for a decent price. Can be pricey with all extras. Love that they are so pet friendly and in a great location behind the Great Dane!

If I could give this complex zero stars I would. I lived here for 6 years and the previous management was fantastic. It truly was a “home”. I would’ve rated them 5 stars at that point. 

Within the last year, they changed property management companies and the office manager changed as well. The new office manager is disorganized and lazy. It takes reaching out and reminding them multiple times to follow through on basic expectations. The quality of support and responsiveness has declined to an unacceptable level. If you are looking for an apartment, don’t consider Swan Creek.

We recently viewed apartments and applied to Swan Creek, we worked with Suela and Grace. They were extremely professional, knowledable and friendly during the entire process. Compared with other apartment complexes we visited the ladies at Swan Creek stood out above the rest. It is a great indication of how this property is run. I would highly recommend this apartment complex not just because it's lovely but because of the excellent customer representatives like Suela and Grace that you will experience.

I lived here for 3 years and absolutely love the apartment complex.  Wonderful leasing office and maintenance staff, beautiful neighborhood, and overall a great community!  I never had an issue the entire time I lived here and the only reason I left was because I was moving out of state.  I lived in a lot of different apartments in the past and Swan Creek is by far the best.

I was having the worst of times trying to find a place in the Madison area, that was at a reasonable price for the amount of space. Along with being in a good neighborhood with not a lot of crime. After coming up with a dead end after dead end with other apartment companies or just being confronted with rude agents. Who would basically bait and switch apartments when I would call them and state what I was looking for and they would say they had it, then when I went to the showing the apartment would be total opposite of what I was asking for. I called Swan Creek and was able to schedule a showing the same day and I wasn't ready for the miracle I was about to been shown. 

The apartment building is across from a beautiful park with a tennis court and play ground. The neighborhood is very quiet at night. Rooms are spacious. Building is well taken care of, has underground parking, security cameras, locked enterance ways. Plus the agent was very friendly, kind, and open to any needs I had or any concerns. The maintenance staff is also friendly and take care of the grounds and building needs in a professional way.

The only con I have about the apartment is when the air conditioning is on the vent is loud in the master bedroom but you get use to it or find ways to drown it out. But besides that it has been wonderful.

So if you're looking for a spacious apartment. In a good neighborhood for a decent price and friendly staff. Check out Swan Creek! 9.5/10

This is a nice complex nestled in a suburban city just outside the big city. You still have quick access to shops, restaurants and entertainment. The location even makes my commute to work short and easy. The grounds are well landscaped and maintenance is superb! Even though it does not have a lot of amenities, there still is a fitness center and gazebo area with grills.

Their primary communication states what you are looking for is available as stated on this app and their website. The email you get will not allow you to reply. They do not provide an email to send messages back to. 24 hours later when you have time to call them which is not your preferred method of communication. They tell you the property is unavailable and direct you to their website. They take a look into properties that are not in the area you are looking for and proceed to convince you that your bedroom requirements is popular which is a common tactic in sales. They also suggested a 2 bedroom downsize. They did answer right away which is why I gave them a 2x

I've been living here for nearly two years now and I have to say it is pretty wonderful here. 

Here's some pros about the place:

-The rent here has always been inexpensive.
- Nice/quiet neighbors
- Close to Madison East mall, Super Walmart, Woodmans, Fastfood, schools, movie theaters etc 
-We just recently got newer prettier windows.
- The staff has always been really nice and helpful
- Maintenance is always ready to help
- Five day grace period for rent
- LARGE walk in closets. I really love these.
- The bedrooms are very spacious. (Bigger than the bedrooms in my parent's house). You could probably fit two large beds and stuff in them.
- Living room and balcony are large and perfect for entertaining guests.
- The hallway closet is also very spacious.
- The heating system works really quickly to warm up your room in the winter.
- Plenty of parking spaces
- No lag time in winter/ The plow snow out the the parking lots in a timely manner. I've never had a problem.
- All in all, it is a very spacious apartment.

The only cons I would have is that the Air Conditioning is only in the living room, however it still does get pretty cold & that you have shared laundry rooms (8 apartments to one washer and dryer) but again the neighbors are really nice and respectful.

I would recommend this apartment to other people because it is cost friendly but still offers a spacious apartment and more.
Been dealing with a loud neighbor who ive recorded evidence on multiple occasions and they just send them the video and do nothing about it. Dont live here, not worth it.

The 17-acre Valley View Apartments Park, just for tenants, is a hidden gem in Madison.  The VVAs were built in the late 1970s when building rental buildings around a private park wasn't considered "strange" and waste use of undeveloped land!  Now "we," in this must take down every tree and who cares about farmland "developer dominated" world would never consider such a lavish "misuse" of land!  
I've lived in VVA for three years.  My highest values have been being near quiet nature, having quiet neighbors and being able to open my window in cold weather with heat included in rent!  I love fresh air!
VVA has issues with lack of hot water, tiny kitchens and minimal storage in apartments.  Also, getting a response from the Front Office is very difficult! 
However, every apartment/housing complex has issues.  One decides on priorities, right?

Very disappointed with the staff.  In front of you they look like they want to help you, but that's not the reality. Last month I went to see one of their apartments and I was very interested on it, but the apartment has a cockroaches infestation. They gave me 3 weeks to fix the roach infestation but at the end of that term that same day they called me a couple hours before  my appointment with them to tell me that the apartment was taken after having a verbal agreement already. Valley View staff is careless, deceitful and untrustworthy.

This place is honestly awful
They don’t care about their tenants or their needs, they don’t even care about maintenance issues

They just want to sell you the place and ignore you for The entirety of the lease
They don’t address issues that have come up

I have been trying to contact someone for two  weeks via email and phone and they haven’t answered
They come into your apartments without appropriate prior knowledge  
They ignore complaints
They don’t communicate 

Worst place to live

Been here for about 4 years now. Every year they take something away. Last year was shorter pool hours. This year was the breakfast.  Or rent gets raised. Matienence is always good. Very fast. Easy acceptance into apartments.   Nice nieghbors. Okay niegborhood. Very close to everything! 
Not very affordable though.
A great Place to live! Been here for 4 months and it's been a awesome place so far.  Friendly personal it's a plus, always on top of things and really energetic, would recommend this place to anyone!

The experience I had with managment was a disappointing one. 

They are not a resident/community centered apartment.

When we first moved in everything was paradise but as building filled in it seems to be too much to handle. Everything was breaking and maintenance had little to no communication, sometimes we would schedule an appointment and they either didn't show or we were given a 5 hour window, we always had to call the main office to see what was happening. At one point out dishwasher was broken for over a month, maintenance never looked at it and simply said they knew what was happening and had to order new parts, once it was fixed it just didn't work the same anymore and we always had to re-wash anything on the top rack. There is a lot of issues with the way heating and AC works, one side of the apartment gets no air flow and vents were open, there are lots of drafts in the apartment as there are massive openings between the door frame and door, locks freeze anytime it is below 40F, to the point we had a broken key and it took over a week to get a replacement key, during the cold snap where temps were below 0F one fuse would always blow and when it was brought up to management they dismissed it as snow build-up around the transformer outside. We looked over our maintenance requests and noticed that we had to put in over 20 tickets for the 18 months we lived here and a lot were repeats! 
During snowstorms nothing was plowed or shoveled for about a week and when the parking lot was plowed the parking stalls were not and the sidewalks were difficult to walk as there were so many snow mounds.
At one point we saw a cockroach near the mailroom and when we informed management we were simply brushed off and told that this property used to be farmland and that it is normal!
Don't be fooled by prices, they are not as cheap as they look as you will then be charged a bunch of extra "lifestyle" fees that you cannot opt out of such as valet trash, which rarely picks up on days they are supposed to or any holiday, not just federal holidays, they won't pickup on things such as Halloween, Easter, etc.
Internet is a forced dish fiber that rarely works and when it does you aren't getting the speeds you are supposed to, we both work for a cable company that offers free internet services to employees and would have appreciated being able to use that benefit. Also, dish fiber claims you get a basic cable package but when you go to sign up for it you get an error message that it's a business account.

I've been nothing but happy with living at Seminole Woods! I've been here for over a year, and the management is great - always quick to respond to any maintenance needs, and they keep the place looking nice! Landscaping is always kept up, repainting the balconies, etc. I've never had any issues with noise & never hear my neighbors. They're also offering upgrades to apartments, which I took advantage of when I moved in, and I love it! Granite counter tops, new appliances, light fixtures, overhead fan, and counter top and sink in the bathrooms. The location is also wonderful...just 10 minutes from downtown Madison, very safe area, and a beautiful large park right in your back yard with ponds, walking/biking paths, tennis courts, basketball courts, playgrounds, a splash pad, and ice skating in the winter! There are also tons of restaurants within walking distance as well as groceries. No complaints here!

I felt good about this place from the moment I asked for a tour. Jeanon was amazing at guiding me through the options and the application process. Holly was instrumental in helping me make a decision to move forward with my ultimate choice—which I'm very happy with. And Chase closed the deal with a fantastic post-move follow-up. I've been living at TVR for less than a month and I already feel at home. Great dog-friendly, well-maintained complex in an amazing location. I totally recommend living here. And based on her comfort level in our new bedroom, so does my four-legged child!

I’ve lived at Tribeca for 3 years and am going on my 4th. This is the first apartment I’ve lived at where I truly feel at home. The amenities are great as well as the location. Shanna, who is the Leasing Manager is always pleasant to talk to with any questions on things. I am happy to call this place my home ??

I lived here for a year and I loved it. The landlord Jodi was extremely accommodating and quick to respond to emails, phone calls, and text messages. The buildings were clean and kept in great shape. There were many wonderful amenities: pool, workout space, yoga studio, community rooms in each building, and a grilling area just to name a few. Maintenance was also very quick to respond to maintenance requests. I would recommend this place to young professionals as well as families with and without pets.

When asked to see video footage for a stolen package they were conveniently broken. They don’t care about security or safety. The front door camera is broken? They also let the fire panel beep for months straight without fixing it.

Awful management. Maintenance requests were never taken care of. No one on site to speak to. Ants everywhere coming in through the walls. Leaking refrigerator, had to use my towels to soak up puddles of water because they refused to fix it. They drilled holes in my vanity after an upstairs neighbor flooded their apartment and they never fixed it. Charged me for damage that I did not have anything to do with upon moving out. They allow neighbors to smoke on their patios, so I couldn’t open my windows in the summer. Closed all amenities for 2 years and yet continued increasing rent. Absolutely horrible place to live.
I have enjoyed living here over the past 4 years.  The property is kept looking top notch, and the staff is great.  Can't ask for anything better.

I can say nothing but wonderfuld things about the staff, residents, and the property. Leopold Place is well kept and there is a real sense of community. Neighbors get together for coffee, bbq's, etc. I would recommend this place to anyone.
I have lived here for 5 years and have had no complaints. The pool is awesome, they accept pets for a small fee. It is very quiet with no crime. Love living here.

Living at the brittany apartments has been enjoyable for me. Its a peaceful complex tucked back in a great spot of middleton. I appreciate the underground parking for wintertime  and being able to have a pet. The pool is really nice in the summer and they even have a soda machine. Im hoping to be able to stay here for a long time.
The entire first floor of the building flooded a few years ago. Water was pouring out of the walls. Shoddy construction. Takes forever to get responses, even from the new owners.
Staff is unprofessional and unresponsive. Property management changes frequently.

I really enjoyed living at the Kestrel. It's a very clean, new & modern building in a great location. Mandy, the on-site apartment manager was absolutely fantastic. She especially made me feel at home throughout my time there. Very dog friendly. I especially enjoyed walking my dog in the neighborhood behind the building and crossing the street to shop at Willy Street Co-op. The building is very quiet and peaceful. Surprisingly, never heard any traffic from University Ave. The hallways are decorated with nice artwork of Middleton. A nice touch and was a great place for me to call home.

I am extremely happy here. The building is always clean, the security is system in place make me feel safe, there is a heated parking garage, and the administrative staff are easily accessible and always helpful. This place really makes me feel at home. I am so grateful I found out about The Kestrel.
The staff are very friendly, the apartments include nice features, and I love the surrounding area. Lot's of exciting places within walking distance.  Very happy with my decision to move here!
I have been living here for 2 years and it’s been great! Management is really understanding and there’s everything around here like stores parks and trails for walks!

I have been living here for 3 years and love it here. Every time someone comes to my apartment they compliment my view and my living space. The staff are really friendly and communicate with residents well. Beautiful area too that’s not far from downtown Madison or Middleton
Love our spacious remodeled apartment and the property management is great. Very timely Maintenence and love the pools and  tennis court
I moved in 2014, i have no complaints. I love coming home to the pond and the staff is friendly.
I love these apartments, it’s always so calm plus there is two pools, a tennis court and a basketball court! Even a garden in the forest to plant vegetables or flowers!

I’ve lived here for 8 years and complete enjoy it. From the office staff to the maintenance crew to the property manager - they are all awesome! The view from my apartment is a pond view where I get to enjoy seeing all the geese and duck babies and my friendly muskrat that lives near me. The apartment is great! Anytime there is an issue - the maintenance crew is on the job. I would totally recommend living at Arbor Lakes. This is the best apartment complexes I’ve lived at.

Cops are here multiple times a week. You will find that there are drug activity going on throughout the property. A poorly managed property with a very dishonest staff. The units itself are old and rundown that need alot of attention. As far as the amenities go they aren't taken care of very well so it isn't something that's appealing to look forward to. I'd give it negative stars if I could. Look elsewhere and do not believe  what the people tell you or what you read about this place, its not good.

Management lies constantly.  Rude!!!  Anything that happens to your 1000 yr old apt you will be blamed for.  Management seems to think you are there for them instead of it is their job!!!  Why have a lease when they pick and choose who and what is enforced.  
It was the best but now I feel like I am walking on egg shells all the time.
NO Matter what----you will be blamed for all that happens.  They are a big company and basically bully.

I would give it zero if I could. after 3 years living here it keeps getting worse and worse. Let’s start with the police being here at least monthly for domestics or drugs. Office never taking your seriously, never cleaning, the common areas are FILTHY, treating you poorly, never answering the phone, etc. there have been multiple people arrested out of our building. The “secure” door is never secure. And not my neighbor is allowing homeless people to live in the building. Not only have the police been here for them fighting but they are always hanging out under my porch trying to get in the building if it just so happens to be secure. This is just within the last 3 months. I could go on and on. Trust me, don’t do it.

I have been living here for a year now, and it had been wonderful! The staff is friendly and helpful, and the whole area is beautiful. I love how there’s a garden where you can have your own plot to plant stuff! The dog park is great, and there’s even nature trails. Sometimes I’ll forget I’m in the city when I’m walking on them! The best part is that there’s not one, but two pools, and even a pond! The apartments are nice, my only complaint would be the kitchen is too small for my liking.

Don't ever rent at this place. The washrooms and the storage areas are disgusting. The snow removal is pathetic. People have complained about insufficient heat. Most of the office staff is pleasant but the property manager, Amanda, is very inconsiderate. I lived at this apartment complex for two years and was never late with my rent, and $25 was deducted from my security deposit for a late fee because I put the check in the box on July 4 and not on July 3. The office was closed on July 3 and 4, so I put the check in the box on July 4 instead of July 3, but apparently the box was checked on July 3 and as my check was not in there, I was charged a late fee. How inconsiderate because how could it be late when it's a check and it could not be deposited until the 5th. So does it really matter that I put it on July 4 especially as I had been never late with my rent. No sense of loyalty and horrible business etiquette. I will never rent there again and would advise everyone to steer clear of this establishment. I only stayed for two years because I was in Wisconsin temporarily and didn't want to be bothered with moving expenses.

I lived here for 2 years, it was my first apartment I ever rented. I loved my apartment, my balcony faced the pond and I was right next to the pool. volleyball court, walking trails, and a garden that residents can use! I always paid my rent 2 days in advance because you get placed in an "early bird" contest and could win a free pizza! Management is very helpful and friendly! The gas station and family video is right across the street! I definitely recommend Arbor Lakes to friends and coworkers!

I have a friend who has been here for a while and I recently moved here myself into one of the one of the apartments by the pool and I really like it so far. My neighbors have been nice and the building is quiet. I was worried because this is my first 1st floor apartment, but I haven't heard anything from upstairs neighbors at all. My apartment is heat included (and I control it) and that's a HUGE plus. Heating for the house I moved from was very expensive. The buildings themselves look like they're from the mid 70's like most of the area but it looks like my building has been kept up pretty well. This is my first place without a roommate, so I decided to start with the most affordable option first which means my kitchen cabinets are definitely from when the buildings were built. The appliances are newer, but the cabinets are a plain dark color. Nothing to write home about. I guess you get the choice to have your apartment remodeled before you move in because they asked if I wanted to, but I chose not to right away because you're also allowed to do your own improvements too and why pay the money if I like what I do myself? I've painted my own colors and put up molding, changed the knobs and drawer pulls in the kitchen and bathroom. Now I'm even thinking of replacing the cabinet doors which the manager said would be ok if I save the originals and don't do any damage or anything in the process. Still, I do like that I still have the choice to remodel the place later if I want to. Who knows, I do really like the new cabinets I saw... Anyway, besides ho hum cabinets, I've really liked everything else. The office people have been really nice, I love the new gym they put in, and there's a new clubhouse with wifi for the residents to hang out in too. The carpet looks new, maintenance has been really quick to respond to the few things I've had them do, I still got a dishwasher even though I have the cheapest version of my unit (I HATE hand washing), and I've had no problems with my heat or water or anything.
bad, awful, horrible apartments! So out of date and the quality of the apartment upon move in was ATROCIOUS! RUN...DON'T WALK...TO ANYWHERE IN MIDDLETON BUT HERE!

The management is not very good, though they are always polite. The water heating is old style and terrible (in my opinion). Impossible to relax in the shower. It seems like you share the water heating with everyone in your building, not just your apartment. Anybody else wants to get a drink or use the toilet you either get frozen solid or scalded. The water temperature never stays steady. The neighbors are friendly, and the location is nice. The pools have problems with the amounts of chlorine in the times I've gone swimming.
It has a nice ponds with lots of ducks that are fun to feed and a sidewalk that goes around most of it for nice walks.

Apartments look like they haven't been renovated, ever. Tour model and pictures on the site are NOTHING like the apartment I ended up moving into. You can have your apartment renovated before you move in at your OWN EXPENSE but it costs A LOT of money! Carpet in every room was coming apart when I moved in. I completely filled up 3 large vacuum bags of old dog hair, dust, etc. in one day! EW! There is even carpet in the bathroom=very unhygienic. Kitchen stove is tilted so much that water spills out of pots despite being fixed three times.
The location is great and the apartments are nice. Its nice to have a place that takes pets too. They have a variety of options for layouts and such.

We had high hopes, we loved our apartment, loved the location, even loved the office staff. Things went downhill FAST. They are NOT military friendly at all (despite claiming to be), the new assistant manager is awful, disrespectful and cold. The old assistant manager was fantastic and so is Carla, but the rest of the staff has treated us HORRIBLY. They don't handle noise complaints until you can complain to someone much higher in the food chain and even then, it's begrudgingly and this is generally how they handle any tenant concerns, requests or even communication. I wouldn't wish this place on my worst enemy.
So the place was perfect except they were infested with bugs,  and roaches. !!

Management is ignorant and rude, they will not respond to any email regarding anything. But are constantly looking for any reason to evict you. The rent is ridiculous for such a cheaply made apartment that breaks within months of living. Doors, door handles, door trims coming up and cabinets falling off. The management does not care about their tenets at all, I was without AC for months in 90 degree weather with a 4 year old and dogs and management did not do anything about it, until I was emailing them 2x a day EVERYDAY. They only have 2 garbage cans for the ENTIRE complex so there is trash everywhere. Do not waste your time. Everything about this apartment is terrible.

I applied here as the income-based apartment fit my budget perfectly. However, the management is rude, lazy and non-communicative. They will NOT answer calls or emails unless absolutely necessary. Routine maintenance is regularly delayed as they have so little people employed to do so. There is dog waste and garbage everywhere. If you are someone who is often out late at night you will likely struggle to find a parking spot and guests have to park at the Church. The inside of the apartment looks nice, however the materials are cheap and the walls are extremely thin. You will have every footstep from every neighbor near you. My apartment began to fall apart within a few months of living there. I would not recommend this rental property to anyone. Avoid at all costs!

Although the apartments are brand new, it is very clear that they cut a lot of corners in building the apartments. Cheap cupboards, tiny kitchens, cheap flooring. Not enough parking for all residents and guests need to park on the opposite side of the complex in the church parking lot. Awful management. Greedy property management company, super unfriendly and only care about making money. They do not care about their tenants at all. Live here if you’re okay with all of that, but if not then don’t even waste your time.

I went in looking for a apartment (obviously) the guy I spoke with with the unicorns on his desk was supper rude . Would not let me tour until I applied then would not even tell me that I had to do it online .Not a pleasant first first impression for this apartment .Hard pass

I live here currently l and have lived here for two years! The apartments themselves are beautiful, great condition and have many amenities. The parking is spotty if you plan on have guests as they have to park in a church lot of the opposite side of the properties and only from certain times. My main issues are that maintenance is attentive but overly so, they come into the apartments at least once a month, every month for “routine maintenance” It’s uncomfortable especially for a woman living alone. Lastly is the accessibility for all people. The dumpsters are very tall and as a 5’6 person I find it very difficult to lift garbage bags above my head into the dumpsters.

I was so pleased with the care we received from Anna in the leasing office at Maple Lawn Apartments. We walked in with our application and she took an hour out of her day to ensure we had everything we needed for a complete application. I highly recommend Maple Lawn Apartments. Praying we become a part of the Maple Lawn Community.

Absolutely do not do business with this property. My father was a resident here and unfortunately passed away at the very beginning of February (2). He paid his February rent. We moved out and turned in the keys to Nick who informed me we would receive the full security deposit back. Both Nick and Martina assured me and my family we would receive his security deposit on numerous occasions. I’ve called, left messages, and emailed after not hearing anything. Only now in May, after me repeatedly calling, did they inform me they charged him rent for the month of March (again, he passed away on Feb. 2) and would not be sending his security deposit. This was a complete change in position and we were never informed about this. Completely shocked me. Really disappointed and disheartened at the lack of honesty.

Management is fantastic and so helpful!
This apartment is also brand new and clean.
I always feel safe here because of the basement and the fob system. The apt door has a push button lock so I never get locked out of my apartment.

Excited for the Limerick to open for my grandma to move in!  We’ve been looking for affordable senior housing for years, and the property manager made the application process so easy. He is super responsive to questions and happy to assist! If this is how responsive and efficient they are before she lives there, I can only imagine how they’ll be when she’s moved in! Thank you so much.

I've been a tenant since day one at this place and absolutely love it. Stacy is an amazing property manager and Pablo is a fantastic maintenance man. We have a huge swimming pool, community room, and are close to everything your heart can imagine. Target, ALDIs, MOOYAH, Pet Supplies Plus, etc., are all literal steps away.
I scheduled a showing with one of the contact persons and they stood me up. The staff just wants a job that pays well not a job they can be useful at.

I’ve lived here 2 years now and have really enjoyed it. We were looking for an affordable place with an in unit washer and dryer, dishwasher, and covered parking. This hit all those boxes and was the most affordable apartment we found in Madison. I work at UW hospital and the drive is very reasonable, 10-12 minutes depending on the time of day. We chose a 2 bedroom and our guests often comment about how much space we have. It can get pretty hot in the summer without central air, but we were willing to sacrifice this for how reasonable the rent is. When we have maintenance concerns we get help promptly which I really appreciate.
Very convenient place to live. Quiet neighbors and attentive property managers.

Very good atmosphere around, in the center of city hence easy access to Malls and other essential stores with affordable rent structure.

Management is good and is quick to respond to all the requests in no time.

I would recommend this place to rent :)

There are MASSIVE garbage trucks that come at 630AM almost every weekday. Tonight between 11PM To 1AM snow removal noise banging into your bedroom because the windows are so thin. Other than that its fine.

Yellow water which constantly stains bathtubs and sinks. It feels like every day I have to double check the water I get out of the tap before I drink it. 

Parking is also heinously bad.

Just a heads up to people that are interested in this place!!! Yes it’s a very nice brand new building but the parking arrangements are horrible. The secure underground parking is full and not available along with the outside parking, you have to park your vehicle almost 2 blocks away!!!

apartmentName: Big Sky Manor & High Point Manor
review:
The property manager and the maintenance crew are amazing! I've lived in this building for almost 4 years. Anytime any issues came up they were amazingly quick to fix them or let me know when the parts will come in for the fix. 

I have lived in both the studio and the upgraded loft apartment in the same building. 

They are really good about addressing any complaints about neighbors and was kind enough to act on them. Most of the occupants are super friendly. 

There are no pet fees which is amazing! People get accustomed to your cat and will hold on to them if they get out.  

The location is great! I love having the Kwik Trip right next door so I can go down whenever I need some last minute butter or milk, or it is 8:45 and I really need a beer. The area itself is pretty quiet with the exception of the normal summer time bbq buzz which is to be expected.

apartmentName: Big Sky Manor & High Point Manor
review:
Pro's: Extremely worth the cost. Fantastic studio layout with plenty of closet space and living space. Property managers are responsive, timely, and willing to help on behalf of tenants making move-in stress free. 

Con's: Hallways and some cabinets of the apartment smell of cigarette smoke. Most likely due to the past before change in-laws.

apartmentName: Big Sky Manor & High Point Manor
review:
Lived here for 3 years and I would not have moved if not for location change. 
Management has always been supportive and easy to deal with.  Katie is exceptional in providing good living experience. 
Location is best in terms of access to lot of places nearby. 
Its quiet too and really safe. 

I will miss my stay :)

Lived here for a few years, and absolutely loved it! Great inclusive property, with in unit washer/dryer, dishwasher, central air and more! The parking garage was a huge plus in the winter months, snow removal was speedy, maintenance was quick and easy. Management was on site and very kind and personable. Would recommend living here!

Mirabel is a great place to live. I have found it to be quiet, I never hear my neighbors. I love having the fitness room right in the building that is always clean. Access to the pool is great for the summer. Something special that I have never found anywhere else is the availability of a free community garden plot right in front of the building. This is my first time gardening but it is a fun extra to have available. The staff is easy to get a hold of and maitance is done in a timely fashion.

I've lived at Westhaven Village Apartments since 2016 and am just now moving out to move to a new city.  This apartment has been everything I hoped it would be when I moved in.  It's priced competitively, safe, offers the pool during the summer, has responsive management, and maintenance requests are fulfilled in a fast manner.  The underground parking during the winter is great as well.  Highly recommend if you are looking for a clean, safe, nice place to live.

This place is reasonably priced and well managed. The office is quick to respond to any questions and very helpful. Maintenance requests are always handled quickly and well. The pool and volleyball courts are a great feature in the summertime, and the property is well-maintained year round. I  lived here for 3 years and recommend it to everyone!

The units are relatively spacious for the price, especially in terms of included storage space. Management is friendly. The first 2 years were reasonably uneventful from a maintenance perspective, however this winter the heating has stopped working 3 times (October, December, and March). Management encouraged a "wait and see" approach to the problem. After insisting that this approach wasn't working, maintenance would come out within 24 hours. However, they clearly didn't actually solve the problem because it kept occurring. Management all but ignored my emailed questions about the issue and complaints about the frequency of occurrences.

They have a pest problem (mice). Tenet's a scared to alert management, in fear of not having their leases renewed. On unit used to be security locked. Last I visited was not. Washers and dryers on site are always breaking. Building in and out isn't well maintained. Managment is hard to deal with. Most interactions are via email. If you're a working stiff, you probably don't check your email often and won't be up to date. IF you don't mind late night noise, the smell of weed in your home or chicken bones and trach in the hallways. By all means stay here.
As for where it's located. It's not bad.

You have to pay to park even have one spot in the lot even though the lot is half empty all the time and they have a towing truck company they will have tow away you car if you don't have they sticker and that happen to us a few weeks ago even tho the rent is alredy ridiculus high and that make everyone have to park on the street and have to walk a long ways in the dark even just to get to the place it aint right. The building smell terrible and  not clean good at all. The hallway and basement always dirty and nasty. Trash not pick up like they should. Sais is smoke free but bunch of them still smoke cigarettes and other stuff anyway and stink up my apartment then dump they buts and ashes on sidewalks in front of the door to get in. All kinda animals hiding in the bushes and junk all growed up and not cut down and always running around all over and then also got renters make it look like we in some arekansas town cuz they hang flags or blankets on they windows andf junk. my apartment got a little tiny kitchen no dishwasher plus little bit half size stove and window air condition that nobody take care of is loud and even after I told them it wasn't workin right and my apartment so hot they send somebody to look and say nothing wrong so it don't matter it stayed broke. don't rent here. im tryin to find new place cuz peiople who used to own it and live here who were real nice and take care of it sold it and move and these new people don't care bout nothin but money and it aint worth at ALL cuz even some thiose pics they got on here is a lie and not even a real apartment nobody live in no more thats where the old owner used to live but now its the manger office and they trying to make people think its good so they can charge so much plus then make people pay to park even one spot and charge all kind of money to do pet test so they can even test the poop and charge you more if they say is your dog plus make us pay  more pet rent fees to have a pet to! this place aint worth at all.
I can’t begin to praise the Gordon! Meticulously maintained. Skillfully managed and conveniently located. A great value in the Madison market!

Our time renting at The Gordon on Roxbury has been Amazing. It is a beautiful and spacious apartment with an incredible property manager Jodi and responsive maintenance by Terry. It is in a great walkable and bikeable location.

We drove by The Gordon by accident during our apartment search last November and thought it looked interesting. After a subsequent tour we were hooked. The Gordon compares very favorably with the luxury apartments along East Wash near the Capitol, but has the distinct advantage of being smaller and more intimate (only 29 units) and very quiet, with the added bonus of being able to enjoy some of the amenities of Maple Bluff like the country club. Everything is very new and immaculate and the finishes and fittings are all top class. We really like it here.
The apartment is amazing the workers there go above and beyond for me I Love it here!!! The best place I have ever lived!!!

My experience has been a good one do to the Asst. Manager we have. Laura has an approachable personality that you know she is always willing to listen to your concerns and she cares. She is professional and treats everyone with kindest and fairness.  She makes sure the building is tip top shape! The complex and grounds are kept very clean.

The downside has been a few tenants that refuse the follow the rules which don't seem to care about others that they make it unpleasant for others around them. One person whose dog is constantly barking and has been told  how it is affecting the rest of the tenants is a perfect example but will defy the rules!!!

I like my new apartment home located at jupiter drive on east side of madison.
Compared to where i used to live, this is such a fabulous place to live. It come with the washer, dryer, and fridge which save me lots of investment. Will definitely recommend if you are also looking for a apartment.

I couldn't think of a better place to live for being a young professional in a place I know nobody. It is way more spacious than any apartment I had in college but still in the heart of all of the action.

These apartment homes are two bedrooms units in four-plexes.  I have lived mostly in large apartment buildings and this is such a nice change.  Of course, you hear your neighbors at times, but we have been very lucky to be in a building with respectful and generally quiet neighbors. Most of the units are adjacent to some wooded lots - it is nice to have a little bit of nature in your backyard.

The location is pretty great, just a block off of mineral point road but it still feels relatively quiet and safe.  There are other large apartment complexes and condos in the area but most of the units are occupied by families and older professional adults.  Very few loud college age kids in this neighborhood. 

Walking distance to the mall and other shopping if that is your thing, otherwise a less than 5 minute drive will take you to Target, Copps, Metcalfes, MadCat Pet Supplies, and lots of other places. 

Central heat and air and an attached garage are my favorite features.  The garage is not attached to the units themselves but rather through the basement, this works out just fine for my family. 

Cats and dogs are allowed in the units and most of our neighbors are respectful and clean up after their dogs outside.

Staff and management has been responsive when we have issues or concerns.

All in all, these are great apartments for small families and professionals of any age looking for a nice place to live that feels a bit more like a house than your typical apartment.

recently had the pleasure of staying at Countryside Corporate Apartments in Madison, WI, and I cannot recommend it enough! From the moment I arrived, I felt right at home. The apartments are spacious, cozy, and incredibly well-maintained—it's like having your own private suite, with a full kitchen, comfortable living spaces, and TVs in every room and much more.

What truly makes this place special is the management. Connie, the property manager, is hands-down the best. She is professional, responsive, and genuinely cares about her guests. She made sure my stay was seamless, always available when I had questions and quick to resolve any issues. Her assistant, Caleb, was also fantastic—always helpful and professional. Together, they create a welcoming and stress-free environment for everyone, no matter where you're from.

The community here is diverse, peaceful, and friendly, with guests from all walks of life. The location is convenient—just a short drive or even a walk to my office, with ample free parking. Plus, it's close to Beltline 12, so getting around Madison is a breeze.

If you're planning a visit to Madison, whether for a few days or a few weeks or longer, Countryside Corporate Apartments is the place to stay. They are very accommodating. It's affordable, comfortable, and managed by people who truly care about their guests. For me, on my next visit to Madison, there's no place I'd rather stay than here! Hands-down a superstar, and superplace to be at. I strongly recommend  it to those that are looking for a great place and community away from home. 

Malek Oskoui
Was ideal rental for me for a short term, furnished, with pets stay. Been here 2 summers for 3 week stays and would definitly stay again.

My apartment was given to me dirty. The carpets hadn’t been vacuumed much less cleaned. The first step in my staircase was broken upon move in and it took them nine months of me continually asking them for them to send someone to fix it. They assured me that it was a mistake that my carpets hadn’t been cleaned prior to my move in and that they would send someone to do that but I am moving out at the end of this week and they never did. There was a large burn mark on the stair railing as well. About into a week of me living here I got around to doing a deep cleaning of my bathroom and noticed that the entire underneath of my toilet was coated in black mold. You can also tell above the shower that they had tried to just paint over the mold growth. Under the sink there was a jagged hole in which the plumbing went through and upon inspection I found that there was a black mold infestation inside the walls. No matter how much I cleaned or what products I used the mold still recurred and when I reported this to management they had the audacity to ask if I had tried cleaning with bleach. I also had raccoons living in my ceiling for a period of time. They were quick to call animal control to apprehend the raccoons but did nothing to address the damage the raccoons had caused to my ceiling. The laundry facilities are often broken and the washers are filled with mildew. It doesn’t seem that they preform any upkeep on their machines. Since this is a smoking building the halls regularly reek of tobacco smoke and took a bit of a toll on my lungs and exacerbated my asthma. Three months before the end of my lease they started doing showings of my apartment two or more times per week while I was at work. This proved to be very stressful for my cat. I’ve never been so excited to move out of somewhere.
The features of the apartment, the on-site maintenance, and the apartment staff are amazing. 5 stars!

The staff at FMI were incredibly helpful in quickly narrowing down my options of apartments to look at. Jupiter Crossing offers comparably-priced, spacious, and very quiet apartments. The included garage space and large storage units are awesome! Grandview Commons is a quiet, well-maintained neighborhood with easy access to restaurants, groceries, and well-maintained walking and biking paths.

This place is great if you want to live in an insulated fish bowl and love the noise of factory workers at all hours. Cold on the bottom floors, hot on all others. No amenities, very poor quality of finishes for the price point. I can’t wait until this lease ends.

PH Apartments is one of the most well balanced apartments downtown Madison has to offer. It is located in a fantastic area of the city--it's walking distance from the lake, two Walgreens, a grocery store, many great libraries and study spots, the Kohl Center, and it's right on State St. The apartments themselves are surprisingly spacious and in good condition (the building itself is still fairly new, about 10 years old) for what the prices are. The maintenance workers often responded the day of submitting a request, and the office staff was very helpful and understanding.

They also have a community dinner every month with free food, afternoon tea with snacks every month, and offer scholarship programs to those interested for up to $100 off your rent a month.

I can only think of two downsides. One is that they only have a small parking area behind the building with one 15 minute parking spot, so owning a car while living there is a challenge, although they do give the opportunity to buy a parking spot at the Fluno Center parking lot, the other is just that for me personally, as an engineering student it was a little far away from my classes, but for the majority of majors it is in a perfect spot.

I recently contacted The View at Grandview Commons.  I was looking for an apartment and I was lucky enough to have Kristina F. within FMI showing me my options.  Kristina was awesome! She took the time to show me 5 or 6 apartments (in The View & Infinity Buildings) until I found the one that was right for me.  Then she also let me come back and revisit the two I was debating between before applying for one. The apartments in both complexes are beautiful and in a great up and coming area.  

Kristina was organized, knew which places would fit my requests and knew the cost that would apply.  I hope everyone in that management group is as awesome as Kristina is as she made it easy to want to live there!

Maintenance and the people who run this property don't care about people. Was treated very poorly for asking for basic things. I'm glad I moved, I know I am just a paycheck for my new apartment complex but at least they treat me like a human being who they are responsible for my housing.

I have lived here for 8 years and I'm so happy to call this home. Amazing building managers and resident managers, friendly quiet neighbors,  and cozy apartments with charm. I love living here and so will you!

These apartments are hidden gems! Going on 15 years living here & the new owners and management are beyond stellar. They are super responsive & maintenance is prompt, courteous, and respectful. We are so close to the bike path entrance and the street is quiet. Lots of families & retirees here…so it was quite the find! The apartments are large and built solid, we truly love it here!

You will hear the neighbors above and below you even if they speak at a regular volume. This acoustics problem caused a months-spanning conflict between me and another tenant, where management only aggravated the situation, and my mental health suffered.

On a more positive note, facilities staff perform their job well. But if you value your sanity, I suggest living elsewhere - you have plenty of more accommodating options in the area.
Thus far the property has been well managed, it is quiet, clean and sits next to a park and paved bike trail.

I've lived at this address for over a year, and it has been a great experience. While it is far away from downtown, it is close enough to stores like Target, Woodmans, and the West Towne Mall. It is one of the few places that I would actually consider pet friendly; we have two small dogs and a cat. It is very spacious, especially the bathrooms and closets. My main complaint is the high rent, but that is what you get close to Epic and pet friendly!

I lived here for a year, and left this place as I moved to another state. I had the best experience here. The management people (Magen, Tim) are very friendly, and they are always helpful and accommodating as much as they can.
The location is decent in a sense that it is walking distance away to the Capitol, James Madison Park, and State Street and you are still away enough to not get a lot of noise. The only problem I had was the off-street parking on the weekends for the first half of my stay (you may need to go to the waitlist to get an assigned parking onsite).
Highly recommend this place in general. It will be my home again if I come back to Madison.

The building is sturdy and we almost never hear our neighbors through the walls/ceiling (sometimes can hear faint coughing when it's late at night and really quiet). The location is fantastic - especially with the lake/James Madison park nearby. The neighborhood in general is quiet/peaceful and nice for walking. The appliances, sinks, and toilet and shower are nice. Balcony is also great! We pay very little for utilities (may go up in the summer months when we use the AC unit). Minor complaints are that it can feel cramped at times for two people (one working from home), the bedroom in our unit is pretty small (we have the smallest unit), the water pressure could be better, and there's no AC in the bedroom.
Nice property. Too quiet of a neighborhood, not much to do without driving somewhere. Kinda overpriced too.
Awesome property, super quiet and pretty neighborhood. Property manager is awesome as well.

Terrible service on the part of the administration. I was living for two years on Hercules Trail without any problems. But when there are problems Reid who is the manager is useless. My dog ??was attacked by dog ??pitbull mastiff from the side apartment, which supposedly the owner of the dog or dog were not allowed to be there was what I informed staff of the office. However, they were the owner and the dog for two months. I had to pay the vet's expenses of $ 500 for the dog owner's aggressor was "disappeared with his dog" and Reid never did anything about it. When this happened Reid was on vacation for a week and no one in the office was left in charge of his post. I had to insist on calls and emails the following week to get an answer to my complaint. In response I received your refusal to the responsibility of having an unauthorized breed dog in the apartment complex. This dog could have more time and management or aware of how many people or pets live in the apartments. If you are going to rent here be careful with your pets or small children.

I have lived here for 8 months. They didn't salt the walkway for the first 2 months and I had to walk through the snow piles over the grass which was COVERED in dog feces. I have had problems with the dishwasher, closet door, screen door, and kitchen drawers. Maintenance takes a while to show up but he does his job well. Apartment looks nice but is cheap and prone to problems. Reed and the office staff are EXTREMELY RUDE and unhelpful!!

I’ve lived in Madison for many years and have dealt with most landlords on the Isthmus. The entire team at Mendota Lakeshore are just phenomenal. You will not find a better group of people to rent from. Once you add the views and lake access, you start to understand what a rare gem the entire experience is.
I lived here for three years with my cousin and a buddy from high school. These were the greatest years of my life up until I purchased my own place. The landlords and staff TRULY care.

My partner and I lived here for two years while I was in grad school and it was by far the best rental experience we've had. The lobby and hallways are always clean and tidy, it's in a great location right on Lake Mendota, in walking distance of UW campus, State St., the capital, and bus lines. The apartments are updated and all utilities (even internet and cable) are included. There is a gym in the basement area as well that is right on the lakefront. There are also cameras throughout the inside and outside of the building for safety. I think the main appeal of this place was the managers and maintenance people who consistently responded to any issue that came up. Mark, Alicia, Chad, and George are all so kind and throughout our experience made sure that we were taken care of. As long as you take care of your apartment, keep it clean, pay your rent on time, notify management right away if something's wrong, and NOT drunkenly throw couches in the lake, your rental experience here will be great!

This place is a decent deal with utilities and internet included, but the quality matches the price. Elevators have a strange double door where you have to pull the door open to get in. The buttons in it are finicky, and I've had them stop on me mid-flight on multiple occasions. I had to use the button to call for help once until it randomly started moving again. I consider myself lucky to have not died in it at some point.

The views from the north end of the apartment are great, but in the summer, the sunlight reflects off of the lake and on to the building, making the place extra hot. Air conditioning is listed as an amenity but the building is absolutely not air conditioned- they'll just install a window unit for you if you pay an extra fee plus more rent. At the start of the summer, the bug situation in the apartment was out of control. From the time that we moved in, the bug screens in the apartments were in bad shape, and allowed a ton of bugs to get in. Some of the bugs were weird, slow moving beetle type bugs, not just little gnats. Some of the windows themselves had bad latches and either didn't open or wouldn't stay open.

There was some kind of issue with the air vent in our bathroom flapping around, but instead of fixing the actual problem, some guy just came into our apartment to seal the vent with duct tape before the winter, then came back to remove the tape when spring came.

2 out of 4 dryers on site- specifically the bottom units- do will not dry close very well at all.

The management, apart from the above issues, seemed personable until it came to move out time. At this point, they were uncooperative about the security deposit and were rude during the checkout process.

Some of the best real estate in town.  MLA is conveniently located between the Capitol and the UW campus.  The building is relatively old, but it is clean, well-maintained, and the staff members are very helpful and responsive.  The lack of central AC can create an uncomfortable environment inside when temperatures rise outside, but window units are available for a small fee.  The gym in the basement contains virtually all of the basics for a quality free-weight workout, and looking out at the lake through the large windows makes running on the treadmill more enjoyable.  In short: good location, affordable rent, quality living environments.

Hola buenas tardes soy un residente de este lugar llevo viviendo aproximadamente 17 años y asta hora no he tenido problemas de nigun tipo el mantenimiento es muy puntual y con profecionalismo poreso le doy 5 estrellas gracias maple glen
The complex is convient for my work and shopping. But they keep raising the rent every year. Maybe it's time to move on. I love the boatyard tho.

My apartment has a view of lake Monona but whenever we have something break or something that needed fixing from when we moved in the maintenance team didn't get here until 2 months later or not at all.

Lived here for a year and it was my first apartment. Enjoyed my stay here and would recommend others to consider it. The management is friendly and there’s great options for the metro bus. It’s also nice to walk around the neighborhood or to the park when the weather is nice.
The on-site management is great. They are always quick to respond, either via email or in person. They are very helpful with maintenance requests and any questions that you have about the property!

Amanda, the property manager, truly cares about people, her job, and is such a professional!!  Amanda has been helpful every time I would ask questions about my apartment, i.e., parking, rent, and maintenance.  Renting at Maple Grove apartments has been a great experience and if I wasn't moving out of state, I would continue to make it my home.  Thank you Amanda for your help and professionalism!!!  It's going to be challenging finding an apartment community as awesome as this one!!  Highly recommend living here at Maple Grove Apartments!!

Management has been amazing! Even after accidentally flooding the place, and causing damage to the other floors, they are working with my budget to make a repayment plan.. the apartment itself is nice, large and not noisy at all. It’s been a great place overall but I’ll be especially thankful next year when the closest bus stop will move closer - about half a block away. I love that my building is wheelchair accessible and has central air instead of an ac wall unit in the least used room in my home.. the only real downside for me is the carpet in bedroom and living room is so light it shows every little bit of dirt my wheels drag in…

We’ve lived here for 2 years and within this time frame, there have been 4 different property managers. Seems nobody wants to keep a job here. Management is never on the same page! The maintenance person is rarely on site and does sloppy work when he is around. There are huge issues with smoking here (cigarettes, weed, etc.)! I don’t know what these reviews are referring to when they say management does not tolerate smoking.. we have reported incidences of smoking multiple times and management has done nothing. I assure you your unit will reek of cigarette smoke upon move in. There is trash everywhere on the property and kids running aimlessly down the halls at all hours of the day/night. People take advantage of our parking lot and have no respect for your car. My car has multiple scrapes and scratches from disrespectful people who don’t even have parking stickers. I’m glad they’re finally towing those cars out of here! Fire trucks and/or police are here at least once a week.

We will be beginning our 2nd year here soon and love it. Yes, there have been some problems with smokers of both cigarettes and weed as well I believe other illicit drugs, but like the other tenant said it gets taken care of. There are many people, young and old that have health issues here and the NO SMOKING RULE is a GOD SEND for them. Please respect that when considering moving here. The issue with garbage is adults having their children take it to the garbage room and them not being able to lift the bags up to put them in the containers, so, they are left on the floor. The other issue is people not breaking down boxes for the recycling container. But otherwise, we have met some of the kindest people here and for the most part it is QUIETTTT!! There is more noise from traffic then the apartments.

Hey guys this place is awesome! Most of the tenants are super friendly especially those on 3rd floor... Huge and absolutely stunning apartments at unbeatable prices! Management is great and gets maintenance requests done with in the hour! If their ever is trash anywhere which albeit rare, it gets taken care of... As for smoking this is a NO SMOKING apartment Complex! If caught or complaints arise of smoking the tenant to whom responsible will get prompt 5/Day Notice! I love that! It's truly a great place to live and the surrounding community has very low crime rate! I L.O.V.E it here!!

Major smoking problems! Cigarette, pot and other illicit drugs. Management refuses do take action!

Building grounds trashed inside. Dirty diapers, chicken bones, bags of trash...
If you want to breathe and not be harassed by your neighbors, Don't move here!!!!

1. Very close to highway, so it's super loud if you have your windows open.
2. The water tastes chemically, so you'll need a filtered pitcher to drink or cook with.
3. Horrible neighborhood - just this weekend, someone drove by and ripped the railing off the steps downstairs. It is NOT SAFE.
4. When you are moving out, they bring people through, but it's hard for them to find renters, so you'll have tons of people in your apartment. We aren't moving for another month, but we've already had fifteen people tromping through our apartment, even on Saturday!

You can find better accommodations at the same price or cheaper elsewhere. Save your time and money and don't choose this one.

The actual apartment I rented was charming, but outdated. The loft provided a non-typical layout and ample space for a single renter.  Kitchens and floors could use significant updates and remodels. Be sure to take your time completing the check-in form before your belongings are moved into the unit.

As a single female renter, the unit/neighborhood is not ideal. Due to the low rental rates (related to proximity to the highway), the building attracts a tough crowd. There have been many instances when cops have been to the unit, and often I receive knocks on my door late at night. 

Wish I could transplant this unit...

Very close location to sun prairie, and east Madison. Close to all amenities including shopping centers and grocery stores such as woodman's and Aldi's. Easy driving distance from Madison technical college. Great neighborhood and surrounded by several hotels. Lease owners are very easy to talk to and make sure all help is given. Apartments are clean and very simple to make into a home.
They do not follow up to emails/calls. Once they do they are very rude and not very well to work with.

I've lived here for almost 11 years and I've never had a serious problem with any of my neighbors. Until my current upstairs neighbors moved in, that is. I've sent three emails to the property manager over the last four months complaining about the noise they were making and I was ignored each time. After getting no response, I followed up with a phone call. The property manager was very rude. She confirmed that she had received my emails, she just wasn't going to do anything about it. The one time I ask the property manager to do her job and, you know, manage the property, she refuses.  I would not recommend living here.

The maintenance staff is very quick to respond should you have any issues.  The grounds are kept clean and beautiful looking.  The property manager is wonderful & friendly.  This has been the best complex I have lived it.  I feel safe here, it's quiet, and close to the mall/restaurants.  I always enjoy the community dinners they provide for us.  I would recommend Autumn Creek Apartments and the management team of Gold Leaf Development are wonderful.

I just want to say that normally I'm not someone who would ever leave a bad review, but in this case my experience with the apartments went downhill during my time there.
The apartment itself was pretty nice for the price point, however the fitness center has taken a turn for the worst with the machines frequently out of service and the cleaning wipes always out of stock.
My biggest issue, though, was the fact that the leasing office was almost impossible to work with.  I would call and leave messages, I would email, and they would never respond.  I usually ended up having to leave work early to go into their office whenever I needed something.  This was particularly problematic when a washer issue caused my apartment to flood, and the leasing office wasn't helpful in scheduling follow up to take care of the issue.
