The maintenance staff are the nicest people and quick on getting any of our maintenance issues fixed. The office staff are all so friendly and on top of things. We feel we are listened and cared for here. 
We live on the 1st floor, we rarely hear our neighbors. I don't know about other areas of the complex but our area is very quiet with friendly neighbors whom I've made friends with. I don't have any parking issues what so ever. Even late at night. My family and I also enjoy the tennis courts and taking walks. It's very pretty here. 
The school is phenomenal. I can easily say it's the best school my son has attended. We have struggled with previous schools, but this one he has really turned abound in. Both socially and academically. 
The location? You can't beat it. Located in Walts backyard and close to anything you could possibly want or need. 
As far as bugs are concerned.. It's an apartment.. In Florida.. Where it's hot and humid. You're gonna get some bugs sometimes. It's not that unusual. If you think there should be zero bugs, you're crazy. Go live in Alaska or something..  Just keep your apartment clean, people! Do your dishes and don't leave food out. It really is that simple. Pest control comes in once a month and sprays and checks things out. They are great pest control! With a great company like that, the only reason you have bad bugs is if you're not cleaning up after yourself for a prolonged amount of time.
Lemme see.. Love my apartment, staff, maintenance, the area, pest control, neighbors.. I think that covers it. Oh! And the rent is SO reasonable. Central to EVERYTHING. It feels like resort living. Not joking. And no, I don't work for Abaco Key, I'm not friends or family of anyone that works here (actually going back to school). I'm new to the area. I just really wanted to share my experience with this place so that people know. People only tend to write reviews if it's negative. This place is anything but.
The office staff and maintenance staff were super helpful when I moved in they are absolutely wonderful. I highly recommend this place the pool and grounds are super clean

I have been living here for 5yrs and new tenants get their work orders done first. When I approach the office to explain this, they always have an excuse after excuse. Saying they dont have employees from maintenance available and short on staff or even worse that "they cant find the work order" when they personally write it down in front of me.

I'm getting really tired of this and rent is going to go higher when not even the hall gets clean for months. 
So how will you answer to this because the company will quickly charge you for any little mistake but cant keep the office, employees and areas to living standards. This place is not worth your asking price for rent.

P.S. I have seen low income places better maintained.

First of all, I want to say when we first moved in we were really excited and enjoyed the staff. However, after a month or two. It was a nightmare and still a nightmare even after moving out. We have always paid rent on time and moved into an apartment that was not cleaned or repaired. Upon moving out we cleaned the carpets, deep cleaned the kitchen and bathrooms, and repaired the damages that were there when we moved in. This apartment complex has requested over $1500 in damages that are nonexistent. They claimed we lived there on an entire lease without renters insurance even though I have documentation proving I paid for it monthly up until the day after our lease was over. They claimed the carpets were not cleaned and the apartment was not either, even though I have pictures proving the apartment was spotless upon leaving. But I accidentally left my container of almond milk in the fridge which was a $50 removal fee. Their administrative abilities are horrendous and embarrassing to the Grey Star company which they are owned by. They can't keep a pool or complex clean at all. Many days I would go lay by the pool only to experience murky water and it to not be a normal color, the trash cans overflowing with glass bottles and beer cans. They do not pick up trash on time and they often have an excuse as to why the company WE PAY FOR won't pick up some nights. The staff does not return phone calls and will avoid you if they feel like you are a problem to them or will make them actually do their job. It would have been a GREAT community, however, the staff are some of the most awful people I have EVER had to deal with. I would 100% not recommend this community to my worst enemy.

I also LOL'd at their response to someone below, "give us a call! We're happy to talk." That's great, but you never call back or answer the phones... so that's 100% a lie.

This apartment may be in a great location but the management is horrible. Felicia is incompetent, doesn't even know the terms of their leases and gives out wrong information all the time. Aquiles the "assistant manager" doesn't know how to handle problems, and always passes them to Carmen who is the property manager.... oh but she is never in the office and never returns voicemails. All in all the location is not worth the headache that the staff brings. They also have roaches, the parking is terrible and the trash is never picked up on time or even at all some days. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I’ve been here 3 years it’s a great place office workers works hard and their great

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: Worst place to live, from an abundance of roaches to trash everywhere it’s horrible. The staff is very unprofessional and ugly. If I could just leave I would but I highly wouldn’t recommend this area for anyone even my worst enemy. Please do deeper research on this apartment complex.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I’ve been very pleased with living here so far! The community is quiet overall and the property is well taken care of. The maintenance & office staff have all been very responsive & friendly. Keep it up! :)

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: this application process has been the worst of my life!! I have lived in multiple apartments throughout orlando and this place has had the most unorganized incompetent people working here. They do not accept original physical paystubs scanned or picture only originally pdf which our place of work could not provide only physical copies which is not our fault!! we gave them physical copies which one worker said we be fine but then they later said they could not accept it. they then said to submit a formal letter of employment and once we submitted that they then said it was the wrong document and that they needed an offer letter instead. Ima specifically has not been helpful at all and also not updating everyone in the party of the situation. Overall, a waste of time and horrible experience! beware!!! do not apply here!!

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: Lived here for 2 1/2 years while searching for a home to buy. I didn't experience any of the issues I saw in the negative reviews. The staff was very friendly and anytime I had a maintenance issue, it was addressed quickly. Had some great neighbors (Eileen and Martin) and enjoyed my time here. Bought my townhouse, so time to move on, but leaving happy and satisfied. Thanks to the manager Crystal, and staff member Ellie who was always very helpful, and maintenance worker Andres, who was always available, even after hours, and also very friendly.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I have lived her over 3 months and still no washer or dryer. I have tried using the facility onsite washer and dryer and they are unreasonable expensive and do not wash or dry for the amount of money you spend. In addition, the basketball court is not operable to give our youth an outlet to enjoy outside. Lastly, the office personnel are not there to help the tenant but to help themselves not be liable. Definitely will not renew my lease or recommend.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I would not recommend this apartment complex to anyone, my family, nor friends. I’ve lived here since Dec. 2018, and what I thought would a great experience by the nice staff has turned out to be the complete opposite. My husband and I have endured pest issues since are move in. When questioned about the roaches from the first night, leasing agent stated they walked through and didn’t notice anything, which is a complete lie because there is no way they could miss it. We had to bomb the apartment are very first night. We kill mosquitoes and little flies everyday, which could be from the pond nearby. However, no excuses for the roaches. It has been brought to mannagement’s attention several times verbally and in writing, nothing resolved. They have put us on pest control, and the guy puts monitors everywhere and says he doesn’t see anything. However, I have pictures and videos, and the leasing agent says oh can you put in a ziplock so we can see, the audacity. The last incident I called up the office to fuss about my frustration once more after finding a roach in my 17 month old toddler’s crib before putting her down to sleep. I spoke with Ellie, who I asked to speak to the property manager and she stated she was in a meeting and would give me call back, never received a call back. I don’t think any paying tenant should have to worry about roaches ending up in your child’s mouth or ears. I can’t even sleep at night ever since finding the roach crawling around in my child’s crib. I keep my apartment in a clean environment to where I should not have roaches in my apartment. Can’t even have guests over because I’m embarrassed about this issue. This apartment has now become inhabitable and I’m counting the days for my lease to be over. If you’re okay with roaches, mosquitoes, and little flies then you will be fine. But what tops everything is the lack of concern from the staff.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: Bed bug infested. Property manager Chelsea is heartless,condescending,rude, lacks empathy or any human emotion. Neighbors can threaten you and get away with it. Upstairs neighbors can make as much noise as they want and inconvenience you and your peace up until 10:00 pm until the noise ordinance kicks in. No parking. Cars get broken into. WORST PLACE EVER FOR WHAT IT COSTS!

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I love our apartment community! It's a quite area and simply a  beautiful place to call home. I love that management is so family orinated and they sincerely care to bring us as friends and neighbors with their monthly gatherings.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: I like my apartment, its very spacious and modern. The gym is very nice as well as the staff. My only wish is that I wish it was gated like the sister properties

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: The size is decent, and location is good. .. but everything else is mediocre at best. The parking is laughable, and if you say anything to the office, they tell you there's sufficient parking, get over it. Maintenance takes forever to fix anything. The rent is far too high for the value of this place. The "imagination room" of really just cutting off your living room, making it impossible to arrange furniture.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: My husband and I moved here 14 yrs ago. Maintenance take long time to make any fix to your apartment. The apartment building is full or roaches, spiders. It's disgusting. You can not even park in front of your own building because of all the "visitors. The good thing  is its close to 429 and I 4. And it has a lot a room.

apartmentName: The Grand Reserve at Maitland Park
review: This apartment is perfect for me and I love the location!

I am pleased with the improvements brought by our new apartment management office. The staff are always friendly, enthusiastic, and ready to assist, which truly makes a difference in our community.

Recently, they repainted the building's exterior with a fresh white and blue palette, giving the entire property a brand-new appearance. The enhancement has greatly uplifted the overall look and feel of our home.

 Maintenance requests are handled very fast. Even when issues are complex and require multiple visits, the team remains positive and solution-oriented.

I appreciate the hard work of the management office and maintenance team. Their commitment to excellence has certainly improved our living experience, and I look forward to seeing even more positive changes in the future.

WOW. I wouldn't recommend this place. I had a lease for a year and within the first few months i had so many issues! Upon move in i was given the wrong keys, the unit was disgusting and not ready at all. I walked into a bathroom with lifted flooring, wasps nests on the balcony and a very moldy smell throughout the apartment. The management at the time did get things "fixed" quickly but month after month something was wrong. The gate was always broken (even under new management)  and the roach problem is outrageous there. I ended up paying for my full lease but moved out two months early because the roaches kept getting into the smoke detector and that was going off random times of the day and night. As someone with anxiety this did not help AT ALL. And i tried to do everything in my power to get rid of the roaches but with the building being so old and the amount of water damage in these units you are legit paying for the roaches to live there. Additionally... the neighbors????? I felt unsafe about a few because on one side of my unit there was constant fighting and the man in the lower unit across the way was always drunk (I know this isnt a reflection on avisa lakes but the neighbors are something to be cautious about) ANNNNND ALSO, I was a second floor unit...this being said when i would take a bath  (without over filling the tub) the people below me would constantly bang on my door to get my attention that the water was leaking into their bathroom.....i only took a total of 2 baths because from this point on i was terrified of their unit becoming worse and terrified of having them bang on my door during a bath that is meant to be relaxing. We contacted management multiple times but i dont believe this was ever fixed because it was a piping issue that would require major renovation.  .......Beware... on move out day I came back and was going to take video of how i left the unit BUT PEOPLE WERE ALREADY IN THERE RENOVATING.  i didnt make that clear to management nor had i turned in keys, or signed official leaving documents. DO NOT let the renovations fool you either. they just slap in "new" grey flooring and fresh black appliances  You'd be better off in a new build apartment WITHOUT the families of roaches. All this being said, i did at least get my deposit back a month after my official move out....not sure if that would have been the case if they didnt have people renovating before my official move out but just be mindful of what you are getting into.

As a woman, I am very cautious of my surroundings and safety and this apartment complex has made me anxious through the roof. 
First off the front gate hasn't worked since February and that was one of the selling points when picking an apartment in the first place. 
Also, there are basically no lights... I like going for walks but can't because the pond has no lights around it and what makes it better is that the two street lamps in front of my building were run into by a truck a few months ago, I guess that will be a few more months until that's fixed too.
Just to add to the overall darkness of the area at night, my building's outside lights have been off for 2 weeks!!! I've complained to the front office but still, nothing has been done about this... there is not a sense of urgency about this management company or any slight sense they care about the residents here. 

Summary: Don't move here if you care about safety or if you simply want a lit-up space outside at night. Luckily I am moving out soon because I miss my night runs.

I will start by saying that my experience leasing for Avisa Lakes has been riddled with bad experiences throughout the year, however, the new management company does appear to be better. With that being said I will now list below the issues I had during my 1-year lease. I would recommend not leasing here because the price isn't worth the apartment, also if you plan on living somewhere for more than a year they will not work with you in the future. Residents of 15 years are not even being helped or considered in this situation, Corporate obviously doesn't care to keep long-term residents and appears to be marketing only to new ones. 
   
1. They are raising my rent and while I get the market is higher this 1 bedroom apartment is not worth the price. The outside looks nice but the inside of the apartments are severely outdated. Management company will not negotiate prices and will say Corporate doesn’t care and in their words.. “ they aren’t even negotiating prices with people whose lives here for 15 years”.

2. Took 1 Month to get access to the Amazon Lockbox system, had two packages stuck in there for a month. Lots of complaining to the front desk before they finally helped me.
3. Took 2 Months to get access to the front gate that closes after 6:30 pm, I was having to wait for someone else to go through to actually go into my own Apartment space. 
4. The Website to make payments for rent online has been down since June ( now November ) this causes all residents to go to the bank for a cashiers check.. 10 dollars each time and having to go out your way is annoying to say the least.
5. I started my lease and the Apartment was dirty, so I asked for a Maintenance guy to clean it before I moved in. I gave them a week.. this wasn't done. I also asked for two other maintenance requests and none of them were completed or even started. I fixed them myself so that is fine. 
6.  I started my lease and they tried charging me higher rent than we initially agreed on and after going to the office 5 times over the course of a week I was able to get it fixed finally.
7. The valet trash is a mess, they opened my bin sometimes and won't take the trash for god knows what reason. Then they will keep it open for Racoons and stray cats to destroy my garbage, which then they will attempt to charge you to clean up. The trash guys need to learn how to actually close the containers, especially if they leave trash inside.

There’s a gate that’s always open, and by always I mean 24/7. Do not let this people lie to you, also once they have your money they really don’t care, a service call can take up to 6 months if your lucky. There’s was a shooting incident inside the community last year, so you might want to ask about the safety measures they have taken every since… (heads up, none)

We love this property! Everything is up to date and well maintained! Maintenance is quick and efficient coming to fix anything! Staff and management are kind and helpful! We love calling this place our home!

They don't care about their residents! They're literally trying to bribe people to move in with a freaking tv ????. Im a current resident and you'll get a TV but it comes with no working air for 2 MONTHS. And they have a lot of roach infestations here as well.

The management is Incompetent. They will tell you what you want to hear to get you out of their way. I recommend not living hear at all . Worst apartment I’ve ever had to deal with in my 7 years of renting. If you are unfortunately already living hear, get everything spoken about in email or record your phone calls. This place is pitiful.

TLDR: Do not move here. These people break laws and contracts, levy random fees that were never discussed nor agreed to, do not care about you as a tenant, don't ever respond to maintenance requests, completely ignore emails, allow themselves into your unit without notice or permission, and if they don't like you for some reason they'll systematically try to evict you by not accepting rent. In all of my professional career, I've never seen more ignorant, unprofessional, underhanded characters. It became so extreme that I was forced to get an attorney involved in the situation. After I thought I was rid of them, they came back to haunt me again recently! Not only that, but the apartment is beyond repair, is cockroach infested, and they'll simply get annoyed by you asking for them to fix the problem and not fix it. Also, don't be fooled by the existence of a gate. In all of the time I lived there, I never once saw it closed. Please, I urge you, don't give these people the time of day. There are so many better options for cheaper in the Orlando area.

Moved in two weeks ago and very pleased with everything. The gym is large, not busy, and has everything you need and more. The pool is never crowded and seating is everywhere, shade or sun. I haven't met many neighbors beyond a friendly hello but they seem respectful and mature. The maintenance request I put in was completed in four days and fixed the problem perfectly. Every staff member I've met has been helpful and friendly. There is coin laundry if you don't have a machine, and a hookup in the apartment if you do. Parking is plentiful which is a plus. There is also coffee/hot chocolate/cucumber water/granola bars available in the clubhouse where the staff will be happy to see you come in. For the price this place is great for me.

The staff at Avisa Lakes went above and beyond and made my leasing experience a memorable one. From the first day after walking into the leasing office, until now the staff is very friendly and care about your concerns. From experience, the staff does what it takes to make sure that I, as a tenant, am satisfied and comfortable with my unit and the community.
Thank you Edwin and Angie for being great at what you do!

The floor plans are excellent, but the leasing price is not worth it. Old and out dated cabinetry, counter tops and appliances in the kitchen and bathroom, plumbing is so old you can hear every one turn on the tub water. Everything is simply repainted over or resurfaced, that have been here since the 80s. Day one and there were roaches in the unit as well as a particular "roach" odor and although steps were taken to rid the pest, more still appear. There are a considerable amount of reoccurring fees (too many) that add up to an addition $100 to $125 above the leasing cost that are not mentioned in the above expenses, per month, and trash removal is not included with the rent. The place has potential, just not worth the asking price, without so few more amenities in the unit (needs a ceiling fan in the bedroom), updated remodeling, and with "all" units having an available washer and dryer in them. Some office staff are warm and friendly (the one guy), while others make you feel as if you're bothering them.
paid 300.00 to be told no. we are just trying to rent an apt not purchase it. if we all had 700 credit scores we would buy a house not try and rent an apt. beware you have been warned

Quiet area very near Hwy 408.  Issues with administration keeping their paperwork correct (lost application, lost proof of renters insurance, lost car registration...honestly don't these things just stay in the file?) but they do respond quickly to maintenance requests and the grounds are always kept nice.

Chickasaw Crossing offers privacy with short drive to shopping centers and schools. It's beautiful landscapes offers amazing views and because its located away from the main roads you have very quite surroundings with gated access. The sparkling pool has a furnished lounge area with Wifi if you want to just hang out by the pool and a grill located inside pool area if you want to BBQ while your enjoying a swim. You can also take advantage of the gym located by the main office, with a variety of machines to stay in shape, with television and cold water to enjoy while working out. It also has a laundry room with with vending machines, racquet ball room and a brand new dog park. The staff is amazing, very helpful and maintenance team keep the grounds clean and respond immediately to every call. The apartments are good size with full bathrooms, laundry room, dining area and porch with extra storage. The neighbors are friendly and the price is affordable compared to other apartments in the area, there is really nothing I do not like about this apartment. If your looking for a beautiful place to live with a beautiful view, privacy, affordable price and convenient location, I highly recommend Chickasaw Crossing.

Lived here going on 4 years. The complex is quiet and most dog owners pick up after their dogs. It is located close to the 408 making commuting easy. There is a good mix of professionals and students and crime and noise levels are pretty low. The gates break down from time to time and the manager lives on property so she is pretty good about handling complaints because this is her home too. The rent was cheaper than most places around but they are raising it to be more market value
in good location close to downtown Orlando & the theme parks.  Low crime area.  Older units that need to be upgraded to match the asking rent.  Office staff friendly.

We where going through our application process for one of their units. throughout the process we would attempt to call or text a few times and never got an answer. the only time we could communicate with them was in person. Eventually, our application was canceled due to the amount of time that passed. However, we were trying to hear back about if our apartment would be available or if we had to switch. Now we're out the money for the fees and they're not willing to let us just reopen the application.

Moved here from out of state and didn't see the place before hand because my roommates mom picked it out for us so we could relocate for work. Before we even moved in none of the sinks worked, all the plumbing just backed up and wouldn't drain. Mold, mystery stains on the floor, and ants the entire time we've been living here. The other residents are the most selfish insufferable people I've ever lived near. Promises of fixing the screens on balconies, cameras, and a working gate since we've moved in and it's been 7 months and nothing. We pay too much for a disgusting apartment both inside and out. Office never answers the phone and upcharges for no reason. I literally can't wait to move out. If you're moving to Orlando GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!!

The property is great I’ve been here for a few months now and I can say that the office staff is great and friendly and the maintenance team is pretty efficient, I made a move in checklist upon move in and Terry came fast to fix all my issues I highly recommend Amara you guys rock!!!

PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE YOU MOVE IN.  If you have a family I don’t recommend this place. These people rented me a unit that had water damage in the A/C closet and the air ducts were filthy. What a nightmare. What ended up happening was mold built up in the air vents while my girlfriend was pregnant living with me.  They finally fixed it after months of us inhaling god knows what. The gates are always broken and security is around once in a while no cameras anywhere. It’s not the safest place at all! There’s been shootings, home invasions very close to that neighborhood in fact Amara at metro west Sent me an email saying I’m responsible for my own safety and to be careful and aware of my surroundings. Also, the apartment upstairs had a nasty cockroach problems a huge one happend to fall in the light fixture from upstairs and a couple more smaller ones. The dumpster is always a mess as well.

This is the worst apartment complex, over price for quality of units. Office staff very unprofessional, maintainince staff slow to fix work orders. Gate always broken an rentals rates are increased by over 100 yearly. Dont move save headaches!!!!!!

This was a great place to live then Bridge Property Management took it over and it became garbage. Broken gates, Trashed streets, Stray animals, RUDE OFFICE STAFF, and They put a soccer field in and now it creates so much disturbance, damage to cars and windows, Trespassing people, and the office staff does NOTHING to help including corporate. Don't bother with them they wont answer your phone or email back. This past month I had a problem trying to pay my own rent ON TIME! and when I tried calling while my husband was in the office she flat out told him "I will NOT answer your wifes calls so she can stop trying" So after that if you move here GOODLUCK

While Basil is a wonderful staff member, this complex is severely overpriced for the lack of support from property management, upkeep, and safety. From trees falling blocking the road, lights strobing, maintenance refusing to clean or repair broken appliances (they will literally take your broken appliance and put it in someone else's apartment as if it's not broken), the renovated apartments are merely the dcp apartments with the landlord white paint everywhere. The complex is also not safe at night, with tenets hosting ragers, and consistently hearing fighting and thrown furniture/belongings etc from multiple neighbors. Strangers banging on our doors, peering into our windows, using our address to mail packages to themselves, even stealing our own packages, I would not recommend this complex in good faith. There are brand new apartment complexes in this area at similar prices, with security and up to date appliances. Do not waste your time, money, sleep, or tears here.

Terrible management. Most of the residents don’t follow any of the leasing terms. Noisy and disrespectful neighbors and the management will never do anything about it. The complex is old and dirty. They’ve remodeled some of the units but I would hardly consider it a remodel. Runaway while you still can. There is plenty of better places for the same money in the area.
Great location. Apartments are still a little dated but the complex is working on some updates. Amenities are okay but very slim, gym is small and dated.
Good area to live in. Very walkable. Close to everything including an elementary school. Complex staff isn't the best especially when it comes to doing any kind of maintenance.
Great up and coming place to live! There was a few hiccups along the way but honestly not the worst I’ve dealt with and the staff was always nice to me while under Lincoln property management!
Great community and realy enjoy living at patterson . Staff are friendly. Maintenance team are amazing. Pet friendly place . Its safe. My family love to be here.

Poorly built so that you hear everything from neighbors and mine fight constantly, police have been here multiple times but management does nothing. Advertising daily for “Spa” but have only seen someone in there 2 or 3 times. Mandatory valet trash fee of 25month but they don’t pick up on weekends, have no recycling available except for broken down boxes, overflowing dumpsters with bags of trash everywhere. Dog park you have to crawl through the bushes to get to. Weekly emails threatening fines for putting trash out before 7pm and not getting cans inside fast enough, no furniture or grills allowed on your porch, office hours are a loosely followed, told access to Baldwin Park facilities but upon moving in found out that was not true. BUGS everywhere so bad I have to cover my dishes, stucco rotting off outside pillars, mold is covered with paint, apartments are so dark you have to use lights all day. The problems are endless, run. Seriously, the worst experience ever and I wait until I can move out!!! The only thing luxurious is the pool is nice the rest of it is lipstick on a pig.

This place is absolutely awful!!!!! I was one of the first people to move into this building. I had my entire ceiling replaced in my living room due to mold issues. Took them 6 months to finally fix it. I finally had to get a lawyer involved because they were dragging their feet. Not to mention the maintenance man told me during the process. Wow if this was me I wouldn't be happy... Yet he went to the people who lived across from me and told me oh it's not that big a deal. You replaced my whole ceiling and it's not a big deal?? Oh btw they didn't offer me anywhere else to stay during this process. My toilet was never attached to the wall. The office manager is useless. She must just online shop on her computer all day long because she never ever returns any call, and never has any idea what she's talking about. It's always "oh let me call you back." Never does. The elevators might as well move backwards their so friggen slow!! And btw they stop working every time it rains because there isn't a lightning rod on the building so it gets struck every time there is a storm. 5 story building. No elevator that works! Gets old. Pretty darn fast! Costumer service is HUGE. The only one who has a clue what she is doing is Nicole, and she only works the front desk. The lack of rent renewals should be the sign that everyone else has the same issue. Save yourself the headache!!!

I love my apartment! It's brand new and my husband, dog and I are the first to live in it :)
Not only a beautiful neighborhood but also beautiful amenities! There's a 24 hour gym with (obviously) brand new equipment for any type of workout. The amazing pool area, (that is never crowded), has a grill area and gorgeously designed decor, plus it's a salt water pool!
It's one of the safest areas in Central Florida with it's own little "bubble" magazine that informs the community about social events and fundraisers that bring the people together and raise money for a variety of good causes.
Friendly neighbors, extremely pet friendly with a park literally across the street - who could ask for more??

I've lived in plenty of apartments through my college career. I've had so many issues with past apartments. However, when I moved to Florida and my boyfriend and I found Azul in charming Baldwin park, I knew we had to move in. From the very start the staff has been amazing. The move in process was so simple and we moved into a brand new, clean apartment. We've lived in Azul since February and have loved every second! Not to mention the salt water pool and full gym is a huge plus! Feels like we are actually living in a resort! So glad we found Azul!

Having moved here from a highrise in D/T Orlando, I find this neighborhood quiet, safe and much less hassle getting around town from here. The buildings & windows are extremely energy efficient. Great staff and love the architecture.

This property is in a great location but don’t bank on having additional amenities.  They don’t tell you the beautiful lobby is closed every night including weekends until after you move in.  The TV by the pool and game simulator room have never worked.   This would be great amenities to have while living here but I have gotten use to not having them.  The package delivery system is confusing. Understandably people are getting more and more deliveries these days so they have you ship packages to a third party mailing address and then have a vendor deliver the package to your door.  It’s different.  Not only are your packages not safe when they are left in the hallway but your friends and family have to know to send packages to a different address.  Makes it awkward to tell people if they ship you a gift they have to send it to a different address.  There is a huge bug problem. One year at lake Nona Watermark and I have a few comments to make:
1. Maintenance does an Excellent job keeping the grounds, facilities, and apartments in great shape.
2. Lack of Privacy.  Be prepared to sign a 78 page lease the takes away all of your rights to privacy.  From photo/videos of you to entering your apartment with as little as 24 hrs notice.They came to review maintenance items two weeks in a row as a part of normal reviews with just 24 hrs notice. They came in and I informed the guy that I was in a video meeting.  He decided to walk behind me and start hammering the door latches which did not need any repair.  He simply was looking for something to do and looking to see what was going on.  Expect at least 1-2 of these less than 24 hour notices for them to enter your apartment. They can provide more notice, but they chose not to. Probably just reporting back to management what they saw.
3. Lack of Communication.  Don't bother writing the Office Manager or the Office Sales Manager via email.  This company which owns multiple complexes in the area must have a policy not to communicate via email. Countless times I wrote without any response. They prefer to speak in person so that there is no record of the conversation or decisions made.  They basically protect the company.
4. Requests for new service or upgrades.  Don't bother asking the Sales Manager to find a garage unit (optional) closer to your building unit. She promises to put you on a wait list and will call, but 14 months later and I never got the call or email or the change requested. Yet, there were many garages that became available over the course of that time. She is overwhelmed trying to handle all rentals, move outs, etc.  
5. Prices - the Company decided to raise rents in 2021 and early 2022 simply because the 'pandemic' had increased demand and 'everyone else is raising prices'.  Rather than trying to do the right thing for renters, they raised the prices to pad the Company income. My rent was increased by 42% when I renewed my lease. They knew I would have to accept it because I had no where else to go.
Overall, I was happy living there, but the issues presented here are quite troubling.  If you can find a different place that puts the renter in the front seat rather than the Company, I would recommend it. The 3 stars review is because the complex is maintained well.

So I called the office and left a message to say that I was confused because the manager said he would schedule these minor fixes with me. No one responded and sure enough someone from maintenance showed up unannounced while I was sleeping (I work late sometimes). I am really disappointed, feel that my privacy is violated, and know that all I will receive from this review is a "sorry" instead of them actually working with their residents to accommodate their schedules for minor fixes. Do not live here if you want your privacy respected.

Cons: HVAC during the spring and summer. I keep my apartment at 74 degrees during the day with thermal curtains closed on all windows. When it gets to 92 or higher outside, the AC can't keep up and it'll likely hit 77 or 78 before cooling down around 8 PM--running nonstop since 1 PM. I've called maintenance more than a dozen times about this. They've installed a new thermostat, and beyond that have told me it's "just the heat outside and there's nothing they can do."

So before you buy, you should know that the HVAC units here are old and in disarray, and the property management isn't going to do anything about it. But, if you don't mind having a hotter-than-normal apartment during the summer, then it's a great place to live. For me personally, it's unacceptable, and I won't be staying.

I wanted to take the time to appreciate the whole management at The Debra MetroWest. They are courteous and alway willing to help. We have lived there at this apartment complex for almost 10 years and thus far this has been the best management company that we have ever had.

Again thank you for all your hard work and for always doing the best you can to keep your residents happy.

You would think that this property is very family orientated but the only time they reach out and send emails is to just remind you of their rules and regulations , I've lived at other properties across orlando and this property is the only one I've lived at so far that doesn't offer any kid friendly activities during the holidays or anything ! Great place to call home, Staff are helpful and friendly. I'll definitely recommend arium metrowest to all. Maintenance is awesome.

I also tried sending Resident Portal messages and emails, with the same futile result. Now the time to pay this bill is almost up and my bill will probably be sent to collections.

This is absolutely surreal, frustrating and ultimately humiliating experience. But in hindsight, this is also something I experienced in nearly four years I lived there - the only way to talk to someone was to go to the office in person.

I'm not sure how is this even legal, not being able to reach the billing office by any means and after trying daily for so long. Just think about what it means to face these many difficulties while trying to give them money, and think what it means if it was you who actually needed anything from them.

roaches, spiders, homeless people knocking on my door at night, 400 dollar electric bill for one bedroom, front office doesn’t answer, outdated appliances, mold on outside and inside of buildings, animals get into trash, there was a murder at the pool of a young girl in 2020.

Super friendly staff, great location. Moved in about 3 months ago and it has been great so far. Last month I was even late for rent because I forgot and Thomas actually waived the fee since it was my first time! Great place to live!

Very poor apartment complex. Starting with the front office Verna was very unprofessional and pretty much unreachable as a property manager. Trying to contact the office is a nightmare. Office Management is never available and never takes calls.  The even trapped me with hidden fees.

I moved in 2 months ago and I love it, people are really nice, it’s quite and the staff it super friendly.

There were several times were lines were building out their office due to no one opening because their entire staff had to take lunch at the same time. This apartment complex is atrocious. There was mold in my ceiling that was painted over and called "fixed"! I've been living here for about four months now, it's a quiet neighborhood except for my upstairs neighbor I can literally hear their every move. Overall even though it's a nice apartment the price we are paying for it is not really worth it.

I rented the Addison floor plan, since I was living by myself on a contract job and didn't want to have to drive far to work. The location was very much a big draw for me, especially since there are a lot of "student housing" apartments in the area, finding a "real" apartment can be a challenge. There are still a lot of college students who live here due to the proximity of UCF, but there are a few small families as well, in addition to a couple of cops. It's a large property so I can't speak for every building, but my own was quiet and I didn't find the students to be rowdy.

What is nice about the location is that there is the Waterford Lakes shopping center barely ten minutes in one direction - with a movie theater, clothes, and all sorts of restaurants - and a Publix in the other direction, as well as quick access to two toll roads. There is also a bus stop right outside the gates. The only thing that isn't within a short walk or drive is an auto repair shop.

They have been renovating a lot of the units. While the renovations are nice, double check before you move in: my apartment had not been dusted up or vacuumed or anything after the renovations were done, so there was "construction dust" on everything, and I spent a few days cleaning it up!

That aside, sugar ants are in abundance, but the pest control services are free and I haven't seen any nasty pests - no roaches or bedbugs.

The landlords are friendly as well! They're prompt and professional, and I've no complaints about them.

I moved to Orlando a few years ago. I looked and looked all over the metroplex for a one bedroom with a screened in patio, washer/dryer, and hardwood floors. I’ve lived at Ariel for 2 years. It’s been a great experience. It’s quiet, I rarely hear neighbors, I feel extremely safe due to the Lake Nona Security officer who drives around the complex. Maintenance is very nice. Massey pest control is fantastic as well.

She went on to tell me that she would get ahold of maintenance to see what is going on, after about 10 minutes it continued so I called in again. It is virtually impossible to reach the office by phone-you just have to go there-which is fine if you live there but was difficult before we moved in and were trying to make arrangements-or if we were out of town. Best thing about the place is the enormous dog park-although it would be nice if they'd added some shade!

Be very careful and if you decide to lease here make sure to save all of your documents and receipts.

The ladies in the office are so responsive, whenever I need something done they help with a smile.

The only thing I wish was that the fitness center had a squat rack with barbells/plates or even resistance bands, but the TechnoGym stuff in there is pretty high quality.

I was ejected from the lobby of Pixon while I was making a phone call, because the assistant manager thought I didn't belong there. No apology from management after suffering this indignity.

Wow... time to find a new place to live.
fernando is a great assest to this vomunity, helped me though the process since day one, very responsive

Living here is a dream. This place is not only a clean, cutting edge, stylish community, but has quickly become the buzz of the town with it's new businesses opening on the first floor. There's so much more to the intention behind every detail of the development of this building. The apartment units are stunning with high ceilings, beautiful floors and windows that stretch 10ft tall from floor to ceiling. I'm not sure how much of an impact it makes, but the electric bill has been pretty now that we mainly use natural light. We've had the opportunity to meet each person on the management and facilities team as well. The staff here are all so excellent, professional, and has responded instantly to any of our concerns and needs. The residents here have created such a wonderful community, which is so rare nowadays. The developments happening on the first floor such as Foxtail Coffee, Tesla, and Island Fin Pokè Company have all of us residents on the edge of our seats in excitement. The place has a pretty nice gathering/lawn/park area on the second floor amenities deck when you cross the bridge from the top floor parking garage. The building is also equipped with a very cool techno-gym, dog wash room, amazon locker hubs, VR gaming station, and a skydeck on the 11th floor with an incredible view facing north. From the skydeck you can oversee all of Boxi Park (next door) along with the rest of the city of Orlando in the horizon.

I lived at the Addison for four years in the beginning it was great even though the first year I was paying rent for something that had no amenities after that management started to kind of relax parking lot. Lights were out most of the time making certain areas very dark Elevators broke down on a weekly basis people smoking weed everywhere even though it’s a non-smoking community. In fact, neighbors were leaving trash all over the ground, which got my dog very sick and I’m now going to be involved in a lawsuit with them the noise from the neighbors are ridiculous. You can hear everything  Police are there at least three times a week for garage is being broken into and domestic issues. The place looks very nice. The grounds were kept up much better at one time and just think of the noise you’re going to have in traffic from that new park that’s opening up right behind there  Stay away

Lived here for over two years. As other review mentioned, I can hear my neighbors through the walls and ceilings. When I moved in, they described it as you would expect in any apartment, you may hear noise. May was an understatement. It sounds like my upstairs neighbors slam the floor constantly at night like they're moving furniture, and I can hear the next door neighbors doing "other" activities at night every night right on cue it seems. 

Management also likes to constantly send blanket emails to the entire building warning of the smoking and garbage policies, but the place still smells like weed most days when you walk to your car, there are people smoking on the porches, and the garbage is supposed to be one bag per can per evening but people stack bags 3-4 bags high out of their cans, which results in the hallways smelling like garbage at night as pickups happen as late as midnight. You also get the people who put out 3+ bags of garbage in the summer on non pickup days so it gets to just rot in the heat, and you know fees aren't being handed out because they have continued to do it (same apartments every time). 

Pest control has been poor as my dog will constantly kill large cockroaches, and at one time I even found a baby scorpion in my bathroom. I had an older car and rats got into my car and ate a hole in my backseat. Had that car for ten years, can't say I ever experienced that before. Another person had mentioned they also saw rats around the community early on. At one point I found a 3 foot snake outside the complex that was domesticated (used to own snakes), so I guess someone who lived here decided to let theirs go, but that's roaming around now somewhere. Stray cats, etc. 

The complex features new digital locks instead of traditional key locks that have a phone app. If yours breaks you get locked out of your apartment for an hour+, during business hours, while you wait for maintenance to take their time getting to you. There's no other alternative. It broke again a year later and the second repair now causes it to take up to 8-10 seconds to even register and allow me to lock/unlock the door, which it didn't do before. Maintenance says "it's just going to be like that now".  

And none of this covers the dog waste everywhere. Nobody cleans up after their dogs, and clearly no fees are handed out. If you have a dog, you will deal with everyone else's mess.

The place looks great! Maintenance is great, staff is great. I’m leaving 2 stars because I want people thinking about moving into this place to be VERY aware of the EXTREMELY thin walls and thin ceilings! Through out the day I hear my neighbors, talking on the phone, I hear their entire conversations. I hear their phones vibrate. If I’m close enough to the wall I can feel them vibrating. Neighbors who slam doors, send vibrations through my entire apartment. Imagine waking up to loud stomping and your glass dishes clinging together and your entire apartment vibrating while the neighbors above stomp and run through the house. This literally happens all throughout the day and night. Unless you plan on living on the very top floor, do NOT rent here. It’s really unfortunate because there is nothing management can do. The buildings were just built incredibly terrible…

I’ve been bouncing around renting apartments for the last 7 years or so, and it’s going on 4 years I’ve stayed here at park central. The amenities and leasing staff are nice, plus there’s an excellent pizza shop here that I can say is genuinely amazing and convenient. The maitenance guys are friendly and always show up at a timely manner. It’s also nice to have a security team at the front and throughout the neighborhood. The area is pretty nice anyway but it makes me feel that much safer to have them around. 
On the downside, Park Central will not hesitate to tow your car in the middle of the night, and when you go to pick it up for $180 at a junkyard in a terrible area, you’ll notice a “warning” sticker stuck on your window. I can understand getting towed because you don’t have a parking pass, but it is uncalled for Park Central to tow vehicles that they deem to be “unfit” due to having a broken window, flat tire, or late tags. I think this is an easy way for Park Central to make a lot of money and make peoples’ car issues 10x worse. It’s not a solution at all and there is no warning. It just goes to show that they can smile and be friendly, but whoever is pulling those strings truly doesn’t care about you even though you pay to live here. This didn’t start happening until this year though, so hopefully they take this into consideration and try to come up with a better solution that frees up parking spaces without burning holes in pockets. 
Other than that, I’d recommend Park Central to anyone considering to make a move here. Rent is expensive no matter where you go, but Park Central could lower theirs a bit based on what you get. The units are standard so it’s really what you make out of it. I love my apartment and have made it my home during these last few years. People come and go for the most part, but it’s nice to see groups of friends and families walking around the lakes and neighborhoods. There are always events, classes, and parties at the restaurant and gym which always has a fun turnout. I hope this helps for anyone who is interested. Good luck in your search!

This complex is using COVID as an excuse to keep their amenities closed!! I am paying so much money to live here and all the hot tubs have been closed since March and they have limited the pool hours in which they are barely open during weekdays and are closed entirely on weekends. Again they are using the virus as an excuse to reduce the costs of running things and keep things closed or with reduced hours!! The basketball court is also only open 4 hours a day which makes no sense! And you have no privacy while playing as they have a security guard watching you play the entire time because someone got shot there years ago. It really is awful here. All the pools and hot tubs should be open with normal hours, let people live their lives!! The governor of Florida gave the entire state the "all clear" to go back to normal several months ago yet this complex refuses to do that. Do not EVER live in this community!!

I love my new home it’s amazing! But what truly got me to say yes this is my home is my leasing agent Ms. Marvia she is outstanding, kind , helpful and her customer service is so professional she truly know how to help new family feel apart of something great her personality is everything as well I can just brag on and on about her I love her if your look for your new home park central at Belmont is the place to be and ask for my leasing agent Ms Marvia because she is what complete the full experience

We have had some experiences living in several places here in the US, more specifically in Orlando. We have had exceptional service and we loved having chosen to live here. The infrastructure is excellent, the location is great, everything is always well maintained. We hope it continues like this, because choosing a maintenance team for a building complex like this requires qualified, meticulous and diligent professionals. We loved living here and we recommend it to anyone who wants to have an incredible experience to come and visit and apply to live here. You won't regret it.

The clubhouse is gorgeous and the pool is great but from there it all goes downhill. If you need anything, good luck- the team in the office only answers the phone about 25% of the time. They are terrible at communicating any inspections or maintenance and sometimes give no notice at all when entering the apartment. I had to get a ring doorbell just to watch them. It is apparent the upkeep of the buildings is not a priority; trash at some point leaked and was spilled in the hallways and has been there for months collecting dirt and bugs and is a huge eyesore. Paint peeling off the walls and now all of the balconies in the building are being closed for the next six months with one day notice due to the fact that they are collapsing. Building maintenance has not offered any storage solutions, but offered $50 a month off rent…which is not enough to rent a storage unit. The office team does not enforce any rules with the pool deck and there are often loud parties with glass bottles, smoking, and big speakers right outside my windows. I have complained multiple times with nothing done to address the issue. I didn’t want to spend the time or energy moving, which is why I haven’t but I will be now.
Great place to live! Everyone is so welcoming and helpful. The 1/1 layout is perfect for a single person and the modern design is beautiful.

If you’re considering moving here, I would strongly advise against it. We went to tour the place as a potential resident, but were shocked to learn that residents are not allowed to use their balconies. This is a huge downside, especially when outdoor space is such a key factor in choosing an apartment. It feels misleading and disappointing, considering the balconies are clearly visible and you’d expect them to be functional. If outdoor access is important to you, this restriction is definitely something to keep in mind.

Malo: cucarachas, estacionamiento difícil de conseguir, pasillos siempre sucios y estructura del edificio visiblemente deteriorado.
Bueno: áreas verdes, piscina, actividades familiares y el personal administrativo amable y siempre sonriente.
Not much positive other than slightly above average Orlando apartments. You will be comfortable and safe but definitely not the living they try to sell you on.

I will not recommend it, because the structure is made of wood,  so you can hear your neighbor walking to different parts of the unit. Also, the hallways have carpet so they are always stained and smelly. Yoga gym has a permanent leak that live a mildew smell in the whole gym. Many Pitbulls pets and only two of three EV work.

Use to be good, then they sold the place and it’s terrible. Everything’s broke. No one cares. They are trying to add a 35$ parking fee per car per resident on renewal lease. It’s not a nice place. It used to be when it first open. Not one grill works they’ve been broke for months. Terrible.

We came to see the apartment, manager asked to check in and wait, in 5 minutes after us came other people, we waited 15 minutes and then she called people who came after us didn't even say us a word! Like we are not existing! I never met that much rude altitude before in any place! I'm sure it shows their altitude in everything. If you don't wanna be humiliated don't go there.

Moved here several years ago & had nothing but good things to say. Unfortunately since UDR took over they really let the place go. It infuriates me because there is so much potential for this complex.. we’ve had so many issues with poor communication & complete neglect of duties. There was a leak in our apartment BEFORE we moved in & they knew about the leak. Then decided to let us move in anyways, proceeded to tell us they had no knowledge of a leak even though we are now good friends with the previous residents that lived in this apartment & they were SHOCKED they let us move in before fixing it! It took them 3 months to fix, the the previous residents had to live with this leak for over a year. They offered for us to move out, however we JUST moved in. we paid $1,000 early transfer fee so we could move into this specific apartment, plus we pay about $1,500 more in rent because of moving from or 1 to 3 bedroom. Meaning we just spent about $4,000 just to get into this apartment.. we were running a dehumidifier in our apartment 24/7, I had to wash towels & clean the blinds, walls, trim around the walls & floors every time it rained, the leak was there for 2 hurricanes and ALL of rainy season which means it rained almost every day for 3 months. they gave us a $300 credit. and they literally replied to our worries by saying “you’re free to go if you want.” Instead of apologizing & owning up to their mistakes! Zero accountability. Again, ZERO ACCOUNTABILITY. the leak was not fixed before the hurricane & I have a substantial amount of evidence that the leak was never fixed before either of the hurricanes. Not only do you not take accountability, but you all are liars.

This place was so nice when I moved in, and the staff was great.  Since changing to UDR, it's been completely downhill.  First they provide zero communication about what's going on in the community or expectations - simple things like when the office is closed on a holiday or events (which don't happen anymore). It's also a gated community. However one of the gates has been broken for MONTHS, and many of the doors to the buildings are also broken.  I guess they don't care about people's safety. The landscaping is now just burnt grass (for the small amount of grass there is) and dead shrubbery. The dumpsters are constantly overflowing and at least once a week, the valet trash people do not show up.  Don't even get me started about the fire ants. Yes, it's Florida, but they are EVERYWHERE.  I have to be careful where my dogs go to the bathroom because then I end up having to brush the fire ants off of them.  Every email I've ever send them has been ignored plus multiple maintenance requests that were just closed without any resolution.  It took them over 2 weeks to send someone to spray for ants (when the request was closed 8 business days later, it just said "called pest control" - it took pest control another 6 days to show up).  

They are raising my rent by 26% for my new lease. They are renting them cheaper to new residents.  Great way of treating your current tenants who you might want to stay.  Maybe with the increased prices, they can fix the broken gate (but not likely).

NO INSULATION at all! I live on the top floor and I can hear people's footsteps from downstairs!!! I have never experienced this in my life ( lived in 5-6 different apartments, mostly top floors) 
I would suggest to listen to noise when viewing this apartment. Amenities are great, but the building itself is poorly constructed, management is horrible. They won't reply back to you at all. The two staff (the only ones i see at the office) will listen to you, they are nice, but understaffed.

I have been living here for 10 months, several times I was unable to use the elevator because it was not working. This month is the worst of all, we are without elevator practically the whole month. When they rented the apartment to me, they said it was a luxury condominium with an elevator and several other amenities, justifying the price. I'm struggling to get up and down with heavy stuff every day and paying full rent. At first, the administration doesn't care much, I'm trying to resolve it amicably.

The entire Veer team was changed, Emerson and Sandra are no longer part of the team, they were so praised and good for the residents.

Updating... Even showing how bad it is for my family to live here with this constantly broken elevator, the veer administration didn't care and said they won't do anything.  Basically they said that this is my problem and that I have to pay everything and pay all the fines if I want to leave early.  I even had to hear that the elevator, pool and other amenities are not part of the rent, lol what a joke.

Think about it , you could be next !

After looking at several locations in central Florida that all had similar state of the art amenities and  apartments/layouts.

We chose Veer due the outstanding customer love that we experienced from day one. It was very clear that the management team and front office staff truly care about the residents who call Veer Apartments their home.

Emerson truly made our experience and application process pleasurable. He was courteous and friendly and efficient and responsive to all of our needs and questions. Totally knocked it out the park for sure!!!

Sandra was always available and knowledgeable during the process and offered her assistance for any and all things.

Eric has such a warm and welcoming approach while conducting business and puts his special twist on things to personalize your experience.

The grounds are well maintained and the cleanliness speaks for itself.

We can’t thank you enough for everything!!!!

Best-
Jodi Russo

Changed owners weeks after I moved in. Just moved out and move out walk thru stated perfect condition. Days later I received a bill because they want to replace the carpet (does not need to be replaced, I have pictures to prove this and I had heard they were replacing the carpet regardless and charging the ex-residents). Before deciding to move out, I had to ask more than once about terms of a new lease only to discover they do not offer current residents any type of discount to stay - the new rent was the same as those for new residents. The location is good, but there are newer apartments in the same area for the same or better pricing.

I moved at the VEER Apartment in December for employment. Starting a new position is stressful enough as it is; moving to a new place not knowing what to expect is stress on top of stress. The VEER Apartment Staff unanimously made me feel welcome. It is like they rolled the red carpet. The apartment was ready on the time they projected. I fell in love with the facility. Erik and the manager, Sandra made me feel right at home. After inspecting the place, I found a couple of issues. The maintenance crew was on top of it in a jiffy. I love it at the VEER Apartments. They have a spinning room joined to an exercise facility. The grounds are well-kept too.

apartmentName: The Oasis at Moss Park Preserve
review:
While Oasis at Mosspark's infrastructure dazzles, our experience with the office staff dimmed its shine. The service fell short of the professionalism and courtesy expected for such a community.

 Access restrictions in social zones, while understandable, were handled inflexibly, leaving us feeling unwelcome with our young daughter 17 y/o.  The promised complimentary wine was limited to "special events," adding to the disappointment.

 Most concerning was the consistently rude and dismissive demeanor of the office staff. Their communication lacked warmth and understanding, making us feel unheard. Attempts to offer feedback and find solutions were met with terse, dismissive responses.

 It's unfortunate that such a beautiful community is marred by unprofessional service. While the infrastructure impresses, the lack of basic courtesy and problem-solving skills from the office staff impedes families like ours from fully enjoying the amenities and feeling valued.

 For a respectful environment, I suggest reaching out directly to the community manager or the real estate company. I hope highlighting this experience contributes to a positive change in service culture, ensuring all residents feel welcome and appreciated within this beautiful community

apartmentName: The Oasis at Moss Park Preserve
review: Top notch customer service! I truly appreciate the professionalism and excellent customer service. Apartments and amenities are nicer and newer than any other property I have seen in Lake Nona.

apartmentName: The Oasis at Moss Park Preserve
review: Everything is like a paradise. The perfect place for living.

apartmentName: The Oasis at Moss Park Preserve
review: I love my new apt. very comfortable . the facilities are amazing and the girls in reception are fantastic. Yeanette helped me from the beginning in meeting all my needs to complete all the procedures successfully. 1000% recommended

I have been living here for a year and a half, and the staff has only gotten better with the addition of Megan. She is a breath of fresh air. I have always thought highly of Renee, Angelica and Jessica, and with the addition of Megan the leasing office has only gotten more fun and attentive to the residence's needs.

I’m entering my 3rd year at IMT Lakehouse and love the property and staff. The amenities here are amazing and the building has a presence (if that makes sense). The staff does a great job making the common spaces feel like home & they keep everything up really well (even though we have neighbors who often do not do their part to do the same). My dog is obsessed with his friends in the office - he’s showered with hugs and treats daily! I’m not planning to leave until it’s time to buy a house - love my apartment, my neighbors and the space. Also regarding the gate - yes it’s annoying when it’s broken but it’s breaking because residents keep hitting it.

This is by far the worst apartment I have ever lived at.  For the cost of a sizable home mortgage each month, you get a garage gate that has been broken for 4+ months, people pulling fire alarms at all hours of the day (including 2am), outdated/few gym equipment, thin walls/floors, dog owners that apparently don’t pick up any of their dog droppings ever, and an unsafe neighborhood with homeless people on Sand Lake/Turkey Lake on the rise.

Not to mention the constant horrible traffic getting in and out of this place if you have to get on or off of I4.  While I realize that isn’t the apartment’s adult, it’s still a factor in the awful day to day chore of living in this overpriced, poorly managed wreck of an apartment complex.

I’m not sure if these past “glowing” reviews are bots, employees or just prior to IMT taking over in 2021/2022 but do yourself a huge favor and stay away from IMT Lake House. Your hard earned rent money is better spent literally anywhere else.

The staff at IMT Lakehouse is the best. I would like to commend the leasing agents and managers, D Angelo, Angelica, and Renee. They made my move seamless and cut through all the red tape to ensure that I had a stress free and enjoyable move.

The maintenance department specifically Arturo and Ben, have addressed my every need. Even before I moved in, I requested fans be installed in my bedrooms. The maintenance staff promptly installed fans. All other concerns were handled equally satisfactorily.

I have only been here a few days but I'm very happy with what I have seen so far. The community is friendly and full of life. The amenities are great and numerous, but the true gem at IMT Lakehouse is the staff.
The staff made it very easy. Nathalie and Beth are excellent   So far I am very impressed with the friendly service.

Hands-down one of the best apartment complexes Ive ever lived in and certainly the best here in Orlando.

The property is beautifully designed and while I have a philosophy of never choosing an apartment complex for its amenities, with this one its hard not to; The awe factor is inescapable and even my friends have a hard time holding back their reactions when they walk through the door .

The units themselves are incredibly well designed and a joy to be in.

As for the location, it could not be better. Dr. Phillips is right next to I 4, international Drive, and restaurant Row: some of the best eats in the central Florida area. And with an Uber around every corner and the airport only 20 minutes away it makes travel a breeze. Its also very central the surrounding area. My place quickly became the meet up spot for all my friends in downtown UCF Kissimmee and Windermere.

I work from home myself and the office and business set up they have here really makes focus at work incredibly effective. The conferences can all be reserved, the desks are very private and I genuinely look forward to going to work every day at a place that isnt my kitchen table. It makes separating work from home much simpler.

As for the staff, I cannot say enough about them. They are the best people Ive ever met and thats just who they are as people. As employees, they go out of their way to make living here for us the best experience possible and it really is. They even organize the package room on a daily basis . For everyone of us here at the lake house and even for my own children they truly have become like family.
Rude staff. Once the sign you in an agreement, their hospitality goes out the window. Apartment has mold. They painted over it with white paint. Mold is back worst.

This is an amazing and great looking apartment complex. However, if you have more than 1 vehicle per person in the lease this is not going to be your place. 

Meaning if you are on your own you get one parking spot included in your lease. You would think well I have two cars I can rent a garage at $225 to solve this. NOPE. If you pay for a garage you are giving away the right of getting your free spot since the garage becomes the one an only spot for your to park. 

The indicated that the have limited amount of parking. I love the place and is high in my list but this parking limitation may be a deal breaker. 

It’s amenities are great, the units as well and the view is gorgeous and it all may deserve a 5 stars. The 3 stars is due to the parking restrictions.

They charge some of the highest rent in Orlando but yet lack the ability to even respond to their residents. Messages get ignored. The doors get stuck so you have to walk in the rain to another entrance and hope it opens. Common area's, gym and amenity Fans and AC are not working most of the time.  If there are issues that need to be addressed don't bother reaching out to the office they will not respond.  It is a shame to watch such a beautiful community get ignored.  Apartments and views are beautiful. All they need to do is get someone who actually cares about their residents and this might be a 5 star review.

Don’t live here, especially if you are a woman!! If you come home later than 11pm I promise you will not find a parking spot, 12am on a good night. They expect you to park a mile away from your car by the trash can and walk all the way back in the middle of the night and will tow your car if you park anywhere else then lie about where you parked to you and the towing company. It was also very difficult to pay my rent on their new system and the leasing office was very unhelpful! Completely ridiculous! and don’t even get me started on how my trash wasn’t getting picked up for days since the valet trash hours are slim and don’t work with my work schedule, there’s bugs, the walls are paper thin, and how the women who work at the leasing office are RUDE ASF!! I really wanted to like it here as this is my first apartment but I can’t wait till my lease is up :) I might even just break it.

I would NOT recommend Vida at Health Village.

Relocating from another state, I signed my lease in December 2022 and arrived for move-in, only to discover the building was in the process of changing ownership with a new property management company.

The building was initially well maintained but quickly deteriorated under new management. The parking garage would have remnants of dried vomit and half eaten fast food meals, left uncleaned for weeks at a time. Dogs were constantly peeing and pooping in the elevators, hallways, and stairwells. Non-residents were constantly waiting to follow you into the parking garage.

At most management would e-mail a notice or post a sign in the elevator to address issues. Otherwise, there was zero enforcement or follow through.

Amenities that initially appeared attractive, were practically unusable due to extremely cold air conditioning, random loud music constantly playing, and business center rooms that smelled of fast food and lacked soundproofing.

The location was only convenient if you worked across the street at the hospital but that was it. The surrounding area didn't feel unsafe but there were constantly homeless people hanging out around the building and the sidewalks were always littered with garbage and dog poop.

Nearly everyone residing at Vida at Health Village when I moved in are long gone or quickly departing, hence the dozens of vacant units.

Ultimately, I was relieved to get out of there.

I like living here with the exception of the noise. Management does not do anything about it. Walls are thin and there are a lot of gatherings in the courtyard at night. If you live on the courtyard side it echos.

This property is great! The property recently transitioned management and have handled it extremely well. They are extremely helpful and willing to find you an apartment that meets your needs (shoutout to Delia!). 

Pros:
1. This gym has a squat rack, dumbbells, machines, and barbells, reducing the need to buy a gym membership. Also has free coffee in 3 rooms, offices and meeting rooms you can rent out all day, and free internet in the amenity centers
2. Great location: near Mills 50, walking distance to AdventHealth, 5-10 minute drive to Downtown Orlando, Downtown Winter Park, and Downtown College Park, and 30 minutes to Disney
3. Traffic isn't bad if you take Dade Ave. vs N. Orange Ave.

Cons (Things that might not make it ideal):
1. Next to I4 so you get some of the noise, though it's not very bad and sounds like white noise
2. Sometimes you can hear others music in other rooms if the bass is heavy (that's kind of everywhere though)
3. Gym could get busy at past 5pm, but neighbors are super nice and are willing to work in with you.

This place has extremely thin walls and flooring you hear everything upstairs and to your sides. I have had trouble sleeping here for months with all the noise. I constantly hear footsteps, music, conversations, tv etc... There is absolutely no peace here I can't wait to move out.
Beautiful apartment building and professionally managed by a friendly staff
Alta at Health Village has been top notch all around, everything from amenities, the building, staff and location have been a joy.

The location is absolutely fantastic. the office staff are incredibly helpful and have helped me with every issue I’ve had. I love the layout of the apartment. I love having an in unit washer/dryer. The only downsides are that parking is a nightmare after 8:00, small kitchen that can’t have more than one person at a time, and the floors are thin and a bit creaky so I can always hear where our upstairs neighbors are
Everything from management to neighbors, well some neighbors.

My husband and I moved in when they first opened. We loved it then but we love it even more now with Nicole as the manager! Natasha is also amazing! They are making such a difference since they came in and we couldn’t be happier. We also love Chanel and Brad with apartment life! Highly recommend if you’re looking for place.

The apartments themselves are nice. People that do not live in the community come in for a free swim. There is no gate so anyone can come in and use the gym and pool. The tenants that live here are loud and troublesome. Bell Partners is one of the worst management companies to ever exist.
The Hudson blends excellent apartments with wonderful amenity spaces. I highly recommend the community to Metro west newcomers and long time occupants!

I’ve been here for about a year now going on my second. I love it the very interactive with their tenants. Everything is perfect Rent might be a little pricey, but everything is pricey. The staff are the best this is someplace you won’t want to think twice on.
Toured this community and it is gorgeous. The amenities and overall look of the apartments is amazing!
Stopped in to take a look. Beautiful property. Nice finishes and amenities
Beautifully built apartments. Apartments nice on inside. The floors are very clean

Altis at Lake Willis is an amazing place to live! The staff is friendly and always helpful, and the amenities are top-notch. The community is well-maintained, and the location is perfect. Highly recommend!
