We moved into a 3BR that is in the perfect location for us within the complex. I have enjoyed getting to know the staff during our application process. The apartment was sparkling clean- even the attached garage! We’re very happy to finally be here after reserving our unit in January.
I recently moved to Altis Grand Lake Willis and was very pleased with the reception and proactivity of the staff team. My special thanks to Isabella for her professionalism and dedication to helping.

The whole team is simply amazing and the reason I moved into this property. The attention to detail and patience was outstanding. Special recognition to Chantelle, Asia, both Jessica’s, Isabella , Melissa and Willy. I’m truly happy at this property.

El personal fue muy amable el servicio rápido son súper educados de verdad muy buena experiencia con el departamento de mantenimiento y el administrativo genial son un excelente equipo el condominio excelente llevo 6 meses viviendo y estoy muy conforme. Recomendado al 100%

The staff were incredibly helpful during the leasing process, and the amenities are top-notch. The community atmosphere is welcoming, and I’m looking forward to getting to know my neighbors. The location is convenient, with shops and restaurants nearby. Overall, I’m very satisfied with my decision to move here. Thank you again Joi and Matt for helping us find our home.

This is one of the best places i've ever lived. I love it here and highly recommend to anyone looking for modern living right in the heart of orlando! The office and maintenance staff are amazing, the apartments are spacious and well lit. 5 out of 5!

I came on my lunch break with no appointment Lilian stood up and shook my hand and made me feel so welcome ...in a genuine way. We had an amazing and fun tour came back to the office and met Chris. AMAZING STAFF Lilian and Chris made us feel like we were home already. We ca. Ot wait for our move to Orlando in 2023 because it'll be to Bayfront on Sand Lake without question. Thanks for being amazing yall.

We leased online! Can’t wait to move in and use their GYM! The equipment in there is so complete for what I need to burn & build but, what did it for me is their separate yoga room -wow-has it has The Mirror trainer built into the wall! Yessssss!
Also love the pet showers at the pet spa! so cute with its own tiny private steps! Home sweet home here we come! 
If you are new to the Dr Phillips Sand Lake area like my girl is, these apartments are Brand New, Just minutes away from fun on Idrive or delicious eateries on “restaurant row”, so we can meet up with our friends or family in no time. Plus, it’s such a short drive to the airport and downtown too! 
Once we meet the office staff and learn about all the personalized concierge services they offer, we knew why we had to choose this as our future home! Chris and Lilian were so helpful helping us choose the perfect balcony too!

Mallory Square has been a dream apartment from my very first interactions before arriving in Lake Nona. Micaela and Angela have been nothing short of stellar, and I’m beyond thankful for them both! They’re hospitable, timely in their responses, and above all, they’re friends to everyone living at Mallory Square.

The apartment and community are unlike any I’ve seen or lived in before, from the internal finishes to the clubhouse and the technology throughout! While there are still amenities being opened since it's a new build, everything we do have access to now contributes to a strong community feel.

I highly recommend leasing here and taking a tour. There’s something for everyone, making Lake Nona living even more special.
amenities are not up and they said they would be in December of 2023 .  People  have to pay full rent with no access to anything

I’ve had a wonderful experience at Encore Narcoossee! The apartments are beautifully designed with high-quality finishes, and the amenities are top-notch, especially the pool and fitness center. The staff has been fantastic, particularly Naesha, who was incredibly helpful and supportive throughout my leasing process, making my move-in smooth and stress-free. The location is convenient to shopping and dining, which adds to the overall appeal. I highly recommend Encore Narcoossee for anyone looking for a comfortable, modern, and welcoming place to call home!

The first thing that separates Encore from all others in Lake nona is the staff! The management is very involved in the property management. The management is in house and not absent like other places. The value provided for the facilities is unparalleled. Easy access to highways, downtown, groceries and medical facilities.

After my tour with Miguel. I fell in love with my apartment. The apartment has everything I was looking for plus more. The new upgraded appliances are such a plus.The property is well maintained and maintenance is so helpful and prompt. I'm so glad I chose these apartments.

This is an amazing place to dwell, calm and the leasing team are very professional. I see them going to places and the sky is their beginning. I am very selective, if I tell you an environment is good to live in, trust me. It's a comfortable and peaceful apartment to be in. Great job guys!
La distribucion del apartamento es perfecta. Los espacios comunes son super lindos, la atencion de su personal ha sido super profesional y enfocada en soluciones. Este lugar regala paz.

They advertise as “luxury” but we have had a car broken into and packages stolen from the patio. The trash is always over flowing, security doesn’t really do anything, and the leasing office is a joke. Honestly don’t waste your time coming here.

My partner and I are new Orlando residents coming from living in South Florida for many years. We were obviously very nervous about relocating and finding the right place for us. We took many trips up for weekends and toured MANY complex's in the Orlando and Kissimmee area and turned up with many places being unprofessional, dirty areas around complex and not enough amenities. We finally came across Park Central and were greeted warmly by Amanda in the main office. She sat down and spoke with us about our exact wants and needs which is something other places did not ask and gave us a tour of this neighborhood. From the kind greeting at the guard gate to seeing how nicely the property is managed and finally to see how beautiful of an apartment we could possibly get we were ready to put a deposit down. We were helped every step of the way and Amanda kept us in the loop of anything going on with our new place which was amazing, especially since we lived almost 3.5 hours away. She made the move in process amazingly simple and stress free and walked the apartment with us and immediately called her service manager or opened tickets for maintenance for any things we found in the apartment which were not to our expectations and they were fixed within a couple days. Our favorite room is our living room where we spend most of our time. We love our high ceilings and the space we had to decorate how we want. We are very happy with our choice of Charlestowne at Park Central and excited for new memories here.

I have lived at Park Central for a year, only moving out because I got a job somewhere else.  Of all the apartment complexes I have lived in the staff at Park Central were the best. Maintenance was super responsive and always were there within 24 hours of submitting a maintenance request. The office staff were always super welcoming and helpful (though going to the office in person was definitely better than emails if you need something done quickly). I also got to know some of the other maintenance staff (Vic and Miguel) and they were super cool and very good. The amenities are always well kept, the gym is definitely a huge bonus, as well as five pools, tennis courts, great side walks, and volleyball courts. If I was staying in Orlando I would definitely stay living here and have actually recommended it to a few friends looking for places in the area.

Where to start... Once you sign that lease be prepared to handle the consequences of the area around you. 1) If you desire to hear the neighbor upstairs stomp and make noise, move here. 2) If you desire to smell illegal substances 24/7, move here. 3) If you desire to hear people run up and down the stairs at hours late in the night, move here. 4) If you want to have your vehicle vandalized, move here. 5) If you desire cockroaches and insects in your place of zen, move here. 6) If you desire poor maintenance service, move here. 7) Lastly, the staff members at the Belmont office will be courteous at the beggining but once the deal is signed assume the responsibility of misinformed, at times rude and confused employees. Receiving your deposit will be channeling, I was almost scammed into paying a whole other month of rent due to their in capability of keeping track of move-out notices in advanced. If you desire all of these qualities then move here, if not find somewhere else far away this location.

I have really enjoyed living in this community. I've never had any major problems other than my bike being stolen off my balcony but i shouldn't have left it outside. They are usually pretty good at getting maintenance requests done as soon as possible. They have really good maintenance staff in general.  You need to call the office or just go in if you have questions because they have never gotten back to my emails. Front office ladies are great and Tom is very helpful when it comes to over all property information. I have renewed my lease once and i'm thinking of renewing it again just in a bigger apartment. You have to stay persistent when it comes to the renewal agreement because we were suppose to get our carpets cleaned and it never happened. Overall five stars, best place i've lived so far. Great gym and pools and love the convenient store.

I recently moved out because they wanted to raise rent by $150 or more, justifying it by forcing upgrades to the apartment that I & my roommate did not want. And they only notified us of the raise in rent 9 days before we had to give our 90 day notice to vacate, during the Christmas season, while I was dealing with a family member in the hospital for a heart attack. This pushed our lease out by a month, forcing is to pay a prorated rent for the extra time.

And now, they're telling us the amount given to us, which we got from them twice because someone in the office gave us a lower amount in a different notice, was wrong & they want $65 more from us.

This complex looked fantastic online, which had me excited. I was moving from Ohio down to Florida and was unable to view the property in person. There are 3 complexes--Manor Row, Charles Town, and Belmont. The community has a lot of amenities including a pool, sauna, grocery store, bar, restaurant, and gym. However, do your research as the road that the back of the complex faces is Americana, which regularly has shootings and stabbings. Security is lackluster at best here, as sometimes they will check ID of visitors, and other times they will simply let guests and Uber drivers pass through no questions asked. Not too safe in my opinion. Parking is awful as there are no assigned spaces, so it is first come first serve. If you get home later in the evening, expect to have to walk at least 1000 feet to get to your unit. My biggest complaints are the management and issues with the maintenance in the dated property. Maintenance requests which are not performed correctly resulted in me having no AC or way to wash clothes for over a week (Orlando is 95  in the summer) (ask for Vic if you move here-he is awesome) consistent billing issues so make sure you check your statement every month, and be sure to take pictures before moving in, as I am currently going through a dispute of over $400 in bogus charges. (This complex also charges a "cleaning fee" upon move out...something I have not seen another complex do) Office staff is helpful (especially Khalila). Parent company is Greystar which has a poor reputation. Please do your research before making a decision to be a resident of this community.
Community has great amenities and some of the friendliest staff. Maintenance is good with responding to repairs too. Nice gated community
I live by the tennis court and the pond with a fountain. Our complex has many amenities, including a great restaurant that even delivers!  We're closing to a great mall, too!
Great floor plans, fun community events, friendly office staff, responsive maintenance team and great location.

Park Central apartments has some of the best accommodations  around for all ages. Multi-pool areas located around the splash restaurant is a winning attraction. Nicely landscaped, Park Central has various apartment selections, so really its like living in a neighborhood within a neighborhood!  This place really welcomes you like no other.

One of the best things about Belmont is the location. The less driving in Orlando traffic, the better! So close to our schools (Valencia & UCF Rosen), as well as Universal, I-Drive and downtown.. so many things to do and opportunities for work. Publix is even directly connected to the neighborhood as well. Lots of amenities for the price, including 24/7 front gate security, pool, gym and even a restaurant & a little store located inside. Lots of trees and lakes give more of a neighborhood feel as opposed to just apartment buildings. All of our friends and family who visit are impressed with the entire Park Central community.. and we love it too. Great value for the price.
my apartment has roach problem, so embarrassing I don't like to have people over. all types of bugs come in even lizards. my first time ever experiencing something like this! iam ready to move!

Park Central is great for someone who appreciates convenience. It is literally less minutes from downtown, five minutes from numerous popular restaurants, multiple shopping centers, department stores and a few minutes from  the Millenia Mall. If you don't feel like driving to pick up food, or other necessities, there is a convenient store and a restaurant located in the community. Not to mention, there is a great gym with a sauna and group classes, that will make anyone cancel their current gym membership. If you like to have all of your needs within reach, Park Central Apartments will exceed your expectations.

The good things about park central are a lot of things security,gated community, there is a little mini mart in there witch I find very good just in case you need to buy milk eggs or just a little snack also a restaurant apartments are spacious and with good lighting one thing that is a little to much is the security I mean is good but a little over the top I would recommend anyone to move here

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Great central location ( close to Ivanhoe district and I-4),  good balance of size ( I can fit my dining room table! ), light (corner living rooms have 6 windows!), convenience ( well connected to garage ( thru bridge), good storage , great value for money, attractive amenities. Tour of apartment was delightful.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Staff are very considerate and responses to requests immediately. I love living here!

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: I wish I could give it more stars! I've been here almost 2 years and really appreciate the friendly and dedicated staff and how well maintained the property seems to be. They have a lot of different and fun events, a really great gym, new dog park, and even a mini market to buy snacks and drinks whenever. They also have a lot of regular food trucks that come every week. It's really close to my work and super close to Ivanhoe district so I can just grab a lime bike and go! My apartment is really nice with granite counters and lots of storage in the kitchen, which is a chef's dream! You can't go wrong with The Ivy!

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Always get good service whenever we put in a maintenance request. The staff are polite and helpful and patient if we have any questions.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Moving in was an excellent experience. Property has great amenities and very helpful staff. Location is very central! Tim helped us out a lot during the move! Thank you all again!

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: I"ve been living here for about 2.5 years and I've had the best apartment experience that I've had over the 5 years living in Orlando. The building is very well maintained and the maintenance staff is very responsive and efficient. The office manager and staff are very kind and truly care about making this complex feel like home. I appreciate the open communication and the fun events that happen regularly.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: There are so many great things about this place! Since I have been here a little over a year, they have had multiple events, super yummy food trucks every week, minimal maintenance issues but quick response the couple of times I've had to, helpful office personnel and very sweet, and just redid their dog park and it's so nice and huge! The apartments are very spacious and seem to be well maintained in the couple I have been in besides my own. I really lucked out! The Ivy is a hidden gem!

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Nawaka, Taryn and Kelly are amazing in the management office! Quick to respond and friendly. They work hard at making our lives run smoothly. They also plan fun activities and food trucks for our complex!

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Shout out to Dee, Taryn, and Angeline in the office! They are so helpful with the whole move in process. And Quan, the maintenance supervisor is awesome.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Moved in 2 weeks ago.  Big THANK YOU to Doretha & Nicole from the lease office, who have been so helpful patient with all our questions and requests.  They are much better than the old management company.  We were impressed how clean and new our apartment looks.  It is facing the swimming pool and it’s nice and quiet.  The building looks well maintained and clean.  So far happy to call this home.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review:
After more than 20 failed attempts in a week to get a hold of a human being at the complex to answer some pretty simple questions, and a total lack of response, I have no choice but to give these guys 1-star.

If this is how they treat you when you want to move there, I'd hate to imagine how they treat you once you've moved in.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: i would not recommend living here it is impossible to contact anyone. No one is ever in the office and no one answers there phone.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: Since I moved in last May, construction around the complex has been nonstop. Spruce street has been closed for almost 1 year now, King St was shutdown for months, Dade right in front of the complex was shutdown for a couple months and now Dade is closed again for a different construction project. The construction is incredibly loud and often the entire apartment building shakes. It also goes on at horrible hours. In addition, the management is absolutely horrible, is impossible to get ahold of, and communicates very poorly with residents (lets us know about things very last minute, if at all). I do not recommend living here to anyone.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review:
The Ivy Apartments seem to be pristine but is not at all. The location is great but that's all you really get for what you pay. 

I've listed below a list of things that we have had to deal with during our time here. 

1. Numerous appliance issues - A/C failures, Washer and dryer failures, electrical issues, pest control problems and much more. 
2. Since Fogelman has taking over property management they dictate to you what the rules are and how you as a paying client need to follow their rules. An example is how they started charging all existing renters a lack of rental insurance fee without disclosing that this was going to be enforced. Numerous tenants are now forced to prove they have had rental insurance all along just to get their money back from these fees. 
3. Customer service is non existent. Doesn't matter how many emails you send, you'd be hard pressed to get any response at all. They just ignore you until you'll forget about any issues you might have. 
4. Fire alarms - In the last year and a half the whole apartment complex has had to get up at 2 or 3 in the morning for fire alarms at least 4 to 5 times. Kids, pets, elderly have all had to step out of their place in the middle of the night for upwards of 30 to 45 mins at a time. No real explanation has ever really been given. 
5. Crime - There have been numerous vehicle break ins and personal bicycles stolen over the last year alone. 

Stay Away from the Ivy and any property Fogelman owns.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review:
We moved here when the building was brand new.  Beautiful space - floors, kitchen area, stainless steel appliances, but definitely new construction... you can hear every step or movement of the people upstairs and every dog bark the floor below.

Fast forward two years and three management companies later and our lease can't end soon enough.  Hallway carpets have never been cleaned, stairwells are rarely swept, and the office is now open vey limited hours that do not coincide with any professional work schedule.  Neighbors leave trash and cans in the hallway or in the trash chute room, despite the threat of fines.  Yes, the apartment space itself is still beautiful, but neighbors can be so inconsiderate and there doesn't seem to be any kind of penalty or accountability.

apartmentName: The Ivy Residences at Health Village Apart...
review: The interior features of the apartments are unique and beautiful-light grey wood plank floors, pendent lighting, granite countertops, marble bathroom sinks, stainless steel appliances,  subway style tile kitchen backsplash, etc.  The wall color is grayish which is a lovely more modern departure from stark white apartments. The kitchen has a HUGE amount of cabinet space which is fantastic.  Hallways and skyway are air conditioned which is surprisingly uncommon in Orlando apartment buildings.  Being so close to I-4 is convenient,  however,  it could be frustrating to hear or see if you get an apartment facing it.  It's close to downtown but far enough away so as not to feel too crowded in terms of traffic.  The parking garage in part of building 2, so if you care about not having to walk fat from your car you may want to request a unit in that building. It can be quite a distance from the parking garage to apartments in building 1, which could get annoying if you have to carry things from your car or make multiple trips. However, all of the ammenities such as the gym and cyber cafe are located in building 1, so if you value being very close to those features you may want to request a unit in building 1. The location is very close to the Winter Park area which has great shops, restaurants,  Publix, CVS, etc.

Burano Hunter's Creek....I needed to write and let management know about my wonderful experience with your leasing agent Coreene Zapata.  Last Thursday my partner and I visited the property to get a tour.  The property looks fantastic, the community seems nice and the apartment was warmily but none of these compliments would find its way here expressing my thoughts if it wasn't for your leasing agent Coreene.  She was very knowledgeable, welcoming, and took time to clear up any concerns my partner and I had.  If we get Approved, Coreene is definitely one of the reasons why we decided on this property.  Knowing that if any issues arise in the future, she will be able to assist, direct and help us.  This community is very fortunate.

If you want to live in a place where the patio in front of your house is like this and they don't take responsibility for leaks, then live here. If you think it's a safe place, you're wrong, if you think it's going to have a club house, then let me tell you to keep it closed, if you think that because they have 2 gyms you're done, I'll tell you that even putting the two together doesn't make one. The gyms stink and the machines are old. In the apartments there are no security windows, so if an emergency happens, it is better to have a hammer nearby. There is no parking after 7:00 pm and the lighting during the night does not work. This place is totally and utterly depressing.

This property was in need of a lot maintenance overall, but I liked the location. Huge mistake. My ground floor unit flooded during the hurricane - a few inches of water came in from under the floor boards and base boards, as well as ceiling leaks and water coming down the walls.  Water flooded the entire living room, kitchen and dining room and the bedrooms as well. I’m sure the building foundation is cracked and drainage is very poor. End result was damp walls, soaked carpets and now the unit is incredibly humid and has a horrible musty smell of mold. I’m certain the carpets, drywall and insulation, as well as vents are moldy. It’s been 2 weeks and management hasn’t even looked at the unit to assess damage.I have not been able to live there since the hurricane and  there is evidence of previous water/flood damage. I pulled the oven out and the outlet is supposed to be mounted on the wall is sitting on the ground - there is evidence of rust, so the outlet was sitting in water when it flooded. 

The parking at the front of the property is non-existent after about 8pm, and bugs (roaches, ants & beetles) have been a constant problem. Believe all the negative reviews, do yourself a favor an do not move here. It will be the worst decision you ever made.

Horrible... changes management as much as renters.... keep increasing the rent and not fixing major issues... AC units are old and causes crazy high electric bills and are too cheap to replace them .... gates constantly broken , not truly gated

They never answer their phones. Doors are locked half of the time to leasing office and sometimes when you walk in nobody is there. They were recently bought out by a new company and are now double charging for things which wasn't on the lease making your account go negative and getting fined and they won't fix it! Terrible management. Everyone in the office needs to be fired.

Not usually one to leave reviews, but I have never lived some where and had such a horrible experience dealing with a business. 

To keep it short: They will never answer the phone when you call, Matthew is horrible and doesn’t respond to emails, the place was falling apart, the “gated”community really isn’t as the gates were only not broken maybe 15% of the time we lived there. It was so bad that someone broke into 20+ cars, shattering all their windows when we lived there. Now that we have moved out, after never recieving a lease to resign after asking for it several times, they are trying to charge us for many outrageous fees, that they are not owed. Stay far far away from this place. Additionally, they tried to raise our rent $100-$200 a month when it was time to resign. 
Literally the worst place I have EVER lived.

If you like to live with mold, roaches and unkept grounds, this complex is for you!!! We had nothing but problems from the day we moved in here. We noticed mold after about a month and kept going to the office but nothing was done. The first time they told us to not use the oven. Oh, ok. The next time they Clorox wiped the mold covered kitchen and told us to keep the cabinets open. Like ok, let the mold fester to the rest of the house. Finally, the lead maintenance man came and realized the dish washer wasn’t connected properly, that’s what was causing the mold. We had to move to a complex 15 minutes down the road for a week. After our apt was supposed to be done, we get told that our apt is so modly we can’t move back in. So since they don’t have an equivalent apt available, we either have to move into a bigger apt and pay the difference or move into a smaller place... again, this is my fault how? Can you at least accommodate us after we had to move everything into a tiny apt 15 minutes down the road last minute THE WEEK BEFORE CHISTMAS? And to make matters worse, we had family in town. So finally after my fiancé called the head honcho since the office did nothing (but offer a $20 gift card for a moving truck...) and miraculously they found an equivalent apt the day after. After we move AGAIN, everything seemed decent; just ok. And then BAM. We have ROACHES IN THE NEW APT. Can we catch a break here!? They’re willingness to help was subpar at best. After about a MONTH of fighting with them and they’re contracted bug people, it somewhat got fixed. I cannot even begin to go on about the disgusting landscaping at the complex. Or the fact the back club house that was supposed
to be a state of the art gym that never open the year we leased there. Or the new dog park that was in progress during our tour that never got finished either. The fact that we lived here for a year blows my mind. I can’t believe we lasted that long. Do. Not. Rent. Here. You. Will. Be. So. Miserable. Plus to put the icing on the cake, they blasted the AC and power the last few days of our lease since they were gutting it. I guess you should never turn your keys in early or you will owe the power company $350 for your utility bill! So if you would like to live with mold, bugs and office personnel that blow you off, then this place is definitely for you!

Live in a 2 bedroom with loft. Apartment itself is amazing but everything else about the complex is bad. The people in the office don't do their jobs and the vendors they use for services (pest control, trash, etc) are a joke. Half the time I personally have to call because it's not getting done. Save the money and headaches and look else where.

As a former 15 year professional in this industry I feel I am qualified to say that the standards of care from the current management team are way below the acceptable norm for a community of this type. I have lived here for 6 years. However, the past year or so have been increasingly frustrating. This only touches on my issues.

The community is not walked by the management team. I walked the property last year and most of the same issues found then are still there or have gotten worse. The benches and fences are rotting and falling apart, with screws protruding from the seats, bushes are dying from rot, irrigation is not adjusted properly so the buildings are being sprayed by the irrigation, palm trees have dead fronds that should have been trimmed months ago, parking lots have not been maintained (a simply case of repainting stripes and speedbumps by the staff), mildew growing up walls and around the windows, dryer vents not being maintained, plastic kiddie pools, litter, bicycles chained to trees, picnic tables buried in the mud, trees falling over, and more.

These are not issues that should require reporting. A properly trained team should have a running schedule for these issues, including health and safety checks for lighting and hazards. A team member should be hitting buildings on a schedule to clean and repair damage, lighting, touch up paint, striping, speedbumps, and signage. The manager should be sending letters of violation to residents who keep unsightly debris at their apartments or remove them. A towing company should be driving through to remove parking violations. The maintenance team regularly is found sitting in carts between buildings (they should never be driving carts off the parking area) playing with their phones or just chatting. They block access to the residents who then must walk around the carts and into the mud. The staff is unreliable, unprofessional, badly trained, and misinformed about fair housing and ADA laws.

When looking for a rental home look for these issues. Ask to walk areas of the property not part of the tour and direct them to areas you would like to see (like the dumpster area). These are signs that the property is not properly walked by management. A property that is not walked is not maintained on a health and safety level. If they can’t maintain H&S standards, they don’t respect the quality of care. Your hard-earned money deserves someone who cares about your home. These people don’t.

Rent is too high. I can hear EVERYTHING my neighbors do. I can hear every step they take, their music, their television, their conversations. When I tried to talk to the office about it, they basically said I had to deal with it since it's part of "apartment living." Nice.

This is the worst apartment facility I've lived in and I've had some bad ones.  The management company does NOTHING to help take care of your needs.  They are charging WAY too much for what you get and maintenance never shows up.  I've had several issues and they can care less.  My apartment flooded a year ago, there is mold growing under the sink, the bottom cabinets are warped and my carpet is messed up and I can't get anyone to respond to me via phone or in person.  They keep saying someone will come.  I keep setting up appointments and then no one shows up.  After 5 times of begging someone finally came and was so annoyed that they had to show up and I STILL don't know what they are going to do about my apartment.  

Oh and by the way, they just decided it was a good idea to renovate both clubhouses at the same time so if you are waiting on any packages, they are telling the mailman to send it back.  Who does that???!!!  Can't get packages via post office and in some cases FedEx.  Would have been nice for them to tell us they were doing this so I wouldn't order anything. 

Thankfully I'm moving next year.  Maybe I don't have to wait until my lease is up.  Wish I could have done it sooner.

Damaged sub floors, cockroach infestation, broken washing machine, broken air conditioning within the first two weeks of moving in. All of these issues laden on top of untimely management and high pricing make this apartment a poor choice. You have to fight tooth and nail to get anything done and ultimately the price of any renovation will likely come out of your own pocket. Consider elsewhere if you do not want to be short handed or can not afford to call out of work.
NICE APARTMENT...BUT THE RENT IS JUST TO HIGHT. I HAVE LIVE HERE FOR EIGHT (8) YEARS.
Maintenance takes a while sometimes but a great place to live and relax. We have so much room in the one bedroom!

The Cottages at Hunter's Creek look good on the outside. However, I've not had the best experience living in this apartment. I've had countless trouble with the air conditioner in this unit. I've had maintenance out on multiple occasions, each time fixing something different but never fully resolving my problem. The maintenance staff responded well when I put the request in, but was rude on a couple of occasions.
This apartment is centrally located with beautiful decor and amenities!
The manager Lacey was super friendly and helpful during the process of getting an apartment! The apartment is clean and up to date. I love the pool and dog area!

Just moved from Cali a couple months ago and I love it here. The apartments are updated and great looking. Also, the community is very quiet and homey, looked exactly like the virtual tour. Lacy was very knowledgeable and made moving a cake walk. Location location is amazing only a few minutes from downtown orlando and winter park. There is a Publix and restaurants that are walkable as well.

After living at the Elon for two years I can say overall it’s a ok place to live. The apartment is beautifully, but cheaply made. The bath tub chips, leaks in the walls every month or so, and some bugs. The good news is maintenance is very responsive so they will fix these problems quickly. The amenities are more hyped than they should be, the gym is the size of your bedroom (only big enough for about 2 people) and the dog park is a joke of a size but the pool is nice. You can get more for the same amount of money elsewhere. Not to mention they’re constantly renovating something so expect to have lots of noise during the day if you’re anywhere near the pool. Not the best, not the worst, but wouldn’t recommend to any of my friends or family.
I absolutely love the Elon. I love the location. The unit is brand new and very modern with spacious rooms and new appliances. The staff is great as well. A great place for a couple!
The new remodel is beautiful - the new apartments are contemporary and attractive. It's in a nice location and the staff is friendly and very helpful!

On first day of move in I discovered the unit I was put into (1802) was roach infested. Dead ones, live ones, baby ones you name it. In one closet I opened 3 middle aged ones ran out of it. Luckily I was able to get my money back or else a lawyer would have been involved SAVE YOUR MONEY

Apartments are small but if you are good with organization you can really maximize the space. The kitchen is a very good size for an apartment and looks very nice with new cabinets, countertops and appliances. Overall, the aesthetics are very pleasing. As far as living here actually goes, I don't recommend it. Prepare for a lot of mandatory monthly expenses such as paying per parking spot, trash, and pest control. I don't know what the trash fee is for when you have to take it to the dumpster yourself. Cannot put trash on front or back porch or you will be fined. Front gates of community didn't even work for the last two months. Employees take pictures of you walking your pets through the complex so they can try to catch you not picking up after them and fine you (which is not mentioned in the lease). Walls are paper thin so if you speak above a whisper or like watching tv without subtitles you'll definitely receive noise complaints. You'll also be able to hear everything else your neighbors do as a result. Maintenance is very slow, took over two months to have some of our issues addressed. They show up with no notice and once didn't even knock before attempting to open our door. Good luck contacting the leasing office with any issues because they don't fix anything. Overall, wouldn't recommend to anybody.

I was there for 2 years, and had very little issues, but now that I've moved out it seems they want to get as much of my security deposit as they can. During the move as we went to unload our first truck-load of boxes and furniture, they let themselves in and inspected the place, and notified me that all they wanted was for me to clean the stove. Sure! They offer a $100 cleaning service when you're moving out, which I opted out of. Me and my fiance were in a 1 bedroom apartment with no pets, no kids, no smoking, and only had 1 roach visit us... so there wasnt much to clean to begin with. Well I spent 3 hours cleaning it, with pictures to prove, that it was SPOTLESS.  But when I handed in the keys the next day (Friday), they didn't want to see the room with me because the person who 'had' to do wouldn't be back till Monday... ok. Well in the final statement, I'm charged $40 for carpet cleaning/stain removal and $50 for cleaning... I did everything by the book and it meant nothing. Be prepared to lose a chuck of your security deposit no matter which option you choose.
Apartment is very good. Manager is not so good all about money. Maintenance is very slow. Etc
The workers never answer the phone. The front office staff always have an attitude and says she will handle it and does nothing. I would find a different place as the rent is not worth it either

I’ve been here two years and it’s been quite pleasant however I’ve had five packages go missing. All different carriers, all different stores. One thief actually signed a fake name with fedex in order to steal the package. Disappointed in human beings.
Beautiful apartments but currently living here and there is not adequate parking for the number of residents. Have to park outside of the complex and walk in.

This place is gorgeous, but they need more parking space I live here and my friends can’t come and spend the night or anything because they can’t park in the side that I live I don’t get why friends or family members have to park all the way to the other side to walk all the way to mines and on top of it there is not an exact area where it determines where the guest parking is at there is no signs or anything how can a person know where is at but then when they call the towing people we get our cars towed and then have to oh to get our car out but they are the ones that don’t specify where the parking is at

I had so many problems with this place, I am seriously thinking about breaking the lease. They had the worst construction company that built this place. After the construction finalized, they had to break the pavement again, because of water leakage underground. Water keeps seeping up through the asphalt! The management is horrible, they make up lies, stating that the neighbor's complaint about my TV being loud during the day! My TV was no even on the day in question, and even it was loud there's nothing unlawful about it! They charge a lot of money for this place not even worth it. I had to clean the hallway outside because they never have anyone clean it. They only have one garbage dumpster for the whole building, garbage dumpster is always overloaded, not enough for the whole complex, and we always have to deal with the extra traffic of people coming to dump their garbage here.

My boyfriend and I had been searching for places to move for a long time, not to mention we were on a time crunch because our current lease was running out. I first heard about The Morgan through a classmate of mine who also lived here with her boyfriend, I had heard of the complex before but was skeptical because it was so new. 

The second we stepped on the property and started touring we knew this complex was the one! The amenities are GORGEOUS and the clubhouse is so modern and spacious, not to mention the gym is beyond words! What is even more surprising is how beautiful the units are! The price makes it even better, especially for a college student.

Alex let us tour the actual unit we had put an application in for! The natural lighting and backsplash make the kitchen so gorgeous and make me want to cook. The bathroom is spacious for a 1BR and has a lot of storage for all my stuff. I cannot rave enough about how amazing this complex is, they made the process easy and I am so glad I live here! 

If you are hesitant due to the fact it is so new don't be! Construction is all finished and everything is amazing! I love The Morgan!

Ever since the new management took over, this place has gone to filth. The office number is not in service. The Maintanence staff is horrible! The water in our building has been turned off several times within the past week and never have we been given proper notification of it being turned off like the previous management would advise. They have no type of respect for the current and / or previous tenants. The level of professionalism is terrible. I've been here for three years and can not wait until our lease is up to move out. And be careful if we decide to do it before hand. It's so upsetting to see this lack of integrity from a NEW company. Horrible transitional process! Horrible service and horrible living ! I highly recommend not moving here anymore. Before yes, but now ? Not even if it was the last place in Orlando.

The worst apartment ever. They show you the model apartment but when you see the real apartment is nothing compare to the model. A lot of roaches everywhere, the bathroom all dirty. I dont recommended to no one. And also ask to see the real apartment first not the model.

I never got to live here, but I'm glad I didn't. The management never answers the phone and they've withheld my application deposit for at least 4 months now. It was a mistake to even consider moving here.

I have been living here for 3 years and I love it but they should put an area for people to smoke since not all of us do it and it affects their health. They should forbid that they do it on the stairs and balconies, I hope they do something about it. Thank you
Never answers the phone and staff is rude. Takes days for a work order to be completed. Don’t move here.

These people are rude and unprofessional. The manager has no compassion and he never tries to fix anything if you move in here please be aware that they have only redid some of the apartments they haven't fixed everything and not everything properly works right. The property manager name is Arvin and  he's very very rude with no respect and when he knows he is wrong he will hind and the office and not do his job. Just sad.

The property manager Rodney has went above and beyond to answer any questions I have via e-mail and even went to the lengths of sending me a detailed photo tour of the unit I am moving into. I am so excited to live where the staff truly cares about their residents and I don’t even live there yet.

Toured infinity on Tuesday afternoon with my brother and the leasing representative Rodney was super knowledgeable in assisting my brother and i in finding the perfect apartment. The 1st floor apartment we viewed was immaculate considering the complex is 20+ years old. Out of all the places we toured, Infinity was the best for the price and location.

I recently toured Infinity and to say it was a beautiful community would be an understatement. Nicole and Rodney assisted me in providing information and taking me on a tour and although I did not lease, both office staff were amazing in providing me tons of information. Good customer service is rare these days so I was happy to have those two pull through for me. Thank you infinity team.

Location is prime! The units themselves look nothing short of beautiful and I love the color white on the outside. Trust me you’re going to want a garage, so if you have the chance to get one, do so. 
The staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable and trust me I can be annoying at times with my questions. 
Over all 10/10. You’ll love it here.

A month ago i visited a few property around because i knew my lease will be ended soon and everybody knows that at the end of a lease the prices are supposed most of the time to increase. After that I went to the front office to talk to the manager to let her know that I am willing to stay here but that I went to other places to have an idea of the prices in the area and depending on what the new rent would be i would make a choice.
I let her knew that i wanted to stay in the same type of apartment but renew as I know they be been renewing all of their appartements for the last months...
She let me knew that of course they want to keep people here and will do everything to make it happen.
She told me that she had none available at that time but that she should have one maybe coming out and will let me know.
She also said that the increase would be around $200.
She also said that they would pay for the move out to the new apartment because they want to please their actual resident and bla bla bla... I was happy about this talk.She called me back after a few days to let me know that she still waiting on the other resident but because she is going in vacations she wants me to know that she did not forget and will keep me updated when she will be back.
She finally came back from her vacations.
Because I had no news I went there.
When I went there everything had changed...
So finally the actual resident are not renewing their lease, which means that the apartment will be renew and available in a few months.
She told me that the price finally will have an $800 increase from what I am paying now.
I told her that it's not the talk we had and she said that it's a misunderstood.
she said that it will be the only one available so that’s why they increase the price that much and also this is the market price.
I told her that they are not Baldwin Park and trying to make the price just like they are.
And she responded to me "yes but this is were you want to leave" (just so that people know, in Baldwin Park the owners have to pay the HOA which is $350/ month and that is part of why the prices are higher, because of the top services that they offer and obviously don’t get here).
I also told her that she should of let me know at first because I came earlier to avoid this  kind of disagreement and that the new apartments in the same street are cheaper... she respond with a smile that "I should go there if it's cheaper"...

I’ve lived in the complex 13 years. The apartment is beautiful, the community grounds are groomed to perfection, and both the office and maintenance teams are excellent. Tony, the lead maintenance supervisor is the most responsive person I’ve seen.  The customer service from everyone is genuine and thoughtful. But most of all, it’s the great apartment floor plan and how quite it is at night! If you are going to rent, this should be your next home.

I have lived there for 4  years. Since Infinity has been there, the office staff is NOT friendly AT ALL. They are VERY defensive when asked questions, judging by other comments made here, I am not the only one that this has happened to. I will say the grounds are nice and I love the area, however, there has been CONSTANT construction for MORE than 6 months with no communication from the office. (Debris, nails, noise, banging)They drilled THROUGH my wall to attach the railing on the balcony outside. Upon renewing my lease, it quoted a couple HUNDRED dollars INCREASE for rent, part of the reason I moved out. When confronted, the management immediately again, jumped on the defense and said it was completely out of their control and it is the market. They came back with a better offer, but nothing would have made me stay there with the current situation. I am EXTREMELY glad to be out of there.

Lived here for many years and once the new owners took over last year this place is TERRIBLE!! The office staff is RUDE, especially the manager Marcella who will lie right to your face and come up with the most ridiculous excuses for why things were not done. The leasing agents change constantly so you never know who works there. The only ones who actually get anything done are the maintenance workers. The loud construction has been going on for well over 6 months with NO communication as to how long it will take with multiple nails are left around the property so good luck not flattening a tire. They lose mail packages then will find them months later acting like its no big deal. Please dont be fooled by their facebook events and photos. I was so happy to get out of this place!

We have lived here for two years and since this new company has taken over it has been AWFUL!! I’ve had to replace two tires from the nails they are doing from construction to the buildings and  my boyfriend has had to replace one! They do not care about the residents here. We went to talk to them and they said they can’t do anything for us even though MULTIPLE people I have talked to in the complex said they also have seen piles of nails around or have found one in their tire. The walls are thin you can hear everything above you, full on conversations. The AC overflows every week and they come to fix it and it breaks over and over again. Save yourself the money and hassle.

DO NOT live here. Especially after the people at infinity took over. The walls are paper thin and you here everything your neighbors do. That parking stinks and it takes maintenance weeks to fix anything. They had to come out 3 different times just to fix my AC because they didn’t care enough to fix it right then 1st or 2nd time. There’s been construction going on for over 6 months, everyone has been getting flat tires and then management REFUSES to do anything about it. When confronted about the situation management was rude and couldn’t care less. NEVER once through any issue (which has been multiple) that I’ve encountered at infinity have they shown a friendly or customer first attitude. They’re greedy and down right awful. Do yourself a favor a pick somewhere else.

I have lived here going into my 3rd year, and was proud to invite family and friends over. The outside of the apartments are painted a beautiful gold and green, with beautiful red brick and black shutters and the garages are black, also. So quaint and full of character. Just beautiful!! NOW the new owners from TX are painting them a stark white, even the beautiful red brick. Looks like a hospital! Horrible!  I need my sunglasses on just to pull up and look at them. We live in Florida, I give it 6 months and they are going to look filthy. Between the weather and the lawn guys. Just a BAD move corporate!! Why??  You took something that the majority of people living here loved the way our community looked, to a whole new level of UGLY!! I definitely won’t be renewing my lease.

Nice staff and they make everything look nice but the fact is the apartments a cheaply built to begin with. Paper thin walls to the apartment. Construction behind the apartments has been going on well over a year and literally shake the whole apartment starting right at 8am. So if you work late I hope you don't like sleep. I can hear every footstep my upstairs neighbors make. They play the complex off as luxury and make it look nice but the quality of the structures is poor.

I am very impressed by the changes made in our complex by the new management. The staff is wonderful and always make me feel special when I come to the office. Maintenance is quick and the guys are all very nice. I love my home!

I've lived at Promenade Crossings for almost a year now, and the new staff is very communicative and responsive. They always take steps to explain to residents what is happening on property, and give concrete reasons and dates as to when things will be fixed/replaced.  A perfect example is when the trash compactor stopped working - they emailed residents right away explaining what happened and took fast steps to fix it. The community  is located in a great area (close to everything - Target, Baldwin Park, Starbucks and a movie theater) and is very safe (gated with a resident Orlando Sheriff and many young families).

There's absolutely no excuse for a 9 floor building in downtown Orlando to have all 3 elevators down for multiple days. This is very clear evidence that management is very slow to respond, does not take issues seriously, and very cheap when it comes to maintenance. The property is old, and the management is not cooperating with what needs to be fixed. Elevators are not an amenity. Elevators are not a luxury. they're necessary for access to all residents, including the ones who are in wheelchairs. There's absolutely no excuse for the elevator problem to be prolonged as it has. 911 was called yesterday to extract a resident from the freight elevator that for stuck. That's a horrible and terrible waste of time for the city's emergency services. Management does not care about lake Lucerne Towers image in the Orlando community.

In the last two years the management has declined along with the interior of the property. They recently poured money into fixing the exterior of the building, but neglected to fix the elevators. Instead they wasted money on the landscaping over the residents elevators. 
People prop open exterior doors letting anyone just walk in, instead of of using the entrance that requires a card. Big security risk and management doesn’t care. 
I would not recommend this building if you value safety and functioning amenities.

I thought the management team when I moved in was bad but the new team is a joke, especially in times of crisis. I was told that my security deposit ($1800) would be returned within a few days of my moving out, but the new team is not respecting that. I have called three times and sent multiple emails since moving out a week ago and every time I am told that the office manager is “out of the office right now” and to “try again tomorrow”
this is a trashy place with really bad management. Please do not consider staying at this cheap place although it is close to downtown. The manager would spy on you every day and every time.

I would Stay away from this apartment. The management is a total mess and they would try every way to make your daily life hard here. 
Few things to note before you plan to rent at Lake Lucerne – 
Remember at first, the people in the office will be nice and act like nice people to you but eventually once you have signed the lease, everything changes right then. 
The uHaul vehicle we brought for moving our stuff was towed next morning because we parked the vehicle for the night in the parking during our moving in. We had to pay $260 for the tow. 
You cannot have friends or guests over to your apartment according to the Manager Kate. Your family cannot come to visit and stay with you here for few days. 
There is trash everywhere in the parking lot and living floors.
The swimming pool is really dirty, and the gym machines are never lubricated. They always make noise or either require repair. 
I signed my lease in June 2019 and cannot wait for May 2020 to come sooner. 
The apartment is under repairs for the next six months so there are construction workers everywhere and you must be cautioned while walking around anywhere outside. 
This place gives me the worst vibes ever to stay.    
Even after all this if you plan on staying here, please read the lease agreement and I am sure you will change your mind.

When we first moved in, we loved it, but now, we can't wait to get out. They started construction in the lot next to as well as behind and it is Monday through Saturday 7am-5pm or so. They are building apartments and a spot for a grocery store/cafe/small shops which will be really nice but they will not be ready for at least another two years. The building has also decided to do some much needed maintenance. However, you have no idea when or what they are doing so there is banging occurring at odd times or other random noises and/or disturbances. It is a great location but it is not worth the current price due to the current conditions.

The view from Lake Lucerne Towers is simply the best in the city. The gorgeous Orlando skyline which shines at night across Lake Lucerne is alone worth the rent. Management, staff, and maintenance are also extremely kind, personable, and helpful. Management knows its residents by first name and regularly ask how you're doing and what they can do for you. Recently, I had a minor issue with ceiling tile in my bathroom which was repaired in a day. When finished, my whole bathroom was sparkling clean (better than before). In fairness, the downside to the apartments is obviously the kitchens. They're older apartments, and thus so are the kitchens in the units. While not ideal, the spaciousness of the unit, amenities (including pool and gym), staff, and definitely view, make up for it. Overall, I highly recommend the apartments to anyone who dreams of living downtown in a city. I've lived in D.C. and Pittsburgh, and the property here in downtown Orlando for its price and accompanied by an amazing staff makes this a complete steal. -Tanner

The apartments are acceptable and the location is very good for us. Management is horrid. Even though there's a major shortage on rentals in Orlando, they can't keep the apartments filled. The worst is they make you pay a penalty equal to two months' rent if you need to get out of a lease. That's even if you give the required 60 days' notice. For a one-bedroom, that's over $2,000. No exceptions, even for sickness, relocation, death. When we moved in (2006), they said they had started to paint the outside of the building. And sure enough, you could see on one side that the new color had been painted on about a quarter of the building. Know what? IT'S STILL LIKE THAT 11 YEARS LATER! Embarrassing! There have to be dozens of better places to rent in this city. Read the lease before you sign!!

Building hallways stink,  because they never clean them. Mold in the laundry machines, grounds are not maintained,  trash all over parking lot. Kate, the property manager,  will make all sorts of grand renovation promises. In order to get you to sign a lease. Nothing has been done to improve the building in the year and a half,  that I have lived there. She then will blame her boss and call him a liar.  The exercise equipment has been broken for months. Finally, the security gates almost never work along with large holes in the surrounding fence.

I had an appointment and was excited. Nice looking area, but dingy looking bulding when I arrived. Leasing agent was not present for my appointment and nobody was at the concierge desk, so I was stuck outside despite the appointment that I got a few reminders about. Then, filling out the paperwork, and asking questions I get hit with their no lawyers--practicing or non-practicing and no law students. Disappointing they have the policy, didn't warn me before my appointment and didn't explain or defend. Didn't try to get more information about my work, just confirmed I passed the bar and refused to show me an apartment.

awesome location for work downtown, but food desert for grocery. beautiful views across Lake Lucerne. the room is a good size and cozy. the building is old with poor insulation so consider the cost of energy (especially in summer months). property manager is hot/cold people person so pick the right day to talk to her.

The location is great for someone who works in Downtown. Forest Properties Management Inc. needs to consider hiring a different manager. Since I've been here, Kate has hired and fired as least 8 - 10 workers (from office assistants, maintenance workers, or concierge) or they quit altogether because they could not get along with the manager Kate. She uses her title to bully residents and she is quick to take a photo. she has a one way mirror in her office so she can see outside but you can't see her. She will spy on you so she can write you a violation.  As far as getting maintenance to fix something... your emergency is not hers, so you have to keep bugging her. The residents are great and friendly but living here would be more enjoyable if you don't have to stress on dealing with the manager.

Downtown Orlando has it all, shopping,movies, music, sports, museums,lakes, a bustling nightlife, great proximity to all of the theme parks, I-4, the turnpike. And if you are NOT living at Lake Lucerne Towers, really high rent. Since my husband was working downtown, we wanted a place that was close to his job,  but after looking around at the places downtown we went into sticker shock. Until we stopped in here. Yes, it is an older building. But older buildings are made of cinder block and that means you don't hear your neighbors every whisper unlike a lot of the new buildings that seem to echo everything going on in the building. It also has a pool that goes to 9ft and a courtyard with lounge chairs and tables. The maintenance staff is friendly and quick to show up if anything goes wrong. They allow pets, but it was 3 weeks before I even heard my neighbors dog. Kate , the manager, is also quick to answer any concerns you may have. And the size of the apartments? Awesome. The kitchen is smaller with older appliances, but well maintained. Did I mention the balcony, valet trash pick-up and limited access with an evening door person ? If you are looking for a "party place", it's not for you. But if you want a break from the hustle and bustle of life with a short walk back to the hustle and bustle , this is it.Not only do we get to live in Downtown, but with our savings, we can also afford to enjoy so much that Downtown has to offer.

We're going on our 10th month at Lucerne and we love it! The management isn't awesome, but they're harmless enough. They're increasing our rent but it's still a pretty good price for a place this size so close to downtown. Our apartment is super spacious and bright with lots of natural light. The building is charming with that mid-century vibe. The gated parking lot is stuck open a good portion of the time so don't delude yourself into thinking the building is as secure as they pretend it is, but I'm a 5'5" girl and I've never felt unsafe. Also DON'T GET AN APARTMENT ON THE 9TH FLOOR. It's the top floor so there's nothing insulating your apartment above the ceiling. They offered us $50/month off our rent when we moved in (in the winter) because the utilities would be high but our last energy bill was $300... and it wasn't even comfortable. We were still sweating all month. Our downstairs neighbors (in the same floor plan as us but on a lower floor) are only paying $130. Oh, and as someone starting law school this fall I think it's a little messed up that they specifically don't let lawyers live here (NOT JOKING)... you have to ask yourself what they're afraid of with that.

Stay away from this apartment complex. It is located in a high-crime area, infested with roaches, neighbors are very loud, and they will steal from you. By the time you try to leave, they will charge you thousands of dollars for normal wear and tear updates, and take your deposit no matter what.

This new upscale apartment complex was completed within the last year and has all the amenities you would find at a luxury vacation resort. The property sits on a lake, is clean and well maintained with a very friendly and attentive staff.  The carriage house apartments out front are quiet (no direct neighbors) and is like living in your own three story house that also includes an attached garage.

This is the place to be if you want a quite relaxing environment. Picturesque lake views, a beautiful new pool. Who could not love living here? The Courtney at Lake Shadow has everything you could ever need, entertainment room, gym, coffee bar, pool, and even a professional dog spa!

If I could give zero stars I would. The apartments are filled with cockroaches. It doesn’t matter how clean you keep your apartment, how often you spray, and how many traps you have they live in the walls and management does nothing to help the problem. We had black mold in our residence that we’re still not sure is fully fixed. Other residents are disrespectful and dirty as well. The trash area is constantly overflowing. People from other neighborhoods break through the gates and then they aren’t repaired. The dog park has holes all in the gates for your dog to escape. There is never any landscaping done so the bug situation just gets worse. If you’re on a first floor apartment good luck dealing with rude neighbors banging around above you. Especially if they have kids that do whatever and play at all hours of the night. Also the pool is now closed until further notice so that is an amenity you pay for and can’t use. The management office could care less about the good residents and just let’s the bad residents do whatever. I can’t wait to run far away from here when my lease is up.

If I could leave zero stars I would. 
DO NOT MOVE HERE!!!
1. All the apartments are roach infested. No matter how clean you keep your apartment. No matter how many times you call pest control and you set traps. You will have roaches living with you.
2. The kids in the neighborhood are vandalizing cars and apartments just for fun. So if you chose to make the mistake and live here you better pay for a garage because your car will probably get vandalized.
3. This is not a gated community. If they tell you that they are lying. The gate does not work. They close it sometimes at night but, for the most part it stays open allowing whoever to come in.
4.Security is a joke they literally do not do anything but park the security car here. If you have a complaint they will look at you and not care and keep sitting there doing nothing.
5. People will rob you. Please get a camera door bell. There has been so many incidents of people stealing stuff off of peoples doors.
6. Always lock your door is you choose to move here. A month in someone tried to open my door and get into my apartment.
7. There are barely any lights and the parking lot is very dark so you must be very careful leaving at night.
8. They have very little cameras for security. Barely none. They swear there are but I have looked everywhere and have not seen any.
Please I beg anyone who read this to not move here. It is extremely unsafe. Management does not care and will not help you if you are having issues. For the ridiculous price that you pay here you can find somewhere else to move. Love anywhere but here.

I’ve lived here since 2016 and when it was Sterling Crest it was an absolute dream. Ever since BlueRoc Premier took over everything about the place went to hell. I honestly don’t believe anyone in the front office is qualified to do their “jobs.” Not one person in that office is of any help. There are German roaches all over the place, maintenance requests will go months before they are fixed. Our security is a joke and never responds to actual complaints. The management will try to act like they care by having food trucks or pizza parties or whatever works on a middle school classroom to get them to shut up. Seriously cannot wait for my lease to end. The only bright light at this complex is Matthew in maintenance. He will fix as much as management allows him to. He deserves so much better than this place.

when repairs are needed it usually is done by the next day.  The bedrooms are large and is quite accessible for a wheelchair.  Also the entrance (front door) is easy to get a wheelchair in and out of.  The kitchen has plenty of storage space as well as a pantry.  I do feel really safe here.  I also like the no carpet in the living areas.  so it's good for people with allergies and asthma.  It is close to Universal studios and convenient shopping.

1. There’s a gate, but 99% of the time it’s broken and anybody can get in do whatever they want and leave. There’s not even 1 security guard. 
2. Loud Neighbors and no parking for you if you work late at night like me. New Management, worthless management.
3. Not what you’d expect for your money.
If you still don’t believe me go live there you’ll regret it.

I have been living here since 2014. Now we have new management and they are updating the units and with that ridiculous increase on the rent. Infestation of German Roaches all over from kitchen to bathroom, bedroom , I have roaches crawling everywhere . I have complain multiple times and nothing have been resolve.

I never had any problems living here until they switched management companies. They don't communicate with you. They don't give you ample time to prepare for any changes they are doing. When you call the front office, you almost always have to leave a message. I even had one time where I actually talked to someone and they forgot why I called, so, didn't take any action. There is always trash in the halls, stairwells, and on the grass. NO ONE picks up after their dogs and you have to walk through the grass to get to your car. The floor tiles in the kitchen were broken, our peep hole had been painted over, the floors weren't even, and there was a massive hole in the floor they had to come fill in later after we complained. We used to have a security guard at the entrance and guards that drove around the parking lot, which is needed in this neighborhood, the new owners fired them and just left the gates wide open at all times. After a couple months they finally started closing the gates at night, not that it helps since people just drive in through the exit gate. Do yourself a favor and get a place for the same money in a better neighborhood.

I have a been a resident for 2.5 years, and as a lot of these reviews are telling you the new management is horrible. I have lived here since 2013 and never had any issues. I have been here for almost a year and it's been one problem after another. We weren't able to see our apartment until we signed the lease and it smelled badly of car urine. Nothing was done to fix it and it took weeks to get the smell out. It takes months for any service request you put in to get fixed. We had issues with our plumbing and our cabinets in both the kitchen and bathroom are ruined and they won't fix them. We have a third floor apartment and the roof is leaking. We have been trying to get them to fix it for months and all they have done is patch it and is now leaking again. The maintenance people will force their way into your apartment if you don't answer the door within 2 seconds and some are very rude and have no idea what they are doing. The office people ignore and dismiss anything you say and try to get you out of the office as soon as they can so they don't have to deal with you. The new manager will not talk to anyone and acts as if she is always busy in her office to avoid talking to you. They only clean near the office and the rest of the complex has trash all over. The apartments are nice enough if you like living in a non updated apartment form the 90's. Among other things to make this place crappy. Sterling Crest apartments is in a prime location. It is walking distance from the supermarket and restaurants. It is also a 15 minute drive from the Universal complex. Sterling Crest has walk in closets. The apartments are surrounded by greenery including a park with a gazebo and barbecue grills. The apartments have large windows, which allow a lot of light. The amenities include a Laundromat, swimming pool, gym and a tennis court. It is a quiet neighborhood. The staff are friendly and fix maintenance issues relatively quickly, usually within a day. The bathrooms are large with more than enough drawers and cupboards. The kitchen is not the most modern, but includes a pantry with laundry hookups.

When showed the apartment and complex it seemed very homie. Since I have been here for a year I have to realize that it's different than what I thought. People leave soda bottles and buckets full of cigarettes in the stairways, and trash is constantly scattered in the parking lot and bushes. The office people are nice enough and do what you tell them to. Their is pest control every month but still find ants all over the apartment and I keep it very clean. The kitchen and bathrooms need updating, the counter tops and appliances look they have been here since they opened and have scuff marks in them you can't get out. They gave away the apartment that I was supposed to be having and they told me that they made a mistake and would have to take one opening up in the next week or so. Most things are OK here but they defintley need to do some remodeling at some point. Basically the price is decent for what you're getting.

Sterling Crest is a pretty good complex. It's location is optimum, but you pay for it as well (700 for a one bedroom). The office is usually on point with maintenance requests, but we have had a few instances where we told them about issues and they never got fixed.

I have been living in my apartment for almost 3 months now and I have to say that I really like living here.  The rent is reasonable compared to the surrounding complexes.  The maintenance people respond very quickly to any service requests.  It's right across the street from a 24 hour Walmart and very close to everything you would need.  The bus stop is also right across the street.  I do wish the apartments were more updated but overall it's a great place to live.

I'm so excited the way Palm Grove Apartments are looking the change is amazing. I have lived here for a couple years now & loved it... that was until the new management. So if you have problems or need anything make sure you are available on their schedule because you're going to need to go down to the office during office hours. Second off, they said when they bought the apartments that they were going to get renovated while we were still in them, well now that has changed to they will not be renovating while the apartment is occupied but if you want to renew your lease you will pay the same as someone who moves into a renovated apartment. As you are driving in it also says new community amenities and upgraded community amenities on little signs but this is the furthest from the truth, there are 5 main community amenities, pool, gazebo, gym, grills, and bark park. ~$3.50 trash valet... admin fee? Why not just charge me $28.50 for trash valet? Feels like a bit of a rip off.

Now that I moved out, they are claiming that the small scratches on the cook top require its replacement. So, if you sign here, you better be prepared to buy a new stove when you leave.
I tried to call them 21 times over 11 days to settle this cooktop issue, and no one would return my call. Getting them to answer the phone is hard, getting them to call you back is impossible. I offered to settle this by paying 50% which they denied. They also are unwilling to accept partial payments for what I agree I owe (I assume this is some kind of legal maneuvering).
I have never in my 40  years been treated so poorly. Their rents are very high, I always paid on time, I followed the rules, and they still treat you like they found you under their shoe.

What started as a great place to live ended up slowly turning into a nightmare. Don't let the nice looks fool you - the cheaply made units are not what one would expect with the price tag they carry. You will hear noise from all possible directions (above, below, side to side - even in the courtyards several floors above or below you!) My wife and kids were verbally assaulted by our downstairs neighbor (if your kids can't levitate, prepare yourself for the onslaught of noise complaints.) The hardest part has been trying to reclaim the security deposit. After fighting bogus expenses, we've been lied to multiple times about getting a refund. It's been nearly 2 months, and we still haven't seen a dime.

It's really a shame - this is located in a great area, but luckily there are plenty of other options available. Don't make the same mistake we made, and choose elsewhere.
No sound isolation, corridors never cleaned and a very expensive price for nothing. Very happy to rent here in a first time, we are living a nightmare.

Wherever do I start on this horrible apartment complex. The experience my boyfriend and I had at the Courtney was absolutely horrendous. I was okay with rent costs and all, but during this whole application process I was told that there would be a deposit but not how much it would be. Finally once everyone had conveniently paid their application fees did a deposit price get announced. We were told it would be between one month’s rent (1,700) and two month’s rent (3,400).
