Please be aware that they hide their fees and are not upfront and honest about any part of the application process and the staff is very unprofessional and disrespectful.

These are absolutely not the Luxury apartments that they advertise. The cabinetry are all pressed particle board, horrible to clean, fingerprints, veneer already peeling. Our current apartment is amidst all kinds of restaurants, shopping centers, and theme parks of Orlando. The leasing office associates are so welcoming and helpful. This place is also extremely pet-friendly! Moving here was the best decision I ever made!

This is a brand new apartment complex and so far it has been great! Once the construction is completed it will be an awesome place to live.  It will have a pet park, pool and barbeque area and many other amenities.  I'm sure it will be deserving of 5 stars at that time! Me encanta, la verdad ha sido una experiencia muy buena. Las instalaciones y el acceso a todo es muy cómodo. Tenemos de todo dentro del complex y eso me encanta.
It is a quiet place where you can live well, the neighborhood is quiet and clean, the maintenance staff and office staff are fast and diligent,

There has been improvements on the complex. However, the bug issue in the building has been crazy. Roaches in the stairwell to the hallways and now made its way into the houses. They spray the rooms but has done nothing.
Everyone from the leasing office to the maintenance staff are so kind and willing to help. The neighborhood is safe and quiet as well. Highly recommend!

Mi experiencia en Axis como Residente es muy buena, diría excelente por todo lo que ofrecen y sobretodo la tranquilidad y la limpieza de sus áreas externas, el servicio de recojo de basura y limpieza .
Es un hermoso y organizado urbanismo, donde se puede deleitar una hermosa vista al lago, particularmente a mi me calma el estrés. Aquí se encuentra paz y armonía para vivir satisfactoriamente

Me encanta la localidad,  todo cerca. El personal muy atento . Cualquier problema lo solucionan rápido. Estoy muy satisfecha de sus labores.
Living here at SUr Lake Buena Vista is a dream come true. The staff is friendly, the apartments are amazing and the amenities are great.

Great place to live for sure!
Great place to live.  The staff make it feel like home!

Location:

Apartment Features:
My apartment itself is a sanctuary of modern comfort. The layout is thoughtfully designed, maximizing space and functionality. High-quality appliances and fixtures elevate the living experience, while the attention to detail in the finishes reflects a commitment to excellence. The balcony is great and has screen protection. Very spacious.

The community here seem nice so far. No complaints so far. Quiet so far, no loud music or noise complaints. Great community if you have pets too.

Shout out to Yesenia for going above and beyond to handle all the paperwork and negotiations securing the best deal for us. Yesenia your exceptional service and unwavering commitment to your clients truly set you apart. thank you for making our transition to Sur Lake Buena Vista a breeze

In summary, living at Sur Lake has been an absolute pleasure. It's more than just a place to live; I feel truly at home. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone in search of a luxury living experience.

I just moved to this community and  I am alredy in love with this place... this complex is full of high end details and the apartments are second to none. Going on my 4th year living here and I am happy to be one of the originals as the office says. I always recommend to those looking for more than just an apartment.
Love the convenience of living here and being within a 2mile radius of all stores. office team is helpful and nice whenever I need assistance.

To top it off, their financial management was a disaster. Upon moving out, I received an eviction notice for unpaid rent in August, despite vacating in July. He emailed me back within half an hour and came to the apartment that night to kill the ants, got an exterminator the next day and I never saw an ant again. It should not have taken 3 requests and an angry email to get a problem that was under the carpet of my room and not my fault fixed, but I let it go because it was fixed. After that, I had no problems with the Verge itself until I moved out in July and heard nothing from them for about 3 weeks. All of the sudden, they charged me $15 to clean my mattress. They responded to all complaints and said that if you call the office, they will not answer your complaints regarding balances and they were assigning Community Assistants to handle each case. However, the carpet in the picture was renovated and mine was old, so the picture was entirely fabricated or they caused the dirtiness of my mattress and charged me. Either way, I contested the charge and have still not gotten a response. About a month after that, I got an email that said they were sending my account to the debt collector since I did not pay the balance. I paid the $15 because I did not want this to affect my credit, but the service fee was $16 for a total of $31 even though they had said in an email that no one would be sent to a debt collection agency until there was a final balance email from a CA, which I never received. I would encourage everyone to look elsewhere for housing,

Bad attitude the manager has plus foul mouth .. I stay away from her but it’s getting old ...
Never knew that apartment was so bad like that,the floor is bad,a lot roches,the rooms is small like a box can’t even feet a queen size ??
i went a 2:00pm and they say "we are close because lunch"
El personal no está calificado y es problematico una falta de respeto

If you're thinking of moving here after June 2020, I strongly recommend you do not. The apartment complex has removed all carpets from the second floor apartments and has refused to put in any sound proofing. You can hear everything the neighbors above you do. You can hear them talk, walk,  be intimate. God help you if your upstairs neighbors have kids. We've been complaining for months but the apartment says the cost savings are worth my family's misery. So I'm warning you, find somewhere else. You are going to be in for a special hell, whether you live on the first or second floor.
DONT MOVE HERE, THEY DONT FIX NOTHING AND NEW MANAGEMENT HARASS YOU. THE NEW GUY IN THE OFFICE HAS MANNERS.
We are currently under new management and I see changes for the better within the complex. Great community to live in. Excellent staff that looks out for their tenants.
Wonderful community to live in. Friendly staff who cares about their tenants and their needs.

To start off the apartment complex use to be so bad I've seen someone get killed. Since then security has basically took over. You can't sit in your car, you can't hang out outside your apartment for more than a minute. Most of them treat you like criminals and you have to follow a numerous set of rules. Now for management, they are constantly raising the rent. We moved from one apartment to another because we wanted lower rent and now they raised the new apartment rent. Also I moved into the new apartment in July,and I told them my door wasnt locking and they still havent came fix the lock. Overall this place sucks. The neighborhood kids are bad and so is the area.  I wouldn't recommend it.

If you're looking for quality living, the BEST amenities, and prime location, Seven41 is IT. The staff is awesome- Always keeping up with events, and attentive to our wants and needs in the community. Thanks Seven41!

This place has really gone downhill. If you want to pay huge amounts of money to live in a place where the fire alarms go off every other day for no reason, this would be it. The residents don’t even bother leaving their units anymore when the alarms go off. And as someone mentioned above, they actually charge you separately for water and electricity etc in the common areas!

Shady, deceptive and disorganized. I don’t get the same answer on anything. Tons of fees they don’t exactly inform you about. I felt like they just wanted to fill all the units and don’t care at all about things like unsecured doors that break on a weekly basis. Ants & roaches in a brand new apartment. Built fast & cheap. I think most of the money was spent in areas like the lobby, club room, lobby bathrooms. I’ve also never lived somewhere where tenants pay for common area water, electricity and sewer (meaning we pay utilities for the leasing office, gym, clubhouse, hallways, etc.).

It seems like there's NEVER anyone in the office. After I wasted my time calling the place about 30 times over the span of a week. I even left voicemails and no one ever called back. I gave up on these people. Seriously don't waste your time renting here.

I would say the amenities save this property but the headache you will endure from the lack of help from the office isn't worth it . The staff is unwelcoming and unhelpful. As they continue to switch out who works in the office , no one seems up to date with rules and procedures. Expect the run around and no help.

Got lucky when found the studio I got, ended with upgraded built in large closet and it’s perfect. The location is great, amenities are quite enjoyable with the exception of the heavy stepper above my apartment, I would recommend the property . Looking forward to renew my lease in a bigger unit !

The change in staff ruined this apartment. I would name them but their lack of physical presence in the office never allowed me to learn their names. They closed the office down consistently always away on lunch or "busy" for "covid" reasons. They did not work with us or many other tenants we spoke to when we were going through difficulties in the building. We had mold more than 3 times in our apartment including the bathroom and kitchen. We asked to get this fixed and instead they made us think there was nothing wrong although the mold kept growing back. Instead, they sent maintenance to paint over the mold. Further, the staff is not welcoming unless you are one of their favorite tenants who provides free services for the building to fake promote a welcoming environment. The elevators are down every other week. nobody is ever in the office and unless you are their favorite you will not receive a welcoming experience. Berkshire staff was the worst thing to happen to this building. The staff cares for collecting the highest amount of fees and checks for unreasonable things. Too expensive to deal with crappy people on a daily.

I have been living here a little close to a year now and it’s been a great experience everyone here down from the staff to the neighbors have been so kind the maintenance workers always come to help as soon as you have a worker it’s quiet here you really don’t hear nothing unless someone leaving or coming in their apartment you hear their key pad but there’s so much you can do here to have a great time with friends and family and lastly not just anyone can come in you need a key to get in any part of the building

What can I say, I absolutely love living at Alexan Winter Park. The amenities are so beautiful and they even have a podcast room if you’re in to that. The maintenance team and office team are so caring and quick to respond. I would absolutely recommend this community!

I'm not really sure where the 5 star reviews are coming from, we just moved into this community and our unit is a complete dump. The entire thing is on a slant which makes you feel nauseous, ok whatever, but the unit itself is so dirty and falling apart it's honestly embarrassing, one of the cabinets is on its last legs and there are multiple unpainted areas across the unit with large visible chips, everything that has been painted was lazily slapped on without a care in the world, roach droppings are everywhere and we found several alive ones in our first times in the unit, as well as worms constantly finding there way into our home despite how clean we keep it. Also can't forget the roaches that were literally painted into the walls as well as human hair and potentially hair on an unknown animal, nearly every fixture in the house has at least 1 thing wrong with it, we spend a total of over 18 hours in labor in cleaning and repairs and a total of over $200 between the deep cleaning of the carpet (awful smell and clearly not cleaned in years with roaches baked into the carpet EVERYWHERE) and cleaning supplies, of course this is not counting the value of our labor and our time (since the maintenance team is only 1 person and clearly has no experience or care, their "improvements" actively made the unit worse and less liveable). This place is really disappointing and at this point it's just a matter of making the best of it during our lease. To sum it up, if you want to live in an old building with a company that doesn't care about maintaining it at all and actively makes the unit worse and cause more work for you to make the unit liveable, I'm not even joking when I say the first month at the place was pure hell with the amount of work, money and the psychological effect of getting used to living somewhere unsafe. I have lived in many places in central Florida and this is by far one of if not the worst.

I am a little nervous living here. I heard 8 to 10 gun shots last night. I don't think this neighborhood is safe anymore. I seen young kids look like they are in there 20's cussing and fighting. This neighborhood used to be peaceful, but these young kids are loud sometimes. There are people that live here be parking where they should not parking that is not a parking space and there is no security. The trash piles up every weekend. We need another dumpster. The gate is always broke. This is crazy.

The apartments are really small there are tiny bugs in our guest bathroom , this is the second night in our new apartment and we have fire ants and giant cockroaches there freaking huge  ,the washer and dryer unit makes load noises like it going to break any minute  had a lizard in our apartment this morning , this apartment is horrible I feel like we got played and I can't wait to move out 2days in !!

They never fix anything and if you call and a leave a message. They will lie and say you didn't. AC has been broke for 3 months mold in my walls. If you complain, they make up fake accusations and post bogus violation notices on your door, but never show up to fix anything. You have to pay them for insurance as apart of your rent and it is a waste of money. Better off staying in a motel. The gates are always open and I have been living there for 6 months. It is not worth the money. I would recommend misty oaks than here. They need a new staff. It seems the staff lives there l for free and won't do anything but make your life miserable.

I just recently moved to this apartment and it is not all that great. The first day we moved in they just walked us through the apartment real quick didn't really get to check everything. It wasn't till later in the day when we started realizing little by little that things were broken. Then we told the office the day of and Maintanance just came and fixed it today. It's been a month since we've been here and it took them that long. Also the gate is always opened which does not feel safe because that's the point of a gate when it stays open for about 20 minutes or so after each car that comes in. Crime around this area is also pretty bad.

Great complex, great staff. Maintenance is fast to respond to any issue. The entire staff knows and acknowledges the tenants anytime I drive past them on their golf carts. They are patrolling the complex as they go about their daily routine. I feel very safe and welcome.

Club Music can be heard in your apartment all night, even on the top floors.
Elevators never work.
Building is Dirty
Packages always lost
Full of Air BnB apartments, like a hotel
Large percentage of residents not on the lease so no background check.

Most residents that have lived there for a while want to leave!

All around Modera Central suits our needs to be within walking distance to work, in a well built apartment, low noise level, close to restaurants and park, great exercise facility, and fabulous pool/ grilling area. The cream on the cake is the concierge service, leasing agents and staff.
Beautiful property, nice staff, kept very clean.
I love having such a luxurious space, and I love that Modera loves my dogs just as much as I do! Its a great location, and overall lovely place to live.
Modera has become our home and we love the whole environment and their employees. Package delivery and overall cleanliness of the building is excellent
Modera Central is an awesome and friendly community.

They lied about ongoing construction noise when I moved in.
The walls are so thin that the noise from the road is functionally the same as if I just lived outside.
The past several months they've charged me a lease violation fee for no reason seemingly just to see if I would come dispute it.
The washer and drier barely work.
The thermostat breaks constantly.
The lighting is atrocious.
Many of the outlets don't work, or are entirely fake.
The drawers are incredibly shoddy, especially in the bathroom.
The water smells and tastes very strange.
A large number of parking spaces are reserved for commercial properties that don't exist.
They will spam your inbox with constant promotions for food trucks, cleaning services, and other nonsense so you're basically paying to be advertised to.

The whole process was great. I came in Wednesday for a tour & moved in the following Sunday. Mari the Assistant Manager and Lauren we're awesome. They answered any and every question I had and helped out a lot with the process to make it a smooth move-in for me. Thanks Leasing Team you guys are the best!!!

Its well maintained with new appliances and friendly people that create a great environment to live. It is also fairly secure with automatic gates for your vehicle and key pad access to the doors and elevators.
I really like this community, the personnel from the leasing office is really helpful, many community events are organized all the time and I love my apartment layout!
I love living at Novel. The quality of the apartments and community is exceptional. The staff is very responsive and professional. AND they host great events!
I feel safe and secure in my apartment and like Im protected by my community

I will start with the good, its a quite safe, cheapest in the area, close to everything so the location is perfect. Community is really quite and not a lot of rif raf or unwanted visitors. The office staff is very nice, polite, and always accommodating. They try to keep up with property as much as they can. Whenever you have a maintenance problem or any other issue they attend to it immediately. There is a gym, and two pools and gated. The community is safety officer patrolled. The layout of the apartment is unique and bigger than most one bedrooms love the french doors.

Now for the bad, when I first moved in the apartment was infested with roaches, the buildings are just old. The wall were literally falling apart and the place is prone to bugs getting in no matter how clean you keep it. If you live in the middle you will hear downstairs and upstairs neighbors all of the time. The gym equipment is terrible, treadmill is so bad if you work out on it regularly. The gate is broken 85% of the time as well as the trash compound. The pools are usually a little dirty from tree fallings.

All in all the community is just old and nothing can change that. They really keep up with what they can but you get what you pay for. I wanted to move after the first year but nothing else is as cheap in the area. So you get what you pay for, for sure.
I ts a good complex very quite .. Very close to main highways and malls
My apartment is right off of the Conroy exit on I-4. Downtown Orlando is only 5-10 minutes away. It's a perfect location if you work in the city.

The apartments are not bad they needs a little bit of fixing up maybe some paint and it wouldn't be a bad place to be but they won't change or fix anything but they wanna increase rent every month or every year but the good side of it is pretty quiet and neighbors are not to noxious and pretty safe for the most part
To many problems keep happening.  Somthing is always breaking. But they have respect for their tenets

The Millenium Cove apartments/Condos are located at an intersection that allow me to travel through four different exits, therefore, I have choices the make my travel shoter. Weather by car, bus or walking. Millennial Mall is my nearest mall, Holy Land Experience is my nearest park and a quick turn to the right on Conroy takes me to Universal Studios Orlando.
Wonderful Place to live at.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: They were very nice and we were able to get all the info we needed all at once quick easy process. When you go there ask for Brianna, was  very kind and gave us a wonderful tour.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Promised move in dates are critical and Sable Palms changed this on us.  We cannot wait two weeks and we asked for option to look somewhere else but they won't return our deposit.  We are fine if we can move in on June 1 but it is impossible to wait without being homeless for 2 weeks.  Is this tupical?  If we broke our end of the bargain they penalize us.  So un fair.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Leasing agent Cristina was a pleasure to work with very professional and friendly.  She made me feel at ease and was very patient with me even though I had 100 questions.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: All staff is friendly and professional! They fix everything super fast!

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: We are really satisfied with the quick response and professional service and execution of it so far! We think we made a great decision by moving to Sabal Palm. We love the way the community was designed surrounded by trees and nature. Thank you.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Es un buen lugar para vivir

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Overall review, the assistant manager is not the nicest person. He has come across rude on a few occasions and interactions that both my husband and I have had with him. He is easily flustered, his tone is unprofessional and his attitude is cavalier. I refuse to interact with him at all costs if I have to. Everyone else there, especially Ms. Juliet, are very nice. But Jonathan.... I think hes just not a people person.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Great complex. The only thing I would have to say is maybe the dog areas, should be cleaned a bit better. Regarding the trash and debris around the area.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Cars broken into consistently; bugs everywhere; roads sinking; mail/packages keep disappearing; but the workers in the front-office are amazing.  Maintenance is also very nice, but I am tired of my tickets being closed as soon as they open my front door.  I have laundry piling up because I don't have a washing machine, and my perception is the issue has been marked as resolved.  It's a liability issue when the apartment complex subsequently enters the unit without legally required notice after they've sent written communication that the problem is fixed and they have no reason to return.  This has to stop.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: I would not recommend this complex!! I've had so Many problems here and the administration and maitenance personel doesn't even do the job it's supposed to do. The plumbing doesn't work I've had problems with Leaks in the laundry, huge Leaks in the bathroom where the dirty water of my neighbors are Like a waterfall coming out from by roof, my kitchen sink has overflowed around 7 times, leaks on my living room wall.. and Many Other things that I don't think I have enough space to write here

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Nice people

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: I put in a online maintenance request about my A/C unit, late in the night, and early in the morning, one of the maintenance personnel knocked on my door and advised me that my A/C unit was fix. I was impressed at how fast it took to fix the problem and very happy with the work that was done. Thank you.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: This review doesn't even deserve a 1 star... The apartment staff are a JOKE.. Firstly, they do not pick up the phone, so you have to go in if you need something or leave a voice message (which they won't respond to). They're extremely rude and unfriendly and clearly don't want to keep loyal residents by trying to increase prices for a 1 year lease by over 6%!

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review:
Avoid this property! It has the lowest price in the area but you get what you pay for... Dirty breezeways, spider webs all over the place, leaves, fleas, snakes and frogs... The parking pole lights don't work so getting back home at night is like getting into a marsh... all you see is trees and two pounds... Its been the same for 2 years...

The staff is useless! Catrina tries to help you but there's not much to do with Johnathan and Casandra taking decisions... The other lady is a wasted salary. Maintenance staff is good. management is the real issue.

If you can afford a little more give your self a favor and avoid this community. There's a bunch of other properties in the area. They may have issues as well but at least their recently built. Some of them in 2015.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review:
The apartment complex is conveniently located to many tourist locations like restaurants and Downtown Disney, but the surrounding traffic can make it difficult to get in and out. 
The apartment sizes are good for the price, and the property is scenic, but it comes with its own problems of mold from the lake and snakes on the sidewalks. 
The amenities are nice (such as the fitness center and a pool which stays a comfortable temperature most of the year) and the staff is friendly, but generally not empowered to actually fix a situation. They are welcoming but if you need actual assistance at best you will get a weak, uncomfortable smile. 
Overall, you may enjoy living here for a few years, if you are aware of what you have to manage.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista is a wonderful spot if you're looking to visit the theme parks or have some great dining experiences. However, the staff is lacking. Cassandra, the current general manager, will stick her nose up at you every chance she gets outside of the initial meet-n-greet. If you have an issue, she will push you off on her colleagues. Plus, Jonathan, he has the worst attitude I've seen out of apartment staff ever. They shut down the gym for a whole month and Jonathan told me to "go to the BH Management website". The area is pretty safe, but the staff is terrible. However, their maintenance team is very quick and nice if you have something broken in your apartment.

apartmentName: Sabal Palm at Lake Buena Vista Apartment H...
review:
When we moved in i would have given it a 4-5 star rating.  

But after management has changed hands it seems like no one cares anymore.  I have called multiple times for maintenance request.  I never get a live person just answering machine.  I left messages for a maintenance request.  But when I go in to the office later to ask about the status on them... they have no record of a request.  I could over look an incident or 2 but it almost every time since new management has taken over.   Seems like they are too busy making "upgrades" to property. 

Would ask for residence to make apartments available for inspections, that pets be locked up or make other arrangements for the 3 day period of inspections, then not show up in the schedule period.  Then week give notice of the new inspection with less then 24 hours to make arrangements for animals.

Management has promised things to me and not delivered.  

The apartments are nice, and they are asking more then they are worth due to the location.

Prop manager changed 3 times in year. Rent too high when services (valet trash, pool) not consistently available.  Won’t return calls for a week. Washer leaked running all over apartment into hall of building but not important enough to address for 3 days.  Maintenance is  wonderful but short staffed and terrible management at property. Deposit not returned after 4 months. Used wrong name when they  finally call. Initially sent refund to Jacksonville -even though they have forwarding address, moved here from TX and never lived anywhere else in FL. Then  wait for duplicate check - confirmed where to send and my name - still no refund. Will not answer or return messages x 1 week. Stay far away -

Don’t move here!!!! Run far past this this place!! Buildings are dirty, valet trash never picks up your trash , trash is always piled up, dog poop all over the the apartment complex and everything gets fixed and always breaks down. The best of all dont plan on sleeping pool party every weekend with loud music and karaoke till 3 AM!!! Puke piles all over parking lot which is disgusting. Tires being slashed!!!Property management is nonexistent. Don’t plan on having a late fee because you will get harassed every time of the day until that late fee is paid or be harassed about getting an eviction. That’s no place to live. Wouldn’t recommend this place to buy my worst enemy!
Wasting the money ! They don’t show you property till you sign the contract. Dirty hallways trash everywhere and smells so bad. DON’T MOVE THERE

I’ve been living here for a few years and every since the management has changed to ZRZ management, the service has been very poor. It’s supposed to be a “gated community” yet the gates are operational once or twice a week. Normally they’re not operational. The maintenance process is very poor and delayed. I’ve been waiting for a month and placed in 3-4 work order for the maintenance team to fix my dryer and it hasn’t been done. The communication skill are bare minimum & the prices are fairly high for the service to not be up to par.

These apartments are terrible! Not worth the money you will pay. The property is dirty. They don’t wash down the buildings, there’s stains in the hallways from people leaving their trash out overnight and the animals tear open the trash bags which leaves stains that will never be cleaned up. There’s dog poop all over the property. Don’t plan on sleeping or working from home here because it is extremely noisy. You can hear everything in the unit next to you and above and below you. Also dogs barking all times of the day.  The parking is trash! You can never find parking close to your building because they let visitors park anywhere leaving residents to park far away from their apartment. This place sucks! Save your money and go somewhere else.

Excellent apartment! The office staff is extremely kind and helpful, the units are newly renovated and beautiful, and the pool is wonderful.  Any issues that I have had have been quickly fixed by maintenance. This is a very kid-friendly community. Location feels somewhat secluded but is very close to multiple grocery stores, starbucks, wawa, etc. Great place!

There is no one to answer questions about move ins or any other question.  The virtual assistant routes you to a full mailbox.  The website says "professional staff available on site 24/7"  That is NOT true!

A hallway alarm has been going off for over a week. All I can hear is a very loud ringing beep. Terrible. Horrible experience. I have called and they have done nothing.
I would not recommend.

When I moved in, My closet mirror was broken, apartment was dirty and lights werent working. For the entirety of my stay here none of the gates locked, so you didn't need a keyfob to get thru anywhere in the building but the garage. Dogs pee in front of the elevators and it takes about a week or two before they decide to clean it. They will look for any ways to fine you upon leaving (even the mirror I took pictures of and submitted upon my arrival). The gym is pretty sub par, I lived at the lark before hand and I would say when I lived there it was better although I've seen recently that has gone downhill as well. My advice to anyone looking at apartments with their current renting price around UCF, rent a house with a couple friends. You'll pay half the price, enjoy it more, and probably choose better roommates then the ones they'd otherwise give you.
if it’s the last thing you do, do not live here. they will soak up all of your money, they fabricate so many things, and the conditions are awful
They gave my apartment away when I had less then a month to move, now I have to find a whole new place. Just terrible!

Not only are the hallways, elevators, stairwells poorly kept, but the way maintenance resolves issues is horrifying. Although the staff is nice, problems are not taken care of in a timely manner and there are major communication errors that prohibit residents from living a decent life here. On top of all of this, most rooms that I know of have either a cockroach or mildew problem. I would not recommend living here.

I just recently moved out after living here for a year. Not everything was bad but majority of it was. The parking is horrible. You will be lucky to find parking on your level! The trash sitting outside of the gate on level one is disable to everyone including guests, which is very gross. The noise you can hear from wall to wall is very annoying when you’re trying to sleep or simply trying to study. The hallways are very dirty, and don’t look like they were cleaned very often. There was a door that was in the MIDDLE of the hallway that was closed and broken and it was left like that for about a week before getting fixed. The management aren’t very nice, they try to charge you for every little thing they can. I was charged $257.00 for a carpet replacement fee because I walked on the carpet with shoes. I wouldn’t normally do that but upon move in day I noticed the carpet was dirty and had NOT been cleaned from the previous tenant and I just didn’t feel comfortable stepping on that used carpet without protection. Also every time I left my building I would see the property manager smoking a cigarette. Not sure how she is able to manage two buildings when she spends half of her time outside smoking. I hope this long review is helpful to someone and you guys do your homework on this place before signing a lease!!

It was the worst decision of my entire life. The place is absolutely filthy inside and outside of the units. They have absolutely taken full advantage of me being a college student. Everything in my unit was broken and disgusting and was NOT cleaned prior to my move in, and now after moving out they are trying to charge me a load of money for "cleaning" when I could have walked around OUTSIDE and my feet would have been cleaner than what condition my unit was in when I moved into it. They accidentally locked me out and changed the keys to my unit and bedroom "BY MISTAKE" once without ANY prior knowledge and I have stopped receiving my mail since that time and have had no success in forwarding my address yet. There are so many different occasions where this place has made my life an absolute terror, in ways I had not even thought possible. PLEASE don't sign a lease here unless you want to live in a real life nightmare.

The place is infested with roaches and dangerous to a fault.  The locks on the doors can be broken through by turning the door knobs a few more degrees past the limit.  Management will charge you for anything that is their responsibility before They even hand you the keys.  Worst apartment living i've ever experienced.

This was my worst decision in awhile. I heard the crime was an issue here but I feel like the only place that robbed me was the Marquee. I paid an arm and a leg for a bug infested apartment with no balcony access and a washer that was broken for weeks. On top of that, the staff is completely rude and they'll try to rip you off at the end of your lease by charging you for a parking permit that will melt on your windshield. They'll try to justify their ridiculous prices by saying utilities are unlimited unlike most apartments. However, the rooms are awful and small and you can find a nicer apartment down the road that you'll ultimately pay less for even when you pay for utilities. Don't live here.

The staff at the Marquee are all wonderful, but if you need someone to give you a tour ask for Tamara! She is knowledgeable, friendly, and will tell you everything you need to know about how to make your stay at the Marquee as positive an experience as possible. The apartments are beautiful, but Tamara really sold me on why the Marquee is the place to be.

The Marquee is very beneficial to myself as well as many other college students. All students are provided with shuttle buses that go back and forth to campus in which we do not have to worry about transportation. The Marquee also has a study room, computer room, and aerobic room. I am grateful for these things being that I know The Marquee is an advocate for making sure that students are able to get their work done as well as making sure students can maintain their health. Aside from school and work, I never have to leave the house because I have access to a pool, gym, and vending machine for snacks!

Being a college students require a lot of growing up. Besides worrying about tution and fee's you have to also include your monthly rent. My mom say's that with turning 18 comes adult responsibility. I  took what she said to me and ran with it all the way to my very first apartment. My apartment is a reflection of myself. It has thousands of college student's running around doing productive things throughout their day. It has has two perfectly built six floor garadges for coverage from a rainy day or pooping birds. If someone goes to the rooftop of my apartment they will get a perfect view of the city. When I look out my window I get a nice calming view of the pool and when the sun goes down the stars shimmer gorgeously over the pool. I love having a washer and dryer inside my unit. The best thing about my apartment complex is that when I get a sweet tooth I can just walk down the hall and get a snack from the vending machine versus having to drive to the store.  There are so many restaurants, gas stations and grocery stores around my apartment that all of my needs feels as if it is literally on my doorstep. Not to forget to mention, the very best part of my apartment is that it is directly across the street from the lovely University of Central Florida. To see over 60,000 students walk across such a beatiful campus is PRICELESS!

Rooms are nice, especially for college students getting out of their dorms. Fully furnished room, full kitchen, TVs, and walk-in closets are what you have to look forward to here. There is also a washer and dryer set in each apartment, so no need to fight over a laundromat. 

They advertise that rent starts August 21st, and early move-in is not an option, because they are "cleaning the apartments." That sounds great and all; however, I walked in to be greeted by sticky floors, a layer of dust on top of the fridge, hard water stains on all the faucets, and even empty bags of chips so graciously left here by the previous occupant. After cleaning the floors on my first day of occupancy, the mop water I used was an unappetizing shade that can only be described as "jet-black."

Being a college student here in Orlando Cadence Crossing was one of my choices to live with my roommates. It's a decent sized apartment and has good privacy. First let me say that I gave a 4 only because a 4.5 is not an option. 
I will keep it simple. The awesome side of Cadence far outweighs the downside, so I will start there. The awesome things are the following: 
Super friendly front office people, you almost feel that they are friends v.s. management. The actual apartments are super spacious, nice decor, and clean. The closets are huge, I could literally turn one of them into a small office if I wanted and the other things in the apartment (microwave, cabinets, in unit washer/dryer) are all brand new. The amenities are also very nice, the pool is beautiful and the workout room although small gets the job done. The computer room is nice also, although I rarely use it and they even have cookies and coffee and daily basis, who can't love that. Overall, it's an ideal residence in that they have the key three C's; comfort, cleanliness, and courteous. 

Now for the not so awesome, which truly is not that bad at all. They are in a convenient location as far as close to the airport. So if you travel often, they are great, it's a quick 10 minute ride. There is also a couple grocery stores and major retailers (walmart, Publix, etc) within 5 - 7 minutes. That said, my only wish, which is not really a complaint, is that it's not a walkable neighborhood in terms of cafe's or diners or local bars. It's a totally safe neighborhood but if you are like me (young professional) you can't just walk down the street to a cafe or bar to meet the locals. However, to be fair, that can probably be said about most of Orlando. Finally, my only real gripe, if you will, is that you have to sometimes ask more than once to get things done. That may be more of a reflection on the maintenance people than the apartment management themselves. If something goes wrong, which is rare, they put in the orders but the maintenance people take a couple days to actually follow up. If you call back a couple times, then and only then will they come the same day. 

So, if you are looking for an awesome place to call home, that is near perfect, then cadence is your place. Just remember to follow up on any work orders that you put in. Good Luck on your hunt!!

It is a nightmare moving in. The people who are the consultants are unorganized and very rude. Highly recommend going somewhere else in lake Nona because it’s the same price everywhere.
Staff is rude and dont care. Car’s are broken into, and parts taken off of them as if parking lot are a use parts area. Managment reaction file a report with your insurance.

They have a great look, but administration is ridiculously incompetent and rude except for the assistant manager Jessenia and a lady at the front desk named Heidi. From the first time looking at Nona Park Village I feel in love with the apartments.  It's like living in a resort not our typical apartment complex.  The Office Staff is friendly and very pleasant to talk to.  They never fail in helping you put.  The maintainance is spot on.  When you have a problem with your apartment they are on the ball to fix it.  

SO, HAPPY IM LIVING HERE.

Moved in late November 2019. Had maintenance issues the first week with clothes dryer and toilet flushing. Heritage Estates is a beautiful complex on the North East side of Orlando. Just 10 minutes from the Waterford Lakes Town Center, it's located on a quiet and safe part of Curry Ford Rd. The exteriors are gorgeous and well maintained. The appliances inside and the carpet are slightly outdated. However, the units overall, are very nice considering the pristine location and price point.
the worst apartment complex ever!!!! i'm moving as quickly as i can ....
I've lived here for 2 year, love the unit I'm in. Great community and community staff. The property is well manicured. I definitely feel safe living and would recommended it anyone.
Very nice apartment. Nice landscaping.  Great amenities and the staff is very friendly and helpful with any issues that have come up!
This is a great property friendly staff very friendly and helpful staff ????

Na minha experiência como morador no MAA Heather Glen, a questão mais preocupante tem sido a grave falta de segurança. Fui vítima de dois furtos dentro do complexo, onde itens do meu veículo foram roubados no estacionamento. Os eventos foram claramente capturados em gravações de vídeo, que mostram tentativas de acesso não autorizado a vários carros, incluindo o meu.

Infelizmente, ao tentar resolver o problema com a administração do complexo, encontrei uma receptividade decepcionante. As preocupações levantadas sobre a segurança geral foram minimizadas, destacando uma lamentável falta de empatia e responsabilidade por parte da gestão. Em nenhum momento busquei compensação financeira; meu objetivo era simplesmente garantir um ambiente seguro para todos os residentes.

Além disso, numerosos relatos e avaliações presentes online indicam que essas ocorrências são comuns, demonstrando inequivocamente a deficiência das medidas de segurança no condomínio. A repetição desses casos cresce, expondo todos nós a riscos inaceitáveis em nossa própria casa.

Dada essa situação, não me sinto mais seguro aqui e já estou arranjando uma mudança. Espero sinceramente que a administração do MAA Heather Glen tome ações imediatas e eficientes para endereçar essas preocupações sérias e legitimas. Até que essas melhorias sejam feitas, eu não recomendaria este complexo a outras famílias buscando um local seguro e protegido para morar.
Quick and convenient move in process. Great community for families with kids. The staff was extremely professional and with a positive attitude.

Great beautiful location, easy commute to everywhere, everything! Something for everyone close by most popular places in Orlando, all the best shopping stores and dining is very good food around here. I love the tranquility of the lake pond out my door, I love that I can take my dog out for a walk around every morning and boost my mood, enjoying peacefully. airy apartment homes, floor plans are very nice and different ones to choose from, I live in one with den that gives me natural lighting in home with nice window and space where I can set office or other sanctuary. Fast and attentive maintenance, yes ?? peace of mind around the clock and consistent upbeat in office team who I can count on. I feel safe and fulfilled, I cannot ask for better I am looking forward to many years here. I appreciate your wonderful services. Thank you immensely for all your services.

Had really bad experience as we move. No correct inspection done before we moved as we where told to move ASAP as it was all ready and we moved even though we had a week time.

Muy mala administración la manager no tiene nada de profesional tuve muy mala experiencia con ellos después q deje el apartamento y ella me había dicho q ya habían ocupado el apartamento y no les debía nada del contrato me mando un email a los dos dias con una deuda de 11,000  no tiene. The Good:
The apartments are good condition, with great floor plans. The two pools are pretty, and the landscaping is great. The location is nice, close to Lake Baldwin, Winter Park, and downtown Orlando.
The employees are polite and competent, and the maintenance crew are excellent. 

The Bad:
Don't let the listed prices fool you. Even if you get the longest contract they offer (15 months), you will be paying hundreds of dollars more per month than the price listed here. Common area electric is an additional charge, so is a mandatory valet trash service. 
The additional fees alone are almost $100 per month. I currently pay about $300 more per month over the advertised price, for a currently listed floor plan. 
Residents frequently set their trash out early, so the corridors smell like trash. Management has not taken meaningful action.
The elevators are frequently broken for long periods of time.
The gym has extremely limited equipment, and the equipment available is odd. It does not support a serious workout. 
The club room is cool, but the pool table needs new felt, and the available sticks need maintenance. 
The corridors and stairwells have not been cleaned in over a year.
The electronic entry gates frequently break.
Overall, I recommend paying an additional $100 per month (over what you will pay here, not the advertised price), and renting at the Paramount in downtown Orlando.

Just renewed our lease since it was easier not to have to move. Let me start by saying we I have lived here now for nearly 4 years. When I first moved it the former company and staff were wonderful. The grounds were kept up and maintenance really cared about the tenants. With this new company ZRS management this place has gone downhill. They just want to take your money and nothing is ever cleaned, fixed or upgraded. Starting this month the company makes you pay for common area electricity (lights in your hallways/building - something that a tenant should not have to pay for not to mention half the time the lights in the building are not working properly so your safety is at risk if you are coming home at late hours) and the water/sewer bill is now billed for the average usage of the building instead of individual meters on top of all the others fees you have to already pay for. So basically you now have to not only pay for your own electric bill but now also for the building. Absolutely ridiculous!!!!! This company no longer care for the safety and well being of the tenants but just how much money they can get out of you. Next they will start charging for lawn maintenance service or common area cleaning fee and pool cleaning fees and gym usage fee……. RUN!!!!!!! Save your money and rent someplace else where they don’t charge for everything!!!

Lived here for a year and didn't really run into any issues. Very quiet community, beautiful pool area, apartment has treated us well, and haven't really had any issues with maintenance. The gym is terrible, so if that is important to you look elsewhere, but overall had a great experience living here and would recommend to a friend!

We moved in almost a year ago and we love our apartment and the staff is very friendly. However, I feel like the staff needs to keep a better eye on the property. Although most residents respect the property and keep it well maintained, there are a few “frat” like residents that are complete slobs and it’s very discouraging. The community has access to valet trash services, which most of our building respects and follows. However, one neighbor has continually left bags of trash and open trash in the hallway. Even after a notice was given that residents who do not follow the trash rules will be fined, they have littered the hallway with trash taking the “luxury” away from our property. I have had guests comment on how disgusting our hallway is. To top it off, these same residents have had guests come in and out SPITTING in the hallway and acting like we live in a frat community.  

We have gotten tired of complaining and unfortunately are considering moving because we moved here because we liked the quiet and “clean” community, but we are getting fed up with living next to disgusting disrespectful residents. It would help if occasionally the staff would walk the hallways in ALL the buildings and address the issues.

This place is going from a posh living environment to a frat house mess. The pool is Party Central destroying property. Sadly just a poor living environment for anyone that wants to pay the prices of an upper scale property do yourself a favor and look for a property that knows how to run a luxury apartment complex not this one. Management is unexperienced!

I moved here in October and it has been a great experience so far! The apartments all have new appliances, the bathrooms are big and the kitchen is beautiful! I love this place.
My husband and I had a certain budget but we couldn’t resist this apartment after seeing the model even though it was a little over our budget, but every penny is worth it. Staff and management are also very professional and helpful.

I lived here a few years ago and then moved away to a different city. When I was planning in moving back, I had liked The District so much that I chose to move in here again. The location is great. I like that it has a garage. I like the package locker system. I like the amenities. The layout of the apartment is nice. Those are all still true, but WOW have things changed. The apartment was filthy when I moved in. The floor was so dirty that it turned the bottoms of my feet black and I spent an entire saturday scrubbing it (when I know, based on my lease, that they charged the previous tenant a cleaning fee at move-out). I have had problems with ants, and last night I found a cockroach crawling into my food. The tub was stained when I moved in. The dishwasher and clothes washer both had damage to them that was not completely rendering them broken, but was concerning. The business center and movie room are closed. Gates are broken. My air conditioner is gushing water and when I called maintenance out the first time, they would not believe me that something was wrong. It’s just frustrating to be paying this much and having so many issues.
The property is dated and afraid to let my child play in the grass due to all the animals using it as a bathroom. the management only seems to want to help until they get you to sign the lease.

The fire alarm in building A goes off at least twice a month, often times at late hours or early in the morning.  It's broken.  The fire department begrudgingly shows up and turns it off.  Maybe a dozen residents still bother to evacuate.  Most people wait it out on their patio.  People's dogs howl in pain from the screeching noise.  

The property management knows that this is a problem.  I'm sure they get countless emails about it every time that it happens, but they just. won't. fix. it.  

Keep in mind - this building has had two fires in the past 3 years.  With that in recent memory, residents still won't evacuate because the problem is so persistent that nobody takes it seriously anymore.  God help us if there is ever an actual fire.

We lived in The District for over a year and absolutely loved it. The apartment is well maintained. Maintenance requests are handled in a timely manner. Staff is super friendly (especially Amanda and Rachel). They just make the standard of living better every passing day.

They wasted my time , after calling and getting info and was asked to stop by to take a look, I go there wait 20 minutes only to be told that they can’t show me today cause they don’t have enough staff! What a joke.

The District was one of our first steps when we were apartment hunting and the staff was so friendly and helpful that everywhere else was just going to be a major step back! Incredible staff and they keep everything nice and clean! Any issue we've had were resolved quickly and efficiently!  Our neighbors are so friendly and the small community events the staff puts on are so fun too!! Absolutely love it!

The apartment units and pool area were fine, but as I was being toured, a large rat ran across the property. This was a few feet away from the apartment model that they showed me. Needless to say, I won’t be moving here, and I couldn’t get out of there fast enough. I was utterly disgusted.

The apartment has always been a great place to live; beautiful rooms, updated facilities, and a great location. However, the previous management (as you can probably tell from the other reviews) didn’t care much about their residents. EVERYTHING HAS CHANGED. The new management has made this place something to be proud to call home. They’re creating a community, not just renting you a place for the night.

The hallways and stairwells have door urine and feces and smell awful.  The sound from above is obnoxious and nothing gets done.  You have to call about maintenance issues multiple times and things are still broken.  The office crew are rude and mean and don't care about you.  Overall run away and spend your money somewhere nice.

We have been at The District for a year and absolutely love the apartments.  The exterior of the building is maintained well along with the actual interior amenities; however, the hallways are a little dark and need some attention.

The staff for the most part are great.  When I have lived elsewhere I have always seen a lot of change among office staff; however, everyone is still here from when we first leased.  Jessica, the Community Manager, is great to deal with when you can catch her.  She is very energetic and knows a lot about the property.  Nicholas always has a smile and is extremely helpful whenever me or my wife comes into the office.  He greets every resident by their name which I think is great considering the size of the community.  Legia (not sure of the correct spelling) is very friendly and helpful .  Kelly, Assistant Manager, is great but can be very sarcastic when you ask simple questions. 

The pool and gym are by far the best amenities that they have on property.  Fitness center is 2 stories and also offers tanning.  Equipment is in need of some repair but is still functional.  Pool is gorgeous.  Weekends and summer it gets a little crowded but the residents keep it peaceful.  Business Center always seems to be out of paper or out of ink.  Multimedia room is a waste of space and would be used more if it offered more than a small DVD player. 

I do wish they would have a few more resident events as the last couple months seems to have been lacking.  Food trucks apparently no longer come and it is always alcohol based.

Basically, The District is a great place to live and we definitely will be renewing our lease for our second year.  Apartments are amazing, amenities are great, staff is awesome.

The District is a nice apartment complex in a great area. However, I cannot reccomend moving here due to incompetent and heartless management. Upon moving out, we were told that we could pay $150 for their EZ clean service. We went in to the office to sign up, and the representative told us not to opt in, that we only needed to wipe down the counters and vacuum. We did all of this. A few days later, we were informed that The District would be keeping our deposit for a cleaning fee, and the total bill came to over $280. When I went in to dispute the charges, I was interrupted and treated poorly. The representative lied outright about the previous conversation. Words were exchanged, and I moved on.

There are other reservations to moving here. The "stunning" courtyard they advertise has become a dump, with no irrigation and vast amounts of dog waste everywhere. The "dog park" that was just built is a joke. It is in a flooded marshland, and the bars are big enough for most apartment dogs to fit through, putting them at risk of being hit by cars, which drive dangerously fast through the garage. The complex claims to have breed restrictions, but one visit to The District and you will find Pitbulls, German Shepherds, Rottweilers, and the like. I love dogs, but the rules they themselves have laid down are unenforced, unless it means cash flow for management.

We actually enjoyed our apartment at The District, but the decay of the facilities is evident all around. Management is friendly when you come through the door, but when you actually need assistance, they are nowhere to be found and outright rude. A few years ago, I would have reccomended The District as a fine place to live, but I simply cannot say it is any longer. I have given a one star review not out of spite and anger, which I certainly have an abundance of today, but to highlight the existing and growing problems of the overpriced, unfriendly environment at The District.
amazing modern furnish, great area, convenient, quite and beautiful

Location is alright if you want to be in the area of tourists and night life. In the apartment the washer and dryer has been giving my roommate and I problems since we moved in. Maintenance came once fixed it, it messed up again and our clothes were still soaked after it ran through the wash. Maintenance came and fixed it three times and we are still having a problem with it. They have trash valet but wont take your boxes unless they are in a trash bag. Since Ive moved in (6 months now) they have not given me a working gate code.

This complex is horrible. Numerous dog owners allow their dogs to defecate in the hallways, stairwells, and everywhere they please. It is not cleaned up even after management is alerted. Even worse, they will not even try to correct the issue. The hallways smell horrible and there is dust and trash everywhere. There is noise from the parking lot every night and every morning from the busses there to pick tourists staying at the complex behind this one. This is the worst place we have lived and would not recommend it to our worst enemy. Stay away!

University Apartments is very close to UCF so if you are a student or working at UCF, it's a great place to live. You can walk or scooter to school with ease. The staff is nice and all issues get taken care of promptly.
You don't have to be a student to live here, but there are students as well as families! Great neighborhood, location, and staff! Neighborly atmosphere.

I have been living in this apartment for the past 6 years. The management and maintenance are always prompt, perfect, and friendly. This is the most affordable apartment and is situated in a prime location. Right across the trail, you have UCF and within the 5-mile radius, you have the best dining options and shopping areas. I definitely recommend it!

We recently performed work at University Apartments in Orlando and the property management staff was wonderful. They take care of their units and make sure anything that is in need of repair and attention is taken care of immediately!  Would recommend them to those looking for a safe and clean housing!
This place is very good for a family. It is very close to the university. The management and staffs are very cooperative. Maintenance is available 24x7. We have a pleasant stay here.

This is a great place to live. The manager here is amazing, super friendly and always smiling. It’s a great price and if there’s any issues management and maintenance are on top of it quickly. It’s close to many stores and restaurants as well.

We live at 2193 W Oak Ridge Road for over 2 years now. More than one instance has occurred in the past with irresponsible handling of residents maintenance requests. The City of Orlando Code Enforcement has been involved and business had to perform multiple repairs to the property, fire and rehire office management staff to no avail. 
On Monday, June 3rd, 2024  our apartment’s AC unit stopped working. The maintenance request has been filed around 3 pm same day with no one responding to it, even though business open till 6 pm and when we came to the office around 4.40 pm same day because no one was accommodating proper response via the phone, the maintenance crew was sitting in the shade area by the leasing office on the golf carts, relaxing and using their cellphones. Once entered the office we were promised that someone will go check it out now. That came, looked at the broken AC and left with no updates to us. At this point our family of three, myself, my husband and 20 months old toddler, had to go out our way and book a hotel stay so we can have AC working. The temperature on our thermostat was 96 F, not much of the difference with outdoor. 
Next day they told us it was fixed and we have to wait for temperatures to cool down since we are on the second floor. No resolution, it has gotten worse. We came to the office again just to be told to wait, because there is a line of people ahead of us with similar issues and we should just wait and no one knows for how long. At this point we are booking another hotel night stay, just to be safe and avoid staying  in these inhuman, dangerous, health threatening conditions at our apartment where rent is always paid on time. On June 5, 2024, we came to office to get some answers and manager told us it will get fixed soon because someone broke our AC unit from outside and they need  to order a part. We were installed a mobile type window unit AC. As of June 8, 2024, AC is not fixed, no one has answers and we are desperate.

The most unorganized place to live hands down. They’ll send “work orders” that leave things just as broken as before they got there. I catch lizards in the house daily. And when you’re in a situation to beat time (paying rent) they won’t answer or respond to voicemails then leave you with a notice that you have a late fee very quickly. Don’t waste your time with this one. Not worth the money

I live here currently. I also lived here years ago for a total of 3 years. No problems (that cant be handled). It does a bit of a roach problem but I spray every other month so I hardly ever see them. The walls are thick, I can hardly hear my neighbors. Hope I can live here for a few more years.
Great customer service / maintenance  team loved my upgraded Kitchen and my new appliances

I was interested in renting a 3 bedroom with them. I’ve sent out several inquiries and called numerous times but I never heard from anyone. Either they need more employees or they just don’t care about renting out their vacant apartment homes.

Let me start by saying the only positive thing about living here is the maintenance. Luke is great. Aside from that, I have lived here since November and like many of the other reviews, it gets progressively worse almost immediately after you move in. I absolutely loved it at first and then I began hearing what sounded like heavy vibrations about a month or so in. A few months later, I finally realized that it was my downstairs neighbor blasting their TV stereo to the point it is shaking the foundation and my oven. I haven't sleep properly for about the past 2 weeks straight because of it.

When I brought the issue up to the leasing office, I genuinely thought they were going to do something about it. They sent out an email reminding everyone of the "quiet hours". After I followed up with Carmen and Amanda, I was told that they couldn't "substantiate" the tenant (who is not on the lease) was making the noise. The time stamp on the video is 12:36 AM on a Tuesday. 

The only solutions I was offered was to either move down the hallway to another unit (next to yet another neighbor that is playing loud music during the week) that was smaller, the cabinets in disrepair, and the floor was outdated (unlike my unit). They said it would be the SAME PRICE as the unit I'm in now. As if they were doing me a favor. I asked if they could at least fix the cabinets to make it comparable to the unit i've been in that ive taken care of and kept in great condition for the past 4 months for them. The response I got was if you don't want the other unit, then "you can still move out in 45 days with no penalty". Rather than addressing the issues with the tenants making the noise past the "quiet hours", as per our lease and Florida Law, as well as the Orlando City ordinance, their "solution" was move me to a smaller, lesser quality unit and pay the same price as what I'm paying now for the newer unit. 

Then to add insult to injury, in good faith, I paid my rent 3 days early (as I normally do) through my checking account. Instead of processing it on the 28th of March (when I paid it), they waited until April 4th (6 days later) to process the payment. Adding $200 in fees and threatening legal action. Move somewhere else that doesn't treat people like this.

I hope you like weekly visits from maintenance, being harassed by homeless people, and constant noise! 
Because I have the perfect place for you

I moved out after only 3 months, having active leaks for all 3 months.

There is no security for the property. You will pay astronomical rent prices only to have your property vandalized and your safety threatened by the numerous drug addicts who frequent the area. These individuals trespass onto the property consistently with no repercussions. The office staff could not care less.

Move in experience was not perfect but the fast response and professionalism of the staff definitely helped. Rain dampened the day and showed a leaky ceiling which was quickly taken care of. Staff did everything in their means to help. Overall positive experience; loving the new place.

To preface I moved into this place in October of 2020 under the assumption it was a luxury apartment complex. Beneath the glitzy and tacky remodel is a building unfit to live in. Dating to 1949 the building is full of lead pipes, notices not to use the water have came up multiple times in my short 7 month lease. Mornings without hot water are a common occurrence. A/c systems failing are a common occurrence. The elevators are from the 1980s and regularly stop between floors. Since they are serviced by the same people that put the bandaid fixes on everything else, they are probably unsafe. Regularly they will stop at the lobby but will not open, they will then take you to the basement and go into service mode, before closing and returning you to the original floor. I have brought this up to staff repeatedly and get shrugged off. The staff will enter your property unannounced without permission. The first time they did this was to provide an emergency repair, they pulled out the refrigerator and left it pulled out when I got home without notice. The second one occurred on June 2nd, I work in healthcare and wasn’t home until around midnight that night, my rent was paid in the AM hours of June 2nd in the front office, (the online bank total was down again) that day a staff member entered my apartment and evaluated my possessions while I was gone and left a notice that in the event I didn’t pay rent I would have three days before I would be evicted. This gross overstep happened after I had payed early several times prior, and was only a few hours late this time. The laundromat on site does not function properly, machines are moldy and poorly maintained. If you venture down the wrong corridor you will find flaking lead paint. The building wiring system is a mess and shorts out at least monthly. The fire department has been on scene twice since I moved here. The junction box in the lobby reads disabled now and lets out beeps every few seconds. If you open any unlocked corridor door you will find leaking pipes, exposed wiring, and more lead paint. The parking garage gates have been broken on and off for months allowing people from the streets to flood the place, so actual residents will usually only find a place on the roof, the garage elevator has been broken several times since moving here,. The turning circle is closed off permanently, as the building gets extra revenue by renting out the space. Saturday and Sunday you are greeted by loud music.

Post Parkside is all about location. I think that's really the only way they can get away with charging what they do. The building looks like an old hotel that sports stains on the carpets in the hallways, faulty elevators, and strange apartment layouts. The parking garage is a total nightmare, and there's no guest parking. 

On a positive note, the pool and workout facilities are conveniently located and always clean. The staff has been nothing but friendly and helpful, and are always there to answer any questions you might have.

If you're a frequent downtown-goer and want a unique place to live, I'd say Post Parkside is a pretty good choice.
April was unbelievably helpful. This is my third apartment in the area and she was hands down the most help. She cared and fixed a few issues on move in day to ensure it went smoothly.

Please just save yourself the headache and live elsewhere. While the location and amenities are nice, they either don’t work or take weeks to get fixed. I could create an ongoing list of issues, but to name a few:

THE ELEVATORS. That’s all I have to say. When an elevator is broken, there is no urgency to get it fixed, no message to the community about the issue, and no timeline of when it’ll get fixed. I was once told the elevator company was coming the day I inquired about it, but it still didn’t get fixed until days later.
MAINTENANCE - Absolutely horrendous. I’ve lived in numerous “luxury” apartment complexes, and I’ve never had to wait over 15 days. My work orders have been pending for 16 days. They always say “we complete them in chronological order and you’ve been added to the queue.” I’ve been added to the queue and have been waiting over two weeks for the office to replace a moldy dishwasher filter. If I hadn’t pulled out the filter on my own because it wasn’t cleaning correctly, then I would’ve kept washing dishes in there without realizing the filter was full of mold, and I only moved here in August.
FIRE ALARMS - Why does a fire alarm go off at random times? We get messages saying “we are working on fixing the fire alarms,” yet I’ve lived here for two months now and still haven’t seen a solution.
THE LIES - When I moved here, I signed a lease under the impression that I could upgrade my appliances for a small extra monthly fee because that’s what I was assured would be an option after asking multiple times. After signing, the leasing agent told me “we’ve stopped that for the time being.” Are we serious? I relied on that assurance, and it’s half the reason I signed here. The Nine boasts attractive features but is marred by considerable issues, especially concerning construction quality and management efficiency:

Amenity Problems: Initially, grills lacked propane for months, and despite sporadic refills, they remain frequently unusable. Similar issues affect amenities like the coffee maker and printer, often out of service or lacking supplies promptly.

Dishwasher Issues: My dishwasher was non-functional initially due to a water supply issue, which leaked into the unit below. Despite maintenance deeming it faulty and leaving it off, I fixed it myself by tightening the water line after waiting a week.

Elevator Outage: One elevator remained non-operational for six months, causing significant inconvenience. While The Nine blamed the elevator company, an apology was warranted.

Parking Shortage: There's insufficient parking for residents and guests, exacerbated by a new lease clause preventing collective legal action regarding this issue.

Trash Management: Trash piled up initially, with management blaming residents, though inadequate setup to handle garbage was evident.

Noise and Structural Issues: Poor sound insulation and construction flaws, like uneven doors and slanted balconies, detract from comfort and safety.

Incomplete Maintenance: Hallway repairs lacked proper finishing, leaving visible screw lines and unfinished painting.

Fire Alarm Disruptions: Fire alarms frequently go off, including late hours, some due to tenant actions or faulty systems, requiring a more proactive response from management.

Bathroom Design Flaws: Some units have impractical bathtub designs with faucets placed inconveniently, with management offering no solutions.

Persistent Leaks: Multiple leaks, including one causing a flood and mold issues, persist due to inadequate maintenance responses.

Security Concerns: Faulty locks and unresolved graffiti compromise security and aesthetics.

Construction Debris: Construction materials clutter public areas like the garage, despite available storage rooms.

In conclusion, despite its newness, The Nine suffers from numerous maintenance, design, and management issues that significantly impact residents' living experience.

Lake Clearwater is a great value for the money and I highly recommend living here. I've lived here since 2019 and have upgraded from the one-bedroom apartment to the two-bedroom apartment with attached garage. 
Pros: 
1) Lake Clearwater's staff office and maintenance staff are all very friendly, highly responsive, and easy to do business with. 
2) The apartments are well-maintained. I have very few maintenance problems with my apartment, and have had no serious problems (no bugs, no flooding, no mold, nothing broken). The amenities, landscaping, parking lot, and all shared areas are very well-maintained and kept looking nice.
3) The apartments are getting better all the time. While the buildings and infrastructure are not the newest, Lake Clearwater takes many steps to improve them. While I've been here, they've upgraded to a new color scheme in apartment interiors (paint and countertops) and exteriors (exterior siding and doors), upgraded to all-new GE appliances (ceramic-top stove, microwave, refrigerator, and dishwasher), renovated the leasing office, installed Amazon Hub for tenant packages, and installed energy-efficient LED lights and Nest thermostats throughout the complex.
4) The apartments include great features that are hard to find in other Indianapolis apartments, such as valet trash service, in-unit washers/dryers, garages, fireplaces, key-code entry, and fiber internet. Pets are allowed too.
5) The neighborhood is great. It’s safe and close to everything. It's a short drive (or even walk!) to restaurants, bars, grocery stores, retail, The Fashion Mall, nature areas, interstate and bus access. 
6) Monthly apartment events are a nice bonus. They usually include free food and drinks, and are a nice opportunity to meet your neighbors and Lake Clearwater staff. 
Cons:
1) The walls and windows are somewhat thin. Noise and cold are occasionally issues. However, it's no worse than other places I've lived in within the Indianapolis area. I’ve been able to work comfortably from home since I arrived here in 2019, and am able to sleep fine at night.
2) The vinyl-wood floors and ceramic cooktop are beautiful, but they both require careful maintenance and cleaning to ensure they stay looking nice and don't get scratched. Not everyone may be willing or able to do so much upkeep.
3) The smoke alarms are very sensitive and sometimes go off during cooking, especially when using the oven.
4) The GPS on some phones has trouble navigating Lake Clearwater.
