My wife and I moved into Shadeland Station after owning our own home out of state.  I got a job that relocated us to Indy, and we weren't able to sell our house, so owning another home was not an option for us.  Our last rental situation involved roaches (enough said), so we weren't okay with renting again, but we felt like we had no choice.  One of my new co-workers recommended Shadeland Station and in one visit, we were hooked.

The overall premises were kept well, with a beautiful water fountain in the middle of the complex, and with obviously landscaped lawns and maintained buildings.  There are a couple of kids' areas on site, as well as a public pool that is open much of the year.  The complex is just off of Shadeland Avenue, giving easy access to many of the Castleton attractions, and it is close enough to a local college that many residents walk down the hill to school!  The welcome center is quite nice, including a fitness room and a small meeting area, but none of those amenities are things I had not seen before.

However, what really separated Shadeland Station to my wife and me is the staff.  From the maintenance crew to the property manager, everyone is very friendly and eager to help with anything we need.  There are frequent tenant appreciation events that offer cash, prizes, and free dinner just for attending!  Even though there must be hundreds of residents in this complex, when I come to the welcome center, I am recognized by name.  In fact, as a frequent Amazon shopper, I often pick up items at the welcome center and usually our welcome staff greets me immediately upon entry with my packages because they noticed me by my car in the parking lot!  This may not seem like a big deal to many, but my wife and I were blown away by the attention to detail and by the level of care that our apartment staff shows in making us feel special.  On almost every staff-sponsored event we go to, nearly everyone we talk to agrees with us that this is the best renting experience we have ever had.

Our apartment itself was beautiful as it usually is before moving in, and it had a newly installed and very effective washer and dryer put in, but as most people know, an apartment is an apartment.  Security is not the same as at a personal home, but SimpliSafe is a great solution if you are interested!  Now that we have a child, we wish there were a 3-bedroom option available, but we love Shadeland Station enough that we want to stay here as long as we can!

I also wish they had a pay rent online feature, but I hope that comes in the future. Parking can be a challenge at times, but if everyone had their guests park at the office when staying overnight, it wouldn't be. I believe they have plans to start towing parking violators once all the red tape is done.
Overall I have no major complaints with living here. I've found the place to be quiet, safe, and comfortable. I do enjoy attending some of the resident events that the office staff throws and almost always win some sort of prize.

Also the latest issue is the fire alarm strobe lights going off from 10:30pm until 2:30pm. Management is useless and does not care about their tenants. 

Trust me you're peace of mind is not at the Block Apartments, rent literally anywhere else.

If you are looking for a "caring people management team" this is the place plus amazing departments with lots of character and "thick concrete floors".  
I'm a young professional girl that travel about 50% of the time, and I always fell safe and had the help and support of Emily (building manager) and specially of Marshall (leasing agent) always going the extra mile to help you and make sure things get done. 
I lived there for about 2 years, and what I miss the most is that they genuinely care about delivering a prime service!

The Block couldn't be in a more perfect location in downtown Indianapolis. Most places are minutes away and you can get to many places without going outside which is awesome in the winter.  This building used to be a department store and it's really cool that the units are so unique with many of the original details. To live here though you have to be willing to compromise on the service. Expect to clean a lot on your own when you first move in. And if you need any fixes, just be aware that they make take the cheapest way out, or things may only be half done. But if you can live with those things, you really can't beat this location in the city. It is a really neat place.
This property is everything the other poor reviews say and more. Cheaply built, challenges with the office staff, and nothing luxury about the experience.

When I moved in, I saw the reviews as warnings but just kind of ignored them. After moving in, I truly think this is the worst place that I've ever lived in terms of the interactions with management. They will tell you what you want to hear in person but then completely change their tone after the lease. make sure that you get everything in writing or record the meetings. Amber in maintenance is truly phenomenal though.

If you wonder why, see the negative reviews. I had the worst rental experience, and I found a much larger home with amenities, nearby for the same price. After years of aggravation and terrible practices from the entire staff and their corporate representatives, I must review this experience as the worst in history. The charge you for everything, and never follow through on maintenance requests so you are much better off renting a home and finding a decent landlord if you are in a hurry to find housing.

When I moved in this place was great. It was quiet and the staff was amazing. They knew everyone and I always had a pleasant experience in the office. When I signed my lease, they even gave me a birthday card as Insigned on my birthday.  My last year, the neighbors were extremely loud and other things… When I asked to have (temporary) roommates removed from the lease, they kept them on. They received emails for months. When I moved, they asked for a signature  from someone that moved out a year prior. The clincher was that I didn’t get a deposit back or any itemized list on why I didn’t receive it. The apartment was left in great condition, cleaned, the carpet looked great and nail holes pre patched. For paying a pet deposit, pet rent and a deposit, you would think you would get something back. The newer staff called two or three times because no one could record my forwarding address properly in the system.

The worst apartment / management. The place is not luxury in any sense. These apartments were built so cheap. You will hear everything from the outside street noise to your neighbors watching tv / talking etc. There is no insulation in the walls / window so your electric bill will be very high each month. The worst part is the rude, spiteful , unprofessional office employees. They will not help you at all . They only care about locking you down to a lease and making you pay a ridiculous amount of money for rent / utility bills and fees especially the fraudulent move out fees they claim you own them. Save your sanity and sleep honestly. This place looks nice from
the outside but don’t be fooled. Don’t say I didn’t tell you. There are plenty of better apartments in every sense around/ in Zionsville.

Do not lease from this company, you will regret it and end up being overcharged, ignored and sent an outrageous bill upon move out. forget about a security deposit, you won't get it back if you have any issues with their staff regarding maintence practices or raised rent during your lease. they will charge you based on whatever they feel like, even if you leave your apartment pristine and had no pets. maintence permanently damages valuable personal belongings while trying to fix an issue from a different unit, corporate refused to compensate for my personal belongings. If you are looking for an apartment or rental in this area, I encourage you to look elsewhere or contact homes for sale to see if you can rent.

Living at The Artistry Apartments for 14 months has been an absolute nightmare. Despite the promises in the lease, many of the amenities were either never provided or constantly unavailable. The elevators were consistently broken, and rarely fixed. My roommate and I almost got trapped multiple times - it was not only frustrating but also dangerous. The valet trash service was another constant headache - inconsistent and unreliable. The gym would have several machines broken, lights in the hallways would not get replaced, and the hallways were always dirty.

There were always issues with getting work orders completed. No matter how many times we submitted requests, they were consistently ignored. One of the most concerning issues was that management never gave notice when workers were entering our apartment for maintenance, which was a clear violation of the lease.

But the worst experience by far happened in May of this year when a painter crew, who wasn't even supposed to be in our building or unit, was let into our apartment. My roommate and I, both women, were terrified to find our unit completely torn apart. The painters caused over $700 in damage to our personal items--breaking headboards, shattering candles, ruining linens by standing on our beds, and more. This was not only a violation of our space but a serious safety concern.

We had to consult legal advice just to get management to negotiate repayment for the damages. The whole experience has been traumatic and exhausting.

If you are considering living here, please save yourself the stress and avoid The Artistry Apartments at all costs. They don't honor their lease agreements, provide subpar services, and the management is careless with tenant safety and property. This place is not worth your peace of mind.

I would highly not recommend. My car has been broken into here multiple times (seems like I'm not the only one) AND had my catalytic converter sawed out of my car and of course the Artistry said it wasn't their problem. An armed man was in the parking garage and the Artistry didn't even think to notify that no one go in there when there were police everywhere. I found a random gun laying outside. And to top it all off they are trying to make me pay over $4000 because I didn't give a 60 day notice that I was leaving even though my lease is ending. Overall, save yourself the trouble and look for a different apartment.

After I moved out of Artistry Indy, I was issued a full deposit refund. I never received the check from the Artistry. I continued to follow up and even offered to pick it up. The check is expired by now since the Artistry has ignored me for months.  I assume Artistry Indy requires its tenants to pay timely and fulfill their obligations in order the keep shelter and avoid negative marks on their credit, however, they lawlessly ignore their residents with no consequences.

I’ve been in my apartment less than a month and I’ve had so many issues. I’m thinking of breaking my lease. A/c went out first week. Maintenance request go unanswered or take days for a reply. Staff and amenities are nice but not worth the price you pay. Shop around!

The downtown Indy area is such a fun place to live BUT if you don't want to over pay for bad quality units, awful and disrespectful management and homeless people in all door ways of this community at late hours of the night than artistry isn't the place for you. I have never lived in a place where I have to argue to have basic maintenance requests taken care of. if this is something you don't mind dealing with I see they have a lot of availability, would never recommend.

Please spend your hard earned money somewhere else. There has been no effort put into this apartment community that would qualify it as “luxury” or that could justify the prices they are charging people for some of these units. For one the leasing office does not have anyone’s best interest in mind. The complex hadn’t been updated in years - the hallways are dark and dingy and the layout sucks. I remember just feeling so sad that I even moved into this place. My current apartment has a sewage smell that comes from the bathroom shower every day - the pictures of the units looks nice online, but no one has updated these units in years. The lights in the units are also fluorescent and make you feel like you’re being interrogated. And everyone who lives here is 22-25 and parties all the time. The washer and dryers in the units all smell like mold. The water pressure in the sinks and bathrooms is no -existent. And it’s even a nightmare trying to locate packages/items that you’ve ordered. Also they don’t deliver large packages to your apartment door - the carriers have to leave oversized packages in the main building. Which means you have to move furniture/large items to your own apartment and maintenance doesn’t assist with things like that

Living downtown is SO fun. Living at Artistry is a mess. They don’t communicate, they never respond to emails, they aren’t human about human problems. I’m just disappointed about how much money I spent to live here and it feels like I should be getting high quality service instead of being babysat and yelled at. Not a fan.

I wouldn't recommend moving here.  The staff is great to sell you on the property, but once you sign you will never hear back from them on any issues that come up.  The pool is nice and fun in the summer, but that's the only upside.  For the price I would go somewhere with better customer service/communication. Not a place for young professionals, mostly seems like freshmen in college live here. Most people definitely don’t work 9-5 jobs so they party all day/night during the week.
Highly recommend not living here. All three of my neighbors have bass speakers hooked up to my walls. Have you ever heard bluegrass music with bass? It’s creepy and scary. Don’t move here.

Artistry is a great place to live! The pool is great in the summer and the staff throws an amazing pool party!! I have lived here for almost a year now and I can't imagine a better place to live in downtown Indy. It is right in the heart of downtown so there is always something to do. The staff always throws great resident events whether it be on the property or at a local brewery. I have made so many friends from living here. I definitely recommend anyone to check out Artistry and call it your home!

Horrible experience all together. DO NOT RENT HERE. My fiance and I moved to Indianapolis excited to live in the city in a luxury apartment. Instead all we got was 6 months worth of pain. No air conditioning in the hot summer, washer and dryer hooked up wrong causing a flood in our back bedroom, no hot water in the showers, leaking dishwasher, I even had a full closet rack fall on top of my head because it was not installed and anchored properly! Oh and did I mention their security is horrible? Parking garage jumping and homeless people getting in the building lobby! But don't bother calling for assistance, because the staff and especially the "manager" will never respond. 

Highly suggest looking elsewhere! There are many other great apartments through out the city.

This building has a great location, just three blocks from the heart of Downtown Indianapolis. The amenities in the building are a once in a lifetime opportunity, so make use of them! The overall atmosphere of the building is very exuberant with a lot of monthly events to attend and meet other residents.  The staff is extremely helpful and very knowledgeable when you have questions. This building has the perfect atmosphere and location for anyone looking to live in the heart of downtown.

The Artistry is a great place to live if you are looking to be immersed in downtown Indianapolis but still would like a quiet place away from the hustle of the heart of downtown.  It is a 8 minute walk to Monument Circle.  The modern feel the Artistry creates is well-complemented with any amenity you could need such as two workout facilities, rooftop pool, putting green, herb garden, well-kept lounges, and parking garages.  It is expensive, but reasonably compares to other apartment complexes in the area.  Recently, I have been frustrated with what seems to be a lack of customer service and construction but the Artistry does have decent means of compliant filing.  Over-all it is a good place to live that remains clean and quiet.

Great apt complex and great service. Full of young professionals, artistry is the place to live if you are in your late 20's -30's. Only had a problem with some construction issues but maintenance took care of them right away.
Bedbugs, mold and terrible management. Need I say more?
DONT MOVE HERE, THESE APARTMENTS ARE TRASH. NOTHING IS PUT TOGETHER RIGHT AT ALL EVERYTHING FALLS APART

Unfortunately this place deserves 0 stars but that’s not an option. Feeling unsafe at the place you call home is unsettling to say the least. If you’re going to listen to one review let it be this one. Roaches, trash, theft, poor management, poor maintenance, and guaranteed amenities that have not worked since I moved in. I’m a female in her 20s on a tight budget so my expectations looking for an apartment were never high but this experience has been worse than I could imagine. I have had to put in over 20 maintenance requests since may. Most of which are the same request being re put in because they were not done properly the first time. I got my car stolen off of the property which I am lead to believe would not have happened if the gated community i was promised was actually gated. The gates have not worked since moving in in May. One of the pools was green for weeks and not usable. The pest control has sprayed my unit 3 times and we’ve seen an increase in bugs ironically. I have talked to the property manager as well as the regional manager multiple times trying to get out of my lease without having to spend two months rent to break it. Although they were understanding with my frustrations it’s disappointing I was never given any resolutions or plans on how to improve my situation. I know my problems are not the property managers fault or the regional managers fault but a little accountability from the company would be appreciated. My car was stolen i believe on 11/26. I made my property manager aware that Monday since it was the thanksgiving holiday and then weekend. I asked for the camera footage 12/3 and then again on 12/5 and she said she doesn’t have footage going back that far which was surprising to me since it wasn’t even a week. I had an in person meeting set with the property manager and was greeted by a vape sitting front and center in front of my chair when I sat down which I found wildly unprofessional but makes sense with how this has been handled. This review doesn’t even scratch the surface of all the other issues I’ve had. Lesson learned on this place.

The apartment itself was actually nice, but the leasing staff…. AWFUL. They WILL try to over charge you. I was charged for 3 pets (there’s a 2 pet limit… so how would that even be possible) for the first couple months I lived there. Talked to the leasing office multiple times and they never took care of it until they tried to tell me I had a balance on my account from not paying for the 3rd pet. My rent wasn’t prorated for my move out until I had to talk to someone about it in person because no one answered my emails. I was charged $200 extra on my move out balance. They don’t care about the people that live there. There was also an incident where the knob on the door broke to get into the apartments… no one could get in or out, HUGE fire hazard!!! They act like they try and help you but in reality they are just after your money and could care less about you. My advice… run and never look back unless you have a lawyer and $1,000 laying around.

When I moved into my apartment it was as if they didn't even know we were coming. The toilet was broken, the tub was not finished, the window in the master bedroom was broken, the stove didn't work and my key was not activated. The staff while nice, was exceptionally unprepared and the maintenance staff unprofessional. Upon awaiting repairs for our apartment the suite we were given keys to stay in was not clean, sheets were dirty, cobwebs were in the corners, and it had bed bugs. The original presentation of an apartment here at Reflections may seem okay but the underlining overall conditions are below average at best but more accurately put unsatisfactory and disappointing

If you want to live in a frat house, strip club, auto body shop, theft city, dogs barking & roaming free central and etc....Then this is the place for you. You would think being a tenant would give you a say so but no. You will end up not getting sleep, having personal property damage and 9 times out of 10 speaking with property manager as well as staff with such issues and being brushed off. If you have a family, morals, bills, personal property, a car and etc... This is not the place for you.

If I could give this apartment complex zero stars, I would. At first it seemed like a nice place to live. Move-in went smoothly and maintenance was quick and the maintenance people were friendly. However, I noticed terrible mold behind the fridge as I was moving out, my dishwasher barely worked, and there was a huge roof leak and  they left my place dirty after they fixed it. I also experienced 3 break-ins. After the second one I requested a security camera for the building for my safety and the safety of other tenants and it was DENIED. This company does not care about the safety of its tenants. Because I was a full-time student I was unemployed when I rented this place, they wanted a large deposit. Despite my high credit score, they made me pay a $500 deposit. I agreed, because I would get it back anyways. It's been 2 months since I was able to break off the lease due to the break-in and they never gave me back my money! Now they are accusing me of owning a pet when I never did, and they are charging ME money after such an outrageous deposit. Never met such an unsympathetic, vile company in my whole life. I think they were taking advantage of me knowing that I was not from the country, and I'm thinking of getting my lawyer involved. For your safety and bank account DO NOT move to this place.

We rented from them for 13 months.

The unit had an absolutely wonderful location close to shopping and north side jobs. 

We overlooked the fact they were unsafe (thefts, thefts of received packages, and burglaries were the norm in the neighborhood).  Don't worry you are required to have renters insurance, they won't make you move until your second claim in a 60 day period we were told by our neighbor.  We were not bothered by our outdated, inefficient, and loud appliances (stoves and stackable washers) because we are old and almost deaf anyway and had low expectations for the place.  We overlooked the very aggressive, rude, and unprofessional manager Denise and the Sales lady Sam both because we are good people and know it takes all kinds to make the world go around. We didn't mind that the maintenance staff was unprofessional (we noticed the maintenance staff often didn't bring tools or supplies needed at time of repair, wrote us rude and condescending comments on our orders, were nosey in our belongings, and didn't call us using our actual phone number on our profile before entering our unit because we expected nothing of them anyway. It didn't bother us that the trash heaped over into the street from the one trash compactor where we had to haul our trash to on our car's hood or carry halfway across the property because we always just hoisted ours up into the compactor even if we had to pole vault to do it.  We were okay with fact the gates would go weeks without being fixed stuck open and people drive the wrong way, because we own two old junker cars and didn't care who came on in.  The pizza man could, and that's all that mattered to us!  

The big court yard in the middle is a good place to let your kids run loose and get out of your hair.

Good luck from our family to yours.

I have lived here for years; they have yet to renovate all the apartments, they have yet to build a pool we can all enjoy, they have yet to build a gym, they have yet to build BASIC LAUNDRY FACILILTIES, they have yet to fix the signs, lampposts, and speed bumps (that everyone but me drives around), so this whole complex looks like a garbage dump. Plus you get bugs like cockroaches. Avoid this place. They clearly don't care and seemingly do the bare minimum to make a paycheck.

This really is the worst place to live, the girls at the office when you move in are very friendly, after you move in, pay they bring out their true personality, the apartments don't have any air conditioning, you ask for help at the office and they simply tell you that they are busy and can't help you, on pay days the office is always closed so that the days go by and they can overcharge you, they close the office whenever they please, they never keep to their hours, rotten water comes out of the ground floor and they never do the math, you ask for a document or the key to the mailbox and it takes them up to 3 months to give it to you, they are awful insects.

When we first toured the apartments it was so nice. When it was time for us to move in the apartment looked nothing like the one we toured. The windows were very old and hard to open. The maintenance is absolutely terrible we had told one of the maintenance workers about our screen in our bedroom window and he said he would have to get a ladder to fix it and never came back to fix it. Maintenance will also walk in your house and get your floors dirty and not clean up after themselves. It also took 7 months for us to get our new patio door after we had put the request in not too long after we had moved in. They also say that they will have pest control come in to get rid of the bugs but they never come. These apartments have a huge problem with bugs and roaches. I would not recommend moving into these apartments. I can say that Blake is very nice and will try her best to fulfill your needs. If you want to move into apartments that have roaches and bugs be guess but I would not recommend moving in these apartments.

I just moved in and I already want to leave. It's so loud outside from car stereos, yelling, reving engines, people hanging out outside. If you want any sort of quiet, peaceful place to live, I would highly recommend not moving in here.

Seriously. Roach-infested and dirty. Have a walk around the property; you can see they don’t put any money into it. Everything is poorly constructed or poorly maintained. You can’t fully open your dishwasher because the refrigerator is in the way. A coaxial cable runs through your coat closet. And when I say roach-infested, I mean it. I’d see dozens a day and hundreds of dead ones in my cabinets after pest control troll came. The complex wouldn’t treat the whole building, just my unit. So the problem never stopped. Channel 6 investigated them in March of 2019 for multiple health code violations. Look into it before you move here. In fact, DON’T move here. It was the worst-managed property I have ever lived at. If you do make the mistake of moving here, stay current on your rent so at least they have to give you a good reference for when you finally escape. That’s what I did and I’ve never been happier to leave a place.

Just left the place totally angry ??, won't ever apply there. Their customer service associate, Erika, made me seat for over 25 minutes, she had forgotten I was there, only to tell me I was too late she couldn't assist. The excuse for jot helping me was that I made an appointment with a different associate, so I had to come back tomorrow if that associate is there then I can get assistance!
Never seen such poor customer service

How has my experience been here ?, extremely unpleasant. There are raccoons screeching and fighting above me while I’m awake while I’m asleep. And I HAVE been asking for a solution since fall. Looking at the model apartment everything appears to be very nice and clean and newly remodeled. The actual apartment is the total opposite everything is old. The office staff is rude. The maintence of the apartment is terrible. But the upkeeping on the outside that is visible to everyone is great. Nothing ever gets fixed. The walls are paper thin. Kids are always outside unsupervised bothering others. The price definately do not match the quality of the experience. Definately can go somewhere cheaper and live the same way.

This is my 1st year in the Fallwood Apartment Community and I don't intend to move anytime soon. My apartment is spacious, my neighbors are courteous, the property is well kept, and the office staff is amazing.  There are plenty of spacious apartments in town, but there's something to be said about courteous neighbors and a pleasant/thorough staff.  This is my home for the foreseeable future and I have no regrets for selecting Fallwood.  If you're in the market for an apartment, I recommend that you take a visit to Fallwood and see Latoria (the property manager) before signing a lease anywhere else.

Gave them free money for no reason:::: 

I'm from out of town. Applied. Was told I had an apartment. About two weeks before time to move, was told the " tenant didn't move out sorry".  
I've already given my 30 day notice.  Have to find another one. 

Ask for my $100 deposit back, arrogant, ignorant leasing agent says " no we got an apartment for you before the end of the month like we agreed "  
So I gave them $130 total for an apartment I didn't get.  Really cool, for someone who's moving and needs $. No... it isn't.

I have been here for 5 years and it has gotten progressively worse. The rent keeps going up, but the service keeps going down. The cost of heating and cooling is appalling and its because the buildings have not been updated since they were built in the 1970s. How they can charge what they are is beyond me. They advertised laundry hook-ups but had to change that later, since their aren't any and the facilities that they do have keep going up in price. This place is a joke and need to be completely gutted and remodeled, something else they told me had been done but hasn't. 

They refuse to fix anything correctly. Part of the roof blew off of the building next too mine and it took them more than 6 months to fix it, despite the fact that I took the piece of roofing in to the office and told them that I'd seen it fly off the building.  

I'd like to give it no stars, but have to give it something.

After living here for over a year now I feel confident in saying that this complex is a good place to live. Its a pretty quiet place and I've never felt unsafe. There are many families here so this is a good place is you have children. I love that we're across the street from the Fall Creek trail as well. Its a very nice trail. Prior to moving in we were told that the apartments had been remodeled,but that wasn't really true for our unit. The bathrooms and the kitchen are the most outdated rooms in the apartment. Management is pretty good. I've never had a problem with them. Maintenance is pretty cool too. They get the job done,but kind of the bare minimum. The cons are that parking is always a problem and that there is no laundry in these units. Each building does have its own laundry room but it sucks to have to deal with going up and down the stairs with laundry and to have to get quarters elsewhere. With those being the only cons its not a bad place to live.

I have been here for 3 years. Maintenance is awesome, the grounds are beautiful and the pool area is like a resort! I feel very safe as well. I would recommend Willow Lake to anyone! It has been fantastic.

We’ve been at Willow Lakes for half a year, and I can confidently say there have been ZERO complaints! From move in day, the team has been very accommodating and receptive. Maintenance comes very promptly within 1-2 days, they even came out on the weekend to give us a space heater when we were awaiting a part for our heater. The community has always been quiet, and we’ve always felt safe. Never have to worry about parking either! Many spots for you and your roommates. The team also has many events throughout the year to bring the community together so there’s always fun going on! We will always recommend Willow Lakes to anyone in need of a new home.
Great place to live. Great amenities. The staff care about the residents. They always host fun events. It is affordable for how spacious the townhomes are. Would recommend!

I have lived at this community for 2 years almost and I love it! The maintenance is always quick and thorough, and the apartments are spacious. My family loves going to the pool and says they feel like they’re at a resort every summer!

Where to start?

Amenities are great, the gym is quite complete, the tennis courts are great and the carwash area is a plus, water hose is not available during winter though.

Staff is great, competent and friendly…you can tell they care about you and your family

We were fortunate to be able to call Willow Lake our home for several years.  The grounds are absolutely beautiful and the apartments are spacious and very well done both inside and out!  The amenities offered are beyond compare -- loved the valet trash service!!  The staff -- both the office staff and the maintenance staff are wonderful and they are very concerned that everything is done right and completed in a timely manner.  I would highly recommend this community!

I wish I can give this place 0 stars. This complex is a mess, there is garbage everywhere!! This place is not worth the rent they are charging and there are several empty units by me because no one wants to live here trust me.

Don’t not move in here save yourself the stress
Roaches roaches roaches! Trash everywhere hence the roaches. I really don’t feel like anything else needs to be said beyond that.

I applied and my app was denied. The fees included app fee and a deposit. The apartment list these together and now they are trying to keep my deposit for an apartment I did not get. I am working through my bank now. Be careful when applying here

apply for an apartment, pay the application and fill out all the documents the next day they told me that they had already given it to another person.  They made me cancel my current apartment and the attention was terrible since they did not care about canceling my application and losing my money

Working with the leasing office and trying to find a place to call home has been one amazing process. The leasing department contacted me throughout the process and made this process very easy due me having to be at work during business Hours.

The new management company (Pepper Pike) is a joke. No Maintenace crew on site, can't keep employees in the office. The apartment itself is functional with a kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom. The layout has its quirks: the fridge is across from the bathroom, and the bedroom has no windows, making it feel cramped. The only large window is in the living room, and some units don’t even have that. The lack of an elevator is also inconvenient, especially during move-in and move-out.

Another issue is the smell of weed and smoke, despite the no-smoking policy. The noise from neighbors is a big problem—there’s no soundproofing, and you can hear everything from footsteps to conversations. You’ll likely need noise-canceling headphones.

Lastly, the office team is inflexible, and once you sign the lease, it feels like all they care about is payment. Their idea of making residents feel welcome is giving out sweets for most (if not all) holiday celebrations. In general, the customer office would benefit from better communication with empathy rather than a forceful approach.

Overall, while the apartments themselves are okay, there are several factors that make it less than ideal for long-term living. The lack of noise control, poor window placement, layout quirks and enforcement of the smoking policy are all things to think about before choosing to move in.

I've lived here for a few years.  At first, it was a fairly priced, unique apartment.  The furnishings are cheap, and you're surrounded by college kids (i.e. noise and weed), but with each management change...things get worse.  We are now officially at the point where if something is wrong, they just throw up their hands and say, "we can't do anything about it."

SEVERAL thefts this week alone; mailroom, patios, cars being broken into.  Upon complaining, you'll be met with such pearls as:

"There's nothing we can do."
"This is Indianapolis, what are you going to do?"
"You shouldn't leave valuable things laying out."

It's one thing to transfer liability.  It's another to completely disregard any attempt to acquire any, and to blatantly say that to your residents.  

If you decide to rent here, be warned that in the unfortunate event that something were to go wrong, management will tell you to f off.

This apartment seems nice. Spacious bedrooms, in-unit laundry, and an attached bathroom per bedroom. When these apartments were built, the thinnest drywall imaginable was installed. You can hear your neighbor sneeze, cough, and (if you were lucky like me), listen to their infant children cry. I invested in noise-canceling headphones after one day. A sound machine after one week. Even in the next room away from the shared wall, I can still hear them constantly. This includes people walking down the hallway, being able to hear entire conversations. Beyond the neighbors, there is an excessive amount of noise pollution. Ambulances and airplanes are constantly going by.  Also, there is no elevator. While this may seem like a minor inconvenience, it gets very old, very fast. If you had an unfortunate accident like breaking your foot, there is no alternative. Not to mention the pain of moving in and out. Stadium Lofts claims to not allow smoking inside the apartments but I can tell you that it consistently smells of weed and smoke. On the website and in the lease, it states that dogs are not allowed. Yet there are probably around a dozen dogs. While I love dogs, I would consider that with the thinness of the drywall. You may be hearing a dog barking during all hours of the day. So no, I would not recommend this apartment complex (at least the actual stadium).

My fiancé and I have been living at Stadium for a about a year now and it has been lovely! The walls are a bit thin but it hasn’t caused any issues or disruptions. It’s a quiet safe area and the apartment layouts are stellar. Appliances are all modern and when something goes wrong (our microwave randomly died about 5 months in) management came and replaced it in about 3 days! The polished concrete floors are easy to clean and beautiful. I really enjoy the management here I have nothing but compliments for the staff which is always friendly and helpful. The gym here is so pretty great for an apartment and didn’t feel like I needed a gym membership until I wanted to start using an actual barbells for the “big” lifts. My fiancé has an emotional support GSD and she has enjoyed it as well. There are quite a few emotional support dogs that live here and we have formed our own little doggie community which has been lovely. Stadium requires dogs to be on leash at all times which makes it tricky to play in the field but aside from that it feels like a pretty “dog friendly” place to live! All in all my fiancé and I love it here and recommend it to anyone who asks. (I will say that the complaints about weed smell are unfortunately legitimate and the management doesn’t seem to care. It sucks but for the cost of living here which is crazy reasonable and all the amenities it’s something I can live with and ignore)

You also would be living under the flight path of inbound planes, so if you have a window open that is a lot of what you will hear. Other than the noise, it is a nice complex and the floorplans are great.

Nice apartments, quiet place. The staff are awesome, very helpful, they go above and beyond!

Living here has been destructive to my sanity and the sanity of my pet. We are lucky to be getting out.

I've been in these apartment for more than 3years now, this is the best apartment I've ever stayed in. Amazing environment, nice staffs and awesome neighbors. And I'm not planning on moving out of this place anytime soon.

I’d rate no stars if this app would allow me to. 

My lease is ending in August and I’ve never been more ready to move than I am now. The apartments stink, the trash is not maintained around the complex, trash all throughout the halls, late pool openings, and rude maintenance and office staff has pushed me over the edge. However even worse than that is the parking. The parking here at this complex is non-existent, there’s not enough spots for every car and visitor. Don’t think about parking next to the sidewalk or anywhere else unless you’re willing to pay $150 to get your car out of the tow impound lot. Talked to the office about this issue and all they said was “you need to find a spot,” funny they say that when it’s not their apartment they’re trying to park at. I have several other rants that have reassured my decision to move out of this complex as quickly as I can, but this is the main one. It’s simply not worth it. Good luck.

These apartments isn’t bad. Things have changed. The pool is open in the summer.  I went last year. The club house is open. Yes you have to pay a water bill but I haven’t had problems with my neighbors or anything. They do need to fix the street potholes.

I will never recommend NOONE to move here ! just because they remodeled and renamed it's still horrible gun shots at nights loud neighbors weed smell in the hall ways water and lights being cut off with out notice from the office just will never recommend NOONE to move here and I can not wait until the lease is up !!!!!

Realmente la administración de esos apartamentos no estás funcionando bien, pusimos una orden pasa días y días no vino nadie a resolver nada. Nada más son buenos para cobrar. Cuando dañas algo no apareces nadie. Estoy decepcionado.
This place has changed a lot and i am glad to call it home. The rent is affordable and the staff is great.

Maintenance is very poor they say they fix it but they don't mold they say it's not molded dust but it's black mold they just don't repair the stuff very well and when they say they do they don't take care of it at all
I love the space and the length as well I love the rooms and the floor I love the bathrooms I love everything about it it’s reasonable!!!
Now that the weather is warm I am happy to have a park to take my kids 2 i like it here it is a good place for kids and familys.
hot water on one side of the apartment has been out for over 2 months. called many times, nothing

Very nice environment  I really enjoyed living at this place. Very convenient from every aspect groceries, hospitals, my child’s daycare. Above all this, I had very nice view from my patio. Staff is very nice.
Awesome experience  Megan, Hayley and Tylee very helpful and professional team. Made our experience seamless.  Excited to start our near phase at Redwood!
Redwood We have enjoyed this move more than any move previously. Meghan is such an amazing person to work with and made the process so simple, made sure we understood everything.
Application Process Megan was very friendly and she helped us have a smoth application process. Cant wait to move in
Wonderful people They are very nice and the apartments are beautiful

Love it here! Smooth move in and the apartment is great! 
Clean and ready to go!
Living at Redwood I enjoyed living at Redwood.  Maintanance was the best!
Really enjoyed living at Redwood !

The place is nice, but the longer you live here you realize how overpriced it is. The rent is extremely high and goes up every year. There are no ammenities (no gym, no pool, etc) And the fines and consequences for paying late are ridiculous. You better have strong security, because if you run into a hardship this group will be very unsympathetic. I've asked for the regional manager to contact me regarding a recent problem on my account and have yet to hear from them. 

Also - they do a LOT of inspections. Literally one or two a month, which really takes away any sort of sense of privacy. When the old leasing manager worked here, I would have given this place a better rating but since he left it has felt like corporate housing and not a home.
maintenance corrected the issue promptly and efficiently  Thank you   Hunter !
Service is always prompt and problem corrected
The men were fast,clean, and professional.  All of Redwoods maintenance personnel are polite and get the job done.
The service here at Redwood is always great.  One of the reasons I'm still here.
I would not recommend renting these properties due to serious maintenance and health concerns. Very troubling and encourage renters to inspect closely prior to signing into leases here.

Try to avoid renting from Van Rooy at all costs. It's been a complete nightmare since signing the lease. Maintenance takes forever to get simple things fixed. Our AC, dishwasher, and dryer didn't work upon move in and took over a week to get fixed. Our door wasn't sealed at all and water leaked in from a slight rain. Wooden deck is completely rotted out and unsafe to walk, but Van Rooy wont replace wood until you fall through the deck. If you have the means, avoid Van Rooy.

The initial move to the Assembly was pleasant, but it has since deteriorated significantly. There are cleanliness issues, like overflowing trash, unclean common areas, and a filthy roof with a strong smell of dog pee during warm months. They haven't fulfilled promises like installing shading on the roof and dealing with roach infestations on the roof, and some hallways. Bugs are everywhere due to the lack of preventative spraying. Basic common area amenities like coffee cups, hand soap, and paper towels are often missing from the community room kitchen. Every apt floor smells bad, (they are carpet) add that there's no AC in common area apt floors making it smell especially worse during hot weather. Apartments leak, and AC frequently malfunctions. Loud parties and shared rooftop with other businesses add to the disturbance. Trash service doesn't cover the entire building, and the absence of a property manager without any notification or alternate contact raises concerns. It's better to use your own judgment when considering living here. Good luck!

PROS:
- two elevators  which are helpful
- beautiful views of downtown if you end up with an apartment facing the city
- workout room is better than most apartments downtown
- valet trash ($25/month)
- close to Fountain Square and a few good coffee shops
- mail is secure in a package room
- promotions like free rent or gift cards to entice you to actually want to live here
- Internet is slightly okay (AT&T)

CONS
- noise coming from the rooftop above is insanely LOUD especially after 10:00PM; people go up on the rooftop and act like it's a park in the city
- Trash rooms constantly have food thrown on the floor instead of being tossed into the garbage chute
- Walls are EXTREMELY thin and working from home has been a complete nightmare
- Parking isn't great for residents as it costs $85 / month to park in the garage and $65 to park in the main parking lot but the employee's entrance is convenient for them and your guests have to walk miles just to get inside the building
- The closer you live towards the train, the louder it is in your apartment
- Rent is beyond overpriced in general for what you're getting
- Some of the layouts for certain apartments are ridiculous as your kitchen cabinets could end up on someone's bedroom wall and vice versa; good luck dealing with a neighbor who decides to slam their cabinets loudly at from 5:00 - 7:00 AM and all throughout the day or while you're trying to sleep after 10:00 PM
- You're basically paying to be sleep deprived
- I've spoken with the property manager multiple times and each time the residents lied about slamming cabinets before 7:00am and after 10:30pm each night which has now resulted in the continuing slamming of things on my wall late at night without any repercussions

Moved in 2022.
- The walls are really thin so I hear my neighbors every move, each morning.
- Multiple machines in the gym have been out of order for well over a year.
- Residents with pets are not held responsible for them. Ex: Residents pets use the restroom in hallways, the elevator, etc and it is not cleaned for days.
- Very strict rules have been enforced to use clubhouse, almost as if they don’t want residents to use it for hosting.
- Parking is and has always been terrible. Parking is limited and CoHatch space next door uses spots meant for residents.

I loved living here when I first moved in. Things have declined since Elon Management took over and the prices are raising with no improvements to the quality of the building, management, or the amenities.
Affordable apartments with good space and a lot of amenities. The staff is very helpful and on top of things.

Wesmont is by far the noisiest place I’ve ever lived and I used to live in a frat house. It’s like the walls are made of tissue paper. It is extremely rare for me to get a good night’s sleep. All I want to do is move out but they want to charge me thousands of dollars just to get out. Stay away. Consider all other apartments before this place.
I just moved into Gathyr Apartments, and I am absolutely thrilled with my new home!  I've already met some fantastic neighbors, and the common areas provide the perfect space for socializing.
Really love the unit layouts! The perfect size after moving out of a smaller unit downtown. The rooftop deck with amazing views is a great perk too.
Broken down appliances, incredibly rude and incompetent management, hidden fees. Look anywhere else.

DO NOT MOVE HERE! A month ago there was a string of car break ins and one car was stolen. My fiancés car was one of the cars broken into and he had to pay $400 to get his window repaired. The office management refused to do anything when made aware of the security issue. They refused to install cameras or offer discounted garages to keep residents vehicles safe. Two weeks later there was another string of car break ins. My fiancés car was one of the cars broken in to again and it was his sunroof this time and he had to pay $700 to repair his sunroof. Once again the office management refused to do anything. The crime rate here is out of control and your vehicles and your homes are not safe. Not to mention the garages cost $100 a month.

I paid the $250 application fee and was approved and told I could move in the following Friday. Then I heard nothing else so I tried calling, never answered. I tried going into the leasing office and there was a note on the door saying no one was there. I emailed them and got different responses all with different move in dates. They finally sent me the welcome packet over a month after my initial “move in date”. I did everything on my end and paid $250 for no reason. I had to find somewhere else to live on short notice because of this place. Horrible customer service and extremely unprofessional.
Apartment layout is very nice and was just renovated.

The maintenance staff is professional and courteous. The community is experiencing a shortage of maintenance employees. There aren't enough maintenance employees to keep up with the maintenance requests of tenants in this medium/large sized apartment community.
Overall I had a good experience.

I am a recent move-in. I’ve researched so many apartments around Indy in the last 7 months and was ready to move at another location. Then was suddenly pulled in this direction. These are not new apartments. These are not the open space kind. But this area has beauty and character. My apartment is not perfect. But maintenance here is the fastest and most awesome group of men. The staff is very attentive  but they are also busy trying to manage and bring to life  a community that was dying. I am very impressed. I love my apartment. It has charm. The beauty of nature..to be able to enjoy the park.. I love waking up to this awesome area and my comfy home. And this does feels like home.  RStout

I just can't express enough why you shouldn't live here. The roads are horrible, so if you care about your car don't live here because there are potholes everywhere and they're HUGE. There's always Semi Trucks parked at the entrance blocking your way and making it hard to see when trying to leave. I have no idea why they allow this, it makes it very dangerous when trying to leave or enter the aparments. When i moved here they let us know we could have any internet we wanted, i decided on att.  I've had an amazing experience with them , however recently they apartments have MANDATED xfinity and just charge you immediately. They don't call you and ask you if you want it or anything. they just charge you so you're paying more on rent. Its CRAZY how much money they try to bleed from you at any chance. The valet trash is also pretty horrible, they dont even pick it up sometimes  and when they dont pick up your trash and you want to go drop it off at the trash compactor yourself you can't because its gone or there's a mountain of trash. And that isn't even exaggerating. and the customer service of the office staff is pretty horrible, they're all pretty condescending. They're also impossible to get in contact with, leaving messages or emailing them doesn't work. Just don't bother moving here, its way overpriced for what you get.

Don’t move here. Maintenance and the leasing office staff are completely useless. We have to have our air conditioning/heat repaired every season. We have gone weeks without heat in the winter and weeks without air in the summer because they are incompetent and can’t get things done in a timely manner. I have  not had a screen in one of my windows for two years. I have put in multiple maintenance request for that and they just cleared them out. I moved in and did not have a shower for nearly a month. My roommates toilet exploded from the wall, and she did not have a toilet for nearly a month. This place is terrible all because of the leasing office and the maintenance team. They said they only have currently one maintenance man yet I see them all the time out there chitchatting riding around on the golf carts.  0/10. Don’t waste your time energy or money on this place. We pay way too much money for them to have this TERRIBLE service.

I have been here over a year. I have maintenance requests that are over 6 months old. I have contacted the Oaks of Eagle creek in every way possible, in person contact, email, phone, request portal. I am told the same things every time, "we will send some one out",  "we called a contractor", "I need to talk to the regional supervisor", etc, etc. 

I can tell the property managers are overwhelmed, and are probably stuck between keeping there jobs or blowing there monthly expense budget on repairs. 

This place could be great with some changes. It is apparent to me that they would rather profit off people living in Black mold infested apartments with constant water leaks, than loose money in the short term to take responsibility for providing livable housing. 

Also good luck getting a hold of the Property manager!

Lived here for a year, reported mold and water leak in February. They never did anything. Now it’s the end of May and the ceiling is falling in the bathroom and kitchen. Black mold is exposed in the bathroom.

I've lived here for 3 years. Started out great. Slowly went downhill. Now I can never get ahold of the office and maintenance is very slow to fix anything. We've been dealing with a broken air conditioner for months and it's still not fixed even though it was 90* all last week. Save your money and live someone else that actually cares about keeping you as a tenant.

Staff is great when you're looking to move and maybe the first month. But after that, their communication with residents and each other is horrible nearly nonexistent in my experience. I set meetings with the manger, she never showed up. I've had a plumbing issue that was never fixed my entire lease. Ultimately I told them to stop coming to temporary fix it and I just suffered with the issue since I wasn't renewing. But the final issue was when I had a maintenance emergency regarding my bedroom window, and the emergency line literally sent my calls to voicemail. And after this they sent a renewal form that would have my rent go up over $100. Good bye!

Nothing gets taken care of !! Maintence sucks ! Office people are rude and never know anything or solve anything !!! I havent had mail keys for 8 months and no one can still tell me if they have been ordered on top of more than half the time they dont answer the phone or hang up on you !!!! I comfirmed with the local post office that mail keys arent that backed up especially from 8 months ago !! so that means they were never ordered!! DO NOT MOVE HERE YOU WILL REGRET SIGNING THAT LEASE !!!

This place is terrible! Stay far away. My wife and I moved into Oaks of Eagle Creek 2 years ago. The first years overall experience was average at best. We only decided to sign the 2nd year lease because of the cost. Once we renewed our lease, the 2nd year our experience went from average to the worst! The crime in that area started to increase big time. We had a broken dish washer that took them 3 months to finally get fixed. Yes, you read it right....3 months! Every time I called about it they said they would pass the info onto maintenance. We put in multiple requests online in the Resident portal. It finally took me red faced mad and went down there to give them my 4 month notice of moving out to get it fixed. There online payment system is a joke. They are behind a couple months on utilities. So you think you are paying your current utilities but in reality you are paying 2 months prior. Residents that live there have zero respect for their own community. They litter trash all over the complex. The complex is partly to blame due to the fact they only have 1 dumpster location by their office. Our lease ended half way through the month so our last month was pro-rated. We logged online to pay it and it showed the full amount. My wife called about it and they said to just write a check and bring it in the office. A week went on and I came home one day with a late rent letter on the door threatening to kick us out, etc.. We lived there for 2 years and have never been late or missed a payment once! I stormed into their office of incompetent office staff and they claimed that there system doesn't allow them to pro-rate. I could sit here for hours and talk about how awful this place has turned into. Every one of my neighbors are moving out with similar terrible experiences. Please take my advice and stay far away from this community.

I've lived here in their smallest one bedroom for five months, now, & so far it's been ok.  I really like all the closet space, the size & layout, & w/d hookups.  I hate reading the reviews about black mold & break-ins... knock on wood, I've not had an issue w/those... maybe living on the second floor helps (?).  I'm sorry to hear of crime in this nice place... tho I believe things can happen almost anywhere.

Yes, there are plumbing problems here -- every day the plumbing tells me it's old, with intermittant water pressure problems, banging pipes in the walls, & maintenace coming to my door a few times to look for the source of a leak somewhere.  If I call Maintence for something (for plumbing both times), they do come in a timely fashion, but I'm not impressed that the two different guys who came fixed anything that well.

When I moved in, I liked the easy access to 465-S & I-65.   My apartment was clean, with new carpet.  I've not had any pest problems.  The entry hall is clean & well lit.  I can hear neighbors' tv's & stereos in the hallway, but not inside my apt.  Occasionally I can smell my neighbor's cooking, or even fresh shower scent in my bathroom.  The office staff has always been friendly & helpful, even when I need a personal copy of a document or receiving UPS packages for me.  The grounds are a little prettier than most places, well kept w/plenty of trees, ponds, & grass.

Sometimes parking lots are packed & it's hard to find a spot, so I rented a $20 carport to always have a place (& to keep pending snow off, of course).

Yes, I'm surprised that there is only one (unsightly) dumpster location for 632 units, but it doesn't bother me any.  I wouldn't like to live near it, so just choosing a different building would seem to solve that.

I've only lived in two perfect apts in central Indiana during the last 30 years, & one was a VERY expensive place in Fishers.  I hear the other one is now gang-infested.  All in all, going by my own experience to date, I'd still sign on here.  I appreciate the warnings about OEC's over-charges upon moving out, so I'll keep my P's & Q's in line.  New management just took over a month or two ago, so we'll see how that works out!

11/15/15
lived hear for 10-years and all I can say is this place is ok. not  a bad place to live we do have a lot of crime a round this part of the city.

i currently live at oaks of eagle creek, I would not recommend anyone living here. I don't feel safe being out side after dark. maintenance is a joke and the people at the office are very rude. the maintenance people do not do anything that is safe for them or my roommates, my central air fan has been broke now for about 3 months we have asked them to fix it multiple times and they have came in to "fix it" only 2 times and it is still broke. in the master bathroom the shower had black mold under the caulk. There was a leak in the living room from the washer from the apartment above us and all maintenance did was put kills paint over the leak but never fixed the leak.  yes there is a pool but i went there only 1 time and i will not go back because my feet got so cut up from them not maintaining the pool area.
I really do like they're service. they're apartments are really nice.I really love living here.

The Oaks of Eagle Creek is a nice quiet clean and relaxing scenic community on the northwest side of Indianapolis that is close to the interstate that can get you to any part of the city in a matter of minutes, from downtown Indy to the International airport to  Pacers or Colts games and the finest dinning in the city. The apartments are right across from Eagle Creek Park which offer running ,hiking trails and great for anyone who loves nature,and a added feature is that it is just a stones throw from the Indianapolis Colts complex  
!!!. The apartment themselves are spacious with well kept grounds with a scenic surrounding  , with a very courteous and professional management staff,that offer a variety of assistance to all residents at a price that is reasonable for the budget.The apartments have a variety ot 1 and 2 bedrooms that can truly fit your living life styles.

First and foremost my apartments would be perfect if i could put it in a different location.. I moved to my apartment complex to move closer to my dad who was in a nursing home nearby.. I really needed to find a place i would feel comfortable. I found it. The grounds up keep is perfect, it's very spacious and reminds me as if I was in a park. I have a lot of trees around me so i get to see all the different birds, and watch the wild life. Even though its an older complex i can honestly say don't judge a book by its cover. I wasn't sure at first but found my place to be very quiet and quaint. The inside of the apartment is very spacious for its side including the storage.. Love it...  If anyone is looking for a home away from home this is the perfect spot.

This community was affordable yet maintained. They had a great gym, one of the only places with a sauna, and loved that they were across from Eagle Creek Park. The staff was for the most part nice and professional. I never used the pool but it seemed clean. I hated the parking for my building because I had to walk pretty far so try not to live in any buildings on the round-a-bout. Because it is so heavily wooded in the area, there are a lot of bugs. It isn't a peaceful community because it is a lot of younger people, which I am part of, so if you are looking for a quiet this isn't it. There wasn't really any crime as far as I knew. The surrounding area is very nice, much nicer than if you head further east or south of this community. In closing they could use a remodel as they are definitely an older complex and are pretty out of date. If you are looking in the area I would recommend these apartments if you are just starting out because they are affordable but still safe.

apartmentName: Parkside at Castleton Square Apartments an...
review:
Rats and mice every night coming from the walls. 
Manager said “nothing we can do”. 
Horrible place. Don’t rent here.

apartmentName: Parkside at Castleton Square Apartments an...
review: The management staff is an absolute joke here. They do not care about anyone. Maintenance staff are nice but not very qualified and it takes forever to get anything done. We had multiple MAJOR leaks in the winter that were not properly addressed which lead to mold in our walls. The rent is overpriced and the amenities are slim to none. You are ONLY paying for location. On-site gym has ONE working machine, and instead of fixing or replacing anything, they decided to spend money on wallpaper. They are way more focused on getting new residents than taking care of current ones. I hated every second of living here.

apartmentName: Parkside at Castleton Square Apartments an...
review: if you look past the constant drug deals going on this place is alright. My neighbors are all very nice and keep to themselves. My apartment has a falling in ceiling in the shower that I was told had to have outside contractors to fix. This is along with my drain that slowly drains the water in my shower. Another thing to consider is if it rains hard the water seeps through the bottom frame of the bigger windows. I mentioned all of these things to the at the time management and they told me they had to have enough of the same claims for the contractors would come out. They also sent me an email a month later stating the window was fixed and it was not even touched and still leaks.. Very frustrating. This is an alright first place of my own but won't be continuing my lease once it is up..

apartmentName: Parkside at Castleton Square Apartments an...
review: This is my first apartment and first time doing it on my own. The apartments are affordable but that comes with many downfalls . I told the apartment place of needed repairs and they told me they fixed it while I was out one day but it was never fixed. The pool they advertised as sparkling is always dirty as well as tiny. There has been a glass door busted out all over someone's patio for over a month . The people are nice and leave you alone just not the highest quality of a place to live..

I would advise you to not live here. This place is so underfunded that nothing gets done. What was once likely a nice property is descending into junk.

The maintenance team is basically non-existent. You'll wait months for crucial work and eternity for smaller items. I went without AC for 2 weeks in the summer and another 10 days without heat this December. I also had a period where I had ants in the attic crawling into my bathroom vent for over 3 months.  Currently, my furnace breaker trips 2-3 times a day; nobody seems too concerned about the fire hazard.

Nobody takes care of the property grounds. The edges are defined by litter.  The grassy areas have been ruining by lazy dog owners. It'd likely be better if there was more than 1 dog trash bin or if the large trash bins were ever anything but overflowing. The sidewalk often has broken glass. 

The amenities are poor. The dog park is properly sized for 10 pound dogs, but even if you have a tiny dog it is often unusable because of the trash. The tennis court is cracked and beat up. It'd be impossible for tennis or pickleball. The pool was closed for 2 weeks this past summer for a health violation. The actual violation was never discussed with residents. There was just a sign added to the entry and then removed. 

The apartment furnishings are also outdated. Neither the AC nor the water heater can keep up. Even the water pressure is terrible. We ended up buying a window AC to get the bedroom below 80 degrees in the summer. Don't ask to see my electric bill. It's over double than my past 4 addresses. Even on months where nobody is home for 2 weeks with devices unplugged, I still run over $100.

Finally, the office doesn't seem to have the authority to get anything done. As mentioned above, they can't seem to get maintenance to do their job. They can't even bother to answer emails nor keep track of executed lease.  I'd also encourage the "owner" to not respond to this post by asking me to call the office. The office has never once answered my phone calls nor responded to a voicemail.

I have lived in the same building now for over 10 years.  Within the last 1 1/2 years, we have been fighting cockroaches that was caused by a tenant (7 people in a 2 bdrm apartment).  We have emptied our entire kitchen, bathrooms 3 times now and there are still COCKROACHES !  How bout using a different company?  With my sister and my age, it's a hard job.  We pay far too much to have to deal with this any longer.  WE NEED RESOLUTION TO THIS !  COCKROACHES are dirty nasty bugs that carry disease !  HELP  !!!

Been here since June and been having issues the whole time. First on our move in date the apartment wasn’t even ready. No appliances paint wasn’t finish no showers. Was not even close to being move in ready. Then not even a week later the whole apartment building had roaches and flys and gnats. We try to let them fix the problem but 4 months later same issue still here. Now today I was told to come to the office to talk about what options we have with their corporate management. And now they closed their office before 3pm and they supposed to close at 6pm. Will update what happens next.

I came here to edit my initial review. After I spoke with Alexis, they replaced the AC within the week and it's been working pretty good. She is so professional, nice and helpful. I appreciate it a lot. They also fixed the potholes in the area.

I’ve been here for a little over a year now & I can honestly say the staff in the office & maintenance is what makes living here so pleasant. Whenever I have any issues with the apartment their staff gets it taken care of right away! 

~Melissa
We have had a great experience so far! The apartment is very spacious and we have lots of parking spots! They are kept clean and we have literally EVERYTHING around the corner!

I’m loving my upgraded apartment! I am currently on my second lease term, and I was transferred into a brand new apartment! I love the ladies in the office Jaz and Shay! Great property manager also! If I have any concerns or questions the office staff responds promptly. They are fair, and care about the residents needs! Anytime I had an issue they jumped right in to help or fix things. It’s quiet down a lot I absolutely love my neighbors. I love the family environment that the complex has become. The Abbys are definitely on the rise that host a great staff who are dedicated too a safe, environmentally friendly and loving family atmosphere! I’m loving the transformation!
The overall complex and office staff have gotten a lot better over the year or two. Thank you for caring for your residents.

My sibling and I moved out in 2019, this was before all the renovations. Main issue? ROACHES!  There were everywhere, even in the tennis court!!  When we lived here the communication with the front office was terrible…. I see some things don’t change. It was so bad we broke our lease. The roaches would greet at the door before you even knocked. Just because you change the name doesn’t mean it change the environment!

Moved in August 2021, second floor apartment beautiful view of the pond. Within a month, roaches were invading the apartment. At one point, the air went out during a heatwave nobody was able to come fix it because it wasn’t an “emergency “. Sat an entire weekend before maintenance came. My door would not stay shut unless it was locked, asked them to come fix it they only changed the lock on the door. Apartments are beautiful but definitely overpriced. Nobody answers the phone in the office, and they only contact you if you’re behind on rent. Others complained of roaches and mice being in their apartments.

I was not able to view unit before signing lease and paying deposit and rent. Once paid and and keys were pick up I can around to the unit and seen several roaches crawling on the walls. I tried reaching out to property regarding this issue and trying to void leasing agreement (in the same day) due to not being able to view first when I could have seen the roaches and decided I did not want the apartment. I did not receive any response but have had an exterminator come out every two weeks. I am seeing even more roaches now after extermination than I did before. And even the maintenance crew agreed when asked if complex was infested. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPLEX AT ALL.

I been living over here almost a year and I had no problems out of my apartment or with the neighbors or with anybody in the office they nice & friendly the few small work order I needed got done no wait . I’ve nvr moved off the east side but this the first year I moved out west and I actually like it quit .The only thing I don’t like is that there are to many visitors taking up parkings spots and it’s hard for the residents to park I think they need parking passes for the residents I get off after 3am and I have to park far from my building just to find a parking spot.

As a young college couple looking for their first place, Abney certainly is a great pick. For students able to commute, the rent is extremely manageable and it's in a good location. I have lived in this community for three years and decided not to renew this year. Mostly because of the 8-12 people in a three bedroom apartment diagonal from me (which I am fairly certain violate leasing conditions but I am by no means the expert). They have four kids that scream day and night, at all times and at all hours and not within the reasonable expectations of what you would expect from smaller children. While there is not much to be done about noisy neighbors, unless you have overpacked apartments and lack of accountability from management. The conditions on the property have steadily declined as well. Sprinklers are broke. There is constant goose poop everywhere (which, to be fair, they are trying to mitigate with little success) and crime has increased. You cannot have a nice car and expect not to get rear ended, side swiped or dented unless you have a parking garage space.  There is mold on the buildings and I suspect within. There are animals that are crawling under the buildings and you can see have eaten into the gutter. While the area is great and overall I feel that the apartments are pretty well ventilated from noise, the condition of these apartments, how old they are and what they are asking as they continue to raise the rates are unreasonable. They do not require vaccination records for dogs nor do they treat the yards for fleas and ticks, so if you have an animal be sure to keep them updated. I also recommend a second floor apartment as I almost never hear my neighbor who actually lives below me, just the screaming kids below and across the way.

This place will probably seem great if you come to visit. Don't believe the hype. You wouldn't see some of the bad things I mention below until you move in. To be fair, there are some positives to The Lakes (see bottom), but the bad outweighs the good. 

The Bad: 
1) You can hear ALL of your neighbors. We live on the second floor and can hear our downstairs neighbor's TV every day. We've confirmed that it's not because he's got the volume way up, the walls are just that paper thin. We can also hear the neighbors through our kitchen and bathroom. 
2) Everything is old and dated for the prices that you pay. The air conditioning has gone out multiple times in the middle of the summer. When it is running, it runs non-stop due to the poor insulation. Cabinets are cheap and cabinet doors are naturally starting to sag from the hinges. 
3) There was an apartment fire in July 2019. We believe we were told it was due to faulty wiring in the building, or a problem with the circuit breaker. To our knowledge, none of the other buildings were checked, and if they were, we were not notified (which would have given us peace of mind).
4) Ants have gotten in through our exterior walls twice. We've also found a cockroach in the apartment once (which the complex confirmed was a cockroach through their pest control people).
5) Parking can be a nightmare if you arrive home late from work, depending on which building you live in.
6) There are no sidewalks in the neighborhood. When taking our dog on walks, we've almost been hit multiple times by cars coming around a curve because there is nowhere to walk except the street. There is a grass field to take your dog to, but it still requires walking in the street around a curve to get to. 

The Good;
1) Neighborhood seems safe. We haven't noticed any crime in the complex.
2) Pool and workout facilities are nice.
3) Maintenance staff responds quickly (I know because I've had to put in too many maintenance requests) and all of the maintenance guys are extremely nice and friendly.
4) Communication regarding the community is pretty good. For example, when they re-paved the complex, we received plenty of notice and info regarding what areas would be worked on and when.

I lived at The Lakes this past year and had great difficulties with the management when it came time for me to move. The apartments are QUITE run down, the issues I experienced in my short time there included my garbage disposal clogging, shower clogging, shower leaking all over my bathroom floor, closet door literally falling off the hinges (thank god it didn't hit me or my small dog!!!), AND my furnace breaking twice during the winter months. While all of my issues were taken care of thanks to the excellent maintenance staff (they are exempt from this criticism), it was still quite a hassle to experience such frequent issues with the apartment. Shortly before moving I was out of town from Thursday evening through Sunday morning for a long weekend - 84 hours to be exact, and when I came back I realized my fridge had completely stopped working. A bottle of dressing had gotten so warm and fermented that it exploded inside my fridge, ruining my Britta water pitcher, in addition to at least losing $50.00 worth of food that had spoiled due to the warm temperatures. 

When I brought the issue of the fridge to management, they claimed they were not responsible due to "not being made aware of the issue in a timely manner."
