Also, because I didn't make them aware of my absence (again, Thursday-Sunday), they would not reimburse me for any of the cost of property/food lost - not to mention the 3 hours I spent cleaning the disgusting mess. Lastly, upon trying to disconnect my electricity, one of the leasing agents was extremely difficult and rude. 

I would HIGHLY discourage anyone from moving to this location. The management is very poor and unprofessional.

The area is excellent, it has many facilities nearby and you can get everything in a few miles, the administration staff is very attentive and tries to solve the number of times that the problems that arise in the apartment are necessary, however, they have a policy of not attending maintenance calls on weekends unless it is an emergency and as my apartment was two bathrooms that one did not work was not an emergency, and several times the toilet was blocked, on two or three occasions it was a Friday and I had to wait until Monday or Tuesday for maintenance to come to solve in 5 minutes. Actually it seems a problem of the infrastructure because I had to buy a tool to solve myself for the amount of events that occurs. The shower and the sinks of the bathrooms also happen to them the same thing and the dishwasher also happened once.

At first I had problems with insects, but after several fumigations this was solved or winter helped me.

My daughter loved the court, but we stopped using it because the dogs run free inside it, I consider this nice but I did not want my girl to fall down with something unpleasant.

My husband and I have been living at The Lakes for the past two years and we have only good things to say.  We switched from a one-bedroom to a two-bedroom and the staff were very helpful during our move.  The neighborhood is peaceful and quiet, never any safety concerns.  Maintenance team is very prompt the few times we have had any minor issues.  Office staff is always welcoming and responsive.  The development has a nice picnic/BBQ area near the swimming pool, as well as a tennis court, a car wash area, and ample parking spots.  Some apartments have great upgrades such as hardwood flooring and new appliances, The Lakes is always working towards improving the apartments.  The location is also ideal, conveniently accessible to grocery, shopping, restaurants, hospital, library, and the highway.  We would recommend The Lakes to anyone looking to find a spacious and comfortable apartment in a prime location.

My elderly Mother and I have lived here for 3 years and are very happy with the friendly office and maintenance staff. When we had a flooding issue in the past, they put us up in a hotel and gave us money for meals. 
The office staff has also been very helpful with key issues we've had with Mom's caregivers. The trivia games, contests and different outings they offer are fun and a great way to meet other residents.
 I appreciate the wonderful job maintenance has done keeping our drives and sidewalks clear this winter. They have even cleared around Mom's car in case I need to take her to an appointment!
I wish the patio was bigger but it gets a lot of sun and Mom loves to sit outside, tend her plants and people watch. She even keeps dog treats in her pocket for the four legged residents who pass by.
If you are looking for a nice neighborhood to live Avalon lake is the place,peaceful environment, great maintenance team and the leasing office staff are one call away.

Do not lease at this apartment complex. This property will try to nickel and dime your move out charges to try to get you to cover repairs that they should cover. All of the doors are cheap and don't even fit the door frames. Doors would fall off track all of the time, and maintenance would do the bare minimum to repair anything correctly.
The neighborhood has gone down hill as well. There were multiple notices about break ins, but nothing was ever done to make the property more secure. There is constantly dog poop in the grass, and on multiple occasions it was because there was no bags in the pet waste dispensers.
People were constantly smoking marijuana in the apartments next to mine and in the parking lot but nothing was ever done. On numerous occasions there would be no where to park because of sketchy cars in the parking lot, I would see drug deals happen in the parking lot constantly.
We had notices recently about roaches in the apartment building, and my apartment was inspected and cleared, however on the day I moved out I pulled back my refrigerator and found a roach crawl into a hole in the wall, as well as other bugs living behind the fridge.
They are just another apartment company that want to take your money without doing anything to make the property a nice community.

this apartment complex is perfect for  people that want to live alone or live with room mates! I've lived in two of their layouts and have loved them both. the neighborhood is very friendly and i have seen and heard of no crime in the past 5 years of living here. this is the perfect place if your just starting out and don't want something too pricy
The neighborhood is quiet, the neighbors aren't obnoxiously loud and the people of the renting office are always friendly.
Hi, my name is Tanya I have lived at my apartments going on 3 years, i really enjoy living here, i was just diagnosed with vertigo, this offer will really help me. Thank You very much.

I work in the apartment industry for a different management company but live here because I love the staff and layout of my loft so much. Amazing safe area in a great location for a great price. I don't even notice that it doesn't have a WD and I will definitely be renewing until I save for a house.

The office staff is terrible at communication when there is an issue. When it comes to maintenance requests, it can take several weeks to get the task/appliance fixed (1-2 weeks to even get the request addressed)
Staff were very kind and I witnessed the maintenance people being friendly with residents.

First I called Circa and spoke to Ian (who I later found out was a call center). We went over everything and I asked him several questions. I wanted to make sure that my MASTIFF (read NOT a Canary Mastiff) was allowed. He assured me she was. So, I wanted to set up an appointment to view the apartments. He asked me if I could come in on Friday at 5:30pm for the last viewing of the day. I was quite aware I’d be the last, but I figured they’d at least spend enough time to show us a couple of apartments. 

Emily was the property manager who had us for her appointment. She also assured us that Mastiffs were allowed, after even reviewing it on their company tablet. We were looking for a cost efficient apartment. I wasn’t sure if I wanted a studio or a one bedroom, so I wanted to start at the smaller apartment first to see if it would fit our needs. It was ok, but I wanted to see something bigger. 

So, we go to get the keys for the apartment. I want to mention here that both my husband and I kept seeing her giving us the stink face for some reason. She goes into the office and shortly comes out, while her supervisor was rushing to leave. She then notifies us that her supervisor told her mastiffs aren’t allowed even though all their websites say they do. What kind of pet friendly apartment doesn’t take a MIXED mastiff? She has no aggressive breeds and we have a DNA test to back it up. I wouldn’t be leaving this review if she wasn’t so weird and if I hadn’t spent over two hours traveling, researching, calling and looking at the facilities. Ridiculous. She should have just told us she wanted us to leave if she wanted to go and we could have picked up the next week. Or I also could have been told we weren’t a good fit and I would have taken that too. But no, all of a sudden my dog is inconveniently banned. Lol is all I can say after having to waste all this time doing all that and now writing this review. Don’t expect to be treated well by Emily. Also, she was bumbling several times, dropping her keys, taking 45 seconds to finish a sentence. Weird behavior. Such a bad experience.

In writing an honest review, you want to be as transparent as possible. I have to say that I do not agree with the location of the dog park. It was put in a horrible location by the pool. I do feel like the community has an overwhelming amount of pets. Aside from it seeming like DogCity I have enjoyed living at Circa. I am most thankful for the responsiveness of the office and maintenance team whenever I have needed them. The location of the community cannot be beat and some of the best shopping and eateries are very close nearby; within walking distance. If you do decide to rent at Circa, you will have a hard time enjoying the pool in the summer due to the nuisance of the dog park.

Being a long term resident at Circa and renewing my lease for another year has allowed  me to reflect. To reflect on all of the positive changes that have happened and why I am choosing to continue living here. Some of my favorite recommendations and reasons why I love living here are the dog park, FREE dog wash station, pool table, free monthly resident events, very welcoming staff and efficiently responsive maintenance staff. Earnest is my favorite! He is my guy!

This is the nicest apartment my wife and I have ever lived in. The units are top-notch, roomy and aesthetically pleasing. They keep the apartments updated (we just got new floors this year), and the complex is very clean. The staff are super nice and helpful. There are all of the amenities you need (package room, dog park, valet trash, etc.), and they keep adding more. Whenever we've had an issue, maintenance has been incredibly quick. We make appointments for them to come while we're gone, and when we come home everything is fixed. Our dogs love it here as well--there are always treats in the lobby, there's a pet washing station, and it's right by an amazing doggie daycare.

The location couldn't be better. It's one block off Mass Ave, so you get all the benefits of Mass Ave but without the noise. Honestly we don't have any complaints!

I recently moved in to Circa. I feel that its only fair to share my experience thusfar. The Circa team has gone above and beyond by providing me with great customer service. My most recent experience was a payment problem that that manager quickly assisted me with. The service team is quick and the office staff respond promptly. Did I mention all of the great amenities offered to their residents. Looking forward to the next monthly event so I can meet more of my neighbors. I couldn’t be happier and look forward to living at Circa. Thank you all!

Great experience at Circa ever since I moved here last year. 

The JVM staff is extremely helpful, friendly and accommodating. The complex was recently upgraded and the new amenities (dog park, dog washing station, office space with printer, coffee bar, and beautiful interiors) are awesome! 

I recently resigned with a lease transfer and the staff, especially Christina, went above and beyond to help me. Thank you, Circa!

I lived at Circa for 3 years. Location was amazing. Amenities were even better… I’m not sure if you can even have more. The Maker’s Room was my favorite and the most unexpected (area to work on projects), gift wrapping, coffee, gym, pool, dog park (new), variety of parking options/costs, safe package pickup, locked bike rooms (even though someone stole my rear tire from one), trash pickup, grills. I had a positive experience with the transition from Milhaus to JVM. Christina and her team have been awesome and made huge improvements… they are friendly and get to know you personally. In general they keep up with all the minor details: coffee is ALWAYS stocked (even during construction they made a temporary location for the coffee with an external jug of water w/pump… above and beyond!), wrapping paper always stocked, the common halls/carpets were always cleaned/fresh smelling in my experience. Never had problems with maintenance (but never had anything break really). They always organize community events which are often catered and provide drinks too. 
I lived in a 2 bedroom in the ‘yellow’ building. I liked the design and layout. I thought the price was reasonable. Never had issues with anything breaking in the apartment. I only moved to try something new and now that I have, I realize all the amenities that I took for granted while living there.
Overall awesome place to live! It’s a shame people are such complainers.

Very difficult to communicate with, numerous unanswered phone calls and emails. When moving out, leasing office tried to charge me for total carpet replacement in both bedrooms when only one room had damaged carpet. They claimed it was their policy to keep carpets matching wear and tear. This is an illegal renting practice in Indiana. A renter does not have to pay for normal wear and tear. After calling them out on this “policy”, the charges were dropped but I was made to feel I was cheating them out of their money. As a resident of two years, this left an extremely bad taste in my mouth. Other amenities of the apartment complex were nice and the location was great. My bike was stolen twice (locked and kept in their indoor bike storage area) however I won’t blame that one on the leasing office.

Losing packages. Can’t figure out how to complete basic maintenance requests. Holding events for the public in our private lounge. Trash valet service used to be excellent. Now we have to wash our trash can every time it comes back because it’s completely covered in a white film. Dog poop everywhere. Dog poop bags not being refilled. Doors not unlocking to get into the building. Incredibly unprofessional staff. No sense of urgency to do anything. Hard to reach the front desk since it goes to an automated service now. Extremely LOUD neighbors. Sound goes straight through floors and walls. College students are your neighbors. Management could care less.

It's been unfortunate to live in a place where the administration lacks common sense and basic customer service skills. Since day 1, there's been one issue after another, all handled in a customary passive-aggressive manner.  It's silly to watch.

I couldn't ask for a better building!  It's located in one of the hottest areas downtown - right off Mass Ave and the Cultural Trail! Just steps away from all the bars and restaurants you need.  Beyond that -ultra modern, pool, in-unit laundry, workout room, fire pit, community space- what more could you want?  Tons of Indy young professionals call these apartments home and always planning events and welcoming new tenants to the community here!

My experience at Castle Creek been amazing. I feel safe during day even at night to walk. The staff are friendly, and supportive. Maintenance is always ready to go. There's enough space inside the apartment. On special occasions there’s activities for kids and adults.

I’ve lived in Castle Creek for about 6 months now, and I truly love it. The maintenance team is friendly and quick to fix any problems, the club house has great amenities (coffee, a very solid apartment gym, meeting room), there are cute little holiday and community events (Halloween party, holiday gift wrapping station), and the apartments are fantastic. I love all of the finishes, the in unit washer/dryer, the ceiling fans, the Nest Home - I could go on. I see earlier reviews about thin walls, but I rarely ever hear my neighbors.

The only cons are:
• the insulation is not very great, so I do have to run my AC and heater consistently to stay comfy
• no recycling option on the property!
• lack of a proper external deadbolt
• lack of proper trash handling for this size of community. The one dumpster overflows constantly

None of these issues are a big enough deal to drop a star. This is easily the best place I’ve lived!
I have been living here a couple months and the experience has been amazing.  From the amenities and staff.  The staff responds quickly and are pleasant.
Amazing amenities and overall wonderful experience!  Jordan and the entire team are always professional, pleasant, and extremely helpful!

I came in wanting to see the property and was greeted by the lovely staff at the apartments. Deziray was a joy to speak with. She took me on a tour of the property and I fell in love with the amenities and the layout of the different floor plans!

I toured at castle creek last week and out of all of the places I have been to they stood out the most. Who knew the lady that showed me around was also a comedian part time lol 
I look forward to applying and becoming a resident

I have lived at Caste Creek Apartments since August of 2021 and have enjoyed my time here. The location is great being in close proximity to everything you need. The amenities are updated and well maintained. The apartments give luxury for a reasonable price. The staff are always friendly, willing to help, and prompt with responses. The community is quiet, family and pet friendly. I've lived in 3 different apartment communities in the past 4 years and this one is by far my favorite.

If you are thinking of living here please read. Castle Creek may look nice on the outside but there are many problems with this complex. 

The walls are paper-thin, interior and exterior, causing electric bills upward to $300 a month during winter times. These thin walls not only cause outrageous electric bills but allow you to hear everything your surrounding neighbors do and say. 

My next-door neighbor would blare music at all hours of the day and night. I would eventually have to wear earplugs to bed just to be able to sleep because there was nothing done by the apartment management. 

When letting management know about the problem, they basically told me that they would send them an email asking to quiet down but that would be as far as they would go. My only other option was to pay the termination fee and find another place to live. 

You can tell that this apartment complex was built cheaply and covered up with well-looking finishes to hide all of its problems. If there is another living situation you are considering, I would strongly recommend choosing that one. If you search the other one-star reviews they explained to have the same problem I had so I am not the only one.

Living here as been a wonderful experience. The amenities and apartments are absolutely beautiful, up to date, and in great condition.  The staff goes beyond their duty to make their residents feel appreciated and welcomed. The maintenance team acts quickly and efficiently. I highly recommend Castle Creek!

The leasing and maintenance team are fantastic. (Special shout-out to Jordan, Hannah, Jody, Mark and Rick!!) The community events are always fun (shout out to pet-pool/doggy-swim day, smores and hard cider by the fire and food truck margarita day!!). The fire pit, seating areas, and grills around the complex are great including Jenga, Bags (you probably call it cornhole) and Ping-Pong. If you want to join a fun, centrally located and beautifully built community this is the one for you.

2 miles from Keystone at the Crossing provides easy access to shopping, dining, entertainment and parks.

So glad I found it!

I've lived here for about 6, going on 7 months and I really enjoy Castle Creek Apartments. The location, is great as the community is located directly between Castleton and Fishers and not even 5 minutes from the freeway. Everything you need can be found within a 10minute drive or less. 

As far as the apartment itself, the office and maintenance staff are friendly and really responsive. Anytime we have had a minor issue, we get the support and service needed. The fitness center is excellent compared to some other apartments I've seen with a mere bench and single treadmill. The office staff hosts events once a month for residents to try to build community. All of the other residents I have encountered have been respectful and friendly for the most part. I feel really safe in our neighborhood. Castle Creek is so cute too that, it puts a smile on my face, each and everyday I drive up to its majestic looking buildings.

My roommate and I have been living here for about 6 months. We absolutely love it! If I never need anything, I can always call the front office, and someone will respond to the call right away. Lastly, castle creek apartments are prime location as there are a wide variety of food options and shopping centers nearby. 

(Comment by Jadah Jones)
Castle Creek Apartments is the best place to live when it comes to living in an apartment.  From the staff to the residents, everyone makes you feel welcome.

If you don't like nice amenities and a GREAT staff, this is not the place for you. I'm going into my second year and did not think twice about renewing my lease.  Come on in the waters fine! No really we have a pool complete with a grill and all the Starbucks you can drink. :-)

I have resided at Castle Creek for just over a year. The staff is always friendly. Maintenance is always reliable and responsive. The grounds are kept tidy and appealing. The amenities are kept updated. Furthermore, the apartments feel like homes. I encourage anyone looking for an apartment in a convenient location to consider Castle Creek!

I am going on my third year at Castle Creek  and am very pleased. The ladies at the front desk are always helpful and responsive as well as the maintenance workers. The apartments are very nice and updated and the location is great. Very close to restaurants and shopping and a short drive to carmel. I feel very safe here as there is a courtesy officer on duty to patrol the parking lot at night. I have a old english bulldog and the complex is very pet friendly. Some of the draw back I have noticed through the years is that you can hear above neighbors foot steps, but that varies as well I have had three different  people occupy the apartment above me and I only noticed the footsteps of one. Allisonville road is currently under construction which makes it somewhat of a pain during rush hours. Other than that the apartment are nice and the fireplaces are GREAT in the fall and winter. Not to mention the rent is reasonable! I could recommend (and have) to anyone!

Overall, Castle Creek is a nice community. Everyone in the front office is very nice and helpful, the apartments themselves are nice, clean, spacious, and provide a lot of natural light with big bay windows. The only real negative and reason I will not be renewing my lease after it is up, is that the windows and doors are extremely poorly insulated. My electric bills for a two bedroom apartment were nearly $300 per month. No thank you!

I have lived in Castle Creek for just over a year and recently renewed my lease. Castle Creek is in a great location. The staff is friendly and it's clear they work hard to take care of their residents. Maintenance is always efficient and responds to requests in a timely manner. They keep the property appearanace clean and inviting. When I moved in here a little over a year ago I was new to the area, I couldn't be more happy with my choice to live at Castle Creek. I feel that it is a safe, friendly, and inviting community, plus the apartments are awesome!

I have lived here almost two years now and it is a wonderful place to live. Charlotte, Barbra and the office staff are friendly and helpful. I will admit sometimes maintenance takes a couple days longer than I would prefer but I have never went without anything I needed. Everything has been taken care of in a timely fashion. The apartments are large and spacious and have a comfortable homey atmosphere. I would highly recommend considering this for your next place to live.

I have been here only a few months and it’s NON STOP PROBLEMS! Maintenance is non-existent! The office SAYS they will get things fixed but DONT! AC problem going on 3 weeks. Running toilet. Tile falling off the wall. Leaking dishwasher. Master bathtub leaking into downstairs apartment. Dryer plug is fire hazard - loose from the wall. Now the microwave doesn’t work. Go anywhere else because this place isn’t worth the headaches.

Charlotte is a HORRIBLE property manager--maintenance takes forever. I'm currently waiting 3 weeks to get a toilet replaced. Replaced, so it means it's unusable.  When I walked into the office to inquire, they said they had no maintenance order. In the past, flames shooting out of the furnace and the main light fixture in the kitchen took almost 30 days each to get fixed.  Lots of better run and maintained choices of apartments out there--choose any one but this.

We were new to Indianapolis and found Ivy Knoll as our temporary home while searching for a house in the area.  The apartment was quite large-nice master suite and had washer and dryer hook-ups in the other bathroom and ample storage closets.  We I love how close it is to the mall and other shopping and a quick walk to Trader Joes.  The office and maintenance staff are incredible-they answered questions quickly and addressed any issues immediately!

I am currently starting on my 2nd year at Ivy Knoll.  My apartment is large; it's like having a house only in a apartment.  I love all the space I have.  It is quiet, my neighbors are friendly and Latoria (Office Manager) is awesome.  She and the office staff always make sure that my needs have been met.  David, Maintenance Manager and the Maintenance staff take care of maintenance requests right way; if they notice something else that needs to be repaired it is taken care of immediately, also. I have lived in apartments for about thirty years now and this has been the best apartment and the best experience that I have had by far.  I love this home in an apartment that I have now. If your looking for an apartment you might want to consider Ivy Knoll Apartments. It is in an area convenient to stores, shopping, restaurants and gas stations.  You can even get to I-69 or 465 in a matter of minutes.

I've lived here for 2 years and, even tho' I was used to living in a house, this is the perfect apartment for me. It's quiet, the neighbors and lovely and the staff--amazing! Plus I have the prettiest view on the whole property with my own little wildlife family.

Latoria, the manager, has been a gem, always making me feel like I belong, what I need matters and going the extra mile to help me with things like delivering packages when I can't get out because of a problem with my foot and knees.

David, the maintenance manager, is quick to get things fixed for me, cheerful, going the extra mile when he sees that something needs done that wasn't on "the list" since I hadn't gotten it called in yet.

As far as I'm concerned, this is home until I decide I want to live somewhere other than Indianapolis.

Thanks sooooooooo much for taking such good care of me y'all. My family says "thanks" too because they feel that I'm in a safe place that I love.

Many blessings
MamaRed

If I could give this property negative stars I would. The management is terrible and they do not care about the tenants at all. They do not reach out when there are issues or call back and the voicemail box is always full !! The AC never works in the summer and the heat breaks in the winter. Hot water also goes out at least once a month. Management and maintenance do not know what they’re doing or they just don’t care or both. They also advertise a sparkling pool which hasn’t been actually open in over 2 years. Don’t live here unless you want to be neglected and taken advantage of.

New management is absolutely terrible, unprofessional and don’t care about the residents. They don’t answer or return phone calls. Maintenance workers are unprofessional and unskilled. Parking is horrible and there’s roaches!!!
False advertisement. It’s July 17th. pool still not open. only sparkling pool here is on their advertised poster
Use to love living here, but new owners do not care about their residents.

I live here now and absolutely love it. Being a young female, living on my own, I could not feel more safe. The amenities are fantastic and the staff even better. They all know my name, as well as my dogs! I use a dog walking service and they have always let me know who they thought was less than stellar, because they care that much about my baby. Any time I needed something fixed, it was fixed within a few hours, if not immediately (even after hours!!)

Have lived here for a few months now and love where I live. Not only are the prices fair for Castleton/Broad Ripple area, but it is a great place to live. The landscaping is impeccable, the staff are fantastic and they are very communicative. Being able to pay online and put in maintenance requests online are great conveniences. Overall, a great place to live where I plan to for quote some time!

I wouldn’t recommend to anyone to live here, maintenance request are slow and take 2-3 weeks to fix a window screen. They have also have made 4 copies of my keys they go from working to not working (not sure if they loose them or not). When I originally moved in they called me the day of move in to say that the apartment wasn’t ready to move in yet. They also switched to a new system called active building which doesn’t allow you to conveniently pay rent but instead makes you go to a third party site where you have to create a whole new account to pay rent then gives you obnoxious advertisements and isn’t phone interface friendly. When you try to pay your rent it’s a $35.00 card processing fee. Trying to talk to someone is a pain have to follow 6 different prompts just to get a VM. Then when you go talk to someone in person it’s never a direct answer just alot of excuses. If this place management team actually learned to do its job properly they wouldn’t probably have a 3.3 star rating which has consistently dropped every month since last year.

Genuinely don't move here, I know people see reviews and will rationalize "oh it can't actually be that bad" it is. My roommate and I spent the summer months with no A/C, our apartment was literally in the high 80s some weeks. We had ants and other bugs that WE had to buy spray for because the leasing office kept either pushing out the scheduled day or they would say they're going to show up and then just didn't (technically the vendors fault but don't work with bad vendors maybe??) 

Parking is awful and was constantly under construction so the maintenance crew would leave pallets in the already limited spaces. Getting anyone to answer the phone is like pulling teeth AND they don't return voicemails so if you work during their office hours theres basically no help for you. 
And finally they submitted to the credit bureau that we owed a balance but when we called in they had no accounts of it. I had to send in documents to dispute this and it almost cost us getting an a new apartment. This place is to expensive to have this many cons, don't rent here there are much better options.

-left us without ac for weeks
-unresponsive about pest issues
-poor overall communication

This place is awful. I wish I could leave a negative star. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone. I was a resident from 2021-March 2022

1. AC was broken in July- Aug for 25 days with no updates as to when they would fix it.

2. ANTS/BUGS When we first moved in for the first month there were so many bugs and specifically ants in the apartment and maintenance/ pest control did nothing for a whole month, gave us excuses as to why they could not come out and spray anything down.

2. Falsely placed an outstanding balance to an INCORRECT amount on our credit to the Rent Bureau which gave a soft check on credit

DO NOT LIVE HERE. Do not trust anything they say, do not fall for the new amenities, and definitely don’t trust any good reviews. The management here is the absolute worst(especially Leslie, Kayla, and Kelly), and there is no maintenance at all. The garages are run down, car ports are falling apart, and the apartments are even worse. There is trash everywhere, some apartments have their windows broken and screen doors torn.  Many apartments have no A/C, broken washer/dryers, stained carpets, and the worst trash “service” imaginable. 

Within 12 hours of moving in, the shelf in our closet fell out of the drywall because it was installed incorrectly, and it has been 3 months and not one person will come out to help. We put in multiple maintenance requests, only for them to mark them as Done without fixing anything. We spoke to Kelly and Leslie on the phone and in person, who both said they would “take a note and let someone know” and then no one ever followed up. 

I’ve lived in some cheap apartments in Indiana and elsewhere, but none have ever been this bad. I wouldn’t let my worst enemy live here. I hope the city demolishes this place and turns it into a park so people can actually enjoy the location.

I did not even last a full year I moved in January 2022 I left November 2022 I couldn’t get anything in my small apartment fixed. I was paying way too much for my small every small two bedroom it’s definitely not worth it. My neighbors had bugs they started to come in my apartment. I called several times to have them come out an spray they never came.I called and emailed them about my daughter’s bathtub being clogged for months they never came. I told them about my nasty neighbors and how they would just leave trash in the hallway for days before they would take it out. I was beyond over it so I left! SAVE YOURSELF DON’T MOVE OVER THERE!!!!
Beautiful apartments for amazing prices, and the views are lovely! Staff is helpful and kind, and the maintenance team is friendly and knowledgeable.

I definitely would not move here if you want safety and peace of mind. Since moving in I have had the swat team infiltrate my building and now a shooting where someone actually died on their patio. If I could give a 0 star I would. They have cameras everywhere and each time these incidents happened they stated they were not random. What kind of screening are they doing to make sure the people who are moving in aren’t going to be bringing crime in with them? They still want their rent increases though of course so I would take my money elsewhere if you can!

I moved my family out of state to Indianapolis, IN. We could only afford so much, so the monthly cost of living here seemed to be somewhere in the middle of the road for the city. We decided to give this place a shot, as it didn't look as bad as some of the reviews on here. Our upstairs neighbors have no respect for the community they live in. Our front porch, and the surrounding area to the water is littered with hundreds of cigarettes. We have cleaned them up multiple times, as maintenance does nothing to beautify the complex. The cigarettes continuously reappear, and is bothersome due to the fact that I have a small child. To make matters worse, I had 1700 dollars worth of tools to start off my career get stolen before I could even make it home that day. So that means that someone, living very close to us, decided that they would take what was not theirs. It is definitely extremely sad that I have probably walked by the thief responsible during my day to day life. The buildings themselves are in rough shape, and will last no more than 2 decades before they have to be rebuilt. I am sure there are good people here, but if you have a family, steer clear away from this place. I am counting down the months, and days so I can leave this place as soon as possible.
AC has been out for weeks, it was over 80 in here. And now cockroaches. Why am I paying so much for this dive?

If I could give 0 stars, I would. Management is only after your money and will do whatever it takes to keep your security deposit and come up with random move-out charges to make you pay. One of the bathrooms had floorboards missing, bugs would stream out and it took maintenance weeks to fix it...pretty sure there was a rat in the walls too

Horrible ! Dont move here ! Only thing good is the walk in closets & front room space. maintenance never comes and fix things , it can take months for them to come and when they do, they don’t even do the job right. Worst apartments ever can’t wait for lease to be up. Air conditioner leaks , fridge leaks, just a mess. Rent should be much cheaper as bad as these apartments are. Cabinets are old and broke. Tub peels . They will put new carpet in but thats it. Very cheap and lazy . Don’t MOVE HERE I REPEAT DON’T ! Management doesn’t even care or try to help. Been trying to reach management for months. Horrible you’ll regret it don’t waste time or money !
Prompt Service I had an issue with my door and immediately had it addressed the next morning. I truly appreciate the urgency to fix the issue.
Location Location Location. It is a nice property with excellent staff. I have lived here for years and walk everywhere. It is amazing.

Highly would not recommend living here unless you are able to tolerate the conditions below:

- Over Priced: Amenities are subpar and constantly break or needed to be replaced years ago. You can find better units literally anywhere else for what they charge

- Old Building: No insulation from sound inside or outside. You can hear everything your neighbors do and you can hear every noise from outside clearly (Ambulances, Fire Trucks, Police Cars, Loud Music, Traffic, even Peoples’ Conversations)

- Management: The lack of communication and action done by the group after consistent emails, phone calls, and in-person visits was shocking with how they treated resident concerns. Even after an apartment fire (never communicated for the cause) very little action was taken to address the safety and concerns of our affected apartment during and after the incident. Packages were consistently stolen with no security protocol and no other guidance from management besides to contact the police or your package carrier

- Parking: If you have a larger or nicer vehicle the parking spaces are incredibly small. Your car will be dinged and damaged from other residents or the property itself depending where your spot is. Very difficult to get in and out of garage while still paying upwards of $100+ per space 

The only positive aspect of the apartment complex is the proximity to downtown and the canal, if that is really what you are seeking I would highly recommend looking at the other apartments on the canal

They cannot mark parking correctly and then fine you if you park in the wrong spot. For as much as they charge for parking you would hope at least your spots are marked correctly. We had rodents in our walls for over a week before anybody came out to check on it and we never got a follow up. We also had to go without heat for multiple days before we got somebody to come out during winter. Front office people are nice but property manager not so much. For the price not worth it at all I would highly suggest living somewhere else.

I am not one to write a bad review, but I have never in my life wanted to more. The location is perfect. It is across the street from IUPUI and right on the canal. Really a great walking distance from everything downtown. Which is all good, but the ONLY positive thing I have to say about Canal Square. The 
Location is what you pay for because the apartment is definitely NOT worth the price. 
The management was awful. They are not friendly or welcoming. Any smile or polite comment felt fake and forced, especially if any concern was mentioned. The online maintenance request was great because it meant not having to deal with management face to face. Maintenance was always prompt, but warning was not given. Which would be fine except they come in if no one answered and sometimes you don't answer because you are taking a shower. 
There was an ant problem throughout the complex for a few months during our two years in the apartment. We reported an ant problem take before. We would told we would be out on the list for the last control to come. Nothing happened. Then about a month later we got a letter in our door one Friday evening saying we were to have our cabinets cleaned out, apartment decluttered, and all switch plate covers and electrical sockets removed by Monday. Living in a small apartment it was impossible to clean out all of our cabinets and have no clutter. Not to mention the massive inconvenience this was. I had two roommates each worked full time and were students, free time was nonexistent and two of us where out of town that weekend. So we all stayed up until 3 am Sunday night to get rd done because we risked a $50 fine otherwise.

Lived here for almost 4 months now in a one bedroom with my boyfriend. We have a dog and the apartment complex is very pet friendly. The rent for the sq. footage is comparable to surrounding apartments but compared to apartments further north it is much more expensive and you get less for your money. The bathrooms could use some work - drains clog easily and DO NOT FLUSH ANYTIME BEFORE SHOWERING... You'll get scalded. The staff is attentive but not always very welcoming and can give off negative vibes. Maintenance crew works quickly. Biggest complaint is the overall costs - once everything is added in. You also have to go to the front to get packages and that's somewhat annoying (especially for someone who does a lot of online shopping - don't have time to go to stores). 

I was really excited to move here and did enjoy it a lot but compared to an apartment up the road it is disappointing and falls short. Will not be renewing lease.

I was a resident at Carlton apartments for 7 years and with every passing year they get worse and worse. They have hardly any maintenance staff and the guys they do have do not complete repairs correctly. I have countless faulty repairs, countless issues with my apartment that they ignore and won't fix, countless issues with my apartment that they caused during other repairs. Also, generally speaking, they just don't keep up the complex or the apartments. For example, The cabinets in these apartments are so old the faces of them randomly fall off and you cant use 90% of the outlets in the apartments because the outlets are so old that whatever you plug in will fall out immediately after you plug it in. They have had dead rats in their pool before. The tennis court ground is completely destroyed. People have been shot in the complex. The garbage at the compactor is often overflowing with trash piled up everywhere. The ladies at the office are extremely unprofessional and disrespectful; including the office manager.  I would highly recommend not renting from Carlton Apartments.

The higher leaders in the office are rude. Maintenance comes whenever they feel like it and barely fixes anything. My garbage disposal has been trash from the time I moved in. I have also had a flood and there are red ants since I have been here. Next year I will not be here and will be moving somewhere else where I know my money will be appreciated with good customer service. Once again please do not move here .

It’s awful.

The maintenance staff are lazy, it seems, as they do not come fix any problems regardless of the situation. When we first moved in here we came with the impression that these people would fix things top-notch. False.

When we addressed our issues the first week of moving (the kitchen floor floods every single day, when it rains the water gets inside, the microwave installed stopped working so we had to result in buying one ourselves, the garbage disposal clogged so we had to unclog it ourselves because they took almost a week to finally come, stains were on the carpet from past resident even though they claimed to have cleaned them, the screen of my bedroom window fell off and no one came to fix it, etc.) Parking spots are also difficult to find and some people even result in parking on the side of the road if you aren’t lucky enough.

There is one positive thing though. Since we’ve moved we’ve never really had any issues with any of our neighbors, so that seems to be the only good thing about these apartments thus far.

Thankfully we will be moving by the end of the month but I would never recommend anyone.

Do not move here!!!! The people who work at the desk are very disrespectful.  When we need something fixed they never fix it. There are dirty stuff on the carpets, many spiders,and poison ivy.! I'm saying this for you safety do not move here!

I had problems from the moment I moved in.  First was the cleanliness of the place.  The carpets looked okay, but the bathroom mirror, counter, and cabinets had splotches of paint all over then, and it was obvious they hadn't bothered to dust the vents before they were painted.  They were absolutely caked with grime, all held together neatly with sloppily globbed paint.

Ants were EVERYWHERE.  They came out of the ceiling, the outlets, through gaps between the windows and walls (the windows themselves were either painted shut or so rusted that I couldn't budge them), and of course all throughout the kitchen.  They even got into the airtight containers I stored food in.  I made a few calls to the office, but never got any resolution.

A couple weeks after I moved in, I get a knock on my door.  It's maintenance, saying my bathtub is leaking into the apartment underneath me.  Before I can say anything, the guy PUSHES HIS WAY (at the time I was a single woman living alone) into my apartment and tracks mud all the way from the front door to the bathroom.  I have no idea if the bathtub was actually leaking, but I do know that Mr. Maintenance Man cracked a tile around one of the taps.  The whole tile came off the next day, making yet another path for ants to get in.  Again I called for a fix, and never got anywhere.

And then there was the mold... mother of all that is holy, the mold.  The ceiling tile above the (warped and wiggly) kitchen bar was so logged with water that it COLLAPSED ON TOP OF ME and covered me in pieces of tile and filthy water.  Turns out my AC had been leaking, and probably had been long before I moved in.  No way could that much water have accumulated in the scant year I'd been there.  I reported it, but when I moved out about two weeks later, still no one had come to deal with it.  Oh, and all that water that drenched me when the tile collapsed?  Yeah it caused a rash.  All over my neck, my chest, my face, my arms... it took two rounds of antibiotics and untold quantities of cortisone cream to get rid of it.

Twelve months in this place was twelve months too long.  The only good thing I can say about this place is that they didn't charge me for any of the above disasters.

Half the time, the office blows you off when you request mentenance. It took a month to get the water turned on in the full bath, and three weeks to replace a microwave that by that time I had already fixed (they gave me cheaper one). There is no security system, noise pollution at all hours, and a lot of drug use. The people below me (a couple living with five children in a two bed) smoke so much weed they stink up the entire building regularly. When our air conditioner broke, they just added Freon and told me it was good, completely dismissing what I had to say. (The unit was also about 30 years old) the windows aren’t properly sealed (they “don’t do that”), and you are lucky if half of your appliances are usable when you move in. On top of that, rent is higher than they claim and they will increase it without warning if you extend your lease, but at least they pay water.

Parking sucks I have to park about 2 buildings down
Dogs use it on my walkway 
Walls thin can hear neighbors conversation 
Neighbors moved and roaches came
Didnt have heat for half the winter had to buy heaters
If you pay by money order its a processing fee, when the 5th comes its 100$ late fee and 5-10$ a day
Raising rent again 
Maintenance just walked in our home while we were in bed instead of knocking

I was moved into a water damaged unit with people in and out for a month fixing water damage issues! Now my AC has been out for over 3 weeks and no one will contact me back or come out. The front office has been closed for 4 days in a row.... the gate to the pool is broken and laying on the ground. Kids run across the tarp covering the pool. There are never parking spaces. I contacted the corporate manager Susan M. But she doesn’t answer emails or seem to care about all the issues.

It is a complete waste of money. I wouldn't even give it one star. We have told the office numerous times about kids throwing rocks around cars and hitting our apartment window and nothing has been done about it. They Also, the dog parks are a joke and aren't being fixed and all ponds except one are hard to get to.

My sister moved in here about 6 months ago, I absolutely love it! A cute little dog park where she can take her dog, quiet & friendly neighbors, friendly staff, etc.! I am looking into moving here myself!

I was hesitant to move here due to bad reviews. I realized after 2 months of living here, those people just like to complain! I LOVE it here! 

Pros:
- Not too expensive at all for what you get! The buildings are roughly 5 years old and well insulated keeping electric bill down. Appliances are new and work great! When I moved into my apartment, it was clean, pristine, and in great condition!
- Washer and Dryer included is amazing! HUGE walk-in closet!
- Private staircase for upstairs residents and NO NOISE from stairs AT ALL.
- Friendly maintenance workers. I see them multiple times throughout the day on their golf cart. They came to my apartment NEXT MORNING when I said I had a problem and fixed it immediately. I have no experience with larger issues, but it’s the first snow of the year tonight and they are salting everywhere already!! Very proactive
- Very diverse complex with ALL ages and ALL types of people!
- I’ve had no problems with management at all! They are very nice! Reid and Alyssa are great! Maybe because I haven’t had any problems and don’t foresee any major problems in my future here because this place is great.
- Pet friendly & Pit Bull friendly!! One of the only places around! I love it! Of course aggressive dogs will not be tolerated. If you’re afraid of pit bulls, do not move here. We love them!
- Walls are quite soundproof! I have a newborn and the dog downstairs howls on occasion. It’s very muffled, doesn’t bother me, and most importantly, doesn’t phase my newborn at all!
- Close to Indy, Camby, Plainfield, Greenwood
- Great neighbors who are either very friendly or keep to themselves! It’s a win-win situation! Nobody bothers anyone here!
- I don’t understand why people say it is so trashy here. Dumpsters are taken care of multiple times a week. The apartments could use a good power washing but that is mostly anywhere you go.
- Private storage units available that are WAY bigger than I expected!
- Internet was just switched to Xfinity Comcast and I have no complaints! My husband is a gamer and has no problems with it at all.
- PARKING. Ok, so if you have a problem parking and walking one building down from where you live ON OCCASION, you must find every little reason to complain! I have a newborn and this has never bothered me! I wonder if these people have ever lived in an apartment complex before! After 6pm is the hardest time to find your ideal, perfect spot but I don’t see how walking an extra 20 feet is a problem. Laziness? Maybe.

If they got new management who actually manages and know how to manage it would become a better place. Katie is by far not a good property manager and the assistant manager, Reid, isn't any better. Not sure if Herman & Kittle knows how the poor management is affecting resident perception and retention, but I think they should. People are constantly moving out and that will include myself within the next month. That should say a lot in itself. This place is trashy... and I mean pathetically trashy. Seems they only clean up on the days they know they have appointments coming to view an apartment, otherwise, it's always looking trashy. They really need to clean the buildings on the outside, looks like green mold is growing on the siding. Katie has talked rude and condescending a few times too many. I am a paying resident and if it wasn't for tenants, she would not have a job. Matter of fact, she shouldn't have this job. Between her and the trashiness is why I am happily leaving. I will be contacting Herman & Kittle's main office directly letting them know of my dissatisfaction and the reasons why I have decided to leave. Don't waste your money.

I have lived here for awhile and am moving out soon for a change of scenery. I do not believe these are quite worth the cost they are priced as their upgrades are now about a decade old but they are clean and decently kept. Office staff is great until there is a problem; the property manager and account manager will not call you back in a timely manner unless you have the time to continually call them until someone will speak with you. Communication to residents is sporadic for some issues and at times confusing but they do have a text communication system. Their solution to any issues regarding other residences was to call the non-emergency police line when that doesn't seem appropriate. The purpose of my review mostly is to give credit to how great the maintenance staff is; they overshadow the inconsistencies of the office staff. They respond quickly and have taken care of serious issues (including a busted pipe in my building's wall) thoroughly and in a timely manner!

I lived here for one year. In that time, my basement apartment flooded no less than 5 times. They came out to rectify the situation on the 4th visit, and it helped for awhile, but it never stuck. The first time I got $100 off rent for my damaged items, but nothing else ever happened. My lease ended on August 31, and on July 11 I emailed regarding upgrading to a larger unit. We played phone tag for 7 weeks and I never got any answers. They say they called me twice in that time, but I don't have record of it and they have yet to provide dates and times for those calls. So by the second week of August, I still had no idea what was happening and if I would be moving or not. I needed more space, so I found alternate housing. They then told me that I did not provide enough vacate notice (60 days), despite the fact that I had been trying to leave this specific apartment for nearly 2 months at that point. Now they are making me pay rent until October for a space I don't have keys to. When moving out, I also found mold on several of my items. Unfortunately, I didn't have the insight to take photos, but it is what it is. Throughout all of this, the property manager has been incredibly rude and unhelpful. Do not live at Westminster Apartments.
I really enjoyed living here. The pool and workout facilities are great perks!
Nice area, beautiful apartments, nice staff. Overall better than most apartments in the area!
Great complex to live at. The office is very responsive and friendly and maintenance is always on top of it. Best complex I have lived at in Greenwood!

The apartment buildings are 50 plus years old, and its startibg to fall apart, the walls smell because of age,Maintenance us doped up, and don't know how to do their jobs, they keep raising the prices, but management doesn't make life better.

Great location, great price for your money, and the staff is even better.  The manager Tenille is always smiling, and the maintenance staff Jorge is always nice and takes care of anything that I need fixed.
Camby Crossing is a beautiful community!  Highly recommend this property and the manager, Tenille, is extremely helpful.  The grounds are beautiful and close to great shopping!
The staff treated me with so much respect and kindness. Tenille and Colin are amazing, I got the feeling that I was part of the community during my visit.
Great place between Hixon and downtown Chatt, quiet and quaint.

Run don't walk away from these apartments, the management is awful, everyone is always in your business. The apartments look remodeled but they aren't. The neighbors watch everything. They have no lives. Don't have visitors because their cars will be towed while visiting you. Also don't have more then 1 car that's not allowed. This place just sucks all around.

The property manage is rude every other word out of her mouth is an outright lie. She will gossip about you and tell everyone your business. I was going to rent there but when i spoke with a number of the current tenants and checked the reviews there is no way. also my ex mother in law was living there and the property manager (jerri) was disrespectful and rude. She9the property manager) needs to learn how to read when a contract reads that it ends on a date that does not mean 2 weeks before!!

At all hours of the day you can hear the neighbors. That’s not just through the walls but outside too. Imagine during the summer being able to hear everything that people do outside. When I first moved in I had put in so many
work orders one being my garage door doesn’t shut at times and it’s constantly breaking. Not to mention they clame there’s a lot of natural light but my apartment is always dark and the lighting fixtures that come with it prevent you from getting brighter bulbs.  I definitely would not recommend moving here. Your paying too much for lackluster accommodation.
Metropolitan apartments staff was very helpful in our move and response was very quickly for repair
Nice community, lots of amenities. Overall floor plans are pretty nice. Plumbing can be a bit of an issue, or at least in mine it did. But overall I’m happy here.

I first moved here when I was pregnant with my son and wanting to find a quiet and safe neighborhood to raise him. Safe to say Metropolitan is great to raise a family, with other children here and young professionals. The staff is also very communicative and I appreciate that so much.
Great place to live!! Moved from out of the state and we have loved this place/community since day one…. Also, great customer service by Celeste :) I highly recommend the Metropolitan Complex

I am currently in the market for a new apartment. I have toured places all over the city but really want to be in the Fishers area. FISHERS IS EXPENSIVE! I want to find something that is affordable and fairly updated. I toured the metropolitan and was very impressed with the updated inside of the home and the price. The staff was very professional, and the tour was unmatched. I am still looking at options, but this was a great apartment, especially for the price.

Very poor management. Moved out and gave notice that we were moving out when they asked if we wanted to renew. Apartment was returned in great condition. They were even surprised at how clean the place was when we returned it. We were given a refund for the deposit below what we expected. Called to have it explained and they sent an itemized report. Seemed a bit unusual, but did not think it was worth looking to get more back from them. Received a call from collections stating that we owed. Did not receive a notice from them at any point that we owed anything. This was 8 months after moving out and getting part of the deposit back. Would not recommend living here.

Tore a hole in the ceiling on Thursday for a leak in their hvac that was reported by Wednesday @ 8am. Then a strong odor of urine began emerging from the hole, office then claimed no repairs could be made until Friday afternoon. FRIDAY @ 4 came and still no repairs. The Office now states it won’t be repaired until Monday. This is only the most recent of issues, and it’s only the 2nd month of the lease, lord help us. Would leave 0 stars if possible ….

If smelling what others are cooking and even hearing conversations bother you, don't move hear. I've lived hear for one and half months...my dryer wasn't working correctly because the vent needed to be cleaned out. After asking several times to have this done and being told it had I called a vent cleaning company to do it. 30 years of built up lint came out!!! but maintenance and the manager didn't believe me. So far it's not worth the money.

I've lived here for almost a year now and I've had no major complaints. It's fairly quiet and right on Allisonville road. The only complaint I would have is that maintenance isn't very fast about fixing non-essential items (a handle of a cabinet fell off and has yet to be replaced, but you can open the cabinet, things like that). It's a little expensive for the quality, but the feeling of safety outweighs that for me. It's gate secured and well-lit at night.

Good area, price is slightly high for what you get. Some apartments don’t have balcony’s! Doors aren’t made very well, ours are warped and the doors to the washer and dryer constantly come of the tracks and break. If you have dogs there are very few bag/trash stations. There is only one dumpster for trash. If you don’t live close to it, you have to drive to throw your trash away. I love the sunroom we have! The windows are extremely drafty though! Bedroom and bathrooms are good sized! Lots of storage in the kitchen. Overall it is pretty decent!

I’m so impressed with my new apartment. When I first visited the grounds I was in love. The showing was everything the pictures showed. I am now a happy resident of Metropolitan of Fishers. Bianca, Jocelyn and Neil are amazing and pleasant. Great staff ??
The amenities are great and the staff is very friendly! This community is in the perfect location for my family also. I recommend!

I LOVE Metropolitan Fishers!  The staff is very friendly and helpful. I love my apartment and love the location.  
I have been here 2 years and couldn't be happier. The amenities are great ,I enjoy being able to use the 24 hour fitness center at my convenience.
I can call in a maintenance service request and it is taken care of in a timely matter. I love my new upgrades that were made with the new management.   my lease is up for renewal and will definitely  be renewing with the metropolitan !!

I have been a resident here for 3 years and I love it here. Yes, they changed names, yes, they are doing improvements and yes, they are coming into occupied apartments to make the improvements. I had mine done 2 weeks ago and I LOVE them! Yes, it was some work to prepare for the improvements but was so worth it! My place doesn't look the same. It's amazing what new cabinets, lighting, and appliances can do! The staff is very friendly and helpful. I love my apartment and love the location.

I live in Dearbrook apartmentsyfor 4 years. Great community, safe, close to all major shopping centers in Fishers and Noblesvile.  Find this size apartment with all amenities (washer/drayer) and great area for family's and everyone else for this price!!!Only at Dearbrook Apartments Fishers,In.Come home!
Staff is very helpful and maintenance is quick and responsive.
The new staff is excellent LeNaya is very caring and responsive!

DO NOT LIVE HERE. The foundation of the apartment leaks water constantly. There are cochroaches and bugs. A few hours of rain will likely soak your apartment carpets. Oh and what does DTN do about it? Replace the carpet and not fix the fundamental problem and pretend the problem doesn't exist. This is their mentality for any serious problem, band-aids. The fourth time this happened, I called and emailed them about my wet carpet for weeks. The walls literally started to mold because they had not done anything about it. They never did anything about it. They do not care about tenants and only care about collecting rent. The only reason to rent from a large company of DTN is if there is not other place to live. Even though they are a large company with large overhead costs, they do not address problems like a company with a big bankroll SHOULD. Save your money and brain cells, rent somewhere else.

Auburn Place Apartments was taken over by Stan Residential in May of 2022 and they have been doing an incredible job! Maintenance issues are being addressed quickly and efficiently. They have repaved the entire community and the pool deck, the interior hallways are being redone, the landscaping looks amazing, they are working on new fences, decks and gutters and they have a courtesy officer that monitors the community daily.  The office staff is fair, friendly and professional. It is so refreshing to see all the hard work and dedication on all fronts to improve the quality of living for me and my neighbors. This is definitely the best place I’ve ever lived!
Older apt prone to FLOODS AND BLACK MOLD units are not secure not uncommon for trespassers or vagrants in apt buildings. Not safe or secure.
Auburn Place is a quiet whimsical community. Here you will find a good peace of mind knowing you are safe and close to anything you may need.
The staff is very helpful and nice, every neighbor I have met so far has been very friendly, and we love our new apartment!

apartmentName: The Otis at Fort Ben Apartments
review: Was an awesome place to call home when we lived there. Fantastic amenities and floorplans. Lots of nice upgrades... too many to mention here. Great management and responsive maintenance staff. Pet-friendly (private dog park!). Clean brick buildings. Quiet neighbors (usually). Easy parking. With lots of new development in the area (new library, Civic Plaza, retail, restaurants, a state park -- all within walking distance), the Otis is a very nice addition to the fabric of Lawrence! Safe neighborhood, too. Highly recommended.

apartmentName: The Otis at Fort Ben Apartments
review: The leasing agents and property manager are wonderful at what they do! However, the maintenance team could use some work... I put in several work orders several weeks ago and I am always told that somebody is coming to fix the problem, but they never show up. I see them driving around on golf carts all day and wonder "what are these people actually doing?"

apartmentName: The Otis at Fort Ben Apartments
review: We recently moved into the Otis and we absolutely love it! From the beautiful apartment to the incredible amenities the complex offers to the staff that ensures your home experience is top notch, you cannot find another place like this one! Kevin with maintenance is very helpful and on top of getting any minor fixes I've needed, completed. Kaylee is incredible at her job and going through all the ins and outs of moving into a new home and making sure your experience is pleasant. If you're looking for anywhere to live, it's here. Not to mention you are close to everything from grocery stores, shopping, hiking, and restaurants. It's all right here.

The staff at the office are somewhat accommodating. The maintenance team, though small, is very efficient. The landscaping is okay and with quick access to I74 and 465, it's a great location with easy access to wherever you want to go.
2 years later, new company runs the property. Repairs do NOT get made, promises are frequently broken, the office is hard to get a hold of, and the staff mysteriously disappear for no reason at all. The new online payment system is full of bugs, and expect an eviction notice if you are 2 weeks late on your rent.....2 weeks! Also, the USPS will lose your packages, leave your mailboxes open, or just mark mail as delivered that never shows up. Not to mention all of the incorrect mail that lands in your box. These are NOT luxury apartments. The hole in the master bath ceiling is from a catastrophic flood over 1 year ago. Still there! All the registers for air are rusted and chipping. Woke at midnight to yet another flood from my upstairs neighbors this morning.

I have lived at Echo Ridge close to 9 years. I just signed another lease. The current staff is a great group of people who work hard to meet my needs and they are constantly asking how to make it better. I commend this staff they remind me of Kelsi and Tony who were there when I moved in. Thank you for finding the right staff to bring Echo back to what I moved into 9 years ago. Keep on rocking team you guys have made a difference.

The location of these apartments is one of the best selling points.  They are located right off of I-74 and within close proximity to I-465.  You can get downtown within 15 minutes, to the north side in less than half and hour, and even to Cincinnati within about an hour or so.  One downside is that there are no grocery stores very close.  You can get a few dry items at CVS and Dollar General, both of which are within walking distance, but if you need fresh fruit or vegetables, you do have to use an automobile.  

The common areas are well maintained by the staff, however, some of the residents cannot be bothered to actually put their trash in the compactor and by the end of most weekends it looks like a landfill.  Thankfully, the staff has it all cleaned up on Monday.  Though I haven't had many maintenance issues, when a few came up they were addressed quickly regardless of them being minor issues.

You pay for what you get. 

Likes: 
- pool area
- community: Nice people and management 
- apartment events 
- The maintenance team is very helpful/efficient 
- Great area/location tucked back behind the strip
- Walking distance restaurants 

Dislikes:
- Trash Valet services: they are inconsistent in picking up the trash and often miss days. This is a third-party company where 82 Flats management does not assist in communication. 
- Trash compactor is often broken
- The gym is very small and the air conditioning doesn't really work
- thin walls and floors 
- No smoking / Drug policies are enforced (hallways smell like smoke etc.)
- limited parking 
- car break-ins
- quiet hours are not enforced

I’ve been living here for over a year and never encountered major issues with maintenance or leasing office. Great place to live if you live by yourself. Any questions or concerns I have get answered immediately
Area is great, safe, some minor issues with needing stairways cleaned but nothing major.  Way better then other apartments I have seen in the area.
Avoid at all costs. Apathetic management, place falling apart

I have lived here with my son for about 5 months now and we both love it here! 

The staff is amazing!   They are very friendly and accommodating.  No matter what the issue, they address it  immediately.
The property at 82 flats is very well taken care of and beautiful.   My favorite feature is the pool for the summer.  The property also has a gym, coffee bar, conference room, and much more. 
There are a lot of extras and little touches in the apartments like the crown molding, granite counter tops and wine fridge that make the apartment feel like home. 

The community at 82 flats was something I didnt expect.  The residents are all so great and welcoming as well. I never imagined you could have such a close community in an apartment .  
I had lived in a house for 15 years and was really worried about going back to apartment living but if I have to be in an apartment this is definitely a gret choice.

The surrounding area of 82 Flats is what (in my opinion) makes 82 Flats. You do not have to travel far for anything. Restaurants, shopping malls, groceries, movies. Everything is right there on that main strip & some can be even in walking distance if it became one of your favorite spots. 82 Flats is a beautiful community of people that live there & the office staff are some of the best 3 people to know. I love the shebang about it & the newly wife & i are enjoying it. Great place to live!
Across the street from a grave yard and traffic is bad at the intersection.

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review: I have been here for almost 2 years and I will not-be renewing! If you work from home, or your a student trying to study, or simply wanting to relax in the confines of your own home these apartments are definitely NOT FOR YOU!! THIS PROPERTY ALLOWS VICIOUS DOGS LIKE PIT BULLS WELL OVER THE 30 POUND WEIGHT LIMIT!!! I Have been dealing with loud music and a BARKING  DOG AS WELL AS EXTREMLY LOUD UPSTAIRS NEIGHBORS FOR ALMOST 4months!!! I contacted the office numerous times and they tell me they will deal with it, nothing has been resolved!!! I even reached out to Buckingham Co. and no response!! I pay way to much for these overpriced, outdated apartments no to be able to reside in peace!!!

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review: The management is a complete joke here. They lose paperwork all of the time and act like it is the tenant's fault. They owe me money. I have it in writing from the manager, yet management still refuses to pay it to me. I am not the only tenant with this problem. Management is absolutely rude. There are no people skills in the office at all. Management is hostile toward tenant's and blatantly refuses to man up to their mistakes.

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review:
Living here was my first apartment experience. Lived in a two bedroom and the rent was very reasonable. I drive downtown every-morning for work and it is only about an eight to ten minute drive. Super close to downtown and has a nearby Walmart on Michigan St that is very convenient too! The apartment complex itself is in a good area, has an entrance gate that at least once a month gets damaged by cars not paying attention, but it always gets replaced rather quickly. Parking is tight, and there are few visitor spots to park in, but you can get a pass from the office so your visitors won't get towed. Towing is frequent here. They do not mess around and I have overheard many altercations of someones car getting taken away because they didn't have a visitors pass or they parked in a handicap spot without a proper pass for that. If you do decide to live here, just stay on top of where you and your visitors park because you might walk out into the parking lot and not find your car. It is not difficult to avoid at all, I promise I have had no problems with parking. 
The pool is nice and has a lot of space in and around it. The work out center is kinda small but they made the best out of what they could. It recently got renovated and is easy to access and use. The office staff is extremely professional and helpful. The Maintenance staff is also very similar. They are timely, polite, and efficient. Our dishwasher was not working and so we called maintenance. They spent a long time on it and determined that a contractor needed to be called. They took it apart and found a piece of glass inside that broke off one of our cups. A big issue was fixed within a week! 
The apartment itself is very nice. The bedrooms are very spacious and the living room and kitchen provide enough space as well. The stove was a little old. We had an apartment with a newer dishwasher. Each apartment also has its own washer and dryer. Ours probably needed some work done to it but it got the job done. I never was able to hear noise from other floors or apartments. However, I could hear about everything that went on outside. 
Overall, this is a great place to live. I think the most important thing is that any problem you have, will get sorted out in a timely fashion.

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review:
Overall, this is a nice place to live. It checks all the boxes on amenities, and the staff are always courteous and helpful. However, it is clear that whoever built the apartments was very cheap. There is a dishwasher, but it only works if you've already rinsed the dishes perfectly clean. There is a sink disposal, but it shakes the entire kitchen and roars when you use it. There are big windows, but they are very thin and not sealed well. Heating bills are $100 . There is a pool, but it's not heated and always freezing. There is a gym, but it's not heated. 

So, overall, it's a nice location and comfortable, but I would have rather gone someplace cheaper without the amenities that barely work anyway.

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review:
I love living here at The Residence at White River Apartments! 

The people here are so friends and always wanting to help! I live by myself and they are always concerned about my safety and wanting to make sure that they are doing everything possible to make me feel safe, and secure. The gated community always tries to get all of the residence together to have different activities for us to have throughout the year.

apartmentName: The Residence at White River Apartments
review:
This apartment has a great location as far as proximity to downtown and close to other fun neighborhoods like Broad Ripple. The buildings are tucked away from the Main Street and the gated parking lots are a plus. 

The apartment itself is older, but offers plenty of storage space with numerous big closets and extra storage on the deck/patio. Also apartments have a good functional layout. 

Maintenance and office staff are both quick and courteous. Anytime I have needed something fixed they respond immediately. I have even had a few emergencies in which they acted promptly too.

This is how bad my apartment was. I had to contact Indiana Board of Health. They gave the apartments 30 days and nothing to my apartment was done . Then they gave days to move out. This was March 2023 .
This place is not a great place to live it is poor in communicating what is going on and the work request are a joke there's no maintenance people
Spacious and comfortable apartment not to modern but not outdated unbeatable pricing I would say this is a hidden gem considering how the economy is looking at the moment..
I do love my apartment it’s perfect for me. The office staff that you have is wonderful even if you are having a bad day they do and say the right words to make you feel better

I have lived in here for two years and ever since I moved in my apartment was not completely done. I was in a need of moving fast due to my children. I was ok with me moving in how it was because it was told to me that it was going to be fixed after I submitted all my Move in concerns. I have constantly been putting work orders during these two years. All this Management cares about is the exterior of the buildings. My truck got towed twice without me getting notified due to them painting the streets. I was not the only tenant that they moved their cars without being notified. I understand there is a process of doing things, I understand there is a protocol and procedure. But this management places notices on the main doors saying and notifying when things will suppose to be done but they never follow what they say. I have been without heat for two days now and they have LAZY EMPLOYEES NOT KNOWING what they are doing starting from the office staff to the outside employees. I have been in this field of PM for more than 10 years and the way how this Management is handling this property is not a safe place to live IN GENERAL.  They lose rent and then place you a nasty letter on your door. Crime in here is always shootings and drugs involved. That is the reason why I will not recommend, and I am moving from the apartments.
I enjoy my apartment, I appreciate the amenities that it offers and the space.

I would say the apartment itself in the inside is very spacious, that’s the best feature. The outside of the apartments don’t look so good. Office staff is dysfunctional. When I moved in they gave me two keys that didn’t work. So I had to wait for a maintenance man from another site to change my locks. Blinds were not changed before moving in.
