They make you pay a $100 holding when u apply on top of the 60$ application fee and it tells you if u get denied you get the $100 back..why I applied in late November and I still haven't received my $100 back ...I call no answer or I get told someone will call me it's nothing she can do ....then I keep getting emails asking how I like my place..like what?... I wasn't approved and where is money ...I'm so confused ...can I get my money back or I guess I can go to BBB cuz at this point something needs to be done
My apartment is spacious and beautiful.  Parking is available, love the hard wooden floors, love my spacious balcony as well. Dishwasher is another great amenity.

Wellington Village use to be a nice place to live. The new management doesn't care about the residents. It's all about money for them. They're allowing this community to go down. The buildings are dirty, tenants keep it cleaned. The outside grounds are nasty, trash everywhere. The pool isn't open.
Yo disfruto vivir en Wilighton porq por el momento no he tenido ningún problema gracias a Dios y me gusta por q tiene a alguien q es bilingüe
Very spacious apartment layout and quiet community. Safe place to raise children.

If you need an affordable spacious place to live Wellington is your place but DONT expect consistent working washers, good communication from the front office, good or even acceptable customer service, clean buildings and parking lots.

ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE. wish i could give 0 stars.they literally never follow up for a maintenance request until you call them 10 times. they have an off site office who answers the phone and says they can’t do anything because they’re off site. washers and dryers nearly always broke! and they have the audacity to raise the rent. so glad to be moving out of here

The worst customer service, you would think that they would be nicer if they wanted to rent their units. If you hate your job then quit, no need to be rude because someone called to get property information.
Pool has been down for 3 years. Apartments are NOT smoke free. Office people are rude and do not care about the your problems.
My apartment has nice space.  Close to my work and church. The maintenance is prompt. People are polite, friendly.

I love my apartment, it fits me perfectly.  I have plenty of space, I don't feel crowded at all. I have an underground lower level apartment with lots of windows so lots of sunlight.  It also has stayed cool enough all summer that I haven't needed to even turn on the central air, a fan has done a great job.  I have a utility closet that I have turned into a pantry with great shelving space which holds all my cookware.  You very seldom hear your neighbors...an apartment I used to live in previously, I heard the neighbors above me ALL the time.  I feel like I'm in the middle of the cod town with the convenience of Interstate 70 & 465 around the corner.  However, we are still kind of secluded back here.  I searched and visited 3 or 4 other complexes before I chose this one, and surprisingly this was the best priced, as well as the most spacious.  It was a no brainier to move in here.

Pool was open for two weeks and then got closed by the city for contaminated water. Management does not care about residents and sits on their cell phones instead of answering phones. Plus they jacked up parking g after I signed my lease by 100 bucks a month 
Actual units are nice and clean but you hear everything from all the apartments around you. Not worth how expensive it is

The management at this property is unbelievably bad. The girl at the front desk can’t answer a single question and the property manager never returns our calls, emails, and is never in the office for any help. We wanted to resign our lease as we enjoy the location but the management never got back to us. Not worth living here, the management is nice up until you move in but is useless from that point on. Also the pool that was supposed to be opened in Sept 2023 is still not open as of July 2024.
Excellent Service Maintenace completed my service same day I submitted my service request, and the work was done efficiently.

Great staff and location. The view to the lake is amazing. The biggest gym I have ever seen in an apartment complex, two floors and a racquetball court in the gym. Basketball and tennis court. The pool is amazing and constantly the staff is doing activities for the residents. Townhomes can seem a little price, but they include a garage, and the size is amazing. Cant complain, calm area, close to all the places I need to go.

It's true when they say people write reviews when they have a bad experience. I'm going to make it a habit to write reviews for places that give or don't give great experiences. I moved her about 3 months ago: my roommates and I have had many maintenance problems. 

1. Our electric bill for a 3 bedroom/2 bath apartment, 1300 square ft has been costing us $250 plus a month. We have never ran our air during the months of September, October, and into November. We are conscious of the appliances. Throughout the day, all 3 of us are usually working or at school. However, the office and maintenance have told us that these bills seem normal according to our living arrangement. I've lived in a 3 bedroom apartment before, all running on electric, but have never had a bill that high. 

2. Termites:  My roommate and I both discover termite exit holes within our walls. Office was informed. They sent a pest control specialist from Gold Seal to look at our wall. The guy that comes says it is termites, but needs to verify with a Gold Seal Termite specialist. He said he would inform the office; which he did. The Gold seal guy did not come until two/three days later. The Gold Seal guy came to our apartment later in the evening, confirming termites. He informed US that the entire building and our apartment needed to be treated. He would let the office know about the estimated costs. After a few days, I still didn't hear anything back from the office. Called the office about my water heater problem and also asked about termites. The office had no idea what the termite inspector had found because he never followed through with them. The office didn't take it upon themselves to follow through with us or Gold Seal. Still waiting to hear what will be done with this problem.

3. Flood: All within the same time frame, roommates toilet valve broke and flood the apartment. Maintenance guy did come to fix the valve and had someone dry up our carpets that day. However, we had to keep fans running for 36 hours; which jacked up our energy bill even more. 



My advice, if you look into living here, make sure you ask the appropriate questions and looking into the place thoroughly. We made a mistake not doing this.

I lived in this apartments complex four years, a very satisfying experience. The campus is extremely safe at all times, and break-ins are unheard of –the only IMPD car I saw belonged to one of the tenants. The apartments are bright and many are newly furnished, with brand new appliances and granite countertops.
The Leasing Office is extremely prompt and responsive in problem resolution. Those working in the Office are ready to help with any problem you may have –they receive your FedEx parcels or oversize Mail while you are out.
The landscape of the grounds is perfectly maintained year round and the freshly fallen snow is plowed immediately.
The rents are competitive and affordable. The Gym is opens early and closes late in the day, and the clean pool is a main attraction in the season. There is a mile long jogging path around the lake, very popular for running or walking your dog. Monthly, there are residents group events at area restaurants or bars, which create a sense of community.
The location of the Complex is off 86th/82nd Ave which is full of shopping opportunities and places to eat out, and is also conveniently situated off I-465.
I recommend this apartments complex ahead of any other place on the North Side.
Dan Baron

After just one month of living at River Crossing, my plumbing system totally failed. My toilet would clog, overflow, etc. all the time. I called a plumber to come take a look who basically said that this was a long time coming and all of the parts were outdated. I told the complex this and they refused to pay for any of the new parts or the service fees that I paid the plumber.

After I moved out, I realized that I had forgotten to empty out my kitchenware from the dish washer. I called the property and asked if they could please have an employee go in the apartment and remove the items and send them to me along with the postage fees which I would repay, to which they replied "we are not set up to do that kind of thing". So I had to buy all new kitchenware.

Additionally, there are no cameras or security at the apartment making it a thief's dream apartment complex. I received countless emails reminding me to lock my car at night due to the reoccurring robberies.

Great location near amenities, grocery store, the mall and freeway entrance. Walking path, pool, workout room are excellent and are great for keeping a healthy lifestyle. Management is friendly, accommodating and goes above and beyond. Highly recommend this place for young professionals and those looking to keep an active lifestyle.

This apartment complex, River Crossing Apartments, is a great first apartment for young professionals who just graduated from college. Many residents are in that age group/life situation which makes it ease to become friends with your neighbors. The lifestyle and pool atmosphere creates an easy transition. It is fair affordable, more so if you have roommates. The apartments are in decent shape if you get one that hasn't been remodeled. The remodeled apartments are very nice. Overall, I am happy living here.

Great location. Close to both malls, and great places to eat either on 86th Street or 96th street. You can hit Chammps with a rock. Monon is right down the road and Broad ripple is close as well. 

Staff are great as well. The summer pool scene keeps me resigning my lease. Maintenance are nice, and respond quickly to any issues you may have. 

I would definitely recommend these apartments.

This is the perfect place to live.  It is walking distance to the premier shopping area in Indianapolis.  I can also walk to restaurants, huge book store, an upscale movie theatre and boutique shops.  It has a beautiful lake that most of the apartments overlook.  The pool area is one of the most fun places to be on the weekend during summer. The staff is always friendly and responds quickly to any issues that could occur in an apartment. 
It has easy access to interstates and near other streets that will quickly guide me to downtown Indianapolis for Colts games, Pacers games, and other events at the Indiana Convention Center.

Patrick T. , Indianapolis, IN

There is no better apartment in the whole of Indianapolis, IN.  I am walking distance to the premier shopping area in Indianapolis.  Also within walking distance, about five to ten minutes tops, are restaurants, (several with outside dinning) upscale movie theatre, botquie shops, sports bar, huge book store.  My apartment overlooks a beautiful lake as do most of the apartments.  The pool during summer is the most fun place to be on weekends.  The apartment size and rent is perfect for me.  The staff is always friendly and courteous and respond to any apartment issues quickly.  The grounds are always in excellent shape with a good deal of natural beauty.  I even watched a robin hatch her eggs in a tree outside my bedroom window. I have video to prove it.
I would not want to live in any other place.
Libby T, Indianapolis, IN
This apartment seems to be great so far. Office staff is very friendly and also available when needed.

My 800 square-foot home at Keystone Crossing in Indianapolis acted as a perfect first apartment. It was easy to meet new people, the leasing staff and other residents were very friendly. Keystone Crossing has many restaurants within walking distance, as well as the Keystone Fashion Mall. Everyone would hangout at the pool on the weekends, and go to Champs on Wednesdays after work. I loved the gym and running around the one Mile sidewalk around the lake right outside my door. After 6 months you can move to an upgraded apartment with better appliances.

I have nothing but good things to say about River Crossing apartments.  The staff and property management is extremely courteous and responsive.  I also love that they take pride in keeping their property clean and renovated.  River Crossing's location is perfect for any kind of food or activities.  The best part might be the pool parties and being able to meet and interact with new people every weekend.

i love the location, set up and atmosphere  for our apartment. But of course all of us living in a apartment we always have a huge chunk of our pay check gone from our rent! Therefore this would be great if this opportunity could give me the chance to take that money I would be using for rent to other things in life that I could enjoy!! You only live once! Help a sister out!
Nice apartment complex, has a pool and work out facility, younger residents overall and great location.

River Crossing at Keystone is a gorgeous place.  I like to run the trail around the lake.  I have a husky mix that is restricted in most apartments, and I actually can have her at River Crossing.  There is no weight restriction and only 3 breeds are restricted.  The staff is always nice.  The monthly resident events are awesome.  Let me tell you, they threw the best pool party I have ever been to!!! It is so close to everything: The Fashion Mall, Broad Ripple, and several restaurants.  Yet, it is still tucked away.  They had me at granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and new cabinets.

if you don't mind the expense it is an excellent place to live. Everyone who lives here and the staff is very friendly. There are all walks of life that live here but the vast majority are young professionals. Fairly quiet during the week and the pool turns into a party spot on the weekends. Convenient location short drive to anything you need. In walking distance to a restaurant/bar with an outdoor patio featuring live music 5 days a week in the summer. Behind the pool sits a lake with a 1.1 mile track around it. Apartment and track are both pet friendly. Would recommend to anyone, especially in the 20-29 age group.

The Apt is in a great location, everything about it was a great experience. I have only been here since June 2013, but the experience I had was positive. The staff from the maintenance guys, to the girls in the office, to the site manager dealt with everything in a very positive and friendly manner. Nothing is perfect and knowing that they definitely do what needs to get done day in and day out. A lot of improvements were made over the summer and snow removal everyday. All with a smile on their face. Highly Recommended!!!!!!

The service staff Is great, however.
 Maintenance is very poor I've had a hole in my bathroom since I moved in within one month and still haven't gotten it fixed it leaks every day.  These apartments are overpriced.I wish I would have known before coming here and when When our lease is up, I don't plan on staying any longer.I really never write reviews.However, Please don't be in a rush to get into any apartments like I was don't make the same mistake.We made coming here...
They always work with you no matter the circumstances such a great community

0 Stars. Very inconsiderate, horrible and rude staff. Have been living here for 4 years and they literally have ZERO respect for their tenants. Not good with communication at all. Took more than a year just to change the kitchen light and instead of changing air filters they just leave them at your door. Been running after them to renew my lease but they just don't respect other peoples time. Was planning to renew my lease but will not consider to renew it. Horrible management has taken over.

I've lived at this property for a few years now. The former management was fabulous. Herron Property Management bought the property May 2021. There is no management on site, and HPM does not visit the property regularly. Since their purchase these are the changes I have noticed at the property:
- Trash accumulates all over the grounds including in and around the dumpsters. Because the bins are never emptied, trash blows everywhere. 
- One month HPM forgot to pay Waste Management to have the dumpsters emptied (this information came from a former property manager).
- High turn over for property managers (there have been 4 over the year).
- They do not return phone calls or emails.
- Maintenance requests sit open for months or are closed without resolution. I've had two request closed without fixing the issues.
- Safety has become a concern (see the next few points).
- For several months the key fobs to the "secure" building were not working. To allow residents access to the building, the doors were not locked. 
- They allow self guided tours so despite it being a “secure” building, anyone can enter by using the QR code.
- Consequently, several bikes were stolen from inside the “secure” building. Some bikes had been locked up for years under the old property management company with no issue.
- Parking lot lights did not work because a contractor turned them off. It took several months of calling consistently for them to fix the safety concern of a completely unlit parking lot at night (in downtown Indy).
- Vagrants and homeless people consistently troll the parking lot (not a problem before). 
- The first floor of building 1430 smells awful and gets worse everyday because the inside of the building is not cleaned regularly. Previously, under the old management, the building was cleaned weekly.
- The walls have visible filth and dirty all over them.
- The stairs are sticky from leaky trash and currently have a trail of cat litter all over them (again, rarely cleaned).
- Poster board “prints” were placed on the walls using velcro commands strips. Most fell down over the course of the day and laid broken and bent in the hallway for weeks before another tenant picked them all up.
- They piled up several stackable washer and dryers in the hallway blocking access to the back exit (yes, MAJOR safety concern). They were there for several weeks before the hallway was cleared
- Lightbulbs go out in the stairwell regularly, and are not replaced for several weeks/months.

I don't think sitting in an apartment with no AC for a week in the middle of summer is acceptable. They think it's fine to let all their office messages go to voicemail without ever giving a call back.

If I could give it ZERO stars I would. I was under the impression that this would be a comforter place to call home as my first place but I soon found that to be false! Theres a list of things I could say but heres a few. The office didnt allow me to do a walk thru of my unit before paying my deposit. Shortly after moving into my unit , nobody responded to my maintenance request until I went into the office. There is only ONE trash compactor in the complex which is always full and some units have rodents (they still charge pest and trash fee) Lastly, My car was stolen from the parking lot outside of my home days before bringing my newborn home from the hospital. The office did absolutely nothing when  I notified them. Nobody seen or knows anything but somehow other residents vehicles keep getting broken into and they dont have any surveillance cameras throughout the whole complex. I regret moving here. Its not what it seems

they are extremely unorganized they put me in the wrong apartment and charged me for the one I originally wanted after hours of arguing on our move in day with their office they corrected it and we then had to change the address for a 3rd time to the correct one. Once we did move in the apartment was newly “Renovated”. Many things were not installed correctly or not touched. I found that our air filter had not been changed in months if not years which is not just horrible for air quality but it also is a massive fire hazard. Our shower was leaking, our toilet seat was not attached, so on. As well there are bigger things such as our dishwasher was inoperable for the first 4 months of our lease after it was broken by one of THEIR maintenance staff. Something that we are paying for included in our rent and was not working. Now there are even more concerning issues such as follows. They often cut the water off without notice or with very limited notice leaving residents without access to water. They also enter your residence without a 24 hour notice and in many cases without a notice at all. I had a maintenance worker attempt to open my door while I was home. He didn’t knock I just heard the key turn and the door try to open but it was caught on the chain. As I hurriedly got dressed I yelled whose there, and as I turned the corner he was trying to remove the chain without saying anything. I asked again whose there and this time he said he was with maintenance and to let him in. I can’t imagine if my wife had been home alone it’s horrifying. I’ve also heard from multiple residents including a family member that lives here that they have had property stolen from inside their apartments with no sign of forced entry. Their maintenance is slow to respond leaving residents without basic necessities. But this also extends to needs, my wife and I spent a few weeks in the winter without proper heating. And now we are in summer and our AC doesn’t work. These are things we are being charged for and not receiving. It has been in the high 80s and I have not had AC in 3 weeks. The property also does not provide a trash service so garbage piles up in the streets, recently they have large dumpsters which has quelled the cumulation of trash to an extent, but they rarely call for them to be taken leaving mounds of trash surrounding these overflowing dumpsters. This property is has horrible business ethics and treating their tenants with little to no respect.

I've lived at Spinnaker Court going on 3 years now. I've actually enjoyed living here,never had any problems.  Until about 2 weeks ago, when my air conditioner quit working. I put in my maintenance request in online, after 3 days I called the office. I was told I was on the list, but they only had one maintenance person who was HVAC certified.  It took 10 days for them to come out, the new maintenance supervisor was very nice, professional and had it working within minutes.

It worked for 2 days, then quit working again.  Here I'm going on day 5 of waiting again.  I know AC isn't a life or death issue, but when you work nights and sleep during the day. Sleeping with all the windows open is hard to do.

Maybe if there are that many apartments with HVAC issues and there is only one HVAC certified maintenance person, they should get a contract with an HVAC company .

I lived here for 3 years. Everything was fine until it underwent new management. Suddenly, you could no longer contact the front office (mailbox always full and no one answers), you have to jump through hoops to get a maintenance order, and if you try to go to the office to talk face to face they are extremely rude

I have lived at Spinnaker Court Apartments for almost 15 years. I witnessed the ups and downs of apartment living. I love my 1 bedroom Resort and my patio. I have a place for gardening and laying out along with a quiet and clean apartment. The grounds are maintained well and have even had my trash taken to to compactor for me. The office staff is courteous and always helpful. It's been a joy to live here! Quiet areas for walking and nice neighbors to boot.

After the pool didn't open when it was suppose to summer 2018. We were told that it would be a delayed opening due to "renovations". Apparently to Spinnaker Court staff, renovating something means rendering it useless! After getting everyone's hopes up and us having to listen to a jackhammer at all hours of the morning, the pool just never opened. If you were to look at it now, it looks like there was an earthquake!!

I would not rent here unless you want poor managed apartments, terrible maintenance, and old outdated units. I lived there for serveral years and recently moved because the apartments went downhill. Don't be fooled by the new windows as the apartments are trash. They need major updates.
I love my apartment! My bathroom, room and living are all very spacious also came with new refrigerator, new stove, new carpet, and I love to call it home
I like living here. The apartments are quite and safe. The staff is friendly and they take time to care for the needs of the residents. The location is perfect. Minutes from downtown.

I have been living here for 3 months so far and I am very happy with my one bedroom apartment. The grounds are kept clean and well maintained. My apartment came with new carpet and fresh paint. The office staff has been friendly and helpful whenever I go in. My only slight complaint is that my smoke alarm has been beeping and has taken a while to get a replacement. Overall I would recommend Spinnaker to anyone.

There's something intrinsically comforting about brick apartments, I love living somewhere knowing that the Big Bad Wolf couldn't blow it down. Plus, the neighbourhood is notably lax, the community keeps to themselves in a friendly and non-reclusive sorta way, which I love. The speed bumps are a little high, but that's a first world problem. :)

I have lived at Spinnaker Court for 3 years. I love the upgrades they have done to the windows and doors. My electric bill has dropped significantly. The staff is friendly and helpful. Maintenance is decent. They could be a little faster when fixing things but they have a lot of apartments here so I'm sure they are super busy. LOVE the fenced in patio for my 2 dogs!

The apartments are very nice. The staff here are so helpful when we need help with things that go wrong in the units. The pool is just so relaxing that you could just lay out in it and get a nice sun tan.
I visited this property and I immediately fell in love with the place.I`m moving in next month.Thanks for helping find this place.
Nice apartment with environment and quite. I will be moving in next month. I will recommend this apartment to friends

I live at The Ascent, and I have to say, Delaney is the best property manager I've ever worked with. She is incredibly responsive, attentive, and genuinely cares about the residents. The property itself is fantastic, with excellent amenities and a welcoming community. I highly recommend The Ascent!

Do not live here
Building quality is poor
Noise is very disruptive

These walls are REALLY REALLY THIN. I can hear my neighbor argue, I can hear them have conversations, I can hear them have sex and I can hear them SNORE... do you know how annoying it is when you can hear your neighbor snore but not be able to do anything about it... if you want peace and quiet you should hope that no one lives next to you if you decide to sign a lease here. For that reason I WOULD NOT recommend this place to anyone...I can not wait to move it is crazy how much they charge for such crap quality when it comes to how this place was built I’ve never had a problem with management or maintenance but it really just irks me that I can hear my neighbors doing simple task if they are home... the free car vacuum, gym, pool, dog park and pet grooming place is really nice but not worth the peace of mind..

This was the worst apartment I lived in. The walls were extremely thin, so I heard everything my neighbors did. Management was rude and unhelpful. Multiple neighbors smoked in the building despite the lease prohibiting smoking anywhere on property. When this was brought to management, the best they could do was having someone come sniff around and confirm. I called for months before anything productive was done. Management would cut me off during conversations about these lease violations and would complain about their personal life rather than address the community problems. When telling them where I would be moving, management had the audacity to tell me it would likely be worse due to location. Don’t be fooled by the initially welcoming management, look elsewhere!

The amenities and management at The Ascent are top notch! I have had a wonderful experience living here for the past 5 months. It feels like I'm on vacation every day because of how beautiful the grounds are (saltwater pool, fitness center, business center, clubhouse, dog park, and car detail station). I will be recommending all of my friends!

The property alone is what caught my attention, but you are close to everything! The office staff, maintenance and vendors are very attentive and great to work with. They also take them time to do wonderful things for us residents. By far the best place to call home!

I was extremely unhappy due to the fact that my car got towed about 3 weeks ago in the middle of the night. I live in a two bedroom apartment, but was only given one parking space for two cars. I came home one Friday and ALL the visitor parking spaces were taken which is where I usually park the extra car. I had the option to pay an extra monthly fee for another parking space, but with the high cost of this apartment, I already felt like I was overpaying on rent so of course I did not opt for the extra parking space. Anyways, I went ahead and parked on the side of the street because I literally had nowhere else to park unless I were to illegally take someone else's parking space. My car got towed and I was told that cars are only towed by the request of the property.... So incredibly frustrating! I was late to work the next day and had to haggle with the towing company for extra 2 days, all of which would have never happened if Somerset Lakes didn't request for my car to be towed. This is just a way for Somerset Lakes to try to force me to buy a monthly carport for my extra vehicle which already is a ridiculous thing to have to do due to the lack of parking in a PRIVATE COMPLEX. This isn't Downtown Indy... I shouldn't have to be searching for 20 minutes for a parking space on the weekends. 

I wish to be reimbursed for this massive inconvenience, but based off other reviews I've seen here, it's doubtful that it'll happen and that I'll simply receive a "We apologize for the inconvenience" sort of response. I plan on posting on every source of information to ensure that people realize that the beautiful views and spacious homes are NOT worth the stress and tiring conversations over minor issues that Somerset Lakes won't assist with.

For Somerset Lakes: If you wish to resolve this issue, please offer a reimbursement and I'll gladly reconsider my opinion of the complex/management. However, if you simply wish to respond and say "I'm so sorry for your experience" without any impactful action on your part, then you can keep your hollow words to yourself.

The office staff needs to take a course in customer service because they are the absolute worse.  Work orders take forever to be completed and when you call to figure out why it's taking so long they give you the run around or never return your call.  I would never recommend this place based on how rude the front office staff is.

We have lived here for the past 2 years and love it for so many reasons! With the variety of models that are available, it was hard for us to choose which floor plan to go with, but they all give you a lot of space for your money. Open floor plans, huge closets, and back decks looking out onto the lake make this property unique and wonderful! The location of this property is also amazing. It takes 5 minutes to drive to the Fashion Mall, 5 minutes to the Glendale Mall, and 10 minutes to get to the heart of Broad Ripple. Another huge selling point is how dog friendly the neighborhood is. There are so many dog owners and the dog park is an ideal place for them to play, run around, and get their energy out. The pool and workout room are amenities we love and use all the time. The complex itself feels friendly and safe, with lights lining the streets when it's dark and the cop car that sits on various corners and keeps an eye out. The keypads on each building door also add an extra layer of security. The staff in the leasing office are amazing as well. When you need something repaired, they get a work order placed and someone is over to fix it in a timely manner. They are always friendly when you come in the office and are willing to help with anything. It seems that they are constantly thinking of ways to improve the property and make it better for th residents, which we've seen in the many improvements they have made over the years! We would definitely recommend these apartments to everyone!

I have lived in Somerset Lakes for almost a year now. I have always wanted to live here but, as a single women in school, financially I could not afford to live here. Now that I have a family and I have a new job, my boyfriend and I were excited to move here. Somerset was in the middle of renovations and we caught a 2bed 2bath with a den(w/d included) on special. Even without all the updates the apartment was nice. It was very spacious and perfect for our needs. 

After two months of living here, our monthly water bill almost doubled , our light bill was on average $275-$300, maintainece has entered our apartment without leaving a notice of being there, and it has taken maintenance up to 2 weeks to put in light bulbs. When they finally came in to address our issues they signed that the work was completed and it had not even been touched.  Recently our vehicle was towed because I parked on the curb. If I would have parked in someone's spot I would have been towed and the nearest free parking space was more than two buildings from where I live. I was not about to walk that far at 12 midnight and I shouldn't have to. Up until then we didn't have any issues with parking but that was the tip of the iceberg. 

Needless to say, we will not be renewing our lease. It is a beautiful property with nice amenities, but for us with 2 toddlers, it is not worth it.

This is a nice looking complex, but keep in mind there is insufficient parking for residents. In addition, in instituting their new parking policies, they did not clearly mark no parking areas and then had residents' vehicles towed in the middle of the night on a weekday, and refused to reimburse us for the cost. For as much as I am paying for these apartments, I should not have to deal with an apartment complex with no consideration for my livelihood and not enough places for a 2-car family to park. This was simply a ploy to force residents to purchase the "optional" carports at an extra monthly charge. Do not get lured by the cost of the rent; the add-ons may make another complex a much better option.

Somerset looks nice on the surface but there are a lot of problems. 

IPL Costs: 
The apartments are not well insulated and have cheap furnaces. So once winter rolls around, your energy bill will sky rocket even if you barely use the heater. We had ours set at 65 degrees and the bill was still $300 for that month.

Patio:
The patios are huge but once nighttime comes, you can expect spiders everywhere, bugs flying all around you, and plenty of mosquito bites. It would be a great patio though but it's just not usable.

Rooms:
The rooms are very large which is definitly nice, but they do not have over head lights for the most part, so be prepapred to have a light source for your room.

Management:
They are not always the best about fixing your problems. Sometimes they will be at your apartment within 24 hours of reporting your problem and other times we have messaged them numerous times a week only for no one to help us with our problem. They also just didn't fix the gate at the main entrance for several months, making the gate pointless. They have also charged us more for random things that they just don't tell us about and struggle to explain when we do call them out on it.

Overall:
The apartments are nice and very large. You can usually haggle your way to a cheaper price when first renting as well. Don't think I would live here again just because of the issues we ran into. It's not a terrible place by any means but these have been issues for us and have been a nuesance to deal with.
They were molded, they never fixed any thing, bad customer service. They had shootings and robberies weekly. I felt so unsafe living here. Management did nothing to help.

When we first moved in we were greeted by chipping paint, failing appliances, and an ineffective air conditioning unit. After that, it got worse. The office staff are unreachable and the maintenance crew can't solve any issues. The apartments have silverfish in the walls and the AC can't keep up with the summer heat. On top of that, they raise the already overpriced rent after 1 year by almost 10%. If you visit, talk to any of the residents and they will tell you just how bad it is. Don't trust the office staff or any of the employees.

I chose to live here because the rent is low, close to my job, i love Trader Joe’s, and seemed like a great area to live...WRONG! Do. Not. Move. Here. When we first saw our apartment before moving in, it was in the same crappy position when they were showing it...so I knew we were in trouble. Aside from poor management, the walls are thin! I could hear everything from neighbors. Children run rampant at night and the adults are no better. And parking is atrocious! Don’t try to have guests over, everyone who lives here claims their parking spot. I absolutely hated living here and my lease couldn’t have come any faster. I hate to be negative...but SpyGlass is horrific!

Avoid this area as much as possible, the residents are awful and the apartments are disgusting. I have never lived around more ruthless, selfish, and honestly terrifying people. Children especially should not be exposed to this kind of environment. These are not good people and the management is the same situation. This is a dangerous area, 3 vehicles have been hit by fireworks after the complex sent out a flyer explaining that fireworks are illegal in the complex. The complex sends these fliers but gives no consequence or number to call if there's an issue, police cannot do anything because it's a private property and no staff lives on site. There are numerous reasons to never come near this area, let alone live here. I could go on forever but i hope you understand the severity of what i am saying. DO NOT MOVE HERE!!!

I rate these apartments poor. Move in at your own risk. I resided at these apartment in 2014 and 2015. There was mold growing in one of my restroom most of my stay there due to a leak in the walls. I reported the mold several times and only once did they come out and check it out. They fixed the leak but nothing was done about the mold. One month later the leak begin again and mold continue growing. I ended up moving out. Also Spyglass Apartments and their Corporate office Flaherty and Collins are thieves and liars. I moved out and broke my lease because I bought a home. I communicated with the property managers the beginning of my search  for a home through the end. The policy is to pay 2 months of rents after the move date if you break your lease. I was okay with that and ready to make payment arrangements. On the day I moved out I gave the property manager a money order to go toward my final balance. The property manager didn't have the form available for me to sign up for the payment arrangements. The next business day I contact the property manager again but had to leave a message as she wasn't available. I left my phone number and new address with the office assistant so the property can contact me to sign the payment arrangement form. I never receive a call back or final letter informing me of my final balance. I called the next week and left another message. I still didn't get a call back. Next thing I know I was submitted to a collection agency. I called the apartments to find out why I was submitted. I was told I never came in to sign the payment arrangement form. I contacted the corporate office and was told there's nothing they can do I need to contact the collection agency. I also applied a payment toward my final balance the day I moved out and I showed interest that I am willing to make payments. The apartments set me up for failure. I never receive a phone call back or letter indicating my final balance and what I was charged for and with the $300 was applied, and I didn't receive the payment arrangement form. They lied and said I never reported my new address to them and they sent a letter to my last known address. I did a change of address with the post office I'm wondering why the letter was never forwarded to my new address. I continue to ask for a printout with my final balance, but the corporate office is not responding. Please be cautious about Spyglass apartments.

These apartments are great! Very family free environment.. I wish I could stay. My son made  a lot of friends here and I hate to see the change. We will come back soon . Love Spyglass Apartments. Great scenery and lake view. Lots of room for kids to play. They also have a great swim and tennis area. You cant help to feel nothing but relaxed while your here!

#1
This apartment CURRENTLY has roaches. I told the leasing office, their fix is to SPRAY pest control. The building needs to be bombed!! I’m afraid to even go in my kitchen and turn on the lights without them running out. Please save yourself the hassle of moving in here. Where there is one roach there is many!!!! You would think they would want to move swiftly to save an infestation.
#2
The apartment complex is not safe! If you stay long enough you will see. I’ve only been here two years and I am ready to go. There was a fatal shooting less than a couple months ago (look it up on the news) and police calls are constantly being made over the weekend. This has been my experience at the Aura, I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.
Quick and easy move in. Welcoming office staff just super busy and inattentive.

The Aura apartments opens the community with what used to be a high crime and/or bad “ideal” area. With the New Property management, they have given the community a new and improved look. As they offer modernized units, a clubhouse, pool, and dog park they have gave my family an upgrade to where we used to reside. The balcony and patio options that the units have, is my favorite feature! Along with the other residents, they all have been welcoming and very kind. Ms. Lorie in the office is extremely helpful and very kind.

I live in a premium top floor apartment. I love the space this apartment provides. The staff has undergone lots of changes and have overcame personal health problems so the effort to make sure the apartments are in good shape was made but due to low staffing, the effort wasn't enough. This apartment has had problem after problem but the staff has been great and accommodating and trying their best to meet our needs. This is one of the nice things about the community. Right now much needs improvement in regard to apartment upkeep and amenities (play ground has no swings). We are here a year so I look forward to the improvements they are trying to strive to implement.

Safe and secured neighborhood.
Spacious apartment and accessible location.
However, the traffic NOISE from 38th Street (close to my block) is a almost unbearable.
Beautiful layout. But nothing gets fixed when asked , the office is vary poor with communication and there is a roach problem.

After looking for several months for upscale living community, I am so happy I chose Quarry at River North for my next home.  Val and Lauren are incredibly helpful and cheerful, and John and Javier are prompt and attentive to maintenance requests (some within the hour of submitting, always within the same business day!).

If you want upscale living, amenities, security, and a friendly environment ... Quarry is perfect.

Before you move here, please, please consider another apartment complex. The management company will try their hardest to make everything seem absolutely perfect. ITS NOT. You will hear everything!! Your neighbors running through the hallways, people loudly stomping in their apartment, down the halls, and slamming of doors inside the homes. You can hear people's conversations outside of the apartment and in the hallways. There's absolutely no privacy. Move to the Quarry if you want fake smiles from management only to find out hours later that they've charged your account several $100s of dollars and threaten you with eviction if you don't pay the fees. Everything seems perfect during the tour until you actually move it. It's not, these apartments have been the most stressful thing ever. If you don't live on the fourth floor be prepared to hear your neighbors stomping above your head all day. Forget to pay anything and you'll be charged $70-$80 everyday that you don't pay on top of paying already high rent. These apartments are beyond overpriced, you can't park in the garage at all times even though there are plenty of empty parking spaces in there. You'll be charged huge amounts of fees if your car is found in the garage for even 30 minutes after 8:30AM. Look elsewhere if you want a peaceful home to live in for a year because you'll want to move out just as fast as you moved in. You're always being watched.

Water has cut off multiple times and the fire alarm has gone off over 5 times in the past 12 months...  The staff usually blames the tenants for these issues, but it’s really because this place is cheaply built.  They’ll also enter your apartment whenever they want with no warning.
Happy to have moved in here. After looking at multiple communities at the Keystone Crossing I have found my new home! So excited for all the resident events and wine nights.

The apartment is nice but overpriced in general. Then comes their water issues. A sewer line burst and flooded multiple people's apartments. Now they have not had running water for over 12 hours with no communication with residents.
I love the location here! The staff is friendly and responds to maintenance requests quickly. Very let friendly :)

Its been one month in Timbers, Apartments are nice and management is good. However , there are issues with the design of the patios as they are not completely covered , so if people staying above waters plants or does gardening, stuff comes down and falls on you. I'm thinking of buying a beach ? just for my patio. Also you don't need subwoofers for entertainment system, you get that by default by all sorts of noises coming through the wall and ceiling.

I'll see how things go and edit my review at a later point in time.

I’m very impressed with Timbers! From the moment I drove into the apartments very clean and stylish!! To talking with the staff answering all of my questions and went over and beyond all expectations! Tiffany in the office was just outstanding!! The apartments alone are beautiful and affordable!! Over all best experience looking for an apartment!!
Taylor in the front office is so incredibly helpful and kind! The apartments are beautiful and the location is perfect for my family! Easy commute to work and lots of great places to eat in the area!

The staff is great, the women in the office are extremely helpful and friendly. The maintenance staff is fast and efficient. Great amenities include pool, grills, outdoor fireplace, workout facilities. Close to everything.Costco next door.  Kroger and Walmart less than a mile away. Bars and restaurants are even closer. Greenwood mall 2 miles away. I’ve been here for 3 months and I love it here.

The apartments are super nice. The manager, Tiffany was very nice and knowledgeable about the apartment community. She answered every question we had for her. We would recommend any friends or family to come here if they were looking for housing.

The apartments are nice BUT there is a HUGE parking issue!! I work evenings/nights and get home at all hours and there is never any parking available anywhere near my apartment. Their response was to find parking at the front of the complex and walk all the way back to mine or to purchase a garage. I already pay for a garage (I live with another person) and I am not paying for another on top of the already high end rent. They are not looking to fix this issue either!!

Ever since the management company changed , this place is no longer nice to live in. The previous company and manager were awesome. However new company took over in June 2023 and they’re all about money. Our trash/water/seer charge went up from 26$ to 75$. Also, in your resident portal you can see what amount is due. We’ve been paying the exact amount that shows in there, thinking all bills paid. Right? WRONG! Few days after rent is paid, you’ll have a past due balance of something ridiculous. I have checked all the charges and it certainly seems like everyone is getting charged twice for the water/trash/sewer. So that’s an extra 200$ on top of your base rent.
The pool opened up a month later instead of Memorial Day. I wonder if they will keep it longer at all.
This is not what I signed in my lease. I cannot wait to move from here.
Please do not move here unless you like getting surprised charges every month.

This apartment complex is great. They are very attentive on everything that they do. Maintenance does all maintenance within 24 hours which is great. The neighbors are wonderful very friendly kid friendly pet friendly could not ask for more with apartment living.
Just about every problem you can have comes from here. Do yourself a favor and stay away.

They recently 'sprayed' for roaches. All it did was bring in more and make the gnats more aggressive. The apartment has no insulation from outside. Bugs crawling from under the walls and windows. Its going on three weeks and no one has called us back about our complaints.
Very nice people and safe place to stay! Great school district (Decatur Township). I would recommend to everyone. #92

Aspen Pointe offers a clean and safe place to stay on the outskirts of Indy. The location is amazing. You are close to anywhere you’d want to go. The staff is pretty amazing too. They are very friendly, honest, and responsive. I haven’t had many issues, but the little ones that did occur were taken care of immediately. I’d recommend these apartments to anyone. 

Rm ~ 66

I thought the roaches were bad enough, but rats too?!I have been awoken from a sound sleep with 1 roach crawling on my face, another time crawling on my arm, and yet another one found crawling in my bed sheets. I am a very trusting person. When they told me they were going to do something, SILLY ME!*

This property has nice amenity, but is terribly managed. 

Matt and Jasmine used to be great, however, management changed since Jan 2019 and everything went downhill. The new management started with terrible communications in the beginning, leaving residents confused. The auto payment had problems during the transition, but was later fixed. 

This place has serious safety concerns - there has been bikes stolen from storage room, cars broken into in the parking garage, and my own car stolen from the parking garage (you read that right). While it's not entirely the property's fault that those things happened, the way they handled it was just awful and totally lacking sympathy. Here's a response I got from the leasing office manager after voicing my concern ard safety: "While we know that you pay for a garage space, the space you pay for is advertised from our end as covered parking. Crime has no address, and we do not promote as being able to prevent crime." I was very disappointed abt the way things were handled. 

On daily issues, response is very slow and ever since I sent in lease ending notification, my call was never picked up. The last straw was after I moved out, they sent me a bill claiming that the valet trash can wasn't left in the room, when it clearly was. I'm going to dispute the charge, but it just feels they try every way to make residents' life miserable. 

There's some rent promotion going on. After my personal experience w. this property, I wouldn't live there even it was for free.

This place looks great from the outside, but is one of the most poorly ran apartments I have ever lived in. 

1. They claim the building is secure, but it’s not. If you’re accessing the building from the first floor doors or lobby you need a key pass to get in. Whoever designed the building decided you don’t need a keypass to get onto the first floor from the garage.. which would be fine if you needed a keypass to get in the garage, but you don’t. You can easily push a button on the garage door entrance to get a “ticket” and gain access to the garage which gives you access to the building without any keys needed. It also leaves all vehicles exposed as the garage is accessible by anyone by simply pushing a button for a ticket. 

2. The parking garage is located underneath the building and has VERY steep ramps leading down to the parking garage door. EVERY SINGLE YEAR, during winter, they don’t salt the ramps so people slide down the ramp and go straight through the garage door.  To add icing on the cake, they will attempt to make you use your own insurance to cover the damages caused by their negligence. Once the door is damaged, they just leave the garage doors open for weeks at a time, allowing anyone access to your vehicles and also to your residence. No keypass needed. 

3. I had a neighbor who constantly smoked cigarettes in his apartment, blared music, stunk up the entire floor, and they never did a single thing about it. I complained 5  times about him dancing in the alleyway shirtless while listening to EDM at 7am and other super weird, eccentric encounters and nothing was ever done.

4. The parking garage underneath leaks calcium deposits from all the water / rain coming from the pool / common area upstairs going through the concrete. There are a TON of spots in the garage where if you park, your paint will get RUINED by these calcium deposits. Management, to this day and to my knowledge, has never addressed this issue, put out cones, or let any residents know about the possibility of having your paint job completely ruined by their garage. There are actual stalagmites growing from the floor in some places, you can’t make this up. 

Save your money and go somewhere else, I got out of there as fast as I could.

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: Been here for way too long they nickel and dime you for everything. Do not move here they made it look a bit better but the service and quality  coming from that front office is trash.  Ready to move away !

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: Let me just start with Nicole is a joke. She has no idea how to run a property.. so unorganized.. unprofessional.. I am so glad I finally decided to leave in June .. I was fed up with not being informed in why I needed to have my apartment accessible for days on end for numberous inspections and a lot of time with no notice.  Then we have dumb and dumber working in maintenance.. they can’t even screw in a light bulb (no joke) I guess you get what you pay for ? If you want to live in a halfway decent area but feel like you are in the slums then move here!!

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: I have been here for 4 years.. only stayed for convienence and I did not want to move.  But the experience has been awful once the current manager took over. I admit the previous staff could be unprofessional at times but, I have never been afraid to call maintenance if I had an issue but , now it’s like if I ask for anything it’s a big inconvenience. I pay my rent every month on time no issues and this is stupid. Any time you ask the office a question they get super defensive and reflect. I am ready to move when my lease is up and honestly since they have an “asset management” company now owning them .. i am having my attorney look at any way out of the rest of my lease..

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: so I sent to rent the apt i was declined so when I went to cash my $125 walmart couldnt cash it because the leasing constulant defaced the money order with a pencil eraser cause she told me to write out the mo in pencil. so now I need to send $125 mo to Corp and wait 30 to 60 days for my money to be return.

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: Great place to live as I have been living here for 9 years.

apartmentName: The Elliott at College Park Apartment Homes
review: close your eyes and dream of a quiet home, 710 square feet where the bedroom has separate closets, great neighbors, community pool parties and cook outs -- bingo where the winner gets 100.00 off the rent - property managers who are so easy to talk to and understanding, pet friendly, tanning bed, work out area, within walking distance from shopping and restaurants.  where are you you ask?   THIS IS VILLA NOVA!!!!!

I have lived here for 3 yrs now and have loved it...however this "new" look they are doing is horrible, very cheep and cheesy looking.  I like the black patio/balcony with the brick very classy look but to paint over it with white brings down the property value so much.

Very Bad Decision

We have been at Crooked Creek for 2 years now.  We love our apartment and the area. Management has always been helpful, prompt and friendly! We like the location, it feels safe and like you can relax while still being close to everything we need.

I been in my first floor apartment about six months, and already regret moving in. The apartment itself is nice and the area in general is quite. However, the water pipes bang very loud (like a hammer is hitting it) and even woke me up a few times at 2am and 3am. The worst part are the upstairs neighbors. You hear ever step very loudly, and there is a loud vibration noise in the living room when they walk. Constantly it sounds like they are dropping bowling balls. I enjoy some peace, but that only existed about 4 days in six months when no one was home above. For the first three months, the noise would continue till about 2am-3am. Management finally talk with the residents about the late night noise, and at least now it usually quiets down around 9pm. But I know it will be very noisy between 7am and 9pm. If you move in, I recommend only considering top floor units. Besides all the noise from above, the complex is nice.

I was so thrilled to find the loft apartments at Crooked Creek.  I am extremely picky when it comes to apartments, and it was starting to look like I would not find anything to meet my "standards" when it came time to move to Indy for my new job.  The only thing I didn't like was that they wouldn't let me see the inside of an apartment for a couple of months because they were all occupied (which is probably in accordance with the law); but I was in a situation where I could wait and commute long-distance for a while, and boy was it worth the wait!!  The apartment I got was spectacularly clean and despite being "small" by square-footage standards, it was the perfect dimensions to hold my humongous sectional couch, swivel chair, 8-seat dining table, queen platform bed, full-size futon, desk, 2 large TV's with stands (one upstairs and one downstairs), plus tons of cabinet space in the kitchen for all my pots & pans and 2 large closets that held a ton of clothes and all my big musical instruments (cello, violin & 2 guitars). The best thing though was the perfect little alcove under the upstairs vanity for the cats' litter box.  And it met all my other standards:  open spiral staircase, huge loft bedroom with balcony, fireplace, patio & large outdoor storage shed, right next to a pond, plus they even let me plow up the area between my apartment and the pond and plant a fenced-in garden.  I only had two water-related maintenance issues while I lived there and someone came to fix the problems both times ASAP.  The neighbors were all very friendly too (though the guy a couple doors down liked to listen to his rap music rather loudly... but that is pretty much ubiquitous to all apartment complexes and society in general, sigh).  I would've liked to have had one of the covered parking spaces but I was not able to get one in the 1.5yrs that I lived there.  The maintenance was only good about getting snow out of your way if you worked regular hours... but having to get to work by 6am, I was usually left shoveling/salting my car out on my own.  No big deal for the wonderful experience I had.  I only left because I got married and moved out to the boonies... but I still miss my little loft at Crooked Creek!  I would give this place the highest recommendation possible to anyone moving to the area! You will not be disappointed.

I and family lived at crooked creek for almost two years.sankes started showing up in the house we  lived we told them and they said  is not their problem and we should called pet control.
Another incident occurred we our AC we called them to come fix it and they said they will not  do anything until the next business day which was Monday so the whole of Friday night me and family get to be sleeping in the heat.so we put our notices in to move.
Very Classy nice minimum of complaints nice prices.

I lived here for 2 years and the moment I renewed for year 2, I regretted it. Area’s crime skyrocketed and felt so unsafe. If someone in your building smoked weed & got tipped to staff, oh don’t worry, they’ll slap on eviction warnings to every. single. door. No matter if you’re clear on the opposite end. Also don’t bother deep cleaning and repairing everything upon move-out, they’ll slap on every cost possible & charge a full cleaning fee no matter if you got every dust particle.

The neighborhood has definitely gotten sketchier. Not sure if they are renting to more questionable folks or what the issue is. Maintenance crew was the best thing about the place. Leasing stuff is entirely unhelpful in solving any issues within the property. You WILL NOT be getting your security deposit back. They aggressively gouge you for silly things like hundreds of dollars for the butter cover door in the fridge and malfunctioning blinds. Just absurd costs that have no bearing in reality. Unless you’re prepared to forfeit your security deposit plus some more, move on from this one.

I read through some of the other reviews to see if I was the only one having some issues, and sure enough, I wasn't. The maintenance staff is great. Haven't had too much trouble with the front office staff. The issue, in my opinion, has been Ardizzone (sp?) Group - the managing company that took over of the property approx 2 years ago. Since then, it just doesn't feel like home. If you like to be treated like you live in a halfway house, this place is for you! I've had multiple letters stating whomever is smoking Marijuana in the apartment needs to stop or there will be consequences. While it isn't me, is that really the way to go about it? And you'll just love to see your money literally being thrown away. They replaced my beautiful wooden deck with a new painted one. Now my deck is peeling paint, has rusted screws everywhere, and the boards are warped and sticking up. I put in a service request, but they keep track of how many requests you have/how many days you've lived there, so I'm afraid to get too many things fixed or they just may charge me. They just installed thousands of dollars worth of rocks where there used to be wild growth and flowers, probably for the last 60+ years this place has been here. I'm guessing so that come renewal time, they can point at all the 'upgrades' they made. It's a relatively quiet place, and safe for the most part. Did have my catalytic converter stolen last Summer. So, overall, it's nice - just hope to God you don't need to ever deal with the property management group or I promise you'll be SOL and they will not work with you.

Harbour Pointe has been great so far. My boyfriend and I moved in in July of this year and haven't had any issues. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful and is kept up really well. The location is great too- 15 minutes from downtown with a trail across the street to exercise and/or walk your pet. Maintenance has responded to both our requests on the same day we placed them and have been very nice and easy to work with. The units are beautiful and spacious. I would definitely renew my lease here at HP!

Harbor pointe is my first ever apartment and I love it . Most people mind there’s business(not the lady below obviously) but it’s a quite slow neighborhood. maintenance has never been a issue. Straight up the dish washers don’t work but besides that (and a robbery across the street from me and my car) nice neighborhood ????

Don't choose this complex if you want your apartment and the surrounding areas to smell like weed literally 24/7. When the A/C and heat turn on, the smell is amplified. Also, if you want to see your neighbors smoking marijuana on their patios freely and management says nothing about it.

Maintenance walks into your apartment without letting you know prior. They also ask you to put up your pets, even though they are the ones coming to your home unannounced.... They also don't know how to properly read the trouble ticket. There was a trouble ticket placed by apartment 3104A and they came to a whole different building and apartment....

1. This complex says "dog friendly" but they only mean dog friendly if your dog is less than 50 pounds. 2. This complex and the majority of its residents only treat you the "dog friendly" way if your dog doesn't look like a pitbull, boxer, or labradors. 3. This complex blames certain pet owners for OTHER pet owners not picking up their pet's poop. 4. Even when you try to defend that you pick up your pet's poop every single time, the complex believes the people blaming you so they can charge you money. 5. There is nothing in the lease or pet lease that says you can get fined for pet potty mistakes, but the complex charges you what ever amount they want to anyway & says you have to pay. (when legally, you do not). 6. This complex lets its residents smoke weed and be as loud as they want throughout all hours, but won't believe you when you say your dog only poops in one spot and it's cleaned every time. 7. This complex lets unauthorized pets in and lets people who don't pay pet deposits and pet rent have pets, but doesn't believe the residents the first time they are blamed for something.

Harbour Pointe was great when I moved in three years ago, but everything has been going downhill since the new management took over. My rent has been raised $100 both my last lease and the new renewal rate they just sent me for the upcoming 2021. I had been asking them for over six months about the rate and if it would go up and they told me that they couldn’t tell me. Then last week, Jessica told me she would have my renewal letter to me on that same day she emailed me back. I did not receive it until a week later. When I received it, they raised my rent $100 and are giving me only a week to accept the offer when my lease doesn’t even end until February.They also said in the letter that they will automatically renew my lease to a month-to-month (which is my current rate plus $200 or the market rate for my style of apartment plus $200). The reason I even signed a new lease is because I was told my apartment would be renovated, but it has been a year and not one renovation has occurred. They have absolutely no sympathy for residents during a pandemic. Their office workers are lazy and take forever to respond or just don’t respond. This has honestly been the worse. Old management and Sylvia were great and on top of everything. It really is a shame to see what this complex has become.

I'm moving out when my lease is up after 4 happy years living here. I was recommended this place by a few different past residents, and they were right. It's great if you don't have a big budget and you want to be very close to downtown.

Pros: Management is really fabulous, personable, and kind. I can think of maybe twice that I called in a maintenance request and it fell through the cracks somehow, and they immediately corrected it and sent someone right out. Really, most of my requests have been handled same-day, and I've needed to use emergency maintenance twice and they came right through. The maintenance guys are all very nice, and almost always respond to a work order same day, unless you call it in in the afternoon or they're super slammed. In four years, I've only had an increase of $5 in rent. They very rarely need to enter the apartment for inspections or anything, and always give you a written warning -- they've even called me before because they know I don't always check my mailbox daily, and told me to check my mail! My first winter here, we had an awful snow/ice storm that absolutely buried all the non-carport parked cars. All of the maintenance crew were on hand bright and early to shovel and push cars out for the morning commute, mine included. Just really nice people, consistently so.

Cons: It's a complex built in the 70s right by the fairgrounds. The apartments are a little rickety, the neighborhood isn't great. You'll hear trains and ambulances in the middle of the night sometimes. You'll probably be driving up to Castleton or Broadripple for groceries, restaurants, and entertainment (like 15 minutes either way). For the square footage and price, it's a good deal, but if you're not comfortable with the location or bare bones 70s-ness of it all, it's probably not going to be worth it for you. 

Your mileage may vary depending on your needs, but I think the people working here are really lovely, nice people.

The apartments are old which is why the value is great because you're not paying for the costs of renovations. If you're looking for extremely gorgeous apartments look elsewhere. However if you're looking for basic necessities and a decent amount of space this place is for you. You're not going to find any other apartments with washers and dryers in the unit for this price which honestly is my biggest selling point. 

Being just across Fall Creak the apartments seem isolated from the crime further south. I've lived here for about two years now without a single issue regarding my car or apartment. Most of the buildings are relatively quiet without any bad neighbors. I've lived in two buildings since being here after switching to a two bedroom and I have also have had a couple other friends live in different buildings. 

The maintenance team is extremely nice and if you have pets most of them do as well so their patient with dogs. 

I really can't justify moving anywhere else unless you're wanting to be closer to some of the more expensive areas.

I have lived at Harbour Pointe Apartments for about 8 months and it has been a disappointment. I read the same reviews below and thought that this would be a great place to live but as you can see most of the reviews are from years ago nothing for 2017. The scenery and landscaping of the apartment complex is indeed BEAUTIFUL  and the apartments themselves are pretty quiet but that's about it. The apartments are very old, built decades ago, I believe in the 1970s and you can tell. Everything in the apartment is outdated, constantly breaking, counter-tops sloping, doors and locks not working and the managers solution to these problems is " NOTHING". Their response is, " the apartments are old and they can no longer find service providers to fix the outdated structure and they will not be compensating for any suffering or discomfort either". The maintenance team and the management do not respond to verbal work orders. It could be a full month of consistently calling the front office and they still will not come. The only way to get them to fix anything is to get a lawyer to draft up a written request and somehow they find all the time in the world to come poorly fill the requests. Also the price is no longer what it was in 2016. They have gone up like the majority of the Indianapolis market, $700.00 and up, along with all their little fees and trust me its not worth it. You are on 38 keystone basically, where the crime rate has steadily risen with no sign of a decline in sight. I hear police sirens at least 3x week and there seems to be some shady characters hiding out by the trash bins at night. My neighbors who have been here for over 10yrs are now deciding not to renew their lease for 2018. People have been running out of here left and right. Also, you cannot rent out the clubhouse, so when you go in, don't let the fancy clubhouse be a selling point for you because you will not be able to use it. With this being said, although the landscaping is nice and the apartments are quiet,  for the price of the unit, the lack of action to fix work orders and fix them properly ( I have had to call about certain things more than 3x after they apparently had been fixed), and the overall age of the unit, I will be looking else where to live when my lease is up.

First the rent for size is great especially when you consider water and gas heat are free.  Could use more utility style closet space as the water heater, washer and dryer, and blower/furnace units take up anything that was there, but the living/dining area is open, the bedrooms are large, we usually don't hear a lot from the neighbors, and maintenance is quick with most things especially smaller ones.  I've been here almost 2 years and the only real complaint I'd give is the traffic since coming from downtown has to deal with either I-70, Keystone, or Fall Creek and they're all a PITA come rush-hour.

I finally received peace when I move  into my first new apartment . As a recent graduate of IU. I was searching all over to find the best place for me. I found it here in a hidden spot. A spot of peace and comfort but it's always great to have a place you can call home

I love my apartment!!  Staff is very helpful and the grounds are taken care of completely.  It's close to grocery store, gas station, movie theater, shopping and many restaurants. There is a large pool w/lounge chairs & a large club house.  I'm retired and live alone, so it's perfect for me.  It's an amazing place to live!!  

My daughter lived with me until she passed away from cancer!   Miss her so much!

I have not lived in an apartment for 30 yrs, but this is the 1st time I have known the owners and management to have a Christmas party. There also was food, refreshments and great prizes/gifts. Thank you to management and staff. I enjoyed and appreciated.

Lived here for a little over a year, the property is very beautiful and easy to navigate.
The fiber internet that the property provides is very high quality and affordable.
It is very quiet, and the noise level is at a minimum (considering how busy the road is)
Very close to downtown ~ 10 mins traffic depending.
The maintenance staff are very helpful and quick to respond, and the property manager is very nice and quick to respond as well.
The only gripe I have is the crime level that is associated with this area, and the amount of break-ins that happened even inside the gated parking.
But, this is no fault to the property at all, and I could see this decreasing in the years to come.
Overall, a good property and I would highly recommend it.

I have been living here for just over half a year and have to say that it has been a pretty good experience. My roommate and I moved from downtown when our previous apartment management took a downturn and we no longer wanted to stay. Matt and the maintenance crew have always been extremely helpful and accommodating. We have never had to wait very long for any requested maintenance, including having our outlets swapped out.

Affordable, basic updates and close to everything. There is no padding under the carpet so it's very squeaky and it's easy to hear upstairs neighbors walking around. The front doors need to be redone. There is lots of space all around the door and almost half an inch under the door making it very noisy when people come in and out of the small hallway. The walls are a bit thin so you can hear people talking sometimes, especially if they are loud or having a party. I hope they invest more and do some soundproofing updates. 

A lot of college students in the complex so there are 2-3 parties a week, especially on holidays. People will not complain too much about the student parties but you will get noise complaints about dogs that do the average amount of barking. Therefore, it is better to have a dog that does not bark very much (like more than 1 minute). There are dog bags and a decent size bark park. 

Overall not too bad if you get get neighbors and you take measures to soundproof you door.

Nice staff and property well maintained, but the apartments are old and have paper thin walls. You can hear your neighbors conversations and the music they are playing. If you are seeking a place to live in peace and quiet, look elsewhere.
My townhouse has a ton of room and is incredibly close to everything in Indy- easy to get downtown or to Fountain Square and the staff id very friendly.
Archie is a very knowledgeable guy and loves his job and gets it done right the first time if he can and will let you know if he needs to order any parts

Archie and Tony worked together to remove my old water heater and install a new water heater. They were very cautious to work quietly as I work from my home office. They went above and beyond to answer any questions I had. They were sure to clean up after themselves and even checked back in to assure the water remained hot. 5 Star work for sure.

Lived here since 2021 and since IRTLiving took over the place has become a slum.

Cracks everywhere in the apartment, but office won't spend any money to fix them. 

A window is without a latch, and "locked" closed by a piece of wood inside of it, and It's been almost a month and a half with no word on it getting fixed besides "We're getting approval from corporate." 

Floors creaks wildly in the upstairs and stairway, like Scooby Doo haunted house stereotypical creaking, and a month and nine days I was told "We have approval to work on the floor" but nothing since.

The front office staff are rude or ignore you, don't expect anyone to pick up the phone after 3:30.
The higher tier staff are really nice, but have no authority to do anything. Any question you ask they'll have to ask corporate and they'll come back with "Oh, sorry, it's not in our policy."

Corp offices ignore renters

Most recently the policy has been changed to "help" renters by no longer allowing paying partial rent, so if you have a roommate one of you'll have to send your half to them so they can pay it in its entirety. This also means you cannot partially pay it throughout the month.

Other Maintenance requests are slow to show to be worked on.
