The maints guys are good people, but the whole place is falling apart and the office doesn't want to cut into profits by hiring more maint staff or do any sort of preventative maintenance besides making the outside of the buildings  look halfway decent.

Their electronic system will charge you first and ask questions and refund later. Moving from one apartment at the end of your lease to another is in the system a "transfer" so it will automatically charge you the transfer fee of (I believe) $400, which you'll need to bring up with one of the office staff for them to then be confused over, ask each other about, then finally remove from your charges as an "oh sorry, it does it automatically." This is no the only instance of the system just charging you for stuff it thinks you owe.

You are required to pay $45 each month for valet trash removal, no matter how close to the open-air dumpsters your apartment is, and no matter if you'd rather do trash yourself. You cannot avoid it, as it's "not policy". The people who pick up the trash will arrive anywhere from 5PM to midnight, or just may not show up at all and skip your apartment. 

AveryPoint and IRTLiving exist to squeeze every cent out of you while doing the absolute bare minimum to fix anything.
This place is the worst! Do not rent here! maintenance here is a joke!
I would recommend the apartment community because it's a peaceful clean community with a great location for businesses in the area

If you love living with noise and drugs, this is the perfect place for you.  Oh, and every car that comes in and out of the neighborhood playing super loud bass heavy music 24/7.  You hear it about every 10 to 15 minutes. Most of the people that live in this neighborhood have zero pride or respect for where they live or for the fact that we all share the area.  They treat it like they're own private area with no regard for anyone else around them. Weekends are especially bad.  

I've been here just 4 months and have have maybe 2 or 3 peaceful days and nights. I've been so sleep deprived that I have had days I cannot function. I have even checked into a hotel twice just to get some temporary relief and get myself together. Not a day goes by that I don't consider just breaking my lease early.  Don't put yourself through the hell I've been though.

360 Market Square is a pleasant and welcoming apartment community that offers a comfortable living experience. The location is convenient, with easy access to shopping centers, restaurants, and public transportation. The complex is well-maintained, featuring clean, landscaped grounds and ample parking spaces.

As one of the nicest properties in Indianapolis, I was excited about moving to these apartments. 

After living there for 4 months, I was unable to continue.  There was an overwhelming amount of unpleasant interactions with some office and apartment staff and weird interactions with apartment residents-  regarding experiences at the dog park. 

The hard water in the apartments coated the dishwasher in a film and the sink was hard to keep clean as well. The apartment then charged me for a new kitchen sink because of the hard water. 

Overall, if you are looking for a nice place to live with your dogs, finding a single family home is really going to be a better solution. Learn from my mistakes and save your lease cancellation  money by choosing another residence.

apartmentName: Lakeside Crossing at Eagle Creek Apartment...
review: These Apartments are completely awesome! Quiet and mature living. Management and Maintenance staff are A1. Great place to live!

apartmentName: Lakeside Crossing at Eagle Creek Apartment...
review: For that side of Indy I definitely recommend Wind Drift. A new bike/jogging trail was just constructed in the summer of 2015 and you can get to eagle creek reservoir really easily that way. If you have questions of it being unsafe because it's off of 38th street that is reasonable but there is nothing that is not safe about Wind Drift. I found it to be a really good value compared to other complexes on the west side with easy access to 465 because others were either a lot more expensive or were crime riddled. Maintenance was kept up with well when I lived there and the office staff are really friendly as well. My unit was clean when I moved in and I had no re-occurring issues with anything there.

Definitely trash apartments from front to back move people in without telling them that it’s roaches I’m just so disgusted maintenance is trash don’t fix anything ignoring your request they should be ashamed of they self. This whole apartment needs fixed ugh

We were shown a 3 bedroom dump with permanently frosted windows, broken cabinets,metal shutter closet doors and the apartment was filthy from front to back. We chose not to live there and are now trying to get our $250 deposit back. Told that it's going to take 45 days to get that back. Management who handles the refunds wasn't in for the last two days. Giving me and my daughter the run around. Be very careful with these people and ask if the previous tenant had bed bugs bc they fumigated for something but it didn't kill the roaches. Saw those too.

I have been living out here since March of 2016. With the new management and ownership that place has done a complete 360. Office staff is very professional and maintenance is always quick to fix any issues I have. We finally have the heated year round indoor pool and brand new basket ball court! They are building a playground, dog park, and grilling area this summer! I am just thrilled to sit back on my brand new patio and watch all the exciting changes! I highly reccommed coming and checking everything out yourself!
These apartments are unsafe. Because of all the duck poo in side the building i know its unsanitary. There is so much viloence in in these apartments and the maintance sucks.

I've been living in Indianapolis and by extension Murphy's Landing for about 7 months now and here's my impression of everything so far. 

I've found Murphy's Landing is not a bad place to live. It's within walking distance to everything you'd need and a short drive away from everything else. There's workout equipment that you can use but it's not really a full size gym. If you're a beginner it'll do but if you're a hard core exerciser keep your membership. The good thing is you can access it 24/7/365 so that's nice. The area is very family friendly. There's a small outdoor play area for kids and an outdoor pool. 

The area itself is relatively safe. Obviously there's no such thing as 100% security but it's not like bullets are flying past my window on a daily basis. It's a little far from the city I guess but that's only what I've been told. I'm from a rural area so my idea of the boonies is different than people who live in big city like Indy. 

The staff is friendly and willing to work with you with whatever issue you have. The only thing is maintenance is slow. Unless it's something they think will harm the building it'll be a low priority. Just keep on them and eventually they'll fix it just to shut you up. 

While you do get some amenities I think the rent is a little high for not giving much in return. If they lowered rent by about $100 I would give this place an A but instead I'd give this place about a B.

I really wanted to like this apartment. It is in a good location, close to plenty of shopping and restaurants and close to several interstates. The apartment does have a decent layout, though the living room, kitchen, and dining area are very small. There is a decent size laundry room and I do like the bedrooms, each of which is a suite with full bathroom and walk-in closet. Though maintenance issues are taken care of quickly, there have been far too many maintenance issues and we have only been here 2 months. The playground is nice for the apartments, but the pool is quite small.  There is also not enough parking so that some days I have to park far away. There are garages for rent, but there aren't enough of them either so our garage is a couple buildings away from us. Overall, it's just a so-so place to live and next year we will be moving.

I lived at River Ridge for 30 weeks. During that time, I submitted 21 maintenance requests. 

Our biggest issue and concern was ants. I submitted the first maintenance request for ants on April 2, and we were still dealing with ants when we moved out on June 23, around two and a half months later. It does not take that long to get rid of ants. Having ants in the kitchen is disgusting as that is where we prepare food and our food is stored. We had to throw out quite a bit of food that ants had gotten into, which is very frustrating. And, as we continued to clean the windowsills and floors, we kept finding live and dead ants. It is completely disgusting and also a health hazard. I submitted a maintenance request on Monday, 5/28 (after several previous requests), and in that case, no one came to my apartment until 6/8 (and that was the first time an actual exterminator came - over two months after the issue started). I am just astonished at how this situation has been handled and how ants in my kitchen wasn't taken more seriously to get resolved, especially when the issue started because they spread untreated mulch outside buildings, so it wasn't our fault.

River Ridge Apartments offers a luxurious gated community nestled away from noisy roads yet within close proximity to two major shopping districts! From your very own spacious garage and balcony, to stainless steel appliances in an updated open-concept kitchen with granite counter tops, and a walk-in closet that's a must see, you'll never want to settle for any other apartment ever again! Finally, an apartment complex that takes care of their residents like family!

Apartments are great and affordable with modern updates and appliances.  Constant maintenance workers to help with any problems on call or within 24 hours. Friendly staff-- when I forgot my key at work they lent me another so I didn't have to go all the way back to work! Walking distance to a couple of great bars and chipotle! Can't say enough good things!

The open floor plan makes you feel like you have more square footage than it really is. The complex feels very safe because it is a gated community. I have felt very comfortable in my apartment and it really feels like home!

I've lived at River Ridge for a year.  The best apartment I've ever lived in, albeit a little pricey.  Facing the back of a restaurant was annoying initially with trash trucks sometimes emptying dumpster in the middle of the night, but I've gotten used to that.  Office staff and maintenance are great.  They plan events for residents every month, usually at a nearby restaurant with free appetizers and/or pizza.  Parking has been a pain lately with very few empty apartments.  Getting back later in the evening can result in having to park a building or two away, maybe further.  Still a great place to live, but I will be moving shortly to a little cheaper apartment.
They are very friendly as a staff.  Very convienant to local shops and restaurants.  I like the set up of my apartment and like how has a pool and a nice work out facility.

Great move in experience but... I've had a great move in experience but was sent emails about being late on payments even after paying rent in full.

Never had an apartment complex that didn't send you an email receipt after depositing a check which is why i feel I was sent that message.

Other than that, it's been a great experience so far

Catalytic converters ripped off of my car right outside my apartment. Multiple other cars stripped as well. Dingy stinky water at one point. Contacted the office about both incidents multiple times with no response. No response to anything. But rising service charges for no service being done. Suspicious activity outside every night and no security. Do not live here if you value your health or safety.

When signing our lease it was never made clear that six months into our stay there would be a mandatory internet provider switch. That was one of the many hidden charges in our lease that was never brought to light. (we pay a mysterious $15 'activation fee' charge every month as one example). When it came time to switch we we're charged $180 dollars for the cancellation fee, the complexes way of reimbursing us is to deduct the new internet providers cost from our bill, monthly, until balanced. Which is absolutely ridiculous considering we have to pay $180 upfront for something we never wanted or were even told about originally! It's absolutely insane, the complete lack of care for residents here is astounding. Truly this place only cares to turn a profit now and the person who signs your lease probably wont be here after a couple months.

Stay away.

Management is by far the worst I have ever dealt with. During covid all amenities were closed (of course) except to the owners who allowed their tennis pro to have massive classes in our facilities. That was just one of the many examples of the care for residents.

It used to be great when we first moved in a few years ago, but it's gone downhill the past year or two. No one answers the phone, so you have to go over to the office to ask questions, if you can get there before they close. Even then, they'll just take your name and number, say they'll "look into it", never do and never call you back. We went over 5 different times for the same problem and it was still never resolved. There is now, also a revolving door of staff. They charge things that shouldn't be on the bill. They're renovating the place, which I thought would be great. But no, it's just been an excuse to come into our apartment 1-5 times a month. We have an elderly dog and hes going to have a heart attack with all this chaos and stress they've put us through. Not worth it! This will definitely be our last year here.

I have lived here from  2015 to present. January 2019 this complex was bought by Binge & Held. This new company has been a revolving door of management, takes multiple requests to get a single thing fixed (sent two in electronically and after two weeks decided to go in and demand repairs in person). Raised rates for less service. Before 2019 I would have recommended this place to anybody. Now I will tell everybody to steer clear of this place. They don't do what they say they're gonna do.

The apartment itself is okay. It looks nice at first glance but there are little issues you wouldn’t notice right away. Not much lighting at all and outlets are no good. The management is a real issue. They never answer the phone and rarely call back. They may have gotten a new manager which may have helped but it’s ridiculous when an email doesn’t get a response for a whole month.
I, HAVE ENJOYED LIVING HERE NICE SPACIOUS ROOMS AND IN A GOOD LOCATION. GOOD SCHOOLS

My apt. is a wheelchair accessible unit. They are extremely difficult to find. This is converted. There is NO governmental help available! I can't afford all the bills on Social Security. Even though I get Food Stamps, it still isn't enough. They are going to evict me. Being disabled with a beloved cat, what am I to do?.......HELP ME

I, HAVE LIVED HERE SINCE 1998 . I, HAVE LOVED LIVING HERE BECAUSE OF THE APT. SIZE . IT IS A GOOD PLACE TO LIVE .THERE HAVE BEEN A FEW PROBLEMS ,BUT MANAGEMENT TAKE CARE OF IT RIGHT AWAY. THE OFFICE STAFF ARE FRIENDLY AND RESPECTFUL..I, WILL MAKE THIS MY HOME AS LONG AS I CAN. RENT IS OK FOR THIS AREA. GOOD ARER.
The George is an awesome place to live. Community vibe and new management is amazing. Love the amenities and location. The apartments are super nice.
We are living on the property for a while now. I must say the new management is doing an amazing job. We are excited to see what is to come!!
if u have an emergency on weekend you will definitely have to wait until monday ,no on call tech will help you.

This community has totally turned around since it was bought by Radco. We haven't had a pool for over 6 years and now we have  beautiful pool, and tons of upgrades. I really think the upgrades are going to change the whole neighborhood. I am one happy resident. Thank you Radco.

I've lived here for over four years. I've seen improvements but not enough. Maintanece issues. I've asked for things to be fixed that never has. What I pay monthly for what I have I would say it's not worth it. If your looking for a great apartment and community I would look elsewhere. If you need an apartment immediately and had no other options this isn't the place either. Like I said I've seen a lot of improvements just not enough. If I could move I would

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review: They will accidentally over bill on your last months rent to keep you security deposit. When they get it fixed after three months, they will then send the security deposit check to the wrong address. Decent apartment, terrible administration.

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review: People are constantly bumping cars, scratching cars, and not leaving a note. They tow cars constantly and people vandalize cars. If you like your car, don't move here.

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review: Unfortunate way to end our time at the villages of bent tree. We did not mind living here. Maintenance was great and the staff did a good job with events! The team did (as we confidently feel) mislead us about move out charges. They are charging us $1,500 on the premise of a "miscommunication." We've tried negotiating and showing proof of our payments and they will not budge even after talking over things for about a week. I hate to be the person to leave a bad review but it feels like they are gaslighting us. Get ALL conversations over the phone documented in writing to prevent this if you choose to live here. If it wasn't for this instance we probably would've given 4 stars.

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review:
Through our 15 month lease it has been a fight with bugs CONSTANTLY. First got bed bugs upon moving in (blamed us and we had to pay for it of course). I could have gotten over this if it had been an isolated incident…. But then we discovered the roaches. We have had roaches the entirety of our stay here and no matter how many times we report them and ask for treatment, they simply will. Not. Go. Away. At a certain point we just gave up and got our own roach traps. It didn’t fix everything but it was at least better than whatever “pest control” was doing.

We found a dead bed bug again later, but pest control gave us the all clear so we thought it was a false alarm. Just found out though that no. There are indeed live bed bugs because we found them ourselves. It frankly feels like management does not care about our living situation and has just written us off when it comes to these pests. Cannot wait to be out of here

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review: My lease cannot expire fast enough. This apartment community and complex is absolute trash!  Key words:  dirty, unkempt, rude associates, BUGS!!!  Stay far away from this place.

apartmentName: The Villages of Bent Tree Apartments
review: The apartments themselves are pretty nice just not very modern. The villages of bent tree does the bare minimum in every aspect. My neighbor got his car stolen from out front. I have seen a dozen people get arrested there in my 1 year, including residents. Your stuff has a good chance of being stolen. Once you move in they will not lift a finger to help you with any menial requests such as maintenance or simple information - this seems to be a challenge for them.

The rental market is at an all time high, affordable options are few. But making the decision to “tough it out” here was a big mistake. Share your apartment with opossums crawling between your walls, reoccurring roaches, and dilapidated buildings. Maintenance is only able to do so much; you can’t put a bandage on a gaping wound! Don’t do it!

I am looking for a four bedroom for my family, and we are moving from south bend indiana and wanted a place to have just until we can get us a house. I send an email to find out if they have any four bedrooms available and no one has gotten back to me.
Everytime I call the apartments they hang up on me

After a somewhat rocky transition to new management, I still love this place.  Diana is an efficient, thorough, kind and helpful manager.  These are older homes and the usual maintenance problems occur. Maintenance is dispatched quickly to do repairs.  The only problem is loud music that residents play when the office closes.  Overall, this is a safe place to live.  I’ve been here almost a year and I am satisfied with my home.

I have been living out here for almost 2 years. So far so good for me when I submit a maintenance request they come. They fix  the issue in a timely manner. I like paying my rent online & how the portal is setup for your records.

I have been living here for 1 year. I have never had any problems. Anytime I need something fixed they are right here in a timely matter. Victor is a very honest and great guy. I'm looking forward in to signing another lease. I love it here

This became the worst place I have ever lived when this place changed from Riverwood to the Preserve . The Preserve does NOT care about it residents and allows unreasonalbe wait time for necessary apartment maintenance. I waited over 6 months  for them to fix a window their team broke while tearing up the backyard (they fixed the window in January).

1. No parking for tenants (expect to walk pass 20 cars or a new street to your car
2. Landlord allows tenants to occupy visitor parking spots or their family/friends to occupy it for 2 months and counting
3. October 2018, 2 cars got their tires stolen so a total of 4 tires stolen on one night
4. Tenants are allowed to smoke in their units, prepare to smell like cigarette smoke 
5. There is no security in this area 
6. When we first moved in they leased us an apartment that wasn’t livable, so we had to push our move in date and get a new apartment unit 
7. New management charges you when you pay rent online, the fee is in the 20’s.
8. Expensive apartment that’s not worth the trouble

We have lived here for 2 years. There have been four different companies that have owned the complex so things were a bit annoying at times. Now they are very good about doing repairs and regular maintenance on the apartments as needed. They are older units, with older appliances and in need of some definite upgrading, but great space and nice wooded property for a great price. We have had our roof leak, shower leaks, washing machine leak, and other small issues. These are old building so things do go wrong more often; they are good about making repairs now. I haven't found anyhting in this area for the price and 3 bedroom tow home styl with 2 1/2 baths; for that it is worth it to us. Quiet neighboorhood and pretty safe for the most part. Other than the maintenance issues with the apartment we have enjoyed living here, especially with a beautiful woods and wildlife out our back porch. We have owls, deer, raccoons, and even humming birds that come to my feeder ;)

I lived here back in 2005-2006. This place is at the perfect location in Castleton. The worst thing that I can remember about living here, is the parking. Other than that, the neighborhood is quiet, and friendly staff.
Not badly priced but not the best place to live. Layout is weird doesn't flow well.

Convenient location and it's nice having a Kroger in the building; however, dealing with maintenance issues is constant and the leasing manager is extremely condescending. Everything was nice in the beginning, and it has quickly gone downhill. For being a "luxury" apartment maintenance (except for Cliff- he's the best) and dealing with management is subpar at best.

Axis Apartments has got to be one of the worst so called luxury apartment complexes in the Indianapolis IN area.  It is very poorly run and Axis Management is uncaring, greedy and incompetent.  When appliances in your apartment break down, the incompetent staff is unable to repair them.  The building on top of a Kroger supermarket is infested with homeless people who camp outside begging for money and get inside the building to sleep.  Axis/ Flaherty & Collins Management are extremely greedy and take advantage of residents with various fees constantly. Stay far away from this dump!

5 star is not enough to show how much I am happy and safe with Axis apartment. I love this apartment because the location is center of downtown and very beautifully  architectured. I have lived in many state and always myself and my parents have issue with safety but in this 2 years living in this  apartment made us feel so safe and gave the piece of mind. The best part of this apartment is common area is well maintained, excellent amenities ( Gym , yoga room , conference room , roof top , laundry, game area , covered parking ) , experienced  maintenance team who respond in no time, Kroger is just below the apartment where you can shop and bring the cart to the apartment to unload( best part ). The entire Management is very kind , always smiling and keep the positivity approach, I would especially thank Stefani , Kaila and entire management for making me feel safe , secure and taking care of me.If you are looking for an apartment in Indianapolis downtown just close your eyes and get into Axis apartment to experience Luxury hospitality and safe living . I would strongly recommend this apartment to my family and friends

Currently writing this review hearing the non-stop knocking of construction within the apartment, which per the landlord will be going on for weeks. They have zero sympathy for you and not least the courtesy to let you know in advance. If I had the chance to start over and choose an apartment to live at, I would NOT choose this place. The elevator doesn't work at least once every week. True, there's a Kroger on the first floor but I did not realize what a liability that could be given how much it attracts homeless people to the curb outside your balcony. They have a lot of little rules about leaving your garbage bin outside your door after certain hours because it "[detracts from their image] as a luxury apartment" and about signing liability forms so that you don't sue them if you get sick by using their gym or their swimming pool, so that should tell you the nature of the management here. I'm sure they'll reply to this comment and ask me to contact them to go over my feedback but this is true honest feedback from a long-term resident here, do not live here.

The apartments have a convenient location however the price tag comes along with it. Management does host events each month which is nice, but still does not add up to how much you pay. My biggest issues was with move in did not go smoothly, the office did not clearly communicate instructions. It took us longer because the complex is so hard to navigate. Each floor is set up so different and the signs at the elevator are not updated or helpful. Be prepared to get lost a few times before you find your unit.

I was looking to move into these apartments because the apartments are nice and the amenities  that are included in the apartment are great. However, the staff is terrible when it came to applying for an apartment. They told me I would hear back from them in a day or so and its been almost a month and no response. All they did was take my money twice for an application costing my $400 all together.

As someone who has lived here (in a 1bd and 2bd) for 4 years now I would stay here before I ever go back to a different apartment. I plan on staying here until we buy a house. The maintenance actually fixes things in a timely manner(usually 24-48 hours). The apartments are spacious and updated, also has a lot of closet and storage space. The kitchen is a bit small but we bought a 5 tier metal shelf for extra space and we learned to live with it. The walls are pretty thick(I never hear any of my neighbors). A/C keeps things cool, Heat keeps it warm as it should. I just wanted to make this review to help with anyone looking for a good place to live as it can be quite hard when every place seems to be littered with bad reviews but, usually only the people with bad experiences will leave a review. This is a safe area, very low crime(from experience and also looking online at a crime map), there are multiple shopping centers and food just minutes away. Both interstates(465, and 65) are only minutes away.
Maintenance doesn't fix anything. My heat and hot water have been broken for more than 3 days.  They have yet to fix it.

I think the title says it all...I live 4 hours away and I am looking for a new home in Indianapolis. I scheduled a tour date and time a WEEK in advice with Jill over the phone. When I showed up to the office, it was CLOSED. My boyfriend and I waited outside for 20 minutes, to at least give them a chance. I understand things happen, perhaps a flat tire? Slept in late? Whatever. As we are patiently waiting, a current resident also comes to the office and appears mad to see the office closed (as their offices hours were supposed to be open during that time). She comes over to us and asked if we were perspective renters. As we get to talking, she tells us horror stories and a million different reasons to not movie in. After our conversation, we instantly left. We will definitely not be renting with them. 

Written June 2019

Living here is absolute hell. I've lived here since 2014 and it has gotten progressively worse, especially since Birge and Held bought the property. I've lived in multiple buildings in the complex. Despite having renovations, all of the buildings still have the original windows and those need to be tightly covered in the winter to avoid an excessive heating bill. They grow black mold any time of year. The basement apartments flood when it rains too much. In the ground level apartments, they flood too, but for no good reason. There is something seriously wrong with the plumbing in these places. When the laundry room floods (which is at least once a week because there are 10 people in the apartment next door that do laundry constantly), so does my apartment. IT COMES THROUGH THE WALLS through a drain meant for the AC condensation drip (which also overflows when it gets too hot in the summer). When the laundry room floods, my next door neighbor's bathtub won't drain. Birge and Held refuses to have this properly fixed, so everything in my 3 closets gets wet and ruined constantly. I've had to lay down tarps to keep my things from getting ruined.
That's not all. The lights regularly burn out and are not replaced, there is a stair that is broken and exists at a 45 degree angle that they haven't fixed for MONTHS. A woman living upstairs was pregnant and had the baby during the time it was broken- still not fixed. Now imagine that broken stair and all the outdoor light fixtures being out. They still struggle to fix the lights and yet to fix the stair.
They changed the rent system so it generates how much rent should cost based on market value, so when you're renewing your lease agreement and they don't approve it on time, the numbers change and go up. My rent increased $8 a month because they didn't approve my renewal in time and the system didn't allow them to change it.
They used to have water and sewage included in the price, but they changed that midway through the lease term because there was a water main break on the property and were tired of eating the costs. I had close to an $80 water/sewer bill for several months and they blamed it on the pool.
There is no phone number to call Birge and Held and the people at the office are nice but are obviously not being given the funds to fix anything. My fence has been falling down and they have refused to fix it so I've had a ratchet strap holding it up.

This is the worst place I have EVER lived

Back in May my A/C went out & I called every day to get it fixed. They kept putting Freon on to reboot it but that would only last a couple hours & they had an actual a/c professional come to look & he told me that the whole unit needed replaced. That’s 5 days after they had kept putting freon back on & this is the beginning of May. It was 90 degrees in my apartment for a month & a half. I had to call the board of health in JUNE to force them to fix it. In the meantime we had a window unit because it was not a living condition for anyone. I actually got sick from pollen getting in my system from the window being open for the window unit because they wouldn’t fix it & the unit got my apartment down to about 78-80 which was better than 90. This was when the old manager Michelle was here & she didn’t care how people lived. She ended up getting fired which was the best safety decision made by Birge & Held. Well at the same time, in April my water heater needed replaced & they replaced it but didn’t turn the water off in the apartment & it flooded. I still at this point have had no help with them replacing my $170 rug or even giving me some money for the electric bill from the window unit running it up. So I have paid $300 a month for IPL because of this & then come to find out my water heater needed replaced AGAIN (twice within a few months) & after it was replaced again, the water still wasn’t getting hot. This was back in August or so. Now back in November I had no hot water again. Come to find out I had TWO leaks in my water lines & that’s what was causing my water heater to constantly run which was keeping my IPL bill at $300 a month. Mind you I have a 1 bed 1 bath & have ALWAYS paid my rent on time. They have still not come to a conclusion on how to help me & it’s December. I will say Jenny (new manager) has been much more reliable & helpful in getting stuff done but it’s the upper management that won’t give her answers on how to help me. If you want to deal with these kind of bills & issues go for it but I don’t know who would. Poor poor hospitality in taking care of the people that pay their bills.

This place has gone steadily downhill for years now. Nothing ever gets fixed. Ground floor apartments flood all the time. You can feel the wind through the closed windows. The common areas are disgusting. I have found countless used condoms, used needles, and used diapers in the grass/parking lot while walking my dog. The people are just as trashy as the apartments. There are frequently cops outside, yelling, and car break ins. I have found cockroaches and mice in my apartment (despite keeping my apartment clean). I have had times where there was no AC for weeks during the summer, and I'm lucky it was only that long because several people I have talked to have been without it for months. My neighbor had standing water in her apartment for several days before they finally sent someone to deal with it. They changed the billing method for utilities from a flat fee to dividing it up by number of occupants and square feet mid-lease. They then had a water line break and waited months to fix it. Guess who has to pay for the water and sewage bill from that pouring out and flooding the apartment complex? The residents who had no control over it!
This place is a nightmare. Avoid it at all costs.

Deercross is a comfortable place to live! When I ever have an issue or concern, the office staff and maintenance are on top of it! I also enjoy the fact that codes are required to enter the buildings and most packages are delivered in an amazon locker. I will say I appreciate seeing the crew out working every morning as well! You can tell that management is great! I enjoy living in Deercross apartments!
I've lived at Deercross for over 5 years. It started of great but as time goes on, maintenance and management gets worse. It's ending on a sour note as being a nightmare to live here.

Inside the apartments theyre not bad and things have changed that are good. Maintenance requests are rough this as proof that my ticket was marked as complete and thats completely false as the issue remains.
Great managers and management! Very friendly & welcoming! Been here for 2 weeks and love it so far!!
Amazing place to call home! The staffs are amazing and love how they help me out in whatever I need immediately.
Deercross is home! I love how friendly the staffs are and how beautiful my apartment looks. Excellent job!

Ive stayed in Deercross since 2016 and I have enjoyed it. The location is great and it is very pet friendly. I have had a few issues however whenever I contact the office they make sure that maintenance responds in a timely manner. I would definitely recommend for anyone to stay here.
It's an OK community. Close to highway and some shopping.

Deercross is a wonderful community. Everyone is friendly including the office and Mainteance staff, they have added a dog park and play ground which is great for those of us that have younger children and pets. I would highly recommend checking them out
Deercross is a nice a quiet place. Location is great! Floor plan is great! I love my apartment. Its spacious
The apartments are spacious and modern. And the leasing staff are super friendly and willing to go the extra mile to help

They have bad customer relation 
They will hang up phone on you when you call to complain about the issue you are facing in the apartment. 
They don't fix the issues on time if at all they want to fix it.

I moved out last year in june 2018 today is march 8 2019 still haven't received my deposit  9mos later till this day still waiting and every time i call the office the have some excuse can not get a straight answer and when i call and ask for the manager she in a meeting im not going say names but im sure you know who you are my ? Is can i get my deposit back this year worse apartment i have ever dealt with poor poor customer service i ever experienced so sad sorry for the people who is dealing with the same issues i been going through till this day still no deposit back .

So when I decided I was moving out, I explained to them that I would have to turn in my keys early due to military service for 10 days which lasted to the end of my lease. They expressed that there wouldn’t be a problem with ending my lease early as long as they had the orders. I finally got the orders to them and they switched around that they would not refund me the difference between the end of the lease and my orders starting. It took them five days to “review” the orders I sent them on Monday. I sent them it on Monday and they replied they would contact me with an update after a review, I emailed them on Tuesday, Thursday, and called twice Saturday to finally get an answer from them and they decided not to because I wasn’t being deployed. If they weren’t going to do it, they should have told me right off instead of dragging it out over a week and changing their minds from initially saying after a full explanation of my situation. As of 20190122, I just found out about my security deposit being returned. Again, they did not follow through with their timeline of it taking a week to get my refund total back to me. I called originally on the 12th of January and they stated it would be no later than a week that being 20190119. My refund was 19¢ off, I called and they stated my prorated rent for January was 19¢ off.

Finally, I would not live here ever again.

This staff is horrible with communication. Well the new staff. Maintainence is terrible when you can get it. Actually had a maintainence guy tell me what to put my thermostat on as if he was paying the bill. Mind you I never asked his opinion. All because the hvac system in my apartment was shotty. The walls are paper thin and have to hear annoying neighbors when trying to sleep. Mailbox is constantly left open and mail addressed to me was literally opened and stuck in my door. This was one of the worst experiences of my life. Not to mention was accused of not paying my rent when I did and had the receipts to prove it. Sheeesh and don’t get me started on the spiders I’ve had to kill....please think twice when considering this place.

Stay away from Deercross people!!! 

Firstly, it took me almost 8 months before composing my first review because I was somewhat expecting improvement in the maintenance aspect of the apartment and I will update as time goes by; only if the apartment maintenance services improves. 
Secondly, I have been living in Deer Cross for the past 8 months and I must admit that this apartment  Maintenance service sucks; I have turned in multiple maintenance service request ticket since my first day of move in and these tickets are still pending up to date. I was told last week that one of my ticket from 8 months ago was finally resolved via email but when I get home, the issue remains the same(They were supposed to replace my living room window net but never did).  Moreover, the apartment just changes their management and I can only hope that this maintenance issue would be resolved under this new management. I personally won't recommend the basic units... I have at least 5 other residents going thru the same issue pertaining to poor maintenance services. 
Conclusion, the maintenance in this apartment sucks and must of the apartment are equipped with old appliances; I don't really recommend Deer Cross.

I have lived here for over 3 years and I wish I hadn't been a sucker for the cheap prices. I constantly fill out the same maintenance work orders that either get ignored or a superficial patch that lasts a couple weeks. Every spring/summer I have to repeatedly fill out maintenance requests to fix the A/C, and the apartment gets up to 85 degrees at least three times a month between May and October because of the shoddy work. The price tag is appealing, but you get what you pay for.

I been living here since 2010 and I love my apartment with the den very spacious!!!! The maintence crew is great you just email or call and your needs will be taking care of fast!!! The office staff is always smiling when come in that's a first impression!!!!!! They have great communication with there tenants and also caring!!!!

Looking for a place to move We've been here a few years and hope to stay a few more. It's the best place, i feel, for empty nesters.  Maintenance is excellent at what they do and the office staff is always open for you.
Great homes, just not as prepared upon move in  Love my unit it just wasn’t finished during my move in time
I have no problem with this place. I love it thank you

Lived here in 2015 , just moved back and so far my experience with staff is great ???? they try to accommodate my every need. And it seems like there always having something for the residents every week.

I have been here since July and only 2 washing machines in the building work! The hallways are nasty!!! They charge you for services that they don’t provide voluntarily  (extermination)!! Maintenance say they fix things they don’t really fix!!! I can’t wait for my lease to be over!!!

I went to move in today and I was just handed the keys to my apartment. Nobody went and did a walk-through with me prior to giving me my keys. Just walking into the building itself left me feeling unsafe and dirty because the carpets were stained terribly, there were holes in the walls, and the humidity in the building was the worst I’ve ever experienced. Upon walking into the apartment, I immediately started crying. They tried to get me to move into an apartment that had mold and mildew on the walls, the paint was chipping off the walls due to the moisture in the air, there were huge stains and rips in the carpet, the cabinets in the bathroom were barely hanging on, and the walls had not been repainted so you could see every scuff mark and stain that was left by the previous tenants. upon telling them about my concerns with the place they seemed like they would work with me to get everything fixed but I quickly realize that they didn’t really care what I had to say. I would point out things and they would simply brush it off like it was unimportant. I quickly decided to cancel my lease and I demanded my money back only to find out that I have to wait a month and a half to have my money re-deposited into my account… With the condition of the apartment, I didn’t even feel safe having my dogs in there, let alone have family over. I wanted an apartment to be a home where I can gather with friends and family and this is definitely not the place to do that!!

Pros: wonderful amenities
All electric (no gas utilities) 
Large clubhouse and building an outdoor shelter area 
Dog park 
Friendly maintenance and Office staff 

Love this complex a lot and it’s got a lot to offer in todays urban busy lifestyle. 

Cons: 
Need to do a better job managing the woodland, small prairie and ponds on site. 

Internet is spotty. Back half of the complex you don’t get much Cellular service so you basically have to buy internet.

My husband and I have lived here for 2 years and we really like it, it's quiet and peaceful, the apts are very nice. The only bad thing about where we live is the parking but other than that I would highly recommend living here!

The “big wigs” do not personally care about the residents and did not want to help at all during time in need with job loss due to COVID. They actually sent out an email telling residents to apply for a rental assistance program, thus causing many to get behind on rent while waiting approval, and then proceeded to change their mind and tell residents that they weren’t going to accept the program to help residents. Do not trust anything they offer or say! Just a follow up for those thinking about moving in. This issue was discussed and a payment plan was offered. This after we were already behind from them offering help and taking it away. NOW, they have sent us papers from a lawyer with a court date for eviction! Mind you - The CDC has extended eviction restrictions until December of 2020 - but of course they are sneaky and won’t tell anyone that! Bottom line - like I previously said - DONT trust these people and expect them to help you or go above and beyond. All about the money and that’s all!

Don't move here. The highest internet available sucks. I am on the verge of loosing my job because everyone is forced to work remote right now and the internet speed wont support my job. Please save your money and time dont move here. It is over rated and over priced it is the worst apartment complex ever built. Even canceled my cable because the signal wasn't good enough. Please dont move here there is better options out there for the same price. The additional bedrooms are small. The master is big but the others are small.SAVE YOUR MONEY THIS IS THE WORST PLACE EVER!!!!

This is my fiances and I, second time living here at Latitudes. We absolutely love our apartment and the location is perfect for us and our commutes. we like the feel of country living but being within 5 minutes of any shopping or restaurants that you could need. The staff are always so welcoming and helpful!
This is a beautiful community with huge apartment homes. The staff is friendly and the amenities are excellent.

(3 weeks in the house) So far I've had several problems with maintenance services, having to ask for the same issues to be fixed over and over. The biggest problem so far is the mice infestation, which has been very frustrating  to deal with, since the mice keeps appearing in the kitchen and dinning room on the daily basis!

On the positive side of things, the appliances are new and nice, the kitchen space is well used (due to the mice we have not used this nice space as much as we normally would).
I also had a flood on the 2nd day in the house; this incident was caused by plumbing issues that were not described in detail.
