I give them 2 stars for rent being reasonably priced and being walking distance from stores,pharmacies, grocers and gas stations.

If you are looking for a place close to grocery stores and other major stores this is the place for you 7 minutes from downtown convenient to the city but not caught in the middle of all the hustle and bustle. The apartment grounds are kept up in appearance there could be more attention taken to maintenance needs of the residents within the complex If I had to make any complaint it would be that you have to repeat your request for maintenance for weeks on end before you can get someone to actually come and fix/repair the problem. I have been here for 4 years and other than needing maintenance from time to time my stay here has been pain free and comfortable.

Where do I start? I new management is horrible. They lack compassion and do not listen to concerns. They also are fixing up the property on the exterior but they are not fixing the major issues. I have been living here for almost four years and I have had horrible issues with the plumbing. I have had several water leaks. One in the kitchen and I lost count of how many I have had in the bathroom. One night it was leaking so bad I emptied 8 buckets of water. I called on-call maintenance and they didn't come until 10am the next day and I could not use my toilet because the water was leaking above my toilet. It was the only toilet I have and I have a child. I also have had ongoing issues with my refrigerator which I have put in a lot of work orders for. They come and "fix" it and I still have to throw food away because it does not regulate temperature correctly. Then there is the oven. You cannot even bake anything in it because it does not work correctly. Also they left me without a furnace for 2 weeks one winter. Then when they finally put a new one in it kept breaking down. Also if you want a non-smoking place do not move here. I could go on with the numerous amount of issues I have had here but there is not enough room to write it in here.
I’ve been living here for 2 months and have had zero issues. I’m definitely a fan. It’s also really nice they have an option to pay through the Zelle app. Definitely a good place

I moved into broad ripple trails right after my divorce and it was my first time being on my own. Plus, being a first time single mother it was a great way to start the new chapter in our lives. Maintenance staff were quick and very handy, office staff were nice and always ready to assist my needs. With the cookouts and pools we had so much to do at this complex. So grateful for this place and all it did for my new beginning.

I picked this place solely for it's location and price. It's only a ~4 minute walk away from the Monon trail, and it's close to so many shops and restaurants in the area. Plus the office staff have always been helpful and friendly.
I’ve lived here for about 6 months now and don’t have any issues or regrets. The neighbors are quiet, they keep everything clean and up to date and respond very quickly to issues! Highly recommended

Please do your self a favor and just dont. I have 4 neighbors that also hate it here and are counting down the days to the end of their lease. It's been a nightmare. 3 months or so and we are able to finally move out of this hell hole. I lived in an apartment almost 2.5 times the size of this place and my electricity bill is almost 3x as much. They love to put bandaids  on things and make excuses. We moved into a filthy apartment, the furnace sucked, the ac has been a nightmare and a half, they don't take care of their wood floors, nothing. We have received no genuine apologies, no compensation, no nothing. Gabriel is the property manager and he is difficult to get ahold of, difficult to talk to, and down right rude. The two new ladies in the front office are sweet as pie! but that's the only thing I like about this place. Don't buy a bunch of apartments if you cant properly bring them up to par.
The apartments are slowly getting better. My son and I enjoy living here. It's reasonably priced as I'm a single mother doing it all on my own.
Finally started ti fix things in my apt, but the potholes are like the GRAND CANYON in my court, they have been like this for over a year TIME TO FIX THEM
Apartment complex is improving,  need to take care of the street to many holes. Still waiting for the replacement of the windows. Good management.

Very dirty complex, difficult management, huge disconnect between staff and residents. Trash in front of dumpsters, Im sure management reads these and is aware of the problems, please do better, this place feels unsafe on weekends and security sleeps in his car.

It has been a nice experience so far. 
The administration is very kind and diligent since our first approach. 
The place is clean and it is a very quiet and family friendly.

Not that bad of a place to live. The staff can be nice. The maintenance is finally great. The apartments are nice. The only thing that needs fixed now is the roads are really bad and also we would love to take our kids swimming, fix the pool and the roads. Everything would be great.

There is a Huuuugggee Ant Problem. There’s Ants coming out from under the kitchen cabinets on the walls, they come out in your bathroom faucets, in your bathroom cabinet, in your bedroom. And they are not regular ants they are RED ANTS!! You can have the cleanest apartment and the ants still come crawling out because they are literally inside of the walls and regular ant killers will not help. Don’t Walk, Run As Fast As You Can Away From this apartment complex Looks Are Definitely Deceiving!!! And the leasing office never answers their phone you always have to physically go to the leasing office if you need something. Just unprofessional and terrible!

They are only here to take your rent money. I have been living with black mold and cockroaches for MONTHS without any care from front office staff. My bedroom flooded (to the point where I couldn't go in it without shoes on) and this flood was left unresolved for over a month. I call, I put in maintenance tickets and I go to the leasing office to inform them of these issues right away. The property manager will just flip it to make you look like you're in the wrong for wanting to live somewhere without mold, bugs and leaks.  It's all about money and flipping apartments to new unsuspecting residents. If you want a serious health/safety hazard such as mold or a front door that doesn't shut for 3+ months this is not the place to live. I was told "that's what renters insurance is for" and "you can move out if you have an issue with the problems you're having" Laughable.

The New Manager is all about cleaning up things!  The community is looking better.  I appreciate the fresh paint in my hallway and cleaning the outside of my building.  I can tell by the newsletters management sends out monthly that she is definitely about cleanliness and the grounds are kept up way better than before to prove it.   Thank you!  One Happier Camper at Hidden Oaks!

I recently moved here and I believe things are improving. Management is superb ! Deionna ! I put in a maintenance request and my issue was resolved within an hour ! Brandon the new maintenance guy is sharp ! I’m loving it here.

My girlfriend and I lived here for one year and it was the worst experience I’ve ever had with an apartment. Maintenance is virtually nonexistent and will say your requests are complete without ever coming out. The droves of roaches are disgusting and you can expect mold and water damage in every unit. The office staff were incompetent and lazy when it came to communicating with residents and following up on maintenance requests. You and your family will not be made a priority at this complex. Definitely not worth the headache. Save your money and go somewhere else.

i just signed my next year lease.i have been at Hidden Oak Estates two years now ,I had small issues at first but the maintenance people took care of them right away.They are a great group of people.i have had no problems since.some of the neighbors do not respect the property,but you are always going to have that no matter where you go.It's a good location ,easy access to  465 and airport.The office staff has always been very respectful and easy to deal with.I hope to be here  a few more years.

This place has a really bad mice problem . The maintenance is god awful . My heat went out 4 time and it took maintenance weeks to come look at my apartment. Please don’t move here the mice are everywhere and the hallway always smell like weed

ROACHES. No matter how much we clean or put out traps, the building is infested. I've also heard about bed bugs and mice from other areas. We've gone almost two months so far without AC, even though they keep marking our service requests completed. A bottle of syrup literally exploded in our cabinet from the heat. Parents let their terrible children run around unsupervised, screaming, breaking property, collecting glass bottles out of the trash and throwing them. Laundry rooms are disgusting and have had my laundry stolen. Pretty much anyone who drives a car is a rude & dangerous nightmare. Cops outside about once a week. Living here has been a miserable experience and I recommend just spending extra money elsewhere.

Hidden Oaks Estates delivers when they say the only bill outside of rent is electric, but outside of that, they fall terribly short.  The front office is sweet and helpful until you sign the lease, then you are essentially on your own.  I went for two months without air conditioning because they refused to even look at it.  I had to threaten to fix it myself and as soon as i started talking about reembursment, they sent someone out that day.  It is set up to squeeze as much money out of you as possible, and because of the way the lease is worded, no matter how bad things may get, "only the apartment owners may deem an apartment uninhabitable, not the inhabitant, nor an outside source".  I had to deal with that when my apartment was infested with both bedbugs AND fleas.  The apartment office refused to send anyone out there until a regularly scheduled check happened... two weeks from the report... Our dishwasher has been broken for months as well, and still hasn't been fixed.  The only reasons i would recomend this apartment is it's location, the relatively low cost of rent, and the small electric bill.  If you need somewhere you don't want to spend alot of time, i would recomend as long as you keep it clean and check for pests often, otherwise, spend the extra 20-40 a month to get a better apartment elsewhere.

Kids screaming outside at two in the morning. Half the parents don't watch their kids. Cabinets were warped. Put in a request, called three times, and talked to office staff several times and in 10 months time, nothing was ever done. Had to go outside to make a phone call because reception was horrible. I've never been so happy to move. I love how they market their homes as elegant. There's nothing elegant about that place!

Me and my wife lived in one of their one bedroom apartments a little while back. It was our first home together and we had "its new" eyes for everything about it. It seemed flawless. Then we lived there for a while. Cracks in the walls became noticeable, the low quality of the appliances(as one by one they began to break down and have problems), and i dont know if maybe we just got lucky or what but half of our floor was unlevel with the rest of the building. With the exception of one of the office staff, the management team was less than welcoming or "on the ball". The best part of the experience there was the privacy, the quietness, the location, and the price(which has since gone up). If you need something cheap and fast this could be for you. If you can afford better, I'd suggest it. Not worth the fallout.

The office will make it all look all pretty for you and make it sound about how great they are. They deff. are not. The halls stink, people do not clean up after their animals, and when you ask to be able to get out of your lease they always tell you it isn't possible but people are constantly moving in and out of this place. Then throughout the night people are yelling and blasting music even in the middle of winter! Also, they have been raising their rent.

Do not move here. It takes them 6 months to do anythng! If they even do it. We went 1 whole month without water just because they didnt want to fix it, thats 12 units without water! There is tons of noice all the time. Just not worth it!

I am going to have to tell you to avoid this one. I just moved out. I lived there for 4 years. The apartment itself is decent, quieter than most, but still had a number of problems. 

Things break often but for the most part it will be fixed in 1 day to 2 weeks. Additional, more permanent, problems were weird leaks from the faucet, water that was never hot, a dishwasher that kept flooding the kitchen ( Maintenance said it should be replaced-- it wasn't),  and hard water that damaged my clothes (that might be a county wide problem).

The major problem, however, is management. They are nice, but it takes a while to hear back from them or you have to track them down which is inconvenient to say the least. Sometimes on time-sensitive matters they wouldn't get back to me until one day before a due date and then refused to provide an extension in regard to fees because corporate controlled fees. I would ask for the number to corporate and be denied. 

Frequently the answer to outlandish fees was that it was out of their hands and they don't allow you to speak with the person in control of those fees. 

But the major reason to avoid this property is a 75$/day charge if you leave your trash bin outside after 9:00 am. Yes, you read that right, per day. Don't over sleep, don't return from a night shift late. I started dropping my trash myself, but I'm still charged for the VIP trash service that I can't use. 

Please avoid.

Former resident. 
Our initial experience was great. The staff was friendly and the apartments are nice enough, but when it came time to break our lease for a job relocation, our experience was nothing short of terrible. I had seen reviews from other pet owners on how they were charged ridiculous amounts after moving out for cleaning fees, but since we’ve never had a problem at any other apartment complex we’ve lived in, I thought we would be okay. We spent 2 days making sure the apartment was spotless and had rented a carpet cleaner to go “above and beyond”. My surprise came a week later when I got a bill for cleaning and when I asked for an explanation, there ridiculous accusations with no picture proof…that of which I asked for picture proof over email and on the phone several times and was denied every time. My advice, stay away from here if you have pets, or at least stay to do the final walk through with them…if you don’t, expect them to make up anything they have to to keep your deposit and charge you more on top of that.

Elizabeth was great. She was helpful, friendly, informational, and professional during the application process. As a result, I'm confident I found the right living conditions in Indy. Moving from out of state I was put at ease once I saw the apartment and it's surroundings.
I am so glad I stumbled upon these apartments. The front office is super nice and helpful. I appreciate how well they take care of the landscaping too!!!
The location is awesome. Super close to the city and close to my school. Also, the staff is super friendly and helpful. I love it here so far!

Noisy apartment/neighbors staff says oh we told him to quiet down. Maintenance comes in at random times no notice. I worked nights so was always home but i noticed there was no notice on others doors so they had no idea maintenance was in there place.
 My sink wasnt draining was told it was my fault for not using the garbage disposal. (Like i didnt have a need to use it).
Got charged for moving out then a 5000$ bill in damages. I basically slept in the place. I never even  wore shoes in the place. Nobody besides me was ever in the apartment. How is there 5000$ in damage.

I have been loving here for 12 months on a 18 month lease and haven’t had any issues. The maintenance department is responsive and very personable and the office staff is helpful. The community is diverse and people seem to look out for each other. The location is great and the dog park on site is convenient!

I absolutely love living here and the staff is so friendly and do a great job at showing us residence that they appreciate us. they are always super kind, maintenance is always on top of things if needed. It’s a very safe quiet community and I am so glad I chose to make this my home!!!

Living at this complex was the WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!!! The apartments flooded for 3 years in a row and during those floods the apartment staff was notified of the flood and NEGLECTED to call me and let me know. Instead I found out from a neighbor that my apartment had standing water and my dog was just standing in it when it was 30 degrees out. When we got home our dog was completely freezing and shaking from the water. Not to mention that during all of those floods not ONCE did they check for mold to ensure our living situation was safe. 

After the floods we had to live in an apartment and pay FULL RENT regardless of the water stains all of the walls and the flooring being completely ruined. The complex could not have cared less that our living situation declined after the floods. 

Also beware of all of the car break ins! They happen ALL THE TIME and the complex refuses to get security cameras because it’s too “expensive” and they truly just don’t care about their tenants.

I would recommend living anywhere but here. It is not worth the stress or the extra money you will have to spend when your apartment floods. Because trust me, it will. They do every single year!
The staff is friendly, and the maintenance is speedy. I thoroughly enjoy my time living here and haven’t had a complaint.

Wish I could give them 0 stars. I never even lived there and the people in the office are rude and ignorant. Apparently there is some sort of mysterious corporate office with no phone number and no way to talk to them. I've been waiting 51 days so far to get my $300 deposit back and no one has any clue where it is. Everytime I call they have some sort of excuse of why I still don't have it. This is place is a joke and I'm so glad I did not chose to live here. If I'm having this much trouble now I could only imagine how hard it would be to get anything done if I lived there.

Update: it is now 9/2 and still have not recieved my deposit back. The company sent it to an old address of mine tarnish 3 hours away and wanted me to drive there to see if it was in that mailbox. When I said no and asked for them to cut another check the replied that I would have to pay for them to stop payment on the old check. Now I've waited 111 days to receive my deposit back, and I'm getting charged $40 for them to send me another one. STAY AWAY from this place. They do some seriously shady business!

Good location, as long as you’re okay with your door facing outside. Also there are two locations: one where the pictures show and the second right after Edgewood, less private. When I moved in, there was an overwhelming smoke smell that was unaware of. I thought it would get better, but it hasn’t even with the ozone machine the complex used. Just beware, I would try and visit the unit you plan to move in to beforehand. Overall very safe though.

I have been here for a year and it is not so bad, they take good care of there property. They are good at weeding out the bad neighbors and also stay on top of crime. They also have 24/7 camera surveillance.

I have lived here for 3 years and love how peaceful and friendly the community is. My neighbors all help to look out for one another, yet keep to themselves, which has been a great change of pace from the previous senior community I lived in. Staff are just as friendly whenever I need assistance with paying rent, putting in a work order request, or just stopping by the main office to chat. Seniors can easily feel isolated or lonely when they don't have friends or family nearby, so it is great knowing that I have a whole community surrounding me that I can lean on when I need to.

I have lived here for over 4 years and have never seen so many upgrades put into the property as I have seen the last 6 months after new ownership took over. The hallways have bright, new LED lighting that make it much easier for us seniors to see. The floors are all being replaced with plank flooring, so now I no longer see old stains in the carpet when coming home, doing laundry, checking my mailbox, etc.

I just moved in this month after a disastrous year.
Gina and Nedra have bent over backwards to help me with my move in. Nedra has been an amazing help! She stayed late for me when I was late for my lease signing. Then still did my walk through, and explained everything to me. I felt very cared for. Nedra is on her game. I was a Regional Property Manager for 10 years and in the industry for 32 years, and I haven't seen a better property manager! I really love it here. It's vary clean, quiet and well cared for. I can't say enough about the great things they are doing here! 5 stars for sure! I'm trying to get two of my friends to move in! I'm going to copy this review to as many places as I can!

NeighborCare of Chapel Hill is great place to live several people come to live here because their parents lived here in the past.  Even folks that move out often come back.  They have friendly staff who care about you and assist you with even when it way outside of the scope of their jobs.  Not to mention all the activities they have which is uncommon in a independent apartment complex.

Neighborcare Chapel Hill does not have a swimming pool as advertised. I also seen some advertisements on a tanning salon that they do not have so a lot of their information is misleading. They also do not have a 24-hour security because they fired them about 2 months ago along with their cleaning crew. Some buildings goes weeks before it is cleaned. Trash piles up in the trash room and brings in mice and cockroaches.

If you are considering moving here....DON'T DO IT!!! If you are considering moving someone to this property don't do it unless you hate that person and want them to suffer on a daily basis. The maintenance here is a joke, and I'm being kind when I say that. We have a screen door that has needed replacing for over a year, we have a patio door handle that is hanging off and has been for a month now. The carpet was supposed to have been replaced over a year ago but hasn't been replaced as of this review. It boggles my mind how the staff here take absolutely no responsibility for anything that goes wrong. They would rather lie to you and pass the blame to someone else instead of just being honest and accepting the fact that they screwed up AGAIN. If you still choose to move to this community after reading this review you have no one to blame but yourself. You have been warned so rent at your own risk.

Maintenance trying to come into your apartment with giving 24 hours notice! Being told that you didn't pay your rent when you have proof that you did! Turning the water off without anyone saying anything! No fire extinguisher in the apartment! It's noisy! No pool like they claim! The bus doesn't go everywhere like they claim!

Not friendly or helpful.   My mom has lived here for 5 months and I’m getting her out of here.  Hall carpet is filthy, elevators smell horrible, no heat in her bedroom, only in the living room.  I guess they expect the heat to radiate into the bedroom.   Neighbors can’t seem to mind their own business, and are constantly trying to cause trouble.  Cafe food is a hit or miss.  They advertise a pool, and if they mean that dirty thing on the other side of the parking lot, then, no thanks.

My father has lived here for 4 years and in 3 different apartments.  We now live in a 2 bedroom here and not once have we ever seen a bed bug. Not one. The new management seems to be working tirelessly with their awesome new maintenance team, to get things done. Our lease is coming up and I am pretty sure we will be staying.

It is not excellent. The model that they show you is the complete opposite of what my grandmother got. As a whole, disappointing. There is so much more that should be done to honor our seniors who worked much of their lives, but this company is concerned about profits. Our grandmothers and grandfathers deserve the best. Good riddance.

Uncontrolled!  The whole building is affected and they only do treatments to one apartment at a time, so the bugs happily relocate to the next apartment!  When the apartment is sprayed or heat treated, there are so many things that need to be done to protect personal belongings, food, plants, etc that have to be moved, clothing and linens washed... it's really hard!  Especially for elderly people!!  After several attempts at failed eradication of the bugs, we were forced to call the Health Dept.  That's when someone finally realized that this problem needs ongoing and regular monitoring and eradication.  Gee - go figure!  To me that just seems like common sense. Well, it's been about 3-4 months and the bug people are still coming in monthly to check my parents' apartment as agreed to by management of the apartments.  Hopefully, they will stick to the agreement.  I do have to say the people that work at the apartments and everyone I spoke with was very nice and, once I got "heard" they were accommodating.  However, I do not think we should have had to go three years to get "heard" and finally get some pro-active steps taken.

Car with 2 flat tires in back parking lot ..has been for months... must be owned by a friend of the building manger because it’s against the lease and yet the car is still sitting there.
But then a resident in a wheel chair is harassed over poop from a small dog .. it wasn’t properly picked up 
Only the mangers favorite pets are even told about donations given to all the residents 
Not all residents are informed 
Lose money in the washer or dryer ..well good luck 
with that for some residents 
The heating and air conditioning issues are a real problem for some units ..some not 
How is it possible to to overlook huge infractures of the lease from some tenants and then pick apart others for the smallest issues if it truly isn’t Favoritism in its finest

I have been here in my one bedroom apartment at Crestwood for approximately three months- i’ve had my bathroom ceiling over the tub tore out for three weeks and could not take a shower - The air-conditioners are always leaking which then causes wet living room carpet and then the ceiling below them gets water issues which my ceiling has had-Was here 30 days and the kitchen sinks were leaking under the sink -water everywhere and that was on race day- I only got to see the apartment for the first time three hours before the movers arrived — and to top if off there is a BED BUG problem— they are actively pursuing treatment for the bugs thank goodness — I was getting tired of being bit by the little buggers ??The thing that I don’t understand is why Cresswood will not consider any kind of compensation for blatant inconvenience- unsanitary conditions -who would want to go three weeks and not take a shower- I had to do washer ups in the bathroom sink and shampoo my hair in the kitchen -  The residents are very friendly and helpful and truthfully they are the only reason that I really would even want to consider staying here at Crestwood

Having lived here at Crestwood for six months now, I can honestly say that I am pleasantly surprised and glad to be here. At first I was a bit standoffish, fearing that such close proximity with so many senior citizens would make me feel old. But the opposite is true. Being here feels just right!

The management and maintenance teams are superb and so accommodating. The residents are friendly and eager to help in any way. It feels like one big family! There are activities built around just about any interest you might have--there is no excuse not to get involved in something. However, your privacy is totally respected as well.

The apartment itself is ideal and I have never lived in a place that feels so safe. After six months at Crestwood Village West, I believe I made the right choice.
It’s been nice living here. Of course getting service requests haven’t been easy to get fixed but other than that it’s been peaceful living here

When first moved in everything was amazing then, (after new management took Over) started slowly going down hill. Maintenance takes forever to show up. Half the time they barely fix what's broke. I've been waiting on a dishwasher for 2 months when I originally just called about it leaking a little and the maintenance guy completely broke it. Communication is next to none most of the time. If you can get a hold of someone, you never get a straight answer or get a we will call you back with an update.

My apartment was newly remodeled and I love that but the very first day I stepped inside the building I noticed the glass entry was shattered, the stairs and hallways were stained and smelled like dog urine, there was trash in the halls, my next door neighbor had multiple pit bulls that barked 24/7, and our apartment had roaches. Last but not least, there are actual craters in the street and parking areas that have already cost me 2 tires. No wonder the rent was lower than expected. I was unable to tour the unit prior to my move in date as I was sick but I wish I was able to crawl out of my hospital bed to view the property before signing the lease. The staff and maintenance crew are all extremely friendly but Customer Service can only take you so far.
I’ve been here for about a week and so far it’s been really good maintenance acts really fast. The apartments are pretty spacious and great for the price.

Not a happy resident at all. The price of the apartments are manageable but for all that comes with it, they should be cheap. Neighbors are loud, potholes are ridiculous, and maintenance takes forever to fix things. The office barely answers the phone, and the amount of roaches are nearly impossible to get rid of even with exterminations. I wouldn’t recommend moving here.

I love the office staff!! They are always on it and there to help especially Jenny and Arianna. The only issues I’ve had is mold in my apartment, maintenance, and people letting there dogs off leash when they dont mind the owner. Other than that I’ve been very happy here !
The property was immaculate! Everything was spotless, and it felt like walking into a brand-new home. We appreciated the attention to detail and the care taken in maintaining the place.
The property was immaculate! Everything was spotless, and it felt like walking into a brand-new home. We appreciated the attention to detail and the care taken in maintaining the place.
Nice remodeling units  with tile work. Great staff friendly  an helpful. Close to the highway. Best of all a pool to relax in.
This place is disgusting! Mice, cockroaches, and ants! It cheap for a reason and this complex should be REPORTED!! Zero stars if I could rate!!

I highly recommend this apartment to people who are looking. The manager
Is the best if help and everyone are so friendly and nice and it is pretty place to live .
We definitely recommend it here if your looking for a great small community to call home . Office staff are phenomenal very helpful. Nice size apartments and reasonable rent

I planned on moving to Aria and was quoted a price by one of the employees.  She told me to act fast because there were only 6 of these available. The next day I went back and toured the apartment with the apartment manager and made sure it was the same price as the other employee told me.  He agreed so I put my deposit down to hold the apartment.  Two days later I get an email stating the breakdown of my feee and my rent was listed as 400 dollars more than they had told me.  I confronted them and they were rude and denied lying. The halls were dirty and it smelled funky so their lies saved me from living in a junk hole.  Don’t view these apartments unless you wants to be disrespected and lied to.

I lived at this property for nearly five years on the ground floor, paying extra for a garage. I did like it until end of 2023 and through my move out date Sept 2024. I always kept my account current and maintained a clean apartment. However, there were persistent issues, including a moldy bathroom and a leaking garage. The exterior building doors are insecure, as key fobs can be useless when the doors are unlocked by physical keys. It happened FREQUENTLY.
While the maintenance team, especially Jamal, is excellent, noise from upper-level units with faux wood floors can be disruptive. Additionally, the pool remains unlocked during the season, allowing non-residents to use it freely—a poor decision. Community events were poorly promoted, and management changes occurred without notice, which was inconsiderate. Even 24-hour entry notices were sent only via email. If you have an issue, you have to follow up for results. Fire extinguishers used to be provided but not all Units get them. I did eventually get one in August right before i moved out LOL. See email from April saying they are working on it. Also install the dog park bench back..it's been like that for over 2 years.

I recently visited this property and met with Jessica. She was very helpful with information on a move I plan to make this summer. The property seems really well cared for and I hope this will be my new place this summer.
I feel pretty safe with the security gates and the locked door into each apt building.
Office staff is friendly and courteous.

For what you get and what you’ll experience, Double Creek Flats is disappointing and way overpriced. The walls are so thin, you’ll hear neighbors coming up/down and in/out of the building along with their full conversations at all hours. At least once a week, we had the displeasure of smelling other people’s cooking in the halls and our apartment for several hours. You will get smells of others’ trash lingering in the halls well after the bins are inside after  valet trash has long come and gone. The dumpsters are an issue with the compactor breaking and trash piling up outside of it.  Management changed during our lease and the response from the office staff changed drastically. When bought with concerns, staff is rude and avoidant; “That needs to be addressed by the manager and she’s not here at the moment, but I’ll take a note to make sure it’s handled” was heard way too much with no resolution even if brought up multiple times. After speaking with other residents, they also said the same thing happens when they brought up their concerns (many of which the same) to the current management team. A big reason we moved to the complex was for the gated community and key fob doors/buildings as things were presented as safer. But when the gates and fob readers aren’t working correctly (surprisingly frequent and for long periods of time) that doesn’t help and the complex would really benefit from additional security measures as a whole. Our apartment was dirty when we moved in (carpets not vacuumed, pet hair all over the baseboards/ windows, dirty cabinets in the kitchen and bathrooms, leftover holes in the walls from the previous tenant, etc.) and management did not care or offer to correct it. The maintenance team was always been great and quick and the landscape is well taken care of on a regular basis. When the weather is warm, you will see couples, families, and pets out around the complex which is wonderful and was one of the selling factors for us.
very clean, grounds look great.

If you want to live in the slums of Greenwood you’re in the right place. This property was nice when I first moved in and has declined in the last 6 months or so. They should definitely revisit their screening criteria. I will not be renewing my lease.

The change in management was needed. We now have management that genuinely cares for their residents and makes this community an amazing place to live. The landscaping is well kept. It says something when you get to see kids playing outside together for hours at a time. To me that means it is both safe and friendly.

I love living here moved here about two months ago. I think the office team is amazing and super friendly!! You feel welcomed as soon as you walk into the office. The maintenance team is great and responds quickly. I love the layout of the apartments and think the upgrades the team here has done to the appliances and other aspects of the apartment really have made it feel like home. I recommend these apartments to anyone looking for a new place.

I lived here for over 8 years. Within 3 months of ardizzone purchasing it, I moved out. They over paid for the complex and are now charging WAY too much for apartments that aren’t worth it. And to now top it off, they just sent me a bill for damages!! They’re want me to pay for new carpet and paint after living there, with pets for 8 years! They are required to do that! They tried to charge me over a thousand dollars for stuff they have to do! Rent at your own risk!!!

Truly unacceptable behavior and professionalism. Nothing but terrible experiences. We are moving in less than 1 month thankfully however they would not wait to do renovations on our apartment. We live in a 1 bedroom apartment that’s maybe 700 square feet and they renovated the kitchen and the bathroom at the same time and required all contents be out of those areas. Which means everything got squeezed into boxes and our 1 bedroom has become even smaller. They asked several times if we had our own washer/dryer and I said yes several times. That was the only communication about that. Then on renovation day they bring in another washer/dryer and said well your washer/dryer can stay in the living room until you move and they would not budge on waiting to install theirs. So now even less space to be able to move around. They tried to write on their notice of renovation that we could not be here while the renovations were done and that they were not liable if anything was lost or broken, I was able to tell them they couldn’t tell us we can’t be in our own apartment. However, if one of the workers stole something that letter saved them against any liability. The absolute worst type of management, completely do not care about your rights as a tenant. Not to mention, for people not moving they increased rent by almost $300/month and for people moving they increased it by almost $500/month.

We've lived here for four years, and the staff (especially maintenance) has always been very nice. There are occasionally loud/obnoxious neighbors, but they tend to move out quickly. The apartment complex offers the first month free of rent, which can sometimes attract people who don't take care of the property, but it's not a huge problem. The apartments themselves have fairly thick walls and a little bit of charm that you don't find in newer apartments.

I lived here for a couple months before I had to leave. The staff and I weren't on the same page on what makes a safe environment. They accidentally forwarded me an email chain where they took personal jabs at me. 

I don't leave reviews. I have never had an issue with an apartment before. I just need to say there are better options out there for anyone looking to rent.

10/10. No Notes.  This community has been a life saver! I am having a blast residing here and it was the perfect location before moving closer to work. Everyone here is kind, professional, detail oriented and always looks out for you!

Pullman Review Pullman does a great job.

However, there is not enough room for residents park  due to the food vendor.  Something needs to be changed.

This place was great at first until change of management. We have had terrible communication, terrible service in general and everything is just so dirty after being built less than 3 years ago. Grass is dead everywhere and there's a constant musty smell in all the hallways, stairwells and even into our apartment. Would highly highly recommend looking elsewhere.

We moved into Pullman Pointe Apartments in May of 2021. We were absolutely in love with the place and would recommend it to anyone. To start off with, I am not the one to complain about anything, but something has got to give. New ownership took over the apartment complex and it has went downhill ever since. The facilities are not cleaned like they used to (hallways inside & workout facility), dog waste is scattered in the landscaping/yard, and you put in a work order and the maintenance team will not respond to you. We recently had a situation with multiple cop cars and the swat team outside of our apartment complex and we were never given an update. My family lives in this apartment and we never knew if we were really safe during this incident. The lack of communication during and after the situation left a lot of uncertainty and a concern for our safety. Finally, I received a call saying that we have "trash" in the package room and that we were going to receive a fine for this situation. Little did we know that our product was taken out of that box, but we were also going to be receiving a FINE for this situation as well. I called management and quote, "We are not liable for the package." I would highly suggest searching for a different complex that actually wants to make their residence a top priority.

I signed a lease back in January for an apartment in March. 2 weeks before I was supposed to move in I received a phone call stating the apartment was not available. Someone in their office didn't get proper paperwork from their tenant and they had to honor that the tenant didn't plan to move. There was never any effort on their part to make other accommodations for their mistake. They said they could refund me my application fee or I could pay more money to rent a different apartment. Come to find out from corporate that the lease was for April but I was told on multiple occasions March was the move in date. They don't know what is going on in their complex or office. Don't bother calling because they don't answer their phones. This was a *hopefully* a rare case but these are their standards! After this fiasco I had to scramble to find somewhere else in the two weeks I had. Found a great place that went above and beyond to accommodate the situation. I highly recommend looking elsewhere.
The staff is very nice easy to get ahold of move in was quick and easy!
The leasing agents are very rude and do not answer questions. Trying to understand their pricing and they would not explain or compare

Mostly great I like living here for the most part. The only thing that could be better is parking spots and making the parking lot brighter. It is very dark at night and I believe encourages car break ins which has happened on numerous occasions over the last year ian

Great Job I've had many maintenance requests and the guys are so polite, punctual, helpful and sooooo much more.  They're the 3 "D's".  You can't get any better.   They're keepers and I don't know how much they make but, they deserve a bonus and raise.   THEY'RE JUST PLAIN GOOD!!!!
Very Great Service. I'm glad to be blessed with a great maintenance team.
I love living here. The grounds are lovely and well kept. My apartment is wonderful and the maintenance staff is just awesome.
New Resident I recently moved back from Georgia and the staff at Seasons made my transition seamless.  Thanks to Nancy and Payge for all their assistance.   I love my new apartment.

If you are unfortunate enough to have an upstairs neighbor here, you will hear every single step they take magnified as the sound comes down through the floor. There's also a lot of noise from the garage door going up and down all day and night. 

My flooring has huge gaps in it vinyl planking, which they will not do anything about. 

The apartment was dirty and in disrepair when I moved in, and the management did very little about it. 

Outside doors are often broken for months, there are drainage issues, lots of dead landscaping, dry brown grass, and problems with the pool. 

For this price point, there are many, many better options out there. Keep looking.

I regret to say that my experience renting from Brige & Held's Alinium Apartments has been nothing short of a nightmare. It is abundantly clear that the company's commitment to maintaining their properties was sorely lacking.  

First and foremost, the condition of the apartment itself was appalling. The Trash pile outside of the non functional trash compactor was always unsightly, But perhaps the most egregious issue was the persistent water damage caused by pipes bursting. It's astonishing how frequently this occurred around the entire complex, and each time it happened, it disrupted our lives and left us dealing with the aftermath of flooded floors and damaged belongings.  

The companies response time and and time to act to these incidents was also very poor.  Despite my efforts to contact the office, it took several days for the office to respond about the event and then 2 more days to present their plan of action.   When i asked why this was taking so long the answer was that they were having so many similar floods that they couldn't handle all of them at once.  Their plan of action was to finally bring over a dehumidifier more than a week after the incident!   I wont even tell you the chaos of the poor remediation that took place after.  Mainly you walk in without proper notice of your place completely trashed and covered in construction dust.  I had to reside in an unlivable place for the next several days.  They never did finish the work while i was there for the next two weeks.  Just lived with a hole in the ceiling and got out quickly before the water soaked carpet started to get too moldy.  (BTW, they then tried to charge me $500 for replacing that carpet and immediately sent it to collections rather than trying to contact me.) 

But the problems didn't stop there. The amenities promised to tenants were a far cry from what was advertised. Take, for example, the pool. For an entire year, the pool heater remained broken, rendering it unusable for the majority of the seasons.

The rent prices were exorbitant considering the sorry state of the apartments. It felt like we were paying top dollar for subpar accommodations.  When it is time to renew your lease, good chance they will be charging and additional 25-50% more.  

look elsewhere for housing.

The electric bill is higher than it should be with no fix. When moving out they will charge you extra for things that aren't true with no proof of damage. Then they send it to the debt collectors, so you don't have a chance to dispute it. Very poor communication as well, could never get in contact with them.

Electric bills are skyrocketing. Renters beware. Ask about energy efficiency. Check with the electric company. They'll report their buildings are NOT energy efficient. Renters can save hundreds of dollars a month and stay warm elsewhere.

Living at the Villa's is more like living in a condo than an apartment.  The layout is spacious in our two bedroom upper story apartment, overlooking the beautiful lake.  My previous apartment nearby called themselves luxury, but they did not have the amenities that we have experienced here.  The appliances are not apartment grade, but the size and quality that you would see in a home.   The pool and barbecue area is very nice and user friendly with two large grills and a hot tub for waiting on your food to cook.  I have appreciated the ceiling fans the storage spaces, the granite counter counters and bar area, the rain shower heads and extended shower rods in both of the bathrooms.  The attached garage was a special feature that most apartments do not have.   All the staff have been helpful,friendly and gracious about helping with anything I've needed and that goes a long way in making this my home.

I moved from my 4 bedroom home in Fishers to this apartment in Zionsville and couldn't be happier! Nice pool, great amenities and best of all the staff is great! Casey is wonderful and I hope he's there for many years! Same goes for Eli and the rest of the gang. Beautiful apartments close to shopping and great schools, couldn't be better!

I just moved to the area to attend dental school and wanted a complex that was quiet enough to study and budget friendly while still giving me the full apartment experience. I fell in love with The Villas almost the minute I walked through the door. All the apartments are brand new and the kinks were worked out in a timely manner by an awesome management staff and maintenance staff. Great location and quiet but still super friendly. I can see myself living here for years.

So far so good! Across the street from Meijer, yet out of the hustle/bustle of the city. Downtown Zionsville is a gorgeous little town about 5 minutes away and then downtown indy is a quick 20 min drive. This is is a perfect combination for me. The apartment and entire complex is beautiful. When I go to the pool area I feel like I'm at at a Sandals resort. They have all the amenities of of a resort and it's right in my backyard! I love that my garage is attched. It really makes it feel like home. Granite counter tops!  Classy light fixtures!  Ceiling fans! These are things that most apartments wouldn't provide, or if or if they did provide them you would pay a hefty premium. Villas by watermark is beautiful and rent is affordable. The staff go out of their way to help you and get to know you. Unfortunately we have had ahead few leaks but management went out of their way to quickly resolve the issue. Thanks guys! Best apartment and management I've ever experienced.
Clean, safe community managed by a great team. An added bonus is that it is a completely smoke-free community.
Absolute best ever! Great quiet friendly area with great staff and amenities. Will stay here for a while.
Very nicely build .good people to work with easy to get along.
The Villas are a great apartment complex that is very good. I recommend it to everyone I talk to it about. Fiber optic internet and the great amenities are the biggest selling points.

Overall, I love this complex. It is new, clean, and well maintained. The staff is polite and helpful.  The buildings are new and have fantastic features. The only real downfall I've encountered is that there is only one dog waste bin, and it's in the bark park. For a dog friendly area with lots of grass, it would be nice if there were a few more disposal areas. 

But it's nice having an apartment that walks into like a house, walls that are thick so very few sounds from neighbors can be heard, and the pool area is fantastic. 

The only other downfall? Crickets, everywhere. I find them in my apartment from time to time, because they like to hang out by my front door in the evenings -- not that much can be done for them!

Living in "the Villas" by Watermark is like living in nice hotel resort, not an apartments development! Execellent value for money.. living in a super nice, brand new "villa,"  with access to an awesome pool and a nice club house with a gym.. while only paying apartment rent! Excellent location that is only 5 minutes away from the 65 highway to facilitate the work commute, and only 10 minutes from the beautiful historical district of downtown Zionsiville. Brand new development with magnificent taste in choice of interior design. We did not think twice!

I live in A-2 (one bed/bath) with an attached garage, and I love it.  It is a great open space, with tons of storage.  The kitchen is nice and making it very convenient  for cooking.  Since I've moved I've definitely been using the kitchen much more than my previous apartment.  The apartment also has a washer and drying which is a great perk.  The garage is really big, so its great for storage.  The property as a whole is very quite and relaxing.  I love having the valet trash as well.  The pool is great, and easy to get to as are the mailboxes.  Overall it is the best apartment I have ever lived in, and would definitely recommend it to anyone interested.

I just moved into this new apartment community located just off of the Zionsville exit from HWY 65.  Very convenient for commutes to Indianapolis where I work. The apartment community is brand new so it is very clean and well maintained. The pool is AMAZING!!!! Very well laid out complete with cabana's and a hot tub. The gym is spacious enough that you aren't elbow to elbow with other people while working out. A decent selection of equipment. However, those who are really into lifting and fitness will still be going tot the nearby LA Fitness as the dumbbells only go to 50lbs and there are no squat racks, smith machines, or barbell stations at all. My son LOVES the game room!! It has a vintage arcade game in it with all the classics atari games, Pac man, Donkey Kong, 1941, etc.!  If you don't opt for a unit with a garage there is still plenty of parking available. The floor plans are OPEN and very well laid out, granite counter tops, dark wood cabinets, and rain fall shower heads in both bathrooms. Ample closet space and even the bathrooms themselves are very spacious as far as apartments go. 

The only 2 draw backs so far is they have a mandatory "valet" trash service and ATT is the only available service provider for internet and cable to the best of my knowledge. The valet trash service costs you $25 per month and you have to pay for it whether you want it or not. Essentially you put your trash and recyclables outside your doorstep before 8pm every night and someone comes along and takes it for you.  Maybe I'm just frugal but for $25 per month I'll walk my own trash to the dumpster... 

Those 2 things aside though and this is a great place to live!! I don't think you will be disappointed at all.

The location of this complex is undeniably great, but in 2 months of living here I have discovered several little things around my apartment that don’t function properly or are broken, and the maintenance here takes literally 2-3 weeks to even respond to your work order request and then they do a terrible job that only temporarily fixes the issue, and then the 2-3 week cycle begins again; every time, with everything.

If you like to listen to your neighbors stomp or slam cabinets all day and night, this is the place for you.  Complex has mold, gnats/fruit fly and insulation issues and they are well aware of them but won’t do anything about.  Unable to open bedroom windows because they’ll fall out of the frame…maintenance won’t fix.  Maintenance has zero sense of urgency and can’t submit request to office…must submit a ticket and they’ll get to it when they can.  There’s no spa but on their website, they say they have one.  Nope…out of order for years and just filled it in last summer.  Still won’t remove from their amenities.  Had an amazing playground and now, they replaced with something that’s not fun.  Pet waste is horrendous and don’t bother complaining to office…again, won’t do anything but submit a “courtesy call”.  In order for anything to get done, calling their property management company is the only way to get them off their butts and do something.

I have lived there a few months and can not stand it. You can hear people walking, closing cabinets, etc in other apartments. Walls and floors are too thin. They do not clean hallways to apartments they are kind of yuk. Will be moving when my lease is up.

I moved out 5 months ago and have been trying to get my security deposit. Prior to the move out I filled out paperwork and asked if I could send an email with my new address. Management approved it and said I could send it anytime prior to the move out date. In June I asked management when I would should expect my deposit and they stated it could take up to 30 days. By July I contacted management again and was told that I never sent an email with my new address therefore they sent it to my old address?!?!?!. I forwarded the email and never got an answer from them showing my contact in April. After calling again at the beginning of August the manager was extremely rude and stated that they sent the refund in April and should have received it. When stated the issue she was short and acted like this was my fault. Now going into October I still don't have a deposit back. For having a clean apartment and zero issues its sad to see this money stay with a unprofessional staff and corporation!

This apartment is very outdated for what they charge you for monthly rent. There are much nicer apartments in the Fishers area that are better priced. Be aware that the apartments are filthy when you move in and the maintenance is terrible. If you decide to live here, make sure to carefully read your lease. My fiancé and I just moved out of this complex and the clubhouse claimed that we had no outstanding balances. A month later we were sent to collections. The staff is terrible in the clubhouse. They are very unorganized and are very uneducated about the property. Also, don’t bother going to management because they could care less about their residents. Overall, the complex is terrible and is not safe. They will take your money and then ask for more. Please don’t make the same mistake that my fiancé and I did!

My boyfriend and I moved in and have been living here since January 2016. This by far has been the BEST apartment I have ever lived in! The neighborhood is peaceful, quiet, and SAFE! We have never had any issues or complaints. The few times we have had to contact maintenance were for very minor things such as replacing a light bulb in the kitchen and a battery in one of our smoke detectors and they always respond quickly. But other than that everything has been perfect while living here. The office staff has been incredibly nice, friendly, and helpful! I would absolutely recommend this community to anyone! Even though we are looking forward to moving to our own home someday, we will greatly miss living here when that time comes!

Lived here for a little over a year. The office staff always answer the phone and are super friendly and helpful. Maintenance has reasonable response times and actually fix things, not that many things broke during my time here. 

The management takes very good care of the property with frequent touchups of various amenities. This place clearly understands re-investment. 

This area never felt unsafe, though being behind a Walmart is by no means reassuring.

As for the price, I found it to be one of the most reasonable options for a decent area and for what you're getting. 

The only reason I moved out was to save more money by getting a roommate. If my situation ever changed, I would likely move back here.
Been here going on five years and have enjoyed it,   the office staff and the maintenance staff are always helpful and any time I put in a maintenance request it was done quickly.
This property is beautiful the grounds are beautiful the staff is very helpful and the neighborhood is in a . Nice location
Office workers are sucks. Office manager needs to be fired from Avon Creek.   Maintenance technicians really helpful and kind.  But office manager and office workers really really rude.

Well. the neighborhood is a bit rougher than I realized when I rented here. There are quite a few issues that have happened with the unit but maintenance is always super fast (usually  same day) and fixes it right the first time. The office staff is professional friendly and helpful.   My apartment is nice overall and I feel safe here. As a single mom- it’s been a nice place to call home.

I’m not sure what other people experienced but for me I would definitely move here! The maintenance is EXCELLENT everytime I have had a problem they were on it RIGHT AWAY! My neighbors are great! The only bad thing I would have to say is that they are older and they really could use an updated kitchen.
I enjoyed my apartment at Eagle Chase. The management and staff was great.  I would highly recommend Eagle Chase
this place is exclent.. everything works, the office staff is super friendly and the maintenance of everything is up to date 24 hours everything is always kept impeccable

Great new leasing office staff.  Utilities are cheap compared to most other areas.  Our 2nd floor 2 bedroom with bonus room has a great open layout.  Very large door with a tree view.  Right across the street from Eagle Creek recreational walking trail.  Very large pool for the warmer months.  Nice location, 15 minutes downtown, 20 minutes to the Castleton area.

Having been a homeowner for several decades, returning to an apartment was quite the challenge.   But I found the prize here at Eagle Chase.   My building is so quiet, I often forget I have neighbors.   Everything is well maintained and anything that is not up to par is fixed immediately and hassle free.  This was important to me after years of needing to upkeep my house on my own.  My patio is my own peaceful oasis, and it is right beside a beautifully landscaped area where I can walk my dog.  The floor plan is open concept and doesn't leave you with that tiny apartment feel.  
To top it off, everyone from staff to residents are friendly and welcoming, and I really wanted that where I chose to live.
I wish I had sold my house and come here sooner for the easy life!

When I was ready to find a new apartment home, that is exactly what I was looking for. Not just a building filled with strangers. I thought I had made my decision, then I had one more page dog-eared that I almost passed by, but I decided to stop by just to say I had. Eagle Chase Apartments' staff was so personable and patient, I knew right away they had kicked the last place off of my list. The grounds and common areas are well kept, and the entire staff, including Kenny the maintenance guru, are perfectly suited for this community. They seem to go out of their way to make sure they know their residents by name, not just numbers on a door. That type of customer service is very important to me. If I have had any maintenance issues, they've been resolved within a short period of time. I love my apartment home and community and the convenience to all of the shopping facilities within a 2 minute drive or 20 minute walk.

I have lived at Eagle Chase for 2 years and I absolutely love it. It is extremely affordable for the amount of space that you get. The office staff is super friendly and maintenance is very fast with any issues that I've ever had. The exterior is constantly updated and there are a lot of events that the office puts on. Great place to live for a student like myself.

I would not recommend this complex at all… especially living on the first floor. First of all, the reason I am moving out of this building is because I was essentially forced to for no reason other than greed. My current lease is ending soon and I was told that in order to renew, I’d have to pay over $200/month MORE than what I have been currently paying. Unable to do that because the cost of rent (and parking, and utilities) is high already, I emailed back asking if there was anyway to keep rent the same. I was denied my request with absolutely no reason given. That situation was upsetting enough because the stress and COST of moving is so high, but to make matters worse, I’ve been watching the price they are listing my apartment for, and it’s dropped to $160/month LESS than what I’m paying. Instead of keeping me as a tenant and keeping my rent the same, they decided to screw me over by making me move out (which again… is expensive) only to realize they can’t rent the unit out for what they thought they could. I have now had to spend additional cost on movers, deposits, overlapping rent and utilities when I had no intention of doing so in the first place. Please know if you plan to live here, they do not care about you as a person at all. 

The noise around this building is absurd. Not once did I hear my neighbors, however the noise from the bar, construction, and trash pick up was unbearably loud. What was strange was the difference in noise level between the bedroom and living room. I could barely hear the outside noise from the living room but constantly worried that my bedroom windows were open. I ended up moving my bed from the bedroom to the living room so I could sleep through the night…

Parking is quite expensive ($150/month) and the garage is not convenient or SAFE when you live on the first floor. Often times homeless people are found sleeping in the garage or stalking the alleyway between the complex and the garage. I had a man who clearly did not live in the building start to sprint towards me to try to get into the building after me. Thankfully I was able to get the door closed or who knows what might have happened. To combat this if you’re living on the first floor, you have to go down the hall, up to another floor, down the hall again, into the garage, and go to the floor of the parking garage your car is parked at. Which is fine… just inconvenient.

I moved into Pulliam back in December and can say, without question, that I have had a stellar experience! My unit is gorgeous -- I love the state-of-the-art appliances and the fact that it's brand new! And the location? You can't beat living right above Mass Ave!

To quickly brag about the management team... these guys are here on site every single day, and have gone out of their way on multiple occasions to ensure that I have a great experience as a tenant. Needless to say, I have really appreciated it. I've lived in many other apartment buildings over the years and have had to deal with my fair share of lazy, irresponsible management teams, superintendents, etc. I was completely taken aback when I moved to Pulliam by how professional and "on top of things" the team here is in comparison to my past experiences. Additionally, all of the other tenants I've encountered have been pleasant to interact with and get to know.

To sum it up, I couldn't be happier having chosen Pulliam Square as my home here in beautiful Downtown Indy!

The apartments are good size They are freshly painted every time someone moves out.  They're maintaince man is really great and as soon as you let office know he is needed he is there as soon as possible. The only thin I wish they had is on site storage

I love the location of Hanna Village Apartments, but would love to win free rent for life in a 2 bdrm unit.

My current neighbors are nice, good location close to the interstate; shopping, gas stations, and most of all close to my elderly mother who wants for me to remain close.

The apartments are nice for the price, rather small, but the biggest issue is the management company is based out of KC, so there is little communication with them.

We have had recent neighbors move into the property that smoke cigarettes frequently, causing the entire building to smell.

If you have asthma, allergies, or are not a cigarette smoker, I'd suggest looking elsewhere.

I have never lived in such a beautifully unique property as Maryden. From the original woodwork, to courtyard space, to free parking this is the perfect property for anyone looking for affordable luxury living within walking distance to downtown Indianapolis. Can't imagine living elsewhere!

Thanks for being the best Maryden,

Lauren

The MaryDen is one of few historical buildings still left in what is considered the Old Northside of Indianapolis. It has charm and style and a cozy atmosphere. With all of the modern apartments and condomininiums that have been developed recently have overshadowed this vintage home sweet home apartment. You can't find windows as large as what is a great selling point at the MaryDen. The architectural structure of the ceiling and walls reminds residents of  history's love for the arts. Living at the MaryDen is unique and it's own work of art.

THESE APARTMENTS HAVE ROACHES! Saw roaches my first day Moving in and everyday since I’ve been here. I’m a very clean person never had them until coming here . Nobody answers the phones doors are always locked during business hours . Didn’t come with washer and dryer like they said also water doesn’t get hot at all literally had to boil water for a bath! These apartments are completely overpriced for them to have roaches and not do anything about it! Worst apartments i ever stayed 0/10 don’t recommend!

This is hands down the worst apartment complex I've ever stayed at. They brought in a contractor to work on flashing on the outside of my apartment from damage that occurred while the prior tenant was living there. That contractor caused damage to the inside of my apartment. I came home to busted drywall all over my apartment floor. I called maintenance immediately and they showed up in good timing being that it was after hours, but the picked up the large pieces with their hands and left over half of the real mess for me to clean up myself. They stated they would have it repaired. About 3 weeks went by and still know word on when it would be repaired. I then reached out to inquiry about the repair. That got their attention enough to call me on 3-4 different occasions and say the contractor would be entering my apartment that day to complete the repair. Each time I came home and it was not fixed. Another week went by, silent. This is now around 7-8 weeks after the initial damage. They reach out stating the repair would be completed. The repair was eventually completed by them patching over the water damage and mold that had since grown in the worst manner I have ever seen.

The owners and managers of this apartment complex clearly do not care about any sort of up keep at all. They take the bare minimum steps on repairs that are not even the tenants fault.

Lastly, the entire complex is coated in cigarette smoke. If you're not a smoker, be prepared to have your fan and air on 24/7 and spend a fortune on cleaning supplies when you first move in.

I do not recommend living here at all.
The entire time I lived here. The staff was very helpful. The maintenance staff made all repairs in a timely manner. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a apartment.

I've lived here for 2 years and haven't had any real issues. My experiences with the neighbors and management have always been pleasant . If I needed anything fixed, it was done the day I requested it or the following day. The spaces are nice and worth the money. The only things I didn't like were raising the rent and the unexpected closings of the gym/pool. I would rent again if I wasn't moving out of state .

TL:DR  The building is falling apart and the management is incompetent. 

Pros: 
Location is good
Prices are more or less at market rates for the location
Ramp makes moving in (and out) easier with a dolly

Cons:
Roof has leaked on and off for a year and half. They keep patching it, but the patches never hold for very long. Water spots on my ceiling the entire time I've lived here. Last time it leaked I filled four buckets with water. Any time that much water gets to drywall it's going to cause mold to start to grow. I've told management about this but they don't care. Won't even have it tested for mold. 

The building's old fire alarms are still in place, and I know that may sound like a good thing, but since the roof leaks, water has gotten in to the electrical system and set off the alarms several times. Since the building used to be a school, this means several fire departments show up and we eventually have to wait for one of the maintenance workers to come over with a code to shut it off. Last time it went off for several hours before he showed up with the code.

Kitchen lights begin flickering every month or so. Maintenance comes in and replaces bulbs. They last for another month or so. Rinse and repeat. 

The building has Latch electronic locks on all of the doors which is horribly inconvenient. Instead of using a key fob you have to download an app on your smartphone to use. The app is buggy and slow. You can't get packages delivered with any regularity because the delivery drivers can't get in the building. 

 And never, ever forget your phone or let its battery run dry. My neighbor had to break the window of her apartment to get into it after her phone went dead while she was out one night. She borrowed her uber driver's phone to call emergency maintenance but they didn't respond and her uber finally had to kick her out after waiting with her for 45 minutes. Maintenance finally did show up about three hours after she called. 

All of my dealings with management have been awful. They send passive aggressive emails threatening to take all of our bicycles and threatening to stop offering recycling services. They don't return phone calls. They don't care if you live there or if you don't. They only wan your money, and they'll do whatever they can to milk you out of every penny they can. 

This place is awful. Don't live here. Don't live anywhere managed by Core Redevelopment. You can find a better place for the same price elsewhere.

May not be as noticeable on lower floors, but in my 6th floor unit it was a literal 24/7 issue for my entire lease. It never once stopped. You can hear glass light fixtures rattle, my computer screens shake, and I’ve had to rearrange dishes in cabinets so I wouldn’t hear them constantly rattling against each other. 

If you tour, I highly recommend taking a few minutes to stand still in the unit. Bring a bottle of water. If you see vibrations in the water with it sitting on the counter, imagine feeling that every moment you’re trying to relax. If you WFH it’s unbearable.

Great spot near Mass Ave and access to 65 is great.

 If you’re not a dog owner or dog lover, the barking dogs are obnoxious.

The ‘gym’ leaves quite a bit to be desired if that’s something important to you. 

Property management group aren’t the most responsive to issues or concerns. I won’t be renewing my lease.

I have lived at the wyndham for a year and here is my take. Parking is tucked behind the building so my car feels safe. Fob key entrance is great. Overall, I'm so glad we signed our lease here. Only complaint is we never got that recycling bin, darn.

They increased my rent by 200 in the middle of a pandemic! The property is very nice and clean! Also the office staff is very friendly and helpful. They also willing to work with you. The few months I had been there, they worked with me through my hardship. I recommend this property to anyone.

The apartment are pretty nice. It’s really quiet without many problems. The maintenance is quick to fix problems. There is a need for more cabinet space in the kitchen. Great office staff , always happy to help and very understanding , the neighborhood stays clean , quiet , and not a lot of traffic in or around the apartments , UPGRADES ARE PHENOMENAL , if your moving permanently or for a while or for work related , definitely consider teal run .
Very quite & clean , the office staff is nothing like your ordinary leasing they really care for the residents , safety, and environment, definitely the only apartments east I recommend.
I  really enjoy living in the Teal Run Community . my apartment building is quiet and clean. staff is friendly and very helpful ,Keep up the good work Teal Run staff.

The staff are amazing I was impressed by the renovations, I definitely like the lock on the main door it gives you a since of security. Great place to live. Peaceful, quiet, and the neighbors are freindly including the staff...

Clean respectful respectable apartments and staff just call this home been here since April and I still love it nothing had changed (B.R.M)

My name is Robert Robinson and I am a current tenant at Teal Run Apartments. I love how much they've improved the exterior of our buildings and also the upgrades they've made to the inside of all the apartments! Working with Mrs. Terry has been a pleasure.
I love these apartments they are just wonderful. I live alone and truthfully I feel so secure and safe here. They recently renovated the whole community and I must say it looks GREAT from years ago!!

While looking for apartments in Indy to relocate from Evansville IN I was very frustrated nothing I saw online was what I saw when I arrived to the apartments or the prices where way off. Teal Run gave me a warm welcome the apartment is very nice and affordable. What I expected is what i got. The office staff is very nice. They keep the complex clean and its very quite. Come visit them THEIR GREAT

We are currently an older model community with new highlights and upgraded features.  The very vivacious colors and appeal; makes for an attractive gaze into the upcoming additions that the management company is sure to add in the year of 2015!  With shopping, dining, and entertaining within five minutes of the community...it is a sure promise that our future on this property will be one of the beautifully developed sites in the next 2016 year!!

I recently moved out of Marcy Village Apartments and i must say that they have come a long way from when i started. The staff is wonderful, so quick to respond to maintenance and genuinely care for you. I love the historic feel of the apartments and there was so much space outside. Conveniently close to everything you could need but felt to calm and peaceful.

The neighborhood is peaceful and tucked away in South Broad Ripple, a true hidden gem. I'm a huge foodie so being near all of the restaurants in Downtown Indy to Broad Ripple puts Marcy Village right in the middle. Also, walking distance to the Monon Trail & Target is less than 3 miles away.... What more could one ask for? The staff has addressed my needs and my maintenance issues were completed in a timely manner (Thanks Jose & Harry!). If you're looking for a place with character, I highly recommend checking them out. I will miss this place that we have built so many fond memories at but excited for our new home owning journey!
Cool historic place...lots of character. Maintenance and office are great...Jose is the man.

The washing machines are both broken once again, and the basement smells like mildew, several lightbulbs out. Carpet in hallway dirty/smelly, same cigarette butts have been on the ground outside for months. That’s just my building. This used to be a better place to live, it has gone way downhill.

Right off the Monon Trail and behind the Fairgrounds, there is always something to do. They take good care of the property and it showd!! I would hoghly recommend living here.

Staff are friendly, apartment is beautiful and the concierge is a great amenity!

Fire alarm goes off almost daily and it’s 99% of the time a false alarm. You’ll be woken up and have to go up and down the stairs. I’m not exaggerating, it’s driving me nuts. It just now went off at 1 am, 2nd time today.

I love living here! The amenities are the best, the concierge desk is super helpful and the residents are the best. I have been going back and forth about transferring from a one bedroom to a two.
