Highly disappointing, as this place is lovely.

We love living here at The Marott. The 24 hour concierge, fitness center, 2 pools, and business center are some of the staple amenities that are hard to get anywhere in an apartment complex especially for the price. Staff and residents are so nice here. Anytime I have ever had a maintenance issue someone has fixed the issue within one day. I definitely recommend living here.

Cons: small for price, no laundry in unit, basic kitchen, smelly hallways, lacks storage, small closets. 

Overall, I like this place and we plan to stay another year.
Castleton Manor's floorpalns are very large.  Nice community and great staff!  Staff is very friendly and helpful!
The best thing about these apartments is the location. Highway is accessible from several directions. Close to any and everything a family could need. Stop by and find your new home.

If you're looking for a clean, quiet apartment surrounded by pleasant residents I say give Pleasant Run a look.

Woodlake is located on the northside of Indpls, IN in a scenic wooded setting with lakeside views. Overall extremely happy living here and have just signed on for our 5th year.

You also have to pay for water and trash, even though its not valet trash. Expect to pay a lot for electric. The neighbors are often noisy and there's usually car alarms going off in the parking lot. But I like this place because I feel safe most of the time (given the area its in) and the appliances are nice and its a good amount of space for 1BD. Maintenance is timely and the office staff is nice. If you need an apartment for a short period of time, this'll do the trick.

Another reviewer mentioned that the water gets shut off often... that happened frequently for a few months, but they have not had to shut off the water since April of 2019 (almost a year now). There are a lot of restaurants and shopping along 38th street that are close by, but the interstate acts as a good barrier from some of the not-so-nice neighborhoods farther east on 38th street. In my opinion, this property is definitely on the upswing!

Keep up the great work!  I will continue to be a Bayhead resident with changes like these.

D.S.

The thing I really enjoy about the location is that its just far enough away from the city that you can enjoy a quiet night in, but still close enough to the city that you can be close to the action in minutes. 

I love the staff.  They are always super helpful and fast to respond to any issues I've had. They plan lots of get togethers and neighborhood parties throughout the year. 

I've looked at a lot of places to live in and around Indy and for the price, service and location, you can't beat Pebble Point.

I have lived in my apartment for almost five years.  The apartments were built in the 80s but in good condition.  Whenever I have a maintenance request, it is completed with in 24 hours.  The management is also very helpful.  I like that the one bedroom apartments are separated from the two bedroom and town homes.  If you are single, it eliminates children from playing near your street.

The apartment and the amenities are great, and you can't beat the location (the Monon is literally right out the front door). The leasing office staff (Kevin) was incredibly helpful and made the entire process flow very smoothly. I had the keys to my new place within the week.

Our apartment is in the city but not. You actually feel like you are in the country because it is off the main part of the city. The reason Trails gets 2 stars is because Teri actually does her job (besides trying to finesse me once but I forgive) and maintenance comes in a timely fashion when you put in a request. However, all other things get 0 stars. From the jump a nasty taste was put in my mouth when I was charged $25 for leaving my trash on the porch for 2 hours while I washed my clothes at the laundromat. I paid because I had no choice and we all had been notified before, but I thought we’d have an opportunity to take the trash considering the dumpster is clear across the complex. To make matters worse, the compactor/dumpster literally overflows every single week for at least 2 days. It smells so bad and looks terrible. Additionally, when I moved in the top of my refrigerator was grey from dust and there was fruit cocktail left in the parking lot for at least 2 months. The pool was closed 80% of the summer which is part of the very few amenities we are paying for. Let’s not fail to mention there is no business center, no ice makers, no washer and dryers and no lights come installed in the bedrooms (at least not in building 12 or 13). To leave a nasty taste in my mouth they have tried to charge me $65 for having to bleach the carpet which was left spotless and $110 for a dirty stove and dishes left in the cabinets. However, I did a final run through ensuring everything was cleaned and cleared out. I wasn’t going to leave a review but that final bill was the final straw. I truly wish my experience was better considering the situation that brought me to them. But in the end, they only added to the painful and stressful situation I was in.

This apartment complex sucks. The management here is horrible. The renovations were poorly done. They slapped on a new counter top on the old one. I called and left a message about my filter being filthy and after a week of not hearing anything I had to call again. Their walls are poorly insulated. On new years day my apartment flooded with 2 inches of water in every room. A lot of my things r ruined. My carpets are still wet and my whole apartment now reeks of mildew which is making me sick. I have a bad cough and feel like there is something in my chest. My dog is also breathing it in. They didn't help me with any of the clean up. My bathtub freezes from the poorly insulated walls and my walk in closet is freezing cold even with the heat on 72. My bed is in my living room right now because the bedroom smells horrible. Water comes out of electrical outlets. The dumpster is over flowing out into the road and its disgusting. I suggest u look elsewhere for a place to live and do not move in here.

We moved in last summer at the recommendation of a friend, but unbeknownst to both parties new management had taken over. The apartment was billed as newly renovated, and it did have new appliances. However all the other updates were cheap cosmetic fixes like a new coat of spray paint on the counters(which they weren't very neat about keeping from getting on the sinks and cabinets.) Within 24 hours of moving in we realized that the air conditioning wasn't working. Even with the windows open, fans on and the temperature only in the 70s the nights were unbearably stuffy and hot. It took them 3 weeks and repeated calls to fix that. Unfortunately it was just the beginning. We've dealt with cracks in the bottom of the bathtub, leaky faucets, doors coming off, gaps in the doors that let cold air seep through, repeated power outages, a master bed window that isn't sealed and lets water in and forms ice on the INSIDE OF OUR APARTMENT and the maintenance have somehow screwed up our comcast wires so many times it feels like it may be intentional given our complaints about the maintenance service. Of course we're the ones having to pay for comcast to come out and repeatedly hook our internet back up. These aren't even all the problems we have had. All of them took weeks, if not months for them to fix, and some of them still aren't fixed. We've threatened to move out multiple times and that seems the be the only thing that makes them come by, even then they only fix one or two things rather than all. We probably will end up moving out before our lease is up. Over the weekend a toilet flooded a bathroom for no reason and we can't use our kitchen sink because the faucet finally gave out. They also only have one dumpster for all the buildings, it's not emptied frequently, so many days there will be bags of trash spilling onto the road. I highly recommend you live anywhere but here.

My apartment has been overall pretty good. The price is not bad for the amount of space - a 2 bedroom, 910 square feet for $799. Kitchen could be updated but overall it works. The staff have been excellent. Maintenance has been quick. It's been a quiet neighborhood which is what I like!
New management is horrible!  Drunks and thieves now live here, I have had factory tires stolen twice!!!
Cute apartments with lots of closet space! Maintenance has always came the same day to fix things. Has a dog park that is super convenient for dog owners. Really Friendly workers too.

The leasing department went above and beyond in helping me to rent this apartment. They are nice, easily approachable, and make sure you are comfortable throughout the entire process. My apartment itself is very spacious and has all of the modern amenities. I have had no issues with anything since I have moved in and appreciate the staff and maintenance team. Would recommend especially if you work at the hospitals or areas around there as it is only a 15 minute drive.

The worst renting experience I have ever had.

There are CHEAPER safer apartments in downtown Indianapolis. I had to hassle the office about the dumbest things (trash being picked up, laundry rooms being cleaned, literally asking if they can mop our common areas or leave a mat out)

The cherry on top of my Christmas was our car wheels being stolen and then the apartments caught on fire. And after 8 months we were finally allowed to get our items back come to find out multiple items were stolen.

If you are thinking about renting in Indianapolis do NOT rent from a fairelawn reality company. They do not care about their tenants and hire staff that LIE on maintenance reports NEVER fully properly fix any maintenance issues the first, second, or third time.

And put there staff in a constant state of fear of losing their jobs.

there has been a lot of turnover in management and maintenance staff, and they are struggling to keep up. The upsides: 
-a property manager and a couple of solid maintenance people who care
-affordable
-safe atmosphere
-I've never had a problem with pests. 
-community laundry is in each building. 

The downsides: 
-They're catching up from years of neglected maintenance and, though they're making steps forward, they lack the resources from corporate to do much more than keep their heads above water. Many tenants are constantly battling fairly major maintenance issues, and none of the elevators have been in operation since I've been here. With more support from corporate to retain support staff and improve the condition of the property, this place could be great.

I have lived here since August 2015 and very much like the place. No, it does not offer a washer and dryer in your unit like some places and sometimes maintenance can get backed up. Also, it can be a bit of a hassle to get the office on the phone sometime but there are usually only 2 people who work in there with a about 108 units so I can see why. What I will say is Megan (I hope I am spelling it right) in the front office has always been really incredible. She's been very fair with me and always has a pleasant attitude. I would definitely recommend her for a raise! As far as location, I feel this is a prime area because you are 10 minutes from Broad Ripple, 15 minutes from downtown, and 20 minutes from Castleton. Not only are you pretty much in the middle of the city but it's in an area that is just beautiful to look at. The trees are just gorgeous to look at in the spring, summer, and fall! Plus this place is totally affordable for the amount of space you get.
Horrible save your time and money. Bad customers service.  Community looks like trash rent to high no parking

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME !!! You WILL NOT get what you think you will. There mission is to just get you to sign. The halls are filthy and smell like urine... Elevator that doesn't work. Laundry room is disgusting. The stairs and carpets in the building are gross. Where the model is, the conditions were a little better. After a week though, you would expect that someone would have cleaned but nope still dirty. 

I was promised one unit but then forced to go to another on a different level. I had no choice because i had to leave the place i was at before. I've been here less than a week and wish i just would have went to a shelter or something and found somewhere else. 

The staff is rude and just want your signature then they no longer care. I was not shown where anything was and you do your walk through in your unit yourself. 

The ONLY thing good about this place is that the unit itself is spacious... Save yourself time and look elsewhere !!!

Buildings are so old and very little to no renovations in 50yrs. My deck is completely dry rotted, 50yrs of paint in the walls so you touch the wall and paint chips off down to the drywall. Mold everywhere, laundry unit in building has ZERO ventilation it causes the walls in the building to actually be wet to the touch, it’s like a sauna from stream that it constantly sets smoke alarms off. Window by front of building has 2in gap from the top of window frame where glass has slid down and no one’s replaced it (a year like that). It’s not worth the money. Have it inspected for mold if you do move in, I promise you will find some!

Moved in 3 to 1 month ago. Apt is lovely, practically brand new! Don't care too much about patio area, just mud on my end til hot weather dries it up. Quiet, friendly. Maintenance is pretty ??. Hadn't had any of our request handled yet. Over all, it's nice. We still hope for a house n 2-3 yrs!

We are on lease #4 here. The apartments are older and need many updates, such as windows, doors, wood trim etc. The maintenance crew is pretty amazing. They usually come within a day or 2 of a minor complaint. The leasing office staff had been very helpful and nice to us. We've been going through rough times as of late. They welcome my dog, my credit isn't very good so we have slim pickings on apartments. They worked with me to get me in here. I didn't pay security deposits, I had to pay off some old debts from other complexes or bills like electric. They went through hoops to get me an apartment. For that I am very grateful.   The apartments are getting more and more expensive and we can't afford to stay here much longer. I wish we could stay longer. But with inflation and cost of living increases, we just can't make it work.  However, for the price and what they did for me to get me an apartment, it was well worth it!!
They have nice floor plans, and it truly a beautiful, quiet, and peaceful place
Just moved in and like the surroundings very much. Staff is friendly and neighborhood is easy to navigate. Apartment was clean and had new carpeting.

I am a current resident been here for approximately 6 months. I would Stay Away. The cheap price is nice but it is still overpaying for all of the nagging issues. My personal list is below and I urge other current residents to post their list to save the next persons piece of mind.

- Noted as dog friendly yet no dog stations, no off leash play area, and really no easily accessible trash cans for when people actually do pick up poop an action that is rare among residents.

- Constant stolen packages notices (3 stolen personally out of like 7 total). Note the management refuses to do anything to change the situation or help find who is stealing them just says file a report.

- Basic security issues. Front door doesn't actually lock 90% of the time lock. I have seen homeless sleeping in front lobby chairs. Also i believe a contributing factor to the package thing above.

- Mailboxes are not behind any locked doors aka open to the public. where the packages get dropped again contributing to the package stealing issue.

- I have had my catalytic converter stolen and have heard many other catalytic converter incidents from fellow residents. In my incident i inquired multiple times to the staff for video or anything to give to detectives but no information was given from them.

- Elevators are notorious for stranding people. Even the one they sent an email out about today saying it worked i heard had someone stuck in it for an hour. Their excuse is the door being held open too long breaks it and they blame the residents instead of maybe getting a new elevator, maybe one with a ceiling that doesn't have the lights taped to the ceiling.

- Maintenance management system is third party and causes issues for the staff. Which leads to  open maintenance request being open and unaddressed for more than 3 months at times.

-No onsite management EVER. The two maybe three maintenance men are forced to work on 4 different buildings (2 other complexes and edge water) and edgewater is obviously the last priority and in the worst shape.

I'm sure If i sat here longer i could list many more issues but i am tired and out of words.

Final note: I love the area but the management and the building has really made it a headache to live in this area. Stay away go find an apartment complex not run by Birge and Held
Cute modern updates, gray & white, "farm housey" vibe. Nice office staff and maint. Good location - near pretty much everything.

I have been with community place apartments since 2015. This complex is absolutely above average in the cleanslyness. The maintenance is 24/7 and always responds very quickly. The location is perfect and quiet on the Southside in Perry schools. All our neighbors are so friendly and the complex feels very safe. The units are beautiful and very large. I haven't ever had a single issue with this company. The staff are really professional and truly care for there renters. The walking paths are perfect for family walks and morning runs! Parking is at convenient and plenty of. And my kids love the yard space to play and the playground!! Pets are welcome! And prices are very reasonable!! I am super picky where I rent and community place well exceds my expectations and more! This has been the best rental experience I have had in Indianapolis!!
I've lived here at Community Place for a year now and it's great. It's a nice family friendly complex and my family and I feel safe living here.

I have lived at Community Place for 9 years and am very happy here.  The management here is very very good.  They are accessible and get things done quickly.  They are extremely pleasant to work with and care about this community.  I have lived in apartments since the 1980's and this is one of the best I have lived in.  The property is being updated, we just had new windows installed which are great and hopefully will keep the warmth in this winter.  We have done energy upgrades here to preserve the environment and also help with the expenses of heating and maintaining through the winter.  I absolutely love that it is pet friendly.  All in all it is an excellent place to live and I would recommend it to any of my friends.
I have  lived here for 9 years and signed on for #10.  Great care for the needs of residents, great management!
I have lived here 2 years and love the apartment. The units are spacious and a decent price.

I lived  at Woodbrook Apartments for a year and from the time that I moved in, the apartment was not orderly. There was plaster on the walls that were never sanded down or painted. The doors were off of the closets and never placed on. The rails on the patio were broken and never fixed, Amongst many other issues. When I first moved in, neither of the toilets work properly. I reported this multiple times and maintenance came to my home multiple times but each time they didn’t fix anything and the toilets seem to be worse each time they came. There was only one maintenance worker for the entire complex, which I assume has a minimum of 400 units. She was very nice, but always seemed very tired and very clearly overworked. Also, The staff were not helpful when it came to issues with the payment portal. I had a misunderstanding with Conservice which caused for a small balance to be left in my portal. I explained this numerous times to the front office and showed many  supporting documents, but they were not helpful and never waived the late fees that are now totaling in at least $1000. I’ve recently received an outstanding debt letter from a debt collector because of this. I’ve been beyond cordial and patient with this property, and to say the very least I feel taken advantage of. I’m strongly considering filing a complaint With the Department of Housing and Urban Development and the Better Business Bureau.

Lived here for a year had permanent stains on my glass patio door, bathrooms are tiny, apartment is very spacious they’ve increased the rent significantly. Maintenance is decent I’ve seen worse. Be careful they will take your whole security deposit for the smallest thing.
I like the size of rooms. Workout room a plus. Nice lake.

Plus the layout of the apartment was not what we were told we’d be getting. We were supposed to have a whole laundry room and we did not. Fast forward a few months and our upstairs neighbor shot and killed someone 20 feet from us. Nobody offered to lower our rent after my balcony had crime scene tape on it. Nobody offered us and type of support. 
This place is ran down, management is iffy, maintenance is iffy, and the complex is not safe. Cars get broken into or stolen constantly. There has been multiple shots fired and then a murder 20 feet away from me. Awful. For the insane rent prices this place is not worth it

I have lived here through management change.  The current manager does not care about your living experience.  Multiple drug and noise complaints have been filed and police have been called, yet management refuses to address concerns.  Advertising should read “Warm bodies needed to fill units.”

From the amazing community activities, local food discounts for residents only, and HEATED pools, we love love love living here. The facilities, staff, and neighbors are A+. The apartments are upgraded, very on trend and the grounds are kept immaculate. I live here with my teenage daughter and find it very safe and friendly and QUIET.

Chase is the best leasing associate I have come to meet through apartment searching a few times over the last 4 years - approximately 60 apartment complexes including another state. Rent is very reasonable for the best quality I have seen in an apartment (granite counter tops sold me). Chase and the property manager were both understanding and accommodating when I needed to move my move-in date due to unexpected military orders including letting me keep the same rent. Chase was very open when I brought up the negative reviews I had read and didn't seem to cover anything up. I know I make final decisions based on critical-read reviews so I will update once I become an official resident.

Multiple cars with smashed windows on two separate nights in the last two months. In front of my building alone more than 7 car windows smashed and the cars ransacked. I started looking for a new place. Before I could get out I had my bedroom window smashed in and my apartment ransacked. Despite all this management has done nothing but send emails and “request additional patrols”. Based on what I’ve been told there have been as many as 50 cars broken into at this apartment in the last two months. If you want to feel safe in your next home, avoid at all cost. Despite not feeling safe in my own home the manager Corey told me that this “did not consitute letting me out of my lease”.

This comment will probably be deleted since that seems to be how it works when you don't say what management wants you to. I would never recommend living here. I was understanding and supportive for the entirety of my lease, followed all rules, paid rent every month on the first, etc. There were times I had to park a full mile away from my apartment after coming home late at night because of their construction trucks. It took 7 days for them to reply to an emergency toilet issue to where I had to leave my apartment and go to Marsh to use the bathroom. This happened 3 or 4 times before the maintenance guy finally figured out what was going on. Creating an apartments.com account purely to prevent people from living in this place that only wants your money and doesn't care at all about you!

While the apartments are not bad themselves, the fact that the complex is going through a major renovation, a poorly managed one, takes away all the good things I had to say.

If you like to live in the construction zone with noise, dust, heavy machinery and blocked parking spaces, this is the place to move in.

Btw, the construction will not be done until August 2017.

and the material is left outside in the rain and snow. Good case for mold down the road...

I lived at Lakeshore for about a year doing 6 month leases at a time.  Lakeshore is very affordable and in a nice neighborhood.  The apartments are reasonable, and in an area with lots of shopping.  

Rent varies depending on locations/appliances in apartment.  Work orders took a while to get filled with appliances going bad during my lease but they gave me a MARSH gift card for my troubles and replaced my washer and dryer with brand new equipment.  The people in the office were very pleasant to work with.

Only area that needs improvement are hallways inside actual apartments.  Very unkept common space, management seems to disregard this and does look ugly.

At the same time, price is extremely affordable!

The location on 82nd street is terrific in regards to places to eat and shop. Everything from fast food to 5-star steak and seafood restaurants to quality sports bars are within a 5 minute drive. Two high quality grocery stores (Marsh and Fresh Thyme) within a 1 minute drive of the complex. My actual single unit itself is well maintained. I opted for the older appliances to save money, and they all work just fine, despite their older looks. I did have to supply my own microwave, which I found odd. There is a washer and dryer in the unit contained within it's own wash room. In my experiences with apartment living, having a washer and dryer in the unit is fantastic. The bathroom is huge for a single apartment. It has a large sink area, towel closet with multiple shelves, a medicine cabinet, the tub is a nice size and the faucets are more than decent. There is storage under the sink as well. The bedroom isn't huge, but it's cozy with a few pieces of medium sized furniture and a queen size bed. Still enough room for two people to move around, but you wouldn't want to have a party in there. The bedroom does have nice sized walk-in closet with shelving.  I was able to fit my dresser in my closer and still have plenty of room to hang clothes and store shoes along with a few other bags and items. My bedroom has a bookshelf, a medium sized coffee table with TV, a queen size bed, a dog bed and there is still room to walk around, even lay down, on the ground. I opted for the larger of the two single bedroom floor plans, so I have an area for a small dining table adjacent to the kitchen and living space. The kitchen itself is an ok size with some counter space, but if you have any appliances like I do, more than 2 and you'll be eating up a bunch of counter space. The fridge is a decent box fridge with an ice maker in the freezer. Could use some more cabinet space, but it's ok for one person. The dual well sink is nice, and the older dishwasher works just fine. The dining area is small and barely fits my small, round 4 person table, but it works. The living area is considerably smaller than similar apartment complexes in the area typically have. I have a 3 seat couch, an ottoman, a recliner with a small TV stand and it feels a bit tight at times. I also crammed my smaller sized desk behind the couch, but I didn't have much choice. Every unit has a patio or balcony. It's a nice size and fits two lawn chairs and a table nicely.

I have lived at Lakeshore Apartments for 10 months now, and have had a mostly positive experience.  The office staff and maintenance are great and the property is very well maintained!  And although turning left out of the apartment complex onto 82nd street can be a bit of a challenge, the location is almost perfect.  My biggest issue has been a neighbor that moved in a few months ago.  She likes to play loud music and turn up the bass, which is frustrating at times.  My only other issue is the carpet, which can be a pro or con, depending on how you look at it.  The positive side is the complex almost always replaces the carpet between tenants.  The negative side is since they replace the carpet so often, they must buy the cheapest carpet on the market.  My carpet was new when I moved in 10 months ago and it’s already matted down pretty bad in all the high traffic areas.  All in all, however, I’ve been happy and would suggest Lakeshore Apartments to anyone checking out this part of town.

Lakeshore is the only apartment complex I've lived at since moving to Indy in the spring of 2013. I have obviously liked it enough to keep living here - there is a lot to do in the nearby areas. It's also very convenient to have 465 a couple blocks away, allows you to choose highway or Allisonville for the commute downtown. The apartment itself has treated me well and I really have no complaints about it. I've had a couple things need fixing or patching up (normal wear and tear), but the maintenance crew has taken care of it rather quickly. The only thing that might keep me from living here longer would be the fact that it can be a little expensive for a one bedroom apartment. It's a little pricey, but I understand for the quality of living around here it must be kept that way.

Maintenance request suck!!
I have two broken feet and requested to be let out of my lease do to medical reasons so I can move in with family and they won't let me.  So I requested to move to a down stairs unit and they won't let Me!!!
Great apartment a little expensive but worth it. Takes a while for them to fix things tho

I have lived at Lakeshore for 5 months and love it! The people here are all very friendly.  The leasing office as well as the  maintenance staff are all very friendly and helpful.  The location is awesome..close to interstate access as well as all the shopping and restaurants.  The work out room as well as the two pools are very well taken care of.  I love living here!
I have been a resident of Lakeshore for nearly two years and it has been a pleasent experience! If there have been any maintenance issues the staff has been quick to respond.

I have been staying at the Lake Shore Apartments for about a year and I am happy  to state that they have been great. The apartment sizes and location provide fast access to the highway in addition they size of the room is a coupled with the rent amounts provides a great value. The staff is attentive to my needs, I have had to have them replace a refrigerator that stopped working and which they did very promptly. I frequently purchase items online and they are always helpful in ensuring my items are available for me when I return from work. In the morning the grounds keeping staff is always working to maintain the grass and pathways they also do a good job of clearing the snow during the winter.
All round great service and a value based price

If you enjoy having hot water, don’t rent here. Our hot water has been out 3 times since living here, with the last instance resulting in 4 days without hot water. 

Also plenty of leaks, broken elevators, car break-ins, random 2 hour fire alarms and plenty of other issues. 

Incredibly poor building management and no care for their residents. 

Worst apartment experience ever. You can absolutely find somewhere better to live  that cares about residents and knows how to take care of apartment community so it isn’t falling apart every week.

As I was moving into my new Maxwell apartment, I received a phone call admitting me last minute to my dream medical school. I made the decision to move out. The Maxwell was too kind and helped me in every way possible. They helped me figure out how to break my lease in the most economical way, they helped me find a lunch spot to rejuvenate after moving all of my belongings two times in one day, and they were kind and understanding with my situation. I was incredibly sad to move out immediately, especially after the staff was so kind. 

The small amount of time I spent in the apartment was great. The facilities were top notch and beautiful. I had a curtain rod broken when I moved in and the maintenance staff fixed it within an hour. Overall the Maxwell was one of my best apartment experiences to date.

The noise in this apartment is by far the worst I have ever experienced in any apartment.  I have sent multiple emails to the manager regarding extremely loud popping noises from the upstairs apartment  and nothing has been done.  I have also dealt with a stereo so loud that you could hear it in the parking lot.  The noise is affecting my mental health and giving me anxiety. People race through the parking lot like it is the Indy 500.  I don't recommend this place at all.

Marijuana smells the halls and apartments every morning and evening and night miserable for the elderly on oxygen these people are too old for this nonsense!

Rundown property. Was not maintained by original/previous owners, was dumped/purchased by new owners who are based in Florida. New owners have had 2 1/2 years to make improvements, very little, other than a few cosmetics, have been done. I do believe current property manager & staff are trying but it is a no-win situation. Perhaps if Florida corporate had to deal with caved-in ceilings, no a/c, no water, consistent flooding, panhandling, vagrants, and on and on and on, they might have a different perspective. Very sad.
Great maintenance crew... Excellent management team they are really doing their best to bring this property up to date I give them four stars...
I never had a issues with this place if I have a issue they will take care of it ASAP. Everyone I have talk with is very nice and understanding. Never had anyone talk down to me.

I often felt unsafe at CityView. There were roach infestations, water damage that wasn't addressed for weeks, and plumbing issues from the beginning. My apartment flooded from another unit and I was uncomfortable/unable to sleep there for several days. Due to this flood, I came home one day to several industrial size fans blowing and the floors sticky, with no text/email/phone call saying there were maintenance workers in my home. I was also denied my security deposit back when I was told incomplete information about the move-out process.

Is definitely not the safest place to live in.. lots of people carry guns, and let’s not talk about the shooting in the lobby and they act like nothing happened. AC always down on summer 80° plus temperatures, is always lies and lies, people breaking on people units, security cameras don’t work. Just not the best place for the prices…. Save your money and find a better place for.

I beleive it's important for prospective tenants to know that I have seen more than a few people on the elevators on this property casually carrying firearms, as in loosely, in baggy pants.  Kind of unnerving.  There has also been gunshots fired in the lobby in recent years.  The bullet holes still exist.  I have spoken to management here and they say there's nothing they can do, even though it's private property and they could issue a no firearms policy in their lease.

This place looks nice in photos, but in reality there are bed bug infestations on multiple floors. They won’t disclose that to you and might even offer you a rent special, ask them if it comes with bed bugs.

The fixtures are old. Windows and sliding door have seals that are crumbling, cold air gets through all the cracks and makes noise.  You can’t control your own heat/ac because the old boilers they use in every unit won’t allow it. 

Overall the building is in bad shape and they’ve done a lot of cosmetic changes. There’s rust and mold everywhere, just look at the tiles on the ceiling when you walk though. 
The hallways look like an old scummy hotel, the elevators are in poor condition, some of the buttons have fallen off and sometimes the elevator won’t stop in your floor. 

There’s no visitor parking. Rent is downtown prices with none of the perks except free gated parking. Beware

I lived here for several years and after a new owner took over - Zinger from Chicago - they did unnecessary renovations while residents were inhabiting the property which is illegal. Tenants who'd lived there forever all moved out because they hiked-up the rents on top of being forced to live through sloppy and cheap "up-dates" by CRG construction. Quality of life dropped swiftly. Druggie neighbors and the place was riddled with bed bug on every floor with the cost of exterminators falling on any resident who wanted treatment. They did nothing. Management never stayed. This place went from being an elegant secret to a glossed-over dump.

It is my second year at this place, and I can say that the office assistant that was last year was the best I could get! The assistant now (from the main office) is a person GROSERA does not help the requests I have made and they never have a quick solution with the damages of the apartment, however the very friendly cleaning staff like the two girls who They are in the night shift and the facilities have improved compared to 2018, they should take into account who they have in the front offices in the afternoon shifts, since that discredits a good rating for this place.

To start with, the management in the leasing office is extremely unorganized and was barely helpful to us in times of need.  Went months without both a washer and dryer and the property never compensated us for our losses.  Overcharged for damages at the end (upwards of $2000 for minor damages/normal wear and tear).  Half the properties are renovated and others are not, but you pay the same price even if you live in an apartment that is not renovated.  And if your appliances are old and stop working it would be months before they would fix it no matter how often we checked in and gave them a stern nudge.  Would never in my life recommend someone to live here. Absolutely disappointed all around.

Gardens of Canal Court continues to let my roommate & I down. 
We have asked for a new fridge because the freezer stopped working one day & blamed us for breaking it because we turned the temperature up 1 notch. 1 NOTCH PEOPLE!
Took WEEKS to get a proper working fridge & had to live out of a 5’2 fridge, which upped our electric bill. 
We also asked for a new sink & countertops because we were due for an upgrade on our sink & our countertop was damaged when the repair guys came to install a new stove. 
We were told that we would receive a phone call to schedule getting our countertops done but on a random day @ 9am, maintence was pounding on our door & telling us to get out, when we were A) NOT INFORMED WHATSOEVER & B) gave us 5 min to get out of the apartment. 
It continues to get better …
whenever Amazon Packages get delivered it’s a hit or miss on if it actually gets delivered to your correct apartment, so if you are missing a package “that’s on you”, Gardens will NOT help you no matter how many times they say “we will keep an eye out”. 
You could walk around the Earth before Garden’s of Canal Court takes initiative in finding your packages. 
It took us MONTHS to convince Gardens to get us a new washer & dryer. We would have to run our dryer 2-3 times just to have our clothes dry.
Might I add, when they came to fix it, Maintenance left dirt & leaves ALL OVER our carpet & kitchen & bathroom (yes, they used our bathroom). & we had to purchase stain remover & clean our carpet after that. 
There was also a resident that was reserving parking spots when in the contract it says “parking spots are first come first serve, no saving or reserving.”
This person was violating the contract & was reported to Gardens & they did NOTHING. 
They claimed they talked to the person & that it wouldn’t be happening any more but it continues happening to this day. 

This property is immature, rude, inconsiderate, & quite frankly do not care at all about you.
You can find 100% fine someplace that will care for you and your apartments needs. 
Pick someplace else.

Never rent here, the leasing office continues to treat us like crap and the do not have good customer service. They do not listen to any requests and everything is a huge hassle with them. Do yourself a favor and pick another apartment complex, you can find apartments with way better customer service for an equivalent price.

I love the Gardens of Canal. The maintenance team and the leasing office members have always been very responsive and helpful! They really care about tenants. Also, the location is amazing with access to the canal! Overall great experience!

BEWARE they will never fix any thing or claim responsibility for any utility fixes. DO NOT COME HERE IF YOU ARE A STUDENT OR WORKING PROFESSIONAL. If there was a zero star that is what they would get. Been without internet for 10 days now. AT&T has been more than helpful to come 3 times; all the times Gardens has failed to help. It is Gardens responsibility to provide its tenants with the phone, cable and internet lines in the walls by hiring contractors. The building needs a new cable and Gardens is not hiring a contractor to provide its tenants with phone, cable and internet. First it was Spectrums fault (it was not, Gardens want others to fix it); then the building manager was on a day off (on Wednesday!); then we have to ask the neighbors permission (which we have now); we have done everything Gardens wants yet they still do not provide us with a utility. Also there are animals (rats or mice) in the attic - courtesy of the AT&T tech and our neighbors. Mrs. Sexton (owner) if you are reading this we desperately need internet for student and work!!! Either hire a contractor and wire us in to AT&T or pay for us to switch to a service that is available. We need internet!

As an IUPUI student moving from out of town, this seemed like the most convenient place to live. Convenient distance, sure. However my experience with the Sexton staff and management of this complex has been largely negative. If you're renting any apartment anywhere, things are bound to break; I won't fault Gardens for that. But once repair time comes, the lack of communication and general indifference demonstrated by the staff is actually quite alarming. I was accommodating to them when they needed repeated (and destructive) access to my unit to fix their building, and they ghosted me when it came time for them to fix their mess. Entirely disrespectful, as I and my colleagues are kind, clean tenants who try to raise minimal fuss over anything. They also don't allocate their parking appropriately, so I hope you enjoy roaming up and down Fayette street at 1AM if you happen to work late. Avoid avoid avoid.

I've lived here for nearly two years. The apartments are clean and spacious, and very affordable for the location. The maintenance staff is professional and fast, and I have never had any problems with bugs. The Core Redevelopment staff are in the building and are professional and quick to respond. They also do a great job communicating via email and text any general updates for the property. Overall, I have had a great experience.

This complex although relatively quiet, is trash! Current resident can’t wait until my lease is up one thing after another! Last July shortly after moving in we had a series of storms come through and completely flood out my living permanently damaging 2 rugs of mine. I reported this incident, no one ever came out to Investigate the flooding or anything. Then the AC goes out a few weeks later and I was told by the office staff that they wouldn’t send anyone out for at least 3 days (this happened on a Friday so no one would come until Tuesday) because the temperature outside was less than 80 degrees (while it was near 90 inside my apartment) so it didn’t classify as an “emergency” also the lady from the office staff was extremely unprofessional, refused to explain or answer any of my questions and even hung the phone up on me mid sentence! The neighbors across from me are always fighting and yelling and have obnoxiously loud barking dogs, and I also recently had an Amazon package delivered and stolen by who I’m assuming to be the contracted workers who are replaced the carpet in the exterior hallways in my building. ALSO maintenance never fixed the sink in my bathroom that wouldn’t drain… I ended up having to resolve that on my own and the toilet in my bathroom needs replacing, doubt they’ll do anything about that either. Also there’s been numerous times where the dumpsters on the property have been overloaded and trash strewn about the parking lot. This place is embarrassing and a joke! DO NOT LEASE HERE they don’t care take your money elsewhere!

I haven't seen the so called fountain in the pond? yet.  No security, poor lighting, hidden fees and maintenance lies or doesn't come.   Photos shown are misleading and a double sided fireplace in the middle of the living room is NOT an open concept!   No dining area,  kitchen is so tiny you can't move to cook.  No fire extinguisher in our building since we moved in.  Atrocious hallways,  saw them cleaned once since move in. Have yet to see any of the amenities,  doors are locked.  Oh and did I mention the pond? is green?  I think we have the only American flag flying except the office.  So if you like hidden fees and green retention pond water ?? this is for you. (Had to throw in the sarcasm)

My roommate and I toured this apartment and immediately wanted to move and loved everything about it. The room sizes were great and the layout was great as well. The gym and pool and facilities all looked very nice. After paying for application fees and applying for the apartment, our experience went on a steep decline. We both have never experienced such poor communication with any business. The only way for us to communicate with the leasing office was for both of us to drive all the way there because the office never answered any calls or emails. I had to call the office 7 times for them to finally pick the phone up and do their jobs. We are hoping that the communication is better throughout our lease.
A lot of hidden fees. Your payment is not the same and always higher than what you agreed upon.
they hold monthly events for residents, they always seem helpful and very friendly. Maintenance has recently changed and they seem more on top of things then the last group they had.

The apartments have been updated but the buildings are still very old and the windows and doors don't work properly which lets in a lot of cold air in the winter. If you have a 2 bedroom apartment, the water bill will be $100 per month. Watch your monthly statement as management has double billed every resident in the community for several months for trash and pest control (which wasn't refunded back to the residents after it being brought to their attention.) Upon move out, management will come up with inflated and erroneous charges to add to your account.
Moving here Thank you Olivia for your help in assisting my husband and me in the application process. You went above and beyond!

Tania is amazing!! She showed me around the property and helped me pick out a perfect floor plan while answering every question or concern I had. I went on multiple apartment tours, but this is the only one that truly felt like home to me. The management and staff is top tier and I highly recommend!
Prestine community! Staff is really helpful. Highly recommend!

Thank you to Melanie and Gaby for helping me with applications, appointments, and leasing options. I was happy to talk to leasing agents who were considerate, professional, courteous, and kind. Thank you for helping me explore short term and longer term leasing options.
A must vist as your looking for your next HOME.  This is a beautiful property and a great staff . Ask for Gaby she was very helpful and knowledgeable with the property.

It’s a really beautiful well kept property, I really like the pool that over looks the lake. 
The people in the office are amazing and very helpful, this truly is a wonderful place
Great staff! Beautiful property! Close to everything! You’ll love living at Sundance!

Sundance at the Crossing is a great apartment complex!  The people who work there are helpful and nice!  They have great amenities and I love the events they have for the people who live there!  A great place to live in my opinion!

I love my apartment!! I just recently moved in. I absolutely love the office staff. They have been awesome since I started my process on trying to move in. The girls in the office are all super sweet and the office manager Melissa was very helpful and welcoming. The community is quite and very well kept. My daughters and I love it!! Location to shopping and family is GREAT!! We will definitely be here for a while :)

These apartments are very nicely designed and reasonable with rent.  The grounds are beautiful, have nice amenities  and the location has great access to shopping restaurants and easy access to the highway.  The staff is extremely helpful and sponsors fun resident parties to help to get to know your neighbors.  That goes a long way in helping build a nice community.

We have had multiple issues with the maintenance of the apartment. Work orders are put in and nothing is done, some are even marked complete and no one comes to look at the issue. The maintenance supervisor is too worried about drinking his coffee and talking down to residents than he is with fixing minor issues that the residence expect complete. If other properties in this company are run the same way I don’t see how this company makes money.

I have lived here 9 months, I have had work order put in before I move into my apartment that still have not been addressed, there are not enough parking spaces so if you leave at night you have to park you car somewhere you can see your apartment.  The outdoor hallways have not been cleaned since I've been here. Good location, good potential, horrible experience.

I have been living here for just over a year. I love the location! My apartment has a huge amount of natural light and the bedrooms are spacious. 
I have had good interactions with the staff when issues arose.

I've been here for over a year now and my experience has been very good. Spacious apartments and a layout that offers a lot of grass and lakeside space to take the kids out for a walk. I'd recommend these apartments to anyone.

Aside from its location, there are not many redeeming qualities this apartment has to offer.  The kitchen is pathetically small, and the dishwasher is a joke (pointless to use it if you plan on getting your dishes clean).  

The bathroom is an even bigger joke.  The vanity looks like it was made in 1935...and the towel rack is over 6 ft from the edge of the tub.  Whoever designed this bathroom must've been incompetent or high on drugs.

Lastly, no matter how many times I scream about the littany of dog waste surrounding the complex, nothing seems to improve. 
At least they provide new-ish washer/dryer combo.  Otherwise it would be a total loss.

The staff at Sundance, both in the office and the maintenance staff, are really great and very responsive.  Compared to other apartments in the area with similar amenities and size, they are very affordable.

There's better places in the Indianapolis area, but if you're constrained to the south or southeast side, this place is very nice.  Small gym, pool, bball courts nearby, tennis and racquetball, and stocked ponds!  There's a lot of nice features.  

Personally, if I could live anywhere in Indy, I would look for a 24 hr gym (theirs closes around 11pm and opens around 6am, so I can't work out before work since I leave at 5am).  Service can be good or bad depending on who you get, so I always try to discuss issues with Ashley- she's the best to work with if you're looking to move here.

I can honestly say that our 4-year stay has been nice. The office staff have been nice and prompt about any concerns. Jenny, officer manager, is super helpful with my concerns that I've had and even reached out to check on our family when she had heard there was an ambulance in the area. 

Some of the maintenance staff could use work. I'll leave it at that.

The community is great. Our neighbors are the absolute best. Very welcoming, warm and pretty quiet. While taking walks, people speak and wave. Something as small as that makes the experience nice. 

Overall, I don't have complaints. We're a growing family so we're forcing ourselves to leave eventually but this apartment community has been great for us.

We lived at Chateau Deville for two years. The apartments are old, moldy and musty smelling. The management changed several times over the course of the two years and policies would change constantly. When we moved out (finally), we were charged $1000 to replace the carpet for "pet damages and stains". We did have ONE dog living with us over the course of two years that is SEVEN years old and never once had an accident in the house. We know that for a fact. When calling about the charges that we were given, they said that they would send pictures of the so called "stains" which they did. But, the pictures are no proof that it is OUR carpet or from our pet. We know for a fact that our pet never went to the bathroom in the house, so there is no way we have stains from a pet. We were good tenants for over 2 years. Always paid rent on time. Always cleaned up after ourselves and our pet and never caused issues. I'm very disappointed in the charges that we were given because we had paid a deposit when we moved in as well as $30/month for a pet fee that essentially went to nothing. It's tough when you've been a good tenant, not damage anything, and get punished for something that you know didn't happen. We will never rent from them again or recommend anyone to do the same. You will get screwed in the end which just isn't fair. Beware when choosing a new place to live!

If you are looking for place to move Chateau De Ville is NOT the place to move. Don't be fooled by the model they show you. Yes the apartment is very out dated.  I moved into a 3bedroom less than 24hrs my family n I was bite by fleas! (Never in my life own a pet) I contact them the next day to report the problem and it took them 1week to send the company to spray. In the meantime my had over 25 bites per person. I contact corporate because I had a 2month old who was also bite and she informed me there's nothing she can do. She than stated I could of brought them with me. Im telling her I never owned a animal and thia happen less than 24hrs. She didnt care nor did she trust what I was saying like I would LIE! Problem number 1. Than 3weeks later I had a musty odor in my bathroom come to find out its Mold! I haven't lived in my apartment no more than 45days and I'm having major issues. Not to mention they really don't care about their residents. Lastly my car was broken into week of Thanksgiving. Went out side and it was over 15cars broken into. We were informed by police that the week before they were called out to same complex for another mass car break in. Not once were we informed about the break ins. Do NOT MOVE OVER HERE. ITS NOT WORTH THE PRICE AND THE TROUBLE! I never lived somewhere so uncomfortable in my life. If you want to provide a good and safe place for your family Look else where! Trust Me!

I have been living at this apartment complex now for 3 years and this last year has been by far the worst. The apartment itself is outdated and has plenty of plumbing and electrical issues. While the office staff is helpful and friendly, the maintenance crew here is not. I seem to have to keep calling about the same issues over and over again and it gets very old very fast. Recently I have had the same plumbing issue twice that have officially ruined the carpets and the best solution they came up with was to just shampoo them and not dry them out causing them to smell afterwards and I still cannot get it out. It is a very frustrating living arrangement. I also feel as if this place is way too overpriced for what they are offering you. I recommend looking elsewhere.
Wonderful place to live,  courteous staff,  responsive and knowledgeable maintenance, and reasonable rent.  Currently expanding facilities...it's just great here.

We are renting a 3 bedroom townhouse from Chateau De Ville and couldn't be happier with it. The style of the buildings is different than any other apartment complex we've rented from, and although it's next to a busier road (Binford Boulevard) it doesn't seem like it.  

Maintenance is always quick to fix whatever the problem may be, and the office staff is incredibly helpful. 

Our apartment is located between two other apartments; if there are loud noises/music/washers or dryers running - you will hear it, but not much. The apartments are an older build, but they're doing a LOT of reconstruction in updating the apartments themselves, as well as the grounds. They are currently working on a water scape, new pool/parking, and a new  playground - which is perfect for families like ours. 

Granted, the updating of the apartments most likely won't take away the ability to hear the louder noises, but it is nice to know that they're updating. 

As far as the price goes, especially in the area - you do get a lot of bang for your buck. We currently have a 3 bedroom 2.5 bath townhouse (1450 sq feet) for the same price as a 2 bed 2 bath flat (1003 sq foot) in our old apartment. 

The local area is quite nice as well. The state fairgrounds are less than 3 minutes away, several grocers in the area, and Castleton Mall is a 10 minute drive. There aren't many sidewalks in the area (outside of the complex), but with busier roads - I'm not sure it'd be too safe anyway. 

If you're looking for a great place to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city while still in it - Chateau De Ville Apartments are a great find.

This property is poorly maintained and has ever changing office staff and customer service. I also believe that it is a bad deal for the price, especially since there are no amenities and you cannot lock your rate in. Find another nearby place that will be more worth your time, sanity, money, and energy!!!

PLEASE believe the negative reviews. You could get WAY more for your money and more customer service and support in surrounding neighborhoods. I could write multiple NOVELS about the unacceptable nature of my experience here. I have lived here three years and it has gotten WORSE not better.

There has been a smell since I moved in. Maintenance stated it was "attic paint", THAT WAS A LIE. The attic does not have a smell. Tiffany the leasing person is sooooo very rude. I will end up throwing everything out cause the smell is mold from the hotel heater and under the carpet. BUT they don't care. Don't move here

I moved in about 2 months ago and have not had any issues.  The apartments are quiet and I have good neighbors.  My apartment had plenty of room and even more storage than what I really needed.  The apartment has a nice size patio and I can not wait to use it this spring!  The location is close to my work and so many other places to shop and eat.  I think I made the right choice.

when i got here they been so nice but after i signed the contract i met the manager and saw the real face for them , and there's no parking spot for the resident so you may find a visitors taking all the parking then you will need to park almost 1/4 mile away . and the extra charges is something you have to deal with other wise they will damage your credit. there's a lot more but i don't like to mention their name, even i can't wait to finish my contract and somewhere else .

The property is Rundown. The front office people. They don't know what they're doing the maintenance people. They don't know what they're doing. For example, we weren't getting cold air upstairs. They came and duct tape our furnace.

We have lived here for going on 4 years and our rent has been increased multiple times to "keep with market value."  These apartments are narrow and cramped with no storage unless you get one of the bigger units.  Our apartment was due for an upgrade when we moved in and nothing has been fixed since.  The price we pay is for an upgraded unit but that is not the case.  The maintenance men are useless.  They are only good at blocking traffic by parking in the middle of the road and driving around the lawns and creating ruts.  The office gets made if anything is put in the lawn but somehow this is allowable.  Their are notices of when the maintenance men should be in the apartment for a yearly inspection and a range of dates are given.  We are also told to remove our pets during this time.  Never once have the maintenance men shown up during the stated time and last year they broke the door to the closet and didn't even fix it.  It had fallen back and hit the wall across from it.  The only reason we know that they have shown up is that they move things and make a mess.  Other than that they never leave a note saying they have "completed" their job.  The office staff was great when we first moved in but it has changed since then and the staff running it now is only concerned with making money.  They charge for everything and raise the rent constantly.  They set up competitions for people to make the outside of the apartments pretty when in reality they are the ones who should be taking care of the grounds.  They went with a cheaper mowing crew who do substandard work.  There are dog restrictions but they are not upheld so any and all breeds are around who's owners don't use leashes so walking around our little dog is a bit scary at times.  The apartment complex has now been taken over by the kids because no adult controls them.  They play and walk in the middle of the roads constantly and the people who get in trouble are the drivers.  The pool is always closed during holidays or when we would want to use it so the pool is pointless.  This place has gone downhill fast and there are no more redeeming features.  Cheap and restrictive more so than it's worth.

I lived at Horizon Apartments from 2002 threw part of 2004.  I was drawn to it because, of how quite the community seemed. plus, with the park, trail, and tolerance for pets was a big deal to me.  life took many different places.  fall of 2013 I purchased my first home.  when I realized my backyard shared a fence line with Horizon. I thought things had come full circle. Many changes threw the years.  But, Horizon isn't just aparment complex.  They are homes and part of a community.  A gentleman from the Horizon community caught someone in the act of a crime. followed him to my back yard. called police. then told me that there was a suspect in my yard maybe my home. He and The maintenance staff did not stop searching till the suspect was found. They wasn't just worried about the safety for the apartments. But, every single hard working person in the community.  They did everything they could to see justice being served.  If you are looking for a HOME and being a home owner just isn't a right fit.  then there is no better place to call home. Home is a community of loving people who look out for each other. Who Call the police when they witness a crime. who become angry and hurt when they see a neighbor being victimized.  Together we are strong! Thank you staff and residents for being good neighbors!

I have lived in my 2 bedroom townhome for 4 years. In the past year the staff has worked very hard to improve the community! 
The ladies in the office are always nice and welcoming anytime i come in or call!
The new maintenance crew is amazing! 
I know it has not always been the best but I have to say this past year has been the best! 
Thank you Horizons Staff I will not be moving anytime soon!

There isn't a lot of square footage they could be bigger and  no matter how many bedrooms you have there is only one bathroom. No washer and dryer hook up unless you rent a three bedroom or a four. A lot of stray animals and they carry fleas. They are working on getting rid of the stray animals. There are no screens on the back windows and some of them wont close. 

They are working on fixing them up, they are older apartments-townhomes.

The complex is in a decent area, but the staff here are awful. At least the maintenance men seem competent, but they struggle under disorganized and disinterested office staff: sometimes your leaky sink gets fixed right away and sometimes it takes them weeks to come and take care of your problem. The office staff are rude and again, disinterested, taking days to return phone calls if they bother at all and never even attempting to be friendly. There's only one girl there who's ever even smiled at me. They also have very little in the way of sense of propriety. They recently had some staffing issues in maintenance, and the staff told us all about it--and we heard them talking about in at length to another tenant, as well.

The laundry facilities just got an update, and they're still pretty pathetic. One row of about 8 washers and 10 dryers, and if more than one person is trying to do laundry, at least one of them are trapped. You won't get to see this before you rent the apartment. The pool (for the short time it's open in the summer) appears to be policed by a tenant who has been given tags she can just hand out to let people in and a list. She and her friends are always there with their whole gaggle of children.

On the upside, our neighbors have been very friendly.

By far one of the worst places I have ever lived. Believe all the 1 star reviews. They are quick to make it seem like the people who live here are the issue. If you are “complicated” or ask “too many questions” during your application process they will make sure you get the WORST unit. They don’t answer the phone unless you are applying to live here. I have been in the office and witnessed them ignoring the phone on several occasions. Their main concern is greed. They never have the front gate shut. When I first moved in it was “down for maintenance”, I have never seen anyone working in it. Someone got robbed on the apartment across from mine. They stole his wallet, keys, and car. He was also pistol whipped. This would of never happened if they promoted safety like they claimed when I first moved in. Neighbors have told me when someone complains they close it for a week, then leave it open all over again. My neighbors also have roaches so I have to keep my place as clean as possible, but doesn’t stop me from seeing them consistently. They are big as HELL! One of my neighbors told me a lady sued this place. Not sure for what but definitely not a surprise. DO NOT MOVE HERE!! Save your self the money and stress. I would rather be living out if my car than be living here. Not putting my name I don’t need the apartments bothering me. Please save your self from this place!!!
Amenities are wonderful! Leasing staff is friendly & helpful! You won't be disappointed!
I moved here shortly after relocating to Indiana. This is a lovely apartment complex. It has it's ups and downs but overall very peaceful and quiet with a picturesque view that I love.
Since April I’ve had mold not addressed properly, neighbor broke into my aptment and remains still living here. Gate is ALWAYS broken. Other neighbor said theirs a bed bug problem. Scary.

Property Manager Ashley Parker put my apartment on a vacant list and allow her employee to steal my items including my daughter's necklace with her ashes inside.

I have not got my daughter necklace return to me. I want justice for her and I will!

Terrible place to live maintenance is horrible the appliances rarely work electrical problems the office staff is under trained and rude gate is always broken terrible living experience I wouldn’t recommend to anybody

Very poor management,maintenance does not come out and repair issues,has mold .The harassment is real,the file eviction for no reason whatsoever.Ask for a 200.00 dollar fee that is not listed in your lease agreement.When asked about the fee they can’t explain the fee please don’t rent from this place 

One star is to much wish it was a way to give a half of star

Covington square sucks. Highly recommended.

They don't seem to take things seriously and every time I go in the office there are always new people. They can't seem to keep a decent staff. For $700 a month in a 1 bed 1 bath apartment, I expect any and all issues to be taken seriously and be accomplished quickly.

In 2024, the management company changed, and several issues have arisen since then:
Elevator Issues: One of the elevators was out of service for approximately three weeks.
Gym Equipment: It has been one week since two of the treadmills in the gym stopped working.
Excessive Inspections: Despite paying a guarantee fee for the apartment, management conducts monthly inspections to check the cleanliness of the living room, washing machine, refrigerator, and cabinets. If these areas are deemed unclean, residents are charged over $100.
Unreliable Security: The apartment's security number often goes unanswered, leaving residents vulnerable to safety concerns. I have personally experienced such situations multiple times over the past three months.
Common Area Hygiene: The hallways, elevators, and stairwells frequently have unpleasant odors, and the carpets in common areas are dirty.
Package Delivery Problems: Packages are placed in a designated room that remains locked. Residents can only request their packages if they receive an email from the management system, which excludes deliveries from services like Amazon or Walmart. I spent 20 minutes persuading staff to give me my own package while it was clearly sitting in their mailing room. If you don’t receive a notification through their system, there is no way to retrieve your package, even if it has been delivered. When I emailed them about this issue, their response was that this is simply "their process."
Staff Unavailability: The situation is worsened by the frequent unavailability of staff. The leasing office is sometimes closed during posted office hours, leaving no one to assist residents. 
Pest Infestations: There are also issues with pests, including cockroaches and other insects, in the apartment. Although I reported this to maintenance, their method of addressing the problem was ineffective, and the pests reappeared within a week.
I enjoyed living at Vivio during my first year. However, dealing with these problems in recent months and witnessing the decline in Vivio’s standards, I can no longer recommend it to students with busy schedules.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review:
I'm writing here because I definitely relied on these reviews when I moved to Indy.  

This complex has the best location- it's in walking distance to Mass Ave, Monument Circle, the Mall, the IUPUI campus, and so much more. I've never felt unsafe walking to or from my car at night, or in the surrounding area. The office staff is so nice and maintenance fixes problems right away. And the office is really good about notifying you when your packages arrive. 

For downsides, I'd say that parking is annoying. Either you can park in the surface lot or in the parking structure. The surface lot is free but you're not guaranteed a spot, so I pay $85 to have an assigned parking space in their structure. I don't mind too much because most monthly parking is going to cost over $100 if you're downtown. Also, the windows are kind of old and so my electric bill goes up a lot in the winter. I put those window insulator things on a couple of my windows and it did go down some. 

Overall, I would definitely recommend this complex if you're looking to live downtown.
