review: I lived at the Continental for a year and had a one bedroom apartment on the 7th floor. The floorplan I had was the Ritz and it's about 850sqft. Let me tell you if you get this apartment your bedroom is massive. It was massive for me because I lived alone. I only had my bed and desk, and still had more than enough space. Apart from the bedroom, the location is basically in the heart of downtown you're close to everything and its one of the many reasons why I chose to live here.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: The Continental Towers is such an amazing place to live.  The staff is truly amazing. I lived there for 3 years with my wife and two daughters. Now you won't find any kids in the building now that we left, most likely. We were very sad to leave. The locations just can not be beat.  It is located just blocks from everything Indy has to offer. Parking is available for free or paid garage parking. You probably won't need a car if you work downtown though. Just steps from all the restaurants, bars, and venues you want to visit. The Continental Towers is the place to be.  The layouts are great for anyone from singles, to roommates, or even couples who might be expecting.  I have two daughters that lived with us and they were all very comfortable all the time. You won't see any other kids, probably, but it goes to show that the place is the safest and best downtown.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I have lived at The Continental for over 4 years and it's been a great place to live. It's affordable, great square footage with functional layouts and good amenities. The staff are friendly and the maintenance requests are handled promptly. The location is incredible with easy access to restaurants, bars and local events that happen frequently. Easy recommendation for anyone looking to move to Downtown Indianapolis.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I have lived here for about 3 years now.  Its a great apartment with a friendly helpful staff.  I would recommend anyone wanting to move to downtown Indianapolis to look in to the Continental.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: You won't find a better combination of price and location. Lived here several years and have never had any issues. Apartments are very spacious with plenty of natural light. The staff is friendly and helpful. Maintenance is quick. The parking situation is better than anywhere else I looked downtown. Continental has all the amenities I need. And again, the location is perfect. Close to Mass Ave., close to the canal, close to the circle and everything downtown. If you want to live in downtown Indy this is the first place you should look.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I love living here at the Continental! I feel like I get the most bang for my buck with a spacious apartment and living close to all down town has to offer. Highly recommend!

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: Great price for the location! You can walk (or BIRD) just about anywhere downtown. They have a friendly front office staff, however, it is difficult to catch them before they leave if you work late. If you're an IUPUI student then you won't have that issue.  It is difficult to get a surface lot parking spot sometimes so I it may be worth paying for the covered garage spot. Overall, I am happy with my experience here.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I have lived here for several months after moving from California and I have nothing but good things to say!  The management was incredibly gracious in assisting me with all kinds of challenges I faced in moving from out of state. They helped make it a smooth transition.  I love my place, including the location, the layout of my apartment, and the price point. The amenities are excellent—  laundry on site, indoor bike parking, inexpensive parking for my vehicle,  lockers for the local drycleaner. I am so grateful to be in walking distance of downtown employment, entertainment and stores. The Continental is a great place to be!

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: Having lived here for more than 5 years (and lived at multiple downtown residences), this place is hands down my top recommendation if you're looking to live in downtown Indy.  The price is extraordinarily reasonable given the amenities, the location is fantastic (central, with 5-10 minute walks to every hot spot downtown), and the staff is extremely friendly and always helpful.  I'd highly recommend anyone looking to live in downtown Indy to check out this place.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I have lived here for a little over two years, both in a one bed and in a two bed and have loved both apartments. The views are amazing. Everything has great natural light and high ceilings, but adorable bay windows. The front office staff is extremely nice and helpful and same with the maintenance group. I have loved living here and would recommend it to anyone. The workout facility is also clean and very nice.

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: I have lived in Continental towers for about 4 months now and I have loved it so far! The location is very central to downtown Indy, and it has been a great first apartment after college. The staff is very attentive and willing to help with any questions you may have. The apartments are very “homey” compared to other apartment complex’s in downtown indy. Also one of the most affordable of its kind!

apartmentName: The Continental Towers at Vermont Place
review: Great apartment and cheap for the area.  Building is old but it adds to the charm.  The only issue is that its expensive to heat.
My apartment is terrific.clean and the workers are super cool.whenever I put in work order the come right away.living here makes me forget the idea of buying a house.love love love
Has lived here eight yrs...lately it's going down..maybe poor management. Needs remodeling in a serious way.

I really love living in these apartments. It's very quiet around here and I still very safe . The staff is so nice and maintenance is very helpful. My only complaint isthat  the pool closes at 5 on weekdays and isn't even open on the weekends.  The layout is wonderful and I enjoy having a balcony off my bedroom.

I do not recommend these apartments to anyone!!! I use to rave about thesw apartments until I officially moved out. The leasing office and corporate is beyond rude. I received a last statement (bill) with the utility charges and miscellaneous charges. One of the charges on there was for the parking permit and key fob for the gym which I still have in my procession to this day. I called the leasing office to let her know I completely forgot to turn it in, but that I still had it and go drop it off right now. The leasing office had reminded me constantly to turn in the key, but never mentioned anything else. She was very rude stating she had already closed it out and there was nothing I could do. I understand it was on the lease contract, but who remembers everything when you are in the process of moving. The least Auburn Hill apartments could have done was provided me a courtesy call before charging me over $300 for a parking permit & key fob.

I then proceeded to call corporate Urbahns Developement to express my frustrations and experience. I can’t believe how that lady handled my concerns!! I literally explained to her the situation with no attitude or rudeness what so ever and she literally interrupts me and says “she (leasing lady) didn’t have to, I’m not about to do this with you.” Then tried to gas light me into saying I said things that I did not say to her. Wow I’ve never had someone from upper management be so rude and careless about an issue. I will be contacting the BBB. I do not recommend these apartments any longer. They are money hungry. A 5 minute courtesy call to a loyal resident could have made all the difference.

Captious leasing staff with pedantic communication. Save your money and go to another apartment complex. Limited parking space (all visitor spaces were taken when I drove by thrice). Once approved, we called the office to speak with someone about steps to add an additional occupant but to no avail. When we requested to schedule a call within their 24-hour deposit due date timeframe and to add an additional occupant, we were told to communicate via email. When we mentioned our concern about the lack of staff availability via phone, we were told that we " need to leave a voicemail as our phones ring all day long especially during summer months." Overall, the combination of a 24-hour deposit submission two months prior to move-in and the lack of helpful customer service threw us off. It was as if trying to communicate to unprofessional, inexperienced leasing representatives with the knack for passive-aggressive email responses that go so far as to impressing their fellow colleagues and friends circle. It was pathetic and exhausting.

This apartment was much better until the last management changes, post which it has become a nightmare to deal with them for anything be it any service or repair. 

Property manager/folks have no experience in dealing with resident and looks very unprofessional. The feels as if they are here for enforcing policies but not to provide an experience to the residents. you would experience terrible service if you deal with apartment management for anything.

I hope you can find a better place than this.............. this would probably my last choice.

I just renewed here for a second year! I love the small private community and the amenities offered. The staff is always so friendly and I love that they seem to know all their residents by name!! Would definitely recommend living here!!!

I've lived at Auburn Hill for the past 4 years and my partner and I have always felt safe & happy here. Our dog loves walking the small neighborhood, the pool is great in summer, and the staff are friendly. Wish the public laundry & gym were a little bigger, but overall it's a great place to live.

I have a big list of bitter shocking experiences in this apartment.
1.your car  from parking will be towed  and fined even though you are a legal resident
2.swimming pool  always filled with outsiders
3. Gym restrooms always closed/locked
4.several rules imposed on the people who stay in apartments
5. Refer friend program is a  fake program they will say 300$ but at the end will show you $0
6. Security deposit $300 will never return as they blind promise.
7. In the end, you will get a big shock after vacating home there 23 types of damages fees collected from you without proper reason.

END of the story I will never recommend anyone to at least see this

I have been here for over a month and it's been extremely disappointing. The apartment model and the apartment you get are very different. The apartment was in very poor condition on move in. I don't think they put in any effort to making it 'move in ready' at all. There excuse to me was that the maintenance manager was on vacation the week we moved in but when we spoke with him he said he just got the job. I have had MAJOR problems and not a single thing has been fixed since move in. This includes no deadbolt strike plate, leaking when it rains, leaking toilet, and an open window that won't shut (as it is getting freezing out). Do NOT waste your money here.

I lived here for 15 months and I hated it. I had to call maintenance 16 times for all the problems I had. First I had ants so bad in my daughters room they were in her bed biting her. Then there was the mice. I caught 4 and saw sooo many more. When I called the office about it she said “well we put traps down and that’s all we can do about it”. There was a nest in my wall so they were everywhere. It was a the worst apartment I ever live in! DON’T MOVE HERE. THEY ARE DISGUSTING!!!
Everyone in the office seems to not care about the residences issues in their unit.

I moved in a few months ago and staff has been great so far. I had a couple small maintenance issues and they were fixed quickly. New management seems to be putting in a lot of money into the property on improvements.
The staff here is awesome, and I would highly recommend living here. They are on top of the game with everything that they have to do. I would highly recommend this apartment complex.
This property has a great management team and there are many people who are always willing to help. Great apartments to live in.

This place is alright. The management team is slow to respond to issues and they are pretty nice to you, as long as they like you. The area is not the best, but I have really seen worse. The apartment is about the right size for a single person or a couple that is just starting out. Wonderful closets! Open floor plan.

I’ve been living at Island Club and I really enjoy it here. The grounds are well-kept, and the lake views are beautiful. The apartments are spacious with a good layout, making them very comfortable to live in. There are also great amenities like a fitness center, a swimming pool, and a clubhouse that provide plenty of activities.

The management team is solid. They’re friendly, responsive, and quick to handle any maintenance issues. The location is also very convenient, being close to shopping centers, restaurants, and highways, which makes getting around easy. Overall, I’m very happy to call Island Club my home.

Beautiful views and layout is nice. But for the price, I don’t think you get your money’s worth. Apartment is in bad shape- mold everywhere, shower peeling, cheap fixtures, cracks (lot of bugs and spiders), front door doesn’t properly seal, sinking floors, windows don’t stay open, dripping and leaking faucets, air conditioner was broken upon moving in. Maintenance is nice but very understaffed, requests take months. Trash is always overflowing into the street from the dumpster. Office is hit or miss.

This apartment is charging high prices for poor apartments. The apartments are in terrible condition with leaks and bad installed countertops bathroom sinks. There is mold in the tubs. There are many holes inside the apartment which bugs and spiders come through. The toilets are not attached to the floor. The leasing office will show you a model unit then, place you in a a different unit. Do not sign a lease before moving into unit. Please inspect unit before moving it !

I am a new resident at the Island Club Apartments. I felt this was home from the first day I moved in.  I had some major issues and the staff in the office came to my rescue.  I really appreciate the help from Veronica, Devon, and Neal.  My apartment has given my peace and tranquility that I never imagined.  This property is a God send.

The apartments themselves are comfortable and very nice area stays clean and the pool looks clean too but in terms of the customer service at the office it needs work. There never seems to be anyone there to help the office is always closed during hours that it should be open
I love Island Club I love majority of my neighbors but I enjoy the peace and the nature.
I lived here for over a decade. Great apartment community with a very friendly and professional staff that works very hard to accommodate your needs. Would highly recommend this apartment community.

I have bikes stolen while living here. Unfortunately, there is no CCTV. I reported the case to the administration people. They said within a week the campus police will contact me but no one contacts yet. 
People should consider to live in here if you have any valuable vehicles or properties.
I also got another problem is that an outsider was trying to unlock my door while I am staying in the room. I was shouting at them and they left. I did not report this case but I still feel unsafe when living here. 
I feel that the security here is not good. Lockefield Gardens should equip CCTV and improve security here.

This place is an outdated mess. I moved into an apartment that smelled like mildew because they cleaned the carpet and did not air it out. The bathroom sink was clogged, the toilets leaked so much water on the floor everytime I flushed. The ceiling in the kitchen fell due to poor installation and it shattered all over the floor. The microwave was dead and was manufactured in the 1980s. The oven is ancient as well. The maintenance people take on average 2 months to get back to your work orders, but only if you call lockefield about why they are taking so long. Lockefield staff are not on their A game, they are not prepared, especially when transferring to another apartment. They gave me a date to transfer and told me that the washer is being replaced and the apartment is basically not ready, even though they gave us a date to move out. Very annoying. Lockefield is not worth the money or time.
Maintenance could not get the black mold problem under control due to constant leaking in the ceiling. Foul place to live

I don't know how these guys work. Those people have no idea with time and doing the wrong paperwork. They printed that I need to pay 500 for example, at last, I need to pay 600, the reason is that they just printed wrong and calculated wrong, which means paperwork is nothing for them.
Rundown, inefficient, untimely repairs. Overall, will not live here for another term

You get what you pay for, very good location in terms of how close it is to campus. However, because of it’s closeness to the river, bugs are an issue but not an infestation. The bugs I come across consist of normal house insects so nothing serious. Maintenance is timely but effective. Most likely due to a shortage in workers as they are always hiring maintence. The quality of the complex is relatively nice. I’d compare the apartments to a small European style. There is also some construction going on but the complex is relatively well Kept. 

Cons: Aside from the bugs and timely management(due to a shortage of workers), another con includes packages being left out at the entrance of each building making it extremely easy to steal any mailed packages.

Pros: Nice management, if there is ever an issue you will be fairly compensated, security (a few police officers live here making it a safer location, also surrounded by a metal fence), location to campus, size, utilities of apartment, and cleanliness.

 I recommend lockefield to students of IUPUI, as well as any Indianapolis residents who are searching for a safe location close to downtown.
Excellent office staff, beautiful place to live, peaceful neighborhood and is kept very clean. Always have parking available parking and I like the pool and amenities.

Linden Square Apartments (Indianapolis), a J. C. Heart location, it's a "phase II" apartment which means it's less than a year old. My wife and I are the first to live in our apartment. Very nice hardwood, counter tops, and cabinet. Comes with dish washer, fridge, microwave, and stacked W/D. Great for singles or small families.
i love my apartments. clean no problems safe place to live
No park or basketball court, pool is almost never open and when it is its disgusting! Unsafe neighborhood, and maintenence shows up weeks after called, if at all.

This complex is by far the best I’ve ever seen. The employees are great!!! They are really attentive to their tenants, & make sure everything is running smoothly. Especially the leasing manager & the front desk leasing specialist. Great atmosphere!!!! Will be moving in within the next month.
Thinking about moving here went in to visit and the employees were great nice friendly staff will be renting a place here within a month

Do not i scream do not move into this complex leasing office lacks professionalism and maintenance requests take between 2-4 months to complete
If you have other options choose them their price is decent because the have poor employees and want to lure you in

Bedbugs infested apartments with rude staff. Lots of roaches, rats and mice. In case of emergency they careless. If something needs immediate attention in your room, they will take up to three weeks before they come. And that is, if they do. And when they finally come, they blame you for the damages and hold you responsible for the cost. Be warned.The bed bug infestation here is too much for one apartment. The worse thing is, they will not treat on time. That is, if they even remember to do it. I hardly write reviews but this is as bad as it gets. Do not be swayed by cheap rent because you will lose more than the rent when the bugs enter your mattress and chairs and be disgraced before friends on a get together party.

The apartments are very spacious and affordable! Besides, that.... These has to be the most mice invested apartments I could have ever lived in. They recently switched over to Orkin and Orkin came out to lay some sticky traps down which in about one day all sticky traps were used. They are more prone to be in the kitchen coming from the laundry area, inside stove, and behind the refrigerator. If you have an upstairs unit plz check the cracks of your stairs. When you do check you will see that there are open cracks were the mice are traveling from. Maintenance and mgmt. covers it up with carpet. Plz look behind your stove, and in the inside you will see mice dropping. This is a health issue and I will be reporting. I have made several calls, and submitted several work orders regarding the mice. Yet no justice, this mice win every time. They have to dig deeper as to why mice are invested in the building. If you ask anyone they will tell you they have mice including the young ladies that lease the apartments. There has been several reports on bed bugs and other little creepy crawlers. Biggest concern is the mice and there dropping. In one particular night I capture about 9 mice. Besides the mice there was two killing in apartment near the front regarding to young men. Oh how that broke my children heart, I had to explain to them what happen because all the other kids were discussing on the bus. There is no security. The pool power with chloride. The basketball court was rim was knocked down within one day after it was put up, by the neighbor hood teenage kids. In the summer time there is a lot of hanging out by teenagers and the teenagers bullies the smaller kids at the park. Where is SECURITY. Apartments are poorly insulated. The new property manager show little concern is very rude at times. Maintenance is Great but they can only do so much.

Apartments are in a great location, and the maintenance staff is great. Where the apartment doesn’t meet minimum expectations are with Management. From the lack of consistency when it comes to cleanliness outside the random mopping by the elevators or late night partial vacuuming to incompetent actions on simple tasks such as moving a package to the “package pickup room” where all packages go for residents. This is great for folks who may be unable to visit the office during open hours but still pick up a time sensitive package.
Outside of that the day to day is fine…no better or worse, just lowercase fine.

Great location by the canal , close to downtown. Management team dragged it down to 2 Stars here, some of them are very rude and unprofessional. Dishwasher has been broken for 2 years i been here and has not had any help regarding it. If changing address was not a big headache, would have moved out 2nd week of staying here...

Great location, but unfortunately, very poor management. We did not have functioning AC for two summers. Instead of bringing in an expert after 7 failed attempts to repair with various forms of tape and foam piping, they told us that it was working properly because it turned on (it did not, as it was not cooling and it was leaking significant amounts of water). After several attempts to convince management that it was in fact not working, they finally replaced the AC (after 39 days without AC this summer alone). As repayment, they compensated us with the equivalent of about 4.5 days of rent. Needless to say, it has been a very frustrating experience in which our concerns were not taken seriously, and we did not receive adequate compensation for living in an apartment without AC for two summers. I understand that businesses need to make money, but this management company will cut corners at every opportunity at the expense of tenant comfort. Please consider living elsewhere. Working with management here is not worth your time, energy, and stress.
The property director Jana helped us a lot in terms of settle down everything during the first several day we moved in. The accociates in the leasing office are nice as well.
We really enjoy living at COA. It's very nice and the location is perfect for students.
Best ever staff yet Dan and Megan are doing great

Bug and mouse infested apartments! On the first day of moving in I seen roaches running around everywhere. these apartments are awful and some of the people living in them are very loud.  if I could rate it a zero I would! Defidently would NOT recommend.

I just moved out and this is the worst place I've ever lived. It doesn't take much to please me. But the fact that I had roaches in my home daily was beyond me. The insect guy only comes once a week in the morning. They say that have a 5 week treatment plan, but all they do is spray the walls. I've asked for my home and unit to be bombed but they said they couldn't do it. I maybe cooked in my home 5 times because of roaches going over my head and food while cooking. Not to mention I had a baby living with me. And sometimes the water shuts off without notice. The apartments are not clean. MANAGEMENT COULD CARE LESS!!!!! I'm begging you, do not move here.

This place is one of the worst places you could live in indianapolis, the management are greedy money hungry scum, they dont care about you or your concerns, the maintenance will come to fix things but they put a patch job on it and the problem persists, there are so many issues with this place and its management that i could go all day but i will just make this short and sweet, this place sucks, and if you dont heed my warning and you do rent from pangea, you will soon find out that it is one of the worst mistakes you have ever made.
The community has gone through a huge change, The new team in the office is very nice and helpful. The apartments are very big
This place is maggot infested as well as the office management. They would never get another lease sighed with me. I'd advise you to keep moving past this place.

Save yourself the headache. I’ve lived here 4 years and have lived my apartment, however management is constantly changing; they are rude; the call the police on frustrated tenants who do not display violent or threatening behavior to get out of following up on tasks; they NEVER answer the phone; maintenance is extremely behind. They are currently adding a random fee that has never been spoken of to our leases for storage units that have always been apart of my apartment. The storage unit cannot be accessed without going through my apartment, but is somehow now an add on after my lease was already renewed and finalized. Just don’t move here. I’m sure there’s something better out there. The property has amazing potential, but management is a disgrace.
They won’t return phone call on repairs. Went 3 weeks with out heat in Dec. As of right now I am over a week with out them fixing my hot water.

This is definitely not a place to live, especially if you have children. It’s all about optics; new outside door frames, freshly painted buildings just to change the color, (buildings were painted 2-years ago), and fancy outside lights that add absolutely nothing to the enhance security. It’s quite obvious inside conditions of the apartments aren’t a priority. My apartment is full of mold, tiles are falling off the walls, and I went without heat for several days. Further, my furnace filter hasn’t been changed in TWO YEARS and the same applies to my neighbors. This is quite dangerous for people with asthma or health-related breathing problems. The hot water works sporadically, it takes at least 10 minutes for it to get hot, then it only stays hot for a very short time. Further, the water is so cloudy that I refuse to cook with it. Drive through the complex and you’ll see filthy trash overflowing in dumpsters, non-working security and carport lights in the evening, and privacy fences literally falling down. Management is completely unresponsive; they don’t answer the phone, return calls and that includes the emergency line, nor do they follow-up as promised. They do little but expect tenants to pay a lot.

Hot water is constantly in and out. Maintenance is poor the management is poor. They will not get back to you if there is an issue in an efficient manor! I have been having apartment leaks for over a month that has not been fixed. I AM READY TO MOVE!!!!!!! Nicely renovated but everything else is TERRIBLE!!!!!

This place is a joke, management and maintenance are poorly ran. I spent majority of my Sunday trapped inside of my apartment because the door was jammed shut and Jenny from the office didn’t even want to call maintenance to come help me. I originally put in a maintenance request with a long list, including the door, it’s now the end of February and no one has yet to come out. Coby from the office let me know not to expect anyone anytime soon. Things constantly fall apart, all of my issues from move in still haven’t been resolved, and we have heating/cooling issues. Currently, we don’t have any hot water and no one notified us, sent an email or a notice.

We haven't lived here long but there has been many issues with our apt. The crazy thing is, they could be beautiful if the up keep was done. The apt we have is wonderful, it's the issues we are having that makes it a nightmare, especially for the rent price. The office staff are dishonest and they close out your maintenance tickets without completing them and we are almost through half the year and they still aren't done. Find somewhere else, it's not worth the money! AND you sure don't get a pleasant experience.

Really would rate them nothing if i could. They renovated these, so they look great upon touring and first move in but every issue from there just makes the experience worse and worse. 
1) there’s no drop box for rent. basically, if you can’t get it there before close. you deal with the late fee.
2) they never complete their maintenance requests in a timely manner. Was waiting for AC repair for atleast 2 months and it was never fixed. Apparently, there are 20 other apartments in here without AC as well. i asked if they could atleast fix the window screens so i could open my windows since i’m on the second floor. I never even received that help. 
3) I had to eventually just leave due to an infestation of rats in my walls. They were trying to convince me that they were “squirrels” since the last tenant “had that issue” My father and i put out traps to figure out what they really were. we put 4, and 4 hours later, all four had a rat inside! At that point, i called the health department, packed my bags and hit jets. Preparing to sue as we speak.

I was skeptical of living here after reading some of the reviews but decided to move in anyway because I figure people have different experiences than others. I cannot even begin to describe how terrible the staff of Veridian is. Very unprofessional, I have been cussed at, lied to, and disrespected this entire time. Not to mention the maintenance and service is the worst I have ever seen. It is absolutely ridiculous and the main reason I am writing this is to save you all from making the same mistake I did. Find somewhere else. Pay more. Whatever. Do not get stuck dealing with this company. I never thought living would be so hard.

I have lived in the complex for 9 years and I’ve never experienced what I’ve experienced over the last 2 years. I have had air and water problems (which has been occurring on and off for at least a year). I’ve called corporate several times and I’ve have gotten no answer. No one returns calls when they say they are going to. Some of the office employees have an attitude when they are called and that’s if they answer the phone at all. Notices are barely sent out about anything. I didn’t even know that the complex name had changed to Veridian Castleton nor the phone number. At one time I told people that these were great apartments and I have had several of my friends move in, but now I tell dont move here. It’s both sad and disappointing.

The new management is making a difference.  I love it here.  The location is off the beaten path and it is convenient to a lot of things.  I like the new people in the office.  I'm glad that Erika is still around because she has been a blessing through the transition.  My lease will be up in a few months and I will be renewing for another year.

I’ve never had so many problems with any apartment like I’ve had with this place. They raised our prices up quite a bit. I regret resigning and should have moved out like most of the people here. I currently still live and right now I have water in my air vents. This is the second time in 2 weeks that this has happened. I can’t turn on my air conditioning. The last time this happened it lasted for several days.  I go to the office several times and get the run around.  Several times in the winter we have gone days without heat. They did “renovations”. All they did was do some painting which was horrible. They replaced the faucet and showers and some light fixtures. Then put granite countertops in the kitchen with new appliances. Maintenance is horrible and they keep getting new people because  their own people keep quiting. I feel like I’m in the office at least every other week for an issue with this place. I’m not even that type of person. I do not advise to move here. I wish I could move out. I’m stuck here. When my lease is up. I’m gone.  You have been warned!!

I have lived here for quite a long time for a renter, but a new company recently purchased the property and it has become a nightmare! It was welcoming to come in to the office,now it is prettier but sterile. We were told that the rent was going to go up by over $300 due to renovations but so many people turned in their notices to move out that a few months later they now say it is going up $140. The renovations are needed as things are dated but that is a HUGE jump to raise it all at once. The maintenance also used to be decent, but now stinks. I had to call several times when my drain was clogged and then got told to BUY a hair catcher because I would start getting charged if they had to come out again. I have been without hot water 3 times in less than a month for over 24 hours, and although they say they will keep us posted on the status no one gets updates unless someone calls. The best thing about this place is the location, but in my opinion, that one big pro no longer out ways all of the cons.

This property changed ownership in the summer of 2017,  and everything has gone downhill.   The rent is way higher,  just for some cosmetic changes,  but now service is a joke,  and the corporate people act like your bothering them when you bring it up,  and give you lip see service about how things will improve.    If you sign a lease here,  you'll regret it.

The place used to be a wonderful complex. The complex was sold to an outfit out of Ohio. The rents were raised by 200-300 per month with no notice. The maintenance staff after 15 years all quiet at one time. The current office staff  has turned over every month for the past 3 months. The break ins are on the rise and tenants are waiting for repairs for 3 months or more. Corporate staff have been here a number of times and nothing has changed. The office manager by the name of Tenille can never be reached! If you have a problem you must address it by email and they take their grand sweet time to respond!  I have sent several! Find another place, don't come to this Nightmare!

I see a lot of bad reviews but my experience has been basically positive. Of course things happen where ever you live but Maintenance does respond. I've been here for just about two years and I will be happy to sign another lease for the third year. I adore the location and I feel very safe here. I lived previously on Ralston ave in a house and did not feel safe . There is only one entrance and exit into the complex that cuts down on random people driving into the complex. The back entrance has always been closed up. There is a security guard that drives around the complex in the evening. For me feeling safe is a priority. The location is amazing as far as I'm concerned..the Monon trail is just about a block away. There are several restaurants in short walking distance. There are a few bars and beer hall walking distance and a very cozy coffee place with a plenty of space to sit and study. Fresh market is a few blocks away and Fresh Thyme is down the road.
