I highly recommend you choose to live in Brockton Apartments, you won't regret it. My grandmother has lived here since 2000. She (we) love it!!

Very decent place to live, Nice people, Nice environment! If you're looking for a place that's affordable, Whether it's your first apartment or not, Brockton apartments are accommodatable in every way!

My grandsons and I really liked living in Greentree. There are multiple small playgrounds, it is within short walking distance of the library, the staff is very friendly and our maintenance requests were responded to quickly. I would definitely live there again.

This place is disgusting. I have been dealing with roaches since day one. Now I have mice. They treat once in a great while and then you don't hear back. I get "well we can't control how dirty people live." Maintenance for repairs is alright but office staff doesn't seem to care since they aren't living in the complex.
Its a nice and quiet area, im looking forward to staying for awhile!

I'm currently a tenant and I  always have issue with maintenance being done. When you complain it's not resolved because the manager is the maintenance man wife. So Laura gets offended when you makes a complaint because it's her husband. This is bad for business. I wouldn't recommend anyone to move in here.

We have lived here almost 5 years. It is a very clean, well taken care of apartment complex.  It is very pretty with mature trees and ponds.  Any maintenance issues were dealt with right away. We have even recommended it for several coworkers.  Conveniently located to the airport, downtown Indianapolis and Speedway.

I just moved into Eagle Creek and I love it here! The staff is always so friendly! Deirdre helped me when I first went on tour. She was very friendly and knew a lot about the property! She was always very quick to respond to my calls and emails!  My apartment itself is wonderful! I love the area because it is so easy to get to downtown, and it is much more affordable than I expected! They have also put in a lot of upgrades to my apartment, and I love the new faucets and lights! I did have a few minor maintenance issues, but Rob was very quick to answer my worker order and resolved all of my issues.

I have had a very long year of terrible service from this apartment complex. When I moved in, they tried to give me a smaller apartment and not tell me. I was put off for a walk through of my actual apartment until the DAY BEFORE I was to move in. I was then told  that they did not have one available. Not ten minutes later, the leasing agent called me and had miraculously found one. In reality, they gave me an apartment that was not ready for anyone to move in. Then I was told I had to pay an upcharge for a renovated apartment. Yet they had to come and upgrade my countertops, my washer and dryer, and my dishwasher because they were old and not working correctly. I was told the appliances were tested before I moved in. The garbage disposal was broken, as well as the water not working. My AC was also out. I called but since it was a Friday, only the AC was an emergency and the rest had to wait for someone to come and fix. Along with MANY, MANY other issues. Paint missing around door handles, cabinets dirty and not painted, closet doors falling off constantly, my ceiling light fell from the drywall, disgusting green mold in the middle of my washer, my AC has gone out multiple times, and many more. Maintenance will come out two times sometimes for the same thing. Or put on my work order they ordered parts and then never show up to finish the job.  I’ve had to have my bathtub resealed because it was leaking through the ceiling a lot to my downstairs neighbor. My neighbors leave dirty diapers out front occasionally. I called three times in five days to the office and no one came to remove them.  I renewed my lease – a huge mistake.  I had my floors cleaned upon my renewal-they are now separating where the different pieces meet and are sewn together. (7/11/17) I gave a list of things that needed fixed a week and a half ago to the office. (7/17/17) After a week, I called and spoke with the manager, who informed me they would be out in three days. (7/20/17) It is now that day, and no one came to fix A SINGLE THING. 
(7/21/17) Update after one day-I went up to the office after a week and a half of no one showing up. Spoke with manager who PROMISED me maintenance would be out first thing to take care of my list. STILL DID NOT COME OUT TO FIX A SINGLE THING IN MY APARTMENT.
Also, those pictures are just a few from my MOVE-IN. I was not kidding when I said they gave me an apartment not ready for anyone to move in.

I have lived here for almost 4 years. The past year has been horrible and I want to LEAVE. They won't let me leave 2 months early after four years of consistent, early payments and being a good rule following tenant?? The city water has made my skin break out horribly, I've had to go to the doctor multiple times for this. It's impossible to get anything fixed. They say they'll, they never come. It took us half a year to get them to change the kitchen light bulb. (This took multiple online requests, at least 10 calls, and me going into the office once) Do you know how hard it is to cook or do the dishes in the dark???? They have regular inspections, where they leave everyone a note, saying you'll receive an automated call the day before so you'll know to put your pets away or whatever. Call never comes! But you'll sure get one when there's a "party" for a holiday, cause that's important....... And be careful if you have a pet, they'll pocket the deposit and then claim a year later that you never paid and they'll expect you to pay them an extra $500.  Some nice added features are neighbors that smoke weed and rotting trash all over the ground by the trash compactor. :/ Please don't live here.

Lived here for about a year and it was fine compared to other places. This place is nestled back away from the road so crime isn't as prevalent in this complex compared to others. I had a first floor apartment and it was poorly sealed, black mold growing on windows and insects (especially centipedes) were almost a daily occurrence during the warm months. The big thing is that this place has bed bugs, we were forced to vacate because of it, only had 10 days to find a new place and move out as well as pay for the bed bug treatment. This complex will screw you, the bedbug addendum they have you sign is a trap so they can kick you out at first sign of bedbugs. During the 10 days we had to vacate I went to at LEAST two dozen other complexes not owned by sexton properties and none of them had bedbug addendums, which leads me to believe that this place has an ongoing infestation that they cannot get rid of. I wouldn't recommend living here because of the bedbugs.

I went to rent an apartment for a year. The management appeared courteous and the apartment looked good. However, while leaving I met a woman dragging her laundry stuff. As I was pretty sure that each apartment gets own washer and dryer, I asked her about it. She said the washer in the building is malfunctioning for a while. According to her, a neighbor told him that the washer is bad for past 4 years and his oven was broke for 3 months, and nothing has been done! Another person told me her kitchen ceiling was collapsed and they had done nothing for few weeks! After I talked around a bit, it seemed the general opinion is the maintenance people are more or less efficient. The management appeared to be in pretty bad shape. And depending on the management, the service changes. There are pretty decent options around this place. I'm clearly not going to rent an apartment at this property.

Do not move here! These apartments are raggedy and the property manager doesn’t care at all! She avoids calls and emails but never forgets to let you know you’re late on rent! My living room is flooded and full of mold. I’ve put in 13 maintenance requests and all of them have gone unanswered. And it’s not just me It’s all of my neighbors dealing with this! DO NOT MOVE HERE!!
I’ve been dealing with roaches for awhile now and they truly don’t care about it. When they say they have pest control come spray every week; don’t believe them. Spend your money somewhere else.

Horrible!! The kids run wild and destroyed our grill and and patio furniture. Also a grill was completely stolen. Dogs and kids running wild. We had a friend over and he was robbed at gun point. Took his wallet phone and keys. Last month there was a dead body found in parking lot. Do not live here. I have called cops repeatedly...no one cares.

My car has been repeatedly vandalized, mail stolen off my porch, my son has been assaulted and robbed, literally feet away from the apartment... yet they won't do anything and even tried to blame me for my car being vandalized... I could write a book on the issues we've had that they ignore, and now there's a been a murder the parking lot, too. We want out, don't live here!
Our cars have been vandalized 4 times, mail stolen, numerous other issues, they never do anything about any of it, and don't care. I strongly recommend not moving here if you have any other option.
Nice affordable apartments for individuals trying to save money. Located right by a high school and close to a university. Very close to shopping areas and only minutes away from downtown.

The apartment it self is very nice and clean, it is recently renovated . I love the inside of it and the rent is at a great price. My main problems consist of there never being any visitor parking , when I have someone come over for the weekend I always have a hard time finding them somewhere to park. I am also not sure how I feel about having to use 2 keys to get into my apartment. after I moved in they decided to put a lock on the side door to enter the hallway towards my apartment, agreed for some it sounds lovely because it makes it safer but for me it just makes it harder when I have things to carry back and forth .

The worst apartments ever! The cost of living here at these apartments is high and not worth it at all. Your car will get stolen, there aren’t any cameras or officers patrolling the complex, overpriced apartments and they are extremely small, maintenance will finish a job and leave their tools on your property and won’t clean up their mess, and management is horrible. Some of the management workers won’t help you if there is a problem or concern regarding your home. Very unprofessional and have no knowledge of how to manage an apartment complex successfully. Worst apartments  I ever lived in and wouldn’t recommend of living here.

have not yet lived here but the application has been super fast and easy ! Jean Ann has by far giving me the best response and helped me through it! She is absolutely a sweetheart and very helpful! I am very excited to move in the location looks very clean and safe !
I downsized from the 3 br to a 2br. I feel safe, staff (Amy) has provided excellent customer service and the grounds are kept pristine. 2 yrs here and I'm a happy tenant.

I've lived here for 10  years with my parents then ended up getting an apartment of my own in here. When I left, I left with normal children wear and tear (couple stains in the carpet, some small marks on the wall that could be painted over). Not only did they take my deposit, which I would have been fine with, but they charged me an extra $600 saying it was just for paint and carpet of a 1 bedroom; 1 bathroom apartment! They run through management because they can't get anyone to stay in the apartments. My car was broken into 3 times & even though my mom has a locked in lease for being a resident for so long, they've gone up on the rent 4 times in the past 4 months. DO NOT DO IT! You can definately spend your money else where. & make sure you don't get into a financial bind because these are the ONLY apartments in Pike Township that does not accept help from the trustees office. Even though they write them a check. I'm looking to get my mom out of here as soon as possible. If you see these apartments, RUN!

The apartments here are cheap but you get what you pay for. The staff on the other hand are generally non-responsive. As a resident you could call in with a particular problem and the issue could go hours or days before a resolution, if at all, is come to. If you are looking for a cheap place to live, this place will fit your needs but do not expect a responsive or customer service oriented staff. This is particularly true of the maintenance staff who are, at times, openly hostile to residents.

I have lived here for a few months over a year the people in the leasing office are friendly and helpful the apartments are spacious and nice and up to date on the inside maintenance comes either the day you call or within the next two to three days but they always show up with in a timely manner to fix anything you need every morning they also drive around the apartment complex on golf carts and pick up any trash so that it always looks nice however there is only one dumpster in the complex which forces you to either have to walk your trash decently far depending on where your building is or you have to put it in or on your car and drive it to the dumpster there are two or three little lakes in the complex one of which is good for fishing lots of children that run around the neighborhood and play with each other depending on where you live you can have a view of the woods or the lake there is also Aunt Millie's pastry factory right next door so every morning when you wake up to walk out to your car for work you get the smell of fresh baked bread or cinnamon rolls which is just wonderful there are train tracks that run very close but you usually don't hear them when you are inside your building there is a small wooded area with a creek in it and then a field on the other side where children can play as well there are a lot of speed bumps in the neighborhood which is good but some of them are rather large and a bear to drive over these apartments are located close to lincoln tech and also close to a lot of factories and restaurants and retailers where you can shop or work it is in the pike school district so older children could attend Park High School or a number of other schools such as Berbuff preparatory school all in all they are nice apartments that I would recommend to a friend they are a little more expensive then I feel like they should be but they are spacious the neighborhood is nice and clean and my neighbors are friendly if I had to rate it on a scale of 1 to 10 I would probably give it an 8

Been here nearly 2 months, and I can say maintenance is absolutely horrible. The apartment you get will not be anywhere near as nice as the model they show.
Everything wobbles. The faucets, towel racks, even my toilet wobbles because they didn't even bother to bolt both sides down. There's paint all over our floor because no effort was made to cover it. The hot water is out frequently.
Their gutters were so bad they had rows of saplings growing in them. When they finally got around to cleaning them, they threw the debris from them onto our balcony.

When we moved in, we noticed that the dryer takes 2 hours or more to dry really small loads, and dryer lint would be all over our floor. I thought the dryer vent might be loose so I went to check it. Not only was there no vent, but there is nowhere for a vent to connect to. So the dryer is just blowing hot air, humidity and lint everywhere. This is a huge oversight, and a fire and mold hazard. My electric bill is also high due to it.
When I contacted the office about it, they said they'd "look into it." Apparently,  they use these crummy ventless attachments (a quick research informs you that these are an insufficient substitute for actual vents, they just use these to charge more for their units). Whatever, at least it is something. But they never came to fix the issue. We checked every few days, nothing ever happens. Two weeks later, they still haven't installed the attachment. I call again, they claim they were waiting on a part to be delivered, but it came that day and they will fix it right away. They never came. Another 2 weeks, they say the same thing, it was delivered today, they'll fix it. Never came. They are so very obviously lying.
It has been over a month and a half, and they still haven't fixed the issue. I have pointed out the obvious dishonesty, and they have just resorted to ignoring me. My partner and I have been very patient with them, but they have no intention to actually do their job.

I would consider other options when looking for a home.

I recently moved into Grove at Harcourt, the worst decision of my life. this place looks like a shady area, I can smell pee on the main door of my building, there are multiple service issues, and despite login service calls no body comes for service, These people don't care at all

I recently moved to this amazing apartment and it truly exceeded my expectations. The spacious and beautifully designed rooms made me feel right at home from the moment I walked in. The modern amenities provided everything I needed for a comfortable stay.

The apartment complex itself was well-maintained and offered a peaceful atmosphere. The surrounding neighborhood was safe and conveniently located near shops, restaurants, and public transportation options. It was easy to explore the city and access various attractions.

The building staff were friendly, professional, and always available to assist with any questions or concerns. The level of customer service provided was exceptional, making my stay even more enjoyable.

Chris was a complete angel sent from heaven for me and my family. Deja was so kind and helpful from the very second we moved in. We also won our 150 back and was able to to pay a pro-rated amount to get into the apartment early they really understood my situation. I really owe them so much for the kindness and understanding they gave me. 

Overall, I highly recommend this apartment to looking for a luxurious and comfortable place to stay. It offers the perfect combination convenience, elegance, and exceptional customer service.
I love living here so much!! Great experiences and would highly recommend!

These apartments are beyond horrible.  Roaches and mice are everywhere and management will repeatedly say pest control is coming. They will tell you short staffed and won't fix issues.  Many people have called for help. There's trash everywhere in the neighborhood. Neighbors get robbed in the wee hours at gunpoint. People sit in cars for hours and play loud music. People smoke weed in the hallways at all hours of the day. Kid's play loudly in them as well. If you try to speak to the parent's it's opening up drama. The driveways have huge pot holes and not enough parking. You will need to carry mace or a gun walking far to your apartment. The state should condemn these apartments.

Been here 1 year and had 3 different management companies.
Some highlights:

Gave me the wrong key on move in, lost their copy of my key multiple times and had to change the locks

Took 3 months to get me mailbox keys. 1 year later they still can't get me a storage room key.

Common laundry room floods my apartment, the hallway, and shared storage areas every time someone does laundry. I've had wet carpet for months at a time and they just clean it instead of fixing the plumbing. Blame residents for the drain blockages, but won't create a permanent solution.

Can't be specific about crime rate, but I encourage you to take a look at what's reported at the property.

Latest is having a mandatory bug bombing scheduled and sending out a letter to empty all closets and kitchen cabinets. Remove pets from home from 9 to 5. 
Pest control never came and when I called the office, they said they meant to tell us that the letter was a mistake and we didn't have to do any of that, and we don't even have to have pest control come. 

Regional management doesn't care either.

Teenagers destroying propery. Trash all over. Nothing done about complaints. Thin walls. Stomping neighbors. Cars broken into. Lazy and rude managers who don't help. Cars towed on the property. Elderly man with a heart condition who has limited funds had flat tire issues and the apartments knew this but allowed his car to keep getting towed. Trust me, these apartments are terrible and you will never be able to call them "home".

My apartments are located in a perfect area. We have several stores in the community and three are within walking distance. Our property is well maintained on the outside and the inside. We have wonderful office staff and maintaince.I have lived here for ten plus years and i dont plan to move any time soon

I would highly recommend this apartment and management company. Responsive to emails quickly, maintenance is friendly and always responds within 24 hours, snow removal is timely and they salt walkways in bad weather, cleans hallways monthly, parking lot is well lit with cameras, and main doors have key entry for safety. I only wish they had washer and dryer hookups in the apartments, but I’ve had no issues with the laundry room located on the first floor. Great location to downtown and 3 mins to get on 65!

I love this apartment, it is modern & cozy. I live downtown Indianapolis and am close to all the action. As a young female living alone, I feel completely save and secure. I would recommend to anyone young professional to check out!

very very poor staff.  Not clean. Maintenance lazy. Front office rude snoody run their mouth and tell residents your business.  Very poor service.  Don't plow snow. Had no street lights for over a year. Charged me more rent due to covid. Over priced. Don't waste your money time or energy on this place... not since BAM no thank you ma'am took over.

Found Gateway Crossing Apartment Homes online and it is located in McCordsville which is out of the loop of Marion County (yay) and a stones throw from Geist.  This community is lovely, the apartments are spacious, well managed and maintained by an incredible maintenance guy who knows how to do everything.  The clubhouse is classy, the gym is well equipped and the ladies in the office have impeccable manners and great customer service skills.  

The buildings in the back are fantastic, especially the penthouse units facing the big hill.  It is like living in a nature preserve and we love living here!  Wish I could buy our apartment!  The stairs enable us to open the windows when the weather is nice as opposed to living downstairs where you cannot (spiders-bugs) and where you hear a little noise from the upstairs.  

A great selling point is we have not lost power in three years while Indianapolis et al seems to get disconnected during storms.  

The only trash dumpster is located at the front of the property, which is tidy and means there are not several tacky dumpsters overflowing by all the buildings like in other apartments. 
 
The maintenance man has to shovel the entire community.  I tip him heavy every Christmas and would suggest others do the same.  He works extremely hard all the time and especially during the winter.  The office ladies arrange all kinds of parties throughout the year for free and for fun and it is a good chance to meet your neighbors and maybe even make a new friend.  The pool is crystal clean and stays open longer than most pools.  There is also a big community barbeque.  Very walkable with sidewalks all throughout.  

Most of the people here are thoughtful and they do not litter and pick up their dog waste and keep their animals on leash.  There is a train which goes by and it is a non-issue and does not bother us one bit.  There are Police patrols and very little crime. The manager, Sherry, has always been very polite and kind.  Erika is also a very nice person and has moved on to bigger and better adventures.  Hannah, the new leasing agent has exceptional telephone and office etiquette, even stands up when a person enters the office, which is awesome manners from someone so young.  It is nice to see this in this day and age.      

JC Hart knows they have a winning team here at Gateway Crossing Apartments and I would hope they are paid above average wages for an exceptional, quiet, beautiful, clean and happy community.

The place is pretty basic, with a few amenities, such as a small pool and a very basic gym with missing equipment, namely free-weights. The price is more than other comparable places in Indianapolis, by about $200 per month. The staff can sometimes be lazy, except for the maintenance guy, who works real hard and get stuff done quick and correctly. When there are neighbors who don't follow the rules, (which pretty lax and standard, but are sometimes exploited by residents,) they have to be coaxed sometimes to enforce them. They have a clause in their rental agreement that includes their right to create and enforce new rules without notice, referring "Policy and Regulations" handbook, which you need to ask for up front. I've never had any issues with this, but it's pretty presumptuous of them to add. It kind of makes me nervous that they can set rules that are not included in the lease agreement, and change them unilaterally, though they are still restricted by the "Landlord obligations" state statute. If you went in and asked for the handbook, them might not even have one on hand. 

   The neighborhood isn't bad, but their are a lot of kids who walk from the gas station to the Gateway Crossing single-family home subdivision behind the apartments, who throw trash on the ground. There are open fields and farms surrounding all the apartments, so bugs, namely spiders and assorted "Nopes" can be a pain during the summer months, much more so in the first level apartments. Be prepared to spay repellent twice a month (no matter the strength), and always keep a Raid can handy, even in the early/late winter months. The wildlife can be plus though. Lots of frogs, lightning bugs, and a few deer are spotted near/in/around the complex quite often. There is also an active train track near the complex, and a crossing or three... their blare the horn 24/7, its loud...

   Its a good place for pets. With a decent number of waste stations around the buildings. Though, some residents get really lazy during the snowy months and don't pick up. A few people walk their dogs without a leash, and this aggravates me. Their is an additional non-refundable pet deposit and regular addition to the rent.

   All in all, it's a good place to live, but the price is forcing my hand to a cheaper residence. If you can find something better/cheaper/more private, then go for it, but this is a good secondary option. Beware the rent increases after each renewal, as it borderlines on absurdity.e
The service has been outstanding!!! Love the community and the staff.

Revolving door of managers with different rules and policies.  Refusal to add grab bars in bath or convert showers.  Add- on fees mid- lease.  Corporate office promises to fix things but ignores calls and emailed complaints.  Weeks of exterior security doors not locking.  Months to fix a dryer.  Very overpriced for no amenities.  No pool, patio, grill, covered parking, or concierge.  Corporate leadership always firing and hiring area, property managers so nobody knows what another manager has agreed to. 3 months without a property manager and office floaters who can’t even create a maintenance order.  Many angry residents and many vacancies.

The original owners planned a hotel next to the apartments which now sits unfinished and an eye sore. They have sold the apartments to new ownership and they are even worse. Good luck getting in contact with anyone. My washing machine has been broken for 2 months and I sent multiple emails with no response. The service request link to report problems is still broken. I call the leasing office and it doesn't even ring. I have to pay $80 for parking and I do not even have a parking spot. Speedway does not have paid parking anywhere else but Wilshaw. You also have no choice but to pay $28 for "valet trash" which doesn't come on weekends or holidays or if there is heavy snow or at the time they are meant to. The dumpster is right outside the doors anyway. The appliances are cheap and the apartments small and noisy. Do not waste your money.

After renewing our lease with the promise that our rent would not increase, we are now being told that despite it not being stated in our lease that paying to park is REQUIRED, we will now risk being towed if we do not pay for the reserved parking. Outdoor surface parking is $80/month per vehicle. On top of this, we overpay for little amenities and a mediocre apartment. The location is really the only perk we get for living here. I am disappointed in Wilshaw.

I cannot say enough great things about Wilshaw apartments. Working with Reina was a pleasure. When I first came to tour and find out my options she was so helpful and maintained a genuine connection with me. I did not feel pressured whatsoever and when I finally returned to begin the application process she was just as enthusiastic as the first time we met. The day I moved in she ensured I was well taken care of. I have had packages delivered to me from the day I moved in with no hassle. The service I have received has been so professional and personalized to fit my needs. The property and amenities are so gorgeous and well built. I am happy to have found my new home here in Indy. Thank you!!!!

I have lived here for just over 2 weeks.  These are very new apartments in nice area.  The units are new and modern and come with pretty nice appliances.  There were some issues on moving in with it being new construction but the maintenance team has been good at fixing the problems.  The only negative so far has been setting up the internet.  The installation of the fiber wire was not done correctly and it has been a challenge getting that issue resolved.  Other than that issue it has been a good place to live so far.

I’ve lived here for about two weeks now and have had nothing but issues. 
The management does nothing with noise complaints. My neighbors above me stomp so loud that literal items hanging on my walls fall off and also wake me up.
This goes on from 3 am until they leave for work then picks back up around 3-4pm until around 11pm. 
Quiet hours as stated by management are 10pm on week days and 11pm on weekends. 
When telling management that the noise is at 3 am and wakes a grown man up because it’s so loud they inform me that since my email was sent at 6 pm the noise apparently doesn’t exist because obviously when the email is sent is the only time noise is able to be made.
I’m happily breaking this lease and warn EVERYBODY to avoid moving in these apartments.
Great place to live.  Quiet neighbors and nice apartments.  Updated appliances. Would recommend to others in the neighborhood.  Nice areas to walk your pets.  Includes a pool and a gym.

After seeing the reviews I had changed my mind about moving here because of the unsafe environment. The manager gave me a follow-up call after me leaving a message. I told her that I no longer wanted to move here because of the crime and reviews. She basically said, I can’t get my money back and she literally slammed the phone in my face. Talking about unprofessional… I’m glad I didn’t move here I can only imagine the residents frustration and what the have to deal with and this was the property manager.

They don’t care about residents, and will screw you over without a single thought.

Stayed here for over a year. Living conditions were okay. Maintenance is incredibly slow..(They left me without an operational toilet for 3 weeks once despite continual office visits.) As soon as covid happened that was an excuse to avoid any work possible. I could tolerate the maintenance issues though.

What is intolerable is their policies regarding move out. As soon as your move out date you can no longer access your online pay portal. However you still have a “final account statement.” Not sure whether they never sent this to me at all...or with the crazy year we have had maybe USPS lost it. (This should have been certified mail anyway clearly it was not.)

They will send your balance to a sketchy collections agency in Missouri without any attempt to contact you. I would have gladly paid my final bills if I had any possible way of knowing or accessing them. I did not receive a single phone call or email and I sure as hell never got anything in the mail. ( I track everything very closely with USPS informed delivery.)I also wouldn’t have heard about this at the walkthrough as we were denied a final walkthrough “because covid” and told we would be contacted if there were any issues, which obviously was not true.

I only discovered this bill by noticing a 150 point dip on my credit score on Experian. Management was totally unapologetic over the phone and says their policy is to automatically send everything to collections. Again I did not receive ANY contact about this and would have gladly paid.

I never had a single late payment the whole time I lived here. Management could have been decent and called me even once about due payment and I would have gladly paid.

If you dream of a new home or car one day DO NOT RENT HERE. They will screw your credit and you won’t know about it until it’s too late.

Seriously don’t do it!! The place looks nice and staff act responsive and knowledgeable, but once you sign the lease you see the charade end. We had one maintenance issues after another and their maintenance staff is horrible. When they do respond which is rare, it’s typically to give you an excuse why something can’t be fixed. The staff are nonexistent and when they are in the office they hardly answer the phones. We literally sat outside calling and the lady looked at the phone and went right back to watching TV. You overpay for poor living conditions and unresponsive unimpressive staff. Just don’t do it.

Had a sink leak. Maintenance came in and couldn’t fix it so wrapped the wood sink base and plastic. Mold grew all over the kitchen and they refused to fix it. We moved our 14 days short of our 60 day notice due to them refusing to fix it and they charged us an extra $450 dollars for not giving a 60 day notice. Staff was non existent and used COVID for every excuse possible. Don’t live here I promise you will regret.

The new management (Birge & Held) is worse than the previous management (Buckingham). They have been dishonest and duplicitous in their dealings with me, especially after having to move from one apartment to another after the plumbing failed and the apartment flooded. Attempted to place me in a smaller and more expensive apartment than I was leaving, then placed me in an apartment, which was ready for move-in. Requests for repairs take months to complete, but the repairs do not last. The online payment portal has shown a lower amount due than the management’s claims, but nothing has been done to reconcile the two despite numerous requests. The current property manager says whatever is necessary to get you to leave without the slightest effort to follow up. A couple of other residents have complained of similar experiences and are leaving, as am I after living here for six years. A tent under a bridge would be preferable to The Rail.

In the last 2 years: 2 of my neighbors have been shot, my wife’s car has been stolen, the wheels have been stolen off my car, and several other cars have been broken into. Not sure how much crime has to happen before they up security measures, or at least stop raising rent $300/month every time you renew your lease. Would not recommend to anyone.

Be prepared for extra charges tacked on to your bill that weren’t in your lease! Our lease that starts the same days as their new mandatory internet fee yet they chose not to disclose prior to signing because we were told EXACTLY 30 days in advance. The same lease specifically states that to receive internet, we needed to seek a third party provider because The Residences doesn’t provide it. 

Hundreds of residents are now being forced to pay for the internet Birge and Held (owners of the complex) have selected, spent different six visits installing and are almost certainly making money off what amounts to internet exclusivity. Many people are locked into existing internet contracts and are stuck either paying both monthly fees (don’t worry, the complex’s fee is much higher!) or shelling out exorbitant cancellation fees.

Their replies to negative feedback are hilarious. Reach out to management to ask questions and all you’ll get is “yes it sucks and yes we’re doing it anyway! Nothing you can do about it!”  

Look at reviews for other B&H properties and the company themselves. This is their MO, it seems. Do not rent unless you’re budgeting hundreds of extra dollars per year on top of whatever agreement you sign.

Trash compactor is always down with trash everywhere. Bogus fees. They just started forcing their own internet. You can’t opt out. It goes against the lease. It’s wireless and if you need hardwired then you have to pay to get it installed in their apartment. Started charging bogus package fees to sit packages behind a locked door. DO NOT RENT HERE!

I've lived at this property since Dec 2018 (I've lived in two apartments here), so I think I have a pretty solid idea about the property's strengths and weaknesses. I lived here before the new company Birge & Held took over and I have seen a decline in the property as a whole. 

Before Birge & Held took over we constantly saw maintenance out picking up trash and overall just making sure the property looked great from an aesthetic point of view on a regular basis. The grass was watered, etc. 

Since Birge & Held took over the grass isn't being watered by the apartments -- only by the leasing office -- so it looks patchy in the spring/summer/fall. Pool fixtures were not fixed during pool season and there's a street light that is constantly flashing by my building and hasn't been fixed for months. I'm not even confident they drained the pool before winter. Also, I'm pretty sure that before the first big cold and ice they didn't salt the sidewalks before Christmas 2022. They're usually outstanding at doing that in prep for bad weather. 

Overall, the super high quality that I was accustomed to has gone down. I think it's due to this company trying to increase the return for investors. They did replace all appliances (all floors) and flooring (first floors) but I'm not confident that wasn't just a cash grab to raise rent next year. (The apartments are relatively new so appliances and floors didn't need replacing.) Our apartment is being listed at over $200 more per month on the website for new renters than what we're paying now which is worrisome.

Now, to be fair, this place was a great deal when I first rented. It appears they're trying to get this property up to "market" plus a little extra. I just hope they actually continue the good quality that we're used to. Time will tell if it's not already telling. 

Strengths: maintenance servicemen are quick and reliable, apartments are nicely sized for the current cost, small gym, lovely pool, leasing office staff has been helpful and forthright when I've asked some difficult questions, gift wrapping station in the winter, cute events throughout the year (which I've never gone to but it's nice that they put them on). 

Weaknesses: property maintenance hasn't been maintained as much. 

I'm getting the sense that for what I'm paying, I'm not getting as much. That's making us (long-term renters who always pay on time) look elsewhere.

DO NOT RENT!!! Staff have a mean girl’s attitude, not friendly and completely unhelpful when asked for help as it takes away from their time of socializing and gossiping during office hours! Walls in this place are paper thin, I can here every toilet flush! There is a dog living upstairs and I hear every single nail scratching on the wooden floors and barking at allll hours!! The drains stink! Smells like the people opposite are growing a marijuana farm!! The AC only works in the living space and will not reach the bedroom!! Uncomfortable living. Over priced!  DO NOT RENT!!!

My husband and I have lived here for a couple of years now and we love it here.  The office staff have been so friendly and helpful, the maintenance staff is also great. In fact, we know everyone by their first names. Our apt. is wonderful and all issues are handled Immediately.  Once again,  we love it, and we love our community.  Thanks.

We lived at the Residences on Ronald Reagan for two plus years and our experience was awesome. Best apartment living you can find! First of all the office staff and maintenance is amazingly kind, caring, and accommodating. Shout out to Casey! They truly care about your experience. Casey remembered our names after only meeting us once. She made you feel like family. The apartments were amazing.... modern, huge walk in closets, lots of kitchen cabinet storage, storage outside of unit, nice garden tubs, and layout of apartments were great. The amenities were outstanding with a very large, well designed pool, valet trash, grill area,dog park, exercise room, and beautiful clubhouse. We miss their awesome pool! Let me say the grounds were always so well kept with landscaping being a priority. We moved away for a duplex experience and let me say we are regretting it now :(.   You won't find a nicer west-side apartment complex than this! Thank you Casey and Ronnie for going above and beyond!

I moved from a very nice apartment in Carmel to the slums in Fishers, AKA Bella Vista. This place is so poorly managed and the apartments are so poorly built! They call themselves 'luxury" apartments and slap with you a pricy rent, but this place is far from luxury! The wall are incredibly paper thin and my boyfriend and I hear our loud upstairs neighbor all day long. We've complained but nothing has been resolved yet. Everything looks nice at glance, but once you actually move in you realize how mediocre everything actually is. Appliances, flooring, lack of storage, AND the washer and dryer are extra in your luxury apartment ;) The gilling area is unusable. The knobs fall off the grills so if you want to use them you need to use a screwdriver to turn the grill on, that is if the grill is even cleaned. Which it usually isn't. The common areas are pretty dirty until you complain then the carpets gets cleaned. The people that live here don't seem to care to take pride in this place, you'll find trash in the hallways, in the parking lot, and surrounding the trash compactor. These are by far one of the worst apartments I've lived in!!

The worst experience ever.  Sold our house and needed a 6 month lease.  Picked the apartment online, put money down to hold it after viewing the model with Italo, then found out 1 week before we were to move in that apartment was not available. We were told by Taylor and Italo the tenants never moved out, we could clearly see it was vacant.  We were offered another apartment, 3rd floor, but with mobility issues that would not work.  Spoke with Carissa the regional manager who was not helpful and didn’t even care when I said I wanted my money back. We took our business elsewhere and you should too.

I love all the outdoor space. Just minutes away from downtown Fishers. I love that fact that my husband and I can walk (15 minutes) to our favorite restaurants downtown Fishers.  Just the convenience of being clise to everything.  The apartments are beautiful and spacious. The office staff treat us like family.  We are excited that we choose Bella Vista as our home.

only place I can have my big dog and walk out his energy with the trails near by. plus is connected to the interstate for my job. glad I found this place me and my dog finally feel at home here. thanks

Communication is not good.  
We were given the wrong address during our lease signing and weren't shown to the apartment.  The one we were assigned didn't exist so we had to search for it.  Several items I requested to be repaired upon move in never were taken care of.  Never received an electronic access card despite requesting one.  I was told they were on back order last July.  I overheard a tenant today being told that they are on back order... The tv package they offer is for the life of the lease, they didn't tell us that and in order to cancel it you have to submit a request to their corporate office so they can decide whether or not to let you cancel it.  Electric was included on our rent statement every month for 10 months.  We got a letter on our door one day saying we needed to transfer our service to our name which was news to us because since it appeared on our statement and we weren't ever told we needed to transfer it.  We were also paying a $25 administrative fee which was explained to me as a fee for the company to bill me for the electric service since I never switched the responsibility.  I sounds like a sneaky way to make $25 a month. Nice pool.

Upon moving into this apartment I was excited. Very nice location and new buildings, but that quickly ended after numerous problems that weren't taken seriously by staff. My internet didn't work for the first month that I lived here and the IT guy had to be in my apartment numerous times! Also the property manager in particular is a very rude person! She should learn to be more polite! You have to call about the same problem numerous times before it gets done (IF it gets done) and you really feel like you're bothering the STAFF when you need a problem resolved, although it's their JOB to be helpful. I honestly wish I went somewhere else because it's been nothing but a headache!

The Brixton is awesome! It is a peaceful, small community located in the heart of Beech Grove! Their amenities alone will blow you away but the office manager was very nice and informative on the community! We can wait to become residents at The Brixton!

I recently moved to The Brixton and must say I have enjoyed every moment of it. The apartment has just enough space for my dog and I and the staff is friendly and accommodating. I would recommend this property to anyone looking for an apartment in the Beech Grove area!

The Brixton is one of the best properties the Beech Grove area has to offer! The apartments are completed updated and there's lots for people to do. The pool is beautiful, the laundry room is always nice and clean, and there's generous parking. I have no complaints !

This is a super complex for those of us who are looking for a rest from the noise of the city; yet we are close enough to downtown to run down there for a great weekend event or evening out. Management is terrific! The grounds are well manicured, buildings and some interiors are showing their age slightly but the retro feel is fun! I only wish the pool was open. Overall, a great place for the price!

Then charged me $50 for not returning it when I moved out months later. I had to scrape it off my windshield and it ripped into pieces.

Apartments are old and need updating!
Great experience. May live here. Still looking, but really like this place.

The maintenance staff respond rather quickly and when we moved in our apartment was in good condition so we didn't have a lot of issues. We did have to follow up a few times about referral money but the staff has always been kind and respectful. We never got bogged down in extra fees and our rent never went up. We are grateful for a good experience with Stanford Court and recommend it for those who are searching for something good at a good price!

This all falls back on me because I was in such a rush in looking for a home... This is not a place that you'll want to spend more than a yr at. 2 reasons... These apartments are the definition of a "lemon", don't be fooled by appearances.  They are manipulative and rush you out of their office as fast as they can.  Don't expect any direct communication.  Wouldn't suggest living here long term.

PLEASE do not move here. I lived here for over a year and a half and found the apartments very charming. However this was not worth the problems I faced here. THE HEAT SHUT OFF MULTIPLE TIMES. To this day I have not been refunded and my calls to the complex and corporate are ignored. Please read the reviews about this place and trust them. Don't live through the nightmare that I did.

You need night vision to go outside at night.  The buildings all have flood lights in the right areas, but only about 20% of them work.  They are too lazy to fix the ones that are broken and won't replace the bulbs in the others.  Snow and ice stays on the walks for days sometimes!  Rent goes up about 10% year after year and what we get for it is all these headaches and more.  Thank you :(

I moved in when it was Conner Farms back in the fall of 2015 when management cared about their residences and maintenance issues were taken care of in a day or two.  Since then the management only cares about their appearance as they spent loads of money remodeling their offices but don't give a hoot about windows that have lost their seals to the point you cannot see out of them, the HVAC sounds like a plane engine when running and the roofs have leaks around the fireplaces. The apartments are all falling apart period.  If you enjoy quite, and good maintenance, do not move here.  Not worth the price.  I will be done building my new home soon and can't wait to get out of this  hole.

Door would not stay locked.  Dryer took 2 hours to dry small load  Sinks and toilets constantly clogging or constantly running unless you giggled handles. You could hear explosions from the quarry at 96th.  Regional management rude and militant.  Kitchen so small fridge door hit wall if you try to open all the way.
I love the neighborhood! It is very quiet...even on weekends when most people are home. Pleasant staff and maintenance crew. Excited to see the renovations to the clubhouse!

Word of caution to others, you'd do well to avoid any Fath property.

From a letter that was left on our doors, there are several rules that are contrary to state laws and are down right discriminatory. For example:
"Resident is prohibited from adding, changing, or in any way altering locks installed on the doors of his or her apartment without the written permission of management." However Indiana IC code says that a resident is permitted to change any locks as they deem fit, provided the landlord is given a key to the new lock within 24 hours. 

Their vehicle regs are a doozy!
This one is fun as it is a complete contradiction to their actual vehicle agreement they want you to sign upon move in or take over: "no vehicle maintenance is permitted on the premises, including: changing oil or fluids, any under hood servicing, body work, or tire changing." But when you look at the actual vehicle agreement they state: "No repairing or washing of vehicles is permitted on the premises, except in designated wash areas. Only emergency service of fixing a flat or jump starting is allowed. All other maintenance or service must be performed off property." So which is it? 

And this is great too:
"All vehicles must comply with the vehicle condition standards set by Fath Properties in order not to detract from the properties appearance. A vehicle may be forbidden on or near the property for any of the following reasons: Excessive rust or dents, missing body parts including hubcaps, flat tires, incomplete or unsightly paint job including primer, unsightly exterior, excessively worn vinyl top or seats, or a vehicle with leaking fluid or an excessively loud engine." And they state: "The definition of non-operable, abandoned, or unauthorized vehicle or equipment shall be liberally construed in favor of management." In other words, they will snake their way into stealing your vehicle.

In Indiana, only one party is required to know a phone call is being recorded. If you're the one recording, you've met the law. This statement from their rules should give you pause and make you record your conversations:
"No oral agreements.There have been no oral agreements made between Fath Properties and the resident.Landlord will not be bound by any agreements or promises made by its representatives unless agreement is in writing, signed by the Property Manager or an officer of Fath Properties." This should give ANY perspective resident pause and force them to reconsider the property.

The name changed from Conner Farms when new owners took over in December of 2015. If anything, they've made things worse. Look at the awful reviews for Conner Farms if you want a real picture of how lousy these apartments are.

The problems with my apartment started when I first moved in. I have gotten the same maintenance guy who is awesome but the office staff is the exact opposite. When I first came to visit the complex I asked about the washer and dryer, if they would be able to take them out as I have my own set. I was told they would just have to see when they would have room to put the ones in my apartment. Once I moved in the story changed, and I was told they never take them out. When I said that wasn't what I was told I asked again because the one they had in my apartment sounded like an airplane taking flight when washing clothes. The story changed again that a guy that just moved in after me was able to bring his own washer and dryer. Also when I first moved in I was taking a shower and my feet started burning, I found out the painters poured paint down the bathtub which also ruined the glaze on the tub. My bathtub had to be reglazed in which I couldn't be in my apartment for 24 hours. The office did not offer to give me a hotel or anywhere else to stay, it was on me to find a place to even though it is required for me to not be home. I also put in a request for my door lock as it wasn't working proper. The office staff pushes you to put work request in online, which I did on Friday. Doors and locks are emergency issues, however they said the maintenance guys received my request on Monday and it wasn't completed. I went to the office on Monday because I was unable to get in due to my lock not working. The office staff told me to go back to my apartment and the maintenance guy would be right over. After waiting for 45 minutes in 40 degree weather I went back to the office and they said the maintenance guy was at another property but I could wait there. The property manager said it was my fault it wasn't done because I put the request in online. My question was, no one could have called me and told me that in the last 45 minutes? It is issue after issue here, when you put in a maintenance request, it takes over 5 days to get it completed. I have never lived at an apartment that is this terrible. I would not recommend this place to my worse enemy.

Conner Farms are nicely maintained apartments.  They are doing things to upgrade the apartments such as new kitchen cabinets and appliances, brushed nickel fixtures, and crown moulding.  I have an 80s kitchen that is super ugly, but updated fixtures and crown moulding.  The management staff are friendly and attentive.  The maintenance guys are quick to respond, but sometimes they try every small thing before they "fix" the problem.  I know it is an effort to save money, but it must cost more in the end since they spend so much time and effort to not spend the big bucks.  But they never leave you hanging.  The grounds are kept nice, as well as the pool and parking areas.  It's a mostly quiet neighborhood, as well as safe.  I rarely hear my neighbors through the walls.  I would definitely rent from them again.

We love it here in Fishers! If you want to move into one of the top suburbs in the US, a perfect step is to simply move into Conner Farms! The apartment staff (office and maintenance)is top-notch, friendly, courteous, and sincerely caring about your living experience. We love our spacious, clean apartment and beautiful landscaping wherever we look! Our goal is to settle into this area by buying our own home, and living at Conner Farms provides us with such a pleasant home environment while we get acclimated to our new area while preparing for our final destination. Best place I've ever lived. You can't beat Fishers and you can't beat Conner Farms! We'll never regret our decision to just move here.

I really enjoy living here at Conner Farms, the apartment community itself is quiet for the most part, but offers lots of amenities. The pool is very nice, and my dog loves running in the fenced in dog run area.

We love that we can be in Fishers, Carmel, Noblesville, Castelton, or Broadripple in minutes.   Great restaurants, Great neighbors, Awesome pool with a grill!  Safe for our kids, nice playground close by.  5 Stars! You will love it here!

Living here for more than 3 years and never seen any delays in maintenance services. Appreciate the work done by office staff to organize several fun events. Great place to stay. One con staying here is the apartments having less square feet.
Mice (a variety of mice little ones medium sized ones mice as big as squirrels), mold, old noisy buildings.

When I touring these apartments they seem fine on the surface a little outdated but fine. they are worse than they appear from a far. up close they are extremely outdated and repaired or "updated" by painting over the old stuff. Trash constantly overflowing from bins, residents leave trash in the halls. No phone signal. If you want internet, you have to use their service which caps at 100mbps at the cost of fiber from other companies and they don't provide a wifi router.  So if there is an emergency, hope you have a landline.

I have lived in apartments my whole life from the east side to north side of Indianapolis this is by far the worst apartment I’ve ever lived in very outdated they charge you for every little thing possible why does it cost me 40 dollars to pay my rent online I’ve never heard of such a rip off in my life they need new owners and possibly office staff this place has potential but if the place charges as much as they do for the quality they have it’s ridiculous how much rent is here very outdated don’t move her didn’t have a good experience at all

this place sucks. If it’s not one thing it’s another with these apartments. The office ladies are rude and snobby. I’ve only lived here for a whole 12 months and had 8! The pool and gym are always way to crowded and let me not forget the mice
Everything is seemingly fine at first but then you move out and you realize they’re not as nice as they seem. The location is great but almost everything else is not.

Very nice place; nice people in the office; maintenance is also very nice and polite. I would say the rent is very high; but it was cheapest and nicest that we found from our searches. Marble counter tops in the bathrooms and kitchen is a plus.

We have lived here going on 3 years. It has been a safe place to live and a great location. I really think the rent is too high for such a small apartment without any updates. Looks like it was built in the 70s. If it was updated it would be a great place to live.

The new PM also threatened to tow my car for resurfacing after giving 2 days notice via email over a weekend, she refused to accept my 30 days notice, and charged me extra rent when I moved out. Beautiful building but poor construction and poorly managed.

While my initial experience here was decent, the noise has escalated to an unbearable level. I can hear my neighbors on the phone at all hours, as if they're in the same room. The most distressing part is being subjected to their intimate moments, especially the disruptive activities at 3 am. Sadly, I feel compelled to advise potential renters to steer clear of this apartment due to the worsening noise situation.

Amazing place to live. The location is perfect, far enough from downtown to escape the hustle and bustle, but close enough to be part of city life. The best courtyard you'll ever see (with plenty of chairs, recliners, tables, grills, and a fire pit!). A well equipped fitness center. The staff is the best amenity though. Cameron, the manager, is legit the nicest person you will ever meet. Right from the beginning, she went the extra mile: when I first moved in, I arrived after office hours, but Cameron provided me with clear pictures and instructions on where my unit was and the best place to unpack. She is always doing something for the residents, whether its holiday events, free food, or inviting food trucks to hang out in the parking lot for an evening. Tim, who does maintenance, is just an all around great guy: when he found out I didn't have a bike, he offered me one that had been abandoned by a previous resident. The one time I needed maintenance done in my unit, Tim resolved the issue quickly and completely. Missy does an amazing job with keeping the place clean: every single time I brought someone over, they always compliment how the place looked--BEFORE we even got into the unit! I really cannot recommend this place enough. Thank you Cameron, Tim, Missy, not enough places work hard to make sure their residents' living situation is the least of their worries. My only complaint is that you've set the standard too high!
Cameron and Tim were absolutely wonderful during our time at Harding Street. They will be greatly missed. This building is beautiful! Our apartment will be missed.

I had a package from Fedex that had gone missing for a week, FedEx couldn’t tell me anything. Cameron the office manager went above and beyond to help me and we finally found my package in a parcel locker after her help!! Maintenance is always extremely helpful and friendly too. 5/5 stars

I would not live here if you like to have company over or if you like to sleep in peace. Between the lack of guest parking and the loud train that goes by 5 times a day and 4 times a night I can confidently say I would not live here again. Management is terrible and unprofessional and also changes frequently. There are less than 15 guest parking spots for 200  tenants. It makes no sense. Walls are paper thin you can hear everything your neighbor is doing. Pros: Cute rustic feel and close to down town.

This is an awesome property in the broad ripple area. I personally love that it still has it's original art deco charm. The units all are unique so your apartment can be truly your own. The location is amazing for walkability throughout Broad Ripple. You have access to multiple restaurants, coffee shops, entertainment venues, and the grocery store. As a lot of buildings in the area have been rebuilt to be more modern, this little hidden gem really is a treasure.

Living solo in a new state/city, I was glad I found this complex in January. A4 floor plan.
Location -- Building is across the street from many fast food places (as well as 3 blocks west). 10th Street is very busy during rush hour as people are trying to get onto I-65, but luckily there's plenty of good alternatives to getting to the building. Otherwise the location is great to get around downtown. 3 blocks from the leasing office.

Parking -- Is on the first floor underneath all the apartments (so covered!), but the spots are a bit narrow to pull into. There's a few spots where guests can park infront of the building but is full maybe half the time. Since there is a business area across the street, I had guests park in that lot without issues (not sure about overnight).

Amenities -- Gym was nice to use,y I wish it had one or two more machines and larger-weight dumbbells. Not many people used the gym. Lounge was nice, but never used by anyone. Originally management was going to install (more) bike racks in the parking spaces but never did. Residents store them in the stairwell (out the actual walkway) and it's been fine. Myself and other residents had issues with Amazon deliveries; they lost the building keys, would leave packages outside along the busy roadway where people walk by.
Spectrum internet (60mbps I think) and cable was included, which is a major bonus. Never had issues with speeds or service but calling customer service was a headache setting up an account.

Apartment -- 3 story building. Key fob entrances [only]. Intercom system is useful. I was on third floor, and had high ceilings. Stairwell and hallways were wide enough where there was no issues moving in/out. The laundry in my one bedroom took up most of the closet space for the main area. Had plenty of storage in the kitchen, and bedroom closet. Balcony would have been nice if it faced outwards, but facing the townhomes became a game of guessing when the nursing students would come home. Large bathroom with plenty of counter space. 

Management -- Stephanie is an amazing manager. Would be able to text her questions well past work hours and would get responses. Because the building is brand new, I never had to call maintenance, but I would see people every few days doing cleaning of the public areas. Downside is that they manage a few buildings, so can't always have someone in the Leasing Office. I think they hired another leasing person recently. If they haven't, they should :)

The rent here is very affordable for the proximity to Mass Ave and other areas downtown.  However, there are certain amenities here that you will not get here like you would in other buildings.  The my unit itself and the appliances in my unit were outdated, and every time I cleaned I would find a quite a few pill bugs lying around.  I didn't mind the noise of the highway behind my bedroom but I imagine other people would be bothered by this.  It may also depend on the location of your unit.  Overall, I ended up renewing my lease once so it's not the worst, but I'm happy to be upgrading.
Month old tickets getting completed with no work actually being done.

The headline says it all. Two bedroom two bath and one toilet clogged three days ago…but it’s okay because “I have another one”. Those things usually get better with time though, right? High prices and bad maintenance but the neighbors are cool…

Overall. I do have to say. This is a great place to live. The community is quiet and kept to themselves and those that arent are incredibly friendly. Megan and Michelle are both so great and have helped me with so much personally and everything is just like home here

We are temporary residents while building our home. Very friendly professional staff in every area. 
The location is perfect for us and convenient to many areas and attractions. 
Would highly recommend .
Pat

When we moved in we had to re-clean the apartment they did a terrible job cleaning our apartment. The fridge stunk and had to have maintenance come fix it the first week here. There's no  insulation in the walls your electric bill is going to be very high. You can hear everything your Neighbors do and are just loud and rude in general. Can smell cigarettes and weed despite their no smoking policy. I found information from previous renters here online they jacked up the rent 300+ dollars a month so your paying more than you should. These apartments are cheap for what you are paying. The office staff are ignorant Jerks. I told them how unhappy I was with everything listed so far and the Leasing consultant just sent me the forms to move out instead of trying to see what they could do to make me happier for the remainder of my lease. I told them I accidentally broke my garage door and it couldn't get my vehicle out and then they wanted to charge me $400 to fix it. They want you to pay for everything here despite how much your already paying. The appliances are dated and don't work that great. My washing machine has rust on the inside lid and a lot of it. All of the doors and windows leak so much cold air through. My fire is extinguishersure is expired and they claim they did a full inspection before we moved in. I would say they didn't do one at all. There only one spot to throw your trash away and it's at the beginning of the complex so if you live all the way in the back you have to walk like almost a mile to throw your trash away or put it in your car. Now they're going to start to fine you if you jam the trash compactor. 50 dollars the first time you jam it, 100 the next and 150 the third time. What a joke. The gym they have on site has ancient equipment in it and half of it is broken. Don't move here this place is a rip off and not worth the money.

I have lived at the Reserve at Williams Glen for a little over five years now and have been consistently pleased with the quality of the community and the level of responsiveness from the office staff and facilities crew.  Any work order requests are consistently responded to in a prompt manner.  And the office staff is always top-notch in their level of professional customer service.  I highly recommend the Reserve at Williams Glen for anyone who is seeking a wonderful apartment community home in the Indianapolis metro area!

Do not rent here. Rent is over priced and they will charge you for leaving a piece of hair in the sink. We were never given a notice saying we needed to give a 60 day notice. We were chrarged $355 for not giving a notice, even though they have the place rented out. If you don't mind having bugs in the house move in here. Doors aren't sealed tight at all. You can take a 10 minute shower and the water goes cold. The place is a rip off.

At our previous apartment in Zionsville we were paying only $50 more than what the base rent is here at Steeplechase but the apartment was far nicer. At Steeplechase, the apartment is decent size with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, which is what we were looking for, but the kitchen is small and the dishwasher doesn't work as well and the ice maker quit working. The appliances are not what I was expecting. But we needed a new place closer to family and the sitter. But when we came to look at the apartment, I was expecting the rent to be $880 which was the lowest advertised price for this apartment; however, when we sat down to talk with someone, we were quoted a different price and I still don't really know what the big jump was (we are at $980). We've had to call maintenance services multiple times for various things, and we've been in this apartment for about 4.5 months.

I lived at this complex from May 2008 to March 2014  and enjoyed it very much.  The first year I was in a little one bedroom and when I wanted to upgrade to a 2 bedroom for more space, I stayed in the complex because I didn't find anything I liked better elsewhere.  Basic shopping (Walmart, Target, Meijer) are all located within a couple miles, as well as a dozen restaurants and fast food joints.  I absolutely loved walking across the street to the movie theater almost every week.  I did use the car wash bay and vacuum a few times a year, and the fitness area and pool were always kept in good order and quite popular.  This facility is popular with families and pet owners; maintenance was always prompt; I always felt safe on the grounds.

We have been renting a here 2 bed 2 bath apartment for 2 years now. On the plus side the bedrooms are large, neighbors are friendly and quiet, close proximity to stores and restaurants, and the staff in the office is lenient and helpful. We had problems with the bank returning a check once and weren't penalized by the landlord even though they got their rent about a week late. On the downside, common areas are a bit cramped, and the convenience to shopping creates a lot of traffic. Overall we have been pleased with our experience here.

Need to improve on the service requests and maintenance. Maintenance repair crew need to clean after themselves when they’re done making repairs.
The people in the office need to stop being rude to residents.
Theres often trash piling at the entrance so we need at least one dumpster on site but other than that ,Comfortable living for the most part with nice prompt office staff!
I can say I’m having a great experience at the Community. I really love this place. Peaceful and clean. Also,  Maintenance is quick and reliable.
I love it  a very nice, clean environment the people are very sweet and welcoming as well,it’s a very homey and safe area my kids and I love it here

I have lived here for almost 2 years and it has been the same problems from day one. Ants are in the walls they come out whenever, they have the same company come out and spray and it still not working, heat went out on the coldest day last winter, air barely works I was without air for 8 days when the temperature was in the 90, they barely call you back.  They have one trash compactor that they have to clear out ever day , the kids are terrible over here. They literally just do not care about the residents here.  I could go in and on about how terrible these apartments are
