Sometimes it's simple like having free sandwiches.  Last year, someone came and wrapped Christmas gifts professionally - for free!  Sometimes there are Taco Tuesdays or cocktail nights or more.   Not to mention the neighbors are nice.  You actually see them.  They say hi!  They grill out, wave, their kids play outside....if you're looking for community, this is an awesome place to find it.

By far the worst place I have ever moved into. Living in an apartment you expect noise and the noise level is high especially from neighbors who are loud or blast music at all hours of the night. The walls are paper thin. These apartments had recently been built and the construction is poor. The construction people had no care in the world, it looks like they just slapped things on and started building more units. There is little cabinet space in the kitchen and bathroom. The paint on the wall and ceiling is Flat paint so if anything splashes (when cooking, washing dishes, etc) there will be spots on the wall. There’s no back splash in the kitchen where the stove is, so if you cook expect oil to be on the wall. There is not good air flow circulation within the apartment. Expect to be cold all winter in one of the bedrooms or hot in the summer throughout the whole apartment. The price you have to pay is not worth it for this “newly” built apartment.

I moved her at The Lofts at North Penn about a month ago or so now. I wanted to get moved in right after school started, and luckily with their help I got in right when i wanted to. I worked with their leasing agent Joshua who was very easy to work with and answered all of my questions (i had a few) lol!  I didn't have any trouble with moving in because i used movers to do it for me haha I've been through that struggle before with it being an upstairs unit...now after moving in i had an air problem in one of my other bedrooms so i used the app they recommended to enter in a work order. I'll keep this helpful with saying that even though it took them until Monday morning to come out I am happy with it being fixed right the first time. Luckily they told me it was just the filter that needed to be changed b/c of the construction being here, which made a lot of sense. The people who came out were fantastic and rang the doorbell which was also greatly appreciated! The office staff has been great and nice. After that initial hickup i haven't had anymore concerns and love my new apartment. If I knew anyone looking to move i would recommend them here. I have lived in several apartments over the years; some have been great and others not so much so i'm excited i get to live in a brand new apartment.

Both the leasing agent and property manager were so friendly.  They answered all my questions and we're so helpful.  They are both really working hard to make it great for the residents.  I loved the solar powered security, it shows how they are really looking out for us even when the electric is out.  Very cool and unique property!  You can even get the garage for just bad weather and seasonal. I was surprised they suggested it and didn't try to milk me for money.  They actually care about the people that live there!  Love it!!!

We just signed our second lease. Move in was almost smooth. We didn't know that we could not move in until after 5pm on moving day but other than that it went great. Love the staff and maintenance team. When there is an issue it's handled by the maintenance team in a timely manner as well as the office. Property is kept clean and rules are enforced. I highly recommend this place.

My girlfriend and I have lived here for more then a month, we are completely happy with management in the leasing office. Maintenance has been on top of everything we have submitted. I have read through the negative comments and they are very petty.  No apartment is going to be perfect.  And it shows how people have created a myth about apartment living.  I am proud to call J Marshalls our home. It's quite and people have been friendly.

We have lived here for 9 months now. There has not been a single two week period when everything is working properly. J. Marshall Square continually fails to deliver on what they have promised to us as residents. The following is one story that describes our experience here.

The security gates are very unreliable and often lock you out of your own apartment until someone comes from the other side to open the gate. The same goes for the clubhouse, the key fobs rarely work and when they quit working, they simply leave the whole place unlocked so that anyone may come and go as they please. 

This happened with the gates recently, the gates were broken for nearly a month. Instead of promptly fixing the issue, they chose to simply leave the gates open. My car was broken into two times. Neither time did J. Marshall Square do anything about it.

This is a very poorly managed apartment complex. This is only one of my many bad experiences with them. We are stuck here for four more months, but we are running as fast as we can as soon as our lease is up. 

Please do not make the same mistake that I did. There are plenty of apartments in Oklahoma City that are not only nicer, but cheaper and will treat you much better.

My lease was terminated early, by them, after I didn't break the law to abide by their rules. I was charged an entire month's rent despite being completely moved out by the seventh. They also took an unexplained $600 from me that I have yet to get back, even though I've asked about it several times.

The Metropolitan is a neat, clean, stylish place.  
The staff is very welcoming & accommodating.
Pet friendly is a plus! 
It is close to Bricktown & many other amenities. 
They have social events for the tenants.
There is also security on the premises.
The Metropolitan is seriously THE BEST in downtown Oklahoma City when it comes to apartment living. All of the amenities, finishes & SMELL sets them apart! I love living here!

I have loved living at the Metropolitan this summer! If anyone is looking for a place to live in downtown, I 100% recommend this place. It truly feels like home and will always hold a special place in my heart!
This place is wonderful! Best place to live and close to everything downtown.

I should of read the reviews before I put the deposit and the application fee. After I did that and the next day I decided not to move in there and they called me saying we will mail you a check for your deposit! I went to get the deposit and the management “which is what all the reviewers talked poorly about” said I will not be able to get that. Why promise something over the phone and turn it reverse!!??
Lost 260$ for not even stepping a foot in my place yet!

My wife and I lived here for almost two years and the management only got worse while we were there. They are supposed to provide pest control services, but there’s no enforcement of making sure they hit every single apartment. We missed one round of pest control and ants immediately began infesting our apartments, making us very aware of the lack of proper seals to the outside. When we informed them we never received the pest control, they straight up lied to us about saying they did, but since I work from home, I would have been there the whole time they were. They also began installing assigned covered parking spaces all around the complex, making every attempt to find parking for those of us that didn’t want to pay an additional $50/month very hard, They also didn’t inform tenants of the correct day the paid parking would go into effect, so there were mass towings across the complex, and the landlords never compensated us for an issue they caused. In conclusion, don’t live here. It’s too expensive for how terrible it is and the property is extremely disrespectful to tenants.

The Indigo is a great place to live for me.  The staff is always ready to help and be of service. The indigo is always hosting events to bring the community Together. Maintenance staff requests are always answered right away. The insides have nice, updated look. The security patrol is also a plus the pool is great during the summer and the distance to local venues and Restaurants are close. I recommend you check them out if you're looking to move to the area.

Hello, I am currently a resident at Indigo Apartment Homes. The place here is absolutely stunning. The staff here are kind, amazing, and sweet, and they CARE about the residents. There are several times I can recall that when I was stressed when I was in a bad time or a dark age, they were encouraging. They helped lift me up. I don't know where I would be without their help. 

This place is always amazing. I can go outside, look out my balcony, and see the city lights from where I stand. Granted, you would have to have the right apartment, but yes. Also, privacy; I feel secure in my room. I feel like everything is awesome. 

If you ever feel like you need a place to live, I DEFINITELY RECOMMEND Indigo Apartment Homes. This is the best residence I've had in 10 years. Come over, apply, and tell them Authur sent you!

I have not stayed in an apartment in years and was very nervous about moving into one. But once I met Danny at Indigo he made me feel really comfortable about getting an apartment. So comfortable that I actually got the apartment and it’s so nice and comfortable. The tenants are really nice and respectful. So because of Danny the nice gentleman with the greatest personality made me feel so welcomed. And I would advise you to come and get a place here as well it’s like a huge family.
Right next to all the businesses on memorial and top golf. Really nice place that I was surprised with how nice they are on the inside!
I just drove through the entire property and it appears clean and tidy. Super important to me.
I love these floor plans and small community feel :)

I began my third year at Park at Tuscany in May 2023.  I have very much enjoyed living here.  The management's main goals are to keep the property well maintained, well groomed, and to keep the residents feeling like they are of the utmost importance and the main reason Park at Tuscany exists.  For my time at Park at Tuscany they have achieved all of those goals.  Whether you are young or mid age or a bit older, have children or not, have pets or not, you'll have found "home" when you come to Park at Tuscany!

I stayed here during a temporary corporate relocation situation. Overall, the place is pretty decent (as far as apartment living can afford). My stay was abbreviated because cockroaches were crawling up through the kitchen sink. Do with that what you will ...

I called and was able to get into an apartment quick and hassle free. The staff is great and always answers any questions I have. I have had one maintenance issue and it was taken care of the same day I requested help. Plus I love my fireplace! I have always wanted one where I live.

Whether You're the New Melinnium Generation, a more Mature Senior. or any age in between The Park @ Tuscany will become your home. Offering beautiful new spacious Living/Bump Room combos, oversized Kitchens & Baths with latest up to date decor & King Sized Bedrooms with walkin closets. Garages also available.

The Park is an Incredible location, surrounded by beautiful lush landscapng, opening to an inviting pool.  A Resident Computer and Fitness Center are available free of charge. You're walking distance to a Major Mall, restaurants, theatres & more!  

LUXURY AND CONVENIENCE AT ITS BEST IN OKC1

I've lived in many apartments, and this has been my favorite so far. Not only is it a beautiful apartment complex to love in, but the staff is always amazing, and I feel safe living here. In the past, I've had problems with the time response of maintenance. This has not been the case here. I had a problem with my toilet one Saturday evening, and once I called maintenance, they were here within 10 minutes. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone

I lived here for 5 years and lived through the rapid decline after ledic bought the place.  It used to be a gated community but the gates stayed open after ledic and my door was kicked in and my apartment was robbed and my car was stolen from the property! Then when it was found and towed back, the management had it impounded!  Instead of returning my deposit, they claimed I owed them over $3500 and sent me to collections!

Do not move in to these apartments unless you want to be ripped off. The management changes every few months. No one is never in the office to answer your questions. They increase your rent every 3 months (5%,). The corporation that purchased the complex are not making any updates for the amount they expect tenants to pay. The new corporation will come into your apartments "for inspection" unannounced. What more can I say! For a 1 bedroom the prices listed are false. They charge me $850 and that just increased 5%. Save your money and move into a better community.

I'm one of several people that have had management unlock and enter my apartment for no apparent reason. Frequent mildew and sewage odors that come and go, and a unit that is hard to cool in the summer and hard to warm in the winter. would not recommend

New management and new maintenance are worst then the people before. Maintenance entering my apartment for no reason with NO paper explaining why they’re entering my apartment. Imagine if I wasn’t there.. I would have never known they entered my apartment

My fiance and I moved in around December 2016. Everything seemed fine until our AC went out in May of 2017. It took a week to repair and they did not offer any window units to help keep up cool. Two weeks after the repair, the AC went out again until August. At this time, they offered a downstairs window unit to help keep us cooled off but as these are upstairs and downstairs, the upstairs was completely unlivable. They cut our rent in half for June and July, however, due to Oklahoma state law, they had broke the lease agreement by not fixing out AC in a proper amount of time. We formally put in a 30 day notice and they attempted to get the other half of rent for those two months along with the money for the rest of the contract. The contract that they broke by not supplying a livable condition. The last day of moving out, they tried to put an eviction notice on our door, so we attempted to call them and the landlord was always too busy to get back to us. We set up four appointments to do walk throughs with management and they refused to show. I tell every person I know, not to live here. I've contacted the better business bureau and housing on them. This was the worst living experience of my life.

I am currently a tenant of this complex. Do not move here unless you want to freeze in the winter and be miserable under the sweltering heat in the summer time. I have fallen down the stairs due to the handrail never being fixed after it broke when I moved in in June 2017. They are poorly insulated and drafty. The sewage does not drain properly and it smells septic constantly even if you keep the toilets clean. The garbage disposal drains into the dishwasher. The maintenance worker, Trey, is lazy and has a terrible attitude. The office manager is clueless. I have small children and currently have the thermostat set to 80 but due to the drafty conditions and gaping hole in the ceiling left on 12/31/2017 I cannot get downstairs to stay warm. Needless to say I will not be renewing my lease

This renting experience has been the worst experience of my whole life... as one previous reviewer mentioned there is a TON of theft in this complex, not only did someone rob me at gunpoint not even two weeks later someone broke into my car and stole my wallet. The office manager is absolutely the rudest,insensitive and disrespectful person I’ve met in my life, after I was robbed I went to the office to report it, Brenda insinuated that it was my fault and was very rude to me despite the fact that I was extremely traumatized. Also worth mentioning is that after my rent check was turned in they sent me a notice to vacate stating that my rent had not been paid and tried to charge a late fee. The gated community thing is a crock of crap considering that the gate never is working. Another issue is “security” if you can even call them that, they come through with their lights flashing in the middle of the night which for myself is annoying as I am a light sleeper. They don’t do anything besides drive around and god forbid you inconvenience them by asking them to do anything for you. There is ALWAYS an ambulance or police here and they park right outside of our building and don’t bother to turn their lights off when they pull into the complex. The people who used to live above me when asked nicely if they could please keep their volume down and not move furniture at night the man spat in my face when I told the office they acted like that wasn’t a big deal. I now have upstairs neighbors who play their music so loud late at night I can identify the songs they’re listening to, they smoke weed all the time and it seeps into my bathroom. It seems as though they don’t give a darn about the back part of the buildings because for one out trash dumpster sits in the middle of the street. As for the apartment itself, the floors are stick on linoleum and are always grimy and dull no matter how furiously you clean them, there are no lights in the bedrooms and lighting in the living area is scarce. The cabinets and fixtures are okay but there is paint all over my countertops in the kitchen.  People park out in the parking lot and blare music at all hours. If you value your safety spend a little more money on a nicer apartment complex that cares about its residents. This place is trashy, grimy and crawling with rude staff ready to roll their eyes at every request or concern you come to them with. Don’t move here.

Staying in these apartments was a bad experience . After staying in these apartments for a month I noticed bite marks on my body . Come to find out the apartment was filled with Bed Bugs . Two residences that just moved in had this issue . If you don’t want to buy new furniture, ,clothes and new bed set then I wouldn’t move into these apartments .

I loved living at crown pointe the first two years. Here is a fact they don't tell you. The back half of the apartments are robbed all the time. The police told me that when my apartment was broken in to. It took maintenance two and a half hours to show up and fix the door after I found my home destroyed. When the head maintenance guy finally showed up he was so rude. Now for the floor tile is coming up. The walls are paper thin you can here everything from the building above, below, and next to yours. There are no light in the bedrooms. Security is a joke they just park in the back of the apartments and do nothing. If you move here have renters insurance everyone in my building has been robbed!

Everything was fine at the time I was handing over my move in fees and signing my lease. Once that was out of the way they were on to the next. The parking lot is really dark at night. Their dumpster areas have wild animals that hoard around them at night. Their gate never works and they give everyone the same code, how is that secure? The apartments aren't that nice and are a little too expensive. I had bugs at one point and they didn't seem concerned on getting the issue taken care of. Nobody picks up after their dogs. Don't even think about getting your deposit back, the assistant manager is afraid of confrontation so she'll send you a bill later after saying everything looks great upon move out. Don't waste your money on poor staffing and poor quality apartment homes.

The only thing good here is the maintenance guy, really nice man who gets things fixed. Moved into this place with a 13 month lease, we put in our notice early and paid our 3 months rent to break lease. I called around August 25th to shut off electric, at that time I was told by the OGE agent that the apartment had already taken control of our electric bill and we were good to go. Today on September 15th, Kim (assistant manager) called saying we needed to return the service to our name and pay the bill. I tried explaining to her that the apartments are the ones who took control of our unit, she got extremely rude and disrespectful stating that it was impossible and that could not have happened and we needed to pay the bill, she continuously cut me off and kept trying to blame it on us. I called OGE to confirm and they have it on their records that CROWN POINTE  kicked us off the units electricity bill on AUGUST 3rd! It is not the customers fault that their people screwed up YET AGAIN and don't want to take responsibility. Simple solution, take the $2100 from breaking lease and pay the bill yourselves and own up to your mistakes and for being extremely rude to a customer.

The location is a safe zone. The amenities are excellent. Response time to any emergency is addressed immediately. The grounds and appearance of apartment complex are well kept. Management response is always handled professionally.

Plumbing constantly gets backed up, Central Heat and Air is not reliable and breaks down regularly, the property is always dirty, trash bins overflow with diapers and trash, the management constantly changes, with each new company being worse than the one before. The current property manager is horrible, she is rude, disrespectful, does not try to communicate with you, talks over you during conversations and is poorly trained in customer service and knowledge of the industry. This place is a nightmare and for what I pay I could be living somewhere much nicer, can't wait till my lease is up.

I've lived at Manchester on May before it was Manchester on May. Back when it was another name it was trashy and the homeless were living in vacant units. Since Manchester on May has opened the Homeless aren't in vacant units. The trash cans are always clean and they are getting ready to open up the pool in a month or so. They are really trying to keep up with the property. Lauren and crew are great landlords.
Philip Robison

If I could give a 6/5 rating, I would! The office staff and maintenance are very attentive and incredibly kind. I appreciate the gated area and location of the property. Although I have had some issues with loud neighbors and speeding cars, the security staff handled these issues beautifully. Everything about my living situation made me comfortable and I adore the nature aspect of the property as well. 

Highly recommend! Family-friendly, pet-friendly, senior citizen- friendly.

After a divorce, I wanted a nice and safe place for my daughter and I. Prairie Springs has been very well-kept and friendly. I feel safe and have been very happy here. Only negative is a rate increase after my lease renewal.

Prairie Springs has been, by far, the nicest apartment complex I've ever had the privilege of living in.  The staff in the office are extremely helpful and friendly, and the workers do a phenomenal job keeping the place looking beautiful!!!   If we all acted with more of a servant's heart toward one another and looked to see how we could help our fellow man, we could have heaven on earth everywhere!!!

Prairie Springs Apartment is nice place to live.  They try to keep the property clean.  The people are friendly and courteous.  The location is perfect, easy access to everything.  Down faults are: there is no drop box, so if your schedule does not match the office hours you will have to pay extra to pay on line and the back gates always have issues.  Prairie Springs is a nice place to live.

Our experience has been nothing short of terrible since we've moved here. From jump, the heater didn't work. These apartment's look nice. Everything seems well kept until you move in and start to notice all the hidden things like unsealed doors and windows, mold growth in the windows and vents, ice and snow in your apartment due to the poor seals. You notice half the outlets don't work, the things on the wall that have been painted over instead of removed. We've been here about a month and have only had troubles. The only reason I'm even giving 2 stars is because maintenance is kind, quick, and helpful.

Do not live here. I would rather live at Willow Creek than to live here and have them take all my money. They tack on bogus charges when you move out. They have you fill out a form when you first move in to write how your appliances/apartments looked but they don’t bring that to when you check out of your apartment: then they try to charge you hundreds of dollars for something that you didn’t do but you can’t prove because they didn’t bring the form. They also have the worst customer service. Every time you walk in whether it’s to get a package or asks question they just look st you like you’re bothering them.  Plus the gates are always broken and they don’t take care of the property. Do yourselves a favor and spend the same amount of money somewhere else that is nicer and has better workers who won’t try to take all of your money!!!

I've experienced better. The staff needs to work on their professionalism and attitude. The maintenance can never figure out why my heat/air doesn't work half the time. There have a few months where my electric bill was doubled the amount due to the their heat/air issues. The wooden fence along the back should have been replaced last year when it was mentioned by management. The fence isn't sturdy and can damage cars at any moment if we get a wind storm. The trash service should be optional since the company that is responsible for picking up the trash isn't reliable. The gates don't work properly. I'm paying for a gated community and I'm not getting it.

Avana midwest is a gated complex. Our rent for a three bedroom and two bath is currently a little above $1,000. It's a nice apartment and includes a living and dining area along with a kitchen and even a laundry room area. There's also balconies and the complex is pet friendly. They having parking garages for an extra cost. Also included is a community pool and gym area. They are very helpful when it comes to problems in the apartment that need to be fixed. The only negative side is you only have one day to pay rent and after that they include a late fee and give you an eviction notice which is unreasonable. Location is great, it's right outside OKC.

I have lived at Avana Midwest for a few years now. I have seen the property change hands to Greystar, and unfortunately there have been some negative changes since that time. The most frustrating change has been the apartment management. Greystar has stripped the manager of almost all power and she and her assistants are not much more than pencil pushers who make excuses for the "rules". Greystar reduced the number of employees available in the office, so there is often a long wait to be helped and the staff is spread too thin. Many requests are not responded to or followed up. I made a request a few days ago in person and I was told by the assistant Hannah, that she would follow up, OR I should just come back. I found that to be extremely unprofessional, and as it turned out, I did have to come back because she didn't follow up. Our rent has increased over 20% in three years, although we have faithfully paid rent on time each month and taken excellent care of our apartment. Between the increases in rent, various fees, and the unreliable valet trash, Greystar has been nickel and diming us ever since they bought this place. It has been very frustrating. Additionally, when we signed our initial lease, residents were able to use the clubhouse after-hours for private gatherings. That is no longer the case, which is a huge loss of value to me. Otherwise, the apartment itself is fine. It's nicer than most places in Midwest City, which isn't saying much, but it does have a dishwasher and washer/dryer. The pool is kept fairly clean, and the maintenance crew does a rather excellent job of keeping things clean and well-maintained on the grounds. I have the highest praise for the maintenance team, who do their job with professionalism, despite the poor example and leadership of the management team. The gated entry is often broken or inoperable, which is likely the fault of residents and mistreatment of the gates by residents, but inoperable nonetheless and not providing the security it is intended for (a perk that generates extra rent, undeservedly). All-in-all, I feel very frustrated and taken advance of. I believe in a landlord-renter relationship that offers mutual respect...but, in my experience, renters at Avana are treated like numbers.

From living next to drug addicts to geese poop being everywhere! You get up charged for being close to the lakes which is ridiculous because they are filthy. The geese poop EVERYWHERE. The sidewalks are hardly traversable having to step around poop on top of it literally floating in the lakes as the filtering system is poor. The dog park is poorly maintained, again poop is everywhere and they hardly clean it. Maintenance requests are taken care of quickly, but usually fail to address the problems at hand. When I moved in the dishwasher didn’t properly work, the whole complex had packet loss for wifi in which I had to contact COX and get them to come out because the wifi was hardly usable, the shower head was rusted out, and it constantly smelled like weed. I’ve heard gunshots, seen broken car windows, fights between residents, and not to mention the visits we get from the homeless due to the lack of a security gate. And “security” hardly does its job. If you put in a call they MAY show up. And that’s a big MAY. They are essentially glorified pool closers as they mainly just lock the pools when they are closed. And on top of all that they are increasing rent here. I literally don’t know what it’s going to because this place is garbage. It’s corporate ran and I imagine the money goes to there high end properties. I’d find somewhere else to live.

The girls in the office are so pleasant and grounds are amazing. I have an apartment over looking the back lake and the tree line, so peaceful. All the tenants I've met are really nice and quiet. It's set back from S Meridian and many people don't even know where it's located! They take care of their tenants, I was without power due to an ice storm for a few days and they gave everyonee affected $150 off their rent.....not something they needed to do being it was out of their control. I really do love it here and recommend it anyone e I know who is looking.

It wasn't until I left that my love for WatersEdge turned into dislike. After moving out and paying the fee to break my lease after I was transferred due to my job I received a letter from the apartments along with photos stating be that I didn't clean the apartment and was charged outrageously over 500 for what they claim was dirty. I'm OCD so I know for a fact I left t spotless, they sent me pictures of a oven that was disgusting and obviously not the same one I had in my apartment along with the bathtub they stated that I had put black marks on which is very untrue personally I cleaned the bathtub for months upon moving in the tub was disgusting but I figured I could get it clean and I did. The bath tub they show me isn't the same one in my apartment. As nice and secluded as it may seem be careful when moving out you should have a professional come clean your apartment (seeing as that is what they want) or you will pay over 500 for what they say is a dirty apartment and send you pictures that aren't even of your apartment just to get your money.

I love my apartment!  It is hidden in the trees near the interstate. It's close to everything. No one knows I'm here.  We have ponds, geese and ducks.  We have a running/walking trail around the larger pond. We also have tennis and volleyball courts. We even have some sort of golf thing. Oh yes, you can fish too.  If you are an out-door person you would love it here.
Come see!!!!Hope you can find it!!!!!

I have liven at Watersedge Apartments for a year and a half now and I must say I am very impressed with how well it is maintained and how quiet, peaceful, and safe it is. It is definitely in my opinion one of the best complexes in Oklahoma City!
I love my apartment it a swimming pool a little gym, and a mini lake. How fun is that?

Tyler , Ricky , Emanuel are a great staff far better than anyone that's been here before and I have been here for the last 10 years. I appreciate their hard work and we finally have our pool open thanks mg.
Tyler and team are doing a phenomenal job! Keep up the great work!

Office staff is always kind and attentive to work orders. Has a pool and I like that there are two laundry rooms. Not far from anything I need and they are putting in a new Laredo Taco next door that will be convenient.

Was nice until I found out the complex has a bed bug issue! Not good considering the ventilation systems in the apartments are connected. To make matters worse I'm getting charged almost $400 for treatments after finding one bed bug. If I was the cause of the infestation I would not have a problem paying for the treatments, but after hearing of other residents complain, combined with the fact that I've only seen one in almost a year, I don't understand how I'm being held responsible. There are no washer and dryer hookups so you're also at risk every time you wash or dry on property. I understand bed bugs are a more common problem than before, but charging tenants for things they're not responsible for doesn't sit well with me. After reviewing my lease, they do mention that you'll be charged in this event. Proof to me that they already knew this problem existed. I thought I would be here for multiple years but will definitely not be renewing after this.

I have lived at Coachlight for almost five years and I would not easily relocate anywhere due to the positive experience I have had. Most importantly it is affordable, singles and family friendly, and management does good upkeep of the property. Many places can be nightmarish because of bad management alone but you won't have that experience here. I feel safe and comfortable here. I have no major complaints and neither do others that I've spoken to who have resided here longer than myself.

I love our maintenance personnel at Penn Station Apartment Homes. They are always courteous and, friendly, professional and kind.
Big shout out to Jeremy and his crew!

The actual location of the apartment within Moore has good points and bad-- it is really convenient being so close to the highway, but it can be an eyesore-- we have an apartment towards the back of the property so we can't really hear it, but there are some units that look right out onto it. The apartments are located about a five minute drive from groceries and lots of food, but the area directly surrounding the complex is a little shady-- some rundown businesses and a couple used car dealerships. The actual property is really beautiful and well-maintained, and all of the neighbors we've met so far have been really friendly. We love it here-- it is one of the best places we have ever lived for a reasonable price!

Here it is mid June and the pool is still not opened because of wiring issues with a pool phone. The list of amenities is bogus, everything is sn additional fee not included in monthly rent, $30 a month for that valet trash whether you want it or not, $15 for package storage that is not used by the delivery companies but you must pay, $60-$80 additional water bill. $500 pet deposit is not refundable, in addition to $150 a month, want that garage, another $150.  Cabana with tv, only if the pool is opened, Secure sccess, nope gates have been broken for 3 months now, security patrol? Nope only around the pool area telling people to be quite. When i first moved here it eas ran nicely, but yhe current managers won't do anything without NOVA property management approval. Glad my lease is up soon, this could be nice but Nova will not put money into these as compared to their other properties.
A good experience, beautiful interiors.  It's a good place

This place is terrible. Poor communication and management. The gate has been broken for almost a year. The equipment in the gym are old and broke, never fix it. They don’t mow the grass. They charge you for trash valet but they don’t pickup it up. The suddenly add another charge the monthly payment without  notice. Maintenance issues all the time always tell you maintenance guy is not available. The AC is not working, when I called the office the said the AC personal is only comes in a specific day in the week. Which means if your AC stopped working on a different day you’re on your own deal with the heat. I can’t wait for my lease contract to end. Stay away you’re gonna waist your money, and you’ll regret it.

Terrible place to live. The communication of these apartments are terrible. The router for your wifi is in the closet so you won't have any good connection even though it's fiber, in the summer time we spent 2 weeks in our apartment with no working ac and no window unit. If you're wanting a safe gated community this ain't it either. The gates are ALWAYS broken and mine and other neighbors cars has been ransacked. During the summertime the pool was always closed. The parcel that you pay extra for they just leave packages on the floor instead of putting in lockers. Most important of all, all these good reviews on here is all lies because they offer you a $10 target gift card if you write a good review for them

Almost a year in here, & You will a 5 day receive a notice to quit before you are even 24hrs late. They charge fees for literally every single tiny thing, they have pest issues and are sprayed deeply inside apartments monthly, are horrible at returning phone calls. This apartment is ran like a greedy corporation. Please, just don’t.
This place has been great! We have been here almost a year now and have been having a great experience. We love the pool and playground!

I’ve been here for a few months and I can honestly say that all my needs and expectations  are met everyday in this apartment. The appliances are beautiful, AND they work! 
I opted in for the washer and dryer and they have made my life so much easier. I got the bump out apartment and while I do wish I would have tried the fireplace and balcony, I’ve never been happier in an apartment. The central air is divine, toasty but not too hot.

Professional working staff
Very clean grounds 
Conveniently located

The walls are so thin you can literally hear your neighbor use the bathroom. I hear babies crying, arguing, and screaming all day and night. The gates hardly ever work even though they charge you 50 dollars for a gate opener that you have to get dangerously close to the curb to even work. Staff is rude and unaccomadating. Don’t even get me started on parking. If you get home past 9 PM you’ll be walking a few buildings down. Everything about these apartments are cheap. This place is a nightmare come reality. Can’t wait until my lease is up.

These apartments are in the PERFECT spot! UCO and OCU colleges are within an easy driving distance (you could even walk to OCU). You can (very) easily access I-35, Kilpatrick Turnpike, and I-44. The units are very spacious and are modern. Darlene, Jordan, and Andrea are all AMAZING that work in the office. Alan is the head maintenance guy and he is awesome! I consider all of them friends now. I’ve lived here 3 years now (a record for me) and this is THE BEST staff they’ve ever had. Darlene calls whenever residents have packages in the office! How awesome is that?! This is definitely a place worth checking out if you’re looking to move!

The Fountain Lake Apts are a large apt community with very nice pool areas and workout facilities. The apartments themselves are reasonably spacious for the price, with middle-tier appliances and build quality. Walls to the outside are quite thin, however. Also, the furnaces in the apts are very loud, so the bedroom near the furnance will be noisy, especially when running the central air. 
     The best feature is the location. It is very near access hwy 77, as well as Kilpatrick Turnpike, so getting to downtown OKC or other areas is quick and easy.
     Overall, a bit pricey for how far you are from downtown OKC, but good location and amenities make up for it.

The one bedroom apartments at Fountain Lake have one of if not the biggest floor plans of all the apartments I looked at in Edmond It is also the cheapest rent for a luxury apartment that I found.  The apartments are well maintained and have nice finishing. The one maintenance issue I have had since moving here was taken care of within hours of reporting it to the front office. The complex itself is nice and quiet with great amenities such as pools and gyms.  We are across the street from the Christian university which has nice walking trails and a dog park.  The complex is on the boarder of Edmond and OKC, so you have quick access to everything you could want.  An additional plus for being on the boarder is the complex is serviced by OG&E electric.
Roaches are constant in the apartments, and maintenance takes there time when something is wrong. no matter how clean you are there is a huge roach problem.

I’ve lived here for a year almost and everything seemed fine whenever I moved in, only until the plumbing started to mess up within two weeks of me living here. Took them almost two weeks to fix it, leaving me without a kitchen sink and dishwasher. After that problem was fixed, the plumbing in the bathroom started to mess up; which resulted in my bathroom flooding 3 different times as well as my hallway closet and the wall nearest to my bathroom from my bedroom. The carpet had been replaced twice due to that. It seems like they’ll let just about anyone live here, as well. 1-2 months later some people moved in across from me. Not sure who was on the lease, regardless of the fact, there was always at least 8-15 people in the apartment all the time. They’d play their music loudly, fight often, smoke their weed blatantly with no care, to the point I could smell through the air ducts, and be up all hours of the night. Management had warned many times, cops were called due to fighting, yet nothing ever happened. It feels like only when I am here that my allergies are the worst they’ve ever been, like there is mold or other allergens inside the walls. This place is far from inhabitable, in my opinion. Just be aware of the place and the people that live near you. Some neighbors are great, but the place is not worth the money you pay.

They claim that this complex is "Smoke Free".
That is a complete lie. Several of the tenants in my building smoke and the smell lingers into my apartment.
I am a non-smoker with children and this is very invasive and inconsiderate of the apartment owners/staff.
I have reported that I can smell cigarette smoke strongly in my apartment and they literally told me "there's nothing I can do about that".

False advertising, you've been warned.

Been living in moore for a while and have noticed big improvement and remodeling and they are starting to look excellent in make being moore look great
thanks 
megan scott 
dmscott882@gmail.com

I love these apartments. We have lived here for 3 years. Connie will do anything to help if you ask her. They just finished redoing the siding and roof so the green siding is gone. There is a lot of cabinet space especially in the bath room. the bedrooms are huge compared too the other apartments we looked at. also has a pool. Its also close to everything which makes get food or anything else easy.
Very well kept apartments for the cost. I have lived here for 2 years and never had any problems. We talk to all of our neighbors in our breezway and never had any problems with anyone.
Worked with Avery and the apartment manger. Very nice and professional. Showed me several options. Clean place and family friendly. Thank you again for making this process easy and welcoming !!!

Moving to Ascend Apartments has been one of the best decisions I've made for my family. The application process, moving into our apartment and now living in our apartment has been a smooth and easy process. The units are clean and very up to date. The common areas are clean and free from trash. The office staff are absolutely delightful and cheery every time I see them. I definitely recommend Ascend Apartments to anyone looking for a clean, quiet and well kept community.
The management is great and the complex is super quiet! They are always updating the complex!

Ascend Apartments come with all new appliances, young and extremely helpful staff, and safe community with many young families just starting off. Would highly recommend to single parents, starter families, and even college students looking to save money.

Beautiful apartment with all new stainless steel appliances, new stacked washer/dryer, and a large covered balcony/patio. Dog park is great and convenient as well. Staff is always helpful and friendly. Maintenance is completed in a timely manner as well. Love these apartments.

The staff was so respectful and kind and the apartment she show me was clean and nice and I just love that it had two full bathrooms and washer and dryer connections you can tell that the apartments is under a new manager I can’t wait to call this place my new place. It’s been a while since I have lived in a apartment

I called to see if I could rent an apartment... she was sooo rude. Second I said I couldnt qualify for the 2 bed room she had she literally slammed the phone down.. I heard it hit... WOULDNT RENT HERE IF YOU PAID ME... she needs to be very far from customers.

Finding the Ascend property was like discovering a hidden gem. Well maintained, clean and inviting. Everything you need to make you and your furry friends feel at home is here at Ascend. Washer and dryer in the unit, a clubhouse to use for parties and a lovely dog park to enjoy. Paying rent is easy using their online rent pay and when I need any maintenance I can easily fill out a request online. They respond quickly to any questions I have. Parking is free, plentiful and unassigned so my visitors never have to worry about parking in the wrong spot or not finding one. I’m ecstatic I decided to rent here and wanted to share my experience. Good rentals are hard to find and great service, included free, is a bonus. I look forward to enjoying a few more years here!
Spent more than a week with no water and we were given no reason or answers to why or when it would be fixed

Everything looks and seems great until you move in. After moving in you start to see all the problems such as old electrical wiring which I’m sure is not up to code, and mold everywhere! It’s in the walls, floors, and I’m sure in the ceilings as well. When ever someone shuts the doors to the building the entire building shakes! They are remodeling but it is nothing more than trying to make things look pretty and they are doing nothing to fix the real problems such as foundation and structural issues. The bugs/pest such as roaches are a nightmare and have been an issue for years! They say they will come spray to fix the problems but never show up. They have recently started to sticker people’s cars in the parking lot threading to have them towed for illegal tags (out of date tags) when the tags are not expired? The office manager is hardly in the office and is rude and condescending.
Great office workers. But the apartments are not livable. Too many problems that never get fixed. Ask the residents and not the office about the apartments. They’ll explain it all
I was shown a clean home, spacious and with all of the amenities we are looking for. They accept our dogs, the apartment has a washer and dryer included.
Very pleasant, gracious, and helpful leasing agent answered all questions and gave a great tour! Thanks.
The apartments are surprisingly big and staff are very friendly. It was quiet and overall seems like a nice place to live.

They say this is a gated community, the gates have not worked since I moved in 7 years ago.  Cars and other items have been and still are being stolen.  Any work orders has to be done on line then it never gets done and they close it saying it has been.  I know I tenant who has had no air conditioning for almost 3 months and another that their sink does not work and has not since they moved in.  The water bill has gone up to nearly 200 dollars a month and when asked to talk to property owner the office personal said they do not know.  I will be moving soon.

I spent 30 days looking at this property but when I met Katy. I knew this was going to be a better experience. Loads of room, very quiet, beautiful apt. Pictures don't do it justice. Smooth process getting in. Full size appliances, ceiling fans, very private spaces in the home. Bedrooms are not next to each other which helps me define my spaces. I know I made the right decision moving here.

These apartments are in a great location and close to everything. The apartment is spacious with huge bedrooms and plenty of space and an outside storage. I have lived here for over two years and it is quiet and secure. I never had any type of security issues and my neighbors are friendly. They are making a lot of improvements inside and out of the apartment homes. The price is also great for the amount of space you have. The manager James is great. He is caring and tries his best to make sure you are satisfied with living here. This would be a great place to live for a family and if you are by yourself.

My husband and I wanted a place with plenty of space in a quiet area for a great price; we were thrilled to find all of that here.  Located in the middle of the city with easy access to restaurants, grocery stores and the main highway but is also an area where we feel safe and comfortable. We were very impressed with the quality of the complex and size of the individual apartments for the incredible price.  This place has been exactly what we were looking for and we look forward to staying for a long time.

Lived here from 2021-2024 and I loved living here. The apartment and facilities were clean. Management was kind and helpful in the few interactions I had with them. Would highly recommend, especially for people working at the nearby hospitals or students at OUHSC.
THEY DO NOT RETURN DEPOSITS!!! Horrible management. Terrible maintenance.

Moved in about a month an a half ago. It has been one issue after another and most of the information provided on here is not accurate. Trash/sewer/water is NOT included (and get ready to pay double what you would pay in a house) none of the listed information is correct, the gates do not work, the parking lot floods, really REALLY bad, the roaches and spiders are terrible and we have yet to see anyone for pest control (I’ve been emailing and putting in request) there is no on site maintenance (one guy for 3 complexes so be prepared to wait) plumbing and electrical issues, man the list goes on and on. I suggest running as fast as you can, AWAY from this place. Most of my neighbors are leaving at the end of their leases. Said this place just keeps getting worse and worse.

Really cool community! I like to have lunch on the clubroom balcony sometimes. There are numerous water features which make the community feel peaceful. There is also a dog park and dog spa which is very convenient. 

I also love how they report your rental payments to the credit bureaus , helping your credit score. What a game changer!
They offer beautifully renovated amenities from their clubhouse, to their pool, to their units. This community has such a friendly vibe, it makes living here a dream come true! A must see!

I love it here. It’s close enough to everything there is to do in the Quail Springs area that I feel connected to the city, but far enough away from it all that I don’t get all the noise. The on-site staff is great, very professional and helpful. Can’t recommend it enough!

These apartments have been renovated and look stunning inside. The outside of the property is just as nice with a waterfall, babbling vrook, and dog park. I cannot express how happy I was to stumble on this little hidden gem of a complex. The staff that work there Celeste and Na'Votanei are so sweet and genuinely seem to care (plus they're really funny.)

Before I moved to OKC in 2017, I made a list in two categories that would meet my preference.  The first was an area that was safe, near the interstate (for quick commutes), and with the essential needs such as hospitals, dentists, parks, and various grocery stores.  The next was the search for an apartment that was clean and well kept, quiet, and more importantly---a staff with great vibe. 

I found that place at the Augusta Apartment Homes on 122th St.  Tricia Conlon and her staff are wonderful!  They greet you with a wonderful smile which just makes your day. They answer all of your questions with professionalism and with resolve.  Raul, from maintenance keeps the apartment repaired and with that great personality. 

Tricia and staff hold many ‘fun day’ and holiday events.  Really enjoy all!

I have lived here for 5 years and always look forward to come home each day!

Thank you Tricia and staff!
The grounds are well kept, and the staff are friendly while always giving a one of a kind experience. This community is very welcoming and highly recommended.

This property is in a great location. Office staff is very helpful and friendly and maintenance quickly repairs problems. I’ve live here 5 years and don’t plan on moving any time soon. It would be nice if there was a dog park.
The community is overall nice and friendly. The resident events they started are a cool way of meeting new people around you!

10/01/2020: Be ready to be your own pest control and to hire professional cleaners. We've had to clean up a ton of cobwebs and steam clean due to how the apartment was handed to us. However it would have been fine, we have very high cleanliness levels and to clean would be completely fine if that was the only issue. We've also had a cockroach problem in which my boyfriend and I found the nest and reported it to the front office. Also have a wasp problem that still isn't fixed a week after reporting it. Apparently we're supposed to get pest control to come spray for roaches just as they sprayed for the wasps that didn't get handle and are still there despite after reporting it a week ago. We were told the apartment was clean and has pest control before we moved in but that was obviously a lie. I added pictures on my google review to include the wasp nest on our patio which if they sprayed as often as they claim then it wouldn't have gotten that big as well as a photo of the roach nest we found in our closet. If you're moving here, then you need to VERY CAREFULLY inspect and even lay out a trap or two before signing anything. Check the ceilings, we have multiple cracks in ours which is where the roaches are hiding. The ones we have are German cockroaches. Apparently maintenance will seal up the holes after pest control arrives. I'll update it if things have improved but so far I've been living here a week and I am not happy at all. It's such a shame too because the place is beautiful, the apartments are spacious, nicely laid out and gorgeous. Until the cockroach problem, I was so happy to be here and now I want to be anywhere but here.

I love living here! Friendly people, quite, great duck ponds while out walking. I feel safe plus the Police dept is across the street!
I've been here over 2yrs now. Love it!?

The Invitational owes me $150 of my $400 deposit and if they think you can get away with sending me a 4 month late check for $63.40 they are wrong. I will hit up every review site I can find. I'm only getting started. Pay me what you owe me, just like I paid you rent for two years. Otherwise you're just a bunch of crooks, and I will make sure everyone knows. Might even run a little campaign at the local universities to let them know to avoid RAIT properties. But I would love nothing better than to never have to think about you again, so why don't you just pay me what you owe me and we'll go our separate ways. Peachy. 

I always knew management was sloppy, but it turns out they're full-blown criminals. Avoid RAIT like the plague. Find a small local place with a landlord you can get to know.
I have enjoyed living here the past three years. I feel safe, there’s lots to do within walking distance, and the office is kind and responsive to maintenance requests

Would give zero stars if possible. This is my daughter’s first apartment, and I am co-signer. The air conditioning was inoperative and the thermostat didn’t have batteries. The oven was filthy and the light was broken. There was no HVAC filter. Areas in the bathroom and entry were dirty.  It was obvious that no one in management or maintenance inspected the apartment before she moved in. And to top it off, the management office closed shop about an hour before its posted office hours said it should close. The emergency maintenance number was old/inoperative. Avoid this complex.

Ugh. Where do I begin? The only positive is the convenient location for military service members like me. Like others have mentioned, car break-ins frequently occur in the premises and the complex has done nothing to resolve such security issues. Parking is also a pain to find. If you come home late at night good luck finding a spot, you'll end up parking about a ten minute walk just to get to your apartment. The walls/floors are thin so if you’re noise sensitive, then this is definitely not the place for you.

Even though I have not decided on a location and do not have a firm move date, Kylie and Savannah patiently answered all of my questions.  They were both so friendly...what a refreshing change from others who did not bother to answer or made me feel like I was bothering them.  Thank you Kylie and Savannah!

I Got a tour from a nice lady named Allison who gave me her card she was very helpful with my questions and friendly and made me smile the whole time. I am looking at apts for my mother and I think liberty point would be a nice place for her because it is very quiete and Allison was very friendly

Had to get our mail carrier to come looking for our package because tracking carrier said it was handed to the office but when we called, they told us there was NO package. We ordered again and the SAME thing happened. After 3 orders, a case had to opened!!! They had a nice excuse as to why they lied about not having it. Next time, maybe send an email instead of making the USPS come searching :)
I personally have lived here for just over a month and have discovered a great place to live! The staff seems friendly and i love having the pool!!! (Swimming is my fave)

Things have not changed a bit since previous reviewer's experience.
I have never written a review before, but after my experience here, I felt I had too. Maintenance is terrible, the apartments seriously need a change in staff, and management is rude, unprofessional, and careless. If you call the office and they actually answer,  with an issue, they are rude and dismissive. The manager seems to not care at all about you unless she is trying to get more money out of you. If they dont answer, don't bother leaving a message, they won't call you back.  If you put in a maintenance request, be prepared to call back three more times before they actually send him out. Then be prepared for him to do it wrong and have to call him out twice more. You won't get your notices that maintenance or anyone else will be entering your apartment, and then they will blame that on you. Walls are paper thin. Don't get a first floor apartment if you don't want to hear every step your neighbors above you take. My biggest complaint, though, would definitely be management. If you can afford better, do yourself a favor and DON'T LIVE HERE.
Great spot in OKC! Walking distance to Bricktown and Downtown OKC. Love living here. The staff is responsive and friendly!

I have lived here for the last 2 years and it has been amazing! The complex is located a short walk away from Bricktown, but is far enough away that the nights are quiet. There is covered garage parking that is gated with plenty of parking. I have met a lot of my closest friends while living here! There are people of all ages from all walks of life living here and everyone is so friendly. It’s a great place for anyone just starting out in OKC to meet people and make friends! Pool time in the summer is always great and the pool is kept clean! Any time I have ever had to put in a work order, it’s been completed and finished before I return home from work the following day. There are 2 elevators on property to make getting up and down easy. For dog owners, there’s a dog park right across the street with a bar next door so you can grab a beer while taking your furry friend out! There are also artificial turf potty areas on the 4th floor parking garage. Management team is attentive and very friendly. Overall I would highly recommend!

I moved to OKC having never been to Oklahoma before and toured a ton of apartments before deciding on Level. I have absolutely loved living here for the past 2 years and don't think there is a better apartment complex, especially in downtown. Garage parking is included in your rent which was not the case at many other places. Never once have I felt unsafe living here especially as a younger female living by herself. You need a key fob to access any of the floors from both the parking garage and to enter the property. Management and maintenance has always been quick to resolve any issues and are extremely friendly and on top of things. I really feel like a valued member living here. The neighborhood is very walkable and there are always people out and about. Had I not taken a job in another state and was staying in OKC, I would continue to live here. I cannot recommend Level enough to anyone looking to move to OKC/downtown area.
My wife and I were shown an apartment that was “move-in ready” that had water damage. Still haven’t returned my deposit a month later! Don’t give this complex a second thought!

You will regret choosing this apartment. It’s old and out of date and management is awful. Appliances are always breaking because they’re cheap. Every year I see dozens of flooded apartments from burst pipes because they refuse to properly insulate their apartments. The trash compactor breaks monthly. And gates frequently stop working this place is not worth your time or money.

I moved into my apartment there in November 2023 and almost been one year and I really love it. My particular apartment has an attached garage which I really love, and it makes me feel safe and secure. Has a large closet and multiple storages and a large balcony. This property has a large chess game, pickleball court and swimming pool not to mention the only property I know that has garden plots for the residents to grow vegetables. Maintenance makes sure to get any work orders done within a couple of days. So far, it's been the best apartment community that I have ever lived in and its only 2 minutes away from my work so that's a plus!

I enjoyed apartment but believe they take advantage of you. I had a good experience living there but when I moved out my girlfriend and I cleaned that place from top to bottom and I was still charged a 133$ fee that they sent to a creditor. When I called to speak about it, they said “it’s not our problem”… that apartment was cleaner when I left then when I moved in… I don’t think that’s right.

Rent increased each year. You must have apartment insurance which is all on top of your rent amount. There is white carpet everywhere! They are often in and out of your apartment tracking in dirt that you are responsible for cleaning. If you have a pet, be ready to get a kennel or find another place for him. They recently repainted and replaced shingles. I was responsible for cleaning up the old shingles and nails off my balcony. Rent increased after this too. When moving out, they threw a nice Bissel carpet cleaner away when I was coming to get it. I still had a day to get everything. They also threw away a garbage can with my cleaning supplies. When I received the bill for moving out I was charged for them throwing my stuff away I was coming to get. Just try talking to them; they are not understanding or supplied with any common sense. They bribe you to write reviews and be entered to win a year of free rent. No one ever wins but they use your review against you! The main Leinbach company will not talk to you. They only send you to that apartment complex manager. Gates are often broken and safety is compromised. The apartments are next to a major turnpike and street. Cars are heard often. All the greenery plants, shrubs, trees are dead. And beware of the many ticks at the property!

By far the best apartment experience I've had. No maintenance issues, no bugs issues, no neighbor issues, absolutely no security issues. The pool, pickle court, and workout room are conveniently located. The staff is friendly and helpful if I need anything. They host monthly resident events and the staff is super understanding. The maintenance crew is great too. Hands down, the best apartment I've ever lived in. I would definitely recommend this apartment complex!
The maintenance service is on time and they have a very friendly approach.

This apartment complex not only feels safe but, the staff and community have been friendly & welcoming. The apartments are extremely, nice & well kept. Grateful to have found this apartment community and looking forward to making many memories through the whole time we are here. I feel wholehearted that the staff at Crown Martin Park understands and manages the property efficiently.  The office and maintenance staff has done whatever it has taken to ensure my needs are met in a timely manner.

I moved here less than a year ago and I am so glad I did! The apartment and amenities are great! I love my view and management and maintenance work hand in hand to make sure any issues are resolved appropriately! Activities that involve resident are fun and enjoyable! The only reason I didn't give it (5) stars is parking for visitors is in the back and I wish it was closer to my apartment. Sometimes guest park in other assigned spots out of convenience.

By far the best place I’ve ever lived! All the office staff are super helpful and friendly!The office staff is very courteous and they are quick to answer maintenance requests. They respond right away and go above and beyond. The amenities are great including a gorgeous pool and pickle ball court. The buildings and grounds are immaculate and the staff goes out of their way to take care of their residents. The community is gated with surveillance and feels very safe. Great community feel, I would totally recommend living here.
Beautiful community with mature landscaping, spacious apartment, great balcony, close to everything you need.
Don't move here! Terrible management. Just please don't move here!

This is house that you can call home! I've lived here for 1.5 years and I appreciate the community every day!
Pros- it's quite, spacious floor plans, reasonable rent rates, fantastic location close to grocery, gas, hospital, and more. Updates to the Fitness Center are almost done and renovation around the Community Garden are looking good! All the staff are kind, friendly, and responsive to needs. 
Cons- I'd like to see more community events.

Mention that Christie Martinez sent you when you check'em out and I'd be glad to take you on a tour! I do not work for Crown Martin, I just call it home!

Crown Martin Park is the perfect apartment if you want a gated community that's within short driving distance to great restaurants, shopping centers, and downtown OKC. The complex is well maintained and the staff is very helpful and friendly. What's very surprising was that the complex hosts social events every month so you can you meet your neighbors and hang out with live music. Not a lot of apartments do that.

This is the best apartment experience I’ve ever had! I lived hear from the beginning of 2024 to March 2025 and couldn’t recommend it more. The front office is awesome and always responsive to any issues I’ve had. The maintenance crew is incredible, I’ve had several minor maintenance issues that are always fixed same day. My heat went out once and they also fixed it the same day. The grounds are very sell kept. 10/10!

Here at Montclair Parc I have had such an easy transition to being by myself! The office staff is great and so helpful, there is no such thing as too many questions with them as they answer them all with a smile! The maintenance team goes above and beyond making sure that every maintenance request you put in is taken care of same day! I look forward to the rest of my time living here!

The team at Montclair Parc was so helpful. The whole application process was completed from home on their website and I was approved in minutes. Sure there is some ID verification required, but that is just a couple extra steps to ensure I was who I said I was (which I am thankful for considering they hadn't ever met me). After talking with the girls in the office, they were able to help me find the exact apartment that I was looking for. They have lots of floor plans and options, but they took the time to see what would best fit my needs. I regretfully have nothing positive to say about my experience at Oak Creek Apartments. From the moment I moved in, it has been a complete nightmare. Here are the reasons why I strongly discourage anyone from considering this apartment complex:
1. Poor Maintenance: The maintenance team at this complex is utterly incompetent. Numerous maintenance requests were made, and most of them were either ignored or poorly addressed. Basic repairs such as plumbing issues and broken appliances took weeks to get fixed, causing significant inconvenience and frustration.
2. Unresponsive Management: The management team demonstrated a complete lack of professionalism and accountability. They were unresponsive to our concerns and failed to address issues promptly. Trying to reach them by phone or in person was an exercise in futility, as they often seemed disinterested or dismissive of our problems.
3. Inadequate Security: The security measures at Oak Creek are woefully insufficient. There have been multiple instances of unauthorized individuals gaining access to the property, and the management did little to address the issue. This lack of security created a constant sense of unease and compromised our safety.
4. Unsanitary Conditions: The overall cleanliness of the complex was subpar, to say the least. Trash bins were often overflowing, hallways were rarely cleaned, and the common areas were neglected. It was evident that proper cleaning and maintenance were not a priority for the management.
5. Noise and Disruption: The noise levels in the complex were unbearable. Thin walls and poor insulation allowed every sound to penetrate, making it impossible to enjoy a peaceful living environment. Additionally, frequent construction and renovation projects caused significant disruption, often starting early in the morning and continuing throughout the day.
6. Unreliable Amenities: The promised amenities were consistently underwhelming and often out of service. The pool was frequently closed for maintenance or overcrowded with unsupervised children.
In conclusion, my experience at Oak Creek was nothing short of a nightmare. The combination of poor maintenance, unresponsive management, inadequate security, unsanitary conditions, excessive noise, and unreliable amenities made living here an absolute disappointment. I strongly advise potential renters to steer clear of this apartment complex and explore other options that prioritize tenant satisfaction and well-being.

When I first moved into Canal Street Flats, the affordable rent was a major factor in my decision to live here. The recent renovations and increased fees have made the rent skyrocket, leaving me to question whether it would have been better to spend a little more and live in a better building in or near downtown. I have quickly realized that the price is not worth the numerous problems and difficulties that have arisen since the change in management.

While the renovated apartments are certainly visually appealing, the building itself is old, and things seem to be constantly breaking down, especially if you don't have a renovated unit. Additionally, the change in management has brought a significant decrease in vehicle security, with multiple break-ins reported in the parking lot. The lax security measures have also allowed individuals to smoke marijuana in the stairways, leaving a potent and unpleasant odor throughout the building, especially for those living near the stairways. This is particularly dangerous for those who have kids or pets in the building, as people leave their ashes and leftover roaches in the stairways.

To make matters worse, the rent has gone up significantly due to the renovations, and more fees are now included in the monthly rent. And if you're not a heavy sleeper and manage to get an apartment with a nice view, be prepared to be jolted awake by the incredibly loud train that runs through downtown in the early hours of the morning.

Overall, I would not recommend Canal Street Flats to anyone looking for a safe and comfortable living experience. The higher price is not justifying staying here, and it might as well be spent on a better building in downtown or commuting a little farther for the same price. While the new management may be trying their best, they have a long way to go to make this building a livable space for its residents.

The Hayworth: Disappointing Disorganization Disguised as Luxury

My experience at The Hayworth Apartments fell far short of the "luxury" image they project.  Here's why:

Walk-in Woes:  I arrived at 2 pm on a Saturday, eager to tour the property.  However, Melanie, who greeted me,  was completely unwelcoming.  She curtly informed me they don't accept walk-in tours, despite the leasing office hours clearly stating Saturday availability on the door.

Probing for Information:  To get any kind of information about a future tour, I had to pry it out of her.  Apparently, Jade, the only person supposedly on-site, wasn't even there!

Misleading Communication:  Two emails I received beforehand made no mention of a no-walk-in policy.  Adding to the confusion, the signage on the door clearly states weekend leasing office hours, yet Melanie insisted they only operate on Saturdays.

Inconvenient Scheduling:  The only tour slot Melanie offered was on Monday at 1:30 pm, a far cry from the immediate service one would expect from a luxury apartment complex.

The entire experience felt like a dismissive runaround.  If this is how they treat potential residents, I can only imagine how frustrating it might be to actually live there. If you're looking for a truly luxurious living experience with professional and accommodating staff, The Hayworth might not be the place for you.  There are better options in Houston that value your time and treat you with respect.

You have a right to demand that the landlord repair any condition that materially affects your health and safety. Under Texas law, by renting you the property, the landlord guarantees that the unit will be a fit place to live.

SB 1448 (81st Regular Session), effective January 1, 2010, now grants justices of the peace authority to order landlords to repair or remedy conditions affecting a tenant's health and safety, as long as the cost of the repair does not exceed $10,000. Tenants can go to justice court without an attorney to obtain a repair order.

Under certain conditions, you and the landlord may have a written agreement that you will make needed repairs. The landlord does not have a duty to pay for or make repairs if you or your guests cause an unsafe or unhealthy condition through negligence, carelessness, abuse or accident—unless the condition resulted from "normal wear and tear."

Also, the landlord must provide smoke detectors. You may not waive that provision, and you may not disconnect or disable the smoke detector.
