I can literally walk out the gate and across the street to 3 restaurants & a Walmart is just around the corner. Plus, if any of the walking distance places aren't to your liking, a short drive or Uber will get you anything else you'd like in regards to dining, shopping and/or nightlife.

Aside from the complex details, the staff have been amazing! The ladies up front (Chandler, Ashley & Madison) have always been super welcoming every time I stop by for a package. Ashley was my initial contact who sold me on the complex and made the rental process super easy but, all three have done some great follow up and make me feel at home every time I see them. It really makes a difference!

I moved here about a month ago, and contrary to below reviews I think the place is awesome and for a good rate! My buddies come over and I even referred someone already and they gave me $250.00. I met some of my neighbors at Taps for a resident appreciation thing and everyone is super nice. I love the location, so many places to walk to.

The location is perfect however, this complex still has a lot of much needed changes. I have lived here for a year & have noticed no major changes except the outside of the building being painted. 

The parking garage is a mess in it's own. Cars getting broken into, stolen & abandoned. Management is well aware of the problems within the garage but since I have lived here, nothing has been addressed. 
There are constantly workers (painters) walking around the building & taking lunch on the stairs of the garage. 
The dog park area is filthy & not cared for properly. It should at minimum get sprayed down every so often as it smells horrible. 
For the most part the residence are extremely nice however I have heard several fights happen in the swimming pool area & on the street in between the buildings.
Security is a joke & comes whenever he pleases. When he's there he can be found walking up & down the street on his cell phone.

Over all, the only real issue here is management. I believe once they address the problems, this place will be the perfect home for anyone. The actual units are nice & maintenance fixes any issues pretty quickly. Just once you step out of your door, you're almost Guareentee to encounter something.
Location is good. The demographic is ok but much better a year ago. Walls are fairly thin so able to hear above and side neighbors frequently.

We have been set up for a couple of weeks now. So far, so good. Highly recommended. The staff is very friendly and attentive. They made sure all of our questions were answered promptly and even called us on move in day to check in and make sure our needs were met. 

The location is great with easy access to I-10. Plenty of restaurants and bars in close proximity. Spotts park is a 5 minute bike ride away with convenient connection to Buffalo Bayou park. No complaints here.

The apartment itself has a perfect layout for roommates. Granite counter tops and laminate wood floors are included in our unit. Best of all, the pricing is very competitive. Only downside is the walk to the garage is a bit lengthy, but most of us could use the exercise. 

5/5. Could not be happier!

This property is exceptionally clean and well-maintained, offering a welcoming and comfortable environment. Every room is spotless, with attention to detail evident throughout the space. The floors, surfaces, and common areas are impeccably tidy, creating a refreshing atmosphere for guests or residents. It's clear that the property is regularly cared for, making it a pleasant place to stay or work.

I’m beyond disappointed with the conditions. The apartment has a serious roach problem that management has failed to address, despite multiple complaints from myself and other tenants. It’s disgusting to see these pests crawling around constantly, and it’s affected my quality of life.

On top of that, the overall maintenance of the building is terrible. Requests take forever to be addressed, and when they do respond, it’s a temporary fix. The lack of cleanliness and proper upkeep is unacceptable, especially considering the rent prices.

Save yourself the headache and money—look elsewhere.
I really enjoy this place, it is not your average apartment complex. I like the fact that there's a garage, washer and dryer, high ceiling with spacious dining room area
I love the peace and quiet and the management staff, well, these ladies are incredible, helpful and knowledgeable.
Prices are fair and staff and managers are always curious and helpful.

I love the space i have in my apartment. My section is quiet i hardly see anyone hardly see anyone
out where i am.

I’ve lived in the Belmont side of the property and let me tell y’all, the new upgrades and changes that are being made are amazing. I’m so glad I’ve decided to stay and remain renting in this property. Also, many thanks to Leticia at the main office for always making sure my needs and concerns are always taken care of. She is always happy to help. Do yourself a favor if going to the main office ask for Leticia!

Units are pretty decent, very spacious, kinda outdated, & the leasing office workers are very helpful. If you’re simply looking for cheap rent & a lot of room, it’s a solid option. Although the rent is cheap for a reason. Our unit was renovated before we moved in & we just recently moved in. Upon cleaning the entire unit, I noticed they painted bugs, hair, & whatever else was already on the walls into the walls. Been tryna get rid of the roaches since I moved in & the occasional spiders. I signed up for the pest control sweeps they do, but nobody came last week. The people who work in the leasing office are very kind and helpful, but it seems like the property managers/owners don’t really care about their units. Definitely not the worst option out there, but definitely wouldn’t recommend it either.

DO NOT MOVE HERE ??

I recently moved here, on the 1st of December, to be exact. On Thursday, December 9th, around 6:08pm (I have video footage of a man walking up my stairs) my apartment was broken into, while no one was home. They broke into the back door, kicking it in, taking many of my valuables and leaving my home a disaster. Not to mention a bullet was fired in my home as well, at the time of the break in. I arrived home around 7:30, the office was closed so I waited till the next morning to notify the office. Once the Manager arrived to my apartment she introduced herself with extremely hostile behavior and insinuated I was lying about the break in before even asking further questions or even offering her help. She also stated that I would be held financially accountable for the reparation of the damages that were made by the break-in. Her reason for this was that “I have worked here for 6 years and no one breaks into just anybody’s home”. On the contrary, every  single one of the neighbors I spoke to has told me that they have had an incident of their privacy, and valuables being trespassed. A police report has been filled and I will be taking this matter with the upmost seriousness.

After almost three years of living in this apartments , I would love to give it 5 stars and share my opinion of this place with anyone looking to live in safe place . Unfortunately I'm moving out of Houston and about to put my 60 days notice and I feel just like when someone leave his family , for all of the people the security is the top priority and this place have 0  security problems , it is very safe specially for a family with kids. I recommend anyone looking for a safe place with respectful staff and clean apartments to live here, they do have some bad driveways needs some work but that is the last thing i will worry about.  I had met a very friendly , lovely and respectful management , office staff , maintenance and housekeeping employees. The prices was not bad at all, It is a great location, Easy access to the tollway and I-10. There is also an elementary & middle school in walking distance. This building has plenty of parking and even better it's covered parking. this complex has pools all in close locations to each apartment but it close on these days because of COVID19. just remember that be respectful for the staff , your neighbors and believe it, I will miss this place and the people I met in it.
 
This is all I can say.

I moved in about 3 months ago and I can honestly say that this is by far the biggest one bedroom apartment I have lived in.  The assistant is nice, and Alex is always so helpful.  There was an issue with parking, because since I get home at 9 and sometimes a bit later, I had to park far.  I talked to Alex about it because he told me when I was ready to reserve a carport to let him know.  After that, no issues.  I already told my sister about this place and she will be here as soon as her lease finishes where she lives.

the one star is for the space... other than that there is nothing good about this place. lived there for more than 3 years. If you are not interested in the following avoid this place:
*BED BUGS!!!
*Roaches
*Days with broken heater/AC
*monthly sewer backups
*maintenance coming into your apartment without permission or being called
*Poor management
This is not all of the issues I had with the time I stayed here. I only stayed as long as I did because of the school that my children attended. Also beware that if you have children they will be harassed by management if they are at the playground. They property boast that they have all these Pools however, they are never open, not even in the summer. Whoever does post their rental payments in the office is a joke. On several occasions I came home to a letter on my door saying rent had not been paid and I had to call them and provide copy of checks that they had cashed on time and then they would just say oh we didn't realize no apology or anything.
You have to pay your own water bill at this property too. However, this would be ok if it was my water bill that I was being charged for. The way they calculate what your water bill will be is they take the usage of the entire apartment complex then they divide it based on how many rooms you have in your apartment. My water bill would range between $75-90 a month. When I have lived in a 4 bedroom home before my water bill never went over $45. I didnt know this is what they did until I had been gone on a 3 week vacation to come home to a water bill which was $75 they explained how they come up with their calculation so even if I used no water that month I would still have to pay. What a rip off. 
I advise you run now if you are considering this place.

Moved in January of 2017, first things I realized was roaches. No mater how many times you call to get fumigated they never send anyone. 2nd thing was my microwave was broken, and there’s a roach stuck between the window of the microwave. I wrote it in the move in report, I’ve also wrote letters, emails and have called about this. (Oh yeah, you can’t call to get anything done, they ask that you write it down or email but never answer emails not actually do anything with the service sheets) they promised for a full year they had ordered the microwave and it was coming.. it is not December 2017, my lease ends on the 31st still no microwave . Also reported carpet wet from Harvey, they even came and asked me at my front door... still no one has changed it.. the service and management is honestly the worst thing I’ve ever encountered in all my years of living in apartments .
These apartments aren't worth it, unless you like roaches an mold. Parking is 1st come 1st serve an the rent increases each time you renew your lease. I regret moving here!!!

Have lived here for a couple of years. We looked at a lot of other apts and for the money, the living area is great.
There have been problems in the past with bad neighbors, but as of right now, no problems. At least not in our section. 
Any time we have issues with our apt, the problem is fixed usually with in a day. I have fixed some problems on my own, simply because I can.
Yes it needs to be re roofed. ( Which we were told would happen the first year we were here.) We do not have any leaks from our roof but I know some do. Needs some other cosmetic improvements.
I have the apt sprayed twice a month for roaches. ( Which they provide ) They are not a real issue in our apt. But I believe its because I do have it sprayed regularly. 
The manger we have now, seems to be fixing issues, but I know she can only do what the owners approve.
Giving it three stars because of the fix up issues.

We have experienced our car being stolen, roaches (we are very clean people), and we have four active leaks in our roof (two of which are leaking rain water into our living room and master bedroom as I type this). There are stabbings and shootings at the on-sight park, and we often receive letters alerting us to home break-ins. Mariachi music blares all day and night. Management will not fix our roof. The apartment is near City Center which is a VERY nice area, however, we found out the hard way that this specific complex is terrible. The smell of weed and urine is often in the parking lot. We should have paid more for a safer apartment. Never again. Only three months left and I can move my family away from here.

I read the reviews on these apartments and as someone that is in the customer service field I can relate why they would feel the way they do and security is the top priority for everyone, but apartments cannot control what happens out of the complex.  I will soon move here 11/1/15, so far the staff I have met are very friendly and the atmosphere is very welcoming.   This is all I have to say, but after moving I will surely give my feedback GOOD or BAD about Belmont Place/La Fontain Apartments.

The price was not bad for the size.... But it seems like the areas is getting more dangerous.  Several times I hear gun shots in the year I have been living here.  During the day everything is great but at night I am nervous of being outside.  If that would change I would love to continue to stay here

This apartment building is a great location. Easy access to Beltway 8 so if you are in a rush you can reach your destination in no time. There is also a middle school, literally in walking distance. This building has plenty of parking and even better it's covered parking so no need to worry about your car getting too hot in the summer or too cold in the winter. Speaking of summer this apartment complex has convenient pools all in close locations to each apartment. Even better there is a corner store one street away. All in all this complex is in a great location and fits most needs if not all.

the apts are good for the price, just don't expect your deposit back it is written on lease agreement, they just sneak it in with the notes that there is a admin fee deducted from your deposit (which is equal to deposit)
I really love what they have to offer, the overall value is number #1 on my list of choices.
Wonderful staff of Anh, Bernice, and Ashley made me feel at home from our first meeting. And the property is beautiful, customer service is top tier!!
Frequent Robberies. People tires and catalac converter have been stolen. Bikes have been stolen off residents balconies.

I have lived here for over 2 years. At first, this apartment seemed nice because of the location on the bayou and the upgraded finishes, but there is so much CRIME in the parking lot and the apartment management has been doing shady things.
Personally, my bike has now been stolen twice. Once from the bike rack with a chain, and once from my balcony, which the thief would have to have climbed up 6 ft or so to get onto.
There has been over a dozen car break ins, tires stolen, etc over the past year. One of these incidents led to gun shots in the parking lot, which I heard from inside my apartment. After this incident and addressing my concerns to management, I was told we would have a town hall type meeting where residents would get together with staff and the courtesy officer to discuss preventative measures and other initiatives the apartment would take. That was over 3 months ago and this has not been scheduled or followed up on..
Management has not done much to steer away these crimes. They say they have cameras and a courtesy officer that lives here but that has not helped any of these situations from being prevented or solved.
Also, after being here 2 years and am about to move out in less than 4 months, I have been charged with a pet fee and pet deposit equaling $500 to my rent, which I thought was taken care of when I first moved in.
The gate is continuously broke from people running into it, and the pool is frequently closed to maintenance and other issues according to management.
During the course of the pandemic, rent continued to increase. Normally I would agree with this because it is standard, but over the pandemic I was the only person out of my friends (living in other complexes in Houston) who had their rent increase elsewhere.
I would not recommend moving into Ashford Lakes. This place is going downhill fast.
Office Management and Staff are excellent, Ashley, Anh and Bernice are all very professional, exemplifying positive attitudes !
I only moved cuz we bought a house.  I miss the staff and neighbors.  Great place to live.

Love this place! And I renewed my lease:) good Bang for the buck$ ( Beautiful nature style and bike trails and all stores nearby! Also easy access to freeways :)Property is always clean and maintained big shout out to the office staff especially Burnece and Haley!! they always pick up or return phone calls Immediately:) always very professional and respectful  and last but not least much love and respect!! to the maintenance team best in the business I appreciate what y’all do!!!

If you don't want to get ripped off, don't move here. They add random fees to the rent every month. If you value peace and safety, don't move here. There's been two murders since I moved in, my car was stolen, the cops are here often to break up domestic disputes, it's roach infested, maintenance request take weeks to repair, and the front office rarely answers the phone or emails.

This place has been horrible to live at. They are quick to charge fees but will not be quick to fix any issues. I have a bad experience living here. They changed management but to horrible ones. They do not fix their gate after being broken for a month! The security here is horrible and apartment complex is infested with roaches!

2022 is my second year living in Westchase Forest as a student with no regrets. I have great neighbors that look out for each other, a friendly and neat environment to workout, an exclusive gym, swimming pools that are well cared for and suitable for recreational activities, and a lovely play arena for kids.

All the office staffs are proactive, ready to listen, and attend to your needs; there has not been any time that I called in for maintenance that I didn’t get a quick response. My recent experience with the new estate manager is remarkable; she returns calls. All the other office staffs are so welcoming, especially Jay. 

I employ you to Check out Westchase Forest apartments, which are excellent value for your money.

apparently you must be sure to have a lockout incident during business hours like a responsible adult per the property manager here.how dumb does that sound? otherwise you must get a locksmith. thats not mentioned anywhere so i wanted to let yall know. then even though its not offered they will charge you $50.75 so yes they will take any money they can and pocket it.

The worst apartment complex ever, recently a tree fell on my car in the parking lot inside the apartments, they didnt respond to that when it’s clearly their fault. every month they charge us an insurance that is supposed to cover incidents like this, when I asked them to send me what the insurance covered, they never answered me again. They don’t care about their residents at all.

On the other hand, last year in October they made a repair in my apartment that they never finished, today, after 7 months they haven’t come to paint, I reported this but clearly  they only care to Attract new residents , not for the ones who live here. Honestly the worst maintenance, the worst staff 

Every weekend there are parties at the pool with loud music that bothers those of us who live near the pool, they don't do anything.

I can't stand to leave here anymore

It's been a nightmare living in this apartment.  I just can't wait to move out. Poor management, work orders takes forever to complete, no form of penalties for noise disturbances especially those on 2nd and 3rd floors. No parking space for residents. Several times, I received work order completed email without anyone coming to my apartment to fix anything. Ridiculous.
Great place with a great staff would recommended it for anyone looking for an apartment...
I’m happy I found this place. The office staff made me feel welcomed. Mia and the rest of the staff are great. I’m very happy with my place.
This is a beautiful community and they are doing some wonderful upgrades. Would highly recommend checking them out!

This apartment is terrible with adding unnecessary charges to your rent. I regret i renewed my lease and cant wait to move out. The new manager( African American)is very RUDE and has no idea about what management is all about. You put it in work orders, you get a reply saying it was fixed; but they never stepped a foot in your home.

I absolutely love my apt and leasing staff. It has been such a great pleasure living here. I have been here for 3 year and have not felt the need to move. My office staff as I like to claim them as my own are alway attentive and willing to help you. I enjoy them so much that,  I will stop in the office to sit and chat with them if they are available. The property is always well kept and maintained. To be honest I have no complaints at all. I really enjoy that on occasions you'll find the office staff outside handing out breakfast! How amazing is that! So if you are thinking about moving to Westchase Forest Apartments, I say come on and tell them DC sent you!
I love the location of my apartment as well as my neighbors. The grounds are kept really clean and I have always felt safe at my complex. I would recommend to anyone looking in Houston!
kitchen, living room, bedroom, two closets, bathroom, burglary alarm, water sprinkler, smoke detector.

I have lived here since June 2014 and have enjoyed my stay. I have not had any problems with other tenants or staff. The only problem I have had was the programming of my number on the front gate. I have asked repeatedly but have never gotten it programmed. That is the only complaint that I have had since moving here.

Mirabella has been my new home for the past couple months and I love it here.. it’s quiet and just about everyone I’ve encountered are friendly especially the staff at the front office. They also made my relocation a lot smoother as well. The area is very convenient in the heart of everything.

Mirabella is a beautiful, clean and quiet community to live at. The staff is always friendly, courteous and helpful. I have lived at Mirabella for almost 2 years now and still happy here. It’s a great place to live at period!
Mirabella’s office personnel and Maintenance teams are great. Respond fast and very helpful, great job guys!!
The layout is great and the staff cares about providing a positive living experience.

Apartment I moved into wasn’t as nice as the apartment I was showed. Put in a request for all the things i needed fixed when I first moved in and they didn’t fix anything except cleaning. Girls in the office are okay just sometimes rude. Also it’s always hard to get ahold of someone in the office. Maintenance guys are good but need to work on notifications and cleaning- they could’ve at least let me know about the glass on the floor so i could clean
Great community always clean and they always greet you with smiling faces.

I lived here for 3 years before having to move out recently due to a job relocation.  I enjoyed our little community.  It was quiet and so centrally located.  It was nice not having to get on a highway to get to work in downtown.  The management team was surprisingly very easy to work with.  You can tell they are not a big corporate company and really take the time to listen to the tenants.  Thank you for a wonderful 3 years!

I love this charming property.  I have lived here twice now in the past 5 years.  I moved out of town for 2 years but came right back.  It's a quiet community on tree-lined street.  The best part is you are within walking distance of so many amazing restaurants.  The major highways are also easily accessible.  The property itself is well-maintained and management has been responsive on answering my questions.

My partner and I were very happy here….in the beginning. While the first year was great, the year that followed brought its “challenges”. In the middle of summer, during the hottest months of the year, the pool was shut down by the health department. When we asked management what the issues were, we got one answer, while our neighbor got a completely different answer. Total lack of adequate and/or consistent information for each person who asked. Shortly after, with Hurricane Beryl came flooding to the newly advertised storage units on the ground floor of the complex. The storage unit we were using had at least 3 inches of water, ruining anything that wasn’t in a plastic container. When management was informed, they claimed they had no idea that it was a flood area, even though the complex was built sometime in the mid to late 20th century. About a week after Beryl, our AC shut down and had to be replaced. When the repairmen were inspecting the AC unit inside and outside our unit, they found that the entire unit needed to be replaced. When we asked management to be reimbursed for a hotel room for the evening, they essentially declined and we were told to take our mattress to a vacant unit and sleep there instead. If it was that easy, we would have done just that. Meanwhile, we slept in an 80-85 degree apt for 2 days until it was finally fixed. Now, I’m no expert, but after a major natural disaster, I would think a management team would check on each property and its facilities/amenities. That was our last straw and we explored breaking our lease, due to breach of contract. The night after my partner spoke with the owners and management, we woke up to our next door neighbor screaming for help, during a domestic altercation with a guest who was not on their lease. The assailant was incapacitated by another neighbor, arrested shortly after, and charged with assault. When we walked out the next morning, we were greeted by small pools of blood on our doorstep and spatter all over our front door. Even after it was “cleaned”, there were still visible traces of blood on our door/doorstep. Needless to say, we moved out shortly after and management did very little to make up for any of my previously mentioned issues listed above. If you are looking for a complex with outstanding management and maintenance, who cares about the needs of it’s tenants, I implore you to look elsewhere.

This is not your typical property that paints Houston’s skyline. Tucked away in the Westmoreland historic district, the authenticity of homes date back to the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The charm, character and location are what I love about my home at 3602 Garrott Street.

There are newly remodeled units offered that provide a modern flare and they give a sense of a small town community feel along with an extra layer of safety. 

In the most populous Texas city, for me, accessibility is key. My home is minutes away from (easy to access) all major key freeways that extend outward from the Downtown area. 

Moving here is one of the best decisions I’ve made, hands down!
Encantada de los apartamentos en Claridge Apartments, el de 3 recámaras es enorme, nos encanta
Over priced ! Always breaking into cars ! Car robbery , theft , no security! Horrible service when it comes to maintenance ! Not safe at all

I saw the reviews about cats and yes this place is overrun with cats and cat urine, but the maintenance and management are by far worse.     You will be without ac for extended periods (half the month) and management will be condescending all the while.  If you work from home, expect lots of days with no water because it’s always being worked on.  If you value your car, don’t move here.  It WILL be towed at least once to welcome you to the tune of at least $234.  Don’t have friends visit unexpectedly or their car will be towed as well.  You literally have to register them online.  This place is just miserable with all the problems I’ve had.  My neighbors all have the same stories so do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.
Overpriced , leaks often on roof that get patched up only . Appliances, cabinets , carpet , and flooring are old and beat up.

Where can I start , I came to check my apartment 2 weeks before my move in day. It needed a lot of work witch they said they would have it done by the time . The day I moved in they gave me paper work to report everything that was wrong with the apartment so that they could fix . It’s been almost 5 months since I moved in and 2 things have been done out of a long list I’ve called over and over but maintenance doesn’t do anything . Always saying there busy but yet they have time to be chatting ?? Don’t move here you’ll regret it apartment are old appliances belong in a trash can and if u need anything fixed well you are on your own .

Looks can be deceiving. It's quiet and all. However, there are cats just EVERYWHERE. I mean everywhere. I'm allergic to cats. They butter you up when you are looking for an apartment, but don't tell you the real deal until after you sign the lease.  If i had known about the cats I would have NEVER moved here. The parking is horrible, maintenance is horrible, the apartments are old and slowly breaking down and they have lots of spiders. I wasn't informed about tenants having to pay for water until after I'm ready to sign. I think that's something that should be disclosed before hand. They have new management now so I'll see if anything changes. I highly doubt it though cause I've called them on a problem several times before it actually got done. Then I have another problem and it's taken them forever to take care of that one.

apartmentName: Creekside Villas at Clear Lake Apartments
review: I love this property! It’s very quiet and well kept, maintenance is very good at fixing things in a timely manner and the leasing office responds to any questions or concerns that I have in a gentle adequate way!

apartmentName: Creekside Villas at Clear Lake Apartments
review:
Well I can't say that it's excellent and I won't say that it's perfect, but I will say I feel at ease.  
I have been living here about 3 years going on 4,  and we have had 3 different apartments in the same complex!!!! I bedroom, then townhouse(I hate stairs??), (now 2BDRM (ON 2/20/23) so when I say I wouldn't live anywhere else ..I wouldn't...I have so many friends here that I met..and my neighbor Jesse is the cop so he's that added security...My daughter and I walk/jog around the complex on weekends and sometimes others will join.the weight room is wonderful my 13 y.o loves it..Im lazy ??..The maintenance crew are like my  brother's (even tho were different races) to me and they ALWAYS make me feel like a priority...
And TBH even though we have had different office management NOT ONE OF THEM HAS EVER TREATED ME UNFAIRLY!!! 
You won't find a better place for the money ?? than right here!!????????

apartmentName: Creekside Villas at Clear Lake Apartments
review: I toured these apartments a few weeks ago and really liked them. However, upon starting an application I had a few more questions. I’ve emailed the assistant manager 4 times with no response, also called and left a voicemail… nothing. I would have really liked to apply, but how do you expect people to move in if you can’t even respond? Highly disappointed.

apartmentName: Creekside Villas at Clear Lake Apartments
review: We were rushed through the process of getting the lease prepared. We were told that our apartment would be one of the renovated units, on the first floor, with a utility room. We asked on several occasions if we could walk the property and were told that the unit was not available to see. We did not see the unit until we signed the final papers and got our keys. Much to our surprise the unit had absolutely 0 of the features that were described to us and looked in almost complete disrepair. It was obvious that no walk was done prior to turning over the keys to us.  We documented everything thoroughly. We brought up a list of health and safety concerns as well as how we felt lied to since the unit did not look anywhere near what was described to us. We saw roaches on our FIRST NIGHT! We STILL fight with this issue, pest control has not been done on our apartment in months. The sliding closet doors in the 2nd bedroom are constantly falling off the track as they were when we moved in which they "fixed" I asked them to remove them as they are nothing but a safety hazard for our small children that occupy that room. They refused. Part of their "Make Ready" was to use latex paint over the old oil based paint on all doors and the bathtub, which began to peel the first time they were used. All of these things were brought to them and they refuse to accept responsibility or want to charge MORE and another deposit on top of that to switch to a unit that you were promised to begin with. (which is not an impressive renovation at all). And these answers only come after prying for WEEKS. They also had an "outage" of the portal that they essentially force you to use to pay rent and pay an additional $30+ on your rent because they "don't accept checks", but the portal goes down and they are suddenly able to accept them. We were told that the portal would be back up on 6/6/22 but according to ActiveBuilding the community is no longer a part of their portal. No communication to their residents in any way. The community pool is also closed due to a HEALTH VIOLATION which, was yet AGAIN not communicated to residents. There is a laundry list of further issues that I could name as well, but they will fall on deaf ears. Don't let the "sincere apologies" on here fool you. It is just to save face with potential residents. They do not care about you one bit! And they strive for nothing more than the bare minimum, which even that is a stretch for them. THIS PLACE IS TRASH! STAY AWAY!

apartmentName: Creekside Villas at Clear Lake Apartments
review:

Management at this property is horrendous. Since being taken over by Knightvest, the front office has become even less responsive, and does not take responsibility for any of the issues in the property. Water has been out for multiple days at a time, people have been locked out after hours due to a malfunction on the electric locks, and multiple packages have been stolen on a regular basis. Every single time there is an issue, management claims it is not their problem and is the third party's problem because they have delegated responsibility over every meaningful aspect of the property to a third party service provider, and are unable to help residents. Very difficult to get help during short hours and phone line typically just goes to voicemail. Beware of five star reviews, they are likely paid for by management. There are plenty of newer, cheaper, better maintained apartments nearby. No need to live in a place that is right next to construction for the next few years.

I moved from Ohio to Texas and had no idea where to live. The staff at San Simeon have been gracious and accommodating in our transition to this wonderful city. I am so glad we chose this little community with so many nice neighbors. It made our move so much easier to handle.
Stay far away, moving out as soon as we can. Knightvest took over this complex recently and caring about tenants left with the previous owners. Do not live here!
Leasing staff is great. Grounds well kept. Great place to live!

Please do not move here! I ignored the reviews and I regret it. They will catfish you with an apartment that looks beautiful during the tour but what you actually get is nothing like the what was shown. They are roach infested, the gate is always open. I lived there for 2 years and my downstairs toilet for broken for half the time I was living there. These apartments are very money hungry and that’s all that they care about. 10/10, do not recommend!!

People in the apartments feed them and they continue multiplying, I know a new litter is born every 4-6months. They live mainly by the trash. They are driving me insane. I used to love living here. I do love the area, the apartments hold up well during floods and hurricanes. Glad the finally fixed the hot water heater. Sometimes there be trash around which is crappy. Maintenance has improved since previous management but still a lot of work needed to fix the community. Have lived here since 2015. I might renew my lease one more year due to inflation and I hate moving but I do want to move
Please, if you care about reviews, listen to me.. do not move here. Gunshots ever so often, no gate code, property unkept, infestation of roaches..

They only care about collecting the rent money on time. The office staff is rude and unprofessional.They do not answer the phone or address maintenance request. Yet they find other petty reasons to enter your apartment unannounced. I lived here over 3 years and will not be renewing my lease.

If you must live here, choose a unit on the newer side. I live on what appears to be the older side: silverfish, missing hardware, rats, rusty landscaping, trash on the grounds, piles of dog s**t, faulty appliances. It doesn’t exactly look like the website. Absolutely tour your unit before moving in. I moved 1300 miles to live here, sight unseen. Mistake. Was given no tour, no orientation & I’ve had to submit roughly 15 maintenance requests in the two months I’ve lived here. Have to resubmit maintenance requests multiple times before anything is completed & there’s no follow-up from management about them. Also, watch for fees tacked onto your rent that don’t seem to be optional, like trash valet and processing charges for using plastic to pay your rent. (They don’t have auto pay here, which is insane in 2025.) Just now I discovered my tub drain doesn’t close for baths & for the 3rd time in two months there’s no hot water tonight. I absolutely regret moving here. Use caution!

Didn’t introduce himself or ask any questions about budget or amenities. Overall just nonchalant and uninterested. if this is how they treat new possible tenants, can’t imagine how they treat the current ones!
Very quite and peaceful complex. All the neighbors are nice! Safe environment. Enjoyed living here. Leasing office works with you and responds fast to maintenance requests.

The administration in Ranchstone are very organized, they are always ready to listen to residents and their  needs. So far they have always been on time in handling repairs and making sure I and my family are comfortable.

Terrible property and management. I been without A/C and No stove for over a week in winter. No hot water and not a working fridge. This property had no urgency to fix my problem. NOTHING but Terrible help. the manager blew us off before the thanksgiving break knowing we was without power. We had to call corporate three times just to get any kind of help. DO NOT MOVE HERE. They will just neglect the residents till they are ready to help on there time. Worst year so far and I renewed. Plus they only have they only have one trash can that never works. CANT WAIT TO MOVE. We've been here almost 2 years and plan to stay until we purchase a home. We haven't had any pest issues and snagged our covered parking for only $10/mo!
I could never get rid of the roaches. The dumpster overflows bc they only have one and empty it once a week. Rude management.

I have loved living here. They are VERY prompt to make repairs and truly care about their people. Alixandria in the office is PHENOMENAL! She has been so very helpful to me. Definitely recommend living here!
My living experience has been pretty good overall. I believe there are a few things that can be improved on the property that would benefit everyone.

There is no place like home my apartment in this community was hand picked my God, Just for me a place with purpose and destiny in mind. ...If you are looking for somewhere to live that continues to grow and prosper this is the place to be where the spirit of life is about to flourish.
Visiting 6 complexes and picked Sunrise. Celia was very helpful and informative. Loved the location and units. Smaller complex but hoping will be a plus.

Oh my goodness, apartment hopping has been my thing for a while now, but let me tell you, Sunrise by the Park is a whole different ballgame! From the second I walked into that lobby, I was like, "Whoa, this is fancy!" It felt like home right away.

The apartments themselves are just dreamy. They're modern, they're huge, and everything is so clean and shiny. My place has this amazing open layout that's perfect for having friends over. And the amenities? Top-notch! The gym is so awesome, it actually makes me want to work out.

And the pool area? Oh. My. Gosh. Not only is the pool sparkling and refreshing, but they have a spacious hot tub to soak in after a long day. Plus, there are big screen TVs all around, so you can catch the game or your favorite show while you relax. And if you get hungry, they even have a fantastic cooking range right there! It's like a resort!

The staff here are seriously the best. They're always so helpful and friendly. But the real magic of Sunrise by the Park is the community vibe. Everyone is so warm and welcoming. It's like a little family!

And you know what's even better? The rent prices are super competitive for all this luxury! It's like they're giving away a five-star experience!

So, if you're hunting for a place that's luxurious, convenient, and full of awesome people, look no further. Sunrise by the Park is the place to be! Trust me, you won't regret it.

Best Wishes,
Darrell W. Levi Sr.

There is a serious roach issue here. I believe there’s an infestation in the walls or carpet. The neighborhood is nice and very safe with no breakins. if I could give 0 stars I would

Kathryn is amazing! Great communicator and very knowledgeable. So thrilled that my son will be living here!

Even though the company's documentation provided during the application says the administrative fee will be refunded, be warned, IT WILL NOT.
They are good and you move in, but terrible when you leave and move out. I left the apartment almost 2 month and haven't received any feedback about my refund.
This complex has the worst management! It is over priced for what it offers! Just has gotten worse over the years! Will tow cars no matter what it says in the lease! Do not rent here!

We live in this project since last 6 months. Overall project is good, except lizards. I cannot enter in my house because of bunch of lizards around my main door. They should contact the Pest control for lizard controlling.

I've lived here for 7 months and it has been AMAZING! The staff is so incredibly friendly (always waving in passing and saying hello), the property is beautiful and clean, neighbors are friendly and courteous, maintenance is always timely. I get packages all of the time and they have an extremely organized and well managed system of getting packages to recipients and documenting it. The location is amazing! Whole Foods and Walgreens are nearby, along with major retail stores. Right off of 249 so it's easy to get on the tollway and interstate. I can't say enough good things about this apartment complex. It truly feels like a neighborhood and I love living here. They hold events periodically  that really brings the community together. So nice! Lots of children and families live here and the children are always so well behaved and sweet. Extremely family friendly. Rent is kind of high but it is worth every single penny because it's clear that the management invests money in the property. We needed a larger apartment (can't commit to homeownership right now) and their 3 bedroom is huge--1900sq! The actual apartment is beautiful--vaulted ceilings, very high quality appliances, fireplace, lots of storage, security system (even though the complex is very safe and I've never felt unsafe here). Wish I could give more than 5 stars. I recommend this to all!!-- tenants and to other apartment complexes because San Cierra is the MODEL for what apartments should be!

Lived here for 10 years, starting back in July 2015. I would not recommend living here on account of the current management team. Their communication is utterly atrocious, with email correspondences taking days for a reply at best or just going completely unanswered. And after reading other recent reviews, this seems to be a recurring trend. Management takes no responsibility for the lack of response and may even blame you for not following up sooner. Even escalating things up to the property manager was more of the same. Too bad if it's an important matter that ends up costing you as a resident thousands of dollars when it all could have been avoided if management had just checked their email.

Location-wise, it's still great being next to HEB. That's the only unique advantage offered, though. There are restaurants, bus lines, and highway access that are close by, but so are other apartment complexes you can consider. The amenities are okay (outdoor pool, billiards tables, gym) but they haven't changed much over 10 full years (a couple of outdoor grills were installed, but they also took away a few perks in the gym). 

Expect to lose power a couple times a year (typical for Houston, though), and to have water shut off in the building for a day every few months on little to no notice. The front gate malfunctions seemingly every other week as well. All in all, I would've rated them higher based on my average experience throughout the past decade, but this feeling like they screwed us over now that we're trying to move out has permanently soured my opinion of this community. I know that this is clearly specific to my personal experience, but it's so bad that I'm seriously considering legal counsel over their communication negligence and felt like I had to speak up publicly.

I wouldn't be living in an apartment with services as tardy as this if Belmons wasn't cheap. Absolute disappoinment!

My two years living in these apartments were great until I had to interact with management. The first red flag was when I was applying for the apartment, my roommates and I didn't make enough money on our own, but together we scraped by. The person reviewing our application with us told us she would adjust MY personal income to get us approved, which seemed like a really sketchy thing to do. They have also managed to "misplace" several documents while I lived there (including my move-out notice). They also "lost" my pet deposit for 1 of the cats we moved in with, so they are blaming us for "having an unauthorized pet", of course the fact that I paid my deposit isn't listed on our copies of our lease. This has lead my roommates and I to distrust the management team. My fiancée and a roommate of mine had the same name, so the management assumed they were married and combined their names on our mail box. It wasn't a problem until that roommate moved out, which then forwarded all of my fiancée's mail to their house. I've had times where I would put in a maintenance request and it no one would show up to fulfill it, but management never forgot to spam my inbox with surveys. That is, if they even manage to email me about something in a timely manner. There have been many points at which we were warned about fire alarm tests or maintenance issues too late. Now that I've moved out, I'm being charged $530 for "damages", which include "the dirtiest oven" they've ever seen and a carpet which is "torn to shreds", the pictures they sent us don't reflect any of this, but Ashley believes that "the charges are justified". My security deposit was spent on a "stench" they claim the apartment had and pests that I never saw when I went back to clean up.

This place is a trap. You can do so much better. Even if you think that it's good for the price, they'll bleed you for every last penny once you move out. The management is hyperbolic and unfair, and I'm glad to have such a bad experience while I'm young enough to recover from it.

Staff very unfriendly made me feel like I was not welcomed at all and that I was bothering them. I think they had better stuff to do rather than renting an apartment. I’ll pass. Thanks for the experience.

When we first moved we were given an apartment infested with roaches. Then they moved us to another apartment at our own expense.

So expensive and nothing is included with rent. Paying a mortgage for a two bedroom is ridiculous. You would think that since the property is near a college they would offer some form of college student discount, but no.

Honestly the worst place I've ever had the misfortune of living at. They stockpile trash at the entrance, Celeste and the Assistant Manager Kimberly are very unhelpful and very rude. I never write reviews, and I'm copying and pasting this everywhere so everyone can see. Horrid horrid horrid.

Glad we chose carrington park as our first apartment home so spacious the office staff is so helpful and attentive  the Maintence is on point Kendrick and his partner are awesome always get our tickets fixed in a timely manner I would recommend this property couldn't asked for q better apartment home ??
I have lived at Carrington Park for 3 years now and have no complaints. The staff in the office and on the maintenance team are so kind.

As I could not fit my full eight-page complaint letter initially written to Fogelman Management Group (see the Better Business Bureau website for our full letter), I am forced to summarize the many issues we experienced in our two years living at Carrington Park at Gulf Pointe. The major issues that frustrated us were with regard to the gates being broken and inoperable nearly 50% of the time, management's lack of attention to trash, poor maintenance of the grounds, and very inadequate maintenance.

As a gated community, one would imagine that maintenance of the gate would be a high priority for management; unfortunately, the gates are broken a large bit of the time, allowing whomever to come in without a remote. Management tells residents regularly that the motor is burned out and they are waiting on contractors, sometimes leaving the complex open for weeks at a time. When the gates are operable, however, non-residents follow residents in after waiting in the parking lot or--as we have experienced several times--push their way through the exit gate, blocking exiting residents and in some cases breaking the gates in the process.

The trash compactor has never held all of the residents' trash and is often overrun with extra trash bags and food that gathers on its stairs and into the parking lot. It is a regular occurrence to take our trash to the compactor and find that we must leave it on the curb because we cannot reach the compactor; as you can imagine, the smell is disgusting, as is the view. When a dumpster is brought in while the compactor is being maintained, it often literally overflows and trash sacks partially block the exit.

Maintenance issues are recurring. We have had to call for several issues, including a crack in the bottom of our tub, needing to have our tub resealed, a broken air conditioner, and a roof leak. In each case, we were unhappy with how management handled the situation, neglecting to tell us on three occasions how long we would be without a shower or air conditioning, forcing us twice to stay with my parents due to a lack of both amenities, and requiring us to write a letter to the manager to allow them to handle a maintenance man's inappropriate misinformation of how quickly items would be corrected. The crack was never corrected because they neglected to tell us to vacate the apartment beforehand, and the damage to the paint and sheet rock tape were still in place when we moved five months later despite being "repaired."

I've lived here for about half a year and I love it. Everyone is pretty respectful and I haven't heard a loud neighbor once. It's not the most modern apartment but I definitely feel at home here. Maintenance is nice and is always out picking up any litter that might have been left out. Plus there's always a parking space for your guests. I've heard so many complaints from friends that live in other places but I can't say I have one about this place. I swear it's not fake I really like it here.
Great management and staff. Walls are thin though and neighbors are often loud. Neighbors are kind of terrible and leave trash everywhere. Other than that, convenient location and good, clean units.

I wouldn't recommend Abbey. One of the biggest issues is the recurring problem with roaches. There are a lot of small cracks in the walls and they seem to live inside them.

The apartments are nice! Abigail Gonzalez was a great leasing consultant. She provided me with detailed information and she was helpful.

Thank you, Ms. Abigail for making my next apartment search so easy and fun

I recently moved to the Abbey at barker cypress and thus far I’m impressed. I stayed in a apartment complex for over 7 years and decided I needed a change. Este complejo tiene una ubicación privilegiada en cuanto a locales de interés y vías de tránsito .,  la atención del personal administrativo y de mantenimiento es excepcional, rápidas respuestas en todo momento
The service in the office is outstanding.  Prices for the area are extremely reasonable, large patios and a quiet community.

Living at Solace Apartment Homes is just wonderful. The staff are very nice and caring, also the Maintenance is good for being on time fixing things...I love the change in the landscape around the apartment's.

The assistant manager has been helpful and great from the start of touring to now. When I first moved in, there were a lot of people who would blast their music in apartments or car after 10pm. Love living here!

I love living here. I have been here for almost 2 years and only had one incident where I did not receive stellar customer service, and the management company promptly took care of the one incident and made sure I was taken care of. Cant say enough great things about this community. :)

I recently had a terrible experience with the management team at a The Huxley at Medical Center. The maintenance work was incredibly poor and seemed to be done haphazardly. What's worse is that when I brought this to the attention of the manager, they refused to admit that there was anything wrong with the work. It was as if they were completely blind to the shoddy workmanship. To make matters even worse, the manager was constantly lying about various things, which only added to the frustration and disappointment I was feeling. I've lived at The Huxley since 2007 and have experienced numerous management teams. The new management team is by far the best I've ever experienced. (Emma Milton, Mona's sister assisted her in writing this review).

At first I really enjoyed living at these apartments but my first red flag was seeing roaches in the kitchen area. My second red flag was seeing a gang of feral cats and the fleas that festered on their bodies and the property. And then should you walk past the grass, fleas would then bother you. My final red flag has been the towing situation.

Numerous extra fees on top of your rent they don't tell you about. Move somewhere nicer if you can. It's a lot of trash as well and don't expect maintenance to fix anything anytime soon. I'm still waiting from June. And the the staff that works in the office never know anything.

Under no circumstances should you even consider moving here. Now, don’t get me wrong, the apartments are actually not too bad, but the management is the absolute worst that I have ever dealt with in my life. The noise here is absolutely unbearable, so I guess if you don’t like to sleep then by all means move right on in. Save your money and live literally anywhere else, it’s not worth it.
Rooms have awesome amenities. Nice laid back spot. Ben was very helpful as always! ??
I would not move here lots of mold, rats, roaches are taking over and etc. They do bare to fix what needs to be fix. So I would keep looking because they will lie.

Mold, mildew, bugs, rats, trash/rubbish all over the place, and a grossly incompetent staff.

I can't recommend it enough to avoid this place like the plague it is.

Every other resident I spoke with also had mold or bug problems.

Do not move into these appartments!!. They do not fully remove mold if water damage occurs they paint over it. They don't even care if your kids room is moldy they don't properly maintain the living conditions. Doesn't even deserve a single star !
They charge an extra fee for parking and if you park in a wrong spot on accident they have your car towed and have no compassion for thier residents.
Sooo many bugs, parking situation is inconvenient and they have a chiller system for the WHOLE complex. You need your own heater and fans to have the temperature you want. New management is not it

I’ve been in my apartment a few weeks now & I’m loving it.  Alyssa was super helpful with the whole process & very welcoming, big thanks to her. maintenance is great and always ready to help in any way possible.

I lived in San Antigua for 2 years. I had to move for work if not I would have continued staying there. Management team is the best. Maintenance issues were resolved in a timely manner. Surroundings are clean and well maintained. Would like to make a special mention for Ileana, she was very professional and answered all our questions during the move in and has always been helpful in general when ever we approached her with anything.

I’ve lived here 5years couldn’t image living anywhere else  there management team make you feel at home, pet friendly ,neighbors it just keep getting better living here they go over and beyond for there residents I love it here

Jessica, the apartment manager, doesn’t keep track of how many guests people have during the summer so it’s over run by people who don’t live there. They break glass by the pool and don’t clean up after their dogs. The winter is quiet, because she always closes the hot tub during the only months it would actually be nice to have. 

Management also lets people party until 3am on weeknights, and they never in my years living here have checked parking passes, so the parking lot is always full of too many more cars than it’s designed to hold. 

The “events” they like to host are often multi-level marketing schemes selling junk essential oils. 

Save yourself a headache and don’t live here. The manager is incompetent, which drags the whole place down.

I have lived at San Antigua for almost 4 years now and couldn't imagine living anywhere else! The management is fantastic and is always looking for new ways to upgrade/improve the property. They also host a lot of great resident functions (weekend brunch, food trucks, bingo, and more) which are super fun and you get to meet your neighbors!

In the last year there have been at least a dozen break ins. Cars and apartments, at all times of day and night. 
Owners refuse to install security cameras or a night guard or any other solution to this situation. 
Secondly, if you end up in an apartment above/below a noisy neighbor or dog who barks all night, management will not do anything about it, nor will they let you out of your lease. 
Rents keep going up and quality of living is going down.

I love the San Antigua. It has been a pleasure staying here , great area. Great neighbors and great customer service as well. Never had any problems thank god . I hope this continues as I move away. Than you

Don't move here, run, absolutely a nightmare!
I lived in this apartment complex for three years, and it's going downhill ever since Knightvest management team took over. They simply do not care about their current residents. Dirty complex, old amenities, frequent water shut offs, no dog poop bags, no mailbox to use for over 6 months because it was vandalized and the incompetent maintenance manager lost my apartment key three times and I had to cook in the dark for two months.. Fine, but what about safety? No security cameras, no guards on-site anymore and gate is constantly open, resulting in my car been marked, I been stalked by strangers and my apartment got broken into. I've lost thousands of dollars but at least the burglars did not harm my dog. The management team showed no sympathy over my incident, and the manager Jessica acted so defensive, stating that my safety is not their responsibility and she even said "sue me I don't care." I never felt so disrespected and disappointed until this very moment. Stay away from this place and those crazy people, not worth the headache!

I've lived here for 2 years. There are plumbing issues from old/cheap pipes that has the water being shut off often without warning to repair leaks usually once a month or so. Current management is renovating the place since they purchased it last fall, but that means that the gate is constantly left open during the day, even on the weekends, for the work crews' convenience. Renovations also means I couldn't use my balcony for a month because of repainting, the pool area for a couple months nor currently the entire leasing office/center. With the renovations, packages are delivered to doors as the locker system is likewise currently not available.

We don't have a guard, I only ever saw one nearly a year ago for a month. Empty apartments are also rented out for AirBnBs, meaning we often have people without fobs entering and staying for short periods of time. Moreover, I have heard several residents in the last couple months complain of thefts from their balconies and even break ins due to security being so low. This is one of the main reasons I am moving as I no longer feel safe living here.

The location is great, the complex is a pleasing walk and aesthetically pleasing, and the other residents are nice. They spray pretty well for pests and the office and maintenance staff are pretty friendly. But the biggest weakness of the complex is the lack of communication. For example, several of the mailbox panels were busted, leading to our mail being directed to a post office on the other side of the medical center. We received one email about this and then heard absolutely nothing for 4 months.  Then they sent an email saying they had tried a solution, it hadn't worked, and so they were going with a Plan B. We finally have mailbox service again after over 5 months. My mail was delayed with this arrangement, I missed important letters.

Yes, the apartments look great. Yes, the location is great. But compared to many other places I've been looking into in the same area, I feel more and more like Kimpton cares more about being competitive with the other complexes nearby by slapping on new coats of paint, some vinyl flooring, and new cabinets for new tenants rather than considering the current residents and their quality of life while living here.

This apartment complex is undergoing renovations after being purchased by an investor that only buys “undervalued apartment complexes” - which just means they want to buy older apartments, do minor upgrades, then jack up the rent. The new management company shows blatant disregard for current residents. From frequent, day long water shut offs with no notice to contractors breaking personal belongings while painting to being forced to not park in our paid for reserved spots for periods of time; there have been no shortages of headaches. Thus far, all renovations have been purely cosmetic. Once the exterior painting was complete, I witnessed the painters dumping leftover paint into the storm drain that leads directly to the bayou. Pipes frequently leak, leading to mildew and high utility bills. Appliances are constantly breaking and not being fixed properly. Apparently refilling the doggy bag stations is no longer within budget. Half of the residents aren’t even able to receive mail at our address due to the mailboxes being broken for months. All of these issues have been brought up to management, each time met with the same boilerplate response of how much we will love the complex once the renovations are done. However, we will be leaving the moment our lease is up

Complex is dirty, amenities are old/broken, water gets shut off monthly without notice, mailbox is broken so you have to go to the post office, less free parking now, no security cameras or staff, front office does not follow up on issues/requests.

It's convenient if you work at the Medical Center but that's about it. A section of mailboxes (> 100 apartment units) has been broken for 3 MONTHS! Residents have to go to the post office to get the mail.

BE AWARE! My apartment and one of the neighbor’s apartment got broken into! Informed the corporate office and yet to hear back anything from them. Asked to inform the Kirby place residents about the break in so, everyone stays vigilant, no communication has been sent out! The concern for safety of residents is poor

I visited this property in the interest of renting here. Stay away unless you just have nowhere else to go. The property felt very unsafe. The gates were wide open. I was able to just drive in without issue. The local area feels unsafe as well, especially with it being right off hwy 6. Anyone can just walk onto the property. The broken glass in the parking lot showed that cars may have been broken into. Ignoring the safety issue, the pool was very small, as was the gym. For as expensive as this place is, especially with calling itself a "luxury" apartment, it should have a much better feel when you are there. It should also be secure.

I have been living here for over a year now. It has been amazing for me. Management has been very friendly and attentive. I have never experienced a problem with the gate being broken. I have seen them out there working on it , so I know when there is a problem they are quick to fix it. I would 10/10 recommend.

I’ve been living here for a year and 4 months and renewed my lease 4 months ago. I regret renewing my lease to the fullest. When I first moved here, when the apartment were under Allen Harrison, the leasing and management team were very professional and ethical at all times. The new management is very poor and unprofessional. The property manager threaten to call the police on me when I attempted to discuss a fee that was assessed to my account. The occupancy is very high, people are moving out left and right and it’s very much because of the management team. I’m dreading my move out date because I made a huge mistake. And I agree with every other review, 2 years ago, this was a great place to live, but it’s going right down the gutter. Yes the gates are always broken, peoples cars are getting broken into. Yes they do let anyone move out, people use to be so quiet and now new tenants are loud, wild and out of control! DO NOT MOVE HERE!!

Please dont move here.  
Maintenance was called to repair my refrigerator. On the online maintenance request form I explicitly did not give them permission to enter because I knew that I would be home and did not want anyone walking in on me.  The next day they arrived as I had just stepped out of the shower. They knocked and in less than a minute and before I could get decent, the maintenance guy entered my locked apartment. When I addressed this with him he got angry and said that he had hearing issues and that I could call management, which I did, but they were no more understanding saying that the maintenance guy was there to "help me" and that regardless of the fact that i did not give them permission to enter, that they had the right to do so. When I tried to explain further, management abruptly cut me off while speaking and asked in a hostile manner, "so what do you want me to do". When you pay as much for rent as they charge here, you expect better.
I normally dont write reviews like this, but given the situation I see no other way to address my complaint.

Moved in almost two years ago, loved it!  However when the new mgmt company took over, it went down hill fast!  Unresponsive, they couldn't care less about who moves in here or what the residents do.  Gates are constantly broken, leading to car burglaries and stolen tires.  Residents openly have gas and charcoal grills on balconies (fire hazard anyone).  Routine pest control no longer happens and the bugs are getting out of hand.  Don't even try parking unless you have a covered spot or garage.  Packages you may not realized were being delivered sit in the office and they refuse to notify you, say "not their responsibility".  Old mgmt company would call or send a text message (automated service) to let you know.  This place had real potential.  Thank God my lease is up in two weeks!!!!!

Best experience so far the whole leasing procedure was a breeze made sure our needs were met and made my boyfriend and I as comfortable as possible every question was answered no matter how many we asked.
I just want to thank the office and maintenance team for always being so helpful. I’ve lived at this property for 3 years now and I truly enjoy it.

This apartment complex was a great place to live! I was very pleased with how responsive the leasing office was. They made sure to resolve any issues and get back to you as soon as possible. Maintenance was quick to tend to any requests. They were also very communicative about anything tenants should know about, such as exterior painting, recarpeting, etc. Additionally, the location of Yale @ 6 was excellent! Would definitely live here again if I was moving back to the area!

BEWARE and definitely take time to read these reviews! I, along with my spouse, were residents here for 3 yrs and for the most part enjoyed our stay. 

A few things to consider:
1. The walls are definitely thin. You hear every door close from surrounding neighbors, children running through the hallways, dogs barking on balconies from owners who obviously forgot they let them out there. 
2. The security of the building is what sold us, however, be sure to have multiple ways to enter the building (an extra fob and/or the keypad connected to your phone for access; because the fob will not work at the most inconvenient times. 
3. The pool was divine during the weekdays when very few people were out there, but the weekends were quite the opposite. It was obvious the “2 guest limit” was not being adhered to.

5. Location is GREAT, but it comes at a steep price!

The move out was what landed this property a 1-star review. 

I was being relocated for work and my company paid a HEFTY fee (upwards of $5k) to terminate our lease early, along with all other fees associated with moving. We even paid for a professional cleaning service to clean the unit. All was well UNTIL we were being charged for damage to the shower in the unit…..$2k worth of damage! Two adults with no pets or children. You have got to be kidding! I guess since all the money was paid promptly for all the move out fees, they figured why not keep this money train rolling. They reported it on my credit, which I take VERY seriously, and with every dispute refuses to withdraw this erroneous charge. 

A mature, professional couple with no pets, no children, that paid in full and on time rent during the entire pandemic, that are not only GREAT tenants, but good hardworking and kind people that follow rules, protects our own peace as well as our neighbors, and certainly does not damage property. 

What a shame.

Have really liked staying in the Yale @ 6th complex. We live in a spacious 2 bedroom/2 bath apartment. I love the location, there's a nice running/walking trail behind us. Postinos, restaurants, coffee shops, and all good things in walkable distance. The management, maintenance services have also been really helpful in answering questions and fixing things. 

Really happy with my stay so far!

Do NOT move here. They do not care about their tenants safety or property at all and only want your money. A person was assaulted in our garage and they did NOTHING to increase the safety. Every month someone's car is being broken into/damaged/or their tires are stolen from them. Management has done NOTHING to increase security. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT MOVE HERE. You will regret it.

We have had such a great experience living at Yale @6th. The front office staff are so tremendously kind, including the maintenance crew who is always so quick and professional in responding to service requests. Waiting for an elevator in the parking garage is disgusting. Applying a month before move in. They took no action on the application, calling them daily after two weeks and still no response. They keep saying their working on it, but their website said it took 1 to 3 days. They're obviously just scamming people for the application fee and not working on it

The staff at Country Club Apartments are always mature and professional when it comes to anything you need to bring to office. Whether it be questions about work orders or just simple questions about interior of their units; they staff here at this apartment complex makes their customers confident because of how they handle contracts, work orders, property care and etc. If you not looking for confusion and love clean areas, check these apartments out.

If I could give one piece of advice it would be to STAY AWAY FROM THIS APARTMENT COMPLEX. They are the worst complex to deal with, from rodents, electrical problems, mold, the front office staff are sometimes unpleasant to deal with it’s just not worth locking yourself in a lease

I really living here. The front office is very nice and clean and they are always willing to help. Apartments are in good shape and the maintenance people do the best they can.  Also like the green turf area for my kids to play.

I’ve never written a negative review about any company but this is one of the worst. You can’t break your lease in anyway. You can’t email the letter it has to be hand delivered by you, even though they only communicate with you by email, and they don’t understand any circumstances. This was one of the worst apartments. I don’t recommend moving in here. My AC was broke twice and had to remind them. There are no screens on the window which is a safety hazard.
