Bellaterra is very quiet and does not have roving groups of kids running around messing with things and making noise.  I have not had a single incident with a neighbor or troublesome kid.  I have a motorcycle with saddle bags and sometimes forget to take everything out of them after a ride.  I have yet to have anything come up missing.  

Bellaterra is located directly behind Academy and is walking distance to sit down and fast food restaurants, shopping, the mall, medical and hospitals.  You can almost live your whole life here and not need a car.  (Well, maybe not in the summer.  That would be nuts.  I did say almost.)

If you want a quiet, well-maintained apartment with a great office and maintenance staff, lots of activities and close to everything, Bellaterra is an excellent choice.

Gene S.

Glad I moved here. I moved in during the management change - literally. I viewed the model apartment with one person that didn't leave me with a good impression, but came back and viewed an available unit with someone else who did a great job! I started paperwork that night. The size of the apartment is perfect for me and my little one, the rate is the best north of Downtown (that I would feel safe at), and there's not much going on to make me feel unsafe. I had a maintenance emergency once - my air went out - it was resolved in less than 30 minutes. Management seems to try to keep the feel of the apartments "community" like, and are always friendly enough. The buildings could use a paint job...maybe a different color, or even just refreshing the current color. The stairwells near the 3rd floor seem neglected sometimes. They have spider webs and could use some pressure washing. Other than that I have no complaints. I do my part - they do theirs. I'll be renewing...
BellaTerra at Deerbrook has the potential to be a great place to live. unfortunately due to poor management, poor communication, and Lazy Employees it is simply an average Apartment community.
THE APARTMENT IS A 2 BEDROOM AND 2 BATH. THE CLOSETS A LARGER THAN MOST APARTMENTS. THERE IS A LITTLE OVER 1300 SQUARE FEET. WE HAVE TWO COVERED PARKING SPOTS.
The managment is great and we get along with our neighbors. We love it here.

When you walk into my kitchen you forget you are in an apartment, the windows give this country feel. The wood floor up to the wooden cabinets just make me feel so warm. My favorite memory of my kitchen was Christmas morning when family came over and helped me cook. They still couldn't believe we were in an apartment. I love this place.
Nice size. But not like the type peop!e that live here
Going onto my second lease, I love the leasing team, they always take care of any issues and send their maintenance team right away.

Fundamentally the Voyager at Space Center units are pretty good in terms of layout and interior quality.  They aren't luxury apartments though, any more than a restaurant that tags its sign with 'fine dining' is actually fine dining.  There are a lot of broader building challenges - the walls and especially ceilings are thin, noise can be a huge problem depending on your neighbors.  Pet waste in the halls is an issue.  Elevators are the reason I moved in originally, and it turns out those can be down for months at a time - the building layout can be real horrible when they're down if you're not by a stairwell.  There have been a litany of property management companies come through so paperwork gets lost, rules are intermittently enforced, and new fees appear at random.  They'll charge you ~$125 for cleaning and repair when moving out, pretty much guaranteed (I went out of my way to do it myself, didn't matter).

Horrible management and company. Auto drafted what the system told me to auto draft and received an eviction notice as the amount was not correct giving me 3 days to leave . What company treats tenants that way. All they needed to do is call me and tell me that the auto draft was not correct and did not include other charges. They clearly do not care about tenants and retaining customers. If you want to be treated like this come to the voyager at  space center.

This apartment is under new management.  Since taking over they have increased rents, increased monthly fees and stopped all grounds maitenance.  If you don't trust me tour their grounds, especially the reflection pond area, total disaster, before signing a contract.  Also, read your contract very carefully, they will use every word in it to collect more money from you, even when you try to leave.  This place has a nice exterier, but don't be fooled, you will regret it...

Poor and unresponsive management. I definitely do not intend to resign my lease. They keep raising the rent and adding extra fees but can’t offer any explanation as to what these fees are going to. Gym equipment is falling apart, break-ins are frequent, security is lacking.

EXPPM jacked up rent $350 when they bought in January and have only made things worse. The 741 sqft floorplans have gone up $70 in the past two months. On the first month of ownership, they posted utilities on the 13th of the month, and then tried to charge everyone late fees, going so far as to post notes with a handwritten "2nd notice" warning on the same day. I don't know a single resident who is planning to re-sign. Just had a break-in last month, and they listed the unit almost immediately on here. Scummy company, please look elsewhere.

I had a very disappointing experience at this apartment complex. While the apartment itself is nice, the overall management and communication are severely lacking. The front desk staff is difficult to reach, you can never get them to answer the phone and the property manager is rarely available or responsive to emails. Additionally, there are confusing and inconvenient rules, and parking is inadequate.

I initially moved in at a great rate and renewed my lease a year later. However, when I attempted to renew again, I was unexpectedly asked for proof of income. They claimed the apartment had always been income-based, but this was never mentioned during the original leasing process, nor was it stated in the lease agreement. After being directed to contact the property manager, I attempted to reach them for several days, but they were unavailable, as they also manage another property. I didn’t receive a response until two weeks later, by which time I had already found a new place to live.

In summary, while the apartment itself is satisfactory, the poor communication and unprofessional management make it difficult to recommend this complex. The prices simply aren’t justified given the lack of support and transparency from staff.

1. Roaches everywhere. They say you brought them.
If you detest them, like I do, AVOID this place. 
2. Crime. At least 10 vehicles were broken into in 2 days recently (October 2019) 
One of the gates was not working the day of the incident  Unsafe!! 
3. NOISE.
If your apartment is on Katy Ranch Rd, garbage trucks come 4 to 5 a.m. and empty the trash bins of the stores across the street. They SLAM down very, very loudly. It WILL wake you and your children.
4. Cheap appliances.
They admitted this to us AFTER we moved in. The washer, microwave, refrigerator and dishwasher all broke within weeks.
5. Thin walls. 
I literally can hear my neighbors snore, shower and talk.
6. Dog poop everywhere. 
Only a handful of people actually use the so-called "dog park". Mostly, tenants just let their dogs run around and relieve themselves around their apartment. If you step on the grass you WILL walk in it.
7. No parking. 
Unless you have a garage, good luck.
8. No trash pickup.
But they will still charge you each month. You can see the huge pile of trash at the back of the complex. During the day you can also smell that! Disgusting!

Recently they run a “Good reviews contest” to encourage people write 5 stars reviews but don’t let them cheat you. Read the Google reviews and you can find the truth. 

AVOID THIS PLACE LIKE THE PLAGUE.
very fast service! was happy to see the issue was fixed before I even got home!  upset such a mess was left in the repair's wake.

Noisy environment, loud cars and motorcycles on road between complexes.  Standing water on exit and on some sidewalks.  Frequent  appliance failure, my dyer has failed at least 3 times this year, disposal fails once or twice a year even with preventive care,.  Trash collectors more reliable now,  the rules are difficult for a person who works for til 7pm.
Eulysses did an outstanding job.........  In fact, you are the only property that has stayed in touch with me.  I have not decided on a place yet
Eulysses did an outstanding job......... In fact, you are the only property that has stayed in touch with me. I have not decided on a place yet

BEWARE!!! The Jaxon has faulty gates on the parking deck that damage vehicles, and they will not pay for the damage or even give you their insurance info to file a report. On the afternoon of June 6th, our daughter was visiting a friend at the Jaxon and leaving the parking deck. She was not tailgating and the gate was just open as she drove down the ramp and neared it. As she drove through, the gate randomly closed on her truck damaging the right side from the front fender all the way down to the rear bumper. The gate did not appear to have any operational safety devices telling it not to close when a vehicle was in the opening or to bounce back if it hit something ... thank God she was not walking through and crushed. The estimate on the truck damage is over $6500 !!! When she spoke to the manager on duty, he admitted that he saw it happen and that it has been happening every week to different people. It was such a problem, that the second gate had been taken out of service to be repaired ... so this is admitted to be on ongoing problem yet they refuse to take responsibility, and even refused to give us their insurance information so we can file a claim. So we are left with a bill for over $6500 to fix the damage when they knew they had a faulty gate that repeatedly damages vehicles !!! BEWARE and avoid renting from this complex or you could be next.

Huge turnover of staff when I lived here last year, some were helpful, some were just rude, I got charged a fee for a service that was not in my written lease, and after bringing it up with the staff they said that it should have been in my lease, so I needed to pay it anyways. 

The trash chute area was constantly disgusting and trash was anywhere but in the chute, and I had water dripping from my ceiling one day (I wasn’t even on the top floor), and by the time maintenance came the next day, they said since it had stopped they weren’t worried about it.

Don’t do it. We are so disappointed and can’t wait for this lease to be over. I am at a hotel right now with my family because our ac has went out multiple times. Then, on yesterday, nobody would even give us a call back. The parking gates have been broke since February. We spent too much money buying parking passes to not have anyone security or even a place to park. The grounds are nasty. Several residents have experienced theft and break ins.

Break ins in the gated parking garage and break ins into peoples apartments which are hard to get to. (All front doors are inside) 
Trash bags being left in hallways. Dog poop and pee in the hallways. EXTREMELY rude managers with no care for their residents. No help during the whole pandemic. They did whole kitchen/restroom renovations back in December 2019. Paint/epoxy and strange men around walking in and out of our apartments while we had a 11 month old and newborn. Glass, screws and nails were left on our floors for my infant to put in her mouth. We’ve had a mold issue for months now. Their solution is to just paint over it. And over it. And over it. These apartments were great until the new management came in. This place is trash now. Wouldn’t recommend to anyone.

Due to my minor physical limitations and complete isolation due to illness at the time my house sold, Kelesia made the downsizing process as smooth as possible.  In fact, every member of the leasing team seems to have been thoroughly vetted and selected for their dedication to customer service. All three appear to genuinely want to know the property's residents and support the community in any way they can, to the very best of their abilities.
 
The finishes in the renovated apartments are thoughtful and attractive (e.g., special tiles in the shower prevent slipping and falling). The only time I've requested maintenance, staff were knocking on my door within the hour and quickly solved multiple plumbing issues quietly and respectfully since I was on a video conference. 

The location of The Jaxon can't be beat. Kingwood's Restaurant Row is within walking distance, as are the many shops between The Jaxon and the restaurants.  The property is on West Lake Houston Pkwy, which provides easy access to FM-1960, Kingwood Drive, Beltway 8 and I-59.
The amenities have been updated and the top floor of the garage is being repurposed into a common area for the community.  The parking garage is secure. A reserved space is available for a small monthly fee. Valet trash service is offered Monday through Thursday and Sunday evenings. The washer at The Jaxon has the largest capacity I’ve ever seen. Although you can expect some increase in noise when moving from a house to an apartment, The Jaxon is surprisingly very quiet. In addition, the porch or balcony is spacious enough for a full outdoor configuration with loveseat, table and chair. 

All in all, if you want to enjoy the look and feel of an upscale property and all it has to offer, and a ready smile and genuine warmth every time you encounter a member of the leasing team, look no further than The Jaxon. The property strives for true excellence on every level, the customer service is unparalleled, and the overall value is hard to beat.
Amazing place to live, great location with all the luxuries anyone could ask for!

If you love paying money to be woken up at 8am this place has your back they will leaf blow outside your window for hours. very inconsiderate. after asking management they lie to you saying they will move up the times and continue. So if you have kids, or hold business meeting from home, or work nights this place will make sure doing these is very difficult for you worst place.

I loved my apartment but the property staff made living there a complete nightmare. They messed up my rent at one point, admitted it was their fault, then threatened to evict me when I questioned why I was being charged late fees. They don't respond promptly to maintenance requests, like the time my fire alarm started going off at 5 pm and they wanted to wait and fix it the next day, and are generally rude and unconcerned with you unless they need your rent payment. Overall I wouldn't recommend living at Harbor Cove.

I SAID YES TO THE ADDRESS because I was looking for a place to call home and Harbor cove has done more than enough to make me feel nothing short of home! I am very proud to say that I have found a complex that is well kept, the staff is amazing helpful and efficient from the moment I called asking about their facility. If you are looking for a clean, updated, welcoming and friendly community, HARBOR COVE IS THE HOME FOR YOU!

I honestly have nothing but amazing things to say about Harbor Cove. My roommate and I have lived here for a year and a half and we have had little to no issues. The maintenance is always here when we need them whether it is a glass in our disposal or a squirrel in our air ducks. Management is so delightful and alway ready to help no matter what. We are in building nine which is backed up against the woods it's beautiful and so peaceful we get to sleep with no interruptions. Valet trash is a god send. There are no other apartments in this area for the price location  and with valet trash it's a huge plus. We get our occasional raccoon friend but they are so cute you can't help but ignore when they tear up your trash. The two bed two bath we have is huge. Arched walk way nice and open floor plan. Different options to choose from such as concert carpet and wood flooring. Washer and dryer in every unit. I LOVE IT HERE  My roommate and I will be going separate ways in January and It's hard to find somewhere as good as here.. I will most likely sign again.

I lived here for four years . The complex has more of a friendly neighborhood feeling than most places I looked at. The location within Katy is excellent; it’s close enough to get to things very quickly, but is on a quiet street. 

The few times that I had maintenance issues were dealt with immediately, and the office staff were unfailingly pleasant and helpful.

I moved to the other side of Houston, otherwise I would still be living here.

I hate living in apartments first off.  But this place is the only apartment I can say I’ve lived at that I enjoyed.  People are friendly, both the staff and the tenants.  It’s quiet since you don’t share walls.  Highly recommended to anyone.

This complex is the most money hungry complex I have ever lived at. Been here for around 6 months, and how they do business makes no sense. First, there is a trash fee. When I asked why there is a trash fee, I was told "because we have dumpsters". What complex doesn't have dumpsters, any place I have ever lived, if there is a trash fee someone is usually coming by to pick it up. Then you have the double water bill, I still don't understand this. The explanation I received was more confusing than the charges themselves. There is also a processing fee for your rent, and if you pay online, there is an online payment surcharge added as well. Plus you have to have the rent in by the 2nd of each month. Again, another first for me as it has always been on the 3rd at any other complex or house I've rented. Had to learn that one the hard way when they charged me a $75 late fee for paying on the 3rd. Then you have parking...There is none! They have open parking which means anybody can park anywhere (including visitors) and stay parked pretty much as long as they want. Residents have no guaranteed parking!!! But, for some reason they give you a useless parking permit that means nothing. When I questioned the office about this, I was told " You can park in the neighborhood next to complex". I have a 4 yr old little girl, do you understand how inconvenient that would be! Which forces you to buy a covered parking spot, or sit in the parking lot for however long until someone moves. Then someone had the genius idea of blocking all the unused covered parking with concrete blocks so no one could park in them, again alienating the actual residence who out of desperation for a place to park occasionally park in the unused spots. I said all that to say this place is terrible, and I didn't even touch the issues with my actual apartment itself. So, I will not be renewing my lease and I can't wait to get out of there.

Living at Cimarron Pkwy Apts. has been good, safe, and quiet. People have pets, but they haven't been a problem to me. There are occasions where cars will drive through the neighborhood with loud music, but that only happens on the weekend. The dumpsters are in the very back of the complex... mere inconvenience. I like the safety and convenience of not being directly on high-traffic Mason and having the stop light at the end of the street. I-10 is a few stoplights down the road. Unit size for the price is great! My biggest issues, though, are verryyy thin walls and the parking (yes, you can hear doors closing like a previous review mentioned). Apt. staff is great and personable, landscaping and maintenance do a great job in a timely manner, and everyone seems to mind their business. To my understanding, though, the water bill is split up among all of us even if I use much less water by myself than the unit near me with three residents? Fireplace and mantel, black GE appliances, and overhead microwave included in premium building. Spacious units for the price, would recommend.

I like the apartment for the most part. Nice and quite atmosphere during the day. You can hear people above you making noise when they walk. My issue was at the beginning when I was finding out about little things that needed to be done to have my pets after they were already at the apartments. It is hard to get pet shot records when your starting a new job and have to have another person take your pets in. The site just needs more information about the procedure for moving in and all the things you are going to have to pay for.

My husband and I have been living in Cimarron for 7 months now with our infant baby. It's HORRIBLE living on the 3rd floor during the summer! It's been times where it was soo hot to the point where we would go spend nights at my in-laws house. Of course my husband or I would go to the office and they would come in short time knowing that we have an infant. But... the ac would constantly stop working and I'm fed up. There has been sleepless hot nights and I can't wait until the lease is up! If you are planning on staying here at Cimarron, I would NOT recommend staying on the 3rd floor!
Our apt is infested with roaches. We have been complaining for months. No solution is working.
This apartment community is infested with roaches. Trust me, you will not be happy. Management does nothing to remedy the problem. I have complained for months.
They're so busy taking care of these empty apt,that they don't take care of the people who actually lives here paying rent.many broken promises.i'm going to be nice and don't say the word...lies.

I toured this property and unfortunately they did not have what i wanted but i met Dallas and Desiree and they were both very helpful. I also met some of the maintenance guys outside and they introduced themselves. I look forward to moving there soon
I've lived at Mallard Creek Apts for about 3 months now and I love it!
I have really enjoyed my stay here for the last 3 years. The trees and landscaping are so beautiful and I love the new paint colors going up. I plan on staying here for many more years to come!!!
Nottingham recently renovated their apartments. Their staff, especially the maintence team, is great. This is a beautiful place to live at a very reasonable price.

My family moved in and we love it. The maintenance staff is great and we love the pool. I like that the complex is tucked away making it feel like a neighborhood. The rooms are big and the area is really nice.

They get ZERO stars. Signed a lease from another state and moved in August 2023 and less than a month later the roaches started. From the tubs, toilets and sinks. Management was made aware and waited an additional 2 weeks before getting a pesticide company to evaluate and spray. The roaches continued and I asked to terminate my lease due to inhumane living conditions and was told I would be charged 25% of the lease, plus had to give 2 months notice, plus lose my deposit. I will be taking them to court because I was forced to break my lease due to the roaches and this is disgusting. The maintenance guy told me himself before roaches it was mice in the complex.
Some people broke the gate and I found my car on blocks and management didn’t provide video footage to police stating “it was tooo much to go back annd search through the footage”…$9000 later and a $500 deductible I got my car back.
Either way BE AWARE. Do NOT rent here unless you don’t mind wasting time and money and cohabiting with roaches!!!

Javier is the best maintenance person I've ever met. He works extremely hard at his job. He's always there when you need him. He never complains and he always smiles and greets you like he is your best friend. You can always count on him to assist you. 
Julian is the best groundskeeper ever. He always does an amazing job without complaining and always with a smile. He works very hard no matter what is asked of him. Nottingham Place appartments have the very best staff. You can count on them for everything! I would give them more than 5 stars if I could!

This one is for the office staff. Wanda, Lisa, and Billy are very helpful in assisting my inquiries. If I've ever had any questions or concerns, they've always met my needs with patience and understanding. I look forward to continue doing business with them in the future.

You don’t want to waste your time checking out this place. Nottingham Place truly sucks it’s simply gross. There is no up keeping  I could almost swear ever since they built the place  nothing has been replaced.  Basically it’s in a deplorable condition. I would never ever come back. Air conditioning stopped working in the fitness room talked  to the management when the air conditioning would be replaced or fixed she tells me it  is too expensive and may take a month. Total disappointment.  And staff completely lacking personality.your requests to the management are simply ignored

We've lived here about 3 years and, in general, really enjoy it. It's a nice, quiet life in pleasant surroundings with nice apartments and good maintenance.

Apparently, though, the landlord signed an exclusive agreement with AT&T to provide internet and cable service. AT&T compensates the landlord for this right. So if you move here, you have no alternative to AT&T, and boy, do they know it. And although we continually decrease our cable/internet services, our price is up by about 50%.

Both AT&T and Comcast are both thieves, but it is a terrible feeling to have no alternative to the service provider chosen by The Man.

I've lived here for over four years (but not for long) and have a lot of friends here.   The rent has gotten over priced for the quality and age (20 years old) of the apartment buildings and units and the current market trends.  The rent goes up every year (no matter what) and there is NO loyalty or consideration for being a quiet, good tenant who pays their rent on time either.  The units have the original cheap white cabinets and vanities and they are falling apart all the time... the management & owners keep having the maintenance men keep cobbling up the cabinets in order to keep getting by with them, rather than replace them (Cheap Owners).  Don't be fooled by the photos either all of the countertops (kitchen & Bathroom) are old warn out Formica that have been painted with an acrylic paint to give the appearance of granite (not even close).

The manager is purposely shielded by his staff, so getting a chance to talk with him is near impossible.  There is a big turnover in the staff for obvious reasons.   I have friends who live in the Clubhouse building (same building as leasing office)... what ever you do, don't let them talk you into leasing an apartment there, because the hallway carpets (especially on 2nd & 3rd floors) are just plan NASTY & FILTHY (check them out) and most of the time there is a bad odor throughout the hallways.  Kids (and adults) run up and down the echoing enclosed stairwells (all four) making loud noises and banging & clanging the metal handrails.  The Garbage chute closets are smelly and filthy and are NEVER NEVER cleaned or sanitized by housekeeping.    

The worst part is that management doesn't want input from their tenants period!!!  There are NO periodic survey sheets given to Tenants asking how are we doing?  Do you have any questions? Do you have any suggestion?  or are there any areas of concern and/or ideas of where we can improve?   You can't talk to the Owners or Manager in person.  There are no suggestion boxes to place suggestions and ideas.  There is NO email addres to send suggestions, concerns and/or complaints as an alternative option (management does NOT allow you to even email a staff member).  Management truly just doesn't care about the Tenants experiences at Nottingham Place or any suggestions that you might have for improvment, they are only friendly, nice and helpful upfront before you sign the lease and after that a whole different ball game, after that you're just an inconvenience, pure and simple.

Lucas is great, every other person there is new and clueless. The turn over rate in this office is ridiculous. Nothing is consistent. Leasing consultant that got us into our apartment told us one thing, now it's completely different. When we moved in, we had to have our water heater serviced 3 times before it was replaced. Then the dishwasher. Then a roof leak that damaged the smoke detector...we didn't have a smoke detector for almost 2 months after that... Neighbors doors getting busted down by police to pets using the bathroom on the patio above us and bleach water ruining our property below. SO many problems and they don't care because they already have your money. Beware.

This is really 4.5 stars. Cowgirl, "Sochi", was ultra helpful before, during, and after my move. 
The APT itself is small but very clean. The hardwood and carpets were new for me; I get plenty of light. The stove and microwave are new and brand name. My only concern is the air quality. Smoking is verboten but someone smokes over my porch; and the main building had a definite smell of mold in the air. I don't go to that part of the gym because of it. 
It's a great apartment complex and I'm glad to be here.

I've been a resident here at Nottingham for over 6 years now. I can honestly say this is the first apartment complex I've ever lived in. With that being said my experience here has been absolutely amazing. I moved from Michigan in hopes of purchasing a home but as you can tell I'm still here lol. The grounds are well kept and the amenities are awesome there is a 3,000 sqft gym here with personal trainer. I would definitely recommend this complex to someone else.

We actually just applied to lease an apartment here and the office staff was amazing!!! They were such a big help and made we sure we had everything we needed BEFORE we went to the office.
I cannot wait to find out tomorrow if we are accepted! :) I would definitely recommend this complex to ANYONE!!
Would love to live here! Very clean,safe,and in a great location .

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: When I moved into my new apartment, I had to wait for the keys to be made and Kenwood hired cleaning people to clean the apartment the day I moved into it. I wasted a half day waiting until 3:00 p.m. to move all of my furniture. If I move into a new place then the morning the apartment opens is when i should receive my keys and the apartment already cleaned prior to move in date. Also, the first day I moved in I got my package stolen. If an apartment has to use a third party like Fetch to ensure your packages are delivered to your apartment then it’s obvious there is a stealing problem.

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: Realmente es un lugar acogedor, sus áreas verdes tienen un buen mantenimiento, se informa de cualquier eventualidad en el complejo, las solicitudes de servicio y reparación responden y solucionan en el momento indicado. Lo recomiendo

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: Lived here 2 years customer service was exceptional. Peaceful and quiet environment. Very spacious.

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: We're seeking for a decent, peaceful apartment for our family. The Kenwood employees were really helpful and treated me with the greatest professionalism. Kenyetta was very personable and courteous. She obviously enjoys her work. Thanks once more

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: This apartment tenant device is extremely bad. A lot of hidden fee is added with the shown rent including pest control, package delivery and so on but any service is hardly provided. My package from Amazon get lost after it said it was delivered. I have made a request for pest control at May 3. A guy came in May 9 and said pest controller will come in May 16 and I need to pack all my kitchen stuffs and leave apartment for 4 hours I did as per they said and when I called next day for asking why they didn’t put any chemicals they didn’t have any solid reason. They just made excused saying we will do next Tuesday. That is so unprofessional. And the security here is rarely weak as any person can enter as the front gate is always open.

apartmentName: Kenwood Club at the Park Apartments
review: Be very careful with this property. They seem to just want to take your application money and run. We were charged $260. We were never called back, we had to keep calling them and asking what's going on. And even after we got something back from them, we still couldn't get an explanation with no return calls. Avoid this place unless you want to lose your application money which is ridiculous nowadays what they charge you.

Manager of the site is ver unrespectful and way too far to provide the minimum service required for maintenance request.
She said my urgency is not her urgency on resolving my maintenance request, always put excuses up front even told my wife she should not even step in the complex as she is not in the contract even Manager / Office employees know who she is.
Maintenace directed by the Manager close my requests without taking any action.
Place is peace and good to live but when the Maintenance issues are reported, the way the site Manager handle them is not customer oriented totally poor service.
So peaceful and nice to live and play. Living here for 3 years.

My family has lived in these apartments since Feb. of 2015. The apartments are really nice and spacious. The apartment office is friendly and things are fixed on time. My only complaint would be there is a lack of residential activities for us to enjoy as well as a playground for kids. There's a dog park but no park for kids?

BEWARE!! My daughter lived at the Landings for 7 miserable months. During that time, her car was broken into, they towed her car twice (the first time, her visitors tag expired for 2 hours - they would not allow her to add a third car, then we have an email from the regional manager reporting that a third car was added and her car was towed the next day again), my daughter developed health issues after the building next to hers burned down and then wasn’t demolished for 5 months, a security guard blocked them into their space and proceeded to scream at them, and they fixed a window by screwing it shut, reporting the job had been completed and then when confronted with legal breaking of the lease, reported the part had been ordered. The staff was not helpful in any situation. I do not recommend living here for any reason. I am extremely thankful we are finished with them. Follow-up Communication Issues

Difficulties Reaching Staff & Missed Appointment

To add to the communication issues, I even emailed once and received a response of "Oh, you did? I didn't see that." Additionally, I showed up for a scheduled appointment and was met with confusion, as if I hadn't booked one.
This frustration continued when I recently applied online and couldn't decide on a unit. Despite scheduling a confirmed appointment for 12:30 pm, the manager prioritized a meeting upon my arrival.
Unprepared and Unhelpful Staff
Disappointingly, the manager offered no apology for the wait and claimed the leasing agent wouldn't be back for an hour. Despite my numerous visits (they recognized me), they had "nothing new to show" and were unsure if a specific unit I requested was available. They even seemed unsure about the layout of different units. This lack of knowledge and unwillingness to help left me feeling like an unwelcome burden.
Broken Promises: "Live It" Mantra Not Reflected
The entire experience contradicted Hawthorne at Crenshaw's advertised "Live It" mantra, which supposedly emphasizes exceeding expectations, creating unforgettable experiences, and fostering kindness. Unfortunately, none of those values were reflected in my interactions.
Lost Interest and Uncertainty
As a result of these repeated issues, my initial enthusiasm has completely vanished.  The constant communication breakdowns and feeling unwelcome make me hesitant to move forward with my application.
This review highlights the significant gap between Hawthorne at Crenshaw's advertised image and the reality of their customer service.

I called the office and plead for any kind of relief on this fee. None was given. Instead I am dryly quoted company policies and practices.

There are many more details to share about this but I realize that I am merely screaming into the void. At the very least I've gained a bit of catharsis of sort by penning the feelings pent up throughout this ordeal.

When I call the office, no one seems to know what to do or how to help; their default response is often, "I will have someone else call you back," leaving me feeling stuck and unheard.
Most concerning of all, after I renewed my lease, I was hit with an incorrect charge—my monthly payment essentially doubled. I have been waiting days for my concern to even be acknowledged, let alone addressed. No one seems to have the time to take ownership of the situation, yet I am being penalized with fees due to their inability to resolve problems promptly.
If you are considering moving to here, I urge you to be cautious. The luxurious facade does not align with the quality of treatment you will receive from the staff or the management. What should have been an enjoyable living experience has instead turned into a series of frustrations

My daughter lives on the 6th floor and it's been over 80 degrees in her apartment for over a week, and this is not the first time this has happened this summer.  I have tried to call and email Memorial Towers and Barvin (MGMT Company) with no response.  A notice was sent out to all residents on Monday (Aug 14th) that they are just 'waiting on parts' to fix the chillers but apparently this is the go-to response they give residents every time the AC Units break and they have been saying this for years.

During our tour back in January 2023 the front office guide told us not to worry, that the pool and gym would fixed before summer.  Crucial element when apartment hunting in Texas due to the heat is a pool.  She said they were offering residents free memberships to the 'Houston Gym' while the apartment gym and pool were being renovated (note this gym is very small and has no pool).  3 months after she moved in a notice was sent to all residents that the gym and pool would be closed permanently, never to be fixed or opened again.  2 major amenities that residents pay for monthly. For what you pay to live at this place that's unacceptable.  Then the appliances started breaking, roaches started appearing and the blinds are always breaking apart (old school vertical blinds from the 70's).  DO NOT SIGN A LEASE HERE unless you want to live somewhere with no pool, no gym, no working AC!  Look elsewhere.

This building is old. Its no surprise that things are breaking. But even older buildings in Houston still have working amenities. The Memorial Towers has very nice staff, but that's about it... Since moving in the list of problems hasn't stopped growing. My two major complaints about living here are the Air Conditioning and the Roaches. 

Air Conditioning in Houston is pretty important, but don't expect much of that if you decide to live here. Also, if you want to live here i would suggest investing in a dehumidifier. Without the 2 I have constantly running, it would never get below 65% humidity and i would certainly see mold starting to grow. 

Roaches could be an easy fix too but somehow the problem never goes away. It's very common to see one or two roaches crawling throughout the lobby and on the stairs or elevator. It's almost impossible to miss the ones near any trashcan or chute. I have done a pretty good job of protecting my unit, but it is unfortunate that i will always have to worry about them since the underlying source of the problem is not addressed. 

Seriously, think twice before signing a lease here.

It started out well. Jerry and David were very nice and helpful throughout the whole move in process. The location is awesome. I was happy. I signed a year lease. I finally had a place to live. The happiness didn’t last long.

The first night in there, the smell was horrid. I thought the place just needed to be aired out because it had been vacant for awhile. I did my best to ignore the smell and continued to move my stuff in. The smell never went away. It only got worse.

After a week, I was becoming ill. Headaches. Itchy, burning eyes. Skin itched. It was hard to breathe. I could no longer get comfortable. The smell was off the charts!!! Worst smell I’ve ever encountered.

I reported the issue in writing to Jerry on 05/17/2018. I told him I suspect mold somewhere in the unit. I was then told, “to buy air fresheners and I’d be fine. The building is old.” It is old, and I had already tried that.

Not staisfied…

I did some investigating on my own and found massive amounts of mold, dirt, and other fungus growing inside the AC vents.

David finally came up to the apartment on 05/20/2018. I showed him the vent in the living room. Next day, 05/21/2018 they bleached the vents and said problem solved.

Still not satisfied…

Cleaning the vents won’t solve the issue. Sorry. It’s deeper than that. The carpet needs to be cleaned. The walls and counters need to be scrubbed, etc…etc… The AC unit itself obviously has issues. I’d also like to mention there is zero weather stripping around the door in the living room where the smell and vent were the worst. There is a steady flow of hot, humid air just flowing into the apartment 24/7.

This is also important. Jerry and David aren’t the ones to blame for this. The building really is old. I can’t thank them enough for letting me move there in the first place. They gave me a chance nobody else would. I was thrilled and happy. This is not intended to bash Jerry or David in anyway shape or form. They are both awesome people. They were, are just doing their job. That being said, they aren’t mold experts.

Let’s start with the fact that it’s a nice place to live . I mean if you don’t mind the pool being shut down by the city for health code, your car being broken into if you park on the side streets or having a washer be broken for over a month then move here . The apartment is outdated and you hear your neighbors pretty distinctly . The grounds are well kept and I have never had an issue with package theft . However, they will make sure to raise your rent upon renewal of rates go up and if it goes down they will tell you “you can move out of your apartment and into another one to get a cheaper rate . I’m not talking about 10 dollars the listed rent is 300 cheaper and they refuse to lower upon renewal . I did not enjoy my time at Midtown Arbor Place and would never live there again. For the price I paid, there were many issues. To start, the apartment walls / ceiling are incredibly thin. I could hear the person and/or dog above me walking around constantly. The apartment is old, and serviced very cheaply. The shower never got hot. During my time, I had to put in a few workorders for the same problem since the prior workorder didn’t fix it. I paid a pest control fee every month, yet there was still a constant flow of bugs in my apartment outside of Winter time. The garbage system is a mess and gross. You pay to have someone pick it up in a bin right outside your door, but this makes the hallway smell terrible some weeks. When I would come home from work late at night there were animals such as raccoon and opossum roaming the hallways picking at the trash. My packages were frequently stolen since packages are left in the parking garage. During move in and move out, management is unresponsive and unprofessional. I’d like to mention a positive of living here, but I can’t. I had a terrible experience at Midtown Arbor Place and would NEVER live here again.

I lived on the first floor for 2 and a half years. Parking was always available on the first floor and I never had to walk too far from my apartment. Most packages are kept in the Amazon hub located by the mailbox, although one time I had a package that contained sneakers delivered to my door and they were stolen. Maintenance responded quickly to my concerns. One time I had noticed a wasp nest growing outside on my patio. I put in a request and it was gone by the time I came home the next day. Another time I noticed my kitchen sink was leaking and I put in a request. They had fixed it by the next day when I came home from work. Another time on Thanksgiving I had to put in an emergency request because my key wouldn't turn in the lock and therefore I couldn't lock the door. Within 45 minutes someone had came and helped fix my lock. The location of this complex is great- not too close to the partying but close enough that you can walk there if you want to. The complex had events where you could grab free food and a bottle of wine, for example Christmas Dinner the week before Christmas, Thanksgiving dinner the week before Thanksgiving, free sweets on Valentine's Day. The staff were always very friendly and helpful and tried to get to know you. The appliances in my apartment were nice but could have been nicer I suppose. I had a bike stolen off of my patio once (that I did not have a padlock for). The area surrounding the complex is beautiful with trees and every visitor I have had will say something about it. Overall, I had a great experience here and am sad to leave.

We lived at Midtown Arbor Place for two years and very much enjoyed the experience. The staff is very friendly and helpful and maintenance requests are addressed quickly. The complex is well located within walking distance to nearby activities as well as the metro rail. The facilities were well maintained and the staff has frequent community events for residents. The parking structure is spacious and there is always room for resident parking with ample guest spaces left over.

There is occasional noise from nearby streets on weekend nights, but it was never terribly excessive. Sometimes it is difficult to have deliveries dropped off at the doorstep, especially in building five, because the building and apartment numbers can be hard to find and follow. But overall, everything that was within control of the staff was very well handled. 

We would recommend Midtown Arbor Place to anyone looking to live in the area.

You probably won't find cheaper for central Houston apartment rentals with swimming pool, fitness center and for its first-come first-served business meeting room, but you do get what you pay for. The on-site leasing office director is friendly and efficient but there is only himself and two young assistants who are stil learning how to be good customer-service professionals, and often only one person is present at the office at any one time. They're very hard to reach by phone, maintenance requests are delayed and you can't always pick up packages when it is convenient. At night, should there be a problem, yo are pretty much left to your own devices. There is security but they walk around talking on their cells phones and do not look as if they would be very efficient in an emergency situation. Security personnel are constantly changing too. Also, this is a VERY pet-friendly complex, so much so that dogs are not screened for behavioral issues, and you may well find yourself like me being kept up at night by a hysterical dog whose owner is absent. Complaints to the administration won't come to anything as  policy here is simply to keep as many tenants on the premises as possible, and if there aren't enough complaints, nothing will be done. This complex, because of its location, tends to draw many young people who are still very much in the "Let's make the most of our newly found legal drinking status", and weekends can feel like a university campus after a football game, especially by the pool which they take over.  Basically you're made to feel that this place is all about making money, and as long as it works, decent clients who know the difference in quality can suffer.

Would not recommend staying at CityPlace Montrose. Main issues below:

- Mold: There was mold in my unit and when discovered, management refused to remediate the issue. When I asked to be let out of my lease since they did not want to remediate the issue, they informed me that I would be responsible for the rent until the end of my lease.


- Management: Whenever there was an issue (key fob not working, locked out of the building on the coldest night of the year, mold in the unit, etc.) I would reach out to management through call/email with no response. They would call at random times, I would inform them that I am working and would appreciate if they could provide a response through email. When I would follow up, they could not recall any phone conversation. Also, I was charged upon move out for indents in the carpet due to furniture. Not a stained carpet but charged so the company could essentially vacuum a few times to remove dents in the carpet that are due to normal furniture placement after a year. I have never heard of that charge before so it seems to be a money grab.


- Infrastructure (not something that can be changed but an important note): the construction quality was poor. It sounded as if my upstairs neighbors were filming a Stomp The Yard sequel throughout the day, but it was due to the flooring, not practicing a new dance sequence. If you have a package delivered outside of working hours (11-5:30 M-F), you will need to meet with the delivery person outside since there is no way for them to enter the building, no dedicated package room, and management does not hold packages. I've had a few packages stolen unfortunately and the response was "ship the package somewhere else". 

Management was notified of these many issues and did nothing to remediate them which is the focus of my review. No place is perfect but customer service and ability to resolve issues is important. CityPlace Montrose failed in that aspect. I've lived in a variety of apartment complexes and residences across 4 states in the past decade and I can confirm that this was my worst experience by far.

Pros:
-Location: This location is in the center of everything yet safe. It's walking distance to a few things yet is not so convenient that non-residents wander into the lobby. 
-Space: Our apartment is lovely and well-maintained by the property. Every maintenance request has been taken care of promptly but we have never really had any major issues. 
-Residents: The other residents I think can make or break apartments and the people that live at Left Bank are on average, really great. 
-The pool and grills: Great space, spots of shade and sun, and chairs can usually be found. 

Neutral:
-The Back Property: When we signed, the back of Left Bank was honestly the reason we signed. Other places are nicer or cheaper or have a bigger gym but Left Bank had the walking trail. During a flood, part of the walking trail washed away and a fence has just been built that says dead end. We'd love to see the trail rebuilt in that area so that we can walk with our dog without having to cut through sand. We'd also love to see the back property more fully utilized with either small dog park or more developed seating areas by the pond. 
-The gym: There is one so... pro? It's tiny and poorly equipped so plan on a gym membership if that is important to you. 
-Online Systems: Everything is done in person including rent, apartment availability, and maintenance requests. It's not horrible but it also seems like an easy fix. Additionally, most notifications are made through a texting system which isn't reliable and the office does not consistently use it (closed early for weather posted on the office door).

Cons:
-Office Hours: The office hours are extremely limited so there is a mad dash at 5:25 pm to try and pick up packages before the office closes. It would be helpful if they would have later hours one day a week or even a different package pick-up door with a code. 
-Parking and Security: The gate is completely form over function and the "security guards" do very little. Half the time, you can't even tell if they're in there or not. More than once, there has been a car waiting to check in and a resident will open the gate for themselves and the guard will motion for the visitor car to go ahead and follow the resident in without checking in. Additionally, the parking stickers are never checked so guests feel free to park wherever, despite signs posted. I would personally rather have security cameras or a better gate system that only let one car in at a time.

As dog owners, I think the best perk is the dog friendly environment and the park that's right next door with walk-up gate access for our convenience. The office even has dog biscuits for our furbabies! The only negative experiences have been vehicle related. My husband's Harley was getting tampered with and he had to store it in his parent's garage for the last year and a half. They live in Tomball, so it's super inconvenient when he wants to ride. The other issue is my husband's truck getting stickered. Parking spaces are unreserved and unassigned. Everyone is entitled to park wherever we want, first come first served. My husband and I work at the same office and drive my car Mon-Fri and his truck on the weekends... His truck was stickered because it had been parked in the same space for more than a few days in a row. The only rule they have about vehicles is no broken down vehicles are allowed on the property. His truck is not broken down, so there was no reason to put a sticker on his truck. Other than that, we have enjoyed our time here. My dog has severe storm/noise anxiety and we don't hear any fireworks on Independence Day or New Year's Day. We are less than ten miles from the office (which has saved a lot of wear and tear on my car, which is approaching 200,000 miles). And, we're really close to shops, theatres, and restaurants. You really can't find a nicer apartment in this location, unless you pay two times more.

Our family of three recently moved from a 2 bed, 2 bath, 1400 square foot house in south east Iowa to Houston, TX. Imagine my horror when I found out the week before the move that the 1st apartment complex we applied to "lost" our application and we didn't have an apartment waiting.  Yes, that was 1,000 miles in a moving van with an upset toddler and no home at the end of the road.

We arrived in Houston on Thursday and I had to start work on Monday... The Marquis at Westchase staff were wonderful when we walked in on Saturday, day 3 of the frantic search. The leasing agent put up with the screaming toddler as she showed us the lovely apartment available for immediate move-in. She helped us with computer application between amusing the toddler. She was able to get us our keys that day. The moving van arrived Sunday and I started work Monday on time.

We are in the largest 2 bed, 2 bath layout and it is great. Size of the apartment and the attached garage made the transition from the house fairly painless. Maintenance is fairly prompt for repairs and the complex is very clean. The garage side trash pickup 3 days a week is nice. Also, the dumpsters are never overflowing. 

The minor problems... They planted the wrong type of trees around the pool so flowers and some leaves are always in it. They clean it once a week but they can be annoying. The apartment power is "dirty" and like to kill fluorescent and incandescent bulbs. We got LED bulbs which are more expensive and they've lasted 7 months so far. 

Overall, it is a great apartment in a wonderful area.

My fiancée lived here for 4 years and we lived here together for 2 years. We had a great experience. Staff and maintenance were very responsive. Location was great. Amenities inside the apartment and on the grounds were fantastic. Good value for the location, size and furnishings. Highly recommend.

I’ve lived in Katy, MedCenter, Galleria, Westchase & I honestly without can say WOW it’s crazy to believe I have been missing out my whole life! The Susanne is a hidden gem, walkable distance to Coffee District, HEB Dunlavy Montrose, and with its location you are a cheap 5-10 min Uber ride to  Downtown, Galleria, Rivero Oaks , Rice Village, Museum & Medical Districts. Staff is super friendly and everything’s immaculate. The Susanne redifines true luxury quality and convenice for any lifestyle !

Nice location and it looks good on the outside but unfortunately the experience does not live up to the expectations.   Our list of issues included:  Incredibly slow to get hot water in the morning (up to 5  minutes), when people above us flushed their toilets, it was like a tornado was happening inside the wall in our bedroom - we had to sleep with a white noise maker to not be woken up.   The security gates were constantly broken and the garbage chute was frequently backed up with garbage.   My $500 mountain bike was stolen right out of their secure bicycle cage and it was not uncommon for cars to be broken into inside the garage.    However, the icing on the cake was the management withholding over $500 of our $700 security deposit for what has always been considered normal wear and tear at every other apartment in which I have lived.    I would stay away....

This is the best and most beautiful place I have ever lived.  Modern, well designed apartments in the middle of an historic neighborhood full of trees and quiet streets to walk along. Just to top it off is the luck of being right across the street from the great HEB grocery store. The staff is efficient, intelligent and very easy to get along with.

The reality is that at the Susanne, you don't quite get what you pay for. Among the highest rents in town, especially for non-high rise. The fixtures are cheap, the appliances are cheap, loud, and break frequently, dishwasher is subpar as compared to other apartments we've lived in. There's leaks everywhere, people let their pets go to the bathroom inside and it will sometimes sit there for days, fairly frequent breakins, etc.

Morgan, the manager, is very nice, but the rest of the staff is typical apartment management - losing packages, rude, act like you're putting them out every time you ask them something...just the general "once we have your money, we don't want to be your friend anymore" stuff.

The only value you're getting here is the HEB across the street. But, there's now more-and-more units going in around the area that have similarly-enticing locations. I would look at those. I'm sure management will still be terrible, but at least maybe the apartments will be nice.

The Susanne apartment building is a great location and has the most amenities of any other apartment I have ever lived. All common areas are clean and well maintained. It is next to the a couple of awesome grocery stores. Also a big plus is it is  walking distance to the best of Montrose. The best restaurants, bars, and shops. After living her a few months I find I do not need to drive much, and the area is a great place for young professionals and young families.

Every guest I have ever had has been super jealous about my brick fireplace and two walk in closets. I have been extremely blessed frantically signing my lease under time pressure from life and being so pleasantly surprised by the whimsical charm and polite neighbors I have. This is the best complex I’ve ever been to and sad to leave it because i’m too far from work. I wish i could pick it up and move it closer to my job so I can stay here.

Been here a year and a half...and don't plan on moving until I move into a house.  The manager Rebecca is such a great manager. The apartments are quiet and safe. The area is great. It a nice place to live. Office staff are great and very helpful.
This apartments were nice when I first move in but now they won't fix anything and is not as clean and rent keep going up.pool been close by the city.

This apartment was very nice and in a nice area. One downfall is that petty crime in the area because it is such a nice area. I definintely would recommend to someone but get an alarm system.
