I’ve lived here for a few months now and here’s everything I’ve learned so far.

These apartments have been under new management, the people I’ve interacted with have been nothing but kind and very quick with how they operate. It’s been a breeze getting all our paperwork done. Maintenance crew is fast and efficient, there does seem to be a roach problem but I used a simple poison from Walmart and I havnt seen any since. Parking does suck but there’s areas where you can temporarily park to unload your car. Overall best apartment complex I’ve lived in so far!
I have lived here for more than a year, there is rarely parking for tenants if you work evenings. The roach problem is out of control and the workout room is only available during office hours.

This is a pretty nice apartment. Originally two of my friends moved in here and after visiting their apartments I decided to visit also because I liked the size or the apartments and amenities at a decent price in a quiet area. My one year is up and I'm only moving because my friends moved out also so I'm a bit lonely here but the apartment itself is wonderful, huge layout and very good price especially with deals they have. The best part is that it's right behind Kroger so you can walk there anytime there is a door in the gate. I never had any safety problems or breakins either, it is a very quiet place. Mostly people upper 20's some couples and families. Also I only talked to management twice once to sign my lease and once to move out I never had any problems with them they were always nice to me. Anyway if you want a nice place to live in the suburbs I'd recommend this.

I scheduled an appointment with Edward to take a tour today. I got one day off to do that, but when I arrived at the scheduled time the office was closed I called then several time but no answer!!! I was waiting for one hour without any answer, I left a message for them but Still no answer. Horrible customer service!!!
This is the most unethical apartment complex I have ever had to deal with.  Moving in was a joke- moving out was a nightmare.  You are better off anywhere else.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: First I just wanted to say that they don’t clean the apartment or care to check it for the next tenant when moving in! there was pee on the toilet, Gnats in my refrigerator and it smelled so badly even after I cleaned it, then there was damage done to room door, the patio blinds were broken & they gave me stove trays that don’t actually fit the stove which is hard to cook with. I’ve reached out twice and they said they would send someone to come look, no one has came and it’s been almost a month. After going through all this they take the special away from me because rent is late, but no one reached out to me to make sure i got those things fixed in my apartment. The walls are super thin and you can literally hear right through them I suggest not moving here & to always look at your apartment before signing the lease!

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: Do not! I repeat do not move to these trust me you can do better! Me and my girlfriend regret moving here, since the day we moved here. They are not organized in the office, and it seemed like it's always something that they're trying to charge extra for, it's a bunch of riddle me this and riddle me that, while at the same time we having problems in our apartment. Toilets don't work right, there's been problems with our sink faucet, just anything you can think about and recently we had to go the day before Christmas Eve all the way up into New Year's day without water, and right now as we speak our hot water is literally off at this very moment, while they just check our rent up again, and I'm sitting here right now have to work today and can't even take a shower, it's always something wrong here, and if possible I will be trying my best to get up out of here soon as I can!!!! I don't recommend anyone to move over here if you can help it, there are much better complexes.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: During my time here I have noticed a few things!  The staff at bridges of cypress creek do care about the residents.  I have witness the property manager taking off running to an apt after a resident called about smoke.  Vicky first response was the safety of the residents.  It was only a heater being turned on and burning off the dust.  I have seen and witness what this team does.  Even though we ending things off in a not so good way, Vicky has taken the time to help me even when she is not even obligated to.  So everyone should take the time to stop by and Thank them for everything they do.  Also thank the Juan and the Maint team.  They work hard everyday keeping the grounds clean and getting the apts turned.  So before anyone gives a bad review please take a look at the people who work there.  They do care and will help you if you ask for it.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: This apartments are horrible!! They Take weeks to fix the things in your home! I got pest control to come once a week and still had bugs! The floor is uneven, the paint is coming up from the tub and sink. The people who work there are very rude

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: Everytime me or a guest parks in the apartments the car gets filled with ants and it could be no food,then the apartment has had a rat infestation and also the same with roaches!i had to pay 325$ for a exterminator and he caught one and left traps and I heard two die and still saw one after he left,right now I’m not sure if their still here or not but I do know I have a baby and this has not been the best experience.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: The grounds are beautiful, well kept and the staff is so friendly and helpful

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review:
Me & my roommate have been here for almost a year; there are quite a few problems we cant overlook.
We arent continuing our lease again this following year & finding some place else to live if we dont see any improvements in the next 4 months.
-Dumpsters- other residents arent putting their trash inside the dumpster but leaving beside them even when its not full. They dont have anyone picking up trash in the parking lot. I find used diapers, pregnancy tests, kid's homework & kitchen trash just laying on the middle of the driveways & in parking spots.  Some neighbors have no decency to maintain peace & honk their horns maliciously.  My neighbors scream at each other daily & can be heard through the walls & even sometimes they yell at each other outside.
-They dont seem to maintain ANYTHING! The dog park gate doesnt latch, wired/wood fences are beaten up & worn, there's not much grass anywhere just weeds & dirt.  They blow the leaves after they trim the bushes back into people's porches.  The gates always sticking because they are OLD & just painted black but super rusted.
If you like night strolls, this is not the place to feel comfortable doing so. A few nights we were chased by loose dogs &  never the same ones.  My guests are afraid to come back because at some point they've been chased into their car & its never the same dog. No peace of mind/safety. There are a few that are but not everyone is a dog person but the office & management have done nothing to ensure dogs stay on leashes here.
The pavement & sidewalks are all uneven & water pools everywhere- hard to avoid or even walk around the puddles.
 If you have stairs there is no railing to protect a child or even an adult from falling sideways & that's a safety issue. Most of the power outlets are very loose & whatever I plug in there just falls out with any movement.  
-There are rodents in the kitchen cabinets because I keep finding droppings & marks they've been chewing inside the cabinets & drawers. This was discovered the 2nd week we've been living here. Brought it up to the office & nothing was done about it. I find these droppings & insects everywhere outside areas: spiders, roaches & ants. Inside  we dont see insects much-around the property we do.
No assigned parking. No signs where guests need to park & our neighbors have people come over & park very close to our apartment.... which most places Ive visited have guest parking marked in the outer perimeter.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review:
Ive been with this complex for less than a year and my wife and I both want to move. Not because the property is bad or management is faulty. But this is literally the definition of "you get what you pay for" when it comes to the area. At the time of this post (2/7/19 at 530pm) there has been 1 murder, several reported car break ins and just today on 1960@ella a gentleman was shot in the head. Granted, none of this has anything to do with the property( as far as I know) and I'm not trash talking the property. If youre looking for a cheap and (mostly) quiet place then this place is a good fit. But do consider the area itself as it continues to go down hill. 
I do give credit to the team they have here, including security as they are quick to fix issues you may be having at the complex but that is not enough for me to stay if I dont have to.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: it's going on a month now and I still haven't heard why I was denied or my money back. people stay away they will not call you or doesn't call back. they need to do their job.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: I lived there in 2007 and those apartments are cursed bad vibes. At night see through writtings in my bedroom looked like diabolic writing.   Plus a girl got murdered and bbq by her boy friend in that area. Bad experience

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review:
I moved into The Bridges of Cypress Creek on February 1, 2016, and moved out February 1, 2017, as a result of a job loss and changes in my financial situation. I discovered this complex a year before I moved in. I got to meet Ms. Claudia and Sergio in 2015, during my tour and they were such great people from the moment I met them until the moment I moved out. The bridges of Cypress Creek was my first apartment after graduating college and I would've loved to stay there for much longer. It was truly difficult moving out after just a year because this complex truly felt like home. The staff was consistent during my entire stay. Anything that I ever needed during my stay they would go above and beyond to accommodate me. Management staff, maintenance team, postal service man, everyone that stepped on the property were great. I lived on the first floor and never had any problems with roaches or insects, and pest control was always available just in case I did.  Open parking for residence and guest so I never had an issue with parking. The complex was pretty quiet all day and I know this because I worked from home. The pool was clean during the summer time and hours were open for use. There is really nothing that I can think of that makes this complex a bad choice... Nothing! Great Staff, Caring Staff, Consistent Staff, Clean appearance, Clean units, Address Concerns... Everything! Even after moving out MS. Claudia still responds to my emails with great urgency and attentiveness and you can't pay for this type of service even if you wanted to at some places. 

In My opinion there's really no need to compare the Bridges of Cypress Creek to any other complex because they're great! No comparison needed!

Thank you to everyone at the Bridges of CYpress Creek for being apart of my amazing experience and year there!

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review:
Formerly The Villages of Red Oak, the best thing here is price. The place is old and it shows despite a new paint job. There are roaches, the pavement is a disaster, and three buildings have burned down over the past few years (one was arson, but regardless of cause newer apartments are likely more fire safe). The group that took over and changed the name of the place about 3 years ago promptly renovated the main office and empty units, but made none for current residents outside of exterior paint and adding Xfinity hook ups. Despite "substantial renovations" being advertised, the unit you end up getting may not be the freshest.

Staff is so-so. You have to stay on top of them. They have a professional and polite demeanor, but are too often slack in doing the actual work. Service requests will sometimes be marked complete despite not being resolved. They withhold repairs of certain issues (carpet and tub repair chiefly) for lease renewal. They charge a monthly pest control fee for contracted exterminators, but can and do use their own staff to perform pest control. They can be slow in calculating the final bill for your rent so be careful paying early, even early in the day on the first of the month. There are $40-50 of extra fees each month so add that to the cost of the unit you're interested in.

Amenities are run-of-the-mill. There are tennis courts but if you or your kids are more interested in playing other sports then you/they won't be able to do so here. The laundry facilities are cramped and have coin-op machines that sometimes don't dry thoroughly. The gates and doors in the fence surrounding the property are beat up and slow, but they work. Newer additions like grills and a fitness center are nice, but if you're working and this is your price range, you may not have the time and/or energy to make use of them and might prefer decent pavement or other basics instead. 

The Bridges is okay at best. The location and prices are fine, but if you can afford something newer, do so as no renovation short of gutting the buildings will bring this place up to the modernity found elsewhere. If you're just getting by you should look around, as there are cheaper places of similar age and amenities where you won't have upwards of $40 in fees and where the pavement won't add wear on your car. No matter what you can afford you should comparison shop before settling on this place. The rates will continue to climb and the buildings will continue to age.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: I've been living hear for 3 years. I love the new management and the upgrades of the apartment.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: I would like to say that even though my apartment complex was built in the 60's It doesn't look like it. The upkeep on these building have been amazing compared to some I have seen in the past. Our staff are full of wonderful and friendly people who try their best to stick by there word. Our maintenance people are quick to respond with pleasant disposition, They do more than what's expected of them and i'm grateful for that. we've switched management within the time I've been here and the new crew are very informative, They stay on top of business whether big or small. You don't get that everywhere you go. They understand the loyalty and the importance of building a good and trustworthy relationship with their residences. Even when mishaps occur as any apartment does, they make sure they compensate fairly. In my book Their alright with me!!!

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: I have lived her for a year now.  I renewed back in April.  I am so impressed with the care the leasing staff and owner of the property has for these apartments.  I witnessed both buildings burning down.  They were caused by resident error.  How cool that the owner is taking the insurance money and actually rebuilding instead of taking the money and run.  I have read the other reviews, and honestly I have never had an issue with maintenance.  When my AC started blowing hot air this summer, I submitted my ticket and maintenance was out the very next day.  I have not had an issue since.  I have seen a roach here and there.  I have lived in Houston for 7 yrs.  They are all over.  All I know is from personal experience that staff go above and beyond to make sure everyone is taken care of.  I guess you just cannot please everyone all of the time.  I would recommend this place.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: I have been living here for 8 months, I have not had any issues. Any maintenance work is always done in a timely manner. I love that I can pay my rent online and it doesn't charge me any extra fees. It seems pretty quiet especially at night, there are not people hanging around outside the apartment. I don't have any complaints in regards to these apartments.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: Worse location to be stuck in a lease. Other than the fact that this is a high crime area, Two fires here in less than a year. Roach infested,and the maintenance staff acts as if they don't want to be there when they do show up. It took 4days to get my a/c fixed and it still doesn't work properly.   I was not planning on renewing my lease,but due to financial issues at the time had no choice, and I was refused a 6 month,they only had a year available.

apartmentName: Bridges of Cypress Creek Apartment Homes
review: The apartment complex is wonderful- run by friendly helpful great people willing to help you whenever you need help. The apartment is lovely and has many amenities and lovely location and surroundings.

Pros are the office staff are really kind and quick with any maintenance concerns. My apartment is a little older looking, but nice & comfy overall. Prices are reasonable. Location is convenient (10 mins to Pearland’s  major shopping center and 15 mins to the medical center). 

Cons are roaches can be an issue. I called for pest control 4-5x and the front office was really on it about taking care of things. Now the roaches are pretty much nonexistent in my apartment (*knock on wood*). There have been 2 burglaries since I’ve lived here. The neighborhood has never felt unsafe and all my neighbors are cool, but I am very aware of leaving belongings in my vehicle and walking in at night. Also, they have cameras on the property, but I wish they had an active security guard.

Been living here for 2 years now. Everything was cool at first but the roaches have just gotten out of hand. I keep my apartment spotless but they still seem to come. They charge for pest control for no reason and the trash overflowing is ridiculous.

Where do I begin. Been here 1 year & planned to stay longer, but due to unreconcilable differences I will not be renewing my lease here. First my key was left in my apt door by maintenance the first week I was here ?? then it was downhill from there. The community seemed quiet for about the first 6 months then the break ins started ??. They don’t want to inform you of that before you move here though, but whatever, neighbors disclosed it’s the norm here after awhile. So after my car was burglarized I decided to still stay but 2 months later my SO’s vehicle was STOLEN! That was it for me. The office staff is cool for the most part, but the lack of security did it for me. Reasonable rent, lot of space, but the experience hasn’t been great.
Good luck.

I do not recommend. I've lived here 10 months now and will not be renewing my lease. I live in a 2bed 2 bath first floor. When we first moved in there was a roach problem that took more than a month to completely get rid of. (Learning lesson with virtual tours). Then we discovered there is a sewage issue in this area. Hint, the odor along the streets of Almeda and W. Orem. The toilets randomly stop up or over flow with bubbles, the washing machine leaked, and when the apt above you flush the toilet you can hear a stream of water going down the wall. This once was an issue when the we noticed water damaged due to this but maintenance fixed the problem and it has been good since. As far as the WALLS they are VERY THIN. Wouldn't recommend the first floor unless you want the same sleeping schedule as the family above you. We experience loud running and stomping all times of the day and sometimes I even hear a child throwing a temper tantrum I'm guessing. The community is ok, pretty quiet. Sometimes there is a lot of loitering but I've seen someone on that. The office staff is friendly and responsive. Maintenance as well, I know because I've had to call them way too many times.

Just moved in and everything is great! Fast responses when I contact the office whether it has been by phone or email. America, Taylor and everyone is super nice! I love calling the Ranch my home because its quiet at night and this is super important to me, I lived here 6 years ago moved and now returned again because it was great then and still great today! #ILovetheRanch Megan H.

I do not recommend anyone to move in any of the Adams LaSalle apartments. I live in ranch at city park and we have a problem with people breaking in the cars. It has become more frequent. It happen a lot during the summers and holidays. The break in are always a row of cars. The persons goes down the line and breaks the back window of each car and just go through the car. I have had neighbors tell me they have had to fix there car window multiple times in a week. You can have everything put away but they will still break the window to see if you have anything inside. I have ask that the apartments do something about this issue and nothing has been done. They sent a letter basically saying the owner knows about the situation however, it is our responsibility as residents to keep ourselves safe not the owner. I requested nightly security as well. Residents are moving out every month because of the safety issues. Is Adams LaSalle do not handle the safety issue in Ranch at city park than I assure it is not being handled in any other apartments they manage. The apartments look nice but the safety is a issue. I do not recommend moving into these apartments or any other Adams LaSalle apartments.

I am a current resident, there is a reason this place has so many open apartments right now. Management is poor, to say the least. The employees have no accountability and act like you're bothering them every time you go to ask a question. They had one good office guy that actually cared about residents, he left so now it is all crabby ladies who can't be bothered, including managers. If you don't live on the top floor you can hear every footstep of the occupants above you. Maintenance is a joke, requests take weeks to fill. Not to mention that when you submit a request, that gives them free access to your apartment and they don't provide any notice to the resident the day they're coming. Not a good experience to have someone unknown in your apartment when you come home from work, especially when a work request was filed 2 weeks prior... All goes back on management, but like I said previously they have terrible managers who have zero accountability just like their employees. Looking forward to moving after my lease is up.

Worst management, dog pop every where ,they get false positive reviews. The truth is for most high rent in this area ,this place is full of dog poop everywhere,  people who leave their dogs without leash, breakin in cars and apartment. Can't wait to get out of this place.

3rd management team since I have been here 3 years. Started out wonderful. Then major crime, break ins, cars broken into, pool is disgusting. New management can’t keep maintenance people. They all leave! They admit to hating management!!! No one returns calls, security “officer” is only here to report cars to be towed. She does nothing else. There are 12 visitor parking spots on the whole property. Residents not on the lease park there, or residents that are do. They will tow. It is impossible to have guests. Dumpsters are disgusting, trash overflowing into the driving area of parking lot. Recently had a dumpster fire. Trash everywhere! Management has no regard for residence, just money. Gates always broken, both drive they and walk thru gates. I’m embarrassed to have people visit. Couches and mattresses at dumpsters that never get picked up. Mold everywhere! I have asked them to power wash for 3 years, never happened. Plus hwy 6 gets shady. We have had homeless ppl camping out inside

This apartment is one of the worst. Luxury? I dont think so. No enough parking space for the visitors, there’s only 3 spaces nearest to my friend’s unit and their residents are the ones filling the spaces. We checked the others which were far away and filled too. Where else can we park? So we parked on the resident’s parking which doesn’t have a signage. We thought it was fine to park. After 20 minutes of parking there, our car was towed for parking without permit! OMG! The security gave us a list of violations to get towed but it didn’t show on it for cars without parking permit. And was told there was a small signage before you enter the gate. You can’t even see the signage because it was too dark and couldn’t see the signage! Terrible complex and not should be named a luxury one. They would get a lot of money from you! I know a lot of friends who are planning to transfer in Houston and i would not recommend this place! 

I visit a lot of apartment complex since I’m a visiting nurse but this is the only luxury complex that doesn’t show enough signages! 

This is a warning to all who are planning to stay here, this is not a visitor-friendly place! I would put zero stars if I could!

I love the complex! I performed my apartment hunting in the area in 2 days and I felt in love with this place. People in the leasing office is awesome, they are very kind and professional. The apartments are very nice and comfortable. Perfectly located! :)
Olga was very pleasant and helpful. The complex was well kept.  The apartments are beautiful with great amenities.

They have a new management company and they are horrible. They charge so much money for everything but when it comes to spending on residents , they are very cheap . I really missed Elain company!!!!!!!!

Units have open floor plan and very spacious.  
However, no playground for the kids who in turn play in the streets or on the picnic tables and in front of apts throughout the day.  No one uses the dog park so best not to walk on the grass...ever.  Valet trash service offered for pick up at night but residents leave out multiple bags of trash throughout the day for all to enjoy the view and smell in the Texas heat.  Cell phone coverage and internet is weak.  AT&T is the only provider.  Will need to take most calls outside.  Had a roach problem like most residents when I moved in.  Can definitely hear your neighbors through the walls.  Especially when they throw house parties on the weekends.  Don’t recommend this property at all.  Too many nicer apts in the area.

I have lived here for a year now and I'm happy to say I will be staying for at least another year. The community and units are nice and quiet. Utilities are minimal. The Bark park is amazing with tons of other dogs to play with. The amenities with the pool, pond, fitness facility, game room are as good as they get in an apartment environment. I can't say I have any negative experiences in my year here.
You can't ask for a better team in the front office. Any time I had a question they were available to help and there is always someone at the front office. They sit down and listen to you without trying to rush you out of the office. I'm looking forward to my next year in the community.

This place has turned out to be a total disappointment. I moved here September of 2015. The Manager and leasing agents were extremely helpful and despite a few bumps in regards to the condition of my apartment, things went smoothly. Fast forward a few months, manager changes and shortly after that new faces in the leasing office. There is a drastic change in customer service from the front office. Some examples of issues, gates don’t work for over a month, supposedly due to a “lightning strike.” Submit a work order to have battery changed in beeping smoke detector. Gets marked as complete, 3 am same night, starts beeping again. Community policy says to put your trash out between 6-8 pm, trash pickup starts promptly at 8. Go to put trash out at 7:30 and they have already passed. Management has been made aware of concerns, will respond to emails but no actual improvements are made. My most recent issue with them has to do with the gate access devices. I live alone in a 2 bedroom apartment and have multiple vehicles. I was told that I could purchase an additional gate access tag for $50. This is how my lease words it:

Remote control for gate access. Each person who is 18 years of age or older and listed as a resident on the lease will be given a remote control at no cost to use during his or her residency. Each additional remote control for you or your children or other occupants will require a $50 non-refundable fee.

I was informed that I could purchase an additional tag, so I did. 2 nights ago I came home and my gate access tag would not work. So I went to the leasing office today and was told that I was not allowed to have 2 tags and I could only purchase a replacement if mine had been lost or stolen. Mind you there is a separate paragraph on the addendum in regards to a last/stolen access tag. The above paragraph makes it clear that an additional tag can be purchased. I pull out my copy of the lease agreement and go back to the office, the leasing agent tells me that “I do not understand the context in which that paragraph is meant.” I was genuinely confused as to how I could be misunderstanding that paragraph. It was pointless to continue arguing with her so I left. 

The point is, they really don’t seem to care anymore. The atmosphere here has changed drastically. There was jut a shoot out in front of my building at 3 am on June 14th.  They seem more concerned with filling apartments than getting quality residents.

I have stayed on the Elan at Briar Forest for 9 moths and love it the unites are well design, the amenities on the unit as well as the community amenities are excellent. The management staff are nice and helpful. The service team took care of my requests within 24 hours. In my opinion The Elan at Briar Forest apartment is a hidden gem on the often busy energy corridor.

The apartment is huge for a one bedroom. Very spacious. The leasing office is beautiful and so is the pool and other amenities. The people are very friendly and the staff is always there to help. The maintenance is done on time as well. The community over all is very good.

Beautiful unit and common areas. Our truck tires were stolen overnight and it was up on blocks. Security was not making hourly rounds and no video cameras after front gates.  Management was rude when we brought it to their attention. I would have appreciated an apology and reassurance they would step up security but I must live in a fantasy world to expect a little empathy when theft occurs. Maybe if the $5k came out of their pocket they would feel differently. It seems irresponsible to leave security gates open over night and not inform residents. The apartment below us had their truck broken into and another unit was broken into during the daytime. We received an email from management to be cautious and in particular to not walk alone in the complex at night. There has been a high speed chase which came from highway 6 through our fence and around the complex. The families that hold pool parties often have 20  people and refuse to share the grills. A lot of people utilize the pool that do not live here.  Last week a suburban pulled up and unload a car full on young kids, I watched as they came right for the pool. The large groups always expect you to let them in the gates, which given the recent thefts is less than ideal.  The large groups rarely watch their kids as they run around and swim. One Friday evening a group under the cabana began cussing and throwing cooking utensils at another resident. Also, heard of residents having crazy ant/ raspberry ant infestations that come through the baseboards/cracks in the floor. We do like Latoya and Luis at the front de sk, they have been friendly but their management is quite different.  We are looking elsewhere once our lease is up.

I've been a resident since January 2015 and couldn't be happier. The staff are always courteous and helpful, and the grounds/amenities are very well kept. The valet trash service is such a great convenience and pretty much eliminates pesky pests. I wish they had a play area for children, but there's a large park nearby. The units have great finishes and are insulated well in the fact I don't ever hear my neighbors. I've lived in several communities in this area and am happy to call Elan 'home'

I live a Elan Briar Forest and it is amazing! From the time you come visit the first time to move in then living has been a great experience. 
First when I came to visit I was instantly greeted. Just as I am at all the apartments that I visited, however the staff really took interest in my needs and didn't just show me their model, but showed me the different locations on the property.
Then, once I selected the location I wanted it was seemless to get the paper work started. Everything was completed online and I did not have to come back and forth to get everything going. The staff called me if they needed anything else and would let me know of the status during the process.
Once it came to move in time they had everything ready for me. They gave me a Welcome bag. The Welcome bag had my keys, a screw driver see, pens, and my signing bonus surprise which I will remain anonymous as it may change for each residence,however I will say it is valued at $200. It was just a little extra that made me happy.
Anyways, after moving in I have been very pleased with the property. Let me say you must check it out in person. At first sight you see the stunning lake that surrounds the property with the awesome pool that is in the middle, it sits like a peninsula. The pool area has a glass gate around it from where ever you sit you can see the lake. The amenities around the pool include 4 large out door tv's, 2 large gas grills,and a fire pit.The gym on sight is very useful it has tons of weights and treadmills.Not to mention it has a kids play room for parents that want to work out and make sure the kids are safe. This is lengthy, sorry. I’d like to start by saying that my apartment is beautiful. However, the issues that have come with it made it not worth renewing the lease after a year. I’ll go from the most frustrating to the least frustrating experiences. 

1. The A/C broke twice. Once in the middle of summer. It got up to 81 degrees in my apartment for a whole week. Maintenance came and told me that I basically didn’t know how to work the thermostat, and changed said thermostat out. Didn’t help. After that week, an actual HVAC company came and replaced a part of the AC that they said was heavily corroded and working 10x harder than normal and that’s why it gave out. 

2. Electricity bill is $400+. I travel for work and am home and don’t use electricity maybe half the month. Brought it up to the office and the manager many many times. In person and over email, with no resolution. The manager said that it was normal for Texas and that some other girls bill was over $1000. Asked to have the meters checked. They were never checked and the issue was never resolved. I am still currently waiting to hear back on the matter. 

3. Our freezer froze over two or three times, resulting in the whole fridge breaking. Maintenance again said I just didn’t know how to change the settings on the fridge. Lost all groceries with no reimbursement. After the last time it broke, they offered either a new (way smaller) fridge or we could have the same fridge I had, from our neighboring empty apartment. But he said that “we can’t be mad at him if it’s infested with roaches.”

4. There were so many changes in such a short span of time, nobody was sure what was going on. First they changed the gate from a normal clicker to an app that no one could access and didn’t explain that it was actually TWO apps that you had to have to get in to anything. Then it was parking. At first your car just needed a little permit sticker, then they said to avoid towing we had to download another app to register our car and if we had a guest over, their car. Then I heard nothing. Then it was nevermind, we’re not doing that. 

5. The package room is a disaster. It’s 1 small room for hundreds of tenants. Packages have “disappeared”, and you can’t find anything.

6. The pool is nice, but the hot tub doesn’t work and is green 80% of the time.

Overall, I’m happy living here. The pool, gym and parking are all great. The property is pretty and the direct access to the bayou is a big plus too. However, my electric bill over the summer was over $500 per month! Their A/C units are outdated and they have no plans on upgrading them (to my knowledge). They’re slightly lower the average price in this area, but with the electric bill being so high it may not be worth it to those looking to save money. The staff and maintenance team and friendly and helpful, my biggest complain here is my electric bill is so high.

I work from home and make calls all day, so I made request to transfer units to a comparable unit because I won't be able to work otherwise. Maintance always timely, staff care for their residents. The community is tight knit.
I would highly recommend these apartments due to the professional management staff along with highly skilled maintenance staff.
I hav been very pleased living here.
I did a walk-in tour earlier today at this beautiful location and Mariam helped me out… she was very kind and explained everything to me to a T and even offered me candy thanks Mariam??

New management is terrible, possibly worse than prior management. The maintenance department is LACKING and the communication between the residents, office, and maintenance is little to non existent. This apartment is very spacious. 2 bedrooms and two and a half baths at 688is a steal!  Private parking and on site security. With perks like that who wouldn't want to live in Westwood fountain? A couple of cons would be the high traffic of midnight ladies.
YES

This apartment complex used to be a place I was proud to live in. Now, especially since the new company has taken over, it has really hit a new low. There is dog poop all in the garage, you can’t walk down a hallway without smelling marijuana, and packages are stolen straight out of the mail room (a service that you are now charged $15 extra for). False fire alarms have been a weekly, if not daily, occurrence. It’s especially fun when they go off at 10 pm, 1 am, 3 am…especially on a weekday. When you try to tell management, they are extremely dismissive, if they don’t just ignore you outright. Their customer service skills and the way they treat residents are pitiful at best. None of the amenities were ever working, Spa, Pool and Gym. (always down). No security, homeless people sleeping in the lobby at night. two shooting at complex.  Westchase hood!!

The apartments themselves are beautiful but it’s the INCOMPETENT STAFF that make this place HELL! The supposed beep in gate is ALWAYS broken. No matter how many times you report it, it remains open to whomever. Same for the front door. Random people have walked in from the street their has even been homeless people sleeping on the corner corridors and benches. As for the parking garage get It finally was closed after several cars got their windows busted and NOTHING was done about it. Office is randomly closed through to the day and they NEVER pick up the phone. My roommates and I have literally watched them be on the cell phones watching the office phone ring as we were calling. The can’t answer simple questions and act as if you telling them about a concern you have is a huge inconvenience  to them sitting down on their job the whole day. We called maintenance one to come look at our dryer because it was making a loud noise. He asked “does it still work?”. We said yes but it’s the noise that’s troubling. He replied it may be something caught in it. Give it a few days and it should stop and said that if not he’ll be back. It’s been 3 months. The noise is louder and has Anatole been back by NO! A lot of drug use on property.  Even in the common areas in the middle of the day.  Management has been informed, but refuses to clean up the drugs.  Serious security concerns that are also never addressed despite repeated requests from the residents.  Apartments are getting broken into.  Garbage is left in the common areas and not cleaned up for days or sometimes weeks.  Our brand new vehicle was damaged in the parking garage and no note was left on the car.  Not worth the money that we pay.

This entire process has been very frustrating and wish the management could order the right unit at the beginning without providing all the excuses that why the bigger unit is not ordered. 

This apartment was like a home to my roommate and myself. After all the A/C unit issues back and forth, it would be hard to trust that the management office did care about the living experiences of their residents. The conversations with the management office was used to be friendly and pleasant, which now is no longer to be that way.

I lived in 2727 Residences for the last one year with no much complaints, The staff and the management were very nice and had very less complaints on maintenance  as they were  fixed immediately. My apartment was very spacious , upgraded and nice with 0 roaches which made us really very happy. Only thing which we did not like about the apartment is we had double shower in the guest bedroom , which we did not like.

Apts are the worst. DONT MOVE IN!! You will get bedbugs in time. Infested with bedbugs, roaches, and even rats. They do absolutely nothing about it. Not a good place for anyone or a family. I am breaking my lease along with other residents because the lack of concern and the distespect from management. No one from the office wants to help you or do something about it. The place looks good when they show you. Soon as you move in you notice all the bad in it. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME. LOOK SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!
Villa anita es un lugar de familia, siempre llevo a mi hija a el parque, y hay seguridad, hay un security que vijila los apartamentos.

I just moved out of another apartment complex and while I was at the office chatting up with the ladies that work there, they gave me excellent service, and answered all my question, maintenance work orders are fast. It's really a great place to live, I highly recommend it.

The apartments are well-kept, the neighbors are decent, and quite often keep to themselves. I appreciate the 24-hour security, the maintenance team usually stays on top of things. However, there is one problem, and that is the apartment staff, they are rude to the tenants and don't appear to know what they are doing, they appear to be a little bit incompetent. Maybe one or two of them seem to know what they are doing, but as a whole, I would rate them to be mediocre. I moved out as soon as my lease was up and moved to a wonderful apartment complex, the rent is a little higher but my experience with this particular apartment makes me feel the higher rent is worth it.

Great community. Friendly staff. If you have rodent problems, forget about about it. They will literally charge you for pest control and will not do a thing about it. They will charge you a fee for pest control and have cockroaches everywhere. Maintenance? You better wait a month or two before your problem is fixed. 5/10 and that’s being generous.
Ive been living here for 2 months. Its not much but i see Everything is good, affordable price, management perfect, quiet place. Only problem for me is parking.

Been living here for a long time, it's really nice here nothing bad ever happens not that much trouble,alright security the management is ok and as for maintenance, there really good you call they'll come right away. Overall it not here

This apartment complex is a huge community. The up keep of the apartment is better than all the apartments in the area. I love this community because it is very ethnically diverse. There is one leasing agent there that goes above and beyond all the time which makes many residents happy.

I rate this apartment three to four stars. I love how well kept the landscaping in this complex. Its also very quite and relaxing apartment community. Affordable rent prices and nice leasing staff. Only reason why I gave it four stars is i wish some of the floor plans would come with washer/dryer connections in unit. That would be so convenient. They have laundry facilities, but they're usually broken machines.

I'm giving 1 star due to the management at The Gibson. They are incompetent, lack integrity, and show no empathy. They mislead you before and after you move in, ignore grievances, and fail to hire an adequate maintenance team. Issues are only addressed after significant complaints, and they place residents in units with roach infestations and numerous plumbing problems, including hot water and water outages. While the property itself isn't terrible and has potential, the management is the real issue. The Gibson needs a new management company with staff who genuinely care about residents rather than just collecting a paycheck.

If I could give negative stars I would. This is the worst apartment and management I have ever rented from. The place is absolute dumpster fire. Their dumpsters are overflowing with trash, Rat communities are living under the dumpsters. There is never parking because guests do not use guest parking. I have been dealing with roaches for over 6 months and they send the same company, and it never lasts more then a day or two before the pests are back. They are forcing residents to buy their $85 cable package that isn't close to comparable internet speeds of what I already have through the same company. They tack on amenities and fees to your monthly and obviously don't fix a thing besides curb appeal to attract new tenants.  I've had water damage issues 3 times in 2 years. One time they said I was going to have to pay for the carpet since I pulled it out and threw it away. I waited 72 hours and called the emergency hotline over and over. I got no reply. I did the repair myself because mold was starting to grow, and my wife was pregnant at the time. The office assistants will take your number down, and never pass it on to management if you can actually get ahold of someone instead of their voicemail. Good luck look elsewhere
Trash and parking are major issues. Cars that have not been driven take up parking, and the trash is always a problem.
I would recommend this place because location is great, apartment I saw was super clean, amenities were well kept and office staff was really accommodating

Quiet community but people don't clean up their dog poop. I also think an email should be sent to residents reminding them they are responsible for making sure trash is in the receptacle and not on the ground.
I would recommend this apartment to any one who is looking for one. I am very comfortable living here.

If you are looking for a place to live DO NOT move here. The management has changed over 4 times since I have moved to the Hamilton. The management doesn’t care about your well being or safety for that matter. There is loud music coming from your neighbors and others that live on a completely different floor from you. There is mold in the apartments and water coming out of the windows from your bedroom. The management/office doesn’t notify when you have new packages making it very difficult to pick up your packages before they close. There is constant theft and vandalism in the parking garage. These are just some of the major issues facing this apartment location. Save your self some time and look at another apartment in the area.

I visited my daughter a year ago and told her that I immediately had concerns being close to the freeway and the camps near.  I drive the downtown area and could see that there are homeless all over downtown.  I tried to get my daughter to move outside of downtown but she really wanted to be in the heart of the city.  I visited my daughter a few weeks ago and was surprised to see that the door keys and elevator keys increased the level of security around the building.  The office is taking a personal interest in the building and it shows.  I see the manager out walking with maintenance going over items.  The manager even asked if I lived in the building or needed help.  I told him that I was visiting my daughter.  He stated that I would need to be let in by my daughter, he could not give me access to the building.  This I really love.  He had no idea who I was and he was not allowing entry into the building.  My Daughter told me that it is so much better now.  I am so much happier for her.  She is getting ready to sign another lease for a year and she is really happy that she gave The Hamilton her business.

I am relocating to Houston and I initially was going to rent apartments at Rice because of their close proximity to my office downtown. I was very disappointed and I decided to keep looking. I spoke with Taylor at the Hamilton Apartments and she was very helpful. I had so many questions and she answered each one in detail. She took care of everything for me. She exceeded my expectations and I’m happy to be a tenant at the Hamiltons. Thanks Taylor!!

I'm so glad I found this place. If you are looking for space and closets... this is the place. It's a new building which I love, and the finishes are top notch. I don't know if pricing has changed since I leased, but you can get a great steal here. Great neighbors who are very warm and friendly, and the management team is detailed, thorough and very professional. Highly recommend!!!!
I'm very happy here. Love the staff, building, and area. You won't regret leasing here, much more bang for your buck than all the places I toured in midtown and surrounding areas.

I have had nothing but good experiences with the leasing staff even when I encountered a few problems. They handled it with professionalism and kindness. I'm not always an easy tenant, but they always treat me like I am. The building itself is great and you can see that they work hard to keep it clean although not everyone who lives here make it easy. They shampoo carpets weekly, and the next day you might find ketchup on the floor, and then they are out again shampooing. Residents don't clean up after they use the grill lounges, but the staff pretty quick to go clean up over and over. They have like 6 grills so that is a huge job. All in all, I'm more than happy with my choice to live here and renew - I would refer this to anyone.
Something was always broken. Office staff was nearly unresponsive with any issues we had. And we were charged after move out for someone else’s unit’s carpet replacement. Renters  nightmare.
Noisy, not a lot of amenities, floor plans are nice, near the galleria.

This is the absolute best place to live!! I searched for a long time and Im very picky! They have everything you need here! The high rise living at its hottest! The pool is beautiful and the units are beautiful inside! The gym has everything you need; I love the stairclimber! The staff and maintenance are very friendly and so sweet! The grounds are very clean and beautiful; like a mini River Oaks! Very posh inside the lobby and lounge!! I recommend Amli Uptown to everyone who wants a nice and safe place to live thats so beautiful!! My little Maltese loves it here too!! Thank you , Layla

My experience at the AMLI so far has been comforting. I relocated from another state and the staff has been really pivotal in ensuring that I feel at home. They are quick and concise and work diligently to provide excellent service. I'm very glad that I chose this property, I'm very grateful for the staff and enjoy the engagements of my neighbors. Everyone is super friendly and helpful and I'm excited to deepen my connections here. Thanks everyone!
Its an OK community for the location and the rental rate.
AMLI Uptown is such a great place to live and management is great and responsive. We have not had any major issues since we have lived here and any minor issues are immediately resolved.

And for some reason THE ONLY PEOPLE IN THE ENTIRE BUILDING WHO CALL THEM ARE ME AND MY NEIGHBOR. Does nobody else shower daily?! Or wash their dishes?! Regardless, it happens a LOT and takes usually a day or so for them to figure out the issue. Right now it’s 40 degrees outside so cold showers are a no go. I always have to go find a vacant apartment to shower in. Yea, a vacant apartment. Sad, isn’t it? But that’s how it is here at the heights at 2121! Enjoy your stay!
You get it all! This is by far the worst place I’ve ever lived in.

I would highly suggest *not* considering this complex for your next apartment.  The German Cockroach infestations throughout the complex need to be addressed by the health inspector.  I have been eating in my car for 7 months, had no access to clean water because the roaches love water and crawl on the faucets, the get inside the fridge even.  My dog is not able to have water out or enjoy a treat and I feel like a horrible human.

Management is aware of all of this.  One of the managers saw me eating in my car one morning.  I have sent emails letting them know that disease infested cockroaches crawling across my work space is unacceptable, only to be constantly ignored.

The worst is when you reach upper management and think that they might actually treat you like a human and uphold their end of what was promised in the lease contact, they do exactly the opposite.  The junior regional manager said, "of course you can transfer apartments, you just have to pay the 85% of one month's fee and give 60 days notice".  I'm sorry... what?  Yes, they want me to pay them to get out of an apartment that the CDC deems uninhabitable.

When I sent certified letters, they offered to let me out of my lease if I signed something saying that I would never report them to any government agency, would never sue them and would drop all my claims, and would never post on social media.  And there is no way in good conscience I could even consider signing that letter without helping out the next person that hopefully reads this review before coming to this joke of a home.

I have dozens of pictures and videos.  They found a massive infestation in the bldg after I BEGGED them to search, and said case closed.  But these continue to breed and they will continue to live in these walls until someone takes this seriously, but I can't imagine that ever happening.

This has been the worst management company experience in the 9 years I’ve lived here. I don’t know the last time I was able to get through to the office on the phone, nor does anyone reply to emails. The only way I can get a response is by leaving a review online or sitting in the office until someone is available, if the office is open. I left a message before Christmas with the answering service about pest control, then followed up by submitting a work order online, still no response.

Staff was great.  No problem with the property either.  Hope they get a GREAT tenant to replace me
Quoted one price charged another …couldn’t change because moving long distance for a job. Too short of notice . Staff is rude . Corporate never returned calls or emails .
I'm a new resident here and I like how I was treated by the leasing agent that attend to me...

This place is awful. They tricked me into getting an apartment i didnt want. Originally when i applied they told me i was applying for a nice, updated apartment with wash/dryer. Once approved, they told me the apartment i was applying for had been taken but they have another one that's the same. So i went over and signed the paperwork. Not even 2 minutes after i signed the lease and left, they called me saying that apartment was also taken and the only one left similar was a more expensive apartment that was out of my budget. Mind you, this was the day before i was supposed to move in. They offered me another apartment for the same price however they neglected to tell me that this apartment was extremely outdated and did not include w/d hookups. Also, it was not move in ready because the carpet was never replaced and is literally the worst carpet i have ever seen. The carpet is coming up everywhere, and you cant walk on it barefoot because its sticky (even after several cleanings). You also cant sit on it, because its scratchy. The a/c never works either and my apartment is always over 80 degrees. They advertise 2 laundry rooms but one of them has been closed for a year now and the other is always broken or the card machine never works. There is mold in my apartment and the air is always moist even with a dehumidifier constantly on that we have to empty several times a day. This means everything in the house is moist, including our bed when we lay in it. This is not at all what i had in mind moving here, and i cant wait until my lease is up.

Do yourself a favor and go with a newer apartment complex.  I have been in this apartment almost a month now.  They give you a sheet asking what's wrong with the apartment.  There are spots that aren't level in the entire apartment but I wasn't concerned with that.  The only place I was concerned with was the kitchen.  It was so severe your couldn't stand at the stove standing level one foot sank in further down into the ground and it the tiles were already bending to conform to the ground which looked like they would begin to Crack but technically w we really cracked yet.  They send maintenance out they leave saying oh the tiles aren't cracked and left.  I personally don't understand what their maintenance people get paid to do but I would definitely like their job of doing nothing.  So I left a negative survey and they send outside contractors to do the floor.  They pull all my appliances out redo the entire concrete stating they need about 7 or 8 hours for concrete to dry then the maintenance people from my complex will be back to lay the tile the next morning.  The next day they come dragging in at 230pm stating they need to put a top coat of concrete on and it will be an additional day of no appliances not even a microwave yet again forcing me to eat out yet another day because my stove and dishwasher are in the dining room and washer dryer is on the patio.  I ask them why they haven't already been there they claim they had emergencies all morning.  The entire apartment is a disaster there is concrete dust everywhere and it's difficult to get off of your belongings. I had to clean out the kitchen for them when it hasn't been long since I unpacked my belongings not to mention having to give up your life for the last two days.  The outside contractors were great but unfortunately they didn't do the entire job.   The joke comes when you have to deal with the maintenance department again from the apartment complex.  The apartment complex is older but could be decent if the maintenance people actually cared about their job and not just trying to cover up something.

The floor plans are nice but they are old and nobody really cares to make them better. It is very nice in the front where the office is full of flowers and plants. The rest of the complex is totally unattended and bad.

Elevators never work. 
Trash chute was out for a while a while ago. 
Property does not compensate, they just apologize and never get the root of the issue fixed!!! OVERPRICED
Lovely apartment, excellent staff and so many extras to make this my home.
Enjoy living in a clean, quite and well managed apartment building.

Staff is professional and highly responsive -- from management to maintenance! Amenities are first class and well maintained -- from the garden grill to the gym! AMLI residents are friendly and thoughtful  - always caring and considerate!
Great location and easy access to many parts of Houston. The apartment layouts are pretty good compared to other properties.

The amli river oaks is a great apartment complex, everything around is always very well kept and the maintenance staff keeps all the amenities around the complex clean and up to date. apartmentName: Allure Hermann Park at Med Center
review: Honestly, typing this is really a disappointment because I had such high hopes.  I moved from NY to Houston and toured a lot of buildings but I chose Allure.  I loved the community and my tour guide was awesome.  I moved in January 2023 and immediately regret my decision.  First, they are just a MESS. Second, I flew from NY, signed paperwork and got my keys.  INSTANT regrets.  The apartment floors were dirty and were not cleaned.  The ice/water dispenser was rusty and unusable. The bathtub was dirty and not cleaned. The kitchen sink was rusty and has mess in the drain. I asked the agent that walked me to my apartment about the appearance and she told me there was “a store close buy to purchase cleaning supplies.” I was disappointed because I was excited to move to Houston and this building.  I went and spoke to the manager whom already has a picture of the refrigerator on her phone (so she was aware of the issue) and offered no resolve.  I told her the state of the apartment and she said “it should have been cleaned” but again, no resolve.  It appears that no one bothered to check the apartment before they rented to a new tenant and it shows they do not care about their tenants.  This was instantly the worst decision I ever made moving here and I wish I did not have to live here. Please beware of these issues if you are thinking of moving here.  Ensure that you see the apartment before you sign your lease or pay your rent and have a backup apartment just in case.  Trust me.

apartmentName: Allure Hermann Park at Med Center
review: Literally every amenity is always broken and ever since Hanover sold it to Allure it's been at nothing but a steady decline. Save your time and money, don't live here. It's a joke of a "luxury" apartment.

apartmentName: Allure Hermann Park at Med Center
review: Allure Hermann Park is not the place you want to live, trust me on this. My move-in date was July 7, 2022, and the A/C unit was not functioning. If you live in the city of Houston you know that during the summer months air conditioning is vital, especially when you have a pet (I'm a dog dad) I paid a full month's rent when I signed my lease but wasn't able to move into my apartment until August 4th. So I was couch surfing with my brother and friends because I had nowhere else to live (even though I had signed a lease and paid full rent) Now you would think because I moved in that the A/C was fixed, well it was not. After notifying the new management of my issues it took over a week for me to get a single-room portable A/C unit that only cooled one room at a time. Eventually, the A/C unit had to be completely replaced, which took a day to accomplish. Now you would also think that because my apartment wasn't livable for almost a month that I would not need to pay for the time I wasn't able to live on the property. Well, I just found out that they are expecting me to pay full rent even though I couldn't actually live in my apartment. I was told if I want to get the rent covered for the time I wasn't able to live in the unit that I needed to reach out to the previous management company (Hanover) myself and get it taken care of. For what you would imagine is supposed to be a 'Luxury" apartment living it's far from it. High-level Customer service is expected at a place like this and I deeply regret signing a lease agreement to live here. Pray for me and Beaux (my dog) y'all. We have 10 months left if I'm not able to somehow get out of my lease.

apartmentName: Allure Hermann Park at Med Center
review:
Facilities good but don’t let that distract you from the ever unresponsive management, the lack of functioning elevators, the poorly-maintained equipment, the massive lines for shared facilities, and the overall mediocre quality of life given the supposed access to these amenities. Packages must be picked up on a DAILY BASIS.

We understand the office is understaffed and is very busy.  However, is it really ok for the office to return someone else's package?  And what if the postman forgets to leave a note in our small mailbox. How is a renter supposed to know there is a package waiting in the office? The postman drops the packages off at the main office just inside the door where anyone can pick the package. The front gate is unlocked every day and stands wide open to the street and sometimes at night too and weekends. 
We have a standard 5" square small box. There are no large boxes to put a package into. My friends apartment complex has large boxes with keys that the postman puts into the small mailbox so the renter can retrieve the package. If the Manor is not responsible for packages, then who is? Once again the management seems to enjoy making our life as senior citizens more difficult instead of helping when they can.

The apartments themselves are pretty nice.  Granite kitchen tops, disposal, ice cube maker in the refrig, washer/dryer combo provided.  Noise level is very low, rarely hear our neighbors. The pool is small and not kept up.  It may, or may not, be safe to swim in.  The "spa"/Jacuzzi mostly doesn't work.  We had one excellent maintenance guy for 200 apartments, but he was recently let go.  Now we have two new maintenance men, so maybe things will get better. Gray! like an institute or prison.  Put up mostly monochromatic "artwork" like one finds in cheap hotels.  Residents had to remove all items outside our doors, including doormats, wreaths, anything interesting with personality.  Now any decoration has to be "approved" first.  Christmas used to be a riot of color down all the hallways, everybody went crazy with the decorating.  Happy.  Now it's a bore.

That disappeared recently, but it could have been at Comcast's request, not sure.  So we had to get our own cable. Pros: The location, The Cheval is in a great location, everything is uber accessible and the only real traffic problem is 610, but that's inevitable. The 2/2 layout is spacious, good setup.
Cons: Unorganized/Unprofessional - The apartment wasn't properly cleaned, the previous owners either painted areas themselves to cover up issues or their staff did a hackjob. Smoke detecters weren't installed and missing stoves pan. We discovered an old work order for the dishwasher lying around and the maintenance staff left their boxes/trash outside of our door.
Bad Management - Lease handled via email, paystubs/contracts information were lost or they were unorganized, had to send multiple copies, take screenshots, hold their hands. When issues needed to be resolved, they're words are useless ("we'll handle that tomorrow") and no-one cared to resolve the pre-existing issues stated above. Took a week and a half to get a smoke detector installed after inquiring daily. Had to email the parent company to get a response/reaction.
Slow Maintenance/Bad Management - First, maintenance has to receive a work-order from the staff, with bad staff the maintenance crew doesn't receive a timely service order. It has come to attention, by trial and error, that it takes 24-48 hours for a service order to be "observed", actual responses and when your issues will be resolved are up in the air. Week and a half so far for a dishwasher to be fixed and an Ice maker to be fixed.
Useless Amenities - The jacuzzi operates sometimes, my room-mate claims it worked once, I have yet to see it working. The activity center is worthless except for the coffee maker, which is currently broken. They have shuffleboard, fuzzball and pool. Every pool stick is damaged, the shuffleboard is in terrible condition and isn't functional, the fuzzball is cheap but it operates. The activity center is locked 6 and opens at 7:30, it's only use is mostly for coffee if you haven't left for work before 7:30. Many of the classes don't exist/canceled and the gym is a typical apartment gym. You're forced to pay $39 for satellite tv whether you want it or not, it's a $50 installation fee. AT&T seems to be the only one available here and it's terrible. There's something fishy about all of it.
Overall - The location is fantastic, everything else here is a gimmick to get you to live here, we fell for it. Can find better places for the money.

Fitness classes are nice, but not many people go and they'll cancel/not show up if there aren't enough people.  Maintenance is responsive.  I've lived here for a year and a half without many issues.  Crime doesn't seem to be much of an issue, although we do get notices on our doors if there has been a problem.  The location is convenient to get on to I10/610, and there's not much residential property around so it is a lower crime area.

Cons:  Not impressed with Baron Properties' management and customer service.  Baron just enacted a new policy of putting a notice to vacate on your door on the first day your rent is late, with no courtesy call or anything.  I know this because they didn't renew my auto-pay when I renewed my lease.  There's an extremely high employee turnover rate, I haven't seen anyone other than the managers work there for more than 3 months.  They also held complex-wide inspections and did not let you schedule an appointment.  You either had to kennel your pets or take off work for the day to ensure they don't escape.  It's pretty clear that they don't really respect their customers, and they can get away with it because the apartments are nice and in a high-demand area.

I would give them a rating in minus if I could. I am extremely disappointed with Metro Midtown and specially their management due to multiple issues that have made my living experience here very frustrating.

First and foremost, after living here for almost 1.5 years and diligently following all parking rules, I got my vehicle from California 20 days ago and changed my vehicle's license plates from California to Texas and forgot to update this information in the parking app. As a result, my car was towed from the complex this morning, and I had to pay $300 to get it back. I immediately contacted the management, explaining the situation and providing proof of my initial registration and the new license plates. Despite my good-faith efforts and clear evidence that this was an honest mistake, the management was unresponsive and unwilling to refund the towing fee.

When I went to the office to discuss this issue, one of the management persons rudely asked me to leave instead of addressing my concerns. This level of unprofessionalism is unacceptable and further demonstrates their lack of care for residents.

Adding to the frustration, the apartment complex is consistently unclean. Common areas are often dirty, and it seems like maintenance is not a priority here. Trash often piles up, and it takes an unacceptable amount of time for the management to address these issues.

Furthermore, any request for repairs, no matter how small, takes an inordinate amount of time to be addressed. I have had to wait weeks for simple repairs, which is completely unacceptable. This has significantly impacted my comfort and convenience living here.

This combination of unfair practices, poor maintenance, and slow response times has left me feeling extremely dissatisfied and undervalued as a resident. I urge anyone considering moving here to be aware of these issues before making a decision and should not move.
