The open concept between living and dining is conveniently located next to a nicely updated kitchen equipped with all new appliances.  Separate bedroom is a good size, fits a queen and multiple dressers easily. Bathroom is also brand new which has been nice. Another benefit is the three large closets. 
Building is pet friendly and located across from a lot of green space!
Only downside to the building is the slightly dark and often warm halls and elevator. This place would be perfect if it was non-smoking! Other than that, convenient and comfortable place to live. As this is a building with many units, neighboring residents are really a hit or miss.

The office personnel are very responsive to any concerns that we may have and overall the we feel everyone that’s a part of this community are good families and the maintenance staff is very responsive and very helpful and do excellent work.
There is a good place to live, clean, modern and apartments are good size.
This is the second time we have had maintenance come into our apartment for a repair and I must say it was fast and completed with no delay! Top notch! Thank you!!
The office response to any issues is excellent and the maintenance crew as well.
I love how well kept everything is and how responsive the entire staff is

Disfruto es un area , tranquila, el mantenimiento es rapido, las personas de la oficina son totalmente preparada para cualquier percanse ofrecen bastante coolaboracion en cada evento para los niños son muchas cosas buenas que ofrecen por eso me gusta mucho se respira tranquilidad y paz????
I havehad  few requests but the staff has always been  quick and respectful  getting  it done with  professional  manner.
Ive been at B.Marine for a year.The cleaning and  maintenance of the property are very professionally taken care of.  GOOD JOB!!!

Been living here for a few months and the maintenance team is always working hard to get things done. Lawn is always mowed neatly and if there are scratches in the walls they're always patching them up and painting the walls. Apartment always smells super clean, and the lounging areas are always clean. Great stuff

Overall my experience Residences at Brighton Marine has been good. The leasing office communicates very well and are involved. The maintenance on this property is very professional and timely. The building is always clean.

When you think of home you think of a place serenity. My apartment ( veterans) is just that is located near T stop and near veteran hospital and close to everything you can imagine., this is a 4 season state so if you looking to all temp I’m so happy I found this place and is brand new it has pool table small gym and also little room like mini movie theaters I thins so far is a perfect place the AC had little problem like any other new building but over all 5 start
I have to say I am shocked! I have been waiting for months for my dish washer to get fixed and the new maintanence worker was right on time. Got the job done and I did not have to keep calling.

Living in 53 Parkman Street was an absolute nightmare. The landlord is really rude, especially if you're a younger tenant. He screwed my windows shut once, which I'm fairly sure is a fire hazard. He and his wife are nosey, unfriendly, and unhelpful. The building also allows people to let themselves into your apartment without any warning, whether it be prospective renters, the landlord himself, or random people with cameras who photograph your personal belongings without any explanation. I would FIRMLY RECOMMEND finding somewhere else to live, unless you want to live with an invasive landlord, and have your privacy violated 24/7.

Ill start with they straight up lied when i moved out and said i squatted there and owed them 10,000.. Not a chance i ran from there. To be truthful wouldn't live there for free. The outside is infested with fleas and ticks. Im not taking them to court and sueing them for every penny i lost because they LIED

Nice spot in East Boston.  The one bedroom doesn't feel as small as you think it would be and there is tons of storage.  Close walk to the blue line to go into Downtown.  Great staff and the area is maintained well.
THIS COMMUNITY IS ONE OF THE BEST HERE IN EAST BOSTON .THE STAFF HERE ARE AWESOME THEY DO A GRETA JOB IN ALL AREA;S.THE PLACE IS CLEAN SAFE AND AWESOME TO LIVE HERE.
Signed an 18 month lease, at the end of the lease they wanted to raise rent 20% then docked 50% of the deposit for a magical refrigerator repair. Good luck to anyone suckered into Portside.

The location of this complex and proximity to the T can't be beat. The amenities are decent, and walkability is excellent. However, this will come at a cost - your sanity. The walls and ceilings are so thin, these are some of the things I can hear through them on a daily basis: footsteps, cell phone vibrations, entire conversations, dogs freaking out and barking 24/7 and to make it all worse, I can actually hear my neighbors upstairs peeing if i'm in the bathroom at the same time (I wish I was kidding).
 The apartments in the Meridian collection over the surface parking lot are constantly subject to noise reverberating. This has become egregious since the tall ship bar opened, and basically feels like living next to a concert venue. Not to mention, the building now feels like a college dorm with people constantly screaming, partying, and generally being super loud on their baclonies - and you'll hear every word of it whether you want to or not.

While my experience with maintenance has been good, they drive around in something that sounds like a lawnmower (often times before 7 am, multiple days a week) through that parking lot and loudly drag dumpsters. I understand some of this can't be avoided, but again, just be prepared to be on everyone else's schedule but your own if you ever want to get sleep living in this section of the building.

The main concierge staff is super nice, building management is hit or miss, with some being absolutely horrendous to deal with and very few being pleasant. Save yourself the exorbitant rent and move to a smaller building.

DO NOT rent from Portside at East Pier, I was treated horribly. I had an apartment chosen, but lost my job due to COVID. They did not give me my security deposit of $1000 back, even though most buildings are doing so in these cases(my Real Estate agent confirmed this). The Director of Operations was extremely unpleasant to work with during this difficult time, and the leasing office was extremely unresponsive to my agent. When I'm reemployed, I will NOT be renting here.  I completely understand why so many of their apartments are vacant.

Awesome place to live, hate to be leaving. The amenities are unmatched by anything else around town.  The staff are as friendly, responsive and incredibly helpful now as they were when we first moved in. The buildings and grounds are kept in excellent condition all year round. It is an extremely pet friendly community, when our dog ran away it felt like the entire building was out looking for him.  It also has an indoor and outdoor pet run area with a dog wash and grooming station. The neighborhood has a lot to offer especially if you are looking for good food. They have also done a great job with the development of the harbor walk area and are  expanding Piers Park. 

Overall great experience, great staff, great neighbors, a block away from the T  and the best view of the Boston skyline that you can get. Most importantly it is very reasonably priced by Boston standards. I will definitely miss this place.

It looks nice, but there are numerous reasons to look elsewhere: rude management; lost packages; and an extreme amount of noise coming from the unit above are just three of those reasons. So disappointed with this apartment. 

Moved in in May, have become even more disappointed as time has passed. The keys are electric and recently decided myself and my roommate don’t live here; we were locked out, after work, without a way to fix it until the leasing office opened and we found a “convenient” time to go have our keys reset. Also, the shaking and noise experienced on our porch from the people upstairs is so intense it has made more than 1 guest not want to sit outside because they’re uncomfortable being on the porch with it shaking. They also took it upon themselves to put a sticker on my car that now won’t come off. Like I said, not worth it.
We regret our experience living in this building. The management was rude and unprofessional. The building was not designed and constructed against noise. Complete waste of money.

Our stay in this apartment was a complete waste of money. The management was very rude and unprofessional. They lie and they are not reliable. Building is built with very cheap materials and is not resistance to noise. Unit's appliances and facilities do not work properly and they are cheap quality. We lived in several luxury buildings and the experience in this building was nothing close to luxury living that they advertise.

For the high rent that they charge and their advertisement of luxury apartment, living in this building complex was nothing close to what we expected and it was a bad disappointment since we had sincerely looked forward to our stay there. I think with paying few thousands dollar of rent, tenants at least deserve peace and respect at their home.

They "boss" around and disregard you if you have concerns or questions.The building is not properly designed and constructed to proof the outside and exterior noise. There were ongoing multiple major construction activities around the building.  The construction trucks, activities and back up beep and alarm noise start from 7am and go all the way till 7pm, Monday through Saturday. There was also a fire department building one block away in Sumner St, in case you have sensitivity to every hour fire and emergency noise. Sumner St, and Marginal St were also usually conducting heavy and industrial trucks. In addition, Building is very close to airport and the noise isolation in walls and around windows are not installed in a way to block such constant loud noise. lastly, If you are renting in the new building, your unit may face the main outdoor patio, which seemed to be crowded with about 15-30 people who loudly grill and play until passed 10pm. Utilities were not paid and not included in the rent. Expect Water&Sewer and Electricity bills "each" for $150-$250 per month. Appliances in the unit were cheap quality and did not work properly. Windows screens were damaged and bugs could get in. Windows blinders were cheap quality.

I was really taken back by what happened to us yesterday at Portside at East Pier. Since December, We have been in touch with the leasing office there directly and we finally went to the appointment to take a look yesterday. 
We currently live in NY and we had to reserve flights and hotel to come take a look at the place. Needless to say we were really excited to look at the place.
Our appointment was at 5:30pm, we took uber from my work in financial district at 5pm sharp. Uber took a wrong exit at the tunnel and we came right back to the financial district... At that point we knew we would be late about 10 mins max so we called the office to let them know we were running late. We got there at 5:39- 9 mins late to our appointment and when we got there, the leasing director(?) Frank told us we can't look at the place because we were late. We begged him to take a look at the property very quickly. He kept saying this is our policy and we can't show you. If I show it to you, I would be unfair to other people. I thought we were the renter? He insisted he can't show us the place. We had to leave... without seeing the place which we have been looking forward to see since December... We spent time and money to come look at it all the way from NYC. We need to move for 3/1 lease and we were really disappointed and somehow found Frank's behavior very rude and unreasonable. I am not sure what kind of "policy" you set at your company but I thought someone high up, who really has the view of investors who wants to fill apartments, can hear what kind of experience even other people than us could be experiencing onsite. This was a huge waste of time.

Are we not allowed to give 0 stars? Well then, the view is the only reason I'll give it 1 star. The management team is terrible. Try calling them during the day anytime from Monday to Friday 8am-5pm and I GUARANTEE they won't answer. They are terrible at helping you with anything. Very condescending and they act like pricks. They'll be so nice when you sign the lease of course, but they will not ever help you with anything from that point on. It's pathetic. Newer apartments are coming to Eastie so please go there instead, these people are genuinely the laziest. On top of that, they charged me $850 when I moved out, even though our apartment was spotless. Literally the worst and laziest management team. 

Even the view is just surrounded by teenagers smoking weed. The hallways smell like weed. The gym is tiny and the internet doesn't work there. Unless you live on the top floor you will hear EVERYTHING happening above you, it's unbearable at times. Dogs are barking all the time, and the walls are paper thin, so you will hear your neighbors. The "events" consist of a small table with 5 granola bars up for grabs while two people talk at you about things you don't need. The construction happening around the building will keep you up all morning, they start very early. Other than that, maintenance is great and so is the concierge. But what's the point if the person running the show is terrible at their job? Don't waste your money here. Better options are out there

We chose this place about 3 years ago and we certainly don't regret it. We are fully enjoying our experience at Portside Eastpier
Beside being in a great location, 5 min from the city, the surrounding is great. 
The management team is wonderful, always available to help you at anytime. The maintenance & cleaning crew are amazing to keep this place neat & clean. We don't want to forget the concierge team who is fantastic. 
We are also looking forward to visit the new building with more and more amenities. 
New in Boston or looking for an amazing place to live ? Portside Eastpier.....

Making a move across country is never easy! However, when my wife and I moved from Indiana to Boston so that I could attend dental school we were lucky enough to find Portside at East Pier to call our new home for the next 4 years. The community within Portside is wonderful including the cleaning ladies, concierge, leasing staff, and the other residents. Not only are the individuals at Portside great, but also the location is second to none. We are 1 stop from the airport, 1 stop from the North End with great food and bars, and just 2 stops to the Orange Line which allows us to venture to the other places we need to go…and if you don’t feel like taking the T across the water residents get to use the water taxi for $5 a person! The well-designed apartments, beautiful view, quietness we get on this side of the water, and all that was mentioned above have all made the experience in Boston great for my wife and I. We can’t wait for phase 2 to finish up that will offer a rooftop hang out area, larger gym, and a pool!

I have lived here for a year and a half, the views are stunning but the AC unit breaks frequently and the management staff is absolutely horrible. Very rude and condescending, which wasn't apparent when I first moved in but became a pain in time as they get involved in every little aspect of your life to make it more difficult and charge expensive hidden fees that they don't tell you about in the beginning.
I regret having lived there.

We rented a beautiful apartment with a great location (within steps from the Maverick T station), modern layout and a great view.  The building is new, with modern appliances including washer and dryer inside the unit (a rarity in the area).  It was nice to work directly with management making the application process less tedious and avoiding the nuisance of intermediaries.  After 1 year living here, unexpected circumstances oblige us to move but if I ever come back to the Boston area I would not hesitate to give Portside at East Pier a call.

I've been living at Portside for a little over a month now. My partner and I couldn't be happier with our new one bedroom apartment. From the quality of the amenities to the ease of paying rent online, Portside has exceeded all of our expectations. Furthermore, all of the staff is extremely friendly and are always willing to help and the people who live in the buildiing are all very nice as well and always say hi. Also, managment tries to make a point of holding events for residents, as a way to get residents to know each other, which I really like.  However, aside from the aprtment itself, the best part of living here is the view--you can't beat it! The view of downtown and the financial distrct from the pier right outside the builing is incredible and is definitely my favorite part about living here.

Great place right on Boston Harbor. The City is visible from the back of the complex with a great view. Very clean and friendly staff. Right near Maverick T station on the blue line. Super easy to get into Boston. Very nice on the inside as well! Great place overall!

Zero property management- when they do respond they’re useless, rodents with no solution, leaks that management avoids for days. Save yourselves a year of aggravation and look elsewhere there are plenty of good places in the area other than this.

We are very happy to live here. The cleaners clean up on time every day, and every corner is super clean. Any questions you have can be answered promptly. The management of this building is outstanding!

The building has great maintenance. It is within walking distance of food stores , cinema , libraries and many restaurants. It is near public transportation providing access to museums and medical providers. Our 14 years here have been great.

I have lived at Beacon Park for many years and could not be happier. Great location in Coolidge Corner featuring many amenities including indoor parking, fitness room, modern appliances including microwave and dishwasher, laundry room on each floor and heat and AC included in the rent to name a few.
On site property manager and maintenance staff who are very responsive to any issues, small or big. I highly recommend this property as having great value.

We have lived here for 10 years, so many improvements have been made to the units like new appliances, beautiful counter tops and flooring. A small but very convenient gym was also added. The green C line is across the street and the D line a 10 minute walk. But there is also an indoor garage, which works great during those snowy days. We have used the community room for birthday parties as well as the outdoor space for small get togethers. The elevators are a great plus and a rarity in Brookline.

Let's go over the cons first:
1. There isn't any parking spots. It is all street parking. 
2. The studio apartments can be a little small.
3. In my experience the studio kitchens can have issues with counter space (i.e., wowie that's not a lot of counter space). But we added in a shelf area and it's fine now.
4. Not all the units are owned by the same company so you may encounter communication issues between maintenance people (for example, if your shower is leaking and it's from the unit upstairs and your unit is owned by someone else--there may be some instances where the two property management places aren't the greatest at communicating with each other).
5. Not so much bad as it is weird but the mailbox to send mail out is 1/2 block down the street. I'm not sure why it is but it's the only closest mailbox we can find. However, there is a mailbox unit for the apartment complex for incoming mail and that's great.
6. No washer or dryers, laundry mat is across the street though.

Now for the pros!
1. GREAT LOCATION! It's literally right next to a T stop, as well as close to the 86 bus stop, and it's right next to a stop for the Boston College shuttle. It's also a short walk to the C and D line. 
2. Very safe and quiet. It's right next to a Jewish temple and mosque. Despite being close to the road, I've never had issues with it being noisy.
3. There's a cute backyard where you can let your dogs run around plus the tree coverage is A .
4. The apartments themselves are very cute and easy to clean. They are hardwood floors (nicely maintained for an older building) and there are lots of big windows for natural light (which is a big plus for me). 
5. The maintenance people arrive very quickly and get the problems done.
6. Close to a Whole Foods and Star Market (as well as a Trader Joe's if you want to use the C line which is a five minute walk from the building).
7. Pet friendly! I have tons of neighbors with dogs and cats, we have a cat as well. Great location for having a pet.
8. Right across the street is a park. It's smaller but very clean and kid friendly, there's an attached playground that's super nice. The park itself is pretty new.
9. Easy access to restaurants and cafe. Around the corner there is Fuel Cafe and little places to eat, and you're right across the street from a Japanese restaurant, Thai restaurant, and corner store.

Overall: I love it here. It's peace and quiet in the city. Great place for families and students.

Managed by the Chiswick Building Company, this Chiswick Arms property is a step above your average Brighton apartment complex. A one bedroom here can be up to 800 Sq feet making it one of the more spacious options available. Private parking is available behind the building for an additional fee. There's even a large coin-op laundry room in the basement. Overall, the units are dated but nevertheless well maintained. The on site superintendent is quick to respond to any issues that arise. This is a great spot for younger professionals looking to stay near the action of Brighton. The neighborhood is family-friendly and safe. Transit is right outside your door. It is difficult to find a better unit for the price.

I recently completed a one-year stay in a studio apartment at The Anchorage Apartments. When I moved in, the unit was clean and ready for occupancy. Throughout my stay, I only had to contact maintenance twice: once to fix a closet door and another time to unclog the bathroom sink. Each time, Gerry, the maintenance superintendent, responded promptly and handled the issues with utmost professionalism and respect. The building has seen positive changes with the new building manager, who has excelled at keeping the community informed about ongoing construction and maintenance projects. Communication has been clear and timely, making life much easier for all residents.
One of the highlights of my lease was that my unit was free from any pests—no bugs or mice—and I never had concerns about safety-no stolen packages. The hallways were always secure, with the only unfamiliar faces being food delivery personnel. The communal amenities, especially the laundry facilities, were well-maintained. The washing and drying machines were regularly cleaned and serviced. Although there were some recent issues with the laundry card loading machine, the management quickly addressed and resolved them, ensuring minimal inconvenience. I would have renewed my lease without hesitation if I had needed to stay in the area longer.

I have been a resident in this community for almost 5 years, and unfortunately, we are facing ongoing challenges related to stolen packages and a mice infestation. Regrettably, two of my packages, delivered to the mail/package room, were stolen on 11/19/2022 and 11/16/2023. Despite the efforts of Hannah and Gerry to review security footage, no leads were found. Once packages are taken from the package room, recovery becomes nearly impossible.

Concerning the mice issue, Hannah and Gerry have been very supportive. Upon reporting the issue in July 2022, they provided multiple sticky mouse glue boards. Gerry inspected for possible entry points and sealed them with metal mesh under the sink. I personally captured 6 mice within 4 days, and later, an exterminator set up poison bait under the sink. Although Hannah shared insights on the potential sources of the mice, the problem persists. Even with the poison bait, I can still hear mice activity inside the walls every few months (especially when people are moving in/out). At least I haven't caught any in my apartment anymore.

Good location, great staff, clean. It is actually more like a low income senior housing building though. Many elderly hang in the lobby and just basically mill around. Not really a bad situation though.

The Anchorage, my home, I've stayed for almost 3 years. It was clean, neat, staffs were great and kind. They were always prompt responder to my callings even my emails. It was a pleasure to stay at the Anchorage. I really missed there.

I lived at the Anchorage for almost one year and all I have to say is good words! First, the price is fair enough compared to the surrounding area. The neighborhood is quiet and with easy access to the best places in town. The manager office is fast to fix any kind of problems. And last but not least,  it is located in a gorgeous area in the heart of Navy Yard!

WARNING- DO NOT SIGN A LEASE HERE. 
They say usually when something is too good to be true, it usually is and this is the case with this building. Take the fact that the rent being much lower than any other building/apartments in Charlestown as a giant red flag. 

The apartment is full of strange tenants, the walls are paper thin and though the management is fairly quick to address problems that may arise their solution to fix them is strictly cosmetic. 99% of the time the same problem will occur again within the month. 

On top of that, The Anchorage is listed as a 'strictly no smoking' resident building. Yet it would take you 5 seconds after walking in the door to see how "strict" that policy really is. I would bet more than 50% of tenants smoke and it drifts into the hallway and neighboring units. Not only is this completely illegal but it is a serious health hazard to those who are involuntarily consuming second hand smoke on a regular basis. 

Laundry is $6.00 for 1 wash and 1 dry with the machine. Yet, more often than not, you return to get your clothes from the dryer and they are extremely damp. On average, I usually am able to do 1 load of laundry for about $9.00.

Gym-If you want the convenience of a place to run-ok. But there are 2 set's of dumbbells, 15lb and 20 lb and 1 exercise ball that probably has never been blown up since management bought it some odd years ago. 

Package Delivery- Better order your valuable merchandise and send it to a friend. Packages are left in 1 of 2 places: at the door of the building where they are unsecured or  in the lobby, piled up on the floor instead of in a locked door where they are designated to go. I've witnessed management walking by packages left out dozens of times. Disappointing. 

I could keep going. But anyone who may read this will get the point. I refuse to exhaust any more energy on trying to fight a pointless battle. I was a fool for not listening to the reviews I read before I signed a lease. Hopefully, you don't make the same mistake I did.

I have been living here for over a year and I am not planning to leave anytime soon  the  property is well maintained and clean the apartments are just beautiful and the management office have the best people I have ever dealt with

The place is a dump.filthy rugs in the halls,parking lot needs to be done over when the pool is opened its a puplic pool for the neighborhood kids.when you complain about it they say they have no one to monitor the pool.The live in janitor is never around,and only complains when you ask him for anything.I am not an angry tenant just telling the truth about this place.Leaving when lease is up like many other tenants.DO YOURSELF A FAVOR DO NOT RENT HERE....................................

Roaches. The units themselves aren’t bad and at an okay price but this building is absolutely infested. I do not cook or leave a speck of food out in fear of the amount of cockroaches I find in my spotless unit. I am even sleeping on my couch and friends couches since seeing one in my bed a week or so ago. Even hygiene Is suffering because every time I shower there is a good chance I will see a cockroach. Please save yourself the mental anguish and pay a little more to actually be able to use your kitchen and sleep at night.

I have lived here for 4 years,  this is a very very quiet neighborhood and friendly neighbors. Maintenance response is timely and great location. You can walk to the Dedham Mall and easy to access many great locations.

I have been trying to get in touch, for a rental. There were three apartments available and the manager never answered the phone.

This place is so poorly managed and the units have mice and roaches. There is no common areas outside of the property as there is barely enough space to park your car. 
The windows are old and drafty and the building has lots of drug dealers and noisy neighbors. I wouldn't live here if you paid me to. 
It was the worst experience of my life! Run for the hills and safe yourself a lot of grief!!! I wish someone had given me this review before I got locked into a years lease. Thank goodness I am finally free to the mayhem!!!

This is the perfect building if you want a quick walk to the metro, great restaurants and outdoor space. The common areas are well maintained and staff incredibly helpful. Unlike other apartments in this area, it has a large courtyard with a pool, lounge chairs and dining tables. It’s like having a touch of country right in the middle of the city.
I have lived here for over a year and absolutely love living here! From the staff in the office to the very responsive maintenance team there is no better bang for your dollar living in Boston!

I am so happy with my new apartment in Ridgecrest Village. It is beautifully maintained and the atmosphere is really pleasant. My neighbors a quiet and there are two gyms on sight, one being right across the road from my apartment. There is also a beautiful pool that is open for summer and it is also quiet!

Apartments are mostly well kept and service people are fabulous if you need anything.  Great location, close to shopping, dining, highway, good area.  Fitness centers, pool and on site (paid) parking are great vs. renting houses.  Neighbors are good.  Only one negative - if you live on the side of the building near the parking lot, the noise is intensified and you can hear every word, door slam, garbage toss, etc.

I called to help someone with section 8 find an apartment. When I asked if they accept section 8, they replied, "We accept section 8 as long it covers the entirety of the rent." I said "section 8 only covers 2/3 of the rent and there is no section 8 voucher that covers 100%, so you don't accept section 8". She replied again with "we accept it as long as it covers the entirety of the rent." I just said so actually, you don't accept it because your policy is a catch 22. What a terrible way to do business!
The woman who answered the phone had not clued of what was available or the rates. It makes me wonder, what kind of property Management Company is this?

Worst customer service ever! Leasing staff was extrely rude. They advertise the wrong rates. I called several times over a period of 2 weeks the rates never matched what is advertised. The short and heavy blond leasing woman showed us a smelly apartment in a deserted building covered by bushes down the street. When asked if the building is also managed by their company she said they only have a select few units in that building. We entered through the back. It appears to be the place they take unwelcomed prospects. When asked if I could see the amenities and parking area she said he did not have any keys to access the front entrance, parking area or amenities.

The apartment is a decent place to live as long as you’re willing to pay way too much for a very small space. Everything they advertise has a catch. The concierge seems great until they are disrespectful, careless, and generally absent from the desk. The instant water seems great except for the fact that it breaks all the time and we went the entire winter without hot water this year. You will get mail from at least the last 3 tenants, the view is cool but gets old quick, and the closet space should be criminal. When I first moved in the AC was unreal and this year it barely works. Nothing ever goes right here. At least you can do laundry now that they got new machines, I had to drive to friends houses for 9 months to do mine. Wondering how long it’ll take them to fix the next thing that breaks…. If you have the money, spend it somewhere else. If you are stretching your budget for the “luxury” of this place, please don’t. Just go to the south end.
they have recently renewed the apartments and it's very close to CVS and other cheap-small eating joints!

I applied for a 1 bedroom at The Apartments at Coolidge School in Watertown over two months ago and never heard a single thing back about my application. 
I don't understand why they bother 
to advertise these apartments and provide applications if they don't intend to follow up. 
Needless to say I chose to look elsewhere.

I’ve lived here for a number of years.  The building and individual apartments are almost adequately cared for but getting things repaired is an ongoing struggle with management.  All work is done to minimum stanads and simple things like repairs to appliances can thane months or more.  Whatever needs attention on the day you move in will still require it the day you move out.

It’s a great location and quiet for the most part. But if you want something fixed, good luck, because Akelius does not care. We now have one functional washing machine for the entire 40 apartment complex. The other two have been broken for nearly a year. Akelius doesn’t care. Had a leak in the apartment upstairs from mine, took Akelius upwards of a month to come fix the damage. They treat tenants like cash piñatas and then do not stay beholden to the maintenance clauses on the lease.

The surrounding area is too loud with the train right outside, the police and emergency vehicles going by constantly and the college students having parties. People have had dogs in this building that bark from 4am until 7am multiple times a week. The maintenance team is abysmal, and the leasing property is unresponsive. Will not be staying when our lease is up.

I was calling about a 3/2 bedroom  and for a week my phone calls and emails went unanswered then i asked were they closed she proceeded to say what can i help you with very rudely. I then asked about the availability of a 3/2 she said people don't move out here. I am from Florida and looking t move but i can guarantee I wont move here.

This is the worst place I lived so far! This is not a safe place to move in. Police is in the building in every week and breaking neighbors doors. Already 3 of my packages got stolen and the management doesn’t care about it. Fire alarm goes off in every week, last time was at 5 am. I have 4 more months left and can’t wait to move out!

This property has a great location, but who lived there has ruined this place. I have 2 months left in my agreement, but I cant wait to move out. Neighbors will have party over the night. They yell and scream till 3 or 4 am. And it is useless to make a complaint, the management will do nothing about it.

I moved into Presidium in November, and my experience has been chaotic, with repairs being ignored and serious breaches of privacy. Maintenance entered my apartment without consent while my wife and I were at work, which we caught on camera. As a Muslim, ensuring my wife’s privacy and safety is a priority, and this blatant disregard for boundaries is unacceptable. Despite my clear notes in the maintenance app, Bianca ignored them, and the office violated lease terms, specifically Chapter 14.

When I confronted Bailey about the situation, she dismissed my concerns, claiming she thought I was home and had spoken to Bianca—highlighting their poor communication. Instead of addressing their mistakes, Bailey called me rude for standing up for our privacy. What’s truly rude is marking work orders as “completed” when they’re not. When I asked Bailey about it, her response was, “We can’t have work orders open for several days.” That’s when rent deductions should come into play, not deception.

Safety is also a major issue here. My wife and I nearly got mugged, and when I originally signed the lease, I was told there was an officer on duty. After signing, Bianca changed her statement, saying they are only “on call.” That’s misleading and shady.

To make matters worse, our window has been broken for five months, yet it keeps getting labeled as “completed.” Lucas claims it’s under warranty, yet nothing has been done. Instead of fixing issues, management has resorted to ignoring my texts and emails, refusing to provide the district manager’s contact information, and even banning me from the office simply for asking for accountability. Lucas accused me of cursing in the office and claimed to have video proof—but has yet to show it.

Enough is enough. Tenants deserve honesty, respect, and accountability, not gaslighting and false accusations. I expect the unjust ban to be lifted and an apology for the privacy invasion. Presidium needs to do better.

(Photos attached for proof.)

I had the pleasure of touring this community and I was blown away by the amenities, the apartment finishes and the customer service. This community is in the PERFECT location for someone looking to live in Austin close enough to get to downtown or the Domain quickly but far enough away to not get caught in all the traffic. I personally love the amount of “green” space.. a walking trail, beautiful mature trees and courtyards really add that Austin and comfort touch. Not to mention, the staff is so kind and friendly. Bailee really took her time in finding me the perfect apartment and I look forward to all this community has to offer. 10/10 recommend! See for yourself.

The rent is a little high, but can you blame them? This place is beautiful and it has so much to offer. Management is very helpful, as is maintenance, and I have no complaints for the neighbors or anyone overall. I love living here and look forward to getting to live here for a long time.

At first this apartment seems really nice, in a central location with amenities built in to the complex, washer and dryer units, internet, a fitness center. over the last couple of years the management company started moving away from prioritizing renting room-to-room to college students towards renting towards non-student adults on fixed unit contracts, in my opinion as part of the gentrification of riverside over the last couple of years (many other complexes nearby are being torn down to build high-rises or commercial buildings). there are some issues that seem minor but can really magnify problems living here if you have the misfortune of experiencing them. the apartment managers are extremely hard to get on the phone when there is an issue, always requiring in person discussion to get anything solved. the location has been targeted by Airbnb companies, and it seems like many of the units have been taken over by these, with short term Airbnb guests constantly coming and going. if you have the bad luck of living near one of these units, especially below one, the noise level, especially footsteps, will be constant and very loud, as the floors are extremely thin, and the apartment management will not be able to fix this as they prioritize the Airbnb companies renting large numbers of units from them, with new Airbnb guests turning over weekly. unlike many other apartments, this complex does not have ordinary open parking for residents, instead you have to register your car with a tow company contracted by the apartment to prevent them from towing your car without warning, despite the fact that the apartment advertises themselves as a gated property. it is gated, but it is more frequent that the gates are fixed open than closed, allowing anyone to enter whenever they like. the tow company was contracted due to the fact that this complex has many short-term Airbnb guests parking in unmarked free parking spaces; they created a problem of short-term guests parking in these unmarked parking spaces next to apartment buildings, and decided to solve it by towing cars instead of assigning parking for each unit or labeling certain spaces for residents and some for guests. if you get lucky enough to live in a unit without any Airbnbs nearby or don't mind constant new people coming and going around you, or don't think you will need the management team to answer the front desk phones, then this complex is good enough for a place to live, but I do not recommend it.

Went to look at an apartment here a few weeks back, really enjoyed the office staff and how kind they were. They had some awesome common spaces such as a sand volleyball court, gym, pool, and study spaces. Possibly looking to lease in the near future. My wife and I are still trying to make a decision. 10/10 recommend based on what we looked at.

This place is beautiful, from the moment you walk in vaulted ceilings, it’s bright, and so refreshing. Living in Austin you can go from one extreme to the next with Village it seems so peaceful. The property has awesome trees throughout that make it feel like you’re away from the city. Staff seems to be very sweet and helpful. The package room is so convenient as it’s located at the front of the community and had easy access, having nice amenities is definitely a perk. I am just thankful that the apartment I’ve gotten into is renovated, spacious, and feels like home. I leased a two bedroom so it comes with two bathrooms it works perfect for a roommate style if you would like however mine is just set up for an additional office space. Will continue to update throughout the stay!

I have consistently experienced the best residential support services of my life with Hilltop Property Management. The staff are friendly and helpful… Anytime I have submitted a maintenance request I have received a prompt response. Whether it was changing light bulbs, replacing/removing furniture, or servicing the plumbing and electricity, maintenance quickly and thoroughly ensured that I have an optimal living environment. I intend to continue renting from Hilltop for the remainder of my time living in an apartment, and I strongly recommend their properties to all of the incoming families in the Austin area. In some ways, your property management company can make or break your living experience and with Hilltop, it’s all in the service. I couldn’t be happier!

We were very excited about moving in to MAA West but after just a few days living here, realized how many issues there really are. The apartments are beautiful from the outside and in a great neighborhood (though right next to the highway). The insides are pretty nice, too, even though the unit we moved into had a ton of unfixed damages from the previous tenant. 
1. Whoever planned the apartments may have been under the influence. It sounds like a joke, but I am serious. Light switches EVERYWHERE instead of one all-in-one panel and some at different heights. As an example, there are 4 light switches all within 5ft of each other in our living room. Doors open into each other, dryer is hard to access without trapping yourself in the corner, etc.
2. Management is uncommitted and seems to not really care about the residents at all. When you first move in, you can only pick up your keys from 9am to 4pm which is very inconvenient for people who have jobs (all of us? lol). There are constantly complaints on the resident portal about packages being stolen, to the point that most residents have had to purchase ring doorbells. The same pieces of trash have been in the hallway since we moved in nearly a month ago... not sure if maintenance/cleaning even exists here or if residents are expected to clean up trash that isn't theirs. Upon signing the lease, residents are asked for their preferred name but it is never used in correspondence.
3. Parking garage -  We were never told that there is an option to buy a reserved parking space ($60/month) and upon the second day of living there, realized parking is a major problem. If you are not home by 6pm, you will likely need to park on the rooftop. The layout of the parking garage is also an issue because anyone can get in the garage at any time, even without a FOB; all they need to do is wait for someone behind them to let them in, which happens daily since there is only one gate and no way to turn around once you go in the garage. 
We just moved in, so I have a feeling this is just the start....

My experience at MAA West Austin has been far from satisfactory. I feel let down by the management for several reasons:

Security letdown: One of their maintenance workers allegedly stole from my place, raising concerns about their hiring process and overall security measures. We had to hire a separate cleaning service at our own expense, as the management refused to reimburse us. Additionally, we had to invest in extra security measures like a Ring camera and storage space due to their security shortcomings.

Lackluster response: The management's actions in response to the incident were inadequate. While they quickly cleaned up the broken glass, the overall cleaning was not thorough, and no comprehensive solution was offered for our safety.

Financial burden: Despite being a loyal tenant facing unexpected financial difficulties, the management refused to waive or reduce the termination fee, leaving me in a difficult situation.

Noisy nightmare: The apartment's proximity to a busy highway, which was conveniently undisclosed, resulted in constant noise from cars, trains, and whistles, making it nearly impossible to concentrate or enjoy a peaceful living environment.

Lack of transparency: Important details, such as the lack of soundproofing, were not disclosed prior to moving in, leading to frustration and disappointment.

Maintenance mishaps: My report of a malfunctioning garage door went unresolved, highlighting a lack of attention to tenant concerns.

Package theft: Package theft is a recurring issue at MAA West Austin. The management's response has been disappointing, with little effort to address the problem. The garage door and entry gate are often left open, making it easy for thieves to target deliveries. Their focus seems to be more on catching dog owners who don't clean up after their pets rather than tracking down package thieves.

In conclusion, my experience with MAA West Austin has been highly unsatisfactory. I urge prospective renters to reconsider their choice and explore better alternatives.

At first glance, this place is awesome - but there's a lot to know.

The Good:
- Located within easy distance to downtown, nearby HEB and quick food options, but also feels a little more residential so running/walking isn't too conguested
- Updated apartments with nice countertops and appliances
- Nest thermostat and Google Fiber are both nice to have
- The bathtubs: the best part - perfect for soaking

The Bad:
- Package service isn't actually available anymore as the office won't recieve packages; if someone attempts to surprise you with a gift or if your box won't fit in a standard locker, you'll have to get it at the carrier's office.
- Parking, while free, is tough depending on your unit. Some units have very little space not allocated to carports/garages so you may end up parking a bit away from your actual building, which can get uncomfortable to walking in (especially with groceries) during the summer, winter and rainy days. 
- 'Gated' is not what it sounds like. There is technically a gate around the property but the entrance is always open so there's the convenience of not having to deal with it but the downside of paying for 'security' in that regard. Plus, you can only use the front gates for entering/exiting, even if you live at the far back of the complex. Also, gate codes don't actually get assigned - and when they do, don't actually work.
- Ignore their notes about a 'sauna' and 'social activites.' 

The Moderate:
- The gym and pool are both nice but not always great. The pool spends large spans of time during all seasons unattended, and the gym is often short of supplies (including non-working machines)
- Maintenance staff are actually really nice but a lot of issues like misfunctioning toilets and blown heat or AC pop up regularly and there doesn't seem to be a proper fix for them.
- Communication is like pulling teeth sometimes. You'll get a response, and their response times are faster, but it might not actually have an answer. More non-answers really - a little gaslighting in all honesty. Any major issues it'll be a hands-off communication style until they get pushed hard enough to actually provide a response. 

Overall: not a bad place if you like the area and want updated units but remember that living here comes with (or without) a lot of smaller, often forgot about things in the home searching process.

I’ve noticed the main community center is used for coworkering or students studying. We like the proximity to the train.

The main pool has been closed for over a month, and I haven't seen any work being done to fix it before summer. Whenever I check, no one is there working on it. When you ask about it, they assure you they're working on it, but it's clear no one has been working at the pool to fix what the problem is. (ITS BEEN A MONTH NOW YALL) They suggest using the south pool, but it's a tiny pool that's not very enjoyable. It seems likely the main pool won't be fixed until winter. Woohoo, a year without a pool!

Windows and walls are thin and we can hear everything everywhere around the apartment. The vibration makes it worse than living on the street.

Maintenance requested are often ignored and rejected.

Trespassers and unauthorized personnel always occupy the clubhouse.

Management won't do anything and is not responsive.

We love cleanliness everywhere! Modern style! And also, all the managers are great professionals, pleasant communication and help in various matters, especially thanks to Keaton. Several of our friends are already interested and are also planning to rent.

I’ve had a very frustrating experience living at AMLI Lakeline. While the location is convenient, the management makes living here a constant headache with their excessive hidden fees and unfair violation charges.

First off, the fees here are outrageous. They charge for everything under the sun, from "administration fees" to "service charges", none of which are clearly explained upfront. On top of that, the violation fees are completely unreasonable. I’ve been hit with charges for minor things that shouldn’t even be considered violations, and it feels like they’re just trying to find ways to nickel-and-dime tenants.

The building itself is poorly managed and maintained. Their cleaning standards are very low, the pet smell are strong near the side door. That security door has broken so many times in one year. But they spend a lot of time finding a way to harshly check things like your patio, your trash, your pet litter, which is completely unfair. For example, I bought a $200 tool to keep my patio clean every week, but despite my efforts, I was still cited for having a patio with "urine-like stains" and yellow discoloration. That is from the stone color!!

To make matters worse, the management is unresponsive and unhelpful when it comes to maintenance requests. I’ve had ongoing issues with my AC and dishwasher, and despite multiple attempts to get these problems addressed, I either get no response or vague explanations that don’t lead anywhere. It feels like they’re intentionally dragging their feet to avoid handling basic issues.

I’ve lived in several apartments over the years, and I’ve never encountered a place where it feels like the management is so focused on finding ways to charge tenants at every opportunity, while providing such poor customer service and maintenance support.

Do NOT rent here. They re nice at first before you sign the lease then it’s hell. There’s no cellphone signal. There’s dog poop on the hallways. The dog areas are gross. They’re rude and no one ever answers the phone. Not only that at the end they’ll try to charge you to change a whole carpet because you were the unlucky person to have rented on the second year of life of the carpet so you they want to assign you the honor of charging you to replace the whole thing. The carpet was not damaged by the way they were just trying to make some money off of us. When we fought for what was right they ignored emails and calls. In the end they pretended we didn’t want to pay and sent our account to collections. Ridiculous because we were the ones trying to get ahold of them! Horrible experience, horrible apartment complex, horrible management. 

Oh, I hope the garage gates are fixed because when we moved in they were “not functioning” and when we left a year later the gates were still missing. You really don’t get what you pay for.

If you value sleep then stay away. Fire alarms go off all the time for no reason. Security is bad, they never fix anything. If a cold front is coming you better run, since the fire alarm will go off nearly nonstop for days as the building is so cheaply constructed that below 32 degrees all the pipes spontaneously explode. They also have frequent power outages so live here if you enjoy the dark ages.

I recently moved into The Elizabeth and I have to say, the beginning was a little rocky but at the end of the day I believe it's how you handle situations that shows your true colors. The management and staff bent over backwards to make everything right and have done just that. I have to say, I'm looking forward to my time living here as it's such a beautiful property and in the perfect location.
Thank you to everyone at The Elizabeth for everything you've done to make this feel like home.

The maintenance staff are good guys, but management and security are atrocious. Management is incredibly rude and unwilling to hear out residents' concerns. If you live here, your car will likely be broken into at least once, so be prepared and be sure to not leave any valuables in your vehicle. "Security" is one guy who drives by on occasion, takes a picture to prove he was there, and then drives away. The tow truck stops by much more frequently to tow your car or your guest's car even if registered. Would not recommend moving here.

Great property - most bang for your buck in Austin. I only have positive things to say about the property and overall leasing experience. Management & maintenance has been especially helpful and ensured my time here has been seamless and stress-free. Highly recommend!

I have been living here for about 4 months and it has been nothing short of amazing. I’d like to note that signing here was a last minute decision for me, but was made SO easy and the staff was incredibly helpful. This community is quiet, clean, safe, and fun! I love the amenities and great community. I can’t wait to resign!!! Thank you 44 south for building and upholding such a great environment to live!

This property is amazing. I went about searching multiple location from South Austin, Downtown and the Domain. 44 South had a great special and I was truly happy with the technology features and amenities found in this beautiful mid-rise community. The office team, Theresa and Tristian are super helpful and friendly! This is a fantastic location for myself to easily get onto i35 for work when I travel and sneak away to The Yard (St. Elmo district) for fun activities and dining. If you are searching for your next home, look no further! 44 South is captures the fun vibe of South Austin with great venues just moments away.

I am a current resident at The Grand. The new management has just dissolved the concierge service completely despite this being the amenity that led many residents to lease here. There’s is no representative onsite any longer. Because of this, there are now homeless people in the garage, car break ins, packages laying all around the building for anyone to grab, and an overall lack of safety. I’m not sure what other amenities they will completely dissolve or start charging for next. This place has been going downhill for the past year. Stay far away. I’d recommend The Bowen for an actual luxury experience in the Domain. Or one of the more affordable buildings as they probably have the same amenities this place has now. Really sad to see this place so mismanaged.

I lived here from January 2023- July 2024. Unfortunately, management changed earlier this year and the quality of the building went down significantly after.

After the change, the concierge table is much less frequently staffed, and general upkeep has declined.

Worst still - the hand off between companies was managed poorly. Autopay settings were not carried over, and the new management chose instead to send notices of late payment instead. In addition - they did not maintain move-in inspection records and asked me to pay for previous damage that I had noted on the form at move-in.

Also one last note - during cold times the building heat cannot keep up. This winter the pipes froze and water was shut off for a few days. In addition - as other reviews noted, the parking garage gates have barely worked at all in the last few months. I had to resort to parking outside.

Unfortunately I must now say that you should absolutely avoid this building. A shame to see it go downhill so badly.

Avoid at all costs.
Love it here and just signed our 4th lease. The location is perfect and private. Building is secure and very well maintained. Some new upgrades are coming soon so looking forward to those.
Great apartment to live in! The management is really nice and connoisseur service is really helpful. The appliances are brand new and maintenance is on point
Love living at the Grand! The building is clean and well-kept. The apartments are BEAUTIFUL. I am very happy to call The Grand my home for going on 2 years now!

Great experience here now for almost the 4th lease! This is definitely the most private and quiet place to live in the domain. Wonderful and helpful staff! High end WiFi appliances, great maintenance, concierge, and perfect location!
We moved here a year ago and we just love this place it is in a nice area that is safe and calm and the service is amazing! The staff are very helpful especially Mia!!

Lived here for a year and I would definitely recommend. I only move out so I can be closer to family, otherwise I would definitely stay. Nice and new. The 2 pool areas are great time for the summer and their gym has great equipment too.

We absolutely love living here and would highly recommend to anyone! The property is beautiful and meticulously maintained, and management is fantastic. Mia and her team go above and beyond in handling maintenance requests and planning community social events. So many great amenities here too. We are very excited to resign for a second year!

Best apartment complex I have ever lived in. The front desk staff and maintenance staff go above and beyond to help residents. They recently changed management and the new management is fantastic.
The apartment grounds are spotless and they keep all of the common areas meticulously clean. They fix any issues immediately.
So nice!!

Spectacular setting and Spectacular apartment and management

This place is beyond words. I have enjoyed it for 3 years since it's opening. They have amazing massive serene park trails and dog parks! The new highway access is finally now open and puts this location simply ahead of all others.

Literally the apartments is very modern. The staff is amazing and works with you step by step. This is the place to be, I promise!

This is a really nice place to live; nice gym, nice pool area, very nice clubhouse and the apartment complex is maintained very neat and clean. I can make it to I-35 in 7 minutes in the morning, and can also make it to 130 Toll-road in 10 minutes if needed.
The office personnel us very kind and helpful, they treat you with respect and a friendly attitude. I have lived here for 18 months and would strongly recommend it to anyone... the place is top level but their rent rates are affordable.
Runnnnn, I cannot wait to leave this place! Management is terrible, neighborhood is so bad.

f there was a zero rating I would have choosen it. Save yourself from a painful experience and find another complex. My daughter moved in to go to school and out 3 weeks later. Banks is always clean and calm. I feel safe and I’ve never experience any criminal activity taking place here.

The Banks of Springdale not only is a cute and up and coming spot in ATX but has great amenities, beautiful pool with a view, pet spa, resident lounge area and wonderful gym!! The staff from the management to maintenance are all very friendly and will work with you to figure out any and all issue or questions you have! Overall great place to live and love it here!
Great quality, location, amenities and management. Excellent living experience so far!
I've just moved in. I feel so far that everything was transparent. The apartment isn nice and the location in the property is very convenient

My experience with staff has been very pleasant. They are kind, attentive and considerate. That alone has made a significant impression on how I view the community. Additionally the complex is very clean and easy to navigate. Would highly recommend The Banks of Springdale to anyone and everyone.
This place is pretty awful. They change rules a lot and dont communicate things well. Also do not care about their property looks or taking care of their renters
Love the Banks of Springdale! The amenities are fantastic and always upkept. It is very convenient as a resident to have a pet spa on site. Saves me money not having to take my dog to the groomer.
The quality of the apartments are top notch. Community is close to Muller, not far from downtown and neighbors a beautiful trail.
Very quiet place to live. Kept clean and has great amenities.

Apartment cares more about fooling others into living there than resolving any issues and even got attitude at me for asking them for the tow info to confirm my car wasnt just towed mistakenly from my reserved spot. This doesnt even go into the huge list of relatively smaller issues that I have encountered here but it matches my experience at other Greystar properties so it appears to be their company culture to screw tennants for their bottom line. 

Avoid at all costs.
The Banks of Springdale is clean and safe. Arie and James are responsive to any and all comments or concerns that a resident may have!

There’s not much to complain about the property itself. Nice/new interiors, utilities, internet connection, great maintenance team, Amazon hub, pool/gym, etc. The location of the property (old neighborhoods, suspicious characters) is the only drawback I’d say. It’s close to a nicer area in Mueller but I wouldn’t recommend taking casual walks/jogs around in the evenings in the immediate vicinity. Overall the pros definitely outweigh the cons though.
The staff is quick and effective! Always on the job!
Great property! Office and Maintenance Staff are great. James and Arie are very helpful. Good location and the apartment is great.

The worst management ever. They never have the gate closed but it’s “gated” they tow your car even if it’s registered. Mine has been towed twice now, both times their fault. Their units say “soon” for being available, when they have until all over available. This place hasn’t even been opened a year and I have seen people leaving left and right. I have 3 months left in this place and I’m counting down the days to move out. I never write reviews but on this place I had too!
I love living at Crosstown. It’s an elevated complex at prices that I can afford, with friendly office and maintenance staff.

It’s a beautiful and new property, but there is a homeless issue. I would feel safer living at the apartment complex if all the doors closed properly. Cops are here at least once a week trying to get rid of homeless people in the pool or inside the apartment complex. No one living in the apartment complex that is a female renews their lease because it isn’t safe. It’s close to the ER Hospital and Firestation, you’re going to hear sirens all day and all night.

Peaceful tranquil place to live 
Convenient location, great amenities

With a curated collection of resort-inspired amenities, it truly feels like a delightful retreat. The community boasts a stunning pool area with sun loungers and a grill. It’s the perfect spot to relax and unwind. Whether you’re into cardio or strength training, you’ll find everything you need here. Enjoy some friendly competition in the game room. It’s a great place to socialize and have fun. Need a cozy spot to watch your favorite shows? The TV room provides a comfortable space for entertainment. Overall, Crosstown Apartments combines convenience, luxury, and resort-style living

Crosstown has been my home for eight months now and I have nothing but wonderful experiences. The place is clean, the staff are kind, and the residents are courteous. Bonus points for the morning rooster on the neighboring property — I can’t always hear him, but I love when I can!
Crosstown is such a beautiful apartment. Very clean and most importantly safe.
Staff at Crosstown are so friendly and welcoming! Great at building community with events that are given monthly :)!
Great complex - once you move in - you will experience peace and serenity

Really beautiful property; it's brand new so everything works and is in great shape. The unit itself is well-constructed and I like having a gym and yoga room in the building. There are some issues to be ironed out, like with the garage gate and parcel pickup, but I feel the staff is on top of it.

Something I didn't anticipate is the garage is bizarrely cramped--it gets really noticeable toward the top floors where there are more cars. They installed mirrors but they're not always visible at each turn, and I'm always nervous I'm going to hit someone who I can't see/who can't see me. It's fine for now but it might get worse as more people move in
I love this community the staff makes you feel welcome and the the property location is Central to Austin. The amenities are nice and I fell safe.

I've only been in the space for 4 days, but the space is very clean, modern, and beautifully designed. The amenities are beautiful as well and so far it seems the management staff does a great job creating community events. The staff is also approachable and helpful in assisting residents with questions and concerns.
Great Staff all around and excellent customer service.
Beautiful apartments and amenities, and a stellar staff! A lovely place to call home.

First time living on my own and this place does it for me. It checks every of my list from apartment amenities to community amenities! The proximity to restaurants and bars is great as well. Not only that but having public transportation right in front of our complex is great too in the event I ever needed it.
URBAN EAST IS THE WORDT PROPERTY I HAVE EVER LIVED IN.   ABSOLUTE WORST!
Gorgeous apartments, amenities, and friendly staff! (Except for Saira and Kelsey) lol

This was the nicest property to tour at and Vanessa was really awesome she made sure to show us lots of options we were interested in and this property has everything we were looking for AND MORE! I am so excited to potentially live here with my family.
Vanessa and Jessica were amazing helping me look through floor plans so that I am happy with my apartment home and Community is great! Amenities are Awesome- can not wait to bowl!
Me gusta urban  east , el personal es muy amable y atento,te ayudan a buscar el apartamento de acuerdo a tus necesidades , la seguridad y el estacionamiento  es muy seguro
A genuinely good location with plenty of offerings that other residents don't offer, a refreshing experience that's fair in its pricing for what it offers

If you value your sanity, DO NOT MOVE HERE. We have had nothing but problems since the day we were handed our keys.

This place is infested by wasps, just one cursory glance at any of the buildings will provide evidence of this, but the worst is buildings 18 and 19.

The Pest control company that we pay for with rent is A JOKE. I’ve never met people who do their job less than this pest control company. Office staff and manager has tried to make pest control do something, but it’s been like pulling teeth and they’re tired of dealing with it. I’m tired of it too and I wish I could give up as they seem to be doing. But I can’t. I live here. With about 30 wasps INSIDE my bedroom in the past month and a half.

There is also a scorpion infestation!! We’ve only been here two months and have already had to deal with several scorpions. Last night, there was a baby one in my living room. We could not even sleep in our own apartment!! I am so afraid every single day!

I have had no peace of mind since moving in. I’ve talked to and visited the office dozens of times now, and all I hear back is “we’re still waiting on a response from the pest control company.”

The pest control company can not help you. They are NOT equipped to deal with a serious pest issue. They showed up with a rickety ladder and a stick to take care of the wasp infestation, left without knocking down the nests, and then LIED to the leasing office and said they took care of the problem.

I’m already stuck here in my lease, but PLEASE save yourselves. Do NOT live here.

Wonderful apartments! I am currently in another state and was so glad they had virtual tours on their website and plenty of pictures. I called and worked with a leasing agent named Ashly and she was amazing. She had great customer service, answered my questions, was very kind and went far and beyond. The apartment complex is beautiful and it’s great that they have great staff as well!
They keep moving move in dates. and they lie about availability

Buyer beware! They switched my move in date almost two weeks before my move in (through email, no phone call). I put my deposit down months in advance! I already had movers booked. Then they tried to sell me a more expensive apartment, that I had to sign for asap, so I could make my original move in date. Terrible business practice and terrible customer service.

My living experience here at Solomon have been great. I love the community , the manager/staff team. They are all very courteous and Friendly.
Living at Solomon has been amazing! such an easy move in experience, everyone is so nice and helpful, and the design of the complex is spectacular.
The Solomon is a great choice for apartment living to live! You know it’s a great place when it smells really good!
Solomon continues to amaze me and deliver on their promise if luxury. The team is so friendly and knowledgeable! I'm so excited to be living here and for what's to come.
Beautiful community in a great location. So far, so good!
Solomon is a beautiful property with top notch amenities. Nirosha was extremely helpful in getting me moved in and I couldn’t be happier with my decision to live here!
Great amenities! Having some growing pains when it comes to having enough staff, keeping hallways clean, a fruit fly issue, but hopefully it will improve in the coming months.
Beautiful interior design, great common spaces and amenities, thoughtful floor plans, and lots of engaging events for tenants!

I moved in a couple of weeks ago and have been really loving it. The amenities at Solomon are unmatched- from the details in the study lounge and the common areas, to the gym, to the rooftop pool, everything is top notch. My friends are shocked how nice everything is when they come over. The move in process was super smooth. The leasing team was very helpful and supportive and they are all very nice people. There was a small issue in my unit that I needed to submit a work order for. I received a call literally 30 seconds after pressing the submit button on the form from Jorge (maintenance). I was so impressed by how quickly he called and came to fix my issue. Solomon is an awesome place to live and I am so thankful to live here!

I just wanted to give a huge shout out to Eddie! He made my decision easy to choose Solomon as my new home. From the moment I stepped in the very first time to tour, he made me feel so welcomed and like I was already at home! His energy is great and you can tell just how much he loves Solomon. 

The attention to detail in every aspect of the community is unmatched. The amenities speak for themselves and the apartments are beautiful. As this was one of the first places I toured, the bar was set SO high and of course nothing compared. They really thought of everything when building the Solomon and have anything you could need to make living here easy. 

Eddie was so helpful in recommending which floorplans would best suit me based on my furniture and preferences. I was probably not an easy resident to deal with, but Eddie did it with ease and a smile on his face. When it came to my indecisiveness, Eddie was a SAINT. I changed my mind multiple times on which floorplan I wanted and he was always accommodating. I even wanted to switch units 2 days before move in because I realized I picked a floor with the other color scheme (completely my fault) and even on such short notice, Eddie made it happen. 

I can’t say enough good things about the whole Solomon team in general. They are always there if you need anything and they genuinely mean it. Any questions or concerns I had were handled immediately. Not once have I walked by the leasing office without someone smiling and waving as I pass by. 

But I have to give all of the credit to Eddie, as he was one of the main reasons I chose to live here. He is one of the nicest, friendliest people I have ever met. When I toured with him, I never once felt like he was trying to “sell” the apartment to me; he shared his love for it so naturally and it showed. 

I’m so happy I get to call Solomon home. I love it here & I don’t plan on going anywhere! Thanks Eddie & the rest of the team!!
Fantastic community with incredible amenities and star lease agents!

Prospect has been a great place to live, the people are friendly as well as the staff. I haven’t had an issue with them at all.

Great amenities but I don’t feel safe. They’ve all decided to live elsewhere.
Love the staff and the community as a whole is amazing  great location and amenities are great.
The move in process was efficient and stress-free. The community living has been a satisfactory so far. Professional and easy to reach staff. Will definitely refer friends to this property.

The experience has been nice. I don’t know if the walls are thick, but I usually never hear anything from the people around me, just the occasional person above me walking and that’s not even bad. The living space is great and spacious, such as a high ceiling which I love.
