Still wish the people that live here cared enough to take care of the property. Too often there's trash in the elevators, stairwell and in the halls as people are too lazy to take their trash to the dumpster. I actually think the trash is causing an infestation problem as I see roaches now.
Lived here for three years .. The staff is amazing.  Nice community and friendly neighbors.   Resigning my lease soon.   Keep the property clean

For the past year we have dealt with probably three different management groups for the office and not so great maintenance we had major issues in our apartment and had to wait almost three weeks for them to fix it and they told us that our problems was not emergencies after we had to do a police report on one of our problems and have no ac for two weeks for the other during the Texas heat. Our current management started cbanging the times the office is open and don’t send out emails letting us know that they close earlier now and open late on some days. Which I think is rude when people are trying to get in contact with them.
Es un lugar muy tranquilo y agradable, cómodo y segura, acogedor y amplio a mi familia y a mi nos gusta mucho nuestra experiencia de vivir en este apartamento

I currently live here and in the beginning it was great, until people moved in. Now I am hearing loud flushing and banging noises all day, feels like I’m living in a toilet. Mgmnt stated it’s normal within multi family units and my friends have left because they said it’s gross. The sound happens all day and they basically implied sleeping is not important or apart of your health.
I recently toured Hanover and I was blown away by the amenity spaces. The leasing agent was extremely knowledgeable and assisted in finding me an apartment that fit almost all my preferences.
I love the community and the entire leasing team. I can't wait to spend the summer by the pool!

We just moved in and we love our apartment! The leasing staff has been so helpful, and we have had a lot of questions! It made a cross country move more bearable. The amenities are amazing- highly recommend!
This is an amazing spot but also the team was so nice! Eneida helped me with everything and she was absolutely incredible! So pleased !

The modern apartments and unbeatable downtown location are fantastic, but the true stars are the staff. From the leasing team who helped us find the perfect space, to the concierge staff who handle any request with a smile, everyone goes above and beyond to make you feel truly cared for. If you're looking for a downtown apartment in Austin, Hanover Brazos Street is the place to be.

These apartments have not been renovated to match the cost of rent. Old 90s appliances,  they’re infested with roaches. Most reviews are by friends and live on site staff!! If you ask the real residents these reviews would be zero stars.
The staff did not relay the maximum income restrictions when initially contacted.

These apartment are great! Security is also very vigilant and keeps the apartments safe. Although management has continued to fix damages from 2021's snowstorm, the apartments continue to be great! Most of my issues are resolved by management, so I'm pretty satisfied with the conditions here.
MY APARTMENTS IS  BEAUTIFUL. GREAT  PLACE TO LIVE IN. THEY ARE VERY HELPFUL IN THE TIME OF NEED. I HAVE A SPACIOUS APARTMENT AND I AM THANKFUL THAT I CHOSE FOREST PARK APARTMENTS.

I like living here, they did a major renovation on the property it looks great. Some people complain about roaches but I keep my place clean and never had an issue at all with that, my neighbors are friendly. Very close to the stores, IH 35 & 183 and schools are at walking distance.
After a year of renovations, this complex looks great!  They renovated even mail boxes!  New free carport!  I really love live here.

I don't live here but did come take a tour of the property. The staff was friendly, the complex and unit was clean, and from what I could tell the amenities look very enjoyable. They have the best gym I've ever seen an apartment complex have.

My fiance and I have loved living at Marquis Barton Trails. We have lived in CWS properties in both Austin and Houston for 5 years now. Though all of the CWS apartments we've lived in have been awesome, this one is by far the best. Not only is the apartment beautiful with great finishes and high ceilings everything feels brand new. The staff on site are fantastic and truly care about the community and seem to enjoy their jobs. The maintenance team always waves hello when we see them out around the property. The community is clean and well landscaped not to mention safe and very quite. We have never heard any noise from neighbors and the property is surrounded by greenery- it feels like an oasis off of mopac! It is so close to everything you need, it literally takes us 5 mins to get to the greenbelt and 10-15 to get downtown. It has super easy access to all kinds of stores, Target, Whole Foods, Costco, Nordstrom Rack, HEB, multiple gyms, etc. In past apartments we didn't realize how important it was to live minutes from a grocery store so when choosing Marquis Barton Trails, the closeness to everything was a high priority. 
Additionally and arguably most important is the value. This apartment complex is by far the best bang for your buck we could find in Austin. It's just far enough from downtown to be affordable and close enough to feel like you're getting a smokin' deal! Friends have always been surprised and a little jealous when they hear how reasonable our rent has been. 
We have no intention of leaving this property until we are ready to purchase a home or if work takes us out of Austin. 
If I could give this property more than 5 stars I certainly would.

I have lived at  The Marquis at Barton Trails (phase II) with my new wife for about two months now and have mostly positive feedback. Before moving in to the brand new complex, we felt a somewhat corporate and impersonal vibe from the leasing agents. However when we fell into a situation that put us at the mercy of the property management, they went above and beyond what I expected to provide quality service.  To this day, the staff remembers my name and seem to genuinely care about my satisfaction.

As for location, I could not ask for more. To the east you have Sunset Valley, which is full of franchise shopping and chain restaurants. Then to the west lies The Shops at Arbor Trails, containing more local restaurants and additional retail. Plus being so close to MoPac and Highway 290, you are never more than a 10 minutes drive away from anything happening south of the river.

As far as the actual apartment itself is concerned, the flow of the 1 bedroom floor plan and 9 foot ceilings provide a spacious feeling. Additionally, the granite counter tops and dark wood floors give an elegant touch. 

The amenities are a nice perk. The pool and grill area is modern and relaxing, while the work out facilities are better than average for an apartment complex. 

With all of the positive things to consider, there are a few flaws that should be addressed. For one, the paint in the apartment seems cheap. It scuffs with the lightest brush and is impossible to clean. Also, parking is regularly an issue. There are many spots, but about half are designated as "small car parking only." I drive a two door Honda Civic and can not even fit between two parked cars. 

Overall this is a quality apartment for its price. All leases in Austin are outrageous at this point, but my wife and I feel like we are getting our money's worth out of this place. What more could you ask for?

My experience with this apartment complex has been extremely disappointing. Upon moving in, I immediately found multiple dead roaches and even saw a living one on the stove while my wife was cooking. Living with roaches is unacceptable, and it made us question the cleanliness and overall maintenance of the property. After notifying management, we decided to use the 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee to terminate our lease early.

Despite adhering to the terms of the agreement and moving out within the 30-day window, management is now refusing to refund my security deposit. The 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee clearly states that residents are entitled to a refund of their security deposit if they choose to move out within 30 days. Yet, they are withholding it without a reasonable explanation. It’s frustrating to deal with a property that doesn’t take tenant concerns seriously or follow its own policies. I would strongly recommend avoiding this complex based on my experience with both cleanliness and the lack of professionalism in handling issues.

I have lived here for over a year and I recently moved into a new unit. My first unit was not so bad but boy as soon as I moved into this “remodeled” unit I soon found a million and one problems. I have been here for 2 months and since day 2or 3 of moving in my kitchen light went out. I put in about 5 work orders for it just for them to respond with they are having an outside maintenance guy coming in to look at it. Obviously that has not happened. That is just one of the many issues I need repaired and quite frankly a very simple fix if they could actually just do their job. I am starting to lose my mind with management they are completely incapable of taking care of their residence. The rent is ridiculously high and not to mention you can hear everything single sound coming from the apartments around you clear as day. I could have a conversation with my neighbors below me. I could honestly write a book about the social apartments and I would not have 1 good thing to say. I hope every employee reads my review because something needs to change. I am disappointed and can’t wait to be out of here in a few months! There is a lot more apartment complexes that charge the same amount for better living. DO NOT MOVE HERE

When I lived at the Social Apartments in 2018-2019 they were under investigation for neglect. Several gas leaks happened and the office didn't do anything about it. Now, I see they are charging almost double and they didn't even bother to change the branding or anything.

In the fall/winter november/December of 2020 I put in multiple requests to have my heater repaired. It took them until snomageddon to even get looked at and that was only because I emailed corporate and threatened legal action. For reference that's 3-4 months no heat in winter. I called emergency maintenance 4 different times and never got any response from any maintenance. One office worker didn't even know my heat was broken. The property manager will not respond to any email you send. They will not return any call you make. Now my ac is broken and it took 8 phone calls and 2 office visits to get maintenance out here. I was taken advantage of once I'm not letting it happen again. Do not move here. Do not renew your lease.

The new people do not care about residents. They are very good at making themselves look great, until there's an actual problem. Then they do everything they can to ignore it at the expense of the residents.
 
As of May 15th, 2020, there has been a leak in my ceiling. I took photos and videos as proof and sent them the google drive link to view. I kept up communications and let them know when the leak got worse. I explained my concerns about possible collapse or mold. They seemed unbothered by this information.

They barely responded. When they DID respond, it was to tell me that they were hiring an outside contractor who would fix it soon.

On June 9th, 2020, they emailed me to say the roof had been repaired and asking permission to enter my apartment to fix the cosmetic damage.

I did not have the opportunity to respond immediately because I am constantly working.  I was asking my boss for a day off to be present for repairs because my cat is a concern when strangers are in my home.

On June 12th, 2020 they sent someone to my apartment without my prior approval or permission. I came home to find my belongings moved and the crack in the ceiling filled in and painted over.

On June 15th, 2020, a month after the first leak, it rained. I came home to water everywhere. All over my belongings. 
I called the emergency number and they did nothing. 
I also left a voicemail for the office. They did nothing. 
I emailed them. They have not responded. 
They promised this was fixed. 
THEY LIED

Do not move here. The apartments smell of cigarette and weed smoke because management allows people to smoke inside of their apartments. People scream and fight almost every night into the early hours of the morning. Cars are broken into constantly. The laundry facilities are always breaking. They do not enforce leash laws or picking up pet poop. Also, the roach problem is inescapable because they NEVER have pest control visit, even though you have to pay for it according to the lease.

This is East Riverside. And the management team at The Social seem hellbent on making sure you know no one gives a crap in this neighborhood. Don't let the prices, the walk-in closets, and gas stove ranges draw you in. 

You do NOT want to live here.

When you go into an apartment at the Social, look at the paint on the walls. You'll see bumps where they used too much paint, areas where there isn't enough paint, and paint in places where there shouldn't be any. 

This kind of lack of organization and attention to detail is a pattern I have observed at the Social.

For the last week and a half, the gas has been shut off. They tried to fix the gas leaks, but the City of Austin came and found more leaks, prohibiting them from turning it on. They didn't do due diligence to make sure there really were no gas leaks, and were content to solve the problem with a quick fix. If you'd ask the Social, they'd probably say they've done as much as they could. But the real problem is that they let it get to that point to begin with. In the same way that the paint job seems to have been done in a rush with little attention to quality, so management has come to treat the entire property in hopes no one will notice.

Here's another example - before they started using a parcel management service, packages would come into the clubhouse. There was no organization of these packages, and the staff would rummage through every single package to find it. At least once they told me my package wasn't there even though I had confirmation from Amazon that it had been delivered. No one thought to organize the packages to make it easier to find them.

Here are several other of my experiences at the Social:

My car was broken into and belongings stolen.
My sink is repeatedly clogged.
Management took my key to copy it, said they would bring it back later that evening, and then forgot to come back and give it back.
There is standing water in my bathroom that never goes away.
I have come to the office several times during office hours, only to find a locked door with no indication of when it would re-open.

Here are some of the benefits to living at the Social:

It's close to several convenience stores.
It's cheap.

Every maintenance request is like pulling teeth. My garbage disposal was clogged for 3 weeks, I woke up one Saturday to no heater in my apartment and it took 6 hours for them to respond to my emergency call (it was 40 degrees outside), and now my bathroom sink and bathtub have been clogged for 3 weeks as well. I make calls to the office every day and get sent to voicemail, and when I walk into the office I am assured the issue will be handled immediately, just to come home the next day and find that the issue hast even been looked at. The only time I have ever gotten a response from them is if I call the corporate office to complain, or if the maintenance team actually happens to be in the office when I walk in with an issue. I would avoid at all costs, there are plenty of affordable apartments in this city that have a competent staff. This doesnt appear to be one of them.

I just recently moved here by far the best management I have came across from the move in process, to becoming a resident. They are always willing and happy to help with whatever they can, concerns are addressed in a timely manner, and best of all they make you feel welcome into the community. Definitely plan on being a long time resident.

DO NOT LIVE HERE! The carpet was torn within a month of living here. The door would constantly falling off their tracks. The apartment had an odor that I could not get rid of from old pipes in the wall. I had noise complaints form neighbors whose dogs barked at 5 am and management did nothing. I have dogs, it was pure a noise complaint. 

My AC went out in May.. MAY in TEXAS with over 90 degree weather and management did nothing to help me. It took days to fix.

Everything was constantly breaking and management was no help. 

SAVE YOURSELF THE HEADACHE!!!!

Good new things are happening over here! I am 1/3 of the way into my third year as a resident and plan on staying for a while. I have been through 2 property management companies already at this complex and finally getting satisfaction with the third. I have been through a few major issues with the previous companies and Shippy is making everything right that was neglected in the past as well as addressing any new issues i have. I have personally witnessed loads of new appliances delivered and installed including a.c. units so odds are they will be new from here on out. I was friendly with the couple good maintnance guys here over the last few years but i am impressed with the new crew as they are getting things done. My pet and I have not had a flea, bedbug, or roach problem our entire stay and the new pest control is doing their job as well in maintaining that. The scenery is lovely all the way up to the smiles that now greet you in the office. The environment is nice and the new staff is definitely improving the experience.

Stuck it out for my 1 year lease and knew 1 month into it I wouldn't be resigning. Moved in July of 2016 and moved out July of 2017. I only gave 1 star because I had to. 

The walls are incredibly thin. Be ready to hear everything your neighbors do and say. Our dishwasher didn't work the entire year we were there. My roommate and I would submit maintenance requests that went unanswered until they finally showed up weeks later. Instead of fixing the problem or replacing the dishwasher they told us to manually fill up the dishwasher with water before turning it on...and then it would work. Disregarding the fact that the dishwasher didn't drain water either. Next the oven stopped working, again instead of fixing or replacing it, they gave us some SKETCHY advice. They told us to turn a burner on on the stove, THEN turn the oven on and leave the burner door open at the bottom. Then we were supposed to wait 3 to 5 minutes for a blue flame to show up, and that meant the oven was on. Long story long... the maintenance crew there doesn't intend to actually do any maintenance when they show up to your unit. If they show up at all. 

These issues were just the beginning. We had roaches the entire time we lived there. Despite having pest control treat the inside of the unit. I think this was probably due to a leak that went unresolved by maintenance for months. There was water coming up through the floor in the master bathroom and bedroom. I put requests in for months (literally, months) and finally called very upset when I got fed up with the stench.  The maintenance crew finally came and fixed the leak but the damage was already done. On top of the smell and mold never going away, they left a huge mess in our unit, including huge holes in the dry wall. 

The management seemed constantly confused by what was happening. They all had a different story as to why the issue wasn't address properly and were totally unapologetic. 

I would definitely not recommend.

While you may be enticed by the picturesque model apartment, complete with renovated bathrooms and a relatively modern kitchen, chances are you will find yourself in a slightly more "artistic" apartment if you decide to unload your hard earned cash at The Social. Unfortunately the best thing about The Social on Oltorf has little to do with the accommodations, even less to do with the disappointing staffers /maintenance and everything to do with the fortune of being minutes from the heart of Austin, which tops big-city economic growth since the recession, according to the Austin Business Journal. I will also admit a recent change in management leaves the possibility, however slight, there is a promising future ahead for the tenants of 1817 Oltorf. As long as they're willing to continue to focus on the little things that The Social does manage to get right, such as the availability of an impressive dog park, and attracting youthful and friendly residents. No matter how unimpressive the units may be one thing is for sure, the renters at The Social know how to have a good time and are more than willing to share in the festivities. But even if you aren't a fan of the "mix, mingle, & chill" mentality at The Social Apartments on Oltorf the rates are reasonable and you can't argue with its convenient location.

These apartments don't look that great on the outside., but on the inside they have a lot of space and most are updated!. Carpets in the rooms, hardwood floors in the kitchen and living room. The great thing about this location is that 35 is right down the street and you're not far from downtown or the lake either. So wherever you want to go you're on the freeway right when you get out of the apartment complex.

I've lived in the apartment complex for 5 years since before it was owned by this management company. Overall, comlex is clean, maintenance is quick and people are nice. However, it is difficult if not inmpossible to get in touch with the manager. Our cabinet was broken when google fiber was being installed (not our choice) and every though I sent her pictures and emailed her multiple times, she still hasn't gotten back to me three months later. I don't really trust their maintenance to do big jobs since there has been so much turn over in that department, but smaller jobs are fine. The assistant manager is wonderful, but the company gives her little power or authority to do anything major.

My girlfriend and I have just recently rented out first apartment and Austin, and luckily for us we found the Social! Getting everything set up was easy and we had no hassle. The prosperty itself is great and had an awesome funky vibe with murals painted on the buildings. The Social also offers social events that allow residents to mingle and socialize! We've definitely met some nice people and we look forward to meeting more!

Been a resident for nearly a year and have no intentions of moving. Office Staff always Greets me with a smile and Hello. Maintenance staff quick to fix any and all issues. Plenty of Meet Your Neighbor events... No Breed Restrictions all done on a meet the Pet interview. The property owners can be seen touring the grounds always looking for ways to improve the grounds and units. THIS PLACE LIVES UP TO THE NAME "THE SOCIAL" AND DESERVES TO BE IN AUSTIN

Absolutely awful place to live. The insulation in the units are nonexistent and due to that the electric bill was coming out to 200$+ every month!!! The place is infested with roaches and fleas; it’s so bad when you even walk to your car you’re covered in fleas. When brought to management attention they say they can’t do anything. The condition of the building alone is terrible it needs to get taken down and re-done it’s so bad. The crime is also very bad; our car got broken into and the “ security” doesn’t exist I’ve never seen them not once. There is trash everywhere and homeless people walk around the complex digging through the trash. People also drive their cars on the grass essentially making it nonexistent and so there’s just mud everywhere. The ONLY good thing was our neighbors. I’d give no stars if I could.

I'm a local realtor of many years sold house and moved here while I look around . It's been great quiet with ample parking .
I waited a few months to leave review to make sure
The worst place I have ever lived. Its infested with roaches and bedbugs.  It's very dangerous.  Gunshots are regular.  I cant stress this enough. DONT LIVE HERE!

While I never had issues with the staff themselves as they have been helpful, they do lack follow through and their pest control company is not up to standard in my opinion. I got bedbugs from the neighbor next door who was conveniently evicted (I did see cops talking to him for some reason) or just left back in June. I finally had to move out in October for my own safety and mental health because they never took care of the problem after the first spraying. Please be aware of the problem when moving in.

I am applying now.  Alex in the office is awesome!  The property is well kept and the apartments are spacious. I have been apartment shopping for 2 weeks and even enlisted an apartment locator.  Everything was small with a LARGE move in total.  High deposits, high application fees and some even had administration fees.  Geeez! Who's really pocketing that money?  If you are looking for space at an affordable price, friendly office staff, low deposit, and market rate application fee this is your next home.

Arlene

Apartments are spacious and priced well considering everything is in creasing in price in Austin. Management listens when there iare problems and fixes them immediately. Neighbors are very pleasant but the parking is horrendous.

In the past 2 ish years they have gone through like 5 management companies then decided to do it themselves, but it wasn’t good. Starting with asking us to bring in a copy of our lease… because they can’t find them? If you were unlucky enough to not save a copy yourself, then you’re out of luck, since before our lease was stored on their portal that was managed by management company 3? Then it no longer worked when they left. There was then a month of rent that they said we didn’t pay when we did. They said nothing about the ‘missing’ rent for months and when they did they tried to tack on an extra 500$ late fee. This is after going into the office multiple times THAT month to ask if they were going to charge us rent for that month. Looks like it happened when management company 5? Was being kicked out?  Had to go into the office multiple times months later to get this resolved and it turned out it was their mess up because they never actually charged us rent when we submitted our payment information, and finally getting that bogus late fee removed. The apartment themselves were ok. They had their issues here and there but so does any older building, so that’s forgivable I guess. Weeks after moving out we still haven’t heard anything a out our deposit. The people at the office are good at emailing in a timely manner when it’s their turn to ask us for something, like proof we paid a deposit, and when we send it in, they stop responding. Par for the course I guess for our last month-ish there.

5 management changes in 2 years.
Incredibly poor bookkeeping.
Get used to going to the bank and not knowing hire much rent and yeah and pest control will add up to.

Living here has been great, if I was not leaving for business I would be staying. I was pleased with how quiet the community is, never had any issues with crime or parties. The apartment itself was so spacious and everything worked great within it. Not to mention how great the ammenitys in the clubhouse are, it offers a gym and one of the best pools ive seen... oh and dont even get me started on the location. it has been great and easy to access stores, trails, fun things to do, and it is a great school district (Westlake) if you have a family.

In the past 5 weeks the water has been turned off for “emergencies “ during the day. My guess is that management is trying to conserve the amount of water used since our water price is a fixed rate. Gym has been closed since we moved in. Office is closed unpredictability (ie you get a few hours notice that it’s going to be closed for a long weekend)- no bueno when that’s where you need to go to get your packages since the parcel boxes are broken . Despite requesting to have them looked into fixing , nothing has been done. Fees, fees, fees. Check how much you’re being charged. Keep close track. I can’t count how many staff I’ve seen working in the front office since moving in. I think the average turnover time is 1-2 weeks. Keep getting emails offering money off my rent to pay early—is our building in financial distress ?

My husband and myself spent all day Saturday looking at places to live. We stopped by Waters at Barton Creek to look at an apartment. We met with Nancy who said she was the manager there. (Not sure why the other reviews say there isn't any management?) She was really nice, very helpful and showed us around. We looked at a huge apartment that had a great view and a ton of windows. The manager was really helpful and answered all of our questions. The price is not bad for the size of the apartment, now we just have to figure out what we can do price wise. Definite Contender!

I went out apartment searching just for the heck of it. I found this place through google maps. I've passed by this place numerous times not knowing Waters at Baton Creek was here. It's hidden. It's tranquil, secluded and peaceful. The office staff is so nice and was ready to put me in an apartment. If I was truly looking for an apartment, I would definitely lease here. ??? Don't take my word for it. See for yourself.

I love living here! My apartment is quiet and my dog does not hear the neighbors so he is not barking all the time. I have a great view of the city from my balcony and I can get to work in about 15 minutes. The ladies in the office are really helpful and I have never had to wait to get something fixed in my apartment. Maintenance guys are awesome! I met the owner the other day and she really seems to care about the residents and what they need. I know she is here all of the time. The price might be a bit more than I wanted to pay but I live in Rollingwood and it is worth the money.

Having lived here for the past couple of years (moving for my job now), I'm really happy with everything here. It's only a couple of minutes from downtown (almost no commute), but really doesn't feel like it because it's very wooded and away from the main road. The property managers on-site now are good people and they are always super nice to me. Check out this place if you're looking for a solid apartment.

I have lived at the Waters at Barton Creek Apartments since January 2019 and will be moving out in October as I'm moving out of state. The apartment complex is a great location as it's 2 miles from downtown Austin, less than a mile to Zilker Park, and is reasonably close to the Barton Creek Mall. In addition, Trader Joes and Randalls are a mile west of the apartments. The apartments are tucked into the trees at the intersection of Mopac and Bee Caves Rd. Mopac is extremely convenient for heading North to the Domain or South to go to Target and the 360. 

My one bedroom apartment is spacious and comfy. I think its approximately 700 sq ft, but not sure. The bedroom is large and the walk in closet has washer & dryer hookups. There is also a washer and dryer room on the premises. I like the set-up of the living room and kitchen area, there is a fireplace, and an outside patio. 

There was a slight hiccup during my time here as ownership change property management companies 3 times from late June to early September. However, Mimie (an owner representative) and the now full time office staff have done a fabulous job during the transition period. The maintenance man, Arturo, is always on top of any maintenance issue. For example, my air conditioner dripped condensation into my shower tub and he came over the same day to fix it. Subsequently, the water heater went out one day and they were able to get a repairman over immediately to restore it. Overall, I've had a pleasant experience living at the Waters and would live here again if I ever move back to Austin.

Potential renters - be advised the whole complex needs new roofs (Angela told me these are the ORIGINAL ROOFS from the 70s!) - I advise you wait until this project is complete to avoid the headache I'm currently facing and to skip the noise/frustration associated with roofing construction which will take weeks once they finally start.

I've lived here almost exactly 1 month. In that time we have gone multiple days with 0 hot water and I had a leak start in my living room (due to a bad roof) on 4.7.19. This was reported the same day and now as of 4.24.19 no repairs have been made. I came home from work today to find a piece of the ceiling on my floor and a constant drip with today's rain.

I have been extremely patient with management but I have to advise anyone looking at this property to stay away as this is completely unacceptable.

I should also note that it is obvious ceiling repairs have already been made from previous work done in this exact same spot so this has clearly been an issue for an extended period of time.

I will update this review when repairs on the roof are complete or after I move out.

If you're planning to move here, be prepared for weekly water issues.  The complex is on a central boiler system, and every time a repair is needed in a unit, or on the boiler, which is weekly, they shut off the water for hours.  Additionally, for the last year, there has been hot water issues.  We'll go days without hot water.  Nothing like a cold shower in the winter!  When there is hot water, you will spend all your time in the shower adjusting the temps from ice cold to boiling hot which is extra fun when you have soap on your face.  Consider yourself warned.

This complex used to have a competent staff.  The new management company has fowled up so many simple things I seriously think an untrained monkey would do a better job.  Maintenance requests go unresolved for weeks, hot water is off for days at a time.  We've even had to go a few days without any running water.  Terrible is to nice of a word for the new management.  If I could I'd rate this place zero or negative stars.

We moved here in August 2015 and were told that our apartment was going to be cleaned, the carpet would be replaced and the sinks and tubs would be replaced as well. When we arrived with the moving van the apartment was filthy. Food from previous renters was still on the countertops, the carpet wasn't replaced nor the tubs and sinks, those were just repainted to look new. Summer 2016 rolls around and we mistakingly renew the lease because we love the location and our kids go to school in the district. Now the real issues start to occur. Our A/C starts going out resulting in high electric bills starting in June. We conveniently had out of town guests each time the A/C went out. After only patching the unit for three months do we finally get a new one. The one they took out was extremely old and extremely rusty. Then the water in the complex starts having issues. We deal with low water pressure and barely any hot water. 2017 we have had continuous water shut offs from 9am-7pm. Probably a total of two weeks no water yet my water bill hasn't reflected this at all. The week of spring break an excavator shows up for the entire week right next to out apartment. They refused to do anything about it, "my hands are tied there nothing i can do" total nonsense. There is something you can do you just WONT do it.

unbelievably horrible. loads of crime in the last year, a murder in my building, at least one other break in, shifty people roaming around and property theft galore. not to mention rude neighbors, with nothing in the lease regarding noise so neighbors feel free just blast their music all day and night. constant domestic disturbances and people yelling in the driveways. zero parking ever, there's a whole 12 spots that you could say are "dedicated" to our building but they're shared by the neighboring buildings so we don't even get that. absolutely abysmal maintenance, will give you every excuse in the book as to why they cant do their jobs. you're charged a fee just to have the privilege to take your own trash to a dumpster that is constantly overflowing and full, only to be attacked by roaches and bugs that feed on the overflowing trash. dont let their sales pitch about "community" fool you, there is zero sense of community here. they have the audacity to raise our rent an insane amount after everything that has happened the last year. i already pay a ridiculous amount to live in a place i feel unsafe in. stay far away from this horrible place.

Nice looking apartments, convenient if you work in North Austin. I would suggest that you all change your ridiculous pet policy. I've never lived in an apartment where you don't pay a REFUNDABLE deposit, that way if your pets do cause any damage, fine you pay for it, but if they don't you get your money back. I've also never had to pay for a cleaning service at the end of my stay. If there are issues with the apartment I'd be happy to pay for them, however don't automatically assume there will be and charge money anyways. You guys claim that you don't do refundable deposits to save your residents money up front, and that is bull. At the end of the day you charge "fees" which doesn't makes sense by the way because the definition of a fee is to pay someone for a service (you all don't provide any PET services) that end up being WAY more to pay then you would have in a deposit. It's highway robbery and you all make sure and let people sign your addendum to trap your residents into thinking they're getting a deal. Also, when explaining all of this to your residents, make sure and have someone who knows proper customer service etiquette do that. I should never feel as if I'm being talked down to. Also if you're going to charge someone $960 to have dogs, you better believe if I want to have my dogs enjoy the sunshine on my own balcony, and not sit out there with them....I'm going to do that. That is the dumbest rule I've ever heard. That balcony becomes the resident's property when we rent out the space, so you can't tell people what they can or can't put on that balcony. FIX YOUR STUPID RULES. Also, you might want to reconsider trying to rob more money by charging people for covered spots, you could just be decent human beings and take all of those down so that everyone can park for free and not have to walk 5 miles to get home. Shame on you.

This is a nice, safe community with great amenities. The only downside is pricing. Rent is par for the course but a water bill for a two bedroom apartment with only two occupants is roughly $100 per month which is outrageous. As well in order to guarantee you will have a place to park you HAVE to pay for covered parking or a garage. The final issue is the trash situation. Though it's nice that dumpsters are not seen all over the complex, I would gladly trade this aesthetic issue given that the community compactor is at the front of the complex, always overflowing, and if you leave a bag of trash on your doorstep for the night they will pick it up and charge you $25 per bag as opposed to the $25 per month trash valet fee many apartments offer.

I loved these apartments. Lived here for a year and a half. Parking was great, staff was great, neighborhood was safe and clean. Maintenance was quick and efficient. Spacious and well light apartments. Never loud or too many people out, and neighbors were friendly. Close to everything! Highly recommended.

In July.....my husband and I decided to relocate to Austin on business. Living a house... we didn't want to deal with the hassle of looking for apartments. Apartments.com made it apart easy! After going th though every apartment on the list........ I adjusted my search, and decided to put in an area..... and we came up on this place! My family and I love it!!!!!
The high school AND middle school cause a lot of traffic. Not many places to eat from, and no where to go to within walking distance.
Too many snakes around the property plus a lot of dog poop on grassy areas. Pipes WILL freeze during the winter so expect no water when it gets cold.

I'm a resident here and they towed my car.  The reason they towed it was because there wasn't a permit sticker on it.  The permit requirement was apparently a new policy they put in place and informed the residents only via email with the following titles:

3/27/18 - Spring Time at Promesa Apartments
2/23/18 - Community Update, Garage Sale, Spring Break
11/21/17 - Promesa Towing

I went in to the front office after receiving the email labeled "Promesa Towing" but was told they are in the process of changing towing companies and the permit wasn't ready.  I ended up having to get an hour ride to the towing company and pay $200 to get my car back.

Aside from this incident, I'd have to say one of the staff (Antonio) is really nice but he has no control over this particular case.

Pros: 1) Nice/quiet area- very suburban. HEB/Walmart are like 5 minutes away also. 2) Complex itself is upscale- leasing office is first class, as is the exercise room and pool (although it's a bit small). 3) Apartment interiors are attractive. Every apartment except 1st floor units have wood flooring throughout, except for the bedroom which is carpet. First floor units have like smooth concrete slab flooring. Appliances are new/nice stainless steel, also granite countertops, washer/dryer 4) Office is fairly responsive 

Cons: 1) Maybe it's scrimping to save money because they spent a decent amount other places, or maybe it's the wood flooring also, but the ceilings are thin. I can hear the unit above me often simply walking around their apartment- not doing anything out of the ordinary, just walking. And it's louder than you'd think. It honestly gets pretty annoying. The good part is, with the AC on, or just the AC fan running combined with TV and stuff it basically disappears. But you shouldn't really have to resort to all that. If you get a top floor apartment this place would be sweet. It's still alright though. 2) Valet trash $25 extra a month, horrible idea. Sometimes the trash is picked up as late as midnight, and you have to see people's cans/bags outside their doors five days a week. 

Overall it's solid if you can put up with some noise. I would especially recommend it if you can secure a top floor apartment.

I love living here at Promesa apartments. Beautiful apartments, stainless steel appliances lots of space even if you pick the small one bedroom. Wonderful dog park and big gym. But... The pool area... there is no hot tub:(

Promesa is a very well located apartment complex in Austin for people who like suburbs. Nice quiet neighborhood, great school right next to it and easy access to highway.  
The floor plan is absolutely astonishing - huge new kitchen, large counter top, open space living room, doble sinks in the bathroom, hardwood floors and if you are lucky you will get a nice view of the hill. 
Definitely recommend the place.

I lived here for almost one year. Honestly, I loved the place, my apartment, and the office staff.

The location is safe and it's close to almost everything. There's also a trail right behind the apartment complex, so that was a great perk.
My apartment wasn't fully upgraded, but it was well maintained.
The community is gated. However, the gates weren't always working.
The maintenance guys were amazing. Whenever I had any maintenance issues, they would resolve it in no time.
Lots of parking spaces available for residences, so you wouldn't find a problem parking your vehicle.
The gym is pretty new and well equipped.

Staff is very friendly. Rachel, Stephanie, and Jason were always there to answer any questions or help with any concerns. They made the move in and out processes easy and smooth.
They're fair with the deposits. I got most of mine back.

Overall it was a great place to live in and I would highly recommend it.

I've only been living at the Marquis for 6 months, and I love it! The office staff are incredibly helpful and so welcoming! Leisha is great get to know her!
The 2 bedroom apartment I live in is extremely spacious! I love  the kitchen area seeing as it has granite countertops and updated appliances. All neighbors are very friendly, I have no complaints about them. I'm extremely picking when it comes to apartment living and the Marquis has done nothing but satisfy my needs. I lived in "upscale apartments" before and they have been terrible. The Marquis is quiet affordable and in a good neighborhood!

I've lived at the marquis at canyon ridge for 2 years and counting, and I love it here. The office staff is very friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. They know you and your pets by name, always give a friendly greeting, and have treats for the four legged residents (but always ask before sharing). Maintenance is quick to respond to issues- usually completing a ticket with less than 24 hours unless a special part is needed.  I cannot speak to the emergency maintenance response time as I have had no need for it.  The complex is clean and well maintained, with numerous doggie clean up areas as well as BBQ grills, tables,  gym, and a volleyball court. The Pool has Grill and tables near by with a fire place, and a small water feature, along with the pool side loungers. I haven't noticed any issues with the pool or surrounding areas being unkept. Valet trash is required and while I don't like the fee, I love not having to lug the garbage to the dumpster- it satisfies the lazy part of me.  The residents are friendly and respectful of noise issues- I've only had to ask the neighbors to keep it down on one or two occasions, and never a second time (per occasion).   The apartments are very spacious and well maintained. Everything works, and looks good- I could probably fit two queen size beds in the bedroom of my 1 bedroom apartment if I wanted and still have room for a dresser. The bathroom is huge with lots of counter space, and there is a walk in closet, storage on the patio, and a utlity closet (with full size washer drier connections) Behind the complex is a local trail- Copperfield trails I think its called- Nice to walk along when it's cool out and leads to a small lake in the subdivision behind us. Very nice place to get away from the city for a while.  I would recommend this place to anyone looking to live in Austin, but not feel like you are inside the city. About 15-20 minutes from downtown, 5 from Pfugerville, maybe 15-30 from round rock?

I have lived here for 3 years come this October. It's been great. The people who run this place are very friendly and professional. They have completed each of my service requests whithin 24 hrs. Rent is very affordable, great bang for your buck. They offer a variety of floor plans with different features depending on your budget. The best part is the hiking trail that runs right next to these apartments. Oh, and they have a hot tub.

Between my husband and I, we have lived in two apartment at the Marquis at Canyon Ridge for over a year, a 1 bedroom and a 2 bedroom. Our overall experience has been a good one, especially coming from the West Campus area. The apartments themselves are very nice and spacious! The one bedroom was spacious and the two bedroom was great! Everything is a good quality with good appliances, plumbing, flooring, etc. They have some apartments on the first floor with a yard area. I love this and would be willing to pay even more than they charge for that! I wish they had even more. The location is also great as you are only 5 min away from the Tech Ridge area.

The management is very receptive to the community and tries and fixes issues that are raised and for that I have been incredibly impressed. People were speeding through the parking lot, so they installed speed bumps. The doggie bags were changed to a cheaper brand, but after 1 complaint, they were changed to a stronger one. 

I've read the negative reviews for this place, and I can honestly say I don't really agree. There is a lack of convenient parking in certain sections of the complex on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday nights; however, there is plenty of parking, just perhaps not right in front of your apartment. There are a lot of dogs; however, I hardly ever have issues and if I do, I let management know and they take care of the issue. A lot of people can complain, but if they dont let management know, then they can't fix it.

For the price, you really can't beat it! It's a great value with a great management team. We are moving out, but only because we have to leave for another city. However, if we ever move back, this will definitely be an apartment we'd look to!
Perfect apartment at a perfect price,has decent upgrades. I highly recommend it.

I’ve lived at this property for years but things have really went downhill since the new management has taken over. We renewed our lease a few months ago thinking it would change but that isn’t a the case.

The paid for garbage valet is inconsistent which caused us a HUGE any problem. My family was constantly bitten throughout the summer.

With the ice storm there were fallen trees that were just left there to rot even after the weather turned hot. It’s just not the general look you want for a property you live in.

The estimated community water bills and community fees total up to a few extra hundred a month

The maintenance team while responsive, never actually complete work orders.

With construction happening across the street we’ve popped 3 tires over the last year with random screws and nails when coming into the property.

Overall the above didn’t exist we would still move because the buildings are nice inside but dated. We will be moving to one of the surrounding new properties built in our area if the timing matches up with our lease ending.

With our research we also found that century hill south has the same exact building and layout and townhome style apartment for about $200-$500 cheaper per month

I lived here for two years.  I moved out 2 months ago, and I got a call this morning from a collection agency that I owed $200 for replacing the carpet and our last water bill.  I would have happily paid it if they had let me know via phone call, email, or mail that I owed something.  I also have been by the apartment complex twice since I moved out to pick up packages that were delivered to my old address.  I just can't believe that any business would have $200 report to the credit bureaus after being a wonderful tenant for 2 years. This is a terrible way to treat someone.

I visited The M at Lakeline and I must say the property is beautiful. Macy gave me the tour of the property and she was great! She is very professional and knows a lot about the property and the floor plans. One of the other leasing agents was very nice as well. When I walked in I wasn't in the greatest of mood, but they both seemed eager to help. Macy was able to turn my day around and I left in a great mood! Loved the property, the apartments, amenities, and the staff! Can't wait to live here!
I love my apartment and the staff is friendly. All around good place to live

Parking is horrendous, if people actually used their garages/reserved spots it would help but they don't and the complex can't do anything about it. Shared water so your water bill is very expensive, I live in a 1 bed 1 bath and our water bill is almost $200 for one month. The excuse the apartment gives you is they did not bill us correctly the last month. Received a warning of a lease violation for not picking up pet waste and I pick up after my dog and other peoples dogs everyday. The apartment says a staff member saw someone so I guess they just issue lease violations to everyone in the vicinity and they think that's ok. They have asked how come you don't report someone for not picking up after their dog, how am I supposed to know what dog waste belongs to what apartment? A friend of mine that lives here also got their sons scooter stolen from their porch and there has been drug dealing in this complex. It has been one problem after another here and there is only one staff member that is genuine and actually cares and that is Colby, everyone else doesn't care and are just going through the motions. They have yet to fix the parking lot light near us and its been a couple months, if you submit a ticket and request a certain day/time or request for them to call for access. They will ignore all of it and just show up when they want. AVOID THIS COMPLEX LIKE THE PLAGUE!!

Everything about this complex is perfect! Our apartment is spacious and the floor plan is unique. Management is attentive to your needs and maintenance issues are handled in a timely manner. We’ll be here a long time!

My roommate and I live in the b4 floor plan (2 bed/2 bath) with a 2 car garage attached.  The bedrooms are separate from each other and have direct access to a full bathroom.  We love how open the kitchen is and all the counter space available for food prep and entertaining.  We use the gym a lot and love that it has so much equipment.  Couldn't ask for a better location to shopping with the mall right down the street.  I highly recommend living at The M at Lakeline.

I relocated from out of state with a job opportunity.  It is hard to move from a home to an apartment, but until I can buy a home this is it.  I leased my 4 bedroom 3 bath, 2 car garge apartment without even touring the community.   Not only did i get to see the model photos, Desirae went out of her way to take photos of my actual home!  The day I moved in I felt so welcomed by everyone in the office including the maintenance guy Kelly who went out of his way to introduce himself to me and my husband.   The apartment really feels like a home.  The location is amazing and I love the gym!  It is nice to not feel rushed to buy a home just yet.

Percy is absolutely amazing! The staff is friendly and prompt. The move in process was anything short of a great experience. It truly feels like home. The property grounds upkeep is done regularly. Living here is amazing!

This complex has some of the worst management in the industry.  The new ownership treats all tenants like they are squatters.  We had our apartment professionally cleaned and received a bill rather than a deposit refund for details such as cleaning toilets and refrigerators that our cleaners had spotless when we moved out.

There are ants in the walls and covering the grounds.

The only way to avoid being victimized by the criminals that run this place is to not even set foot on the property.

DO NOT MOVE HERE!! The Management has the worst communication skills. They do not communicate with each other or with the residents.  On several occasions, I overheard management lying to residents blaming old management for things that were new issues. The grounds are riddled with feces and ant hills.  For months I brought this up to management, but there was never an improvement.  If you have a dog, this is the perfect way for your dog to catch a disease or bring the disease into your home! 

I almost fell down my stairs because the floors were improperly repaired.  I was told that the flooring company came by and said the floors were just fine, even though I provided pictures of the un-leveled floor! Nothing was ever done to fix this issue!

We also had to have pest control come out on a weekly basis because we had ants, that showed up when our neighbors moved out and nothing could get rid of them. 

Unprofessional management and maintenance lacks the knowledge to complete tasks properly. 

DO NOT MOVE HERE!

After having lived in the complex for over 1 1/2 years, I moved out in mid-January.  Today I received my final bill stating I owe $377.33.  Upon looking into this, I realized the new management had charged me for an extra day of living in the apartment in spite of the fact that I actually moved out a day BEFORE my vacancy date.  With this came "month-to month" charges as if I had entered into a month to month contract by staying an extra day.  Also tacked on for good measure were $195 worth of late fees for this extra day I wasn't actually there, not to mention water, trash and pest control charges as well.  When I questioned why my water bill was $91 dollars for an apartment I stayed in only 4-5 nights a month, I was told the new management was using a new system and that they were charging for two occupants.  I told them my husband had never even seen the apartment much less used any water there since I only used it for business lodging when I was in Austin for my job.  They said he was on the lease and I reminded them that I was made to put him on the lease because we are married.  Their answer -- I'm sorry, that's just they way we do it.  So for 3 or 4 showers and a couple of loads of clothes, expect to pay huge amounts for your water since the entire complex pays for everyone's water.  Beware and choose wisely.  Pass this complex up in your search!

The new management company that took over recently is terrible. They are rarely available and you always have to wait at least 20 minutes before you talk to someone. They seem to never be able to give you a straight answer either. This is the first month of water billing that we received from the new company and it is somehow doubled. When I asked them how this could be, they all gave me different answers. Many of the residents are questioning the bill and they are just saying that it's right. They refuse to show how it is right and how they are actually billing and just tell you to talk to the third party billing company.
Wonderful location just a block from the Austin Metro Rail, yet away from the worst of the Austin traffic.

Overview at the bottom. 
PROS:
-Maintenance staff is nice and helpful. Sometimes they are short staffed but that’s a management company problem not theirs. Shoutout to Don and his team!
-Location!! Walkability to stores and restaurants on South Lamar is wonderful. 
-Park/train behind the complex is nice for walks or dog walks
-Dog park and lots of doggie bag stations around the complex. I haven’t used it but there’s a self service dog wash station in the parking garage. 


CONS:
-Roach Problem. Very bad. It’s the big “water bugs”. 
-Pay $30 a month for trash and it’s not even valet
-Rat problem
-Management company is not great
-Front office staff changes frequently leading problems to slip through the cracks. There’s a new office manager every 6-12 months but they don’t notify the residents so when you’re waiting to hear back, no one has told you the previous person is gone. You can email call or voicemail multiple times with no answer. Until they want something from you, you pretty much have to go to the office to get help or answers. 
-My unit wasn’t ready on move in day….as in, it hasn’t even been professionally cleaned. There was bugs/roaches in the light fixtures, literal loogies still in the shower, and broken appliances. They had painted the morning of and did the old paint over old screws, tape, dirt, etc. on the walls. The previous resident’s keys were still in the drawer to be picked up. 
-Security is nonexistent. There’s not enough cameras, half the doors and gates that require a key fob or code are broken, and if they’re not the other half are. My car was broken into multiple times with an answer of “security isn’t in our budget right now”. Cars have been stolen when the garage gate was broken and forced resident to park unsecured on the street outside. 
-Price has gone up by a margin that doesn’t match the market for the area, nor any improvements to the property, every time I got a lease renewal offer

TLDR-Amazing location, tons of problems that the price doesn’t justify suffering though.

Everything is broke all the time.  The entry doors are suppose to be secure yet every fob on every door is broken, and has been for months.  Anyone can and does walk in.  Packages are stolen daily.  Reporting to the management gets you no help.  What you see at the tour is not what you will see when problems start appearing and trust me there are problems.    You pay for security yet they do not care to fix anything in a timely manner.   Now the mail is being stolen as someone must have a master key!  Cars getting broken into as the security gate is broken more times than it works.   Rat problems.  I will not be leasing again after my 12 month contract ends.

If I could give zero stars I would. This property has a horrible rat/pest infestation currently and is doing nothing to fix it!!! Do NOT come to live here because they will do nothing to fix the rats that are scratching through your walls keeping you up at night. Not a place to consider renting if you ever come across issues such as these.
Living at BellSouth has been great for the passes 5 years I have been here. Staff is always pleasant

If you like getting packages, which I’m sure you do, absolutely do not move here. In the 12 months I have lived here I have had 6 packages stolen. The new delivery system, Fetch, is cumbersome and is only useful if you agree to sign for every package, a huge inconvenience. Sure, Amazon always issues refunds for stolen packages, the new system puts all the liability on the resident, if a package gets stolen after being delivered by Fetch, too bad, the resident has to eat that cost. I have contacted the office every time a package has gone missing to ask them to do something about the theft and they have always said something to the effect of “we are aware of the issue and are exploring options”. Those options do not ever include things that would cost more money (installing cameras at entry points/hallways, installing additional entry security points, hiring a security guard), they are only interested in slashing costs and not addressing the issue. Granted, this is a problem at all of the apartment complexes in this area but Bell South Lamar is absolutely not committed to resolving the problem. Buyer be ware.

My experience as a whole as been wonderful. From my initial tour of the property, to my move-in, Bell South Lamar has been pleasant. The employees are super friendly and helpful and are quick to respond to any questions or concerns. The surrounding community and available amenities make it easy to enjoy your new home!

I’ve been a resident of this complex for 3 months and so far, the property management company has been a complete let down.  

The most basic amenities that residents should be able to rely on (parking, package delivery, trash removal, printing) fall very short of expectations.  The model that this management company uses is to simply outsource all services so that they cannot be held accountable for any issues that occur.  

The package delivery locker system is managed by a third party.  There are not nearly enough lockers for all the resident’s deliveries which leads to many, many packages being left on the floor outside of the lockers by delivery couriers.  These packages are accessible to all other tenants to be taken either on purpose or by accident.  See attached photo.  In the short time I’ve been here, I’ve had two packages delivered only to be taken by others before I can pick them up.  When bringing the issue to the front desk, I was re-directed to the locker management company who redirects you to the courier.  There are cameras in the package delivery room to deter this, but according to the property management company, these are inoperable.

The parking lot is managed by….a third party.  The online system used to register your vehicles requires approval by property management.  If the approval doesn’t occur in a timely fashion, your car will be towed from the parking lot which is less than 50% occupied.  My vehicle was towed on the first night I parked in the lot due to the management company not approving my vehicle in time.  There are no temporary passes or trail period to prevent this while the approval process is taking place.  When bringing the issue to the front desk, I was re-directed to the third party parking lot management company who redirects you back to the property management and was ultimately left with a $300 bill from the towing company.
I would recommend it. But with rent increases and the parking situation, I'm not as excited about The Addison like I once was.
The maintenance guy was very effective and courteous. If based only on maintenance I would recommend the Addison.

Community is nicely located but has quickly become outdated with several new apartments going up across the street and soon on the other side of top golf. Rent increases did not match the interior aesthetic. Community is also in need of a dog run.
Many fees unnecessary added for small things that could just be a polite notice. Especially when the rent is so high already.
Great location, spacious apartments, nice amenities, well-kept. Good value considering the rising prices in Austin.
Cockroach infestation upon move-in. Thin walls, lousy parking, dogs barking constantly. Incompetent management. Stay away.

I love my apartment and the Staff is great and maintenance is fast. I love the view and quietness of the complex. My only complaint is the parking near my building is terrible. There are two cars that never move, they are taking up parking from residents that really needs it. And I have two neighbors that flip flop their cars so no other residents can park in the spots ( I seen it with my own eyes).    Otherwise I love where I am at.

Cielo has to be one of the most beautiful apartments in the beecave/lakeway area! Ontop of the staff being amazing, especially La’Keisha & Debbie who have been so helpful throughout my experience of living here and the view of the mountains we get outside our windows is breathtaking and moving here has been a breath of freshair for me.

I am looking to move into a new apartment around the summertime and I called in to ask about typical costs around that time, I spoke with someone named Kaylene and she was very helpful! I look forward to working with her in the future!

Madrone apartments are surrounded by beautiful canyons and have the best view to over look nature here in Bee Cave, TX. I have enjoyed living here with my partner since we moved from the Austin area to escape the fast paced living and nonstop traffic. These apartments provide excellent apartment layouts and modern finishes. The amenities here will keep your travel bug at ease if you love traveling because every day here will seem like your own little paradise!

I have lived here for over a year now.  Great place, great views, great amenities.  The staff is attentive and responds quickly.  It's close to everything in Lakeway and Bee Caves. I would recommend for sure!

This place is terrible at conducting business: please allow me to explain why. I visited this complex about 2 weeks before I was looking to move in and had a good experience with the leasing consultant. I filled out an application and paid a security deposit, but was not presented with a lease yet. At this point it was about 11 days before my move in date. I emailed to confirm when I would receive the lease, and was finally sent the lease for review 10 days before my move in date. This lease had the INCORRECT monthly rental amount listed – it was about $300 more than the amount listed on the application I had filled out a few days prior. I reached out to confirm that this needs to be changed before I signed the lease, and I was told that I would receive it the next day with the corrected amount. The next day came around and I never received it… so I followed up. I was told that they couldn’t send me the lease with correct amount electronically because they were “going through a transition." They said I could go into the office, and they could print the lease with the right rental amount. I get there after driving 30 minutes and when I get there I was told “you didn’t get my email? We weren’t able to print it.” When I visited in person that day, I expressed that I may have to start looking elsewhere being that I didn’t feel comfortable moving forward with scheduling movers if I didn’t have a signed lease. I was told that day “the apartment is yours, but if you do find another complex, send an email to Louren and we’ll be able to get the deposit refunded.” My response: “I’m glad to know that is an option.” The following day I STILL had not received the updated lease (nor an update by phone or email) and it was now 7 days before I was supposed to move so I looked into and found another complex. When I ended up emailing Louren to ask when I’d receive the deposit back, I was told that I wouldn’t be receiving the deposit back because the apartment was still mine and I signed something stating the deposit was nonrefundable. I understand that I signed something, BUT this situation seems like it should warrant an alternate outcome where I receive my security deposit back. I’ve emailed the apartment manager and not heard back, and I must say the way this was handled was absolutely terrible. I don’t think it’s MY FAULT that a technical issue on the apartment complex’s end warrants that I shouldn’t receive my security deposit back.
The walls for this apartment are so thin or sound isolation is too low or none. You can hear your neighbors every moment very loudly. it's really annoying. Don’t move here!!

It is very close to downtown and public transportation. The apartments are of a good size and have character. One of the reasons I chose to live here was the promise of well kept maitenance wise, but my AC has not been serviced and my electric bill is over 200 dollars for a 1 bedroom 575 Sq ft apartment!
