I definitely felt like I was at home when visiting the apartment community.

I've been living at this property for a couple months now, and I feel now is the appropriate time for me to write a review.

I am super pleased with the property and all that it brings. One of the biggest factors that I was mindful of while doing my apartment search was evaluating the staff. Needless to say, they did a very good job.

Tracy B., in particular, took my needs and helped me narrow down my search to a couple units. She was and has been super receptive, understanding, and helpful since the moment I toured this property. All the kudos to her. The rest of the staff is just as amazing. The team they have here is the epitome of what property management companies should have if they want to ensure that the tenants are happy.

If you are looking for an apartment and you are reading this (and if you want to get the most out of what you're paying for, with the best staff, a beautiful and clean environment, and EVERYTHING being within a couple minutes' drive) I would recommend you tour Marquis Lakeline Station for yourself. I can go on and on about how happy I am with my decision on choosing this property as my home, but I'm not trying to write a paper here. So I'll leave you with this: 5 STARS, without a doubt!!!
I've lived here for about 4 months and Daniel plus tracy, have made this an amazing property and staff.

Excited about moving into my 2/2.The Newest staff here at The royal is 
prompt and efficient..Ms.shannon and Ms. Kristine are a asset/blessing, as too others I have had in the past where kinda ..eh.(They really go above and beyond).They Royals have a beautiful pool and 24 hour gym on site. Also the Royals have a  no breed restriction and  offer a Dog park in the back of the property for the pups. I enjoy the Monthly events held by the management that usually are Fun for the Family and friends..almost forgot...they also do  raffles, grab bags and things of that nature. Go ROYAL

I have lived in the apartment for 6 months and it has been good experience. It is quiet gated community, and has very nice pool. The staff there are friendly except one lady. There is no playground for kids thought, which is sad.

I have dealt with a lot of bad living situations in the past few years and for the first time in a long time I finally feel at home. The staff at The Royal have been so incredible and patient. There is this positive and very cozy energy that radiates from here. The apartment is beautiful and spacious and might I add that my neighbors are incredible. There must be something in the water because everyone here is so kind and happy or we just live in a really great apartment.

Absolutely adore this place. The maintenance team is very personable and always stop to say hello regardless of their busy day. When I moved into my new home I did not have anything crucial missing or wrong. The office staff helped every step of the application and thoroughly guided me through the move in process. I look forward to my stay in my first TX apartment.

Let's just start by saying that this place is old and with that comes problems. We have mold in all of our vents and there's no exhaust fan in the bathrooms. Maintenance doesn't respond in a timely matter, if at all. Had some maintenance requests just straight up cancelled. The most recent debacle was sending multiple emails/ service requests to report water stains on our ceiling (top floor, clearly roof problem) for months. They spray painted one stain and ignored the others that popped up. Now we have an active leak each time it rains, the ceiling is falling apart, and that room is no longer safe. On top of that, homeless people are a constant, crime, roaches, and water shut offs.

I stayed at grace woods for a year and did NOT like it here. The management is NOT good. Current residents, please check the move out charges correctly. I had returned the keys, still they have charged 80$ for missing keys. We have followed up multiple times, no response. management just ignores you, whenever you call, they say the accounting manager is out, call after 15 mins. When called after 15 mins, they say the same thing. Management is not treating the moved out tenants fairly.

Talking about property, its not good. 
1. Roach infestation - Pest control doesn’t work. Roaches are behind the refrigerator, the stove, cabinets, and some in the room
2. Air conditioner malfunctions once every 2 months.
3. when raised a maintenance request - it takes at least 3-4 business days for urgent service, 3 - 6 weeks for non urgent service. 
3. No safety - multiple break ins during holidays.
4. Old building
5. Homeless people walking around day or night
6. All washers covered with dog/cat hair
7. Gym isn't fully equipped

Grace Woods took a chance on me since they never met me in person, and I am originally from out of state.  I have had all good experiences with them before living there, during, and after. They were prompt whenever I had a service request, the apartment was clean and comfortable.  I especially loved the package hub.  I really liked the abundance of trees on the property - it felt so cozy since even though it’s so close to the highway - a nice little retreat.  The property is also very conveniently located.  My moveout process went well, and they were more than fair when it came to me getting my security deposit back.  If I ever move back to Austin, I will definitely consider living at Grace Woods again.  The staff are very professional and friendly, and great at responding in a timely fashion.  Thank you Griselda, Aida, and Louisa.

It's definitely not a good portrayal of the actual units. buildings infested with German cockroaches and they're deep rooted in the kitchen particle boards. run down and old. they keep making improvements on the outside to make them look nice but no effort to even address or repair more important parts. my roach infested unit that I'm moving out of this month has had a rent spike and increased by more than $200. it's a disgusting property. don't fall for the facade.
Tenants beware! This apartment complex has several units that are infested with German cockroaches. Exterminator appointment did not help at all.

I recently moved out of Wildcreek after living there for almost 5 years. Do not move here unless you want to fight tooth and nail over money once you move out. Wildcreek kept my deposit and charged me an additional $400. I have yet to receive the evidence of the three bags of trash that apparently had to be removed from my apartment nor a suitable explanation as to what constituted "beyond normal wear and tear" after living in a place normally for almost 5 years. I moved out at the end of October after not receiving proper notice of the expected rate for a new lease in time and am still currently fighting with management over the remaining ~$100 they want to squeeze out of me.

In additional to the above issues that have thoroughly soured my experience with Wildcreek, the apartments are very small for the price they are currently asking, there is often trash left all around the complex, and the neighborhood is not good or particularly safe. Do yourself a favor and find somewhere else to live.

The management here is AMAZING! Anything you need and they are on it right away. When my apartment needed any maintenance they would always get someone out right away. If I had a question they would respond almost immediately. I am moving out of state but if I was staying in Texas I would happily live at Wildcreek Apartments forever.

If you are looking for a cheap place to live, this is your place. While saying that, I heavily recommend that you document every single correspondence with management. Be sure to get a copy of your lease and any sort of paperwork that you have with the office. Videos and photos of moving in/out of the apartment. What I’m saying is, be sure to document anything and everything with Wildcreek. Oh and be sure that you cancel the automatic payment. Do not rely on selecting, “when I cancel or move out.” Their lawyer states that it is my fault for choosing that and not cancelling. Even better, just pay with a cashier check every month. It’s more expensive but well worth it for you.

I have lived here in 4 different apartments over the course of the last 13 years. Every time I have left for another place, I have always come back here. The space is a good value for the money, maintenance is on time every time I call, and they fix everything. The manager is very friendly and nice and will help you with any problems you have in any way that she can. I have no problems with mail. Dogs are welcome, and they have a dog park for them. The swimming pools are nice, and they even give you breakfast like a hotel sometimes! The neighbors are wonderful-mostly they are very quiet and friendly, and no problems with parking. There is no crime here, and the schools and universities are close by. There is a bus stop for the university right on the corner, so it is very convenient. Overall, it is a good place to live, and I would recommend it.

We have lived here since July of 2013.  Since we moved in, regardless of how much we spray for bugs, german roaches are everywhere. In the bathrooms, in the closets. They come through the walls from other tenants, and routine spraying of the entire facility by the apartments themselves does nothing. We hired our own private pest control person to spray our unit specifically, and it did nothing.

This would be mild, expect ever since we moved in, our air condition has not worked properly, and cannot compete with Texas heat. The air conditioner is a model from the 80's, and broke down/literally froze up daily. Temperatures in Austin during THIS summer (2015) have been in the 100-104* range, and our air conditioner has not worked properly through it once. We have asked the managers for two years to fix our air conditioner, and they have flat out refused. The maintenance man has even said that he was not authorized to fix the air conditioner past spraying something in it to make it temporarily not freeze up. The apartment reaches 90* and up, and the managers do not care. My household currently cares for a 60 year old man that the managers refused to take into consideration when reviewing our air conditioner repair requests.

Bottom line, do not rent here. They refuse to do repairs, period.

I have lived here for one year and hope to be here for another year! I am in a 2x1 and hope to be in the next available 1x1!!
Office staff is great! Complex is quiet! Apartments are upgraded and rent is very reasonable compared to the newer buildings in area and the newest ones on Riverside!
Wildcreek has the highest safety and recommended rating of all the apartments I looked at. If you are not a resident ....you should be!!!

I have been living here since June of last year, I can say that I am very impressed with the people in the office and the property itself. They keep the area nice and clean, the pool is beautiful, and if you have dogs their dog park is very spacious. So far I have had no issues, and I definitely would recommend living here.

This place was recently renovated, so it does LOOK better than it did. But the place is absolute garbage. The gates are always broken, lots of crime (I literally got an email a couple weeks ago informing the residents of the SECOND shooting in the complex THIS MONTH)
Maintenance staff is horrible, it took them 6 months to put a lock on the door on my patio (luckily I’m not on the first floor!!)

all amenties are under construction, gate is broken most of the time so it will stay open day and night, parking is first come first serve so its always hard to find good parking after work, sketchy neighborhood, constant car break-in. Overall, terrible experience

I did find some value in my apartment - rent is significantly lower than the Austin median. They are not only pet friendly, but there are no weight or breed restrictions.

Unfortunately, these pros seem insignificant when I weighed them against the cons of living here and I ended up breaking my lease to move to a safer area.

A few weeks before I moved in, I received an email saying that a resident had been shot and killed through their front door. I should have heeded that warning because over the year and a half I lived here, I observed more crime than everywhere I’ve ever lived my entire life - combined.
- The security gates are always open / broken. Just as soon as it’s repaired, someone bumps the gate off it’s tracks again and anyone is free to enter the property. This is literally a daily occurrence. You’d think at this point management would have cameras installed to find out who keeps doing it.
- The hood of my Smart car was stolen (yes, the hood!)  
- One morning I was walking my dog and noticed a truck on cinder blocks with all four tires gone. An email from the property manager confirmed the tires were stolen. 
- An SUV parked right in front of the leasing office one night had all four tires slashed.
- My downstairs neighbor’s apartment was broken into in broad daylight.
- Another resident had their door kicked in while they were sleeping and were robbed.

Earlier in the summer, the water boiler for half of the community failed and it was days before management communicated anything to us. It was close to a week until they had the problem resolved.
The pool was shut down by the health department for a week and no one in the office had any explanation and the only notice we had were signs hung by the City of Austin.

The grounds are landscaped on a regular basis and well kept. While there are attempts at preventative maintenance, the community shows its age. 
- The building I was in was settling and my walls were beginning to crack. At one point during the summer, my I couldn’t lock my door because the frame had shifted so much the deadbolt would not engage. After two days of requests, some adjustments to the strike plate were made for a temporary fix but maintenance told me the whole frame would eventually need to be replaced.
- The carpet is replaced after every resident but they don’t tell you until you move out that you pay for it. I had a one bedroom and they charged me $471 after moving out plus $99 for cleaning.

I wanted this place to be better. I pay way to much for the quality of this apartment. The rent shown is just the base rent, after all the fees and cable expect to pay another $100 on the rent. Everything is falling apart and no matter how many times pest control comes there are roaches everywhere. With the construction on 183, there is constantly dust inside the apartment even though I don’t open any windows or hardly go outside. The walls are very thin and you can hear everything your neighbor does. As of now, half the washers are broken so if you plan on doing laundry, hopefully you can make it to 1 out of 4 working. People throw their trash and leftovers everywhere outside. My puppy is always finding chicken bones all over the complex. I don’t recommend this place to anyone.

I moved into the apartment from out of state, with a broken garbage disposal that did not work, a new stove with no plug and didn't realize It until I went to use it for the first time after a month of being there. My first shower in the bathtub, water filled the bathroom floor coming from underneath the tub in which I had to wait 2 days before a work order was completed. The office staff seemed very nice and friendly at first until after moving in and they were absolutely terrible even down to the property manager. Whenever calling the office you could never get through to any staff as if no one was working and there was times that  even when visiting the office during normal business hours, the office door would be locked and no one there. When asked to speak to the property manager about a specific issue, you couldn't call her, you had to send an email and wait for a reply. I was told 3 different thing by 3 different people in which it came down to being apologize to that I was miscommunicated to and that is all. My apartment was entered by management in which I did not authorize in which I was out of town for a long period of time. I could go on and on about the problems that I faced but to sum it up I end up breaking my lease, owing a termination fee along with 2 months of rent and then not receiving a statement from the leasing office of the balance due on the account but rather a phone call from a collection agency. TO TOP IT OFF within 2 months after being there I come home to the news channel and police officers within the apartment complex and a letter on my door stating that there had been a homicide in the parking lot in the early morning and later found out that a woman had been shot and killed and the residents would receive updated information in which was never received. THE VERY NEXY DAY, I come home to another letter on my front door stating that there had been assault  in the parking lot that night in which another woman was assaulted. I REPEAT, DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME..I could not imagine staying here any longer, probably one of the worst experiences I've had in my life.

I loved living at the Marquis at Treetops. We had a private and gorgeous view at our apartment. Our 3 bedroom apartment was big enough for me, my husband, my newborn, and two cats. The staff is friendly and the neighborhood is usually quiet and calm. Residents are usually families and young professionals. I liked to take walks through the adjoining neighborhood mostly because of the views. Before we left last week, management was doing general exterior upkeep such as changing bulbs in streetlights, power washing patios and buildings, touching up chipped paint, etc. The apartment complex also takes an effort to make the Marquis feel like a community by providing activities throughout the month; past activities were gardening, cookouts, wine tasting, mimosa breakfast. 

I would recommend this apartment complex. The only reason why we left was because we moved to a new city. 

Pros: great location, staff, management
Cons: Recycling bin is difficult to get to because of the hill, exiting on to Spicewood Springs Rd can be difficult sometimes, a long mailing address that occasionally causes lost packages

Marquis at the Treetops is an excellent place to live. The clubhouse staff is very attentive and work swiftly to resolve any issues you might be having. The maintenance staff is great as well. The apartments are updated with granite counter tops and new cabinets. The hillside/canyon views are top notch and hard to find anywhere else in Austin. I highly recommend living in this lovely, private community that is nestled away in the hill country of Austin, TX!

Management has been on top of things,which I really like.Maintance has been taking care of things in a timely manner,and if it is going to take a while,they come back and take care of the problem .Thanks to everyone.

Been here for 4 years and I have been content with my neighbors, my apartment, my surroundings 
Sometimes when I ask maintenance to come by it does take a while but they eventually come. Sometimes the people who work in the office are not very friendly. The staff rotates so much so the energy ebb and flows. It would
Be nice to have some benches in other places of the property while
Walking dog
Or just wanting to a moment to sit

I’ve really enjoyed living here. Nearly a year. I’ve used the pool during the summer and attended a few of the events put together by the leasing office staff. Haven’t had the chance to use the gym because all the equipment was broken, but I believe it’s all currently being fixed. Considering renewing after my 18 month lease ends this summer. 
My only complaint is the arrangement of the “Reserved” parking spots- I do wish they were separated equally amongst the buildings.
Es un lugar tranquilo, donde tienes mucha paz,  el lugar es tranquilo con muchas comodidades, lugares verdes, parques para los niños y parques para los perros
Es un buen lugar para vivir ya que es una propiedad bastante segura siempre se mantiene limpio, y realizan siempre actividades en las que los residentes se puedan involucrar siempre que lo deseen.
My review is the result of 3 years of residency and appreciation for the courteous and efficient service I've received from the Managerial and Maintenance Staff.

This place is not what is advertised. None of the amenities on the website have been available to us for the better part of the last six months. Pool is usually cold, green with floating leaves or the debris. The laundry is not working. Machines are either out of service or the ceiling has collapsed, or both. You have to haul your hampers to the laundromat
Hard to get any kind of help from the office which seems to have a revolving door. You can blame the stuff from wanting to work for a better place to actually cares.
Rodents and roaches seem to own the place

I've been living at Cascade Apartments for a few months now, and I'm pleasantly how great this apt is. Things just seem to be kept clean all the time, and I really appreciate that. The apartment unit is cozy and feels like home to me, and I haven't had any problems with pests or noisy neighbours. Anytime I've had a maintenance issue, the team has addressed it quickly and thoroughly. Honestly, I wasn't expecting to find an affordable and clean living space in the heart of the city, but Cascade Apartments have definitely exceeded my expectations and its a great price for austin apartments. I would highly recommend this place to anyone.

This apartment complex is terrible want to hear rats running through your ceiling this is the place want to move out and get a call falsely saying you owe a $1000 but slow to get you your security deposit back this is your place!

I have been a resident for about a year and a half. The water is constantly shut off with no warning and the office is rarely staffed during office hours, meaning that management is rarely available to assist when needed. The lack of concern for resident needs is disrespectful- avoid this property.

The worst. I’ve lived here for 2 years and have countless issues. There have been 3 or 4 different management companies in those 2 years and the current one is the absolute worst. Most recent issues have been: the pool was closed for almost a year and since it’s been back to operating, it’s mostly unusable because They do not clean it. The washers and dryers never work or function correctly...and the washers have NO hot water. I’ve notified the staff several times and they have nothing but excuses and will not supply hot water for laundry. They literally could not care less. The weekend staff is especially horrible- not caring at all. Just today, they sent out an announcement email at 11am about concrete and construction work being done today and I got home from work to have my door yellow taped off and concrete dust EVERYWHERE- COMPLETELY covering my door, outdoor decor...and because there is a crack under my door, the concrete dust was forced / blown under my door and there is now a layer of concrete dust over everything in my den (at least). THAT IS A HEALTH HAZARD. This dust was is in the air- I can literally smell it right now, inside my home.  This is just the most recent issue and I a SURE the staff will do nothing about it. They are HORRIBLE. They are turning this into a horrible place to live. Back to the washers and dryers- their most recent announcement is that everyone is receiving a washer dryer in their apartment. Have said nothing about raising rent costs but I feel that is coming. Also, instead of placing / fitting the w/d into a closet...they plan to place it in my bedroom, in the open, in the corner. In the corner of my bedroom. Who does that??! Other issues in the past have included: water gushing into my apartment through a crack in the side wall (I am a corner unit) and calling the after hours maintenance emergency number with no call back until the next day, there have been homeless people using the laundry room before and after alerting the office, they refused to change the security code for the laundry room door lock (there currently isn’t even a door lock anymore), there was a shooting literally 30ft from my door and the staff refused to put up security cameras in that area outside. This is all in TRAVIS HEIGHTS neighborhood, mind you. This is a nice area. THE STAFF NEED TO FIT THAT EXPECTED LEVEL OF LIVING. They are lazy and literally do not care about doing the right thing and running a successful management operation.

Almost at the end of my lease, and I do still like these apartments after a year. Lot of downsides but good for the price. Location is amazing but being on the first floor there is pretty much nothing to do about the roach problem. Also my upstairs neighbors constantly drop garbage and stuff off their porch onto my slab. Repairs always done in a timely manner though!

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING. THIS PLACE IS A MESS. Luckily, I never ended up living here. However, I Spent almost four months going back and forth with management about renting a unit. They told me I could use my one month free to spread it out over the entire lease, making it much cheaper per month. Sadly, they took almost another two month to actually send me the lease, and when they did, they were going to charge me almost 300$ a month more than we agreed upon!

When I tried to call Algarita, they told me the woman who gave me the deal no longer works with them and they do not honor those kind of deal. But they said they would check with their supervisors and get back to me. They never called me back and I had to spend a week trying to get back in contact with them. They ended up sending me the lease with an inflated price TWO MORE TIMES!! They were trying to squeeze more money out of me, hoping I wouldn’t read the lease. 

If you take away anything from this, please please don’t waste as much time as I did with these incompetent people. I ended up having to scramble to find a new place to live 3 weeks before moving to Austin. Management is awful, they don’t care about you or your complaints, and I feel lucky to have dodged a major bullet by not living here. 

If I could give this place zero stars, I would.

Lived here for two years and had multiple floods in the apartment.  The management was horrible.  The original manager, Nikki, was awesome, but the two latest office managers were not helpful and at times very rude.  We got flooded more than four times and had to move out and then they charged us for the carpet when we moved out, despite the fact that leaks damaged the carpet.  The management doesn't respond or answer phone calls or emails.  

In addition, the renovations are cheaply done and it is the opposite of luxory apartments.  I would not recommend living here.

Got free basic cable and Internet. Though it is Time Warner, would rather have Google Fiber, but we are not a Fiber hood location yet. So can't fault them for that. The complex is pretty quite, which is nice, hardly ever see any kids. Also don't expect much from the gym very tiny. But you are in a quite neighborhood and can run the trail at Little Stacy Park. Speaking of location, you are next to the Whip In, which has an amazing beer selection to go, beer-mimosa for brunch, and some really good Indian fusion food. Then next door, is liquor store, if you need something a little stronger. But back to the apartment, you also have newer A/C units which helps save on your electric bills. Which is a common mistake for renters. Due to heating and cooling being 50 to 60% of your energy bill. So that new A/C really helps. I would say the only down fall for this place is the Gym.

We moved in about three months ago and it has been a nice stay. Our neighbors can be heard when they walk and what not, but its an apartment. The staff is wonderful, and very friendly. I would recommend this place to others.
"Botoxed" but beautiful. AMenities & a great location

I've been a resident at Algarita for almost two years, and it's been great. I love living there- the staff is great, the sense of community is second to none, and it feels like home. It's a very animal-friendly apartment complex, which is awesome for me- I have a dog and a cat.

Nikki in the front office is the best property manager anyone could ask for- she knows you, takes care of you and ensures that you always feel confident in your home. I'm not moving anytime soon!

The best thing about this complex is its location. 
The property is so old and the renovations are a joke as they are poorly and cheaply done. The place does not have a sense of luxury.
Management is okay but they do a horrible job with maintenance requests. You have to ask for something multiple times until it gets done. Then you have to ask multiple times to actually get it done right.
I will not be renewing my lease

I've lived here for several years and I wanted to write a review here since I never have before. This apartment complex is a great place to live. It's clean and well run, the leasing staff is very helpful, and when I have an issue it get's fixed. Not to mention it's beautiful and the neighborhood is great.

If you want to have a pitbull that has not been neutered or spayed, this is the place for you!  

They have a smaller 1 bedroom unit that they offer after you find the larger 1 bedroom a little too expensive.  They don't allow you to see the smaller unit because the upstairs have vaulted ceilings and a truly small kitchen.  As far as I am concerned, they trick you into renting.

The Post Park Mesa team has the best office staff I've ever experienced in my long rental history.  They're quick to respond, reasonable and the maintenance requests are always filled quickly. I highly recommend it! My only issue is that our rent after one year was raised $500 for a 2 bedroom. I understand the Austin market is challenging, but this was too much for me. The property is beautiful and well maintained, and I've never had a parking issue.
Good - Waiting on the landscaping in front of my unit to be completed as promised
I love living at Post Park Mesa Apartments. It is quiet, clean, has nice neighbors, a competent and responsive staff, and lovely grounds. There is no downside.
Comfortable, quiet,very safe, convenient

The concierge here told me this place was a “fifth year college dorm” and no words are more true.  My neighbor has parties literally all night, people running up and down the hall and slamming doors.  I called the police last night at 3am because the concierge said they cannot stop parties here.  My neighbors have loud thumping bass music that stop me from working, but really that is the least of my problems.  When you complain, the leasing office does nothing.
I "would" and "have" recommended this apartment community to my friends and co-workers as the incredible staff make living here extremely easy.

I'd still consider recommending Skyhouse, but the pet problem is so acute right now that without at least limiting pets to specific floors, I would not recommend it to anyone who does not have or want pets.

There are many disruptions if you are working from home at Skyhouse. The community of neighbors are also incredibly disrespectful and no action has been take to resolve repeated issues. That being said, the location is great if you are looking to live down town.
I have said it before and will say it again- absolutely the best place I have ever loved. I love it here. I am so thankful.
I would definitely recommend, fantastic staff - always professional and super nice, great amenities and location!

So, I moved into this apartment complex in the middle of June and have had a great experience so far. That being said there are definitely some discrepancies that might not show up on that initial tour. First of all, there was a sense of strict security on that tour and truth be told the complex is very lax on many seemingly strict rules. That includes rules regarding dogs and hours for certain building amenities. In my opinion this is a good thing but for some it might be frustrating. Other than that, Sabina has wonderful amenities and spacious room layouts for great prices. Also, some have complained about the noise,i.e. hearing neighbors above you but this is no more than any other apartment complex. Finally upon touring you will find the complex to be massive (which it is) but that does allow for the feeling of more privacy and also due to the many rooms they are still trying to fill with tenants, which allows for tenants to get offers like a crazy 6 weeks off to move in!  Bottom line, this apartment is a great deal and really does have everything you would want:  swimming pool, club room, 24 hour gym, 24 hour free print room, conference room, movie theater, outside patio area with tv's, dog friendly, outdoor fireplace, 5 outdoor grills, free garage parking and more.  So definitely check it out, you'll be glad you did.

Sabina 2 bedroom apartments are spacious.  They have great functional flow.  Haven't had very many issues but when I've needed the help of the management they were always quick to respond.   The elevator situation is not great.  When i moved in,  it seemed to be broken every other week.  It has since gotten better but it is still slow and there's only one on each end of the building which makes it tough.  Overall, the property is always maintained well.  I would recommend it to anyone looking for a 2 bedroom close to downtown

I don't recommend it. 
Its very dangerous to live there there are thefts every day strange people walking around  dirt all around. The office does not react in any way they are only interested in money Terrible

This place is horrible, I moved here over a year ago, and got stuck.

I have videos and pictures for the building and the place. When it rains, you can’t walk in the backyard, as the place floods, so you’ll have to use the front door.

My apartment was flooded in the first month after moving in.

The building is not cleaned or touched for a year, so the trash made those huge spots and lines on the floor and stairs, it’s absolutely disgusting.

The trash ok the main street piles up next to the trash can, so you drive by it everyday. People are fixing their cars in parking lots! :)

Packages are stolen everyday, so you have to pick it up from an Amazon box or have their delivery service deliver it to you (Fitch). I have videos of a neighbour picking ip packages from my other neighbour’s front doors, this place is really miserable. I also have videos of people just walking by apartments to steal packages, but then realise the ring cam is there and just leave.

The place is nothing short of the projects, with people drinking by the entrance of the building and actually leaving trash behind, so you’ll sometimes walk to your car by beer cans and the fast food bags.

when you sign the lease, you’re locked for a year, if you try to leave prior to it, you’ll pay a penalty.

You might sign a lease for a nice wooden floor apartment, but might end up with another apartment.

Do NOT live here. They take advantage of you and provide the worst quality of living. A few issues I had with this place:

- Rent is Not Pro-rated: Move-in date is usually around August 25th, and they make you move out around July 25th, but they still charge you a full 12 months even though you're not there for a whole month. If you want to terminate early, you still are liable for a whole 12 months' worth of rent.
- Slow Maintenance: When I moved in my windows did not have screens. I put in a work order and it took 2 whole months and 5 phone calls to have screens installed. Our AC broke down twice, and each time it took over two weeks to fix--unacceptable in Texas's 100-degree weather. There were multiple times when they said they'd "get someone to fix the issue within the next 48 hours" and no one would come unless we kept following up.
- Pests and Dirty: The hallways are always a mess with trash and bird poop and I suspect they don't do enough pest control since I've had multiple cockroaches and gnats found in my unit that I ended up having to take care of myself with some bug killer spray.
- Parking Fee Not Canceled: A parking space is $100/month, and I had originally signed for a spot since I thought I'd have a car upon moving in, but I ended up not having a car for the first 6 months and had asked for my parking spot to be canceled during that time. The office refused, saying "it is part of the lease". The parking space was an add-on to the unit, it is not part of the lease.
- Missing Packages: a few of my Amazon packages said they were delivered to the front office but the office lost them.
- Loud: Leaf-blowers start at 8 am and fire alarms always going off. I understand it's near a university and there's a frat house literally across the street, but just make note that it's also near a couple of bars.
- Bad Wi-Fi: You don't have to set up your own Wi-Fi but just keep in mind you're sharing the network with all the other hundred or so residents so expect a slow connection.

Also a side-note, I noticed when it got closer to July (when potential new tenants would come to take a tour) they'd start sprucing up the place. Hallways that were filled with trash for the majority of the year would suddenly get cleaned up, the pool which was always dirty would suddenly become swimmable, work orders would be addressed faster, etc.. Just keep that in mind if you're touring the place in the summer.

But what really sets The Park at Walnut Creek apart is its location. It borders the Walnut Creek Metro Park, which is an absolute paradise for runners, hikers, bikers, and dog lovers. Whether you want to take a leisurely stroll or push yourself to the limit, this park has something for everyone. Overall, if you're looking for a basic but well-maintained apartment in a fantastic location with excellent staff, The Park at Walnut Creek could be just what you're looking for.

The area is perfect for students due to the local college only two blocks away. The management is friendly and the staff reply promptly to any problems that may arise. The club house is open 24/7 and includes a workout area with sauna and steam room, open pool and a grill area. Perfect for those days off when you want to hang out with friends.

The value for money at Bowie is poor due to its excessive prices compared to other luxury apartments in downtown Austin. I would strongly discourage you from considering Bowie Apartments. They have numerous issues with elevators, water, and power outages, among other problems. Bowie also charges extra for cable TV and internet services, even if we don't request them, and they refuse to remove these charges. Thus, in my opinion, Bowie no longer qualifies as a luxury apartment.

I’ve lived here two years and the infrastructure is unstable. Instead of investing in replacing necessary functions, they’ve chosen to enhance areas in the leasing office lobby area to lure new people in.

Unstable elevators, gas leaks or shut off, ongoing water issues / pipes bursting (not related to freezes and twice last month flooded), garage cracking and oozing water, expansive pest infestation of fruit flies for weeks, roaches have taken over pet park, improper pet park irrigation, 7 year old hallway carpet that is absolutely disgusting, trash chutes caved in and hallways lined with bagged trash instead of valet trash bins, NO A/C in elevators and hallways (hot humid stinky and packed as it takes 20min to get an elevator)… it goes on. 

Don’t sign a lease here.

I lived at the Bowie since November of 2019 and loved the accessibility to the lake but honestly, I am thoroughly disappointed with the experience now. I would NOT recommend this apartment complex.

I moved out on February 28, 2022. For over 3 weeks in February 2022, we had no gas. I am vegan and had my mom visiting - so it was absolutely painful (and super expensive) to NOT be able to cook at home and order out all the time. I was promised a concession (or rent rebate) but now the team tells me that Management hasn't approved any concession for folks that have left the building. This comes after an email where I specifically mentioned that I was moving out and my last month at Bowie has been thoroughly frustrating.

I would like to point out that it is NOT just the gas, there is always trouble to find a spot for Visitors to park their vehicle. I loved the Concierge and the Leasing team (especially Dey/Emily) but definitely would like to call out Emiliano - who is the rudest person to work with and has a major attitude problem.

You might be better off at other places in Downtown but do NOT go to the Bowie.

I went to ask about an Apartment and spoke with Denise the manager.  She was so helpful and kind, she went out of her way to answer any questions I asked and was so polite.  I would recommend anyone to go there and, all the staff were very pleasant and kind.

Thank you, Carmen and Tyler, for your exceptional service! Your attentiveness to my questions and concerns made me feel welcomed and appreciated. I truly enjoy the well-kept property, especially the swimming pools, which add to my positive experience.

We recently stayed with family members who live inside this complex.  We were very impressed with the apartment layout and quality of fixtures and flooring.  This was a very quite complex.   The staff was very informative of the area attractions and immunities of the complex.

My experience living at Cortland River Place began with a tour that made me feel so comfortable. That feeling followed me through choosing an apartment and moving in.  I have decided that a home that offers peace of mind and comfort is an incredible thing. The staff are all professional and friendly. They go the extra mile to make living here the best it can be.

I just moved here recently and I’m already loving it, my unit is nice, leasing staff is amazing especially Tyler and Carmen. I hope they continue to maintain the cleanliness of this apartment complex. That’s how it shows they care about their residents.

All of my experiences with the property manager, Denise, and the staff at Cortland River Place have been positive and pleasant. You can tell that you are in good hands with the professionalism and attentiveness with which they operate. I highly recommend!

I moved down from Washington State 2 weeks ago and its been great so far. A few issues that needed fixed were taken care of as soon as I could coordinate with maintenance. Its not resort quality, but its not resort cost either, it is way better than price for value I have found elsewhere. Overall a great place to live so far. And the staff that I have met so far are very helpful and friendly.

Colonial Grand at Onion Creek is such a nice community. It is set right off the highway in SW Austin. The community is quiet and well kept. Maintenance is quick to handle your requests and keeps you updated every step of the way. Even in the middle of the night when you call the emergency line they come. If the problem is very server, they call in re-enforcements. Management is very nice and friendly each time I call the office. I am still often surprised when I call the office and they address me by my name. They provide small treats for the residents and activities that you can take home an enjoy with your family and friends. This property is more than just an apartment complex-it truly is a home. I love the sense of safety that I feel when outside in the evening. I can safely walk inside the complex and greet my neighbors who are also outside walking or just sitting on their balconies and porches. If you are a nature lover, you can see the deer running in the fields behind the complex or see the many different species of birds that call our community home. There are events focused on the residents to keep us happy all year long.

QUESTION...do you value your sanity? THEN DO NOT SIGN A LEASE WITH THESE PEOPLE!! Everything about this apartment complex is a mess. I've been here since November and its just been one thing after another with this place. Read the reviews and heed their warnings. Don't let them hose you!!

oh....and....YOU MUST PAY FOR CABLE in the year of our lord TWENTY NINETEEN!! I don't even watch cable but theres no way out of it. I recently moved to MAA Balcones Woods in Austin, Texas, and unfortunately, my experience has been less than satisfactory. When I applied, I was promised a unit with a swimming pool view, but upon moving in, I discovered that this was not the case. The video they showed me during the application process turned out to be outdated, which created false expectations. Additionally, the apartment itself is in poor condition, with cracks on the walls and mold growth. Safety is also a concern, as there have been incidents of stolen cars on the property, and a gun shooting occurred here on April 22, 2024.

I recommend that potential renters exercise caution and thoroughly research before choosing MAA Balcones Woods. Honest reviews like this can help others make informed decisions.

I've lived at this apartment complex for the past 14 months, and my experience has been disappointing.

The leasing office staff are unprofessional and rude, particularly the managers, who seem to lack proper training. On the other hand, the maintenance team is fantastic—helpful, professional, and always pleasant.

The safety of the complex is a significant concern. Car break-ins are a daily occurrence, and there have even been instances of shootings.

When we first moved in, we were promised an apartment with a pool view, which was the reason for the higher rent. However, upon moving in, we were given a different unit with no pool view. Despite our objections, the management refused to adjust the rent, which felt like a deceptive practice.

Upon moving out, we meticulously cleaned the apartment, leaving it in better condition than when we moved in. Nevertheless, they charged us a cleaning fee and took our deposit. When we questioned this, they said we were supposed to inform them via email about our cleaning efforts, which seems absurd since they wouldn't waive the fee just based on our word.

Overall, my experience with this apartment complex has been marred by poor management, safety issues, and unfair practices.

I’ve been living here a few months and don’t have a thing to complain about. The front office and the maintenance team have been extremely attentive and prompt in addressing any concerns or messages sent to them. Its quiet, the grounds are kept clean, haven’t had any pests issues, they communicate with the tenants regarding anything we need to be made aware of, and the overall location of the complex is close to so many stores/places and is also a good value for the price you pay for what you get.

good luck getting any help from management. this place is horrible and needs an overhaul. rent is already on the high end—then you realize you have to pay an exorbitant water bill and are forced to sign up for their tv/internet service. what a joke.
