My motorcycle was stolen yesterday, our car got broken into last month. The gate has never worked, doors have never consistently worked more than a day at a time. Hallway either smells like weed or sewage depending on the day. Turn around, don’t drown.

I don't ever write reviews but after my experience I had no choice. Management was the worst I've ever dealt with. They will not return calls or emails but continue to raise their fees. Security is a huge issue, doors are constantly broken and my truck even got broken into. A new mice problem has occurred in the building but you can get ahold of management to fix it. For a 500sqft studio apartment, they fees are around $300. Don't rent here.

When I first moved in the place was decent and management was good, but now with the change of management there is nothing luxurious about this place. Maintenance is done through a separate app so you get no help at front desk if nothing gets fixed, also they only allow ONE person within the apartment to have the app, so i always have to ask my roommate for his phone to let me put in a request. The door knob to the entrance has been broken for MONTHS (literally missing an entire door knob), you hear police sirens literally every night, and the traffic to get to the apartment is terrible. Very crowded and surrounded by homeless people. Phones dont get answered and the hall ways smell terrible because everyone leaves their trash out because they locked the trash room. The trash has been an issue for MONTHS now with no fix. The luxor package room is always packed to the brim with no organization, takes years to find your package (if it didnt get stolen) and the management is just awful. I've been to my friends apartment and it is like night and day, so organized and up-kept, and it is way cheaper since it doesn't have the "luxury" tag on it. DO NOT MOVE TO THE EDISON APARTMENT, don't be fooled by the beautiful lobby area.

Keys were ready when scheduled! Staff was just as friendly as the day I applied. The energy around the complex is soul changing warm and the landscape is beautiful. For the money I believe I made a great investment for my future. No matter your budget, there is a place for you in this life. I believe I have found my sin for the next few years! Thank you for the opportunity to live in your community.

I love my new home. Leasing was easy and staff is professional, friendly, knowledgeable and transparent which is of key importance to me. 

Maintenance staff is responsible, respectful, and attentive.
It's not worth the price anymore. It went down hill express the pandemic, and hasn't made it back yet. It used to be good.  But, all apartments are way to expensive for what you get.

It seems a lot like the dishwasher; the new one seems iffy. Brandon at the front desk is our hero. He came to shut off the fire alarms. He would be a GREAT manager; he goes above and beyond every time. The maintenance is lacking in doing a job for 4 or 5 times.

This community has been nothing short of amazing.  The staff is wonderful and the complex is safe and clean . They stay on top of maintenance request and are always willing to help of you need it . I have recommended so many people to greystar properties and will continue to do so .

I have a good experience in Toscana in general, my apartment is very luminous a little noisy the maintenance is fast and efficient, some things to improve, for example the garbage containers that are in poor condition and give a bad impression to the complex.

Cameron provided outstanding service as he walked us through all the details. He provided excellent perspective into pros and cons (in his perspective) of some of the units we looked at. His understanding of the rules and policies as we asked questions about the property. 

The property itself is beautiful with a surprisingly quiet location. There is a huge amount of green space in the area with plenty of trees and open areas for dogs. Multiple exits to very different streets means that traffic will rarely block you from getting onto nearby main surface roads.

Big thanks again to Cameron for absolutely knocking it out of the park and giving us a wonderful tour.

We have called Southpark Terraces home for a year now and couldn't be happier. The maintenance of the common areas is exceptional as is the response time and quality for any request.
All the team is service-oriented and you can tell that leadership is truly present.

I was very impressed at how clean the facility was.  The apartments are spacious  with all the amenities I needed.  The staff was friendly and courteous.  I interacted with Renee and she was very helpful.  I would definitely recommend!!

I've been living in this apartment community for a while now, and I have to say, the maintenance team is exceptional! Joe is always prompt in responding to requests and ensure that any issues are fixed quickly and efficiently. The staff is friendly and professional, and they go above and beyond to make sure that residents are comfortable and happy. Whether it's a minor repair or a major fix, they handle everything with care and expertise. I'm really grateful for their hard work and dedication. Highly recommend!

I am happy to have found this complex to call home. from the moment we toured with Renee we knew we found the perfect place. we love our apartment and the entire front office team. highly recommend this complex.

I chose Cortland mainly based on the safety reviews. Since my move in, I have noticed how quickly the office staff checks up and how pleasant everyone has been as well as how the maintenance crew responds quickly to service requests and general care in the complex. I have been very happy and have felt much safer here during the few months that I’ve been here than in the last couple years in my last couple apartments. I felt safe enough to have my motorcycle out, and when someone did decide to hop the fence and take it, the neighbors quickly called it in to the cops and someone from Cortland staff found the bike just a few days later. I know they were just doing their job, but all of these things mean a lot to me as a resident. 
I have had no issues with noise or packages being taken, and have already experienced neighborly community. Just wanna say thanks for being the first place I’ve actually called home since moving to Austin!

This is the most incompetent management company in an unsafe location that does not deliver on any of its advertisements. 

There is nothing about these units that match the pictures shown. The walls are thin as paper, the units are infested with bugs, no rules are enforced, and management doesn't follow the stipulations in the leases. 

Do. Not. Live. Here.

I like this apartment community because the service staff are actually helpful and the rents are reasonably priced for good quality apartments. These are not trophy-style apartments but good quality and safe for my family and I.
This place sucks. Apartments are overpriced for what you get. Bugs. Drug addicts. Garbage everywhere. And terrible staff.

The price is too high and the communication is really poor. The pool and gym are still under construction. Half of the tenants seem to be hoarders with boarded-up balconies. I toured 3 units. Two smelled like cat urine and one smelled like mold. I didn't end up signing my lease it was worth losing the $250 application fee NOT to live here. They did finally call me back and refunded $50 of the Application fee. That is the only reason it's not a 1 Star from me.

All of the negative reviews are on point to this place. I’ve lived here for a couple of months and am waiting for the final days of the lease to move to a better place.
Bug problems, horrible neighbors that litter with little conscious to other people, loud music from neighbors, little to no parking space, AC is old and dust riddled, etc, the list just goes on and on. On top of that, they expect rent that is equivalent to better managed apartments. 
Don’t be deceived by the “showing room” they guide you through. The real apartment they give you is nothing like that.

I WISH I would have paid attention to the reviews before renting from this company. I was in a tight spot since I was 9 months pregnant and wanted a place before the baby arrived. I figured this would be a okay temporary situation. Unfortunately, from day one there have been issues with management, maintenance and worst of all ROACHES. I’ve been pretty easy going about it because the assistant manager I met when first visiting the property had been nice. However, 6 months later I have to keep my food in ziplock backs in the cabinets and can not even place my daughter on the floor to play for fear a roach will pop up. Don’t even get me started on the other tenants they allow to live here and all the disruptive behavior of people and pets alike. The property is gated but they can’t be bothered to fix them to working conditions. The parking situation is dire and there’s constantly debris strewn about everywhere. I politely asked for an out on my lease and was told if I leave, I would need to pay all early termination fees. I’ve always paid my rent on time and have given them ample time and chances to fix the issues inside of my apartment. You would think a business would hold up their end of the contract and provide livable conditions. I feel sorry for anyone who finds themselves in my situation and has to rent at such a horrible property. That being said I will still be ending my lease and will just have to deal with the consequences. My daughter deserves to grow up in a roach free environment.

Love the fact that even in the complex, you never leave the hill country scenery. There’s a trail towards the back that my dog and I have made a routine. Staff keeps you updated with everything. Portal is super easy to use. Maintenance was quick. 8/10 (bc of the small kitchen cabinets)
This community is quiet, Friendly, and is in a great location with awesome views.

I have lived at Hudson Miramount for over a year now, and have loved everything about living here.  It’s a wonderful place to call home.  I feel like it’s a hidden gem.  The front office staff are always very helpful, professional- including the maintenance team.

I’ve lived at Hudson Miramont for 12 years, it’s a great place to call home! The property is beautiful, both the interior and exterior of the buildings, and the lush landscapes of native flowers and tress. It’s centrally located and quick to get anywhere, downtown, dripping springs, bee cave and Lakeway.

You get charged a trash pickup fee but your trash doesn't always get picked up. You're not allowed to throw away your own trash because you get fined. They keep the trash compactors locked and the community cannot access them.

I'm a 10 year  resident of the Hudson Miramont community and I love the people who take care of it, who help populate it and the people who live here. When we have a crisis (remember the Icecane of February 2022?), we all band together to assist each other and it's a beautiful experience. The pool is like a family reunion, all during the warm months.  Hudson appears to be far away from downtown, however the reality is that it is a VERY short drive to the downtown area, is built next to a beautiful greenbelt and if you are a plant lover, next door to Natural Gardener.  I highly recommend living at Hudson Miramont!!!

It's fine living here but they will make up stuff to charge you when you leave. I was charged 200 dollars for crack in ceiling and wall.. I sure as heck wasn't dancing on the ceiling to cause a crack. Prolly the bad building moving more likely or the dog above that never stopped barking over a year. Dont move here y'all.

DO NOT BE FOOLED. THESE APARTMENTS LOOK NICE, but that is all. Feel equal out to ATLEAST 100 more a month on rent, maintenance is half fixing things. I’ve had the same issue fixed 3 times and it is still messed up. The renewals will be astronomically high, so plan to only live here 1 month. They act like they are offering the best rate, they are actually overpriced.  The apartments do not pay for anything. Make sure you look around more before moving here.

New management gives conflicting and dishonest information. This is not a place that cares about its residents. Fellow residents also complain of skyrocketing rent that comes ahead of pay increases, and this from engineers and other well educated professionals.

It has mainly been a good experience. I did have a crazy upstairs neighbor on my first apartment there. The walls are thin, you can hear your neighbors. The apartments are very nice and modern. I love the kitchen island and the open floor plan.
Landscaping is not consistent. Maintenance has gotten better but still issues unresolved. Location is great and buildings are never loud at all. Management can be hard to reach.

This complex is the nicest I've been in by far. Beautiful landscaping, easy to navigate, and the kindest and most helpful management I've dealt with. I've had a tumultuous year and they have been so understanding and helpful.

Nice apartment, I love the beautiful community. Only problem is regular big noise from the railway when train passing through. And also you can barely find a parking lot right at your unit, have to park pretty far away.

Highline is a nice luxury apartment and is located conveniently off Parmer within a short distance of anything you could need--grocery stores, banks, gas stations, restaurants or bars. The pool is a fairly large size and can hold quite a few people. The grounds are clean and very pet-friendly. I have lived here for 3 years and my unit feels like home.

Terrible maintenance staff that ignore requests and do nothing to fix the issues. Always tells us they are waiting for "parts" that they never receive. Since move-in our dishwasher has never worked and requests have been made almost monthly with no avail. Even called front office for direct contact of the problem and they tell us a specific day for when they will send maintenance and they never show up. 

Noise is awful to deal with here because of the thin walls and flooring. You can hear footsteps from units above you that you do not want to be petty about and submit a complaint but this is a problem when it comes to normal-voice conversations during the night. You can hear average conversations during the night. My roommate and a share 2br/2bath and have received multiple noise complaints for "loud voices, yelling, and loud music" when we dont even use speakers and use headphones. Furthermore, when we arent using headphones and studying, working, or on our computers we cant even hear each other from the other side of the same unit but would receive noise complaints from residents above us that truly show how thin the flooring is here at this Apartment Complex. 

There is constant trash near the area and walkways of the apt that have been there for months. We kept a fairly large tube for the river that we use in our gated porch that was stolen that the apt complex did not take any responsibility for and told us to be more careful and leave goods inside. Basically making our gated porch useless. 

During the snowstorm in 2021 the sheltered parking that we pay for as an "amenity" collapsed on every single residents vehicles and we were obviously not reimbursed for damage. However, the main issue with that was the poor structure of these rooves and the amount of time it took for them to be removed from our vehicles. The collapsed sheltered parking stayed on all of our vehicles for weeks as they only sent us emails saying they are doing what they can and we should file claims, out of our own pocket of course. 

If it wasn't for the location being close to work and average price, only because I share a unit, I would not live here because of the TERRIBLE maintenance staff, unhelpful front desk when it comes to maintenance, subpar amenities, AWFUL noise due to thin floors and unfriendly neighbors who complain, and overall lack of responsibility by the apartment complex.
Great community and an excellent staff running the place.

Long story short.... DONT LIVE HERE. 

Ive lived here for about 2 years and have been through 3 management teams: US Residential, Avenue 5, and now Lincoln Management. 

When Lincoln took over they started charging us more for trash. There is NOTHING that they cover. You pay water, the boiler management fee, the gas bill for the boiler, valet trash, storm drainage, and even the trash dumpster pick up cost, the package storage locker sign up fee. 

Management, including Courtney, seemingly don’t care about their tenants.

Courtney always has an excuse for why the office falls short on communication. 

An email was sent out at the beginning of COVID saying we’d be surveyed prior to any maintenance coming out, and yet my tickets weren’t being actioned. When I questioned the office (who never answers and always changes their hours) they said they had a company policy that prevented them from coming out and performing any non-emergency maintenance. 

These apartments are very nice and quiet, however management is a serious issue. 

Also, My garage has been broken into twice and there are numerous other burglary reports from this property. The gate has stayed open for the past 2 years and there is always an excuse. From, someone hitting it, to parts back order, to bids, to the latest “because of COVID-19.”

Management says the following are affect by COVID-19:
-the clubhouse can’t be used
-the pool and gym can only be used during office hours and by reservation only
-non-emergency maintenance is suspended
-the gate is kept open

I wouldn’t have renewed here if I knew Lincoln was going to basically limit all the amenities and maintenance. 

I’ve asked to speak to someone higher than Courtney and have yet to get a call from anyone higher.

These people find ways to charge you for anything. 
Getting in contact with management is nearly impossible if you don’t drop in. Calls and emails are rarely answered.
You have to pay for valet trash even though you don’t need it. Dumpsters are always full, looks very messy.

Location is great, apartments are decent, and area is maintained very good.
After the management has been changed, all they want is MONEY. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

I have been living here for about a month and cannot be happier about my choice. The staff particularly Bri and Felix have been very friendly and helpful. They care about the residents and are approachble about any and all concerns. We are new to Austin and the highline has felt like home already! Thank you!

I hate to have to write a review like this, but probably not a place to live if you’re looking as a resident. The care of the complex overall is poor- trash piles up near the dumpster for days, trash is left around the complex without being picked up my maintenance or residents. The gym is never cleaned and smells like sweat and cigarettes. I showed the leasing office a video of a severe ceiling leak in my bathroom and still, nothing has been done about it (not to mention I have placed work orders for it that have been ignored). I was promised on move in day that the mold in my bathroom ceiling would be addressed; it hasn’t been addressed BUT more mold has grown instead. Poor quality interior appliances and materials- the dishwasher doesn’t actually clean dishes but leaves them still dirty with a greasy film. And my fob key goes on the fritz on a monthly basis. I’m incredibly disappointed in the difference between what I was shown and promised on a tour, versus what I actually received.

Despite living at this property for over 5 years, I would never recommend it while it is managed by American Landmark. 

I'm sure if you are a prospective tenant, they're attentive and communicative, but once you actually live here, any issues you experience will just be brushed aside.

After having issues with neighbors for months, the office managers were unwilling to offer me any assistance in providing a discounted unit elsewhere on the property or covering costs that I would incur to have to move to a different unit at the same price. I was basically told, you can move to a different unit and that's it, all because they refuse to do more than the bare minimum at addressing tenant's concerns.

Previous property management companies were attentive and willing to work with tenants, but that seems to have gone away with American Landmark.

The only reason they aren't left with 1 Star is because the maintenance staff is usually quick to respond to maintenance requests.

Other concerns:

- Rent keeps going up despite no additional value added to the units aside from putting in a new countertop and painting some cabinets.

- There is a "technology package" included in your lease (not reflected on the rent prices on these sites though) that is basically inadequate apartment-assigned community wifi and basic cable for $89.

- Mailboxes are perpetually broken and half of the wall is always open, leaving mail exposed to anyone who happens to walk by.
My visit was great. Everyone was extremely nice and informative. The property is nice. Also, I spoke with Sophia, who made me feel very welcomed.

Are you planning on moving here? Well, plan on getting your identity stolen by the people that break into the mailboxes. This place has made my life a living nightmare. For months now, they have been breaking into our mailboxes and the maintenance staff just repairs them and let the stealing continue. No security at all. The most unsafe place I've ever lived in. The replies from the admin office are vague, to say the least, and they have not notified the residents of these ongoing issues.

While being here only 1 year I've seen at least 3 or 4 managers come and go. While claiming to be "luxury" apartments it's really just a shiny facade and not actually that luxury. On top of that Tennants were forced to pay for upgrades that weren't needed or wanted. They made us leave the apartment several times for them to complete remodels not caring that we had a 7 month old baby to take care of. On top of that the "upgrades" were of the lowest quality work and have since already crapped out. It's obvious that the new property owners really only care about making money. The valet trash service costs $30 a month and leaves the entire community looking like garbage since a majority of people who live here don't follow the rules, which means garbage everywhere when you leave and come home (also the compacter rarely works so there is  huge PILE of garbage you have to drive by every day.  There are security gates that never close. A bunch of mailboxes are broken and can't even lock. They forced us to sign up for a $90 technology package for internet and TV and even after a month never explained how to access it. We recently had a bug problem. They are short on maintenance crews (BEFORE the pandemic) and repairs are rarely completed in a timely manner. There are several other reasons this place is not worth staying at. Sadly, if you decide to break your lease they want 3 months worth of rent to do it. There is a good chance that once they finish gentrification of the complex all these issues will be a thing of the past, but I fully regret ever moving in here. Again. This has been my personal experience and others may love this place.

The reason I  gave it a 1 star is because it does not deserve an overall three stars, plus the bad outweighs the good by A LOT. I  have supplied some of my reasons here. I  also advise that everyone read their contract completely before signing and ask questions. I WILL BE UPDATING THIS REVIEW ON A REGULAR BASIS.
Issues in no particular order of importance; 
1. The gate has not worked since I moved in late December of 2019  and still doesn't till this day 02/21/2020 - was told I'd get a key fob for the gate. ( didn't get one)
2. Still have not received washer machine and dryer machine - I  was initially informed it would be delivered a week after I moved in, and I  have asked numerous times after that. (I gave up asking - make sure it is in your apartment at move-in.) 
3. There is nothing in place for resident safety - There aren't many lights here on the grounds so at night its extremely dark. There are no practices in place to even mitigate safety. 
4. There is a great amount of unused covered parking and almost no-one uses it so if you get off at 5 PM and it takes more than 36 minutes to arrive home chances are you are parking along the sides of the complex (just get rid of some ports and incorporate some light fixtures) so at least if I have to walk with my child to my apartment from across the complex there is some sense of safety. 
5. Uneven and broken terrain - mean there are cracks, loose gravel, and sharp and acute dips in the concrete pavement that goes unnoticed by management (not even a warning sign or cone) 
6. The doors are not sealed properly - I  learned this quickly once the temperature started to drop, no amount of heat keeps my apartment warm unless it is continuously running. 
7. The bathroom toilets in the apartments are small and the bathroom sink water pressure is almost nonexistent plus the water heater and HVAC equipment are kept in the bedroom closet. (these may be more personal preferences but important FYI's)
8. The management/lease/maintenance team could improve (also refer to the good section of this post)  
The good in no particular order; 
9. Mailbox keys - I  struggle daily to open my mailbox because there is a lock malfunction or a box malfunctions it is so bad I  thought I  had the wrong key for a long while and did not get some important mail. (I still struggle with it)

Great location- terrible management! They do not care about their residents. I’ve been here for 2 yrs and during this past year we’ve been without water and electricity for a 1.5 weeks, flooding damage from above units with no corporation from management and they’ve been renovating/fixing damages for 6 months. The latest complaint - they’re painting the hallways so all our doors are taped shut and of you get out of your door you enter a cloud of paint smoke.

This place isn’t worth the price
First class amenities and high end finishes
Highly recommend 7East! Great community, staff and maintenance are friendly and responsive, location is great!
Great location.
Good apartments in a great location
Lived here for 2 years and have no reason to consider leaving. The community, management, maintenance teams, and location gives me everything Id want and more.
The community is well kept, but management team needs improvement. Very unsatisfactory.
Great community located in a trendy neighborhood. Many cool spots locally.
I would not recommend 7east given their inability to provide safe living conditions.

7East is the best place I have lived in Austin. The staff is great, there are tons of well maintained amenities, and the culture and location can't be beat. You are within walking distance of so many great spots, but tucked just far enough back to still feel private and not constantly surrounded by people. I love it!
Great place to call home. Friendly and responsive leasing and maintenance teams. Fiber internet available.

Good location with access to trendy bars and dining, standard amenities for anything built since 2012. 

While you do have to pay for access to the garage, there’s plenty of parking. Although, I don’t recommend parking on the lower gated level as that gate is often left open and has resulted in alleged theft from other residents. And despite there being a gated access garage, there have been a couple of car break-ins since I’ve lived here. 

There’s a dog run/Park, but it doesn’t smell great and a lot of the residents just let their dogs go out there to bark at other dogs. 

While I’ve never heard my next door neighbors, I’ve experienced continuous and daily disruption from not one, but two upstairs tenants. Being right on a busy road and the consequence of what appears to be shoddy construction have resulted in a lot of noise. It is by far the biggest drawback and worst part of the apartment. If you’re not on a top floor, it’s likely you’ll end up with an inconsiderate upstairs neighbor who stomps around non-stop. 

Management is responsive to complaints but not helpful as after a year they’ve been unable to mitigate the noise issues from above. The solution was to move me to another unit that far exceeds my current rent and completely unrealistic. 

If you’re near a door leading to the exterior you’ll also hear your neighbors going in and out as the doors squeak and slam. 

Maintenance is quick and does a decent job. Could be more professional and better about cleaning up after repairs are made. 

I’m on the second level and encounter a lot of dirt, cobwebs and other less than pleasant things toward the end of hallways and in corners. 

The building was finally able to resolve the missing and undeliverable package issue by installing package lockers. 

When I first moved in, there were a couple of cool businesses operating in the retail space below the apartments, all of those have since closed or changed service direction. But as I first mentioned, this area is walkable with lots of great things in close proximity. 

Overall, I would strongly recommend considering other apartments if you’re looking to rent for more than a couple of months.

We have lived here for a little over 6 months and absolutely love it. The building is brand new and in the perfect location on the Eastside. We can walk to so many restaurants, bars, coffee shops, or even downtown. We didn't know much about the location when we first visited, but the leasing office staff is amazing and a large part of the reason we moved here. The Property Manager Brenda showed us around the first time and she is awesome. We had so much fun touring the building and talking to her. The rest of the office staff, Summer and Michael, are also great and so fun to talk to whenever we are down in the leasing office. 

I also recently sold my car so now I use Car2Go all the time. There may not be parking on 7th Street, but there is plenty of street parking just one block over on Robert Martinez or Hidalgo. I have never come home and not been able to park the Car2Go on those streets. If you are looking for a smaller community, where you will actually meet some of your neighbors at the great resident events, then I would highly recommend this apartment building. Keep up the great work 7East!!

I have lived at 7East for about six months. The building is great and the office staff is fantastic. They have stayed late so I could come pick up a package after work. They are very quick to respond to maintenance requests. They also organize community events at local restaurants with free food and drinks. These events are a great way to meet your neighbors. I have never known so many of my neighbors as I do here. The gym, pool, and club room are really nice and never crowded. There is plenty of secured parking for residents and then there is guest parking on the first level. If the guest lot is full there is plenty of free street parking on Robert Martinez Rd. The location of the building is amazing. You can walk everywhere. I highly recommend living here.
I live in a couple apartments in Austin Tx, this is the best maintenance staff (THEYRE PROFESSIONAL END KNOW WHAT THEY RE DOING.

Pearl Lantana has raised rent renewal prices to astronomical levels. 
Management recently started a new partnership with the hated Fetch delivery service.
EV chargers have been broken for many months.
Avoid!

I lived at Pearl Lantana from April 2020 – July 2021.  It was the best apartment complex I’ve lived in and I only moved because I bought a home.  I actually miss living there.  Here is why I recommend Pearl Lantana:

-The management team is top notch.  I worked with Gina mostly, but everyone at the property was genuinely friendly, they knew residents by first name, were very professional, and were on top of the details.  Any time something came up they worked to accommodate me.  For example, I owed them an answer on a lease renewal, but had a home to tour the weekend I was supposed to let them know whether I was renewing.  I asked for a few days extension and they gave it to me with no problem.  I’ve lived in places that are so robotic that you don’t feel like you’re dealing with people or so loose that nothing is tended to or there’s a lot of turnover in the management team.  The management team at Pearl Lantana is consistent and the best I’ve worked with (and I’ve lived in a lot of places in different states).  During the winter storm of 2021 they worked around the clock to help everyone out and brought in tons of resources to make everyone comfortable.  

-The maintenance team is top notch.  Any time I entered a ticket someone was there that day to address anything that came up and they were also professional, timely, and knowledgeable.  They seemed well staffed on this front, which is part of why the property is so well maintained.

-The location is perfect.  Not directly in the thick of everything, which translates into a more affordable price.  It’s on Southwest Parkway, so getting places is easy and fast and I never had to wait in traffic.

-The property is one of the best I’ve seen in the Austin area.  The building quality is high.  Appliances and finishes are nice, nothing in my unit was worn down or beat up looking.  I’m pretty sure my carpet was brand new when I moved in.  The amenities are beautiful and high quality.  2 big pools and a lap pool, a really nice club house, and a functioning gym that you can do most types of workouts at (including heavy lifting).

I’ve been with Pearl Lantana for quite a while now and have really loved living here. As a female living alone, I really appreciate that it’s a gated complex with a courtesy officer who lives on site. The maintenance staff is like family and even had a rapport with my dog ;)

I would highly recommend if you are looking to live in Austin but with some breathing room out near the hill country. Will definitely be renewing my lease!

Pearl Lantana is a great apartment!  It is by far the best apartment we have lived in (out of 7 apartments).  Julie has gone above and beyond to keep this a luxury apartment community.  

Below are a few reasons why we love Pearl Lantana: 

The office staff is very friendly and helpful.  It is always a nice experience stopping by the front office for a package or discussion.  The office staff is also super quick at responding to emails.  

The maintenance staff goes out of their way to assist with any issues.  Our air conditioner broke on the weekend and 15 minutes after we called Sid was here helping us out! 

The areas around the property are ALWAYS clean! This includes the pool, gym, front office, etc.  I love that you have coffee available for your residents.  This helps me out tremendously when I work from home or at the front office area! 

The quality of the apartment is wonderful.  We love our little home! 

The community events are a great time! 

The list goes on.... 

I highly suggest Pearl Lantana!

My partner and I toured this property hoping to get a place with a yard for our dog. We were showed the unit we would be moving into, loved it, and decided to apply that day, 7/12.
Radio silence. Checked the application online to see that it had been canceled. Reached out to the person we toured with, and was told the application was canceled by the 3rd party screening service due to “no response given” regarding our credit info. No response to what? We were never sent anything to respond to! I obsessively checked my email, including the spam folder and I never received ANY correspondence from the property or the screening service. Also crazy that it had been canceled for an entire day and no one told us anything, I had to ask about it. But no big deal, he re submits the application for us. Again, radio silence. I reach out again on 7/20 for an update. Only then am I made aware that there was an issue with my partner’s credit, and we had to wait for the property manager to override the problem and rescreen us (it was the weekend, property manager wouldn’t be back until monday. Cool, no problem) Radio. Silence. 7/24 I send another email asking for an update or literally anything concerning our application. It is worth noting that when we applied, we set our move in date to 7/26. Two days prior to when we would’ve been moving in, and I have no idea whats going on. I receive no response, and my partner and I decided to cut our losses and apply somewhere else. We got approved immediately. JULY 29TH I receive a voicemail while at work from the person we had been corresponding with, telling me that since we were “approved conditionally” we needed to let them know what type of deposit we wanted to do, and if I didn’t respond by 5:45 (it was 5:30) the application would be denied. Im sorry what???? Not only did I not receive an email, phone call, or ANYTHING from the property over the last 5 days, I wasn't even told we had been approved???? As far as Im concerned this was a bullet dodged. I can’t imagine living somewhere with such horrible communication.

If you have kids stay away from this place. They have 2 dog parks with tents and a playground for kids without it. Just try to imagine how hot slide when 100 degrees outside ?? My car was stolen from the garage, and my bought kids were bitten by dogs. Dogs poop everywhere. Gates is broken all the time. I waited 3 weeks for washer repair. I could go on and on

I recently moved into this community and I'm liking it overall. My apartment is clean but it has some repairs which they fixed in the first few weeks. The gym, pool & leasing office are really good. The staff here (especially Trevor) are very friendly & responsive. The community has nice place for walking, jogging & kids park etc. There's plenty of open parking. The area is also close to all supermarkets & restaurants. You'll find almost everything within 10 minutes radius.

The only thing I hated is that the steps & corridors are very dirty (reason for one less star in my rating). I don't know if they have plans on cleaning it, when I asked them they just said it gets done when the cleaning staff have time. I did not get any definitive answer. I spoke to other tenants and they told me the same. Also, my balcony was very dirty when I first moved in. I asked them if they can clean but they were not sure. I cleaned it myself.

Basically, outdoors are dirty but indoors are beautiful. I hope they clean it soon. I'll update my review based on their future actions.

They’ve raised my rent by over $250 in less than 1 year. There are always pests, including wasps INSIDE my home. There are bed bugs in the apartment community and they will charge YOU to exterminate them, even if you’re quarantined and can prove you didn’t bring them in.
Where’s this money going? There’s been a pile of dirty cat litter next to my front door for MONTHS that nobody cleans. Garbage pickup is unreliable. The front gates and coffee maker in the lobby are always broken. Overpriced dump.

Never ever move to this apartments! I have been affected by snowstorm  in early February. There was a power cut and no water supply for several days. I can understand its all over the Texas. But there was no much help from management. My apartment is damaged very badly because of water leakage , as a part of fix they teared apart the hardboard inside the walls and yet to fix it.Its been almost 2 months and dont see they are going to fix it anytime soon. There is no proper estimate on fixing it. Management come up with so many excuses if I ask about my apartment. I cant use my living room at all. I wish i could post my apartments pictures here. There is no proper response on when they are going to fix it(like weeks or months or years). One more issue is there is no guarantee that our packages deliver safely. I never have good experience in my package deliver. Feeling bad staying here.

We live here and there's a lot of crime. The cops were called last month for a shooting and yesterday we had someone steal a $600 bike that was chained up in our backyard. Management doesn't care about the people who live here, and always say legally they are not responsible for what happens even though our community gates have been opened and broken for weeks leaving the people who live here unsafe. You have been warned you do not want to live here especially if you have small children!

Been here for over 3 years and I can’t say enough about how awesome the office and maintenance staff are here!! Maintenance is super responsive and the office staff is so nice! The pool area and grounds are beautiful and the clubhouse area is awesome, they have a really nice gym, a game room and vending machines. The entire property is always clean, updated and well kept. Don’t listen to the bad reviews about this place. It’s probably coming from people who don’t pay their rent and blame everyone else for their own self inflicted shortcomings. I have nothing bad to say about this complex or its staff. Don’t hesitate to sign a lease and make Onion Creek Luxury Apartments your home!

Management Support is the worst management company of any apartments I’ve ever experienced. They will enter without notice, refuse to prove copies of paperwork I signed (my move out notice for one and move in inspection).  Vital to fight their bogus charges at move out.  I was gouged in price because I’m trying to do the right thing and not break my lease when I accepted a job in Austin while living in San Antonio - I transferred to this ‘sister property’ and they are like twin evils.  Steer clear from Onion Creek (not so) Luxury Apartment’s... if you value your hard earned money anyway.  Zero stars here!

The entire staff at Onion Creek Luxury Apartments is professional.  The culture is that similar to that of a family.  The culture is one that is unmatched by other complexes in the city.  The management team is very attentive to its residents and the office staff listen to the needs of its residents.  Additionally, the maintenance is very prompt in responding to the needs of the residents by attending to issues in a timely manner.  Moreover, the grounds are kept in tip-notch shape.  One can tell how happy residents are by just walking the grounds of the complex.  I have lived here for seven years and have hesitated making the move for a reason, I am really happy here!

My experience living here has been good living. The property is well maintained, despite the ants and wasp nest every now and again. A short call for the  maintenance crew and problem solved. Quite neighborhood, close to great areas of shops and nightlife spots.
Love my apartment, clean and well maintain. Gym is magnificent. Too many amenities to mention. Close to shopping with great staff!!

This is an excellent property to live in.  Staff, from the front office to maintenance personnel are readily available and attentive.  It is truly a "Luxury" apartment, with amenities available.  It sits in a cul-de-sac, which someone has to be going to the apartments to get in.  It is gated, with two separate gates to get in. It is not overly priced for Austin, but still a bit on the pricier side.  My apartment was over 1200 square feet, 2-2. I also rented two garages, providing space enough for my two cars and additional storage.  It truly is a wonderful apartment.  I cannot say enough about the Maintenance personnel, who came to my apartment whenever I had a normal problem.  My main problem was that I'd clog up the disposal...repeatedly.  They'd come in within 2 hours after my call to fix it.  The management staff is very friendly, willing to work with you on different issues, including rent increases.  

Wonderful property.
Moving in was smooth. Tatiana was very helpful and made sure I was properly accommodated. Location is good and close to downtown

Here you will be charged $20 a month for Fetch. A services with notoriously terrible reviews and services. Seriously, google it. All there is is negative press with it. Your packages will be lost and delayed and you have no say if it appears in your monthly fees. If you try not to use it. Your packages will be either returned or stolen. I think this is a great example of how this apartment management does not actually care about you.

When I moved out, I was charged for damages that were there when I moved in. They lost my move-in-inventory sheet and claimed I never turned it in, so they charged me for most of the price of the repairs out of my security deposit.

Additionally, I had some irregularities with my water bill and the front office told me to pay the full bill anyway and that I would be reimbursed later when it was fixed. Unsurprisingly, they never fixed it and they say now that my water meter was fine the whole time, even though the utility company says it was definitely broken and I was overpaying.

They also use a service called Fetch, where you ship all your packages to their warehouse and they deliver them to your door later. If you aren't home in the evenings, this means that you basically will never get your packages on the same day they arrive, because you can't have them brought to your door until way later than they actually arrive at the fetch warehouse. It's also a huge pain to manage what address to put where when you have one for general mail and one for packages.

Also I think they de-listed the building from google maps because they were getting so many bad reviews.

Living at ESS has been great! The area is so nice and everything is super convenient. It's close enough to enjoy the east side but not sooo close that it's noisy. 

The staff and maintenance staff are very attentive and nice. The property stays pretty clean for the most part and the facilities are super nice.

I used to love living here, but unfortunately Mill Creek bought this complex and the management is really bad now. Amenities are always broken, appliances are always broken with long repair wait times, and the office managers (specifically Tatiana) are always very rude and unhelpful. I would have renewed my lease, but I will look elsewhere now.

New management is incredible neglectful of residences. From roach infested units to safety issues (garage gate has been open for weeks and numerous residents have had their cars broken into) to negligent maintenance (had an emergency issue at midnight only to find out there was no emergency maintenance.) Don’t move here.

I regret living here and have since found better properties for the same cost with superior amenities, staff, and apartment quality.

Apartment Quality
- Roaches in multiple buildings; also heard of raccoon issues.
- Likely your unit was infested—roaches were probably vacuumed up right before you moved in.
- Have personally seen some hideous units; conditions vary drastically.
- Peeling bathtub and leaks; no compensation when repairs required vacating overnight.
- Dated interiors; kitchen appliance remained broken for months.
- AC problems left some residents without cooling for their entire lease.
- Maintenance is essentially non-existent; requests often ignored or closed without action.

Complex Quality
- In a bad area; suspicious neighbors, frequent catcalling.
- Pool closed most of the summer; complaints met with dismissive responses referencing lease terms.
- "Fitness center" is outdated and machines often non-functional.
- Renovations focus on the leasing office while ignoring resident areas that are in disrepair.

Staff
- Frequent threats over valet trash, parking, parcel pickup, and decorations. Forced to pay for valet trash despite inconsistent service.
- Maintenance issues rarely addressed; no reliable contact for staff. Promises were made but never followed through.
- Heard former positive reviews were incentivized with free food during one particular community event.
- No sense of community; only one event during my lease.
- High staff turnover; trusted maintenance worker was fired without explanation.
-Another employee quit over ethical concerns—personally aware of sketchy office matters.

Do not move here !! The property is absolutely disgusting & not worth the money & all the extra fees ! There’s trash everywhere & the hallways are filled with stains & grime. Don’t let the pictures of the renovated units fool you! EVERYTHING IS RUSHED & poorly done! & the pest problem is out of control! I CAN NOT WAIT TO GET OUT OF THIS NASTY ROACH INFESTED APARTMENT COMPLEX!! The entire community could use a pressure wash & bleaching!

Great apartment complex. Never had any complaints about noise, trash, parking, etc. Staff and maintenance are quick to help and always friendly. The employees are always there for me with questions or fixes. The entire complex is fenced and secured and the pool is always clean and open. Location is also key - grocery store, gym, restaurants and I-35 are just around the corner, yet the location is still quiet and low key. I don't regret signing my lease again.

I lived here for 2 years from 2018-2020. It got worse the longer I stayed. Management is rude and disorganized. My A/C broke more than 4 times while I lived there. One of those times, it took over a month to get fixed. The parking is so narrow that I was usually unable to open my car door. Way overpriced especially considering it’s not near anything exciting and it’s not a walkable area. If you have the money to rent at these prices, you can get something way nicer and in a better part of the city. I pay less now where I’m at and I don’t have any of those issues here.
My wife and I lived at these apartments for only a year and the experience was very disappointing. I wouldn’t recommend these apartments to anyone.

Leased here site unseen and it definitely exceeded my expectations. I looked at a lot of newer apartments, but this property just has an awesome charm to it and isn't just concrete and buildings. The pool is nice and always clean as is the gym. So far so good with my experience!

Great apartment complex. Never had any complaints about noise, trash, parking, etc. The staff and maintenance crews are quick to help you out and are always friendly. Whenever I had any questions or repairs, staff were always available to help out. The entire complex is gated and secured, and pool is always clean and open. The location has also been key - grocery stores, gyms, restaurants, and I-35 literally around the corner, yet the location is still quiet and low key. Had no regrets re-signing my lease.

I do not recommend living here! The complex itself is okay for what you pay. There's always something going wrong and they take weeks to fix it! The front office people are horrible! They do not care for their residents! They never answer the phones they just let it ring. They take their sweet time to submit your maintenance request but when it's time for rent they're on you like flies! Better places out there people; don't waste your money here!

If I could I was give this place zero stars.   I really cant see how anyone can give this place a 5 star.

The location of this property is not even a 10 minute drive from downtown, it has all the things you would want in a apartment, pool, spa, 24 hour gym, media center, gates, etc. Also, for being so close to downtown you aren't paying an arm and leg to live here. Not sure of the other reviewers experiences, but mine has been pleasant the entire time and the staff are always friendly and willing to help!

Legend has it that the pool area was open, functional, and at least somewhat maintained at one point, and not merely a decoration to lure people into living here. What do the maintaince guys even do here exactly? I really have no clue. I cant wait to move. The godawful parking and hidden fees are a nice touch too. Hopefully some honest reviews will motivate managment to get their act together.

My mailbox key was never fixed and took three attempts to get it corrected.  Maintenance "claims" to have fixed what needs to get done but nope, that is not the case.  You have to put in numerous request to get something done in your apartment.  The only reason I moved in was 1.) time constraint and 2.) close to my work.  After my lease is done...good riddance.

Its a decent complex and upgrades were being made, but it all is just smoke. Horrible management and maintenance.
They say new or renovated, but its all just rushed and cheap work being done.
Moving in, all my cabinets LOOKED new but i couldn't even open them because the railings were all broken.
The drawer itself was cracking already from being hammered or stapled together. This is me moving in.
I put in work orders for the drawers, and other things and still has yet to be done. The same excuse is - oh we are ordering new ones and they are backed up. Same excuse, every single time.

We have been living in these apartments for about 3 months now. Beside the hidden cable cost and the fact that we moved under the impression we were getting newer appliances, we like living here. We weren't expecting the newest of the appliances, but at least a dishwasher that doesn't smell or overflow with water would have been nice.  My biggest appreciation goes out to the maintenance crew for always attending to all of our requests as quick as possible. Especially when our ac goes out. Nobody likes a hot apartment in the Texas summer. This is will not be our forever home, so we're just waiting for move out.

I found this apt with reasonable rent and very nice sized. As soon as I moved in new management took over. I got wood floors, wood blinds and granite and stainless steel to come. Nice perks for low price. Only bad is parking. They are tight and few

The current management is an upgrade as far as promptly performing maintenance on the apartment.

I have enjoyed living at Bexley at Tech Ridge Apartments (previously The Springs at Tech Ridge). The apartments are nice and fairly new. There is construction on two sides and a field (shows as a "Park" on Google Maps)but it is just overgrown weeds that is fenced off. The only complaints I have are that the staff (except for one very nice guy in the office Ruben)is so rude and they have no sense of customer service. They always act like everyone is bothering them if you go in there for ANY reason. Except when you are looking to lease. Then, they are really friendly. But, after you sign your lease, forget it. They could care less as long as they get their $$$ every month. The only other complaint is the pest problem. There have been snakes on the property and all kinds of bugs inside and out. They blame it on construction nearby, but the pest control provider told me that he really only sprays every 4-6 weeks.
If you don't care about service or living with bugs - then it is GREAT!
Love the place that I live and the people around me.

Seven is a great place to live. It is relatively soundproof considering it is downtown. The maintenance staff does a great job at keeping the lobby area clean. Yes, the elevators break often which I can tell annoy most residents but that is to be expected in a high rise building. They do make an effort to do events for the residents. I think it would be fun to try and do more interactive events where the residents can get to know each other. Maybe a game night or something? The movie night is cool, I haven't been but I feel like it would be hard to talk and get to know people during the movie.

The location, price, place, amentities, and management are incredible. I'm a little over halfway done with my lease and I am more than likely renewing. A big part of the reason is solely because of Seven's front of house staff/management.

My stay here at Seven has been great. I feel safe in the building. Building is always clean the staff is friendly and helpful as well as the concierge. 

Close and walkable to everything which is great!

My experience with Seven has been great so far! The staff has been incredibly helpful in answering any questions regarding my lease or the amenities promptly. It's obvious that they care a great deal about renter experience which is a breath of fresh air when moving into a new building. The view from my apartment is incredible and the walkability to my favorite spots from Seven is great!

The staff at Seven are professional and pleasant. So far, any issues I have had, have been handled in a timely fashion. The elevator repair issue is ongoing, but in the defense of the property managers, they are addressing the matter.
The lady at the front desk had a lot of positivity
