Not to mention almost the entire time we lived here amenities were closed, we did not receive any compensation for that. They are NOT flexible and have hardline policies that they stick to and nothing more. There's other apartment complexes nearby that are cheaper and have better management and communication about issues.

This is a great place to live! Me and my husband moved here from out of state, and the staff was very accomidating with helping us with the process. 

To add the the other reviews: yes, there is a dog park at the end of the complex. It is a nice large, fenced area. However, the grass is dying due to all the dog urine, but that is to be expected!

The trash is an issue for this complex, as they only have one dumpster which is not enough for everyone. They try their best to keep things tidy but they really just need to get another one.

The parking is not that huge of an issue as everyone is saying it is. There is plenty of room in between vehicles. We bought a car port when we first moved here and we are now taking it off our lease because we do not even use it. Sometimes after 8pm you have to park two complexes down because everyone is home already and walk. But, honestly who cares.

We have not had any issues since we moved here, and we are renewing our contract in a month.

When we moved in this place was fantastic! The apartments are amazing and so are the office staff. But the management company sold the complex and since then, it's gone downhill with the new owners. Previously we would have any repairs fixed in a couple of days, now its months. Previously we would have landscaping done every Monday, now its sparodic. The dog mess is all over and they dont seem to get a handle on it. Rubbish is overflowing in the huge bins since they changed the dates for emptying. Special events run by the office used to be common, now its dried up. Fresh fruit available in the common area is no more and even the coffee is ltd now to one or two types. The pool is not maintained as it use to be. One weekend the filters weren't even on, the pool was filthy. The grills didnt work on memorial day weekend either. It's a shame the new management company have cut back so much and turned an A1 complex into a B2 complex. The only thing that hasn't changed is the great office staff, but it seems their hands are tied now and can only apologize. It's a shame, we loved our time here, but are moving on now before it gets any worse.
Sucks no dog parks... before I moved here they said there would be three.  I expected more because these are brand new apartments.

we just moved in and we already love this place. the staff is sooo nice and accommodating. the rental process and the paperwork was mostly handled by the leasing agents (Kudos to Hailey and her teammates). this place is a real gem.
Amazing apartment with huge swimming pool right beneath my apartment and gym! Trash and recycle are perfectly maintained and I would love to recommend this apartment to anyone
Great layouts and very roomy! Property is very kept up with the grounds always look great. I also like that there are regular resident events. Enjoyed living here for the last 5 years!

I grew up in a single family home in a really friendly neighborhood. I missed that vibe when I moved out on my own and into apartment living. Sycamore Springs has been great because it has that neighborhood feel. The apartments are large and bright, and the residents are always out using the dog parks and pool. The staff is really friendly, the area is great, and I really enjoy living here.
Great apartments, well kept, great location. Maintenance is super good, leasing agents are as good as mgmt lets them be. Beware of notices about new and improved, it's going to cost you!

The apartments are lovely, truly. They're spacious and the lighting is wonderful. The grounds are well maintained and the amenities are wonderful. The leasing office staff is also very responsive and reasonable. 
My only qualms are the rent increases over the past year, the parking difficulties (certain areas of the complex have small spaces and too many cars), and the valet trash service (that fee is an annoyance and you can't opt out). 

If you don't mind being so far north and can afford the rent, it's an amazing place to live and I'm sorry to move.

If you are looking for an apartment that oozes luxury at an affordable price range look no further cause Sucamore Springs is it! From the upgraded black and stainless steel appliances to the 9ft vaulted ceilings, his and her bathrooms makes apartment living feel more like a home of your own. It has amazing anmenties and with 2 spa pools with grills, full court basketball court and two fully equipped 24/7 hour gyms makes working out and fun time a breeze. With a baby on the way you would think that this would be the perfect time to get out and enjoy life before the sleepless nights and more responsibility kicks in but all I want to do is stay home.... They say home is where the heart is and this is most definitely it!!!?

Do not be fooled by the virtual tour. This is the teeniest, tiniest bathtub I have ever seen in my life. Writing this review as a warning to fellow bathers -  it is NOT a garden bath, do not sign a lease without seeing the actual unit in person!
I love the staff! They are always able to resolve any problems in a timely manner with a smile on their face!
The Valet trash service is very inconsistent, the pool area needs sprucing up, need a recycling service or bin
It's mostly soundproof, quiet, gated, maintenance is always quick, and the staff is awesome.
The office personnel is great, they are very friendly as well as professional. They respond to questions quickly and with knowledge.
They are always competent in completing the request in a time manner. Great group of staff.

I have lived here for 3 years, each time we get a new management, they keep adding new fees instead of fixing existing issues. Roach and bee infestation, A/C issues. They are doing the bare minimum cosmetically to get you to move in, don't get fooled by a pretty picture.

An incredibly frustrating place to live. The management is a joke. The management staff is constantly either quitting or getting fired so any issue they always blame it on the staff before them. Don't take anything anyone tells you as true because they will be gone before you know it and the next person will tell you something different.

Assume that you will need to follow up on any issue or request to management multiple times because they will likely forget or pretend something was being done when it really is not.

Maintenance staff is questionable at best and does a lot of jerry-rigging. A great example of this is when I had an issue where the door wouldn't close properly. Their solution, after pretending there was not an obvious gap in the door, was to hammer the wooden door. As you would expect this did not fix the gap, but it did dent the door. I was shocked with how stupid that was.

Stayed there and was disappointed.  Manager walked me into the apartment the first day and someone had broken in and had been showering in my apartment bathroom...  just a prelude of many other issues.  Overall, the place was just old and dirty...  not a good experience for me.  My opinion and experience.

This building is about average for the price. The finish outs are pretty nice but it is an older complex. I live on the first floor and bugs are an issue certain times of the year. In general not a bad place though. Lots of families and very friendly staff. They are very responsive when there is a problem. Very good location. Close to downtown and easy access to good restaurants and grocery stores. Complex includes pool, workout facility, dog park, and walking trail, and covered parking. I would recommend to a friend, but I would suggest not living on the first floor.

The Cliffs at Barton Creek is a great place to live. The staff and maintenance are very nice and they know your name. The apartments are updated and have an open flow concept that is easy to live in. It's a quiet gated complex that has a lot of families. You get to know your neighbors and keep an eye out for each other. You can't beat the price for the views and amenities. I've been here for 2.5 years and have loved every minute!
Lived here for 12 years. Overall I can say it is a good place to live.
Love this place. Maintenance requests are handled IMMEDIATELY and the guys are always respectful, efficient, and quick. Keep up the great work, team, and thank you for everything you do.
I have lived here for 12 years and i feel it is a good value. I have enjoyed living here.
The staff are amazingly supportive and I love the location.

I have very mixed feeling about this apartment complex. Maintenance is fantastic and always quick with work orders. I also love how we have a ranger that patrols now. Makes me feel a lot safer. I don’t love how a lot of people break rules within the lease (tying dogs up, having things in the halls that breaks fire code, or leaving dogs on patio for hours while they’re barking). Especially when the office is notified and nothing is done. I have tried calling the office multiple times with concerns but no one contacts me back. I’ve even emailed the manager with no reply when she told me to reach out to her. I think communication is lacking and I work full time so I’m not able to go into the office for help usually. I’ve given up on reporting things to the office because nothing ever seems to change.

This apartment complex seemed great at first but looks can be deceiving. For one yes the visitor parking is completely unfair. Not even my friend that lives there got her second car back groin the tow place but was never reimbursed either. They're real quick to say ur a couple days late on rent and they'll come inside ur place but can't hand out parking passes to the tenants who will need more than 1. That's ridiculous, another thing yes there is a cockroach infestation. We're constantly cleaning and spraying our own chemicals and nothing helps. They're even in the brick wall outside of the complex. It's just ridiculous that this seems to continue with how much the rent is they should honestly make their tenants comfortable. Also I've heard from other tenants that their bills have also increased within the last 4 months. Austin isn't cheap and everyone could use some peace in their lives here at blunn creek apartments. It's time management or whomever runs the show realize they have very unsatisfied tenants and do something about it. Extremely annoyed and looking for a different place very soon.

Today they informed the tenants there will be no more visitor parking! That if your friends and family want to visitor, you have to go to the office and get a visitor pass. What if someone come to visitor you in the evening or on the weekend and the office is closed! That means J & J Towing will tow their car because you can't get a pass!  THIS IS SO UNFAIR, THAT PAY YOUR RENT BUT YOU CAN'T HAVE ANYONE COME VISIT YOU WITHOUT THE OFFICE BEING NOTIFIED IN ADVANCE, SOMETIMES YOU DON'T EVEN KNOW WHEN SOMEONE IS COMING OVER!

In 2 years of living here, have experienced all of the following:

- being towed 2 times with proper stickers/registration/inside of parking lines and resident area. Towing company said "take it up with the apartments".  Keep in mind this is affordable housing. These apartments are literally robbing their own broke residents cause they get a % of the towing fees

-visitor towed because the "VISITOR" paint on the ground was faded. Visitor had taken a picture just in case &  after being towed they showed apartments & towing company but they wouldn't release the car because "then they would have to do it for everyone"
 
-BLACK MOLD. For several months reached out to management to come look into it due to symptoms of everyone in the household (migraines, major allergy symptoms, persistent coughing, wet smell). They refused to do mold testing in the air. They found mold in our roof and AC vents and painted over it. Told us to tell them if it comes back.
 
-cockroach infestation. At night when you turn on a light at least 30-40 tiny cockroaches scatter underneath the carpet no matter how clean. A bug guy comes out (you have to get on the list), we've done that more times than you can count & doesn't help.

-building next to us has a rat infestation. Multiple neighbors are talking about it and office will do nothing as it is "the residents responsibility". They have found multiple rat nest/holes and apartments are full of rat poop and pee and concerned for the health of their children. 

-CONSTANT false fire alarms. My husband logged how many times and the duration of the false ear piercing alarms which equivalates to over 30 hours in one month. Between the hours of 2am until early afternoon. My children wake up in fear I've been without a good night sleep in months. Our neighbors & I have expressed concerns to management and they said "they are annoyed too because they get fined".  

-Front gate is always broken but rest assured that the only criminals to worry about in these apartments are staff.

-not enough parking for visitors or residents. I live in fear of having to pay 200 being towed so when I come home I drive in circles for sometimes 30 mins or more waiting for someone to leave. I don't mind walking. There are no spots in the entire complex. they recently got rid of the street parking. I dread the day that no spots open up at night and I get towed for parking in visitor or have to park a mile away down the street.
I have lived at Blunn Creek for 3 years now and I love it. The office is friendly and they take care of any issues I have right away.
I can't go back to school because it is prohibited in their lease. Maintenance is terrible and it's opposite of energy efficient bills are through the roof
I have lived here for 3 years and he enjoyed every moment. I Really Like The Staff In The office.
I drive by these apartments everyday and i finally decided to take a look inside. It was great and so spacious. Im really considering moving in.

I have lived in this complex for three years. They are very good about taken care of your maintenance issues. Could be a little better with garbage pick-up.

They are friendly and helpful in the office.

Recently updated the Gym and Laundry Room. Lots of dogs here and most tenants are respectful of others with cleaning up after their dogs. A few do not no matter hos many notices are sent out. That should be enforced beter

This is the best apartments in this area. I feel this area is very safe. I love the way the property is laid out. When it rains hard, the water drains very good. There's a lot of park for the residents, and, plenty of visitor parking. They are pet friendly and they furnish dog mess bags.

This is exactly what you want if you are  young, adventurous and new to Austin, Texas. Blunn Creek is affordable, less than a mile from South Congress in one direction and less than a mile to 35 in the other direction. 
Fairly large and spacious are the actual apartments with plenty of room to put your own personal spin into your space! 
The staff is friendly and attentive and works with its tenants instead of constantly battling and rationalizing your needs.  You've got access to a gym and pool along with a great sense of community. Our city is growing but everyone here keeps up that amazing Austin spirit. Welcome home!

The good:  Amazing gym, nice pool when it is open/ accessible.  For me the location was good and the layout of my one bedroom was good.  When I first moved there in 2019 most of my neighbors were families with young children.  During the pandemic there was a mass exodus and the culture of the complex changed.  I no longer felt safe.  Screaming, disrespectful neighbors, parties, fights in the parking lot, multiple break-ins.  

The bad:  I have lived here w/ 3 different "management" situations.  They were all pretty bad.  Minor repairs would get "bandaid" repair right away, but big things (like my AC going out every 3 months) would require multiple contacts (like 5-10 contacts).  The mailboxes were broken for a year, the gates are nearly always broken, many of the amenities are perpetually out of order, the internet went out every few weeks, there were roaches and so much mold.  They will do nothing about loud, abusive neighbors (even though that is a clear lease violation).  They will do nothing to increase security, or have someone on call for after hours emergencies... but boy howdy are they "on it" with the extra fees and fines.  Not a week went by without a threatening email about some new fine or another... Watch for a bait and switch both with the units they let you see vs what they let you rent, and with the garages (saying you can have one, and then not having one available on move in day - and not being willing to let you know if/ when one comes available).  After all this, if you still decide to live there?  Watch your bill CLOSELY.  I was double charged for something nearly every month for 3 years.  It was exhausting.  So glad to be out of there!

This property looks nice outside looking in, but once you move in, you start to see all the issues with the property. Like many people have already mentioned, the gates never work and many of the amenities are constantly broken, reduced hours, or simply dirty and simply unpleasant. They have 3 peloton bikes, but don't be fooled, none of them work. I have never seen anyone clean the gym, not patrons or a professional and there is dirt and dust everywhere. 

When I moved in, my windows were stuck shut, but I didn't realize it until Fall when I tried to open them for fresh air. Maintenance said they needed a contractor to come replace them and it would be 4-6 weeks. No big deal. Except when the 'contractor' came, all they did was spray some WD-40 and replace a spring. They told me maintenance could have fixed it. 

I have had numerous issues with maintenance not doing what they should. I had a smart thermostat that I had installed with permission from the front office staff (TIP: get everything in writing) about 4 months later Maintenance had to come because my heat wasn't working and instead of looking at the unit, uninstalled my thermostat and left a mess in my apartment. 

About 6 weeks ago, an outside contractor was sent in to repair sprinklers in the units, in doing so they had to cut holes in the walls. I am now 6 weeks out with no timeline for repairs. There are just gaping holes in the wall and nobody will do anything about it. 

The office staff is also incredibly untrained, and nobody can give you a straight answer on anything. They also never respond to emails and have 'office closures' on a weekly basis making it extremely difficult to talk to anyone about anything.

Front Office is nice, will give you a great tour, but it’s all down hill from there. The grounds are not kept up, the gates never work and are left open constantly. Dumpsters over flowing and amenities always out if order, closed or dirty. You can find places in the area for much less and get much more. Don’t waste your money.

Tl;dr - Read reviews from people who have lived here. And don't have high expectations if you decide to move in.
We have had nothing but trouble from the management of this place as soon as the lease was signed. The leasing agents were awesome and we were excited to move in, but they don't give half as much attention to current residents as they do to prospective residents.
The apartment smelled strongly of spray-paint for 2 months after moving in despite our heavy use of baking soda and candles.
The amenities (movie theatre and lounges) which came so highly recommended by the leasing agents close at business hours, are never open on Sundays, and therefore are unusable for regular workers with no option to reserve them after hours.
When we have asked for information on when we will be able to use the amenities, we have been repeatedly ignored and a mass email was sent out telling us to stop asking, with no further information provided.
They have also made it a hassle to vacate, claiming a 60 day notice (which I know is normal) but not providing the paperwork in time to make that happen, and losing our communications with them giving notice that we were moving out.

After moving into my initial apartment I found and reported mold, (I had specifically asked if there were any issues with mold, water damage or pests and I was assured there was not). The complex was slow to even come and investigate it. I developed fairly serious allergies and started staying with family instead after about a week or two. They eventually tore out parts of the walls and saw how far the mold was spreading including in to the AC system. One of the repair men told me that if he were me I needed to leave. Apparently before I moved in someone had shot multiple rounds through the door not only hitting the prior tenant, but also hitting pipes flooding this apartment and the one beneath it. The apartment complex just hid this fact and the obvious possibility of mold. The apartment beneath me I was told was far worse with mold over all the walls and they were doing nothing about it. The repair man told me they would replace some of the sheetrock, but likely not fix the mold in the AC, or beneath the carpet....just enough to make it look habitable.
I moved apartments in the complex hoping it would be better but have had birds fly up vents into my bathroom fan, squirrels building nests in the dryer vent and tearing up my patio furniture, hundreds of bugs crawling out of the walls, and under the sink, and out from the dishwasher and overall management has not been helpful or quick at resolving these issues. 
The only good thing about this place are a few of the leasing staff and repair workers who have truly been pleasant. They actually seemed to have my best interest at heart, and for them I am very thankful as they made this place much more bearable.

Worst apartment to ever live in. There are roaches everywhere, i kill about 7 a day, sometimes they get in my shoes when im getting ready to head out to work!!! The apartment does not have pest control, but we get charged for it every month. We have to pay a manditory $79 for cable on top of our rent even though we dont have cable, and they dont tell you that when you sign the lease. The staff are extremely useless, any issues that we have, everytime we bring it up to them, they always say that "there is nothing we can do about that, but ill write it down" when i wanted to complain to the corporate about their terrible service, they would not give me the number. The a/c broke on us, and it took them two weeks to fix, we slept in 80 degree condition for two weeks. The apartments came with damages that were fixed up by glue from the maintenance, but eventually the glue is wearing off, so whenever we move out, they will charge us for repair, but all they will do is glue it back up for the next sucker to live there. There isnt a problem finding a parking space, but thats because they tightned up the parking space, if you have a nice car, beware because you will have door dings the next morning.

kinda a waste of time. I schedule a tour and only viewed the apartment virtually because someone lives in the unit. She was nice but as she showed me apartments off the computer and explained them to me I noticed the “renovated” bathrooms are the same at the classic but just changed to brown.

Lived here for years only because the rent didn’t increase for a time, but after two new management companies and increases in rent we have never once gotten an upgrade. Appliances and carpet and paint are the same as they were five years ago for our unit despite them telling us that we would be upgraded. Then they said they couldn’t without us moving out and re applying then moving back in. Neighbors in our building and others are rowdy and out in the parking lot all the time. It is definitely not upgraded or nice as the pictures make it out to be. I wouldn’t….

Done be fooled, it is a second opportunity for people who have bad credit or have broken leases.  The management is not helpful with issues such as maintenance and other amenities offered. Also, theft is rampant from package deliveries missing to several care break ins. BEWARE !!!

We have lived here 4 years, going on 5. They changed managers some time in 2018, and the new staff, execpt for Boyd and Chasity (awesome people) are rude. Dont ask questions unless you want to be talked down to.

They have rules against leaving dog poop, but don't really inforce it. They have stations for dog bags, but there is literally never bags in them. I buy my own bags, but not many people will. 

We are moving out after this lease is up..

These apartments are verry horrible. The Management there are not curteous. Thier rude and sharp tongued. There not clear about payments no explanations on extra charges it is not the place to live. Not a good experience for us. We moved back to Round Round. I must say  it is very much pleasant where we live now. This place needs the owners there and managemen needs a overhaul!!!!!!!!!!

Don't be fooled by the exterior looking like a normal building. This building has been very poorly maintained, with tenants suffering leaking roofs, flooded apartment, lack of replacement of hot water heaters that are ancient. It's more than like your apartment has had several major maintenance emergencies. This is just the beginning. First you need to know that this property is a center for crime in this neighborhood. Most recent was 2 drug dealers chasing around with machetes March 25, 2018. Your neighbors with throw garbage everywhere and it will be left there for weeks. Tenants do not pick up after their dogs so you will have to walk to work with poop on your shoes everyday. There are too many children here so forget ever using the pool in the summer is is stacked to capacity from early morning to late at night. Regarding utilities in Nov. 2017 all tenants received a $ 300.00 water bill because management made a mistake but tenants had to pay for it. I am one person and there is no planet on which I could use $ 300.00 worth of water in a month. Because they will accept anyone here, you will have constant sketchy people breaking their leases and dragging their furniture in and out, up and down the stairwells at all time of night or day after having moved in only a month before. The Sheriffs office has been over here literally dozens and dozens of times for family violence, gangs, threats. The pool area is filthy in the summer. Cigarette butts all over the property and the trash is frequently overflowing onto the grounds. The managers DO NOT walk the property everyday if at all around the back. Finally, after extruding water from the apartment next to me, my apartment was flooded, ruining all my clothes. 6 weeks later, they hired a contractor who used a well known deadly poison to refinish my tub and I had to be evacuated by EMS and couldn't return to my apartment for 5 days. I have still not been reimbursed for my expenses. I know it looks good compared to the dumps you've probably looked at, but turn around and leave. You or your children could actually die here and they don't care one bit. The "nice" people" in the office only care about their paycheck.
The Crescent is a great place to live. The location cannot be beat. The management and maintenance team are conscientious, contributing to my overall positive experience.

The location is great, but that’s pretty much the only good thing about these apartments. They are very overpriced for the quality. The amenities are basically nonexistent and the appliances in the apartment keep breaking or having issues.

These apartments are so overpriced! They claim that they’re luxury, but things break so easily! I’ve only lived here for 7 months, and I’ve already had about 10 maintenance visits due to things breaking. There are also a ton of fees that just make this place not worth it at all. Please don’t waste your time.
I love living here, mostly for the location but the apartment itself it’s great too.
Living at the Crescent has been an awesome experience. All the staff are clearly committed to providing excellent, prompt, friendly service and creating a friendly atmosphere for residents.

The maintenance guy is great. The office staff is incompetent and the noise is unbearable. This place is so gross. I’ve been eaten with bugs and the office staff is so unresponsive. I cannot wait to get out of here. Stay far away from this place.

This place keeps selling and it is  absolutely going downhill in healthy living (trash and rats) , lack of any calls and maintenance help, over-priced by far to great deals all around Austin and just plain disrespectful neighbors partying all through the night.  

The latest Management team is worst than even the last, sassy, talking back, non-responsive and seem to think the front office is a new happy hour party place while not answering phone nor taking care of work orders.

Save yourself the trouble and do NOT move here. Lakeline Parmer Lane does not value the safety and well-being of its residents.

I had 1-2 inches of standing water throughout my kitchen, living room, bathroom, and bedroom. Repairs for this took over SIX MONTHS and the work completed was inadequate and incomplete. There are still pieces of baseboards missing throughout my home, as well as unsealed areas in the walls, which has allowed venomous pests and other insects into my home. I have had pest treatment completed in my apartment several times, but obviously the treatment is insufficient because I still get pests.

This is a huge safety concern for myself, my boyfriend, and my pets. I put in a work order with photos showing the areas of my home that are not properly sealed and allowing pests inside. It took numerous calls, emails, and visits to the office until a maintenance worker came THREE WEEKS LATER. He finally came the day I threatened the leasing office that I would take further action since they were not upholding their end of the lease. And he did not even fix all of the unsealed areas. The office said there was only one maintenance worker. How could there only be one maintenance worker for a community with ~20 buildings? When I spoke with the community manager, Angelica, she was completely apathetic to my situation. When I asked if I could move to a different unit due to the pest situation, she said that I would have to pay the current rent price since it would be a new lease. Rent has gone up significantly since I moved in a little less than 2 years ago, so having to pay the current rent price would mean an increase of $400/month. Oh, but Angelica said she would waive the relocation fee of $500.

In terms of the community, it is not well-maintained. The gates are always open (because they are broken), the dumpster and pet waste trash cans are usually overflowing, and community amenities are broken, dirty, and unusable. ZERO STARS! This message is for the regional manager and owners of this property. It clearly shows you do not care for your residents and community. How can a property with so many units have only one service worker? How come every month there is a new leasing agent? I am shocked that the property manager is still around. There is garbage in the pool, in the grass, everywhere. Nothing gets done here. The ball is in the court of the owners and management to get this property back into satisfactory condition. I can’t wait for that day I put this place in my rear view mirror.
Lovin' it. Great place to live and wake up to every morning. It is very spacious and comfy.  Staff are very nice and attentive.

Although slightly outside of Austin proper, this apartment is in a good location near a lot of convenient places. A mile from an HEB Plus, Alamo Drafthouse Lakeline, and the Lakeline Metro station. It sits right behind Shipley Donuts and a gas station that tends to have cheaper prices.

The management staff are friendly and communicate well. The property is kept clean. The laundry facilities could use some TLC (at least one machine is always broken, and you never know when you're going to be the one who discovers it).  

Overall, this apartment complex is a safe and comfortable place to live.

We were looking for a ground floor, 2 bedroom, with an attached garage, and in unit laundry, that also allowed large dogs (60 pounds).  This is the first complex we looked at and they had everything we needed and required.  The few times we've needed assistance, they were right there...same day.  The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, professional, and  
I would highly recommend Riverton to anyone looking for a new apartment home.

I’ve lived in phase 2 for 3 years and there have been multiple problems with homeless people just hanging out on the stairs at all hours and car break ins and stolen items such as packages and bikes. Management does nothing even though this is supposed to be a gated community. Don’t recommend living here.

I have lived here for almost 3 years and it’s the best decision I ever made. The staff is incredibly friendly, the neighbors are wonderful, and the amenities are excellent. I feel very safe here. Everything I eat is close by, and don’t have to worry about bad traffic. I highly recommend this place!

My husband and I have lived here almost 2 years and we really like it. Quiet, beautiful grounds, large bathroom, friendly neighbors and a playground that's great for the kiddos.  We definitely are staying here until we decide to buy a home. My only issue is parking can get tough at times and there used to be a courtesy notice when packages arrive in the office. But those are minimal. Pricing for our unit is very good especially in the area. Great value. I definitely would recommend.

And don't expect your deposit back. Management consumes it with miscellaneous, trivial bullshit to absorb it. This apartment complex has really gone down hill since I moved there almost three years ago. I am out now, but if you are desperate enough to try it expect terrible parking, noise, 18 wheeler parking in your backyard at all hours of the night because the self employed truckers use it as their personal truck storage. 

There are a lot of far better choices in the Austin area now. Do your homework to avoid disappointment.
Horrible management!! Do not move here! There are better options in Pflugerville!

Front office staff needs some serious training on how to be courteous, respectful, and helpful to ALL paying residents. I have witnessed for myself as a guest,  the unprofessional manner that reports and requests are handled here. Don't waste your time. These apartments have been poorly managed since 2010 and nothing has changed.

I’ve lived in this complex for about 9 years. It’s in a great location and environment. Another reason I enjoy living here is the office staff and maintenance people. I recently needed my faucet and light bulbs replaced. Carlos and the maintenance staff were very helpful and quick to fix my issues. Edith and Molly are always very helpful for any questions I need answered.  It is a family oriented and safe place to live.

A very pleasant place to live in peace. My agent, Molly, showed me around and the apartments and helped me with my application with great kindness and professionalism, making it a very nice experience. Great team. The place is always very clean. I liked the area where the kids can play and have fun.
Our leasing agent, Molly, was so incredible and walked us through the application process with a kind, thoughtful and willing attitude. Things like this are so very important to new residents.
I just moved in so far it has been a great experience.

The apartment itself is nice - Pools been closed a while now with no info from office. Edith bullies a lot of the tenants, so much so that a lot of people don’t even like calling in to ask questions or for help. No places for adults and their kids to lock up bicycles and or scooters but office will inspect your porch and if you have even just one thing that doesn’t fall within  what’s allowed on your porch from the lease you get fined. Including a child’s bike. Every building has 3 floors but no elevators in sight. Trash compactor is still broken.  My neighbor has trash in front of their front door but it’s the porches that matter more I guess? Each spring the 2nd and 3rd floors of every phase two building become the perfect homes for birds of all kinds. So that means every walkway is covered in bird poop from spring until whenever you beg enough for them to come pressure wash. Charged a monthly pest control fee but I have never seen a single person spray down any part of my building.
We’re living this place almost 4 years. We are living comfortably. Haven’t seen any major issues yet. Very quiet and peaceful place for families.
The Overture Arboretum primary advantages are location and access to services, restaurants, etc. parking garage is a definite plus.
If you value the exercise center for your health Overture Arboretum is the WRONG place.
At this time, I would not recommend Overture Arboretum to my friends.
Our community is filled with activities, residents, and support staff who create an energetic and welcoming atmosphere.

We are a community.   We gather for events, 
And activities.
Spirit of community makes Overture Arboretum a good place to live.

Do not be deceived by false promises. Here are some things they conveniently leave out until they have you locked in. The so-called luxury living they advertise is nowhere to be found. These apartments are anything but luxurious. The buildings are shoddily constructed with cheap materials, including faux vinyl wood floors, low-quality fixtures, and flimsy bathroom drawers. The walls are coated in flat paint, the windows are drafty, leading to bug problems despite monthly pest control fees.
If you opt for a yard (for an additional cost), you are not allowed to put anything in it. You can only look at it or let your dogs relieve themselves on the dying sod and muddy mess that passes for grass. Forget about decorating, except for the cement patio. The staircases are peeling, the breezeways are stained and dirty, and dead bugs linger in the lights. The dog park is littered with uncollected waste, the gym is lacking in equipment and proper maintenance, and there is never any water available.

Children under 14 need adult supervision to play outside, which seems excessive. You are forced to pay for a pet screening service annually, whether you have a pet or not, along with a  monthly fee for valet trash service that merely relocates your trash a short distance for animals to rummage through. This explains the ongoing rat infestation in the area. The front gate has been broken for nearly two years, showing a lack of concern for residents' safety.
Honorable mention of the now green color and unswimmable pool in the midst of summer, with repairs that a 12 year old could have done better.  I nearly cut my foot off due to uneven and rough patch jobs. 
The office staff is far from welcoming, often making tenants feel like a nuisance or outright ignoring them. Numerous aesthetic issues are ignored in favor of insignificant upgrades like a single bike rack for 152 units. There is clear favoritism shown towards certain residents, with some receiving special treatment while others are overlooked. The "management" fails to advocate for tenants or support them when needed. Zero empathy, zero advocacy. 
Violations are issued void of a conversation, and not spelled out in the lease agreement. 

Save yourself the trouble and seek out true luxury living elsewhere, even if it means looking across the street.

Belterra Springs is pretty, quiet and 
has nice floor plans and great amenities.  The mgt. is friendly and responsive.  There were unavoidable setbacks during construction, but most have been resolved.  My only concerns are high rent and it needs more frequent cleaning of breezeways & lights.  The outside of windows have not been cleaned.  Otherwise, I love it here.

Please run away from these apartments! We had the toilet clog multiple times. Lights were always going out. The mold problem was HUGE! The maintenance personnel would come in and spray this 50/50 bleach solution, and then mold would show up a week later somewhere else. When it rained water would drip everywhere and then mold/stains on the ceiling/walls would appear. Me and my family had major coughing issues when we first moved in. We replaced the air filter (which was disgusting), and it helped out. Overall, for this apartment complex to be built in 2015 and be this messed up is very shady. It looks like the owners were just trying to make a quick buck and didn't care about the tenants. My family is now living in a rental house that was built in 1959 and it has none of these issues. I'm sure the people up top (corporate) are making some major money off this property, however the tenants/renters are suffering the consequences. Please bring your hard earned money elsewhere.

We've lived in three apartments in this complex so far, and every one has had major construction-related problems. On the good side, management is reasonably responsive to these issues, but we've had to move out of the apartment for them to address water damage four times in four months. Watch like a hawk for mold.

A selection of the construction issues we've experienced so far:
* Water dripping from light fixture at a rate of 1 liter per 10 minutes
* Sewage entering apartment from drain under HVAC closet, soaked through walls and carpet in multiple rooms
* Mold in bathrooms and kitchen under sink less than 2 months after building was completed
* Toilet failing to drain due to 2x4 which was broken through top of drain line, under slab
* Hot water heater not properly installed
* Slab not properly levelled causing trip hazards
* Apartment not properly sealed allowing insects free entry
* Doors not properly installed causing difficulty closing, locking
* Missing hardware such as knobs to turn shower water on, towel rack, door knobs, sliding door hardware
* Poorly installed carpet and vinyl flooring

I moved here about a month ago and love it so far.  The apartments are spacious, newer and built well.  My walk in closet is huge! Danielle at the office is phenomenal!  The gym, pool and outdoor amenities are also great.  My only downside would be the lack of guest parking.  If they had more spaces, this place would be ideal! I highly recommend it.

It is a great community the office staff is nice and friendly. The Apartments are nice and modern with granite counters and i love the stain concrete floors. It's close to downtown Austin and near the southpark meadows shopping center its a great location. The rent is high for a one bedroom apt you do get a garage and a back yard with a bottom floor unit. They have a great dog park and love the pool area very nice place to call it a home.
We just moved in the other day and this by far the best apartment ever! We love it so much. big shower, high ceilings, nice finishes. If I could live here forever I would..

My fiancee and I just move in these apartment on December 15, 2014 from Houston, Texas. Before we move in we work very close with Irene. She gave us the best costumer service and kept us update with everything before our moving in date. When we got here monday morning and met Issac to sign our last paperwork and hand over the keys. He was very patience with us and explain everything really well on what we need to know and the rules He was very helpful in every way, Made my fiancee and i welcome here. Since we move in it been very quiet and there has not been any trouble. Our apartment is warm a cozy. The kitchen i love the most, because it update with an island and i love it. The bedroom is a great size and closet too. I have not con about these apartment. All i have to say is it a great environment and friendly environment and we can't wait to see what the future has in store for us when we are here.

Just moved in to my apartment a few weeks ago and so far I love it. Everything is new, and my apartment is immaculate. It's a $20 cab ride downtown I have found some of the best food within a block of here.

Do not rent here unless you want rats and mice eating everything you own and be charged over 5,000 dollars when you leave because you were told there's nothing pest control can do about the rodents. Not safe living conditions at all! HUGE health hazard.
Highly recommend living here. Very happy. Easy access to everything!
The manager at these apartments is really nice and helpful.  She really elevates the service in the community.

I have lived at Bell Quarry Hill for a long time and this complex is still amazing. However, with a large freeway being built less than 15 feet from the complex, the amazing views and quiet living are now gone. Instead, we have construction taking place 24/7. I am sad to leave what once was a hidden gem in Austin.
Es un lugar tranquilo para vivir, con excelente equipo de trabajo al pendiente de sus residentes.
This is an excellent community. I have lived here just over 2 years.
I love my apartment at Bell Quarry in Convict Hill. It’s convenient to shopping and neighbors are friendly.

My partner and I have had nothing but positive experiences since moving into Bell Quarry Hill! Maintenance staff is prompt and communicative, our leasing office staff is super friendly and resourceful, and the complex feels like we are staying at a resort! Amazing layouts and super spacious! We love it here.

I have always loved it here.  I have been a resident for over 6 years.  It is just these past months that I have been unhappy with the noise & dust & no notifications as to what to expect in the future.

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review: Prone to flooding which causes  mold issues.My neighbor’s truck was set on fire, the SWAT team arrived  when shots were fired & they thought it was a hostage situation. Security gates rarely work. Management normally responds to complaints by saying residents are lying.

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review: The property manager coco will answer all the questions you may have and will go out of her way to make sure you have a comfortable not only touring experience but also move in experience. Thank you guys!

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review: Over priced!!! They charge you rent so the roaches can run free. Parking lot floods.

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review:
Awful owners, price is way too high for a place that’s old moldy and smelly. Every apartment has roaches. They tried to get me to sign a lease saying i didn’t know if my items had bed bugs, so just in case I got them from this disgusting place they wouldn’t be liable. 
Crooks!!! 
Many cars broken into. Theft. parking lot dips so if the street floods it will flood into your car.
AC and heater are ancient, barely work.

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review: The guy who lived above me died and rotted for 2 weeks... the staff was unwilling to let us move units or get out of our lease because flies were coming out of our air vents and sinks. The office lady told me there were maggots all over the apartment upstairs... our apartment never smelled the same and could smell the stench for  the rest of the time we lived there. Please don’t move here. It was the worst living experience I’ve ever had in my whole life.

apartmentName: The Arts Apts At South Austin
review:
Michelle and Anthony are ON IT! They have a WONDERFUL MAINTENANCE TEAM that doesnt simply bandaid issues but makes an effort to address underlying problems for you. I went thru several Admin Staff in several yrs. I leased and this current team, bar none, is the BEST.

The rent is reasonable and while the property is not new it offers that quaint and charming wierd vibe that Austin is known for. 

New gig that requires weekly travel or I would've renewed. 

Yes! I recommend.

Save yourself time and money and DO NOT live here. It is the absolute worst and there’s nothing you can do about it honestly. The cost may seem ideal in the beginning but trust me you will be out of more money from extra charges to getting towed and they will never accommodate you. Valet trash is a joke. Their trash situation is always a mess. The gates are typically broken. There was a shooting in the complex in 2021 which I feel could’ve been prevented had the gates been working. The staff could not be more detached from the residents. You try to follow their rules only for them to wiggle out of accountability in the end. 
I bought a brand new 2023 Kia while I was visiting my family in Mississippi and drove it back to tech ridge on a Saturday. Obviously the office was closed so registered everything make/model/year/color/vin. The only detail I could not register was the tag # because Mississippi does not give temporary tags. I even went further and called the emergency line at tech ridge, (which no one answered) but I left a voicemail telling them I bought i new car and I registered it as best I could. But of course my car was towed! I sent them proof of me registering my car and how I had no temporary tag because my car was out of state. They basically told me it was the towing company’s problem and that they wouldn’t reimburse me. Typical! 
The basketball goal is usually broken and their gym door is weird, I saw many people be deterred from working out because they couldn’t get through the door. I had to personally make them come from out of the office and show us how to get into the gym.
Lastly, my shower had mold because the caulking was poorly done and when you move out you better have lots of cash. They told us we could paint an accent wall, and when we move out just ask maintenance for a sample paint so we can paint it back before we move out. Well tech ridge would never give us a sample of the paint so we just tried to match it on our own at home depot. Didn’t matter. Be prepared to be charged with everything under the sun. Especially the things you asked them to fix during your stay. It will be on your bill after you move out. Just don’t bother with this place y’all!

I rented here for two years. First day we arrived the apartment was flooded and they didn’t clean up the mess. It took us fighting with them to remove the mold in the closet. When we left they charged us our deposit and a 1500 dollar termination fee we paid and they still put an eviction on our credit. I have tried to get them to return my call or resolve this issue so I can get another apartment they refuse to answer. Worst mistake of my life trusting them.

Cockroaches, poor resident support, dirty common grounds, buildings in poor repair, theft, broken security gates, dog poop everywhere. Please do not rent here, you will be better off spending slightly more to live in a newer property in the area.

Amazing— I didn’t think I could write a one-Star review about anyone ever.... until now. 

Let’s start with the basic complaints— the parking is absolutely terrible, the other tenants are uncomfortably inconsiderate and dirty, no one picks up after their dogs (half the time the dog waste stations are out of bags, even though management swears they will provide bags). 

If you have a garage, don’t even think about ever actually being able to park in your garage peacefully without being blocked in. It’s one way to get to know your neighbors, I guess?

Moving in? While I don’t suggest it, I understand that is freakin expensive to live in Austin so you just might have to...... make sure you don’t have a roommate with a common name or you’ll probably learn that they are a criminal (they won’t though don’t worry) because the office doesn’t actually pay attention to what they put in for background checks. Godspeed y’all. 

What about moving out? What if you’re like SUPER clean and take really great care of things? Forget about it— these guys are going to do whatever they can to get a couple hundred bucks out of you. Like, claim you’ve broken an appliance that definitely was not broken when you left— and then refuse to show you more than a very unclear photo (don’t even dare ask for a walkthrough, your unit was probably magically already leased like 4 days after you moved out!)

I am genuinely disappointed in my experience here, and I am thrilled to be done dealing with this complex and management company. There are so many other options in the Tech Ridge, please choose one of those if you value your sanity.

I am really glad I chose Oxford at Tech Ridge! I had a lot of options to choose from in North Austin. This was the best fit in terms of price, location and size of apartment. I love my apartment! It is very quiet and my apartment is beautiful. The girls in the office, Yvonne, Valerie and Jennifer were awesome! They walked me through the process and had me approved in 24 hours! I've only been here a couple months, but it's been great so far!

Some neighbors like to leave their trash laying around outside their apartment. The parking lots usually have a good amount of beer cans, alcohol bottles, and fast food trash that ends up on someone's car on the weekend. 

The Valet trash service misses many collection days, and comes from 7pm to about 930pm depending on how they feel. If the gusts of wind don't topple your neighbor's trash bags into your door and leave grease streaks everywhere, consider yourself lucky. Try taking to your trash to the compactor in back and get a new sense of what a landfill looks like. 

Many residents have dogs that leave lots of dog mess in all the grassy areas and sidewalks. It's definitely not pleasant when walking after sunset. 

And don't forget the handful of people that decided to remove their mufflers and race down I-35 or Yager Ln at either 1am or 6 am (why not 10pm???).

Overall not bad, but I think there's equally affordable places elsewhere.

I moved to Griffis Lakeline Station in 2017 from across the country, the location met my needs at the time due to it’s proximity to my employer. The leasing staff at the time was great! I’ve found that the location is convienant for shopping and entertainment as well as Downtown being a short drive away. The property and the amenities are very well maintained. I really like the pool and there’s a lot of space to be able to enjoy it. My really dog loves the dog park, if he had the option, he’d live there. The maintenance staff are fantastic and responsive, any issues are usually addressed within 24 hours of submitting a request, sometimes even the same day. I really appreciate being able to stop into the office with questions and be treated like a person rather than just my apartment number. I really do enjoy calling it home.

After living in my last apt this is ideal. The staff are great, maintenance is fabulous and they work with you if there is an issue. I have met some very nice people as my neighbors. People are friendly here. I have a nice one bedroom(not updated) but, so what. There is a nice greenbelt in back. I have only good things to say about this complex.

If there was a 0 or negative, that would be what I'd select. And the sad thing is I live here and have ways to go in my lease. First of the office staff sucks! They are unprofessional and their response to renter questions and concerns are horrible at best and unresponsive at worst. 
Parking is a nightmare, most of the parking spots are reversed as covered parking, which in itself is not bad except they are more than the free parking and they are disproportional to the number of buildings and unit occupancy. Residents have made several complaints about this to no avail. Their response to this issue is 'get covered parking'.
There have been several car break ins and the mail box and package locker center has also not been spared.
Residents are noisy, do not pick after their dogs, smoke weed and cigarettes eventhough the apartment claims to be a smoke free property and even charge a fee for this.
Residents leave their small kids to play unattended in the parking area. Several complaints have been made about this but nothing has been done. This is reckless and the part of parents who allow this and irresponsible of the office staff not addressing this. This is a huge safety issue and a preventable accident waiting to happen.
The renting conditions here can be summed as frustrating at best and painful at worst. 
Look elsewhere!
Mostly it's young people and i really like that ,The people are nice it's close to the fast foods and major shopping centers and the malls. Love it!!!

I’ve lived here for a few months and it was good at first but it seems like they got rid of all the nice and friendly staff. Now the staff is unhelpful, doesn’t give you any useful information and lets the residents do whatever they want. Nice in the outside but when you move in it’s a small apartment with residents that are kinda just ruining the complex slowly but surely. Can’t wait to move
I visited Towne Oaks this past Thursday looking for a 2 bedroom for next year and Angela was so nice and knowledgeable. I will be coming back as soon as my lease is up.

MR. ALTON excellent and thorough maintenance man!!!
MS. KAREN goes above and beyond to keep her tenants happy and make you comfortable living here.
The units are very spacious for the price. She came in and genuinely cares about her tenants a great change from the normal.  

Mr. Alton and Ms. Karen great job!

I have been the resident here at town oaks one going on 11 years I have always been very happy and have always felt very safe here the Management  Team her really cares about the property and their tenants. The maintenance crew Is extremely proficient whenever I put in a request it is addressed immediately and  Most of the time depending on the issue is repaired and taken care of within the hour. I have noticed a  Positive change in   Management and maintenance crew In about the past 3-4 years.  And this definitely makes a difference
We have been living in Towne Oaks 1 for the past 2 years and do not intend on leaving any time soon. The location, staff, and overall experience here has been amazing!

We lived in Towne Oaks 1 for 2 years and we will always have fond memories of the place! The staff and maintenance at Town Oaks 1 is the best by far! I've lived in apartments for about 10 years and I've never seen such responsive and friendly staff. Karla at front office was awesome! I don't remember the names of maintenance folks, but they were extremely efficient and would get the job done the same day. The location of this apartment is great! It's right at the junction of I-35 and 183. It can't get more central than that in Austin. We also like the old school town home setup with plenty of space. We don't see such homes/apartments coming up anymore.  Thank you Towne Oaks staff, we greatly appreciate all you've done. 

Thanks,
Santosh and Megha

I have lived here for over two years, I love that I dont have any neighbors above me or below me. Also a free carport so I wont have to be looking for parking at night. Very easy to get on IH 35 and highway 183 if i wanted to. Very good prices for the square footage and maintenance is great at what they do.

Nickel dime and take lots of time. If I would have known there would be such poor service combined with such an old apartment I would probably have moved into landmark instead I like the location, but I regret choosing the woods. The have made mistakes on billing, they have attempted to charge us for items after they couldn't fix them, and half the vents don't even work. Half our apartment doesn't get heat. Then on top of that the mail isn't available outside of business hours. Meanwhile I am at Work or in commute 12 hours a day. It's a shame such a great location is being so poorly managed. If you are thinking of moving here I would consider spending a little more to live in the nicer communities in the area. MAA finds other ways to make you pay.

On the surface this apartment was not bad for the price.  It is in a good location for those who enjoy the outdoors.  However, the units are old and poorly maintained.  BE SURE TO THOUROUGHLY FILL OUT YOUR PRE MOVE IN INSPECTION.  We were hit with random charges at move out.  

As time went by, the poor quality of the units became more and more apparent.  Things started to fall apart (cabinets and drawers), the drainage was horrible, and the sliding doors and windows were frequently stuck.  As soon as winter was over our apartment was completely infested with mosquitos and millipedes- likely due to poor upkeep and proximity to the greenbelt.  

Additionally, management failed to keep the premise safe.  On multiple occasions we had people clearly not living at the apartments come up to our door, and I had my car broken into parked right outside of our unit.  The pool was also closed for a significant portion of our tenure living here.

Lived here for two years... A lot of insects... you cant even use the balcony because of the terrible amount of mosquito... The apartment is falling apart... Our doors are repaired multiple times because the house is clearly moving... you can see cracks around the house... Come move - out time they will charge you with terrible fees...A lot of dog poop everywhere and their trash bins are always in terrible condition

The Woods on Barton Skyway is a Jem within our beautiful city. It has everything! First I have to say I love the staff. Denise and Sandy run the office and are a couple of the sweetest women you'll ever meet. If you are in the area come and say hi. They're great! They I've never had an issue these ladies went prompt on getting resolved. Dwight runs the maintenance and grounds. There isn't a problem he can't fix!! Very Experienced! Thank you Dwight for all your help over the years... Rudy and Murtada are on point with everything around here. The staff here just gets the job done. Everyone is so professional and so cool. The staff alone is a reason to move in!!! Anyway, your right off the Mopac but you can't hear the cars. Easy access to head in any direction. Your a mile from downtown,trails are at the bottom of the hill along with Taco Deli and a corner store and a health food deli inside. Dog friendly neighborhood and beautiful people. The Woods on Barton Skyway!!! I can't say enough!!!

As long time home owners with memories of our wild and crazy youth we were anxious as we searched for an apartment in Austin. Our must haves were pets, quiet, and near downtown. The bonus wish list included washer/dryer or hook-ups, location near public transportation and an exercise room or near-by bike-jogging-walking path.

The Woods at Barton Skyway met our wants, needs, and so much more. The location is one of the best in town. We are across the street from the Greenbelt that leads to Zilker Park and all it offers (ACL, Barton Springs Pool, Festival of Lights, Botanical Gardens, canoeing, kayaking, The Kite Festival, and free musicals at the outdoor theater every summer). We are also across the street from Taco Deli (try their breakfast Otto). The school and public bus stops are at the end of Barton Skyway and on Spyglass so you are never far from one. The public school district is one of the best in the state.

Though The Woods isn’t one of the newer apartments in the area it is well maintained and laid out. Parking is located in cul-de-sacs that allow for a more pleasing view from most apartments. Maintenance issues are dealt with quickly and emergencies are dealt with immediately. Dealing with the staff is a pleasure rather than a trial. They let you know over two month before your lease is to expire to give you time to make other plans if that is your wish instead of kicking you on your way out with additional fees.

The apartment doesn’t have a playground but it does have a doggie play area. The floor plans draw residents from all ages. Students, retirees, and young families enjoy the pool and gas grill on the patio at the clubhouse. The area is safe and quiet.

The reasons I rated The Woods on Barton Skyway 4 stars instead of 5 stares are 1) You are required to purchase Time Warner Cable whether you will be using it or not, 2) We don’t have Google Fiber, yet, and 3) The clubhouse kitchen, dining room and living room are not available after office hours. There is no separation between the offices on the top floor and the entertaining area on the bottom floor. It is a nice area that is under used because most gatherings occur.

We had intended to live in an apartment for a year while we found our way around Austin. We have revived our plans to stay here until our daughter graduates from college as we can’t think of living anywhere else.

1 minute walk to the Barton Creek Greenbelt and Tacodeli. Great if you're into nature, hiking, swimming holes, and delicious taco's. That should be just about everyone with a pulse. Grounds look great and the rent is reasonable by Austin standards to boot. Units themselves are clean and well maintained if not a little out of date.

The quality of construction here is average and the cost is OK. Importance maintenance requests will not be fulfilled, like addressing leaks, cleaning mold growth in AC units or patching rat holes. Also after losing my job due to COVID and receiving a grant for rent payments the apartment complex "lost" the payments and tried to charge me. The late fees here are also excessive and criminal, in upwards of 150 dollars after the third. Monolithic management corporation evades responsibility at every turn.

Trash and waste management is an eye sore and poorly managed. I have loud neighbors I had to repeatedly ask to lower their bass music. Property has been under renovation for last two years, I appreciate this, but it is disrupting my work from home.

First off, I got bait and switched. The apartment they showed me had a completely different layout including counter space, no overhead lighting or ceiling fan which I was showed, and my "first floor" apartment ended up being a sub floor apartment, essentially living in a cave. Upon move in, I was extremely upset but none the less had to move in during that time. Over the next year my AC broke 6 times, in the middle of the summer when my apartment would be 86 degrees with my poor dog locked inside. Also, they will randomly cut water off almost monthly, but that wasn't a big deal for me, but I came home twice to my laundry room flooded from the floor above me and the ceiling fallen everywhere. After staying my lease, I went to check in with how much my new rent was and it was going up $100 a month. Right before I put in my 60 days, there was a water leak from the outside into my living room, ruining my book shelves, books and record player. This maintenance was never fixed, having me live with fans and moldy walls for 2 months and my book shelf, contents  and everything near it in the middle of my living room until move out. This is not a nice or new complex, and there had been no renovations for me. After all was said and done, they ended up charging my an extra $500 for "pet smell" though it was cleaner and nicer than when I'd moved in, taking all my deposit, pet deposit and making me pay those extra fees. Worst year of my life.
The location is great and the apartment is a nice size.
I think it's a great value for the price, even though the interior isn't the fanciest!
My experience was positive overall, and my apartment suited my needs just fine 95% of the time. The location is also not bad- a lot of things that I wanted or needed were a short drive away.

Good location. Truly within five miles, there  is everything you need. Grocery stores, Costco, Sams club, movies, normal too high end shopping and ovrr 100 restaurants. All personal needs such as doctors, hospitals, dentists, salons and car care. The apartments have been refurbished with modern finishes. The pool, Jacuzzi and grounds are kept well. They are not energy-efficient as newer apartments. However, deer and squirrels and birds enjoy the huge trees and greenbelt at rear of property. Great maintaince crew. Rent on high side, but so close to major roads and convenient shopping and eating, it is worth it.

My apartment has a great layout, especially for me as a self-employed individual with a need to have a home office. I really didn't need a 2nd bedroom (nor the cost of one) and this unit has a small "study" or den space which is just perfect. Two big windows bring in lots of natural light and I have great views of the beautiful courtyard. Great setup which increases my productivity!

Everyone is very friendly at this place. It has been here since the 90's but they still keep the grounds in good condition. There are lot of a dogs (all on leashes). There is a very nice inner courtyard where you can take your dog for a walk, and it is very common to see deer roaming the area. It is very close to many big companies, and grocery stores. The office staff is very very nice. They are willing to work with you in most cases and seem to actually care about their residents. Maintenance requests are always complete promptly and well. The staff even remembers our names and which apartment we live in even before we say anything. The gate breaks now and again (like any gated apartment complex does), but this is the first place that actually fixes it in a reasonable amount of time.

I have a very bad experience here (2019-2021). I paid them very fully even during pandemic but the way they treated me is so bad.

The floor in the restroom got water leaked. I kept reporting in a month but they did not do anything.

This apartment complex has no respect for its tenants. After the winter storm in Feb 2021, the apartment did not have running water for a week after the ice and snow melted. I will not recommend this complex and advise anyone find a better place to live. This complex does not care about it's tenants.

Great place to live if you prefer the walkability and don't have a car. It's very close to many groceries, clothing stores, restaurants, etc. Good apartment and neighborhood. Very helpful and friendly staff in the leasing office

Disgusting, non-maintained apartments (from the 1960s or so) and uncaring staff.  All they care about is money.  We wanted to move into a bigger apartment, (before we found out about the BLACK MOLD in the vents), and they told us we had to pay all the fees (almost $2,000 in fees again) Maintenance is extremely slow to do ANYTHING and none of the staff cares about you or even pretends to.  We had mold in our vents and when I told them, they insulted my intelligence and told me there was no way it was mold. Every time it rained, water leaked into our apartment.  Our power bills averaged $265/month for a 1 bed/1 bath, 600 sq foot apartment due to the old AC unit (at least 20 years old.)  This was the absolute worst experience of my life and this place seriously needs to be shut down.

I laugh at the pictures because they look nothing like the unit I live in or even the grounds (no way some of these reviews are real).  The 1 bedroom apartments (even the larger floor plans) are small.  My stove I swear is like from 1983.  None of the gas grills are functional anymore because of people using charcoal in them.  Gym is a joke.  Pool is almost completely shaded by trees, so if it's not shady, it's dirty from leaves.  

Parking lot isn't secure, lots of break-ins and half the lights don't work.  People constantly rushing through the parking lot way too fast.  And if you like sleep, forget about it.  Trash and recycling pickup is generally between 3-5 am.

My apartment isn't in great shape.  I've had more water leaks than I can count.  Rent keeps going up and no improvements have been made to the apartments or the grounds.

I adored my apartment here at Arboretum Oaks, I only left because I moved out of Austin. The apartments themselves are fantastic - brick fireplace, built-in shelves, updated kitchen and bathroom fixtures and heat-resistant counter tops, cool gray walls with white trim, ceiling fan in the bedroom...honestly, nothing to not love about this place. Maintenance was always extremely quick to respond and friendly around the community. Cute little pool and grill area that's probably underutilized. And the staff is really friendly and helpful! As long as you pay rent on time, obviously, they're the best. So close to so many great things - Trader Joe's, Target, HEB, 24-Hour Fitness, etc... Highly recommend this complex!

Absolute hell on earth. Please read for your health and safety. The entire complex is riddled with a black mold infestation. Our original unit 2117 in building 2 had a bathroom ceiling covered in black mold. The complex refused to do more than Clorox the problem, and would not conduct an air test due to plans to “renovate” the unit and stated that “it's a liability for us to test and remediate.” 

Despite our previous unit being inhospitable, there is currently a new resident living there and no renovations are in progress. West Lake Vistas lied to us about renovation plans and leased a contaminated unit to an unwitting resident.  

We ended up transferring to another unit here because we were in a pinch and had already moved our stuff onto the property. They up-charged us $350 more per month. Because management wasn't willing to fix the mold problem, we ended up paying more money per month? What a business model.

My partner had to go to the ER in the middle of the night for sudden severe trouble breathing (he’s a very healthy adult with no family history or personal history with pulmonary or cardiac issues). After a myriad of tests, the doctor came to the conclusion that "airborne particles including mold" are the strong cause. Additionally, we both had developed rampant itchiness/frequent hives. We then discovered our air vents are covered in black mold.

When we moved in, there was literally urine in our master bathroom toilet; used contact lenses stuck to the toilet seat; missing and gouged floor boards; grout missing in the shower and areas covered with mold; a leak coming from the secondary bathroom ceiling; a closet rack left broken and unusable for 3 months; a dishwasher that leaked a puddle every time we ran it; a severe cockroach infestation; and a general lack of cleanliness throughout. The air filters were completely black and encrusted with dust and the dryer line had never been emptied. We were forced to wait 2 weeks before moving into this unit (while our belongings were in the moldy unit) because it had to be “cleaned” before our arrival. Nothing was clean. To make matters worse, we now have a gaping hole in our bathroom that snows insulation every time we walk in since they haven’t bothered to patch where they fixed a majorly leaking fire sprinkle.

Don’t live here.

Our apartment was turned over to us 1 day late in poor condition.  In general, the property is dirty and poorly maintained.  Office staff is unable or unwilling to give status updates on maintenance requests.  In unit repairs are not made in a timely manner.  We have had outstanding service requests since our move in 48 days ago.  Pet stations are not maintained.  Waste bags are often missing and receptacles are overflowing.

Do not rent here. The complex is severely neglected from a maintenance perspective—- pools always broken and full of algae and debris. The gym looks as though it has never been cleaned, with half of the equipment broken, and no cleaning supplies available most of the time. Trash everywhere. Lots of vandalism and theft in garages that are kept open and unmonitored. Insufficient parking due to a plethora of abandoned vehicles that do not belong to residents.

Except for the views this is a horrible property. Maintenance never comes to fix problems. The amenities are never working either. Be warned there is no lease break clause in their lease so once you sign you are stuck. Do not rent here.

So far I LOVE it!! I had a crazy move in due to personal/family things and they were SO HELPFUL and accommodating. A few things weren't perfect when I moved in and they made sure to fix it and prorated the rent (without me asking) due to it not being as the lease said it would. 
I've only been there a few days but the area is great and the front office is very accommodating. I've seen other reviews and have no idea who they dealt with but Giuliano was AMAZING and so was the property manager I can't remember her name :( .
In response to other reviews...yes, there is trash in the trees/near the pool/dumpsters and some  areas with lots of dog poop but that's a matter of lazy/disrespectful residents not doing what they're supposed to and it is not management's fault ppl are assholes. I haven't been here long enough to know much else.

I am so excited to be here and think the other reviews are CRAZY.

DO NOT LIVE HERE!

When you look at pictures and see reviews this complex looks like an amazing place to live but just remember this is the worst complex we have ever lived in and are waiting for the day to never come back.

Basically, I live in a kennel now. I realize I am in Austin where the vast majority own and love dogs but I do not. I think they are offering specials to large dog owners now because all the old tenants are so disappointed in the new management and uncleanliness they cannot fill the place any other way. I recently have new residents above me. They have at least one very large dog, maybe 5 from the sounds of it sometimes. Now I get the pure joy of listening to the dog(s) run back and forth many times a day. It sounds like a massive thunderstorm or a bunch of bowling bowls being dropped. I can also hear the dog(s) barking as if they were in the room next to me. This in addition to the 10-12 new dogs in other apartments in the buildings since I moved in. They bark either on the ground below my window/balcony or on their owners balcony at all hours of the day and night. I also get the joy of listening to the owners repeated call the dog or tell the dog to stop barking, sometimes for 15 minutes straight. I am not sure what is worse - the dog barking or listening to the owners shout at them. I am hoping the dog(s) upstairs settle down at some point or maybe I can somehow bribe the residents to do something about the noise otherwise I am going to have to find a way to sublease this apartment.

I also no longer enjoy using the pool since the residents continue piling trash into the bins well past the point of them being full. They leave trash and food everywhere by the pool and grill. They apparently think this is a hotel that has 24 hour cleaning staff? Yes there is a maintenance staff but they are not there on Sundays and yet people just keep adding trash to overflowing bins knowing they will not be emptied.

I have talked to management about the issue and their response is that its not during "quiet hours" so its my problem. The floors/walls are so thin that its unbearable. Management has no consideration or respect for basic tenant needs. Please reconsider if you're thinking about living here. You'll regret it.
