BEWARE THIS PLACE - IT IS NOT WORTH YOUR TIME OR MONEY!!!

What a disappointment. What started out great (when it was called Alexan Vistas) has completely gone downhill over the past year. I've been here almost 2 years and the management has been handed off twice, progressively getting worse as it's gone on, and the most recent of which has been the most unreliable management I've experienced at an apartment. 

Maintenance:
It's like pulling teeth to get management to take any half-action on maintenance that's remotely helpful. I literally had to pull out Texas Property Codes in order to get my hot water heater replaced after a MONTH of them coming by, running the water for an extremely short amount of time, saying it's okay, only to repeatedly fail to resolve my issue (didn't have hot water for a month). Furthermore, maintenance has stopped by my apartment with management FAILING TO NOTIFY ME. The only reason I happened to figure this out is by having to call them about the SAME issue that was yet again not resolved and they said maintenance had "already stopped by". This makes me even very uncomfortable with any work or inspections that need to be performed in my apartment.

Safety:
Garbage trucks consistently leave behind an excess of broken bottles after moving on to the next location. This wouldn't be an issue if management had this promptly cleaned up, but NOPE. Glass shards are sprinkled throughout the main area where dogs are walked for the two buildings at the top of the hill. The "dog park" at the bottom of the hill is a joke and a farce for what residents at the top of the hill have to deal with. Whereas the dog park has a nice astro-turf, fenced-in area, the top of the hill has the glass shard patch before you get to a strip of grass that is only cut but not maintained.  When you look closer, you also realize that it's overwhelmed with weeds producing an excess of burrs. This is a SAFETY HAZARD for pets.

Pricing:
If the pricing seems too good to be true right now, it is. I'm locked into a much higher price (about $400 above) for a 2 bed 2 bath than what's currently advertised until my lease ends. There's a reason the value has dropped. The management here has become so unhelpful that I don't even want to sublet to get out because I don't want anybody else to get misled by this place, even if it were for a short amount of time.

Wrap Up:
Ever since the new management, the only remaining good quality about this place is the view. Do NOT buy into what they're selling.

The current manager is Ashlee Funcannon, and she's doing a great job.  There have been some problems with some tenants (noise, cleanliness, parking issues, etc.), and Ashlee has stepped in effectively.  My main complaint is that when we do get a good manager, they are quickly transferred elsewhere, and a new person has to step in and start over.  Keep Ashlee here!

The new counters look really nice in my apartment and I really like it. Only thing I would suggest is better cleaning of trash rooms. Gym is always clean and I like that my room has a window. I am glad that I renewed for another year.
my apartment was renovatted in December and I like the new counters.one thing that I wish would change is the elevators. the complex is really nice and maintenance is good and staff is nice.
This place is smaller but feels homey. The staff is great and accommodating and gave me a great tour. I signed here and I can't wait to live here in fall
I've lived in 4 different west campus apartments and GrandMarc is by far best. Great amenities and living space. Move-in was as easy as it gets

First and foremost, I have had nothing but great experiences with the management. They are very accessible, quick to help, and friendly. They work with residents to make the building better. If we ever had a maintenance request, it was taken care of quickly.
I lived in a 4bed/4 bath. The rooms were a little small, but the apartment is in a great location right off of campus. My apartment was furnished, so we didn't have to worry about lugging furniture up to our place. The bathrooms are nice and the apartment has nice finishes (including a TV for the living room). The building itself has good amenities. The pool is nice and there's a recreation area on the 2nd floor by the pool. There is a study area with plenty of tables and power outlets on the 1st floor. The gym is small, but proportional to most gym/complex ratios.  My only complaint is how thin the walls are, but that is usually the case in any kind of student housing development.

When I moved into the property management was horrible but they to be really working on improving the management team. Josh and Lindsay have been great so far! 

The property has good features and I have enjoyed living here.

I have lived here for almost three years, and I would like to warn anyone (Especially families with children) who would like to move there. There have been continuous break ins that happened every few weeks for the bast three years. Unfortunately, I was a victim of one of them as well. We all contacted the property manager many times regarding this and the only answer we got is that the landlord is not responsible to protect you. They are advertising this property as gated and luxury apartment rental and unfortunately, they aren’t even able to secure the gate at night and refused to take any steps to prevent this. I have so many videos available showing cars circling at night and people breaking in garages that I caught on my ring cameras that I was forced to install to protect my family. All those videos were sent to the property manager and unfortunately, they did nothing. Many people wrote reviews about this online and the property manager threatened them to terminate their lease if they didn’t remove them. When the time comes to move out, they will do anything possible to hold your security deposit and charge you unfair hundreds of dollars under any excuse. If you have children, this is not a safe community for your family.

We had just left after three years and they want to charge me $1500
For a nail that I left in the wall that was so small I didn’t even seen it and for other little things that don’t make sense 
Don’t move there

Visitor from Houston, TX. Had an excellent tour with Taylor on January 21st. PROS: The tour was very thorough featuring the unit, amenities, and parking area. This was the kindest, most down to earth property I toured (and I toured 8 that day)! Coffee, water, and an entire map of Austin so I can learn my way around!! I love LOVE the enclosed wooden patio, the stain compliments the wood so well. The interior is nice and humbling, its an excellent use of space. CONS: The paint used may be Behr Dove-Grey Latex. Latex paint is not appropriate to paint the entire apartment, its shiny and gross. Latex is for doors. Not sure if its an Austin thing, the standard for any luxury apartment are 9' ceilings minimum. The amenities are lovely but this wouldn't be considered a luxury property requesting luxury rents.

"We are not going to honor the lease", said the Leasing Manager lady while looking me in the eye, I am still in disbelief.

They raised the rent by 25%+ after my first year. I only renewed, because the lease clearly stated that the garage is no longer extra, it is included in the rent. Not only did they not accept it being included in the rent, they doubled the monthly cost of the garage compared to the previous year. They told me they won't honor the lease, since it was a clerical error on their end, and just don't respond to the fact that had I known they will charge extra for the garage I would not have renewed, since I can't afford it.

As for the leasing/management staff, if you are looking for an apartment here you will find that they are extremely nice, helpful and responsive. They will tell you anything you want to hear. This ends the moment you sign the lease.

The staff has a huge rate of turnover as well, if you speak to someone in the office today it is very likely that person won't be working there the following week, so you'll have to keep repeating yourself over and over.

There have also been numerous car break-ins lately that management not only does nothing about, but removes posts from the neighborhood social app. This place is supposed to be a gated community, but the gates are constantly wide open.

As for the positives: The maintenance staff is very friendly and responsive, and this area is quiet and is next to the nature preserve, you can walk down to Lake Austin and is next to the country club.

Unless you really are set on this specific area, and don't mind the constant management and safety issues, I would highly recommend looking for housing elsewhere.

I hate to have to leave a bad review here. Until now, my stay at NW had been adequate. However, we have had multiple incidences of break-in rampages this year. Last month my car window was smashed, along with eight other cars. Most cars had personal documents and other items stolen from the glove box. NW hardly addressed this event with the entire community - we received one email the week it happened that they are "making sure the gates work properly" and that they're adding additional patrol, and since then have left us in the dark. Their response has been completely insufficient in helping make the community feel safer. I have followed up with them consistently and politely since this event. I sent multiple emails to management over the past couple weeks asking for an update on what security measures have been changed, or added, or if we should not expect any changes if we can at least know that so we can protect ourselves. No response. Honestly just really sad how management has neglected this entire community and left us in the dark on this.

Managment wasn’t aware that the fire department put a hole in my wall for a faulty sprinkler. Now I have roaches in the kitchen. Pest control only comes once a week. They claimed to have knocked on my door, with no phone call being made to me.  Please don’t waste your time. Management doesn’t care about tenants.
The caretakers and maintenance do nothing for their residences. There are cockroaches everywhere and the AC never turns on so it’s always boiling like the devils armpit

PLACE you should consider residing in. The staff barley answers the phone. Several residents including myself have had their cars STOLEN off the lot. Not only was mine taken, but it was found shot up in a nearby neighborhood.  Swear that only happened in movies lol...There are NO SECURITY CAMERAS so if anything happens you are out of luck. The gate is always open, and you will see homeless people wondering around occasionally, walking up stairs or on their bikes looking through the trash. Silverfish infestation do not much they can do to help with that. Lastly the apartments look nice, but they are poorly put together, and as time passes you realize that. One day my bath head literally shot off and put a hole through the floor. 

ps. You will hear police sirens at all times of the night..

But if all that’s sound feasible, please enjoy your life at Radius on Grove??
looked at over 20 apt before leasing at radius on the grove. Shenay and Sam are awesome and mainteance guys are nice.

I must say , so far it's been a very pleasant experience living here. It's mostly 20's-late 30's age group that lives in this complex. 

- The property overall is "clean" and a new feel to it
-Security: I've never felt unsafe outside, nor has my gf. The parking lot is well lit , and the building areas are gated off. The doors have 2x deadbolts on them so it'd be really hard to bust in
-Internet: It's AT&T, it's pretty affordable for what you get and the internet is very very fast (I stream Hockey games and there's no lag)
-Previous complaints on other reviews: Bugs- you'll run across reviews for bugs but literally i've seen 2 in the time that i've lived here. So that's pretty baseless. I requested my apartment be sprayed after the 2nd one and I got a note saying it had been completed a day and a half later. 
- Maintenance: Same day service. 
- Parking:I have a reserved spot for $25 a month, It's worth it. 

Rent Payment: Online

All in all, I would highly recommend living here , Management is quick to respond to any inquiries and it's been a pleasant experience thus far.

These apartments are located off of Riverside Dr. The community is very quiet and secure. Maintenance is timely and professional. Any small concerns were handled next day. Apartments are generally clean and kept up. New management is great.. WAY better than the last one.

I am beyond excited to have leased at Radius on Grove! We just signed our lease and will be moving in next month! :) Upon coming to look at the apartments, the lady in the office told us about some events they do and even invited us to stop by the next day to join their pool party. Since we leased that day, we decided why not and ended up going. We were able to meet some of our neighbors who were very welcoming and nice! We cannot wait to move in!!!

I moved in almost 8 months ago, and from the first day the staff has been amazing. The property has new owners/management (I think in the past 10-12 months?). People will have their own experience, good/bad, but my experience has been amazing. Broke my leg in April, and the staff (including the director) offered to walk my dog. Any time I've called they came to walk him. What property staff does that? There may be some irregularities in an apartment, but the current staff/owners are not responsible for that. They have been kind and understanding to everything for me, and I truly recommend Radius. Just keep the lines of communication open with them. :-) Patience goes a long way...

During my lease, I had the worst bug problem I have ever experienced. Everyone that came over was shocked at the amount of bugs everywhere. The first floor is not for the faint of heart. There were countless times of me seeing spiders bigger than the size of my hand and cockroaches that were too big to fit into a cup in my room and around the apartment. Every time I would get rid of the endless PILES of bugs around my apartment, they'd be back within a few hours. We payed for pest control every month and requested extermination countless times to no avail. Moving in, the carpet wasn't tacked down, there was a HOLE in the bathroom wall, parts of the wall weren't painted or were already cracked (we were the first people to live in the unit). Our water heater was leaking into the living room wall causing visible mold and water damage and maintenance's first response was to paint over it before addressing the real problem. Management wise, there is a lot of room for improvement and growth. Email communication is very slow and unreliable. Be aware that customer service for current residents is not their priority once you've signed your lease. There are countless other issues I could mention about the quality of the apartment, since it looks nice, but many corners were cut, but I digress on that. Safety is a big concern for me. The gates are only built where you can see them, but are not connected, so you could still walk along the tree line to get in with no obstacles. Even if they were connected, the gate was working properly for only 2 or 3 months out of the 13 I was there - the rest of the time they were wide open. After several scary instances and a couple calls to the police, this was a major concern - which I voiced to management. There is no live on security or even a general patrol of the grounds, which I was told would happen. There is no after hours source to call - safety concerns or otherwise. Overall, the place was cute and put a roof over my head for 13 months; but when looking at all deeper than surface level, there were many flaws. I have so many stories and have heard so many stories from my former neighbors that still send shivers down my spine. I tried to move out twice during the lease, if that tells you anything. For the price, look elsewhere. This is not advertised as a low quality place, nor does the price reflect that, but it is not held to the standards of a luxury apartment complex.

Last week, I was in NYC for work.  Flew back into town on a Sunday (4th of the month), held onto my rent check because I thought the office would be closed.  Hand delivered the check the next day (Monday, 5th of the month- 3rd business day).  I was greeted with "did you add $100 for the late fee? Today is the 5th. You could have avoided it if you'd gave us this check yesterday."  On the bright side, she did say it with a pleasant, professional tone of voice.  She also handled my look of surprise really well.  I guess that helps when slapping someone with a surprise $100 charge.

I agree with the other reviews I couldn’t be happier with my choice at Radius on Grove.  The apartment is brand new the finishes are fantastic, and the staff is extremely nice and on top of things.

Parking is plentiful and the community is quiet.
I absolutely love my new apartment! It's brand new and is exactly what I was looking for. Plus, the location can't be beat. The staff is awesome too!
after searching all over, this is by far the best place I have found and can't wait to move in.  The staff was the most genuine and caring about my needs of every place I looked at.

I absolutely love this place!!  So much parking you don't have to fight for or pay for and so close to everything! Brand new too! This is perfect in every way &I love the sense of real community & that everyone remembers your name in the office & they are so nice!!  This apartment is gorgeous & has so much space!!

This place is amazing! 
Brand New!  Luxury Living.  Staff at the Leasing Office are outstanding and helpful.   Great floor plans,  beautiful appliances and marble kitchen counters.  Hey Foodie Lovers and and Home Chefs we have GAS stoves!     Pool area is amazing, and the ROOF TOP Sky Lounge is lux living.

Property is not being maintained and updated. Discounts for lower income seniors have declined, so rents are unaffordable. Management changes often and some do not treat tenants respectively. Under 55 tenants have been allowed in. However living in Mueller is wonderful and the current community of residents is friendly and helpful.

My family has lived here for 2 1/2 years, and we can testify that Austin Parke is an amazing value. Whenever we've needed a repair, the front office has responded the same day. Today, once the maintenance team confirmed that our old refrigerator was beyond repair, Karla (the manager) found us a new one and made sure it was installed the same day. Neighbors are friendly and the complex is well-maintained and safe. You'll be happy you moved here.

Lived here for two and a half years. Facility staff has always been swift in repairs whenever something broke. Property has been kept clean. Washing machines don't get repaired enough but there's at least one that still works close to me.

After moving from apartment to apartment every year, my wife and I decided to give this place a try. Three years ago, we moved here and have not thought about moving out just yet (unless we are looking for a house). Management and office staff is incredible, and very prompt! Don't get me started on maintenance. I would say 9/10 times the work orders get done the same day.  If they can't get to it that day, most likely its because they have a lot going on and will most likely get done by the next day. The location of these apartments is by far the most convenient. It is located just close enough to different food places and right off 183 and 35 so you can pretty much get anywhere in Austin quick (Depending on traffic). My wife and I have had an incredible experience here and although the apartments are not perfect, it feels like home.

all the team here are works together to make the customers happy one day I was had an issue with water all the maintenance team and supervisor came and fix it for me within few hours
and the management of the office always smiling and they are always asking me if I have any question or concern please let us know to fix it for you... I am here since 2016 and feel like my home 
I want to thank you all 
with my love 
Malik Al Hasani

I moved in to Austin from Houston in 2016 and it was hard to look for an apartment within my price range, clean and close to my work. Surprisingly, I didn't just got a 2 bedroom / 2 bath apartment and moved-in in less than 2 weeks, pricing is very reasonable and it is very clean when I moved in. The staff are AMAZING and VERY HELPFUL. Too bad, I need to move out because I purchased a new home. I stayed in this apartment for a year and I cannot tel you how much  satisfied I was. My neighbors are really nice and complex is always clean and very well maintained. Staff are easy to talk to (If you have issues or problems in the apartment ;  which I never had any :P) they will respond sooner and graciously accommodate you. Close to freeway and stores around the perimeter. Bus stop seconds away from the complex and there is a huge Bus system that is walking distance away.  My apartment unit is equipped and really nice. Parking is never a problem and it is a gated complex. A ....5 STARS!  

Arlene C

There are a number of things we love about this place.

When we first moved to Austin, we stayed in a motel while looking for apartments. After the staffs learned our situation, they worked extra hard to process the paper work so that we were able to move in the same day we walked into their office. This allowed us to save the spendings on the motel and return our moving truck on time.

Compared to other places we lived in the past, the apartment here is well equipped, especially in the kitchen area where we are provided with a microwave oven, a dish washer, and most amazingly a digitally controlled stove!

The staffs show great care about the place. For example they would send notices to residents when they saw children loitering without the supervision of their parents. When the summer came there were reminders about the rules around the pools.

The maintenance crew are very friendly. They were able to respond to our requests promptly in the past.

The leasing office organizes parties once in while. For instance there was an egg hunt for the Easter. There is also an annual resident appreciation day when tenants have a chance to win prizes. We were lucky enough to win a 43" 4K TV the first time we participated in such event! Besides the prizes, it was also a good chance to talk with the neighbors. We met a person who lived here since the 80s and was apparently very happy about this place.

There is a children playground behind the leasing office. We just had a baby here. It will be a nice place to let her play when she grows up a little.

If I have to say something critical, I wish there are more tree shadows. There are many pine trees around which make the place look neat, but unfortunately they don't block much sunlight during the summer.

I'm leaving this review to let people considering moving into this apartment complex know — don't come before knowing that there is no security or any kind of support regarding incidents here.

My husband was already living here when we got married, and before that, he had his vehicle windows broken and his car stolen right in the parking lot. It is very common, almost daily, to see cars with broken windows in the condominium. In January of this year, we contacted the management hoping to move out earlier before our lease ended because we don't feel safe — but our request was denied. We asked for measures to improve the security of the place, but no changes have been made.

The complex gates remain open 24 hours a day. Anyone can enter and leave without any problem. There are no security cameras or surveillance in the parking lot. As you can see from the email screenshots, they don't intend to change that. In fact, they almost implied that it was our fault that the car was broken into.

Well, today, February 7, 2025, when I woke up, my car had its window broken, and the steering wheel was completely messed up, as shown in the photos. Once again, the office refused to take any action regarding this.

Besides the constant car break-ins and thefts, another issue here is the frequent towing of vehicles. If your guest comes to visit and forgets to register their vehicle on the requested website, their car will be quickly towed as a welcome gift.

In conclusion, I do not recommend this complex to anyone looking for peace, security, and good service.

wish you could give -100 stars! Don't live here! The pictures are misleading, all they did was take some cheap paint and paint over all the old kitchens.  I knew it was a bad sign when I couldn't get a call back after 5 calls over 2 days before moving in. The leasing manager is rude and blames everything on being short staff.  I was left without AC for a weekend when it was 103 outside. Left without a running toilet for 8 hours after calling the office 3 times and submitting 2 work orders.   My unit was set for a June 9 move in, yet the apartment was not ready.  Just a few of the many items that came with a "move in ready unit that was just redone"

Missing tile on floors
stains on the carpets
no working keys
no mailbox keys
Ants and bugs all over
The garage was filled of supplies they used to "redo" the apartment
No Hot water
No working AC and I was given a window unit that leaked all over.
No trash can for valet trash service, yet I had to pay for it.
There was over 40 nails, screws and hooks throughout the apartment and in the garage.
Maintenace staff came in to fix some items and made them worse and no dates can be given on when anything will be fixed.
Reached out to the regional manager of the company yet she is not reachable.
This place is a mess and a joke. They really don't care about people, their jobs or what they tell tenants.

Do not rent here, you will be sorry and regret it.

It's the worst. Bugs, maintenance takes months, the office never calls you back, the pools are always closed, the gyms DO NOT look like these pictures, it's awful. So bad. I wouldn't wish this place on my worst enemy.

There are so many things i need address

1. Roof ceiling is wet and complained about it 3-5 months back but still no use
2. Roaches are allover the kitchen and living room area
3. Trash and pet poop is seen in so many   places.
4. maintenance service is not good at all

Half of what I'd write would probably get a lawyer to send a letter.
3+ property managers in under a year.
selectively enforced parking permits.
trash everywhere.

I’ve been waiting 10 months for my dryer to be fixed. I have 2 months left on my lease and it still hasn’t been fixed. I’m not even sure if they have ordered the part yet. I’ve been told by 3 people the part would be ordered. Roaches are everywhere. They get in our microwave, oven, clock on the oven, cabinets, drawers, and behind the fridge. Exterminator comes Friday’s. You have to call every week to be put on the list and he doesn’t always come. Trashes are only picked up Monday and Friday. We were able to put out 2 bags of trash. Now they are giving violations for more than 1 bag out. It took them about a month to come “treat” our black mold in the restroom after we told them we would have the health department come. We pay our bills and do maintenance request on an app. There’s a $30 fee included to use the app. AC in one fitness center never works. No one cleans up after their dogs. Gate fob never works. Gates are always open.

If you can't afford to move anywhere else i guess this property will do but try to look elsewhere. I was ready to move out the moment I moved in. I made the mistake of not making time to see the property in person as I was moving from a different state and trusted that the pictures were what the property actually looked like. Big mistake. Take a tour of the property prior to signing the lease.
Walls are very thin; you can hear EVERYTHING going on the other side of the wall. Units are very old, and you can tell if you look closely at things. There is a bug issue, but nothing too severe if you don't mind a cockroach here and there. Since I moved in, I had an issue with the shower, water turns from very hot to very cold throughout the duration of your shower, if you enjoy your showers, do not move here. Previous management told me there was nothing they could do about this issue as there is only one water heater for the entire property and that is how it works, which I did not buy. Property is dirty and laundry rooms are dirtier. Washer and dryers are always broken, and residents do not clean up after themselves. 
Overall, I did not renew my lease and would not recommend this place to anyone I care about that is moving to Austin or looking for a new place to live. Look elsewhere. I found a much nicer community, brand new, and cheaper than what I was paying. Just look around there is much better. I was being generous giving this property 2 stars. Probably the only perk I can think of is that there is a gym right across the street, hours aren't the best, but you can literally walk to the gym.

This apartment was a GODSEND... before they changed management. These apartments are tiny, the laundry facilities are unreliable and expensive, they never fix things when you put in requests, and they don't contact you about the things you need to know.
It took them nearly a week to send me a copy of my lease after realizing they took away my ability to see it on the app. There is no split pay available on the app either so you end up trying to get roommates to send you rent and you lose money in the transfers.
They make promises they don't keep (ex. I moved into this apartment in June and I still don't have a closet door OR a ceiling fan in the bedroom AND the fans in the livingroom are on remote controls that simply Do Not Work.) They also don't fix things, if anything they make things Worse. 
More examples of things that just Suck here that they have yet to fix include, my front door doesn't latch unless it's locked, the entire apartment is painted in primer meaning that it's peeling in the humidity, they CONSTANTLY shut off the water with little to no warning, they don't answer emails, the appliances are either falling off the walls or severely damaged from malfunctioning repeatedly. The past reviews are old but they are not wrong.
DO NOT MOVE HERE IT IS NOT WORTH THE MONEY OR ALLEGED CONVENIENCE.

Unbelievable what these people call acceptable living conditions. Front door inoperable combined with an oven that will not regulate creating a SERIOUS safety hazard!!! 1960's Air conditioning unit runs all day to produce a unit that over 84*. Cockroaches abound!!! In spite of numerous notifications of the deplorable conditions, the owners and management refused to address and remedy these situations. Nice, remodeled leasing office, though.

These guys have so many great things going on right now and the place is really coming together well! The office staff is super friendly and attentive. The new manager has been quick to respond with any issue I have and is just all around super friendly and nice. Excited about the parking issues being addressed as well as the new patrol service we have now. I was considering moving at the end of my lease term but I've decided to stay and watch the progress unfold. I know some people might have had bad experiences and it's easy to focus on the negative but I would recommend this place for sure!! There are just so many positive changes that I'm noticing in such a short amount of time that I know it's only going to get better here.

Its like a trailer park Melrose place with everyone drinking cheap beers and creating  problems for no valid reason. Its horrible and I don't belong here at all. I didn't want to move here but had no choice financially. Its a nightmare. 
I need a quite place to live. I'm disabled and this place antagonizes my issues I'm facing mentally and physically. 
Not recommended at all.

The staff that work here are excellent and maintenance is really responsive. Aesthetically the community and apartments are nice. The problem truly lies in the construction with paper thin walls, we planned on renewing our lease. But after several nights of being woken up at 3:00 in the morning from our new upstairs neighbors. We decided not to renew our lease 10 days shy of the 60 day cancellation at which point we were penalized with an exorbitant and unnecessary fee. Instead of paying our prorated rent for the 12 days of occupancy for the month of December, We are now responsible to pay an additional $1239. Which is ironic considering we were one of the first people to move in to this apartment and we dealt with months of delay on the pool and gym amenities being available for use with no compensation past the dates we were told upon signing our lease.
they will lie and tell you one thing at first and then end up telling you something totally different two weeks later. I really do love my apartment here but management and services here are awful.

Pool is still not done - they said February, then for sure April, then May, then beginning of June, it's now ALMOST JULY, NO POOL!!! 

Nothing but problems since moving in. The approval and application process was good, but ever since getting the keys, it has been a nightmare.

They are also charging the amenity fee when none of the amenities are done (they said because the business center is complete, they are charging amenity fee + offering online workout classes but that has yet to be done). Moved in Dec. 28th and it's April 25th and the pool/gym still are not done.

EDIT: May 4 and pool/gym are  still not done and NO communication on when it will be done after many emails sent to management.

They also lack communication. No communication on door codes and locks and just put them into place. Security is also a joke as my car was broken into last month with no apology from management and NO FOLLOW UP. I had to email them three times asking if there had been any other cars that were broken into. They don't close the security gates because of construction still ongoing, not even at night.

Last bit of advice if you are thinking of moving here… get a top floor unit. The buildings were constructed very poorly and cheaply and you can hear everything your upstairs neighbor is doing, and I mean everything as to even shutting the shower door. If you got a top floor unit, this wouldn’t be a problem. If you are looking at a lower unit or middle, please have someone go walk in the unit above you before signing the lease.

DO NOT rent from here. This place is 100% a joke and the management is theeee worst.

Now onto the positive since I am for the majority a positive person… the location is great if you’re looking in north Austin. Close to HEB & Target.

I moved in a couple of months ago. Prior to leasing I asked when the amenities would be done, I was told December. So I said ok, not a long wait, sign me up! I asked again in January, and I was told a couple of weeks. I asked again in February and I was told “definitely by spring break”. Fast forward to April, still no sign of completion. And yes, you will STILL pay for amenities fee each month even though it’s not available. At move in, my apt was not clean... dust, glue, paint, damage cabinets everywhere. All the baseboards already cracked and my floor is also lifting despite the extra glue sticking out after 2 months. So much for “brand new” right? The best part is maintenance, they show up unannounced and they don’t show up when they say they do. The original maintenance crew left due to management, there’s a new team but somehow worse than the first group. It took 4 weeks to resolve a simple order that takes a flip of a switch. Parking is already an issue, construction folks take up most of the parking spaces and they are MESSY.... garbage, cigarettes, nails & screws all over. I had to get a brand new tire due to screws on my first month. Leasing office avoids phone calls from residents due to all the issues, all they care about are getting new ones in. If you confront in person, the front desk just says sorry and play dumb. The managers say they’ll look into it but weeks go by and nothing.

DO NOT LIVE HERE! I am a current resident, and my personal experience is horrible. The application process was horrendous. If it wasn’t for Cody (asst. mgr.), I would have not moved in. They do not respond to questions, nor do they return communication when they say they will. This is the same with the manager. 
I have had a family that constantly allows their children to run throughout the apartment above for the last six weeks. The manager said she would look into a solution for me and get back to me the day after our meeting. A week later, I email her asking for a follow-up and I get nothing. The next day I go into the office and the solution is I can transfer for a $500 fee, go through the application process again (which was not fun the first time) including the fees, only after being here for six months. I have lived here for only two, so I need to stay in this situation for another four months before a change can be made. This is all after speaking to the resident at minimum of six times (who blames the management on moving them into a second story unit and blames construction for being poor), the office staff over a dozen times including emails, and the courtesy officer three times. The officer even states the office should do something being the noise occurs during waking hours such as 7am on Sunday morning or 11pm on a Tuesday and can last for hours. Residents do have a right to have a reasonably comfortable living environment, however, it is not the community's responsibility if you do not.
I have had two flat tires because of construction leaving nails in the parking lot. I have also picked up boxes full of trash and debris that has blown in front of my building from construction our ever-overflowing dumpster. This has happened on more than one occasion, after allowing the trash/debris to sit for over 24 hours and build up in the breezeway/entry. This is also broken Styrofoam and a wide variety of plastic.
We pay amenities fees for a coffee machine that is working 80% of the time, a business center with a printer that has not been online the last three times I have tried to use it, a pool and gym that don’t exist, and valet trash pickup that simply adds to the overflowing dumpster in the parking lot.
I had an open work order for a running toilet for over two weeks. After one week, I asked, “how long is a typical work order open?” 24 hours was my answer. I explained my situation and it only took an additional eight days to be completed.
I LOVE THE Aura Avery Ranch TEAM! From the front desk to the maintenance they always provide great customer service and take care of matters efficiently! They all rock!

This place is a masterpiece! The views will blow any community out of the water. The location is so convenient for living outside of the city. The staff is unbeatable and unbelievably amazing. They really cater to your needs! I could not be happier with the customer service experience I was given. I’m applying today and can’t wait to start my life at The View!
I enjoy being a part of this beautiful community. Great location and modern convinces!

David in the office is so helpful and genuine...you can tell he cares about the residents and making this complex a wonderful place to call home. The amenities and property are beautiful and it is a great place to live!

The View has nice amenities and WAS a great place to live. Unfortunately, new owners/management brought some unwelcome changes. Not only has rent gone up(“because all the others did” market based) but new fees have been added as well. Fees added, and the quality of life in the time since the takeover has gone down. Parking has never been good and wasn’t considered when built.

Living at The View is very peaceful and quaint! Its a great mix of kinds of people and dynamics and its such a beautiful place to live! The staff is excellent at everything they do, everything is very inviting, and it definitely feels like home.
The View at Bel terra is a fabulous apartment complex; home to warming staff members ready to help you get a tour of theyre new apartments.

Tramor at The Arboretum has been my favorite home in Austin. Since living in South Austin for three years , I wanted a change of scenery. The Arboretum has amazing nature SCENERY! Maintenance team works efficiently and they are so kind! All the staff shows how much they care for the apartments.

I have talked to management regardibg above noise over the last few months. They refuse to do anything. I have lived in apartments for over 20 years and understand noise! This is not normal!  Do not rent here if you want to deal with horrible management

I have lived here for around five years. It's been great. The place is nice and quiet. I've never had a maintenance request open for more than a day. Everything has been good here, and it's a really good deal for the neighborhood.

I lived here since 2018 and at first I really enjoyed it but this place has gone down hill. To start, I was living in a second floor apartment in building 18 which was nice and clean, newly renovated and never had any issues. However when I was planning on transferring to a single bedroom without a roommate, they moved me to a different unit but in and much older building, towards the front #8 that was not taken care of nearly as much as I had expected it to be like the other one. The patio was in awful condition, the restroom tiles were smothered with mold, and there were cracks all inside the unit from structural damage. You couldn’t beat the price and it was during covid, so it was doable at that time. However they continued to hike up the price by a whopping 50% by the 3rd year which was insane considering the damages already existing in the unit based on the structure in the building, mold in the cracks in the restroom, crappy insulation that could make you hear your surrounding neighbors, and worse, disgusting roaches that live in the trees were consistently trying to get through in the summertime. When I brought up these issues to them, nothing was done to address the cosmetic concerns for their newly hefty price. They tried to PAINT over the mold instead of trying to actually remove it and the big cracks in the unit were simply painted over with an off white which made them look worse than before. I am glad I left and this place is 100% not worth the money unless you are in one of the nicer buildings towards the back of the complex but it seems like it could be hit or miss.

New complex manager, Jamie, started a little while ago and the service took a huge dip in care of tenants. The old manager Carlos worked to keep the community happy. 

I have lived in this complex for over 5 years and I have never experienced such lackadaisical tenant care and no interest in customer service. Maintenance is great for my needs. The office just wants to make it easier for themselves. Two staffers are just gone. It is just sad that my home is in the hands of someone who would rather get convenience for themselves rather than making sure tenants are taken care of. 

The gate of the gated community has been broken for over 3 years and they are not fixing it. I am forced into having “trash valet” and Spectrum cable and internet instead of being anole to upgrade my internet. The apartment complex still raised the rent to be competitive with local apartment complexes, the rent isn’t worth it to me now. It’s the lack of customer care and the new manager’s disregard to tenants service. 

The last straw now is that the office manager has decided to stop accepting mail packages and holding them for tenants. Instead of figuring out an alternative they are implementing this rule even though the USPS carrier and office are returning all the refused deliveries. The mail carrier, Mr. Tracey, told them that refused mail and packages are automatically returned to the sender. The staff at the post office had my held mail and not my packages because of this. The staff even knew the manager Jamie because she took time out of a work day to go to the post office and curse them all out over this. Poor professional behavior!

I lost 3 important work packages and 2 personal packages that were returned. Now I have to pay extra for a PO Box in order to get my mail delivered to me.

I now hate this place, don’t move in because you will leave sooner than you thought.

If you are looking for a welcoming place I could not recommend Northland at the Arboretum any higher.  The staff are great, helpful and very attentive.  The property and units are clean, well maintained and have a decorative interior and exterior appeal.  Families of all kinds would be happy here.  They are many places that have star appeal in Austin these days but Northland at the Arboretum still keeps their tenants at the top.

Unfortunately, the people who run this complex do not treat people with respect or fairness.  I have lived here for years. They have threatened to tow my car twice because my car registration was expiring the following month. There's one woman in the office who behaves like a junior high school mean girl. She has sent me three inappropriate e-mails which clearly display her lack of professionalism or kindness. This month my "water bill" was $72 for a two bedroom apartment. Most people who live in HOUSES in Austin don't pay that much for water, so it's literally impossible that I owe that much. The water bill should really be called "extra rent" because you're not billed by the City of Austin, but the Northland Corporation - and the amount rises every month, whether or not units in your building or empty or full.

First and foremost, love the location of my apartment. I am very close to anything I could ever need. I've lived here for a few years now and am very happy. The apartments are not new, but are well kept and were updated with more modern cabinetry and flooring some time ago. All of my neighbors are friendly and I have yet to meet anyone unpleasant since moving here. The office is great. They are always genuinely happy to help and always have treats for my dogs in the office. Maintenance is good, they get the job done quickly. There is now a dog park on the grounds which my dog absolutely loves. It has also been great for getting to know my neighbors. The pool is nice, but often very busy on the weekends. I really have no complaints and plan to renew my lease. Good overall value.

Pros, neighbors for the most part are nice and quiet and the grounds are kept clean and nice. Locations is near perfect as far as entertainment, family friendly, and close by shopping. Cons, Parking is rough and the spaces are painted too thin. Management isn't helpful, and have an odd sense of entitlement. Will tack on random charges so always ask what the charges are for, reasons are not listed or are not very clear on the charges. Also overpriced, I am not going to renew my lease once it is up.
This maintenance crew is better than having your own private plumber, carpenter, electrician and handy man all in one place.  They respond rapidly and do excellent work. We couldn't be happier!

I can’t stress enough how wonderful it was to be here. Wildlife here helps you relax while on your porch, and it’s a quiet community. It is a 5 minute walk from the nearest grocery store and gas station, which I found very convenient. It is also right next to a nature preserve which allowed me to relax even more. The staff were very kind and the maintenance were timely in any circumstance (upstairs had a leak at one point and they fixed it almost immediately after sending in the request). I would love to continue living here if I hadn’t relocated for my career. Thank you so much for having us Caprock!

We relocated to Austin from South Florida last year. We spent a day looking at rental houses only to be turned down because of my big dog. We found Caprock by accident. Christy was (and still is) the most amazing at what she does. She sent us to two other Marquis properties and we ended up back at Caprock. There was just a "vibe" that we couldn't deny. The office treats you like family, not residents. Jesse always has cookies for my pup. The friendly deer were an unexpected surprise. Loved "living" with them.
This is an older property, but very well kept.. I'll be moving  to Austin soon and this property is definitely a contender.

I live in a complex across the street but despite several phone calls and emails from both myself and the management at my complex management is apathetic at best about their residents dogs running about in the street. We consistently come across 3 that are together, another small brown one and have also come across a (friendly) Shepard mix. We have been instructed to take a photo of these dogs off leash when it happens. However that is difficult to do with a 50+ pound dog who is reactive to manage, while these dogs approach most of the time without a owner even in sight.  We have yet to hear back from management themselves and only got this update via our management.

Based on how simple leash laws are enforced- I have some doubts about how effectively management will deal with any potential issues.
The complex is clean and affordable. Maintenance is really quick when I need anything and the people in the office are nice.

The state of the amenities at this apartment complex, including the gym, pool, pool bathrooms, and clubhouse, is consistently filthy, with unclean water and unpleasant odors. 

Upon moving in, the apartment itself was in a disgusting condition, with cat hair and litter on the carpet, a dirty toilet, and even clothes left in the washer and dryer. Despite the attractive pricing, I strongly advise against choosing this complex for your living arrangements.

I have been here for over 3.5 years. I will be moving soon (out of Austin), but I’d like to advise newcomers or anyone examining the reviews that the overall management of this property has really gotten a lot better in the last year. For starters, Ocotillo has the best maintenance manager they have ever had, and just about the best I have seen – Erik. Erik gets things done, he will take care of what ever problem comes up maintenance wise. In addition, the lead office/property manager, Anita is far superior to the past managers (that usually only lasted less than 6 months). Anita has overseen some positive changes around here. Building walkways, and stairs are now power washed, common areas have been better maintained. The operation is running a lot better. I have substantial background in real estate management. I am an investigator for the Texas Real Estate Commission, so I have a deep understanding how these businesses operate. There have been substantial rent increases, as we are seeing all over Austin, so it is what it is. If can afford the rent, you’re going to have a good experience with the staff. I have enjoyed living here.

Where to begin… quality has really gone down. Pool was dirty all summer, clubhouse is neglected and smells. Amenities, opened earlier this year(were closed due to Covid), are terribly taken care of. Dog park gate has been broken and held together with zip ties for almost a year now, water faucet in the park has been dripping just as long. Parking is a nightmare. I’ve been here 2 years and it’s a different team managing the place, definitely gone downhill. They have a valet trash service that you pay for, whether you use it or not, but because of it, the breezeways in the buildings smell awful. Gate at the entrance is broken more often than not.

Ocotillo is a great option for you if you’re looking for a peaceful/secluded area, always helpful and sweet staff, and pet-friendly place to live. I’ve been here about a year and just re-signed for a second one. The manager here, Samantha is an absolute doll and has been a huge factor in my decision to re-sign. She’s helped me in more ways than I could ever list and honestly I’ve never gotten along with another property manager as well as I have with her. The pool is very nice and the fitness center, clubhouse areas, and overall landscape are always well-kept. There are some nice views outside the complex and the inside is updated with modern appliances and nice color schemes. I’ve really enjoyed living here and so has my pup. I highly recommend this complex.
Every since I moved in I have had issues from them giving me a dirty apartment to not honoring what's inthete lease. Management is rude, unorganized and uninformed.

From application to moving in, my experience with Cricket Hollow has been nothing short of fantastic. My meeting with Mayra and Mario made me feel very welcomed to the community. The location is prime with everyday necessities close by, trees and greenery surround the complex giving a tropical/ peaceful feel.  Theres laundry, pools and a gym on site with a park close by. What more do you need? Hossein, a property technician, has been helpful and kind. I feel blessed to call this place home. Thank you Cricket Hollow and staff.

I do not recommend these apartments to live in. Nobody calls on the phone and you go to the office and they do not solve your problems. The people who are in the direction of the office do a very bad job, they send you to call 911 when there are internal problems and that only they can give you a solution

DO NOT MOVE HERE ! Catalytic convertors are being stolen from cars and management refuses to inform anyone or install cameras. It's a $1000 cost so definitely not worth the risk. Also management in general refuses to do any hard work and blames you for "breaking stuff" when in reality it just stops working and sometimes needs repairs.

I have lived at Cricket Hollow for about 2 years and have seen a few management changes, but I can say that the management they have now are on point and always friendly and maintenance requests are answered promptly. It may not have a lot of extras, however if you want something affordable, clean and safe, I recommend them.

Excited that my lease is almost up.
Contacted maintenance on 9/16 to fix a leak that was causing problems. They ended up placing a little piece on the hole. The water has continued to leak and  ruin the carpet. What is more frustrating is that they keep closing my maintenance requests as if they have completed the job. I have continued to request they fix it but the problem remains. It is now 10/30. I'm not sure what further action to take. I have lived here two years. This is how they treat the tenants that live here. Choose somewhere else. Trust me go somewhere else

Staff is all over the place. Didn't get any advanced notice if I qualified for the predicted move in date. Tried calling the day before and no one returned my phone calls. The day of move in, I was not shown my apartment or where any of the amenities were. Guess you get what you pay for!
Water shut off multiple times a month for “maintenance”. Inconsistent hot water. I always have to pray that the hot water is working before showering.

It's poorly managed. People in the office are notoriously hard to reach. They will charge you fees for stuff without notifying you. The laundry room is a disgusting mess.  The water system is constantly breaking. The majority of the summer the pool has been closed. My apartment is constantly falling apart and then when I get stuff fixed eventually the job done is usually shoddy and I end up calling maintenance multiple times. I hate living here and will leave as soon as my lease is up.

This apartment was my nightmare. The management team was extremely disorganized and unhelpful.
1. Lease Start: On the day before my lease began, I was told my apartment was not available, and I couldn't move in. It took eight phone calls to resolve the issue.
2. Move-In Condition: The apartment was in horrible condition—jammed bathroom door, paint on the mirror, broken dishwasher, no washer/dryer, no microwave, damaged walls, no WiFi, broken shower curtain rod, and nearly falling cabinet doors.
3. Hot Water: No hot water for two months with no compensation. When I broke the lease, they demanded a penalty and refused to return my deposit, violating Texas law.
4. Package Theft: Packages were frequently stolen, and the leasing office refused to help secure my deliveries.
5. Maintenance Requests: Maintenance issues can never be resolved. I put a painting working order and waited for three months. They never show up to fix it.
6. Lease documents: You cannot see your lease agreement on the resident portal. I asked them to send me a copy, but I never receive it even after I moved out.
Living here was a constant source of stress and frustration. Avoid this place at all costs!
I recently moved in and the staff was so great to work with. Moving can be stressful and they made it easy and took away the stress of the situation! I’m very thankful to be here

There are hidden fees in the rent. They will quote you on something and you will pay something different every single month. 
They do not come and fix anything, pest control is charged but pest everywhere, and packages are constantly stolen.

I had a rather disappointing experience with this apartment complex, as I felt that they mishandled my application process. Despite paying the application fee, my movement date was delayed and I was subsequently ghosted by management. 

Upon visiting the leasing office in person for an update, I was informed by Jennifer, the manager, that my application had been rejected by management, a piece of information that had not been conveyed to me earlier.

Adding to my frustration, Jennifer proposed an alternate apartment (B2 instead of the anticipated B3) without adjusting the price accordingly. Moreover, her promise to send over the new lease agreement for this substitute apartment via email was never fulfilled.

In light of my experience, I would caution potential tenants about the potential for inefficiency and miscommunication that I encountered here. The management seemed evasive, which resulted in three weeks of wasted time. Moreover, once you do secure a lease, be prepared for additional monthly amenity fees. In my opinion, you could find better value for your money, along with a higher quality of apartment, elsewhere.

I’m currently aparment searching and Wolfdji has been very helpful taking me to both Patten East and West so that I could get a good feel for the place! The renovated units all feel very spacious and it seems like a very pleasant place to live!

Oh let me count the ways...
- Suprise water outages MULTIPLE times a month. Sometimes announced, sometimes not. 
- Currently have been waiting 20 days (and counting...) to have a maintenance request fulfilled for a toilet issue.
- Of the 14 machines in the gym maybe 5 work. The free-weight situation is insulting
- The gym never has wipes to clean the machines or toilet paper, or soap - STEER CLEAR
- The Smart locks are a pain and a hazard
- No one answers the office phone, EVER! Could not imagine what I would do if I was unable to walk across the street to the new front office anytime I needed to speak to someone...which is often.
-  There's no customer service etiquette in the front office. Do not expect ANY sense of urgency when it comes to anything besides getting a lease signed. There is no management-level oversight whatsoever

Overall, The Patten East is a waste of money. Save yourself the headache and rent somewhere else

I do not recommend this place, at first glance it seems nice and safe but in the 14 months that I lived there I only heard complaints from my neighbors because their things were stolen, the glass of my car was broken, and the office staff sent alert emails saying don't go for a walk at night, it's really not a safe place.

Every place is going to have it's ups and downs. This was my first apartment when I moved to Austin, it served it's purpose but there was no way I was renewing my lease.

PROS:
Patten East is only one exit from downtown with convenient access to the highway and major roadways. The neighborhood is alright but you can expect some disturbances and crime (see cons). Salt water pool is really nice (but really small), large dog park, small gym but with decent equipment.

CONS: 
The "legacy" apartments have appliances from the 1980's and wood veneer cabinets that were peeling. The floors were severely bowed, and the staircase outside leading up to the apartment was coming off the side of the building. The community internet was spotty and cost $60 a month and I ended up having to purchase a separate internet connection (note they do not have access to AT&T or Google Fiber here). There were water shutoffs almost monthly to fix broken pipes and boilers, the Amazon Hub locker would be out of service regularly. Had my car broken into twice in the parking lot. Someone was also robbed at gun point in the parking lot. The affordable housing across the street is full of trash, they are loud, throw trash all over the street, and will try to sell you drugs while you walk your dog. They raised the rent more than 20% when my lease was up and I was able to find multiple places with bigger and nicer units for that price. Rent is determined by the length of the lease you sign. Going month to month would have been a more than 50% increase in rent (there are plenty of places where the rent is the same regardless of the length of your lease). They also charged me for extra days when I moved out and I had to work with the property management company to get those charges removed even though i had paperwork showing i turned in the keys 2 days prior to my lease ending. The office staff are useless at best. 

In summary you can find much nicer places for what they charge.

When I was apartment hunting, I saw reviews of several other properties cautioning against Roscoe Property Management and I was careful to choose a place that was not run by them. But just a few months after living here, Roscoe Property Management bought the property and it’s been downhill ever since. 

First and most importantly, the showers don’t work properly! The temperature randomly shifts to way too hot, to way too cold throughout the shower. I spend half of my time in the shower hiding behind the curtain until the temperature is within a range that won’t scald me. At this point I’ve been trying to get them to fix it for an entire year, but they are at the point where every time I call, they pretend they never heard about it before, tell me they’ll call me back or schedule a plumber, and then I’ll never hear from them again until I follow up. They say that it’s a long-term problem that effects many units in the complex and that it’s just “how it is.” They offered to move me to another unit but that’s an absurd solution if they can’t guarantee the shower in the next unit isn’t broken too. 

On top of that, they tried raising my rent on my second year even though they reduced the cost of similar units for new tenants. I managed to keep my previous rate but I still pay about $1400 more per year for similar un-renovated units with the same floor plan, AND they raised several fees too. 

Oh and on top of that, during the snow storm, they had someone come sand the area in front of the office but didn’t do anything to clear the parking lots, walkways or stairs for the residents. And every Tuesday at 8:30am the lawn care guys come by with their leaf blowers because they treat this like a business and not a residence. 

So if you want to live somewhere that the showers don’t work properly, where the staff ignores you, where you’ll get your rent and fees increased every year, and where you can’t sleep in on Tuesdays, this is the place for you! But they have a corn hole setup now so that’s great!
Excellent facility that caters to the business oriented ,notary and WiFi, with cable added amenities. Awesome!!!!!! Includes some units with washer and dryer.

This used to be a fantastic community. However, under new management, specifically Samantha, the "assistant," it's a completely unprofessional and inconvenient place to live.
Do yourselves a favor and rent elsewhere -- unless of course, you enjoy being laughed at by the office staff and forced into paying late fees because you're unable to pay rent due to the community's refusal to accept payments.
I'm currently having to work with Hawthorne Residential Partners to get anything resolved.

I will agree with most of the reviews expect the review about bugs and coos! I have lived here almost 3 years and never saw a roach(perhaps they should be cleaner). The water shut is very annoying however, it must be fixed! As far as cops? I find cops a comfort but saying that, I can count on one hand the amount of times I have seen them since I have been here! Office staff is great and so are the maintenance guys! Like anything rent is rising so I may have to leave and move north!

I've lived at Hawthorne at the District for almost 4 years. The rent has remained relatively low compared to other rent prices in Austin. The neighborhood is comprised mainly of other apartment complexes, so it's not the most exciting area, but it's quiet and mostly made up of families and students.

The amenities are nice. There is a small saltwater pool, a great fitness center, and a brand new community grill and patio area. The complex is also very dog friendly and contains a small dog park. The residents are somewhat lax about picking up after their dogs, and there is one a-hole cat I have to deal with. But as a dog owner, I appreciate the management's welcoming attitude toward pets.

The only recurring problem I've had has been with the water system. Over the course of the first two years there were numerous underground pipe problems, causing the water to be shut off for a day or so every few weeks. I believe they've done a lot of repairs, so the situation is improving. General maintenance is responsive and helpful. 

The 2 bed/2 bath I'm in has a somewhat strange layout. There is one full bathroom, and another in the master bedroom. The bathroom in the master has a full bathtub and toilet, but the sink is located outside of the main bathroom. The kitchen is tiny, with old appliances. 

Overall, in my experience I have no real complaints, but I'm not about to write a love ballad about the place either.

DO NOT LIVE HERE! This apartment complex has to be the worst in Austin. First off, I lived in a 2 bedroom apartment where my bedroom would flood every time it rained. I'd have to use my bath towels to try and soak up the water until maintenance would come (2-3 days later). They told me they didn't know where the water came from (because I had already cleaned it up and it had been days). It took them ~ 3 months to come out and "try" to solve it. Every other day I had to go to the leasing office to try and get them to do something about it. No matter what, nothing was fixed. 4 months later they put us in a new unit in the back of the complex with the homeless.
Homeless camps are right behind our building and you can see them, hear them argue, and their dogs bark all night long.

Unfortunately, they "can't" do anything about it. Cars getting broken into often and the homeless will knock on your doors.

Also, do not sign up for covered parking. They make you pay this $50/month fee until the end of your lease, although you don't sign any paperwork to get the spot (they don´t tell you this). I'm no longer in need of the spot since I bought a house, but they're forcing me to pay the fee as they automatically tacked it onto my lease.

You also have to pay for trash pick-up, even if you don't use it, which is terrible. I'm a 45sec walk from the dumpster and take it myself, but still have to pay the fee. They should get with the times and only have people pay who are using the service.
Another drawback is when paying your rent online (app), you have to pay a fee (you're paying the apartment's fee for them to have the app).

Please avoid this place at all costs. The rent may look good, but this place is disgusting. If you do sign, your rent will go up ~$500 each renewal. Your appliances will constantly break and the water gets turned off at least 2x/month. People had to go to the Gold's Gym and LA Fitness close by to shower because they said someone hit the main water line.

Also, should you end your lease, they charge you $250 to not renew. If you find a roommate to replace your unit, you’ll be charged $500 for “they’re damages of finding a replacement”.
You've been warned!

Poorly managed, property seems nice until you look closely and see things are not properly maintained. It’s a great location but management makes changes to save money regardless of if it’s inconvenient for renters. Only positive is the front pool which is frequently closed

As a resident you are now required to register each time you have guest.  They are allotted 6 free day passes until they have to pay to park with one guest pass per resident. Avoid this complex like the plague if you ever plan on having family or friends over.

The property and location are okay for the price, but the recent rent hikes are outrageous!  I've been here two years and my rent has hiked  $500+.  There are such few amenities for the amount we pay to live here and the security is terrible.  LOTS of homeless as well. There's a camp behind the Greenbelt that's hosting a large group.  This is making the "trails" they advertise false.

Location is great, apartments quite old, same as appliances. Expect to see cockroaches all the time. Make sure to see the unit days prior to moving in, as if not you’ll find it poorly cleaned up and probably painted; we received a unit with all the construction remains on the patio as the odor of the paint so strong that had to go to a hotel while it cleared. They won’t offer any help or apologies, but they will make sure to make you pay for everything.
We gave our leave notice 3 days prior to the 60 days’ notice, so they charged for the three days. No reason would work, so we agreed. We handed over the keys 19 days prior to the original lease end date, as told, we paid for the extra 3 days late notice. Here comes the ugly part; they again discounted us the 3 days from the deposit.
Make sure to give your notice on time, if you don’t, expect to be charged twice, and if you wrote to them, expect to be gaslighted by them. Sure, you’ll have from time-to-time snacks and wine, but for the moment one paid, the complex should be offering better amenities, service, appliances, etc…

Solid place to live. Been here for just over 5 years and have had very few issues. One of the few issues I've had were a few instances of A/C and water heater in the apartment above mine leaking, but management and maintenance have been on point in getting the issues fixed ASAP. My compliments to managememt as well for giving me a little extra time on my lease for moving out due to a construction delay. My biggest issue has been security. Being located near a few overpasses, homeless will occasionally set up camps, and that leads to dumpster diving and theft. Had my license plate stolen twice, so keep an eye on yours if you get a place here. Also, be sure to take advantage of the Fetch Package service for package delivery to avoid theft. Other than those issues, this place has been great in general. Only reason I'm moving out is increased rent prices and finding a cheaper place with a detached garage.

Management is aggressive, apartments say renovated its just paint. BUGS. The pool is concreted and mailboxes are constantly broken into new Management in 2023. Not worth the money period. Dont listen to any good old reviews.

You have to ask multiple times to get any sort of maintenance done and it takes months to get anyone to come in and “fix” things. Non-existent leasing personnel except for maybe a random 10 minutes a day. If I can find someone to help me get out of my lease I will be doing so because this place is a waste of money.

Best decision I could have made to move on to this property! Office staff is professional courteous and very friendly. Every issue I have had has been resolved quickly by their super friendly, professional, and knowledgeable support staff. The maintenance Duo are second to none! Well done gentlemen. The community is well-kept, clean quiet and has a small family feel. It is pet friendly and I can't wait to one day purchase my own puppy!

They just raised my rent $200.00 to match their new rates. I have been here for years. I couldn't figure out where the extra value of this apartment was coming from.  There is more crime. Cops are here all the time.  The new management seems rude and insensitive.  Nothing in my apartment has been fixed. They say there is a security guard who is non-existent. There is a HUGE water tank in the middle of the apartments surrounded by a chain link fence.  They placed signs for free Wi-Fi but had to remove them because it didn't exist. The walkway near the fence in the back is dangerous. The dog park is a wood chipped covered gated area with a bar-b-que pit. Most the outlets inside my home don't work and I have to do the filter myself.  Ceiling fans are falling.  Light fixture covers are missing.  I have stayed because it was a safe place and more convenient than leaving. Now I can't afford to stay. AND they haven't given a reason to.  The upgrades have nothing to do with current tenants and I haven't been given one upgrade to my apartment since I have been there. If you are going to increase over and over again, give a reason it's worth it...other than terracotta color paint job on the outside.

I moved here a couple of months ago and I love the look of everything. My apartment is beautiful and the rent is pretty reasonable for me. I have new everything and I am completely happy. I give it 4 stars because I really wanted a first floor but I could only have a second floor. :(

After reading other reviews it would seem I was treated the same. They have a creepy manager named Michael that always hits on you and asks if you want to go jogging with him. The even weirder part is he lives in the apartments. I come home to take care of my pets and my apartment smells like pot. I have complained many times about the neighbors and nothing has been done. I thought there was no smoking aloud ???. After one month of living there I couldn't stand it and they agreed to move me to another building. I no longer have to smell pot anymore but now I have to deal with bugs and fleas. It seems the area is really bad with fleas. I walk my pets around and in the field next door and now there are so many when I come home they are jumping on me and biting my legs. On top of all that good luck finding a parking spot if you get off at 6. There are no places to park ever and people always backing into your car and banging there car doors on yours because its a tight fit. For what you pay its not worth it and they do spend peoples security deposits on renovations. When you try to leave they make up anything to keep your money.

I’ve had an amazing experience at Museo! The community is beautiful with lush trees and has great access to nature trails. My praises are for the the office staff, With my many questions throughout my stay they have been patient, kind, and super helpful. I highly recommend Museo, I promise you’ll love it just as much as I do.

I’ve been with Museo for 3 years now, and the overall experience has been great! The community is beautiful, and is the primary reason I moved here. The trees and the trails make it a fantastic place to live in. The apartments look great, and love having washer/ dryer included! Thank you Museo Management & Maintenance team for taking pride in the community, it truly shows.

I've lived here for 2 years and will stay as long as the rent remains reasonable (so far, modest increases each year). Lots of windows letting in natural light and overlooking Great Hills greenbelt (bonus: easy access to walking in nature) provides the balance I need since working from home. Occasional maintenance issues have been addressed more satisfactorily over the last year, and the current manager responds quickly to any communications. Pre-COVID, management was planning monthly social opportunities; hopefully, that resumes eventually.

Museo is a hidden gem! I moved in here recently and I'm very happy with it. It's a quiet, peaceful community with beautiful trees throughout. The apartments are clean and well kept. Great location! The management has been very friendly and helpful. Neighbors are nice and it's pet friendly. It feels more like a condo community vs. a rental community. Very happy here.

1- I have called every day for a week and no one has ever picked up. When I drove to the office, there were 2 employees in there by themselves and no other people. Why they couldn’t answer the phone or return a call from the day before is beyond me. 
2- the quality of the apartment I was shown was not what I walked into, and management conveniently pulls a disappearing act.
3- the apt was dirty when I moved in, and I mean crumbs, hair, Bobby pins, and dead bugs in the drawers and tub (well the drawers that would open).
4- apparently they expect you to buy lightbulbs when you move in because they aren’t going to make sure the lights are working when you move in

There are many more issues in the ONE WEEK that I have been here but the management seems to not care. DON’T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY AT THE CRAPSHOOT!

This isn't the worst apartment I've had the displeasure of living in but it's close. I went to view the apartment, they showed me a model apartment instead as they needed to get my unit clean and ready for move-in. Except when I moved in the carpet was stained and dirty, the blinds had some kind of grease on them, and the bathroom floor still had hair from the previous tenants all along the baseboards. It smelled like wet dog in there so I'm hoping that was all just from a pet... Oh and did I mention the orange mystery substance in between the tiles in the shower?? The front door's deadbolt was difficult to lock and unlock, and eventually fell apart. This was the only time management responded quickly and appropriately to a maintenance request. Half the drawers in the kitchen were broken and unusable as well as a few cabinets, and there was serious water damage under the sink making the cabinet cave in (they painted over everything down there - the cabinet, the pipes, the hoses, the garbage disposal). The stove was fine but the oven had tons of burnt on food that I had to spend hours scraping out myself. There were always cockroaches and spiders abound even though I kept my unit VERY clean - management sent out an "exterminator" that just sprayed raid around the place and called it a day. This didn't work. When my AC broke in the middle of summer, they took a whole month to get around to fixing it, telling me they would be by on x day and then not showing up or giving me a call even though I had to take off work or spend my day off waiting around for them to show up. The walls are paper thin and you can hear the neighbors when they're watching TV or drunk and having a loud party.
