I will part from this gem when I start looking for a home.

First off, parking is horrible. You see your rent? Now make sure you add a necessary extra $30 on top of that for covered parking because if you’re not home by 6pm you will not be able to find ANY free parking. If you work late at night, STAY AWAY or else you’ll have to wait until someone leaves or else you have a chance of getting towed because you aren’t paying that “optional” $30 if you’re forced to park in covered parking. 

Second off, management team is horrible. They’re rude, stand off-ish and have no basic human empathy. They’ll have the audacity to give you an apartment that has a broken outlet, several dead lightbulbs, and missing light fixtures and unpainted walls and stained carpet and tell you that it’s “move-in ready!” You know the quiet hours that they highlight in the lease? Saying you can’t move in past a certain time? Reasonable right? People need their sleep. Good. Wrong! Even though they highlight “quiet hours” in the lease you have a chance of getting complaints at ALL hours of the day and if they favor that person who’s complaining more than you, you have a good chance of receiving a lease violation even though you were just building some furniture for your new apartment at 2pm or playing with your dog at 5pm. Quiet hours are ALL hours here, which is fine but don’t tell us that they start at 10pm if that’s the case. Forget the people who live above us that scream and have parties until 3AM! Lets threaten to evict the people who were playing with their puppy at 5pm if they get 2 more complaints from the intolerant neighbor downstairs. I think people forget that in an apartment complex, noise is going to happen, ESPECIALLY if you live on the bottom floor. 

The only redeeming quality about this place is their maintenance team. They’re FRIENDLY and prompt unlike the rest of the people who just sit in an office all day and give you judgmental stares whenever you walk into the office. If you don’t have tenure and haven’t lived here for 10 years your quality of living doesn’t mean anything to them.
Beautiful property over all, parking sucks. Grounds keeper lady does extremely well keeping up with the property.
I would not recommend moving here to my friends and have advised them to avoid it.

Keep in mind that if you rent here, they will try and raise your rent ~$100 every year and are not open to any kind of rent negotiations unless you agree to a ridiculous 15-month lease.

I rented a renovated apartment here where all of the appliances were supposed to be new, however, I doubt it as almost every appliance has had issues multiple times this year right after being "renovated".

Our "new" floor also came with deep scratches on it.

The apartment also had significant damage to the molding and the entire time we've lived here one of the bathroom lights hasn't worked and we've made several maintenance requests about it. Maintenance just tells us that it can't be fixed because of the faulty electricity lines.

We're missing a light in our kitchen due to the same issue, according to them, there isn't enough power to connect all of the lights in our apartment.

Our dimmers don't dim, they just flicker on lower settings.

Our paint has been falling off the walls and doors since we moved in, leaving specs of paint all over the vinyl floor.

On top of that, our sliding glass door was broken for months without getting fixed when we first moved in. They had to hire a third-party contractor that then damaged our floor while fixing it.

The apartment also only has cameras inside their common area, not looking over the pool or grill areas. This last year my neighbors had to move because there was a person stalking people at night in the apartment complex with a baseball bat near the pool threatening to kill them.

Thankfully after speaking with the staff, he has since moved.

The staff I spoke with when the incident happened said they would look into getting new cameras, but after speaking with the new staff recently, there are NO plans to upgrade the camera system.
My refrigerator was not cooling. Within hours frigerator fixed and 200$ with of meat saved. I appreciate the quick response of maintainence, plus the experience. Also great clubhouse and pool.

I've lived here for over 5 years. Rent has gone up every single year, But for new residents it's way cheaper then someone who has never missed a payment and loyal to the community. Doesn't make an sense.
Open, airy unit, quality appliances, responsive staff, and convenient location.  Overall experience is excellent!
Very helpful and Friendly staff, Sabrina helped me a lot and made everything much easier!

Gates are always open.. no security. 
I live in building 7 and stairs are always dirty
Stairs dont have light. 
Elevator has stopped working 4times in my stay here for 1.8 years!
Excellent living experience. Very clean and quiet. Feels like a luxury hotel but also a great place to call home!

I hate to leave a poor review but from day one problems with the unit, complex, and management have been non-stop.

1. To start, the maintenance team has been great. Unfortunately many of the 5-star reviews are a result of the maintenance people coercing good reviews out of tenants under the guise of helping them keep their jobs. This is deceptive to future tenants and shady business practice.

2. The unit we moved into had been vacant for at least a month before we moved in. Despite this, no maintenance/cleaning had been performed on the unit and we were welcomed to water damage, cracks in the walls, broken shelves, and a dusty dirty apartment. The dryer, refrigerator, garbage disposal, and toilets all had damage prior to moving in.

3. The pool is gorgeous and was a big draw for us moving here. Unfortunately it is closed without warning during the summer for days on end. It would be greatly appreciated if advanced notice could be given even if a possible reopen date is not yet known.

4. Most concerningly, the air filters in the unit had not been changed in 4 YEARS. This led to many of the vents being covered with dust, mildew, and mold. If you live here please check your vents as prolonged exposure can be hazardous.

we have been living here for a year and we recently moved to a bigger apartment here in the complex, and we really love our new an our old apartment. its a good location, safe and secure.
The staff is the best part here, they are really nice, responsible and very quick to solve any issue you might have to deal with it. they also have an emergency after hours line, submit maintenance request and the ability to text to the office.
The neighborhood is algo well maintained and there are sidewalks with poop bag dispensers throughout the whole neighborhood.
Tramor at Cannon Place is a huge bang for your buck - comfortable, safe, kind and reliable staff who are truly dedicated to making this an enjoyable place to live

Took my deposite, ran multiple credit checks, for 3 weeks told me I was eligible and it wasn't until 3 days after the move in date we agreed on that they told me they couldn't give me the apartment. They are very unprofessional, they wasted 3 weeks of my time going back and forth. Very rude people, and won't answer calls or respond back to unless you physically go in person.

The community is not kept up very well. Slow response to apartment problems and quite run down. It is also a place where you see a lot of Uhaul trucks everyday with people leaving left and right. I would not recommend this or any other Tramor property.

Our lease expired on 12/31/2021.  Our new place couldn’t let us in until January 6th.  Carter, my husband, asked Michael at one of the open jams in November if it would be okay for us to prorate the first week of January so we wouldn’t be homeless for a week.  He said yes.  When it came time to submit our notice to vacate, Michael insisted he never said we could have the prorated week and told us we had to pay the full month of January for those 6 days.  Okay, not a problem, we will just move out on our original end of lease date 12/31/2021 and stay with some friends for a week.  

We get to 12/30/2021 and are packing up the moving truck.  Carter gets a call at 4:45pm informing us that we are being fined for not turning the keys in that day as the office was going to be closed on 12/31.  Now we had NO idea that this was the case as we had never been spoken to about turning our keys in early.  Carter asked if we were going to be reimbursed for 12/31 as we technically still had one more day on the lease that they were trying to take away from us.  At that point they backed down and said we could just leave the keys in the kitchen drawer on 12/31/2021.  Not a problem.  

Where it gets really interesting is that I got a notification that we had been charged (payments were set up for automatic withdrawal) for January 2022 rent despite our lease ending on 12/31/2021.  As the office was closed until Tuesday, I waited until then to reach out to management.  There were many back and forth emails in which Michael completely ignored my issue and went on and on about the deposit.  I reiterated this had nothing to do with the deposit and that they had charged us for rent after our lease had ended.  After many emails I was told that there was nothing they could do and to reach out to my bank to reverse the charge. 

We had a wonderful experience with previous management and all of the front office people until this last month when new management took over.  It is very sad to see one person trying to destroy what was a great community and place to live.

The best 3 years of my life. Had so much fun living here, the community is awesome and you're so close to everything.  This is the coolest place to live in Austin and still a great value when most places are skyrocketing.  I really don't have a complaint, but will point out that if you aren't looking for an active party lifestyle this probably isn't for you.  Mostly bands live there and there is a lot of noise but in my experience neighbors were always respectful.

The Metropolis Apartments. It's a place that doesn't kill that screaming artist's voice inside of you after you become an adult. A place where special noise ordinances are in place to encourage the birth of a new guitar-riff most hours of the day. A place where three or more hot colors cake each building in a unique way (Google Earth it...Seriously). Truly a staple of the Austinite in the know. A place close enough to the heart of the live music capitol of the world, that a short walk (year round) could get you to a stage. A place that amplifies that different beat that's been pounding in your heart since you were old enough to dream. I have screamed, rocked, painted, photographed and filmed this place for almost six years now. Not a bad place for a Iowa farm boy to have landed.

You get what you pay for, like the other reviewer says. The rent is very reasonable for the central location near N Lamar and nearby shops/medical facilities. The interior is fairly dated but recently renovated. If you live on the first floor, you may see some pests as per usual. Maintenance is usually very prompt. Management is alright. Updated laundry room. I would say its best for recent graduates or college students.

Thin walls, no parking spots after about 8pm, outadated appliabces and fixtures, interesting neighbors/visitors wandering from nearby hospital, expensive pet fees ($600 per pet),and awful management - get ready to fight with landlord for anything and everything. 

Pros: Good location, affordableish rent. 

Good luck!

The buildings are older, but well maintained.  The complex has a 70's motel vibe with a kidney shaped pool.
The apartment  itself is very basic but for the price in the area is a great deal. Apartments do not have washer/dryer hookups but there is a small laundrette on premises that is sufficient.
I personally have had few issues that needed attention. When I did place a maintenance request, the property manager was quick to take care of the issue.
The surrounding neighborhood is nice and quiet and has a great park.
These apartments are perfectly located within walking distance of great restaurants and upscale shopping. 
Downtown Austin is just 10 minutes away and there is always something fun to experience.

Very stressful living experience, gates were always broken, homeless always digging in the dumpster. I had my car broken into, the front office never responded to emails it got so much worse when new management took over. I just felt unsafe the whole time living there with little to no communication from management.

this place stinks, my wife and I wanted to like it but the roaches are all over building 14 do not live in this one. The dwello hub never worked since we moved in, the gates are always broken and anyone can get in, they closed the mailroom for packages because so many got stolen, now good luck getting a package you have to go through fetch and they stole my Garmin watch. The pool gates are open to anyone ao go ahead in from the side gate just pull the lever up! I pay for this monthly too.. the my q gate system never works, office people keep switching and don’t know which darn end is up! Homeless problem at the pool bathroom. Few months back. My garage rent keeps going up and there have been numerous garage break ins. All in all it sucks and you should avoid !

Do not lease here.  Nothing but trouble.   
They let us move into a dirty apartment.  Dog hair everywhere.  Blinds chewed up.   Nothing worked.

The staff at Terra was very friendly and they have beautiful apartments! I really appreciate the large square footage and open floor plan that my 1bd has, as well as the walking trails! This community has been very friendly and I feel very safe living here.
The team at Terra is always friendly and deals with maintenance requests promptly! I love living here!
Terra is a beautiful property with great amenities and a hilltop view.
I moved back in after trying a different place for 1 year. I really do like my apartment.  This place has always been good to me.  The move in process is smooth.  I've had no issues so far.
Very poor maintenance, lots of bugs,old appliances with frequent maintenance.

I lived here for a year and it was probably one of the most frustrating years I’ve had in a while. I lived in the apartment with mold on my ceiling, when I told the office(on multiple occasions) they laughed it off and ignored my concern each time. Finally 4 months after first reporting it then they fixed it. There was a leak in the ceiling and it was routed to the fireplace and the storage closet. They never truly resolved the leak in the roof either.
Very good place to live. The interior is nice, slightly out of date, grounds are very nice. Perfect place for a dog.

Shadow Oaks was my first apartment after college. It was the only place I could find that was in my budget and was in a clean and safe neighborhood. The office staff was always very helpful and maintenance was always done quickly. The apartments are a bit older but still clean and kept in good condition. There's a huge open dog park as well and the pool area is great for lounging!

Overall, this is a great place for the cost of rent and its close proximity to the city.

I've lived here going on 4 years now. It's perfect for me because I'm in-office 2 days a week and at home the other three.  I've never lost connectivity during a meeting. This area of Lamar has a ton of places to walk to. Probably the biggest plus is some really cool people work here. For example, Amir in maintenance who came to my apartment (in his dress clothes, and on his day off) to repair my plumbing.
Very old and dated, very expensive, gross buildings!

When I signed up, my leasing consultant was very seasoned and helpful. The property has doorbells and a great view of Austin skyline, which are 2 reasons I chose it. However, my apt location was occupied so I could not see it. That was a mistake. Between the time I applied and moved in, they changed property management companies and the difference in service and staff is night and day. Not in a good way. My apt was filthy, the cold and hot water for washer connections were opposite, there was a pest problem that persists, months after moving in maintenance has not fixed the items on the punch list, and when I ask the brand  new office staff for an update on service requests, they say the AC problems are the priority. But 3 months after move in? It’s because they are too cheap to hire enough maintenance staff to handle the volume of issues, and also none of the staff know what they are doing. The constant AC issues go back to poor quality of appliances and upkeep backlog. The maintenance lead is very good but there is only 1 of him. Not enough to help with all. Telling me that someone is sick is not the same as foxing the issues so I can settle in without the risk of cockroaches or other critters in my kitchen. Also, they do not have a courtesy officer, and ask you to call 311 to report noise issues. They also don’t tell you that the package lockers are an additional fee, paid to a 3rd party, but Amazon and the other carriers all will put your packages in there, forcing you to pay this hidden fee instead of delivery to your door even if you specify this on your directions or call Amazon customer service. And, there’s significant noise that starts 6 am every day from construction Next door, and trains that run all night. I knew there would be some noise, but not to this degree, and no you don’t get used to it! It’s a really bad apartment experience, full of frustrations, and I would not recommend anyone move here.

The team here has always been so responsive. When you have an emergency, you can count on maintenance ver quickly.
Good walkable area but be aware of the apartments by the train tracks and the trash pickup, which is at 5 a.m., because there is alot of noise pollution. Great balconies for people watching though, especially the intoxicated people leaving Gibson Street Bar- who take up alot of the street parking at night. Overall, great apartment with minimal cons.
Apartment operates very smoothly. Maintenance requests are taken care of extremely fast. Great restaurants only a few feet away.
The place has potential but they need to focus more on maintenance issues and the quality of appliances in the units.
Building should be condemned! This place is mouse infested and when you put in a maintenance request they do absolutely nothing about it.

Have had random people walking into the property with no locks or cameras on the outer doors. No lights in the parking areas. And water shut offs multiple times a month with horrible communication. DO NOT LIVE HERE

Wow... By far without question the most ghetto apartments in all of Austin.

1. The mailboxes don't lock. Your mail can, and will, be stolen. I've already lost a medical record from Veteran Affairs.

2. The entire complex smells like dog crap because NOBODY picks up their dog crap. There are hundreds, and I do mean hundreds, of piles of dog crap in ANY of the grass.

3. I was lied to about having a washing/dryer in my unit. She told me "It's a european unit so we're taking it out". ...How is that true when we have US outlets in the wall? There never was a W/D. There is a laundromat, NOT A LAUNDRY ROOM, downstairs. It costs FOUR F***ING DOLLARS PER LOAD OF LAUNDRY. Expect your rent to be +$100-160 of what they claim off this alone. I'm so mad that she lied. It would be one thing if she straight up told me, but no. She lied to my face.

4. Dust & Dirt... everywhere. The complex hasn't been cleaned in YEARS. The walls are completely coated in years of dust. Absolutely... everywhere... The really nasty part are the screens on the windows. They have SO MUCH dirt on them that you can't even see outside the windows. All the pictures from the apartments have the screens taken off so you can't see how dirty the windows are. They truly haven't been cleaned in years. I know, because I had to take mine off to clean the windows.

5. The doors don't seal. You will get a really bad draft & have to run the AC 24/7. Roaches will come in through that huge crack under the door.

6. Aggressive dogs running loose. I've already had to mace one dog that ran up on me. Very few people keep their dogs on leash.

7. Front office completely disappeared once I signed the lease.

8. The cost of living here along with laundry & all the other problems, you're seriously better off just paying another +$100 a month to get a unit with a washer/dryer.

9. There's a real-deal meth head living at the end of the complex standing in front of his unit 8-14 hours a day. It's crazy. Always standing there, pacing back & forth, with the door open.

The only thing this place has going for it is the units are updated, but they've been updated in the crappy landlord fashion, where they bought new stuff but put in with absolute minimal effort.

I have no idea who wrote the two reviews below. I've lived here for two years and while the property/location is nice, the property management is the WORST. There have been multiple thefts but for some reason they keep the gates open or don't fix them when they break. I live in one of the renovated units and everything is so messed up. The door doesn't open all the way because the floor is so slanted in my unit. Recently the door sweep broke off and the gap between the door and floor was so huge that you could clearly see outside with the door shut. There are massive cracks on 4 of the interior walls where the apartment is sinking and I constantly worry about having the unit collapse on me. Now the bathroom and closet doors won't shut property because the property is literally shifting and no one cares about any of it. When I asked to get security footage of the second theft I was left hanging because of confusion on their end on whether or not I had already gotten it... why wouldn't they follow through instead of just not returning my calls? I can't get anyone to come fix anything and the "renovations" here are just temporary fixes that fall apart quickly. Ive had rats, roaches and black mold. After submitting a few final requests last week and being completely ignored FOR A WEEK I came to write this review- I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

This is the first time in 10 years that I have had great landlords. They are hard to come by and so are reasonable prices at great locations. I highly recommend living here or at least checking it out. Great for first time Austinites especially if you are looking for a great location that has everything nearby!

I really love this apartment. The people are very friendly and the renovations look great. Nice location and the courtyard is really cute. The new management is very attentive and helpful. Would definitely recommend living here!

This place used to be owned and managed by gables until it was acquired by Cardone Capital. Greedy slumlords. This is an older property. When things break, they get rid of it instead of fixing it. The fire safety doors to breezeway in our building broke, they just shut it off instead of fixing it. Not a drop of care for residents safety. Past 4 years, the water feature at the pool wasn’t functioning. No attempt at fixing. First they let it turn into mosquito breeding ground then drained it after it smells horrid. The pool doesn’t have proper filtration and never adequately sanitized with chemicals. If you complain, they retaliate by trying to remove the residents. When the sprinkles broke, they just let the grass die and now it’s either mulch or little river rocks everywhere. When you put a maintenance request, nothing happens. Only times my maintenance requests were done were the times I had to physically go to office and complain. The gate is often broken. Too many car break ins. Few weeks ago, the car thieves were even armed and shot at a resident. Luckily he wasn’t harmed. I can give you a long list of negatives. The property itself is beautiful but old and need a much better management and more caring owner.

I've submitted multiple specific requests through apartments.com and directly via e-mail. The only responses I have received are obviously generated by AI and do not answer my questions or provide me with the information i need. The management company obviously places zero value on the time of prospective tenants. 0/5.

I fell for the beautiful views this apartment has to offer. What a mistake. For 3 years, my experience only got progressively worse. I dealt with one of the rudest and most unresponsive property mgmt. teams ever, bugs, leaks, mold as a result of leaks, charges for amenities that weren't available half the time... Cars were constantly getting broken into and packages were constantly getting stolen. To give you an example of what it's like living here, I submitted 6 service requests in the past 9 months for leaks coming through the ceiling in my bathroom and the issue was still not fixed when I moved out this month (I have this all documented). The previous tenant in my unit contacted me after getting sick due to exposure to mold that they believe was in the apartment. I recently had an environmental professional come in to conduct a test and confirmed there are harmful types of mold in the unit (also documented). Since moving out, I received a list of arbitrary charges for damage that was never identified or documented during our final walkthrough with the property manager. Oh yeah, they showed up to the final walkthrough 45-minutes late and never seemed to intend on actually coming when we called them to see if they were still coming. I'm not really sure where Amber and the rest of the property mgmt. team get off treating people the way they do. They give you the worst attitude every time you bring any issue to them and are only kind when they're in front of prospective tenants. This place is a scam full of literal and figurative scum. I beg you, don't give them a penny. Living in Satan's inferno would be better than this place. Don't believe me? Check out some of the horror stories on yelp. Can't wait to see if I get a canned response like some of the other reviews I've seen.

I called to ask two questions - when renovations were completed and if there was carpet in bedrooms because I have severe allergies. I was trying to ask my question and the leasing agent interrupted me mid-sentence demanding to know who she was talking to. I was shocked and didn't know what to say (yes I could have said my name but she was so rude). I mumbled, "I wanted to know about flooring but nevermind..." and as I was still talking she hung up on me. One minute later I get a phone call from someone different saying they had a missed call from my number (hmm). She was much nicer, I asked my question but it left me almost in tears.

Living in this apartment complex has been a terrible experience. While the view is nice, it's the only positive aspect of living here. Packages are frequently lost or stolen, and the gate was not fixed until recently. The grounds are never maintained and there's dog poop everywhere. Maintenance requests take an unreasonable amount of time to be addressed.

To make matters worse, vehicles are broken into or vandalized nearly every other day. I myself fell victim to this when I discovered that my car had been vandalized with slashed tires while it was parked in the designated parking area. Despite immediately reporting the incident and requesting assistance, the management showed no concern whatsoever. It's important for others to know that there may be people roaming the complex at night checking for unlocked cars.

I finally moved out of this poorly managed property and was able to receive my security deposit refund. However, the management also sent me a 1099 tax form indicating that I have to pay the tax for the refund, which is incorrect. Despite my efforts to contact them since February, the management has not taken any action to address the situation and has only told me to wait. The lack of concern and support from the management has caused me significant stress and inconvenience. 

I recommend others to read more views before living in this apartment complex and be aware of the numerous issues that come with it.

The view is the only positive thing you will get out of living here. Apparently there was a management change and the problem hasn’t changed. Lack of communication, promises to reach out and provide service with no actual action, broken appliances they refuse to address even after putting in work orders, and horrible bug infestations even with exterminator services.

Worst apartment you can live in. package lost left and right while taking fee of 20dollars, gate was never fixed until recently. Car break in every other day. Doggy bags are never refilled and we have to pay pet rents. Dog poop everywhere and never maintained. maintenance never comes in reasonable time. Not recommended.

Terrible. Hidden fees, security gate that hasn’t worked a single day which has led to at least 1X/week cars are getting broken into. You’ll pay fun fees. For example, on my latest bill there was 3 trash fees and my favorite - the “package fee.” There is no package center and the front office doesn’t take our packages so why am I paying an extra $20 for Amazon/ups to drop it off at my door? That’s if it’s delivered correctly which is rarely is and you have to hunt down your packages and hope they weren’t already stolen.  They will sell you on all the great things “on the way” — don’t fall for it! 

You can get so much more for your money somewhere else. No dog park, no real amenities, no security, and about all you’ll get is a nice view. The new management company isn’t any good either. 

If you want more value for your money, go elsewhere.

I truly loved the actual apartment we lived in. It was a beautiful location and I loved having a big bathroom and large closet for my things. This past year has been hard on us all, especially with the ice storm and for a short period of time, due to the hiring of new management, I was hopeful for an improvement in how things were handled at the complex. 

To keep things professional and transparent: the front gate does not lock/close, package room and car break-ins, it is difficult to get ahold of management on the phone, promises are made to you that are not kept, emails are rarely answered, and maintenance is very, VERY, nice but untimely and inaccurate.

Most of the management is extremely nice and professional, like Kirby (I apologize if that is spelled incorrectly) as well as others that work in the front office. She made moving out as smooth as possible after we reached out to other staff, I will not mention specific names, and never got a reply from them.  She was very helpful and professional.

After the ice storm, there was mold in our apartment which we had to contact maintenance repeatedly about getting removed. When it was removed, large holes (6 feet in length) in the wall remained for 4+ months and were there until we moved out. Other mold in the apartment was documented on our part but we received a written statement from maintenance that it wasn't mold, it was dirt under the sink. It was never removed or addressed again.  Our garage door was broken for months and was finally fixed, then broke again. We were told that it would be fixed within the next week, which it wasn't, and we had to call the front office multiple times in order to be proactive and fast-track it being fixed.

I write this review to provide some feedback in hopes that management can take notes and improve upon professionalism and accuracy in communication with their future residents. If I had known what it would be like a year ago, I wouldn't have signed. I thoroughly enjoyed my neighbors and it was a beautiful location, but it was all-in-all a very stressful place to live.

The only star I'm giving is because of the location and the view from outside. This is easily the worst experience I've had in an apartment community in all these years in Austin. STAY AWAY from this property.

1. The staff is incompetent and incapable of getting anything done. The older management was bad and the newer management is just as bad. They just know how to keep making false promises, manage their social media game to get brownie points from residents and blame anything wrong to the older management and the winter storm.

2. The entrance gate to this 'gated' community was dysfunctional for several months and it took ages to repair. Note that this community has had a history of mailroom, package room and car break-ins.

3. The package room is still not available. The management keeps talking of a wonderful solution, but has taken many months to provide a solution. On top of that, they charge a separate fee every month for package service.

4. The gym maintenance is non existent. You will rarely find napkins and wipes in the gym. Nor is it clean or sanitized. On any evening, you fill find dry leaves and dust inside. The pool was unavailable all of last summer, and will most likely be unavailable all summer this year.

5. Don't get fooled by the referral bonus they promise. You will never get it, even if you beg for it.

In summary, I will STRONGLY advise to stay away from this community. Or else, all you will ever hear from the office is "we will get back to you" for every concern you raise.

While recently they have hired a new manager (maybe a week and a half ago) who knows how long she will be there. They go through staff almost weekly it feels like. They use the lack of staff as an excuse to not do their jobs and they will not take responsibilities for their actions. With the constant turnover, knows what’s going on. You can call them to try and get things fixed and in return, it’s just broken promises. I felt like I had to say something because the lack of reviews on this site seem like a misrepresentation. You can tell by our private community page that most people here hate management as well. My friends like the area and constantly ask me if it’s worth it to move here and I would never allow them to make the mistake that I did. I regret my decision daily. I can’t wait to move so I can post my detailed experience with this place. If I gave the detailed post, management would KNOW that I posted this. Just beware and I’ll be posting my full experience everywhere the second my lease is up, I would never renew at this awful apartment complex.

We moved in over 2 years ago and just recently moved out. Poorly managed complex, though they are trying to make some effort to Improve. Building 26 is the worst as you hear everything outside your apartment. Management needs to communicate better with tenants

So we’ve been here for 2 years now. When we first moved in it was AMAZING, everything was always working, the staff was always receptive, the leasing managers really loved their jobs and you could tell. Not too long ago the property was taken over by Weller Management and EVERYTHING started to go down hill, the pool was closed for months when they first transferred, they had the phone lines turned off and still do so even if you need something you can’t get transferred to the leasing office 1/2 the time, they work with no sense of urgency. It’s like pulling teeth to try and get the maintenance guys to come out and fix anything. They focus a lot on bringing food trucks and social events to the property but have no customer service and it’s like talking to a wall. At this point i’d think that the bumps of switching management companies should be over but it isn’t so I 1000% don’t recommend moving in here, you pay WAY too much for this service.
Don’t be fooled by pictures and beautiful scenary. Customer service is poor . Maintenance is poor . Poorly managed. High turn over.

It's move in day!! Ahh I'm so excited! These views are gorgeous and can't wait to have game night soon with friends! I am loving my apartment so far and the office has been very welcoming & helpful as moving can be quite stressful. I love the package room and can't wait to take advantage of the pool & fitness center! 10X Living at Grandview definitely has its #Grandviews! The location is perfect and very convenient to local restaurants, shopping and most importantly the lake! I am looking forward to my next adventure at 10X!

This place stinks. Build quality is poor for the cost. Management is terrible. Parking is also the worst. I mean seriously, GOOD LUCK not having to walk a football field to where ever your apartment is if you park at night. I will not be re-signing a lease or recommending this place to any friends.

Gables Grandview is a nice place. The complex is basically along the ridge on top of a hill. So chances are you'll get a nice view. Maintenance staff are always friendly and reliable. Office staff are very accommodating. 

The pool is great but could get crowded since there's only one. Which also means it's a bit of a trek to the pool if you live near one end of the complex. If you live at the bottom of th the hill you're better off driving to the office since the hill can be quite steep but mostly because there's no sidewalk. 

There's also no dog park so no off leash fun for your pets. Definitely consider getting a covered parking spot since open parking can be quite hard to find if you get home at night. 

We didn't find out about the lack of parking spaces till we moved in. Also, just a minor issue, your address will be VERY long. You'll find that it won't fit when filling out certain forms. 

Overall a great place to live and short drive from Mopac, 183, Arboretum, Domain, and Four Corners.

Package room/lockers always broken and the front desk refuses mail so you have to go to post office or use Amazon hub to pick up your stuff. Cars constantly broken into. We had to get our tubs resurfaces atleast 6 times which you then have to be out of the apartment all day. They don’t get you notice about anything… will only use messages in the portal and only one person gets them. Had our water turned off with no notice abunch of times. Just over all horrible experience

There are many things that have led to this rating. First, the one star is for the new look of  the updated apartment. Now for the negatives. When we first moved in, we requested a repair. One month later and it still was not repaired. We had to keep making requests until it was fixed. One of my visitors parked in a spot for a few hours (2-3) and was towed with no warning. It cost about $200. Also, our vehicle was broken into months ago. The leasing office sent a notice about this recently so it must be an ongoing problem. There are no gates at this apartment complex. Finally noise can be an issue. There are several dogs that live in our building that can be heard barking day and night as well as people constantly slamming doors. Sometimes loud music is also a problem.
DO NOT MAKE THE MISTAKE OF MOVING IN HERE!!! Office staff is rude and unhelpful. I've lived in many apartment complexes and this one was the worst!

I have lived here for over seven years when this place was called Mission Hills and I have to say this place is going downhill fast. They can replace the flooring, paint the walls but the bones of these buildings are not good. Many units (including mine) are on a horrible slant due to the foundation and nothing is ever level. You can literally feel yourself falling forward in bed. The plumbing is a mess and most units have some form of water damage. Maintenance is lazy and it often takes multiple requests to have something fixed. The office staff is incredibly rude and condescending, except for Jorge. This place has SERIOUS issues that go ignored like black mold, ceilings rotting away due to water damage, broken tiles, etc. I do not recommend this place and I am sad to say I will not be renewing after a loyal 7  years.

The apartments themselves are okay.  Good location and decent improvements being done around the property.  Adding small back yards, dog park, remolded pool, are a few of the bigger things done. Nothing flashy or fancy, but that's fine for the price.

The major area of concern is the management.  The management at Ellie Apartments is rude and inconsiderate.  The property manager completely blows off your concerns if they inconvenience him/her in the slightest.  Any time we talked with him/her, we just got a fake smile and that look like all we are doing is bothering him/her.   

They setup a new package holding service that you have to put your credit card information in to pickup.  If your're out of town, you're going to get charged for the days that your package is sitting there waiting to be picked up.  We asked to opt out of it, but the property manager said we couldn't.  They then told us to go and get a P.O. Box if we didn't want to use it, an absolutely ridiculous "choice" forced on you.  Everyone used to just go to the office and pick up their package, but that was just a "service" that they didn't want to do anymore.  

If you want a decent apartment within close driving distance to the areas around town, not a bad place to be.  You'll just have to deal with management that forces "improvements" on you or flat out doesn't care about your concerns.

Hopefully, you never have any problems with payment discrepancies. The office employees are particularly rude, specifically the actual manager, Jenny, and office staff, Monica. When I called to place a complaint regarding the manner in which they addressed an unfortunate bounced check (they take a full 5 days to pull from debit and I made the mistake of transferring too much to my savings too soon) they speak over you impatiently and angrily, as if you're some sort of idiot child. I even attempted to explain why I was so upset initially - I had been notified that they received payment, and they choose to notify me of a bounced check through eviction, no courtesy notice of any kind - both employees used condescending and offensive language. I'll admit I was very upset initially, but the manager refused to de-escalate the situation and added to the problem by referring to the discrepancy as a "hot-check", when I said that offended me (she's treating me as if I'm some kind of criminal for a very innocent mistake) she told me "by law, that's what it is", last time I checked, it's a bounced-check, if not something less aggressive than that. 

Additionally, they're charging late fees despite being notified several days late, which they insist is in the lease agreement, but no such section allows them to formally charge late fees prior to a formal notice. I tried to question a number of discrepancies between the lease agreement and T.A.A.  (Texas Apartment Association) regulation and they said to bring my complaints to T.A.A, that they will not provide any additional explanations in writing aside from what they said on the phone, and denied my request to set a formal meeting by hanging up on me. 

Overall, very dissatisfied in the price I pay (despite their offensive accusations) and the terrible treatment I've received from all levels of staff and management.

I just moved in almost a month ago and maintenance have yet to finish my apartment. Ive called and email the front office numerous of time, they just give me the run around. After you sign the lease you are irrelevant.

This place is horrible. It is riddled with rude staff and none of the amenities can be used. The fitness equipment is always broken down and the pool is never cleaned and most of the time is drained! If you want something done, be prepared to wait 30 days because they only have 2 maintenance guys on site and one of them goes to his apartment and smokes pot throughout the day. He almost hit my car while he was in the golf cart too! No one ever answers the phone here and if you need something.... forget it! This place isn't worth the money and I feel like they don't care about the residents anymore! You best believe as long as you keep quite and pay rent you will not hear from them! Stay away! They charge you so many fees for no reason and make up policies as you go! Be educated and look at your rights as a tenant! Don't let them try to do something illegal to you!

Where should I start on this apartment complex… First off, management is horrible and the management company is worse! They never respond to anything and they claim they never get emails that you send. Everything is fine until you move in… then they want nothing to do with you! When we moved in, the apartment wasn’t even ready. The bathtub was pure black and the maintenance told me that the manager didn’t want to pay the money to resurface it. It took them 2 months to repair anything in the apartment. In addition to this, the maintenance guys left our door unlocked, left nails for the dog to eat and the AC didn’t work the whole time we were there. There is never any parking here because they let anyone park here and the gates were always breaking. In addition to this, because they were too cheap to replace a broken appliance, they put another dishwasher with roaches in our unit and gave our unit Roaches. This place is by far the worst “quality” that I have ever had. The price was good but you get what you pay for with management. The management staff is uneducated and very rude. I wouldn’t recommend anyone living here if you value quality living.

The rent here is a little expensive due to the great location. However, you get what you pay for. The staff are always friendly and helpful. If you have an issue, maintenance crew is very prompt. We had a leaky roof and they came in an hour after submitting the work request. The grounds and pool are well maintained. The apartments are located in a great neighborhood, which is hard to find on the outskirts of downtown. Also located close to many food establishments and public transportation. I have lived here for a year and have never had a problem or complaint.

Best apartment I have ever had, they are on a hill close enough to downtown to have amazing views of the skyline. Great maintenence that always shows up same day as reqeusted. All billing can be done online and in office with the lovely secretarys. Rent runs me $1200 for two bedroom  with "specails" but you get what you pay for and here you get quality. Though my roof leaked during rainy season as im on third floor for the view, they had it fixed as soon as the rain stopped. Great pool maintenence and landscaping. Interior and exterior is emaculate. Apartments on third and second floors have views of sunsets on Austin.Its a gated community and I never worry about my car. Neighbors are quiet and friendly if you care to say Hi. I recommend livng here.
-Current Resident 
        Travis

I am not the type of person to complain . I am too nice and that may be my downfall . The Maintence team comes inside when I am at work and refuses to leave a note . It's both shocking and scary . This is my only thing to note . The property is in decent condition . It's the staff that needs some management changes made .

I lived at Mission Hills for two years while I was living in Austin. In that time I never had any problems with my apartment. The few times I had to submit maintenance my issues were handled the same day, or the next. There is always room for improvement, but where isn't there? It was an apartment, not my home, so I didn't expect it to be much more. Parking could be difficult sometimes, but I have lived with much worse. They added permits which helped some. If other residents would realize that parking is for the residents and not their twenty visitors I don't think this would be such an issue. For the area they're in, it's at the top of the pack. Overall I had a positive experience here, and both would and have recommended it to my friends.

They'll show you the upgraded model room to entice you into moving into Mission Hills. What they'll fail to let you know is that you will deal with the following:

-Fleas
-Cockroaches
-Maintanence crew never showing up when asked, and then showing up when told not to
-Unairconditioned laundry facilities that may or may not work
-Cops being called on your neighbors several times a week
-Hidden fees upon moving out
-Rent being raised if you decide to renew
-Ceiling leaks
-Gated community that rarely has the gates working
-etc.

Decided to look somewhere else? I hope so too.

I was only here the first 3rd of the year as I had to move, but my time here at Cannon South was lovely from beginning to end. The property manager Marie was very outgoing and helpful when I was signing my lease, and she was always very responsive during my stay. The complex itself is cute, small, and maintained very well. 
 Though the star of the show has to go to my man HECTOR!! I have never experienced such fast maintenance and I don't think you can get any better unless the guy is standing outside your door at all times. If your AC breaks down during a heat wave, you definitely don't have to worry about being stuck in a miserably hot apartment.
 The only negative thing I can say is, if you're on a first floor apartment, bugs are a possibility. It's kind of inevitable wherever you are though, as I've had to realize. Management was quick to help though and they will send out pest control to spray INSIDE the apartment to really get the issue resolved.
 Now for my favorite thing about Cannon South overall: ... THE KITTIES! If you're a cat person like me this complex is heaven. They often roam around at night and they're friendly too! They also probably serve as secondary pest control! ??

I had been searching for an apartment in Austin for several months with no luck. I had to be for a job in May this year. It was becoming difficult since most apartments were six months out from availability or the rent was extremely high, much more than what I was budgeting. I thought I was going to find roommates or pay a higher rent. Luckily I came across Cannon South Apartment, where Marie has been the most helpful person I have ever dealt with at any property. She made me feel right at home. She was even excited to show me the apartment the first time I saw it. I didn’t even get to see the place until I moved in. The property is so great. Its clean and well taken care of. The whole experience from calling the day I did and me getting a call back that day as well asl the paperwork emailed so I could apply and secure the apartment is how it should be at all properties. Knowing I had a place to be here when I moved in Austin was so comforting. I’m more than happy the with my new place. I feel right at home, and it’s been such a blessing. Thank you, Marie and Cannon South Apartments.

Everything has been perfect since we decided to move here! Management is responsive & so attentive to our needs. The complex is very well kept & always in wonderful condition. They keep the pool very clean. So happy!
I've been here 6 months now and have had a great experience, Management is excellent, location is good and I spend lots of time by the pool!  100% worth the price.
I’ve had the pleasure of living here for over four years. The neighbors are nice and Mari the apartment manager has always been very helpful. 10 minutes from downtown and very affordable

Our house on the lake is being remodeled so we thought it would be nice to live downtown but our experience is getting increasingly worse. A neighbor asked us where we lived and her response sums it up best...
Ah... the Monarch College Dorm.
Suggestion: Formal complaint system with hefty fines.

We recently had a very loud group move in above us and I'm not one to complain but there have been multiple occasions of over the top parties. Jumping up and down, screaming from the patio and loud music.
The construction is an issue as others have noted and the best example is that the demolition crew started making loud noises at 5AM and woke up my 9 month pregnant wife (not fun).
Suggestion: Don't allow construction to start at 5AM or put the bin around the corner.

The entry driveway is a constant source of frustration almost as if there is no coordination of when people are moving, where construction trucks can park and no one policing the area to ensure people are following some sense of order. It doesn't really affect me but I have two small dogs and its always a concern walking through.
Suggestion: Set days and times for moving and the concierge team should be empowered to manage the congestion.

Fixtures in our unit are old but overall not bad. The biggest issue is the lack of water pressure in the kitchen sink and the shower which no one has been able to resolve.

Overall the experience is ok and the only reason I say its ok is the location and the concierge team who are all really nice and helpful.

The Monarch in Austin is a very nice place. The staff is so helpful and they care. Bobby actually took care of my belongings while I was gone on calls. You guys are the best. Jared, Brittney, Patrick. All of you. Keep it up!

I've lived in the Monarch for over 7 years...on three different floors, but the same 3BR/3B floorplan.  This floorplan has 270 degree views of DT, the lake, and even Zilker park.  The Monarch is a super building, in my opinion, even though it was opened in 2007.  Staff works hard to keep the property clean and management works to update as much as possible.  Concierge desk is fantastic.  Low turnover of staffers, so they know you and you know them.  I like living here.

This dump has been the worst thing besides my fathers death that has ever happened to me. I had a horrible roach problem they pretended wasn’t a big deal. The elevators were as loud as a train every 5 minutes, the staff was the worst! And even when I finally got out of my lease, their “better than anyone else” attorney still put a bogus amount on my credit report. They will not return my calls and the office says I never lived there!!

I think they have managed the pandemic well, changing what needed to change and trying to preserve the services and amenities as best they could.  The concierge staff is so stable and competent it is amazing.
the property is dated and dirty, especially the hallways carpets and paint.  Maintenance is timely, but sometimes makes things worse or leave a mess behind.

When you move to Texas you move here because you have heard about Southern Hospitality. I lived in Texas 9 years before I found just that. And I found it at Windsor Lantana Hills. My neighbors have been helping me rehabilitate a rescue dog who WAS (now much better) afraid of his own shadow. But the staff here also stepped in. Head of Maintenance (Will) knows every dog by name, and will even help you set up playdates. The entire staff is invested in you having a great experience. I've never waited more than an hour for maintenance request to be fulfilled. But overall this is a place to actually feel at home, to know your neighbors, to trust the staff to make sure things go smoothly, and to honestly just feel safe.

I generally thoroughly enjoy living at Windsor Lantana, it is a beautiful and well maintained community. I am especially impressed by Michael Sabatini, the leading consultant. He has been very attentive to all of our needs, and has bent over backwards to help out with specific items. Recently I was traveling out of state and urgently needed access to an item I had left in my apartment and Michael went way out of his way to help coordinate me gaining access to that item. 5 stars to him and 5 stars to the community experience in general!

We do not have any running water at this time and the entire community's maintenace is backed up. Very poor infrastructure. Not sure if this community was built in the 60s or 70s but it certainly does not feel as modern as Windsor makes it seem. We had the same issue last year and the year before with pipes bursting. Now our kids cannot shower or use the restroom and we have to leave to go live at our parents house for a few days. Certainly will not be renewing here. Not getting the value we paid for time and time again with these recurring issues.

I had water damage from the freeze earlier this year.

What I find extremely unacceptable is that at no point in the repair process, did I have any idea when any work was going to be done. When I reached out to make sure the subcontractors would be able to perform their work unhindered, I was told that the work was isolated to the bedroom. Imagine my surprise when every single piece of furniture is moved and in random spots, my bed inaccessible, my toilet inaccessible, and my shower inaccessible.

I was not warned that this was going to happen so I didn't put anything away or secure anything in areas other than my bedroom, so I can't even really begin assessing what has been moved. What I can tell you is that I feel violated knowing that a bunch of subcontractors went through all my personal items due to a lack of communication from your team. I can also tell you that I am upset to see that my sensitive electronics are coated in a layer of dust and scattered about in such a way that I can't tell if anything is missing or damaged. I can tell you that I have a few plants that have been knocked over or damaged in some way. Your inclination here might be to say they are just plants, but some of these are expensive orchids that have been in my care for years. So in short, I am very upset.

This happened on Friday. Today is Monday and I have yet to received any communication or a fix from them. I have been staying in a hotel since Friday.

The apartments and amenities are nice.  Quiet place to relax.  There is no hot water in the bathroom sinks and the fixtures are very old looking which is surprising compared to the marketing of this property.
I am very happy with my decision to make Windsor my home.  I absolutely love it here.

During our time living at the Langdon we had several serious issues with the unit as well as property damage to our owned property. This all began once RPM Living purchased the complex and everything went downhill. To name a few incidences: the maintenance team damaged our brand new dryer when they stepped on it when fixing the ac and despite my best efforts to get resolution with the complex they said that it was ultimately our responsibility to tell their maintenance team not to step on our washer and dryer when fixing the ac unit. This was the 3rd time our ac broke in less than 4 months and had to be replaced which also caused severe water damage to several of our items that were stored in our laundry closet at the time. Again, when I went to the apartment complex about this they basically said to deal with it and that we should have removed the items from the shelves above the washer and dryer below the ac unit faster despite us moving all of the items as soon as we noticed the water leaking. Mind you, this was during the hottest part of summer and our apartment was also getting to absurd temperatures in the high 80's and I was several months pregnant at the time. During all of these issues with the ac, we had mold and mildew start to grow in our air vents and run down our walls below the vents and when I flagged this to the complex they had someone from the maintenance team simply come and paint over the mold and mildew stains on the walls and they didn't even clean out the vents. Again, I was several months pregnant and this could have caused serious illness for both myself and my son. There was just such an absurd level of incompetence that presented itself once RPM living bought the building from the previous owners and thankfully we moved out before our son was born because I would NOT want a child or anyone that may be immunocompromised to be living at this complex due to their negligence alone. Don't get me started on the car break ins in the complex, how frequently the gates are broken causing further security concerns, and the lack of awareness from the front office despite these issues being flagged several times. If the previous owners still ran this place, I would HIGHLY recommend renting here, however I can't tell you more simply than this, if you care about the health and safety of yourself and/or your loved ones, do yourself a favor and do not rent here.

Picking up a package can take a while because there is typically one person in the office and they prioritize lease signing over grabbing packages. While understandable they are just managing that situation poorly. 

Gets old after a while

Walnut Park has the best amenities! Management and maintenance are totally incomparable to any other apartment that I have ever lived in. I rarely hear my neighbors and the dog park is huge and actually shaded! The location to stores and restaurants is great as well, not to mention Walnut Creek is within walking distance.  I recommend this apartment complex to anyone and everyone, hands down.

I appreciate that when I put in a maintenance request it is done the next day. The workers are wonderful, friendly. Chris and John who fixed out refrigerator were very knowledgeable and efficient.  I also like the of the whole complex.
Excellent management team.  Requests are attended to in a timely manner.

The management and maintenance teams at Windsor Oak Hill apartments are outstanding! Whenever I have a concern or need maintenance asap, I can always be rest assured that I will receive an immediate resolution from both teams. I am truly grateful to be living in a highly responsive rental community.
It's a wonderful place to live. The management socializes with residents as extended family and doesn't treat you, the resident/tenant, as a number or stranger.
The maintenance people of this building is the highlight of the Windsor Oak Hill!

Worst apartment complex I have ever lived at. Move in was a disaster (missing shelves, codes not working which my daughters still does not as of today, mold in washer that just got replaced over a month later, pieces to floor not glued down that are laying around my apartment) not to mention getting locked out of our building for over 40 minutes with myself and other residents with NO ONE to let us in as no one answered the phone nor emergency maintenance number. They sent ONE email at 10:45a and then nothing, no contingency plan as to how to let in locked out residents but they’re “sorry I feel that way” - not sorry this happened to you and your pet, instead a very emotionally immature response that showed that they could care less and this isn’t “their fault”.

The comms system is just so bad. Specifically on the maintenance side. The maintenance people are amazing but the 3rd party system governing all comms between maintenance and residents makes things really flustering. Also, the lack of governance and fine enforcement for garbage violations makes the hallways disgusting. There are a few bad eggs here that ruin everything. It's been ok in the winter, but once it's hot, this garbage pileup from violators will get bad. Also, so many things just keep breaking. The doors between the buildings and garage constantly don't work. The elevator keeps breaking. And the staff downstairs not being able to answer a yes-no question on whether units have CO meters really concerns me.
I love living at the Windsor! The staff has always been very kind and helpful. It is a peaceful and safe property in a great location.

I have recently moved in in aug 2024. Its been 1 month now, initially i had some issues with the apt but the management took care of it very diligently. I like the community vibe and the amenities provided here. Just one issue with my apartment is my neighboir upstairs makes lots of thumping noises, the floor creaks when they walk. Trying to live with that. Apart from that i would rate this place a 8/10 for the overall experience.
Very beautiful apartments with very sweet staff and prompt service when you need to put in a work order. Very convenient location and affordable pricing with lots of safety guaranteed.

I have lived at the Windsor for about 8 months and everything has been smooth sailing since the day that I moved in. I have not had any issues other than two routine maintenance work orders that were completed in a very timely manner. The staff has always been very kind and helpful whenever I have needed any assistance!

Within 3 days of move in, the entry gates were broken and I had $4000 worth of valuables were stolen from my vehicle in the parking structure.  Security locks are broken in the stairwell, and trash pickup will jar you awake like a freight train passing your window at 7am every weekday morning.  Dogs bark all day.  The guy above me has a dog that runs around all day long trampling into my ceiling.  It feels like I’m living in an industrial trailer park.  Don’t live here.  I regret it every morning the 100 decibel garbage collection starts.

I am currently living here and there is nothing great about it. Lots of pests, roaches and such. I am not the cleanest guy but I do keep a clean kitchen and do not leave food lying around ever and I can’t seem to get the dang things out of my apartment. It’s my first apartment so I can’t complain but if you have the means to choose somewhere else, please do it. Also the wood is rotting on my patio because they were built so long ago. When I moved in my apartment reeked of cigarettes and still does, all my clothes and furniture now smell like it and all they’ve done is bring someone over to do an “ozone treatment” which seemed to be just a hardcore fragrance spray that lasted for maybe 2 days. Just overall, old, nasty, falling apart apartments.

The front office was attentive and understanding about getting the central air fixed in my apartment during a heat wave. The maintenance team was courteous, polite, professional, clean and worked hard to get everything right the first time. Much appreciated attention to detail.

This place saved us when we needed it and it came with that and more! A great community, and amenity with easy access! There was a slight bug problem once but as long as you protect your home with the proper treatments you will be okay! 

I will miss you Kristina and Nat!! Y'all were awesome and helped me with so much!

Keystone Apartment unit #248 review
Overall this has been the best apartment I’ve had in 6 complexes I’ve lived in throughout my life. The staff (Christina and Natalie) have been great, professional and are personably warm which was a relief having come from out of state. Love the fact it’s only 2 miles to all my main stores from my gym to the organic grocery stores and best of all my Costco gas station . Costco in South Austin doesn’t have a gas station because its above a water reservoir  , but this North Austin Costco does have one putting my membership to good use. 

I spent a lot of time with online searches/apartment finders and apartment inspections before I found this place. I’ve never had a problem in my unit 248 (obviously I can’t speak for all units) and the neighbors are quiet and friendly. Parking lot is very well lit which I’ve learned over experience from my past apartment complexes to care about. The maintenance staff responded promptly and were courteous when I needed a working blind for the window. Small request, but fast response time. Sad to leave back out of state for work, but North West Austin has been great and Keystone was a lovely gift to call home from an out-of-towner.
Walls are thin, neighbors are noisy. Can't wait until my lease is up.

While Keystone Apartments is not fancy, it it a quiet, safe, comfortable place to live.  The management is excellent.  They are always helpful and even know me by name.  The maintenance staff are friendly and never leave a mess.  I've never had trouble finding a parking place either.

Bikes stolen off patio, cars broken into, behind Walmart, people floating around all times of day and night, gate is always out of order. Someone urinated on the wall outside my door a year ago, and you can still see the stain on the wall and concrete.

I moved in 3 years ago w my son and dog and they love it here, they have a big dog park and the pool just perfect for us is really peacefully complex and everything you need is really close to you ( restaurant, market, bars, movies,etc) . I love the staff, they listen to you and fix any problems you have. My maintenance needs are completed within the same day or next and the guys are really professional and friendly. Everyone here is courteous and friendly and I don't ever plan on moving from here. great job guys

I was a little iffy about applying here at first based on the security reviews, but this place is a no brainer. Great location, gated community, and they are installing a new camera system which makes me feel safe. The inside is beautiful and spacious. Super happy here. Staff Rocks!

This place is a joke. My truck was broken into (vehicle break ins are normal here) I live right next to the leasing office where there are cameras. I informed the leasing office of this and asked if they could check the recording. They said they could not because the cameras don’t actually record. Tf you got them for? Two months later a shooting occurred and two vehicles got shot up. The 24 hr security comes at 9 pm flashes their lights, drives through once and leaves for the night. They close the pool often for “maintenance” so good luck trying to use that amenity. It’s technically a gated community but the gates are always broken, therefore they are always open. Don’t waste your money here. I’d give zero stars if it were an option.

Not sure where the good reviews are coming from. These apartments are way overpriced, in a mediocre area directly across from walmart, their car gate has been broken for more than half a year and its almost impossible to get in contact with their front office. I would say the only good thing about them is their maintenance staff, who are always super cool. In the middle of the summer the pool was "Closed for our convenience" many times without warning and for undisclosed amounts of time. Its really just not a great place, if you want something nice, save your money and go towards the Arboretum.
Very rude property manager. Very unsafe environment. There’s no way I’d ever let my young daughter live there after my experience with how poorly this complex is managed. Do NOT live here

Ive lived here for 5 months and have had roaches the entire time. They sent a contracted exterminator that told me maintenance would have to fill the holes in the apartment to stop them from coming in. They have not. The flooding caused mold. Avoid avoid avoid.

We moved down from Illinois. For the first place to live in Texas, we are glad we lived here. The management, is, nice. But not dependable. For starters. The apartment that I viewed and applies for is not the apartment that they places me in. I was placed in a smaller apartment that I didn't even see because I was unaware of the change that property manger Elma made on her own. Secondly there is NO laundry facility on this property.
