Rockwood apartments was my home for almost two years. The manager, Robin, took care of the residents. She guided us through the "big freeze" of February 2021. We kept power, water, and heat the whole time. Repairs were always fast, and the guys who did them were personable and polite. When I first came to view the apt., I nearly made a u-turn before I got there out of trepidation about a third floor apt. But I went anyway, and found out about the free two-level wheeled carts and the ELEVATOR, so in the 1 year and 8 months I lived there, it was no problem getting heavy stuff up and down. The pool always looked clean and the "tiki hut" was a nice place to read in good weather. The communal laundry room was also always clean. Eventually a rented washer dryer eliminated the need for the downstairs communal laundry room. It had credit/debit card payment, a nice alternative to coins, and the dryers worked well. Through no fault of rockwood, a multilevel apartment complex being built next door since 2021 created a lot of construction beeping and dust, but it's up to four levels now and might be finished in a few months. The location right off burnet rd near Waterloo burgers was outstanding. I walked to shops on Anderson lane (one mile away) even at night. I never had any issues with car break-ins or tampering. I would recommend rockwood apartments because of Robin's excellent management.

I’ve lived in these apartments for 9 YEARS now and they are absolutely wonderful! No, they are not the most glamorous apartments inside but the appliances, cabinetry, and flooring are pretty good quality while still being budget conscious. The mgmt has always been super attentive, super friendly, and they really make you feel at home. I CANNOT SAY ENOUGH ABOUT HOW INCREDIBLE, GLEN, THE MAINTENANCE GUY IS! He’s worked at these apartments for 30  years now (I’m pretty sure I have that right) and he’s absolutely amazing! If you put a maintenance request in it is handled immediately and he goes above and beyond. And since he’s been here so long I don’t worry at all about him being in my apartment when I’m not there. It’s a relatively small complex so he’s the only maintenance person and good lord he is always busy keeping everything around the exterior of the apartments fixed and cleaned as well. It’s absolutely pristine all the time and the pool is always well maintained which I’ve noticed is not the case at a lot of other apartments. Another great thing about this complex is that it is SUPER SECURE. You need a key card to get into the parking lot and you need it to get out of the parking lot and visitors have to buzz the apartment (your cell phone) to walk in (be sure to warn your delivery drivers. They have been known to follow cars in and get trapped). The key cards may seem inconvenient especially when you have guests for the weekend but once some people followed someone in at night and tried to steal a motorcycle by putting it in the bed of their pickup truck and then they couldn’t get out of the parking lot so they ditched it behind the dumpsters and tried to come back for it during the day and they got caught. Also we’re right on the edge of a super nice, quiet, family friendly neighborhood so while it’s centrally located in the city you would never know it while you’re at home but just go a little bit out of the neighborhood and there are so many restaurants and businesses that are so conveniently located. Finally, it is so quiet and peaceful here.

From time to time I’ll look into other apartments to see if there’s something more economical available and I have yet to find anything in Austin or the surrounding areas in 9 years that even kind of compares to the pricing, especially for this location, and that’s not even taking into account how wonderful the staff is here. They really are truly incredible!

Rockwood apartments is a great place to live. I feel really safe here because  the gate for entering and exiting require a card, not a code that anyone can get.  The management is always very fast to respond to work requests. The complex is small, 88 units, so I know my neighbors. It is clean and in a residential neighborhood near an elementary school.
Lived here two years and so happy to have moved out. They are unwilling to help in any way if they can avoid it

We love this apartment complex, the units are a great size and it is always peaceful at night and close to things to do. Also the staff here is really helpful, especially Ramon in the office who helped us find the perfect apartment.

My roommate and I moved in to our apartment in August 2018 under an 11-month lease. We move out in two weeks. Since day one we have placed 36 maintenance requests; some of which are for the SAME, unresolved problem.

The front office staff is meet available by phone;m. Nine times out of ten you will reach their offsite call center instead. Property manager and office manager are not truthful, and will say just about anything to satisfy you in the moment.

The master bath cabinetry where the sink is was rotten and moldy when we moved in, and there’s a clear 1 inch gap below the baseboard and cabinets where roaches were crawling from. The countertop surface is paint, so it collects dust and is hard to clean. We put in not 1 but 4 requests for a leaking refrigerator - spoiled food and rotten smell. There was a different issue every time it was “fixed”. By the fourth time, they decided it was time to replace the appliance.

Our biggest complaint by far was the lying and lackadaisical responses for an A/C unit that was NOT cooling. Not sure where they thought we were living, but Texas is HOT. Seven. That’s how many maintenance requests we put in for our A/C unit. Blackout curtains - check. Closed blinds - check. Fans on - check. Thermostat set to 70-72 when home, or 74-75 when at work. Each time we placed a request it was above 90 outside, except one time that when it was about 86, and yet our thermostat would read that the inside temperature was 78-82. After the second request, the technician’s notes clearly stated that if the unit does not cool again that the system would need to be replaced and not just refilled with more Freon. Please keep in mind this is a first floor unit facing North, which means the sun does NOT ever hit us directly. I spoke with the office manager, Benny, around the 5th time and he promised that he would get the system changed if it happened again. He said he told the property manager and head of maintenance that this issue was no longer acceptable and should have been handled much better from the get go. Lo and behold here I am after the 7th time and maintenance is currently here fixing our A/C unit because it’s 96 out and we’re sitting at 80. Our electric bill this month - $172!! Un-freaking-believable!

Don’t move in. You’ll waste more time at home putting in maintenance requests than you will relaxing.

I lived here for 2 years.  Rent paid on time, no hassle with issues leading up to our renewal for yr 2 after yr 1. 

During this transition the management team/maintenance/and or the 3rd party vendors that conduct walk-throughs for apartments determined that our apartment was deemed non-repairable as it pertained to the carpet. Quote "Smells like urine and pet dander".  I have been a long time renter for apartment living spaces, and I can honestly state through my years of renting, my dog, nor my roommates dog have never had accidents inside our home as they are house trained.  Furthermore, we did a thorough cleaning of the apartment carpeting with shampoo and carpet cleaner to assure we did our part as residents.  We did not expect to owe over $700.00 to replace carpet that we were never informed would be replaced, even though contract states they can make these decisions.  When we asked if they brought in a carpet cleaning company before deciding to rip the carpet, they stated quote "No the workers determined it was non-repairable."  No effort was even attempted.  At this point this is where we received half the costs cut after they admitted their fault.  Much to our displeasure, we still paid the fee and moved in to our next transferred unit.  At the end of yr 2, we were set to turn in keys and leave the residence.  Both of us had already moved and with less than a week notice we were informed we needed to return our parking permit stickers in to the office before our move out date.  If we did not return them, the charge would be $100.00.  Little did we know from the start, a sticker carried that much value to park in our own residence.  Had I known, I would have never asked for the permit being it is an outrageous charge for people who will no longer have any interest in parking their vehicles in a place they no longer live at.  All in all I would have to say the Property Manager and the leadership above them are reaching for as much pocket change they can from their residents.  Staff had very poor communication between each other and it almost seemed like they had no organization on channels of communication amongst a team.  Management changed at least once in between my stay and I have to say their direction and organization is completely unprofessional and wrongful to residents who mind their own business and just want a place to live and call home.

This place use to be awesome and they would hold residential events. Ever since we had gotten this new Apartment Manager Lori, everyone is on edge (staff and residence). She's not very nice and the place has become very unorganized. It's just a matter of time before this place becomes run down! I'd rather sit in traffic an hour away from home than to live here and be able to walk to work. Side note rent seems reasonable upon sign up, but they'll jack up your rent when you resign.

Overall a great place to live given the area. It is a secure gated community in a good part of town. People around seem to be pretty friendly. Unfortunately the maintenance takes forever to get things fixed and a lot of the times they provide a band-aid solution. Parking is always an issue, they promised us that parking is never a problem, but there are some nights where I am parking very far away from my apartment.

I’d like to say I would definitely be renewing my lease here. I love the views from my apartment and the well maintained property. The management is always there to help and very upbeat. I initially moved here for the location, but the respect and quality response to issues is unmatched.

I’ve lived here for almost 4 years. Neighborhood is riddled with mail theft, they don’t treat the stairs when it ices, maintenance uses “band-aid” fixes for huge problems, the pool on my side of the property has been out of common mission for over 8 months, and I’ve had an ant problem since my FIRST WEEK living here. The list goes on. Wouldn’t recommend, but it served its purpose as my first apartment.

I was looking for the most affordable option but was surprised when the lowest price I found was also the biggest and came with a free washer and dryer. The staff also let me know of a special they had that I did not even know about saving me an extra $200! I couldn't be happier! With Austin the way it is right now, I was very surprised to know places like High Oaks still existed!

Update 10/04/2021: Went to Main Office after they failed to respond to my email last week. Explained about mail theft. They're going to change my mailbox lock. Rent is going up between $70-$100 if we choose to renew our lease. 

Update Sept 29, 2021: Mail is being stolen again. I had packages taken on Sept 24 & 26. One was stamps ordered from USPS, delivered by USPS according to their email notifications. My friend had small tokens removed from envelopes before she took them from her locked mailbox. We want mailroom cameras. Also, a lot of police presence in the complex for the last few weeks. 

Update May 3, 2021: Main office called back. They're looking into the Mail Center issue. Delay was due to being overwhelmed with calls over their new payment portal. I advised emailing those with effected mailboxes. She didn't see the need. I explained that residents who don't check mail often won't know there was a break in if they're not notified. They won't know their mail was potentially taken. She did email residents afterwards, sharing what occured. They've started contacting CSC Works over laundry problems.

Update May 2, 2021: Main office stopped answering the phone? I leave messages requesting a call back which I don't receive. My neighbor is having the same issue. They fixed the mail center but one section of panels was broken into this week. I reported it to the Main Office & to the Post Office. 

January 2021: Residents are forced to pay for Spectrum cable & internet. That's $70ish a month when we don't watch TV & could've gotten the internet-only package for cheaper on our own.

The living room doesn't have a ceiling light. If moving here, bring lots of lights.

There must be hundreds of residents in this complex. Yet there are only 4 washers & 4 dryers in our laundry mat which is always broken. Residents have to contact CSC Service Works themselves or nothing gets fixed. The complex left notes in the past informing residents that the front desk won't contact CSC Service Works on residents' behalf. 

Mail Center's been Out of Order for over 2 weeks with no progress towards tearing it down nor fixing it. But the Post Office is right down the road.

Tree roaches were a regular issue for months. Our Roach Hotel traps were more effective than the exterminator the complex sent, but they did send them. 

Otherwise, this place is fine. Maintenance is responsive to issues, and the front desk ladies are friendly.

I have really enjoyed my stay at High Oaks. I have had an incident with my rent and once I spoke to management they worked with me to solve my problems and were very polite. The maintenance staff is AMAZING!!!! They literally contact you regarding your issue and Sal left my restroom in better condition than it ever was before my issue. My apartment had a leaky toilet and maintenance contacted me shortly after I placed my request. I informed them they did not have to come the same day and could wait until the next day since it was so late. Sal was there first thing in the morning and literally fixed my bathroom so nice and neat. The towel that was in the ground for the leak was nearly folded and my bathroom rugs and trash cans were placed in a better place than I had them originally! I totally recommend these apartments to anyone who is searching. Plus the valet trash and cable and WiFi bundle just add a greater reason why this place is so awesome !

Anyone thinking of moving to Austin, Tx: 
DO NOT LIVE AT HIGH OAKS OR ANY OTHER NORTHLAND COMMUNITIES PROPERTY. 

I moved in 7 weeks ago and my AC unit has been broken 6 times already. Summers in central Texas are brutal because it is between 95-105 degrees consistently and it is worse when your apartment is 90 degrees while you sleep at night.

I rarely write reviews, but this place deserves one. I lived at the district for about 3  YEARS in the same unit, which attests to the fact that I loved living here.
Here's what you get:
The apartments are modern and clean with friendly tenants, and the units support Google Fiber. Maintenance has always been very responsive and quick to address the few issues that popped up.

DJ and Richie, the leasing managers (and Juan in maintenance) are fantastic and have always been pleasure to work with or even to have a chat with. During the Texas winter storm of 2021, they continued to be responsive and kept us posted.

The gym has strength training machines, a cable machine, and free weights (and not just an endless row of cardio machines in some "fitness centers")

Location location location: need groceries? Walk to the HEB down the street. Need to return packages? Walk to the UPS in the mall next door. Want to visit Soco for some food or just to hang out? Walk/Scoot/Bike or drive to soco in a couple of minutes. Need to go on a trail to relax? Go to the Blunn Creek Nature preserve a block to the east. Work downtown? it's a short drive/801 bus ride away (you can bike all the way to the Capitol)

If I didn't have to move out of Austin, I would've continued living here.

Management screwed us over after we left. We were chared over $400 if unnecessary fees for damages that weren't real. The biggest lie was claiming that we had pet urine stains int he carpet. This is NOT TRUE, yet they took is an opportunity to completely replace the carpet costing us over $200. Despite the fact that we did extensive cleaning in the apartment, we were charged a hefty cleaning fee which again, was simply them taking advantage of the situation. We tried reasoning with them, asked for proof of these damages, and argued that we did everything we were told to do, management's response was rude and condescending. Although the apartment itself is nice, I can't in good faith recommend this apartment complex to anyone. We feel like they saw took advantage of us to update the apartment and I wouldn't be surprised if this happens to other tenants after they leave.

I even at this location with my husband and son for about a year and I have no complaints! The apartment is about a 5-10min drive, depending on traffic, from downtown and all its glory. This has been a great first home for my growing family.

Its nice but its not mine if i dont find a place in a week i will be honeless im 24 years old im gonna start school in the fall i just need a place to live...i hope i win it will help me out alot i just beed stressing.

Nice building, convenient to soco, 35, Hwy 71, plenty of resident events.  

Not one maintenance ticket since I moved in! Response from the office is always timely if not immediate. 

New materials, not one of the many "newly renovated"

Very satisifed.

Great apartment. Very clean and the staff is attentive.  It's a good mix of quiet and fun.  

No ticky-tack monthly charges.  The payments are very straight forward.

Very happy about my decision to move here. I'm in a two bedroom that was renovated prior to me moving in. Very cute apartment and my neighbors are amazing. Katie and Kelvin are awesome! They really take care of you. THanks for all you do!

I will be honest, I was looking for something a little newer but the apartments are still nice. I absolutely needed a two bedroom because I work from home but with the prices in Austin, there was no way I was going to find one within my budget. I happened to stumble across the Robinson and I'm so happy I did. I have a 2 bedroom with 2 bathrooms. It's perfect for my work space and also great if I ever have company since I have the extra bathroom. One thing I enjoy most about this community is the sense of community. Most of my neighbors have lived her 5 plus years. They all know each other and everyone is really nice. The office and maintenance team are very attentive and easy to work with. Overall, I'm very happy with my decision to live here.

I moved to The Robinson about 5 months ago. I really love the feel of this property. I'm in one of the fourplexes. My apartment is super cute. So much natural light which I love. The staff here is the best I've ever experienced and I've lived at several apartment communities. Only downside is they don't have a pool or a gym for those of you looking for that kind of stuff. Overall I give this property 5 stars. Keep up the good work.

I lived at Melrose Place for 4 years and LOVED it. Now called The Robinson on Melrose is set up like a little neighborhood type community instead of an apartment "complex" and the whole community really has that friendly neighborhood vibe. Maintenance is very difficult to get unless it is an absolute emergency. The other tenants leave breezeway very dirty in most buildings. Suddenly have a roach problem out of nowhere for the first time since I've lived here although, the pest control did come in a timely manner. The apartment overall is a good space for the price but, the complex owners cut corners and as a result, management seems to be overrun with issues and has changed three times since I've lived here. I imagine they are overworked, underpaid and not given the proper resources to help tenants.

Things here are great. I  most recently signed another year with Residence at Onion Creek. And would most definitely recommend to others.
Property is beautiful. Apartment is Spacious. Maintenance is always on time.

I have lived here for almost 4 years and I will not say that it has been perfect but I can honestly say that I have very little complaints.If I complain, it would be about some of the tenants but not the actual apartments. I live in a 2 bedroom 2 bath  floor plan and I must say that it is very spacious giving me a lot of room. If I have a maintenance request, it is done in a very timely and satisfactory manner.The office hours are great and I love the fact that I now have the option of paying rent online. So far I am satisfied and have no serious complaints. This is definitely home Sweet Home for me.
The office staff is always friendly. Abby helped us out a lot in the process of getting our apartment. We truly appreciate it! Weve never had any issues while living here

my apartment is breaking in two, I applied to the office for another apartment and they say they are not available, but I have seen that they are accepting applications for new residents, there is roach infestation, I requested fumigation and they did not come to fumigate.

The facilities are very nice, it is a comfortable place to live, unfortunately the administrative staff lacks a lot, if the manager is not good, everything else will not be good, I am not criticizing or offending anyone simply, I comment on what I have seen, since I have no problem with anyone,

Parking is horrible at night, neighbors are loud until 4 am, people are loud during the day, theres trash all over the grounds, its sketchy to walk around alone, neighbors are rude, people drive through super fast

I live in this apartment 3 years and I liked it but they decided to renovate buildings and now it’s a problem. They work outside early doing roof and other stuff so you can’t sleep. And workers occupied most of parking spots so you can’t find parking at all if you come home in the evening. I pay for covered parking and I have to tow other cars from my spot. I can’t wait my move out date!!!(((
By the way my car was hit and run by someone at night at this property

Ok,  Let me see where to start, I've been living here for quite a while at least 9 years and they always act like they will better the place but lack very much in that department. Please don’t rent in this apartment. There are lot cockroaches and rats in the apartment as well as other major problem is you will see your car windows broken so make sure before you rent there.

Although my apartment itself is nice, since moving in this spring there is always some excuse as to why the gym, pool, business center, fire pit, and other amenities are not working or are closed. It feels like there is literally always some excuse, and yet I doubt they'd accept excuses from me if I couldn't pay my rent for weeks, or months, at a time. With so many other great options in North Austin, there's no reason to put up with this. If consistent amenities are important to you, look somewhere else.

They go out of there way.
They have been super patient.
I'm hoping we ( tenants)  can be as patient with them. .

Since the storm, my unit has had no water for over 2 weeks. There were daily emails sent with work updates but it did not include my unit for reasons unknown. When I attempted to call the office, most times I was sent to voice mail. The lack of communication is appalling.  
When I was finally able to get running water the plumbers left a mess saying maintenance will take care of it. It's been days and I have yet to hear anything from them. I should mention that the water is cold, not hot, but hey....at least it's better than nothing. 
When it came to paying rent, the server was down for hours, it's insane. Not sure if it'll be the same onwards.
Save the hassle, do not move here.
As of right now the new management needs a lot of work.
They have really poor service and management. I have been having terrifying experiences since last 3 months. That includes over paying, no service and loss of time.

Griffis North Austin are the best apartments I have ever lived in. I am in love with my unit, it’s spacious, renovated and has an attached garage. 
The landscaping is beautiful, and community is quiet. The management is consistently friendly and helpful, maintenance responds to issues quickly. Tomas one of the techs was a life saver when I called regarding an emergency at 2am. 
Parking has never been an issue for me or my guests. They have an app where you register your guests; its super easy to use. 
This place is a paradise for dog lovers. My dog and I are so trilled that Griffis has so many amenities for dogs; Dog Park, Dog wash and proximity to Walnut Creek Park. 
Overall my stay at Griffis North Austin has been phenomenal. I'd recommend living in a Griffis community to friends and family.

1) They let tow companies prey on guests and residents. They force you to use a parking app to register your car every time you park and if it is 1 digit off from your plate, they will tow you immediately without a warning. All of the other vehicle info the app asks for is ignored. It will give you and your guest PTSD worrying if your car will be gone in the morning for any mistake in the app.
2) Management does NOT value your business. When you voice a frustration to management, they give a uncaring response. Then you threaten to move out, they welcome you to immediately put in your notice. Wow! 3 years of rent and more rent to come does not mean much to these people.
3) They will give you a preferred parking spot one year and take it away the next. They used to reserve few parking spaces closest to the buildings for a premium. Then one day they chose to take them away due to confusion. They could have simply made better signage to eliminate the confusion.
4) The kitchens and bathrooms are C- quality for A level prices. The ugly counter-tops and cabinets are out dated and need a face lift.

WORTH THE READ!! We've only been living here for a week and had our car towed over night with our resident permit clearly showing in the window. There is a sign in front of the spot that says "permit only" that, after having talked to the front office, is not up to date and should actually explain that it is a RESERVED spot. The towing place is 12 miles away and we now have to Uber there to get our car back. The office management said that they would ask their manager if we would have to pay a fee to release the car from the towing company and after sitting there for almost THREE hours and checking in, they only texted their manager and offered up the idea of calling their manager, which they should have done in the first place. They got an immediate response- go figure- and we were told that we would have to pay to release our car, but management would pay for half of it later if we bring them the receipt, even though we shouldn't pay ANYTHING (to get there or to release the car) considering that the signage was not up to date and thus, we were not wrong to park there. On top of this, literally on my way up to my apartment on my move-in date, I was told that my balcony was possibly unsafe and would be under construction for about the next FOUR weeks. Seeing as to how I was literally moving in and had no other place to go, I had no choice but to be okay with it. I don't go into work until the afternoon, so I get woken up most days because of banging right outside of my apartment. This would be less frustrating if we weren't paying for the balcony as part of the property that we're renting, but we are, and the office refuses to give us a credit for not being able to access part of our apartment, even though we got no advanced notice. There is rat poop behind our refrigerator, there is hardly any parking (each resident is only allowed to have one car parked on the property and only given one permit per car/resident), they make you pay for your car getting towed even though you may rightfully park there, assuming you follow the verbiage of the sign in the spot directly- one of the office people accidentally said this isn't the first time this has happened :))) and they still haven't updated that sign- and there is dog crap everywhere you step.

(Continuation) I've never been one to take off my shoes at the door, but we do now because of the fear of tracking dog poop everywhere. To dry clothes in the dryer that we have (on HIGH heat), we have to run the dryer twice. Only half of our outlets in our apartment actually function and after freezing our butts off the whole first night and next half of a day with the heat "ON" and putting in a maintenance request, we found out that the connection was done wrong, so we were just wasting our money and freezing because someone didn't know how to do their job :). He at least, was very open and honest and apologized to us directly letting us know that he hooked it up wrong when he was doing the walk-through of our place before we moved in, but all the office staff do is apologize and send you on your way. Oh, also... We don't have a fan/light in our living room but there is a connection?? Seems pretty hard to forget, but they did. Also, when we walk our dog at night, we fear that we're going to get hit because the tow truck drivers pay no attention to pedestrians and just zip through the parking lot to hurry up and finish their job.
Gated community and great maintenance turn around.

When we come after 10 pm, most of the time we don't get parking. We have parked in front of leasing office many times. Before we moved-i, they had mentioned they have sufficient open space parking for the residents.

I really like living here. The outdoor area at the main building was just updated and looks super good. I like that theres a grilling station, and hot tub for when i have a group of friends over. My apartment is one of the updated ones, so everything is new and includes a washer and dryer in unit. I have a dishwasher and a huge bathtub. Dionna was my leasing agent and she's super sweet, so are all the others who work in the main office. Highly recommend Griffis!

A very worst and irresponsible management, each service request is taking 48 hrs to address. And there is no proper intimation about water maintenance, most of the time there will be a notification in site before 1 hr on water maintenance. 
many times sewer back'd up and flooded my apartment. Gym and swimming pool was closed most of my tenure with the Griffis. Not worthy for the rent paid. Better Avoid signing lease here.

Overall, I have no major issues. The complex makes an attempt to have events for residents. The property is always well kept. The office staff is fairly friendly and helpful. Maintenance is quick to respond and has never complained even when I asked them to do very very minor things that I just couldn't do myself. My one complaint is that sometimes maintenance is somewhat careless. They've left my patio door unlocked and moved stuff around without putting it back. Very minor things. Overall, good property. At this point, no major complaints.

I am very happy with my apartment it's close to downtown and so convenient. The domain is right around the corner and the grocery store is also close. The maintenance is a good team and change my filter whenever I need them. The office staff is friendly.

I have never loved where I live more then I have here. The office staff is amazing. They know you by name and are happy to see you. They also all live here! There is available parking every night of the week. The community here is awesome with different events every month. You can also join the volleyball team. The pool area is beautiful and clean. You can grill in the grilling area. We also have a real working hot tub! The work out center is fully loaded and also very clean. Any problems we have had where taken care of in a timely manner. Everything can be assessed on thire website and is easy to work. Also paying rent online is free. I plan on living here till I buy a home. No reason to leave.

It's very true: no establishment with a French name lacks sophistication, and Chez Moi is no exception. 

Pros:
* The property managers are always busy creating events, updating everyone with relevant news, and listening to your needs.
* Chez Moi's maintenance crew has got to be one of the best in town; I've never had to wait more than a day to get someone to respond to even the smallest upkeep needs.
* The "extra" facilities (laundry, sweet pool, gym, volleyball court, and kids playground) are excellent and actually get used quite frequently; the place is lively!
* That being said, every neighbor I've met has been respectful and quiet and the kids are always back home by sundown
* Great location if you work for some of the tech companies here, go to ACC, or work at Pickle's Research Center. Oh, also, the domain is 10 mins away

Cons:
* The appliances could really use an upgrade, but work fine and never broke on me (they're just inefficient)
* Speaking of inefficient, insulation is pretty bad tbh. Expect your electric bill to be somewhat higher than usual. The water bill is ridiculously high, they run the sprinklers even after it rains.

All in all, this is a great place to live and I've genuinely had a pleasant experience. Would definitely recommend as it's probably the best deal for the money in the area.

From the moment I inquired abt this complex they have been nothing but amazing!! I had to do everything online & was sent pictures, had follow ups & they have gone above & beyond! When we moved in I loved the welcome home surprises throughout the apt & with any issue we've had they have been nothing but helpful!! The community is beautiful & our dog as well couldn't be happier!!!

I use to live in this area when I was in college about 6 years ago and after moving around to different parts of town, I decided to come back again because I miss being able to either jump on I35 or Mopac or 183 to get to where I need to be. I also miss being near Chinatown and the Domain. I looked at every, and I mean EVERY apartment on Metric and the off streets and I never even looked here because I thought it looked too fancy and was probably way too pricey. So as we were about to sign our lease at another complex, the boyfriend wanted to stop in and look real quick. Jennifer was the rep that greeted us and aside from her offering different floor plan options to us, her exceptional service was really what got us to sign our lease here. She was very upfront and nice about everything and even 5 months later, the front office continues to impress us. The apartment seems to have gone through a management change but that hasnt effected us much. For a month we couldnt pay online so we just had to go get a money order from the bank and paid our rent for that month that way. We order alot of our things online and the front office has been exceptional in accepting packages for us. They keep it in the back where its secure as to where I have lived in places that either didnt accept packages or would just keep it in a pile at the front where anyone could take it.

A few other things I like is the secure gates that actually work. The playground comes in handy when my little nephew comes to visit. Dog waste recepticles that are actually filled with bags everytime I have needed it. The gym is great, lots of weights and exercise machines, although I seem to be one of the only ones that use it. There is a sand volleyball court and even though I dont use it, I always see a group of people actively playing there. I never have any problems parking, even when i work and come home late at night, I can find something nearby my complex. My boyfriend paid for a cover parking spot because they were running a special for it when we signed our lease and now I wish I had too for me, mainly just for bad weather days to keep my car and bike safe. There are kids and family here and it seems to be a very safe complex. I walk my dog around and Walnut Creek dog park and trail is just nearby.

A few complaints: Some of the drywall in the apartments have been worn, so they have been doing construction outside our apartment on the patio deck. The construction wakes me in the morning when I work nights and my dog goes nutso with the hammer pounding every time. Also, I can hear my upstair neighbor, possibly because they could be elephants but that is soemthing I put up with since I always want to live on the 1st floor. I dont hear the family that lives next door even though they have 2 small kids, so the walls are pretty well sound proof. The inside carpet is a dark brown which works with all our furniture. All in all, I wish we could sign a longer lease here.

Everyone that works at the Whitley is exceptional. They have high standards of customer service and want to make sure the residents are well taken care of. They really understand that this is our home and want to make sure we are as comfortable as possible. They are extremely responsive to issues and see the residents as humans rather than customers. I truly appreciate living here and always feel well taken care of.

This is my girlfriend and I's first time living together, and we are working on a big move across the country to Austin. The apartment hunt is never the most fun process, but the Whitley agents (in particular Caroline and Holly) were extremely helpful and responsive throughout the entire process. We are looking forward to moving in soon!

New Management totally ignores resident calls and emails and hides in her office like residents are beneath her. They will not allow any dry cleaning delivery/pick up service except tide which is awful. My apartment has a lingering weird smell despite candles, purifiers and diffusers. Also was not cleaned prior to moving in. Maintenance does the bare minimum and work is sloppy with splattered paint, cracking grout, old beat up appliances, rusty tubs and sink. Apartment is also weirdly dusty; I have to dust multiple times a day. Also management hates dogs.
We’ve had a very positive experience with the leasing agents and maintenance staff. Both friendly and helpful. Everyone has  been informative as well. Thank you to the entire staff.
If you love constant construction noise next door and being assaulted by your neighbors, then look no further than the Whitley. Oh and did I mention the elevators are always down. Fun!
Needs improvement on cleanliness, communication, and maintenance.
Extremely satisfied with moving here- easiest move-in process I have ever encountered and the apartment is great. Location and view is incredible and the staff has been super helpful along the way.
Extremely helpful, courteous and friendly staff make the building feel like a home. Thank you!

The Whitley is a great place to call home. From the amenities to the management and staff, they are top notch. It checked all the boxes when looking for a downtown apartment and we are glad we made the choice.

At the end of the day, I still love The Whitley. It exceeded my expectations for high rise living in Austin from the day I moved in (and I did a lot of research and tours). I hope it stays that way, as time is fleeting and change happens fast.
Front desk concierge service, with the exception of Alex is incompetent. Likely very poorly trained. Lose packages. Forget to let guests upstairs. Really atrocious.
Beautiful building and friendly employees. I am recommending it to all my friends that are also moving to Austin! It even smells amazing and the apartments are lovely.
The staff are the friendliest, most helpful people Ive ever met! Theyre always courteous and ready to solve any issues I have. The location is prime and the residents are friendly and international!

I've been a resident here for four years, and I've been so pleased with the experience. Management is helpful and friendly, and the complex is always clean and well-maintained. You couldn't be in a better location or pick a more welcoming community to live in!

Whitley has amazing layouts and very well thought through use of space inside of the apartment. I love the feel of my new place. I had a bit unpleasant experience with moving in but after addressing the manager of leasing it was all sorted out. She is very professional and personable. Overall, I am happy with my new place and would recommend Whitley to others.

I lived at the Whitley for about a year, and my first six months was nothing but pleasant. However, the quality of the Whitley Apartments service overall went drastically downhill in 2019. There were fire alarms at odd times, once at 4 am in the morning, and one of the elevators was always out of order for some reason. Since they fired most of their staff early this year, the communication in and outside the leasing office has been ineffective and rather costly.

The day I moved out, May the 15th, I had already emptied the apartment with only a few pieces of furniture left, which I scheduled to be picked up that very day. There was some trouble with the pick up, however, and I was flying out of the state the very next day and was not going to return.

Since I could not be there to supervise the pick up of my remaining furniture I had to reschedule, I asked a leasing office staff what I should do, and was told that if I left the keys, he would  supervise the pick up, and all I had to do was send an email to reserve the elevator and let him know when the pieces of furniture would be picked up.

When I emailed the Whitley about the rescheduled pick-up, I was instead told they went ahead and disposed of all my remaining furniture. The leasing office staff I talked to turned out to be "only a temp" who happened to make a lofty promise. Had I been told that the apartment would discard my belongings and charge me 300$ for it without letting me know, I would have asked a friend to arrange and supervise the furniture pick-up and then return the keys. When I emailed to express my dismay, they only reiterated that it’s part of their protocol and refused to respond to my further emails. I understand the apartment staff are going through many transitional issues, but be responsible for your own staff. If you can’t, don’t leave only your temps in the office feeding your residents misinformation. And please do get your transitional issues resolved already, the excessive change in staff is obviously something the apartment’s not equipped to handle well at all.

Extra 300$ is far from fortune, but the complete denial of your responsibility and refusal to communicate with your former resident is nothing but utterly unprofessional. If anyone’s planning on signing your lease here, please expect to be treated very differently when you’re about to move out.

This is my first time ever to write a negative review online, so the Whitley did excel in something in that regard.
Beautiful place to live in a great location!
Excellent building in a prime location. Upscale downtown living

The laminate flooring was laid on top of old laminate. There is obvious water damage that they did a bad job of covering up. There are always police. The mail doesn't get delivered here. The power shuts off randomly and often. I could keep going...

The apartments are huge and little bit scary. Houses are far away from each other. I had to walk far away to my house I had apartment on second floor. Nice view from windows. Huge bath. Kitchen is small and compact. Old apartments. Old houses.

Avoid this disgusting pit at all costs! Living here is constantly infuriating, depressing, and embarrassing, and I can't wait to get out of here. 
I've been here for many, many years and have seen it go from a decent, well-run, happy place to live, to a dirty, rundown, understaffed, and poorly managed slum. Everyone I talk to regrets living here. 
*The management is unavailable, dismissive, unresponsive, and ineffectual with frequent turnover of office and maintenance staff. I've sent dozens of emails to the mgr and asst msg that got no response. The office is often closed throughout the day during business hours because there's not enough staff to keep it open when someone has to go out.
*It takes at least one week, if not two or more, to get maintenance requests taken care of. 
*There's trash and dog poop everywhere. I've complained *literally* 100+ times over the last 8 years (since I've had a dog) about the dog park never getting cleaned up. We've gone WEEKS with the piles and piles of fly-covered and moldy poop not picked up and the trashcans overflowing. We have to pay $20 in "pet rent" per dog per month (which is the biggest scam ever) and get absolutely NOTHING for it.
*Valet trash (the second biggest scam ever) often doesn't show up, leaving trash outside everyone's doors all night, allowing the resident raccoons to dig through it and make a mess. I've complained many times about people leaving piles of trash bags and their trashcans outside their doors for 3 or 4 days at a time, but management couldn't even handle that. I finally left a note on my neighbor's door, and they stopped. You are forced to pay $30 a month for someone to walk your trash 50 feet to a dumpster. It's an obscene and abusive fleecing of the residents.
*After the ice storm in Jan '23, there were very large piles of branches all over the property FOR FIVE MONTHS. As usual, I got nothing but excuses and the run-around every time I asked when it would be picked up.
*I haven't seen a security car on the property for years. Last year, someone stole the catalytic converter from my car, which was parked under a light right next to the building.
*I've been complaining for over 1.5 years about the broken and falling down fence all along my building. Everything is shoddy and falling apart.
I'm ashamed to have put up with this so long and wish I could leave tomorrow. Don't make the same mistake I've made and STAY AWAY from here!

When we first moved here, we were in desperate need of a home. We had lost our home and our credit was troubled.They took us in. As covid lasted, finances struggled. Rent became hard.In July they helped. KaryaKares paid a small portion to help. Despite concerns with maintenance and trash pickup, I will still give them a high rating.

My stuff gets fixed very quickly.

The pool is always in good shape.

I love the staff here.

I renewed my lease to stay here longer bc I liked it so much.

Management is unprofessional, the upkeep of the apartments are horrible, probably due to the shabby job maintenance does. Not worth the money, there are better priced apartments in the area that will give you a higher quantity living situation.

Since the new property manager and her team have come in things have improved 100 percent.  It's obvious that property upkeep and tenant care and satisfaction are their main priority.  I look forward to many happy years here.

Moved in a Year and a half ago and was in a Beautiful one Bed Room moved in the same place to a Two Bed Room Great easy to get to work and stores and doctors, the Staff in the Office are the Absolute Best! Maintenance are Great and can Solve any problem with fixing on things...I am Grateful to the Woman that works in that office they are professional and kind.  my car was towed from in front my door, I have the handicap placard and forgot to put it in the window and got towed I was hurt and upset but it was my fault not following the Rules of the place I can't be mad at the office I needed to pay more attention to what I was doing. My Point is when things don't go our way look to see what part we played...and find the answer...I'm Still a Resident

Do yourself a favor and find another place to call home. By far the worst experience  I have ever had renting. Have so many complaints but today tops them all. The apt upstairs from us has a water leak they provide little to no help, the manager basically tells my pregnant wife that they are going to spare some kind of chemicals to treat the toilet water that ran down the walls soaked our mattress, box spring and entire carpet. Then tells her that it is no problem that the chemicals are safe, but won't put it in writing. So now we have to find a hotel room on our dime of course because it is not their problem that we choose not to stay in a room that was flooded by toilet water. So if you're reading this know this is just the worst of many bad experiences at San Paloma apartments, there's certainly better places and cheaper I'm sure!

We're in the process of downsizing from homeownership to an apartment.  We visited San Paloma on 7/3 and toured of a 2/2 with Nora.

Nora was very nice, answered all our questions and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  

We also like the fact that this property has been owned by the same family since it was built so we don't have to worry about constant management company turn around.

They also do employer discounts which is another plus for us!  

I have been in the apartment business for over 40 years and I currently help manage 715 student apartments.  I am very impressed with San Paloma!

Community policies are not enforced. The staff is rude and unhelpful—going as far as being retaliatory against residents who make requests for repairs. 
The grounds are covered in animals waste. 
Parking is not regulated. You are not guaranteed a parking spot, and they will not create additional handicapped parking spaces, despite all of the available spaces being consistently filled. 
Each of the 13 buildings is surrounded by banks of outdoor air conditioning units—26 individual units at each building. None of the 300+ units are property insulated to prevent the ungodly amount of low-frequency vibrations. 
The maintenance staff speeds around the grounds in a dilapidated old pick up truck with music blasting at full volume. They use garages intended for resident parking/storage for maintenance purposes and are constantly moving equipment and machinery in and out of these garages, which are located within 50 feet of bedroom windows. This begins at 6:00 am and continues until past 10:00 pm. 
Any issues brought to the attention of management are swiftly denied. They refuse to accept responsibility for enforcing the policies they have set. 
The “courtesy officer” becomes aggressive when residents request his services. If you have a noise complaint, you must confront the offending party yourself or waste the time and resources of the Austin PD. 
Residents are permitted to perform vehicle maintenance in the parking lots and often leave hazardous waste materials behind. 
The system used to collect residents waste is unsanitary and unsafe. Raccoons frequently forage through the pile of bags left under the stairwells. On hot days, the smell of rotting garbage fills the breezeways. 
My advice is to find somewhere else to rent.

Be careful living here. There is a homeless camp on the South side of the apartments and the inhabitants break into cars. They broke into my car just for spare change! Then threw everything into the parking lot in the middle of the night.

I have lived here for three years and I have because I do not have the extra money to move. Since moving in, this place has continiously gone down hill. Management sucks, maintenance sucks, trash is all over and they don't clean up. I came home one day to dog crap all over the breezeway, I called and no one ever came to clean it up. I can rent a home for a better price than rent here.......$1,000 plus a month for a tiny one bedroom with a maintenance team and management  does not listen to your needs and do not care about you. When I asked for the upper management or owners number I was told I cannot get that. So nothing can be done about the crappy service that renter's receive living here.

I was a tenant from 2020-2021. 

Safety
During that time we had three homeless bang on our door on separate occasions to the point we had to call the cops because we felt unsafe.

Amenities
While we were promised a pool on site they failed to tell us it was not approved by the city yet and we only could swim in it during the last quarter of our lease.

Grounds
Trash comes twice a week but even then usually the two dumpster locations are overflowing into the parking lot and into the nearby parking spots.

Property
Typically maintenance takes three visits to fix anything. First to see the problem, second to fix the problem, and third to fix something they messed up. We had the stairs to the second floor of our apartment broken for four months before they fixed them correctly. We also had a small water problem that resulted in maintenance flooding our second-floor bathroom which spilled down to the first floor. I moved to Tacara at Steiner Ranch about four months ago and I must say that I am very impressed by the location, amenities, and the units themselves.  Everything is brand new (in my unit no one had ever lived in it before), and the maintenance is superb in responding to resident issues.  The area that surrounds Tacara is in the affluent northwest Austin suburbs, with rolling hills, terraced elegant homes, and the excellent Leander Independent School District.  Many neighbors are friendly and sociable and Tacara hosts quite a bit of "get-togethers" in the clubhouse including wine-tasting and chili cook-offs.  

The views this area affords are incredible, and I have spent hours relaxing in an easy-chair watching sunsets over the lake.  Quick access to FM 620 and 2222 heading into downtown Austin is a plus, although as many Austinites know, the commute is sometimes long and does get backed up a bit during rush hours.  However, for many of us, the commute is worth it to live in such a beautiful and desired place.  There is a hiking trail behind the complex that allows for some quiet time, and Tacara is a very pet friendly community with many dog areas placed around the property.  

The A2 floorplan, which is a one-bedroom, is very spacious at 825 square feet and among the largest one-bedrooms that metro-Austin has to offer.  Tacara is set back from Quinlan Park Rd and has a long entrance to the community which ensures a rather peaceful and quiet area in which to live.  There are a lot of apartment complexes in the Austin area from which to choose, as this is the fastest-growing large metro area in the nation (and also ranked the number one best place to live in the country by US News) so the decision to make one your new home must be based on sound advice and research.  

My advice, therefore, is to seriously consider Tacara at Steiner Ranch, but don't take my word for it, do some research on the Internet and compare and contrast the various housing options for you and your family.  I bet that you will do as I and many of my neighbors have done, fall in love with the beauty of this area of the Texas Hill Country and make Tacara the start of your new life in Texas!

Location (3.5 stars)

I go through gas a lot faster here than at my previous complex.


Neighborhood (5 stars)
The neighborhood is nice and quiet. I've never seen any action around here except when lightning struck a nearby building a few months ago. The complex is adjacent to a Seventh Day Adventist church, and across the street from a park. There's another park just off Sheridan Blvd, which can be reached by following the back residential roads all the way through. A little further out, but within walking distance is Ford Logan National Cemetery, Colorado Academy, and the Bear Creek bike trail.

Amenities (4 stars)
Amenities are pretty standard, but generally kept in good condition. There is a pool, communal BBQ, and dog park, however as I don't use any of those things, I cannot comment on their quality. There are laundry rooms in every building, which are clean and cheap, and kiosk to recharge laundry cards in the office. Also in the office, there is a lounge, and a computer room with free wifi. The fitness center has cardio equipment and weight machines, as well as free weights. There are some amenities that you can pay extra for, as well: Storage boxes ($10/mo), and covered parking ($35/mo).

Miscellaneous (3.5 stars)
Maintenance usually does a good job. The biggest issue I've had was with leaks this past Spring, but they've been working hard to replace the roofs all Summer. Unfortunately they needed to get "approval" for the roofing work, so until that approval came through, I had buckets everywhere and I had to rearrange my furniture. My boyfriends car was stolen out of this GATED community and when we asked if we could please obtain any video footage from both gates we were told " oh they don't work"... uhhh what do you mean they don't work ?! isn't that the whole point of living in a GATED community ?! fast forward we buy a new car the old one is found and we have it parked in front of our apartment as we try and work the details out for selling it. here's the real cherry on top of the cake ... the car gets BOOTED for non movement, we were told that someone patrols the area and noticed the car hasn't moved ( funny how you have enough people to patrol the area for non movement of vehicles but you don't have enough security to monitor the car theft that goes on here) ANYWAY, this car is still registered to the apartment complex as one of our vehicles, as a resident who pays a pretty penny to live here and also pays for a bunch of amenities we don't even have access too (valet trash service, smart home features) we SHOULD have been notified. shame on this apartment complex and shame on the property managers who run it. I can confidently say we will not renew our lease and I will never refer anyone to move here.

Finding  somewhere to feel like home is a hard thing to do but at TAVA Waters they make it easy. From crazy amazing amenities, to be able to walk your furry friends around a safe neighborhood and have plenty of places for them to play. There is no other place like this community in Denver. PS you get to say you have a fun lake and beach in your back yard. PPS. Free paddle boarding and kayaking in the summer provided by your new home.
Amazing place to live, the best in Colorado! Resident services, leasing office, maintenance are incredible!

Strata may have great marketing, but the grounds are not kept up at all and they are horrible at communicating. When I first moved in, the apartment was not clean at all — there was dust and dirt everywhere. The AC also didn’t work for the first week we were there, and it took over a week for someone to come out and fix it. On top of that, we had a broken fire alarm, fridge, and dishwasher that also took weeks to be fixed. There is a constant weed smell and the dog poop problem has yet to be addressed. My roommate’s car was stolen and was told that they didn’t have any cameras and to call the police. Lastly, upon moving out, we couldn’t get anyone to answer our phone calls or numerous emails which was super rude and frustrating. It’s not worth the amount of money you pay for no cameras and bad upkeep. DO NOT LIVE HERE !!!!!

Grounds are kept a mess with no care or respect for how much money you’re paying to live here. My car was broken into and the leasing office literally told me “we’re not responsible for that” when I asked if they had any security footage or security cameras on the property.
This apartment is amazing. The inside is beautiful. They’re so organized and friendly. I’m glad I choose Strata.

The inside of the apartments are very nice, and Chris and Rikita are friendly and seem receptive to feedback. However there is a constant problem of dog droppings not being picked up (supposedly there are fines imposed by management for owners that neglect the mess). Also there is a recurring theme of vomit in the common areas that does not get cleaned up for several days even after notifying the office staff. Lastly there is a recurring weed smell even though the complex claims to be smoke free. When I try to contact the office they typically do not answer the phone, or when I try to go in person they often close before the posted 6PM closing time. Overall I just wish this place would get its act together since the insides are so nice, but it really is not worth the cost.

I was filling out my application for this rental property and unfortunately, I was requested to pay a $1,000 security deposit. It was also really difficult getting an appointment for a tour. I am disappointed that this community did not work out for me.
The units are nice enough but overpriced. Bad location with lots of homeless around. Management is a terrible mix of incompetent, unresponsive and neglectful. There are better places to live.

Communication with management is by far the worst I've had at any apartment, I've been trying to contact management for awhile now about an issue with my apartment and its been over a month and I haven't receieved a response -- highly recommend finding a different place.
Live in the modern apartment with a balcony is a must! It is like a beautiful home in my dream to live in. And a laundry on-unit is a bonus. Love it.
Do not move here. Too many problems without solutions. Management is no help. Most people living here have been complaining for months about issues at the complex ! :)

After touring many apartments for my cross country solo move to Denver, 20th Street Station really jumped out to me as being the obvious choice. The apartments are beautiful, modern, and spacious. The staff is incredibly friendly and very helpful. And the location can't be beat. Not to mention the views from the apartments and amenity spaces are stunning. I wanted a mountain view and this apartment gave me just that.

Used to be nice. Now there has been an influx of people that trash everything, don’t follow posted rules about anything, dog poop and trash everywhere. They smoke pot on balconies, blast music night and day, trash the pool area, intimidate people from using the pool, loud and disrespectful to everyone, work on cars in the garage, and so far suffer zero consequences from their actions. 
Sleeping has become a joke. There is no peace and quiet here.

I moved here in the fall of 2023. I was impressed with the cleanliness, upkeep, safety, the variety of amenities available. Unfortunately, within 3-6 months an influx of people have moved in and it has changed everything. The rules are not enforced. Large groups of people who don’t live here are using the pool and other rooms and trashing the area. There are broken down cars in parking spots. You can see engine parts laying around. There was a drive shaft for 6-8 weeks on one parking floor. Our hallway carpets are stained so badly that it will never come out. People won’t even put their trash down the chute, they just leave it piled in the room. The safety gate for secured parking continues to break - leaving it accessible to everyone.  I can only hope they make some improvements before my lease is up. Renewing is not even an option.

I have been a tenant here at the Deco Apartments for three years now. The location is great with easy access to shopping, dining and major roads and highways.These apartments also have a great variety of updated and modern amenities.
The best part of living here is the Management Team, Brandon, Nancy, Sharonda, and Alfredo. They’re all so kind, accommodating and friendly. Any minimal or minor issues I have had living here the management team has acted quickly and effectively to always resolve any issues. Definitely the best Management Team!
I highly recommend the Deco Apartments.

They jerked me around for two weeks, approving my application, then saying I didn't have enough proof of income, then saying I was approved again, then saying actually I wasn't approved because my income wasn't high enough. And the worst part is, they couldn't do this in a timely manner and take their sweet time responding to emails. They completely ignored my last one. (also, the apartments look nice in photos but are cheap looking in person)
very Spacious and the 8-week assistance is a plus. love the refinery/ modern style.

I hope to upgrade this review. I moved here in late March. The amenities that were offered at the time of my visit made this a place to  live. Things were so great during the tour that I broke my own decision making protocol. I was totally excited about the opportunity to experience such. The staff and maintenance have provided a good customer service experience. 

        I totally understand the situation and scenario as to why certain experiences and amenities that were promised to me have not been delivered. As things started to open up in the cities and certain restrictions were lifted, the amenities stayed closed. They have slowly opened amenities(with restrictions), but guests are still not allowed in the amenities(main reason I chose to live here to share with others). The pool is open during business hours only; The gym just opened but with heavy restrictions and very limited time(during business hours, no weekends). The coffee machine is closed as the company is afraid to open that. 

      Problem solving is very critical to me. I gauge how effective a company is in innovation, problem solving, and engagement during issues. At this junction I do not feel that management have effectively done such to provide what was marketed plus provide safety according to local guidelines. I have let that be known. I am still paying full rent and holding my end of the agreement when I first moved here. When they have expectations for me, as a tenant, in regards to following their rules and guidelines of the complex(especially during this time), they definitely want me to adhere without any excuses. So it goes both ways for me.

        Problems arise and that is understandable. I feel I go above and beyond to communicate things before I act. I let it be known that my expectations were not met, numerous times. I understand what they wanted to offer before the pandemic. It seems the expectations were for me to accept the excuses. However, I have to understand from my point of view and uphold my standards as I do with every other business that compete for my business.  

    This review may not matter to many, but at least the current state of the complex is out there for others to decide if they happen to be deciding between other complexes who may be providing their marketed experience while adhering to local safety guidelines. I feel that properties as such should be commended and rewarded for such(innovation and problem solving aspect are big too me).
Very modern amenities, love the RiNo art in front of my place, the plazas around the community are great!!!

I moved to Denver for a fresh start and I feel like Novel has helped me dip my toe into a golden pool of kindness, luxury, and excitement! I feel so welcomed here and it has really boosted my confidence to be more social and less anxious. The staff here at NOVEL are incredible!!! Truly!
The leasing staff is amazing, very helpful with getting all documents signed and submitted!
I’m extremely happy to be part of this community.  Everyone has been warm and welcoming.  The events that I’ve attended in my two weeks living here have been incredible!

Novel is a wonderful community with beautiful amenities, first rate apartment features and a professional leasing team.  Krystan, Candice and Chelsea are all amazing.  The maintenance team is also responsive and really pleasant. When a request for service is made, John is ON IT right away.
I really appreciate the maintenance staff here. They are always kind and courteous and very effective
Best apartment I have lived at in Downtown Denver. Fantastic amenities, very friendly staff, great apartments and views. Check it out!

I recently started my lease at Sabine Apartments on May 31st 2024, and I am absolutely thrilled with my decision.

From the very first moment I called them in March 2024 while starting my apartment search, their friendliness and professionalism stood out. This initial and memorable positive interaction made choosing Sabine Apartments an easy decision.

Megan and Steven were exceptional throughout the entire process. They cheerfully and patiently answered my questions, ensuring I felt comfortable and informed every step of the way. Steven, in particular, was impressively consistent in treating me with dignity and respect.

Upon moving in, I felt incredibly welcomed. The apartments are top quality, offering a living experience that truly feels like the best in America.

I was especially touched by the thoughtful warm welcome gift of a bottle of Chardonnay, beautifully adorned with a ribbon. Totally cute gesture. This modern, phenomenal and elite touch to my move-in experience made me feel valued and appreciated as a new resident.

Overall, Sabine Apartments have set a high standard for what a rental experience should be, and exceeded my expectations in every way.

If you are looking for a place that combines outstanding service, high-quality living spaces, and a welcoming leasing office team, look no further. I highly recommend Sabine Apartments! Five Stars all the way!

I loved Sabine from my first tour! Karla walked me around and her friendly professionalism and warm personality made a great first impression of the staff. When I came back to finalize moving in, Megan walked me through every detail patiently and thoroughly. A few days later when I was ready to move in, Steven ensured a smooth transition by answering my remaining questions about the apartments.

While the apartment itself is amazing, it's truly the incredible office staff that sets Sabine apart. Anytime I have a need, the office team is always ready to help out fast.
and that really gives me a great peace of mind while living here.

Great management team! I was having some problems with paperwork from another company while trying to move here, and Megan, (office manager) stayed on them until it was done. There are plugs everywhere, which helps tremendously. Spacious closets and bathrooms. The living room, and bedrooms are small, but the new appliances and cabinet space are great. I do wish there was closer parking to our unit. There are plenty of shops, restaurants, and gas stations close too.

This apartment complex is truly amazing, It is very spacious and comfortable. There is so much natural lighting. It’s just very beautiful inside and outside. 

From the beginning of the process, the staff was very knowledgeable, helpful friendly. I have had the pleasure of meeting all four of the staff members. Starting with Steven, He helped me through the application process because I had lots of questions wanted to keep viewing Apartments so I can remember what they look like, and he always had a smile on his face and accommodated me, And second was Megan, She is so nice and helpful, and cheerful, always smiling and laughing as she communicates with you she has a wonderful personality. I got to meet Karla She also is Very friendly and knowledgeable about the leasing process she helped me get my renters insurance together and made sure that that was all taken care of. And last Charles that is maintenance there was one little thing that was going on nothing serious, but he came resolved the issue the first time and no problems since then and he as well was very nice. He even put those blue things on his feet so he didn’t get my floor dirty lol, he was very pleasant to talk to as he fixed the issue that I had. So I want to say kudos to this apartment complex there is not one person here that is not helpful and that is happy to be at work with a smile on their face. One last thing I love how they know you by name when they see you. If you want to call any place home for a very long time, Sabine is the place to be.

I couldn't be extatic over the management team at Sabine. They all were involved and very communicative through the whole process. Being a new apartment complex still partially under construction, there were changes on a daily basis and I was kept informed of any that might affect me whether big or small. The apartment is new, clean and spacious. I'm so glad I decided to take the tour along with the dozen or so other apartments I reviewed. I am very confident in my choice.

I just moved into the Enso Zen Apartments, and I’m loving it! The staff is super friendly, and the building is really well taken care of. My apartment is awesome, and the view is absolutely incredible. I also love how close it is to downtown, but it’s still easy to hop on the road and get to the mountains early for a ski day. So far, everything about living here has been amazing!

These apartments are beautiful, I love all of the finishes they have and the amenities are wonderful. The rooftop patio has stunning views of the mountains and downtown Denver, you get the best sunsets there. The office team is very friendly and helpful, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a new apartment.

I have lived here for roughly 2 months and honestly have no complaints. This place has it all. They are super dog friendly with a dog park, dog washing station, and dog friendly apartments. The staff is patient and friendly. The amenities are amazing with a rooftop lounge and a clean and spacious gym. Not only can you see the mountains from the rooftop but I have had company there and they are amazed. Your car has its own spot in the garage and keeps it safe. I recommend living here and I know I will be staying.

"I recently had the pleasure of living enzo zen in central Denver, and I couldn't be happier with my experience. The location is unbeatable—just steps away from vibrant restaurants, trendy cafes, and beautiful parks. The apartments are spacious and well-designed, with modern finishes that make you feel right at home.

The amenities are fantastic, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, a rooftop terrace with stunning views of the city, and a cozy lounge area perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. The management team is incredibly responsive and helpful, always ready to assist with any questions or concerns.

Overall, Enzoffers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to call home in Denver!"

May have a few bumps here and there but they have fast and reliable maintenance and the leasing office always respond quickly with any questions. Super dog friendly which is great for the fur babies. Very clean lobbies and well taken care of gardens, along with the courtyard and rooftop always being kept tidy, a lot of games and outside activities to do for families and for little ones.

I have been living at The Seasons for over a year now, and it has been a fantastic experience! The management team is always friendly and responsive. Meghan has been extremely helpful.  The amenities are top-notch, with a beautiful pool, a well-equipped gym, and great community spaces for gatherings. The grounds are always well-maintained, and I love how peaceful the environment is.

BROE Mgmt took over this property during the summer of 2023.  Broe seems unable to reasonably maintain the apartments and grounds.  Broe is also seriously lacking in reasonable communications with the residents.  Broe sends out short notice "move your stuff or it will be removed" notices.  The pool and hot tub was down for months during the Fall.  In a resident hallway, at one point, more than 5 cieling lights were out for an extended period of time.  When BROE first took over, they made investments in superficial aesthtetics, yet dont' seem to be focused on maintaining the property for residents.

I renewed my lease because I have loved it here for almost 3 years and trusted new ownership would keep it going. We have had nothing but problems ever since - elevators constantly broken in buildings and garage, hot water issues constant with frequent turn offs, repeated incidents of no heat, the jacuzzi was out of commission for over 3 months and then sporatic at best after that, half the washers and dryers are now broken regularly, the entry doors are broken regularly, the 'free' coffee machines are ALWAYS broken and/or unusable due to needing a rinse or a filter....the list goes on. Its absolutely insane how downhill this place has gone down with the new ownership. I am not a picky person but i wish I hadn't renewed. I stayed bc of the amenities, and now everything is broken and has been regularly for months. Its like whack-a-mole with what works on a daily basis. 

But hey, they offer free bagels and random things like that -- note to BROE, the residents dont care about cheap bagels and donuts when we can't do our laundry, have to carry things up 5 flights of stairs, and can't the amenities that we are already paying for!!

I seriously don’t think I would live here for free having experienced what I have in the last year and a half.

If you want a property that just slaps a bandaid on every issue. And I’m talking a dollar tree non waterproof with no adhesive off brand band aid then yeah; rent here.

First things first; when Red Peak owned this property the lobby in building A always had the heat on in the winter. Now, Broe owns this property and of course the heat is on in the winter in the C building where their office is, but no other building. It feels like a walk in cooler when you get off the elevator.

Second; my apartment unit is an absolute dump. The AC was broken from August to September with multiple calls to fix it. My garbage disposal broke and took 3 calls to fix it. My microwave broke in September with multiple calls to fix it, and they finally replaced it with an enormous microwave that takes up the very little counter space we have. It’s overlapping into the sink. Upon replacing it I was told that they would be ordering new ones in about a week. But maybe it’s like dog years and 7 months is a week. Who knows.

Thirdly; it takes a literal half hour for my shower to get hot in the primary bedroom, and while it’s heating the drain is clogged so it can easily overflow. Which you guessed it, I’ve called multiple times to get fixed.

These are a few of the issues I’ve encountered here. If I wrote them all it would be too long to read.
I have been addressing the trash issue with management since moving in six months ago. Their continued neglect has led to a rodent infestation in my apartment.

The application and leasing process were unnecessarily protracted due to poor communication. We had to pay an additional month's rent at our previous apartment because the Seasons couldn't get our apartment ready for move-in. Our apartment flooded due to broken pipes two floors above us. This is a chronic plumbing issue they did not warn us about (even though we asked about any such problems). We were in sub-standard temporary accommodations for months. When we were finally allowed to return to our home, we experienced significant disruptions due to ongoing construction above us, next door, in the hallway. Throughout, management avoided us when they could, lied to us when they couldn't avoid us. Contractors hired by RedPeak damaged our property. Initially, RedPeak promised to compensate us for the damage. While admitting responsibility for the damage, they have since declined to make this right. Overall, the property is poorly maintained.
