Secure entrances are often broken and either open without a fob or don't open at all. The dog park is in very poor condition, resulting in a number of injuries to dogs. The area around our building is an ongoing construction zone even though it was built a decade ago. We have restricted access to our home, to the parking garage, and to the rest of the property. Nightmare. Avoid.

This was my first apartment moving out of my parents house. There has been an issue since day one, first my dishwasher was broken (freshly renovated), then my sink was leaking had to have maintenance come out numerous times to come out and fix it. Even to the day of move out my kitchen sink was dripping. I put in multiple maintenance request for pest control and just basic maintenance and no one came, or I had to have them come out multiple times to fix the issue. This place also has a cockroach problem and won’t do anything about it. My AC went out (middle of august) right before I moved out put in 3 different maintenance request while also going to the office to have someone come out and look at it and no one ever came. It’s very hard to get a hold of the office, unless you wait at least 30 mins before you’re seen in the office. It’s a very noisy place to live, security and the office doesn’t do much. Pool wasn’t open unless there was a party in  the club house and the gym was never available. It took months until I was able to do the laundry in the shared laundry room and even then there were different occasions when the laundry room wasn’t available due to renovations, doors being locked (the keys that were given out didn’t even work), and the laundry keys are always out. Hopefully, you don’t make the same mistake I did with choosing this place to live in.

I have been out of hot water for several days now.  I cannot shower or bathe in the middle of winter because the water is freezing cold.  The emergency maintenance line doesn't work, the office isn't picking up during business hours, and I'm steadily growing angrier.  And that's just one issue.  Let's not forget that their primary payment method has been not working for close to a month now, along with all of their other systems.  And instead of giving the residents a more convenient method of payment in the interim, they tell us to figure it out and fine us for being late.  My bank does not offer their alternative methods, and they will not take card.  So I'm left kinda screwed here.  Worst of all, maintenance in my building doesn't speak any English.  And that part is fine if they took effort to translate certain things.  Instead though I can only get repairs when I'm in the apartment when they happen to come by (which is never scheduled, just sorta random) because the maintenance guy won't figure out what "Permission to enter when resident isn't home" means.   But hey.  Heated swimming pool I guess.  And a gym that's advertised but isn't actually open and hasn't been for months because "the equipment hasn't arrived yet."
No fire alarms or extinguishers. Multiple other tenants have complained and nothing has been done. And Now a fire broke out.

This place is a complete disaster. Trash everywhere. Police here every single week if not multiple times during the week. People constantly working on their garbage cars.  Leasing office is filled with rude and untrustworthy employees who do not care or try to help you at all. Constantly had issues with my heater which barely ever worked. Literally had to harass the leasing office multiple times per day just for them to “try” and make it over to my unit. The first week I lived here my heater didn’t work the entire time and I would wake up shivering, even with blankets on. The have ANCIENT heaters, and the water would go cold/hot at any given time while taking a shower.  Do NOT LIVE HERE. YOU WILL REGRET IT. DON’T SAY YOU WEREN’T WARNED.

The Ivy Crossing apartments have become an on going nightmare of issues, stress and feeling uncomfortable for the past 6 months. I would not advise living here unless you are renting a town house from the Ivy Crossing then those are luxurious compared to others.
What you get for the rent amount is above average. A few minutes from anything you need.

This is the only apartment complex I’ve lived in that has been infested with roaches. You quite literally see them in the halls. I’ve also seen mice and heard from my neighbors about bed bugs. It doesn’t get worse than this building. Please do not move here.

We have been living here for 3 months already and everything in here is breaking down. Water pipes break down inside the walls and make the place feel like it’s coming down. Everything about his place is is horrible and wouldn’t recommend anyone to live here.

My husband and I rented this apartment for one year we were never late on any of our payments but you were charged almost almost $340 to touch up a little blot of paint in the bedroom closet.so sad of them to charge us for something like that.
He only nice person at the Harper was Scott the manager.

I just toured The Harper and wow have they done a great job with the remodel.  I have lived in this area for years now and remember what an eye soar the building was, but not anymore.  The units look amazing and what amazing views of downtown and the mountains.  I can't wait until my lease is up in Feb so I can move in.  Great Job!!!

I’ve noticed roaches, rather large roaches in our apartment for months, it took weeks to even get someone up to spray, and it hasn’t worked at all. Management does not care about what is happening to their residents. The elevators constantly break, it can reach up to 85 degrees in my apartment because the heat is for the whole building not just by apartment. They make it look glamorous to get you to move in, meanwhile everything is falling apart.

Management and employees are super nice and helpful, and they keep the place running smoothly. Fresh air all the time, and the grounds are splendid. My apartment is spacious and comfortable, and I've never been put out by any of th amenities. 

LAUNDRY..
The laundry room is always clean, and having the trash shute right there is very helpful. ((Although sometimes the trash shute overflows on weekends when the employees are off)) But it's not a huge issue.

NEIGHBORS...
The neighbors are friendly and kind. There are a lot of families here and it shows with how people treat each other here. Everyone is holding open doors for each other and holding the elevator. It's a really nice environment and I'm glad to be a part of it.

PARKING...
The free parking is really nice. Spacious lots, easy to pull in and out of. There's enough people being busy that you can always find a good spot. 

The covered parking is really nice too, especially in the winter and hail months. 

KITCHEN...
My kitchen is awesome, my oven, dishwasher, and fridge all work flawlessly. 

I have run into a couple of bugs (NOT bedbugs) but seeing them was few and far between so I really haven't worried about it.

The disposal is really nice. And honestly I am in deep love with the dishwasher. Very effective. 

APARTMENT...
My balcony is spacious and I love chilling out on it. Facing west I get an awesome view of the mountains. 

Thick walls. I never hear any talking or footsteps from my neighbors. 

The carpets are SO SOFT and FLUFFY. I love the carpeting, very nice to walk on. 

WATER/BATH...
The water pressure here is amazing. I need to put my settings at a fraction of the power or else it feels like a cyclone. Gets hot quickly and I've never had a problem with it. 

I've never had any leaks or any issues with sink or toilet.

I love my home.

Where to start. After 17 years in LA I landed an opportunity that Involved me having to relocate to Denver. I lived in the best of the best neighborhoods in LA. I had never been to Denver. I looked at SO MANY places and when I tell you so many I looked at a lot of places. Literally found this 24 hrs before I signed with a place a block from them ( I had even placed a holding fee but they refused to refund it ?? but that’s how much Helios is worth it)  Something told me to stop by. I was greeted by Alissa. From the moment I walked in .. her attention to detail. I didn’t feel like this was a transaction. I told her what I wanted and she found me what I was looking for. Every email was answered immediately! I feel safe when I’m here. Moving can be so stressful. But when I tell you Alissa made it easy! The moving company from LA almost had me at a breaking point. But the team at Helios made sure I was well taken care of. I had last minute deliveries and they effectively communicated my deliveries to me. Thank you to Kellie for making sure I was comfortable. The location is perfect. I couldn’t be any happier. Oh and thank you Engineer Chad. Alissa!! I will always be thankful to call Helios home because of you queen!!
We love living here! The staff is amazing, the property is well cared for, the location is very walkable!
The entire team at Helios makes this an incredible place to live. How many places have you lived that make life easier for you? Exactly. Helios is that place.

Love the apartment layout, very spacious, huge closets and bathroom, beautiful cabinets and very nice washers dryers, dishwashers and oven. Clean hallways and great decor. Feels upscale without extreme prices. Love it!! Highly recommended.
Helios apartments is a very nice place to call home. Professional office employees and maintenance workers.
We love it here, the team is great, the building is kept up nicely!

The loudest (and most expensive) apartment I’ve ever lived in. I can hear every footstep from my upstairs neighbors -it shakes my unit and rattles my light fixtures. Earplugs, white noise machines and noise canceling headphones are the only way I can get some peace (but still woken up regularly). It is very hard to sleep, work from home or relax with all the noise/ vibrations and is severely effecting my life. Management has yet to take any action besides offering me to transfer units which would come with a transfer fee, increased rent and moving costs. Horrible experience. 

*this is all my opinion and based on my personal experience. Hoping to help others avoid what could be a very long year for them.

I love living here. Sold my house and went back to apartment living and I cousins be happier with my choice. Sequel is so nice, the units are all great quality, the clubhouse is awesome and the rental rate is fair.

the mailroom is a hot spot for criminals to enter and steal out packages. It has happened to me many times. 
Also, I was hit with many fees when I transferred from my old unti to my new one.

Pleasant place to live, albeit very over priced. The rail makes for a lot of disturbances while watching movies. And the amount of dust you will contend with is something to marveled. And lets not forget that the water from the tap basically has sand in it(figuratively speaking), but for now it's "newness" still makes up for most of the short comings.

I loved moving in and living here! Move-in everything was done ahead of time and the staff communication was great. I literally had to go in on move in day and it took 5 mins to get keys and paperwork and that was it! They give lots of flexible options to pay rent and everything is detailed and laid out for you.
Wow great friendly staff !! I loved the tour. Manager is fantastic, very helpful and very nice. I would recommend to all friends and family
Sequel is a great community! It's quiet and the location is convenient.
Great community.  Management is attentive, amenities are top notch, common areas are kept clean. Lots of nice Landscaping.  9 foot ceilings are a nice touch.

I love living at Sequel. The apartments are very nice and it does not feel overcrowded. The amenities are amazing & staff are very friendly. 
- Courtney A
Great apartment community with a modern architectural design and thoughtfully laid out units with higher end fixtures.  All the amenities you could ask for.  Excellent service from the staff.  A
we love it here, very nice location, very professional and helpful staff, spacious and beautiful living space with great views
Sequel is a great place to live! The location is fantastic and it’s quiet. Staff is responsive and truly care about your comfort and needs.
So happy with my choice to rent at Sequel! I would recommend.

I'ma current renter at Sequel and it really is not worth is to lease here. its new and looks nice but the management/leasing team is terrible at getting back to residents and have had all the luxurious common area they advertise and have pictures of closed all weekend. They don't tell they only have it open from 10-6 M-F, and then 9-5 on Sat. It's closed from 5 pm Saturday until 10 am Monday which is when the majority of users would want to use it. Management has received 10+ residents complaints about this issue and does nothing to remedy it.  They also charge you common area fees/electricity whether you can utilize it or not. Plus they continue to rapidly increase rent despite poor access to the amenities and issue during their build. 

-Constant shorts with electric appliances that rip the breaker and make cooking a hassle.
- advertise a tv in the gym with app access but have no control to make it useable
-charge an extra $9 per month on processing fee for rent payment even if you use a bank/e check
-package room is overwhelmed with carriers just dumping packages as they don't have access to the locker/the room itself
-trains are pretty noisy and run mostly at nighttime. lots of freight trains; the light rail isn't bad
-you don't get a key; just a key fob for your unit and for which is a pain to use vs a regular key
-garages and poor and hav broken multiple times already; super tiny too.
-charge you for outdoor parking but the lots doesn't even have painted lines still

there's just better options in the area for the cost. places with common areas you can actually use and more attentive leasing staff. rapidly increasing rent and don't negotiate at all.

Overall turning into a poor value. No weekend common area access.even weekday access closes at 6.

Property management team is not very responsive with issues/complaints.

Already have had maintenance having to enter my place more in the 2 months here than the previous 2.5 yrs I lived at my last place. And this is to replaced chipped/dented appliances the builders damaged during construction…seems like a quick walk thru PRIOR to move in would have been easy to spot and reduce this inconvenience. 

Multiple days they have done follow-up work that didn’t allow use of garage. Had to re do sealing the pavement yet still haven’t painted lines…likely needing another day without access.

Had a community get together with some raffles but then never proceed to give the prizes out. Then never sent an email out about who received them. Seems pretty suspect/ shady and seems like the management team pocket for themselves. No alcohol offered.

Pretty complex. Just poor management and value for what you pay for. There are lots of other new complexes in the area with amenities that you can actually utilize and much more responsive management teams.
Es el mejor lugar seguro limpio y bello que eh vivido tiene una espectacular vista a la montaña es genial

My apartment is fabulous... the space is efficiently laid out and beautiful, and the appliances are top-notch.  All-in all, my unit is very luxurious!  
The on-site management is readily available and is ALWAYS very responsive and friendly!

It's an absolute pleasure to live here!

Professional, relatable, relational! Super friendly staff. Quick to respond and provide any help needed, whether it be maintenance or leasing office related. Incredible area - quick to downtown, and quick to the mountains. Great location with all the stores I need nearby. Pool area is also amazing! Absolutely love it here!

So far, living here has been great. The location is great, the community / neighborhood is quiet, neighbors are friendly, and the staff is great. They are attentive to your needs, quick to respond, take action, & make you feel cared for.

The property and tenants seem nice, but the staff is understaffed and rude.

We drove 60 miles to view a few more places and were prepared to sign a lease, however, the staff would not take time to spend with us despite us having an appointment.

The staff does not answer phone calls, despite having a concierge.

Also, we saw numerous doors propped open, allowing local homeless to access the tenant's front doors and vehicles.
I love living here. I'm incredibly happy with Kent Place. I have made some wonderful friends here. This home!
I love living here. I hope after Covid, Kent Place will be the wonderful apartment building that I moved into 6 years ago.
Gorgeous property that has been run into the ground. Ownership has either forgotten that they own it, or feels that the market is so hot right now, that they can spend zero dollars on upkeep.
If there is ever a problem with anything in our apartment home someone is always there to help and I really appreciate that!

I just love it here. I have been here for over six years. There is no better location. Everything is next door, bank, grocery, liquor, restaurants, and now Nail Salon. It is like living in a hotel, and my apartment is beautiful.
Pest problem for this complex. Stay away from here.

I would not recommend anyone to move here. My apartment has mice and they do the very minimum to resolve the problem. My car was stolen in broad daylight and 6 months later someone tried to steal my new car. People leave their old furniture at the dumpsters frequently and there's trash left on the ground around the dumpsters. The neighbors are noisy and I'm constantly calling the office to ask them to talk to them. If you value your peace of mind, you won't have it living here. I'd give them a 0 but it's not an option.

Horrible place to live. Every month I've been here I've had to deal with a loss of power, water, and/or heat. The emergency maintenance crew told me to boil water when I had no heat or hot water when I called to report the issue. We haven't been able to use mailboxes due to vandalism for two months forcing us to go to the post office to pick up our mail. There is a playground area for children but it is usually filled with children spewing curses, causing property damage, and throwing trash everywhere. Despite paying for a two bedroom apartment, I am only allowed one parking spot, regularly forcing me to park on the other side of the complex. The laundry facilities are a constant mess with detergent splashed all over the machines and trash on the floor. The staff is rude and will attempt to blame the first person they can find for damage or pet waste without actually trying to deal with the problem. Management will schedule "inspections" so they can send people into the apartments to spy on you without actually breaking the law. Do not move here if you care about your health or well-being.

I've lived here for a year now, and this is easily the biggest steal in Denver (even in the middle of COVID). Reasonable pricing for a clean, spacious but cozy apartment, great location, very responsive and helpful staff, consistent, friendly maintenance everywhere, perfect amenities in spite of COVID, excellent sound insulation, and an overall calm, safe vibe (seems like many families from all over the country and world).

If I could afford it alone, I would stay in a heartbeat for much longer, but the studio is pretty pricey :(. Definitely recommend to anyone with roommates/SO or a sizeable solo income.

Hunter’s Run has been a wonderful renting experience for me. Front desk staff is always very nice and helpful, especially Samantha! Maintenance repairs don’t take too long to be completed, and most of the people who live here are pretty friendly. Hot tub is also open year-round! 

The only reason I can’t give Hunter’s Run 5 stars is because the parking is obscene. It’s obvious at some point they tried to add more parking spaces to their (still) too small parking lots, and these new spaces are very small and hard to get into, especially when your neighbors seem to not care about their parking jobs. If you’re coming home after 8 pm, don’t expect to get a spot anywhere near your building.

We moved here in May to escape another crummy apartment. While the windows and laundry room are a perk, we haven't found much else to brag about. The structural integrity of the building is horrible and we can hear every step our upstairs neighbors take; our downstairs neighbors can hear everything we're doing, too (and she's certified psycho, don't even wanna go there). There are raccoons in the dumpsters, the parking spots are SO small even for my teeny tiny car and our cars were instantly banged up. We often have to park on the street. There are people screaming and fighting and throwing stuff outside every other day. If it weren't for all the other people surrounding us, however, it is a fairly decent apartment. Front desk has always worked with us on repairs. If you have a package delivered and it goes to the office, they have a room full of packages that anyone can just take from. I send packages to my parent's house now.

Friendly environment. Office staff always courteous and quick to respond. Can be a little loud with little kids running around but that doesn't bother me.  It's nice to have a place I can go home to and relax.

For the price there's nothing better in Denver. But the maintenance is awful, they take forever to come out and fix anything. The fix is only a cover up and doesn't last. My sink has so much gunk on it that it can never look clean. Management knew I was moving in across from a wife beater and never told me. And the property manager has a nasty temper. He yells, curses and hangs up on people. If you're desperate I get it. But I wouldn't if you don't have to.

While this is neither luxury living nor trendy, it's still a place I'd be proud to show to Grandma.  It's just the basics one needs to make a few walls into a space that feels like home.  The apartments are older, but are well cared for. The grounds are well-maintained, everything from pretty landscaping to the parking lot being kept clean and surfaced well through the seasons.  Really nice office staff, who are responsive and intelligent, and seem to communicate efficiently with one another.  The amenities are numerous: multiple swimming pools, hot tubs, workout facilities, covered parking available (for extra, per usual).  And the price point is affordable!  The action of Denver's various scenes are within fairly close reach, as are commodious routes to the mountains.  Yet the neighborhood and apartment community reflect sleepy suburbia and respectful tenants who keep quiet hours well.

I was shown an apartment but it was the faster tour I have ever taken. Leasing agent said they didn't know when they would have a vacancy. This apartment has over 300 apartments - odd that every unit is filled.

Just moved in with their “special” they were right about there not being any parking, even during the day there’s nothing available!!! Their whole lot is filled with covered parking…. Guess im going to have to pay extra, this is ridiculous smh

They have more car ports than anything!!!! If you come past 5pm, GOODLUCK!!! Just know you’re gonna be putting in those steps everyday when it comes to parking. People bring multiple vehicles to “work on” and never get moved after. Oh, and don’t get me started on the amount of vehicles they break into, glass shattered on the floor, cars stolen, and vandalized, etc. No cameras and many residents come home drunk and hit cars not knowing how to park and just drive off like nothing because they refuse to install cameras and have security so everyone knows they get away with it. They are money hungry so they will spend the least on their property but do the most to get money out of you!!!! If only I could put pictures to not sound so exaggerated of the things I have seen within the small timeframe of living here. Please spend your money elsewhere, not worth it living here.

great apt, good price, good location, but absolutely horrible when you live below a neighbor where their dog is out 24 hours a day with 0 water, barking all day to where you lose sleep, being hit, with the owner not doing anything about it nor animal control, or parliament. All the reasons to move out. other than that, it’s A-ok

No parking, be prepared to walk from the main road. My vehicle was towed from my paid parking spot. First they said permits were not required and never said there was a policy change for reserved, paid spots- refuse to refund me. 
The hot water heater above me burst, water was running into my closet. At 3 a.m. maintenance told me to go knock on my neighbors door. Maintenance didn't show up for 36 hours and told me to just keep a trash can under the drip and empty it when it was full, as if I didn't have to go to work. I had to call and get them to bring me a fan to dry it, I seemed to be the only one who cared about water damage.

Lived here around 6 weeks now and the property itself is wonderful. The trails, pool, landscaping and floor plans are great! My only compliant is that maintenance is not as efficient as I’d prefer. Note: the underground garage exit door has been broken since before I moved in (a friend informed me) and, there is a staircase in which the key-access handle has been broken for quite some time. These are 2 MAJOR security concerns of mine. 

Denver is pretty safe, however, this property doesn’t seem 100% secure — if you’re a single woman or a wary person, I may consider looking into a property that has better security.

I'm totally miserable living at Parliament Apartments. The floors are paper thin and you can hear everything! I moved in a few months ago and I live on the 2nd floor and recently I've noticed lots of noise coming from unit above. I thought to myself oh someone moved in because I haven't been bothered by the noise before. A week in and it was unbearable and I asked Parliament Management to see if there was something wrong up there because of all the banging, loud footsteps, etc. Raija the property manager said she has to ask for permission to get into the unit above to check out what was going on and told me to file a formal noise complaint with them. A couple of days later I filed the noise complaint and Raija tells me that they are doing renovating the unit above and that it'll take another 10 days or so. It's be a total of 2 months of loud noise I have to deal with. The footsteps alone are loud and makes lots of popping noises.... I'm frustrated because she should've told me in advance that they were going to do renovations and she should've told me when I asked her in person instead of lying and making up things up that there was a resident above. I highly don't recommend this place, I can't wait for our lease to be up.

I have been living at the Parliament for about a year and two months now and my entire experience has been nothing short of amazing! I moved in as a single female with a front door/patio leading to an open air stairwell and never felt like the area or community was dangerous. We had a top floor apartment which helped negate any neighbor noise and the community itself was relatively quiet at all hours of the day and night (including weekends). There are numerous patio areas with grills that can be rented for special occasions (even holidays!) and a large heated pool/jacuzzi. I will admit the heated pool still feels cold all the time, but honestly I don't want to swim when it's cold outside anyways. We recently moved into a slightly larger apartment in one of the enclosed buildings with included underground parking. This has been an amazing step up. The hallways do occasionally smell of Pot, and considering it is a drug free community it can be slightly annoying, but it is nothing you wouldn't experience anywhere else in Denver. Our move was easy and seamless. The property manager, Rajaa, is literally a life saver. She is always thrilled to see both my boyfriend and myself, is incredibly helpful especially as I was having trouble getting my rent to go through the online system (my debit cards fault), the entire staff is welcoming, my mail isn't ever stolen (because apartments suck and neighbors suck sometimes), and the renovated apartments are beautiful!  I am sure no apartment can have a 100% success rate but I am more than happy to call the Parliament my home!

Pro's: the granite looks nice and doesn't clash with the cabinets
Con's: my water heater was set to an unreasonable 150 degrees when I moved in and cost a fortune in gas. I realized how hot it was after nearly burning myself in the shower. My wash machine was installed improperly, had a broken hose, and was using hot water instead of cold water for three months. Guess how many sweaters and work clothes were ruined?

I've received no apologies from the front office for the above problems. I'm a reasonable person and I understand that mistakes happen, but to not receive at least an apology is just disrespectful. I've seen a number of interactions in the front office that were just rude and that's my biggest complaint about Parliament. They are either incredibly incompetent and mismanaged, or there's an enormous hole in oversight.

Also, the walls and floors/ceilings are paper thin and I can hear my neighbors snore, cough, and play the guitar. I've been here for months and my unit still smells like paint. 

Don't do it. Live anywhere else.

The leasing office is full of inept people, who never answer the phone.  The hot tub has been broken for OVER A YEAR, despite the office telling everyone that it will be fixed "soon".  Don't move into a first floor apartment in buildings 6 or 7, you will flood-- and they won't fix it. Our place was flooded for so long, we were able to break our lease, but we tried to work with the leasing office to stay at the complex (we just didn't want to move) but no one gave us all the information, or gave away the apartments we thought we secured.  The price may be right for the size apartment, and the fact that you are not too far from both the Southmoor and Belleview Light Rail stations, but there are nicer places that have a staff that is better equipped.  

The one star is to the maintenance staff, who tries to keep up with the falling apart buildings.  They were always courteous and responded fast to emergencies, they were just trying to keep it all together as best they could. They were the only people in the complex that won't lie to you about the state of the buildings.

I have lived here for about a year and have had nothing but great experiences. It's a very nice community with great amenities and friendly, helpful staff. The grounds are kept beautiful and maintenance requests are completed promptly. I've just renewed my lease for another year. It's a great place for pets, too. Parking is slightly problematic, but I've never had major issues with it as I rent a covered reserved spot (which I recommend). It's a great location right in DTC within minutes of shopping and restaurants. It's also great as it's right where I-25 and I-225 connect, so it's super convenient to get around Denver.

I've lived in the Parliament Apartments in Denver for a month now. So far I like it. It's pretty quiet, hardly ever hear anyone. My particular building has an underground parking which will be nice when it snows. It's pricey, but everything is pricey in Denver now so at least you get a lot of ammenities for what you pay.

We recently moved to Denver and blindly went into our apartment hunt from a different state. After frustration at the amount of apartments in Denver, we decided to just take the plunge and commit to a lease at Parliament. Upon moving in we had some issues with construction after renovations, but since then we've had no issues and feel safe in our home. Rent is reasonable and the apartment staff and maintenance is helpful and friendly. We once had a maintenance member help us get a wallet out of our car and put it in safe keeping when we were in another state as we were in fear someone would try to break in to the car if the wallet was in plain sight. The only complaint I have is that one of our cars did get broken into once through an unlocked trunk, nothing was stolen but some change but still made us more cautious. 

Overall, the pool is nice, the fitness center is ok (there's no tv's which is kind of a bummer), but all the amenities are more than adequate. We're about 1 mile north of the tech center and a mile and a half away from the Highline Canal trail. We are happy with choosing Parliament as our first apartment home in Denver.
Complex has very nice outdoor space. Nice location in nice area. Apartments are well maintained.

I have not been happy with the management team at this complex. They lost my original lease and my notice to vacate. I was told by other tenants that they do this on purpose so they can charge you an additional fee for not giving 60 day notice.
I have also had problems with maintenance. My apartment flooded and when I called the emergency number they told me they could be out in the morning. I have requested they fix my dishwasher 5 times and it still does not work. They also changed my filter in my heating unit and let the heat run at 100 degrees until I returned home at 8pm to find everything in my apartment was melted or spoiled and my plants were dead. I was not able to stay at my apartment that night because I could not get it cooled down and the management team did not even apologize. 
I am excited to be moving out.

Maintenance has not come once in the 10 months I’ve lived here. There is dog poop, broken glass, and trash all over the complex every single day. Off leash dogs everywhere and a crazy man that wanders around the parking lot. Management is incredibly rude and condescending and will do anything in their power to make money off of you.

Currently still live here and it’s literally not worth it. Was told we’d get a new fridge, dishwasher, and sink upon moving in… 4 months in and still have not received anything while the dishwasher and sink break once a week. Still have missing cabinets.. and they just don’t care about tenants issues. Do not move here.

Literally had to pursue legal action to get my heating fixed with temperatures dropping to freezing. Maintenance was great and tried to help but Management was refusing to seek outside help and had zero communication until I gave them the legal notice. And also the accounting portion is messed up with rent fluctuating monthly by 400$ with no apparent reason.

I've lived here for 3 years and the past 6 months have been enough to convince me that I am not safe living here anymore. The new management company does not care about the safety of their tenants or tenants property. Every car under my buildings car port has been broken into. A car was stolen, phones stolen from car, key locks completely stripped, car windows broken, documents thrown all around. The office asked me "what I want them to do about it" and when I said we want security they said they are "working on it". Myself and neighbors have all filed police reports for our situations but it's not the responsibility of the police to ensure the security of an apartment complex- it's the property managements! I am appalled by the lack of security measures taken from a place whose residence are getting robbed and property damage weekly. If you value yourself and your property-find somewhere else to live.

The ONLY reason you should settle for this place is if you have more than two pets and you can't get in anywhere else. If you are older, have special needs, or have kids, understand that your health, safety, and needs are not priorities to the office staff.

We rented here from Oct 2019-July 2020. We never really had any issues until our outdated, ancient half washer/dryer broke in the spring right as Covid started. We had to initiate every conversation with the office staff and ended up having to use a laundromat during a pandemic despite paying astronomical rent to have access to our own sad excuses for appliances. The office staff continuously churned out excuses and lies about when our unit would be replaced or fixed. After (lying) telling us that they were planning to pull one out of another unit and admitting to not having anything on hand/backups in case of malfunction, they continuously sent an independent contractor to our apartment. They usually called to let us know he was coming about 30-45 minutes AFTER he showed up. From March/April to the day we moved out in July, we had no functioning washer and a handful of excuses from office staff. We reached out to Greystar, the parent company, several times and never heard anything back. By the time I started to lose patience with the inept office staff, they had resorted to throwing the maintenance team under the bus and shifting blame. We gave up and moved.

For the amount of rent paid, this place is a train wreck. Tenants' balconies/patios are dry rotted and falling apart, siding falling off of buildings, broken sprinkler systems drenching the parking lots and sidewalks, overflowing trash cans of dog poop bags, overflowing dumpsters, etc.

It also says a lot about the office staff that they removed my HONEST, fact-based review from Google. They do not want people to know what a mess this place is because they have to compete with so many other complexes.

GO SOMEWHERE ELSE. Seriously, you have options.
Friendly management and move in process was easy/excellent. Apartment was in great shape.
Loved living here. A few random fire alarms as people noted but much improved over the last year. Really enjoyed the community and the frequent food trucks was a really cool touch.

Apartment constantly has fire alarms going off, there have been police incidents here multiple times this past year, and you can no longer receive packages directly on site. Neighbors are loud, there have been multiple raves here in the past year which shake the building. I encourage any renter to review the most recent reviews. Positive reviews from 5 years ago are from different management.

Since moving here my vehicle has been broken into twice in less than a month, as well as mail packages being stolen from mail room. Management is not going to invest in security even tho theft incidents have skyrocketed. Also fire alarms at 3 am.

I've lived here since 2021 and it was fine until the past year. Mail theft is RAMPANT as are car break-ins and the garage door breaks at least once a week. The fire alarm goes off at all hours to the point residents don't even leave (don't worry, management sends an email the next day thanking us for our patience!). They refuse to invest in security cameras of any kind and are vague and evasive about how they're addressing the issues at hand. I can't wait to move

I would second guess moving here. I moved here because it was in a good location for a good price and I now understand why the price was good. From broken doors that get fixed and broke again 2 days later, to fire alarms going off at 2 am, to packages getting stolen, to garage doors not working, this place is a mess. The issue is that the company that owns the place is cheap as hell and doesn’t want to invest in the property to make it any better. They just put duct tape over the issues and nothing ever is actually fixed. Now they’re attempting to get $20 a month for a BS for a terribly reviewed delivery service called “Fetch” because they don’t want to invest in a camera system. This place is a joke.

Have been here a little over a year and the fire alarms go off constantly. Water is constantly shut off. There is always poop in the hallways and people leave trash everywhere. Would not recommend especially after how high they just raised prices.

They will take your deposit and send you an outrageous bill after you move out regardless how clean the apartment is, or how long you've lived there, or how good of a tenant you were, or how clean you get the apt, or how much you spend on cleaning supplies, or the hours you spend cleaning, they take your deposit and send you an outrageous bill. It's all about money to them.

I'm just warning you.

The parking is also terrible, and you get to stare at nasty trash everyday when you pull into the apartment as they are never cleaning up by the trash.

Upon moving in:
-The apartment was FILTHY. We had to go out and buy a vaccuum and mop before we could even bring our belongings inside.
-Ice machine in fridge didn’t work
-stove didn’t work
-master bathroom door didn’t close

While we lived there:
-Trash EVERYWHERE. ALL. THE. TIME.
-When you walk to your apartment, you’re walking through mountains of trash bags. 
-Seriously, there’s trash everywhere. Even when it’s 90+ degrees outside. So in addition to trash everywhere, there's huge flies and rancid stink. Management does NOTHING about it (I contacted them more than once in regard to my neighbor leaving bags of trash and bags of dog poop outside of their door and they did nothing.
-You have to pay $30/month for “valet trash removal” and there is no way to opt out.
-There is also a mountain of trash by the dumpsters every weekend. 
-Our dishwasher broke and was “fixed”, broke again/was not ever actually fixed and took 3 months for it to be replaced (the woman in the office will tell you “its so hard to get replacements for appliances”. No, that’s not what happened because as soon as I called and made a big fuss, I had a replacement the next day.)
-Our refrigerator broke
- The grounds are pretty gross, there is limited grass and the grass they do have is yellowed with dog pee.
-The office staff doesn’t contact you via phone or email regarding any issues, they will leave a paper notice on your door at the very end of the day so you can’t contact them that day. 
-Office staff is very rude, condescending and unhelpful.
-They will nickel and dime you at every possible opportunity. Expect to pay $100-300 more per month than what is quoted on the website
	-$30 valet trash removal
	-$20 “real estate fee”
-$30-40 CAM (common area maintenance) fee. Not sure how that one can fluctuate, but it does. Not to mention lights in the outside hallways are always out and not replaced
-$8 per month PER CAR for parking
-$6 “Service Fee”
-$2 to pay rent online, which you can’t opt-out of.

-We left the apartment in MUCH better condition than when we moved in, and were still charged $135 cleaning fee in addition to not getting our $250 deposit back. We requested an “in-person” move-out inspection, and the woman in the office was surprised we asked for it, and the “inspection” she did was not the same inspection that I was emailed about, with photos and notes. I would have much preferred to have been present for the inspection that resulted in charges.

We really enjoyed living there however when we moved out they billed us over 1K in cleaning fees that included maintenance requests over 12 months (broken blinds, stove pans, and even a pigeon family as pests on the balcony) this however was put on our bill. They never gave us an option for security deposits. The pictures they took were of broken appliances requested for maintenance. Moral of the story is great place to live but when you leave they milk you as much as possible.

I didn't even see the apartments in person before I signed my lease, I trusted the positive comments that people wrote and weighed the negative ones. That being said, I don't regret my decision! I love living here.

I selected an upper priced one bedroom apartment with an attached garage so that I wouldn't have any "parking issues". I paid a little more and complain a whole lot less (funny how that works, right?). I have lived in places that only allow street parking and it sucked! I have lived places that only let you have two cars on a lease no matter how many people/cars you had, and guess what? It SUCKED. People complained there wasn't enough parking, so M2 enforced two cars per apartment rules and then people complained there weren't enough passes. How can you win with that mentality? (You can't). When I needed an extra place to park, I walked into the office and asked to be put on the carport waiting list. Problem solved. They have garages and car ports for rent and apartments with garages attached. Solve your own problem. Can't afford the extra cost per month? That's coo! We aren't all made of money, but don't complain about it. 

The front office staff are wonderful, truly. What people don't understand is they don't own the complex! They can only do so much! Someone puts money down and passes the background check? You're allowed to lease here. They aren't allowed to discriminate. If they pass the necessary steps to live here there is nothing the office can do! The maintenance team is sorely understaffed, which speaks volumes to the amount of stuff one guy can get done in the complex. Bart is wonderful and will take care of anything, you just gotta give him some time! 

I love that they provide FREE poop bags for dogs at various spots throughout the community, and I love the bark park. While I wish it were bigger (see, no apartment is perfect!) it is awesome to even have one available in the community. I have never had a problem with the smell in the year that I have been here. Poop, yes. But, again, that's every apartment! Some people just suck! 

Yes the walls could be thicker, yes people that don't follow the rules suck. BUT! The finishes are high end for the price point, the storage units are ample and work while, the grounds are wonderfully kept, and the pool is year round. 

My only complaint is that they raise the prices for people that renew, but that isn't something the front office can fix. That's something corporate america needs to fix!

DO NOT RENT HERE!!!!!  I have never written a review before.  But, they convinced me I should.  
The day we moved in, the apartment was filthy, and this was after we had to wait a week for them to 'get it ready' for us to move in.  There were dog prints all over the place.  We don't own a dog.   When my wife called and said it was dirty, she was told "It's not dirty, it just looks dirty"  It stopped looking dirty after we cleaned it.  
Also when we moved in, the air handling unit made a horrible metal on metal banging noise every time it was running.  When we complained about that, we were told that that was the way it was supposed to sound and there was nothing they could do about it.  Finally after repeated complaints they begrudgingly sent someone from maintenance to look at it, and in short time they were able to make the banging noise go away.
We lived there for 1 year, and parking was woefully inadequate.  
I have seen tenants come to management with a concern and be immediately disregarded.  I have even been present when the staff encouraged tenants that if they didn't like it, they should break their lease and move somewhere else, rather than try to help. Of course if you break your lease, you owe 2 months rent.
The management does not care about it's tenants. But, they sure care about their money.  
We wanted to move in on the 1st of the month, but they couldn't have it ready for us until they 8th. We signed a 12 month lease.  We gave 60 days written notice and at the end of the 12 months, we moved.  Because they couldn't get the place move in ready until after the 1st, they tacked on an entire extra month to the end of the lease.  Making me pay 13 months for a 12 month lease, because they couldn't move me in sooner.
The manager is arrogant and condescending, and absolutely does not care when you have a problem.  The assistant manager is just as bad.  The only nice person is the front desk girl.  But there is only so much she can do.  The people with the power treat the residents like second class citizens and then act like they should appreciate it.
The apartments are nice, they are pretty.  Not especially high quality construction.  But, not matter how nice the apartments are, the management makes it not worth it.  
Find another place to live.

We have lived here at M2 for two years and it has drastically gone down in quality. It starts with the property switching owners 3 different times, three different management companies and the newest office personnel are horrible at customer service.  The latest fiasco is the new assigned parking system that punishes tenets that lives here who has more than one vehicle. Each apartment (no matter how many bedrooms) gets only one assigned parking space! The other spaces are first come, first serve which is not enough for all the residents who live here and by 6pm there is NO PLACE TO PARK. The management has a solution that will get you booted--park over at the Cosco parking lot. Literally said that!

The property manager is rude, disrespectful, power-hungry and condescending. If you choose to move here, remember you will have no place to park, nor will your guests have a place to park and that 100% accurate.

CoLab Apartments has exceeded my expectations! The modern design and amenities make it a fantastic place to live, but what really stands out is the customer service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and genuinely cares about the residents. They helped me with everything from the application process to settling in, making the transition smooth and enjoyable. I feel truly valued as a resident here. If you’re looking for a community that combines comfort with exceptional support, I highly recommend CoLab Apartments!

Wont let me get a key fob for my girlfriend so I'm leaving a one star review in spite (they still deserve the one star). Honestly the living isn't terrible I found in to be much better than the assembly but the management is terrible and the prices are pretty meh for what you get. We have had maintenance requests in for months and nothing they actually closed one of mine marked it as complete and never did anything which is a joke but kind of how it goes so it's not to surprising. I honestly feel that the colab isn't to bad and some of the amenities are not to bad like the gym and the pool. I really hate the valet trash service I think it's stupid: stinks up the halls and trash is everywhere there are literally dumpsters out back and I don't see why they force us to pay for it when we could go throw it away ourselves. The halls are just disgusting throw up everywhere and just dirty but it's a college housing so what can you do. I don't mind the colab it's ok for what you get but I just don't understand why I can get a key fob for my partner when she practically lives here I understand there are rules but still it's ridiculous not to mention it's $75 for a new one. Last thing if you're unlucky and don't get a room with a window it feels like a prison cell like ya it's not terrible and the bathroom is really nice but no window is painful and the walls are practically paper thin so you here everything from party's next door to just loud roommate's but these things are not to big of a deal for me and I can deal with it. Don't understand some of the policies and why some of the management are even management when they don't know anything and always have to call or ask someone else my question like why are u even there but I digress I would not recommend living here but it could be worse. (Give me another key fob)

DO NOT LIVE HERE. I would give zero stars if I could.

Do not let your kids live here, if you want to be a good parent.

If you think they are fixing the problems of all the bad reviews, they are not. Colab apartments are the worst possible choice when moving to Denver. I tell everyone who visits me its a really nice apartment if you squint your eyes and plug your nose.

Since my time living here I have experienced
- lost packages due to the ill-considered mail system because if the office is closed, mailmen cannot get packages into the mailroom and will leave them at the front door.
- maintenance taking 2 months to fix my freezer while it was unusable
- took almost half a year to fix my roommates toilet causing us to share, when we pay extra for separate bathrooms
- peephole on my door has been missing for over a year
- dismissed me for my own parking space, in place of people who got on the waiting list after me
- failed to clean vomit off the floor for over a week on several occurrences
- failed to replace exit signs and leave loose wires hanging from the ceiling
- failed to fix the hinges of the front door of the building, but "fixed" it by placing a sign to close the door, which this is unsafe due to the location we are at, and that any one can enter the building if the door is not properly shut.


And above all else, my roommate's car was stolen from the street down from the apartment since there was street paving, which the residents were never notified about, and was unable to get back into the garage. Her rental car was then towed. She was told verbatim, that she is responsible for the rental car towing fee since there was no permit sticker, even though the office was closed when she got back home with the rental car. She would then have to leave the rental car on the street which her car got stolen from originally until she received a new sticker.

If you plan on touring this apartment, ask to be taken to the 2,3, or 4th floor because they only clean the first and fifth level.

The new community manager Emily states that this place has gotten better since she took over in August, but I disagree completely as it is now an unclean and hazard living space. They are rude and dismissive when faults are brought up to them. Therefore, nothing is going to get better since they since no error on their part.

I hate going out my way to write a review, but CoLab is a uniquely terrible place to live. They mainly rent to young adults right out of high school, so expect loud parties all weekend, throw up in hallways, Dog Crap on every floor, empty beer cans everywhere, and VANDALISM. Vandalism might be the worse thing about CoLab, it was super common for people to steal and destroy property, for example the nearly all Exits signs in the building were stolen and even your room number signs were stolen too. Oh yeah and you DO NOT even have access to dump your own trash, they have you leave it in the hallway all day until they collect it. So the entire building SMELLS TERRIBLE. And once you sign that lease THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT YOU. Don’t do it, don’t move into CoLab or any Greystar properties. 

I hope this helps people

You will be charged for damage regardless of who caused it.  If you don't pay, it goes to collections.  Just a really poorly run complex with zero accountability and response from principals.

   My son, a full-time student and full-time employed worker, lived there from 2019 to 2021 while finishing school.  His roommates were unknown to him on move-in and assigned by COLAB.  Two of his roommates who were not students and unemployed decided to get a puppy shortly after they moved in.  They didn't notify my son they were getting a dog.  The dog wrecked some furniture and the two dog owners and dog soon left the apartment never to return.  My son notified COLAB management of the issue of damaged furniture and the vacated roommates and dog.  Management advised that they couldn't replace any furniture until move out date, but to "rest assured that the owners of the dog would be charged for any damage".  This is all documented in emails with management.
   
My son graduates and moves out in August of 2021.  Shortly after move out, he gets a bill for damaged furniture!  Yep, can't make this up.  Even after presenting past emails with management concerning this issue and their assurance that only the owners of the animal would face charges.  My son, rightly so disputes the charges and then COLAB being COLAB ignores all inquires and sends it to collections.

Be prepared to swim upstream with an incompetent group of facility management and tone deaf collections company if you have any disputes.  

You are taking your chances here and I don't recommend COLAB apartments.  IF you do, document everything with photos, email etc. and be prepared to be ignored.

The lease transfer process is painfully punishing. I was lucky enough to find a subtenant but the staff made it almost impossible.

I planned to schedule model apartment tours to my potential subtenants, but the staff don't schedule more than 20 mins per day in two weeks even if they are just sitting at the front desk doing nothing. Not to mention, there is no lease breakage policy whatsoever (even during unforeseen circumstances including COVID pandemic).

The subtenant is liable to pay all the fees such as application fee/ misc. fee even though the primary lease holder has already paid all those fees. On top of that, the lease transfer fee is ridiculously high $500!!! 

There are much better places around if you do your research well. Avoid altogether, if possible.

Smells horrible always. Trash is overflowing, and its not secure!!! My car was broken into TWICE in the “secure” parking.

If you see this place RUN THE OTHER WAY

Don’t sign the lease! As soon as you sign they do not answer your requests. If you have any issues, they won’t be addressed. The building itself smells like a dumpster. Management is HORRIBLE. The location is also dangerous. Stray away if you want to save yourself stress.

I signed a one year lease with Colab for a 4 bed 4 bath apartment. While I appreciate the proximity to Auraria campus as a student, the disgusting condition of the building and other concerns I’ve witnessed do not make it worth it. The hallways constantly smell like trash because the trash rooms are not emptied in a timely manner. On multiple occasions my roommates and I have had to walk past vomit and dog poop in the hallways that doesn’t get cleaned up for days. The security staff has been a revolving door since moving in, and often times I have pulled up to the building and the garage or entrances are unlocked/open making it feel unsafe. Work orders for important maintenance in my apartment took weeks to be completed (broken AC and ceiling repairs). Overall, it’s for college kids who don’t care about the condition of the building and neither does the staff in my experience. I regret spending so much money to live here.

Not only is the place absolutely trashed they refuse to clean it and fix things.the fire escape door has been broken for 5 months and elevators are constantly broken with people getting stuck inside of them. Maintenance requests can take up to 3 months. The pool is always randomly turning green. For the amount that you pay none of this should be a problem and it sadly is. RUN FROM THIS PLACE

I do not recommend living here the staff is trash they can rarely answer your question and concerns or they send emails you may have concerns about when the office is closed almost always. And if you have a concern you have to wait until the next day which sometimes is too late because they are already in the act of the task they sent in the emails. Also even though they tell you that you have a grace period of 6 days to pay rent before they give you a late fee or notice I have still received an eviction notice on my door within a 3 day period out of the 6 days even though I have never been late on a payment before. There is always something broken in our building whether it be common use or in your own apartment. Also before the apartments were fully built and made Colab made a lot of promises a lot of things we did not get in the apartment building yet we did not receive any refunds for the thing we paid for. For example, the parking spaces we had originally paid for before moving in we did not get to use or get assigned parking spaces for almost 4 months but we had to keep paying for the use of it and even though most complained including myself and did not get any refund money. The trash room stays with trash stuffed in it even though there is a trash shoot. There is always trash in the stairways in the halls and the trash room is always filled with trash. I do not recommend living here also people throw things off their balconies and it lands on yours neighbors are loud and leave their full stinky trash in the hallways as well. All in all i give this place a 1 star but appearances are great the rooms are small more like studio apartments for each room. I live in a 4 bed 4 bath apartment and storage is definitely limited and just enough space for all of us two of us cook two do not and use microwave foods its the only way it worked this far.

This place says they are student housing but none of my roommates have been students and I’ve gone through 6. They let anyone live here that wants to and half the rooms don’t have windows and get extremely hot. Not enough parking either.

Way overpriced !!!!   Constant parties,  arrests and illegal activity which can leave tenants feeling overwhelmed and unsafe.  When tenants have to make the choice to move for their own mental and physical wellness, CoLab has no interest in working with the tenants.  It's are all about the bottom dollar and they will not negotiate.

I just signed my lease today! I’ll admit, it’s kinda pricey, but, I came across a flash sale and got a great deal! I love how utilities are included in the rent. The only downside is paying for monthly parking, but, it’s cheap compared to other parking garages. Becca was so nice and helpful and so was Kira! Can’t wait to call this place home!

I am new to the Denver area and was looking for an apartment near CU Denver. The rates are per room in a shared apartment, but for all of the amenities, you cannot beat it! Everyone in the leasing office is so kind, helpful, and accommodating. Kira helped me find the perfect space to call home. I cannot wait to move in this August.

i reached out to this apartment complex for more information. it turns out that their listed prices are not per apartment, but per person. ie, 1050 per person in a 3 bed apartment. Not a fan and i would not recommend this apartment complex.

We have lived here for about 4 years now and the last 2 have been ABYSMALLY BAD. Management doesn't care, everything is extremely run down as prices go up somehow!!! The least clean common areas I have ever seen in my 15+ years of renting. The pools are always broken and dog poop is LITTERED EVERYWHERE. Garbage cans are overflowing on the regular. Only one of the office lady's does anything. If you talk to the front desk lady and not the manager expect 0 communication and nothing to be done she will lie to your face and has multiple times to us. 

DO NOT LIVE HERE THERE ARE SO MANY OTHER PLACES IN DENVER DONT SETTLE FOR THIS TRAP
New management sucks. No longer griffis. Gate does not work. Mail always stolen. Lots of crime. Roaches.

Ive lived here for two years and its terrible. From my AC barely working correctly, to my package constantly beinf stolen and the office doing nothing about it. To cars being broken into, gates being busted for months, 0 security. This is a terrible place to live.

Avoid moving here if you can, you pay absurd prices for nothing.

Living at the Highline at Cherry Creek has been comfortable, affordable, fun and easy.  I love the location, the staff, the amenities, the apartment and the complimentary coffee bar.  We enjoy our front porch often and the neighbors with friendly pooches and kids.  Thank you for this wonderful community that really is a hidden gem.

The highline on cherry creek is a nice gated community right on the river. The apartments are nice and clean. The staff are really nice and get things done in a timely manner. There is a real sense of community, most of the neighbors are great.

I've been living at The Highline on Cherry Creek now for a little over a year and a half. I can say that for the most part I have enjoyed my stay. The front office staff is among the best that I've ever dealt with. They're all very courteous, available, and welcoming. They're never too busy for even the smallest request. They took excellent care of my needs when I was moving from a one bedroom into a two bedroom, and made sure that it was an easy transition. One aspect of The Highline on Cherry Creek is the great transportation system, I am less than a mile from the light rail. It's a straight shot to wherever you may need to go down south or up north. In the time frame the time hat I have lived here I have had no problems and I can tell you that I'm have already enjoyed my stay at The Highline on Cherry Creek apartments so far. The neighbors, staff, and services are all world class. I highly recommend it to those who are looking for a new place to live.

I would never live here again. Management has an agreement with a towing company to tow multiple cars a night out of what is supposed to be guest parking. There is no responsibility for poor maintenance, broken amenities, or even basic questions. Leasing from these people feels like a shakedown from start to finish.

The door to get into my home breaks all the time, if I’m lucky this happens when the leasing office is open and once I am treated rudely by the awful leasing office, it is fixed in an hour. If it’s at night, then good luck getting a hold of maintainer. They have a call center that seems to be in Mexico that doesn’t get the message to the CO team. People have been locked out of their apartment all night. My tub also broke and was running hot water all night and could not fix it until 10 am the next morning when the leasing office came back in. Someone vomited on the floor of the hallway and it took 3 months to clean up. The gym has  broken equipment: the pool is always closed. DO NOT rent here. I’m am trying to get out of my lease. An awful dirty place to live.

HILARIOUSLY OVERPRICED - here's what Luxury gets you:
Pool broken 6 months+
Elevators broken 6 months+
Garage door broken 6 months+
Elevators break about every month, takes forever to get one, and they lock the stairwells so you can't use them anyway. 
Thefts, motorcycle thefts, multiple car break-ins and vandalism. 
Borderline incompetent maintenance currently - this place has gone through 3 management companies in the last 2.5 years.

The apartments are nice and pretty soundproof BUT the leasing office is impossible to deal with. They never answer your calls/emails and are rarely there. They charge you extra for every little thing when the amenities are not even that nice! Expect to pay at least another $100/month on top of your rent just so they can leave every single light in the building on 24/7...

My son lived there for the past year. I don't know what went on in the past, but his experience was positive. Well maintained and a professional front office. I recall that he had some issues with the doorman at night, but otherwise he enjoyed it. Great common area overlooking the front range. The apartment was spacious with a huge closet. And if you are going to DU you cannot beat the location.
The location is unbeatable with terrific views and access of DU. Neighbors are awesome and rent is decent for Denver. Management is also pretty good. I look forward to staying here for a bit!
The maintenance team is great here. Especially Courtney. She really helped us out along with management when we had to replace our blinds 2x in a week. Thanks Courtney!

I lived at IMT City Park from April 2020 to October 2024 and had a fantastic experience overall. The complex is clean, modern, and well-maintained, with a contemporary design that feels fresh and welcoming. The maintenance team is stellar – they’re always prompt, professional, and thorough. Any issue, big or small, was resolved quickly, which really added to the peace of mind of living here.

The location is unbeatable, making it easy to access everything I needed, from Sprouts to Chipotle and City Park. Plus, the rent and fees were very reasonable, especially for the level of quality and service provided. If you’re looking for a fair, convenient, and well-kept place to live, I’d definitely recommend IMT City Park. No major complaints from me – it was a wonderful place to call home!

I have lived in a lot of corporate owned apartment complexes and have realistic expectations about how friendly they are to their tenants pocketbooks.  IMT is by far the greediest landlord I have ever rented from.  

Maintenance is deferred until things have been broken for months.  They require a 2x monthly rent lease break fee and 60 days notice.  Month-to-month rent rates are extortionate.  

If you need any flexibility with your move out, this is the wrong apartment complex.  Period.  

On a positive note, I like the building and the employees were decent.  Such a shame the company ruins that.

The amenities are always out. The hot tub is functional maybe 7 months out of the year. The elevators are constantly breaking. I live on the 4th floor and the closest elevator to me has been broken for 6 months. They sent out emails saying they were trying to fix it and then didn't communicate with the residents for months about the broken elevator. The only other elevator in the building stopped working a week ago and it still isn't operational. Live anywhere else. The management here doesn't care about their residents.

Absolute WORST experience I've ever had with a rental property. No security whatsoever and management doesn't care. Neighbors in my building have had multiple break-ins and I've personally been on the receiving end of numerous crimes:

-Had my car towed from a spot that I pay for every month. No solution from management or the predatory towing company they partner with.
-Had my tire slashed in the resident parking garage. No solution, security improvements, or really even concern from management.
-Car vandalized in resident garage.
-Had my bike stolen from the resident parking lot. Someone breached the lot and destroyed the bike rack. Nothing from management.
-Encountered severe smoke damage in apt. from the previous resident. Again, no solution.

Find another place to live! They will give you great service until you sign the lease. At that point, they've got your money so they don't have any further incentive to improve security or customer experience. 
 
IMT -- What, if anything, are you doing to fix this? I haven't seen a front range patrolman, functional security cameras or anything else to suggest you're taking this rampant crime seriously.

I haven't had too many maintenance issues in the three years I've lived here but when I've needed something done the maintenance staff has taken care of things quickly and with great attention to detail. I've had the pleasure of working with both Stephen and Kyle and both have gone above and beyond. I don't have experience with the other engineer but always seems like he's busy working on something. 

The front office staff have also been very helpful, especially when they have to juggle a number of tasks at the same time. The issues that they are able to control have always been tended to with professionalism and in a friendly manner.
The new management company is really trying but the complex still needs a lot of work

Es un complejo de apartamentos muy seguro y agradable y el área de administración y mantenimiento siempre están dispuestos ayudarnos en cualquier necesidad q solicitado. Me gusta como hace su trabajo Ricky muy buen muchacho gracias x ayudarnos
The Modern is a good community and office staff is always ready to help with concerns.
I appreciate Valerie, she has made sure things have been handled and promptly. Always has a moment to talk and is very resourceful and helpful to my needs
I appreciate Valerie, since day 1 she has helped me through the process of getting into my new home despite some issues that happened she was able to get me into my new home.

It's hit or miss. Sometimes maintenance and the office are great other times they are horrible and I feel bad for having to call about things. The buildings are gross, laundry works 1/2 the time. No fire alarms in building 9, they have been ripped out of the ceiling. Rent is way too expensive and they nickel and dime you for everything. You have to pay 3.75 for laundry, parking passes are 16 for a couple and then rent. We were told we had certain things in our apartment but we don't. Overall stayed because this was the most affordable. Our lease will be up for renewal soon but I don't think we will sign again.

My experience with the modern has been extremely horrible, employees and managers are extremely rude. Freak out anytime you ask them to do their job. Trash and dead animals are in the parking lot. Charging me for things they shouldn’t. Never can get ahold of anyone.

When I first moved in I loved my unit and the property. Since then there has been so many changes in management. Stuff is being left undone, sloppy, messy. The crossing of people in some units, the cleanliness of the property isn’t the same. The up keep of the amenities at the property is not the same.
Amplias instalaciones, apartamentos agradables, execelente climatización, espacios de parqueadero buenos instalaciones de confort

Not taken care of AT ALL! Pool has been filled and CLOSED since April, it's all changed up and I lost track how many different excuses residents have been given! Pictures on the website is a LIE! the grills they say they have are dirty, BROKEN and have NO GAS! Play ground is dirty and smells like dog crap! Look at the "whole" property and find a resident & ask them!
They don’t fix anything, they don’t enforce quite hours or anything else in the lease. They will tow your car even with a permit and they will ignore your calls if they don’t want to help.

My experiences as a resident at The Modern Apartments have been completely terrible, and the office management and broader Avenue5 regional management have done nothing to make the situation right in spite of multiple attempts contact them. Our issues have included an ongoing roach problem, a lack of hot water and heat in winter, poor management, and overall poor quality of the apartment and grounds. 
1. We have been battling a roach problem for ~6 months, and the problem was made worse by multiple miscommunications between the leasing office and the exterminator. In addition, the roaches keep reappearing, apparently because the problem has not been properly addressed in our neighboring units.
2. We had inconsistent hot water and heat for much of the winter, while the boilers in our unit were being fixed. They were not fixed in a timely manner, and there was a solid one-month period this January when we did not have enough hot water for a single shower, and the building's heat went out several times. The apartment complex did not remedy this situation in a timely manner. To make matters worse, the water has been shut off completely three times since those repairs were fixed. 
3. The transition of the complex to Avenue 5 ownership was not handled well and made life as a tenant more difficult. For example, there were two months when there was absolutely no ledger and one month where we didn't even receive a utility bill, so it was up to us to guess what we owed and write a check to the office. In addition, there were several times when I attempted to go talk to the office employees during business hours and all the doors were locked and shades were drawn, and nobody answered the door when I knocked. Finally, the new employees were not trained properly and weren't aware of how to handle simple things like guest parking passes.
4. I am overall very unhappy with the quality of the apartment complex. There is an excessive amount of trash lying around the grounds most of the time, the walls are incredibly thin, and the floorboards are very squeaky. 
5. The staff is incredibly rude and regularly ignores tenant questions and complaints when you do manage to get in touch with them.

This place is ridiculous. I have had a MOLD PROBLEM in the master bedroom which happens to be my SEVEN YEAR OLD daughter and I. The room is continuously moist and humid if I don’t keep fans blowing all day and night. I have had to wash MY ENTIRE CLOSET OF CLOTHES WHICH IS EVERY PIECE OF CLOTHING I OWN FOUR TIMES IN THREE WEEKS. They didn’t go to find the real issue or offer for us to go somewhere while there is MOLD, we are living and sleeping around MOLD. They provided me with an OZONE GENERATOR instead of a dehumidifer. The Ozone generator is not for inhabited areas! It is extremely dangerous for our health and I not only have my seven year old here but my cat and my brother so naturally I inplugged it and went to the office where a very nice TEMP had to hear me flip out where she can’t do anything about it.  Today is the third week I’ve had to wash my entire closet. They haven’t offered to reimburse my laundry fees or to search for a main issue. THIS HAS NEVER HAPPENED TO ME AND ITS DISGUSTING AND EXTREMELY UNHEALTHY. I am mortified with this experience and I was told I have to wait until MONDAY to talk to management. This is a SERIOUS issue and I don’t recommend living in this mold infested apartment complex as they don’t take care of serious issues like this because they don’t believe it’s an emergency. This is MOLD WE ARE TALKING ABOUT AND PUTTING AN OZONE GENERATOR THAT EMITS OZONE LEVELS MORE THAN .04 PPM. LOOK THAT ONE UP. This has been going on for FAR TOO LONG. I am beyond mortified.
Rude unprofessional and unhelpful staff, exorbitant and bogus fees, unclean apartments. Save your money, find somewhere else to give your business. I’d give this place 0 stars if I could.

During the 2 years I lived here the mail room was broken into 3 times, my car was broken into 3 times in the locked garage and my car was stolen out of the parking lot in broad daylight. The staff is rude and unprofessional. The buildings are trashed and disgusting. There’s better places to live for a cheaper or same price. Definitely avoid this place.
Vandalism is rampant, nearby apartments are noisy, outside is covered in poop and never maintained, things breaking frequently and work orders ignored
I’m from Atlanta and want to say that I absolutely loved my time and experience living here! Extremely friendly and professional staff! Loved it!

Glenbrook is a great place to live. The residents are polite and the staff are helpful. If you ever have a question or need help, there is always somebody available, whether it be staff or resident.

Great place to live!!
Lived here since Feb. Great staff and place to live very quite and affordable.
Booked a tour on apartments.com just to be called 2 days later to be told they’d double booked. They seem to not have it together…

this apartment is poorly managed and there have been about 4/5 break ins to cars and package locks since I have moved in. No increased security and their solution was that the tenants should deal with it and call the cops if they want.

My fiancé and I moved into a one bedroom apartment here that we absolutely love, but that’s where the good ends with the Douglas. There are constant inconveniences, from the fire alarm going off at odd hours several times a month to painting the garage in the middle of the winter, to broken appliances that take months to fix, and so much more. I can’t recommend this building regardless of how cozy we have been able to make our space. We are absolutely looking to move at the end of this lease with no chance of renewal.
