This apartment is so loud. It's right next to one of the largest homeless shelters, there are tons of parties, and there are bike bars that go by late into the night. I was on the 5th floor on Walnut, and was constantly being woken up. 

I'm the year I've lived here I've had to evacuate for 9 different fire alarms! Twice the apartment was evacuated because a truck hit the sprinkler system, and a few times we were evacuated because someone smoked in or near the building.

There have been a lot of car break-ins I the last year, I've seen a few people get arrested against balconies on the first floor, and would be nervous to liv at street level. I know The Douglas can't help the homeless population around the building, but the place is a little unsafe.

This place feels like an upscale down, not the young adult luxury living they advertise.

Moved into the Douglas and immediately regretted it. Every weekend night the entire lobby is trashed, glass broken, drunk people on couches, people are in the hot tub until 5. If you want to relive your college days and live in a dirty college frat house, than the Douglas is the place. Otherwise, I'd look elsewhere there. So many options in downtown Denver this place is last on the list.

Great Building and amenities, however there is no security - other than to kick you out of the hot tub.  Cars in the garage have been broken into, the main garage door was broken for 6 months, card readers are broken all the time - months to repair, they just don't care about the tenants....

The apartments and the community itself is very nice. I like the units. Some downfalls. Overall it's the tenants that make it a not so great experience. It's a gated community and the residence are always damaging the gates. The owner (AMC Properties) need to invest in more quality repairs instead of quick fixes w cheap materials. They don't take pride in the community. The maintenance is great but, they can use some help. I don't think they have enough staff to maintain the property. I have never had any problems w/ management which is a plus.
Worst property ever very rude disrespectful people. hate it here

I counted down the days until my lease was up! Management is amazing at blowing smoke and saying whatever you want to hear. I don't think they've followed through once. The gates been broken for months and vehicles have been stolen. There is never any parking. Multiple apartments have to have like eight plus people in them with multiple vehicles that never get towed even when you call the tow company. They charge you nearly 200 a month on fees related to maintenance or convenience that you will never see in your life time being put to use. One fee literally says they can charge you for cost of professional management of the apartment community.... that's the C.A.M. fee if your interested in looking at the addendum. I beg of you do not give AMC your money and your life will be so much better off.

Well this complex is decent. My husband and I have been living here since Sep 2017. First of all, this website says they’re open sundays 12-5 and that’s a big lie. They are closed on sundays. They have been remodeling the leasing office for months now and just now I am seeing some progress that they are actually working on it. The “controlled access gate” is always open. Maintenance request take DAYS to show up and even then, they only show up cuz you need to call them again to remind them they need to come out to your apt. There is absolutely no parking ever!!! We had to get a garage because when my husband would come home from work there would be NO parking and he’d have to park by the entrance, and we live way in the back. They made a dog park that is the size of a two car garage which is so tiny!! But there is no kid playground. I’ve seen kids play in the dog park all the time , which they wouldn’t have to do if they would have made a kid playground instead!!!

If you want management that screams at you and dares you to call the cops on you, this is the place.

3 months after moving in, none of our move-in problems have been fixed, except for knobs for the bathroom/kitchen drawers that were installed yesterday. Bedroom window won't open, roof is leaking, kitchen sink has no handle to turn it on or off. The rent is double the cost of comparable options. The grounds are covered in dog poop and the pond is rotting.

But better yet, your packages will be left unsecured in their mail room, torn open and left askew, which is a felony.

And even better, I had them void a rent check I wrote from one bank and wrote them a new one from a different bank, assured they would only charge me what was due. They deposited both checks, and now claim they cannot refund me my money. This apartment complex is the most criminal business I have ever dealt with.

They smile on the front, but will scream at you red in the face the minute they can't correct their own mistakes.

Don't make the same problem we did.

ZERO STARS!!!!! DO NOT MOVE HERE!!! They may seem nice at first, but that's only because they want your money and under that mask, they are rude! They are not military friendly. Oh, you've been a loyal resident and renewed for years, never had a late payment, etc? They don't care and will never even try to help you out. When you decide you want or need to leave/move, they will try to milk you for all that you're worth and kick you on your way out the door. Please do not ignore the bad and true reviews or be distracted by the pretty lake....this place is not luxury, is falling apart and is ran by liars and hateful people! I regret every day that I have lived here!

I have lived at 1801 Skyline for the past 2 years. The apartments are small, you will have a difficult time having a couch and a dinner table. However, the finishes are nice and new appliances as they renovated in 2013. The apartment complex has 5 awesome living areas! 

The Kitchen – A huge kitchen with 3 tv’s and couches and chairs. 

The Courtyard – A court yard with a fire pit and grill.

The Rooftop – Awesome Penthouse rooftop with an outdoor area with two grills, a fire pit and plenty of seating. 

The Dog Park- The dog park is large and there are a lot of friendly pups. 

The Game Room- 2 ping pong tables, pool table, poker table, darts, shuffle board, 3 TVs.. 

The complex also has free coffee, a gym and a yoga studio.
While living at Skyline 1801 my girlfriend have met many friends and play on the apt. complex softball team. Skyline also hosts several events like taco night, 4th july party, st pattys party and a new year’s eve party. It’s a great place for young professionals who are moving into town. 

The location is perfect, two blocks from 16th st mall so you do not get a lot of tourist walking by your apartment, and 2 blocks from the bars so you don’t get a lot of the loud drunk people.

Had an amazing experience touring this property. Andrea at the front was extremely friendly & helpful, she answered all my questions and was very pleasant to speak with. The property was well maintained and it’s very evident the employees truly care about your experience. If you’re looking to live here, be sure to ask for Andrea.

The apartment homes are beautiful, clean and have a very homey feel to them. Rebekah, Peyton, Amanda and Kyle are amazing in the office. Alwyn, John Sr, John Jr, and Johnny handle maintenance calls quickly and efficiently! Sr fixed my AC right away, Alwyn connected my dryer vent correctly and Jr fixed my dishwasher right after the new one was delivered! Jake and Ben take care of the grounds and keep the community looking amazing! Definitely rent here if you are looking for a new home!

DO NOT LIVE HERE!!! We have been here for three months. Since June 2021. Three weeks into our move in our upstairs neighbors moved in. They have a dog that they leave out on the porch and in their garage for hours on end at all times of day and night and it will bark for hours even during quiet hours and well into the middle of the night. The dog is also aggressive and has lunged at every other dog it comes across while they walk. Not only that but it has knocked out both of the screens on their windows due to the aggressive way it will bark at every dog that walks past the apartment. Its a very dog friendly complex, so their are a lot of dogs so it happens very often. We have sent in over ten noise complaints with video evidence of them breaking noise ordinances and they have received and violated multiple probation periods, but nothing is being done to fix it. There is also a constant stench coming from their apartment and I am worried for our health. Im also worried for the wellbeing of every dog at this complex as the dog is so aggressive, if it got off its leash or somehow jumped out of their apartment (which does seem likely as they leave their windows open for it to bark with no screen on) it would absolutely hurt another dog or maybe even a person. Management has since stopped replying to our emails. Ever since the management team has switched two months into our stay we feel as though they don't care for the tenants like our last management did. Why would they favor a tenant that violates multiple lease agreements over a tenant who hasn't violated anything? Do Not Live Here.

I have lived on the property since AMLI Lowry managed it. It was wonderful then, but since Holland Residential took over and new management came in...it's overpriced, run down, and the staff (both office and maintenance) are unprofessional, rude, and inept regarding day to day responsibilities. I cannot believe, especially after reading other reviews that Apartments.com has Pilot House scored at a 5/5. NO way is this is accurate. The grounds are covered in doggie pooh because they rarely stock the pooh bags (we pay for), and the main pool has not been accessible for over a year. Not at all, not even the hot tub. They slack on their responsibilities consistently (good luck getting maintenance to fix anything), but oh my gosh...don't you dare not follow that lease to the letter and pay your rent on time (I always do. I'm just pointing out the hypocrisy) or they'll come at you with a vengeance. Long story short...go somewhere else. You can find more affordable, nicer apartments in Lowry/Denver. I have read and heard so many horror stories regarding how PH sends final notices to wrong addresses, overcharges ppl with move out fees, and sends people to collection because PH makes accounting mistakes and then doesn't properly notify tenants. My neighbor paid them electronically and he said he has proof because the exact amount of his rent came out of his bank account, but PH claims they never received the funds. They are taking him to court. It's always something with this place.

I lived in their apartments and upgraded to a townhouse. The manager, Nathalie, was amazing not only during the transition but in the day to day as well. She was always looking out for our best interests and made sure any maintenance requests we had were taken care of promptly! An amazing place to live, with staff and management to compliment. A hard balance to find these days!

The Pilot House property management company has a D- rating from the Better Business Bureau. Please do your research and be very, very careful if you do business with this company.

I have filed a complaint against the management company at Pilot House, Holland Partner Group (HPG), in response to months of dealing with their unethical practices -- specifically, for HPG (i) neglecting to send a final ledger after I was forced to break my lease, (ii) ignoring communication, and (iii) erroneously sending my account to a collection agency, putting my credit and livelihood at stake. 

Other random issues included (but are not limited to):
- Cigarette smoke permeates the hallways and common areas.
- Due to "valet trash service," there is constantly garbage everywhere.
- Grounds are very poorly maintained.
- Leasing staff is rude, inexperienced, and unprofessional.
- The leasing office and the corporate office frequently ignore emails.
- "Common area utilities" fees are added to monthly ledgers, but agreement to these charges are not outlined anywhere in the rental agreement.
Went to get keys on a Saturday office hours 9 am til 5pm and office was closed at 1pm came back at 3 pm office still closed . Not a good look for a new tenant

I am a brand new resident. As I walked into the office there was a line of people that needed help, it was a Monday so there were many questions from anxious people that needed attention. As I patiently waited I was greeted by a very friendly lady with the warmest most welcoming smile. Most people would be flustered and she was very patient and kind not to mention helpful. Joelle stopped what she was doing to assist me with my mailbox and answer all my questions. I am very happy to call Hampden Heights my new home.
Great staff super friendly!  my move in went smooth. Tour went great! everyone there is awesome thank you so much for your help, moving out of state to another is not easy but they made it easy!
Bug infested and extremely unhelpful staff, they are very rude more often then not telling people to bad instead of helping

maintenance doesn’t do anything, the office is always putting notes on our building for false info and trying to steal every last penny from residents, the neighbors are a WRECK! Neighbors party till 6am with loud music, other neighbors complain about residents smoking when they themselves smoke. We’re paying the price of a 1 or 2 bedroom for a STUDIO. Apartments are overly priced for what they offer. Parking is always overly packed. And the whole property is dirty! Definitely not renewing a lease here!

Please don't become another victim of Harbor management Group. This company is preying on innocent people especially those moving here from out of state. The property is run down and full of health hazards. Shortly after we moved in we both became very ill and we believe that a subpar cleaning job is to blame. Management will likely respond to this review with a disingenuous response saying how sorry they are. Don't buy it, Live somewhere where you and your family can be healthy and safe.

This place is trash. The property Manager Ericka is completely useless and has no control over the property. Its literally an abandoned couch grave yard with a moat of dog waste around it. After I move out I know where I’ll be dumping all my unwanted furniture. Right next to the pile that sits there for months at a time. Can’t wait!!

THIS is NOT at all a luxury apartment.This is not a decent apartment! Worst place and worst managing staff ever! Full of mold and bugs.Dog park is not very clean in most cases, and the carpets way old and stinks of previous animals. They have cockroaches all over. And the pool is not cleaned at all. The sliding glass windows are old, warped,break and can't actually be repaired because of the frame. Everything is so old. Needs new appliances across the board.  YIKES.

If I could leave no stars I could. I lived here for a year and it was the worst experience ever.
Nothing works ever, electricity is spotty, and the buildings are old and mold infested. Looking at there low ratings, it’s no secret that this place needs some major changes in order to be at least passable. I would strongly suggest not moving here.

I moved into Hampden Heights about 6 months ago after relocating from Nevada. At first, it seemed like a decent place for the price but I soon discovered that not only is this complex mold-infested, But management does everything they can to cover up and ignore the issue. I brough up my concerns about becoming ill due to mold on several occasions only to be ignored. Do whatever you can to avoid getting into a contract with this company. They do not believe in delivering value to the end-user.

The only good thing about this place is location. Shifty management. Pipes constantly being repaired. Units without water more often than not. Maintenance goes into Aptmnts when you are not home.
Complaints get forwarded to their corporate office which is not local. Manager, Brad,dishonest. Rest of the personnel, clueless at best. Cheap materials in the units.

I've lived here just over 3 months now, and this apartment is already so much better than my last one. The office staff is super nice and helpful. Maintenance is on top of things that need fixing. Laundry facilities are convenient, clean, and nice. I would have to say that for the rent, compared to a few others in the area, this place is your best bet.

This apartment complex has potential, but is longer well maintained and has some of the sleaziest and most dishonest management in the industry. They have no qualms about upselling a mediocre complex with lies and false promises. Beware of old reviews!

This complex is an ok place to live. Have lived there for 5 years, they have changed management companies 3 times. They have gotten worse with every change. Be prepared to walk through knee deep snow  on the side walks from your apartment to your car.

This is a great apartment complex.  The staff is friendly and fast to reply.  The maintenance crew is also very friendly, and VERY prompt; all of our maintenance requests have been resolved within 24 hours.  Even my cats love it here, it is a great place to call home.  I desperately wish we could afford to stay here, but unfortunately they bumped our monthly rent up too high for us to stay longer than a year.  If I could afford it, it would be worth the extra money.  Other than that, no complaints, great apartment complex!

I have lived here for about 7 months, and I really enjoy it so far. It's quiet, in a great location that's close to a lot of grocery stores, entertainment, and major highways, and it's a great price. I feel safe living here, and maintenance has always been fast.Office staff is always nice.  I would recommend this place to anyone in a heartbeat.

These homes feature nice open concept areas and really appeal to the renter. I have enjoyed it here as the office ladies are friendly and the maintenence crew really goes above and beyond the call. So I believe they deserve a definate 5 stars. As for the reasons I am giving it a 3 stars, the homes are simply falling apart. upon first moving in review of the home I found that the over vents were not working, garbage disposal blade not rotating, and window seals falling apart, were some of the bigger wear-and-tear things. With us being backed up to one of the busyiest roads in Denver and window seals falling apart, it has cause several loud nights. We have also had theft recently wich causes some concern for the surronding area that seems really nice.Other than that, I will say it is pretty nice to be closer to downtown for a decent rate compared to other apartments.
The apartments are in a great location near shopping and many outdoor activities.

My hot water heater went out, suddenly. The management got someone over to install a new one very quickly. I'm very grateful to live in a community where the management really cares about its tenants.
Definitivamente César es el mejor en todo, ayuda mucho y con el todo es más fácil
Hasta ahora la estancia y la atencion en Velo es muy buena y tranquila.Gracias a todos por su trabajo.

Velo is a very nice place to live. The staff are always helpful and pleasant to work with. The rent is reasonable and their payment system has boosted my credit score, which is nice. I enjoy living at Velo, very much!
I called to notify the office that my heat wasn’t working in my apartment and they had it taken care of within 24 hours.
I love living at Velo. The people in the community are friendly and nice. The management is great. And the maintenance guys are always helpful.
The items needing repair were done quickly, within 24 hours and I was satisfied
Overall quick and efficient, even for small repair requests. Maintenance team and office team are on point!

I have lived at Velo for almost a year and 1/2. There has been alot if turn over in the office as well as the maintenance staff. Everyone that works there now is very helpful and kind. Jose in maintenance is great and Heidi in the office is great. I hope to see more stability  of the staff. I am happy here
I have been living here for three months. and I am satisfied and happy. My neighbors are all excellent. and in the office everyone is a good worker. especially Cesar.

Velo is a wonderful place to live. The staff are knowledgeable and ready to help. The grounds are kept nice, for the most part. The units have nice amenities and feel warm and inviting. I would recommend them.
Any maintenance request we have had has been completed on time and maintenance is always very pleasant and kind

Management is horrible. They’re never there and they are constantly switching. I’ve lived here for almost two years and there probably has been 4-5 switches. The maintenance never helps and your packages can also get stolen and they will not help you at all! Do not move here and spare yourself the headache.

Lived here about a year, apartments are fine. Things are clean and they generally work, but the management company is awful to work with. I started my lease when it was owned by Trinity and they were fine. They made a few mistakes but the staff was very kind and would work with you on any issues. They were bought by Avenue5 midway through my lease, and things went downhill from there. They lost paperwork, picked up old copies of leases that had to be amended, etc. Despite talking to numerous office staff and receiving assurances everything would be fine and they would work with me on correcting any issues, they are now expecting me to pay an extra $400 a month to see out the terms of my lease. This has been such a common issue that the staff has even joked about it.

I would not recommend this place, it would be in your best interests to avoid living here unless you want to be taken advantage of financially.

A bit off the beaten path but decent apartments at relatively good price. Second year in the complex with minimal complaints. The staff when I moved in here was great however since then they have changed. The new team is rude and depending on who you talk to have different answers. Moving from a one bedroom to a 2 in the same complex sounds like it should be an easy deal but was a mess. Was told I could move in on the 26th and was given the keys only to find the place under construction. Was then told they would be done by the third of the month but that I needed to be out of my old place by the 1st? I had to explain to the lady twice before she figured out that would leave me homeless for 2 days... Definitely decent place to live but the new staff is a joke.

The units are nice, and the pool and gym are great. However, I had several issues with my unit. My AC broke 4 times within 10 months. On days it was 70 degrees, my unit would be 78. Maintenance mngr said it’s just something that comes with living in an apartment and that I should open my one window & door vs being able to run AC. They have a “48-hour service guarantee” posted on their website (and was advertised to me when touring in Feb ‘21) that they simply don’t honor and use Covid as an excuse. My washer sounded like it was going to blow up - I was told that b/c they didn’t have any more washers on site and b/c the AC needed to be fixed by a contractor, their “guarantee” didn’t apply. They shut off the AC for 6 days with 80+ degree temps to redo the roof. Their solution is bringing a huge, loud portable AC unit that blows out dust and requires you to keep your window open at night. I had a unit by the dog park and the gate would slam every time someone went in/out, so couldn’t sleep with window open ever. Very noisy neighbors, thin walls - could hear everything above & below me. Bugs even though we pay a pest removal fee. Trash rooms smell, hallways aren’t vacuumed and rarely air conditioned. Big security issues in the garage - not sure why there aren’t more cameras? Rent was raised 27%.
AMLI is 10x better than the last place I was in. I have a sense of security here and the amenities are so great! I really love it here.
The staff is extremely warm & welcoming! All of the residents Ive met at the dog park are very friendly & the gym is awesome.
Rental rates dont reflect building upkeep. Look elsewhere.

I’ve lived here for 1.5 years - disappointed in the lack of after hours security and ongoing instances of theft. Honest feedback below. 

Pros: the apartments are equipped with updated appliances; members of the maintenance team and staff are friendly and quick to respond to requests; very friendly neighbors (and dogs!); the gym is clean with newer equipment; the pool area is beautiful and well maintained; central location; close to the Cherry Creek bike path and Infinity Park.

Cons: security concerns — frequent car break-ins and theft in the parking lot; multiple instances of bike theft from the locked bike room (including my own); it is very easy for non-residents to gain access to the building and amenities.

The pool area can be noisy during open hours as well as after hours by residents and multiple non-resident guests. If the after hours courtesy team is on-site when a noise complaint is called in, they will ask the resident and non-residents to leave. However, this could be monitored better. At times, I have been told the courtesy surveillance guard is not on-site. If that is the case, I have been advised to wait until they show up (which can take several hours) or to call the police.

There are security cameras, but not enough. I inquired about an after hours incident and was told the security camera footage is unreliable in poorly lit areas like the pool, for example. Installing more security cameras with night vision is easy and affordable — this might be the best solution for AMLI’s ongoing security concerns.
AMLI is a beautiful place to live with spacious apartments! The amenities and staff are great and the team is very responsive to any issues.

I have lived here go 10 months and regret it daily!  The elevators constantly are shut down or running slow due to over booking of freight elevators. I step into urine at lease once a week from dog owners that allow their animals to use elevators as restrooms! And there’s constant construction projects occurring due the unfinished building they neglect to tell you about when you sign your lease!  Blinds are not sufficient to keep sun glare out and I can constantly hear dogs barking and music being played overly loud due to the poorly built, thin walls.  Just not worth all the glamor they sell you on to get you in the door only to ignore all issues of yours while your a resident! Just please choose another place it’s not worth having to be disappointed in coming home.

The building management has changed so many times yet nothing has changed. For almost an entire semester there was no hot water, and this was during the fall/winter. 1 of the 3 elevators broke in December and hasn't been fixed, and the 2 remaining elevators are inconsistent and often out of order. The floors are almost always dirty with some floors smelling of roten eggs and urine. No matter how much we complain about these issues they don't go away. I'm glad that my lease has finally ended and I can escape from the h*ll hole that is Auraria Student Lofts

I moved here in August of 2023. I beg of you, DO NOT move here if you value your safety, peace of mind, or working apartment/building. 

For almost 24 hours yesterday, 0 out of the 3 elevators on property were working. ASL is not motivated to fix the other two elevators. One of which hasn't been working since December, and the other hasn't been working for several months. People have gotten stuck in these elevators so often that I'm genuinely afraid to use them, but I live on a high floor and can't access my door by using the stairs, so they leave me no other choice. 

Additionally, from roughly August through December of 2023 (yep, three months) there was no hot water in the whole building. The delayed ASL solution to this was to give us limited access to two rooms in the Curtis Hotel to shower. These rooms were not cleaned between users, and were used to accommodate 150+ residents. There were 30 minute time increments, and not offered at times I could reasonably shower before I had to go to work. They did not compensate us for the time our unit was legally uninhabitable.

Maintenance work is often marked complete in the tenant portal without a technician addressing the issue, or it will be completed in an incorrect way. My faucet has been leaking since I moved in. I sent in four maintenance requests, and several of them were marked complete without even touching the faucet. As another example, the handle on my shower is installed backwards, and the dishwasher makes a "crack" noise every time you try to close it. 

Fire safety is an issue. The staff do not know how the fire alarms work, even asking me if I knew how to turn them off when they accidentally triggered them during a routine inspection. Once, when my roommate triggered the alarm, it took four hours and five phone calls from us before they were turned off. No staff even knew the alarms were triggered before we called the emergency line.

To conclude, this unit is simply not worth the money, the hassle, or the safety issues. You can find places for less money and fewer roommates that won't risk your safety or your sanity. I can't wait to get out of here this month, and I encourage you to not get stuck living here either.

Just moved here and I go to school near. The manager here, Mark is great. He was able have my lock on my apartment door fixed fast and answers all of my email questions in a timely manner. So happy that management was able to get the pool cleaned and the gym equipment fixed.

I moved in March after the new management group Cardinal  took over and I just signed my lease for next year. I love the location, in the heart of downtown, also the amenities are really nice with study rooms of lounge couches by the pools. The building stays clean and quiet. With secure doors, elevators and security at night I feel very safe. Also the staff are so kind and helpful and quiet a few are on site which is really nice if an emergency arises.

The auraria student lofts are the last place you’d want to live. Everything advertised on social media about this place is not what it seems. All they care about is milking your money, not to mention the horrible manager Chris K.

I lived here for two years. Right after Christmas 2017, the hot water heaters broke and weren’t fixed for 3 weeks. We went for that long without being able to shower in hot water or wash anything in hot water. Now, the hot water is shut off again today (April 2018) and will be broken indefinitely.  They fined me $150 for my friend spilling peanut butter near the elevator. Terrible place to live, don’t move here. Overpriced, dirty, old, and feels like a dorm.
Don't let the concrete ceilings fool you, you can hear every single one of your neighbors in the entire building loud and clear. Rolling blackouts and water shutoffs sometimes more than once a week.

I’m not one to write reviews but this one is needed. My apartment has fluctuated between 85-90 degrees during the day. If I’m lucky at night, I can get down to about 78. We have had no A/C since it’s been needed (mid-may) with no timeline on it being fixed. THE SAME EXACT ISSUE HAPPENED LAST SUMMER (2021) AND TOOK 6 weeks to fix. The layouts are great but the new price points (20% higher than they were a year ago) no longer justify shotty management and hot living conditions. Gwendolyn and Dustin in the leasing office are great, but only so much office staff can do to help living situations. I’ve seen the property manager be very rude and defensive to tenants that are justifiably upset at the A/C situation. I understand that things happen, but when you give a lack of communication as well as no temporary remedies, there is no excuse. You can find something better for the price you will pay here. Guaranteed. I and many other tenants have contacted the BBB to file complaints if that is any indication of how fed up we are.

I’ve lived at the lex at Lowry for 4 years now. You’d hope they value a resident that has been with the complex for a while, but this year The Lex raised my rent for almost $400 more expensive! No renovations in my apartment, no new floor in the patio like I have requested, nothing. Very disappointed to have to find another place to live purely because of the price! Not worth it.

It’s been 85 degrees every night here and nearing 90 during the day. Haven’t had working AC all year, it’s miserable. Pools aren’t opened yet and we’re promised they’d open two weeks ago. Car break ins are a regular here and it’s near a fire department so it’s super noisy. Had the audacity to raise rent when half the amenities aren’t available both in unit and on grounds. Most equipment in the gym is broken, washer and dryer were broken for 3 weeks on our floor. Could go on forever there’s so many more issues.
Lex at Lowry: great location, lots of amenities, modern kitchens with all appliances, hard wood floors ,parks nearby, thriving neighborhood.

Nice, pet-friendly property with pools, a gym, a playground, a dog run and various sports fields. Management is active and generally on the ball. Maintenance is hit or miss, which means you might have to repeat some maintenance requests. The community is diverse, both culturally and in terms of income level. My family has felt safe here in the complex and in the neighborhood. Parking policy is extremely strict, we or our guests have been towed twice in two years, one of them for being on a spot that looked like a parking spot but wasn't well marked as non-parking.

Management refuses to resolve maintenance requests. Leak in bathroom, was told there is no leak and they fixed it with the a screw. Leak got worse. Has been effecting electrical systems - lights, stove.  Amenities are generally broken - year round sauna is rarely available. Many broken exercise equipments. 

Evicted after no notice, and having had our rent check denied multiple times, even when they had taken the check from us, and mailed it back days later after they had applied a new late fee. 

Apartments also have holes in outer walls, allowing critters to enter. Rats are found in winter dead around property.

I had a wonderful experience working with Alexis. She genuinely wants her clients to have the best experience. And besides being a workaholic she makes things easy for tenants with their move as much as possible. The rest of the staff seems really nice.

Trying to catch the attention of staff with poor reviews and save people the hassle of becoming unhappy tenants! 
Lived here in its prime when the property was well maintained, a problem was solved in an afternoon, and I felt safe and comfortable. Fast forward to today, where rats and trash are abundant, parking is not. Free laundry means waiting hours for a washer and when you get one, if they aren’t all broken, it is a disgusting mess.  Want to spend your summers relaxing by the pool? Well you can, just don’t get in it or the hot tub either as they have been deemed unsafe by the city of Denver. I cannot blame the office staff as they always seem busy and  handling every situation they possibly can, I will blame the new greedy company who came in and screwed us over. I’m sure Scrooge is in the back counting all the money he collects from us as we suffer without water for days, wade through the dog poop and weeds overflowing onto the sidewalk to reach our car on the other side of the property, and listen to our screaming neighbors till 1 AM. It’s a shame and I don’t see any hope for change. Zero stars.
Not too shabby. Great price for area. Can't beat free laundry and internet. Office staff seems nice. No issues there.

Upon moving from Louisiana to here we had such poor communication from the office staff. Once we got here there was a huge fan in our apartment and found out from neighbors that the apartment had flooded. Reached out multiple times to the office, heard nothing except when they asked for the fan back. Today our apartment has flooded again and can’t even get the office to answer a phone. Walked to the office and was told maintenance would be here within an hour. It’s been almost 2 and still nothing.

One problem after another.  Lost my rent and almost evicted me. Mold under sink and they are ignoring me.  Hallway stairs covered in old smelly stained carpet. Paint drops everywhere all over the apt- they must have painted the ceiling w/o dropcloths.  They wanted to give me the keys to a dirty apt.  I had to insist they clean it. They charge you for everything- water, sewer, trash, gas, electricity, even the things you don’t use- electricity in the clubhouse, maintenance on pools that aren’t always open. Even rain water drainage!!!!!!!!
Acredito al cambio de administración que ha mejorado tanto la atención al público, mantenimiento a los edificios y servicios de mantenimiento a los apartamentos.

I lived here for 13 months and chose not to renew because I felt unsafe at the property, and the property manager and staff are of poor quality. Lisa D. and Ana L. are extremely unresponsive. This place does not care about your well-being, only your rent.

The photos they post are extremely deceitful. The dog park is in ruin and never cared for. It is covered in weeds, and the obstacles are broken. It was like this the entire time I lived there.

The volleyball pit they show is nothing like their photo. It is essentially a sand pit full of weeds. No net, and rail spikes or rebar are poking out of the wood outlining the perimeter.

I maintained my unit and cleaned it weekly, yet I was still charged a $110 cleaning fee for my kitchen sink and a $55 carpet cleaning fee. They failed to provide evidence to support these charges as well. I have been attempting to dispute these charges since February 27th with no response from Tamarac or MG Properties.

If you move here, there is a chance you will be unhappy with your choice. High crime, unresponsive office, and the possibility you will not get your deposit back no matter how well you maintain your unit. 

Read the reviews and walk the property for yourself before attempting to move here.

I understand they are trying to improve the property, but the way they are going about it is absolutely asinine. Construction is constant, loud, and invasive. They will ask you to leave all day so they can work and will barely give you 24hrs notice. Water is shut off often, and the property won't email you until after its already shut off. They've been fixing my roof for close to a year now. Projects are always delayed and never finished on time, or are started on a different date than the office says, which is extremely inconvenient if you've already prepared for the work to be done. If you work from home don't even consider this place. There is no privacy or peace.

My car got stolen today in the middle of the day from the parking in front of my building. I pay for parking each month and they don't even have security cameras. 
Stay away from this place!!!!!!

I've lived in this building for 4 years. In that time there have been numerous cars and bikes that have been subject to theft. But recently I've known several women in the building who have been either stalked or had their apartments broken into while they were sleeping. This has been going on for months with management being fully aware of the situation and doing nothing about it. The unit next to mine was broken into by someone who came in the building off the street. The management does not share of these things with the residents and instead sends email telling us to lock our doors as if that is the problem. There has also been an individual that has been squatting in a unit for over 3 months. Apparently management has been aware but yet hasn't identified or removed this individual. I'm happy to say I've signed a lease elsewhere and will be moving soon. Please reconsider living here, this address has the most number crimes in the DU area area.
Overpriced. There is a hotel on the 2nd floor of the building. Constant water issues, Internet problems, neglectful management

2nd night after I moved in the roof leaked all over my sofa. The emergency maintenance never responded for my help. The manager Michelle didn’t send a person to clean my sofa until 1.5 months later, he made it worse. My sofa is now a different shade and the material is ruined. He is definitely not a professional upholstery cleaner. After 6 months my sofa is still damaged and Michelle has numerously lied to me. Don’t move into this place, it’s been one big headache after another. I also pay $200/month for a reserved parking spot but can hardly use it because someone else is in my “reserved “ space. Michelle says I can’t guarantee that no one will use that space so sorry. That night I had to park in a different spot and my car was broken into, there’s no security in this place so beware.

We have lived in the Atelier for 2-months and in that time period we have had our storage locker broken into x 2 resulting in 3 bicycles along with numerous other items being stolen. On the night of March 28th, the closet system broke and fell from the wall. None of these issues are being addressed by management and the building remains unsecured with un-monitored public access in/out of the garage. This facility is not secure and management has unfortunately proven unresponsive. I cannot recommend this facility.

I've been living here for a couple months now. All that I can say is the owners and the manager really needs to work on their customer service goals and transparency. There are lots of hidden costs they won't tell you about in touring the building. There are many fire hazards within the apartments the manager will not inform you on. The singles apartments you are basically sleeping in a closet and the apartments tend to not be well lit due to poorly done paint jobs. If you order a package from any company most likely the building manager will lose your package and blame it on the delivery companies rather than compensating you for the loss of your merchandise in their possession. The manager is a rude lady and her body language shows it. The amenities look all nice, however, I'd give this building about two years and it's going to go bankrupt and shut down because they don't take care of the building nor take action on the concerns of the tenants.

Awful place to live. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY MOVING/LIVING HERE! We never get any sleep because of the fire alarms constantly going off at 3am. And there's always an excuse from the management telling us to "rest assured" that the problems are being fixed but they're not! And idiot neighbors/guests shooting off fireworks from the penthouse. It's a pretty building and the units are nice, but the quality of living is well below standard.
The team at The Den are always ready to help and provide a service-driven experience. The Den is well-kept and in a great location in Denver. Love working with Cicely and the rest of the team!

The apartment seems nice on the surface... But I've experienced a series of ongoing issues and wouldn't recommend it to anyone. I think there's potential here to have a good apartment experience, but I've lived here for 7 months now and have had a really BAD experience.

* The rooftop hot tub is great - when it's WORKING! The hot tub has been empty (broken) for OVER A MONTH now. Also, while the view from the rooftop is great, you can't really see over the walls from the hot tub.

* My apartment has problems with a SEWAGE ODOR. I've been in contact with the managers since moving in 7 months ago, and the problems have still not been resolved. I would have thought this type of problem was isolated to one or two units, but now that I look closer I see it on a few other reviews here too. This is the number one reason I'd recommend avoiding this place.

* The staff are generally responsive, but don't always follow through on things and don't seem to be really invested in creating a great experience for the residents here. Actually, in most of my interactions with them I'm given the feeling that I'm interrupting something important and they don't have time to help me - not a great experience.

* The package lockers are great, but I've had some packages that were delivered to the leasing office either because of size, a required signature, or some other reason. When this happens, the staff doesn't even take the time to notify me that a package has arrived. I had one package sit in the leasing office for over a month because I wasn't expecting it and was never notified that they received anything.

* On a positive note, I haven't had any problems with noise - but this might vary quite a bit depending which unit you're in.

* Most of the convenient shops below are overpriced. Would be great to have a convenient lunch/dinner option without spending $25.

Things that were advertised:
- Secured parking garage with resident-only access from the 2nd floor up.
- Secured access building, only residents can enter the upper floors of the building, use the elevators, etc.
- A year-round heated pool

All of the three things mentioned above didn't happen. Parking garage was never secured. Gates became operational, someone would hit one, then became in-operational indefinitely because they were "installing new warning lights" and "needed a part" that apparently never came. Because of this, several cars were broken into, windows smashed the entire two years I lived there. My license plate was stolen off my vehicle on the 4th floor of the parking garage.

The secured access into the building on my floor was compromised for over a year. The door from the garage (which was no longer secure), into the building, was broken because of poor construction. I had requested someone to look at it to be fixed. After months of not seeing it fixed, my storage unit down the hall of my apartment was broken into very easily, as well as several other storage units in that room. Thousands of dollars of things were stolen, and the Den was no help. Refused to look at the security cameras because "you can't really see anything on those anyway", and then basically said "we do not guarantee safety or security of the building or your belongings in any way."

Lastly, the pool. Advertised as "year-round heated pool". This was great on those random days where it would be 80 in February. They claimed that the heated pool didn't meet City of Denver requirements to be open all year round, so they stopped heating the pool. Instead of just doing what the City required. My guess was that it was getting too expensive for them to keep it heated year round. Also, hot tub was broken frequently.

In closing-- don't move here. Management is terrible. You will get your things stolen, because criminals target this high-end building. Even after setting up a meeting with the manager about my concerns, no one was helpful, nor did they really care that multiple things have been stolen from me despite the building being "resident-only". For being a "luxury apartment" and paying the higher price, I was left feeling like I was not getting what I was paying for, and not getting what the leasing agents boasted about during the walking tour.

The apartments were great but when I looked at one the bathroom in the one bedroom we looked at smelled like sewage!! Sewage is toxic so I didnt move in. If they are showing a until that smells like that I cannot imagine other units dont smell like that. It was sooo gross.

Disappointing Experience the lack of security measures in the parking space made it difficult to feel safe and protected within the complex. The apartments have cameras but cars and bicycles often get stolen to even be considered a "luxury apartment".
In addition to the security concerns, the sanitation situation at the property was distressing. The maintenance of common areas, such as hallways and stairwells, was severely neglected. Filthy floors, overflowing trash bins, and unpleasant odors were a common sight, indicating a lack of cleanliness and regular maintenance.

There is a high car theft rate in this complex. 
People are always breaking into the garage and the hallways, floors, and elevators are constantly dirty even though there is a cleaning fee included every month. Definitely not a luxury property.

Staff is friendly and respectful however safety/theft, and cleanliness are an issue that is not prioritized for being a luxury apartment. Cars often get stolen and the foul smell due to the lack of sanitation is often unpleasant especially when friends and family come to visit.

Moved in this year, because it’s close to my work. Looks great on the outside, and the area around the apartment is also nice. But the parking garage is a disaster. People take your “assigned” parking spot all the time, the access to the garage is suppose to be for residents only. But the garage doors that you’re suppose to need a garage door opener for, is constantly open 24/7. My car has been hit twice in a six month time span. Only to have no luck with the renting office or police into accessing the security cameras. There’s been a window in our hallway that’s been broken out since we moved in, along with a note from another resident saying it’s been like that for over a year. Our apartment itself is nice, and the maintenance crew is usually here within a day or two to fix whatever issues we have. Dogs are allowed, but expect to see the dog poop stations overflowing, and be out of bags constantly.
We love our home (especially since weve spent so much time in the the last year)! Its clean, quiet and such a great and bright layout!
The work order system at Outlook is great! The Maintenance team responds quickly to any concert we might have.

If I could give this place 0 stars, I would.  Management is horrible.  Parking is a joke.  Maintenance is slow and unresponsive.  You can hear your neighbors through the walls.  You can hear the traffic through the windows. There are WAY better places to live in the area and even worth paying more to avoid this place!

We lived here for a year before leaving in which we did like it. I WOULD NOT LIVE HERE. They charged us over $800 for a cleaning fee for cleaning that they should have performed themselves. Pictures they sent include hair on the floor, fingerprints, and dryer lint. I have NEVER lived in a place where you need to get professional grout and carpet cleaners to come in an clean or you will be charged. Further, for writing this review I received an email from the management complaining about my previous post. This is why reviews are so important. The pictures that were sent to me that I requested of the damage do not add up to $800 they sent me pictures of the sink which had dust from moving out a month before they performed the walk through, light bulbs that were out, a picture of fingerprints, and ice in the freezer. I could not post pictures to this review but if you have any questions about living here please feel free to message me. This company is hungry for money and should be taken to court. Very disappointed in how this management handled loyal tenants who paid rent on time every month and followed all procedures for over a year.

My family recently moved from Texas which was super stressful. The manager and leasing agent helped a great deal in reducing the stress for us. From the application process to move in they were always willing to answer questions and even send me pictures of our actual unit since we would be moving in site unseen. The property is absolutely beautiful and well maintained. Well worth the rent.

This place is a complete joke. The pest control isn't being kept up at all, mailboxes have been broken for weeks and have to got to the post office for mail. Homeless sleep in the hallways and owners dont care at all.

I've always had a positive experience here. The maintenance staff has always completed my request in a timely fashion, and the leasing team is stellar. 

Anytime that I've had an issue, they've always been able to assist.

I have had a terrible experience living here. Since I moved in, about 2 months ago, we have not had any air conditioning. We have filed endless work orders and have talked to everyone that works here and they won’t fix it. I work from home and had to deal with sitting in 87 degrees heat all day. Also, trying to sleep in 83 degree heat is miserable.

We have had issues with so many other things, like no hot water for long periods of time and people parking in our parking spaces without being towed.

I have never written a review for anything before but my experience living here has been so terrible I had to get this out. Hopefully people read this and realize what a scam this apartment building is.

Since moving in here I’ve been amazed with all the amenities that have been involved with being a new resident. They offer valet trash, ButterflyMX, fetch package services. And so much more so it makes like sooooo easy. I legit leave my bin outside and boom picked up. I love it. And I even had to get rid of my grill since the property had so many!
This place went downhill fast. Meth labs, pipes bursting, management ignoring us, and THEFT ALL THE TIME. I advise you to go to our FB group and see what's up.

I have lived at the property for two months now and have had nothing but bad experiences. My move in was delayed twice by almost a week with three days notice because of water damage that was not fixed when I eventually did move in. On top of that, you are charged large fees for the utilities for the entire building on top of another 50 dollar charge for a Fetch and a trash service. If you have any maintenance issues you won't get them fixed in any timely matter because of how understaffed the building is. Live anywhere else if you can, there are even buildings next door if you want to live in the area.
Friendly, clean environment for my dogs and I - great location and amazing amenities!

I’ve wanted to live in a high rise for awhile and have toured maybe half a dozen other communities. I honestly didn’t care for the 2 vacant apartments I saw here on my tour, but love my place! And something about it here just felt right compared to the other apartments in Denver I’ve seen.
One of the nicest communities I have lived in! Management is always helpful.

Staff is very friendly but shows room for improvement on communication. Attention is only shown towards prospects and residents gets shuffled under the rug. Building hallways smell rancid from bags of trash left out and we tried to mitigate putting trash bags directly on the carpet with our valet trash can provided at move in, however, this trash can was stolen from in front of our door one evening. 
Weekends make me feel like I live in a student housing community.

Nothing bad comes to mind about this complex. The maintenance guys are all as cool as can be and know exactly what they're doing. There's no guesswork or nonsense involved, they just come in, are super nice, and get done what you've asked them to. Excellent experience with everything else otherwise

I have lived here for two months and have been very comfortable in the space. For a downtown apartment, the price is relatively affordable. The amenities are wonderful, and the pool is my favorite. The management is incredibly kind and works hard to ensure we are all happy. I have not had any issues with service requests and have been able to quickly have any issues rectified. I am happy to live here minus the construction across the street, but this is Denver you literally have to start expecting that, plus, the building is concrete, so it's not even loud during the day.
Do not move here, poor management, overpriced and hallways are dirty from valet trash.

I have lived here for 3 months of an 18 month lease. Maintenance and communication from management has been incredibly poor. Not only would I not recommend this building, we are considering breaking our lease

I have lived at Arapahoe Square for more than two years. I have enjoyed my time here at Arapahoe Square, but I am moving to spend more quality time with my family. We have experienced several staff transitions lately, but I have enjoyed each and every member.

Current Resident Here.  If you have a social life, this is not the place for you. The building has a no guest policy. So if you want to go in the hot tub with a girlfriend, not allowed, no fun.  You can only be friends with other residents and enjoy the amenities. Ok, you are friends with residents, sorry only 3 of you can be in the hot tub that can easily fit 20 people. This is just a sample of what is going on and almost every resident that I have talked to is leaving at the end of their lease cause other buildings don’t treat you like children. They will say they are following CDC guidelines but when you read them yourself, there is no mention of anything that they are practicing in the building. We are all adults and can make our risk/reward assessment.  The managing staff are nice and do their best but they need to do better to be accommodating to young adults life styles. We don’t pay this high rent to be told how to live our lives.

We moved from out of state & virtually toured over a dozen properties. Read reviews of Amli Rino, toured over FT (the sales pitch looking back was *chefs kiss) 
“Only 65% occupancy, quiet neighborhood/safe, 1 month free, great floor plan/amenities, 1st parking spot is free & 2nd is only $100, they are an energy conscious community…” 
The building. Great. The unit really nice. Our bathroom fan hasn’t worked since we arrived a month ago, but they were pretty responsive to that originally. Not a huge deal. 
There are homeless encampments everywhere. I can’t walk alone with my dog, or go for a run as I’ve been yelled at, spit at, followed several times. I can’t ride my bike down the river path next to the complex because they are so densely camped along the entrances. 

Sirens every night. They shoot off fireworks? needles on the sidewalks, they wander onto property, have had 1 guy wander into the building due to someone propping the door open. 

Amlis leasing offices response is, we can’t do anything, you can complain to the city. We’ll, they could be in the office during posted business hours for starters. Had to call the police because we couldn’t get ahold of them when we passed this guy coming off the elevator. 

The ATTITUDE from that leasing office. They either hate their job or don’t know how to communicate because asking for a package shouldn’t be met with an attitude. Complaints or concerns shouldn’t be met with placating a resident. They also in the lease, & in the tour told us we get 1 free parking spot & can pay for 1 additional. What does, “1st spot free or additional vehicles” mean? That you can have more than 1. Nope. 

“1 spot per unit” no additional parking onsite other than maybe 10 spots not on the street. We had to park over a mile away the other day to get parking I. 

Unprofessional, unempathetic at a minimum and just poorly managed overall. Should have been transparent about the homelessness.

I have lived here for 4 years & I absolutely love it! The amenities are my favorite part, the rooftop & work from home space makes me feel like I live at a luxury resort when guests come over. Everything from the maintenance to the staff, 5 stars. Huge plus being 10 mins from downtown & Great Lawn Park is my dogs backyard… beat that!
This is nice on the outside, but the management company charges you for every little thing, plus the management is condescending, unprofessional and bad mouths other residents.

Buyer beware. Moved out after dealing with a leaky roof, drug use, constant malfunctioning alarms, and amenities that were not well cared for. Multiple communications with no resolve, so I left after giving plenty of notice of them violating their part of the lease. Received a zero balance via mail in August, however received a collections bill for 21k this past Friday. Seems like most of the bad apples in the company left from when I was there. Hope the new people turn it around. Will fight this in the courts, and countersue for damages.

I am a current resident and was verbally lied to at the time of signing the new lease. Without asking how to break an early lease we were provided information that they actually offered something totally different to other complex’s instead of having to pay a large lump sum to break a lease they offered tenants the opportunity to have someone else take over the lease. Now jump to today we’re extremely unhappy living here and want to move and are being told that is not an option there isn’t a way to break the lease period we are stuck here for the entire year. Do not believe anything they verbally tell you make sure to get into writing.
The management company is absolutely awful! They’re condescending and rude and full of excessive charges. The building is beautiful but not worth dealing with the management.

The new management company is horrible. They cannot keep the buildings or common areas (pool, etc)clean. I have been double charged for rent 2x in the past 4 months. They also stopped using the code box for after hours entry, so I have to go down to the lobby when I have a food delivery - defeats the purpose of non-contact delivery.

Want bullet holes in your lobby doors for 3 months? Broken elevators and hot tubs that take 1-2 months to fix? Broken fridge takes 2.5 months to fix? This was all in the last 6 months - been here 3+ years and Gables Vista has become unlivable. Don’t recommend to anyone and will be leaving as soon as we can.

Edit: Ah - I forgot the water leak that we couldn’t live here for 2 weeks and needed to move into hotels. Gas leaks that almost blew the building up. And the multiple cars stolen from our private garage. Security is terrible here (also all in the last 6 months)

I’ve been a resident at Gables Vista in Cherry Creek since April 2024 and it’s been issue after issue. It's disheartening to write this review because I was so excited to live in this building and completed (what I thought was) a lot of research prior to signing a lease. I hadn't anticipated leaving a 1 star review so early into my lease, but I hope doing so saves prospective tenants future heartache. Do not move here.

TLDR:
- June 2024: a shooting into the lobby
- July 2024: a gas outage that left residents without hot water and utilities with no concessions for food costs - third party shower options were offered on the 3rd day without hot water
- September 2024: water outage for 6 days
- amenity issues
- soiled carpets in the resident hallways

The response from property management is defensive and lacking empathy. Example: when requests were made to have biweekly email updates on the lobby shooting from June, it was too burdensome for them to commit to (last update was provided on August 7th).

The 80+ page lease locks you into an impossible situation. Save yourself the time, MONEY, stress and hassle and choose elsewhere. They charge way too much for these issues to be "the rule" and not "the exception".

At this point it’s not “if” another maintenance or safety issue will occur, but “when”.
Over a month to get anything fixed. No hot water for days, no water for a day, broken hot tub. The list goes on. Drive by shootings. Moving out as soon as my lease is up.

A mix bag experience. 

Pros:
Love the area. Friendly staff. Nice lay outs. Common areas always seem well maintained.

Cons:
The 3rd floor parking garage constantly smells of dog urine. 
Maintenance is lacking. When I moved into the apt a toilet was broken and the ac broken. The ac unit didn’t have a filter for the past 5 years, so it clogged. Due to years of drainage back up we still smell sewage from time to time around the ac. The fridge is missing a filter, and has had a smell since move in. Faucet with rust and mold still awaiting repair.   Dakota avenue side, be warned the building next door has a near constant loud generator sound that you will hear all day. The apartment building across has been doing months long renovations and appears no where near finishing  as of 10/23. Entering and exiting the complex strained due to cars parked in street and construction crane. dirty carpets from dog owners leaving dog poop and from trash stains. Revolving staff.  

Have had better.
Like living at Gables very much. Wish they would fix the ice machine and add a game table somewhere. Workout facilities are nice. Public areas are clean.

Safe clean and quiet residence.  Staff are friendly and helpful.  Security appears to be a priority.  Pool and spa areas are beautiful and well maintained.  Multiple opportunities to gather with others.

plain and simple. dont live here unless you cant afford a nicer place. No idea how this place says 4.2 stars as none of the reviews on here are over 2. They somehow probably paid for that. Asset Management took over at the beginning of the year. None of this relates to the leasing agents. they do what they can. this is about the management company that took over. 

The pros of this place are the location, the cost, and the amenities ( kind of). First and foremost I have lived here for two years now because they keep dropping my rent. Its hard to leave because of that. Since then the 11th floor co working space flood when there was a leak in the pool. The pool is fixed but the co-working space has yet to get worked on since, its been 8 months. No communication on when it will be open again or if they plan on opening it again. This also hit the serves for the key fobs on the doors to the building and apartments. Its stead of getting them fixed they instead started to replace the locks with deadbolts, which they swapped out without any heads up to the residence in those co-living rooms. One of my current roommates has three different keys for the building, the suite, and his private room. I dont have the ability to keep my room unlocked or locked, its one or the other unless i want to have the front office do it. I use to have control before the servers went down. 
The three garage doors on the parking garages broke in June and have yet to get fixed. There is no security on site for the once private parking garages. If your car gets broken into its your own fault. There's no inclination that they are going to get fixed. They do have a security team, but I have yet to see any of them around. its probably a monitoring team that isn't actually on site. 
the leasing team/management has done is remove all of the trash cans from the first floor. I mean the only trash cans are in the bathrooms or behind the front desk. Some of the bathrooms have small sample size dish soap in them instead of hand soap. The lounge area has really odd hours. m-f 9-6, sat 12-5. these could be off as I don't go there, they don't clean it. There use to be small trees out front but they removed those. they axed the bar/kitchen when they took over and dont plan on reopening it. 

This place just kinda smells in some areas for no reason. Parking is 150-200 a month. The maintence team is just as bad. they dont talk to the front office.

X Denver is a nightmare. They put residents in the wrong rooms, ignore maintenance requests, and fail to address serious issues like leaks and broken amenities. Prices are deceptive, and living conditions are abysmal. Residents endure weeks without basic utilities and face unexpected fees. The management is unresponsive and manipulative. Avoid this place at all costs.

I would agree with all the one star reviews that are posted on here. The only thing that was working for this complex was the amenities however they seemed to have closed the lounge as of December 12th. No further explanation on why and if anything is going to replace it. Don’t move here and look for other places 

During the time I lived here you could hear neighbors with tv’s blasting and the club throwing parties while dumping ice over the 12th floor balcony to the 3rd floor level. Don’t get me started on the trains shaking the entire building at all hours of the day. The front desk/management does not care for feedback as they just want to get paid and leave considering there was no front desk or management for about 3 to 4 months as they complained and worked from home. Typical reply time is 24 to 48 hours if you send a message and finally if you can afford to live here get a P.O box so you can have packages and mail delivered there as its safer than having your mail or packages stolen

They’ll do anything to get you to sign a lease and then you’ll never see another leasing agent in the building again. It’s impossible to talk to someone who runs the building. 

Packages get stolen constantly, the lounge areas are disgusting. The hot tub is only a cold tub and your co-living situations are terrible. 

Just DONT.

Stay away from this place. Secured an apartment in May 2023 with a deposit. Move in date was June 10. 3 days before they said the apartment was given away. 
I am STILL waiting for my deposit back and it is Sept 21,2023. 
No one will return my calls. They give info via text only. Completely incompetent staff. 
DO NOT RENT HERE. YOU WILL BE SORRY

Worst property management. Major life and safety issues. Stay away … They host gatherings more than occupancy allowed on the rooftop and use the staircases for storage. They really don’t care if someone get hurt in this apartment. They have the cheapest finishes. You can trip over the flooring that is peeling off and hurt yourself. Also they make you pay premium for the amenities and they add miscellaneous charges to your bill for common amenities while the amenities are usually “closed” for various reasons.So you’ll be paying much more than advertised. Get ready for the app not working and “randomly” getting locked out of your residence.

X Denver is inexcusably mismanaged at every level. The amenities are not worth the daily headache of dealing with the incompetency and immaturity of the leasing staff. 

I moved units during my stay here and was made to pay over $2,000 on my moving day with no prior notice. My new unit was not ready and I had already taken off work, so I was made to wait all day in the lobby to start my move. I was given no mailbox key for months, leaving me walking around with an expired temporary ID, because even after 6 rounds of conversations with leasing I couldn’t get a key until I asked other residents that faced similar issues to get management’s contact information. Management resolved the issue but could not even be bothered to respond to my email.

It’s a nightmare to get ahold of anyone in the leasing office and when you finally do, nobody knows what they’re doing. There’s no longer anyone that mans the front desk, the link to set up an appointment is broken, and nobody answers the phone. Management is grossly negligent.

If you’re still unsure if you want to move here I encourage you to ask your tour guide about current turnover rates. The X can attract new residents but refuses to hire leasing staff with the competency to support and retain its existing residents. As long as this trend continues, rent levels will push artificially higher to cover the additional cost of new resident acquisition. I urge you to invest your time and money somewhere else.

The management of X Denver is absolutely awful, especially in the coliving. 

The front desk is supposed to be open 10-6 every day and in 9 months of living there I have yet to see someone working. No one answers the phone. The only way to communicate is via text or the X Denver app. I’ve experienced waiting 6 days for a reply. Trying to get a hold of someone is nearly impossible. 

My coliving roommate abruptly moved out before the end of his lease (either evicted or broke his lease) and I received no communication from X Denver on the matter. Luckily my roommate told me he was leaving, otherwise I would’ve just noticed empty cupboards one day. 

I reached out and asked if anyone would be entering my apartment for maintenance, inspections, etc. The reply was that they always try their hardest to give advance notice. I got back from the gym one day to find a man in my apartment, blasting music and painting the empty bedroom. The next day I got out of the shower to find a group of people cleaning the bedroom. As a young woman living alone, it’s unacceptable that I should feel uncomfortable and unsafe in my own home, with the fear that someone will enter my apartment at any moment. I tried to speak with someone about this and didn’t hear back for 6 days. 

In addition, after my first roommate moved out, I asked what the process is to fill the other bedroom. They said they’d give me a one week notice if someone is moving in. One day a leasing agent enters my apartment (again with no advance notice) to inspect the other bedroom. She says, “Oh, since you’re here I should warn you that you might be getting a new roommate tomorrow”. Turns out someone had signed a lease that was supposed to start the next day, and they didn’t realize until the day before that that unit was “unsuitable”. Therefore, they planned to put this individual in my unit with no advance notice to me. They wouldn’t confirm at all that day or the next morning whether a man would be entering and moving into my apartment. Again, as a young woman living alone this is extremely uncomfortable and stress-inducing. 

Overall, the management and communication here is poor. It’s impossible to get a hold of anyone, they do not care about their residents, and it’s basically just a bunch of college kids running the place. Do not live here if you can avoid it. 

The amenities are not worth it, either. I also got food poisoning from the X Denver Club Lounge.

it takes them 4-5 hours to message back on their own app. All of their workers are nose deep into their laptops, and they dont see the message bubbles pop up on their screen? why have a front desk if you moved all your workers upstairs? That's idiotic. so instead of going all the way down to the first floor, you gotta go all the way up to the 12th floor or wherever they decide to set up. its kinda like where is waldo. gotta find em. hide and seek love that game. probably the most employees they've had since the opening of this apartment complex, and it takes days for anything to get done, they dont follow up with you, but they will let their little bot ask you "from a 1 star to 5star how would you rate your conversion" their app doesnt even work, there will be an event that has tickets left, you go to rsvp for that said event, it says its sold out. while you're able to see that theres tickets still available. 1 out of 5 again.

This place’s property management company is Asset Living. While my problems with no heating or AC for 10 months started with X CO’s (the building’s owner) first property management company; those problems absolutely continued into Asset Living’s takeover. I used to recommend this place to dozens of my friends, and convinced 10 or so people to even re-sign. But now I wasn’t surprised when I heard their renewal rate was only 8%. (I heard this from word of mouth, could be a little higher or lower; still atrocious though)

Recently my newest roommate moved in and they’re amazing, but they got absolutely screwed over during the move in process. The room was supposed to be cleaned, sanitized, and repainted (because the paint the use chips insanely easily) before they moved in (Pretty basic standards there for any apartment). But even up to the day they were supposed to move in the room was disgusting. It was so bad that management literally wouldn't let them see the room, and forced them to wait another day to move in. Even then the room wasn’t cleaned properly. And this definitely isn’t the fault of the cleaning staff, they are so kind and wonderful. My new roommate did get a concession of 1.5ish months off rent, but wow she was literally so stressed because she couldn’t go into work because of Asset Living’s mess up. 

My new roommate’s story isn’t unique, I have multiple friends that’ve all had major trouble with their units and have had to be given concessions of months off rent to not go to public or take down their negative reviews. I went through all the proper channels when my AC/heat and other unit issues were happening but looking back I should have raised hell. I mean, I went through an entire WINTER with no heat and summer with no AC.  They have a chance to make things right, but thus far haven’t yet. I’ll make sure to update this review if they do. It’s exhausting that the only way to get problems fixed is weeks/months of constant pressuring. 

Parking is incredibly expensive and the waitlist for spots is often months long. Also there have been multiple car break-ins and bike thefts IN the garage itself. Not to mention the fact that their package room is outside so people steal packages by just breaking into the lockers. Security has done a better job recently though.

Asset Living needs to start listening to their community managers and residents. This place has SO much potential, and I want to see it succeed.

Had my car broken into and 2 others in the locked parking garage that we pay $200 a month to park in. Thieves stole over $5k in belongs and management didn’t even bat an eye and wouldn’t cooperate in showing footage. (Whole thing happened in front of cameras). Many many other story’s like this. Do yourself a favor and don’t live here

I moved in August of 2021. During the 10 months I've lived here I've had NO heating or cooling for the entirety of my residence expect for one 2 weeks period (A couple months into my stay maintenance came and fixed the heat pump, but it immediately broke again less than 14 days later). This is absolutely ridiculous. It get's incredibly hot in these apartments on warm days. And on cold days, it's even worse. Maintenance provided me an outlet-heater, and that would technically be a okayish temporary measure: except I CAN'T use the heater b/c it trips the breakers. So basically they gave me a heater I can't use so they can protect themselves from being sued for negligence or whatever. For how insane rent is here, you'd think they would just go out and buy a heat pump, but no. It's been on order for MONTHS. And every time I ask it's just right around the corner from getting fixed (fun fact: it's not). The pool is dope and so is the lounge (little overpriced, but wonderful views) and the gym is nice too(It isn't dope if you live on the 11th floor below the gym. They didn't design the floor right and all 11th floor residents can here weights being put down/dropped. So now the gyms only open till midnight instead of 24/7 as was advertised when I was signing my lease). The people that live here are also dope. But man oh man think twice about actually living here.  I'm purposefully putting a 2 star review instead of a 1 star review so you know I didn't just casually review this place.

I had originally left a 1-star review when I had major problems moving into the building (due to a lack of communication from those who work here) but then I changed it because management reached out and I thought they sincerely were sorry and wanted to do better...I'm usually understanding except when people waste my time and money.
