No fresh air in the room. We didn’t ask for the tour and Mercer didn’t offer one. Also the window being permanently closed was not mentioned. But the good thing is it’s a short term lease and we are managing. Another good thing is the AC and exhaust type fan run in the room. So you will have access to that. Apart from this, Mercer has a nice deck area, staircase sitting area and fitness studio. These are the best. Also, there is a coffee machine which allows you to have coffee multiple times a month for free. I would recommend to stay in Mercer after having a tour of the apartment.

My experience at the Mercer has been nothing short of incredible. The building is close to the action of downtown Denver. The staff is kind, warm, responsive, and caring. Any concerns are listened to. The management makes constant and swift decision making to better the experience of the residents.

Very poor customer service including unpleasant experience with management team absolutely unprofessional and rude customer service.I would not recommend any Greystar properties due to intentional misleading especially fees and screening process. My experience was awful and I learned my information didn’t match records on file with third party service where they made an error with social security number that agency did apologize for mistake , however management at Mercer did nothing. Outrageous customer service and for those reasons I can’t recommend them.

The Mercer, so far, is great in my opinion. I’ve never had built-in wifi, which a was a fun surprise, as it follows you throughout the building and not just in your apartment. LOVE the monthly events they host; super fun, super cute. Staff has been absolutely AMAZING. Coming from previous properties who have had a less than good management team, this team meets the bar and just tops it off with the professionalism and kindness. Damion and Jordan have been so attentive and helpful to the many questions and concerns I’ve run into. They do not make me feel like a pest when I have a million questions. Staff really makes it for me- everything else is a plus!

If you are looking for a family oriented building downtown at a reasonable price, extra-caring staff and nice neighbors!! Look no further. The Mercer is the place to be. The state of the arts 24 hour gym and the free laundry room are some of my favorite places! The conference rooms also help me study with my baby. Damian and Jordan  are very nice! The apartment gave us tenants a valentines party and it was soo nice to see people get together. So far this is my favorite apartment, especially being thousands of miles away from home. To you gentlemen, keep up the good customer service. When you do something from the heart, it shows.

THE best spot in Denver to live. It is a brand new building with the BEST staff. I also work in the residential industry, so I know how hard finding a good place can be. From day one, the amazing property managers Jordan and Damion have been as helpful and friendly as can be! Rori, the maintenance tech, has also been friendly and amazing! This property has gone above and beyond to meet my needs as a new move in and the location is far better than expected. It is so fun to be right by union station, with such a great price too!
The Mercer is a great community in LoDo. Central location in LoDo of Denver! Great property manager & staff. Would recommend for anyone coming to Denver & looking to live downtown for a good price.
So far, my experience in this building has been fantastic. The space the home location is perfect. Wouldn’t of chose any anywhere else
The Mercer isn’t one of those huge megaplex apartments where you feel like a number. It’s giving more of a boutique hotel vibe where the staff care and you feel taken care of.

Great staff! Garrett answered all my questions while taking the tour and responded to my emails immediately. The apartment complex is in a quiet and clean area of Denver while at the same time being within walking distance from all the great things that Denver offers. The building has great amenities and each unit I looked at was modern and comfortable.
Not only does this apartment have great amenities - but every request I have is fulfilled quickly. I needed to repaint some walls and Tanner was so quick and detail oriented with it.

I had a problem with garbage disposal and I put work order in the Sentral app. Maintenance showed up quick and he was polite, friendly and get the work done! I am very impressed with Keith. He did a great job!

I cannot even begin to express how much I love living here. The complex itself is kept extremely clean, the staff are friendly, the amenities are the best in Denver, and they have so much to offer beyond that. I’ve lived at a few different complexes and Sentral blows each one out the water by far. Location is prime, the apartments themselves have amazing layouts, and it is truly such a community feeling. I would recommend this building to everyone and anyone. They offer tons of community events, deals on rent when moving in, and really try to give the residents and hotel quests a community feel.

This is a beautiful building with top notch amenities. However communication from management is average at best (though has gotten a bit better with new manager in fall 2022). I've lived here since late 2021 and the property has not met my expectations, but is good enough to stay because moving is a pain. Maintenance/cleaning team is great. Parking and certain amenity fees are ridiculous.

I decided to sign a lease for an unfurnished 1-BR/1BA sight unseen and I could see myself living here for a while! The layout accurately reflects the floorplan and virtual tour online. I am pleased with the large walk-in closet, ample kitchen cabinet space, and other features like the tile bathroom flooring and carpeted bedroom. The pool and gym are just the icing on the cake to a wonderful location, friendly neighbors, dedicated staff, and thoughtfully catered resident events. Access to the south Platte River and surrounding parks is less than a 10-minute walk away which is great for getting the dog outside, and it’s about a 4-minute drive to hit I-25 for mountain adventures. If you are deciding on your next place to live or visit in Denver, then look no further than Sentral Union Station.
Seemed great at the beginning but they have plenty of pest issues that go unresolved and not worth the price.

There has been so much cockroaches is disgusting to live and I've only been here since May. The staff has been rude to me since I've complained and have done nothing to help or even care. They maintenance is speedy but they come and tell me there is nothing they can do for anything I've asked. On top of that I've had an harassment from the neighbor and they could care less. Horrible place to live and it's basically unlivable with the infestation situation. Please avoid these apartments I wish someone told me.

My husband and I have been here for 3 years without any major complaints. I personally think they should invest in higher quality appliances because several of ours have broken (hot water heater, dryer, and fridge), BUT maintenance comes and fixes them immediately. Several neighbors have been evicted, so just make sure you’re aware of all costs before signing. The dog park is usually great, and I love having the security of the Amazon lock boxes. My biggest complaint is how loud the air conditioning units are- sleeping with the window open in the summer, it’s incredibly loud to have 3 AC units right outside our window, but we manage. Good amount of storage in hallway closet + balcony closet (we keep extra tires, luggage, golf clubs, camping and ski gear all in these 2 closets.)

I moved from out-of-state & the garage wasn’t ready when I moved in. Business center PCs not activated, so no security. On the 10th day of the month almost everyone in my building had a landlord notice.

When neighbors poo, I can smell it. Apt smells like cigarettes/bar. No smoking policy so I guess people smoke inside. Laundry gives you bad morning breath & washer smells like a wet band-aid. Dryer turns off every 20 min & the line backs up.

Apt started smelling like rat poop after they changed the HVAC filter. Last time I smelled this, it was from an old rat infestation. When HVAC turns on, air pours out of vents and under sinks. On a bad night people have their doors open & you can go out on the balcony and bathe in rat poop from other people’s apts.

The living room rocks up and down in the wind. Water leaks repaired w/ tape and paint. I sealed the drafts, even the dishwasher cord, and the smells went away.. until my throat swelled up.. Looks like I have walnuts in my neck.

Maintenance said my standards were too high, insulting me because I didn’t have a job yet. I was nice to them. Was told he was fired for not completing jobs & now I’m dealing w/ the same rude stuff from the maintenance manager, who should have completed jobs if not already completed.

Lease is 1/2 over and they haven’t completed a single maintenance request. No maintenance receipts so you have to take screenshots. Knobs came off when I tried to use them. Bathroom sink clogged, water heater & fridge turned to max, living room light blew up cuz one of the lights was the wrong kind. Maintenance reclaimed the other bulbs to use in other units and left. Took a month to get my mailbox key & they ended up just giving me their key. Toilet runs, bubbles & smells, fridge motor broken, neighbors call in noise complaints, floors have leveling & make noise, hollow walls like a cheap Extended Stay & noise is amplified. Bedroom blinds broke, vertical blinds jam, wasps come in from nests on roof. Office is often closed for tour. On the 1st, office was open unsupervised w/ ~25 people waiting 30 min. Called 90 min later and no answer. Water kept leaking so high bill and no water. Bedroom doorstop painted on. $500 off special advertised only applies to apts w/ problems. Complex right outside calls cops multiple times per week. Bedroom carpet looks normal, but is so bumpy you need a bed w/ adjustable legs. Bedroom is so drafty sometimes I’m not sure if the window is open or not.

Let me start off by saying that the Alton Green complex is VERY nice and very well kept. We were in one of the newer apartments and it was absolutely perfect. We had a 1 BR 1 BA, and it was the absolute perfect space for my fiance and I. The office staff is wonderful and so friendly, and we enjoyed them thoroughly while we were there! 

The only thing I wasn't okay with with Alton was all of the fees they add in addition to your rent. I understand having to pay the water, trash, sewage, etc... but some of these fees are absolutely RIDICULOUS and are hidden from you (I'm assuming intentionally) basically until your first month of rent is due. All of these fees (including a fee for keeping up the grounds around the complex..?) added an additional $200-$250 to our rent, which wasn't doable for us. We ended up having to break our lease and move out due to these extra fees. 

I am not necessarily complaining about these fees because they are there at most complexes you go to... I'm more so not happy about the fact that they were hidden and not really explained to us before we signed a lease. Plus, on a lot of places on apartments.com, apartment complexes will be up front in their information and say whether or not there are fees for these things and how much they are, but Alton does not.

That being said... it's a great complex, nice and clean apartments, and wonderful office staff and management. Just be aware if you're looking here about these extra fees- they will charge you for literally EVERYTHING that they can.

If you love the convenience of internet shopping, please save your money and do not live here. They have lost at least $400 worth of packages (mostly car parts) just in the last two months alone and will not take responsibility for it. These people are crooks, you can get a lot more for your money elsewhere, maybe even at a place that doesn't lose your packages. According to Alton Green, getting the things you paid for is a luxury, such as packages or a working dishwasher or a microwave that was promised when you moved in. I've lived here for almost 3 years and instead of being civil and telling me they were not going to offer to renew my lease in a timely manner, they instead gave me notice 40 days before I had to be out. They treat tenants as dollar signs, not people. Save yourself!

Living here was the worst apartment experience of my life. I had to hire a lawyer to prevent the landlord from doing construction work inside my unit while I was living there -- paying full rent and locked into a lease. Thankfully, the lawyer was able to keep them out, but it cost me $800 in legal fees and generated a ton of anxiety. ...  I'm sure this apartment building will look wonderful once the construction work is all done. But prospective tenants should be aware that the landlord and property manager (Baron Properties) do not respect tenants' basic rights. For instance, tenants were required to leave their apartment doors unlocked throughout the day so construction workers could come and go. I observed apartments with doors left wide open, which compromised tenants' safety and the security of their belongings. (This building is located in an urban neighborhood with high rates of theft and a sizable transient population.) Moreover, the construction work was messy and loud, and it resulted in water shut-offs, power outages, and numerous fire alarms. The management office showed little concern or regard for tenants. My life was quite miserable for the last few months of living at the Belmont Buckingham. ... One final note: The building has some fundamental problems that prospective tenants should watch out for. The water has a disgusting orange/red tint; the electrical wiring is shoddy (I couldn't use two kitchen appliances at one time); and the elevator is constantly breaking down (I got stuck inside once for 20 minutes, and the fire department had to be called). Also, the building has lead paint, which can be extremely dangerous if disturbed. If construction work continues, tenants should be certain that proper lead abatement measures are in place. I never even saw a construction permit while I was living there. ...  I've always had very positive rental experiences, as I'm a friendly, clean, and responsible tenant. I NEVER envisioned myself having to hire a lawyer to fend off an unscrupulous landlord. It was extremely stressful, to say the least. I have since found a beautiful apartment just a few blocks away. Everything works great, and the building is run by a company that treats tenants with respect.

Living here has been nothing but a pain. The “soft” remodel is a joke. Workers walk in without knocking, construction goes on well past the time it’s supposed to end, management does not respond to voicemails, the radiator clangs all winter and burns you up with the heat, the elevator rarely works, the call box breaks frequently, neighbors will party on the patio long after its closed and management does absolutely nothing to fix any of this. I have lived here for six months, and it is a complete disaster. Management is completely incompetent. And don’t be fooled by the promise of a remodel. They are taking away your closet space to add a washer and dryer and are replacing the counters. The new signs are cheaply done and look ridiculous.
Read the reviews...trust the reviews.. anything marked higher than a 2 was probably written by an employee.

Would not recommed this property to anyone.   For the first two years we lived here the property was great and then there was a change in ownership.  Since that change has happened, it has been a revolving door of staff in the management office.  There was a point in time when within a matter of weeks, whenever we went to the management office, all the staff was brand new.  This revolving door went on for over a year and is still going, with the latest casualty being the Regional Manager for Baron Properties. 

Fast forward to two weeks ago, when we get a notice from the leasing office stating that they are not renewing our lease due to renovations (of which we found out thorugh the NextDoor app).  They did give us the option to stay month to month and then move to a renovated unit for an extra $300 - $400 per month.  But, to this day the leasing office has not been able to fully articulate what the upgrades are.  No thanks. 

Yesterday, shortly before we were going to leave town for close to a week, we received a notice that we are supposed to empty a couple of our closets so that they can put electrical and plumbing in them.  This was Thursday, for something happening the following Monday-Friday.  We were also told that if we do not empty,the closets, they would fine us.  

Finally, this notice also let us know that everyday between 8am - 5pm they will be unlocking the door to our home so that random construction workers can come in and out all day for the project.  This is Monday through Friday, with 2 business days notice.  Since this construction started, the security doors into our building have been propped open by construction workers.  Now, our front doors will be as well.  I wish I was making this up.  

I don't feel safe for myself or my belongings here with this happening.  My husband works from home too, so now he has no place to work from when we return home to a construction crew, doing whatever they are doing in our home.  We've also had to board our indoor cat (with almost no notice) now for the week, as we are not comfortable leaving her in the unit with people we don't know going in and out while we are travelling.  

We emailed the manager who had no regard for our situation.   All they care about is how fast they can renovate this place and have zero regard for the tenants that are living here.  Renters beware; Baron Properties, Belmont Buckingham.

Do YOU like having unexpected construction projects pop-up outside your bedroom window? Are you a fan of lost packages or perishable food items held hostage behind a locked office door? Does the idea of having a the *same* person work in your front office for more than a few months bore you?

Then Belmont Buckingham is the place to live!

Come to this newly-purchased property for unending frustration over seemingly simple tasks! In most other places, you could expect to pay $110 a month for your own parking spot. Here, you can pay $110 a month for the chance to get unexpectedly kicked out of your parking spot on a regular basis!

The radiators clank, the washers smell, and the brand new package lockers that are "guaranteed be ready by the end of February" might be up and running by April! Maybe!

And if you sign now, you get an extra bonus: they'll kick you out of your apartment in JUNE! They need to renovate all the apartments before they jack up rent. Oh, and they won't tell you that on the tour – it's more fun when it's a surprise.

I used to love my apartment here until the beginning of this when the whole staff who was AMAZING all left due to new ownership. They were replaced by a revolving door of untrained, unresponsive, and overall incompetent staff. Don't be fooled by a slightly less expensive price-point, you'll end up paying for it in the end.

Packages were impossible to get because the staff was always out at other properties. When they were in the office it was always a new "temp" that never knew anything other than how to lose your messages or tell you that they "don't know" and "can't help you". The facilities often had broken or out of order equipment, e.g. treadmills, BQQ, and office printing services. 

In particular, the "manager" Kiley is the worst of the worst. She never knows what she's talking about, provides false information and then lacks the integrity of being accountable for her mistakes. I can forgive a lot, so long as someone is willing to acknowledge and apologize for when they're wrong. I had the satisfaction of neither. Moving out of this slum-lord's property into a new place with competent staff has been an absolute pleasure. 

It's sad that this charming historic property is so poorly managed. It's clear that corporate does not care about the residents, the property, or having a shred of integrity. I wouldn't recommend living here to someone I disliked and I'm sure corporate will respond with... Please reach out to our phone/email (where no one will be competent enough to resolve anything for you).

I contemplated writing a letter to the corporate offices though I'm certain that given my prior experience it'll end up in the garbage, like the quality of this building. Would have given zero stars if it were possible.

The pictures are extremely deceiving and look nothing like these pictures. The neighbors are horrible and loud and the people in the office don’t live here so they don’t care about absolutely nothing. If I could give zero stars I would.
This place is so noisy I cant sleep I need help from mangers but no one will help me

Ignoring the shootings that happen nearly monthly in this neighborhood, the worst part is actually the management and maintenance. They'll either wait months to fix things, or just not fixing them at all. When they do show up to fix something, they won't be there the day or time they said they would and have on multiple occasions just let themselves in to the apartment. Don't waste your time or money.
During all the tough times and stuff they have been awesome with us! I have no complaints! Anita has been very helpful with anything we need! The manager has been awesome also! Thank you

0 stars. Just because these apartments changed their name does not change the fact that these are some of the worst apartments in Denver to live in. Please search "The Artisan Apartments" in Denver. It's these apartments. Everything is sub-par from the management, to maintenance, to your neighbors, to the apartment and the pool. Management has 0 customer service skills and will actually yell at you. The apartments are old, dingy, full of bugs. The water is turned off for hours a couple of times a week, every week. So good luck if you're in the middle of a shower. People will reuse the buckets and dip them in the pool to refill them. At move out, they will charge you for carpet cleaning even though they reuse the same carpets. The maintenance people look like felons and will keep "losing" your keys. You will hear gun shots and people break in your car. You will see your neighbors grabbing old couches and mattresses from the dumpster and bring them back in their apartments. Your neighbors love to play mariachi music all night until 2 or 3 in the morning. It was a very horrible experience to live here.

The office is sold every year because they can't seem to find competent staff. I have never been able to reach anyone at the office via phone. Every time I try to call, I get transferred over to their headquarters or something, then they promise me that they will call back, and never do. I have been trying to discontinue my lease since may, and have called several times to no avail. I am at the point of pursuing a lawsuit.

Please don't move here I've been here going on 2 years and this is my opinion but the customer service here is terrible you get a smile up on moving in once your here that disappears if my finances we're better I would have moved long time ago. There's no happy ness here please don't do it....
Staff was incredibly hard to get a hold of and was incompetent in relating information. I called 12 over three days and only got one email. Don’t rent from here. Positive reviews probably paid for.

I have lived here for 2 years. Do not move here!
For one there is nothing but problems - New paint means nothing. They have to shut off your water atleast 1 or 2 times every week for maintenance that never seems to be fixed. My AC hasn't worked since last year, the apartment is 90 degrees, this is a health problem and they take their time for months to do anything about it. The only working pool or laundry is on the other side of the complex. The laundry and pool for this side is trashed and has never worked, I have to drive to a laundry mat. Soliciting, even by residents happens daily. 
The people have always been nice, but nothing  gets done. Its affordable I.e. Cheap but I can see why. If I didn't run into financial hardship I would have left long ago.

As a Resident This place did start out kind of ok. but as the time went by the place started to go down from there, beware if you send you rent in early they will not process the payment when they receive it, I have sent in 3 payments early and 2 of them they can not tell me where the payments went, so i got charged a late fee, so i had to call the bank and cancel those two payments, the other payment the received early they tried to tell me they processed the payment an after calling the bank, they told me the payment was not processed, so had to stop payment on that, and the apartment charged me $50 for their mistake again, so please don't deal with this place, the staff if rude, i was in the offices and a lady walked in telling them that her water was coming out brown, and one of the girl laughed about it, which was not funny and the resident was not happy about that, the parking really suck, the sidewalk on the east and west side was re-done but all the dirt and old cement  that was pulled up it still in the parking lot, and this has been here for like 3 or 4 months now, the place has bugs they say they have pest control but don't tell you it out of your pocket, it get charged to you account, and its only upon request, the pictures for this place are not the real pictures, please take a tour of this place before you sign any papers, and the kids here they destroy everything and it seems to be OK with the staff, the laundry rooms are always messed up or closed, the laundry on the west side had been shut down, it has been messed up so bad, that it became a health issue, the two pools that are here are never open and the place is trashed, for the quality of this place it is not worth the amount of rent these people put on this place, SO please really check this place out before to sign a lease, but my advice is please stay away

This is, in my opinion, a terrible place to live. Not worth anyone's time or money. The management company has now decided to charge a 8 dollar fee every month to park your vehicle. If you want to break the lease you have to give 4 months worth of rent plus a 60-day notice. Had so many issues with the new management. I urge anyone looking into The Artisan Apartments to look else where they have a better chance of finding a better price, location, and better staff. The laundry rooms are HORRIBLE they have never done anything to fix it. Have a lovely day.
Am so happy with all the employees they are very helpful and answer every question. Really nice apartments and clean. Highly recommend these apartments.

If I could give this place no stars, I would. I am going to give a review completely on my own problems and not what other problems other residents here have had. First, their pictures on their website are not at all like this place is. It only has four machines in the gym. Their pool has not been available to use the entire summer. I've seen papers taped to doors saying that they need to be out on X date because of bed bugs. Also, the worst part is they drive around in a little golf cart and will get a towing service to tow your car. I parked in an area where it simply said Private Parking Residents Only thinking that, hey I live here, I'm a resident. But no, they still towed it and had to pay over $300 to get my car back. The manager at this place said yes we have a towing service and you shouldn't have parked there. I explained to her that it didn't say No Parking. So before I could get the news station here she had someone paint the side red and put new signs up saying No Parking. Of course, after I had paid to get my car back and she sneered that they would not help me at all. The residents here go dumpster diving of thrown out couches and mattresses from residents that had bed bugs which is what is causing recurring infestations. If I get bed bugs in my place I will not stand for that. -Ann Mc Guire-

This place is awfuuuul. Just do not even bother moving here. I've had absolutely nothing except for problems here. My ceiling leaked for 3 months before the management thought it was worth fixing. We don't have any of the bug infestations that I have heard from other neighbors but our apartment had dirty carpets upon move in along with a million other problems. There's red stuff all over our tiles in the kitchen, which we don't know what it is but the staff refuses to replace. When we moved in, none of our doors could even open. The pictures are absolutely not what you'll get upon move in and the smiling faces in the front will no longer be there anymore. I've proudly sent away at least 3 people from this apartment complex. I read all of the reviews and didn't think it seemed that bad and gave it a shot. It was an awful idea. They've also up'ed the rent by over 200$ from when we originally looked at the complex. It is definitely not worth that extra money. I really mean it when I say this, this place is AWFUL. And I am not being bias based on what has happened to me, it is happening to every single neighbor I have talked to. You can find places with cheaper rent that's much better than here.

So both I and a coworker live in this apartment complex (we don't live together.) She has had several issues with getting things fixed and such. I have too, but I haven't had as much break down. She is moving out because of the issues.

I had my toilet break twice. The first time, it took them a week and a half to get in and fix it. So that was fun...

They don't leave any sort of notes after they enter the apartment, but they've left the lights running for who knows how long. One day, I was away from my house from five in the morning until about eleven at night and three lights were on. I had no idea when they had been in, or how long the lights were on.

As of now, I have submitted three work requests to get my garbage disposal looked at. 

On the plus side, it's affordable for me (I live alone and Denver is expensive.) and it's close to my family, my work and friends. And I have lots of space now - the rooms are somewhat large. I'll probably stick it out another year as I'm trying to save up for a house, and don't see the point in the moving expenses. But yeah, had I known the issues I'd have here, I would have stayed in my tiny studio I had before. =/ Not worth the headaches, really.

Lived there for over a year. Only reason we left is because we were waiting for senior housing again due to the Littleton seniors fire. Our son lived there and was happy Before us and his boss/friend was so impressed visiting there he decided to move there and remains.
They won’t fix amenities and will continue to raise your rent. They don’t care about their tenants, just the money you give them. Overpriced for awful living.

This property is ideally located & beautifully landscaped, with great residents & the best management I've encountered! Pet friendly & roomy apartments, with helpful maintenance & well kept amenities. An awesome place to call home

Update: Still living here and loving it!! I have my 2bdrm and if snafu's arise the office and maintainence are on top of it!! My fridge died and I had a new one within hours. Anthony, Susan and Keith in the office are always amazing and helpful!! Maintainence is the best.

I have lived here since October, 2019 and love it. I love in Building A and have never had problems with bugs, maintenance, parking or the staff. Everyone is kind and helpful. I like it so much that I'm upgrading to a 2bdrm next week! Definitely recommend living here!

Beautiful Property. And that is why the transients have decided to take it over as their own. Unfortunately, management has no interest in securing the property against transients living around the property. Security is a joke and does not respond to calls of transients sleeping in the elevators, laundry rooms, courtyards and parking lots. Too bad. They have the power but choose not to do anything.

Don't waste your money living here.  I recently moved to this location from out of state, site unseen.  BIGGEST MISTAKE EVER!!!!.  This place looks nothing like the website so don't let that fool you. Let me give you a list of the problems, so far.

Positive notes.... none...

The whole building is so dirty, the apartments are filled with mice and roaches. The crime happening at this place is continuous, my license plate was stolen in the garage (that might be due to the garage never working and thus always being open), saw my neighbor beating his gf in the parking lot, saw a neighbor shooting a gun in the parking lot. Don’t live there, just don’t…..

Half of my apartment was wrecked when a pipe broke and flooded my living room and kitchen. When I explained to management that I had no where to stay because I had just paid the rent and couldn’t afford a hotel I received a shrug and a “well the bathroom and bedroom aren’t wet.” When I complained I was “gifted” $200 off my next month’s rent, which was a complete slap to the face. They can repaint the building but it’s a dump that’s falling apart. Don’t be fooled.

Upon first arrival the property was making improvements and seemed to be turning a corner. However while I stayed till Jan 2023 and while there I saw roaches, mold, faulty electricity/elevators, electronic locks being broken and Un-repaired for long periods. Loud tenants that refuse to calm at late hours. Water being cut off for days/hours constantly even during the the holidays.

Roaches everywhere, they make you pay $35 a month for maintenance and no maintenance is ever done. trash is left out in the hallways which only allows the bugs to get worse. We have lived here for 7 months and my boyfriend had a gun pulled out on him for asking someone in the hallway to quiet down at 2:30 in the morning as we have a 2 month old in the unit. Our first 2 months living here we had no working toilet in the unit after numerous emails and calls to the office we finally got a working toilet after not having one for 2 months WHILE i was pregnant. Very poor management, please don’t get yourself stuck at this place like we did.

The office staff is terrible. That says another since it's changed 3 times in the year and a half I lived here. Roaches everywhere as they have pest control out every Monday and you still see them. Is not a secured building. Doors are always broken and so easy to walk in. Homeless people sleeping in the mail room laundry room stairwell. My car got broken into 3 times. Third time they tried to steal. Within the first month had a major leak in the kitchen which took them almost 5 months to fix causing water damage to the wood floor and cabinetand lead to mildew/mold. Then my washer breaks causing the apt to flood which ruined the carpet. To months to get new 1. Window unit doesn't cool. Smells like trash all the time due to Trash pick up service that's not picked up between the hours stated. Lack a communication with the office staff. You will not talk to a person unless going into the office. DO NOT MOVE HERE

Water goes out multiple times in the month ,they attempted to break into our unit and after informing office they never even came to fix or replace our loose door lock and seen multiple ppl try to break in on ring cam at different times

The Avantus was bought out by the previous owner a year ago. Since then they have spent a ton of money to make to exterior look like. Don’t let this fool you. There will be constant water issues, they will constantly be turning your water off. You’ll have many days without hot water. My bathroom had mold on the ceiling that they refused to fix. I had no hot water in my kitchen for over a year that they refused to fix. I withheld my rent to try to get them to fix this. When they did not fix these issues I moved out, I was very forthcoming with their staff that I was going to move out. If these things weren’t fixed after I moved out they charged me $2500 in an early move out fee despite me only moving out 15 days before my lease was up. The management staff seems very in capable of managing a building of that size. They constantly have a rotating maintenance staff because maintenance never gets finished. The office staff does not care at all about any issues that you have and does not try to help you with any issue arise. I’ve had my car stolen from the gated Underground parking, because none of the gates actually lock or are secure. They also have a key fob system that is the cheapest system in the world. The locks aren’t very sturdy, leading to many people just yanking the doors open and if you’re near one of those doors, you will be woken up every single time.  This place is cheap for a reason don’t fall for it.

Moved here 3 months ago, started having issues basically right away. Gates keys to enter parking do not work at all. Was shown an apartment with “the same floor plan” because my apartment wasn’t ready to be shown, only to be given the key to a smaller apartment with less storage. Broken handle on door, electrical issues, plumbing issues. Management had work done on the parking garage (which you pay for separately) while I was out of town, when I returned home I was told my truck was moved without notice and they could not locate it. The office then said that the towing company may have towed my vehicle, that I’d have to check with that company, and if they did I would have to pay the fees to get it out. All without any notice. The trash chute in my building has been closed for 2 weeks and because the elevator is closed half the time I have to walk down 4 flights of stairs to take the trash out. Was told pool was open year round but it’s been closed for half the time I’ve been here. 0/10 management and 0/10 building. Stay far far away.

No hay seguridad en esta residencia, me partieron el vidrio de mi auto hace días y hoy fui a verlo y se lo robaron del estacionamiento de abajo. La oficina no tiene respuesta sobre los casos ocurridos.

Ya voy a cumplir 2 años aquí viviendo y Con la nueva administración ya se a visto cambio sobre todo el edificio lo felicito. Con el personal de la administración son muy amable me ha tratado muy bien  la Sra Adriana me a solucionado todo en el momento. Muchas gracias

If the price is too good to be true, it is. This place sucks so hard. Where to even begin? In just the 10 months I've lived here, the hot water has gone out at least a dozen times. Which means no hot showers AND no heat in the winter. The wall-mounted A/C units are a joke. They cool off one corner of the apartment and that's it. This place uses garbage chutes instead of valet trash pickup, and as a result the chutes get clogged so tenants just leave literally piles of garbage spilling out into the hallways. The gate to the "secure" parking garage has been broken for months and there is no surveillance in the garage. As such, many vehicles had been vandalized, broken into, or stolen right out of the garage. It's a car thief's shopping spree. Every 3 months there is a completely new set of office employees. Work orders go ignored for weeks at a time and the office needs to be constantly reminded. Oh, and I almost forgot about the frequent false fire alarms in the middle of the night.

I've lived in 5 different apartments since I moved to Colorado, and Avantus is BY FAR the worst one. One of my previous landlords threatened to have my dog taken away by animal control, and I STILL think the Avantus is worse. Don't live here. Don't even think about living here. Tell your friends not to live here. Tell your ENEMIES not to live here!

Do NOT let the lower price (for the area) of this place sway your decision to move here.  You will absolutely regret it.  My daughter (student with us co signing) lived here for a year and it was TERRIBLE.  Trash issues, paper thin walls and ceilings, broken gate to garage, theft to her car numerous times, and so much more.  At the end of her lease she took her time moving out. Two days before she had turn in her keys, she returned to clean and gather the last of her things only to find that maintenance had entered the unit, changed the locks, and stolen some of her things that hadn't been moved yet.  She was still within the time of her lease, and there was no attempt to contact her to enter the unit!  Management took no responsibility and told her to file a claim with her renters insurance and has avoided all calls and emails regarding the matter.  Read the reviews and absolutely avoid this place!

The only nice building in this property is their office lobby. Gated community that has wide open gates because there stuck open. Tons of vehicles with windows smashed out. Property is terribly trashed and vandalized.  Garbage rooms backed up spilling into hallways. No hot water almost on a weekly basis. The only prayer for this place is a bulldozer

I have lived at Avantus for 1 year under a 15 month lease contract. They are now charging 20% more in rent than when I signed. For the place to be a dump, they are robbing tenants of rent payments. It is not worth that much by any means. The rent you see does not include the extra $50 in fees they charge. It also does not include any utilities. They say internet is included, but it does not really work. You still have to purchase your own. You get one spot in the underground parking garage; however, there are often homeless people in there at night breaking into cars. I have already had my vehicle broken into. There is no security, doors to buildings are usually propped open, and the gate is always stuck open. So much for a gated community. When I first moved in, there was no oven rack and the light in the bedroom was out. It is a special fixture that you can't change yourself. It took weeks of me putting in multiple maintenance requests only to be told that I was not on their priority list. I finally got the light changed after about a month and they put the dimmest light possible in there. You can barely tell it's on. I live on the top floor where it is blazing hot year round. The hallway never drops below 85 degrees even when it is in the negatives outside. There is no A/C in the apartment, only a single wall unit in the living room that doesn't really do anything. In the summer, I'll have the wall unit running on turbo non-stop, blinds shut all day long, and multiple fans running, and the temperature still won't drop below 80-85 inside of my apartment while it is over 90 in the hallway. I have had packages waiting on me in the office for weeks now. They do not have package lockers like almost every single apartment complex in Denver has. You can only pick up packages when the office is open, which is just business hours and they usually leave early. I am a teacher and high school coach and have two part time jobs, so I am never around to be able to actually access office staff or my packages. It's unacceptable really. the walls are quite thin. My apartment just reeks of the smell of marijuana at all times and I don't smoke. That's with my windows closed. I have trouble sleeping at night because I can hear my neighbor snoring or there's people in the center lot blaring music. The fire alarm has gone of in the middle of the night 7 or more times since I've lived here. hot water has also gone out a handful of times.

I recently had an issue where my dryer went out and the staff worked exceptionally with me. They understood the need for an in-unit laundry and were able to allow me access to a vacant apartment in order to accommodate my need. They kept me informed of the date my replacement would be here and even brought it two days early. The maintenance person, Clyde, was very professional, easy going, and quick in replacing the unit. I couldn't be happier with the response I received and the great service this property has.

The area is perfect, maintenance issues get fixed right away and the staff are phenomenal but if you have a noisy neighbors it is not so good.  Only live on the top floor if you really want to live here.  And that is if your downstairs neighbor is quiet.  When I asked if these apartments were noisy,  I was told no BUT they are, I hear everything my neighbors do, it is not conducive to me working from home.  I would not live here, given what I know now..

I don't regret living here but I wouldn't recommend it.

Aside from the nice design, this isn't the luxury experience they advertise. Other true "luxury apartments" are available in Denver at similar rates. 

Feedback based on 2 apartments; mine and a neighbor/friend who also lived in the complex:
Rooms are aesthetically pleasing! However, walls and ceilings are thin and you can hear everything... feels like SF or NYC.
Pool opened over a year after advertised (I assume the permit they said they got when they sold me on the place did not come through). 
They do not honor the referral bonus. 
No rental discount during pandemic despite losing access to pools, hot tub, gyms, business center, patio/grills. 
Required to pay for parcel service even though it's not used properly by delivery drivers. 
Parking lots are full after 9pm. 
Move out documents/process are not streamlined so there's lots of confusion. 
Seems like they're money focused and don't value the hospitality that "luxury" requires.

Maintenance staff are all VERY friendly. That was great. Some office staff are snippy, some are nice.

Avoid anything owned by IMT. Lived here almost ten years through three changes in ownership and IMT and their property manager are absolutely terrible. Very unhelpful and unfriendly. Maintenance requests never done and packages impossible to receive. They go out of their way to avoid their tenants unless rent is due. Overpriced to begin with, but terrible service as well???!!!

I've lived here for two years. I have had my disputes with packages as well. Good thing they are installing parcel lockers because for awhile they had employees who thought rejecting resident mail meant packages just get dropped off at the post office for pickup.  
Also they need to get with the program, protect their residents and monitor parking lots with an electronic system that runs the license plate instead of relying on a scummy third-party. I am happy to be leaving this complex. Only positive is the maintenance crew who are courteous and prompt and the pub next door.

August 2019: We tried to talk to IMT staff and IMT corporate about not receiving notifications that we have packages and their response to us is that the emails are just courtesy, they're presuming residents know when they have packages because of tracking info, even though tracking info isn't always available.  Secondly, there's always issues with couriers and rideshare drivers blocking the entryway (when there's no guest parking available) and their response to this was that they have guest parking available for couriers and rideshare, which completely ignores that there are issues when there are no parking spots available. They also explained to me that they wouldn't give the codes to couriers or rideshare drivers because they don't want them using resident parking spaces - which is insane, because I never wanted this to be the solution and did not ask them to share the code. I asked if there was anything to do so they wouldn't block the area that residents need to use code or key card to open the gate. So, yes, IMT is great with maintenance requests, but any other issue we've been told there's nothing they can do. I can understand not being able to do certain things like enforcing doors and gates not be propped open, but there are other issues that I wish they'd even just pretend to try and I even suggested a sign being put up by the roundabout to notify couriers not to block entryway, but even that effort can't be made. So yes, cute apartment, poor customer service. I just feel annoying and crazy for letting them know about an issue/inconvenience that frequently takes place. It would be nice if they at least expressed understanding in the frustration or the issue.
Rats living under sidewalks and parking lot in the roots of bushes and trees on the property throughout the property.
Me parecen un buen lugar para vivir, son muy antentos lo recomiendo al 100%
Les recomiendo alquilar en las villas son apartamentos cómodos para vivir
La verdad hay mucha basura en los contenedores que tiene semanas y no los limpian eso se ve mal y muchos roedores en el patio

No es un lugar recomendado, es bastante caro para los servicios que proporcionan y las condiciones en las que se encuentra, principalmente mantenimiento viví 6 meses puse una orden porque el sink de el baño no servía  salía agua negra con un holor horrible y hasta el último día que viví nunca obtuve servicio
Terrible maintenence program, decent office interaction when you can get a hold of them. All in all not a very pleasant experience for the 3 years I've been here.

I’ve lived here for three years. In those 3 years, we’ve had 4 different property management companies, a non working oven for 4 months, every summer you can also count on your AC going out. Oh, and how can I forget the time they hadn’t paid the city for our water? Super cool. Or when our apartment flooded? I had to force them to come out with threats of calling the city. We had inches of water on our second level dripping onto electrical in the garage. They said it wasn’t an emergency. Classic scenarios you can expect with this property. When approached with this, management gives you every excuse to just get you off the phone without offering any solution or indication that they working on it. After years of “we’ll get back to you” “our maintenance is backed up” those phrases begin to lose their weight. What are we even paying for? So glad to not be renewing our lease. Avoid at all costs.

We have been living here for a year and just resigned. This is definitely the best quality apartment I have had so far in Denver. Joe the maintenance guy is super nice and always gets to our requests within a day or two max. The location is hard to beat-near buses and trains but tucked in enough to be safe. There are plenty of parks and trails near by and just about every type of food you could want just a few minutes away. All in all its a great place to live!

I love the freedom that renting affords me.  I am not young and have been renting for a long time.  This is hands down my most favorite home.  Located on the Highline Canal, close to major highways (but not too close), and the office staff is always helpful and welcoming. Maintenance was an issue in the past but not anymore.  Jose goes above and beyond the call of duty.  All I have to do is pay rent and they take care of everything else!  I'm free to enjoy my life without the responsibility that comes with owning a home.

Horrible!!! Management is the absolute worse! Maintenance were in my apartment twice to fix some issues I had reported, both times my door was left unlocked (No one was home at the time) one time my door was left opened. I emailed the office and requested that the manager contact me, she never did. I asked multiple times for the manager but she refuses to call me. My car got towed, it was taken to Arvada, are you kidding me? This place charges per mile, clearly Arapahoe Club does not have their tenants interest in mind or else why would they use that towing company? $325 I paid to get my car out. I requested a call from the manager and of course I still have not heard back from her. I emailed ARC and they refuse to call me back. I emailed the woman in the main office and she told me to park across the street if I didn't want to get towed! Yet people park in the handicapped spaces and they never get towed. We are required to pay a CAM fee, that obviously doesn't go anywhere since there is always dog poop all over, I have emails of me telling the office to come clean up the dog poop that is left everywhere. When it snows the sidewalks in the property are left super icy, easily for someone to slip and fall. They clearly do not care about their tenants, it's so sad.  Many people complain and nothing gets done! If you are looking for an apartment in this neighborhood go down the street you can get gated apartments for the same price, check out the reviews and compare.

I lived at Arapahoe club in 2005 for a year, and I came back 2016 and I have been living here for almost a year, it is a clean safe and elegant complex. I don’t know about previous management but MS. Lena and stuff were always respectful and welcoming. 
I remember when I moved in I requested some fixes and Ms. Lena and a maintenance guy his name is Eric were very responsive and accommodating.
And Yes, it is a little expensive, but the location and the space justifies it. I think it is rising rent price that got so many upsets. But this a market and a corporate issue.
To be fair, the management of Arapahoe club staff is trying very hard and I don’t think they are the one who setting up the rent prices or asking four people with four cars to live in two bed room. The thing that created the parking issue!
My advice to resolve the parking issue, I think management should ask corporate for funds to tag tenants overnight parked cars. So, they know who is who!
I recommend living there

My toilet flush got broken. Since one week no parts available.
You have to run the water tap for minimum 30 sec. to get hot water.
Windows are not tight. Cold wind comes out the wall outlets.
You can hear the tenant walking above your apartment.
You can hear loud the running water when the tenant above opens the water tap. Same when he flashes the toilet.
I will be happy when my renting period is done.

Don't get fool by the nice pictures. Pool is gross and greenish, jacuzzi out of service and gym dirty and smelly along their restrooms. Air conditioning on the apartment is so old and loud that won't let you sleep at night. Not to say about rude management and inefficient maintenance staff. Don't get a contract here, it's not worth your money.
I am so happy with the new management. They have made great improvements and are very responsive. Had an issue and Joe took care about it right away and even gave my dog a treat!

I live here, staff is unavailable and office is always closed. Everyone has cockroaches, nothing gets fixed. A ton of hidden fees so definitely plan on rent being $100-200 more than it says. Gunshots on occasion, nothing gets fixed around here, homeless people sleep in front of your front door (personally this has happened many times in only 6 months and they told me just to throw her stuff down the stairs). Never get your mail because the mailboxes cannot be used because they are so broken. Randomly they change my keys without telling me. (2 times in 6 months is a lot) and the office is closed so I have no access to mail. To be fair temporary living and location? Great. But save yourself some stress by looking elsewhere this place is a wreck that is made to look nice.

I've been here three years nothing but issues the best one is the post office closed/ won't use the mail boxes now because they keep getting broke in to and they could even tell us Residences but they can close to pool and email everyone so glad I'm moving

management and leasing people are rude.
you can not sleep at night, lot of noise and disturbing.
rooms smells bad even they are painted 
After i moved out and I left everything clean no damages at all
they took my $250 deposit and they charge me $459 
this place is not a place to live at
the rent is cheap but they charge you alot of money after you move out
The maintenance people never fix anything.  The staff is rude.  The place is falling apart.  Not worth it!!! Run away!!!!

I am very regret just after I move in. The room haven't been cleaned and manager just prepare to paint the room on the moving day when I get the key.  The room was full of paint smell despite they almost did not paint, but the manager said the smell would go when they open all windows and turn air condition. I don't believe that the paint smell would go within one day and it is very harm to health. Then the manager gave me $200 credit , I have to stay overnight at hotel. But this room is still have strong previous tenant cigarette that release from wall into the environment. I have to keep the windows open no matter how cold is outside. Now it is going into winter, I told the manager to repaint the room, she only procrastinated week by week. The $200 was only for inconvenience to me on moving day but not means they can give up their responsibility. Actually, I paid $175 maintenance  administration fee for my move in. They just care if the tenant pay money on time, nothing else. My friends who live this apartment complain too. Now, I don't trust them any more. Here is really not a right place to live.

We are in our first month here at our new home. Every time we have seen the leasing office staff they have immediately greeted us with a smile and know our names. The courteousness and professionalism of this staff is top notch. The maintenance department is Johnny on the spot. They are professional and thankful for us. We have never felt like we are a burden to them at anytime. Every person I have met that works here has treated us with dignity and respect. We do not feel as though we are just customers or tenants. We feel like we are an important part of a community. 

The area is close to everything. Stores, restaraunts and entertainment are within just a couple minutes in any direction. I would highly suggest going online for your lease. We did that and was just able to pick up our keys and move in without any pressure. This place made everything hassle free for us. We pay our rent on time online. 

We are extremely happy with our decision moving in here. The only thing I can say needs a little work and attention is the common access area of the apartment buildings (hallways). The carpets are old looking and wore out in spots. That was the only attention to detail that is overlooked. If I have learned anything while living here I am sure it won't be long for that to be taken care of. 

All in all I would say give this place a try. So far I really cannot give a bad remark and have to give them a top rating. Keep up the great job Advenir, we appreciate you.

Brittany was so nice and helpful during post/pre move in. Nice amenities and neighbors. Love the dog park for my pup and the walking trails. My apartment was immaculate upon moving in. I would definitely recommend staying here.

The worst community management company I have ever rented from. They train and/or higher the rudest people who have no communication skills. The property I lived at (Andante at Nine Mile) was one of the worst places to live. I have worked in the apartment industry for a number of years, and have lived in a house of apartment industry professionals (20+ years) and we have never witnessed or experienced anything like this.

The property manager is rude and insulting and displays the worst customer service that I have ever witnessed and experienced. When discussing these issues on the phone he became sarcastic and demeaning. My lease was fulfilled, proper notice was given, the apartment was cleaned (with the exception of minor items). The move out charges list that they sent out to us were extremely high and blown out of proportion. We received our final move-out statement and we called to discuss the charges to see about making a payment for reasonable charges. The manager flat out refused to take any payment, instead, he will be writing it off to bad debt and will not be collecting any revue for the property/owner. 

I am a Veteran and can and will admit to any mistakes or damages I have made and am willing to pay for those mistakes so long as they are fair and reasonable. I find it disturbing to know that a company such as Thompson Mitchie Communities takes advantage of people and places them in a situation of financial hardship with no remorse.

This is definitely one of those places where once your an resident, any requests you have going forward they do not care. For example my car got towed for not having the parking pass super present on my car, so after getting my car and asking for bother pass, they were going to nickel and dime me another 50 dollars after I paid 300 to get my car out for a pass! The parking is so bad there too! There are better places out there!! Oh did you hear about the rodent problem?? Go ask about that.

My unit is beautiful, but the builder apparently cut corners. For instance, the pipes are not properly insulated resulting in a notice to set faucets to drip to prevent frozen pipes. Now, I'm originally from an area of the country that spends a good couple months at below freezing, and even below zero, temperatures and never needed to drip faucets. A little insulation goes a long way. Also, although I never hear my lower neighbors or those to my sides, I hear just about every step made in the unit above me. I really don't think they're intentionally doing it, and they appear to be healthy people, I really think it's lack of padding under the carpet mixed with too thin floors. 

The location is amazing. 1 mile from the light rail station, which can be accessed by taking sidewalks along the main roads or from the bike trail that runs behind the property. The trail also leads you over to the reservoir with a beautiful beach-only three miles and easily walkable.

Parking is plentiful, but the spaces are tight. I've never seen such close parking spaces before. I've never experienced a problem with the gates myself, so I think it's safe to say they fixed those after the other reviews posted.

Overall I do like it, but I'll be looking at the possibility of upgrading to a third floor unit asap.

I love our apartment complex! It's mostly young professionals and I love the pool. There is a shallow portion that you can sit or lay in and I love it. I've only lived here for 4 months, but our apartment is perfect for our needs and love the layout. Here are somethings that get to me here though. The gates are always broken and I think it has something to do with the apartment complex across the street. Our apartment faces the apartment complex and we have had some issues with that and had the cops show up to ask us questions  about if we had heard or seen anything across the street. I have seen the kids from the complex across the street out late when I took my puppy out late one night (too late for these kids to be out) and they started shaking at the gates. They didn't know I was there so I called my dog to startle them and they took off. I really love it here and the rest is good for the size and the prices in Denver, but I really would make sure that if I were moving here again I would demand an inner apartment.

I've lived here for 5 months and absolutely love my apartment! I was drawn in by the kitchen - granite counter tops, lots of cabinet space, and a great flow into the living area. My unit also has a fireplace, built in desk and shelf, and a soaking tub. The complex is very pet friendly and quite a few people have dogs. I've enjoyed using the pool, hot tub, and grill area when friends come to visit. The staff has been responsive and easy to work with. There are a few other complexes bordering Andante, so guest parking can be limited at times. Other than that, I don't have any complaints!

Lumina is central to not only LoHi activities but to downtown as well with the walk ability due to its location. However, due to it being tucked at the edge of LoHi and closer to residential buildings, it is much more quiet throughout the day and night resulting in a good night's sleep.

The apartment itself has a solid foundation where you don't hear your neighbors, the apartment staff are absolutely phenomenal and very attentive. For maintenance, Eric is extremely responsive, knowledgeable, and cares about providing a good and working place to live for the residents. Athina, the complex manager is also there for the residents, putting on monthly events, attentive to questions and concerns, etc. 

The apartment complex is also very secure due to the access you need to get through the doors. For the other residents, they're very respectful and not rowdy at all. Add in the well built complexes and thick walls, you never have an issue with noise! 

Just from the pictures, you can tell this apartment has complex. One of the best features is the garage door to the balcony. If you like living in a unique and vibrant apartment then this place is for you. 
Overall, I highly recommend you rent with Lumina apartments! We'll definitely be renewing our lease.
The apartment has great common areas with very unique designs that make the building feel magical.
Lumina is a great place to live in a great location and offers events and activities for those looking for a community.

Down side: Missing packages, break-ins to vehicles/lobbies, and cameras/package lockers often dont work; up side: you dont usually hear your neighbors, most of the neighbors you encounter are friendly, its well decorated, and has a wonderful location.
Love the floor plan and location, most of all love the balcony and view.

Lumina Apartments is an overall great choice with a prime location. The quality of the building and the working staff make this place truly unique. It's only been a few weeks but I am very happy with my choice.

I’ve been living here for a little more than 2 years now and have had nothing short of a great experience. The complex is safe, interior of the units are clean and updated. Service requests are completed within a short time, and management is always accessible/reaches back out to follow up on things. They also do a pet of the month in their monthly newsletter! Great and affordable place to live :)

I rented online, sight unseen (because I was coming from out of state) and have been thrilled with my decision to rent here.  Maintenance is quick to respond to any issues (not that there are many).  My apartment had recently been upgraded and is absolutely gorgeous.   I've had no issues AT ALL!  There are apartments that have not yet been updated, so do clarify which "level" of rental you are getting.

Safety and resident comfort are not a top priority for this housing complex or this management company. Homeless people can regularly be seen wandering the premises or digging through the trash. Multiple security issues have been brought to the attention of staff and the management company with no response, and if they do respond, it is with placations. The facilities are constantly in disrepair, with large trash items, like couches, sitting on the lawns for days at a time from residents who have dumped them. The year-round facilities that were promised upon move-in, namely the clubhouse and the hot tub, have yet to open or remain open throughout the winter. The actual maintenance staff has been great, yet because the property can't afford to fully staff maintenance for the 400+ apartments, issues go unresolved for longer than they should, if they are resolved at all. 

I was promised hardwood in my apartment and did not know I would receive carpet until the day I pulled into the parking lot to move in. Management's response was to either do nothing or offer me another apartment at some indefinite date when one became available, which would require me to move twice with no monetary compensation. If you don't pick up your package within two days of it arriving, which can easily happen if you travel at all, it automatically gets returned to the sender. The office staff refuses to hold packages for you, regardless of the situation.

The apartment itself is nice and has a larger floor plan than most in Denver. They have wood-burning fireplaces, which I love. Limited counter space in the kitchen, but the appliances all function well. There is also very limited storage. Basically, don’t bring anything but the essentials. There isn't much to do in the area unless you want to go to a biker bar, body shop or sex shop, but the location is close enough to DTC, Glendale and Cherry Creek to find food and drinks. If safety and cleanliness are not your top priorities, this complex is centrally located in the Denver metro area and is reasonably affordable. 

You get what you pay for in Denver, that is for sure.

We've lived at Alara Greenwood Village for nearly 2 years now and we are certainly happy to call this place home.
First, to address the immediate concerns of future tenants--In the 2 years we've been here, there indeed has been some turnover of management...yes, in the past, there were delays with a few maintenance tickets...yes, the fitness center suffered flood due to a burst pipe and required a complete rebuild. The current management team that has come on board has gotten a lot done in the time they've been here. The fitness center has been completed and is better than before. The pool has been completely redone and looks like new. Maintenence tickets are handled quickly, as well as basic facilities needs around the complex. The management staff are all very friendly, approachable and quick to respond.
Now, realize that the management team is only one element of an apartment/townhome complex. The units themselves are well kept and well built, with spacious floorplans and attached garages (which is a very nice ammenity!). The noise transfer in our unit is very minimal, the construction appears to be very solid. The grounds are very well kept with manicured landscaping throughout. There's a gulch that cuts through the middle of the complex, so there's great views of tall mature trees, grasses and cattails, depending on where your unit may be. The community has remained quiet with no loud children or loud late-night music to disturb this peaceful community.
It's a tough job to take over a complex that's been neglected and make positive changes as quickly as they have. I applaud the new management staff for working so hard in catching up the community on its needs while maintaining friendly attitudes.

The grounds are very well kept and the common areas like the dog park and the grill/community area are kept up and pretty. Tenants seem to spend a lot of time in these areas, if not because they're well maintained. The pool is nicely heated, as is the hot tub. The complex makes use of Amazon Hubs placed inside the main office where it's nice and cool. I have meal kits delivered and it was nice knowing that the hub wasn't sitting in the sweltering heat while I'm at work. Also, Melissa puts together fun events and brings in food trucks every month. That cheese steak was delicious.

Overall, I'm very impressed with Skye Crest and I hope they continue treating their tenants great. Be on the lookout for move-in specials. They're often quite gracious and saved us a huge chunk of cash upon move-in.

Called them to get more information and possibly schedule a viewing because I had seen the listing. Amanda happened to answer very rudely. Informed me that they had nothing available and she couldn't help us. Glad I found out before how they treat potential tenants.

My experience living here was deeply unsatisfactory due to relentless noise issues and problematic delivery services. There are 20 of 60ish units in this building available for a reason. Avoid signing a lease here at all costs! Tablerock management is non communicative. Management is non-existent. They go 3-4 months without contact, to the point where you’re not sure if anyone is still managing the building at all. Homeless camps outside for months at a time. Don’t waste your time and money.

Ever since Tablerock bought the building, the condition has deteriorated, and gets worse every day.  The last management company had maintenance onsite every day, and they would fix things fast. This company is invisible, and as a result the building is in bad shape. It’s only cleaned once a week, but if repairs are needed, it takes months to do them. There is no communication from management at all. Unsafe, gross conditions outside with a homeless camp set up now for 2 months. Trash everywhere. I’ll never move in a building managed by Tablerock again.

Everything about this place is a nightmare. Unsafe, unsanitary homeless camps set up out front for months at a time, management does zero to help. Constant stolen packages. Living in this building is such a terrible, stressful experience.

If you like sharing your front entrance, back alley, and stairway with crackheads and vagrants, you’ll love it here. The management of this place is a disgrace. Unless these dumps go down to $200 a month, stay far away.

The only good thing about this building is that it’s very close to Trader Joe’s. But your sanity isn’t worth being neighbors with TJ’s, find somewhere else nearby. This place is the dregs of the neighborhood.
Run as fast as possible from this dump. For real. Location is convenient, building is terrible, management is terrible, homeless camp at the doorstep is a disgrace.

Management here is absolutely heinous and incompetent. They are shady with their money and how much they charge. It’s extremely overpriced for what you get. I really regret signing a lease with these people and wish I never had. They are extremely rude and do not care at all about any of their tenants. My experience living here was horrible from start to finish. I don’t recommend living here if you have any form of self worth. They genuinely should be shut down.

The location is really nice which garners two stars. There's lots to do in Cap Hill.

That being said, property management is terrible. They often don't respond and when they do they will gas light you and tell you the reason why they aren't fixing things is your fault. For example, I want them to come fix some simple things in my apartment. I have cats so I would like them to come when I am working from home. I work from home three days a week. That I don't understand at all.

Unresponsive and rude management. Cannot execute a lease properly. Building is unsecured. Homeless issues. Quality of this apartment has declined drastically since the building sold and went under new management. Do not live here. Management simply does not care.

The management of the building is pretty poor, and the apts are overpriced. The front call box has never worked, the parcel room rarely works, and there’s no attention paid to complaints.  

The building is new, but the apartments feel cheaply made. Thin walls, fuses constantly blow. You can hear your neighbors talking, and their pets. There are much better deals nearby.

On the plus side, the location is convenient and mostly nice.

The management company started off pretty good, but went downhill very fast. I would not recommend living here anymore as I have been completely ignored by the management company on very simple issues and it's just not good enough.

The building is nice, units are good for just one person, pet policy is good, it’s super walkable to bars and grocery stores. However, the elevator breaks all the time (meaning you have to hike 3+ flights to get to your unit), packages get stolen, and there is an unexplained thumping in the ceiling 24/7 (not noisy neighbors). The property manager is really nice and helpful, so I’m hoping the issues will be resolved for future residents and these problems are only happening because of how new the building is.

The extra fees that are tacked on to your apartment equate to an extra 250-300 dollars on top of the base rent. Definitely not even close to worth it to have to deal with the terrible, non responsive management. Do yourself a favor and give your money to someone who actually cares about the property they manage.

Management deals with maintenance issues, and generally keeps common spaces clean. These are old buildings so you will have mice sightings occasionally if you leave food out. The baseboard heating systems are ancient, but do work well. AC units are pretty weak, the window units can't cool the whole apartment if temps get above 90F. My unit doesn't have a dishwasher, but I think some of the newer units do. As long as they don't increase the rent, Mountain Vista is a fair deal.

-I lived here 2 years.

management doesn't respond. mice get into the apartment and you have to buy traps yourself, even though you pay for pest control. the bedroom is completely unusable due to no central A/C. Look elsewhere, this is not worth the money.

- paint over everything instead of cleaning it; There are clumps of dust stuck on the walls because they painted over it instead of wiping it off (see picture)

- this place will nickel-and-dime you

- They advertise free weights but there are none.

Don't live here.

Do not do not DO NOT move here. Management switched twice when I lived there and the housing office has been a complete mess. Everything is so unorganized and it's gotten to the level of being unprofessional. I dealt with them on an issue after I moved out for MONTHS that should've taken them no more than a day for them to figure out. Lynette is the saving grace of the apartment complex, but it seems like everyone else has no idea what's going on. Certainly not worth the base rent cost, and on top of that, there are bogus miscellaneous charges. They nickel and dime you for sure, with no value coming from it. The laundry card machine was broken for months, their methods of payment processing is ludicrous, and their "new" online system is archaic. Unresponsive to emails and calls the entire time I was there. Maintenance staff takes a while to get things done, and in one instance I work ordered something twice and it was not fixed either time so I just gave up on them. Live somewhere else. Please.

Would not recommend this place. Loved having my own apartment. First place I moved into on my own. But was not worth the money I was paying. Figured out I could pay the same amount somewhere else and would have more amenities. Fees on my utility bill that didn’t make sense. Did not help out with my heater nor my a/c. I had 100 degree apartment in the summer and 30 degree winter. They kept putting fixing it off. The new office people are rude. Rather have the old office. Once new management came we left.

First, utilities are not included. Let's be clear. Second the parking is unacceptable. My 18 year old son is usually forced to park his car at the train station and walk past a group of homeless people because they have about a third of the needed parking spots. THAT IS UNACCEPTABLE! UNACCEPTABLE! In addition, the apartments are filled with pot smokers and they don't enforce their no smoking policy. If you are looking for a safe place for your college student...this isn't it!

If I could share a photo as evidence I would. The 3rd, 4th and 5th floor are going on months now with reserved spaces for another building that remain unoccupied.
