I hate to write a bad review because I appreciate the staff here, but corporate needs to respect their tenants and the price we pay to park ($100 plus an additional security fee) I am begging that you at the very least you open up half these unused spaces on each floor. I would assume there are in total roughly 100 spaces reserved and by the looks of it, maybe 40 being used in total. Happy to remove when this situation is rectified.

I lived here for over 3 years, and the people in the front office progressively get worse. Just very bitter humans. The property is not well maintained. Either the garage is broken, or the elevator is broken. For months on end. There are also soft spots in the hallway marked with red tape that no one has ever fixed. It’s a shame, because the location is great.
My apartment is very nice and the location is prime.. General housekeeping with amenities, halls and stairs would make it a lot nicer
Currently living here, all amenities are absolute trash. Nothing good about it accept the size for the price and the location.

Trust me, this place is not a good living situation, especially if you are a single girl. There are homeless people in the hallways every single night and they are aggressive. They will promote 24/7 security, but there will not be someone on-site. I eventually just started calling the police.

Where to begin.  Incompetent and rude front desk staff who refuse to look up from their Facebook on the computer when you try to request help with a problem.

Halls are full of trash despite paying over $50/month for valet and trash service.  The elevators, doors, and amenities are always broken.  The maintenance staff is functionally non-existent, although I did see a gentleman once that I had initially mistaken for a homeless trespasser until I saw his branded t shirt.  

The parking garage door has been broken for 5 months causing very unsafe traffic conditions on a side street already closed to one lane due to construction across the street.  

This place is prob the worst apartment in Denver.  Seriously, look at all the one star reviews in other sources.  Do yourself a favor and don’t be swayed by the cheaper rent compared to other options.  You’ll get what you pay for.

Car was broken into twice in one week. When we attempted to go to the front office about this we were shooed away and told to send an email. It's unfortunate as well since we just signed another lease here as it's obvious that the people managing this property do not care about you, your safety, or your belongings.

Short and sweet don’t live here. It’s a mess, poop in the hallways for multiple days, passive aggressive management who won’t take accountability, security who don’t answer phones, homeless people everywhere, and to top it off my car has been broken into twice on the fourth floor of this complex. Management is awful and always looking to charge you extra, will be leaving as soon as possible.

Horrible management ! They are absolutely horrible at communicating, difficult to work with and literally DO NOT care about the residents. 
They let a towing company tow two of my cars despite the fact they were both permitted.

I would advise to NOT live in this apartment complex... there are TONS of other/newer apartments in the area that I would look into!! My husband and I lived here for 2 years and there were several things that occurred...

We paid rent and utilities on time every month for 2 years, there was no documented damage to the apartment upon move out, and my husband and I never caused any troubles with the complex for the above concern and upon move out the complex charged us $856 (YES $856) for giving a 45 day notice of intent to not renew our lease instead of 60 days. Upon voicing our concerns for this outrageous charge we were informed our verbal notice at 60 days was not acceptable! Keep in mind we obtained an e-mail 7 days following our written intent to not renew our lease indicating the apartment was already leased!  
3. Homeless individuals bathe in the pool. 
4. There is NO response from security if you need them. We attempted to contact them following two men attempting to break in (yes the 3rd time)and there was no response. 
5. My car was scratched/dented multiple times in the parking deck.

Save yourself the hassle and money and look into the TONS of other newer apartments on the block or in the area!! There is NO need to live here and be taken advantage of at this apartment complex!

I live here currently and 2 weeks ago my car was broken into and then 4 weeks ago my boyfriend's car was broken into. There have been multiple instances of cars in the garage being broken into, bikes locked up in the garage being stolen, and most recently sexual assaults in the apartment's gym!

Our actual apartment is comfy, modern, and clean, but the walls are ridiculously thin. We can hear everything our upstairs neighbor does at all times.

Do not live in this apartment complex. They are lazy and don't care about the safety of their residents. It's been a nightmare living here.

The construction quality is atrocious - calling this building "luxury" is beyond misleading. The alliances, flooring, and cabinets are on par with what you'd find in a low-income housing building. When touring the building I was very impressed, very sleek and modern look but everything from cabinets to the dishwasher is cheap and not off good quality. Things are constantly breaking, like garage doors, entrance doors, etc. and are not fixed in a timely fashion. There is a lot of construction going on in the area that can be very loud and noisy. However, the amenities and staff are great. The building is almost full now and the residents I have met are super friendly.

On my second year living here.  The parking lot is full of potholes that haven't been filled in since I've lived there.  When it rains or snows it is like driving through a mine field. 
 The rat problem outside by the dumpsters has improved but the building still has rats.  Can hear them behind the walls and in the ceiling attacking each other. The tennis court is trash.  The gym equipment is questionable and most of the electric gym equipment is broken.  The elevator is out quite often.  The washers and dryers take a while for them to be fixed as well.  I live here cause it's cheap and can save money.  Staff don't really bother looking for packages when searching the office mailroom, they a found a package from 2 months prior after telling me they couldn't find it when I went to pick up a new package.  Also, the hallways smell foul sometimes and leaky pipes in the hallways.  Hope this helps before deciding to stay here.

It's only been a week. Management and staff are absolutely great. The 3 stars are because of that. 
But I'll keep it 100% while my living space is excellent.  I live on the 5th floor. We've had a water main break and elevator has been out 3 days. I've reported the elevator both to Management and maintenance.  The first day it wad fixed immediately. However after multiple 12 hr shifts at work I had to walk up the stairs. A bit troubling because I just moved in. I had to cancel furniture delivery because of this. I don't see all the stuff that other reviews have. 
The greatest advice I can give to anyone reading this, always focus on the purpose of any move. I believe that this is a great starting point or first step. I'm starting all over again, so my purpose is to have a roof over my head. Stability is essential. This complex does that for me. I stay to myself and don't have any interest in what others are doing.

read reviews before moving in!!!! this place is roach infested! area is dirty and unsafe, caught a homeless person sitting in the stairwell, people leave their trash laying in the building. the door handle to get in the building breaks every month so people prop the door open. don’t trust your car in the parking spots, someone broke into my car, hallways have a strong odor. definitely will not be staying here any longer! wouldn’t recommend

We scheduled a tour with the leasing office earlier in the week to have them call us at 4:30 the day before to cancel the tour saying they will be closed because they are shortstaffed. We are in from out of town and if we had been notified at time of making appointment we would have made arrangements to see the apartment. The agent did not seem to think this was rude or a problem so just beware when trying to tour here! Wish I could say anything about the property- we were looking forward to it.

I'll keep this brief: the models for their apartments are beautiful, but yours won't be, nor will it be cleaned properly before you move in.

Gunshots in the area happen occasionally, so if you value safety, you won't find it here. We also have not had access to the pool or tennis court in who knows how long, yet we pay for that. 

Long story short: if you enjoy bug-infested, poorly maintained properties close to light-rail stations, this is the perfect place for you.

My mother moved here recently and loves it.  The staff is very helpful to her, and the neighbors are friendly.  Her apartment is newly renovated with lovely hardwood floors and brand new appliances.  Extremely good value.

Thanks to the staff for making every resident feel important!

Where do I begin.... while construction was happening I had 2 screws in my tire. The hot tub has sooooo much chlorine it ruined mine and my friends suits. Also, I am also on the 1st floor and everytime someone comes down the stairs it sounds like a matching band going through my apartment. The walls are super thin. Bitter...yea, kind of. I was super excited to move here and I feel let down.

Juna, Tristin, and Cameron were all so helpful during my apartment search and move-in. No hesitation to go above and beyond making sure I had everything I needed and more. The service from them made my move-in just so much easier. The building is mostly clean and tidy and has a homey vibe. The amenities are just the cherry on top. The parking garage is a huge plus. I enjoy the area as there are so many shops nearby and within walking distance of a great gym. I'm very happy with my decision to move here! Overall a great apartment living experience so far.

As a former employee and resident, I’m disappointed by the lack of professionalism, accountability, and integrity at Griffis Residential, especially at Griffis Cherry Creek. Staff often prioritize their own interests over resident needs, and troubling behavior frequently goes unchecked. HR and corporate seem to turn a blind eye to workplace issues, offering little support for serious concerns. As a person of integrity, I have decided to take my skills and professionalism elsewhere. Do yourself the due diligence to do some research before considering this property and company.

It’s unfortunate because the location of this apartment is great. But, we haven’t had clean water in our apartment for over a year. We have black specs in our shower/bath tub consistently. Management has been very slow to help give us any sort of solution. We have had to spend our own money on filters.

This place has really gone downhill. It used to be fine and now it just sucks. Griffis won’t invest in proper fixes so elevators, fire alarms, etc., have constant issues (at least once a week). Multiple floors have had to call 911 on other tenants. Management is too cheap to put in cameras in most common areas so things like the hot tub wiring catching on fire via cigarettes and nobody knowing who did it is a common thing. Maintenance people here are trying to keep it going but their job is impossible. 

At least it’s quiet.

My experience has been awful here, be careful before choosing this property. There have been repairs going on right outside my apartment for the last 8 days, turbines making noise 24/7 to dry a leak, can't sleep.. If you want an honest opinion, stop by and ask a resident. Unpleasant and unfortunate that we chose to rent here. Management is unexperienced and can't resolve problems, completely clueless.

I absolutely love this property. After living several places in Denver, I can say this is the most centralized, clean and luxurious property at a good price point. The neighborhood is peaceful and quiet, and there are several great stores and restaurants all within walking distance. Couldn’t have chose a better place.

My family and I have loved living here in Tower 1. It’s beautiful, very well cared for both inside and outside, and the location is amazing! Plus, Anita, Jodi, and Starr are absolutely incredible ?? They are genuinely kind and there to help with anything and everything. There’s a nice community feel and so many events that they host here for the residents. We feel so lucky to have found this gem ??

I have had issues with noise from above neighbors for over 6 months. Manager refuse to do anything I escaleted to the regional manager who said manager will take care of me. Today I still have the same issues. any way staff is great other than manager. location and property is great

This apartment complex is amazing! It is in a wonderful location with a "community" atmosphere. The staff is great and they are always helpful! This is such a great location for young adults to live. There are a variety coffee shops, shopping, dining, and bars close by! They have different options for living.. the gardens and the towers. They also have wonderful amenities for everyone; pool, theater room, yoga by the pool, workout room, etc. If you are looking to live in this area, this is the place to choose!

I have only been living here for a month and my apartment is terrible. There is so man broken things. My stove was broken when I moved it they ‘fixed’ it and I went to use it and it’s sparking at me requested help still waiting. My heater doesn’t work properly and they had someone ‘fix’ it and my house is cold no matter how high I put it. So cold that my Pyrex busted in my sink. I called maintenance to make sure no glass in still in sink and I’m still waiting on that too. My door to patio is held together by foam. I’ve been to the office with no help

If you want repairs done in a timely manner this is not for you. My AC went out during a heat wave last summer it took 2 months to repair. Combine that with 2 sets of neighbors who host parties at late hours on any given night of the week....

When I moved here 4 years ago it was a nice building. Now it's garbage. We have 3 cars and 2 we're broken into, they take forever to fix anything, the leasing office people are the worst - no customer service. When you call they act like they care, but in reality they don't. I've been complaining to them about my washer for over a month, 3 different maintenance guy have seen the washer, yet no one can't find what's wrong with it. There's been shooting in the complex. Someone tried to steal one of the neighbors gas from his car, in the process messed up his car. There's so much bad things with this complex. There are times that the gate works, and most of the time it doesn't work. Since I've been complaining so much they decided to raise my rent $200. I'm happy to say I won't be renewing my lease.
Handyman! He did everything quickly, clearly and accurately. Thank you very much Mr. Moose for the service. Highly recommend.

If you’re planning on moving here... BEFORE you sign papers and give money please please please make sure you see your unit first. Don’t make the same mistake we did. I felt extremely led on by their model unit. Nothing like that and tell you everything is pretty much the same when in fact it’s not. Since day one not even an hour being in Denver we had horrible experiences from before even opening the front door to our “ready to move in” apt.. we were lied to over the phone four days prior to our 1200+ mile drive here saying it was ready for us. When we move out here. shortly I’ll try to update this with everything that’s crap about our experience here. But mainly just want to say recently I’ve never been so frustrated in my life with this place our AC hasn’t been working correctly since June I’ve called several times (6-7 times) to put work orders in they’ve come four times two of which I was never notified they were coming.. I want to be home And they know that.. I don’t like having someone in my apartment especially without my knowledge first. If they call and I don’t answer don’t just walk in especially when I gave times of when I’ll be available and will be home. Disrespectful and really upsets me this happened twice.! Anyhow they’ve said they fixed it.. how?! If you did it wouldn’t be hotter in our apt than it is outside. Or 83 when it’s 90+ degrees out and they’ve yet to get a vendor out to at least look at it. My electricity bill for a one bedroom apt shouldmt ever be over 100$ let alone 140$ last month. There’s only so much our personal portable AC can do. Thats one of our biggest issues right now.. I was told twice by the office this is considered a emergency maintenance since it’s summer and in the 90’s!! Going into the office this past week was the last straw! I don’t deserve to be treated as if nothing is wrong.. or I’m wasting their time. 

Again view the unit first make sure it’s up to your standards. I’m not telling someone not to live here.. but just warning that they may be led on thinking it’s a great property over all. It hasn’t been for us and I’d hate to see more people experience the same or similar situations.

I have lived here for almost 2 years now. Last year when I moved in it was a Wonderful place to live. Now as of about 9 months ago and has just gone completely downhill. They let people put trash all over the complex.  They shut down the pool at least once a week because they let a bunch of people throw parties there. They never fix up the dog park and let it get piled up with poop. You pay a $55 maintenance fee included with your with the utilities (that is 100 for 1 single person) to keep the grounds nice but if you walk around there’s broken trees everywhere dog poop and tons of trash.  The apartment complex is full of broken down cars and trailers so you have nowhere to park at night.  The newest is condoms and broken beer bottles. The maintenance here is Absolutely horrible if you have anything wrong expect to wait 2 to 3 weeks. My dishwasher stopped working eight months ago and it took him one whole month to fix. Now my dishwasher stopped working eight months ago and it took them one whole month to fix after calling 5 times and my kitchen flooding. Now my sink disposal is broken and has been for 20 days. I have called four times for maintenance and it each time they said they completed the job when they have it. So the maintenance here even lies to the apartment complex  and they believe it so don’t expect to get anything fixed anytime soon. Go anywhere else but here it’s not work the money!!
Great maintenance staff Zach P. Very helpful and friendly person got all the work order requests done with no problem. Thanks again!

We really enjoy living in this apartment complex till today that we found out they did a hard credit inquiry on us when we moved in, which shows on our credit report. We have lived in 4 different apartment complexes before and they all did a soft credit inquiries, which non of theirs shows on our credit reports.  The landlord first told us that they only do a soft credit inquiries which won't hurt our credit, then today one of us were applying for an auto loan, and we pulled our credit report that shows an inquiry from this apartment complex listed, why???

Do NOT MOVE HERE.  Rent WIlL BE $250 more than they will ever tell you.  There are HORRIBLE parents who are training their kids to be HORRIBLE ALL OVER THE PLACE.  This place is PROFOUNDLY overpriced...and the price changes EVERY month... It feels like you live in a trashy daycare with trashy kids and their super trashy parents and you actually pay money for this- what makes it really painful is that you pay SOOOOOOO much more than to live somewhere actually nice.  Horrible mistake living here.  NOTHING is done to fix the horrible parents and horrible kids running all over the place (never together though, because NONE of the kids, ages 3-10 are monitered in ANY way by ANY parents, EVER, of course).  Thereis no explanation for the ever-changing monthly costs that they DID NOT dislcose when you signed the lease... GO SOMEPLACE ELSE.
my apartment has a real grand ambiance, grand high ceiling that make the place roomy. love the wood flooring in the kitchen and the bathroom.
Overall good. Maintenance and front office good. Been here 6 yrs but rent is doable. A little loud during the weekdays (always doing maintenance outside). I like my neighbors and the neighborhood.
My apartments are not bad it's the people that live here
love this apartment complex. The people are great and very helpful. I would recommend this place to anyone. The only down side is that it is expensive. But very nice big apartment.

this is a great place. Mimi was so helpful when we were moving in. all of the office staff is really friendly and welcoming. The apartment itself is awesome, somewhat small but everything looks good and all the appliances worked. Overall a really great place to live.

I wouldn't recommend long term living.

I lived at the Amaranth for 1 year beginning in November 2019. The 1BR 1BA apartment was sufficient--though surprisingly cheap in its finishes: bubbling laminate flooring and kitchen shelving not properly secured. Once that very kitchen shelving decided to give out, collapsing on top of me and shattering all of our glassware.

During the pandemic, all the amenities of the building were of course shut down--but as residents we sure as hell still paid for them--no discount for the lack of access to the gym that's been worked into your monthly rent.

Management made sure to send out reminders during the peak of covid to pay rent on time or risk eviction. This building is run by people who will squeeze everything out of their tenants while doing the absolute bare minimum.

The janitorial and maintenance staff at this building was great. During the 1 year stay I put in orders for several of the light bulbs to be replaced multiple times (cheap faulty wiring? cheap bulbs? who knows?) and the staff worked quickly and professionally to care for the issues.

I recently moved into The Amaranth, and have had an absolutely amazing experience thus far! What has impressed me most about The Amaranth, is property management's overall attention to detail. Beyond the immaculate apartments, outstanding rooftop lounge/patio and state of the art gym, they go the extra mile with the little things that make all the difference. Things such as the community coffee/espresso station, dog treats for your furry friend in the lobby and the monthly mimosa social on the rooftop to meet your neighbors and make new friends really does make it feel like home! If you are looking for apartments in the area, I highly suggest giving The Amaranth a visit!

I have lived in the Amaranth for seven months now and have nothing but good things to say about the experience. The apartment itself is beautiful, the community spaces are top notch, and the service from the office has been prompt and thorough. As with any new building there are items that need tweaking and fixing, but the maintenance staff is quick, friendly and respectful. It might sound cheesy but I've never loved an apartment or experience but I love this one!

Love this building. The amenities are top notch. Beautiful rooftop deck with stunning views, nicely appointed apartments with modern finishes, and the staff is very committed to and supportive of the tenants. They always have a smile and are happy to help. Maintenance is very responsive. My only issue is that the market rents are very high (imo), and maybe not in line with true "market value." Were it not for that, I would definitely give them five stars.
I highly recommend this property, which boasts an exceptional office and property maintenance team.  It provided the best apartment living experience.

A friend of ours lived here and recommended we check out Griffis Belleview Station. As many of the properties that surround it, this property is located near the rail station. You probably figured that out given the property name.

After spending the day looking at properties, and looking at one across the street from Griffis Belleview Station, we thought we'd pop in to just pick up information. It was about 10 minutes to closing. Marcia R. greeted us very friendly, and was extremely polite when she said she had to close the doors promptly at 5:00 because she had to go to the airport. We apologized and said we would come back, but she said she could show us a two-bedroom fairly quickly. 

Wow! While the apartment wasn't new, it had a ton of extra storage space! There is a lot of room in the laundry room. You can use the space around the car in the garage as storage. And the unit gets an extra storage closet in the hallway. Some units have a fireplace, which is a bonus. 

While the floor plan wasn't exactly what I wanted, Marcia really made you feel like you were coming home.

I was very impressed and great full for the maintenance team during this most recent blizzard. I saw them outside shoveling and clearing the walkways from 7:30 pm until past 11:30 pm in the freezing cold so that when all the residents got up the next morning to leave to work the sidewalks were clear. I truly appreciated it.

I moved into Griffis Belleview Station back in 2016. They have made so many improvements to the community, and it looks so nice and put together. The pool area is ver pretty and the gym is very convenient. The on sight dog park is a nice touch as well. I really like the fact that is is no close to the light rail because I work downtown, and I don't even have to drive to the light rail station. What I really like about living at Griffis Belleview Station is the staff and the maintenance team. Anytime I have an issue in my apartment the maintenance team responds quickly and they are always nice and respectful.

I've lived at Griffis (previously Enclave) since May of 2016, and in all of my time in Colorado, this has been by far the best apartment complex I have lived at. The management team and the staff overall are great to work with and treat me as a member of their community rather than just as some person who lives there. The staff has always been responsive and good for their word. The units are sturdy and solid and are extremely comfortable. Many of the units have gone through an upgrade recently, leaving a more modern feeling within the units. The amenities are awesome (I love swimming in a heated pool and the dog park is a nice addition), and the location is great, especially since Belleview continues to expand. 

Other residents have mentioned problems with parking and such, which did exist at one point. I'm happy to see that this issue is being rectified and addressed in an appropriate manner. Parking has become more stricter, but this was an ask of the residents, and I feel management took the appropriate steps to address the residents concerns. There have been reported break ins of vehicles as well, but with the night patrol, I feel that this issue has become less frequent than reported before. Other than these two issues, I really haven't seen any glaring issues or concerns in the past few months. 

My only real gripe about the complex is the cost of living, but this is more of a Denver issue than a Griffis issue. I've had three opportunities to relocate to a cheaper option, but I find myself not wanting to. I'm comfortable here, and the staff at Griffis are very inviting, helpful, courteous, and proactive. The only reason I would ever leave this place at this point is if I chose to move into a home within the Denver area or if I was relocated from Denver. 

At this time, I would recommend this location five times over if I could. You really couldn't ask for a better, nicer community to be a part of. If you're looking for a new home, I would definitely recommend coming in and speaking to the folks at the office.

I love the entire layout of the complex. My unit was well maintained and had a modern look to it. What I truly enjoyed was how wonderful the maintenance team was. Anyone who's ever rented an apartment knows the maintence can either make of break a place. I would recommend checking this place out.

Per our contract there was no indication the notice to vacate form would have to be provided by Addison at Cherry Creek Apartments. There wasn’t proper specifications on what our notice entailed. We reached out to the leasing office on numerous occasions during businesses hours in regard to what was needed in preparation to vacate and were told by staff nothing else would be necessary if we were not renewing our lease which they were made aware of before the 60 days. We even received several emails that confirm our move out date. If we did not agree to resign, therefore we do not agree to the terms of remaining a resident following our lease expiration. We were certain there was proper documentation of our choice to vacate as we were led to believe by the leasing staff’s statements and exchanges both over the phone and in person. We were not provided the 60 day notice to vacate form until after the 60 day period had passed. There was no mention of this particular form needing to be provided by Addison at cherry creek apartments prior to the date required to sign the notice. There was no indication our signatures would be a requirement for a notice to vacate prior to receiving the form (after the 60 day period). We did reach out after receiving the notice to confirm everything was in order and there would be no further issues. We got no response through email so we called the leasing office to confirm we would not have to pay additional fees, we were reassured we would only have to pay a portion of our last month not once but twice. We received a bill in the mail with additional charges because ‘they were not informed prior to the 60 days’. I talked with the Dani the apartment manager and I was hoping she’d understand this predicament and that we thought we did everything we could to inform them and that we had never even seen/received the 60 day notice form until after the 60 days. She didn’t even acknowledge they were supposed to mention the form itself or provide it in order for us to actually sign before the requested date, she didn’t care at all, said it’s on us if we didn’t know and just blatantly disregard our efforts to have everything done ahead of time. Needless to say it doesn’t matter how much you think you communicated with leasing office they just don’t care, they’ll tell you never talked with anyone, and take your money. I have call logs and screenshots, all of this is true.

Addison at Cherry Creek is a horrible place to live. Moving here was the worst decision I’ve ever made. Management is immature, dishonest, rude. I cannot believe these people are allowed to continue to treat residents like trash. Speaking of trash. They never clean the complex grounds, trash everywhere. Don’t rent here. Trust me. They push for 5 star reviews when you tour because they know they won’t get it after you are here for a month.can’t wait to leave.

Addison has been the worst place I have ever lived. The reasons are threefold.
1.) A couple days into our lease our downstairs neighbor accidentally fired his weapon through our floor, shattering our sliding glass door and creating a large hole in the floor. It was a terrifying incident and my spouse and I were feet from being shot in our living room.The most Addison did was to tell us we could move to another (smaller apt size) on our own dime. They left our shattered glass door covered with a piece of plywood on it for a couple days before they fixed it. A couple months later we decided we did not want to live there any longer and decided to leave. They let us leave without penalty for breaking lease due to that situation. We were thankful and everything was good.
2.) Upon leaving their office manager "forgot" to remove our penalty for breaking lease and charged us 1600 dollars. I called back and reminded them and they apologized and corrected it. Then a couple months later I get a call from a collection agency trying to collect the debt for "breaking our lease". I send everything to them again and then we are all clear once more.
3.) It is now 2 years later and I get another agency trying to collect this debt that doesn't exist. Addison - this is not a good look. Do not live here unless you are ready to be tied to an obviously inept business that struggles to honor simple arrangements with tenants who were close to being killed in their housing complex. The amount of time I have spent correcting their mistakes and following up is ridiculous. Not to mention the trauma of that experience. Long story short - don't move here. The lower cost of rent is hiding a bad living experience and poorly managed main office.

Addison at Cherry Creek is a dumpster fire. Look back at the 1 star reviews on here. Nothing has been improved and in fact become worse. Never in my lifetime have I seen such a scam of a company, all while pushing so hard for 5 star reviews. They push it the day you sign the lease because they know how full of crap they are! Trash allover the grounds, rude staff who constantly make mistakes like lose or misplace rent payments and then blame their mistakes on the residents. It's insanity! There is absolutley no reason for this place to have higher than 2.5 stars not sure if they pay this site for the fairy tale 4.9.

This apartment complex may look alright on the outside but there are a multitude of hidden fees tacked on to the agreed rent price. The apartments also have a multitude of fitment/construction issues due to rushed renovations like cabinet veneers peeling off, doors not locking or properly closing. The management during the previous summer, despite multiple shootings occurring within the complex would maintain keeping the gates open for all to enter. Additionally, for those splitting rent between roommates they had a partial pay option which would allow for easy payments which has now since been revoked due to COVID being eradicated. How they came to that conclusion I have no idea. So now one person has to pay the entirety of the bill all at once, but they kept the overpayment functionality of course. In short, stay away from this heap of garbage as you can find much better in this price range this far away from downtown Denver.

At one time Addison at Cherry Creek was a nice place to live, now it has become an over-crowded apartment community managed by ConAm. Addison at Cherry Creek management doesn't implement any policies to help manage the overwhelming amount of parked vehicles. Instead they will tell you to park down the street, outside of the community and walk to the home you pay top dollar for. Addison at Cherry Creek managed by ConAm make no effort in correcting parking issue - there are no assigned spots. So you can imagine in inclement weather walking several blocks in snow and ice to get to a place you live because there's no parking. The gate to enter the complex is broke and has been broken for months on end now. ConAm management say they plan on fixing it, but have yet to do so. All talk and no action. Do not move here. Go to a place where the management and staff make you a priority. Avoid any where ConAm is managing and especially Addison at Cherry Creek.

I moved to Denver from the East Coast and am absolutely thrilled to be living here!  As you can imagine, making that kind of long distance move is stressful and complicated.  From the beginning, the property manager, Monica, was helpful, answered all my questions, and did everything she could to ensure that the move in was smooth.  Once I arrived she was warm and welcoming, and helped me get oriented.  She's a marvelous, caring person who will clearly go above and beyond to help you out.

The apartment itself is amazing!  It's very quiet here - I never hear anything from my neighbors.  The grounds are beautifully maintained and clean.  The apartment is large and has tons of closet space.  The view of the adjacent creek and mountains are wonderful.  It's a relaxing, friendly, clean, and safe place to live.  There are 2 lovely parks right outside the apartment complex, so it's easy to walk, hike, and bike.

The maintenance team is fabulous.  I had a very minor issue with the closet door and they were Johnny on the spot.  Thanks, Steve, for the very prompt response.

Creekside at Amherst has surpassed my expectations grandly.  If I could leave 10 stars I would!  Kudos to the team - thanks for all of your hard work and dedication.

SKIP IS THE BEST HANDYMAN EVER. HE IS VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE, HELPFUL, AND A GOOD FRIENDLY PERSON. SKIP IS ALWAYS QUICK, EFFECTIVE, AND PROFESSIONAL WITH HIS JOB. I HAD REQUESTED MAINTENANCE A PLETHORA OF TIMES, AND EACH TIME HE WOULD PERFORM THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF SERVICE. RECENTLY, MY BATHROOM VENTILATION FAN FAILED. SKIP REPLACED THE FAN AND LEFT EVERYTHING CLEAN. NOW I HAVE A PERFECTLY WORKING AIR EXHAUST. THIS TYPE OF GREAT SERVICE MAKES MY LIFE MUCH EASIER.  GOD BLESS, SKIP. 

SINCERELY, 
ALEXANDER AND DANIELA.

First of all, I want to praise the people in the office (Tambra & Monica) they are the nicest, most down to earth, friendliest people there are. When we were struggling to find a place they helped us get an apartment to move into. They helped us more than anyone else would. Also the maintenance people (Roman and Steven) were nice as well, when I did the walk thru and there was something that needed fixed I'd let them know and they got it fixed ASAP. I am appreciative of everyone there and our place is bigger than the previous house that we lived in. I would HIGHLY recommend this place to anyone looking to live in a quiet, dog-friendly neighborhood.

The location is amazing and surrounded by beautiful landscape! The staff is friendly and the maintenance is always very helpful, even after hours. The floor plans are spacious and the windows are huge, providing tons of natural light. The atmosphere is quiet and homey. I love it here!!!

The apartments are well maintained.  Repair issues are responded to quickly and repaired within 24 hours.  The common areas are well maintained and enjoyable to walk through when going for a walk.  It is on a major bus route leading to various shopping areas.  The bus line then leads to various areas throughout the metro area.  

Marcelino C. Baca, Denver, CO

So, first I must say that I love the complex I live in. If you're looking for a quiet and relaxing place to move them thisnisbthe place for you. The management staff here is amazing and are beyond friendly. The location is Awesome, the view is pretty amazing as well. Although we are trying to buy a house in the future, I must say that I am HAPPY to call this complex home until I do so. Look no more folks, this is the next place for you:)

Moved here in October 2022, maintenance is quick to respond to tasks we have had. The grounds are kept clean. The office is friendly, replies to emails asap. The office has an open door policy. If you prefer to talk in person instead of email, the office will help you. They are friendly, attentive, you can take your dog with you. Your dog will love them and the treats!  I have no complaint about my neighbors. Everyone is friendly says hi. LOVE this place!

Pre-covid, my neighbors were great.  The units having pretty good noise isolation and I barely heard anything from the previous occupants of that unit.  My current next door neighbors now are particularly awful.  They slam their kitchen cabinet doors and drawers for hours every night.  They frequently cook greasy and nasty smelling food that stinks up my apartment.  Their children bounce balls, jump off furniture, drag chairs across the tile floor, scream, and slam doors.  I've had some terrible, disrespectful, and entitled neighbors, but these are the absolute worst. 

The grounds are well maintained, but the breezeways and stairwells are stained and full of trash.  The dumpsters are almost always full of mattresses, furniture, and boxes.  The tap water leaves a sticky brown residue on everything.  Like most complexes, dog poop is still everywhere despite maintenance picking it up.

As for pluses, the units are very large and the included private garage is really nice.  All of my appliances are from 2005 and the cheapest most basic units, but they do function.  The only reason that I renewed was the covid peak and I'm regretting that now.

Do not move here unless you want to be overrun by dog poop.  There is poop all over the property, all the time.  Sometimes the maintenance crew cleans it up but within a few days it is back in full force.  When I walk my dog, I am constantly looking out for poop so I can try to prevent her from stepping in it.  Even with my constant vigilance, she still manages to step in it several times a week lately, simply because there is so much.  Also don't even try walking on the side streets in the larger community - trash, empty liquor containers and broken glass all over, all the time.  Moving as soon as my lease is up and starting to think the $4,000 early termination fee would be worth it.

When we first moved into our apartment at Whisper Sky it was great! However, as time progressed there was multiple changes in management and 'type' of residents. Maintenance also turned over quickly.

We were made to feel that we were the problem when all we wanted was to live in peace and have management enforce the rules. 

1) We had repeated issues with one of our neighbors. While we understand things are never perfect when people are living in such close proximity, we had our downstairs/adjacent neighbors that were heavy cigarette smokers. The smoke would overtake our apartment and get on our belongings. Additionally, the way the apartment was situated is that their garage was under our living room. They drove Uber and had two small but loud dogs and were constantly in and out of their garage in the likes of 15-20 times between 5pm and 2am. This was loud and shook the apartment. I had to get an attorney to fix this and even then, it took months. 
2) Upstairs neighbors whose dog constantly barked.After asking nicely several times we they did end up giving them a notice of compliance, which took care of the issue. 
3) Other neighbors would be loading an unloading their car/truck in the middle of the night, multiple times a night, because they were charging those electric scooters. 
4) We paid $50 per month in pet rent for two cats and got nothing in return. See # 5. 
5) There was dog poop everywhere. They poorly enforced this and then would not clean. 
6) There were central/general fire alarm pulls in the public corridors. Someone was pulling these in the middle of the night, sometimes multiple times in one night or over multiple days. There was a speaker inside your unit  which was ungodly loud and would often take an hour for the fire department to access what they needed to shut it off. 
7) At some point, the complex changed from Republic to Waste Management. Trash would constantly overflow so there was literally a trash pile. This was almost weekly. 
8) Our Air-Conditioning would freeze up multiple times during the hottest days in the summer because the system was poorly maintained and leaked refrigerant.

I have lived here for over a year and recently decided to upgrade to a bigger floor plan.  The transition was smooth and the Leasing Office staff couldn't have been more accommodating to myself and my teenage daughter.  Isaac, Jennifer and especially Preston have gone above and beyond for me.  The neighborhood is clean and quiet. The apartments are huge and the maintenance staff has always been timely to any requests for repair that I've had.   I've been a renter in Colorado for over 20 years and this is by far the best rental experience I have ever had!  

Dana P.

We have lived here for 2 1/2 years and only reason we are moving is for job relocation. Preston, Isaac and (Jennifer) were Awesome to work with . If you want Great Location, Beautiful Apartments and Incredible Grounds then this is the place  for you . I wish I could take the office staff and the Grounds with us today our new location . Our Family was Very Happy to live here .

We would recommend Whisper Sky to friends and family. The front office staff is friendly and helpful. Issac is great and accommodating. Whenever we had questions or concerns he helped address them and got back to us immediately. In addition, he helped answer all our questions before we even moved in, something that we appreciated since we were not familiar with the area and/or property. Once again, this is a great place to live and we look forward to continuing to work with the front office staff.
I love whisper sky apartment . Everything very nice

When I moved to Colorado from Florida, I never thought I would find an apartment as nice as what I had.  I was wrong!  Whisper Sky is absolutely beautiful.  I can see the mountains from my windows.  The rooms are very large.  Everyone is very pleasant.  Service calls response time is quite quick.  I am close enough to downtown Denver as well as Denver airport.  Shopping as well as restaurants are very local.  The fixtures that can with the apartment are very nice.  The appliances are great.  The kitchen island is perfect and the master bath is to die for.  Closets are huge.  The amenities offered are perfect.  Garage, pool, dog park, workout center.  Free trainer and yoga classes.  The office staff is warm and helpful.  I do not think I could have found a better place to live.
Amy Zalesky, Whisper Sky, Denver
Not good management.  For example my dryer has been broken for months and they won't replace it

After searching for many apartments in the Denver area I found an affordable place in a park like setting smack close to Cherry Creek, Downtown and Denver Tech. I feel very safe here pulling into my attached garage. Let me continue by saying my place is quiet, quiet , quiet as it was originally built to be condos. The front office staff are amazingly helpful with just about everything and made my transition to Denver seamless.  Every maintenance request has been met promptly and thoroughly.The pool and hot tubs are well kept and provide a lot of social interaction. The grounds are always beautiful with flowers, wind architect pieces, willow trees other assorted greenery. The monthly newsletter keep us all connected with tips, social events and ideas. I love this place!
Wonderful first apartment. Staff are friendly and very helpful! We have loved it so far!
Great amenities, awesome staff, quiet and convienient. Love it here.

This is a great place to live.  It is close to restaurants, shopping, and many parks, as well as churches.  Besides a pool, hot tub and fitness center on the property, there are yoga classes.  Clubhouse with pool table and many other activities.  Staff is great and always helpful.

Great area, the location makes several grocery stores walking distance. The place has thick walls, making it very awesome for being comfy and quiet. Pool and jacuzzi really hit the spot after I go to the gym. I sound like I'm over selling it, but it's the nicest apartment I've been to since I got out of Lakewood.

Before moving to Denver, I spent 6 months looking for an apartment.  Whisper Sky had exactly what I was looking for.  The apartments are like new, pricing is right, neighbors are great.  Overall, I have been extremely satisfied with this property.  They do a fantastic job of keeping the grounds very clean and safe.  The staff is extremely friendly and helpful!  I would recommend this to anyone moving into the Denver area.  Large apartments with garages!

My family has lived at Whisper Sky for over a year now. The staff, who are amazingly friendly, have gone above and beyond to keep the buildings clean, safe and quiet. They are always organizing parties and events for the residences. Every issue we have brought to them has been dealt with quickly and with a smile. The rent might seem higher than other buildings in the area, but so much is included with what you pay, no water bills, no trash bills, no yard to maintain. Free yoga on Saturday mornings, a gym, a pool, a hot tub, a dog park, creative time for the kids, a gift wrapping station, and on and on. Most all the other residences are friendly and considerate. The pool in the summer is a great place to socialize and let the kids play.
The apartments are beautiful and updated. It's a wonderful place to call home.

My husband and I have lived at Whisper Sky Apartments for three months having moved from Cambridge, MA. Our experience here has only been positive. The management team are friendly and really work with you to achieve what you want. The apartment is deluxe with lovely features. The maintenance team keep the grounds impeccably clean. The gym is always open and kept very tidy. Even though the complex is close to Parker, a major road, it is quiet and peaceful. I would highly recommend Whisper Sky to anyone looking for a well-cared for, quite, deluxe apartment home.

This apartment complex is horrible. The washers never work and the office refuses to fix them. There is dog poop everywhere and it is a safety hazard. It is so loud with so many people in the common areas and parking lots at all hours of the day and night. The office manager is incredibly rude and nasty. The apartments smell. The apartments are very old. Live anywhere else but here in Denver.

Management is decent. The apartments are pretty good for the price, especially the top floor units that have skylights (super nice). But it is old, so you can expect the typical old building stuff: shower temperature changes while you’re in it, you have to sign a waiver for possible lead-based paint, etc.. it is almost the end of June and the pool is not open, apparently due to vendors being behind because of COVID? And, there are only 7 visitor spots sprinkled throughout the entire complex, while a whole bunch of additional resident parking sits empty all the way at the end. So if you want visitors, be prepared for them to park all the way on another street and walk. 

Honestly though if the owners invested in better security, I might stay. Here’s the kicker: in the last two months, my own vehicle has been stolen from the parking lot, my neighbors work van was broken into and cleaned out (catalytic converter and all), an actual apartment in this complex (someone’s HOME) was broken into in the building next to mine, AND the leasing office was broken into. And who knows what else. There is a unit in my building full of heroin and meth addicts who bring random strangers in and out all hours of the night. I invested in my own security cameras because the complex refuses to invest in them. They say there is a security patrol but I have literally never seen it. 

If the complex invested in better security, I’d stay. But I will likely not be resigning my lease if things don’t change. The price is not worth it to be worried about our safety and belongings everyday.
I love my apartment its just the right amount of space and i love the area and the neighborhood.
Apartment community was functional - on bus lines that went directly to downtown or DTC, and nearby grocery stores.
The apartment building is quit. No one in building C fights or is loud. I don't know about the rest of the buildings but ours is very quiet at night.
I would recommend this apartment because they keep them clean and maintenance comes on time every time

New staff has been great, Melissa I believe has been pleasant to deal with in the front office. They helped when I lost my key and fob immediately, the only bad thing I can say was there was some paint overlap when the last management had the apartment repainted hastily. New management and things have been pleasant so far, no complaints with them at all.

Echoing other recent reviews- the quality of this building has deteriorated. High staff turnover and constant safety concerns are the new norm. 
Fire alarms go off all the time and are exceptionally loud with strobe lights. Homeless people make their way in, in part because there has been NO GARAGE DOOR FOR MONTHS AND MONTHS leaving the building vulnerable. 
Staff are rude and unhelpful and do not follow up on concerns and complaints- including residents smoking on balconies, using balconies for dogs to use as bathrooms, and dogs peeing all over the carpets in hallways. Building isn’t kept clean with trash in stairwells and hallways. 
I would recommend spending your rent money somewhere that feels safe!

This was the absolute worst apartment experience in my life thus far from start to finish. Our move in was a complete mess. We later realized that nobody ever knew what was going on in the office because management is constantly turning over. In the 10 months we stayed in this horrific lease, we saw at LEAST three separate managers. Further, the handoff process for their documents is nonexistent. The regional manager – Michael – is kind enough, but seems to have no idea what actually happens with the management team at SB1K. 
If you think about moving here, they talk all about their amenities, but don’t take that at face value. If you want to use the resident lounge, you have to pay $350 (!!!!!!) dollars. The pool is disgusting. It is NOT salt water and our friends saw a homeless man bathing in it on more than one occasion. 
They also have mice. We caught FOUR mice in less than 2 weeks. We also had friends on the first floor catch videos of mice on her cameras at home. When we called to report it, they assured someone would come by to exterminate. More than TEN DAYS LATER someone finally came, threw some poison behind the fridge and stove, and called it good. When we decided to end our lease one month early because of this, the manager at the time said she understood and would allow us to leave. By the time we completed move-out, this manager (the THRID manager we knew of in our time there) had left. The new manager said she was not handed over any info that we were allowed to end our lease because of these health hazards, and she tried to charge us OVER $6,000 to leave. 
Finally – it’s blatantly unsafe. The doors are constantly broken (INCLUDING the garage door), so people from the outside can get in at any time (hence people bathing in the pool). During one of our last weeks enduring this place, we were woken up at 2AM by someone running their shoulder into our locked door and trying to get in. While I called 911, my partner tried to reason with the intruder. He started showing videos of explosions, violence, etc. through our peephole on his phone. Not only did the property management not care when we sent the video to them, they also did nothing to notify residents that this occurred nor did they even send a simple email regarding safety. The 911 operator actually told me other people were calling in about the man outside, but NO SECURITY WHATSOEVER was anywhere to be found in or around the apartment complex.

I have lived in about 8 luxury apartments throughout Denver in all sorts of different neighborhoods and I used to manage apartment buildings as well so I have a pretty good grip on how operations work.

The good: Location, the actual inside of your apartment is nice, layout of apartment is ideal, maintenance is quick for issues you have within your apartment, friendly neighbors, dog lovers throughout the building, events.

The bad:
From the second when I received my keys and they did not open half of the doors on day 1 until this very second with the fire alarms going off for the third time this week...please trust me when I say to RUN RUN RUN. You will be better off paying a little bit more at a different apartment building in the area.

When I first moved in, the doors within the parking garage to get into the building did not work and I couldn't get into the building. I asked over and over and over when they were going to get fixed and they kept delaying it. To this day I still don't know if they work because one day I decided to park on the street to carry groceries in and my car got STOLEN that night. Our other car got broken into one of those nights that the garage door was broken. Things like this happen with city living, but this is why you seek out at least a functioning garage - it won't happen here. I finally got my car back and it got stolen a second time FROM THE ACTUAL LOCKED garage. I never got the car back. 

Fire Alarms... They will go off at 3AM on a Saturday, 1AM on a Monday, 2PM during the day. It is never ending. IT IS BAD. Alarms do go off once in a while in these large buildings, but this is a common occurrence here. This week, people are lucky to hear it three times!

The pool is absolutely disgusting. We refuse to use it and would be embarrassed to have people over at it. 

There is poop literally everywhere. This is not managements fault but it shows the type of people you live with. Dog poop on the sidewalk, in the road, all over the grass to the point where it can't grow. It's honestly disgusting. You will step in dog poop while living here.

ALSO they sent me to collections for my move out. They never sent me an invoice through their portal or to my new address they provided so I assumed I didn't owe anything at move out. I even logged into my account and it said I owed $0.00. Months later I found out they reported me to collections. Make sure to reach out to them after you move or your credit will be screwed. DO NOT MOVE HERE.

As previous reviewers have said, the fire alarms go off ALL THE TIME. They have come up with a new excuse every single time for they go off, but no other building has this issue so obviously this building has an issue. You can expect a fire alarm probably once a week, so good luck if you have small children or animals with any type of anxiety. 

Oh and on top of that, the doors are constantly broken as well. The garage door is broken a couple times a month. The gates to the courtyard do not lock, so anyone and everyone can just push that bad boy right open. 

Unfortunately no one in the office seems to care. The building has potential, but they will just try to raise your rent when the lease is up despite all the issues here. Would not recommend.
The faulty wiring makes the alarm go off for minor reasons and it’s LOUD. It’s causing emotional and mental distress as it happens frequently and at any hour of the day

Lowry North is a good community. The office and maintenance team are very helpful. The community is quiet and I feel safe. The night patrol actually comes around frequently, I have seen them a handful of times. I renewed my lease

The parking can be tight if you come home late, there's spots, but may just be further away. 
The units can be drafty

Kayla and Tammie are the most accommodating leasing professionals I've ever met, the maintenance takes care of EVERYTHING expediently and the grounds are kept decent.  I've seen better in that department for sure.  The pool is year round and heated, so is the hot tub.  The one thing I don't really like is the parking situation.  Everything else is top notch.

I have lived at my apartments for 10 months now and I have never had such quality service within the staff and my residence. I can honestly say they have always gone above and beyond when I needed anything fixed or even a package to be placed inside my house because I work late. They also have security/police which patrols our parking lot for safety. I would definitely recommend these apartments as as a great place to live.

Living here has been an incredible experience in every way. The community is beautifully maintained, offering a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and aesthetics. The facilities are well-kept, and the environment feels safe and welcoming. It’s truly a place that feels like home, where attention to detail and resident satisfaction are clearly a priority. Whether it’s the serene surroundings, friendly neighbors, or the thoughtful amenities, this community stands out as a wonderful place to live.
Working with the leasing team at Waterford Cherry Creek was wonderful. They made the application  process easy, even for a computer  challenged person as myself.
Clean apartments between tenant usage, fix maintenance issues with a timely manner, better communication from leasing office. Waterford in Cherry Creek is terrible.
I have only had good experiences here at Waterford. The management team is kind and friendly and helpful, and the maintenance team respond quickly and competently to any requests.
Uncaring management has no solution for a broken appliance (washing machine) besides ending my lease or letting me use a vacant apartment to do my laundry which is completely absurd.

“Property mangment is lack luster and the premises is not secured. Don’t be fooled.”

That’s a million dollar marketing line if I have ever seen one.

I have been living in this apartment complex for a little over a year, and unfortunately, my experience has been consistently disappointing. The management’s communication is extremely poor. After reporting a cockroach infestation over a week ago, I have still not been given a resolution to this problem.

Maintenance and upkeep are severely lacking. The hot water goes out frequently, and this has been a recurring issue for months. The pool was unusable all summer after it appeared someone defecated in it in June. Despite complaints from residents, management refused to clean the pool for the rest of the season, leaving the water green and unsafe. The elevators are constantly broken, adding another layer of inconvenience to daily life.

Broken laundry machines are often left out of order for long periods, causing significant inconvenience. Trash around the property piles up regularly, making the grounds unpleasant and unsanitary.

Security is also a major concern. My car was stolen from the property last October, and the complex offered no support during the situation. In addition, I have seen two homeless individuals in the mailrooms, one of whom was using drugs. These incidents raise serious safety concerns that management has failed to address.

Given the ongoing issues with maintenance, security, and management’s lack of action even after repeated complaints, I cannot recommend this complex to anyone. I highly encourage people to look elsewhere for their new home, as this property does not meet basic standards for communication or upkeep.

I have lived here for about a year and half. The building is more than 50 years old, and because maintenance was deferred over the course of many years, it is barely holding up. 

They are regularly shutting the water off in the entire building  in order to "resolve water main issues." It has been occurring the entire time I've lived here, and there is no sign these issues will be resolved any time soon. 

I'm writing this review during the second major shut-off in the span of a week. The management gives notice of the shut-offs less than an hour ahead of time in most cases, and the shut-offs have lasted for hours at a time. Do you want to live in an apartment where your water could shut off while you're in the middle of a shower with shampoo in your hair? Then come to Monaco South. Otherwise, steer clear.

The main courtyard has major drainage issues. Any time it rains or snows, the moisture is retained in the waterlogged soil. In some shady areas, the ground is wet year round. There is moss growing where grass should be.

The washers and dryers are frequently out of commission. The elevators are notoriously unreliable. One of the elevators in the building is just an exposed cab with no weatherproofing or shaft protecting it. How is that safe??!

The residents. People leave their trash outside their apartments in violation of management policy. Many residents fail to pick up their pets' excrement, leaving it to dry on the sidewalk or grass, and sometimes on the exterior walkways. 

Lastly, the neighborhood. Yikes. The day I moved in, I found a bullet casing in the parking lot. Within a couple months, someone got shot in the alley north of the the building directly below my apartment. Within a year, there was a major drug bust one of the apartments. A few weeks ago, I was taking my dog on a walk and an unleashed pit bull attacked my dog. 

I'm a poor student and Monaco South is right next to a bus stop, so that's why I live here. It's NOT IDEAL in many ways. I've lived in some real stinkers. This place is a nightmare.

Dont live here. Everything is broken all the time. There is one elevator that is broken at least once a week. The water gets turned off once a week. You might get notified but probably not. Everyone in the office is rude and not helpful. Maintenance doesn't know how to properly fix anything. Homeless people like to hang out here. Cars get broken into, my mailbox got broken into. The package room is always broken so packages get stolen. Save your money. DO NOT live here.

I lived here for about three years. The office staff has a high turnover rate and it's obvious they're not trained; they rarely answer the phone during office hours and when you go in with a question they rarely if ever know how to actually answer. If you have to take paperwork in make sure to print out multiple copies because depending on who you talk to in the office they’ll either have no idea where your paperwork is or deny that the office received it in the first place. When doing the routine smoke detector tests one of the office ladies practically begged me to leave a positive review. It takes maintenance days to call and get something scheduled and longer to actually get something fixed.

People treat the main hallway as a Goodwill and leave old furniture, clothes, and appliances for you to step over on your way out. There's trash everywhere and sometimes puke in the parking lot or in the elevator which takes days to get cleaned up if at all. There's a gym across the street, you should just go there if you want to work out because all the equipment the apartment provides is damaged, dirty, and falling apart since kids play in there all the time. I sent an email with pictures to the manager and was told it would be fixed, it wasn't. The laundry room is disgusting, the washers and dryers are so old and smell disgusting and at least a few of them are off at a time. 

The walls are so thin, you can hear your neighbors talking on the other side of the wall and neighbors yelling at each other in units diagonal from you. Sketchy people hang out in their cars for hours in the parking lot obviously a drug dealer or looking to buy and cars get broken into monthly. Denver PD had to put up a sign on the side of the road saying "Reduce theft, lock your car" and that sure says a lot about this area.

dirty, disgusting, smells rotten inside the apartments and out. no up keep what so ever. takes days to get something done by maintenance, weeks to get an answer on anything from the office. staff is horrible doesn’t care about anyone. pool is always closed. elevator is always broken and gets urinated in every other day. washing machines are always broken and laundry room is dirty. windows get broken all the time. trash everywhere. apartments haven’t been updated since the 70’s DO NOT LET THE PICTURES FOOL YOU THEY ARE FAKE!!!! peeling floors, chipped paint, things are “fixed” with tape and glue. they constantly run the heat through the whole building during the winter to the point where it’s too hot and you need to run your “air conditioning” (just a small wall unit that only cools down one room) or keep all your windows open. children run loudly up and down the halls screaming at all hours of the day and night. dumpster never gets emptied is always over flowing. people leave their trash bags in the hallways because they are too lazy to take it to the dumpster. they charge you for everything like the community lights outside of the building, the heat that they force you to have that you don’t want. had to call the “security” line for homeless people sleeping right next to the door to the parking lot, damaged windows and doors, people screaming outside in the middle of the night. extremely high deposit that you will NEVER see again they make up fake reasons why you can’t get your deposit back. this place is only for extremely poor people who have absolutely NO other options you have to be desperate to live her and even then it still is not worth it!!! there’s a reason it’s one of the cheapest apartments in denver do not believe any of the fake advertising this dump is not a good deal.

Kids constantly yelling
Trash everywhere
Elevators run down and smell like a urinal 
Dumpster diving residents
Drunk homeless who sleep in the ‘secured’ hallway
Incompetent and unscrupulous staff
Hallway windows smashed several times 
Waterline is always broken and water is shut off with little to no notice
‘Renovated’ units are just a new coat of paint over old rundown cabinets
Floors lock in all the dirt and won’t scrub clean no matter how much you mop
Unit wasn’t cleaned before moving in 
Bad odor that’s stuck in the walls 
BED BUGS upon moving in 
Did I mention incompetent staff? Or ones who have no integrity? Why not both? 


Avoid this place. You’re better off sleeping in your car.
Homeless people live immediately to the right of the main garage door entrance behind the building's utility box. Building ignores complaints and refuses to address. Very unsafe.

Location is nice but I have lost hundreds of dollars of mail due to it being stolen from the mail room. Management says that nothing can be done. There is no leasing office or staff on site so this does not help. Walls and floors in this building are also very thin and you can hear everything your neighbors are doing. Little storage and bad use of space in the single room apartments, not worth the money in my opinion.

Over the year that we lived here, we experienced constant fire alarms, broken garage door equipment (making it not a secure building and allowing cars to get broken into and constant bike theft), and rude/disrespectful neighbors. Let’s start with the neighbors- people are constantly partying to the point where you can’t share the space with them. One tenant was so angry that we were grilling while she was throwing one of her parties in the shared commons that she genuinely tried to bully us off the roof by making incredibly rude/antagonizing comments to us as her friends were drunkenly sitting on the side of the building and throwing trash and spilling beer around the entire commons. Another episode ended with us calling the cops after finding a pool of blood in the stairwell along with splattered blood all over our hallway and door- thank God this person was okay- just very drunk and in need of stitches. This was the major reason we broke our lease but the constant fire alarms waking us up, the petty theft, and overall poor construction of the building motivated us to get out of this place by whatever means necessary.

I write this because after everything that Kayla and the building owners have done for me, it's the least I can do to broadcast how great my experience at Peregrine Place was. The building owners are there a few days every week and, along with Kayla, respond immediately, even outside business hours. I often casually texted with them about maintenance and unit questions. Brian, the maintenance guy, is on site everyday too so lightbulbs and small issues are resolved within the hour. The building is immediately across the street from a beautifully maintained and quiet park. The very well-funded city of Glendale's admin functions (and it's large YMCA) are based in the park, which ensures that it is safe and empty at night and always kept clean. There are many small businesses down along our block and Colorado Blvd with all of it's chain restaurants is only a block and a half away. The proximity (1-3 blocks away) to a post office, Target, Home Depot, and Whole Foods makes life much easier as well. I moved to this neighborhood after living downtown because it avoids nearly all of the morning traffic on I-25 to get to my job in the Tech Center while still being close to Cherry Creek and downtown. The convenience of no longer having long drives for any of my errands more than made up for having to uber downtown twice a month. Bull and Bush, one or the oldest and coolest bars in Denver, being a short walk away also gave us a fun neighborhood bar to gather at with friends. The units are smartly laid out with plenty of storage space and, even though the aesthetic hints at it, is not cheaply made like the other new buildings I lived in so far in Denver. Get an apartment with a view of the park, it's refreshing to watch rugby and cricket games all week long from your balcony.

Around three years ago the apartment was built. So the apartment is very new and has little maintenance issues. If any issues ever occurred I reached out to Kayla or Ellen. The problem was fixed either that day or the next. 

The management and the community is extremely friendly. I would stop in by Kayla or Ellen and say hi on regular basis. 

Additionally, there are community events if you ever want to meet more people! 

I absolutely loved living here, the only reason why I moved is because I moved to a different state.
We have lived here for the past 6 months and we love it so far! The apartments are extremely clean and everything is brand new. Kayla, the leasing agent, is amazing!

I’m so happy to have found this place. Moving from Texas I was worried about finding a place I loved here. Everything from management to the property has been a great experience. I am a very happy girl!

Peregrine place is absolutely terrific, from the leasing agent to ownership! It is a true community, it is not run by corporate drones, but by people who truly care. The best part for me is that it is pet friendly, they have a dog wash in the basement and a designated doggie area on site. Infinity Park is directly across from us so I try and go over there as often as possible, my pup loves it! The apartments are beautiful and things are fixed in a timely manner. The management makes things go smoothly in the process of moving in or out. They go above and beyond and make new additions to the building to enhance it even when it is not necessary. Abide by the lease and the simple guidelines management puts in place and you will have a enjoyable living experience.
Great location with good views and close to 25. Staff are friendly and easy to work with. Building is well maintained and apartments are updated.

I've been fortunate enough to live all over the U.S., and Gardens at Cherry Creek is the *worst* apartment I have stayed at. They get away with charging an arm and a leg due to their location, which is also surrounded by truly luxury apartments -- but it's nowhere near appropriate for this complex to ride the coattails of other developments. The buildings are old, the floors are very cheap vinyl, and the walls are desperate for new paint. During my year-long lease, the pool wasn't usable, and the gym had 80% of it's equipment broken for nearly 5 months.

To my surprise my unit wasn't cleaned before I moved in, and the blinds were broken from day 1, which I also documented in my move-in paperwork.  They never offered to remedy the situation or reimburse me to hire someone to clean. I submitted several maintenance requests over the course of my lease asking to fix the blinds so I didn't have to keep using a rubber band to keep them up or down every day. 

They force you to enter into their bulk account during lease signing, which states that you will receive a "tech package"; package insinuates more than one, but they will only give you internet. You still have to purchase cable separately. If you were Joe-blow walking into the cable store right now, you would be paying ~$130 TOTAL for a cable/internet bundle, depending on the cable tier.

I had moved from out of state, and I was in a rush to get settled. You will find that this is a common story of residents living here; this complex is actively looking for people who are  rushing and that will gloss over details that are *really* important -- like noise from units upstairs and beside you, bursting pipes, stolen mail and belongings from the garage, broken and unusable amenities, etc.

Even after all of that, and I left the unit better than I got it.....they refused to return my security deposit. Learn from my mistake: don't rush your next move, and don't view an apartment at Gardens at Cherry Creek remotely. Be on site and ask to see the exact floor plan that you will have to avoid surprises.

I moved into this apartment 6 months ago and since I moved in half of the gym equipment has been broken with no promises of repair, the pool and hot tub are broken half the time, the bike locker has been broken into and I had $250 worth of parts stolen off my bike, the garage has been left wide open for months with no sign of additional security, and our storage unit in the garage has been broken into. I would not recommend leasing here.

We’ve lived here for 2 years and it was great until a few months ago. They took 3 months to fix our broken heat. Made us wait until someone from their company flew in from out of town at their convenience instead of bringing in a local vendor. Never acknowledged their mistake. Escalation to regional management means nothing. Major security issues and lots of theft that they don’t tell residents about. Won’t make security improvements despite multiple issues and theft events. Property is dirty and unkept. Will spend rent money on improvements that enhance their LEED certification but not what actually improves the safety of residents. I would highly advise not living at any Connor Group buildings in the Denver area.

Brandi, Santos, Dave and the rest of the team at the Gardens are AWESOME!  If you want a turn-key renting experience then come live here.  The neighbors are friendly, lots of pet lovers to accommodate your furry companions, and very responsive staff that make living here so great.

TLDR: Beware: trapped in lease with no lease break option, poor maintenance (leaking ceiling, 8 attempts to repair without resolution), extremely poor management, excessive noise with no resolution, ill-treating to their front-line worker tenants, multiple ineffective repair visits in the middle of a pandemic, COVID-19 positive repairman; pool shooting last summer, broken garage door repeatedly (cars at risk), no security, dirty fur covered halls and stairwells

I have lived here for over a year and would not recommend this apartment complex to anyone. I am a doctor working long hours in the context of COVID-19. In May, new tenants moved in above me with a puppy who runs back and forth, scratches the floor, and rubs toys against the ground. It sounds like bricks dropping and is incredibly disruptive for hours each day, impacting my sleep, and has caused me terrible migraines. Since the weekend of their move-in, I have been reporting my concerns to management, both Shantell (on-site management) and Jessica (regional).
