I moved here in 2016 when it was managed by Sares Regis. But just few months ago, a new management took over - AMC. 

All the good experiences just went downhill. 

The new management charges you to Pay your rent via online. They took away the cheque drop box (apparently it was vandalised just 2 days after they took over the property). 

Our utilities bill has significantly increased since the new management took over (about 20$ additional). They also make you sign new contract where it looks like your security deposit is not safe and will not be refunded fully even if you handover the apartment in good condition without any damage. 

The premises are not well maintained now, there is repair work all the time with central heater, water system  etc. The management do not give you any notice to inform if your wa We supply will be cut off for repair work. They also do not tell you by when you could expect the  water to be turned on again.

The property itself is great – nice updated apartments and amenities. Unfortunately that is strongly outweighed by the awful new management. The property was sold a couple month ago (plenty of time for the adjustment period) and ever since Arabella has gone way downhill. First, the old maintenance staff was absolutely amazing but the new maintenance staff are rude, not helpful, and always seem annoyed to be doing their job. There has also been an alarming increase in police actively in the complex since the new management came on. I realize that this is probably not a direct result of management but they handle it very poorly. Most recently a CAR WAS STOLEN on the property and no notice was put out to the residents to let them know of the threat. Very irresponsible of the management. There are also spiders everywhere. The old management would spray the stairwells and hire professional pest control for inside apartments. The new management does not spray the stairwells (even when specifically requested) and just has the maintenance staff come in with generic bug spray to spray inside the apartments instead of professionals. We now have to pays fees when you pay rent online via a bank account or credit card as well as a onetime initiation fee and the website is extremely outdated.  You also have to wait until the 1st to be able to see your balance on the online portal. Apparently they wait until literally the last minute to put the balance online, very unprofessional and annoying. I do not believe there is not a better system for them to use. Paying rent online was no extra cost with old management and their system was MUCH better. It is now obnoxious to pay rent with the new management. I shouldn’t have to pay a fee to give YOU money. Now, the girls in the office are generally nice (if you are on their good side) but being nice does not alone make you good at your job. The quality of management of an apartment complex makes or breaks the apartment as a whole. And the management at Arabella is a major downfall and there is a ton of room for major improvements.

New management has been in place for about a month at Arabella and the service has drastically changed. 
New owners have proven to be money hungry, by implementing additional, monthly fees. 
New management, while understandably overwhelmed, has been inconsiderate. 

I've lived in this complex for a while now and was always able to access information about my apartment online, but new management requires a fee, even for existing tenants to set up an account - without paying to have this information made available again, tenants are not able to view fees for the month until after the fact, and must pay with physical checks. The check drop box has been recently removed, though due to vandalism (which was never a pervasive issue under previous management), which led all of the checks placed in the box to be stolen. Notice to tenants was not sent out about this incident, and the only reason I know that it happened is because I've had to visit the office several times in the past week to get a service request completed. Prior to new management, I'd never waited more than 48 hours to have a maintenance request fulfilled. With new management, after over a week and three visits to the office (not to mention about 15 calls, only 1 of which was answered) my service request was finally completed. I am certain that the task was completed, because the maintenance staff left a very large mess. 

These issues, coupled with the year round pool being shut down for the first time in over a year leaves me with little encouragement to any potential new tenants looking to pay the premium rents - you will find better service for comparable prices, easily, elsewhere. 

That being said, the location and apartments are lovely - hopefully, this management will figure some things out to make it a place worth paying for again someday soon.

The apartment itself is great. The location is convenient, the apartments are updated, and the amenities are awesome. But unfortunately the thing that use to push Arabella to 5 stars was the management and maintenance staff. The old management staff was always on top of it, available and friendly. But just a couple weeks ago Arabella switched management, and I have yet to be impressed. The first weekend they took over there was absolutely no one in the office and no signs or notice to the residents that they would be closed. Now there is only one employee working the office at a time, which causes there always to be a line to talk to anyone in the office (if they are there at all.) Lastly, the new online rent payment system is awful compared to the only management’s system and now includes processing fees for every payment type and well as activation fees. It is just overall dated and annoying. So if having an available/friendly/helpful management and maintenance staff and a convenient rent payment system, the apartment complex is not for you.

This is a great community to return to after the hustle and bustle of Denver's Tech Center. Surrounded by high rise offices and upscale restaurants, you can rub elbows with the rich and famous of Denver during the day, and return to a comfortable modern home at night. The apartments are well-maintained and frequently updated, giving them a high-end feel without the price tag. The staff is extremely helpful, maintenance is always completed promptly, and everyone who works here will soon know you by name! The facilities are an added bonus, and there are many good eateries and drinkers within walking distance. Great place to live!

I have had water leaking into my apartment for over a month after I reported it. It leaks over a light switch and into a light fixture. The only thing I would change is my kids schools closer.
First off my apartment is not were I want to live and people are not friendly at all hopping to move.

Moved to a one bedroom sight unseen, going off the floorplan from this site. My living room is 7.5 ft wide, from the front of the fridge to the opposite wall. This space consists of a couch and some houseplants, there’s absolutely nowhere to put a T.V. I’ve lived in smaller studio apartments that have more usable space.

I was a bit nervous to move here considering the lack of reviews, but I’m so glad I ended up going with this complex. I have almost nothing bad to say. Chris, the property manager,  made my move here seamless and easy as I came from out of state. The apartments are exactly like the pictures, modern and clean with lots of bright, natural light. Common areas and hallways are cleaned daily. I have had 2 small maintenance requests that were acknowledged day of and taken care of promptly. Any time I have any questions about anything, Chris replies immediately. My favorite part about this apartment complex is how quiet my neighbors are, which is very important to me. My only negative thing would be the fact that there is a fire hall across the street so sirens go off pretty regularly. It’s very comforting knowing I have this space to come home. You won’t regret making 2525 your home

Staff at Commons Park West are very friendly, helpful, and responsive, both in the leasing office and on the maintenance staff. We get prompt notifications of work that is being done in the building, and maintenance follows through with even the most non-routine issues.

Commons park west is the best place I’ve lived. Nothing is ever perfect but this comes close. Location, amazing, like insanely beautiful, cost, slightly lower than a lot of places and again a way cooler location. I can walk to get all kinds of food, my apartment has a couple design flaws like doors that should open the other way or mirrors hung too high because that’s where the outlets are but I’m quite sure no apart figured it all out without costing an arm and a leg. The pool is beautiful, and the workout room is really great. So many conveniences and my back yard is the Platte river and commons and confluence park. Gorgeous!
I love it here! The people are kind and active which fits my lifestyle. And you can’t beat this location!

Commons park west is the perfect way to live downtown or highlands or sunnyside. All of these places are so expensive and Platte st is safe and I love watching people with their dogs and all the people who include outdoor activity on a daily basis. It’s a wonderful environment especially motivating to be healthier, to get some puppy kisses (only if mom/dad says it’s ok). The only frustrating aspect is the timing of redoing the outdoor areas. Losing the pool for two weeks in July is sad but I know the weather has been wet and may not have been conducive to sealers and grinding. Overall location is perfect, my apartment is cozy, and neighbors are totally great       I do wish there was more sound insulation between the walls and ceilings. But that’s apartment life.

I currently live here. It is such a great place and centrally located in Cap Hill. Walking distance to a ton of places, including the museums, and Stoney's (most importantly, lol). The apartments are all studios (with a loft type bed). The kitchens and bathrooms are brand new and gorgeous. There is a dog run, a dog cleaning station (a room actually), a giant bike storage area (another big room), a 'makers' room where you can print junk, get on the internet on the giant desktop mac, take pics with some fancy lighting, and there is even a 3d modeling thingy and a sewing machine. There is a great gym with a bunch of fancy equipment, including a peloton. There is also a very extensive sitting area in lobby with a ton of comfy places to just hang and/or remote work on your laptop. There is parking garage legit right next door and behind the building (additional cost - the garage is like $125'ish). There is a beautiful terrace on top (10th) floor with 2 separate outside sitting areas (that have 2 BBQ's and a firepit) as well as an inside terrace area with a pool table, free coffee, large screen tv, seating areas and THE most spectacular views!!!! Also, this place is a secured building so a fob is required to get into any doors, including the front/back entrances. And, I cannot say enough good things about Michelle (front office) and Tony (maintenance guy extraordinaire)...they legit will respond and fix any issue you have like immediately. They are totally wonderful.
Since i apply to the apts the staff they were all kind and if i have an issue with the apt they fix things quick and fast.

Loretto heights is a great community to live in you have dsst middle school and high school around you you are very close to Littleton to King Sooper shopping center at Bellevue and at Bear valley also Walmart on Inglewood and Hampton there is parks around here it's a beautiful community to live in I love loretto heights apartments I've always lived down Southwest Denver and I would recommend it
Personal muy amable el mantenimiento rápido y eficiente gracias

The leasing office staff and maintenance teams are absolutely amazing and I have never had an issue with this. However, the rent is too high for the quality of apartment you receive. Many apartment features are outdated and frequently require repairs. The amenities at the community are also below average for the price you pay.

Norma was very helpful in our application process and welcomed any questions or concerns. Kudos to her and her hard work. She is clearly passionate about people and her roll at Loretto Heights.

We have been here for just over a month now and we love our apartment. Any service requests we've submitted have been resolved promptly. The neighbors and staff are all friendly and it seems to be a safe, family orientated community.

Overall, I would recommend others to living at Loretto Heights.
This location fails to satisfy any criteria and standard. Having a contract with the sage at panorama implies that you are bound in a serious-series traps.

The amenities- Great The location-great. The layout of the unit- Great. The cleanliness of the apartment- ok. Security- Fantastic. Neighbors- so nice. Management office- Awesome.

- Updated countertops/cabinets/appliances
- Near a park
- Pretty quiet

- Lots of animal waste supplies located all around the complex
- Pool/gym (haven’t gotten to use as much due to COVID)
- Quick to respond to work orders
- They have a few promotional activities Ex: free cookies/milk, winter decorating contest
- Friendly staff
- Deck and outdoor storage

Cons:
- Water heater issues for our building frequently
- Heat doesn’t seem to hold well/it feels like cold air blowing out a lot of the time
- Marijuana smell infiltrates our apartment from smoking neighbors
- Minimal storage. There is a closet on the deck but zero coat closets or linen closets

When I brought this issue to the management's attention, they sent over maintenance and of course I got the answer 'that's just how HE machines work'. The next place I'm moving into have a different type and brand and they actually said HE has to do with the movement/electricity use, not water use. I guess that's a whole different discussion, but just sayin'... So for those out there that are particular when it comes to their laundry and want to make sure it actually cleans your laundry, be wary of this place! 

Another few quick points:

Valet trash, haha what a joke - you HAVE to pay whatever they charge monthly to have your trash picked up. Haha of course you can't! People, think about it, do you really think that however much they charge per apartment for valet trash is what it costs to pay someone to go around and pick up trash.... It is noisy, something I read in other reviews as well( bf I live with has experience in apartment constructions and knows it isn't the best of quality) so what you pay per month is definitely not equal to the quality of living you get, but that might be a Denver problem with the major boom happening now.

Dishonest and disreputable management. When you move out, expect to be charged for everything imaginable, including essential wear and tear they would have to address anyway. They are unprofessional, inconsiderate, and clearly out to squeeze every last penny from tenants without providing a safe or functional living environment.

Save yourself the misery. Don’t be fooled by the seemingly low rent—the hidden costs, rampant crime, and complete lack of professionalism make The Tiffany Apartment a nightmare. You deserve better.

The rent is reasonable, maintenance team is always on top of their work, no issues with the apartment. Parking is unprotected and this is Denver. Break ins and theft are pretty common, but I think its an unavoidable risk living in denver. Gets a little chilly in winter, but nothing a space heater can't fix. Overall, I had a good experience living here.

This place is unruly. Safety is not enforced. My car was broken into and attempted to be stolen in the first 3 weeks of me living here. I was later accosted by someone in the parking lot at night, clearly very drunk and meandering. I've had to call the cops to remove loud gatherings in the lot. And when a tenant was murdered on the property, staff did not notify everyone. I had to learn this by seeing it on the news. My heat broke in the winter and it took them a week to respond (this was during the coldest dates with negative windchill and my unit was sitting at 56 degrees). Do not move here.

DONT LEASE HERE, PLEASE. Constant break ins, a recent partnership with Wyatt’s Towing (just Google Wyatt’s if you don’t know why that says a lot about the property), constant car break ins and thefts (none of the cameras work so they won’t provide police with footage when you file a report), heat doesn’t work, water is regularly shut off or just no hot water at all, rodents, exorbitant monthly charges for utilities to upkeep the building no matter how little you use (and despite the fact that you will be paying electricity and Internet elsewhere), no amenities or elevator, property manager will not help you…I could go on and on. Safety, laundry machines that work, heat, hot water, respectful and responsive management, etc are all worth your money. This place isn’t. Reviews with higher stars were gained by them sending maintenance guys in to ask for 5 star reviews of MAINTENANCE not the building - that’s how bad it is there. Stay away.

Beware, this apartment complex is in a high crime rate area. Car break ins, car thefts, vandalism, and stolen packages are all a very big problem at this complex. 

Management is fully aware of this situation and has not been interested in doing anything to resolve the situation.

If you're ok with finding used needles in the parking lot and broken glass on the ground from the car that was stolen the night before, this is the place for you! 

It's worth noting that the best thing about the complex is the maintenance team, they are incredibly friendly and helpful with any issues. Unfortunately the crime in the area greatly overshadows the wonderful maintenance team.

This review is specific to the maintenance team of Joe and Jorge. These guys are courteous, accommodating and genuinely great people to know. 

We’ve lived in the complex for 7 years now. Most of the small stuff we try and take care of ourselves (ie lightbulbs) but they insist to submit a work order. They’ve replaced our garbage disposal and most recently expedited our request to replace our a/c unit that was on its last leg. They even helped me jump our car just because they happened to be in the parking lot at the same time. For that we’re grateful. 

We see them often the same day of a work order or worst case the next morning. Always polite and sympathetic. 

One thing you don’t have to worry about at the Phenix is maintenance. We love these guys for making our life easier. In apartment living there’s only so much you can control and knowing the maintenance team has you means the world.

Since I moved into my apartment on May 9, 2023 the whole apartment has smelled like smoke. The best offer that the leasing office did was to try "sanitize" the apartment after I moved in. The machine used not only didn't clear up the smell, the chemical used soaked into my furniture.  I have tried to lesson the smell by running the ac and opening the windows and screen doors. I have also tried to use a air purifier throughout the day. I have went as far to use a water/ammonia mix to clean the walls but it still very pungent by the entry way, the bathroom, and walk-in closet. I signed a 14 month lease and never was given the opportunity to see the apartment before signing the contract. If I had there would have been very little chance of me going with that apartment. I have been so disappointed with the experience with this apartment complex that not only was I not made aware of the status, but have not been offered to set me up in another apartment. I feel its only right seeing that since from day one it hasn't gotten better.

I was promised that I would receive lease renewal/extension offers 120 days before the end of my lease. It's now less than 90 days before the end of my lease and despite numerous calls with the front office and several voicemails to "corporate" no one can provide me with any information. I would caution anyone against signing a lease with the Concordia or any other Maxx properties if this is how unprofessionally they manage their business.

I find this apartment reasonably priced. Clean, quite, well maintained. I was looking for a 1 bed apartment to move in   right away and guess what. Natalia said no problem. She got me in next day although I am only staying for 4 months. There aren't many apartment around here welcoming short term stay or they would raise the rent $200 to $300.   As I moved in, the tub water was set at hot hot and the handle wouldn't move. I called next day for service and they took care of it that day before I got back. Nice work!

I really enjoy these apartments. Super close to Sloan’s lake to go for a run and very dog friendly. The first day we moved in we had an issue with smelly carpets from previous owners and the complex immediately got us new carpets to accommodate us. They are quick to respond to maintenance needs and always say hello when they see you around. They know everyone by name and make a point to ask about specifics in your life. I have been very impressed with the staff. The apartments themselves are nice. I love the wood burning fire place. My only complaint is that our electric bill is fairly high and utilities in general seem pricey, but that could be due to the top floor on a north west facing apartment. Overall, I would recommend staying in these apartments.

Clean, newly renovated apartment really close to downtown Denver. Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is that they do not have recycling, and refuse to look into it. Sloan's Lake Apartments 100 feet away have recycling facilities. In 2015, recycling should be a priority...
Concordia Apartments made my family feel like we are living in a house instead of an apartment.

Living here has been great! The location of the apartments is in a prime area. Not only is there Clement park and the Raccoon Creek golf course, but there’s just about any store you can think of within 5 minutes away. My experience with the apartment and staff has also been excellent overall. The staff are very accommodating and friendly. Any questions or help I have needed they were more than willing to extend a helping hand. The apartment itself is one of the nicest apartments I’ve ever lived in. The appliances and apartment look well maintained and cared for. I would recommend this apartment complex for any of my family and friends!

Having lived here for three years, this is by far my favorite place. Management is always willing to assist with any questions or concerns. Shout out to the maintenance team for being so on top of following up with anything that needs fixing.

Management was extremely unprofessional when we lived there and never took care of any of our concerns. Our neighbors had the Sheriff’s office there at least twice a month, we were verbally threatened by them and their dog constantly barked. Nothing was ever done with our complaints, despite bringing it to management’s attention that multiple rules were broken on the lease. 

The key card to the pool and fitness facility didn’t work for months, so we were unable to get access to those facilities after hours. We talked to multiple other tenants who had also complained about this. 

When we moved out, we accidentally put Ave instead of Blvd on our new address, so we never got the security deposit back. When I contacted the office, they said they updated it and the check would be re-issued. Four weeks later we still hasn’t received it, so I emailed management again who told me it had already been sent out. We just got the check today and it was printed and mailed 2 days AFTER I had contacted them, meaning it was actually never sent out. 

Needless to say, we wouldn’t recommend living here based on our experience.

The Fairways at Raccoon Creek is an excellent place to live. Management is responsive and the maintenance crews are very knowledgeable and respectful of living arrangements. They are per-friendly (huge bonus). The one downside - cost. Not cheap at all.
I'm living in my 3rd apartment in Fairways and I've been happy in every single one.

I love living at The Fairways at Racoon Creek.  Our apartment has wonderful views, and if I need any maintenance work done from time to time, no problem.  The attention to detail here meets my need for it.  I'm happy at home here.

- Management does not respond to emails or phone calls ever
- Recent shootings, office break-ins, graffiti throughout complex
- Doors throughout complex have broken locks and are never repaired
- No security cameras anywhere; they were removed from some dumb reason
- Management offers gift cards for positive reviews
- Poor snow plowing and de-icing; two people went to the hospital trying to get to their cars in the last storm
- Litter everywhere throughout complex
- Did I mention management NEVER responds to emails or calls?
- Break-in at office resulted in resident financial documents stolen
- Walls are paper thin and you hear EVERYTHING
- Cigarette smokers everywhere with no enforcement of rules
- Stay away
High cost for 1 bedroom apartment and the ski simulator is constantly non-functional

I love this apartment community. They go over and beyond to make sure we are taken care the way we should. When I place a maintenance order, they come right away and do an excellent job. Thank you so much. Livia

Stinky Garbage left out in hallway all the time.Smoking on property in lots of places at various times. Pot smoking inside & outside. Secure, fob magnet doors propped open frequently with rocks, pieces of wood, smushed beer cans , cigarette butts everywhere, dog mess not cleaned up.
The maintenance staff at Westwood Green is extremely professional, quick to respond, and has solved all of our issues immediately. They deserve a 20/10!
You guys dud a great job. The staff is super.

I love this apartment complex for so many reasons, but the noise from surrounding apartments is unbearable. If you have sensitive hearing, I would say avoid avoid avoid. There is absolutely no insulation in the walls or ceilings, so every noise your neighbors make only amplifies the noise. If you can, get an upstairs unit. If you get a downstairs unit, you are completely under the mercy of your upstairs neighbors and unfortunately not everyone is considerate of the fact people live below them. I don’t know about you, but I like to have some peace and quiet in my down time but that’s simply not possible with folks trying to get their 10k steps while stomping above me every single day. For the price, this place is great but if you enjoy your sanity, I’d say look elsewhere.

it’s been great…after my last place this is a definite upgrade. no cockroaches, great air conditioning, and a washer and dryer?!??? how could this be better. i feel safe walking around the complex. overall i love my new place so much and im excited to spend a long time here:)
Its nice! Maintenance is always fast and thorough. No complaints. It’s peaceful and quiet & the neighbors are nice. Round 1 is right across the street! & Close to everything you need! Mountain view!
I've been here for almost 2 years and have not had any issues with the property or neighbors. i love the location and how quiet it is. The only thing that can be a pain is the parking.
Very kind and attentive staff! Maintenance is there for you right away which is not the experience you get at most apartments!’ Pool area is absolutely amazing!!

The Dakota at Governor's Ranch is amazing! The community is peaceful and impeccably maintained with excellent amenities. My apartment is awesome, with a great courtyard view, and I love having easy access to everything nearby. The staff is fantastic and always helpful. It's a wonderful place to live!

I moved in May 2024 and I have had nothing but BAD EXPERIENCES in the last month!! Upon moving in, I was told that the pool would be open by mid June because of being short staffed. It is now July and still no pool... I lived here for one week and TWICE a leasing agent walked into my apartment for no reason- once on Memorial Day when the leasing office was closed and the following Sunday, again when the office was closed. When I asked  the office about this, they told me that this was NOT an employee. ( I later found out that it was) So I was scared to sleep there for the first week, because I thought someone was trying to break in. 
Then I soon realized that my dishwasher was not installed, It was simply placed in the hole in the kitchen. I had to pay someone to install it. About 2 week after moving in, I realized that my AC was running nonstop and not getting cold. I put in a maintenance request and about 10 days later a maintenance man showed up and stayed for 2.5 hours. I thought that my problem was fixed, but it had just begun... As soon as I got home, I turned on the AC only to find that my HEAT was now on when I turned on AC!!! I called the office right away and I was told that no one had been in my apartment. I have cameras so I saw the maintenance man in my apartment!! I have now called the office more than 4x and emailed 3x. NO ONE WILL HELP ME AND ITS OVER 100 degrees in my apartment!! I am beyond upset. I finally bought an AC unit to put in my bedroom just so I can sleep at night. THESE PEOPLE JUST SIMPLY DON'T CARE!!! THIS IS UNBELIEVABLE. I am in the medical field and I rarely complain,but I have never seen such incompetence!! i call almost daily now, and I get no response from anyone in the leasing office.

First impressions tells you everything, and if you forget the second impression is there to remind you.

Kenan answered one email with generic details and answered a couple of questions.  My wife sent 3 follow up emails looking for information and it was radio silence (no one reply or acknowledgment).

My buddy was going to Denver the following week and offered to check the place out.  Here's the second impression.  You will see pictures online of these apartments all updated and honestly pretty nice.  INFACT that's not the case.  They brought my buddy into an apartment that was right out of the late 80's.  Kitchen cabinets were brown (that old dingy brown), draws wouldn't open/close without effort, old medicine cabinets in the bathroom with a bunch of rust, sliders that didn't close tight, and to top it off the unit AC didn't work.

Renters beware.

I just moved in and I absolutely love this property. The staff are all so nice, maintenance is really helpful and on top of work orders, and the community is kept clean. The apartments are a great size and really cozy. You won't make a mistake moving here!

Do not i repeat do not lease at this place. Units have mold and they will tell you it’s not and try to blame it on you. Horrible management and horrible maintenance. Here’s a picture of what to expect. they came to wipe down with bleach and was told the problem was solved. Tried braking my lease and the so called “assistant manager” gave me a quote to end it and never once asked the reason to do it as if he was just trying to get rid of me, when i started addressing my concerns he told me i should have been more persistent (after letting them know 4 times) he rolled his eyes at me the entire conversAtion and had a smirk on his face the entire time and literally made feel like he could care less about my concern or anything i had to say for that matter. No one has ever cleaned out the vents, maintenance takes at least 2-3 weeks. There are better places out there do not waste your time here. If i could add pictures, trust me i would
All apartments are going downhill in the u.s. but at least the Huntington backs up to a park. Location, location, location.
The Huntington is such a nice little complex to live in! The renovated units are so so nice! We are so glad to have found a place here!

Didnt even get to view the apartment because i wasn't in the system but I got a text yesterday morning that my appointment was today at 9am. Called the office and spoke to the so called manager Jonathan and he was extremely rude and talked over me several times for no reason. Im glad i got a sign beforehand. Management needs to surely address this. ????

Lived here for 2 years when we moved out gave them 60 days noticed and did the best cleaning job we could they sent us our final bill and we paid it move out went smoothly then almost a month later they sent us a bill saying we stilled owed them money cause the last month rent was apartently double what they originally told us.

This is really the one of the worst apartment complexes I have lived in. They not only make you split the water payment with the entire building, which would be fine if you didnt also have to pay for laundry in that building. $3.75 for each load. I moved here with The impression that I would have access to a gym and pool.... if you work a day job dont plan on it. They are only open during office hours. 9-6. And halfway through the lease they changed the parking to only permit parking (2 per apartment). Of which there is never any parking at night. Good price, but would not recommend.

I've lived in this apartment since August 2013 and like living here. The staff is friendly and has always been willing to work with me. Sometimes it's taken awhile for them to get maintenance in, but when they come, they get the job done. It's clean. Someone comes around to clean each building everyday. Laundry facilities are convenient and accessible. Sometimes, I can hear neighbors when they're loud, but I never hear daily activities through the walls (people talking at normal levels, etc.) I'm moving to a bigger apartment within the complex. I would recommend living here.

I have lived in this apartment complex since September 2015. As my first apartment, I wasnt expecting much. However I was very disappointed when I discovered what exactly was involved in this place. To begin, my experience was awful. I was tempted to take away my deposit multiple times. They made me and my roommate reschedule our move in date THREE TIMES. They then tried to make us pay almost 1,000 dollars more than originally planned because our move in date got moved after the 25th of the month, when our original schedule was to move in on September 11th. I then negotiated to pay half of the money due at move in and then the other half of the money due on October 1st. When my roommate went to go pick up the key and drop off the money the very man that spoke to me and made the arrangement with me claimed that the agreement never happened, and that I must have misunderstood. After speaking to an office manager I was able to renegotiate the terms, but by then I was incredibly steamed. The parking lot is kept in miserable condition, and finding a spot after midnight (when I get off work) is almost impossible. There have been multiple times that I have been forced to park in Future Resident Parking and having to put a sign in my car begging them not to tow me because I had no other place to park. Maintenance is awful. Me and my roommate complained of a squealing meter from outside the apartment below us, and it took them over a month to get it taken care of. For the past month straight one of the entrance doors has been broken, left swinging open and they have yet to do anything about it. For over a week now there has been motor oil spilled at the entrance of the door and leading up the stairs, which is a massive safety hazard and they have done absolutely nothing to fix it. Also, my roommate went in to get a spare key for our mailbox made, because we lost one, and they completely replaced our lock without our knowledge. They werent planning on telling us at all, I was only able to find out after going to the office and having to wait for almost an hour for somebody to come talk to me. I have also had a package delivered to the office and one of the ladies at the office signed for it but they didnt call me OR my roommate to let us know that the package was received. I would never have known unless I saw who signed the FedEx slip. Overall, I honestly cant wait to get out of here.

Mold, like tons, like hard to breath! It just keeps getting worse. It is waaay beyond the 'mold waiver' they have you sign. Never clean air ducts. If you suffer with allergies, not place for you! Run down 'fluff'. My quality of living not great there. Stuff breaks down constantly, cheaply made. Just not worth it. Please put some money and consideration into the quality of living here instead of just making a fast buck. These are real people  you are renting to, and quality of living is important. You charge a lot of money too for rent. Put it back into the building.

This is a great building that is both close to the city, yet still feels like a suburb. It's a smaller complex which is awesome, and I feel like the staff that work here are excellent at getting back to you quickly and actually getting to know you. The office manager Patty is actually a big part of why I decided to move here. The buildings are secured with key entry, and although the buildings are older, the apartments have all been renovated with brand new appliances. What's also nice about this is that if you aren't home but have someone coming over, they can call you from the keypad which comes to your phone as a call and you can open the door for them without even being here!  Although you can sometimes hear other people while walking down the hall, once you are in your apartment you can not hear your neighbors (or maybe I just have really awesome quiet ones). All the residents are working adults, and I haven't had any issues. One slight problem however, is that there is only enough parking for one resident per apartment, so if you have people coming over they will have to park across the street, which can be pretty busy. All in all, the amenities are great. We have a pool which is never busy, smoking areas, and are close to Broadway, Swedish Medical Center, and lightrails. You can also pay your rent, and request maintenance online which is super convenient! This place is only cat friendly.

Maintenance request Great timing and experienced

 technician 

Thanks

Leasing tour - uncomfortable  Did not enjoy being hit on by the tour guide. Did not enjoy him saying to the other guy in the leasing office "isnt she pretty" and the other guy joining in and also making an uncomfortable comment. As a woman looking to live somewhere alone, I would not have felt comfortable living here. Which is unfortunate because I really liked what the place had to offer otherwise. It was just not very professional and it made me concerned about the dynamic of the management here.

Work was done quickly A work order was put in some time ago, and a person came within a couple days to look at the problem-a light in my kitchen that wasn't working. The guy that looked at it said it wasn't just a dead bulb, but rather, an electrical problem with the light fixture itself, and would need to order a new one. I did not hear anything back after that for a few weeks.

Apparently there was some turnover in maintenance, as a new team showed up to look at it, unaware of the previous maintenance guy's need to order a new fixture. I'm not sure if the order for a new one was ever even put in. Anyway, this new guy, who apparently was only brought on a few days prior to this (mid to late December--I think he said is name was CL?) looked at the problem and said he could fix it without needing to order a new fixture. He comes back 2 days later with the stuff he needed, and him and another guy have the fixture repaired and fresh bulbs put in.

This second guy, again I think he said his name was CL, fixed the problem quickly and didn't have to put in an order for any new parts or fixtures, and explained to me what the problem was and how he was fixing it too. Seems like a good hire--saved money not ordering unnecessary stuff, and fixed the problem in a timely manner.
work was never finished  Put in the work order 11/08/24 got it looked at the next day, said they would order the part on thanksgiving, and now it’s new years and still not ordered or fixed.
Apartment and site tour I enjoyed my tour, loved the apartment and all that Viridian has to offer and I am waiting to hear back on our application to rent.

This is undoubtedly the worst apartment complex that I have ever lived in. I am genuinely writing this as a warning to those looking to rent here. 

There are so many better options in the area. Avoid this one. I'll list details below:

1.The office staff in particular is the worst that I have ever come across. Unprofessional, incompetent, and unresponsive. Try calling them...I guarantee that they won't pickup.

2. Terrible trash setup. The trash chute will pile up and the whole parking garage will consistently smell of hot garbage in the summertime. 

3. The parking garage is abysmal. You are forced to park in their 5 level parking garage. There are no other parking options in the area. The garage is small enough that maneuverability is very difficult. I have personally seen two accidents. Also, they will make you pay a lot of money for a parking space. Many other surrounding apartment complexes have much lower cost for parking. Also, this is a hot spot for cars getting broken into. The complex assumes no responsibility. 

4. The gym is falling apart and children will constantly be running through the weight lifting area. I found it very unsafe. Complaints fall on deaf ears.

5. I've never had so many last minute maintenance emails. You will certainly receive emails stating that "maintenance will be entering your apartment tomorrow." It really is to the point where it feels invasive. 

6. Also, those emails that you get from the complex are also wrong about 1/5 of the time (riddled with typos) and revisions may not be sent until the following day

7. Thinnest walls that I've come across at an apartment. You will hear your neighbors.

8. Your water will be shut off multiple times a year with a warning email being sent out anywhere from 24 hours before up to an hour before the water is shut off for hours at a time

9. The air conditioning is spotty and cuts out during the summertime 

10. Trust me. There's more.


Side note: Once you are in the apartments themselves, they are fine but don't be fooled by a decent looking apartment and a smiling salesperson on the tour. The community is a nightmare.
If you want to park, expect to pay. If you get towed, expect to pay. If you walk out of your building and forget your keys, someone might let you back in or expect to pay.

I've been here 6 months and the front door lock has been broken since I moved in. The mailboxes for my entire apartment have been broken into at one point, water/hot water has been shut off multiple times, and just found out today that there will be no heat this February weekend.

Amenities and the apartments themselves are pretty nice, but it doesn't make up for all the other issues they seem to have.
Park at Canyon Ridge Apartments has refreshing open-planed units that are not enclosed.
I've lived here for a while and the new maintenance and office team are great you can tell they are trying to help people and make this a nicer place to live

When we applied for our apartment we wanted a loft. But they weren’t available. One of the ladies said that we can still apply and then change it when a loft was available. Well that wasn’t the case so we got stuck with a one bedroom apartment instead of the loft. I wish I knew or I would have waited tell we could apply for the loft. Because this was not what we were looking for. Once we got moved in and settled the loft was finally available and they said they would get back to me about maybe doing a transfer. I have yet to get that call or even contacted about the loft. I wish I didn’t get my hopes up to get one of the lofts, but I don’t think that will happen. Not really happy with my experience from the start and should have just looked elsewhere. But I didn’t want to spend money on another application sense it went through for this apartment complex. All and all wouldn’t recommend Park at Canyon Ridge to friends or family because of this experience. I also do not understand why there is a $45 convenience fee to pay on line instead of in cash or with a cashiers check. I would assume that it is more convenient that they get their money right away and not have to wait to put it in the bank themselves. Oh well. Thank you for letting me put in my two cents on the apartment complex.

The entire time at Park at Canyon Ridge go out of their way to make me feel home in this community. Any issues that have come up are handled with care. The front office crew, especially Nikaila, are kind and polite and make sure I am happy with my time living here.
Friendly and helpful staff. Apartment was clean. Love the amenities and how you can pay rent online which makes it super easy and convenient.

I'm unimpressed so far at best, extremely disappointed at worst. Management here is not good, though some staff individually are. They do not care about quality or about engaging their community members. They will not help you when their own stuff breaks. I do not recommend moving here.

THE WORST PLACE I'VE EVER LIVED IN. And I've lived a lot of places.

DO NOT waste your money here. It costs more to live here than what they tell you. This is a nice apartment complex I looked into, they are nice and it appears to be a decent place to live.

I've booked 2 Virtual Tours, and they have done nothing but pretty much ignore me. Nobody answers the Phone, and forwards to a voicemail that has a full inbox, and emails go unanswered.
Not a good first impression at all if you're trying to get people to rent.

Please spend your money somewhere nice.  They don't care, poor customer service and rude.  Leasing office is rarely open, when it is they sit in office with lights off.  They don't answer the phones often.

I have never felt more disgusted living anywhere in my life. Not only are there roaches, but bed bugs and mice too. And management does NOTHING about it. And what’s worse is no matter how clean you keep your apartment, you’ll still have to deal with all of the infestations because nobody else in this complex can keep themselves clean. Despite the constant disinfecting and cleaning of every inch inside this apartment, I’m finding bed bugs on the floor and MICE DROPPINGS IN MY BED. The rodents and bugs are everywhere and you won’t be able to avoid it, no matter how hard you try. And again. Management does nothing to help either. My roommates car was almost stolen and the door handle was ripped off because of this.
