Rent I'd fair, but there are no none smoking restrictions. We have several smokers around our building and management ignores our frustrating.

After apartment shopping for a month and touring over a dozen apartment communities, I fell involve with Adiamo. The grounds were breathtaking and the staff was so warm and inviting. Kim, the leasing specialist, spent time with me showing me all the amenities and floor plans available. Her warm and personable demeanor made me feel like part of the Adiamo family immediately. Thank you Kim and Adiamo!

I have been living here the last year & 3 months, the maintenance is very good, the management very helpful and everything is pretty neat. The only thing is the rent is high and they go up every end of lease. But like they say in my old job you pay for good service and that is the reason I am moving. Thank you Adiamo employees they are very professional.

Adiamo can best be described as a community, not the usual high-density apartment complex.  The management and maintenance staff are friendly and responsive to our needs.  The clubhouse and pool are kept up quite well and the grounds are tended to regularly and well.  Pets are viewed as part of the tenant's family.  I don't know about the other apartments but ours is more like a condo than an apartment.  We have a front entry patio and a side patio accessible from the dining area and the master bedroom.  We have a 2-car attached garage. And most important to me is I have a walk in closet.  We have been here for going on 4 years and have no plans to relocate in the near future.

This is the worst apartment complex in NV. Terrible unresponsive management, rude staff, zero maintenance, unsupervised kids allowed to play in hallways, loose dogs and high fees for nothing. Stay away. Anywhere is better

first year here was fine. second year they proceeded to raise rent and it’s nearly impossible to get out of the lease early if u want. don’t expect any of ur security deposit back either lol. loud neighbors and they don’t care to do anything about it they just want ur money.
The leasing staff have a superiority complex, and laugh at the tenants. The maintenance men are lazy and super creepy. The Manager doesn't treat complaints seriously.

My wife and I have lived her for almost two years. If I didn’t get a promotion taking me across the country we would have stayed for a third.

The apartments are in a great location. A few minutes from both the 215 and 95. A few minutes from the galleria mall. I can get to the strip in less than 35 minutes during rush hour. 25 minutes to be parked at UNLV. An abundance of places to shop and eat nearby. This is a really safe area too. We didn’t have any issues with theft, or shady people hanging out.

The units are nice. All stainless steel finishes and nice faux granite countertops in kitchen and bathrooms. A huge plus is the nest thermostat and HUE lighting. All the bedrooms are a good size and the master tub in our unit was a soaking tub which my wife loved. It is allegedly non-smoking though the people below us smoke on their patio every now and then. 

Most of the people here have pets. The office has a little pet station and a few areas to take the dogs. During non-summer months we walked our dog to the park around the corner. They have tons of doggie bag stations and trash cans to clean up after the dog. They also do a really amazing job of keeping the grounds clean.

We only had one major maintenance issue. Our A/C went out in the dead of summer. They quickly brought us a portable A/C unit and offered to bring one for each room. They fixed the A/C then it broke again a week later, which wasn’t very convenient. That being said, they again brought us the portable unit and they got someone out a few days later to fix it. No problems since. We only saw one bug our two years here and they sprayed the next day.

I have heard that parking can be an issue and for some reason a lot of people park on Quest Park St. but there are easily 50 parking spaces in the east end of the apartment available on any given night.

The theater and clubhouse are great. My wife and I used the clubhouse for a rehearsal dinner and rented the theater for the super bowl, Stanley cup, and to have movie night with our friends. Team in the clubhouse is incredibly accommodating. Ebony and Grace are awesome. Always answer questions (even silly ones) with a smile. They try their damndest to organize community events though turnout is low.

Overall, I am sad to be leaving this apartment. My wife and I have both lived separately all over town before moving in together. I can say this is the best overall place I’ve lived since I was 18.

I’ve lived here for 7 years going on 8! This is not a place I feel I could move from. The management team is 2nd to known and saying they are top notch is an understatement! From Grace, Jessica to Ebony and Alex and his  maintenance team they are all far amazing as proffessionals and individuals. They all make you feel like family and the property actually has a real sense of community! The structure and design is perfect and has something for every style and liking. I’ve been to 9 other properties before I came back here and signed and i haven’t left since despite all the opportunity I had. You must come see for yourself!!!!

Stay away from this horrible, overpriced, disgusting complex. Pools are always closed, BBQ is always broken... annnd this place comes with a Free infestation of scorpions in each apartment. They will call terminex and spray for everything BUT scorpions, been stung, neighbors broke leases because they were stung. Complete idiots manage this place. Bark scorpions can be lethal to small animals and children. They will lie and lie until you sign your lease, then tell you "we are aware of the issue"!!!! STAY CLEAR OF THIS PLACE!!!!!! Spend your rent money in a place you can actually sleep at night.
One thing i can truthfully say is Lynn the manager of these apartments is very helpful and gets things done,very nice and clean apartments as well
Looking for a new place, talked to Jeri and Lynn. Both were very professional, and answered all of my questions. Nice to see customer service is still alive.

Going on my second year here at Solevita. Lynn and Jeri are on top of everything, they're old school and honest. Property is kept clean, maintenance is always there quick if anything needs fixing, and I like the fact that they always go the extra mile on everything. So refreshing. Thank you Solevita. Great teamwork!
I visited out of curiosity, so much hype from my buddies at work- Clean cute cozy condos and the 2 ladies Lynn and Jeri showed me real southern hospitality- Cant wait to call Solevita my home!

Lynn and Jerri were so great.  They listened to what I needed and took action right away.  They made everything so easy and I was in my apartment within a week.  This is the best decision I could have made.  Thanks Lynn and Jerri!!
Jeri and Lynn we're both extremely helpful. They went above and beyond to make me feel welcomed.

We’ve just moved in and I have to say the process has been easy and hassle free. Office staff were always available to answer questions (and I had a lot) and always answered the phone. Our apartment is newly renovated and beautiful, our appliances are great and our dogs love it here. We moved across country and I very nervous about the area and the apartments themselves and my boyfriend and I have been so happy with our decision to live here. I know there are some bad reviews but happy people rarely take the time to write reviews. We highly recommend this complex and although we are new, we’re very pleased. Oh also, we rent a small apartment and most of our neighbors are young adults but we’ve had zero issues with noise, loud music or parties.

Terrible staff with a bad roach problem. Maintenance doesn't speak English either. Office never answered the phone. I had a leaky pipe and they changed it to my rent. Don't make the same mistake. SAVE YOUR MONEY!!!

They will respond to this like they do with the other reviews and no I do not wish to reach out to the staff or go to the office to discuss things. I don’t think it will even matter or if they even care. If management spent more time solving issues instead of responding to reviews I doubt this place would be as bad as it is now. I have lived here for three years and I am surprised just how bad it has gotten in that time.
1.	Cleanliness – This property has roaches, and although there is a pest service the issue is not and has not been solved. They keep coming back. There is dog poop everywhere from tenants not picking up after them. Management has failed here.

2.	Safety- This property has had car break -ins and patio thefts.  NO decent locks on all pool gates. We have asked for an in house security, but all management seems to do is change security agencies and not let the tenants know the new one, again management has failed.

3.	Cost- Management increases the rent every year. They do THAT well.

4.	Noise- There are neighbors that blast music and stomp around upstairs. Management says that they can’t do anything for they have a right to live. What about our right to live in peace and quiet and not have unruly tenants throw their trash about our patio. I feel very sorry for the next tenant that has to live in this apartment.

I will be moving from here in a few months and I am counting the days. I have to rate 1 star because I can’t rate zero stars. If you are considering moving here take my advice DO NOT COME.

Property management can be a lot to deal with. There is a slight pest problem I’ve never had a major roach problem however I’ve had to go to war with ants a few times. The apartments themselves are just ok. But if you’re just looking for a place to live and this suits you then it’s sufficient for living. I’d say there’s worse places to live but if you can do better go for it.

I’m going to start off saying IF YOU HAVE SMALL CHILDREN DON’T RENT!!!! they have very bad pest problems (roaches) they not going to let you know about the pest problems until you rented it out and seen the roaches for yourself. I have 3 small children I’m very upset I just moved in and I still haven’t moved my furniture in due to the roaches. I hope this help someone else

Property Management is rude and don't help with things. Multiple different Neighbors Dogs  on or off a leash have jumped on me and tried to bite me going to get my mail. Thieving Neighbors stole things from my porch when I went out of town for a few days. All around a waste of time and money living decent here. I've had one good conversation with someone recently moving out and lived here for 7 Months. So grateful to be leaving. I hate to complain but Weird people and bad vibes Go somewhere better for your money.
The staff is amazing, they’re very friendly and helpful with my transition to my new home. Thank you :)
From Maintenance to Management my experience here @the edge,  has  been excellent.
The Edge is a great place to live. All the conveniences are at your fingertips. Grocery store, the mall, parks are all easy to get to by public transportation or by car.

The apartments are very nice and spacious. The community is quiet and clean. The leasing team at the front and the maintenance team are all very helpful, nice, and professional. If I have any issues they always fix them as soon as possible. Selena and Meisha and the front always go above and beyond for residents. Andrea on the maintenance team pays close attention to details while working and she is very helpful, and professional.

Te maintenance staff at The Edge have always been prompt in their response to a maintenance issue. Their work has always been well done. The demeanor of the maintenance staff as always been respectful and courteous.
I enjoy living here. I love my spacious apartment.

The apartments look nice and are relatively up-to-date.  Pool area is well kept.  Somehow my floor plan does NOT have an oven, so watch out for that, no one told me before moving in or signing my lease.  The neighbors don't pick up after their dogs and are constantly barking.  Definitely not a peaceful place to live.  You do not get any responses when you message management about it.   Definitely not worth paying for, only good for a temporary space.

My husband and I moved into Elevate, a little over a month ago, and we Absolutely Love it here!!  It's a Great Place to call home! The Amenities here are fabulous: pool, spa, gym, clubhouse...just to name a few. We also want to give a Big Thank-You to the Entire Staff...they are All, Truly Wonderful and Helpful people; and they work hard (as a team) to help make Elevate a Great Place to live!!

The leasing office is not easy to deal with! Lived there for over two years! Could hear every movement my upstairs neighbors made. Dogs parking all day and night! Upon moving I was charged for things I had nothing to do with! I wouldn’t recommend!

Good Morning!  I was waiting for me to move into this apartment complex to complete my review ... I like most who may be reading this message was moving from California (Bay Area) looking for a comfortable place at a fair price and from the first  contacting the leasing agent Xochit was amazing.  She gave me the immediate return, went to the apartment to make videos for me to have a real view of what I was renting, sent me many photos and when I decided to do the application she managed to give me approval in less than 24 hours (this is really amazing  ).  When I decided to sign the contract she received a couple of friends of mine in the apartment complex to once again accompany them to the apartment so that they could tell me without a doubt the size of what I was renting ... Anyway, she managed to do it  this process is usually complex and long as light and quick as possible ... I highly recommend it.  If you live here, in addition to having the most efficient team at your disposal, you will have the best view and one of the newest buildings in the Region.

I decided to take a big move from New York to Nevada. I came quite a few times and visited so many other apartments, and didn’t quite find what I was looking for. Finally I came upon The View at Horizon Ridge. Michael, took me on a tour of the apartment complex, he was very knowledgeable, welcoming and took the time to make sure he was trying to accommodate to the things I was looking for in an apartment, at the same time explained in detail what our apartment was like, from where each room was located to the views I would have from my patio. Michael was beyond helpful, and he answered any question I had without hesitation. He made sure I was taken care of from the initial meeting to the day of move in, to even the questions I had afterwards! The View at Horizon Ride has such great accommodations for its residents including their gym, pool, cabana area and they even have a dog park! The other leasing agents in the office were amazing as well! I’ve been living here for two weeks now, and it was exactly what Michael said it would be and exceeded my expectations! I highly recommend coming here if you’re looking for an apartment to rent!

Awesome place to live. I am definitely renewing my lease. I currently live here and I’ve had nothing but positivity here. It is super quiet 24/7, the neighbors are kind, the office staff are so nice and respectful. Nice outdoor amenities: a cool/warm pool depending on the weather, multiple large flat screen tv’s, electric grills, pool tables, ping pong table beautifully decorated clubhouse, brand new dog park, and etc. Maintenance comes as soon as you call them and they clean the property every morning. Pest control is very consistent even though I never see any bugs. I was the 1st person to move into my apartment and everything was brand new and nicely cleaned. The view is amazing, I am able to see all of Las Vegas including the Strip and Henderson. I also enjoy the weekly events we have, ex: restaurants come to cater, dinner day, milkshake day, waffle bar, and etc. The community is pet friendly and everyone clean up after their pets.

I moved into my apartment back in March and haven’t experienced anything negative. For the most part, I stay to myself and don’t really interact with my neighbors but my interactions with them in passing have always been pleasant. (I saw a review that said the neighbors weren’t nice and I don’t think that should affect the rating of the complex itself) Anyway, the gym and pool are always clean and there’s always water available. I’ve had no issues with having a hard time cleaning build-up from my sink or granite counter tops (maybe because I never let it get that bad in the first place and there’s never any build-up to remove? Lol) I’ve never heard a peep from my neighbors, but I specifically got a top floor apartment for this reason. ( I have only had a complaint on me once from when I was moving in and sliding furniture around. But other than that it’s very peaceful.) The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the parking. If you get home after 8 or have to run to the store later on in the evening, don’t count on being able to park near your apartment building. I’ve had to carry groceries from 3-4 buildings away before because there wasn’t anywhere to park. But besides that, these apartments are wonderful and I have never had an issue here. They have little community events or freebies, they don’t charge a convenience fee to pay rent online with your bank info, my rent has never increased, the water, sewage, and trash fee is pretty much the same as any other decent apartment complex, and nothing has broke down or needed to be replaced.

"Convenience" fee to pay the monthly apartment rent is an average of $50 by credit card and there are tow trucks every night.  Is there ever anyone cleaning the residents' walkways for dog stains?  It's a community with many dogs.  Two residents get 1 key and 1 covered parking space for the high price of rent.  I have not received a phone call back from the regional manager because of the apartment manager for weeks.  Low-grade granite and sink.

First of all this place has the best views of Las Vegas and the property is situated so you are able to see the city lights at all times. My husband and I got an apartment that has amazing views of the lights of Las Vegas and mountains. We had looked at other properties and they had no views but of another unit or parking lot. Marq is a funny and caring person at the front desk. He really genuinely cares about the residents. The maintenance staff I’ve been in contact with are super friendly and our work orders are completed immediately. This place resembles a fancy spa. The decor is exceptional and there are elevators to take to the different floors. It’s a non smoking community so it’s a lot stiff on any type of smoke. So if you like to burn candles, sage or incense you might not like it here. That’s the only drawback. As I have a beautiful porch that faces the city lights and can’t burn sage on my porch and do yoga. A little stiff with rules. Also had a bee problem and my husband and I were in the jacuzzi turned on the jets and over 50 bees started swarming. Marq was really caring about us being upset about it but the manager and maintenance man said it was normal. Which in all honesty I’ve never lived in a complex with that type of situation and been told we were over reacting and it’s normal and I’m 54 and from Tucson. My husband is 51. So overall most of everything is really wonderful and if you can live with a little stringency on no smoking rules and bees. You’re going to love this place.

I have been a resident since 10/2019. My experience living at Imagine, aka Aspire@ Paseo Verde has been comfortable. High 5 to the amazing maintenance staff. Always prompt with my service requests. Regarding tenants, some displayed a sense of entitlement. Remember, we're all RENTERS. I've had experiences with the prior leasing staff and my experiences were always pleasant.  Regarding the new  staff, my experiences were pleasant and the Leasing Manager, Melissa, is a compassionate Leasing Manager.

The management is awful, takes days if not weeks to get a response. Thin flooring. Trash around premises. Grass areas always smells like urine and poop, especially in the Summer. For the price you pay, you can find somewhere way better.
Kids playing at the pool at 11pm at night. Loud music. Disrespectful neighbors. Slamming doors. Yelling. Stomping.

I have flown to NV 3 times to search for the ideal living complex. Problem was, ALL places were identical in design and interior. Most of the complexes were had an older design and all were carpet. After wasting three days in NV I decided to walk across the street (from my hotel) and check out Imagine. I was familiar with Ovation and adored the staff at all their locations. Figured, why not check it out. I fell in love with the temporary feel, the pleasant aroma of sweet berries (yay air fresher!) and the wonderful staff. Since this place is still under construction, I was able to choose WHAT floor plan was ideal to my needs. I explained exactly what I was looking for AND I was shown 4 units. Best part......unlike all the other complexes, the unit you see is the unit you rent! This made my move even more exciting. Nothing is worse then a blind rent. You never know what your place will look like. Or the location. 
I also have a full view of the strip so that makes me feel special. And it gives me a mental boost of, "yup. My view is Vegas, baby!"
The review below, about this being over priced and over looking a bar and car wash is very inaccurate. I know this from staying at the hotel across the street. My room from the hotel faced the car wash so unless your apt has transparent walls (kinky), its unlikely you will see the car wash. Its also nice and quite so YOU can help create and keep this calm environment. 
The price is awesome and also features a special so sometimes you can save! These do rent fast. There were 6 people interested in renting when I walked in last weekend. 
If you are looking for a great place with class, check it out! We might even be neighbors!

My husband and I truly enjoy living here at Imagine!!  

It's a Fabulous hidden treasure...with a comforting feeling of home!! 

Such as...walking through the hallways to each apartment, there are beautiful pictures displayed on the walls...which makes you feel like you're walking through your own personal art gallery. But to fully understand and appreciate what I'm sharing, you must walk it yourself to see. :-)  Also, each floor has it's own special color decor...which adds to the beauty of the art work. 

Imagine also has  many wonderful amenities...Some of which include: Outside decks with Fabulous city views, a heated pool, a spa, an amazing gym, a clubhouse / game room...with amenities of its own, a barbeque area, multiple sitting areas (inside and outside) and some with fire places too.  

Imagine is also in a Great Location...with easy freeway access, places to go and eat, gas stations, grocery stores, coffee shops, etc.

Imagine also has a Great Staff!!  They are very welcoming and kind! They help answer any questions you may have, and if something is in need of fixing, they are quick to help get it fixed.  Overall...Imagine is a Great Place to Call Home!!

For one I needed an apartment complex that had a spacious garage which this definitely does.  I am a bachelor and even though there are families that live here I have a large apartment with a great spacious place.  Tons of room to store all my man cave stuff and the garage was a necessity for me so I would recommend living here any day of the week!

Very disappointed with this place!  Theres a new manager that started and she's unsociable not quite sure what she does. and not like the old manager.  The office closes at 5 now and most times it is closed prior to 5.  There is no communication! rates goes up and the service goes down.  The grounds look awful and nothing ever works. I thought this was a good home to stay at but the short time I've been here is disappointing lately.  Should not be just a number to anyone!

My wife and I moved in June 2018, and we love this place. These apartments feel more like townhouses with the attached garages. The majority have 2 or 4 car garages, which was a deal changer for us since we moved to Vegas from a 3,100 sqft home, so instead of having an apartment and a storage unit, we were able to fit our things comfortably between the apartment (about 1,250 sqft) and garage. Our car still fits in the garage as well, and we haven't had a single dead battery since we've lived here.

The gas stove is great. The other apartments we stayed at had electric stoves, and god were those bad. It's nice to be able to boil water in like 5 or so minutes and not have to wait 20  minutes for it to just start simmering. The dryer is a bit meh. Any cycle that is lower than normal seems to do nothing, but the washer is fine. The tankless water heaters are iffy. They take a little too long to heat the water, and once its heated, it is usually borderline too hot. My wife likes hot showers and doesn't mind this, but when I would come back from the fitness center, I'd want to take a cool shower and this seemed harder to do than it should of been.

Maintenance and office staff are friendly to you even after you move in. One problem we had at the other apartment communities we lived at where the staff trying to exceed your expectations to get you to sign a lease, but once you do sign, they couldn't care what happened to you and wouldn't even return a wave or hello.

The walkscore for this place isn't great, but if you are able to afford these, then you should have some kind of vehicle. Walgreens and Starbucks are probably the only places I'd attempt to walk to from here, but I have a bad knee so take that as you will. These are close to Stephanie St, which has basically everything you need down it. Closest grocery store would be Albertsons, but WinCo is about 1 or 2 minutes further down the road, and a Walmart Grocery store is about a minute away from that. You have just about every major food chain around you (ironically, I think McDonald's is the furthest away from us, maybe a 7-8 minute drive, across from Galleria Mall). You are about the same drive away from your department stores like Kohl's, JC Penny, Target, Walmart (not just the grocery store), CostCo, and more.

Just moved in this past month. Fell in love with One60 during our search. Spacious apartment with upgraded appliance's,  hardwood floors and beautiful kitchen. Attached garage is a great plus. Property Manager Krystine and Riley have been great. We love our new home!

Absolutely have been treated with the best customer service. The staff especially the Property Manager Kristyne makes you feel like you belong. This is home and I was initialed worried because of the construction review. Not sure what that person is talking about. The Manager walks the property all the time making sure everything is well cared for and no issues. Lots of choices out there and i would never choose any place else!

Moving is never easy...finding the right location, the right complex. And when you think you've found it, reading reviews online will put you right back at square 1.  I was so relieved, after days and hours of calling and online research, when I found the One60 apartments.  From the moment I spoke with Krystine in the community office, I had a good feeling I had found my home.  

Not only did Krystine professionally and patiently guide me through the leasing process which she made effortless, she went above and beyond to make sure to work around my schedule and have my apartment ready at a moment's notice if my plans happened to change.

First of all it's worth mentioning this is a brand new community so from the apartments to the community itself everything is clean and fresh, and well, new!  I was pleasantly surprised by the size of the apartments, the quality appliances including gas stoves, and most importantly for me, the fact that each apartment comes with an attached garage is an invaluable luxury for an apartment that really gives you the feeling of "home" and helps make life much easier.  From storage space to keeping the car cool during those brutal summer months, to not having to carry groceries across a parking lot after finally finding an available space, a garage is amazing to have.  

The clubhouse is elegantly designed and offers a beautiful pool, hot tub and BBQ/grill area, as well as an indoor coffee bar and lounge area with a big screen TV, and a gym with brand new workout equipment including treadmills, dumbbells, and a fancy multi-equipment station with cable weights.  

The property is off a very quiet side-street, close to Reunion Trails park,  only a short drive from any type of store, restaurant or bar you could want, and close enough to the expressways to offer quick access to get anywhere.  I also really enjoy the views of the Vegas strip from this area.  

After 2 months here at the One60 community I am very satisfied with my decision to move here and I can see myself here for a long time to come.  The whole staff is amazing, everyone is friendly and helpful.  I appreciate Krystine and Willis' friendly attitude and all the help they have given me from the moment I first spoke with them.  They are truly an asset to the One60 community and help make it the place I am happy to call home.  

I highly recommend the One60 apartments to anyone!

I can't emphasize enough how disappointing and unsafe my experience has been at Dune "Luxury" Apartments. If you value your privacy, security, and peace of mind, STAY AWAY. There is absolutely nothing LUXURY about this place!

Good - The complex is visually nice looking, fairly clean within the property walls/gates, up to date units. 

Bad - can only get ahold of management by physically going into the office. The web portal that you use to pay rent has a messaging area but no response to complaints or questions is ever received via the web portal. Have a problem? You have to go into the office or it won’t be resolved. Also, the parking is garbage. Only one parking pass is given per unit for covered spots yet uncovered spots are very few except for the center of the complex which is far from most units. They’ll tag your car for not having a pass but not blink an eye at a car blocking the EV chargers for days…go figure.

I have been staying here for 14 months.. i am counting the time to move out from here, just waiting my lease date..  The service is terrible, i got problem with dishwasher and they have not fixed it since 1 month.. during this time we have been washing all dishes by hand.. the problem is still there.. and this is just one of the problem i am sharing.. i had many of them.. you just put service request in their system but nobody take care of what you need.. like a nightmare... management is unprofessional.. i went there to talk to property manager but even she was inside, she did not come out to talk and explain.. just sitting there and not taking care of anything. I strongly do not recommend this property.. just be far from this complex.. it does not make any sense to pay that much money for this terrible service providers.. they are not helpers..

If you’re hard working and looking for peaceful quiet place to relax and enjoy at the end of the day, this isn’t it! Living here feels like student housing. The walls are very thin. You will hear noise all around you daily; people yelling, partying, arguing, doors squeaking and slamming. Imagine coming home after a long day and wanting to relax or get some much needed rest. You won’t! Most times it goes on till about 6am. If you have an issue, the office staff will not reply to your emails or letters. They don’t really care, and it’s really sad because the staff can either make or brake a company’s reputation. The manager and staff at this property are getting paid to do pretty much nothing. Parking may be another issue for you because guests park where they’re not permitted, and parking violations aren’t being enforced. Security patrols the property on foot at night. You can call security if you have a problem. However, they’re not much help. For what you get and have to go through, Dune LV apartments are overpriced. The apartment looks nice online, but it’s built cheap. The cabinets are cheap and fall apart easily. The appliances are cheap too. I wouldn’t recommend this property. After a month, you’ll feel cheated and will be ready to leave. Don’t fall for the glitz and glam. It’s just good marketing!

The apartments themselves are modern and well-maintained, and I felt comfortable and at home during my stay. The staff were friendly and professional and always available to answer any questions I had. The amenities were great, with a nice pool and hot tub, and plenty of outdoor seating areas to relax in the sun. Overall, I had a great stay and would highly recommend the Empire Apartments to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Henderson.  I have moved to New Mexico since I have lived in Las Vegas but whomever is currently on the hunt to live at a great apartment complex in Henderson this is the place to move to!

This apartment is a joke. We moved here 2 months ago. Serious problem with roaches, ants  and mice. Staff is very helpful. Assigned parking is always taken. And did I mention unhelpful staff. Very unhappy

Living in the Invitationals is such a relief. If and whenever there's an issue the maintenance men on duty are always available, kind, and gets the job done in a timely manner. Thanks Lorenzo and to the front office. You make living here stress free and relaxing. They keep up the outside appearance quite well also

I've been here almost a year, and looked around for a newer place. After looking at newer complexes with granite and stainless (and more $$, which really didn't bother me), I decided to renew my lease here because I cant afford to lose my peace of mind. The good: It's really quiet here; even with kids and dogs.  I love the arched doorways, and since it's older, the walls are thicker. The rooms are MUCH larger than the newer properties. I had new carpeting, flooring and a new AC when I moved in. I have never had to wait long on any maintenance issues, management is respectful, and pretty much everyone I've encountered says hello and is respectful. The grounds are kept neat and clean (I don't use the pool, but I have a view of it, and it looks clean; folks use it.) Most importantly, it's in an amazing location; right near my job!

The not-so-good: This place is old (1980s is old for Vegas). If you're looking for updates throughout, you won't get it here. It looks like a throwback to the 80s. The only real problem with my unit is the plumbing; it works fine, but when my neighbor take a shower, it's really loud. So I asked myself; do I want to live with loud music, loud neighbors and parties (one complex told me "this was to be expected with a younger crowd"), or do I go home to peace and quiet, but hear a shower for 10-15 minutes every day? I think it depends on your lifestyle; I'm over 50, and I'll keep the peace and quiet.

Just moved into the invitational! Great move in experience, staff are great. Minor issue with apt. Washer did not fit in washer room, preventing door closing, until maintenance resolved the issue. Some minor existing carpet stains, no biggie.

Looking for a great place to call home? Well the Invitational is the home for you. The property is very well kept and recently has a fresh paint job. Located behind a beautiful golf course it's the place for you. Friendly staff will always make you feel right at home.

My lady and I have been living here for over a year. Property is well kept and low key for its location. Most units have been upgraded and more are being transformed. It is deffiently worth the price for peace of mind.

No pool 
Dirty gym only open during office hours
Expensive for what you’re paying!

I've been in my unit two years, and I am very happy with it. I have no bugs, but I'm such a clean person that I maintain my space well. I have access to the gym when I need it, which is 9am to 5pm. The recreational center is very nice. It has a gym, game room, and place to host a party. The landlord allows people to have one parking pass per household. Then there are spaces for visitors to park. My only concerns about the complex have nothing to do with the current landlord or how the property is managed. I'm grateful for my home.

Management changes alot on this property, They are very nice but have recently became bug infested, The people who live here smoke on premises and this is supposed to be a "NON" smoking apartment.  The bums hangout on property.  Its not the greatest but the rent is within my budget.  Maintenance is okay, whenever they get to you hold your breath!  Otherwise, if you like the dumpster over flowing with trash and the pool never opens nor fitness center then come here.

Gates are constantly breaking and the side gate is open to the public all day . Gym and pool are never open. Office is closed weekends and for two hours everyday. Open trash is being left everywhere in the stairs in the street next to cars literally smells like trash all the time. Sinks, toilets and shower are always breaking. Mold and bugs are everywhere. Oh and there aren’t enough parking spots for everyone!! Lastly the new staff will literally talk poorly about the tenants in front of everyone !

If you love a "non-smoking" community that constantly stinks of garbage and cigarette smoke, then this is the place for you. The dumpsters are overloaded, the tenants are extremely loud, the sidewalks are full of trash/animal waste, and the office rarely answers the phone! I literally hold my breath and tip toe around when I need to go outside, some areas are beyond disgusting and minimal effort is made to make things better. The rent and square footage ratio aren't terrible given present economy, but I cannot wait to get my family out of this place! If you don't mind unhygienic conditions and crazy excessive noise at all hours of the day, then inquire today! :D

I highly suggest looking elsewhere especially if you have children. Although it is a gated community and residents are required to get background checked, it is NOT SAFE at all. I was shot at while walking my dog across from the neighborhood and was unable to get out of my lease so had to live in fear for almost a year. There's always suspicious people jumping over walls, walking around at night, and just swarmed with criminals, drugs, and gang activity. Theres no where for kids to play which is extremely dangerous considering the community has small parking lots. Dogs are always off their leashes. The leasing office personnel are incredibly incompetent and unprofessional. They don't want to help you and are impossible to get a hold of unless you track them down in the office. Yet, they somehow manage to harrass you with monthly "mandatory" inspections with little notice.  Their notices that are stuck in your door read urgency even when it's accued by their mistakes. Rent amounts changes, or they somehow miscalculated your move in fees so you immediately owe them money three mos prior to the lease ending, with no explanation. When I moved in I had just graduated college and was in transition from half time work to my career, with very little money.  I'm a professional and was treated by office staff as if I were a criminal. I received lease violation notices making several invalid accusations. I  was spoken to disrespectfully and none of my concerns were ever handled by the leasing office. Leasing staff is constantly changing, so if you call and they actually decide to answer the phone, they "don't know" and tell you to call their property manager.  

I do NOT recommend signing up to live there!! You will be stuck in a year lease, and will be miserable. They will harrass you on a monthly basis, yet when you need something you can't get a hold of them. Living there was a joke!! I'd give the property a half star  rating if that were an option.
Splendid customer service all around and welcoming staff. The maintenance service is amazing because they tend to our apartment needs in a flash.

Significantly raised the rent on my lease after only 1 year living here, even significantly higher than what they would agree to with a new resident (not even counting current concessions). Many amenities that you think you're paying for frequently don't work or are unreliable. There is trash and litter all over that does not get picked up. And I've had a hard time receiving reliable maintenance service. There are good people who work here, but to me it seems the company that manages Evolve does not value it's current residents.

Kudos to the maintenance crew who promptly attends to our service requests and fixes any issue in our unit. Furthermore, the proper managers/office workers are polite and attentive with your needs. Hopefully they continue their work ethics and excellence!
I love this place. I moved in about a year ago. The neighborhood is beautifully manicured and well kept. My neighbors are friendly and so is the staff. The amenities are wonderful.

The Management Office will tell you anything to sign the lease and will do nothing afterwards unless you pester them to death. Even then you will be lucky to get someone to fix it.
Sold us on a “luxury move in ready apartment” with Smart Rent…
Told us to come a later date after our move in day due to “cleaning.” Our first day, we had to scrap black tar off of our 1 year old son from him crawling around on the floor. Stains from previous tenant were everywhere in our kitchen. They say they can’t install Smart Rent they promised us because the vendor won’t reply. 
Totally feel taken advantage of….

I lived here for 2 years. New management isn’t friendly and put unrealistic restrictions on amenities. 

Apartment common areas boast of lot of bells and whistles you won’t be able to use regularly for security or maintenance reasons.

They charged me for pet damage carpet when I never had a pet . I also looked at all the reviews and I’m not the only one who experienced the same problem with him about cost about them ripping out the carpet and saying they had damage and they had to charge a pass tent a thousand dollars for the carpet

My fiance, kids, and I lived here for 2 years and it was the best complex we’ve ever lived at. Maintenance takes care of things almost immediately. Christina is the kindest lady I’ve ever met and she goes above and beyond for her residents. Literally the only reason we left was because we got a house. Would recommend leasing here.
I’ve lived at Ventana Canyon for over 3 years now and have absolutely no complaints.. Management super friendly. Maintenance always on point. Great for small dogs.
Poor construction, you can hear and smell everything your neighbors do.  Small parking spots. And the office staff are RIDICULOUSLY RUDE! Not worth the money

I've never been so appalled at my living situation. At first it was going really well but then the property was bought out by another investor. However, that individual has never set foot on the property. The new owner fired the great maintenance guys that worked on the property. He hired incompetent individuals who do not even know how to do their job. It was an absolute embarrassment. I refused to let family or friends visit me because of the situation. Also, there was a fire ant, cockroach, and spider infestation in our apartment. Once again the office did nothing. They claimed they never saw any of these issues but that is because they never left their pretty offices to actually look for themselves. I was also appalled by the number of times the police were called into the complex. I never felt safe there. We also know that several drug dealers live on property given the amount of marijuana that is smelled on property. So if you have a family or pets, I would definitely not recommend living here. The rent goes up dramatically every time you want to renew your lease. We renewed once and it was a complete nightmare. My husband and I were tired of hearing loud music, cars driven really fast around the parking areas, and the random loiterers around the property. After reading several of the other comments, I have come to realize that many of them are definitely made by the staff in order to make the apartment complex more appealing. IT IS NOT! I have several pictures that I took of all of the infestations and the injuries it caused to many people. Furthermore, after not renewing our lease anymore, the apartment complex will come after you for superficial damages that don't exist. Overall, there are bugs, loud noises and the office does not care at all.

When we first got our apartment, my wife and I were ecstatic. After the first four months, it became a nightmare. Every time our lease was up they raised our rent a minimum of $100 claiming "market changes." The apartment complex was bought out by a foreign investor, who had our apartment inspected 3 times in one week! They also fired all of the qualified maintenance employees, and hired a bunch of high school kids, now all the maintenance employees do is drive around the complex too fast in a golf cart and repair nothing. The apartment complex has a terrifying pest problem. My apartment had a spider infestation in the ceiling above the apartment with visible webs above the entrance to the apartment. We told the office and there was no response. We also had alive and dead cockroaches all over our poach and outdoor patio. We told the office again and no response again. Then the apartment complex developed a fire ant infestation. The infestation has already grown tremendously.  My wife was bitten all over her ankle, my puppy was bitten on his paw, and I was bitten all over my left ankle. My ankle swelled up to four times its normal size. I was unable to work for about two weeks. I went into the office and reported it. The staff acted concerned and then later told me the didn't find any fire ants. So they never did anything about the infestation, they just said they talked to their "bug" guy. The next day a gentleman approaches me by my car, and says he is the "bug" guy. That my complaints about him, are causing him trouble. Apparently him doing any of his job is "trouble."

I would not recommend this place to anyone! If you have small children and small pets, I would definitely stay away because of the horrific fire ant infestation.

I wish I could post the pictures I took of all of the bugs and my swollen ankle so people could see how bad it truly was.

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review: Definitely won’t be renewing. New renters beware management is rude and no matter how loyal of a tenant you are they are not willing to listen to you. They increase the rent every year without any upgrades on top of the pool that you’re paying for monthly to never be opened. Maintenance takes forever to get stuff done. These people moved out weeks ago and they are letting this trash just sit here stinking up the building but they demand so much money?? You can take the same dollar and get better living services at one of the apartments buildings across the street. You’ll get a pool in this 110+ weather no roaches and a relatable leasing office. You guys should really treat your tenants better

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review: I have lived here for almost 13 years. They have changed management at least 3 or 4 times in those years. NEVER are we told there is a new team there. Also, the past 12 years have had the absolute BEST pest control........until they went and changed this past year. It's definitely a DOWN grade. They should have never got rid of such an excellent service and will be expected to have a lot of bugs this coming summer for sure. Also, the new pest service (which I think is just the complexes staff) doesn't use pet safe products.

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review: Velvet and Lilly saved us !!! They made sure we got into our home!! Their professional attitude and kindness made things flawless. Maintenance has met our every need in a timely manner, friendly and helpful. I highly suggest moving to this community.

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review: Entire grounds are covered in ants. I woke up covered in ants couple nights ago, after asking repeatedly for them to spray my apartment and sending them a video of the ants swarming the sidewalk in front of my apartment. They charge you for all kinds of things that they shouldn’t. For example, you have to pay for the electricity use in the front office. You are not allowed to bring visitors to the pool, unless if you pay an extra fee. Maintenance frequently takes forever to respond to serious requests. Homeless people frequently digging through the trash, because it took them forever to fix the gates. Instead of communicating when they are unable to fulfill a maintenance request, they just submit that it has been completed. This has happened to me at least five times since I moved in in September. Don’t even think about moving in if you like it cold at night. The thermostat will not cool the place to less than 69°. I also had to call the police one time, because there was a gunshot literally outside of my window

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review:
Renter Beware

This complex is, at best, a ‘pig with lipstick’ on it.

Interactions with the staff while setting up a lease and living across the country. I arrived to find:
*Leasing staff lied about the condition of dog park
*Leasing staff lied about terms of lease
*Property Manager always ‘unavailable’
*Leasing staff made multiple errors on initial lease
*Leasing staff was unorganized and unprofessional; often requesting the same documents and information multiple times.
*Leasing staff admitted she was new and left alone w/o management supervision or assistance. 

Now let’s talk about the complex:
*Landscaping is almost entirely dead around the complex, and it’s obvious they aren’t making an effort to fix it
*Neighbors have already ripped open and taken the contents of SEVEN packages in less than 24 hours 
*Construction in various forms surrounds the entire complex (roadwork and new housing developments)

And finally the unit:
*The bathrooms are so small that you will struggle if you are over 6’ tall. These were not designed well, at all.
*Tons of issues with creaky drawers, loose baseboards/doorframes
*Very obviously not cleaned beforehand
*Water damage and mold build up surrounding both bathroom showers

I was incredibly careful not to sign online, as it contained errors. I was assured that this wouldn’t be a problem, and even requested to sign a copy in person (only after viewing the unit). The leasing office has zero idea what they are doing, so instead of my lease being processed correctly - it was entered in with  lease terms that I did not request. 

I’ve met and interacted with several neighbors whom have all shared horror stories about the management staff’s inability to take care of the basics - which is never a good thing to hear. Even the local grocery staff warned me about moving in to this particular complex after mentioning I moved here.

Looking at this complex and thinking of moving to Nevada from out-of-state? Don’t.

Looking at this complex in the area? Just take a drive by and you’ll quickly see you’ve made a mistake.

apartmentName: The Bristol at Sunset Apartment Homes
review:
THEY GET TO CHARGE YOU FOR THINGS ON YOUR OWN PROPERTY WHEN "THEY" NEED RECEIVED A NOTICE ON MY DOOR TODAY 3-7-18 ALL ITEMS ON PATIOS AND PORCHES NEED TO BE MOVED SO THEY CAN PAINT. IT DOES NOT MATTER WHAT IS GOING ON IN OUR LIVES. MOVE IT OR GET FINED $350.00??? WHERE DOES IT SAY YOU ARE ALLOWED TO CHARGE US A WHOLE $350 IF WE DO NOT MOVE "OUR OWN THINGS" FROM "OUR OWN PATIOS AND PORCHES". 
WHAT TO EXPECT IF YOU DECIDE TO MOVE HERE.THIS IS A THREAT IF I EVER SAW ONE AND I AM PRETTY SURE THEY FORGOT THE WORD "NOT".

I loved my time here! Madison at Green Valley is in a nice location within Henderson, and the staff was always extremely nice and diligent with helping me. I would gladly recommend living at Madison at Green Valley!

Madison at Green Valley is amazing complex! Such awesome amenities and responsive management. We had been living here for past two years and we are very happy with our 2 bedroom spacious appartment. There is so much light in it and with a huge living room. I will give special 5 star rating  to Juri, she is amazing person, always ready to help with any type of maintenance, or any question you may have. Neighborhood is awesome and neighbors are super nice people. I would recommend Madison complex to everyone including my friends and family.

I have lived at the Pines for 4 years and have loved it. The apartment managers, Scott and Sherri, are very friendly and helpful. I have only had one maintenance problem in the last 4 years, (air conditioner) and it was fixed in about 2-3 hours. I highly recommend this apartment complex.

We have been here for nearly 2 years. We moved blind from NYC and management helped us get situated, providing information needed about the area, etc.
Rules here are not unreasonable as they provide a safe, quiet, and peaceful living environment.
Whenever a rule was overlooked we got a friendly non-confrontational notice. I honestly dont understand some of the reviews here.
When maintenance was needed we got notification they received our request then followed up again that very day to arrange maintenance.

THE POOL:
is never crowded, with plenty of quiet relaxing lounging. tables, chairs, and lounge chairs. Tree placement means having a choice whether you want to sit in the sun or shade. It could use a vending machine for soda/water but I can bring that from home so its not really a complaint.

The Gym:
is modest but serves it purpose perfectly. Equipment is clean and the few people I have seen inside when Im there wipe down machines with clorox wipes leaving a healthy workout environment

Mail:
Since we have been here the mail boxes have been reinforced with a metal frame keeping our mail safe. one review said the mailboxes had been broken. I can attest that this has been rectified as the frame is sturdy.

My wife and I were only going to spend a year here before renting a house elsewhere but we are too comfortable and happy here to roll the dice anywhere else.
There is no reason to move elsewhere with what we have here.

Very clean, spacious 1 bedroom apartment. Enjoyed my time here. Sherri and Scott do an excellent job managing and maintaining the property. Also, any maintenance requests were handled in a very timely manner!

The Pines is located along a paved recreational trail and minutes from I-215 in beautiful Green Valley. The property is managed by Sherri and Scott who lend a caring personal touch to all interactions. They keep the apartment complex clean and safe, as well as updated. I lived at The Pines for four years and enjoyed every minute and you will too!
We have been here almost a year and we love it. Management is strict but that's good. The place is always clean safe and quiet. Apartment is very comfortable large bedroom very reasonably priced.
I have lived here for 8 years. I love the location, it's spacious, nice and safe. The  management does a great job.
Good news Good maintenance crew and the environment is beautiful new & improved
Very nice and quite. All of the staff have been very nice. When we call for service it is done right away.

Not only do they charge a deposit but will also charge a NON refundable $500 deposit on top of that based upon the lowest credit score possible. Since we just moved to the area and did not have the luxury of looking very long, we applied thinking our credit was good enough not to have the extra charge. We put $100 down to hold the apartment which we would have lost if we didn't accept the extra charge for a ridiculously low credit score that came from nowhere since we keep track of ours. But again, no time or an extra $100 to lose, so signed since it seemed a nice apartment. 
Little did we know but the insulation between floors is NON existent! We asked who lives above and was assured a quiet older lady lived above. We have kids and would not move to a top floor out of respect for our neighbors. Well, the so called "quiet" older lady walks around day and night since she is obviously retired and likes to walk around in heels like a drunk monkey at ALL hours of the day and night...sometimes at 3 and 4 in the morning. And it is not only a single lady. There are two or three others up there and a dog whom it sounds like they play ball with inside as well. Been here over a month and have NOT had a good night's sleep since. The kids stare at the ceiling with a worried look on their faces; likely thinking the ceiling is going to cave in. Granted, it's been a while since living in an apartment but I KNOW I have never dealt with this level of noise!! Obviously this place is poorly built and it makes you worry about the possibility of a fire breaking out and just tearing it's way through an uninsulated building.
We are not the only ones in the complex complaining either. The turn-over is high. There are people constantly moving out and I wish I would have talked to another tenant before moving in here. 
So be warned. You will be miserable. Whether up or downstairs. Horrible noise from above or neighbors complaining below. Not sure which is worse or less stressful. If we had the money to move, we would. Now just saving up to get out when the lease is up.
Again...find a better place and talk to other tenants before moving in. It is expensive, time consuming and back breaking to move in and out. Not something I'd ever recommend.

I was rented an apartment that I was told was going to be remodeled soon - that was a year ago.
Now they are renovating the pool area in the middle of summer, with no regard to those with kids that use it daily - who does that?
There are residents here that can't get their trash in the bins, don't pick up after their pets, not to mention breeds that aren't allowed and not on leash, and let their kids play in the parking lot, when there are play areas and a park 2 blocks down the street, don't have the courtesy to turn down their car stereos when the pull into the complex and don't observe the speed limit.  I could go on and on, but I think you get the idea.   The managers at site are very nice, but their hands are tied by upper management and new owners.
There is not enough room here to list all the things that were wrong with my apartment, not to mention I paid a $200 cleaning fee and it was not clean.
My apartment is a good apartment just cost too much

I moved into a one bed one bath apartment at Cielo Apartments and honestly I must say I do love it thus far.  I love the vaulted ceilings they have in my place and its a really nice community.  I have made great friends here so far and I have nothing but great things to say about the complex!

The amenities at Cielo Henderson are also top-notch. From the sparkling pool and hot tub to the state-of-the-art fitness center, there is truly something for everyone here. I was also impressed by the ample parking and the well-maintained grounds, which really make the whole complex feel like a welcoming community

I recently had the pleasure of visiting the Cielo Henderson Apartments, and I have to say that I was thoroughly impressed with what I saw. From the moment I arrived, I was struck by the modern and stylish exterior of the building, which sets a great tone for what you'll find inside.
I love how they remodeled the complex's clubhouse recently it was so nice to see definitely love that about Cielo they are always on top of what needs to get done its such a pleasure living here!
I moved in about a little less than a year ago with my fiance and we absolutely love the community we couldn't ask for a better place to live highly would recommend!

I’m a current resident at Cielo.. I’m very happy with my unit now. There were a few issues upon move in, but, Felicia the property manager has really gone above and beyond to help me get everything fixed, promptly. I’m truly grateful she is here.The clubhouse remodel looks very nice as well and the grounds are always kept very clean! I hardly hear my neighbors here. It’s very quiet in the evening hours and feels very safe, which I like very much. The current residents around my building are very nice and seem to be respectful. For apartment living, I have to say, I’m pretty happy overall. I would definitely recommend.. A big thanks to the office staff and maintenance crew for keeping everything running smoothly.

My husband and I have lived here since 2016. This was one of the few communities that was affordable and had many amenities that we were looking for.  Beautiful grounds, pools, decent apartment space. 

We recently moved from a 1 bedroom to a 2 bedroom and the difference in square footage is amazing.  I really love coming home each day and interacting with the new staff has been a blessing.

Cielo apartments have been one of the best living experiences I've ever had.  Never had any problem with pests, you can barely hear your neighbors, and the maintenance staff are top notch! The front office staff,  made the process simple to move in, took a tour one day and moved in the next. I'm so happy that I chose this spot, if you are looking at a place to live you have to take a tour here, you will not be disappointed!

Jon S. Dec 2016

I recently moved to Henderson from out of the area. The Cielo Apartments came highly recommended to me by a prior four-year resident for the location and amenities. 

Management:
The management and staff have been friendly and helpful. They have gone out of their way to make me feel welcome and to address any concerns that I have had.

Security:
The exterior of the complex including the parking lot is well lit. Additionally, my unit is equipped with a security alarm. 

Maintenance:
The grounds are clean and well maintained, and garbage service is frequent. Dogs are allowed in the common areas such as lawns and they too are well maintained. Everything in my apartment is clean and in excellent working order. 

Life:
This complex is for the most part quiet. The residents have been respectful and helpful to me since I have lived here. I would highly recommend this apartment complex. It is conveniently located near several shopping centers and the 215.

I've been living at Cielo for about 3 years now and love this complex. The office staff are always friendly and helpful. My neighbors are long term renters, great people   quiet! Maintenance does a great job taking care of the property. To date I have not had any apartment repair issues.

They rent out short leases and that bring in people who don't care about the place. The front office is cynical and non-empathetic bc the turn-over is so constant they have become desensitized. My next door neighbors are a bunch of young traveling sales men who are only here for a couple of months. The management office bent the rules & allowed very large German Shepard in. They haven't been picking up after him and leave him unattended on their patio (on the first floor). The other apartment by me just evicted the tenants after 2/3 months due to violent behavior and never-ending cops showing up.We had to put security guards on our windows and sliding glass doors. I renewed my 14 month lease has asked them to provide me with a closer covered spot. I walk past an entire building and down half the block to get to my spot with a 3 yr old & groceries. I can park closer in an uncovered guest spot but during the summer I have to choose between walking in 120 heat to the covered spot or leaving the car in an uncovered spot. I'm not trying to be a diva here. When your son is crying because the seat buckles are so hot they can fry an egg and I'm carrying 4 bags of stuff ...it sucks!! I thought I had a compelling reason but every time I go to discuss it they have brushed me off and said I asked too late, all the spots are assigned to residents. I asked them to let me know if that spot or something similar can be made available to me when it becomes unassigned again. Finally after the fifth time they finally stopped evading and told me it was never going to happen. Here were the reasons they gave me: 1. It's a rule we never break. If we do it for you then we have to do it for everyone. BUT at the same time they say that no one by me has ever asked for a parking swap in the history of the apartment complex. 2. The parking was assigned before any of the managers worked there but was decided by a "parking expert" so therefore, my issue with my covered spot can't be valid bc this unknown expert knows better. 3. It's on the lease so I need to deal with it and if I left it wouldn't matter because they have a waiting list and I'm only upset bc "I didn't get my way"  & not because I'm looking at another summer where I have to deal with this parking hassle. The more you implore them to treat you as a loyal tenant...the more insulted you get and the more they remind you that you are replaceable.

We needed to relocate to the Las Vegas area and quickly. I made the polygon that I wanted to live in and Cielo apartments was the first of three properties we looked at.  They were the first we looked at. We loved that the community was gated and had gas appliances. On apartments.com it did not indicate the apartments had a dishwasher but I let the Cielo staff know this in case someone uses that filter. The staff was super friendly and we put down a deposit and were able to move in at the end of May. Once moved in we did notice that some things needed to be fixed (tear in the sliding door screen, bedroom door off the hinge, electrical outlets defective).The dishwasher for example took two weeks which is why I gave 4 stars. We did get a new dishwasher installed but serveral of the things could have been done before move in. We love the area and the staff has been amazing. Good start for relocating.
The apartment and community is very nice and quite. 10/10 would live here again.

there is no luxcery in these appartments only missery cant get my floors replaced after 5 and half years of living here . we are both 75 years old and cant afort to move again both money and physical to hard  . rthe rent went up bat not the improve ments always fitting for everything with the manager she is not a people person and not fit to manage anything  the rent is 1059.00 dsollers keeps going up thats wy we have to make a 14 month lease . ok thats about it i hope we dont have to stay here much longer  .

I have lived in a lot of apartments in the last thirty years, but none I have loved as much as Cielo in Henderson, NV.

The management staff is both kind and helpful. They even went so far as to resurface the sinks before we moved in because the previous tenants had scratched them.

The carpeting was new, and all of the windows had screens without holes. I know those should go without saying, but based on my experience it bears pointing out. Turnaround time on small work orders, and pest control are the smallest I've seen. I cannot comment on large work orders simply because I have not had any. On the topic  of pest control, it has not been a problem, but this being a desert in the summer there are some bugs to be expected.

This gated community and my friendly neighbors make for a very peaceful home. Even the children in the area are polite and really not loud. The people even clean up after their dogs.

All in all, I would highly recommend Cielo in Henderson, NV to anyone.
Its got  two pools, plenty of parking and very centrally located. Great for all ages.
big dogs bark, day and night. so many time a day. Seems to live in the countryside and owners don't care. and Management is slow and doesn't keep promises. Poor for the price

I was forced to renew my lease way before it ended, with the stipulations of $100 more a month staring within a few days. After, signing my lease I found out that my mother in-law became ill with stage 3 breast cancer regarding my 5 month pregnant wife and 1year old daughter would relocate back East coast for the final moments with my mother in law. I then came back to management asking for a new ending terms on my lease 24 days after my lease was signed. I was then told the contract could not be voided and I had to either stay in my apartment for a whole year or pay out two months rent and current rent. Another nice little perk - you have a small yet quite modern shopping complex literally walking distance down the street, with an Albertson's, various food establishments, a dentist, haircut place, etc.. I've lived at RP for about 6 months now - first of all, the grounds are very well kept & the buildings are really gorgeous. You can catch some nice sunrises from the patios/balconies the units have. Onto the unit itself, my appliances look brand new and work without problems. When I moved in, the garbage disposal was broken & within hours of me submitting the request, the maintainance guys (who were so nice & worked quickly) fixed it and I've had no issues since. 

A great mix of folks live here (as you can expect of Las Vegas). Lots of cute dogs, small families, young professionals, etc. Most everyone is quiet and keeps to themselves. Parking is very good & you get a covered spot with your unit which is great. No bug problems, trash is picked up regularly, folks typically clean up after their dogs, and noise is generally very low. 

Onto the biggest reason you should give RP a chance - the office staff. I had a very serious noise problem with a neighbor that was disrupting my work (I work from home) and keeping me up at night. This neighbor would blast music into my apartment almost constantly & it was making me miserable. The first time I called in to complain, the office staff gave me clear instructions on what to do & told me to "hang in there." I followed their instructions, documented the noise, and while it certainly felt awkward continuously bothering busy people with my complaints, they had my back. In the end, they ended up evicting the neighbor for the noise violations & kept me in the know and informed the whole time. Eyleen, Jonathan, & Brenda are professionals & understand how important peace & quiet in someone's home is. They went the full mile in answering this issue, and that is rare to find in apartment management!

Other notes - the location is PERFECT. You are a hop and a skip from the Strip, but far enough away to where its problems don't make it out here. Tropicana Ave. can take you all the way to Summerlin or to the airport in 15 minutes tops even during rush hour. CC/I-215 and I-15 are both close, but not too close. The complex is gated & patrolled nightly by guards, which keeps things much safer than other places in Spring Valley.
