The Avondale Apartments do not offer automatic rent payments. What they do instead, is let you go online and manually enter how much you want to pay for NEXT MONTH'S rent. Yup, not this month's rent. Next month's.

Okay, that's not TOO weird. It's the same amount every month anyways, right? NOPE!

Because they include water, sewer, trash, HoA fees, and all sorts of other taxes into your rent total. But those numbers change every month based on usage. Usage of services you haven't used yet, because this is the cost for NEXT MONTH.

So you have to guess.

Now, if you over-guess, they do credit your account. But what happens if you under-guess? Well then you have to go back in and do a manual payment for the difference. But wait! There's more! Every single charge (the initial guess and the "haha got you!" followup payment) incurs a PAYMENT FEE.

So your choice is to over-guess by a wide margin, giving them more money than you owe and constantly piling up credits which only cause you to over-guess by more the next month... or you under-guess and double/triple pay the ridiculous "payment fee".

Also the kitchen counters are small, cabinet space is limited, and the nearest pool's water has been straight-up brown for over a month now.

are we safe in this community?where are the security?first day in this apartment they broke my door,they took all my valuable things 55" 4k ultra tv,ps4,mac,jewelries,collection watches,collection sunglasses,cash etc....where is the 24 hours maintenance?me & my wife didn't sleep the whole night watching my kids,they are so scared.i am waiting the maintenance to fix that door but nobody shows up

New management of Avondale is not as good as previous Camden.  Avondale is not customer friendly .   They want to make quick money with the tenants without the service.  Also watch the utilities which will cost you about 20 percent of your rent.

The community looks nice, three pools and three hot tubs, Great location, good prices. However, in the middle of our lease Camden Del Mar sold to now what is the Avondale apartments, I feel the staff is the same as it was before, not very attentive to your needs once you're in, before you sign a lease they tell you all this great stuff but don't follow through. The parking spaces are horrible, if you happen to get one that is next to an open space good luck trying to keep their car from getting dented her hit. The non-residents don't care about how they park how close they are to you. I went into the office to try to get a different parking spot but they were not accommodate me whatsoever. The price is good for what you get, but after a year lease is up we won't be living here anymore.

I rented in this community for only a year.  Contrary to some of the reviews below, I found the staff to be incompetent, unresponsive and very unfriendly.  Despite it's location, the community itself is ridden with crime with multiple apartment break-in's throughout the year.  The apartments are dumpy for what you pay for.  You can rent down the street in a much nicer complex for less $$$.  I would never recommend this management company to anyone.

I have lived at this location for 8 months... Great community with RUDE staff. If you do not mind that, it is in a great location close to shopping and restaurants. Very calm and inviting atmosphere with well kept grounds. (HOA Fee $14) Use of the Peccole Ranch park area is a plus however Charleston is a BUSY street and there have been some horrible accidents right out side the complex, so keep pets and children close. The 3 pools through out the complex are kept very clean and busy. New paint to the outside of the buildings is in progress and parking assault was just completed so it looks shiny and new (More modern feel)

I just signed my 6th year lease with Camden Del Mar.  I love living here.  The staff our so nice and friendly, the maintenance guys are at your apt. within the hour when putting a request on line. Great location, beautiful grounds well maintained, access to anything you might need. Management throws BBQ's for the residents, and many other little treats. Quiet, lovely place to call home. Upscale cozy apts..roomy and nice. Highly recommend.
Lauren Jones   Las Vegas

We have lived here since April 2015. My husband recently retired from the military so we are definitely not strangers when it comes to apartment living.  This is the best we have ever lived in.  The pools, gym, racquetball and tennis courts are all beautiful and well maintained.  The apartment is beautiful and nicely updated with new flooring, carpet, granite and stainless steel.  It has a roman size bathtub that could fit 4 adults!  It's quiet here.  There are also walking trails out the back of the property that are absolutely gorgeous and we'll maintained.  The office staff are always kind, compassionate and helpful.  Maintenance responds quickly.  It's in an upscale area with close walking distance to groceries, home depot, Target, restaurants.  It's absolutely amazing here.  We feel like we live in paradise, like we're secretly on vacation forever!!

Granite counter tops. Arched hallways. The perfect 2/2 apartment floor plan. Polite and professional staff. Pay your rent online. Covered parking. Beautiful amenities. The buildings in the gates complex are all getting a fresh coat of paint with an updated color scheme. All high end appliances. Pet friendly. In the year we have lived there, we have had our share of disasters. Water leak from floor above followed a week later by a leaking water heater in our apartment. Appliances have failed: microwave, toilet, dishwasher, disposal. Each disaster was a priority for management to address. Rather than repair we duck tape and bailing wire, we received brand new top end appliances. When our motor home went up in flames, we moved quickly into a senior complex which was horrible. Same kind of problems were met with complaints, delays and poor repairs. Moving from there to Camden Del Mar has made us completely forget two years of nightmares.

Camden del Mar. It looks gorgeous coming in and the apartments are beautiful inside, but don't let the looks deceive you!!!  The WORST management and office staff in a service industry I've ever encountered. You be better to go to ask.com before thinking this office staff can help or answer any questions. Everything is an inconvenience to these lovely ladies up front. Got a question? You'll be answered by a sign of disgust like you've just ruined there day. Got a package delivered up front? They make you feel like you owe them money from doing their job. Not to mention their extreme failures on numerous times to correctly annotate your account with the rent you've just paid. It's also not their fault if their computer systems failed and you find a notice on your door saying pay or quit because their systems failed and it told you you owed a dollar less then you actually do(this is because the water bill varies monthly) so yup no call or knock just a notice because the check was $.98 cents short. Rude rude rude rude up in there. If you're in a bind don't ask them for any favors!!! Maintenance guys rock tho!!! But man you're walking into the Devils lair when you go into that office!!! Oh last thing. They don't clean the gym. EVER!!

I've had a pleasant experience at KCH. From Vanessa (leasing agent) to the maintenance and management staff, I've nothing but positive experiences whenever I needed them. The area is safe, quiet, and convenient. And I loveeeee the different food trucks they have visit the property on a regular basis. Definitely one of the best communities to live in, in south Vegas.

If you want to end your lease on time, you need to give a 60-day written notice OR pay $2800+ to buyout your lease that already ended, or get an eviction on your credit report.

The rates listed are before the $145 monthly lifestyle fee, $15 monthly package locker charge, and all the other monthly charges you’re nickled and dimed for. 

They charge you a $175 cleaning fee to move in and a minimum of $110 cleaning fee to move out. 

If you or a guest gets their car towed, it’s $400, and you have to go all the way to North Las Vegas to retrieve it.

There’s a first floor resident who lets their dogs defecate on her patio. It’s an awful sight to pass by, nothing has been done. It’s been months.

Someone vandalizes the clubhouse monthly. There’s no security personnel on property, so anything goes. I smell cigarette smoke from time to time from a neighboring apartment, even though this is a non-smoking building. 

Nothing about this place is spectacular. Management does the bare minimum. Maintenance can’t fix a lightbulb. Just a big money grab.

You can’t count on anything at this property to be consistent other than the deterioration of the property.

The 5 star reviews must be from people who just moved in, I’m sure they’ll be back to edit their reviews.

When we signed the lease there was ample parking. During our stay we’ve seen most of it reassigned to the businesses nearby. Management sent out construction plans to tear out the back and replace the dog walking area with more parallel parking. So now you have construction on the front for Pine Bistro and Snax store and construction in the back to start eventually on the new parking. In the meantime they started towing vehicles without warning, other than sending an email day of when towing had started, to a location in NORTH LAS VEGAS. 

If you have more than one car, don’t move here.
If you have only one car, wait two years at least and check if construction is done.
Parking is terrible here, there’s not enough parking for residents, only one parking spot per unit. Park out front? 75% chance you’ll be towed

So to begin:  I actively rent from Keller Cactus Hills and will be leaving when my lease terminates, there are several major issues that I have with the property management company, and frankly for what we pay we could do far better.  After I move out I will update this section of the review.

The biggest issues I have with the building have to do with their parking situation, and how building management has handled it.  When presented with a choice between options that are reasonable versus options that are tenant antagonistic the management has chosen antagonistic 100% of the time.  They purchased this building knowing about the parking situation and took a system that has worked perfectly fine for 3 years and made it untenable.  To add insult to injury they maintain a pool of unallocated spaces and require us to pay $3/day for parking when we already pay thousands of dollars to actually rent the apartment.  The lease they inherited for my unit, and renewed without modification, stipulated a spot for each registered resident and the building has basically told us to go pound sand.  Communication has been entirely unprofessional, and has left us feeling like we are constantly getting the short end of the stick. For a slum I would expect this but this is a luxury building.

Speaking of luxury, we can move on to amenities.  While I am not super into fitness, my brother is.  The principal reason we chose Keller Cactus Hills was their gym facilities, specifically the free weights and squat rack.  Which they removed because a $5 floor tile designed to break is too much upkeep for their $77 million investment. 

Or in reality, and to get to the core of the issue, the building management does not care.  They don't care about you.  They care about your money and how much of it they can separate from you before you decide that they're a bad bet.  The willing ignorance for a $3/day parking spot, the unwillingness to fix a $5 floor tile that is designed to break instead of the actual floor, the $2.50 service charge to _pay our rent_ in the only way the lease allows rent to be paid.  It's all tacky.  

This place isn't a casino, and yet it's built entirely to separate fools from their money. Boy do I feel like a fool for having a lease here.

I want to thank the Ariva Leasing team—esp Jojo who was very gracious with her time in helping me get my questions answered.

Her and Keo, and the rest of the team made this move a simple and stress-free experience. They made sure to follow-thru with inquiries and kept me updated throughout the process.

Smooth sailing  The level of customer service is above and beyond. The stress free process of moving with Ariva has been amazing. The entire staff are friendly and helpful. The property has so much to offer and it’s still new. Our place we are in love with it. Thank you

I recently moved into Ariva, and although I had a few frustrating issues initially, Nahid and Angel went above and beyond to make things right. Their dedication to resolving my concerns and their genuine care for residents really stood out. They made me feel valued and supported, turning what could have been a difficult experience into a positive one. I truly appreciate their kindness and professionalism, and thanks to their efforts, I feel way more comfortable in my new place. Thank you both for your exceptional service!
Maintenance moved so fast  If something comes up, maintenance works on it quickly and well
LOVE THE PROPERTY All of the staff are super helpful and knowledgeable and take pride in the community.

Best apartment complex! The staff at the office are very helpful, apartment is great and up to date and the residents are friendly. Whenever we have a problem maintenance comes right away! The amenity fees are very reasonable just like other apartment charges and you get more of benefits of all the great amenities in this apartment. I love it here. I would recommend it to a friend for sure.

This neighborhood is so quiet. The Mission style architecture is georgious. The club house is superb and all the interior design impeccable. There are elevators. It views of Vegas amazing. High end great quality. You will love the office staff for excellent management and leasing. They went out of their way in my relocation. Come see, you won't want to leave. Its got that resort feel.

If you value safety, DO NOT LIVE HERE. In less than 9 months, our apartment has been the target of two unsuccessful break ins. The neighbor, unfortunately, was the victim of a successful break in. The car has been broken into and stolen from. Drug addicts are CONSTANTLY on property. They will jiggle door handles to see if any apartments are open. Some sketchy neighbors have random people in and out of their apartment, at all hours of the day. You will wake up to spray painted walls. People will leave their condoms in the parking lot for you to almost step on. If there is a security guard, l've never seen them. The apartment itself is just a glorified motel room. I’ve lived here a year and no issues! Staff communicates well and neighbors are pretty friendly. I’ve felt safe here and never had any issues or concerns for my safety at any time of day. Also walking distance to the strip is not far at all! I go every week as a workout! Highly recommend!

Please consider living somewhere else.

This is a money pit for the owners. They are trying to get every penny at the expense of their tenants. They advertise a 24/7 fitness center and yoga studio on their website.IT DOES NOT EXIST. They also make sure  everything is in working order for us. Ive only had to call them once to fix smthn & they were on it right away. I love my apartment.  
~~A.C.

I Love my apartment complex.. Any time I need any thing mix they always there to fix.. If I'm late on my rent they work with me.. Tiffany Place is an ok community. The amenities of having an indoor/outdoor pool, small gym, tanning beds and having water, cable and internet is pretty sweet. This is a pet friendly community and as far as I am aware they don't have breed restrictions (i have seen numerous pit bulls and german shepards). It is also really nice that when things break like the AC the office staff makes sure maintenance comes quick and repairs it. There are only a few things that I would change about the complex itself. It would be really nice if they allowed electronic/onlinepayments or accepted credit/debit payments. I believe it would be more beneficial to the residents and staff if they setup their webpage to allow service requests and rent payments. Another issue is the complex must have a contract with The tow company because they often tow residents vehicle for various infractions even when parked in their assigned spots. The only other thing that would be nice is if the apartment wasn't all electric because with the extreme heat the bill gets high quick from running the AC all the time. On the bright side it is fairly close to shopping centers, elementary schools, UMC hospital, and the strip. I would recommend Tiffany Place to those who want to live in a decent complex and those who might have had issues renting in the past.

I'm still new to the complex but so far it's great. Very friendly people in the office, security 24hrs a day, and nice pool and fitness area. The only thing I would change is making the fitness area also 24 hrs. Awesome place to live and love that internet and direct tv is included in my rent.

Notice how this ad says nothing about being a gated community because the gates are broken and open more than they are closed.
This place is not safe at all. There is no on-site  security.They have a courtesy  patrol that comes through at night with flashing lights.The thieves literally just duck down and wait for them to drive by.
Trash is everywhere  for days after the garbage truck comes.The dumpster enclosures are absolutely disgusting. 
The Fees are ridiculous. You pay for trash and you also pay for someone to collect trash from your front porch.You are literally  paying $50 a month for garbage.
The fee bill has charges on it like community  electric. They leave all the lights and tvs on in the gym all night even though it's not open 24 hours.There are fans on around the pool that never get shut off even in the winter.They're  not trying to save you any money by turning things off.
The new Management  company will not answer or address concerns.Look at the reviews of the company ,it's all the same complaints  no matter what city they're  in.
This place has taken a turn for the worse and they are lowering all the prices now.The people who have lived here are paying way more than new people moving in .
If you ok with leaving for work not knowing if your apartment will be broken into or if you go to bed not knowing if your car window will be smashed and your ignition destroyed then this is the place for you.

Hopefully I can help someone not make the same mistake of moving here.
The people in the area break into your cars. Maintenance never fixes anything correctly. Office managers are always rude & unprofessional.

There have been numerous burglary attempts within the six months since I moved in. There was an attempted break-in, and unfortunately, my car was stolen this weekend. The main gate has been broken for over a month, and despite numerous security issues within the community, they're unwilling to release the lease.

Given these security concerns, I would strongly advise against choosing this place. Please consider other options.

Conveniently located near freeways, shopping and restaurants. The office staff and maintenance are great, my neighbors are friendly. I feel safe in my home and that is what I was looking for myself and family. Definitely recommend
I love my apartment and the gym. The office is helpful and maintenance fast on getting my stuff repaired. Thank you Victor and Alex for taking care of my water heater :)
Recomiendo estos apartamentos, son muy lindos. El gimnacio me facina, la gente de las offie son muy amables. Gracias por hacer mi experiencia magnifica.
WiFi was good.room had good amount of space. Super nice bedroom.

There isn't an appliance in the place that was manufactured in the last 3 decades.

A/C gets the one room with a vent to below freezing while the rest of the house is on fire.

Everything that's ever been nicked or dinged is slathered in layers and layers of paint, aka the landlord special.

Landlord will strongarm you every time you renew, they tried to raise rent by 22% last year.

Amazon hub was installed that's closed at 5pm daily (at the latest, typically closed well. Before that, hope you get off work before 5)so good luck getting anything you purchase same day.

Don't put in work orders, they'll generally leave you worse off than you were before you called. Three separate calls now I've had to fix on my own out of pocket because these people truly do not care.

I was a resident at Gloria Park Villas from Sep 1993 thru May 2021. I lived in both 1 bdrm 1 bath and 2 bdrm 2 baths.  In fact, I may be one of the longest residents at the complex. So take my review to heart. It is an excellent and well-run apartment community.  The leasing staff is exceptional and very well run.  Silva is well versed in her job and provides excellent customer service to any and all residents.  The maintenance staff is TOP NOTCH. Any issues I had over the years (which were few) were taken care of quickly.  Anyone looking for a great place to call home should put GLORIA PARK VILLAS at the top of their list. I may be returning to Las Vegas in July 2022 and rest assured that I hope to once again reside here.  This complex is 5 stars no doubt about it.
GEORGE B. KEELEY, CMSgt, USAF (Ret)

If you're thinking of renting here, look elsewhere.
Pros: It's close to Chinatown and the grounds are beautiful.
Cons: Neighbors and the Leasing Office. 
Let me tell you about some incidents about here. One of my Amazon packages went missing the first week I moved in. I seem to live under a bowling alley with constant loud banging, the occasional domestic arguments, the cops coming in regularly, loud music, littering, etc. I have repeatedly told the leasing office and the leasing office is not competent.  Their answer is that YOU should figure out how to deal with the problem. I have had appliances break down because they are old and I live in a "renovated" unit. I had a package delivered by my mail carrier to the leasing office and the leasing office did not bother to inform me and their excuse is 'well the letter carrier should have told you". Right because the letter carrier has my number or I am supposed to be psychic and know that the Post Office changed their policies? The Leasing Office has no customer service skills once so ever after you move in. The leasing office handling of just general problems was so bad I had to call the corporate office in Utah.  They even make you change your own aircon home filters which is a general maintenance issue and something covered under HVAC services in all other properties because they don't want you to mess up the aircon system except here.  Again, really poor customer service considering how much you pay for living in a "luxury" condo.  The maintenance is okay. Then there are the constant price increases that hit you after 6 months.  There are far better places and within the price range. I suggest looking around before settling down here. While the place is pretty, just hope you don't have to deal with the leasing office because when there is a problem, you're on your own.

I am a resident of Gloria Park Villas Apartments, and I wanted to share that Gloria Park is a nice complex, the floor plans are spacious and it just makes you feel right at home.  The management from the office to maintenance are incredible, very friendly, courteous, and very professional in all aspects.  I am super happy I have found this place, and I am looking to stay forever.
My apartment is so nice, the office staff and maintenance team is so quick to respond to problems. I recommend.
Estoy muy contento con mudarme a estos departamentos un lugar muy tranquilo y muy limpio y muchas gracias a Beatris por su atención es muy paciente y tiene un trato maravilloso gracias

This is a shady, unresponsive leasing office and I would not recommend doing business with them.

LOVE my new home.  I didn't think it's possible to be so happy with an apartment.  The team at Rancho Mirage did an excellent job getting my apartment ready and doing the renovations.  I'm completely satisfied and one happy tenant.  Everything works great and work orders are responded to promptly.  They really take care of their tenants here and want you to have a great experience.  Every concern is addressed with professionalism and handled promptly.  

Special commendations to Eyleen and Gabby in the front office for helping me with the application process and then moving in.  These ladies did so much to ensure I had a smooth transition.  They are patient and kind in addressing all my concerns.  This level of professionalism and caring is rare and I feel very lucky to be a tenant here.

His colleague Bob helped resolve the outlet issue and I'm very grateful to the whole team.  You guys are wonderful and I'm very happy I made the choice to move here.

This sloppy, mean spirited excuse of a manager, Stephanie should not be in the position of interacting with people. She has no skills of decency to be effective...No people, nor interpersonal skills. review: Lived here from mid April 2024 until now, early January 2025. I’ve had a couple maintenance issues which were handled promptly by very pleasant workers. The staff in the office are very nice and responsive. I suspect I will renew my lease when it is up. Also, giving Brandon a shout out. He did a little work in my apartment and did it efficiently, getting a little help to make sure that it was done correctly.

review: When I signed my lease LAST Aug 2023 I was told the pool was being repaired. Now, June 17, 2024 the pool is padlocked off and not open! So disheartening

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review: Esperanza was very nice and did amazing customer service for the complex and I’m satisfied that I had no problems filling out application and etc.

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review: It was such good wifi.spacious bedroom and living room.I would recommend this place!

review: I’ve lived her 2 years. BIGGEST PROBLEM IS THE DOG POOP. It’s everywhere it looks like a San Francisco street. They have to get cameras and start giving out fines. The poop is ridiculous. I feel bad for the kids not only is the no place for them to play but there’s dog poop everywhere.  But maintenance is great things get fixed fast. Office ppl are nice. Rent is reasonable. Good location.

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review:
The Property Manager assisted me in my tour and applications.  She was helpful, coordinative, and nice, which made the move-in easy. 

I live on the first floor, and unfortunately, I can loudly hear my neighbors upstairs.  I can tell they have toddlers, since I can hear the children scream and run around the apartment.  I can hear the neighbor yell at their kids.  I can even hear them play stereo music and their instruments.  I did not expect the surface between the first and second floors to be so thin.  I don’t hear much of the neighbors beside me though.  Maybe the walls are thicker?

Spectrum is a pet-friendly apartment.  Due to this, the downfall is that not all tenants pickup after their dogs.  There’s a pet relief area, but there are still poop on other parts of the complex.  Like the walkways to your apartment.  It’s a health issue and puts other dogs at risks, since leaving poop out is unsanitary and can spread diseases.  I wish management had due diligence to resolve this health issue. I have my service dog with me, and I pickup after him.  I don’t feel safe having him poop nor pee at such unsanitary areas.  I didn’t know this was an issue until
I moved in. 

I do like living at Spectrum.  Unfortunately, my two unfortunate experiences will not allow me to renew my contract until such issues are resolved.  My biggest peeve is dog poop everywhere.

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review: Nice location, and units. Definitely on my final list of places to decide on!

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review: Debbie in the Front Office is amazing and sweet. But what isn't sweet is the previous owner having a dog that shed heavily, the carpet in the room not being cleaned, nor the washer and dryer area that had lent and dog hair all through it. I wad charged for a cleaning fee but my apartment was not cleaned fully when I moved in. The tub drain was full of hair,  so much so the water was not daining quick enough. I had to get maintenence to come and remove it. Living on the first floor it didn't matter how many times I asked for someone to spray my apartment, roaches and cricktes still found their way in. I ended up putting down dearth powder down to keep them from coming in. The deposit being paid by Jetter is the complex way of getting money from you on move out day. If you can't pay the deposit find another place to rent from because it doesn't seem like they throughly clean their apartments for move in, then turn around and bill you a cleaning charge at move out for something that they don't even do. I told the lady on the phone after I moved out about the carpet not being cleaned upon move in and the dog hair and because they came and put some water on the carpet and soaked it up, they said they cleaned it.

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review:
Scheduled an appointment over the phone for early afternoon.  Lady on the phone specifically said “I have 3 showings available for today.” Decided to take the earliest one. Got there on the dot. Office was locked. Was confused so called the number again. Was told to knock on the door. Staff who came from a showing said she had a couple signing up for a lease and asked us to come back three hours after our SCHEDULED appointment. 

To staff: If youre going to schedule appointments for people, atleast hire enough staff so you dont waste peoples time.

review: Just renewed my 4th lease here at Spectrum. I work from home so I need a quiet place and this beautiful community offers it. I have great neighbors, and my dog chu chu loves the dog park!

review: I've lived here about six months. Great office staff. Nice amenities. They have taken care of issues in a timely fashion. Enjoy living here.

review: Don’t move here. The smiles and everything looks wonderful. Let me say this, we were walking to turn our keys in and someone screamed “don’t live here”, we replied we are moving out THANK GOD. Don’t do it, all tenants before new management took over said it’s gone down hill and I agree!!!

apartmentName: The Michael B Townhomes and Flats
review:
Lived there for a year with my roommate.
Gave Debbie at the office my new address a month before the lease was over to have her send the deposit there in order to split it with my roommate since they said they cannot send half to each one of us.
I knew that if my roommate will get it then she would just keep it (No I can’t see the future but amazingly I was right). Anyways that’s not the issue.
Wrote down my new address and signed the form.
Just like Debbie told me to do.
I also explained the situation to her and she told me that that’s where the money is gonna go since I signed the form.
Called two months later because I didn’t get the deposit.
Apparently when my roommate was moving out
(I was already renting a new place) she gave Debbie her new address and Debbie just decided to send the money there without contacting me.
she either threw away the form I signed, changed it or just ignored it and pulled out a new form.
I don’t know what she did with it but she had no right to do that.
I Called and told Debbie that it is unacceptable and asked her what gave her the right to decide where the money goes and in response she said that it is my issue with my roommate and that it has nothing to do with her. And no...she wasn’t joking even tho it sounds like a joke.
She didn’t take any responsibility and obviously didn’t apologize. 
Just be careful guys.
Writing a review here is the only thing I can do at this point.
Don’t care about the money as much as I care 
About how unfair I was being treated.

review: I regret the day that I signed a lease with these people. It has been one thing after another since move in. Don't sign a lease with this complex. You will more than likely regret it. From the thin walls that shake every time you close a door to the rats, bedbugs, noisy neighbors, crap apartment management, cheap appliances, over priced rent, and rent payment scams you will be dying to leave as soon as possible, After you sign a lease, you are screwed and they know it. Do not move in. Take the warning and these reviews seriously.

Pathetic. Been here 6 months and still having issues. 
I had to report my stove not working (didn’t get a new for 2 weeks), missing stick for blinds (weren’t fixed for a whole month), countertops are not granite (complete lie), appliances are OUTDATED, oversized tub (bumpy-still can’t use it without scratching my back up) window fell out (wasn’t fixed for at least 4 weeks). They don’t have enough dog stations but complain and send emails about it. The dog park they have is just dirt and rocks (and I was told they were upgrading it) still hasn’t been UPGRADED! If I were you I would definitely not apply and go to the next apartment complex that is not under this property management company. The maintenance crew is experienced. Best thing they got goin is nice it gets GOING. AVOID THEM DO NOT APPLY

The maintenance office has an extremely high turnover rate and yet they are always rude no matter what with the exception of one person that has been there for a certain period of time now. The grounds are always kept unclean. There has been two attempted break-ins on my apartment and I haven’t even lived here for a year yet. I have witness kids breaking in cars and reported it to the 24 hour security and yet they never even showed up or did anything about it. I have gone as far as taking my concerns all the way to corporate just to get anything resolved, and those are just some of my problems. Needless to say, I will not be renewing my lease.

This apartment has many things wrong. I can't believe they have a good rating here. They must pay for it. 
The new management it's spiteful and the corporate does not care to even be involved. I just want a working washer so I can stop complaining. I can go on and on with how bad this place is but I've done that already. Now I just want a working washer. Going on 2 months.

0 stars!  Bugs, Roaches and more bugs!  No swimming-the pool is broke from the kids all the time.  They have outside faucets that the kids use-you have to pay for that water. Washer and dryer, stove and refrigerator, did not work for weeks.  The grass is a foot long and be careful where you step as there is dog poo everywhere, even is the mail area! SICK  The gate is broke, there is no lock on the walk through gate and cars wait for you to enter and then follow you.  They say there is dop restrictions-this is a lie as well.

Management was very helpful and very professional. The apartment that I picked out was very clean and maintenance Supervisor Craig made sure that the apartment had no major issues and was very helpful. He went beyond and and above to make sure everything was perfect in my apartment before I moved in. I highly recommend these apartments

I’ve lived here for over 2 years now and I haven’t had any issues. However when I moved in the unit wasn’t cleaned. There were roach eggs and hair left everywhere. There’s a seasoning factory down the street that stinks really bad and closing the door doesn’t help. The smell comes through the windows and bathroom. My rent is going up $300 which is unfortunate because I’ve never missed a payment or paid late. From the leasing staff not knowing how to do their jobs correctly to the macitence staff not knowing how to fix anything. Excellent amenities engulf apartment living 3 beautiful open floor plans awesome views and clean, peaceful surroundings, amazing pool area, fun at the pool equals family gathering with beautiful and humble neighbors quick and convenient shopping trips and excitement and entertainment all around and for the fit and fitness center made for Billy Blanks security 24 hours easy access to all your needs.

These apartments aren't terrible. I wish the neighbors were a little more quiet, but they are not out of control loud. everyone keeps to themselves. The office staff is friendly and are willing to help if you go into the office they have a hard time picking up the phone but if you go in the office they are glad to help. I haven't had any maintenance issues and I have lived here for 9 mo. I did need a light bulb replaced as well as an air filter but they changed them for me within an hour of requesting it.

The apartments are very clean when you move in. The staff is very helpful and maintenance is done quickly and efficiently. The grounds are well taken care of. The location is great too. Simply perfect for someone looking for a great place to stay in Vegas.

This apartment complex is perfect.  Nice common areas with a well maintained courtyard and pool.  The complex also has a small fitness room.  The apartment is in a great location.  Just minutes away from the major highways in Vegas.  Located far enough from the Las Vegas strip that you don't get caught up in the busy lifestyle, but close enough that it does not take long to get there.

My apartment was selected for its proximity to my job, which was in a fairly remote area away from metropolitan Las Vegas. It is spacious for a one-bedroom and reasonably priced. My brother commented on the size on a recent visit. Security was a concern when I first moved in, but management has improved security significantly in the last six months. Appliances are up-to-date and include a good-sized refrigerator (the ice-maker is a real plus!) and a microwave/gas range/self cleaning oven unit.
The office staff is always friendly and helpful.
Worst management ever, had a horrible experience 6 different mangers in 3 years. Bugs. Roaches to be exact

I moved in 4 months ago and love my apartment. It's huge and the finishes are great. Estrella is so helpful and the Manager really cares about the community. The place is always neat and my 2 repairs were taken care of quickly. This place is great. I highly recommend.

When we arrived to move in the doors were not locked, windows wide open with no screens letting bugs and dust in. They had plenty of notice for the apartment to be ready but there was urine on the bathroom seat, hair in the shower, dust and dirt everywhere. It was visibly dirty. You could tell they had not cleaned and it was going to be 3 days before they came out to "fix it".

When I first moved in I was hopeful, that was when these apartments were managed and owned by Pinnacle. Alliance is a joke. Alliance doesn’t know a thing about quality. Alliance thinks they’re smart for re-doing the blacktop in the parking lot, thinking that it will give the place a “luxury” appearance. Management is ok. I feel bad for both Nathan and Ana, this company has them dealing with all the complaints that comes with poorly-runned-company owned properties.

DH sold to new owner in September, but they are still putting this on the residents to pay. There is a 65.00 Amenity fee that they make you aware of with rent. Then there is a clause in the lease about community fee's which is the usage of everything used by the residents regardless of if you use it or not. Pool, water, lights and all. Monthly billing for that is 130.00 back dated 2 months added to your rent. It's not being open and honest with people that rent from you. Horrible way to trick people to live here. Please skip this property when deciding to move in.

I’ve lived in a lot of apartment complexes but never one of this size. It’s huge. I think there’s 364 apartments. However, every apartment I’ve lived in has had at LEAST 4 times the dumpsters this place has. This place has 2 dumpsters. TWO plus a compactor. And they fill up immediately, including the compactor, especially on the weekend (when valet trash doesn’t come). They have now changed the rules. You are not allowed to throw away trash except on days valet trash doesn’t come. And you can also only throw trash away in the compactor. That’s a single place to throw trash away for 364 apartments. When the dumpsters and compactor was already filling up when all three were accessible, this is unacceptable. They should have had at least 6 dumpsters to start. But now they make it even worse? So, now how it works - if the trash compactor fills up (which is already did with the 2 dumpsters being usable) you are fined for having trash. Fined for the poor planning of the management. Maybe they’re doing this so the fines can go towards more dumpsters.

They promised me the front gate would be working by the time I moved in but it still isn't working. Anyone can just walk in, at any time. These apartments are almost fully at fault for the murder. If the gates were working and there really was security, I believe that woman would still be alive. I HATE Living in these apartments. I would not recommend them to any one. They are roach infested, the floors have soft spots in them that may cave in if you are not careful. The office does not take work orders,serioisly. I had to wait 3 weeks for maintenance to address the mold and leaks in my bathroom. Now they are completely tearing out both the bathrooms and wont provide any compensation. The first month I lived here I had to get my mail from the post office because the mailboxes had been broken into and were getting fixed. Crime is very high in this area. When I first moved in, there were no knobs on any of my doors, no window panes, the apartment was not finished at all. It's like they didn't even inspect the apartment but handed over keys. The AC/heat has not worked since I moved in. I put in work orders for maintenance and they never show up. When I call the office, the excuse is always that maintenance is sick. The building has flooded more than once which always results in my water being shut off for an entire day. There are an insane amount of roaches. Every morning and night I see them yet no pest control. I went into the office last month to pay rent and there was a woman complaining that the health department said her apartment was not habitable. These apartments are DIRECTLY under a flight path (which I was not told before signing my lease, I just got a quick tour, quick enough to not have a plane fly over). The planes are so loud they wake me from my sleep multiple times every night, also shaking all the windows in my apartment. There are insane amounts of crime. Constant police sirens, cops in the parking lot all the time. I've seen people get arrested in the complex parking lot multiple times. They say there's security but I have not seen security once. Oh, and when I signed my lease more than 6 months ago, I was told the gates would be up shortly and there are still no gates. I'm currently trying to get out of my lease because it's not safe or habitable here.

I absolutely LOVE what they have done with this complex. Considering the surrounding area, this is definitely a diamond in the rough. They have remodeled their apartments, which feel really modern and retro (great for a college student like me!) and have backslash even! BACKSPLASH! I thought I would have to own my own home to see this kind of detail but Skyline Parc has made that come true for me already :-D
Also, their on site security is AWESOME. Always checking the property, talking to residents and making it feel a lot safer and protected.

The apartments are all newly renovated which is nice! But the area is not good, kids stealing things and anyone can walk up to your door. People ask you for money right when you walk out your front door! I don't recommend this place.
Apartments look very clean, very organized, area isn't to bad. Nice set up, good pricing for Vegas apartments.

The apartments are beautiful but be prepared to hear your neighbors conversations word for word. The same with the person above you. Imagine pay rent every month only to be woken up by loud music during the week at 3 am. Not the best apartments for an infant

Management does not care about they’re residents at all. You can complain to them over and over again and nothing is done. I loved it here at first but I can’t wait to be able to move. The building is old and not kepted up my neighbors upstairs are so loud and sound like they gonna fall thru the floor one day. I was told maintenance don’t fix floors here. The floors crack so loud upstairs you could hear every step they take up there.

These are the worst most nastiest apartments ever. Mold, roof leaking and tubs are disgusting! I do not i repeat do not recommend these apartments at all! Maintenance people don’t help all they do is drive around the apartments that’s it. Office ladies never wanna help you out! If I could rate these apartments I’m sure they would be on the negative side ! Mind you the roof almost fell on top of me.

I was so grateful when we were approved for an apartment in September 2021. It was the only 3 bedroom available on short notice. I didn't even mind the large deposit. However, problems started day 1. The apartment was filthy when we got it. Drawers were broken, drains were compacted with grease and gnats. The tub and sink were not grouted properly, and there was clearly water damage under our kitchen sink (the smell... Yuck!) At first Maintenance would come out right away to address smaller concerns, like the grouting. But whenever we reported major issues we were ignored or given mickey-mouse workarounds for the problem. AC motor going out? "Just give the unit a good smack to get it going again." Drains clogged out to the street? "Just open your drainage valve right by your front door and let the sewage water run down the sidewalk." Several water leaks from our upstairs neighbors never received dry-out services so there's mold and mildew growing on the ceiling. After a year of this, I went month- to-month (which increased my rent by $240, BTW). Now they don't even bother responding to my work orders. The pools are disgusting. The amenities are non-existent; no playground, no volleyball or basketball courts, no gym. All of that is false advertisement. The office is a ghost town. No one is ever there or ever responds to inquiries. We used to have 24 hour security at the gate but about 4 months ago that stopped, so anyone can drive in any time because the gates are wide open. Pigeons are everywhere. You will have drain flies because of the constant water issues. OH, the water issues! Yesterday our water was off for 14 hours. 14 hours! From before 7am to right after 9pm. No explanation, no apology, nothing. Today, our water was shut off AGAIN at 8pm. As of now, an hour later, it's still off. Once again, no explanations from the office or ER line when you call. And this happens CONSTANTLY. At least once a month. That isn't even an exaggeration. Also, while we've lived here, there have been 4am police raids, domestic disputes, and even one kidnapping/suicide... But to be fair, that's the quality of the residents and not the complex staff itself. So please, please, PLEASE avoid living here at all costs!

This place is horrible. It doesn't even come close to resembling the pictures. The pools are always shut down. There is no longer a basketball, volleyball court, or tennis court. The BBQ area has been torn down. The outside is filthy with adults and kids throwing trash on the ground. They do not fix any repairs that are needed. They say they'll put in a work order, but if you call in a few days, they will tell you there is no work order. They will guarantee work will be completed by a certain day, but no one ever comes to fix anything, even if they set a specific day and time to come. Faucets and toilets all leak and run which is a big concern for our valley. It is barely safe to be outside during the day, but do not dare going out at night. It is full of gang members and drug dealers, as well as crazy people on drugs all over. I have seen the police in here every single day, sometimes several times a day, and I don't even go outside often...just to handle everyday business like going to and from work, taking or picking kids up from school, going to the grocery store, etc. I do not get scared easily, however unless you are into illegal and/or dangerous activities, I do NOT recommend moving here. I could go on and on more, however I think you should get a pretty good understanding by what I have written.
Never have time to attend you. Poor service attitude. The lady of the desk unprofessional
Don't do business with Anna. She was very misleading. I now have no place, a money I can't cash and my power on in unit that's I can't move in.
They are the worst apartment complex to ever live in!! They are infested with roaches and bed bugs!!! And it states it in the lease! So please read the lease before you sign it! Thank you!!!

Of all the places I called to find a place to live from out-of-state, Village Square Apartments turned out to be the most beautiful as well as the most ideal situation for me.  I want to start a new life and the wonderful people especially made me feel like a very welcome new resident-to-be.  I look forward to moving in and living in my new place, it looks so cute, I love the kitchen bar and the Roman tubs!  Decorating is going to be so much fun, there is a lot of space to work with and the layout is open and airy, just how I like it.

Moved in about 3-4 weeks ago and it’s been nice. Spoke to Wendy through my application process and Nelly moved me in. Jennifer the assistant manager was nice to explain to me some policies but overall been a good experience as my first apartment. Got a cheap price moving in and Maintanence even helped me move my furniture too! No complaints so far!!

Also, to keep you cool year round are two swimming pools and hot tub for the cool nights. This Oasis in the middle of the desert, all inclusive, is moderately priced at $530. Make an appointment to view one today.
If you love stepping in dog crap, constant rent increases and awful neighbors, then this is the place for you.

They are rude and unprofessional. They charged me for items I had nothing to do with. I found the maintenance to be the opposite of what was written. They usually made us wait for a couple days before showing up. This place has potential but probably with different office personnel. The overall area of the street is supposed to be one of the safer in the city but these apartments are not. I would look up the number of criminals living there.

Please don't do it! The location is good but the inside is old and they do not keep them up. You pay all this money to move in and they don't even give you new carpet. It was filthy, they didn't clean the walls before painting them so I have hair from God knows where stuck on my walls, and they are NOT in a rush to fix issues in the building. I've been waiting for months for maintenance. The staff is nice... AT FIRST but once they have your money you can kiss that goodbye. I don't feel that it's worth the money, find somewhere nicer and more updated.

As a recent transplant to the Las Vegas area, I am very happy that I choose Summerhill Pointe residence homes! This is a very large apartment complex that feels like home. Since I did not know anything about the city ,this turned out to be the perfect location (even without a car). Located in the West side of Vegas, in an area known as "The Lakes", it is quiet and I feel very comfortable and safe. I am near several bus lines and The West Sahara Free library is directly across the street. There are many strip malls in & surrounding this area. Anything you need can be found nearby. Walgreen's, CVS, Sprouts, Albertsons, gas stations, movie theater, UMC urgent & primary care, nice restaurants are all within walking distance. Downtown Summerlin , Red Rock casino & resort are only 5 minutes away.The leasing, maintenance and management staff are awesome and very professional! The staff are incredibly efficient, friendly, trustworthy, competent and concerned about their residents.  At Summerhill, you can request an accent wall in various colors. I love my  Paprika LR wall, and the spacious 2bd 2ba layout has a home like feeling. The master bath is a good size with a huge Roman tub. Having your own laundry room on the patio is quite convenient. Beautiful landscaping is throughout, with 3 crystal clear pools w/spas & cabana area. This property is well taken care of, clean, friendly and quiet. The residents are very amicable and polite. Pets, especially large dogs, are welcomed here.The dogs are walked responsibly and are well trained. There is even a pet spa! I have been at Summerhill Pointe for 10 months, would recommend it to others, and I love living here!!!

I like living here because this is a terrific location.  The West Side of Vegas is convenient.  There are stores and restaurants of all types nearby.  It is easy to get across Vegas from here.  The highways are accessible.
And I can have a large dog-no breed restrictions.
The company has put in a lot of work on landscaping recently.  It is kept up.

I love my apartment the maintenance people come right away if you put in a work order. The front office is helpful and if you have bug problems they come once a week n take care of it till it's gone. I feel the rent is a little high but it's also my first place out here since I moved here

Be very careful when you lease at this location. I submitted an application for a two bedroom that was listed at $1300 a month. Their system proceeded to charge me $60 for the application fee. After completing it, I was told by the leasing manager, that it was a computer error. And the actual price was $2050! They were not going to honor the advertised price.

Later on when I asked about the miscalculation of the pro-rated rent before moving in, she said that the computer dictates the amount and she couldn't adjust it. This is despite my detailed explanation on how the daily rate should be legally calculated. (The total monthly rate x 12, then divided by 365 days, then multiply the number of days for the remainder of the first month.) Their calculation was off in favor of the leasing office by well over $100. She wouldn't hear any of it, and just blame it on the computer.

This shows a pattern of honoring any computer error, as long as it benefits them.

Very dishonest! Stay Away from this place.

The apartment was everything we had hoped it would be after watching it for over 10years, we final made here. When I first view it on the website I decided this is where we would make our new home after retirement, and we have not been disappointed. Management staff was so helpful in our processing application. I love the open concept it offers and the environment it not disappointing.

Boca Raton has a great location and 24 hour gated security. Almost everything is above code except for some major flaws. 9 floors means its a concrete building so noise from other units is never an issue. First major flaw. No dryer hookup so each unit has a all-in-one washer/dryer unit. None of them work and even the ASKO technician advised not to use it as it will ruin your clothes. The washer/dryer smells and don't dry your clothes at all even if's it one item. Of course, they have laundry facility on the 3rd floor but you have to pay for it. Very inconvenient as tenants never set their timers and leave their clothes in the washers or dryers. As of late the washers and dryers do not even work in the laundry facility. Clothes come out with stains and residue. The dryers take your money but do not dry. Management refuses to acknowledge the issue. Also, if you are the only person doing laundry (washing) in the laundry room you would think the dryer would be available for you since you are next in queue to use the dryer. This isn't the case as so many people wash their clothes in their apartment and then take it to the laundry room to dry. So, some days you can never time it correctly to get your clothes from the washer to the dryer. Laundry is an all day thing at the Boca.

Second major floor is hot water. Some floors have return piping only and not supply. If there are vacant units around you, you can wait from 10-30 minutes for hot water. I went without hot water for up to 8 months without any cooperation to resolve the issue or reimbursement from my landlord or Management. Finally, smell is a big issue. There is illegal drug use and dog feces everywhere at the Boca and Management refuses to address the issue aggressively. I have examined the evidence by taking a survey method and many unit owners complain of the noxious odors of marijuana in the common areas. Lazy people with their dogs refuse to pick up. Also, there seems to be more crime than normal. Every one I run into seems to have an issue with crime. i.e. bike stolen, Motorcycle damaged due to an attempt at theft, cars being broken into. This is happening on premises. Just heard Boca is now fixing their video cameras. (Lock the barn after the horse is stolen seems to be their motto.) Management says security cannot call Metro police unless it's emergency. They do little to enforce the by-laws and nuisance laws and care little for tenants. Concierge however is courteous, helpful and empathetic.

A year and a half ago, I went in looking for an apartment and walked out with a fully loaded townhome.

I've been a renter for most of my life.

This is my first time renting from a company managed property. (I normally rent directly from owners.)

The staff here are professional & courteous.

The property is clean and very well maintained.

Given the number of residents here, it's surprisingly quiet as well.

The 24hr security does an outstanding job of preventing any unwanteds from making their way into our personal space.

The walls are exceptionally thick so you and your neighbors are never in each others' business if you know what I mean.

The bedrooms are spacious and the bathrooms are spa-like.

For those who enjoy a little elbow room while cooking, you need not worry as the updated kitchens are roomy as well as loaded with counter space & storage.

Although I personally don't take advantage of the numerous amenities that are offered, I do like the fact that they're available.

For those with four-legged family members, you'll be pleased to know that this luxury property is also pet friendly.

I absolutely love the fact that the building is pre-wired for cable and satellite. I've never been a fan of cable, so having the option is a huge plus!

The location is perfect. It's close, but not too close to the craziness of the strip and only a few minutes to several supermarkets, restaurants, malls and the interstate.

Living here makes it easy to forget that you're in the desert.

When I began my apartment search in June, my current location was actually the last location I looked at for a new address. With all the amenities Boca Raton Condominiums and Apartments had to offer, this was the best place for me, and I put a hold on my new Apartment. It is a corner unit overlooking the South End of the Las Vegas Strip.

Unlike my previous residence, this apartment is much quieter. My cat is no longer stressed out as he has not gotten sick since he moved with my to my apartment.

Many casinos, shopping centers, grocery stores, and restaurants are close by, along with fitness options. This is by far the best move I have made since moving to Las Vegas in 2003.

I have lived here for a very long time The new managers that took over A couple months ago are absolutely incompetent They have no compassion they have no idea how to do their job I know firsthand that they allow people to move apartments when their apartment is to roach infested because they refuse to go in and make people clean their places On top of that they don't just Kick them out they move them to another apartment so you have a chance of getting roaches yourself so If I were you and you want to be safe oh by the way the amenities are never available gym doesn't work pool's never open And the gates are very On and off if they're even secure so it's not even safe so if I were you I would not move here if you don't want to be roach infested And not be safe

Living here at Xander 3900 has been a lovely experience. Is quiet, safe, pet friendly, clean, and friendly. It gets even better when you find out about, the 2 swimming pools, basketball court/tennis court, and a cute dog park. I strongly recommend applying for a lease here and live comfortably.
My move-in was easy and smooth. I was very stressed at the time and the leasing office followed up with me multiple times to help. I’m very grateful. I’ve had a lovely time living here so far.
HELIX !!! An excellent place to live! Office staff are helpful, and always available. All the amenities you can imagine. Maintenance is very helpful too! Thanks for the great place to stay. ??

I stayed at Aviata for two years + two months. The apartment itself was fine; recently renovated, new appliances & flooring. Maintenance was fine and the staff was pretty nice. While I was there, management company changed, but overall here is what I experienced that might help someone else…

- don’t be fooled by the rent posted online; that’s the base rent and you can easily expect another $150 to be added each month including W/S/T. What they don’t tell you right off the bat is there are other community fees added. 
- when I first moved in, security drove around pretty consistently for awhile. When I left, that very rarely happened, but there were a lot of days with police presence on property. 
- a strange man approached my apartment covered head to toe with a face mask. My peephole camera scared him off thank god. When I reported to the office, they had similar complaints. Another time, I was approached by a neighbor warning me of someone knocking on doors with a bloody hand. I’ve never experienced incidents like this in other apartments. Lack of feeling safe was a huge contributor to me not resigning my lease. 
- I was incorrectly given a notice for having an unreported animal in addition to my dog. Luckily I cleared this up with the office, but this was inconvenient
- after you leave, be aware that they IMMEDIATELY give your final charges to a collection agency and you have 30days from turning in your keys to pay, not 30 days from when you’re aware of this. 
- they automatically include refresh charges on your final statement; carpet cleaning & patching up drill holes and paint. So expect at least $250 coming out of your security deposit. 

Overall, this apartment tries to get $$ from you where other apartments include these charges.

If you're considering this place, it might be wise to look elsewhere if you value your finances. Here’s a summary of what to anticipate:

- **Amenity Fees:** Expect to pay $75 a month for amenities that are often either unclean or closed. This fee doesn’t seem justified.
- **Valet Trash Fee:** A $25 monthly charge for valet trash service, which can be more inconvenient than simply managing your own trash.
- **Parking Issues:** Finding a parking spot near your building is only possible through the "rent a parking space" program, costing an additional $25 a month. Without this, parking can be very difficult, and visitors may struggle to find a spot. Handicap parking is limited and generally only available near buildings with tenants who have a handicap, putting handicap visitors at a disadvantage.
- **Additional Charges:** Expect extra charges for community gas, electric, water, trash, and sewer. It feels like every aspect is monetized.
- **Late Rent Fees:** The management imposes an additional $150 charge for a "7-day notice" on top of the standard 5% late fee. This practice is not legal, as it’s a loophole to charge more than the 5% allowed by state law. The added charge is an attempt to circumvent legal limits on late fees.

In summary, this place tends to find every opportunity to impose additional costs, and the services provided don’t seem to justify the expenses.

Additionally, there are issues with car break-ins, residents who disregard property rules, litter, excessive noise, and general disregard for others. Most of the office staff seem uninformed and inconsistent with their answers. They also display poor attitudes, making interactions unpleasant.

$30 for cable TV... you cannot opt out
$25 for "valet trash service" (more below)... you cannot opt out

$25-30 for water (more below)

$5 common area electric...

Regarding Valet Trash service:
Supposedly, you leave your trash out at night, and it's gone in the morning.  In actuality, you have to put your trash way outside the door in the sprinklers where the trash can gets covered in mud.  Most days, in the morning, you get to bring out your trash, then take your trash can out back and wash the mud off and bring it back in... or else you get charged $25 for leaving your trash can out... but you still pay for the "service" which is a hassle, and you get nothing out of it.
Water:

Don’t be Fooled by the Pool

My fiancé and I moved to the Avenue apartments a year ago because we liked the amenities that they offered and we thought the pool was the nicest that we’d seen in comparable complexes. Our year started off well enough, but then the management company changed to Pinnacle and the complex got worse and worse.

Here’s what they did (I had to edit this down to fit): 
•	They stopped pesticide services. 
•	Our refrigerator began leaking from the freezer on top into the refrigerator down below. We submitted a service call and they came in during the day, tracked dirt throughout our kitchen (which was the only way we knew they had shown up at all), and “fixed” it. Except it never got fixed. We kept emailing them about it and they kept showing up at mysterious times to fix it except it never got fixed. We had to keep a bowl inside to catch all the leaking water. This was the case for months. It was still leaking when we moved out.
•	At one point my fiancé got attacked by a dog in our complex. When we complained to the front office they asked for the dog’s information. We gave a description of the dog but they said that didn’t help because they kept no records of who had dogs and what they looked liked. When we moved in, we had to submit a picture, description, and pay a $250 pet deposit for our dog, yet apparently they didn’t have any of those records for any other dog on the property. This dog that attacked my fiancé was not on a leash and untrained. They said they would write an email blast about enforcing leash laws in the complex but they never did. Half the dog owners don’t walk around with leashes…
•	There is no security and frequent dumpster divers.
•	The beautiful pool that you see as you walk in and out of the front office was NEVER clean. At times it was borderline disgusting, filled with bugs and bird feathers. The pool rake was broken so it’s not even like the tenants could rake the pool themselves. And the spa was never operational. Never. We stayed there a full year and at no point was the spa ever operational.
•	The front desk associates/management is useless. 
•	And don’t expect your security deposit back. 

This place started out okay enough but once it switched to Pinnacle Management it was a disaster. I wouldn’t recommend this complex to my worst enemy. I have never been treated with such disrespect while at the same time paying so much for it. Absolute garbage.

apartmentName: San Moritz and Angel Point Apartments
review: I recently moved into an apartment here from out of state. Everyone in the office is extremely nice and helpful especially Heather and Emily. The apartments are clean and I feel safe here. Maintenance is timely with requests. I would recommend moving here.

apartmentName: San Moritz and Angel Point Apartments
review: We have lived here 15 years now, and couldn't be happier.  Judy, the office staff, and maintenance crew are all very friendly, and efficient.  The apartment is roomy with open modern design and the crown molding adds an elegant touch.

apartmentName: San Moritz and Angel Point Apartments
review: I moved to Las Vegas about 1 year ago, and was not sure about the neighborhoods.  I had a friend recommend the San Mortiz Apartments on Washington Avenue, and it has been a good choice.  They have 3 pools and a weight room.  The apartments are kept up, and the people are friendly.  The maintenance team does a great job of responding to requests in 1 day.  The office staff is very helpful.  They could use more convenient hours during the week; 8 to 5 pm.  But they are open on Saturdays.  They are planning to get credit card payments available which would be awesome; love those mileage points on my card! It's a gated community with security, but the area is more upscale anyway.  I would definitely recommend this place if you want to live on the Westside of town.

apartmentName: San Moritz and Angel Point Apartments
review: If you are looking for a convenient location, reasonable monthly rent, and a safe, pleasant environment in Las Vegas, then the San Moritz Apartments may be for you.  Conveniently located just north of the Summerlin Parkway with easy access to Route 95 and I-15, this gated complex has good security, lovely landscaping, and a friendly and responsive office and maintenance staff. The large number of long-term residents adds to the stability of the community.  No dogs allowed makes it quieter and multiple swimming pools means us swimmers can avoid the splashers!  I have lived here for two years, going on three, and have not found anything better.  There are a variety of apartment layouts (I have one of the two choices of 2-bedroom layouts) and, of course, covered parking (you want that in Vegas!).

apartmentName: San Moritz and Angel Point Apartments
review: These apartments are beautifully desert landscaped and maintained impeccably as well.  The maintenance is not only outdoors but indoors also.  The call to fix something is immediately addressed and this location is very convenient to shopping, groceries and public transportation.  I couldn't as for a better place to live.
Customer service is top notch, units are bigs and clean, gated community, location is great just 5 minutes from the strip.

It took them forever to tend to the issue. Forever meaning we found a new home and moved out before they came to tend to it. Management is poor here. I would not recommend.

The property looks great and is located in a great neighborhood with malls, restaurants, shops, parks, and a library all in walking distance. I enjoyed living here due to its accessibility to the bus line and shopping centers. Although the area looked great I quickly realized that looks can be very deceiving. I lived in this complex for 2 years and had pest problems from day one (literally my first night in the apartment I reported ants in my kitchen to the property). At a point the issue got so bad that I could not use my kitchen for 5  weeks for fear of aggravating the problem. I literally had ants crawling up the kitchen walls. At one point the only way pest control could deter the issue was by spreading bug poison throughout my kitchen. I could not do anything but store food in the fridge. The managers who I emailed regarding this issue were slow to react and unsympathetic to this reoccurring pest issue. I called the management company and left several messages about the issue and never received one follow up call. Not 1 penny of my rent was reimbursed to me for this pre-existing problem even after being unable to use my kitchen for 5  weeks. Although the property looks good externally it is old and not well cared for. I've had neighbors tell me they had the same pest issues. I mention all this to express how the management treats and reacts to its residents. I moved out and am in an amazing new apartment for $100 more than the price of this apartment. The extra money doesn't bother me as the peace of mind is priceless! If you're apartment hunting and desperate for a place and choose this one I wouldn't recommend signing a long term lease as there are better maintained apartments in the area for the same price or cheaper. Happy hunting!

The manager Ann was so amazing she made the whole process so stress free. she went above and beyond just getting me moved in, but helped me to find things like the local utility companies, places to eat and  things to do. Not with Sahara view apartments and that made all the unexpected costs of moving to a new state that much more affordable. All the units are freshly remodeled which was great because I hate moving into a new place and getting all the bad smells from the old tenants especially when it’s smoke, but not here, nothing but freshly painted walls, new countertops, and new modern appliances. Parking was another plus, There was plenty of it and all the other tenants were vary courteous.I worked in a vary physical demanding job so after a long hot day of work jumping in the pool to cool off or soaking in the hot tub was awesome. It’s a gated complex witch is nice because I didn’t have to worry about strangers trying to break into my car witch was sometimes filled with work tools. Edd the maintenance guy is one of the coolest guys I know. He was always on time,  professional and got the job done write.Dennis is another manager on site, I would always see him when I would be heading to do my laundry or pick up my mail. He was always super friendly and enjoyed getting to know the tenants personally. To sum it all up I would recommend this place to everyone I know. Ann, Edd, and  Dennis are a dream team to work with and they treat you like family not a tenant.

It’s quiet, the upgrade are comparable with any of the new complexes in the city, the management team Dennis and Ann are amazing ! They really cater to the tenants, any issue that comes up they are on it pronto, Ed is great at keeping everything in order   When my daughter needed a apartment Ann was quick and efficient, and now I have my mom here, 3 generations at Shara view and no worries. It is gated and safe 
Close to stores and transportation!! Easy peasy.

The apartment itself is very cozy and clean with some modern touches. My favorite parts are: gated entrance, instant hot water, filtered water/RO faucet, ice maker, bathroom storage, and the central location. The area is not the best, but I've never had any problems myself. This place is an excellent value, highly recommended!
Close to the Strip, quiet and a gated community.  The management and maintenance is really good. Really a good place to live. Highly recommended

Hello, my name is Richard. As I state in my headline, you shouldn't believe anything you read. Including this review. Do yourself a favor and go check it out for yourself. You have to remember a couple of things about reviews. First: Most people who write reviews, like me, write them out of anger. When something they felt was done wrong to them, they feel the overwhelming need to vent about it. Even if most of the time, it is themselves that is the real cause of the problem (sometimes). Most people do not take the time to write positive reviews for one simple reason...they are too happy to care and do not have that emotional reaction that demands a review. Not because it is not deserving. But rather because they are too busy being positive and enjoying life. Second: Use common sense!!! If there are only a handful (even less) of negative reviews, that should tell you that most people are very happy with the company and or business. After visiting numerous apartment complexes earlier in the day, our last stop was Vernazza Apartments. And let me tell you...immediately impressed with Maria and her manager (please forgive me Maria if I am spelling your name wrong) and the entire complex. The prices are amazing (compared to many other apartment complexes in that same area). The location seems relatively safe. Right next to an elementary school. If i had one complaint, it would be the hours of the pool and gym. But that is trivial in the grand scheme of things. I wanted looks, safety, friendliness, price, and most of all...comfort! And without even living there one single day...I feel at home! So no matter the reviews...let your own eyes be the judge. Good luck!

Summerlin Meadows, unfortunately, does not meet the standards one might expect from a quality residential community. Below are several concerns that prospective residents should consider.

Building and Facilities:
During the weekdays, the water is frequently shut off for maintenance and repairs, causing significant inconvenience. Despite these disruptions, requests for maintenance or repairs within individual apartments often go unanswered or take weeks to be addressed. Additionally, the water pressure is consistently low, faucets tend to leak, and the walls appear to have been poorly patched over the years.

Management and Communication:
The management team at Summerlin Meadows displays a lack of effective communication and responsiveness. They are often unresponsive to resident issues unless they require something from the residents themselves. This lack of engagement can be frustrating and concerning, as it impacts the overall living experience.

Safety and Security:
Safety within the community is a significant concern. There have been numerous incidents of theft, including car thefts and break-ins. The security measures in place are inadequate, with no surveillance cameras to monitor activities. The mail bin is frequently broken into, and porch piracy is a common occurrence. Although management sends out email notifications about these issues, no substantial actions are taken to improve security.

Overall Living Experience:
The overall living experience at Summerlin Meadows is disappointing. The reality of living here is starkly different from the impression given by the pictures on the website. Potential residents should be aware of these issues to avoid unnecessary headaches and frustrations.

In conclusion, I would advise anyone considering Summerlin Meadows to carefully weigh these points before making a decision. There are significant issues that need to be addressed to make this a comfortable and safe place to live.
