We relocated here from across the country about 5 months ago and are very glad we did. We were attracted by the value (Direct TV, high speed internet, trash, water all included in rent), recently renovated apartments (with pergo-like hardwood floors in all but the bedrooms, gives less of a standard issue "tan carpet throughout" apartment feel), well kept property (lots of trees and green grass), incredibly convenient and yet quiet location, and staff responsiveness to our cross country moving needs.  

Having read some of the negative reviews on here, I would like to clearly state to all that may be interested in this place, it is a very good choice to make.  Maybe they are tough if you are late on your rent, I have no experience with that, but it is a business after all.  We live on the ground floor and have had issues with a squeaky floor above us.  Maintenance immediately responded and worked hard to fix it.  

The only real issue that we've seen here would be parking.  You are going to have 1 assigned parking spot, and, unless you live near the rear of the property (we do) where there is overflow parking it will be an issue when you have guests.  How big an issue is really up to you.  There is nothing anyone can do about it except to enforce the parking rules to guarantee your spot.  Your guests may well have to walk a bit to your place.  Or, better yet, you may let them park in your spot while you take a short walk.  When you rent an apartment or do anything else for that matter, try and consider all aspects before, not after committing.  If parking is a major concern, then take a look at the unit you are considering and the parking arrangements before signing.  

So, if you are considering Diamond Sands take a look at the :
POSITIVES: "location, location, location", value (Direct TV, high speed internet,  water, trash incl.), curb appeal, quietness, responsive management and maintenance staff, excellent pool, club-room, and fitness center
NEGATIVES: parking, 22 year old apartments may need some tlc from time to time

For us, the positives far, far exceed the negatives.  I hope this helps you when considering your next apartment.

She said that they take a standard $300 cleaning fee out of everyone's deposit in order to turn the apartment to make it ready for the next tenant.  I was confused by this answer because I thought security deposits were supposed to be used for damage caused by the tenant.  So if their standard practice is to use all tenant's security deposit to turn the apartment, then no tenant would be able to get their deposit refunded, even if the tenant did no damage and returned a clean apartment.  When I asked about this, Francine told me that "you are not a typical tenant.  How we treat our typical tenants would not apply to you."  I didn't know what that meant.  She said the cleaning standards are in the lease.  When I asked to see a copy of the lease she refused to give it to me, saying that all their leases are unique, they don't use a template lease, and leases will only be released to tenants five days prior to move-in. Other than that, we do recommend this apartment complex if you don't mind a couple of hiccups, but for the price range, it is well worth it.

Homeless ppl on the property and in the dumpsters daily.

Shootings, people breaking into mail boxes, fire department stated this apartment is prone to huge fires, if you look up Townhome villas and keyword  news you will see. Cops say this is a Terrible area, lots of sketchy people walking around and homeless. If you decide not to get an apartment here and want to cancel or get denied you will not get the $200 holding deposit back it is non refundable so it costs almost $300 to apply. The leasing office takes screenshots and looks up information on Google not relevant to you to make their decision. Not updated, if your desperate I'd say go for it.. not a good area for families.

Management has frequently changed here and they do not walk the property or check gates are secure. There are many people squatting on the property who are aggressive. The pool in lease states you have use , but it was not opened . They changed security companies and never gave info to tenants. There are fights and kids that run through complex even on upstairs walkways through most of the day. Many unleashed dogs and people living here that are not supposed to be. We lived by a 2 bedroom that had more than 9 people living there full time. Lease rules are never followed.

I agree with the other review on here. Mailboxes were broken, then other people tried to further break into them. The gates are always propped open , so it's no really a gated community. Our car has been rummaged through 5 times. People wander through property because gates are opened. There are units with lots of people illegally subleaseing because they are townhomes , people will move additional people in. There are fights sometimes at night. There are lots of people that don't live here using drugs in the parking lot or sitting on the stairs at night. The laundry breaks down and there aren't enough machines due to it's a large complex and so many extra people that aren't on leases living here. So, plan on working around living with people who don't have leases here, and wander through because gates are left propped opened with rocks by people who don't live here and don't have keys.

Okay so at first glance we were tricked! The property seemed okay and the apartments are large. However, we haven't been able to check our mail in  over a month. As in the post office will not mail mail to our address. Why? The mailboxes are broken and no ones fixing them. Not the post office nor management. Oh and if and when the mailboxes are fixed, if there is anything larger than an envelope it will be held at the post office 4 miles away. Not being able to have mail delivered to where you live is beyond a hassle. I take public transportation which makes it ten times worse. Also, when we moved in we were able to pay with a good ole money order. Now we have to pay online or only at a location also 4 miles away. I dont like this method of payment. We weren't given any other option. Now my rent has increased because of taxes and fees with the online payment. Its just ridiculous.  There is no security during the day time. There NEEDS to be security during the day time. The gates are constantly being propped open. Which invites dumpster divers and all the local homeless people into the complex. These are things you are not told when you move in. ASK!

We absolutely love our apartment. the space we have is unbelievable for what we pay. its centrally located perfect to get anywhere. no other place has what we have. and even better our staf is amazing.

Have you ever been to jail? Me either, but I would imagine it would feel a lot like living at One Museum Square. The number of rules at this place is astounding — and at the price point, it's truly outrageous. There is a new security guard every other day at the front desk, you will know no one's name and the guest parking situation is terrible. If you want a true luxury experience, go elsewhere. This pretty place is horribly run and is NOT worth the money.
Can’t get a hold of anyone, been trying for two days.

It’s OK, at best. Looks like it would be really nice and clean, and it is for the most part, but consider this being an ikea version of a new building, if it were assembled by someone who didn’t read the instructions. There’s hardly any outlets, one/2 bedrooms of Gemma south were converted from a studio, in other words they built walls and put plexiglass up top and have no vents to the room or outlets on the walls, all the outlets are on one breaker and flips all the time. Management changes like every 6 months. Oh and for a new building there is NO soundproofing between neighbors. Again. Amateur ikea build.

We moved to the Gemma Apartments right when it opened, and we love our place. Management is really helpful and the staff is friendly. We've been getting great deals every year we renew and we plan on staying here for a while!

Building is in great location, inside apartments look really good but we have had a car break in, problems with getting hot water and unable to get consistent working AC. Management offers no answers or solutions other than, “we can’t do anything about it” and we’ll send someone to fix it. It’s embarrassing and if we hadn’t signed a lease already, we’d be leaving.

Avoid this place! The property management is unresponsive and neglectful. There have been multiple break-ins by armed homeless individuals, and management has failed to properly inform residents or take adequate measures to address the issue. Recently, a pipe burst in my hallway, causing water to flood into my unit, damaging electronics and personal belongings. Despite multiple attempts to resolve this, management has neither taken responsibility nor processed my claim for the damages. The communication is poor, and the overall experience has been unprofessional and frustrating.

Since moving into Alloy, I feel like royalty. The maintenance team has handled every request with care and always wears clean shoe covers inside my home. The office team is stellar and responds promptly. 10/10.

This place has the most insane amenities and views I've ever seen! I can't get enough of it. I constantly find myself staring out the window thinking how lucky we are to live here. Let's talk about the real reason you should move in, though: The people! Robert stayed in constant communication with me while we waited for our big move day. On moving day, Willie and Christian gave us V-VIP treatment! They helped my movers get set up, and offered everyone a crispy cold water with the Alloy logo on the botte--how cool is that?! Every one of my neighbors are some of the kindest, most interesting people I've met in LA. We hit the jackpot at Alloy and never want to leave. If you're into vibes, awesome people, and stunning views this place is for you.

Just moved into the building and as far as the building is concerned - I’m impressed. The building itself is beautiful with excellent amenities (some nearing final construction). A big 5 stars for Rob and the leasing team—they’ve been professional and incredibly helpful, even as they navigate the natural kinks of a new building/processes.

That said, one issue really stands out and weighs heavily on the overall review: the low shower water pressure. Unfortunately, it’s not just low—it’s literally a trickle. To put it into perspective, I’ve experienced better water pressure in remote areas of developing countries. While this might seem like a small detail, it’s not when the building is being positioned as the best in the city. For me a great shower is key to start the day right... and this issue is a major frustration.

I’ve submitted feedback and hope it’s resolved soon.... However, if it remains unresolved, it raises serious concerns about whether I made the right choice....

Living in Alloy has been an absolute joy for me. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a stunning lobby and a friendly concierge team that makes you feel right at home. The amenities are next-level—think rooftop pool with panoramic city views, a state-of-the-art gym, and even a cozy lounge space perfect for working or unwinding.

My apartment is modern, spacious, and designed with so much attention to detail. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, and the finishes are sleek yet practical. Having an in-unit washer/dryer is a huge plus, and the building’s soundproofing is excellent—I barely hear my neighbors.

The location is unbeatable, with tons of great restaurants and shops just steps away. It’s truly the best of both worlds: luxury living with the convenience of urban life. If you’re considering a move here, do it—you won’t regret it!

Leasing agent seems confused as to what's going on--after I paid the application fee and confirmed a MINIMUM of 5 times over text and call the unit that I wanted, she informed me it was being given to someone else. Accused me of ghosting her when she had not reached out to me at all throughout the process. Poor communication all around and management backed out of a deal we had initially agreed on while pressuring us to sign our lease. Would not recommend
I have just moved from Italy, I am lucky to find this beautiful contemporary design high-rise which I enjoy immensely and enjoy the views, amenities and the team.  I call my new residence, the dream!

I just moved to Los Angeles to finish up my fellowship program and was so happy with the service and amenities of the building.

  The building is brand new and is basically still under construction and a new owner took over right as I left so there was some problems that came with that.  My AC stopped working every other day and my water temp never got very hot.  Also the size of the units are very small, I had one of the bigger ones and it still felt a little claustrophobic at times.

But the maintenance super, George,  was great and always came same day to help fix any issues.  Trevor who is the manager was always great to talk to, even with all of the issues going on the with building he did everything in his control to make sure we were all happy and safe.  I agree with some of the other reviews I would stay again just because of him.

The Concierge team is also so nice and welcoming.  Alejandro especially was a pleasure to talk to everyday.  Though I wish the valet service would have started before I left.  

Overall the rooftop is one of the nicest I have ever seen but the building definitely needs some work overall.  That being said I will totally stay here again because I know that the staff will take care of me which is a rare thing to find.  And once the construction is done this building is going to be perfect!

I want to leave my negative feedback. Half a year ago I applied for a settlement and I received a refusal. They never returned the $1000 deposit. The manager Trevor doesn't even come out to explain why even though I've been to the office three times already. On my letters of which I wrote more than 10, he answered only 2 times that I need to wait and marked my letters as spam. I do not feel sorry for this $ 1000, keep it to yourself since they are more important to you than your reputation. But the way you treat customers I want people to know!

I only stayed here for a few months and the name of the building changed during that time.  But I absolutely loved my stay here!  This is a new building so there were issues that popped up but the Manager, Trevor, was undeniably my savior and did everything in his power to take care of the issues and make me feel comfortable.  The front desk staff were also amazing especially Peta who I always looked forward to talking to went I came home from my internship.  I would 100% come back just for Trevor and Peta, but the views are also the best views in LA hands down.  It's alittle pricey for the size of the apartments, but the service is well worth it!

This is a brand new building with beautiful amenities. Most of the managers are great, especially Trevor, he is very responsive and cares about the residents. They've work out most of the kinks that come with a new building. The AC system was intermittently functioning but seems to be fixed. The concierge team is also great. Peta has been amazing!
Safe, beautiful, and happy home and community :). We love it here
Great building, amazing views and upgraded apartments!

Very unprofessional staff including leasing agents, the building won’t get clean on the weekends, some staff bring their relatives/friends to use the amenities. It’s very noisy.  it takes forever to get to your apartment because The traffic is crazy in La cienega most of the time. The neighborhood is not safe especially during night
Extremely safe and beautiful environment to live in. Luxury feel with convenient and beautiful amenities.

ARQ is truly an amazing place to live in. Overall, the management and concierge team is professional, passionate, and friendly. The apartment is well-established, spacious, and has amazing views and facilities. The building is home to fascinating amenities and well-equipped with almost all the comforts needed. The cleaning team conducts cleaning work almost by the hour. Maintenance, however quick to respond to inquiries, needs improvement as I stated.
It’s a great building, very professional and friendly staff, great amenities
Very walking friendly, and has great amenities! The staff is super friendly and amazing!

The amenities here are amazing; the reason I decided to sign a lease. However, they're often rented out to the general public. When the building hosts a party or event for groups that don't live in the apartment, the parking fills up, guests are permitted to use the elevators and roam the building, and the roof is reserved without access. The building has a fire alarm system that goes off on a regular basis. Their policy of no smoking isn't being enforced, and the system goes off regularly in the middle of the night. Our water has been shut off several times in the last month for repairs, often for 8-10 hours at a time. The chairs and cabanas on the roof aren't cleaned and are covered in stains after only a few months of being there. I've caught front desk security asleep on the job several times. There's plenty of added fees in the contract. Including a package holding fee if you're out of town on a weekend, and a management fee you pay to a third party to handle your utilities. I've been overcharged by mistake every month I've been here, and it's my responsibility to contact management to adjust it to what the lease agreement says (often pressing them for weeks with an overdue balance). I've lived all over the country moving often with the military, and this apartment is one of the least organized and frustrating experiences I've had.

Just moved here 12 days ago. I'm very grateful to live here. The aminties are beyond perfect, amazing views, secured, and very clean. The building has wonderful team especially Cody who made the process very smooth and easy. I highly recommend this building.
Absolutely loving living here. The staff is friendly & welcoming definitely made me feel at home in my new place!!

My experience at The Bora has been great.
The staff and manager are always friendly to residents and responsive to any needs. The building is always very clean and well taken care of by staff and residents as well. The building itself is beautiful and all the units have great brand new appliances!

The building is really nice including the large gym, pool, and common spaces. I had a very good experience with management being on top of everything and they were very nice to me. Location is wonderful and close to all Ktown's best restaurants.

The management uses the bait and switch tactic to sell the amenities on new residents. The staff was quick to point out all the new common space amenities (rooftop grill, club house, etc.) and they emphasized that there was no need to reserve these spaces when I was first touring the apartment. However, it’s only been a few months actually living here where management has decided to enforce a $150 fee to book the common spaces. Honestly, the reservation fee to use the club house is standard, however the fact that they are expecting residents to pay $150 to simply use the grill is mind-blowing. Their explanation on why they are suddenly implementing this change? Because other apartment complexes are doing it. Well, I also don’t remember any apartment complexes charging $150 to USE A GRILL when I was initially apartment hunting. If I knew this earlier, I wouldn’t have decided to live here. Why call it an amenity when residents are required to pay a ridiculous fee to even use it?

Below average quality for a new-build apartment. The walls here are thin, to the point where I can feel my floors and walls shake when my neighbors do laundry. I’m not sure why they market themselves as a luxury apartment when they can’t even invest in good insulation.

This place is awful. Apartment walls are paper thin, constant bugs, dogs barking incessantly, apartment was wrecked when I moved in. The fixtures are all stained, the shutters are held up with tape, the appliances are well used, there’s random holes in the walls that have been shabbily patched up. This place is a nightmare and the managers are even worse. 100% do not recommend.

Living at Barringway Place for just over a year has been pretty much a dream! Right smack in the heart of LA, this place has everything a girl could ask for. It’s 10 minutes from the beach and Santa Monica Pier!! The location is a total win - I'm minutes away from the cutest cafes, buzzing bars, and some really cool shopping spots. Plus, catching the metro or a bus is super easy, making my commute and weekend adventures a breeze.

My apartment is my little sanctuary. It's got this modern, airy vibe that's just so me. The kitchen's sleek, and having my own washer and dryer? Life changing!! It's usually super quiet around here, so whether I'm working from home or chilling with Netflix, it's always peaceful. There is a gym and rooftop lounge area where you can host gatherings and have a nice view of the city! We've got this little community vibe going on, which makes the whole living experience even sweeter. The management holds events sometimes for holidays or for meeting your neighbors never seen a place care so much about its residents feeling at home! 

Shoutout to the building manager Monica - she's a legit star!! Anytime something needs her attention or I've got a question, they're on it. Fast, friendly, and super professional.
excellent service from the entire staff, really great events every month and the apartment interiors are beautiful!

Such a beautiful building with amazing amenities!! The gym is so nice and the rooftop is great for having friends over. Janet the manager is beyond helpful, friendly, and accommodating to my needs. Highly recommend!!

Living here for over a year has been fantastic! The amenities are top-notch, with a great gym and an amazing rooftop pool. The staff is incredibly kind and always ensures a comfortable and friendly atmosphere.

These are apartments are so tiny-- such a large building with tiny units and super pricey. I know it's LA but people are so greedy. Could have been the same sized building with less units and more space in them. sad.

Applied for an apartment, was told that I will get the apartment when I applied, was then told that apartment was unavailable. Tried upselling me, and I wanted to get my deposit back.

Never got the $500 deposit back

I've had a fantastic experience at The Eden! The atmosphere is welcoming, the staff is friendly, and the community feels like home. Everything is well-maintained, and there’s a great sense of belonging. I highly recommend The Eden to anyone looking for a wonderful place to live!"
Really happy with the Eden.   The apartments are beautiful.  The amenities are very good.   The staff is great!
The Eden DTLA is a new property located in a quieter area of south downtown in the Fashion District. The leasing consultants (Ruben and Darius) are super professional, responsive, and helpful!

Its nice looking and modern and looks awesome, but for a new build and for the price that they are asking for rent, you'd expect at least a small standing pool and spa/ hot tub and some tanning chairs, but there is none. There are so many great buildings just as nice in this area that offer everything this building has to offer along with a pool and spa with the same luxury experience for $500-1k cheaper for 1 and 2 bedrooms.

Everything is poor. appliances are easily broken and it takes you forever to have a maintenance guy fixing for you. The worst thing is their management, their response was so slow and they always push their responsibility to another department.

I've lived here for the past 11 months and I honestly cannot even try to explain how horrible of an experience it has been. The elevators are constantly in repair, sometimes for weeks at a time. I have had a leak in my unit for 3+ months now that has not been fixed. The wifi has not been working (if it does work, it is below 2mbs) for 3+ months as well. My desk chair suddenly broke and I was informed that a replacement cannot be had for over two months (conveniently after my lease expires).

Also, the water is out seemingly more than it works; and no, they will not notify you when it is not working. Maintenance staff come and go as they please, making a mess of our unit without notifying us of entry. Resident services are effectively useless and just push your request along without ever solving anything.

Seriously, stay as far away as possible. The location isn't good. The units are low quality and rundown. The service and maintenance are abhorrent. GHP management is a joke

I subleased an apartment here for a month. Let me say the apartment and the facilities it offers are great. However, it is in a bad area. I didn't have a car so it was nice that it was close to the train. But I soon realized that it wasn't safe. My first night there when I was walking back to the apartment a homeless man followed me yelling various things at me. As a young girl that was very scary especially because I had to walk through the parking garage to get to the elevator. I quickly learned not to leave the apartment before light and return before dark. I only ended up staying a week instead of a month because I didn't feel safe leaving the apartment. 

It really sucks because I really liked this apartment but the location is awful. The people are really nice(all college students), the pool is great, I had no issues with the apartment, and it's a really cool enviornment. I do believe that if you have a car it would be a totally different situation.
Bad, rude, slow, and disorganized management. Would not recommend this place.

I toured the Lorenzo and had the pleasure of working with Carla. She was wonderful and really made us feel welcomed. I’m a typical mom and had many questions (sorry) but she was able to provide me information that I needed and really put my mind at ease. The facilities themselves are very well kept and clean, this impressed me a lot. My daughter is excited to live at the Lorenzo as a sophomore and I couldn’t be happier. *I’ll update my review once she moves in. Thank you Carla, and the nature staff at Lorenzo. You all are doing a wonderful job!

They wont let you have a social life here as they will fine you for every little thing. Too many people..fine, tiny scratch on the floor... fine, didnt pick up your package beacuse you were out of town for the weekend... fine, water bottle left out on the balcony... fine. This place is truly the worst
This place has the worst application process ever, they still haven’t said anything and now I have 1 week left until my lease is up and I need to find a new place asap
I’ve stayed there one night as a guest, and it’s a most luxurious place you would find in downtown Los Angles
Very spacious apartments! Great building for networking.

I've loved living here for the last month. The community is great and the management staff are some of the most kind and helpful people I've ever met. The building is super clean, safe, and calm. I would recommend this building to anyone looking for a new home.
The management and staff here at Wilco are amazing. Always quick to help and also wonderful to talk to.

I like Wilco due to the friendly and responsive staff. It’s extremely important for staff members to maintain and manage an apartment complex. Your living experience largely depends on them and Wilco just has very good staff onsite

I highly recommend living in Wilco. The leasing manager and asst manager (Glen and Erin) are the nicest without compromising professionalism. Even maintenance and security are reliable. Amenities and community events make my stay here all the more fantastic.

I truly have enjoyed living here the past 3 weeks. I found Wilco on Zillow. All communication was done virtually as I was on the east coast. I moved in site u seen and everything was as pictured online! It smells great In the building. Truly appreciate the dog park and all the amenities. I am very pleased with my apt. Very spacious for a studio!

I'm so grateful to have my home at WILCO. The leasing staff - Erin & Glen were very helpful in the process of finding my apartment. They were responsive, caring and patient. I love my new home. It has exceeded all my expectations.
They never answer the phone, emails, or texts. I walked in to the elevator today and the floor was black, dog pee in the corner and the Sales person who rode the elevator with me even apologized.. :(

This place is a very secure and safe spot in DTLA, although many passer bys are near the building, it remains very safe and protected by a very well prepared staff. They handle packages and guests with great professionalism and safety toward the residents. I appreciate their great attitudes also as  each day I’m greeted by someone at the front lobby with a smile. Such a honest welcome each time. Feel safe and secure with friendly neighbors and staff!

This apartment is gorgeous and the garage is really convenient and safe. You will love the rooftop and fun social activities the staff hosts with food and beverages. Sergio is so nice and always so helpful!

I was lucky enough to stay at Sentral DTLA for a weekend. I loved it so much I leased an apartment here! The staff is amazing and the community is just as amazing! The amenities are top notch. The views to downtown LA are second to none. If you’re looking for a place for short term leasing or for a place to call home I highly recommend Sentral DTLA you will not be disappointed!

I stayed in the furnished room twice for a total of 6 months. I’m very happy with my life here. My room was spotlessly clean, with stylishly designed furniture, a large kitchen. The pool and hot tub are also great. All the staff at Sentral were friendly, they took care of our luggage and were quick to respond when l had a problem.
In my case, the rent included furniture and utilities, including Wi-Fi, so it was a good deal.

I moved in this past summer and love it here. I am on a high floor with a beautiful downtown view. The apartments are quiet, apart from the normal DTLA street sounds.
I love the rooftop. The staff is nice and they have some parties for residents once or twice a month that are always a good time. I recommend this building and already referred a friend who is moving in next month!

I just stayed here for a month as I was working on a project downtown with my job and I loved it. The building is very nice, well maintained, and I love the lounge and pool. The pool is heated so I was able to enjoy it even in December. The location is perfect, close to everything and very convenient for someone from out of town with no access to a car.
The folks at the front desk were very nice and helpful. Work will bring me back and I’ll definitely stay here again, it’s a lot better than a hotel!
I have lived I Sentral for two years and have had the best experience with the maintenance staff. Specifically Everardo always resolves any maintenance issues in a speedy and professional manner.

I really like this building. I moved in this summer and have been happy since. I love my apartment, it’s quiet and great for people like me who work from home on most days.
The pool deck is shaded and quiet during the week, perfect when you want to take your laptop and work outside. The staff at the desk is nice and helpful. I just had a friend tour as well and I hope he moves in soon!

I have lived in many cities and complexes but it never felt like home until I moved to Sentral DTLA ! The community, amenities, events organized by the building -everything is just unbelievable. I even feel like I will be stuck here for a while, honestly, because it's THAT good. I have never had yoga on the rooftop or comedy show at the place where I live, have you?? Sentral is killing it! Moving here was easy peasy , thanks to Alina, the leasing manager who has been taking such good care of me since I even started to think about moving here. Moving is supposed to be tough but not if your leasing manager is Alina, she makes things happen like magic without any effort from your side. Thank you guys for my beautiful Downtown life ??!

I toured 8+ apartments and was not set on anything until I toured Sentral. When I arrived, Kurt had multiple apartments to show me within my range, and helped me find the perfect home. Even after the tour he was quick and responsive with any questions I had. The look and lease deal was a steal, and 6 months of free parking in downtown LA?! Can’t beat it.
Cant wait to call the Sentral my home in 3 days!

Living at Sentral has been so wonderful. I know DTLA can be a commitment to move to but I truly haven't looked back. Kurt is the best, and from the moment I got my first (and now second!) apartment here it's just been a dream to work with him! The team at Sentral is so cool and welcoming. They are always checking the grounds to make sure the amenities look great and are enjoyable, you get to play, work out, and enjoy the facilities on both sides too which is awesome. I also love that they foster community by throwing fun events with food, drinks, music, games every once in awhile to meet friends, etc. To be honest, for the price, the well thought out layouts, and awesome people you can't really beat choosing Sentral for your next home!

Alina was the leasing agent that showed me many different properties that fit into my specific needs. She was very professional and went out of her way to ensure that I saw all of the amenities and features the building(s) had to offer.

After I found the unit I loved, she was very thorough and responsive through my application process. She never made me feel like I had too many questions or was inconveniencing her with some of my indecisiveness (haha).

In addition to Alina making a great impression on leaving there, the building was very well kept, clean, peaceful and everyone seemed to know each other which I love. It felt like a  close community even though there are two separate large buildings.

 I toured many different residences in DTLA for over a month and knew after my experience with Alina and touring the building that I had found the right place. Looking forward to moving in soon!

Alex is the best! I'm 7 month pregnant and got locked out of my apartment (problem wity the door). It was 10pm, Sunday night. Alex got my call and came within 15 minutes!!! He insisted to fix everything on spot even though he could have done it the day after. I really appreciate it! You're the best!
The management is extremely friendly, they are thoughtful when calling but the maintenence is slow and terrible at providing ETAs.

Well, we paid for what we get. However, lashelle really knew how to sell it to us and started off so nice, but quickly once we moved in we found all of the flaws and deceptions she did not tell us about before moving in. We thought we were getting a great value but at the end of the day, we get what we paid for and that’s a disappointment because I could have lived somewhere else.

I've been living here since 2019, they've gone through so many different managers. Nothing gets done around here. The elevator is always broken. There's 2 elevators and the other one has been out of service for at least 6 months. Packages get stolen all the time, the water is turned off at least once or twice a week. The trash area is disgusting and has roaches and rats in the premises. I've asked for a refrigerator replacement back in July of 2023 and it is now January 2024 and I still haven't gotten the correct fridges. I also had a gas leak and it was never resolved by their maintenance. There's no sense of urgency with getting anything done here. Ever since the new maintenance guy took over, nothing gets done at this building and you're given so many excuses and run around. Take your business elsewhere and save yourself the hassle and disappointment. This building has so many issues and they're not being addressed.
I would never recommend this place to anyone. Although Lashelle is the only good thing about PW and affordable rent, so you get what you pay for.
Love this place, convenient, staff is the best, always get the Park Wilshire personal touch.
Overall, my experience was great...Lashelle is amazing and very friendly. The apartment is just what I was looking for, clean with new appliances, pet friendly and very friendly security. ??

Park Wilshire Apartments falls short of all the promises they make to its residents. The price you pay doesn't match the service you are entitled to. The problems are as follows; The mismatch furniture of the lobby, the elevators being costly broken, the amenities in shambles( The basement is ugly, no tv, broken furniture, broken pool table the gym uncleanliness), poor and untrusty customer service. The Wilshire apartments are a place to avoid. If you have made the mistake of moving in such is the case with me all you can do is hope and pray that your lease date comes soon otherwise, it's gonna be a disappointment after a disappointment. I hope the following issues can be fixed but I know they will most likely not be fixed such is my experience with Wilshire. I hope I do get a call from you guys but again I know that will not happen as well.
General maintenance of the building is deteriorating.  The community spaces are either closed or in constant repair.  The building loses water at least once a month.

Do not consider living here.  The trash situation is unacceptable!  After 9 months of requests, they finally fixed the door.  It smells as you walk in and out you are bombarded by FLIES.  The water has been turned off over 20 times since I moved in August 2022.  I plan to move ASAP it is too bad my apartment the Penthouse is lovely but the lack of dependable management and service is untenable.
No one cares about your safety. Residents steal each other’s packages. Nightmare. Plus no where to park your car. Horrible
I have a great apartment on the penthouse level with all new upgrades.  New ownership and management are excellent too.

DO NOT MOVE HERE! Since living here the building has gone through two owners. The new management team is not helpful and incompetent in helping their residences tackle small issues one on one. They always seem like they're in a hurry or that the resident is wasting their time. 

It takes several days for management to respond to an email or understand any protocol to help the resident. It's never a pleasant experience addressing an issue with them. 

My apt. flooded in March - right before the stay at home orders went into effect and there was no emergency line to contact maintenance after hours. I spent the late night trying to clean up the apt myself and keep my belongings dry. The very next day, I quickly learned the building and the management team was ill-equipped to tackle this issue in a timely manner. They refused to put me in a hotel or even allow me to stay in another unit until my unit was fully recovered. It was a nightmare of a situation handled with apathy from an incompetent management team. It literally took 4 days to have my unit back to normal. 

Most of the units STILL don't have heat which is an amenity they offer. 

Rent here is way too expensive for the lack of communication and service the management exhibits. This place does not deserve the 3 stars it currently has. 

It's shame to have such a beautiful building operated under carelessness.

It's a really neat old building and the owners are doing some cool improvements.

Pros:
Location close to downtown and right off the park (if you have a dog).
Building is cool.
Building is well maintained, really clean.

Cons:
There is apparently a bed bug problem, I see them treating units frequently.
Units are tiny and there is no storage.
Elevators constantly broken.
Laundry area sucks, and it's expensive too!
Resident center closes at 10PM making it practically unusable.
"Manager" Debra is neither attentive nor professional.
Office staff keeps odd inconsistent hours making picking up packages problematic.

I wish they'd fix up the laundry area, add a tv or pool taable and some vending machines.

The Worst apartment experience here. If you think I'm judging, keep reading:

Good thing and only good thing: residents are friendly here.

Let's start:
1, absolutely no management, managers are friendly and professional only before you sign lease agreement! What about after, absolutely no reply to email, no answer to phone call, no follow up to your problem. 

2, this place has two elevators. One is tiny, another is a 'manual' elevator, which means you have to manual close its heavy door! More frustrating is, both elevators break every single week! 

3, this place has two gates also, once again, they are heavy, and they break every single week! 

4, managers they are tricky. After few months here I was told no checks accepted after 3rd of every month, however it only shows "late fees applied after 5th" on my agreement.

5, managers they have no profession. I looked my agreement which is clearly not automatically month to month renewal, however, when I planed to move out by my termination date,  they asked me for 30 days notice! So I went back and read my lease agreement again, it states clearly no requirement of 30 days notice unless you are monthly to monthly renewal. I sent my email, no answer at all

I'll let you guys judge, good luck
Made an appointment to tour the apartment complex via phone. At the time of the appointment, no staff was present and no follow-up/rescheduling was done. Waiting almost an hour before giving up.

TLDR: DO NOT MOVE HERE, DO NOT LET THE STAFF FOOL YOU

I've been in this apartment complex since 2016 and the quality of the staff and apartment has gone down the drain. 

Don't be fooled by the "friendly" staff and nice leasing office. This current staff (mainly Kendrick and Meriah) cares more about you signing the lease and throwing social gatherings in the clubhouse verse providing a safe living environment or providing solutions to issues that arise. 

Just a FEW of my current issues:

- COCKROACHES are constantly a recurring problem in the apartment and in the common areas.
- MICE have been an issue due to the constant construction. I haven't seen one in my apartment for a few years but they are on the property.
- I've had my car antenna STOLEN TWICE from my car while it's parked in the garage. Staff won't do anything about it unless you file a police report.
- My packages have been stolen countless times from the Parcel Pending lockers. Despite it literally being less than 10 feet away from the leasing office.
- I've had closet doors that don't fit my closet, they're too small and are cracked. They haven't been replaced because it's been on "backorder". It's been 6 years.
- Multiple brown stains on the ceiling.
- Repairs that are done on the apartment are usually given the "landlord special". Sloppy paint jobs to cover repairs.
- Cracks on the wall throughout the apartment complex.
- The laundry room is disgusting. They said they're remodeling it but I've stopped using it since I've had other residents open my machine while I'm using it.

I can go on and I'm sure someone from the management company will give a generic reply about my unfortunate experience. 
I've contacted the leasing office with my complaints but more often than not they say it's out of their control or they're working on the issue, but with the lack of results, it feels like a BOLD FACE LIE read off of a generic corporate response sheet. DO NOT MOVE HERE

I toured this apartment back in July and put a deposit down to HOLD an apartment. After reading reviews, I decided to pull my application. I was told I would be getting my deposit back. I paid with a card, but they said I would be refunded via check. Well.... Its now October and I have yet to receive my money. No one answers my emails. So beyond frustrating! Do not give this company your money. I am still waiting, still trying to get someone to find a resolution for this problem.

It’s pretty unfortunate that I have resolved to writing this review. I was so excited to move into my new apartment. I have been living here for four months now, and I have already had 7 packages stolen from this place. Whenever I’ve tried speaking to management about this issue, they quickly shut me down and tell me it’s “not their problem.” I was also told that if I don’t want people in the building stealing my packages, then I should buy one of their lockers. Well, I did buy one of their lockers, and I have still had THREE more packages stolen from me... I know this isn’t just a problem for me in the building. I have spoken to other people who live here who have dealt with the same problem. Even the security guard told me he’s never seen anything like it. I understand they can’t be responsible for lost mail in the building. But if they actually cared at all about their tenants they could make their mail room more safe and secure? Have a mandatory security guard check your ID before grabbing your package, have a secure mail room that requires a key fob before entering... SOMETHING. Because having 7packages stolen in the span of four months is ridiculous. ESPECIALLY after buying one of their scam lockers. I have plenty of friends who live in apartment buildings with their packages in a mail room who have never had to deal with an issue like this. Now, I have to result to buying a separate PO Box which can go up to $100 a year, and drive to another location just to make sure my own packages don’t get stolen in my own home. Sucks that something that could be resolved so easily isn’t considered important to the management of this property. I love everything else about my apartment, and don’t want to have to move again, but it’s a huge disappointment how poorly this place manages the safety of their tenants. If you do move here, all I gotta say is buy a PO Box somewhere else, before you regret having thousands of dollars stolen from you, and management looking at you like you’re in idiot for even bringing it to their attention

This is not a place you would ever want to stay  at. I've been here for three months and hated my entire stay. Every time there was a problem, it was never resolved or took forever to get resolved. I've dealt with bugs in a completely clean apartment, Washer and dryer machines not working to the point where you have to walk to the other building to get your clothes washed, 5 stolen packages In which I was instructed to "call the cops" because they would not show me any footage of what was going on, I've seen people sell drug's out of this apartment, the elevator NEVER and I mean NEVER works. Imagine carrying loads of laundry, groceries or a big case of water up flights of stairs by yourself. Fire alarms constantly go off in the middle of the night. My sink and drains would always clog, parking is ridiculous, even the parking garage is creepy and does not make you feel safe. I am a nurse staying here for a travel assignment. I will never stay here or recommend anyone to have to deal with what I've dealt with in 3 months. It's too expensive to feel like you're living in the projects. Please take my advice. I am not a difficult person at all. I was very excited to move to LA and this place made me think twice about my decision.

Lived here for 7 months and i hate it! When we first got our apartment we were excited but this place is only somewhat nice in some parts. Like lobby, gym area etc.
The apartments are awful. Super thin walls. Loud neighbors! You could hear everything!! Not just the neighbors that live in the building but the other buildings too! Thin windows! All of my walls were painted with the cheapest paint and now we can see all the hair and dust that was underneath from previous tenants!! Everything is old! The cabinets are falling apart. Not like the pictures on the site. Their is tagging everywhere. It stinks! Bugs and infested with flies inside the hallways! Security is bogus! They brake into cars and people steal things daily!! Elevator always broken! Ugh I can go on and on For the price!? Look elsewhere please!

We disregarded the reviews but all of them are reliable. Bad management, they will not help you with issues, you will be asked to call and schedule an appt rather than taking action. No response on emails or any update with some constructions. Parking is not good, it is a public parking, homeless can enter. There are a lot of renters who got their car broken without managements action and when you complain and want the cctv footages, they will tell u it’s a blind sppt etc. Also, security is not 24/7 and shortage, no one patrolling to make sure place is safe.

The hallways are filthy and on a weekly basis the trash shoots are overflowing and smell. There are also constant issues with the parking system that resulted in our frequently getting stuck in the building because the system was broken and there was never anyone that could be reached to assist. If you need help with anything from the management, you have to call and call and call because they hardly answer the phones and don't return messages you leave. Definitely do not recommend.

Lived in this building for 3 years, and after keeping my place incredibly clean with very little wear and tear, Broadway charged me over 300 dollars for a cleaning fee and kept the other 300 dollars of my security deposit to cover "repairs" that were not even done before I lived in my unit.

Stay away! Not only will they take your security deposit even if you are a model tenant, but your packages will definitely get stolen, you will be kept up at night by loud parties on the rooftop, and security does nothing to keep out large groups of people who seemingly have no connection to the building.

When I initially moved in, during COVID in 2020, this place was WAY cheaper than the other luxury communities in DTLA. Now, the prices are NOT worth dealing with management and the other annoying components of the property.

I've lived here for almost 3 years, and I regret it completely. 

Just about everything that seems great about this apartment while touring is a facade. It's noisy, it's loud, packages get stolen, plenty of people off the street get into the apartment walk the halls and use the amenities, building and garage can be disgusting and littered with trash, etc.

All of this continues to go on as management doesn't seem to effectively know how to fix things. 

I unfortunately stayed in this apartment over ease of not having to move everything in my life, but I wish I had just picked up and left. There's been some recent real safety concerns on property, and the building will not only not address it but won't let you break your lease despite fearing for personal safety and being an outstanding resident for years. 

AVOID THIS PLACE. Plenty of other great properties downtown that aren't as overrun and don't operate as cash grabs.

For me, use of the amenities by the public and safety for the residents is a major red flag for this building. Many people are drawn to this building for the pool, basketball court, and gym. While they are nice amenities, know before moving here that they are essentially treated as open to the public with the building management and security doing little to enforce its usage. The pool and gym will always have non-residents there using them, whether there are clients from a trainer being let in to take up machines or people sneaking in and finding ways to be let up to the pool to party. It's a mess, and building management's consistent reply to issues regarding amenities is that they are a bonus luxury they provide and not something guaranteed as part of the rent. If you pay the high price of rent to live here, I'm sure you'll feel otherwise on if you should have easy use of amenities...

Then, there's the basketball court. At about 4pm every night, don't plan on getting up some casual shots if you're a resident. Anywhere from 20-40 men off the street sneak in and continue to pry the door open to let each other in. They take up the entire space, and security refuses to remove them for two stated reasons: nobody ever listens to them and leaves or some of the security has good relationships with the people off the street and don't want to ruin that. This leads to a large group of people off the street that are unaccounted for being in the building. All from non-residents, there have been fights to break out, threats of violence when you try to leave to walk to your apartment, and guns have actually been pulled out before. Building management has been made aware of these issues frequently and have yet to instill any effective solution. The court is as bad as ever. With the issue being at an all time high, I let the building know that I was not comfortable living here due to my personal safety being questioned stemming from an issue they continue to not only not resolve but seem to be fine allowing. They could care less and won't let me break my lease until they've got all my rent money.

OVERALL, I would suggest going with a different apartment complex if you're looking downtown. This property is a bit too spread out with too much going on that seemingly everything falls through the cracks, and you're left with an apartment where anything goes, even if you don't live here.

I've been living here for two years. 

Location: great, I can easily find good restaurants and nice stores nearby, there is also a CVS downstairs which is very convenient

Management: good, maintenance requests are usually taken care in 3 days

In apartment: spacious floor plans, good amenities, hard wood floor is very easy to maintain

Noice: It's relatively quiet if the apartment is facing the courtyard, but could be loud if facing the streets. False alarm rings occasionally, which can be annoying in the middle of night. 

Overall good experience considering the price.

Lived here for one year, and overall it was a mixed bag.

Pros:
- good building security and location
- elevators are fast
- the building itself is well built (noise generally does not carry between units, except for very loud base)
- move in with La Saun was very easy and she was a pleasure to work with
- good appliances (dishwasher, half-size laundry, stove)

Cons:
- low square footage
- The quality of cabinets and other in-room fixtures is very low. It looks okay on the surface-level, but I think if we'd stayed there more than a year it would have started falling apart (ex: pieces of cabinets are glued and fall off, the flooring has gaps in between boards). Another example: there was a lot of issues with water leaking in one of the apartments below us, and they did a lot of work in our apartment taking plumbing apart to try and find the source of the leak (but never found it, as far as I know). Because of that, we didn't have a bathroom for an entire week of our tenancy.
- moderately often the HVAC would blow air with smoke (cigarette + marijuana) smell in it, which would made me cough horribly.
- The management repeatedly tried to overcharge me (one for a parking pass, once for utilities, once for rent, again for "damages" that I have pictures don't exist). I was able to resolve (most of) the first three of these issues, but it took a lot of time and effort.
- Parking for residents is "reserved", but not really - employees at the office park use many of the "resident reserved" spots during the day
- bugs in the pool - we used it a few times at the start of the year but stopped because there were too many dead bugs
- Once while we lived there, someone threw eggs from above at the park out front (makes it hard to feel secure using the park when eggs can rain down on your head)

The weirdest experience I had on my move-out day. A Landmark employee took one of our movers' dollys - with a piece of our furniture on it!! We didn't know where it had gone, and when I started asking about checking the cameras to see where the dolly had gone (the movers noticed it was missing after they loaded up the truck, and said it was expensive so we all tried for a good while to find it), an employee immediately took us right to the employee-only back room where someone (he?) had put it behind a trash can. However, our bookcase was totally gone and we never saw it again. Very strange....

I made a grave mistake by living in Circa for over a year. The building is in a state of disrepair and perpetually dirty. The 8th floor reeks of dog urine, and the elevators and water systems are constantly out of order, undergoing maintenance or
experiencing leaks. What makes this situation even more frustrating is the incompetence of the management, Kevin and Luke, who consistently refuse to address any issues. To make matters worse, Circa permits Airbnb rentals despite being prohibited in the leasing contract. l've complained to management about my neighbor's Airbnb and reported multiple incidents involving Airbnb guests, including police calls, attempted break-ins to my apartment, harassment and employee had open my package and stole the context. Management has shown no interest in taking action. Additionally, marijuana smoking is rampant throughout the building, despite it being explicitly prohibited. There were also numerous car break-ins due to the fact that the building is not fully secured I've attached pics.
Furthermore, Circa has been involved in controversy, leading to a criminal complaint against its employees for attempted rape. You certainly don't get the quality and peace of mind for the price you pay. I strongly advise you to stay away! I'm glad I'm no longer living through that hell. I would give it no stars if I could

Circa La is a beautiful place to live located in a great and easily accessible location. We just love how spacious our unit is, the high ceilings and all the windows that provide such gorgeous views.  The amenities are nice and are also well maintained. We did have a few issues upon move-in however maintenance and staff did an excellent job at resolving it. 
We especially love the community activities and holiday parties at Circa. So much effort is put into providing the residents with fun experiences.
My experience at CircaLA has been the best thus far. Excellent staff that is fully competent to do their jobs. Professional, helpful, and kind. They go above and beyond!
Great living experience and amazing views and central location. Amenities are top class!
Solid walls, cannot hear neighbors. Lots of cigarette smoke, fees for everything. It’s pretty in here but expensive for what you have to deal with.
Just moved in March 1.  Love it here.  Josephine offers great resident service.

This apartment was a great find when I found it, the community is very friendly and it's a very warm environment to live in. Management can be a tad slow when it comes to fixing things, but in spite of that they are great about communication on the subject. Laundry can be a bit pricey overtime because of their system for using the washers and dryers. Right across from a Ralphs and right off Sunset Blvd, very convenient and ideal location. Also definitely a very young building, a lot of 20 and young 30 somethings, but not as loud as you would expect from that kind of environment.

There are many factors to take place when finding an apartment.  One of which that gets overlooked is maintenance. Things break, but so far at this apartment complex, everything has been addressed and fixed within 24hrs. Also, all the units are pretty well kept and nicer compared to apartments nearby. Only downfall is that the walls could be thicker and windows double paned.

Extremely disappointed with Josephine DTLA. The so-called 'dog run' is insect-infested and poorly maintained. The gym lacks basic equipment, and room appliances are substandard. Experienced unwarranted intrusion from staff and serious security concerns. Not recommended.

8th and Hope is the perfect location for true downtown living. We moved here in June 2018 and love the location, friendly staff, and responsive maintenance crew. It’s a nice place to live. Also, pet friendly, which is important to us.

This building is very well maintained.  I feel safe here.  The concierge, leasing and maintenance staff are very professional and helpful if I do have an issue.  I also appreciate having a charging station at my assigned parking spot.  The apartments are beautiful and well designed.  Definitely worth every penny.
Nice place overall. Good location & staff, clean and modern apartments.

This building is well maintained, location is fantastic, close to all of the necessities.  I also feel very safe here as they have taken steps to ensure the safety of residents here.  The concierge team is great, so friendly and professional.  I absolutely love living here.

Overall 8th and Hope is a wonderful place to live. Great views, great apartment, and nice neighbors. I truly enjoy coming home everyday and spending time at home with my girlfriend. The neighborhood is very lively and makes you feel like a part of the community.

The water and electricity bills are shared among all residents, which means you have to pitch in several hundred dollars even when you're not home. More, packages frequently go missing. The elevator frequently has a strong smell of marijuana. The gym's air conditioning breaks down every month. After moving out, they come up with all sorts of reasons to deduct over 50% of your security deposit, even for things that are just normal wear and tear.

It looks good on paper and it was fine before covid but it is getting worse and worse. There’s only about 15 visitor parking spots for a building with over 100 units. Cars get broken into all the time and the thieves always conveniently know which floors don’t have cameras. Package delivery is a nightmare. All the security workers have attitudes and do their job poorly, if at all. There is a party every weekend on the pool area with about 30 people and security does nothing.  There are so many airbnbs in the building and im sure the building owners are the ones doing it. Only 2 treadmills in the gym work and the rest of the equipment is old, broken or deteriorating. The apartments share vents so you could get a smoker or stinky food smells in your apartment.

Giving 2 stars because maintenance is amazing and the employees are great. Also the other good thing is floors and walls are thick so you don’t hear much.
The location of the Vermont and the views are great. Just note that the utilities are split across all residents evenly.
Need better parking garage security,  people smoking in their unit all the time. Bec the smoke goes through the vents to other tenants vents

The unobstructed views, the amenities with the friendly security and maintenance staff makes this place one of the safest and cleanest apartments to live in K-Town. Excellent management team! Donna and Sunny have helped me to settle into a clean, peaceful and quiet home. Thank you.

The Vermont has a lot of potential to be a mecca for young professionals & as a gathering place for social media users/influencers. However management's lack of connection to the residents and community makes this difficult because the residents are not connected to the people that make up our community even though we live in a tight knit space. More residential engagements mean more communication and awareness of what the community needs,  and encourages the residents to invite their friends and families over  or even move in.

The management has been awful here, starting off with our move in, where we found water damage and a leaking dishwasher, to which our management responded by claiming it was fine when they visited the house last. We have been contacting them about safety issues regarding a door that does not lock properly, which was also ignored. Managers are never easy to get a hold of and are consistently rude despite not doing their jobs. My advice: pick any other place to live, save your money and sanity
2+ years living at Kentwood- quiet, safe and good neighbors. We really like how the property is managed- well kept plants, lawn and walkways.

I was looking for a community a bit closer to work (West LA) and found The Villas and Matthew the property manager. He helped us through the rental process despite me having to push back the move-in date because of a traveling responsibility. We couldn't be happier.

Our apartment is very spacious...I think around 1400 sq. ft. My wife LOVES the kitchen and bathrooms - and that makes me happy!

Private rooftop patio is a nice touch and the hardwood made us fall in love.

I would recommend this to anyone looking for a quiet, comfortable community.

How can the unit not be ready on the DAY of the contracted move-in date when I was asked to sign the lease agreement THE DAY BEFORE THE MOVE IN DATE?? I was told that I could move in at 10am and when we got there, they said the unit isn't fully ready and we would be able to move in by 2pm. Then, after I reached out and called them 10 times before someone picked up, we were told to wait until 5pm. Again, nobody at the Chadwick is reaching out to me to give me an update. I am the one who is calling and asking for updates. At 5pm, we were told we couldn't move in on our agreed-upon contracted date and I was told that I could move in 5-6 days. Is this a joke? (Please take a look at the photos as this was the terrible state of the apartment unit).

My experience with The Chadwick Apartments has been NOTHING short of a disaster. From the very beginning, the management has displayed a complete lack of professionalism and responsibility. We applied for a unit in late July 2024, and despite receiving approval in mid-August, the communication from the leasing office was inconsistent and unreliable. The staff, specifically Katherine Westfal repeatedly assured us that our move-in date would be on September 1st, which we planned our entire relocation around. However, when the day arrived, we were told—after hiring movers and coordinating utilities—that the apartment wasn’t ready. This information was given to us last minute, forcing us to scramble, cancel our plans, and absorb extra costs due to their incompetence. On top of that, Katherine has the audacity to be disgustingly rude to my family and me when she was in the wrong.

The communication from The Chadwick has been appalling. Promises were made and broken time and time again, with no proactive effort from the staff to keep us updated. We had to constantly chase them down for information, only to receive conflicting answers and excuses. The whole process was characterized by mismanagement and a lack of transparency. Even after their assurances, we were later informed that the unit would take an additional two to three weeks to be completed. In the end, they couldn't even provide a move-in date because there was a pest infestation in the unit. Why was this not taken care of before the move-in date? Also, my family saw a gigantic cockroach at the apartment complex so it seems they have a huge bug problem. Disgusting.

I moved into this building on July 15th and regret not conducting thorough research beforehand; had I done so, I wouldn’t have chosen to live here. Since my arrival, I’ve experienced frequent package thefts, which raises the question of why there are cameras in the mailroom if no action is being taken. When I moved in I had submitted work orders regarding my plumbing, It’s October and still no one came to fix it. Additionally, the building is dealing with a significant roach infestation. I encounter roaches daily, whether in my unit, the laundry rooms, or the hallways. Recently, I even saw someone moving out with their belongings covered in roaches.

-Save yourself the headache.

DO NOT MOVE HERE. PLEASE LISTEN TO ME DO NOT MOVE HERE. 

I have lived here for a year and had about 2 good months MAYBE. Everything is broken from the gate to the parking lot, the washing machine and dryers, the gym equipment and “secure” mail room. I have had laundry stolen, packages stolen, guest parking in my paid spot and all of this with no extra repercussion. Management does not care about their tenants all they want is their rent. This is a bottom of the barrel apartment complex which is why is is cheap for LA standards buy trust me you get what you pay for. The amenities are just to pull you in; the weight room sucks and is always something broken, tenants don’t pick up their dog poop in the soccer/turf area, the pool is rarely blue more of a green-ish color, the grills are dirty from parties and nothing is done about it.  There is a homeless encampment that takes up half of the street that no one does anything about and growing very rapidly. Bugs and insects are all the the halls and creep their way inside of the apartments no matter how good or clean you are. The community manager is NEVER available at all and does not answer emails and has no personal line it just takes you to the leasing office. This is my first apartment and I wish I never ever would have found this place it makes living in dorms look like the Ritz- Carlton. I cannot stress enough do not move here unless you are happy losing your values and sanity there are better options all over and wish someone would have warned me.

I went here as an interested applicant and walked out thinking I was pranked, but unfortunately I wasn't . The privileged guy that gave me the tour, saw dead roaches in the unit he walked me into and was completely unfazed, in fact, he seemingly got offended when I pointed them out the in living area, when I pointed out another dead one in the bathtub and others almost every 5 -6 steps I took. I asked about this problem and he said they have exterminators coming regularly. I asked "How's that going"? He was silent. Obviously it's not going well if the building has a massive infestation problem. This seems to be the acceptable norm here at the Chadwick. If paying a lot of money for a roach infested apartment this is the place for you. Not to mention the strong smell of DOG URINE that is throughout the facility, apparently the residents are allowed to let their animals urinate wherever they please. Sad I wasted my time to experience this.
There are roaches, packages ALWAYS stolen, car almost stolen, clothes stolen from the laundry room, machines always down in laundry room, animal poop every where.

Management is incompetent and unprofessional. Please believe all of the bad reviews for this complex. Management is aware of these issues and refuses to fix them. They do not communicate with residents and do not respond to emails. The complex is far from a luxury apartment complex. Do yourself a favor and rent somewhere else.

I've had a thoroughly disappointing experience at Ava Toluca Hills. For four years, I endured subpar living conditions and unprofessional management.

During my first 2.5 years, I resided in a unit on the first floor plagued by relentless leaks every time it rained. Despite numerous complaints, maintenance only offered temporary fixes, forcing me to endure the inconvenience repeatedly. Eventually, after relentless pestering, they begrudgingly relocated me to a new apartment.

For the next 1.5 years, I maintained impeccable cleanliness, only to be slapped with exorbitant charges upon moving out. Despite passing their initial inspection, they concocted frivolous charges for stove glass replacement and cleaning. Conveniently, they failed to furnish any receipt for the alleged replacement, leaving me to suspect foul play.

Furthermore, the flashy amenities they flaunt are merely a facade to mask the shoddy quality of the apartments. Living on the first or second floors is a nightmare, as the paper-thin floors amplify every sound from the neighbors above, necessitating constant earplug use to maintain sanity.

In conclusion, Ava Toluca Hills is a rip-off disguised as a luxury community. Don't be swayed by their amenities; the reality of living here is far from glamorous. Save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere for a place to call home.

As a current resident in AVA Toluca Hills for 3 years(Moving out of here immediately as soon as I find a place), need to tell you that it is not worth the money you pay for this place and I'll explain here to you why:
1. The security harasses you or your guests in the amenities every hour.
2. Paid parking which is comparably expensive, is only and only for one of your cars. If you have 2 cars, you only get one sticker, and the other car without the sticker will get towed if you park it in your own PAID expensive spot! Disrespectfully ridiculous! 
3. The hallways always dirty, full of bugs laying down or dog poops. Not only that, you may occasionally find empty alcoholic bottles by your building or parking spot!
4. Staff do not care about you or your needs. Disrespectful and unprofessional.
5. As an electric car owner, the charging station is too narrow that every now and then the car gets small scratches by the cars parking nearby.
We never had most of this problems mentioned here back in 2020 or 2021. Do not waste your money here. Moving out soon! Ciao AVA Toluca Hills!

It's got it's apartment living issues that just about every place has. But I have never had an issue with excessive bugs or any roaches at all! For LA, that's generally asking a lot. We had the usual noisy people around us, but nothing you wouldn't expect living in an apartment community. The amenities were amazing pre-COVID, and during the chaos of 2020, the on-site store was heaven sent and always had the things we needed to get through. The amenities are decent so I'll give one star for that, and the staff is pretty nice. Maintenance team is good too. 

DONT LIVE HERE!

When I first found Empire Landing (now Atrio) I fell in love. It felt like a Hawaiian oasis. COVID happened and the property was sold to Westfield and everything has been getting worse. What changed?

1) Guest parking which used to be easy and free, now requires you to register your guest's car and driver info, and charges $7 if they stay overnight. Not a problem if you don't want family or friends to visit. Also, the 2-bed units got one of their free parking spots taken away and are now charged $75/month to keep it.

2) That green space that you fell in love with during the tour? Don't get used to it. The property manager confirmed they're ripping up the grass and removing privacy shrubbery to put in concrete fire pits. They also removed tables and much needed shade at the pool, instead they have fancy looking furniture that looks nice in photos but is uncomfortable in the desert summer sun/heat. (Dark colors absorb heat!)

3)They closed the pool, gym and business center for renovations while simultaneously raising rent 10% for current renters. Didn't you know living in a construction zone with half the amenities is the newest luxury trend? Unless your salary goes up 10% every year, you'll be priced out of your unit within a year or two. Don't expect loyalty for being a reasonable and long term tenant. But back to the renovations... the pool looks exactly the same as before the "reno" except the showers are now missing hardware and there's dead wildlife painted into the deck!  The gym will be smaller than it was because they took half the space to convert to a movie theater (I'll be surprised if they don't charge extra to use it). They also removed the business center in favor of an open layout co-working space... because  who needs privacy?

4) They fired the 24/7 security patrol and replaced them with a "new and improved" overnight ONLY security patrol. The old patrol used to walk the premises all the time and were always super helpful. This new patrol ... I NEVER see them. 

Most of the families that were here moved because the prices have gone too high and the policy changes don't justify the price increases.

This apartment complex is perfect for people who want something relatively close to Ventura Blvd, as well as something that will make you feel safe.
