It's extremely close to the 101 which is a huge plus and it's dog friendly! The apartment manager also seems like a really good person who in the end will look out for your best interests. The only complaint I can think of at this point is the tandem parking, but it's honestly worth it for all the other benefits you get!

I appreciate you asking for my feedback, but unfortunately, my experience has been negative. Given the ongoing noise issues, lack of enforcement of quiet hours, and poor management communication, I wouldn’t feel comfortable leaving a review you’d want to share for marketing. I’m happy to provide details to someone other than Francisco if it helps address these concerns, but as it stands, my feedback wouldn’t be positive.
My experience was great. The staff is very professional and very helpful. The neighborhood is nice.
It’s a wonderful place to live. Thanks you Living at Noho.
Affordable spot in a fairly central part of LA! Great first apartment for newcomers to the city!
Overall my living situation here has not been horrible, however the location of my apartment is on a busy street & i have witnessed a lot of violent activity from my balcony.

Living at NoHo is great. I love my apartment layout and the overall location. The amenities are always clean and inviting. The application and move-in process was simple and I felt supported every step of the way. I’m so excited to be a part of this community and look forward to making this my home for a while.
The property is not maintained well. Tons of break-ins (cars and units).

Not sure how this is a 5 out of 5 with so many terrible reviews. Lived here 2 years now.   Construction has been going on for about a year now and there are constantly workers all around the complex and constant noise.  That's not the real issue though.  Management is the issue here.  Since moving over to a mobile app it is impossible to get an actual person on the phone to talk about an issue.  And they don't even call you back when you do leave a voicemail.   It's not a terrible complex.  But it's nowhere close to what they charge for this place.  Tenants are constantly leaving trash everywhere, dogs crap everywhere, and despite the maintenance's best efforts the place is constantly a mess and the elevators are always breaking down.  It's been two-plus years since the elevator was inspected.  Wish instead of trying to touch up the place with some paint and cheap floors they'd make the experience here better.  I won't live at an Avalon Apartment after my lease is up here.

Sketchy area filled with homeless people outside. There was a drug related murder here last year. 10% rent increases every year and car break-ins are normal. 

The cherry on top is they just started major overhauls to all the buildings that's going to take at least a year to finish. We get woken up from construction every morning at 6am. 

Price is ridiculous for what you get, don't fall for the "luxury" apartment trap - it's everything but!
I couldn't even get a tour. They said, they would call with instructions the day before and I received no call or instructions. I responded to them via email and got no response.

A man was shot and killed here this morning!  The gates in this "gated community" are  broken all the time.  Vehicle break-ins happen way too often. The elevators are super slow, they creak, and have actually stopped working while I was inside one of them.  They are unsafe and terrifying to use.  People leave target and grocery store carts everywhere.  The trash piles up in the trash bins and people just leave their trash in the parking lots.  I pay extra every month to rent a small storage while my parking spot neighbors leave furniture and various other items stacked  up in their parking spaces.  One of the doors leading to the emergency stairs in the event of a fire is LOCKED with no other alternative but the elevator which would be dangerous.  This complex is just downright horrible and it is turning into a disgusting slum.  STAY AWAY!!!!

Beware! Take pics upon moving in and moving out. Make sure you do the walk through with them and have them complete the inspection with you present otherwise they will charge you to replace the carpet. This happened to my daughter and numerous other tenants according to previous reviews.  Criminal behavior in my opinion.
Sway's staff are top notch, very professional, courteous, and fun!  They build a community through events and their frendliness.

Living at Sway has been an amazing experience! We feel so welcomed and safe, thanks to the overnight security. The amenities are top-notch and well-maintained, including the gym, pool, hot tub, and various community events. A special shout-out to Brittany, who has been exceptionally thorough and supportive throughout our application and move-in process. Her constant communication and check-ins have made us feel right at home. Brittany's dedication to creating a welcoming and vibrant community truly sets Sway apart. It's truly a wonderful place to call home.
Sway is such an amazing apartment. Great location and amenities. But above all else, the people are amazing and the events are top notch! Well done Sway team!

I lived in a one bedroom (Approx. 670sq ft) on third floor from July 2020 to November 2022. 
PROS:
The apartment is well thought out with a wine coolers etc and ample storage.
Everything always worked in my apartment.
Maintenance was typically quick to respond (under 48 hours).
There is nightly security.
The amenities are truly beautiful and I always felt like I was living in a resort. 
Since March 2022, the management team have put on some spectacular events for the residents including mermaids in the pool! There is roughly one event per month.
Neighbours are friendly and never had any noise issues etc.
Location is fantastic with a TJ's, Vons, the Pier, bars and restaurants all within a 15 mins walk.

CONS:
My biggest bug bear was a limited closet size in the bedroom 
Occasional late night / early morning noise from the local restaurants during clean up. 
The level of homelessness in the area has definitely risen.
Rent prices are astronomical - I got a great deal as I moved during covid.  Current rent prices are outside my range.
The management team are typically responsive and very friendly - There have been times that response has been limited. For example, it took over 2 months to get my windows cleaned.
The amenities are great but they are not used much and the hot tub breaks down a lot.
Getting packages and food deliveries is annoying. Food delivery people need to be let into elevators etc by the security - who do hourly patrols so can be missed easily. And you need to get packages from the mail room which only the staff have keys to - this is more about the inconvenience than anything else.
I am annoyed that I paid $75/month pet rent for my cat - why is it so high?
I really wish they had built some amenities on the roof - its wasted space with spectacular views. 

Overall I loved living at Sway and I will miss it. If you can afford the Santa Monica lifestyle, its a wonderful choice.
Sway is a hip residence loaded with amenities and surrounded by downtown Santa Monica activities. Good times!
Sway is horrible. Stay away unless you want to live a nightmare and pay big for it. Water issues, security issues, lack of proactive attention to known issues, unresponsive management.

Worst management ever. You can never get things fixed, packages get stolen, credit card gets stolen, and management come into your unit without permission and leave the balcony door open for a "fire drill" without telling me. Bad customer service and disrespectful of tenants. I would recommend moving to a different place for your mental well-being.
This is the worst apartment I rented ever. Cheaply made it. No hospitality , No customer service.

Please DO NOT rent here. Please save your money and quality of your life. Please look for another place. 

You will literally share everything with your neighbors. You can hear what they watch/listen to/talking about and the intimate sound at night. This building is built in a very thin wall. Also, you can hear every single footsteps from the upper floor, not only footsteps, you can hear if they drag something. The manager will NOT HELP YOU AT ALL. 

This place is the worst place I ever rented in my life. I wasted money the whole year. I would rather pay more and live a better quality/peaceful life. 

I highly NOT recommend this place.
Poor sound privacy, I can hear what neighbors are saying, feel like living with roommates. Poorly built. Not worth the price.

This is one of the worst places I’ve lived in. I was excited to move into a new building in Koreatown. From the very beginning, it’s been nothing but trouble. Moving in was a pain. Trying to get in communication with the leasing office was always difficult. After move in, there was rarely anyone in the manager’s office. The walls of the building are really thin. You can hear people walking outside and above you. Everything is cheaply made. 

Worst part of it was at move out. Trying to find a place for the moving truck to park was difficult and management wasn’t accommodating. We had to ask the restaurant next to the building to let us park in their loading zone. 

Finally get out of there when they send the move out bill with a bunch of bogus charges. There’s a “balance forward” charge when I had paid my rent in full prior to move out. They charged $150 cleaning fee after we’d cleaned the place spotless. Almost $300 in painting fees for what should have been wear and tear in the apartment. Lastly, they had a poorly installed bathroom mirror that had water accumulation behind it, that they’re trying to force us to pay for to replace. They did everything they could to keep the security deposit. 

Over all most expensive place I’ve lived and hands down the worst place I’ve dealt with. Save your money and live somewhere else. I’d stay away from any apartments managed by this company as well. Terrible communication, terrible amenities, terribly built, too expensive, and will cheat you out of your entire security deposit.

Pros: Management has been responsive to my complaints relatively quickly. It LOOKS nice.  Promotional rate was pleasant but still not worth the cons. No other pros here, honestly.

Cons: Cheaply built, and not ready to be moved in. Hence, the promotional rate. High noise level. Normal noise gets amplified due to structure. Washer/dryer combo unit vibrates and moves when in use, because it sits on uneven wooden board. The W/D does not remove lint so you have it all over your clothes and takes 3-4 hrs to complete a single load. The walls are very thin and hollow. I can hear my neighbors talking, coughing, sneezing, tv/music through the wall. You can hear the hollowness if you knock on the walls. Privacy is non-existent. The trim along the bottom of the wall is brittle. A picture frame fell off the wall onto the trim revealing the fragile material. There was trash visible from the courtyard that remained for a few months before it was removed. The metal gate leading from the courtyard to the lobby and garage would clank loudly throughout the courtyard whenever someone used it. A simple fix was ignored for almost half a year. I wouldn't be surprised if it was actually a tenant that did end up fixing it. Visitors were parking in assigned parking and management gave out warnings for 6 months until they finally started to take action. H2O temp in the shower is inconsistent. As of now I have to turn the handle almost all the way high to get hot water.  

There are other issues. All these are factual statements and in no way are they exaggerated. I suspect many people leaving when leases are up. I'm already here on Apartments.com looking for my next move and my lease doesn't end for 5 more months.....but I honestly have been looking and thinking about it months ago. I just feel bad for the next tenants who will also be trapped with the lease without realizing the flaws.

To management: Too many complaints, and not much you can do. Some you can and you have, but it just took way too long for appropriate actions to be taken. For example, here something you can do about the trash chutes. If someone keeps clogging the trash chute or leave boxes and trash outside of the chutes, use the camera and find & fine the problematic tenants. Don't make the recyclable chute into a trash chute and make all the tenants take the recyclables to P2 and dispose of them there. So impractical and hassle for your tenants, and, above all, not a good move.

I moved here in August 2018 and immediately discovered that my A/C did not work. Management responded promptly to my complaint and were able to send someone to fix it. They did need to fix a couple times over a period of 3 weeks but eventually they discovered the problem and was able to resolve it. Additionally, as it became colder, I found out that my heat wasn't working. They also were able to fix this promptly.

My reason for giving 4 stars is because, despite the other reviews on here, the apartment is a great place to live. The apartment complex is very clean (except for the occasional tenants leaving dog poo in the garden). Management has been very responsive to me (Shane has been extremely helpful and polite). I have not had problems with the fitness center, parking garage, or rooftop. The internet has been extremely fast and has only gone out once. The surrounding neighborhood is also great, ton of things to do.

My only complaint is that the rent is very expensive compared to other luxury apartments in Koreatown. Although, I would like to continue living here, I will probably move out after my promotional lease ends. I don't see justification for the rent being so high.

This is a very new building so any positive reviews are fake and done by the management. The building has so many issues and all the current tenants hate it. It's understaffed and everything breaks due to poor quality.

I just moved in a month ago and have been very pleased with my choice to live here as opposed to other apartments in Koreatown. Luna's location is excellent as it is walking distance to most trendy restaurants and bars in Koreatown. Furthermore, this apartment complex has great amenities like a decent gym with enough equipment to never have to wait very long for other residents to finish. I also had a great time hosting a BBQ with friends this past Sunday while watching football streamed from the apartment's free WiFi.

Lastly, I want to commend the folks in the front office: Shayne, Jena, and others who have been communicative and helpful with my needs as a resident. 

I assume some of the negative reviews left below may cause concern, but my experience has been quite the opposite. I am a real resident (5th floor) and I've had a great experience with the front-office, so I wanted to leave some positive and honest feedback.

DO NOT RENT HERE period! 

It is very unfortunate but is the truth. The apartments yes are nice if you get one that is completed 100% and does not have any unfinished stuff. 

This is a new complex and everything expressed here before is true. This place is bad. It is dirty everywhere. Don’t get me wrong. There’s two part time maintenance senior people and they try their best but management does not really care. You try to let anyone here know about the issues and you get retaliation back. The Manager is very disrespectful towards you. 

The P2 or parking always smells like trash. I cought a cockroach walking on outside my car windshield this morning. You walk around and you just want to throw up. The gym is always dirty and that’s an unsanitary situation. I invite the sanitation Department to give a visit to this place and for sure they will close it. Everything is unsanitary here except your apartment which is the only nice thing if you get a good one. 

The roof top please forget it. The bbqs have food from I don’t know when and the floor is disgusting. 

Please take my advice as others did. Look around there’s better a bit more expensive but for sure you will get a sanitary clean safe place where manager and management really do care and does not brush you away when you bring normal concerns. 

Beware!!! Is my best advice. I didn’t believe the comments and I decided to join due to the promotion of the two months but it has been just a week and this is a nightmare already. 

Don’t do it. Yo are on your own once you sign those papers. 

Cheers and good luck

This apartment complex has been a refreshing experience when searching in the Los Angeles koreatown area. The building has a modern feel and plenty of elevators so there is never an issue of getting up and down. The roof has a space with three separate BBQ and Lounge areas so there’s always room to hangout and enjoy the view of the Hollywood sign. Downstairs is a sleek lobby and gym equipped with pretty much anything needed for a solid workout. Shane in the front office has been more than helpful explaining the simple ways you can put a maintenance request in and has even given me a number to text if needed for any type of help etc. Jena moved me in and the process was as simple as can be. I enjoy living here a lot and hopefully my review shines light on the reality of what it is like to live here because I have had a 5 star experience since I moved here.

I just moved into this apt complex and I am very disappointed. It is so dirty! The parking smells like trash, there were boxes thrown in the parking today! Trash was all over in the trash area, smelled horrible, the doors were not even closed. The halls are dirty, they don't seem to be maintaining it and it's very sad that we are paying so much for a brand new building and having to deal with this. Also, management and leasing agents don't seem to care. Some can be rude, specially a blonde girl who I have interacted with and she had a very bad attitude. They need to act more professional and learn how to treat people with respect. We are paying to live in a clean environment and also have our concerns addressed. Please look somewhere else until management does something about it.

BEWARE! This is a warning to you all that this place may look nice on the outside, but internally there are just SO MANY ISSUES. The 2 months free rent might be a good deal, but I can see why they would need to offer that. Where do I start..
Their management team is non-existent. Good luck trying to get anything done or have any of your questions answered by their team. Once you’ve signed the papers you’re on your own. My neighbors and I have to crowdsource answers amongst ourselves because their team just does not respond or give proper answers. 
Incomplete construction. Yes, you read that right. It's as if they decided to complete 95% of the job in my unit and then lease it out without ever finishing. After multiple promises of them resolving the issues in my unit, 1.5 months later still nothing is being been done about it. 
Free internet promotion? It may take you a month to get any information on how to set this up because that's how long it took me. I literally had to ask 4 times for this. 
Online rent payment was promised at the time of move-in. Nearing my August rent payment however, I sent multiple emails over the span of several days asking how to do this. After management initially told me they would send me the info, they didn’t (what a surprise). I sent multiple follow up emails because I didn’t want to pay any late fees, but they completely stopped answering. Yes, they ghosted me right at the deadline of when our rent payment was due. Does that make sense to anyone? I am trying to give them my money but they won’t tell me how to do so.
Other known problems from myself and other tenants after speaking with them: Blinds, washing machine, elevator, trash chute, AC, mailbox, etc. This is a brand new complex, so there shouldn’t be this many problems.
All in all I really want to like this place, I do. But their incompetent management team is giving me every reason not to. It’s also very evident they rushed out this apartment complex prior to everything being ready as evidenced by all of the problems tenants are having. Until Luna can get their act together, I would highly recommend looking elsewhere.

The apartment itself is great—modern layout, clean common areas, and well-maintained. However, there are major downsides that impact the experience.

There’s no sense of community—no group chat for residents, no events, and little engagement. The leasing office is slow to respond, making simple issues, like correcting my pet fee despite early ESA documentation, unnecessarily drawn out.

The biggest frustration is EV parking. I was assured there was no waitlist before moving in, only to find out after signing that there actually is one. Meanwhile, non-EVs occupy designated EV spots, and despite promises of availability by the end of January, I’m still waiting with no clear timeline.

While the living space is great, management’s lack of responsiveness and transparency can be frustrating, especially for key amenities like parking.

Apartment is really nice. Community has lots of events that they offer. Location is nice too. They send emails for fun events around the area for the weekends. Building events are posted in the elevators and also sent out through email.
So far I love the community it is very clean, very peaceful overall there is very good energy in this building. I’m happy to be living at the Axis!

The community is beautiful, the staff is exceptional  & the residents are pleased with where they live. Before making my decision on living here I asked a few residents about their experience and thoughts of the community. There were no grievances.
Outstanding service! Friendly staff, quick responses, and excellent quality. I highly recommend this company for their professionalism and attention to detail. Truly exceeded expectations!
i’ve been at axis apartments for almost 2 years now and i still enjoy living here! no complaints from my side. it’s a great experience and i’ve already recommended to my friends!

I had an extremely disappointing experience with the management of this apartment complex. Upon moving in, the unit was unclean, with numerous pending repairs despite prior assurances. The management team was unresponsive to work orders, leading to significant delays in addressing even basic issues. Furthermore, their AppFolio system is full of glitches—at one point, I had access to another tenant's lease, and it took them months to resolve the issue.

The worst part was the end of our lease. It took over a month to receive our security deposit back, and they deducted charges for pre-existing damages that had not been fixed since move-in. There were no concrete bills or proper explanations provided for these deductions. The entire process felt deceptive and left us with a deep sense of frustration. I would strongly advise future tenants to avoid this property and any managed by CBG. The lack of transparency and respect for tenants is appalling, and it was one of the most stressful renting experiences I’ve ever had.

Since I moved in, we have dealt with dilapidated living conditions, including mold, broken drawers and cabinets, homeless people sleeping in the garage and breaking in to pull fire alarms, and that's just getting started. They also have the audacity to raise rents, which is probably why so many people are leaving. They are bleeding residents and trying to win them back by offering referral bonuses that don't even cover 2 weeks of rent.
It's cool. No problems. Close to everything. Always a vibe. Melrose is right there. The Grove is even closer. Like I said it's always a,vibe.
Management writes rave reviews to bring the score up - this place is under new management and has gone down hill quickly.
cool living here no complaints.  perfect location, close to everything and everyone.  melrose, the grove and all other things. its a hot spot

This is a small apartment community. There are not a lot of amenities, but the units are very modern and nice. It is tranquil, and I have not had any issues while living here. It is also convenient to the grove.

I’ve lived in LA for 13 years and NVE Fairfax is by far the worst I’ve endured! This “luxury” building is poor in every aspect from property management, property maintenance and upkeep, and safety and security
Smoke free building policy. But weed smell everywhere. Management doen't care.

It’s the worst when the place you live become the greatest source of stress. The reason? Its not having to dodge and weave around the puddles of dog urine in the hallways every time I go out. No, I became quite a natural at that. It’s also not the lack of response from management whose staff seems to get regularly replaced. I’ve given up on relying on them to handle issues. No, it’s the constant thudding and ceiling quaking that I receive from the unit above through these paper-thin walls. There is absolutely no noise insulation in this building. I get to hear everywhere my upstairs neighbor goes as they, what sounds like stomps around the apartment. I am not a noise sensitive person I don’t mind street noise, but I can feel the weight of their steps as it vibrates the ceiling and ripples down the walls to me, who is living in a constant state of anxiety anticipating when the next earthquake will happen. Considering this is a “luxury” apartment I feel duped that I am paying a lot of rent money for a place I can’t even relax in.This isn’t even the only issue, I can attest to all the complaints from the reviews posted on here.

Not even sure where to start, my lease will not be renewed. On the paper this place looks great with all the amenities a “luxury place” as to offer. However this has been less than a pleasant experience, bugs, noise and dirt. Bugs you will walk up to quite some of it, be patient the management will question your sanity. Noise, tenant do not respect the “quiet time” although listed in the lease, made few complain but this will not go anywhere. The place is extremely dirty, as mentioned in some other reviews the hallways are getting worse by the day, pet owners let their dog pee in the garage, the outdoor of the building have trash everywhere and landscape maintenance is inexistant. On and all not a great experience here, looking forward to my move...
The only greatness about this place are the security guard, they will try their best to make it right (although not their job) and the maintenance people, they are professional even with the limit resources.

The apartments look nice but there is a big bug problem. I find different kinds of bugs and spiders in my house every single day even though I clean my house regularly. 

Management never does anything. I regret moving here and I cannot wait to move out. Everything breaks even though they fix it. Microwave light literally broke a couple of days after they 'fixed' it. 

The street is so loud we cannot sleep. It never stops, there is noise 24/7. Windows are not sound-proof.

The only good thing about here is the security team. They are here 24/7 and they are on everything.

The building looks good on the surface, you will be swayed with the all-included amenities and "promotional deals," but 30sixty is not the luxury apartment experience that it advertises itself to be. As other reviews have mention, the hallways are filthy, lined with pet stains that have been left for months. My unit was not prepared for move-in. There were a lot of things still requiring maintenance and was very poorly cleaned. There was moldy food left in the fridge and the washer was gunked up with fur. The resident here lack consideration and leave their trash everywhere. Not to mention you can hear every step of your neighbor above you. Despite new management having twice the amount of people than the previous one, they are slow to take action and "handles" issues by sending out reminder emails of apartment policies.

Pros 

Great design
Great central air
Security 
Great views and location

Cons 

I am not high maintenance but the dogs peeing or taking a dump in the hallways does happen
Contacting the lease offices seems harder than it should be



Overall things have been great- it’s quiet and chill neighbors 
Amenities are ok

I've moved out of here 2 months ago and i still have not received my security deposit. Calls and emails have been made many many times. We are so fed up that we are suing because by law, landlords are to return the security deposit within 21 days after move out. PLEASE SAVE THE MONEY, AND HEADACHE and DO NOT MOVE HERE. You are warned. Unprofessional management and very overpriced.

I decided to give this a place a chance since it had a very attractive move-in offer. The very first day-scorching hot water in one tub, lukewarm at best in the other. Maintenance was called and it seemed to get better for a while but it was still temperamental. Also noticed the garbage disposal was making a weird noise. Turned out it was broken even before we had a chance to use it. Called maintenance again and they replaced the whole unit. This was the first week of staying at a brand new apartment. Not soon after that, I got trapped outside on the balcony because the balcony door handle broke. Had to call down to the office so that someone could come and let me back in to my own apartment. First time ever I've been locked out of my apartment in my apartment. Needless to say maintenance was out again and "fixed" the issue. I didn't trust them so I made sure to put a box of tools outside in case it happened again. Lo and behold, just a couple days later the handle stops working again. I had to take it apart myself to fix the issue, this time for good. At least these were fixable. Not the "state-of-the-art" fire alarm system. It had to be the most invasive system I've ever had the pleasure of living with. They installed speakerphones inside the unit so that they could make announcements whenever they felt like it seems. I'll tell ya, there's nothing quite like being awoken by a strange man's voice inside your apartment. If it's once or twice, okay, that's understandable. But ONCE OR TWICE AN HOUR, 4-5 HOURS A DAY FOR 5 DAYS STRAIGHT?!?! If you think I'm exaggerating, I have the email from management warning us of the impending fire alarm testing FOR THE WEEK. In close to 20 years of renting in southern California, I have never once had a building that tested their fire alarm as frequently as these people. So at the end of the lease, I couldn't get out of here fast enough, thinking that my woes were over. Not so fast. As I'm writing this review almost a full month after I've moved out, i am still waiting on my security deposit to be returned to me. They're required by law to return it within 21 days of move out date. It's now day 25 and I have called and written them about it for the past week and have yet to hear back from them. It's as if the entire leasing company disappeared. But at the same time, I'm getting emails saying my lease is now month-to-month and that I owe them rent. It is unbelievable how bad this experience has been. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Lived here for a year and moved out this past weekend. Not worth it. I'm a dog owner and I have never been so frustrated whilst living anywhere else about how owners do not clean up after their dogs AND how the management "threatens" to take care of the situation. Now that the retail spaces are all open, the garage is completely filled with cars (did not design the place well to handle all the cars). The managers are not responsive to any of the emails and even when they are, cannot help you at all with any of the specific billing questions you have. All of a sudden there are these charges that show on my account and all they can tell me is to look into the specific billing itemizations. I sat down and literally had to calculate 13 months worth of itemizations. I'm trying to currently talk to a manager to finalize my move out but they aren't responsive to that as well.

I’ve been living here since 30Sixty opened and WOW can I tell you it has been a huge frustration the entire time. 

Pros: clean looking apartments, great central air
Cons: almost daily/weekly fire alarm testing, power in the entire building goes off very frequently, entire building smells like dog because people all their animals to defecate in the hallways and elevator (please imagine stepping in dog sh*t on your way into your apartment), maitnence is nearly non existent, Bryan the leasing manager is NEVER around, car theft in the “secure” parking lot and on the street is frequent. This building is a disaster with a pretty face. 

Overall, 30Sixty is WAY too expensive for the quality of living you’ll have here. Find a more established building with working amenities and a fully functioning leasing office to get your money’s worth.

If I could give the place 0 stars I would. If you want to live in a place that has fire alarm testing everyday, pets that urinate and defecate throughout the hallways, and have maintenance issues go unattended / not fixed in a timely matter, then this is your spot to live! I have never lived in a place that has let maintenance issues go for months without being resolved. Lights in the hall / garbage room being out for weeks to nothing being fixed.  Owners of pets leaving their messes out in the hallway for someone else to clean and or walk in is ridiculous and the owners have not been fined or dealt with. The garage is a disaster, the gate opener hardly works when trying to get back in. I would say the only good thing about the place is the security guards. They are usually nice and friendly. After that, go and find another place to live.

Since I moved here, I feel so happy to make the choice. The amenities are new and great! They did a great job on sound insulation. 
Since it is a relatively new community, it could avoid small little issues coming up, but Bryan relied all my emails or questions in time, and the property managers are doing their work to help the environment be better. Especially the 24hr security made me feel safe!

When we moved in, there was already a lot of damage to the place. Not sure how that happened since it's a brand new building.

It was clear that they were not completely ready for the opening of this building as they ran out of gate opener remotes and 6 months after moving in, the pool is still not accessible to residents because management hasn't handed out keys. 

Also, there are not enough parking spots for everyone. It's very frustrating paying such a large amount of money when people don't have the option of buying another spot. That also means there's no visitor parking. 

I think they really try to cut costs by hiring the least number of managers, which really shows. 

The only good thing is that the security guards are there 24/7 and are generally friendly.

The apartment building is nice; however residents are allowed to let their pets urinate and deficate anywhere they please inside the building without little recourse from property management. It sucks to have to hold your breath while waiting on the elevator so that you do not have to inhale pet urine or walk with your head down so that you don't step in dog poo. I wish the pet owners were more considerate of their neighbors who have to share the same space with their pets. I won't be renewing my lease....that's for sure.

It was great experience having my home here and everyone was nice helping me to get amazing special deals such are free rent, free internet and parking. Also, security people, technicians and other staffs are pretty cool too!

Do not even bother trying to schedule an appointment for a viewing, they have little to no interest in showing. The phone lines go to voicemail (tried 15 times throughout the day) and I finally showed up in person hoping to schedule a showing and was asked to wait 2 hours. 2 hours later, I was asked to come back in an hour. Extremely unprofessional and difficult, should never have to basically beg to speak with the office manager Brian, who dodged me twice as I waited outside his office.

Lived here for almost 3 years. If you want to be right in the center of Ktown, the location can't be beat. Restaurants and grocery stores right across the street, bus stops and metro down the block, covered garage under the building. I've also always felt safe. And maintenance requests are dealt with same day or within 48 hours. Of course the building and amenities aren't fancy - if you want high class there are plenty of other places in Ktown with a higher price tag. But it's perfect for the price that it is, and I would absolutely recommend it.

Overpromised and underdelivered. Elevators always broken, fire alarms going off, urine and trash in the stairways. There is no way to buzz into the building, therefore deliveries are left out in the street. On-site parking is only given out via email lottery (ie management chooses who gets parking at their discretion). The rooftop has been “reserved for a private event” almost every Saturday and Sunday for the past 2 months. They advertise security at night, but I haven’t seen anyone on duty in months. Management will gaslight you. And then they will raise your rent 11%! Avoid at all costs.

I stayed here for over a year. They recently changed management and are much less attentive to the needs of renters and do not seem to care on a day to day basis for their renters.
There are more and more homeless tents popping up on mariposa making the surrounding area less tolerable. Its hard to even go out for a short walk now.
The fire alarms are constantly going off for no reason or periodically for testing.
Theres always something breaking too in the apartment and turnaround time is very long to get help or service.

Honest review of Vue's On Gordon Street from a previous tenant. The rooftop that they advertise is not what it seems, the tv and fireplace are just for looks and do not actually work. The apartments are extremely small, the common areas are not big enough for 2 or 3 people to share. You cannot fit a kitchen table. The kitchen can really only fit 1 person at a time. The garage parking is a major plus, but be aware if you have guest over there is no guest parking and street parking is tricky. However, the location is great as it is in walking distance to many bars and shops. The price is just way to high for what there is to offer. Overall 2/5 stars
Toured this apartment building today and fell in love with it . They did a great job on the interiors in comparison to the other newer buildings in the area.

We love living here. Just moved in about a month and so happy we decided to move here rather than one of the other larger communities in the area. Management is great  especially Davelle . Everyone form the management company is extremely professional. I would recommend this building to anyone who wants a smaller newer community and wants to be in the center of everything

I'm a recent tenant and just renewed for another year! Already stayed at this property for 1 year and the experience was definitely awesome. The convenience of the location is unbeatable - with restaurants and supermarkets walkable you really couldn't find any other places that are as accessible as this one.

Within the property it's very clean and well maintained. The property manager and the team always responds quickly and deals with everything on the point. Shoutout to Danny and Angel for helping me out on a lot of stuff and really appreciate for all the support.

Within the unit the room is spacious and has a lot of natural light. The appliances are new and there's definitely a lot of storage place (if you have a lot of stuff like me lol)

Staying here still and really looking forward to the next year!

I lived here for a year (moved to be closer to work) and it was such a peaceful, pretty, well-run place. There are relatively few apartments in the building so there is a lot of attention given to the individual tenants by the wonderful building manager (Danny) and the on-site maintenance manager, Angel, who is aptly named. I've never lived in such a quiet, peaceful place and my apartment got lots of natural light. The building and all the appliances are also new, and it's across the street from Hmart, for all your Korean cooking needs. My packages arrived outside my door.

I’ve never lived somewhere where I thought that the building truly cared about the tenants , however, Haven does.
I have lived here over a year now and truthfully it just keeps getting better. Christie and Victoria are the most amazing management team, they make it feel like a family here. They generally do something for the residents once a month, but they just wrapped up tenant appreciation week for the building, filled with little surprises, bbq, wine tastings, and pizza night from yummy lodge downstairs…it was a great time!!! The building itself has beautiful amenities if you’re looking for privacy it’s here, if you’re looking for activity it’s here. Haven has surpassed all of my expectations greatly and it just keeps getting better and my neighbors are the best! There’s a true sense of community here.  The maintenance staff Cesar and Luz are all over it if something needs to be done. I 100% recommend Haven if you are looking for, well, a Haven :-)

I like living here. The building is beautiful and well taken care of. The location is ideal in my opinion.

Ceasar the maintenance manager is always helpful and works extremely hard to make sure we are taken care of. Same goes for the property managers Christy and Victoria. 

- Alex

The building is very well run and maintained by the mgmt team. They also put in really thoughtful effort to put on fun events and community parties. Shoutout to Christy, Victoria, and Cesar for always going the extra mile!

Awesome team and incredible amenities help make the living experience here feel like you're at a resort. Christy leads an all star staff who are consistently making the residents feel at home. Whether it's a food truck or hosting a flamingo themed pool party it's always good times here. Couldn't recommend more!

I've lived here for the past year and remain consistently impressed by how clean and well-cared for the property is. Everyone in the office is so helpful and responsive. Cesar with maintenance does an amazing job - quick to respond to issues and extremely friendly. Highly recommend this complex!
After looking at 30+ apartments I decided on Haven and have never looked back. Everything from the amenities, to management, and maintenance deserve 5 stars.

I really loved living here because of the facilities. The ceilings are high and the apartment itself was a dream. The fridge, washer/dryer, pool, and gym were all excellent. So on paper, this is a 5 star property. 

However, after living there for some time, you'll realize that the management is quite disorganized. To fix something small like the A/C, I had to put in multiple maintenance requests. There were several technicians who came to the apartment just to confirm that the A/C was indeed not working. Finally, the A/C was fixed after several weeks. 

Then there's the hidden fees. Your rent is not what you will be paying. You will be paying for utilities (obviously fine with that) and internet. But the internet is provided by the building and you have to go with their expensive as hell internet and their router which you buy from them. Then there is parking which, since they didn't have enough parking on site, is an offsite shadier lot about a block away from the property. It is expensive too: $85 a month. Not to mention random additional charges to our rent that we'd have no warning of. 

A leasing agent told me that this building was an older building before it became an apartment complex. That means that the walls and floors are very thin and you will hear everything that your neighbor says and does. The people below me were obnoxious and constantly bothered me about WALKING in my apartment. Management didn't tell them to stop. 

Then the worst thing: Since the building is older, the ventilation and air is old. Not sure what exactly it was, could be fungus or dust or something, but the air in the apartment was always rather stale and made my sinuses clog up. My roommate developed polyps and had to have a dangerous surgery to have them removed. 

Although the amenities and the apartment itself is really nice, I strongly recommend considering somewhere else based on the above information.

Bryan was exceptionally helpful and patient through the entire process. He was able to navigate hiccups with my application in a clean and efficient manner and matched me to a unit that had yet to be listed online according to my preferences. Top to bottom it was a very pleasant experience

Bryan was incredibly helpful and patient throughout the entire leasing process. He was able to handle hiccups with my application in a clean and efficient manner and matched me to a unit that had yet to be listed online according to my preferences. Top to bottom it was a very pleasant experience

beware do not live here! building advertises as pet friendly but pets not allowed anywhere on the building and get kicked out by security. management also has rude attitude all the time and does not care about the livelihood of their tenants. also EV charging is a rip off 20/month AND 25 cents for each kwh you charge

The building management is useless and won't bother to help you with anything you ask for. If you ask a question or have a request expect to be either completely ignored or given an unhelpful, unprofessional, rude response. The property is poorly maintained, dog excrements and loose garbage just lying around in the hallways. The only helpful person who works here is the security guard who is the only one who knows what’s going on in the building at all times.
manager is the worst! They are so rude and always slow to get things done.  Leasing office manager hates to  work.  I don't know why they are working.

Lived here for ~ 15 months. Multiple trespassers (including theft), water meter wasn't installed correctly so I was hit with a $400+ dollar bill (and expected to pay immediately), dishwasher broke over 3 times, and I was initially overcharged for repaint and cleaning after moving out (totaling almost $1k in security deposit deduction).

PROs: Beautiful brand new well designed property,  south west side of unit with ceiling to floor panoramic windows showcasing stunning views,  stellar staff with quick response time and very attentive, top quality appliances, roof top pet play area, first floor bike storage unit, sizable deck with amazing glass walls and attached outdoor storage unit. *Secured building. Convenient location close to beach , downtown LA, mall and airport. Safe neighborhood. Walking distance to store, gym, food. Online portal for payments and maintenance request. Complimentary internet first year. Conference rooms. Trash chutes. Dope remote controlled shades. Smart thermostat. 

CONs: Very minimal closet space ( no coat closet, no linen closet, bedroom closet in higher cost units are not walk-in and limited space). Limited 2 drawer storage under sink in bathrooms. Floors are vinyl faux wood ( not hardwood as listed ) that takes away from quality esthetics of rest of unit. Gym is small.  *Subterranean garage is not gated with security guard only posted in evening hours. Roof top deck no furniture or grills as of current. Rent cost even with new build move- in special is above average (for the area and comparable square footage) for the higher cost units. Covers no utilities cost at all as most apartments complexes include at least water or gas. 

Overall great experience.

High end apartments that are extremely spacious. We have 3 roommates who all work from home but we are Neve run each other's space. Walkability to Larchmont and always street parking. Garage parking is a little tight. Overall love living here and management is great - responds right away and takes care of any request quickly!

I just moved out of this complex, and had an amazing experience. Andrea, the property manager, is so helpful and always willing to go the extra mile to help you out.  It has a great rooftop area with a grill to relax and look out over the city. The apartments are spacious and newly updated. Highly recommend!

I just recently moved out of this place but it was the most amazing experience living here. Andrea, our property manager was absolutely amazing to us. She was there in any moment we needed anything fixed and was an absolute pleasure to have as our contact there. I 100% recommend living in this beautiful building! The community is great and I am sad to leave! Thank you so much Andrea, we will miss you! 
-Emy Chinen

I can not express enough love and respect I have for this building and the on site manager. The apartments have such a Genuine luxury feel about them. Every single detail was thought of for this building. Top of the line everything. The on site manager is incredible, she is on top of everything and wants nothing more but for the residents to have a lovely living experience, which really helps make it feel like home. I have been here for two and a half years and the only reason I am leaving is to buy a house, otherwise I would remain a tenant! You will not regret these apartments!

If you are looking for neighbors who are laughing and have fun during the night time you got it. Absolutely inadequate tenants' behavior, gambling with squeals, night parties, etc. Management doesn't want to do anything because they need to fill the apartments asap. For this amount, you can rent a quiet place in Santa Monica or Studio City. Don't make my mistake.

This community became a college housing.
Young people are sharing rooms and they never kept the quite time. 
Management does not care about all the noises tenants make.

You will hear your upstairs walk. The sounds is like floor cracking...if you happen to have a neighbor like mine who walks heavily, drop items on floor and has tense activities at midnight, you won't sleep. I'm sure your mental health will suffer. The management company will not care about resolving it but asking you to endure.

Do not move here! There is always something wrong from mold, to building smelling like marihuana, people parking in your designated parking spot, noise all the time, elevators not working and the list goes on and on.

1 Star review specifically goes out to the parking policy. I've been living here since March 2023. When I moved in, the apartment had plenty of guest parking. It was great. However, there is a senior home next door that the apartment had some sort of agreement with and now the guest parking have turned into their employee parking. Wish this policy was announced sooner so I wouldn't have renewed my lease.

Getting close to the end of my lease and I’ve mostly enjoyed my time here. Some other comments mentioned issues with management, but I’ve always had requests taken care of quickly. I had one package stolen before they implemented full time security. As a young woman, I feel safe in this building, though not safe walking alone outside at night in the area. I must have been lucky to be surrounded by respectful neighbors because I hardly hear the ones next to me or above me. That being said, the top floor can be a bit rowdy from what I’ve heard when I’m on my patio, so I wouldn’t recommend living directly below them. I’ve had issues with other tenants leaving pet waste, cigarette butts, and other gross things in common areas/elevator/garage, but whenever I’ve reported it, it’s gotten cleaned up. The only thing that isn’t enforced that well is smoking on balconies. If you live with the patio facing the courtyard, you WILL smell the cigarette smokers if your door is cracked.  When I toured buildings here almost a year ago, this building was the nicest and felt the safest. Overall, I enjoy the building itself and my only issues stem from a small handful of inconsiderate neighbors.

Only go by the poor reviews because they are the honest truthful ones where I found myself nodding along and grateful I'm not the only one having a terrible living experience here. I have been miserable here for almost a year and am stuck in an 18 month lease which leaves almost ZERO room to get out of. Basically you're stuck so read the lease word for word to make your choice. Walls are ridiculously thin and you can hear conversations around you word for word and I get scared to talk about private matters sometimes. Complaining does no good because they'll say they gave out a warning, but nothing changes. DO NOT LIVE HERE. You will be paying a crazy amount of money in exchange for poor quality of life, rude neighbors and management that is not equipped to handle this number of isues.

Constant fire alarms going off in the middle of the night, EXTREMELY thin walls, like your next door neighbors and those who live above you. You can hear EVERYTHING. Giant headache all around. And management doesn’t really care at all. Cheap building, terrible management, half of our outlets dont work and they never came to fix them. For how much you’re paying, this place is a joke.

My apartment is beautiful but that’s about as far as it goes. This building is unclean and unsafe ! Always a lot of trash outside. There’s only One cleaning lady, none of the common areas are ever clean especially the pool and the rooftop deck the furniture has been rained on which means that it’s soiled and molded and it has not been replaced. James the manager is completely checked out of his position as a manager. You will regret signing a lease trust me.

The way this management addresses residents is just disgraceful. I have numerous emails that I could provide to show how he talks down to residents, is incredibly disrespectful, doesn’t respond to emails or maintenance requests. It’s been addressed with him numerous times and he still still doesn’t know how to address people with an ounce of respect. The overarching company doesn’t seem to care either. There’s so many issues in this building too. Packages getting stolen (which he will just say “lease releases us from liability” and not address the reasons it’s happening), fire alarm going off in the middle of the night for 30 mins many nights over the course of the month, noise issues. He also lied during the leasing of the apartment. I felt like I should post this here because even though the apartment looks nice at first glance, it’s super cheap and with such terrible management it’s not worth it.

The building is new, which is great, but the walls and floors are extremely thin.  You can hear your neighbors on all sides of your apartment.  Too bad noise wasn’t taken into consideration when this building was being designed and constructed.

Poorly managed property, the management is a joke they don't care about their residents at all. The trash room is filled with trash and no one comes to clean it. You have to request multiple times for a service even it is emergent. The entire building has very limited internet connection and you can't even make a phone call.

The apartments are brand new and have great appliances. Lots of amenities and on top of that the leasing agent, James was really quick to answer all questions and went above and beyond to make sure we knew all the costs and information about the apartment. Very great experience! Would highly recommend it.

The property itself is aesthetically beautiful since it is brand new however good luck trying to deal with management if you decide to live here.  Basically if you have questions / concerns / repairs you'll have a very hard time reaching anybody. Not sure if they are just lazy or straight up incompetent but I have never dealt with building management / landlords that have such poor communication with its tenants (how hard is it to respond to an email...even with a few words?).  Again, the place is nice, but if you decide to rent here, just pray you never have issues that require building management help.

This is a brand new apartment but it’s poor management is a big issue. They have not cleaned the pool chairs, pool umbrellas, outside chairs, or pool floor in months. This is frightening in the age of covid. When you walk along the pool your feet turn black and many residents have resorted to bringing their own wipes to clean when they visit the outdoor areas because it has gotten out of control. The halls always smell like trash from the trash room and I saw a flying roach on my hall a few weeks ago most likely from the trash room. Not a good sign!! They do not clean areas for days and never vacuum the floors. I can only imagine what the apartment will be like when they are done trying to fill it with people. People here are nice and kind but the cleanliness is very worrying as a new resident here.

Look at these fake reviews... What a joke. We scheduled a tour we get there and our agent wouldn't pick up her phone. At least have the decency to cancel the appointment. This is the second time this is happening to us. If future tenants get treated this way God knows how they'll treat their current tenants. Rude security guard wouldn't even open the door to answer our question. Wasted an hour driving there. Keep in mind we got 6 reminder emails. At least their computers do a good job...

Checked out this apartment while driving passed it. Called the number and was told that it was fully booked for tours but was able to schedule me for the next day. It's a new property and we found a vacancy that no one has ever lived in before. Floors are super clean, hallways are well lit, and I really love the recessed lighting in each unit. Instead of spending my time focusing on my family, I am dealing with this. And since my apartment isn't listed, I lose nothing by giving a review detailing exactly what I think of their business practices. 

*Note: this does not include the front desk worker in the leasing office who has been very kind and forwarded all of my requests to upper management. I hope you find a better job soon.

I moved here three weeks ago. The carpet was very dirty while the property manager insisted that it had been cleaned. She tried to hide her problem and said I did not submit the checklist when I moved in. However, I submitted that form on time. It took over two weeks battling with the company then they sent someone to clean the carpet.
The internet is quite bad. For the apartment with four rooms and five people, it only provides 300Mbps internet and a very old router with bad performance. The average speed of our device is less than 25 Mbps. We even lose connection with Wi-fi from time to time. They are not willing to make efforts to improve the internet quality and update the router device. Just sent Spectrum staff doing some useless tests while the cable is fine, and they don't take charge of the router. This problem is still here, and nobody is trying to solve it.
There were more than five problems when I moved in, such as broken blinds, flashing lights, a broken toilet, and small shower water. They refused to change the shower head, so I had to pay and change it by myself, and it worked very well.
Too many problems with this apartment, and now, some problems still exist.

I'm a current tenant. If you choose to live in the area, just be ware of your package. Make sure get it before other. Chance of you forgot, the second day it will be gone. 
Yes, there is video recording, but guess what, Triplink will charge you $15 for looking for the evidence of who stole your stuff.

I'm regretful about my decision to live here. Tripalink is an awful mgmt company. Save yourself from headache & safety hazards. The rent is cheap for a reason. There's been a new property manager every few months bc they go through hell working under Tripalink. Here are the issues at Atlas:

1. Broken elevators & amenities, no water in building: I live on the 12th floor & there have been many days when I'm leaving for work and I had to walk all the way down bc of broken elevators. Elevator permit was expired until recently. Swimming pool is usually dirty and the patio fire pit never works. Residents had to live without water for several hours one day bc they accidentally cut off water.

2. Water leaks: Within a year of living here there have been water leaks that damaged my belongings. I had to put towels and bowls to prevent it from damaging my TV and other furniture. One time the bolts holding the window blinds came loose and the heavy metal fixture slammed inches above my brother's head. Tripalink hasn't given me any compensation.

3. Carelessness by Tripalink Mgmt: I submitted maintenance request for the waterleaks and damages on 2/6/24. All they did was give me plastic buckets and tell me that they can't fix the blinds until the drywood dries up. They put up one of those blue Home Depot tarps in my room for TWO months. I emailed the mgmt saying this is a breach of lease and asked for some compensation. Their offer was 10 days of free guest parking. They just don't give a dime. I also reached out to mgmt about my TILTED floors and they didn't do anything about it. 

4. Weird utility billing system: Usually in any normal apartment building, each unit has their own electricity meter so you pay for what you use. Atlas, however, has ONE meter for the whole building that gets divided among the tenants. So I'm paying for what other people are using PLUS the A/C and electricity bills used in the hallways, lobby, mailroom, etc. My utility bill has been going up since more people have moved in. Residents complained about the utilities bill and the management's response was basically, "It was written in your lease agreement."

5. Unpleasant & dangerous neighborhood: I used to love going on morning and evening walks but I stopped ever since I moved here. As soon as you walk out of the main doors it smells like pee. Homeless are roaming around peeing and pooping and the management does not care. They scream late at night & I've even heard gunshots.
It’s disgusting, I keep my apartment extremely clean. So I was disgusted to find a roach near the door of my apartment. & The hot tub is FILTHY.
Great location, close to DTLA, Korea Town, Echo Park and has great amenities.

So much noise in the night time. 
The soundproof here is bad, you could feel everything shaking when your neighbor washing clothes!
And the guys in gym careless drop heavy things to make large noise after 12am!!
And your neighbor will throw party at 12am, loud talking and laughing. 
Avoid this place!!!

Just moved into Atlas House on January 1st and couldn’t be happier. There’s a gym, yoga studio, business room & also pool/hot tub that I can’t wait to open. We also have 24/7 security who are super helpful and I feel much safer than my last place. The amenities are incredible. It’s a beautiful apartment complex and I’m so grateful I found it!!

Don’t be fooled by the pictures you see on here. They try to market this place as a brand new building but it isn’t. There’s lots of issues included common areas that aren’t maintained, paper thin walls, upside down key holes, stained and tattered carpeting, broken or half working appliances. Don't be fooled by the price and new building. The building doesn't have any amenities. Also, the walls are paper thin. You can hear everything from your neighbors. Dogs barking, music, TV, talking, and their phones ringing. Honestly regret moving here as I was fooled by the exterior.
The one bedroom lofts  are super cool.  Great Ktown Location! Excellent pricing!  I highly recommend this building and the leasing staff at Lido are really helpful!

I moved here 5 months ago and since then, management has changed three times. While the place itself isn’t bad, the front desk staff, particularly Bri, needs improvement. Her consistently poor attitude lowers the building’s overall value. She’s often unresponsive and seems unwilling to assist, making it frustrating and ineffective to seek help from her. If the business wants to improve, replacing her would be a good step
I provided a review of Alta Ink my first year as a resident in 2022.
I love living at Alta Ink. The staff is amazing, the property is well maintained, and all needs are met quickly and precisely.
I do love living here 90% of the time but like with everything there a few thing that should be upgraded.

Management can never resolve any issues. Hallways and elevators are always dirty. Every two months there is a problem with every unit that they take forever to fix. The building was not build properly. The management do not know what they are doing.
Leasing and Maintenance are professional, friendly and on top of what they are doing. Haven't had any issues with staff.
I've had a mostly terrible experience living at Kurve. Disappointed to say the least. Management is terrible and unhelpful. Amenities are broken or unusable at most times.

My experience at Kurve so far has been amazing. The property is always clean, my neighbors are quiet and respectful, and my apartment unit is very nice and luxurious. I love the amenities and all of the free events that are held for residents. I feel Kurve offers a top tier luxury living experience at a very fair price.

Best leasing / move in experience from start to finish. I was hunting for an apartment for a month and had A LOT of tours and nothing was as close to how great Angela was. She was super knowledgeable and answered all of my millions of questions from touring to even after moving in. The staff made the move in super easy and were super helpful with communicating anything I needed.

After living at Kurve for over a year, I've made the decision not to renew my lease. While the property staff, including the concierge desk, security, maintenance, and cleaning teams, deserve recognition for their efforts and dedication, the overall living experience has been disappointing due to persistent issues that management seems unable to address effectively.
1. Chronic Maintenance Issues: The trash and recycling chutes have never functioned since I moved in. As a result, garbage piles up in the trash room, creating a constant stench in the hallways that greets residents daily.
2. Inconvenient Parking: The parking garage gates break down almost weekly, causing significant delays that add unnecessary stress to daily commutes. Access to the building from Sunset Pl is often blocked by deliveries or ride-shares, making entry and exit a logistical nightmare.
3. HVAC and Comfort Concerns: The HVAC system's single-speed fans are not only loud and energy-inefficient but also make living conditions uncomfortable year-round.
4. Ventless Dryers: The ventless dryers release moisture and lint into apartments, posing potential health risks, especially for those with respiratory conditions.
5. Kitchen Inadequacies: The gas stove burners are disappointingly weak, which could be frustrating for anyone who enjoys cooking.
6. Smoking Policy Enforcement: Despite a no-smoking policy, the building remains a de-facto smoking environment due to ineffective enforcement by management.

Kurve’s claim of "luxury elevated living" is not just an exaggeration but a blatant misrepresentation. Prospective tenants should be aware that they are paying for a label rather than a living experience that remotely resembles luxury. Save yourself the disappointment and look elsewhere for true quality living accommodations.

2. Inconvenient Parking: The parking garage gates break down almost weekly, causing significant delays that add unnecessary stress to daily commutes. Access to the building from Sunset Pl is often blocked by deliveries or ride-shares, making entry and exit a logistical nightmare.
3. HVAC and Comfort Concerns: The HVAC system's single-speed fans are not only loud and energy-inefficient but also make living conditions uncomfortable year-round.
4. Ventless Dryers: The ventless dryers release moisture and lint into apartments, posing potential health risks, especially for those with respiratory conditions.
5. Kitchen Inadequacies: The gas stove burners are disappointingly weak, which could be frustrating for anyone who enjoys cooking.
6. Smoking Policy Enforcement: Despite a no-smoking policy, the building remains a de-facto smoking environment due to ineffective enforcement by management.

Building is dirty, there’s always a stench in the elevators, cleaners only come once a month (if they come at all), fire alarm is always going off Ecco is not giving residents their security deposits for those who signed a lease before they took over management.

I recently explored leasing options at this property, and I feel it's essential to share some insights for potential tenants on Apartments.com. While the advertised rates may seem attractive, it's important to note that the displayed rate includes up to two months of specials.

For those considering a stay longer than a single lease term (e.g., 15 months), it's crucial to be aware that the actual rent rate, factoring in the entire lease term, is higher than the initially advertised amount. This was a consideration I found noteworthy, drawing on my experience as a former manager of luxury properties.

Despite this aspect, the building itself is undeniably beautiful and offers an appealing living environment. If your housing plans align with a shorter-term stay( e.g., one lease term), this property might be an excellent choice.

This company will give you prompt responses for every thing until after the lease is signed. They are terrible at communicating, and also have no attentiveness to requests you may have. The promises of cleaning is a whole other situation. Don’t count on the unit being in any sort of living conditions.

Where to start?

-There is no front office and rarely ever any on-site staff besides maintenance and cleaning.
-The cleaning person consistently does not do their job and complains to people that live here about others’ complaints towards them.
-Management appears to cherry-pick the lease to threaten fines against those who don’t comply with their smallest demands, but does little to nothing to remove troublesome individuals causing bigger issues such as consistent and unnecessary noise.
-There is a disturbingly high quantity of maintenance issues for a building that was being built in February 2021.
-Although there are locks on building and apartment doors, there are none allowed on bedroom doors. I witnessed a lock get reported.
-Parking costs extra and is limited to underground, gated tandem parking. Despite the gate, someone still had their car broken into.
Absolutely horrible experience with the management team and noise at this facility.  Once they take your money they do not care one bit to address any issues.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Management does not take tenant's concerns seriously and will not respond for weeks at a time. Don't be fooled by it's sleek, modern design. Living here is not worth the literal headache.

In any apartment building, there are some things more important than others. For me, it's staff. How responsive they are, how kind-hearted they are, and how they make you feel. Living at the Legacy provides an exceptional environment for our son who is a student athlete. Management has told us "it's almost done" for months now, yet it seems as though there are still many apartments that have not been renovated yet.
