It sucks here! save yourself time and misery and go somewhere else. DO NOT be fooled by this place and DO NOT come here!

A smaller complex when compared to nearby apartments and lofts but I like it that way. Im able to go up and down the elevators without much delay. This is especially a perk when you have a bunch groceries or have a pet to take out. Ive interacted the most with Torrie from the leasing office and she has been a delight to work with. She is responsive to all my questions and concerns as a new tenant. The security and maintenance team are also friendly and helpful. All around a great experience so far!
Park La Brea is a well maintained apartment complex. Also Trevor at the management office is very diligent .
Roaches everywhere and in a bad neighborhood as well as mold

As a new resident, I wasn’t given much information about the process at Park La Brea. The property is large, and I had trouble reaching anyone until I met Trevon from Administration. He was quick to assist, gave me a clear rundown of the rules, and made my experience enjoyable. Thank you!

Maintenance staff was nice and friendly. BUT! if you want quiet night of sleep or any assistance from management - don't move!

1) Lived in the tower block 47 (main block facing the office), had very loud neighbours (yes, multiple) all around, partying, shouting and making loud noises throughout the night and early morning hours all year round, no one did anything. And most importantly, had a next door neighbour that was literally shouting, signing and screaming THROUGHOUT EVERY SINGLE NIGHT (have recording proofs) of our multi-year residency at the property, NO ONE DID ANYTHING, nor security nor management bothered to help us, got completely ignored our complaints even though we had proof. Due to that, we were mentally scared, were forced to move out of the bedroom and sleep in the lounge area throughout the whole period we lived there... 

2) Another example of ignorance: fridge broke, had to throw away $100 worth of food, been told we will be reimbursed but literally our emails got fully ignored once we provided the receipts, after dozens of pings nothing happened... 

Overall,  good place, however, the above examples, especially the loud next door neighbour and unwillingness from management to help, left us scared and sadly would never move back or recommend anyone to live there..

i have never encountered somewhere as dysfunctional as this building, my apartment fully flooded i had los angeles biggest waterfall in my kitchen and it fully took them an hour to come and stop the water and then a month to renovate it they had to put us somewhere else as they did it and we had to move three times because they kept putting us in units with issues. the apartment itself was so old and so gross they only care about money and not their tenants

There is so much to explain; but enough characters. First, the apartment i rented I was not able to view. The day it became available I inquired and before the day was out someone had already paid to hold it and I thought I had missed out. But, from what I thought was a sign, that person had withdrew and the leasing agent contacted me to let me know it had opened and I would need to act quickly. I thought the stars had aligned. This is where the story will take a turn. The apartment was old, older than I realized. Nothing like the the models, in my opinion. The only updated thing in my place was the fridge and stove and those could’ve been dated to the 90s or early 00s. The bathroom was small and even though I am big & tall even my smaller friends expressed amazement at how small it was especially because the space itself was so large for what my rent was. And it was extremely dated; the toilet was so small. And there was no storage in the bathroom, beside the medicine cabinet. Also my apt was equipped with a shower stall no tub; honestly that was fine but the stall needs lighting. I lived in a main floor apartment and encountered roaches on move-in day. 2 were about the length of a matchstick while I also saw several small roaches on the same day. All were dead! But this would not be the last I would see of them. On that first day; I made a vow to never cook in my place because the sight of roaches made me feel disgusted. I killed well over 10 roaches in my apartment and I’m a clean person. All my food was taken to the trash chute. I never threw open containers in my apt trash. I’ve read (after I moved in) that the roach thing is hit or miss at here and that is frankly unacceptable. They were in the hallways, crawling out of the trash chute before they closed them down, and in the basement. I would come home they would be on my front door. It made living there hellscape for me. Even after getting an exterminator; I still had the critters. I used to believe the maintenance team was very responsive until by unit lost power and took them 5 days to fix. FIVE, no compensation-nothing. I had to pull out my lease and email that they were violating the lease agreement which at the time stated the apt must be “liveable”. And for 5 days it was not! Ultimately; I would never recommend this place to the next person.
Everything about Picasso is great. If you are looking for place to live, come and check out. It's conveniently located on Wilshire and Bundy, next to Ralphs, cafes, and UPS...etc.

Picasso Brentwood is a beautiful place located a few minutes from the ocean. You have everything you need nearby like grocery stores, coffee shops, pharmacy in less than 10min walk. And the term "hospitality" was created to define the Picasso's team. These people are just awesome, supportive and can help you with whatever you need
The Staff is very nice and helpful. The apartments are very cozy and ideal for living. The portal is very effective when it comes to maintenance and payments.
Picasso Brentwood is heaven. The building is brand new, the people are incredible, the amenities are perfect and the rooms are beautiful. Im so happy here!

Eunice and Oliver are so responsive, kind, and professional! They already remember our names, our reserved unit number, and specific information about our needs. I'm so impressed by this because we are moving from across the country and have not actually met them face-to-face yet. It's clear that they pay attention and care about their future tenants. Thanks to their flexibility and quick response time, they have made this whole apartment pre-leasing experience very easy for us. I have talked with so many leasing agents around LA beforehand but the Picasso Brentwood team is the best! On top of this, the apartments look beautiful (quart countertops, fancy cabinets, stainless steel appliances, etc.), have amazing amenities (pool, hot tub, co-working space, fitness center, etc), and rent is really great for a BRAND NEW apartment in Brentwood. I'm super excited to live here and I really can't thank the Brentwood Picasso team enough for all of their efforts! If you are thinking of moving here, definitely talk to the leasing team (Eunice & Oliver) - they are incredibly helpful!!

Honestly Be DTLA is an amazing complex from the very first moment I came to visit for a tour. The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly. The buildings are crazy clean and smell great on each floor which with being in LA is hard to come by especially considering being super close to Downtown. Love that there is a Starbucks and grocery store super close for convenience. My only complaint is about my upstairs neighbors stomping and walking really hard all day in the two weeks since moving in.

Be DTLA is an incredible community that combines modern living with a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere. The amenities are top-notch, and the staff is always helpful and attentive. Living here feels like being part of something special in the heart of downtown LA. Highly recommend it!

I’ve been living at Be DTLA for two years now, and I couldn’t be happier! The staff here are incredibly friendly, which adds such a welcoming vibe to the community. The common areas are always clean and well-maintained, which I really appreciate. The neighborhood is also great—conveniently close to essentials like a grocery store, Starbucks, and Chipotle, making day-to-day life so much easier. Highly recommend for anyone considering DTLA!!!

The facility is great for those looking to stay and explore Los Angeles with a reasonable lease. The studio outline is decent with some things wished to be desired such as pre-installed internet. The rate for some amenities are fantastic as you save $25   on internet, parking costs less than most apartments, and the water and power payments are done through Be DTLA. The gym is reasonable with some highly professional equipment. For those who like to workout with essentials, this is the gym for you! The pool is small but mostly unoccupied for those who do not like large crowds. The accessibility to restaurants, market, and a dentist office are convenient.
Aside from the beautiful community and its amenities they have thee BEST office and maintenance team. Going for my 4th year living here.
BeDTLA is a nice community with helpful staff that maintain a nice attitude and help with packages, parking, etc. The complex is conveniently located and has some nice amenities.

One of the best apartments I have ever stayed in! Amazing management, super tight security, and overall a tightly run ship. Anytime I had maintenance issues they were resolved in less than 48 hours, I had every question and issue outlined to me by Carlitos (property manager) and he treated me with respect and kindness, something I don't get as a younger renter in DTLA. Units are super spacious with completely new appliances, new paint, and everything you possibly need to make it a home. This street can get absolutely crazy with the club across the street and there was multiple times the security helped me out of a sticky situation with shady characters trying to follow me inside. Building is very quiet, very chill, and overall a great place to stay in DTLA. Carlitos is the best property manager I've ever had, and I'm honestly sad I have to move! Highly recommended.

Our contact at Premiere Towers kept telling us that we were on track to sign the lease, then suddenly started ignoring our calls. We had to resort to calling from another line, and he told us he already gave the place to someone else weeks ago. Now I'm stuck without an apartment, just because they refused to be honest with us. You don't want to deal with this place.

This is one of the best apartment in downtown LA! The location can not be beat. It is on Spring Street, and is walking distance from some of the best restaurants, bars, boutiques and of course, the Metro station. The management staff are friendly and extremely helpful, often resolving maintenance problems on the same day. There is a rooftop patio that is perfect for lounging with friends (and playing life-size chess!) on hot summer nights. Definitely check this apartment out if you love city life and appreciate the architecture of historic buildings.
Located in the heart of Spring Street, the Premiere Towers are beautiful living spaces right next to all the downtown hot spots. The staff is quick and responsive to any problems.

For a place that’s got so many amenities, has lots of trees and is supposed to be peaceful and family oriented, they sure figured out a way to ruin it. They have the worst staff, starting with the property manager. You have really noisy neighbors and the staff, including security does nothing about it. They will increase your rent annually but the hot tub will be broken, pool area flooded, gym equipment not working, broken elevators, random people parking in your parking spot and you can complain as much as you want but absolutely nothing will get done. Worst experience i ever had with a landlord and I’d highly recommend anyone looking at this place to move someone else. For your own peace of mind.

Poor communication between management and tenants regarding various procedures - they do not have their emails/contacts accessible when you need to reach them urgently. Paco claims that their office is accesible 7 days a week yet their hours say otherwise.

On top of that, several neighbors including us have had ceiling/flooding issues. There's poor ventilation/AC issues which lead to mold in the ceiling. Elevators are not properly inspected and are constantly under maintenance. Being in an elevator can be a terrifying experience as it lurches and shakes too. Laundry units leak and flood over the floor. Dryer machines fail to dry clothes. Besides the elevator, certain gym equipments break and take weeks to replace/fix.

I unfortunately would not consider Playa Summit a "Luxury" after being here for over a year

Paid a premium for a short term lease. Was notified 14 days before my lease ended that I had to give a 60day notice before I could move out. Ended up having to pay another 1.5mo. After all is done, I’m faced with a $1500 bill in the mail… to be corrected a month later saying it’s been adjusted to $250. I don’t know what property management they have in place, but it was absolutely atrocious. The room and property itself was alright, but they’ll use shady tactics to squeeze every penny out of you.
It is an unsafe building. I currently live here and my someone broke in and stole some of my property! DO NOT MOVE HERE!
you can find a better place to live. the buildings are very old. there's a constant maintenance problem. laundry room always problematic. I have no idea why it was called ''luxury''

This place is filled with cockroaches, have the pictures (several) to prove it. We kept our place in GREAT condition and they kept our security deposit, and now are asking for MORE! If you love paying high rent for cockroaches, bad management, homeless people around, busted elevators, (should I go on?) then by all means live here. STAY AWAY if you know what’s good for you!!

For the area, I think this is a fairly priced apartment. My building was built long ago so occasionally has some errors but I think that's where the star of this property comes from - incredibly quick maintenance response. Lisa and Frank are both very efficient and sweet. A good option to consider for Otis or LMU Students!

Loved living here! Lisa, the property manager, is quite honestly the best possible manager you could ask for. She is always on top of it! She’s very communicative, gives fast responses to any concerns or maintenance issues, friendly, and professional. Frank is also prompt to fix any maintenance issues and friendly! In fact, the entire staff here is amazing. Issues get addressed within the same day usually.
I was worried about the airplane noises prior to move in since it’s close to LAX, but the double paned windows do their job. Because the apartment is around a residential neighborhood, it’s also quite peaceful and the view is nice. Street parking is generally easy to find for guests. There’s a lot of newly remodeled amenities that are well maintained and always available for use. Some other random notes are that the apartment is well insulated. I’ve only turned on the AC twice for the entire year.

I cannot say more of what an amazing experience we have had with Sepulveda West Apartments. Lisa, the property manager truly the best. From when we first viewed the complex, to moving in, to 6 months later she has made us feel so welcomed and has gone above and beyond with all of our needs. She is reliable, communicative, proactive and truly cares about the property and it shows. On top of that,
Frank and Alma who help maintain the property are so great. We have had very few fixes needed but when we have, Lisa is immediately on it and Frank is there to fix it ASAP. The complex is quiet and the tenants are very friendly and respectful. We absolutely love our new home and HIGHLY recommend Sepulveda West Apartments to anyone.

I’ve lived here for about five years now and I really love this place. It’s in a great location where you can easily get to Culver City or Manhattan Beach or LAX and. Inglewood. 

Lisa is a great manager very approachable and always very nice. Anytime there’s been a maintenance issue it’s usually taken care of within the day. And the recent remodel of the apartment looks great! 

Overall a really good place to live I highly recommend it

I loved every second of living at Sepulveda West! The 1 bedroom unit I lived in was so spacious and clean. The location was in a beautiful neighborhood that was great to take strolls in. Also was close to so many great restaurants and to grocery stores and other shopping. Also a very close run/drive to the beach. Close to the 405 and 105 for commutes and the property management team led by Lisa is so helpful and nice. Only moved to the Bay for family reasons, but I had such a great experience living here

I’ve lived here for 4 years and love this apartment complex. For one it’s close to my favorite beach ?? Manhattan beach and also a stones throw away from Culver City. 

Lisa is a great landlord who’s helped me a lot with any issue I’ve had over the last few years living there. The apartment was recently renovated and everything looks amazing especially the pool and gym area.
They don't mention the shared bathroom and that the tiny rooms have no windows.

Management does not. care. if. you. live. or. die. There was a shooting in the elevator lobby area a few months ago and there’s 3 cameras in that location - management said the cameras were not “activated” so they can’t do anything about it. Make sure to ask about the painted over bullet holes on the garage elevator door. There was a man parked outside an entrance to the building for months who threatened to shoot people as we walked out - management and LAPD did nothing. You will never, ever be able to have a package delivered without it being stolen. Laundry machines are constantly broken. Water is shut off for 8 hours a day every 3 weeks. The pipes are constantly clogged and drains are overflowing. The elevator is constantly broken. Every day here is a living, walking nightmare.

Apartments are modern and look nice but don't do it. Cars get broken into in the garage left and right, one car was stolen off the lot. Water gets shut off for the day at least 3 times a month. All the packages get stolen.... like literally every single one. There was also a shooting in the common area recently. OH AND LAUNDRY MACHINES CONSTANTLY BROKEN!!!!!! Management will have you sign a contract about how they aren't liable for anything and also tell you to buy a PO box. If you don't mind extra money coming out of ur pocket to fix ur car, replace stolen items, and therapy for all the trauma this building gives you then move in

I will provide a complete review once I move out, but do not do it to yourself. This has been the worst living experience I ever had. Luckily my lease just ended so I have the freedom to leave, which I will do ASAP, but details to follow and my exact unit once I move. The noise is unbearable, the neighbors are inconsiderate, management does not tend to request . . . I have a few more things to list, but stay away at all costs. I literally cannot sleep at night because my upstairs neighbor stomps, drop weights, and plays loud music.  I complained to building management only for the tenant to knock on my door to address the issue. It's unprofessional and tasteless. More to come.
I stayed with them for 8 months. Customer service was excellent. Furniture was new and good quality.

Hardwood floors, massive one bedroom with vaulted ceilings, huge beautifully tended to garden. PERFECT for entertaining. Whitley Heights is central but not in the thick of the Hollywood madness, everything is walkable but you can opt out of the hub bub and retreat in the hills. Rick the landlord is great, he's responsive, takes care of the place. The house is a Tudor revival from the 20s and is often referred to as "snow white's house" by the neighborhood.

After living here almost a year, here's my list of pros/cons


Pros
-10 min walk to the Metro and lots to do in the neighborhood
-Parking included
- Management seems attentive and takes care of maintenance issues in a timely manner
-lots of space

Cons
-Refrigerator not included and other appliances/kitchen is super old
- They paint everything (including sinks and showers) before move in to make things look new but once you clean your place the paint strips 
-Laundry is bit pricey and the machines aren't the best
- The location can be fun (across from the Bowl, walking to Runyon) but the traffic can be absolutely awful on Highland
- We live on the side of the building facing a construction site (management didn't warn us about that before moving in) and the windows are thin so it's super noisy

Not sure if it's a place to settle for longer than a year or two...
The up keep of the property is great & the management team is above par !
THE OVERALL MAINTENCE & COMMERCATION WITH THE FRONT DESK IS TERRIFIC WHICH MAKES A PROPERTY LIKE THIS WONDERFUL & THE UP KEEP OF THE PROPERTY IS ALSO GREAT !   SINCERLY LEO THOMAS

Just moved in. Our first time in a building like this and so far it's been great! The apts are really well set-up. Response time for maintenance is immediate. Great amenities. Well maintained property. Peaceful and quiet. And shout out to Barry in the leasing office he's the best! So far so good.
Accent is a great place to live combining knowledgeable and respectful staff in a very clean and modern, well appointed environment.

Accent has been a wonderful place to live for me, my husband, and our dog. We use the amenities regularly, and the dog washing station has been a life saver. After coming from an apartment with a horrible management company, accent has been a breath of fresh air. Everyone in the leasing office has been incredible and responds to any concerns promptly. Barry has been there since day 1 of our move in 2 years ago and always has a big smile on his face when he greets every resident.

My experience at Accent has been remarkably pleasant. The management team consistently goes well above and beyond the scope of their responsibilities to serve the tenants. Both Adie and Barry are excellent representatives for Accent at all times.

My boyfriend used to live here and visited often. We ran into the manager in the lobby a few times and she was always friendly and helpful. His maintenance requests were always completed. I recommend this place!
I just moved in and love the people and the place. Very generous and fair, best service. I live the unique street. Feels like resort. Thank you Urbanlux team for make it happen

I’ve been living here for the past 2 months and so far so good. The process from application to move-in was seamless. I felt taken care of every step of the way, Very personable and professional. Thank you guys

I live in this property for over 3 years and love the new management. Very helpful and fast respond. Great amenities. Very fair prices and always clean and smell good. I really care about this building, it’s my home

I used to move apartments every year but since I moved here I cannot find another apartment complex that has the same amenities for the price. The staff is nice (shoutout to Judith and Joseph - they do so much to make sure the community is happy!), the building is gorgeous, and amenities are amazing. Definitely the best bang for your buck in the area.

It's been a great experience living at Da Vinci thanks to Edgar and Joseph who always go extra miles to help and respond to the residents requests.
Thank you Edgar for going out of your way to solve the EV parking  situation. we know you guys are always busy and I truly appreciate your assistance and patience.
Keep up the good work!

I absolutely love living at The DaVinci! The property is stunning and impeccably maintained, making it a beautiful and comfortable place to call home. The pool and hot tub are incredible — perfect for relaxing after a long day or enjoying some downtime on the weekends.

A big shout-out to Joseph in the leasing office! His positive energy and welcoming attitude are unmatched; he always takes the time to say hello and make you feel appreciated. The rest of the leasing staff is just as kind and helpful, ensuring any questions or concerns are promptly addressed.

The security team deserves recognition as well — not only are they professional and attentive, but they’re also incredibly friendly, which adds to the overall sense of community and safety at The DaVinci.

If you’re looking for a beautiful, well-maintained property with great amenities and an amazing team, The DaVinci is the perfect choice!

I've been here 4 years. It's always been a pretty well run apartment. They respond pretty quickly to maintenance requests and keep the place clean. 

However, Joseph is the best. He cares about making every resident feel at home. As long as he's employed, I'll live here.

Our apartment was broken into IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT. A man came in through our balcony and when we brought it to the residence services they totally brushed us off and made it seem like it was our fault? This place is soooo poorly managed and they do not care about their residents or their safety.

Apartments have unhealthy conditions. There are roaches everywhere.
People leave trash on the hallway.
There is never a maintenance crew on site.
The manager Judith is never available.
Leasing office never want to see again after you already signed the leasing contract.
They charge a lot and the majority of the facilities don’t work.

Maintenance/repair here is lackluster 
Maintenance request is ignored most times

This is hands down one of the nicest buildings in Hollywood. Living here has felt like an absolute dream. As soon as you arrive you know you are taken care of. From the valet, to the front desk, to management…it’s all top notch. Everyone is super professional and kind. Anything I have needed, they’re on it! Any minor maintenance issues have been handled almost immediately. The units are also incredible. The views, the finishes. I could go on and on. And the rooftop pool is almost too good to be true. I start each morning with a cup of coffee up there and it feels amazing just to take in the view before I have to start my busy day. Then I head to the gym, which is beautiful! With all new machines, anything you would need. No other building in the area even compares. I feel safe and cared for here. The best way to describe it is that it feels like living at a five star hotel and I never want to leave.

I feel like I live in a luxury hotel and I am thankful to wake up here every day. The staff is extremely warm and professional and there for anything I need. My apartment is gorgeous. From the floors to the finishes, it is so good! And being able to go to the rooftop every morning to enjoy my coffee with an amazing view is the best feeling. Now that I live here I can't imagine living anywhere else and I want to tell everyone I know to move in here. I can't say enough great things!
I love our building, it is beautifully maintained, the amenities are awesome and the staff is professional and friendly.
Beautiful building with excellent staff. Its in the central area of Hollywood so there are lots of homeless but that is the city we live in
Great location, fantastic views, and abundant amenities have made my everyday life at home a 5 star experience!

Lived here from 2023-2024, property manager Tamara is great, maintenance is friendly, rooftop is mostly clean I think they removed pets, laundry is pretty good, little expensive $4.50 for wash + dry. There’s a small gym with multifunctional machines. The neighbors are nice people of all ages never had a problem with any. In comparison to mostly places I’d say this gets 4.5 stars to even 5
The on site managers, maintenance and security are experienced easy to  work with folks who do their job right

Perfect apartment. Cute, comfortable and in the best possible West LA location. I am completely spoiled by living 2 steps away from a grocery store. Management is friendly and attentive. I think I'll grow old here.

Great & quiet building. Well attended to by on-site manager. Apartment itself is spacious, full of storage and comes with a detached single-car garage. Laundry on-site. Very close to the I-10 and not far from the 405 either. And the basics (grocery, dry cleaner, pharmacy, etc) are all within a few minutes walk. And downtown Culver City is just a bit farther at a 20 min walk.

I have lived in the building for around a year. Lots of turnover in neighbors, and some issues with the building. Some noise issues from rude neighbors, and a garbage chute that is always blocked.

There is an on-site gym, but most of the machines are old and broken.

The apartments themselves are nice and big. Rent prices in the area keep increasing, and keep pushing people out.

This is the worst building to live in. None of my concerns are ever addressed! the construction is terrible with THIN floor assemblies and EVERYTHING ABOVE YOU CAN BE HEARD! There is also a serious roach problem
Poorly managed property and management is terrible. They also respond to these like they care publicly  but the minute you raise an issue with them internally they wont do anything about it.

I moved here a few months ago and have so far really enjoyed my time. You definitely get what you pay for! 

The complex is virtually brand new and the units are super clean and beautiful. I'm really surprised by how quiet it is at night for the most part. I get great sleep here. Really nice hardwood floors, appliances in impeccable condition, functioning air conditioning, and in-unit washer and dryer. The complex amenities are awesome. Every day feels like a vacation. Not only because of the nice pool area, gym, sky deck and resident lounge but also because of the proximity to so many iconic Los Angeles spots. 

Personally, I think this is one of the best locations in Los Angeles. You're super close to all the best neighborhoods in LA, including Chinatown, Arts District, Little Tokyo, DTLA and Echo Park. All those neighborhoods are accessible within a 5-20 min walk, which is insane. If you own a car, you'll love that this building is directly adjacent to both the 110 and 101 and can jump on in seconds, so you'll really cut down your commute time considerably. You can get to Pasadena in 10 minutes from here! If you ride public transit or don't have a car, this is probably the best possible location to live in LA. I own a car and I barely move it. Super close to Union Station. There are also bus stops directly outside the building. If you live on the A side of the complex, the security guard and leasing office are inside your lobby, which is awesome. They also have package storage, which is very convenient. 

CONS: Ok, let's be straight up, living in this area is not for everyone. There is a homeless encampment directly outside the A building and to the side. If that bothers you, don't live here. In fact, most of DTLA has homeless encampments around, so don't live in DTLA if that triggers you.

I absolutely hate the trash "concierge" fee of $35. This only does more to attract mosquitos to our complex, because of the number of residents who leave their trash bags outside. The building smells like trash some nights. 

This building nickels and dimes you for every replacement you need because they don't use regular keys. You have to pay a hefty fee to replace them if something happens. And it's not like you can just call a locksmith and get an instant replacement, you have to wait until the leasing office opens Mon-Fri to get a replacement. 

Overall, however, the pros definitely outweigh the cons of living here.

Even master room ceiling was repaired, water continues to leak, and cockroaches continue to appear even after exiting past control did treating them. Water kept leaking and cockroaches kept coming out, so I asked the manager for an early lease break, but we have to pay two months' rent as a penalty.

I absolutely do not recommend living in this apartment. Would you like the safe and clean place to live? Then this place is definitely not.
I'll let you know what was wrong with the LA plaza APT.
Since I moved to this place I have had so many bad experiences.
1. Master room bathroom wasn't cleaned properly. 
2. The laundry machine is broken. 
3. The dishwasher is broken.  
4. The floor is filthy. 
5. Master bathroom fan is out of order.
6. Guest bathroom fan keeps going on every 10 minutes with extremely loud sounds (I could not sleep).
7. Cockroaches came out of my unit. 
8. Water leaked from the ceiling of the master room, and the dirty water got into my eyes and caused eye inflammation.
The parking lot and my unit are in a different building, so when I park and go to my unit building, I have to walk outside. There are many homeless people walking around in this area and of course! it is not safe. There are no security guards here. It scares me every time I walk home at night from the parking lot.
Poorly managed property. Below average among greystar property.

Generally great. Quite expensive here even despite a 2 month deal.

However, the community seems well taken care of with an onsite manager that's quite responsive, residents that all seem quiet and nice, and community events that go above and beyond what I'd expect from an Apartment complex.

Built in gym and post office room is quite convenient as well.

Really safe area and loving the amenities. The team is also super receptive and fast when it comes to fixing things in our apartment or whenever we need help. I am so glad we chose Arrive and so far having a great experience here!

Location is great and convenient (right off the 405 and Santa Monica Blvd), apartments are nice and adequately furnished, I feel very safe here, and the new management is very proactive. Ariel (property mgr) has been quite the breath of fresh air and the maintenance staff is attentive, polite and professional. They provide immediate attention to any issue you bring to them, and it’s noticeable how well they work together as a team.  I actually saw the manager mopping the floor in the entry way. They seem to take a lot of pride in the work that they do to the point where it was so noticeable, I felt compelled to write a review. It’s really nice to live in a place that is so well managed.

This place is very convenient. Lots of restaurant and markets nearby. Public free WIFI is fast in the conference room and courtyard. Kitchen is new. Bathroom is spacious which I like very much!! In unit washer and dyer is a big plus. Very happy to stay here.
Management tries their best, but the amenities are really lacking for a "luxury apartment".  You are essentially paying a premium for the location here.

This noise and quaking shocks reverberate into all of the residents apartments and we are constantly woken up.  Requests to add padding to walls or floors, or to set up quiet hours, or to post/inform gym users to be mindful that this is a residential gym that shares walls with neighbors have all been ignored.

Some other issues we've faced:  Homeless people getting into the building, mail being stolen as packages are just left in the lobby, amenities are often broken, and maintenance issues take months to be addressed.
It is a great place, locations is amazing but a lot of young people making loud parties in the weekend.
I moved in recently. Couldnt be happier. I feel extremely safe in my apartment. The management team and workers are very tentative and are always there for anything. This has been great

The property manager,  leasing, and technical team are professional and friendly.
Very good amenities and services.
Special thanks to Simon and Gil.

The amazing management & leasing team made the whole leasing and move-in process seamless (thanks, Simon!). The building is also really secure and well-maintained. Loving everything about living here so far!

Pros: Modern building (which is huge for LA), clean, amenities, secure garage and building, friendly staff and people. Location (things to do). 

The downsides are the price (although maybe this is just how insane real estate is out here), small size of apartments, no free parking included, the army of homeless/vagrants/mentally ill (welcome to Santa Monica, thank the Mayor/Governor) and the location (noisy from street). And the metro. The metro is the worst part of living here. I got used to it, but I still do hear it sometimes in the middle of the night or early in the morning. If you are sensitive to sound this place is not for you, particularly if you choose a unit facing the street. 

Overall, if you can afford it and don't mind a smaller space and city "life" (noise and homeless), I'd recommend considering Catherine Apartments.
Clean and amazing amenities. Management is the best in town.

Catherine Santa Monica is the place to call home.I’m a happy and satisfied resident of Catherine. specially the stuff members Simon and and Gill they make your life easy they’re knowledgeable and very professional.

The staff at Catherine has been uniformly great.  Extra special praise to Gil in the leasing office and Dario in maintenance.  Every new building has some shakedown issues to resolve and the team here has been super responsive in dealing with any quirks that have arisen.
Living at CSM has been a very welcoming experience. We are so blessed and fortunate to be here. Thank you!

We moved from out of state during covid and leased out apartment virtually. Gil and Simon were extremely helpful and welcoming. Then once we moved in, the place was everything we wanted and more! Great amenities, luxury appliances, tons of sunlight, and the staff flawlessly maintains the grounds. Love it here!!

We are finally moving in this week. The staff (Simon and Gil) has been amazing and helpful and so kind. The building was built well for the most part and I’m a huge snob about needing buildings to be built very well with health and indoor air quality in mind. I’m so excited! Will update in awhile once we’re more settled.

Unauthorized charges-  Contract is vague and charge whatever they want. Good luck getting any contact, they take the money and run. Per month they charge an extra $180 fees and gov charges that I ASKED TO CLARIFY PRIOR TO SIGNING. That doesn’t include the hundreds spent in electricity because these are so hot to live in. 

Thin walls- my neighbors below have thin floors, I can hear word for word what they say. 

Breach of contract- said I had trash included and added it to the bill, have fun paying $58 per month in valet trash and gov fees and the hallways stink of trash daily. 

No disabled access- there’s no access that doesn’t include a step no matter where you enter. You have to walk three lengths of the building to access the ramp that to exit that still have a step. Best part is they all park in disabled spaces without their badge so I can’t park in them with a badge. When I called the regional manager never called back and now have no way to access outside after my next surgery. 

I tried to reach out to fix everything and forced to place reviews, how about you give me back my ‘service fees$25’ and ‘valet fees $25’ in back charges. My favorite part is raising my concerns and getting ignored or gaslit. If I wanted to be gaslit and have some one take all my money it would have been cheaper to call my ex. The only nice managers eventually quit so rarely any management on site. New manager to wonderful but owners and these fees and heavily overpriced unit need to review what you’re charging.
Management is terrible. Repairs go undone, making the units dangerous and unlivable. Also the walls are paper thin and you will hear your neighbors.

My husband and I have lived here for 6 months now. I think Margaret is doing a great job maintaining and monitoring the property. We've needed maintenance for 2 small things, both were fixed the same day. I would email her in the morning and by afternoon Francisco would be there. Francisco also does a fantastic job keeping the property clean and maintained. I don't know how they manage 68 units with just the two of them. The rooftop is an additional lounging space, the fitness room has what you need for a small workout. The space feels safe and the neighbors are all pretty nice. We don't really hear our neighbors, there are some exceptions like times where there may be gatherings on the rooftop on the weekends or when someone is moving and making building noises but we're never bothered. We close the windows and we're good to go.

Management unresponsive.  Left multiple messages via their online forms, email, phone calls, and voice mail over the course of two months.  Even stopped by in person to a locked door and unanswered phone number.  Never received a reply.  Calls seem to go to a call center- too corporate, never got to a real person.

The Studio is an Adaptive Reuse Project building.

The Adaptive Reuse Program exists to create new housing opportunities.

The Studio has repeatedly and continuously leased residential units for exclusive commercial use.

Shame on The Studio for illegally reducing available housing!

This place used to be wonderful. When I moved here 4 years ago, I was so happy with everything. But the quality of life and quality of service has deteriorated significantly. For the last 4 months, we've had no access to the pool or jacuzzi in my building. Our beautiful view is now an empty pool and piles of rubble, empty pails and huge garbage bags! It's been one excuse after another; "we ran into plumbing problems," "we didn't know we needed permits." Now they're blaming the fires!! But why do we have to look at garbage for $3,000 a month? The customer service is also horrendous. Horrendous! There is a manager that lives in my building and she has a habit of parking her golf cart in a no parking zone in front of the elevator that blocks my car and my neighbor's car. When I mentioned it to her and requested that she stop, she was extremely rude, dismissive and basically told me to buzz off. To my face! My neighbor and I have both written emails and made phone calls to the front office to complain about this. No one has done anything about it and no one cares that an employee is blocking tenant cars in the parking lot! My dishwasher broke 10 days ago. I have made two written maintenance requests and a phone call and I'm still living with a broken dishwasher. When I first moved here maintenance requests were responded to and resolved within 48 hours. They don't even answer the front desk phone half the time because they don't want to hear the complaints that they will do nothing about. This place used to be paradise but now it feels more like a brokedown palace. Take your hard earned money elsewhere. There are much nicer buildings in Marina Del Rey. You will not get what you pay for here.

The water stops all the time. Fire alarms go off unplanned and they don't know how to fix them. And they don't give you keys to the stairwells so when the power goes out there's no way to get back in the building. Management tells you they're dealing with problems but never take care of them. They just tell you what you want to hear. The General Manager in particular doesn't care and won't respond to e-mails about these issues.

Location is great but the property management company is so deeply incompetent it's not even funny. We go full days without water because of repairs, have to suffer hours of the fire alarms going off because of incompetent contractors they hire, and they raise the rent every chance they get. 

Sure, it's pretty, but the management company, E&S RING, sinks this place down to 1 star.
they are great at taking your money, but that’s where the luxuries stop. this place is a house of cards - no wonder why everyone moves out so quick. don’t get stuck like i did.

The location yes, the management no. They will raise your rent by 7-8% from an already ridiculous amount at the end of your one year lease. The person behind the lease means nothing to them, it’s all about greed. The units are outdated and not even worth close to what the are saying the “market” is. There are much better and newer options in the marina. Go with the places that want to keep good residents not out price them.
Plus a lot of safety/break in issues next door at Waters Edge.
It's alright. It's a place to live. There are rooms and a pool.

The construction of this apartment building was done poorly.  My unit was not properly leveled, balcony screen door did not open and close properly and couldn’t be fixed, kitchen cabinets broke and couldn’t be fixed, bathroom sink and bath tub constantly got clogged and couldn’t be fixed.  Trash chute was broken and made the entire hallway smell like trash and was never fixed.

When my neighbor used to cook or smoke it would come through the air vents into my unit.  Which management did nothing to fix.

Worst management I have ever dealt with.  It is really hard to get a hold of anyone at the leasing office and when you finally do you have to deal with Margie or Amira which are really rude and not helpful at all.  If you have a problem they do not fix it and furthermore give you attitude every time you speak with them.

I would not recommend this place to anyone.  Stay away and do not move into this place.

I loved here for about two years and enjoyed my time for the most part. However, please know that they will literally squeeze every penny they can out of you in the form of deductions on deposit or any other avenues they can.

The property manager changed here shortly before I moved in, but I have to echo the other reviews that management here (now Stacey) is very nice and responsive.   She made things about as easy as they could be.  The property is nicely maintained.  
If I had a dog here, I would be a little bummed that you are supposed to keep your dog on a leash even in the nice grassy area that is considered to be like the 'dog park' part of the property.

PROS:

- Well-kept grounds

CONS:
