- Relatively expensive
Beautiful place. Management is very friendly. We come back again!
this building is very nice to live in. The management company is good. The up keep is regular.

Sherway villas is a quiet community, I've never had problems with noise here. The staff is respectful and the area in Reseda is ok. There's tenant parking that's gated so your car will be safe. It just went into renovations in 2014 so the carpet, tile, and lighting is all new.

I have  been here for about three months now and I can say in all honesty that moving here was a great decision. I looked on-line and did not even visit the property when I decided to  'go for it'. At the time, one of the things that made me rent here was the accessibility of the management. They are all very prompt and really try to  help you out. 


Once I moved, I was very surprised to see that what had been written online (some bad reviews) was a thing from the past. 

The building is pristine; I see crew cleaning every day and they keep all areas very clean. It is super pleasant to walk into the building, specially after taking a stroll down Hollywood Blvd. Location is great! You have all the crazy touristy things right by you, but when you are in the building … it is surprisingly quiet. 

The pool area and all the other amenities are great and always super clean. It really has an 'hotel'-the nice kind- feel to it.  I have placed 2 service requests and they have been solved in less that 24 hours. And as I mentioned before, management replies to emails super quick. 

As for loud neighbors (I have not experienced this) I do not think it is a problem with the management; there are just inconsiderate people out there. I

In all honesty, do not think about it twice. There are shops. bars, the Hollywood bowl, hikes, the Metro (that takes you all the was to the beach) right out your door. And the best of all is that you can come to a super chill, well-taken care home after enjoying the city. 

The one suggestion I would make is to make the recycling bins a bit more accessible; other than this, the place is great.  

Oh, ignore all those old reviews, they must have been written a while back. 

PS: I am super picky with my living spaces and, seriously, this place is amazing.

I appreciate the leasing office, the maintenance team and overall my experience at the Alaya Hollywood. I was enjoying my experience here up until I realized that this place is not safe enough to live in. My Motorcycle was stolen from the property (my designated parking spot) and there is no trace or evidence of what happened! this makes me terrified and scared to live in such place.

If you want to live in Hollywood this is the perfect place and affordable. I have been here 3 years. Great management wonderful employees great security spacious living wonderful pool area whole property is kept clean great maintenance response time 0 roaches never had to complain about noise everyone living here is nice, friendly, minds their business.
Beautiful apartments and a friendly staff makes these apartments a prime choice for anybody looking to move in the area.

Alaya Hollywood is a wonderful, stylish, and beautiful property in the heart of Hollywood and I am excited and happy that I have moved here. I just moved to the building and getting situated and familiar. Everything is great and I Iove the property. The entire Leasing office and Security team staff are friendly , amazing and supportive and answered all questions that I have and facilitated me with my move-in. I would highly recommend Alaya Hollywood to friends and acquaintances, and I look forward to continuing my residence at Alaya!
The Alaya team is always on top of any situation that has occurred and has consistently done a Great Job in my opinion

This apartment complex is well run and maintained. The managers, Carlin, Martin and Sam are wonderful. They are open and welcoming to everyone. They fix what needs to be fixed-Fabian and the maintenance team are friendly, trustworthy and efficient. The building has nice amenities and management holds events for residents with live music! We love that! Additionally, there's security at night and on the weekends. This is a lovely community to live in and management and maintenance are definitely part of our Domain family. We appreciate them immensely.
Do not try to apply. Take advantage of people looking for a home.
The environment is nice and the staff is friendly.I lived here for four years and I have no complaints. I am moving but I will definitely miss living here.

I have been living in Portofino Townhomes for almost 3 years now. The best place I have ever rented at. The management and the staff are extremely helpful and courteous. Stacey helped me with figuring out the best unit and the best moving date for me and my daughter. The community is very friendly and we feel very secure with it being gated and having on-site security guard. The 2 pools and the barbeque area are awesome and our dogs enjoy walking on the nice grass areas. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great place to live in.

Got a 2-bed with 1.5 bath. Clean, spacious, peaceful, very friendly & helpful staffs(especially Stacy!!), very close to interstate 110. It has two great pools and BBQ grills for families to enjoy. 2 designated parking spaces per unit; one covered, one with no cover. I highly recommend these townhomes! If anyone is interested, call the leasing office and make an appointment right away!

These townhomes are great. Located in a nice gated community makes you feel secure. The homes are very nice and spacious. Comes with easy assigned parking. You get two parking spots if you need an extra one . The staff is always very helpful if you need anything they are always there to help, they are also always setting up activities for everyone. I would definitely recommend moving in if you are planning on it.

Ive lived here for almost a year with friends and the complex is nice, clean and peaceful. The apartments are modern and spacious. The pool areas are nice along with the little playgrounds for kids to play on and more than enough room on the complex to walk your dogs!

I have been living here at these townhomes for about a year and a half now and I have had the best experience very helpful staff and I especially couldn’t moved in without Stacy in the leasing office she helped me figure everything out best move-in date that would be smarter and more convenient, every time I need help or have any questions I can just walk in or call the office and They don’t hesitate to help you with anything you might need 10/10 would recommend moving in to these beautiful homes if you are looking for something nice and with up to date appliances in a nice gated community and they always put together activities all the neighbors are always invited. By far the easiest and best place I’ve ever rented at!

The property manager and leasing office deliberately keep hours that mean anyone with a normal 9-5 cannot reach them in office. Nobody gets back about phone calls unless you email the company's corporate email and they get scared. Nobody responds to emails. My first night here the ceiling light strobed all night and they did nothing for two days. I could not sleep in the room for the first two days of my lease, and they offered no real help at all.  This place is not worth your money. The managers are scam artists.  The rent is so much but on top of the rent they add in fees for everything.

Convenient location if you need to be in the North Hollywood / Burbank area. However, in the midst of a pandemic which they cite as the reason for not providing necessary maintenance, they also choose not to make any effort to encourage residents to wear masks in public spaces. Cheap, poorly maintained finishes such as sagging cabinet doors and light fixtures, malfunctioning windows, finicky plumbing etc.

The worst living experience I have had. From EDM music constantly pulsing through the apartment from the kids that live here and go to the school across the street, FBI raids for people selling LSD, Sewage water (and contents) covering the garage from burst pipes, and fire alarms from people smoking too much in their apartments every single day.... it will never stop.

Very disappointed with Madison Toluca, neighbors are very noisy. Residents are mostly young and parting all the time, you can hear them screaming in the corridor, sometimes even running at 3 a.m. Property manager seems to ignore it.
If you want to sleep well, do not choose this place! I do not recommend it!

This is a great place to live if you want to avoid the freeway. Located just between Toluca Lake, Burbank, and North Hollywood, Has a real small town feel to it.  Close to Burbank Airport. Portos Bakery is within walking distance.Universal Studios nd Warner Brothers is a five -seven minute drive.  Maintenance and staff  very friendly. There is no pool here, each building (3) has roof top lounging and gas BBQ grills. Building one is pet friendly, if you live on first and second floors, you may hear pets scampering above (elevator smell gets a bit strong at times.Recommend Building 2 or 3,

Madison Toluca has been a good experience overall. It's a quiet environment with a lot of amenities including a gym and roof top with grills and comfy patio furniture. The location is perfect in North Hollywood. It's situated nicely between Toluca Lake and Burbank. The apartment itself is a little small for the price, but what do you expect when you live in Los Angeles.

The office manager is completely unprofessional and non transparent to begin with. Everything was done through e-sign which I am very familiar with but the form only let you apply unless you pay lump sums of deposit $500 plus $15 processing fees which doesn’t include the application fees. Application process was very confusing and didn’t make sense. In the process, I missed three initials which the manger sent email saying the lease is canceled due to a few missing initials. I tried to call but there is never anyone there to answer which was more frustrating. Overall I basically got run around of back and forth of thousand email exchanges. And our lease was canceled and I didn’t get the deposit back. I am absolutely furious about their unprofessionalism and in away glad it didn’t work out. The place looked great and is at great location but with this kind of bad service I highly doubt you will get any type of answer if you are having problems inside or outside of unit/ property. Do Not get this place

There is a construction going on in this building and they start pounding and drilling the wall 7:00am! I never get a good sleep and wake up with stress. The wall is super thin. You can hear when people are talking through the wall. The window doesn’t block the noise well either. And the worst thing is the hot water doesn’t work in the morning. You have to run the water for 10 mins to get heated. Waking up with noise and then no hot shower!! This is a insane place!

When I moved into this building the leasing manager was very accommodating and any concerns that came up felt like they truly cared. Especially when my first 6 months I had neighbors who would fight all day and cops came out multiple times. As soon as Sofia left it went downhill from there. Rent raised $800 in 2 years, major construction started with water being turned off all day at times with short notice, loud noises from Construction happening, the garage has also been broken into multiple times I've had 2 bikes stolen. The walls and floors are very thin in the bedroom you not only hear people next to you but also below and above you. They used to have a security guard at night but they do not anymore - raise the rent but get rid of expenses? Truly terrible. The building says dog friendly but they clean the dog run with bleach which causes rashes for animals and no one picks up their dog poop. The worst part of all of this was I spoke with the leasing manager about renewing my lease and my concerns with the construction, she said I can do 3 months to see how it goes and renew at the same rate for 9 more months if I decide and told me to remind her as if she was doing me a favor. That three
months came up and the rent went up $325/month. I tried reaching other people from the property management company to discuss any of this but no one Wanted to listen just immediately shut me down. There are a ton of new buildings in the area offering great incentives I would not look at 3838 by clg.

The Irvine Company does not care about you at all. They try to make you happy with words that mean nothing. When you have an issue pertaining to theft or security, they will ignore you when it matters most and then try to convince you that they are doing all they can. In reality, they can and will do nothing. They will shove your lease back in your face and then say they are "sorry" for doing literally nothing to help you and they "hope they have helped you find a resolution". No, they have helped nothing. After staying here for over a year, the niceties don't work anymore. They have a revolving staff every few minutes to the point where they are disorganized and cannot help you when it matters. Don't count on the safety of yourself or your property when staying here. The gates to the parking garage which give access to the entire complex are broken at least twice a month and allow anyone and everyone in to the complex. Irvine Company claims they are doing something about it, and yet the issue is unresolved after nearly two years. Look somewhere else.

One of the worst possible places you could ever live. Fire alarms go off constantly. At least 7-8 full days so far in 2024 and the building management does not care at all for the impacts on babies/pets. They provide no information other than the alarms will be on all day and they can provide zero accommodation regardless of the impacts to health/safety for babies or others that have hearing related health issues. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!

If you are looking for a safe building, this isn’t the one for you. The new management took over in Feb 2023 and since then, we only have an on-site manager 2 times per week (the first part time one quit after just a few weeks), our online portal and access to our documents and ability to pay online was taken down, maintenance requests go unanswered, security has been lax to the point of unhoused individuals getting in and causing a floor to be flooded after opening a gas and a water valve to “possibly take a bath” as said by the fire department when the responded to the emergency, we get a piece of paper the night before our rent is due with no official letterhead telling us to pay rent to a company with no online presence that was not specified in our lease, and our new owner has made it very clear if you don’t like the way she runs things then get out. RUN as fast as you can from this property.

Only 2 people at the desk. Impossible to get anything done with maintenance here. Incredibly loud in the rooms. Nonstop fire trucks and buses blaring by all day all night. Not the mention the construction you wake up to every day. Biggest mistake of my life signing a lease here
Love the brand newness of the building, location  is great and the team is Really nice people!!
The complex is always clean and well maintained, thanks to the staff here! Everyone is great, cleaning crew, maintenance, and management! It’s been an overall great experience living here:)

Building and facilities are brand new. Management is nice and the maintenance team is the best thing about this place. However this is not a place for families nor early workers. The structure is extremely thin, you can hear everything from all the neighbors. EVERYTHING. Tenants play loud music and party all night during weekdays and weekends. If you are an early worker or if you have a family, this is not the place for you to live.
Mira is the best. We have the best community of tenants, most attentive management team and they are so pleasant. The dog community is great. We love where we live.
Mira is an amazing community. It's clean, beautiful and the people who work here make it 10x great. I love living here.
Awesome place to live, they keep everything clean and safe, as well as great technology with the app when in need of any Maintenance. Happy to be part of this community

It went from the Ritz to the Marriott to a Motel 6. I have to wear headphones in my own home as they refuse to manage the noise at the pool and are allowing partiers to move in so that the walls shake from above, below, and the sides. The security is a joke as I've found many people who don't live here wandering around and the residents are so rude to the wonderful facilities team who do the upkeep by letting dogs crap in hallways and leave items they are too lazy to take down to the recycling themselves for them. The resident office doesn't seem to stress what's in the lease and community rules, only caring about filling empty rooms.

The Villas at Playa Vista Malibu succeeded in making me believe that I was moving into a luxury apartment building. Everything seemed too good to be true, and it was. While the building does have great amenities and asthetics, it is not worth the annoyance of paper thin walls and horribly maintained necessities. 

The insulation in this building has to be some of the worst of its kind. My girlfriend and I originally moved into a 4th floor apartment (5th floor being the highest). We could hear every single thing from the apartment above us. Foot steps, talking, TV, even them going to the bathroom. It got to the point where we knew their exact schedule from the moment they woke up in the morning, until they went to sleep at night.

Luckily, we were able to move to a top floor apartment within a couple months. We made the switch and hoped to finally have peace. Unfortunately, as soon as we moved in, we noticed that we could now hear the apartment beneath us just as well, if not worse. We are no longer able to sleep in, or even relax at home comfortably. 

Don't let the enticing appearance of The Villas at Playa Vista fool you, this construction of this building cut costs at every corner. My biggest regret was signing a 14 month lease and now having to wait for the end. If somehow you are able to find comfort in constant shaking floors and walls, this may be the place for you!

I have lived at Malibu villas for 2 1/2 years. I live in building one.. personally my DOGS, My husband my son and I , are completely satisfied and have enjoyed living here. Irvine company has exceptional properties throughout all over. We have lived in two of their managed buildings one in Hollywood and this building Malibu ..  We love our walks in the community, the dogs love going to the dog park 4 min away, my son walks to whole foods and to soccer field, feeling always safe, and that’s so important for me because I know he is safe. The gym has great equipment and the 
FREE workout classes provided by Malibu are awesome. The amenities of the buildings and in the overall community are
Satisfactory  ..
By biggest compliment goes to The management and the staff that keep this place clean are exceptional without a doubt, they work so hard to keep the entire complex clean. The functionality of the building is great .. elevAtors and doors have occasionally broken down, but management is very quick to get elevAtors, and any electrical malfunction running by calling in repair ASAP... It is not easy to keep the parts running in a 400 unit complex with 600 tenants. Great job !!!! Price is fair, it should be higher for the area, due to its price point of $4 million dollar homes just around the corner. My advice is keep rent high to keep the area exclusive. I Pay for the area not the building, so thank you Malibu for a nice building to go with the nice area  View Less

I've lived here for a year but would not make this mistake again.  The elevators are constantly broken.  There are only two elevators, and it is common for one or both of them to be down.  What's more, the stairs don't go directly to the ground floor, so during the regular elevator breakdowns, the entire building is forced to go through a maze of corridors just to get home.  Not to mention the front door and key fobs regularly don't work.  So I sometimes have to wait for someone to leave the building in order to get into my own home.  Playa Vista is a great community overall, but Malibu and its management don't seem to care about maintenance.  Given the high rents, I'd look elsewhere.
Management is impossible to get in touch with. No answers to phone calls, emails, voicemails. If you need assitance you're on your own

I like my apartment. The staff is very courteous. However, there are chronic issues with both elevators and the laundry machines which have made living here very unpleasant. If it weren't both expensive an inconvenient, I would move to another residence as soon as my lease expires.
Woodley Sara is a great place to live. We love living here. Everybody here has been so friendly.

The building itself looks nice on the outside, but the reality is it's simply uncomfortable to live here. First, the laundry system has been down for months so we have to do our laundry out of the building. That would be fine if it were the only issue. The main elevator breaks down constantly and people are often stuck inside. The building also seems to have a problem with bugs and we have little roaches in our apartment and had to have an exterminator come by which hasn't fixed the problem. Alarms (fire alarms and the smoke alarms inside the apartment itself) go off all the time often in the middle of the night. The saving grace is that maintenance is wonderful as the head of maintenance lives in the building and always takes care of things. Overall I would NOT recommend moving here. Renter beware!!

Welcome to Woodley Sarah, “professionally managed by Graystar”.  The professional management will make sure to keep you busy with daily surprises. From getting stuck inside the elevator and panicking for nonstop false fire alarms to shutting off water for days, and out of order/dirty laundry rooms and laundry dispenser. The backyard is decorated with different size and shapes of dog poop which are not getting cleaned. It’s a nonsmoking apartment for the benefit of smokers. I should admit that they are really “professional” at imposing extra charges like parking, insurance, utility etc. The packages are being stolen and it’s not a safe building.

The building its self is very nice, but maintenance has been very poor. Since moving in 7 months ago, the main elevator has gone offline almost weekly and some times for up to two weeks at a time. At least three times the LAFD has had to be called to reduce someone from a stuck elevator. The laundry pay system has been broken for a total of six weeks which means having to go outside the building to wash your clothing. The staff here is doing their best, but appear to have their hands tied by the ownership in terms of who they can hire to repair major systems which are down.

Apartment building has some flaws.  

First, apartments are very noisy. Particularly on the side facing the Ivy Station restaurants and metro stop, you can hear everything going on. 

Unlike many buildings of the same age, A/C system is pretty shoddy. At move-in, the A/C was broken.  Even after it was fixed, the apartment was either roasting or freezing. 

Before move out the management company failed to provide the required pre-move out inspection itemized statement.  They nevertheless withheld the bulk of the deposit for "damage" to the unit.  However, they were unable to identify a specific reason or documentation beyond an invoice saying the apartment was fully cleaned and fully painted.  The place was professionally cleaned before move-out, so its unclear what the justification for the additional cleaning was or why the apartment needed to be fully repainted.

Clean, safe, well-appointed. So grateful to be here. Security staff at Ivy Station at night solved my concern about living by a train stop. I’ve walked my dog at midnight and didn’t feel bothered while on the grounds.0

I’m new to Upper Ivy and have loved every minute since I’ve moved in! The staff is extremely knowledgeable and helpful no matter the situation. They’ve made living here a breeze and it’s great to know there’s a reliable team to go to if I ever need anything. Best management experience I’ve ever had!

overall, upper ivy is a great option if you want to be close to all the action of downtown Culver City. very nice facility with professional and responsive staff. fairly priced and will work with you to meet your needs. seems like they are invested in building a community amongst the residents which is a huge plus.
Management is never available, always gone - never picks up phone or responds to emails. Management mislead us on certain aspects of our lease and now we're stuck with two major inconveniences.
UpperIvy has been amazing! Can’t imagine living anywhere else.
Great place to live with great amenities, very clean and management is on point. Never had an issue whatsoever.

I love the location of this property, great walkability great amenities, office staff is pretty nice when dealing with them. The floors between the units are the toughest so you dear hear your above neighbor, But if you lived in Los Angeles all your life you expect that from apartments at times so its not a big deal. honestly love the quiet community. People that complain still renew so its a great place. :) Looking forward to see all the great things they have coming in the future. Events wise.

The amenities are nice and the location is walkable to Platform. The ceilings/floors are extremely thin, so we could hear every footstep of the people above us. It was clear that management did not care about residents whatsoever. Maybe because the management constantly turned over. No one who worked there when we moved in still worked there when we moved out. There was constant noise from events held at Ivy Station. We were told when we toured that there would be farmers markets and yoga on the lawn. Instead, there were lots of events blasting loud music until late at night. The worst thing would be large construction machines that beeped loudly from 8PM to 3 or 4AM every few weeks to change the ads on the side of the platform. The lawn was actually the main reason we chose the apartment, so that our dog would have room to run around. Our leasing agent said that dogs were welcome on the lawn, but not even a month later, a big sign went up banning dogs. This was enforced strictly by the security guards, who seemed more interested in enforcing management’s rules than protecting residents (someone on the platform literally threw glass bottles at our window while the security guards did nothing). On the financial side, we were given a rent concession as a special to be applied on our 3rd and 5th months. Both times, the concession was not applied and we had to contact management repeatedly to have the issue fixed. No one seemed to care that we were charged more money than we were supposed to be charged, and they had either no idea or no interest in fixing it. Our last month of rent was supposed to be prorated since we were moving out halfway through the month, but they charged us the entire month. When we went to ask about it, they wrote down a number on a post it and told us to just pay that and leave a balance, which felt super weird. Upon moving out, they kept almost our entire security deposit despite us leaving the apartment in great condition. We were charged $170 for cleaning, $199 for water when our monthly water bill was typically around $30, and a ridiculous $495 for paint. I have never lived in an apartment where they charged for painting what should be covered by normal wear and tear. They also didn’t send us a list of what we were charged for until we sent several emails and called several times. Our first few emails were ignored. Overall, this place looks nice on the outside, but seriously deserves to be investigated for their sketchy practices.

Great location with super easy access to public transportation. Well maintained and modern apartments. Getting into the garage can be annoying, but it is at least very secure. If you like walking to places and using public transportation this is the apartment complex for you.

Upper Ivy aesthetically is an amazing apartment building but good management is what seems to be lacking here. I had a major plumbing issue in my unit for which I was not contacting until 48 hours later. It then took 7.5 hours to fix the issue but no communication was provided while maintenance would pop in and out (at one point leaving for 2 hours). A giant hole was present after the fix for which I was not contacted on when it would be patched. Multiple times I had to chase down people to do their job and as a resident, that is unsettling. Overall, the process was a mess and I would not recommend Upper Ivy to future residents as they don’t seem to care about issues unless they are pressed to do something about it.

I’ll start off with the pros 
- great location! 
- good amenities
- clean 

Cons
- you can hear every single noise from upstairs 
- not really dog friendly - dogs aren’t allowed outside their homes? Very strange 
- no overnight guest parking or free guest parking spots 
- nobody wears a mask in the gym

Upper Ivy was one of the first properties we toured when moving to LA and it won us over immediately. The space is so well thought out all around the property, and its central location in Culver City can't be beat. We've had a great experience with the leasing, concierge and maintenance staff and feel like all of our needs have been met quickly. We'd recommend Upper Ivy to anyone looking for a new place on the west side.

Upper Ivy is a beautiful hip cutting edge community. For anyone looking to upgrade and have concierge this is the place. The staff is so helpful and approachable and the building and amenities are 5 star! Upper Ivy is in the middle of everything cool and walkable. So happy to call it my new home.
Upper Ivy is the place to be for location, amenities and upscale units! The community is unmatched with a walkable location to many restaurants, stores and fitness boutiques.

Upper Ivy is a place where the feeling of home meets the feeling of being on a resort. It is such a beautiful property, well positioned in LA with a walk score well into the upper 90s! It has everything in just a few short moments of travel time. The property is amazing and well kept. The units are beautiful and some with such unique layouts. I feel safe and genuinely feel that Im getting every cent worth of incentive while living there.

Upper Ivy is what you hope every new building should be; modern, sleek, tech forward, and to have the team running the show to be a compliment to the living experience. Most staff forget about you once you sign and pay the deposit, but the Upper Ivy team has been there for whatever I need!
Beautiful apartments with high quality appliances and counter tops. Amazing and easy to access amenities.
The property is first class; as are the team that manages the building. Nick is simply the best

Just moved in and I love it here! The building is well kept and so quiet. This is by far my favorite place that I’ve lived in, in the Los Angeles area. Not to mention, Nicholas has been such a big help before and after moving in. Any questions I had, he was quick to answer them.

Great amenities (on-site pool, gym, Amazon lockers), well-kept environment, modern finishings, great location and quiet and respectful tenants. 

Staff here are friendly, helpful and responsive and I like the sense of a small community here compared to larger complexes I've lived at.
I was floored the moment I moved in, from decor to design to the way staff welcomed me in. Can't wait to share my home with my guests!

This is a fabulous place to live if you like style, an open floor plan, and brand new EVERYTHING. Nick will give you a tour and he couldn't be more helpful and responsive to any questions or concerns. He cares about the tenants and the building. You'll be glad you live here!

The building: new, the people: stylish, the neighborhood: green. The apartments are so fresh and cute and perfect for a bachelor such as I. Nicholas the building manager was SUCH a doll and made me feel so comfortable! Pressure free situation!! You’re gonna love it babe.

I lived here for a year before moving to the east coast. The apartments were really upscale and all the rooms and halls were well kept and clean. The main issue I have with this place is that the fire alarm ALWAYS went off and there's no way of turning it off, down or making it come out of a different place. I developed nighttime anxiety because of it. Other than that, the place was a great place to live right next to CSUN but beware if you don't want to get nighttime anxiety of a jumpscare fire alarm sitting right next to your bed.
Laura is amazing office person and she always is really nice  and Chris is the best maintenance person bc he makes sure he gets his work done

Seems like a beautiful upscale apartment, but once you move in, you realize that it’s literally just a college dorm with luxury apartment prices. It’s brand new, however it’s cheaply made. No one had ever lived in my unit before I moved in, yet the air conditioning filter was CAKED in dust and dirt. 

The real problem here is the management. The main manager is unfriendly, unapproachable and just annoying. All she does all day is watch the cameras and issue warnings to residents. Often times in those cases she gets tenants mixed up and sends warnings/penalties to wrong parties. She is very unprofessional and unfortunately has gotten the rest of the staff to start acting the same. It’s a shame because this place could be really great with other more friendly management. Will not be renewing lease.

The building is clean and conveniently located. However, the side facing the nearby school can be quite noisy. I wouldn't recommend it for a long stay, as you might be charged about half of your deposit for reasons that seem unrelated!!!
They took over $1,200 from my $2,200 deposit without telling me, security for the building is not acceptable, and sadly is average for the price, I do not recommend living here
The apartment is very mordern is worth the money and the pool is very clean Every day and the people in the management office is very nice to the Residence

There is just something special about this place and you can tell so much thought was put into the building layout and unit designs. It gives a calm and minimalist aesthetic that you’ll want to show off to everyone you know. Dinner parties are a must. The pool area is secluded and cute that you’ll wanna go out there and relax on the daily. I am so excited to call this place home. Extra kudos to Cameron, a genuine and welcoming human who I hope you get the chance to encounter :) Come be my neighbor!

As a resident, it’s my responsibility to warn potential tenants about the concerns I have with the safety of property. 

First, this building is in Van Nuys, but listed as Sherman Oaks. As a transplant, I was not aware of this until other residents noted it. We receive several notifications daily about home robberies, mail/car thefts in this area on the Ring app. There was also a large graffiti tag painted in the alley of our parking garage this week. Management quickly removed it but several residents noticed, and a strong indication of gang presence.

Upon move-in it was also clear that the units were built with haste, as I had 3 different amenities fall apart with the first few days. The floors were also covered in sharp particles and dirt left my feet completely black on night one

I brought up lack of security in the building, entrance & parking garage during my tour. I asked why there was no key required to enter the lobby from the garage, and was told it would be installed this summer, but it was not. Once in building, you have full access to all unit doors. The units arent keyless entry, there is no concierge and inadequate camera placement. Thus, anyone can easily access the building and break in to units with the right tool. The garage is filled w/ luxury cars that are perfectly visible from outside. Once the gate opens, anyone can walk in, and gate also takes a min to close. This kind of negligence makes it a cake walk for car thieves.  And as mentioned, a huge gang  tag was painted right next to the garage this week. It’s only a matter of time before the wrong people enter this property. Especially because it’s a quiet building with no adequate security

Next, I had a large package stolen from the mail room. I asked manager about this, and I was told that it “looked ugly” and that I should not have left it there longer than  24 hrs. She even went as far to say that this was listed in renters agreement, which was flat out untrue. The mailroom also doesn’t have cameras nor a lock on door, anyone can access. When I asked them to review the camera footage, I was told they weren’t going to waste their time because it wasn’t their responsibility. It was clear to me that they removed the package and that our deliveries are not safe if not picked up immediately and subject to being thrown away. As someone who travels frequently, this is extremely concerning. Another resident also told me that his package came up missing too.

Management does not care about the tenants. There is a HOMELESS ENCAMPMENT across the street that sell drugs to the tenants. Sometimes the homeless people come on the property to use the laundry room to charge their phones and walk the halls. There are homeless people that sleep in the parking lot. Very loud and noisy building. Management only cares about the MONEY. They charge extra fees for everything. DO NOT MOVE HERE! You will regret it, especially when management does not give you back your security deposit. They make up lies to keep your money.

I've been dealing with this complex since September and I'm ready to blow my top! As of now I'm withholding rent bc they installed windows in my apartment that allow bugs to come through. I've killed hundreds of gnats, mosquitoes and other small flying insects since March and have been given no help or information on fixing the problem till this day! I've sent over twenty emails with pictures and video, nothing. I'm sure if I broke my lease they'd be contacting me then but even with threats of doing that they still don't reply. Literally stuck in hell.

I wish I would have paid attention more this place is just bad, bad experience so far. Nothing gets fixed and once you email for repairs it’s like you’re leaving in a ghost building. Non existent management. I want to scream right now!!!!! Ugh!

I searched West LA/SaMo for 4 months before finding Chelsea. I was looking for a balance between luxury, affordability and being happy to come home every day. Roze @ Chelsea made it all come together. He was extremely patient and when one unit didn’t work, he offered another coming up in a few weeks. That unit ended up being beyond perfect for my needs and he was there every step of the way even allowing me to push my move in date so It was convenient for me. Roze greets me every day by name and has an open door policy. This was great to hear and see because my last management company was terrible. Every day feels like i’m coming home to a hotel but with all my stuff in it. Thank you Roze and Chelsea for making my apartment search dreams come true!
Chelsea is a great place to live if you want a great community, professional and receptive manager and a beautiful ocean view.

Also building was really not nice and super loud.
Location is good but no amenities other than an awkward rooftop lounge. Way too pricey for the product.
Looks like this will be the place to live in Santa Monica
I find Ventana a lovely place to live. The staff is friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a safe and attractive environment to live.
Great office staff. Nice community and neighborhood,
The Leasing Office and Maintenance Department are very friendly and take care of all the needs of the community, and residence.  My building is extremely quite.
This is our second year living in the Ventana Apartments. We are fortunate to have quiet and kind neighbors. It's lovely and safe here. The community personnel are attentive and also kind.

My husband and I are seniors, have sold our house to be close to our daughter; and with living in an apartment being our best option at this time, we couldn't think of a better place to be than at The Ventana. We couldn't appreciate more everyone  management and maintenance. They're so great!
The Ventana Apartments are a great place to live, a professional Leasing office and Maintenance Department.  A safe, quiet place to live.

Palm Twins ?? complex is amazing! Very quiet, clean and well maintained place. Tiffany, the property menager, is one of the kindest. She's incredible nice, attentive and warm person, always making sure you wishes are satisfied. I'm so happy and pleasant to have her around. This complex is located in beautiful NoHo, prices are very affordable and is close to everything.
So don't hesitate to stop by, check this place and make it yours. I highly and strongly recommend it!

Tiffany, the building manager creates excellent community vibes. It's a small community, so it's nice to cultivate such a positive environment. I feel very safe living here and the unit is modern with SS appliances. Even though it's a studio, it has a sleek, modern stove and a dishwasher. I've lived here about a year and am planning on staying another year because I feel at home in this community.

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review: My partner and I have loved living here! We think the staff is great, the apartment is well made, and the location is top-notch. If something breaks, maintenance is there THAT DAY to fix it. We've never felt unsafe, nor have we ever disliked our apartment. You can hardly hear your neighbors, at least we can't, and the space is big. 10/10 we recommend to anyone looking to live here!

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review:

Thx VDM

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review: The walls are incredibly thin. You can hear people talking in their apartments as you walk down the hall and I live under, what I can only assume, are a herd of elephants. They stomp around the apartment above me for hours in the middle of the night each night. I don’t care what people do in their own apartment but I don’t want to hear it. Typical Los Angeles management company. Complain about anything and you get a patronizing answer and nothing gets fixed or taken care of. It’s a loud neighborhood full of rude people and it’s all around awful. ToO expensive for what you get. Glad I got out when I did.

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review: This place sucks. The management is terrible, they lie to appease you but never fix any of the issues. It’s overpriced. They did a remodel a few years ago but it was done cheaply and everything breaks. The people who tend to the outside use a leaf blower everyday for hours. They use it for everything and there aren’t even that many trees on the property. They say no pets allowed but everybody has a dog so if you have any allergies to pet dander do not move here because management does nothing of course. Also the construction across the street is terrible goes on at 7 AM until 6 PM six days a week, there is never a break. Cars are covered with dust and there’s constant construction noise all day. There are nicer places in the area for the same price. Save your time and money and look elsewhere.  Worst mistake moving here, wish I could give zero stars.

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review: I cannot wait to move out of here! Birds poop all over the common areas and the entry to your building. You have dodge it when you are at the pool with your children smh! The carports don't protect your car and if you car is left out for one day it looks TERRIBLE! The management is completely disconnected and suck... they act like there is nothing they can do, and the "Birds are indigenous to this area". They are always working on areas prohibiting you from parking and constantly being rerouted. Construction on this street is on going and will be for another year. You have to drive through a construction site just to get to your home. Please do not move here, as you would dodge a huge bullet!

apartmentName: Villa Del Mar Apartment Homes and Marina
review:
The good side
The new building and its amenities are what initially sold me on this place. They are pretty nice. The people in the leasing office are super nice and the maintenance guys are great as well.  The residents all keep to themselves but are friendly. 

MOLD:
There will be a construction project going on for the next few YEARS which WILL cause you to shut your windows due to NOISE and DUST. According to management, this will trap humidity and in my case, eventually cause MOLD. We had a very bad MOLD OUTBREAK and management was not willing to help fix the problem. Here are your two options: have a VERY dusty apartment OR have a moldy apartment. There is ONE vent in the apartment in the bathroom and no air conditioning. Therefore, there is no way to properly vent your apartment. In my opinion, this is a structural issue with the apartments. Management told me to get a dehumidifier which raises the apartment temperature to OVER 80 degrees! The humidity level in my apartment is above 70%. To put things into perspective, a 40% humidity level is considered a safe level and above 60% is considered problematic.
 I run the dehumidifier 24 hours a day which pulls about 4-6 gallons of water out of the air.

CONSTUCTION NOISE:
If you like loud noises, this is the place for you!!! Construction starts every day at 7am! I know this because it wakes me up every single day. I no longer need to set an alarm. I consider myself to be a heavy sleeper as well. Large excavators and backhoes SCREACH down the street in the morning. Occasionally, they Trucks and Backhoes go in reverse to cause a loud beeping sound. In some cases, the heavy equipment is close enough to my apartment for me to touch it with my own hand. Construction occasionally occurs on the weekend as well. 

 DUST PILE
There is a MASSIVE pile of dirt down the street at the construction site. As the wind picks up, which it does in the afternoons, it picks up the dust and evenly distributes it across the Villa del Mar apartments and boats. If you are looking to rent any of these apartments, just look at any balcony, and you will see it is covered in dust. To be fair, the leasing office has complained to the construction company. 

Management’s Solution
Several times, when I have had an issue, management has told me that I can break my lease. Instead of fixing the problem, they will just take a check from another renter.  I am writing this to make other renters aware of this issue.
Disastrous management company that is genuinely incompetent beyond any degree of comprehension
I lived here for about a year and it was a great experience, their amenities were aesthetically beautiful and cozy! The manager was always so attentive. Very calm place to live in

In my time living here, my car was keyed and vandalized, the manager entered our apartment daily without warning, and the management team did everything they could every dollar from you. Upon move out she charged me an extra month of rent without reason.

I do not recommend C1 Coliving, I lived in Coliving at C1 for 8 months as an in between while I sort out a new job. They placed 5 different roommates in the 4 bedroom + 1 room with no windows and 2 bathrooms to share. There's no screening process with roommates on their end and no introduction. Each roommate was worse than the last. They are solely operated on profit, greed, and filling rooms which are now listed above and beyond what any tenant should be paying for the rental room and above market rate. The roommates ranged from super young alcoholic drug users, to one's whom would go through my personal belongings, groceries and toiletries, to screaming and cursing at me and other roommates, and overall unstable . They also kept my security deposit without valid claims and refused to refund. Their claim was to paint and patch the walls. Completely unreasonable, fraud, and abuse of my security deposit. I'm suing .

We sold our house in Porter Ranch and needed a place to stay in the area for a few months before moving in to our new home. The Vineyards Apartments made the transition seamless and made our stay very comfortable. We met Alex during our first visit and we were impressed by his level of professionalism, customer service and willingness to help. Once we moved in, we also had similar experiences with Mike and Cassandra. Our apartment was clean and looked like no one had ever lived there. The best part of it all is that they were understanding and accommodated the changes in our move-out dates because our new home move-in date was pushed back several times. They dont care what size your car is, they just say every unit is assigned to specific carport and the carports is narrow just fit for compact cars while open spaces is wider. What if you change the car and your new one not fit? i emailed twices (they ignored my email, no response) and even come to office but manager left at 4pm everyday and staff can't do anything! Ventilation fan in bathroom is running every 1 hour regardless during the night which can wake you up. Maintenance team is doing mickey mouse, even didnt fix but they still emailed telling me the work is done and ask for survey LOL. I gonna move out when lease end!

Absolutely love this complex. I was looking around to help a friend find an apartment today and the vineyards was the 1st to pop up. Figured I should write a review. I grew up in Porter Ranch, as soon as we saw they were building these apartments we knew we had to check them out. We have been here for a year and so far the management has been nothing but the best. Casandra and Mike are always smiling and say hello. Alex always waves when he’s taking ppl on tours. Any time we put in a work order it’s taken care of within 24 hours, usually that day. I saw the previous review about coyotes, well, that’s what you get when living in Porter ranch. Wildlife has always been around Porter ranch and most likely always will be since we are in the hills. The Gym is well taken care of and never more then 3/4 ppl in there at a time and I’m there 6/7 days a week. Landscapers are here all the time and you never go a day not seeing maintenance all over cleaning up and working hard. I’m so grateful we got in when we did especially with the cost of renting today! Truly can’t say a bad thing about this place or how it’s taken care of.

Don't be mislead there is nothing luxurious about this complex. They don't have any security at the complex, people that don't live at the complex jump the gate to use the pool on the weekends its always crowded. They have a big bug issue I found bugs in the light fixtures and coyotes stop by every night to sleep in the patio area.

Kitchen has all stainless steel appliances, white cabinets, charcoal stone countertops, washer/dryer, distressed grey vinyl plank, carpet in bedrooms, ceiling fans in bedrooms and also outside on the patio. You also have an extra storage room off the patio and in the garage. Lots of recessed lighting, all with dimmer switches. Pendant lighting over the kitchen island.
And the staff is truly great. Everyone has been so patient, showing us how to use all the modern hi tech features, front door fob, appliances, nest thermostat, etc. They are professional, friendly and truly helpful. 
This is one of the best apartments I’ve seen in a long time. And having sold my home and moved to an apartment, the transition has been fabulous. Oh, and I can walk to Whole Foods, AMC, Nordstrom Rack, my nail salon, Peet’s coffee and a bunch of amazing restaurants  right below us!  And all the neighbors in the whole community have been great. Lots of dog people. We meet everyone walking our dogs, and it’s so nice to have such great neighbors. Other than the one hypocritical woman in the gym who asked my boyfriend to wear a mask when she wasn’t wearing one. (Lol- there’s always one) we have loved all our neighbors. 
I highly recommend The Vineyard Apartments. I just can’t say enough. It’s the next best thing to owning a home. ??

Thank you ! I love living in my new apartment. The residential support is awesome .. the staff friendly and helpful and the services offered are great ! I would definitely refer this to my friends

Great community, great staff, quiet & clean building. Nice place to live.

The team at Bell Warner is top notch.  They get the job done in a timely manner and easy to reach with any issues that arise.  
The building is kept clean.   The new security upgrades make the community a safe place to live. A

Home is where the Harrison is.

Pros
- Got a free month at sign up as the building was brand new and they needed tenants (not sure if they'll offer this again)
- Newer building with gym, pool, bbq grills
- Friendly neighbors
- Ample guest parking
- Appliances are included (fridge is on the small side)
- Has washer/dryer in unit

Cons
- One bedroom gets you 1 parking spot, good luck finding parking on the busy street (they charge $150 more for an additional spot)
- Bathroom is very large yet the closet is tiny, poor design choice
- Smoke alarms are too sensitive and go off 50% of the time when you're baking
- Some of the outlets don't work
- You need to notify management every time you have guests over or else they can tow their car if they decide to (very inconvenient) 
- If your unit is near the dog park, some owners do not clean up after their pet so you will smell it (it also often smells like urine at that area)
- If your unit is near the gym, you will hear noises/banging as people tend to drop weights 
- There are some hidden fees on top of your payment (like a $6 management fee, seems petty)
- There is also a separate trash fee for the building (even though you are paying Glendale city for trash service)
- Security will patrol the building at night and tell you to leave common areas even if you aren't making any noise
- Can't break lease term early for any reason (good luck if you switch jobs or buy property and need to leave early), they require 60 day notice and will charge you a 2 month penalty for breaking the lease early. Management is a nightmare to deal with if you need to leave early for any reason. Read the lease terms/contract carefully and don't agree to their ridiculous rules. Most places require a 30 day notice only and don't charge you ridiculous 2 months penalty (they only keep your security deposit).

I would not lease here again given what they charge and what you get. Sure it's a nice building, but there are some serious cons.

It is close to Everything - Mall, Shopping Centers, Restaurants. On site attentive and friendly staff!!!

I have lived in The Shores for over one year and have decided not to renew my lease.  I am a single father with 2 children and I have decided the two towers next to the beach is not a safe place to live.  Please consider the following facts before visiting The Shores as a new place of residence.  
There is no security at this location.  
The pool is beautiful but it is a public pool .  Since there is no security, often times the homeless people from Oceanview Park jump in the pool to bathe and get cleaned up.  They also use the restrooms that are open 24 hours as well.  The homeless and other public people walk directly on the property in a number of ways..  
Strong smell of cigarettes from people smoking on their balconies (many of the residents are elderly because of rent control) and a strong smell of weed too.
The park next door is filled with homeless people and most are mentally ill.  You can hear them screaming at each other all night long and all the bottles rattling against each other as they collect these bottles for recycling.  This happens all night long.    
The optics of this place from a 30,000 view will look impressive.  The real down to earth view will actually scare you and make you think about your safety.  Folks, there are just too many other places to choose from.  Trust me, don't choose to live here.

Poor security, homeless and local neighbors use the amenities for their own enjoyment, including the spa to take baths in. Elevators in the South Tower rarely work, and the wait times are 3-4 minutes at times, as usually only one is working. Overpriced for what you get, only reason it gets 1 star is the location is great, but all other facets of the property need vast improvement by the owners, Douglass Emmett.

I just moved into Tribeca Urban, and I’m loving it! The building is super clean and feels really safe, which is important to me. What’s even better is the location—I’m right in the middle of everything!

It’s so nice being able to walk to work, stop by my favorite shops, and stroll down to the Marina. I’ve been walking a ton since I moved in because there are so many great restaurants and places to check out nearby. If you’re looking for a fun and convenient spot to live, definitely give Tribeca Urban a look!

Watch out when you rent a place here. While this is a nice building, there are many issues with communication, including:

- late replies to requests, service and support. You will need to ask twice or three times to get a response

- when we moved in, we were told that holes in walls smaller than a dime would not be a problem, and now that we are moving out, they asked for writing proof, not honoring their verbal commitment

- we moved in and had contracted 3 parking spots, we will move out in a few weeks and we never had the third spot, one of our vehicles had to be parked in visitor parking for 1 year — and one of our vehicles that was parked on our assigned spot got a tow notice (even though it was registered and parked correctly on the assigned spot)

- bikes are regularly stolen

- many more issues to mention here, most importantly, when we were considering renting a place here, we were told we could not see our place until we moved in (we got access to a demo apartment) — and now that we are moving out, we got calls asking if they (management/leasing) could show our place, which we agreed to once. The leasing office continued to ask if they could show our place, which we declined to, as it is an inconvenience because of COVID and because we are working from home — the leasing office threatened us saying that if we did not comply, they would serve us a 24 hour notice and walk in to show the place.

Do not recommend — there are many new buildings at a reasonable/competitive price where you may get more for what you pay.
floors here are paper thin, you hear every footstep above you. truly poor construction.

Nice looking property, but overall one of the worst places I have lived in 25 years of renting in LA. The staff is very rude and mostly unhelpful, I had several packages that showed as signed for by the reception go missing. Maintenance service is extremely unreliable, often waiting days to get stuff fixed only to have many things end up more broken than before. I once had someone from maintenance fix a gas stove with duck tape. The property is well landscape but cleanliness of the common interior areas is very poor. Most windows are so dirty you can’t see out of them anymore, floors are rarely cleaned, often full of dog hair. Garage spots are given to local business so lots of people coming and going with access to the building. The few guest parking spots are often full usually with the same cars that never move dispute the lease stating guess access is limited to 48 hours. The floors are also very thin so if you are not on the top floor you will hear everything.

I hate to give this place a low rating but the problems are really starting to stack up.  The actual apartments are great and the location in the Marina is perfect. But over the last year and a half, a lot has gone downhill. There have been numerous instances of theft and vandalism to the apartments, cars, and bikes. All of the surrounding apartments have consistent security... this building does not. Sometimes they show up, sometimes they don't. Many residents, myself included, have had numerous discussions with the apartment managers about adding security cameras, and security on site and no action is taken. These conversations have spanned over the last year.

They've cut back on cleaning the carpets in the hallways and it often takes days for trash to be removed from the lobbies. The pool chairs are falling apart and there are no umbrellas...meaning no shade by the pool. Responses to that from management have ranged from "It's been too windy to put up the umbrellas" to "The umbrellas are still in storage." These conversations have also spanned over the last year.

I hope these comments spark change. The apartments themselves are lovely but life at Harborside is on a downward path.

This property used to be great - not perfect, apartments never are, but it was a nice place to live. And yes, management companies are usually a pain in the neck but AMC Management, which took over 1+ years ago, is uniquely bad. All their other properties are mid to lower tier and they are clearly not used to managing luxury apartments at this price point. 

Just one example of this degradation is the landscaping which they've allowed to die. When they did have a landscaping company come out it was only to replant the area outside the leasing office. This is typical. They present a good face to prospective tenants and then ignore us. Complaints about tenants smoking on their balcony have been ignored. The maintenance staff tries to do a good job but they (he - there is only one) is overworked so that even plumbing emergencies take 2-3 days to be fixed.  

Finally, don't be fooled by the good reviews. Many of them are clearly fake and sound more like brochure copy than the experiences of real tenants. 

There are a lot of choices for renters in MDR - almost all offer more amenities than Harborside and are probably better managed. Go there.

Ever since the new management company (and new owners) took over in late 2019, things have gone south. There's a reason they had to do a town hall at the request of the many angry tenants, but the result was nothing but empty promises. I've lived here for more than 4 years and was happy, but will move out now.

The apartments at Avalon are newly renovated and really nice inside. I have a 1st floor unit, which has laminate floors throughout the entire kitchen and living room - an awesome feature. The community pool, gym, and rooftop lounge are well maintained and rarely crowded. Management and maintenance staff have always been friendly and quick to respond to any issues, and thankfully we haven't experienced any problems other than some basic wear and tear issues. The rent is not cheap (and our rent just went up with our lease renewal), but it's comparable to other similar communities in the Marina area. I'll definitely stick around as long as I can afford it!

I live at the Avalon apartments in Marina del Rey and I love it. I share my paradise with two doggies  and my hard working hubby. these apartment's have the biggest balconies in MdR and the neighbors  are all do freindly. The apartments are modern and cozy with lots of extras. in apt. washer driers, pool,hot tube,workout room, marina stroll,food truck Thursday and month community event. Tonight is Taco Tuesday free food and beer for all. What's not to love?
our one bedroom has a huge walk in closet and super nice hard wood floors and carpet. The bedrooms boast a fantastic office nook with a marina view to die for.

The entire courtyard smells like marijuana ! How do I know I'm glad you asked I use to live here during the HORRIFIC REMODELING for these new " luxurious" over priced new units. the locked building is always unlocked and unkept.Very very noisy as it is still under construction with the disrespectful workers who will play music LOUDLY on a daily basis. People smoke in their units even though this is a non smoking building ! I also hope you enjoy roaches as they run through the walls and are in most units ( didn't have an issue before remodel) I was 16 days late on rent and evicted due to them wanting to remodel my unit and charge more.This review is true ! I am still upset however this place is a mess nothing is maintained inner plumbing is mickey moused and purely pretty for aesthetics the floors are uneven and the regular laundry facility is FILTHY ! THE MANAGEMENT company is sneaky and makes up rules as they go good luck though I genuinely hope you have a different experience than I did .

THIS PROPERTY IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION WITH NO COMPLETION DATE SET. 

When trying to get a response from resident services how much longer the construction above our apartment will go on for, we were told "construction never has a set end date", I get that, sure, delays happen, but they couldn't even give us the most general ETA. Instead they yelled at us. 

Please, please, please don't live here. There are so many better places for the money. I'm only staying because i've been here for several years, but if your looking to move here now, DON'T!

Everything you need is at Mariners Village... 24hr spa/fitness, cafe, library, clubhouse lounge, 4 heated pools, very lush environment, directly on the channel so near the water too. Closest walking distance to the beach in the marina... the maintenance staff is very responsive, quick to handle things, and kind, too, along with the other staff. Management is very committed to helping residents when needed and ensures an enjoyable living space for everyone. 24/7 courtesy patrol on site, too. I can't recommend this place enough. It's truly magical and our family LOVES living here. (I have 2 kids, btw... so grateful they get to grow up here... also a lot of other long term residents which in itself says A LOT!)

Take it from a current resident...This place is terrible! There are amenities but don't let it fool you. I am counting down the days my lease is over. The cops are called here every other week. My neighbors have been arrested several times.  Music is heard throughout the night along with dogs barking. I have complained several times to the management, nothing has been done. I sleep at my girlfriend's apartment more than I do here. The rent is so expensive you're better off living somewhere else for the same price with more room and better appliances. There is no A/C. The walls; including the ceilings are paper thin. Unless you live on the 3rd floor, you do not go to sleep until the people above you do. This is not including the hallways which have doors that slam throughout the night. I wish someone had told me before I moved here all this, please save yourself. Live somewhere else

Leasing personnel are very nice and professional.  They will upgrade you at every turn.  There is no air conditioning here and even though the property is by the beach units have no cross ventilation.  It is HOT and STUFFY inside the apartments and the hallways.  Beware - the property is NOT SECURE or clean.  There are security people riding around in carts that do nothing.  There is a lot of CRIME and THEFT.  Public areas are not frequently cleaned including hallways, elevators, walkways etc. Residents have loud parties until all hours of the morning and there is no one to stop that. Besides that the vintage 1960's property is charming and the location is nice.

It’s a beautiful place to live, but be prepared to have your car and bike stolen and Mariner’s Village do nothing about it. Be prepared to have maintenance wake you up at 7am trimming trees. Be prepared to pay $40 to do laundry just to have dog poop in the washers.

Absolute disappointment.
First their phone number routes to a call center. So when I spoke to someone they told me they had one unit that matched the features and price I sought. But when I made an appointment and drove across town to go see this unit, their on site leasing agent not only was completely unaware of any such unit, she also quoted a higher price, with different features. Then, she was totally unaware of their virtual tour of the unit I sought after and even tried to tell me they didn’t have any units with plank (as they call it) flooring. However after insisting they do, because I’ve seen it, she then told me as if she just learned it, that there is one layout with plank flooring. But it’s $500 more than the price I was quoted and again a totally different unit.

She was the rude and unapologetic regarding her own supposed ignorance of the property she worked at, and seemed unmoved regarding the misinformation, and my wasted time.

I immediately lost all interest in even giving them a chance after this. I have never in 11 years of living in LA and touring many many complexes, ever dealt with such an experience.

Truly a shame since I had pretty much made up my mind sight unseen that I was going to lease a unit that day from Mariners Village

I went through: Bed bugs, roaches, noise from neighbors, noise outside, regular downed elevators, slow hot water, dark dingey garage, crime, homeless getting in, laundry room issues. All for premium prices!

There are MANY cockroaches. There is no air conditioning. Laundry is downstairs and it's a mess while everyone is collecting each other's clothes. Security is never in place. No water flows from the shower head. And pacific plaza managers never return messages sent. All the machines in the laundry are broken and eating your money. When we tell this to the managers, they say it's none of our business and kick them out of their rooms. Never rent a apartment here. It's a waste of your money!!

The location is great! Building is a bit old, but the trade off is that it's way cheaper than other building in Santa Monica. The issue is with the rental office staff. The manager Cheryl is confrontational with an unfriendly attitude. Matthew is a pretty cold unfriendly guy as well. As soon as he gets your signature on a lease forget about any warmth after that. Courtney is also extremely rude. I hope management replaces all of them SOON!
And yes, I too will change my review to 4-5 stars once they change office staff!
