There isn't a direct stairwell to the garage, causing traffic issues with the elevators (only 2). Though the staff is fantastic and extremely helpful on many issues, the location itself has a tendency to attract a lot of party people (not necessarily a bad thing) and can be quite rowdy on the weekends. Not to mention that the pleasant beachfront view and accessibility leads to inclement weather on occasion(at least for California). I'd say, for the amount of money they request, you could find a much better location nearby.

Sahar was pleasant when we first went in to arrange a viewing.
After she took our deposit she was very eager to rent the apartment to us. We took the place and wishing 2 weeks we were treated like 3rd rate citizens.
Not only did we have issues with brown water coming out of the faucets, but the noise from the neighbors upstairs.
This building is filled with noisy college kids despite what the leasing office might say.
We had to complain about the loss noise/parties till 3am and they did nothing ....
Filthy hallways with animal feces
Non working laundry
Snotty valet

I regret this decision.
They also stole our packages

I noticed the review 2 years ago, says the same thing I’m about to say. I have only been residing here for 10 months and I have already had several incidents with management regarding the pest infestation. They insist on me doing a fumigation in my unit but they are not only in my unit. I have seen them in the hallways and other people’s balconies, therefore I refuse fumigation because it the building not me. Not to mention I have an infant child. Management  has a really bad attitude for the building to be nasty,doesn’t mix well.

The apartment complex is nice and the apartments are decent but the landlord does not keep keys  on site which is a huge inconvenience if you're locked out of the apartment and the washers sometimes work and sometimes don't and the parking spaces are too small and there are sometimes problems with the air conditioning and the landlord has an attitude

This is my first apartment and I'm fairly comfortable there. Only reason it's a four star is because airport is down the street so I constantly get woken up by them. Besides that I'm pretty content with the place

I don’t recommend this place at all . The worst experience i ever had ,currently dealing with a serious issue and cant wait to move out.  If you really care about your peace , your sleep and your health do not move here . 
tennents above me jump and have crazy fits all the time even during midnight , they move their stuff almost all day .
I complained to the office several times  but NOTHING changes .This situation is not acceptable at all! We can’t sleep at all .
Do not rent here and stay away from this location. you can hear almost everything from the apartment above . Management here do not care about you and your peace and your rights .they ignore the concerns literally.

Rules and fees are constantly changing here. The security system is annoying. Every couple months the fire alarm system goes off in the middle of the night. It’s so expensive just to be constantly inconvenienced.
Boulvard. Is an excellent  place to live in. Staff are friendly and professional.

I loooove this place! Living my best life here! During my application, Ella was helping me, and wow, she went above and beyond to help me achieve my dream! Very professional and caring person! From the bottom of my heart - thank you, Ella! Also, I would love to mention Sara and Jess - responsive and kind people! Security - there are always two security guys at each entrance. They are always awake and patrolling, not like in the previous community our security was sleeping in the car every night. Hallways - never ever smelled any waste of animals and it's a big thing! It always a problem in the big communities, but not here :) Parking - after I got used to going up and down in the loop - I like it, so far didn't see any illegal activity (which was always a problem in the previous community). And there is always guest parking available! Oh, and my apartment - it's just amazing, literally luxurious! Floor, cabinets, countertops, faucets, all appliances - like in the 5-star expensive hotel! I truly love this place and hopefully will stay here for long :)

We wanted to review and express our gratitude for the Leasing Office team. It was a process but it was worth the wait. We wanted to lock in a price point and were hoping to get the keys ASAP. We understood that this timeline put pressure on the move in date. However, the Leasing team accepted the challenge gracefully and worked super diligently with us to make things happen. We were blessed to have worked with both Sara and Ella as both were very attentive, super knowledgeable about the property, extremely organized, and they communicated every update/action item to us. They were such a great team to work with. Thank you Sara and Ella!!

Another thing to we noticed was on our tour was ALL the residents greeted Sara. It was clear she had a good rapport with each resident we passed. That was a good sign for me. It was a great indication that this Leasing Office team does their due diligence to help and they have great relationships with their residents. We look forward to living here and eating at these food trucks!
Great place to live with terrific amenities and very friendly and helpful staff. We just moved in and absolutely love it here!

My application experience with Jefferson at Marina was incredibly disheartening. Despite submitting all required documents and meeting their criteria, my application was unexpectedly denied. The lack of clarity or reason provided for the denial was frustrating and left me feeling unfairly treated. This experience has unfortunately tarnished my perception of Jefferson at Marina's leasing process. I would caution others to approach their application process with caution and seek clearer communication before making any commitments.

I moved into the complex and without any heads up prior to me signing in the next month they closed down the pool and gym for the entirety of my year lease.  They say you can go to the neighboor buildings gym/pool but that is almost a mile away and you have to walk on Lincoln past a bunch of homeless to get to it (not at all what I signed for when I was thinking pool/gym in my complex) and that gym is 75 degrees with no drinking water.

During this time they also have been building a small dog park for over 6 months outside my window so that included construction noise (sawing brick and metal) that entire time).  This is all on top of constant fire alarms, homeless people breaking in, homeless people actually breaking in to live and SHOOT/MURDER each other and just trash bags everywhere.

… now they are raising rent….. simply put - LOOK ELSEWHERE!

This place is terrible save yourself the trouble and rent anywhere but here. This was the worse property I have ever stayed at. They will try every way to squeeze money out of you. Even if it is wrongfully charging you with a late payment so they can get the extra $100 late fee and then sending a note to your door a day later that you must pay the $100 or they will evict you. Then to top it off if you break your lease and someone is moving in your place so they actually don't lose any rent they will file a claim against you saying they loss rent which is untrue. Worse property they do not care about the people living there just want your money.

1) This place has a lot of nice photos on their website, but the rates you pay are not worth it. The pool and gym are nice, but super outdated. The gym's equipment is old/broken and they don't have full sets of weights
2) The rent is astronomical for the value. The units have no natural light. You can get much better value elsewhere. There is a lack of security and the garage gates break all of the time. I've seen countless number of homeless people in the garage. Also there was a shooting on the top floor of the building. Apparently a resident was renting out their unit on Airbnb. The people staying in it setup some kind of meet on the top floor of the garage, it went poorly and we hear gun shots. The property never explained what happened. To this day we still DO NOT HAVE CAMERAS INSTALLED ANYWHERE ON PROPERTY. For what they charge for rent you think they would install cameras in a 6 story garage.
 I've even have had people come off the street, to my door to solicit a "charity" fund. It's not safe at all. Also, if you are not on the top floor you will hear everything your neighbors are doing. This isn't just me, I actually heard an argument from our neighbors across the courtyard screaming at their upstairs neighbor because of how loud they were.
3) rent/utilities: You are charged $40 a month for parking (a lot of residence actually skip this and park in other spots because jefferson doesn't actually tow). I know this because there was a person who continually parked in our spot and the building never did anything about it. Your water and trash fees are about 40 dollars a month. Trash is expensive and the trash rooms are disgusting (I will say that the staff does a great job at cleaning it up) but it gets backed up and the cockroaches come out
Renewal: again this is UDR, so they will jump your rent after 1 year. They are also sly about it because they tell you 15 days before you need to make a decision ( I know if you reading this and thinking, why didn't you read your lease, you are right). But make sure you do! UDR tells you your rent increases and if you don't accept this great "offer" you need to tell them 60 days before your move out (CA law is 30 days). Otherwise they increase about 10%. We were trying to get ahold of our personal renewal specialist who ghosted us on a call and then didn't get back to us  until a few days right before our renewal deadline.

this apartment building is nice we just have a big problem with outside locals stealing bikes and bike parts from the bike racks, rent control needs to be set in place for marina del rey our rent now is 2,400 if we go month to month it jumps to $8,000 now that's not cool.

For my family… this was the perfect place for us to move.  With 3 kids and 2 dogs, the space is perfect and the amenities ( in the building suit our needs.  Many weekends you will find us Barbecuing at the pool if we are no surfing down at the beach.  We are within walking distance of the beach, Marina, many shops,and Abbot Kinney. We are also close to the 90 freeway which is great doe the commute.  I feel super safe in the building as well and the staff is incredibly helpful! We all love living here and plan to renew our lease!

This is a great place to live.  The location is great.  Close to many resturants in Woodland Hills, and entertainments.  The property is always clean and quiet.  The staff is friendly and nice.  The maintenance team is super!  No complaints thus far, expect for rent that is increasingly becoming quite high.

Charming design, high ceilings and angled walls are like my single-family home.  Courtyards with BBQs, pool, gym, and fireplace for friends to gather have made my transition from homeowner to apartment dweller a positive experience.  My apartment home has a private sanctuary vibe that’s as great as is the staff.

I love my apartment! What do I love about it? First off the front office the people who run this property are fabulous they actually care about  me and my community.  Next the maintenance crew is also fabulous and they care about me and my community and most important the building and grounds.  Now the grounds the design of this complex is modern with a great sense of style and fend shui.  No my apartment it does not feel like an apartment I have a corner unit which overlooks a fountain and a beautiful green ginkgo and rock zen garden. Soaring palm trees  reach above the courtyard to the open sky and often a full moon that beams in through my window. My apartment is cozy and modern and not boxlike has an open kitchen and a beautiful  unobstructed  view out my sliding glass door to the courtyard.  My bedroom is spacious with plenty of  Storage and a walk-in closet.  With secure parking a gym and a fab pool I am content often to not leave the premises.  I feel safe and secure and at home.  These are fabulous modern times.

Get ready for leaks, broken appliances, water leaks, gas leaks, incompetent contractors that break what they're trying to fix - even in my FRESHLY RENNOVATED unit nearly everything broke the first time I used it and I just came home to find the gas leak from my fireplace that was due to - according to the emergency repairman - parts so old they aren't made anymore was just "fixed" by the landlord and I'm SMELLING GAS AGAIN.

This was after MONTHS of construction in the unit next door that made it impossible to work from home due to the noise. For what I'm paying for this place I expect the washer to NOT break when I use it the first time, the sink to NOT leak under the drainpipe, the bath to NOT leak into the ceiling of the appartment downstairs, the balcony to NOT have random construction tape warning me I can't go out my own front door. It's absurd and irresponsible>

The units look nice but are non-functional. Oh, and it's VERY LOUD on the weekends thanks to street performers with amplifiers. The location is nice enough that I'd deal with the noise, I live alone so I can put headphones on without being terribly disrupted, but on top of everything else? STAY AWAY.

Besides the only other 1-star review, the other reviews here are all fake –– I know this because I talk with all of the neighbors. This apartment has easily been one of the worst living experiences of my life. Let me explain: 

1.) Management sucks. They're unresponsive, lack empathy and are unhelpful. They will be nice to you to get you to sign the lease but once you do, they'll have no further regard for you.
2.) The public parking garage/alleyway behind the apartment is a hotspot for loitering past midnight. Unless you're in a front unit, expect to lose sleep 4-5 nights a week. This is amplified by the fact that the apartment only has single pane windows that don't insulate any sound.
3.) The homeless problem is out of control. Every single neighbor in this apartment has a story of getting assaulted or harassed by the homeless. If you enjoy walking around your neighborhood in the mornings, expect this to happen on a regular basis. I would recommend carrying pepper spray when leaving the house.

I wish I could leave zero stars!!!
DO NOT EVEN CONSIDER THIS PLACE! YOU WILL REGRET IT!!!!
I have been a resident of this place for almost a year & it is the absolute worst apartment building I've ever lived in (I've lived in many). The management is terrible, unresponsive, rude, and not qualified at all. They do not care about their residents, their apartments, safety of the building or tenants, or any issues that we have. I have came to them about over 10 issues in my unit and the building & they have not attempted to fix them or even act like they care. From the sinks to the patio doors to the lighting to the a/c to the electricity to problems with other tenants, you name it & it hasn't been taken care of.
THEY SIMPLY DO NOT CARE ABOUT ANYTHING BUT MONEY. DO NOT DO THIS TO YOURSELF!!!!

If you are reading this review then you must be thinking about moving to the "Residence on Third Street Promenade".  This place checks on the boxes for an excellent place to live.

The staff is amazing.  Always helpful and positive. This is the entire staff from maintenance (Alonso and Luis are great at their job and great people as well), house keeping, security, and of course the Property Manager, Paula!

The location is perfect, you can walk to the beach, roller skate / bike on the beach for miles and miles, shopping, the movies. If you want it do anything, this place puts you right in the heart of it.

If you wonder about safety, they have you covered. It is top notch and I guarantee you and your family will love the systems they have in place. 

There are also features that may seam simple but it makes your everyday living here top notch.  The trash chute is very convenient.  I know that seams silly but most places you have to walk several floors and often into a sticky area.  The common areas with Wi-Fi allow you to use your laptop or phone, the grill, the fire pits, the seating area, oh by the way this is all on top of the building over looking the ocean and the city.  

Ok, your probably wondering about the inside of the apartments. It is just as incredible as everything you have read so far. We had a two bedroom with a spiral stair case.  Everyday we would spend the evening on the porch watching the sunset and sailboats on the ocean. This company has set up everything in this apartment to ensure you have the best experience ever.  Top grade appliances, cabinets are beautiful, soft closing doors and drawers, you can not hear the dishwasher running it is so good.  The bathrooms have a shower that is second to none. The fireplace is a nice touch when you have a cool evening.

If you want be close to the ocean, be surrounded by nice people, and enjoy living in Santa Monica then this is the place for you.

I'm new to LA but have lived and worked here for a few months now, and every day I still can't believe how great this location is. There's so much to see and do, with plenty of great restaurants and shops practically right downstairs.

The Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Pier are only a couple of blocks away. You can get some exercise under the sun at Muscle Beach, then take a jog on the famous Strand path toward Venice or the other way toward Pacific Palisades.

We have a car, but just about everything we need is within a few blocks, so I find I only need to drive a handful of times a month. It's a good thing the Residences provides excellent parking!

The apartment itself is gorgeous. Everything is updated, and the place feels really solid with thick concrete floors and superior soundproofing. I absolutely love the "Skydeck," which is the outermost rooftop common area for residents. You can see it on the website. It's beautifully designed to take advantage of the fantastic view, with lots of comfortable places to sit and relax. The community grill is awesome.

Lastly, the staff here is outstanding. If anything ever needs attention, or we just have a question about something, all we ever have to do is ask. Everyone is so friendly. I would definitely recommend living here to anyone who wants to live close to the beach in the heart of Santa Monica.

I've lived here for almost a year and will not be leaving anytime soon. When I moved to Santa Monica, I toured most of the complexes downtown but none of them checked the boxes of what I was looking for. Once I toured the complex here I immediately knew that this was the place for me! The apartments are conveniently located in downtown Santa Monica right on the promenade, with spectacular views of the mountains and the ocean. Short walk to shops, restaurants, bars, parks and most importantly, the beach! It is a small community and every neighbor has been so friendly and helpful. Paula and her team are phenomenal and take care of any issues in a timely manner.

I loved living here! All my neighbors were friendly, in fact, the whole building is like a small community. The building is very safe and well kept. The location is amazing for getting to the beach every day. The balcony and barbecue provides iconic views. If you have a chance at living here, take it!

I have lived here for over four years. I love it! It's convenient to everything and the staff are incredible. Very safe. Faub access to all point of entry and cameras everywhere. Parking under the building too. The is a great big terrace for residents with barbecue pit and sitting areas. one block from the beach and of course I'm living on the 3rd Street Promenade so the stores are all right there. The pandemic has been tough on everyone but I would rather be here than anywhere else in town.

You seriously cannot beat this location. It's literally on the 3rd Street Promenade. I've lived here almost a year now and can confidently say this place is head and shoulders above all other apartment complexes/buildings I've lived in. So many options we haven't even explored after 9 months since there is so much to do in the area. I don't even drive on the weekends any more because everything you need is within walking distance. Fine dining? You got it. Casual drinks/dining? Tons of options. Fast food? A few. Food trucks are right around the corner if you want to grab something quick and picnic at Palisades Park or on the beach. The only utilities we pay is electric and TV/internet, all else is included in rent. Always feel super secure since the resident parking is in it's own area separate from the rest of the garage (the building also has offices on some floors) and you also need your fox when using the elevator. In the short time we've lived here there have been a number of improvements/construction elevator lobby, exterior, etc.) the building has done which I think is nicer now. Parking is included also which was not that common when I was looking at other places in the area. Neighbors are all pretty cool too. Bottom line: you won't regret living here

I’ve never been so pleased to have found a rental property like this. Weeding through reviews of different apartments nearby and visiting a lot of them, I’ve truly felt like I found the best place to rent. From the management, staff, location, and just overall vibe of this place, I don’t know what else I’m missing. I was a bit skeptical at first since it is on the higher end of my budget, but I’ve gotten full monies worth even in the short time I’ve been here. Being able to walk for all of your essentials, and shopping on 3rd street is the dream. I want to personally thank Paula (the manager) for making out application process, move in, and just our time here so seemless. She’s always saying don’t hesitate to ask her any questions, and almost feels more than just your “landlord,” but someone who is truly looking out for your best interests. Sucha rarity nowadays to find someone like that. Eric the security guard is also incredibly helpful, kind, and just fun to talk with in passing. Alonso is a great maintenance person who quickly fixed the few repairs we had moving in (the apartment we’re in was staged for the last year so no one lived in it, which I found suprising since pretty much everything was working perfectly. AND on top of all of that we have arguably the best views in Santa Monica looking down on third steet and checking the surf. It’s nice to be out on our porch listening to the live music being played on third steeet, or to close up the doors and windows and have a pretty quiet and relaxing apartment. All the appliances are very impressive from the google nest to the microwave, dishwasher are some of the nicest ones I’ve used. I could go on and on, but this really is an amazing find and am so thankful to be here! Thank you Paula, and the rest of the staff for making this place truly feel like our new home!

We can’t believe we found this hidden gem! 

My wife and I live in a one-bedroom unit, and the size is perfect for us. It’s not giant, but we don’t feel cramped. We have a good-sized patio that almost creates another room, which is great for when we’re both on work calls. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances, clean white counter tops, and a giant farmhouse sink. The central air (Nest) and in-unit laundry also win extra points for us.

As far as the location goes, it’s seriously amazing being so close to the beach.  It’s definitely a touristy area so it gets pretty packed over the weekends, but to me that’s not an issue. We’ll usually take our dog for a walk along the beach path in the evenings, and it never feels too crowded. I’ve lived in walkable cities all my adult life, so when I moved to LA, I missed being able to just walk everywhere. Living on the Promenade definitely gives you that city-feel, popping outside to grab a burrito or a coffee without having to get in your car. It’s mostly quiet inside the building, so it’s a win-win for city-living. 

The building staff is awesome. The property manager, Paula, is so nice and is always working on something or another to make this place even better than it is. We appreciate that. Alonso and Luis take care of so much around the building and have helped us out countless times - they’re great!  It’s really nice to have such a supportive staff around the clock.

My husband and I have lived here for a little over a year and we love it! The units were recently remodeled and have a modern aesthetic with a sleek kitchen, dark hardwood floors, and a lovely fireplace. Our unit also has an amazing patio that we (and our pup) love!! Our unit is closer to the alley, so we occasionally hear sirens and car alarms going off, but that’s just part of living in a city. The building is really secure with multiple places you have to use your fob to access. There’s secure garage parking with some extra storage space down there, too, which has been so helpful for us! Also, the community rooftop patio is stunning - we love sitting out there to catch the sunset over the water and neighbors will grill over the weekends, etc. The other residents we’ve met are so warm and respectful, and even our dog has made some new furry friends around the building. Paula is the building manager and she is so incredibly helpful and kind. It makes a huge difference to have a someone on the property full-time who is both easy to talk to and solution oriented.
Overall, great place to live!

After living here for just under a month I wonder if I'll ever find a place as nice and comfortable as this again. The apartment itself is extremely spacious and natural light is constant throughout the day! I've gotten in the habit of taking my work breaks on one of the two patios to listen to the music and watch all the funny interactions happening on third street. The moving process couldn't have been any easier too. Paula was super responsive to all our questions and made sure our move in went seamlessly. Since then she has been sweet enough to check up on us and offer any advice on how to get the best out of Santa Monica. Also shoutout to Eric! He is super kind and welcoming and has gone out of his way to help us with packages and parking. This residence is truly special and a great pick for anyone with a young heart looking to live up the Cali Lifestyle!

This complex is the place to live if you want to experience the Los Angeles lifestyle. The complex is clean, quiet, and safe, which are the main components I look for when finding a place. The location is incomparable; when you step outside, you’re immersed in the culture of the famous 3rd street promenade where you find numerous places to eat, drink, and shop. The units are soooo nice and updated with new appliances and GORGEOUS views of the ocean, the city, and in between. I would highly recommend giving this place a look if you love the beach, sun, and fun. 
First off, the apartment manager Paula is amazing and incredibly helpful.

I lived on the 6th floor of Promenade Gateway for a year (2019/2020). It's one of the best locations in Santa Monica, but it's high enough off the street/Promenade that you don't hear any noise. You can walk to groceries or the Pier, and jog/bike along the beach each day. 

Great management team and great security.

I've lived here for several years and let a lot of things slide because I understand situations happen that are out of peoples hands. However, I am now done with this place and wouldn't recommend it to anyone. First of all, on several occasions the building fire alarm has gone off in the middle of the night for no reason. As in we all had to exit the building in the middle of the night several times because of a fire alarm malfunction. if you have kids or pets this is a nightmare. My most recent issue was with a neighbor who leaves trash everywhere and has basically ruined the side of my car by denting it with her door. When bringing this to management attention I was forced to move my parking spot, took my car off site, and have to pay for the repairs.  95% of the tenants here are good people but the 5% of the bad tenants make this place an absolute disaster. I let it slide over the years but I am done. don't live here, you are going to have issues with a neighbor who doesn't care about the building or their neighbors property. Think twice before moving in.

I love my apartment. I have a 3rd floor apartment with a loft. The apartment feels spacious and bright. The apartment is centrally located right near the 134. 101, and 170 freeways. It is also very close to cute shops and restaurants in Toluca Lake and North Hollywood. I think you will like living here. The only downside is that the apartments are a bit pricy but I guess you get what you pay for.

We recently moved into one of their lofts and we really like it. The apartments are nicely renovated with top of the line appliances which makes a big difference. There is quite a lot of noise from the highway on our side of the building, but it's fine with the doors closed. The patio on the roof is nice and air conditioning is a lifesaver in the valley. 

I will say the application process was one of the most complicated I've ever had to do though. Checking references, sending tax returns, recent pay stubs, bank statements on top of credit checks, but the staff are very friendly.

This building runs like a well oiled machine for the most part, with maintenance requests being handled very quickly and building maintenance handled in a professional manner overall. Leasing office personnel are professional and courteous and very helpful. This is a good place to live.

The apartment staff at Warner Pointe is among the best when it comes to all aspects of renting. Mark has been an incredible help from the moment I contacted Warner Pointe about leasing and was a large reason why I decided to call Warner Pointe home.

I have lived here for 16 years and have seen all manner of issues. A new management company took over in late 2023, and they have been much more responsive than the old company. Great on-site management and maintenance personnel, and a more frequent security patrol presence on the street around the building have both been welcome changes. With the old company, a maintenance request might languish for a week or more before being addressed, and the parent company was completely unresponsive to any communication from residents. The new company is much more responsive and on top of things. I worry less about maintenance/repairs - I know they will be taken care of. Competent folks who care about their jobs are running things at Warner Pointe.
Hello! I didn’t like the place beause of cockroaches
The manager Fransheila is HORRIBLE! She’s very combative, dishonest and unprofessional. The halls are ALWAYS dirty, the power and the water shut off with no warning for days.

The apartment is old with most of the property details not working properly.
- The gym has half of the things broken with most of the weights missing
- The jacuzzi doesn't work
- Maintenance takes ages to reply

Ended up having to pay an extra month while apartment was empty.  We signed a 10 month Lease Agreement with specific move in and out days. It wasn't clear we were still required to give a 30 day termination notice.  We didn't find this out until the day we were moving out. 
Also this place is always dirty, it's very noisy with dogs barking and smells like weed all the time.  A/C is not central so it gets very hot in the warmer months.  Not to mention it's pricey.
I do not recommend

For starters, if you want your packages to always get stolen, live here. If you wanna see mysterious pools of blood throughout the stairs of the lobby, live here. If you want 10 cop cars and cops in your lobby looking for someone and you don't know what's going on, live here. If you want to be woken up at 3am cause of a crackhead neighbor screaming at the top of her lungs and no one doing anything about it (including police), live here. If you wanna live here cause of CSUN I wish you all the best...

Do yourself a favor and don't live here, I'm currently in the process of suing the apartment complex in small claims court for inhabitability because of loud noise caused by one of the hallway doors next to my apartment. After requesting  for this to be fixed over 10!!! Times over the past 6 months they told me to wear earplugs in my own apartment to ignore the noise when they should just fix the door. After the 10th time I told them they also told me that the door won't be replaced because it's to expensive so I'm currently suing them. Every night I can't sleep because the door slams to loudly every time someone walks in and it's going to take literally suing them in order to get them to fix the door, because that's where we're at now. Also their maintenance stuff is up bright and early at 9 am to scream at one another in front of my unit and wake me up after being unable to sleep in the unit due to their hallway door that slams. Also when i first moved in my shower was producing brown water with sand in it  and it took them a nice two months to fix it :) also the AC breaker will just randomly shut off every 2 weeks and I have to call maintenance for them to fix it, move somewhere else!!

I've lived at Waves for years & definitely don't plan to move anytime soon...if ever! The community itself is GORGEOUS, the location & views of the marina are AMAZING & the staff is an absolute DREAM to work with (especially Eli & Anita)! Can't recommend this place enough!

My experience with Samoa at Porter Ranch was a complete disappointment. Despite being promised a three-day application process, I was left scrambling when the individual assigned to my application was unexpectedly unavailable for two days. This shortened my timeline significantly, and when I raised concerns, the staff's attitude suddenly soured. To make matters worse, they rejected some of my initially submitted documents, asking for alternatives, despite those documents being on their initial list. All this frustration came after I had already made a payment. The lack of transparency, poor communication, and unprofessional behavior make it clear: steer clear of Samoa at Porter Ranch.

Management is good. Maintenance is all right and reasonably prompt.

Pretty sure that the units were designed for seniors. Light switches are placed low as if to accommodate people In wheel chairs, toilet tall for people with mobility problems, etc. A little weird and takes some getting used to. 

Walls are thin… Can hear your neighbor's TV when there's no ambient noise in your own unit. Besides that, the community is very peaceful.

Each unit has its own garage (some with direct access to the unit), however they are TINY. My SUV does not fit and there is not really any room to store anything inside when there’s an average sized car in there. Other parking available for a small monthly fee. Visitor parking something of an issue as well. Very few spots available and they are ALWAYS taken.

Overall, the place is great... clean, quiet and reasonably priced for what you get.

Ever been to a private Resort, that you felt had It all? Amazing empathetic and sincere leasing Agents and Managers, exceptional hospitality on any given day, caring neighbors who would give their last just to ensure you had what you needed to make it through a day, beautiful landscape, useful, clean and well maintained amenities, breathtaking views of the city, a top notch soaring school district, a community that is surrounded by great people and the most efficient and sincere maintenance team ever who has always been friendly, efficient and amazing at repairing, altering or accommodating any concern you may ever have on the property! I may not have the financial support to ever revisit a private Resort again, but why should I.... I live on one every single day!! Thanks Sonoma Apartment Homes for all that you do not only for me and my daughter, but for everyone who lives on this amazing private Resort of APARTMENT living! Who knew......

I'll start out with the only two negatives: the complex is in Porter Ranch (far from the city) and is very expensive compared to other rental communities a few miles away. 

Everything else is good. The management company changed recently and they not only do a good job, they make a real effort to keep out or get rid of problem tenants. The grounds are unfailingly maintained and are always clean. The pool is beautiful. There is no trash anywhere. 

And.. they allow pets (any size).

Not many know of this fairly new complex for seniors. It's lovely & close to a great shopping center in Porter Ranch. Gated community. The apts are beautifully done - kitchen is great.  Large bathroom & washer & dryer provided in units. Love it here.

Worst Apartment and bad leasing management. It's been a month I have moved here and with in 15days of move in  Bulgari has happened. The only  security cameras which are at the entrance/exit gates are not even working properly. By the time we took the lease for 6months the leasing management have stated they will be waveing off our one month rent as a part of  our movein special. 
But now when we questioned them about the bulgary ,they instead of being shameful about it  they  removed  our benefits asking us to pay the rent for whole 6months.  Their negligence and irresponsible towards not repairing the gate allowed the theft to enter/exit the community easily. We are in a huge loss now. It is so bad the way they are behaving towards the customers.I dont recommend this community it is very high risk to stay here.

The most awful place I've ever lived at. Please do not even consider living here for your own sake. Paid $24,000 of rent in a year just to be left with extremely poor communication by the staff, bugs, mold, broken appliances, broken elevators, and broken washers/dryers that were all left that way for weeks at a time. The office staff is inexperienced and gives their residents different information that is unreliable. Even worse when you attempt to call the office with questions, you do not have the option of speaking with a representative, you are immediately sent to an automated voicemail and they DON'T return your calls if it's an inconvenience to their business. Absolutely terrible service. Save your money and time, run!!!

This is the worst apartment in Woodland Hills. I regret living here because of the unfriendly staff, rude neighbors, and horrible quality apartments. The apartments are too small and unclean and the rent is too high. The neighbors have no respect for others and don't clean up after their dogs. The people working at the leasing office are super rude. I don't recommend this place at all.

This is the worse place that I have ever lived. The leasing office kept my package for 4 months and each time I went there for my package, they denied of receiving it. Finally I get an email 4 months later to pick up my package. I showed her the date on the package & acknowledged her that I came here for my package several times and had to purchase it again & their mistake cost me over $400 then instead of apologizing, the manager tells me to leave if not they will call the security on me. 
I have recorded her voice and starts changing her behavior as soon as she finds out that I was recording her. Unfortunately she refuses to tell me her name and they’re alway rude to tenants specially this particular manager. 
I have been living in this complex for over 8 months and amenities are always broken and hasn’t been fixed since...

They really earned this bad review. I was tempted to leave it after the 2nd time they wasted my time but I didn't simply because I worked in customer service before and I generally have sympathy for people that have to deal with angry customers, but here's the deal:

I've been here 5 times already and have yet to see the unit that I was interested in. Twice I came without an appointment and they couldn't be bothered to show me the unit but, I didn't get mad since I didn't make an appointment. Then I made an appointment for 5:30pm and got there 5-10min late (with after work traffic its nearly impossible to get there in less than 40min), when I got there she told me that tour hours end at 5:30 and wouldn't budge. So I made another appointment with her for the next day at 12:30PM, skipped lunch to get there early this time and the same lady decides to disregard my appointment and help someone else. Her coworker told me that she's sorry and to come back another time. At this point I was pretty annoyed and had no interest in going back. Fast forward about 2-3 weeks, the lady that ignored my last two appointments called me, apologized and asked me to come in today (Monday) again at 5:30PM. I was clear and told her about my work/traffic situation and she told me that she could be flexible. Sooo again I drive there in rush hour traffic, get there 10min late (I was very aware of the time this time) and they give me an idiotic excuse about it being too late and too dark to show me the unit. How is it not too late at 5:30 but way too late at 5:40?

So all I got from this place was a bunch of wasted time and empty "I'm sorrys". Honestly, I have a feeling that they, for whatever reason, just don't want to rent out this unit. I just wish they wouldn't waste hours of my time and make me sit in traffic for nothing. At this point, I wouldn't live here out of principle. I'd rather pay more for rent and not have these kinds of people as landlords.

Advice to anyone considering this place, maybe your schedule is more flexible than mine is and you can play by their weird tour rules, but you're still going to have to deal with these people for as long as your lease is and that alone imho is reason enough to consider a different building.

When you move out even after more than 2 years of stay, they may charge you stating various damages. You will be in a helpless situation where you will have to end up paying or else the outstanding amount will go to collection agency. The amount can vary and come close to a month's rent. It is not worth paying a high amount as rent and then paying additional charge during move out. 

Mostly they will charge on your carpet , interior painting, cupboard painting etc. My Suggestion is to go for a cheaper apartment in the outskirts (like chatsworth, De soto) . You will get the same service and need only pay a lower amount as rent.

The reviews don't lie! I had scheduled a tour to view the building (despite the reviews because how could it be that bad?). I had a tour confirmed for Friday at 2 so I drove all the way from Brentwood to Marina Del Rey. Upon checking in, a leasing agent texts me saying there are no units available to tour.

Why schedule a tour in the first place? Save yourself the energy.

Do not live here. We have had multiple break ins, and packages stolen and mailboxes broken into. There is a 3 year construction project adjacent to the building so you hear loud beeping and vibrating apartments Monday-Saturday 7am-9pm (these times is what the city is allowed to do).  Legally there must be a on-site manager, which they do not have. The management is the worst I have ever dealt with, do not care about their tenants and just money hungry. The support center is in Denver so you can never speak with a person who will help you with any issue you have. DO NOT MOVE IN

I lived at Tierra Del Rey (building 1) for 8 years due to the convenience of the location and not wanting to spend time moving.

I finally decided to move out this month (May 2023) and I am so happy to be gone.

There have been major issues over the years including:

 * The bathroom/closet flooding (and not getting it fixed for weeks) that caused clothes damage and water mold damage even after maintenance left. This issue reoccurred multiple times, over the first few years, before UDR finally replaced the entire HVAC unit in the apartment to remedy the issue.
 
 * A kitchen ant infestation due to the major construction project next door

 * My bike stolen right in front of my door (the bike was pad locked). Management said they reviewed the security tapes, but did not see anything.

 * The entire bike storage broken into multiple times (the gate was completely removed)
 
 * Repeated stolen packages from the package room (it is a well-known problem in the community that many couriers leave the packages in the room and then homeless/other people break into the room and take them)

 * Constant "water shut off" issues for the entire building because of a new leak that would happen in one of the units (due to bad plumbing infrastructure). If you worked from home, you would often be without water for multiple hours at least 2-3 times a month.

Even with how bad the previous years were, the past year went downhill even more because of the following:

 * UDR removed on-site leasing personnel from Tierra Del Rey. This means that you have no one who you can immediately talk to if something goes wrong. Instead, you have to contact one of their other sister building on-site employees or their automated maintenance phone number and wait until they respond.

 * Vandalized mailboxes that caused the USPS to stop delivering mail to ALL units (you would have to go to the USPS Venice location 10-15 mins away to pick up your mail in person). This issue occurred the month before I moved out and UDR sent an email saying they hoped the mailboxes would be fixed in 6-8 weeks afterwards (so a minimum of 2.5 months without mail getting delivered likely longer).

* Homeless hanging around at the entrances of the building causing major security issues (this issue started to get worse once all on-site leasing personnel were removed from the property).

I came home from a vacation 7 weeks ago to my apartment sinks flooded and overflowing into the carpet.  It was absolutely disgusting and the smell of sewage was overwhelming.  I was able to get an emergency plumber to come and drain, but despite repeated requests to management they have done absolutely nothing to remedy this situation in what is now almost 2 months.  They did not bring in someone to clean and sanitize the sinks, and they still have not dealt with the carpet.  To make matters worse, I came home last week and found my door unlocked.  Maintenance had let a 3rd party into my apartment ILLEGALLY WITHOUT ANY NOTICE AND DID NOT LOCK MY DOOR WHEN THEY LEFT.  I feel extremely UNSAFE in this building and management has been completely dismissive to my requests to terminate my lease despite their gross negligence and the fact that they have allowed other neighbors to terminate their leases without penalty.  I have filed a complaint with the housing department as management seems to think it's okay for me to live with a moldy carpet for 7 weeks, enter my apartment without any notification or my permission, and to leave the door unlocked without caring that there is a lot of crime in the neighborhood and theft is rampant here.

I lived at Tierra for a single year, during which I noticed huge churn in the employees and staff, general incompetence and disorganization from management, and effective negligence to renter concerns.  Some of the things I dealt with: (a) many e-mails and phone calls, even for essential concerns like AC functionality, water problems, etc. to get fixed *numerous times*.  (b) pretty routine lateness, occasional missing of appointments, and general lack of knowledge from desk employees to handle issues regarding rent, maintenance and lease signing tasks (lots of "uhhh i don't know how to do this, can you come back next week when X person is here?" rinse and repeat nonsense), (c) loud noises from neighbors and management unwillingness to address concerns, (d) VERY frequent water shutoffs and issues.

I'm pretty sure all these problems could be addressed by hiring competent people in management and staffing the place, but Tierra has been consistently bad at this.  The only redeeming quality of this place is the location, and there are other, better complexes nearby which I believe are much better managed.

My car was stolen last night from the parking lot, where there is supposedly "Security"...

There is absolutely no security here. 

The homeless routinely get into the hall ways and run around causing havoc. 

Last night someone apparently got into the complex and proceeded to steal my car. I've lived throughout Los Angeles and I've never felt as unsafe as I do here. 

Management will tell you "crime happens everywhere" -- it just so happens it reoccurs here over and over again and they've done nothing to try and help.

If you would like to put your life and belongings in jeopardy, i'm sure management will give you a gift card to move in. 

There are many great places to live in Marina, but Tierra Del Rey is not one them.

Would not recommend.  The location is AMAZING but that is really the only good thing about this place. 
We lived there for 3 consecutive years, and after the first year and half, they changed out all of the staff and renovated the building. And they slam you with little extra fees.  Staff is seemingly impossible to reach and we didn't feel we could trust them.

We lived in an older apartment, not a remodeled one, which is fine, but it was priced the same as an updated one. 
For fees, we had an "optional" parking spot, which we could not choose to not have, and there was a $30 monthly fee for it.  
Community utility bills were outrageous and we were charged an average of $120 each month - and it always seemed to be increasing.  Also, for packages, they have package lockers which you have to create an account for, for a $20 annual fee, then a monthly $5 fee, and if you don't pick up within a particular time frame, you incur extra fees.  You could choose not to have this "service", but the office would not receive packages.  Also, many times the carriers would not even put your packages in the lockers - they would leave them in stacks by the mail boxes or at the apartment door.  We had a few go missing in our time there, and many of our neighbors had stolen parcels as well. 
Not to mention, they kept repainting the hallway floors, then would power wash them causing them to need to be re-painted. 

Fire alarm testing was OFTEN.  After we complained numerous times, they at least started to give us warning when they would test so we could make arrangements for our dog since the alarms stressed her immensely.  Additionally, we had a number of times (like 3 or 5) that the alarm would go off in the middle of the night - sometimes it was a fault in the system, sometimes it was a resident burning their food, one time a resident was smoking in the hall, and one time, someone tried to drive a U-Haul into the parking garage and busted the sprinkler that was on the ceiling and got the truck stuck.  SMH

In the end, the only care about the money and do not value you as a resident.  I highly suggest you take your money elsewhere.

There have been several issues since moving in, such as a near full month of loud construction with electric saws etc. around the clock, but the most recent event has left me no choice but to voice my concerns about the management at this facility. 

On Friday I noticed that one of my walls inside my walk in closet had been leaking, causing mold to grow. The floor was also soaked. I reported the incident within 24 hours. It was not until 4 days later, half a dozen emails, and personally walking up to the office, and then another email that someone finally showed up. Amara from the leasing office purposefully ignored the issue, as she was aware of the issue when I came to her, yet she didn’t feel it necessary to reply to my messages or tickets. She also lied about service walking to the apartment as we spoke, when really they didn’t show up for another 4 hours (after I finally warned approaching her boss about this). 

Maintenance Service is just straight up under qualified. For 4 days in a row they just made me run a loud obnoxious fan without fixing the actual leak. Aside the nuisance, electricity cost, this thing sprayed dirt and sand all over my clothes over night, even though the guys said it won’t cause any issues and can leave my clothes in the closet. 

It’s now been a full week since this issue started, and there is no finish line in sight. They hope it gets fixed soon. Soon? As in like 3 weeks from now? A competent management would have fixed the issue within 48 hours. 

I reached out to the manager Felice Brown to discuss the issue and potential compensation for damage caused and time wasted, but she too decided to ignore my email, so I’m left with no choice to make this heard in the hope that they wake up, and not just let a tenant’s apartment get flooded and ignore it.

I wish they had a zero star this place deserves a zero...
The good:
Great location
Friendly neighbors

Take it or leave it in competing may last lease here, wish I could get out early... April is not to far away... ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK!!!!!

I have been a tenant for 4 months. Always pay rent on time. Today we received an email from the leasing office reminding us not to be late or they would add a fee. Direct these to those who do not pay please. Rent is around 4k but there are numerous additional fees, the latest being a parcel fee because the on site team refuses to accept packages for tenants. I have had a list for 4 months of repair items some of which are cosmetic but some which are health and safety related. In four months they have done nothing. Great location but the lead manager is in the wrong business. Put your money elsewhere

This location is ideal if you want to live in a clean place with loads of amenities and quick access to food and entertainment. The building offers it's residents a pool, a gym, a whirlpool, few bbq spots, a large courtyard with plenty of clean lounge chairs, a business center, a gym, and a common area with seating and a kitchen so you can entertain guests. 

A great feature of this building is it's location: including a slew of eateries, it has 3 grocery stores in walking distance, 1 drug store, a bank, juice shops, pizza shop, 2 AMC theaters (yup 2)...all right across the street. 

If you're the kind of person who wants the option of coming home from work and relaxing in a pool and then walking across the street to get some amazing food...and maybe catch a movie (dine-in theater, by the way), then you'll be happy here.

Pro: Thick walls, washer/dryer, air condition, clean community, good maintenance and helpful management. Cons: Rent increases 10% per year. Lots of complexes are being built close by and traffic is getting bad.

Tierra del Rey is residential living embraced by the quiet confidence and classic elegance that define the neighborhood on the corner of Glencoe and Maxella Avenues in the heart of Marina Del Rey. It is distinctive and contemporary from the outside where you'll be surrounded by the finest restaurants, theaters and shopping all in walking distance in the glamour and energy of the Marina. Modern, warm and inviting on the inside you'll find a recreation area to swim and sunbathe, barbecue, workout in the gym and drift off to sleep knowing it's not just where to live but how to live. With gracious interiors this exceptional complex offers generous one-to three- bedrooms with each residence outfitted  with a washer and dryer, quality appliances, recessed lighting and granite countertops. Floor to ceiling wall of glass opens onto private terraces to create an inviting indoor/ outdoor environment. Some people might call it the vacation of a lifetime. You will call it home.
Excellent amenities, walking distance to many restaurants and shops, and a few minutes from the beach. A fantastic place to live for those who want everything right next to them.
Clean, light, lovely views, great workout room, excellent gym and lovely common area.
Very clean and maintned facilities. Staff is friendly approachable and very helpful!

The reconstruction process was not managed properly.  

The hallways were demolished while we were still living in our unit.  The elevators were either out of order or reserved for the construction work.  Exiting and life safety issues were ignored. The heat was shut off and the fireplace was closed off, so there was no heat while we were living in the unit. Plastic sheets were installed on the ceiling to prevent asbestos from falling on us while work was done on the roof.  

When we moved back into our unit, the areas surrounding the unit were not complete.  The deck/balcony was still under construction for several months, and the public areas adjacent to the unit were under construction for about a year after we moved back to our unit.  

The Dolphin Marina now looks good and appears to be well maintained, but the reconstruction process was a disaster.
We came here since the Palisades fire. We felt welcomed and felt home very quickly. We are truly enjoying our stay. We highly recommend this place!

What can I say? This place has everything! Did I mention the views? Mark and his team are phenomenal! They went above and beyond and showed me all this place has to offer! Best move in special in the area. Can’t bet it! This maybe the one!

Marina is definitely outside of where i would typically rent. Of course everyone wants to live on the water but we LA natives know what that cost looks like right? Nevertheless every year when it comes that time to move again I'll peek around and see what's out there and Ii totally got lucky this time. I scheduled a very short noticed tour and made the drive out there. I couldn't believe what i found. I found this community dolphin Marina. Couldn't believe it. Right on the water. Huge huge 100sqft 1 bed floorplans!! Most of LA 2 bedrooms are around that size these days. I took a look at a couple units weigh a great leasing team. Now being in property management myself i have a specific criteria that i look out for cause as we all know just as important as the building and location you also need to consider the management team and their practices. Throughout the tour there was this great chemistry with the onsite team but also amongst each other. Absolutely amazing. When we popped into some of the units i was amazed. I came to find out that they just renovated and not the half hearted attempt like most communities where they have changed a counter top then charge a premium. No there were brand new finished ge appliances. Absolutely beautiful. Super comfortable with the people who will be managing my home and for once i feel like I'm actually getting what I'll be paying for and more which who can remember when the last time any of us felt like that in LA. Super super excited to make the move in 60 days or soi just hope theirs still something left by then
As a resident I have had a few minor issues come up with the property but management has always been available and have handled my issues quickly. The property is getting better every day!

Loved the open space, community events, leasing agents went above & beyond service! 
Defiantly a place I would like my daughter to move in.

It’s a lovely location. Grounds well kept. Public spaces, hallways cleaned continuously. The BIG problem is management/office staff. If you get anyone to answer phone or even BE in office get ready to be insulted by attitude. They generally treat you as the problem. You are not welcome to discuss anything with them. I felt like a trespasser more than a tenant while living there. The communication they are really good at is more rules for YOU and to tell you they won’t be around for holidays, weekends. Nobody around. Even the management company is unresponsive. 
There is one washer/dryer for about 20 units assuming it works. At times no washer for 2-3 weeks. Water pressure made my shower useless. Maintenance team very knowledgeable but getting them is a coin flip based on office following through. The rehab plan is a secret. They won’t tell you anything about it but the rumor persisted that it will be torn down. It is one of the last complexes on the marina that hasn’t been turned into a congested dense modern mess. It’s a shame occupancy is high enough in MDR that they don’t have to treat you better. If it weren’t for the insecurity of not knowing if your “home” will be there in 5 months and you don’t mind the attitude, prefer baths and are handy around the house...it’s lovely.

While the location is amazing...this place is FULL of old, miserable people.  I say old (instead of sr citizens)because they're all so unhappy and have nothing to do but look for something to complain about.  Complaints about the most mundane and petty things are excessive and rampant here.  In addition, the apartment units are falling apart inside.  Getting maintenance to fix something takes forever and then if you do get something replaced, they use (literally)the cheap cheap cheapest quality available.  No Wifi in the very small gym or anywhere on the grounds.  Dated rec room.  The pool is center of the courtyard and surrounded by complainers.  No one even uses it as a result. You will not get your moneys worth here and you'll be disappointed with your neighbors.  Not worth it!!

We stayed here for a year (2016 - 2017) and have to say that it's not a good place at all. In the first few months the police were called four times because of a violent tenant, the elevator breaks every other week, as does the washing machine. However, management does nothing.

Smoking is allowed everywhere and the cigarette smoke drifts into your apartment, almost continuously. Oh, our dishwasher broke down and it took them 2 months to replace.

The place feels old and dirty (they're renovating from 2018, so be aware of that). 

And then there's the management. They're often extremely rude and always talk down to you. 

The only good thing about the place is the location and the pool. Everything else is simply awful.

Finally, beware of your deposit. They will try to take as much from it as possible.

This place is terrible.  Capri Apartments is miserable do not live here.  They will fix nothing.  They will Never follow up about fixing anything.  All the cameras are broken and stuff gets stolen weekly.  The office actually has stolen my belongings and denied it until I called the cops and they were forced to give it back and it happened to be in their storage closet.  Their phones go down weekly so you can't can't contact them.  The hallways are hotter than the Death Valley.  Our AC was broken for 3 of the hottest weeks of the summer in 2016 and it's still not fixed properly because it still doesn't work.  Our sink has been dripping since we lived here.  

I am seriously not making any of this up.  Everytime we go to the leasing office they act like we don't know what we are talking about.  Then they proceed to not follow up.  They once tried to call us once and apparently called the old Tennant from out apartment and they contacted us.  They found our number but our own building didn't have it!

The Dolphin Marina is a beautiful building right on the water.  The apartments are spacious and they take animals!  It is walking distance to many restaurants and the beach.  The staff is great and staff always willing to go the extra mile!

1000 sft that was amazing with a large patio but their price had gone up and they did have any one bedrooms available, it was an older complex but it is close to the beach. Only thing they were missing was a washer/dryer in the unit. But very nice overall.

Living at 6940 Sepulveda has been such a great experience. Not only was processing for the apartment a smooth transaction it has also been nothing but great living here. Everyone from staff to residents have been extremely nice.

It has been two months and no one has taken any of my concerns. Seriously my items were stolen the first week I was here. Management never followed up with me on reviewing the footage from where my car was parked. I am still waiting for a second parking spot that I have paid for although management and maintenance have four parking spots at further use each, no one is reachable or responsive, the 24 hour emergency maintenance number

Excellent location, pet-friendly, central AC and washer/dryer in each apartment.  Maintenance is responsive and quick to address repairs in each apartment.  Building is security conscious, although there is room for improvement.  Plenty of parking for residents but guests must use street parking.  Just a hop, skip and a jump away from Sherman Oaks!

I absolutely love the space and layout! The tenants I’ve seen in passing have all been friendly and welcoming. So far, I’ve got no complaints regarding this building whatsoever and it’s very well maintained and quiet.
Management team is 100 percent nice, caring and helpful with everything. Thank yoi

This place is far from "clean", and the service is not "quick". Simply take a look at the yellow tape that has been covering the cracked flooring tiles at the entrance of the building for months now. Great idea to divert foot traffic to the "better" side, so that can crumble too. 

Tenants allow their stupid dogs to urinate in the hallways, near elevators, and in the parking garage. 

One of the advertising banner poles in front of the building fell on a Dodge Charger's hood, and now it will just lay behind a bush forever.
Clean, quick service, easygoing, loving everything about the place

We lived here since 2017. The building was well kept and had wonderful management. Since GreyStar managing company took over, things have been gone downhill.

While the rent keeps going up, the building is getting dirtier by the minute.

There’s dog pee everywhere. Elevators don’t work every often, broken concrete steps that haven’t been fixed for months now. 

It’s no longer worth it, GreyStar doesn’t take care of this once wonderful building.
Great building. Kind staff. Very happy here as a resident.

Spacious apartments, well insulated so you rarely hear your neighbors.  Central air and heating works very well and you get your own washer and dryer in the unit!  Maintenance responds quickly which is appreciated.  Underground parking with random security checks at night is also appreciated.  Elevators seem to need maintenance often and smoke alarms are a little sensitive but overall I have had a very good experience living here.

Save yourself the trouble and skip this building. The building is cockroach infested! We had Orkin come out 4-5 times and the roaches did not go away. Management was not bothered by the infestation. Management will under no circumstances give you your deposit back no matter how great you leave the apartment.

This community is quite , well kept and peaceful community. The office staff was extremely accommodating and friendly also. It could not be better located and was amidst a lot of shopping, restaurants, transportation and schools. It offered great  amenities.
6940 Sepulveda is a well run apartment complex.  The facilities are clean and welcoming and the staff is efficient, effective, and friendly.  It's a great place to live!
The team at 6940 Sepulveda Blvd is customer focused and provides an exceptional service all around.  Great job!

My experience living at 6940 Sepulveda Apartments has been amazing thus far.  The office and maintenance staff are so friendly and attentive. When I have a maintenance issue, maintenance is on it immediately. In particular the office manager Tonika from day one has been and continues to be the most consistently professional,  kind,  considerate,  and respectful person I have ever met in apartment management. I for one am so grateful to have a manager who makes you feel like they care especially during the difficult times our country is going through. A smile and a kind word goes a long way.

Grey star is the best. Thank you for your help and fast move-in process. The apartments are worth living, there are windows with good noise reduction. Carpeted sleeping areas which help not to hear anybody at night from other apartments. Very spacious apartments which is a plus and a workout for muscles and legs :) thank you Grisel and Tonika for your help, we are more than happy to stay here. No roaches  I hope, this would be almost all the year round.

I live on IMT on the Boulevard. It is a wonderful apartment, it has a kitchen, living room,balcony 2 bathrooms 2 bedrooms.I will start looking at other apps trying to find an apartment then I saw this wonderful app "apartments.com" it shows me reasonable prices and a enough room for me to live in and start a family. I am a 20yr college student and "apartment. com app" helped me find "affordable apartment" that made me feel like home.

I am moving out after 4 years because the quality and service at Avalon 4121 has declined drastically. Management refuses to enforce community policies and tenants are disrespectful of their neighbors with regard to noise, smoke and trash. Even though this is supposed to be a non-smoking building, secondhand smoke travels through the vents from residents who smoke in their units. Problem tenants have also disabled the front gate lock and attracted crime to this building resulting in multiple break-ins and thefts. This is building is trashy and unsafe.

I've really loved the fact that I can be on a quiet street and about three small blocks away lies the epicenter of Studio City. Walking to the Farmers Market, Grocery Stores & Restaurants has really been special. I got to celebrate 4th of July with family & friends watching the best fireworks in the city outside on my balcony. Try to get an apartment that doesn't directly look into CBS Radford's parking garage..for privacy. Its small square footage for the price, but its sleek with a nice design & floor plan. The price has increased but if you have the money to afford it.. its a great place to live.

Overall living at Avalon has been a rewarding experience; having great neighbors and being a part of a community of people in a bustling city.   I have been able to look out my window at CBS Radford and see actors filming action scenes suspended off the building (who needs TV?). Also living close enough to walk to the grocery stores & restaurants saves me money in gas & in Uber!

When the time came to finally get the opportunity to move to LA, I knew there was only one challenge standing in my way, and that was finding the perfect place to live.  I must have searched and viewed over 25 different apartment complexes before finding Avalon Studio 4121. I had a list of items that were necessity and a list of things that would be deal breakers. It was such a relief to find a place that had a safe parking garage, secure doors and stairs, storage space, fully equipped appliances,  a workout facility, walk ability and a friendly office staff.  Of course you get what you pay for and the only downside is the high cost in rent.  I would be lying if I didn't bother me, but the cost of finding a great place is always worth it in the long run.

Been living here for almost 3 years and the place has gone down since Archstone took over. The location is the best thing it has going for it. Otherwise I would recommend looking elsewhere. Staff only cares about bringing in new residents, not the residents that live there.

I lived in this complex for five years and found the tenants great and the apartments modern and immaculately maintained.  The complex is centrally located, with supermarkets, gas stations, dry cleaners, Trader Joes and fast food easily accessible - within walking distance.  The grounds are well kept, there's an onsite manager to respond to issues and the complex boasts a gym, rec room and pool and spa area.  Moss and Company is an incredible management group and is evident while living in this great location.

Great apartment complex with beautiful pool and spa! there is a nice common area with a workout equipment, a billiard table and a bbq. The apartment itself is nice and comfortable. The Building manager is very professional. The surrounding area is beautiful and safe. Little old ladies are walking their dogs right outside the building in the middle of the night!

only complaints are the windows are thin so the energy bill is a little higher and it also lets in more sound from outside...Also each unit only comes with one parking spot so if you have 2  cars you have to street park. 

Overall Its a great place to live! I have now lived here comfortably with my wife for two years and have no plans of moving any time soon!

Esto está completamente infestado de cucarachas, no importa las veces que ellos te fumiguen, no sirve de nada, pues no hay día que no salgan de 10 a 15 cucarachas aproximadamente, y eso matándolas así como salen, por más limpio que se tenga, nunca dejan de salir. Las encuentras en pasillos, lavandería y por todos lados y de todos tamaños, NO tienen el control que te aseguran , no hacen inspecciones y la mayoría de apartamentos están echos un asco por lo mismo que no tienen un control, viven como quieren y hacen lo que quieren. No se dejen llevar por que el área por fuera es bonita, y nice, les prometo, no cumplen con lo que prometen y te la pintan muy bonito pero no será así :)

Roaches!!! If you haven’t lived with them this is your chance to experience the unknown. The list is long as to reasons why. Criminals who will steal your packages whenever you have a Amazon delivery Will send you into a spiraling depression. The police and fire department will become your newfound friends as someone spent months ringing the fire alarm here and multiple fires were set as I was living there. Domestic violence is a every day occurrence. Many washrooms but they are always broken. The roof will leak and the water or power will be cut off with no notice. Cars were vandalized and broken into. The security here is sleeping or never there. The management here are just sales people who after they close the deal will become your supervisor, Posting unlimited notices on your door on the daily basis to remind the community of the policies And code of conduct. I expected so much more. Don’t get your hopes up here. Keep your expectations low and you won’t get disappointed

Currently living here and it is terrible! Our floors and walls are leaking from the rain terribly. Please do yourself the favor and save yourself from this headache my partner and I are experiencing. Management sucks too. They are completely unorganized and don’t care.
Pests, constant trash issues, and regular elevator outages, and security issues make what should be a good living experience a stressful one.

I had a great time here during my stay! The management is great as well as the ladies in the office. They were on top of things! Issues that I had were resolved immediately. Thank you so much for the great experience guys!!

So I went to tour this property the other day, I am a first time renter; Giselle the assistant manager helped me out when u showed up with out an appointment. It looked like they were really busy, and even so she took care of answering all my questions about the property and about the whole rental application. She truly made the shopping experience easy! Unfortunate I didn’t rent there; but the service was so excellent I had to come comment and let y’all know to come here! Giselle is an awesome person who truly loves what she does and I felt as if she really cared for my interests.

I've been living at Talaria Burbank for four years now. Talaria is a poorly run apartment building and the worst I've ever experienced. The elevators break down almost every month. Mail and packages have been stolen so many times. Last year, one of the elevators wasn't working for over six months. Security is non-existent in this building. Garage doors are left open almost all day long with little to no security. The main entrance garage door has been broken for over six months. Thieves have easily broken into cars and I've seen wheels stolen off of new high end cars several times. You are on your own when you live here. Every man and woman for himself. I can't tell you how many times I've stepped on dog pee in the elevator. There is dog poop all over the sidewalks surrounding this building. When I contact the front desk they blow me off and it's not cleaned until the next day. The cleaning crew don't speak a word of English. The building rents out units to questionable characters who smoke weed all day and the smell is always in the elevators and the garage. Pricing and availability is questionable because I've seen my unit rent for 30% more than what I'm paying. They adjust their prices constantly and I don't believe they are being honest on availability of units. During the last four years, I've been dealing on and off with rolling vibrations throughout my unit and it takes them months and dozens of emails to investigate and problems are never resolved. Furthermore, a tenant deleted himself last year by taking a jump off the fifth floor but you didn't hear about that either. Management does not disclose theft or other significant issues that tenants should be aware of. We are left in the dark and have to fend for ourselves. Many problems are ignored and swept under the rug. Also, instead of fixing the elevators and garage doors in a timely manner, they wait for an insurance payout which takes months. I've lived in many apartment buildings over the years, this is one of the worst managed buildings I've seen and experienced.
Talaria is a beautiful building with fantastic units and great common amenities. The staff are incredibly helpful and friendly.

Our Family has moved many times giving us different rental experiences around the world. Talaria is by far the most fantastic place we have ever lived. The Talaria Team goes above and beyond to create a safe, peaceful, luxurious and fun atmosphere for the community.

Talaria is a stunning upscale apartment complex with a wide range of services.  The maintenance team keeps hallways and common areas immaculate. The courtyards are beautiful and welcoming.  Apartment repairs are done promptly.  Building management is extremely responsive to concerns, and the concierge service offers food delivery and household services.  Both front desk and back office staff are warm and professional.  The gym is particularly first rate, with an excellent trainer on-site.  The pool is lovely, as are the screening room and pub.  Just an excellent building.

Living at Talaria has been an exceptional experience! The management is top-notch, always attentive and responsive. The property is impeccably maintained, making it a comfortable and enjoyable place to call home. It's undoubtedly the best place to live!
It is very reassuring to stay here, the comprehensive service is great, the outside environment is very clean, the property service is very timely.Good job.

I’ve lived at AMLI for 2+ years on the first floor of building six.

Pros:
The location is convenient, the amenities are good, they do some fun events and I’ve found the management responsive.

Con:
The floors between units are VERY thin which makes it loud for even the lightest of people living above you. If you’re trying to sleep it’s infuriating, otherwise it’s just a nuisance.
