I’ve heard this same complaint from other residents not on the top floor and I’ve have had multiple different tenants live above me.

I decided to move out because the noise from the unit above me makes it impossible to sleep which outweighs all the positives of the complex.

After a little over a year here at AMLI, I want to share my experience solely for prospective tenants. The marina is one of the best places to live in Los Angeles.  If you're considering relocating here: do it. Your quality of life will increase drastically. However, think twice about this building.  It is not at all what it appears to be.

From the outside, the property is aesthetically stunning.  All the amenities appear refined, the location looks great in photos, & it’s super fun to have friends come over. The maintenance staff is also incredible (leasing office folks could definitely take a few pointers from them). That's truly where the list of pros ends.

Construction of the units is awful (you will see this talked about in many reviews - it is a real problem). We were fortunate to live on a top floor unit, which in theory would eliminate the noise that travels between floors.  However, we quickly realized we were living on top of folks with above average hearing, greatly bothered by music playing from computers and laptops.  So bothered, they scaled the building one night and banged on my window with a broom (yes, scaled to a 5th floor window from a 4th floor balcony). Besides the extreme level of panic this caused me, a female home alone late at night, the response from management to “wear AirPods” instead of playing things out loud was…disappointing, to say the least.

Additionally, there are MAJOR security issues in the building. We’ve had a bicycle taken apart in an attempt to remove it from a bike lock. I’ve been chased down my hallway by an intoxicated homeless person who was attempting to breach someones unit. Upon reporting this incident to management, their only response was, “Did you let this person in?” I’m sorry…what?

When choosing a place to live, especially at this price range, security and communication are bottom line requirements. When you live in a city like Los Angeles, things will happen. It is the unfortunate truth.  However, the complete disregard for the tenants of AMLI by management, beyond receiving rent payments, leaves you to fend for yourself in any type of uncomfortable situation.  It is nothing more than an overpriced dorm for influencers...the pool is a Vegas party every weekend, condoms in the bathrooms, emergency vehicles on site at least once a week.  If you’re looking for something more than that…look elsewhere.

Don't trust them. Seriously, this place is so disappointing. They recently just started taking away amenities. The clubhouse in our building, which we were told was ours to use and my husband and I really enjoyed hanging out in, was now just... taken away. You have to rent it for $700 a day. They just put a poster on the front door saying it's no longer for everyone's use. Such a cheap and crappy way to try to make money off the people who are ALREADY your renters.

While AMLI appears beautiful from the outside, once you move in, you will soon discover how poorly managed AMLI Marina del Rey is. AMLI stands for Apathetic Management Lives Inside.

Dealing with AMLI Marina del Rey Management is the most frustrating experience you will ever have living in a self-proclaimed "luxury building." 

AMLI Management refuses to enforce any of its own community rules to keep you safe and to guarantee the quiet enjoyment of your apartment, and that's if they even respond to you at all. It's no wonder Omicron is currently spreading through the AMLI community like lice through a college dorm. 

In conclusion, you will soon realize what a nightmare it is to live in a culture of non-compliance and a total lack of consideration for fellow neighbors that AMLI Management has cultivated with its unwillingness to lift even a finger to enforce its own rules.  

My advice is to STAY AWAY!
Not a great place to live. Management is negligent and complacent when it comes to noise, health, safety and security issues.
Beautiful place to live! I feel like Im on vacation  everyday!

Walls and ceilings are thin. Neither of my neighbors above my unit and next door were obnoxiously loud by any means but i could hear every single footstep from above, I could hear the toilet flush, conversations etc. The manager Angelia is extremely rude, talks down on residents. Washer and dryers on site leave a smell on your clothes.
Very positive, friendly interactions with leasing professional. The property is beautiful and well kept, in a prime location.
Customer service is outstanding and the place is very well-kept! Not happy about coffee shop coming. Wish the space had been designated for small exercise/fitness area instead.
Good people working in leasing especially Kate and Taylor. The maintenance guys Alex and Eddie are kind and great
The area is good and the service is pretty good
yes

Given the homeless problem and rising neighborhood crime, I became very concerned about living in a ground floor unit. The quality of the buildings you own and the staff that run your operations will bring me back when I need to return to Los Angeles for work again.

I lived here for a little more than two years. My car got broken into three times, and neither the building manager nor the landlord did anything to make the building safer. 

The first time it happened my garage door opener was stolen and things were moved around in my car. The landlord tried to tell me that it was my fault for not locking my car (it locks automatically after 2 minutes so even if I didn't, the car was not unlocked for long). She then proceeded to lie to me and say that she looked at the CCTV, which she didn't.

The second time it happened, she tried to pull that again but I got angry and told her to send me the footage. Finally she admitted that someone broke in. I called the property management company who did nothing but make excuses and refuse to even change the clicker to make it so that the thieves that stole the garage door opener couldn't continue to use it.

The third time it happened I put in my notice. Do not move here. The landlord is a liar, the property management company is negligent, and you won't be safe.

Booked an appointment to meet with the property manager that was confirmed. She emailed me the day before saying that she booked another meeting at the same time as the date we had already set to take a tour of the building. When I responded asking for a different time, she never responded again. 

Not a good start especially when you're trying to leave a building with horrible property managers.

Tenants smoke on their balcony/in their apartment, which comes up through the floorboards (the building is “non smoking”) and the manager does nothing about it no matter how many times you complain. Super thin flooring, you can hear everything. Person below me has their music blasting during “quiet hours”, apparently yelling or talking so loud I can hear every word. Manager takes forever to respond, and not helpful. Don’t move here.
I have called this property 4 times as well as the leasing manager multiple times to no avail. I don’t know how they plan on leasing the property without taking calls from potential renters

Building was recently sold and the new manager is not responsive at all and offers no help to residents when needed.  Since it is in Culver City it is not mandated to have an on site property manager.  Overall the building and units are great, when my leased was signed they were a great deal, but who knows what the new ownership group will try and charge.

Management is pretty much non-responsive to their online maintenance portal. They will change a ticket to completed when nothing's been done about the issue. There are bushes harboring thousands of spiders in the parking lot and front common areas. They should trim or cut those bushes down which are infested with spiders. Gross!

There's been a new management company "FPI Management" that recently took over this complex, and they are trash to say the least. They got rid of our onsite manager (who was great), it's actually literally impossible to get a hold of anyone in the office, our intercom system has not been working for months (which is constantly causing failed package deliveries) and they still have yet to even respond to my request about it. And the best part is that they've been trying to raise our rents on top of all this!

Also the walls are paper thin. Structural integrity is so weak that you can hear your _downstairs_ neighbors walking.

Only redeeming factor is that the residents here are friendly.

PROS:
- Great location near 405 and 10 freeways and Culver City/Venice/Marina Del Rey
- Huge walk-in closets
- Gated parking
- Gas and electricity included
- Neighbors are quiet and respectful
- 2 washers and 2 dryers on premises
- Apartment managers are pretty easy to deal with and most maintenance issues are taken care of promptly

CONS:
- Small kitchen (but I don't cook anyway!)
- No air conditioning
- No overhead lighting (so get lots of lamps)

Ashley is amazing! She responds to our inquiries and questions as soon as she can. Sure, there are other properties in prime locations as well, but many of them didn’t even bother to respond to our email inquiries. I wouldn’t trust a landlord who doesn’t want to be bothered with potential renters. That’s a bad sign of what’s to come once you become their resident. 

This property is clean and beautiful, but what really sets it apart from all the others is having Ashley as the property manager. Great job! I would highly recommend this property.

The most important thing I was looking for when I moved to LA was not location, not amenities (Spoiler: both are fantastic here), but more than anything else was the quality of management and the service. Ash and Daniel bring the family feel to this home with kindness, care, and impeccable attention to detail in keeping the SW clean, extremely well maintained, and filled with warmth!

The most important thing I was looking for when I moved to LA was not location, not amenities (Spoiler: both are fantastic here), but more than anything else was the quality of management and the service. Ash and Daniel bring the family feel to this home with kindness, care, and impeccable attention to detail in keeping the SW clean, extremely well maintained, and filled with warmth!

I knew this location was perfect for me, but I was even more pleasantly surprised by how well this property is maintained.  Ashley (property manager) is fabulous - so responsive and always ready to help out.  Daniel is very patient and through in resolving any maintenance issues and I appreciate the way that Juan keeps the property clean.

We began looking at this building before construction was finished and Ashley was extremely helpful and excellent in her communication about move-in timing, touring multiple times, etc. She was a true professional and really made the moving process as easy as possible. Thanks Ashley!

Ashley assisted in my having fallen in love with this building and was extremely easy and fun to work with throughout the process. She’s not only very transparent and honest, but also has the personality to go with it!! Highly recommend

There is either a problem with the sink being backed, lack of hot water ir water pressure, leaks from a subpar tile replacement, screen door has NEVER been fixed after 4 years.  These are continuous issues that arise every week.  Not to mention we had to pay for our own pest extermination which is caused me the sewage back up.

There is a fire alarm that's been going on for two days now and the building manager is nowhere to be found and never reachable by phone or email. Many people tried to reach her including the officers from the fire department.
Noisy, messy, dirty, and horrible parking. It's all you should know.

I had such a wonderful experience during my time living at Atelier apartments. The apartment complex is beautiful with modern and upscale amenities. The rooftop jacuzzi and sky deck lounge were my absolute favorite!! The resort style pool and the theater room were also very nice. The complex was always  clean, all of my Amazon packages were always stored safely, the front desk staff were always so welcoming and cheerful and the maintenance team responded quickly whenever I placed a service request. 

In regards to my unit, I loved the floor to ceiling windows, the spacious floor plan layout,  the gorgeous bathroom with a dual vanity and huge resort style bathtub, the large led mirrors, the spacious walk-in closet,  the upgraded appliances such as the large washer and dryer as well as the large refrigerator and I especially appreciated the thick walls that never let a peep in from any of my neighbors. I will truly miss living at Atelier and I’d definitely recommend atelier to anyone looking to live in DTLA

Con: There are many transients “homeless” right outside the complex however this is common in most DTLA areas. The security guards sometimes patrol at night if they are not asleep in their cars. At the very least, I would have appreciated if the security guard on duty sat on the couches at the entrance to the building so they could be near just in case something were to happen at night. Although a fob is needed to enter the front door after hours, there are occasions where people who do not live in the complex attempt to enter in right after a resident has opened the door.
Studios do not have parking spaces! We park across the street at Eight and Grand
One of the best buildings in downtown!
Atelier is a lovely bubble in a challenging area
Clean building with professional and respectful staff. Highly recommended.
This a great place to leave the staff is very friendly and helpful, the amenities are  5start I definitely recommend to leave here.

This apartment is very well-built. I've lived in several new apartments in LA, and I think this is the best one. It's very comfortable, quiet, and the environment is beautifully maintained. There are also great communal facilities. I highly recommend it to a friend.
Excellent staff, great units, very secure and beautiful rooftop lounge pool and hot tub areas

It's been great living here. The staff is friendly and the amenities are top-notch. I feel safe inside the building since there is 24/7 security. Parking is easy with a dedicated EV charger at my assigned spot. Gym is huge with plentiful equipment. Rooftop has a beautiful view towards Griffith Park and the Hollywood sign, with a pool and jacuzzi. Community Room and patio area is spacious, with a conference room that is great for meetings. I am happy living here.

The Louise 4900 is a new, amazing, beautiful and functional building right on the boarder of East Hollywood and Los Feliz. The staff is wonderful and the property is pristine with every amenity one could want. The property was designed very intelligently, with convenient exits, elevators and stairs in every direction. The view from the fully furnished rooftop is breathtaking and the active security make the complex feel safe. 

The location is great, right next to Barnsdall Art Park. Lots of dog owners in the area and everyone is very friendly. We love living here at the Louise.
So far I love living at the Louise! The leasing team and maintenance staff are super friendly and made move-in easy. The in-unit appliances and communal amenities are also really nice.

The Louise 4900 is a great community to live in. It’s within walking distance to a lot of places, bars, and is very convenient. I feel safe in the parking lot area and it is super clean. I love the gym and it was one of the reasons I moved in. The rooftop common area has a 4ft pool and a hot tub with amazing views.
Unfinished apartments with unprofessional sales team. Constant construction and noise. Stay away.

The good. It is a beautiful building and the units are gorgeous, well thought out with tech, layout and appliances. The common spaces are well done and the rooftop has a great view. Also, the leasing office staff is very friendly. Close to the shops and restaurants in Los Feliz. 

The bad. The fire alarm has been going off about once every two weeks since I moved in over 4 months ago. Nothing had fixed this. While the security guards are friendly they are often on their phones and the cameras you see everywhere are not connected. There have been a couple incidents in the building that they have not taken steps to prevent from happening again. While close to the shops and restaurants the immediate area is a little rough hence the issues above. The pool and jacuzzi have been closed for months without any explanation or estimate of when it will reopen. We have been offered to use the pool at the building across the street but nothing has been sent out on how to access it. The building also up charges wherever it can for things like using common spaces or parking. 

All in all I would like to resign the lease when mine is up but the issues with the alarm, security and amenities need to be resolved. In the meantime it is starting to feel like I am in a sleep deprivation study due to the fire alarms.

The Louise is a beautiful building in a great location in Los Feliz.  Staff is helpful and you absolutely cannot beat sitting in the rooftop pool looking over the view of the Griffith Observatory and the Hollywood sign, while still having a casual neighborhood feel in Los Feliz.  Great building and great team, would recommend.

We couldn't have had a better experience finding and moving into The Louise. From start to finish, Alicia has been a dream to work with and is a huge reason we chose this building as our new home. THANK YOU, we love it here!

Property is amazing and the location is great. Management responds to repair requests pretty quickly. Alicia made my cross country move super easy and painless. Always responded to emails quickly and and went above and beyond to show me the available apartments via video. On move in day Alicia was warm and welcoming and made sure she gave me a full tour before we signed anything. Thanks for the great experience Alicia!
Great community, with excellent amenities, a great management team, and wonderful maintenance personnel. So glad to have moved in!
This building is beautiful! Not looking to move in until September but I can’t wait!! Lucy and the staff are great.

Fell in love with this building and the staff… Lucy the manager of the building was very informative of the building/area. Such a beautiful building! Super friendly staff loved everything about it. Thanks Lucy

I cannot say enough good things about this building and the management. The building is super nice, well maintained, and has wonderful amenities! The staff is truly THE BEST! Always so nice and willing to help or answer any questions I have. A great place to call home! :)

The floor plan is open with beautiful views of the city and the hills. Lots of beautiful light with floor to ceiling windows and great size balcony. The bathrooms are large. The rooftop amenities are wonderful to sit under the stars or go for a swim. I love this property and all that it offers.
This building feels like home the minute you walk in.  The team greets you with a warm smile as you enter. My absolute favorite amenity is the Clubhouse.  Can’t wait to move in.

I've lived here for a year now and nothing usually works. When me and my husband first moved we didn't realize that they hid everything well. The Windows can't open unless you want it to break off. There was dried up gum that The previous renters and left and graffiti on The window's.  The washer and dryer are usually broken. The dryer has burned my clothes on multiple occasions and the washer doesn't always take out water. You don't get your money back for putting it in the machine when it breaks down. Me and my husband  have been waiting for a parking spot for months even when they said it will just be a month or two in reality it's been passed a year and a half. Another example, We complain that our shower is leaking and when they came "to fix it" the person said "it was okay"when clearly it was flooding my bathroom floor. Aswell, The manger and tenat have enter my apartment  without a notice before and not knocking to inform they were entering the premesis. Also, when trying to reach the manger he never answers unless he wants you to pay something.

Cockroaches, bed bugs, dangerous neighborhood with gangs. next to an abandoned lot overflowing with trash and unhoused people. elevator breaks down all the time and is old, slow, dirty and scary. water outages about once a month, impossible to find steet parking (I had to pay $200 a month to park in a trashy lot 2 blocks away), dirty neighbors, no a/c in my unit, power outages, random people hanging out in the hallways and stairs at night, no recycling available, rats scurrying around the building at all hours, people leaving their trash in the hallways. I could keep going but I think you get the hint. Please for the love of god find anywhere else to live.

I see that someone already wrote a review that expresses my exact feelings. I moved here because of the exposed brick, hardwood floors, and renovated kitchen. But everything that last reviewer had to say was correct and that was 4 months ago and no, no improvements have been made.

I regret moving in here every single day. The building is absolutely disgusting, inside and out, they mop the lobby floor maybe once a week and that’s it, and when I say they mop it they literally don’t even sweep it first they just smear a wet mop across the floor and that’s it, nothing else in the building EVER gets cleaned. There are cockroaches everywhere, you literally cannot get rid of the bugs. They have water shut downs almost every single week to do god knows what. When I moved in they told me they had a laundry room that they were fixing so it could be used and it’s been 9 months with no update. There is no parking with the building and there is absolutely no street parking available in this neighborhood, if you want to park on the street you’ll be driving around for 30 minutes before you find something and then you have to move your car before 7am. I would never ever ever recommend this apartment building to anyone.
Terrible water system, bug infestations all the time, clogged drains, and just recently, someone was shot and killed in broad daylight in the leasing office. STEER CLEAR FROM THE PRESIDENT'S APT!
Great management. Great apartment. Great layouts with the units. Great location.

apartmentName: The Hive On Ellendale USC Student Housing
review: Living at The Hive for my second year and so far everything has been pretty great. Maintenance comes when they are supposed to and construction is finally ending so I'm looking forward to having everything back to normal. The location is really close to Ralph's and I can walk to class pretty quickly. Biggest plus is it's QUIET! I don't ever hear my neighbors and it's a quiet street overall.

apartmentName: The Hive On Ellendale USC Student Housing
review: Moving is very expensive and I'm settled in already. It's been a comfortable experience so far and apart from the construction that is finally wrapping up, I don't really have any complaints.

apartmentName: The Hive On Ellendale USC Student Housing
review: I lived here three years ago and had a great experience. Management was communicative and friendly, I got along with my roommates and the place being pet friendly is a huge plus.

apartmentName: The Hive On Ellendale USC Student Housing
review:
Have lived here for almost a year and love my place because it is really spacious and has newly renovated and has nice furniture and stainless steel appliances. Love living just a block from campus on a safe street too and the community is gated and will be renewing.
The new Management has been great about communicating.
Great experience so far!

First of all, the apartment is great. Way more square footage for the dollar than in most of LA. We've got a couple terraces and tons of light with a view of the cathedral on Wilshire and the Hollywood Hills beyond. Secondly, the neighborhood is fantastic—walking distance to the Metro (15 min to DTLA), Ralphs, H-Mart, a quick bike ride to Erewhon—and it's K-Town, so tons of restaurants and bars in the 'hood. And finally, a little while ago we got a new management company and things are a lot more buttoned up than before that change, thanks in large part to our new manager, José, very professional, on top of things, super-responsive and just a very chill dude. It all adds up to 5 stars, and I don't grade on a curve.

So Bad management and landlord. It’s full of trash most of the time no one clean and take the trash. Also, they are not professional with dealing with tenant complaints. Highly recommended to stay a way from this apartment. You can expect any kind of trouble and noise and no one care. All what they care about collecting the rent.

This is literally the WORST apartment complex in Los Angeles. There are homeless people sleeping in the storage unit of the garage and the management refuses to do anything about it. Cars are stolen and broken into constantly. 2 cars were stolen on nye. The trash is absolutely overflowing everywhere in the parking garages and we’ve complained for over a month and they’ve done nothing about it. The fire alarm has been pulled every single day and night for the past 5 days straight and they refuse to do anything about it. In addition my kitchen sink has overflown and flooded our kitchen 4 times! Also packages get stolen ALL THE TIME! 

We cant sleep, we live in trash, our cars get broken into and stolen, our kitchens are flooded, and the management does absolutely NOTHING! NEVER EVER LIVE HERE!

This apartment building has amenities, but the cons outweigh the good. There are car thefts from the parking garage; as well break ins by smashing windows. The complex is always dirty with mounds of trash that pile up in common areas (incl. both floors of the parking garage and the mail room). The building manager rarely replies to e-mails, including in emergency. It took 3 days to fix the gate after someone had jammed it and broken in someone’s vehicle. There are people who do drugs behind the building all the time, so you’ll find people od’ing or used syringes. There has also been a couple fires behind the building as people light fires to mattresses/couches. Packages often get stolen from the mail room, as there is no lockers to store packages in. I wish I was being dramatic, but if I could save anyone from any of these incidents happening to them, I’ll feel better.

For months we’ve complained about our packages getting stolen and our storage was broken into. They’ve done nothing to remedy the situation besides blame us because couriers don’t deliver to your door. Today, our CAR was stolen from our parking space in the sparking structure. This is an unsafe place to live with high theft and even reported break ins to apartments.

The HW ICLG offers attractive amenities, but the day-to-day experience here is extremely frustrating due to ongoing issues with management and lack of building maintenance.

While the new property manager has been communicative, the prior manager was highly unresponsive, often taking over a week to reply. The maintenance supervisor has responded quickly and professionally to any minor repairs in our home. However, when we ask about larger property concerns, the feedback is that ownership is overseeing projects and repairs and no details are available. Again, the new manager has been a drastic improvement but up until recently, it was hard to get in touch with anyone at the office: The leasing office is frequently closed with the shades drawn, making it difficult to address concerns.

Cleanliness is a major issue, especially with all the construction. Common areas and the garage are constantly covered in dust and debris, and our cars in the garage are coated with dirt from construction activity. Despite management’s communication that construction workers would use a designated elevator during business hours, the elevator has been frequently left shut off or inaccessible outside of those hours—sometimes extending through weekends. The construction team has also been using the alternate elevator, making it difficult for residents to move through the building.

Trash collection is poorly managed, with clogged chutes and waste piling up. Additionally, there are safety hazards throughout the property that have been ignored by management, despite numerous complaints. We requested a meeting with the regional VP after a lack of on site response and were told that she doesn’t take calls and to put everything in writing. When we escalated urgent fire and life safety concerns to the regional VP, her response came days later, even though she had told us that emails with subjects noted as urgent received quicker responses. Neighbors have also reported leaks from the rooftop into their homes.

The boiler has failed multiple times, resulting in hot water outages, and the water shut-offs have become a regular inconvenience. These issues have persisted for months, and it’s clear from other reviews that poor communication and responsiveness from management are ongoing problems.

Living here has felt like being stuck in a construction zone for two months, with constant noise, false fire alarms, and restricted access to guest parking and amenities like the rooftop pool. Packa

While this building has some appealing features—it’s small, quiet, and charming, with nice finishes and amenities—unfortunately, the management is severely lacking.

When we moved in, we had multiple repair issues that had been overlooked during the inspection process. We had to request repairs that should have been addressed before move-in, which was frustrating.

The pool was unexpectedly shut down in late August with no notice, and the communication about its reopening has been almost non-existent. Recently, we discovered that the entire rooftop would be closed until late January, again with very little communication and no offer for rent concessions despite the major inconvenience.

To make matters worse, for the past three weeks, noise levels have been so disruptive that my partner hasn’t been able to work from home. Despite reaching out multiple times to management, specifically Karmine, we received no response. A new manager has taken over and has been more communicative, but the lack of responsiveness and accountability beforehand has left a bad impression.

The building has potential, but unless the management issues are addressed, I wouldn’t recommend it.

We have lived in this building for many years, and like any apartment complex it has never been perfect but over all in the past was a wonderful place to live. The last couple of years the maintenance of the building has gone way way down-it seems as if the CLG ownership group is more focused on building new apartment complexes elsewhere then maintaining their current properties. 
The rooftop was torn up/large platters emptied & ugly plywood nailed over the top of all of them in the first week of March 2024. They emailed the residents saying they were going to “beautify & update the roof.” It has now been over 6 months & still looks like a construction site with minimal updates from management & zero apologies for ruining the main amenity with no plan to fix it. 
The pool was drained mid-August without any warning & it has now been a month & a half with no pool in the peak of summer heat. 
One can tolerate constant water shut offs & constant random fire alarms going off however removing the main amenity of the building with no apology, plan, and next to zero updates & expecting all of the residents to just tolerate it in a “luxury building” is ludicrous.
The water is shut off almost weekly without notice. The fire alarms go off randomly for no reason. Building maintaince and staff is great.Great rooftop and amenities.

This complex looks beautiful with the Spanish architecture but don't let it lure you in. This place is poorly managed and has a series of issues. The water gets shut off without proper notice multiple times per month. The fire alarm randomly goes off in the middle of the night forcing you to evacuate for a non-emergency. They pass along every single building charge as an incremental charge, so there is an additional $200+ monthly for water and electricity for the building. It's a pet friendly building which is great except there are loose dogs running around at the pool and soil marks everywhere in the carpet.

This is not a luxury building, it only has a luxury price.

The Place is beautifully landscape decorated with exotic plants in a Sevilla, Spain type of Architecture. Located in West Hollywood. Close and walking distance to Sunset Strip. Where all restaurants and entertainment places are located.

Don't be fooled by the attraction of the zip code and living right off Sunset blvd.   It's actually a pretty sketchy area.   I've been living here for almost 2 years and have had to deal with crazy transients getting into the building & loitering, people on drugs walking down your streets all the time, don't bother walking around after 2 a.m.  I've heard from neighboring buildings that their managers are as just as bad as mine.  My advice, stay away from this block move a few more blocks west past Poinsettia.  It get's a little cleaner.

I had a viewing that I scheduled on apartments.com they sent me a email to confirm it, the day of the viewing I was literally like 5 mins away . Not even late very early . Appointment time was 11:30 it was 11:05 am and they sent me a email saying my viewing was cancelled. I stay all the way in San Pedro and I have to drive for nothing . So rude

My experience at Sherman Circle Apartments has been nothing short of disappointing. From the outset, the management at Sherman Circle Apartments has proven to be highly unprofessional and consistently rude in their dealings with tenants. It is evident that their priorities lie not with resident satisfaction, but with maximizing profit at any cost.

One of the most frustrating aspects of living here has been the persistent issues with maintenance. The elevators at Sherman Circle Apartments are in dire need of servicing; they frequently malfunction or operate erratically, posing a serious inconvenience to residents, especially those with mobility challenges. Additionally, several doors throughout the building either do not function properly or outright fail to unlock, compromising both security and accessibility.

To exacerbate matters further, tenants at Sherman Circle Apartments are burdened with hidden fees and inexplicable charges that seem to materialize out of thin air. The management has developed a knack for concocting reasons to email notifications of these charges, often without any prior explanation or transparency.

In conclusion, my time at Sherman Circle Apartments has been marred by a litany of issues stemming from the management's incompetence and disregard for tenant welfare. I would strongly caution anyone considering renting here to think twice, as the frustrations and disappointments far outweigh any potential benefits of residing in this establishment.

DO NOT LIVE HERE. Very unprofessional very rude management. Any issue you have VIANKA (management) does not help at all does not have any manners she speaks to you with a sarcastic tone. She tells you one thing and when you confront her she pulls up the contract and says I never that such a thing. Basically giving us different info that what's in the contact. She Gives me a hard time everytime I have some sort of problem. Contract was signed for a specific rent amount but so many random charges are added to rent it goes up and extra $200. Building looks new from outside but actual apartments are old ac/heater unit does not work my ice machine has mold I requested maintenance several times they still have not fixed the issue. My microwave randomly moves. When you turn the lights on in the house there is a noise. Lastly there was a cockroach outbreak in our side of the building I kept telling vianka and she would tell me there is no possibility I took pictures and showed her she still would not admit there is such a thing. Months passed and an exterminator came and told us there was a huge outbreak on our side of the building. Now it is not as bad as before but there still is cockroaches in the building. Moral of the story this building is trying to be a luxury complex but is completely failing to do so starting with VIANKAS unprofessionalism finishing up with the actual apartments. It's a scam so not live here.

Don’t get me wrong the building is nice and was pleasant when we moved in.. BUT since they switched management/ ownership it has gone downhill. There is a door that never unlocks for anyone in the building that hasn’t been fixed for months. Everywhere I turn it seems like something is constantly being broken and having to get fixed. Elevators constantly going out of order, the building has bugs, TRUST ME we have had it sprayed, pest control come in, doesn’t help it’s a problem with the building. To top all this off management will flat out lie to your face about problems you bring to their attention. They do not care about the residents all they want is to make a pretty penny off you. Do not move here.

The units may look nice but the customer service is terrible. I have not received my refund it’s been over a month. Get the run around. I’ve called and am told someone will call back. Still nothingZ I’ve sent emails. Nothing. They just took my money and have yet to tell me where my check is.

G12 is located in one of the calmest and cleanest places in DTLA. The building itself is very well kept and maintained, all the staff are great and helpful, the amenities are great, and the apartments themselves are modern and have a nice finish. Definitely would recommend!

G12 was the first apartment I moved into in 2019 when I just moved to LA. I lived here for about a year and a half, then moved to a new area to explore another part of the city. I moved back to G12 when that lease finished earlier this year because I truly missed living here and being downtown. G12 feels like home to me and I've always had great interactions with management and other residents. I am so happy to be a part of this community again!
Excellent living community. Staff is professional and the amenities are very useful.

Let me just start off by saying I dont normally do this, but I HAD to because of the overall amazing experience I have had here at G12 so far. From the leasing process as a prospective tenant to living here day to day- I can say all my needs/wants are met. I have no complaints whatsoever. The whole process was made easy, efficient, and welcoming by the amazing staff here. Every one is knowledgeable, helpful, and warm-hearted! As for the building, the units and amenities are modern and well taken care of.  Its perfect for any millennial and I would recommend it to anyone!

In the past I have had awful experiences with apartment complexes so I was hesitant to rent at G12. However I am SO glad I did. The apartment itself is so beautiful and has great amenities like the gym and movie room. Safety is a huge priority of mine and I always feel safe here with the 24hr security and front desk staff. Renting can be a nightmare, especially during the pandemic, but G12 has been so great that it's truly been a pleasure renting here.

G12 made the process and our move in transition very easy. Staff is great, and accommodating. They are easy to get a hold of, best part is you get to speak to people.
Thanks G12 team

When I moved to G12, my quality of life went up a notch. From the 24-hour gym to the swimming pool, I am very satisfied with this apartment, and the G12 team works very hard to satisfy the needs of residents.

G12 is a great apartment complex with a justifiable price due to how luxurious it feels. It has all the amenities you need and is very clean. It is in a nice part of Downtown which overall isn't the most safe or clean area in LA.
The apartment is great and the staff is very nice and helpful. Overall we had a great experience and highly recommend G12

My car got towed for no reason.  The parking pass had just fallen on the floor.  I pay monthly for parking and had to pay over $350 to get it back and was told Jamie had it towed.  When finding out more info, I was told cars at this building will get towed if parking pass is not visible.  I then requested to Jamie that building should at least call or contact the tenant before towing, the response from her had a very nasty tone, she said its tenants responsibility to make sure pass is visible.  No mercy here!!!  I also read other peoples reviews that mentioned fob problems.  I also had problems where my fob kept getting dis connected and I had to pay $50 each time to get it fixed, just doenst make sense that same fob keeps going out.  Perhaps they are racking up on the $50 fob replacements since the building doesnt have enough tenants to pay the bills.  I'm ready to move out of here!

I pay for parking at this building and my car got towed multiple times because my pass was not visible and it fell.  The manager Jamie didnt care one bit, it seems she goes on power trips and has a bad arrogance about her.  She has always been rude to me and others living in the building including my friends that visit.  Once I was given a key fob and it stopped working weeks later.  I was told by the front desk I will need to purchase a new one.  I thought it was not fair that I was given a bad key fob that barely worked for 2 weeks and now I had to purchase a new one.  On top of that there was an additional charge for the fob on my online account, when reaching out to Jamie she said I had to pay!  Im looking forward to getting out at end of my lease!

I have lived at different locations downtown and G12 is by far the worst experience i've had.  Mainly due to the incredibly rude staff.  Another review below said it correctly, this staff is very nice to you up front when they want a commission check, after your in expect no customer service.  Jamie, the property manager, in particular has been extremely rude to my guests when they are trying to get into property.  I registered names of guests to the leasing office and many times security denied them entrance.  Also, security will tell you that its ok for other guests to park in your designated spot, but then Jamie will immediately have the car towed.  She doesnt even contact for a warning, its an immediate tow!  And yes, there have been multiple burglaries in the parking garage.  Numerous times my fob stopped working because the staff themselves dis connected the fob then make you pay $50 for a fob.  This happened 4-5 times, a resident should not be continuously paying for fobs that are faulty or dis connected from the office!  Several other residents have the same complaints i've stated here.  Stay away from this property unless Jamie and other staff such as Ashley are no longer there!
I lived at G12 for 2year. Maintenance was really good. They repaired quickly! But the leasing office was not good.

I lived here for the past year and I wouldn't recommend it.  The walls and ceilings are thin.  You can hear loud footsteps from upstairs neighbors and you can hear your next door neighbors. Try to get a unit on the 7th floor, if possible.  Also there are a lot of college kids that live here, which isn't a deal breaker, but they are really messy.  They leave trash in the garage, in the elevator, in the halls, etc.  And lastly, THEFT.  There are a lot of break ins, even motorcycles have gotten stolen out of our garage which is only accessible by key fob.

There are plenty of great locations in DTLA. What makes G12 special is the fantastic staff. Everyday they strive to provide top quality service. Questions and concerns are addressed promptly and with a smile.

Definitely a beautiful and great place to live.  The staff is the best and makes this a community in addition to a very pleasant place to live.  Maintenance requests are responded to quickly--even on the weekend.  Farmer's Market behind the apt on Sundays and Taco trucks Tuesdays.  Pool is heated, clean gym, beautiful clubhouse and rooftop patios.  Walking distance to metro, Staples, LA Live and eating/bar establishments.

Was ready to move in, but the leasing consultant made a mistake in my application process. He admitted that it was his mistake and that I was the first to lease with a guarantor (co-signer). My credit is bad so I have someone to co-sign. BUT the consultant said since my credit is bad I cant live here..This doesn't make sense because THAT IS THE REASON WHY I HAVE SOMEONE TO CO-SIGN (who has a good credit). The leasing consultant and the manager are very irresponsible and inexperienced. There is a reason why the units aren't selling out fast here. I didn't even get an apology nor my application fee back. They made a mistake that led to myself not being able to move in. I was set; Literally had all my stuff packed because my lease date is ending very soon. Also, while I was writing my application my leasing consultant was in a different room chatting with his co-workers. I absolutely got no help. Irresponsible and inexperienced.

After moving out I got final accounting with a zero balance.  Weeks later I got a letter and phone calls from a debt collector.  The management had made an accounting error and instead of notifying me of their mistake they handled the situation by turning me over to collections.  No apology.  Beware also that leases are longer than 12 months and there are penalties for earlier termination.  Look elsewhere if you want fair treatment by management!
Moved out four months ago, but still no deposit return. Landlord avoids calls. Frustrating experience. Proceed with caution.

Kacey (leasing manager + concierge) and Angel (maintenance) are amazing and really go above and beyond to make sure all your needs are met. The units have modern appliances and central air controlled by a Nest. The building also has a crazy gym that is usually pretty empty so you aren’t having to wait on equipment to open up. There was a waitlist for parking which ended up being an additional $150/month, but I got off the waitlist within a week and Kacey has been working with the third party that manages the parking on lowering the cost (they had originally told me it was $175/month when I first moved in so it already dropped while I’ve been here).

Right before I moved in, my unit was deep cleaned, the carpets were replaced, and the walls were repainted. The common areas (which include free coffee and water which any guests I bring over have loved) seem to be cleaned every day and you need a key fob to get into the building, units, and any of the amenities. The building is very well insulated so you don’t get a lot of street noise and I rarely hear my neighbors next to me or above me- only if they drop something really heavy, and even with that, it’s a very soft thump. 

When you first move in, you’re given instructions on how to get a parcel locker so your deliveries are safe. Even though my packages have rarely actually ended up in the lockers (they usually end up in the center of the mail room or delivered directly to my door), I haven’t had any issue with anything being stolen yet. The residents here all seem to be good people. Lots of nice families and working people.

I’ve absolutely loved my apartment from first viewing. It’s clean and modern which was a big concern and requirement of mine. The new management is responsive, understanding, and accommodating! I am very happy with my choice to move in .

The former manager was not responsive, but Delise took over and got everything situated for me. She’s extremely kind, responsive, and ensured my move in was seamless/ I was set up with everything I needed. The new manager Casey has also been a pleasure since he started, taking care of our every request. I wish they were the two I worked with from the start, but I know I am now in good hands with them running the show. I love this building. It’s quiet, updated and has a beautiful rooftop. Very happy with my decision thus far.

I moved here about a month ago and love this apartment so far :) My apartment is spacious with all new appliances and was in great condition when I moved in! Staff is amazing and shoutout to Delise who helped answer all my questions! The process after my application was a bit rough because there was GM transition happening, but grateful for Delise who went above and beyond! She truly cares for the tenants and is a very bubbly fun individual!
I love this place that was my home for three years.  Jean, the manager is a doll.  Five Stars for this building.

I set up an appointment for a tour of the apartments and had everything scheduled for 10:30am Sunday. I even received a text reminder the night before from the property management. 
When I show up to complex for my appointment there was nobody there at all except for one other person who mentioned they had an appointment at 10 and no one has shown up. 
I called the property management and was told they would try to contact the tour guide and that I would receive a call back, waited about 30 minutes outside the complex, then left and never received a call back at all.
Seems unprofessional

I was born in LA and have lived all over this great city. Moved to The BW 5 months ago and I must say I've got very little to complain about. Everyone is friendly and helpful from leasing managers to concierge, 24-7 valet personnel, and the building handyman. I use the gym every single day and the rooftop jacuzzi weekly. Both the lobby and rooftop wifi work like a charm and the room service experience from the restaurant below is tough to beat. These amenities and excellent service do come with a price for one of the newest, cleanest and nicest buildings in Brentwood.

Living at Olive has been a great experience. 3 years going strong and won’t be moving anytime soon. Staff has always been friendly and warm hearted towards me and my dog.  I have lived in about five different DTLA apartment buildings since I moved to California from New York about 12 years ago. Olive is my absolute favorite! I’m a social person who has met multiple people in the building. Everyone seems to be pretty chill and easy going which was important to me. I chose Olive based on the open layout, spacious closet,  and friendly staff.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS. It is not “luxury.” All luxury buildings should have security at the front desk at night especially in DTLA where it’s a heavily homeless populated area. This building is under new management and they have taken away 24-hour security allowing anyone to just walk in the building at night.

Packages are left at your door in an open area which is NOT safe. Many packages have been stolen since they stopped allowing the front desk to take them.

Utilities: I have been overcharged for 6 months for utilities. I have complained multiple times and they haven’t done anything to resolve the issue. There’s no way a 400sqft apartment with no tv is using $169 worth of utilities. My guess is they are overcharging residents to make up for the people who have moved out or haven’t paid rent. I have documented everything via email just in case I need to file a lawsuit if they are still not cooperating.

Front desk: Front Desk is sweet and kind. They are the ONLY good thing about this property.

Management: Non-existent and never here. Like what are you getting paid for?

Avoid the headache and don’t rent here. It’s HELL.

CURRENT RESIDENT!!!

DO NOT MOVE IN HERE !

There are 2 garage doors to resident parking, out of the 12 months I lived here more than 6 months both doors have been broke, I could live in my apartment for the first month because the neighbor flooded, I was literally locked in the building 1 day because they decided to change just my code and no one else's, the nearest elevator to my apartment was down for over a month, instead of fixing it they put a note "elevator down". I came home late one night, and was locked out, no one answering phones, took an hour for someone to finally wonder to the front to help me. Your cars are not safe, there are a lot of issues with the structure, and they will charge you PREMIUM downtown prices, and they tried raising the rent on us all, with all these problems, about 40% of the building has moved out in the past month.

I hope this helps someone from make a bad decision, because I know forsure management won't see this. They need a reality check. It's sad because I love my apartment layout.

Bye bye

I've loved my time here at OLIVE DTLA, the amenities are amazing and the building is always clean. The maintenance staff is responsive and the front desk is always friendly. You can sometimes hear your upstairs neighbors walking around but that's to be expected with hard flooring. There was recently a change in ownership but that's not caused any changes and the new staff is just as wonderful as the previous staff.

I regret ever signing a lease at this apartment. The quality of the materials used in the units is absolutely terrible—cheap flooring that scratches if you so much as look at it, appliances that barely function, and plumbing issues that never seem to get fixed properly. Everything feels like it was thrown together as quickly and cheaply as possible.

But the worst part? The incompetent management. They constantly lose track of important information, like parking and billing records. Because of their disorganization, I’ve been forced to pay hundreds of dollars in extra fees that were entirely their mistake. They don’t take responsibility for anything, and good luck getting them to fix an issue—they’ll just give you the runaround for weeks. The property manager is especially rude with a flippant attitude who blames everything on the tenant. 

If you value your time, money, and sanity, do NOT live here. Dealing with such careless, unprofessional management is not worth it.

This is the worst apartment, worst management ever. The management is outrageously irresponsive. It takes forever for them to response to your issue, often no response at all. The management NEVER care about you and NEVER resolve your problem.

I have experienced a severe NOISE issue since I moved in. The ceiling construction is paper thin and has ZERO noise insulation ability. EVERYDAY I can hear EVERY sound from upstairs. I have complained to the management many times (several emails a day). But it takes weeks to get a reply from them. They did nothing to resolve this problem but tell me that the noise is “the normal noise of an apartment living,” and warn me to pay a TWO-MONTH rent penalty if I terminate the lease! STAY AWAY! Save your time, energy and peace!

Save yourself time, money, energy, and your mental health and do not live here. Poorly managed is an understatement. My experience has been nothing short of a nightmare. I have had to endure 6 leaks in the span of just 1 year – a clear sign of the property's neglect and incompetence.

The horror didn't end there. I left for a few months, during which time they promised to repair my leaking ceiling. When I returned, I was shocked to find my apartment absolutely trashed. It was as if a tornado had torn through my home. Items were thrown everywhere, dust was inches thick, and my personal belongings were treated with utter disrespect – picture frames were BROKEN, and all the screws to my furniture were stripped. The promised "repair" had turned into a disaster.

To add insult to injury, just a day after returning to this tornado-like apartment and obviously having to hire my own maids, my mother and I woke up to find the ceiling light leaking onto my bed. After months of supposed "repairs," my apartment was trashed FOR NO REASON – THE REPAIRS DIDN'T EVEN WORK!

It took an emotional breakdown – myself and my mother sobbing in front of the FOURTH property manager I had dealt with in just one year – to finally have them take steps to help me. Let me emphasize: four different property managers in a single year. That alone speaks volumes about the chaotic mismanagement of this place.

Let me tell you, this isn't the only horror story coming out of this complex. My experience is just one of many. If you value your peace of mind and want a livable home, look elsewhere. This place will drain you in every way possible.

This apartment has 0 noise isolation. You can hear all your neighbors' activities and the management does nothing about noisy neighbors. The property manager is also incompetent and rude. For the sake of your health and happiness, STAY AWAY from this place even if they offer "rent concessions". You will regret ever moving here. I certainly do.

STAY AWAY, THIS PLACE IS NOT WORTH IT!!! Packages get stolen all the time, management pretends to be helpful but never actually helps with anything, EXTREMELY LOUD (this building is literally built with the worst possible materials and you can her EVERYTHING from inside your apartment). The management only treats you well when you're looking to rent. Once you sign, the management will never help you resolve any problems, EVER.

Stay away , there is no management at all , trash is always full the whole apartment smells like trash , 5 water leaks so far and this is a new building!!! Packages getting lost , not a secure building at all

I moved to be closer to work.  I love the location and the neighborhood is like being back on the East Coast.  The building is really quiet and I have children.  Lincoln Park is in walking distance, it has great playgrounds and a pool.

I workout in the buildings weight room.  There's a business room too that I find myself using to read when I need quiet space.   

I will be moving soon to a house, but this home will truly be missed. My neighbors and the manager are all exceptional.  If you need a place that feels like home and is peaceful try Sichel.

I’ve been living here for almost 4 yrs now, and have nothing but positive things to say. The space is great, the amenities are great, parking is fairly easy to find and the onsite manager is very responsive, friendly and attentive when it comes to her tenants and the building.

My partner and I moved in back in 2019 and haven’t felt the need to look elsewhere since. We’re so happy to have found this community. Everything from the on-site amenities to management is absolutely great. The on-site manager is the BEST, she really goes above and beyond to ensure there is a sense of community, safety and cleanliness and is always so responsive and attentive of tenants. If you’re looking for a place and are lucky enough to snag a unit here, do it!
I was one of the first tenants in this building and i’ve been here for 5 years because i love my apartment. I’ve been very happy here and highly recommend this building.
Walls are VERY thin. Not only can you hear your housemates, but you can hear your neighbors.

management is mean and angry. 

Not actually luxury, given how they treat their tenants.

The property manager at this location shows that his first priority are his tenants and goes above and beyond in ensuring things are done timely, efficiently, and effectively. Furthermore, his gratitude is extended and is very approachable. When I have a problem, it get resolved quickly! The apartment is kept clean weekly and maintainance does their job. Perfect layout for couples or students. All your neccessities are in your unit! Rooftop is a perfect place to view the DTLA city or drink a mimosa! With the apartment features, atmosphere, and great service, it makes the price worth it.
Great location and staff

Lived here for some time and seen many good and bad changes to the city around it. The staff is nice and even with some of the people that do their best to destroy and dirty everything, the building staff works hard to make things presentable and clean.
Thank you for all that you do, and all the hard work you put in to make this a wonderful place to live.

Grateful to live at  The Met. Times have been tough financially and the worry of being without a place to live is an extreme trauma. Thank you to the Met Staff for being courteous and professional with helping tenants wh are experiencing hard ships.
great location convenient for me , friendly staff
The location is perfect for where I like to be in Los Angeles

Took my tour on a Friday last month and had plans to move in the following Monday, tell me why the specific leasing agent that toured me ends up being the ONLY 1 that could make my move happen (called daily for the next 3 weeks but she was “on vacation” and I got NO HELP!) I got emails to pay the application, to sign the resident portal, to pay the security deposit, just for them to tell me
3 WEEKS LATER they couldn’t get me approved! Been a week now and still a nightmare just to get my deposit back, most UNPROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE I’ve ever had with ANY apt!

I lived here for 2 years. 

Even though it looks like a luxurious apartment building, it is still in DTLA. There will be homeless people coming in, people on drugs, following you, people sleeping in stairwells, stealing packages, sewage smells & urine smells inside & out. 

It's a pet friendly building in a city. You can expect lots of poorly socialized dogs, lots of barking, dog excrement everywhere, owners who cant or wont curb their pets. 

The apartment was quiet for downtown and clean. The bath tub is huge. Generally things look very nice but are poorly constructed/maintained or just of low quality. 

When we first moved in there was water damage and a smell in the bathroom, it took several calls until someone actually came and fixed the issue. The bathroom cabinet was water damaged for our entire stay here. I asked if it could be fixed or replaced (since it's a luxury building, high prices, etc) and all they did was paint over the damage. 

There's a pretty high turnover rate of renters here- it doesn't look like folks stay for long. 

During our stay, the building switched management companies. After, the level of upkeep has gone down. They've become less responsive and lost a lot of our information in the swap. With the original management we had received so much care. With the current management I have to wait days for an email response. We were left in the dust after the switch- going down to the lobby to ask for clarification we were told that we should be in contact with a point-person which we didn't have. It turned into a very impersonal big-building vibe (which it is).

I think this is normal for large building culture, and a culture that follows a large population of college kids but overall there's a lack of accountability from the residents of this building. Dog poo in the carpet hallways, spills in elevators, trash shoots clogged and overflowing, stealing packages, car damage. It all sucks but it's the nature of living in a large building in LA. 

Your lease will say that your deposit can be used to paint and clean the apartment. They'll bill several hundred just to paint and sanitize (something any apartment building would do upon move-out regardless). 

It’s nice but it’s not that nice. The sort of “fake nice” facade and lack of community/accountability from other residents really makes it feel like a short-term thing and not a real long-term home. I would spend more time shopping around if I was looking to live in Downtown again.

Pros:
My apartment is very quiet for dtla, little to no street noise
Pools are nice
Very convenient location
Gym is quite nice
Good size living room area & bathroom 
In-unit washer & dryer

Cons:
Most of the grills have not worked the times I tried them
Theater room has been closed for like a year
Staircases are a bit gross
Limited closet space
Lights could be brighter /  turn on faster
Not far enough from skid row for comfort
Not as many food options late at night as you'd think

In conclusion it's nice but you should comparison shop, especially when it comes to renewing a lease here. The prices in this and all comparable buildings in the area fluctuate quite a bit and there are great new tenant promos to be found. 

I'm moving out for a comparable apartment nearby that will save me over $15k over the life of the lease compared to staying. Even if I drop $1k on movers I'm coming out way ahead. Don't let them take advantage of your hesitance to move  / ignorance of the market. Look around and insist on a fair price.
Eighth and Grand is beautiful clean and spacious offering high end living for an affordable price. Can?t wait to move in and making the amazing space my home.
Our leasing agent John was extremely thorough and knowledgeable of the available apartments, building amenities and our specific needs.  Great building location!
I like the touring experience and the quality of the room.

We moved here sight unseen and has its up and down. My wife and i opted for a very small 1 bedroom. The walls are thick and you aren't bothered much by neighbors. The buzzer to open the gate is helpful because it keeps others out, however its very loud if you live on that side of the building. Parking is difficult till you get used to the times and days of which streets have street cleaning and when. Internet is amazing fast and cheap through time warner 300 mbps down. And 1220 all utilities included is impressive as well. You get what you pay for. There are bigger units for more money of course. I signed a 1 year lease and will be happy here as my first place. I wish this place had a fitness center, parking, and air conditioning in the units. But then again i didn't want to pay 2500-4000 per month. Hence great starter place and you get what you pay for.

I will start with the good points. This building, one of the many owned and operated by Statewide Enterprise. The reason I first moved here, back when I didn't have a vehicle, it seemed like a great building. I have an apartment by the windows in the front of the building. There are major metro trains and buses within a close proximity. It's in the Ktown area, so Hollywood isn't too far, downtown, Beverly hills, south central, this area is central to everything and everything is but a bus ride away or a 5 - 20 min drive. The convenience is key with this apartment. We have our own laundry units (yet no change machine to get change). 

Everywhere in LA, the rent has risen, so it's a common phenomenon that seems to have no end. When I first moved in the rent was 950 a month and for a one bedroom apartment (before this I had 7 roommates, that was a nightmare). However, in just 2 years I've seen the rent increase at least 3 times, 2 times within this year alone. It went from 950 to 1000 to 1050 to 1095 to 1200.  I hate to say, there hasn't been enough improvement to warrant such increases. For a while the elevator wasn't working for 2 months of which we at least had slightly cheaper rent and recently they replaced the front door which was a great move, the new door doesn't jam like the last one and provides better security. I must say though, this is an old pre-war building central A/C is non-existent, the windows aren't best for installing your own because the windows open vertically, most a/cs don't fit properly. Expect smoldering hot summers. If you drive a car, parking is a nightmare, it's also a nightmare for any friends you invite to your humble abode....who also have cars. Normandie is a busy street with tow away times and there's a cat-and-mouse element to parking enforcement, but these are the usual things to deal with when you have to deal with street parking anyways. If you're a student, ride bikes and bus it, this apartment would still be perfect.

The neighbors are all friendly, if you're outgoing, you'll find the best friends just next door. If you're an introvert, people will be kind and respect your space. Some of the best restaurants are within walking distance especially Korean BBQ which I crave, there's 3 or 4 supermarkets nearby, chinese food, mexican restaurant, there's even a taco stand right across the street after 7pm that has the best pork tacos in all of L.A. Delicious boba shops.

I’ve lived here 2 years and in that time was mugged outside the building, and had all my christmas packages stolen from the mailroom over consecutive days due to poor security. The apartments themselves are updated, but the hallways are decrepit and management is lacking.

I've been in this building a long time, and it the quality of it continues to decline while the prices continue to raise. Yes, it has a pool, but it's no one's job to clean it, so it is constantly dirty. Packages are often stolen from the lobby, the whole building's water is routinely shut off for maintenance, and the elevators are slow and frequently breaking. Worst of all, management is constantly changing, and with those changes come new rental policies. Not just increases in rent, but how we pay rent. In the time that I've been here there have been 5 building managers and 2 of them were fired and evicted for stealing money and getting into fights with tenants. Stay away. You can do better!

I lived here a year ago and it was $300 cheaper. That is part of the reason I moved. The apartment manager, Star didn't seem to care about all the noise from neighbors and informed me that was part of living in apartments. Actually, no, that is not something you should have to live with. The upstairs neighbors had hardwood floors and due to lack of proper insulation, you can hear almost everything. (I seriously hear all about her break up one night while she was crying on phone to friend).
BUT the location is great! The perk across the street is wonderful if you have a dog and all the shops on sunset junction are a 5 minute walk. The hills make fro great exercising (I gained weight after I moved...lol).
But be warn of loud neighbors, poor management , oh and the maintenance men are a little creepy so if you are a single woman, best have a friend over when they are fixing plumbing or ac.
Great location near Sunset Junction! Staff very helpful! It has a pool,garage, laundry! Very good conditions!

A very pet friendly apartment block in the heart of Silverlake with a pool, but at a price… and not just a $$$ price. The cost per sq ft is pretty much on the money for the area, but the paper thin walls can give you some sleepless nights depending on your neighbours. Well maintained and a great building manager, but you might want to check out who your neighbours are, especially if you're not on the top floor, before moving in. The pool and secure parking is a real plus though and the utility bills are on the low side, so worth a few sleepless nights during the year.

We almost moved in here, but ended up going with another property within Moss.

There's so many perks to living here, pools, gym, outdoor grills, great views from the rooftop units, and even a sauna. It's a very central area, super convenient to a lot of different places within LA.

Ray, the property manager there, was exceptionally helpful and went out of his way to help us in our search. Very responsive management as a whole, as other people were very helpful. 

Although we didn't end up moving in, I know from firsthand experience touring the property, and a friend who currently lives there, that it's a great place. It was such a large unit for a good value for the location too.

I have lived here at Woodcliff Apartments for seven years. And it's been a pleasure. I am in a two bedroom/ two bath apartment with a balcony that runs the length of my apartment. The staff in the leasing office are always kind and professional. Whenever I have any maintenance issues they are usually handled within a day. This is a huge complex, and I have never experienced any vermin problems. The grounds are well cared for. Even though Overland is a busy street, it is not a noisy place to live. And the windows keep it pretty quiet as well. An example of how the staff is here is when I broke my leg. They removed my shower door for me and replaced it when I was better - no questions asked. And they also came and changed a light bulb for me, as I was obviously unable to climb up on a chair to change it. The only thing I am a little sad about, is that they had to remove the huge beautiful trees that shaded my balcony. They did replace the trees, but it will take some time before they grow large and lush as the ones before. If you are looking for a building that is professionally managed, clean, and warm vibe, this is a good option.

PLEASE READ!!!!!!
YOU WILL GET RIPPED OFF AND GET DISRESPECTED IF YOU MOVE HERE!!!
I don't even know where to start. I guess I will start by advising every potential resident to look elsewhere and save yourselves money and trouble. This has been absolutely the worst experience I have ever had in my whole life. 3 months after my move in, their pipes broke in the garage and flooded my car and totaled it. They refused to pay me anything even though the same spot flooded before and was never fixed neither was I ever warned. I had to buy myself a new car and spend tons of money. About 10 months later some pipes from the apartment above mine broke and flooded my apartment!!! I had to move out for one month until repairs were made and also incurred huge charges. After all that, my apartment got infested with roaches for 11 months!!! (My apartment was always super clean and I had cleaners come twice a week) the management couldn't care less and made up huge lies to not get this issue fixed and it is because of them my apartment was infested. I had to move to a new apartment and incurred huge charges for the third time, except this time I also had to deal with health issues because the infestation affected my respiratory system.

Please read reviews from other residents and you'll know that every word I wrote is true.
AWFUL

My apartment building is great, lots of amenities, great front office staff. I dislike the office hours, since most people work a 9-6pm job and I think they should open at 8am. But other than that, its a pretty great building. My apartment is a studio loft and I love it, wish it had more closet space but for the most part its a wonderful apartment. Lots of natural light, good air conditioner upstairs. My place has a lot of character, its not stiff and sterile like most apartments. I also do a lot of DIY projects to give it talking points all around the house. It's home!

This review is to serve the public with an informed warning about Moss & Company and the ownership of 708 Barrington Partners, LP. The purpose of my review is to help protect you from what I have experienced as a new resident this past month. AS A HIGHLIGHT: LOUD CREAKING, NO ASSISTANCE FROM MANAGEMENT, FALSE PROMISES, YOUR WELL-BEING AT STAKE.

I feel like I’m living in a temporary situation, still in boxes, waiting for a resolution as the noise persists and my health continues to deteriorate. Renter beware.
Have lived here for four years and absolutely love it. Wonderful management and fantastic building. Great gym and pool. Laundry room is rarely busy. Overall, A+.

Key fob may or may not work on entrances to building. Slow to fix or never fix AC, water, doors, etc. They will try to add late fees to your account. A stabbing occurred in March 2024. Trash out in the open. Standard of living and etiquette not maintained.

Today is move in day and opened the apt door to this. No one is responding to emails or phone calls and our movers are coming in a few hours. Im regretting convincing my bf to choose this place. 
Floors are cracked, laundry is small, microwave is dirty, outlets are peeled, walls are dirty and you can see all the times they try to cover it up with paint. Seems like the paint is different color each time too.
Passive aggressive messages about broken elevators and trashed common places. Save your money and find something a little nicer.

I have lived in a 1BR with Den for 7 months. My favorite part are the tall ceilings and floor to ceiling windows. I get so much natural light and the panoramic views of the city from the balcony and shared rooftop are very nice, especially in the evenings. 

The building staff are all super nice. The security guards are always around (they even help me with my luggage when I return from travel!) and the cleaning lady is very sweet. Bryan Shin, the building manager have made the whole process, from unit tour to move in, very easy and is very responsive over email and phone. The portal also makes it very easy to pay bills, request maintenance, etc.

Been living here for awhile and so far, really enjoying it. It's walking distance to a lot of good places to eat and centrally located. I'm surprised by the number of negative reviews. I would simply say to garner your expectations appropriately when looking for places in K-town. :) Management replies pretty quickly and in my experience, has been easy to get a hold of. Most units in this building (I believe) are studios, which is more geared towards a couple or single-living. There's definitely street noise but that's a result of the property being located on a main street. I personally have great neighbours but I think having potential noisy neighbours is a matter of luck when renting in most places. So just make sure to do a tour in person if you're considering :)

Garage 01/10
Elevator 01/10
Street Noise 01/10

I would not recommend it...overpriced..
It is renovated old building.

Pool is super nice, big enough for a real swim. The pool area is just a great place to unwind. Super helpful staff, move in was alot easier than expected, at least easier than any place iv moved into in the past

Roaches, mold, constant construction, manager is obsessed with leaf blowing the apt for hours*** everyday***. The front of the building does look nice but the inside of the units are absolutely terrible plus there's no peace and quiet would not recommend and will not be renewing my lease
Ever since I moved in I’ve been accommodated greatly, truly love this place

I’ve been a tenant for 18 yrs and so far I never had a problem in the building, neighbors, and manager(Irene), for she is reliable and accommodating that she make actions for whatever problem occur in the unit. The area is accessible to School, church, groceries, drug stores, restaurants and others. I’m comftable and feel secured??

I been a tenant for almost 3 years, and I like how they maintain the cleanliness, and the property manager Irene is very approachable whenever you have some concern to be resolve. Its very accesible to everywhere as well.

The Area is surely safe. It is accessible to Major busses  and few blocks away from the Metro Train. The area is very near to almost everything like grocery, restaurant, Salons and Others.

I recently moved here and love my apartment. My unit is nice and was recently renovated, management has been great and I haven't had a single issue living here so far. I like this apartment a lot. The community here are diverse with families and young artists. The managing team here are amazing. The mail system and laundry room here are great too. The building just renovated is nice ! There’s a courtyard for dog walking too. I like !
