The entire building is old and is being remodeled, so expect at 7AM every morning to DRILLING AND BANGING all around you, Saturday mornings included. You'll see construction workers more than you see tenants when you live here. 

Everything is cheaply put together in the units so EXPECT TO HAVE MULTIPLE MAINTENANCE REQUESTS upon immediate arrival, COCKROACH INFESTATION included. TRASH IS ALWAYS PILED IN FRONT of the building to the point that it completely cuts off the sidewalk. 

They offer "free wifi", when I'd get a better wifi connection sitting outside of a starbucks in my car. It's more of a last resort, and often doesn't work at all. In fact, this is my third trying to get this review to upload using that same WIFI. You'll end up ordering your own in the end so add that to your utility calculation. 

All in all, expect the bare minimum when moving here and leave some more room for major dissapointment. My advice, don't move here at all.

Finally, I've found an apartment in LA that is 1. Affordable 2. Safe 3. Clean 4. Legit! They are reasonably priced, especially for the beautiful Los Feliz neighborhood. They went out of their way to help me find an apartment as quickly as possible when I contacted them. I felt like I was the only person that mattered to them however, as much as I'd like to believe I was the only person they were dealing with Im sure I was not: This is a 4 building complex! This place has a super cute retro vibe, bringing you back to the 1940s but only in a really good way. The apartment staff is friendly, knowledgable and available. I've lived in apartments in the past where management is harder to find than Jimmy Hoffa, but here there is an office on site and most of the staff also live on site! Everything is included except electric, so just put into practice all those times your dad yelled at you to "turn off the light!" There is the option to pay extra for parking but street parking is fairly simple here. It's pet friendly, laundry on site,(which is cheaper than the laundromat and less smelly) secured entrance to each building, oh and it comes with a refrigerator, which might sound standard, but here in LA it is not! They are the first landlords I've had in LA that are not scammers, they are a legit company who cares that you are happy and secure! (Actually I think they might write that into your lease, I'll have to check) I know it sounds too good to be true but I'm going on my 8 month anniversary here (thank you we're so happy!) and I'm still in the honeymoon phase! They had me at hello, they had me at hello!

I lived here in 2019 and had a horrible stay, there were homeless people dumpster diving every single day, the dumpsters were infrequently emptied, trash strewn everywhere due to the homeless dumpster divers, cockroaches frequently finding their way into my second floor apartment, people constantly parking in my reserved spot, and the electricity breaker constantly went down because we couldn't even use a portable AC unit and the microwave at the same time. The only positives are there was a full gas range, the grass was mowed often, the carpet was clean and the previous tenant left a stainless steel fridge behind. I do not recommend living here at all. I hope they have gotten new management since then.
Love it here. Centrally located, beautiful grounds, quite, and a charming 2 bedroom apt. The management has been welcoming, accommodating, available and eager to please. No complaints, all good.

This property offers a chic & peaceful living space.

The only reason I gave this complex only 4-star, is that it's in a rather rough area. Not the most comfortable place to come home to late at night so be prepared. Still for a Brooklyn girl like me, I'm looking forward to many years here at my new west coast home!

Moving out of La Ventana was the best decision we could have ever made. The unit is NOT worth the abusive price hiking and extremely money hungry landlord. This is a HUGE warning to those wanting to move into this building. They will tell you anything you want to hear to move in and then neglect you because they probably have to focus on filling another vacancy that opened up. The turnover rate is about 50% of the units become vacant per year (15 units in building). The owner’s neglect is some of the worst in the city- not to mention the countless lawsuits that they are involved in. In the span of a year, some of the building complains have been: a broken washer/dryer refused to be fixed, an air conditioning unit catching on fire, and one of the apartments having the most inconsiderate tenants in the building being so loud the entire building notices when he stomps around. They claim to paint, when they only prime and charge you a surcharge just to put bandaids on things for them to break and then claim you broke it. They charge you over $100 for each parking space and just tackle on fees that the owner things is acceptable because he’s “losing” money and trying to “sell” the building and makes it his tenants problem. The building fire extinguishers are expired, the elevator permit was 3 years expired, and none of the building cameras actually work- they are for show. The building intercom system is always broken and doesn’t actually function properly even when it’s working. Do yourself a favor; avoid this building. Unless you know a lot about renters law because you will have to threaten to sue the landlord (I know of 4 different units that had to) to get anything, including security deposit back. 
Also- they’ll tell you the pool is heated… it’s not.

Just moved out of La Ventana at Crescent Heights because of the abusive pricing and absolutely horrible service provided by Rosh Management. The landlord is clearly trying to cut corners with costs while still catering to and charging luxury price ranges. Many of the amenities that the apartment comes from are only partially offered. After nearly two years living there, these are some of the "highlights" to give you an impression:

• They charged us another new month of rent two weeks after we had moved out! They also only partly returned our deposit (21 days after we moved out, as legally required, and after multiple reminders) so we are now poised to move to a small claims hearing, unfortunately.

• The dishwasher never worked – it clearly needed replacement but they sent a technician to "repair" it at least a dozen times.

• During the rainy 2023 season, our home was flooded for several weeks, rooms unusable, and constant repairs and construction over the span of 10 weeks. There was no type of credit or reimbursement for this type of interruption and lack of service.

• The pool is heated during the summer but not in the winter, in spite of what's advertised (nevermind how odd it is to heat it up in the summer). After I notified management, they announced to the building they'd reinstate heating but they never did, even after I confronted that multiple times.

I wish I could stay here longer but I need a place that is less expensive. Hardwood floors throughout, viking stove/oven, spanish tiling, huge backyard with exotic plants.
Its really beautiful. Also I love my neighbors :(

Only downside is that there is a building behind the duplex and occasionally some idiot will get loud. I just yell for them to be quiet and it does the trick.

Terrible property management. They delete all negative comments. 3 days ago there were 7-10 negative comments. Extremely difficult to work with. Horrendous income verification process. Systems don't work - they somehow got my social security number wrong and then blamed me and wanted me to come to their office to verify my identity through bringing my social security card and employer ID. I was going to be the guarantor and live out of state. No feasible way to comply. Property manager hung up on my daughter (the future renter) twice. False information about pet rent (several people said deposit only, no ongoing monthly fee then rental agreement had a monthly fee). Within 1 days of rescinding application to rent, my daughter was accepted at a different location without a co-signer.  So glad we won't be working with this property going forward.

I was very excited to rent here, but had an absolute nightmare trying to get approved. Management is extremely hard to get a hold of. They own a few properties in the area and there is no manager on site at Toluca Court. When I first toured, I was not told of this and ended up having to go across the street to find someone. The number listed is not correct, and when I was provided the correct number, we found it goes straight to voicemail, which is always full. On top of that, nobody on the team is on the same page. Every time we spoke with someone new, they had no idea who we were and sometimes the person at the front desk did not even have access to our file and could not help. We had to follow up constantly, with me making multiple on-site visits to try to get an update. There were errors on the offer to rent that they sent us, and it took 2 full business days to revise. In trying to verify our income and residence history, they contacted both our supervisors and our guarantor's supervisor, all of whom said they were asked far more invasive questions than they ever had to provide for anyone else's income verification. They even contacted my parents to verify I used to live in my childhood home. 2 days before our move-in date they told us we wouldn't be able to move until 2 days after that, which was incredibly frustrating, unprofessional and disrespectful as we'd already arranged utilities, time off work, a moving truck and flights for people who were going to help us. Then we realized management had entered our guarantor's social security number wrong, and the only way we could move forward is if she flew in from Washington and presented her social security card, drivers license, birth certificate, and work-issued ID. We had to rescind our application THE DAY BEFORE OUR MOVE-IN DAY because of this negligence, and my roommate was hung up on when she made that call. I would not wish this process upon anyone.

We felt this building did not live up to its promises. It was marketed as a luxury apartment building yet it was quite mediocre in every way. The pool was often crowded and we gave up trying to use it. The cleanliness was not up to par. The noise level and general disrespect from other renters in the community made it uninhabitable for us. We would not recommend this property.
These are great apartments and I really like the design of the brick facade.  The resident manager is also very friendly and helpful.
Love this building! The murals are awesome.  The Beat lab is amazing and completely sound proof.

Molly and Nethania are so friendly and professional and made my move-in super easy. They are both kind and caring leasing professionals. Jorge is an excellent maintenance director and leads a fantastic maintenance team! Loving my new home so far! Thank you Alta South Bay!!

Overall a great apartment to live in. It’s quiet. It’s clean. Parking is easy. Great place for people with pets. The staff is excellent. They’re very nice and punctual and always willing to help. Lots of amenities as well.

Overall I like the apartment complex. Not very happy about the unfinished hallways. Also, the front doors all seem to have a giant gap that allows for a lot of wind and debree to come in. The cabinet hardware will do well with a replacement/maintenance as some are difficult to open and close.

I was live in Alta South Bay for almost 4 years. In December 2023 one pipe was broken and flooding many units. My apartment was several damage. Very bad experience!!!!

Worst place to live! Rude manager. Roaches every where. Packages get stolen from the mail room.

We lived here for 2.5 years and moved out recently. They raised our rent over $425 in the short time we were there. And now we see our unit priced another $200 higher than when we moved. That's over a $600 in a couple years! The manager was so rude too, always saying that she's "doing us a favor" - what? No, that's called doing your job!

ROACHES AND MORE ROACHES ... the property manager is rude.. I lived there almost a year and then there was a roach infestation things were falling apart since the first week my ceiling fell and stove wouldn’t work

I lived here for a year and it was a very clean, well taken care of property in the center of the NOHO Arts District. They always had a cleaning staff come each week to keep it up to par. The management team was also very kind and attentive!

I stumbled upon Luxe because I needed a shorter-term lease (they offer as short as 6 months, which is rare). I very much enjoyed my 6 months here. The on-site manager, Maria, is communicative and responsive. The building is clean, well-maintained, and was built in 2020 so feels very new. Can't overstate how nice it was to have a great property manager - those are rare.

The only downside is parking is not included, and rather steep at $175/month without any promotions. Overall, would love to live here again in the future if the budget allows for it.

I’ve been here since it opened in 2020 and signed another year lease! Management and maintenance staff are extremely helpful. Building is well maintained and tenants are highly vetted. I look forward to another year here at The Luxe

We stumbled upon The Luxe in 2021 and loved the new building and modern design. The apartment treated us well for the 1.5 years we stayed - the parking and building made us feel very safe. It's conveniently located near a ton of restaurants and places to go. 

The highlight of our time here was the exceptional customer service we received from the on-site Resident Manager and Maintenance Tech. They were both very courteous, easy to work with, and communicate well.

This complex offers a 6 month lease, which is very rare in the area. The rent is not too high, considering it was built in 2020, although parking is not included.  It is well managed by a corporation, and the resident manager Maria is exceptionally responsive, caring and keeps the complex super clean. Noise from residents is almost a non-issue, and I experienced no unpleasant residents. The street is homeless-free, and feels safe at all times, however, it can be frequently congested.
Manager and maintenance staff live on site. Staff is very knowledgeable and helpful. Excellent response time from management. So happy we picked this building!

The pros: The maintenance staff and the janitors are the only pluses of this this apartment complex. They are quick to respond, are extremely nice, and keep the property very clean and well maintained. 

The cons: There is no guest parking outside of about five spots only available from 6pm to 8am. Guests are advised to park in front of the houses across the street which is always full. 
There floors between rooms are so thin you can hear everything your upstairs neighbor is doing. Sound also travels from the courtyard to the rooms even when your windows are closed. 
Other residents do not clean up after their pets and let them go to the restroom in the hallways and in the garage. 
While the inside of the apartments initially seemed very nice, over time we noticed issues such as uneven floors, uneven paint jobs, and loud and cheap appliances.
Calls to the office/front desk go to an offsite location which can make it difficult to speak with those at the office on site. 
The charge way more for additional parking, garbage, and sewage than what is average in the area.
It is a great place overall to live at!
nice amenities and friendly staff, really like the layout of the studio and 1 bed overall, a little more storage space would make this place perfect.

Overall great first impression.   Making phone calls to get thru to office has been frustrating.  Dealing with a corporate environment vs what I am use to is not my first choice.  Linnette is awesome.

Property is very well maintained-pool area is constantly cleaned.
Trees & bushes very recently trimmed.
How about having an ice cream social?
I am really enjoying my apartment. Its the nicest place Ive ever had. I also like having all the amenities too.

The units themselves are fine; however, management is unresponsive to emails. You won't get a prompt answer (if you get one at all)! Also what the other review stated is true. For some reason the owners of the building decided to fill up 2 floors with residents and then commence a construction project on the bottom level more than 2 years after people started to live here which is incredibly inconvenient for anyone that works from home or stays home with young children in the daytime. Parking is also not enforced, no window permits are issued either; the tow signs are just for show, so good luck is someone else takes your parking spot. We love the location so that's what keeps us here despite the negatives, the community is very walkable and we prefer TUSD over LAUSD for schools.

This apartment is currently under construction and you will have to deal with constant jackhammering, drilling, hammering noise for 8 hours per day NONSTOP. The management did not warn us of this info before signing the lease and has been ignorant of the extreme disturbance we have to deal with 8hrs 5 days a week. I would definitely not recommend moving here.

I'm a current tenant.
The building is old and you can see that. There's a guy who always keeps it clean and I love that. Also, I have quiet neighbors so that is the main reason I keep living here. But the pool and jacuzzi are always broken, as well as the washer and dryer machine. Next is that the manager said that they gonna renew the floor on the main level and never did. That's sad because that floor looks disgusting and I have to see it every day. But overall my experience here is 6/10.
Huge apartment with big closets and plenty of cabinets. The neighbors are very nice and the pool is always clean.

Casa Del Riverside is a family-friendly building, with a great swimming pool and all the common areas well maintained. My apartment is very large and comfortable with central air, which is essential in the Valley! The only thing I don't like much is the carpet but since I live on the 3rd floor, there's not much to be done about it. Dan, the manager, is very helpful and very polite. I definitely recommend Casa del Riverside.

My husband and I moved into Casa Del Riverside 3 years ago, and it was our first "grown up"apartment. We had previously lived in the heart of North Hollywood and while it was nice to be able to walk to bars like The Federal and Bow and Truss, it was super loud all the time, and the rents were just getting to be sky high for what we were getting. (Often dirty pools, rude neighbors, and a non stop slew of 18 year olds fresh off the boat from the midwest with dancer dreams) 

Casa Del Riverside is in a very safe, quiet neighborhood between Laurel Canyon and Colfax. We were 27 when we moved in, and now we are 30- it has been such a stellar choice for a really affordable amount. We have a one bedroom, one bathroom, and nearly 800 square feet. That is as big as some houses here in Los Angeles! Our very spacious balcony overlooks Riverside and the Burbank mountains: the sunsets are amazing to watch. There is a laundry room on each of the 3 floors, and 2 working elevators. 

There is a nice mixed bag in this 108 unit building. A good amount of young couples (ages 30-40) who work in the entertainment industry (like us!), several elderly retired couples, and also families of 3, 4, and 5. The families stay in the units overlooking the pool (which is always clean) for the most part, and we've had very little issue with noise or screaming children. (The walls are thick, unlike most apartments in the valley) 

The rent is so affordable, (and has gone up very little in the 3 years we have been here) and the neighborhood itself is lovely and serene lined with quaint houses and small apartment complexes. Within walking distance to Gelsons, Starbucks, Subway, Jack in the Box, Menchies, dry cleaning, and several busses. You are about 1.5 miles from the redline subway- a good walk or short bus ride away. Even being on a major street like Riverside, we don't really hear the cars very much, and don't have issues with sleeping due to traffic noises. 

You have covered, gated parking, and the street parking if you have friends visit is very good most days- lots of space for everyone, and no street cleaning signs- hooray!

Maintenance is quick. Aside from the occasional spider here and there in the summer time, there are no issues with bugs!  An affordable place in the valley that is 10 mins from Hollywood, 10 from Burbank, and 2 mins to Studio City. The 101, 170, and 134 are all a block away. No complaints... best place I ever lived. :)
This building has been under construction for over a year. If you enjoy living in a never-ending construction zone then this is the place for you.

It's very convenient and close to CSUN (it's literally right across from the dorms). Aside from that there is nice spacious living and a really solid apartment. The reality is, it's very expensive! There is no forgiveness in this economy. We are in the valley and aside from the university there is nothing near us. Every other month the water is getting turned off "for repairs". Elevator breaks down about every 3-4 months. I have had minor other nuances but those come with renting I understand things happen. Overall if you are desperate or financially "ballin" come through.

Zelzah Court Apartments is a wonderful place to live.  The buildings are quiet, the management keeps to themselves,  and there are a lot of amenities. The only things that I am not happy with is that you b have to drive c almost everywhere,  and the parking spaces cost you about 150 monthly but they are super close together. All in all the units are huge for the price,  the building is well kept, and since they installed cameras in the parking lot and hired night time security its also  a safe place to live.
It's nice and clean and close to my college. My roommates and I enjoy it a lot.
The management offered us prizes to leave reviews for them. But overall the place is clean and quiet.
My buds and I just moved into Legacy Apartments and we love it ! Clean, modern, and so many flowers - the rent isn’t too bad either.
Spacious, well equipped apartments, robust management services, nice gym, it with refrigerator washing machine and dryer, definitely a pleasant place to live
The  Management is very helpful and always ready to help

I have been to different apartments near CSUN. But Legacy is clearly the best. I love the colours within the apartment. Nice deck and I like the gym too. Also, the manager(Ivette) is very helpful. This apartment is super clean and well maintained.

Do yourself a favor and look someplace else. Unkept building. Over priced for no reason. Units are used as airbnbs. (Party every weekend until 6am. ) management changes so often there’s no accountability for anything. All they want is to take your money and give you a horrible living space. Wouldn’t recommend to anyone. Many better buildings in the area.

Multiple issues with this complex. Maintenance requests take DAYS to be completed. I had a backed up toilet with poop sitting in it for 4 days since "I had a second bathroom to use and it was a holiday weekend" so we had to smell that for days before it was fixed. I found mold growing in my washing machine that they refused to replace until I made a fuss. Then I had to wait over a month for the new one to come and use another apartment on a different floor to wash my clothes. Amenities were closed for over a year but our rent stayed the same. My hospital shoes were stolen from my front door. My $600 bike was stolen from downstairs in the designated LOCKED garage that requires a fob to get in. I've found homeless people in the staircase on rainy days. Do yourself a favor and keep looking. Once my lease is up, I plan to do the same.

My boyfriend and I have lived here for a little over 2 months and we LOVE it! We moved from downtown and love that everything is much more quiet and relaxed in our new place. The complex is very well maintained and the staff are extremely friendly and helpful. We are walking distance from the Galleria, the Americana and the small shops on Brand which makes it great when we want to eat out! We have a huge courtyard with grills, and I've been able to start my very own vegetable garden in our balcony. This place is unlike other apartments!

I've been a resident at this facility for more than 8 years. Many residents always had a problem with the owner of these apartments. One big problem is that this apartment is infested with bed bugs and cockroaches. I've had to throw various kabinets and beds away.    Owners of the apartment always hire exterminators but they seem to never find a solution.
Manager focuses on his own well being, leaves apartment units to rot. Maintence Guy fixes everything with caulking

This place is not smoke free the management says hes not a babysitter when asked nice that the kids make to much noise at night and also this place is filled with cockroaches nice place but the management and maintenance guy don't do there job sorry
Car has been broken into inside the underground parking facilities multiple times within a couple months. definitely do not feel safe here at all

I will definitely miss this apartment and all the friendly staff at Legado! My husband and I moved to LA from the east coast last July and we picked this apartment as our first ‘home’ in LA.

The high rise ceiling and good natural lighting made our one bedroom apartment look enormous. Flooring was newly renovated before we moved in. Thermostat was also upgraded to Google nest upon our arrival. All the minor cosmetic flaws I marked on our move in checklist was resolved within a day. 

Maintenance is always professional and efficient every time we needed something done. Props to Vince! Our leasing office manager Joanne is literally the nicest person! She responded to all of our questions and concerns promptly and you can tell that she genuinely cares about the residents at Legado. 

Security was my top priority when I was shopping for apartment in LA. Due to the high crime rate in LA, like car thefts, break ins, stolen packages and other crime issues, I knew I needed to be careful with my selection. Legado has gates, on site security and underground parking which made me feel safe the entire time we had lived there. 

We moved out after our one year lease ended because we are buying our first house in LA! Our move out process was easy and smooth. I will definitely miss this place and recommend it to anyone looking for an apartment in the area!

The Catalina is a well run, well kept property. It has an excellent and very professional property manager who is attentive and focused on making the complex a nice place to live. It is in a nice area but unfortunately, like any major city, there are folks that pass through that do not belong. The management are continually doing their part in helping keep tenants safe. The facilities (pool, sauna, fitness center, dog park) are convenient to have on the grounds and are cleaned on a regular basis. If you're new to Southern California and want to live in a well run complex, this would be a great place to begin your journey.

Catalina Apartments have been a great place to live so far.  I love having the washer/dryer in the apartment.  Recently, however, they changed the grass areas in front of the building and replaced them with decorative plants and then fenced it off.  So, us dog-owners need to walk a bit to find a grassy area.  Why did they do this when they claim to be pet-friendly?

This is my first apartment since I moved to LA. I am very fortunate to live in an apartment with reasonable rent, a nice environment, and friendly, knowledgeable staff. It makes me feel safe and relaxed.
CC Tan has a great team staffs< friendly and clean environment
CC Tan is such a well maintained community, the team is approachable and friendly

We love CC Tan Center, as it’s situated close to the freeway, making it very easy to get out into LA. We’re also close to downtown Glendale, so we can take advantage of all the shopping and dining in our area. The complex is kept very clean and the amenities in our unit are all brand new. Our neighbors are friendly and the maintenance team are all super helpful and respond very quickly. I recommend it to all of my friends looking for a safe, clean, and fairly affordable place to live in Glendale.

Throwaway account, just wanted to share a recent experience so folks can learn from my mistakes.

Do not attempt to move into the CC Tan Center in Glendale without a backup property lined up.

I am currently in transit to Glendale to move into the apartment. I have just been told they are cancelling my lease before it begins because the current tenant will not move out and they say there is nothing they can do.

I am now over a thousand dollars out of pocket for car hire and moving costs. I am sitting on the side of the road attempting to find an alternative apartment so I do not become homeless when the moving truck arrives.

The leasing office kept stringing me along telling me the apartment would be ready until the last second. You cannot move to this apartment without at least 2 weeks of overlap, in case they cancel on you due to an issue with the current tenants.

And before you ask - yes, this is permitted in their lease. All standard Greystar leases waive responsibility for cancelling leases due to building work or overstay of existing tenants. All application fees are also non-refundable.

Just something to bear in mind if you ever try to move to Glendale and are considering the CC Tan Center.

CC Tan Center is a lovely apartment complex that is very clean, safe, and friendly. The management is kind and the maintenance team is efficient and very helpful. Overall, I've loved living here and would recommend it to anyone looking for a great modern apartment for much less cost than many of the luxury apartment complexes in Glendale.

This property has fantastic amenities, is in a prime location, and management has the special element of the human touch. There is a gym, various outdoor lounge areas, a community room, the building recycles, pets are welcome, you feel safe as the building is access controlled, there's plenty of guest parking (parking pass required), and you have easy access to the 5 or 134 freeway. 

You feel as though you're dealing with a real human. I had major surgery and needed help with the basics (food, bathing, walking my dog, etc.). Management was so kind about allowing me to borrow a second set of keys/fob so my sister could take care of me. They are also thoughtful in that they give out goodie bags on Halloween, decorate the office on the holidays, and are very pleasant to interact with. My mother came to visit me and got lost (she's directionally challenged). The assistant manager was kind enough to take her up to the air-conditioned community room to wait for me (I was in a zoom interview) until I could get to her. 

I'm on a first-name basis with the maintenance man. Due to COVID, I haven't had many opportunities to get to know my neighbors, but the few I've interacted with are so kind! I love to see so many families with their kids. It's a relatively quiet complex too which is a bonus. The walls have some great soundproofing as it honestly took me weeks to realize I had a new neighbor. I didn't even realize someone had moved in/out since it's very calm and quiet. It's definitely great for a small family (3-4) with kids, couples, or individuals such as myself. 

Living here has been a fantastic experience and management has truly made it easy with online payment and personable service. I can call or text the manager with any questions or concerns and she is very responsive. CC Tan Center has set the bar pretty high.
You should move here if you want to live in a dark, yet modern, shoebox.

CC Tan has been a great building to live in. It is in a prime location with reasonable pricing compared to nearby buildings. The leasing staff is always receptive and welcoming. The building is maintained well and has very good lighting at night, and includes 2 parking spots in a very nice garage which is always a plus!
Its been a pleasurable experience living in CC Tan for the past 6 months. The staff is very responsive and friendly. It is easy to communicate with them. The building is clean, and safe.

So far it's a good experience living here, though only 2 weeks have passed. The best management, lease specialists with a friendly approach. When the situation with quarantine gets better, we could use all the amenities of the building, and living here would become even better.
CC Tan Center provides five star service! They go above and beyond to ensure you have a flawless experience from the initial tour to move in. Erin in particular was absolutely wonderful!
Awesome property, Package Concierge and roof top fire pit are my favorite.
Lucy is the best very helpful and accomdating. The apts are very nice, clean, the staff here is very helpful

I made an appointment for the tour two weeks in advance for May 12 at 9:00 am, I got there after receiving emails and messages to confirm that I was coming
I drove 50 minutes and they did not respect my time, a disgusting building!
And when I arrived no one was there! Rude people spoke to me on the phone rudely and unpleasant people, don't live there, run away!
The Security or lack there of has caused many peoples car and possessions to get stolen from this property and Anna the management will not do nothing to help. So I would suggest not moving there
Great amenity spaces and  a dog cleaning room! No more mess in my sink or tub! Yay
My son and me like the pool, gym and dog grooming room for our puppy!!..plus very safe building!.

Management offer me model apartment. They run credit check, get deposit and send me email that I'm approved. 
After manager Ana call me and tell that she will cancel my application and I have resubmit new one if I want to get apartment.
This management not trustful at all.

Roach issues. Laminate floor is blisteringnand comming up. I've been trying to get it fixed since November of '23 multiple repair issues go ignored or unaddressed. A/c unit constantly goes out. Landscaping is a joke. Regular rent increases but nothing changes. Cornelia was a great manager but she left. The new one got tlreplaced and the current one is overworked and splits his time in other complexes.

The prior apartment manager had been there for years and was effective and responsive.  Since she left, the management has changed several times and doesn’t do their job and are very difficult to contact.  The apartment was updated superficially inside, the outside of the building and plumbing is showing it’s age. Some of the ledges outside of the windows are falling off due to dry rot.  Although there are signs for picking up after your pet, poop in the landscaping remains a problem.
We have loved living here the past 11 years. Cornelia keeps things clean and well maintained. If something breaks she gets it fixed.

This place is amazing. Our apartment is very nice and spacious. i've lived here for a few  years and i love the little park i have when i walk outside my apartment. There is so much green and the manager is always taking care of the place. 
DEFINITELY recommend SUMMER BREEZE APARTMENTS

Terrible management and no communication skills. Manager has maintaince workers come into the apart at random times without warning or notice. Not cool when you're in the shower and there's a random stranger inside my apartment. 

Expect rent increase every 5-6 months. Water to be turned off for a 9 hour stretch, and pipes that screech every time someone from an adjacent unit flushes the toilet or showers. Laundry rooms that are constantly out of service, and people that go In and steal clothes. Inside parking is not safe, many people have complained about having cars broken into. I've had my car doors keyhole broken. It's just disappointing. This is a building where tenants come and go. I've had 4 neighbors in less than 2 years.

In a city where the average rent is so high no matter if you make 6 figures. You wind up paying most of the money to the rich who own expensive apartment buildings.  My apartment has everything I need and is affordable and only 1 mile from my job.  

It has central air conditioning, dishwasher, secure parking, pool, and jacuzzi, and well below the average rent for the area, and its only 5 minutes away from my job.  It allows me to eventually save to purchase a condo one day.

I love my apartment!!

Horrible management took over and everything is in disrepair. Leaks in the hallway ceilings and in peoples units, pest and rodent issues, mold, the pool was shut down because it was tested and there was zero chlorine in it. Roaches are abundant. The elevators are ALWAYS broken. Nobody gives any notice before they show up at your door for maintenance. It’s loud and the residents here are constantly skipping out on rent in the middle of the night. Tons of 3 day pay or quit notices on doors all the time. It’s a slum. Endless problems and tons of complaints to the housing dept and environmental dept.

Wish I could stay longer but prices in general are just out of control, I'm bowing out. The management and people who live here are genuinely kind and happy people and it makes a world of difference in quality of living. There's no theft or crime, only the occasional bit of noise which quickly subsides. It's surprisingly uneventful for it's proximity to the highway and major streets, I've never seen or heard anything that crazy happening. Homeless person here or there once in a while, but I get the sense police here tend to herd them out pretty quickly - or maybe they just move on because is this basically just a commuter community. Overall I've felt welcomed here, the staff are always available, receptive, and they are all very reasonable people. The facilities are well laid out and generous, with numerous washer and dryers on every floor, several elevators, an excessive amount of stairwells!, and four gigantic dumpsters that can probably handle all the trash in Los Angeles. Also a pretty nice pool and fitness room and flora.
Very nice, maintenance and management are top-notch. One or 2 bad seeds and that's it. Best place I've ever stayed. That's why I've been here for over 10 years.

Apt is ok..Old fashioned apt. But Management is not really helpful. They do not care much about tenants. Had maintenance issue. 4th day still not fixed. Usually they take unbelievable 3-4 days to fix a maintenance issue. Yes. 3 days is a normal thing here. Now it has started going beyond 3 days. But I have seen Maintenance guy inside the building. But they cannot fix until management inform them. So basically Management or Leasing office people not able to communicate properly to the Maintenance workers. Either they don't have the proper resources or they don't have proper technology. This apt is good as long as you don't need anybody's help. But when you need help Management doesn't really care. Maintenance Emergency after hours is a joke. Phone number itself will never work. You are screwed up if kitchen water flowing out of sink. You have to wait till 9 AM next day. You get what you pay for. Realized after moving into this apt. Other than that of course some cockroach issues.

This place is very nice to stay in the valley. This place is close to pretty much everything you need and right off the freeway which is a big save in avoiding local traffic.
Everyone in the management staff is so nice and very responsive to any concerns you have. The management team is flexible to your needs which I have not seen in any other place i stayed. Brianne in the management team is very helpful and is the right person whom you would want to talk to. The remaining staff is very nice too.
The apartment units are very spacious unlike other apartments in this area with similar price range.

Overall we had a very pleasant stay here and will surely miss this place. I would strongly recommend this place to others looking for a good hassle free stay.

I never do reviews but I just felt I had to! Brianne is in the management office and has been above and beyond with some of the things that had to have been taken care of lately! I have literally lived there since 1994 and have been through a few managers, but she is the first to get back to me when I leave a message, and follows through when she says she is going to do something! She is always in such a good mood when I talk to her, and doesn't ever make me feel bad if I need something done. She is exceptional and I am so glad they decided to go with her!  This will 100% lead me to recommend Woodland House if anyone is looking for an apartment! The grounds look great, plus the pool has just been redone and it I just truly like living there!!

Built about 1947. From the outside our small apartment complex looks quaint. Parking is very limited. If you rent a single unit only street parking is available. Depending on what side of the building you live on there is alot of street noise especially on weekends & Hollywood Bowl nights. Traffic on those nights is horrendous and forget about finding parking close to the building.  Some pets are allowed however they are not allowed in the grassy areas.  We've had a high turnover rate due mainly to the management of the building.

Love my building, unit and amenities. Especially love how quiet my building is. Rarely ever hear my neighbors. Location is also superb, right by the 101 and 405 so I can easily get anywhere I need to.
Everyone I have encountered has been friendly that it make choice for living here a blessing. Although there issues with the water at times I still feel this community was the better choice for me.
I continue to be happy with my apartment and the amenities at The Highlands. Through epic rain storms, and intense heat, my apartment has remained dry and cool as we all navigate crazy weather.
Been here with my wife for 3 years and we love it. Highly recommend anyone to live here! Walkable to everything you need. Restaurants, markets, bars  etc.

Management is doing this new thing now where they are turning the hot water off at night to save money. They say they are "working on it" but no one is ever in the water heater room working on it. They also are never concerned about it and never call out an emergency technician. My guess is because they know exactly what they are doing and are turning it off at the meter. We also do not have an on-site property manager in our 101 building or a maintance person.
Close to everything you need, no need to drive anywhere. Very safe neighborhood.

The apartment was clean and well kept. You can't beat the location - directly on the beach. Everything worked and the bed was comfy and also very clean. The management company and building manager were easy to deal with and helped us through the rental process to ensure a quick process. Love this place :)

Awesome property on the Boardwalk.  Literally 5 steps to the sand... Easy transition to move in as all utilities, tv and internet are set up by the landlord. Going to miss this place and hopefully will return for another 6 months when I am back in the city!! Bye Venice, will miss you.

Worst mistakes moving into this place. There is so much wrong with it starting with the management company that does not care about the residents. Remodeled apartment- Mickey mouse job. Every single cabinet and door has nails sticking out. They make you pay for water and trash and the bill is not based on personal usage, it’s based on how much the entire complex uses. 
Thank God my lease expires in 2 months.

This place needs so much work and they use the poor to house this place. They will attempt to fix things but they will lie to get you in here.  Ive been exposed to bad plumbing, insects airbourne allergens from the open walls to do the plumbing since it hasnt been done since the 50’s!!!!  The manager is not honest. Dont trust her! During the course of my entire lease there have been problems and repair request.
Non stop construction with no end in site. Unsafe conditions rocks dust and debris all over the entire complex.

the building is very good, has a swimming pool, sauna, laundry, parking space, barbecue and is in an area with good access to the roads (101, 170, 134 and 605).  The apartments are a great size with large closets, the units that are available are being remodeled and modernized.  The condominium administration is located in the building itself and the management has a very good job that is prepared to assist with any need.  The price is on average with what is practiced for apartments of this size and location.  I recommend it to everyone looking for a quiet, safe place with a structure for children as they also have a large and wide area in their common areas.

This is the worst place I’ve ever lived. Disgusting. Renovated units are made so quickly. Don’t be fooled by the price. Building manager is awful. Maintenance is awful. Literally fighting a roach in the bathroom as I type this.

I have several problems maintenance has failed to resolve over the passed few months. Beware of the renovated apartments as they are done very quickly and there will be issues including (but not limited to) roaches coming out to play, shawty craftsmanship, paint bubbling, poor ventilation, and terrible outdated, old, and drafty windows that they refuse to replace.

This place is a hoax. Please beware. The building is out dated and has numerous problems. There’s some sort of “construction” going on everyday. Huge plumbing problems and drainage problems. My apartment got flooded and I had to use my all my bedding and clothes to stop it and I was not reimbursed. They also will enter your apartment without permission.

This unit is up above and private which is great, but it has 2 major downfalls:

1) It is either freezing cold or boiling hot. If it is 80 degrees outside, then inside it is a strong 95 degrees. If it is the least bit cold out, the apartment is fridged. 

2) I can dust and vacuum the entire place and with 24 hours, every surface has a thin layer of dust on it. It is very annoying and I HAVE NO IDEA where it is coming from.

The owner is very sweet most of the time and will fix things if you bug her enough. Closed in front yard for pets. No washer-dryer, but that's okay.

My roommate and I moved in February 2021 after a really bad year and a half experience with Pan American Properties after they took over the building we were living in. By FAR the manager Alberto and Maintenance team (Richie) have been great!  Anytime we have needed anything it has been taken care of properly, professionally and in a timely manner. Communication is great. You can always get ahold of them if needed. Very professional team and always willing to help. I highly recommend Bluffside apartments!

I have been living here since December 2020. The building is very safe, quiet, and is in a great area. Alberto and Issam are great. They are always here to help and the move in was very easy. I highly recommend it.

i just signed my lease 1 week ago and couldn't be happier. Ive wanted to move to this street fro a few years now, due to its amazing location...got Ralph'S, Rite Aid, Starbucks, 7-11,a gas station, Jamba Juice, restaurants and bars just one block away!
The application process was fairly easy And Alberto The Manager is amazing at his Job. He went above and Beyond to get me approved since my credit wasn't the best. I really feel like I'm in good hands with this maintenance staff here.
ready to start a new chapter of my life at Bluffside Apartments.

It is in a great location with everything really close. There's a Ralph's just a five minute walk away and a bunch of good restaurants. The manager Alberto is very nice, always a smile on his face and always willing to help with anything we need.

I lived here for a year and a half and had roaches the whole time. Not a coupe of roaches... A full infestation. I was told by the property manager's boss that it's bound to happen since the property is next to the freeway. Which is ridiculous and just not true. I have strings of emails where promises were made but they were really just pushing me off til the end of my lease. I would avoid at all cost.

I wouldn't recommend this place. I had to changed my time to 5:30, Orlando said they normally do their last viewing at 5, but he was going to wait for us. I made everything in my power to get there by 5 pm to make his life easier yet he never borhered to call me once from the moment I got there, which was at 5 after 5 to inform me that he was busy. I heard him on the phone with a young lady, and he didn't make one effort to try to let us know that he was going to be right out to help us out. There was no sense of urgency and it was a lack of courtesy towards prospective residents. He needs to receive a class in customer service for sure. I

This was my husband and I’s first apartment together. We have so many wonderful memories to look back on when we think of our three years here. We miss the home we made here every time. Arely and the on site team were always so respectful and genuinely nice. It is an older building, but well maintained. The way they’ve curated the space with the pool, pond and plants really makes you feel like you’re in a tropical getaway. 10/10 would recommend!

Arely and all the staff on-site are wonderful. We lived 2 + years or so in this apartment. The apartment is ideal for tenants who work M-F during the daytime--more for your evening and weekend rest time. It is near the freeway (the start of 110 in fact) so you may hear some cars blasting their engines like they have no tomorrow (don't know why) but it is overall pretty quiet. The on-site team is great at fixing things very quickly; the on-site manager is super helpful if you need help. It is a big apartment complex so like in any other apartment there will be various types of tenants--it takes all kinds of people to make a community so as long as you are courteous to others and be communicative there should be no issue.

I lived at this complex for a short time and couldn't wait to leave. This complex is located by the freeway which is constantly noisy and the units is small with a single bathroom even for a two bedroom. There is also constant noise from the maintenance worker renovating all the empty units and with their music blasting. The workmanship is done by an amateur at best. The maintenance supervisor isn't a professional and hires sub workers that knows even less. The manager does not acknowledge you as you walk by unless there is a complaint to tell you. And the other worker in the office doesn't even know what is going on in the complex. Rent goes up every year like clockwork. I don't know who is writing these great reviews it is probably written by the manager herself.

My stay at Palm Gardens Apartment over the last 10 years has been excellent. The complex itself is large and always cleaned and kept up to date with remodeling upgrades. My unit itself was upgraded 3 times since my initial lease started. The building itself is beautiful with ambient lighting, plants, ponds, gym and a large pool with plenty of seating. The maintenance workers are amazingly quick and are available at all hours of the day should you experience an emergency at your unit or put in a request for repairs. All of this, ably managed by the nicest building manager who is quick to respond to messages and considerate of your request and very professional. Needless to say, I enjoyed my stay at Palm Gardens and left with nothing but good memories of a place I called home for 10 years.

The apartment complex is beautiful and well kept at all times. Very family oriented and super accommodating. I was new to California and this complex and the people who work in it and the people who live in it , made it the absolute best experience. Palm Garden is a place you can truly call home. 10/10!

Palm Gardens Apartments was a fantastic place to live. The place itself is beautiful, full of plants, a pond and a pool. The patios are very big, with many tables and chairs. The management and the workers there are very nice and will come and fix anything if there is a problem at your house. The place is constantly remodeled so it is always up to date. The gym at the place is perfect, they have all the equipments you need for a full body training. The view from my apartment was beautiful since it was towards the mountains and a very open space since it is next to the freeway, I loved my time there and hope that many others enjoy It as much as i did.

Stayed here back in 2000 while I was pursuing my graduate studies in USC. The apartment was ideally located:
- Very near the 110 on/off ramps. 
- Located at the heart of South Pasadena commercial district
- Walking distance from many shops
- Safe and secure environment
The rent was very reasonable back then (circa 2000). I would imagine the current rates are still reasonable. The apartment managers were so helpful and responsive.
By the way, we did not have the gym and nice landscapes back in 2000. All we had was the swimming pool.

I love so much this place. I have only good memory of this place. Especially,  manager is so kind and very professional of her job. If I go back to south Pasadena I will go back this apartment!!!!!!!strongly  recommend!!! And handyman of apartment ..he is so kind!!!! ..from oh's family.
1800 State Street is a nice apt building. The building is clean.  The manager and work crew are friendly.  We felt safe during our 2.5 years stay there.

This place was a gem to find. The location is in a great area and is quiet. This apartment truly became our home. I’ve lived in many different apartments in California and other states and this one definitely tops the majority. The property manager, Arely is so caring and superb. I wish I could take her with me to any apartment I live in. The maintanence crew is always on it and they handle jobs efficiently and timely. There are a lot of amenities and pros to this place - including parking and there is a ton of street parking as well. Definitely will miss the staff and apartment complex.

This is the best apartment complex that I have lived in.  The superintendent Arely was extremely helpful and always available to help when I needed her.  The maintenance staff was the same and would look at and fix anything I needed them to within the same day.  It is a great complex that is clean, quiet, well maintained, and in a wonderful neighborhood.

I just recently moved because of a transfer from work.  I loved the size and location of this property.  The amenities are great and the management team and her staff are amazing and quick.  I can't say enough about the property manager, she was always easily accessible and reliable.  She responded quickly and helped me out a ton when I moved.

My family and I have been living here for more than two years. It is a lovely place to live. They renovated the floor with laminate before our moving in and upgrated the kitchen appliances last year. It is an old building, but the manager and her staff are doing their best to keep it updated, clean, and cozy for the tenants. We are leaving California and missing this home, but I cannot forget very patient, kind, and helpful manager who always takes care of every single problem. She is one of the best managers.

We had the privilege to live here over the past year. It has been great. With small children, security is always a concern. At Palm Gardens, we always felt safe and never had any issues. The neighbors are great and the leasing staff and maintenance team is wonderful. They keep the property clean at all times and were such a pleasure to work with. We definitely recommend living here.

We have been living in this apartment for a little over a year and love it. My kids love that we have a clean pool. Our manager is always there to help with our needs and solve our problems. It is great that she is always reachable. Also, she always has her happy face on. Moreover, the staff here is also great. they do their best to keep the unit clean and neat. You can always find someone to help you in the apartment.

My family and I lived at this property for 5 years, the apartment is nestled at the end of State st. close to the 110 Freeway exit. I loved living there for many reasons, the swimming pool, the availability of the on-site gym, the convenience of the location, and the upkeep of the property as well. There are plenty of trees and plants within the property including a pond and the flowering plants are always in bloom and well manicured. If we ever needed anything to be fixed in the apartment, Management always took care of it. Before we moved, management started upgrading the bathrooms, added Hardwood floors and recessed lighting in the apartments so every single apartment has recently updated. We left since we bought a home..  miss South Pasadena a lot.

I currently live at Palm Gardens apartments and while I can say that the  location is excellent, the apartments themselves are lacking a bit. The location is very close to the 110, 210, and 134 freeways which is very convenient for commuters going to work and school. The management at these apartments can be rather frustrating when it comes to fixing current problems in the apartment. There also has been a problem with plumbing so the water has been shut off for more than 8  full days (8:30-5:30) sometimes with little notice. I do like that the two bedrooms come with 2 parking spaces, although it is very common for management or an employee to park in your spot. Overall, decent apartments but definitely overpriced and lacking in good management.

Palm Garden Apartments in the community of South Pasadena is not the ideal place to live.  The rent is extremely high for a place that has no elevator and the property is not worth the price that one renter would think.  The back bed rooms are extremely hot because the AC, does not reach the rooms.   There is only one bathroom, which is very small for a two bedroom or a one bedroom.  The landlord does not keep the property clean at all.  Its very noisy during the day and the freeway noise all night long.   Yes, there is a pool, but, only can be used between May and September, the gym always has broken equipment and the so called TV's with Cable are never working .  The land lord, increases rent by 300 or more after the first year.  He is very dishonest and only hires cheap help.  Many have had property stolen.   This is not a place to live, run before you sign a lease at Palm Garden Apartments, its not worth 1850 - 2100.  You will be sorry...

Just moved into a 1bd/1bth. Process was simple and straight forward. Lease agreement is a bit extensive, make sure to read all the pages. Ari from the leasing office was stellar at helping us get into our space. She answered all our questions and went above and beyond to accommodate us.

I would not recommend this apartment building or RW Selby as a company. Not only has there been frequent turnover in property managers (AJ, Toyia Evans, Sylvia ), leaving many of the tenants frustrated by lack of prompt response to leaks in the roof, noise complaints, and rent increases, but there is also a complete lack of transparency from the various property managers, who are unfortunately all guilty of lip service to appease angry tenants and do not honor their verbal promises. My husband and I are both MDs who initially loved being walking distance to work, but neither of us would recommend this building or company. Not worth the money at all, especially with mold in our walls after the rain leaked through our bedroom roof, not to mention the broken elevator.

I cannot say enough good things about Kenmore. It is a beautiful building, clean and everyone is so nice. The building manager, AJ, goes above and beyond to take care of all the residents. Communication is great and is anything is not working, it’s fixed immediately. I have never had a better apartment experience than Kenmore.

I just moved into Kenmore View in March and have had a good experience.  Yesenia the property manager was very thorough and friendly throughout the rental process. Hector is the groundskeeper/maitenance person on site M-F and is extremely helpful, and keeps the building in immaculate condition. He even let us borrow his Dolly on move-in day. The building is very clean & covid safe.

Pros: Amazing neighborhood/Location, breathtaking rooftop view, lots of natural light in the unit. Huge studio (650 sq ft), Brand new kitchen.

Cons: Rent is quite high, walls are very thin & if your balcony faces the courtyard sound travels quite a bit, and there isn't much privacy.

Overall a good choice for now.
Luis has a great eye for what needs to be fixed and is a pleasure to work with.

The majority units are around 400 sqft of usable space. Its a lot of money for stuff that breaks a lot and maintenance fixes in a glue and tape kind of way. If amenities break like rooftop fire places its previously taken months before fixed. The parking gets old very quickly when you want to immediately leave but you have to wait for the machine to get your car. Unless your car can be charged then you don’t get to opt out if using said machine either. They will raise your rent after a year and if you choose month to month then they charge you a 10% base rent fee. They’ve raised the monthly parking fee too so be prepared for that happening again.  They will squeeze every penny out if you that they can. I feel like the neighbor turnover rate is also high because people quickly realize these apartments aren't really great. There is also the issue of sound: doors slamming, people in hallways sound echoing in the middle, paper thin walls depending on your unit.

Natashia. What to say about this charming woman?  Incredibly knowledgeable, patient, kind, and funny!  Really took the time to sincerely listen to my specific needs and went above and beyond to find a way to make my price point and specific needs blend. Cares for the property AND its tenants.  Come through !!
Security and maintenance are incredibly helpful here, they have solved numerous problems in a professional and timely manner. Excellent location and great square footage with washer and dryer.
If you have a service/maintenance request it is resolved in a timely manner. Great to know all the leasing/security staff. Very comfortable place.

My parents have been living here for a year and I recently moved in with them to a bigger unit. This is a fantastic/affordable place within walking distance of the financial district.  It has 24/7 security guard, with key activated elevators so if you see anyone come and go they must be living there.

Moreover this apt complex has a fantastic management team, and a great maintenance crew. Anything that is broken is usually fixed within the next day. Furthermore Sandy has been the most helpful person in the management team, accommodating all of our needs in any way possible.

For anyone moving to DT make sure to check this place out!

This apartment complex is very elegant with a kind staff and a good mix of people. Located just a few blocks from the heart of the financial district, this apartment complex is great for people working downtown and want to live right by the action, but be able to sleep at night if you decide to stay in (it's pretty quiet & peaceful in most of the complex).

I LOVE everything about this building! This is the only place I’ve ever actually wanted to sign a lease for the second year. The two front office managers are amazing, helpful and kind! Shannon feels like family at this point and literally always brightens my day when I see her. The amenities are ALWAYS cared for (cleaned daily) which has never been the case anywhere else. The pool is essentially a resort pool that is a great place to make new friends. The gym has everything you could ever want so you don’t have to pay for a membership somewhere else. There’s a machine in the lobby where you can get free espresso daily & everyone who lives here is just super friendly and kind. If you have a pup it’s perfect for you too. On top of all of this the apartments put on events all the time. From a pool party with an open bar, taco stand, and a DJ to networking events with snacks and beverages. My favorite is the hot cocoa bar, with all the fixings, every winter. It’s amazing, so if you’re thinking about moving, definitely give it a try.

Have lived here for 18 months and I love it! The most striking part is that the management team is so consistent and stable. They truly care about the residents and go out of their way to make life there great. 

The complex is very clean and all the amenities are top class. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone.

It's a beautiful building. Most of the tenants are great. Management is full of nice, incompetent people. Whether it's suddenly charging us to use the very amenities in the building that we are paying rent in, or, the fact that it takes security, an hour, yes, you heard that right, AN HOUR, to respond to anything OR the fact that they deal with numerous complaints from numerous tenants by doing... nothing. Seriously, nothing. I would not recommend living here until there is a change in management. I'm sure the nice customer service lady SRG will respond to this review by saying how much they care and to reach out to them, but we promise you we have, numerous times, they don't care and no changes will be made. Nice, but incompetent.

The building looks nice from the outside but it’s not worth every penny they squeeze out of you. No parking spot included, extra pet rent per pet, no utilities included. The sound proofing is non existent and the first time in my life I’ve been able to hear the people above and BELOW my apartment. The gym is about the only amenity I was able to use consistently without it being broken. Packages have been stolen despite two secure package rooms and the “secure” bike area was broken into and pilfered twice so far. The staff are lovely to speak to but the property management will take you for every dollar they can in the end. We left our apartment in a spotless clean condition and still lost half our deposit.

Other than its location, this is over priced old apartment. The front desk lady is very rude and she is the reason I won't be renewing my lease here. That's right she is THAT rude. They do not take care of your packages, and did I mention how rude she is? The walls are very thin, and this place needs some serious ramifications. You can do better than here.

This is a great location in Koreatown Los Angeles. Quick walk to markets, subway station/metro,  restaurants, citi and Bank of America and Feria(Korean club) for nightlife right across from the building. The staff is great and active, security is friendly and helpful. Parking for guests can be hard but if you need extra space you can pay 100$ monthly to park across from the building behind the plaza. They do offer you 1 parking space per unit. 
The rent price is above average but it is worth the money with a great view. With 3 working elevators, not wait time is not long at all. The roof is amazing.. beautiful and best 360 view in Koreatown.. the only thing missing is a spa/jacuzzi. I say its well worth the money!

Wait before you rent here. I've been living at the Recreation Center apartments for a few years and the building is under non-stop construction. The price for a studio (450sqft) is already higher than any in the area, although you do get your utilities included, which is nice not to think about, but that's it. There are no other amenities at all. AND you will get woken up at 8am on a regular basis. For someone who does not work a traditional 9 - 5p, this has seriously effected my life. This has been going on for the past 4 months straight, and then intermittently for the past few years. They also have permits to do construction on Saturday mornings so good luck with sleeping in on the weekend.
So, yes: The building is cool and getting cooler as the construction gets going, the building manager is a gem and it's a 5 minute walk to Echo Park Lake.
BUT: you're constantly getting woken up and having construction workers walking trough your unit (this is almost as constant as the construction by the way), there are no amenities for the price you are paying (even parking), there is no security on duty - packages were stolen and vandalized  over the holidays and it was caught on the cameras (someone literally held the front door open as someone else ran around the building stealing packages), and bugs (the building is so old - it's a given).
Only you know what your money is worth to you so if these types of things don't worry you, go for it. I just want to throw this out there because I think these units are so overpriced for what you actually get and I had a hard time finding an honest review of the building. So my advice is to wait a couple (or even a few) years before you rent here. The building will be much improved and you won't have to deal with all the commotion and non-stop hectic construction that interferes with your well-being.

I live near the USC campus and this place is the perfect spot for me to be secluded at times and yet near all LA has to offer as well. Eric is great at what he does. He is a very knowledgable guy when it comes to about anything and he will take a look at any problem immediately if they show up. He keeps his customers in mind and connects with them all on a personal, friendly level. He is very easy to reach out to and an overall good guy. I would recommend living here to most anyone. Great location and great service.
Jonathan and Michelle are spot on with how the manage Maxfield Lofts...this place is top notch. Absolutely loved my residential experience there!

I've lived in LA for many years and just moved to Maxfield Lofts a little over 4 months ago - this is a great building to live in! My apartment is quiet, clean, modern amenities with old world charm, and I have a fantastic view of Downtown LA!  Even though I'm in a studio, I have plenty of space for a living room, bedroom, kitchen, creative area and office space for myself.  The building managers are nice and helpful and take care of any maintenance issues right away. The leasing agent Ashley helped make moving in here easy and convenient and is so friendly every time I see her.  I feel safe in this location, especially with tenant parking right across the street and no vagrants in front of the Maxfield building. Unfortunately, due to Covid-19, I haven't been able to use the rooftop or gym area yet, so that's the only thing I'm missing.  The nice thing about being in the Fashion District, is that at night when I drive home I see sanitation workers cleaning up street debris from the day. I'm close to everything needed and there is so much downtown history to appreciate walking around in the neighborhood-I love it here!

I have been pleased with living here, Maxfield Lofts is one of the best places when it comes to management, amenities, overall living and safety. I’m born and raised in Los Angeles, my first loft and couldn’t be more pleased with the floor I’m on, the upkeep as well neighbors. If this is your first time renting or wanting to own a loft I highly recommend the Maxfield Lofts. - Asaad

Worst apartment ever! Water is freezing cold and I have been complaining for months! Don't let the cute building with amenities fool you. They have serious issues in this building and they don't care about any of it because the managers don't live here. Without a doubt they will come out as many times as you call just to pacify you but in all actuality the nightmare will continue. Water here has never been hot and is almost as cold as ice currently. I have been complaining from the first week I moved in. I don't care about any excuses they have at $2k a month I need a resolve. This apartment sucks DONT RENT HERE!!!! Total waste of money and personal energy! They simply do not care. BEWARE OF THIS HORRIBLE BUILDING! Wish I could give them zero stars, trust me they have earned it! Great job guys! Cannon management is the parent company just so you know. Avoid all properties they have no integrity whatsoever.
Have been trying to get ahold of someone at the front desk and they are continuously rude and carry an attitude for no apparent reason.

It’s a churn and burn “luxury” (see: old and leaky but new paint) bldg where owners are giddy to see constant turnover of units so they can relentlessly raise rent. If you live here, your rent WILL go up 10% every 12 months without fail. Go find a bldg where landlords want to retain tenants.

I have a very basic studio in the heart of Culver City. It has a remodeled bathroom which looks great, a huge walking closet, and a small kitchen area with a sunk and fan which is a huge upgrade from most studio apartments in the area. The apartment is also gated.

The landlord is very responsive and willing to remodel whatever is needed. 

Only set back is that the street parking here is very scarce.

This building is 2 years old and there is a major problem with HOT water. In 10-15 mins shower the water fluctuates several time to lukewarm to absolutely COLD temperature.  It is impossible for any one to have a decant and pleasurable shower. Even giving 1 start is too high of rating.

There is no one here answering . Terrible management I had power outage because of faulty circuit breaker sent request of maintenance several times also sent emails no one returning calls or doing anything even during weekdays . The washer is strlean dryer there is no dryer and the cloths are wet in all programs after 2 hours . No one from management answers your emails or returns your calls . The water was cold and you don’t hear back from them . No management at all . Terrible management just don’t waste your money and your time and your life here .

Run dont walk away from this place. Brand new beautiful apartment and thats where the good things end. I havent had a good nights sleep since I moved in. I literally hear every step my neighbor above me makes and he sounds lije he is moving furniture every night. Its so loud my dogs are terrified. Leasing agent/maintenance doesnt  fix anything. Slow draing tub, squeaking  door I had to fix these myself. Broken ice maker I just buy bags of ice,  dishwasher has burning smell, I just hand wash my dishes.  I have  lost count of how many emails , calls and face to face conversations I have had with leading agent about the noise. He says whatever to get you out of his face and never fixes the problem. I first told them about the noise on Jan 13th.  He told me mgmnt is working with their construction company to address the issue as I am  not the only person complaining about the noise but here it is almost 2a.m. and it sounds like 3000 people are in the apartment above mine moving furniture.  I am sure management is sleeping cozy in their quiet homes as I write this.  If you want  a pretty apartment that you wont get any rest in, this is the place for you.  Otherwise, avoid this poorly constructed building and the lazy, uncaring staff that run it.  Thank God, I didnt sign a year lease. I cant wait to get out of here. I was forced to give them 1 star in order to subit this review. Its not even deserving of 1 star. Run!!!!!
The people here do not respect their neighbors. They are LOUD until past 2AM EVERY NIGHT. Their friends pull up in the middle of the night and honk their car horns. Loud, rude, disrespectful.

I do not recommend anyone to move in to this apartment!
Yes, it seems nice when you first come, but after living in here for 2 years, I have to say it's not worth it to live here. I've been living in downtown for several years and I can tell you there are so many apartments where you can feel SAFE in stead of worrying about your package been stolen or your car been broken in!! It's definitely NOT A SAFE PLACE although they have some security guard who will only show up at late night. Also, your neighbors will play loud music and party at 3PM just like other reviews said.

Simply put, the management staff is very unprofessional, specifically the onsite manager Melody. This someone the takes advantage of her job, this woman stays up till 2am blasting music in her apartment with the windows and doors open for everyone to hear.Not just on weekends but on a nightly Basis. She consistently throws parties with no concern for anyone, one occasion this woman walked into the home of an resident having a get together completely unannounced with a friend of hers. She proceeded to eat and drink all the food to the point that the host had to move his gathering to another location. One intense when I came to complain about the noise Melody was making to the security he simply said  “yea we get a lot of complaints about her, she likes to party a lot”…  Again this is the property manager!!

     As far as her work ethic goes, I have not once seen her in the office, both her and “ security “ are never to be seen. During her work hours you can find her relaxing in her apartment or anywhere put where she should be. Try calling now, I guarantee you no one will answer.

We have nothing but trouble with this apartment since the begging. The apartment is suppose to have security at all time because of the area. When the seucurity is actually here you can never find them because they are either sleeping in their car or smokeing week on the roof! Today we had an instadent where a homeless lady was able to make her way into the building and she started a fire on the second floor at 7 in the morning and we all had to evacuate until the fire department came and take care of it! 

Please don’t risk moving in here
Weird layouts. Not very large apartments. Semi-sketch neighborhood.

Initially, the front office exhibited responsiveness and friendliness, yet these positive qualities quickly deteriorated over the course of my year-long stay. Regrettably, the building's value doesn't align with the price it commands. The financial burden extends beyond just rent, encompassing additional expenses for water, trash, electricity, internet, parking, and even renter's insurance – essentially an all-encompassing list. Unfortunately, the maintenance team's pace of response leaves much to be desired, coupled with an uncooperative attitude and subpar repair efforts when they do tend to issues. However, the most distressing aspect is the pervasive presence of cockroaches throughout the common areas and even within living spaces, disgusting! 

To amplify my disappointment, cockroaches emerged from the drain within my unit. When I sought pest control assistance, I was taken aback by the proposition of an emergency service charge – a proposition that I found utterly unreasonable. Additionally, the unit's HVAC system struggled to maintain consistent performance, and a persistent odd odor greeted anyone entering the premises. Adding to my discontent, upon terminating my lease after just one year, I had to reach out twice as my security deposit exceeded the 21-day window stipulated by California law.
