To my surprise, a substantial portion of the deposit was withheld for supposed "cleaning" and "full repainting." It's worth noting that I assumed the unit from a previous tenant that left without paying, and I had even invested in professional cleaning before vacating.

Awarding a mere one-star rating feels lenient given the collective grievances I've encountered during my tenancy.

Stay away, there are better options!!!

I scheduled a tour and drove from the Bay Area to Los Angeles to see the apartment. I called in the morning to double confirm my appointment and the lady said she’d like to cancel the tour, meaning that if I didn't call her,  I’ll go there without seeing the apartment. Also, I’d like to ask her more questions and she just hanged up the phone. Now, I know how they manage their property. I won’t choose and visit there! Suggest don’t need to waste your time.
Packages get regularly stolen from the mailroom, which has cameras that the staff “don’t have access to” and the complex is infested with roaches. Don’t move here!

I have been living in this complex for a few years. I have swapped my apartment two times due to sewage issues and water damage from the old pipes running throughout the building.

The area is not safe and lots of thieves are constantly stealing cars and breaking car windows and taking stuff out if you park on Sepulveda (my car was stolen 2 months ago and I found it when it was nonoperative).

Management/leasing staff are quite rude and they are only nice to you when you are looking to rent out a unit.

3 out of 4 BBQ Grills have been constantly out of service for the past year and nobody is fixing them.

The laundry rooms are always dirty, and I can't remember the last time I used the building’s service.
Don’t be fooled by the shiny images. Roaches, surprise fees, smokers, loud dogs, rude neighbours, lazy staff. DO NOT LIVE HERE.

I lived here for a year during the height of the pandemic and it was a nightmare.  It felt like living in an overpriced dorm. Noise at all hours, loud neighbors and people having parties with guests wandering the halls late at night yelling and screaming.  Also, not particularly secure. Located in an area with a rising crime rate and no security cameras in the hallways or parking garages. And side gate entrances were frequently left propped open by tenants so their guests (or anyone) could wander in. Several tenants cars were broken into while parked in garage.  Also, building 1 has a huge water leakage problem. Water was constantly flowing down the walls in the parking garage and hallways leading to elevators. Huge bug problem in the laundry room in building 1. Maintenance is non existent and common areas rarely cleaned.  You can do better.

Leasing staff is horrible and will treat you poorly. I was trying to lease for a apartment not long ago but was told before I got the chance to lease to not even bother by the leasing staff because they assume I couldn't afford it. Kind of glad I didn't because I got to see their true colors.

The location and the space is not bad. 

However, the facilities are not well-kept. The smell from the garbage disposal permeates the whole hallway, especially in the summer and I've found blood/trash on the floor of the elevator on a few occasions. Any communication with management has been mostly unhelpful, and getting anything fixed in the apartment has been like pulling teeth. 

The management still has little consideration for their tenants; multiple occasions, when a neighboring unit is getting renovated, I will get no warning ahead of time. Since I work from home, weeks of construction noise was very disruptive-- much less, unannounced. The water was also shut off unexpectedly without any notice, which has grounds of legal recourse. 

Unfortunately, even after being a 4+ year tenant (have always payed rent on time, no property damage, no noise complaints), I will most likely have my deposit with-held.

PROS

Location : it is right in the heart of Koreatown, streets are wide, good amount of street parking, pretty safe :) close to Ralphs, Vons, Larchmont area. accessible to public transportation and freeway (101, 110)

Apartment review : apartments are well maintained, we stayed in  1 bedroom apartment for almost 5 years and it is decent, a lot of space. you have an option if you want wood or carpet flooring. There is a central AC or box type.Then after 5 years, we moved to 2 bedroom with 2 baths, Central ac's , with 3 parking lot(gated and covered) with security guard at night. Out master's bedroom is huge for an apartment and so is the 2nd bedroom. Our living room is pretty big as well considering that we had friends over a couple of times and there were about 10-15 people at home then. We also have a walk in closet in the master's bedroom :)

Amenities : Swimming pool and Gym
Neighborhood : family oriented and working professionals


Cons : 
pricey! for the price of the apartment - it is like you are paying a mortgage rate already!

Hi. I hope I do this right, never done this before. I love the place I have been living here for 20 years, the are it's wonderful, and now a corporate owns the building and the ones around, they never ever since the took over, the fix up every single apartment, but mine. :-( I told them several times to fix the apartment end they just give the round and round.  I was paying 1250,00 a month, and since the own the place, they raise my rent 350 more! And it's been a little hectic to afford life. Some it's a  2 bedroom apt, and 2 full baths A/C parking and a laundry room. I have everything hear. I LOVE MY APT....! THANKS.

The worst customer service all around. Very unorganized. Terrible and slow maintenance service. Several times tenants were stuck in the building due to a power outage which wouldn't allow for the garage gates to open, maintenance took hours to allow people to move there cars and leave. They towed cars that weren't parked correctly due to the garage gate being broken. They overcharged me my first month here on the rent. They make it difficult to transfer to another building. They recently opened another building in the area and told me they had no availability even though i knew for a fact they did after receiving a tour of it from another agent. They gave me and roommate the wrong code to enter our rooms and apartment. Maintenance has left our personal room doors unlocked and open before without our consent. My roommate was locked out her room for nearly a whole day because they didn't know the correct code to give her. There's no manager on site ever at this building. They took days to fix something in my apartment. Cleaning isn't offered weekly like advertised on website (1-2x a month). The maintenance guy was very rude and complained about having to do his job. The cleaning products and toilet paper provided is poor quality. I had paid for parking and wasn't assigned a spot for weeks, and was terrified they would tow me. There's basically no street parking and i was paying for a spot i hadn't even been assigned to yet. The wifi didn't work in our apartment and they basically didn't fix it until months later. We had to sign onto another apartments wifi. Several packages delivered to tenants in the lobby were stolen and though they had video footage of the tenant who was stealing packages did it they did nothing about it and didn't bother to put some safety net in (lockers, mail room). Im thrilled to leave in the next 
 months. Im heard previous tenants had trouble getting their security deposit back, so hopefully i can get mine back as well.

my contract says i have parking, i was assigned a spot, was charged $300 BUT after 2 wks. "management" threatened to tow my car, since they didnt have documentation (awful communication), forcing me to park on the street and i still haven't got my money back for parking I couldn't use! On top of it I paid 3 months in advance and they're trying to hit my bank acct. After the 1st month saying I owe them! NO ONE will respond to my emails or call me! They try to sound great, replying back on my review posts, but its just an auto reply. I have over 40 emails (since thats the only way to communicate) and still NO ANSWERS! DONT MOVE HERE IM NOT THE ONLY ONE WITH THESE ISSUES!

nobody answers. The process takes a lot because the emails answer them every 24 hours. And when they answer them they do not respond to what is requested. The customer service are rude and they hang the call; they do not help you solve the questions and the process.

apartmentName: The Regal Villa Apts...Gorgeous Newly Remo...
review: When I found my apartment I felt like I finally found the place I could call home in LA. In my opinion this is the best location for someone who travels a lot for work and wants to see so many sides of what LA has to offer. The building and street are very quiet (even some major celebrities have homes on the street), yet at the end of the street is the on-ramp to the 101 freeway. The building itself isn't perfect. It's pretty old and needs several updates. I've had to have a lot of calls into the building and they don't always get responded to quickly as the property manager won't own a cell phone (at least that's the story). My bathtub is unusable. They replaced all the pipes and refuse to do anything more and the water comes out full of red minerals I can only assume is rust. They say it's just the old pipes but as an avid bath lover I'm going to continue to stay on them about this. The building is rent controlled and the neighbors you'll meet at the pool have lived here a long time and will make you feel right at home!

apartmentName: The Regal Villa Apts...Gorgeous Newly Remo...
review:
Location, location, location. Walkable neighborhood with decent bars and restaurants, shopping centers and the metro. Shuttle buses tothe Hollywood Bowl stop a block away, and freeway access is easy to most freeways.

The building is a little run down, and getting things fixed can take a while, but it's not the manager's fault. It's managed by a corporate management company and that's how they tend to be.

My stay at Westwood Riviera was nothing short of amazing.

My SO and I stayed here roughly a year as my SO was finishing up grad school @ UCLA.

Specifically, we needed a place that would allow us to live and work stress-free .. with no music being blasted through paper thin walls at 2 AM till the wee hours of the morning and no enforcement by building management beyond repeated "warnings". 

We found a quiet, beautiful sanctuary here at Westwood Riviera. 

During our time here, Nina (management) was responsive and attentive and set us up to succeed! 

Even when we needed to suddenly extend our lease, this was a painless process.

If there was any sort of renovation or construction or need to enter our unit, it was always communicated well in advance - never any surprises. 

All of our maintenance requests were handled quickly and efficiently. Amenities here are nice (the gym is fantastic!). The residents I've met here have been down to earth, and certainly respectful of noise after hours!

Lastly - I credit my first (and many more) good night's sleep in Westwood to Westwood Riviera.

I lived with my wife and teenager daughter for about an year there, and the building has been completely refurbished and renewed in this period! It is well located, twenty minutes walking distance from UCLA and the Westwood´s middle school. Westwood Village is very charming with all services around. The building is clean, tidy and organized. The appartments are spacefull, with garage, modern gym room, swimming pool, sauna, commom laundry area per floor, and controlled access. Nina, the manager, is a very nice person and a very good professional in dealing with the everyday´s routine in the building organization. The maintenance staff is really good and Mr. Carlos is a senior professional that really takes care of the tennants in a very simpathetic way! Miss L.A.! Missing Westwood, The Riviera and The Village! Enjoy your stay!!

I had the best time of my life living in Westwood Riviera. The staffs are amazing. They get things done right away. It is a quiet building, good neighborhood and a safe and convenient location. I lived here for 10 years and really sad that I had to move to another city.

I have lived here a while and yes, renovations have taken a bit longer than approximated but having experienced with construction projects elsewhere in the past, there is no guarantee they they are completed on the exact date originally scheduled.  I also have never heard of a quiet renovation with tools that don't make noise. It's just reality.  The tenants I know on my floor have all remarked how responsible management is here.  Now that renovations are in their finishing stage and seeing the results, I will say the Westwood Riviera is now better than ever.

This place used to be good however after the construction it has quickly gone done hill. The renovation has taken ten times longer than what was originally told and has made living here feel like you are constantly in a construction zone. It’s been borderline hazards and management has shown no respect to the current tenants that live here.

The Westwood Riviera apartments are close and convenient to UCLA.  There are several nearby supermarkets, malls, restaurants etc.  The building is approximately 4 miles from Santa Monica pier.  Overall, the building would get a 6.5 out of 10 pimarily due to its age and the fact that there are only 1 bedroom, 1 bedroom lofts and studio apartment units available.  There is a small pool, a small spa and a gym on the ground floor.  Most of the time, these can be used without numerous participants.  This building was chosen mainly due to its location and proximity to UCLA and the 405 freeway.
Not very secure. Parking spaces are small. Lots of pests in the summer. Ask for move in inspection they do not provide one when you sign the lease and make sure to fill it out.

Tons of ants, spiders and mosquitoes everywhere, ants especially in the summer 
the water in the shower never gets hot to steam that little bathroom 
Dog poop everywhere,  a dog attacked kid, nothing was done 
The front desk won't hold pkgs, the guards will do nothing if someone's car alarm going off 3a or if there's  domestic violence they won't even call the police 
THERE'S ABSOLUTELY NO PARKING AVAILABLE for guests,  everyone double parks and if u do find a space  in the building they have to leave at midnight 
No matter what time in the morning afternoon or night people play VERY LOUD music from their cars and won't be asked to turn it down
The rent set doesn't include the shared water/ trash bill added monthly and they will raise that rent as much as they legally can no matter what pandemic or natural disaster has occurred

I moved in in June 2018 and have been having a problem ever since. It’s october and there’s a terrible problem with ants. No matter how often clean, ants are EVERYWHERE. “Pest control” has come and seems like they don’t do sh*t because there’s still ants. Terrible slipped on paint job, cracks everywhere, and you have to continue to call and email for something to be done. There’s all types of bugs and insects here it’s ridiculous! No central air and they have an ancient heater.  Makes sense now why they trap you in a year 1/2 lease! I can’t wait to leave here. Mgmt only responds quickly to you when are moving in because they want the money. Only thing that’s good is it’s quiet and people mind their business...a lot of older people so no rift raft. Other than that this place is horrible. I wouldn’t recommend living here at ALL! Unless you are desperate like i was for a place smh.

Gloria Homes Apartments managed by Jones & Jones is known for towing cars. My car was towed this morning 12/21/16 for expired registration from my parking space. I called the leasing office (they were rude, of course) they said they had given me several warnings. I asked them to send copies of those warnings, because I had not received any on my car, email, or phone. The warnings listed a grey Toyota Corolla. I have a grey Toyota Corolla. However, the dates and times on the aforementioned tickets were assigned to me while me and my car was at work. License plate number  on the tickets are different from my own. And to top it all off my registration is NOT expired. Yet and still I had to pay alot of money to get my car from Southside tow and recovery, who apparently tows cars for no reason at all.

The place is quite renovated and may seem nice and flashy. But please go there once during the night time before you move in. 
I'm living there now and the leasing agent wouldn't let me terminate my lease while I'm on my 8th day living there.

Gloria apartments are great. They have 24 hours security and a great neighbors. They provide great maintenance assistance as well as amenities such car ports laundry rooms and safety surveillance. It can improve tremendously still. For instance small designated play yards for children, bigger laundry rooms, better parking monitoring, bigger car ports. But this only means that they will charge us more for rent. So kind of makes you wish that they leave everything alone.

My experience at 7403 Living has been exceptional! The community is well-maintained, and the staff is incredibly friendly and responsive. The amenities are top-notch, and the location is convenient, with easy access to everything I need. Living here has truly made my daily life more comfortable and enjoyable.
The building is new and all facilities are in good condition.

Marquese and Brenna made our move so easy and enjoyable. Their response time to any issue we had was met with amazing service and prompt attention. The two of them deserve big praise and we personally could not be more thankful to have them as our property management at 7403. We also love the advance technology at 7403 making things like, access to the building, rental payments, access to immediate assistance all available at the tip off your fingers.  Thank you 7403 management and Marquese and Brenna for everything!

Love living at 7403! The management is super friendly and I love the smell of coffee from the shop downstairs. The gym is awesome and it's a safe secure building. The surrounding neighborhood is great for long walks and is safe.
Beautiful community with lots of amenities in a great location.

I don't even live here and I'm giving it 1 star. No one answers when you call and you can't leave a message because the mailbox is full.  If this is what it means to be "professionally managed" I'd hate to see what it'd be like if they were a bunch of amateurs.  Might be better, to be fair; at least they'd probably try then.

Great Business Staff!
Great Maintenance Staff!
Safe!
Secure!
Great Neighbors!
Parking!
Very Clean Property!

From the moment you step into the leasing office of Sunset Barrington Gardens, the staff are warm and welcoming (thank you Latisha and Vesna). Having escaped the Palisades wildfire, they were both so patient and kind and thoroughly explained the process (including the lease and the insurance).  Yesterday, the leasing office even sponsored a formal delicious brunch for the tenants as a thank you gesture for the fact that the property did not have power during the wildfires. Highly recommend!

Sunset Barrington Gardens is a very special place to live.  Super attentive, kind, and supportive staff in a gorgeous setting well cared for and welcoming for both singles and families.  I have been here for nearly a decade and look forward to calling this home for years to come.  Thank you, Latisha, Dale, and team!
This is the best property in Brentwood. Latisha is an amazing manager, Aida the best leasing person and the service staff keeps the place looking brand new!

I don't often write reviews, but the Sunset Barrington Gardens has been a fantastic home for the past 2.5 years.  Despite being a fairly large property (over 200 units), management does a great job of keeping it in order.  People are quiet, respectful, and the grounds are always well kept.  There is a night guard that walks the property at night which is an added safety bonus. Maintenance requests get fixed in 24-48 hours and all of the on-site management folks are incredibly nice. Biggest complaint is that packages get lost sometimes because Fed Ex and other delivery services get confused about the building numbers. For example, there are multiple Apt. 105's (in building 217, 219, etc.).  I typically just get things delivered to the front office (233) to avoid that.

Came for a tour and the leasing agent wasn’t there. The person who set it up via email + confirmed “Alisa J” never responded to my two emails asking why this tour was set up with no availability to actually show/no one in the leasing office. A tenant let me in - she said she was moving because the walls are thin and that no one is ever around or answers calls regarding maintenance. I looked around the property - it smelled good and was nice but a stranger (me) was able to go from floor to floor as there is no security and no need for a fob. The pool would never get any sun (obviously.) All in all this place is terrible. Particularly because of the way they handle their potential lessors.

Call box has been broken all year, no leading agents, break ins, theft, when they ARE here the agents are rude, washer/dryer suck. 

Apartments are nice with views, good retry quiet for the most part, nice appliances, cleaning staff is amazing.

I double confirmed my appointment for a self guided tour but no one was in the leasing office. I waited 30 mins and asked the agent who I can contact directly for a tour and no response. Waste of time and very unprofessional.

My daughter and I had an appointment for a tour on 6/8/21 at 1:30pm. She had confirmed the appointment the end of the week prior, as we were traveling in from out of state to look at housing options for fall when she starts school. We got stood up. We followed the instructions in the confirmation email: tried the call box several times, no answer. Called the phone number we were given, no answer, and no ability to leave messages. Voicemail was full. Called the office number on the leasing advertisement board out front. Went to the same voicemail as the other number we had. Text and email options aren’t managed by a live person. We’re pretty sure “Alisha” is an AI, as she asked what kind of unit we were interested in, and if we wanted to schedule a tour.  We tried everything we could, for 45 minutes, including asking a resident who came out if anyone was in the office,  then finally gave up and left. We tried to call the afternoon of 6/9/21 to follow up, and again no answer, full voicemail. Office hours say Tuesday-Friday 9am-6pm, but good luck finding a live person.

I put in a request on apartments.com and toured the apartment in the same week. The agent was really nice and I liked that it wasn't one of other massive k-town complexes, the building seemed more low-key and quiet. The units I toured all felt bright and airy with the high ceilings and large windows. I really liked the kitchen - warm cabinetry with white countertop and bright under-cabinet lighting. I ended up moving in and everything has been great! The specials were very generous and I got the unit I wanted with the views :) The building is in a great location right next to 6th street, I can walk to a lot of the usually crowded plazas with no parking!!

Very warm welcoming and exquisite. From the moment I viewed the apartment I immediately signed on! Thanks for being such an amazing property loving the foundation for sure and the amazing neighbors! The rooftop though only by God!
Thinnest walls you can think of, since moving here I had only a few full nights of sleep.

I've been here at Villa Vicente for 2 years now and have really enjoyed living here. The neighborhood is quiet, and haven't had any issues with neighbors being loud. Everything is clean and well taken care of. 

The apartment is the perfect size and the upgrades they made prior to moving in really make the space seem bigger and more modern than non-renovated units. I'm glad I chose this one. My only gripe being not enough places within short walking distance, but so much is still a short distance away.

Dishonest business practices and a lack of responsiveness & accountability. Villa Vicente is an unsafe community. The trees at the property are dangerous and the community refuses to do anything about it. The management office is unresponsive and unreliable. Do not do business with this management company. I have reached out to the corporate office and I have yet to receive a response. Do not lease an apartment at this shady business

I lived at Villa Vicente for 3 years. There was unfortunately constant plumbing issues, specifically with the toilet. Towards the end, I felt very unsanitary in my own apartment. Also, my upstairs neighbors were very loud at night - but whenever I called security, they said they were unable to do anything about it. This is a fine apartment complex if you really need to move out of your current situ and need something temp or for a year, but I wouldn't really recommend this complex for long-term living. The front office people are very nice, and the laundry facilities are clean and nice, so there's definitely ups to this place!

I have lived in my current apartment for 3  years now,  I have never had any major issues that didn't go unnoticed. Since there are a lot of trees throughout the complex, there are also a lot of spiders, squirrels and birds. There is a gym also that is always clean and readily available. I have horrible cell phone reception and unfortunately you can only have one cable provider because of the landscape but I have to say, because of the price and location you really cant beat what Villa Vicente offers.

We have been here 6 months and so far so good. They moved us in right away, last minute. The grounds are beautiful, lots of greenery and trees. It is always well maintained and groomed. Once you walk in, you're in a different world. The pool is large and always heated.  Although small, the gym is open 24 hours. Also, there are grills available for all to use. This location is central to everything. It takes about 20 min max to get anywhere you need to go. The staff is very friendly and eager to help. This building/location has everything you will need and are looking for at a decent price. The only downside is the lack of friendly neighbors. There are many people here, but only few that are friendly enough to say hello when you pass by. Also, areas like the pool and gym can feel a bit crowded at times. I would recommend anyone to this location.

I LOVE K2LA! We've lived here for almost a year and I can truly say this is one of the best places in Koreatown! Not only are there AMAZING views from our rooftop and awesome amenities, but the customer service here is incredible. Megan in the Leasing office is so helpful and nice! She definitely makes living here feel so welcoming. This location is also in an area where there is food, bars, clubs, venues, and museums all within a 10-20 mile radius! We absolutely would recommend these apartments to our friends and family!

I’ve been living here for a year now, every worker here is so friendly and helpful, security guards are available 24/7 the whole building is always very clean and peaceful. Very safe place they don’t let anybody in without calling you first to make sure you’re waiting for them.

There are many complaints with this property. I highly suggest you look at another property. Poor management and disorganization. It's dirty here. Management doesn't know how to do their job. It's not a safe place to live.

I moved from orange county due to my job. i dreaded it because i hate k-town and just la in general.  But after 1 week of moving here, K-town isn't so bad after all.  There's a rooftop lounge area with an amazing view.  At first when they took me to the roof, all i saw was A/C units.  I was like what? But then you walk around into a lounging paradise.  Washer/Dryer in the unit makes me feel like a baller.  Boba Time and Korean BBQ right around the corner.  The building is clean right down to the garage and even the trash area.  The apartments are the nicest i've ever been, but what stands out is the staff.  Erica, Christine, Michaela, Monica, and my security homies are some of the best people.  Friendly, informative, professional, and fun.  The amenities are great and all that are great, but the staff makes me miss home every minute I'm away.  Come live here, but you gotta be cool.  :)

I have lived in K2 for a year now and its been great!

1) Staff is awesome - sure they have changed a few staff members since I first moved in but the news ones are super accommodating!  Christine and Erica are very helpful and will resolve any issues that arise.

2) Hosted get to know your neighbors happy hours / Events - 4-5 times since moving in we have had events for the tenants.

3) Electricity bill is soooo low - I run my a/c 24/7 - I am used to paying $90-$130/month in the summer for my a/c bill. Our bill has not been over $20 since moving in....what! They told me it would be low before I moved in but it is unbelievably low.

4) Location - Koreatown is awesome and safe. Alot of bars and korean bbqs are local and you can walk to them without having to uber everywhere.  

5) The amenities - the pool, gym, lounge areas, bbqs are all luxury.

Berkshire K2LA is great living.  The new management team Christine, Erica, and Michaela are always happy and willing to help.  I'm so thankful for choosing this community over the others.  Customer Service is key.

I had to give the leasing agent 5 stars because he was super helpful, kind, and patient with me. I saw many apartments and met with many different leasing agents but he was the Top Tier. I first saw the apartment yesterday, he showed me the place and honestly it was fantastic. He kindly gave me all the information I needed and showed me all of the amenities/building thoroughly so I would not miss anything. I was very impressed and asked for the application right away. Throughout the application process, he explained everything that I needed and assisted me every step. I really want to give a shoutout to the leasing agent and also to The Thompson. I am looking forward to living here! Very excited.

The management team confirmed that I was scheduled to tour the apartments, but when the date arrived, they said that no tour was scheduled. They were also not transparent at all about the move-in specials that they advertised here. I agree with other reviewers here, they are incompetent. Look elsewhere

The room is good for the price. However, the management team is the worst that I have ever met. The elevators are constantly broken. There were issues with water, electricity, and internet in the building. I remember we had no internet for one week and no hot water for three straight days. We emailed the manager, Joanne, for help and received a reply after two days saying sorry. The utility fixing schedule is also a nightmare. You have to choose a time that fits their time the best for any issue, otherwise, you may end up waiting for weeks for some emergency issue.

Deceptive management, dog pee stains, smelly garbage in the hallways, incredibly loud street noise and internal building noise, outrageously high rent increases, bottom of the barrel appliances that break often. Look elsewhere.

I have been trying to schedule an appointment since EARLY JUNE but I was always being redirected to this third party text center that gives me dates that are 4 weeks away - Okay, that's fine it's understandable that they may be busy and booked up. BUT EVEN WITH THIS DATE BEING 4 WEEKS AWAY, THE LEASING AGENT HAS been CANCELLING my appointments when the date got closer and asked to reschedule 4 TIMES and it is IMPOSSIBLE - and when I say impossible, TRUST me, it'd be easier to solve climate change at this rate - to contact them. Whenever I call the leasing office directly, they kept forwarding me to their voicemail, leaving me uncertain if the leasing agent is even going to show up at my tour appointment. If they are this bad at communicating with their prospective tenants, IMAGINE how bad they are communicating with their current tenants. AND GUESS WHAT, I showed up to my appointment today and the leasing agent WAS A NO SHOW - they didn't even have the decency to TEXT ME OR let me know that they weren't able to show me around. THEY JUST GHOSTED ME - WHAT KIND OF PROFESSIONALISM IS THIS? I waited for 30 minutes outside the building, kept trying to call them but NO LUCK - no one picked up; not a single reply to my messages; I took out time of MY BUSY schedule to make it to this appointment because I was genuinely interested - guess what, you lost a good prospective tenant. THIS TEAM HAS NO SENSE OF PROFESSIONALISM WHATSOEVER - if they can't even respect the time of prospective clients OR HAVE THE DECENCY to reply.  NOT WORTH THE STAY. everyone please PLEASE AVOID THIS building and avoid this MANAGMEENT.
Worst management ever since they first opened in 8/2019. Even after a switch in management, no improvement. DO NOT LIVE HERE. More details to come.

The building is gorgeous and I love how they kept some of the old office building memorabilia and incorporated it in the new modern design. Management are super helpful and I've personally had no issues getting in contact with them. They have been nothing but professional and punctual when getting back to me. This place is just a real gem in the heart of Koreatown.

We moved into the Thompson on the first day it opened (august 1st) after many months of delays but we were really happy it finally opened! My apartment is beautiful, very big windows and tall ceilings. You can barely hear any of your neighbors since the walls/floors are so thick (it used to be an office building.) Maintenance does not take long, We needed our sink fixed and it only took a day or 2. All payments are through an app which is really convenient. 24/7 security. Everyone else who lives here seems really nice and i’ve never had a problem with anyone. The lobby and elevators are gorgeous and there’s also a great view of the whole city from the roof. I can see the Hollywood sign from my apartment too ! Love living here

I went in for a viewing this past week at The Thompson, and thought it was very informative. Better than some of the other places i have visited for rent! the management (bryan) was really thorough and answered all my questions that i had. What i liked best was the location of the Thompson and how modern and updated it was. The area it was in seemed really safe as well, which was my main concern and the security seemed really nice and attentive there. Also, since i will be living there by myself, i thought the space was perfect and manageable for a single person home. Overall, i really liked my experience at my showing! highly recommend this apartment :)

We were one of the few tenants who first moved-in at Thompson when they finally opened after months and months of delays. Disappointingly, the building is still unfinished up to now! Exterior windows in the entire building are DIRTY!  The concrete columns outside the building are full of paint patchwork looking like graffiti! It looks like we live in an old abandoned building. See the building for yourself and you will immediately see what I am talking about. Think twice before signing a lease at Thompson!

BE AWARE!! 

I planned to move in to this apartment in late May, did a tour of the unit, submitted my application, paid the deposit, and so on. With the move-in date being delayed for months, I had to find another complex to move into and now I cannot reach the management to request for my refund. I have sent in a request through their leasing office email, but no response or actions taken for three weeks now. All the numbers related to this complex go straight to their company call center, and the call center doesn’t even know how to reach the management besides via email. I’m sure I am not the only one in this situation.

This apartment complex has an extremely loud industrial size air condition unit directly outside of residents windows. It produces noise levels over city regulations, multiple times EVERYDAY. I constantly hear neighbors breaking down and screaming because the noise can be so overbearing at times. If you prefer the ability to hear yourself think I would not recommend living here.

I leased an apartment in the building, and I can say that, yes, communication has been bad. They were originally targeting a late April move-in date, then May, then June 1, June 15, and now (I wish I could say finally)—July 15, it seems. I understand that the delays themselves are more up to the city and departments, but I would expect the management to be upfront and proactive in letting me know about the delays. Instead I have had to chase them for information. In the time being, I've moved my furniture in.

I scheduled a viewing of the building and the management didn't even show up. The building isn't finished being built as the entire lobby was still under construction. I ran into some tenants trying to move in and they told me they've been having the worst time communicating with the management and the building had not yet passed fire inspection. I felt so bad for the security woman who had to deal with all this confusion and the ineptitude of the management.

trash all over halls, construction constantly, alarms go off often, hidden fees, and a community manage who does not care about tenants. she is not just disintersted ... but rude /and dishonest. unless you are prospect.  do not sign a lease. you will get screwed.

The place is nice from outside, that is it. That is even questionable. They do construction work here with out permits on distribution electrical. Dangerous and irresponsible to tenants. I moved in and 3 weeks later started un-permitted  construction to fix a major electrical problem. They hired a company that showed up everyday for three weeks to jackhammer. They basically showed up to work with forks and knives to do this work. They said that demo was only going to take 3 days not 3 weeks. Still to this day they have not repaired the electrical system. Construction fence is still there and they got shut down from the City of Los Angeles for not having a permit.  They never informed me of construction prior to lease therefor taking my choice away from renting a property that was not under construction. Then the property manager name Chase said he would let me out of my lease but not pay relocation and moving expense. This is the kind of treatment you will receive here. Like I said Buyer Beware!
Should have heeded the negative reviews. Moved out as soon as we moved in.

Without a doubt would never live here again. There’s no way to emergency maintenance or security, no phone number to call that connects you to your landlord. Their emergency lines hang up on you before you can leave a message. Palazzo incorrectly installed our stove during a routine repair and had gas pumping into the house for over a day, when we noticed the smell ended up having to call SoCal Gas since no one here would pick up. People that live here will constantly park in your assigned spot despite the ludicrous price tag to live and park at the Palazzo West, nothing will be done about it, there is no one to reach out to. For a place that’s this expensive to live in, Palazzo West deliver garbage quality if they deliver at all.
No comments provided.
No comments provided.
Solid spot, it has all the amenities you need for a decent price.

This apartment is great the staff is amazing Toni the manager is so helpful since we have tour until we moved in.The location is closer to my family need like the grocery store is just walking distance the public transportation is accessible.

The location is good, the price and amenities are great, but the staff is a bit slow to respond. Overall, I've had a solid experience and would recommend this place for someone looking to get a solid bang for their buck.
great location, good facility and even better management.
I've had a very positive experience living here, and staff/management is wonderful.
Plaza at Lafayette exceeded my expectations. A great apartment with quick responses to maintenance requests and fully functional appliances/living spaces. I would recommend.
Overall a great experience. If I ever have any issues, maintenance is here right away.

I have lived this apartment for 11years. Every time we were thinking to find new place, there were no apartment we can enjoy to live like here. I love this community and all the neighbors. Building is so clean and modern also the management service is great.

The building manager is nice, but that doesn't nearly make up for the run down nature of the apartemnts, the incompetent maintenance staff, and the fact that when you move in you are moving into an un-maintained and filthy apartment that was barely touched since the last residents moved out.

This place is truly disgusting to move into, and I wouldn't suggest it to anybody since other options exist.
This is clean, comfort and friendly place to live. Not too many units makes the building safe and friendly.

I rarely write reviews, but this one is a must. I am moving from NY to LA and scouting apartments for the second time. A few month ago I visited Plaza at Lafayette. I was impressed, but not ready to move. I recently returned and went back to the apartment for a pleasant surprise. There were so many upgrades. Parking, safety, pricing, upgrades, and efficient customer service are all important to me, including all the authentic LA eatery suggestions the manager provided, she was very pleasant. 5 stars. I can't wait to move.

This property has such a clean, open feel when you walk in. The common areas are all very aesthetically pleasing. With a fire pit as well as a grill, its nice to be able to step outside of your apartment and still be in a comfortable space. The manager, Terri, has been so nice, informative and GREAT when it comes to communication. Her attention to detail and super kind disposition makes the community so inviting. It also has parking which is a MUST in this area. 5 STARS for sure!

Plaza at Lafayette seems like a great community.with a pleasant staff.  I mistakenly came to the property searching for a 1 bedroom unit but I actually had an appointment next door. The manager was very helpful. Although there were no available  1 bedroom units for my immediate move in date, she informed me of a sister property that may have units in my price range. Very helpful!
Teri is very hopeful and took care of all my concerns/requests that was required by maintenance in a timely fashion. Excellent customer service.

-Laundry machines only work about 20% of the time. 
-They do a terrible job prioritizing maintenance around the complex.
- There’s exposed live wires in one of the parking garages. 
-building manager attempted to leave us without a door handle on our front door for a full day, and at that point we just went ahead and purchased and installed our own door handle and lock since our safety was only a concern to ourselves and not building management.
-attempted to change the terms of our lease IN THE MIDDLE OF THE LEASE.

Overall I’d advise you to avoid it, or be prepared to have an attorney on call.

The apartment is clean, spacious and well maintained. It is in a great location, the middle of downtown LA. Everything you need is just a few blocks away. You will never get bored with constant events happening almost every week. Clubs and restaurants are just a crosswalk away. On the other hand, it gets crowded and the traffic gets very bad. Parking is also a pain as it is not a part of your rent. You have to pay another extra 150  a month.

This apartment is pretty well located. It is easy to get most everywhere including lots of interesting places on Hollywood Blvd. The price has been fairly reasonable until recently. We just got a notice on our door saying the rent is going up from $1600 to $1900. That's why we're moving out. 
The new price actually puts these apartments in a similar bracket with Hollywood area apartments. The downside to these apartments is that they are not always well maintained. Up until a few months our elevator was out of service. It was out for seven about six or seven months. During this time, I was using crutches and it was rough going. 
The railing on the back steps was painted a couple months ago, which was nice, but the neon green painters tape is still attached to the wall. The floors in the hallway are never cleaned, but painted over every couple of years or so. A new "fitness room" has been added and has recently opened, but so far there is just a single treadmill in it.
The door to the parking garage has been jimmied open since I've lived here. About 3 years. Consequently, my car was broken into last night. There are often transients in out garage doing suspicious things and our mail has also been tampered with. 
I don't want to make this place sound worse than it is. I have mostly enjoyed living here, but if the rent is going up, we haven't been seeing any of the benefits to cleanliness or safety. Hope this helps
The apartments are as up to date on the exterior, yet the interior is updated and well unkept. Maintenance request don't really take that long and a good price for the area.

Seriously reconsider if you're considering living here

1- They have serious plumbing issues. I had to live without hot water for three days and they didn't even inform me about the issue until I asked

2- They charged me a move out fee of over $1200 for a non-existent crack in the microwave and the fridge. I had photo evidence but they're unwilling to adjust the fees.

3- The leasing office is here a joke. They lose lease agreements, don't respond to emails until things are made public. I had to follow up for 2 months to get my referral bonus and over 3 months to get ahold of someone for smoking issues.

DO NOT RENT HERE. I have never lived a more unsanitary situation, or dealt with more neglectful management. I have lived in Wren for 4 months and my laundry has been broken for the entirety of that time, so that I maintenance has to constantly visit my apartment with industrial vacuum cleaners and suck water out of the broken machines. They replace the old, broken machine with other old, broken machines that inevitably fail with the same issue, despite pleading with management to test the appliances prior to installation.

In the last month, the water/plumbing has also repeated failed.
The water in my apartment has either been shut off entirely,  or running frigid cold without access to heat, or, in the case of this last week, the water running out of the faucet is completely black or dark grey. We could not shower, flush toilets, bath, or drink this water.

Despite laundry and water being paramount concerns, 99% of my emails, phone calls, or voicemails to the management begging for a remedy go unanswered, with shocking excuses including "I don't check my work email."

Despite having an exhaustive collection of well-documented witnesses and undeniably videos evidencing the black water and broken laundry, management's response has been to say that they don't think there is a problem because their own personal apartments are fine, which is as illogical as it sounds.

While I do want to acknowledge that there are individual leasing and maintenance staff such as Letty and Helena who are very lovely people and very decent to work with, the property management is without a doubt the most shockingly unprofessional, neglectful, incompetent, and gaslighting management I have ever encountered.

I cannot recommend against renting here strongly enough.
The walls are too thin, the noise comes through the wall / ceiling.
It feels quiet in the busy city community. Clean and cozy.

To potential renters be advised that the internet here is unreliable. There is no choice but to get AT&T. Most of my neighbors have complained about their internet cutting out or being extremely slow.  One neighbor apparently didn’t get internet for weeks. The same goes for the common area WiFi. We are rarely able to connect to it. Any time these issues are brought up we get the run around from management.

Being at Next on Sixth, you can walk to restaurants without paying valet or spending time finding street parking and good walking distance to stores (nearest H Mart, Walgreens). On top of that, there is target below but does not carry a lot compared to bigger targets. They also got your Starbies (no order ahead option unfortunately). This apartment is overall good from my experience thus far. Security, your concierge is friendly, helpful, and addresses your calls on any concerns; for example, homeless entered in and he shoo shoo them away. He makes his rounds and makes sure residents are warned several minutes before 10 that the pool/jacuzzi is closing. The only 2 negative things I have is (1) they don’t have storage closet.. unless it’s just mines? But no storage closet except for regular walk-in closet. (2) hallway carpets have stains. Hopefully they’ll deep clean one day or replace. Other positive remarks: nice open airy gym, amenities are good, hangout areas, secured package lockers, fob key to get you up and down the elevator so you don’t have non-residents trying to come up except if you got ubereats then security will allow, dog lawn to pee/poo (can be smelly), reserved parking, and much more but this comment has been lengthy.

From advantages - there are nice common areas in the building but they all close at 10 pm.
The renewal terms were overpriced to me as for current resident although the market rates advertised on the website were much lower. No way to negotiate a lower price. The management doesn’t care.
There is no assigned parking. The trash and water are not included in the rent price.
The additional fees include mandatory internet of $85 a month, parking depends, around $75-$150 a month, utilities around $100-200 a month.
No sun in the pool.
Cold pool.
No safety in the building.
Also the neighbourhood is not safe.
The assigned public schools are very bad.
I don’t recommend this building.

I moved in right before equity took over. I was paying for a luxury experience, however with new management.. there were major security staff cuts and amenities taken away. I’m still paying the rent price of a luxury apt complex. New listings for my same unit is much lower... terrible way of doing business.

I recently moved to LA all the way from East coast and I was so scared at first but when I found out about this place through a mutual friend online while I was searching for a place to stay and it was very affordable to live there too! I was surprised which it's a great location as well! 

I also got the chance to meet the new manager who runs this place at the very beginning of time and he is a very great person who always there for every resident and constantly taking care of things 24/7. I was also surprised to learn the fact that he had to wake up at 2 am and quickly responded to an emergency from someone who lived there then took care of it immediately. I even learned how much improvements this place has gotten over time and the outside environment is very relaxing too. This whole area was nothing to compare from before since there was no pool or beautiful garden or such until the new manager changed everything! 

It is true that he has strict rules which it makes perfect sense because there are a lot of college students who wouldn't care so they don't mind for breaking every rule and can possibly cause a lot of damages. If they did break a lot of rules, it would disturb the whole area and other residents who are trying to live comfortable and being happy to live in the same area so I completely respect the rules while I live there too. 

I would strongly recommend for this place if you definitely want to live in the most comfortable, stress-free and great environment while being respectful for your own privacy and others. It is also in a great location RIGHT next to DTLA, USC, Koreantown, and Expo Blue Line metro station all the way to Santa Monica!

I’ve been here for a few years and have seen the building manager change. I’ve never had a bad experience with either manager but will say that the new building manager has definitely been making improvements to the building. It’s cleaner, there’s FINALLY a camera in the lobby and a package room (no more stolen packages). Very responsive and friendly. Maintenance is also very responsive, but if you have an emergency request after hours be prepared to wait a while as there is no one on property after hours. 

The rent is cheap for the area so you get what you pay for, it’s an older building so don’t move in expecting perfection.

The staff is horrible. The place has giant roaches and i still have damage to my body from the elevator being down . Staff will harass you . Never any parking . The owners of the building are even more incompetent then the terrible manipulative unprofessional people they hire . Don’t bother

I really enjoyed living at Franklin plaza! 
The apartments were nice and have w/d in unit, which is hard to find. There’s a small gym, pool, hot tub, bbq, and awesome neighbors! But what I really appreciated the most was the AMAZING manager, Nikki. She was really the best and was on top of everything, super pleasant, and always took care any of my requests. I only moved because I needed a 2 bedroom, but I would definitely live here again if my situation were to change. Thank you so much Nikki and Franklin Plaza, I really enjoyed my time there!

Moved in here sight unseen from across the country and really enjoyed my time at Franklin Plaza. The building is well taken care of and the pool and grill are nice amenities. The units have nice finishes for the price you pay and the laundry and central ac are really nice as well. The building is well sound proofed and quiet. Only interacted with management upon move in and out so no big issues there.  No major complaints about this building other than the elevator is seriously so slow. Getting from my car to my unit was always time consuming.

You'll regret it.  A complete nightmare of a place. Meth heads and people with mental issues roaming the building.  Not safe at all.  The management is the worst as well. Not clean.  Trash chutes never work.  Break-in constantly.

While this property is in a great location, there are several issues. One, theft is high. I have had numerous packages stolen. My car was also broken into (my window was shattered) while in the garage.    The mailboxes have also been broken into. Two, laundry machines are ALWAYS broken and take a while to be fixed. Also, the laundry card reload machine is in the office which is not always open so that has been a problem. Finally, I had some issues with the kitchen stove when I moved in and it was extremely difficult to get them resolved even with a red tag warning from the gas company. The issue was escalated to Triumph Management and the manager I spoke with was EXTREMELY rude. Overall, I do not recommend this property.

This apartment community is quiet, for the most part. There is an on-site manager, however her hours are difficult if you have a 9-5 job as she is not in the office or accessible outside of the hours of 8-5. There are laundry rooms on each floor, but to put money on your laundry card you need to utilize the machine which is in the manager' office. If you want to do laundry on the weekend, but you have run out of money on your card, you are out of luck! This can get annoying after awhile. However, if you need a maintenance issue fixed they are generally pretty quick to repair it. We have had some issues with noisy neighbors, but generally the community is a quiet place to live. The location can't be beat, it is so close to everything.

This apartment is in a wonderful location right at the bottom of the beautiful hollywood hills, literally minutes from the entrance of Runyon Canyon. It is a quiet building with a friendly and hardworking manager, Debbie. I live in a studio and the kitchen is small but still totally fine for one person and two if you're really close:). I highly reccomend this apartment if you're looking in the Los Angeles area!

For starters this whole profile is lying to you. There are NO amenities, and they will tell you that these will be ready in a couple of months but they have been in construction since 2018. Elevators stop working every couple of months, same with the parking gates so anyone can walk in, we've had break-ins on cars. Any package you receive will be left in the mail room where anyone can steal it, including meal prep boxes were the food can go rotten. Fire alarms don’t work and go off at 2am. Fob system fails to work so anyone can enter the buildings. Management is irresponsible and unresponsive, uncaring and unwilling to work on behalf of the tenants.

The worst of the worst. I lived here for 4 years and would not recommend this property to anyone. I loved my apartment, but management made it unbearable to live there. Fire alarms would go off all times of the day and night. Management has zero compassion about residents.

Worst place I’ve ever lived. The other reviews were written three years ago...there has been a BIG change and decline in customer service and conditions since beekshire communities bought and took over this building in 2018. As of late, the elevator has been broken for three weeks. Management staff is impossible to communicate with. At one santa fe, THE TENANT is the last on the totem pole and always wrong. Stay away.

I have called One Santa Fe 3 separate times throughout the month for a tour because we were very interested in moving in and they keep saying they will call me back and still have not heard from them. Very unprofessional.

The location is great.  The amenities are great; love the mailing system. Maintenance is great and the staff is receptive to our needs. Most of the current neighbors are friendly, which is better than the other apartments in LA. The only thing I do not like is that you only get one parking space.  Overall, I have to give AVA Little Tokyo five stars!

It has been a wonderful experience from the first moment my boyfriend and I stepped into the leasing office One Santa Fe. The office staff, including maintenance, have been nothing but gracious, professional, quick to respond, and even make us laugh. We love the open hallways, which allows the flow of fresh air into the community. The double gates requiring your personal key scanner is a plus, making leaving our cars in the garage feel more secure. The restaurants (ediBOL, Cafe Gratitude)that have opened under living spaces have been delicious with great service. We are looking forward to the organic market "GROW"  to open and all the other businesses anticipated to become available. The community is a walk away from many different events, attractions, public transit, and venues. We never have to drive on the weekends because we can just walk to many places such as Little Tokyo, Pie Hole, or a Metro train ride away to downtown LA, Korean Town, China Town, and Hollywood. We have lived in many different cities and communities but One Santa Fe by far has the nicest neighbors. Everyone says hello, thank you, you're welcome. We actually have conversations with our neighbors! People hold the doors and elevators for each other, and the dogs are friendly  with together. We highly recommend One Santa Fe as your next living community. You are not just another tenant here. You are an actual community!
The Staff is very professional, helpful, attentive, respectful and friendly.  Abgar and Patty do follow up and do an excellent job.  Jonathan and Vanessa are super nice and make you feel welcome.

THIS PLACE IS THE WORST!

Management is terrible. Daun is the worst manager I've ever had to deal with in my life. She's very rude and unresponsive. I can also see why this is rated one of the "Best Places to Work". If I could sit at my desk, listen to music and play Solitaire all day instead of working, I'd rate it the best place to work too. Her manager who works for Alliance Residential is just as bad. Angela, who is the assistant to the manager, is the only one who actually works. She should be manager.

My apartment was damaged from a water leak from another apartment and they had to reconstruct part of my apartment. They offered no re-location even though it clearly says on their contract. Even worse, the manager called my place "livable" when I had 8 industrial grade dehumidifiers in my apartment running and the temperature soared to over 100 degrees in my apartment. The construction workers also left all their equipment and moved my furniture without notice. They stacked random material on my furniture for construction and left my place with wall debris everywhere. I was unable to use my room for about 3 weeks and they offered no compensation. When I asked the manager and Alliance Residential about a rental discount for the month, they told me they would be in touch. I've moved out and they still have not offered any compensation.

I don't normally write reviews but I was compelled to write one because this place is just terrible and it could potentially save another person's life. I'm still receiving emails from their customer service reps about a final payment even though I've gotten a confirmation that they've received it. What a joke.

If you have a lot of time to deal with management and the company, then this is the place for you. Good luck! I also have a bunch of pictures that I documented and hopefully will be able to upload them. This also happened to the floors below me and above me.

City Lights on Fig has exceeded every possible expectation I could have had. Its location right at the intersection of the Convention Center and Staples Center is unbeatable in every way. Parking is extremely affordable, and managed perfectly. I've never heard about a single issue of someone's spot being taken or anything along those lines. The apartments are beautiful as are the common areas like the pool, lounge and dog walk zone. The walls are nice and thick - I've never heard the sounds of my neighbors at all (I've also rarely ever heard the sounds outside from the city streets). Management is the best I've ever dealt with - they are quick to respond to your questions via email, in person or on the phone. Any type of maintenance issue I've had has been addressed and fixed within a day. They're also great about sending out community emails and keeping you posted about things that might be happening at LA Live. Security is top-notch; they're always on-site as soon as the Leasing Office closes and are constantly patrolling every part of the premises. Overall, I would recommend City Lights on Fig in a heartbeat to absolutely anyone. Its location, amenities, staff and beautiful units make this my favorite building in the entire Los Angeles area, by far.

The R2 building is expensive for the area but the area is nice. The issues beyond the expense include an insecure entry to the building via the main gate which remains wide open for whoever to enter the building because the lock gets jammed all the time. Also the packages randomly get strewn outside, sometimes inside the mail room and sometimes by your door. There is no front desk or concierge staff which there should be given the rent. Units that get turned over do so with cheaper floors, locks and light fixtures - you can't ask for high rent and cheapen the building.

R2 has some interesting units, some even are real lofts, and is in a decent neighborhood at least relatively speaking but of late (2023) things have gotten bad:

Plumbing is an issue with old pipes getting blocked and LA HydroJet having to clean out the crap (literally). 

You will hear fire alarms all the time because they are either testing them or they just go off when you or your neighbors cook. And if you are by the pool or gym get ready for splashes, screaming and the pumping iron at any time. They installed a punching bag which is cool but now you can hear wannabe MMA stars screaming and punching it any hour. 

As of 2023 there is a massive construction site across the building - the construction noise is all day every day except Sundays and looks like it will go on for years. It throws up dust and chemicals in the air. 
 
The apartments are kind of arty but they have gotten rid of the real hardwood and replaced them with fake wood.

The rents seem high given the condition of the building and the lack of a concierge staff or front desk. Packages are supposed to be placed in a mail room but often they just get left outside and get stolen.

Maintenance staff is nice but they drag their feet. Even if your work is High Priority or an Emergency they will get to you when they get to you. Not sure if they are overworked or if it is just a callous attitude.

You can't ask for too much from management who may or may not respond to emails and your lease is written in such a manner that your deposit will be worthless and your ability to get into a serious legal argument is neutered. Not that any of that is worth it.

I would say there are better places for the money R2 wants. So look around.

I called to inquire about the available apartments I’ve been watching online and the person over the phone seemed to treat me with a dismissive attitude as if there were 0 units available. Very rude from the start and seemed like he was steering me away from the property. Thanks for that though, will not consider any CLG property.
Avoid at all costs, absolutely terrible management. Not worth the nightmares especially for somewhere you want to live. Avoid this place and R2 at all costs

I used to live here for 6years+ at 3954 ursula ave. It is the worst management ever! You wonder why it is cheap! Because of the management and neighborhood. It takes forever to get then to do maintenance. They have installed cameras everywhere. They are gentrifying the building without considering the tenants that have years living in the same building! The office is 3954 is a joke, and they treated me like if I was below them.

this is a nasty Disgusting place for living the property management never take care issues .. water leaks on the parking lots, fleas, roaches, trash inside and outside the property, cutting water service with out previous notice,

This is the worst apartment complex ive ever lived in. The gates are always broken so anyone can just walk in. They change property managers at least once every year. The manager does not speak english and the property manager doesn't let you speak to her. No one is helpful. There are no parking spaces available anywhere. Never move to this neighborhood. Pay the extra $100 bucks its worth not being harassed every day.
I LIVE HERE FOR 12 YEARS AND I LOVE IT SINCE MY CHILD HOOD NO TROUBLE AND NO PROMBLEMS WITH NOBODY !

They started construction work to improve balconies and replace the roof - the disruption to my apartment was estimated to last 6 weeks but it has been three and a half months and there's no sign of it ending. My balcony and parking space have been out of action this entire time. They are still banging and drilling on my walls every day from 8am to 5pm. I WFH and it has been impossible. Termites. Asbestos. Management don't care. Stay away.
I went to tour the apartment complex and was shocked how old and dirty the place looked. These pictures online are not representative of the complex or the vibe of the place.

This is one of E&S Ring properties, beautiful landscape, 2 beautiful pools! Hot tub and small gym with new equipment! Any and all maintenance is done in a timely manner and the office team are genuinely caring! Thanks LH

This apartment has been amazing and has everything I need. The amenities such as the pool and the gym are fantastic for active people like myself since I can have them readily available whenever I need.

I lived there for a few years and I recently moved out but I miss the community pool parties and the management, it’s by far one of the best tenant experiences I’ve had and I would recommend this complex to anyone
Toured the community this week. Place looks great. Definitely considering this location.

This was the apartment I stayed at when I first moved to LA. Front office staff are very friendly and courteous, and always respond quickly to any questions or concerns, including regarding maintenance. They will hold large packages that you get delivered up at the front office and will notify you, you do not need to worry about someone else taking your package if you aren't at home at the time. The premises are always neatly kept, with hired gardeners and cleaners frequently tidying up the grounds. It is a gated complex, with hired security that patrols at night. 
Although I am here no longer, I greatly enjoyed my stay. I would definitely recommend West Park Village!

The apartment building has a cozy vibe and everyone's respectful. The manager Danny, is one of a kind. He's friendly, professional and truly cares about the tenants. He handles all issues and concerns in a timely manner. Always felt safe and comfortable living here.

This apartment is a good price for what it is. I found it a comfortable place to live despite not having many bells and whistles beyond the pool. The building manager Danny has always been responsive to tenant needs and easy to work with during the leasing process. He was a great building manager to have.

Although the building is slow in it being "up and coming," the one saving grace is Danny, the building manager. Even-tempered, helpful, manages expectations while assisting you in navigating the bureaucracy. It's rare.

While the size and amenities of the apartment are good to have (pool, on site laundry) the management of the complex is absolutely attroticiois. They do not respond to maintenance requests whatsoever and with an older building there are many things that need to be fixed and there's no way to get it done.
I just leased with Kim, she was really amazing 10/10!
Bad management, go to google for reviews and pictures is so ghetto the good reviews here they are fake, no body is happy in that place

I just got a new apartment here and my experience was so good! Mostly because I wanted to save money in rent and live in a 1 bedroom m’and the option I found here has a den I love it! It’s so close to my job and friends and I love the market nearby! Totally recommend it!

I am seriously obsessed my apartment is so spacious and bright they definitely did it right with the windows! Look yes the building is older but has so much charm and it is really well kept! I love to location super prime and the prices are amazing!

I've been living here for about two weeks now and I absolutely love it! I have a one bed room and it's so spacious. I'm in love with my layout. The location is perfect, everything is walking distance and in such a cute part of town. This building has a lot of charm, highly recommend!
Been living in the building for almost a year now and plan to stay for many more! Love the area and the management team.

we lived here for over a year, they didn't return our deposit for the animal, they appropriated this money for themselves, in addition, there is constant construction work on the territory, a lot of noise always in the morning and during the day, poor soundproofing, you will hear every step of your neighbors upstairs, sometimes homeless people came into the building and swam in the pool, security does not monitor

From loud dump trucks early in the morning to wake me up to constant leaf blowers testing my sanity. This place is noise polluted. The walls are so thin that you can hear your neighbors upstairs, downstair, left and right. NOT WORTH THE PRICE!
By far the best apartment complex I've lived in in Los Angeles.

From homeless people making a mess every time the trash bins are out to the dirty pool to loud workers. This is an older complex that charges premium prices for thin walls and poor security in a so called gated community which I use the term loosely. The pool is dirty very often, the gym always has something broken or filthy, it looks rarely cleaned.

This is what nickel-and-diming looks like.  I give them credit for coming up with more creative "fees" to allow them to circumvent the rent control statute in the area.  But every year is a total money grab.  In the meantime, I have had another bike stolen from the parking-structure bike area.  I had a plumbing leak that saturated my carpet (They initially would not replace it until I demanded, they still made me move my own furniture) and the pool has been shut down for months.  We have repeatedly asked for security cameras because of the rampant theft but the request has fallen on deaf ears.  Yikes.  Looking for a new home.

The trees did that all by themselves.  Coming up on one year and wish I had chosen another place to live.  Yes the grounds are beautiful and the pool is nice so that's what they show all potential tenants.  But the property is literally crumbling and the management obviously doesn't care.  A water main broke a few weeks ago and water was off for over 24 hours to the entire complex.  They provided buckets and recommended getting water from the pool to flush the toilets.  The rupture ruined all of the machines in one of the 2 laundry rooms and they have yet to replace them.  The entire complex, 400  units, are now sharing 7 washing machines.  There is no sign of a repair or replacements.  The residents are beginning to get angry and fighting over machines.  There are a bunch of cheesy-looking gas lamps located on the grounds but more than half of them are broken and you can literally smell the gas leaking all over the place.  Why would they not update these malfunctioning and dangerous gas lamps that are leaking?   The "water features" are broken most of the time and collect leaves.  I have had 2 bikes stolen because security is non-existent.  If I were a single woman I would DEFINITELY AVOID.  Not safe.

It's great that people clean in the morning, with leaf blowers, dumpsters being slammed etc..But if you work nights at all, this place I don't think is for you at all. It's very loud, there's roaches in the laundry rooms and were in my apartment. I wouldn't give this place a second shot at all. If they show you around, make sure you check the computer lab, it's pathetic, the computers won't work longer than 4-6 minutes. You cannot print anything because the computer freezes and shuts off. I've tried over the period of 6 months and they never get fixed, ever. It's a joke, the computer lab shouldn't be a factor for you. The pool used to be heated quite warm, but they lowered it a couple degrees and I don't know if they've raised it back up or not. I do not like this place whatsoever, too expensive, too loud and honestly it has bugs!

Ahhh this place is killing the competition.  They got everything from ants, roaches, rats,isis, mosquitoes , beetles, spiders, flies, raccoons , cats, skunks, possums and some unidentified animals that chase you at night.  Other amenities include a one of a kind on site maintenance team.   what separates them from the rest of the world is their ability to be the the loudest in its class.  My daughter learned Spanish from hearing them 9-5 EVERY SINGLE DAY!!.  What else can I say about this place.  They don't offer parking, grounds are not well kept, they got over flowing dumpsters for those who love dumpster diving with the animals.  It sad to watch the leasing office lure another victim everyday so I thought I'd give them a heads up.

The apartment complex has everything you need: gym, laundry, coffee machines, internet cafe, outdoor grills, and a pool that they have heated year round! Very secure and affordable. Located next to a major highway which can take you to downtown LA in about 10 min. Across the highway we have Griffith Park! Plenty of shops and restaurants all walking distance on Los Feliz Blvd. Apartment itself is very spacious and cozy with several amenities included! I love walking around the huge garden they have inside the complex; it makes me feel like I'm truly in a little paradise.

I just moved to Los Angeles from Atlanta, and I've gotta say, definite upgrade. Rancho Los Feliz has been everything I had hoped for and more. My Dad and I came out to LA to look at apartments in early July, and not only was I surprised by most agents' lack of interest in helping us, but almost all of the renting agencies we contacted via phone or email, never responded. It was as if they were actively trying to prevent us from renting their available units. Oh well. 

Now enter Rancho Los Feliz and Lamar (Leasing office staff). Right off the bat, he was extremely friendly and courteous. He gave us a tour of the facilities--from the spectacular private pool, the lounge area, fitness center, media room, the lush grounds, laundry, and parking (That's right, PRIVATE PARKING!). He showed us a great updated studio with stainless steel appliances and granite counter tops. 

After the tour, we told him we'd be looking in some other areas of LA as well, and he went so far as to give us areas we might be interested in and places to consider. Lamar is such a genuinely helpful human being, that he actually was willing to help me find an apartment, even if it wasn't with RFL. Amazing. 

Long story short, and many unsuccessful apartment-viewings later, we head back to Rancho Los Feliz to sign the lease for my studio. I wasn't moving in until August, and they were nice enough to hold the apartment for a few weeks for me so I wouldn't incur extra rent in the meantime. He even threw in the fridge for free for the entire year! I paid for my private parking space, which was incredibly cheap compared to many places, I'd seen, and was on my way to living big in LA....  

Now moved in, I can see the full benefit of living here. The units are separated from the street, so it is quiet, private, and inviting. The interior of the complex is lush with plants, and the maintenance and security staff are incredibly helpful and nice. As for Lamar and the rest of the leasing staff, they're as helpful as ever. Their sincerity wasn't a trick to get me to sign a lease. He asks how my dad is doing. They are literally doing their best to make you happy, and that is above all what makes RFL such an incredible place to live. 

Seriously, live here. You won't regret it. 

P.S. The only drawback I've experienced so far is that there is no gate code to enter to facilities, so if you lose your key, or the leasing office is closed, you have no way of entering the premises.

This is great place for professionals, and families. The neighborhood has grown a lot since I first moved here 3 years ago. If you are an active person, there are lots of bike routes nearby. The complex is also near the bus, which connects to Hollywood and the LA Redline Metro. The staff is always friendly and prompt at fixing anything in your apartment. Although there is no late lock out services, so if you lock yourself out of your apartment you'll need to call a locksmith.
