There are several fun community events throughout the year for you to meet your neighbors. The parking lot is very small, so if you have a large vehicle the parking spots are little tight. I squeeze in and out of my car, once i had to roll down the window to get out. Other than the skunks, parking and no lockout services this is a great place to live.
We are currently in an efficiency apartment.  The surroundings are well kept and the office is very quick to resolve issues.

Rancho Los Feliz is a gem in a city where safe, affordable housing can be difficult to find. The complex is well-maintained with beautiful flowers and decorative ponds. It offers convenient amenities (package pick-up service, heated pool, free wifi in common areas, bbq's, fire pits, computer cafe, free Starbucks coffee in the main office, and a decent-sized gym). The apartments are functional, and the staff is very friendly and responsive. The apartment complex is safe. It is gated, and there is a security employee on the grounds 24/7. Additionally, it is in a trendy part of town, with many restaurants, shops, grocery stores, and parks within walking distance.

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: I enjoyed my tour. It was a guided tour with Larry and Sara . Loved that he was very knowledgeable and was able to show we everything that I needed to see. Great professionalism and energy. Overall it was a great experience. Thank you for being so amazing.

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: Would recommend because maintenance is quick to respond and the building has pleasantly trained personnel.

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: I love the staff, the apartment, and the views. I feel there could be more in way of amenities (roof access or a similar outdoor area access would be great, I know the building has areas like this that aren't accessible).

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: This has been my BEST living experience in the past 10 years of living in Los Angeles.

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: Don't think both elevators have ever worked at the same time since I have been here. The front door only opens from one side to enter the building. The blinds were pretty filthy and in poor shape. (Still waiting for this repair request to be completed)

apartmentName: The Lofts at the Security Building Apartments
review: Please repair the second elevator. There are two but only one seems functional so the wait is anyways protracted.
Renting here was the worst decision of my life. Building was so broken-down that LA imposed a 50% rent reduction on the city from June to December.

I feel like this building is a bit of a pig with lipstick on. Looks pretty decent and they've recently made a number of cosmetic updates. However, it's just to get you to sign a lease. They don't really care about tenants once they've signed. Prime example. My heat went out at the beginning of December. It didn't get fixed until early January. For that whole month my apartment would not get above 61 degrees without the assistance of a space heater. This is well below the habitable standards the state of California holds. When I asked about a potential rent reduction for the major inconvenience I was told it would have to be approved by "upper management." I wasn't provided with any reasoning, but was told that the reduction wasn't approved. I find it hard to believe they think it's acceptable to have a tenant living in substandard conditions while paying the full rent amount. I'll most assuredly be moving out upon the end of my lease.
Classic, LA apt built in the 80's. Nice location...good management.

If I could give a rating of 0 stars, I would have done so. The building's soundproofing is nonexistent, allowing not only the noise from the upper unit to penetrate but also conversations from the adjacent unit and even the sound of the TV from the unit below. It's clear enough to hear exactly what conversations are taking place next door. The management is atrocious. Basic repair requests can be ignored even after submitting them 4-5 times. To get repairs done, you'd have to contact the owner directly rather than going through the management company. I actually reached out to the owner myself.
The property is very well kept. The community Manager Nancy is very helpful and attentive, her turnaround time to get things done is great- as well as her communication.

In the thick of the Financial District lies Pegasus. Built in 1949, this former big oil headquarters and somewhat cold and modern Art Deco 13 story building boasts a plethora of pros; The sun drenched pool, the gorgeous lobby with it's original marble and express elevators, the 12 foot ceilings, and the historical bi-fold windows. Not to mention the people. From the leasing agents to the maintenance workers to the concierge to the parking valets. Courteous and professional. And the location?! Walk in any direction and you've got it all; Eateries, bars, coffee, and groceries. A bit further and you've got LA Live, Staples and Little Tokyo. And of course the 7th Street Metro Station. Days become weeks before you realize you don't miss driving. 

Now the unfortunate side of things. I've been a resident at Pegasus for three years, and each year my rent has increased by 10 to 15%. We're talking an extra $200 per month after your first and second years. The leasing agents will work with you the best they can, but really there's very little room to negotiate. It all goes straight up the ladder to corporate. The publicly traded Equity Residential. 
Guess they need to keep their shareholders happy. I on the other hand do not own stock and will not be renewing my lease for a fourth year. If Downtown was rent controlled I'd never leave! 

If you love this city, crave it's culture and dig it's diversity, then yes, spend a year or two at Pegasus and soak it up like a sponge. Bum urine and all!

I live here because it’s below my means,  but best believe as SOON as I save up the money I want to save I’m OUT OF HERE!

I have been here 9 months now and the staff have been professional, courteous, and they got things done to improve the place. in my opinion, this place is worth your consideration.

When we moved here a few months ago, we were having a hard time finding a place to go but this place was very easy to get into. It took only one week to get approved and they are very family friendly. A lot of kids running around all day but very polite and not bothersome. The price of the tent also includes utilities, so that isn't a worry. All in all I like living here, especially since they maintain everything and fix everything so fast.

very speedy response with maintenance requests,   very nice looking apartment units lived there for 2 years (two lease terms)  with maintenance requests normally 1-3 days.  when AC went out it was next day awesome office people very friendly and great perks for paying your rent early (early bird special)  the grounds are kept up just great place to live

I have lived in the 1Br Trilogy for 2 years, and love it. the layout and renovations are great, the grounds are kept up very well, the management seems to truly care about the property, and the maintenance staff is top tier.

The management is amazing, I believe Virginia the woman who helped me move in has worked here at this apartment for 10+ years! She is great with communication and helps you in anyway once moved in. I really loved how fast the maintenance showed up for smallest or big things that needed fixing right away. Also very kind. The grounds always look kept up l, which was great for my lil pup to run around. With doggy bags around the complex for your convenience. I always recommend people to live here. In fact got a friend from out of state to move in ??.. you will not regret living here. Awesome community with great neighbors.
Great place to live. Good views. Great amenities. Nice pool. Spacious rooms
I love living here. It's clean, well maintained, and very quiet.. well with the exception of my loud children (lol). The office and maintenance staff is always very nice and very helpful.

I highly recommend this complex! The office staff is super friendly and I have had zero issues. The place is kept clean and very taken care of! I absolutely love it here and the neighbors are kind and quiet. Theres two pools and a gym! The apartments are very spacious and the balconys are gorgeous.

Avoid moving to The Tides at all cost. No matter which one around the valley, they are all owned by the same “owners”. These “owners” never take responsibility for their business activities. I’ve been at this property for about two years, and ever since I’ve been here I’ve had little to no complaints. I will say, I am requesting pool furniture or I will not be renewing. Please just get us some good quality furniture for the amenity fee we are burn g charged. Again, these guys are awesome here, and the new community manager, Hannah, she is so sweet and cares so much.

This complex is pretty decent considering the area and the prices. I appreciate how they have different options for different needs. You can’t beat having all the amenities/other bills all included in monthly rent. It’s a spacious campus with many options. Good place for single living and smaller families. Lots of people have lived here for years, which says a lot.

I cannot say enough about how wonderful the office staff is at Sierra Grande.  Patty and Kristi are 2 of the most professional, caring, accommodating leasing agents you will ever find.  They have made relocating my father from Missouri to Arizona as seamless and worry free as possible.  The apartments are clean, affordable and perfect for what we needed.  Thank you doesn't seem adequate to express my gratitude for all the extra assistance they provided.

I want to preface this review by stating that the people in the office were wonderful, especially Patty. There were just too many issues that I could not give this place a decent review. 

My husband and I rented an updated, fully furnished corporate apartment for 2 months. During our time there, we experienced the following issues without resolve:
1. Multiple water outages
2. Daily wireless internet blackouts (provided by apt.)
3. Multiple channels not working for weeks
4. Washer that destroyed my $120 comforter. The property manager said she would follow up with me about replacing it. Naturally, I never heard back. 

In addition, the walls are paper thin. I could literally hear our neighbor snoring. Smoking on the front balcony is allowed and people do it constantly. I was always having to walk through a cloud of smoke to get to my front door. We moved out 2 weeks prior to our lease ending. We could not wait to get out of there.

This property is delightful.  So quiet and absolutely one of the cleanest I think I have ever seen!   The landscaping is always kept fresh looking.  The entire staff is friendly and personable.  Quick to respond to needs or questions;  you feel they really care about this little community here.  Patty is the greatest!
Pierre showed up and fixed everything and didn't have to wait forever.  I'm happy with the service. Overall, I love my apartment and the apartment building.

I don't know which company is managing this complex but they have forgotten to service the pools, letting them dry. Poor property management. People who was managing this complex before they bought it they kept the buildings in very great condition.

When I first moved in I had spoken with a wonderful woman who helped out greatly. The place was nice. Never had a bug issue. HOWEVER, the staff is one of the worst. I never saw the helpful lady again and the people I’ve been seeing have just been awful. Never answer the phone, never want to put in a maintenance request. If you read the paper, it tells you what we offer.” Even though the paper had 6 months on it. Everything else is fine it’s just the staff that’s the worst.
3 months to get a hold of someone to get information that could have easily been posted online...thanks for wasting my time. Based on reviews we'll be looking elsewhere.

Worst place to ever get all the ladies and manager have to be the worst . They dnt care about anything or try to work with u .Roaches everywhere Everything inside the apartments is messed up broken etc

This is not the place you would want to live. The apartments have roaches coming out of the sink and outlets in the walls. When we first moved in they did not clean from previous tenants there were still someone’s prescription drugs in the cabinets. The carpets were not cleaned there were dead/alive roaches in the carpet. There is not a lot of hot water to take a bath/shower even though you have to pay for water. Management also will not do anything if your car has been damaged by soccer players many of cars have smashed windshields if you have to park your car by the field.

When I first moved in, there were some issues that left me questioning if I’d renew .The mail room was a constant source of frustration. Always piled up, the staff didn’t seem to acknowledge residents’ struggles. The small dog park was seldom cleaned to a proficient standard. There were frequent noise complaints due to pool parties with little done to address them. Common areas were left open where heating and air conditioning freely flowed out—a cost that ultimately hit residents’ pockets. When things like the garage door broke or trash valet service missed their rounds, residents would be the last to know, with delayed updates or none. But with new management stepping in under “Preston at Biltmore,” I’ve seen a turnaround. I held off writing this review initially, wondering if this was just a “honeymoon phase”. But months later, their commitment hasn’t wavered, which speaks volumes about their consistency. The team’s welcoming approach has set the tone from day one, largely thanks to Carmen, the property manager, who ensures every resident feels valued and that every concern receives attention. Her leadership keeps the team aligned, and this sense of accountability shows in all interactions. The mail room, previously chaotic, is now efficiently organized, with Carmen (yes, another Carmen!) often going out of her way to assist residents personally. Trevor adds a personal touch with his detailed knowledge of the property and genuine interest in residents’ needs, making inquiries about available units or amenities easy and pleasant. Tyler, too, brings positive energy, proactively addressing concerns, from timely trash valet pickups to seamless communication on any building updates. Together, this team has created a welcoming environment, actively engaging with residents more than just “behind the desk” and visibly improving the community experience. The groundskeepers also deserve recognition for maintaining the property’s appearance. Their efforts adds to the well-kept atmosphere that the new management has worked hard to build. The beautification additions that are going on in and outside of the complex with more in store are a nice touch. I was considering moving since my lease ends mid-November but the positive changes under this new management made my decision easy. I’m definitely renewing. If you’re considering moving here, I’d suggest coming in soon; it feels like every time I check on available units, they’re filling up quickly.

DO NOT LIVE HERE! This property was built poorly, and the management will not fix or keep up the property. Requests for maintenance are ignored or delayed for months. Plumbing is a major issue, and residents have had water heaters leak, flooding, and piping issues. Flooded apartments are common, and there's mold. The rest of the complex is poorly maintained, with dog poop and dirty walkways everywhere. Trash piles up for months, and cars get broken into. Please save yourself the headache and frustration and your health, live somewhere else.

I have lived here for several months, and regret every moment. The complex is poorly managed with little response or remedies for issues. Contacting them is nearly impossible and they will either ignore you, or seriously delay responses.

Dog odors/stains and trash are everywhere and the amenities are constantly broken/closed/empty. They will charge you for every little service and convenience, and then not provide them consistently.

There are far better managed properties in the area. The location is not worth the hassle. This is not a luxury or even a mid-grade complex to command such high prices.
Management is rude and not present! Maintenance  is not a priority! Dirty grounds with only one person that cleans!
The new management team is trash and the apartments aren't worth the price. You'll have to hound them to get something as simple as a lease renewal form sent to you.

I lived on the third floor and my AC went out a few times but they fixed it quickly. AC unit in the attic is bad design. Also, the air quality is very poor. the units are very old and do not get professional HVAC cleanings. location is convenient, some homeless people wander through the surrounding neighborhoods. leasing office staff and maintenance are great. community is good.

Love the dog park, walking here every night thru a beautiful setting that is always clean. The staff is very friendly and helpful. There’s a bbq park like area and it’s turned into my favorite place to relax and I have made several very good friends there too.  I’ve been living here 4 years and I’m staying here until I can buy my own home. Thank u Laserena staff for always being friendly and helpful to me.

The property is beautiful. The office staff is super friendly and remembers names. The maintenance staff works fairly quick. Although  they will try to get out of doing work if a dog is in the house. BUT THE PARKING IS HORRIBLE!! If you have more than one car or even expect to have 1 visitor over DO NOT MOVE HERE! You are expected to park on the back road because of lack of parking. Neighbors are having to rush home to fight over parks just to get to their house. If you only have 1 car and don’t have friends or family this place is great for you. If i has to rate everything outside of parking it would be a 4. But parking so so horrible it deserves a 1. I have had to come home with a car full of groceries and park on the other side of the gate. They will lie like they have added more spaces and all of the reviews are lying but IT IS NOT TRUE! Save yourself a headache and don’t move here. This has been a long year spent here!

We have lived here almost five years now and we love it. The complex is very clean and this is my favorite staff so far! They are so helpful and they really care. We live in the biggest size apartment here and it's perfect because our daughter has enough space and so do we. They have events which we enjoy and anyone that visits me can't believe how beautiful it is here!

Dont not move here! Downstairs neighbor harassed me and family constantly. Office staff was NO help. We ended up having break our lease due to downstairs neighbor. Walls are so paper thin you can hear your neighbors having a simple conversation.

Very rude leasing office staffs. Not sure, why they are treating tenants like thieves  and beggars.

Pest control is very worst (so many roaches in the home and scorpions at lawns). So much marijuana smells in swimming pool.

Apart from rent, too much monthly unwanted charges. Premium trash pickup($30), locker($10), life style fees($70), fiberwave ($70), Cam charges ($70 thru $120).

Good things are - near to target, AMC and Costco. So many lawns for kids to play. Good walking community.

Zero customer service (even check previous reviews), zero communication skills , zero awareness for tenants once you’ve signed away. 
They are rated 2 stars for a reason! Save yourself the headache stay away!

Not a fun experience for me. Poor contractor work. Lots of drug activity. Some incompetent staff members. One transfer to cleaner apartment (bugs/mold). Excessive utility fees every month after base rent($150-$250).

Management has a lot of room for improvement. They ignore emails, you have to chase them down to get their help. Due to their irresponsibility, I'm being charged double for electric despite having an aps account I already pay for. I had to chase down management to get the FOB for the pool/gym, which doesn't work half the time. And management doesn't communicate with each other. If you are wondering if this place has roaches, yes it does.  I scoured my kitchen trying to find where they're coming from I couldn't find any obvious infestation so they must be coming from inside the walls/outside. I'm going to have to spend my own money to make sure everything is sealed so roaches don't come in. Smaller negatives is yes homeless do live behind the dumpsters, they charge cam charges that don't make sense, and they charge electric penalties they themselves caused, and charge a service fee for literally nothing.

Amenities haven’t been available since we moved in- 2 years ago, but the roaches have kept us company. CAM charges keep us from saving to move. They have been doing more maintenance on the property… but I don’t know what using a leaf blower 4-5 times a week on the sidewalks & blowing it into the ground floor patios accomplishes, I do dust more. I hate it here so much.
I never seen this kind of worst customer service any where. If you want to experience unclean community, Rude behavior… this is the right place

I really don't even know where to begin. I've lived in about 30 different locations in my life, and this is by far the worst I have ever experienced. 1. Police raided the complex in the middle of the night on 2 separate occasions. Helicopters with search lights shining into the apartments. 2. My car got broken into. 3. Two people were shot and killed in the building across from mine. 4. Men patrolling the area outside my building with AK47s in the middle of the night. Be prepared to buy a lot of cleaning supplies. 12. I cleaned the place spotless and left it better than i received it, yet they took my entire security deposit. 13. Speed limits are non-existent in the complex. 14. I have never in my life posted a review. I specifically made this account to warn people not to make the same mistake I did.
Great location and the units are nice, but the grounds are disgusting. Trash all on the stairs and poop all on the sidewalks. And it just stays that way. Feels like a biohazard walking around.

The apartments are great and the amenities are nice but it stops there. The walls are so thin that you can hear everything going on with your neighbors. The police patrols atleast once a month and I have seen the police helicopter looking for individuals at the trailer park right next to the complex. The front office is full of incompetent people that do not know how to do their job. They have gone through quite a few community managers in my 1st year here and they won’t address issues brought up to them. They add on so many fees when rent is due that it bumps up the price listed about $300 than what is listed. Save your money and your time and look for apartments elsewhere. Tenants have been moving out at an alarming rate and I know I will definitely not be renewing my lease.

The worst experience ever! I moved in a little over 3 months ago, and for the first 2 months i had no working AC... they moved me into an apartment with AC that worked the day i moved in at that was it! IN THE MIDDLE OF SUMMER.  IN ARIZONA! i spent every day asking when it would be fixed, and was given the run around or " i'm not sure" for 2 months!I also had random people coming into my apartment without my knowledge the whole two months. Also, at one point my own key wouldnt work for the door and i was locked out in the middle of the night. Most likely due to all the extra keys being used to get into my apartment! MANAGEMENT SUCKS! karen is the worst and was not helpful in any way, the only person in management that was good was Javone and he quit.  The apartments are nice, the neighbors are awesome but most are leaving due to horrible experiences and raise in rent price. my rent is more every month witb so many extra fees!  the apartments are not worth the price, they look nice but all the extra fees which ends up being at least another $150 they add on to rent and all the problems with management it make it unbearable to live here. if i had the time or money to break my lease i would! Do not rent here!  i have never left a review, but i felt this was very needed! 0 stars!!!

Went on a tour yesterday and everything looked great and once I saw the price tag was inflated $100 (not a big deal just was advertised on a different price) I really liked the unit so I applied once I applied is once the headache began first I was told something when I was there and the next day everything changes and they have all of these requirements that’s they failed to mention on the tour...and worst of all they have 0 customer service skills it was like talking to a wall once they decided to deny my application for not meeting the requirements I wasn’t informed of and lost $120 and most importantly my time.

My wife company put us up here for a year and I must admit that my initial impression was wrong.  The pig in a fur coat analogy works well here.  I have been listening to the tenants above us for the whole time.  Noise insulation is non existent.  If this actually insulated, man I would hate to hear them through non insulated floors.  This is a dog friendly complex and many of the friendly dog owners refuse to pick up after there animals.
I enjoy walking my dogs but despite the green belts etc,  its the dog poop and trash literally dropped anywhere they seem to feel fit.  Walking out of the building, especially in the heat greets you with the smell of fresh dog poop and pee.  The landscape out side of these entrances or freely littered with trash.  Heck i walked out of my door this morning to see a whole banana peel lying right on the sidewalk.  This is the type of community that lives here.

If you aren’t on the top floor, you are going to wonder if elephants live above you. But after to speaking with other tenants, I can assure you it’s just shoddy construction. Having lived in apartments for most of my life, I’ve never had this much of an issue. Sleeping with white noise on full blast helps but that doesn’t make it any less annoying in the day. 
The other gripe I have is that the maintenance is poor. Security gates not working for months on end be kind of thing. Broken lamp posts, signs and unfinished landscaping go beyond what should be expected at this price point. 
Truly advise you look elsewhere.

I lived at Montreux a year. I would not recommend anyone to live here. Due to staff treatment, the elevators constantly being down, the thin walls and constant noise from upstairs neighbors was enough to make me move. Don’t get me started on the dog smells when coming into the building due to people not cleaning up after their pets as well as the pet garbage can never being emptied regularly. Majority of the times there was little to no one in the office or around to answer the phone if you called. The major issue was when I moved out. I was told “oh you had a pet” we seen it through the black light so we will be charging you to replace the carpet. First of all I never had a pet, I’m allergic and further more my application said I had no pets as well as when you put in a Maintenance request, it ask you do you have any pets. So it is very odd to me if I had a pet wouldn’t maintenance or furthermore the cameras see it? Because it was not listed on my move in sheet that there were issues with the carpet there is nothing they can do. When I moved in the carpet was just vacuumed. You cannot see a prior wet stain that seeped through a carpet unless it had a color so if it isn’t visible how would I have known? Mind you the carpet was not brand new prior to me moving in. The whole situation was very eye opening. It shows you how these corporations do you once you are no longer paying them. They try and nickel and dime you for normal wear and tear on top of that the tones and attitudes from management was ridiculous. I am glad to have moved from this complex. Asset management  group values do not align with the staff and policy’s that happen within the leasing office at Montreux.

Pool heater is once again broken. Luckily elevator actually working tonight. Management forces use of parcel pending but then packages get left out in the open and are frequently stolen. Parking lot security gates don’t work. Rules are stated but not enforced. Management is a joke - not available after hours to handle matters that should have been addressed during regular hours.

Renter's beware. I will not be renewing my lease when the time comes to move out of this apartment. Pool, club and amenities are nice, but it does not make up for the lack of professionalism, incompetence, and disorganization from the leasing office and the overall staff at X Phoenix. The staff in the leasing office misinterpret fair housing regulations in order to force tenants into apartments without choosing their roommates. I ran into an issue with my apartment and was forced to stay somewhere else for several weeks in the interim until a single apartment was ready. Additionally the leasing office staff was rude, refused to work with me and made my move out to Phoenix hell. I do not recommend moving to this complex. I would suggest looking at other apartments in downtown Phoenix before considering here.

Construction feel like it’s 24/7. They start construction sometimes at 1am - 12 pm during week days. The noise is so loud it’s impossible to sleep. The building is poorly managed. New units often have mold and they occasionally open random units to make people do their laundry in. The staff is extremely rude and tends to close off space to allow only select residents in. The Super Bowl weekend was a disaster and the staff closed the pool to host their own private party.

The Good:
Staff is friendly
The gym facilities are top-notch
They work hard to put on a lot of events

The Bad:
You will need to suffer through at least 7 nights of bad sleep per month due to noise.  Every weekend Cresent Ballroom is loud enough that even on the 14th Floor and half a block away, with airpods and a noise machine on I cannot escape the sound.  You will have to deal with this until 2am.  This problem will be even worse for the complex when their Phase 2 is complete and 100 new apartments are immeidately adjacent to Cresent Ballroom.

If it's not Cresent Ballroom it will be construction of their Phase 2 keeping you awake or waking you up at 6am.  The staff tries to give you notice but instead they should be putting you up in a hotel room because it is wild they are allowed to do the overnight construction they perform so close to residences.

Many of the residents are also the type that see no issue with blaring their music so loud that it can be heard several rooms away.

I would love to leave this apartment as soon as possible.  Prior to leasing these noise issues should have been disclosed, they of course know about them.  I would love to give this apartment 5-stars for the things it does well but if I can't get a good nights sleep 25% of the time then it's an obvious 0-star.  Would leave in a heartbeat.

To start off, they make the leasing process incredibly easy. Aside from phone calls or emails, they also communicate with you via text. It almost felt like I was texting one of my best friends for a while. Very quick to respond and work to get me answers when I needed them. The whole process is done electronically as well, so if your schedule is super busy, you don't have to go in person to sign anything. This is also the first community I've been in that doesn't screen based on income either. It's so obnoxious to me to feel like I need to make almost $7 or $8k a month to afford like a $1,400 apartment. I was told I came back as approved with conditions and they had a few options for me to go with and all was fine with me! They were great in following up with me after my lease was signed, and the welcome I got on my move-in day was awesome.

The X Club is incredible. I can definitely tell a lot of thought and effort went into designing the building and the community, and what they strive for is so great because most places I've lived at have a clubhouse or a small little fitness center, but this place feels so much more open. You get free access as a resident to daily fitness classes, you have private conference rooms you can use, they've been doing NFL watch parties on Sundays with different food provided each week, there's a public bar and restaurant coming soon. I could go on but you get the idea lol.

The staff is great. They make you feel incredibly valued, respected, and understood, even when I sometimes get an answer that I don't entirely like I can still tell that they care. You have a free app you use that is your key to the apartment, and you can message the staff through the app, so you don't have to constantly call or email them. The utilities are set up in advance for you so you can save some extra money. I LOVE having an in-unit washer and dryer.

This is definitely not what would be considered your typical apartment community. It's a new product that some people out there may not entirely grasp, which is understandable. That said, if you do have kids, the club is awesome, but it's definitely geared towards a more adult crowd, so I get why it's a kids-free zone. You can still have kids with you in your apartment though. They are also building a new phase of the community, so there's been some construction noise, but granted you're also living downtown, so there's gonna be some noise either way lol.

Overall, would recommend!

This place has so much potential to be great, but right now, it's very messy. I've lived here for 4 months, and this is my honest take.

Pros:
- I've lived in one of the coliving units and have met some great people that way and had some really fun experiences.
- The apartment and amenities are gorgeous -- the units themselves, the coworking space, and gym are all top-notch.
- Convenience. Some have mentioned that the app can be buggy. I personally use the keycard they give us instead of the app, and that works every time.

Cons:
- This is worth disqualifying X Phoenix from your apartment search: They are constructing a new building on the south side of the complex. If you live on the south side of the apartment, you will hear the noise and it is LOUD. Make no mistake -- this renders all the pros null. If you can't get a solid night's sleep, it doesn't matter how great everything else is. They've moved residents to the other side of the building to avoid the noise, but you have to consider what sort of company won't halt construction that interferes with residents' sleep. That should speak volumes -- I'm talking construction noise from 5am - 5:30pm, Monday - Saturday. No joke. They have an extended hours permit for construction, which is for concrete pouring, but they only pour concrete 4 times per month.
- I was expecting the vibe here to be more grown-up and professional. In all, people here can be friendly, but it's a step above a college dorm in terms of the culture. If the vibe here were more mature and less try-hard, it would be absolutely amazing!
- The coworking space is gorgeous, but good luck getting work done here. There are some loud groups that gather down here most days and the entire time they're here. There's nothing wrong with friendly conversation, in fact, it's a great thing! It's part of why I moved here. But this is talking-all-day conversation. Just a generally unprofessional vibe.

Read around, do your research, and make sure you consider the construction noise before you make a decision about moving here. The team here is friendly, but keep in mind that they are not the ones making the decisions -- I feel for them because it seems like their hands are often tied. The team deciding to do construction 12 hours a day, 5 days a week is the one making decisions. That's important to keep in mind when touring.

These people will lie to you to get you to sign a lease. There is NOTHING for dogs like their website says. I moved into an apartment and it was dirty! Crumbs and garbage all in the cabinets. A huge thick film of dust in the air conditioning vent. leftover crusty Tupperware from the last tenant. Absolutely disgusting. The managers are awful.. they could care less if you have issues, that’s if he even emails you back. They rarely clean each floor, only the lobby so everything looks nice upfront. For almost 3k a month I expect a little more. Don’t waste your money and be stuck in a year lease. Sooooo many people hate living here!!

Bungalows at Camelback is a beautiful property. It really feelings like your own little home and the finishes are fantastic. Miranda made the leasing process so smooth, she was always in contact with and made me feel so welcome upon move in. The entire team is caring and so helpful!!

We’ve been here over a year and love living here! Apartments are clean and great, many have only had one or no previous renters as it is relatively new. No bug problems (which is a plus downtown). Great walkability to restaurants around the corner. Street noise bounces between buildings but not bad. I’d recommend living here!

The apartments are beautiful, but the service here is the worst I have ever experienced. They don’t respond to all emails, it’s taken 2 days past our move in date before we got access to the app portal, and they either straight out lied to our face, or their staff is not well informed. We would have gone somewhere else if we knew the pool wasn’t heated year round. We were told multiple times, AS A SELLING POINT, that they don’t have a jacuzzi because the pool is heated all year @ 84°. May be writing to corporate in how disappointed I have been since we locked in the lease price.
We love it here! The community is well kept and the maintenance staff is excellent with addressing any issues that may arise. We have been very happy with our choice of residence!

This apartment has a peaceful environment, and the gym is clean and well-equipped.
The staff and management are very dedicated and promptly address any issues we encounter.
Great place to rent so far. Love the security and community. Very quiet. Nice gym. Has dog wash! Always wanted to live in apartments with a dog wash

It’s a really clean environment, love all the amenities! would definitely reccomend !! All neighbors are friendly and follow all apartments guidelines. love the two car garage it really comes in handy !

Stay away from the first building on the right if you choose to move here.  There are 2 very aggressive barking dogs that attack at anyone walking by.  There will be no relaxing while the owner lets them out on the patio every day.  Too bad.

The Beverly is our first apartment living experience; we have always been home owners.  It has been great: the complex, amenities, parking, community and views are wonderful.  The Beverly is just beautiful.  We looked at several apartment complexes and we are very happy with our choice of The Beverly. My husband and I have drove past this apartment building everyday on our way to work for over a year and we always talked about wanting to live at The Adeline apartments.  Last winter we took the leap and rented an apartment here. Our experience here has not been all bad but this complex definitely has its rough spots. The apartments themselves are really quiet and you very rarely hear your neighbors. To start our experience here it took us a few weeks to get our parking passes. Though we could use the valet parking to park our cars; that meant we had to be home before 11PM. The parking garage is also shared with Bank of America and public parking so you have to plan coming home and leaving depending on what is going on across the street. You also have to watch out for BofA employees speeding through the parking in the mornings. The complex is dog friendly and they have a dog park on the 11th floor; on the weekends it gets so bad with dog poop left everywhere that the area is almost unusable. Though the complex has recently changed management and they are working on improving things the elevators are another really rough spot. They have quit working multiple time and are constantly under maintenance and we have gone down to one elevator if any at all. Being on a double digit floor we definitely have gotten our steps in going up/down the stairs instead of waiting almost 15 minutes for an elevator.  Though the views are really nice higher up in the building; if you are planning on living here I highly recommend getting an apartment on the lowest floor possible. The last point I will make is though they charge a rather high “lifestyle” fee to start it was completely worth it because our guests had free valet parking; which is great being right downtown. They have recently taken that perk away. We are left with 10 spots that our guests might get access to depending if there is a game/ concert happening across the street. We can only request 1 guest parking pass per 24 hours and there is a time limit on that pass before you or your guests need to start paying. The front office team is in a tough spot just taking over the building a few months ago.  They have always been super friendly and have helped as much as they possibly can. I wish I could be leaving a better review.

One of the advertised perks of living here, for which we pay an amenities fee, is the complimentary guest valet. They’ve taken that away without any notice or compensation. Additionally, the electric charging stations have been broken for over three months, which is unacceptable.

The main floors have carpet that is often not vacuumed and is soiled and smelly. We recently experienced a power outage that lasted almost 24 hours in the middle of summer. Lastly, the front desk staff are amateurs and clueless. If you need help, don’t bother asking them.

Renter beware.  

The other review is also correct as this was a nice place to live three years ago when I moved in, but that is no longer the case.

I've lived here for almost a year now, and it's been a great place.  

Noise:
The walls separating the units are block and the floor is concrete, and such there's very little, if any noise from your neighbors.  When I moved in they were still remodeling the units and heard a little noise when they were remodeling the kitchens of the adjacent units.  The only noise you'll hear is from the front of the unit, which is floor to ceiling windows facing the pool, nice view and not at all loud.

Build Quality:
I was the first person to live in my unit after the remodel.  They did a great job.  It looks like is should be in a swanky Scottsdale neighborhood.  The accent colors on the exterior complex are a great mix of slate grey and a mint green and look great against the off white background.  Inside, you'll find large, long grey tile in a brick pattern, very high ceilings to the loft master bedroom, which is great because it shares the light from the front windows while maintaining privacy.  The kitchen has newer appliances, cabinets and countertops and has a stainless steel option (at a monthly charge, and not at all worth it IMO).  

Bathrooms:
There are 2 bathrooms, both feature the same tile as the rest of the unit and new fixtures.  They are bright and cleanly laid out and have modern, minimalist fixtures.

Bedrooms:
The master is in the loft and has it's own bathroom, and a spacious walking closet.  The lower bedroom is also large for an apartment, and has a full wall of closets with shelves on one side.  Both are carpeted, which is nice and beige.

Utilities are included, Water, Electric an the AC and Heater function well.  However, at the change of season, when they change the system over from heat to AC  and AC to heat, there was a week where the temperature was not quite right.  I understand it is a common problem with having a complex wide HVAC system, but it was uncomfortable none the less and worthy of noting.
Pool and fitness area:
The pool area is clean, nice and has a few gazebos and a large covered area with a huge sectional outdoor couch.  The pool area is huge and is the main focal point once inside the complex.  There is also a fitness center which is not bad by apartment standards, Elliptical, recumbent bike, and treadmill along with a small assortment of dumbbells.  It's small but gets the job done.

Management:
They are quick to address issues and very helpful.  They will accept packages as well.

I just moved in from out of state a couple months ago.
I love my apartment! Maintenance was very quick to fix my garbage disposal and the office is super nice!
Wonderful area with access to so much, I do recommend.

The water is ALWAYS shut off for most of the day at least once a week! its sad. million dollar company cant permanently fix the water system. 

In addition to that, it always smells like weed throughout the whole complex. Tons of people smoke in their apartments with doors and windows open, or right out on the patio. Even when the complex sends out notices of no smoking they ignore it. And management does nothing about it! 
There is never parking if you have 2 vehicles your screwed. 
The maintenance staff is not very friendly. I dont know how many times I have smiled and waved at them passing by as a common courtesy and they ignored me.
Despite the speed bumps throughout the complex, People drive fast and wreck less eventhough their are kids around. 
Its gone down hill pretty quick. Enter at your own risk

Just beware of the property manager and maintenance very creepy. Oh and dont believe these reviews by no means. The property manager amanda will literally take your phone if she feels comfortable with you enough and put good reviews on here herself, she did it to my partner. So I wouldn't be surprise if half of the people writing reviews is either/or working with this company or was bribed to put good reviews on here. Just beware they have eyes and ears everywhere, if a property manager cant be honest about their own property than that should say something about their loyalty or trust.  Also they have a very bad water problem I wouldn't recommend you even cooking with that water. They are constantly having water shut off etc... And lately the polices stay out there it's a shame. They are called every other day which is very weird, I never seen anything like it the 2yrs I was living there, and reportedly my kids had to come inside because there was a man walking around with a gun outside. I guess they are that desperate for residents that they dont think about the safety for the elderly and kids especially.  Then they have residents complain about the kids out there but they dont have anything for the kids to do. No park no nothing. They use to have security but God knows what happened with that.  If you have kids especially its nicer places around the area and more things to do with kids etc...The termites come up thru your bathroom sink beware of that as well

*I haven't had a working washer or toilet in my home since Wednesday(5 days)!!!!! I've left 3 voicemails since I don't have time to go to the front office. They NEVER answer the phone.* Used to be a semi-decent place then they just recently switched management companys and it's been nothing but issues since they got here. Always shutting off the water without any warning until after it's already been done(not always emergencies) and because of there most reasent time I havent had a washer for 5 days cause they turned it off in the middle of the cycle without warning. Every time you turn around you're getting a notice on the door about how you're going to get fined if you do this or fined if you do that. Also, I've lived here since August and never had any problems but now all of a sudden supposedly they're getting complaints about how loud we are. I watch my friends kids basically every day so that she can work. My house does get a little bit loud but by the time the 10pm quiet enforced time hits it's always quiet so I don't know where they're getting these complains. Also, it is a 60 day notice for the end of your lease, make sure you set a reminder some how cause they don't warn you your coming up to your 60 days. I got a phone call after I was 16 days into my 60 day of them asking me if I had made up my mind if I was going to renew my lease. Mind you, I never talked to anyone about renewing cause I never even knew I was in my 60 days. The old management said, when we signed our lease, that they would let us know about 2 weeks in advance that our 60 day was coming up, guess that got lost in the transition with the switch, now I'm going to have to pay an extra 16 days at this apartment. Yay......

I hate living here so much.

I have been a resident since only the end of 2018. It started out great here, but it all went down hill painfully fast. I can't believe they jacked rent up as high as they did because this place is disgusting and falling apart. There are so many unbelievable issues here. Constant water issues. Never hot, if it works at all. No parking. So if you come home late at night from work or school, you run the risk of getting towed for winging it. Between me and my roommate, we have one covered parking spot, so one of us ends up screwed if we come home late. Mail is constantly going missing. The walls are crazy thin so you can hear every sound and there are always children screaming well past 10pm in my area of the complex late at night (by the pool). There was liquid dripping from our main A/C vent and now a permanent green mold spot on our floor. The drawers and cabinets are falling apart. The appliances barely work. New management set up a new online portal to pay rent but can't figure out how to get my email right so I haven't been able to use it at all. They're having peoples' cars towed from their assigned spots and not reimbursing them for it. They're not reimbursing anyone for the failure to provide proper hot water because they think painting the walkways is more important. The office staff turns their phones off ALL day during the middle of the week sometimes and they never return messages. I would not recommend moving in. I cannot wait to leave this place.

Don't trust the 5 star reviews, people. I've been fighting with this complex for a while now. Our first lease here was decent-- it's a cheaper complex and you can tell that by looking at it, but it used to be worth the price. Now, it's still cheap, but I feel like we're paying too much. We haven't had hot water in months, and they're constantly turning off the water to repair this issue, but it's never getting fixed. Even when they do "fix" it, maintenance breaks something and they have to call real plumbers. When the plumbers came, they just shook their head in awe at maintenance's mistakes. The "new" shower piece they installed was over two years old and the entire job would've taken the plumbers all day to fix, which they were unable to do. When I try to call the office, no one is available to help, and no one returns voice mails. When we try to say we have a problem, they gaslight us and say that no one else is having problems. I made it a point to walk around the complex and speak with neighbors throughout the buildings, to which the majority have shared the same concerns. Save yourselves the time and money and find yourself a nicer property with a staff that cares about its tenants. If you like hot showers, toilets that work, and apartments that don't constantly smell like sewage, I would find another property.

The property itself is very nice and in a great location. The apartment is very nice as well...however, I unfortunately chose an apartment right next to the Parkway and the noise is incredible. There is a constant steady stream of traffic, and especially big trucks from the construction sites across the road. What makes things worse is that the trucks drive right over a big divot in the highway and they bounce in the air, and when they come down, the bang is so loud and impact on the ground causes my apartment to shake and vibrate. The noise is so bad that I have to wear ear plugs to sleep at night, and some nights the car noises are so loud at 2-3 in the morning I have had to sleep in my bathroom and bath tub. I am very disappointed the property staff did not disclose the street noise to me when I rented the apartment (they could not sow me the apartment I rented until I moved in -the apartment I saw a few weeks before was across the building and shielded from all the noise). If you need to rent an apartment here, do so way into the property and away from the North Valley Parkway.

A minimum of $150 is added onto your rent every month thanks to fees. Amenities aren't nice enough to justify the pricing of everything. You are forced into dealing with 1 ISP that provided terrible customer support. If you are working from home there is no greater nuisance especially when you pay $40 a month for "MAA Connect" Be aware of these nuisances before you decide on this place.

I lived in phase 2, for 3 years and just moved recently. I can say it’s a beautiful place to live, very nicely kept and great amenities. The maintenance crew is terrific, know you by name and that’s no mean feat with a large complex! It’s a safe area, with friendly neighbors I’ll miss a lot!
Quiet, clean, well maintained
I have been here 6 years, and I like it very much.
My experience living at the property has been great.

Speedy Work Not sure if the maintenance guys have a lot of work and are generally this fast or they are just bored but they seem to be pretty speedy with responding to maintenance request.  Thanks to you all

Had an amazing experience with the manager Angela in the office. Made the whole application process easy and she kept us informed and up to date as we went through the steps. My kids are looking forward to the splash pad and pools.

We lived here for about a year and things were great! We had a couple issues that were resolved in a timely manner. We had an issue that was waiting on COVID to slow down, but it was never resolved before we moved. For the most part everything was nice and tidy when we moved in. The trim was scuffed up in places and the bathroom needed paint touch ups here and there. We noted these things when we moved in, but they never came to resolve them. So we assume they just wanted it for information purposes for when we move out. There were a lot of nails and screws that were found in the carpet all over the apartment when we moved in(so just be aware).
They are usually okay at getting back to you. Sometimes it takes a little while. Email is better than a phone call, but sometimes still takes a bit. I felt like the longer we were there, the worse the speed of responded became. 
There are a lot of dogs which do bark, yip, and cause a general ruckus. Not everyone cleans up after their pooches, which is an annoyance.
I did not have a lost package or mail and it was a pretty easy process to receive packages.
You do only get one covered/guaranteed parking space, so you do need to be aware of who will get home the latest to be able to park appropriately. If you get home after 7:00, it’s going to be a decent amount of circling to find a space.
I always felt safe here and it’s surrounded by good neighborhoods. It’s close to just about any shopping or restaurant you could want and also close access to the interstate.
There are four pools, but none of them have restrooms! They do have a decent amount of seating and some covered space.
There’s a little gym on property and a little marketplace, which is surprisingly stocked well!
Just moved in! Met Sierra in the morning to get my keys and when I walked into my apartment they had a little goodie bag waiting for me that said Welcome Home. So far this place rocks!
Office staff and management are great love the property. Highly recommend

There’s a chill marketplace inside you can walk too, management has fun events and resources, maintenance comes fast, no one really bothers you, only con is office is kinda rude sometimes so when your setting up the apartment with them they’ll be very dry and if you ask question about the apartment and the mailing system is hard if you have a package since they don’t have a mail room for packages, but overall I think after you move in and get settled, just get a P.O. Box for mail and you’re all good :)

Just look somewhere else because they will not attend to any of your maintenance req no matter how important they are. I wrote a rev about having to throw my clothes away due to their broken dryer (I did multiple maint Req and they kept marking them done) & the owner said to reach out to them. It’s been over a week and still nothing.  Definitely reconsidering renewing my lease here.

The turn is located in high crime area. You can hear gunfire most weekends. There are sirens every single day. The property is not well maintained in terms of cleanliness. There is landscaping conducted every Monday from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. which is very loud. The dog park is not kept clean and emits a foul aroma. The leasing office is closed when rent is due and the mail slot is glued shut. There were cockroaches in my unit when I first moved in that management was very reluctant to take care of. I was harassed by management for complaining about cockroaches. If you're an older person be aware that this property has many uneven surfaces which creates a risk of trip and fall. I do not recommend this property because it is located in an unsafe location and the management has been cruel.

This is the only place I've ever renewed a lease, and I would be renewing again if I wasn't moving to another state shortly. Our apartment is so beautiful. Vaulted ceilings, huge bathroom, big closets, large fenced patio/balcony. The layout is so cute, the appliances are updated. I wish I could just pick up this apartment and take it with me to the next destination. Our unit is upstairs and in the corner of the complex, super private. Totally pet friendly. The maintenance team is super quick with getting things checked out, sometimes it takes a bit for parts but what can you do? Amenities are still super limited due to covid, so the once upon a time 24hr gym is restricted to business hours by appt only and same goes for the pool. The only thing that just SUCKS is the parking situation. There's no assigned parking unless you want to pay for a garage for an extra 100ish a month. I'm in the restaurant business so I tend to get home late when I work nights. There's been over a dozen times I've had to park in the residential neighborhood across the street, not too horrible since I'm in a front corner unit but I have no idea how people do it that live in the back of the complex. Anywho, this is a very family oriented area with the school nearby and I haven't ever really felt unsafe. Thank you for the last two years The Turn Management. Amanda you've been great and thank you to the maintenance team always being so friendly, greeting me with a smile and good morning whenever we crossed paths. 10/10 would recommend this rental community to anyone.

I am so happy that I live here. I am happy with everything from the maintenance to the management, Lewis is a Gem! He is so down to earth and professional not to mention the grounds are always clean and I love the view of the sunset over the golf course from my living room! The inside.... like 5 star hotel faucets with luxury granite and crown molding throughout. Thanks a million for having me here! The Turn is excellent!

What I love about The Turn is that there are no gotchas coming in. You choose the level of rent you wish to pay; Basic, Mid, and Premium. The ladies in the office are very friendly, and very accommodating. Maintenance requests are handled swiftly, and don't right the first time. The amenities  add eve further value with the 24 hr gym access, lit and secure mail room, BEAUTIFUL clubhouse, and well kept grounds. A bonus is the movie theater and free popcorn. Take it from a very satisfied renter, you will not go wrong choosing The Turn as your next home.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: Don't be fooled. This is not a smoke free community. Pot permeates the air and the staff smokes. The maintenance staff smokes while driving around in their golf cart.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
Do yourself a favor and avoid this place. The office is clueless. They can’t even decide when they open each day (is it 9 or 10- they certainly can’t figure it out!). When we moved in 2yrs ago it was a nice area and the office was easy to work with. The area is now surrounded by homeless camps (one is literally right across the street on Greenway). 
Our cars were broken into 3x while here, needing replacement windows each time. Management did not care. The new owners have no idea what they are doing. By the way- tack on $50 a month to their advertised rent cause they surprise you with that mandatory “amenity fee” when you go to sign. Lease somewhere else and avoid the headache.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
My car was towed without notice for being backed into a parking space. The no backing in rule has never been enforced in the 10 months I have lived here, and on any given day I usually see 1/5 to 1/3 of people backed in. By the time I realized my car was gone it was too late to pick it up from the towing company, because again I wasn't given any notice that my car was towed. I went to leave my apartment tonight and it was just gone. 

The only justification for this rule that I was able to get is that there are apparently so many stolen cars stored in their parking lot that they can't take the time to check the license plate of a backed in car and make sure it isn't stolen, despite the fact that I have been parking in the exact same section every day for the last 10 months. 

My biggest issue isn't even that it was towed, because while sure I think it is a stupid rule, it IS in the lease, so backing in was a gamble I was taking along with the hundred other people doing it. The problem is that I was not notified in any way that it was going to happen or that it had happened. My car was just gone when I went outside. This is completely unnacceptable as far as I am concerned.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
When the new management took over I was hopeful and optimistic. However now I see that things are worse than before. I fought for months with the old management about roaches in my oven so I was hopeful things were finally going to get fixed. I was wrong. It was another fight to FINALLY get a new roachless oven in my kitchen. 

My newest of problems, and most concerning, is that in the month of June (the past ten days) my AC has broken twice. The first time (a Wednesday) maintenance came out and they we’re kind and as helpful as they could be and told me the air conditioning workers would be out tomorrow morning to fix it. They brought in this rinky-dink portable AC unit that did absolutely nothing as our thermostat stayed at 91 degrees the entirety of the breakage. We waited all morning and not until 1pm the AC workers came, went on the roof, and left without saying a word. We contacted the leasing office and management multiple times all day long including going in person when our phone calls were not being answered. All day long we received the same answer “It will be fixed today.” Until 5:45 rolled around and I received a call that it indeed would not be getting fixed that day and instead the next morning in between 7:30 and 10 AM. That time came and passed on Friday and it was finally fixed around 2 pm. It lasted 6 days and my AC is broken again. Today is Friday and with record breaking high temperatures and another rinky-dink portable AC unit that will once again do nothing, I was told the AC workers will not be out until MONDAY!!!! And that’s just to look at it, who knows when it will actually be repaired. When I asked if there was anything they could do for us, management told me there is nothing they can do as they have to let the AC people they are contracted with attempt to fix it first. I’m assuming in attempt to save money since the part that broke before is “under warranty” as the leasing office had told me previously.

Roaches in my oven for months and AC broken for DAYS with record breaking high temperatures in JUNE ARIZONA HEAT, and no real solutions or help at all from management.

Whatever you do, don’t do it here.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
Commute- great
Noice- up front at Greenway Parkway you can hear the traffic, but it sounds like the ocean to me…except speedsters.
Safety- my husbands work truck got broken into twice in 4 years- they don’t have stong security patrol presence that seems to be consistent or overly effective. 
Ammenities- gym,pool, clubhouse (WiFi) all nice.
Maintenance- GREAT! Ive never had one issue with maintenance- they are personable, professional, and prompt. I’ve had my garbage disposal, microwave, and dryer replaced over the years- the day after and without incident. They always followed up to see if we were satisfied. The grounds are kept beautifully (lawn and no trash).
Parking- Great! One assigned spot- a garage for a price (but really not neccesary… unless you need a bunch of extra storage .We have two cars and we have no problem parking close to our apartment.
Overall we have been happy- obviously seeing that we have been here for 4 years. The office staff is really accommodating, friendly, and knowledgeable.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: Bad communication from management, the trash cans are always overly full. I was pressured into signing my lease as the management new I was closing on my house so they wait til the day before to reach out. I'll just say the numbers are a lot higher then what was shown on there website. I do not recommend anyone to come move in unless you like paying more for less.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: Keep in mind, if you do rent here, you WILL NOT get your security deposit back and they will charge you additional fees upon moving out. So, right as you're done moving out and dealing with all the stressors of moving and relocating, they will promptly mail you a bill full of inaccurate deductions and outlandish fees which you will owe to them after you no longer live there. Additionally, if you plan on being there over a year, keep in mind, they raised our rent over 14% with the start of our new lease going into our second year.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: This has been the worst year of my life. Management is terrible. Ronnie doesn’t know how to run a large complex. My apartment has had numerous issues that have taken weeks to fix and still have not been fixed as I’m moving out. Plugs in my apartment don’t work. Black mold growing in the air conditioner that is told to be “normal”. The pools are dirty and hot tubs are usually broken. Overall these apartments look nice from the outside, but the multiple problems on the inside isn’t worth your time or money.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: Very overpriced for what you get. Management is horrible! Do not rent here.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
I am actually quite shocked to read any negative reviews. I moved here from out of state and was able to do everything virtually and with E signatures which made life a lot easier. I also had a lot of questions and anxiety due to the fact that I had a very short window. 
Monica and Ronnie made everything smooth and painless.  I have been so impressed and taken back not only by both these lovely ladies, but the maintenance staff as well. I honestly can say that I have never lived anywhere that has been so prompt and on top of communication as this staff at the Boulevard is. 
I also had an influx of boxes being delivered to my place during a time that I  was traveling. I asked if they would be willing to assist me in possibly putting the boxes in my home and guess what, they did it, not only did they do it, but these boxes were heavy and there were a lot of them, talk about going the extra mile!!! And with a smile lol !!! 
The apartment itself is great as well. I love my patio and the overgrown trees and the grounds are kept beautifully. It is spacious, has high ceilings, big bathrooms and awesome closets!! The air conditioner works great and the apartments is  in great condition. 
I am so happy that I moved here! It is an excellent location and  work is now a 10 minute commute. You can't get better than that!  You have major highways all within about a 5 minute drive and multiple stores EVERYWHERE - SHOPPERS HEAVEN!   Anything you could think of really is nearby or next door.  Great restaurants within walking distance.  
It's also very quiet which I like, I don't hear  anything disturbing ever. 
You should also ask about the incentives they have for certain companies, which I had no idea about, however, they offered the information and now I get a little discount!!! Every penny counts, doesn't it!?!?! How nice that I didn't even have to ask about it, they told me!!  
I could go on and on, but long story short, I'm very appreciative of the level of  attentiveness and service I receive on top of feeling like the staff that works here, really cares!!! 
KUDOS TO ALL THE BLVD. STAFF FROM THIS HAPPY & THANKFUL RESIDENT!! PROUD TO SAY SO!

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
I AM EXTREMELY LIVID WITH THIS PLACE. I HAVE NEVER BEEN SO DISRESPECTED IN MY LIFE. THIS COMMUNITY IS NOT GATED, SECURITY IS NOT EFFICIENT, AND PEOPLE IN THE COMMUNITY PARTICULARLY IN PARKING SPACE 116 ARE INHUMANE. ACCORDING TO THE POLICE OFFICER THEY INTENTIONALLY VANDALIZED MY VEHICLE, CAUSING SEVERE CRIMINAL DAMAGE. THE APARTMENT MANAGEMENT TEAM HAS YET TO HELP ME SOLVE ANY ISSUES WITH THIS PROBLEM. I'M CONSTANTLY  WORKING AND I FEEL LIKE THIS HAS BEEN BLOWN WAY OUT OF PROPORTION. I DON'T FEEL WELCOMED OR SAFE AT THIS POINT. AS MANAGEMENT OF AN APARTMENT COMPLEX I PERSONALLY WOULD DIG DEEPER INTO THIS SITUATION, BUT THEY HAVE NOT AND THEREFORE I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE TO THE BOULEVARD. 

THANKS

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: I just moved out of the apartment and understand the negative reviews now.  I moved in and there were so many issues and there is not even characters allowed to list them all. I pride myself on being very clean and took extremely good care of the apartment.  I had a visiting pet a couple times (watched my mom's declawed, neutered cat when she went out of town) and they charged me a $163 fee for that.  A $163 fee is quite a bit to pay for a pet to visit but okay, I get it.  However, they charged me a total of about $630 for carpet replacement for pet damage.  I know that the pet did not do damage I do not feel like they did the right thing or being ethical since I am being charged almost $800 because I watched a cat for a few nights.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: The Boulevard luxury apartment complex prides itself on maintaining a safe, clean, and balanced environment with respectful neighbors and a well maintain community. With a newly renovated exercise center, business center, new improvements being made as of late (new door number signs, the aforementioned renovations, repainting of the streets), two pools with new comfortable outdoor furniture, and gas grills included in both pools, this apt. complex gets you your bang for your hard earned bucks. As well, the complex is only a quick walk away from Sprouts, a Super Target, Fry's, several Starbucks, Chipotle, a myriad of banks, restaurants, and only a 15 minute car ride away to Central/Downtown Phoenix, and 20 minutes away from north Scottsdale. It is generally quiet with no city noise, and most apartments come with spacious balconies and private entrance ways. To top it off, the management team is very kind and accommodating at providing information for apartment sizes and prices, and at helping you with the entire process of moving in.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: What can I say? The Boulevard Luxury Apartments are not so...luxurious. Don't get me wrong, the interior is decent, the amenities offered are okay, but no where near luxury. Pretty quiet complex. Oh and if something in your apartment breaks, please be sure to have your own personal handy man on speed dial, because maintenance here is a joke! Half of my outlets work, a couple of light switches never worked since I've been here, and they have yet to come fix these things. But overall these are decent apartments. I'm sure if you look hard enough you can find more luxurious apartments for a cheaper price relative to The Boulevard. I'm just saying. Oh and The Boulevard is located near 2 major highways, plenty of stores and eateries, and gyms. Enjoy!

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review: Just moved in. Apparently they will tell you anything to get you to move in, and when confronted about it they do nothing. I am extremely disappointed and upset. Stay away!!!

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
Me and my girlfriend have been living here for almost 8 months, and were really disappointed. They appear to be high-end and luxurious, but after we moved in we found the amenities are no good at all. There's only one sink in the kitchen. No vent in guest bathroom. Toilet breaks constantly. Broken ceiling fan. Smoke alarm went out of battery and beeps every 30 mins. Bent bar in the closet.... I can keep going.

Their maintenance responds pretty fast, but is kind of sloppy. They never take off their shoes when they enter. They will put tools on your bed and put away your personal belongings with very little care. But overall is not too awful.

Tasha is great, she thinks in residence's shoes. Very nice young lady, Alyssa and another brunette is too much of a pain to deal with! Always very impatient and have a terrible attitude. Don't go to them if you have a chance, their attitude will possibly make you very uncomfortable. Go get Tasha, she's very nice and helpful. There used to be an old gentleman working there, he's such a delight.

But either way, we do not recommend this complex. Definitely moving out in about 4 months.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
As stated in previous reviews it is in a great location but there are at least a dozen other complexes in this area, so choices are unlimited. Be sure to explore them ALL.

They advertise themselves as a luxury apartment but they are not. It is just an apartment complex like any other. Large multi-unit complex, with standard issue carpet (that wears out easily and stains even faster) verrtical vinyl blinds (that stick and break) and no luxury fixtures.

Noise level is the same as any average apartment.

There doesn't seem to be any "proactive" behavior of either the office staff, maintenance personnel or the landscaping company. I had to open a ticket to get a dead bird removed that laid outside our door for three weeks. Certainly the landscapers must of have seen it and the office/maintenance people would have seen it if they ever walked the grounds.

Washer and dryers must be rejects from GE, that never sold to the public, so why not unload them on tenants who do not have a choice . The washer has a "soak" feature on every cycle that increases the time it takes to get a load of laundry done and the amount of water (which you pay for) used for each load.

My electric bill (APS) was $181 as of this date, December 2013, the most I have ever paid for electricity for house or an apartment. We have not used the heat in our apartment once this winter.

As with the other review, unless your upstairs neighbor floats like a butterfly you will hear every step, thump and bump as they move about the apartment. You would expect more sound-proofing in a "luxury" apartment.

You will hear them wash dishes, flush toilets and take a shower.

Bottom line it is not a luxury apartment complex. It is just a complex like any other.

apartmentName: Boulders at Lookout Mountain Apartment Homes
review:
We have been living here for two years. This apartment complex is in one of the best locations in the city. It is within walking distance of three grocery stores, a Walgreens, half a dozen hair salons, a fitness center and over a dozen places to eat. It also has easy access to public transit.

That would be the extent of the excellent features of this apartment. After that it is just an average apartment complex not the luxury complex as they advertise.

The grounds and amenities are good. The apartments have no luxury finishes (i.e. hardwood or engineered wood floors, higher end window coverings). Just standard apartment issue carpet, vertical vinyl blinds (that stick and break as expected) and fake wood -peel and stick tile.

The kitchen cabinets are constructed with fixed shelves, cannot be adjusted to accommodate different sizes and types of housewares or food. We had to purchase extra storage for food, pots and pans.

No medicine cabinets in the bathrooms (we rent a 3bed/2bath apt). One towel rack in each bathroom.

Noise level from other apartments is just what you would expect in an "average" apartment not a luxury apartment, maybe worse. When the upstairs neighbors take showers, flush a toilet or just run water it sounds like the water is running down the inside of the walls like a waterfall.

If you are interested a 3 Bedroom please note at this complex they are ALL on the first floor, which the staff will tell you is a good thing. This means that the upstairs apartment is set back and the living room, dining room and kitchen ceiling of the 3 Bedrooms has nothing above it.

Beware, that means that the living room floor of the upstairs apartment is the ceiling of the master bedroom. That can mean that when you are trying to sleep, they have their television going, which you can hear if loud enough; they will be walking around, you will hear every step.

Lastly the office staff just under went a major change, except for Alyssa, the assistant manager, most of them do not appear to be to concerned with existing tenants, just new ones. But that has been my experience at every other apartment complex I have lived at.
