Jared, the on-site manager, is extremely personable, responsive, and readily available to handle any issues that may arise.
Maintenance is quick to fix things both in the apartments, and in the common areas.
The garage is secure, and I love that we have a bicycle repair station and a pet-washing station.
Overall, I'm so glad I chose 11 Marche for my home!

In terms of location, this place is ideal for anyone looking to live in downtown Portland - all necessities are within walking distance. Management is friendly, approachable, and have always answers quickly if there is something that needs tending. Apartments are clean and well kept with up-to-date appliances! It's been such a pleasant experience to live here.

I have been living at 11 Marche a little over a year and it has been a positive experience.

The apartment is in a convenient location downtown, near the highway (not too loud), the light-rail is across the street, near a grocery store/pharmacy and about 5 minutes from central downtown. The apartment itself is clean and modern. Jared (leasing manager) and Ted (maintenance) are a delight, willing to help answer any questions and clear up any maintenance issues quickly. Jared always has a treat ready for your dogs, and will make you feel welcome when you come in. Jared has made sure that "Mask's required" signs are up, per Multnomah regulations, ensuring the safety of tenants, which is always appreciated. 

Although street-parking is limited and garage parking is expensive, parking can still be found. Please be aware the apartment is near downtown and next to PSU. There is a large houseless crisis in Portland, like any other city in the U.S and many youths. If you park in the street, make sure you take your junk out of the car and you have less chances of your car being broken into. If it does that's what auto insurance is for. We park on the side of the road and don't have issues. In my opinion the location of 11 Marche is safe, convenient, and comfortable.

The only reason it's worth living here is because of the great deal we got moving in when the building had less than three stars. Completely overpriced now. The management of this building is the issue. The JLE Properties company that owns it is not only greedy, but willing to keep irresponsible and incompetent employees on board in charge of their properties. Cute and convenient location though.

I recently moved to Portland and walked by 11 Marche Apartments and I liked the building.  The leasing manager was in and kindly showed me an apartment without having an appointment.  Jared, the manager was friendly and helpful, gave me a tour and answered my questions.  The building is quiet.  The apartment was spotless.  I love that I have a bay window that looks into tree tops.  Great fit for now!

PLEASE check out the Google reviews as well (includes pictures and will give you more of an idea of what you are getting yourself into if you choose to move here). 

My sister and I moved in 2 days ago and it has been a terrible experience. We walked into a unit that had code violations and simply was not finished or clean. What we discovered on move in:

-One toilet is not fully sealed to the ground (code violation). You can see it visibly detach from the ground when you sit on it.
-The other bedroom toilet has exposed sheetrock around it (code violation)
-Shower head not fully attached to the wall
-Paint spray on every windowsill. If they would taken just a few minutes to clean it would have been much appreciated
-Our valet trash was left with trash from either the workers or the previous tenant and smelled like cat pee
-Missing tile on our backsplash and exposed nails
-Holes in the closet walls
-Green sticky stuff left on walls and brown sticky stuff left on bathroom counters
-Dog hair on windowsills
-Overall wear and tear (we would be okay with this if the above did not exist).

Shortly after walking around the unit and discovering this, I went to the leasing office and was told that the unit was signed off on by their employees and that anything that needed to be fixed would have to be a service request.

I am truly flabbergasted if anyone signed off on that place. When we brought the issues forward to the leasing office, the attitude presented was dismissive and they seemed actually annoyed that we were bringing these items up. Being met with a little bit of empathy in this situation would have gone a long way. We in no way blame the leasing office, but would have really appreciated an "I'm really sorry that happened, let me check with our team and see what we can do to get this resolved".

When we confronted them about the code violations we were also told to submit a service request which I have completed this morning. I am hoping they will be resolved quickly, but based on the other reviews.... I guess we will have to see. If possible, I will update this if we start to have a better experience.
Erroneous reviews are slanting the true assessment of this place.  Do your homework.  Years of filth and lack of response to any of it. MAKE SURE YOU DO NOT FALL FOR THE LIES
Love the maintenance team. Quicker than usual response. Anthony really takes the time to take care of what you need and does a great job with repairing!
Trash areas look like a homeless camp. Refusal to do upkeep on common areas

New mgmt is rude.  Vacancies galore, and will stay that way with their way to high rental rates.  Offering one month free?   HA!  LOWER THE RATES.  Walkways and patios / decks in dire need of pressure washing.  Moss galore on the roofs.  I'm dealing with ants....AGAIN!  $200+ per month for w/s/g?  INSANE!!
Poor Management (New), Trash, Vermin, Smoking issues are abundant. Dog poop is also a big issue in the community. Fees and services you can’t opt out of. Parking is also terrible.

My experience so far at RiverWest has been spectacular. The move in process was so easy and convenient. Jeff and the team in the office have been very impressive and take care of everything you need. The apartment complex is very clean and nice. I love my apartment and all the great features it provides.
rent is on the high side and would like additional elevators but it is a easy, friendly upscale place to live with nice amenities.

RiverWest is a beautiful place to call home. I love the waterfront location, the staff is very responsive, people comment on how nice it looks and smells when they first walk in.  I have a view condo and absolutely love the river and city views!
RiverWest is an amazing building full of amazing residents. The staff is kind and always making sure youre as comfortable as you can be. I love living here!

RiverWest has a beautiful lobby, amazing waterfront location and waking up to that beautiful river view, and falling asleep to the city lights is amazing. Love walking to the restaurants and shops, and it's a short drive anywhere I need to go!  Staff is responsive, parking is gated and safe.

My experience here has been poor from the beginning. I had to chase the original employee to get a walkthrough and then a rental agreement. After move in, I discovered the apartment was never cleaned, had painters tape on the walls, and was missing a light covering. I immediately asked for a walkthrough form so I could list problems with the unit because there were many paint scratches, but I had to go through three separate employees over a three week period before I received one. Upon using the dishwasher the first time, water was pouring onto the floor because the water line was never opened on the garbage disposal. Months in, the staff erroneously put me on a different utility payment schedule such that I was being charged for utilities that were not in my lease or agreed to. That problem persisted for months with a final employee chasing me for $11.00 that I never agreed to pay. At one point, I changed my electronic payment to a direct bank draw to avoid the credit card payment fee. However, two months later, I was being charged a fee for that too. The apartment is also not worth the rent I am paying. Thankfully I currently pay the original lease rate and not the extortionate upped rates like my neighbors. I know I am not alone with this complaint because people are constantly moving out. The quality of the units does not justify this rate, and, if you are standing outside on a breezy day, it smells like sour milk and concrete. The only shining light here is the maintenance staff who are always nice to talk to and are efficient at their job.

While we have just recently moved in mid-November in the midst of this COVID pandemic we are thrilled with the cleanliness of the apartment complex, and professionalism of the maintenance and management team here. The neighbors that we've met here in the complex are wonderful, and we can't wait to be able to utilize all the amenities once the pandemic is under control. It can only get better from here!

Overall living at RiverWest has been great so far. My husband and I love the apartment, the view, and access to all the waterfront and DownTown Vancouver activities. We hope to enjoy the amenities more once COVID restrictions allow.

I lived here for 9 months.

This property is fine if there are 0 issues with your unit. I moved into to this unit when it was brand new. Two appliances were broken in the span of 9 months. One took 4 months to fix (dryer issue) and one took 2-3 weeks (air conditioner). 

Community spaces are fine. At least one elevator frequently not in service (due to people reserving it for moving in and out, which happens almost daily), sometimes elevators are broken all together, and sometimes elevators smell like wet dog. Random fire alarm went off 2 times during stay. When this happens you're stuck outside for an hour or so until the fire department comes and gives all clear. Fine when it's not cold and rainy out and when it's not in the middle of the night.

You can hear people living above you. Building is not high quality construction so there is not insulation for noise between floors. When asked about this, management gently ignores the inquiry. YMMV depending on which unit you end up in.

Management staff comes and goes. They're nice, but often times don't have answers to questions, probably because they're always in training mode.

RiverWest has may our transition to Vancouver so much better than expected. We don't feel like we are in a temporary home.  You don't hear other residents, it is close to downtown, close to restaurants and wine tastings, and easy to get outside for a walk or run.  RiverWest is VERY pet friendly.

RiverWest Staff has been outstanding prior to my move in, and since.  Always attentive and even returning missed calls, when no voicemail is left, to make sure everything is okay and to see if I had any questions.

Aside from great views. location and beautiful interiors the staff here has been amazing. Especially Jeff who helped us with all our questions or concerns long before we even moved in. Then he personally greeted and guided us upon arrival. He truly went above and beyond saving the day when we needed help getting our huge tv set up! I can't say enough great things about being here and again especially Jeff.
Impressed resident 501
From the management, the sense of community and the dog treats...we are happy as can be!  LeAnne & Zeus
This community is the best ever.  I highly recommend you renting with RiverWest. The staff goes above and beyond your expectations.

The Aria is located downtown and is not far from great restaurants and entertainment on the waterfront. There is a Famers Market every weekend as well as events in the park. A great place to call home.

The Aria has been a great place to live in the center of downtown. The location is near the river where great restaurants and a walking trail are located. The staff have been amazing in addressing any issues that come up. Overall I would give it a 10 rating.
Great location, excellent management, clean hallways, great maintenance services, strong sense of community.

Great location & spacious apartments, with nice layouts. Friendly helpful staff. Very pet friendly. Nicely maintained. Love that it has a/c - heat & washer/ dryer; just wish the apartments had a built-in microwave above the stove.
Beautiful building & friendly helpful neighbors are only the beginning of the Aria!  Breathtaking views, cleanliness and positivity exudes here always!
Aria staff addressed any issues that came up with my unit in a timely manner.

The 72nd has been my home for over 3 years. It's an oasis of calm and quiet. I'm most impressed with Rich, the owner/manager who lives on-site. He and his team are willing to go above and beyond night or day.
Whether you need a studio, 1, 2, or 3-bedroom home, the 72nd is the place to call home. There's assigned parking-or choose secure garage parking with an EV station. Enjoy a spacious, inviting top-floor gym, hot tub, and Bar-B-Que area, along with an enclosed cozy entertainment area for entertaining your guests.
This area in the Tigard Triangle is convenient to several grocery stores, I-5, 217, and Highway 99W, with easy access no matter which direction you desire to go.

What a great place to live! It has been an absolute joy to live here. I love how everything is clean and always kept up. Landlord is available and maintenance is done as needed, but nothing ever breaks so it’s a pleasure to live here. Super convenient location, you practically don’t need a car here if you work from home.

Highly recommend checking out this apartment. I have had a hard time finding apartments over the years that would take me and my pit bull mix. There were no questions asked when we applied! This place is very clean and tidy, management is kind and responsive! Very close to basically everything with the highway onramp down the street. Highly recommend.
The 72nd is a small complex, great location, well maintained with nice amenities and the Best onsight management

I have lived in many apartments over the years and this place was the best. Owner is super responsive to any issues and lives on site, it’s very well cared for, and has great amenities! No having to deal with a mgmt company.  Highly recommend. +EV charging!!

Been looking due to several changes! but at the end finally content at this small apartment community.
*Location, 5 min freeway access I-5 and Hwy 217
*Cosco,Walmart,Wincos,Petco 5 Mins!! Across the street
*Quiet!!
*Very nice floor plans
Leasing agent/Manager  THANK YOU! For listening to my needs:)

I was really disappointed in this property for how it’s managed. After having my vehicle hit in the garage (the first month)and no help even tho there was a camera monitoring that area… “well technically your car isn’t in the veiw because it’s an inch or so out of frame” even tho you could see everyone that would have swooped in to hit it. The elevator’s CONSTANTLY smelled of dog pee all the time, the trash chute always smelling up the hallways, dog poop is everywhere outside and even found some in the hallway, and the management can take away or change the amenities at any time! But my favorite is they can point out one person for not following community guidelines and threaten you with $200 fine while not enforcing anything else… I don’t think so!!!! BYEEE

I am very pleased with the service and employees during the application process and the move in days. I was working with Gage mostly, who was patient, responsive, and attentive to all my questions and needs. Gage went above and beyond and helped me with some custom shelving in my apartment. 

Jeff was also very helpful on my first move in day, and Gage was very helpful working with my last minute request of reserving the elevator for a few separate occasions. 

The team here you can tell care about their residents and go above and beyond to satisfy the residents.

Rented site unseen, & was completely nervous despite the research I did on this area. Moved from a state over, so the move was long, exhausting & slow due to weather & a flat tire. Arrived to our new home, & cannot express our gratitude for it being clean, cozy, & move-in ready. Management and maintenance have been incredibly helpful & welcoming. Neighbors are quiet & keep to themselves mostly, while the mature landscaping dampens any obtuse noises from roads nearby, creating a peaceful haven for introverts. There are playgrounds on site, and many close by for small children, plenty of room for walking pets, & a community that feels safe enough to walk around even at night. I’m deeply impressed so far by my new home, & this neighborhood.

When I lease an apartment  that's advertised as a 2 bedroom 2.5 bath. I expect it to have 2.5 bathrooms. Not three .5 baths and a janky tub. The place smelled like something died under the floor, and the management office has trouble doing even the simplest of task. Like giving me mailbox key, to my mailbox. Zero stars. Will not be staying past my lease. Will actively encourage everyone not to rent from this property.
Although Apt was not 100% ready for move in the customer service and response has been great! I appreciate the quick turn around in getting everything ready.

We have no on sight management or maintenance people.  We sent a maintenance request 3  days ago about the washing machine making loud noises on the spin cycle.  
There has been no response.  
They offer 6 weeks free rent to new tenants,  while raising existing rents!
It's a national property management company so there is very little personal communication

Months for a maintenance request. Out of touch with community and residents. Implementations of ridiculous smaller none issue things when bigger issue still given no attention or care whatsoever. Rental rates are called competitive rates when they are extremely high. Way to much turn over with property management staff so no consistency. Who pays for the grass to be green in the summer, the residents which is absolutely silly. Utilities are not calculated, there is no meter whatsoever so rather than flat fees the equation is calculated in a non ethical manner. I express my concern and get no communication back whatsoever about any issues. The units are turned over with cheapest possible solutions (carpet, door handles, fixtures, plumbing) for max profit and issues become unresolved and unresponsive from any staff.
The community seems nice and quiet so far . The people seem to stay to themselves and not outside much . The common areas are clean and there are many dog cleanup stations throughout.
Terrible maintenance, now no maintenance. Everything needs fixed/replaced. Extremely poor communication all around. Not what we expected. Very unhappy.
Ha sido muy grato encontrar paz, me encanta mi casa y la luz que entra por las ventanas, disfruto de la naturaleza y disfruto de caminar a mi perrita por los alrededores, este sitio es precioso
Great experience and very nice staff! Move in process was super easy and quick and the apartment is very nice. All updated appliances and new carpet.

Super quite neighborhood and helpful staff! It’s a Diamond in the Portland Rough… 
Extremely happy we choose RenewRock Creek. It has been a smooth transition for our family.

This is a quite and peaceful neighborhood. So far I enjoy my neighbors and have had no problems. The move in process was quick and streamlined. Renew seems very organized. I appreciate Kathaleens support through the process. We have only been here a month but so far any concerns have been promptly dealt with. My only negative comment thus far is that prices are very high. I of course knew this and chose to live here anyway as it is a much safer, cleaner and more peaceful environment for my children.
Office staff helped create a welcoming environment , communication was great with move-in.  I have been presently surprised I have had horrible experiences in the past
We just moved in, and we couldn’t be happier! Kathy has been an amazing help throughout the process. We are thankful for her time, support, and promptness.
Neighborhood is quiet and everyone is really nice! The first month of rent was also free! Very pet friendly with sidewalks everywhere, and it's next to a soccer field.

These places are not worth what they are trying to charge. Save your money and go live somewhere where they actually value you as a resident. Expect a paper on your door every other day with some kind of "upgrade" to the property. It is so sad what this company is doing to our area :(
The landscaping looks terrible now.

I have lived here for over twenty years and it has been nice. This new company doesn't seem to care about keeping it look nice as they have done exactly zero yard maintenance in 4 months. I have never seen the grass and landscaping as bad as it is now 12 -18 inches tall. This renew is actually trash.

Several months ago several floors got their bike storage units (which our on each individual floor) broken into. All Jose, manager, had to say was "it is our fault because we (as apartment residents) don't look back when we walk through the front door to see if someone else walked in". When several residents came up to him, he continued to say there was nothing they could do besides put new latches on the doors to the bike rooms. They refused to put security cameras on the doors or in the hallways. They refused to put security locks/fobs on the stairwell (because right now anyone can get in without a fab). They also did not let the community know about the bike rooms being broke into & the bikes being stolen until OVER 3 WEEKS AFTER THEY WERE BROKEN INTO.

Unfortunately upon moving in I didn’t realize I live directly above the garbage/recycling dock for both retail and residential which pickup occurs 6 days a week between the hours of 3am and 5am and comes twice between those times for both recycling and garbage. It is so incredibly loud there is no sleeping through it even with the best ear plugs and white noise, it’s intolerable if you like sleep. Stay far away from any apartments facing south. The leasing office acts like they had no idea about the noise and that nobody else has complained about it, but come to find out they are liars. All of my neighbors have complaints about the intolerable noise. They bait and switch you, they tell you that you can move apartments after 6 months, signing a new lease of course. I would like to bang pots and pans in their ear at 3am and again at 4am everyday and see how much they like it ??
Only good thing about this place is the location , but it’s slabtown and there are many other options, and new complexes being built.
I've been at LL for a few months now. My move in experience was great! Ashley was exceptional during the whole process. Awesome location too.
I've only lived here a week but so far it's been great!

LL Hawkins feels like home! The management team is wonderful and I love living here. My apartment is amazing, the neighbourhood is awesome and the building is safe and well cared for. Its a wonderful place to live! Just need a dog, ha.
This really is a very nice place to live. The current management team is very good and very responsive

It takes forever to get anything fixed. Management is incredibly slow to respond to requests. We called and spoke with the management over the phone to on our move out date, which they said would be fine. But then we're given an email later asking about our move out date. They said the person we talked to over the phone no longer worked their and that they didn't know we already set our move out date. Now we are stuck paying for another month, because of how poor communication is in this apartment company.

Don’t even think of renting here if you have a car.  There is only on street parking and no less than 7 restaurants on this corner.  And a lot of neighbors who are already pissed off at the restaurants.

Our AC/Heat has been broken since we moved in over 6 months ago. Many other things were broken/ non functional when we moved in, and took them months to fix. At this point, they have still not fixed the AC/Heat and the managers/ those working for the property seem to have disappeared. Have had 8 or so maintenance requests that have not been addressed for 3 months. Would suggest living elsewhere.

I only write reviews when they are 100% deserved and I have done enough research to objectively bring my opinion value. Here is a summary of my situation leading up to my decision to live at The Celine so that the full picture is perceived.
 I lived in fantastic building under a great management team in the NE but my lease was up and I wanted to live in a NW neighborhood. I moved here almost 2 years ago from Los Angeles and was missing that big city buzz. The search for my next spot was on like Donkey Kong!!
Between the research I had done when moving from out of state in addition to moving within Portland, I have visited or contacted almost every new/old building that exists or will  in the near future. I am picky as my home in addition to where I put my money is very important to me. Many of them have significant concessions and offer certain ammenities that are appealing. I personally found that The Celine was the only one that hit all the marks I was looking for within the neighborhood I desired to live. I found them to be true luxury homes set at the right value. 
The most significant factors leading to my decision are as follows: 
1. It is by far the hottest building on the block in one of the best neighborhoods. 
2. My leasing agent was knowledgeable, professional, helpful, patient, respectful and kind. She made the entire process much less stressful than it usually is and continues to do an outstanding job even after I moved in. 
Remember renting a home is very different than purchasing a pair of shoes that have a return window. I personally want to be living around people that are honest and care about their business. 
3. The modern interiors, timeless design, beautiful floor to ceiling windows, technologically advanced appliances, swirled marble counter tops, hardwood flooring throughout, and perfect lighting is to die for. 
4. The neighborhood is vibrant. You get the best of both worlds, big city electricity mixed with peaceful Oregon nature, which equals true balance. The streets are safe, well lit, and filled with great shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. 
5. Since I have moved in I have noticed several people on a daily basis admire the building as they walk past. Many making complimentary statements or expressing desire to possibly live here. 
6. Your friends will be Jelly. 
7. I did the research for you - save yourself time and effort. Remember if you snooze you may loose. Check out The Celine before it fills up!

Exceptional. Magnificent. Compassionate. It truly takes superior communication & authentic empathy to create a sense of wellbeing in communal environments; The Olivia nailed it! Their catch phrase “there’s room for you here” was displayed repeatedly by the loving kindness centered actions of outstanding staff. Highest of accolades to both JoAnne & Hailey. This new residence already feels like Home. Gorgeous architecture & darling design. Highly recommended property.

I strongly advise against moving here. Management ignores resident complaints, especially regarding noise. If you work from home, this isn't the place for you. They allow noise outside quiet hours and do little to enforce limits, even during quiet hours. Recently, noise complaints were outsourced to an ineffectual security company.

Everything here is truly fantastic! The staff are not just helpful; they’re genuinely friendly and bursting with knowledge. If you're working at OHSU, you'll love the convenience of being right next to the NS Streetcar, and the aerial tram is just a pleasant walk away. Plus, all the apartments and their buildings are brand new, nestled in a peaceful neighborhood that really enhances the living experience. It's an ideal place to call home!

I had a terrible experience living here. Management ignored safety issues like a broken parking garage door, failed to address noisy neighbors, and neglected basic building maintenance, including trash and elevator problems. They focused more on superficial events than actual resident concerns, making it an unbearable place to live.

The Olivia is a very nice place to live. However, it is bothersome only have two elevators because when an elevator is being reserved for someone to move in, there is only once elevator to use which causes longer wait times and more foot traffic. Also, it seems like there are frequent mechanical issues with the elevators, trash chutes, and garage doors. It seems like something is always down. Other than those few things, my experience with The Olivia has been very positive.

Every thing is good except the noise of the upper floor. 
I love the The location of the building. It’s nice and has access to the walkway

I have lived in this complex for about 5 months! I haven't had any problems. Their app to pay rent and put a work order is very helpful. The maintenance guys are incredible and do a very good job. So far it has been the best complex I have lived in.

I want to give a shout-out to the manager and the maintenance guy at Terwilliger Terrace Apartments - 7425 SW Barbur Boulevard in Portland.  Over the many years I’ve lived here, I really came to appreciate the same day response, sometimes the same hour response!  Very efficient too – they would call to learn about the problem, so they were prepared with the tools and materials needed before they got to my apartment.

I'm sad to leave my beautiful apartment which had a new cabinets and granite counters.  I was spoiled by having Fred Myer's shopping center across the street and the  5 bus lines which stopped in front of the building to give me a 5-minute lift to downtown.  Also, the manager, Shelly  always seemed to be around when I needed help with a smile.

This apartment complex recently changed management and it has been terrible ever since. We recently turned out rent into the dropbox on time, only to receive a form stating that they never received our rent, which we owed ASAP and a late fee about 4 days later. When we called to talk to someone about the issue, we found out that they were missing 6 other rent checks and that someone's rent check had been stolen and attempted to be cashed by an unknown person. Turns out someone had used something to open the dropbox and steal rent checks. Rather than noticing that it was questionable so many rent checks were stolen and looking into it, they just decided to charge everyone for late rent. That's not at all the end of it. Our fire alarm battery died a bit ago and we let the old management know that we needed a new one, which they never ended up bring us before management changed. With new management always brings apartment inspections. When they saw our alarm down still needing a battery they decided to charge us a $250 fee. After we told the leasing lady, Michelle, that we had already reported the dead battery and had been waiting for the battery and we couldn't really afford a fee that we didn't think we deserved since we had taken the appropriate steps to take care of the issue, she simply stated, "well if you have documentation of that then we will see but its no skin off my back". $250 isn't chump change for us and her belittling comment was more than offensive. She said she would look to see if old management had kept records of our request and maybe we wouldn't have to pay. A couple days later we opened our door to find an envelope with a balance statement for the $250 fee and a hand written note stating "sorry no record found from old management and it is the same situation for other tenets who reported dead batteries but never got them. Sorry." So how is it our fault that the old management wasn't very thorough and clearly if so many other tenets were experiencing the same issues, why do we have to pay for their mistakes. It is simply because to this terrible management company we are all just rent checks. No compassion or understanding from any of them. I highly suggest you look somewhere else for housing or be prepared to deal with a management company that will treat you like you are nothing.

The previous property management company was very responsive, kind, and considerate. They just recently changed management and the transition has been very rocky. The apartments are in decent condition but could use some maintence. They are also very loud from I-5 traffic. Since the new management has taken over I have had a very difficult time getting in touch with anyone regarding basic questions despite leaving multiple messages. Even when I was able to get through no one seemed to be able to answer my questions. I hope that they can get back to the swing of things quickly.

The manager is dishonest.  IPM will do everything they can to keep your money from you. There's garbage all over the place,  and they don't clean it up. They say they have a dog park, workout room, etc. but none of it is ever available to use.

They will take electricity from you without paying for it.

They will overcharge you for water, sewer, and garbage (it will range between $140-360 a month). When you confront them they will lie about being compensated by the Portland Water Bureau.

Our car was broken into while in the parking lot.

They will fail to refund your deposit, or give a reason why they are keeping it. I have been waiting almost 3 months for a resolution to their incompetence, and they continue to send me to someone who cannot communicate properly.

The manager is never in the office. He doesn't know how to check his email for 30 day notices. Incompetence is the nicest way to express their ability to function honorably.

I've been living here for 2 years, and can only speak to the one and two bedroom units they have, but can attest to the other reviewers experience with insulation (noise is awful, even through concrete walls). They're constantly doing "landscaping" which it seems is just their excuse to make tenants take down any garden beds or plants they've put up themselves. The management company has changed 3 times since I've been here, and I haven't been able to get ahold of anyone (especially when someone parks in our space) since I moved in. Posted office hours are not adhered to, and I was directly told by the current property manager that tenants are supposed to "set a good example" for each other by following the policies - which feels super childish and unprofessional. 
I can't wait to move out.

Where to begin. The insulation for the apartments is horrible. Noise carries from everywhere, whether it's someone parking their car in the parking spot that is below your apartment or the constant "landscaping" going on. I use the term lovely as it never adds anything to the complex. No one is ever in the leasing office and getting a hold of anyone for any issues is impossible after you move in. The ownership of the complex has changed 3 times in the past year. The "remodeling" done to the apartment is worse than putting make-up on a pig. I regret moving in and eagerly await moving out. Please do yourself a favor and avoid this place, learn from my mistake.

Very few quality amenities. The “gym” is terrible. You can’t even call it a gym. There’s a reason they don’t even show it in any pictures. No rooftop lounge. No sauna, jacuzzi, etc. Limited paid street parking. The concrete floors are impossible to clean if that is important to you.  Everything in the immediate area has a massive homeless presence including the closest gas station and Walgreens. Vehicle break-ins and bike theft in the small garage that costs $275 per month.  The mail area has had package theft because they leave packages literally lying on the floor in the lobby……IN PORTLAND.  There are around 20 there right now. 

For what they charge for rent here, there are MUCH better options in MUCH better neighborhoods within a short drive from here. Especially if work downtown. After living here, I honestly recommend avoiding this property.
I Love the building. Centrally located and walking distance to some of our favorite spots, a huge plus for us! The slate team was super responsive and our cross-country move was pretty seamless.

I was one of the first tenants to move into Slate 3 years ago. I was drawn to the modern open living design, views in all directions, the proximity to downtown, multiple bus lines and the PDX streetcar. The east end of the Burnside Bridge is developing at our doorstep. New cafes, shops, restaurants, spas, services and bars have opened within blocks of our building. A great management team runs the building and maintenance has been top notch. The building is safe, secure, quiet and pet friendly. Highly recommend!

We love our apartment and building location. Design touches create a great modern aesthetic and a bright and warm home. Apartment is quiet, even in a bustling neighborhood. Property service is not on site, but close by and helpful. We love living within walking distance of some of the best bars and restaurants in Portland, including hidden gems in the warehouse district. It’s also cool to be next door to Burnside Skatepark and Knot Springs.

The office staff has been great. Maintenance was fantastic til I noticed a break in the fence which was allowing people from the neighboring apartment to come onto the property, smoke fentanyl, leave drug paraphernalia (still there), and was told if I want privacy I should buy a home by victor. What I expect is maintenance to be ok with performing maintenance tasks. What I expect is to get a response regarding no accessible parking in the back. What I expect is to see the security that’s supposed to be here from 8-8 like I was told when we signed the lease.

Oversold on property - would recommend checking your unit prior to lease signing. Was told about major renovations that were delaying availability and although some may be true, many things like basic upkeep are lacking; doors don't close all the way, baseboards in bathrooms stripping off walls, and seems they tried to put a coat of paint over everything to take away from the focus on the overall wear down of the property. Claims no smoking but I see tenants smoking on back porch almost daily. Overall disappointed with what I feel I was promised.
Mariela is the best, thanks to her we have a beautiful place to call home. Very understanding and patient. Answered all our questions. Will highly recommend

This is a nice community with quiet spaces and excellent service and attention, from employees that are always willing to attend to the needs or concern. we have been here for a short time but we already feel at home.
So far so good. Got a little frustrated during the move in but, it was during the holiday time so things happen. The apartments are beautifully laid out and have great amount of space!

I like living here. Neighbors are mindful and friendly. There seems to be a lot of police calls though. Not really sure why but I've seen a decent amount of police cars and cops talking to residents in my one year of living here. Besides that it's been great. And it doesn't feel like anything scary has happened? Hopefully just noise complaints or something.

All the good reviews are before the change in management in December 2020. The elevator is broken, and they will tell you they’re planning to fix it soon, but they have not scheduled a repair, but they gave me multiple false timelines. I love my neighbors and the charm of the old building, but there is shotty workmanship galore. I’m glad to be leaving. Management sent out typo ridden rants, although they seem more professional since mid 2023. Must have been a complaint, as staffing has not changed. The manager never leavers her apartment but is constantly watching the cameras. She used to email about every small incident in the lobby, it feels like living in a surveillance state. They claim the cameras for our safety, but they didn’t cover our mailboxes which could have been fixed by adjusting the camera by a few feet. Mailboxes have since been moved to a package room that recently got a camera after package theft got out of control. Latex paint was used over oil paint, and is splattered over every fixture, even lights, and many outlets are painted over which is just unsafe. The sinks were refinished incorrectly and peeled away within weeks, trapping food and bacteria galore. The only good things I have to say about the management, is that repairs are remarkably quick and they love cats!

I have lived at the Manhattan Apartments for a year now and I could not be more pleased with the experience. The property manager and the owner have been extremely friendly and helpful. They are always available to answer questions and post info relevant to residents in the lobby/halls/on doors with plenty of notice. The building is definitely older and shows some signs of wear, but there is so much character and it has been well maintained. The neighborhood is perfect with easy walking access to multiple grocery stores, parks, trails, and public transit. We have not had any issues with noise within the building, just usually city sounds being so close to downtown! Overall a great experience so far.

It was very sad moment to leave this place after only six months. what a great community, what a friendly and kind professional leasing staff, what a quiet and safe neighborhood. It is in a walk distance from whatever we need (Restaurants, Markets, Buses, Trains, Banks, Clinics...etc.) I will miss this place for sure, and I will always recommend it to others.

Sad To Say Goodbye After Only 6 Months!
I had a wonderful time here. The professional leasing staff is always greet you with a nice smile, warm welcome, and great faith. The apartments are nice, clean and quiet. it is located in a walk distance from whatever you need (Markets, restaurants, clinics, coffee shops, pharmacies, gyms, bus stations ... etc). You couldn't feel safer any where else in Portland as you feel in this neighborhood. I will always recommend these apartments to others.

Location is great, and some units look nice when you tour them, but once you sign your lease the staff act like they are having a contest to see who can provide the worst possible customer experience. Some of them act like they have no idea what customer service is.

The building is under a constant state of construction as the owner is trying to optimize his profit by squeezing as many new apartments as possible into formerly larger apartments. Expect horrendously loud construction most days of the week, sometimes even on Saturdays. And all of the new units mean they don't have enough parking for some residents who then have to park on the street and risk getting their car burglarized, which has happened to a number of residents. Some cars also get burglarized in the secure parking garage.

Unless this will be your very first apartment after living in a noisy college dorm I'd look elsewhere. Don't be fooled by this place.

Management is horrible. People keep taking my assigned parking spot and they refuse to tow. I only signed a lease because I got assigned parking. Then I park in the wrong spot, and they tow me. What a joke. Otherwise the building is ok not great, decent location, but I've only lived there for two weeks.

However, if management is this incompetent with parking, I am dreading ever having a maintenance or emergency issue with the apartment itself. 100% regret signing the lease. Don't live here.

I've lived at Vista St, Clair for 3 years and currently starting my 4th. I am very happy here for the following reasons:
- Location, location, location
- The views!!!
- Management is great, they are responsive and they truly care about the resident's needs
- Maintenance crew and and response to requests is very fast and they are good at their job, once fixed it doesn't break again. 
- online portal works very well
- The building is very nice with the remodel and it is very comfortable in all common areas, you can work out or BBQ anytime and it is usually available or most of my neighbors I've come across have shared the space with no hesitation. 
- The building was built a while back so the walls are concrete, I never hear my neighbors. 
- They have 3 elevators, easy moving in and out for sure with their dock station too in the back
- Easy Highway access, various bus stops, walk to the max is super quick
- great location for a timbers fan

Cons:

- Depending on which side you are facing but it can get very warm in the summer, windows only crack open about 3in. AC external unit available but installation by maintenance is pricey   electricity. 
- This is more of a complaint but worth mentioning; Street Parking is basically nonexistent, even with the zone parking you will spend game nights after work during Timbers season driving around for hours trying to find a spot and if you do it will be on the other side of Washington park
- You can only get xfinity 
- Gym equipment is old and feels insecure sometimes but the room is nice with large mirrors if you like to do yoga or other non-machine workouts. Newer machines would make it as good as LA Fitness for sure. 

Cons are not big enough to drop it from 5 stars, overall I'm happy to call Vista my home and could see myself here for longer if need be.

Is the VSC the BEST apartment building in the Goose Hollow/Nob Hill area? No, I cannot say that. But considering how astronomical rents have gotten in the last few years, VSC offers the best bang for your buck. Hands down, the best part of my experience here is the management. Kearsten, Ryan, Jayselle and the rest of their team work tirelessly to respond to resident concerns/questions/complaints in a prompt and professional manner. The maintenance staff is equally impressive by addressing issues very quickly and effectively. 

About the building itself, clearly this is an older property that once used to cater to elite residents. I stayed here 10 years ago and felt it could use a facelift. It is getting just that right now. Granted this is talking a lot of time and certainly has been inconvenient for months at a stretch. But I have to commend the team on timely communication on updates and progress. The apartments are not very big and the kitchens are ridiculously small (at least in the 1br plans). But I cannot complain about storage space. Rent is way more reasonable here than at most places in the area. Garage parking is also competitively priced but the spaces are unfairly small.

Also, you gotta love the location! Washington Park, NW23rd, downtown, MAX stops are all within minutes. But that uphill climb every day sure gives you a good workout !

Tenants tend to vary from 19-22yr old college kids (rich parents?) to retirees. My one big complaint/peeve is that the building is NOT pet-friendly. It may be the ONLY property of its size in the area (or the city?) that isn't pet-friendly. In a dog-loving city like Portland, this is really ridiculous.

All things considered, you get a very good deal and I recommend this place.
Love the location. Management is friendly and helpful. Great views. Nice community of longtime residents.

The management is extremely helpful with any questions and Carmen, Kiersten and Ryan have always been to answer any questions i had. Maintenance orders are taken care of in 24 hours. The location is great and close to bus stops and grocery stores and trails leading to Washington Park. The tenants are a good mix of retirees, professionals and students and they have a weekly friday social in the lounge. The management organizes events in the lounge and sundeck in summer and they are fun. I like it here.
Easy move in process, same day showing. I'm excited for the roof top pool. I haven't moved in yet but the kitchen was spacious and walk in closet. Seems like a friendly chill environment.
Quiera was pleasant and more than helpful within the entire process. The apartment was easy to get into and it was an easy move. The other tenants were welcoming
Fast and friendly staff. Beautiful apartments. I was able to get in quickly and love the space im in. Fantastic amenities and a great view. Highly recommend.
Amazing amenities and love the neighborhood with so many food , drink , and fun venue to go out for entertainment .  Wish more parking was available

I resided in the Modera Akoya apartment complex from Feb 2023 to Feb 2024, and here's my honest review.

During my initial tour, I was meant to view a vacant 1-bedroom unit, but there was a mix-up with keys, leaving me waiting for 15 minutes. This hiccup was just the start of my concerns at Modera Akoya.

Starting with the positives, the complex's location is convenient with easy access to various amenities and freeway routes. The facility itself is well-maintained, boasting outstanding amenities such as a top-notch gym and scenic rooftop views.

However, the 1-bedroom unit I stayed in had its drawbacks, including a dark interior and an awkward layout. The absence of overhead lights in the living room and limited natural light were notable downsides. Despite this, the unit featured stainless steel appliances and a few convenient features like soft-close cabinets and a water filter attached to the fridge.

Moving on to the negatives, residents often abused the facilities, leading to trash and other waste being left in common areas. Verbal and physical altercations were not uncommon, contributing to a feeling of unease. Additionally, during summer, the rooftop became a hotspot for disruptive parties, and amenities were sometimes closed without explanation.

Security was a major concern, highlighted by multiple break-ins at the storage lockers. Despite reporting incidents, management's response was inadequate, leaving residents uninformed about security risks. The lack of security presence despite signs claiming otherwise further exacerbated safety concerns.

My attempts to seek compensation for stolen items were met with dismissive responses from management, and promises to improve security were not fulfilled. The passive-aggressive and unprofessional behavior from management, coupled with security lapses and disruptive resident behavior, made it a regrettable living situation. If you're considering moving in, I'd suggest exploring other options.

Everyone is super friendly and helpful. My kids and I love living here and hope to continue to. We’ve faced an uncertain year and have been blessed by the location, amenities and the apartment itself. There’s nowhere else I’d rather be!

What does yard do that is rarely seen in other apartments? The building is mostly concrete so noise is non existent, the only noise you are bound to hear is from the hallway. The lack of sound is really the best thing about this place. What does it do badly? Ask anyone who has lived here longer than a few months and they will tell you that the parking garage is a nightmare. I've been hit 2 times in 1 year in this garage, it is so tight that if you own a large vehicle your life will be hell every time you leave or return.

needed something. The whole property is always SO clean, it really feels luxury. The only downsides that I personally experienced were: the computer and printer never work in the office. Although the office is awesome. The only way I figured out how to print anything is by using a thumb drive and plugging it right into the printer. Also, the garage doors seem to be broken a lot. Although that's not Yard's fault, they don't manage the parking garage. And it's about $250/month I believe. I have spent 3 years parking on the street, so it IS possible, if you are looking to save money. If you or your kid loves skateboarding, this place is perfect. It is directly above Burnside Skatepark and my son practically lived down there. Despite it being a little sketch because there are homeless people on the street (just as everywhere else), it is pretty safe. Although my car has been stolen and windows broken out several times. So better to park in the garage if you can! It is also within walking distance to so many places and on all the main transit lines which has been super helpful.

I don't usually write reviews unless I feel like a person or a company went above and beyond or the service was absolutely horrible. In this case, Yard PDX was/is absolutely horrible. I pay $195 a month for "secure" parking, yet my car got broken into not once, but twice. I know at least eight other residents who have had their bikes stolen from the bike room and multiple people who have had items stolen from a "secure" storage room. The management's explanation for this is "Criminals around the city have gotten more brazen."  This is supposed to be a luxury apartment building. Yet, they don't have sufficient security even though they have had an ongoing theft problem for well over a year. When I asked if the cameras in the garage caught the person who broke out my back window, they said: "we only have a camera at the entrances and nowhere else." This is a 4-story parking structure and they have no security and only two cameras that don't even record inside of the garage.

The old management team was incredible, and it actually felt like they cared about the residents. The new management team does everything in their power to deflect responsibility.  Even though this is all happening inside of the building that they manage. If this were a one-time thing, I would get it, but this has been going on for some time now, and they haven't done anything at all to better serve their residents.

I’ve lived in the Yard apartments for about 3 months now. The community areas (lobby, mail room, gym, outdoor area) always seem to be clean and appealing. The actual apartments are good sized and come with washer/dryer and kitchen appliances. The leasing office usually has someone in it and they have always been helpful when I stop in. However, in the 3 months I’ve lived there the parking garage exits/entrances have been broken down at least once a week and there is an elevator or two down every other week.

I absolutely adore living at Laurel 42 and having Jose as my property manager, along with all of the staff including Roberto! I feel extremely safe in the building and in my apartment. Delivery companies always comment on the security of the building. Due to Roberto, the garbage area, elevators, stairwells are always clean and smell good. Jose's door is always open to ask a question or inquiry. The garage is just an added bonus to this fabulous property. Now that it's so beautiful outside, I couldn't enjoy my beautiful deck more! I can leave my back door open all day, which allows my cat to never want me to move again!!! I doubt if I ever will.
Being in between all the great things in NE and SE Portland makes it a great place to live.
Very great apartment complex close to everything you need. Great staff.
Beyond thankful for what the Laurel42 community has to offer. They provide nothing but excelent service.

I was nervous to live here as Im use to my old place and my old neighbors but this place has brought me a sense of peace and Im loving it. The staff Samantha and Jose are top tier they are so helpful, fast and just made me feel welcome since day 1. The building is clean and quiet. The neighbors Ive met so far are so friendly and have the cutest little fur babies. My kids are thrilled and so happy to be here. Thank you Jose and Samantha

I'm so happy with my experience so far at Laurel42. I just moved in 2 days ago. I'm shocked at how beautiful and well maintained everything is. The appliances are large and in perfect condition. I can't even find anything broken or damaged to note on my move in inspection. Everyone I've met, Samantha, Jose and Steven have been so helpful and really made the application and move in process seamless. I've been bragging to my friends and family what a great place I got especially for the value.

The elevators have been on the blink for several months and there is an intermittent alarm sounding that supposedly cannot be turned off.  Even though it's not coming from the elevators,  it's coming from the main lobby.  The parking garage door was damaged and it took an entire month to get it fixed.  Management flat out refused to reduce the fee for the month even though the parking was not secure and cars were vandalized.  The outside lights are always missing bulbs.  I haven't seen the fountain on since I've lived here.  So many little things that are not good.

It’s really disheartening to have to write this review but I wish I had known prior to moving into this complex. We have lived here 2.5 years. Our storage unit got broken into 3 times and our vehicle has been broken into 2 times. Thousands of dollars later, the complex continues to refuse to do anything to protect its residents and at this point it is negligence. They told us they are not required to provide footage to the police and it was a courtesy they were doing so. If you are thinking about living here I would pursue other complexes that offer more security and are responsive to complaints by residents.
We had an amazing experience living at Bridgetown. Tiffany and Cristina in the office are very accessible and helpful with all inquiries. Super dog friendly, amazing location, great amenities.

I moved into Bridgetown Lofts in December of 2018. So far, I have nothing but total love for my new apartment. I have literally nothing to complain about; I haven't, so far, had to make any maintenance requests or experienced any hassle with the management. I actually rented the place sight unseen-- I was moving from far away and couldn't visit. Tiffany (in particular) made that process easy, she sent me so many helpful pictures and gave me confidence that I was making the right choice. I have never lived in a better place!!

My pup and I relocated from Michigan to Portland for work recently and I cannot be any happier with Bridgetown Lofts! I toured about 8 or 9 different apartment complexes on my initial visit to Portland and was blown away by the amazing customer service, competitive prices, and amenities Bridgetown offers. Daniel and Maureen are amazing to deal with. Both making my cross country move less stressful and reassuring that I chose the right place to live.

This is a brand new building located less than a mile from the heart of the Pearl District. Beautiful apartments (some with awesome, polished concrete floors). Extremely pet friendly with a breath taking rooftop and view of the Fremont Bridge. Being so close to the bridge was a concern due to the noise but inside the building and my apartment, I don't even notice. 

I highly recommend Bridgetown Lofts and love coming home every day!

I rented a ground level studio apartment next to the stairwell sight unseen because the property managers KNOW HOW TO SELL and they don't care if it's true or not. I was sold on 24/7 monitoring, a quiet place to live and a vibrant community. You get none of that. In four months I had four packages and a bike stolen out of a monitored secured parking lot? The monitoring they sell you on is a joke. They don't face the entrances, the bike rack, the parking lot, mailboxes or tenant doors and no one ever looks at them and if you do report anything to them or ask them to check camera footage they just tell you to call the cops. 

Quiet? not even a little. There is a didgeridoo (a beautifully annoying instrument) that plays for a few hours a day and it is a non smoking building so people are always in their cars outside ground level apartments blasting music in the middle of the night or just having flagrant and loud fights outside of the ground level windows.

When I moved in I was given the wrong contact information and  asked for correct information 4 times but never received it. I went two months where no one would respond to my emails or phone calls and the 24/7 security number they give you for lock outs goes to the main answering machine where the manager is for maybe 45 minutes out of the week but there is no time posted so you just have to guess when you'll see her. The callbox is fantastic if they choose to actually put you in it (I never made it after almost five months). At some point in my time here they switched property managers but didn't inform anyone in the building that it occurred or that we would have a brief time where there was literally no one tending to the property.

The apartment itself has an eight foot window and no natural lighting, make it make sense because I can't. The apartments have no ventilation so it always smells stale regardless of what I tried to do. If the temperature is above 65 or you use your oven your apartment will be 100 and if it's cold your apartment is now under 40 degrees. The L shaped "small studios" are SMALL. The bathrooms are 110 sq. ft. the living space is also 110 sq. feet (closet, living room, dining room and bedroom) and the entryway/kitchen is 90 sq. ft. of unusable space so I could only open my fridge even though the only furniture I have is a fullsize bed, a 52 inch couch and a small dresser. 

All in all I terminated my lease 7 months early and it was the only positive experience I had here.

I rented a studio apartment from them for this last Summer. It was small, dank, and musty with ZERO ventilation. The heat was unbearable this summer, as there was no airflow or air conditioning. I started experiences heat flashes when I have never before had such a health problem. The apartment management is the worst management I have ever had to deal with, they never answer their phone even on work hours, forcing me to spend the night at another place when I lost my fab. My shower was backed up with sewage and it took them days to respond and perform maintenance. When notifying them of my health concerns, they completely ignored me and had NO care for their tenants or their health. Please do not make the mistake I did, do not rent with this company as they have no concern for their tenants.

The Monroe is a fantastic building. The staff are just wonderful, quite hospitable. I love the tenants, the beautiful units, the fact that it is within walking distance to great food and New Seasons Market. So close to the waterfront, I walk there at least twice a week. I would not think of living anywhere else in all of Multnomah County.

Absolutely horrific management, unsafe building, multiple break ins, most of the common area things have been stolen (benches, TV's, Coffee Machines), smoking in hallways, the place is rarely cleaned. Smells horrible. DO NOT MOVE HERE!!

Management is awful. The building has serious safety issues (tenants attempting to break into other units, items being stolen, etc) and management refuses to take actions even with the simplest of requests (trying to coordinate how to pay final bill). 

If you value your safety go to the many other buildings in the neighborhood I wouldn’t want my worst enemy to have to live at this building. 

If I could leave 0 stars I would, would not be surprised if the building is half empty in the next few months.

Do yourself a favor and avoid this property. It may look "cute", but management is unresponsive and does not keep any promises. The building is NOT regularly cleaned or even monitored. There have been attempted break ins. Items (like the TV, coffee maker) have been stolen from common areas. "Emergency 24 hour maintenance" will take your phone number down and never call you back. Terrible

Clean building and very quiet for the most part.  For the price of my studio here, its the best deal in the area that ive seen, and i got 1 month free! Staff is super friendly and my service request for my room always get done very quickly!  No complaints at all!

I've been in my apartment for just a short time and I'm loving it. The apartments are VERY quiet, even with quite a few dogs here. The studios are small but for one person, it's enough. The appliances are new and beautiful; full size washer and dryer! (That alone is worth the price). Wood style laminate flooring, very nice and pretty. There is a cool dimming light system and electronic A/C / Heating system, ceiling fan, and windows that are large enough to let in the right amount of natural light. If you don't pay for parking in the garage, parking can kinda be a pain but the neighbors are quiet and seem decent enough to not have to worry too much about your vehicle. (knock on wood). The 6th floor is the roof top and while it is small, it seems nice for a nice day. There is a bar-b-que and sink outside for small gatherings. It also seems super secure, camera's are located in the halls and entrances along with a keyless security system to get into the building. My view isn't the greatest, but it's not the worst. I've gotten use to it already. I hope I enjoy the rest of my lease enough to want to stay longer.
Terrible management, car break ins, packages stolen, dog poop in the hallway, “gym” is 1 treadmill in a dark room WAY OVERPRICED
Great prices and wonderful deals along with very fair costs of living
Revolving door of property managers that don't take care of the serious issues here with crime and violence (including from residents).
Good central location to mass transit and freeways.
The management was very kind and helpful and answered all of my questions when needed. And it’s a very nice community around the area.
Staff are friendly and helpful, always try to make it right. Apartment has a great location, you are still downtown but it feels safe and tucked away.
Clean and welcoming. The people living there are kind and keep to themselves mostly but it is a nice community

I was moved into an apartment with a major plumbing issue the building new about and lied about! The heating is abysmal, I have no control over it and it's always too cold or too hot. The windows are ancient and need desperately to be replaced with properly fitted and sealed modern windows. The pipes are full of rush and constantly spit brown water out. I had to install a special expensive water filter in the shower so my hair would stop falling out. And they just raised the price, so if you move in today all of this will be yours for more than $100 more a month than I paid less than a year ago.
I’ve only lived here a few weeks but I absolutely love it.
Great apartments and management. Definitely recommended
Safe place , clean and well maintained . Place that I call home. Blessed to live here!

Great place to live! Management is very helpful , kind and ready to help when we are in needs . Clean and safe place , security cameras. Renting here is affordable. 
5 stars from my family for Melrose apartment
If you are an adult professional person who appreciates when rules are followed and contract you sign followed ,this is the place for you!!

My family hase lived here going on ten years ..the management has been probky the best ive seen for this sort of complex ...the place is newly renovated and always well maintained..the management has taken great strides to not only make this place a eye appealing place to live but a safe comfortable place to live ..you wont have to worry bout your place being broke into or your car cause they are on it ..its nice living in a place that the management team actually does what you should expect management to do ..you need it fixed they fix it you call telling them there is a suspicious non resident lurking around they are right there in thier face ..their tennants privacy safety and well being is certainly a priority to them ...and it shows  ...management takes any problems or concerns you might have seriously and swiftly ..great extremely hard working people  and they have certainly made Melrose court a great place to live ...if anyone has anything negative to say about this place or the managment they really need to look in the mirror and ask themselves really why ..all tenants are treated equally and fairly ..i cant say enough good things about this place and to be honest ..when the day comes that its time to move on it will be a sad one ...i love this place ...
Melrose is a great place. One of the best apartments around this area.Great on site managers ready to help us any time are needed. I give them 5 stars . They deserve it .

Unfortunately, my son and I are exposed to nail salon fumes when in our apartment unit. If you choose to live here, be careful about which unit you pick. We are often feeling sick due to the strong chemical fumes, which enter from the Dipped Salon below into our unit. We have been here since July 2023 and management recently came into our unit at my request and agreed they smelled the strong fumes. We try to stay with friends, travel or use the common areas as much as we can to stay out of our unit for which I pay $$$. My son is young and I worry about his health. It's not just a nuisance, it's a health concern. Even the hair salon adjacent to the Dipped Nails has complained about their fumes. Management tried to appease my concerns by explaining they are working with the salon regarding proper ventilation. However, it's impossible to block the air from circulating. This was a problem with another building here that housed Burger Deluxe.  Residents in that building found the cooking smells a major nuisance. The burger place eventually shut down. I find it surprising that a nail salon is even permitted to operate below a residential space. It smells like rotten cabbage and is unbearable at times. However, there are no units available for me to transfer to, so it is making the situation very stressful and unpleasant, while paying a premium in rent. I was shocked that my rent was increased despite this being an ongoing issue. Management offered the solution for me to move to another unit if I am "so concerned about my health" but they have increased the rent to what I am paying (and more) on units that are actually smaller than mine. Lastly, you are also expected to pay a hefty utilities and common areas fee. So currently I am paying $3000 per month for a one bedroom with a den and lots of nail salon fumes. The other issues that bother us: Star Cycle music and "whoos" early in the morning and major traffic noise in the bedroom, which we are afraid to use due to the fumes. Parking is also extra and there is no effort to retain loyal residents. I'm not going to get into the maintenance and cleanliness of the courtyard furniture and hot tub. Compared to the past management, the new management is a breath of fresh air.  However, the air in my unit is far from fresh.

I would like to mention that it is a treasure to have Brianna on the front lines as community first response staff. She did great with following up all the way to completion of the work request. Brianna is amazing to work with, she his very personable and caring in her approach to helping others. Bri is a big reason why it's great to reside at The Windward in Lake Oswego. Thank you.
I am new in Lake Oswego and finding The Windward makes it possible to get to know this community well before putting more roots down.  Happy to be here and to be in the Windward.

The windward leasing team has been wonderful to deal with. I like all the different floor plans.
But was shocked about having to pay for common areas and they absurd an amount for the parking on premise.

The Windward is a wonderful property to call home. It is within walking distance of several restaurants and grocery stores. It's location in the central village area of Lake Oswego gives many opportunities for social outings.
I am proud to call the Windward my temporary home. We moved here from So Cal to be close to our daughter’s family. The transition from single family residence has been easy and uplifting.

I have lived at Oswego Cove for almost 2 years, and I absolutely love it here! It is quiet and secluded, no traffic noise whatsoever! The nearby foresty-style landscaping and walking trail make it feel so peaceful. Add to that the year-round heated pool & spa, and wonderful staff! I can't say enough about it here. I hope to be here for a long time.

I recently moved to Lake Oswego, Oregon from Virginia.  Not an easy task.  Settling in, love the neighborhood and would recommend this apartment. 

Oswego Cove caught my attention on-line.  Largest (2 bdrms) with nice amenities (W/D, FP, pool/Jacuzzi, work-out room and free access to Mt. Park Rec Center), non-smoking in my price range.  Lacks the high-end interior upgrades, lovely landscaping and spectacular views of some others in the neighborhood, but I find it to be a nice, clean, well maintained, spacious (large rooms), quiet complex located in a very nice residential neighborhood with easy access to I-5/Rte 217 and conveniences.  I’m happy on the 3rd floor, (the stairs are worth experiencing greater peace, privacy and safety).

Management/office staff top notch!  My long list of questions about the apartment and surrounding community were kindly and thoroughly answered, with quick responses and follow-up and pictures to boot!  I experienced patience and flexibility to my long distance challenges, and after 2 months I find the same courtesies to be true in-person.  

Necessary conveniences are close with a range of options. Ten minutes either direction to major shopping  (Bridgeport or Washington Square).   

Biggest negatives for me include a lack of closet space - no hall/coat closet!  (Somehow that got by me.) No walk-in closet in MBR and no organizationally updated closets (CA closets)!  This leaves me lacking closet space big time!  The kitchen pantry and linnen closet help!  With a larger vanity, MB could have more counter space.  Covered old fashion interior lights and bone/beige walls make lighting and atmosphere an issue, both could easily and inexpensively be improved. (Maybe this review will help.)

A few ants visited MB at move-in but have since gone away, and appear to be a non-issue.  

Kudos to MOD Pizza for a great free pizza on my first visit!
Pizzicato and Pizza Schmizza (Pricey & $3 delivery fee) need to step it up!   45 min. prior to close, neither could provide their delivery service due to staff shortage.  Too bad!

Driveway is messed up. You have to enter/exit a certain way if you have a normal newer car otherwise you scrap the asphalt. People from the neighborhood regularly walk through property because there's a open gate so anyone and everyone walks through constantly. Landlord allows pitbulls and heavy dogs to live on upper floors which you can hear running around all day. The walking around of residence in their apartments sounds like stomping because the construction is bare minimum. Gutters are leaking all over. Maintenance people leave mortar mess and never cleans it up or the area where they have their storage. Plus they power wash the sidewalks and spray dirt all over the windows and never clean it up. The residents are slobs that can't even get their recycling into the right containers or they don't break down the cardboard and just leave it on the ground. They raise the rent every year even during the pandemic!!! The rental office is never open.
Great apartment, amenities, location, management etc. Would highly recommend!
Great place to live if you want to be surrounded by the downtown experience!

The apartment itself is nice. The office team is so friendly. My neighbors are cool. I just think when it comes to maintenance it could be better. Im not sure if the place was just built in a hurry or what but it seems like it was just thrown together as things break very easily. It also takes a long time for things to get fixed. Im not mad at anything but theres definitely room for improvement.

I have never lived in an apartment this nice! The attention to detail in the build of these apartments and the views of the city from both my windows AND the gorgeous rooftop patioamazing. The amenities are so generous and the staff really made me feel welcome in my new home. I love it!
overpriced for what/where it is. lots of fire engine sirens day and night, plus lots of loud and visible mental health issues close by in the adjacent streets.
Nothing but good things to say. I truly enjoy living here!
Beautiful aesthetically, energetically and environmentally! :)

I enjoy the location and the amenities of this apartment. I walk to most of the stores and restaurants in the area. The roof top deck is beautiful and the gym is clean and has the right amount of equipment to get a quick workout in before work.

The property is overpriced for what it offers. There is zero insulation/noise detinning  between apartments horizontally and vertically. You can hear every single foot step above you or tv/music in apartments next to you. For a luxury apartment, this is by far the poorest construction I have seen. Not worth your money.

We have loved our stay thus far. Sarah goes above and beyond every time I ask her for something. She made our move-in easy. Sarah and the rest of the staff are amicable, and they ensure that all our needs are met.
The management team is quick to respond and take care of the tenants. On top of that the building is in a prime location and its features are worth taking note of.

Great place to live, everyones friendly and very positive when interacting. I lost my engagement ring in the trash shoot an Zac the manager was so helpful we dug through the trash compactor and it was just the most kindest thing in the world due to situation a having to do with trash, not many would volunteer for that so it was greatly appreciated. Sarah and Zac are always so very pleasant to deal with an really do make living there enjoyable. Great team!!
Good place to live in a very walkable neighborhood. Great amenities.

They recently started a remodel; painting, replacing light fixtures and carpets in the hallways. Before the place was quiet, you couldn't hear people in the hallways or other dogs bark but since replacing the carpet the hallways echo and you hear almost everything/one. Our lease is up in September and we're counting down the days until we can move out.

The location is great and the building is clean, I have to give it that. It looks new, but it is missing a lot of the amenities you might expect — there's no AC and the heating is old, radiant heat.
There is a fair amount of turnover with management so things don't get addressed right away.
The walls are very thin. This is one of the noisiest places I've ever lived in. Never had to sleep with earplugs until now.
They charge for cleaning when you leave, like a lot, so don't expect your deposit back.

The building itself is alright.  There are less in-unit amenities than I would like (no washer/dryer, DW is very dated, doesnt come with a microwave) but I'm fine with that.  I have adapted.  However, what I have not adapted to is the lack of responsibility that the management company takes when dealing with issues.  There have been "transients" squatting on the roof of the building for the last week and no action has been taken.  The police were called last night and were unable to do anything since the roof doors were locked.  That's fine, I understand that's a safety thing.  However, when the emergency maintenance line was called to get the police on the roof, no one responded to the call and nothing could be done.  Management rarely responds to emails, and frequently says they will take care of something, and then it never happens.
