I've been living at The Peak for the past year, and overall, it's been a great experience. The location is one of its best features--it's close to local shops, restaurants, and public transportation, which makes getting around a breeze. If you don't have a car, there's easy access to bus stops, and if you do, there's ample parking space, which is always a plus.

The apartment itself is spacious and well-maintained. I have a three bedroom unit, and there's plenty of room for everything I need. The layout is open, with a comfortable living room and a kitchen that's surprisingly big for an apartment. I also really appreciate the natural light that floods in from the large windows, which make the space feel even bigger. The appliances are modern, and I haven't had any issues with maintenance so far. When I did need a couple of things fixed, the maintenance team responded quickly and were very friendly.

The building is generally quiet, and the neighbors are respectful. I haven't had many problems with noise, and I feel safe walking around the complex at any time of day or night. The grounds are clean and well-kept, and there's even a small gym and pool that I've used a few times--great amenities if you want to stay active without leaving home.

Overall, I've really enjoyed my time at The Peak. It's a comfortable, safe, and convenient place to live, with responsive management and solid amenities. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a place in the area.
They take your $100 hold even if you still want to rent here & need to change your move in date!! So if life happens, don’t bother because they’re inconsiderate. Stay away from Vista Ridge!

I am a first time renter and I chose Vista Ridge Apartments as my first apartment. I have live here for about a week now and I can’t think of a single complaint. I live in a 1x1 apartment that has been updated. The renovations are absolutely beautiful. The complex is gated adding safety to all tenants. The complex grounds are well maintained and have a wonderful look. The view from my balcony is beautiful. There is a lot of storage space in each unit. I have had no issue with finding guest parking. The office staff is very friendly. The area is perfect. Right off of I-80 making commute easy. Every store and restaurant is within five minutes. Nestled into a suburban area making it a perfect home. I’ll likely post an update after I have lived here longer.
Great staff and great place to live! My apartment had a beautiful view of downtown, I will defiantly miss living here.

Vista ridge is a great place, the apartment itself is very spacious, with walking closet, washer dryer in each unit. The maintenance staff is very friendly and quick to respond to any issues. The office staff is very professional and help with any issues. This apartment complex is blocks away from Walmart and other shopping centers, easy access to the freeway.

Great living spaces master bedroom separated from other bedroom by living room and kitchen areas as well as in unit washer and dryer, with a balcony over looking the city of reno. spacious, clean apartment with beautiful views from every window. In quite neighborhood located near lots of shopping areas as well as outdoor activities,  such as trails and parks. Also very pet friendly with access to multiple outdoor areas located with in the gated community of the apartments. Apartments that are nestled in North west reno conveniently next to 24 hr fitness. Vista ridge also includes swimming pool and year round spa, gym, bbq areas, recreational activities.  Really great atmosphere as well as great staff the maintenance crew is amazing. Really loved calling this place home for the past year

By far the worst apartment complex I have ever lived in. It is a premium amount of rent with NO amenities that are promised. They will NOT take ANY responsibility for anything that is not taken care of, they have had a spa that we were PROMISED would be up and going when we were touring the place a year and a half ago (hint, it’s still not up) and we have had work orders that are either months in without being taken care of, or promptly closed without any notification. Oh, and when all of this is brought up and why it’s not taken care of, their response is ‘we go home to be with our families on the weekends’.

Wouldn’t recommend, to anyone.

Management has communicated with me well over the months that I've lived here. Any issues I have with appliances are taken care of promptly and management has followed up with me later to ensure my issue was fixed.
People within the complex are friendly. The complex itself isn't rowdy or noisy, usually tends to stay very quiet in my area. 
Bugs are hardly an issue. I have seen 1 spider inside the apartment and maybe some wasps/hornets outside on the balcony, but a can of raid is plenty. 
Location of the apartments is great because you're close to grocery stores, food, airport and Huffaker park trails. From my experience, this place is great for what you pay.

Last year I had a hornets nest growing in the light on my out door patio area. I called the office to come take care of it, and they assured me that pest control would be out to take care of it that week. Three weeks later they finally show up but I had to lie and say that I was allergic and that could cause legal issues for anything to actually happen.

Now I have a mouse in my apartment. Yes a MOUSE!!! I called the office to report it and get pest control back out here. They assured me that they would be there the next day to take care of it. I had to go out and get traps myself because no one ever showed up, after 11 am no one in the office would answer the phones, and no one seems alarmed that their buildings have mice. If they don't care about that, what else have they just let slide. GROSS!! - Will be moving out as soon as my lease is up.

Absolutely the worst place I've ever lived. The management has such a blatant disregard for their residents that it could be argued that they are at best negligent and at worst cruel. I went through the summer without an AC because they constantly had to get "approvals" every time they looked at it, so my apartment was 100° or higher during the day on most days.

During the past few months they've taken to towing vehicles for arbitrary reasons, and mine were towed twice. The first time they said it was because the car appeared to be "abandoned", yesterday (Thanksgiving) they towed a newly purchased truck. I don't understand how they could justify that, they ruined a holiday and a celebration of a new big purchase by towing it.

Last time they towed a car, they told me they'd reach out to me if it was in front of my apartment, but they didn't.

From day one, they've lied to me. I toured the wrong apartment (have video proof), and the paperwork I signed on was not the same apartment. Instead I got one with torn up carpet, missing kitchen drawer, an insecurely mounted towel rack, and a broken toilet paper mount. Management is comprised by monstrous individuals, vile villains, and thugs. Using extortion on a new vehicle on Thanksgiving is inexcusable.

I'm tired of being lied to over and over again, I'm tired of the abuse, and I'm tired of making excuses for them. I am livid, how do they justify this behavior to themselves? Who goes outside on Thanksgiving and looks for resident vehicles that tow away? I've spent nearly $1,000 in towing services because of their cruelty. I've spent a summer sweating bullets, I've been living with torn up carpet and an improperly mounted towel rack, and this all started when I was signing paperwork for the wrong apartment.

I urge anyone looking for a place to stay to steer clear of this establishment. They don't care about you, they don't even pretend to. With as expensive as their rent is, you'd think they would at least give you respect at a premium, but that has never been the case, and I see no evidence they will begin doing the right thing. They truly garbage, and you'd be better off to bypass this level of harassment.

How could a management group allow this to happen.
HOW COULD THEY ALLOW THIS SITUATION TO CONTINUE?

Upstairs neighbors urinating on our porch daily.  Throwing rotten foot at our front door.  we've had many police calls and the police even went to confront the management team for allowing this to go on.  NO CHANGES
ONLY "talking to".  

Neighbors from hell.  They were caught dumping a bucket of urine on our porch after maintenance pressure washed our filthy deck.

Many incidents where we have found urine, vomit, vacuum cleaner junk, garbage tossed on our entrances and back patios from upstairs and our property becoming completely ruined i.e. chairs and barbeque.   Dogs roam unleashed.  Loud screaming and music every night (has gotten better after calling police many times).

The absolutely filthy condition of our patios due to upstairs neighbors truely ruined what would be a wonderful remodeled apartment and to terminate the lease would be equivalent to 2 months rent, so take this into consideration before rolling the dice.

Since they are bribing everyone with gift cards... Since FPI took over everything has gone down hill.  They never answer the phone.  Maintenance requests take weeks or months to get completed.  Sometimes they never do.  You can submit a maintenance request through the app and they close it out as completed without it ever being completed.  You pay ridiculous amounts for water, sewer, and trash when there is no way for them to prove your usage.  The neighbors hook up hoses to wash their cars, water the trees, clean off their porches and all that does is run up the bill.  Then they charge you an extra $25 valet trash fee for someone to come pick up your trash Monday-Friday, you have no choice but to pay this fee on top of your regular trash fee.  In the summer you will pay way more for water, sewer, and trash.  They say they don't include the sprinklers in what the residents pay for water but they can't ever explain the huge increases.  We're talking roughly $100 a month more in the summer. The fees they charge for "utilities" are more than you would pay for a house with a yard to water.  Anyone that doesn't have a renovated apartment has to move out for 2 weeks when their lease is up, at their own expense, before they will renew the lease.  You can't throw paint on an old building, replace the wood floors with linoleum, put in some new counters and paint on the walls and call these luxury apartments.  There is dog poop all over the grass and they don't maintain the landscaping.  Believe all the negative reviews you read online, they are true.  Any recent positive review is because they're literally telling people to write a good review for a gift card.  Not to mention the crappy attitudes the women in the office have.  When the snow arrives be prepared to shovel it yourself because they do not.  Stay away, stay far away. Oh, there's been 3 slab leaks in less than  3 years which causes most of the 1st floor to be covered in inches of water.  It takes them a month to finish all the repairs and that's only because you have to harass them yourself to get it done.  The list goes on.  It used to be nice before FPI took over.  Find somewhere else to live.

New and clean, efficient, good outdoor lighting.  The community room has taken some time to complete but there is a gym and it is quiet and convenient - can walk to bus terminal and some eateries, the movie theatre.
Look at the outside of the building. This place is gross.

For the extreme prices we’re paying, we expected much more than we’ve got. The apartment itself is beautiful. But the windows are filthy and covered in bird poop, unable to be cleaned yourself. The waterfall is the main attraction but hasn’t been on once. The fake plants aren’t even done being filled in, the gym has a broken treadmill already, the common areas are all consistently trashed and never cleaned. The “clubhouse” has flooded twice. Which we also all share the water, so we paid for the floods :-) The garage is literally already falling apart, chunks of the ceiling just fall off. Completely unsafe. Wifi went out for two full days- completely unacceptable. They also demand repeated alarm testing which is absurd and uncalled for. Trash room is disgusting, there is never any maintenance done on the building, half of the amenities they boast are not here, the few calls i’ve made to the office they have been extremely rude, the list goes on. Children steal weights and break gym equipment, they don’t even care enough to spell correctly on any of the signs. This place has so much potential and it is so sad that they are letting it go down the drain. It is extremely expensive and I have had better service and amenities at half the cost.

Don't live here. Wifi is frequently out. Common areas are unclean. Common area bathroom does not include a trashcan(seriously). Signs across the property are misspelled, staff is rude, effort put into this place is 0. Don't sign here, you'll regret it.

I just recently moved into Atrium from another building in the area, and I am so pleased with this building. The price is appropriate for the amenities and just the general quality of the building and units themselves. The lighting and natural light along with the light colored floors makes the apartment so beautiful and bright. I love it here!

I lived here for 2 years and HATED to move out, but needed to relocate for work.  

Kevin (maintenance) was on the spot.  If I had any issues, big or small, he was on top of it, always smiling, and willing to get the job done.

Joanne (manager) was very helpful in the entire process.  She was always willing to answer questions and help where she could.

Love the common area.  I hosted my friends every Sunday during football and they loved it.  Two TV's, pool table, golf game, couches, and a small kitchenette with a bar was great!    Close to so many locally owned restaurants it was difficult to choose where to go.  

All utilities were included in the rent, water, sewage, cable, internet, electricity, etc.  Very convenient!

Good:  Love the style and concrete floors
            Great location
            Pet friendly

Bad:  Continue to add service fees 
          Maintenance is a joke
          Video security does not work
          Parking is not assigned and not monitored
          Very cheap appliances, no ice maker

The people that run this place are all college kids who know nothing about running an apartment and the apartment manager isnt any better. They loose your packages, will watch you on camera to try and find things to fine you for, and the amenities are always broken or closed for way longer than what they say. This apartment is cheaply made and everything in it breaks. I recommend you live quite literally anywhere else.

it seems like every other day there is something going wrong. I've lived here for a year and a half and have had nothing but problems with the management it seems like it's impossible for them to keep employees because every other month I'm dealing with someone new. they nickel and dime you for every little expense. it's just a bunch of people in an office who just don't know what they're doing. if you value your money and want your kids to live in a decent place THEN DONT CHOOSE THIS PROPERTY

I work from home and their internet and lack of management has put me out of a job, and in debt to the company. Not to mention living in circus circus for three months with no clear information from staff. I don’t know how to make it more clear if you value your time and money DO NOT LIVE HERE.
This property doesn’t offer parking for residents. The parking garage is full and they don’t offer any other viable parking solutions.

Rent is way to much for the amenities that are provided. They will just enter your home with little to no warning, even when requested not too. There was a dead bat on the wall by the pool for months and it was not cleaned up. Good luck getting ahold of someone when you call the office. For how much you pay I recommend going to another place. Again worst part is the lack of privacy you have no idea when they will enter your home.
Apartment has great views and amenities are within the building. Restaurants, groceries, shopping and Movies are within a 1 mile distance. Nancy was super helpful with the move in.

My wife and I will be relocating to Reno next month for jobs - we visited Emory as a "backup plan" because the housing market in Reno has made it challenging to find rental homes ... to our surprise, we enjoyed so much of what Emory has to offer that we signed a lease before even visiting half of our other scheduled tours. The units are refined, polished, and modern. The bigger selling point is the entire district of amenities, which seems to be ideal for young professionals (especially Nevada transplants, like us!) who are looking to be a part of an active community, find friends, enjoy the beautiful community-based amenities (pool, gym, events, movie theater), and live close to downtown and midtown. 

Looking forward to moving in to our new home in a few weeks!!

Management spends their time harassing tenants over silly rules that no one follows. Valet trash is a joke. Parking is non existent unless you park by the mailbox/units with attached garages. Overpriced with minimal effort on repairing previous tenants damage. Old dirty stained carpet.

I want to start by saying I was the Montebello's biggest fan for my first year and a half as a resident. The apartments themselves are great and I've never had any issues with maintenance or staff before today.

I walked outside this morning to make a Costco run and my car was missing. My immediate thought was that I may have left it unlocked and it was stolen -- my heart sank. I called the front office where I was told that they had not authorized any tows in the past week. I was given the number to their tow partner and told I could check with them, but the Montebello did NOT request a tow.

Upon calling the tow company I was informed that my car was marked BY MONTEBELLO (where my car is registered to my apartment) on Monday for 48 hour tow. It has been snowing all week and I work remotely, so I had not driven my car since we went out over the weekend. Confused and annoyed (but relieved it wasn't stolen), I called back the building with the rational expectation that they would remedy their error -- this is where it gets fun.

Montebello began by telling me that they have a policy where a car has to be moved every 1-2 weeks just so that other residents have fair access to the "up for grab" spots -- never heard of it before, but fine, my car was just gone all night five days ago. Problem solved right? Negative. They told me that their parking lot staff "must have thought my car hadn't moved in a while" and that made it my fault. I was responsible for Uberring to the other side of the city and paying to get my car out of impound. 

Whether the manager of the complex is unable to solve this issue or refused to, this ordeal raised MAJOR red flags as a resident. The towing company was somehow more understanding than my complex and at least gave me a discount. Insane that I pay my rent every month and park my registered vehicle in an available spot (only one assigned spot per apartment and my roommate uses it) and I am towed and somehow on the hook for it "because I had 48 hour notice posted on my car". Make sure you don't take a weekend trip if you want to live here or they'll be entitled to tow your car and make you pay for it!

I have been at Montebello for a couple of years now and this is the BEST apartment complex in Reno. The leasing office girls are very efficient and always are responsive with answering calls and emails. Maintenance team is AMAZING, they always take care of the apartment needs in a timely manner.
Have enjoyed being a resident here. Very nice views and entire staff is awesome so is maintenance getting all work done in a fast matter.

The administration of the complex and units is exceptional. I've lived here for a little more than a year and I haven't had any issues or concerns. The complex is in every case all around kept up even with dog proprietors who slack off getting after there pets. Any issue that I've had in my unit includes been amended inside 48 hours. Sink waste allocator to seals on my entryway. All staff from the primary office to the upkeep group have been inviting and moral and have gone above to guarantee my stay here is comfortable.

I used to live at Montebello for a bit and I really enjoyed my time there. I moved to a complex in South Reno and completely regret it. Montebello is in a nice location and the area is pretty quiet no trouble there at all. I miss their spacious apartments and their huge bathtub in the master was amazing.

Management does not care… Have waited for an ice maker for almost a year and the fireplace to be fixed since November 2022. Have called and stopped in office repeatedly with no help. Have been in apartment since 2015, never been a day late with rent and it means nothing.

Understaffed and everything gets blamed on staff. But the real issue is ownership. The owners are trying to squeeze more money anyway they can. Cheap renovations. Cant open drawers because appliances are in the way. Weeks to get fully working appliances. Hot tub regularly left running for entire weekends overflowing everywhere. And the list goes on. The only ratings for 5 stars on here are from coersion because this place is terrible. Need new owners asap otherwise look elsewhere! Money trap! Greedy owners! Good luck.

The unit was putrid and moldy. I wish I could give zero stars.The entire unit smelt of filth due to waste caked on the master toilet. We were supposed to move in the 15th of November but the cleaners didn’t show up until 6:00 pm. When we moved in the following day, the apartment was still filthy. Spent one night, found mold the following day and left. Maintenance and cleaning after the previous tenant was almost nonexistent, every issue I found had a band aid fix. I won’t list all the issues but will provide pictures of water damage, mold, and the previous tenants filth still caked on the master toilet. Management is pathetic and ownership is apathetic towards our issues. Truly a pathetic effort.

We managed to find a different complex to live. While we did receive a refund, they charged us for the 5 days that we had the keys even though the unit still wasn’t move in ready by the time we left. Management and ownership should be embarrassed.

I have very bad experience at this place 
Staff not listening to resident concern, one day the staff yelled at me over the phone and never listen to my discussion. Non respectful.
No parking lots specific for resident your will suffer every day to park your car near your unit.
No care of inside road tracks, when snowing it will be a mess.

At some point in time these apartments were nice. They used to be well maintenance and taken care of, but as of now that is no longer the case. The complex is overrun by squirrels and ants, the landscaping is maintained very poorly(weeds everywhere.) The pool area is not very well maintained either, generally the pool has plenty of leaves and trash inside. The pool bathrooms are a horrible mess, there was a trashcan outside the bathroom that remained full for about two weeks. Most of the pool furniture is destroyed. The pool area is covered in weeds and once again ants everywhere around the pool. There is a waterfall near the pool that was just finally turned on with a month left in the season. Maintenance in the apartments themselves is done just as well as the pool. The maintenance men are known to come into your house with a key without notifying you so be aware of that if you sign a lease. The repairs to apartments after move out is done very poorly and usually on the past tenants dime. Don't believe this site listing granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, neither of the three models I was shown includes either of these things. My unit itself also does not have stainless or granite. These apartments used to be nice, they are not anymore. Please spend the extra 50-100$ and go somewhere nicer.

Nice apartments, were condos prior to becoming a apt complex, management better then before , but when u move out they go after you for everything including carpets etc, they want apts to be turn key, without painting or new carpets and they go after the last tenet with a vengeance. GET LAWYER when moving out.

We are seniors an have lived here for approximately 8 years,,,There are quite a few long term residents here that love this place as we do.  Manager/Owner is very nice an friendly,,, Maintenance is on site an responds to any needs immediately day or night. Any negative reviews are more than likely evicted tenants that caused trouble or did not pay their rent in a timely manner. Our manager does not put up with any bull,, an we love that....  Rob & Luc

This was the worst rental experience of my life.  Constant, never-ending repairs.  Leaking roof/ceiling worse than what you can imagine.  Leasing office is rarely open.  Laundry facility is a joke - it's nice to look at, but if you think you'll be able to use it, think again.  Most washers and dryers are broken and have been broken for over two years that I am aware of.  Parking is a joke.  One reserved spot.  Less than adequate guest parking - I have one neighbor who has five cars;  one in reserved spot (broke down, no tags, out of state license) and the other four are in guest spots.  Property manager is completely apathetic and unconcerned.  You will get tired of calling about needed repairs.  I lived in two separate units here.  The first unit leaked in the master bedroom every time it sprinkled outside.  Unfortunately, the leaking roof didn't stop when the rain did due to the rain water pooling on the roof.  What a joke!  Property manager is more interested in telling me that "We have the money to pay for it.  We just can't find anyone in the area to do the work."  LIAR!  This went on for over 6 months.  Save yourself the headache and stress that goes along with living here.  Read the reviews on other sites.  Also search "Fairway Park Manor" on a popular video hosting site for evidence of other peoples' experiences.

Worst place I have ever lived. The staff is so mean, and they will do absolutely nothing if you have issues with your place. I called about lights not working, about dishwasher leaking, people in my assigned parking and all of those things I had to fix myself.

Everything falls apart! They will come and fix a issue all for it to fall back off the next day.  We were told we needed new carpet and then was told that's never going to happen.  I don't do reviews but on this place I have to!  The blinds are so cheap they are always breaking and expect you to pay and fix them.  Windows are not double pane so electric bill is really high and feels like a cold breeze is always coming in and you also hear everything outside! I would be happy here if they cared about the people living in their apartments and made things right without making you feel like you're the one in the wrong cause everything is cheap from the 70s and always breaks.  Don't be misled by the pictures this place is like a bad dream. I hate even being in my apartment and that's really sad for how much I pay monthly.  Fix stuff the right way and don't make people feel like they're crazy just cause they want to pay to live in a nice place like the pictures show.

The apartment is.... fine there is a lot of bugs but that’s fine too.. what really sucks are the managers if you leave anything outside your door they will threaten you with eviction (even if there isn’t anything outside) and if say, one of your blinds is bent out of place they will again threaten to evict you or charge you $40 to get them fixed. (when they are not even broken) as long as you don’t mind having f*cking a**holes constantly blaming you for things then the place is fine. Also don’t bother going to the pool it is unsupervised and kids will throw footballs across the pools and nearly drown you by canonballing on top of you.

The staff at this complex made getting information about a unit impossible. I was repeatedly interrupted, cut off, or ignored by staff when trying to get information about unit prices/application process/deposits/amenities/etc. Not to mention from what I see, the deposits are outrageous anyway. Literally any other complex has better pricing and SIGNIFICANTLY BETTER CUSTOMER SERVICE. If one intends to LIVE at your property, you probably shouldnt start off treating them like trash.

Property looks appealing from the outside, inside is really out dated and always really cold. The walls have cracks everywhere and crumble when even touched in some places. Base boards were removed a lot time ago but they should of kept them on, it looks awful. Not to mention nails from the structure itself are poking out in the bedrooms! Oh, and beatles EVEN WHERE in the summer, inside, outside, on windows, it's awful. Closet doors keep falling off, they've fixed them over 10 times within 2 years but refuse to replace them, and everything is super cheap, the blinds break when pulling them up, then they tell you to pay for new blinds...$24 per blind from them just so they can do it over and over, and if blinds are broken they give you 24 hours to replace them or you will get eviction notices. Learned my lesson the second pair of replacements. Went to walmart, got a grade up which made a lot of difference, cordless, total of 3 sets for $36!! $24 buying from them PER SET is just not okay, especially when they are the lowest of quality. Also, teeagers and kids EVERYWHERE during summer. They tear things up and they won't do anything unless you know who the kids are and live, I'm not a creeper, just get security you claim we have to go out and investigate for us!

My husband and I moved into Rosewood soon after we were married. At first it was great but we couldn't wait to get out of this place. We would come home after work to our apartment smelling like pot and the office did nothing about it. We had a convertible and our top was sliced open. When we complained to the office they said there was nothing they could do about it. We renewed our lease and were told the rent was being raised due to an increase in loving expenses and had to choose free carpet cleaning or new paint job. We chose carpet cleaning and never got it. Instead when we moved out we were expected to pay for the carpets to be cleaned. People will park in your spot and  all the office will do is give you a note to put on their car. My husband and I needed help to get an item off the wall when we moved and asked the office for help. They told us to go find maintenance on the ground somewhere if we wanted help. They don't care about you and will threaten to evict you when you put in a notice. Don't ever go here! They raise the rent every renewal and the place continues to go down hill. Stay away!

The apartment is dirty and the people in the office are rude especially the manager. The neighbors are creepy I used to live here and I complain about my neighbor about how creepy they were but the people in the office didn't do anything about it the worst place ever zero star at all not even 1 star

STAY AWAY!!!! As another person commented here, they don't charge you a deposit but when you move out they renovate the apartment on your dime. I lived in this place for five years only because moving is such a hassle and when I left they charged me for new carpets, new blinds and others, and when I left the unit was in very similar condition as it was when I moved in. The carpets probably did need to be replaced but not on my dime after five years, they weren't new when I moved in. Combine that with the two buildings burning down while I lived there, the drug deals that happen behind all the time, and as mentioned terrible customer service makes this place a bad choice. STAY AWAY!!! ZERO STARS!

I have lived here 4 years and have had no issues. The staff is very friendly. Its close to shopping. The apartments are spacious and a little outdated but is currently under remodeling. They keep the pools, the gym, and the grounds well maintained. I feel safe here. Very family friendly. A nice place to live.

Awful conditions. The outside balcony is literally caving in, there's a hole in our bathtub (before we even moved in), poor sealing on windows and door, and a maintenance crew that's nowhere to be found. The ladies in the office are very sweet, but overall not very helpful. The lure of no first months rent and no deposit are tempting, but overall not worth it.
Very peaceful place. Management is very nice and understanding of situations. Clean and great laundry rooms, gym and pools plus a playground for our daughter.

I have lived in a one bedroom apartment at Rosewood Park Apartments for 5 years.  The complex is well maintained inside and out.  The staff is very helpful and responsive to my needs.  I never have a problem with getting something fixed at any hour of the day.  I feel safe here.  Their rates are good for our area.  I would recommend this complex to anyone.  I have referred several of my friends here and they love it too.

When my wife and I first moved into rosewood park apartments it was great, now after half a year we don't like being by a pool. Pool hours are open until 10pm at night where the careless parents and teenagers go down there and scream and yell at the top of their lungs to what seems like much later than 10pm. Neighbors are noisy, no regard for others. 8 people in one apartment is unacceptable, especially for a 1 bedroom. Management is always on top of things, they always do updates to the complex, new paved roadways, deck replacements, etc. their staff in the front office is friendly and always helpful. The caretakers and maintenance do their jobs for the most part except for the walkway by our apartment area. Bushes overgrown and they haven't trimmed them for 3 months which makes it difficult to walk through especially with children. Gated community but as of this last month or so gates are inoperable making it open gate policy which I don't like at all. That's what we pay for is gated community. Other than those minor details, everything is pretty well taken care of. Lastly I do not like the usps timely delivery. 4:30-5:00pm is our mail time we are the last stop of the day which is really inconvenient. We like the apartment, like the access to our vehicle, other than the little things which I'm sure will be taken care of soon. Water is included which is a big plus, too.

24 hour emergency maintenance with ease. I've never had any trouble getting my A/C or heat fixed. Satellites are welcomed and my very large service dog was accepted with open arms. Everyone here is very friendly and the maintenence is amazing at keeping the property clean and beautiful. The insulation is great so any outside sounds stay outside. The only downside is the lack of washer and dryer in the unit, but the multiple laundry facilities on site makes it a short and easy walk. Let's not get started on the multitude of pool, hot tubs, and large gym.

apartmentName: Village at Arrowcreek Parkway & Village South
review: The property is decaying and management ignores requests from residents for upgrades or fixing. The reasons for not fixing things go from "no response" to obscure covid-19 restrictions. There can be 10 people heavily breathing in the gym, but no people on the clubhouse. Several (15+) residents I know dislike the place for the same reasons. The apartments are spacious and equipped with lower standard stainless steel appliances - it looks nice, but are poorly functional. The maintenance  employees (4 people) use the clubhouse in the morning and during lunch so resident are naturally excluded. The common area nice TVs you see do not work, they seem to be there simply to impress potential tenants. Lighting in several common areas require fix since a couple of years now. I just want to put these untold facts here to help you weigh your decision and hope none of the above is relevant to you.

apartmentName: Village at Arrowcreek Parkway & Village South
review: Very large and cozy apartment that comes with a garage for a price that is unbeatable. Justin really took care of us and made the whole moving process so much easier! If you’re planning on moving here, make sure you go and see Justin!

apartmentName: Village at Arrowcreek Parkway & Village South
review: Very spacious apartment. Well built. Nicely maintained. Great community. The staff is easy to work with and communicate very well.

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review: this location is great in offering easy access to restaurants, retail establishments, and public transit. the pool and fitness center in specific are excellent attributes to the community. Sheila is very accommodating, and maintenance is quick to respond to work orders, taking care of issues before they arise. all in all a lovely place to live. office staff is very welcoming, would definitely recommend.

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review:
Been here for some time. Watched as the neighbors and staff have changed. The manager is extremely rude. Yells and screams at you and blames you, the tenant for every fault even when she is breaking the law. Corporate does not respond to voicemails or emails . The maintenance men all complain about how many work orders the small complex has because everything is so worn down and old. Sometimes it takes months to get a repair done. If you say they have no permission to enter they come inside your house anyways! The property has animals of all kinds but over the last 3-4 months people have stopped picking up their dog poop so there is poop everywhere! Side walks, grass, rock areas. You tell the office and they don't do anything. If there is a problem you're supposed to be able to communicate this to the manager who's job is to insure the complex is kept clean and up to date for future tenants as well as current residents. This is not the case. All she will tell you is if you have a problem you can move instead of actually trying to fix the problem which is part of her job. 

Unfortunately Alot if people are in the same boat and stuck here because rates have increased everywhere and moving isn't an option. If someone insists on making their job in real estate/property management they should probably learn how to treat the people they service.

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review: Expect a massive rent increase every year that you are there if not the rent then expect your sewer, trash, and water to make up for the price increase. Sidewalks will never get salted during the winter, so be prepared for a skating rink. Everything is outdated - from the appliances to the amenities, for the price you pay, you can go 10 minutes south of Reno and be in luxury. FYI homeless people will always walk around on the property and leave trash everywhere. Also, the property went to non-smoking however the maintenance team will sit on their golf carts and smoke every stop they make. Lastly, hope you enjoy people that do not live on the property or near it to be camped in their motor homes all around the premises!

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review: When we first moved in everything seemed very nice. Except the fact that our move in date got pushed out twice by them. There were the normal first couple of days of checking out to see if anything needed to be fixed and of course there was. It took them 4 months before they even came to start fixing things and there was a lot. One of the biggest complaints was the fact that the seam of the sliding glass door leaked all across the top which meant it would soak the carpet when it would rain. The walls had marks that weren't painted. The screen in the kids room had big holes in it that never got fixed the whole year we lived there. The dryer would have to be ran 4 to 5 times just to dry things it didn't matter if there was a lot or a few things in it and this is just a few things. The only positive thing I have to say is the office staff was great at communication but that doesn't help if what is being said never has follow through. When we moved out the things that never got fixed we got charged for including water damage to the carpet by the sliding glass door, what a shocker. So basically their lack of interest in fixing things cost us a lot of money that was their responsibility.

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review: I've lived here almost 4 years now. It has been a great experience in all facets except one area! Unfortunately my rent has been raised considerably every year I've been here (over $200). That coupled with the water, trash and sewage (which has also tripled in $$) which the residents are responsible to pay, I can no longer afford it so I will have to move. Be aware,,, rent will go up every year you are here. I've never lived somewhere, that this has been like this. To say the least, I'm very disappointed because I did love it here.

apartmentName: The Lodge at McCarran Ranch Apartment Homes
review: I've lived in this apartment for almost 5 years, and I just love every minute of it.  It a very nice apartment, safe environment.  The staff are very helpful, and accommodating every time you call them for whatever reason.
The vertical layout is great. The garage has tons of storage space, and everything is nice and new.  The staff are all very friendly and helpful, and the grounds are well maintained.

I've lived here since this building was brand new. I will not renew  here any longer.

When they started "enforcing" parking, they reneged on promises given by to leaseholders and failed to follow up to even when they stated numerous times they would.

In the past month water has been shut off no less than 4 times. Never is there any update or information from management except when it is down, even though they promise updates.

The gates are continuously broken and again, never communicated as to when they will be fixed.

With all the inspections they do at this place, about one every other month, you would think they would have no issues.

There is a reason why most of the people who were here when this property opened are gone.

The gate that I, along with many others, have complained about and has been down for over a month has been fixed for about a week. Something a competent management company would advise their tenants of, but alas I guess we were supposed to find out by seeing the maintenance people go through  it. 

They did send a notice after this review was posted on another site...That notice was still wrong and they have yet to correct it.

I am a current resident on my fourth month at this complex. honestly, this complex is a fantastic place to live; short and/or long term. The staff is incredibly helpful, actively responsive and positive; plus nice!! The complex is routinely maintained and feels clean, safe and welcoming. You have all the accommodations; from your own parking space to multiple extra parking spots, a laundry facility (if you don’t have a W/D in unit, close to a beautifully park and the truckee river, shops, etc. The apartment unit we live in was newly renovated, clean and all rooms, doors, appliances, etc. i  working order. Also, this complex holds complex community events every so often and has a instagram page with the latest news. I definitely recommend this place to all!!
Manager Jennifer is very nice amd tries to address all issues. In a nice area.
The Park at Idlewild offers nice apartments in a convenient location for schools, groceries, and the downtown area.

Park at Idlewild is a pleasant place to call home.  The staff are amazing, and they are always willing to help.  The units are remodeled and some are a little aged, but maintenance responds quickly when needed.  We enjoy living here. :)

The best properties i have visited after moving to Reno. Went to about 10 and wasn't to thrilled about this or that about any of them. Then i  was directed to this property, and knew it was the one! Quiet neighbourhood, not even 5mins from the river. Then your about a 15 to 20 mins. walk from downtown. There us a busline on the 2 main streets. I'm not a fast-food person but it is available near by, grocery stores (2). Now some of the units have washer and dryer but some don't. But they do have on property facilities for that also. Schools are close by, also pet friendly. Great place to live!
I love living living here! Having Idlewild right across the street is perfect. Its so fun to walk over there for all the events, such as Food Truck Friday. Its great for my two dogs as well.

The apartment is beautiful but not worth the money what so ever or the hassle. Management and maintenance watch your every move. Accuse you of breaking rules without even questioning. Would not recommend

I dont understand the negative reviews. Our experience here has been phenomenal. The office staff, as well as the maintenance team are responsive, friendly, and give this place a sense of community. W/ covid going on, they have really done everything they can to keep things normal here by trying to keep amenities available, within state regulations. Also, having the lake to walk around is priceless. For the record, I do not work for this company, nor was I asked to write this. I just think they deserve some credit for the quality of this community.
The price posted and the price I was given are 2 different numbers Run

Horrific management. This place is a house of horrors. The front office would not hesitate to interpret your life. Onsite Management is confrontational and combative.  If you have children and live on an upper floor, If you don’t put your trash out from 8am - 4:30pm - if you bring anything but a hand type toy for your kids to the pool - don’t put anything in your garage that keeps you from parking you car in there,  you will get didactic lectures, threatening letters and multiple phone calls. Of course the managers put their Garbage outside at 7am. The managers put stuff in their garage for storage and park outside. Stay away

This property is beautifully situated beside a lake with lots of water fowl. Great walking path all the way around. The management work hard to build a great, friendly community by hosting events like pancake breakfasts, a Halloween Party and other Holiday parties. Apartments are beautiful and very functional.

Ive lived in the Moran Street apartments for two years. The right side of the building has a cockroach problem, and has since the first day we moved on. Not only does the office not notify anyone before they show the apartments, but they refuse to take responsibility as well. They say that someone sprays every two weeks, but I am never notified and I have yet to see a pest service more than a few times. Only once in the two years have they sprayed the entire building. I have watched numerous families with children move in and out because they were not notified of the cockroaches
 And in all the right side units the cockroaches are in the kitchen and bathrooms. Also they have it written in the lease that they do not have to offer you a lease renewal, instead they do not offer you a lease renewal and they move you month to month, then upcharge your rent and offer you a new contract. The owner of the property requests that the rental agency do this so they do not have to give you a 45 day legal written notice for the rental increase towards the end of your lease, so they decline your lease, move you month to month, then increase the rent and give you the option of signing a year lease, or stayinh month to month at a higher rate. Also the owner was planning on increasing the rent i$100 a month every year, the rental this year was $50 a month. Also the wifi always has no signal and the office will not call Charter. Moving as soon as we can afford it. Renter beware here!

The apartment was okay.  Nothing to brag about. Parking is a nightmare once you leave your assigned spot its open to all. Ive even been blocked in multiple times by people who should be parking on the property pulling right behind my car.  The main number is pointless to call. Maintenance is rude, Casey is nice and Rachel is nice. Whoever answers the number at the main office is rude. The say payment arrangements can be made on a form but when you ask about it they say thats not "a real thing its from the software used." This management makes things very difficult. If you leave your lease early (like we did) you get things even harder with more attitude. People smoke by their doors knowing you aren't allowed too then just leave their cigarettes everywhere making the place look trashy, they also leave their trash laying around especially down the stairs leading to the laundry making that a hazard. Only good thing is the free Wi-Fi.

I lived here for 9 months and for what you pay, it's not a bad place to live. The interior has all new appliances, flooring, etc. as of about a year ago. The apartment manager, Casey, was very helpful, although some of the other management I deal with was not as nice. Parking can be a bit of a challenge and the neighborhood isn't the nicest, but for the price it really wasn't a bad place to live.

The quality of the floors is the worst thing about these apartments in my opinion. The carpet is cheap and gets gross and hard quickly. The hardwood floor chips and breaks easily, and makes loud creaking noises when you walk. The floor plans look good online but aren’t as nice as they appear to be. The dog parks are very gross and never cleaned. The single car garages are absurdly small. Overall it’s just not worth the money.

The apartment itself is a bit above average, with super thin walls.  You can hear everything!

Facilities are nice but certainly not worth the money.  The maintenance guys are great.

This place is NOT quiet at all!  Barking dogs, screaming kids and super loud music.  And the loud music is all the time!

Forget having the security gate given everyone just drives right behind you without scanning in.  Nobody follows rules around here.

I’ve been a property manager myself for over 12 years back in California and moved here two years ago.

My husband and I are very picky when it comes to apartment complex living.
We were looking for a brand new beautiful luxurious living apartment, quiet, and great management. My knowledge and experience over the years helped me identify the right home very quickly.

I was looking to live in South Reno because this is the best area to leave. I searched the entire South Reno and found four decent apartment complex, and of course Harvest at Damonte Ranch was the best from all of them.
The apartment complex it is absolutely beautiful from all the amenities to the interior of the apartments and management.

It is very important to have a great manager in order to keep residents happy in such big community.
Lauren is doing a fantastic job with all the community events and creativity that she creates in a daily basis.
She keeps you up-to-date daily with any activity that is going on the property.
I highly recommend this apartment complex to anyone that is looking to live in South Reno, feel free to stop your search and come and live here because you’ll be more than satisfied with everything.

Harvest has many apartments to choose from and many of them are super quiet.
I have never experience any sort of noise in my home.
Again, we are very sad to leave this home if it wasn’t that we had to move back to California.
 I would’ve gladly make Harvest at Damonte Ranch our home for a long period of time.

This is by far the best luxury apartment community in the Reno area. It’s more affordable than the others and had more to offer! The only I wasn’t happy about is you can only have AT&T for cable/ internet.
Awesome place to live with all the needed amenities

We moved in September of 2023. Right out of the gate we were told that our apartment would have a fireplace. When we showed up to move our stuff in? No fireplace. Our fire alarm was broken and wouldnt stop screeching even after replacing batteries and the shower door is not even so the door opens no matter what. They sent maintenance to fix the shower but never fixed the smoke alarm. That was back in October of 2023. The shower door also still opens on one side every single time you open it. The smoke alarm is still not fixed as of 6/3/24. Then recently they messed up our billing, resulting in an additional 200.00 on my bill with no notice! They screwed up billing again by not telling me that the additional charge was going to be again billed, and wasn't put through with my rent which incurred a late fee ( that I had gotten worked out). Their late fees are 86.00. My AC is now out and I dread to see how long that will take to fix. The "balcony" is a joke, as its too small to even sit out on, and we no longer can decorate outside.

Additionally like others have said the gate has not worked, save about 4 days, since we moved in. As such we have homeless people filtering in and out of the complex, break ins to cars, and cops chasing people through our complex. This place is a joke

During my time there I had sent multiple noise complaints that were all ignored and the neighbor had never quieted down during my time living their (either neighbor because there were issues with both apartments on each side of me.) I had a horrific experience while living here! Never heard from management, extreme safety concerns within the area, and added fees to my rent that were not told to me! I would really do your research and read reviews before staying here, I would 100% not recommend it!

Absolutely do not move here.

Corporate housing company bought these units, all the staff were replaced and made me want to end my lease ASAP.

I loved living here!  In all the apartments we've lived in since 1994, this was our favorite.  It was very spacious and has many amenities not found in other apartments:  The laundry room is huge and is much better than machine in a closet.  The kitchen pantry is large and the kitchen counter space is excellent.  We lived in an apartment that faced other apartments and the trees and desert landscaping. I don't know how many of the comments up here are fake but I can tell you this is not a good place to stay for a long time and I cannot see a reason people give 5 stars to this place. 

Due to work I have to move from north reno to south and I found this apartment. You could say this is an OK place to stay in general. By ok I mean no HUGE issues. but once in a while you will be having small things bugging you from the manager, maintenance people causing you headache.  The environment is ok but I don't appreciate neighbors here, you can always find dog poops here and there. Small charges here and there for no reason and you know sometimes you just cannot argue.  I am glad I moved. btw, they took all the deposit and charged me extra $78 for the blinds which was broken by the maintenance people once they came in. still no way to argue.

I am so happy I found this apartment! I moved to Reno from Seattle and I did not have a clue about the neighborhoods, etc. I feel very safe here and Management and Maintenance are the best that I have ever dealt with. P.S. Love the free tanning bed too!!!

Sequoia is the worst property management company I’ve ever dealt with. My time at the Vintage has been a nightmare, and I can’t wait to move out.

During my lease, maintenance visits were random and ineffective, often marked as complete without resolution. My name wasn’t added to the gate list, which was less of an issue since the gate has been broken for most of my lease and makes loud noises.

Security is minimal; Signal makes occasional checks, but I’ve seen masked individuals breaking into cars. If you have a dog, invest in a headlamp due to poor lighting.

My air conditioner broke in summer and took about a month to fix. I noticed a strange taste in the bedroom, which worsened over time and was due to the previous tenant’s cat spraying. Despite using enzyme cleaners, the smell persisted and had seeped into the concrete. I had to move my bed to the dining area because the fumes were overwhelming. The carpet cleaner didn’t show up on the scheduled day, and when he did come, he was indifferent. The smell in the bedroom worsened, and the dining area also had a strong cat ammonia odor.

I’ve paid rent for months while essentially being poisoned. My dog and I have stayed with friends due to the apartment’s uninhabitable condition. I’ve spent hundreds on cleaning supplies and repairs, including removing urine-soaked wooden boards.

Last night, I had to open all the windows because of suffocating fumes and found more spots needing priming. The office suggested moving units, but given their track record, I’m wary of that. My lease ends in two months, so why pay for movers twice?

Their "valet" trash service is disruptive, with collections right outside the bedroom door at 2 or 3 a.m.

This place is poorly managed and dirty, with trash everywhere and filthy stairways. Positive reviews seem misleading. I hope this helps others avoid the same mistake.

I have lived at The Vintage on 3 separate occasions and have always loved my time here. The community is very well maintained, beautiful, and welcoming. This is absolutely one of the best apartment complexes to live at in Reno. I love it here!!!

This property has so much to offer and the staff truly makes you feel at home. The mature trees, grass and amenities are a plus. The grounds are clean and there is a beautiful pond on the back of the property!

This is advertised as a luxury complex with prices to match but things weren't as I expected. Here are some details:

* Dog waste everywhere: Dog waste is not picked up and is pervasive across the grounds; community rules around this are not enforced. For several consecutive weeks the overflowing dog waste receptacles were not emptied and it was not picked up on a regular cadence after that was sorted.

* Poor Safety: Cars are regularly broken into. There are no security cameras and I rarely saw security patrols even when I took my dog out late at night. There was a stabbing at the complex and no safety changes were made after that as far as I'm aware.

* Poor maintenance standards: Apartments that are up for rent and should be ready for move in are not. Mine was not ready by any means and was also very dirty and it took some serious complaints to fix, which they did. However, other apartments were in the same boat. For example, not long ago one was found to have a lot of mold under the kitchen sink with the floor in the kitchen bubbling up due to a long-standing leak when it was shown to a potential resident. The pool was closed for most of the summer because the pumps weren't working; garage doors are falling off their hinges and not fixed for months; the front gates had been broken for over 6 months and when they were finally fixed no residents who had moved in over the last 9+ months could be added to the directory. We kept getting promises that these things would be addressed and they weren't.


* There are lovely mature trees and grass areas here - there's a lot going for it! It's sad because I really liked my apartment layout and it was nice once everything was fixed. I liked my neighbors and made a lot of friends at the dog park, too. There was just too much that was not taken care of outside of my apartment and too many broken promises for me to stay.

I have lived here for 4 yrs. I love it here! The amenities and the office personnel are like family.

Me encanta! es súper tranquilo, excelente atención cuando necesitamos ayuda en arreglos o mantenciones! realmente es un lugar central y con acceso directo a todos los hermosos lugares de Reno! Súper recomendado!
Been here almost 3 years. Very quiet. Great neighbors. Great staff.

Truly a great place to live. Super neat and clean. Well maintained and the grounds are lovely. The staff is so kind and thoughtful. 
The apt. Is beautiful and spacious. We walk the trails near by and you can’t beat the lake walk. Everything works great. Anything that comes up is dealt with immediately. 
The community is safe and the neighbors are considerate. The location is exceptional with great shopping and schools. 
What a great place to live.

We love living at the Vintage. The apartments are spacious and luxuriously updated, we’re close to many grocery stores, and the staff is very friendly. The semi-private lake around back makes for a beautiful walk anytime of year.

In my past, 2 years was the longest I ever stayed in an apartment community because things always, inevitably go downhill with management changes, office staff turnover, etc. But I have lived at the Vintage at South Meadows for almost 8 years now, in 5 different units. We keep staying because of the following:

1. The Staff Cares - This is the first place Ive ever lived where the staff remembers your name, things about your life, and always has time to talk to you. When you have a problem, they will not only listen but, if its related to living here, they will go to bat for you to resolve it as quickly as they can. Sure, sometimes there are things outside of their control that cause issues, but they are always communicative and conscientious and work diligently to resolve things.

2. They Dont Pull One Over On You! - A lot of places tend to punish people for staying longer...you watch rent go down on new units while yours go up. Anytime we have ever had concerns about pricing, or bills, etc., they are always willing to hear us out and discuss things. You never feel like you are fighting a losing battle and the prices have stayed reasonable every time we have renewed or transferred.

3. The Community and the Homes - The property is well maintained, beautiful, and doesnt feel manufactured or cheap. The apartment homes are spacious, unique, and dont all look the same. The varying models suit whatever size or need you have for you and yours, and they are regularly upgrading to keep with the times.

4. Maintenance - While, like any other place, they can get bombarded and backed up,the maintenance team always responds to your requests and does their best to resolve them as quickly as possible. Anytime we have ever had an issue, we may have to wait for parts or due to a backlog, but the team stays in communication so we know whats going on.

All in all, the Vintage is great. I love living here and the staff are the most caring and genuine I have ever encountered!

Been here for a little over five years. 
The staff in the leasing office and the facilities staff rock. I’ve had normal wear and tear in my home, and anytime something breaks or needs a fixin, the crew always take care of me quick. 

Very dog friendly also, we got a 1km loop duck pond that is awesome for dog walks. Lots of poop stations for your fur babies. 

Tariq in the leasing office is super cool and will go out of his way to greet you and see how everything is going if he sees you walkin by. 

5 stars for friendly staff for being awesome!!

The maintenance does cookie cutter work. The upgrades look like crap. They did the countertops and around the sink looks like crap. The Vintage staff is great and so are the amenities! I love the lake and the walking path too! It really feels like a little neighborhood! :)

My son and I along with our our little fur family love living at the Vintage apartments. This is a safe feeling and quiet community. Dog friendly with plenty of little doggie stations to keep everything clean. There’s also a small fenced in dog area so that your dog can play off-leash with the neighbor dogs. ??

We love to walk around the little lake here to get exercise and view the wildlife. We have witnessed pelicans as well as turtles! We have seen a toad and there are plenty of geese and ducks to enjoy.

I’ve had a couple of maintenance requests since I moved in. They were handled quickly and professionally. The maintenance crew and office crew clearly work well together. Communication is always intelligent and tasks are swiftly completed.

I love that the Vintage Apartments has an online networking community for us residents. Once you live here you can chat with other residents on the community page. We like to post pictures of the beautiful scenery around the little lake!

I chose the Vintage over some of the newer complexes in the area for a very specific reason. It is an older complex, they don’t make them like they used to! I noticed they have been ‘slapping’ these newer apartment complexes together so quickly. The quality and craftsmanship shows at the Vintage. These buildings were made to be long-lasting family homes and not some quickly fabricated short term solution to a home.

When you are comparing the Vintage to other similar apartments in the area is the quality and professionalism of the staff. I shopped around and looked at quite a few apartments in this price range in this neighborhood before I rented at the Vintage. I was not impressed with the staff members at the other apartment complexes. They seemed disconnected, disinterested and unprofessional. The office staff at the Vintage are friendly, long-term employees who clearly care about their careers and the community here.

This is a comfortable place where you and your family can feel like you are at home.

I love my apartment! I have the dark wood cabinets, granite counter and so many windows! Beautiful views, nice neighbors and a lifestyle I can be proud of. 

And the pool is awesome.

The location is excellent with groceries stores, banks, restaurants nearby. Close trails for a good walk or even ride your bike. Easy access to the Interstate 580, only at 28.1 miles from Incline Village, NV. if you love to visit Lake Tahoe.

The Vintage personnel is awesome, very respectful and friendly, they really take care of you. 

I definitely recommend The Vintage at South Meadows to everyone looking for a place to called home.

Sincerely,

Gilberto Lopez

Overall, it’s a place to live. Can’t be picky these days. At least the staff is nice.

This place is infected.  The pest control is there just about every day.  Rent at your own risk.

My husband and I stayed in a one bedroom here for seven months. Good environment, area is good and so is the maintenance. The complex is quite during the night, and during the day children play and traffic is not to busy,very responsive apartment management.

Worst living experience ever especially having a pregnant girlfriend getting eaten alive by bed bugs. They didn’t do anything about the bugs and no AC and the pool doesn’t open it’s just for show. I've lived at Colony for 6 months and love it! The Manager and staff are friendly & my neighbors are nice. They are currently remodeling the complex and it looks beautiful. I have lived here for three years now, I have read some other reviews but some are not talking about this complex, the pool has been open every year that I have been here, the new management we have is really good, kind, friendly, helpful.
