Kids here play mainly unsupervised but have not been an issue or caused problems. The interior of my 3 bedroom is average size. It does not have an actual linen closet for towels, sheets, etc but instead offers a coat and regular room closet in the hallway and the master has a HUGE walk in closet(that could be either a closet or an office space because it is really that big) The washer dryer seems deluxe to me, as it gives generous space for those extra large loads and doesn't take hours to dry. The rooms are on the average size, big enough for a bed, dresser, and lamp and some leftover floor space. The apartment also gets lots of natural lighting from the windows, which I love. Overall, this is a great community to live in, and I am always trying to refer people here, especially coming from Ca where there were no affordable housing units EVER available. The process to get in was kind of a tedious task, but management works with you to make sure you get everything you need and answers questions you might have. I definitely am happy with my choice to live here and plan on being here for a while.

Zephyr Pointe is trash. Management is horrendous and breaks laws whenever possible to convenience themselves, including giving us notice that they would enter our apartment for an "inspection" at 9AM the next day, after giving us notice at 2PM. While this isn't a big deal to us - we don't have anything to hide and didn't need to do cleaning or anything, but the law states we need 24 hours notice, and we need that time to adjust our schedules around people walking in and out of our apartment. 

Parking is a nightmare - people park in other people's reserved parking spots, people street park like crazy, and nothing is ever done by management. 

When we were not given enough notice for an inspection, we refused entry as was our legal right, and then the retaliation started. We got a nasty note on our door for the next inspection a few days later (these happen all too often) and then we got nastiness from the management in the office, and they capped it off by screwing us on our deposit at the end of our lease. We moved out on 10/4, and got zero word from them about our deposit until yesterday, 11/29 when they called to say we owed them an extra $140 on top of our deposit for ridiculous charges, and if we did not pay by today (11/30) they threatened to send debt collection agencies after us which would destroy our credit. Keep in mind, we heard NOTHING from them until yesterday at 9:44 AM. 

There’s plenty more I could go on about, including people with loud cars and motorcycles revving their engines at 2 in the morning and neighbors selling drugs, but the worst part of our time at Zephyr Pointe was the management, plain and simple. 

Moving to Zephyr Pointe Apartments was a mistake, and I know I'm not alone - I have never met a tenant who is happy living there, and I'm so glad I have moved on. I just wish I had had this warning before I moved in!

DO NOT MOVE HERE. I lived here for a year and a half and it was the worst place I’ve ever lived. Management is awful and never dealt with any issues around the complex. The biggest issue while living there was parking. There is never anywhere to park unless you’re lucky enough to come home from work before 4pm and find a spot. I had one assigned parking spot and at least 10 times I came home to someone parked in my spot. I’m not joking. It was a nightmare. I complained enough that finally management decided to just give me tow notices to place on the cars when they were in my assigned spot but they still would never follow up to tow anyone! 

There were also several times that I almost hit a child while driving 5 mph through the parking lot because they would just run out from behind cars into the street and there were NEVER any parents around watching them. 

Management also tried entering my apartment without 24 hours notice. Luckily I caught them on it. They came into my apartment to do “inspections” so many times I lost count. I understand this is section 8, but it was beyond ridiculous. 

When I moved out, I waited over a month for my deposit, but instead got a phone call from them claiming I owed move out fees!! They claimed they sent a detailed list of expenses but I never received it. (I run an eBay shop and check my mail frequently, so there was no way I missed it.) They called me TWO DAYS before the fees were due and threatened to send the bill to collections even though I never got it. If you move here, expect to lose your entire deposit AND an additional $140 in fees! Paint alone was $355! Absolutely ridiculous. We left the apartment in great condition with no excess damage, just normal wear from living here for 1.5 years. This place takes advantage of the poor and people who don’t know any better. STAY AWAY. FAR FAR AWAY.
It has washer and dryer in apt. A nice pool. Staff is friendly and do repairs quickly. It has onsite gym and nice playgroud. Covered parking and central air conditioners in every apt.

We move in in December. Sarah and Alex have been amazing. It’s my first time living in Reno and this has been a wonderful experience. They accept dogs, and provide doggy bags and treats in the office. When we have any issues with spiders or the AC they put in an order and got it done the same week or even day.They communicate well to the community through emails and notes. They really do have amazing communication with us tenants. 10/10 so far from my experience living here.

Lots of hiking areas, beautiful all around! Big soccer field, cozy environment, safe, quiet & peaceful, no theft, no homeless around. Pool is great, stores and schools close by, close to tennis courts, no noise, close to cafe, freeway & gas station not far, lots of nature & beauty:)

We love where we live and absolutely love the view! We have bee here for over a year and the Maintenance guys are very kind, helpful and easy to get a hold of. The office ladies are amazing and very nice. the property is fairly well managed. My only complaint would be the limited parking available.

I've lived here for almost 3 years now. It's quiet, safe and the staff is super helpful and nice. The view alone is worth it to live here. If you're looking for an apartment in reno I highly recommend this one!

I just recently moved out in May after 13 months and I agree that you couldn’t pay me to live here. Dirty dangerous and expensive. It is a LANDLORDS TREATMENT apartment quality. The refurbishments online look nothing like the half-done job inside the frail apartments they lease to people. Property owner has zero interest in resolving the terrible parking (not just the space but the literal bumps, cracks, poles, etc laying out in the street easy to hit) and instead thinks that building a dirty indoor pool would be enough to appease residents and distract them from everything terrible going on here. 

Then, after moving out, they charged me for everything under the sun, and after paying a per deposit and regular deposit totaling almost $2k, they made me pay out extra on top of clearing me out. All I ever did was put holes in the walls, which they documented as $500, the rest was over the smallest things, my bill was two pages long. 

Long story short don’t live here if you value your experience and money. If you’re looking for a cheap place, this isn’t it either. If you’re looking for a dirty run down pile of garbage to live in while you get by paycheck to paycheck because of their outrageous pricing and unfavorable returns for said pricing, this is the perfect place for you!

I wouldn't move here again if they paid me. It's dirty expensive and dangerous. Cars and apartments are broken into. The laundry facility is disgusting and expensive. They have all sorts of fees for everything they can think of. On move out they charged me to clean the apartment, but funny thing is when I moved in there was mold on the walls and the carpets were gross. I had to clean before we moved in. This place is so poorly run I would believe any bad stories I hear. We're so happy we moved. For the price there are many other excellent properties in Reno. Any of them are better than this place

They are trying to rebrand as "Ascent on Steamboat", and I have no idea what that means but they definitely were 'ascented' on something when they came up with it. I've been trying to get in touch with the office to get several maintenance requests taken care of, and have been met with silence for WEEKS. Some of these things are major safety concerns - the decks on some of the units look like they are about to fall off, haven't been sanded or painted, and have nails coming out of them! 

My roommate had his car broken into, and they were  so incredibly rude and blamed him for the situation. "You shouldn't keep things visible in your car", "You need to file a police report, we aren't going to do anything about it" etc.

The pools have been closed for over a year now, and they finally tore down a bridge on the property that had the literal railing hanging off with nails sticking up that my dog almost stepped on. The pond in the back, which for the last two years has been a lovely spot for the frogs in the spring, was drained when the baby tadpoles were swimming in it, and left as an empty hunk of cement since last year. 

But hey, they had to get their pet project of repaving the parking lot in. That was super important. My appliances have been failing, the stairs leading up to my unit shake whenever you walk on them, and they've been closing maintenance requests without ever responding to them. But at least the asphalt is fresh.

If it weren't for the astounding views, I'd award this place 0 stars, for the worst management team to ever walk this plane. I'm hiring a lawyer and getting out of this disaster of a property. I advise you to look elsewhere, and don't let the scenery fool you, unless you plan on staying in a tent outside the whole time.

They must be posting fake reviews because I can't imagine anyone would enjoy living there. They NEVER EVER answer their phones. The pool is always closed. They don't repair things. And there is a lot of domestic violence. use caution!

I Loved living in these apartments, until someone robbed me inside the property, someone opened my car at night and took everything away. there are no cameras and  is not safety, I put the complaint in the office but I did not feel support and are not responsible.They just told me to talk to the police and my insurance, but I don't feel safe in this place.

I absolutely LOVE living in my apartment at Skyline Canyon! I first came across them when looking for a an apartment in Feb. 2019 before relocating from CA to Reno. I loved the property through pictures but it wasn't until April when I first stepped into what would be my new home. Tessa was incredibly engaging and easily welcomed me. She showed my the grounds, gave me background about the area and property. I loved being able to hold the place for three days before finalizing my decision and in the second day I knew. While I was previously a home owner, Skyline Canyon gives me the 100% homey  feel. The pet friendly areas, the doggie bins, my friendly neighbors. People take care of their  patios and balconies and what I love even more is the way we can personalize our spots. That's something that makes this place unique. I feel safe walking at 0100 with my pup. I love the midnight serenade of frogs. The views are gorgeous. I love being able to relax by my fireplace after work just by a flip of a switch! Give this place a chance and you will be glad you did!

The place looks nice on the outside but the management is terrible and getting anything fixed doesn't happen. Things are fixed cheaply and break. I had maintenance come out 4 times to fix my hot water which lasted less than 10 minutes for the first 6 months there. Finally, the water heater actually broke and they replaced it. Also at the begining I was told the non-refundable deposit that I put down was non-refundable but would go toward damages and needed paint but this did not happen. And then they billed me at the end for a stain that was already there and was documented before moving in. The place looks good at first but then you find plenty of things wrong as you stay, couldn't wait to get out of there by the end of the lease.
Beautiful outdoor ponds and landscaping.  Very open large patios and lots of interior light.

This place will FOOL you with its pleasant grounds and decent view of the city. It can also be quite peaceful at rare points during the day. In reality it is actually full of people with oversized dogs in undersized apartments. I am barked at constantly, and periodically charged at, when I go up or down my own stairs. I have complained twice to the office and nothing has been done.
I am barked at as I walk thru the "peaceful" garden to do my laundry. The "scenic" courtyard is essentially a doggy-toilet mine field not to be walked on.
The laundry rooms are filthy and the inside of the washers are coated with pet hair.

There was ZERO empathy or urgency expressed by the office, or the management group in Los Angeles, whom I appealed to for help. I was told that they are not required by law to provide me with air conditioning...even here in the high desert during the height of summer.
My next door neighbors smoke pot and have car parts out on the landing... also brought to the attention of the office and ignored.
If you are looking for a partial view of the city...and pleasant grounds to be viewed from your window, but not actually enjoyed.. or you have a large dog that you like to keep cooped-up in a tiny dwelling.. and don't really rely on your a/c during the summer... then this place is for you.

My family has lived here for the past five years.  The first apt we had, was a two bedroom and lovely.  We downsized and got an un-upgraded unit which fit our budget, at the time.  There is definitely variety in what you get and what you pay for.  The nicer unit had more noise, and the unit we moved to is beautifully quiet.  Gorgeous views of park, canyon, downtown and mountains!  Nicest neighbors you are likely to find in an apt.  One indoor and two outdoor pools are used by the kids year round.  Best sushi in town, just across the street (dangerous!)  Generally, a peaceful, pleasant and fortunate find.  Not perfect, but better than most!
I would NEVER recommend this to anyone who wants to get sleep through the night. The manager claims there are no rules in this regard and does nothing about it. I can't wait to move out of here.

THESE ARE APARTMENTS ARE JUST GREAT! NICE LOCATION AND NICE STAFF.
STAFF IS ALWAYS ON TOP OF EVERYTHING!  BEEN HERE FOR 2 YRS. AND PLANNING TO STAY FOR A LONG TIME.

I have enjoyed living here. However, management changes to often. They never really get to know the renters. When something is broken it may take a couple days to get fixed. The pool was closed more than open this summer due to vandialism. This complex is designed for famlies and I need a place that is quieter.

I LIVE AT AUSTIN CREST APARTMENTS, AND I HAVE TO SAY ITS VERY NICE. ESPECIALLY IF YOU HAVE KIDS AND PETS. VERY SPACIOUS, CLEAN, SAFE, AND FRIENDLY. ALSO VERY AFFORDABLE FOR A THREE BEDROOM APARTMENT. WE LOVE IT HERE!!! MY KIDS ENJOY THE PLAY GROUNDS AND SWIMMING POOL. WHILE ME AND MY HUSBAND LOVE THE GYM. ALSO STAFF AND MAINTENANCE ARE VERY CARING AND SO HELPFUL. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE I LOVE IT AND I KNOW YOU WILL TO.

I lived at austin crest for 4 years when the apartments were brand new. I found the staff to be very friendly and attentitive. The neighborhood is safe and it is close to public transportation, schools, and shopping.

I've had to sleep in freezing in weather with busted windows in rain and snow and make sure my dog stayed warm with a coat inside. It's not just my unit.

My neighbors are moving out and expressing frustration.

This is an excellent well tucked community. Everyone keeps to themselves, the amenities are nice and our kids love the pool. Management and staff are great and responsive. 
The only con is the rent increases yearly but it’s to be expected and when compared to other apartments in town rent is comparable or still of greater value especially for the square footage. It’d be amazing to get a special offer or discount for renewing. Other than that a great place to live for a family or roommates.

The management of this community has for years now, been skimping on normal upkeep of the buildings. The exteriors needed to be painted YEARS AGO, and now the roofs need to be replaced... but nothing gets done. The community looks shabby and unkempt , and it NEVER used to look like this.
The manager is not in the office A LOT,but "your emails are welcome". She does not communicate at all about basic things that a community manager would normally inform the tenants about, such as when the pools opening day is, and when the pools last day is. Today, I just went up to use the pool one last time before it turns the season, and surprise! The pool was closed for the season, without any notice or warning.This manager does not effectively communicate.

This new manager has raised the rent each and every year, and even during covid lockdown year, she raised the rent! No care or concern for what anybody was having to go through.

My wife and I have lived in this apartment for almost 7 years now.  I can tell you first hand that they will treat you fairly and courteously.  Any issue we've ever had, even the most minor, they have jumped to make sure its not an inconvenience to us.  They even went an extra mile for me as I'm a disable person in making sure my needs have been met.

Very friendly staff to show up around the complex. I was impressed with the area and community.

We have lived here for 10 months! The staff is amazing! Maintenance repairs issues within 24 hours, usually within an hour. The complex is quiet. Love the gym! Beautifully landscaped! We had a bad experience before this for our first time renting after being homeowners for 15 years! We LOVE living here!!

Loved living here so close to downtown, I could see the river from the window. Friendly, older, homey community, everyone says hi to each other. Anytime maintenance was needed it was no hassle, I was locked out of my apt at 10pm

Old, noisy, lots of fees. Is in league with a tow truck company that prowls the parking lot at night looking for excuses to tow you. Cabinets, counters are all cheaply made.

Severely overpriced for what it is. Move anywhere else. Management doesn't care about residents, only their money.

One of the first things that grabbed us about this property was location. Whether it be shopping, schools or highway 80 they are all within a couple of miles. The apartments are all modern and well maintained with a patio that allows grills. Manzanita Gates also allows pets which is a nice convenience. However, most importantly the staff here are incredible. They are always easy to help with anything you need. Joanne has been a god send. The maintence staff is incredible!!! Our A/C stopped working in the middle of a heat wave and the guys were over thawing our system out and making sure everything works within hours.

Relocating to Reno was a bit of a shot in the dark for us, but we are very grateful to have found this community. We were eager to move in before starting our new jobs and Manzanita Gate was the only property I could successfully speak to a leasing agent. Every time we've called, each person answering has been courteous and helpful.

Richard was extremely helpful with our application process and was very quick to respond. The management has quickly resolved any challenges we've encountered and we are grateful to be 'home'.

The units are roomy and the buildings are nicely spaced. The property is clean and quite. Located at the top of Robb Drive gives us great views from anywhere in the community. Our apartment has been well maintained the amenities are accessible by appointment. Bus line is near by. Food, retail and necessities are less than 2 miles away.

I'm glad I found this apartment not knowing anything about Reno. I relocated for work from the Washington DC area and this place exceeded my expectations. It's nestled in a secluded area but not too far away from stores and I-80. The apartment itself is pretty small being 655 sq. ft. but is perfect for a single person. The fact they allow you to have pets and a grill on your balcony really won me over. Staff is super friendly and makes you feel right at home. Oh and the parking... plenty of it unlike some places I've stayed and visited in Reno. The only negative thing about this place is the small kitchen space. I had to purchase my own microwave and eventually turned part of my living room into a kitchen and eventually my balcony was also considered a kitchen with the electric smoker and gas grill I was allowed to have too.
Choose this property because the management, support staff and rooms are a winning combination. You couldn't ask for a more professional caring team.

Rent and fees have been raised 46% in a year.  Every week, it seems there's a new fee to pay. They just make up fees you need to pay even though there's language in the lease that says they need to give you notice.  The apartment is trouble.  Boiling hot in the summer, freezing in the winter.  Landlord special everywhere you look. Management only communicates via text.  There's mold in the bathroom they won't fix. Overcharge for utilities.

Pros: The lady who cleans the laundry room is so sweet, and the new manager is also very friendly. end of list.
