I've been in these apartments for 3 years now. It's very quite and peaceful here. It's well maintained and the manager and assistant manager are very nice and respectful.
I have received excellent customer service from the management at Regency Park very happy.

These apartments have cockroaches, mice, and other pests and the management does nothing about it. I moved in and the same day I reported roaches and asked for my money back and they refused. They offered me half a month off the rent. I have videos, pictures, and even caught several bugs throughout the few months I lived there and they denied any rodents. While moving out after they evicted me I caught a mouse on a trap and even showed the manager and got that conversation recorded of her acknowledging the pests. Now working on a lawsuit because I can prove they moved me into an apartment that was already infested and they knew about it!!!!

These apartments are good for college students who need proximity and low cost. They are very low quality but do have AC, heat, a dishwasher and plenty of parking. Expect higher energy bills and very hot summers. As well as very cold winters. If budget is a priority, there is nothing cheaper.

I lived here for a few years and I honestly did not enjoy most of it. Sure, the location is good for students and rent is (for now) not too high, but that's about where the benefits end. 

Most of the people renting here are students but there is also a fair share of older adults. In my experience, students weren't much of an issue but the older people can be the worst, ranging from loud to creepy to just downright rude. I've seen and heard multiple screaming arguments between other tenants, and I've even seen people get arrested not 20 feet outside of my door (not once, but twice). 

Speaking of people, management is about as distant and uncaring as can be. Repair requests will be ignored, the office WILL be closed when you need help even if you're within office hours. In my experience, they likely won't confront an issue (like a broken water heater) or problem neighbor until it's gotten out of hand or multiple people have reported it. 

I recall reading in my lease that tenants are responsible for ensuring that the furnace filters are replaced - yet the furnace in my kitchen has a large padlock preventing this. This is just another example of the blatant disregard for tenants and the property at large.

The room itself isn't exactly great, either. The walls and doors to the common kitchen and outside are paper-thin so you'd better believe you will hear and smell everything, and I mean EVERYTHING that happens in the kitchen whether you like it or not. the (tiny) Bathroom fixtures were downright ugly or gross in my unit - the underside of the toilet seat was caked in who-know-how-old urine and I ended up replacing the thing myself because it was so gross. 

The AC won't quite keep the place cold on the hottest days which is not fun. You're gonna be sharing the furnace with all the other people in your kitchen so you better hope they aren't rude about the temperature. 

Overall if you're a student looking for a studio and can't afford much more or just need a cheap place to live, you might be able to stick through it in this place for a year or two but you certainly will not enjoy it.

They do not care about you, only your money. I had no WiFi for months they said “we’ll look into it”. Sure. As a student it sucks. The whole property is basically falling apart. Expect lots of ants in the summer... every summer. New kitchen appliances paint and floor only in kitchen increased rent by $200 in one year. Can’t wait to see how much they increase it to this year. Fingers crossed!

I would like to give this place a negative star rating, but one star will do. The people in the front office will always make excuses about why they are too lazy to get off their butts do something about all the complaints from multiple people including myself. There is constant noise that happens 24/7, yes that includes in the middle of the night. There are people that are constantly slamming the doors, I actually mean literal slamming. There's another person that's stomping around and constantly dropping something on the floor at 4 in the morning. Cleaning service is suppose to come in once a month and clean out the kitchens; however, that doesn't happen. The 6 months I've been living here, the cleaning service came once, I go and turn on the stove and I swear that stove started to smell like gun powder, few minutes later it started to spark. Another thing, they won't let you see the room before you sign the lease, and some of the rooms are even renovated out and they still want you to pay for the additional renovation fees and they refuse to renovate it at all. If the place is renovated, it really isn't when you get a closer look. The tub is resurfaced, meaning it was painted over and all the nasty crud is still underneath. The cabinets are poorly painted, the floor is uneven, the lights are extremely old. DON'T live here it's all a lie, all they want is your money. I wouldn't even ask of my worst enemy to live here. It's a dump, find somewhere else to live

I have lived here for a year! I love my apartment. I’ve had  no issues or do I have any complaints about the neighbors. I feel safe! It’s a fantastic location next to UNR. I take my grandchildren To the park that is in walking distance. My maintenance orders have been resolved promptly and professionally. The staff has always been courteous, helpful And most of all pleasant. I would recommend this apartment  complex to all my friends and family!

These apartments were a nightmare to live in since new management came around. There seemed to have been no communication between the previous management and the new, as the notes on some of the resident's accounts seemed to have disappeared. I had arranged a move out date with the previous manager which the new management did not honor and charged me full months rent for a time I was not even staying in the apartments. I did a complete deep cleaning all day, even though the apartment was stained in the carpets and in the bathroom when I moved in, and I was still charged a cleaning fee which took almost half of my security deposit. The new management also did not listen to complaints about noisy neighbors who took over the kitchen at all times (even at 2:00 am) and had the audacity to come for me when asking to pay for kitchen cleanup when I did not use the kitchen once during my stay. 

The apartment itself is tiny, and there is not much room if you have a bed. Apartments (when I first moved in) provided furniture including a desk, two tables, lamps, and a filthy cigarette burnt couch. Management would not move the couch out so I had to move it myself so that I could fit my full sized bed into my room, which was difficult with only one guy (me) moving the very heavy furniture.  Living in the bottom apartments rather than the top apartments were also disgusting, as there was mold on the bathroom ceiling from the unit above mine. The location was the only good thing about these apartments as it was across from the Lawlor Event Center at UNR and very close to UNR's gym. Parking is a nightmare in the complex if you lived in the front units, as the lines on the spaces are disappearing, leading to chaos when trying to park (luckily I lived in the back). The cost of this apartment, even though it might be the cheapest in Reno, is astonishing for what is provided, and I believe the new management has also raised it since I left. 

I would avoid this apartment complex if you can, unless you want to be constantly disappointed by management. Please take it from me, if you think you can grin and bear it, you can't. This place is small, dirty, and completely terrible as I'm sure most of the people who lived there would agree.

I have been here a few months and so far I really like it. The property is very clean and there is lots of parking. Night security is great and neighbors are quiet. The maintenance is very nice and address requests quickly. The laundry room is hot but the prices for machines are fairly inexpensive compared to going to a laundromat. The previous message said they are broke down but every week I go and they are all up and working. The price for a one bedroom is low compared to other complexes. So far I am very happy here and if things continue this way, I will renew my lease. The only thing I criticize is that their "gym" is small and is very minimal. If you and another person are trying to work out at the same time it's very stuffy and you have no room. It fits one person at a time. But, It's still nice that it's offered and for the price per month it really is a good deal. I recommend this complex to everyone.

If they would not let people have cluster products and broke down cars in parking spaces. Have washer n dryers or at least the hook-up. The laundry room is to hot and most of the machines are broke. This is why I can see myself moving after being there for one year.

If you are looking for move quick and have headache with poor management then move in! You are not gonna truly see how they are until you need a "big" maintenance emergency. Everything is cheap here too, they are going to "fix" things and maybe you should call two days after again, very very poor management communication. Sprinkle water is gonna make you have a daily bath morning and night walking in the place you supposed. My family and I are here around 7 months and really is annoy how they can't manage this place. We have a repair situation for many things like walls and roof with bare holes and still wait
waiting more than 3 weeks! They said are gonna call for fix and nothing. If you are not behind them then they "forget" you! At the office you may have to yelling for makes the lazy lady's work too! Maintenance guys seems to have very poor ability for fix and work. Manager need to do better I still waiting on her send me copy on some papers!!! 0/10 aif I can. I never recommend you move here.
Easy and straightforward application process and front desk very friendly

They are trying to charge tenants $50 for not uploading renters insurance to a new system they have EVEN if they already have proof of insurance in their old system. And they just implemented this a few weeks ago but on the 1st they are charging all tenants $50 if they haven't done it and are not refunding the $50. And the lease states that they just need to be provided proof WHICH they have! So frustrating to be charged twice and for having to do their work for them. Like if THEY chose to switch systems, why Dont they do the work of moving the info over to the new system. I don’t get paid to do your work for you. I ALREADY DID MY JOB BY PROVIDING PROOF OF INSURANCE. When I renew it, THEN I understand the process of having to upload it somewhere else.
Great place and location. Close to mall and freeway
moved here 2 years ago and we love this place. everyone in the office is great and maintenance address all our issues in a timely manner. and during the summer have 4 pools in property is great.

Relocated blind (without visiting) cross country to Reno, NV for work.   Jessica in the Village at Iron Blossom leasing office did a great job of guiding me through the modern, but involved tenant vetting procedures for rental approval.   She also upsold me to a better level of rental unit for a lower price...very much appreciated in Reno's expensive housing market.  Jessica was flexible when I encountered difficulty in getting documentation from my previous landlord and handled my moving target of an occupancy date in stride.  Upon arrival, the rental unit was as advertised, and a small maintenance issue that popped up a day later was handled within 24 hours.. My rental unit was well kept.  Community amenities are limited in the winter, but the facilities look good for summer enjoyment.  So far, so good!

Apartment 331 has horrible cigarette odor and leaking roof with water damage. I had to deal with these issues while living here. I reached out to the management office many times and was told there was nothing they would do, the roof started to grow mold and colapse in the living-room. Very disappointed and feel taken advantage of.

We loved the community so much we decided not to look anywhere else!  As soon as we are ready to make the move we will definitely choose this community.  Also want to compliment Brianna on a wonderful tour - she answered all of my questions and made us want to move sooner than planned!

My family and I have lived here at the village at iron blossom for quite a while now.  Pam in the office has been so good to us as I have a disabled son and she makes sure all of his needs are met.  The new weight room is awesome as is all the pools,tennis courts, laundry rooms and hot tub.  Parking is NEVER a problem.  If I need anything fixed they are here in under 15 minutes.  I would recommend The Village At Iron Blossom to anyone who is looking for a great place to call home.  Thanks and cudos to all the staff I look to long happy stay here.
-Star M

We absolutely LOVE living here! Don’t let the paint fool you, neither my boyfriend or I have ever lived somewhere where the staff cared more about the residents or the complex and it definitely shows. The location of this complex is great - it is right next to a freeway exit and down the street from numerous shopping centers. We have never had a problem with parking and there are plenty of spaces for guests. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Pam in the main office is always pleasant to talk to and will go out of her way to help you if she can. All of our maintenance requests have been quickly responded to, and the people who come in to fix stuff have always been professional and respectful. We often see the security guard making rounds at night which makes us feel very safe. They have always been very attentive to our needs and have answered any questions we have had. Our apartment itself it exactly what we were looking for. We toured a number of places and after walking through the unit here, we both got to our car, turned to each other, and immediately agreed that this was our number one choice - no discussion needed. I believe they are in the process of upgrading most of the units as they come available. It is clean and nice at an affordable price, whereas other complexes we saw were significantly more or grimy and derelict. Possibly one of our favorite aspects of this complex are the amenities. More than just the fact that there is a gym and a pool, we love that they are always making improvements here. Since we have been here they have bought all new furniture for the pool, all new equipment for the gym, completely updated the barbecue area by the leasing office, replaced all the furniture in the leasing office, repainted and updated the mailbox area, hot tubs, and tanning bed room - and those are just the things I can think of off the top of my head! The lawn is always well maintained and green. We rarely come across dog poop that has been left, and there are plenty of stands with dog bags and trashcans all around which makes it easy to take care of when we take our dog for a walk. Overall, we would absolutely recommend living here!

When I moved here, I fell in love. This is such a great community to live in. The office staff is amazing and everyone living here is so kind. I love this part of town and have never had any issues with my apartment.

First let me say that I love my apartment; I have a great 2 bedroom floor plan and wonderful neighbors.  I do have to pay more because I chose an upgraded unit. Now for the bad news:  The Village at Iron Blossom advertises 4 pools (they are all gross), a weight room (old equipment and dirty), a hot tub (indoor and unpleasant), and two dog parks (yes, but they are are small, the gates don't lock, and there aren't any benches for owners to sit on).  They do have nice playground areas for kids to play and beautiful green space with lots of trees.  The apartments themselves are very nice. If you don't mind paying for amenities you probably won't use, I would recommend it here.

Very nice neighborhood, great schools around, restaurants, close to bus stop and stores. it has i believe 4 great and clean pools, great place for kids and pets. and it has very nice stuff, i really recommend this place.

I really like the location, its close to a park and a mountain and stores!  Also I have met a lot of good neighbors here and some of them our now good friends.  Most of the staff is very friendly and accommodating.  I also like the layout of the apartment and the complex has great amenities.

Management is very unprofessional and rude.  They are disordered, its complicated to get anything fixed or repaired.  Pest control eapecially for ants around here are never on time or dont make it at all.....management refuses to change companies......  when my lease is over I am moving asap! Not only because i hate ot here but....management sucks so bad do not live here.... Fyi they turn the heat off for 4 mos out the year and there's no laundry facility on site nor a dishwasher

Apartment close to convention center, very affordable, loud on weekdays and weekends. Have big speed bumps, but some unnoticeable due to paint rare off and are black like the rest of the cement. Inside the house is design lovely, upstairs is one bedroom and bathroom. When i first move in, was not clean will, carpet was torn. Also the Heater does not work and the realty and i been playing phone tag for awhile, now my lease is almost over on November, this is not good due to having my 2 year old in the apartment and it snows here and gets really cold like touching ice. Night times you will have ants, size of an inch, creeping in, so watch where you walk at night because they will bit, good thing they don't go upstairs where the room are at. This is my experience and review of my apartment.

I have lived here about 8 years. Within the 8 years everything has gone down hill. The pools were open before covid it and ever since then it remains closed. Residents have no access to the hot tub either. The playground, is a basket ball area although the hoop doesn’t have a ring or string so it’s just a small box board on a pole. They have one slide and that is considered the playground as well. The “ play ground” is normally covered in shattered glass and garbage. The tennis court they have is closed and locked with a chain and now children have found ways to break into there to have somewhere to play. The buildings are beat up looking and grounds are majority of the time dirty. Maintenance does their best when they have the employees as office staff states they have no employees, but also state they have no hiring positions. There are so many black widows and refuse to actual send pest control out to take care of the issue. The landscaping is mainly either dirt, some grass, dog poop, or garbage. Again, maintenance does their best when they are needed or when pushed for the such needed work order to be completed. Cars are continuously getting either broken into it, stolen or people are dumping cars in the parking lots. Residents have no access to the fitness center. Every amenity besides washer and dryer in some units, dishwasher, garbage disposal, and ceiling fans, that is listed on any of there websites that they have their floor plan information on, we residents have NO AMENITIES. When residents try to do transfers, the office staff does not follow fair housing guidelines. I had called about moving to a two bedroom and they said they had no availability, although my friend called right after me and they stated they would be having some come available shortly. Besides the location, having a washer and dryer in unit, sometimes maintenance being reliable, and needing a Roof over your head, I would look else where.

The front office does the best that they can, but the owner refuses to let them help the property or the people living there.  The property is over run with spiders, mice, and squirrels. Almost all amenities have been out of order since before the pandemic even began. 

It's outdoor camping, most outlets and appliances don't work and if replaced it is with something so old it barely works.

Great location and neighborhood, but the apartments, especially kitchen and bathrooms, are old and deteriorating. The "amenities" are mostly useless, and the grounds and apartments generally are not maintained hardly at all. Maintenance is quick to respond but jimmy-rigs things rather than fixing them.

We've lived here for over 2 years. We love it! It is quite, safe and the staff is always helpful. There are a few updates that could be done, but really for the price and the neighborhood it cannot be beat. Perfect for kids & families!
The ideal home for people going to school and needing to be close to main streets its perfect no pets and parties
Lived here 7yrs. Building I live in is old and in disrepair with several foundation, plumbing and air conditioning issues.

Good place and good price. Staff is always pleasant and helpful if I had any issues. Location of apartments is one of  things I love. Having a mall across the street with bus transportation to get around Reno makes a great place to live. I have been here a year now and happy. Apartments have some problems with nabor noise sometimes but that's all part of Apartment Living.  People come and go.  Would recommend.  Thanks Meadowood staff. Kudos to Cindy...

I moved in about 4 months ago and everything has been great. I have large dogs that normally make it hard to find a rental but Meadow Wood has no breed/weight restrictions (and they only charge "pet rent" by unit, not by number of pets). The complex has lots of grass and paths so its easy to walk my dogs, I take different routes through the complex and never have to go out onto the street to deal with random people or cars. 

My unit is recently updated and in excellent condition. I had an issue with my A/C but the office staff was very helpful and got someone out to repair it ASAP. The complex is well maintained and kept tidy, management doesn't put up with people letting the exterior look trashy.

FYI, most people in this complex have dogs so if you are not a dog person or have minimal tolerance for barking (because it happens) you should go somewhere else. None of the barking is constant/excessive, but there are a lot of dogs in a relatively small vicinity.

I honestly don't understand the negative reviews. I've rented apartments in multiple states and this is my favorite so far.
Not too happy with my apartment. My rent is raised every year. I have lived here for 3 years. They do no improvements for your rent raise.

Beautiful and mature landscaping make my walks with my dog enjoyable. Quiet complex considering this is the only property available offering a truly pet friendly environment with no breed restrictions.  Every renter is very considerate with their pets! Great staff!

I've lived here since 2006 and we went from a one bedroom to two, then a two bedroom townhouse. The property is usually quiet and peaceful. Having the bus center across the street at the mall is great for someone who doesn't drive. The management is good and maintenance responds quickly. The clubhouse is nice and offers free coffee and snacks and has free internet. The pools are kept clean and the gym is well equiped.

We lived at this complex for about 3 years. It was an awful experience. 
The buildings are very very old, there is definitely mold in the walls. We would feel sick on and off all 3 years up until we moved out. They had several weeks of cockroach infestations. I remember I was going to sleep one night and felt one crawling on my face. The maintenance team is absolutely completely useless. We moved into another unit and it took them six months of them coming in and out of our home to fix a bunch of issues in this supposedly "move in ready" unit. We are convinced the maintenance guys told the office they took care of it, when in fact they did not. 
We've had packages stolen from our front door, our neighbors also experienced this. 
There have been numerous occasions where homeless people would sleep in the laundry rooms. This complex doesn't have ANY cameras on property (not even facing the mailboxes) and they don't have security. Which they would benefit from getting. This "beautiful gated community" is not in fact gated. The gates haven't worked in over a year. And even if they do work, sometimes they won't open and you're literally stuck. You have to pay extra money per month for parking spaces. But that's not a guarantee your spot will be avaliable when you get home. There's nothing you can do when someone is parked in your spot that you pay for. 
The property manager is nice, but very tone deaf to the issues of this property. These apartments are extremely over priced for what you're getting. With this price range you're better off moving to a nicer part of Reno. Highly highly DO NOT recommend living at this complex.

Office people are nice but the units themselves could use some work. You'll see a roach every now and then and mold due to the windows they use.
Be prepared to have the fire alarm pulled everyday for at least a week every summer cause of the kids in the area. Homeless people living in the laundry rooms or sleeping in the lobby at night. Tweakers hanging out on site doing God only knows what. Gates are all left open except the back but still not secure at all. 
Their "fitness facility" is a room in their office that is one of the apartment units. Super tiny room with a treadmill, elliptical,and bench. Feels too awkward to use.

These apartments used to be decent. The neighborhood is bad, but the low rates and pet-friendly leases made it worth it. Then, Tarantino property management took over in 2016 and everything got worse. They are the least professional people you will ever meet, if you can catch them in the office. They regularly lose paperwork, so be sure you get reciepts for *everything*.
 0/10 would not recommend. 
The only thing that earns this place a star is the maintenance guy is ok. He does what he can for being the only person to maintain the entire complex. That being said, if something goes wrong in your unit, do not count on getting it fixed. They'll sure bill you for it when you finally can't take it anymore and move out though!

Living at this place is very basic. It's doesn't have a pool, business center, or a gym. In exchange of all that, the rent is quite reasonable, the only necessity utility that is required is the electricity (they cover the gas, sewage,water and trash). On top of all that, the property is gated. Access card or code is required after a certain time. It is very quiet and I  haven't had any troubles with anyone (except maybe one crazy lady, but everyone got em). The management are friendly and they'll do whatever they can to solve any issues that arises. The maintenance crew is the same way, when I had an issue with the garbage disposal, I told the management. They apparently dispatched them to fix it while I was there just chatting with them because when I returned to the apartment, it was working and I returned to the office to apologize to them for wasting their time and it made a liar out of me. They said it was being fixed while I was chatting with them, I was impressed.  They also constantly evaluate the safety and living conditions in the apartment and make a great effort to correct (i.e. Safety electric socket to prevent shock when a toaster just might fall in the water). All in all, I gave them a four star simply there are always room for improvement, but I would recommend to anybody to live at the Regency Park.

I would like to give a huge shout out to Hannah. Please forgive me if I spelled your name wrong. So I am a transfer student from FL.looking for an apartment in Reno area to be close to the college. Hannah picks up and immediatly greets me and makes me feel welcomed. I talk to her for a while and find out that this is student living, which doesn't suit me as well since I am a single father bringing a child along. The conversation could of ended there. Instead she went above and beyond by helping with suggested areas to look at for my budget, location and more. She is very knowledgeable and a pleasure to talk to. She genuinely cared to help and I like that so thank you Hannah and keep up the great work.

I stayed here for two years and just recently moved out in July 2023. I received my final statement about two days ago and saw charges for cleaning the carpet and bathroom and stovetop, among other things. There was normal wear and tear on the couches that I actually brought up to management a few times along with the final inspection and they are still charging me and my roommate $550 EACH simply for the couch. I have videos of move in and move out showing it was cleaned to nearly the same way as when I moved in. They will charge you as much as possible for cleaning fees for an apartment that basically looks better then when moved in. Even if you cleaned, they will still charge you without any photo evidence. Now that I am trying to dispute it they are sending me to email contacts that don't exist and will not address my concerns over the phone. They have entirely screwed me and my family over with this and wont even respond.

I lived here from August to April in 2021-2022. Management changed in that time and, while I thought it would get better, it ended up getting worse. Their communication is severely lacking and you are not able to speak to any of the managers when you need to. Maintenance takes forever and rarely would get to the project.

Before we even moved in, they made us sign an addendum that changed the way they were doing utilities. I moved in the next day so I was pretty much forced to sign it. 

In February, my window ended up breaking due to structural issues. I contacted them several times over several months and no one ever came in to even look at the window. I had an appointment to meet with and talk to maintenance, and no one ever showed up or contacted me that they weren’t coming. This problem caused my room to be severely cold as it was during the middle of winter.

The final straw in April was when our entire townhome ended up getting mold. The maintenance guy that came in told my roommates that it was very likely the reason we were all sick and that the ventilation was not up to par. Instead of fixing the problem, they told us a spray that WE could go buy and use it on the mold… my one roommate did buy it and it did not work.

I ended up moving towards the end of April due to unsafe living conditions. My parents and I tried contacting a manager multiple times but they never got back to us. Finally I went in person to deliver a letter and turn in my keys since they had told me the general manager would be there. They confirmed that she was there but she couldn’t see me right then. I waited for an hour to talk to her before someone came out and told me that she would not meet with me at all, not even for five minutes. My family has sent certified letters to both the office in Reno and the office of the management company, and yet they are still contacting me and telling me I owe money.

The stuff I listed was just the major things and certainly does not include all the problems I had while living here. My biggest advice: DO NOT sign a lease with wolfrun!
Not recommended, No exhaust in bath, kitchen, dog poops everywhere. Nobody clean after dog do it. People create noise till late night. They don't respect other. Management not professional.

apartmentName: The Towers at Pink Hill- Student Living
review: The location is great for those who are students. On the other hand, there are constant problems with the unit - broken light fixtures, leaky plumbing, loud neighbors, broken door hinges, broken furniture... etc. If you intend on living here, don't plan on bringing any furniture because the apartment is furnished, and because there is no elevator. The trash is hardly ever picked up by Waste Management, and the Reno winds blow the overflowing garbage all over the breezeways. There is also no parking, so I have to walk 10 minutes to my car daily. The rent is increased every year, which would be fine if the apartment was actually worth the money. Oh and when you go online to pay the rent, don't forget there is an additional $30 transaction fee as well as a $25 utilities fee. Too expensive for the quality.

Read the other reviews about the management keeping the security deposit on various sites. They are taking our $400 deposit and charging an additional $170 on top of that. They are charging for 1/3 of the carpet replacement even though we only lived there 9.4 months (normal wear and tear of the carpet and we only lived there 1/5 of the total time since the carpet was installed and yet are being charged 1/3 of the price of replacement: $970 for replacement and we are being charged $350 for carpet installed in December of 2016). They tack on a $100 in house touch up and another $100 cleaning charge. I tried to get a hold of somebody multiple times but, not surprisingly, they just ignore you and sent demand letters. I have never had an apartment where I didn't get at least part of my deposit back and absolutely never had to pay more than my deposit. Very shady imo. Avoid this place at all costs.

Closet doors in both my room and the broom closet doors fell on me the first week after moving in. Dishwasher didn’t work and fridge leaked water immensely. It warped the floor and my room mate and I couldn’t stop it! Called management to get these things repaired and they said they’d put a work order in. Both my room and I called once a week to ask if they were coming. Eventually, I found out that someone had been putting our work orders as completed and we had to continue filing complaints. It took over six months, and for us to say we weren’t going to pay rent until these things were fixed, to get our fridge repaired and replaced. Upon removing and replacing the dishwasher, the maintenance men accidentally pulled up the vinyl flooring and left it that way - despite our complaints to the management. Many things were broken upon moving in - chipped counters, stained carpet, cracked railings on our porch, dents in walls, etc. Management does not care for their residents and will find a way to get your complaints through without having them actually solved.

Poor care of the land around here. Trash is often seen in the roads and leaves are everywhere.

As much as I love the area, as I grew up right up the street, this apartment complex is the most heinous place. They don’t care about you or your family!
Management is horrible. Parking is horrible. Trash all over. Maintenance never comes through. Cant wait to get out of here.

New management arrived in August.  Outside is full of leaves and looking very sloppy.  No attempt by mgmt. to do anything about it.  Used to be able to pay rent online.  FPI has had 3 months to get an online payment site going, and they still have not done so.

the apartments are old but they are maintained. they have garages which is great, I wish they had in home washer dryer hookups instead of a laundry mat area. they are doing a lot of improvements and making it nice. the school district is very good as well!
GOOD PLACE TO LIVE QUITE CLEAN NICE PEOPLE WELL LIT NICE PEOPLE RUN THE PLACE.

This is no more than a shelter management does not care about the bed bugs and filth, they blame the children and old people who have to suffer through this. Babies covered in bed bug bites they come out night all over the place like some horror movie.  If you value your health and a piece of mind do not stay there.  You are better off sleeping in your car.
Awful, one tenant looked like he has leprosy he had been bitten so many times.!!

Poorly managed. Bed bugs. Over priced. Lost my job and stayed here for a time. Huge mistake but didn't have a choice. Little to no parking. Someone brought bed bugs and they spray something on Fridays that doesn't work, that's if you can get the manager to believe you have them. The front desk person is rude and unfriendly. They take full advantage of the people without.

This property is just horrible. Pool is closed in August...Price stays the same  appears to be a place for crack heads and homeless....and oh yea prostitution....just heard gun shots    880 a month   sleep in your car

These apartments that I live in are pretty great, the neighbors are fantastic the management is great! I've been here for 3 years now, the landlord helps works with me in rent because we can't come up with all at once so they work with us! Fantastic place! It would be nice to win that rent for life!

Throughout my stay at the hub it has been nothing but the worst, first off management is rude, the walls are paper thin you can hear everything your neighbours are doing. The halls have a very bad odour, there is homeless sleeping in the building cops are always there constantly.

I have now resides at The Hub for a year and have signed to remain here for another year.  Having lived in various states and various areas of Northern Nevada, The Hub is clean, secure, safe, and well kept up by the owners and management. 

Many amenities and on site storage facilities that are reasonable to purchase.  Rents are reasonable , decent fitness center, nice patio areas, spacious units regardless of size, bike lock area, dog wash room, and much more.  If you need something taken care of, management is quite responsive and always polite and helpful.  

Professional management, quiet complex , and enjoyable secure environment overall with reasonable costs.  

Definitely would recommend. 

Daryl Frazetti

I found that this apartment is on the airplane path ...
u r hearing noises from airplane every 20 minutes for 24hrs...

The Hub @ Oddie is by far the best bet if you are wanting to move into a new modern apartment in the area. The rooms have just been renovated and come with nice modern appliances. The property managers have been very responsive to any questions and have been super kind. The secure access via key FOB is also worth mentioning as this was a big selling point for me.

Its a small apartment comfy and cozy. I been living here for the past 4years. I would love it more if management were nicer and willing to work with you when it comes to maintenance, they take long time but eventually takes care of your requests. Parking is very limited as well.

Management is awful, you cannot get a repair done. You are charged for everything. Including a broken window, that was broken from the outside in a common area. We were told if we did not pay it, that they would take it out of our rent and make our rent late. We lived there for over a year, rent was paid on time every month. The apartment was cleaned and in great shape when we moved out, they took our deposit and charged us over a $1000 for ridiculous things and also things that should have been normal wear and tear. I absolutely do not recommend these apartments or any others managed by this company.

Been here over a month, and I am now seeing the place start looking better. Tenants still need to pick up after their dogs. Zero to no crime in the apartments, cops very very rarely have come, only for an emergency on an elderly tenant. Landscaping is looking  up. Apartment quality is looking up as well, I would recommend these apartments.

The washer & dryer is one machine, it goes from wash to rinse and dry. But when the machine stops, we have to hang our clothes up because they are still wet. Something needs to be done about  the clothes being wet. We should not have wet clothes, when taken out the machine.

I live in a two bedroom, one bath, it has a fair sized kitchen, its an open floor plan, with a large balcony, that faces south.with a panoramic view of the mountains. the bed rooms are nice sized also, with a washer/dryer unit in the apt.there is also , a lot of storage space in the apartment. and a fair sized storage unit on the balcony. the apt. complex sits right on Virginia st. and is on the bus line. or you can just walk down town. there are lots of resturants, and retale shops right here in the neighborhood. your right in the middle of the action here in the middle of midtown.

I’d lived at the Villager Studio Apartments in Reno for one year and 9 months.The studio itself was spacious for a one-room apartment, with plenty of natural light, and the kitchen area had everything I needed. 
One of the best things about the Villager Studio Apartments is the location. It’s in a great part of Reno, close to downtown, shopping, and public transportation, but still maintains a peaceful vibe away from the bustle of city noise. Whether you’re a student or a professional, it’s incredibly convenient.
The management team was fantastic – always professional, quick to respond to requests, and friendly. 
I recommend the Villager Studio Apartments for anyone looking for a convenient, well-maintained, and affordable living space in Reno.

Denice, Ray and staff are great. I’ve been living here for 4 years and absolutely love it. The neighborhood is very quiet. The office puts on holiday parties for tenants. Maintenance is prompt. I’m so happy living here.  Tina N.
Rotten manager, lazy staff, terrible tenants.  Crime ridden drug dealing area.  Better off staying at a motel/hotel

I was overall pleased with my time living here at the Villager. It's a good place to live for students who don't intend to party. The remodeled student rooms are quite nice, with simple yet elegant Ikea furniture, and the kitchen appliances are good. Office staff is friendly, and maintenance comes pretty quickly once you request them. You get $10 rent discount for paying early, which is pretty nice. 10 minutes walk from UNR, and right across from a park, although you wouldn't wanna walk the area alone at night.

I just moved out of these apartments in October. Received a BILL instead of my deposit back. Took pictures of the entire apartment before I left. I gave my 30 days notice, never made a late payment, never had any complaints. They are trying to charge me $235 for CARPET CLEANING. Literally one room 8x10. They use Stanley Steemer, so I looked up how much it would be for a single room, for the full clean, protect, and deodorize package and guess how much they charge? $86. And apartments generally get a discount for using them so often. The other charges are completely legitimate, I mean $2 for a lightbulb, $39 for apartment cleaning, and $12 for maintenance labor. I will absolutely give them that, it's pretty standard. But $235 for an 8x10 room? FORGET IT. Calling HUD on Monday. Great place to live if you don't plan on moving out.

I lived here for about two years. It's quiet and nice. The rent is reasonable, and they have parties from time to time. Good place for a student like Myself. It's close to UNR, and the buses stop right there. The people in the office are always very nice, and take good care of You. The maintenance people are really friendly, and always take care of stuff real quick. I really liked living there and would again if I needed a place.

Apartments are clean very nice everything you need. manager is friendly 
and very helpful. We have stayed several times and had a great experience.
We give them 5 a star rating.

Need to hole up somewhere for a while? Fled the house with only the clothes you were wearing? This is the apartment for you. Fully furnished, all utilities except phone included (even cable TV). Linens, dishes, pots and flatware are also included, although a little threadbare and showing signs of much use. The apartments were built in the 70ies, and it shows (no central air, no dishwashers), but they are quiet, clean and located in a decent neighborhood. Laundry facilities are on site. No pets, and no more than two tenants per apartment.

Leases are 30 days, with no security deposit or credit check. The manager is very helpful, and maintenance is taken care of promptly. If you are in Reno temporarily, or looking for a place to stay while buying your own home, this is a reasonably priced, no-frills, low-hassle option.

I was on the waiting list for years and always checking on my application progress then explained that I was homeless, then they would mail me another verification letter to turn in within 10 days after they would reassure me I was either moving along or no progress then they would pull snake move that I didn't have to sign anything until I had a approved appointment which they always had me reapply get back on the waiting list this process took me about 6 1/2 yes and finally just gave up

They wrote notices, then close the office so you can not contact them about said notice. Then when yiu actually do get an appointment they cancel it on you with NO notice. I will be sending a formal letter to the FPI management which these apartments are under. Renters BEWARE!

I've been living in these apartments for 7 years now! Pros: swimming pool, laundromat, your own parking, pretty quite apartment complex, always tided up, monthly notices of rent due.
Cons: 1) there are a ton of kids in the apartment complex. I live near the office so I'm surrounded by more elder people, but more into the apartments you end up finding big family's with kids. Which isn't all too bad! Unless you don't like kids. 2) the laundromat has very poor functioning machines. They just recently installed three excellent washing machines and 4 awesome drying machines, but since it's an apartment complex,  you'll usually have to wait your turn to use the machines and sometimes it's a long wait. 3) old apartments have roaches. They've been sending pest control to handle this, and my situation has been handled! 4) there is a pet fee :( I think it's around $240 or just a monthly fee of $15. Not sure. 
5) some neighbors guests tend to steal parking. And then you end up either taking someone else's parking or having to park super far. It sucks

But all in all, it's a good place to live in. Not excellent, but good

This property is consistently unclean, trash throughout the property, amenities that are provided are never open; such as the pool. There is no mailroom for packages and the package lockers are never maintained/work. Until management changes, I would recommend looking elsewhere.

My family and I moved in and stayed for a year. In that year, we paid on time each month and had one month we paid late and had a one time late fee applied, however, the office from that point on gave us late fees each month even when they received payments on time. They then tried to evict us over multiple late fees we did not accumulate. When brought to their attention we received no apology and continued to do this with our future payments. We as tenants are supposed to have access to the pool but they never maintain it properly so the pool is closed even during the summer. Playground areas are run down and can cause injury to the kiddos due to broken parts and rust. Washer in our unit leaked water and would flood when washing. When we reported it, no one ever came to fix it even after promising to have the work order put in and giving us a two week time frame. The dryer had no lint catcher and wouldn't dry clothes properly. One load of clothes would take two days to dry. Upon move in, many of the window shades were missing and the one that was installed in one bedroom fell off it's hooks and broke the window and again, when reported, nothing was done. Corporate came in for an audit and directly insured me that they would be in the next day to repair the window being that the start of winter was here. Yet, again, no one showed up and no one would return my calls when trying to reach out. No one that is employed here cares about taking care of their units and maintaining a good repor with their tenants. False charges, poor staffing, poorly maintained units, appliances, and complex grounds. Your money is better spent on another rental. Save yourself the stress!

I am a resident and the management is terrible!! You put in a complaint about something you have to keep calling and bugging them or they do nothing about it.  The manager says she will call you back and she doesn’t. If you want something done you have to take care of it your self. I also hate if you do put in for something to be fixed it takes a month in a half. When you live somewhere and you are a clean person always take care of your apartment you should not have he problems that you do, especially for the money that you are paying. When you need to renew something they also need to think people have jobs we will have to do it on a weekend not expect people to take off. There is a gym there but only open Monday through Friday office hours so the people that don’t work get to use it!!

Terrible apartments, terrible management, terrible service, the owner and staff are brainless and the at most unprofessional people, nothing they say or give about the apartments in the description is true. These are the worst managed apartments. I’d rather make myself a mud hut outside to live in than these cheap, dirty, run down, garbage apartments.

I love the set up and the price for the quality of the apartment, but they need to have more parking. Me and my two other roommates have to share one parking spot and the visitor parking is very far away from our apartment.

So for it's a spacious apartment. But they have increases our rent and at the moment my spouse and i are having a very hard time coming up with rent monthly right now that im in school as well. Trying our best to give my daughter everything i can.

Don't do it!!!!!   Please don't!!!! 
Nothing but damages to my car, things stolen out of my apartment.  The master keys were missing, but they never bothered to tell anyone.  Great!   Also, they were charging me way too much. 
You can get better, just don't rent with AMC.

This is easily the worst place I have ever lived. They will include hidden fees on every single bill (like $500, not $50) and when you complain they treat you poorly. You cannot pay rent until the day it is due, and one Friday they completely shut down the office so no one could come in and turn in a check. The following Monday we had an eviction notice on our door despite it being their fault, and they refused to waive the late fee of the "eviction notice" fee. Management will refuse to fix anything or work with you. Absolute worst place to rent from, please don't live here.

This is the worst apartment complex I have ever lived in. They have given us two eviction notices, one for being three days late in paying rent (I was out of town, I accept fault for this as it is stated in the rental agreement, although a phone call would have resolved the issue, instead we were charged a $20 “notice delivery fee” to put the paper on our door) the second was for not paying the pet rent ALTHOUGH the amount in the contract was different from the amount stated by the rental agent. While we were waiting for an email response to clarify the amount (the office was closed for the weekend), there was an additional eviction notice placed on the door. Again a simple phone call would have immediately resolved the issue. The office is generally not able to respond to phone calls or return calls even if you leave a voice message. The pool and workout room was unavailable for most of the summer despite promises stating otherwise during move-in and the hot tub still remains unavailable, again a despite promises during touring stating otherwise. There is constantly trash around the grounds, including from random people that will place it in the “valet” trash cans that are unbagged and therefore not collected. Expect many forced fees including for the washer and dryer, internet, parking, and so-called valet trash, making this complex much more expensive than it first appears. There is a lack of parking in the winter, so a guest of ours, who parked in a snow plow spot, was forced to pay a $400 towing fee, despite a low in the 40’s and zero chance of snow. This complex will nickel and dime you at every single opportunity. The maintenance man entered the apartment with no prior warning from the office while my two female roommates were asleep (they work graveyard shifts so are sleeping during the day), making them feel extremely unsafe living here. Finally, when we were confronted with noisy roommates, there is no option for noise complaints or 24-hour contact, we were told the following day to file a police report instead of given the option for a noise complaint. We do not recommend living in this seemingly peaceful yet very slimy community.

Wow, after the terrible start at this apartment of it not being clean and the water heater breaking and not having Wi-Fi to my unit for a month I am extremely disappointed with how they treat their residents. They don’t follow their rules and aren’t flexible at all. I had a terrible experience here and would not recommend it.

Today, on 8/4, I was shocked to receive a "notice to vacate" on the door due to not paying for August. Before today, I did not receive any notice or reminder in any format about a balance due. The payment system did not notify me the autopay was ended and did not remind me that I had a balance due. The manager eventually cancelled the late fee, but we were still charged a concession fee and notice fee for $230. This is ridiculous as they did not notify in any format about balance due but just notify to vacate and add much of penalty 1 day after payment due. I was shocked. In a word, they try all to charge the residents more.

I was concerned about the payment system starting from the move-in date, and it turned out this concern is valid.

Preston Hollow was once a great hidden gem, with spacious apartments for a relatively affordable price. Unfortunately, that is long gone. Rents continue to increase in the complex despite no discernable improvements. The actual clubhouse/office was improved, but the complex itself has seen very little. If anything, rents should be decreasing, as they've removed amenities--they initially had a laundry facility on site, but that was shuttered and replaced by nothing at all.

An el-cheapo slap of paint on the exteriors was a nice change of pace, although ultimately meaningless. They "renovated" the pool area by removing all its character, tore out the pergola, couldn't get the machinery into the area because they built up around it so everything was done using hand tools (what a total clusterf), and keeping it shut down in the middle of a pandemic during the summer. Thanks for that too.

Management doesn't care AT ALL about the tenants. The gates rarely ever work, so it's really mislabeled calling this a "gated community". The fitness center is a fitness center in name only, and more of a small cement afterthought with poorly maintained and possibly dangerous equipment. 

And if that's not bad enough, the seasonal infestations of box elder and elm seed bugs is just a wonderful treat to come home and find that the poorly sealed windows and doors just let all of them find their way inside, covering the walls. My roommate and I spent weeks fighting a futile battle against these intrepid pests. The nearby runoff stream does bring a nice array of birds and ducks and geese, which is about one of the only perks.

The walls are thin too, so if your neighbor likes to listen to their music at a volume above a whisper, that means you get to listen to their music too. 

All in all, avoid at all costs. It was once a 4-star property, but has since fallen into embarrassing disarray. I think AMC took it over, and that is excruciatingly evidenced by their continued degradation into slum lords.

I used to LOVE living here! I could deal with the maintenance delays because the staff was so great, and the exterior of the property looked fine. Now, the exterior of three buildings is unacceptable and has been for two months. The effects of coming home to a junky building each day are compounded by the lack of communication from the staff. All of the doors, rails, and balconies are literally half painted since mid-December. Do you know when they will be complete? “When it’s warmer.” There is no gesture from the company for the inconvenience of coming home to a trashy apartment. Very poor management. 

We are being surveyed if we want a pet bath or a yoga room — but they can’t communicate the maintenance we were told would haven (via a printed newsletter) wouldn’t actually happen. 

Get it together please. I really want to like living here again.

They prioritize the aesthetics of the facility more than the well being and security of the residents. "Under new management" by AMC something or another investment company. You know what investment companies care about? Return on investment. Keep the complex fully occupied. Full stop! Don't be fooled by their clu club house, they make you pay to use it. Their pool is average, the hot tub is lukewarm (for liability reasons, wouldn't want kids playing in there to burn themselves).

Their "gate" which they claim "only closes at night" is never actually closed. My car has been broken into twice. And on more than one occasion have I seen creepy individuals wandering through the parking lot late at night.

Dont be fooled by their out of date advertising pictures. This place is not in a safe area.

I'm moving from out of state to Utah, and my first attempt to contact this apartment went unanswered. My second attempt finally got a response, and we started exchanging emails (it's easier than a phone call during the day since I'm at work). I suddenly stopped receiving responses for a couple days.

I contacted Preston Hollow again, and someone else replied and said the first person I spoke to was off work. They could've at least let me know. So, I started to communicate with the second person. After putting together information from both people, I decided I thought I wanted to live there. I let Preston Hollow know I was interested in living there, and asked how the application process would work, and what I should do next. I never got a reply.

Fortunately, they never did reply because I kept looking, and I found a much better place for me.
Location is awesome, building is nice and management is great. Highly recommend this place!

The best decision I've made when it came to look for a new apartment this year 21 by Urbana is a beautiful building in the heart of Sugarhouse!  

I moved in about a week ago and the experience to date has been nothing but exceptional.  The management and maintenance teams go above and beyond to ensure your expectations are being met.  The building is kept clean daily by a wonderful and friendly cleaning staff and maintenance is very efficient. They are courteous, responsive, and professional, characteristics that are hard to find in today's rental market. Security is great and I feel safe here with the security measures the building has in place. Amenities are great - hot tub, BBQ grills, large deck/patio area for entertaining, gym, entertaining kitchen. As previously mentioned, 21 by Urbana is located in the heart of Sugarhouse so it is literally in the middle of everything.

I must give a big thank you to Kim who has been so helpful and accommodating throughout the entire process.  From the moment I walked through the door, she was very professional and certainly knowledgeable of the brand and product.  She sold me.  I knew I had to make 21 by Urbana home and that I did!  Thank you, Kim and Annette!!!  I am not regretting my decision and for those who are considering 21 by Urbana you won't either.

We lived there for almost a year and there were 2 break ins in the first couple of months. I never felt safe there. 
The management are thieves. Our shared utilities fluctuated wildly, even 10,000% from one month to the next. 
Overall it was the worst living experience we ever had. 
There are so many better buildings in the are with better utilities. We wish we would have chosen one of them.

Pet ownership is extremely difficult from our experience here at Post. The complex's lease agreements do not contain any language about what pets are restricted or not, and are only found through a random web page https://www.liveatpost.com/pet-policy/ only accessible through the amenties tab on the site. None of our documents my wife and I signed described specific restrictions (ex. breed, weight, etc.), but only a vague "universal" clause that this complex can reject pets for any reason at the time we agreed to be residents and signed our agreement. Had a disappointing experience where we tried to adopt a dog but the policies were hidden from us and had to return her after initially getting the ok from the team, but done with incorrect procedures. Very disappointed that this is language is not put in the contract compared to other apartment complexes where this is standard. Not sure if we are renewing or not after they implied they were hesitant about putting it in writing for people for some reason, no trust with the management team and we feel awful we felt mislead and cheated out of getting a stellar dog who needed a home. There seems to be a lot of "legal-ese" excuses for this thrown our way instead of making things clearer for residents. PetScreening had no information about the policy at all until after the fact someone else casually mentioned it. 1 star. The process is overcomplicated, has so many steps, and at times is done with bad information given to pet owners from the team due to lack of consistency. If you want a pet here, get it in writing that this pet is ok since they do not make it clear to residents what is and isn't allowed. Avoid at all costs to keep your furry friends.
Can't beat the location and amenities.  Indoor/outdoor pool, etc.

Post District is awesome! I've lived here for over a year and just renewed my lease. The property has only gotten better now that construction is done and you never have to leave with all the amenities and restaurants on or coming to the block. Chris, Shane, and the rest of the team are the best!

Recently visited this property and was amazed by the pool.  Loved the pool and spa not to mention the wall of TV's in the club room.  Kade was super friendly and took his time showing me around.  I have not made my decision yet but so far Post was the nicest one I saw and friendliest staff.

This is an high end property, well designed exterior and interior. I’m very pleased with the furniture that are placed in my apartment.

The location of Post District apartments is convenient located in downtown and as well close to freeway, which gives me the opportunity to drive quickly at my daily destinations.

Staffing members are wonderful people, are always prompt to help and support when needed.

I’m very satisfied with Post District apartment and the quality of the residency that they offer.

Neighbors in the apartment are friendly and welcoming, it makes me feel like home!

Great choice to rent and live in Post District. You have my 5 Stars!

Thank you!

I was looking forward to living in this building and its proximity to downtown. Unfortunately, it has been a horrible experience. No hot water over Christmas break – check! Issues processing January's rent – check! I still haven't received mail, having lived here for two months. Now I can't get out of the parking garage without calling three people. Other buildings in the area are not going through these growing pains, especially at this level. Save yourself the headache and look elsewhere.

Things have deteriorated since living here for almost a year. Management has become less helpful and caring. It all came to a head when there was an unauthorized entry into our apartment when we were not home and notice was not given before or even after letting us know they were there. I came home to signs of someone entering our apartment with no knowledge that it could have been property management or maintenance or any way of contacting them until the next morning. It was a pretty scary experience and it’s terrifying to think about how many times this may have happened to us or other tenants that didn’t get noticed until now.

This is a super nice complex in a great location. Even though it is a new building, it seems the management is still always making improvements. The property manager, Lorena, is wonderful and the maintenance staff are very quick and do a great job. The price also seemed more reasonable than a lot of downtown complexes. I enjoyed my 2 years here.

This is the best apartment complex I have ever lived in.

The leasing staff are very nice, always accommodating when I received packages, there is a gym with free weights and a rack (I've never seen any apartment actually have a bar and rack in their gym),  close to the freeway and downtown, and very new building with a parking garage.

Would recommend living here to anyone.

This a great apartment complex that's clean, secure, with everything I needed moving to Utah from out of state. In-unit washer/dryer, fridge, microwave, stove. Included indoor, badge access parking is definitely a plus since it's my first time living in a place that snows. The leasing office ladies are amazing to work with, so sweet and helpful. They have resident mixers and random treats. Maintenance is super responsive. Love that they are starting to notify us when packages arrive in their office. Great location close to TRAX station, Gateway mall, Energy Solutions Arena. Only downside is the shelter a few blocks away where a lot of homeless people roam the streets and jaywalk right in front of your moving vehicle, but I haven't been concerned about my safety at all.

I just moved here from NY to start my new job, and chose Liberty Gateway as my new home. This place has wonderful amenities, great security, and is close to EVERYTHING. I love being next to all the great restaurants downtown. It's right next to a couple of  great concert venues, not to mention the ease of access to the public transit system. 

The staff is all very friendly and helpful to boot. Really an amazing place to live!

i have moved 5 times in two years and toured countless apartment complexes.   This is by far the best.  Not only is the price great for what you get, it is safe, clean, and great staff.   I did everything pretty much over the phone because I was out of town.    The only thing I could say negative is the homeless people down the street are a nuisance.

This place has a great staff, modern apartments, plenty of storage space, and feels safe. It's a great first apartment to live in! The staff is really helpful and will let furniture or utilities be delivered/set up before you arrive. They have a room for storing packages so they don't get stolen off your door step. Highly recommended!

I stopped in for a tour today. Nato showed me around and went above and beyond helping me find the perfect apartment! I also met with the manager Erin who is the nicest person ever. I would highly recommend Encore for anyone looking for a place in SLC! You can’t beat the location plus the staff is great

The building, apartments, amenities and personnel is amazing. I personally feel extremely grateful for having had the support of Nato through my moving process, I had to manage moving from Spain and he made my life so much easier. This is the best place to stay downtown. The service I recommend 500%!

I've been living here for two months now, and it's fantastic! This is my first visit to the US for a short internship. I wan to avoid the high costs of hotels, so I tried to book a 1B1B apartment online. Despite I do not having credit history, the Encore Team tried their best to verify my overseas addresses, some of which weren't even in English.

Since my arrival, the encore team has continued to impress with their exceptional service. The leasing agent Nato has patiently assisted me with understanding rent and utility bills and have promptly addressed all my maintenance requests.

I am a huge golfer as well and they have a GOLF SIMULATOR!!!! Huge Plus!

In terms of daily commuting, I don't have a car. It is good that the bus and TRAX stations are only a 3 2 minute walk away, making it easy for me to reach all my destinations.

Regarding noise, I would like to say that I have never noticed any noise, unless all the windows are open during TRAX running time, then I can hear a little TRAX ringtone.

I'm immensely grateful to the encore team for their professionalism and kindness.

I had the pleasure of living at Encore for the last 4 years. The stunning views and amenities made the experience incredible. If it wasn't for medical issues, I would renew my lease. I felt safe here. It is in walking distance to countless stores to shop from, food options, and rail station. The new management is also great! Nato is always eager to help and make me feel at home. The heated pool is also open all year long and my friends love coming over for it!

Staff is always professional, always willing to go the extra mile. It has been a great experience working with them so far. Nato the leasing agent made the entire leasing process as well as anything in between and after an effortless experience. The apartments overall are wonderful and the rest of the staff is amazing and great to work with. Always friendly, always a smile on their faces. I love this place!!!

Highly recommend this place. The location is very central and the staff is super friendly and caring especially Nahomi. She always makes sure your requests are completed and goes that extra mile for the residents. If you see her at the leasing office she would be more than happy to assist you with anything

My sister and I moved into a two bedroom apartment in August and we have absolutely loved living here! It's a great location - within walking distance from grocery stores, restaurants and downtown! The amenities are all kept so well and are fixed quickly if something is wrong. We have both felt safe in our apartment and the parking garage! The staff are so friendly and helpful and always available to help with whatever you need. Maintenance has also been great, whenever we have needed something done in the apartment they have done it within 24-48 hours. The only reason we aren't renewing our lease is because I am moving for a job, we highly recommend Encore!

We have loved it here! This is a great place to stay if you are looking for a central apartment in the heart of Salt Lake City! Great location and great views! We love all the amenities they provide and they also provide parking! That's a great thing to have when living downtown. 
I have to thank Nahomi and Rachel for making our life so much easier and helping us with all the application process. You guys are the best!

The current manager gives Encore five stars. I give it two. 

When the leasing office failed to mention the unit we'd reserved didn't have the primary feature we reserved it for--we should have walked. Danger ahead. 

We asked them if there was any other funny stuff going on. They said no. But we were put in a unit that didn't feel right. Turned out to be violating building codes left and right. Didn't have a single window that opened. Not even an air-pump to the outside. This isn't a glass skyscraper. It's a five-story in SLC. The unit smelled like a full jumbo-jet after a trans-Atlantic flight just because there was no ventilation at all. 

Making matters worse, the only intake point was the front door to the building's inner hallway (technically not an "intake" point). The hallway smelled like rotting flesh and garbage. We were told the reason for the garbage smell was the "valet trash service" tenants were using incorrectly. I was pretty sure there was a body decomposing somewhere. They disagreed. 

Long story short, we moved in the building and they charged us a lot of money for the privilege. We found out that the first unit was violating city code and their staff should have taken our concerns seriously. At least they should have listened to their own maintenance staff who thought it was a fire hazard. Also, the body was cooking on the fourth floor. 

When we complained about the air they treated us like it was all our fault. They said we'd signed a lease and that was that. We were "inconvenienced" by the smells and lack of clean air or any ability to open a single window. 

Look at a picture of this building. Would you expect to not have a single functioning window?

We expect far better for "urban luxury in downtown SLC." At a minimum we expect kindness and courtesy.

Moving into Encore was the best decision I made in moving from Los Angeles to Salt Lake City! Kara, the manager, helped me find the perfect apartment tailored to my needs, all while we were located in different states. Kara went above and beyond to send me photos of available units and spent several phone calls with me patiently discussing the differences and benefits of each unit. Kara helped me feel confident in the unit I selected, provided me with a clear breakdown of monthly costs (rent, parking, etc.) and made the application process easy (a huge relief when dealing with the stress of moving to a new state). 

Aside from the fantastic and responsive management staff, the quality of the building is the best there is in Salt Lake. The unit feels brand new, and the stainless steel appliances, wood floors, high ceilings and modern, simple design make for a beautiful place to call home. The communal areas are also stunning, with a great pool and hot tub, outdoor grills, clean and updated gym, golf simulator and lounge. The building feels extremely safe and secure (you need a fob for all points of entry), especially in the parking garages, which are well lit and always have plenty of open spots. Encore has a diverse mix of tenants, ranging from young singles to families, and it’s apparent that most all tenants are successful, career-oriented professionals. My apartment view overlooks the pool and grill area, where I consistently see people using the great amenities which makes for a fun and social environment. 

There is definitely a shared feeling of pride among those who are fortune enough to call Encore home, and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for the best apartment there is in downtown Salt Lake!

Beautiful building, beautifully maintained by the Wasatch A-team.  Then the building sold and Alliance took over management and maintenance.  Building getting dirtier by the day.  Unresponsive office personnel.  Tenant violations, mattresses in hallways, stealing gym equipment, bicycle theft.  If you work from home the internet is appalling, just fails to work at times during the day.  With the A team we had one woman who meticulously kept the whole building spit-spot.  With the C- team we've been through two individuals, who being nice people, haven't any clue how to clean slate floors, the gym, the elevator, etc.  I've worked in many professional buildings in downtown Dallas with ten times the traffic we have at Encore able to keep an impeccably clean appearance.  Don't understand the lack of standards nor the lack of initiative to research and improve.

I didn't know this when I moved in, but the garbage collections for the stores across the stress are quite common (4-5 times a week).  They're usually very early and surprising loud.  Think back-up beeping from a large truck plus a lot of "dummmmm dump" from the trucks unloading the trash.  No smell but it would have been nice if they informed the people on the East side of the building.  Guess I'll be hearing this for 1.5 years given my lease.  Le Sigh.  On a note on trash, maybe its because people are just moving in, but I keep finding trash in the hallways over the weekends (which can be smelly).  They have a trash collection service (a perk, that you're not allowed to opt out of - & they've increased it incrementally so don't be surprised if you're rent goes up juuuust a little bit every few months) where people pick up your garbage on the weekday.  One of those trash valets as you would say.  But they skip the weekends...so when people leave they're trash out on Friday night...it stays there all weekend until late Monday night.  If you have one of those neighbors...good luck.  Also, don't live on the South side of the building unless you want to hear the Trax all night.  If you haven't lived that close to Trax, I suggest you don't try it.

Moved in in December.  Expect a lot of maintenance calls.  So far I think every unit had to update their washer/dryer because they didn't install it right.  Something about them bumping into each other if you use both of them at once.  They also had to have people install water measure systems, etc.  For my apartment, I had a lot of cabinet issues (hinges coming loose, paint where it shouldn't be, etc).  You would think all would be complete for a something so new.
It may look pretty nice, but once you start living, you'll find out a lot of the things breaking down

5th floor is still unfinished.  They said it would be by the time I moved in.  Been 2 months now & they still haven't addressed it.  Also, I found it pretty unethical that they started tacking on hidden fees after I moved in with my wife.  Oh!  We didn't mentioned but we're increasing your rent for (unreal reason here).

Don’t live here seriously! This place is poorly managed, no one can be trusted, snow removal is a joke. One positive they kicked out my neighbor quickly. Please read whole review. 

My problems started before I even moved in. Three weeks before move in they let me know that there was flooding in my apartment, but they assured me my apartment would be ready in time. Luckily after waiting all day and pushing back my mover’s everything was finished that day.

My BIGGEST PROBLEM!!! At the time I LIVED ALONG. I also didn’t have anyone over because I was new to the area. I bought an engagement ring for my now wife who lived out of state and had it in a desk. I last saw this ring right before an inspection and a work order. Three people from their staff came into my apartment when I wasn’t there. Again I lived alone and the ring disappeared. I filed a police report, my doors and windows were always lock, and my renters insurance only covered a small portion of what I paid for the ring. 

Needless to say after that I felt really unsafe living there. I bought multiple cameras (some hidden) and always watched it after they came in.

Lastly for the bad, the snow removal. If you are older looking at this place please be careful. There were multiple occasions when I left for work around 7-8am the sidewalks weren’t shelved in the winter.  I almost fell a few times because my sidewalk was on a small hill. I noted one time no one came around until 9:30 am. 

There were two positives. Since I had all the cameras up. I did catch my upstairs neighbor stealing my packages. I turned him into the office and he was quickly evicted. The second is I sadly had to renew my lease, but I enrolled in a home buyers program with them. This allowed me to end my new lease 3 months after it started if I bought a home.

They really nice in the beginning and told me they offered 3 different types of tours including virtual tours.
